intro.en: These are all words for things that happen or the force that causes them to happen.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指机遇、命运、运气。

items.def: the force that causes good or bad things to happen to people:
items.zh: 指机遇、命运、运气

examples.en: This ring has always brought me good luck.
examples.zh: 这戒指总是给我带来好运。

items.def: the way that some things happen without any cause that you can see or understand:
items.zh: 指偶然、碰巧、意外

examples.en: The results could simply be due to chance.
examples.zh: 这结果可能纯属意外。

items.def: the fact of two things happening at the same time by chance, in a surprising way:
items.zh: 指出人意料的巧合、巧事

examples.en: They met through a series of strange coincidences.
examples.zh: 他们因一连串奇妙的巧合而相遇。

items.def: something that happens unexpectedly and is not planned in advance:
items.zh: 指意外、偶然的事

examples.en: Their early arrival was just an accident.
examples.zh: 他们早到仅仅是偶然而已。

items.def: the power that is believed to control everything that happens and that cannot be stopped or changed:
items.zh: 指命运、天数、定数、天意

examples.en: Fate decreed that she would never reach America.
examples.zh: 命中注定她永远到不了美国。

items.def: the power that is believed to control events:
items.zh: 指主宰事物的力量、命运之神

examples.en: I believe there’s some force guiding us—call it God, destiny or fate.
examples.zh: 我认为有某种力量在指引着我们，称之为上帝也罢，天意也罢，或是命运也罢。

senses.def: the part of a hospital where people who need immediate treatment are taken

examples.en: The teenager was rushed to accident and emergency.
examples.zh: 那个少年被紧急送进了急诊室。

examples.en: the hospital accident and emergency department
examples.zh: 医院的急诊部

senses.def: more likely to have accidents than other people, companies, etc.

examples.en: She was the most accident-prone of the four children.
examples.zh: 她是四个孩子中最容易出意外的。

examples.en: another major incident on the state's accident-prone rail system
examples.zh: 该州事故多发的铁路系统又发生重大事件

senses.def: happening by chance; not planned

examples.en: a verdict of accidental death
examples.zh: 意外死亡的裁决

examples.en: I didn't think our meeting was accidental—he must have known I would be there.
examples.zh: 我认为我们相遇不是偶然的 － 他肯定知道我要去那里。

senses.def: by chance; in a way that was not planned

examples.en: As I turned around, I accidentally hit him in the face.
examples.zh: 我转身时不经意打到他的脸。

examples.en: The damage couldn't have been caused accidentally.
examples.zh: 这损失不可能是偶然因素造成的。

senses.def: people say accidents will happen
to praise or welcome somebody/something publicly
senses.zh: 公开称誉某人／某事物（为…）；给予高度评价

examples.en: The work was acclaimed as a masterpiece.
examples.zh: 该作品被誉为杰作。

examples.en: This book has been widely acclaimed as a modern classic.
examples.zh: 这本书被广泛誉为现代的经典之作。

examples.en: a highly/widely acclaimed performance
examples.zh: 受到高度／广泛赞扬的演出

examples.en: Mario Vargas Llosa, the internationally acclaimed novelist
examples.zh: 马里奥•巴尔加斯•略萨，在国际上受到广泛称誉的小说家

senses.def: praise and approval for somebody/something, especially an artistic achievement
senses.zh: （尤指对艺术成就的）称誉，高度评价

examples.en: international/popular/critical acclaim
examples.zh: 国际上的／公众的／评论家的赞扬

senses.def: loud and enthusiastic approval or welcome
the act of electing somebody using a spoken not written vote

examples.en: The decision was taken by acclamation.
examples.zh: 该决议是经口头表决而作出的。

senses.def: to get used to a new place, situation or climate
senses.zh: （使）习惯（新地方、新情况、新气候）；（使）服水土

examples.en: Competitors should arrive two weeks earlier to get acclimated to the sweltering heat.
examples.zh: 参赛者应提前两周抵达以适应酷热。

senses.def: the process of getting used to a new place, situation or climate
senses.zh: （使）习惯（新地方、新情况、新气候）；（使）服水土

examples.en: acclimation to high temperatures
examples.zh: 适应高温

senses.def: the process of getting used to a new place, situation or climate
senses.zh: （使）习惯（新地方、新情况、新气候）；（使）服水土

examples.en: Several studies investigated acclimatization to low temperatures.
examples.zh: 几项研究调查了对低温的适应情况。

senses.def: to get used to a new place, situation or climate
senses.zh: （使）习惯（新地方、新情况、新气候）；（使）服水土

examples.en: Arrive two days early in order to acclimatize.
examples.zh: 提前两天到达以便适应新环境。

examples.en: It takes many months to acclimatize to life in the tropics.
examples.zh: 适应热带地区的生活需要几个月的时间。

examples.en: We haven’t got acclimatized to village life yet.
examples.zh: 我们还没有习惯乡村生活。

examples.en: She was fine once she had acclimatized herself to the cold.
examples.zh: 当她习惯了寒冷以后身体便好了起来。

senses.def: praise or an award for an achievement that people admire

examples.en: Four restaurants have been awarded the highest accolade of a three-star rating.
examples.zh: 4 家餐馆被授予三星级餐馆的最高荣誉称号。

examples.en: a long list of industry accolades
examples.zh: 一长串工业界的荣誉

examples.en: He was finally awarded the ultimate accolade —British Hairdresser of the Year—five years later.
examples.zh: 五年后，他终于获得了终极荣誉——英国年度美发师。

senses.def: to provide somebody with a room or place to sleep, live or sit
senses.zh: 提供住宿（或膳宿、座位等）

examples.en: The hotel can accommodate up to 500 guests.
examples.zh: 这家旅馆最多可供 500 位旅客住宿。

examples.en: The aircraft is capable of accommodating 28 passengers.
examples.zh: 这架飞机能容纳28名乘客。

senses.def: to provide enough space for somebody/something

examples.en: The garage can accommodate three cars.
examples.zh: 这个车库可以停放三辆车。

examples.en: The old town hall now accommodates a Folk Museum.
examples.zh: 老市政厅现在设有民俗博物馆。

senses.def: to consider something such as somebody’s opinion or a fact and be influenced by it when you are deciding what to do or explaining something

examples.en: Our proposal tries to accommodate the special needs of minority groups.
examples.zh: 我们的提案尽量照顾到少数群体的特殊需要。

examples.en: She modified her views so as to accommodate the objections of American feminists.
examples.zh: 她改变了自己的观点，以适应美国女权主义者的反对意见。

senses.def: to help somebody by doing what they want

examples.en: I have accommodated the press a great deal, giving numerous interviews.
examples.zh: 我多次接受采访，已给了新闻界许多方便。

examples.en: I’m sure the bank will be able to accommodate you.
examples.zh: 我确信银行能够满足您的要求。

senses.def: to change your behaviour so that you can deal with a new situation better

examples.en: I needed to accommodate to the new schedule.
examples.zh: 我需要适应新的时间表。

senses.def: a place to live, work or stay in

examples.en: rented/temporary accommodation
examples.zh: 租来的／临时的住处

examples.en: Hotel accommodation is included in the price of your holiday.
examples.zh: 你度假的价钱包括旅馆住宿。

examples.en: We may have to provide alternative accommodation for you.
examples.zh: 我们可能不得不为您提供其他住处。

examples.en: First-class accommodation is available on all flights.
examples.zh: 所有班机都备有头等舱位。

examples.en: It can be difficult to find suitable accommodation for those in need.
examples.zh: 为有需要的人找到合适的住宿可能很困难。

examples.en: The building plans include much needed new office accommodation.
examples.zh: 建筑规划包括紧缺的新办公用房在内。

examples.en: furnished accommodation
examples.zh: 连家具出租房

senses.def: somewhere to live or stay, often also providing food or other services

examples.en: More and more travelers are looking for bed and breakfast accommodations in private homes.
examples.zh: 愈来愈多的旅行者在寻找提供住宿加早餐的民宿。

examples.en: The boat provides reasonable overnight accommodations for four adults.
examples.zh: 这艘小船可为 4 个成年人提供一晚上不错的食宿。

senses.def: an agreement or arrangement between people or groups with different opinions that is acceptable to everyone; the process of reaching this agreement

examples.en: They were forced to reach an accommodation with the rebels.
examples.zh: 他们被迫与叛乱分子达成调解协议。

examples.en: The two countries should be persuaded to work towards some sort of mutual accommodation.
examples.zh: 应该说服两国努力实现某种互惠互利。

senses.def: the way in which the lens
senses.zh: （眼睛）调节晶状体形状实现聚焦

senses.def: music that is played to support singing or another instrument

examples.en: traditional songs with piano accompaniment
examples.zh: 用钢琴伴奏的传统歌曲

senses.def: something that you eat, drink or use together with something else

examples.en: The wine makes a good accompaniment to fish dishes.
examples.zh: 这种葡萄酒很适合作鱼菜的佐餐酒。

examples.en: These wines also make a good accompaniment for vegetarian dishes.
examples.zh: 这些葡萄酒配素菜吃也很好。

examples.en: Serve plain rice as an accompaniment.
examples.zh: 配上白米饭。

senses.def: something that happens or exists at the same time as another thing
senses.zh: 伴随发生的事情；伴生物

examples.en: The sun was back, with its accompaniment of dust and flies.
examples.zh: 太阳重新露了出来，灰尘和苍蝇也随之出现。

examples.en: the market, with its inevitable accompaniment of bustle and noise
examples.zh: 不可避免地会伴有喧闹和嘈杂声的市场

examples.en: High blood pressure is a common accompaniment to this disease.
examples.zh: 这种病通常伴随有高血压。

senses.def: while a musical instrument is being played

examples.en: They performed to the accompaniment of guitars.
examples.zh: 他们在吉他的伴奏下表演。

examples.en: She sang to the accompaniment of a guitar.
examples.zh: 她在吉他的伴奏下演唱。

senses.def: while something else is happening
senses.zh: 在…发生时；伴随有；同时有

examples.en: She made her speech to the accompaniment of loud laughter.
examples.zh: 她的演讲不断引起哄堂大笑。

examples.en: The women's medical school opened in 1874, to the accompaniment of much ridicule of ‘lady doctors’.
examples.zh: 女子医学院在一片对“女医生”的嘲笑声中于1874年创立。

senses.def: while a musical instrument is being played

examples.en: They performed to the accompaniment of guitars.
examples.zh: 他们在吉他的伴奏下表演。

examples.en: She sang to the accompaniment of a guitar.
examples.zh: 她在吉他的伴奏下演唱。

senses.def: while something else is happening
senses.zh: 在…发生时；伴随有；同时有

examples.en: She made her speech to the accompaniment of loud laughter.
examples.zh: 她的演讲不断引起哄堂大笑。

examples.en: The women's medical school opened in 1874, to the accompaniment of much ridicule of ‘lady doctors’.
examples.zh: 女子医学院在一片对“女医生”的嘲笑声中于1874年创立。

senses.def: a person who plays a musical instrument, especially a piano, while somebody else plays or sings the main part of the music
senses.zh: 伴奏者；（尤指）钢琴伴奏者

senses.def: to travel or go somewhere with somebody/something

examples.en: His wife accompanied him on the trip.
examples.zh: 那次旅行他由妻子陪同。

examples.en: She was accompanied on the visit by her partner.
examples.zh: 她的伴侣陪同她参观。

examples.en: I must ask you to accompany me to the police station.
examples.zh: 我必须请你和我一起去警察局。

examples.en: Warships will accompany the convoy.
examples.zh: 船队将由军舰护航。

examples.en: The groups are always accompanied by an experienced mountain guide.
examples.zh: 登山队总有一名经验丰富的向导同行。

examples.en: Each young person must be accompanied by an adult.
examples.zh: 每个年轻人必须有一名成人陪同。

senses.def: to happen or appear with something else

examples.en: Shouts of protest accompanied this announcement.
examples.zh: 公告刚一宣布就引来一片抗议声。

examples.en: strong winds accompanied by heavy rain
examples.zh: 狂风夹着暴雨

examples.en: The text is accompanied by a series of stunning photographs.
examples.zh: 文字附有一系列令人惊叹的照片。

examples.en: Tax cuts have been accompanied by massive increases in public expenditure.
examples.zh: 减税伴随着公共支出的大幅增加。

senses.def: to play a musical instrument, especially a piano, while somebody else sings or plays the main tune

examples.en: The singer was accompanied on the piano by her sister.
examples.zh: 女歌手由她姐姐钢琴伴奏。

senses.def: a person who helps another to commit a crime or to do something wrong

examples.en: She became his unwitting accomplice in the robbery.
examples.zh: 她稀里糊涂地成了他进行抢劫的帮凶。

examples.en: an accomplice to murder
examples.zh: 谋杀案的共犯

examples.en: The police suspect that she had an accomplice.
examples.zh: 警方怀疑她有同伙。

senses.def: to succeed in doing or completing something

examples.en: The first part of the plan has been safely accomplished.
examples.zh: 计划的第一部分已顺利完成。

examples.en: I don't feel I've accomplished very much today.
examples.zh: 我觉得我今天没干成多少事。

examples.en: That's it. Mission accomplished (= we have done what we aimed to do).
examples.zh: 就这样。大功告成。

senses.def: an impressive thing that is done or achieved after a lot of work

examples.en: It was one of the President's greatest accomplishments.
examples.zh: 那是总统最大的成就之一。

examples.en: The series of paintings is quite an accomplishment.
examples.zh: 这一系列的绘画作品是相当有成就的。

senses.def: a skill or special ability

examples.en: Drawing and singing were among her many accomplishments.
examples.zh: 她多才多艺，能歌善画。

examples.en: He was described as ‘a poet of rare accomplishment’.
examples.zh: 他被描述为“一位具有罕见成就的诗人”。

senses.def: the successful completing of something

examples.en: Money will be crucial to the accomplishment of our objectives.
examples.zh: 要实现我们的目标，钱是至关重要的。

examples.en: There is a real sense of accomplishment when everything goes right.
examples.zh: 一切顺利时，人们就会有真正的成就感。

senses.def: a formal agreement between two organizations, countries, etc.

examples.en: The two sides signed a peace accord last July.
examples.zh: 在刚过去的七月，双方签订了和平条约。

senses.def: in agreement with

examples.en: This action would not be in accord with our policy.
examples.zh: 这一行动不会符合我们的方针。

examples.en: Botanists are not in complete accord about how many species exist.
examples.zh: 植物学家对总共存在多少物种的看法并不完全一致。

senses.def: without being asked, forced or helped

examples.en: He came back of his own accord.
examples.zh: 他主动回来了。

examples.en: The symptoms will clear up of their own accord.
examples.zh: 症状将会自行消失。

senses.def: if people do something with one accord
to give somebody/something authority, status or a particular type of treatment
senses.zh: 给予，赠予，授予（权力、地位、某种待遇）

examples.en: Our society accords great importance to the family.
examples.zh: 我们的社会赋予家庭十分重要的地位。

examples.en: There were complaints about the special treatment accorded to some of the candidates.
examples.zh: 有人抱怨一些候选人受到特殊待遇。

examples.en: Our society accords the family great importance.
examples.zh: 我们的社会赋予家庭十分重要的地位。

senses.def: in agreement with

examples.en: This action would not be in accord with our policy.
examples.zh: 这一行动不会符合我们的方针。

examples.en: Botanists are not in complete accord about how many species exist.
examples.zh: 植物学家对总共存在多少物种的看法并不完全一致。

senses.def: without being asked, forced or helped

examples.en: He came back of his own accord.
examples.zh: 他主动回来了。

examples.en: The symptoms will clear up of their own accord.
examples.zh: 症状将会自行消失。

senses.def: if people do something with one accord
to agree with or match something

examples.en: These results accord closely with our predictions.
examples.zh: 这些结果和我们的预测高度一致。

examples.en: His views accord with public opinion.
examples.zh: 他的观点符合民意。

examples.en: We ensure that our goods accord with modern standards.
examples.zh: 我们确保我们的商品符合现代标准。

examples.en: His version of events does not accord fully with the facts.
examples.zh: 他对事情的描述与事实不完全相符。

senses.def: according to a rule or the way that somebody says that something should be done

examples.en: in accordance with legal requirements
examples.zh: 根据法律要求

examples.en: We acted in accordance with my parents’ wishes.
examples.zh: 我们按照父母的意愿行事。

senses.def: according to the standards that somebody sets for himself or herself
senses.zh: 根据为自己设定的标准

examples.en: The police were left to do the job according to their lights.
examples.zh: 警察只能根据自己的信号来执行任务。

senses.def: as stated or reported by somebody/something

examples.en: According to Mick, it's a great movie.
examples.zh: 据米克说，这是一部了不起的电影。

examples.en: You've been absent six times according to our records.
examples.zh: 根据我们的记录，你已经缺席六次了。

senses.def: following, agreeing with or depending on something

examples.en: The work was done according to her instructions.
examples.zh: 这项工作是依照她的指示办的。

examples.en: Everything went according to plan.
examples.zh: 一切均按照计划进行。

examples.en: The salary will be fixed according to qualifications and experience.
examples.zh: 薪金将依资历和经验而定。

senses.def: to do only what you have enough money to do and no more

examples.en: We wanted to buy a bigger house than this but it was a case of cutting our coat according to our cloth.
examples.zh: 我们想买栋更大的房子，但只能量入为出。

items.idm: cut your coat according to your cloth

senses.def: to do only what you have enough money to do and no more

examples.en: We wanted to buy a bigger house than this but it was a case of cutting our coat according to our cloth.
examples.zh: 我们想买栋更大的房子，但只能量入为出。

senses.def: in a way that is appropriate to what has been done or said in a particular situation

examples.en: We have to discover his plans and act accordingly.
examples.zh: 我们得弄清楚他的计划，然后采取相应措施。

senses.def: for that reason

examples.en: The cost of materials rose sharply last year. Accordingly, we were forced to increase our prices.
examples.zh: 去年材料成本大幅度提高，因此我们被迫加价。

senses.def: a musical instrument that you hold in both hands to produce sounds. You press the two ends together and pull them apart and press buttons and/or keys to produce the different notes.
to go up to somebody and speak to them, especially in a way that is rude or frightening
senses.zh: （贸然）上前搭讪；（唐突地）走近谈话

examples.en: She was accosted in the street by a complete stranger.
examples.zh: 在街上，一个完全陌生的人贸然走到她跟前搭讪。

senses.def: an arrangement that somebody has with a bank, etc. to keep money there, take some out, etc.

examples.en: I don't have a bank account.
examples.zh: 我没有银行账户。

examples.en: I paid the money into my savings account.
examples.zh: 我把这笔钱存入了我的储蓄账户。

examples.en: a joint account (= one in the name of more than one person)
examples.zh: 联名账户

examples.en: With internet banking you can manage your account online.
examples.zh: 通过网上银行，您可以在线管理您的帐户。

examples.en: Do you have an account with us?
examples.zh: 您在我们这里有账户吗？

examples.en: He opened an account at a bank in Germany.
examples.zh: 他在德国一家银行开了账户。

examples.en: Interest will be paid monthly into the account holder's current account.
examples.zh: 利息将每月支付到账户持有人的往来账户中。

examples.en: What's your account number please?
examples.zh: 请问您的账号？

senses.def: an arrangement that somebody has with a company that allows them to use the internet, send and receive messages by email, social media, etc.
senses.zh: （互联网、电子邮件、社交媒体等的）账户，账号

examples.en: an email/Instagram account
examples.zh: 电子邮件/Instagram 帐户

examples.en: Millions of accounts have been hacked.
examples.zh: 数以百万计的帐户被黑客入侵。

senses.def: a written or spoken description of something that has happened

examples.en: an eyewitness account (= a description given by somebody who saw what happened)
examples.zh: 目击者的描述

examples.en: a first-hand/personal/first-person account
examples.zh: 第一手/个人/第一人称帐户

examples.en: Can you give us an account of what happened?
examples.zh: 你能给我们讲述一下事发经过吗？

examples.en: The diaries contain a detailed account of the writer's experiences on the voyage.
examples.zh: 日记详细记述了作者在航行中的经历。

senses.def: an explanation or a description of an idea, a theory or a process
senses.zh: （对思想、理论、过程的）解释，说明，叙述

examples.en: the Biblical account of the creation of the world
examples.zh: 《圣经》对创世的叙述

senses.def: a written record of money that is owed to a business and of money that has been paid by it

examples.en: to do the accounts
examples.zh: 记账

examples.en: to keep the accounts up to date
examples.zh: 及时更新账目

examples.en: the accounts department
examples.zh: 会计部门

examples.en: She works in Accounts (= the accounts department).
examples.zh: 她在财务部工作。

senses.def: an arrangement with a shop or business to pay bills for goods or services at a later time, for example in regular amounts every month

examples.en: Put it on my account please.
examples.zh: 请记在我的赊购账上。

examples.en: We have accounts with most of our suppliers.
examples.zh: 我们与大多数供应商都是实行赊购制。

examples.en: Log in to your account to see how much you have spent.
examples.zh: 登录您的帐户即可查看您已花费了多少钱。

senses.def: a bill for goods or services provided over a period

examples.en: Departing guests should settle their accounts at the office.
examples.zh: 离店客人应在服务处结账。

examples.en: It is best to settle the account each month.
examples.zh: 最好每月清账。

senses.def: a regular customer

examples.en: The agency has lost several of its most important accounts.
examples.zh: 这家代理机构失去了几家最重要的老客户。

senses.def: a description of an event that gives you all the details in the order in which they happen

examples.en: He insisted on giving us a blow-by-blow account of what had happened.
examples.zh: 他坚持要向我们详细讲述所发生的事情。

examples.en: She gave us a blow-by-blow account of the incident.
examples.zh: 她向我们详细讲述了这起事件。

senses.def: according to what other people say

examples.en: I've never been there, but it's a lovely place, by all accounts.
examples.zh: 我从未去过那里，但据说是个美丽的地方。

senses.def: according to what you say yourself

examples.en: By his own account he had an unhappy childhood.
examples.zh: 据他自己说，他童年不快乐。

senses.def: to make somebody explain a mistake, etc. because they are responsible for it
to do something or perform well, especially in a contest
senses.zh: （尤指比赛中）表现好，干得出色

examples.en: The team gave a good account of themselves in the match.
examples.zh: 这个队在比赛中表现出色。

senses.def: not important
senses.zh: 不重要的；次要的；无足轻重的

examples.en: Emotional matters were of no account to them during the war.
examples.zh: 战争期间，情感问题对他们来说并不重要。

senses.def: if you buy something or pay on account
senses.zh: 挂账；（先付小部分款额的）赊账

examples.en: Call a cab on account.
examples.zh: 打电话以赊账方式叫辆出租车。

examples.en: She bought the furniture she wanted on account.
examples.zh: 她赊购了想要的家具。

senses.def: because of what you think somebody wants

examples.en: Please don't change your plans on my account.
examples.zh: 请别因为我而改变你的计划。

senses.def: because of somebody/something

examples.en: She retired early on account of ill health.
examples.zh: 她体弱多病，所以提前退休。

examples.en: The marsh is an area of great scientific interest on account of its wild flowers.
examples.zh: 该沼泽因其野花而成为具有重大科学意义的地区。

senses.def: not for any reason

examples.en: On no account should the house be left unlocked.
examples.zh: 离开住宅时千万要锁门。

senses.def: for yourself

examples.en: In 2012 Smith set up in business on his own account.
examples.zh: 2012 年史密斯开始创业。

senses.def: because you want to and you have decided, not somebody else

examples.en: No one sent me. I am here on my own account.
examples.zh: 没有人派我，我自己来的。

senses.def: because of the particular thing that has been mentioned

examples.en: Weather conditions were poor, but he did not delay his departure on that account.
examples.zh: 天气不好，但他并没有因此延期启程。

senses.def: to use something in a good or helpful way

examples.en: He turned his artistic talents to good account by becoming a sculptor.
examples.zh: 他成为一名雕塑家，充分发挥了自己的艺术才能。

senses.def: to hurt or punish somebody who has harmed or cheated you in the past
senses.zh: （和某人）算账，清算旧账；报复（某人）

examples.en: ‘Who would do such a thing?’ ‘Maybe someone with an old score to settle.’
examples.zh: “谁做得出这样的事呢？”“也许是结有宿怨的人吧。”

examples.en: An embittered Charlotte is determined to settle accounts with Elizabeth.
examples.zh: 愤怒的夏洛特决心与伊丽莎白算账。

senses.def: to consider particular facts, circumstances, etc. when making a decision about something

examples.en: The company takes account of environmental issues wherever possible.
examples.zh: 这家公司总是尽量考虑到各方面的环境问题。

examples.en: Coursework is taken into account as well as exam results.
examples.zh: 除考试结果外，课程作业也要计入成绩。

senses.def: to have the opinion that somebody/something is a particular thing

examples.en: In English law a person is accounted innocent until they are proved guilty.
examples.zh: 按英格兰法律，一个人未经证实有罪之前被视为无罪。

examples.en: The event was accounted a success.
examples.zh: 人们认为这次活动是成功的。

senses.def: used to say how difficult it is to understand why somebody likes somebody/something that you do not like at all
senses.zh: 人的爱憎好恶是无法解释的；人各有所好

examples.en: They think it's wonderful—oh well, there's no accounting for taste.
examples.zh: 他们认为这太棒了——哦，好吧，品味是无法解释的。

intro.en: These are all words for a written or spoken account of events.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指对所发生事情的记述、讲述。

items.def: a written or spoken account of an event, especially one that is published or broadcast:
items.zh: 尤指刊登或广播的报道

examples.en: Are these newspaper reports true?
examples.zh: 报纸上这些报道属实吗？

items.def: an account, often spoken, of what happened to somebody or of how something happened; a report of events in a newspaper, magazine or news broadcast:
items.zh: 常指对所发生事情的口头叙述、描述、（新闻）报道

examples.en: It was many years before the full story was made public.
examples.zh: 许多年之后，事情的全貌才公之于众。

items.def: a written or spoken description of something that has happened:
items.zh: 指对所发生事情的书面或口头描述、叙述、报告

examples.en: She gave the police a full account of the incident.
examples.zh: 她向警方详尽地叙述了所发生的事情。

items.def: a description of an event from the point of view of a particular person or group of people:
items.zh: 指特定的人或群体对某事的描述、说法

examples.en: She gave us her version of what had happened that day.
examples.zh: 她从她的角度向我们描述了那天发生的事情。

intro.en: These are all words for a record of how much you owe for goods or services you have bought or used.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指账单、账目。

items.def: a list of goods that you have bought or services that you have used, showing how much you owe; the price or cost of something:
items.zh: 指账单

examples.en: the gas bill
examples.zh: 煤气费账单

items.def: an arrangement with a shop or business to pay bills for goods or services at a later time, for example in regular amounts every month:
items.zh: 指赊销账、赊欠账、赊购

examples.en: Put it on my account please.
examples.zh: 请记在我的赊购账上。

items.def: (rather formal) a bill for goods that somebody has bought or work that has been done for somebody:
items.zh: 指发票、发货或服务费用清单

examples.en: The builders sent an invoice for £250.
examples.zh: 营造商发出了一张 250 英镑的发票。

items.def: (North American English美式英语) a piece of paper that shows how much you have to pay for the food and drinks that you have had in a restaurant:
items.zh: 指餐馆的账单

examples.en: Can I have the check, please?
examples.zh: 请给我结账。

senses.def: a business person, especially one working in advertising, marketing or public relations
senses.zh: 客户经理（尤指在广告、市场、公关部门中负责为指定长期客户提供服务者）

senses.def: to be the explanation or cause of something

examples.en: The poor weather may have accounted for the small crowd.
examples.zh: 天气不好可能是人来得少的原因。

examples.en: Oh well, that accounts for it (= I understand now why it happened).
examples.zh: 哎呀，原来是这么一回事。

examples.en: The differences in achievement between the pupils are partly accounted for by differences in age.
examples.zh: 学生之间成绩的差异部分是由年龄差异造成的。

senses.def: to give an explanation of something

examples.en: How do you account for the show's success?
examples.zh: 你认为这次演出为何成功？

examples.en: He was unable to account for the error.
examples.zh: 他无法解释这个错误。

examples.en: The increase can be fully accounted for.
examples.zh: 这种增长完全可以作出解释。

senses.def: to be a particular amount or part of something

examples.en: The Japanese market accounts for 35 per cent of the company's revenue.
examples.zh: 日本市场占该公司收入的 35%。

senses.def: to know where somebody/something is or what has happened to them, especially after an accident

examples.en: All passengers have now been accounted for.
examples.zh: 现在所有乘客的情况均已查明。

examples.en: Three files cannot be accounted for.
examples.zh: 三个文件无法解释清楚。

senses.def: to defeat or destroy somebody/something

examples.en: Their anti-aircraft guns accounted for five enemy bombers.
examples.zh: 他们的高射炮占了敌方轰炸机的五架。

senses.def: to give a record of how the money in your care has been spent
senses.zh: 报账；出示经手款项的单据

examples.en: We have to account for every penny we spend on business trips.
examples.zh: 我们出公差所用的每一便士都得报清楚。

senses.def: the fact of being responsible for your decisions or actions and expected to explain them when you are asked
senses.zh: （对自己的决定、行为）负有责任，有说明义务

examples.en: proposals for greater police accountability
examples.zh: 加强警方问责制的提案

examples.en: the accountability of a company’s directors to the shareholders
examples.zh: 公司董事对股东所负之责

senses.def: responsible for your decisions or actions and expected to explain them when you are asked
senses.zh: （对自己的决定、行为）负有责任，有说明义务

examples.en: The state spends taxpayers’ money and should be held accountable.
examples.zh: 国家花的是纳税人的钱，所以应该承担责任。

examples.en: Politicians are ultimately accountable to the voters.
examples.zh: 从政者最终是向选民负责。

examples.en: Someone must be held accountable for the killings.
examples.zh: 必须有人要对这些凶杀事件负责。

senses.def: the work or profession of an accountant

examples.en: She studied accountancy at university.
examples.zh: 她在大学里学会计。

examples.en: It had taken considerable ‘creative accountancy’ on my part to produce a set of figures that showed us making any profit at all.
examples.zh: 我在一定程度上“造账”，以提供一套数字，表示我们根本没有盈利。

examples.en: the members of the different professional accountancy bodies
examples.zh: 不同行业会计团体的成员

senses.def: a person whose job is to keep or check financial accounts

examples.en: We talked to the company’s chief accountant.
examples.zh: 我们和公司的总会计师进行了交谈。

examples.en: the investigating accountant’s report
examples.zh: 审查会计师报告

senses.def: money that is owed by a company; the department of the company that deals with paying this money
senses.zh: 应付账款；应付账款部门

examples.en: He works in accounts payable.
examples.zh: 他在应付账款部工作。

senses.def: money that is owed to a company; the department of a company that deals with this money, sending out invoices
senses.zh: 应收账款；应收账款部门

examples.en: a clerk in accounts receivable
examples.zh: 应收账款文员

senses.def: dressed in a particular type of clothing or having a particular type of equipment, especially a type that is impressive or likely to attract attention
senses.zh: 有装备的：穿着特定类型的衣服或具有特定类型的设备，尤其是令人印象深刻或可能引起注意的类型

examples.en: She arrived accoutred in an ankle-length leather coat.
examples.zh: 她到达时穿着一件及踝的皮大衣。

senses.def: pieces of equipment that you need for a particular activity

examples.en: There was the waiting surgeon, green-gowned nurses and all the alarming accoutrements of modern medicine.
examples.zh: 那里有等待的外科医生、穿着绿袍的护士和所有令人震惊的现代医学装备。

senses.def: to believe that somebody is responsible for doing or saying something
senses.zh: 把…归于；认为（某事为某人所说、所做）

examples.en: The discovery of distillation is usually accredited to the Arabs of the 11th century.
examples.zh: 通常认为，蒸馏法是阿拉伯人在 11 世纪发明的。

examples.en: The Arabs are usually accredited with the discovery of distillation.
examples.zh: 通常认为，阿拉伯人发明了蒸馏法。

examples.en: She is accredited with having first introduced the word into the language.
examples.zh: 她被认为是第一个将这个词引入该语言的人。

senses.def: to choose somebody for an official position, especially as an ambassador
senses.zh: 委任，委派（某人为大使等）

examples.en: He was accredited to Madrid.
examples.zh: 他被委任为驻马德里大使。

senses.def: to officially approve something/somebody as being of an accepted quality or standard

examples.en: Institutions that do not meet the standards will not be accredited for teacher training.
examples.zh: 没有达标的机构不会获得教师培训的资格。

senses.def: official approval given by an organization stating that somebody/something has achieved a required standard

examples.en: a letter of accreditation
examples.zh: 一份合格证明书

examples.en: The Accreditation of Prior Learning scheme allows work experience to be added towards qualifications.
examples.zh: 先前学习认证计划允许将工作经验添加到资格中。

senses.def: a British organization run by the British Council
senses.zh: 由英国文化协会和UK UK运营的英国组织，对以英语为外语授课的学校和学院给予正式批准

senses.def: a layer of a substance or a piece of matter that is slowly added to something
the process of new layers or matter being slowly added to something

examples.en: the accretion of sand by wind action
examples.zh: 风作用引起的沙子堆积

senses.def: the fact of something increasing over a period of time

examples.en: the accrual of interest
examples.zh: 利息积累

senses.def: a sum or money or a debt that has been allowed to grow over a period of time

examples.en: The firm had trade creditors and accruals totalling €362 236.
examples.zh: 该公司的贸易债权人和应计费用总计 362 236 欧元。

senses.def: to increase over a period of time

examples.en: Interest will accrue if you keep your money in a savings account.
examples.zh: 如果把钱存入储蓄账户，就会自然生息。

examples.en: economic benefits accruing to the country from tourism
examples.zh: 旅游业为该国带来的经济效益

senses.def: to allow a sum of money or debts to grow over a period of time

examples.en: The firm had accrued debts of over $6m.
examples.zh: 该公司已积欠了 600 多万美元的债务。

examples.en: The money was placed in a special account to accrue interest.
examples.zh: 那笔钱放在一个专门账户下生息。

senses.def: account (= an arrangement that somebody has with a bank, etc. to keep money there)
to learn to live successfully in a different culture; to help somebody to do this

examples.en: people who have acculturated to a new society
examples.zh: 已经适应新社会的人

examples.en: The course is designed to acculturate new staff.
examples.zh: 该课程旨在培养新员工。

senses.def: the process of learning to live successfully in a different culture; the process of helping somebody to do this

examples.en: the acculturation of immigrants to American society
examples.zh: 移民对美国社会的文化适应

examples.en: The process of acculturation included bonding over food and family.
examples.zh: 文化适应的过程包括通过食物和家庭建立联系。

senses.def: to gradually get more and more of something over a period of time

examples.en: I seem to have accumulated a lot of books.
examples.zh: 我好像已经收集了很多书。

examples.en: By investing wisely she accumulated a fortune.
examples.zh: 她投资精明，积累了一笔财富。

examples.en: We have accumulated a great amount of evidence.
examples.zh: 我们积累了大量证据。

senses.def: to gradually increase in number or quantity over a period of time
senses.zh: （数量）逐渐增加；（数额）逐渐增长

examples.en: Debts began to accumulate.
examples.zh: 债务开始增加。

examples.en: Dust and dirt soon accumulate if a house is not cleaned regularly.
examples.zh: 房子如果不经常打扫，灰尘很快会越积越多。

intro.en: These words all mean to get more of something over a period of time, or to increase in quantity over a period of time.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含收集、聚积、积累之义。

items.def: to bring things or information together from different people or places; to gradually increase in amount in a place:
items.zh: 指收集、采集、聚积、积累

examples.en: We’ve been collecting data from various sources.
examples.zh: 我们一直从各种渠道收集资料。

items.def: to bring things together that have been spread around; to collect information from different sources:
items.zh: 指收拢、归拢（分散的东西），搜集、收集（情报）

examples.en: I waited while he gathered up his papers.
examples.zh: 他整理文件时我就在一旁等待。

items.def: (rather formal) to gradually get more and more of something over a period of time; to gradually increase in number or quantity over a period of time:
items.zh: 指积累、聚积，（数量）逐渐增加

examples.en: I seem to have accumulated a lot of books.
examples.zh: 我好像已经收集了很多书。

items.def: (rather formal) to collect something in large quantities, especially money, debts or information:
items.zh: 指大量积累、积聚（尤指金钱、债务或情报）

examples.en: He amassed a fortune from silver mining.
examples.zh: 他靠开采银矿积累了一笔财富。

senses.def: the process of gradually increasing or getting more and more of something over a period of time

examples.en: the accumulation of wealth
examples.zh: 财富积累

senses.def: an amount of something that has gradually increased over a period of time

examples.en: an accumulation of toxic chemicals
examples.zh: 有毒化学物质的积聚

senses.def: growing by increasing gradually

examples.en: the accumulative effects of pollution
examples.zh: 污染的累积效应

senses.def: a section of a computer that is used for storing the results of what has been calculated
a large battery that you can fill with electrical power (= that you can recharge
a bet on a series of races or other events, where the money won or originally bet is placed on the next race, etc.
senses.zh: 累计下注（每赢一次即押于下一轮赌博）

senses.def: the state of being exact or correct; the ability to do something with skill and without making mistakes

examples.en: They questioned the accuracy of the information in the file.
examples.zh: 他们怀疑档案中信息的准确性。

examples.en: Candidates are judged on technical accuracy as well as artistic expression.
examples.zh: 我们将根据技术准确性和艺术表现力对候选人进行评判。

examples.en: She hits the ball with great accuracy.
examples.zh: 她击球十分准确。

senses.def: the degree to which a measurement, calculation

examples.en: the accuracy of radiocarbon dating
examples.zh: 放射性碳定年法的精确度

examples.en: to achieve accuracies of 50–70 per cent
examples.zh: 达到 50% 到 70% 的精确度

senses.def: correct and true in every detail

examples.en: an accurate description/picture of something
examples.zh: 某事物精确的描述／图像

examples.en: Accurate measurements are essential.
examples.zh: 准确的测量非常关键。

examples.en: I'm not convinced the reports are accurate.
examples.zh: 我不相信这些报道是准确的。

examples.en: The film is not historically accurate.
examples.zh: 这部影片与历史不完全相符。

examples.en: an accurate prediction/estimate/assessment
examples.zh: 准确的预测/估计/评估

examples.en: an accurate representation/portrayal
examples.zh: 准确的表述/描绘

examples.en: scientifically accurate information/data
examples.zh: 科学准确的信息/数据

examples.en: reasonably/entirely/fairly accurate
examples.zh: 相当/完全/相当准确

examples.en: The cost is an accurate reflection of the quality of our products.
examples.zh: 成本准确反映了我们产品的质量。

senses.def: able to give completely correct information or to do something in an exact way

examples.en: a highly accurate electronic compass
examples.zh: 高度精确的电子罗盘仪

examples.en: My watch is not very accurate.
examples.zh: 我的表走得不太准。

examples.en: Scientists have found a more accurate way of dating cave paintings.
examples.zh: 科学家们找到了一种更准确的测定洞穴壁画年代的方法。

examples.en: Huygens was able to build a clock accurate to within ten seconds in a day.
examples.zh: 惠更斯能够建造出一天精确到十秒以内的时钟。

senses.def: an accurate

examples.en: There were only two accurate shots on goal.
examples.zh: 只有两次射击命中目标。

senses.def: in a way that is correct and true in every detail

examples.en: The article accurately reflects public opinion.
examples.zh: 这篇文章如实反映了公众的意见。

examples.en: The report accurately reflects the current state of the industry.
examples.zh: 该报告如实反映了这个行业的现状。

senses.def: in an exact way

examples.en: Quantities must be measured accurately.
examples.zh: 数量的计量必须准确。

senses.def: hitting or reaching the thing that was aimed at

examples.en: You need to hit the ball accurately.
examples.zh: 你必须准确击球。

senses.def: having a curse

examples.en: an accursed house
examples.zh: 被诅咒的家庭

examples.en: His line would be accursed to the last generation.
examples.zh: 他的后代将受到诅咒。

senses.def: a statement saying that you think a person is guilty of doing something wrong or illegal; the fact of accusing somebody

examples.en: I don't want to make an accusation until I have some proof.
examples.zh: 我要有一些证据以后才提出控告。

examples.en: There was a hint of accusation in her voice.
examples.zh: 她的语气暗含谴责。

examples.en: accusations of corruption/cruelty/racism
examples.zh: 对贪污腐化／残暴行为／种族主义的控告

examples.en: At the time, no one believed his accusations against her.
examples.zh: 当时，没有人相信他对她的指控。

examples.en: He denied the accusation that he had ignored the problems.
examples.zh: 他否认别人说他忽视这些问题的指控。

senses.def: in the form that a noun, a pronoun or an adjective has when it is the direct object

examples.en: The accusative forms of the pronouns ‘I’, ‘he’, ‘she’ and ‘we’ are ‘me’, ‘her’, ‘him’ and ‘us’.
examples.zh: 代词“I”、“he”、“she”和“we”的宾格形式是“me”、“her”、“him”和“us”。

senses.def: the form of a noun, a pronoun or an adjective when it is the direct object

examples.en: In the sentence, ‘I saw him today’, the word ‘him’ is in the accusative.
examples.zh: 在 I saw him today 一句中，him 一词为宾格。

senses.def: suggesting that you think somebody has done something wrong

examples.en: He pointed an accusatory finger in her direction.
examples.zh: 他指责地用手指指着她。

senses.def: to say that somebody has done something wrong or is guilty of something

examples.en: to accuse somebody of murder/a crime
examples.zh: 控告某人谋杀／犯罪

examples.en: She accused him of lying.
examples.zh: 她指责他说谎。

examples.en: The government was accused of incompetence.
examples.zh: 政府被指责无能。

examples.en: to be falsely/wrongly/unjustly accused of something
examples.zh: 受到虚假的／错误的／不公平的指控

examples.en: They stand accused of crimes against humanity.
examples.zh: 他们被控危害人类罪。

senses.def: a person who says that somebody has done something wrong or is guilty of something

examples.en: He demanded the right to face his accusers at a public hearing.
examples.zh: 他要求获得在公开审讯中与原告当面对质的权利。

senses.def: in a way that shows that you think somebody has done something wrong

examples.en: ‘Emma!’ he said accusingly.
examples.zh: “艾玛！”他指责道。

senses.def: to make yourself/somebody familiar with something or become used to it

examples.en: It took him a while to accustom himself to the idea.
examples.zh: 他过了一段时间才习惯这个想法。

examples.en: She quickly accustomed herself to the darkness.
examples.zh: 她很快就适应了黑暗。

examples.en: Education should accustom children to thinking for themselves.
examples.zh: 教育应该让孩子养成独立思考的习惯。

senses.def: a playing card

examples.en: the ace of spades/hearts/diamonds/clubs
examples.zh: 黑桃／红心／方块／梅花 A

senses.def: a person who is very good at doing something

examples.en: a soccer/flying ace
examples.zh: 足球／飞行顶尖高手

examples.en: an ace marksman
examples.zh: 神枪手

examples.en: French ace Mbappé scored a late penalty.
examples.zh: 法国王牌姆巴佩在最后时刻打入点球。

senses.def: a serve
senses.zh: 爱司球（对手未碰到的优质发球）

examples.en: He served 20 aces in the match.
examples.zh: 他在这场比赛中发了 20 个爱司球。

senses.def: an occasion when a player hits the ball from the tee
a secret advantage, for example a piece of information or a skill, that you are ready to use if you need to
senses.zh: 秘藏的王牌；撒手锏；锦囊妙计

senses.def: to have all the advantages in a situation

examples.en: The union soon realized that the management held all the aces.
examples.zh: 工会很快意识到管理层掌握着所有王牌。

senses.def: to use your best argument, etc. in order to get an advantage in a situation
very close to something

examples.en: We came within an ace of victory.
examples.zh: 我们差点儿赢了。

senses.def: a US company that makes various types of elastic
senses.zh: Ace 公司（美国一家生产医用弹性绷带的公司）

senses.def: very good

examples.en: We had an ace time.
examples.zh: 我们过得真痛快。

senses.def: to be successful in something

examples.en: He aced all his tests.
examples.zh: 他通过了对他的所有测试。

examples.en: They watched the golfer ace the 17th hole (= get the ball into the hole using only one shot).
examples.zh: 他们看着这位高尔夫球手一杆进洞，打出了“老鹰球”。

senses.def: a secret advantage, for example a piece of information or a skill, that you are ready to use if you need to
senses.zh: 秘藏的王牌；撒手锏；锦囊妙计

senses.def: to have all the advantages in a situation

examples.en: The union soon realized that the management held all the aces.
examples.zh: 工会很快意识到管理层掌握着所有王牌。

senses.def: to use your best argument, etc. in order to get an advantage in a situation

items.idm: within an ace of something/of doing something

senses.def: very close to something

examples.en: We came within an ace of victory.
examples.zh: 我们差点儿赢了。

senses.def: not consisting of or divided into cells
a tree or plant that is often grown for its attractive leaves and bright autumn colours
senses.zh: 槭属植物，秋槭（常栽作风景树）

senses.def: critical in a direct and rather cruel way

examples.en: The letter was written in her usual acerbic style.
examples.zh: 这封信是用她惯常的尖刻语调写的。

senses.def: the fact of being critical in a direct and rather cruel way
a drug used to reduce pain and high temperature
senses.zh: 对乙酰氨基酚；扑热息痛

senses.def: a chemical made from acetic acid
a chemical used to make fibres
a clear plastic sheet that you can write or print something on and show on a screen using an overhead projector
senses.zh: 醋酸透明塑胶片；投影胶片

senses.def: the acid
a clear liquid with a strong smell used for cleaning things, making paint thinner and producing various chemicals
a gas that burns with a very hot bright flame, used for cutting or joining metal
used to express the fact that you are surprised, sorry, etc.
used to show that the speaker agrees with, accepts, understands, etc. something
senses.zh: （表示同意、接受、明白等）嗯，唔，噢

examples.en: Achcha! We'll meet at eight.
examples.zh: 好吧！我们八点钟见。

senses.def: used to express surprise, happiness, etc.

examples.en: ‘She’s going to marry the Minister’s son.’ ‘Achcha, is that so?’
examples.zh: “她要嫁给部长的儿子。” “阿查，是这样吗？”

senses.def: to feel a continuous pain that is not severe

examples.en: I'm aching all over.
examples.zh: 我周身疼痛。

examples.en: Her eyes ached from lack of sleep.
examples.zh: 她的眼睛因睡眠不足而隐隐作痛。

examples.en: It makes my heart ache (= it makes me sad) to see her suffer.
examples.zh: 看到她在受苦，我心里真难过。

senses.def: to have a strong desire for somebody/something or to do something

examples.en: I was aching for home.
examples.zh: 我很想回家。

examples.en: He ached to see her.
examples.zh: 他渴望见到她。

senses.def: a continuous feeling of pain in a part of the body

examples.en: Mummy, I've got a tummy ache.
examples.zh: 妈妈，我肚子疼。

examples.en: Muscular aches and pains can be soothed by a relaxing massage.
examples.zh: 做放松按摩可以减轻肌肉疼痛。

examples.en: an ache in my heart (= a continuous sad feeling)
examples.zh: 我心中的隐痛

synonyms.words: ache ▪ burn ▪ sting ▪ tingle ▪ itch ▪ throb

intro.en: These are all words that can be used when part of your body feels painful.
intro.zh: 以上各词均可指身体部位感到疼痛。

items.def: (of part of your body) to feel painful; (of an action) to cause pain:
items.zh: 指（身体部位）感到疼痛、（某一动作）引起疼痛

examples.en: My feet hurt.
examples.zh: 我脚疼。

items.def: to feel a continuous pain that is not severe:
items.zh: 指（持续地）疼痛、隐痛

examples.en: I’m aching all over.
examples.zh: 我周身疼痛。

items.def: (of part of your body) to feel very hot and painful:
items.zh: 指（身体部位）火辣辣地痛、发烫

examples.en: Our eyes were burning from the chemicals in the air.
examples.zh: 空气中弥漫的化学物质熏得我们的眼睛火辣辣地痛。

items.def: to make somebody feel a sharp burning pain or uncomfortable feeling in part of their body; (of part of your body) to feel this pain:
items.zh: 指（使）身体部位感觉刺痛、灼痛

examples.en: My eyes were stinging from the smoke.
examples.zh: 烟熏得我眼睛痛。

items.def: (of part of your body) to feel as if a lot of small sharp points are pushing into the skin there:
items.zh: 指（身体部位）感到刺痛

examples.en: The cold air made her face tingle.
examples.zh: 冷空气冻得她的脸发痛。

items.def: to have an uncomfortable feeling on your skin that makes you want to scratch; to make your skin feel like this:
items.zh: （使）发痒

examples.en: I itch all over.
examples.zh: 我浑身痒。

items.def: (of part of your body) to feel pain as a series of regular beats:
items.zh: 指（身体部位）有规律地抽动、抽痛

examples.en: His head throbbed painfully.
examples.zh: 他的头一抽一跳地痛。

senses.def: that can be reached, especially by making an effort for a long time
senses.zh: 可完成的;可达到的;可实现的

examples.en: Profits of $20m look achievable.
examples.zh: 2 000 万美元的利润看来是可以完成的。

examples.en: achievable goals
examples.zh: 可以达到的目标

senses.def: to succeed in reaching a particular goal, status or standard, especially by making an effort for a long time
senses.zh: （凭长期努力）达到（某目标、地位、标准）

examples.en: He had finally achieved success.
examples.zh: 他终于获得了成功。

examples.en: They have both achieved great results.
examples.zh: 他们两人都取得了巨大的成就。

examples.en: She has worked hard to achieve her goal.
examples.zh: 她为实现目标而努力工作。

examples.en: to achieve an objective/aim
examples.zh: 实现目标；达到目的

examples.en: They could not achieve their target of less than 3% inflation.
examples.zh: 他们未能达到通货膨胀低于 3% 的目标。

examples.en: The firm has achieved the status of undisputed market leader.
examples.zh: 该公司已经取得了无可争议的市场领导者的地位。

examples.en: Course objectives were achieved through a range of activities.
examples.zh: 课程目标是通过一系列活动来实现的。

senses.def: to succeed in doing something or causing something to happen

examples.en: I haven't achieved very much today.
examples.zh: 我今天没做成多少事。

examples.en: All you've achieved is to upset my parents.
examples.zh: 你唯一做到的就是使我的父母难过。

senses.def: to be successful

examples.en: Their difficult home life makes it harder for them to achieve at school.
examples.zh: 他们困难的家庭生活使他们在学校更难取得成绩。

examples.en: These students need to achieve academically in order to enter the labour market.
examples.zh: 这些学生需要取得学业成绩才能进入劳动力市场。

senses.def: a thing that somebody has done successfully, especially using their own effort and skill

examples.en: the greatest scientific achievement of the decade
examples.zh: 这十年最伟大的科学成就

examples.en: sporting/artistic/academic achievements
examples.zh: 体育／艺术／学术成就

examples.en: It was a remarkable achievement for such a young player.
examples.zh: 如此年轻的选手有这样的成绩真是了不起。

examples.en: an outstanding achievement
examples.zh: 杰出成就

examples.en: This work is the crowning achievement (= the greatest achievement) of her career.
examples.zh: 这项工作是她职业生涯的巅峰之作。

examples.en: They were proud of their children's achievements.
examples.zh: 他们对孩子们的成绩感到自豪。

senses.def: the act or process of achieving something

examples.en: the need to raise standards of academic/educational achievement
examples.zh: 提高学术／教育成绩标准的需要

examples.en: He won a lifetime achievement award for cinematography.
examples.zh: 他获得了电影艺术终身成就奖。

examples.en: Even a small success gives you a sense of achievement (= a feeling of pride).
examples.zh: 即便是小小的成功也给人一种成就感。

senses.def: a reward that you can earn in some video games by completing a challenge or level
senses.zh: 成就（电子游戏完成挑战或过关后得到的奖励）

examples.en: If you complete the game in less than twelve hours, you are awarded an achievement at the end.
examples.zh: 如果您在十二小时内完成游戏，您将在最后获得一项成就。

senses.def: a person who achieves a high level of success, especially in their career
a person who achieves the particular level of success that is stated

examples.en: a low achiever
examples.zh: 成绩平平的人

senses.def: a weak point or fault in somebody’s character, which can be attacked by other people

examples.en: The desire for publicity became her Achilles heel.
examples.zh: 对宣传的渴望成为她的致命弱点。

examples.en: The enemy had an Achilles heel somewhere, if only he could find it.
examples.zh: 敌人在某个地方有一个致命弱点，但愿他能找到它。

senses.def: the tendon
(of qualities or feelings) very great and affecting you deeply
senses.zh: （品质或情感）非常；极其；感人至深地

examples.en: an achingly beautiful song
examples.zh: 触人灵魂的妙曲

senses.def: a piece of men’s clothing that reaches to the knees, with buttons down the front, worn in South Asia
senses.zh: 爱客坎（南亚男子的开衫长款上衣）

senses.def: the word for the sound people make when they sneeze

examples.en: It's winter and—achoo!—I've come down with a cold.
examples.zh: 冬天到了，阿嚏！我已经患上感冒了。

senses.def: suffering from a continuous slight pain

examples.en: I feel all achy.
examples.zh: 我感到浑身酸痛。

examples.en: an achy back
examples.zh: 背痛

senses.def: a chemical, usually a liquid, that contains hydrogen

examples.en: The acid burned a hole in her coat.
examples.zh: 她的外套被酸烧了一个洞。

examples.en: Stomach acids can break down the poison.
examples.zh: 胃酸能分解这种毒素。

examples.en: You will need a special chemical to neutralize the acid.
examples.zh: 你需要一种特殊的化学物质来中和这种酸。

senses.def: a powerful illegal drug that affects people’s minds and makes them see and hear things that are not really there
senses.zh: 麦角酰二乙胺；迷幻药；致幻药

examples.en: They smoke joints and drop acid.
examples.zh: 他们抽大麻烟卷，吸食迷幻药。

examples.en: He described the music as ‘Brahms on acid’.
examples.zh: 他称这种音乐为“服了迷幻药的勃拉姆斯”。

senses.def: that contains acid

examples.en: Rye is tolerant of poor, acid soils.
examples.zh: 黑麦耐贫瘠的酸性土壤。

senses.def: that has a bitter sharp taste

examples.en: acid fruit
examples.zh: 酸水果

examples.en: It’s a very juicy fruit with a slightly acid flavour.
examples.zh: 这种水果多汁，味道略酸。

senses.def: critical and unkind

examples.en: an acid wit
examples.zh: 尖刻的俏皮话

intro.en: These words all describe a strong, unpleasant taste or smell.
intro.zh: 以上各词均形容味道或气味强烈、令人不适。

items.def: (of a taste or smell) strong and usually unpleasant; (of food or drink) having a bitter taste.
items.zh: 指（味道或气味）强烈的、令人不适的，（食物或饮料）味苦的

items.def: (of a smell or taste) strong and usually unpleasant; (of food or smoke) having a pungent smell or taste:
items.zh: 指（气味或味道）强烈的、令人不适的，（食物）味苦的，（烟）呛人的、刺鼻的

examples.en: the pungent smell of burning rubber
examples.zh: 烧橡胶的刺鼻气味

items.def: (of a taste) bitter like the taste of a lemon or of fruit that is not ready to eat; (of food or drink) having a sour taste:
items.zh: 指（味道）酸的，（食物或饮料）有酸味的

examples.en: Too much pulp produces a sour wine.
examples.zh: 过多的果肉会让酒变酸。

items.def: (of a smell or taste) strong and unpleasant; (of smoke) having an acrid smell:
items.zh: 指（气味或味道）刺激的、难闻的，（烟）呛人的、刺鼻的

examples.en: acrid smoke from burning tyres
examples.zh: 燃烧轮胎产生的熏烟

items.def: (of a taste or smell) strong and slightly bitter; (of food or drink) having a sharp taste:
items.zh: 指（味道或气味）强烈而略苦的、刺鼻的，（食物或饮料）味苦的、辛辣的

examples.en: The cheese has a distinctively sharp taste.
examples.zh: 这奶酪味道很冲。

items.def: (of a taste or smell) bitter, like the taste of a lemon or of fruit that is not ready to eat; (of food or drink) having an acid taste.
items.zh: 指（味道）酸的，（气味）有刺激性的，（食物或饮料）有酸味的

senses.def: a type of hard sweet with a bitter sharp taste
a type of electronic music with a strong steady beat, popular in the 1980s, often played at parties where some people take harmful drugs
senses.zh: 酸性浩室，迷幻浩室（节奏强烈而稳定的电子音乐，流行于 20 世纪 80 年代，常在有人服用迷幻药的聚会上演奏）

senses.def: a type of dance music that combines jazz, funk
senses.zh: 迷幻爵士（结合爵士乐、放克乐、灵乐和嘻哈音乐成分的舞曲）

senses.def: rain that contains harmful chemicals from factory gases and that damages trees, crops and buildings

examples.en: Sulphur, falling as acid rain, is killing fish in the Great Lakes.
examples.zh: 硫磺以酸雨形式降落，正在杀死五大湖中的鱼类。

senses.def: a type of rock
senses.zh: 迷幻摇滚乐（主要在20世纪60年代后期流行，与迷幻药有关或由迷幻药引发）

senses.def: a salt formed when the hydrogen
a way of deciding whether something is successful or true
senses.zh: 决定性考验；严峻的考验

examples.en: The acid test of a good driver is whether they remain calm in an emergency.
examples.zh: 对一个好司机的严峻考验就是在紧急情况下能否保持冷静。

examples.en: The perception of fairness is the acid test for democracy.
examples.zh: 对公平的看法是对民主的严峻考验。

examples.en: This type of stone is the acid test of a climber’s ability.
examples.zh: 这种石头是对登山者能力的严峻考验。

senses.def: having a very bitter sharp taste

examples.en: Some fruit juices are very acidic.
examples.zh: 有些果汁酸得很。

senses.def: containing acid

examples.en: acidic soil
examples.zh: 酸性土壤

senses.def: to become or make something become acidic
the state of having a bitter sharp taste or of containing acid

examples.en: to test the acidity of soil
examples.zh: 测试土壤的酸度

senses.def: in an unpleasant or critical way

examples.en: ‘Thanks for nothing,’ she said acidly.
examples.zh: “不用你费心。”她挖苦地说。

senses.def: having a bitter sharp taste
the repeated firing of guns at aircraft
a type of tree that produces bright red fruit, originally from West Africa
senses.zh: 阿开基木（原产于西非，结浅红色果实）

senses.def: the fruit from this tree, which is poisonous to eat unless it is completely ripe
senses.zh: 阿开基木果实（未完全成熟时有毒）

senses.def: to accept that something is true

examples.en: She refuses to acknowledge the need for reform.
examples.zh: 她拒不承认改革的必要性。

examples.en: I have to acknowledge the fact that I am partly responsible.
examples.zh: 我不得不承认我负有一部分责任。

examples.en: It's a generally acknowledged fact.
examples.zh: 这是公认的事实。

examples.en: Most people acknowledge the existence of evil.
examples.zh: 大多数人承认邪恶的存在。

examples.en: to openly/publicly/readily acknowledge something
examples.zh: 公开/公然/欣然承认某事

examples.en: He does not acknowledge that he has done anything wrong.
examples.zh: 他不承认他做错了。

examples.en: It is generally acknowledged to be true.
examples.zh: 普遍认为那是真的。

senses.def: to accept that somebody/something has a particular authority or status

examples.en: The country acknowledged his claim to the throne.
examples.zh: 这个国家承认了他继承王位的权利。

examples.en: The peace settlement effectively acknowledged the country's independence.
examples.zh: 这一和平协议事实上承认了这个国家的独立。

examples.en: He is widely acknowledged as the best player in the world.
examples.zh: 普遍认为他是世界最佳球员。

examples.en: He is widely acknowledged to be the best player in the world.
examples.zh: 普遍认为他是世界最佳球员。

senses.def: to tell somebody that you have received something that they sent to you

examples.en: All applications will be acknowledged.
examples.zh: 所有的申请都将得到复函告知收悉。

examples.en: Please acknowledge receipt of this letter.
examples.zh: 信收到后请复函告知。

senses.def: to show that you have noticed somebody/something by smiling, waving, etc.

examples.en: I was standing right next to her, but she didn't even acknowledge me.
examples.zh: 我就站在她身边，可是她理都不理我。

examples.en: He waved, acknowledging the applause.
examples.zh: 他挥手示意，表示接受掌声。

senses.def: to publicly express thanks for help you have been given

examples.en: I gratefully acknowledge financial support from several local businesses.
examples.zh: 我对几家本地企业的资助表示感谢。

examples.en: He is always ready to acknowledge his debt to his teachers.
examples.zh: 他总是准备好感谢他的老师。

intro.en: These words all mean to agree, often unwillingly, that something is true.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含承认之义，常指不情愿地承认某事属实。

items.def: to agree, often unwillingly, that something is true:
items.zh: 指承认（常指不情愿地承认某事属实）

examples.en: It was a stupid thing to do, I admit.
examples.zh: 我承认，那次干的是件蠢事。

items.def: (rather formal) to accept that something exists, is true or has happened:
items.zh: 指承认某事物存在或属实

examples.en: She refuses to acknowledge the need for reform.
examples.zh: 她拒不承认改革的必要性。

items.def: to admit or be aware that something exists or is true:
items.zh: 指承认、意识到

examples.en: They recognized the need to take the problem seriously.
examples.zh: 他们认识到需要严肃对待这个问题。

items.def: (rather formal) to admit, often unwillingly, that something is true or logical:
items.zh: 指承认（常指不情愿地承认某事属实或合乎逻辑）

examples.en: He was forced to concede (that) there might be difficulties.
examples.zh: 他被迫承认可能有困难。

items.def: (rather formal) to admit something that you feel ashamed or embarrassed about; to admit, especially formally or to the police, that you have done something wrong or illegal:
items.zh: 指承认自己感到羞愧或尴尬的事，也指供认、坦白、承认错误或罪行

examples.en: She was reluctant to confess her ignorance.
examples.zh: 她不愿意承认自己无知。

senses.def: an act of accepting that something exists or is true, or that something is there

examples.en: This report is an acknowledgement of the size of the problem.
examples.zh: 这个报告承认了问题的严重性。

examples.en: She gave me a smile of acknowledgement (= showed that she had seen and recognized me).
examples.zh: 她向我微笑打招呼。

examples.en: There is acknowledgement on his part that he was to blame.
examples.zh: 他承认自己难辞其咎。

senses.def: an act or a statement expressing thanks to somebody; something that is given to somebody as thanks

examples.en: The flowers were a small acknowledgement of your kindness.
examples.zh: 这些花聊表谢意，感谢你的好心帮助。

examples.en: She is still waiting for some acknowledgement from her fellow academics.
examples.zh: 她仍在等待着学术界同仁的认可。

examples.en: I was sent a free copy in acknowledgement of my contribution.
examples.zh: 我收到一本赠刊，表示对我投稿的谢意。

senses.def: a letter or an email saying that something has been received

examples.en: I didn't receive an acknowledgement of my application.
examples.zh: 我的申请没有得到复信告知收悉。

examples.en: It may be appropriate to request a written acknowledgement of receipt.
examples.zh: 要求书面回执可能是适当的。

examples.en: I wrote to them but never got any acknowledgement.
examples.zh: 我给他们写过信，但从未接到过确认收悉的回信。

senses.def: a statement, especially at the beginning of a book, in which the writer expresses thanks to the people who have helped
senses.zh: （尤指作者在卷首的）致谢，鸣谢

examples.en: a page of acknowledgements
examples.zh: 致谢页

senses.def: (in Australia) an act of formally recognizing the traditional Aboriginal owners of the land at an event such as a conference or festival, and in Parliament
senses.zh: 土地声明（在公开场合如大会、庆典活动和议会上正式承认澳大利亚土著居民为传统意义上的土地所有者）

examples.en: The event started with an Acknowledgement of Country by one of the organizers.
examples.zh: 活动以一位组织者对国家的认可开始。

senses.def: American Civil Liberties Union
the highest stage of development or the most excellent example of something

examples.en: the acme of engineering achievement
examples.zh: 工程成就的顶峰

senses.def: a skin condition, common among young people, that produces many pimples

examples.en: to suffer from/have acne
examples.zh: 患痤疮；长粉刺

senses.def: a person who follows and helps a leader

examples.en: the Emperor’s faithful acolytes
examples.zh: 皇帝的忠实侍从

senses.def: a person who helps a priest in some church ceremonies
a wild plant with yellow or blue flowers and a poisonous root that is sometimes used to make drugs
senses.zh: 乌头属植物（野生，花黄色或蓝色，根有毒，可入药）

senses.def: the small brown nut of the oak
something large and successful often begins in a very small way
senses.zh: 参天橡树长自小小橡实；合抱之树，生于毫末

items.idm: great/tall oaks from little acorns grow

senses.def: something large and successful often begins in a very small way
senses.zh: 参天橡树长自小小橡实；合抱之树，生于毫末

senses.def: related to sound or to the sense of hearing
designed to make natural sound, not sound amplified
in a way that is related to sound or to the sense of hearing

examples.en: an acoustically perfect concert hall
examples.zh: 音响效果完美的音乐厅

senses.def: using musical instruments that make sound naturally, not using electrical equipment

examples.en: We’re all playing acoustically with no raging electric guitars, etc.
examples.zh: 我们都是用原声演奏，没有猛烈的电吉他等。

senses.def: a scientist who studies sound
the shape, design, etc. of a room or theatre that make it good or bad for carrying sound
senses.zh: （房间、戏院的）传声效果，音响效果

examples.en: The acoustics of the new concert hall are excellent.
examples.zh: 新音乐厅的传声效果极佳。

senses.def: the scientific study of sound
to make somebody/yourself familiar with or aware of something

examples.en: Please acquaint me with the facts of the case.
examples.zh: 请把这事的实情告诉我。

examples.en: You will first need to acquaint yourself with the filing system.
examples.zh: 你首先需要熟悉文件归档方法。

senses.def: a person that you know but who is not a close friend
senses.zh: 认识的人；泛泛之交；熟人

examples.en: Claire has a wide circle of friends and acquaintances.
examples.zh: 克莱尔交游很广。

examples.en: He's just a business acquaintance.
examples.zh: 他只是业务上认识的人。

examples.en: I bumped into an old acquaintance on the train.
examples.zh: 我在火车上碰见一个老熟人。

senses.def: slight friendship

examples.en: He hoped their acquaintance would develop further.
examples.zh: 他希望他们的交情会进一步发展。

examples.en: a man with whom I had a passing acquaintance
examples.zh: 我不甚了解的一个男子

examples.en: I first met Simon in 2008 and struck up an acquaintance with him.
examples.zh: 我第一次见到西蒙是在 2008 年，并与他相识。

senses.def: knowledge of something

examples.en: I had little acquaintance with modern poetry.
examples.zh: 我对现代诗所知甚少。

senses.def: to only know somebody/something slightly
senses.zh: 与…有点头之交；对…略知一二

senses.def: to meet somebody for the first time
senses.zh: 与某人初次相见；结识某人

examples.en: I am delighted to make your acquaintance, Mrs Baker.
examples.zh: 贝克太太，我很高兴与您相识。

examples.en: I made the acquaintance of several musicians around that time.
examples.zh: 大约在那段时间，我结识了几位音乐家。

examples.en: I first made his acquaintance in 1992.
examples.zh: 我是在1992 年认识他的。

senses.def: that you know

examples.en: No one else of my acquaintance was as rich or successful.
examples.zh: 我所认识的人当中，其他人都没有如此富有或者成功。

examples.en: He introduced me to a lady of his acquaintance.
examples.zh: 他把我介绍给他认识的一位女士。

senses.def: when you first meet somebody

examples.en: Even on first acquaintance it was clear that he was not ‘the right type’.
examples.zh: 初次见面就看出他显然不是“对路子的人”。

examples.en: On first acquaintance she seemed a little odd.
examples.zh: 初次相识她显得有些古怪。

items.idm: have a nodding acquaintance with somebody/something

senses.def: to only know somebody/something slightly
senses.zh: 与…有点头之交；对…略知一二

senses.def: the crime of raping
a slight friendship with somebody or knowledge of something

examples.en: It was unfair to judge her on such a brief acquaintanceship.
examples.zh: 你刚认识她就对她作出评价，这是不公平的。

senses.def: to accept something without arguing, even if you do not really agree with it
senses.zh: 默然接受；默认；默许；顺从

examples.en: Senior government figures must have acquiesced in the cover-up.
examples.zh: 政府高级官员必然已经默许掩盖真相。

examples.en: She explained her plan and reluctantly he acquiesced.
examples.zh: 她解释了她的计划，他无奈默然接受。

senses.def: the fact of being willing to do what somebody wants and to accept their opinions, even if you are not sure that they are right
senses.zh: 默然接受；默认；默许；顺从

examples.en: There was general acquiescence in the UN sanctions.
examples.zh: 普遍默认了联合国的制裁。

senses.def: willing to do what somebody wants and accept their opinions, even if you are not sure that they are right
senses.zh: 默然接受；默认；默许；顺从

examples.en: Party members proved more acquiescent than had been expected.
examples.zh: 事实证明，党员们比预想的更加默许。

senses.def: to gain something by your own efforts, ability or behaviour
senses.zh: （通过努力、能力、行为表现）获得，得到

examples.en: She has acquired a good knowledge of English.
examples.zh: 她英语已经学得很好。

examples.en: How long will it take to acquire the necessary skills?
examples.zh: 掌握必要技能需要多长时间？

examples.en: I would love to apply these newly acquired skills to a job that I enjoy.
examples.zh: 我很乐意将这些新获得的技能应用到我喜欢的工作中。

examples.en: He has acquired a reputation for dishonesty.
examples.zh: 他得到了奸诈的名声。

examples.en: I have recently acquired a taste for olives.
examples.zh: 我最近开始喜欢吃橄榄了。

senses.def: to obtain something by buying or being given it

examples.en: Not all of the land acquired for the road has been paid for yet.
examples.zh: 为修路而购得的土地尚未全部付清账款。

examples.en: The country has pledged not to acquire nuclear weapons.
examples.zh: 该国已承诺不获取核武器。

examples.en: Property acquired through crime will be confiscated.
examples.zh: 通过犯罪获得的财产将被没收。

examples.en: The company has just acquired new premises.
examples.zh: 公司刚购得新办公楼。

examples.en: How did the gallery come to acquire so many Picassos?
examples.zh: 这家画廊是如何购得这么多毕加索作品的？

examples.en: I've suddenly acquired a stepbrother.
examples.zh: 我突然有了一个继兄。

senses.def: a thing that you do not like much at first but gradually learn to like

examples.en: Abstract art is an acquired taste.
examples.zh: 要慢慢培养才会欣赏抽象艺术。

senses.def: a thing that you do not like much at first but gradually learn to like

examples.en: Abstract art is an acquired taste.
examples.zh: 要慢慢培养才会欣赏抽象艺术。

senses.def: a change to a living thing that is not produced by genes
the act of getting something, especially knowledge, a skill, etc.

examples.en: theories of child language acquisition
examples.zh: 幼儿语言习得的理论

senses.def: something that somebody buys to add to what they already own, usually something valuable

examples.en: His latest acquisition is a racehorse.
examples.zh: 他最近购得一匹赛马。

examples.en: The money will be spent on acquisitions for the university library.
examples.zh: 这笔钱将用于购买大学图书馆。

senses.def: a company, piece of land, etc. bought by somebody, especially another company; the act of buying it
senses.zh: 购置物；收购的公司（或产业）；购置；收购

examples.en: They have made acquisitions in several EU countries.
examples.zh: 他们在几个欧盟国家购买了一些产业。

examples.en: the acquisition of shares by employees
examples.zh: 雇员购股

examples.en: The group has announced its first overseas acquisition: a successful software company.
examples.zh: 该集团宣布了其第一笔海外收购：一家成功的软件公司。

examples.en: The company has just made another acquisition.
examples.zh: 该公司刚刚又完成了一项收购。

senses.def: wanting very much to buy or get new possessions
senses.zh: 渴求获取财物的；贪婪的

examples.en: the post-war acquisitive society
examples.zh: 战后的贪婪社会

examples.en: It is an acquisitive company looking for ways to expand.
examples.zh: 那是一家充满野心寻求扩张的公司。

senses.def: the fact of wanting very much to buy or get new possessions
senses.zh: 渴求获取财物的；贪婪的

examples.en: We rejected the acquisitiveness of our parents’ generation.
examples.zh: 我们拒绝了父辈那一代人的贪婪。

senses.def: to decide and state officially in court that somebody is not guilty of a crime

examples.en: The jury acquitted him of murder.
examples.zh: 陪审团裁决他谋杀罪不成立。

examples.en: Both defendants were acquitted.
examples.zh: 两名被告均被无罪释放。

examples.en: She was acquitted on all charges.
examples.zh: 她获宣判所有罪名不成立。

examples.en: He was acquitted on the grounds of insufficient evidence.
examples.zh: 由于证据不足，他被无罪释放。

senses.def: to perform or behave well, badly, etc.

examples.en: He acquitted himself brilliantly in the exams.
examples.zh: 他在考试中表现出色。

senses.def: an official decision in court that a person is not guilty of a crime

examples.en: The case resulted in an acquittal.
examples.zh: 此案件最终作出无罪判决。

examples.en: The jury voted for acquittal.
examples.zh: 陪审团表决赞成判定无罪。

senses.def: a unit for measuring an area of land; 4 840 square yards or about 4 050 square metres
senses.zh: 英亩（4 840 平方码，约为 4 050 平方米）

examples.en: 3 000 acres of parkland
examples.zh: 3 000 英亩开阔绿地

examples.en: a three-acre wood
examples.zh: 一片三英亩的林地

examples.en: Each house has acres of space around it (= a lot of space).
examples.zh: 每座房屋四周都有大片空地。

senses.def: an area of land measured in acres

examples.en: The aim is to increase the forestry acreage by 60% by the end of the decade.
examples.zh: 目标是到本十年末将林业面积增加 60%。

senses.def: having a strong, bitter smell or taste that is unpleasant

examples.en: acrid smoke from burning tyres
examples.zh: 燃烧轮胎产生的刺鼻气味

examples.en: The fog was yellow and acrid and bit at the back of the throat.
examples.zh: 雾的颜色发黄，气味呛人，直刺喉根。

intro.en: These words all describe a strong, unpleasant taste or smell.
intro.zh: 以上各词均形容味道或气味强烈、令人不适。

examples.zh: 他根本不会演戏。

examples.zh: 若要使这些美丽的动物能生存下去，现在就要行动起来。

examples.en: to threaten/demand/call for action
examples.zh: 威胁/要求/呼吁采取行动

examples.en: Firefighters took action immediately to stop the blaze spreading.
examples.zh: 消防队员立即采取了行动制止大火蔓延。

examples.en: Divers were close at hand, ready to go into action if the stunt went wrong.
examples.zh: 潜水员近在咫尺，随时准备在特技表演出现意外时采取行动。

examples.en: What is the best course of action in the circumstances?
examples.zh: 在这种情况下最佳行动方针是什么？

examples.en: She began to explain her plan of action to the group.
examples.zh: 她开始向小组讲解她的行动计划。

examples.en: The men face disciplinary action.
examples.zh: 这些人面临纪律处分。

senses.def: a thing that somebody does

examples.en: Each of us must take responsibility for our own actions.
examples.zh: 我们每个人都必须对自己的行为负责。

examples.en: They sought to justify their actions.
examples.zh: 他们试图为自己的行为辩护。

senses.def: things that workers do, especially stopping work, to protest to their employers about something

examples.en: Workers voted in favour of strike action.
examples.zh: 工人表决支持罢工。

examples.en: They called off their action at 7.40 a.m. after the meeting was arranged.
examples.zh: 会议安排完毕后，他们于上午7点40分取消了行动。

examples.en: Unions said the action could be suspended early on Friday if talks between the two sides resumed.
examples.zh: 工会表示，如果双方恢复谈判，行动可能会在周五早些时候暂停。

examples.en: The government began taking a hard line against labour actions.
examples.zh: 政府开始对劳工行动采取强硬立场。

senses.def: a legal process to stop a person or company from doing something, or to make them pay for a mistake, etc.

examples.en: A libel action is being brought against the magazine that published the article.
examples.zh: 刊登该文章的杂志将被起诉诽谤。

examples.en: He is considering taking legal action against the hospital.
examples.zh: 他正考虑起诉这家医院。

senses.def: fighting in a battle or war

examples.en: The possibility of taking military action has not been ruled out.
examples.zh: 不排除采取军事行动的可能性。

examples.en: I never saw action during the war.
examples.zh: 战争时期，我从未参加过战斗。

examples.en: soldiers killed in action
examples.zh: 阵亡战士

senses.def: the events in a story, play, etc.

examples.en: The action takes place in France.
examples.zh: 这个故事发生在法国。

senses.def: exciting events

examples.en: I like films with plenty of action.
examples.zh: 我喜欢情节曲折离奇的影片。

examples.en: New York is where the action is.
examples.zh: 纽约是个热闹活跃的地方。

examples.en: If you want to know where all the action is around here, just ask Jo.
examples.zh: 如果您想知道这里的所有活动地点，只需询问 Jo即可。

senses.group: exciting events 激动人心的事

senses.def: the effect that something such as a chemical has on something
senses.zh: （一种物质或化学品对另一种所起的）作用

examples.en: Vitamin D can be made in the body by the action of sunlight on the skin.
examples.zh: 维生素D可以通过阳光对皮肤的作用在人体内产生。

examples.en: The action of the rushing water cleans the gully.
examples.zh: 湍急的水流清洁了沟壑。

senses.def: the way a part of the body moves or functions

examples.en: a study of the action of the liver
examples.zh: 对肝功能的研究

senses.group: of part of the body 身体部位

senses.def: the mechanical
senses.zh: （钢琴、枪炮、钟表等的）机械装置，活动部件；（机械部件的）活动方式

senses.def: what a person actually does means more than what they say they will do
if somebody/something is in action

examples.en: Just press the button to see your favourite character in action.
examples.zh: 只要按一下按键就可以看到你最喜欢的角色表演。

examples.en: I've yet to see all the players in action.
examples.zh: 我还得看所有参赛者的实地比赛。

examples.en: I have not yet seen the machines in action.
examples.zh: 我还没有见过这些机器运转。

senses.def: if you put an idea or a plan into action

examples.en: The new plan for traffic control is being put into action on an experimental basis.
examples.zh: 新的交通管理方案正在试行。

examples.en: We need to put these ideas into action.
examples.zh: 我们需要将这些想法付诸实施。

senses.def: not able to work or be used because of injury or damage
senses.zh: 不能工作；失去作用；停止运转

examples.en: Jon will be out of action for weeks with a broken leg.
examples.zh: 乔恩断了一条腿，将有几个星期不能工作。

examples.en: The photocopier is out of action today.
examples.zh: 复印机今天出故障了。

examples.en: She is out of action following an ankle injury.
examples.zh: 她因脚踝受伤而无法参加比赛。

senses.def: a share or role in an interesting or exciting activity, especially one that makes money
senses.zh: 插手，参与（尤指有利可图的活动）

examples.en: Foreign firms will all want a piece of the action if the new airport goes ahead.
examples.zh: 要是新机场开始修建，外国公司都会来插一手捞好处。

senses.def: to suddenly start working or doing something

examples.en: ‘Let's go!’ he said, springing into action.
examples.zh: 他突然行动起来，说道：“咱们走！”

examples.en: The town springs to life (= becomes busy) during the carnival.
examples.zh: 狂欢节期间，全城突然热闹起来。

senses.def: to start doing something quickly and with a lot of energy
senses.zh: 立即行动起来；马上大干起来

examples.en: The ambulance crew swung into action to resuscitate the patient.
examples.zh: 救护人员立即行动起来抢救病人。

examples.en: The rescue operation swung into action immediately.
examples.zh: 救援行动立即展开。

examples.en: The emergency services swung into action as soon as the disaster was reported.
examples.zh: 灾难一经报道，应急服务机构迅速采取了行动。

senses.def: to act in order to avoid danger or an unpleasant situation
senses.zh: 采取回避行动（以避免危险或不愉快的处境）

examples.en: The pilot had to take evasive action to avoid a mid-air collision.
examples.zh: 飞行员不得不采取规避行动以避免空中相撞。

senses.def: to make sure that something is done or dealt with

examples.en: Your request will be actioned.
examples.zh: 你的要求会处理的。

items.def: a thing that somebody does:

items.def: an official action that is done in order to achieve a particular aim:

examples.en: Tougher measures against racism are needed.
examples.zh: 需要更强硬的反种族主义措施。

items.def: one of a series of things that you do in order to achieve something:
