examples.en: This was a first step towards a united Europe.
examples.zh: 这是向建立统一欧洲的目标迈出的第一步。

items.def: a thing that somebody does:
items.zh: 指行动、动作

examples.en: an act of kindness
examples.zh: 善行

items.def: (used especially in the media) an action that you do or need to do to achieve something:
items.zh: （尤用于新闻）指为达到某目标而采取或需要采取的行动

examples.en: They are waiting for the results of the opinion polls before deciding their next move.
examples.zh: 他们在等待民意测验的结果，然后再决定下一步行动。

senses.def: a doll
senses.zh: （仿影视等角色的）战士玩偶，人偶

senses.def: a film that has a lot of exciting action and adventure
a group that is formed to work for social or political change
senses.zh: （社会或政治改革的）行动小组

examples.en: the Child Poverty Action Group
examples.zh: 解除儿童贫困行动小组

examples.en: Local parents have formed an action group to campaign for better road safety.
examples.zh: 当地的家长成立了行动小组，以争取改善道路安全状况。

senses.def: a toy in the form of a man, often a soldier
senses.zh: 机动人（一种人偶玩具，常采用士兵造型）

senses.def: a strong, active man

examples.en: The illness damaged his Action Man image.
examples.zh: 这场病损害了他的硬汉形象。

senses.def: a film that has a lot of exciting action and adventure
a British organization, originally founded in 1911, that helps people who are deaf
senses.zh: 听力损失行动：一家英国组织，最初成立于1911年，旨在帮助失聪（听不清）或听不清声音的人。直到2011年，它才被称为皇家国家聋人研究所。它支持并照顾有听力障碍的人，并提供实用建议，以帮助人们保护听力。

senses.def: full of exciting events and activity
senses.zh: 充满令人兴奋的活动的

examples.en: an action-packed weekend
examples.zh: 活动安排得满满的周末

senses.def: a method of painting used by Jackson Pollock
senses.zh: 行动绘画，动作绘画（在画布上随意泼洒倾泻颜料的抽象绘画技巧或风格，由杰克逊·波洛克而闻名，并构成更为普通的抽象表现主义运动的一部分）

senses.def: a suggestion for action that must be taken, especially one that is made in a meeting
senses.zh: （尤指在会议上达成的）行动方案

senses.def: part of something, for example a sports game on television, that is immediately repeated, often more slowly, so that you can see a goal or another exciting or important moment again
senses.zh: （体育比赛等电视画面的）即时重放，慢镜头回放

senses.def: an event or a situation that repeats something that has happened before

examples.en: It was an action replay of the problems of his first marriage.
examples.zh: 这是他第一次婚姻问题的重演。

senses.def: studies done by people doing a particular job or activity, especially in education, to improve the working methods of those involved
senses.zh: （尤指教育界为改进工作方法而进行的）行动研究

senses.def: the positions to which soldiers go to be ready for fighting
giving somebody a legally acceptable reason to bring a case to court
senses.zh: 可予起诉的；可提起诉讼的

examples.en: Our lawyer advised us that the breach of contract was actionable.
examples.zh: 我方律师建议，违约事项可以提起诉讼。

senses.def: that can be done or acted on

examples.en: The research is aimed at getting actionable solutions.
examples.zh: 这项研究旨在寻求可行的解决方案。

senses.def: a film that has a lot of exciting action and adventure
what a person actually does means more than what they say they will do
to make something such as a device or chemical process start working

examples.en: The burglar alarm is activated by movement.
examples.zh: 这防盗警报器一动就会响。

examples.en: The gene is activated by a specific protein.
examples.zh: 这种基因由一种特异性蛋白激活。

senses.def: the act of making something such as a device or chemical process start working

examples.en: The activation of several target genes results in two major effects.
examples.zh: 几个目标基因被激活，导致两个重要结果。

examples.en: to trigger/inhibit/block the activation of something
examples.zh: 触发／抑制／阻止某物的激活

senses.def: always busy doing things, especially physical activities

examples.en: Staying physically active in later years can also keep you feeling younger.
examples.zh: 晚年保持体力活动也能够使人感觉年轻。

examples.en: Before our modern age, people had a more physical and active lifestyle.
examples.zh: 进入现代社会以前，人们的生活方式是活动量大、忙忙碌碌。

senses.def: involved in something; making a determined effort and not leaving something to happen by itself

examples.en: They were both politically active.
examples.zh: 他们两人在政治上都很积极。

examples.en: his active involvement/participation in the arts
examples.zh: 他对艺术活动的积极参与

examples.en: She takes an active part in school life.
examples.zh: 她积极参加学校活动。

examples.en: He still has an active role in running the company.
examples.zh: 他仍然在公司的运营中发挥着积极的作用。

examples.en: an active participant/member
examples.zh: 积极的参与者；积极分子

examples.en: He is an active member of several professional organizations.
examples.zh: 他是多个专业组织的活跃成员。

examples.en: At 50, I'm an active participant in my community.
examples.zh: 50 岁时，我是社区的积极参与者。

examples.en: She remained active in politics until her death.
examples.zh: 她一直活跃在政治舞台上，直到去世。

examples.en: The parents were active in campaigning against cuts to the education budget.
examples.zh: 学生家长积极参加反对削减教育预算的活动。

examples.en: They took active steps to prevent the spread of the disease.
examples.zh: 他们采取积极措施，防止疾病蔓延。

senses.def: doing something regularly; functioning

examples.en: Numbers of sexually active teenagers have continued to rise.
examples.zh: 有性行为的青少年人数持续增加。

examples.en: These animals are active only at night.
examples.zh: 这些动物仅在夜间活动。

examples.en: The virus is still active in the blood.
examples.zh: 这种病毒仍然在血液中起作用。

examples.en: an active volcano (= likely to erupt)
examples.zh: 活火山

senses.def: lively and full of ideas
senses.zh: 活跃的；（思想上）充满活力的

examples.en: That child has a very active imagination.
examples.zh: 那个小孩想象力十分丰富。

examples.en: It's important to remain mentally active after retirement.
examples.zh: 退休后保持敏捷的思维是十分重要的。

senses.def: working; in use or able to be used

examples.en: The old watermill was active until 1960.
examples.zh: 这台旧水磨一直用到 1960 年。

examples.en: Ensure the website URL is an active link.
examples.zh: 确保网站 URL 是有效链接。

senses.def: having or causing a chemical effect

examples.en: What is the active ingredient in aspirin?
examples.zh: 什么是阿司匹林中的有效成分？

examples.en: drugs that are active against cancers
examples.zh: 对治疗癌症有效的药物

senses.def: connected with a verb whose subject is the person or thing that performs the action

examples.en: In ‘He was driving the car’, the verb is active.
examples.zh: 在 He was driving the car 一句中，动词是主动语态。

senses.def: the form of a verb in which the subject is the person or thing that performs the action

examples.en: In ‘She drove the car’, ‘she’ is the subject and the verb ‘drove’ is in the active.
examples.zh: 在“She drove the car”中，“she”是主语，动词“drove”是主动语态。

senses.def: a person who is actively involved in trying to improve things in their local community
senses.zh: 社区活动积极分子（积极参与社区事务以改善区内环境）

senses.def: taking part in military action as a member of the armed forces

examples.en: He has been treated in hospital and is returning to active duty.
examples.zh: 他已在医院接受治疗，即将返回继续服役。

examples.en: He sustained serious injuries while on active duty.
examples.zh: 他服役期间受了重伤。

senses.def: a list of people that an organization may contact at any time, offering a service, providing information, or asking them to do something
senses.zh: 积极分子名单（可用于随时联系以便提供服务、信息或寻求帮助等）

examples.en: Please email us to be removed from our active list of blood donors.
examples.zh: 假如你想把自己的名字从献血积极分子名单中删去，请给我们发电子邮件。

senses.def: a list of officers or former officers connected to one of the armed forces who can be called for duty
senses.zh: 服役名册（记录现役或退役军官）

senses.def: taking part in military action as a member of the armed forces, especially during a war

examples.en: troops on active service
examples.zh: 现役部队

senses.def: in a way that involves doing something
senses.zh: 积极地：以一种涉及做某事的方式

examples.en: Your proposal is being actively considered.
examples.zh: 正积极考虑您的建议。

examples.en: The government was actively hostile to any criticism of its policies.
examples.zh: 政府积极反对对其政策的任何批评。

senses.def: in a way that involves making a determined effort and not leaving something to happen by itself

examples.en: She was actively looking for a job.
examples.zh: 她在积极找工作。

senses.def: in a way that has or causes an effect
senses.zh: 积极地：以产生或引起影响的方式

examples.en: Some counterfeit drugs contain actively harmful ingredients.
examples.zh: 一些假药含有活性有害成分。

senses.def: the activity of working to achieve political or social change, especially as a member of an organization with particular aims

examples.en: political/social/environmental activism
examples.zh: 政治/社会/环境行动主义

senses.def: a person who works to achieve political or social change, especially as a member of an organization with particular aims

examples.en: human/civil/animal rights activists
examples.zh: 人权／公民权／动物权利活动人士

examples.en: Thousands of environmental activists joined the march to demand action on climate change.
examples.zh: 数千名环保活动人士参加了游行，要求采取行动应对气候变化。

examples.en: The Prime Minister will face party activists when he addresses the party conference tomorrow.
examples.zh: 首相明天在党内会议上发表讲话时将面对党内积极分子。

senses.def: a thing that you do for interest or pleasure
senses.zh: （出于兴趣爱好而进行的）活动

examples.en: leisure/outdoor/recreational activities
examples.zh: 休闲／户外／娱乐活动

examples.en: The club provides a wide variety of activities including tennis, swimming and squash.
examples.zh: 这家俱乐部的活动丰富多彩，诸如网球、游泳、壁球等。

senses.def: a thing that somebody does in order to achieve a particular aim
senses.zh: （为达到一定目的而进行的）活动

examples.en: criminal/terrorist/illegal activities
examples.zh: 犯罪／恐怖／非法活动

examples.en: The book contains plenty of ideas for classroom activities.
examples.zh: 这本书里有很多课堂活动的点子。

examples.en: He has decided to focus his time and resources on his business activities.
examples.zh: 他决定将时间和资源集中在他的商业活动上。

examples.en: We met to review progress and to coordinate our activities.
examples.zh: 我们开会审查进展情况并协调我们的活动。

senses.def: a situation in which something is happening or a lot of things are being done

examples.en: Economic activity has taken a downturn this year.
examples.zh: 今年的经济活动有所减退。

examples.en: The streets were noisy and full of activity.
examples.zh: 街上熙熙攘攘，车水马龙。

examples.en: Muscles contract and relax during physical activity.
examples.zh: 身体活动时肌肉收缩放松。

examples.en: There was no criminal activity involved.
examples.zh: 不涉及任何犯罪活动。

examples.en: The machines can monitor brain activity.
examples.zh: 这些机器可以监测大脑活动。

senses.def: a device that you can wear that records your daily physical activity, as well as other information about your health, such as your heart rate
senses.zh: （可穿戴的）健康追踪器（记录每日运动量以及心率等健康状况的仪器）

senses.def: a person who performs on the stage, on television or in films, especially as a profession

examples.en: Both lead actors (= the ones who play the main parts) are outstanding.
examples.zh: 两位主演都很出彩。

examples.en: She is one of the country’s leading actors.
examples.zh: 她是这个国家最优秀的演员之一。

examples.en: a stage/film/movie actor
examples.zh: 舞台/电影/电影演员

examples.en: a Hollywood actor
examples.zh: 好莱坞演员

examples.en: The movie starred a bunch of relatively unknown young actors.
examples.zh: 这部电影由一群相对不知名的年轻演员主演。

senses.def: a person who plays a part, pretending by their behaviour to be a particular kind of person

examples.en: I don't know if he really meant the things he said—he was always a good actor.
examples.zh: 我不知道他说的是不是真的，他一直很会装。

senses.def: a participant in an action or process

examples.en: Employers are key actors within industrial relations.
examples.zh: 雇主在劳资关系中是关键角色。

senses.def: an actor who is in charge of a theatre company and acts in the plays that they perform
a woman who performs on the stage, on television or in films, especially as a profession

examples.en: The Oscar-winning actress has taken a break from acting.
examples.zh: 这位奥斯卡获奖女演员已经暂别演艺圈。

examples.en: the lead actress from a hit show
examples.zh: 热播剧的女主角

examples.en: In 1940 he married actress Jane Wyman.
examples.zh: 1940年他与女演员简•怀曼结婚。

senses.def: a woman who plays a part, pretending by her behaviour to be a particular kind of person

examples.en: I became a very good actress and they nearly always believed me.
examples.zh: 我装得很好，他们几乎总是相信我。

senses.def: used to emphasize something that is real or exists in fact

examples.en: James looks younger than his wife but in actual fact (= really) he is five years older.
examples.zh: 詹姆斯看起来比他妻子年轻，但实际上他还大了五岁。

examples.en: The actual cost was higher than we expected.
examples.zh: 实际成本比我们预计的要高。

examples.en: The actual number of unemployed is more than 15 million.
examples.zh: 实际失业人数超过 1 500 万。

examples.en: What were his actual words?
examples.zh: 他的原话是什么？

examples.en: A variety of factors could cause our actual results to differ from the expected results.
examples.zh: 多种因素可能导致我们的实际结果与预期结果不同。

examples.en: The story of the film is based on actual events and people.
examples.zh: 影片的故事取材于真实事件和人物。

senses.def: used to emphasize the most important part of something
senses.zh: （强调事情最重要的部分）真正的，…本身

examples.en: The rehearsal was fabulous, the actual performance even better.
examples.zh: 彩排很精彩，实际演出更加出色。

examples.en: The wedding preparations take weeks but the actual ceremony takes less than an hour.
examples.zh: 准备婚礼要几周，而婚礼仪式本身还不到一小时。

senses.def: the crime of causing somebody minor physical injury
the state of something existing in reality

examples.en: The building looked as impressive in actuality as it did in photographs.
examples.zh: 这栋大楼外观雄伟，与照片中所见一模一样。

senses.def: things that exist
senses.zh: 真实情况；现实情况；事实

examples.en: the grim actualities of prison life
examples.zh: 严酷的监狱生活现实

senses.def: to make something real; to make something happen

examples.en: He finally actualized his dream.
examples.zh: 他最终实现了自己的梦想。

senses.def: used in speaking to emphasize a fact or a comment, or that something is really true
senses.zh: （在口语中用于强调事实）的确，真实地，事实上

examples.en: What did she actually say?
examples.zh: 她到底是怎么说的？

examples.en: It's not actually raining now.
examples.zh: 其实现在并没有下雨。

examples.en: The book was never actually published.
examples.zh: 这本书实际上从未出版。

examples.en: I'm glad we were actually able to get the message across.
examples.zh: 我很高兴我们真的能够传达信息。

examples.en: That's the only reason I'm actually going.
examples.zh: 那是我确实要走的唯一理由。

examples.en: There are lots of people there who can actually help you.
examples.zh: 那里有很多人可以真正帮上你的忙。

examples.en: I didn't want to say anything without actually reading the letter first.
examples.zh: 在没有确确实实看过那封信之前我什么也不想说。

senses.def: used to show a contrast between what is true and what somebody believes, and to show surprise about this contrast
senses.zh: （表示想法与事实不一致因而惊奇）居然，竟然

examples.en: It was actually kind of fun after all.
examples.zh: 这居然还蛮有趣。

examples.en: The food was not actually all that expensive.
examples.zh: 食物居然并不那么昂贵。

examples.en: Our turnover actually increased last year.
examples.zh: 去年我们的营业额竟然增加了。

examples.en: I couldn't believe it had all actually happened.
examples.zh: 我难以相信这一切竟然发生了。

senses.def: used to correct somebody in a polite way
senses.zh: （礼貌地纠正他人）实际上，事实上

examples.en: We're not American, actually. We're Canadian.
examples.zh: 实际上我们不是美国人。我们是加拿大人。

examples.en: Actually, it would be much more sensible to do it later.
examples.zh: 事实上，以后再办这件事可能要明智得多。

examples.en: They're not married, actually.
examples.zh: 他们实际上没有结婚。

senses.def: used to get somebody’s attention, to introduce a new topic or to say something that somebody may not like, in a polite way
senses.zh: （礼貌地引起注意、转换话题、直言）确实，说实话

examples.en: Actually, I'll be a bit late home.
examples.zh: 说真的，我回家会晚一点。

examples.en: Actually, I'm busy at the moment—can I call you back?
examples.zh: 说实在的，我这会儿正忙。我可以给你回电话吗？

examples.en: Well, actually, I think she's done a pretty good job.
examples.zh: 呃，老实说，我觉得她做得很不错。

senses.def: connected with the work of an actuary
senses.zh: 保险精算的;保险精算师的

examples.en: actuarial tables/calculations
examples.zh: 精算表/计算

senses.def: a person whose job involves calculating insurance risks and payments for insurance companies by studying how frequently accidents, fires, deaths, etc. happen
senses.zh: 精算师（研究事故、火灾、死亡等发生的频率，为保险公司计算保险风险和保险费）

senses.def: to make a machine or device start to work

examples.en: The timer must have been actuated by radio control.
examples.zh: 计时器必须由无线电控制启动。

senses.def: to make somebody behave in a particular way

examples.en: He was actuated entirely by malice.
examples.zh: 他完全是出于恶意。

senses.def: the ability to think, see or hear clearly

examples.en: a child’s visual acuity
examples.zh: 孩子的视力

senses.def: the ability to understand and decide things quickly and well

examples.en: He had demonstrated considerable business acumen.
examples.zh: 他表现出相当强的商业头脑。

examples.en: commercial/financial acumen
examples.zh: 商业/金融头脑

examples.en: She has an acumen for handling finances that far exceeds what one typically finds in our industry.
examples.zh: 她处理财务的敏锐性远远超出了我们行业中的一般人。

senses.def: a form of medical treatment, originally from East Asia, in which pressure is applied to particular parts of the body using the fingers
senses.zh: 指针疗法（一种治疗方式，以手指按压身体特定部位）

senses.def: a method of treating pain and illness using special thin needles that are pushed into the skin in particular parts of the body

examples.en: I'm having acupuncture for a bad back.
examples.zh: 我正在接受针刺治疗背痛。

examples.en: Needles are inserted into specific acupuncture points in the body.
examples.zh: 针刺入人体特定的穴位。

senses.def: a person who is trained to perform acupuncture
very serious or severe

examples.en: There is an acute shortage of water.
examples.zh: 水严重短缺。

examples.en: acute pain
examples.zh: 剧痛

examples.en: the world’s acute environmental problems
examples.zh: 全球十分严重的环境问题

examples.en: Competition for jobs is acute.
examples.zh: 求职竞争非常激烈。

examples.en: The scandal was an acute embarrassment for the President.
examples.zh: 这桩丑闻使总统处于极度难堪的境地。

examples.en: He was suffering from acute chest pains.
examples.zh: 他患了急性胸痛。

senses.def: an acute

examples.zh: 急性阑尾炎

examples.zh: 重症病房

examples.zh: 狗的嗅觉灵敏。

senses.def: intelligent and quick to notice and understand things

examples.en: He is an acute observer of the social scene.
examples.zh: 他是个敏锐的社会现状观察者。

examples.en: Her judgement is acute.
examples.zh: 她的判断敏锐。

noticing or feeling something very strongly
senses.zh: 深深感觉到；强烈意识到

examples.en: I am acutely aware of the difficulties we face.
examples.zh: 我十分清楚我们面临的困难。

senses.def: (describing unpleasant feelings) very; very strongly
senses.zh: （描述不快的感觉）极其，强烈地

examples.en: acutely embarrassed
examples.zh: 极其尴尬

senses.def: to a severe and dangerous degree

examples.en: acutely ill
examples.zh: 病重

senses.def: how serious or severe something is

examples.en: the acuteness of her injury
examples.zh: 她受伤的严重程度

senses.def: how sensitive and well developed a sense or mental ability is
senses.zh: 感觉或心智能力的敏感度和发达程度

examples.en: unusual acuteness of hearing
examples.zh: 听觉异常敏锐

examples.en: mental acuteness
examples.zh: 精神敏锐度

senses.def: the state or quality of

examples.en: accuracy
examples.zh: 精确性

senses.def: the status or position of
not occurring in cycles
containing no rings of atoms
a drug that is used to treat viruses
senses.zh: 阿昔洛韦（用于抗病毒的药）

senses.def: a notice, picture or film telling people about a product, job or service

examples.en: The TV ads were first run last year.
examples.zh: 这则电视广告去年首次播出。

examples.en: They've produced an ad for a new chocolate bar.
examples.zh: 他们为新品巧克力棒制作了一则广告。

examples.en: We put an ad on a classifieds website.
examples.zh: 我们在分类广告网站上刊登了一则广告。

examples.en: A $10 million TV ad campaign
examples.zh: 耗资1000万美元的电视广告活动

examples.en: an ad agency
examples.zh: 广告公司

senses.def: used in the Christian calendar
senses.zh: 公元（源自拉丁语 Anno Domini）

examples.zh: 公元 55 年

examples.en: in 55 AD
examples.zh: 公元 55 年

examples.en: in the fifth century AD
examples.zh: 公元 5 世纪

senses.def: a piece of software that removes the advertisements from a web page when you view it

examples.en: Widespread use of ad blockers could pose a threat to the way many websites are currently funded.
examples.zh: 广告拦截器的广泛使用可能会对许多网站目前的融资方式构成威胁。

senses.def: arranged or happening when necessary and not planned in advance
senses.zh: 临时安排的；特别的；专门的

examples.en: an ad hoc meeting to deal with the problem
examples.zh: 处理此问题的特别会议

examples.en: The meetings will be held on an ad hoc basis.
examples.zh: 会议将根据需要随时举行。

senses.def: in a way that is arranged or happens when necessary and is not planned in advance
senses.zh: 临时安排的；特别的；专门的

examples.en: The tribunals operated ad hoc and were dissolved when the work was concluded.
examples.zh: 法庭是临时运作的，并在工作结束后解散。

senses.def: directed against a person’s character rather than their argument

examples.en: an ad hominem attack
examples.zh: 人身攻击

senses.def: without ever coming to an end; again and again

examples.en: You cannot stay here ad infinitum without paying rent.
examples.zh: 你不付房租就不能一直住在这里。

examples.en: The problem would be repeated ad infinitum.
examples.zh: 这个问题会一再出现。

senses.def: if you give a speech or performance ad lib

examples.en: She delivered her lines ad lib.
examples.zh: 她的台词是即兴说出的。

senses.def: something that you say in a speech or a performance that you have not prepared or practised

examples.en: The speech was full of ad libs.
examples.zh: 讲话中满是即兴之词。

senses.def: to say something in a speech or a performance that you have not prepared or practised

examples.en: She abandoned her script and began ad-libbing.
examples.zh: 她抛开脚本即兴表演起来。

examples.en: I lost my notes and had to ad-lib the whole speech.
examples.zh: 我把讲稿弄丢了，只好临时说了一通。

examples.en: He ad-libbed his way through the meeting.
examples.zh: 他在会议中即兴发言。

senses.def: an ad-lib
if a person says or does something ad nauseam

examples.en: Sports commentators repeat the same phrases ad nauseam.
examples.zh: 体育解说员翻来覆去说着同样的词语，真叫人腻烦。

senses.def: according to the estimated value of the goods being taxed
senses.zh: 从价的，从价征收（按照应课税品的核定价值的一定比例征收）

senses.def: a well-known phrase expressing a general truth about people or the world

examples.en: According to the old adage, a picture is worth a thousand words.
examples.zh: 俗话说，一图胜千言。

slowly
a piece of music to be played slowly
a first name for boys
to not know at all who somebody is
senses.zh: 根本不认识某人；与某人素不相识

senses.def: to not know at all who somebody is
senses.zh: 根本不认识某人；与某人素不相识

senses.def: the first novel (1859) by George Eliot
senses.zh: 亚当·贝德（Adam Bede）：乔治·埃利奥特（George Eliot）的第一本小说（1859）。亚当·贝德（Adam Bede）是英国中部地区一个村庄的木匠，爱上了一个美丽的年轻女子，但她与另一个男人有悲惨的恋情。后来，亚当爱上了她的表弟，表姐是个好，冷静和虔诚的人。

senses.def: the part at the front of the throat that sticks out, particularly in men, and moves up and down when you swallow
(1723-90) a Scottish philosopher
senses.zh: 亚当·斯密（1723–1790）苏格兰哲学家和经济学家。信奉自由贸易和私营企业。他的《国富论》被认为是现代经济学的第一部重要著作。他的思想影响了不少现代政治家，包括撒切尔夫人和戈登·布朗。

senses.def: determined not to change your mind or to be persuaded about something

examples.en: Eva was adamant that she would not come.
examples.zh: 伊娃坚决不来。

examples.en: The government remained adamant that there was no more money available.
examples.zh: 政府仍然坚称没有更多资金可用。

senses.def: very strong and impossible to break
in a way that shows you are determined not to change your mind or to be persuaded about something

examples.en: His family were adamantly opposed to the marriage.
examples.zh: 他的家人坚决反对这门亲事。

senses.def: to change your behaviour in order to deal more successfully with a new situation

examples.en: It's amazing how soon you adapt.
examples.zh: 你这么快就适应了，真是令人惊奇。

examples.en: The organisms were forced to adapt in order to survive.
examples.zh: 生物被迫适应，以求生存。

examples.en: Some animals have a remarkable ability to adapt to changing environments.
examples.zh: 有些动物适应环境变化的能力相当强。

examples.en: A large organization can be slow to adapt to change.
examples.zh: 大机构可能应变迟缓。

examples.en: The company was able to adapt to the conditions and enhance its position.
examples.zh: 该公司能够适应条件并提高其地位。

examples.en: We have had to adapt quickly to the new system.
examples.zh: 我们不得不迅速适应了新制度。

examples.en: It took him a while to adapt himself to his new surroundings.
examples.zh: 他过了好一阵子才适应了新环境。

senses.def: to change something in order to make it suitable for a new use or situation
senses.zh: 使适应，使适合（新用途、新情况）

examples.en: These styles can be adapted to suit individual tastes.
examples.zh: 这些式样可以修改，以适应个人不同爱好。

examples.en: We need technology that can be adapted to suit the needs of the future.
examples.zh: 我们需要能够适应未来需求的技术。

examples.en: The gym has been adapted for use by visually impaired students.
examples.zh: 健身房经过改造，可供视障学生使用。

senses.def: to change a book or play so that it can be made into a play, film, television drama, etc.

examples.en: Three of her novels have been adapted for television.
examples.zh: 她的长篇小说中有三部已经登上电视荧幕。

examples.en: The radio play had been adapted from a novel.
examples.zh: 这部广播剧是由小说改编而成的。

examples.en: They have adapted her original novel beautifully.
examples.zh: 他们对她的原著小说进行了精美的改编。

examples.en: It was adapted for the screen from his original play.
examples.zh: 该剧根据他的原创剧本改编为银幕。

senses.def: the quality of being able to change or be changed in order to deal successfully with new situations
senses.zh: 有适应能力的；能适应的

examples.en: Small enterprises generally offer greater adaptability than larger firms.
examples.zh: 小企业通常比大企业具有更强的适应性。

senses.def: able to change or be changed in order to deal successfully with new situations
senses.zh: 有适应能力的；能适应的

examples.en: Older workers can be as adaptable and quick to learn as anyone else.
examples.zh: 较年长的工人的适应能力和学习速度有时并不亚于其他任何人。

examples.en: Successful businesses are highly adaptable to economic change.
examples.zh: 成功的企业对于经济变化的适应能力很强。

examples.en: The company provides highly adaptable business systems.
examples.zh: 这家公司的业务系统适应性非常强。

examples.en: The vehicles are large and not easily adaptable to new uses.
examples.zh: 这些交通工具很大，不易改作新的用途。

senses.def: the action or process of changing something, or of being changed, to suit a new purpose or situation

examples.en: the adaptation of buildings for military purposes
examples.zh: 出于军事目的对建筑进行的改造

examples.en: The process of adaptation to a new school is difficult for some children.
examples.zh: 对有些孩子来说，适应新学校的过程非常艰难。

examples.en: making adaptations to your home
examples.zh: 改造你的家

senses.def: a film, television drama or play that is based on a particular book or play but has been changed to suit the new medium

examples.en: a screen adaptation of Shakespeare’s ‘Macbeth’
examples.zh: 莎士比亚悲剧《麦克白》的电影改写本

senses.def: the process of change by which a species becomes better suited to its environment

examples.en: the adaptation of desert species to the hot conditions
examples.zh: 沙漠物种对炎热环境的适应

examples.en: Adaptations in plants occur over thousands of years.
examples.zh: 植物发生适应性变化要花上成千上万年。

senses.def: a device for connecting pieces of electrical equipment that were not designed to fit together
a device for connecting more than one piece of equipment to the same socket
senses.zh: （供多个设备连接电源的）多头插座，多功能插座

senses.def: a person who changes a book or play so that it can be made into a play, film, television drama, etc.

examples.en: award-winning writer and adapter Andrew Davies
examples.zh: 屡获殊荣的作家和改编者安德鲁·戴维斯

senses.def: connected with changing; able to change when necessary in order to deal with different situations

examples.en: Adaptive learning systems offer students customized learning experiences according to their needs and capabilities.
examples.zh: 适应性学习系统根据学生的需要和能力为他们提供个性化的学习体验。

senses.def: Agricultural Development and Advisory Service
aide-de-camp
to put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, amount, etc.

examples.en: Next add the flour.
examples.zh: 接着加面粉。

examples.en: The juice contains no added sugar.
examples.zh: 这种果汁没有加糖。

examples.en: As an added bonus, the book includes many black-and-white photographs.
examples.zh: 作为额外福利，这本书加入了许多黑白照片。

examples.en: Melt the butter, then add the onion.
examples.zh: 融化黄油，然后加入洋葱。

examples.en: The plan has the added (= extra) advantage of bringing employment to rural areas.
examples.zh: 该计划还有一个优点，就是给农村地区带来了就业机会。

examples.en: Shall I add your name to the list?
examples.zh: 我可以把你的名字写进名单吗？

examples.en: They are looking at ways to add further value to their products.
examples.zh: 他们正在研究进一步增加产品附加值的方法。

examples.en: There are a number of ways to add emphasis to words on a web page.
examples.zh: 有多种方法可以强调网页上的文字。

examples.en: A new wing was added to the building.
examples.zh: 这栋大楼新添了一座配楼。

examples.en: Chlorine is added to the water to kill bacteria.
examples.zh: 在水中加氯杀菌

senses.def: to put numbers or amounts together to get a total

examples.en: He knew how to add and subtract.
examples.zh: 他知道如何做加减法。

examples.en: Add 9 to the total.
examples.zh: 总数再加上 9。

examples.en: If you add all these amounts together you get a huge figure.
examples.zh: 你把这些数目加在一起就会得到一个巨额数字。

senses.def: to say something more; to make a further remark

examples.zh: “还有别迟到。”她补充说道。

examples.en: I have nothing to add to my earlier statement.
examples.zh: 我对我早先说的话没有什么补充的。

examples.en: Do you have anything to add?
examples.zh: 你有什么要补充的吗？

examples.en: He added that they would return a week later.
examples.zh: 他接着说，他们一周以后会回来。

examples.zh: “这家酒店适合儿童入住，”她说，并补充说儿童可享受特价优惠。

examples.zh: 这套家具会给你的卧室增添一些典雅气质。

examples.en: The Easter Festival added a new dimension to Salzburg's musical life.
