examples.zh: 他们讨论了困扰钢铁工业的问题。

senses.def: to make somebody ill

examples.en: What is ailing you?
examples.zh: 你哪里不舒服？

senses.def: a part of the wing of a plane that moves up and down to control the plane’s balance
an illness that is not very serious

examples.en: childhood/common/minor ailments
examples.zh: 儿童期／常见／轻微小病

examples.en: I got all the usual childhood ailments.
examples.zh: 所有常见的儿童期疾病我都得过。

examples.en: Below is a list of common childhood ailments.
examples.zh: 下面是一份儿童期常见轻微病症的清单。

synonyms.words: illness ▪ disorder ▪ infection ▪ condition ▪ ailment ▪ bug

intro.en: These are all words for a medical problem.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示健康问题。

items.def: a medical problem affecting humans, animals or plants, often caused by infection:
items.zh: 常指人、动植物感染的病、疾病

examples.en: He suffers from a rare blood disease.
examples.zh: 他患有一种罕见的血液病。

items.def: a medical problem, or a period of suffering from one:
items.zh: 指病、疾病或患病期

examples.en: She died after a long illness.
examples.zh: 她久病不愈而亡。

items.def: (rather formal) a condition that causes problems with the way part of the body or brain works:
items.zh: 失调症（disorder）一种导致身体或大脑部分工作方式出现问题的病症：

examples.en: a rare disorder of the liver
examples.zh: 一种罕见的肝病

items.def: an illness that is caused by bacteria or a virus and that affects one part of the body:
items.zh: 指由细菌或病毒引起的身体某部位的感染或传染疾病

examples.en: a throat infection
examples.zh: 喉部感染

items.def: a medical problem that you have for a long time because it is not possible to cure it:
items.zh: 指因不可治愈而长期患有的疾病

examples.en: a heart condition
examples.zh: 心脏病

items.def: (rather formal) an illness that is not very serious:
items.zh: 指轻病、小恙

examples.en: childhood ailments
examples.zh: 儿童期小病

items.def: (informal) an infectious illness that is usually fairly mild:
items.zh: 指轻微的传染病、小病

examples.en: a stomach bug
examples.zh: 胃病

senses.def: to try or plan to achieve something

examples.en: He has always aimed high (= tried to achieve a lot).
examples.zh: 他总是心气很高。

examples.en: We should aim for a bigger share of the market.
examples.zh: 我们应该以更大的市场份额为目标。

examples.en: The team is aiming for the top this season.
examples.zh: 球队本赛季的目标是登顶。

examples.en: Don't try to aim for perfection.
examples.zh: 不要追求完美。

examples.en: The government is aiming at a 50% reduction in unemployment.
examples.zh: 政府正着力将失业人数减少 50%。

examples.en: They are aiming to reduce unemployment by 50%.
examples.zh: 他们正力求使失业人数减少 50%。

examples.en: The project aims to provide employment for people with learning difficulties.
examples.zh: 该项目旨在为有学习障碍的人提供就业机会。

examples.en: We aim to be there around six.
examples.zh: 我们设法六点钟左右到那里。

examples.en: The training programme aims at raising employees' awareness about human rights.
examples.zh: 该培训方案旨在提高雇员的人权意识。

senses.def: to have something as an aim

examples.en: The initiative is specifically aimed at helping young people.
examples.zh: 这项倡议专为帮助年轻人。

examples.en: These measures are aimed at preventing violent crime.
examples.zh: 这些措施旨在防止暴力犯罪。

senses.def: to say or do something that is intended to influence or affect a particular person or group

examples.en: The courses are aimed primarily at older people.
examples.zh: 这些课程主要针对老年人。

examples.en: My criticism wasn't aimed at you.
examples.zh: 我的批评不是针对你的。

examples.en: The book is aimed at very young children.
examples.zh: 这本书的读者对象是幼童。

senses.def: to point or direct a weapon, camera, shot, kick, etc. at somebody/something

examples.en: I was aiming at the tree but hit the car by mistake.
examples.zh: 我对准树射击，不料误中了汽车。

examples.en: Aim for the middle of the target.
examples.zh: 瞄准靶心。

examples.en: She raised one leg and aimed an almighty kick at the door.
examples.zh: 她抬起一条腿，对着门狠狠地踢了一脚。

examples.en: I aimed my camera and got one shot.
examples.zh: 我调准相机镜头拍了一张照片。

examples.en: He aimed the rifle in the direction of the target and fired.
examples.zh: 他将步枪瞄准目标方向并开火。

senses.def: the purpose of doing something; what somebody is trying to achieve

examples.en: the stated aims of the study
examples.zh: 研究的既定目标

examples.en: Our main aim is to provide affordable childcare.
examples.zh: 我们的主要目标是提供平价的儿童保育服务。

examples.en: His sole aim in life is to enjoy himself.
examples.zh: 他唯一的人生目标就是享受生活。

examples.en: Teamwork is required in order to achieve these aims.
examples.zh: 要达到这些目标需要齐心协力。

examples.en: to pursue/further/fulfil your aims
examples.zh: 追求/进一步/实现你的目标

examples.en: She set out the company's aims and objectives in her speech.
examples.zh: 她在讲话中提出了公司的各项目标。

examples.en: The organization was formed with the aim of helping local people.
examples.zh: 这个组织是为帮助当地人而成立的。

senses.def: the action or skill of pointing a weapon at somebody/something

examples.en: Her aim was good and she hit the target with her first shot.
examples.zh: 她的瞄准很好，第一枪就击中了目标。

examples.en: The gunman took aim (= pointed his weapon) and fired.
examples.zh: 持枪歹徒瞄准后就射击了。

examples.en: His aim was poor and he missed the target.
examples.zh: 他瞄得不准，没有击中目标。

examples.en: It was a perfect aim and there was no way he would miss.
examples.zh: 这是一个完美的目标，他不可能失手。

senses.def: to direct your criticism at somebody/something
senses.zh: 把目标对准某人（或某事物）；把批评的矛头指向某人（或某事物）

senses.def: to direct your criticism at somebody/something
senses.zh: 把目标对准某人（或某事物）；把批评的矛头指向某人（或某事物）

intro.en: These are all words for talking about what somebody/​something intends to do or achieve.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指意图、目的、目标。

items.def: what something is supposed to achieve; what somebody is trying to achieve:
items.zh: 指目的、目标

examples.en: Our campaign’s main purpose is to raise money.
examples.zh: 我们这次活动的主要目的是募款。

items.def: what somebody is trying to achieve; what something is supposed to achieve:
items.zh: 指目标、目的

examples.en: She went to London with the aim of finding a job.
examples.zh: 她去伦敦是为了找工作。

items.def: what you intend to do:
items.zh: 指打算、计划、意图

examples.en: I have no intention of going to the wedding.
examples.zh: 我无意去参加婚礼。

items.def: what you intend to do or achieve:
items.zh: 指计划、打算

examples.en: There are no plans to build new offices.
examples.zh: 现在没有建新办公楼的计划。

items.def: (rather informal) the purpose or aim of something:
items.zh: 指意图、目的、理由

examples.en: What’s the point of all this violence?
examples.zh: 这些暴行的意图何在？

items.def: (rather informal) the purpose of something; somebody’s aim:
items.zh: 指目的、意图

examples.en: The whole idea of going was so that we could meet her new boyfriend.
examples.zh: 我们去的唯一目的就是要见她的新男朋友。

senses.def: having no direction or plan
senses.zh: 没有方向的；无目标的；无计划的

examples.en: My life seemed aimless.
examples.zh: 我的生活似乎没有目标。

examples.en: She was wandering around in a somewhat aimless way.
examples.zh: 她有些漫无目的地闲逛着。

senses.def: in a way that shows no direction or plan
senses.zh: 没有方向的；无目标的；无计划的

examples.en: He drifted aimlessly from one job to another.
examples.zh: 他漫无目的地换了一份又一份工作。

senses.def: the fact of having no direction or plan
senses.zh: 没有方向的；无目标的；无计划的

examples.en: He worried about his son’s aimlessness and lack of ambition.
examples.zh: 他担心儿子漫无目的、缺乏雄心。

senses.def: am not/is not/are not

examples.en: Things ain't what they used to be.
examples.zh: 现在情况不比从前了。

senses.def: has not/have not

examples.en: I ain't got no money.
examples.zh: 我没有钱。

examples.en: You ain't seen nothing yet.
examples.zh: 你还什么都没有看到呢。

senses.def: used to say that if something works well enough, it should not be changed

items.idm: if it ain’t broke, don’t fix it

senses.def: used to say that if something works well enough, it should not be changed
a course near Liverpool
senses.zh: 英格兰利物浦附近的赛马场。其中最著名的是大国民。

senses.def: a thick cold sauce made of mayonnaise
the mixture of gases that surrounds the earth and that we breathe

examples.en: Let's go out for some fresh air.
examples.zh: 咱们出去呼吸点新鲜空气。

examples.en: a blast of hot air
examples.zh: 一阵热气

examples.en: currents of warm air
examples.zh: 暖气流

examples.en: He stood outside, breathing the cold night air.
examples.zh: 他站在外面，呼吸着夜晚寒冷的空气。

examples.en: She was gasping for air as she ran out of the burning house.
examples.zh: 她从着火的房子中逃出来时上气不接下气。

examples.en: whales coming up for air (= in order to breathe)
examples.zh: 鲸鱼上来换气

examples.en: I need to put some air in my tyres.
examples.zh: 我需要给我的轮胎打些气。

examples.en: The agreement requires reductions in air pollution.
examples.zh: 该协议要求减少空气污染。

examples.en: The Act lays down a minimum standard for air quality.
examples.zh: 这项法案规定了空气质量的最低标准。

senses.def: the space above the ground or that is around things

examples.en: Music filled the night air.
examples.zh: 乐声荡漾在夜空中。

examples.en: Wave your hands in the air!
examples.zh: 把手举高，摇动起来！

examples.en: I kicked the ball high into the air.
examples.zh: 我把球高高地踢到空中。

examples.en: Spicy smells wafted through the air.
examples.zh: 空中飘来一阵阵浓烈的气味。

examples.en: He punched the air in triumph.
examples.zh: 他高兴地挥了挥拳头。

examples.en: The air was thick with cigarette smoke.
examples.zh: 空气中满是香烟的烟雾。

senses.def: the space above the earth where planes fly

examples.en: The temple was clearly visible from the air.
examples.zh: 从空中看去，那座庙宇清晰可辨。

examples.en: We watched as the helicopter took to the air.
examples.zh: 我们看着直升机升空。

examples.en: It only takes three hours by air (= in a plane).
examples.zh: 乘飞机只要三个小时。

examples.en: air travel/traffic
examples.zh: 航空旅行；空中交通

examples.en: air defence systems (= weapons that defend against attacks from the air)
examples.zh: 防空系统

examples.en: A surprise air attack (= from aircraft) was launched at night.
examples.zh: 夜间突然发起了空袭。

senses.def: the particular feeling or impression that is given by somebody/something; the way somebody does something

examples.en: She looked at him with a defiant air.
examples.zh: 她用蔑视的神情望着他。

examples.en: The room had an air of luxury.
examples.zh: 房间具有豪华的气派。

examples.en: There was an air of complete confidence about her.
examples.zh: 她显得信心十足。

senses.def: a tune

examples.en: Bach’s Air on a G string
examples.zh: 巴赫《G 弦上的咏叹调》

senses.def: a way of behaving that shows that somebody thinks that they are more important, etc. than they really are

examples.en: I hate it when people put on airs.
examples.zh: 我讨厌人们摆架子。

senses.def: a way of behaving that shows that somebody thinks that they are more important, etc. than they really are

examples.en: Even when he became a star he didn’t have any airs and graces.
examples.zh: 即使成了明星，他也没有架子。

senses.def: clean air breathed in after being indoors or in a dirty atmosphere

examples.en: We'll get a breath of fresh air at lunchtime.
examples.zh: 我们午餐时出去透透气。

examples.en: I'm going outside for a breath of fresh air.
examples.zh: 我要出去呼吸点儿新鲜空气。

senses.def: (to have) plans or dreams that are not likely to happen or come true

examples.en: As a child he would wander round the boatyards, building castles in the air about owning a boat one day.
examples.zh: 小时候，他会在船坞周围闲逛，幻想有朝一日拥有一艘船。

senses.def: to improve a difficult or tense
senses.zh: （通过沟通）改变困境，缓解紧张状态，改善气氛

examples.en: This meeting will be an opportunity to clear the air and start the healing process.
examples.zh: 这次会议将是一个缓和紧张、弥合分歧的机会。

senses.def: to make the air less dirty or less humid

examples.en: Storms were supposed to clear the air.
examples.zh: 按说暴风雨可以净化空气。

senses.def: to disappear suddenly in a mysterious way
senses.zh: 消失得无影无踪；不翼而飞；悄然而逝

examples.en: She can’t just have vanished into thin air.
examples.zh: 她不可能凭空消失。

examples.en: At a stroke she could make things vanish into thin air.
examples.zh: 她用手碰到什么就能让它消失不见。

senses.def: used to refer to an estimate or method of doing something that is not very accurate or scientific and partly based on guessing

examples.en: It isn’t an exact science—it’s a kind of finger in the air thing.
examples.zh: 这不是一门精确的科学——而是一种随意估计的事情。

examples.en: ‘It’s all a bit finger in the air,’ admitted a spokesman.
examples.zh: 一位发言人承认，这只是凭空猜测。

senses.def: to feel very happy

examples.en: Most couples feel they are walking on air on their wedding day.
examples.zh: 大多数新人在婚礼那天都感到乐不可支。

senses.def: felt by a number of people to exist or to be happening
senses.zh: 在传播中；流行；可感觉到

examples.en: There's romance in the air.
examples.zh: 有种浪漫的气氛。

senses.def: broadcasting or not broadcasting on television or radio

examples.en: We will be back on air tomorrow morning at 7.
examples.zh: 明天早上 7 点本节目再见。

examples.en: The programme was taken off the air over the summer.
examples.zh: 这个节目在夏季停播。

senses.def: from nowhere or nothing, as if by magic

examples.en: Unfortunately, I can’t just conjure up the money out of thin air!
examples.zh: 不幸的是，我不能凭空变出钱来！

senses.def: to say a name, number, etc. without thinking about it, especially in answer to a question

examples.en: I just plucked a figure out of the air and said : ‘Would £1 000 seem reasonable to you?’
examples.zh: 我随口说出一个数字问道：“你看 1 000 英镑合适吗？”

senses.def: not yet decided

examples.en: Our travel plans are still up in the air.
examples.zh: 我们的旅行计划尚未确定。

senses.def: in a way that is not friendly and suggests that you think that you are better than other people
senses.zh: 傲慢；看不起人；鼻孔朝天，自高自大

examples.en: She walked in with her nose in the air, ignoring everyone.
examples.zh: 她傲慢地走进来，谁也不理。

senses.def: to put clothing, etc. in a place that is warm or has plenty of air so that it dries completely and smells fresh; to be left to dry somewhere

examples.en: Air the sheets well.
examples.zh: 把这些床单好好晾晒一下。

examples.en: Leave the towels out to air.
examples.zh: 把毛巾拿出去晾干。

senses.def: to allow fresh air into a room or a building; to be filled with fresh air

examples.en: The rooms had all been cleaned and aired.
examples.zh: 所有的房间都已打扫干净并且通了风。

examples.en: Leave the window open to air the room.
examples.zh: 开窗通风。

senses.def: to express your opinions publicly

examples.en: The weekly meeting enables employees to air their grievances.
examples.zh: 周会可以让雇员诉说他们的委屈。

examples.en: The issues were openly aired and discussed by the group.
examples.zh: 这些问题被公开提出并在小组进行了讨论。

senses.def: to broadcast a programme on the radio or on television; to be broadcast

examples.en: The show will be aired next Tuesday night.
examples.zh: 这个节目将在下周二夜间播出。

examples.en: The programme aired last week.
examples.zh: 该节目于上周播出。

senses.group: radio/TV programme 广播／电视节目

senses.def: the clear liquid that is found in drinks such as beer, wine, etc. and is used in medicines, cleaning products, etc.

examples.en: Wine contains about 10% alcohol.
examples.zh: 葡萄酒含有约 10% 的酒精。

examples.en: The food and drink industry has responded to the demand for low- and no-alcohol drinks.
examples.zh: 食品和饮料行业已经满足了对低酒精和无酒精饮料的需求。

examples.en: levels of alcohol in the blood
examples.zh: 血液中酒精含量

examples.en: She was arrested for driving under the influence of alcohol.
examples.zh: 她因酒后驾车而被捕。

examples.en: He pleaded guilty to driving with excess alcohol.
examples.zh: 他对过量饮酒后驾车一事表示服罪。

examples.zh: 酒精度低的啤酒

examples.zh: 不含酒精的啤酒

examples.zh: 酒精饮料

examples.zh: 果汁尝起来略带酒精味。

examples.zh: 客人们醉醺醺地离去了。

examples.zh: 豪因为工作压力而开始酗酒。

examples.zh: 我认为没有适当的药物帮助，酗酒者戒不了酒。

senses.def: an international organization, begun in Chicago in 1935, for people who are trying to stop drinking alcohol. They have meetings to help each other.
senses.zh: 匿名戒酒会（1935 年成立于芝加哥的国际组织，成员不用全名）

examples.zh: 戒酒互诫协会等自助团体

examples.zh: 戒酒互诫协会每周在中心举行两次聚会。

senses.def: the medical condition caused by drinking too much alcohol regularly

examples.zh: 他最终为酗酒寻求治疗。

senses.zh: 壁凹，凹室，壁龛（房内墙壁凹进空间）

examples.en: The bookcase fits neatly into the alcove.
examples.zh: 书架正好放得进壁凹。

senses.zh: 桤木（多见于北方国家潮湿地区）

senses.zh: （旧时英格兰和威尔士的）高级市政官（职位低于市长）

senses.zh: （美国、加拿大、澳大利亚的）市政委员会委员

examples.zh: 市政委员会委员蒂姆·埃文斯

senses.zh: 位于英国伯克郡的一个小镇，靠近重要的核武器研究中心。在1950年代和1960年代，从伦敦到Aldermaston举行了大型有组织的游行，以抗议核武器。

senses.def: the furthest north of the Channel Islands
senses.zh: 奥尔德尼岛（位于英吉利海峡最北端，是海峡群岛中的第三大岛屿）

senses.zh: 奥尔德肖特（英格兰南部城镇）

senses.def: a type of beer without bubbles. There are several kinds of ale

examples.en: a pint of ale
examples.zh: 一品脱啤酒

examples.en: This pub specializes in fine ales.
examples.zh: 这家酒吧专营优质麦芽酒。

senses.zh: 一杯（或一瓶、一罐）麦芽啤酒

examples.en: Two light ales please.
examples.zh: 请来两杯淡麦芽啤酒。

senses.def: relating to music or other forms of art that involve elements of chance in their creation or performance

examples.en: Some will be amused to know that Mozart composed aleatory music and even devised a dice game to write it.
examples.zh: 有些人会很高兴知道莫扎特创作了偶然的音乐，甚至设计了一个骰子游戏来编写它。

examples.en: Her musical work is an aleatoric succession of dub rhythms, circus melodies and mechanical sound.
examples.zh: 她的音乐作品是配音节奏、马戏旋律和机械声音的任意连续。

senses.def: a first name for boys, short for Alexander
senses.zh: 亚历克（男子名，Alexander 缩写）

senses.def: (1903-95) a British conservative politician and Prime Minister (1963-4). He was a Member of Parliament
senses.zh: 亚历克·道格拉斯·霍姆（Alec Douglas-Home）：（1903-95）英国保守派政治家兼总理（1963-4）。1951年父亲去世后，他成为国会上议院议员，并成为上议院议员。但是在1963年，他放弃了自己的头衔，以便以亚历克·道格拉斯·霍姆爵士的身份回到下议院，成为总理。1974年，他成为终身同伴，并以上议院的身份回到上议院。

senses.def: (1914-2000) an English actor who appeared in a wide variety of plays and films. Some of his best-remembered films were Ealing comedies
senses.zh: 亚历克·吉尼斯（Alec Guinness）：（1914-2000）一位英国演员，曾参加各种戏剧和电影。他最著名的电影是Ealing喜剧，包括Kind Hearts和Coronets（1949），他在其中扮演男性和女性八个角色。1957年，他在《桂河大桥》中获得奥斯卡奖。他还参加了根据约翰·勒·卡雷（John LeCarré）的小说创作的两个电视连续剧中的乔治·史蒂夫（George Smiley）的角色，并在《星球大战》中饰演了奥比·旺·克诺比（Obi-Wan Kenobi）。1959年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1906-88) a British car designer, born in Turkey. His two most successful designs were the Morris Minor
senses.zh: （1906-88）英国汽车设计师，出生于土耳其。他的两个最成功的设计是Morris Minor（1948）和Mini（1959）。1969年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: a place where people used to drink beer
to warn somebody about a dangerous situation or one that requires immediate action
senses.zh: 向…报警；使警觉；使警惕；使戒备

examples.en: Neighbours quickly alerted the emergency services.
examples.zh: 邻居很快向应急服务机构报了警。

examples.en: Alerted by a noise downstairs, he sat up and turned on the light.
examples.zh: 楼下的响声使他警觉，他坐起来打开灯。

examples.en: The coastguard were alerted that a yacht had run into difficulties.
examples.zh: 海岸警卫队接到警报称一艘游艇遇到了困难。

senses.def: to make somebody aware of something

examples.en: They had been alerted to the possibility of further price rises.
examples.zh: 他们已意识到价格可能继续上涨。

senses.def: a situation in which people are watching for danger and ready to deal with it

examples.en: Police are warning the public to be on the alert for suspicious packages.
examples.zh: 警方警告公众要警惕可疑包裹。

examples.en: More than 5 000 troops have been placed on (full) alert.
examples.zh: 5 000 多名士兵已处于（全面）戒备状态。

senses.def: a warning of danger or of a problem

examples.en: a bomb/fire alert
examples.zh: 炸弹／火警警报

senses.def: a signal on an electronic device to inform the user of something or remind them to do something

examples.en: You can set a vibrating alert to remind you.
examples.zh: 你可以给自己设置一个振动提醒。

examples.en: Receive regular text alerts about breaking news.
examples.zh: 接收有关突发新闻的定期短信提醒。

senses.def: able to think quickly; quick to notice things

examples.en: Suddenly he found himself awake and fully alert.
examples.zh: 突然他发觉自己醒了过来，而且高度警觉。

examples.en: Two alert scientists spotted the mistake.
examples.zh: 两个警觉的科学家发现了这个错误。

examples.en: Try to stay alert while driving at night.
examples.zh: 夜间驾驶时尽量保持警惕。

examples.en: an alert mind
examples.zh: 机警的头脑

examples.en: mentally alert
examples.zh: 机警

senses.def: aware of something, especially a problem or danger
senses.zh: 意识到，注意到（尤指问题或危险）

examples.en: We must be alert to the possibility of danger.
examples.zh: 我们必须认识到危险发生的可能性。

examples.en: She was alert to the slightest sound.
examples.zh: 她注意到了最轻微的声音。

senses.def: in a way that shows you are aware of something, especially a problem or danger
senses.zh: 意识到，注意到（问题或危险）

senses.def: the ability to think quickly and to notice things

examples.en: Sleep deprivation could affect mental alertness.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足可能会影响精神警觉性。

senses.def: the fact of being aware of something, especially a problem or danger
senses.zh: 意识到，注意到（问题或危险）

examples.en: With a real threat of ambush, the crews remained at a high state of alertness.
examples.zh: 面对真正的伏击威胁，船员们保持高度戒备状态。

senses.def: a member of an indigenous

examples.en: the local Aleut people
examples.zh: 当地的阿留申人

senses.zh: 亚历克斯（男子或女子名，Alexander 或 Alexandra缩写）

(1898-1976) a US sculptor
senses.zh: 亚历山大·考德（Alexander Calder）：（1898-1976）美国雕塑家。他以众多大型室外雕塑以及发明了移动装置而闻名，移动装置是一种雕塑，由可自由移动的不同部分组成，通常悬挂在电线上。

senses.def: (1881-1955) a Scottish scientist who became well known for discovering penicillin
senses.zh: 亚历山大·弗莱明（Alexander Fleming）：（1881-1955）是一位苏格兰科学家，因发现青霉素而闻名，青霉素是第一种成功杀死细菌并治愈感染的抗生素。1944年，他被任命为骑士； 1945年，他与两位同事共同获得了诺贝尔医学奖，这些同事帮助他开发了青霉素的用途。

senses.def: (1847-1922) a scientist and inventor
senses.zh: 亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔（1847–1922）科学家，发明家，以发明电话而闻名。生于苏格兰，1872 年起居于美国。后在美国创办贝尔电话公司，成为美国最大的公司之一。

senses.def: (c. 1757-1804) one of America's Founding Fathers
senses.zh: 亚历山大·汉密尔顿（约 1757–1804）美国的制宪元勋之一。曾参加美国独立战争，是《联邦党人文集》的作者之一，联邦党的创立者和领导者。曾任美国第一任财政部长（1789–1795），并建立了美国中央银行。在与副总统阿伦·伯尔（1756–1836）的一次决斗中受伤后去世。

senses.def: (1688-1744) an English poet, well known for his humour and intelligence. He is considered the greatest poet of the Augustan Age
senses.zh: 亚历山大·波普（Alexander Pope）：（1688-1744）英国诗人，以幽默和机智着称。他被认为是奥古斯都时代最伟大的诗人。他通过翻译荷马的《伊利亚特》（1715-20）和《奥德赛》（1725-6）而获得了主要作家的声誉，但是现在他的讽刺诗如《锁的强奸》和《给阿布诺特博士的书信》（1735）而闻名。取笑了当时的作家和时尚人士。

senses.def: the song that made Irving Berlin
senses.zh: 亚历山大的拉格时间乐队：使欧文柏林出名的歌曲。1911年，他写了一首快速、快乐的布格时间曲调。1938年，同名电影也传唱。

senses.def: a method of improving somebody’s health by teaching them how to stand, sit and move correctly
senses.zh: 亚历山大技巧，亚历山大正姿保健法（通过纠正不良的坐立行姿势，保持身体各部位的平衡以促进健康）

senses.def: a first name for girls
a large building in north London, surrounded by a park. It was first built for an international exhibition in central London in 1862, and later moved. It is best known for having been the BBC's
senses.zh: 亚历山德拉宫（伦敦北部的一座大型建筑，被公园所环绕。建造于1873年，其目的是作为北伦敦地区的娱乐和教育公共中心，而相对的南伦敦地区则建造有水晶宫）

senses.zh: 亚历山大诗体的；含六音步抑扬格的

senses.zh: 失读症（通常因脑部损伤导致）

senses.def: a first name for boys or girls
senses.zh: 亚历克西斯（男子或女子名）

senses.def: a character played by the actor Warren Mitchell in the BBC
senses.zh: 阿尔夫·加内特（指英国工人阶级中头脑顽固、自以为是的人）

senses.def: (1920-99) an English football player and manager. He was manager of the England team that won the World Cup in 1966, and was made a knight
senses.zh: （1920-99年）英国足球运动员兼经理。他曾是1966年赢得世界杯足球赛的英格兰队的经理，并于次年成为骑士。他在南安普敦和托特纳姆热刺的球员生涯也非常成功，他为英格兰队效力32次。

senses.def: a plant with small divided leaves and purple flowers, grown as food for farm animals and as a salad vegetable

a first name for boys
(1899-1980) an English film director best known for his thrillers
senses.zh: 艾尔弗雷德·希区柯克（1899–1980）英国电影导演，以惊悚片和恐怖片著称。在《三十九级台阶》（1935）和《贵妇失踪案》（1938）等影片获得成功后，于 1940 年移居美国，之后拍摄了《西北偏北》（1959）、《惊魂记》（1963）和《群鸟》（1963）等。希区柯克经常在自己的影片中客串露脸。1980 年被封为爵士。

senses.def: (1894-1956) a US scientist who published the first major scientific studies of human sexual behaviour. The results of his research, which shocked many people, came from answers to questions given by 10 000 people. His books were Sexual Behavior in the Human Male
senses.zh: 阿尔弗雷德·金西（Alfred Kinsey）：（1894-1956）是美国科学家，他发表了有关人类性行为的第一批重大科学研究。他的研究结果震惊了许多人，是来自对10,000人提出的问题的答案。他的著作是《人类的性行为》（1948年）和《人类的性行为》（1953年）。它们一起被称为《金西报告》。1942年，他在印第安纳大学建立了性研究所，并一直领导着该研究所直到他去世。

senses.def: (1878-1959) an English painter known especially for his pictures of horses and horse racing, and for criticizing a lot of modern art. He was made a knight
senses.zh: 阿尔弗雷德·曼宁（Alfred Munnings）：（1878-1959）英国画家，以其骑马和赛马的照片以及对许多现代艺术的批评而闻名。1944年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1864-1946) a US photographer who developed photography into a fine art. He managed several New York galleries, where he presented exhibitions of photographs and modern art. He was married to the artist Georgia O'Keeffe
senses.zh: 阿尔弗雷德·斯蒂格利茨（Alfred Stieglitz）：（1864-1946）是一位将摄影发展成美术的美国摄影师。他管理过几个纽约画廊（展示艺术品的地方），在那里他展示了摄影作品和现代艺术展览。他嫁给了艺术家佐治亚·奥基夫（Georgia O'Keeffe），并经常为她拍照。

senses.def: (849-99) king of Wessex
senses.zh: 阿尔弗烈德大帝（849–899）英格兰威塞克斯王国国王（871–899 在位）。因抗击丹麦入侵、建立英格兰海军、鼓励教育、使用英语而被铭记。有一个“阿尔弗烈德国王和饼”的故事广为流传，讲述一次战役后阿尔弗烈德藏身在一个妇人家中。女主人不认识他，让他照看炉子上烘烤的饼，他却把饼烤煳了，令女主人非常生气。

senses.def: (1907-91) an English author of books that give information to people walking for pleasure in the north of England, e.g. in the Lake District
senses.zh: 阿尔弗雷德·温赖特（Alfred Wainwright）：（1907-91）的英文作家，为英格兰北部（例如湖区）散步的人们提供信息。这些书还包含他自己的插图。

senses.zh: 阿尔及利亚人；阿尔及利亚的；阿尔及利亚人的

senses.def: (1837-1909) an English poet and critic. He was a writer with a lot of skill, but his lack of respect for the Christian religion and the sexual themes in his poetry shocked many people in Victorian
senses.zh: （1837-1909）英国诗人和评论家。他是一位技术娴熟的作家，但由于缺乏对基督教信仰和诗歌中的性主题的尊重，这震惊了维多利亚时代英国的许多人。他最著名的作品包括三部关于苏格兰女王玛丽的戏剧和里昂内斯（1882）的诗《崔斯特拉姆》。他是但丁·加布里埃尔·罗塞蒂（Dante Gabriel Rossetti）和其他拉斐尔前派的密友。

senses.def: a substance that kills algae

senses.zh: 用于科学计算的早期计算机语言

examples.zh: 公司使用机器学习算法向求职者推荐工作。

examples.en: to apply a complex/sophisticated algorithm
examples.zh: 使用复杂算法

examples.zh: 开发/设计/调整算法

examples.zh: 从网上购物到机场跑道，算法在现代生活中无处不在。

senses.zh: 哈娅（去麦加完成了正朝功课的穆斯林女子，常用作称谓）

senses.zh: 哈吉（去麦加完成了正朝功课的穆斯林男子，常用作称谓）

senses.def: a character in an old Arabian story who hears some thieves say 'Open Sesame!’, the magic words that open the door of the cave
senses.zh: 阿里巴巴阿拉伯古老民间故事中的人物。他听见盗贼喊“芝麻开门”，这是打开盗贼收藏所有赃物的山洞之门的咒语。阿里巴巴偷了盗贼的金子，盗贼想杀死他，但他的仆人默吉亚那救了他。这个故事经常在英国作为童话剧上演，很受欢迎。

senses.def: a comedy character played by the English comedian
senses.zh: 由英国喜剧演员Sacha Baron Cohen扮演的喜剧角色。他最初出现在1999年的英国电视连续剧《 11点钟秀》中，随后出现在英国和美国的Da Ali G Show中，以及电影《 Ali G In Da House》（2002年）中。他使用语言，穿衣服并保持态度，这是尝试复制黑人街头文化的英国年轻人所特有的。他采访了名人，并问了他们一些愚蠢的问题。

senses.def: items connected with the particular area of activity or interest mentioned
senses.zh: （与某活动或兴趣范围）有关的物品

examples.en: kitchenalia

senses.def: used when a person, especially a criminal or an actor, is known by two names
senses.zh: （罪犯、演员等）又名，亦名，别名，化名

senses.def: (1621-78) one of the English metaphysical poets

senses.def: (1855-1937) a rich US businessman who also served in the US government. He gave large amounts of money to help charities, museums, etc. He was Secretary of the Treasury (1921-31) and then US Ambassador to Britain (1932-3). In 1937 he gave his large art collection to establish the National Gallery of Art

senses.def: to heat metal or glass and allow it to cool slowly, in order to make it softer and easier to shape (= more ductile
a first name for girls
to take control of a country, region, etc., especially by force

examples.en: Germany annexed Austria in 1938.
examples.zh: 1938 年德国吞并了奥地利。

examples.en: The territory had been annexed to Poland.
examples.zh: 这块领地已并入波兰。

senses.def: the act of taking control of a country, region, etc, especially by force

examples.en: the US annexation of Texas in 1845
examples.zh: 1845 年美国吞并德克萨斯州

examples.en: illegal annexations of territories
examples.zh: 非法兼并领土

senses.def: a building that is added to, or is near, a larger one and that provides extra living or work space
senses.zh: 附属建筑物；附加建筑物

examples.en: Our rooms were in the annexe.
examples.zh: 我们的房间在附属建筑物里。

senses.def: an extra section of a document
a US musical play (1946) by Irving Berlin
senses.zh: 安妮·Get Your Gun：欧文·柏林（Irving Berlin）的美国音乐剧（1946）。这是一个关于安妮·奥克利（Annie Oakley）的故事，一部电影版本是1950年制作的。其中的一首歌《没有像演艺界的生意》对艺人有特殊的意义。

senses.def: a successful US film (1977), written and directed by Woody Allen in which he acted with Diane Keaton. It is a romantic comedy and won Oscars
senses.zh: 安妮·霍尔（Annie Hall）：一部成功的美国电影（1977），由伍迪·艾伦（Woody Allen）执导并执导，他与黛安·基顿（Diane Keaton）合作。这是一部浪漫喜剧，并获得了奥斯卡最佳影片，最佳导演和最佳女主角奖。

senses.def: (1860-1926) a famous US sharpshooter
senses.zh: 安妮·奥克利（1860–1926）美国著名神枪手，绰号“小小必中射手”，因其身高不足 5 英尺（1.53 米）。丈夫弗兰克·巴特勒也是一名神枪手，夫妇俩在“水牛比尔”的狂野西部秀中表演。音乐剧及电影《飞燕金枪》即以她的生平为原型。

senses.def: a free ticket or pass, for example for a theatre performance. It is called this because it has holes in it (so that it cannot be used again) and looks like one of the cards shot by Annie Oakley
senses.zh: （用于观剧等的）赠券，免费入场券 （券上有孔，如同安妮·奥克利射中的纸牌，因此得名）

senses.def: to destroy somebody/something/yourself completely

examples.en: The human race has enough weapons to annihilate itself.
examples.zh: 人类有足够的武器灭绝自己。

senses.def: to defeat somebody/something completely

examples.en: She annihilated her opponent, who failed to win a single game.
examples.zh: 她大获全胜，对方连一局也没有赢。

senses.def: the act of somebody/something being completely destroyed

examples.en: the annihilation of the whole human race
examples.zh: 全人类的毁灭

senses.def: the complete defeat of somebody/something

examples.en: The Brazilian needed just 82 minutes to complete the annihilation of his opponent.
examples.zh: 巴西人只用了82分钟就完成了对对手的歼灭。

senses.def: a date that is an exact number of years after the date of an important or special event

examples.en: on the anniversary of his wife’s death
examples.zh: 在他妻子的忌日

examples.en: to celebrate your wedding anniversary
examples.zh: 庆祝结婚纪念日

examples.en: the theatre’s 25th anniversary celebrations
examples.zh: 剧院 25 周年庆祝活动

examples.en: The company is celebrating its 100-year anniversary this year.
examples.zh: 该公司今年庆祝成立 100 周年。

examples.en: Public events will be held to commemorate the anniversary of the end of the Second World War.
examples.zh: 将举行公共活动来纪念第二次世界大战结束周年纪念日。

examples.en: They held celebrations to mark the anniversary of Mozart's death.
examples.zh: 他们为莫扎特逝世举办周年纪念活动。

examples.en: a yearlong celebration of the 25th anniversary of his company
examples.zh: 为期一年的公司成立 25 周年庆祝活动

examples.en: The context was the occasion of the 450th anniversary of his birth.
examples.zh: 背景是他诞辰450周年之际。

senses.def: to add notes to a book or text, giving explanations or comments

examples.en: The drawings were all clearly annotated.
examples.zh: 图纸都标注得很清楚。

examples.en: The text was annotated with her own comments.
examples.zh: 该文本附有她自己的评论。

senses.def: a note or notes added to a book or text giving explanations or comments; the act of adding these notes

examples.en: It will be published with annotations and an index.
examples.zh: 这本书出版时将附有注释和索引。

examples.en: The new edition is based on previously unpublished manuscripts with full annotation.
examples.zh: 新版本基于以前未发表的手稿，并带有完整注释。

examples.en: The software allows annotation of photos for telling stories.
examples.zh: 该软件允许对照片进行注释以讲述故事。

senses.def: to tell people something officially, especially about a decision, plans, etc.

examples.en: He officially announced his intention to resign at today's press conference.
examples.zh: 在今天的记者招待会上，他正式宣布了辞职计划。

examples.en: They haven't formally announced their engagement yet.
examples.zh: 他们还没有正式宣布订婚。

examples.en: A ring at the doorbell announced Jack's arrival.
examples.zh: 门铃一响就知道杰克驾到。

examples.en: We are pleased to announce that all five candidates were successful.
examples.zh: 我们高兴地宣布，五位候选人全都当选了。

examples.en: It was announced that new speed restrictions would be introduced.
examples.zh: 据宣布，将有新的限速规定出台。

examples.en: The company announced its decision to the public in March.
examples.zh: 公司在三月份向公众宣布了其决定。

examples.en: The government yesterday announced to the media plans to create a million new jobs.
examples.zh: 政府昨天向媒体宣布了创造一百万个新工作岗位的计划。

examples.en: She was announced as the winner at last night's ceremony.
examples.zh: 在昨晚的仪式上，宣布了她为获胜者。

senses.def: to give information about something in a public place, especially through a loudspeaker

examples.en: Has our flight been announced yet?
examples.zh: 广播通知了我们的航班没有？

examples.en: The winners will be announced in reverse order.
examples.zh: 获奖者将以相反的顺序公布。

examples.en: ‘Now boarding flight 897, destination Seattle,’ the loudspeaker announced.
examples.zh: “飞往西雅图的 897 次航班现在开始登机。”广播通知说。

examples.en: They announced that the flight would be delayed.
examples.zh: 广播通知，该航班将晚点。

senses.def: to say something in a loud and/or serious way

examples.en: ‘I've given up eating meat,’ she announced.
examples.zh: “我已经放弃吃肉了，”她宣布。

examples.en: She announced that she'd given up eating meat.
examples.zh: 她宣布她已经放弃吃肉了。

senses.def: to tell somebody your name or somebody else’s name when you or they arrive at a place
senses.zh: 宣布（某人）到达；通报…的到来

examples.en: Would you announce the guests as they arrive? (= call out their names, for example at a formal party)
examples.zh: 客人到达时请你通报他们的姓名好吗？

senses.def: to introduce, or to give information about, a programme on the radio or television

intro.en: These words all mean to say something, usually clearly and definitely and often in public.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含表明、宣称、宣布之义。

items.def: (rather formal) to say something officially or publicly; to state something clearly and definitely:
items.zh: 指公布、宣布、表明、宣称

examples.en: to declare war
examples.zh: 宣战

items.def: (rather formal) to formally write or say something, especially in a careful and clear way:
items.zh: 指陈述、说明、声明

examples.en: He has already stated his intention to run for election.
examples.zh: 他已声明打算参加竞选。

items.def: (rather formal) to state something, sometimes in a way that is slightly indirect:
items.zh: 指表明、暗示

examples.en: During our meeting, he indicated his willingness to cooperate.
examples.zh: 在我们会晤期间，他提及了合作的意愿。

items.def: to tell people officially about a decision or plans; to give information about something in a public place, especially through a loudspeaker; to say something in a loud and/​or serious way:
items.zh: 指宣布、宣告、（通过广播）通知

examples.en: They haven’t formally announced their engagement yet.
examples.zh: 他们还没有正式宣布订婚。

intro.en: These words all mean to say something, usually clearly and definitely and often in public.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含表明、宣称、宣布之义。

items.def: (rather formal) to say something officially or publicly; to state something clearly and definitely:
items.zh: 指公布、宣布、表明、宣称

examples.en: to declare war
examples.zh: 宣战

items.def: (rather formal) to formally write or say something, especially in a careful and clear way:
items.zh: 指陈述、说明、声明

examples.en: He has already stated his intention to run for election.
examples.zh: 他已声明打算参加竞选。

items.def: (rather formal) to state something, sometimes in a way that is slightly indirect:
items.zh: 指表明、暗示

examples.en: During our meeting, he indicated his willingness to cooperate.
examples.zh: 在我们会晤期间，他提及了合作的意愿。

items.def: to tell people officially about a decision or plans; to give information about something in a public place, especially through a loudspeaker; to say something in a loud and/​or serious way:
items.zh: 指宣布、宣告、（通过广播）通知

examples.en: They haven’t formally announced their engagement yet.
examples.zh: 他们还没有正式宣布订婚。

senses.def: a spoken or written statement that informs people about something

examples.en: to make an announcement
examples.zh: 发表公告

examples.en: a formal/an official/a public announcement
examples.zh: 正式／官方／公开的通告

examples.en: We welcome the recent announcement by the Government.
examples.zh: 我们对政府最近的宣布表示欢迎。

examples.en: Announcements of births, marriages and deaths appear in some newspapers.
examples.zh: 有些报纸刊登出生、结婚、死亡通告。

examples.en: Today's announcement of a peace agreement came after weeks of discussion.
examples.zh: 经过几周的讨论之后，今天公布了和平协议。

examples.en: An announcement about her future is expected soon.
examples.zh: 预计很快就会公布有关她未来的消息。

examples.en: We saw an announcement in the national newspaper.
examples.zh: 我们在国家报纸上看到一则公告。

senses.def: the act of publicly informing people about something

examples.en: Announcement of the verdict was accompanied by shouts and cheers.
examples.zh: 在一片喊叫和欢呼声中宣布了正式判决。

examples.en: He was speaking after the announcement of record results for the company.
examples.zh: 他是在公司公布创纪录业绩后发表上述言论的。

intro.en: These are all words for something that you say or write, especially something that gives information or an opinion.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指口头或书面的说明、宣布。

items.def: something that you say or write that gives information or an opinion, often in a formal way:
items.zh: 通常指正式的说明、声明、陈述、报告

examples.en: A government spokesperson made a statement to the press.
examples.zh: 政府发言人向新闻界发表了一份声明。

items.def: something that you say or write that gives an opinion on something or is a response to a question about a particular situation:
items.zh: 指议论、评论、意见

examples.en: She made helpful comments on my work.
examples.zh: 她对我的工作提出了有益的意见。

items.def: a spoken or written statement that informs people about something:
items.zh: 指公告、布告、通告

examples.en: the announcement of a peace agreement
examples.zh: 和平协议公告

items.def: something that you say or write that gives an opinion or thought about somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指谈论、言论、评述

examples.en: He made a number of rude remarks about the food.
examples.zh: 他对这食物作了许多无礼的评论。

items.def: (rather formal) an official or formal statement, especially one that states an intention, belief or feeling, or that gives information:
items.zh: 指官方或正式的公告、宣告、宣言、声明

examples.en: the declaration of war
examples.zh: 宣战

items.def: (rather formal) a comment, especially one based on something you have seen, heard or read:
items.zh: 尤指根据所见、所闻、所读而作的评论

examples.en: He began by making a few general observations about the report.
examples.zh: 开头他先对这个报告作了几点概括性的评论。

senses.def: a person who introduces, or gives information about, programmes on the radio or television
senses.zh: （广播、电视的）广播员，播音员，节目主持人

examples.en: The continuity announcer advertised a few forthcoming programmes.
examples.zh: 节目间隙播音员介绍了几个将要播出的节目。

senses.def: a person who gives information about something in a station, an airport, etc., especially through a loudspeaker
senses.zh: （车站、机场等的）广播员，播音员

examples.en: The station announcer warned us that the train was running late.
examples.zh: 车站广播员预先通知我们火车晚点了。

examples.en: The PA announcer called out the score.
examples.zh: 有线广播的播音员大声说出了比分。

senses.def: a person who broadcasts at a sports event

examples.en: a play-by-play announcer (= who comments on a game as it is happening)
examples.zh: （体育赛事的）现场解说员

senses.def: to make somebody slightly angry

examples.en: His constant joking was beginning to annoy her.
examples.zh: 他不停地开玩笑，已开始惹她生气。

examples.en: I’m sure she does it just to annoy me.
examples.zh: 我确信她这样做只是为了惹恼我。

examples.en: I only stay out late to annoy my parents.
examples.zh: 我在外面待到很晚只是为了气我的父母。

examples.en: It really annoys me when people forget to say thank you.
examples.zh: 有人连谢谢都忘记说时我确实感到不愉快。

examples.en: It annoys me to see him getting ahead of me.
examples.zh: 我看见他领先于我就心里不痛快。

senses.def: to make somebody uncomfortable or unable to relax

examples.en: He swatted a fly that was annoying him.
examples.zh: 他猛力拍打一只搅得他心烦的苍蝇。

examples.en: The wasps were beginning to annoy me.
examples.zh: 黄蜂开始惹得我心烦。

annoy the hell out of: @@@LINK=scare, annoy, etc. the hell out of somebody
annoy the hell out of sb: @@@LINK=scare, annoy, etc. the hell out of somebody
annoy the hell out of somebody: @@@LINK=scare, annoy, etc. the hell out of somebody

senses.def: the feeling of being slightly angry

examples.en: He could not conceal his annoyance at being interrupted.
examples.zh: 他因受扰而难掩怒色。

examples.en: Much to our annoyance, they decided not to come after all.
examples.zh: 他们最终决定不来，使我们很生气。

examples.en: She stamped her foot in annoyance.
examples.zh: 她气得直跺脚。

examples.en: His behaviour caused great annoyance to his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他的行为给同事们带来了极大的困扰。

senses.def: something that makes you slightly angry
senses.zh: 使人烦恼的事；令人生气的事物

examples.en: The delay is now shorter but still an annoyance.
examples.zh: 延迟的时间现在变短了，但还是让人厌烦。

examples.en: petty annoyances and irritations
examples.zh: 各种小烦恼

senses.def: in a way that makes you feel slightly angry
senses.zh: 使人烦恼的事；令人生气的事物

examples.en: Graham can be annoyingly childish at times.
examples.zh: 格雷厄姆有时会显得幼稚得令人恼火。

examples.en: Annoyingly, my phone had run out of charge.
examples.zh: 令人烦恼的是，我的手机没电了。

senses.def: happening or done once every year
senses.zh: 每年的；一年一次的；年度的

examples.en: an annual meeting/event/report/conference
examples.zh: 年度会议／活动／报告／大会

examples.en: The 12th annual Music Festival runs from Friday 25th to Monday 28th October.
examples.zh: 第 12 届年度音乐节于 10 月 25 日星期五至 28 日星期一举行。

examples.en: Funding will be awarded on an annual basis.
examples.zh: 资金将按年度发放。

examples.en: She is organizing this year's annual staff party.
examples.zh: 她正在组织今年的年度员工聚会。

senses.def: relating to a period of one year

examples.en: an annual income/revenue/budget/fee/salary/turnover
examples.zh: 年收入；年收益；年度预算；年费；年薪；年营业额

examples.en: an average annual growth rate of 8%
examples.zh: 平均 8% 的年增长率

examples.en: Our total annual costs have declined.
examples.zh: 我们的年度总成本下降了。

examples.en: I have already taken all my annual leave for this year.
examples.zh: 我今年的年假已经全部休完。

examples.en: annual rainfall
examples.zh: 年降雨量

senses.def: a book, especially one for children, that is published once a year, with the same title each time, but different contents

examples.en: The children usually asked for comic or sporting annuals for Christmas.
examples.zh: 孩子们通常会要求圣诞节看漫画或体育年鉴。

senses.def: any plant that grows and dies within one year or season
senses.zh: 一年生植物；一季生植物

senses.def: an important meeting that the members of an organization hold once a year in order to elect officers, discuss past and future activities and examine the accounts
senses.zh: 年会，年度大会（全写为 annual general meeting）

senses.def: calculated for a period of a year but based on the amounts for a shorter period
senses.zh: 按年度计算的；折算成为年度总额的

examples.en: In June, inflation stood at an annualized rate of 3.3 per cent.
examples.zh: 6月份，年化通货膨胀率为3.3%。

senses.def: once a year

examples.en: The exhibition is held annually.
examples.zh: 这个展览每年举行一次。

senses.def: a fixed amount of money paid to somebody each year, usually for the rest of their life

examples.en: She receives a small annuity.
examples.zh: 她每年得到一笔微薄的年金。

senses.def: a type of insurance that pays a fixed amount of money to somebody each year

examples.en: income from pensions, annuities and trusts
examples.zh: 来自养老金、年金和信托的收入

senses.def: to state officially that something is not legally recognized

examples.en: Their marriage was annulled after just six months.
examples.zh: 他们的婚姻仅过半年就宣告取消。

examples.en: Amid renewed protests, the regime annulled the elections.
examples.zh: 在新一轮的抗议中，该政权取消了选举。

senses.def: having a shape like a ring
the act of stating officially that something, usually a marriage, is not legally recognized
senses.zh: 宣布（法律、协议、婚姻）无效

examples.en: The king sought an annulment of his marriage to Catherine of Aragon.
examples.zh: 国王要求废除他与阿拉贡的凯瑟琳的婚姻。

senses.def: a bell, light or other device that shows which of several electrical circuits
the Latin for 'horrible year'. Queen Elizabeth II used this expression in a speech in 1992 to describe that year, when there was a serious fire at Windsor Castle
senses.zh: 多灾之年，凶年（拉丁语，意为“horrible year”。出自英国女王伊丽莎白二世 1992 年的一次演讲。当年，温莎城堡发生严重火灾，安妮长公主离婚，约克公爵与妻子分居，威尔士亲王出现婚姻问题。）

senses.def: the Latin for 'remarkable year'. John Dryden's
senses.zh: 拉丁语，意为“杰出的一年”。约翰·德莱顿（John Dryden）的诗《 Annus Mirabilis（1667）》描述了1666年的伦敦大火发生，英国人击败了荷兰人

examples.en: That year was something of an annus mirabilis for British racing drivers.
examples.zh: 那一年对英国赛车手来说堪称奇迹年。

senses.def: the electrode
senses.zh: 阳极；（电解池的）正极；（原电池的）负极

senses.def: to cover a metal, especially aluminium
senses.zh: 对（铝等金属）作阳极氧化；阳极处理

senses.def: unlikely to offend anyone or cause them to disagree; not expressing strong opinions
to put oil or water on somebody’s head or body as part of a religious ceremony
senses.zh: （作为宗教仪式）抹，涂（圣油、圣水）

examples.en: The priest anointed her with oil.
examples.zh: 神父为她施涂油礼。

senses.def: different from what is normal or expected

examples.en: He is in an anomalous position as the only part-time worker in the firm.
examples.zh: 他与众不同，是公司里唯一的兼职人员。

examples.en: They couldn’t find an explanation for the seemingly anomalous results of the experiment.
examples.zh: 他们无法对实验中看似异常的结果找到解释。

senses.def: in a way that is different from what is normal or expected
a thing, situation, etc. that is different from what is normal or expected

examples.en: the many anomalies in the tax system
examples.zh: 税制中的许多破格现象

examples.en: the apparent anomaly that those who produced the wealth, the workers, were the poorest
examples.zh: 创造财富的工人最贫穷这一明显不正常现象

examples.en: There are areas of anomaly in the report.
examples.zh: 报告中存在一些异常的地方。

senses.def: a medical condition in which somebody cannot remember the names of common objects
senses.zh: 命名性失语症，命名失能症（无法说出日常物品的名称）

senses.def: a lack of social or moral standards
senses.zh: 失范，无规范状态（社会准则或价值观的崩溃）

senses.def: soon

examples.en: See you anon.
examples.zh: 再见。

examples.en: More about this anon.
examples.zh: 有关于此的更多信息。

senses.def: anonymous
the state of remaining unknown to most other people
senses.zh: 匿名；不知姓名；名字不公开

examples.en: Names of people in the book were changed to preserve anonymity.
examples.zh: 为了姓名保密，书中的人用的都是化名。

examples.en: the anonymity of the city (= where people do not know each other)
examples.zh: 城市中的人互不相识的现象

examples.en: He agreed to give an interview on condition of anonymity (= if his name was not mentioned).
examples.zh: 他同意在不披露姓名的条件下接受采访。

examples.en: The person donating the money insisted on complete anonymity.
examples.zh: 捐款人坚持要求完全匿名。

examples.zh: 针对决定/判决/命令/裁决的上诉

examples.en: The court dismissed his appeal against the verdict.
examples.zh: 法院驳回了他对判决的上诉。

examples.en: The case was upheld on appeal.
examples.zh: 该案经上诉维持原判。

examples.en: The verdict was later overturned on appeal.
examples.zh: 该判决后来在上诉中被推翻。

examples.en: You have the right of appeal to the Constitutional Court.
examples.zh: 你有权向宪法法院提出上诉。

senses.def: an indirect suggestion that any good, fair or reasonable person would act in a particular way

examples.en: I relied on an appeal to his finer feelings.
examples.zh: 我寄望能唤起他的爱心。

examples.en: an appeal to reason
examples.zh: 诉诸理性

senses.def: to make a deeply felt request, especially for something that is needed immediately

examples.en: We are appealing (= asking for money) on behalf of all the victims of this terrible disaster.
examples.zh: 我们代表这场可怕灾难的所有受害者发出呼吁（=索要金钱）。

examples.en: Community leaders appealed for calm (= urged people to remain calm).
examples.zh: 社区领导们呼吁保持冷静。

examples.en: Appeal directly to the public, answer their questions.
examples.zh: 直接向公众呼吁，回答他们的问题。

examples.en: The government appealed to the British people for help.
examples.zh: 政府呼吁英国人民提供帮助。

examples.en: Police have appealed for witnesses to come forward.
examples.zh: 警方呼吁目击者挺身而出。

examples.en: Organizers appealed to the crowd not to panic.
examples.zh: 组织者呼吁人群不要惊慌。

senses.def: to attract or interest somebody
senses.zh: 有吸引力；有感染力；引起兴趣

examples.en: The prospect of a long wait in the rain did not appeal.
examples.zh: 想到要在雨中久等使人扫兴。

examples.en: The design has to appeal to all ages and social groups.
examples.zh: 设计得要老幼皆宜、雅俗共赏。

examples.en: His movies appeal to a broad audience.
examples.zh: 他的电影吸引了广大观众。

examples.en: The ad is designed to appeal to female voters.
examples.zh: 该广告旨在吸引女性选民。

senses.def: to make a formal request to a court or to somebody in authority for a judgment or a decision to be changed

examples.en: He said he would appeal after being found guilty on four counts of murder.
examples.zh: 法庭判决他犯有四项谋杀罪，他表示要上诉。

examples.en: The company is appealing against the ruling.
examples.zh: 公司正对判决提出申诉。

examples.en: He is seeking leave to appeal to the High Court against the decision.
examples.zh: 他正在寻求许可就这一决定向高等法院提出上诉。

examples.en: Permission to appeal to the House of Lords was refused.
examples.zh: 向上议院上诉被拒绝。

senses.def: to try to persuade somebody to do something by suggesting that it is a fair, reasonable or honest thing to do

examples.en: They needed to appeal to his sense of justice.
examples.zh: 他们需要激发他的正义感。

senses.def: a court that people can go to in order to try and change decisions that have been made by a lower court

examples.en: They took their case to the Appeal Court.
examples.zh: 他们把案子提交到上诉法院。

examples.en: The guilty verdict was quashed by the appeal court.
examples.zh: 上诉法院撤销了有罪判决。

examples.en: The case may be heard by a court of appeal next month.
examples.zh: 该案可能将于下月由上诉法院审理。

senses.def: the highest court in England and Wales (apart from the Supreme Court
senses.zh: （英格兰和威尔士）上诉法院（仅次于最高法院的司法机构）

senses.def: one of the courts in the US that can change decisions made by a lower court
in an attractive or interesting way
senses.zh: 有吸引力的；有感染力的；令人感兴趣的

examples.en: It's an appealingly simple idea.
examples.zh: 这是一个非常吸引人的简单想法。

senses.def: in a way that shows that you want people to help you or show you sympathy
senses.zh: 恳求的；可怜的；希望同情的

examples.en: The dog looked up at her appealingly.
examples.zh: 狗可怜巴巴地抬头望着她。

senses.def: to start to be seen

examples.en: Three days later a rash appeared.
examples.zh: 三天后出现了皮疹。

examples.en: Symptoms usually start appearing within two to three days.
examples.zh: 症状通常在两到三天内开始出现。

examples.en: A cat suddenly appeared out of nowhere.
examples.zh: 一只猫不知从哪儿冒了出来。

examples.en: Smoke appeared on the horizon.
examples.zh: 地平线上升起了烟雾。

examples.en: A bus appeared around the corner.
examples.zh: 一辆公共汽车出现在拐角处。

examples.en: Posters for the gig appeared all over town.
examples.zh: 演唱会海报在城里随处可见。

examples.en: New shoots are just appearing at the base of the plant.
examples.zh: 植物根部刚刚长出新芽。

senses.def: to begin to exist or be known or used for the first time

examples.en: Scientists are unsure when the virus first appeared.
examples.zh: 科学家不确定病毒首次出现的时间。

examples.en: His work began to appear on the scene in the 1960s.
examples.zh: 他的作品在 20 世纪 60 年代开始面世。

examples.en: When did mammals appear on the earth?
examples.zh: 地球上的哺乳动物起源于何时？

examples.en: This problem first appeared in the inner cities.
examples.zh: 这个问题最初在内城区出现。

senses.group: begin to exist 起源；出现

senses.def: to give the impression of being or doing something

examples.en: She didn't appear at all surprised at the news.
examples.zh: 她听到这消息时一点也没有显得吃惊。

examples.en: Everything appeared normal at first.
examples.zh: 起初一切看起来都很正常。

examples.en: It now appears likely that the school will be closed down.
examples.zh: 现在看来，这所学校很可能会关闭。

examples.en: It appears unlikely that interest rates will fall further.
examples.zh: 看来利率不大会再降低。

examples.en: He appears a perfectly normal person.
examples.zh: 他看上去完全是个正常的人。

examples.en: The couple appeared to have nothing in common.
examples.zh: 这对夫妻看上去没有共同之处。

examples.en: The video appears to show a car driving through the wall of a house.
examples.zh: 该视频似乎显示一辆汽车穿过房屋的墙壁。

examples.en: She appeared to be in her late thirties.
examples.zh: 看样子她快四十岁了。

examples.en: They appeared not to know what was happening.
examples.zh: 他们似乎不知道正在发生的事。

examples.en: There appears to have been a mistake.
examples.zh: 看来一直有一个差错。

examples.en: It appears that there has been a mistake.
examples.zh: 看来一直有一个差错。

examples.en: It would appear that this was a major problem.
examples.zh: 看来这是个主要问题。

examples.en: The sunset made it appear as if the sea was made of gold.
examples.zh: 落日余晖之下，大海仿佛是金子做成的。

senses.def: to be published or broadcast

examples.en: His new book will be appearing in the spring.
examples.zh: 他的新书将于春季出版。

examples.en: It was too late to prevent the story from appearing in the national media.
examples.zh: 现在已经太晚了，无法阻止这个故事出现在国家媒体上。

examples.en: These allegations appear in a forthcoming documentary.
examples.zh: 这些指控出现在即将上映的一部纪录片中。

senses.group: of book, article, programme, etc. 书、文章、节目等

senses.def: to take part in a film, play, television programme, etc.

examples.en: He has appeared in over 60 movies.
examples.zh: 他参演了 60 多部电影。

examples.en: She regularly appears on TV.
examples.zh: 她经常在电视上露面。

examples.en: She is currently appearing as Juliet at the Liverpool Playhouse.
examples.zh: 她目前在利物浦剧院扮演朱丽叶。

senses.def: to arrive at a place

examples.en: By ten o'clock Lee still hadn't appeared.
examples.zh: 到十点钟李仍然没有露面。

examples.en: A man appeared at the door and asked to see her.
examples.zh: 一名男子出现在门口要求见她。

senses.def: to be written or mentioned somewhere

examples.en: Your name will appear at the front of the book.
examples.zh: 你的名字将出现在书的封面上。

senses.def: to be present in court in order to give evidence or answer a charge

examples.en: A man will appear in court today charged with the murder.
examples.zh: 一个被控犯谋杀罪的男人今天将出庭受审。

examples.en: She is expected to appear at Dumfries Sheriff Court on Monday.
examples.zh: 预计她将于周一在邓弗里斯警长法庭出庭。

examples.en: She appeared on six charges of theft.
examples.zh: 她因被控犯有六项盗窃罪而出庭受审。

examples.en: They will appear before magistrates tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天他们将出庭接受地方法官的审讯。

examples.en: He has been asked to appear as a witness for the defence.
examples.zh: 他已被传唤出庭为被告作证。

examples.en: They had all appeared before the court several times.
examples.zh: 他们都曾多次出庭。

senses.def: to act as somebody’s lawyer in court
senses.zh: （作为律师）出庭；出庭当…的律师

examples.en: James Gilbert is the lawyer appearing for the defendant.
examples.zh: 詹姆斯·吉尔伯特作为被告的辩护律师出庭。

senses.def: the way that somebody/something looks on the outside; what somebody/something seems to be

examples.en: the physical/outward/external appearance of something
examples.zh: 某物的外观

examples.en: She had never been greatly concerned about her appearance.
examples.zh: 她从来不怎么注重外貌。

examples.en: The dog was similar in general appearance to a spaniel.
examples.zh: 这条狗总的来看像西班牙猎狗。

examples.en: He gave every appearance of (= seemed very much to be) enjoying himself.
examples.zh: 他处处表现得很快活。

examples.en: Judging by appearances can be misleading.
examples.zh: 单凭外表判断可能出错。

examples.en: To all appearances (= as far as people could tell), it had been a competely ordinary day.
examples.zh: 从表面上看（=据人们所知），这是完全平常的一天。

senses.def: the fact of somebody/something arriving, especially when it is not expected

examples.en: The sudden appearance of a security guard caused them to drop the money and run.
examples.zh: 保安人员突然出现，他们丢下钱就跑了。

examples.en: I don't want to go to the party, but I suppose I'd better put in an appearance (= go there for a short time).
examples.zh: 我不想去参加这个聚会，不过我认为最好还是去露个面。

senses.def: the moment at which something begins to exist or starts to be seen or used

examples.en: the early appearance of daffodils in spring
examples.zh: 春来早开的水仙

examples.en: the appearance of organic vegetables in the supermarkets
examples.zh: 有机蔬菜在超市出售

senses.def: an act of appearing in public, especially as a performer, politician, etc., or in court

examples.en: The Dutch player will make his first appearance for Liverpool this Saturday.
examples.zh: 这名荷兰球员将于本周六首次代表利物浦队亮相。

examples.en: The show featured a guest appearance from Amy Schumer.
examples.zh: 这场演出的亮点是艾米·舒默的客串。

examples.en: The singer's first public appearance was at the age of eight.
examples.zh: 这位歌手八岁时初次登台演出。

examples.en: She made a cameo appearance in the film.
examples.zh: 她在影片中饰演一个小角色。

examples.en: the defendant’s appearance in court
examples.zh: 被告出庭

examples.en: a court appearance
examples.zh: 出庭

examples.en: his appearance before the committee/inquiry
examples.zh: 他出席委员会/调查

senses.def: an act of being published or broadcast

examples.en: the appearance of claims about the minister’s private life in the press
examples.zh: 关于这位大臣私生活的说法见诸报端

senses.def: to hide the truth about a bad situation and pretend that everything is going well

examples.en: When she lost all her money she was determined to keep up appearances.
examples.zh: 她的钱全没了，但她决意强装体面。

senses.def: to hide the truth about a bad situation and pretend that everything is going well

examples.en: When she lost all her money she was determined to keep up appearances.
examples.zh: 她的钱全没了，但她决意强装体面。

senses.def: to make somebody calmer or less angry by giving them what they want

examples.en: The move was widely seen as an attempt to appease critics of the regime.
examples.zh: 普遍认为，这一举措是试图安抚批评政权的人。

senses.def: to give a country what it wants in order to avoid war
senses.zh: 绥靖（满足另一国的要求以避免战争）

senses.def: the practice of giving a country what it wants in order to avoid war
senses.zh: 绥靖（满足另一国的要求以避免战争）

examples.en: a policy of appeasement
examples.zh: 绥靖政策

senses.def: the act of making somebody calmer or less angry by giving them what they want

examples.en: The statues were devoted to the glory and appeasement of the gods.
examples.zh: 这些雕像致力于神的荣耀和安抚。

senses.def: a person who appeals
a court in which people can appeal against decisions made in other courts of law
a name or title
relating to the giving of a name
a common noun that is used to address a person or thing, for example ‘mother’ or ‘doctor’
senses.zh: 称呼词（可作呼语的名词）

senses.def: to add something to the end of a piece of writing

examples.en: Footnotes have been appended to the document.
examples.zh: 该文件附加了脚注。

examples.en: The principal has the right to append comments to the final report.
examples.zh: 校长有权在最终报告中添加评论。

senses.def: a thing that is added or attached to something larger or more important

examples.en: They treat Scotland as a mere appendage of England.
examples.zh: 他们将苏格兰当作英格兰的单纯附庸。

senses.def: part of a living thing, such as an insect, that sticks out and has a particular function

examples.en: The two appendages hanging from the insect’s mouth are used to detect and taste food.
examples.zh: 昆虫嘴里悬挂的两个附肢用于检测和品尝食物。

senses.def: a medical operation to remove the appendix
a serious medical condition in which the appendix
a small bag of tissue

examples.en: He had to have his appendix out (= removed).
examples.zh: 他不得不切除了阑尾。

senses.def: a section giving extra information at the end of a book or document

examples.en: Full details are given in Appendix 3.
examples.zh: 详见附录 3。

senses.def: to belong or refer to somebody/something

examples.en: rights appertaining to the property
examples.zh: 产权

examples.en: These figures appertain to last year's sales.
examples.zh: 这些数字指的是去年的销售额。

senses.def: physical desire for food

examples.en: He suffered from headaches and loss of appetite.
examples.zh: 他头痛，而且食欲不振。

examples.en: The walk gave me a good appetite.
examples.zh: 散步使我胃口大开。

examples.en: Don't spoil your appetite by eating between meals.
examples.zh: 不要在两餐之间吃东西，以免影响胃口。

senses.def: a strong desire for something

examples.en: sexual appetites
examples.zh: 性欲

examples.en: The preview was intended to whet your appetite (= make you want more).
examples.zh: 预告是为了吊胃口。

examples.en: The public have an insatiable appetite for scandal.
examples.zh: 公众对丑事总是喜闻乐道。

examples.en: There is no appetite for (= people do not want) massive federal investment in the US.
examples.zh: 美国公众对大规模联邦投资没有兴趣。

senses.def: a small amount of food or a drink that you have before a meal

examples.en: Some green olives make a simple appetizer.
examples.zh: 一些绿橄榄可以做简单的开胃菜。

examples.en: This wine should be served chilled as an appetizer.
examples.zh: 此酒应冷藏后作为开胃菜。

senses.def: a small dish of food that is served before the main course of a meal

examples.en: We ordered our appetizers and entrees.
examples.zh: 我们点了开胃菜和主菜。

examples.en: I can recommend the shrimp appetizer.
examples.zh: 我可以推荐虾开胃菜。

senses.def: that smells or looks attractive; making you feel hungry or thirsty
senses.zh: 开胃的；引起食欲的；使渴的

examples.en: the appetizing aroma of sizzling bacon
examples.zh: 炸得咝咝作响、热气腾腾的腊肉那令人胃口大开的香气。

examples.en: The meals he cooked were always nourishing but never particularly appetizing.
examples.zh: 他做的饭总是很有营养，但向来不怎么好吃。

senses.def: to show your approval of somebody/something by clapping

examples.en: He started to applaud and the others joined in.
examples.zh: 他开始鼓掌，其他人也跟着鼓起掌来。

examples.en: They rose to applaud the speaker.
examples.zh: 他们起立向演讲者鼓掌。

examples.en: She was applauded as she came on stage.
examples.zh: 她上台时人们向她鼓掌。

examples.en: The audience applauded loudly.
examples.zh: 观众掌声雷动。

senses.def: to express praise for somebody/something because you approve of them or it

examples.en: We applaud her decision.
examples.zh: 我们称赞她的决定。

examples.en: His efforts to improve the situation are to be applauded.
examples.zh: 他为改善状况所作的努力应该受到赞许。

examples.en: The decision to save the company has been warmly applauded.
examples.zh: 拯救公司的决定受到了热情的称赞。

examples.en: I applaud her for having the courage to refuse.
examples.zh: 我赞赏她敢于拒绝。

senses.def: the noise made by a group of people clapping

examples.en: Give her a big round of applause!
examples.zh: 为她热烈鼓掌！

examples.en: The audience broke into rapturous applause.
examples.zh: 听众中爆发出一片欢呼喝彩声。

senses.def: a round fruit with shiny red or green skin that is fairly hard and white inside

examples.en: Peel and core the apples.
examples.zh: 将这些苹果削皮、去核儿。

examples.en: an apple pie
examples.zh: 苹果馅饼

examples.en: apple sauce/juice
examples.zh: 苹果沙司／汁

examples.en: a garden with three apple trees
examples.zh: 有三棵苹果树的花园

examples.en: I took a bite of the apple.
examples.zh: 我咬了一口苹果。

senses.def: a child usually behaves in a similar way to his or her parent(s)
senses.zh: 有什么样的父母就有什么样的儿女；上行下效

senses.def: a person or thing that is loved more than any other

examples.en: She is the apple of her father's eye.
examples.zh: 她是父亲的掌上明珠。

senses.def: used to describe a situation in which two people or things are completely different from each other
senses.zh: 苹果橘子两码事；截然不同

examples.en: They really are apples and oranges.
examples.zh: 他们确实是迥然不同。

examples.en: They are both great but you can't compare apples and oranges.
examples.zh: 他们俩都很棒，但是截然不同，无法比较。

examples.en: It’s a totally different situation, it’s apples and oranges.
examples.zh: 这是一个完全不同的情况，这是苹果和橙子。

senses.def: used to say that something is typical of America
senses.zh: 典型美国式的；地道美国式的

senses.def: one bad person who has a bad effect on others in a group
senses.zh: 带来恶劣影响的人；害群之马

examples.zh: 一切都井井有条。
