examples.en: It’s a totally different situation, it’s apples and oranges.
examples.zh: 这是一个完全不同的情况，这是苹果和橙子。

senses.def: a program that is run from within another program, for example from within an internet browser
senses.zh: 小应用程序，小程序，小程式（在另一个程序内运行的程序）

senses.def: a machine that is designed to do a particular thing in the home, such as preparing food, heating or cleaning

examples.en: electrical/household appliances
examples.zh: 电器；家用器具

examples.en: They sell a wide range of domestic appliances—washing machines, dishwashers and so on.
examples.zh: 他们出售各种家用电器，如洗衣机、洗碗机等等。

examples.en: modern heating appliances of all types
examples.zh: 各种类型的现代加热设备

examples.en: Always switch off appliances that are not in use.
examples.zh: 不用的电器一定要关闭。

senses.def: the fact of being true or useful in a particular case or situation

examples.en: The new approach had wide applicability to all sorts of different problems.
examples.zh: 新方法广泛适用于解决各种各样的问题。

senses.def: that can be said to be true in the case of somebody/something

examples.en: Give details of children where applicable (= if you have any).
examples.zh: 如有子女请提供详情。

examples.en: Much of the form was not applicable (= did not apply) to me.
examples.zh: 表格中很多部分不适用于我。

senses.def: a person who makes a formal request for something (= applies for it)
senses.zh: 申请人（尤指求职、进高等学校等）

examples.en: There were over 500 applicants for the job.
examples.zh: 有 500 多人申请这份工作。

examples.en: Successful applicants will receive notification within the week.
examples.zh: 成功申请者将在一周内收到通知。

senses.def: a formal (often written) request for something, such as a job, permission to do something or a place at a college or university
senses.zh: 申请；请求；申请书；申请表

examples.en: a planning/patent/visa application
examples.zh: 规划／专利／签证申请

examples.en: We have received applications from more than 3 000 students.
examples.zh: 我们已经收到 3 000 多名学生的申请。

examples.en: You need to complete the online application form.
examples.zh: 您需要填写在线申请表。

examples.en: an application for asylum/a licence
examples.zh: 政治避难／执照申请

examples.en: an application for leave to appeal against the conviction
examples.zh: 针对定罪提出上诉许可的申请

examples.en: After graduating she made an application to join the BBC.
examples.zh: 毕业后，她申请加入 BBC。

examples.en: His application to the court for bail has been refused.
examples.zh: 他向法庭申请保释遭到拒绝。

examples.en: They submitted an application to the council to build two houses.
examples.zh: 他们向地方议会提交了建造两栋房屋的申请。

examples.en: Further information is available on application to the principal.
examples.zh: 详情可致函校长索取。

senses.def: the practical use of something, especially a theory, discovery, etc.
senses.zh: （尤指理论、发现等的）应用，运用

examples.en: The invention would have a wide range of applications in industry.
examples.zh: 这项发明在工业中会有广泛用途。

examples.en: What are the practical applications of this work?
examples.zh: 这件作品的实际用途是什么？

examples.en: the application of new technology to teaching
examples.zh: 新技术在教学上的应用

senses.def: an act of putting or spreading something, such as paint or medical creams, onto something else

examples.en: It took three applications of paint to cover the graffiti.
examples.zh: 刷了三道油漆才盖住了涂鸦。

examples.en: lotion for external application only (= to be put on the skin, not swallowed)
examples.zh: 仅限外部敷用的乳液

senses.def: the act of making a rule, etc. operate or become effective

examples.en: strict application of the law
examples.zh: 法律的严格执行

senses.def: a program designed to do a particular job; a piece of software

examples.en: a database application
examples.zh: 数据库应用软件

senses.def: the strength of mind to work hard at something; great effort

examples.en: Success as a writer demands great application.
examples.zh: 作家要成功就得悉力以赴。

senses.def: a set of programming
a small tool that is used to put a substance onto a surface, or to put something into an object

examples.en: Use the applicator to apply cream to the affected area.
examples.zh: 用涂药器把药膏抹在患处。

senses.def: the scientific study of language as it relates to practical problems, in areas such as teaching and dealing with speech problems
a type of needlework

examples.en: an appliqué bedspread
examples.zh: 贴花床罩

senses.def: with small pieces of cloth sewn

examples.en: an appliquéd bedspread
examples.zh: 贴花床罩

senses.def: sewn
senses.zh: 贴花：以一定图案缝在一块大布上

examples.en: She was wearing a white sweatshirt with glittery appliquéd teddy bears.
examples.zh: 她穿着一件白色运动衫，上面贴着闪闪发光的泰迪熊。

senses.def: to make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a loan, permission for something, a place at a university, etc.

examples.en: You should apply in person/by letter.
examples.zh: 你应该当面／写信申请。

examples.en: I have decided to apply for this new job.
examples.zh: 我已经决定申请这份新工作。

examples.en: They have successfully applied for political asylum.
examples.zh: 他们已成功申请政治庇护。

examples.en: to apply for a visa/passport/grant/licence
examples.zh: 申请签证／护照／拨款／执照

examples.en: The developers applied for planning permission to build over 200 houses.
examples.zh: 开发商申请建造 200 多栋房屋的规划许可。

examples.en: to apply to a company/university
examples.zh: 向公司／大学申请

examples.en: They may apply to the court for the decision to be reversed.
examples.zh: 他们可以向法院申请撤销该决定。

examples.en: He has applied to join the army.
examples.zh: 他已报名参军。

senses.def: to affect or be relevant to somebody/something

examples.en: Special conditions apply if you are under 18.
examples.zh: 18 岁以下者按特殊情况处理。

examples.en: The rules applied to employees and their behaviour at work.
examples.zh: 这些条例适用于员工及其工作中的行为。

examples.en: What I am saying applies only to some of you.
examples.zh: 我所说的只涉及你们中的一些人。

examples.en: The policy will apply equally to everyone.
examples.zh: 该政策将平等地适用于所有人。

examples.en: The law applied only to workers in member states.
examples.zh: 该法律仅适用于成员国的工人。

examples.en: The word ‘unexciting’ could never be applied to her novels.
examples.zh: “乏味”这个词绝对和她的小说沾不上边儿。

senses.def: to use something or make something work in a particular situation

examples.en: to apply political pressure
examples.zh: 施加政治压力

examples.en: The challenge allows students to apply economic principles they learn in class.
examples.zh: 这项挑战让学生能够应用他们在课堂上学到的经济原理。

examples.en: to apply economic sanctions
examples.zh: 实施经济制裁

examples.en: to apply a test/method/technique/approach/rule
examples.zh: 应用测试/方法/技术/方法/规则

examples.en: We need to apply the same standards to ourselves as to others.
examples.zh: 我们需要对自己和他人采用相同的标准。

examples.en: The new technology was applied to farming.
examples.zh: 这项新技术已应用于农业。

examples.en: Now is the time to apply the insights you have gained from your studies.
examples.zh: 现在是运用你所学知识的时候了。

senses.def: to put or spread something such as paint, cream, etc. onto a surface

examples.en: Apply the cream sparingly to your face and neck.
examples.zh: 把乳霜薄薄地抹在脸和脖子上。

examples.en: The glue should be applied to both surfaces.
examples.zh: 胶水应涂在两个表面上。

examples.en: She combed her hair and carefully applied her make-up.
examples.zh: 她梳了梳头，然后仔细地化了妆。

examples.en: The paint was applied with a fine brush.
examples.zh: 油漆是用细刷子涂的。

senses.def: to work at something or study something very hard

examples.en: You would pass your exams if you applied yourself.
examples.zh: 努力学习就会通过考试。

examples.en: We applied our minds to finding a solution to our problem.
examples.zh: 我们绞尽脑汁寻求解决问题的办法。

senses.def: to press on something hard with your hand, foot, etc. to make something work or have an effect on something

examples.en: to apply the brakes (of a vehicle)
examples.zh: 踩刹车

examples.en: Pressure applied to the wound will stop the bleeding.
examples.zh: 压住伤口可以止血。

senses.def: to choose somebody for a job or position of responsibility

examples.en: They have appointed a new head teacher at my son's school.
examples.zh: 我儿子读书的学校任命了一位新校长。

examples.en: She has recently been appointed to the committee.
examples.zh: 她最近获委任为委员会成员。

examples.en: They appointed him (as) captain of the English team.
examples.zh: 他们任命他为英格兰队队长。

examples.en: She's been appointed British ambassador to the UN.
examples.zh: 她获任命为英国驻联合国大使。

examples.en: A lawyer was appointed to represent the child.
examples.zh: 一名律师被指定为这个孩子的代理人。

senses.def: to arrange or decide on a time or place for doing something

examples.en: A date for the meeting is still to be appointed.
examples.zh: 会议日期尚待确定。

examples.en: Everyone was assembled at the appointed time.
examples.zh: 全体人员均按规定时间召集到场。

senses.def: a person who has been chosen for a job or position of responsibility

examples.en: the new appointee to the post
examples.zh: 新委任此职务者

senses.def: a formal arrangement to meet or visit somebody at a particular time, especially for a reason connected with their work

examples.en: I've got a dental appointment at 3 o'clock.
examples.zh: 我约了下午 3 点看牙医。

examples.en: to book/make/keep an appointment
examples.zh: 预约；守约

examples.en: Do you have an appointment?
examples.zh: 你有约会吗？

examples.en: She has a doctor's appointment in twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 她20分钟后要去看医生。

examples.en: Viewing is by appointment only (= only at a time that has been arranged in advance).
examples.zh: 参观必须预约。

examples.en: an appointment book
examples.zh: 约会登录本

examples.en: an appointment with my agent/doctor/specialist/consultant
examples.zh: 与我的代理人／医生／专家／顾问的预约

examples.en: an appointment for a blood test
examples.zh: 验血预约

examples.en: She made an appointment for her son to see the doctor.
examples.zh: 她为儿子约定了看医生的时间。

senses.def: the act of choosing a person for a job or position of responsibility; the fact of being chosen for a job, etc.

examples.en: They announced the appointments of key security officials.
examples.zh: 他们宣布了重要安全官员的任命。

examples.en: the appointment of a new captain for the England team
examples.zh: 英格兰队新队长的任命

examples.en: her recent appointment to the post
examples.zh: 她新近获此职位的任命

examples.en: his appointment as principal
examples.zh: 他担任校长的任命

examples.en: appointments and dismissals
examples.zh: 任免

senses.def: a job or position of responsibility

examples.en: a permanent/first appointment
examples.zh: 固定职位；第一次任职

examples.en: The department wished her success in her new appointment as sales manager.
examples.zh: 该部门祝愿她在销售经理的新任命中取得成功。

examples.en: I would like to congratulate you on your appointment.
examples.zh: 我谨祝贺您获得任命。

senses.def: a person chosen for a job or position of responsibility

examples.en: Government ministers and other political appointments are frequently replaced.
examples.zh: 政府部长和其他政治任命经常被更换。

intro.en: These are all words for a position doing work for which you receive regular payment.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示工作、职位。

items.def: work for which you receive regular payment:
items.zh: 工作；职业；职位

examples.en: He’s trying to get a job in a bank.
examples.zh: 他正设法在银行找一个工作。

items.def: (rather formal) a job:
items.zh: 指职位、职务

examples.en: a senior position in a large corporation
examples.zh: 在一家大公司的高级职务

items.def: a job, especially an important one in a large organization:
items.zh: 指职位，尤指大机构的要职

examples.en: a key post in the new government
examples.zh: 在新政府中的要职

items.def: a job that is available for somebody to do:
items.zh: 指空缺的职位、空职

examples.en: We have several vacancies for casual workers.
examples.zh: 我们有几个临时工的空缺。

items.def: (rather formal, especially British English尤用于英式英语) a job or position of responsibility:
items.zh: 指承担一定责任的职务、职位

examples.en: This is a permanent appointment, requiring commitment and hard work.
examples.zh: 这是一个固定职位，需要专心致志和勤奋工作。

senses.def: a book or an app with spaces for each day of the year in which you can record things you have to do in the future
a book or an app with spaces for each day of the year in which you can record things you have to do in the future
a former small community in the US state of Virginia where the American Civil War
senses.zh: 阿波马托克斯郡府（美国弗吉尼亚州中部旧村庄，现在是国家历史公园。）

senses.def: to divide something among people; to give a share of something to somebody

examples.en: The programme gives the facts but does not apportion blame.
examples.zh: 这个节目只摆出事实，并不评论谁是谁非。

examples.en: They apportioned the land among members of the family.
examples.zh: 他们把土地分给了家中各人。

senses.def: the act of dividing something among people; the act of giving a share of something to somebody

examples.en: The contract defines the apportionment of risks between employer and contractor.
examples.zh: 合同规定了雇主与承包人分担的风险。

examples.en: an apportionment of land
examples.zh: 土地分配

examples.en: The apportionment of seats in the House of Representatives is based on the population of each state.
examples.zh: 众议院的席位是根据各州的人口分配的。

senses.def: very appropriate for a particular situation or in relation to something

examples.en: Her remarks are extremely apposite to the present discussion.
examples.zh: 她的言论与当前的讨论极为贴切。

examples.en: His conclusions remain apposite today.
examples.zh: 他的结论至今仍然正确。

senses.def: the use of a noun phrase immediately after or before another noun phrase that refers to the same person or thing

examples.en: In the phrase ‘Paris, the capital of France’, ‘the capital of France’ is in apposition to ‘Paris’.
examples.zh: 在短语 Paris, the capital of France 中，the capital of France 是 Paris 的同位语。

senses.def: coming immediately after another noun or noun phrase that refers to the same person or thing

examples.en: In the phrase ‘Paris, the capital of France’, ‘the capital of France’ is an appositional clause/phrase.
examples.zh: 在短语“巴黎，法国的首都”中，“法国的首都”是一个同位从句/短语。

senses.def: a noun phrase that comes immediately after another noun or noun phrase that refers to the same person or thing

examples.en: Journalists are prone to pile up appositives between subject and verb.
examples.zh: 记者很容易在主语和动词之间堆积同位语。

senses.def: a judgement of the value, performance or nature of somebody/something

examples.en: He had read many detailed critical appraisals of her work.
examples.zh: 他读了许多详细评论她的作品的文章。

examples.en: She was honest in her appraisal of her team's chances.
examples.zh: 她对自己队的获胜机会做了客观评价。

examples.en: The report has been subject to appraisal.
examples.zh: 报告已受评估。

senses.def: a meeting in which an employee discusses with their manager how well they have been doing their job; the system of holding such meetings
senses.zh: （上司对雇员的）工作鉴定会；工作表现评估

examples.en: I have my appraisal today.
examples.zh: 我今天与上司见面讨论我的工作表现。

examples.en: staff/performance appraisal
examples.zh: 员工／工作表现评估

examples.en: The company has an annual appraisal system.
examples.zh: 公司设有年度考核制度。

senses.def: to consider or examine somebody/something and form an opinion about them or it

examples.en: an appraising glance/look
examples.zh: 打量的一瞥／目光

examples.en: Her eyes coolly appraised him.
examples.zh: 她冷冷地打量着他。

examples.en: She stepped back to appraise her workmanship.
examples.zh: 她退后一步，看看她的作品是否完美。

examples.en: The architect gave the exterior an appraising glance.
examples.zh: 建筑师对外部进行了评估。

senses.def: to officially examine a building, an object, etc. and say how much it is worth

examples.en: They appraised the painting at £200 000.
examples.zh: 他们对这幅画的估价是 20 万英镑。

senses.def: to make a formal judgement about the value of a person’s work, usually after a discussion with them about it

examples.en: Managers must appraise all staff.
examples.zh: 经理必须对全体员工作出评价。

senses.def: (in an appraisal

examples.en: The system allows appraisees and appraisers to complete appraisal documentation electronically.
examples.zh: 该系统允许评估者和评估员以电子方式完成评估文件。

senses.def: a person whose job is to examine a building, an object, etc. and say how much it is worth
a person who makes a formal judgement about the value of a person's work, usually after discussion with them about it

examples.en: In addition to job performance, appraisers are expected to evaluate an employee's attitude towards their work.
examples.zh: 除了工作表现之外，评估员还应该评估员工对其工作的态度。

senses.def: large enough to be noticed or thought important
senses.zh: （大得）可以觉察到的，足以认为重要的；可观的

examples.en: The new regulations will not make an appreciable difference to most people.
examples.zh: 新的规定对大多数人将无大影响。

examples.en: an appreciable effect/increase/amount
examples.zh: 可观的效果／增长／数量

examples.en: The increase in salary will be appreciable.
examples.zh: 薪水的增加将很可观。

examples.en: There has been an appreciable increase in profits.
examples.zh: 利润有了可观的增长。

senses.def: much; a lot; in a way that is easy to notice
senses.zh: 相当地 很多; 以容易注意到的

examples.en: The risk of infection is appreciably higher among children.
examples.zh: 儿童受感染的风险要大得多。

senses.def: to recognize the good qualities of somebody/something

examples.en: Over the years he came to appreciate the beauty and tranquillity of the river.
examples.zh: 经过这些年，他开始欣赏这条河的美丽和宁静。

examples.en: His talents are not fully appreciated in that company.
examples.zh: 他的才干在那家公司未受到充分赏识。

examples.en: Her family doesn't appreciate her.
examples.zh: 她的家人不重视她。

examples.en: You can't really appreciate foreign literature in translation.
examples.zh: 看翻译作品不能真正欣赏到外国文学原著的美妙之处。

examples.en: The sound quality was poor so we couldn't fully appreciate the music.
examples.zh: 音质太差了，我们根本无法好好欣赏音乐。

senses.def: to be grateful for something that somebody has done; to welcome something

examples.en: I'd appreciate some help.
examples.zh: 如果有人帮忙我将非常感激。

examples.en: Your support is greatly appreciated.
examples.zh: 十分感谢你的支持。

examples.en: Thanks for coming. I appreciate it.
examples.zh: 谢谢光临。无任欢迎。

examples.en: I would appreciate any comments you might have.
examples.zh: 如果您有任何意见，我将不胜感激。

examples.en: Your kindness and generosity is much appreciated.
examples.zh: 非常感谢您的善意和慷慨。

examples.en: We really appreciate the extra effort you're making.
examples.zh: 我们非常感谢您所付出的额外努力。

examples.en: I would appreciate it if you paid in cash.
examples.zh: 假如你支付现金的话，我会不胜感激。

examples.en: I appreciate having the opportunity to discuss these important issues with you.
examples.zh: 我很高兴有机会与您讨论这些重要问题。

examples.en: I don't appreciate being made to wait half an hour.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢等半个小时。

examples.en: We would appreciate you letting us know of any problems.
examples.zh: 如有任何问题，请告诉我们。

senses.def: to understand that something is true

examples.en: What I failed to appreciate was the distance between the two cities.
examples.zh: 我没有意识到这两座城市间的距离。

examples.en: The experience helped me understand and appreciate some of the difficulties people face.
examples.zh: 这段经历帮助我理解并理解人们面临的一些困难。

examples.en: I don't think you appreciate how expensive it will be.
examples.zh: 我想你不了解它会有多昂贵。

examples.en: We didn't fully appreciate that he was seriously ill.
examples.zh: 我们没有充分认识到他的病情很严重。

senses.def: to increase in value over a period of time

examples.en: Their investments have appreciated over the years.
examples.zh: 他们的投资这些年来已经增值。

examples.en: We wanted a property that would appreciate in value.
examples.zh: 我们想要一处会增值的房产。

examples.en: The euro continues to appreciate against the dollar.
examples.zh: 欧元对美元继续升值。

senses.def: pleasure that you have when you recognize and enjoy the good qualities of somebody/something

examples.en: She shows little appreciation of good music.
examples.zh: 她感受不到美好音乐的妙处。

examples.en: The crowd murmured in appreciation.
examples.zh: 人群低声赞叹着。

senses.def: a full understanding of something, such as a situation or a problem, and of what it involves

examples.en: I had no appreciation of the problems they faced.
examples.zh: 我没有体谅到他们所面临的困难。

senses.def: the feeling of being grateful for something

examples.en: I would like to express my appreciation and thanks to you all.
examples.zh: 我想对你们所有人表达我的感激和谢意。

examples.en: Please accept this gift in appreciation of all you've done for us.
examples.zh: 承蒙鼎力相助，不胜感激，谨备薄礼，敬请笑纳。

examples.en: She never shows any appreciation for our efforts.
examples.zh: 她对我们的努力从无感激之情。

examples.en: The clock was presented to Snell by his colleagues as an appreciation of his work and friendship.
examples.zh: 该时钟是斯内尔的同事赠送给他的，以感谢他的工作和友谊。

senses.def: increase in value over a period of time

examples.en: an appreciation in the value of the house
examples.zh: 房屋升值

examples.en: capital appreciation
examples.zh: 资本增值

senses.def: a piece of writing or a speech in which the strengths and weaknesses of somebody/something, especially an artist or a work of art, are discussed and judged
senses.zh: （尤指艺术方面的）鉴定，评价，评估

examples.en: They were asked to write an appreciation of a poem of their choice.
examples.zh: 他们被要求为自己选择的一首诗写一篇欣赏。

senses.def: feeling or showing that you are grateful for something

examples.en: The company was very appreciative of my efforts.
examples.zh: 公司对我的努力十分赞赏。

senses.def: showing pleasure

examples.en: an appreciative audience/smile
examples.zh: 有欣赏力的观众；会意的微笑

examples.en: appreciative laughter/comments
examples.zh: 赞赏的笑声／议论

examples.en: She watched them with an appreciative smile.
examples.zh: 她望着他们，露出赞赏的微笑。

examples.en: The audience was highly appreciative.
examples.zh: 那些观众都很懂得欣赏。

senses.def: in a way that shows that you are grateful for something or are enjoying something

examples.en: She took the cup of hot tea appreciatively.
examples.zh: 她赞赏地接过一杯热茶。

examples.en: He laughed appreciatively.
examples.zh: 他欣然大笑。

senses.def: to catch somebody and arrest them

examples.en: The police apprehended an armed suspect near the scene of the crime.
examples.zh: 警方在案发现场附近逮捕了一名持械疑犯。

examples.en: The thief was apprehended in the act of stealing a car.
examples.zh: 窃贼在偷汽车时当场被（警察）抓住。

senses.def: to understand or recognize something

examples.en: He was slow to apprehend danger.
examples.zh: 他对危险的察觉很慢。

senses.def: worry or fear that something unpleasant may happen

examples.en: There is growing apprehension that fighting will begin again.
examples.zh: 人们愈来愈担心会重开战火。

examples.en: He watched the election results with some apprehension.
examples.zh: 他不无忧虑地观察选举结果。

examples.en: There is apprehension about the safety of the missing children.
examples.zh: 人们对失踪儿童的安全感到担忧。

examples.en: They shivered with apprehension.
examples.zh: 他们惊恐得浑身发抖。

examples.en: She spoke about her childhood fears and apprehensions.
examples.zh: 她谈到了她童年的恐惧和忧虑。

senses.def: the act of capturing or arresting somebody, usually by the police

examples.en: the apprehension of the terrorists in the early hours of this morning
examples.zh: 今天凌晨逮捕了恐怖分子

senses.def: worried or frightened that something unpleasant may happen
senses.zh: 忧虑的；担心的；疑惧的；恐惧的

examples.en: an apprehensive face/glance/look
examples.zh: 忧虑的面容／一瞥／目光

examples.en: The long delay had made me quite apprehensive.
examples.zh: 长时间的耽搁使我相当焦虑。

examples.en: I was a little apprehensive about the effects of what I had said.
examples.zh: 我有点担忧我说的话所带来的影响。

examples.en: You have no reason to be apprehensive of the future.
examples.zh: 你不必忧虑未来。

examples.en: She was deeply apprehensive that something might go wrong.
examples.zh: 她很担心可能要出什么差错。

senses.def: in a worried or frightened way because you think something unpleasant may happen
senses.zh: 忧虑的；担心的；疑惧的；恐惧的

senses.def: a young person who works for an employer for a fixed period of time in order to learn the particular skills needed in their job

examples.en: an apprentice electrician/chef
examples.zh: 电工／厨师学徒

senses.def: to make somebody an apprentice

examples.en: He was apprenticed to his uncle as a carpenter.
examples.zh: 他给叔叔当木匠学徒。

senses.def: a period of time working as an apprentice

examples.en: She was in the second year of her apprenticeship as a carpenter.
examples.zh: 她当木工学徒已是第二年了。

examples.en: He had served his apprenticeship as a plumber.
examples.zh: 他当过管子工学徒。

examples.en: Apprenticeships were becoming more difficult to find.
examples.zh: 学徒职位变得越来越难找到。

senses.def: to tell or inform somebody of something

examples.en: He saw no reason to apprise the committee of what had happened.
examples.zh: 他认为没有理由向委员会通报所发生的事情。

examples.en: We were fully apprised of the situation.
examples.zh: 我们完全获悉当时的情况。

senses.def: if you buy goods, or if goods are sold on appro
a way of dealing with somebody/something; a way of doing or thinking about something such as a problem or a task
senses.zh: （待人接物或思考问题的）方式，方法，态度

examples.en: She took the wrong approach in her dealings with them.
examples.zh: 她和他们打交道的方式错了。

examples.en: It was time to take a different approach.
examples.zh: 该换一种方法了。

examples.en: an alternative/innovative approach
examples.zh: 替代/创新方法

examples.en: a traditional/similar approach
examples.zh: 传统/类似的方法

examples.en: The approach they were using no longer seemed to work.
examples.zh: 他们使用的方法似乎不再有效。

examples.en: We need to adopt a new approach to the problem.
examples.zh: 我们需要对这个问题采取新的措施。

examples.en: The therapy takes a holistic approach to health and well-being.
examples.zh: 这种治疗对身心健康采取整体疗法。

examples.en: a variety of approaches for the treatment of depression
examples.zh: 治疗抑郁症的多种方法

examples.en: Will this be a successful approach for providing high-tech offices?
examples.zh: 这将是提供高科技办公室的可行方法吗？

senses.def: movement nearer to somebody/something in distance or time
senses.zh: （在距离或时间上的）靠近，接近

examples.en: She hadn't heard his approach and jumped as the door opened.
examples.zh: 她没有听见他走近的声音，所以门开时吓了一跳。

examples.en: the approach of spring
examples.zh: 春天的来临

examples.en: They felt apprehensive about the approach of war.
examples.zh: 他们担心战争会到来。

examples.en: The children fell silent at the approach of their teacher.
examples.zh: 老师一来，孩子们变得鸦雀无声。

senses.def: the act of speaking to somebody about something, especially when making an offer or a request

examples.en: The club has made an approach to a local company for sponsorship.
examples.zh: 俱乐部已向当地一家公司寻求赞助。

examples.en: We've received an approach from the director of a rival company.
examples.zh: 一家竞争公司的董事曾经接触我们。

senses.def: attempts to start a personal or sexual relationship with somebody
senses.zh: 试图与某人开始个人或性关系

examples.en: She resented his persistent approaches.
examples.zh: 她对他没完没了的纠缠极为反感。

senses.def: a path, road, etc. that leads to a place

examples.en: All the approaches to the palace were guarded by troops.
examples.zh: 通往宫殿的所有道路都有军队守卫。

examples.en: a new approach road to the port
examples.zh: 去港口的一条新通路

examples.en: The approach to the village was very pretty.
examples.zh: 通往村庄的路非常漂亮。

senses.def: the part of an aircraft’s flight immediately before landing

examples.en: to begin the final approach to the runway
examples.zh: 开始进入跑道着陆

examples.en: The aircraft had to make a steep approach to the landing strip.
examples.zh: 飞机不得不陡直降落到简易机场。

senses.def: a thing that is like something else that is mentioned

examples.en: That's the nearest approach to an apology you'll get from him.
examples.zh: 那是他所能作出的最似歉意的表示。

senses.def: if you use the carrot and stick approach
senses.zh: 胡萝卜加大棒；威逼利诱

examples.en: The emphasis is on the carrot of incentive rather than the stick of taxes.
examples.zh: 重点是激励的胡萝卜而不是税收的大棒。

senses.def: to come near to somebody/something in distance or time

examples.en: We could hear the train approaching.
examples.zh: 我们能够听到火车开过来了。

examples.en: Winter is approaching.
examples.zh: 冬天就要来临。

examples.en: The deadline was fast approaching.
examples.zh: 截止日期即将到来。

examples.en: The rapidly approaching storm could be seen on the horizon.
examples.zh: 地平线上可以看到正在迅速逼近的风暴。

examples.en: She's approaching the end of her first year in the job.
examples.zh: 她干这项工作快满一年了。

examples.en: I was approached by a woman who asked for the time.
examples.zh: 一位女士找到我询问时间。

examples.en: The house is approached via a long driveway.
examples.zh: 房子是通过一条长长的车道到达的。

examples.en: The men approached the creature cautiously from behind.
examples.zh: 那些男人从后面小心翼翼地靠近那个动物。

senses.def: to speak to somebody about something, especially to ask them for something or to offer to do something

examples.en: We have been approached by a number of companies that are interested in our product.
examples.zh: 一些对我们的产品感兴趣的公司已和我们接洽。

examples.en: I'd like to ask his opinion but I find him difficult to approach (= not easy to talk to in a friendly way).
examples.zh: 我想征求他的意见，但发现很难和他谈得拢。

examples.en: She was often approached for help and advice.
examples.zh: 经常有人找她寻求帮助和建议。

examples.en: We have approached the company about the possibility of a merger.
examples.zh: 我们已就合并的可能性与该公司接洽。

examples.en: Have you approached John about organizing a concert?
examples.zh: 组织音乐会的事你有没有找过约翰？

examples.en: She was approached to take part in the event.
examples.zh: 有人邀请她参加该活动。

senses.def: to come close to something in amount, level or quality

examples.en: Interest rates are approaching zero.
examples.zh: 利率正在逼近零。

examples.en: profits approaching 30 million dollars
examples.zh: 接近 3 000 万美元的利润

examples.en: Few writers approach his richness of language.
examples.zh: 他语言之丰富很少有作家能望其项背。

senses.def: to start dealing with a problem, task, etc. in a particular way

examples.en: to approach a subject/matter/task/question
examples.zh: 处理题材／事项／任务／问题

examples.en: What's the best way to approach this problem?
examples.zh: 处理这个问题的最佳方式是什么？

examples.en: The issues should be approached with caution.
examples.zh: 这些问题应该谨慎处理。

senses.def: if you use the carrot and stick approach
senses.zh: 胡萝卜加大棒；威逼利诱

examples.en: The emphasis is on the carrot of incentive rather than the stick of taxes.
examples.zh: 重点是激励的胡萝卜而不是税收的大棒。

senses.def: friendly and easy to talk to; easy to understand

examples.en: Despite being a big star, she's very approachable.
examples.zh: 她虽然是个大明星，却非常平易近人。

examples.en: an approachable piece of music
examples.zh: 浅显易懂的乐曲

senses.def: that can be reached by a particular route or from a particular direction

examples.en: The summit was approachable only from the south.
examples.zh: 只有从南面才能到达山顶。

senses.def: approval or agreement

examples.en: a shout of approbation
examples.zh: 一声赞许

examples.en: The King received the official approbation of the church.
examples.zh: 国王得到了教会的正式认可。

senses.def: the extent to which something is suitable or acceptable
the extent to which a word or phrase sounds correct and natural in relation to the situation it is used in
suitable, acceptable or correct for the particular circumstances

examples.en: an appropriate response/measure/method
examples.zh: 恰如其分的反应；恰当的措施／方法

examples.en: Now that the problem has been identified, appropriate action can be taken.
examples.zh: 现在既已找出问题的症结，即可采取适当行动。

examples.en: Is now an appropriate time to make a speech?
examples.zh: 现在发表演讲是不是时候？

examples.en: I will/will not be able to attend the open day (delete as appropriate) (= cross out the option that does not apply).
examples.zh: 我将/将无法参加开放日（酌情删除）（= 划掉不适用的选项）。

examples.en: This may be an appropriate treatment for many patients.
examples.zh: 对于许多患者来说，这可能是一种合适的治疗方法。

examples.en: Skills can be enhanced by the appropriate use of technology in certain circumstances.
examples.zh: 在某些情况下，可以通过适当使用技术来提高技能。

examples.en: He said she had responded to the situation in an entirely appropriate way.
examples.zh: 他说她以完全适当的方式应对了这种情况。

examples.en: to deem/consider/think something appropriate
examples.zh: 认为/考虑/认为适当的事情

examples.en: Jeans are not appropriate for a formal party.
examples.zh: 正式聚会上穿牛仔裤不合适。

examples.en: The book was written in a style appropriate to the age of the children.
examples.zh: 这本书的文体适合儿童阅读。

examples.en: All personnel were trained at levels appropriate to the needs of each job.
examples.zh: 所有人员都接受了适合每项工作需求的级别的培训。

senses.def: to take something, somebody’s ideas, etc. for your own use, especially illegally or without permission

examples.en: He was accused of appropriating club funds.
examples.zh: 他被控盗用俱乐部资金。

examples.en: Some of the opposition party's policies have been appropriated by the government.
examples.zh: 反对党的一些政策已被政府照搬照用。

senses.def: to take or give something, especially money for a particular purpose

examples.en: Five million dollars have been appropriated for research into the disease.
examples.zh: 已拨款五百万美元用于这种疾病的研究。

senses.def: in a way that is suitable, acceptable or correct for the particular circumstances

examples.en: The government has been accused of not responding appropriately to the needs of the homeless.
examples.zh: 政府未采取适当的措施以回应无家可归者的需要，为此已受到谴责。

examples.en: The chain of volcanoes is known, appropriately enough, as the ‘Ring of Fire’.
examples.zh: 人们把这火山链很恰当地称作“火环”。

senses.def: the quality of being suitable, acceptable or correct for the particular circumstances

examples.en: He questioned the appropriateness of their methods.
examples.zh: 他质疑他们的方法是否合适。

senses.def: the act of taking something that belongs to somebody else, especially without permission
senses.zh: 擅自调用；挪用；占用；侵吞

examples.en: dishonest appropriation of property
examples.zh: 以欺骗的手法侵吞财产

examples.en: The film company sued them over their appropriation of a cartoon character.
examples.zh: 电影公司因盗用卡通人物而起诉他们。

senses.def: the act of keeping or saving money for a particular purpose

examples.en: a meeting to discuss the appropriation of funds
examples.zh: 讨论拨款的会议

senses.def: a sum of money to be used for a particular purpose, especially by a government or company
senses.zh: （尤指政府、公司的）所拨款项，专款

examples.en: an appropriation of £20 000 for payment of debts
examples.zh: 用于还债的 2 万英镑拨款

senses.def: the feeling that somebody/something is good or acceptable; a positive opinion of somebody/something

examples.en: She desperately wanted to win her parents' approval.
examples.zh: 她迫切地想赢得父母的认可。

examples.en: Do the plans meet with your approval?
examples.zh: 这些计划你赞成吗？

examples.en: Several people nodded in approval.
examples.zh: 好几个人点头表示同意。

examples.en: The president's approval ratings were slipping.
examples.zh: 总统的支持率正在下滑。

senses.def: agreement to, or permission for something, especially a plan or request
senses.zh: 批准，通过，认可（计划、要求等）

examples.en: The plan will be submitted to the committee for official approval.
examples.zh: 该计划将送交委员会正式批准。

examples.en: parliamentary/congressional/government approval
examples.zh: 议会的／国会的／政府的批准

examples.en: Senior management have given their seal of approval (= formal approval) to the plans.
examples.zh: 高层管理部门已经正式批准这些计划。

examples.en: I can't agree to anything without my partner's approval.
examples.zh: 没有合伙人的认可我什么也不能答应。

examples.en: planning approvals
examples.zh: （建筑）规划的批准

examples.en: The government is seeking approval of its plans.
examples.zh: 政府正在寻求批准其计划。

examples.en: The proposal is subject to approval by the shareholders (= they need to agree to it).
examples.zh: 这项建议须得到股东的批准。

examples.en: They required/received approval for the proposal from the shareholders.
examples.zh: 他们要求／获得股东对这项提议的批准。

examples.en: He won approval for his project.
examples.zh: 他的项目工程获得了批准。

examples.en: He left without obtaining the necessary approval from the authorities.
examples.zh: 他在没有获得当局必要的批准的情况下离开了。

examples.en: She expects to gain final approval from the council.
examples.zh: 她希望获得理事会的最终批准。

senses.def: if you buy goods or if goods are sold on approval
the percentage of the population that expresses approval of somebody/something, usually a politician

examples.en: The president's approval rating after a year in office is the lowest on record.
examples.zh: 总统上任一年后，支持率跌至历史最低点。

senses.def: to think that somebody/something is good, acceptable or suitable

examples.en: I told my mother I wanted to leave school but she didn't approve.
examples.zh: 我告诉母亲我不想继续上学，但是母亲不同意。

examples.en: Do you approve of my idea?
examples.zh: 你同意我的想法吗？

examples.en: She didn't quite approve of the way he was running things.
examples.zh: 她不太赞同他的办事方式。

examples.en: She doesn't approve of me leaving school this year.
examples.zh: 她不同意我今年毕业。

examples.en: She doesn't approve of my leaving school this year.
examples.zh: 她不同意我今年毕业。

senses.def: to officially agree to a plan, request, etc.

examples.en: The committee unanimously approved the plan.
examples.zh: 委员会一致通过了计划。

examples.en: We hope that the proposals will soon be approved by the committee.
examples.zh: 我们希望这些建议能够尽快得到委员会的批准。

examples.en: to approve a bill/application
examples.zh: 批准法案/申请

examples.en: They approved the creation of a human resources development centre.
examples.zh: 他们批准设立人力资源开发中心。

examples.en: His appointment has not been formally approved yet.
examples.zh: 他的任命还没有正式批准。

examples.en: The Legislature narrowly approved an amendment to the Massachusetts Constitution.
examples.zh: 立法机关勉强批准了马萨诸塞州宪法的一项修正案。

examples.en: The committee has approved the compensation package.
examples.zh: 委员会已批准补偿方案。

senses.def: to say that something is good enough to be used or is correct

examples.en: The course is approved by the Department for Education.
examples.zh: 课程已获教育部核准。

examples.en: This medicine is not approved for use in children.
examples.zh: 这种药未获批准用于儿童。

examples.en: The chemical has never been federally approved as a pesticide.
examples.zh: 联邦政府从未批准将这种化学物质用作杀虫剂。

examples.en: The auditors approved the company's accounts.
examples.zh: 审计人员审核通过了公司的账目。

synonyms.words: accept ▪ approve ▪ go along with somebody/​something ▪ consent

intro.en: These words all mean to say that you will do what somebody wants or that you will allow something to happen.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含答应、同意之义。

items.def: to say that you will do what somebody wants or that you will allow something to happen:
items.zh: 指答应、容许

examples.en: He agreed to let me go early.
examples.zh: 他容许我早走。

items.def: to be satisfied with something that has been done, decided or suggested:
items.zh: 指同意、接受、认可

examples.en: They accepted the court’s decision.
examples.zh: 他们接受法院的判决。

items.def: to officially agree to a plan, suggestion or request:
items.zh: 指批准、正式通过（计划、建议或要求）

examples.en: The committee unanimously approved the plan.
examples.zh: 委员会一致通过了计划。

items.def: (rather informal) to agree to something that somebody else has decided; to agree with somebody else’s ideas:
items.zh: 指赞同某事，同意某人的观点

examples.en: She just goes along with everything he suggests.
examples.zh: 他的一切建议她都赞同。

items.def: (rather formal) to agree to something or give your permission for something:
items.zh: 指同意、准许、允许

examples.en: She finally consented to answer our questions.
examples.zh: 她最终同意回答我们的问题。

senses.def: a school where young people who had committed crimes were sent
senses.zh: （旧时的）少年犯教养院，少年感化院

senses.def: in a way that shows that you believe that somebody/something is good or acceptable

examples.en: She looked at him approvingly and smiled.
examples.zh: 她赞许地看着他笑了笑。

senses.def: (in writing) approximate

examples.en: Contents: approx. 6 000 beads
examples.zh: 内容物：约 6 000 颗珠子

senses.def: a speech sound made by bringing the parts of the mouth that produce speech close together but not actually touching, for example /
senses.zh: 近似音；无擦通音；无摩擦延续音

senses.def: an answer to a problem in mathematics that is a close estimate of the solution of the problem
almost correct or accurate, but not completely so

examples.en: an approximate number/total/cost
examples.zh: 约数；概算总额；约计成本

examples.en: The cost given is only approximate.
examples.zh: 所列成本仅系约计。

examples.en: Use these figures as an approximate guide in your calculations.
examples.zh: 计算时把这些数字作为近似参考数值。

examples.en: Construction was completed at an approximate cost of $4.1 million.
examples.zh: 工程竣工成本约为 410 万美元。

senses.def: to be similar or close to something in nature, quality, amount, etc., but not exactly the same

examples.en: The animals were reared in conditions which approximated the wild as closely as possible.
examples.zh: 这些动物是在尽量近似自然的环境下饲养的。

examples.en: The total cost will approximate £15 billion.
examples.zh: 总费用将近 150 亿英镑。

examples.en: His story approximates to the facts that we already know.
examples.zh: 他的陈述和我们已掌握的事实接近。

senses.def: to calculate or estimate something fairly accurately

examples.en: a formula for approximating the weight of a horse
examples.zh: 估算一匹马重量的公式

senses.def: used to show that something is almost, but not completely, accurate or correct

examples.en: The journey took approximately seven hours.
examples.zh: 旅程大约花了七个小时。

examples.en: The two buildings were approximately equal in size.
examples.zh: 这两座建筑差不多同样大小。

examples.en: Approximately £4 000 worth of product was stolen in the raid.
examples.zh: 价值约 4 000 英镑的产品在这次抢劫中被盗了。

senses.def: an estimate of a number or an amount that is almost correct, but not exact

examples.en: That's just an approximation, you understand.
examples.zh: 你知道那仅仅是近似值。

senses.zh: 亚瑟·布利斯：（1891-1975年）英国作曲家。他在皇家音乐学院就读于霍尔斯特（Holst）和沃恩·威廉姆斯（Vaughan Williams）并就读，并继续写各种音乐，包括芭蕾舞和电影音乐。他于1950年被任命为骑士，并于1953年被选为女王音乐大师。

senses.def: Arthur Charles Clarke (1917-2008) an English writer of science fiction
senses.zh: 亚瑟·克拉克（Arthur C Clarke）：亚瑟·查尔斯·克拉克（Arthur Charles Clarke）（1917-2008），英国科幻小说作家和太空旅行书籍。他以史丹利·库布里克（Stanley Kubrick）的非常成功的电影《 2001：太空漫游》（1968）而闻名，该片是根据他的故事《前哨》（1951）制作的。克拉克在斯里兰卡生活了很多年。他在1998年被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1859-1930) a Scottish writer. He is best known as the author of the famous detective Sherlock Holmes
senses.zh: 阿瑟·柯南道尔（1859–1930）苏格兰作家，笔下的侦探夏洛克·福尔摩斯家喻户晓，也写历史和科幻小说。初为医生，在其第一部福尔摩斯小说《血字的研究》（1887）大获成功后弃医从文。1902 年获封爵士。

senses.def: a character in the British television series Minder
senses.zh: 亚瑟·戴利（Arthur Daley）：英国电视连续剧Minder（1979-1994）中的角色。作为出售二手车和其他商品的伦敦人，他始终对赚钱感兴趣，不一定是诚实的，但通常不会成功。他雇用了一个“看护人”特里来保护他。亚瑟·戴利（Arthur Daley）使用的某些表达方式也已成为该语言的一部分。例如，他有时将商业交易描述为“一个不错的小收入者”，这意味着这将使他轻松赚很多钱。他还谈到自己的妻子（从未见过）为“室内”。

examples.en: The law will make things difficult for the Arthur Daleys of this world.
examples.zh: 法律将使这个世界的亚瑟·戴利家族的事情变得困难。

senses.def: (1905-83) a British author, born in Hungary. His experiences as a Communist in the 1930s and later as a prisoner during the Spanish Civil War influenced his most famous novel, Darkness at Noon
senses.zh: 亚瑟·科斯特勒（Arthur Koestler）：（1905-83）英国作家，出生于匈牙利。他在1930年代作为共产党员的经历以及后来在西班牙内战期间作为囚徒的经历都影响了他最著名的小说《中午的黑暗》（Darkness at Noon，1941年）。他还撰写了许多有关科学的书籍，包括有关科学与艺术之间关系的著作《创造法案》（The Act of Creation，1964年）。

senses.def: (1915-2005) a US writer of plays. They include Death of a Salesman
senses.zh: 阿瑟·米勒（(1915-2005) 美国戏剧作家。其中包括获得普利策奖的《推销员之死》和《桥上的风景》(1955)。在《坩埚》(1953)中，他用塞勒姆女巫审判的故事作为他强烈反对的麦卡锡主义的象征。米勒于 1955 年至 1961 年间与玛丽莲·梦露结婚，并创作了她的最后一部电影《乱点鸳鸯》(The Misfits，1961 年)，这也是米勒后来的戏剧《完成画面》(2004 年)的主题。本身。”）

senses.def: (1863-1944) an English author and professor
senses.zh: 亚瑟·奎勒-库什（Arthur Quiller-Couch）：（1863-1944）是英国作家，也是剑桥大学（1912-44）的英语教授。他最著名的是《牛津英语经文》及类似收藏的编辑，并以“ Q”为名撰写小说。他在1910年被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1867-1939) an English artist. He is famous for his highly detailed illustrations of children's books, drawing a world of strange imaginary creatures for books such as Fairy Tales of the Brothers Grimm
senses.zh: 亚瑟·拉克姆（Arthur Rackham）：（1867-1939）英国艺术家。他以对儿童读物的高度详尽的插图而闻名，为诸如格林童话的童话（1900年）和彼得·潘（1906年）之类的书描绘了一个奇特的虚构生物世界。

senses.def: (1884-1967) an English author of children's books. He is best known for his adventure story Swallows and Amazons
senses.zh: 亚瑟·兰索姆（Arthur Ransome）：（1884-1967）儿童书籍的英文作者。他以冒险故事《燕子和亚马逊》而著称，这是十二本相同字符的书中的第一本，大多定于湖区。第一次世界大战期间，他还曾在俄罗斯担任新闻记者。

senses.def: (1888-1982) a US piano player of classical music, born in Poland. He first played in public at the age of 12, and continued performing until he was 90. He became a US citizen in 1946. Rubinstein made many recordings, including the complete works of Chopin and many by Beethoven and Brahms.
senses.zh: 亚瑟·鲁宾斯坦（Arthur Rubinstein）：（1888-1982）是美国古典音乐钢琴演奏家，出生于波兰。他在12岁时首次在公共场合演出，直到90岁时才继续演出。1946年成为美国公民。鲁宾斯坦录制了许多唱片，包括肖邦的完整作品以及贝多芬和勃拉姆斯的许多作品。

senses.def: (1842-1900) an English composer
senses.zh: 亚瑟·沙利文（Arthur Sullivan）：（1842-1900）是一位英国作曲家。他以萨沃伊歌剧而闻名，萨沃伊歌剧是他与WS吉尔伯特（WS Gilbert）所写的一系列轻歌剧，展示了他写轻音乐（通常是幽默音乐）的技巧。吉尔伯特（Gilbert）和沙利文（Sullivan）创作了14首热门小歌剧，其中包括《天皇》和《彭赞斯海盗》，这些小歌剧在英国仍然定期演出。他还写过严肃的歌剧和其他古典音乐作品，但它们不如萨伏伊歌剧闻名。1883年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1886-1948) a Scottish pilot. In 1919 he and John Alcock
senses.zh: 亚瑟·惠顿·布朗（Arthur Whitten Brown）：（1886-1948）苏格兰飞行员。在1919年，他和约翰·阿尔考克（John Alcock）是从加拿大纽芬兰到爱尔兰西海岸横渡大西洋的第一批人。布朗在1919年被任命为骑士。

senses.def: connected with the stories about Arthur, a king of ancient Britain, his Knights of the Round Table and court
senses.zh: 亚瑟王（及骑士和朝臣）故事的

examples.en: Arthurian legends
examples.zh: 亚瑟王传奇故事

senses.def: a round vegetable with a lot of thick green leaves. The bottom part of the leaves and the inside of the artichoke
senses.zh: 朝鲜蓟，洋蓟，球蓟（圆形蔬菜，绿色厚叶基部及茎内部均可食用）

senses.def: a light-brown root vegetable that looks like a potato
a piece of writing about a particular subject in a newspaper or magazine, on a website, etc.
senses.zh: （报刊或网络上的）文章，论文，报道

examples.en: to read/write/publish an article
examples.zh: 读／写／发表一篇文章

examples.en: Her comment follows an article posted online by the ‘Huffington Post’.
examples.zh: 她的评论是在《赫芬顿邮报》在线发布的一篇文章之后发表的。

examples.en: I read an interesting article by a well-known scientist on the subject of genetics.
examples.zh: 我读了一篇著名科学家写的关于遗传学的有趣文章。

examples.en: Have you seen that article about young fashion designers?
examples.zh: 你见到了关于年轻时装设计师的那篇文章没有？

examples.en: According to a recent newspaper article, the company is worth over $20 billion.
examples.zh: 根据最近一篇报纸上的文章，这家公司价值超过 200 亿美元。

senses.def: a separate item in an agreement or a contract

examples.en: Article 10 of the European Convention guarantees free speech.
examples.zh: 《欧洲公约》第 10 条保障言论自由。

senses.def: a particular item or separate thing, especially one of a set
senses.zh: 物件，物品（尤指整套中的一件）

examples.en: articles of clothing
examples.zh: 衣物

examples.en: toilet articles such as soap and shampoo
examples.zh: 诸如肥皂和洗发水之类的梳妆用品

examples.en: The articles left at the scene helped the police to identify the criminals.
examples.zh: 现场留下的物品帮助警方辨认了罪犯。

senses.def: the words a
senses.zh: 冠词（a 和 an 为不定冠词，the 为定冠词）

examples.en: Names of countries in English do not usually take an article.
examples.zh: 在英语中，国名通常不带冠词。

senses.def: something you believe very strongly, as if it were a religious belief

examples.en: He tried to believe, as an article of faith, that his daughter was not guilty.
examples.zh: 作为一种信念，他试图相信他的女儿是无罪的。

senses.def: employed by a group of lawyers, architects or accountants
senses.zh: 签约给（律师、建筑师、会计师）当实习生的

examples.en: an articled clerk (= somebody who is training to be a solicitor)
examples.zh: 见习律师

examples.en: She was articled to a firm of solicitors.
examples.zh: 她与律师事务所签了约当见习律师。

senses.def: to express or explain your thoughts or feelings clearly in words

examples.en: She struggled to articulate her thoughts.
examples.zh: 她竭力表明她的想法。

examples.en: It is the school’s duty to articulate its practices to parents.
examples.zh: 学校有责任向家长阐明其做法。

senses.def: to speak, pronounce or play something in a clear way
senses.zh: 口齿清楚；清晰吐（词）；清晰发（音）

examples.en: He was too weak to articulate properly.
examples.zh: 他太虚弱了，无法正确表达。

examples.en: Every note was carefully articulated.
examples.zh: 每个音都唱得很认真、很清楚。

examples.en: She spoke slowly, articulating each word clearly.
examples.zh: 她说得很慢，每一个字都说得很清楚。

senses.def: to be related to something so that together the two parts form a whole

examples.en: These courses are designed to articulate with university degrees.
examples.zh: 这些课程旨在与大学学位接轨。

senses.def: to be joined to something else by a joint

examples.en: bones that articulate with others
examples.zh: 与其他骨骼以关节相连的骨骼

examples.en: a robot with articulated limbs
examples.zh: 关节型四肢机器人

senses.def: good at expressing ideas or feelings clearly in words

examples.en: He was unusually articulate for a ten-year-old.
examples.zh: 对于一个十岁的孩子来说，他的表达能力非同一般。

examples.en: She is the most articulate critic of government policy.
examples.zh: 她是对政府政策最明确的批评者。

examples.en: The teachers help the children to be more articulate about their strengths and weaknesses.
examples.zh: 老师帮助这些孩子把自己的长处和不足讲得更清楚。

examples.en: a highly articulate woman
examples.zh: 极擅言辞的女子

senses.def: clearly expressed or pronounced
senses.zh: 口齿清楚的；发音清晰的

examples.en: All we could hear were loud sobs, but no articulate words.
examples.zh: 我们听到的只是大声啜泣，没有清楚的话语。

senses.def: in a way that expresses ideas or feelings clearly using words
the expression of an idea or a feeling in words

examples.en: the articulation of his theory
examples.zh: 他的理论的表述

senses.def: the act of making sounds in speech or music

examples.en: The singer worked hard on the clear articulation of every note.
examples.zh: 歌手苦练把每一个音都唱得清晰。

examples.en: The tongue and teeth are both organs of articulation.
examples.zh: 舌头和牙齿都是发音器官。

examples.en: As he drank more wine, his articulation suffered.
examples.zh: 酒喝得越多，他的发音就越发困难。

senses.def: the state of having a joint
senses.zh: 关节；关节连接；铰接式接头

senses.def: a person who expresses an idea

examples.en: He is a good articulator of the party's message.
examples.zh: 他是党的信息的良好表达者。

senses.def: an organ in the mouth used for making speech sounds, such as the tongue, lips or teeth
connected with the action of making speech sounds

examples.en: articulatory movements/organs
examples.zh: 发音动作╱器官

senses.def: (1910-2004) a US musician who led big bands
senses.zh: 邵逸夫（Artie Shaw）：（1910-2004）是一位美国音乐家，他在1930年代和1940年代领导大型乐队。他还演奏单簧管并写音乐。他最著名的音乐之一是《 Beginine》（1938年）。肖在第二次世界大战期间还领导了一支美国海军乐队。他结婚八次，妻子包括演员Lana Turner和Ava Gardner。他因终身成就而于2004年获得格莱美奖。

senses.def: an object that is made by a person, especially something of historical or cultural interest
senses.zh: 人工制品，手工艺品（尤指有历史或文化价值的）

senses.def: the clever use of tricks to cheat somebody

examples.en: Pretending to faint was merely (an) artifice.
examples.zh: 假装昏迷只不过是个诡计。

examples.en: the artifices of the theatre
examples.zh: 剧院的技巧

senses.def: made or produced to copy something natural; not real

examples.en: an artificial limb/flower/sweetener/fertilizer
examples.zh: 假肢；假花；人造甜味剂；化肥

examples.en: artificial lighting/light
examples.zh: 人工照明；人造光

senses.def: created by people; not happening naturally

examples.en: A job interview is a very artificial situation.
examples.zh: 求职面试是一个相当不自然的场面。

examples.en: the artificial barriers of race, class and gender
examples.zh: 种族、阶级、性别的人为障碍

senses.def: not what it appears to be

examples.en: artificial emotion
examples.zh: 假装的情感

intro.en: These words all describe things that are not real, or not naturally produced or grown.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指假的、非天然的、人造的。

items.def: made or produced to copy something natural; not real:
items.zh: 指人工的、人造的、假的

examples.en: artificial flowers
examples.zh: 假花

items.def: made by combining chemical substances rather than being produced naturally by plants or animals:
items.zh: 指人工合成的

examples.en: synthetic drugs
examples.zh: 合成药物

items.def: not natural:
items.zh: 指非天然的、非天生的、假的

examples.en: false teeth
examples.zh: 假牙

items.def: made by people; not natural:
items.zh: 指人造的、非天然的

examples.en: man-made fibres such as nylon
examples.zh: 尼龙之类的人造纤维

items.def: made to look like something else; not real:
items.zh: 指仿制的、人造的、假的

examples.en: a fake-fur jacket
examples.zh: 一件人造毛皮的短上衣

items.def: [only before noun] made to look like something else; not real:
items.zh: 指仿制的、人造的、假的

examples.en: She would never wear imitation pearls.
examples.zh: 她绝不会戴假珍珠。

senses.def: the process of making a woman or female animal pregnant by an artificial method of putting male sperm

examples.en: artificial insemination by a donor, abbreviated to ‘AID’
examples.zh: 供精人工授精（缩写为 AID）

senses.def: the study and development of computer systems that can copy intelligent human behaviour

examples.en: Language is crucial to the development of artificial intelligence.
examples.zh: 语言对于人工智能的发展至关重要。

senses.def: a language invented for international communication or for use with computers
senses.zh: （为国际交流目的的）人造语言；（用于计算机的）人工语言

senses.def: the use of programs or systems that copy the behaviour of living things
senses.zh: 人工生命（用计算机程序或系统模仿生物行为）

senses.def: the process of helping a person who has stopped breathing begin to breathe again, usually by blowing into their mouth or nose or by using special equipment that sends air in and out of their lungs
the fact of being made to copy something natural, rather than being real

examples.en: the artificiality of theatre
examples.zh: 戏剧的人为性

senses.def: the fact of being created by people rather than existing or happening naturally

examples.en: the artificiality of international boundaries
examples.zh: 国际边界的人为性

senses.def: in a way that copies something natural

examples.en: artificially created lakes
examples.zh: 人工湖泊

senses.def: in a way that has been caused by people rather than existing or happening naturally

examples.en: artificially low prices
examples.zh: 人为造成的低价

senses.def: large, heavy guns which are often moved on wheels

examples.en: The town is under heavy artillery fire.
examples.zh: 该市镇处于密集的炮火之下。

examples.en: artillery attacks/barrages/shells
examples.zh: 炮火攻击/弹幕/炮弹

senses.def: the section of an army trained to use these guns

examples.en: He was a captain in the Royal Artillery.
examples.zh: 他是皇家炮兵的上尉。

senses.def: a member of a regiment
a person who does work that needs a special skill, making things with their hands

examples.en: The hand-woven textiles were made by skilled local artisans.
examples.zh: 手工编织的纺织品是由当地熟练的工匠制作的。

senses.def: relating to an artisan, or typical of an artisan's work

examples.en: an artisan bakery
examples.zh: 一家手工面包店

examples.en: artisanal skills
examples.zh: 手工技能

senses.def: (of food and drink) made in a traditional way with high-quality ingredients
senses.zh: （食品和饮料）手工制作的，传统工艺精制的

examples.en: artisan bread
examples.zh: 手工面包

senses.def: a person who creates works of art, especially paintings or drawings

examples.en: an exhibition of work by contemporary British artists
examples.zh: 当代英国画家作品展

examples.en: a graphic artist
examples.zh: 平面造型艺术家

examples.en: a make-up artist
examples.zh: 化妆师

examples.en: He became a full-time artist in 1929.
examples.zh: 他于 1929 年成为一名全职画家。

examples.en: In Paris she met a group of young artists: poets, film-makers and painters.
examples.zh: 在巴黎，她遇到了一群年轻艺术家：诗人、电影制片人和画家。

examples.en: This is an artist's impression of the new stadium.
examples.zh: 这是一位艺术家对未来新运动场作的印象画。

examples.en: Whoever made this cake is a real artist.
examples.zh: 制作这个蛋糕的人真是个艺术大师。

senses.def: a person who is a professional singer, dancer, actor, etc.
senses.zh: 艺术家（指职业歌手、舞蹈家、演员等）

examples.en: a recording/solo artist
examples.zh: 音像录制艺术师；单人表演演员

examples.en: Among the artistes appearing on our show tonight we have…
examples.zh: 今晚为我们演出的（表演者）有....

examples.en: He was a true artiste: sensitive, dramatic and tragic.
examples.zh: 他是个真正的艺人－敏感、夸张，富于悲剧色彩。

senses.def: connected with art or artists

examples.en: the artistic works of the period
examples.zh: 该时期的艺术品

examples.en: a work of great artistic merit
examples.zh: 艺术价值很高的作品

examples.en: an artistic temperament (= behaviour thought to be typical of artists, musicians, etc.)
examples.zh: 艺术家的气质（感情冲动，行为古怪被视为艺术家的特征）。

examples.en: Love is a time-honoured subject of literary and artistic expression.
examples.zh: 爱情是一个历史悠久的文学艺术表现题材。

senses.def: showing a natural skill or pleasure in art, especially being able to paint or draw well
senses.zh: 有艺术天赋的；（尤指）有美术才能的

examples.en: artistic abilities/achievements/skills/talent
examples.zh: 艺术才能／成就／技巧／天才

examples.en: She comes from a very artistic family.
examples.zh: 她出身于艺术世家。

senses.def: done with skill and imagination; attractive or beautiful

examples.en: an artistic arrangement of dried flowers
examples.zh: 富有艺术性的干花插花

examples.en: The decor inside the house was very artistic.
examples.zh: 屋内的装饰极富艺术性。

senses.def: the freedom of artists or writers to change facts in order to make a story, painting, etc. more interesting or beautiful
senses.zh: 艺术上自由发挥的权利；诗的破格

senses.def: the freedom of artists or writers to change facts in order to make a story, painting, etc. more interesting or beautiful
senses.zh: 艺术上自由发挥的权利；诗的破格

senses.def: the person in charge of deciding which plays, operas
a form of gymnastics

examples.en: At the last Olympics she won the gold in artistic gymnastics.
examples.zh: 她在上一届奥运会上赢得竞技体操金牌。

senses.def: the freedom of artists or writers to change facts in order to make a story, painting, etc. more interesting or beautiful
senses.zh: 艺术上自由发挥的权利；诗的破格

senses.def: the freedom of artists or writers to change facts in order to make a story, painting, etc. more interesting or beautiful
senses.zh: 艺术上自由发挥的权利；诗的破格

senses.def: in a way that is connected with art or artists

examples.en: The film was both commercially and artistically successful.
examples.zh: 这部电影在商业和艺术上都取得了成功。

senses.def: in a way that shows a natural skill or pleasure in art
senses.zh: 艺术上的：以某种自然的技巧或愉悦的方式表现出来的

examples.en: a summer school for the artistically gifted
examples.zh: 为有艺术天赋的人开设的暑期学校

senses.def: in an attractive or beautiful way that shows skill and imagination
senses.zh: 艺术性地：以吸引人或美丽的方式展现技巧和想象力

examples.en: The food has to be artistically arranged on the plate.
examples.zh: 食物必须艺术地排列在盘子上。

senses.def: the skill of an artist

examples.en: He played the piece with effortless artistry.
examples.zh: 他游刃有余地演奏了这首乐曲。

examples.zh: 对这幅画的美感和艺术性的欣赏

examples.zh: 美术馆里有重要的工艺美术展览。

senses.zh: 艺术委员会：英国的一个组织，旨在为艺术项目提供政府或私人资助，以鼓励艺术并使之流行。例如，如果一家剧院公司从艺术委员会那里收到了款项，那么它可能会帮助该公司降低门票价格。1994年，大不列颠艺术委员会分为英格兰，苏格兰和威尔士的单独委员会。

senses.def: making a strong display of being very artistic or interested in the arts
senses.zh: 附庸风雅的；表现得爱好艺术的

senses.def: trying too hard to be artistic or show an interest in the arts

examples.en: I expect he's out with his artsy-fartsy friends.
examples.zh: 我猜他是和他那些艺术气息浓厚的朋友出去了。

senses.def: pictures and photographs prepared for books, magazines, etc.

examples.en: Can you let me have the finished artwork for the poster by Friday?
examples.zh: 你能在周五之前让我拿到海报的成品吗？

senses.def: a work of art, especially one in a museum; works of art as a group
senses.zh: （尤指博物馆里的）艺术品；一组艺术品

examples.en: 30 original artworks have gone missing from the museum.
examples.zh: 博物馆丢失了30件原创艺术品。

examples.en: a collection of artwork from different cultures
examples.zh: 来自不同文化的艺术品收藏

senses.def: making a strong display of being very artistic or interested in the arts

examples.en: She hangs out with the arty types she met at drama school.
examples.zh: 她和一些在戏剧学校认识的附庸风雅的朋友常混在一起。

examples.en: Why do you pretend you like those boring, arty films?
examples.zh: 你为什么假装喜欢那些无聊的艺术电影？

senses.def: trying too hard to be artistic or show an interest in the arts

examples.en: I expect he's out with his arty-farty friends.
examples.zh: 我想他去会他那帮玩艺术的朋友了。

an African plant with large white petals
afternoon

examples.zh: 下午见！

senses.def: connected with

examples.zh: 行星的

examples.en: budgetary
examples.zh: 预算的

senses.def: belonging to the group of people, who spoke an Indo-European language, that went to South Asia in around 1500 BC
senses.zh: 雅利安人（公元前 1 500 年前后到南亚）

senses.def: relating to the language of the Aryan
(according to the ideas of the German Nazi party) Caucasian, not Jewish, especially having fair hair and blue eyes
senses.zh: 属于雅利安人种的人（尤指德国纳粹党认为的非犹太民族白种人）

senses.def: a member of the group of people, who spoke an Indo-European language, that went to South Asia in around 1500 BC
senses.zh: 雅利安人（讲印欧系语言，公元前 1500 年前后到南亚）

senses.def: the language of the Aryan
(according to the ideas of the German Nazi party) a member of a Caucasian, not Jewish, group of people, especially one with fair hair and blue eyes
senses.zh: （根据德国纳粹党的想法）白人而非犹太人群体的成员，尤其是金发碧眼的人

senses.def: used to describe somebody/something appearing to be somebody/something else

examples.en: They were all dressed as clowns.
examples.zh: 他们都打扮成小丑。

examples.en: The bomb was disguised as a package.
examples.zh: 炸弹伪装成一个包裹。

senses.def: used to describe the fact that somebody/something has a particular job or function

examples.en: She works as a courier.
examples.zh: 她的职业是导游。

examples.en: Treat me as a friend.
examples.zh: 要把我当作朋友。

examples.en: I respect him as a doctor.
examples.zh: 我尊敬他这个医生。

examples.en: You can use that glass as a vase.
examples.zh: 你可以把那个玻璃杯当作花瓶用。

examples.en: The news came as a shock.
examples.zh: 消息传来，令人震惊。

examples.en: She had been there often as a child (= when she was a child).
examples.zh: 她小时候常去那里。

senses.def: used when you are comparing two people or things, or two situations

examples.en: You're as tall as your father.
examples.zh: 你和你父亲一样高。

examples.en: He was as white as a sheet.
examples.zh: 他面无血色。

examples.en: She doesn't play as well as her sister.
examples.zh: 她演奏得不如她姐姐。

examples.en: I haven't known him as long as you (= as you have known him).
examples.zh: 我认识他的时间没有你长。

examples.en: He doesn't earn as much as me.
examples.zh: 他挣的钱比我少。

examples.en: He doesn't earn as much as I do.
examples.zh: 他挣的钱比我少。

examples.en: It's not as hard as I thought.
examples.zh: 这没有我想象的那么困难。

examples.en: Run as fast as you can.
examples.zh: 你尽量快跑。

examples.en: We'd like it as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 我们希望越快越好。

senses.def: used to say that something happens in the same way
senses.zh: （指事情以同样的方式发生）和…一样

examples.en: As always, he said little.
examples.zh: 他和平时一样，少言寡语。

examples.en: The ‘h’ in honest is silent, as in ‘hour’.
examples.zh: honest 中的 h 与 hour 中的 h 一样都不发音。

senses.def: used to emphasize an amount

examples.en: As many as 2 million people could be affected.
examples.zh: 多达 200 万人可能会受到影响。

examples.en: The chimp is an endangered species, with as few as 170 000 chimps left in the wild.
examples.zh: 黑猩猩是濒临灭绝的物种，野外仅存17万只黑猩猩。

senses.def: while something else is happening

examples.en: He sat watching her as she got ready.
examples.zh: 他一直坐着看她准备停当。

examples.en: As she grew older she gained in confidence.
examples.zh: 随着年龄的增长她的信心增强了。

senses.def: in the way in which

examples.en: They did as I had asked.
examples.zh: 他们是按照我的要求做的。

examples.en: Leave the papers as they are.
examples.zh: 别去动那些文件。

examples.en: She lost it, just as I said she would.
examples.zh: 我就说了吧，她把它弄丢了。

senses.def: used to state the reason for something

examples.en: As you were out, I left a message.
examples.zh: 你不在，所以我留了一张字条儿。

examples.en: She may need some help as she's new.
examples.zh: 她是新来的，可能需要一些帮助。

senses.def: used to make a comment or to add information about what you have just said

examples.en: As you know, Julia is leaving soon.
examples.zh: 你是知道的，朱莉娅马上要离开了。

examples.en: She's very tall, as is her mother.
examples.zh: 她个子很高，和她母亲一样。

senses.def: used to say that although something is true, what follows is also true

examples.en: Happy as they were, there was something missing.
examples.zh: 尽管他们很快乐，但总缺少点什么。

examples.en: Try as he might (= however hard he tried), he couldn't open the door.
examples.zh: 他想尽了办法也没能打开门。

senses.def: in contrast with something

examples.en: They got 27 per cent of the vote as against 32 per cent at the last election.
examples.zh: 这次选举他们得了 27% 的选票，而上次他们得了 32%。

senses.def: used to say that something may happen at some time in the future, but only when something else has happened
senses.zh: （用于在特定条件下才会发生的事情）将来…时，到时候

examples.en: We'll decide on the team as and when we qualify.
examples.zh: 将来我们具备了条件时就会决定成立这个队。

examples.en: I'll tell you more as and when (= as soon as I can).
examples.zh: 我一有可能就会告诉你更多情况。

senses.def: used to start talking about somebody/something

examples.en: As for Jo, she's doing fine.
examples.zh: 至于乔，她现在日子过得不错。

examples.en: As for food for the party, that's all being taken care of.
examples.zh: 关于聚会要用的食物，都在置办当中。

senses.def: used to show the time or date from which something starts

examples.en: Our phone number is changing as from May 12.
examples.zh: 我们的电话号码自 5 月 12 日起更改。

examples.en: Lee and I are now officially engaged, as of yesterday.
examples.zh: 李和我昨天正式订婚了。

senses.def: in a way that suggests something

examples.en: He behaved as if nothing had happened.
examples.zh: 他表现得若无其事。

examples.en: It sounds as though you had a good time.
examples.zh: 听起来你好像过得挺愉快。

examples.en: It's my birthday. As if you didn't know!
examples.zh: 今天是我的生日。你好像不知道似的！

examples.en: ‘Don't say anything.’ ‘As if I would!’ (= surely you do not expect me to)
examples.zh: “什么也别说。”“我才不会说呢！”

senses.def: used to say that you doubt something very much

examples.en: ‘He says he'll be on time tomorrow.’ ‘As if! He's always late!’
examples.zh: "他说他明天会准时到。" "谁信啊！他总是迟到！"

senses.def: considering the present situation; as things are

examples.en: We were hoping to finish it by next week—as it is, it may be the week after.
examples.zh: 我们本希望在下周完成，看样子可能要下下周才行。

examples.en: I can't help—I've got too much to do as it is (= already).
examples.zh: 我帮不了忙，我已经有太多的工作了。

senses.def: used when a speaker is giving his or her own impression of a situation or expressing something in a particular way

examples.en: Teachers must put the brakes on, as it were, when they notice students looking puzzled.
examples.zh: 当老师发现学生神色茫然时，就应该在一定程度上放慢速度。

senses.def: used when you are referring to something

examples.en: As to tax, that will be deducted from your salary.
examples.zh: 至于税款，将从你薪水中扣除。

examples.en: I have a few ideas as to how we might do this.
examples.zh: 关于我们怎么做这事，我有一些想法。

examples.en: There is a serious issue as to whether or not we give tutors enough guidance.
examples.zh: 关于是否给予导师足够的指导，这是一个严肃的问题。

senses.def: until now or until a particular time in the past
senses.zh: 直到现在；直至过去某时

examples.en: an as yet unpublished report
examples.zh: 一篇尚未发表的报告

examples.en: As yet little was known of the causes of the disease.
examples.zh: 当时人们对这种疾病的起因几乎一无所知。

senses.def: used as a comment on something that you have just said

examples.en: He smiled and I smiled back. As you do.
examples.zh: 他微笑，我也报以微笑。正所谓礼尚往来。

examples.en: A little boy finds a gigantic robot in his backyard—as you do—and has to keep it secret.
examples.zh: 一个小男孩在他的后院发现了一个巨大的机器人——就像你一样——并且必须保守秘密。

examples.zh: 一般来说，植物油比动物脂肪对人较有好处。

examples.en: It's a nice place. We've stayed there ourselves, as a matter of fact.
examples.zh: 那个地方不错。事实上，我们在那儿待过。

senses.def: used to disagree with something that somebody has just said

examples.en: ‘I suppose you'll be leaving soon, then?’ ‘No, as a matter of fact I'll be staying for another two years.’
examples.zh: “我想你快要离开了吧？”“不。事实上，我还要再待两年呢。”

examples.zh: 北方的失业率比整个国家的高。

examples.en: The festival will be great for our city and for the country as a whole.
examples.zh: 这次会演对我们城市乃至整个国家都将是意义重大的。

senses.zh: 和往常一样；和料想的一样

examples.zh: 波莉和往常一样，上学又迟到了。

examples.zh: 他询问了她的家庭情况。

examples.zh: 我能提个问题吗？

examples.zh: 你问了价钱没有？

examples.zh: “你去哪里？”她问道。

examples.zh: “你有把握吗？”他问她。

examples.zh: 我要求见经理。

examples.zh: 我会问是否可以在这里停车。

senses.zh: 要自找麻烦；要自讨苦吃

examples.en: He was asking for trouble when he insulted their country.

examples.zh: “然后他做了什么？” “别问！”

examples.en: ‘What will the meeting be about?’ ‘Don’t ask me.’
examples.zh: “会议将讨论什么？”“别问我。”

examples.zh: 只要开口，这份工作就是你的了。

senses.def: if you say I ask you
senses.zh: （表示震惊、气愤或厌恶）请问，真是，这还了得

examples.en: He told me I had to work late on Friday night. I ask you!
examples.zh: 他告诉我周五晚上必须工作到很晚。我问你！

senses.def: in my personal opinion

examples.zh: 依我看，他们的婚姻是个错误。

senses.def: a difficult thing to achieve or deal with

intro.en: These words all mean to say or write something in the form of a question, in order to get information.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含口头或书面询问之义。

items.def: to say or write something in the form of a question, in order to get information:
items.zh: 指口头或书面提问、询问

examples.en: ‘Where are you going?’ she asked.
examples.zh: “你去哪里？”她问道。

items.def: (rather formal) to ask somebody for information:
items.zh: 指询问、查询

examples.en: I called the station to enquire about train times.
examples.zh: 我打电话到车站询问了火车时刻。

items.def: to make a very strong request for information:
items.zh: 指严正地问、质问

examples.en: ‘And where have you been?’ he demanded angrily.
examples.zh: “那你去了哪里？”他怒气冲冲地质问道。

intro.en: These words all mean to say that somebody should do or have something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含要求之义。

items.def: to make a very strong request for something; to say very definitely that somebody should have or do something:
items.zh: 指强烈要求、坚决要求

examples.en: She demanded an immediate explanation.
examples.zh: 她强烈要求立即作出解释。

items.def: [often passive] (rather formal) to make somebody do or have something, especially because it is necessary according to a law or set of rules or standards:
items.zh: 指要求做（某事）、达到（某水平），尤指根据法规或规定

examples.en: All candidates will be required to take a short test.
examples.zh: 所有候选人都要做一个小测验。

items.def: to demand that somebody should do, have or be something, especially because it is their duty or responsibility:

examples.en: I expect to be paid promptly for the work.
examples.zh: 我要求即时付工钱。

items.def: to demand that something happens or that somebody agrees to do something:
items.zh: 指坚决要求、坚持

examples.en: I didn’t want to go but he insisted.
examples.zh: 我并不想去，但他硬要我去。

items.def: to expect or demand something:

examples.en: You’re asking too much of him.
examples.zh: 你对他要求过分了。
