senses.def: an act of criticizing somebody/something severely

examples.en: The suggested closures came under assault from all parties.
examples.zh: 关闭机构的建议受到各方严厉批评。

examples.en: The paper's assault on the president was totally unjustified.
examples.zh: 这份报纸对总统的攻击纯属无稽之谈。

senses.def: an act that threatens to harm somebody physically, whether or not actual harm is done
senses.zh: 威胁要对某人造成身体伤害的行为，无论是否造成了实际伤害

senses.def: to attack somebody violently, especially when this is a crime
senses.zh: 猛烈攻击，袭击，侵犯（尤指构成罪）

examples.en: He has been charged with assaulting a police officer.
examples.zh: 他被控袭击警察。

examples.en: Four women have been sexually assaulted in the area recently.
examples.zh: 近来这个地区有四名妇女遭到性侵犯。

examples.en: He admitted indecently assaulting three men.
examples.zh: 他承认猥亵了三名男子。

examples.en: Many healthcare workers say they have been physically assaulted by patients.
examples.zh: 许多医护人员表示，他们遭到了患者的身体攻击。

senses.def: to affect your senses in a way that is very unpleasant or uncomfortable

examples.en: Loud rock music assaulted our ears.
examples.zh: 喧闹的摇滚乐直往我们耳朵里钻。

senses.def: the crime of threatening to harm somebody and then attacking them physically

examples.en: He was found guilty of assault and battery.
examples.zh: 他被判犯有袭击和殴打罪。

examples.en: He was arrested and charged with assault and battery.
examples.zh: 他被捕并被指控袭击和殴打。

senses.def: an area of land with many objects that are difficult to climb, jump over or go through, which is used, especially by soldiers, for improving physical skills and strength
to test a metal or chemical substance, often to see how pure it is
the testing of metals and chemicals for quality, often to see how pure they are
any of the offices where gold, silver and platinum
senses.zh: 化验室：任何测试过金，银和铂金并具有标记的办公室。在英国有四个这样的办事处：在伦敦，伯明翰，谢菲尔德和爱丁堡。

senses.def: a weapon consisting of a long stick with a sharp metal point on the end, used mainly in southern Africa
senses.zh: （多为南非部落所用的）长矛，标枪

senses.def: a South African tree that produces hard wood
a collection of things; a group of people

examples.en: Tropical rainforests have the most varied assemblage of plants in the world.
examples.zh: 热带雨林聚集了世界上种类最繁多的植物。

senses.def: a machine made from different parts

examples.en: The mechanical device was an intricate assemblage of gears, springs and rods.
examples.zh: 这台机械装置是由齿轮、弹簧、杆件装配而成的复杂机器。

senses.def: a work of art made from different, often everyday, objects
senses.zh: 由不同的（通常是日常的）物品制成的艺术品

examples.en: The exhibition features assemblages made from natural materials, especially stones, branches, leaves and moss.
examples.zh: 展览的特色是由天然材料制成的组合，特别是石头、树枝、树叶和苔藓。

senses.def: the action of bringing things together

examples.en: What is impressive about this publication is the skill in the assemblage of the different contributions.
examples.zh: 该出版物令人印象深刻的地方在于其整合不同贡献的技巧。

senses.def: to come together as a group; to bring people or things together as a group

examples.en: All the students were asked to assemble in the main hall.
examples.zh: 全体学生接到通知到大礼堂集合。

examples.en: She then addressed the assembled company (= all the people there).
examples.zh: 接着她向全体集合者讲话。

examples.en: to assemble evidence/data
examples.zh: 收集证据／数据

examples.en: The manager has assembled a world-class team.
examples.zh: 经理组建了一个世界一流的团队。

examples.en: He tried to assemble his thoughts.
examples.zh: 他试着整理自己的思绪。

senses.def: to fit together all the separate parts of something, for example a piece of furniture

examples.en: The shelves are easy to assemble.
examples.zh: 搁架容易装配。

synonyms.words: construct ▪ assemble ▪ erect ▪ put something up

intro.en: These words all mean to make something, especially by putting different parts together.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含制造、建造之义。

items.def: to make something, especially a building, by putting parts together:
items.zh: 指制造、建造、修建（尤指房屋）

examples.en: a house built of stone
examples.zh: 用石头建造的房子

items.def: [often passive] (rather formal) to build something such as a road, building or machine
items.zh: 指修建、建造（公路、房屋、机器等）

items.def: (rather formal) to fit together all the separate parts of something such as a piece of furniture or a machine:
items.zh: 指装配、组装（家具、机器等）

examples.en: The cupboard is easy to assemble.
examples.zh: 这个橱柜容易组装。

items.def: (formal) to build something; to put something in position and make it stand upright:
items.zh: 指建立、建造、安装、竖立、搭起

examples.en: Police had to erect barriers to keep crowds back.
examples.zh: 警察只得设立路障来阻截人群。

items.def: to build something or place something somewhere:
items.zh: 指修建、建立、设立、设置

examples.en: They’re putting up new hotels in order to boost tourism in the area.
examples.zh: 他们正在盖新旅馆以促进该地区的旅游业。

senses.def: a person who assembles
a program for changing instructions into machine code
senses.zh: 汇编程序，汇编器，组译器（将指令转变为机器码）

senses.def: the language in which a program is written before it is changed into machine code
the largest Pentecostal Church in the US (= one that emphasizes the gifts of the Holy Spirit, such as the power to make sick people healthy again)
senses.zh: 神召会（美国规模最大的五旬节教派，强调医治等神恩）

senses.def: a group of people who have been elected to meet together regularly and make decisions or laws for a particular region or country

examples.en: state/legislative/federal/local assemblies
examples.zh: 州众议院；立法会议；联邦／地方议会

examples.en: Power has been handed over to provincial and regional assemblies.
examples.zh: 权力已移交给省和地区议会。

examples.en: The national assembly has voted to adopt the budget.
examples.zh: 国民议会已表决通过预算。

examples.en: the California Assembly
examples.zh: 美国加利福尼亚州众议院

examples.en: the UN General Assembly
examples.zh: 联合国大会

examples.en: assembly elections
examples.zh: 议会选举

examples.en: an elected assembly
examples.zh: 民选议会

senses.def: the meeting together of a group of people for a particular purpose; a group of people who meet together for a particular purpose

examples.en: They were fighting for freedom of speech and freedom of assembly.
examples.zh: 他们为言论自由和集会自由而斗争。

examples.en: He was to address a public assembly on the issue.
examples.zh: 他要对公众集会发表演说谈论这个问题。

examples.en: an assembly point (= a place where people have been asked to meet)
examples.zh: 集会地点

senses.def: a meeting of the teachers and students in a school, usually at the start of the day, to give information, discuss school events or say prayers together

examples.en: The deputy head was taking (= leading) school assembly that day.
examples.zh: 副校长正在主持那天的晨会。

senses.def: the process of putting together the parts of something such as a vehicle or piece of furniture

examples.en: Putting the bookcase together should be a simple assembly job.
examples.zh: 组装书橱应该是个简单的装配活。

examples.en: a car assembly plant
examples.zh: 汽车装配厂

examples.en: the correct assembly of the parts
examples.zh: 零部件的正确组装

senses.def: the language in which a program is written before it is changed into machine code
a line of workers and machines in a factory, along which a product passes, having parts made, put together or checked at each stage until the product is finished

examples.en: workers on the assembly line
examples.zh: 装配线上的工人

senses.def: a person elected to represent one of the constituencies
senses.zh: 威尔士议会议员由威尔士各选区或大区选举进入威尔士议会。每个选区选一名，每个大区再选四名。威尔士议会选举独立于英国议会普选。1999 年首次举行，每四年换届一次。

senses.def: a person elected to the Northern Ireland Assembly
senses.zh: 北爱尔兰议会议员每个选区选六名。北爱尔兰议会选举独立于英国议会选举。1998 年首次举行，每四年换届一次。

senses.def: any of the elected members of the London Assembly
a public room or building in which meetings and social events are held
senses.zh: （供会议、社交活动等用的）礼堂

senses.def: a man who is an elected representative in a state assembly
a woman who is an elected representative in a state assembly
official agreement to or approval of something

examples.en: The director has given her assent to the proposals.
examples.zh: 负责人已表示同意提案。

examples.en: He nodded (his) assent.
examples.zh: 他点头同意了。

examples.en: There were murmurs of both assent and dissent from the crowd.
examples.zh: 人群议论纷纷，赞成和反对的都有。

examples.en: The bill passed in Parliament has now received (the) Royal Assent (= been approved by the king/queen).
examples.zh: 议会通过的法案已获御准。

examples.en: She is by common assent, the best person for the job.
examples.zh: 一致认为她是这项工作的最佳人选。

senses.def: to agree to a request, an idea or a suggestion
senses.zh: 同意，赞成（要求、想法或建议）

examples.en: Nobody would assent to the terms they proposed.
examples.zh: 谁也不会同意他们提出的条件。

senses.def: to state clearly and definitely that something is true

examples.en: She continued to assert that she was innocent.
examples.zh: 她仍然坚称自己无辜。

examples.en: The report asserts confidently that the industry will grow.
examples.zh: 报告断言该行业肯定会发展起来。

examples.en: She continued to assert her innocence.
examples.zh: 她仍然坚称自己无辜。

examples.en: The German Chancellor was anxious to assert his government's commitment to European unity.
examples.zh: 德国总理急于表明其政府对欧洲团结的承诺。

examples.en: ‘That is wrong,’ he asserted.
examples.zh: “那是错的。”他断言道。

examples.en: It is commonly asserted that older people prefer to receive care from family members.
examples.zh: 人们普遍确认，老年人更愿意由家人照顾。

senses.def: to behave in a confident and determined way so that other people pay attention to your opinions
senses.zh: 坚持自己的主张；表现坚定

examples.en: You’re too timid—you must try to assert yourself more.
examples.zh: 你太畏缩了--要尽量增强自信心。

senses.def: to make other people recognize your right or authority to do something, by behaving in a determined and confident way
senses.zh: 维护自己的权利（或权威）

examples.en: to assert your independence/rights
examples.zh: 维护你的独立／权利

examples.en: I was determined to assert my authority from the beginning.
examples.zh: 我决心一开始就维护我的权威。

senses.def: to start to have an effect

examples.en: Good sense asserted itself.
examples.zh: 明智服人。

senses.def: a statement saying that you strongly believe something to be true

examples.en: He was correct in his assertion that the minister had been lying.
examples.zh: 他认定部长说谎，事实果然如此。

examples.en: Do you have any evidence to support your assertions?
examples.zh: 你的断言是否有真凭实据？

senses.def: the act of stating, using or claiming something strongly

examples.en: the assertion of his authority
examples.zh: 对他权威的维护

examples.en: The demonstration was an assertion of the right to peaceful protest.
examples.zh: 这次示威游行行使了和平抗议权。

intro.en: These are all words for a statement that something is true, although it has not been proved.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示未经证实的说法。

items.def: a statement that something is true, although it has not been proved.
items.zh: 指声称、宣称、断言

items.def: (rather formal) a public statement that is made without giving proof, accusing somebody of doing something that is wrong or illegal.
items.zh: 指无证据的说法、指控

items.def: (rather formal) a statement of something that you strongly believe to be true, although it has not been proved.
items.zh: 指明确肯定、断言

senses.def: expressing opinions or desires strongly and with confidence, so that people take notice
senses.zh: 坚定自信的；坚决主张的

examples.en: You should try and be more assertive.
examples.zh: 你应该努力坚定信心。

examples.en: assertive behaviour
examples.zh: 坚定自信的行为

senses.def: in a strong and confident way, so that people take notice of what you think or want
the quality of expressing opinions or desires in a strong and confident way, so that people take notice
senses.zh: 坚定自信的；坚决主张的

examples.en: an assertiveness training course
examples.zh: 自信心训练课程

senses.def: to make a judgement about the nature or quality of somebody/something

examples.en: Accurately assessing environmental impacts is very complex.
examples.zh: 准确评估环境影响是非常复杂的。

examples.en: to assess a patient’s needs
examples.zh: 判定病人的需要

examples.en: It's difficult to assess the effects of these changes.
examples.zh: 这些变化带来的效果难以评估。

examples.en: Interviews allow you to assess the suitability of candidates.
examples.zh: 面试可以让您评估候选人的适合性。

examples.en: She engaged a safety consultant to assess the risks.
examples.zh: 她聘请了一名安全顾问来评估风险。

examples.en: Quality of life was assessed using a questionnaire.
examples.zh: 使用问卷评估生活质量。

examples.en: The young men were assessed as either safe or unsafe drivers.
examples.zh: 这些年轻人被评定为谨慎驾驶员和不谨慎驾驶员两类。

examples.en: I'd assess your chances as low.
examples.zh: 我估计你的机会不大。

examples.en: The committee assesses whether a building is worth preserving.
examples.zh: 该委员会评定一栋建筑物是否值得保存。

examples.en: We are trying to assess how well the system works.
examples.zh: 我们正设法评估这个系统运行得是否顺畅。

senses.def: to calculate the amount or value of something
senses.zh: 估算，估定，核定（数量、价值）

examples.en: They have assessed the amount of compensation to be paid.
examples.zh: 他们已经核定赔偿额。

examples.en: Damage to the building was assessed at £40 000.
examples.zh: 该建筑物的损失估定为 4 万英镑。

senses.def: possible to judge

examples.en: The proposition must be assessable as true or false.
examples.zh: 该命题必须可以评估为真或假。

senses.def: possible to calculate

examples.en: assessable income
examples.zh: 应税收入

senses.def: an opinion or a judgement about somebody/something that has been thought about very carefully

examples.en: a detailed assessment of the risks involved
examples.zh: 对涉及的风险所作的详细判断

examples.en: An adequate environmental impact assessment was not carried out on the bypass project.
examples.zh: 没有对绕行公路工程进行充分的环境影响评估。

examples.en: We conducted the initial assessments defining the scope of work.
examples.zh: 我们进行了初步评估，确定了工作范围。

examples.en: The city hired them to do a structural assessment of the damage.
examples.zh: 该市聘请他们对损害进行结构评估。

examples.en: his assessment of the situation
examples.zh: 他对形势的看法

senses.def: the act of judging or forming an opinion about somebody/something

examples.en: Objective assessment of the severity of the problem was difficult.
examples.zh: 难以客观判定该问题的严重性。

examples.en: Needs assessment is crucial if the hospital is to deliver effective healthcare.
examples.zh: 医院要提供有效的医疗保健，需求评估是关键。

senses.def: the process of testing students and making a judgement about their knowledge, ability or progress

examples.en: written exams and other forms of assessment
examples.zh: 笔试及其他形式的考核

senses.def: an amount that has been calculated and that must be paid

examples.en: a tax assessment
examples.zh: 税款核定额

senses.def: an event where people applying for a job are given a number of tests and interviews to find out what their strengths and weaknesses are; the place where this happens
senses.zh: 求职评估；求职评估中心

examples.en: After the first interview you may be asked back for an assessment centre.
examples.zh: 第一次面试之后可能要求你回来接受求职评估。

examples.en: The book tells you how to prepare for an assessment center.
examples.zh: 这本书告诉您如何为评估中心做好准备。

examples.en: the assessment centre method
examples.zh: 评估中心法

senses.def: an expert in a particular subject who is asked by a court or other official group to give advice

examples.en: The government appointed independent assessors to review the viability of the remaining coal mines.
examples.zh: 政府任命了独立评估员来审查剩余煤矿的生存能力。

senses.def: a person who calculates the value or cost of something or the amount of money to be paid

examples.en: an insurance/tax assessor
examples.zh: 保险估价员；估税员

senses.def: a person who judges how well somebody has done in an exam, a competition, etc.
senses.zh: （考试、比赛等的）考核人，评判员

examples.en: College lecturers acted as external assessors of the exam results.
examples.zh: 学院讲师是考试成绩的校外考核人。

senses.def: a person or thing that is valuable or useful to somebody/something
senses.zh: 有价值的人（或事物）；有用的人（或事物）

examples.en: In his job, patience is an invaluable asset.
examples.zh: 他干的这份工作，耐心是无价之宝。

examples.en: Being able to speak a foreign language is a major asset.
examples.zh: 能够说外语是一项重要资产。

examples.en: I’m not sure if his forcefulness is an asset or a liability.
examples.zh: 我拿不准他的强势是长处还是短处。

examples.en: She'll be an asset to the team.
examples.zh: 她将是这个队的骨干。

senses.def: a thing of value, especially property, that a person or company owns, which can be used or sold to pay debts

examples.en: the net asset value of the company
examples.zh: 公司的资产净值

examples.en: Her assets include shares in the company and a house in France.
examples.zh: 她的财产包括公司的股份和在法国的一座房子。

examples.en: asset sales/management
examples.zh: 资产销售／管理

examples.en: income from fixed asset investments
examples.zh: 固定资产投资收入

examples.en: financial/capital assets
examples.zh: 金融／资本资产

examples.en: to freeze a country’s assets
examples.zh: 冻结一个国家的资产

senses.def: all of the assets
senses.zh: 个人或公司拥有的以及开展业务所必需的所有资产

examples.en: They have chosen to leverage their current asset base rather than make new capital expenditures.
examples.zh: 他们选择利用现有的资产基础，而不是进行新的资本支出。

senses.def: the practice of buying a company that is in financial difficulties at a low price and then selling everything that it owns in order to make a profit
senses.zh: 资产倒卖，资产拆卖（以低价购进公司，再将其资产出售，以获取利润）

senses.def: the anus
an offensive word for a person who you think is stupid or unpleasant
the quality of working very hard and taking great care that everything is done as well as it can be
senses.zh: 兢兢业业的；勤勤恳恳的

senses.def: working very hard and taking great care that everything is done as well as it can be
senses.zh: 兢兢业业的；勤勤恳恳的

examples.en: one of the most assiduous members of the team
examples.zh: 团队中最勤奋的成员之一

examples.en: their assiduous efforts and attention to detail
examples.zh: 他们的不懈努力和对细节的关注

examples.en: She was assiduous in her duties.
examples.zh: 她恪尽职守。

senses.def: in a way that involves working very hard and taking great care

examples.en: They worked assiduously to earn the money for their son’s education.
examples.zh: 他们勤奋工作，挣钱供儿子读书。

senses.def: to give somebody something that they can use, or some work or responsibility
senses.zh: 分配（某物）；分派，布置（工作、任务等）

examples.en: The teacher assigned a different task to each of the children.
examples.zh: 老师给每个孩子都布置了不同的作业。

examples.en: The two large classrooms have been assigned to us.
examples.zh: 这两间大教室分配给了我们。

examples.en: We have been assigned the two large classrooms.
examples.zh: 我们分得了这两间大教室。

examples.en: The teacher assigned each of the children a different task.
examples.zh: 老师给每个孩子都布置了不同的作业。

senses.def: to provide a person for a particular task or position

examples.en: They've assigned their best man to the job.
examples.zh: 他们指派了最优秀的人承担这项工作。

examples.en: Two senior officers have been assigned to the case.
examples.zh: 已经指派了两名高级警官去处理这个案子。

examples.en: British forces have been assigned to help with peacekeeping.
examples.zh: 英国军队被派遣协助维持和平。

senses.def: to send a person to work under the authority of somebody or in a particular group

examples.en: I was assigned to B platoon.
examples.zh: 我被派到 B 排工作。

examples.en: He was assigned to the Royal Canadian Navy in 1975.
examples.zh: 他于1975年被派遣到加拿大皇家海军工作。

senses.def: to say that something has a particular value or function, or happens at a particular time or place
senses.zh: 确定（价值、功能、时间、地点）

examples.en: Assign a different colour to each different type of information.
examples.zh: 给每类信息分别确定一种颜色。

examples.en: The painting cannot be assigned an exact date.
examples.zh: 这幅画的年代确定不了。

senses.def: to say that your property or rights now belong to somebody else

examples.en: The agreement assigns copyright to the publisher.
examples.zh: 协议规定将版权转让给出版商。

examples.en: She has assigned the lease to her daughter.
examples.zh: 她已将租约转让给她的女儿。

senses.def: to be said to have a particular gender
senses.zh: 当你出生时就被认为具有特定的性别

examples.en: They were assigned male at birth but identify as female.
examples.zh: 他们出生时被指定为男性，但被认定为女性。

senses.def: a meeting, especially a secret one, often for sexual or romantic reasons

examples.en: rumours about his secret assignations with a mystery woman
examples.zh: 关于他与一位神秘女子的秘密约会的谣言

senses.def: a task or piece of work that somebody is given to do, usually as part of their job or studies

examples.en: Students are required to complete all homework assignments.
examples.zh: 要求学生完成所有家庭作业。

examples.en: You will need to complete three written assignments per semester.
examples.zh: 你每学期要完成三个书面作业。

examples.en: a business/special assignment
examples.zh: 商业/特殊任务

examples.en: I had set myself a tough assignment.
examples.zh: 我给自己定了一项艰巨任务。

examples.en: She is in Greece on an assignment for a media company.
examples.zh: 她正在希腊为一家媒体公司执行任务。

examples.en: one of our reporters on assignment in China
examples.zh: 我们派驻中国的一名记者

senses.def: the act of giving something to somebody; the act of giving somebody a particular task

examples.en: his assignment to other duties in the same company
examples.zh: 他在同一公司内担任的其他职务

senses.def: to fully understand an idea or some information so that you are able to use it yourself

examples.en: The committee will need time to assimilate this report.
examples.zh: 委员会需要时间来吃透这个报告。

examples.en: Some people can only assimilate change gradually.
examples.zh: 有些人只能逐渐地适应变化。

senses.def: to become, or cause somebody to become, a part of a country or community rather than remaining in a separate group

examples.en: New arrivals feel the pressure to assimilate.
examples.zh: 新来者感受到了融入社会的压力。

examples.en: As a Chinese teen I tried to assimilate into Canadian culture.
examples.zh: 作为一名中国青少年，我试图融入加拿大文化。

examples.en: Over time different groups were assimilated into the community.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，不同的群体被同化到社区中。

senses.def: to make an idea, a person’s attitude, etc. fit into something or be acceptable
senses.zh: 使吸收，使接受（想法、态度等）

examples.en: These changes were gradually assimilated into everyday life.
examples.zh: 这些改变逐渐渗进了日常生活。

senses.def: the process of fully understanding an idea or some information so that you are able to use it yourself

examples.en: the rapid assimilation of new ideas
examples.zh: 对新思想的迅速吸收

senses.def: the process of becoming, or allowing somebody to become, a part of a country or community rather than remaining a separate group

examples.en: his assimilation into the community
examples.zh: 他融入社区

senses.def: the act of making two sounds in speech that are next to each other more similar to each other in certain ways, for example the pronunciation of the /
senses.zh: 同化（使相邻的两个音发音接近，如 football 中 /t/ 同化为 /p/ ）；同化现象

senses.def: to help somebody to do something

examples.en: Anyone willing to assist can contact this number.
examples.zh: 凡愿协助者可拨此号码联系。

examples.en: He assisted in the development of the business strategy.
examples.zh: 他协助制定了业务战略。

examples.en: We are looking for people who would be willing to assist in the group's work.
examples.zh: 我们正寻找愿意协助该团体工作的人。

examples.en: We'll do all we can to assist you.
examples.zh: 我们会尽量帮你。

examples.en: They will be ably assisted by our remarkable staff.
examples.zh: 他们将得到我们优秀员工的大力协助。

examples.en: The play was directed by Mike Johnson, assisted by Sharon Gale.
examples.zh: 该剧由迈克 · 约翰逊导演，沙伦 · 盖尔为助理导演。

examples.en: His task is to advise and assist his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他的任务是向同事提供建议和协助。

examples.en: We will assist you in finding somewhere to live.
examples.zh: 我们将帮你找个住的地方。

examples.en: Two men are assisting the police with their enquiries (= are being questioned by the police).
examples.zh: 有两个人正配合警方接受询问。

examples.en: The driver has been assisting police with their investigation.
examples.zh: 司机一直在协助警方调查。

examples.en: a course to assist adults to return to the labour market
examples.zh: 成人重返劳工市场的辅导班

senses.def: to help something to happen more easily

examples.en: activities that will assist the decision-making process
examples.zh: 促进决策进程的活动

senses.def: an action in ice hockey

examples.en: He had/made ten assists.
examples.zh: 他有十次助攻。

senses.def: an action in baseball in which a player throws the ball to another member of the team who gets an opponent out either by stepping onto the base before the runner reaches it, or by touching the runner with the ball before they reach the base
help or support

examples.en: technical/economic/military assistance
examples.zh: 技术／经济／军事援助

examples.en: financial assistance for people on low incomes
examples.zh: 给低收入者的经济援助

examples.en: Can I be of any assistance?
examples.zh: 我能帮上忙吗？

examples.en: Despite his cries, no one came to his assistance.
examples.zh: 尽管他喊叫，却没有人来帮助他。

examples.en: The other passengers went to her assistance.
examples.zh: 其他乘客过来帮她。

examples.en: He can only walk with the assistance of crutches.
examples.zh: 他靠拐杖才能走路。

examples.en: She offered me practical assistance with my research.
examples.zh: 她给我的研究提供了实实在在的援助。

examples.en: The company provides advice and assistance in finding work.
examples.zh: 公司提供就业咨询和帮助。

senses.def: a dog trained to help somebody who has a medical condition or disability

examples.en: Dogs are not allowed inside the cafe, with the exception of assistance dogs.
examples.zh: 除辅助犬外，咖啡馆禁止犬只入内。

senses.def: a person who helps or supports somebody, usually in their job

examples.en: My assistant will now demonstrate the machine in action.
examples.zh: 现在我的助手将演示机器运转情况。

examples.en: a senior research assistant
examples.zh: 高级研究助理

examples.en: I work part-time as a classroom assistant in my local primary school.
examples.zh: 我在本地小学兼职做课堂助教。

examples.en: She was working as a special assistant to the president.
examples.zh: 她当时担任总统的特别助理。

senses.def: a person whose job is to serve customers in a shop

examples.en: an assistant in a department store
examples.zh: 一名百货公司售货员

examples.en: Maybe one of our assistants can help you make your choice?
examples.zh: 也许我们的售货员能帮您挑选？

senses.def: a student at university or college who spends time in a foreign country teaching his or her own language in a school
senses.zh: 助教（在国外留学的大学生，教授本国语）

senses.def: having a rank below that of a senior person and helping them in their work

examples.en: the assistant manager/director/commissioner
examples.zh: 副经理；副总裁；助理专员

examples.en: She is an assistant professor of psychology at Ohio State University.
examples.zh: 她是俄亥俄州立大学的心理学助理教授。

examples.en: Assistant Chief Constable Owen
examples.zh: 助理警察局长欧文

examples.en: Assistant Attorney General William Weld
examples.zh: 助理总检察长威廉 · 韦尔德

examples.en: a former assistant Secretary of State
examples.zh: 前助理国务卿

examples.en: an assistant coach/editor
examples.zh: 助理教练/编辑

senses.def: (in the US and Canada) a teacher at a college or university who has a rank just below the rank of an associate professor
senses.zh: （美国和加拿大的）助理教授（职位比副教授低一级）

senses.def: the official name for a linesman
senses.zh: 助理裁判（边线裁判员的正式名称）

senses.def: the position of being an assistant
a paid position for a graduate student that involves some teaching or research
senses.zh: （研究生的）助教金职位，助研金职位

senses.def: a part of the country in which there are many unemployed people, and the government tries to encourage business and industry to employ more people, for example, by lending money to companies at low interest
senses.zh: 受援地区（英国失业者较多的地区，政府采取各种措施鼓励工商行业在当地雇用更多人员，如为公司提供低息贷款等）

examples.en: When the mines closed down the region was granted assisted area status.
examples.zh: 矿场倒闭后，该地区获批成为受援地区。

senses.def: the act of a person ending their life with the help of a doctor, because they are suffering from a disease that has no cure

examples.en: The Bill seeks to legalize the choice of assisted dying for terminally ill adults with less than six months to live.
examples.zh: 该法案旨在使生命不足六个月的绝症成年人选择安乐死合法化。

senses.def: accommodation for people who need help, for example with tasks like washing and dressing themselves

examples.en: assisted living apartments
examples.zh: 赡养公寓

examples.en: assisted living and other options for elderly people
examples.zh: 老年人的辅助生活和其他选择

senses.def: the act of a person killing himself/herself with the help of somebody such as a doctor, especially because he/she is suffering from a disease that has no cure
senses.zh: （假医生等他人之手的）辅助自杀，协助自杀

senses.def: connected with the assizes

examples.en: the assize court
examples.zh: 巡回法庭

senses.def: a court of law that travelled to each county of England and Wales
senses.zh: （英格兰和威尔士的）巡回审判

examples.en: He was tried and sentenced at the assizes.
examples.zh: 他在巡回法庭受审并被判刑。

senses.def: Association
Association
to make a connection between people or things in your mind

examples.en: I always associate the smell of baking with my childhood.
examples.zh: 一闻到烘烤食物的味道，我就想起了童年。

examples.en: He is closely associated in the public mind with horror movies.
examples.zh: 在公众的心目中，他总是和恐怖电影紧密联系在一起。

examples.en: Most people immediately associate addictions with drugs and alcohol.
examples.zh: 大多数人立即将成瘾与毒品和酒精联系起来。

examples.en: You wouldn’t normally associate these two writers—their styles are completely different.
examples.zh: 通常不会把这两位作家联系起来，他们的风格完全不同。

senses.def: to spend time with somebody, especially a person or people that somebody else does not approve of

examples.en: I don't like you associating with those people.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢你和那些人混在一起。

senses.def: to show that you support or agree with something

examples.en: I associate myself with the prime minister's remarks (= I agree with them).
examples.zh: 我赞同首相所言。

examples.en: I have never associated myself with political extremism.
examples.zh: 我从来不赞同政治上的极端主义。

senses.def: of a lower rank; having fewer rights in a particular profession or organization

examples.en: associate membership of the European Union
examples.zh: 欧洲联盟的非正式会员身份

examples.en: an associate member/director/editor
examples.zh: 准会员；副导演；副主编

examples.en: She was only the associate producer of the movie.
examples.zh: 她只是这部电影的副制片人。

senses.def: joined to or connected with a profession or an organization

examples.en: an associate company in Japan
examples.zh: 在日本的一家联营公司

senses.def: a person that you work with, do business with or spend a lot of time with

examples.en: business associates
examples.zh: 业务伙伴

examples.en: a close political associate of
examples.zh: 密切的政治伙伴

examples.en: The company is called Landor Associates.
examples.zh: 这家公司叫兰多联合公司。

examples.en: He was known to be one of the convicted man’s associates.
examples.zh: 据说他是这个罪犯的一个同伙。

senses.def: an associate
a person who has an Associate’s
senses.zh: 准学士（获得两年制高校学位）

senses.def: (in the US and Canada) a teacher at a college or university who has a rank just below the rank of a professor
senses.zh: （美国和加拿大的）副教授（职位比教授低一级）

senses.def: a degree given to somebody who has completed two years of study at a community college
senses.zh: 副学士学位，协士学位（完成社区学院的两年学业后颁发）

examples.en: an Associate's degree in nursing
examples.zh: 护理学副学士学位

associated society of locomotive enginee: @@@LINK=the associated society of locomotive engineers and firemen

senses.def: a US news service. Its offices throughout the world send news to its members which include newspapers and television and radio stations.
senses.zh: 美联社美国的一家通讯社。其遍布世界各地的分社采集新闻并发送给各个成员。该社成员包括多家报社、电视台和广播电台。

senses.def: an official group of people who have joined together for a particular purpose

examples.en: Do you belong to any professional or trade associations?
examples.zh: 你参加了专业学会或行业协会没有？

examples.en: a residents’ association
examples.zh: 居民联合会

examples.en: The association meets/meet four times a year.
examples.zh: 该协会每年召开四次会议。

senses.def: a connection or relationship between people or organizations

examples.en: They have maintained a close association with a college in the US.
examples.zh: 他们和美国一所学院保持了密切联系。

examples.en: his alleged association with terrorist groups
examples.zh: 他被指称的与恐怖组织的关联

examples.en: She became famous through her association with the group of poets.
examples.zh: 她通过与这些诗人交往而成名。

examples.en: The book was published in association with (= together with) English Heritage.
examples.zh: 这本书是与英国文化遗产保护协会联合出版的。

examples.en: The competition was organized in association with the Government's anti-drugs initiative.
examples.zh: 这项比赛是配合政府的禁毒行动而举办的。

examples.en: The letter was a clumsy attempt to establish guilt by association.
examples.zh: 这封信是试图通过关联来确定有罪的笨拙尝试。

senses.def: an idea or a memory that is suggested by somebody/something; a mental connection between ideas

examples.en: The seaside had all sorts of pleasant associations with childhood holidays for me.
examples.zh: 海滨使我联想起童年假期的各种愉快情景。

examples.en: The cat soon made the association between human beings and food.
examples.zh: 这只猫很快就把人类与食物联系起来。

examples.en: Incense always had associations with religion for him.
examples.zh: 对他来说，香总是与宗教联系在一起。

senses.def: a connection between things where one is caused by the other

examples.en: Studies have shown strong associations between housing conditions and health.
examples.zh: 研究表明居住条件和健康有密切的关系。

examples.en: a proven association between passive smoking and cancer
examples.zh: 已被证实的被动吸烟与癌症之间的因果关系

examples.en: The study found a significant association between exposure to electromagnetic fields and the disease.
examples.zh: 研究发现电磁场暴露与疾病之间存在显着关联。

examples.en: cases of cancer found in association with colitis
examples.zh: 已查明与结肠炎有关的癌症病例

senses.def: the formal name for football/soccer
the theory that we think and learn by connecting many different very simple ideas in our minds
senses.zh: （哲学或心理学中把思维或感觉的简单联想和共现作为意义、思维和学习的基础的）联想主义，联想说，观念联想论

senses.def: relating to the association of ideas or things

examples.en: making associative links
examples.zh: 建立关联链接

senses.def: giving the same result no matter in what order the parts of a problem are done, for example (a × b) × c = a × (b × c)
the effect created when two syllables in words that are close together have the same vowel sound, but different consonants, or the same consonants but different vowels, for example, sonnet
senses.zh: 准押韵，半谐韵，半谐音（靠得很近的单词中有两个音节元音相同而辅音不同，或辅音相同而元音不同）

senses.def: of various different sorts
senses.zh: 各种各样的；混杂的；什锦的

examples.en: The meat is served with salad or assorted vegetables.
examples.zh: 端上的肉配有色拉或什锦蔬菜。

examples.en: The jumper comes in assorted colours.
examples.zh: 各种颜色的针织套衫一应俱全。

examples.en: The children arrived back from the game with their assorted friends.
examples.zh: 孩子们和他们各色各样的朋友玩完游戏回来了。

examples.en: a box of assorted chocolates
examples.zh: 一盒什锦巧克力

senses.def: a collection of different things or of different types of the same thing

examples.en: a wide assortment of gifts to choose from
examples.zh: 各式各样可供挑选的礼品

examples.en: He was dressed in an odd assortment of clothes.
examples.zh: 他穿着奇装异服。

examples.en: an assortment of plates of varying sizes
examples.zh: 各种不同尺寸的盘子

senses.def: (in writing) assistant

examples.en: Asst Manager
examples.zh: 协理

senses.def: to make an unpleasant feeling less severe

examples.en: His reply did little to assuage my suspicions.
examples.zh: 他的回答并没有消除我的怀疑。

examples.en: to assuage your guilt/fears
examples.zh: 减轻你的内疚/恐惧

senses.def: to think or accept that something is true but without having proof of it

examples.en: It is reasonable to assume (that) the economy will continue to improve.
examples.zh: 认为经济将继续好转是有道理的。

examples.en: It's probably safe to assume (that) we'll be hearing more about this story.
examples.zh: 几乎可以肯定的是，我们会听到更多有关这个故事的消息。

examples.en: Let us assume for a moment that the plan succeeds.
examples.zh: 咱们暂时假设计划成功。

examples.en: She would, he assumed, be home at the usual time.
examples.zh: 他认为，她会在通常时间回到家的。

examples.en: It is generally assumed that stress is caused by too much work.
examples.zh: 普遍认为，紧张是工作过重所致。

examples.en: Don't always assume the worst (= that something bad has happened).
examples.zh: 别总往最坏处想。

examples.en: In this example we have assumed a unit price of $10.
examples.zh: 在这个例子中，我们已假定单价为 10 美元。

examples.en: I had assumed him to be a Belgian.
examples.zh: 我本以为他是比利时人。

senses.def: to take or begin to have power or responsibility
senses.zh: 承担（责任）；就（职）；取得（权力）

examples.en: Rebel forces have assumed control of the capital.
examples.zh: 反叛武装力量已控制了首都。

examples.en: The court assumed responsibility for the girl's welfare.
examples.zh: 法庭承担了保障这个女孩福利的责任。

examples.en: Goodman will assume the role of president.
examples.zh: 古德曼将担任总裁一职。

examples.en: Lynch assumed office in April.
examples.zh: 林奇于四月上任。

senses.def: to begin to have a particular quality or appearance
senses.zh: 呈现（外观、样子）；显露（特征）

examples.en: This matter has assumed considerable importance.
examples.zh: 这件事看来相当重要。

examples.en: In the story the god assumes the form of an eagle.
examples.zh: 在这个故事中神以鹰的形象出现。

senses.def: to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality

examples.en: He assumed an air of concern.
examples.zh: 他装出关心的样子。

examples.en: He had assumed a stage Southern accent.
examples.zh: 他佯装戏中的南方口音。

senses.def: a name that somebody uses that is not their real name

examples.en: He was living under an assumed name.
examples.zh: 他过着隐姓埋名的生活。

senses.def: a belief or feeling that something is true or that something will happen, although there is no proof

examples.en: an underlying/implicit assumption
examples.zh: 暗含的假定

examples.en: We need to challenge some of the basic assumptions of Western philosophy.
examples.zh: 我们有必要向西方哲学的某些基本假设提出质疑。

examples.en: We are working on the assumption that everyone invited will turn up.
examples.zh: 我们假定每一个人都会应邀出席并正就此作出安排。

examples.en: It was impossible to make assumptions about people's reactions.
examples.zh: 臆断人们的反应是不可能的。

examples.en: His actions were based on a false assumption.
examples.zh: 他的行为基于错误的设想。

examples.en: She arrived at college with a whole set of assumptions inherited from her family.
examples.zh: 她带着从家庭继承的一整套假设进入大学。

senses.def: the act of taking or beginning to have power or responsibility
senses.zh: （责任的）承担；担任；（权力的）获得

examples.en: their assumption of power/control
examples.zh: 他们权力／控制的取得

examples.en: the assumption of responsibility by the government for the disaster
examples.zh: 政府对灾难承担责任

senses.def: a statement that something will certainly be true or will certainly happen, particularly when there has been doubt about it

examples.en: They called for assurances that the government is committed to its education policy.
examples.zh: 他们要求政府保证切实执行其教育方针。

examples.en: Unemployment seems to be rising, despite repeated assurances to the contrary.
examples.zh: 尽管反复担保减少失业，失业率看来却在上升。

senses.def: belief in your own abilities or strengths

examples.en: There was an air of easy assurance about him.
examples.zh: 他表现得从容淡定。

examples.en: It was good to see some of her old assurance coming back.
examples.zh: 很高兴看到她以前的一些自信又回来了。

senses.def: a type of insurance in which money is paid out when somebody dies or after an agreed period of time

examples.en: a life assurance company
examples.zh: 人寿保险公司

examples.en: We bought a life assurance policy.
examples.zh: 我们购买了一份人寿保险单。

senses.def: to tell somebody that something is definitely true or is definitely going to happen, especially when they have doubts about it

examples.en: You think I did it deliberately, but I assure you (that) I did not.
examples.zh: 你认为这是我故意干的，不过我向你保证不是的。

examples.en: Let me assure you that I will try to help you.
examples.zh: 我向你保证，我会尽力帮你。

examples.en: We were assured that everything possible was being done.
examples.zh: 我们得到保证说，正在尽一切努力。

examples.en: She's perfectly safe, I can assure you.
examples.zh: 我可以向你保证，她绝对安全。

examples.en: We assured him of our support.
examples.zh: 我们向他保证给予支持。

examples.en: I won’t let you down, I can assure you of that.
examples.zh: 我不会让你失望，我可以向你保证。

examples.en: ‘He'll come back,’ Susan assured her.
examples.zh: “他会回来的。”苏珊安慰她道。

senses.def: to make yourself certain about something

examples.en: He assured himself of her safety.
examples.zh: 他确定她是安全的。

examples.en: She assured herself that the letter was still in the drawer.
examples.zh: 她查清楚信仍然在抽屉里。

senses.def: to make something certain to happen

examples.en: Victory would assure a place in the finals.
examples.zh: 胜利将确保能参加决赛。

examples.en: Victory would assure them a place in the finals.
examples.zh: 获胜后他们就能参加决赛。

examples.en: This achievement has assured her a place in the history books.
examples.zh: 这一成就确定了她将在史册中留名。

senses.def: to insure

examples.en: What is the sum assured?
examples.zh: 人寿保险额是多少？

senses.def: certainly; definitely

examples.en: Their attempts will most assuredly fail.
examples.zh: 他们的尝试肯定会失败。

a chemical element. Astatine

senses.def: a place or an activity that is very popular or fashionable
senses.zh: 盛大活动（场合）；流行活动（地方）

examples.en: Judging by the crowds waiting to get in, this seems to be where it's at.
examples.zh: 从等待入场的人群来看，这好像是个盛大活动。

senses.def: used when you are giving an extra piece of information

examples.en: He managed to buy a car after all—and a nice one at that.
examples.zh: 他终于设法买了一辆小轿车，而且还挺不错的。

senses.def: to be doing something, especially something bad

examples.en: Look at all that graffiti—those kids have been at it again.
examples.zh: 瞧，那么多涂鸦，又是那些孩子干的好事。

senses.def: a place or an activity that is very popular or fashionable
senses.zh: 盛大活动（场合）；流行活动（地方）

examples.en: Judging by the crowds waiting to get in, this seems to be where it's at.
examples.zh: 从等待入场的人群来看，这好像是个盛大活动。

senses.def: after much delay, effort, etc.; in the end
senses.zh: （经过长时间的延误或努力等之后）终于，最终

examples.en: At last we're home!
examples.zh: 我们终于到家了！

examples.en: At long last the package arrived.
examples.zh: 包裹终于送到了。

senses.def: used for saying what is the worst thing that can happen
senses.zh: （指可能出现的最坏情况）往最坏处说，充其量

examples.en: At the very worst, he'll have to pay a fine.
examples.zh: 最坏的情况是，他得交罚款。

examples.en: At worst this may mean the end of her playing career.
examples.zh: 在最坏的情况下，这可能意味着她职业生涯的结束。

examples.en: At worst, the drug can be fatal.
examples.zh: 在最坏的情况下，这种毒品可以致命。

senses.def: relaxed and confident and not nervous or embarrassed
senses.zh: 舒适；自由自在；无拘无束

examples.en: I never feel completely at ease with him.
examples.zh: 我跟他在一起总感到不是很自在。

examples.en: She was at her ease straight away in the new job.
examples.zh: 她很快就适应了新工作。

senses.def: with time between

examples.en: Buses to the city leave at regular intervals.
examples.zh: 开往城里的公共汽车每隔一定时间发出一班。

examples.en: The runners started at 5-minute intervals.
examples.zh: 赛跑的人每隔 5 分钟出发一批。

senses.def: with spaces between

examples.en: Flaming torches were positioned at intervals along the terrace.
examples.zh: 沿排房每隔一段距离插着燃烧着的火炬。

examples.en: The flags were spaced at two-metre intervals.
examples.zh: 旗帜的间隔为两米。

senses.def: fast; at a high speed
immediately; with only a quick look

examples.en: He could tell at a glance what was wrong.
examples.zh: 他一眼就看出了问题所在。

examples.en: The software allows you to see at a glance what fonts you have on the computer.
examples.zh: 这个软件让你一看便知道你电脑上有些什么字体。

senses.def: with a single immediate action

examples.en: They threatened to cancel the whole project at a stroke.
examples.zh: 他们威胁要一下子砍掉整个项目。

examples.en: They lost half their fortune at a stroke.
examples.zh: 他们一下子就失去了一半财产。

at a (single) stroke | at one stroke.word: at a (single) stroke | at one stroke

at a fast clip: @@@LINK=at a fast, good, steady, etc. clip

senses.def: quickly

examples.en: Land prices will rise at a healthy clip.
examples.zh: 土地价格将稳步上涨。

at a fast, good, steady, etc. clip.word: at a fast, good, steady, etc. clip

at a go: @@@LINK=at/in a single go | at a/one go
at a good clip: @@@LINK=at a fast, good, steady, etc. clip

senses.def: having nothing to do and not knowing what you want to do

examples.en: Come and see us, if you're at a loose end.
examples.zh: 你要是闲着无事就来我们这儿坐坐吧。

senses.def: not knowing what to say or do

examples.en: His comments left me at a loss for words.
examples.zh: 他的评论让我不知说什么才好。

examples.en: I'm at a loss what to do next.
examples.zh: 我对下一步做什么心里没谱。

examples.en: We are at a loss to understand his actions.
examples.zh: 我们对他的行动迷惑不解。

senses.def: in a way that loses you money

examples.en: We are now operating at a loss.
examples.zh: 我们现在是亏本经营。

senses.def: in a poor state; worse than usual

examples.en: Morale among teachers is at a low ebb.
examples.zh: 教师的精神面貌不佳。

at a moment's notice: @@@LINK=at short notice | at a moment’s notice

senses.def: used to say that something could be done or used in a particular situation if it is really necessary

examples.en: We can get six people round this table at a pinch.
examples.zh: 必要时，这张桌子可以坐六个人。

examples.en: The recipe is for beef, but at a pinch you could use chicken.
examples.zh: 食谱是牛肉，但必要时你也可以用鸡肉。

senses.def: if something is at a premium

examples.en: Space is at a premium in a one-bedroomed apartment.
examples.zh: 单居室公寓的空间是很有限的。

examples.en: Good student accommodation is at a premium.
examples.zh: 舒适的学生住处费用昂贵。

senses.def: at a higher than normal price

examples.en: Shares are selling at a premium.
examples.zh: 这种股票以高于面值的价格出售。

senses.def: costing a lot of money

examples.en: You can buy strawberries all year round, but at a price.
examples.zh: 草莓一年到头都买得到，不过很贵。

examples.en: Food is available, at a price.
examples.zh: 食物可以买到，不过出价要高。

senses.def: involving something unpleasant

examples.en: He'll help you—at a price!
examples.zh: 他会帮助你的，但要付出代价！

senses.def: used to say that something is possible, but only with difficulty

examples.en: We can provide accommodation for six people at a push.
examples.zh: 我们勉强可以安排六个人住宿。

senses.def: very quickly

examples.en: She's getting through her winnings at a rate of knots.
examples.zh: 她正在以节数的速度花完她的奖金。

at a single go: @@@LINK=at/in a single go | at a/one go

senses.def: very slowly

examples.en: Traffic had slowed to a snail’s pace.
examples.zh: 车流速度太慢了，像蜗牛在爬。

at a steady clip: @@@LINK=at a fast, good, steady, etc. clip
at a tender age: @@@LINK=at a tender age | at the tender age of…

senses.def: used in connection with somebody who is still young and does not have much experience
senses.zh: 在少不更事的…岁时；在不谙世故的…岁上

examples.en: He left home at the tender age of 15.
examples.zh: 他 15 岁离家，还少不更事。

examples.en: She shouldn't be having to deal with problems like this at such a tender age.
examples.zh: 她小小年纪涉世未深，实在不必应对这样的问题。

at a tender age | at the tender age of….word: at a tender age | at the tender age of…

senses.def: separately or in groups of two, three, etc. on each occasion

examples.en: We had to go and see the principal one at a time.
examples.zh: 我们得逐一去见校长。

examples.en: She ran up the stairs two at a time.
examples.zh: 她一步两阶地跑上楼梯。

examples.en: He surfs the internet for hours at a time.
examples.zh: 他一次在网上待好几个小时。

at a/one go: @@@LINK=at/in a single go | at a/one go

senses.def: in one single attempt or try

examples.en: She blew out the candles at one go.
examples.zh: 她一口气把蜡烛全吹灭了。

at a/one go | at/in a single go.word: at a/one go | at/in a single go

senses.def: at an important point in somebody’s life or development
senses.zh: （人生或发展）处于关键时刻，在紧要关头

examples.en: We are standing at an important crossroads in the history of Europe.
examples.zh: 我们正处于欧洲历史的紧要关头。

examples.en: I knew I was at the crossroads of my career.
examples.zh: 我知道我的事业处在一个十字路口。

senses.def: whatever is needed to achieve something

examples.en: You must stop the press from finding out at all costs.
examples.zh: 你必须不惜一切代价阻止媒体查明真相。

senses.def: always

examples.en: Our representatives are ready to help you at all times.
examples.zh: 我们的代表随时准备帮助你。

examples.en: Hot water is available at all times.
examples.zh: 随时都有热水。

senses.def: very early, especially when this is annoying

examples.en: The job involved getting up at some unearthly hour to catch the first train.
examples.zh: 这工作需要起大早赶头班火车。

senses.def: very early or very late and therefore annoying
senses.zh: 一大早（或很晚）；在十分不便的时间

examples.en: I apologize for calling you at this ungodly hour.
examples.zh: 原谅我这种时候给你打电话。

senses.def: under any circumstances
senses.zh: 在任何情况下；无论如何

examples.en: He is determined to win at any cost.
examples.zh: 他决心无论如何要争取胜利。

senses.def: whatever the cost or the difficulties may be
senses.zh: 不惜任何代价；无论如何

examples.en: We want peace at any price.
examples.zh: 为了争取和平，我们不惜任何代价。

senses.def: used to say that a particular fact is true despite what has happened in the past or what may happen in the future
senses.zh: （强调事情的真实性）无论如何，不管怎样

examples.en: Well, that's one good piece of news at any rate.
examples.zh: 不管怎么说，那是个好消息。

examples.en: I may be away on business next week but at any rate I'll be back by Friday.
examples.zh: 我下周可能要出差，但无论如何，我最晚星期五回来。

senses.def: used to show that you are being more accurate about something that you have just said
senses.zh: （表示说得更加确切）不管怎样，至少

examples.en: He said he'll be coming tomorrow. At any rate, I think that's what he said.
examples.zh: 他说他明天要来。至少，我认为他是这么说的。

senses.def: used to show that what you have just said is not as important as what you are going to say

examples.en: There were maybe 60 or 70 people there. At any rate, the room was packed.
examples.zh: 那里也许有六七十人吧。反正屋子里挤得严严实实。

senses.def: trying to hit the ball with a bat

examples.en: It's his first time at bat in the major leagues.
examples.zh: 这是他第一次在大联盟中击球。

senses.def: when an animal that is being hunted is at bay
senses.zh: （猎物）被围困，被迫作困兽之斗

senses.def: used to say what somebody/something is really like
senses.zh: 归根结底；本质上；实际上

examples.en: Their offer to help was at bottom self-centred.
examples.zh: 他们提出要帮忙，这其实还是他们为自己考虑。

senses.def: for only the amount of money that is needed to make or get something, without any profit being added on

examples.en: goods sold at cost
examples.zh: 按成本价销售的商品

senses.def: if two people are at daggers drawn
so ill that you may die

examples.en: I suppose you won’t be coming to the party if you’re at death’s door!
examples.zh: 我想如果你快要死了，你就不会来参加聚会了！

senses.def: everywhere or every time you try and do something

examples.en: At every turn I met with disappointment.
examples.zh: 我事事都不顺心。

examples.en: Her ideas were blocked at every turn.
examples.zh: 她的想法处处受阻。

senses.def: at or in the beginning

examples.en: I didn't like the job much at first.
examples.zh: 起初我并不很喜欢这个工作。

examples.en: At first I thought he was shy, but then I discovered he was just not interested in other people.
examples.zh: 起先我以为他腼腆，后来才发现他就是对别人没兴趣。

examples.en: If at first you don't succeed, try, try again.
examples.zh: 一次不成功就反复尝试。

senses.def: when you first look at or think about something, often rather quickly

examples.en: At first glance the problem seemed easy.
examples.zh: 乍一看问题似乎很简单。

examples.en: At first glance the contract seemed to be fine.
examples.zh: 乍一看，这合同似乎很好。

senses.def: when you first begin to consider something

examples.en: At first sight, it may look like a generous offer, but always read the small print.
examples.zh: 乍一看，对方给出的条件好像很优厚，但任何时候都不要小看那些小号字印刷的附加条款。

senses.def: when you see somebody/something for the first time

examples.en: It was love at first sight (= we fell in love the first time we saw each other).
examples.zh: 我们一见钟情。

examples.en: We fell in love with the house at first sight.
examples.zh: 我们第一眼看到这所房子就爱上了它。

examples.en: He looked at first sight like a tourist.
examples.zh: 乍一看他像是个游客。

senses.def: using as much energy as possible, or the greatest possible amount of supplies
senses.zh: 竭尽全力；以最大财力物力

examples.en: Fire crews have been operating at full stretch.
examples.zh: 各消防队一直在全力以赴。

senses.def: as fast as possible; with as much power or energy as possible
senses.zh: 全速；开足马力；全力以赴

examples.en: He drove along at full throttle.
examples.zh: 他全速驾车行驶。

examples.en: The campaign is continuing to run at full throttle.
examples.zh: 这场运动继续全力进行。

senses.def: while threatening somebody or being threatened with a gun
senses.zh: 用枪威胁；在枪口威胁下

examples.en: The driver was robbed at gunpoint.
examples.zh: 司机遭持枪抢劫。

senses.def: flown at the middle of the mast
senses.zh: 降半旗，下半旗（以示哀悼）

examples.en: Flags were flown at half mast on the day of his funeral.
examples.zh: 在他葬礼那天降了半旗。

at hands: @@@LINK=at the hands of somebody | at somebody’s hands

senses.def: used to say what somebody is really like even though they may seem to be something different

examples.en: He's still a socialist at heart.
examples.zh: 他本质上还是个社会主义者。

at his time of life: @@@LINK=at my, your, his, etc. time of life

senses.def: in a person’s own house, flat, etc.

examples.en: I called round last night, but you weren't at home.
examples.zh: 我昨晚去你家了，但你不在家。

examples.en: Oh no, I left my purse at home.
examples.zh: 糟了，我把钱包落在家里了。

examples.en: He lived at home (= with his parents) until he was thirty.
examples.zh: 他一直和父母同住到三十岁。

senses.def: comfortable and relaxed

examples.en: Sit down and make yourself at home.
examples.zh: 坐下，别拘束。

examples.en: Simon feels very at home on a horse.
examples.zh: 西蒙骑马得心应手。

senses.def: in somebody’s own country, not in a foreign country

examples.en: The president is not as popular at home as he is abroad.
examples.zh: 总统在国内不如在国外受欢迎。

senses.def: if a sports team plays at home

examples.en: Leeds are playing at home this weekend.
examples.zh: 本周末利兹队将在主场进行比赛。

examples.en: Is the match on Saturday at home or away?
examples.zh: 星期六的比赛是在主场还是在客场？

senses.def: while being threatened, or threatening somebody, with a knife

examples.en: She was robbed at knifepoint.
examples.zh: 她遭持刀抢劫。

senses.def: as a whole; in general

examples.en: the opinion of the public at large
examples.zh: 普通大众的意见

senses.def: not captured; free

examples.en: Her killer is still at large.
examples.zh: 杀害她的凶手仍然逍遥法外。

senses.def: with no particular activities; free

examples.en: Spend the afternoon at leisure in the town centre.
examples.zh: 下午到城中心区去玩吧。

senses.def: without hurrying

examples.en: Let's have lunch so we can talk at leisure.
examples.zh: 咱们吃午饭吧，边吃边谈。

senses.def: for a long time and in detail

examples.en: He quoted at length from the report.
examples.zh: 他大段大段地引用报告中的话。

examples.en: We have already discussed this matter at great length.
examples.zh: 我们已经十分详尽地讨论了这个问题。

examples.en: She told me at length about her new job.
examples.zh: 她详细地告诉我她的新工作。

senses.def: after a long time

examples.en: ‘I'm still not sure,’ he said at length.
examples.zh: “我还是没把握。”他最后说道。

senses.def: no longer in prison or in a cage

examples.en: The escaped prisoner has been at liberty for five days.
examples.zh: 囚犯已逃脱在外5 天。

senses.def: having the right or freedom to do something

examples.en: You are at liberty to say what you like.
examples.zh: 你尽可畅所欲言。

examples.en: I am not at liberty to discuss my client’s case.
examples.zh: 我无权讨论我委托人的案件。

senses.def: in strong disagreement

examples.en: The two governments are still at loggerheads over the island.
examples.zh: 两国政府依然对这个岛的归属问题争执不下。

senses.def: after a long time

examples.en: At long last his prayers had been answered.
examples.zh: 他的祷告终于应验了。

at my time of life: @@@LINK=at my, your, his, etc. time of life

senses.def: at the age you are (especially when you are not young)
senses.zh: 在…这样的年纪（尤指不年轻时）

examples.en: Eyesight doesn't get any better at my time of life.
examples.zh: 到我这把年纪，视力绝不会变好的。

at my, your, his, etc. time of life.word: at my, your, his, etc. time of life

senses.def: immediately; without delay

examples.en: Come here at once!
examples.zh: 马上到这里来！

senses.def: at the same time

examples.en: Don't all speak at once!
examples.zh: 大家不要同时讲！

examples.en: I can't do two things at once.
examples.zh: 我不能同时做两件事。

at one go: @@@LINK=at/in a single go | at a/one go

senses.def: without deciding in advance what is going to happen, or without any regular pattern

examples.en: She opened the book at random (= not at any particular page) and started reading.
examples.zh: 她随意翻开书就看了起来。

examples.en: The terrorists fired into the crowd at random.
examples.zh: 恐怖分子胡乱地向人群开枪。

examples.en: Names were chosen at random from a list.
examples.zh: 名字是从名单中随便点的。

senses.def: not moving

examples.en: At rest the insect looks like a dead leaf.
examples.zh: 这种昆虫不动时看上去像一片枯叶。

senses.def: dead and therefore free from trouble or worry. People say ‘
senses.zh: （委婉说法，与 dead 同义）安息，长眠

examples.en: She now lies at rest in the churchyard.
examples.zh: 她现在长眠在教堂墓地里。

senses.def: in danger of something unpleasant or harmful happening

examples.en: As with all diseases, certain groups will be more at risk than others.
examples.zh: 所有的疾病都是如此，一些群体比另一些群体更容易受到威胁。

examples.en: If we go to war, innocent lives will be put at risk.
examples.zh: 如果我们发动战争，无辜的生命就会受到威胁。

examples.en: Journalists in the zone are at serious risk of being kidnapped.
examples.zh: 该地区的记者有被绑架的严重危险。

examples.en: Adults were also at risk from epidemics.
examples.zh: 成年人也面临流行病的风险。

senses.def: with the possibility of harming yourself/somebody/something

examples.en: He dived in to save the dog at considerable risk to his own life.
examples.zh: 他冒着相当大的生命危险跳到水里去救那只狗。

examples.en: He saved the child at considerable risk to himself.
examples.zh: 他自己冒着相当大的生命危险救了那个孩子。

at sb's hands: @@@LINK=at the hands of somebody | at somebody’s hands
at sb's service: @@@LINK=at the service of somebody/something | at somebody’s service

senses.def: on the sea, especially in a ship, or in the sea
senses.zh: 在海上（尤指乘船）；在海里

examples.en: It happened on the second night at sea.
examples.zh: 事情发生在出海后的第二天夜里。

examples.en: They were lost at sea.
examples.zh: 他们在海上迷失了方向。

senses.def: confused and not knowing what to do

examples.en: I'm all at sea with these new regulations.
examples.zh: 我全然不懂这些新的规章。

at service: @@@LINK=at the service of somebody/something | at somebody’s service
at short notice: @@@LINK=at short notice | at a moment’s notice

senses.def: not long in advance; without warning or time for preparation
senses.zh: 随时；一经通知立即；没有准备时间

examples.en: This was the best room we could get at such short notice.
examples.zh: 这是我们临时能弄到的最好的房间了。

examples.en: You must be ready to leave at a moment's notice.
examples.zh: 你必须随时准备出发。

at short notice | at a moment’s notice.word: at short notice | at a moment’s notice

senses.def: in a confused state; not well organized

examples.en: I haven't had time to clear up, so I'm all at sixes and sevens.
examples.zh: 我还没来得及清理，所以我心乱如麻。

at somebody's hands: @@@LINK=at the hands of somebody | at somebody’s hands
at somebody's service: @@@LINK=at the service of somebody/something | at somebody’s service

senses.def: always ready to obey somebody’s orders

examples.en: He is constantly at the beck and call of his invalid father.
examples.zh: 他总是听从他生病的父亲的指挥。

examples.en: Don't expect to have me at your beck and call.
examples.zh: 休想随意摆布我。

senses.def: because somebody has ordered or requested it

examples.en: at the King’s behest/at the behest of the King
examples.zh: 奉谕旨。

senses.def: at a time or a place that is suitable for somebody
senses.zh: 在（某人）方便时；在（某人）适宜的地点

examples.en: Can you telephone me at your convenience to arrange a meeting?
examples.zh: 你能不能在你方便时给我来个电话，安排见一次面？

senses.def: according to what somebody decides or wishes to do
senses.zh: 由某人斟酌决定；按照某人的意愿

examples.en: Bail is granted at the discretion of the court.
examples.zh: 由法庭决定准予保释。

examples.en: There is no service charge and tipping is at your discretion.
examples.zh: 不收服务费，给不给小费由你自行决定。

senses.def: paid for by somebody
senses.zh: 由某人付钱；由某人负担费用

examples.en: We were taken out for a meal at the company's expense.
examples.zh: 公司出钱请我们外出就餐。

senses.def: if you make a joke at somebody’s expense

examples.zh: 她怀疑有些秘密势力在作祟。
