senses.zh: 巴卡拉纸牌游戏，百家乐（玩牌者手持两张或三张纸牌，赌谁的点数被十除后余数最大）

senses.def: wild and involving large amounts of alcohol

examples.en: a bacchanalian orgy
examples.zh: 狂饮作乐的闹宴

senses.def: tobacco
a small holiday house
a child or young person
a man who has never been married

examples.en: an eligible bachelor (= one that many people want to marry, especially because he is rich)
examples.zh: 合意单身男子（尤因富有而为理想对象）

examples.en: a confirmed bachelor (= a man who does not intend to marry)
examples.zh: 信守独身主义的单身汉（报章上常用来指同性恋男子）

examples.en: He was 38, and a confirmed bachelor.
examples.zh: 他 38 岁了，是个独身主义者。

examples.en: one of the country’s most eligible bachelors
examples.zh: 全国最让人中意的单身汉之一

senses.def: a person who has a Bachelor’s

examples.en: a Bachelor of Arts/Engineering/Science
examples.zh: 文学士；工程学士；理学士

senses.def: a small apartment suitable for a person living alone
a small apartment suitable for a person living alone
an independent young woman who is not married
senses.zh: 独立生活的年轻女子；单身女子

senses.def: a house or flat in which a man who is not married enjoys a lifestyle without family responsibilities
senses.zh: 单身男子的窝；单身男子公寓；单身汉公寓

senses.def: a party that a man has with his (usually male) friends just before he gets married
senses.zh: （婚礼前夕为新郎举行，只有男性朋友参加的）告别单身聚会

senses.def: the first degree that you get when you study at a university. Bachelor's degrees include Bachelor of Arts (BA
senses.zh: 学士学位：在大学学习时获得的第一个学位。学士学位包括文学学士（BA）和理学学士（BSc）。

senses.def: a young woman who is not married
senses.zh: 少女；年轻姑娘；未婚年轻女子

senses.def: a party that a woman has with her (usually female) friends just before she gets married
senses.zh: 婚礼前夕为新娘举行，只有女性朋友参加的）告别单身聚会

senses.def: the time in a man’s life when he has never been married
a type of bacteria. There are several types of bacillus
the part of the human body that is on the opposite side to the chest, between the neck and the tops of the legs; the part of an animal’s body that corresponds

examples.en: He was lying on his back on the sofa.
examples.zh: 他仰面躺在沙发上。

examples.en: Do you sleep on your back or your front?
examples.zh: 你睡觉是仰着还是趴着？

examples.en: She was standing with her back to the camera so you can't see her face.
examples.zh: 她当时背对摄像机站着，所以你看不到她的脸。

examples.en: They stood with their hands behind their backs.
examples.zh: 他们背着手站着。

examples.en: They set off with the wind at their backs (= behind them).
examples.zh: 他们乘着风出发了。

examples.en: your lower/upper back
examples.zh: 你的下／上背部

examples.en: I have a nagging pain in my lower back.
examples.zh: 我后腰老是疼。

examples.en: The ball hit him in the back.
examples.zh: 球击中了他的背部。

examples.en: a bad (= painful) back
examples.zh: 背痛

examples.en: I pulled (= injured the muscles in) my back playing squash.
examples.zh: 我打壁球时拉伤了背部肌肉。

examples.en: She was laid up with severe back pain.
examples.zh: 她因严重的背痛而卧床不起。

examples.en: A small boy rode on the elephant's back.
examples.zh: 一个小男孩骑在大象背上。

senses.group: part of body 身体部位

senses.def: the row of bones in the middle of the back

examples.en: She broke her back in a riding accident.
examples.zh: 她在一次骑马事故中摔断了脊梁骨。

examples.en: He spent six months recovering from a broken back.
examples.zh: 他脊柱骨折，花了六个月时间康复。

examples.en: He put his back out (= dislocated something in his back) lifting the crates.
examples.zh: 他搬大木箱时脊椎脱了臼。

senses.group: part of body 身体部位

senses.def: the part or area of something that is furthest from the front

examples.en: She was hit on the back of the head.
examples.zh: 她的后脑部被击中。

examples.en: He kicked the ball straight into the back of the net.
examples.zh: 他把球直接踢进了网窝。

examples.en: The man was refusing to go to the back of the queue.
examples.zh: 那个人拒绝到后面排队。

examples.en: The house has three bedrooms at the front and two at the back.
examples.zh: 房屋正面有三间卧室，后面两间。

examples.en: We could only get seats at the back (= of a room).
examples.zh: 我们只能找到后排的座位。

examples.en: There's room for three people in the back (= of a car, etc.).
examples.zh: 后排的空间可容三人。

examples.en: There's room for three people in back.
examples.zh: 后排的空间可容三人。

examples.en: Come around the back (= to the area behind the house) and I'll show you the garden.
examples.zh: 到房子后面来，我带你看看花园。

senses.group: part furthest from front 后部

senses.def: the part of a piece of paper, etc. that is on the opposite side to the one that has information or the most important information on it

examples.en: Take a card and write your name on the back.
examples.zh: 拿一张卡片，在背面写上你的名字。

examples.en: He scribbled some figures on the back of an envelope.
examples.zh: 他在信封背面潦草地写了一些数字。

senses.group: of piece of paper 纸张

senses.def: the last few pages of a book, etc.

examples.en: The index is at the back of the journal.
examples.zh: 索引位于日记的背面。

examples.en: The answer key is in the back of the book.
examples.zh: 答案就在书的后面。

examples.en: The article I mentioned is in that magazine—towards the back I think.
examples.zh: 我提到的那篇文章是在那本杂志上的——我想是在背面。

examples.en: The arts page is usually towards the back of the newspaper.
examples.zh: 艺术版通常排在报纸的后几版。

senses.def: the part of a chair, etc. against which you lean your back
used to describe furniture that has the type of back

examples.en: a high-backed sofa
examples.zh: 高靠背沙发

senses.def: a player whose main role is to defend their team’s goal
if a thought, etc. is at the back of your mind

examples.en: At the back of my mind was a small, warning voice, telling me it was wrong.
examples.zh: 我的脑海深处有一个微小的警告声音，告诉我这是错误的。

examples.en: The problem was always at the back of my mind.
examples.zh: 这个问题我一直记着。

senses.def: when somebody's back is turned

examples.en: Officers are ready to issue a parking ticket as soon as a driver's back is turned.
examples.zh: 违规停车的司机一旦离开车辆，执法人员就随时准备开出罚单。

senses.def: a place that is a long way from other houses, towns, etc.

examples.en: We stayed in some farmhouse in the back of beyond.
examples.zh: 我们住在后面的一些农舍里。

senses.def: used to talk about planning or calculating something in a way that is not detailed, exact or complete

examples.en: We added up our savings on the back of an envelope.
examples.zh: 我们把我们的积蓄写在信封背面。

examples.en: back-of-the-envelope calculations
examples.zh: 粗略计算

senses.def: if two people stand or sit back to back

examples.en: The children sat back to back so they couldn't see each others' drawings.
examples.zh: 孩子背对背坐着， 以免看见彼此的画。

senses.def: if two or more things happen back to back

examples.en: The team had to play three games back to back.
examples.zh: 该队不得不连续进行三场比赛。

senses.def: if you put on a piece of clothing back to front

examples.en: I think you've got that sweater on back to front.
examples.zh: 我觉得你把毛衣前后穿反了。

senses.def: to be happy that you will not have to deal with or see somebody/something again because you do not like them or it
senses.zh: 庆幸终于摆脱（不喜欢的人或事物）

examples.en: Was I pleased to see the back of her!
examples.zh: 真高兴不会再见到她了！

examples.en: I can’t wait to see the back of that old car.
examples.zh: 我迫不及待地想把那辆旧车处理掉。

senses.def: without somebody’s knowledge or permission

examples.en: Have you been talking about me behind my back?
examples.zh: 你们是不是在背后说我的闲话？

examples.en: They went ahead and sold it behind my back.
examples.zh: 他们径自背着我把它卖了。

examples.en: People say bad things about him behind his back, but never to his face.
examples.zh: 人们在背后说他的坏话，但从不当面说。

senses.def: to keep asking or telling somebody to do something that they do not want to do, in a way that they find annoying

examples.en: He’s still on my back about that money I borrowed.
examples.zh: 他还在为我借的那笔钱纠缠不休。

senses.def: to finish the largest or most important part of a task
senses.zh: 完成（任务等的）主要部分

examples.en: I want to break the back of this translation before the weekend.
examples.zh: 我想在周末之前把这篇翻译做完。

senses.def: to realize that you may be blamed or criticized for something later and take action to avoid this
senses.zh: 粉饰污点；防止可预见的指责

examples.en: Get everything in writing in order to cover your back.
examples.zh: 一切都要立字为据，以绝后患。

senses.def: to annoy somebody

examples.en: That sort of attitude really gets my back up!
examples.zh: 那种态度实在叫我恼火！

senses.def: to stop annoying somebody, for example by criticizing them, or asking them to do something
senses.zh: 不再烦扰某人（如停止批评或缠磨等）

examples.en: Just get off my back, will you!
examples.zh: 请别烦我了好吗！

senses.def: to protect and support somebody

examples.en: Don't worry, I've got your back.
examples.zh: 别担心，我支持你。

examples.en: I’m loyal and I’ve got your back.
examples.zh: 我很忠诚，我会支持你。

senses.def: to be in a difficult situation in which you are forced to do something but are unable to make the choices that you would like
senses.zh: 处于背水一战的境地；没有退路

examples.en: We had our backs to the wall with no choice but to sell.
examples.zh: 我们别无选择，只能卖掉。

senses.def: to be aware of everything that is happening around you, even things that seem difficult or impossible to see
senses.zh: 脑后长眼；眼光敏锐；什么都能觉察到

examples.en: You can’t get away with anything in her class. She has eyes in the back of her head.
examples.zh: 在她的课堂上你无法逃脱任何惩罚。她的后脑勺长着眼睛。

senses.def: to be very familiar with somebody/something

examples.en: This is where I grew up. I know this area like the back of my hand.
examples.zh: 我在这儿长大的，我对这地方再熟悉不过了。

senses.def: the last in a series of bad events, etc. that makes it impossible for you to accept a situation any longer
senses.zh: 压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草；终于使人不堪忍受的最后一件事（或因素等）

senses.def: to do something that will cause problems for you in the future
immediately after something

examples.en: They come into this game off the back of a 1–0 defeat to Chelsea.
examples.zh: 他们刚以 0 比 1 输给切尔西队就去参加这场比赛。

senses.def: as a result of an achievement or a success

examples.en: The profits growth came on the back of a 26 per cent rise in sales.
examples.zh: 利润增长来自 26% 的销售额增长。

senses.def: goods that fell off the back of a lorry
in bed because you are ill

examples.en: She's been flat on her back for over a week now.
examples.zh: 她卧病有一个多星期了。

examples.en: The UK market was flat on its back (= business was very bad).
examples.zh: （当时）英国的市场十分不景气。

senses.def: praise or approval for something that you have done well

examples.en: He deserves a pat on the back for all his hard work.
examples.zh: 他工作兢兢业业，值得嘉许。

examples.en: Give yourself a pat on the back!
examples.zh: 表扬一下自己吧！

senses.def: to praise somebody or yourself for doing something well
to try to forget about something unpleasant
senses.zh: 刻意忘掉（不愉快的事）；把…丢到脑后

examples.en: I tried to push the thought to the back of my mind.
examples.zh: 我尽量把这个念头忘掉。

senses.def: to use a lot of effort and energy on a particular task
anything that somebody has, including the things they really need themselves, that somebody else takes from them or they are willing to give
senses.zh: （别人拿走或自愿送掉的）全部家当

examples.en: He was the type of person who would give you the shirt off his back.
examples.zh: 他是那种愿意把衬衫脱下来给你的人。

senses.def: an act that harms somebody, done by a person they thought was a friend
senses.zh: 背后捅刀子；对给予信任的人的陷害（或中伤）

examples.en: Her refusal to support his campaign was a real stab in the back.
examples.zh: 她拒绝支持他的竞选活动真是背后捅刀子。

senses.def: to do or say something that harms somebody who trusts you
senses.zh: 在某人背后捅刀子；陷害（或中伤）信任你的人

senses.def: to turn so that you are facing in the opposite direction
to move so that you are standing or sitting with your back

examples.en: When on stage, try not to turn your back on the audience.
examples.zh: 在舞台上尽量不要背对观众。

senses.def: to reject somebody/something that you have previously been connected with

examples.en: She turned her back on them when they needed her.
examples.zh: 他们需要她的时候，她却背弃了他们。

examples.en: More and more people are turning their backs on meat and becoming vegetarians or vegans.
examples.zh: 越来越多的人放弃肉食，成为素食主义者或纯素食主义者。

examples.en: She decided to turn her back on Paris and return home.
examples.zh: 她决定离开巴黎回家去。

senses.def: to protect yourself against danger

examples.en: She'd better watch her back if she wants to hold onto the top job.
examples.zh: 如果她想保住一把手的位置，最好小心提防。

senses.def: used to say that something, especially criticism, has no effect on somebody/something

examples.en: I can't tell my son what to do; it's water off a duck's back with him.
examples.zh: 我无法告诉我儿子该做什么，他根本听不进去。

senses.def: used to say that if somebody helps you, you will help them, even if this is unfair to others
located behind or at the back of something

examples.en: We were sitting in the back row.
examples.zh: 我们坐在后排。

examples.en: the back garden (= behind the house)
examples.zh: 后花园

examples.en: a back room (= one at the back of a building)
examples.zh: 后室（位于建筑物后部）

examples.en: My phone's in my back pocket.
examples.zh: 我的手机在我身后的口袋里。

examples.en: back teeth
examples.zh: 臼齿

examples.en: the back page of a magazine
examples.zh: 杂志的封底

examples.en: We drove along miles of twisty back roads (= away from the main roads).
examples.zh: 我们沿着曲折偏僻的小路行驶了几英里。

senses.def: of or from a past time

examples.en: a back issue of the magazine
examples.zh: 一份过期杂志

senses.def: owed for a time in the past

examples.en: back pay/taxes/rent
examples.zh: 欠薪；欠税；欠租金

senses.def: produced with the back of the tongue in a higher position than the front, for example /
senses.zh: 舌后的，后位性的（舌高点位于口腔后部发音）

senses.def: left for the present time, to be done or considered later
(to put somebody) at a disadvantage or in difficulty
senses.zh: （使某人）陷入不利局面，处于困境

examples.en: Advances in drone technology have caught lawmakers on the back foot.
examples.zh: 无人机技术的进步教立法者措手不及。

examples.en: The side that’s on the back foot, struggling to defend, will usually give away more penalties.
examples.zh: 处于劣势、防守困难的一方通常会判罚更多的点球。

examples.en: We'd like to put the fossil fuel industry on the back foot.
examples.zh: 我们想让化石燃料行业处于不利地位。

senses.def: to or into the place, condition, situation or activity where somebody/something was before

examples.en: When is he coming back to work?
examples.zh: 他什么时候回来工作？

examples.en: He'll be back on Monday.
examples.zh: 他星期一会回来。

examples.en: Don't forget to bring it back when you've finished with it.
examples.zh: 用完以后不要忘记还回来。

examples.en: Please give me my ball back.
examples.zh: 请把我的球还给我。

examples.en: Put the book back on the shelf.
examples.zh: 把书放回书架上。

examples.en: Could you go back to the beginning of the story?
examples.zh: 你能不能回到故事的开头？

examples.en: She woke up briefly and then went back to sleep.
examples.zh: 她醒了片刻又睡了。

examples.en: I can't wait to get back home.
examples.zh: 我急不可待想赶回家。

examples.en: It takes me an hour to walk there and back.
examples.zh: 我步行往返要花一个小时。

examples.en: We were right back where we started, only this time without any money.
examples.zh: 我们回到了起点，只是这次一点钱也没有。

examples.en: It's good to have the whole family back together again.
examples.zh: 全家又团聚一起，真是太好了。

senses.def: away from the front or centre; behind you

examples.en: I moved back to let them pass.
examples.zh: 我退后了，好让他们通过。

examples.en: Sit back and relax.
examples.zh: 靠椅背坐好，放松放松。

examples.en: You've combed your hair back.
examples.zh: 你把头发往后梳了。

examples.en: He turned and looked back.
examples.zh: 他转身向后望。

examples.en: She fell back towards the end of the race.
examples.zh: 赛跑快结束时她落后了。

senses.def: at a place previously left or mentioned
senses.zh: 在曾去过（或提到过）的地方；在前面

examples.en: We should have turned left five kilometres back.
examples.zh: 我们在五公里之前就该左拐的。

examples.en: Back at home, her parents were worried.
examples.zh: 在家中，她的父母很担心。

senses.group: at a previous place 在原处

senses.def: in return or reply

examples.en: She's a tough kid, who, when attacked, fights back hard.
examples.zh: 她是个坚强的孩子，一旦受到攻击就会奋力反击。

examples.en: If he hits me, I'll hit him back.
examples.zh: 如果他打我，我就要还手。

examples.en: Could you call back later, please?
examples.zh: 请稍后再打电话来好吗？

senses.def: at a distance away from something

examples.en: The barriers kept the crowd back.
examples.zh: 障碍物拦住了人群。

examples.en: Stand back and give me some room.
examples.zh: 站远点儿，给我腾出些地方。

senses.def: in or into the past; ago

examples.en: The cathedral dates back to 1123.
examples.zh: 这座大教堂的历史可以追溯到 1123 年。

examples.en: The village has a history going back to the Middle Ages.
examples.zh: 这个村子的历史可追溯至中世纪。

examples.en: She left back in November.
examples.zh: 她十一月已经离开了。

examples.en: That was a few years back.
examples.zh: 那是几年以前的事。

senses.def: under control; prevented from being expressed or coming out

examples.en: He could no longer hold back his tears.
examples.zh: 他再也无法控制住眼泪。

senses.def: fashionable again

examples.en: Beards are back.
examples.zh: 络腮胡子又重新流行起来。

examples.en: I wonder if flares will ever come back in?
examples.zh: 我想知道耀斑是否会再次出现？

senses.def: from one place to another and back again repeatedly

examples.en: ferries sailing back and forth between the islands
examples.zh: 往返于岛屿之间的渡船

senses.def: in the past

examples.en: My dad's always talking about how great everything was back in the day.
examples.zh: 我爸爸总是讲过去的一切如何如何的好。

senses.def: at a particular time in the past

examples.en: I was a fan back in the days when the band wasn't yet famous.
examples.zh: 在这个乐队还没出名的时候，我就是他们的歌迷。

senses.def: behind something

examples.en: the houses back of the church
examples.zh: 位于教堂后面的房屋

senses.def: a return to the situation you were in at the beginning of a project, task, etc., because you have made no real progress
senses.zh: （因无进展）回到起点，从头再来

examples.en: If this suggestion isn't accepted, we'll be back to square one.
examples.zh: 如果这个建议得不到采纳，我们就得从头再来了。

senses.def: to return, or to make somebody return, to a normal way of thinking or behaving after a time when you/they have been very excited, not very practical, etc.
senses.zh: （使）从幻想中清醒过来，回到现实中来

senses.def: to encourage somebody or give them help; to give financial support to somebody/something

examples.en: Her parents backed her in her choice of career.
examples.zh: 她父母支持她的职业选择。

examples.en: The project to improve healthcare is backed (= given financial support) by the government.
examples.zh: 改善医疗系统的计划有政府资助。

senses.def: to support and agree with somebody/something

examples.en: Local residents are enthusiastically backing the campaign to save the library.
examples.zh: 当地居民热心地支持拯救图书馆的运动。

examples.en: Doctors have backed plans to raise the tax on alcohol.
examples.zh: 医生们支持提高酒精税的计划。

examples.en: He has publicly backed calls for an enquiry.
examples.zh: 他公开支持进行调查的呼吁。

senses.def: to help prove that something is true

examples.en: All complaints must be backed by evidence.
examples.zh: 所有投诉必须有证据支持。

senses.def: to bet money on a horse in a race, a team in a competition, etc.
senses.zh: 下赌注于（赛马、参赛队伍等）

examples.en: I backed the winner and won fifty pounds.
examples.zh: 我押对了赌注，赢了五十英镑。

examples.en: The horse was heavily backed on the morning of the race.
examples.zh: 比赛当天早上，这匹马受到大力支持。

senses.def: to play or sing music that supports the main singer or instrument
to move or make something move backwards

examples.en: He backed against the wall, terrified.
examples.zh: 他退到墙边，惊恐万分。

examples.en: to back out of a parking space

examples.zh: 真高兴不会再见到她了！

examples.zh: 我迫不及待地想把那辆旧车处理掉。

examples.zh: 你们是不是在背后说我的闲话？

examples.zh: 他们径自背着我把它卖了。

examples.zh: 人们在背后说他的坏话，但从不当面说。

examples.zh: 他还在为我借的那笔钱纠缠不休。

examples.zh: 我想在周末之前把这篇翻译做完。

examples.zh: 一切都要立字为据，以绝后患。

examples.zh: 请别烦我了好吗！

examples.zh: 别担心，我支持你。

examples.en: I’m loyal and I’ve got your back.
examples.zh: 我很忠诚，我会支持你。

senses.zh: 处于背水一战的境地；没有退路

examples.zh: 我们别无选择，只能卖掉。

senses.zh: 脑后长眼；眼光敏锐；什么都能觉察到

examples.en: You can’t get away with anything in her class. She has eyes in the back of her head.
examples.zh: 在她的课堂上你无法逃脱任何惩罚。她的后脑勺长着眼睛。

examples.zh: 我在这儿长大的，我对这地方再熟悉不过了。

examples.zh: 她卧病有一个多星期了。

examples.zh: 她决定离开巴黎回家去。

examples.zh: 如果她想保住一把手的位置，最好小心提防。

examples.zh: 我们的房子背向河流。

examples.zh: 他因轻微毒品指控而被保释。

senses.def: to leave a place, especially quickly

examples.en: Sorry, I really have to bail.
examples.zh: 对不起，我真得赶紧走了。

senses.def: to approach somebody and talk to them, often when they do not want this
senses.zh: 与…搭讪（尤指对方不愿意）

senses.def: to fail to appear at your trial after you have paid money to be allowed to go free until the trial

examples.en: He skipped bail and went on the run for two weeks.
examples.zh: 他弃保潜逃了两个星期。

senses.def: to jump out of a plane that is going to crash

examples.en: The pilot bailed out and parachuted into the sea.
examples.zh: 飞行员跳伞跳入海中。

senses.def: to escape from a situation that you no longer want to be involved in
senses.zh: 逃避，摆脱（不想再牵连其中的情况）

examples.en: I'd understand if you wanted to bail out of this relationship.
examples.zh: 如果你想从这种关系中摆脱出来，我可以理解。

senses.def: to empty water from something by lifting it out with your hand or a container

examples.en: He had to stop rowing to bail water out of the boat.
examples.zh: 他不得不停止划船，把船里的水舀出去。

examples.en: The boat will sink unless we bail out.
examples.zh: 我们若不排水，船就要沉。

senses.def: to pay somebody’s bail
to rescue somebody from a difficult situation

examples.en: The government had to bail the company out of financial difficulty.
examples.zh: 政府只得帮助该公司渡过财政难关。

examples.en: Ryan's late goal bailed out his team.
examples.zh: 瑞安在比赛临近结束时攻入一球，拯救了他的球队。

senses.def: the open area of a castle, inside the outer wall
a temporary bridge made of strips of metal that can be quickly put together, used especially by the armed forces
a law officer whose job is to take the possessions and property of people who cannot pay their debts

examples.en: The bailiffs seized the car and house.
examples.zh: 法庭执达官扣押了车和房。

examples.en: Their landlord has threatened to send in the bailiffs if they don’t pay their rent.
examples.zh: 房东威胁说，如果他们不付房租就叫法警来。

senses.def: a person employed to manage land or a large farm for somebody else
an official who keeps order in court, takes people to their seats, watches prisoners, etc.
somebody's particular area of responsibility or interest
senses.zh: 个人职责（或兴趣）的范畴

examples.en: He never writes up our reports—that's my bailiwick.
examples.zh: 他从不写我们的报告，那属于我的职责范围。

senses.def: an act of giving money to a company, a foreign country, etc. that has very serious financial problems

examples.en: The airline was saved by a government bailout.
examples.zh: 该航空公司因政府救助而得救。

senses.def: a pan of hot water in which a bowl of food is cooked or warmed slowly
senses.zh: 热水炖锅；热水蒸锅；双层保温锅

senses.def: a child
food put on a hook

examples.en: Live worms are used as bait.
examples.zh: 使用活虫作为诱饵。

examples.en: The fish took the bait.
examples.zh: 鱼咬了钓饵。

senses.def: a person or thing that is used to attract somebody in order to catch them or make them do what you want

examples.en: The police used him as bait to trap the killers.
examples.zh: 警方用他作诱饵，设圈套捉拿凶手。

examples.en: He had chosen the right bait to persuade her to go.
examples.zh: 他选择了正确的诱饵来说服她走。

senses.def: to place food on a hook
senses.zh: 下诱饵；在（鱼钩上、陷阱中等）放诱饵

examples.en: He baited the trap with a piece of meat.
examples.zh: 他在陷阱中放了一片肉做诱饵。

senses.def: to deliberately try to make somebody angry or to hurt them by making cruel remarks
senses.zh: （故意以侮辱性言语）激怒，伤害

examples.en: The soldiers remained calm even though the crowd was baiting them.
examples.zh: 尽管人群在引诱他们，士兵们仍然保持冷静。

senses.def: the activity of attacking a wild animal with dogs

examples.en: bear-baiting
examples.zh: 纵犬斗熊

examples.en: badger-baiting
examples.zh: 獾诱饵

senses.def: a selling method where advertisements for low-priced products are used to attract customers, who are then persuaded to buy something more expensive
senses.zh: 诱售法（以廉价商品招徕，再兜售较高价商品）

senses.def: a type of thick cloth made of wool that is usually green, used especially for covering card tables and billiard
senses.zh: 台面呢（通常绿色，尤用作牌桌、台球台面的衬垫）

senses.def: an extremely large number

examples.en: My inbox contained a bajillion emails when I came back from my holiday.
examples.zh: 我度假回来，收件箱里堆积了无数封电邮。

senses.def: to cook food in an oven without extra fat or liquid; to be cooked in this way

examples.en: to bake bread/biscuits/cookies
examples.zh: 烤面包；烤饼干；烤曲奇饼

examples.en: baked potatoes/apples
examples.zh: 烤马铃薯；烤苹果

examples.en: the delicious smell of baking bread
examples.zh: 烤制面包的香味

examples.en: The bread is baking in the oven.
examples.zh: 烤箱里正在烤面包。

examples.en: I've been baking all morning.
examples.zh: 我一上午都在做烘焙。

examples.en: I'm baking a birthday cake for Alex.
examples.zh: 我在给亚历克斯烤生日蛋糕。

examples.en: I'm baking Alex a cake.
examples.zh: 我在给亚历克斯烤蛋糕。

senses.def: to become hard when heated; to make something hard by heating it

examples.en: The bricks are left in the kiln to bake.
examples.zh: 砖坯放在窑里烧。

examples.en: The sun had baked the ground hard.
examples.zh: 太阳把地面晒硬了。

senses.def: to be or become very hot

examples.en: We sat baking in the sun.
examples.zh: 我们坐在太阳底下晒得热死了。

senses.def: a dish consisting of mixed ingredients that is cooked in the oven

examples.en: a pasta/vegetable bake
examples.zh: 烤意大利面；烤蔬菜

senses.def: a social event at which a specific food is cooked and eaten

examples.en: a clam bake
examples.zh: 烤蛤蜊

examples.en: Becker was at the annual Kirkland Rotary salmon bake.
examples.zh: 贝克尔参加了一年一度的柯克兰扶轮鲑鱼烘烤活动。

senses.def: an event at which cakes, etc. are baked and sold to make money, usually for a school or charity
senses.zh: 烤饼义卖（为学校或慈善事业等募集资金）

examples.en: The bake sale made $358 for cancer research.
examples.zh: 自制糕饼义卖为癌症研究筹集了 358 美元。

senses.def: a dessert
senses.zh: 烤脆皮冰激凌蛋糕，火焰冰激凌（将蛋糕冰激凌裹上蛋糖，放入高温烤箱烤制）

senses.def: small white beans cooked in a tomato sauce and usually sold in cans
senses.zh: 番茄酱烘豆（常制成罐头）

senses.def: small white beans baked with pork
senses.zh: （加猪肉和红糖或糖浆制成的）波士顿烤豆

senses.def: foods like bread and cakes that are cooked in an oven

examples.en: There was a tempting display of home-made baked goods and refreshments.
examples.zh: 摆满了诱人的自制烘焙食品和茶点。

senses.def: a potato cooked in its skin in an oven

examples.en: a baked potato and beans
examples.zh: 一份烤土豆加烘豆

senses.def: a building or an area where bread is made
a type of hard plastic used in the past for electrical equipment, etc.
a person whose job is baking and selling bread and cakes
senses.zh: 面包（糕饼）师傅；面包店老板

senses.def: a shop that sells bread and cakes

examples.en: I'm just going to the baker's.
examples.zh: 我正要去面包店。

senses.def: a US make of chocolate mostly used for making cakes, etc. It is not very sweet and is sold in small squares. The original Baker's Chocolate Company started in 1780.
senses.zh: 美国制造的巧克力，主要用于制作蛋糕等。它不是很甜，以小方块出售。最初的贝克巧克力公司成立于1780年。

senses.def: a group of thirteen (= one more than a dozen, which is twelve)
a street in central London. It is perhaps best known as the place where Sherlock Holmes
senses.zh: 贝克街：伦敦市中心的一条街。最著名的地方可能是亚瑟·柯南·道尔爵士创造的侦探福尔摩斯居住的地方。他的地址是贝克街221B号。在故事中，福尔摩斯有时会雇用一群当地的孩子，他称他为贝克街的不定期伙计，以获取有关他的信息。

senses.def: a city in the US state of California
senses.zh: 贝克斯菲尔德（美国加利福尼亚州城市）

senses.def: a place where bread and cakes are made and/or sold
senses.zh: 面包（糕饼）店；面包（糕饼）烘房；面包厂

senses.def: a place where bread and cakes are made and/or sold
senses.zh: 面包（糕饼）店；面包（糕饼）烘房；面包厂

senses.def: tins and other containers used for baking
a sweet pie
senses.zh: 贝克韦蛋挞，果酱馅饼，杏仁果酱馅饼

senses.def: flour that contains baking powder
a mixture of powders that are used to make cakes rise and become light as they are baked
a small sheet of metal used for baking food on
a chemical in the form of a white powder that dissolves
an important ruling made by the US Supreme Court
senses.zh: Bakke判决：1978年美国最高法院作出的一项重要裁定。一个叫Allan Bakke的白人声称他因肤色而被非法拒绝工作。法院裁定，雇主没有为他提供工作是非法行为，但雇主在决定是否给他们工作时确实有权考虑某人的种族。

senses.def: a motor vehicle with low sides and no roof at the back, used for transporting goods or people, or as a car
a sweet dish from the Middle East, made from very thin pastry
senses.zh: 蜜糖果仁千层酥（中东薄脆甜点）

senses.def: (in some countries in the Middle East and South Asia) a small amount of money that is given as a gift to poor people, or given to somebody to thank them or to persuade them to help you
senses.zh: （一些亚洲国家中的）施舍，小费，小额贿赂

senses.def: a type of hat made of wool that covers most of the head, neck and face
senses.zh: 巴拉克拉瓦盔式帽，巴拉克拉瓦羊毛头罩（裹住头、颈和脸的大部分）

examples.en: The two attackers were wearing balaclavas.
examples.zh: 两名袭击者戴着巴拉克拉法帽。

senses.def: a large type of xylophone
a musical instrument like a guitar with a body in the shape of a triangle
senses.zh: 巴拉莱卡琴（拨弦乐器，腹呈三角形，可有二弦、三弦或四弦，尤在俄罗斯流行）

senses.def: a situation in which different things exist in equal, correct or good amounts

examples.en: Try to maintain a good balance of carbohydrates and protein in your diet.
examples.zh: 尽量保持饮食中碳水化合物和蛋白质的良好平衡。

examples.en: Tourists often disturb the delicate balance of nature on the island.
examples.zh: 观光客常常干扰岛上脆弱的自然生态平衡。

examples.en: His wife's death disturbed the balance of his mind.
examples.zh: 妻子的离世使他心神不宁。

examples.en: Try to keep a balance between work and relaxation.
examples.zh: 尽量保持工作与休闲均衡。

examples.en: It is important to keep the different aspects of your life in balance.
examples.zh: 保持生活中各个方面的平衡是很重要的。

senses.def: the ability to keep steady with an equal amount of weight on each side of the body

examples.en: Athletes need a good sense of balance.
examples.zh: 运动员要有良好的平衡感。

examples.en: I struggled to keep my balance on my new skates.
examples.zh: 我穿着新溜冰鞋，努力保持平衡。

examples.en: She cycled round the corner, lost her balance and fell off.
examples.zh: 她骑车拐弯时失去平衡，摔了下来。

senses.def: the amount that is left after taking numbers or money away from a total

examples.en: to check your bank balance (= to find out how much money there is in your account)
examples.zh: 核对银行结存

examples.en: Consider a balance transfer to a credit card with a lower rate of interest (= = moving the amount owed from one card to another).
examples.zh: 考虑将余额转移到利率较低的信用卡（==将欠款从一张卡转移到另一张卡）。

senses.def: an amount of money still owed after some payment has been made

examples.en: The balance of $500 must be paid within 90 days.
examples.zh: 500 美元结欠款必须于 90 天之内付清。

examples.en: I'll pay the balance later.
examples.zh: 我以后会把差额补上。

examples.en: The final balance is due six weeks before departure.
examples.zh: 最终账目应在离开前6个星期结清。

senses.def: the largest part of a group or an amount; the position of advantage or attention

examples.en: The balance of opinion was that work was more important than leisure.
examples.zh: 大多数人的观点是工作比休闲更重要。

examples.en: The balance has now shifted from the unions to employers.
examples.zh: 现在平衡已经从工会转向了雇主。

senses.def: an instrument for weighing things, with a bar that is supported in the middle and has dishes hanging from each end
(considering) the evidence on both sides of an argument, to find the most likely reason for or result of something
senses.zh: （从）总的来说；（考虑）正反两方面；权衡双方证据

examples.en: The balance of evidence suggests the Liberal party's decline began before the First World War.
examples.zh: 综合证据表明，自由党的衰落始于第一次世界大战之前。

examples.en: The coroner thought that on the balance of probabilities, the pilot had suffered a stroke just before the crash.
examples.zh: 验尸官在分析各种可能性后认为，飞行员很有可能在空难发生之前突然中风。

senses.def: if the future of something/somebody, or the result of something is/hangs in the balance
senses.zh: （前途）不明朗；（结果）未定，悬而未决

examples.en: The long-term future of the space programme hangs in the balance.
examples.zh: 航天计划的长远前景尚未明朗。

examples.en: Tom’s life hung in the balance for two weeks as he lay in a coma.
examples.zh: 汤姆昏迷了两周，生命垂危。

senses.def: to make somebody unsteady and in danger of falling
senses.zh: 使失去平衡（而有跌落危险）

examples.en: I was thrown off balance by the sudden gust of wind.
examples.zh: 突如其来的一阵风差点儿把我吹倒。

examples.en: The sudden movement threw him off balance.
examples.zh: 突然的移动使他失去了平衡。

senses.def: to make somebody surprised and no longer calm
senses.zh: 使（毫无准备而）不知所措

examples.en: The senator was clearly caught off balance by the unexpected question.
examples.zh: 参议员显然因这意想不到的问题而乱了阵脚。

senses.def: after considering all the information

examples.en: On balance, the company has had a successful year.
examples.zh: 总的来说，公司这一年业绩很好。

senses.def: to make a situation equal or fair again
senses.zh: 恢复公平合理的情况；恢复平衡

examples.en: For years poorer children have had to put up with a lower quality education, and now is the time to redress the balance.
examples.zh: 多年来，较贫困的儿童不得不接受较差的教育，现在是扭转这一不公平状况的时候了。

senses.def: to manage to find a way of being fair to two things that are opposed to each other; to find an acceptable position that is between two things
senses.zh: （在对立二者之间）找到折中办法；平衡（对立的双方）

examples.en: We need to strike a balance between these conflicting interests.
examples.zh: 我们需要在这些对立的利益之间找到平衡。

senses.def: to affect the result of something in one way rather than another
senses.zh: 使天平倾斜；使结果倾向某方；起决定性作用

examples.en: In an interview, smart presentation can tip the balance in your favour.
examples.zh: 在面试中，巧妙的演讲可以让天平向对你有利的方向倾斜。

examples.en: New evidence tipped the balance against the prosecution.
examples.zh: 新的证据打破了检方的立场。

senses.def: to put your body or something else into a position where it is steady and does not fall
senses.zh: 使（在某物上）保持平衡；立稳

examples.en: How long can you balance on one leg?
examples.zh: 你单腿能站多久？

examples.en: Her laptop was precariously balanced on top of a pile of books.
examples.zh: 她的笔记本电脑摇摇晃晃地平衡在一堆书上。

examples.en: She balanced the cup on her knee.
examples.zh: 她把杯子在膝盖上放稳。

examples.en: He balanced the glasses carefully on the tray.
examples.zh: 他小心地使玻璃杯在托盘上保持平衡。

senses.def: to give equal importance to two things or parts of something which are very different
senses.zh: 同等重视（相对的两个事物或方面）

examples.en: They try to balance the needs of their children with those of their employers.
examples.zh: 他们试图平衡孩子的需求和雇主的需求。

examples.en: The song perfectly balances melody and rhythm.
examples.zh: 歌曲的旋律和节奏相得益彰。

senses.def: to be equal in value, amount, etc. to something else that has the opposite effect

examples.en: The good and bad effects of any decision will usually balance out.
examples.zh: 任何决策的效果往往利弊互见。

examples.en: This year's profits will balance out our previous losses.
examples.zh: 本年度的赢利将可弥补我们之前的亏损。

examples.en: His lack of experience was balanced by a willingness to learn.
examples.zh: 他的好学弥补了他经验的不足。

senses.def: to compare the relative importance of two things which are different
senses.zh: 比较（两个不同的事物）；权衡重要性

examples.en: The cost of obtaining legal advice needs to be balanced against its benefits.
examples.zh: 法律咨询的费用与其效益需权衡一下。

examples.en: We have to balance the risks of the new strategy against the possible benefits.
examples.zh: 我们得权衡新策略的风险与可能带来的利益。

senses.def: to manage finances so that the money spent is equal to the money received; to show this in the accounts

examples.en: In order to balance the budget severe spending cuts had to be made.
examples.zh: 为了平衡预算，不得不大幅削减了开支。

examples.en: The law requires the council to balance its books each year.
examples.zh: 法律要求议会每年保持收支平衡。

senses.def: (of an account) to have an equal amount of money spent and money received

examples.en: I tried to work out why the books wouldn't balance.
examples.zh: 我想要弄清这些账目收支为什么不平衡。

senses.def: (considering) the evidence on both sides of an argument, to find the most likely reason for or result of something
senses.zh: （从）总的来说；（考虑）正反两方面；权衡双方证据

senses.def: a wooden bar that is used in the sport of gymnastics

examples.en: The gymnasts finish with floor exercises and the balance beam.
examples.zh: 体操运动员以自由体操和平衡木项目结束比赛。

senses.def: the difference between the amount a country pays for imports and the amount it receives for exports in a particular period of time
senses.zh: 国际收支（一国在某时期的进出口差额）

senses.def: the way in which political or military strength is divided between two or more countries or groups

examples.zh: 周六，童子军将举办集市。

senses.def: British Broadcasting Corporation

examples.zh: 新闻在英国广播公司电视一台 6 点钟播出。

senses.zh: BBC英语（一种英语发音方式，为英国广播公司的新闻播音员所常用）

the second television channel of the BBC
an international BBC
senses.zh: BBC世界新闻：BBC国际电视频道，每天24小时在世界各地播报新闻

before Christ

examples.zh: 公元前 3 世纪

examples.en: Send an email to the head of finance and bcc me.
examples.zh: 给财务主管发一封电邮并密送给我。

examples.en: That company keeps bcc’ing promotional emails to me.
examples.zh: 那家公司不断把促销电邮密送给我。

examples.en: He now bcc’ed his boss on every email he sent to difficult clients.
examples.zh: 他现在给难缠客户每发一封电邮就密送给他老板一份。

senses.def: before the Common Era (before the birth of Christ, when the Christian calendar
senses.zh: 公元前（用于表示年份，用法与 BC 同）

examples.zh: 在公元前 2 000 年

examples.en: the third century BCE
examples.zh: 公元前三世纪

senses.def: body dysmorphic disorder
senses.zh: 躯体变形障碍（过度关注自己的外貌，为并不存在或他人不会注意到的缺陷感到焦虑的心理疾病）

examples.en: The exact cause of BDD is not known.
examples.zh: 躯体变形障碍的确切原因尚不清楚。

senses.def: used when you are naming people or things, describing them or giving more information about them

examples.en: Today is Monday.
examples.zh: 今天是星期一。

examples.en: ‘Who is that?’ ‘It's my brother.’
examples.zh: “那个人是谁？”“是我哥哥。”

examples.en: She's a great artist.
examples.zh: 她是一位伟大的艺术家。

examples.en: Susan is a doctor.
examples.zh: 苏珊是医生。

examples.en: He wants to be (= become) a pilot when he grows up.
examples.zh: 他想长大后当飞行员。

examples.en: It's beautiful!
examples.zh: 美呀！

examples.en: Life is unfair.
examples.zh: 人生没有公平。

examples.en: He is ten years old.
examples.zh: 他十岁了。

examples.en: ‘How are you?’ ‘I'm very well, thanks.’
examples.zh: “你好吗？”“我很好，谢谢。”

examples.en: Be quick!
examples.zh: 快点！

examples.en: The fact is (that) we don’t have enough money.
examples.zh: 事实是我们没有那么多钱。

examples.en: The problem is getting it all done in the time available.
examples.zh: 问题是要在现有的时间内把它全部完成。

examples.en: The problem is to get it all done in the time available.
examples.zh: 问题是要在现有的时间内把它全部完成。

senses.def: used when you are describing a situation or saying what you think about it

examples.en: It was really hot in the sauna.
examples.zh: 桑拿浴的确很热。

examples.en: It's strange how she never comes to see us any more.
examples.zh: 奇怪，她怎么再也不来看我们了。

examples.en: He thinks it's clever to make fun of people.
examples.zh: 他觉得拿别人开玩笑显得聪明。

examples.en: It would be a shame if you lost it.
examples.zh: 你要是把它丢了就太可惜了。

examples.en: It's going to be a great match.
examples.zh: 这将是一场了不起的比赛。

senses.def: to exist; to be present

examples.en: Is there a God?
examples.zh: 上帝存在吗？

examples.en: Once upon a time there was a princess…
examples.zh: 从前有一位公主…

examples.en: I tried phoning but there was no answer.
examples.zh: 我试过打电话，但没人接。

examples.en: There's a bank down the road.
examples.zh: 沿马路不远有一家银行。

examples.en: Was there a pool at the hotel?
examples.zh: 宾馆里有游泳池吗？

senses.def: to be located; to be in a place

examples.en: The town is three miles away.
examples.zh: 镇子距此地三英里远。

examples.en: If you're looking for your file, it's on the table.
examples.zh: 你要找的文件在桌子上。

examples.en: Mary's upstairs.
examples.zh: 玛丽在楼上。

senses.def: used to say where somebody was born or where their home is
senses.zh: 出生于（某地）；来自…；是（某地的）人

examples.en: She's from Italy.
examples.zh: 她是意大利人。

senses.def: to happen at a time or in a place

examples.en: The party is on Friday evening.
examples.zh: 聚会定于周五晚上举行。

examples.en: The meetings are always in the main conference room.
examples.zh: 会议总是在主会议室进行。

senses.def: to remain in a place

examples.en: She has been in her room for hours.
examples.zh: 她已经在她的房间里待了几个小时了。

examples.en: They're here till Christmas.
examples.zh: 他们将在这里一直住到圣诞节。

senses.def: to attend an event; to be present in a place

examples.en: I'll be at the party.
examples.zh: 我将出席聚会。

examples.en: He'll be here soon (= will arrive soon).
examples.zh: 他很快就会到达。

senses.def: used to talk about time

examples.en: It's two thirty.
examples.zh: 现在是两点三十。

examples.en: It was late at night when we finally arrived.
examples.zh: 我们最后到达时已是深夜。

senses.def: to cost

examples.en: ‘How much is that dress?’ ‘Eighty dollars.’
examples.zh: “那条连衣裙多少钱？”“八十美元。”

senses.def: to be equal to

examples.en: Three and three is six.
examples.zh: 三加三等于六。

examples.en: How much is a thousand pounds in euros?
examples.zh: 一千英镑合多少欧元？

examples.en: Let x be the sum of a and b.
examples.zh: 设 x 为 a 加 b 之和。

examples.en: London is not England (= do not think that all of England is like London).
examples.zh: 伦敦并不等于英格兰（不要以为整个英格兰都像伦敦）。

senses.def: to visit or call

examples.en: I've never been to Spain.
examples.zh: 我从未去过西班牙。

examples.en: He had been abroad many times.
examples.zh: 他曾多次出国。

examples.en: Has the postman been yet?
examples.zh: 邮递员来过了吗？

senses.def: used to say what something is made of

examples.en: Is your jacket real leather?
examples.zh: 你的夹克是真皮的吗？

senses.def: used to say who something belongs to or who it is intended for

examples.en: The money's not yours, it's John's.
examples.zh: 这钱不是你的，是约翰的。

examples.en: This package is for you.
examples.zh: 这个包裹是给你的。

senses.def: used to say how important something is to somebody

examples.en: Money isn't everything (= it is not the only important thing).
examples.zh: 金钱不是一切（不是唯一重要的东西）。

examples.en: A thousand dollars is nothing to somebody as rich as he is.
examples.zh: 一千美元对于像他这么富有的人来说算不上什么。

senses.def: as somebody/something used to be called
senses.zh: 像以往所称呼的；作为曾用名

examples.en: Jill Davis that was (= before her marriage)
examples.zh: （婚前）姓名为吉尔·戴维斯

examples.en: the Soviet Union, as was
examples.zh: 旧称苏联

senses.def: the most important part; all that matters
senses.zh: 最重要的部分；最要紧的事

examples.en: Her career is the be-all and end-all of her existence.
examples.zh: 她的事业是她生活中至关重要的事。

senses.def: used to show that you are surprised and annoyed by something that somebody has done

examples.en: Someone's been and parked in front of the entrance!
examples.zh: 有人居然把车停在大门口！

senses.def: used to say that somebody/something stopped somebody/something from happening

examples.en: If it weren't for you, I wouldn't be alive today.
examples.zh: 如果不是你，我早就死了。

senses.def: used to show that you accept that something negative cannot be changed
senses.zh: 事已至此（表示接受无法改变的负面事情）

examples.en: I never imagined that our company share prices would fall so low, but it is what it is.
examples.zh: 我从没想到我们公司的股价会跌到这么低，但事已至此，又能如何？

senses.def: to leave somebody/something alone without bothering them/it
senses.zh: 随…去；不打扰某人／某事物

examples.en: Leave her be, she obviously doesn't want to talk about it.
examples.zh: 别烦她了，她显然不想谈论这事。

examples.en: Let the poor dog be (= don't annoy it).
examples.zh: 别逗弄那条可怜的狗了。

examples.en: mothers-to-be (= pregnant women)

senses.def: used with a present participle to form progressive tenses
senses.zh: （与现在分词连用构成进行时）

examples.en: I am studying Chinese.
examples.zh: 我正在学中文。

examples.en: I'll be seeing him soon.
examples.zh: 我很快就要见到他了。

examples.en: What have you been doing this week?
examples.zh: 你这个星期都在做些什么？

examples.en: I'm always being criticized.
examples.zh: 我总是受到批评。

senses.def: used to make question tags

examples.en: You're not hungry, are you?
examples.zh: 你不饿，对吧？

examples.en: Ben's coming, isn't he?
examples.zh: 本要来，是不是？

examples.en: The old theatre was pulled down, wasn't it?
examples.zh: 老戏院被拆了，对不？

senses.def: used with a past participle to form the passive
senses.zh: （与过去分词连用构成被动语态）

examples.en: He was killed in the war.
examples.zh: 他死于这场战争。

examples.en: Where were they made?
examples.zh: 这些东西是在哪里制造的？

examples.en: The house was still being built.
examples.zh: 房子还在建造中。

examples.en: You will be told what to do.
examples.zh: 会有人告诉你该干什么的。

senses.def: used to avoid repeating the full form of a verb in the passive or a progressive tense
senses.zh: （在被动语态或进行时中代替重复的动词完整形式）

examples.en: Karen wasn't beaten in any of her games, but all the others were.
examples.zh: 卡伦没有输掉任何一场比赛，但所有其他人都输过。

examples.en: ‘Are you coming with us?’ ‘No, I'm not.’
examples.zh: “你和我们一起去吗？”“不，我不了。”

senses.def: used to say what must or should be done

examples.en: I am to call them once I reach the airport.
examples.zh: 我一到机场就得给他们打电话。

examples.en: You are to report this to the police.
examples.zh: 你应该报警。

examples.en: What is to be done about this problem?
examples.zh: 该如何处理这个问题？

senses.def: used to say what is arranged to happen

examples.en: They are to be married in June.
examples.zh: 他们计划于六月份结婚。

senses.def: used to say what happened later

examples.en: He was to regret that decision for the rest of his life (= he did regret it).
examples.zh: 他终生都会后悔作出了那一决定。

senses.def: used to say what could not or did not happen

examples.en: Anna was nowhere to be found (= we could not find her anywhere).
examples.zh: 我们到处都找不到安娜。

examples.en: He was never to see his wife again (= although he did not know it would be so at the time, he did not see her again).
examples.zh: 他注定再也见不到他的妻子了。

examples.en: She wanted to write a successful novel, but it was not to be (= it turned out never to happen).
examples.zh: 她曾想写一部成功的小说，但从未如愿。

senses.def: used to express a condition

examples.en: If we were to offer you more money, would you stay?
examples.zh: 假如我们给你加钱，你愿意留下吗？

examples.en: Were we to offer you more money, would you stay?
examples.zh: 假如我们给你加钱，你愿意留下吗？

senses.def: to make or treat somebody/something as

examples.en: Don't belittle his achievements (= say they are not important).
examples.zh: 不要贬低他的成就。

examples.en: An older girl befriended me.
examples.zh: 一个年纪大些的女孩对我很友善。

senses.def: wearing or covered with

examples.en: heavily bejewelled fingers
examples.zh: 戴满珠宝的手指

examples.en: bespattered with mud
examples.zh: 溅满污泥

senses.def: to cause something to be

examples.en: The ship was becalmed (= there was no wind so it could not move).
examples.zh: 帆船因无风而停航。

examples.en: The rebels besieged the fort.
examples.zh: 叛乱者包围了城堡。

senses.def: used to turn intransitive
senses.zh: （与不及物动词结合，构成及物动词）

examples.en: She is always bemoaning her lot.
examples.zh: 她总是怪命不好。

note.en: Most idioms containing be are at the entries for the nouns and adjectives in the idioms, for example be the death of somebody is at death.
note.zh: 大多数含 be 的习语，都可在该等习语中的名词及形容词相关词条找到，如 be the death of sb 在词条 death 下。

senses.def: as somebody/something used to be called
senses.zh: 像以往所称呼的；作为曾用名

examples.en: Jill Davis that was (= before her marriage)
examples.zh: （婚前）姓名为吉尔·戴维斯

examples.en: the Soviet Union, as was
examples.zh: 旧称苏联

senses.def: the most important part; all that matters
senses.zh: 最重要的部分；最要紧的事

examples.en: Her career is the be-all and end-all of her existence.
examples.zh: 她的事业是她生活中至关重要的事。

items.idm: (he, she, etc. has) been and done something

examples.en: Someone's been and parked in front of the entrance!
examples.zh: 有人居然把车停在大门口！

senses.def: used to say that somebody/something stopped somebody/something from happening

examples.en: If it weren't for you, I wouldn't be alive today.
examples.zh: 如果不是你，我早就死了。

senses.def: used to show that you accept that something negative cannot be changed
senses.zh: 事已至此（表示接受无法改变的负面事情）

examples.en: I never imagined that our company share prices would fall so low, but it is what it is.
examples.zh: 我从没想到我们公司的股价会跌到这么低，但事已至此，又能如何？

senses.def: to leave somebody/something alone without bothering them/it
senses.zh: 随…去；不打扰某人／某事物

examples.en: Leave her be, she obviously doesn't want to talk about it.
examples.zh: 别烦她了，她显然不想谈论这事。

examples.en: Let the poor dog be (= don't annoy it).
examples.zh: 别逗弄那条可怜的狗了。

senses.def: future

examples.en: his bride-to-be
examples.zh: 他的未婚妻

examples.en: mothers-to-be (= pregnant women)
examples.zh: 准妈妈

senses.def: to be a person who enjoys something, or who does something often or well
senses.zh: 乐于（或长于）做某事的人

examples.en: I've never been a great one for fish and chips.
examples.zh: 我一向对炸鱼薯条不热衷。

senses.def: to be involved in an agreement or action

examples.en: to be party to a decision
examples.zh: 参与作出决议

examples.en: He refused to be a party to any violence.
examples.zh: 他拒绝参与任何暴力活动。

senses.def: to see something take place

examples.en: He has been witness to a terrible murder.
examples.zh: 他目击了一起残忍的凶杀事件。

examples.en: a witness to murder
examples.zh: 谋杀案目击者

senses.def: to show that something is true; to provide evidence for something

examples.en: His good health is a witness to the success of the treatment.
examples.zh: 他身体健康证明这种疗法是成功的。

senses.def: to be easy compared with what came before

examples.en: It's all downhill from here. We'll soon be finished.
examples.zh: 从这以后就容易了。我们很快就会结束。

senses.def: to become worse or less successful
senses.zh: 每况愈下；走下坡路；不断恶化

examples.en: It's been all downhill for his career since then, with four defeats in five games.
examples.zh: 从那时起他的战绩便江河日下，五场比赛输掉了四场。

examples.en: I started work as a journalist and it was downhill all the way for my health.
examples.zh: 我开始当记者后，身体每况愈下。

be (all) downhill | be downhill all the.word: be (all) downhill | be downhill all the way

senses.def: to be pleasant, friendly and polite

examples.en: I can’t complain—he’s been all sweetness and light with me.
examples.zh: 我没什么可抱怨的——他对我一直很甜蜜、轻松。

examples.en: People think she's all sweetness and light, but she actually has a temper.
examples.zh: 人们都认为她亲切和善，但实际上她的脾气很坏。

senses.def: to be fun and easy to deal with

examples.en: It’s not all sweetness and light being an actor.
examples.zh: 作为一名演员并不全是甜蜜和轻松。

senses.def: to be famous or known for a particular thing that you have done in the past
senses.zh: 因某事而成名（或名留青史）

examples.en: He is best remembered as the man who brought jazz to England.
examples.zh: 他因为将爵士音乐传到英国而为人们所熟知。

examples.en: She is best remembered for her first book, ‘In the Ditch’.
examples.zh: 她因第一部作品《在沟里 》为人们所熟知。

be (best) remembered for something | be.word: be (best) remembered for something | be (best) remembered as something

senses.def: to be in a difficult situation when any action you take will have bad results
to be strongly opposed to something

examples.en: Why are you so dead set against the idea?
examples.zh: 你为什么那样死命地反对这个主意呢？

examples.en: Her parents are dead set against the marriage.
examples.zh: 她的父母坚决反对这门婚事。

be (dead) set against something/against.word: be (dead) set against something/against doing something

senses.def: used to say that two friends are not having a romantic relationship with each other

examples.en: They gradually got to know each other better but they remained just good friends.
examples.zh: 渐渐地，他们对彼此有了更多的了解，但他们仍然只是好朋友。

senses.def: to still be alive after the time when you were expected to die

examples.en: He’s been living on borrowed time ever since his last heart attack.
examples.zh: 自从上次心脏病发作以来，他一直过着借来的时光。

senses.def: to be doing something that other people are likely to soon stop you from doing
senses.zh: 做很快就会遭到制止的事；好景不长

examples.en: According to the latest opinion polls, the government is living on borrowed time.
examples.zh: 根据最新的民意调查，政府的生存时间是借来的。

senses.def: to be likely to happen; to be quite normal
senses.zh: 可能发生；可以预料；相当正常

examples.en: A little tiredness after taking the medication is to be expected.
examples.zh: 服药后可能会有些疲倦。

senses.def: to not be important or practical
to be unable to change something that you have been doing the same way for a long time and that has become boring
not having changed at all from a time in the past although everything else has

examples.en: Her whole house seems to be stuck in a time warp. It’s like something out of the 1950s.
examples.zh: 她的整个房子似乎停留在过去，还是20世纪50年代的样子。

senses.def: to be (very) friendly with somebody, and likely to get an advantage from the friendship
senses.zh: 和…（十分）友好（很可能从中得到好处）

senses.def: to be generous, cheerful and pleasant, especially in a difficult situation or when you have lost a game
senses.zh: （尤指在困境中或输了比赛后）开朗大度，讲交情，输得起

examples.en: She's a good sport.

senses.def: to be better than anything else or anyone else of the same type

examples.en: He is a player without equal.
examples.zh: 他是个无与伦比的运动员。

examples.en: As a family holiday destination, the seaside has no equal.
examples.zh: 作为家庭度假胜地，海滨是无与伦比的。

be without equal | have no equal | have.word: be without equal | have no equal | have no/few equals

senses.def: to be very active or too active

examples.en: There was nothing to worry about. It was just her imagination working overtime.
examples.zh: 没什么可担心的。那只是她的想象力太丰富了。

senses.def: to be completely different in attitudes, opinions, etc.
senses.zh: （在态度、看法等方面）有天壤之别，截然不同

examples.en: Although they are twins, they are worlds apart in their attitude to life.
examples.zh: 尽管他们是双胞胎，他们的人生观却完全不同。

be worn to a frazzle: @@@LINK=be burnt, worn, etc. to a frazzle

senses.def: to be extremely worried

examples.en: Where have you been? I've been worried sick about you.
examples.zh: 你上哪儿去了？把我急死了。

examples.en: She was worrying herself sick about the exams.
examples.zh: 她为考试担心得要命。

be worried sick; be sick with worry.word: be worried sick; be sick with worry

senses.def: to be poorer, unhappier, etc. than before or than somebody else
senses.zh: （比以前或其他人）更穷，更不愉快，更差

examples.en: The increase in taxes means that we'll be £30 a month worse off than before.
examples.zh: 税收的增加意味着我们将比以前每月少挣 30 英镑。

examples.en: I've only broken my arm; other people are far worse off than me.
examples.zh: 我只是断了手臂；其他人的情况比我差得多。

senses.def: to be so involved with somebody/something that you do not pay enough attention to other people or things
senses.zh: 专心致志于；全神贯注于；完全沉浸于

examples.en: They are completely wrapped up in their children.
examples.zh: 他们把全部精力都用在孩子身上了。

examples.en: She was so wrapped up in her work that she didn’t realize how late it was.
examples.zh: 她只顾埋头工作，没意识到天已经很晚了。

senses.def: to be very obvious to other people from the expression on somebody’s face
senses.zh: 形之于色；表现得十分明显

examples.en: Guilt was written all over his face.
examples.zh: 他满脸愧疚。

be written all over somebody’s face.word: be written all over somebody’s face

senses.def: to act or think independently, not following others or being ordered

examples.en: Working for himself meant that he could be his own man.
examples.zh: 他自己单干表明他能独立自主。

senses.def: to be free to make your own decisions rather than being told what to do by somebody else
to be the cause of your own problems
senses.zh: 自讨苦吃；是自己问题的根源

examples.en: Her indecisiveness makes her her own worst enemy.
examples.zh: 她的优柔寡断使她成为自己最大的敌人。

examples.en: Some dancers become their own worst enemies, criticizing themselves for every imperfection.
examples.zh: 一些舞者总是因每一处不完美而责备自己，成了他们自己最大的敌人。

senses.def: to be a plan or project that somebody is responsible for and cares about because they have created it
senses.zh: （计划或项目）就像某人的孩子一样（因亲自制订而尽心负责）

senses.def: to act naturally

examples.en: Don't act sophisticated—just be yourself.
examples.zh: 不要装得老成持重，表现出你平常的样子就行了。

senses.def: to not know or understand what is happening in a particular subject or area
senses.zh: 不了解，不懂得（某课题或领域）的情况

examples.en: Unfortunately, the people making the decisions are out of touch with the real world.
examples.zh: 令人遗憾的是，做决策的人脱离了实际。

examples.en: This government is increasingly out of touch with ordinary voters.
examples.zh: 这届政府越来越不能体察普通选民的情况了。

senses.def: to be working or functioning

examples.en: The new working methods will come on line in June.
examples.zh: 新的操作方法将在六月实行。

senses.def: to almost do something

examples.en: They came within a whisker of being killed.
examples.zh: 他们险些丢了性命。

senses.def: to be, feel, look, taste, etc. very bad
senses.zh: 感到（或显得、尝起来等）非常糟糕，非常难受

senses.def: to communicate with somebody, especially by writing to them or phoning them

examples.en: Are you still in touch with your friends from college?
examples.zh: 你和大学的同学还有联系吗？

examples.en: Thanks for showing us your products—we'll be in touch.
examples.zh: 谢谢给我们介绍你们的产品，我们将会保持联系。

examples.en: I'm trying to get in touch with Jane. Do you have her number?
examples.zh: 我正在设法和简取得联系。你有她的电话号码吗？

examples.en: Let's keep in touch.
examples.zh: 咱们保持联系。

examples.en: I'll put you in touch with someone in your area.
examples.zh: 我将安排你和你那个地区的一个人进行联系。

examples.en: The security staff were in close touch with the local police.
examples.zh: 保安人员与当地警方保持密切联系。

senses.def: to know what is happening in a particular subject or area
senses.zh: 了解（某课题或领域的情况）

examples.en: It is important to keep in touch with the latest research.
examples.zh: 及时了解最新研究情况很重要。

be, keep, etc. in touch (with something).word: be, keep, etc. in touch (with something)

senses.def: to be in a normal state of health or happiness
senses.zh: 身体（或心情）一切正常；如平时一样

examples.en: She didn't seem quite herself this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上好像有点不太对劲。

senses.def: not influenced by other people

examples.en: She needed space to be herself.
examples.zh: 她需要自己的独立空间。

senses.def: to be in a normal state of health or happiness
senses.zh: 身体（或心情）一切正常；如平时一样

examples.en: He didn't seem quite himself this morning.
examples.zh: 他今天上午似乎有点不对劲。

senses.def: not influenced by other people

examples.en: He needed space to be himself.
examples.zh: 他需要自己的独立空间。

senses.def: if you are bombed out
senses.zh: （家园）被炸毁；被炸得无家可归

examples.en: a programme of house-building for those who were bombed out of their homes
examples.zh: 为那些住房被炸毁的人修建住房的计划

senses.def: if a building is bombed out

examples.en: a bombed-out warehouse
examples.zh: 被炸毁的仓库

senses.def: to be left somewhere after a shipwreck
to be sad or unhappy about something
to become involved in something, especially when you do not want to be

examples.en: Innocent passers-by got caught up in the riots.
examples.zh: 无辜的过路人被卷入了那场暴乱。

senses.def: to be full of or completely covered with people, insects or animals, in a way that is unpleasant

examples.en: The place was crawling with journalists.
examples.zh: 这地方挤满了记者。

examples.en: Her hair was crawling with lice.
examples.zh: 她的头发上爬满了虱子。

senses.def: to lie or sit with your back curved and your arms and legs bent close to your body

examples.en: She curled up and closed her eyes.
examples.zh: 她蜷成一团，闭上了眼睛。

examples.en: He was lying curled up on the bed.
examples.zh: 他蜷缩着躺在床上。

senses.def: to continuously suffer from or be affected by something bad
senses.zh: 不断因…而遭殃；为…所苦；受…之害

examples.en: She seems cursed with bad luck.
examples.zh: 她好像运气不好连连遭殃。

senses.def: to have the qualities and abilities needed for something
senses.zh: 具有所需素质及才能；是…的材料

examples.en: He's not cut out for teaching.
examples.zh: 他不适于做教学工作。

examples.en: He's not cut out to be a teacher.
examples.zh: 他不是当教师的材料。

senses.def: to have the qualities and abilities needed for something
senses.zh: 具有所需素质及才能；是…的材料

examples.en: He's not cut out for teaching.
examples.zh: 他不适于做教学工作。

examples.en: He's not cut out to be a teacher.
examples.zh: 他不是当教师的材料。

senses.def: to come or develop from something

examples.en: The word ‘politics’ is derived from a Greek word meaning ‘city’.
examples.zh: politics 一词源自希腊语，意思是 city。

senses.def: to be related to somebody who lived a long time ago

examples.en: He claims to be descended from a Spanish prince.
examples.zh: 他声称是一位西班牙王子的后裔。

examples.en: The breed is almost directly descended from the Eurasian wild boar.
examples.zh: 这一品种几乎是欧亚野猪的直系后代。

senses.def: to put on special clothes, especially to pretend to be somebody/something different

examples.en: Kids love dressing up.
examples.zh: 孩子们都喜欢装扮游戏。

examples.en: The boys were all dressed up as pirates.
examples.zh: 这些男孩子都装扮成了海盗。

examples.en: dressing-up clothes
examples.zh: 孩子装扮玩的服装

examples.en: dress-up clothes
examples.zh: 孩子装扮玩的服装

senses.def: to naturally have a particular feature, quality, etc.
senses.zh: 天生赋有，生来具有（某种特性、品质等）

examples.en: She was endowed with intelligence and wit.
examples.zh: 她天资聪颖。

examples.en: The stones are believed to be endowed with magical powers.
examples.zh: 人们认为这些石头具有神奇的力量。

senses.def: to be looking for an opportunity to blame or attack somebody

examples.en: I don’t want your father gunning for me if we’re back late.
examples.zh: 如果我们回来晚了，我不想让你父亲向我开枪。

senses.def: to be competing for or trying hard to get something
senses.zh: 竭力谋求，力图获取，寻求（某物）

examples.en: She's gunning for the top job.
examples.zh: 她正竭力谋取最高职位。

senses.def: to be likely to experience something bad
senses.zh: 很可能遭受（不幸）；会招致

examples.en: They look as though they're heading for divorce.
examples.zh: 他们看样子会离婚。

senses.def: to hide in a place

examples.en: He'll hole up now and move again tomorrow, after dark.
examples.zh: 他现在会躲起来，等明天天黑以后再动身。

examples.en: We believe the gang are holed up in the mountains.
examples.zh: 我们认为那帮匪徒躲藏在山里。

senses.def: to be closely connected with somebody/something

examples.en: The Church became increasingly identified with opposition to the regime.
examples.zh: 教会日益和反对政权的势力走到一起。

examples.en: The policy is closely identified with the President himself.
examples.zh: 这项政策被认为与总统本人有密切关联。

examples.en: Great orchestras came to be identified increasingly with German conductors.
examples.zh: 杰出的交响乐团越来越被认为是德国指挥的功劳。

senses.def: to remain when all that is needed has been used

examples.en: There was lots of food left over.
examples.zh: 饭菜剩下了不少。

senses.def: to know about what somebody has done wrong

examples.en: She knew the police would be onto them.
examples.zh: 她知道警方将追查他们。

senses.def: to be talking to somebody, usually in order to ask or tell them something

examples.en: They've been onto me for ages to get a job.
examples.zh: 很久以来，他们一直催促我找份工作。

senses.def: to know about something or be in a situation that could lead to a good result for you
senses.zh: 了解；掌握；处于有利地位

examples.en: Scientists believe they are onto something big.
examples.zh: 科学家相信，他们将会有重大发现。

examples.en: She's onto a good thing with that new job.
examples.zh: 她在新工作中将大有作为。

senses.def: if people are said to be queuing up

examples.en: Italian football clubs are queuing up to sign the young star.
examples.zh: 意大利的足球俱乐部都抢着要与这个年轻球星签约。

senses.def: to be cancelled or to have to stop because it is raining

examples.en: The game has been rained off again.
examples.zh: 比赛又一次因雨而被取消。

senses.def: to punish or hurt somebody because they have made you suffer

examples.en: She vowed to be revenged on them all.
examples.zh: 她发誓一定要报复他们所有人。

examples.en: Macduff declares his intention to revenge himself on Macbeth.
examples.zh: 麦克德夫宣布他打算向麦克白报仇。

senses.def: to start/be living with somebody that you have a sexual relationship with, but that you are not married to

examples.en: I hear he's shacked up with his girlfriend.
examples.zh: 听说他和他女朋友同居了

senses.def: to have something important taken away from you

examples.en: Shorn of his power, the deposed king went into exile.
examples.zh: 权力被褫夺后，遭废黜的国王流亡国外。

senses.def: to be all sold

examples.en: The tickets sold out within hours.
examples.zh: 几小时内票就卖光了。

examples.en: This week's performances are completely sold out.
examples.zh: 本周的演出门票全部售完。

senses.def: to have sold all the available items, tickets, etc.
senses.zh: 售空，卖光（某种商品、门票等）；脱销

examples.en: I'm sorry, we've sold out of bread.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我们的面包卖完了。

examples.en: We are already sold out for what should be a fantastic game.
examples.zh: 想来这场比赛一定精彩，我们的门票已经卖光了。

senses.def: to be giving all your time and energy to something/somebody
senses.zh: 致力于；专心于；对…一心一意

examples.en: She’s completely taken up with preparing for her exams.
examples.zh: 她全神贯注地准备考试。

senses.def: to find somebody/something attractive or interesting

examples.en: We were all very taken with his girlfriend.
examples.zh: 我们都觉得他的女朋友非常讨人喜欢。

examples.en: I think he's quite taken with the idea.
examples.zh: 我认为他对这个想法十分感兴趣。

senses.def: to be full of people, cars, etc.

examples.en: The cafes were thronging with students.
examples.zh: 各个小餐馆里都挤满了学生。

examples.en: The streets were thronged with people.
examples.zh: 条条大街都挤满了人。

senses.def: to behave in a way that is suitable for somebody of your age and not as though you were much younger
senses.zh: 行为和年龄相称；举止不再有孩子气

examples.en: Isn’t it time you started acting your age?
examples.zh: 你难道不应该开始表现得像个成年人了吗？

senses.def: to behave or do things in a particular manner because it is part of your character

examples.en: It's not his fault he's so pompous—he was born that way.
examples.zh: 他如此自命不凡并不是他的错，他天生就是这种性格。

senses.def: to be/become somebody that other people laugh at
senses.zh: 是嘲笑的对象；成为笑柄

senses.def: to finish a long way behind the winner in a race, competition, etc.

be/come a poor second, third, etc..word: be/come a poor second, third, etc.

senses.def: to be in operation or available

examples.en: The new computer system comes on stream next month.
examples.zh: 新的计算机系统下月投入使用。

senses.def: used to say that something that somebody does is like a punishment
senses.zh: （表示所做的事无异于惩罚）自作自受，活该

examples.en: She works with us in Accounts, for her sins!
examples.zh: 她跟我们一样也在财务室做事，活该如此！

senses.def: to be killed and eaten by another animal or bird

examples.en: Many small birds and rodents fall prey to the domestic cat.
examples.zh: 许多小鸟和啮齿动物成为家猫的猎物。

senses.def: to be harmed or affected by something bad

examples.en: Since the attack, he had fallen prey to irrational fears.
examples.zh: 自从袭击发生以来，他一直陷入非理性的恐惧之中。

examples.en: She knew she must not fall prey to his charm.
examples.zh: 她清楚自己绝不可以被他迷住。

examples.en: The new government has fallen prey to corruption and fraud.
examples.zh: 新一届政府深受腐败与欺诈之苦。

senses.def: to be pleased because somebody has made you feel important or special
senses.zh: 被奉承得高兴；感到荣幸

examples.en: He was flattered by her attention.
examples.zh: 她的关注使他感到格外高兴。

examples.en: I felt flattered at being asked to give a lecture.
examples.zh: 承蒙邀请来演讲，我深感荣幸。

examples.en: She was flattered to hear that he had been asking about her.
examples.zh: 听说他一直在打听她，她颇感得意。

examples.en: I suppose we should be flattered that he agreed to come at all.
examples.zh: 我想我们应该为他同意来而感到受宠若惊。

senses.def: to be or feel unfairly treated
senses.zh: 受到不公平待遇；感到委屈

examples.en: She has every right to feel hard done by—her parents have given her nothing.
examples.zh: 她完全有理由觉得委屈，她父母什么都没给她。

senses.def: to feel proud and happy

examples.en: I was honored to have been mentioned in his speech.
examples.zh: 他在讲话中提到了我，真是荣幸。

examples.en: ‘Would you be my best man?’ ‘I'd be honored.’
examples.zh: “你愿意做我的伴郎吗？”“我很荣幸。”

senses.def: to feel proud and happy

examples.en: I was honoured to have been mentioned in his speech.
examples.zh: 他在讲话中提到了我，真是荣幸。

examples.en: ‘Would you be my best man?’ ‘I’d be honoured.’
examples.zh: “你愿意做我的伴郎吗？”“我很荣幸。”

senses.def: to feel weak because you are nervous

be/feel like jelly | turn to jelly.word: be/feel like jelly | turn to jelly

senses.def: to be sad or feel sympathy for somebody

examples.en: He decided to help Jan as he felt sorry for her.
examples.zh: 他同情简的遭遇，决定帮助她。

senses.def: to be or get very annoyed
to be/become very angry or excited about something

examples.en: You’re getting all steamed up about nothing!
examples.zh: 你对任何事情都感到气愤！

senses.def: to become annoying and no longer acceptable
senses.zh: 超出开玩笑的限度（令人恼火或无法接受）

examples.en: His teasing is getting beyond a joke.
examples.zh: 他的戏弄已经超出了玩笑的范围。

senses.def: to get very excited or lose control of your feelings
senses.zh: 变得很激动；失去自制力

examples.en: I got carried away and started shouting at the television.
examples.zh: 我激动得不能自持，冲着电视机大叫起来。

senses.def: to be involved in an argument or fight between two other people or groups
senses.zh: （在两方的争吵或冲突中）被夹在中间，左右为难

examples.en: When they quarrel, I am often caught in the middle.
examples.zh: 他们争吵时，我常常夹在中间左右为难。

senses.def: to be caught and punished for doing something illegal but not too serious

examples.en: I got done for speeding on my way back.
examples.zh: 我在返回的路上因超速行驶而受罚。

be/get done for something/for doing some.word: be/get done for something/for doing something

senses.def: to cause somebody the same amount of trouble or harm as they have caused you
senses.zh: （向某人）报复；（跟某人）算账，扯平

examples.en: I'll get even with you for this, just you wait.
examples.zh: 这事我会找你算账的，等着瞧吧。

senses.def: to be/become anxious or frightened about something
to be/become involved in something; to share or know about something

examples.en: I'd like to be in on the plan.
examples.zh: 我很想参与这项计划。

examples.en: Is she in on the secret?
examples.zh: 她知道这个秘密吗？

senses.def: to be/become involved in an activity that somebody else has started, especially to get something for yourself

examples.en: Other manufacturers are getting in on the act, creating their own versions of the popular toy.
examples.zh: 其他制造商也加入了这一行列，创造了自己版本的流行玩具。

senses.def: to become involved in a plan, project, etc. at the beginning

be/get in on the ground floor.word: be/get in on the ground floor

senses.def: to be/become involved in something, especially something illegal or dishonest
senses.zh: 卷入（不正当的事）；与某事有牵连

examples.en: Don't tell me you're mixed up in all of this?
examples.zh: 别告诉我你卷入了这一切？

senses.def: to be/become friendly with or involved with somebody that other people do not approve of
senses.zh: 与（不适合的人）交往；和某人厮混

examples.en: He got mixed up with a crowd who were into drugs and crime.
examples.zh: 他与一群吸毒和犯罪的人混在一起。

senses.def: to behave in a way that shows you think you are better than other people
senses.zh: 趾高气扬；自命不凡；自以为了不起

be/get out of line: @@@LINK=step out of line | be/get out of line

senses.def: to be/become less good at doing something than you were because you have not spent time doing it recently

examples.en: Don't ask me to speak French! I'm out of practice.
examples.zh: 可别让我讲法语！我已经生疏了。

examples.en: If you don't play regularly you soon get out of practice.
examples.zh: 如果不经常演奏，你很快就会荒疏。

senses.def: to get rid of somebody/something so you no longer have the problems they cause

examples.en: I'll be glad to get shot of this car.
examples.zh: 我巴不得处理掉这辆车呢。

examples.en: By the end of the week I just couldn’t wait to get shot of them.
examples.zh: 到了周末，我已经迫不及待地想拍摄它们了。

senses.def: to become or feel nervous or worried so that you cannot relax

intro.en: These words all mean to have a strong feeling of dislike for somebody/​something.

items.def: to have a strong feeling of dislike for somebody/​something. Although hate is generally a very strong verb, it is also commonly used in spoken or informal English to talk about people or things that you dislike in a less important way, for example a particular type of food:
items.zh: 尽管 hate 通常为语气很强的动词，但亦常用于口语或非正式英语中，谈论不太喜欢的人或物，如某种食物等

items.def: (rather formal) to not like somebody/​something. Dislike is a rather formal word; it is less formal, and more usual, to say that you don't like somebody/​something, especially in spoken English:

examples.zh: 什么也比不上家里的饭菜。

examples.en: You can't beat Italian shoes.
examples.zh: 意大利鞋是无与伦比的。

examples.en: For a break in the sun, Thailand is hard to beat.
examples.zh: 去阳光充足的地方短期度假，哪儿都比不上泰国。

examples.en: They want to beat the speed record (= go faster than anyone before).
examples.zh: 他们想打破这一速度纪录。

examples.en: This is his latest attempt to beat the world record.
examples.zh: 这是他最近一次尝试打破世界纪录。

senses.def: to get control of something

examples.en: The government's main aim is to beat inflation.
examples.zh: 政府的主要目标是抑制通货膨胀。

senses.def: to be too difficult for somebody

examples.en: It is a problem that beats even the experts.
examples.zh: 这个问题连专家都难以解答。

examples.en: It beats me (= I don't know) why he did it.
examples.zh: 我弄不懂他为什么这样做。

examples.en: What beats me (= what I don't understand) is how it was done so quickly.
examples.zh: 我想不明白的是，怎么完成得这么快。

examples.en: ‘Where's she gone?’ ‘Beats me.’
examples.zh: “她去哪儿了？”“你问倒我了。”

senses.def: to avoid something

examples.en: If we go early we should beat the traffic.
examples.zh: 我们早点出发应该就可以避开交通拥挤。

examples.zh: 我们很早就起床出发了，趁天还没热。

senses.def: to hit a person hard and many times in order to hurt them

examples.zh: 那时候孩子们常常因为很小的过错而挨打。

examples.en: A man was found beaten to death.
examples.zh: 一名男子被发现殴打致死。

examples.en: The prisoners were beaten into submission (= they were beaten until they did what was wanted).
examples.zh: 公司为员工提供医疗保险补助。

examples.en: They beat him unconscious (= hit him until he became unconscious).
examples.zh: 他们把他打得不省人事。

examples.en: The men took him out into the street and beat him senseless.
examples.zh: 这些人把他带到街上，把他打得不省人事。

senses.def: to hit something hard several times

examples.en: Somebody was beating at the door.
examples.zh: 有人在捶门。

examples.en: Hailstones beat against the window.
examples.zh: 冰雹不断地砸在窗户上。

examples.en: Someone was beating a drum.
examples.zh: 有人在敲鼓。

examples.en: I was beating dust out of the rugs (= removing dust from the rugs by beating them).
examples.zh: 我正在敲打地毯上的灰尘（=通过敲打地毯来去除地毯上的灰尘）。

examples.zh: 她没死，她的心还在跳动。

examples.zh: 他的心跳开始加快。

examples.en: We heard the drums beating.
examples.zh: 我们听到击鼓声。

examples.en: The bird was beating its wings (= moving them up and down) frantically.
examples.zh: 鸟儿拼命地扑着翅膀。

examples.zh: 把鸡蛋打成黏稠泡沫状。

examples.zh: 充分搅打混合物，直到它像奶油一样轻滑细软。

examples.zh: 那块金属被锤平了。

examples.zh: 猎人们在灌木丛中踩出了一条小径。
