senses.zh: 棕色间杂其他花纹（或斑点）的

senses.def: water that contains a lot of salt, used especially for preserving food

examples.en: a can of tuna in brine
examples.zh: 一罐盐水金枪鱼

senses.def: to come to a place with somebody/something

examples.en: Don't forget to bring your books with you.
examples.zh: 别忘了把书带来。

examples.en: Can we bring the children?
examples.zh: 我们可以带小孩吗？

examples.en: She brought her boyfriend to the party.
examples.zh: 她带着男朋友去参加聚会。

examples.en: Bring a present for Helen.
examples.zh: 给海伦带件礼物来。

examples.en: Bring Helen a present.
examples.zh: 给海伦带件礼物来。

senses.def: to give or provide somebody/something with something

examples.en: They brought us some good news.
examples.zh: 他们给我们带来了好消息。

examples.en: We'll bring you the election results as soon as we have them.
examples.zh: 我们一收到选举结果就会立即向您提供。

examples.en: His writing brings him $10 000 a year.
examples.zh: 写作每年为他赚 1 万元。

examples.en: The team's new manager brings ten years' experience to the job.
examples.zh: 该队的新经理到任时已有十年的相关经验。

senses.def: to cause something

examples.en: The revolution brought many changes.
examples.zh: 这场革命导致很多变化。

examples.en: The news brought tears to his eyes (= made him cry).
examples.zh: 这个消息使他不禁流下泪来。

examples.en: Retirement often brings with it a massive drop in income.
examples.zh: 收入常随退休而大幅下降。

senses.def: to cause somebody/something to be in a particular condition or place
senses.zh: 使处于某种状况；使到某地

examples.en: to bring a meeting to an end
examples.zh: 结束会议

examples.en: to bring an end to the conflict
examples.zh: 结束冲突

examples.en: No one has worked harder to bring peace to the region.
examples.zh: 没有人比谁更努力地为该地区带来和平。

examples.en: Bring the water to the boil.
examples.zh: 把水烧开。

examples.en: They have taken on six more staff, bringing the total to 45.
examples.zh: 他们又增加了 6 名员工，使员工总数达到 45 人。

examples.en: The issue was only brought to my attention this morning.
examples.zh: 这个问题直到今天早晨才引起我的注意。

examples.en: Mismanagement had brought the company to the brink of bankruptcy.
examples.zh: 由于管理不善，公司一度濒临破产。

examples.en: His travels brought him into contact with many famous artists.
examples.zh: 他在旅行中接触到许多著名的艺术家。

examples.en: Publication of the article brought her into conflict with the authorities.
examples.zh: 这篇文章的发表使她与当局发生了冲突。

examples.en: Hello Simon! What brings you here?
examples.zh: 你好，西蒙！什么风把你吹来了？

senses.def: used to move a speech or piece of writing on from one point to the next

examples.en: This brings me to the second point I'd like to make:…
examples.zh: 由此，我将说到第二点：…

senses.def: to make somebody/something move in a particular direction or way
senses.zh: 使朝（某方向或按某方式）移动

examples.en: The judge brought her hammer down on the table.
examples.zh: 法官把锤子放在桌子上。

examples.en: His cries brought the neighbours running (= made them run to him).
examples.zh: 他的哭声让邻居们跑了（=让他们跑向他）。

senses.def: to start legal action against somebody/something; to make somebody/something answer a case in court

examples.en: to bring charges/legal action/proceedings against somebody
examples.zh: 控告某人；对某人提起诉讼；控告某人

examples.en: The decision comes in a case brought by the residents of a small town in Alabama.
examples.zh: 这是对亚拉巴马州一小镇的居民所提诉讼的判决。

senses.def: to force yourself to do something

examples.en: She could not bring herself to tell him the news.
examples.zh: 她难以开口把这个消息告诉他。

senses.def: to make a great effort and perform well

examples.en: We'll show you how Canada brings it!
examples.zh: 我们将向您展示加拿大如何做到这一点！

senses.def: used to express confidence about a challenge
senses.zh: 来吧，放马过来（用于面对挑战时表达自信）

examples.en: We've trained hard and we're ready. Bring it on!
examples.zh: 我们训练刻苦，准备充分。来吧！

examples.zh: 我们将确保通过法庭将欺诈者绳之以法。

examples.zh: 使叛乱分子屈服的非暴力手段

senses.def: to make a dog come close to you
senses.zh: 让狗靠近；唤狗来到身边

senses.def: to make somebody/something more interesting or exciting

examples.en: The new teacher really brought French to life for us.
examples.zh: 新来的老师给我们把法语教得生动活泼。

examples.en: Flowers can bring a dull room back to life.
examples.zh: 鲜花可使沉闷的房间恢复生气。

senses.def: to behave or make somebody/something behave in the same way as other people or how they should behave
senses.zh: 使一致；使规范；使符合；（和…）一致

examples.en: The other members of the board must be brought into line.
examples.zh: 必须使董事会的其他成员保持一致。

examples.en: The actions of investors do not always fall into line with financial theory.
examples.zh: 投资者的行动并不总是符合金融理论。

senses.def: to make something interesting

examples.en: The pictures bring the book alive.
examples.zh: 图片使得这本书生动有趣。

examples.en: The teacher brought history alive with fascinating stories.
examples.zh: 老师用引人入胜的故事生动有趣地讲述了历史。

senses.def: to make somebody realize how important, difficult or serious something is
senses.zh: 使某人了解某事的重要性（或艰难、严重程度）

examples.en: The sight of his pale face brought home to me how ill he really was.
examples.zh: 看到他苍白的脸，我才意识到他病得有多么严重。

examples.en: The television pictures brought home to us the full horror of the attack.
examples.zh: 电视画面使我们充分地了解这次袭击有多么恐怖。

senses.def: to have something as a result

examples.en: Unemployment brings great difficulties in its train.
examples.zh: 失业带来了重重困难。

senses.def: to cause a law, rule, etc. to start being used
senses.zh: （使法律、规则等）开始生效，开始实施

examples.zh: 主席的辞职最终使事情到了紧要关头。

examples.zh: 这场争论最终在当年三月达到了白热化阶段。

examples.zh: 一些护士正式投诉后，事情到了非处理不可的地步了。

senses.zh: 把精力用于；对…施加压力（或影响等）

examples.zh: 我们必须全力以赴不辱使命。

examples.en: Pressure was brought to bear on us to finish the work on time.
examples.zh: 我们得按时完成工作，没有回旋余地。

examples.zh: 燃料短缺使整个国家在几周内陷入了瘫痪。

senses.def: to make new information known to people

examples.zh: 他跟老板关系密切，当然能够升职了。

senses.zh: （1936-59）摇滚乐早期的美国歌手，他弹吉他和写歌。他和他的乐队The Crickets受到了很多好评，包括That'll Be the Day（1957）和Peggy Sue（1957）。尽管他死于飞机失事，享年22岁，但他的音乐对其他流行歌手有很大影响，尤其是在英国。

senses.def: a film in which there is a close friendship between two people
senses.zh: 伙伴电影（两角色之间关系密切）

examples.en: It's a buddy movie about two guys on a road trip.
examples.zh: 这是一部关于两个人公路旅行的兄弟电影。

senses.def: to become friendly with somebody

examples.en: You and your neighbour might want to buddy up to make the trip more enjoyable.
examples.zh: 你同你的邻居或许应该结伴旅游，热闹一点。

senses.zh: （为谋私利）亲近（某人），（和某人）结交

examples.zh: 他总是跟老板套近乎。

senses.def: to move slightly; to make something/somebody move slightly

examples.zh: 她推了推门，但门纹丝不动。

examples.zh: 狗不肯动弹。

examples.zh: 我用尽全力也没把它拽动。

examples.en: He won't budge an inch on the issue.
examples.zh: 在这一点上他丝毫不肯让步。

examples.en: Company executives refused to budge from their position.
examples.zh: 公司高管拒绝改变立场。

examples.en: She was not to be budged on her decision.
examples.zh: 她的决定不容动摇。

examples.en: They would not be budged from their initial asking price.
examples.zh: 他们不会改变最初的要价。

senses.def: to move, so that there is room for other people

examples.zh: 闪开点！

the money that is available to a person or an organization and a plan of how it will be spent over a period of time

examples.en: an annual budget of £10 million
examples.zh: 1 000 万英镑的年度预算

examples.en: a balanced budget (= one where the amount spent matches the amount available)
examples.zh: 平衡的预算

examples.en: Many families struggle to balance the household budget.
examples.zh: 许多家庭艰难地平衡家庭预算。

examples.en: to cut/slash a budget
examples.zh: 削减预算

examples.en: the education/defence budget (= the amount of money that can be spent on this)
examples.zh: 教育／国防预算

examples.en: an advertising budget of $2 million
examples.zh: 预计 200 万美元的广告费

examples.en: It's one of those big-budget Hollywood movies.
examples.zh: 这是一部巨额预算的好莱坞大片。

examples.en: We decorated the house on a tight budget (= without much money to spend).
examples.zh: 我们俭省地装修了房子。

examples.en: The work was finished on time and within budget (= did not cost more money than was planned).
examples.zh: 工作按时完成且未超出预算。

examples.en: They went over budget (= spent too much money).
examples.zh: 他们超出了预算。

examples.en: The project came in under budget.
examples.zh: 这个项目未超出预算。

examples.en: Is there any money left in the budget?
examples.zh: 预算中还有尚未动用的款项吗？

examples.en: The hospital now faces severe budget cuts.
examples.zh: 该医院现在面临着严重的预算削减。

examples.en: a budget surplus/shortfall (= when there is more/less money than is needed)
examples.zh: 预算盈余/短缺

senses.def: an official statement by the government of a country’s income from taxes, etc. and how it will be spent

examples.en: Tax cuts are expected to be a major part of this year's Budget.
examples.zh: 减税预计将成为今年预算的主要部分。

examples.en: a budget deficit (= when the government spends more money than it earns)
examples.zh: 政府预算赤字

examples.en: The finance ministry is trying to reduce the budget deficit.
examples.zh: 财政部正在努力减少预算赤字。

examples.en: Military spending accounts for around 17% of the federal budget.
examples.zh: 军费支出占联邦预算的 17% 左右。

senses.def: to be careful about the amount of money you spend; to plan to spend an amount of money for a particular purpose

examples.zh: 我们精打细算一点，就能够负担这次旅行。

examples.en: I've budgeted for two new members of staff.
examples.zh: 我已经把两名新职员名额编入预算。

examples.en: Ten million euros has been budgeted for the project.
examples.zh: 为该工程已编制了一千万欧元的预算。

examples.en: We have budgeted $10 000 for advertising.
examples.zh: 我们已经在广告方面编制了 1 万美元的预算。

examples.en: The project has been budgeted at ten million euros.
examples.zh: 该工程已制订了一千万欧元的预算。

senses.def: low in price

examples.en: a budget flight/hotel
examples.zh: 便宜的航班／旅馆

examples.en: Save pounds on budget flights to the sun.
examples.zh: 享受阳光，享受特价机票。

intro.en: These words all mean to spend less money.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含存钱、节俭之义。

items.def: to keep money instead of spending it, often in order to buy a particular thing:
items.zh: 常指为了买某物而攒钱、储蓄

examples.en: I’m saving for a new car.
examples.zh: 我正攒钱想买辆新车。

items.def: to be careful about the amount of money you spend; to plan to spend an amount of money for a particular purpose:
items.zh: 指谨慎花钱、把…编入预算

examples.en: If we budget carefully we’ll be able to afford the trip.
examples.zh: 我们精打细算一点，就能够负担这次旅行。

items.def: to use less money, time, etc. than you normally use
items.zh: 指节省、节约、节俭

items.def: (rather informal) to spend less money because there is less available:
items.zh: 指勒紧腰带省吃俭用

examples.en: With the price increases, we are all having to tighten our belts.
examples.zh: 由于物价上涨，我们都只好勒紧裤腰带了。

intro.en: These words all describe a product or service that costs little money or less money than you expected.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指产品或服务花钱少或低于预期。

items.def: costing little money or less money than you expected; charging low prices. Cheap can also be used in a disapproving way to suggest that something is of poor quality as well as low in price:
items.zh: cheap 亦可作贬义，指价低质劣

items.def: (of prices, goods or services) as cheap as or cheaper than those offered by other companies; able to offer goods or services at competitive prices.
items.zh: 指价格、产品或服务收费方面具有竞争力

items.def: [only before noun] (used especially in advertising) cheap because it offers only a basic level of service.
items.zh: 指仅提供基本服务因而价格低廉

items.def: cheap enough for most people to afford.
items.zh: 指多数人买得起或负担得来的

items.def: (of prices) not too expensive.
items.zh: 指价格不太高、公道的

items.def: (rather formal) cheap. Inexpensive is often used to mean that something is good value for its price. It is sometimes used instead of cheap, because cheap can suggest that something is of poor quality.
items.zh: inexpensive 常含物有所值之义，有时用以代替 cheap，因为 cheap 可有质量低劣的含义。

senses.def: an arrangement with a shop or company to pay your bills in fixed regular amounts and not as one large payment
senses.zh: 预算账户（作定期付账之用）

senses.def: connected with a budget

examples.en: budgetary control/policies/reform
examples.zh: 预算控制／政策／改革

examples.en: Industrial expansion could solve the regime’s chronic budgetary problems.
examples.zh: 工业扩张可以解决该政权长期存在的预算问题。

examples.en: The new accounting procedures will improve budgetary control.
examples.zh: 这套新的会计程序可以更好地进行预算管控。

intro.en: These words all describe activities or situations that are connected with the use of money, especially by a business or country.
intro.zh: 以上各词尤用于企业或国家的经济活动或状况。

items.def: connected with the trade, industry and development of wealth of a country, an area or a society:
items.zh: 指国家、地区或社会经济的、经济上的、经济学的

examples.en: This book deals with the social, economic and political issues of the period.
examples.zh: 这本书论及了那个时期的社会、经济和政治问题。

items.def: connected with money and finance:
items.zh: 指财政的、财务的、金融的

examples.en: She had got into financial difficulties.
examples.zh: 她陷入了财务困境。

items.def: connected with the buying and selling of goods and services.
items.zh: 指贸易的、商业的

items.def: (formal or finance) connected with money, especially all the money in a country:
items.zh: 指货币的、钱的，尤指一国的货币

examples.en: closer European monetary union
examples.zh: 更为紧密的欧洲货币联盟

items.def: (finance) connected with a budget (= the money available or a plan of how it will be spent).
items.zh: 指财政预算的

senses.def: a person who is very interested in a particular subject or activity and knows a lot about it

examples.en: a film/movie/history buff
examples.zh: 影迷；历史迷

examples.en: an opera buff
examples.zh: 歌剧爱好者

examples.en: They were a group of computer buffs who used to meet every Thursday evening.
examples.zh: 他们是一群电脑爱好者，每周四晚上都会聚会。

examples.zh: 一些武器将在下次更新中获得增益。

pale yellow-brown in colour

examples.zh: 浅黄褐色信封

senses.zh: 健美（或健壮）而肌肉发达的

examples.zh: 他是一个三十多岁的高个子、肌肉发达的小伙子。

examples.zh: 开发人员在最新版本中对剑进行了抛光。

examples.zh: 她已被抛光以增加她可以造成的伤害。

examples.zh: 他为饰演这个突击队队长的角色练出了一身肌肉。

examples.zh: 这支队伍必须改善其受损的形象。

examples.en: The city spent $40 million buffing up the downtown area before the festival.
examples.zh: 节日前，该市斥资 4000 万美元对市中心进行了修缮。

senses.zh: 布法罗（美国纽约州工业城市，位于伊利湖东端）

senses.zh: 布法罗·比尔（Buffalo Bill）：威廉·科迪（William Cody，1846-1917年）的通名，是美国边防人员和（后来的）艺人。他杀死了许多水牛，为堪萨斯太平洋铁路上的工人提供肉食。1860年，他还是小马快车（Pony Express）的骑手。内德·邦特琳（Ned Buntline）通过在自己的一毛钱小说中写出自己的生平故事而闻名。在1870年代，布法罗·比尔（Buffalo Bill）组织了自己的“狂野西部秀”，以娱乐美国和欧洲的观众。

senses.def: chicken wings cooked in a spicy sauce

examples.en: a marinade for spicy Buffalo wings
examples.zh: 辣水牛翅的腌料

senses.def: a thing or person that reduces a shock or protects somebody/something against difficulties
senses.zh: 缓冲物；起缓冲作用的人

examples.en: Support from family and friends acts as a buffer against stress.
examples.zh: 家庭和朋友的支持有助于减缓压力。

examples.en: She often had to act as a buffer between father and son.
examples.zh: 她常常不得不在父子之间扮演调解人角色。

examples.en: The organization acts as a buffer between the management and the union.
examples.zh: 这个组织在资方与工会之间起缓冲作用。

examples.en: a buffer state (= a small country between two powerful states that helps keep peace between them)
examples.zh: 缓冲国（两大国之间有助于维持和平的小国家）

examples.en: a buffer zone (= an area of land between two opposing armies or countries)
examples.zh: 缓冲区（两敌对军队或国家之间的地区）

examples.en: Peacekeepers have been sent in to establish a buffer zone between the rival forces.
examples.zh: 已经派遣维和部队在交战双方之间建立缓冲带。

senses.def: one of two round metal devices on the front or end of a train, or at the end of a railway track, that reduce the shock if the train hits something
senses.zh: （火车头尾或轨道末端的）减震器，缓冲器

senses.def: an area in a computer’s memory where data can be stored for a short time
senses.zh: 缓存区；缓冲存储区；缓冲器

if a plan, somebody’s career, etc. hits the buffers

examples.en: The former tennis star’s comeback trail hit the buffers yesterday when she lost in straight sets.
examples.zh: 这位前网球明星的复出之路昨天遭遇了挫折，因为她直落两盘失利。

senses.def: to reduce the harmful effects of something

examples.en: to buffer the effects of stress on health
examples.zh: 减少压力对健康的影响

senses.def: to protect somebody/yourself from something

examples.en: They tried to buffer themselves against problems and uncertainties.
examples.zh: 他们尽力保护自己免受困难和不确定因素的影响。

senses.def: to hold data for a short time before using it
if a plan, somebody’s career, etc. hits the buffers

examples.en: The former tennis star’s comeback trail hit the buffers yesterday when she lost in straight sets.
examples.zh: 这位前网球明星的复出之路昨天遭遇了挫折，因为她直落两盘失利。

senses.def: a meal at which people serve themselves from a table and then stand or sit somewhere else to eat

examples.en: a buffet lunch/supper
examples.zh: 自助午餐／晚餐

examples.en: Dinner will be a cold buffet, not a sit-down meal.
examples.zh: 主餐是自助冷食，不是坐着等服务员送来的那种。

examples.en: a finger buffet (= food that you can eat with your hands, not with a knife and fork)
examples.zh: （常指在特殊場合客人站著）用手抓著吃的自助餐

the part of a train where you can buy something to eat and drink
a piece of furniture in a dining room
to knock or push somebody/something roughly from side to side

examples.en: to be buffeted by the wind
examples.zh: 被风吹得左右摇摆

examples.en: The nation had been buffeted by a wave of strikes.
examples.zh: 罢工浪潮使这个国家受到了重创。

senses.def: the part of a train where you can buy something to eat and drink
a person who does silly things that make people laugh
behaviour that is silly but makes people laugh
senses.zh: 愚蠢的行为：愚蠢但让人发笑的行为

senses.def: a US television series (1997-2003) about a teenage girl, Buffy Summers, played by Sarah Michelle Gellar, who has special abilities that help her to fight against vampires
senses.zh: 吸血鬼猎人巴菲：美国电视连续剧（1997年至2003年），由莎拉·米歇尔·盖拉（Sarah Michelle Gellar）饰演，讲述一个十几岁的女孩布菲·萨默斯（Buffy Summers）的特殊能力，可以帮助她与吸血鬼抗争，在她的高中朋友的帮助下。这些节目融合了恐怖，浪漫，战斗场面和喜剧元素。

senses.def: any small insect

examples.en: There's a bug crawling up your arm.
examples.zh: 有一只虫子爬上你的手臂。

senses.def: an illness that is usually fairly mild but spreads easily from person to person

examples.en: a flu bug
examples.zh: 流感

examples.en: There's a stomach bug going round (= people are catching it from each other).
examples.zh: 现在流行一种肠胃传染病。

examples.en: I picked up a bug in the office.
examples.zh: 我在办公室被传染了疾病。

examples.en: He's off work with a flu bug.
examples.zh: 他因为得了流感不能上班。

senses.def: an enthusiastic interest in something such as a sport or a hobby

examples.en: He's been bitten by the travel bug.
examples.zh: 他迷上了旅游。

examples.en: She was never interested in fitness before but now she's been bitten by the bug.
examples.zh: 她以前从来不在乎健身，现在却着了迷。

senses.def: a fault in a machine, especially in a computer system or program

examples.zh: 这个软件有很多漏洞。

examples.en: My computer's really slow at the moment—it must be some kind of bug.
examples.zh: 我的计算机现在速度特别慢，一定是出了什么故障。

senses.def: a small hidden device for listening to other people’s conversations

examples.zh: 他们在他的酒店房间里安了一个窃听器。

senses.def: to put a special device (= a bug

examples.zh: 他们在她的旅馆房间里装了窃听器。

examples.zh: 他们在窃听他的电话交谈。

examples.en: A mobile phone can be used as a bugging device even when it is switched off.
examples.zh: 即使手机处于关机状态，也可以用作窃听设备。

senses.def: to annoy somebody

examples.zh: 别烦我了！

examples.zh: 那事使我最近一直大伤脑筋。

examples.zh: 她真的开始烦他了。

examples.en: What's the matter? Is there something bugging you?
examples.zh: 怎么了？有什么事烦你吗？

senses.def: to annoy somebody very much

examples.zh: 这首歌真他妈的烦死我了。

intro.zh: 以上各词均表示健康问题。

items.def: a medical problem affecting humans, animals or plants, often caused by infection:
items.zh: 常指人、动植物感染的病、疾病

examples.zh: 他患有一种罕见的血液病。

items.def: a medical problem, or a period of suffering from one:
items.zh: 指病、疾病或患病期

examples.en: She died after a long illness.
examples.zh: 她久病不愈而亡。

items.def: (rather formal) a condition that causes problems with the way part of the body or brain works:
items.zh: 失调症（disorder）一种导致身体或大脑部分工作方式出现问题的病症：

examples.en: a rare disorder of the liver
examples.zh: 一种罕见的肝病

items.def: an illness that is caused by bacteria or a virus and that affects one part of the body:

examples.en: a throat infection
examples.zh: 喉部感染

items.def: a medical problem that you have for a long time because it is not possible to cure it:
items.zh: 指因不可治愈而长期患有的疾病

examples.zh: 和你做买卖很愉快。

examples.en: There will be some changes to the way we conduct business.
examples.zh: 我们开展业务的方式将会发生一些变化。

examples.zh: 她已经开店当理发师。

examples.en: When he left school, he went into business with his brother.
examples.zh: 他毕业后和他哥哥去经商了。

examples.zh: 音乐／娱乐／电影行业

examples.en: the insurance/banking business
examples.zh: 保险/银行业务

examples.en: the food/restaurant/hotel business
examples.zh: 食品/餐厅/酒店业务

examples.en: Retail is a tough business.
examples.zh: 零售业是一个难做的行业。

examples.en: She works in the software business.
examples.zh: 她从事软件行业。

examples.en: We need to concentrate on our core business (= the main thing that our business does).

senses.def: work that is part of your job

examples.en: business travel/travellers

senses.def: the amount of work done by a company, etc.; the rate or quality of this work

examples.zh: 生意兴隆。

examples.en: Business was bad.
examples.zh: 生意不景气。

examples.en: Her job was to drum up (= increase) business.
examples.zh: 她的工作是提高营业额。

examples.en: How's business?
examples.zh: 生意如何？

examples.en: Uncertainty is bad for business.
examples.zh: 不确定性对生意有害。

examples.en: to be good for business
examples.zh: 对生意有利

examples.en: If we close down for repairs, we’ll lose business.
examples.zh: 如果停业整修，我们会失去生意的。

senses.def: a commercial organization such as a company, shop or factory
senses.zh: 商业机构；企业；公司；商店；工厂

examples.en: an organization that represents small businesses
examples.zh: 代表小企业的组织

examples.en: She works in the family business.
examples.zh: 她在家族的企业工作。

examples.en: We try to support local businesses.
examples.zh: 我们努力支持本地企业。

examples.en: a successful/profitable business

examples.en: a retail/an online business
examples.zh: 零售店；网店

examples.en: to run/start a business
examples.zh: 经营／创办企业

examples.en: to grow/expand/build a business
examples.zh: 发展／扩张／建设企业

examples.en: He wanted to expand the export side of the business.
examples.zh: 他想扩大出口业务。

senses.def: something that a particular person or organization is responsible for
senses.zh: 归（某人或某机构）管的事；职责

examples.en: It is the business of the police to protect the community.
examples.zh: 警察的职责是保护社会。

examples.en: I shall make it my business to find out who is responsible.
examples.zh: 我要亲自查出是谁的责任。

examples.en: My private life is none of your business (= not something that you need to know about).
examples.zh: 我的私生活与你无关。

examples.en: It's no business of hers who I invite to the party.
examples.zh: 我邀请谁参加聚会不关她的事。

examples.en: Keep your nose out of my business!
examples.zh: 不要多管我的事！

examples.zh: 他还要处理一些尚未了结的事务。

examples.zh: 会议的主要议题

examples.en: They should leave the business of making policy to the experts.
examples.zh: 他们应该把制定政策的工作留给专家。

examples.zh: 那次飞机坠毁是十分可怕的事。

examples.en: I found the whole business very depressing.
examples.zh: 我觉得整件事令人沮丧。

examples.en: The business of the missing tickets hasn't been sorted out.
examples.zh: 遗失票这件事还没解决呢。

examples.zh: 感谢您光顾本店。

senses.zh: （会议结束前）议程以外的议题

examples.zh: 我想我们已经讨论完第四项。还有其他要讨论的吗？

to have everything that you need in order to be able to start something immediately

examples.zh: 我们所需要的只是一辆车，然后我们就准备就绪了。

senses.def: to regard a particular activity as an essential part of what you do
senses.zh: 把…作为重要业务；主要从事

examples.zh: 不管哪儿的餐馆老板都重视建立关系。

senses.def: a way of saying that things will continue as normal despite a difficult situation
senses.zh: （尽管处境困难）一切照常，不受干扰

examples.en: It's business as usual at the factory, even while investigators sift through the bomb wreckage.
examples.zh: 即使在调查人员检查炸弹残骸的时候，工厂仍照常运转。

senses.def: a way of saying that financial and commercial matters are the important things to consider and you should not be influenced by friendship, etc.

senses.zh: 着手处理正事；开始认真工作

examples.zh: 我们马上开始谈正事吧——稍后我们会停下来喝杯咖啡。

examples.en: OK, let's get down to business.
examples.zh: 好，我们言归正传。

senses.def: to do the things that you normally do
senses.zh: 忙自己的事；做通常做的事

examples.zh: 挤满为日常生活奔忙的人的街道

examples.en: market traders going about their daily business
examples.zh: 为日常交易奔忙的市场交易员

examples.zh: 你无权待在这里。

senses.def: very much, very fast, very well, etc.

examples.zh: 为按时完成任务，我一直在快马加鞭地工作。

examples.zh: 他看上去像是个说话算话的人。

examples.en: He says he's going to make changes, and I think he means business.
examples.zh: 他说他打算有所改变，我想他是认真的。

examples.zh: “你在读什么呢？”“少管闲事！”

examples.en: I was just sitting there, minding my own business, when a man started shouting at me.
examples.zh: 我就坐在那儿，也没招谁惹谁，忽然有个男人对我大喊大叫。

examples.zh: 我无意让别人替我工作。

senses.zh: 天使投资人（尤指新创小企业的投资者）

senses.def: a small card printed with somebody’s name and details of their job and company

examples.zh: 我们交换了名片。

examples.zh: 商务舱已经没有座位了。

examples.en: I always fly business class.
examples.zh: 我乘飞机总是坐商务舱。

examples.zh: 他们制定了后备计划，以确保所有关键业务系统保持运行。

examples.zh: 当前的商业周期低迷是该公司经历过的最长的一次。

examples.zh: 你可以在正常营业时间拨打服务热线。

examples.zh: 亚洲的许多公司都遵循这种商业模式。

examples.en: Adopt a new direction by rethinking your business model.
examples.zh: 通过重新思考您的商业模式来采用新的方向。

examples.en: We're developing a better business model for expanding our fibre optic network.
examples.zh: 我们正在开发更好的商业模式来扩展我们的光纤网络。

senses.def: an area of land that is specially designed for offices and small factories

examples.en: The company's offices are located in the new business park out of town.
examples.zh: 公司办公楼坐落在城外的新工商业园区。

senses.def: a person who works in business, especially at a high level
senses.zh: （尤指高层的）商界人士；实业家

senses.def: a document that describes a business’s aims for the future and the ways in which the business hopes to achieve those aims
senses.zh: 业务计划；商业计划；商业计划书

examples.en: The company has put together a comprehensive business plan for the next five years.
examples.zh: 公司整合了一份详尽的未来五年商业计划书。

senses.def: a tax paid by businesses to a local authority for land and buildings that they use
senses.zh: （地方政府征收的）商业房地产税

senses.def: a part of a college or university that teaches business, often to graduates (= people who already have a first degree)
senses.zh: （大学里针对毕业生的）工商学院

senses.def: the study of subjects connected with money and managing a business

examples.en: a degree in business studies
examples.zh: 企业管理学位

senses.def: done between one business and another rather than between a business and its ordinary customers

examples.en: business-to-business transactions
examples.zh: 企业对企业交易

senses.def: used to describe the selling of products, services or information to consumers over the internet
senses.zh: （互联网销售）企业对消费者的，商家对顾客的

examples.zh: 企业对消费者的电子商务使消费者能够全天候接触全球供应商。

examples.zh: 她用一种公务口吻，说话干脆利落。

senses.def: a man who works in business, especially at a high level
senses.zh: 商人：从事商业工作，尤其是高水平工作的人

examples.zh: 意大利政商代表团来访

senses.zh: 商人：在商业和财务事务上表现出技巧的人

examples.zh: 成功/富有的商人

examples.zh: 多年来他一直是成功的企业家，经营着自己的小公司。

examples.zh: 这辆车我本该拿到更优惠的价格，但我不太会讲价。

the fact of accepting a policy or change because you agree with it

examples.zh: 如果想进行重大变革，就需要得到机构中所有人的认可。

examples.zh: 你需要赢得人们的支持。

senses.def: to buy shares in a company, especially in order to gain some control over it
senses.zh: 购买公司股份（尤指为取得部分控制权）

senses.def: to believe something, especially an idea that many other people believe in

examples.en: She had never bought into the idea that to be attractive you have to be thin.
examples.zh: 她从不随大溜认为要想有魅力，就得瘦身。

senses.def: to pay somebody money, especially dishonestly, to prevent them from doing something you do not want them to do
senses.zh: 收买，贿赂（某人不干某事）

senses.def: to pay somebody for their share in a business, usually in order to get total control of it for yourself
senses.zh: 买断…的股份；买下…的全部股权

senses.def: to pay money so that somebody can leave an organization, especially the army, before the end of an agreed period
senses.zh: （为提前退役、离职等）支付补偿金

senses.def: describing or connected with a house or flat that somebody buys in order to rent it out to somebody else, not to live in it themselves

examples.en: He owns several buy-to-let flats in the city.
examples.zh: 他在城里拥有几套买房出租的公寓。

examples.en: buy-to-let properties/investors/mortgages
examples.zh: 为出租而购买的房产／投资者／房屋按揭

senses.def: to buy all or as much as possible of something
senses.zh: 全部（或尽量）买下某物；收购

examples.en: Developers are buying up all the land on the island.
examples.zh: 开发商们要把岛上的全部土地都买尽了。

senses.def: a person who buys something, especially something expensive

examples.en: Have you found a buyer for your house?
examples.zh: 你的房子找到买主了吗？

senses.def: a person whose job is to choose goods that will be sold in a large shop

examples.zh: 她是一家百货公司的时装采购员。

senses.def: a situation in which there is a lot of a particular item for sale, so that prices are low and people buying have a choice

examples.zh: 在买方市场的情况下，商品丰富，因此价格不高。

senses.def: the disappointed feeling somebody has after they have bought something when they think they have made a mistake
senses.zh: 买家的懊悔（购物后感到后悔的情绪）

senses.def: a situation in which a person or group gains control of a company by buying all or most of its shares

examples.en: a management buyout
examples.zh: 管理层购买控制性股权

senses.def: to make a continuous low sound

examples.en: Bees buzzed lazily among the flowers.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂在花丛中懒洋洋地嗡嗡作响。

senses.def: to make a sound like a bee buzzing

examples.en: The doorbell buzzed loudly.
examples.zh: 门铃蜂鸣声大作。

examples.en: My ears were buzzing (= were filled with a continuous sound).
examples.zh: 我耳鸣了。

senses.def: to be full of excitement, activity, etc.

examples.en: New York buzzes from dawn to dusk.
examples.zh: 纽约从早到晚都熙熙攘攘的。

examples.en: My head was still buzzing after the day's events.
examples.zh: 一天的活动结束后，我头脑中还是闹哄哄的。

examples.en: The place was buzzing with journalists.
examples.zh: 那个地方被记者搞得闹哄哄的。

senses.def: to call somebody to come by pressing a buzzer

examples.en: The doctor buzzed for the next patient to come in.
examples.zh: 医生按蜂鸣器叫下一个病人进来。

senses.def: to fly very close to somebody/something, especially as a warning or threat
senses.zh: 飞近（尤指作为警告或威胁）

senses.def: a continuous sound like the one that a bee, a buzzer

examples.en: The air was alive with the buzz of bees and dragonflies.
examples.zh: 空中有蜜蜂和蜻蜓的嗡嗡声，生气勃勃。

examples.en: The buzz of the Entryphone interrupted our conversation.
examples.zh: 大门口对话机的蜂响声打断了我们的谈话。

examples.en: hums and buzzes from the amplifier
examples.zh: 扬声器发出的嗡嗡声

senses.def: the sound of people talking, especially in an excited way

examples.en: The buzz of conversation suddenly stopped when she came into the room.
examples.zh: 她一踏进屋子里，热烈的谈话便戛然而止。

examples.en: the background buzz of conversation
examples.zh: 交谈时的背景杂音

senses.def: a strong feeling of pleasure, excitement or achievement
senses.zh: （愉快、兴奋或成就的）强烈情感

examples.en: a buzz of excitement/expectation
examples.zh: 十分兴奋／期待

examples.en: She gets a buzz out of her work.
examples.zh: 她从工作中得到了很大乐趣。

examples.en: Flying gives me a real buzz.
examples.zh: 飞行真让我兴奋。

examples.en: You can sense the creative buzz in the city.
examples.zh: 在城市里可以感觉到创造的热情。

examples.en: The marketing campaign created extraordinary buzz.
examples.zh: 营销活动引发了强烈的兴奋情绪。

senses.def: news that people tell each other that may or may not be true

examples.en: The buzz is that Matt is in Scotland. Have you heard anything?
examples.zh: 传言说马特在苏格兰。你听到什么了吗？

senses.def: to phone somebody

examples.en: I'll give you a buzz on Monday, OK?
examples.zh: 我星期一给你打电话行吗？

senses.def: to phone somebody

examples.en: I'll give you a buzz on Monday, OK?
examples.zh: 我星期一给你打电话行吗？

senses.def: to move around quickly, especially because you are very busy

examples.en: I've been buzzing around town all day sorting out my trip.
examples.zh: 我一整天都在城里转来转去，安排旅行的事情。

senses.def: to move around quickly, especially because you are very busy

examples.en: I've been buzzing around town all day sorting out my trip.
examples.zh: 我一整天都在城里转来转去，安排旅行的事情。

senses.def: a style of cutting the hair in which all the hair is cut very short, close to the skin of the head
senses.zh: 寸头发型（头发理得很短，贴近头皮）

senses.def: one of the small groups of people that a large group can be divided into in order to discuss and give their opinions about a particular subject. The information obtained is used by people doing market research
senses.zh: 蜂议小组，大家说小组（由大团体划分而成，组员讨论某一问题并各抒己见，意见用于市场研究）

senses.def: used to tell somebody rudely to go away

examples.en: Just buzz off and let me get on with my work.
examples.zh: 走开，我得继续干活了。

senses.def: a saw
a large European bird of prey
a large American bird like a vulture
an electrical device that produces a buzzing

examples.en: Put your fingers on the buzzer and be ready to answer.
examples.zh: 将手指放在蜂鸣器上，准备接听。

examples.en: The buzzer went off at eight o’clock.
examples.zh: 蜂鸣器在8点钟时响了。

senses.def: at the end of a game or period of play
senses.zh: 比赛结束时；游戏结束时

examples.en: He missed a three-point attempt at the buzzer.
examples.zh: 终场哨响时，他投三分球未中。

senses.def: at the end of a game or period of play
senses.zh: 比赛结束时；游戏结束时

examples.en: He missed a three-point attempt at the buzzer.
examples.zh: 终场哨响时，他投三分球未中。

senses.def: a word or phrase, especially one connected with a particular subject, that has become fashionable and popular and is used a lot in newspapers, etc.
senses.zh: （报刊等的）时髦术语，流行行话

examples.en: Avoid overused marketing buzzwords.
examples.zh: 避免过度使用营销流行语。

examples.en: It's one of the most common current buzz phrases.
examples.zh: 这是当前最常见的流行语之一。

senses.def: likely to capture the attention of the media or the public

examples.en: This year's award ceremony was filled with buzzworthy moments.
examples.zh: 今年的颁奖典礼充满了热闹的时刻。

senses.def: lively and exciting
senses.zh: 活泼的；令人兴奋的；提神的

examples.en: The bars along the Strip are always buzzy at the weekends.
examples.zh: 周末，拉斯维加斯大道上的酒吧总是热闹非凡。

senses.def: generating excitement or interest because people talk about it
senses.zh: 因为人们谈论它而产生兴奋或兴趣

examples.en: Start-ups often raise their profile through buzzy social media campaigns.
examples.zh: 初创企业经常通过热闹的社交媒体活动来提高自己的形象。

examples.en: It's definitely the buzziest new TV series of the season.
examples.zh: 这绝对是本季最热门的新电视剧。

senses.def: a word used in parts of East Africa to address a man who has authority over you, for example your employer
senses.zh: （东非部分地区用以称呼上司）主人，老板

senses.def: used for showing how or in what way something is done

examples.en: The house is heated by gas.
examples.zh: 这房子是燃气供暖的。

examples.en: May I pay by credit card?
examples.zh: 我能用信用卡付款吗？

examples.en: I will contact you by letter.
examples.zh: 我会给你写信联系的。

examples.en: to travel by boat/bus/car/plane
examples.zh: 乘船／公共汽车／轿车／飞机

examples.en: to travel by air/land/sea
examples.zh: 坐飞机；经陆路／海路

examples.en: Switch it on by pressing this button.
examples.zh: 按下这个开关启动它。

senses.def: near somebody/something; at the side of somebody/something; next to somebody/something

examples.en: a house by the river
examples.zh: 河边的一所房子

examples.en: Can we have the table by the window?
examples.zh: 我们可以坐靠窗的桌子吗？

examples.en: Come and sit by me.
examples.zh: 过来挨着我坐。

senses.def: used, usually after a passive verb, to show who or what does, creates or causes something
senses.zh: （常置于表示被动的动词后，表示施事者）

examples.en: He was knocked down by a bus.
examples.zh: 他被公共汽车撞倒了。

examples.en: a play by Ibsen
examples.zh: 易卜生写的剧本

examples.en: Who's that book by?
examples.zh: 谁是那本书的作者？

examples.en: I was frightened by the noise.
examples.zh: 我被那响声吓坏了。

senses.def: not later than the time mentioned; before

examples.en: Can you finish the work by five o'clock?
examples.zh: 你五点钟前能完成工作吗？

examples.en: I'll have it done by tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天之前让人把它弄好。

examples.en: By this time next week we'll be in New York.
examples.zh: 下星期的这个时候我们将在纽约。

examples.en: He ought to have arrived by now/by this time.
examples.zh: 他现在应该已经到了。

examples.en: By the time (that) this letter reaches you I will have left the country.
examples.zh: 你收到这封信时，我已离开这个国家了。

senses.def: used before particular nouns without the
senses.zh: （置于不带 the 的名词前，表示原因）由于

examples.en: They met by chance.
examples.zh: 他们不期而遇。

examples.en: I did it by mistake.
examples.zh: 我误做了这事。

examples.en: The coroner's verdict was ‘death by misadventure’.
examples.zh: 验尸官判定是“意外致死”。

senses.def: used to show the degree or amount of something

examples.en: The bullet missed him by two inches.
examples.zh: 子弹只差两英寸就击中他了。

examples.en: House prices went up by 10%.
examples.zh: 房价上涨了 10%。

examples.en: It would be better by far (= much better) to…
examples.zh: 那比…好得多。

senses.def: during something; in a particular situation

examples.en: to travel by day/night
examples.zh: 白天／夜间旅行

examples.en: We had to work by candlelight.
examples.zh: 我们不得不借助烛光工作。

senses.def: from what something shows or says; according to something

examples.en: By my watch it is two o'clock.
examples.zh: 我的表是两点钟。

examples.en: I could tell by the look on her face that something terrible had happened.
examples.zh: 从她的脸色我可以看出，发生了可怕的事情。

examples.en: By law, you are a child until you are 18.
examples.zh: 按照法律规定，18 岁之前是未成年人。

senses.def: past somebody/something

examples.en: He walked by me without speaking.
examples.zh: 他一言不发地从我身边走过。

senses.def: used to show the part of somebody/something that somebody touches, holds, etc.
senses.zh: （表示触及或抓住的人或物的部分）

examples.en: I took him by the hand.
examples.zh: 我拉着他的手。

examples.en: She seized her by the hair.
examples.zh: 她揪住她的头发。

examples.en: Pick it up by the handle!
examples.zh: 抓着手柄把它提起来！

senses.def: used with the
senses.zh: （与 the 连用，表示时间或量度单位）

examples.en: We rented the car by the day.
examples.zh: 我们按日租用汽车。

examples.en: They're paid by the hour.
examples.zh: 他们的报酬是按小时计算的。

examples.en: We only sell it by the metre.
examples.zh: 我们只按米出售。

senses.def: used to state the rate at which something happens

examples.en: They're improving day by day.
examples.zh: 他们在一天天地改进。

examples.en: We'll do it bit by bit.
examples.zh: 我们会一点一点地做。

examples.en: It was getting worse by the minute (= very fast).
examples.zh: 情况急速恶化。

examples.en: The children came in two by two (= in groups of two).
examples.zh: 孩子们一对一对地走了进来。

senses.def: used to show the measurements of something

examples.en: The room measures fifteen feet by twenty feet.
examples.zh: 房间 15 英尺宽 20 英尺长。

senses.def: used when multiplying or dividing

examples.en: 6 multiplied by 2 equals 12.
examples.zh: 6 乘以 2 等于 12。

examples.en: 6 divided by 2 equals 3.
examples.zh: 6 除以 2 等于 3。

senses.def: used for giving more information about where somebody comes from, what somebody does, etc.
senses.zh: （补充有关出生地、职业等的信息）

examples.en: He's German by birth.
examples.zh: 他是德国血统的。

examples.en: They're both doctors by profession.
examples.zh: 他们两人的职业都是医生。

senses.def: used when swearing to mean ‘in the name of’

examples.en: I swear by Almighty God…
examples.zh: 我以全能上帝之名发誓…

senses.def: used to introduce a comment or question that is not directly related to what you have been talking about
senses.zh: 顺便提一下；捎带说一声；附带问一句

senses.def: past

examples.en: Just drive by. Don't stop.
examples.zh: 直接开过去。别停车。

examples.en: He hurried by without speaking to me.
examples.zh: 他没和我说话就匆匆过去了。

examples.en: Excuse me, I can't get by.
examples.zh: 劳驾，请让开点路。

examples.en: Time goes by so quickly.
examples.zh: 时光飞逝。

senses.def: used to say that something is saved so that it can be used in the future

examples.en: I've put some money by for college fees.
examples.zh: 我已经存了些钱作大学学费。

senses.def: in order to visit somebody for a short time

examples.en: I'll come by this evening and pick up the books.
examples.zh: 我今晚过来取书。

senses.def: before long; soon

examples.en: By and by she met an old man with a beard.
examples.zh: 她不久就碰到了一个大胡子老头。

senses.def: used when you are saying something that is generally, but not completely, true

examples.en: By and large, I enjoyed my time at school.
examples.zh: 总的说来，我在学校的日子很开心。

senses.def: less important

examples.en: a by-product
examples.zh: 副产品

senses.def: near

examples.en: a bystander
examples.zh: 旁观者

senses.def: used to introduce a comment or question that is not directly related to what you have been talking about
senses.zh: 顺便提一下；捎带说一声；附带问一句

senses.def: before long; soon

examples.en: By and by she met an old man with a beard.
examples.zh: 她不久就碰到了一个大胡子老头。

senses.def: used when you are saying something that is generally, but not completely, true

examples.en: By and large, I enjoyed my time at school.
examples.zh: 总的说来，我在学校的日子很开心。

senses.def: by a great amount

examples.en: He was the best by a long way.
examples.zh: 很长一段时间以来他都是最好的。

senses.def: if a person or an animal wins a race by a neck
by only a small amount (used mostly when talking about horse racing)
senses.zh: 一步之差的，差距甚微的（多用以谈论赛马）

examples.en: He lost his first race by a nose but won the next three.
examples.zh: 他以微弱的差距输掉了第一场比赛，但赢了接下来的三场比赛。

examples.en: Glen's Diamond was declared the winner by a nose from the 11–4 favourite.
examples.zh: 马匹“格伦钻石”以微弱优势跑赢了 11-4 的热门马匹，险胜夺冠。

senses.def: by a very small amount
in a way that is not planned or organized

examples.en: We met by accident at the airport.
examples.zh: 我们在机场不期而遇。

examples.en: Helen got into acting purely by accident.
examples.zh: 海伦当演员完全出于偶然。

examples.en: It happened, whether by accident or design, that Steve and I were the last two people to leave.
examples.zh: 不知是偶然还是事先安排，史蒂夫和我是最后离开的两个人。

senses.def: used to say that you are very willing for somebody to have something or do something

examples.en: ‘Do you mind if I have a look?’ ‘By all means.’
examples.zh: “我看一眼行吗？”“当然可以。”

senses.def: before long; soon

examples.en: By and by she met an old man with a beard.
examples.zh: 她不久就碰到了一个大胡子老头。

senses.def: used when you are saying something that is generally, but not completely, true

examples.en: By and large, I enjoyed my time at school.
examples.zh: 总的说来，我在学校的日子很开心。

senses.def: used especially in questions, to ask whether something is true, possible, etc.
senses.zh: （尤用于问句，询问是否真实、可能等）或许，可能

examples.en: Are you in love with him, by any chance?
examples.zh: 或许你爱上他了？

examples.en: Are you by any chance Mr Ludd?
examples.zh: 你会不会就是路德先生？

senses.def: because you have chosen

examples.en: I wouldn't go there by choice.
examples.zh: 让我选择，我不会去那里。

examples.en: I wouldn't have come to this cafe by choice!
examples.zh: 我不会选择来这家咖啡馆的！

senses.def: used especially at the beginning of a sentence when the next thing that is mentioned is compared with something in the previous sentence

examples.en: By comparison, expenditure on education increased last year.
examples.zh: 相比之下，去年教育经费增加了。

examples.en: His problems seemed trivial by comparison.
examples.zh: 相比之下，他的问题显得微不足道。

senses.def: a game or competition can be won by default
senses.zh: （比赛）因其他参赛者不到场，由于对手缺席（而胜出）

examples.en: He became world champion in 2007 by default.
examples.zh: 他在2007年因对手缺席而成为世界冠军。

senses.def: if something happens by default
senses.zh: 由于没有特别作出决定（或选择）

examples.en: I became a teacher by default rather than by design.
examples.zh: 我最初没有选择教师这个职业，但后来机缘巧合地成为了一名教师。

senses.def: slowly and gradually

examples.en: By degrees their friendship grew into love.
examples.zh: 他们的友谊逐渐发展成为爱情。

examples.en: By slow degrees, the company's turnover dwindled to nothing.
examples.zh: 公司的营业额逐渐下降至零。

senses.def: by means of something

examples.zh: 我仿佛听见有人在呼喊。

examples.en: She called out to her father for help.
examples.zh: 她向父亲大声呼救。

examples.en: Someone called to him to wait.
examples.zh: 有人叫他等一等。

examples.en: Did somebody call my name?
examples.zh: 有人叫我的名字吗？

examples.en: People in the audience called out requests.
examples.zh: 听众中有人大声呼吁。

examples.en: ‘See you later!’ she called.
examples.zh: “再见！”她叫道。

senses.def: to ask somebody to come by shouting or speaking loudly

examples.en: Will you call the kids in for lunch?
examples.zh: 把孩子们叫进来吃午饭好吗？

examples.en: He heard me call him and came to the door.
examples.zh: 他听到我叫他，于是走到门口。

examples.en: Did you call?
examples.zh: 你叫我？

senses.def: to order somebody to come to a place

examples.en: Several candidates were called for a second interview.
examples.zh: 几个候选人接到通知去参加第二次面试。

examples.en: The ambassador was called back to London by the prime minister.
examples.zh: 大使被首相召回伦敦。

examples.en: He felt called to the priesthood (= had a strong feeling that he must become a priest).
examples.zh: 他感受到要成为司铎的召唤。

examples.en: You may be called to give evidence.
examples.zh: 你可能会被传去作证。

examples.en: She was called to testify before a Senate subcommittee.
examples.zh: 她被传唤到参议院小组委员会作证。

examples.en: The defence says it plans to call four witnesses.
examples.zh: 辩护律师称计划传唤四名证人。

senses.group: order somebody to come 召见

senses.def: to order something to happen; to announce that something will happen

examples.en: to call a meeting/strike
examples.zh: 召集会议；号召罢工

examples.en: The prime minister has called an election for 8 June.
examples.zh: 首相宣布六月八日举行选举。

senses.def: to make a short visit to a person or place

examples.en: I'll call round and see you on my way home.
examples.zh: 我想在回家的路上去看看你。

examples.en: Let's call on John.
examples.zh: 咱们去看看约翰吧。

examples.en: He was out when I called to see him.
examples.zh: 我去拜访时，他不在家。

senses.def: to make the noise that is typical for it

examples.en: The cuckoo called across the trees to its mate.
examples.zh: 杜鹃穿过树林向它的伴侣呼唤。

senses.def: to predict what the result of something will be

examples.en: It's a very open game that is very hard to call.
examples.zh: 这是一场旗鼓相当的比赛，胜负难料。

examples.en: to be difficult/impossible to call
examples.zh: 很难／不可能预测结果

examples.en: The result of this election is going to be too close to call.
examples.zh: 这次选举的结果将是势均力敌，不相上下。

examples.en: Most media pundits called it for the Conservatives.
examples.zh: 大多数媒体权威人士认为保守党会获胜。

senses.def: to say which side of a coin you think will face upwards after it is thrown

examples.en: to call heads/tails
examples.zh: 要硬币的正面／反面

senses.def: to shout out the steps for people performing a square dance
senses.zh: （方形舞或土风舞中）喊出舞步的指挥

senses.def: to remember somebody/something

examples.en: She couldn't call to mind where she had seen him before.
examples.zh: 她想不起来曾在哪里见过他。

senses.def: to remind you of somebody/something

examples.en: The painting brings to mind some of Picasso's early works.
examples.zh: 这幅油画使人想起了毕加索早期的一些作品。

senses.def: to tell somebody to do what they are threatening to do, because you believe that they will not be cruel or brave enough to do it
senses.zh: 要求…摊牌，要求…兑现其恫吓（因相信对方不至于或不敢这样做）

examples.en: She was tempted to call his bluff, hardly able to believe he’d carry out his threat.
examples.zh: 她很想逼他亮出底牌，并不相信他会做他威胁要做的事。

senses.def: to make use of something

examples.en: Chess is a game that calls into play all your powers of concentration.
examples.zh: 国际象棋是一项需要全神贯注的活动。

senses.def: to doubt something or make others doubt something

examples.en: His honesty has never been called into question.
examples.zh: 他的诚实从未受到过怀疑。

senses.def: to decide or agree to stop doing something
senses.zh: 结束一天的工作；到此为止；停止

examples.en: After forty years in politics I think it's time for me to call it a day (= to retire).
examples.zh: 从政四十年，我想现在也该退休了。

senses.def: to agree to end a contest, argument, etc. because both sides seem equal
senses.zh: （因势均力敌）同意停止比赛（或争论等）

senses.def: to decide to stop doing something
to use offensive words about somebody

examples.en: Stop calling me names!
examples.zh: 不要再骂我啦。

senses.def: to be the person who controls a situation
to say exactly what you think without trying to hide your opinion

examples.en: I believe in calling a spade a spade.
examples.zh: 我笃信直言不讳，实话实说。

senses.def: to say or decide that it is time for something to finish
to make somebody explain a mistake, etc. because they are responsible for it
to ask people in a meeting to be quiet so that the meeting can start or continue
senses.zh: 要求安静下来（以便开始或继续会议）；要求遵守会议秩序

senses.def: to order somebody to obey the formal rules of a meeting; to start a formal meeting
senses.zh: 叫（人）遵守议事规程；宣布开（会）

examples.en: The argument continued until the chairman called them both to order.
examples.zh: 争论持续不休，直到主席要求双方遵守议事规则。

examples.en: The president brought the meeting to order at 9.15 a.m.
examples.zh: 主席于上午9时15分宣布开会。

examples.en: As the meeting was brought to order, the councillor immediately stood and began to protest.
examples.zh: 会议开始后，议员立即起立抗议。

senses.def: the person who provides the money for something can also control how it is spent
senses.zh: 花钱的人说了算；财大者气粗

senses.def: called to see somebody in authority because you have done something wrong

examples.en: I got called on the carpet for being late.
examples.zh: 我因为迟到被叫去训了一顿。

senses.def: used to say that you should not criticize somebody for a fault that you have yourself
senses.zh: 锅笑壶黑；五十步笑百步；乌鸦说猪黑

senses.def: used instead of a name that you cannot remember
senses.zh: （记不得名字时说）你叫他（或她、它、他们）什么来着

examples.en: She's just gone out with old what-d'you-call-him.
examples.zh: 她刚和老——你叫他什么来着——一块儿出去的。

senses.def: the act of speaking to somebody on the phone

examples.en: to get/receive a call from somebody
examples.zh: 接到某人的电话

examples.en: to give somebody/make a call
examples.zh: 给某人打电话；打个电话

examples.en: I can't take (= answer) your call at the moment, so please leave a message after the beep.
examples.zh: 我现在无法接听（=接听）您的电话，因此请在嘟声后留言。

examples.en: I left a message but he didn't return my call.
examples.zh: 我留了口信，但他没有回电话。

examples.en: An emergency call was made at 9 p.m.
examples.zh: 晚上9点，紧急电话拨通。

examples.en: They put out a distress call and were towed into harbour
examples.zh: 他们发出求救信号并被拖入港口

senses.def: a shout or loud sound made to attract attention
senses.zh: 大声呼叫，大声说（以吸引注意力）

examples.en: a call for help
examples.zh: 呼救声

senses.def: a loud sound made by a bird or an animal

examples.en: the distinctive call of the cuckoo
examples.zh: 布谷鸟独特的叫声

examples.en: The call of the barn owl is often described as a screech or scream.
examples.zh: 仓鸮的叫声通常被描述为尖叫声或尖叫声。

senses.def: a request, an order or a demand for somebody to do something or to go somewhere

examples.en: The government has resisted the calls of the international community.
examples.zh: 政府拒绝了国际社会的要求。

examples.en: calls for national unity
examples.zh: 国家统一的呼声

examples.en: This is the last call for passengers travelling on British Airways flight 199 to Rome.
examples.zh: 乘坐英国航空公司 199 次班机飞往罗马的乘客，这是最后一次通知登机。

examples.en: calls for the minister to resign
examples.zh: 要部长辞职的要求

examples.en: The book is a call to action.
examples.zh: 这本书呼吁行动。

examples.en: The mosque was sounding the call to prayer.
examples.zh: 清真寺里传来钟声，召唤人们去祈祷。

senses.def: no demand for something; no reason for somebody’s behaviour

examples.en: There isn't a lot of call for these nowadays.
examples.zh: 如今对这些的需求并不多。

examples.en: There was no call for you to go upsetting everyone like that.
examples.zh: 没有人要求你那样去惹恼所有人。

senses.def: a demand or pressure placed on somebody/something
senses.zh: （对某人或某事物的）需求，压力

examples.en: She is a busy woman with many calls on her time.
examples.zh: 她是个大忙人，有很多事等着她去办。

senses.def: a short visit to somebody’s house

examples.en: The doctor has five calls to make this morning.
examples.zh: 医生今天上午要出诊五次。

examples.en: I'm afraid this isn't a social call.
examples.zh: 恐怕这不是一次礼节性拜访。

examples.en: to pay a call on an old friend
examples.zh: 拜访一位老朋友

examples.en: The doctor is out on a call.
examples.zh: 医生出诊看病人去了。

senses.def: a strong feeling of attraction that a particular place has for you

examples.en: the call of the sea/your homeland
examples.zh: 大海的／家乡的魅力

senses.def: a strong feeling that you want to do something, especially a particular job

examples.en: He felt the call to the priesthood early on in his life.
examples.zh: 他很早就感受到了成为神职人员的召唤。

senses.group: to a particular job 职业

senses.def: a decision

examples.en: It's your call!
examples.zh: 那是你的决定！

examples.en: a good/bad call
examples.zh: 正确的／不恰当的决定

examples.en: That's a tough call.
examples.zh: 那是个艰难的决定。

senses.def: a decision made by the umpire

examples.en: There was a disputed call in the second set.
examples.zh: 第二盘比赛有一个有争议的判决。

senses.def: a player’s bid
senses.group: in card games 纸牌游戏

senses.def: always ready to obey somebody’s orders

examples.en: He is constantly at the beck and call of his invalid father.
examples.zh: 他总是听从他生病的父亲的指挥。

examples.en: Don't expect to have me at your beck and call.
examples.zh: 休想随意摆布我。

senses.group: in card games 纸牌游戏

senses.def: to a higher standard or level than is required for a job or task
senses.zh: 超出职责要求（或标准、范围）

examples.en: She went above and beyond the call of duty in her efforts to save his life.
examples.zh: 为救他的命，她所做的努力超出了职业要求。

senses.group: in card games 纸牌游戏

senses.def: the need to go to the toilet
senses.group: in card games 纸牌游戏

senses.def: a strong request to fight in the army; a strong request to defend something or get ready for a fight about something
senses.zh: 武装起来的号召；准备战斗的号令

examples.en: A leading environmentalist has issued a call to arms to companies and the public to do more about plastic waste.
examples.zh: 一位领先的环保人士呼吁企业和公众对塑料垃圾采取更多行动。

examples.en: The president's speech was a call to arms to restore the vitality of the American dream.
examples.zh: 总统的演讲是为了重振美国梦而发出的入伍参战号召。

senses.group: in card games 纸牌游戏

senses.def: a situation in which you only just manage to avoid an accident, etc.
senses.zh: 侥幸避免事故；侥幸脱险；幸免于难

examples.en: He had a close shave when his brakes failed on the mountain road.
examples.zh: 当他在山路上刹车失灵时，他差点就死了。

senses.group: in card games 纸牌游戏

examples.en: The children always have first call on her time.
examples.zh: 她的时间总是先花在孩子们身上。

senses.group: in card games 纸牌游戏

intro.zh: 以上各词均含突然大声喊叫、说话之义。

items.def: to shout or say something loudly to attract somebody’s attention:
items.zh: 指大声呼叫或说话以吸引注意

examples.en: I thought I heard someone calling.
examples.zh: 我仿佛听见有人在呼喊。

items.def: to shout something loudly, especially when you need help or are in trouble:
items.zh: 尤指需要帮助或陷入困境时大声呼喊

examples.en: She cried out for help.
examples.zh: 她大声呼救。

items.def: to say something suddenly and loudly, especially because of a strong emotion:
items.zh: 尤指因强烈的情感而突然大声说话

examples.en: ‘It isn’t fair!’ he exclaimed angrily.
examples.zh: “这不公平！”他气愤地喊道。

items.def: to say something suddenly and without thinking carefully enough:
items.zh: 指脱口而出

examples.en: I blurted out the answer without thinking.
examples.zh: 我想都没想就脱口说出了答案。

items.def: to say something suddenly and loudly, especially with a lot of emotion:
items.zh: 尤指突然激动地大声喊叫

examples.en: ‘He’s a bully!’ the little boy burst out.

Beefheart上尉：（1941-2010）是一位美国摇滚音乐家，嗓音很刺耳，他也演奏萨克斯风，对朋克摇滚音乐影响很大。他出生于Don Van Vliet，并于1964年开始了他的唱片生涯。他和他的魔术乐队录制的专辑包括《 Safe as Milk》（1967年），《 Trout Mask Replica》（1969年）和《 Crow Cream for Crow》（1982年）。Beefheart队长本人在1982年放弃表演成为画家。

senses.def: used in the media to describe a person who manages a large business company

examples.en: Some people were badly injured and needed medical care.
examples.zh: 有些人受重伤，需要医疗救治。

examples.en: We aim to continually improve the quality of patient care.
examples.zh: 我们的目标是不断提高患者护理质量。

examples.en: The parents shared equally in the care of the children.
examples.zh: 父母平等地分担对孩子的照顾。

examples.en: The company provides care older people living in their own homes.
examples.zh: 该公司为住在自己家中的老年人提供护理。

examples.en: With proper care, the plants may last for fifty years.
examples.zh: 照料得好，这些植物可以活 50 年。

examples.en: skin/hair care products
examples.zh: 护肤品；护发品

senses.def: the fact of providing a home in an institution run by the local authority or with another family for children who cannot live with their parents
senses.zh: （儿童福利院或其他家庭的）收养

examples.en: Most children in care live with foster carers.
examples.zh: 收养儿童大多数与寄养照料人生活在一起。

examples.en: The two girls were taken into care after their parents were killed.
examples.zh: 两个女孩在父母遇害后由人收养。

examples.en: He had been in foster care since he was five.
examples.zh: 他从 5 岁起就一直由别人抚养。

examples.en: Mentors support teenagers leaving care.
examples.zh: 导师支持青少年离开护理机构。

senses.def: attention or thought that you give to something that you are doing so that you will do it well and avoid mistakes or damage

examples.en: Great care is needed when choosing a used car.
examples.zh: 选购旧车时要特别小心。

examples.en: She chose her words with care.
examples.zh: 她措辞谨慎。

examples.en: Fragile—handle with care (= written on a container holding something that is easily broken or damaged)
examples.zh: 易碎物品，小心轻放

examples.en: Consumers must exercise care when buying medicines online.
examples.zh: 消费者在网上购买药品时必须谨慎。

senses.def: a feeling of worry; something that causes problems or worries
senses.zh: 忧虑；引起麻烦的事；令人烦恼的事

examples.en: I felt free from the cares of the day as soon as I left the building.
examples.zh: 我一离开那栋大楼便觉得轻松自在，不再为白天的烦心事发愁了。

examples.en: Sam looked as if he didn't have a care in the world.
examples.zh: 萨姆看上去好像什么事都不操心似的。

senses.def: used when writing to somebody at another person’s address
senses.zh: （以别人的地址给某人写信时用）由某人转交

examples.en: Write to him care of his lawyer.
examples.zh: 写给他的信由他的律师转交。

senses.def: being cared for by somebody

examples.en: The child was left in the care of friends.
examples.zh: 小孩留给朋友照管。

examples.en: You won’t come to any harm while you’re in their care.
examples.zh: 有他们照顾你， 你不会受到任何伤害。

examples.en: Many historic sites are in the care of the National Trust.
examples.zh: 许多历史景点是由国家信托公司管理的。

senses.def: used when saying goodbye

examples.en: Bye! Take care!
examples.zh: 再见！多保重！

senses.def: to be careful

examples.en: Take care (that) you don't spill any of it!
examples.zh: 小心不要洒出任何东西！

examples.en: Care should be taken to close the lid securely.
examples.zh: 盖子应小心扣紧。

senses.def: to care for somebody/something/yourself; to be careful about something

examples.en: Who's taking care of the children while you're away?
examples.zh: 你外出时谁来照料孩子？

examples.en: She takes great care of her clothes.
examples.zh: 她非常爱惜自己的衣服。

examples.en: He's old enough to take care of himself.
examples.zh: 他已经不小了，能照顾自己了。

examples.en: You should take better care of yourself.
examples.zh: 你应该更加保重自己。

senses.def: to be responsible for or to deal with a situation or task

examples.en: Don't worry about the travel arrangements. They're all being taken care of.
examples.zh: 别担心旅行安排，一切都会有人照管的。

examples.en: Celia takes care of the marketing side of things.
examples.zh: 西莉亚负责产品营销方面的事宜。

senses.def: receiving medical care from somebody

examples.en: He's under the care of Dr Parks.
examples.zh: 他在接受帕克斯医生的治疗。

examples.en: refugees under the care of the relief agencies
examples.zh: 受救济机构照顾的难民

senses.def: to feel that something is important and worth worrying about

examples.en: I don't care (= I will not be upset) if I never see him again!
examples.zh: 即使我永远再也见不到他，我也不在乎！

examples.en: He threatened to fire me, as if I cared!
examples.zh: 他威胁要解雇我，好像我多在乎似的！

examples.en: She cares deeply about environmental issues.
examples.zh: 她对环境问题深感担忧。

examples.en: I don't really care about how much it costs.
examples.zh: 我并不在乎它的价格。

examples.en: I don't care what he thinks.
examples.zh: 我才不管他怎么想呢。

examples.en: No one seems to care that we need help urgently.
examples.zh: 似乎没有人关心我们迫切需要帮助。

senses.def: to like or love somebody and worry about what happens to them

examples.en: He genuinely cares about his employees.
examples.zh: 他真诚地关心他的雇员。

examples.en: They care an awful lot about each other.
examples.zh: 他们非常关心彼此。

examples.en: It is good to know that there is someone who cares.
examples.zh: 很高兴知道有人关心。

senses.def: to make the effort to do something

examples.en: I've done this job more times than I care to remember.
examples.zh: 这事我都记不清做了多少遍了。

senses.def: used to say that a person is no longer worried about or interested in somebody/something

examples.en: I'm past caring what he does.
examples.zh: 他做什么我已经不在乎了。

senses.def: used to say, often rudely, that you do not think that somebody/something is important or worth worrying about
senses.zh: （常用于无礼地表示）不在乎，不在意

examples.en: Quite honestly, I couldn't care less what they do.
examples.zh: 说实在的，我才不在乎他们做什么。

senses.def: used to say that a person is not worried about or interested in what happens to somebody/something
senses.zh: 漠不关心；无动于衷；全然不在乎

examples.en: I could be dead for all he cares!
examples.zh: 我是死是活，他才不关心呢！

senses.def: to not care at all about somebody/something
not to care at all about something; to think that something is not important
senses.zh: 对…丝毫不在乎；完全不把…放在心上；认为…毫无价值

senses.def: not to care at all

examples.en: I don’t care two hoots about having money, as long as I’m happy.
examples.zh: 我根本不在乎有没有钱，只要活得开心就行。

senses.def: to think that somebody/something is not important or that they have no value
senses.zh: 认为…无关紧要；认为…没有价值

senses.def: used to say, often rudely, that you do not think that something is important or interesting
senses.zh: （常用于无礼地表示）管它呢，谁管呢

examples.en: Who cares what she thinks?
examples.zh: 谁管她怎么想呢！

senses.def: used to ask somebody politely if they would like something or would like to do something, or if they would be willing to do something
senses.zh: （礼貌问语）您想要，您喜欢，您愿意

examples.en: Would you care for another drink?
examples.zh: 您再来一杯好吗？

examples.en: If you'd care to follow me, I'll show you where his office is.
examples.zh: 如果您愿意跟我走，我会把您领到他的办公室去。

senses.def: a private US charity. It was established as the Cooperative for American Remittances to Europe in 1945, to help people in Europe after the Second World War
senses.zh: 照顾：美国私人慈善机构。它成立于1945年，是美国向欧洲汇款的合作社，通过发送CARE食品和其他物品的包装来帮助第二次世界大战后的欧洲人民。今天，这些被送往难民（即因战争或其他事件被迫离开家园的人）和幸免于自然灾害的人。有时还会以幽默的方式使用“关爱包裹”一词来表示由美国父母寄给离家儿童的包裹。

senses.def: used when writing to somebody at another person’s address
senses.zh: （以别人的地址给某人写信时用）由某人转交

examples.en: Write to him care of his lawyer.
examples.zh: 写给他的信由他的律师转交。

senses.zh: （礼貌问语）您想要，您喜欢，您愿意

examples.en: Would you care for another drink?
examples.zh: 您再来一杯好吗？

examples.en: If you'd care to follow me, I'll show you where his office is.
examples.zh: 如果您愿意跟我走，我会把您领到他的办公室去。

intro.en: These are all words for attention or thought that you give to something in order to avoid mistakes or accidents.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指小心、谨慎。

items.def: attention or thought that you give to something that you are doing so that you will do it well and avoid mistakes or damage:
items.zh: 指小心、谨慎以做好某事，同时避免出现错误或损失

examples.en: She chose her words with care.
examples.zh: 她措辞谨慎。

items.def: care that you take in order to avoid danger or mistakes; not taking any risks:
items.zh: 指小心、谨慎，以免发生危险或错误

examples.en: The utmost caution must be exercised when handling explosives.
examples.zh: 处理爆炸品一定要慎之又慎。

items.def: (rather formal) a sensible and careful attitude when you make judgements and decisions; behaviour that avoids unnecessary risks:
items.zh: 指判断和决策时谨慎、慎重，处事时避免不必要的风险

examples.en: As a matter of prudence, keep a record of all your financial transactions.
examples.zh: 为慎重起见，请记下你所有的财务往来。

senses.def: used when writing to somebody at another person’s address
senses.zh: （以别人的地址给某人写信时用）由某人转交

examples.en: Write to him care of his lawyer.
examples.zh: 写给他的信由他的律师转交。

senses.def: a person whose job is to help and take care of people who have a medical condition or disability
senses.zh: （精神病人、残疾人，尤指住院治疗者的）护理员

senses.def: to look after somebody who is sick, very old, very young, etc.

examples.en: She moved back home to care for her elderly parents.
examples.zh: 她搬回家住，好照料年迈的双亲。

senses.def: to love or like somebody very much

examples.en: He cared for her more than she realized.
examples.zh: 她不知道他是多么在乎她。

senses.def: a place where people live and are cared for when they cannot live at home or look after themselves

examples.en: children brought up in care homes
examples.zh: 在疗养院长大的孩子们

examples.en: She became very frail and moved into a care home.
examples.zh: 她变得非常虚弱，搬进了疗养院。

examples.en: He moved to a residential care home when his health deteriorated.
examples.zh: 当他的健康状况恶化时，他搬到了安老院。

senses.def: long-term medical and other care that is given within the community and allows people to live at home rather than in a hospital
senses.zh: 社区护理服务（让长期需要照料者在家中接受医疗等）

senses.def: a label attached to the inside of a piece of clothing, giving instructions about how it should be washed and ironed
a person whose job is to help and take care of people who have a medical condition or disability
senses.zh: （精神病人、残疾人，尤指住院治疗者的）护理员

senses.def: to move forward very quickly especially in a way that is dangerous or shows a loss of control
senses.zh: （尤指危险或失控地）猛冲，疾驶

senses.def: the series of jobs that a person has in a particular area of work, usually involving more responsibility as time passes

examples.en: a teaching career
examples.zh: 教学生涯

examples.en: She plans to pursue a career in medicine.
examples.zh: 她打算从医。

examples.en: He had a successful career in television journalism.
examples.zh: 他在电视新闻业有一份很成功的事业。

examples.en: He enjoyed a long and distinguished career as a historian.
examples.zh: 他作为一名历史学家，享有长久的职业生涯，而且卓有成就。

examples.en: She has been concentrating on her career.
examples.zh: 她一直专心致志于她的本职工作。

examples.en: a change of career
examples.zh: 改换职业

examples.en: That will be a good career move (= something that will help your career).
examples.zh: 那将是事业发展上明智的一步。

examples.en: We wish our graduates every success in whatever career path they have chosen.
examples.zh: 我们祝愿我们的毕业生在他们选择的职业道路上取得成功。

examples.en: a career soldier/diplomat (= a professional one)
examples.zh: 职业军人；外交人员

examples.en: a careers adviser/officer (= a person whose job is to give people advice and information about jobs)
examples.zh: 职业顾问；就业指导员

senses.def: the period of time that you spend in your life working or doing a particular thing

examples.en: She started her career as an English teacher.
examples.zh: 她以当英语教师开始了她的职业生涯。

examples.en: He began his professional boxing career in 1998.
examples.zh: 他于 1998 年开始了他的职业拳击生涯。

examples.en: She is playing the best tennis of her career.
examples.zh: 她正在打出职业生涯中最好的网球。

examples.en: My school career was not very impressive.
examples.zh: 我的学业成绩并不很出色。

examples.en: This was a turning point in her career.
examples.zh: 这是她职业生涯的转折点。

examples.en: He has had injury problems throughout his career.
examples.zh: 他的整个职业生涯都饱受伤病困扰。

senses.def: to move forward very quickly, especially in a way that shows a loss of control

examples.en: The vehicle careered across the road and hit a cyclist.
examples.zh: 那辆车横冲过马路，撞上了一个骑自行车的人。

intro.en: These are all words for the jobs that somebody does in return for payment, especially over a long period of time.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指有报酬的工作，尤指长期从事的职业。

items.def: the job that somebody does, especially in order to earn money:
items.zh: 指工作、职业

examples.en: It’s very difficult to find work at the moment.
examples.zh: 目前很难找到工作。

items.def: (rather formal) work, especially when it is done to earn money; the state of being employed or the situation in which people have work:
items.zh: 指工作、职业、受雇、就业

examples.en: Only half the people here are in paid employment.
examples.zh: 这儿只有一半的人有拿工资的工作。

items.def: the job or series of jobs that somebody has in a particular area of work, usually involving more responsibility as time passes:
items.zh: 指生涯、职业

examples.en: He had a very distinguished career in the Foreign Office.
examples.zh: 他在外交部有过一段光辉的事业。

items.def: a type of job that needs special training or skill, especially one that needs a high level of education:
items.zh: 指需要专门技能（尤其是较高教育水平）的职业、专业

examples.en: He hopes to enter the medical profession.
examples.zh: 他希望能从事医务工作。

items.def: (rather formal) a job or profession:
items.zh: 指工作、职业

examples.en: Please state your name, age, and occupation.
examples.zh: 请写明姓名、年龄和职业。

items.def: a job, especially one that involves working with your hands and requires special training and skills:
items.zh: 指行业，尤指手工职业、手艺、行当

examples.en: Carpentry is a highly skilled trade.
examples.zh: 木工是需要纯熟技巧的职业。

senses.def: a period of time when you do not do your usual job, for example because you have children to care for
senses.zh: 离职期（如因照料小孩之需）

senses.def: a woman whose career is very important to her; this word is mainly used by people who think this is unusual or bad
senses.zh: 职业女性（视事业比结婚生孩子更重要的女人）

senses.def: the fact of being more interested in your career than anything else
a person whose career is more important to them than anything else
senses.zh: 视事业重于一切的人；事业狂

examples.en: He was accused of being a cynical careerist.
examples.zh: 他被指责是个只顾自己利益的事业狂人。

examples.en: a careerist politician
examples.zh: 一位政治野心家。

senses.def: having no worries or responsibilities
senses.zh: 无忧无虑的；无牵挂的；无责任的

examples.en: He looked happy and carefree.
examples.zh: 他看起来轻松愉快。

examples.en: a carefree attitude/life
examples.zh: 轻松自在的态度；无忧无虑的生活

senses.def: giving attention or thought to what you are doing so that you avoid hurting yourself, damaging something or doing something wrong

examples.en: Be careful!
examples.zh: 小心！

examples.en: I was careful to keep out of sight.
examples.zh: 我小心翼翼地避开别人的视线。

examples.en: He's been careful to avoid significant debt.
examples.zh: 他一直小心翼翼地避免背负巨额债务。

examples.en: Be careful not to wake the baby.
examples.zh: 注意别吵醒了宝宝。

examples.en: You must be careful when handling chemicals.
examples.zh: 搬运化学品必须小心谨慎。

examples.en: Be careful what you say.
examples.zh: 你说话要当心。

examples.en: Please be careful with my glasses (= Don't break them).
examples.zh: 请当心别打碎我的眼镜。

examples.en: Be careful of the traffic.
examples.zh: 注意交通安全。

examples.en: As a young actor, you have to be extremely careful about the roles you accept.
examples.zh: 作为一名年轻的演员，接演角色须慎之又慎。

examples.en: I’m very careful about washing my hands before eating (= I make sure I do it).
examples.zh: 我在吃饭前非常小心地洗手（=我确保这样做）。

examples.en: Be careful you don't bump your head.
examples.zh: 留神别撞了你的头。

senses.def: giving a lot of attention to details

examples.en: After careful consideration we have decided to offer you the job.
examples.zh: 经过慎重考虑后，我们决定给你这份工作。

examples.en: A successful party requires careful planning.
examples.zh: 成功的聚会要悉心策划。

examples.en: He praised the careful attention to detail shown by the report's authors.
examples.zh: 他赞扬了报告作者关注细节。

examples.en: She made a careful analysis of the evidence.
examples.zh: 她对证据进行了仔细的分析。

examples.en: Careful study of finds from archaeological sites has confirmed this theory.
examples.zh: 对考古遗址发现的仔细研究证实了这一理论。

examples.en: This is a very careful piece of work.
examples.zh: 这是一件精雕细琢的作品。

examples.en: A careful examination of the facts suggests a different conclusion.

examples.zh: 此案下周审理。

intro.en: These are all words for a thing or situation that is typical of a particular group or set, and is sometimes used to support an argument.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指事例、实例、例证。

items.def: something such as an object, a fact or a situation that shows, explains or supports what you say; a thing that is typical of or represents a particular group or set:
