examples.en: She went out charring in the mornings.
examples.zh: 她早上出去烧炭。

intro.en: These words all mean to damage, injure, destroy or kill somebody/​something with heat or fire.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含因高温或火导致损坏、损伤、毁灭之义。

items.def: to damage, injure, destroy or kill somebody/​something with fire, heat or acid; to be damaged, etc. by fire, heat or acid:
items.zh: 指烧（或灼）坏、烧（或灼）伤、烧（或灼）死

examples.en: She burned all his letters.
examples.zh: 她把他的信全部付之一炬。

items.def: [usually passive] to make something black by burning it; to become black by burning:
items.zh: 指（使）烧黑、烧焦

examples.en: The bodies had been charred beyond recognition.
examples.zh: 这些尸体已烧焦，无法辨认。

items.def: to burn part of your body with very hot liquid or steam.
items.zh: 指被高温液体或气体烫伤

items.def: to burn and slightly damage a surface by making it too hot:
items.zh: 指把物体表面烫坏、烧煳、烤焦

examples.en: I scorched my dress when I was ironing it.
examples.zh: 我把自己的连衣裙熨焦了。

items.def: to burn the surface of something slightly, usually by mistake; to be burnt in this way:
items.zh: 尤指不小心把物体表面烤焦、烫煳

examples.en: He singed his hair as he tried to light the candle.
examples.zh: 当他试图点燃蜡烛时，头发被烧焦了。

senses.def: an early type of bus, used in the past especially for pleasure trips
senses.zh: （尤指用于游览的老式）旅游车，游览车

senses.def: a person or an animal in a book, play or film
senses.zh: （书、戏剧或电影中的）人物，角色

examples.en: the main character in the film
examples.zh: 电影的主角

examples.en: a major/minor character in the book
examples.zh: 书中的主要／次要人物

examples.en: Who plays the main character?
examples.zh: 谁扮演主角？

examples.en: He loves to draw and create his own cartoon characters.
examples.zh: 他喜欢画画并创作自己的卡通人物。

examples.en: Her character is the most sympathetic in the movie.
examples.zh: 她的角色是电影中最令人同情的角色。

senses.def: a particular type of person in a play, film or TV show
senses.zh: （戏剧、电影或电视节目中形象鲜明的）性格演员，个性角色

examples.en: He has developed a skill set from his character work in film, TV and stage.
examples.zh: 他从电影、电视和舞台上的角色工作中发展出了一套技能。

senses.def: all the qualities and features that make a person different from others

examples.en: to have a strong/weak character
examples.zh: 个性强／软弱

examples.en: character traits
examples.zh: 性格特点

examples.en: character defects
examples.zh: 性格弱点

examples.en: The book gives a fascinating insight into her character.
examples.zh: 这本书对她的性格进行了令人着迷的洞察。

examples.en: Generosity is part of the American character.
examples.zh: 慷慨是美国人性格的一部分。

senses.def: strong personal qualities such as the ability to deal with difficult or dangerous situations

examples.en: Everyone admires her strength of character and determination.
examples.zh: 每一个人都钦佩她坚强的性格和决心。

examples.en: He showed great character returning to the sport after his accident.
examples.zh: 他在出了事故后仍能重返体坛表现出他顽强的毅力。

examples.en: Adventure camps are considered to be character-building (= meant to improve somebody's strong qualities).
examples.zh: 冒险野营生活被认为能磨炼意志。

senses.def: the way that something is; a particular quality or feature that a thing, an event or a place has
senses.zh: （事物、事件或地方的）特点，特征，特色

examples.en: The character of the neighbourhood hasn't changed at all.
examples.zh: 这片街区的风貌依旧。

examples.en: I love the delicate character of the light in the evening.
examples.zh: 我喜欢夜间柔和的灯火。

examples.en: The police pointed out the illegal character of the protest action.
examples.zh: 警方指出抗议行动的非法性质。

examples.en: buildings that are very simple in character
examples.zh: 造型很简洁的建筑物

senses.def: the interesting or unusual quality that a place or a person has
senses.zh: （地方或人的）与众不同之处，特色

examples.en: The modern hotels here have no real character.
examples.zh: 此处的现代化旅馆毫无特色可言。

examples.en: a face with a lot of character
examples.zh: 与众不同的面孔

senses.def: a person, particularly an unpleasant or strange one

examples.en: There were some really strange characters hanging around in the park.
examples.zh: 公园里有一些非常奇怪的人物。

senses.group: strange/interesting person 古怪的／有趣的人

senses.def: an interesting or unusual person

examples.en: She's a character!
examples.zh: 她真是个有趣的人！

senses.group: strange/interesting person 古怪的／有趣的人

senses.def: the opinion that people have of you, particularly of whether you can be trusted or relied on

examples.en: a slur/attack on his character
examples.zh: 对他名誉的诋毁／攻击

examples.en: My teacher agreed to be a character witness for me in court.
examples.zh: 我的老师同意出庭做我的品德信誉见证人。

examples.en: a character reference (= a letter that a person who knows you well writes to an employer to tell them about your good qualities)
examples.zh: 品德证明书

senses.def: a letter, sign, mark or symbol used in writing, in printing or on computers
senses.zh: （书写、印刷或计算机上的）文字，字母，符号

examples.en: These are the Chinese characters meaning ‘wind’ and ‘water’.
examples.zh: 这些汉字的意思是wind（风）和water（水）。

examples.en: This size of type produces a line 30 characters long.
examples.zh: 用这种字号，一行可长达30个字符。

examples.en: The URL contained non-standard characters like question marks.
examples.zh: URL 地址包含问号等非标准字符。

senses.def: typical/not typical of a person’s character
senses.zh: 符合（或不符合）某人的性格

examples.en: Her behaviour last night was completely out of character.
examples.zh: 她昨晚的举止与她的性格截然不符。

examples.en: The lawyer argued that his client's violent behaviour was out of character.
examples.zh: 律师争辩说当事人的暴力行为与他的性格完全不符。

senses.def: in the same style as something

examples.en: The new wing of the museum was not really in character with the rest of the building.
examples.zh: 博物馆新建的配楼与大楼其他部分的风格有些不一样。

senses.def: typical/not typical of a person’s character
senses.zh: 符合（或不符合）某人的性格

examples.en: Her behaviour last night was completely out of character.
examples.zh: 她昨晚的举止与她的性格截然不符。

examples.en: The lawyer argued that his client's violent behaviour was out of character.
examples.zh: 律师争辩说当事人的暴力行为与他的性格完全不符。

senses.def: in the same style as something

examples.en: The new wing of the museum was not really in character with the rest of the building.
examples.zh: 博物馆新建的配楼与大楼其他部分的风格有些不一样。

senses.def: an actor who always takes the parts of interesting or unusual people, instead of taking one of the main parts
the unfair treatment of a person, with the aim of damaging their reputation
senses.zh: （尤指报纸或电视上不公平的）人格诋毁，人身攻击，诽谤

examples.en: He claimed that he was the victim of character assassination by the press.
examples.zh: 他声称自己是媒体人格诽谤的受害者。

senses.def: a combination of numbers that is used to represent a particular letter, number or symbol
senses.zh: 字符代码；字符码；字元码

senses.def: the ability of a computer to read numbers or letters that are printed or written by hand
senses.zh: 字符识别（计算机读取印刷或手写数字或字母的能力）

senses.def: very interesting and unusual
a typical feature or quality that something/somebody has

examples.en: There were few similarities in the brothers' physical characteristics.
examples.zh: 哥哥和弟弟的体貌特征几乎没有相似之处。

examples.en: All human languages share some common characteristics.
examples.zh: 所有人类语言都有一些共同的特点。

examples.en: The two groups of children have quite different characteristics.
examples.zh: 这两组儿童具有截然不同的特点。

examples.en: Personal characteristics such as age are taken into account.
examples.zh: 年龄等个人特征都会被考虑在内。

examples.en: genetic characteristics
examples.zh: 遗传特征

examples.en: The need to communicate is a key characteristic of human society.
examples.zh: 需要交流是人类社会最重要的一个特征。

examples.en: a defining characteristic of contemporary American culture
examples.zh: 当代美国文化的典型特征

senses.def: very typical of something or of somebody’s character

examples.en: Community support of families is characteristic of many societies.
examples.zh: 社区帮扶住户是许多社会的特点。

examples.en: This is just one example of the rudeness that was so characteristic of him.
examples.zh: 这只是他粗鲁行为的一个例子。

examples.en: the characteristic features of his style of painting
examples.zh: 其画风特点

examples.en: She spoke with characteristic enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 她说话带着特有的热情。

senses.def: in a way that is very typical of something or of somebody's character

examples.en: Her response was characteristically blunt.
examples.zh: 她的回答是典型的直率。

examples.en: Characteristically, Helen paid for everyone.
examples.zh: 一如她的作风，海伦替所有人付了账。

examples.en: Parkinson's disease characteristically occurs in old age.
examples.zh: 帕金森病通常发生在老年。

senses.def: the way that a writer makes characters in a book or play seem real
senses.zh: （对书或戏剧中人物的）刻画，描绘，塑造

examples.en: a work of comic brilliance and masterly characterization
examples.zh: 一部充满喜剧才华和精湛人物塑造的作品

examples.en: The film is worth seeing for its fine characterizations.
examples.zh: 这部电影因其细腻的人物塑造而值得一看。

senses.def: the way in which somebody/something is described or defined

examples.en: This is an unfair characterization of the prime minister.
examples.zh: 这是对首相不公正的描述。

senses.def: to be typical of a person, place or thing

examples.en: the rolling hills that characterize this part of England
examples.zh: 成为英格兰这一地区特征的绵延起伏的丘陵地

examples.en: The city is characterized by tall modern buildings in steel and glass.
examples.zh: 这座城市的特点是钢铁和玻璃建造的现代化高楼大厦林立。

senses.def: to describe or show the qualities of somebody/something in a particular way
senses.zh: 描述，刻画，表现（…的特征、特点）

examples.en: How would you characterize the mood of the 1990s?
examples.zh: 您如何形容 20 世纪 90 年代的情绪？

examples.en: Her political views have been characterized as ‘extreme’.
examples.zh: 她的政治观点被描述为“极端”。

senses.def: having no interesting qualities
senses.zh: 无特征的；无个性的；平凡的

senses.def: a situation in which people pretend that something is true when it clearly is not
senses.zh: 明显的伪装；做戏；装模作样

examples.en: Their whole marriage had been a charade—they had never loved each other.
examples.zh: 他们的整个婚姻都是在做戏，他们从未相爱过。

examples.en: We had to go through this whole charade of holding auditions for the part.
examples.zh: 我们不得不装模作样地为这个角色进行试镜。

senses.def: a game in which one player acts out the syllables of a word or title and the other players try to guess what it is

examples.en: Let's play charades.
examples.zh: 咱们来玩打哑谜猜字游戏吧。

senses.def: to cook meat or other food over charcoal
a black substance made by burning wood slowly in an oven with little air. Charcoal
senses.zh: 炭，木炭（可作燃料或供作画）

examples.en: charcoal-grilled steaks
examples.zh: 用木炭烤制的牛排

examples.en: a charcoal drawing
examples.zh: 炭笔画

senses.def: a very dark grey colour
a vegetable with large green leaves and thick white, yellow or red stems
a type of white wine, or the type of grape
senses.zh: 霞多丽白葡萄酒；霞多丽葡萄

senses.def: the amount of money that somebody asks for goods and services
senses.zh: （商品和服务所需的）要价，收费

examples.en: admission charges
examples.zh: 入场费

examples.en: We have to make a small charge for refreshments.
examples.zh: 我们得收取少量茶点费。

examples.en: Delivery is free of charge.
examples.zh: 免费送货。

senses.def: a charge account

examples.en: Would you like to put that on your charge?
examples.zh: 你愿意把这笔费用记在你的账上吗？

examples.en: ‘Are you paying cash?’ ‘No, it'll be a charge.’
examples.zh: “你用现金支付吗？”“不，记账吧。”

senses.def: a position of having control over somebody/something; responsibility for somebody/something

examples.en: She has charge of the day-to-day running of the business.
examples.zh: 她负责掌管日常业务。

examples.en: He took charge of the farm after his father's death.
examples.zh: 他在父亲去世后掌管了农场。

examples.en: They left the au pair in charge of the children for a week.
examples.zh: 他们把孩子留给做换工的照料一周。

examples.en: I'm leaving the school in your charge.
examples.zh: 我这就把学校交给你掌管。

senses.def: a person that you have responsibility for and care for
an official claim made by the police that somebody has committed a crime

examples.en: criminal charges
examples.zh: 刑事指控

examples.en: a murder/an assault charge
examples.zh: 谋杀罪／侵犯人身罪的指控

examples.en: a charge of theft/rape/attempted murder
examples.zh: 盗窃/强奸/谋杀未遂的指控

examples.en: He will be sent back to England to face a charge of (= to be on trial for) armed robbery.
examples.zh: 他将被遣返回英格兰面临持械抢劫罪的指控。

examples.en: Both men deny the charges.
examples.zh: 两人都否认指控。

examples.en: They decided to drop the charges against the newspaper and settle out of court.
examples.zh: 他们已决定撤销对那家报纸的指控，在庭外和解。

examples.en: After being questioned by the police, she was released without charge.
examples.zh: 她被警察传讯后无罪释放。

senses.group: of crime/something wrong 罪行；过失

senses.def: a statement accusing somebody of doing something wrong or bad

examples.en: She rejected the charge that the story was untrue.
examples.zh: 她否认了说她编造事实的指责。

examples.en: Be careful you don't leave yourself open to charges of political bias.
examples.zh: 你要小心别留下把柄，让人家指责你带有政治偏见。

senses.group: of crime/something wrong 罪行；过失

senses.def: the amount of electricity that is put into a battery or carried by a substance
senses.zh: （电池的）充电量；（带电物质的）电荷

examples.en: a positive/negative charge
examples.zh: 正电荷；负电荷

senses.def: the act of putting electricity into a battery; the electricity in a battery

examples.en: He put his phone on charge.
examples.zh: 他给他的手机充电。

examples.en: My laptop had run out of charge.
examples.zh: 我的笔记本电脑没电了。

senses.def: a sudden rush or violent attack, for example by soldiers, wild animals or players in some sports

examples.en: He led the charge down the field.
examples.zh: 他带头沿着球场冲杀过去。

senses.def: the amount of explosive
the power to cause strong feelings

examples.en: the emotional charge of the piano piece
examples.zh: 那首钢琴曲扣人心弦的感染力

examples.en: a film in which every scene carries an emotional charge
examples.zh: 一部每个场景都深具感染力的影片

senses.def: a task or duty

examples.en: His charge was to obtain specific information.
examples.zh: 他的任务是收集具体的信息。

senses.def: to accuse somebody formally of a crime so that there can be a trial in court

examples.en: Police have brought a charge of dangerous driving against the man.
examples.zh: 警方以危险驾驶罪控告那名男子。

examples.en: Many victims of crime are reluctant to press charges against their attackers.
examples.zh: 许多罪案的受害者不愿意指控侵害他们的人。

examples.en: She laid charges against the firm for not complying with the regulations.
examples.zh: 她指控该公司不遵守规定。

senses.def: to get a strong feeling of excitement or pleasure from something

examples.en: I get a real charge out of working hard and seeing good results.
examples.zh: 努力工作并且取得好成果真是让我兴奋极了。

senses.def: to be the first to make the effort to do something new

examples.en: Denmark, Norway and Sweden are united in leading the charge to a cash-free economy.
examples.zh: 丹麦、挪威和瑞典联合起来，引领无现金经济的发展。

senses.def: to ask an amount of money for goods or a service

examples.en: The fees charged by some companies are excessive.
examples.zh: 有些公司收费过高。

examples.en: What did they charge for the repairs?
examples.zh: 他们收了多少修理费？

examples.en: The restaurant charges £40 for the set menu.
examples.zh: 这家餐馆的套餐价格是 40 英镑。

examples.en: They are charging a reasonable price for the subscription.
examples.zh: 他们收取合理的订阅价格。

examples.en: We won't charge you for delivery.
examples.zh: 我们送货不收费。

examples.en: He only charged me half price.
examples.zh: 他只收我半价。

examples.en: Some councils will charge you a small fee for bulky waste collection.
examples.zh: 有些市议会会向您收取少量大件垃圾收集费用。

examples.en: Calls are charged at 36p per minute.
examples.zh: 电话费按每分钟 36 便士收取。

examples.en: Do you think museums should charge for admission?
examples.zh: 你认为博物馆应该收入场费吗？

examples.en: The bank doesn't charge to stop a payment.
examples.zh: 银行不收取停止付款的手续费。

examples.en: They charge you to change money into euros.
examples.zh: 兑换欧元要收费。

senses.def: to record the cost of something as an amount that somebody has to pay
senses.zh: 把…记在账上；在某人账上记入

examples.en: They charge the calls to their credit-card account.
examples.zh: 他们用信用卡账户支付电话费。

examples.en: Don't worry. I'll charge it (= pay by credit card).
examples.zh: 别担心，我会用信用卡付款的。

examples.en: Research and development expenditure is charged against profits in the year it is incurred.
examples.zh: 研发费根据其当年所产生的利润收取。

senses.def: to pass electricity through something so that it is stored there; to take in electricity so that it is stored and ready for use

examples.en: I need to charge my phone.
examples.zh: 我需要给我的手机充电。

examples.en: Before use, the battery must be charged.
examples.zh: 电池使用前必须充电。

examples.en: Don't unplug my phone—it's charging.
examples.zh: 不要拔掉我的手机——它正在充电。

examples.en: Let the batteries charge fully before using.
examples.zh: 使用前给电池充满电。

examples.en: The shaver can be charged up and used when travelling.
examples.zh: 这种电动剃须刀可充电供旅行使用。

senses.def: to accuse somebody formally of a crime so that there can be a trial in court

examples.en: Several people were arrested but nobody was charged.
examples.zh: 有数人被捕，但均未受到起诉。

examples.en: He was charged with murder.
examples.zh: 他被指控犯有谋杀罪。

examples.en: They were charged with organizing an illegal demonstration.
examples.zh: 他们被指控组织非法示威。

senses.group: with crime/something wrong 犯罪；过失

senses.def: to accuse somebody publicly of doing something wrong or bad

examples.en: Opposition MPs charged the minister with neglecting her duty.
examples.zh: 反对党议员指责这名女部长玩忽职守。

senses.group: with crime/something wrong 犯罪；过失

senses.def: to make a claim or statement that something will happen or be the case

examples.en: Opponents charged that cutting costs would reduce safety.
examples.zh: 反对者宣称削减成本会降低安全性。

senses.group: with crime/something wrong 犯罪；过失

senses.def: to rush forward and attack somebody/something

examples.en: The bull put its head down and charged.
examples.zh: 公牛低下头猛冲过来。

examples.en: We charged at the enemy.
examples.zh: 我们向敌人发起冲锋。

senses.def: to rush in a particular direction

examples.en: The children charged down the stairs.
examples.zh: 孩子们冲下了楼梯。

examples.en: He came charging into my room and demanded to know what was going on.
examples.zh: 他冲进我的房间，要求知道发生了什么事。

senses.def: to give somebody a responsibility or task
senses.zh: 赋予…职责（或任务）；使…承担责任（或任务）

examples.en: The committee has been charged with the development of sport in the region.
examples.zh: 委员会已被赋予在该地区发展体育运动的职责。

examples.en: The governing body is charged with managing the school within its budget.
examples.zh: 学校管理部门负有在预算范围内管理好学校的职责。

senses.def: to fill somebody with an emotion

examples.en: The room was charged with hatred.
examples.zh: 这个房间里充满了敌意。

senses.group: with strong feeling 强烈感情

senses.def: to fill a glass

examples.en: Please charge your glasses and drink a toast to the bride and groom!
examples.zh: 请各位斟满酒杯向新娘、新郎敬酒！

senses.def: to load a gun
to accuse somebody formally of a crime so that there can be a trial in court

examples.en: Police have brought a charge of dangerous driving against the man.
examples.zh: 警方以危险驾驶罪控告那名男子。

examples.en: Many victims of crime are reluctant to press charges against their attackers.
examples.zh: 许多罪案的受害者不愿意指控侵害他们的人。

examples.en: She laid charges against the firm for not complying with the regulations.
examples.zh: 她指控该公司不遵守规定。

items.idm: get a charge out of something

senses.def: to get a strong feeling of excitement or pleasure from something

examples.en: I get a real charge out of working hard and seeing good results.
examples.zh: 努力工作并且取得好成果真是让我兴奋极了。

senses.def: to be the first to make the effort to do something new

examples.en: Denmark, Norway and Sweden are united in leading the charge to a cash-free economy.
examples.zh: 丹麦、挪威和瑞典联合起来，引领无现金经济的发展。

senses.def: to charge, etc. a lot of money

examples.en: I'd love that dress, but it costs the earth.
examples.zh: 我很喜欢那条连衣裙，但贵得离谱。

examples.en: If you want a house in London, you’ll have to pay the earth for it.
examples.zh: 如果你想在伦敦买一栋房子，你就得向地球付出代价。

charge, cost, pay, etc. the earth.word: charge, cost, pay, etc. the earth

senses.def: an arrangement with a shop or business to pay for goods and services at a later time, for example in regular amounts every month
the act of setting a limit on the amount of money that the local government of an area can charge people in order to pay for public services
senses.zh: （地方政府为公共服务向公众收取的）收费限额

senses.def: a type of credit card on which the whole amount owed must be paid each month
an official who takes the place of an ambassador
senses.zh: 临时代办（大使不在期间代行其职责）

senses.def: an official below the rank of ambassador
senses.zh: 代办（派驻在未设大使国家的外交官）

senses.def: a nurse, especially a man, who is in charge of a hospital ward
senses.zh: 主管护士，护士长（多为男性）

senses.def: a record kept in a police station of the names of people that the police have charged with a crime
that must be paid by somebody

examples.en: Any expenses you may incur will be chargeable to the company.
examples.zh: 你的所有开销均由本公司支付。

senses.def: that you must pay tax on

examples.en: chargeable earnings/income
examples.zh: 应征税的工资／收入

senses.def: a worker in charge of others on a particular job, but below the rank of a foreman
a piece of equipment for loading a battery with electricity

examples.en: a phone charger
examples.zh: 手机充电器

senses.def: a horse that a soldier rode in battle in the past

examples.en: knights on white chargers
examples.zh: 白色战马上的骑士

senses.def: to accuse somebody formally of committing an offence and to ask for an official reply or defence
a place or piece of equipment for charging electric vehicles with electricity

examples.en: We installed rapid electric vehicle charging points on the campus last year.
examples.zh: 去年，我们在校园内安装了电动汽车快速充电站。

examples.en: Can company car drivers get funding for home charge points?
examples.zh: 公司司机家里安装充电桩能得到资助吗？

senses.def: a place or piece of equipment for charging electric vehicles with electricity

examples.en: The government is committed to installing 50 000 more charging stations within the next 18 months.
examples.zh: 政府承诺在未来 18 个月内再安装 5 万个充电站。

examples.en: Drivers of electric cars need to plan ahead to find a charging station in many parts of the region.
examples.zh: 在该地区的很多地方，电动车司机需要提前规划找好充电桩。

senses.def: to cook meat, fish or vegetables over a very high heat so that the outside is slightly burnt
senses.zh: 高温烤炙，高温烧烤（至表皮焦黄）

examples.en: chargrilled chicken
examples.zh: 炭烤鸡

senses.def: an area of central London, where Whitehall
senses.zh: 查林十字街（Charing Cross）：伦敦市中心，白厅（Whitehall）与特拉法加广场（Trafalgar Square）交汇的地方。它的名字来自卡斯蒂利亚女王埃莉诺（Eleanor of Castile）尸体在其葬于维斯敏斯特大教堂（Westminster Abbey）的路上过夜的每个地方留下的一个石制十字架。1290年，最初的十字架接近现在的查令十字车站（Charing Cross Station）伦敦的主要火车站，用于往返于英格兰南部和东南部的火车，伦敦地铁上也设有火车站。十字架的副本站在车站前。在测量到其他城镇的距离时，查林十字街被认为是伦敦的确切中心。

senses.def: a street in central London, which is famous for its second-hand
senses.zh: 查林十字路（Charing Cross Road）：伦敦市中心的一条街道，以二手书店而闻名。伦敦许多最重要的新书商店也在查令十字路（Charing Cross Road）上。

senses.def: an open vehicle with two wheels, pulled by horses, used in ancient times in battle and for racing
senses.zh: （古代用于战斗或比赛的）双轮敞篷马车

senses.def: the driver of a chariot
a film (1981) about the 1924 Olympic Games, in which Harold Abrahams, a British runner, won the gold medal for the 100 metres race. The film won several Oscars
senses.zh: 战车：一部讲述1924年奥运会的电影（1981年），其中一位英国选手哈罗德·亚伯拉罕斯（Harold Abrahams）赢得了100米赛跑的金牌。这部电影获得了数项奥斯卡奖，并在英国大受欢迎。它的标题是威廉·布莱克（William Blake）的诗《耶路撒冷》中的一句话。

senses.def: the powerful personal quality that some people have to attract and impress other people
senses.zh: 超凡的个人魅力；感召力；号召力

examples.en: The President has great personal charisma.
examples.zh: 总统具有超凡的个人魅力。

examples.en: a lack of charisma
examples.zh: 缺乏个人魅力

senses.def: having charisma
senses.zh: 有超凡魅力的；有号召力（或感召力）的

examples.en: the charismatic leader of a religious sect
examples.zh: 某教派魅力超凡的领袖

senses.def: believing in special gifts from God and holding very enthusiastic religious services
a charismatic
in a way that shows a lot of charisma
connected with a charity or charities
senses.zh: 慈善团体的；慈善事业的

examples.en: a charitable institution/foundation/trust
examples.zh: 慈善机构／基金会／基金机构

examples.en: a charitable donation/gift
examples.zh: 慈善捐赠／赠品

examples.en: to have charitable status (= to be an official charity)
examples.zh: 是认可的慈善机构

senses.def: helping people who are poor or in need

examples.en: His later years were devoted largely to charitable work.
examples.zh: 他晚年主要致力于慈善工作。

senses.def: kind in your attitude to other people, especially when you are judging them

examples.en: Let's be charitable and assume she just made a mistake.
examples.zh: 咱们宽容些吧，就当她只是犯了个错误。

examples.en: Less charitable accounts of his character say he was vain and selfish.
examples.zh: 对他性格的不太仁慈的描述称他虚荣且自私。

senses.def: kindly, especially when you are judging other people
senses.zh: 友善，尤其是当你评判别人的时候

examples.en: Try to think about him a little more charitably.
examples.zh: 尽量宽容一点看待他吧。

senses.def: by a charity or charities
senses.zh: 慈善团体的；慈善事业的

examples.en: The helpline is charitably funded.
examples.zh: 该帮助热线由慈善机构资助。

senses.def: an organization for helping people in need

examples.en: a registered charity
examples.zh: 注册慈善机构

examples.en: the UK's largest children's charity
examples.zh: 英国最大的儿童慈善机构

examples.en: Many charities sent money to help the victims of the famine.
examples.zh: 许多慈善机构捐款赈济饥民。

examples.en: The concert will raise money for local charities.
examples.zh: 这场音乐会将为当地慈善机构募捐。

examples.en: My parents always supported charities.
examples.zh: 我的父母一直支持慈善事业。

examples.en: a charity for homeless people
examples.zh: 为无家可归者设立的慈善机构

senses.def: organizations for helping people in need, considered as a group; the money, food, help, etc. that they give

examples.en: Most of the runners in the London Marathon are raising money for charity.
examples.zh: 大多数人参加伦敦马拉松赛跑是为慈善事业募集资金。

examples.en: A portion of the proceeds was donated to charity.
examples.zh: 一部分收入捐给了慈善机构。

examples.en: Do you give much to charity?
examples.zh: 慈善捐助你捐得多吗？

examples.en: a charity event (= organized to get money for charity)
examples.zh: 慈善活动

examples.en: All the profits go to charity.
examples.zh: 所有利润都捐献给慈善机构。

examples.en: a charity auction/concert/football match
examples.zh: 慈善拍卖/音乐会/足球比赛

examples.en: She does a lot of charity work.
examples.zh: 她做了很多慈善工作。

examples.en: to live on/off charity (= to live on money which other people give you because you are poor)
examples.zh: 靠赈济生活

senses.def: kind behaviour and sympathy towards other people, especially when you are judging them

examples.en: Her article showed no charity towards her former friends.
examples.zh: 她的文章对她以前的朋友毫不宽容。

examples.en: He replied patiently, with more charity than I deserved.
examples.zh: 他耐心地回答，比我应得的更加仁慈。

senses.def: you should help and care for your own family, etc. before you start helping other people
you should help and care for your own family, etc. before you start helping other people
you should help and care for your own family, etc. before you start helping other people
a shop that sells clothes and other goods given by people to raise money for a charity
senses.zh: 慈善商店（通过出售捐赠的衣物等募集慈善资金）

senses.def: a woman whose job is to clean a house, an office building, etc.
a person who claims to have knowledge or skills that they do not really have

examples.en: He knows nothing about medicine—he’s a complete charlatan.
examples.zh: 他对医学一无所知——他是个彻头彻尾的江湖骗子。

senses.def: a first name for boys

(1894-1974) an American who had great success selling courses on how to develop muscles and a stronger body, using a method which he called 'dynamic tension'. The advertisements for his courses showed a thin man ('a seven-stone weakling') on the beach having sand kicked in his face by a strong man who was popular with the girls. Atlas's name is sometimes used to refer to somebody who is very strong.
senses.zh: 查尔斯·阿特拉斯（Charles Atlas）：（1894-1974）是一位美国人，他成功地销售了有关如何发展肌肉和更强壮身体的课程，并使用了一种称为“动态张力”的方法。在他的课程广告中，一个瘦小的男人（一个七石弱者）在沙滩上，被一个受女孩子欢迎的强壮的男人踢了沙子。Atlas的名字有时用来指非常强壮的人。

senses.def: (1795-1860) an English architect who designed the Houses of Parliament
senses.zh: 查尔斯·巴里（Charles Barry）：（1795-1860）是一位英国建筑师，他以哥特式复兴的风格设计了伦敦的国会大厦。1852年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1809-82) the English naturalist
senses.zh: 查尔斯·达尔文（1809–1882）英国博物学家，自然选择进化论创立者。年轻时乘英国“小猎犬号”舰航行五年，遍游世界南部海岸和岛屿。在旅途中，尤其是在太平洋加拉帕戈斯群岛发现的不同类型动植物，使达尔文相信，在漫长的时间进程中不同地方会演化出不同的生物。而当时大多数西方人认为天地万物是上帝在七日内创造的。1836 年返回英国，并在此后 23 年里为自己的理论收集证据。其著作《论借助自然选择的方法的物种起源》（1859）因违背圣经中的创世故事而引发极大争论乃至愤怒。如今多数人接受达尔文理论的主要观点，许多人将它和圣经视为对同一件事的两种叙述。但也有人对圣经依文解义，尤其在美国，认为学校只应教授“创世论”，或称“创造论科学”。

senses.def: (1812-70) an English writer of novels who combined great writing with the ability to write popular stories full of interesting characters, such as Scrooge
senses.zh: 查尔斯·狄更斯（1812–1870）英国小说家，善于在作品中讲述引人入胜的情节，刻画妙趣横生的角色，如吝啬鬼斯克鲁奇、贼首费金和机灵鬼道奇。许多作品着笔于维多利亚时代的英国生活，描述穷人的恶劣生活。其早期小说，如《匹克威克外传》和《雾都孤儿》，多为周刊或月刊撰写的连载。后期作品包括《大卫·科波菲尔》、《双城记》和《远大前程》。

senses.def: Bonny Prince Charlie
senses.zh: 查尔斯·爱德华·斯图尔特：邦妮·普林斯·查理

senses.def: (1600-49) king of England, Scotland and Ireland (1625-49). He often disagreed with Parliament, and in 1629 he stopped it meeting and tried to rule the country without it until 1640, when he needed Parliament to help raise money for a war against Scotland. The Long Parliament
senses.zh: 查理一世（1600–1649）英格兰、苏格兰及爱尔兰国王（1625–1649 在位）。常与议会对立，1629 年解散议会，试图在不召集议会的情况下统治国家。1640 年因需要筹款讨伐苏格兰而再次召集议会，但其要求遭长期议会拒绝，导致英国内战爆发。1647 年被捕，两年后被斩首。

senses.def: (1630-85) king of England, Scotland and Ireland (1660-85). He was the son of Charles I
senses.zh: 查理二世（1630–1685）英格兰、苏格兰及爱尔兰国王（1660–1685 在位）。查理一世之子。英国内战中长期居住国外，奥利弗·克伦威尔去世后，受议会之邀回国即位。纵情享乐，与多名女子有染，包括内尔·格温。

senses.def: (1874-1954) a US composer
senses.zh: 查尔斯·艾夫斯（Charles Ives）：（1874-1954）美国现代古典音乐作曲家。他的作品引入了许多新的音乐思想，但在他的一生中演奏并不多。他最著名的作品之一是《协和钢琴奏鸣曲》（1915年）。

senses.def: (1749-1806) an English Whig
senses.zh: 查尔斯·詹姆斯·福克斯（Charles James Fox）：（1749-1806）英国辉格党政客。在他的大部分职业生涯中，他是反对党领袖，而皮特则是总理。他是摄政王的朋友，也是当时震惊人们的思想的支持者，例如法国大革命，美国独立和奴隶贸易的结束。

senses.def: (1959-2015) a British politician, born in Scotland, who became a Member of Parliament
senses.zh: 查尔斯·肯尼迪（Charles Kennedy）：（1959-2015）是一位英国政治家，出生于苏格兰，他于1983年成为下议院最年轻的议员，成为国会议员。从1999年到2006年，他是自由民主党的领导人。

senses.def: (1819-75) an English writer and priest. He is best known for the novel Westward Ho!
senses.zh: 查尔斯·金斯利：（1819-75）英国作家和牧师。他以有关伊丽莎白女王英格兰的小说《向西！》（Westward Ho！）（1855年）和儿童读物《水上宝贝》而闻名。他还是维多利亚女王的牧师（私人牧师）。

senses.def: (1775-1834) an English writer. His best-known works are Tales from Shakespeare
senses.zh: 查尔斯·兰姆（1775–1834）英国作家。代表作有与姐姐玛丽（1764–1847）合著的儿童读物《莎士比亚故事集》（1807），以及《伊利亚随笔集》（1823）与续集《伊利亚后期随笔集》（1833）。

senses.def: (1899-1962) a British actor who became a US citizen in 1950. His films included The Private Life of Henry VIII
senses.zh: 查尔斯·劳顿（1899-1962）是一位英国演员，于1950年成为美国公民。他的电影包括亨利八世的私人生活（1933年），他因此获得了奥斯卡奖，以及《驼背的巴黎圣母院》（1939年）。他不常被赋予浪漫的部分，他形容自己的脸“像大象的背后”。

senses.def: (1902-74) a US pilot who became the first person to fly across the Atlantic Ocean alone. His popular name was Lindy, and he was also known as the 'Lone Eagle'. He flew from New York on 20 May 1927 and arrived in Paris 33½ hours later. His plane was called Spirit of St Louis
senses.zh: 查尔斯·林德伯格（Charles Lindbergh）：（1902-74）美国飞行员，他是第一个独自飞越大西洋的人。他的俗名是Lindy，他也被称为“孤鹰”。他于1927年5月20日从纽约起飞，并于33½小时后到达巴黎。他的飞机被称为圣路易斯精神。当他返回时，他获得了纽约有史以来最大的游行队伍。1932年，他的小儿子在一次震惊美国的案件中被盗并被杀。林德伯格（Lindbergh）写下了自己的生平，被称为“圣路易斯精神”，并获得了1954年普利策奖。

senses.def: (1832-98) the real name of the English children's author Lewis Carroll
senses.zh: （1832-98）英国儿童作家刘易斯·卡洛尔的真实姓名

senses.def: (1766-1823) a Scottish inventor
senses.zh: 查尔斯·麦金塔（Charles Macintosh）：（1766-1823）是苏格兰的发明家，他开发了一种橡胶制成的材料以防水。“ mackintosh”或“ mac”现在是指用类似材料制成的任何外套以防雨淋的意思。

senses.def: (1925-2010) an Australian conductor
senses.zh: 查尔斯·麦克拉斯（Charles Mackerras）：（1925-2010）是一位澳大利亚指挥，他出生于美国，并于1940年代后期在英国居住。他曾在英国国家歌剧院（1970-77），威尔士国家歌剧院（1987-92）和许多其他乐队工作。1979年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1934-2017) the leader of a group of hippies
senses.zh: 查尔斯·曼森（Charles Manson）：（1934-2017）一群嬉皮士的领导者，被称为他的“家庭”。1969年，该团伙在曼森（Manson）的命令下谋杀了包括洛杉矶附近的演员莎朗·泰特（Sharon Tate）在内的七人。曼森和他的四个追随者被判终身监禁。

senses.def: (1922-79) a US jazz musician. He played the bass
senses.zh: 查尔斯·明格斯（1922-79）是美国爵士音乐家。他弹低音并为其创作音乐。他的作品包括《 Faubus寓言》（1959年）和《墓志铭》（1962年）。他活跃于民权运动，并写了自己的生平，《弱者之下》（1971年）。

senses.def: (1868-1928) a Scottish architect and designer who produced buildings, furniture and decorative
senses.zh: 查尔斯·雷尼·麦金托什（Charles Rennie Mackintosh）：（1868-1928）是一位苏格兰建筑师和设计师，以新艺术风格生产建筑，家具和装饰物。他最著名的建筑是格拉斯哥艺术学院（1899年开业）。他还以水彩画而著称，水彩画主要在他生命的尽头在法国完成。

senses.def: (1922-2000) the US artist who created and drew the popular comic strip
senses.zh: 查尔斯·舒尔茨（Charles Schulz）：（1922-2000）美国艺术家，他创作并绘制了流行的连环画《花生》。他以查理·布朗（Charlie Brown）的性格为基础。

senses.def: (1846-91) an Irish politician who led the campaign for Home Rule
senses.zh: 查尔斯·斯图尔特·帕内尔（Charles Stewart Parnell）：（1846-91）爱尔兰政治人物，于1877年至1890年领导爱尔兰的“自治”运动。随后他突然失去了所有公众支持，因为据透露他与另一名男子的妻子发生了性关系十年。他的支持者称他为“爱尔兰的王冠”。詹姆斯·乔伊斯（James Joyce）的书中经常提到帕内尔（Parnell），他对此非常钦佩。

senses.def: (1707-88) one of the people who helped to establish the Methodist
senses.zh: 查尔斯·卫斯理：（1707-88）与他的兄弟约翰·卫斯理一起帮助在英国建立卫理公会的人之一。他主要以超过7,000首赞美诗（即宗教歌曲）的作者而著称，其中许多赞美诗今天仍很流行。其中包括《爱神》，《全爱超人》和圣诞节颂歌！先驱天使会唱歌。

senses.def: (1802-75) an English scientist and inventor
senses.zh: 查尔斯·惠斯通（Charles Wheatstone）：（1802-75）英国科学家和发明家。他发明了很多东西，包括万花筒（一种由装有彩色玻璃的管子和一个反射镜的镜子组成的玩具，当反射管转动时会形成变化的图案），电钟和惠斯通电桥，一种用于测量电阻。他在伦敦大学教授物理学，并于1868年被任命为骑士。

senses.def: a fast dance that was popular in the 1920s
senses.zh: 查尔斯顿舞（流行于 20 世纪 20 年代的快步舞）

senses.def: a city on the coast of the US state of South Carolina
senses.zh: 查尔斯顿（美国南卡罗来纳州沿海城市）

senses.def: a cramp

examples.en: Ow! I just got a charley horse in my leg.
examples.zh: 哎唷！我的腿抽筋了。

senses.def: a British comedy play (1892) by Brandon Thomas (1856-1914) which is still often performed, especially by amateur
senses.zh: 查理的姨妈：布兰登·托马斯（1856-1914）创作的英国喜剧剧（1892年），至今仍经常演出，尤其是业余演员。这是关于一个男人假装自己是朋友的巴西富婆。当真正的姨妈到来时，会发生有趣而荒谬的事情。

senses.def: a silly person

examples.en: You must have felt a proper charlie!
examples.zh: 你一定觉得自己是个十足的笨蛋！

senses.def: a first name for boys or girls, short for Charles
senses.zh: 查理（男子或女子名，Charles 或 Charlotte 缩写）

senses.def: (1920-55) an American who greatly influenced modern jazz and helped to create the style of bebop
senses.zh: 查理·伯德·帕克（Charlie'Bird'Parker）：（1920-55）一位美国人，对现代爵士乐产生了巨大影响，并帮助创造了波普风格。他弹萨克斯管，也写音乐。在1940年代，他与Miles Davis，Thelonious Monk和'Dizzy'Gillespie等音乐家一起演奏。他的吸毒和酗酒问题导致他早逝。

senses.def: the main character in the US comic strip
senses.zh: 查理·布朗（Charlie Brown）：美国漫画花生中的主角。他是一个对生活中的重要事物（例如棒球）运气不佳的孩子，担心他的朋友们不尊重他，并且因为害羞而无法与他所爱的女孩说话。

senses.def: an American Chinese detective character in books, in films and on television, who regularly solved crimes which the police had failed to solve. He was created in 1925 by the author Earl Derr Biggers who based him on the real detective Chang Apana. More than 40 films were made with different actors playing Chan, including Peter Ustinov
senses.zh: 陈查理（Charlie Chan）：美国华裔侦探，在书籍，电影和电视中扮演角色，经常解决警察未能解决的犯罪。他由作家厄尔·德尔·比格斯（Earl Derr Biggers）于1925年创立，他以真正的侦探张阿帕纳（Chang Apana）为基础。超过40部电影是由不同的演员饰演Chan的电影，包括1980年的PeterUstinov。Chan非常有礼貌，并且经常受到他的“第一儿子”的帮助。

senses.def: (1889-1977) an English film actor and director who did most of his work in the US. Most people consider him the greatest comic actor of the silent cinema. He appeared in many of his films as the best-known character he created, a poor man with a small round hat, a small moustache
senses.zh: 查理·卓别林（1889–1977）英国电影演员、导演。其大部分作品在美国完成。被公认为无声电影时代最伟大的喜剧演员。在多部影片中塑造了一个家喻户晓的穷人角色，戴小圆帽，蓄一撇小胡子，穿肥裤子和特大号鞋子，步态滑稽。拍摄了许多喜剧短片，如《寻子遇仙记》（1921），以及数部长片，如《城市之光》（1931）、《淘金记》（1935）和《摩登时代》（1936），在喜剧中融入了对社会和政治的批判。1975 年获封爵士。

senses.def: a cooked pudding
a commercial city and transportation centre in the US state of North Carolina
senses.zh: 夏洛特（美国北卡罗来纳州的商业城市和运输中心）

senses.def: a first name for girls
the capital and main port of Prince Edward Island, in eastern Canada
senses.zh: 夏洛特敦（加拿大东部爱德华王子岛省的首府和主要港口）

senses.def: (1924-2008) a US actor famous for playing leading parts in big historical films. He was Moses in The Ten Commandments
senses.zh: 查尔顿·赫斯顿（Charlton Heston）：（1924-2008）是一位美国演员，以在大型历史电影中扮演主角而闻名。他是《十诫》（1956）中的摩西，并因本·胡尔（1959）获奥斯卡奖。他以保守的见解而闻名（反对许多政治和社会变革），并担任国家步枪协会主席（1998年至2003年）。

senses.def: the power of pleasing or attracting people

examples.en: He was a man of great charm.
examples.zh: 他是个极富魅力的男人。

examples.en: The hotel is full of charm and character.
examples.zh: 这家旅馆风格独特，极具吸引力。

senses.def: a feature or quality that is pleasant or attractive
senses.zh: 迷人的特征；吸引人的特性；妩媚

examples.en: her physical charms (= her beauty)
examples.zh: 她那妩媚的外貌

senses.def: a small object worn on a chain or bracelet
senses.zh: （链子或手镯上的）吉祥小饰物

examples.en: a lucky charm
examples.zh: 吉祥配饰

examples.en: a charm bracelet
examples.zh: 吊饰手镯

senses.def: an act or words believed to have magic power
used when you have failed to do something twice and hope that you will succeed the third time
senses.zh: （但愿）第三次交好运；过一过二不过三

senses.def: to be immediately and completely successful

examples.en: Those new pills you gave me worked like a charm.
examples.zh: 你给我的那些新药丸真是药到病除。

examples.en: Her strategy worked like a charm.
examples.zh: 她的策略完全奏效了。

senses.def: to please or attract somebody in order to make them like you or do what you want

examples.en: He was charmed by her beauty and wit.
examples.zh: 他被她的才貌迷住了。

examples.en: Her words had lost their power to charm.
examples.zh: 她的话再也没有吸引力了。

examples.en: He charmed his mother into letting him have his own way.
examples.zh: 他哄得母亲让他随心所愿。

senses.def: to control or protect somebody/something using magic, or as if using magic
senses.zh: （以魔法或似用魔法）控制，保护

examples.en: He has led a charmed life (= he has been lucky even in dangerous or difficult situations).
examples.zh: 他的日子过得如有神佑（即使遇到艰险都能逢凶化吉）。

senses.def: used when you have failed to do something twice and hope that you will succeed the third time
senses.zh: （但愿）第三次交好运；过一过二不过三

senses.def: to be immediately and completely successful

examples.en: Those new pills you gave me worked like a charm.
examples.zh: 你给我的那些新药丸真是药到病除。

examples.en: Her strategy worked like a charm.
examples.zh: 她的策略完全奏效了。

senses.def: a situation in which a person, for example a politician, is especially friendly and pleasant in order to get other people to like them and to support their opinions
senses.zh: 魅力攻势（如政客为拉拢民众所采取的）

senses.def: to obtain something such as information, money, etc. from somebody by using charm

examples.en: She managed to charm his address out of the porter.
examples.zh: 她设法从门房那里骗出了他的地址。

examples.en: Perhaps I can use his good mood to charm a concession out of him.
examples.zh: 也许我可以利用他的好心情来说服他让步。

senses.def: a school where young people are taught to behave in a polite way
a group of people who have special influence
senses.zh: 有特别影响力的一群人

examples.en: the charmed circle of the senator’s advisers
examples.zh: 参议员顾问的迷人圈子

examples.en: She failed to break into the charmed circle of political insiders.
examples.zh: 她没能打入迷人的政治圈子。

senses.def: a person who acts in a way that makes them attractive to other people, sometimes using this to influence others
senses.zh: 使人着迷的人；有吸引力的人；施展魅力的人

senses.def: the name of a range of US paper products. For many years television advertisements for soft Charmin toilet paper showed Mr Whipple, a supermarket employee, telling customers ‘
senses.zh: 美国一系列纸制品的名称。多年来，电视上用柔软的Charmin卫生纸做广告的广告显示，超市的一名雇员Whipple告诉顾客“请不要挤压Charmin！” Charmin也曾在英国出售，但在2010年被命名为Cushelle。

senses.def: in a way that is very pleasant or attractive
senses.zh: 令人着迷的；迷人的；吸引人的

examples.en: He smiled charmingly at her.
examples.zh: 他对她迷人地微笑。

examples.en: charmingly eccentric/naive/old-fashioned
examples.zh: 迷人古怪/天真/守旧

senses.def: used to show that you have a low opinion of something or of somebody's behaviour
senses.zh: （表示对某人的行为评价不高）真是太好了

examples.en: a work charmingly titled ‘The Book of Death’
examples.zh: 一本迷人的书名《死亡之书》

senses.def: not at all pleasant or interesting
senses.zh: 无魅力的；无吸引力的；无趣的

examples.en: a charmless industrial town
examples.zh: 一座毫无吸引力的工业城镇

senses.def: a place used in the past for keeping dead human bodies or bones
a light wooden or metal frame, usually with many ropes stretched and tied across it, that you can sleep on
senses.zh: 轻便床（木架或金属架，床面通常由绳索编成）

senses.def: a diagram, lists of figures, etc. that shows information

examples.en: Some shares have lost two-thirds of their value since being issued (see chart).
examples.zh: 有些股票自发行以来已贬值三分之二（见图表）。

examples.en: The charts of 138 patients with chronic heart failure were reviewed.
examples.zh: 已经审核了包含 138 例慢性心力衰竭患者数据的图表。

examples.en: The accompanying chart shows data for eight countries.
examples.zh: 附图显示了八个国家的数据。

examples.en: a sales chart (= showing the level of a company’s sales)
examples.zh: 销售图表

examples.en: an astrological chart
examples.zh: 占星图

examples.en: a weather chart
examples.zh: 天气图

examples.en: comparative charts of prices of food items now and in 2019
examples.zh: 现在和2019年食品价格对比图

examples.en: Gas prices have risen over the past decade, as shown in the chart below.
examples.zh: 如下图所示，过去十年天然气价格不断上涨。

senses.def: a detailed map of the sea

examples.en: a naval chart
examples.zh: 海军航图

senses.def: a list, produced each week, of the songs or albums that have sold the most copies or been downloaded or listened to via streaming
senses.zh: （歌曲或唱片每周销售、下载或流播数量）排行榜

examples.en: The album went straight into the charts at number 1.
examples.zh: 这张专辑一进入流行唱片排行榜便占首位。

examples.en: to top the charts (= to be the song or album that has sold more copies than all the others)
examples.zh: 位居排行榜之首

examples.en: a chart hit
examples.zh: 图表命中

senses.def: extremely high in level

examples.en: World demand for the product is off the charts.
examples.zh: 此产品的世界需求量高极了。

examples.en: Enthusiasm for the project soared off the charts.
examples.zh: 人们对这个项目的热情高涨。

examples.en: The wealth to be found in this town is off the charts.
examples.zh: 该镇有待发掘的财富不可限量。

senses.def: to record or follow the progress or development of somebody/something

examples.en: The exhibition charts the history of the palace.
examples.zh: 展览记载了这座王宫的历史。

examples.en: The tests are used to chart the progress of both the schools and their pupils.
examples.zh: 这些测试用于绘制学校及其学生的进步情况。

examples.en: His job was to chart the progress of the spacecraft.
examples.zh: 他的工作是绘制航天器的进度图表。

senses.def: to plan a course of action
senses.zh: 计划行动步骤；制订计划

examples.en: She had carefully charted her route to the top of her profession.
examples.zh: 她周密地制订了达到她职业巅峰的行动计划。

senses.def: to make a map of an area

examples.en: Cook charted the coast of New Zealand in 1768.
examples.zh: 库克于 1768 年绘制了新西兰的海岸图。

senses.def: extremely high in level

examples.en: World demand for the product is off the charts.
examples.zh: 此产品的世界需求量高极了。

examples.en: Enthusiasm for the project soared off the charts.
examples.zh: 人们对这个项目的热情高涨。

examples.en: The wealth to be found in this town is off the charts.
examples.zh: 该镇有待发掘的财富不可限量。

senses.def: a song, singer, band, etc. that has reached the highest position in the music charts
senses.zh: 位居流行音乐排行榜榜首的

senses.def: having reached the highest position in the music charts
senses.zh: 位居流行音乐排行榜榜首的

examples.en: his latest chart-topping hit
examples.zh: 他大受欢迎、占据排行榜首位的新作

senses.def: a written statement describing the rights that a particular group of people should have
senses.zh: （说明某部分民众应有权利的）宪章

examples.en: the European Social Charter of workers’ rights
examples.zh: 欧洲工人权利社会宪章

examples.en: a rail passenger’s charter
examples.zh: 铁路旅客包机

examples.en: a charter of rights for people with disabilities
examples.zh: 残疾人权利宪章

senses.def: a written statement of the principles and aims of an organization
senses.zh: （表明某一组织之宗旨和原则的）宪章，章程

examples.en: the United Nations Charter
examples.zh: 联合国宪章

senses.def: an official document stating that a government or political leader allows a new organization, town or university to be established and gives it particular rights
senses.zh: （政府或政治领袖批准组织、城镇、大学等成立并享有某些权利的）特许状，许可证，凭照

examples.en: The Royal College received its charter as a university in 1967.
examples.zh: 皇家学院于 1967 年获得升格为大学的特许状。

examples.en: Certain towns were allowed to hold weekly markets, by royal charter.
examples.zh: 根据皇家特许，某些城镇可以每周举办一次集市。

senses.def: a law or policy that seems likely to help people do something bad
senses.zh: （法律或政策的）不完善，漏洞，缺陷

examples.en: The new law will be a charter for unscrupulous financial advisers.
examples.zh: 新的法律会使不诚实的金融顾问有机可乘。

examples.en: a blackmailer’s charter
examples.zh: 敲诈者可钻的法律空子

senses.def: the act of hiring a plane, boat, etc.

examples.en: a yacht available for charter
examples.zh: 可供租赁的游艇

senses.def: to hire a plane, boat, etc. for your own use

examples.en: They flew to Athens and then chartered a boat to the island.
examples.zh: 他们飞到雅典，然后包船去岛上。

senses.def: to state officially that a new organization, town or university has been established and has special rights
senses.zh: 特许设立；给予…特权；发给许可证（或凭照）

senses.def: a flight in an aircraft in which all the seats are paid for by a travel company and then sold to their customers
one of the first members of a society, an organization, etc., especially one who helped start it
senses.zh: （社团、组织等的）创办人之一，发起人之一，创建人之一

senses.def: a school that has been established by teachers, parents or community groups, but receives public funds, and places special emphasis on a particular subject or teaching method
senses.zh: （美国的）特许学校（出于某种特殊原因而建立，公共出资的独立学校，只接收符合条件的学生）

examples.en: Both of her children attend a performing arts charter school.
examples.zh: 她的两个孩子都在一所表演艺术特许学校上学。

examples.en: a Chinese immersion charter school
examples.zh: 中文沉浸式特许学校

senses.def: a fully trained and qualified accountant
senses.zh: 特许会计师；注册会计师

senses.def: a British public school
senses.zh: 查特豪斯公学（成立于1611年，是英格兰历史悠久的公立学校之一）

senses.def: a member of a group of people in Britain in the 1830s and 1840s who supported the People's Charter
senses.zh: 宪章主义者19 世纪 30—40 年代宪章运动的参与者。支持《人民宪章》，要求改进政治制度，主张成年男子普选权、秘密投票权，取消议员候选人必须拥有土地的限制等。三百多万人签署了宪章，其中一些人参加了政治暴力活动，但他们大部分变革要求很久以后才得以实现。

senses.def: a green or yellow liqueur
senses.zh: 察吐士酒，荨麻酒（一种烈性甜酒，呈绿色或黄色）

senses.def: a pale yellow or pale green colour
a large house in Kent
senses.zh: 查特韦尔（Chartwell）：英格兰肯特郡的一所大房子，温斯顿·丘吉尔（Winston Churchill）从1922年起就住在那里，直到去世。房子和花园，其中包含他一生中的许多物品，现在作为博物馆向公众开放。

senses.def: a woman whose job is to clean a house, an office building, etc.
not willing to risk doing something; fearing possible problems if you do something
senses.zh: 不愿冒风险的；小心谨慎的；谨小慎微的

senses.def: to run, drive, etc. after somebody/something in order to catch them or it

examples.en: My dog likes chasing rabbits.
examples.zh: 我的狗喜欢追捕兔子。

examples.en: The kids chased each other around the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 孩子们围着厨房的桌子相互追逐嬉戏。

examples.en: We were chased by a bull while crossing the field.
examples.zh: 我们在穿过田野时被一头公牛追赶。

examples.en: He chased after the burglar but couldn't catch him.
examples.zh: 他追赶那个盗贼却没有抓住他。

senses.def: to force somebody/something to run away

examples.en: Chase the cat out—we don't want her in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 把猫赶出去，我们不想让它进厨房。

examples.en: This particular fish chases off any other fish that enters its territory.
examples.zh: 这种特殊的鱼会赶走任何进入其领地的其他鱼。

senses.def: to try to obtain or achieve something, for example money, work or success

examples.en: Too many people are chasing too few jobs nowadays.
examples.zh: 如今有太多的人在角逐寥寥无几的工作职位。

examples.en: The team is chasing its first win in five games.
examples.zh: 这支队伍正全力争取五场比赛的首场胜利。

senses.def: to try to persuade somebody to have a sexual relationship with you

examples.en: Kevin's been chasing after Joan for months.
examples.zh: 凯文几个月来一直在追求琼。

examples.en: Girls are always chasing him.
examples.zh: 姑娘们总是在追求他。

senses.def: to persuade somebody to do something that they should have done already

examples.en: I need to chase him about organizing the meeting.
examples.zh: 我得催他有关筹办会议的事。

senses.def: to rush or hurry somewhere

examples.en: I've been chasing around town all morning looking for a present for Sharon.
examples.zh: 为了送给莎伦一件礼物，我一上午都在满城奔走寻觅。

senses.def: to cut patterns or designs on metal

examples.en: chased silver
examples.zh: 雕花银器

senses.def: to be very busy but in fact achieve very little
an act of running or driving after somebody/something in order to catch them or it

examples.en: The thieves were caught by police after a short chase.
examples.zh: 经过短暂追捕，小偷被警察擒获。

examples.en: a high-speed car chase
examples.zh: 高速汽车追逐

examples.en: We lost him in the narrow streets and had to give up the chase (= stop chasing him).
examples.zh: 我们在狭窄的街道上被他甩掉，不得不放弃对他的追捕。

examples.en: to take up the chase (= start chasing somebody)
examples.zh: 开始追捕行动

examples.en: The chase is on!
examples.zh: 追逐开始了！

senses.def: a process of trying hard to get something

examples.en: Three teams are involved in the chase for the championship.
examples.zh: 有三支队伍角逐冠军的宝座。

examples.en: the title chase

examples.zh: 我们讲了好一会儿老板的闲话。

examples.en: Her chauffeur was waiting in the street outside.
examples.zh: 她的司机正在外面的街道上等着。

examples.en: They were met at the airport by a chauffeur in uniform.
examples.zh: 他们在机场由一名穿制服的司机迎接。

senses.def: to drive somebody in a car, usually as your job

examples.en: He was chauffeured to all his meetings.
examples.zh: 他由司机开车送去参加所有的会议。

examples.en: a chauffeured limousine
examples.zh: 有专职司机驾驶的豪华轿车

examples.en: With young children, you spend a lot of your time chauffeuring them around to all their various activities.
examples.zh: 对于年幼的孩子，您会花费大量时间接送他们参加各种活动。

senses.def: an aggressive and unreasonable belief that your own country is better than all others

examples.zh: 这是英国沙文主义和狭隘主义的典型案例。

examples.en: national/cultural chauvinism
examples.zh: 民族／文化沙文主义

senses.def: the belief held by some men that men are more important, more intelligent or better than women
a man who believes men are more important, more intelligent or better than women
a person who has an aggressive and unreasonable belief that their own country is better than all others
believing that men are more important, intelligent or better than women

examples.zh: 他扮演一位广告主管的沙文主义猪。

senses.def: showing an aggressive and unreasonable belief that your own country is better than all others

examples.zh: 狂热爱国的民族主义

senses.def: in a way that shows you believe men are more important, more intelligent or better than women
senses.zh: 以男性沙文主义的态度

senses.zh: （侮辱性语言）低俗青年，低俗一族（常指受教育程度低、穿着怪异、戴各种首饰、行为讨人厌的年轻人）

senses.def: behaving, dressing or speaking in a way that you think shows a low social class and lack of education
senses.zh: 侮辱人的说法，认为某人来自社会底层，其性格、行为、衣着没有教养。

senses.def: badly made or lacking in taste
senses.zh: 肉汁：制作不好或缺乏味道

examples.en: a chavvy tracksuit
examples.zh: 时髦的运动服

examples.zh: 这个球员嘴里嚼着一块东西。

senses.zh: （供劳工居住的）廉租公寓大楼

costing little money or less money than you expected
senses.zh: 花钱少的；便宜的；廉价的

examples.en: cheap imports/flights
examples.zh: 廉价进口商品／航班

examples.en: Their cheap prices have helped them pick up new customers.
examples.zh: 他们价格低廉，帮助他们吸收到了新客户。

examples.en: They're offering incredibly cheap fares to Eastern Europe.
examples.zh: 他们提供前往东欧的极其便宜的票价。

examples.en: Cycling is a cheap way to get around.
examples.zh: 骑自行车是一种省钱的出行方式。

examples.en: A good education is not cheap.
examples.zh: 好的教育可不便宜。

examples.en: Electricity is relatively cheap in Ireland.
examples.zh: 爱尔兰的电力相对便宜。

examples.en: The device isn't exactly cheap at £500.
examples.zh: 该设备售价 500 英镑，并不便宜。

examples.en: A falling dollar will boost the economy by making exports cheaper.
examples.zh: 美元贬值将使出口更便宜，从而提振经济。

examples.en: a cheaper alternative/option
examples.zh: 更便宜的替代品/选择

examples.en: Renewable energy is getting cheaper all the time.
examples.zh: 可再生能源一直在变得越来越便宜。

examples.en: The cheapest rates are usually available online.
examples.zh: 最便宜的价格通常可以在网上找到。

examples.en: These desperate people are used as a source of cheap labour (= workers who are paid very little, especially unfairly).
examples.zh: 这些绝望的人被用作廉价劳动力的来源（=工资很低，尤其是不公平的工人）。

examples.en: Game shows are cheap to produce.
examples.zh: 游戏节目制作成本低廉。

examples.en: Back then it was quite cheap to buy a house here.
examples.zh: 那时候在这里买房子相当便宜。

senses.def: charging low prices

examples.en: a cheap restaurant/hotel
examples.zh: 收费低廉的餐馆／旅馆

examples.en: a cheap taxi firm
examples.zh: 便宜的出租车公司

examples.en: We found a cheap and cheerful cafe (= one that is simple and charges low prices but is pleasant).
examples.zh: 我们找到了一家价格低廉环境宜人的咖啡馆。

senses.def: low in price and quality

examples.en: cheap perfume/jewellery/shoes
examples.zh: 低价劣质香水／珠宝／鞋

examples.en: cheap plastic toys that break within seconds
examples.zh: 容易损坏的廉价塑料玩具

examples.en: a jar of cheap and nasty instant coffee
examples.zh: 一罐又便宜又难喝的速溶咖啡

senses.def: unpleasant or unkind and rather obvious
senses.zh: 令人讨厌的；明显不友好的；不和善的

examples.en: I was tired of his cheap jokes at my expense.
examples.zh: 我讨厌他拿我开低级庸俗的玩笑。

examples.en: a comedian who is always looking for cheap laughs
examples.zh: 一个总是寻找廉价笑声的喜剧演员

examples.en: to score a cheap political advantage
examples.zh: 获得廉价的政治优势

examples.en: He couldn't resist taking a cheap shot at his political opponent.
examples.zh: 他无法抗拒对他的政治对手进行恶意攻击。

senses.def: having a low status and therefore not deserving respect

examples.en: He's just a cheap crook.
examples.zh: 他简直是个卑鄙的骗子。

examples.en: His treatment of her made her feel cheap (= ashamed, because she had lost her respect for herself).
examples.zh: 他那样对待她使她感到很丢脸。

senses.def: not liking to spend money

examples.en: Don't be so cheap!
examples.zh: 别这么小气！

senses.def: so good or useful that the cost does not seem too much

examples.en: To buy all the recommended equipment is expensive, but as an investment for the future it is cheap at the price.
examples.zh: 购买所有推荐的设备是昂贵的，但作为对未来的投资，它的价格很便宜。

senses.def: used to say that there is a situation in which it is not thought to be important if people somewhere die or are treated badly
senses.zh: 把他人生死视同儿戏；视人性命如草芥；人命不值钱

senses.def: spending less money than you usually need to spend to do something

examples.en: a guide to decorating your house on the cheap
examples.zh: 房屋廉价装潢指南

examples.en: to acquire valuable works of art on the cheap
examples.zh: 以便宜的价格获得有价值的艺术品

examples.en: Liverpool hoped to sign the midfielder on the cheap.
examples.zh: 利物浦希望以便宜的价格签下这名中场球员。

senses.def: for a low price

examples.en: I got this dress cheap in a sale.
examples.zh: 这件衣服是我在大减价时便宜买的。

examples.en: You can buy it cheaper elsewhere.
examples.zh: 这在别处买更便宜些。

examples.en: They're selling fabrics cheap this week.
examples.zh: 他们这周正在廉价卖纺织品。

examples.en: Two people can live cheaper than one.
examples.zh: 两个人生活比一个人便宜。

examples.en: private equity companies that borrow cheap
examples.zh: 借贷成本低廉的私募股权公司

senses.def: to be offered for sale at a lower price than usual

examples.en: The house was going cheap because the owner wanted a quick sale.
examples.zh: 房子变得很便宜，因为房主想快速出售。

examples.en: There was usually some bread going cheap at the end of the day.
examples.zh: 在收市前常常有些面包降价出售。

senses.def: something is expensive

examples.en: Violins like this don't come cheap.
examples.zh: 像这样的小提琴不会便宜。

examples.en: A quality pair of Italian shoes doesn't come cheap.
examples.zh: 一双优质的意大利鞋子不会便宜。

intro.en: These words all describe a product or service that costs little money or less money than you expected.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指产品或服务花钱少或低于预期。

items.def: costing little money or less money than you expected; charging low prices. Cheap can also be used in a disapproving way to suggest that something is of poor quality as well as low in price:
items.zh: cheap 亦可作贬义，指价低质劣

items.def: (of prices, goods or services) as cheap as or cheaper than those offered by other companies; able to offer goods or services at competitive prices.
items.zh: 指价格、产品或服务收费方面具有竞争力

items.def: [only before noun] (used especially in advertising) cheap because it offers only a basic level of service.
items.zh: 指仅提供基本服务因而价格低廉

items.def: cheap enough for most people to afford.
items.zh: 指多数人买得起或负担得来的

items.def: (of prices) not too expensive.
items.zh: 指价格不太高、公道的

items.def: (rather formal) cheap. Inexpensive is often used to mean that something is good value for its price. It is sometimes used instead of cheap, because cheap can suggest that something is of poor quality.
items.zh: inexpensive 常含物有所值之义，有时用以代替 cheap，因为 cheap 可有质量低劣的含义。

senses.def: so good or useful that the cost does not seem too much

examples.en: To buy all the recommended equipment is expensive, but as an investment for the future it is cheap at the price.
examples.zh: 购买所有推荐的设备是昂贵的，但作为对未来的投资，它的价格很便宜。

senses.def: to make people lose respect for somebody or for yourself

examples.en: She never cheapened herself by lowering her standards.
examples.zh: 她从不降低标准来贬低自己。

examples.en: It just cheapens you when you make jokes like that.
examples.zh: 当你开这样的玩笑时，只会贬低你。

senses.def: to make something lower in price

examples.en: to cheapen the cost of raw materials
examples.zh: 降低原材料的成本

senses.def: to make something appear to have less value

examples.en: The movie was accused of cheapening human life.
examples.zh: 有人指责这部电影贬低了人的生命价值。

senses.def: without spending or costing much money

examples.en: I'm sure I could buy this more cheaply somewhere else.
examples.zh: 我相信我能在别的地方以更低的价格买到这个。

examples.en: a cheaply made movie
examples.zh: 一部低成本电影

examples.en: You can live very cheaply there.
examples.zh: 你可以在那里生活得很便宜。

examples.en: The company was sold far too cheaply.
examples.zh: 该公司被卖得太便宜了。

examples.en: The leaflet had been cheaply produced and photocopied.
examples.zh: 传单制作粗糙，影印质量差。

senses.def: the fact of costing little money or less money than you expected
senses.zh: 花钱少的；便宜的；廉价的

examples.en: the relative cheapness of property in this area
examples.zh: 该地区的房产相对便宜

senses.def: the fact of being low in price and quality

examples.en: The show is spoiled by the cheapness of the production.
examples.zh: 该节目因制作的廉价而被破坏。

senses.def: the fact of having little value

examples.en: the apparent cheapness of human life in ancient times
examples.zh: 古代人的生命明显廉价

senses.def: cheap and often of poor quality

examples.en: cheapo printers
examples.zh: 廉价打印机

examples.en: a cheapie horror flick
examples.zh: 低成本恐怖烂片

senses.def: a person who does not like to spend money

examples.en: We really need a new heater, but the landlord’s such a cheapskate we’ll never get it.
examples.zh: 我们确实需要一个新的取暖器，但房东太小气了，我们永远买不到。

senses.def: to trick somebody or make them believe something that is not true

examples.en: She is accused of attempting to cheat the taxman.
examples.zh: 她被指控企图蒙骗税务员。

examples.en: We will crack down on people who try to cheat the system.
examples.zh: 我们将严厉打击那些试图欺骗系统的人。

examples.en: Many people feel cheated by the election process.
examples.zh: 许多人感觉被选举程序欺骗了。

examples.en: He cheated investors out of billions of dollars.
examples.zh: 他骗取了投资者数十亿美元。

senses.def: to act in a dishonest way in order to gain an advantage, especially in a game, a competition, an exam, etc.
senses.zh: （尤指在游戏、比赛、考试等中）作弊，舞弊

examples.en: He cheats at cards.
examples.zh: 他玩牌爱作弊。

examples.en: Have you ever cheated in an exam?
examples.zh: 你考试作弊过吗？

examples.en: Have you ever cheated on an exam?
examples.zh: 你考试作弊过吗？

examples.en: You're not allowed to look at the answers—that's cheating.
examples.zh: 你们不许看答案，那是作弊。

examples.en: Anyone caught cheating will be automatically disqualified from the examination.
examples.zh: 作弊被抓的人一律自动取消考试资格。

examples.en: Why would anyone want to lie or cheat?
examples.zh: 为什么有人想要撒谎或欺骗？

senses.def: to have a secret sexual relationship with somebody else
senses.zh: 与他人有秘密性关系；对伴侣不忠

examples.en: He’s cheating on his wife.
examples.zh: 他欺骗了他的妻子。

senses.def: to survive in a situation where you could have died
a person who cheats, especially in a game

examples.en: You little cheat!
examples.zh: 你这小滑头！

examples.en: Are you accusing me of being a cheat?
examples.zh: 你是在指责我是骗子吗？

examples.en: a plan to crack down on tax cheats
examples.zh: 打击偷税漏税的计划

examples.en: benefit/welfare cheats
examples.zh: 福利/福利作弊

examples.en: attempts to eliminate drug cheats from the sport
examples.zh: 试图消除这项运动中的药物作弊行为

examples.en: I've been a liar and a cheat.
examples.zh: 我一直是个骗子。

senses.def: something that seems unfair or dishonest, for example a way of doing something with less effort than it usually needs

examples.en: It's really a cheat, but you can use ready-made pastry if you want.
examples.zh: 虽然这么做是作弊，但如果你愿意的话，可以用现成的油酥面团。

senses.def: a program you can use to move immediately to the next stage of a computer game without needing to play the game
senses.zh: （电脑游戏的）秘技，欺骗程序，作弊软件

examples.en: There's a cheat you can use to get to the next level.
examples.zh: 有种秘技，你可以用来到达下一关。

senses.def: to survive in a situation where you could have died

synonyms.words: fool ▪ deceive ▪ betray ▪ take in ▪ trick ▪ con

intro.en: These words all mean to make somebody believe something that is not true, especially in order to get what you want.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含使人误信之义，尤指有目的地这样做。

items.def: to make somebody believe something that is not true, in order to get money or something else from them:
items.zh: 指为得到钱财或其他东西而欺骗、欺诈

examples.en: She is accused of attempting to cheat the taxman.
examples.zh: 她被指控企图蒙骗税务员。

items.def: to make somebody believe something that is not true, especially in order to laugh at them or to get what you want:
items.zh: 指蒙骗、愚弄

examples.en: Just don’t be fooled into investing any money with them.
examples.zh: 别上当受骗，同他们一起搞什么投资。

items.def: to make somebody believe something that is not true, especially somebody who trusts you, in order to get what you want:
items.zh: 尤指利用别人的信任欺骗、蒙骗、诓骗

examples.en: She deceived him into handing over all his savings.
examples.zh: 她把他所有的积蓄都骗走了。

items.def: to hurt somebody who trusts you, especially by lying to or about them or telling their secrets to other people:
items.zh: 指辜负别人的信任、出卖

examples.en: She felt betrayed when she found out the truth about him.
examples.zh: 她发现他的真实情况时，感到受了欺骗。

items.def: [often passive] to make somebody believe something that is not true, usually in order to get what you want:
items.zh: 指为个人目的而欺骗、蒙骗

examples.en: I was taken in by her story.
examples.zh: 我被她的花言巧语蒙骗了。

items.def: to make somebody believe something that is not true, especially in a clever way, in order to get what you want.
items.zh: 尤指以巧妙的方式欺骗、欺诈

items.def: (informal) to make somebody believe something that is not true, especially in order to get money from them or get them to do something for you:
items.zh: 尤指为获取钱财或使人为自己做事而欺骗、哄骗、诈骗

examples.en: They had been conned out of £100 000.
examples.zh: 他们被骗走了 10 万英镑。

senses.def: to survive in a situation where you could have died
to prevent somebody from having something, especially in a way that is not honest or fair
senses.zh: （尤指用不诚实或不正当的手段）阻止某人得到某物

examples.en: They cheated him out of his share of the profits.
examples.zh: 他们施展伎俩，不让他获得他的那份利润。

examples.en: She cheated Ryan out of his fortune.
examples.zh: 她骗走了瑞安的财产。

senses.def: to prevent somebody from having something, especially in a way that is not honest or fair
senses.zh: （尤指用不诚实或不正当的手段）阻止某人得到某物

examples.en: They cheated him out of his share of the profits.
examples.zh: 他们施展伎俩，不让他获得他的那份利润。

examples.en: She cheated Ryan out of his fortune.
examples.zh: 她骗走了瑞安的财产。

senses.def: a set of notes to help you remember important information, especially one taken secretly into an exam room
senses.zh: 备忘纸条；（尤指考试作弊用的）纸条，夹带

senses.def: a person who acts dishonestly in order to gain an advantage; a person who cheats

examples.en: Many conservatives see the president as a cheater and a rogue.
examples.zh: 许多保守派认为总统是骗子和流氓。

examples.en: I don't want to break up the family, but I can't live with someone who's a liar and a cheater.
examples.zh: 我不想拆散家庭，但我不能和一个骗子、骗子的人一起生活。

senses.def: to examine something to see if it is correct, safe or acceptable

examples.en: She gave me the minutes of the meeting to read and check.
examples.zh: 她把会议记录交给我审阅。

examples.en: Check the oil and water before setting off.
examples.zh: 出发前应查看一下油和水。

examples.en: Check your work before handing it in.
examples.zh: 交作业前先检查一遍。

examples.en: Customs officers have the right to check all luggage going through customs.
examples.zh: 海关官员有权检查所有通过海关的行李。

examples.en: The cars were checked to see whether the faults had been spotted.
examples.zh: 对汽车进行了检查以确定之前是否已经发现这些故障。

examples.en: Check the container for cracks or leaks.
examples.zh: 检验容器是否有裂缝或者漏洞。

examples.en: Be sure to check labels for specific information.
examples.zh: 请务必检查标签以获取特定信息。

examples.en: I'll need to check these figures against last year's.
examples.zh: 我需要把这些数字和去年的数字比对一下。

senses.def: to look at something or ask somebody to find out if something/somebody is present, correct or true or if something is how you think it is

examples.en: We'll check back in a couple of hours.
examples.zh: 我们过几个小时会复查。

examples.en: We were interrupted by a waiter checking to see if everything was OK.
examples.zh: 我们被一位服务员打断了，他正在检查一切是否正常。

examples.en: ‘Is Mary in the office?’ ‘Just a moment. I'll go and check.’
examples.zh: “玛丽在办公室吗？”“请稍等，我去看看。”

examples.en: Hang on—I just need to check my email.
examples.zh: 稍等，我得查看一下我的电邮。

examples.en: She's constantly checking her phone—it drives me mad.
examples.zh: 她不断地查看手机——这让我抓狂。

examples.en: Check our website for details.
examples.zh: 请查看我们的网站了解详情。

examples.en: Go and check (that) I’ve locked the windows.
examples.zh: 去查看一下我是不是把窗户锁上了。

examples.en: Check with your doctor before beginning any exercise programme.
examples.zh: 在开始任何锻炼计划之前先咨询您的医生。

examples.en: She glanced around to check whether anyone was watching.
examples.zh: 她环顾四周，看看是否有人在看。

examples.en: You'd better check with Jane what time she's expecting us tonight.
examples.zh: 你最好向简核实一下她今晚见我们的时间。

examples.en: The data is then checked against a database of criminals.
examples.zh: 然后将数据与犯罪分子数据库进行核对。

senses.def: to put a mark (✓) next to an item on a list, an answer, etc.

examples.en: Check the box next to the right answer.
examples.zh: 在正确答案旁边的方框中打钩。

examples.en: To take advantage of this extra bonus offer, simply check the box on your order form.
examples.zh: 想要获得这个特惠，只需在订货单上的方框内打钩即可。

senses.def: to control something; to stop something from increasing or getting worse

examples.en: The government is determined to check the growth of public spending.
examples.zh: 政府决心要控制公共开支的增长。

examples.en: She tied some strips of cloth around the wound to check the bleeding.
examples.zh: 她在伤口上缠了些布条来止血。

examples.en: The active ingredient checks the growth of bacteria.
examples.zh: 活性成分可抑制细菌的生长。

senses.def: to stop yourself from saying or doing something or from showing a particular emotion
senses.zh: 克制，抑制（做某事或表露感情）

examples.en: to check your anger/laughter/tears
examples.zh: 忍住怒火／笑／眼泪

examples.en: He made no effort to check his tears and just let them run down his face.
examples.zh: 他没有刻意去阻止泪水，只是让它们顺着脸颊流下来。

examples.en: She wanted to tell him the whole truth but she checked herself—it wasn't the right moment.
examples.zh: 她本想告诉他全部真相，但是又忍住了 － 还不是时候。

senses.def: to leave coats, bags, etc. in an official place (called a checkroom

examples.en: Do you want to check your coats?
examples.zh: 你们要寄放外套吗？

senses.def: to leave bags or cases with an official so that they can be put on a plane or train

examples.en: How many bags are you checking?
examples.zh: 您要托运多少件行李？

senses.def: an act of making sure that something is safe, correct or in good condition by examining it

examples.en: Could you give the tyres a check?
examples.zh: 你能检查一下轮胎吗？

examples.en: I went for a health check before going on the trip.
examples.zh: 我在出发前进行了健康检查。

examples.en: The drugs were found in their car during a routine check by police.
examples.zh: 警方作例行检查时在他们的车里搜出了毒品。

examples.en: I'll just have a quick check to see if the letter's arrived yet.
examples.zh: 我要快速查看一下，看看那封信是否已经寄到。

examples.en: She had a thorough check of the room, but nothing had been taken.
examples.zh: 她彻底检查了一遍房间，但没有任何东西被拿走。

examples.en: a check for spelling mistakes
examples.zh: 拼写错误检查

examples.en: It is vital to keep a check on your speed (= look at it regularly in order to control it).
examples.zh: 经常检查并控制你的车速是至关重要的。

examples.en: I did a final check on the seating arrangements.
examples.zh: 我对座位安排做了最后检查。

examples.en: A check with the doctor confirmed his fears.
examples.zh: 医生的检查证实了他的担心。

examples.en: A spokesperson said the company made regular checks with the police and the council.
examples.zh: 一名发言人说，公司配合警方和市政厅进行了定期检查。

senses.def: an investigation to find out more information about somebody/something

examples.en: The agency insisted all the necessary background checks had been carried out.
examples.zh: 该机构坚称已完成所有必要的背景调查。

examples.en: Security checks were causing long delays at border crossings.
examples.zh: 安全检查导致过境点长时间延误。

examples.en: The police ran a check on the registration number of the car.
examples.zh: 警方对那辆车的牌照号码进行了调查。

examples.en: Was any check made on Mr Morris when he applied for the post?
examples.zh: 莫里斯先生申请这个职位时对他进行调查了吗？

examples.en: We're running a police check on all applicants for the job.
examples.zh: 我们正在对所有求职者进行警方记录核查。

senses.def: a mark (✓) put next to a sum or an item on a list, usually to show that it has been checked or done or is correct

examples.en: The teacher put a check next to his name.
examples.zh: 老师在他的名字旁边打了钩。

examples.en: If there are no checks in the boxes, you have successfully unsubscribed.
examples.zh: 如果框中没有复选标记，则您已成功取消订阅。

examples.en: Place a check beside each characteristic that you feel that you possess.
examples.zh: 在您认为自己拥有的每个特征旁边打勾。

senses.def: a piece of paper that shows how much you have to pay for the food and drinks that you have had in a restaurant

examples.en: Can I have the check, please?
examples.zh: 请给我结账。

examples.en: Tess asked for the check and handed the waiter a credit card.
examples.zh: 苔丝要了支票，并递给服务员一张信用卡。

examples.en: I paid the check for the dinner.
examples.zh: 我付了晚餐的支票。

senses.def: a printed form that you can write on and sign as a way of paying for something instead of using money
something that delays the progress of something else or stops it from getting worse
senses.zh: 阻碍进程的事物；阻止恶化的事物

examples.zh: 寒冷的春季会自然控制昆虫的数量。

examples.en: the most fundamental check to the power of the British monarchy
examples.zh: 对英国君主权力最根本的制约

senses.def: rules that are designed to control the amount of power, especially political power, that one person or group has
senses.zh: （对政治等权力的）规定，条令，约束

senses.def: a pattern of squares, usually of two colours
senses.zh: （通常指双色的）方格图案，方格，格子

examples.en: Do you prefer checks or stripes?
examples.zh: 你喜欢方格还是条纹？

examples.en: a check shirt/suit
examples.zh: 格子衬衫／西服

examples.en: a yellow and red check skirt
examples.zh: 红黄色相间的方格裙子

senses.def: a place in a club, restaurant, etc. where you can leave your coat or bag
senses.zh: （俱乐部、餐馆等外套、包的）寄存处，存放处

senses.def: a ticket that you get when you leave your coat, bag, etc. in, for example, a restaurant or theatre
senses.zh: （餐馆或剧院等的）存物牌，存放证

senses.def: a position in which a player’s king (= the most important piece)

examples.en: There, you're in check.
examples.zh: 瞧，将你一军。

senses.def: to keep something under control so that it does not spread or get worse

examples.en: Maggie managed to keep her temper in check.
examples.zh: 玛吉设法控制住自己的脾气。

examples.zh: 这种传染病靠广泛的预防注射已受到控制。

examples.en: You need to keep your temper in check!

examples.zh: “你要和我们一起出去吗？”“我可以临时检查一下吗？——我今晚必须把这件事完成。”

senses.def: used to show that you agree with somebody or that something on a list has been dealt with

senses.def: to keep something under control so that it does not spread or get worse

intro.en: These words all mean to look closely to make sure that everything is correct, in good condition, or acceptable.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含仔细检查、审查之义。

items.def: to look at something closely to make sure that everything is correct, in good condition, safe or acceptable:
items.zh: 指检查、审查、核查，以确保完好、正常和安全

examples.en: Check your work before handing it in.
examples.zh: 交作业前先检查一遍。

items.def: to look at somebody/​something closely to see if there is anything wrong or to find the cause of a problem:
items.zh: 指仔细检查或检验人或事物，以确认有无问题或找出问题所在

examples.en: The goods were examined for damage on arrival.
examples.zh: 货物到达时已检查是否有破损。

items.def: to look at somebody/​something closely to make sure that everything is acceptable; to officially visit a school, factory, etc. in order to check that rules are being obeyed and that standards are acceptable:
items.zh: 指检查、查看、审视，以确保一切妥当；视察（学校、工厂等）

examples.en: Make sure you inspect the goods before signing for them.
examples.zh: 要确保在签收货物之前进行检验。

items.def: to check something carefully for mistakes, damage or anything dangerous:
items.zh: 指仔细检查是否有错误、损坏或危险

examples.en: Go over your work for spelling mistakes before you hand it in.
examples.zh: 交作业前仔细检查一下拼写错误。

intro.en: These are all words for a record of how much you owe for goods or services you have bought or used.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指账单、账目。

items.def: a list of goods that you have bought or services that you have used, showing how much you owe; the price or cost of something:
items.zh: 指账单

examples.en: the gas bill
examples.zh: 煤气费账单

items.def: an arrangement with a shop or business to pay bills for goods or services at a later time, for example in regular amounts every month:
items.zh: 指赊销账、赊欠账、赊购

examples.en: Put it on my account please.
examples.zh: 请记在我的赊购账上。

items.def: (rather formal) a bill for goods that somebody has bought or work that has been done for somebody:
items.zh: 指发票、发货或服务费用清单

examples.en: The builders sent an invoice for £250.
examples.zh: 营造商发出了一张 250 英镑的发票。

items.def: (North American English美式英语) a piece of paper that shows how much you have to pay for the food and drinks that you have had in a restaurant:
items.zh: 指餐馆的账单

examples.en: Can I have the check, please?
examples.zh: 请给我结账。

senses.def: a plastic card that can be used to take money directly from your bank account when you pay for something
to go to a desk in a hotel, an airport, etc. and tell an official there that you have arrived

examples.en: Please check in at least an hour before departure.
examples.zh: 请至少在飞机起飞前一小时办理登机手续。

examples.en: We've checked in at the hotel.
examples.zh: 我们已经在旅馆登记入住。

senses.def: to leave bags or cases with an official to be put on a plane or train

examples.en: We checked in our luggage and went through to the departure lounge.
examples.zh: 我们托运行李后直接进入候机室。

senses.def: the place where you go to at an airport to leave your bags, cases, etc. and show your ticket

examples.en: The airline apologizes for long delays at check-ins today.
examples.zh: 航空公司为今天办理登机手续耽误了很多时间而道歉。

examples.en: Aim to arrive at check-in at least two hours before departure.
examples.zh: 争取在出发前至少两小时到达办理登机手续。

senses.def: the act of confirming your intention to take a particular flight and your personal details either at an airport or using a computer
senses.zh: （在机场或电脑上）办理登机手续，值机

examples.en: Do you know your check-in time?
examples.zh: 你知道办理登机手续的时间吗？

examples.en: the check-in desk
examples.zh: （机场）登机手续办理处

examples.en: the check-in counter
examples.zh: （机场）登机手续办理处

senses.def: the time when you arrive at a hotel at the start of your stay
senses.zh: 登记入住宾馆；办理入住手续

examples.en: We can arrange an early check-in.
examples.zh: 我们可以安排提前办理入住手续。

senses.def: to arrive at a hotel or private hospital to begin your stay there
senses.zh: 登记入住（旅馆或私立医院）

examples.en: He checked into a top London clinic yesterday for an operation on his knee.
examples.zh: 他昨天住进了伦敦一家顶级诊所，准备做膝部手术。

senses.def: to put a mark (✓) next to a name or an item on a list to show that something has been dealt with

examples.en: Check the names off as the guests arrive.
examples.zh: 客人到来时在其姓名旁打钩。

examples.en: As I packed my case I checked everything off on my list.
examples.zh: 当我收拾行李时，我核对了清单上的所有内容。

senses.def: to make sure that there is nothing wrong with somebody/something
senses.zh: 核实，检查（是否一切正常）

examples.en: I'll just go and check on the children.
examples.zh: 我正要去看看孩子们。

senses.def: to be found to be true or acceptable after being examined

examples.en: The local police found her story didn't check out.
examples.zh: 当地警方证实她的说法不成立。

senses.def: to pay your bill and leave a hotel, etc.

examples.en: Guests should check out of their rooms by noon.
examples.zh: 客人务请在中午以前办理退房手续。

examples.en: I'm sorry, they aren't here. They checked out this morning.
examples.zh: 抱歉，他们不在。他们今天早上退房了。

senses.def: to find out if something is correct, or if somebody is acceptable

examples.en: The police are checking out his alibi.
examples.zh: 警察在查证他不在案发现场的证据。

examples.en: We'll have to check him out before we employ him.
examples.zh: 我们得先调查一下才雇用他。

senses.def: to look at or examine a person or thing that seems interesting or attractive
senses.zh: 察看，观察（有趣或有吸引力的人或事物）

examples.en: Check out the prices at our new store!
examples.zh: 看一看我们新商店的价格吧！

examples.en: Hey, check out that car!
examples.zh: 嘿，看看那辆车！

senses.def: to borrow something from an official place, for example a book from a library

examples.en: The book has been checked out in your name.
examples.zh: 这本书已用你的名字从图书馆借出。

senses.def: to examine something carefully to make sure that it is correct or acceptable

examples.en: Check over your work for mistakes.
examples.zh: 仔细检查你的作业以防有错。

examples.en: We checked through the photographs to make sure there were none missing.
examples.zh: 我们仔细检查了那些照片，确保一张不落。

senses.def: to examine something carefully to make sure that it is correct or acceptable

examples.en: Check over your work for mistakes.
examples.zh: 仔细检查你的作业以防有错。

examples.en: We checked through the photographs to make sure there were none missing.
examples.zh: 我们仔细检查了那些照片，确保一张不落。

senses.def: an examination of somebody/something, especially a medical one to make sure that you are healthy

examples.en: to go for/to have a check-up
examples.zh: 去做体检

examples.en: a medical/dental/routine/thorough check-up
examples.zh: 体格／牙科／常规／全面检查

senses.def: to make sure that somebody is doing what they should be doing

examples.en: My parents are always checking up on me.
examples.zh: 我父母总是督促我。

senses.def: to find out if something is true or correct

examples.en: I need to check up on a few things before I can decide.
examples.zh: 我得核实几件事情才能作决定。

the practice of journalists paying people large amounts of money to give them personal or private information for a newspaper story
senses.zh: 支票簿新闻（指记者用重金购买的独家新闻）

senses.def: a small square on a computer screen that you click on with the mouse to choose whether a particular function is switched on or off
a small square on a printed form in which you put a tick

senses.def: a person who works at the checkout
a computer program that you use to check something, for example the spelling and grammar of something you have written

examples.en: a spelling/grammar/virus checker

senses.def: a person who checks things

examples.en: a quality control checker
examples.zh: 质量控制检验员

senses.def: a board with black and white squares, used for playing checkers
senses.zh: 国际跳棋棋盘；西洋跳棋棋盘

senses.def: a pattern that looks like a checkerboard

examples.en: Funky designs included checkerboards and flower patterns.
examples.zh: 时髦的设计包括棋盘和花朵图案。

senses.def: a person’s past, etc. that contains both successful and not successful periods
senses.zh: 成功与失败并存的（过去、历史、事业）

senses.def: having a pattern of squares of different colours
senses.zh: 有不同颜色方格图案的

senses.def: a game for two players using 24 round pieces on a board marked with black and white squares
the name of a dog that belonged to Richard Nixon
senses.zh: “跳棋”理查德·尼克松的宠物犬。1952 年尼克松竞选副总统时被指非法接受捐款，为此他发表电视讲话，称唯一收下的礼物就是这条狗。这一煽情的演讲大获成功，尼克松人气高涨，当选艾森豪威尔总统的副手。

senses.def: a type of bank account that you can take money out of at any time, and that provides you with a debit card
senses.zh: 活期存款账户；往来账户

senses.def: a list of the things that you must remember to do, to take with you or to find out

examples.zh: 以下是选择教材时需要注意的要点清单。

examples.en: a checklist for proofreaders
examples.zh: 校对员清单

senses.def: to put your opponent in a position in which they cannot prevent their king (= the most important piece)

examples.en: His king had been checkmated.
examples.zh: 他的王棋已被将死。

senses.def: to defeat somebody completely

examples.en: She hoped the plan would checkmate her opponents.
examples.zh: 她希望这个计划能彻底打败对手。
