the place where you pay for the things that you are buying in a supermarket

examples.en: a checkout assistant/operator
examples.zh: 收银员

examples.en: long queues at the checkouts
examples.zh: 收银台前排起长队

examples.en: You can’t just go through the checkout without paying!
examples.zh: 你不能不付钱就过付款处！

senses.def: the time when you leave a hotel at the end of your stay
senses.zh: 结账离开宾馆；办理退房手续

examples.en: At checkout, your bill will be printed for you.
examples.zh: 退房时，旅馆会把你的账单打印给你。

examples.en: The hotel’s extra benefits include late checkout.
examples.zh: 酒店的额外优惠包括延迟退房。

senses.def: part of the process of online shopping in which the customer enters delivery information and pays for the item
senses.zh: （网购）结算（输入送货信息并付款）

examples.en: You may choose to pay for your order online using our secure checkout.
examples.zh: 您可以选择使用我们的安全结账在线支付订单。

examples.en: Proceed to checkout.
examples.zh: 去结算。

senses.def: a place, especially on a border between two countries, where people have to stop so their vehicles and documents can be checked

examples.en: There are border guards at the checkpoint crossing.
examples.zh: 检查站有边防警卫。

examples.en: The soldier stopped the motorist at a roadside checkpoint.
examples.zh: 士兵在路边检查站拦住了司机。

senses.def: an official place at which people crossed the border between East Berlin and West Berlin during the time when the city was divided. It was opened in 1961. Checkpoint Charlie was moved in 1990 to a museum, and this was seen as a symbol of the end of the Cold War
senses.zh: 查理检查站：在这座城市分裂期间，人们穿越东柏林和西柏林之间边界的官方场所。它于1961年开放。查理检查站（Checkpoint Charlie）于1990年移至博物馆，这被视为冷战结束的象征。

senses.def: a room in a public building where people can leave coats, bags, etc. for a time
influences in an organization or political system that help to keep it fair and stop a small group from keeping all the power
senses.zh: 制约与平衡（为保持机构或政体内的公正并防止权力集中于小团体）

examples.en: Democracy depends on a system of checks and balances.
examples.zh: 民主的实行依赖于相互制衡的制度。

senses.def: (in the US) the principle of government by which the president, Congress and the Supreme Court each have some control over the others
senses.zh: 三权分立（美国政府中总统、国会以及最高法院之间相互制约的政体原则）

senses.def: the total of the numbers in a piece of digital data, used to check that the data is correct
senses.zh: 检查和（用以校验数据项的和）

senses.def: a type of hard yellow cheese
senses.zh: 切达干酪（一种黄色硬质干酪）

senses.def: a long deep valley in Somerset
senses.zh: 切达峡谷：英格兰萨默塞特郡的深谷。它以其迷人的风景和山谷周围悬崖上的许多洞穴而闻名，那里是人们在史前时代居住的地方。

senses.def: used to show that you think something is horrible or unpleasant
senses.zh: 用来表明你认为某件事是可怕的或令人不愉快的

senses.def: either side of the face below the eyes

examples.zh: 丰满的／红润的／粉红的脸颊

examples.en: He kissed her on both cheeks.
examples.zh: 他亲吻了她的双颊。

examples.zh: 成双成对的舞伴在跳贴面舞。

senses.def: having the type of cheeks

examples.zh: 双颊丰满／红润／瘦削

talk or behaviour that people think is annoying, rude or not showing enough respect
senses.zh: 令人讨厌（或粗鲁、无礼）的话（或行为）

examples.en: What a cheek!
examples.zh: 真不要脸！

examples.en: He had the cheek to ask his ex-girlfriend to babysit for them.
examples.zh: 他竟厚着脸皮要他以前的女朋友为他们临时照看小孩。

examples.en: I think they've got a cheek making you pay to park the car.
examples.zh: 我想不到他们居然有脸要你付停车费。

to make a deliberate decision to remain calm and not to act in an aggressive way when somebody has hurt you or made you angry
senses.zh: （受到伤害或被激怒时）甘心容忍，不予回击

very close to somebody/something

examples.en: The guests, packed cheek by jowl, parted as he entered.
examples.zh: 他进来时，客人们挤得紧紧的，纷纷散开。

senses.def: the bone below the eye

examples.en: A flush of anger appeared on her cheekbones.
examples.zh: 一股怒气上冲，她顿时双颊飞红。

examples.en: The hollows beneath his cheekbones showed his stress.
examples.zh: 他双颊深陷，看得出他压力很大。

examples.en: The skin stretched taut over his cheekbones.
examples.zh: 他的双颧皮包骨头。

senses.def: in a way that is rude and funny or annoying
senses.zh: 脸皮厚地；放肆地；粗鲁无礼地

examples.en: to grin/smile/wink cheekily
examples.zh: 厚颜无耻地咧嘴笑/微笑/眨眼

examples.en: He cheekily asked for her phone number.
examples.zh: 他厚颜无耻地询问她的电话号码。

senses.def: behaviour that is rude in a funny or an annoying way
senses.zh: 厚脸皮、不要脸的行为;鲁莽、放肆的行为

senses.def: rude in a funny or annoying way
senses.zh: 厚脸皮的；鲁莽的；放肆的

examples.en: You cheeky monkey!
examples.zh: 你这厚脸皮的猴崽子！

examples.en: a cheeky grin
examples.zh: 厚颜无耻的龇牙一笑

examples.en: You're getting far too cheeky!
examples.zh: 你太放肆了！

synonyms.words: cheeky ▪ insolent ▪ disrespectful ▪ impolite ▪ impertinent ▪ discourteous

intro.en: These are all words for people showing a lack of respect for other people.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指人粗鲁、无礼。

items.def: having or showing a lack of respect for other people and their feelings:
items.zh: 指粗鲁的、无礼的、粗野的

examples.en: Why are you so rude to your mother?
examples.zh: 你为什么对你的母亲这么没礼貌？

items.def: (British English英式英语, informal) (especially of children) rude in a funny or an annoying way:
items.zh: 厚脸皮的、鲁莽的、放肆的

examples.en: You cheeky monkey!
examples.zh: 你这厚脸皮的猴崽子！

items.def: (rather formal) very rude, especially to somebody who is older or more important Insolent is used especially to talk about the behaviour of children towards adults.
items.zh: insolent 尤用于形容孩子对成年人的行为。

items.def: (rather formal) showing a lack of respect for somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指不尊敬、无礼、轻蔑

examples.en: Some people said he had been disrespectful to the president in his last speech.
examples.zh: 有些人说他在最近一次讲话中对总统不尊重。

items.def: (rather formal) not behaving in a pleasant way that follows the rules of society:
items.zh: 指不礼貌、粗鲁

examples.en: Some people think it is impolite to ask someone’s age.
examples.zh: 有些人认为询问别人的年龄是不礼貌的。

items.def: (rather formal) not showing respect for somebody who is older or more important Impertinent is often used by people such as parents and teachers when they are telling children that they are angry with them for being rude:
items.zh: impertinent 常用于父母、老师等对孩子的粗鲁行为表示气愤

items.def: (formal) having bad manners and not showing respect:
items.zh: 指不礼貌、失礼、粗鲁

examples.en: He didn’t wish to appear discourteous.
examples.zh: 他不想显得没礼貌。

senses.def: the short high sound that young birds make

examples.en: the shrill cheep of the baby starlings
examples.zh: 椋鸟宝宝的尖锐叫声

senses.def: to make short high sounds

examples.en: We heard the birds cheeping as their mother fed them.
examples.zh: 我们听到鸟儿妈妈喂它们时发出叽叽喳喳的声音。

senses.def: to shout loudly, in order to show support or praise for somebody, or to encourage them

examples.en: We all cheered as the team came onto the field.
examples.zh: 球队入场时我们都为之欢呼。

examples.en: Cheering crowds greeted their arrival.
examples.zh: 欢呼的人群欢迎他们的到来。

examples.en: The fans cheered for their team.
examples.zh: 球迷为他们的球队加油。

examples.en: The crowd cheered the president as he drove slowly by.
examples.zh: 当总统的车缓缓经过时，群众向他欢呼致意。

senses.def: to encourage somebody or to give them hope or comfort

examples.en: She was cheered by the news from home.
examples.zh: 来自家里的消息使她受到鼓舞。

senses.def: a shout of joy, support or praise

examples.en: A great cheer went up from the crowd.
examples.zh: 观众爆发出一阵热烈的欢呼声。

examples.en: cheers of encouragement
examples.zh: 鼓励的喝彩声

examples.en: Three cheers for the winners! (= used when you are asking a group of people to cheer three times, in order to congratulate somebody, etc.)
examples.zh: 为优胜者欢呼三次吧！

senses.def: a special song or poem used by cheerleaders
an atmosphere of happiness

synonyms.words: yell ▪ cry ▪ scream ▪ cheer ▪ bellow ▪ raise your voice

intro.en: These words all mean to say something in a very loud voice.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指大声说出、叫嚷。

items.def: to say something in a loud voice; to speak loudly and often angrily to somebody:
items.zh: 指大声说、叫、嚷、斥责、怒骂

examples.en: Stop shouting and listen!
examples.zh: 别嚷了，听着！

items.def: to shout loudly, for example because you are angry, excited, frightened or in pain:
items.zh: 指（因气愤、激动、害怕或痛苦而）叫喊、大喊、吼叫

examples.en: She yelled at the boy to get down from the wall.
examples.zh: 她冲小孩大喊，让他从墙上下来。

items.def: (rather formal or literary) to shout loudly:
items.zh: 指喊叫、呼喊、呼叫

examples.en: She ran over to the window and cried for help.
examples.zh: 她跑到窗口呼喊救命。

items.def: to shout something in a loud high voice because you are afraid, angry or excited:
items.zh: 指（因害怕、气愤或激动而）尖叫、大叫

examples.en: He screamed at me to stop.
examples.zh: 他冲着我大叫，要我停下来。

items.def: (especially of a crowd of people) to shout loudly to show support or praise for somebody, or to encourage them:
items.zh: （尤指一群人）欢呼、喝彩、加油

examples.en: We all cheered as the team came onto the field.
examples.zh: 球队入场时我们都为之欢呼。

items.def: to shout in a loud deep voice, especially because you are angry:
items.zh: 指大声吼叫，尤指怒吼

examples.en: ‘Quiet!’ the teacher bellowed.
examples.zh: “安静！”老师大吼道。

items.def: to speak loudly to somebody, especially because you are angry:
items.zh: （尤指因气愤而）提高嗓门、大声说话

examples.en: She never once raised her voice to us.
examples.zh: 她从未对我们提高嗓门说话。

senses.def: to give shouts in order to encourage somebody in a race, competition, etc.
senses.zh: （赛跑、比赛等中）以喝彩声鼓励，为（某人）加油

examples.en: The spectators cheered the runners on.
examples.zh: 观众为赛跑选手加油。

senses.def: to become more cheerful; to make somebody/something more cheerful

examples.en: Oh, come on—cheer up!
examples.zh: 噢，得了，高兴起来吧！

examples.en: Give Mary a call; she needs cheering up.
examples.zh: 给玛丽打个电话，她需要人安慰。

examples.en: Bright curtains can cheer up a dull room.
examples.zh: 色彩鲜艳的窗帘可以让单调的房间变得亮丽起来。

senses.def: happy, and showing it by the way that you behave
senses.zh: 快乐的；高兴的；兴高采烈的

examples.en: You're not your usual cheerful self today.
examples.zh: 你今天不像往常那么快快乐乐的。

examples.en: a cheerful smile/voice/face/disposition
examples.zh: 欢快的微笑／说话声／表情／性情

examples.en: to look/seem/sound cheerful
examples.zh: 看起来／听上去很欢快

examples.en: He felt bright and cheerful and full of energy.
examples.zh: 他感到非常高兴，充满活力。

examples.en: You’re in a cheerful mood.
examples.zh: 你心情愉快。

examples.en: He's always been a cheerful, hard-working employee.
examples.zh: 他一直是一个开朗、勤奋的员工。

senses.def: giving you a feeling of happiness

examples.en: a bright, cheerful restaurant
examples.zh: 明亮宜人的餐馆

examples.en: walls painted in cheerful (= light and bright) colours
examples.zh: 用亮丽色彩涂饰的墙壁

examples.en: He was whistling a cheerful tune.
examples.zh: 他吹着欢快的口哨。

examples.en: She wrote him a chatty, cheerful letter.
examples.zh: 她给他写了一封亲切活泼的信。

examples.en: The animated chatter gave the room a cheerful atmosphere.
examples.zh: 热闹的交谈声让房间里充满了欢乐的气氛。

examples.en: We went for a meal at a cheap and cheerful restaurant.
examples.zh: 我们去了一家便宜又令人愉快的餐厅吃饭。

senses.def: in a way that shows you are happy

examples.en: to laugh/nod/whistle cheerfully
examples.zh: 快乐地笑／点头／吹口哨

senses.def: used to say that you would like to do something

examples.en: I could cheerfully have killed him when he said that.
examples.zh: 他说那话时我真想把他宰了。

senses.def: used to show that somebody is not embarrassed about something
senses.zh: 兴高采烈：曾经表明某人对某事不感到尴尬

examples.en: She cheerfully admitted that she had no experience at all (= she wasn't afraid to do so).
examples.zh: 她大大方方地承认自己一点经验都没有。

senses.def: brightly, in a way that makes you feel happy
senses.zh: 开朗地：明亮地，以一种使您感到快乐的方式

examples.en: The school staff proudly showed me each cheerfully decorated classroom.
examples.zh: 学校工作人员自豪地向我展示了每间布置得令人愉悦的教室。

senses.def: behaviour that shows you are happy, especially in a difficult situation

examples.en: Everyone on the team demonstrated an unfailing cheerfulness that served us well.
examples.zh: 团队中的每个人都表现出始终如一的快乐，这对我们很有帮助。

senses.def: in a happy and cheerful way

examples.en: to wave/chat/grin cheerily
examples.zh: 愉快地挥手/聊天/微笑

senses.def: goodbye

examples.en: Cheerio! I'll see you later.
examples.zh: 再见！回头见。

examples.en: Cheerio now.
examples.zh: 现在欢呼吧。

examples.en: Cheerio then. See you on Wednesday.
examples.zh: 那就谢里奥吧。星期三见。

senses.def: a popular cereal
senses.zh: 恰瑞奥燕麦圈（一种受欢迎的速食燕麦制品，通常加入牛奶作为早餐吃，呈小圆环状）

senses.def: (especially in the US) one of the members of a group of young people (usually women) wearing special uniforms, who encourage the crowd to cheer
senses.zh: 拉拉队队员（尤见于美国，通常为女性）

senses.def: a person who supports a particular politician, idea, or way of doing something
senses.zh: （某一从政者、某种观点或做法等的）支持者，摇旗呐喊者

examples.en: one of the leading cheerleaders for the President’s welfare policies
examples.zh: 总统福利政策的主要啦啦队员之一

senses.def: a sport involving organized cheering
senses.zh: 啦啦队啦啦队：一项由有组织的欢呼和舞蹈来支持运动队的运动，在美国很受欢迎，通常由穿着特殊制服的一群女孩表演

examples.en: a cheerleading squad/team
examples.zh: 啦啦队

examples.en: She plays volleyball, participates in cheeleading, and runs track.
examples.zh: 她打排球、参加啦啦队和田径比赛。

senses.def: strong support for a particular politician, idea or way of doing something
senses.zh: （某一政治家、某种观点或做法等的）支持者，摇旗呐喊者

examples.en: the president’s continued cheerleading for the ‘strong dollar’
examples.zh: 总统为“强势美元”不断摇旗呐喊

senses.def: not being warm or brightly coloured so it makes you feel depressed

examples.en: a dark and cheerless room
examples.zh: 黑暗阴森的房间

examples.en: a damp and cheerless December afternoon
examples.zh: 十二月一个潮湿而阴郁的下午

senses.def: happy and cheerful

examples.en: a cheery remark/smile/wave
examples.zh: 开心的话／微笑／挥手

examples.en: He left with a cheery ‘See you again soon’.
examples.zh: 他高兴地说了声“希望早日再见到你”就离开了。

examples.en: The staff are cheery and welcoming.
examples.zh: 工作人员很愉快而且热情。

senses.def: a type of food made from milk that can be either soft or hard and is usually white or yellow in colour; a particular type of this food

examples.en: Cheddar cheese
examples.zh: 切达干酪

examples.en: goat’s cheese (= made from the milk of a goat)
examples.zh: 山羊奶酪（由山羊奶制成）

examples.en: a cheese sandwich
examples.zh: 奶酪三明治

examples.en: a piece/slice/block of cheese
examples.zh: 一块／一薄片／一大块奶酪

examples.en: I had cheese on toast (= toasted bread covered in melted cheese) for lunch.
examples.zh: 我中午吃的是奶酪吐司。

examples.en: a selection of French cheeses
examples.zh: 精选的法国奶酪

examples.en: a cheese knife (= a knife with a special curved blade with two points on the end, used for cutting and picking up pieces of cheese)
examples.zh: 干酪刀

examples.en: a snack of bread and cheese
examples.zh: 面包和奶酪的小吃

examples.en: a wedge/hunk/chunk of cheese
examples.zh: 一块奶酪

examples.en: a cheese sauce/salad
examples.zh: 奶酪酱/沙拉

senses.def: what you ask somebody to say before you take their photograph
senses.zh: “茄子”（要求照相的人说的口形词）

senses.def: an important and powerful person, especially in an organization
if two people or things are like chalk and cheese

examples.en: Frank and I will never get along. We’re chalk and cheese.
examples.zh: 弗兰克和我永远不会和睦相处。我们是粉笔和奶酪。

senses.def: used as a way of saying that you are sorry about something, usually ironically
senses.zh: （常作反话）太不幸了，真够倒霉

senses.def: an important and powerful person, especially in an organization
if two people or things are like chalk and cheese

examples.en: Frank and I will never get along. We’re chalk and cheese.
examples.zh: 弗兰克和我永远不会和睦相处。我们是粉笔和奶酪。

senses.def: used as a way of saying that you are sorry about something, usually ironically
senses.zh: （常作反话）太不幸了，真够倒霉

senses.def: the act of being extremely careful or mean with money
not liking to spend money
a stick of pastry
a board that is used to cut cheese on
a variety of cheeses that are served at the end of a meal
senses.zh: （一餐饭结束前上的）干酪拼盘

examples.en: The meal finished with the cheeseboard and fresh fruit.
examples.zh: 这顿饭以奶酪板和新鲜水果结束。

senses.def: a hamburger
a cold dessert

examples.en: a strawberry cheesecake
examples.zh: 草莓奶酪蛋糕

examples.en: Is there any cheesecake left?
examples.zh: 还有奶酪蛋糕吗？

senses.def: a type of loose cotton cloth used especially for making shirts
annoyed or bored

examples.en: He’s cheesed off with his job.
examples.zh: 他厌倦他的工作。

senses.def: not very good or original, and without style, in a way that is embarrassing but funny
senses.zh: 拙劣可笑的；令人尴尬发笑的

examples.en: a cheesy horror movie
examples.zh: 拙劣可笑的恐怖片

examples.en: That’s the cheesiest chat-up line I’ve ever heard.
examples.zh: 这是我听过的最俗气的搭讪台词。

senses.def: too emotional or romantic, in a way that is embarrassing

examples.en: a cheesy love song
examples.zh: 过分伤感的情歌

examples.en: a cheesy romance novel
examples.zh: 一部俗气的言情小说

senses.def: done in an exaggerated

examples.en: She had a cheesy grin on her face.
examples.zh: 她做作地龇牙笑了一笑。

senses.def: smelling or tasting of cheese
senses.zh: 干酪气味的；干酪味道的

senses.def: a wild animal of the cat family that has black spots and that runs very fast
a person whose job is to cook, especially the most senior person in a restaurant, hotel, etc.
senses.zh: 厨师；大厨；（尤指餐馆、酒店等的）主厨，厨师长

examples.en: a new book by a celebrity chef
examples.zh: 一位名厨的新书

examples.en: the head/executive chef at a famous London restaurant
examples.zh: 伦敦一家著名餐厅的主厨/行政主厨

examples.en: She used to work as a chef in a big hotel in Johannesburg.
examples.zh: 她曾在约翰内斯堡一家大酒店担任厨师。

senses.def: a very good piece of work, especially the best work by a particular artist, writer, etc.
senses.zh: （尤指某一艺术家、作家等的）杰作，代表作

senses.def: a large salad consisting of lettuce
senses.zh: 主厨色拉，主厨沙拉（用莴苣、番茄等蔬菜制成，上面配有干酪片和鸡肉、火腿等肉片）

senses.def: typical of a chef, especially involving complicated recipes and methods
senses.zh: 厨师：典型的厨师，尤其是涉及复杂的食谱和方法的厨师

examples.en: There are no trendy ingredients or cheffy tricks, just amazing dishes made from simple ingredients.
examples.zh: 没有流行的食材或厨师技巧，只有用简单的食材制成的令人惊叹的菜肴。

examples.en: When you cook and write a lot about food, you pick up some cheffy habits.
examples.zh: 当你做饭并写很多关于食物的文章时，你就会养成一些厨师的习惯。

senses.def: a district of London, on the north bank of the Thames
senses.zh: 切尔西（Chelsea）：伦敦的一个区，在威斯敏斯特以西的泰晤士河北岸。在19世纪和20世纪初，许多艺术家都住在这里，并在艺术领域享有盛誉。现在，它是伦敦最时尚，最昂贵的地区之一。

senses.def: an English football club, based in Fulham
senses.zh: 切尔西（Chelsea）：一家位于西伦敦富勒姆（Fulham）的英国足球俱乐部，自1950年代以来在英国和欧洲曾多次取得成功

senses.def: a boot with elastic
a small round cake containing dried fruit
a large building in Chelsea
senses.zh: 切尔西医院（Chelsea Hospital）：伦敦切尔西的一栋大型建筑，由查尔斯二世（Charles II）于1680年代建造，是440名老兵或受伤士兵的住所，这些士兵后来被称为切尔西退休人员。它是由克里斯托弗·雷恩（Christopher Wren）设计的。

senses.def: any of the former soldiers who live at Chelsea Hospital
senses.zh: 切尔西养老金领取者：居住在伦敦切尔西医院的任何前士兵。在切尔西地区经常可以看到他们穿着传统的制服，夏天穿红色长外套，冬天穿蓝色长外套。

senses.def: one of Britain's oldest botanical
senses.zh: 切尔西植物园（Chelsea Physic Garden）：英国最古老的植物园之一，那里种植的植物和树木用于科学研究。它成立于1673年，位于伦敦的切尔西。尽管它在夏季对公众开放，但仍主要用于科学研究和教育。

senses.def: a large vehicle such as an SUV
senses.zh: 切尔西拖拉机（指在城镇中使用的越野车之类的大车）

examples.en: the environmental cost of driving a Chelsea tractor
examples.zh: 驾驶切尔西拖拉机所产生的环境污染成本

examples.en: They suggested an increase in taxes for air travellers and drivers of Chelsea tractors.
examples.zh: 他们建议增加航空旅客和切尔西拖拉机司机的税收。

senses.def: a town in Gloucestershire

(1451-1506) the Italian explorer
senses.zh: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布（1451–1506）意大利探险家，1492 年抵达美洲大陆，是第一个发现美洲的欧洲人。说服西班牙国王斐迪南二世和女王伊莎贝拉出资，横渡大西洋，寻找通往亚洲的新航线。行至加勒比海一岛屿时，误以为抵达亚洲海岸，且始终深信不疑。之后又三度远航美洲，但因商业上不成功而失宠，在穷困中去世。

senses.def: (1904-86) an English writer of novels and plays. The musical show Cabaret
senses.zh: 克里斯托弗·伊舍伍德（Christopher Isherwood）：（1904-86）英国小说和戏剧作家。音乐剧《歌舞表演》是根据1939年他的收藏《再见柏林》中的一个故事改编的，他的其他大部分作品都基于他在第二次世界大战前在德国的经历。他还与WH Auden合作创作了三部戏剧。1939年，他与奥登一起移居美国，后来成为美国公民。

senses.def: (1922-2015) an English actor who appeared in over 200 films beginning in 1948. He is best known for his parts in horror films such as The Curse of Frankenstein

senses.def: (1564-93) an English writer of plays and poetry. He is considered the greatest English playwright
senses.zh: 克里斯托弗·马洛（Christopher Marlowe）：（1564-93）英国戏剧和诗歌作家。他被认为是威廉·莎士比亚之前最伟大的英国剧作家，并且对莎士比亚的风格产生了重要影响。他最著名的作品是坦布勒（Tamburlaine）（约1587年），福斯特斯医生（Faustus），马耳他犹太人（约1590年）和爱德华二世（约1592年）。他可能还曾写过莎士比亚戏剧《泰特斯·安德鲁尼库斯》和亨利六世的部分作品。马洛（Marlowe）过着狂野而暴力的生活，他因涉嫌谋杀而于1589年短暂入狱，并在29岁的战斗中被谋杀。

senses.def: (1952-2004) a US actor best known for his role as Superman

senses.def: (1632-1723) one of the most famous English architects, known especially for designing the present St Paul's Cathedral

examples.en: He took us on a circuitous route to the hotel.
examples.zh: 他带我们绕道去酒店。

examples.en: The journey was circuitous and slow.
examples.zh: 旅程迂回而缓慢。

senses.def: in a long and not direct way
a system of electrical circuits
senses.zh: 电路系统；电路；电路装置

senses.def: having the shape of a circle; round

examples.en: a circular building
examples.zh: 圆形建筑物

examples.en: He had round unblinking eyes and a perfectly circular head.
examples.zh: 他的眼睛圆溜溜的，一眨不眨，脑袋也圆圆的。

examples.en: The crater was two miles across and roughly circular.
examples.zh: 这个火山口有 2 英里宽，大致呈圆形。

senses.def: moving around in a circle

examples.en: a circular tour of the city
examples.zh: 环城游览

examples.en: Using small circular movements, massage the muscles on either side of the spine.
examples.zh: 通过小幅度的圆周运动，按摩脊柱两侧的肌肉。

senses.def: using an idea or a statement to prove something that is then used to prove the idea or statement at the beginning
senses.zh: 循环论证的（以一种观点证明另一观点，接着再用后一种观点反过来去证明前一观点）

senses.def: sent to a large number of people
a letter, notice or advertisement that is sent to a large number of people at the same time
senses.zh: （同时送达很多人的）信函（或通知、广告）

examples.en: The company sent a circular to its shareholders giving details of the takeover.
examples.zh: 该公司向股东发出了一份通函，提供了收购的详细信息。

senses.def: a saw
the fact of an argument or a theory using an idea or a statement to prove something which is then used to prove the idea or statement at the beginning
senses.zh: 循环论证的（以一种观点证明另一观点，接着再用后一种观点反过来去证明前一观点）

examples.en: There is a dangerous circularity about this argument.
examples.zh: 这一论述存在循环论证的问题。

senses.def: when a liquid, gas or air circulates

examples.en: The condition prevents the blood from circulating freely.
examples.zh: 这种病会阻碍血液的畅通循环。

examples.en: Cooled air is circulated throughout the building.
examples.zh: 冷气在整座大楼循环。

senses.def: if a story, an idea, information, etc. circulates

examples.en: Rumours began to circulate about his financial problems.
examples.zh: 有关他财务问题的谣言开始流传开来。

examples.en: There's a story circulating around the office that you are about to leave the company.
examples.zh: 办公室里有传言说你要离开公司。

examples.en: the latest conspiracy theory circulating among some online communities
examples.zh: 一些网络社区中流传的最新阴谋论

examples.en: Who has been circulating these rumours?
examples.zh: 到底是谁在散布这些谣言呢？

senses.def: to send goods or information to all the people in a group

examples.en: They circulated a petition for his release.
examples.zh: 他们散发了一份要求释放他的请愿书。

examples.en: The book was circulated widely in Russia.
examples.zh: 这本书在俄罗斯广为流传。

examples.en: The document will be circulated to all members.
examples.zh: 这份文件将在所有成员间传阅。

senses.def: to move around a group, especially at a party, talking to different people
senses.zh: （尤指在聚会上）往来应酬，周旋

senses.def: the movement of blood around the body

examples.en: Regular exercise will improve blood circulation.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼会促进血液循环。

examples.en: to have good/bad circulation
examples.zh: 血液循环良好／不畅

senses.def: the passing or spreading of something from one person or place to another

examples.en: the circulation of money/information/ideas
examples.zh: 货币的流通；消息的传播；观念的流行

examples.en: A number of forged tickets are in circulation.
examples.zh: 有一些假入场券在流通。

examples.en: The coins were taken out of circulation.
examples.zh: 这种硬币已停止流通。

examples.en: Copies of the magazine were withdrawn from circulation.
examples.zh: 这期杂志有不少已从市场上收回。

examples.en: putting computer viruses into circulation
examples.zh: 让计算机病毒传播

senses.def: the usual number of copies of a newspaper or magazine that are sold each day, week, etc.

examples.en: a daily circulation of more than one million
examples.zh: 日发行量超过一百万份

examples.en: The newspaper has a daily circulation of 20 000.
examples.zh: 这份报纸的日发行量为 2 万份。

senses.def: the movement of something (for example air, water, gas, etc.) around an area or inside a system or machine

examples.en: Poor air circulation can cause condensation.
examples.zh: 空气流通不良会导致凝结。

senses.def: the fact that somebody takes part in social activities at a particular time

examples.en: Anne has been ill but now she's back in circulation.
examples.zh: 安妮一直生病，但现在又回来参加社交活动了。

examples.en: I was out of circulation for months after the baby was born.
examples.zh: 孩子出生后我有几个月都没有参加社交活动。

senses.def: relating to the movement of blood around the body

examples.en: the circulatory system
examples.zh: 血液循环系统

senses.def: around

examples.en: to circumnavigate (= sail around) the world
examples.zh: 环球航行

senses.def: to remove the foreskin
senses.zh: （因宗教或医学原因）对（男子）行割礼，环切（男子）的包皮

senses.def: to cut off part of the sex organs of a girl or woman for non-medical reasons (a traditional practice in some cultures but illegal in many countries)
senses.zh: 割除（女子）的阴蒂（一些文化中的传统习俗，在许多国家属非法）

senses.def: the act of circumcising
senses.zh: 包皮环切术；阴蒂切除术；（宗教仪式，尤指为男婴施行的）割礼

senses.def: a line that goes around a circle or any other curved shape; the length of this line

examples.en: the circumference of a circle
examples.zh: 圆的周长

examples.en: the circumference of the earth
examples.zh: 地球的周长

examples.en: The earth is almost 25 000 miles in circumference.
examples.zh: 地球的周长大约为 25 000 英里。

senses.def: the mark placed over a vowel in some languages to show how it should be pronounced, as over the o
senses.zh: 音调符号（标在元音字母上表发音，如 rôle 一词中 o 字母上的符号）

senses.def: the use of more words than are necessary, instead of speaking or writing in a clear, direct way
to sail all the way around something, especially all the way around the world
senses.zh: 环绕…航行；（尤指）环绕地球航行

senses.def: the act of sailing all the way around something, especially all the way around the world
senses.zh: 环绕…航行；（尤指）环绕地球航行

examples.en: the circumnavigation of the globe
examples.zh: 环球航行

senses.def: to limit somebody/something’s freedom, rights, power, etc.
senses.zh: 限制，约束（自由、权利、权力等）

examples.en: The power of the monarchy was circumscribed by the new law.
examples.zh: 君主统治的权力受到了新法律的制约。

examples.en: They are still highly circumscribed in their authority.
examples.zh: 他们的权力仍然受到严格限制。

senses.def: to draw a circle around another shape
the act of limiting somebody/something's freedom, rights, power, etc.
senses.zh: 限制，约束（自由、权利、权力等）

senses.def: thinking very carefully about something before doing it, because there may be risks involved
senses.zh: 小心谨慎的；考虑周密的；慎重的

examples.en: He was very circumspect in his financial affairs.
examples.zh: 他在财务方面非常谨慎。

senses.def: the act of thinking very carefully about something before doing it, because there may be risks involved
senses.zh: 在做某件事情之前仔细考虑的行为，因为其中可能存在风险

senses.def: very carefully, because there may be risks involved in what you are thinking of doing
the conditions and facts that are connected with and affect a situation, an event or an action

examples.en: Police said there were no suspicious circumstances surrounding the boy's death.
examples.zh: 警方说关于男孩死亡一事没有发现可疑的情况。

examples.en: Under normal circumstances, your white blood cells are able to fight infections.
examples.zh: 在正常情况下，白细胞能够抵抗感染。

examples.en: The company reserves the right to cancel this agreement in certain circumstances.
examples.zh: 本公司保留在一定条件下取消这项协议的权利。

examples.en: In exceptional circumstances, detainees could be denied access to a lawyer.
examples.zh: 在特殊情况下，被拘留者可能不允许接触律师。

examples.en: I know I can trust her in any circumstance.
examples.zh: 我知道我在任何情况下都能信任她。

examples.en: Due to unforeseen circumstances, we have had to reschedule the concert.
examples.zh: 由于不可预见的情况，我们不得不重新安排音乐会的时间。

examples.en: Britain is fortunately not facing the same set of circumstances.
examples.zh: 幸运的是，英国没有面临同样的局面。

examples.en: The court will take into account all the circumstances of the case.
examples.zh: 法庭将考量该案的所有情况。

examples.en: Police are investigating the circumstances of the death of a baby boy.
examples.zh: 警方正在调查一名男婴的死亡情况。

senses.def: the conditions of a person’s life, especially the money they have
senses.zh: 境况；境遇；（尤指）经济状况

examples.en: We want to work towards improving the often difficult circumstances in which people find themselves.
examples.zh: 我们要努力改善人们经常遭遇的困难处境。

examples.en: The particular circumstances of each individual claimant must be considered.
examples.zh: 必须考虑每个索赔人的特殊情况。

examples.en: Grants are awarded according to your personal circumstances.
examples.zh: 补助金的发放将根据您的个人情况而定。

examples.en: her family/domestic circumstances
examples.zh: 她的家庭/家庭情况

senses.def: situations and events that affect and influence your life and that are not in your control

examples.en: a victim of circumstance (= a person who has suffered because of a situation that they cannot control)
examples.zh: 客观环境的牺牲品

examples.en: He had to leave the country through force of circumstance (= events made it necessary).
examples.zh: 为势所迫，他不得不离开这个国家。

examples.en: We were simply thrown together by circumstance on the long journey.
examples.zh: 我们只是在漫长的旅途中因环境而聚集在一起。

senses.def: used before or after a statement to show that you have thought about the conditions that affect a situation before making a decision or a statement
senses.zh: 在这种情况下；既然如此

examples.en: Under the circumstances, it seemed better not to tell him about the accident.
examples.zh: 在这种情况下，不告诉他有关这次事故的情况似乎更好。

examples.en: She did the job very well in the circumstances.
examples.zh: 她在那种情况下仍把工作干得很出色。

examples.en: In the circumstances, you'd better call the police.
examples.zh: 在这种情况下，你最好打电话报警。

senses.def: used to emphasize that something should never happen or be allowed

examples.en: Under no circumstances should you lend Paul any money.
examples.zh: 你无论如何都不能借钱给保罗。

examples.en: Don't open the door, in any circumstances.
examples.zh: 在任何情况下都不要开门。

examples.en: Under no circumstances should you leave the door unlocked.
examples.zh: 无论如何都不应该不锁门。

senses.def: formal and impressive ceremony

examples.en: Funerals of famous people were conducted with great pomp and circumstance.
examples.zh: 名人的葬礼非常隆重、隆重。

senses.def: the state of being poorer than you were before. People say ‘
senses.zh: （委婉说法，与 poor 同义）境况不济

senses.def: used before or after a statement to show that you have thought about the conditions that affect a situation before making a decision or a statement
senses.zh: 在这种情况下；既然如此

examples.en: Under the circumstances, it seemed better not to tell him about the accident.
examples.zh: 在这种情况下，不告诉他有关这次事故的情况似乎更好。

examples.en: She did the job very well in the circumstances.
examples.zh: 她在那种情况下仍把工作干得很出色。

examples.en: In the circumstances, you'd better call the police.
examples.zh: 在这种情况下，你最好打电话报警。

senses.def: used to emphasize that something should never happen or be allowed

examples.en: Under no circumstances should you lend Paul any money.
examples.zh: 你无论如何都不能借钱给保罗。

examples.en: Don't open the door, in any circumstances.
examples.zh: 在任何情况下都不要开门。

examples.en: Under no circumstances should you leave the door unlocked.
examples.zh: 无论如何都不应该不锁门。

senses.def: formal and impressive ceremony

examples.en: Funerals of famous people were conducted with great pomp and circumstance.
examples.zh: 名人的葬礼非常隆重、隆重。

senses.def: the state of being poorer than you were before. People say ‘
senses.zh: （委婉说法，与 poor 同义）境况不济

synonyms.words: circumstances ▪ position ▪ conditions ▪ things ▪ the case ▪ state of affairs

intro.en: These are all words for the conditions and facts that are connected with and affect the way things are.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指情况、状况。

items.def: all the things that are happening at a particular time and in a particular place:
items.zh: 指情况、状况、形势、局面

examples.en: the present economic situation
examples.zh: 目前的经济形势

items.def: the facts that are connected with and affect a situation, an event or an action; the conditions of a person’s life, especially the money they have:
items.zh: 指条件、环境、状况、境况，（尤指）经济状况

examples.en: The ship sank in mysterious circumstances.
examples.zh: 那艘船神秘地沉没了。

items.def: the situation that somebody is in, especially when it affects what they can and cannot do:
items.zh: 指处境、地位、状况

examples.en: She felt she was in a position of power.
examples.zh: 她觉得她自己有权力。

items.def: the circumstances in which people live, work or do things; the physical situation that affects how something happens:
items.zh: 指居住、工作或做事情的环境、境况、条件，影响某事发生的物质环境、状态、条件

examples.en: We were forced to work outside in freezing conditions.
examples.zh: 我们被迫在户外天寒地冻的环境下工作。

items.def: (rather informal) the general situation, as it affects somebody:
items.zh: 指形势、局面、情况、事态

examples.en: Hi, Jane! How are things?
examples.zh: 喂，简，近来怎么样？

items.def: the true situation:
items.zh: 指实情、事实

examples.en: If that is the case (= if the situation described is true), we need more staff.
examples.zh: 如果真是那样，我们就需要更多的员工了。

items.def: a situation:
items.zh: 指事态、情况、形势

examples.en: How did this unhappy state of affairs come about?
examples.zh: 这种不幸的情况是怎么发生的呢？

senses.def: containing information and details that strongly suggest that something is true but do not prove it
senses.zh: 按情况推测的；视情况而定的；间接的

examples.en: circumstantial evidence
examples.zh: 情况证据

examples.en: The case against him was largely circumstantial.
examples.zh: 对他不利的案情大多为间接推测的。

senses.def: connected with particular circumstances
senses.zh: 与特定条件（或环境、情况）有关的

examples.en: Their problems were circumstantial rather than personal.
examples.zh: 他们的困难是环境而非个人所致。

senses.def: to find a way of avoiding a difficulty or a rule

examples.en: They found a way of circumventing the law.
examples.zh: 他们找到了规避法律的途径。

senses.def: to go or travel around something that is blocking your way
the act of finding a way of avoiding a difficulty or rule
senses.zh: 寻找回避困难或规则的方法的行为

examples.en: To prevent further circumvention of the law, the cut-off date for obtaining permits is March 31.
examples.zh: 为了防止进一步规避法律，获得许可证的截止日期是3月31日。

senses.def: a group of people, sometimes with trained animals, who perform acts with skill in a show that travels around to different places
a show performed by people who are members of a circus
senses.zh: 马戏表演（常在大帐篷里进行）

examples.en: We took the children to the circus.
examples.zh: 我们带孩子去看了马戏表演。

senses.def: a group of people or an event that attracts a lot of attention
senses.zh: 引人注意的人（或事）；热闹场面

examples.en: A media circus surrounded the royal couple wherever they went.
examples.zh: 无论王室夫妇走到何处，他们的身后都会跟着一大群媒体记者。

examples.en: the American electoral circus
examples.zh: 美国大选的热闹场面

senses.def: (used in some place names) a round open area in a town where several streets meet
senses.zh: 圆形广场；环形交叉路口

examples.en: Piccadilly Circus
examples.zh: 皮卡迪利广场

senses.def: a place like a big round outdoor theatre for public games, races, etc.
a round hollow area in the side of a mountain
a serious disease of the liver
a broken layer of small clouds
a thin layer of fairly flat clouds very high up in the sky
a type of light cloud that forms high in the sky
describing or connected with people whose sense of personal identity and gender

examples.en: Most of the people who have appeared on the show have been cis men.
examples.zh: 大多数出现在节目中的人都是顺性别男性。

senses.def: Commonwealth of Independent States
senses.zh: 独立国家联合体，独联体（由 1991 年之前原属苏联的主权国家组成）

senses.def: describing or connected with people whose sense of personal identity and gender

examples.en: Many ask whether cisgender actors should be playing trans characters.
examples.zh: 许多人问顺性别演员是否应该扮演跨性别角色。

senses.def: an offensive word for a boy or man who is considered to be weak, easily frightened, or interested in things considered only suitable for girls or women
senses.zh: 女人气的男子;胆小鬼;懦弱的人

senses.def: an offensive word to describe a boy or man who is considered to be weak, easily frightened, or interested in things considered only suitable for girls or women
a container in which water is stored in a building, especially one in the roof or connected to a toilet
senses.zh: （尤指屋顶上的）蓄水箱，贮水箱；（抽水马桶的）水箱

senses.def: (in the past) a castle on high ground in or near a city where people could go when the city was being attacked

examples.en: After the Mongol invasion of 1241, a citadel was built on the hills opposite the city.
examples.zh: 1241 年蒙古入侵后，在城市对面的山上建造了一座城堡。

examples.en: citadels of private economic power
examples.zh: 私人经济力量的堡垒

senses.def: words or lines taken from a book or a speech

examples.en: The report contained several citations taken from her PhD thesis.
examples.zh: 该报告载有几处取自她的博士论文的引文。

senses.def: an official statement about something special that somebody has done, especially about acts of courage in a war
senses.zh: 表彰；表扬；（尤指对战争中英勇表现的）嘉奖令

examples.en: a citation for bravery
examples.zh: 因勇敢而受到的嘉奖

senses.def: an act of citing or being cited

examples.en: Space does not permit the citation of the examples.
examples.zh: 篇幅有限，示例从略。

senses.def: an order to appear in court

examples.en: The judge issued a contempt citation against the woman for violating a previous court order.
examples.zh: 法官对上一次拒不遵守庭谕的那名妇女发出了藐视法庭的传讯。

senses.def: to mention something as a reason or an example, or in order to support what you are saying
senses.zh: 提及（原因）；举出（示例）；列举

examples.en: She cited examples of companies the city has helped relocate or expand.
examples.zh: 她列举了该城市帮助一些公司搬迁或扩展业务的例子。

examples.en: Citing unnamed sources, the newspaper reports that the two companies are nearing a deal.
examples.zh: 该报援引未透露姓名的消息人士的话称，两家公司即将达成协议。

examples.en: There is no reason to doubt the information in the articles cited above.
examples.zh: 没有理由怀疑上述文章中的信息。

examples.en: He cited personal reasons for his decision to resign.
examples.zh: 他列举了自己决定辞职的个人原因。

examples.en: The Bank of England has again cited concerns about inflation.
examples.zh: 英国央行再次表达了对通胀的担忧。

examples.en: Their method is similar to those used by many studies cited in this report.
examples.zh: 他们的方法与本报告中引用的许多研究所使用的方法类似。

examples.en: He cited his heavy workload as the reason for his breakdown.
examples.zh: 他提到巨大的工作负荷是导致他精神崩溃的原因。

senses.def: to speak or write the exact words from a book, an author, etc.

examples.en: He cites no primary sources for his claims.
examples.zh: 他的说法并没有援引任何原始资料。

examples.en: She cited a passage from the President’s speech.
examples.zh: 她引用了总统的一段讲话。

examples.en: She is the author most often cited in his work.
examples.zh: 她是在其作品中最常被引用的作者。

senses.def: to order somebody to appear in court; to name somebody officially in a legal case

examples.en: He was cited for contempt of court.
examples.zh: 他因藐视法庭而被传唤。

examples.en: She was cited in the divorce proceedings.
examples.zh: 她在离婚诉讼中被传唤。

senses.def: to mention somebody officially or publicly because they deserve special praise

examples.en: He was cited for bravery.
examples.zh: 他因表现勇敢而得到嘉奖。

synonyms.words: refer to somebody/​something ▪ speak ▪ cite ▪ quote

intro.en: These words all mean to write or speak about somebody/​something, often in order to give an example or prove something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含写到、说到、谈及或举例说明之义。

items.def: to write or speak about something/​somebody, especially without giving much information:
items.zh: 指提到、写到、说到，尤指未给出详细信息

examples.en: Nobody mentioned anything to me about it.
examples.zh: 没人跟我提过这事儿。

items.def: (rather formal) to mention or speak about somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指提到、谈及、说起

examples.en: I promised not to refer to the matter again.
examples.zh: 我答应过再不提这事了。

items.def: to mention or describe somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指提起、讲述

examples.en: Witnesses spoke of a great ball of flame.
examples.zh: 目击者都谈到有个大火球。

items.def: (formal) to mention something as a reason or an example, or in order to support what you are saying:
items.zh: 指提及（原因）、举出（示例）证明

examples.en: He cited his heavy workload as the reason for his breakdown.
examples.zh: 他提到巨大的工作负荷是导致他精神崩溃的原因。

items.def: to mention an example of something to support what you are saying:
items.zh: 指举例说明

examples.en: Can you quote me an instance of when this happened?
examples.zh: 你能否给我举例说明一下发生这事的情况？

senses.def: (in some countries) a legal relationship between two people, usually of the same sex, with the same legal status as marriage

examples.zh: 西方文明社会的常见病

to say that something is true although it has not been proved and other people may not believe it

examples.en: He claims (that) he was not given a fair hearing.
examples.zh: 他声称他未得到公正的申诉机会。

examples.en: I don't claim to be an expert.
examples.zh: 我不敢自称为专家。

examples.en: She claimed to hate all art.
examples.zh: 她声称讨厌所有艺术。

examples.en: She's not the saint that many have claimed her to be.
examples.zh: 很多人说她是圣人，但她不是。

examples.en: After disappointing box office results, newspapers claimed the show to be a failure
examples.zh: 票房成绩令人失望后，报纸称该剧失败

examples.en: Scientists are claiming a major breakthrough in the fight against cancer.
examples.zh: 科学家宣称治疗癌症已有重大的突破。

examples.en: It was claimed that some doctors were working 80 hours a week.
examples.zh: 据说有些医生每周工作 80 小时。

examples.en: ‘I did not tell any lies,’ she claimed.
examples.zh: “我没有说谎。”她声称。

senses.group: say something is true/you have done something 声称

senses.def: to state that you have done, gained or achieved something

examples.en: He claimed victory in the presidential elections before all the results were in.
examples.zh: 没等结果完全出来，他就宣布赢得总统大选。

examples.en: Nobody has claimed responsibility for the bombing.
examples.zh: 没有人声称对爆炸事件负责。

senses.group: say something is true/you have done something 声称

senses.def: to ask for money from the government or a company because you have a right to it

examples.en: He's not entitled to claim housing benefit.
examples.zh: 他没有资格申领住房补贴。

examples.en: You might be entitled to claim compensation if you are injured at work.
examples.zh: 如果受了工伤，你可能有权要求赔偿。

examples.en: You could have claimed the cost of the hotel room from your insurance.
examples.zh: 你本可以从你的保险中索取旅馆住房费。

examples.en: She claimed damages from the company for the injury she had suffered.
examples.zh: 她因受伤向公司要求获得损害赔偿金。

examples.en: You can claim on your insurance for that coat you left on the train.
examples.zh: 你可按你的保险索赔你遗忘在火车上的大衣。

senses.def: to demand or ask for something because you believe it is your legal right to own or to have it

examples.en: A lot of lost property is never claimed.
examples.zh: 许多失物从未被认领。

examples.en: The family arrived in the UK in the 1990s and claimed political asylum.
examples.zh: 这家人20世纪90年代来到英国要求政治避难。

examples.en: He is claiming his right to his family's fortune.
examples.zh: 他正在主张自己对家族财产的权利。

senses.group: demand legal right 要求合法权利

senses.def: to get or take somebody’s attention

examples.en: A most unwelcome event claimed his attention.
examples.zh: 一件非常讨厌的事情需要他去考虑。

senses.def: to gain, win or achieve something

examples.en: She has finally claimed a place on the team.
examples.zh: 她终于成了那支队的队员。

senses.def: to cause somebody’s death

examples.en: The car crash claimed three lives.
examples.zh: 那次撞车事故导致三人死亡。

senses.def: a statement that something is true although it has not been proved and other people may not agree with or believe it

examples.en: The company had made false claims about its products.
examples.zh: 这家公司对其产品做了虚假宣传。

examples.en: to reject/dismiss/deny claims of discrimination
examples.zh: 对存在歧视的指控予以否认

examples.en: a report examining claims of corrupt links between politicians
examples.zh: 一份审查政客之间腐败联系的报告

examples.en: The singer has denied claims on social media that she is leaving the band.
examples.zh: 这位歌手否认了社交媒体上有关她将离开乐队的说法。

senses.group: saying something is true 表示真实

senses.def: a request for a sum of money that you believe you have a right to, especially from a company, the government, etc.
senses.zh: （尤指向公司、政府等）索款，索赔

examples.en: You can make a claim on your insurance policy.
examples.zh: 你可按保险单索赔。

examples.en: to put in a claim for an allowance
examples.zh: 提出领取津贴的要求

examples.en: a claim for £2 000
examples.zh: 2 000 英镑的索赔

examples.en: Make sure your claims for expenses are submitted by the end of the month.
examples.zh: 你的费用一定要在月底以前办理报销。

examples.en: a 3 per cent pay claim
examples.zh: 3% 的加薪要求

examples.en: Complete a claim form (= an official document which you must use in order to request money from an organization).
examples.zh: 填写索赔表格。

senses.def: a right that somebody believes they have to something, especially property, land, etc.
senses.zh: （尤指对财产、土地等要求拥有的）所有权

examples.en: nineteenth-century land claims
examples.zh: 十九世纪的土地所有权

examples.en: They had no claim on the land.
examples.zh: 他们无权索要那块土地。

examples.en: She has more claim to the campaign's success than anybody (= she is responsible for it).
examples.zh: 她为活动的成功立了头功。

senses.def: one thing that makes a person or place important or interesting
senses.zh: 一举出名的事；成名的一件事

examples.en: His main claim to fame is that he went to school with the prime minister.
examples.zh: 他出名主要是因为他曾经是首相的中学同学。

examples.en: The town’s only claim to fame is the castle.
examples.zh: 该镇唯一出名的是城堡。

senses.def: to have the right to demand time, attention, etc. from somebody

examples.en: You have no claim on me any more.
examples.zh: 你对我不再有任何要求了。

examples.en: I have many claims on my time.
examples.zh: 我繁务缠身。

examples.en: She had a prior claim on his affections.
examples.zh: 她有权优先得到他的疼爱。

senses.def: to state that you have a right to own something
senses.zh: 声称对…的拥有权；提出对…的所有权

examples.en: He laid claim to the property.
examples.zh: 他声称拥有该财产。

senses.def: used when you are saying that you cannot do something

examples.en: I make no claim to understand modern art.
examples.zh: 我自认为不懂现代艺术。

senses.def: to say or show publicly that you think something should be yours
senses.zh: 公开宣布自己（对某物）的所有权；向公众表示某物应属于自己

examples.en: Adams staked his claim for a place in the Olympic team with his easy win yesterday.
examples.zh: 亚当斯昨天轻松获胜，这无异于告诉人们奥运代表队中应有他的位置。

senses.zh: 声称对…的拥有权；提出对…的所有权

examples.zh: 他声称拥有该财产。

examples.zh: 亚当斯昨天轻松获胜，这无异于告诉人们奥运代表队中应有他的位置。

intro.en: These are all words for a statement that something is true, although it has not been proved.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示未经证实的说法。

items.def: a statement that something is true, although it has not been proved.
items.zh: 指声称、宣称、断言

items.def: (rather formal) a public statement that is made without giving proof, accusing somebody of doing something that is wrong or illegal.
items.zh: 指无证据的说法、指控

items.def: (rather formal) a statement of something that you strongly believe to be true, although it has not been proved.
items.zh: 指明确肯定、断言

senses.def: one thing that makes a person or place important or interesting
senses.zh: 一举出名的事；成名的一件事

examples.en: His main claim to fame is that he went to school with the prime minister.
examples.zh: 他出名主要是因为他曾经是首相的中学同学。

examples.en: The town’s only claim to fame is the castle.
examples.zh: 该镇唯一出名的是城堡。

senses.def: to ask or demand to have something returned because you have a right to it

examples.en: You can claim back the tax on your purchases.
examples.zh: 你可以要求退回购物时缴纳的税款。

examples.en: You can claim back some of the cost of your treatment.
examples.zh: 你可以追索部份治疗费用。

senses.def: a person who claims something because they believe they have a right to it

examples.en: a claimant to the throne
examples.zh: 要求继承王位者；觊觎王位者

senses.def: a person who is receiving money from the state because they are unemployed, etc.

examples.en: sickness benefit claimants
examples.zh: 疾病补助金领取者

senses.def: a person who works for an insurance company and whose job is to calculate how much money somebody should receive after they have lost something or had something damaged
senses.zh: （保险公司的）险损估价师，损失理算人，理赔员

senses.def: (1931-2010) an English agony aunt
senses.zh: 克莱尔·雷纳（Claire Rayner）：（1931-2010）一个英国痛苦的姑姑。她在报纸，广播和电视台工作。她还出版了许多提供医学和个人建议的书籍，并且是多本小说和自传的作者。

senses.def: the power that some people claim to have to be able to see future events or to communicate with people who are dead or far away
senses.zh: 预知能力；通灵能力；遥感能力

senses.def: connected with the power that some people are believed to have to be able to see future events or to communicate with people who are dead or far away
senses.zh: 预知能力；通灵能力；遥感能力

senses.def: a person who is believed to have the power to be able to see future events or to communicate with people who are dead or far away
senses.zh: 预知能力；通灵能力；遥感能力

examples.en: to consult a clairvoyant
examples.zh: 求教于先知

senses.def: a shellfish

examples.en: clam chowder/soup
examples.zh: 蛤蜊浓汤／汤

examples.en: The moment I mentioned the children he closed up like a clam (= became silent and refused to discuss the topic).
examples.zh: 我一提到孩子们，他就沉默不语，拒绝讨论这个话题。

senses.def: to refuse to speak, especially when somebody asks you about something
senses.zh: （尤指被询问时）拒绝说话，拒不开口，闭口不言

senses.def: an outdoor party, especially for eating clams
senses.zh: 野餐会；（尤指）烤蛤及海鲜野餐会

senses.def: to climb or move with difficulty or a lot of effort, using your hands and feet

examples.en: The children clambered up the steep bank.
examples.zh: 孩子们攀登上了陡峭的河岸。

senses.def: slightly wet in an unpleasant way

examples.en: His skin felt cold and clammy.
examples.zh: 他的皮肤摸上去冷冰冰湿乎乎的。

examples.en: clammy hands
examples.zh: 又湿又黏的双手

senses.def: making a loud noise
making demands for something
to demand something loudly

examples.en: People began to clamour for his resignation.
examples.zh: 人们开始大声疾呼要求他辞职。

examples.en: Everyone was clamouring to know how much they would get.
examples.zh: 大家都吵闹着想知道他们能得到多少。

examples.en: A great many interest groups were clamouring to be heard.
examples.zh: 许多利益集团都在大声疾呼，希望得到倾听。

examples.en: ‘Play with us!’ the children clamoured.
examples.zh: “跟我们一起玩吧！”孩子们吵吵嚷嚷地要求道。

senses.def: to shout loudly, especially in a confused way
senses.zh: （尤指乱哄哄地）大声地喊叫，呼叫

examples.en: A crowd of reporters clamoured around the car.
examples.zh: 一群记者围着车吵闹。

senses.def: a loud noise, especially one that is made by a lot of people or animals

examples.en: the clamour of the market
examples.zh: 市场上鼎沸的人声

examples.en: the incessant clamour of monkeys and birds
examples.zh: 猴子和鸟儿不断的喧闹

examples.en: Her head was filled with the clamour of voices calling her name.
examples.zh: 她脑子里充满了呼唤她名字的嘈杂声。

examples.en: He could barely make himself heard above the clamour of the rain.
examples.zh: 在雨声中，他的声音几乎听不见。

senses.def: a demand for something made by a lot of people

examples.en: The clamour for her resignation grew louder.
examples.zh: 民众要求她辞职的呼声越来越高。

examples.en: There are clamours for him to be reinstated.
examples.zh: 有人呼吁让他复职。

senses.def: to hold something tightly, or fasten two things together, with a clamp

examples.en: Clamp one end of the plank to the edge of the table.
examples.zh: 把厚木板的一端用夹具固定在桌子的边上。

examples.en: Clamp the two halves together until the glue dries.
examples.zh: 用夹具把两半物品夹紧，待胶干后再松开。

senses.def: to hold or fasten something very tightly so that it does not move; to be held tightly
senses.zh: 紧紧抓住；紧夹住；被抓住；被夹紧

examples.en: He had a pen clamped between his teeth.
examples.zh: 他的牙齿间叼着一支钢笔。

examples.en: She clamped a pair of headphones over her ears.
examples.zh: 她把一副耳机戴在两边耳朵上。

examples.en: I clamped a hand on his shoulder.
examples.zh: 我一只手搭在他的肩膀上。

examples.en: A mobile phone was clamped to her ear.
examples.zh: 一只手机夹在她的耳边。

examples.en: Her lips clamped tightly together.
examples.zh: 她的双唇紧闭。

examples.en: He clamped his mouth shut.
examples.zh: 他紧闭着嘴。

senses.def: to fix a clamp

examples.en: Her car had been clamped.
examples.zh: 她的车给上了车轮锁。

examples.en: She’d been (= her car had been) clamped.
examples.zh: 她的车被锁住了。

senses.def: a tool for holding things tightly together, usually by means of a screw
a device that is attached to the wheel of a car that has been parked illegally, so that it cannot be driven away
senses.zh: 车轮锁（用于锁住违章停放的车辆）

senses.def: to take strict action in order to prevent something, especially crime

examples.en: a campaign by police to clamp down on street crime
examples.zh: 警方严厉打击街头犯罪的运动

examples.en: The US government is clamping down on drugs.
examples.zh: 美国政府正在严厉打击毒品。

examples.en: to clamp down hard on bullying
examples.zh: 严厉打击恶霸行为

senses.def: to force somebody to accept something such as a law

examples.en: The army clamped a curfew on the city.
examples.zh: 军队对这座城市实行了宵禁。

senses.def: sudden action that is taken in order to stop an illegal activity
senses.zh: 严禁，制止，取缔（非法活动）

examples.en: a clampdown on drinking and driving
examples.zh: 严禁酒后驾车

senses.def: having a cover or other part that opens and shuts like the shell of a clam

examples.en: a clamshell phone
examples.zh: 翻盖式手机

senses.def: the shell of a clam
a container or device that has a cover or other part that opens and shuts like the shell of a clam
a group of families who are related to each other, especially in Scotland
senses.zh: （尤指苏格兰的）宗族，氏族，家族

examples.en: the Macleod clan
examples.zh: 麦克劳德氏族

examples.en: clan warfare
examples.zh: 宗族冲突

examples.en: The Campbell clan was/were the most powerful of the Protestant clans.
examples.zh: 坎贝尔家族是新教家族中最强大的。

senses.def: a very large family, or a group of people who are connected because of a particular thing
senses.zh: 庞大的家族；宗派；帮派；小集团

examples.en: She's one of a growing clan of stars who have left Hollywood.
examples.zh: 她是离开好莱坞的越来越多的明星之一。

examples.en: There's a photo of the whole Kennedy clan on the bookshelf.
examples.zh: 书架上有一张肯尼迪家族全家的照片。

examples.en: The entire clan was/were gathered for Donald's birthday.
examples.zh: 整个家族都聚集在一起庆祝唐纳德的生日。

senses.def: done secretly or kept secret
senses.zh: 暗中从事的；保密的；秘密的

examples.en: a clandestine meeting/relationship
examples.zh: 秘密会议／关系

examples.en: the clandestine sale of weapons
examples.zh: 秘密出售武器

senses.def: to make a loud ringing sound like that of metal being hit; to cause something to make this sound

examples.en: Bells were clanging in the tower.
examples.zh: 塔楼上的钟当当地敲响了。

examples.en: The gates clanged shut.
examples.zh: 大门咣的一声合上了。

examples.en: The trams clanged their way along the streets.
examples.zh: 有轨电车哐啷哐啷沿街驶过。

examples.en: He clanged a spoon against a glass.
examples.zh: 他用勺子叮叮当当地敲玻璃杯。

senses.def: a loud ringing sound like metal being hit

examples.en: the clang of the school bell
examples.zh: 校铃的叮当声。

senses.def: an obvious and embarrassing mistake
senses.zh: 明显且令人难堪的错误

examples.en: Mentioning her ex-husband was a bit of a clanger.
examples.zh: 提及她的前夫是有点令人难堪的失言。

examples.en: He was always dropping clangers (= making embarrassing mistakes or remarks).
examples.zh: 他总是出岔子，令人十分尴尬。

senses.def: making a continuous loud crashing or ringing sound
a continuous loud crashing or ringing sound
to make a loud sound like pieces of metal hitting each other; to cause something to make this sound

examples.en: clanking chains
examples.zh: 叮当作响的镣铐

examples.en: I heard a steel door clank shut.
examples.zh: 我听到一扇钢门叮当关上。

examples.en: The guard clanked his heavy ring of keys.
examples.zh: 看守把他的那串沉甸甸的钥匙弄得叮当响。

senses.def: a loud sound like pieces of metal hitting each other
not showing interest in people who are not in the group
senses.zh: 小集团的；宗派的；排他的

senses.def: a member of a clan
senses.zh: 氏族（或宗族）成员；宗派（或小集团）的成员

examples.en: Will you call on your clansmen to fight with us?
examples.zh: 你会召集你的族人与我们并肩作战吗？

senses.def: to hit your open hands together several times to show that you approve of or have enjoyed something
senses.zh: 鼓掌，拍手（表示赞许或欣赏）

examples.en: The audience cheered and clapped.
examples.zh: 观众又是喝彩又是鼓掌。

examples.en: After she performed, Ariana stood up and clapped for her.
examples.zh: 表演结束后，阿丽亚娜站起来为她鼓掌。

examples.en: Everyone clapped us when we went up to get our prize.
examples.zh: 我们上前领奖时，大家都为我们鼓掌。

senses.def: to hit your open hands together

examples.en: Everyone clapped in time to the music.
examples.zh: 大家合着音乐的节奏拍手。

examples.en: She clapped her hands in delight.
examples.zh: 她高兴地拍起手来。

examples.en: He clapped his hands for silence.
examples.zh: 他拍手要大家安静下来。

senses.def: to lightly hit somebody with your open hand, usually in a friendly way
senses.zh: （常指友好地）轻拍某人的背（或肩）

examples.en: ‘Cheer up, Tony,’ I said, and clapped him on the shoulder.
examples.zh: “振奋起来吧，托尼。”我说，轻轻拍了拍他的肩膀。

senses.def: to put something/somebody somewhere quickly and suddenly

examples.en: ‘Oh dear!’ she cried, clapping a hand over her mouth.
examples.zh: “哎呀！”她叫道，急急用手捂住了嘴。

examples.en: to clap somebody in irons/jail/prison
examples.zh: 迅速把某人关进监狱

examples.en: In the old days they would have clapped you in jail for that.
examples.zh: 在过去，他们会因此把你关进监狱。

senses.def: to see somebody/something

examples.en: I haven't clapped eyes on them for weeks.
examples.zh: 我几周没见到他们了。

examples.en: I hope I never set eyes on this place again!
examples.zh: 我希望永远不再见到这个地方！

examples.en: Tom fell in love the moment he laid eyes on her.
examples.zh: 汤姆对她一见钟情。

senses.def: an act of clapping

examples.en: Give him a clap! (= to praise somebody at the end of a performance)
examples.zh: 为他鼓掌吧！

examples.en: With a clap of his hands he ordered more food.
examples.zh: 他拍了下手又点了些吃的。

senses.def: a sudden loud noise

examples.en: a clap of thunder
examples.zh: 一声霹雳

senses.def: a disease of the sexual organs, caught by having sex with a person who already has the disease
to see somebody/something

examples.zh: 我几周没见到他们了。

examples.en: I hope I never set eyes on this place again!
examples.zh: 我希望永远不再见到这个地方！

examples.en: Tom fell in love the moment he laid eyes on her.
examples.zh: 汤姆对她一见钟情。

examples.zh: 汤姆对她一见钟情。

senses.def: one of a series of long, narrow, pieces of wood, each with one edge thicker than the other. They are fixed to the outside walls of a house, going from side to side, with the bottom of one over the top of the one below, to cover the wall and protect it from rain and wind
a very busy railway station in south London. Thirty-five people were killed in a train crash there in 1988. People sometimes use 'Clapham Junction' to describe a place that is crowded and busy
senses.zh: 克拉珀姆枢纽站伦敦南部极为繁忙的火车站，1988 年曾发生火车相撞事故，导致 35 人丧生。常用来指代拥挤、繁忙的地方。

examples.en: We've got builders in this week and the house is like Clapham Junction.
examples.zh: 这周有建筑工人来，房子里就像克拉珀姆枢纽站似的忙乱。

items.idm: the man on the Clapham omnibus

senses.def: an ordinary person who is typical of many others

examples.en: Can you persuade the man on the Clapham omnibus that it is useful?
examples.zh: 你能让普通人相信这个有用吗？

senses.def: old and in bad condition

examples.en: The van's totally clapped out.
examples.zh: 那辆货车已破得不成样子。

examples.en: a clapped-out old Mini
examples.zh: 又旧又破的迷你牌汽车

extremely fast

examples.zh: 飞快地奔跑；骑马飞奔；驾车疾驰

examples.zh: 飞快地奔跑；骑马飞奔；驾车疾驰

stupid talk that has no value
a group of people who are paid to clap
senses.zh: 受雇喝（倒）彩的一伙人；职业观众

senses.def: a first name for girls
(1821-1912) a US nurse who started the American Red Cross
senses.zh: 克拉拉·巴顿（Clara Barton）：（1821-1912）是一位美国护士，于1881年创立了美国红十字会。她一直担任美国第一任总统，直到1904年。巴尔顿以前是一名教师，在内战期间成为工会士兵的护士，并因此而广为人知作为“战地的天使”。

senses.def: (1905-65) a US actor known as the 'It Girl'. She was in both silent and talking films and usually played a lively flapper
senses.zh: 克拉拉·鲍（Clara Bow）：（1905-65）美国演员，被称为“ It Girl”。她曾参加无声电影和有声电影，通常扮演《咆哮的二十年代》活泼的拍手。她最出色的电影包括《翼》（1927年）和《它》（1927年），从中她获得了自己的特别名字。“这”意味着使女人对男人有吸引力的品质。

senses.def: a first name for girls
(1903-87) a US politician and journalist who also wrote plays. She was the managing editor
senses.zh: 克莱尔·布斯·卢斯（Clare Booth Luce）：（1903-87）是美国政治家和新闻记者，他也写过戏剧。她是《名利场》杂志（1933-4）的执行编辑。她最著名的戏剧包括《妇女》（1936年），该片成为1939年的电影，有135名妇女没有男人，以及《亲吻男孩再见》（Kiss the Boys Goodbye，1938年）。露斯（Luce）是众议院的共和党议员（1943-7），后来成为美国驻意大利大使（1953-7）。她的丈夫亨利·卢斯（Henry Luce，1898-1967年）创办了《时代》杂志。

senses.def: (1857-1938) a US lawyer who became famous for defending people on trial. These included Leopold and Loeb
senses.zh: 克拉伦斯·达罗（Clarence Darrow）：（1857-1938）美国律师，以在审判中捍卫人民而闻名。其中包括利奥波德（Leopold）和勒布（Loeb）以及约翰·T·斯潘斯（John T Scopes），他因向学生讲授进化论而被告上法庭。

senses.def: a large house in London, next to St James's Palace
senses.zh: 克拉伦斯之家（Clarence House）：伦敦的一栋大房子，毗邻圣詹姆斯宫（St James's Palace）。它于1829年为克拉伦斯公爵（后为威廉四世国王）建造。1953年至2003年，这里曾是王后的住所，后来成为查尔斯王子的伦敦住所。

senses.def: a dry red wine, especially from the Bordeaux area of France
senses.zh: （尤指产于法国波尔多地区的）干红葡萄酒

senses.def: a dark red colour

senses.zh: 伦敦西区梅菲尔的著名酒店。自1800年代初以来，它就已经在富人中流行，其中包括各种国王和皇后。现在的建筑于1898年开放。

senses.def: the act or process of making something clearer or easier to understand
senses.zh: 使更清晰易懂；阐明；澄清

examples.en: I am seeking clarification of the regulations.
examples.zh: 我正在努力弄清楚这些规则。

senses.def: to make something clearer or easier to understand
senses.zh: 使更清晰易懂；阐明；澄清

examples.en: to clarify a situation/problem/issue
examples.zh: 澄清情况／问题

examples.en: I hope this clarifies my position.
examples.zh: 我希望这能阐明我的立场。

examples.en: The law on data protection needs to be clarified.
examples.zh: 数据保护法需要澄清。

examples.en: Talking to someone has helped clarify my feelings.
examples.zh: 与人交谈有助于理清我的感情。

examples.en: She asked him to clarify what he meant.
examples.zh: 她要他说清楚他是什么意思。

senses.def: to make something, especially butter, pure by heating it
senses.zh: （通过加热）纯净，净化（尤指黄油）

examples.en: clarified butter
examples.zh: 已净化的黄油

senses.def: a musical instrument of the woodwind
a person who plays the clarinet
a clear message or request for people to do something

examples.en: a clarion call for action
examples.zh: 行动的号角

senses.def: a first name for girls
the quality of being expressed clearly

examples.en: a lack of clarity in the law
examples.zh: 法律上不明确

examples.en: The brilliant clarity of his argument could not be faulted.
examples.zh: 他的论点极其清晰，无可挑剔。

senses.def: the ability to think about or understand something clearly
senses.zh: 清晰的思维（或理解）能力

examples.en: clarity of thought/purpose/vision
examples.zh: 思路清楚；目的明确；视野清晰

examples.en: With painful clarity she remembered the day he had died.
examples.zh: 她真切地回想起他去世当天的情景，痛不欲生。

senses.def: if a picture, substance or sound has clarity
senses.zh: （画面、物质或声音的）清晰，清楚，清澈

examples.en: the clarity of the sound on the recording
examples.zh: 录音的清晰音质

(1901-60) a US film actor who was especially famous in the 1930s and 1940s. He was sometimes referred to as the 'King of Hollywood'. His best-known role was as Rhett Butler
senses.zh: 克拉克·盖博（1901–1960）20 世纪 30–40 年代知名美国电影演员，常被誉为“好莱坞之王”。以《乱世佳人》中的白瑞德一角最为著名。凭借喜剧片《一夜风流》获奥斯卡奖。其他作品包括《叛舰喋血记》（1935）以及和玛丽莲·梦露联袂主演的《乱点鸳鸯谱》（1960）。

senses.def: Superman
the name of a British company that makes and sells shoes; any of the shops owned by the company
senses.zh: 制造和销售鞋子的英国公司的名称；公司拥有的任何商店

senses.def: a small harp
senses.zh: 凯尔特竖琴（用于苏格兰和爱尔兰音乐）

senses.def: a short fight between two groups of people
senses.zh: （两群人之间的）打斗，打架，冲突

examples.en: Clashes broke out between police and demonstrators.
examples.zh: 警方与示威者发生了冲突。

examples.en: Eight people were wounded in a clash with border guards.
examples.zh: 在与边防警卫的冲突中有八人受伤。

examples.en: Several people were injured in violent clashes with the police.
examples.zh: 几个人在与警察的暴力冲突中受了伤。

senses.def: an argument between two people or groups of people who have different beliefs and ideas

examples.en: There has been a head-on clash between the two candidates over education policy.
examples.zh: 两位候选人一直在教育政策上针锋相对。

senses.def: the difference that exists between two things that are opposed to each other

examples.en: a clash of interests/opinions/cultures
examples.zh: 利益冲突；意见分歧；文化差异

examples.en: a personality clash with the boss
examples.zh: 与老板的个性不合

senses.def: a situation in which two events happen at the same time so that you cannot go to or see them both

examples.en: a clash in the timetable/schedule
examples.zh: 时间安排有冲突

senses.def: a loud noise made by two metal objects being hit together

examples.en: a clash of cymbals/swords
examples.zh: 铙钹的敲击声；剑的撞击声

senses.def: an occasion when two teams or players compete against each other

examples.en: Bayern’s clash with Roma in the Champions League
examples.zh: 拜仁队在欧洲冠军联赛中与罗马队的交锋

senses.def: the situation when two colours, designs, etc. look ugly when they are put together
senses.zh: 不协调；不和谐；搭配不当

senses.def: to come together and fight or compete in a contest

examples.en: The two sets of supporters clashed outside the stadium.
examples.zh: 双方的支持者在体育场外打了起来。

examples.en: The two teams clash in tomorrow's final.
examples.zh: 这两支队将在明天的决赛中厮杀。

examples.en: Demonstrators clashed violently with police.
examples.zh: 示威者与警方发生了激烈的冲突。

examples.en: They often clash violently with rival gangs.
examples.zh: 他们经常和敌对帮派发生激烈冲突。

senses.def: to argue or disagree seriously with somebody about something, and to show this in public

examples.en: The leaders and members clashed on the issue.
examples.zh: 领袖和下属的成员在这个问题上产生了分歧。

examples.en: The leaders clashed with party members on the issue.
examples.zh: 政党领袖与该党党员在这个问题上产生了分歧。

senses.def: to be very different and opposed to each other

examples.en: His left-wing views clashed with his father's politics.
examples.zh: 他的左翼观点与他父亲的政见分歧很大。

examples.en: His views and his father's clashed.
examples.zh: 他的观点与他父亲的观点相抵触。

examples.en: They have clashing personalities.
examples.zh: 他们的个性迥然相异。

senses.def: to happen at the same time so that you cannot go to or see them both

examples.en: Unfortunately your party clashes with a wedding I'm going to.
examples.zh: 不巧得很，你的聚会和我要参加的婚礼在时间上有冲突。

examples.en: The dates of my exams clash, so what do I do?
examples.zh: 我的考试日期冲突了，我该怎么办？

senses.def: to look ugly when put together
senses.zh: 不协调；不和谐；搭配不当

examples.en: The wallpaper clashes with the carpet.
examples.zh: 墙纸与地毯的色彩不协调。

examples.en: The wallpaper and the carpet clash.
examples.zh: 墙纸和地毯的色彩不相配。

examples.en: Do you think these colours clash?
examples.zh: 你觉得这些颜色冲突吗？

senses.def: to hit together and make a loud ringing noise; to make two metal objects do this
senses.zh: （使）撞击出巨大的响声；（使）当啷作响

examples.en: The long blades clashed together.
examples.zh: 长刀相击铿然作响。

examples.en: She clashed the cymbals.
examples.zh: 她当啷一声敲响铙钹。

senses.group: make loud noise 发出大声

intro.en: These are all words for a situation in which people try to defeat each other using physical force.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指搏斗、打斗、打架。

items.def: a situation in which two or more people try to defeat each other using physical force:
items.zh: 指搏斗、打斗、打架

examples.en: He got into a fight with a man in the bar.
examples.zh: 他在酒吧里和一个男人斗殴。

items.def: (in the media) a short fight between two groups of people:
items.zh: （新闻用语）指两群人之间短暂的打斗、打架、冲突

examples.en: Clashes broke out between police and demonstrators.
examples.zh: 警方与示威者发生了冲突。

items.def: a noisy and violent fight involving a group of people, usually in a public place:
items.zh: 通常指一群人在公共场合喧闹、斗殴、闹事

examples.en: a drunken brawl in a bar
examples.zh: 在酒吧里酒后闹事

items.def: a fight between two people or groups of people, especially when one of them is trying to escape, or to get something from the other:
items.zh: 指搏斗、扭打，尤指抢夺、挣扎脱身

examples.en: There were no signs of a struggle at the murder scene.
examples.zh: 谋杀现场没有打斗痕迹。

items.def: a short and not very violent fight or struggle:
items.zh: 指短暂而不太激烈的扭打、冲突

examples.en: He was involved in a scuffle with a photographer.
examples.zh: 他和一名摄影记者发生了肢体冲撞。

senses.def: to hold something tightly in your hand

examples.en: He leaned forward, his hands clasped tightly together.
examples.zh: 他俯身向前，双手十字交错地紧握着。

examples.en: They clasped hands (= held each other's hands).
examples.zh: 他们相互紧握着对方的手。

examples.en: I stood there, clasping the door handle.
examples.zh: 我站在那里，紧攥着门把手。

senses.def: to hold somebody/something tightly with your arms around them

examples.en: She clasped the children in her arms.
examples.zh: 她把孩子紧紧地搂在怀里。

examples.en: He clasped her to him.
examples.zh: 他紧紧地拥抱着她。

examples.en: She clasped her arms tightly around him.
examples.zh: 她用双臂紧紧地搂住他。

senses.def: to fasten something with a clasp

examples.en: She clasped the bracelet around her wrist.
examples.zh: 她把手镯戴上手腕扣牢。

senses.def: a device that fastens something, such as a bag or the ends of a belt or a piece of jewellery

examples.en: the clasp of a necklace/handbag
examples.zh: 项链扣环；手提包扣

examples.en: He tried to undo the clasp on the briefcase, but it was stuck.
examples.zh: 他试图打开公文包的搭扣，但卡住了。

senses.def: a tight hold with your hand or in your arms

examples.en: He took her hand in his firm warm clasp.
examples.zh: 他用温暖的手紧紧握住她的手。

synonyms.words: hold on ▪ cling ▪ clutch ▪ grip ▪ grasp ▪ clasp ▪ hang on

intro.en: These words all mean to have somebody/​something in your hands or arms.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示抓住、抱住。

items.def: to have somebody/​something in your hand or arms:
items.zh: 指抓住、抱住、托住、夹住

examples.en: She was holding a large box.
examples.zh: 她提着一只大箱子。

items.def: to continue to hold somebody/​something; to put your hand on somebody/​something and not take your hand away:
items.zh: 指抓紧、不放开

examples.en: Hold on and don’t let go until I say so.
examples.zh: 握紧，我让你松手时才松开。

items.def: to hold on to somebody/​something tightly, especially with your whole body:
items.zh: 尤指用身体紧抱、紧握、抓紧

examples.en: Survivors clung to pieces of floating debris.
examples.zh: 生还者紧紧抱住漂浮在水面上的残骸。

items.def: to hold somebody/​something tightly, especially in your hand; to take hold of something suddenly:
items.zh: 尤指用手抓紧、紧握、抱紧、突然抓住

examples.en: She stood there, the flowers still clutched in her hand.
examples.zh: 她站在那里，手里仍然紧握着花束。

items.def: to hold on to something very tightly with your hand:
items.zh: 指用手紧握、紧抓

examples.en: Grip the rope as tightly as you can.
examples.zh: 尽可能紧紧抓住绳子。

items.def: to take a strong hold of somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指抓紧、抓牢

examples.en: He grasped my hand and shook it warmly.
examples.zh: 他热情地抓着我的手握了起来。

items.def: (formal) to hold somebody/​something tightly in your hand or in your arms:
items.zh: 指紧握、攥紧、抱紧

examples.en: They clasped hands (= held each other’s hands).
examples.zh: 他们相互紧握着对方的手。

items.def: to hold on to something very tightly, especially in order to support yourself or stop yourself from falling:
items.zh: 尤指为支撑自己或防止跌倒而紧紧抓住某物

examples.en: Hang on tight. We’re off!
examples.zh: 抓紧，我们出发了！

senses.def: a group of students who are taught together

examples.en: We were in the same class at school.
examples.zh: 我们在上学时同过班。

examples.en: She is the youngest in her class.
examples.zh: 她在班里年龄最小。

examples.en: He came top of the class.
examples.zh: 他在全班名列前茅。

examples.en: The whole class was/were told to stay behind after school.
examples.zh: 全班被告知放学后留下。

senses.def: an occasion when a group of students meets to be taught

examples.en: I have a history class at 9 o'clock.
examples.zh: 我 9 点钟有历史课。

examples.en: I was late for (a) class.
examples.zh: 我上课迟到了。

examples.en: See me after class.
examples.zh: 下课后来见我。

examples.en: She works hard in class (= during the class).
examples.zh: 她在课堂上学习用功。

senses.def: a series of classes on a particular subject

examples.en: Are you still doing your French evening class?
examples.zh: 你还在夜校学习法语吗？

examples.en: I've been taking classes in pottery.
examples.zh: 我一直在上陶器制作技术课。

senses.def: a group of students who finish their studies at school, college or university in a particular year

examples.en: The class of 2020 was/were invited back to join the celebrations.
examples.zh: 2020 届毕业生被邀请回来参加庆祝活动。

examples.en: the freshman/sophomore/junior/senior class
examples.zh: 大学或高中一年级／二年级／三年级／四年级

senses.def: one of the groups of people in a society that are thought of as being at the same social or economic level

examples.en: the working/middle/upper class
examples.zh: 工人／中产／上层阶级

examples.en: The party tries to appeal to all classes of society.
examples.zh: 这个政党尽力吸引社会各阶层人士。

examples.en: His ideas had an appeal among the wealthy, professional classes.
examples.zh: 他的想法获得富裕的专业阶层认同。

examples.en: The ruling class is/are not going to give up their position without a fight.
examples.zh: 统治阶级不会不战而屈人之兵。

senses.def: the way that people are divided into different social and economic groups

examples.en: differences of class, race or gender
examples.zh: 社会等级、种族或性别差异

examples.en: The old class system is not appropriate in a modern age.
examples.zh: 旧的等级制度不适用于现代。

examples.en: a society in which class is more important than ability
examples.zh: 一个社会等级比能力更为重要的社会

senses.def: each of several different levels of comfort that are available to travellers in a plane, etc.

examples.en: He always travels business class.
examples.zh: 他总是坐公务舱旅行。

examples.en: The first-class compartment is situated at the front of the train.
examples.zh: 头等车厢位于火车的前部。

examples.en: It doesn't matter which class you fly, the food is always horrible.
examples.zh: 无论您乘坐哪个舱位，食物总是很糟糕。

senses.def: a group of people, animals or things that have similar characteristics or qualities

examples.en: It was good accommodation for a hotel of this class.
examples.zh: 就这种档次的旅馆来说，住宿条件算是不错了。

examples.en: different classes of drugs
examples.zh: 不同种类的毒品

examples.en: Dickens was in a different class from (= was much better than) most of his contemporaries.
examples.zh: 与大多数的同辈相比，狄更斯要出色得多。

examples.en: As a jazz singer she's in a class of her own (= better than most others).
examples.zh: 作为爵士乐歌手，她比大多数同行都要出色。

senses.group: group of people/animals 人／动物群体

senses.def: one of the different groups in a competition

examples.en: He came first in his class at every event.
examples.zh: 他每次比赛都是所在小组的第一名。

senses.group: group of people/animals 人／动物群体

senses.def: an attractive quality or a high level of skill that is impressive

examples.en: She has class all right—she looks like a model.
examples.zh: 她的确风姿娴雅，看上去像模特儿一样。

examples.en: There's a real touch of class about this team.
examples.zh: 这支队确实技艺超群。

senses.def: one of the levels of achievement in a British university degree exam

examples.en: a first-/second-/third-class degree
examples.zh: 一级优等／二级优等／第三等学位

senses.group: of university degree 大学学位

senses.def: a group into which animals, plants, etc. that have similar characteristics are divided, below a phylum
the people in society who like to give their opinions on political or social issues
senses.zh: 喜欢（对政治或社会问题）发表意见的人

examples.en: Constitutional reform is popular among the chattering classes.
examples.zh: 宪法改革在喋喋不休的阶层中很受欢迎。

examples.en: topics being discussed at the breakfast tables of the chattering classes
examples.zh: 聒噪阶层在早餐桌上讨论的话题

senses.def: to think or decide that somebody/something is a particular type of person or thing

senses.def: not having taken drugs or alcohol

senses.def: having a smooth edge, surface or shape; simple and regular

senses.def: very clean
a report that says somebody is healthy or that something is in good condition
