examples.en: Soccer needs to clean up its image.
examples.zh: 足球界的形象需要改善。

senses.def: the process of removing dirt, pollution, or things that are considered bad or offensive from a place
senses.zh: 清扫；清除（污染物）；清理；整顿

examples.en: the clean-up of the river
examples.zh: 河流清理

examples.en: a clean-up campaign
examples.zh: 整顿运动

examples.en: a massive clean-up operation
examples.zh: 大扫除行动

senses.def: a woman whose job is to clean the rooms and furniture in an office, a house, etc.
the state of being clean or the habit of keeping things clean
senses.zh: 清洁；干净；爱干净的习惯

examples.en: Some people are obsessive about cleanliness.
examples.zh: 有些人有洁癖。

examples.en: The bathroom was in a good state of cleanliness.
examples.zh: 浴室卫生状况良好。

senses.def: easily and smoothly in one movement

examples.en: The boat moved cleanly through the water.
examples.zh: 小船在水面上轻快地行进。

senses.def: in a clean way

examples.en: fuel that burns cleanly
examples.zh: 环保型的燃料

senses.def: to clean your skin or a wound

examples.en: a cleansing cream
examples.zh: 洁肤霜

examples.en: The wound was then cleansed and dressed.
examples.zh: 随后清洗了伤口并包扎好。

examples.en: a lotion to cleanse the face/skin
examples.zh: 洁面乳；洁肤液

senses.def: to take away somebody’s guilty feelings or sin

examples.en: She felt cleansed of her sins after confession.
examples.zh: 她忏悔之后觉得自己的罪洗清了。

intro.en: These words all mean to remove dirt from something, especially by using water and/​or soap.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含打扫、洗净之义，尤指用水、肥皂等。

items.def: to remove dirt or dust from something, especially by using water or chemicals:
items.zh: 指除去灰尘、打扫，尤指用水或化学品洗净、擦净

examples.en: The villa is cleaned twice a week.
examples.zh: 这栋别墅一周打扫两次。

items.def: to remove dirt from something using water and usually soap:
items.zh: 指洗、洗涤

examples.en: He quickly washed his hands and face.
examples.zh: 他很快把手和脸洗了。

items.def: to remove dirt, etc. from something using clean water only, not soap; to remove the soap from something with clean water after washing it:
items.zh: 指用清水冲洗、清洗、冲掉皂液

examples.en: Make sure you rinse all the soap out.
examples.zh: 一定要把皂液冲洗干净。

items.def: to clean your skin or a wound.
items.zh: 指清洁（皮肤）、清洗（伤口）

items.def: to clean clothes using chemicals instead of water.
items.zh: 指干洗

senses.def: a liquid or cream for cleaning your face, especially for removing make-up
senses.zh: （尤指用于面部卸妆的）洁肤液，洁肤霜

senses.def: a substance that contains chemicals and is used for cleaning things
easy to understand and not confusing
senses.zh: 清晰易懂的；明白清楚的；不含混的

examples.en: She gave me clear and precise directions.
examples.zh: 她给了我清晰而准确的指示。

examples.en: Are these instructions clear enough?
examples.zh: 这些说明够清楚了吗？

examples.en: Your meaning needs to be clear.
examples.zh: 你的意思必须清楚。

examples.en: You'll do as you're told—is that clear?
examples.zh: 叫你做什么你就去做什么，明白吗？

examples.en: She was quite clear about her reasons for leaving.
examples.zh: 她很清楚自己离开的原因。

examples.en: This behaviour must stop—do I make myself clear (= express myself clearly so there is no doubt about what I mean)?
examples.zh: 这种行为必须停止。我讲清楚了吧？

examples.en: I hope I made it clear to him that he was no longer welcome here.
examples.zh: 我希望我已经给他讲清楚他在这里不再受欢迎。

senses.def: obvious and leaving no doubt at all

examples.en: This is a clear case of fraud.
examples.zh: 这无疑是一桩诈骗案。

examples.en: She won the election by a clear majority.
examples.zh: 她以明显的多数赢得选举。

examples.en: His height gives him a clear advantage.
examples.zh: 他的身高使他具有明显的优势。

examples.en: a clear warning of the risks
examples.zh: 明确的风险警告

examples.en: He left no clear indication of his wishes.
examples.zh: 他未曾明确流露出他的意愿。

examples.en: We must send a clear message to young people that cyberbullying will not be tolerated.
examples.zh: 我们必须向年轻人发出明确的信息：网络欺凌是不能容忍的。

examples.en: There is clear evidence that he was involved with the gang.
examples.zh: 有明确证据表明他与该团伙有牵连。

examples.en: They made their intentions abundantly clear.
examples.zh: 他们十分清楚地表明了他们的意图。

examples.en: It was quite clear to me that she was lying.
examples.zh: 我十分清楚她在撒谎。

examples.en: It is clear from the graph that sales have dropped sharply.
examples.zh: 这张图表清楚地显示了销量已经急剧下降。

examples.en: It is not clear what they want us to do.
examples.zh: 我们不清楚他们要我们做什么。

examples.en: How he got there was not clear.
examples.zh: 他是如何到达那里的还不清楚。

senses.def: not confused; having no doubt
senses.zh: 了解清楚的；没有疑问的

examples.en: Are you clear about the arrangements for tomorrow?
examples.zh: 你清楚明天的安排吗？

examples.en: My memory is not clear on that point.
examples.zh: 那一点我记不清了。

examples.en: I'm still not clear what the job involves.
examples.zh: 我仍然不明白这项工作包括哪些内容。

examples.en: We need a clear understanding of the problems involved.
examples.zh: 我们需要了解清楚所涉及的各种问题。

senses.def: thinking in a sensible and logical way, especially in a difficult situation
senses.zh: （尤指在困境中）思维敏锐而有逻辑的，头脑清醒的

examples.en: a clear thinker
examples.zh: 思路清晰的人

examples.en: You'll need to keep a clear head for your interview.
examples.zh: 面试时要保持清醒的头脑。

senses.def: easy to see or hear

examples.en: The photo wasn't very clear.
examples.zh: 这张照片不太清晰。

examples.en: The voice on the phone was clear and strong.
examples.zh: 电话上的声音清晰洪亮。

examples.en: She was in Australia but I could hear her voice as clear as a bell.
examples.zh: 她虽然在澳大利亚，但我却能非常清楚地听到她的声音。

examples.en: The image was crisp and clear.
examples.zh: 图像清晰。

examples.en: The colours in her paintings are very clear and bright.
examples.zh: 她画中的色彩非常清晰、明亮。

senses.group: easy to see/hear 容易看见／听到

senses.def: that you can see through; transparent

examples.en: The water was so clear we could see the bottom of the lake.
examples.zh: 湖水清澈见底。

examples.en: clear glass
examples.zh: 透明的玻璃

examples.en: a clear colourless liquid
examples.zh: 透明的无色液体

examples.en: a sheet of clear cellophane
examples.zh: 一张透明玻璃纸

senses.group: easy to see through 透明

senses.def: without cloud or mist

examples.en: a clear blue sky
examples.zh: 晴朗的碧空

examples.en: On a clear day you can see France.
examples.zh: 天气晴朗时你可以看见法国。

senses.def: without spots or marks

examples.en: clear skin
examples.zh: 没有丝毫斑点的皮肤

examples.en: a clear complexion
examples.zh: 无瑕的面庞

senses.def: bright and lively

examples.en: Her clear blue eyes sparkled.
examples.zh: 她清澈的蓝眼睛闪闪发亮。

senses.def: free from things that are blocking the way or covering the surface of something
senses.zh: 畅通无阻的；无障碍的；（表面）收拾干净的

examples.en: The road was clear ahead.
examples.zh: 前面的道路畅通无阻。

examples.en: All exits must be kept clear of baggage.
examples.zh: 所有出口必须保持通畅，不得堆放行李。

examples.en: You won't get a clear view of the stage from here.
examples.zh: 从这里看舞台，你的视野会受到遮挡。

examples.en: I always leave a clear desk at the end of the day.
examples.zh: 每天工作结束时，我总是把桌面收拾干净。

examples.en: Most roads are now clear of snow.
examples.zh: 大多数道路现在都没有积雪。

senses.def: if you have a clear
senses.zh: 无罪的；清白的；问心无愧的

senses.def: free from something that is unpleasant

examples.en: They were still not clear of all suspicion.
examples.zh: 他们仍未解除所有的嫌疑。

examples.en: We are finally clear of debt.
examples.zh: 我们终于偿清了债务。

senses.group: free from something bad 与坏事不沾边

senses.def: not touching something; a distance away from something

examples.en: The plane climbed until it was clear of the clouds.
examples.zh: 飞机爬升直至穿出了云层。

examples.en: Make sure you park your car clear of the entrance.
examples.zh: 切莫把车停在入口处。

senses.group: not touching/near 不接触；不靠近

senses.def: whole or complete

examples.en: Allow three clear days for the letter to arrive.
examples.zh: 信要整整三天才能寄到。

examples.en: You must give seven clear days’ notice of the meeting.
examples.zh: 你必须提前整整七天通知开会。

senses.group: period of time 一段时间

senses.def: that remains when taxes, costs, etc. have been taken away
senses.zh: （扣除税项、成本等后）净的，纯的

examples.en: They had made a clear profit of £2 000.
examples.zh: 他们已赚得 2 000 英镑的净利。

senses.def: produced with the central part of the tongue close to the top of the mouth. In many accents
to be simple and free from trouble
easy to see or understand
not clear at all; not easy to understand

examples.en: Oh well, that's all as clear as mud, then.
examples.zh: 哎呀，那么一来这真是成了一本糊涂账了。

senses.def: a complete difference or division between two people or groups

examples.en: Voters want to see clear blue water between the main parties.
examples.zh: 选民希望看到主要政党之间有清澈的蓝水。

examples.en: They failed to put clear blue water between themselves and their competitors.
examples.zh: 他们没能让自己和竞争对手形成明显区别。

senses.def: there is no danger of being seen or caught
senses.zh: 没有被发现（或抓住）的危险

examples.en: As soon as the coast was clear, he climbed in through the window.
examples.zh: 等到四下无人，他便从窗户爬了进去。

senses.def: to remain calm in a difficult situation

examples.en: She needed to keep a clear head if she was to remain in control.
examples.zh: 她要想继续控制局势就必须保持清醒的头脑。

senses.def: to enable somebody to be successful in a particular area of activity because other people or groups have given up competing with them
senses.zh: 为⋯的胜利铺平道路；为⋯的成功扫清障碍

examples.en: The complete disarray of the opposition parties leaves the field clear for the government to implement urgent reforms.
examples.zh: 反对党的彻底混乱为政府实施紧急改革留下了空间。

senses.def: in a way that is very easy to understand

examples.en: The message is coming through loud and clear.
examples.zh: 消息传达得清楚明白。

senses.def: to find that it is possible or convenient to do something
senses.zh: 觉得有可能做某事；认为便于做某事

examples.en: Small builders cannot see their way clear to take on many trainees.
examples.zh: 小建筑商认为不可能招收很多见习生。

senses.def: to remove things that are not wanted or needed from something
senses.zh: 移走，搬走，清除（不需要的东西）

examples.en: Developers cleared the land to build new homes there.
examples.zh: 开发商清理土地在那里建造新房。

examples.en: It was several hours before the road was cleared after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故过去几小时后这条道路才被疏通。

examples.en: It's your turn to clear the table (= to take away the dirty plates, etc. after a meal).
examples.zh: 该轮到你收拾餐桌了。

examples.en: They started clearing a path through the dense jungle.
examples.zh: 他们动手在茂密的丛林中开辟一条小路。

examples.en: The work of clearing the debris is in its final stages.
examples.zh: 清理碎片的工作进入最后阶段。

examples.en: She cleared a space on the sofa for him to sit down.
examples.zh: 她在沙发上清出一个空位让他坐下。

examples.en: I had cleared my desk before I left.
examples.zh: 离开前我清理干净了办公桌。

examples.en: I cleared my desk of papers.
examples.zh: 我清理好了写字台上的文件。

examples.en: The streets had been cleared of snow.
examples.zh: 街道上的积雪已被清除干净。

examples.en: Clear all those papers off the desk.
examples.zh: 把桌子上所有那些文件都拿走。

examples.en: The remains of the snow had been cleared from the streets.
examples.zh: 街道上的残雪已被清扫干净。

senses.group: remove something/somebody 移动某物；使某人离去

senses.def: to make people leave a place

examples.en: Security officials tried to clear the area, fearing more bomb attacks.
examples.zh: 由于担心再次发生炸弹袭击，安全官员试图清场。

examples.en: After the bomb warning, police cleared the streets.
examples.zh: 接到有炸弹的警告后，警察疏散了街上的行人。

senses.group: remove something/somebody 移动某物；使某人离去

senses.def: to move freely again; to no longer be blocked

examples.en: The traffic took a long time to clear after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故后很久交通才恢复畅通。

examples.en: The boy's lungs cleared and he began to breathe more easily.
examples.zh: 男孩的肺部恢复通畅后，呼吸开始比较轻松。

senses.group: not be blocked 不受阻碍

senses.def: when smoke, fog

examples.en: The mist will clear by mid-morning.
examples.zh: 雾将在上午十时左右消散。

examples.en: The fog was beginning to clear away.
examples.zh: 雾开始散去。

examples.en: As the dust cleared, we saw that the whole ceiling had come down.
examples.zh: 当灰尘散去后，我们看到整个天花板都塌下来了。

examples.en: As the smoke cleared, two fighter planes came into view.
examples.zh: 随着烟雾的消散，两架战斗机进入了视线。

senses.def: when the sky or the weather clears

examples.en: The next day the weather cleared.
examples.zh: 第二天天气放晴了。

examples.en: The sky cleared after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，天转晴了。

examples.en: The rain is clearing slowly.
examples.zh: 雨渐渐停下来。

examples.en: The clouds had not yet cleared.
examples.zh: 乌云尚未散去。

examples.en: Hopefully the storm would clear soon.
examples.zh: 希望暴风雨很快就会过去。

senses.def: when a liquid clears

examples.en: The muddy water slowly cleared.
examples.zh: 浑浊的水慢慢变得清澈起来。

senses.def: if your head or mind clears

examples.en: As her mind cleared, she remembered what had happened.
examples.zh: 头脑清醒之后，她想起了所发生的一切。

examples.en: I went for a walk to clear my head.
examples.zh: 我去散一会儿步，好清醒清醒头脑。

senses.def: if your face or expression clears

examples.en: His face suddenly cleared as understanding dawned.
examples.zh: 他逐渐明白过来，脸上霎时明朗起来。

senses.def: to prove that somebody is innocent

examples.en: She was cleared of all charges against her.
examples.zh: 对她的所有指控均已撤销。

examples.en: Throughout his years in prison, he fought to clear his name.
examples.zh: 在整个服刑期间，他奋力证明自己名誉的清白。

examples.en: He has finally been cleared of any wrongdoing.
examples.zh: 他终于被洗清了，没有任何不当行为。

senses.group: prove somebody innocent 证明无罪

senses.def: to give or get official approval for something to be done

examples.en: His appointment had been cleared by the board.
examples.zh: 他的任命已由董事会批准。

examples.en: I'll have to clear it with the manager.
examples.zh: 这事我须要获得经理的准许。

examples.en: I'll have to clear it with the manager before I can refund your money.
examples.zh: 我要得到经理批准之后才能退款给你。

senses.def: to give official permission for a person, a ship, a plane or goods to leave or enter a place
senses.zh: 批准（人、船只、飞机或货物）离境（或入境）；使通过（海关）

examples.en: The plane had been cleared for take-off.
examples.zh: 飞机已获准起飞。

examples.en: The goods had been cleared through customs.
examples.zh: 货物已通过海关清关。

senses.def: to decide officially, after finding out information about somebody, that they can be given special work or allowed to see secret papers
senses.zh: （经审查后）正式批准（某人）做机密工作（或阅读机密文件）

examples.en: She hasn't been cleared by security.
examples.zh: 她未获保安部门批准做机要工作。

senses.def: if a payment that is made into your bank account clears
senses.zh: （付款）到账；（银行）将（付款）划入账户

examples.en: Cheques usually take three working days to clear.
examples.zh: 兑现支票通常需要三个工作日。

senses.def: to gain or earn a sum of money as profit

examples.en: She cleared £1 000 on the deal.
examples.zh: 她在那笔交易中净赚 1 000 英镑。

senses.def: if you clear

examples.en: They sold $25 million in holdings in order to clear colossal bank debts.
examples.zh: 他们出售了 2500 万美元的股份，以偿还巨额银行债务。

examples.en: We are economizing for a few months to try to clear our overdraft.
examples.zh: 我们要过几个月节衣缩食的日子，努力还清透支。

senses.def: to jump over or get past something without touching it

examples.en: The horse cleared the fence easily.
examples.zh: 那匹马轻松地跃过了栅栏。

examples.en: The car only just cleared (= avoided hitting) the gatepost.
examples.zh: 那辆汽车通过时险些撞上门柱。

senses.def: if you clear
senses.zh: 将（球）击离己方球门区；（球）滚离己方球门区

senses.def: to help somebody have a fresh, lively state of mind again
senses.zh: 使头脑清醒；使振作精神

examples.en: A brisk walk should blow the cobwebs away.
examples.zh: 轻快的散步可以使人头脑清醒。

senses.def: to improve a difficult or tense
senses.zh: （通过沟通）改变困境，缓解紧张状态，改善气氛

examples.en: This meeting will be an opportunity to clear the air and start the healing process.
examples.zh: 这次会议将是一个缓和紧张、弥合分歧的机会。

senses.def: to make the air less dirty or less humid

examples.en: Storms were supposed to clear the air.
examples.zh: 按说暴风雨可以净化空气。

senses.def: to prepare for an activity, event, etc. by removing anything that is not essential to it
to cough
to remove things that are stopping the progress or movement of something

examples.en: The ruling could clear the way for extradition proceedings.
examples.zh: 这项裁决也许能为引渡程序铺平道路。

senses.def: away from something/somebody; not near or touching something/somebody

examples.en: Stand clear of the train doors.
examples.zh: 不要靠近列车门站立。

examples.en: He injured his arm as he jumped clear of the car.
examples.zh: 他跳离汽车时手臂受了伤。

examples.en: By lap two Walker was two metres clear of the rest of the runners.
examples.zh: 跑第二圈时，沃克已领先了其他赛跑者两米。

senses.group: not near/touching 不靠近；不触及

senses.def: all the way to something that is far away

examples.en: She could see clear down the highway into the town.
examples.zh: 她顺着公路一直望去，能看到远处的那座城镇。

senses.def: to avoid a person or thing because they may cause problems

examples.en: Steer clear of the centre of town at this time of the evening.
examples.zh: 晚上这个时段还是避开市中心吧。

senses.def: no longer in danger or thought to be guilty of something
senses.zh: 不再有危险；不再被认为有罪

examples.en: It seems that the original suspect is in the clear.
examples.zh: 好像原先的嫌疑犯已被认定无罪。

senses.def: to be simple and free from trouble
easy to see or understand
not clear at all; not easy to understand

examples.en: Oh well, that's all as clear as mud, then.
examples.zh: 哎呀，那么一来这真是成了一本糊涂账了。

items.idm: clear blue water (between A and B)

senses.def: a complete difference or division between two people or groups

examples.en: Voters want to see clear blue water between the main parties.
examples.zh: 选民希望看到主要政党之间有清澈的蓝水。

examples.en: They failed to put clear blue water between themselves and their competitors.
examples.zh: 他们没能让自己和竞争对手形成明显区别。

senses.def: there is no danger of being seen or caught
senses.zh: 没有被发现（或抓住）的危险

examples.en: As soon as the coast was clear, he climbed in through the window.
examples.zh: 等到四下无人，他便从窗户爬了进去。

items.idm: keep your head | keep a clear/cool head

senses.def: to remain calm in a difficult situation

examples.en: She needed to keep a clear head if she was to remain in control.
examples.zh: 她要想继续控制局势就必须保持清醒的头脑。

items.idm: leave the field clear for somebody

senses.def: to enable somebody to be successful in a particular area of activity because other people or groups have given up competing with them
senses.zh: 为⋯的胜利铺平道路；为⋯的成功扫清障碍

examples.en: The complete disarray of the opposition parties leaves the field clear for the government to implement urgent reforms.
examples.zh: 反对党的彻底混乱为政府实施紧急改革留下了空间。

senses.def: in a way that is very easy to understand

examples.en: The message is coming through loud and clear.
examples.zh: 消息传达得清楚明白。

items.idm: see your way (clear) to doing something/to do something

senses.def: to find that it is possible or convenient to do something
senses.zh: 觉得有可能做某事；认为便于做某事

examples.zh: 他们不够聪明，找不到密码。

examples.en: He's always been clever at crosswords.
examples.zh: 他在填字游戏方面一向很聪明。

examples.zh: 妙计

examples.en: What a clever idea!
examples.zh: 多么精明的主意！

examples.en: That wasn't very clever (= what you just did wasn't sensible), was it?

examples.zh: 聪明的营销

examples.en: Admitting her mistake may have been quite a clever move on her part.
examples.zh: 承认自己的错误对她来说可能是一个相当聪明的举动。

examples.en: It was clever of him to have spotted the mistake.
examples.zh: 他发现了错误，真是聪明。

examples.en: How clever of you to work it out!
examples.zh: 你解决了这个问题真是太聪明了！

examples.en: 'Young people think it's clever to do that sort of thing, and it isn't,' she said.
examples.zh: 她说:“年轻人认为这样做很聪明，其实不然。”

examples.zh: 让他认为这是他的主意，你真是太聪明了。

examples.zh: 苏西意识到她必须施点手腕，让亚当以为自己信任他。

examples.zh: 我并不自称是专家，我当然也不想成为一个聪明的家伙。

examples.zh: 咖啡馆的布局设计巧妙，给人一种空间感，又不失一定的舒适感。

examples.zh: 大脑的大小和聪明程度并不相辅相成。

examples.zh: 她又重复了“与人说愁愁减半”的陈词滥调。

examples.zh: 说布拉格是欧洲最美丽的城市已经成为陈词滥调。

senses.def: to choose a particular function or item on a computer screen, etc., by pressing one of the buttons on a mouse or touchpad
senses.zh: （用鼠标或在触摸板上）点击，单击

examples.en: Click here to add your opinion to the survey.
examples.zh: 单击此处添加调查意见。

examples.en: Click the OK button to start.
examples.zh: 单击 OK 按钮启动。

examples.en: Just click the link below.
examples.zh: 只需点击下面的链接即可。

examples.zh: 我单击链接进入网站的下一页。

examples.en: Click for more images.
examples.zh: 点击查看更多图片。

senses.zh: （使）发出咔哒声，咔哒（或咔嚓）响

examples.en: The cameras clicked away.
examples.zh: 照相机咔嚓咔嚓地不停拍照。

examples.en: The bolt clicked into place.
examples.zh: 门闩咔哒一声插上了。

examples.en: The door clicked shut.
examples.zh: 门咔哒一声关上了。

examples.en: He clicked his fingers at the waiter.
examples.zh: 他冲服务员打了个响指。

examples.en: Polly clicked her tongue in annoyance.
examples.zh: 波莉气得直咂嘴。

examples.en: The corporal clicked his heels.
examples.zh: 下士的脚后跟发出咔哒声。

examples.en: The police officer clicked a pair of handcuffs around his wrists.
examples.zh: 警察将手铐戴在了他的手腕上。

senses.def: to suddenly become clear or understood

examples.en: Suddenly it clicked—we'd been talking about different people.
examples.zh: 我们突然领悟到原来我们谈论的不是同一个人。

examples.zh: 一切都豁然开朗。

examples.zh: 拼图的碎片突然拼凑在一起。

examples.zh: 我们在聚会上相识，一见如故。

examples.zh: 他从未真正受到过他的学生的欢迎。

examples.zh: 代表客户行事是我们的职责。

examples.zh: 我们将为客户提供解决问题的最佳方法。

senses.def: a situation in a story, film, competition, etc. that is very exciting because you cannot guess what will happen next, or you do not find out immediately what happens next

examples.en: The first episode ended with a real cliffhanger.
examples.zh: 第一集以真正的悬念结束。

examples.en: Tonight’s vote in the House of Commons threatens to be a cliffhanger.
examples.zh: 今晚下议院的投票可能会成为悬念。

senses.def: connected with a situation in a story, film, competition, etc. that is very exciting because you cannot guess what will happen next, or you do not find out immediately what happens next
senses.zh: （故事、电影、竞赛等扣人心弦的）悬念

senses.def: a first name for boys
the area of land at the top of a cliff
very exciting, most important
senses.zh: 非常激动人心的；高潮的；最重要的

examples.en: The play builds up to a final climactic scene between father and daughter.
examples.zh: 该剧将父女之间的最后一幕推向高潮。

senses.def: the regular pattern of weather conditions of a particular place

examples.en: a tropical/warm/mild/temperate/cold climate
examples.zh: 热带／温暖／温和／温带／寒冷气候

examples.en: the harsh climate of the Arctic regions
examples.zh: 北极地区的恶劣气候

senses.def: an area with particular weather conditions

examples.en: They wanted to move to a warmer climate.
examples.zh: 他们想迁移到气候较温暖的地区。

examples.en: Little grows in such a dry climate.
examples.zh: 在这种干旱的气候下很难有东西生长。

senses.def: a general attitude or feeling; an atmosphere or a situation that exists in a particular place
senses.zh: 倾向；思潮；风气；环境气氛

examples.en: the present political/economic climate
examples.zh: 当前的政治／经济气候

examples.en: the current climate of opinion (= what people generally are thinking about a particular issue)
examples.zh: 目前的舆论倾向

examples.en: a climate of fear/suspicion/uncertainty
examples.zh: 恐慌／怀疑／不确定的氛围

examples.en: Finding affordable rental accommodation is not easy in the current climate.
examples.zh: 在当前的环境下，找到负担得起的出租房并不容易。

examples.zh: 我们需要创造一个有利于商业繁荣的环境。

senses.def: the act of doing something to reduce or stop climate change
senses.zh: 气候行动（旨在应对气候变化，保护环境）

examples.zh: 要求采取全球气候行动，减少排放的呼声再次高涨。

examples.en: A growing number of people believe that further climate actions must be taken.
examples.zh: 越来越多的人认为，必须采取进一步的气候行动。

examples.zh: 全球气候变化的威胁

examples.en: These policies are designed to combat the effects of climate change.
examples.zh: 这些政策旨在应对气候变化的影响。

senses.def: the fact of refusing to accept that climate change

examples.zh: 否认气候变化和推动使用化石燃料削弱了世界遏制全球变暖的能力。

senses.zh: （室内或车内的）温度湿度控制系统

examples.zh: 所有这些汽车都标配有空调或气候控制系统。

senses.def: having a system that cools and dries the air inside it and maintains a steady temperature
senses.zh: 气候控制的：具有冷却和干燥内部空气并保持稳定温度的系统

examples.zh: 动物被饲养在气候受控的环境中。

senses.zh: 气候紧急状态（指需要采取紧急行动来缓解或遏制气候变化，防止对环境造成严重和永久性破坏）

examples.en: Momentum is growing around the world for governments to take urgent action to tackle the climate crisis.
examples.zh: 世界各国政府采取紧急措施应对气候危机的声势越来越强。

examples.zh: 该事件让人们了解了主要污染者否定气候变化的策略。

senses.def: a situation in which immediate action is needed to reduce or stop climate change

examples.en: Halifax became the second Canadian city to declare a climate emergency.

examples.zh: 全球数百万人参加了周五的气候罢工罢课。

the most exciting or important event or point in time
senses.zh: （重要事情或时刻的）高潮，极点，顶点

examples.en: to come to/reach a climax
examples.zh: 达到极点

examples.en: Signing the peace agreement was the climax of his political career.
examples.zh: 和平协议的签署是他政治生涯的顶峰。

examples.en: The team’s 3–1 victory in the final provided a fitting climax to a great season.
examples.zh: 该队在决赛中3:1获胜恰如其分地将这一重要赛季推向高潮。

senses.def: the most exciting part of a play, piece of music, etc. that usually happens near the end
senses.zh: （戏剧、音乐等通常接近结束时出现的）高潮

examples.en: The book’s powerful climax is the murder of Nancy by her lover Bill Sikes.
examples.zh: 这本书的高潮是南希被她的情人比尔·赛克斯谋杀。

senses.def: the highest point of sexual pleasure

examples.en: She found it hard to achieve a/reach climax.
examples.zh: 她感觉很难达到性高潮。

senses.def: to come to or form the best, most exciting, or most important point in something
senses.zh: 达成（或形成）极点（或顶点、高潮）

examples.en: The festival will climax on Sunday with a gala concert.
examples.zh: 星期天的音乐盛会将把这次会演推向高潮。

examples.en: The sensational verdict climaxed a six-month trial.
examples.zh: 那项引起轰动的裁决使长达六个月的审判达到了高潮。

examples.zh: 爬山；爬树

examples.zh: 她爬上了楼梯。

examples.en: to climb a ladder/wall

examples.zh: 他们爬上台阶来到前门。

examples.zh: 汽车缓慢地爬上了山坡。

examples.zh: 登船队伍开始爬上船舷。

examples.zh: 他爬上去检查屋顶的损坏情况。

examples.zh: 在多数周末他都喜欢去登山。

examples.zh: 他每年夏天都去爬山。

examples.zh: 我从窗口爬过去。

examples.en: She opened the passenger door and climbed in.
examples.zh: 她打开客舱门爬了进去。

examples.en: The boys climbed over the wall.
examples.zh: 那些男孩翻过了那堵墙。

examples.en: Sue climbed into bed.
examples.zh: 休吃力地爬上床。

examples.en: Can you climb down?
examples.zh: 你能爬下去吗？

examples.zh: 他把坟墓挖完了，就爬了出来。

senses.def: to increase in value or amount

examples.zh: 毁灭性洪水造成的死亡人数继续攀升。

examples.en: Interest rates climbed to 8 per cent.
examples.zh: 利率攀升至 8%。

examples.en: The temperature had climbed above 30 degrees.
examples.zh: 气温已经升至30度以上。

examples.en: Prices have climbed sharply in recent months.
examples.zh: 最近几个月价格急剧上涨。

examples.en: The dollar has been climbing all week.
examples.zh: 整个星期美元一直在升值。

examples.en: Membership is climbing steadily.
examples.zh: 会员数目稳步攀升。

senses.zh: （在排行榜、社会或组织中）上升，爬升，晋升

examples.en: The team has now climbed to fourth in the league.
examples.zh: 这支队现已上升到联赛的第四名。

examples.en: In a few years he had climbed to the top of his profession.
examples.zh: 他在几年内攀上了职业的巅峰。

examples.en: The song also climbed the charts in North America.
examples.zh: 这首歌在北美排行榜上也有上升。

examples.en: to climb the corporate/career ladder

examples.zh: 飞机爬升到 33 000 英尺。

examples.zh: 太阳升高了。

examples.en: The plane took off and climbed to 20 000 feet.
examples.zh: 飞机起飞后爬升到 2 万英尺。

senses.def: to slope upwards

examples.en: From here the path climbs steeply to the summit.
examples.zh: 这条小路从这里突然变陡，直上山顶。

examples.zh: 爬到顶峰需要一小时。

examples.zh: 经过一段陡峭的攀登，我们到达了一个高原。

examples.zh: 我们开始爬山。

senses.def: a mountain or rock which people climb up for sport

examples.zh: “巨人墙”是这座山最难攀登的一段山岩。

senses.def: an increase in value or amount

senses.def: progress to a higher status, standard or position

senses.def: to join others in doing something that is becoming fashionable because you hope to become popular or successful yourself

examples.en: politicians eager to jump on the environmental bandwagon
examples.zh: 急于随大溜加入环保行列的政客们

senses.zh: 认错；（争论中）改变立场，让步

examples.en: The chancellor was forced into a humiliating climbdown on his economic policies.
examples.zh: 财政大臣被迫狼狈地承认他的经济政策存在失误。

senses.def: a person who climbs (especially mountains) or an animal that climbs
senses.zh: 攀登者；登山者；攀爬的动物

examples.zh: 登山者和山地徒步旅行者

examples.zh: 猴子的攀缘能力很强。

senses.zh: （室内供练习用的）攀登墙，攀岩墙

senses.zh: （具有某种气候的）地区，地带；气候带

examples.en: I'm heading for sunnier climes next month.
examples.zh: 我下个月要去阳光比较明媚的地区。

senses.def: to succeed in achieving or winning something

examples.en: to clinch an argument/a deal/a victory
examples.zh: 赢得辩论；成交；赢得胜利

examples.en: They clinched a place in the semi-finals.
examples.zh: 他们进入了半决赛。

senses.def: to provide the answer to something; to settle something that was not certain
senses.zh: 提供解决办法；解决；确定

examples.en: These findings clinched the matter.
examples.zh: 这些调研结果解答了这个问题。

examples.en: ‘I'll pay your airfare.’ ‘OK, that clinches it—I'll come with you.’
examples.zh: “我会帮你付飞机票。”“好，就这么说定，我跟你一起去。”

examples.en: a clinching argument
examples.zh: 让人折服的论证

senses.def: a position in which two people hold each other tightly and with passion
a position in a fight in which two opponents hold each other tightly
a fact, a remark or an event that settles an argument, a decision or a competition
senses.zh: 起决定性作用的事实（或话语、事情）

examples.en: There was a lot of circumstantial evidence but they still needed a clincher, something cast iron that would carry a conviction.
examples.zh: 有很多间接证据，但他们仍然需要一个铁证，一个可以让人定罪的铸铁铁证。

examples.en: Mead scored the clincher (= the winning goal) after 81 minutes.
examples.zh: 81 分钟后，米德打进了决定性的进球（=制胜一球）。

examples.zh: 分数被分类为沿着从负到正的曲线的点。

senses.def: to hold on tightly to somebody/something

examples.en: survivors clinging to a raft
examples.zh: 紧紧抓住救生筏的幸存者

examples.en: Leaves still clung to the branches.
examples.zh: 叶子依然紧附在树枝上。

examples.en: She clung on to her baby.
examples.zh: 她紧紧抱住她的婴儿。

examples.zh: 紧紧抓住！

examples.zh: 他们紧紧地抱在一起，冷得直发抖。

examples.zh: 紧身连衣裙

examples.zh: 湿衬衫紧贴在他的胸部。

examples.en: The smell of smoke still clung to her clothes.
examples.zh: 烟味仍附着在她的衣服上不散。

examples.en: Her hair clung to her hot damp skin.
examples.zh: 她的头发紧贴着湿热的皮肤。

examples.en: After her mother's death, Sara clung to her aunt more than ever.
examples.zh: 萨拉在母亲去世后比以往任何时候都更依附于她的姨妈。

synonyms.words: hold on ▪ cling ▪ clutch ▪ grip ▪ grasp ▪ clasp ▪ hang on

intro.en: These words all mean to have somebody/​something in your hands or arms.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示抓住、抱住。

items.def: to have somebody/​something in your hand or arms:
items.zh: 指抓住、抱住、托住、夹住

examples.en: She was holding a large box.
examples.zh: 她提着一只大箱子。

items.def: to continue to hold somebody/​something; to put your hand on somebody/​something and not take your hand away:
items.zh: 指抓紧、不放开

examples.en: Hold on and don’t let go until I say so.
examples.zh: 握紧，我让你松手时才松开。

items.def: to hold on to somebody/​something tightly, especially with your whole body:
items.zh: 尤指用身体紧抱、紧握、抓紧

examples.en: Survivors clung to pieces of floating debris.
examples.zh: 生还者紧紧抱住漂浮在水面上的残骸。

items.zh: 尤指用手抓紧、紧握、抱紧、突然抓住

examples.en: She stood there, the flowers still clutched in her hand.
examples.zh: 她站在那里，手里仍然紧握着花束。

items.zh: 指用手紧握、紧抓

examples.en: Grip the rope as tightly as you can.
examples.zh: 尽可能紧紧抓住绳子。

items.def: to take a strong hold of somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指抓紧、抓牢

examples.en: He grasped my hand and shook it warmly.
examples.zh: 他热情地抓着我的手握了起来。

items.def: (formal) to hold somebody/​something tightly in your hand or in your arms:
items.zh: 指紧握、攥紧、抱紧

examples.en: They clasped hands (= held each other’s hands).
examples.zh: 他们相互紧握着对方的手。

items.def: to hold on to something very tightly, especially in order to support yourself or stop yourself from falling:
items.zh: 尤指为支撑自己或防止跌倒而紧紧抓住某物

examples.zh: 抓紧，我们出发了！

senses.def: a thin clear plastic material that sticks to a surface and to itself, used especially for wrapping food
senses.zh: （尤指包装食物的）塑料保鲜膜，透明薄膜

senses.def: to be unwilling to lose something or stop doing something

examples.en: Throughout the trial she had clung to the belief that he was innocent.
examples.zh: 在整个审判中，她都坚信他是清白的。

examples.en: He had one last hope to cling on to.
examples.zh: 他还抱着最后的一线希望。

examples.en: She managed to cling on to life for another couple of years.
examples.zh: 她顽强地又活了几年。

examples.zh: 他在医院的眼科接受了治疗。

examples.zh: 两周后，患者返回门诊。

examples.zh: 他正在伦敦一家私人诊所接受治疗。

examples.zh: 他无动于衷地看着她受苦。

examples.zh: 你怎么能对你儿子的事故这么冷漠？

examples.zh: 托儿所里的一切都是白色的、临床的，墙上没有任何照片。

examples.zh: 临床死亡的（从身体的状况判断为死亡）

senses.zh: 冷淡的；无动于衷的；无同情心的

examples.zh: 她几乎是冷静地报告了这些事实，就好像在谈论别人一样。

examples.zh: 叮当响的硬币

examples.zh: 硬币叮当作响地落入了机器的投币口。

examples.zh: 她听到说话声和玻璃杯相碰的声音。

examples.zh: 自行车上的踏脚夹套

examples.zh: 土地价格将稳步上涨。

examples.zh: 他把麦克风别在衣领上。

examples.zh: 把这些散页夹在一起。

examples.zh: 那些耳环是夹戴的吗？

examples.zh: 修剪树篱

examples.zh: 他剪掉了一段金属线。

examples.zh: 汽车转弯时撞上了马路牙子。

examples.zh: 她把球斜推入网。

senses.zh: 好像一模一样的人；复制品；仿造品；翻版

examples.en: Caroline’s brothers grinned alongside her, clones of their father.
examples.zh: 卡罗琳的兄弟们在她身边微笑，他们都是父亲的克隆人。

senses.def: a computer that is a copy of another more expensive model
senses.zh: 克隆（计算）机；仿制（计算）机

examples.en: Once they found that the PC clones were just as good, companies saved a lot.
examples.zh: 一旦他们发现克隆电脑一样好用，公司就省了很多钱。

senses.def: to produce an exact copy of an animal or a plant from its cells
senses.zh: 以无性繁殖技术复制；克隆

examples.en: A team from the UK were the first to successfully clone an animal.
examples.zh: 英国的一个小组率先克隆动物成功。

examples.en: Dolly, the cloned sheep
examples.zh: 克隆羊多利

senses.def: to illegally make an electronic copy of stored information from a person’s credit card or mobile phone so that you can make payments or phone calls but the owner of the card or phone receives the bill
senses.zh: 非法复制，克隆（复制他人信用卡或手机的存储信息，从而使卡主或机主付费）

senses.def: a short loud sound of heavy things hitting each other
to hit each other making a short loud sound
to put something into a position so that it covers an opening; to get into this position

examples.en: He closed the door firmly.
examples.zh: 他把门关严。

examples.en: Would anyone mind if I closed the window?
examples.zh: 我关上窗户会有人介意吗？

examples.en: She closed the gate behind her.
examples.zh: 她关上了身后的大门。

examples.en: It's dark now—let's close the curtains.
examples.zh: 天黑了，咱们拉上窗帘吧。

examples.en: I closed my eyes against the bright light.
examples.zh: 我闭上眼睛以防强光的照射。

examples.en: The doors open and close automatically.
examples.zh: 这些门自动开关。

senses.def: to move the parts of something together so that it is no longer open

examples.en: to close a book/an umbrella
examples.zh: 合上书；收起伞

examples.en: He ate greedily, without closing his mouth.
examples.zh: 他狼吞虎咽，连嘴都合不上。

senses.def: to make the work of a shop, etc. stop for a period of time; to not be open for people to use
senses.zh: （使）关门，关闭（一段时间）；不开放

examples.en: The school was closed because of the heavy snow.
examples.zh: 学校因大雪而关闭。

examples.en: The museum has been closed for renovation.
examples.zh: 博物馆已闭馆整修。

examples.en: The road was closed to traffic for two days.
examples.zh: 这条路封闭了两天。

examples.en: The castle has been closed to visitors because of the royal wedding.
examples.zh: 由于皇室婚礼，城堡已不对游客开放。

examples.en: What time does the bank close?
examples.zh: 那家银行什么时候关门？

examples.en: We close for lunch between twelve and two.
examples.zh: 十二点至两点是我们的午餐打烊时间。

senses.group: shop/store/business, etc. 店铺、商店、公司等

senses.def: if a company, shop, etc. closes

examples.en: The hospital closed at the end of last year.
examples.zh: 这所医院去年年底关闭。

examples.en: The play closed after just three nights.
examples.zh: 这部剧仅上演了三个晚上就停演了。

examples.en: The club was closed by the police.
examples.zh: 那家夜总会被警察查封了。

examples.en: All the steelworks around here were closed down in the 1980s.
examples.zh: 这一带的所有钢铁厂都在 20 世纪 80 年代关闭了。

senses.group: shop/store/business, etc. 店铺、商店、公司等

senses.def: to end or make something end

examples.en: The meeting will close at 10.00 p.m.
examples.zh: 会议将在晚上 10 点结束。

examples.en: The offer closes at the end of the week.
examples.zh: 优惠将在本周末截止。

examples.en: I will close with a few words about future events.
examples.zh: 最后我会讲一讲将来的活动。

examples.en: to close a meeting/debate
examples.zh: 结束会议╱辩论

examples.en: to close a case/an investigation
examples.zh: 结案；结束调查

examples.en: to close an account (= to stop keeping money in a bank account)
examples.zh: 注销账户

examples.en: The subject is now closed (= we will not discuss it again).
examples.zh: 这个话题的讨论现在已告结束。

senses.def: to arrange and settle a business deal

examples.en: Right now we are trying to close the deal with our sponsors.
examples.zh: 现在我们正试图与赞助商达成协议。

senses.def: to put an end to a mistake in something that causes a security risk or gives somebody an unfair advantage

examples.en: The company acted quickly to close a security hole in its online systems.
examples.zh: 该公司迅速采取行动，堵住了其在线系统中的安全漏洞。

examples.en: Congressional leaders have agreed to close a loophole that gave small businesses a big tax break for buying SUVs.
examples.zh: 国会领导人已经同意堵上漏洞，小企业购买运动型多功能车将无法获大幅减税。

senses.def: to stop using a computer program or file and put it away

examples.en: Once I got a few apps closed, it started working again.
examples.zh: 我一关闭几个应用程序，它就又开始运转了。

senses.def: to be worth a particular amount at the end of the day’s business

examples.en: Shares in the company closed at 265p.
examples.zh: 这家公司的股票收盘价为 265 便士。

examples.en: closing prices
examples.zh: 收盘价

senses.def: to make the distance or difference between two people or things smaller; to become smaller or narrower

examples.en: These measures are aimed at closing the gap between rich and poor.
examples.zh: 这些措施旨在缩小贫富差距。

examples.en: The gap between the two top teams is closing all the time.
examples.zh: 两支顶尖球队的差距一直在缩小。

senses.def: to cover somebody/something and hold them/it, or to make something do this

examples.en: She closed her hand over his.
examples.zh: 她牢牢抓住他的手不放。

examples.en: Her hand closed over his.
examples.zh: 她牢牢抓住他的手不放。

senses.def: to make an electrical circuit

examples.en: When a finger touches the panel, it closes the circuit.
examples.zh: 当手指触摸面板时，电路就会闭合。

senses.def: to stop doing something because you no longer believe you will be successful or will find a solution
senses.zh: （因相信不会成功或没有结论而）放弃

examples.en: The police have closed the book on the case (= they have stopped trying to solve it).
examples.zh: 警方已经放弃侦破此案。

senses.def: to make it unlikely that something will happen
senses.zh: 使不可能；拒⋯于门外；把⋯的门堵死

examples.en: She was careful not to close the door on the possibility of further talks.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼不让进一步谈判的大门关上。

senses.def: to stop trading

examples.en: The factory closed its doors for the last time in 2009.
examples.zh: 这家工厂最后于 2009 年关闭。

examples.en: The company closed shop and left the US last year.
examples.zh: 该公司去年关闭了商店并离开了美国。

senses.def: to refuse to think about something as a possibility
senses.zh: 对⋯拒不考虑（或置之不理、置若罔闻）

senses.def: if a group of people close ranks
senses.zh: （尤指受到批评时）抱团，携手合作

examples.en: It's not unusual for the police to close ranks when one of their officers is being investigated.
examples.zh: 在一位警员受到调查时，警察抱团的事并不罕见。

senses.def: if soldiers close ranks
to refuse to listen to something

examples.en: She decided to shut her ears to all the rumours.
examples.zh: 她拿定主意对所有的谣言置之不理。

senses.def: to pretend that you have not noticed something so that you do not have to deal with it
senses.zh: （对⋯）视而不见，熟视无睹，置若罔闻

examples.en: You can't just close your eyes to his violence.
examples.zh: 你不能对他的暴力行为视而不见。

examples.en: They seem intent on shutting their eyes to the problems of pollution.
examples.zh: 他们似乎一心要对污染问题视而不见。

senses.def: very easily, without thinking about it
senses.zh: 闭着眼都能做；轻而易举

examples.en: I've made this trip so often, I could do it with my eyes shut.
examples.zh: 我经常走这条路，闭着眼睛都能找到。

senses.def: the end of a period of time or an activity
senses.zh: （一段时间或活动的）结束，终结，终了

examples.en: at the close of the seventeenth century
examples.zh: 在 17 世纪末

examples.en: His life was drawing to a close.
examples.zh: 他的生命正走向终点。

examples.en: Can we bring this meeting to a close?
examples.zh: 我们可以结束会议了吗？

examples.en: This chapter of her life had come to a close.
examples.zh: 她人生的这一章结束了。

examples.en: By the close of London trading, Wall Street was up 9.78 points.
examples.zh: 到伦敦交易收盘时，华尔街指数上涨了 9.78 点。

examples.en: The West Indies were 98 for 3 at the close of play (= at the end of the day’s play in a cricket match).
examples.zh: 比赛结束时，西印度群岛队 3 球 98 分（= 一场板球比赛结束时）。

senses.def: the fact of something shutting, especially a door

examples.en: The door swung to a close.
examples.zh: 门关上了。

senses.def: a street that is closed at one end
senses.zh: 一端不通的街道；死胡同；死巷道

examples.en: Brookside Close
examples.zh: 布鲁克赛德巷

senses.def: the grounds and buildings that surround and belong to a cathedral
senses.zh: 大教堂所属的周围场地及建筑物

senses.def: near in space or time

examples.en: I had no idea the beach was so close.
examples.zh: 我不知道海滩会这么近。

examples.en: Our new house is close to the school.
examples.zh: 我们的新房子离学校很近。

examples.en: The children are close to each other in age.
examples.zh: 这些儿童彼此的年龄很接近。

examples.en: She is looking for a job closer to home.
examples.zh: 她正在找一个离家近点儿的工作。

examples.en: The tables were too close together.
examples.zh: 桌子靠得太近了。

examples.en: Their birthdays are very close together.
examples.zh: 他们的生日挨得很近。

examples.en: This is the closest we can get to the beach by car.
examples.zh: 开车去海滩到了这儿就再也不能往前走了。

examples.en: We all have to work in close proximity (= near each other).
examples.zh: 我们都不得不紧挨在一起工作。

examples.en: Victory was tantalizingly close.
examples.zh: 胜利近在咫尺，令人憧憬。

senses.def: knowing somebody very well and liking them very much

examples.en: Jo is a very close friend.
examples.zh: 乔是一个很亲密的朋友。

examples.en: She is very close to her father.
examples.zh: 她和父亲的关系很亲密。

examples.en: She and her father are very close.
examples.zh: 她和父亲的关系很亲密。

examples.en: We're a very close family.
examples.zh: 我们全家彼此亲密无间。

senses.def: near in family relationship

examples.en: close relatives, such as your mother and father, and brothers and sisters
examples.zh: 近亲，如父母和兄弟姊妹

examples.en: The groom and his close family took their places.
examples.zh: 新郎和他的近亲就位。

senses.def: very involved in the work or activities of somebody else, usually seeing and talking to them regularly
senses.zh: （与某人的工作或活动）紧密相关的，密切的

examples.en: She has kept in close contact with the victims' families.
examples.zh: 她与受害者的家人一直保持着密切的联系。

examples.en: They have forged a close working relationship.
examples.zh: 他们建立了密切的工作关系。

examples.en: a retired army general with close ties to the military
examples.zh: 与军方关系密切的退伍陆军上将

examples.en: The college has close links with many other institutions.
examples.zh: 这所学院与其他许多的机构有着紧密的联系。

examples.en: We work in close association with the ministry.
examples.zh: 我们与该部密切合作。

examples.en: Their survival depends on close cooperation.
examples.zh: 他们的生存取决于密切合作。

examples.en: Even their closest allies were shocked by the move.
examples.zh: 即使是他们最亲密的盟友也对这一举动感到震惊。

examples.en: He is one of the prime minister's closest advisers.
examples.zh: 他是首相最亲信的顾问之一。

examples.en: We are in close touch with the police.
examples.zh: 我们与警方保持密切联系。

senses.def: careful and complete

examples.en: Take a close look at this photograph.
examples.zh: 仔细看看这张照片。

examples.en: On closer examination, the painting proved to be a fake.
examples.zh: 经过更加仔细的查看，那幅画被证实是件赝品。

examples.en: A close inspection reveals stunning attention to detail.
examples.zh: 仔细检查可以发现对细节的惊人关注。

examples.en: Pay close attention to what I am telling you.
examples.zh: 要认真听我给你讲的话。

senses.def: almost in a particular state; likely to do something soon
senses.zh: 几乎（处于某种状态）；可能（快要做某事）

examples.en: The airline is close to collapse.
examples.zh: 这家航空公司濒临倒闭。

examples.en: He was close to tears.
examples.zh: 他几乎掉眼泪了。

examples.en: The species is dangerously close to extinction.
examples.zh: 这个物种几近灭绝。

examples.en: The new library is close to completion.
examples.zh: 新图书馆快要竣工了。

examples.en: She knew she was close to death.
examples.zh: 她知道自己将不久于人世。

examples.en: We are close to signing the agreement.
examples.zh: 我们可能很快要签订协议。

senses.def: very similar to something else or to an amount

examples.en: There's a close resemblance between them (= they look very similar).
examples.zh: 两者外表酷似。

examples.en: This movie is about as close to perfect as you could wish for.
examples.zh: 这部电影几近完美。

examples.en: Their chances of winning are close to zero.
examples.zh: 他们获胜的机会几乎为零。

examples.en: His feeling for her was close to hatred.
examples.zh: 他对她的感情近乎仇恨。

examples.en: The total was close to 20% of the workforce.
examples.zh: 总数接近劳动力的 20%。

examples.en: It was the closest thing to a home she had ever known.
examples.zh: 这是她所知道的最像家的地方。

examples.en: We tried to match the colours, but this is the closest we could get.
examples.zh: 我们尽量使颜色搭配协调，但最好也只能做到这样了。

senses.def: won by only a small amount or distance
senses.zh: 实力相差无几的；仅以些微之差获胜的

examples.en: a close match/contest/election
examples.zh: 旗鼓相当的比赛／竞赛／选举

examples.en: It was pretty close but we lost.
examples.zh: 双方实力相当，但我们输了。

examples.en: Our team came a close second (= nearly won).
examples.zh: 我们队以微弱差距屈居第二。

examples.en: No one expected such a close finish.
examples.zh: 没人料到比赛结果如此难分高下。

examples.en: The game was closer than the score suggests.
examples.zh: 双方实力比得分所显示的要更接近。

examples.en: The result is going to be too close to call (= either side may win).
examples.zh: 双方实力非常接近，因此结果无法预料。

senses.def: used to describe something, usually a dangerous or unpleasant situation, that nearly happens
senses.zh: （通常指危险或不愉快的情况几乎发生）差一点儿，险些

examples.en: Phew! That was close—that car nearly hit us.
examples.zh: 啊！好险！那辆车差点儿撞上我们。

examples.en: We caught the bus in the end but it was close (= we nearly missed it).
examples.zh: 虽然我们最后总算赶上了那趟公共汽车，但也是够悬的。

senses.group: almost bad result 近乎于不好的结果

senses.def: with little or no space in between
senses.zh: 空隙极小的；无空隙的；密集的；紧凑的

examples.en: over 1 000 pages of close print
examples.zh: 1 000 多页字体密集的印刷品

examples.en: The soldiers advanced in close formation.
examples.zh: 士兵排着密集的队形前进。

senses.def: cut very short, near to the skin
senses.zh: 剪到齐根的；剪得很短的

examples.en: a close haircut/shave
examples.zh: 剪到齐根的头发；刮剃干净

senses.def: carefully guarded
senses.zh: 严加戒备的；守卫严密的

examples.en: The donor's identity is a close secret.
examples.zh: 捐赠人的身份是保密的。

examples.en: She was kept under close arrest.
examples.zh: 她被严密监禁。

senses.def: warm in an uncomfortable way because there does not seem to be enough fresh air

examples.en: It’s very close today—I think there’s going to be a storm.
examples.zh: 今天已经很近了——我想将会有一场暴风雨。

senses.def: not willing to give personal information about yourself
senses.zh: （对自己的个人信息）守口如瓶

examples.en: He was close about his past.
examples.zh: 他对他的过去守口如瓶。

senses.def: not liking to spend money

examples.en: She's always been very close with her money.
examples.zh: 她用钱总是很吝啬。

senses.def: produced with part of the tongue in the highest possible position without limiting the flow of air
very near

examples.en: fighting at close quarters
examples.zh: 近距离作战

senses.def: from only a short distance away

examples.en: The president was shot at close range.
examples.zh: 总统遭到近距离枪击。

examples.en: She scored from close range.
examples.zh: 她近距离得分。

senses.def: close to you in time or distance

examples.en: Help was at hand.
examples.zh: 援助近在咫尺。

examples.en: The property is ideally located with all local amenities close at hand.
examples.zh: 这处房地产的位置很理想，离当地的生活设施都近。

senses.def: used to tell somebody that their attempt or guess was almost but not quite successful
senses.zh: 很接近，但还是输了；猜得差不多，但不完全对

senses.def: a situation in which you only just manage to avoid an accident, etc.
senses.zh: 侥幸避免事故；侥幸脱险；幸免于难

examples.en: He had a close shave when his brakes failed on the mountain road.
examples.zh: 当他在山路上刹车失灵时，他差点就死了。

senses.def: a situation in which success or failure is equally possible

examples.en: We got him out in the end, but it was a close thing.
examples.zh: 我们最后总算把他救了出来，可那是真险啊。

senses.def: having a lot of importance and interest for somebody
senses.zh: 为某人所重视关心；为某人所爱

senses.def: if a remark or topic of discussion is close to home
senses.zh: （话语或讨论的话题）因点中要害而使人局促不安（或尴尬）

examples.en: Her remarks about me were embarrassingly close to home.
examples.zh: 她说我的那些话使我尴尬不已。

senses.def: that involves somebody directly

examples.en: The next year tragedy struck much closer to home.
examples.zh: 第二年，不幸来得更加直接。

senses.def: to watch somebody/something carefully

examples.en: Over the next few months we will keep a close eye on sales.
examples.zh: 在今后的几个月里我们将密切关注销售情况。

senses.def: so near that it is uncomfortable or dangerous
senses.zh: 距离过近而令人不适（或不安全）

examples.en: When she leaves the stage, the fans can get a little too close for comfort.
examples.zh: 当她离开舞台时，粉丝可能靠得很近，令她感到不舒服。

examples.en: They got the win but it was a tight match, definitely too close for comfort.
examples.zh: 他们取得了胜利，但这是一场激烈的比赛，绝对是太接近了，让人感到不舒服。

senses.def: physically very close to somebody; getting to know them well

examples.en: Get up close and personal with the koalas at the San Diego Zoo.
examples.zh: 与圣迭戈动物园的树袋熊亲密接触。

examples.en: For the last 30 years, I’ve been up close and personal with people whose lives were in crisis.
examples.zh: 在过去的 30 年里，我一直与那些生活陷入危机的人们进行近距离接触。

senses.def: near; not far away
senses.zh: 接近；靠近；紧挨着；不远地

examples.en: They sat close together.
examples.zh: 他们紧挨着坐在一起。

examples.en: A second police car followed close behind.
examples.zh: 第二辆警车紧紧跟在后面。

examples.en: They are edging closer to an agreement.
examples.zh: 他们正在接近达成协议。

examples.en: Don't come too close!
examples.zh: 别靠得太近！

examples.en: He moved closer so that he could hear her better.
examples.zh: 他凑近了一些，以便能更清楚地听到她的声音。

examples.en: I couldn't get close enough to see.
examples.zh: 我无法靠得很近去看清楚。

examples.en: The days were growing colder as winter drew closer.
examples.zh: 冬季将至，天气越来越冷。

examples.en: Stay close to me!
examples.zh: 别离开我身边！

examples.en: She held Tom close and pressed her cheek to his.
examples.zh: 她紧紧地抱着汤姆，并把脸紧贴在他的脸上。

senses.def: to be fairly accurate in a guess, statement, etc.
senses.zh: （猜测、陈述等）接近准确，几乎无误

examples.en: Such guesses are thought to be close to the mark.
examples.zh: 这样的猜测被认为是接近事实的。

examples.en: ‘The Times’ was nearer the mark when it said…
examples.zh: 《泰晤士报》更接近事实，它说……

senses.def: near; in a place where somebody/something can be reached easily
senses.zh: 在附近；在触手可及的地方

examples.en: There are good cafes and a restaurant close at hand.
examples.zh: 附近有几家挺不错的咖啡馆和一家餐馆。

senses.def: at a short distance (from somebody/something)

examples.en: Our friends live close by.
examples.zh: 我们的朋友住得不远。

examples.en: The route passes close by the town.
examples.zh: 这条路离那座城镇不远。

senses.def: almost; nearly

examples.en: Mr Taylor’s election defeat was a close-run thing.
examples.zh: 泰勒先生的选举失败是一场势均力敌的事情。

examples.en: The invasion never happened but it was a close-run thing.
examples.zh: 侵略始终没有发生，但是差一点就发生了。

senses.def: in a position very near to something

examples.en: The picture looks very different when you see it close to.
examples.zh: 这幅画贴近看时就很不一样。

examples.zh: 我喜欢橱窗里的那些银耳环。我可以近距离看看吗？

senses.def: very near in space to somebody/something

examples.en: She snuggled close up to him.
examples.zh: 她紧紧地依偎着他。

senses.def: to almost reach or do something

examples.en: He'd come close to death.
examples.zh: 他曾与死神擦肩而过。

examples.en: We didn't win but we came close.
examples.zh: 我们输了，但离赢只差了那么一小点儿。

examples.en: Millions of Britons will never come close to earning enough to buy their own home.
examples.zh: 数以百万计的英国人永远赚不到足够的钱来买自己的房子。

examples.en: The car came perilously close to running her down.
examples.zh: 汽车向她逼近，险些将她撞倒。

senses.def: to keep your ideas, plans, etc. secret
to be nearly as good, fast, successful, etc. as somebody/something else

senses.def: to take a risk by doing something that is dangerous or that may be illegal
senses.zh: 冒风险（干危险或可能违法的事）

senses.def: to stop doing something because you no longer believe you will be successful or will find a solution
senses.zh: （因相信不会成功或没有结论而）放弃

examples.en: The police have closed the book on the case (= they have stopped trying to solve it).
examples.zh: 警方已经放弃侦破此案。

senses.def: to make it unlikely that something will happen
senses.zh: 使不可能；拒⋯于门外；把⋯的门堵死

examples.zh: 她小心翼翼不让进一步谈判的大门关上。

senses.def: to stop trading

examples.en: The factory closed its doors for the last time in 2009.
examples.zh: 这家工厂最后于 2009 年关闭。

examples.zh: 该公司去年关闭了商店并离开了美国。

senses.def: to refuse to think about something as a possibility
senses.zh: 对⋯拒不考虑（或置之不理、置若罔闻）

examples.zh: 在一位警员受到调查时，警察抱团的事并不罕见。

senses.def: if soldiers close ranks
to refuse to listen to something

examples.en: She decided to shut her ears to all the rumours.
examples.zh: 她拿定主意对所有的谣言置之不理。

senses.def: to pretend that you have not noticed something so that you do not have to deal with it
senses.zh: （对⋯）视而不见，熟视无睹，置若罔闻

examples.en: You can't just close your eyes to his violence.
examples.zh: 你不能对他的暴力行为视而不见。

examples.en: They seem intent on shutting their eyes to the problems of pollution.
examples.zh: 他们似乎一心要对污染问题视而不见。

senses.def: very easily, without thinking about it
senses.zh: 闭着眼都能做；轻而易举

examples.en: I've made this trip so often, I could do it with my eyes shut.
examples.zh: 我经常走这条路，闭着眼睛都能找到。

senses.def: very near

examples.en: fighting at close quarters
examples.zh: 近距离作战

senses.def: from only a short distance away

examples.en: The president was shot at close range.
examples.zh: 总统遭到近距离枪击。

examples.en: She scored from close range.
examples.zh: 她近距离得分。

senses.def: close to you in time or distance

examples.en: Help was at hand.
examples.zh: 援助近在咫尺。

examples.en: The property is ideally located with all local amenities close at hand.
examples.zh: 这处房地产的位置很理想，离当地的生活设施都近。

senses.def: used to tell somebody that their attempt or guess was almost but not quite successful
senses.zh: 很接近，但还是输了；猜得差不多，但不完全对

senses.def: a situation in which you only just manage to avoid an accident, etc.
senses.zh: 侥幸避免事故；侥幸脱险；幸免于难

examples.en: He had a close shave when his brakes failed on the mountain road.
examples.zh: 当他在山路上刹车失灵时，他差点就死了。

senses.def: a situation in which success or failure is equally possible

examples.en: We got him out in the end, but it was a close thing.
examples.zh: 我们最后总算把他救了出来，可那是真险啊。

senses.def: having a lot of importance and interest for somebody
senses.zh: 为某人所重视关心；为某人所爱

examples.en: Her remarks about me were embarrassingly close to home.
examples.zh: 她说我的那些话使我尴尬不已。

senses.def: that involves somebody directly

examples.en: The next year tragedy struck much closer to home.
examples.zh: 第二年，不幸来得更加直接。

senses.def: to watch somebody/something carefully

examples.en: Over the next few months we will keep a close eye on sales.
examples.zh: 在今后的几个月里我们将密切关注销售情况。

senses.zh: 距离过近而令人不适（或不安全）

examples.en: When she leaves the stage, the fans can get a little too close for comfort.
examples.zh: 当她离开舞台时，粉丝可能靠得很近，令她感到不舒服。

examples.en: They got the win but it was a tight match, definitely too close for comfort.
examples.zh: 他们取得了胜利，但这是一场激烈的比赛，绝对是太接近了，让人感到不舒服。

examples.zh: 与圣迭戈动物园的树袋熊亲密接触。

examples.zh: 在过去的 30 年里，我一直与那些生活陷入危机的人们进行近距离接触。

senses.zh: （猜测、陈述等）接近准确，几乎无误

examples.en: Such guesses are thought to be close to the mark.
examples.zh: 这样的猜测被认为是接近事实的。

examples.en: ‘The Times’ was nearer the mark when it said…
examples.zh: 《泰晤士报》更接近事实，它说……

examples.en: There are good cafes and a restaurant close at hand.
examples.zh: 附近有几家挺不错的咖啡馆和一家餐馆。

examples.en: A rock concert closed out the festivities.

senses.def: very close together

senses.def: when a wound closes up
to hide your thoughts or emotions

examples.en: She closed up when I asked about her family.
examples.zh: 我问起她的家人时她避而不谈。

examples.en: Peter turned away from him, his expression closing up.
examples.zh: Peter转过身去，表情凝重。

senses.def: to shut and lock something such as a shop or a building, especially for a short period of time

examples.en: Why don't we close up and go out for lunch?
examples.zh: 我们何不关上门出去吃顿午饭？

examples.en: Can the last one out close up the office?
examples.zh: 最后离开的人把办公室锁上好吗？

senses.def: to come closer together; to bring people or things closer together

examples.en: Traffic was heavy and cars were closing up behind each other.
examples.zh: 交通拥挤不堪，汽车一辆紧挨一辆地前行。

senses.def: to become narrower and less open

examples.en: Every time he tried to speak, his throat closed up with fear.
examples.zh: 每当他试图讲话时，他都害怕得喉咙发紧说不出话来。

senses.def: a photograph, or picture in a film, taken very close to somebody/something so that it shows a lot of detail

examples.en: a close-up of a human eye
examples.zh: 人眼睛的特写镜头

examples.en: It was strange to see her own face in close-up on the screen.
examples.zh: 在屏幕上看见她自己的脸部特写使她感到奇怪。

examples.en: close-up pictures of the planet
examples.zh: 这颗行星的特写照片

examples.en: The slide gave close-up detail of petal formation.
examples.zh: 幻灯片展示了花瓣结构的细部特写。

examples.en: The wound was photographed in extreme close-up.
examples.zh: 伤口用大特写镜头拍了照片。

examples.en: She was careful not to close the door on the possibility of further talks.

senses.def: having captions

senses.zh: 只雇用某工会会员的工厂（或企业等）

senses.zh: （只限于一小群人的）专业活动领域

examples.zh: 俱乐部的管理层是一个封闭的商店。

examples.zh: 他走进房间，后面紧跟着他的家人。

examples.en: closely spaced rows of seats
examples.zh: 几排间隔很小的座位

examples.en: streets of closely packed terraced houses
examples.zh: 街道上密密麻麻的排屋

senses.def: near in family relationship

examples.en: The two species are closely related.
examples.zh: 这两个物种关系很近。

examples.zh: 密切相关

examples.en: The two events are closely connected.
examples.zh: 两起事件之间有密切的联系。

examples.en: The country's economy remains closely tied to oil.
examples.zh: 该国经济仍然与石油密切相关。

senses.def: in a way that shows you are very involved in the work or activities of somebody else, usually seeing and talking to them regularly
senses.zh: （工作或活动上）深度参与地，紧密合作地

examples.en: The organization works closely with customers in nearly 100 countries.
examples.zh: 该组织与近 100 个国家的消费者紧密合作。

examples.en: The Royal Navy was closely involved in the early development of wireless technology.
examples.zh: 英国皇家海军深度参与了无线技术的早期开发。

examples.en: They collaborated closely together for the next four years
examples.zh: 在接下来的四年里，他们紧密合作。

senses.def: carefully

examples.en: I sat and watched everyone very closely.
examples.zh: 我坐下来密切注视着每一个人。

examples.en: The government has looked closely at the arguments for and against a change in the law.
examples.zh: 政府仔细审查了赞成和反对一处法律修订的论据。

examples.en: We will be closely monitoring the situation.
examples.zh: 我们将密切关注事态发展。

examples.en: a closely guarded secret
examples.zh: 严格守护的秘密

senses.def: in a way that is very similar to somebody/something else

examples.zh: 她酷似她母亲当年的样子。

examples.en: It was an exciting game between two closely matched teams.

examples.zh: 一想到当时很容易就会被杀掉，我们就吓得浑身冰凉。

intro.en: These words all describe somebody/​something that has a low temperature.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示温度低。

items.def: having a temperature that is lower than usual or lower than the human body; (of food or drink) not heated; cooled after being cooked:
items.zh: 指寒冷的、冷的，（食物、饮料）凉的、冷的

examples.en: I’m cold. Turn the heating up.
examples.zh: 我觉得冷，把暖气温度调高一点。

examples.zh: 一大口冷饮

examples.en: It’s absolutely freezing outside.
examples.zh: 外面冷得不得了。

items.def: (rather informal) too cold to be comfortable:

examples.en: Bring a coat. It might turn chilly later.
examples.zh: 带件大衣，过一会儿天气可能会变冷。

cold coffee made by mixing coffee grounds

examples.en: Customers can enjoy an ice-cold cup of cold brew.
examples.zh: 顾客可以享受一杯冰镇的冷萃咖啡。

examples.en: Cold brews are known for their smooth, sweet taste.
examples.zh: 冷萃咖啡以其顺滑、甜美的口感而闻名。

senses.def: a phone call made to somebody that you do not know, in order to sell them something
to phone somebody that you do not know, in order to sell them something

examples.en: Fraudsters would cold-call residents with offers of solar electricity.
examples.zh: 诈骗者会向居民推销太阳能电力。

senses.def: a crime that has not been solved and remains open to investigation if new evidence is found
senses.zh: （尚未侦破、有待重启调查的）旧案，悬案

examples.en: Britain is becoming a leader in solving cold cases, thanks to its national DNA database.
examples.zh: 凭借其国家 DNA 数据库，英国正在成为解决悬案的领导者。

senses.def: money, especially in the form of coins and notes, that you can spend
a supply chain
senses.zh: 冷链（全程控制在低温环境的供应链系统）

examples.en: Cold chain is critical in the proper handling of vaccines to preserve their efficacy.
examples.zh: 为保持疫苗效力，冷链在疫苗的规范管理中至关重要。

examples.en: Many modern medicines require cold chain storage at all times.
examples.zh: 许多现代药品都要求全程冷链储存。

examples.en: Developing sustainable cold chains is vital.
examples.zh: 建立生态友好的冷链系统是十分重要的。

senses.def: the fact that something that would normally be good does not make you happy because the whole situation is bad

examples.en: A small drop in the inflation rate was cold comfort for the millions without a job.
examples.zh: 对数百万失业者来说，通货膨胀率的微降是不起什么作用的安慰。

senses.def: a humorous novel (1932) by the English author Stella Gibbons (1902-89), about a lonely farm and the strange people who live there. It is a parody
senses.zh: 冷舒适农场：英国作家斯特拉·吉本斯（1902-89）创作的幽默小说（1932），讲述了一个孤独的农场和住在那儿的陌生人。这是一本模仿1920年代流行的哈迪和劳伦斯影响力的“朴实”小说的戏仿（模仿另一种作品的风格以便于娱乐）。

senses.def: a thick white cream that people use for cleaning their face or making their skin soft
slices of cooked meat that are served cold
a drink made by mixing red wine and champagne
senses.zh: 冷鸭：一种通过将红酒和香槟混合制成的饮料，有时还添加柠檬汁和糖

senses.def: a small wooden or metal frame covered with glass that you grow seeds or small plants in to protect them from cold weather
senses.zh: 冷床，阳畦（用于保护育种或幼苗抗寒）

senses.def: nuclear fusion
not showing any love or sympathy for other people; unkind
senses.zh: 冷酷无情的；无同情心的；不仁慈的

examples.en: The strawberries are put into cold storage for several months.
examples.zh: 草莓被冷藏保存几个月。

examples.en: I've had to put my plans into cold storage (= I've decided not to carry them out immediately but to keep them for later).
examples.zh: 我不得不把我的计划暂时搁置起来。

senses.def: a room where food, etc. can be kept at a low temperature in order to keep it in good condition

examples.zh: 出了一身冷汗

examples.en: I woke up in a cold sweat about the interview.
examples.zh: 梦中的面试情景吓得我在一身冷汗中惊醒。

senses.def: if somebody stops taking a drug cold turkey
senses.zh: 火鸡：如果有人停止服用毒品，他们会突然停下来，产生不愉快的状态

examples.en: I quit smoking cold turkey.
examples.zh: 我用突然戒烟法戒了烟。

senses.def: the unpleasant state that drug addicts
senses.zh: （吸毒成瘾者）突然戒毒时的痛苦；（治疗吸毒成瘾者的）突然戒毒方法

senses.def: the lack of warm feelings; unfriendly behaviour

examples.en: She was hurt by the coldness in his voice.
examples.zh: 他说话的冷漠语气让她很伤心。

senses.def: the state of being cold

examples.en: The icy coldness of the water revived her.
examples.zh: 水刺骨的寒冷使她苏醒过来。

senses.def: a British pop group formed in the middle of the 1990s. The lead singer is Chris Martin. They have won a number of music awards including Brit Awards
senses.zh: 酷玩乐队：1990年代中期成立的英国流行乐队。主唱是克里斯·马丁。他们赢得了许多音乐奖项，包括全英音乐奖和格莱美奖。

senses.def: (1892-1964) a US writer of popular songs with clever words for Broadway
senses.zh: 科尔·波特（Cole Porter）：（1892-1964）是美国流行歌曲作家，并为百老汇音乐表演和好莱坞电影配上巧妙的词语。他的演出包括《一切》（1934）和《吻我，凯特》（1948），他的电影包括《上流社会》（1956）。在他最著名的歌曲中，有《让我们去做》（Let's Do It，1928年），《我被踢出你》（1934年），《夜与日》（1932年），《开始的贝甘》（Beginine，1935年）和《真爱》（True Love，1956年）。

senses.def: the funny things that people, especially sports commentators
senses.zh: 科尔曼球：人们，尤其是体育评论员，在兴奋和快速说话时有时会误说一些有趣的事情。这个词是由《私人之眼》杂志发明的，并以经常犯此类错误的大卫·科尔曼（David Coleman，1926-2013）的名字命名。这是该杂志定期列出的最有趣的例子的标题。

senses.def: a person who studies beetles
senses.zh: 鞘翅目昆虫学家；甲虫研究者

senses.def: pieces of raw cabbage
senses.zh: 凉拌菜丝（用生圆白菜、胡萝卜、洋葱等切丝与蛋黄酱搅拌而成）

senses.def: a N Atlantic fish that is used for food
a US company, started in 1806 in New York, making Colgate toothpaste
senses.zh: 高露洁–棕榄公司（美国公司，1806年在纽约成立，生产高露洁牙膏、棕榄肥皂和其他家庭日用品。于1896年推出管装牙膏）

senses.def: severe pain in the stomach and bowels
senses.zh: （尤指婴儿的）急性腹痛，腹绞痛

examples.zh: 患急腹痛的婴儿

examples.en: colicky pain
examples.zh: 绞痛

senses.zh: 柯林·戴维斯（Colin Davis）：（1927-2013）是一位英语指挥，他在1960年代与英国国家歌剧院合作，并在1970年代和1980年代在皇家歌剧院工作。他还指挥过波士顿交响乐团，并于1995年成为伦敦交响乐团的主要指挥。1980年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: a large building used for sports events, entertainment, exhibitions, etc.
senses.zh: 大体育场；大剧场；大展览馆

examples.en: With a seasonal schedule, the State Fair uses the coliseum all year round.
examples.zh: 根据季节安排，国家博览会全年使用体育馆。

examples.en: The Hornets attracted an average of 23 000 fans at Charlotte Coliseum.
examples.zh: 黄蜂队在夏洛特体育馆平均吸引了 23000 名球迷。

senses.def: a disease that causes pain and swelling
to work together with another person or group to create or produce something; to collaborate

examples.en: He has collabed with artists from across the musical spectrum.
examples.zh: 他与来自各个音乐领域的艺术家进行了合作。

examples.en: She turned down the company's offer to collab on a new make-up range.
examples.zh: 她拒绝了该公司合作开发新化妆品系列的提议。

senses.def: to work together with somebody in order to produce or achieve something

examples.en: Researchers around the world are collaborating to develop a new vaccine.
examples.zh: 世界各地的研究人员正在合作培育一种新的疫苗。

examples.en: We have collaborated on many projects over the years.
examples.zh: 这些年来我们合作搞了许多项目。

examples.en: She agreed to collaborate with him in writing the biography of her grandmother.
examples.zh: 她同意与他合作撰写她祖母的传记。

senses.def: to help the enemy who has taken control of your country during a war

examples.en: He was accused of collaborating with the enemy.
examples.zh: 他被指控与敌人勾结。

senses.def: the act of working with another person or group of people to create or produce something

examples.en: It was a collaboration that produced extremely useful results.
examples.zh: 这是一次带来极其有益的成果的合作。

examples.en: The new plane was a triumph of European industrial and technical collaboration.
examples.zh: 这架新飞机是欧洲工业和技术合作的胜利。

examples.en: the results of a fruitful collaboration with the industry
examples.zh: 与业界有效合作的成果

examples.en: She wrote the book in collaboration with one of her students.
examples.zh: 她和她的一个学生合写了这本书。

examples.en: The government worked in close collaboration with teachers on the new curriculum.
examples.zh: 政府和教师就新的课程进行了紧密协作。

examples.en: collaboration between the teachers and the government
examples.zh: 教师和政府间的合作

senses.def: a piece of work produced by two or more people or groups of people working together

examples.en: The exhibition is a collaboration with the Australian Centre for the Moving Image.
examples.zh: 该展览是与澳大利亚移动图像中心合作举办的。

examples.en: This mission was a collaboration between the National Space Development Agency of Japan and NASA.
examples.zh: 这次任务是由日本宇宙开发事业团和美国国家航空航天局合作完成的。

senses.def: the act of helping the enemy during a war when they have taken control of your country

examples.en: his wartime collaboration with the Nazis
examples.zh: 他战时与纳粹的勾结

senses.def: involving, or done by, several people or groups of people working together

examples.en: collaborative projects/studies/research
examples.zh: 合作项目／研究

examples.en: a collaborative effort/venture
examples.zh: 共同的努力；合作企业

senses.def: in a way that involves, or is done by, several people or groups of people working together

examples.en: She often works collaboratively with local artists.
examples.zh: 她经常与当地艺术家合作。

senses.def: a person who works with another person to create or produce something such as a book

examples.en: He is working on a new series with his long-time collaborator Michel Baudin.
examples.zh: 他正和自己的长期搭档米歇尔•博丹合写一部新系列剧。

senses.def: a person who helps the enemy in a war, when they have taken control of the person’s country

examples.en: Former collaborators are now facing public humiliation in the courts.
examples.zh: 从前的通敌者现在正面临法庭上的公开羞辱。

senses.def: a picture made by sticking pieces of coloured paper, cloth or photographs onto a surface, or by putting images together on a computer

examples.en: She makes collages from everyday objects that she finds.
examples.zh: 她用她发现的日常物品制作拼贴画。

examples.en: a photo collage
examples.zh: 拼贴的照片

senses.def: the art of making collages

examples.en: He began to experiment with collage techniques.
examples.zh: 他开始尝试拼贴技术。

senses.def: a collection of things, which may be similar or different

examples.en: an interesting collage of 1960s songs
examples.zh: 有趣的 20 世纪 60 年代歌曲的收藏集

senses.zh: 胶原蛋白，胶原（存在于皮肤和骨骼中的蛋白质，可通过注射来美容等）

examples.en: collagen injections
examples.zh: 胶原蛋白注射

senses.def: an old star that has collapsed under its own gravity
senses.zh: 坍缩星，塌缩星（由于自身引力而坍塌的古老恒星）

senses.def: to fall down or fall in suddenly, often after breaking apart

examples.en: The roof collapsed under the weight of snow.
examples.zh: 房顶在雪的重压下突然坍塌下来。

examples.en: The building had partially collapsed.
examples.zh: 该建筑已部分倒塌。

senses.def: to fall down (and usually become unconscious), especially because you are very ill
senses.zh: （尤指因病重而）倒下，昏倒，晕倒

examples.en: She collapsed and was rushed to hospital.
examples.zh: 她晕倒了，被紧急送往医院。

examples.en: The man collapsed in a heap on the floor.
examples.zh: 那名男子瘫倒在地。

examples.en: He collapsed in the street and died two hours later.
examples.zh: 他昏倒在街上，两小时后死了。

examples.en: One night I practically collapsed from exhaustion.
examples.zh: 一天晚上，我几乎因精疲力尽而倒下。

senses.def: to sit or lie down and relax, especially after working hard
senses.zh: （尤指工作劳累后）坐下，躺下放松

examples.en: When I get home I like to collapse on the sofa and listen to music.
examples.zh: 回到家时，我喜欢倒在沙发上听音乐。

senses.def: to fail suddenly or completely

examples.en: Talks between management and unions have collapsed.
examples.zh: 资方与工会的谈判已告破裂。

examples.en: All opposition to the plan has collapsed.
examples.zh: 所有反对此计划的力量均已消除。

senses.def: to decrease suddenly in amount or value

examples.en: Share prices collapsed after news of poor trading figures.
examples.zh: 在交易数额不佳的消息公布后，股票价格暴跌。

examples.en: She lost a lot of money when the property market collapsed.
examples.zh: 房地产市场崩溃时，她损失了很多钱。

senses.def: to fold something into a shape that uses less space; to be able to be folded in this way
senses.zh: 折叠；套缩；可折叠（或套缩）

examples.en: The table collapses for easy storage.
examples.zh: 这桌子可折叠起来方便存放。

senses.def: if a lung or blood vessel
a sudden failure of something, such as an institution, a business or a course of action
senses.zh: （机构、生意、行动等的）突然失败，倒闭，崩溃

examples.en: the collapse of the Soviet Union
examples.zh: 苏联的解体

examples.en: The peace talks were on the verge of collapse.
examples.zh: 和平谈判濒于破裂。

examples.zh: 这一决定将使该国离经济崩溃更近一步

examples.en: the collapse of law and order in the area
examples.zh: 该地区治安的瘫痪

examples.en: They thought their strategy would cause the collapse of the regime.
examples.zh: 他们认为他们的策略会导致政权崩溃。

examples.en: The articles they published led to the collapse of the trial.
examples.zh: 他们发表的文章导致了审判的失败。

examples.en: The present system is on the brink of collapse.
examples.zh: 目前的体系正处于崩溃的边缘。

senses.def: the action of a building or structure suddenly falling

examples.zh: 围墙已加固以防倒塌。

examples.zh: 那座桥的突然倒塌

senses.group: of building/structure 建筑物/构筑物的

examples.en: She was taken to hospital after her collapse at work.
examples.zh: 她在工作时晕倒后被送进了医院。

senses.def: a sudden fall in value
senses.zh: 突然降价；突然贬值；暴跌

examples.en: Shares suffered a fresh collapse today.
examples.zh: 今天股票再次暴跌。

examples.en: the collapse of share prices/the dollar/the market
examples.zh: 股票价格／美元／市场价格暴跌

examples.en: the collapse in the price of oil
examples.zh: 油价暴跌

examples.zh: 他瘫倒在地，蜷作一团。

examples.zh: 我把衣领竖起来挡风。

examples.zh: 他上班总是穿衬衫打领带。

examples.zh: 那条狗挣脱项圈跑掉了。

angry or embarrassed

examples.zh: 我问他一整天到哪里去了，他很尴尬。

examples.zh: 罪犯正离开现场时，警察逮住了他。

senses.def: to collect information together from different sources in order to examine and compare it
senses.zh: 核对，校勘，对照（不同来源的信息）

examples.zh: 核对资料／信息／数据

property or something valuable that you promise to give to somebody if you cannot pay back money that you borrow

examples.zh: 我们把房子作为银行贷款的抵押品。

senses.def: connected with something else, but in addition to it and less important

examples.en: collateral benefits
examples.zh: 附加津贴

senses.def: deaths of or injury to civilians
senses.zh: 附带损害，附带性破坏（指战争中的平民伤亡和非军事建筑损坏，是“无辜者被杀害”的粉饰表达）

examples.en: The government denied that there had been any collateral damage during the bombing raid.
examples.zh: 政府否认轰炸突袭中有任何附带损害。

examples.en: Collateral damage caused by the drone attacks was high.
examples.zh: 无人机攻击造成的附带性破坏很严重。

examples.en: They were rightly concerned about civilian collateral damage.
examples.zh: 他们有充分理由关切对平民造成的附带损害。

examples.en: As forests are cleared for logging, woodland caribou become collateral damage (= the animals die even though they are not deliberately killed).
examples.zh: 森林被采伐殆尽，林地驯鹿惨遭池鱼之殃。

senses.def: the act of collecting information together from different sources in order to examine and compare it
senses.zh: 核对，校勘，对照（不同来源的信息）

examples.en: the collation of information
examples.zh: 信息的整理

senses.def: a person that you work with, especially in a profession or a business

examples.en: work/senior/male colleagues
examples.zh: 同事；资深同事；男同事

examples.en: We were friends and colleagues for more than 20 years.
examples.zh: 20 多年来我们既是朋友又是同事。

examples.en: some of his former colleagues on the council
examples.zh: 他以前在议会的一些同事

examples.en: the Prime Minister and his Cabinet colleagues
examples.zh: 首相及其内阁同僚

examples.en: Scientists are now working with colleagues in Arizona to develop a working model.
examples.zh: 科学家们现在正在与亚利桑那州的同事合作开发一种工作模型。

examples.en: He is described by party colleagues as a workaholic.
examples.zh: 他被党内同事形容为工作狂。

examples.en: Russinova and her colleagues found that 74% of participants had held the same job for 24 months or longer.
examples.zh: Russinova 和她的同事发现，74% 的参与者在同一份工作上工作了 24 个月或更长时间。

examples.en: I've talked to colleagues at other universities about it.
examples.zh: 我和其他大学的同事谈过这个问题。

examples.en: colleagues in the IT department
examples.zh: IT部门的同事

examples.en: a colleague of mine from the office
examples.zh: 我办公室的一位同事

senses.def: to bring things together from different people or places

examples.en: to collect data/evidence/information
examples.zh: 收集资料／证据／信息

examples.en: We're collecting signatures for a petition.
examples.zh: 我们在为请愿书收集签名。

examples.en: The purpose of his trip was to collect material for a book.
examples.zh: 他此行的目的是为一本书收集材料。

examples.en: Samples were collected from over 200 patients.
examples.zh: 已从 200 多名病人取样。

examples.en: an analysis of 400 specimens collected from 12 localities
examples.zh: 对从 12 个地点采集的 400 个样本进行分析

examples.en: We've been collecting data from various sources.
examples.zh: 我们一直从各种渠道收集资料。

senses.def: to buy or find things of a particular type and keep them as a hobby

examples.en: to collect stamps/postcards/coins
examples.zh: 集邮；收藏明信片；收藏硬币

examples.en: She started to collect art seriously soon after the turn of the century.
examples.zh: 世纪之交后不久，她就开始认真收藏艺术品。

examples.en: He began collecting antiquities in 1785.
examples.zh: 1785年，他开始收集古董。

senses.def: to gradually increase in amount in a place; to gradually obtain more and more of something in a place

examples.en: In spite of their efforts a large pool of liquid continued to collect.
examples.zh: 尽管他们付出了努力，仍然有一大滩液体积聚起来。

examples.en: Dirt had collected in the corners of the room.
examples.zh: 房间的角落里积满了灰尘。

examples.en: Water had collected on the flat roof.
examples.zh: 平屋顶上积满了水。

examples.en: We seem to have collected an enormous number of boxes (= without intending to).
examples.zh: 我们似乎无意中积存了大量的盒子。

examples.en: It’s amazing how she collects friends.
examples.zh: 她如何结识朋友真是太神奇了。

senses.group: increase in amount 数量增加

senses.def: to go somewhere in order to take somebody/something away

examples.en: What day do they collect the rubbish/garbage?
examples.zh: 他们哪天收运垃圾？

examples.en: The package is waiting to be collected.
examples.zh: 这包裹在等人领取。

examples.en: On arrival, collect your keys from reception.
examples.zh: 到达时，在接待处领取钥匙。

examples.en: Someone will be at the airport to collect you.
examples.zh: 有人会在机场接你。

examples.en: She's gone to collect her son from school.
examples.zh: 她到学校接她儿子去了。

senses.def: to ask people to give you money for a particular purpose

examples.en: I've been out collecting, knocking on peoples doors and asking them for money.
examples.zh: 我一直在外面收集，敲人们的门，向他们要钱。

examples.en: We're collecting for local charities.
examples.zh: 我们正在为当地慈善机构募捐。

examples.en: Volunteers have been going door to door, collecting money.
examples.zh: 志愿者一直在挨家挨户募捐。

examples.en: We collected over £300 for the appeal.
examples.zh: 我们为此吁请募集了 300 多英镑。

senses.def: to obtain the money, etc. that somebody owes, for example by going to their house to get it

examples.en: to collect rent/debts/tax
examples.zh: 收租金；讨债；征税

senses.def: to receive something; to win something

examples.en: She collected £25 000 in compensation.
examples.zh: 她得到了 25 000 英镑赔偿金。

examples.en: to collect a prize/a medal
examples.zh: 获奖；赢得奖牌

examples.en: She collected $50 000 on her husband’s life insurance policies.
examples.zh: 她为丈夫的人寿保险保单领取了 50 万美元。

examples.en: He went to the casino most nights, but usually failed to collect.
examples.zh: 他大多数晚上都会去赌场，但通常都无法领取。

senses.def: to come together in one place to form a larger group

examples.en: A crowd began to collect in front of the embassy.
examples.zh: 人群开始聚集在大使馆的前面。

senses.def: to not be used for a long time

examples.en: That guitar's been sitting there gathering dust for years now.
examples.zh: 那把吉他已经放在那里多年了，积满了灰尘。

examples.en: Play your guitar that's gathering dust, or pull out the old tennis racket for a match.
examples.zh: 弹奏积满灰尘的吉他，或者拿出旧网球拍进行比赛。

examples.en: You may already have an old laptop that is collecting dust but otherwise usable.
examples.zh: 您可能已经拥有一台积满灰尘但仍可用的旧笔记本电脑。

examples.zh: 地板上有成堆的书和鞋。

examples.en: There is always a strange collection of runners in the London Marathon.
examples.zh: 每次总会有一批稀奇古怪的选手参加伦敦马拉松比赛。

examples.zh: 研究工作的第一步是收集资料。

examples.en: waste/rubbish/garbage/refuse collection
examples.zh: 废物／垃圾的收运

examples.en: The last collection from this postbox is at 5.15.
examples.zh: 这邮筒最后一次收信的时间是 5:15。

examples.en: Your suit will be ready for collection on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 你的套装可在星期二领取。

senses.def: a group of poems, stories or pieces of music published together as one book, etc.

examples.en: a collection of stories by women writers
examples.zh: 女作家小说集

examples.en: a collection of favourite Christmas music
examples.zh: 最喜欢的圣诞音乐合集

senses.zh: （为慈善机构或做礼拜时的）募捐，募集；募集的钱

examples.zh: 为资助癌症研究院挨门逐户进行的募捐

examples.en: The total collection last week amounted to £250.
examples.zh: 上周的募捐总额达 250 英镑。

examples.zh: 募捐箱／桶

examples.zh: 教堂的奉献盘

examples.en: Armani’s stunning new autumn collection

senses.def: done or shared by all members of a group of people; involving a whole group or society

examples.en: collective leadership/decision-making/responsibility
examples.zh: 集体领导／决策；共同责任

examples.en: collective memory (= things that a group of people or a community know or remember, that are often passed from parents to children)
examples.zh: 集体记忆

senses.def: used to refer to all members of a group

examples.en: The collective name for mast, boom and sails on a boat is the ‘rig’.
examples.zh: 船的桅杆、帆桁和帆总称为“索具”。

senses.def: a group of people who own a business or a farm and run it together; the business that they run
senses.zh: 企业集团；合作农场；集体企业

examples.en: an independent collective making films for television
examples.zh: 为电视制作影片的独立集体企业

senses.def: discussions between a trade union and an employer about the pay and working conditions of the union members
senses.zh: （劳资双方就工资和工作条件进行的）集体谈判

examples.en: Unions were insistent on the right to collective bargaining.
examples.zh: 工会坚持集体谈判的权利。

senses.def: a large farm, or a group of farms, owned by the state and run by a group of people
a singular noun, such as committee

examples.zh: 共同商定的费率

examples.zh: 今年对我们团体和个人来说都是成功的一年。

examples.zh: 雨、雪和冰雹总称为“降水”

senses.zh: 集体主义；集体所有制；公有制

senses.zh: 集体主义；（一切农场、工商企业都归政府或全民所有的）公有制

examples.en: collectivist ideology
examples.zh: 公有制意识形态

senses.def: the act or policy of joining several private farms, industries, etc. together so that they are controlled by the community or by the state

examples.zh: 票务员/税务员
