examples.zh: 跟我来——我有东西要给你看。

examples.en: Why don't you come skating tonight?
examples.zh: 今晚来溜冰好吗？

senses.def: to travel a particular distance

examples.en: We've come 50 miles this morning.
examples.zh: 我们今天上午走了 50 英里。

examples.en: The company has come a long way (= made lot of progress) in the last 5 years.
examples.zh: 公司在过去的 5 年里取得了巨大进步。

senses.def: to move in a particular way or while doing something else

examples.en: A car came flying round the corner.
examples.zh: 一辆汽车从拐角处飞驰而来。

examples.en: A huge wave came crashing over the sea wall.
examples.zh: 巨大的波浪冲破了海堤。

examples.en: Questions came rushing into her head.
examples.zh: 各种疑问涌入她的脑海。

examples.en: Don't expect me to come running every time you call.
examples.zh: 别指望每次你打电话我都会跑过来。

senses.def: to happen

examples.en: The agreement came after several hours of negotiations.
examples.zh: 协议经过几小时的谈判后才达成。

examples.en: The rains came too late to do any good.
examples.zh: 雨季来得太晚，什么用也没有。

examples.en: Spring came late this year.
examples.zh: 今年春天来得晚。

examples.en: The time has come (= now is the moment) to act.
examples.zh: 采取行动的时机到了。

examples.en: His first goal came in the 81st minute.
examples.zh: 他的第一个进球出现在第81分钟。

examples.en: His resignation came as no surprise.
examples.zh: 他的辞职毫不令人惊讶。

examples.en: Her death came as a terrible shock to us.
examples.zh: 她的死使我们极为震惊。

examples.en: More details of the event are coming soon.
examples.zh: 活动的更多细节即将发布。

senses.def: used in questions to talk about how or why something happened
senses.zh: （用于疑问句，表示怎么或为什么）

examples.en: How did he come to break his leg?
examples.zh: 他怎么把腿弄断的？

examples.en: How do you come to be so late?
examples.zh: 你怎么这么晚？

senses.def: to have a particular position

examples.en: That comes a long way down my list of priorities.
examples.zh: 在我的优先事项中，那事远没那么紧要。

examples.en: She came second (= received the second highest score) in the exam.
examples.zh: 她这次考试名列第二。

examples.en: His family comes first (= is the most important thing in his life).
examples.zh: 他把家庭放在首位。

senses.group: to a position/state 位置；状态

senses.def: used in many expressions to show that something has reached a particular state
senses.zh: （用于许多表达）达到，进入（某种状态）

examples.en: At last winter came to an end.
examples.zh: 冬天终于结束了。

examples.en: He came to power in 2019.
examples.zh: 他于 2019 年上台执政。

examples.en: We need to come to an agreement on this issue.
examples.zh: 我们需要就这个问题达成一致。

examples.en: When will they come to a decision?
examples.zh: 他们何时会作出决定？

examples.en: our understanding of how the universe came into existence
examples.zh: 我们对宇宙形成过程的认识

examples.en: The trees are coming into leaf.
examples.zh: 树开始长叶子了。

senses.group: to a position/state 位置；状态

senses.def: to be available or to exist in a particular way

examples.en: This dress comes in black and red.
examples.zh: 这款连衣裙有黑、红两种颜色。

examples.en: The new edition of the game comes with a whole range of upgrades.
examples.zh: 游戏的新版本带来了一系列的升级。

examples.en: New cars don't come cheap (= they are expensive).
examples.zh: 新汽车没有便宜的。

examples.en: This luxury villa comes complete with its own private swimming pool.
examples.zh: 这栋豪华别墅配有自己的私人游泳池。

senses.group: to a position/state 位置；状态

senses.def: to become

examples.en: The handle came loose.
examples.zh: 这把手松了。

examples.en: The buttons had come undone.
examples.zh: 纽扣都松开了。

examples.en: Everything will come right in the end.
examples.zh: 一切到最后都会好起来的。

examples.en: the Nigerian film industry, which came to be known as Nollywood
examples.zh: 尼日利亚电影业，后来被称为诺莱坞

senses.group: to a position/state 位置；状态

senses.def: to reach a point where you realize, understand or believe something
senses.zh: 达到（认识、理解或相信的程度）

examples.en: In time she came to love him.
examples.zh: 她终于爱上了他。

examples.en: She had come to see the problem in a new light.
examples.zh: 她开始从新的角度来看待这个问题。

examples.en: I've come to expect this kind of behaviour from him.
examples.zh: 对于他的这种举止我渐渐不感到意外了。

senses.group: to a position/state 位置；状态

senses.def: to have an orgasm
to be very clever, stupid, etc.
to play the part of a particular type of person; to behave in a particular way
senses.zh: 扮演（某类人）；以（某种方式）行事

examples.en: Don't come the innocent with me.
examples.zh: 别跟我扮无辜。

senses.def: used to ask somebody to repeat something
senses.zh: （要求重复）再说一遍，你说什么来着

examples.en: ‘She's an entomologist.’ ‘Come again?’ ‘An entomologist—she studies insects.’
examples.zh: “她是昆虫学家。”“请再说一遍？”“昆虫学家，她是研究昆虫的。”

senses.def: to arrive and leave; to move freely

examples.en: They had a party next door—we heard people coming and going all night.
examples.zh: 他们在隔壁聚会，我们整夜都听见人来人往的声音。

senses.def: to be present for a short time and then go away

examples.en: The pain in my leg comes and goes.
examples.zh: 我的腿时而疼时而不疼。

senses.def: to be easy, natural, etc. for somebody to do
senses.zh: （对某人而言）轻而易举（或生来就会等）

examples.en: Acting comes naturally to her.
examples.zh: 她天生就会表演。

senses.def: to be unsuccessful; to have no successful result

examples.en: How sad that all his hard work should come to nothing.
examples.zh: 他的所有辛勤劳动竟全部付诸东流，太让人伤心了。

examples.en: Her plans didn't come to anything.
examples.zh: 她的计划全落空了。

senses.def: used to introduce something extra that is connected with what has just been said
senses.zh: （引出与刚提及的事物相关的事）说起…来，既然如此，假如那样的话

examples.en: I don't really trust him—or his wife, come to that.
examples.zh: 我真的不太信任他——或者他的妻子，说起来。

senses.def: despite any problems or difficulties you may have
senses.zh: 不管出现什么问题；无论有什么困难；不管怎样

examples.en: He promised to support her come what may.
examples.zh: 他答应不管出现什么问题都支持她。

senses.def: used to say you do not understand how something can happen and would like an explanation
senses.zh: （用以表示不理解情况是如何发生的，希望得到解释）怎么回事，怎么发生的，怎样解释

examples.en: ‘I think you owe me some money.’ ‘How come?’
examples.zh: “你好像欠我钱。”“怎么会呢？”

examples.en: If she spent five years in Paris, how come her French is so bad?
examples.zh: 既然她在巴黎待了五年，她的法语怎么还会这样糟糕？

senses.def: to not be important or successful
senses.zh: 不重要；无关紧要；不成功

senses.def: in the future

examples.en: They may well regret the decision in years to come.
examples.zh: 他们过几年之后很可能会为这个决定而后悔。

examples.en: This will be a problem for some time to come (= for a period of time in the future).
examples.zh: 这将是未来一段时期里的一个问题。

senses.def: when it is a question of something
senses.zh: 当涉及某事（或做某事）时

examples.en: When it comes to getting things done, he's useless.
examples.zh: 一涉及做事，他便不中用了。

senses.def: somebody’s ideas, beliefs, personality, etc. that makes them say what they have said
senses.zh: （决定某人言论的）某人的全部背景

examples.en: I see where you're coming from (= I understand what you mean).
examples.zh: 我明白你究竟是什么意思。

senses.def: when the time mentioned comes

examples.en: They would have been married forty years come this June.
examples.zh: 到今年六月他们结婚就有四十年了。

examples.en: Come next week she’ll have changed her mind.
examples.zh: 到下星期她就要改变主意了。

examples.en: Come summer, people like to eat outdoors.
examples.zh: 夏天来了，人们喜欢在户外吃饭。

senses.def: used when encouraging somebody to be sensible or reasonable, or when making a slight criticism
senses.zh: （劝某人理智、讲理，或表示略有不满）嗨，得啦，好啦

examples.en: Oh come now, things aren't as bad as all that.
examples.zh: 哦，好啦，情况并不是那么糟。

examples.en: Come, come, Miss Jones, you know perfectly well what I mean.
examples.zh: 得啦，得啦，琼斯小姐，你完全知道我的意思。

senses.def: semen

note.en: Most idioms containing come are at the entries for the nouns or adjectives in the idioms, for example come a cropper is at cropper.
note.zh: 大多数含 come 的习语，都可在该等习语中的名词或形容词相关词条找到，如 come a cropper 在词条 cropper 下。

senses.def: to fall over

examples.en: He came a cropper on the ski slopes.
examples.zh: 他在滑雪道上猛地摔了一跤。

senses.def: to have a failure or near disaster

examples.en: We nearly came a cropper in the second half of the game.
examples.zh: 在比赛的下半场我们差一点就输掉了。

senses.def: to fail or be defeated
used to ask somebody to repeat something
senses.zh: （要求重复）再说一遍，你说什么来着

examples.en: ‘She's an entomologist.’ ‘Come again?’ ‘An entomologist—she studies insects.’
examples.zh: “她是昆虫学家。”“请再说一遍？”“昆虫学家，她是研究昆虫的。”

senses.def: to become interesting and exciting

examples.en: The game came alive in the second half.
examples.zh: 比赛在下半场变得有看头了。

examples.en: New political issues suddenly came alive after the election.
examples.zh: 选举后新的政治问题突然出现。

senses.def: to become busy and full of activity

examples.en: The city starts to come alive after dark.
examples.zh: 这座城市天黑以后便热闹起来。

examples.en: The fishing villages come alive in spring.
examples.zh: 春天的渔村生机勃勃。

senses.def: to show interest in something and become excited about it

examples.en: She came alive as she talked about her job.
examples.zh: 她一谈到她的工作精神就来了。

senses.def: to arrive and leave; to move freely

examples.en: They had a party next door—we heard people coming and going all night.
examples.zh: 他们在隔壁聚会，我们整夜都听见人来人往的声音。

senses.def: to be present for a short time and then go away

examples.en: The pain in my leg comes and goes.
examples.zh: 我的腿时而疼时而不疼。

senses.def: to be a completely new or surprising experience; to be different from what was expected
senses.zh: 让人大开眼界；令人耳目一新；出乎意料

examples.en: His performance in the race today was a revelation to everyone.
examples.zh: 他今天在赛跑中的表现让所有人都大吃一惊。

examples.en: My trip to Texas was a revelation.
examples.zh: 这次得克萨斯之行使我大开眼界。

examples.en: Isn't it time the government came clean about their plans for education?
examples.zh: 这难道不是政府彻底说明教育计划的时候了吗？

senses.def: to almost reach or do something

examples.en: He'd come close to death.
examples.zh: 他曾与死神擦肩而过。

examples.en: We didn't win but we came close.
examples.zh: 我们输了，但离赢只差了那么一小点儿。

examples.en: Millions of Britons will never come close to earning enough to buy their own home.
examples.zh: 数以百万计的英国人永远赚不到足够的钱来买自己的房子。

examples.en: The car came perilously close to running her down.
examples.zh: 汽车向她逼近，险些将她撞倒。

senses.def: to choose between two possible choices
senses.zh: 二者择其一；支持两方中的一方

senses.def: to happen; to become easy to notice

examples.en: We're hearing a lot about new inventions coming down the pike.
examples.zh: 我们经常听说新发明不断问世。

come easily, naturally, etc. to somebody.word: come easily, naturally, etc. to somebody

senses.def: to be considered more important than anything else
senses.zh: 首要；第一；首先要考虑的

examples.en: In any decision she makes, her family always comes first.
examples.zh: 她作任何决定都是家庭第一。

senses.def: to become completely clear to somebody, often in a way that is painful

examples.en: It suddenly came home to him that he was never going to see Julie again.
examples.zh: 他突然明白他再也见不到朱莉了。

senses.def: to become accepted or included in a group, etc. after a period of being outside it
to be useful

examples.en: The extra money came in very handy.
examples.zh: 这笔额外的钱正好派上了用场。

examples.en: Don't throw that away—it might come in handy.
examples.zh: 别把它扔了，它或许有用。

examples.en: Take your penknife—you never know when it might come in handy.
examples.zh: 带上你的小折刀，说不定什么时候会用得到。

senses.def: to come into use; to begin to apply

examples.en: New controls come into effect next month.
examples.zh: 下月开始实施新的管制措施。

senses.def: to be born
to have the opportunity to show how good or useful you are or something is

examples.en: When the traffic's this bad, a bicycle really comes into its own.
examples.zh: 在交通如此拥堵的时候，自行车就显出了它的价值。

senses.def: to start/stop being used

examples.en: When did this word come into common use?
examples.zh: 这个词是什么时候普遍使用起来的？

examples.en: These pesticides are gradually going out of use.
examples.zh: 这些农药正逐渐不再使用。

senses.def: if something comes naturally

examples.en: Making money came naturally to him.
examples.zh: 赚钱对他来说轻而易举。

examples.en: We were simply doing what came naturally.
examples.zh: 我们只是在做自然而然的事。

senses.def: when a person comes of age

examples.en: The money will go to the children when they come of age.
examples.zh: 孩子成年后，这笔钱将归还给他们。

senses.def: if something comes of age

examples.en: It was the year that concern for the environment really came of age.
examples.zh: 那一年，人们对环境的关注真正成熟起来。

examples.zh: 自遇到玛丽以后，他真的变开朗了。

senses.def: to win a contest or an argument
senses.zh: （在比赛或辩论中）名列前茅，先拔头筹

examples.en: In most boardroom disputes he tends to come out on top.
examples.zh: 在大多数董事会议的辩论中，他往往占据上风。

senses.def: whether there is rain or sun; whatever happens
senses.zh: 不论是雨或是晴；不管发生什么事

examples.en: He goes jogging every morning, rain or shine.
examples.zh: 他每天早晨出去跑步，风雨无阻。

examples.en: We work outside every day, rain or shine.
examples.zh: 我们每天在外面干活，风雨无阻。

senses.zh: 赶紧做某人喜欢的事；急于应某人的要求

examples.zh: 她知道只要打个电话，他就会高高兴兴地照办。

senses.def: to have an accident; to get into trouble

senses.zh: 扮演（某类人）；以（某种方式）行事

examples.zh: 别跟我扮无辜。

senses.def: to stop completely

examples.en: The car began to shudder and eventually came to a full stop in front of the church.
examples.zh: 车子开始颤抖，最终在教堂前停了下来。

senses.def: to reach a sad or difficult state
senses.zh: 陷于不妙的（或困难的）境地；落到这步田地

examples.en: I never thought things would come to this pretty pass.
examples.zh: 我从没想过事情会发展到这一步。

examples.en: Things have come to a pretty pass when we can’t afford to pay the heating bills!
examples.zh: 当我们付不起取暖费时，事情就变得很糟糕了！

senses.def: to start fighting because of something

examples.en: We almost came to blows over what colour the new carpet should be.
examples.zh: 为了新地毯的颜色，我们差点大打出手。

examples.en: The children came to blows over the new toy.
examples.zh: 孩子们为了争那件新玩具动起手来。

senses.def: to end in total failure
senses.zh: 以彻底失败而告终；惨遭失败

examples.en: All his schemes for making money seem to come to grief.
examples.zh: 他所有的赚钱计划似乎都以失败告终。

senses.def: to be harmed in an accident

examples.en: Several pedestrians came to grief on the icy pavement.
examples.zh: 几个行人在结了冰的人行道上摔伤了。

senses.def: to agree to obey somebody and accept their orders
to come close to the person who has called it
to become more interesting, exciting or full of activity
senses.zh: 变得更有趣（或使人兴奋）；变得活跃

examples.en: The match finally came to life in the second half.
examples.zh: 比赛在下半场终于精彩起来。

examples.en: The city only comes to life at night.
examples.zh: 这个城市要到夜晚才充满生机。

senses.def: to start to act or move as if alive

examples.en: In my dream all my toys came to life.
examples.zh: 在我的梦里，玩具都活过来了。

senses.def: to become known to people
senses.zh: 为人所知；变得众所周知；暴露

examples.en: New evidence has recently come to light.
examples.zh: 新的证据最近已披露出来。

come to nothing: @@@LINK=come to nothing | not come to anything

senses.def: to be unsuccessful; to have no successful result

examples.en: How sad that all his hard work should come to nothing.
examples.zh: 他的所有辛勤劳动竟全部付诸东流，太让人伤心了。

examples.en: Her plans didn't come to anything.
examples.zh: 她的计划全落空了。

come to nothing | not come to anything.word: come to nothing | not come to anything

examples.en: How did such a disaster come to pass?
examples.zh: 这样的灾难是怎样发生的？

examples.en: I wondered how it came to pass that a thinking man bore the prejudices of his unthinking parents.
examples.zh: 我想知道一个有思想的人如何忍受他无思想的父母的偏见。

senses.def: to stop moving

examples.en: The car crashed through the barrier and came to rest in a field.
examples.zh: 汽车闯过护栏，在一块田里停了下来。

examples.en: His eyes came to rest on Clara's face.
examples.zh: 他的目光停留在克拉拉的脸上。

examples.en: The ball rolled down the hill and came to rest against a tree.
examples.zh: 球滚下山，撞在一棵树上停了下来。

senses.def: to become known by somebody
senses.zh: 被某人知道；被某人获悉

examples.en: It has come to our knowledge that you have been taking time off without permission.
examples.zh: 我们了解到你们时常未经允许就不上班。

senses.def: to reach a sad or difficult state
senses.zh: 陷于不妙的（或困难的）境地；落到这步田地

examples.en: I never thought things would come to such a pass as this.
examples.zh: 我没想到事情会发展到这样的地步。

examples.en: Things have come to a such a pass when we can’t afford to pay the heating bills!
examples.zh: 事情已经发展到这样的地步，我们已经付不起取暖费了！

senses.def: to reach an agreement with somebody; to find a way of living or working together

examples.en: The enemy was eventually forced to come to terms.
examples.zh: 敌人最终被迫妥协。

senses.def: to accept something unpleasant by learning to deal with it
senses.zh: 迁就顺从；接受（令人不快的事物）；适应（困难的处境）

examples.en: She is still coming to terms with her son's death.
examples.zh: 她还没有完全从儿子死亡的阴影中走出来。

senses.zh: （引出与刚提及的事物相关的事）说起…来，既然如此，假如那样的话

examples.en: I don't really trust him—or his wife, come to that.

senses.zh: 变得重要（或突出）；起重要作用

examples.zh: 近几个月来这个问题又成为热点。

examples.en: She has always been to the fore at moments of crisis.
examples.zh: 在危急时刻她总是挺身而出。

senses.def: to join formal discussions about something
senses.zh: 加入正式协商；来到谈判桌前

examples.en: Different countries come to the table with differing expectations about what they can achieve.
examples.zh: 不同国家带着对结果的不同期待参与协商。

senses.zh: （用于突然想起某事或认识到其重要性）想起来了，的确

examples.zh: 想起来了，他确实提到看见过你。

to become reality

examples.zh: 获得这枚奖牌好比梦想成真。

examples.en: All her wishes came true.
examples.zh: 她所有的愿望都实现了。

if a plan, etc. comes unglued
to become separated from something it was stuck or fastened to

examples.zh: 信封的封口没粘牢，张开了。

senses.def: to fail completely, with bad results

examples.en: Their plans came badly unstuck.
examples.zh: 他们的计划严重失败。

examples.en: If you keep on taking risks, you’ll come unstuck one day.
examples.zh: 如果你继续冒险，有一天你就会陷入困境。

senses.def: to still have a good reputation, even though you have been involved in something that might have given people a bad opinion of you
senses.zh: 虽卷入…而好名声依旧；事后于名誉无损

examples.en: Nobody ever knew the details and he came out of the deal smelling of roses.
examples.zh: 谁也不知道那笔交易的内幕细节，因此他名声依旧。

senses.zh: 打出王牌；做有助于获得（意外）成功的事

examples.en: I didn't honestly think he'd pass the exam but he came up trumps on the day.
examples.zh: 说实话我以为他考试及不了格，但是那天他发挥出色，考得不错。

examples.en: Just when we thought there was no hope, my parents turned up trumps with a large loan.
examples.zh: 就在我们以为已经没有希望的时候，我的父母突然拿出了一大笔贷款。

senses.def: despite any problems or difficulties you may have
senses.zh: 不管出现什么问题；无论有什么困难；不管怎样

examples.zh: 他答应不管出现什么问题都支持她。

senses.def: to happen to you by chance, or when you were not expecting it
senses.zh: 意外落在…头上；偶尔发生在…身上

examples.zh: 他选择了他遇到的第一份工作。

examples.zh: 你最近读到什么有意思的文章了吗？

senses.def: to be successful from the beginning, especially in sport
senses.zh: （尤指体育运动）从一开始就很成功

examples.zh: 灰熊队一开场就斗志昂扬，迅速以 27 比 10 领先。

examples.zh: 今年该队奋力争取开门红。

senses.zh: （事情或经历）兜了一圈回到原处

examples.zh: 你能告诉我事故是怎样发生的吗？

examples.zh: 他讲了很久，但并没有人真正理解他的意思。

senses.def: to make a particular impression
senses.zh: 给人以…印象；使产生…印象

examples.zh: 她在面试中常给人留下很好的印象。

examples.zh: 他给人的印象是一个富有同情心的人。

senses.def: to meet or find somebody/something by chance

examples.en: I came across children sleeping under bridges.
examples.zh: 我偶然发现睡在桥下的孩子。

examples.en: She came across some old photographs in a drawer.
examples.zh: 她在抽屉里偶然发现了一些旧照片。

examples.en: I hoped she'd come across with some more information.
examples.zh: 我希望她能再提供更多的信息。

senses.def: to run after or follow somebody
senses.zh: 追赶某人；跟在某人后面

examples.en: When the right opportunity comes along, she'll take it.
examples.zh: 适当的机会来临时，她会抓住的。

senses.def: to go somewhere with somebody

examples.en: I'm glad you came along.
examples.zh: 有你跟我一起来，我很高兴。

senses.def: to improve or develop in the way that you want

examples.zh: 你的法语最近进步很大。

senses.def: used in orders to tell somebody to hurry, or to try harder

examples.en: Come along! We're late.
examples.zh: 快点！我们迟到了。

examples.zh: 再加把劲！这很容易！

examples.zh: 这本书就在我手中散开了。

examples.zh: 我的整个生活都崩溃了。

examples.zh: 你的母亲麻醉后还没有苏醒过来。

examples.zh: 我的生日似乎一年比一年来得快。

examples.zh: 务必抽空来看看我们。

examples.en: He'll never come around to my way of thinking.
examples.zh: 他绝不会改变观点与我的思路一致。

senses.def: to move towards somebody as though you are going to attack them

examples.en: She came at me with a knife.
examples.zh: 她拿着刀子向我扑过来。

examples.en: The noise came at us from all sides.
examples.zh: 噪音从四面八方向我们袭来。

senses.def: to think about a problem, question, etc. in a particular way

examples.en: We're getting nowhere—let's come at it from another angle.
examples.zh: 我们这样会毫无进展，还是换个角度考虑一下吧。

senses.def: to become separated from something

examples.en: The plaster had started to come away from the wall.
examples.zh: 灰泥已开始从墙上剥落。

senses.def: to leave a place with a particular feeling or impression

examples.en: We came away with the impression that all was not well with their marriage.
examples.zh: 我们离开时有一种印象：他们的婚姻并不十分美满。

senses.def: to return

examples.en: You came back (= came home) very late last night.
examples.zh: 你昨晚回来得很晚。

examples.zh: 她的双颊又泛起了红晕。

examples.zh: 联队在先失两球的情况下将比分扳回，最终以 3:2 取胜。

examples.en: Come back, I need to talk to you!
examples.zh: 回来吧，我有话要跟你说！

senses.def: to reply to somebody angrily or with force
senses.zh: 强有力地（或愤怒地）答复；反驳

examples.en: She came back at the speaker with some sharp questions.
examples.zh: 她用一些尖锐的提问来反驳讲话人。

senses.def: to return to somebody’s memory

examples.en: It's all coming back to me now.
examples.zh: 现在我全都回想起来了。

examples.en: Once you've been in France a few days, your French will soon come back.
examples.zh: 只要在法国待上几天，你的法语就会很快恢复的。

senses.def: to become popular or successful again

examples.en: Long hair for men seems to be coming back in.
examples.zh: 男子留长发好像又在流行了。

senses.def: to return to a subject, an idea, etc.

examples.en: Let's come back to the point at issue.
examples.zh: 咱们还是回到问题的焦点吧。

examples.en: It all comes back to a question of money.
examples.zh: 一切又回到钱的问题上来了。

senses.def: to be presented to somebody/something for discussion or a decision
senses.zh: 被提交给…讨论（或作决定）

examples.en: The case comes before the court next week.
examples.zh: 这案件在下周庭审。

senses.def: to damage a relationship between two people

examples.en: I'd hate anything to come between us.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢任何有损我们之间关系的事情。

senses.def: to make a short visit to a place, in order to see somebody

examples.en: She came by the house.
examples.zh: 她来家里看了一下。

senses.def: to manage to get something

examples.en: Jobs are hard to come by these days.
examples.zh: 如今找工作很难。

senses.def: to receive something

examples.en: How did you come by that scratch on your cheek?
examples.zh: 你脸颊上的抓伤是怎么来的？

senses.def: a popular British television programme in which couples and teams competed in ballroom
senses.zh: 快来跳舞：这是英国最受欢迎的电视节目，情侣和团队参加舞厅舞比赛。它于1996年结束，2004年，一个名为《严格来跳舞》的新节目取代了它。

senses.def: to break and fall to the ground

examples.en: The ceiling came down with a terrific crash.
examples.zh: 随着一声可怕的巨响，天花板塌了下来。

senses.def: to fall

examples.en: The rain came down in torrents.
examples.zh: 大雨滂沱。

senses.def: to land or fall from the sky

examples.en: We were forced to come down in a field.
examples.zh: 我们被迫降落在田野里。

senses.def: if a price, a temperature, a rate, etc. comes down

examples.en: The price of gas is coming down.
examples.zh: 煤气价格在下跌。

examples.en: Gas is coming down in price.
examples.zh: 煤气价格在下跌。

senses.zh: 决定并宣布（支持或反对）

examples.en: The committee came down in support of his application.
examples.zh: 委员会决定并宣布支持他的申请。

senses.def: to reach as far down as a particular point
senses.zh: 下垂，向下延伸（到某一点）

examples.en: Her hair comes down to her waist.
examples.zh: 她的头发垂至腰部。

senses.def: to become less excited or happy, especially after taking drugs

examples.en: As the drug wore off I felt myself coming down.
examples.zh: 随着药效的消失，我感觉自己的情绪开始下降。

senses.zh: （大学学期结束或毕业时）离校（尤指牛津或剑桥）

senses.zh: 从…到…（通常指从一国的北部到南部，或从大地方到小地方）

senses.def: to have come from a long time in the past

examples.zh: 这名称是从上个世纪流传下来的。

senses.def: to criticize somebody severely or punish somebody

examples.zh: 不要太严厉地责备她。

examples.en: The courts are coming down heavily on young offenders.
examples.zh: 法庭对年轻罪犯实行严惩。

senses.def: to depend on a single important point

examples.en: What it comes down to is either I get more money or I leave.
examples.zh: 归结起来就是：不给我加薪，我就辞职。

senses.def: to get an illness that is not very serious

examples.en: I think I'm coming down with flu.
examples.zh: 我好像得了流感。

examples.zh: 警察来抓布拉德的时候他就在家里。

senses.def: to move towards somebody to attack them
senses.zh: （为攻击某人而）走到跟前，走近

examples.en: The guy was coming for me with a knife.
examples.zh: 那家伙拿着刀冲我而来。

senses.def: to offer your help, services, etc.
senses.zh: 主动提供（帮助或服务等）

examples.zh: 有几个人自动站出来提供了信息。

examples.en: Police have asked witnesses of the accident to come forward.
examples.zh: 警方呼吁事故的目击者出来提供线索。

senses.def: to have as your place of birth or the place where you live

examples.en: She comes from London.
examples.zh: 她是伦敦人。

examples.en: Where do you come from?
examples.zh: 你是什么地方的人？

senses.def: to start in a particular place or be produced from a particular thing

examples.en: Much of our butter comes from New Zealand.
examples.zh: 我们的黄油大多产自新西兰。

examples.en: This wool comes from goats, not sheep.
examples.zh: 这种羊毛是山羊毛，不是绵羊毛。

examples.en: This poem comes from his new book.
examples.zh: 这首诗出自他的新书。

examples.en: Where does her attitude come from?
examples.zh: 她的态度因何而起？

examples.en: Where's that smell coming from?
examples.zh: 那种气味是哪里来的？

examples.zh: 他出身于演员世家。

examples.zh: “她没有竭尽全力。”“你自己也没尽力，还说别人。”

senses.def: to be the result of something

examples.zh: 我做过一些查询，但到头来却毫无结果。

examples.en: That comes of eating too much!
examples.zh: 那是吃得太多的结果！

senses.def: to win when it was not expected because you seemed to be losing

examples.en: They surprised everyone by coming from behind to beat Buxton 2–1.
examples.zh: 他们后来居上，以 2-1 击败巴克斯顿，这让所有人都大吃一惊。

senses.def: appearing to be trying to attract somebody sexually

examples.en: a come-hither look

senses.def: to enter a room or building

examples.en: Come in! (= used when somebody knocks at a door)
examples.zh: 进来！（用于有人敲门时）

senses.def: when the tide
to finish a race in a particular position
