examples.zh: 承担抵押贷款是一项巨大的经济支出。

examples.en: the commitment of resources to education
examples.zh: 对教育的资源投入

examples.en: Achieving success at this level requires a commitment of time and energy.
examples.zh: 取得这种水平的成就需要花费时间和精力。

senses.def: the official process of sending somebody to prison or to a psychiatric
senses.zh: 将某人送进监狱或精神病院的官方程序

examples.en: He was released on bail pending committal proceedings.
examples.zh: 他交保获释正在候审。

senses.def: the point in a funeral
senses.zh: 葬礼上尸体被埋葬或火化的时刻

examples.en: The funeral will take place at St Andrew's Church, followed by a private family committal at the crematorium.
examples.zh: 葬礼将在圣安德鲁教堂举行，随后在火葬场举行私人家庭葬礼。

senses.def: a group of people who are chosen, usually by a larger group, to make decisions or to deal with a particular subject

examples.zh: 议会/国会/参议院委员会

examples.zh: 委员会已决定将活动推迟到今年晚些时候。

examples.zh: 委员会一致通过了计划。

examples.zh: 他曾在多个委员会任职。

examples.zh: 我已被邀请担任委员会成员。

examples.zh: 他将被传唤到委员会作证。

examples.zh: 议员/专家委员会

examples.zh: 稻米、面粉和其他基本商品

examples.zh: 商品价格的下跌

examples.zh: 原油是世界上最重要的商品。

examples.zh: 基本农产品

senses.def: a thing that is useful or has a useful quality
senses.zh: 有用的东西；有使用价值的事物

examples.en: Water is a precious commodity that is often taken for granted in the West.
examples.zh: 水很宝贵，但在西方国家人们往往意识不到这一点。

intro.zh: 以上各词均指产品、商品。

items.zh: 指制造或种植的产品

examples.zh: 创造／开发／推出新产品

examples.zh: 我们只售当地的新鲜农产品。

senses.def: happening often; existing in large numbers or in many places

examples.en: a common problem/occurrence/practice
examples.zh: 常见问题／事件／做法

examples.en: a common feature/theme
examples.zh: 常见特征／主题

examples.en: the most common type of injury
examples.zh: 最常见的损伤类型

examples.en: Breast cancer is the most common form of cancer among women in this country.
examples.zh: 乳腺癌是这个国家妇女中最常见的一种癌症。

examples.en: Jackson is a common English name.
examples.zh: 杰克逊是常见的英语人名。

examples.en: Some birds that were once a common sight are now becoming rare.
examples.zh: 一些曾经常见的鸟类现在变得越来越稀有。

examples.en: a common spelling mistake
examples.zh: 常犯的拼写错误

examples.en: Bad weather is the most common cause of flight delays.
examples.zh: 恶劣天气是航班延误的最常见原因。

examples.en: The disease is very common in young horses.
examples.zh: 这种病很常见于马驹。

examples.en: Allergies to milk are quite common in childhood.
examples.zh: 对牛奶过敏在儿童时期很常见。

examples.en: They share a common interest in photography.
examples.zh: 他们在摄影方面兴趣相投。

examples.en: to have a common ancestor/enemy
examples.zh: 有共同的祖先／敌人

examples.en: the need to cooperate to achieve a common goal
examples.zh: 为达成一个共同目标进行合作的必要

examples.en: We are working together for a common purpose.
examples.zh: 我们在为一个共同的目标一起工作。

examples.en: The various groups all learn Arabic, so they have a common language.
examples.zh: 各个群体都学习阿拉伯语，因此他们有共同的语言。

examples.en: common ownership of the land
examples.zh: 土地的共同所有权

examples.en: This decision was taken for the common good (= the advantage of everyone).
examples.zh: 作出这个决定是为了共同的利益。

examples.en: It is, by common consent, Scotland's prettiest coast (= everyone agrees that it is).
examples.zh: 这是苏格兰公认的最美丽的海岸。

examples.en: basic features that are common to all human languages
examples.zh: 所有人类语言共有的基本特征

examples.en: The report identifies three core problems that are common to many businesses.
examples.zh: 该报告指出了许多企业普遍存在的三个核心问题。

senses.zh: 普通的；平常的；寻常的；平凡的

examples.en: Shakespeare's work was popular among the common people in his day.
examples.zh: 莎士比亚的作品在他那个年代很受平民百姓的欢迎。

examples.en: In most people's eyes she was nothing more than a common criminal.
examples.zh: 在多数人的眼里她只不过是个普通的罪犯。

examples.en: You'd think he'd have the common courtesy to apologize (= this would be the polite behaviour that people would expect).
examples.zh: 你还以为他会懂得起码的礼貌去道个歉呢。

examples.en: It's only common decency to let her know what's happening (= people would expect it).
examples.zh: 出于礼貌，该让她知道正在发生的事。

senses.def: found or living in quite large numbers; not rare

examples.en: the common garden frog
examples.zh: 园地里常见的青蛙

examples.en: I wanted a recording of the common cuckoo.
examples.zh: 我想要常见的布谷鸟叫声的录音。

examples.en: The swordfish is not common in European waters.
examples.zh: 旗鱼在欧洲水域并不常见。

examples.en: She thought he was very common and uneducated.
examples.zh: 她认为他很粗俗且无教养。

examples.zh: 他们的关系是众所周知的。

examples.zh: 这两种文化具有许多相同之处。

examples.zh: 我的老天，你也凭常识想想！

examples.zh: 按常理解决问题的方法

senses.def: the state of sharing features

examples.en: There is a high degree of commonality between the different computer science courses on offer.
examples.zh: 所提供的不同计算机科学课程之间存在高度的共性。

examples.en: The group is working with other organizations that share a commonality of approach and purpose.
examples.zh: 该小组正在与具有共同方法和目标的其他组织合作。

senses.def: a shared feature

examples.en: We need to understand the differences between us and the commonalities that we share.
examples.zh: 我们需要了解我们之间的差异以及我们的共同点。

senses.def: a system in which each person owns their flat in a building but the building and shared areas are owned by everyone together
senses.zh: 公寓楼共有制度（住户共同拥有楼房及公用区域）

senses.def: usually; very often; by most people

examples.en: Christopher is commonly known as Kit.
examples.zh: 克里斯托弗通常被称为基特。

examples.en: the sudden increase in the birth rate after the Second World War, commonly referred to as the ‘baby boom’
examples.zh: 第二次世界大战后出生率突然上升，通常称为“婴儿潮”

examples.en: avian influenza, commonly called bird flu
examples.zh: 禽流感，俗称禽流感

examples.en: This is one of the most commonly used methods.
examples.zh: 这是最常采用的方法之一。

examples.en: symptoms commonly associated with HIV
examples.zh: 通常与艾滋病毒相关的症状

examples.en: These fats are commonly found in processed foods.
examples.zh: 这些脂肪常见于加工食品。

examples.en: one of the most commonly available substances on the planet
examples.zh: 地球上最常见的物质之一

senses.def: done very often, or existing in many places, and therefore not unusual

examples.en: This technology is now commonplace in schools.
examples.zh: 这种技术现在在学校很普遍。

senses.def: an event, etc. that happens very often and is not unusual
a remark, etc. that is not new or interesting
senses.zh: 平淡无奇的言语等；老生常谈

examples.en: The speech was full of commonplaces.
examples.zh: 讲话充满了老生常谈。

senses.def: (especially in the past) a book into which you copy parts of other books, poems, etc. and add your own comments
an organization consisting of the United Kingdom and other countries, including most of the countries that used to be part of the British Empire
senses.zh: 英联邦（由英国和其他大多数曾经隶属于大英帝国的国家组成）

examples.en: a member of the Commonwealth
examples.zh: 英联邦成员国

examples.en: Commonwealth countries
examples.zh: 英联邦国家

examples.en: There is an annual meeting of Commonwealth heads of government.
examples.zh: 英联邦政府首脑每年召开会议。

senses.def: used in the official names of, and to refer to, some states of the US (Kentucky, Massachusetts, Pennsylvania and Virginia)
senses.zh: 州（用于美国肯塔基、马萨诸塞、宾夕法尼亚和弗吉尼亚四州的正式名称中）

examples.en: the Commonwealth of Virginia
examples.zh: 弗吉尼亚州

examples.en: The city and the Commonwealth have lost a great leader.
examples.zh: 这座城市和这个州失去了一位伟大的领袖。

senses.def: an independent country that is strongly connected to the US
senses.zh: （与美国联系紧密的）自治政区

examples.en: Puerto Rico remains a US commonwealth, not a state.
examples.zh: 波多黎各至今仍然是美国的一个自治政区，而不是一个州。

senses.def: used in the names of some groups of countries or states that have chosen to be politically linked with each other
senses.zh: （用于某些政治上相互有联系的国家集团的名称）联合体

examples.en: the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS)
examples.zh: 独立国家联合体（独联体）

examples.en: We want to create a commonwealth of democratic, self-governing countries.
examples.zh: 我们希望创造一个民主、自治的国家联合体。

senses.def: a period (1649–60) in English history when the country was governed without a king or queen. For the first four years after the death of King Charles I, the country was governed by the House of Commons
senses.zh: 联邦：英国历史上一段时期（1649–60），该国在没有国王或王后的情况下进行统治。国王查理一世去世后的头四年，该国由下议院统治。然后在1653年，军队以保卫勋爵的头衔授予奥利弗·克伦威尔（Oliver Cromwell）权力。因此1653–9年被称为保护国。英联邦以查理二世国王的复辟而告终。

senses.def: a public holiday in some parts of the Commonwealth (but not Britain), celebrated every year on the second Monday in March. Before 1958 it was called Empire Day.
senses.zh: 英联邦日：每年3月的第二个星期一庆祝英联邦某些地区（但不包括英国）的公共假日。在1958年之前，它被称为帝国日。

senses.def: sudden noisy and confused activity or excitement

examples.en: I heard a commotion and went to see what was happening.
examples.zh: 我听到一阵喧闹，便去看看发生了什么事情。

examples.en: The crowd waiting outside was causing a commotion.
examples.zh: 在外面等待的人群眼看就要发生骚乱。

examples.en: What's all the commotion about?
examples.zh: 这喧闹声是怎么回事？

senses.def: communications

examples.en: You'll need to get radio comms set up.
examples.zh: 你需要设置无线电通信。

examples.en: The company is a subscription-based IT and comms provider.
examples.zh: 该公司是一家基于订阅的 IT 和通信提供商。

senses.def: shared by, or for the use of, a number of people, especially people who live together
senses.zh: （尤指居住在一起的人）共享的，共有的，共用的

examples.en: a communal kitchen/garden
examples.zh: 公用厨房/花园

examples.en: As a student he tried communal living for a few years.
examples.zh: 当学生时他尝试过几年集体生活。

senses.def: involving different groups of people in a community
senses.zh: （集体中）不同群体的，各团体的

examples.en: communal violence between religious groups
examples.zh: 不同教派之间的暴力冲突

senses.def: the fact of living together and sharing possessions and responsibilities
a strong sense of belonging to a particular community, especially a religious community, that can lead to extreme behaviour or violence towards others
senses.zh: 社群主义，宗教社群主义（可导致极端排外或暴力行为）

senses.def: in a way that is shared by, or for the use of, a number of people, especially people who live together
senses.zh: （尤指居住在一起的人）共享的，共有的，共用的

examples.en: The property was owned communally.
examples.zh: 财产属集体所有。

senses.def: a group of people who live together and share responsibilities, possessions, etc.
senses.zh: （共同生活、分担责任、共享财产等的）群体，公社

examples.en: a 1970s hippy commune
examples.zh: 20 世纪 70 年代的嬉皮士群体

examples.en: She lives in a commune.
examples.zh: 她生活在一个群居村里。

examples.en: The commune is/are part of a social movement of the poor that fights for housing and human dignity.
examples.zh: 该公社是穷人争取住房和人类尊严的社会运动的一部分。

senses.def: the smallest division of local government in France and some other countries
senses.zh: （法国及其他一些国家的）最小的行政区

senses.def: to share your emotions and feelings with somebody/something without speaking
senses.zh: 与…默默分享情感（或沟通、交融）

examples.en: He spent much of his time communing with nature.
examples.zh: 他把他的许多时间都用来沉浸在大自然中。

senses.def: that somebody can pass on to other people or communicate to somebody else

examples.en: communicable diseases
examples.zh: 传染性疾病

examples.en: The value of the product must be communicable to the potential consumers.
examples.zh: 产品的价值必须能够传达给潜在的消费者。

senses.def: a person who receives Communion
to share or exchange information, news, ideas, feelings, etc.
senses.zh: 交流（信息、消息、意见、情感等）

examples.en: We only communicate by email.
examples.zh: 我们只是互通电邮。

examples.en: They communicated in sign language.
examples.zh: 他们用手语沟通。

examples.en: Candidates must be able to communicate effectively.
examples.zh: 候选人必须能够有效地沟通。

examples.en: Dolphins use sound to communicate with each other.
examples.zh: 海豚用声音相互沟通。

examples.en: Direct marketing allows a firm to communicate directly with its customers.
examples.zh: 直接营销允许公司直接与其客户沟通。

examples.en: In times of uncertainty, a leader must be able to communicate a message of hope.
examples.zh: 在前景不明朗的时候，领导者必须能够传递希望的信息。

examples.en: Language evolved as a means of communicating information between individuals.
examples.zh: 语言是作为个体之间交流信息的手段而发展起来的。

examples.en: He was eager to communicate his ideas to the group.
examples.zh: 他急于把他的想法传达给小组。

examples.en: Her nervousness was communicating itself to the children.
examples.zh: 她紧张不安的情绪传递给了孩子们。

examples.en: They failed to communicate what was happening and why.
examples.zh: 他们没说清楚当时发生了什么以及起因是什么。

senses.def: to have a good relationship because you are able to understand and talk about your own and other people’s thoughts, feelings, etc.

examples.en: His inability to communicate has damaged their relationship beyond repair.
examples.zh: 他欠缺沟通能力，使他们的关系受到无法修复的伤害。

examples.en: The novel is about a family who can't communicate with each other.
examples.zh: 这部小说写的是一个成员间彼此无法沟通的家庭。

examples.en: couples who communicate well with one another
examples.zh: 相互间沟通良好的夫妇

senses.group: in a relationship 人际关系

senses.def: to pass a disease from one person, animal, etc. to another

examples.en: The disease is communicated through dirty drinking water.
examples.zh: 这种疾病通过不干净的饮用水传播。

senses.def: if two rooms communicate

examples.en: a communicating door (= one that connects two rooms)
examples.zh: 连通门

senses.group: of two rooms 两个房间

intro.en: These words all mean to share news, information, ideas or feelings with another person or other people, especially by talking with them.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含交流、交谈之义。

items.def: to speak in order to give information, express feelings or share ideas:
items.zh: 指说话、讲话、谈话

examples.en: We talked on the phone for over an hour.
examples.zh: 我们在电话里谈了一个多小时。

items.def: (rather formal) to talk and share ideas on a subject or problem with other people, especially in order to decide something:
items.zh: 指谈论、讨论、商量

examples.en: Have you discussed the problem with anyone?
examples.zh: 你与谁商量过这个问题吗？

items.def: to talk to somebody about something; to have a conversation with somebody:
items.zh: 指谈话、交谈

examples.en: I’ve spoken to the manager about it.
examples.zh: 那件事我已经和经理谈过了。

items.def: (rather formal) to exchange information or ideas with somebody:
items.zh: 指与某人交流信息或意见

examples.en: We only communicate by email.
examples.zh: 我们只是互通电邮。

items.def: to discuss something, especially formally, before making a decision or finding a solution:
items.zh: （尤指正式）讨论、辩论

examples.en: Politicians will be debating the bill later this week.
examples.zh: 政界将在本周晚些时候讨论这项议案。

items.def: (rather formal) to discuss something with somebody in order to get their permission for something, or to help you make a decision:
items.zh: 指（与某人）商议、商量（以得到许可或帮助决策）

examples.en: You shouldn’t have done it without consulting me.
examples.zh: 你不该不和我商量就做。

senses.def: the activity or process of expressing ideas and feelings or of giving people information

examples.en: Good communication between team leaders and members is essential.
examples.zh: 团队领导和成员之间的良好沟通至关重要。

examples.en: attempts to improve communication with customers
examples.zh: 改善与客户沟通的尝试

examples.en: Cybercriminals are also relying on encrypted communication channels.
examples.zh: 网络犯罪分子还依赖加密的通信渠道。

examples.en: helping students develop their communication skills
examples.zh: 帮助学生发展沟通技能

examples.en: non-verbal communication such as gestures or facial expressions
examples.zh: 诸如肢体动作或面部表情等非言语交际

examples.en: We are in regular communication by email.
examples.zh: 我们定期通过电子邮件联系。

senses.def: methods of sending information, especially phones, radio, computers, etc. or roads and railways

examples.en: communications technology
examples.zh: 通信技术

examples.en: to launch a communications satellite
examples.zh: 发射通信卫星

examples.en: wireless/electronic/satellite communication
examples.zh: 无线／电子／卫星通信

examples.en: to intercept/disrupt/monitor communications
examples.zh: 拦截／干扰／监听通信

examples.en: The new airport will improve communications between the islands.
examples.zh: 新机场将改善岛屿间的交通联系。

senses.def: a message, letter or phone call

examples.en: a communication from the leader of the party
examples.zh: 来自该党领袖的信息

senses.def: willing to talk and give information to other people

examples.en: I don't find her very communicative.
examples.zh: 我觉得她不太善于交际。

examples.en: He wasn’t very communicative and kept things to himself.
examples.zh: 他不太善于交际，喜欢把事情藏在心里。

senses.def: connected with the ability to communicate in a language, especially a foreign language
senses.zh: 语言交际能力的（尤指用外语）

examples.en: communicative skills
examples.zh: 语言交际能力

senses.def: a person’s ability to communicate information and ideas in a foreign language
a person who communicates something to others

examples.en: an effective/skilled/successful communicator
examples.zh: 有效的／熟练的／成功的交际者

examples.en: a poor communicator
examples.zh: 不善于交流的人

examples.en: It was his skill as a communicator which made the television programmes so successful.
examples.zh: 正是他作为沟通者的技巧使电视节目如此成功。

examples.en: The ideal candidate will be an effective communicator.
examples.zh: 理想的候选人定要是善于沟通的人。

intro.en: These are all words for a person who talks or who is talking, especially in a particular way.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指说话者，尤指以某种方式说话的人。

items.def: a person who is or was speaking; a person who speaks a particular language:
items.zh: 指发言者、讲某种语言的人

examples.en: I looked around to see who the speaker was.
examples.zh: 我四下环顾看说话的是谁。

items.def: (rather formal) a person who is able to describe their ideas and feelings clearly to others:
items.zh: 指交际者、交流者

examples.en: The ideal candidate will be an effective communicator.
examples.zh: 理想的候选人定要是善于沟通的人。

items.def: (disapproving) a person who enjoys talking about other people’s private lives:
items.zh: 指喜欢传播流言蜚语的人、爱说长道短（或说三道四）的人

examples.en: Don't tell anyone, because some people are terrible gossips.
examples.zh: 不要告诉任何人，因为有些人很八卦。

items.def: a person who talks in a particular way or who talks a lot:
items.zh: 指以某种方式说话的人、爱说话的人

examples.en: He’s a very persuasive talker.
examples.zh: 他是一个说话很有说服力的人。

senses.def: the state of sharing or exchanging thoughts and feelings; the feeling of being part of something

examples.en: poets living in communion with nature
examples.zh: 与大自然情感交融的诗人

senses.def: a ceremony in the Christian Church during which people eat bread and drink wine in memory of the last meal that Christ had with his disciples
senses.zh: （基督教教会的）圣餐仪式，领受圣体

examples.en: to go to Communion (= attend church for this celebration)
examples.zh: 去参加圣餐仪式

examples.en: to take/receive communion (= receive the bread and wine)
examples.zh: 领受圣餐

senses.def: a group of people with the same religious beliefs

examples.en: the Anglican communion
examples.zh: 圣公会

senses.def: an official statement or report, especially to newspapers

examples.en: The leaders attending the conference have issued a joint communiqué.
examples.zh: 出席会议的领导人发表了联合公报。

senses.def: a theory or system of social organization in which all property is owned by the community and each person contributes and receives according to their ability and needs
the system of government by a ruling Communist Party, such as in the former USSR

examples.en: a book describing life under Communism
examples.zh: 描写共产主义体制下生活的书籍

senses.def: connected with communism

examples.en: communist ideology
examples.zh: 共产主义思想体系

senses.def: governed by or belonging to a Communist

examples.en: a Communist country/government/leader
examples.zh: 共产党国家／政府／领导人

senses.def: a person who believes in or supports communism
senses.zh: 共产主义者；共产主义的支持者

senses.def: a member of a Communist Party

examples.en: The president of the new democracy is actually a former Communist.
examples.zh: 新民主政体的总统实际上是一个前共产党人。

communist party of the united states of: @@@LINK=the communist party of the united states of america

senses.def: all the people who live in a particular area, country, etc. when talked about as a group

examples.en: The local community supported us from the start.
examples.zh: 当地社区从一开始就支持我们。

examples.en: the international community (= the countries of the world as a group)
examples.zh: 国际社会

examples.en: It is hoped that the campaign will encourage members of the community to get active.
examples.zh: 希望这次活动能鼓励社区成员积极行动起来。

examples.en: the problems faced by rural communities
examples.zh: 农村社区面临的问题

examples.en: good community relations with the police
examples.zh: 社区与警方之间的良好关系

examples.en: community groups/leaders
examples.zh: 社区团体／领导

examples.en: health workers based in the community (= working with people in a local area)
examples.zh: 以社区为基地的保健工作人员

examples.en: community parks/libraries (= paid for by the local town/city)
examples.zh: 社区公园／图书馆

examples.en: the wider/entire/whole community
examples.zh: 更大的社区；整个社区

examples.en: She comes from a small island community.
examples.zh: 她来自一个小岛社区。

examples.en: Our aim is to serve the community.
examples.zh: 我们的宗旨是服务社会。

senses.def: a group of people who share the same religion, race, job, etc.

examples.en: The Polish community in London has/have a long history.
examples.zh: 伦敦的波兰人社区有着悠久的历史。

examples.en: the business/scientific community
examples.zh: 商界；科学界

examples.en: the Muslim/Jewish/Christian community
examples.zh: 穆斯林／犹太人／基督教社群

examples.en: the gay community
examples.zh: 同性恋群体

examples.en: the intelligence community (= all the people whose job is to collect secret information)
examples.zh: 情报界

senses.def: the feeling of sharing things and belonging to a group in the place where you live

examples.en: There is a strong sense of community here.
examples.zh: 这里有一种强烈的社区意识。

examples.en: The town has a strong community spirit.
examples.zh: 该镇有一种强烈的社区意识。

senses.def: a group of people who live together and all equally own and share what they have

examples.en: The nuns live in a closed community.
examples.zh: 修女们住在一个封闭的社区里。

senses.def: a group of plants and animals growing or living in the same place or environment

examples.en: the communities of microbes inhabiting our bodies
examples.zh: 居住在我们体内的微生物群落

senses.def: long-term medical and other care that is given within the community and allows people to live at home rather than in a hospital
senses.zh: 社区护理服务（让长期需要照料者在家中接受医疗等）

senses.def: a place where people from the same area can meet for social events or sports or to take classes
a church for a particular area or group of people, especially one that welcomes people from different Christian denominations
senses.zh: （尤指接纳基督教各派的）社区教堂

examples.en: The family attends the non-denominational Antioch Community Church.
examples.zh: 一家人参加非宗派的安提阿社区教堂。

senses.def: a college that is mainly for students from the local community and that offers programmes that are two years long, including programmes in practical skills
senses.zh: 社区学院（为社区成员提供两年制课程，包括职业技术训练）

senses.def: a secondary school where adults from the local community can attend classes, use the sports facilities, etc. in the evening
senses.zh: 社区中学（在英国除接收本校学生外亦向当地社区成人开放）

senses.def: a large area of land where people can grow flowers, vegetables, etc.

examples.en: The program helped 140 families find plots in community gardens.
examples.zh: 这个项目帮助了 140 个家庭在社区园圃中找到耕种的地块。

senses.def: a garden that is made for many people to use and enjoy

examples.en: The new community garden provides environmental and social benefits for local residents.
examples.zh: 新建的公共花园为当地居民带来环境改善和社交便利。

senses.def: a small hospital for the local community
senses.zh: 社区医院（为当地社区提供基本医疗服务）

examples.en: A woman with severe leg pain was admitted to the community hospital.
examples.zh: 一名腿部严重疼痛的妇女被送往社区医院。

senses.def: a method of teaching a foreign language that uses small groups and other ways of reducing students’ feelings of worry
a decision, made in court, to give a punishment that involves helping people in the community, having treatment for an addiction
senses.zh: 社区服务令（须完成法院规定的社区服务工作或接受戒瘾治疗等，无须入狱）

examples.en: He was sentenced to a community order that involved psychological counselling.
examples.zh: 他被判社区服务，需要接受心理辅导。

senses.def: a person whose job is to manage and organize work done for and by people who live in a particular area
senses.zh: 社区组织者（负责组织管理对本地区居民的服务工作）

examples.en: He worked as a community organizer in Chicago before going into politics.
examples.zh: 在从政之前，他曾在芝加哥担任社区组织者。

examples.en: Community organizers are finalizing plans for the summer youth program.
examples.zh: 社区组织者正在敲定夏季青年计划的计划。

senses.def: a police officer who works together with members of the public to prevent crime and antisocial

examples.en: He's a well-known and popular community police officer.
examples.zh: 他是一位著名且受欢迎的社区警察。

examples.en: Community Police Officer Mia Johnson
examples.zh: 社区警官米娅·约翰逊

senses.def: a system for developing trust and understanding between the people who live in a particular area and the local police, in order to reduce crime in that area. The system involves regular contact between the public and individual police officers and members of the public work together with the police to prevent crime and antisocial
senses.zh: 社区警务：一种在特定地区的人们与当地警察之间建立信任和谅解的系统，目的是减少该地区的犯罪。该系统涉及公众与警官之间以及与警察一起的公共工作人员之间的定期联系，以防止犯罪和反社会行为。

senses.def: property that is considered to belong equally to a married couple
a school that is run by a department of the local authority of a particular county
senses.zh: 社区学校：由特定县地方政府部门运营的学校

senses.def: a secondary school where adults from the local community can attend classes, use the sports facilities, etc. in the evening
senses.zh: 社区中学（在英国除接收本校学生外亦向当地社区成人开放）

senses.def: (in the UK) a punishment, given by a court, that involves helping people in the community, having treatment for an addiction
senses.zh: （英国）社区刑罚，社区服务刑（须完成法院规定的社区服务工作或接受戒瘾治疗等，无须入狱）

examples.en: She was given a two-year community sentence for the assault on her neighbour.
examples.zh: 她因袭击邻居被判处两年社区刑。

senses.def: work helping people in the local community that somebody does without being paid, either because they want to, or because they have been ordered to by a court as a punishment
senses.zh: 社区服务（自愿或因受法庭惩罚的无偿劳动）

senses.def: the spread of a disease within a group of people without any obvious source of infection

examples.en: As more and more countries experience community spread, containment at borders becomes harder.
examples.zh: 随着越来越多国家出现社区传播，边境防控变得越加困难。

senses.def: the activity of producing and acting in plays by people who do it for pleasure and not as a job
senses.zh: 玩票；业余戏剧爱好活动

examples.en: She joined the local community theater in a production of ‘It's a Wonderful Life’.
examples.zh: 她加入一个业余剧团，演出 “美好生活”。

senses.def: a small theatre where these plays are performed

examples.en: The musical has been performed at numerous community theaters in the south-east United States.
examples.zh: 这个音乐剧在美国东南部的众多社区剧场上演。

senses.def: the spread of a disease within a group of people without any obvious source of infection

examples.en: There is no evidence yet of local community transmission within the country.
examples.zh: 尚无证据显示国内出现本地社区传播。

senses.def: close enough or short enough to make travelling to work every day a possibility
senses.zh: 上下班方便的；（离工作地点）近的

senses.def: a commutable
able to be exchanged
the act of making a punishment less severe

examples.en: a commutation of the death sentence to life imprisonment
examples.zh: 由死刑减为终身监禁

senses.def: the act of replacing one method of payment with another; a payment that is replaced with another
giving the same result whatever the order in which the quantities are shown
senses.zh: 交换的（排列次序不影响结果）

senses.def: a device that connects a motor to the electricity supply
a device for changing the direction in which electricity flows
to travel regularly by bus, train, car, etc. between your place of work and your home
senses.zh: （乘公共汽车、火车、汽车等）上下班往返，经常往返（于两地）

examples.en: She commutes from Oxford to London every day.
examples.zh: 她每天上下班往返于牛津与伦敦之间。

examples.en: She commutes from Sunset Park to Manhattan each morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早晨乘车从日落公园去曼哈顿上班。

examples.en: He spent that year commuting between New York and Chicago.
examples.zh: 那年他穿梭来往于纽约与芝加哥之间。

examples.en: I live within commuting distance of Dublin.
examples.zh: 我住在离都柏林上下班可乘公交车往返的地方。

examples.en: People are prepared to commute long distances if they are desperate for work.
examples.zh: 亟需得到工作的人会愿意长途乘车往返上下班。

senses.def: to replace one punishment with another that is less severe

examples.en: The death sentence was commuted to life imprisonment.
examples.zh: 死刑被改判为无期徒刑。

senses.def: to exchange one form of payment, for something else

examples.en: The capital invested will be commuted to a loan.
examples.zh: 投资资本将转换为贷款。

senses.def: the journey that a person makes when they commute

examples.en: a two-hour commute into downtown Washington
examples.zh: 去华盛顿中心区两小时的上下班路程

examples.en: I have only a short commute to work.
examples.zh: 我上班的路程很短。

examples.en: Today most commutes are not suburb to city to suburb but from one suburb to another.
examples.zh: 今天，大多数人的上下班路程不是从郊区到城市到郊区，而是从一个郊区到另一个郊区。

senses.def: a person who travels into a city to work each day, usually from quite far away

examples.en: The five o’clock train is always packed with commuters.
examples.zh: 五点钟那趟车总是挤满了通勤者。

examples.en: the commuter belt (= the area around a city where people live and from which they travel to work in the city)
examples.zh: 上班族居住地带

senses.def: (a person) from Comoros
senses.zh: 科摩罗人；科摩罗的；科摩罗人的

senses.def: affecting somebody at the same time as another disease or medical condition

examples.en: comorbid conditions
examples.zh: 合并症

examples.en: Anxiety and depression are often comorbid with Parkinson's disease.
examples.zh: 焦虑和抑郁通常与帕金森病共存。

senses.def: the presence of two or more diseases or medical conditions at the same time
senses.zh: 同时存在两种或多种疾病或健康状况

examples.en: Age, weight and comorbidity are all risk factors for serious illness.
examples.zh: 年龄、体重和合并症都是严重疾病的危险因素。

senses.def: a disease or medical condition that is present at the same time as another disease or condition
senses.zh: 与另一种疾病或病症同时存在的疾病或病症

examples.en: patients with cardiovascular comorbidities
examples.zh: 有心血管合并症的患者

senses.def: a country consisting of a group of islands in the Indian Ocean
senses.zh: 科摩罗（印度洋的群岛国家）

senses.def: a comprehensive
senses.zh: （英国为各种资质的学生设立的）综合中学

examples.en: Her children go to the local comp.
examples.zh: 她的孩子们上当地的综合中学。

senses.def: a competition

examples.en: To enter our comp answer this question.
examples.zh: 要进入我们的比赛，请回答这个问题。

senses.def: a complimentary
compensation
senses.zh: 补偿（或赔偿）物；（尤指）赔偿金，补偿金；赔偿

examples.en: comp time (= time off work given for working extra hours)
examples.zh: （加班后的）补休时间

senses.def: smaller than is usual for things of the same kind

examples.en: a compact camera
examples.zh: 袖珍照相机

examples.en: The kitchen was compact but well equipped.
examples.zh: 这间厨房虽然空间小但设备齐全。

examples.en: The device is small and compact and weighs only 2.2lb.
examples.zh: 这个设备很小巧，重量仅为 2.2 磅。

senses.def: closely packed together

examples.en: a compact mass of earth
examples.zh: 一堆压得很结实的泥土

examples.en: The grey clouds had become more compact and the sky suddenly grew dark.
examples.zh: 灰色的云层变得更加密实，天空突然暗了下来。

senses.def: small and strong

examples.en: He had a compact and muscular body.
examples.zh: 他个子矮小，身体健壮。

senses.def: a small car
a small flat box with a mirror, containing powder that women use on their faces
a formal agreement between two or more people or countries

examples.en: The government has signed a compact of free association.
examples.zh: 政府签署了自由联合契约。

examples.en: The support will continue under a compact which runs until 2010.
examples.zh: 该支持将根据一份持续到 2010 年的契约继续进行。

senses.def: to press something tightly together

examples.en: a layer of compacted snow
examples.zh: 压紧的一层雪

senses.def: a small disc on which sound or information is recorded, played on a special machine called a CD player
in a way that uses or fills only a small amount of space
in a way that is closely packed together
with a small and strong body
the fact of using or filling only a small amount of space

examples.en: the ladder's light weight and extreme compactness
examples.zh: 梯子重量轻且极其紧凑

senses.def: the quality in a person or an animal of being small and strong
senses.zh: 紧凑性：人或动物的体积小而结实

examples.en: He had the natural compactness of a good ball player.
examples.zh: 他具有优秀球员所具有的天生的紧凑性。

senses.def: the fact of being closely packed together

examples.en: soil compactness
examples.zh: 土壤紧实度

senses.def: a machine that presses rubbish together
senses.zh: 垃圾压实器；垃圾压缩机

examples.en: Trash compactors minimize waste by reducing large quantities of rubbish to smaller amounts.
examples.zh: 垃圾压实机将大量垃圾的体积压缩以使废物量降到最少。

senses.def: a friend or somebody that you spend a lot of time with
the building and organization in Cardiff
senses.zh: 公司大楼：威尔士卡迪夫的建筑物和组织，保存了英格兰和威尔士公司的记录。公司必须将某些信息发送到公司之家，并且大多数信息可供公众使用。在爱丁堡有一个办公室，供苏格兰的公司使用。

senses.def: a person or an animal that travels with you or spends a lot of time with you

examples.en: travelling companions
examples.zh: 旅伴

examples.en: Geoff was my companion on the journey.
examples.zh: 杰夫是我旅途中的同伴。

examples.en: Fear was the hostages' constant companion.
examples.zh: 人质一直都感到恐惧不安。

senses.def: a person who shares your experiences, especially when these are particularly pleasant or unpleasant

examples.en: She was a charming dinner companion.
examples.zh: 与她同桌进餐使人感到十分高兴。

examples.en: His younger brother is not much of a companion for him.
examples.zh: 他的弟弟和他志趣不太相投。

examples.en: They're drinking companions (= they go out drinking together).
examples.zh: 他们是酒友。

examples.en: We became companions in misfortune.
examples.zh: 我们成了患难之交。

examples.en: He was an entertaining dinner companion.
examples.zh: 他是饭桌上大家的开心果。

senses.def: a person, usually a woman, employed to live with and help somebody, especially somebody old or ill
senses.zh: 陪护（通常受雇照料老人或病人）

examples.en: She lived in the house as a companion to our grandmother.
examples.zh: 她住在这栋房子里给我们的祖母作伴。

senses.def: one of a pair of things that go together or can be used together
senses.zh: 成对的物品之一；一副物品中的一个

examples.en: A companion volume is soon to be published.
examples.zh: 这卷书的姊妹篇即将问世。

senses.def: used in book titles to describe a book giving useful facts and information on a particular subject

examples.en: A Companion to French Literature
examples.zh: 《法国文学指南》

senses.def: an animal that you have at home for pleasure, rather than one that is kept for work or food; a pet

examples.en: Companion animals can help reduce stress and offer companionship to lonely people.
examples.zh: 伴侣动物可以帮助减轻压力并为孤独的人提供陪伴。

senses.def: any of the members of a British order of chivalry
senses.zh: 荣誉同伴：由乔治五世国王于1917年发起的英国骑士制度的任何成员。这项荣誉授予经常在政治或艺术领域做出过重要贡献的男女。会员没有荣誉称号，但可以在姓名后加上CH。

senses.def: friendly
senses.zh: 朋友般的；友好的；友善的

examples.en: They walked to the studio together in a companionable silence.
examples.zh: 他们在友好的沉默中一起走向工作室。

senses.def: in a friendly way
senses.zh: 朋友般的；友好的；友善的

senses.def: the pleasant feeling that you have when you have a friendly relationship with somebody and are not alone

examples.en: They meet at the club for companionship and advice.
examples.zh: 他们在俱乐部相会是为了联谊和寻求建议。

examples.en: She had only her cat for companionship.
examples.zh: 她只有猫儿做伴。

examples.en: He had never had any close companionship with another man.
examples.zh: 他从未与其他男人有过亲密的友谊。

senses.def: a set of stairs on a ship
a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services

examples.en: insurance/oil/tech/technology/pharmaceutical companies
examples.zh: 保险／石油／技术／制药公司

examples.en: It is the world's largest software company.
examples.zh: 它是世界上最大的软件公司。

examples.en: He works for the National Bus Company.
examples.zh: 他在国家巴士公司工作。

examples.en: Carrington and Company of London
examples.zh: 伦敦卡林顿公司

examples.en: a large/small company
examples.zh: 大/小公司

examples.en: She runs her own TV production company.
examples.zh: 她经营着自己的电视制作公司。

examples.en: to own/start/found a company
examples.zh: 拥有/创办/创立一家公司

examples.en: The company has/have just announced record profits.
examples.zh: 该公司刚刚宣布创纪录的利润。

examples.en: Smoking in the workplace is against company policy.
examples.zh: 在工作场所吸烟违反公司规定。

examples.en: Company profits were 5 per cent lower than last year.
examples.zh: 公司利润比去年下降5%。

examples.en: a company executive/director
examples.zh: 公司高管/董事

examples.en: a company pension
examples.zh: 企业养老金

senses.def: a group of people who work or perform together

examples.en: a theatre/dance company
examples.zh: 戏剧/舞蹈团

examples.en: the Royal Shakespeare Company
examples.zh: 皇家莎士比亚戏剧团

examples.en: a small touring opera company
examples.zh: 巡演小歌剧团

examples.en: The company has/have just been on tour.
examples.zh: 该公司刚刚进行了巡演。

senses.def: the fact of being with somebody else and not alone

examples.en: I enjoy Jo's company (= I enjoy being with her).
examples.zh: 我喜欢和乔在一起。

examples.en: a pleasant evening in the company of friends
examples.zh: 与朋友一起度过的愉快夜晚

examples.en: She enjoys her own company (= being by herself) when she is travelling.
examples.zh: 她喜爱独自旅行。

examples.en: The children are very good company (= pleasant to be with) at this age.
examples.zh: 和这个年龄的孩子在一起很开心。

examples.en: He's coming with me for company.
examples.zh: 他要陪我一起来。

senses.group: being with somebody 与某人在一起

senses.def: guests in your house

examples.en: I didn't realize you had company.
examples.zh: 我不知道你有客人。

senses.def: a group of people together

examples.en: She told the assembled company what had happened.
examples.zh: 她把发生的事告诉了聚会的人。

examples.en: It is bad manners to whisper in company (= in a group of people).
examples.zh: 在众人面前窃窃私语是不礼貌的行为。

senses.def: a group of soldiers that is part of a battalion
the people that somebody spends time with
senses.zh: 某人所交往的人；伙伴；与之为伍的人

examples.en: Judging by the company he kept, Mark must have been a wealthy man.
examples.zh: 根据马克所交往的人来判断，他一定是位富翁。

examples.en: Jane's mother was worried about the company she kept.
examples.zh: 简的母亲很担心她的陪伴。

senses.def: to be friends with people that others think are bad

examples.en: They worried about their teenage son getting into bad company.
examples.zh: 他们担心十几岁的儿子会结交坏朋友。

examples.en: She got into bad company and got involved in crime.
examples.zh: 她结交了坏朋友，并卷入了犯罪活动。

senses.def: together with or at the same time as somebody/something

examples.en: She arrived in company with the ship's captain.
examples.zh: 她与船长一起到达。

examples.en: The US dollar went through a difficult time, in company with the oil market.
examples.zh: 美元与石油市场同时经历了艰难时期。

senses.def: if you say that somebody is in good company
senses.zh: 无伤大雅（表示不必为错误等担忧，因为他人，尤其是更重要的人也犯过同样的错误）

examples.en: If you worry about your relationship with your teenage son or daughter, you are in good company. Many parents share these worries.
examples.zh: 你要是担心跟十几岁的孩子关系处不好，那很正常。很多家长都有同样的担心。

senses.def: to stay with somebody so that they are not alone

examples.en: I'll keep you company while you're waiting.
examples.zh: 你等待时我会陪伴你。

examples.en: I'll stay and keep you company.
examples.zh: 我会留下来陪你。

senses.def: to leave somebody; to end a relationship with somebody

examples.en: This is where we part company (= go in different directions).
examples.zh: 这就是我们分手的地方。

examples.en: The band have parted company with their manager.
examples.zh: 乐队与其经理人已散伙了。

examples.en: The band and their manager have parted company.
examples.zh: 乐队与其经理人已散伙了。

examples.en: He parted ways with the team at the end of the season.
examples.zh: 赛季结束后他与球队分道扬镳。

senses.def: to disagree with somebody about something

examples.en: Weber parted company with Marx on a number of important issues.
examples.zh: 韦伯与马克思在若干重大问题上意见有分歧。

examples.en: The two leaders parted ways on this question.
examples.zh: 两国领导人在这个问题上意见分歧。

senses.def: used after being rude or critical about somebody to say that the people you are talking to are not included in the criticism
senses.zh: 在座诸位除外；与这里的各位无关

examples.en: The people in this office are so narrow-minded, present company excepted, of course.
examples.zh: 这个办公室里的人都是心胸狭隘的人，当然，现在的公司除外。

senses.def: used to suggest that it is better to be in a group of only two people than have a third person with you as well

a car that is provided by the company that you work for
an officer of middle rank in the army
a town or city where most of the people work for one company, which supports the whole economy of the area
senses.zh: 公司城（城中大部分居民受雇于同一家公司，而该公司是地区的经济支柱）

examples.en: Dearborn is a company town, home for over a century to Ford Motor Co.
examples.zh: 迪尔伯恩是一个公司城，作为福特汽车公司的总部已逾百年。

senses.def: the fact of being similar to somebody/something else and able to be compared

examples.en: Each group will have the same set of questions, in order to ensure comparability.
examples.zh: 为确保可比性，每组均会使用同一套问题。

senses.def: similar to somebody/something else and able to be compared

examples.en: A comparable house in the south of the city would cost twice as much.
examples.zh: 一栋类似的房子位于城南就要贵一倍。

examples.en: The situation in the US is not directly comparable to that in the UK.
examples.zh: 美国的情况与英国的不能直接相比。

examples.en: Inflation is now at a rate comparable with that in other European countries.
examples.zh: 现在通货膨胀率已经和欧洲其他国家的差不多了。

examples.en: The two machines are comparable in size.
examples.zh: 这两台机器的尺寸相当。

senses.def: in a similar way or to a similar extent
senses.zh: 以类似的方式或类似的程度

examples.en: a comparably priced phone
examples.zh: 同等价格的手机

senses.def: measured or judged by how similar or different it is to something else

examples.en: Then he was living in comparative comfort (= compared with others or with his own life at a previous time).
examples.zh: 他那时生活比较舒适。

examples.en: The company is a comparative newcomer to the software market (= other companies have been in business much longer).
examples.zh: 就软件市场来说，这家公司相对而言就是新手了。

senses.def: connected with studying things to find out how similar or different they are

examples.en: a comparative study of the educational systems of two countries
examples.zh: 两国教育制度的比较研究

examples.en: comparative linguistics
examples.zh: 比较语言学

senses.def: relating to adjectives or adverbs that express more in amount, degree or quality, for example better, worse, slower
senses.zh: （形容词或副词）比较级的（如 better、worse、slower 和 more difficult）

senses.def: the form of an adjective or adverb that expresses more in amount, degree or quality
senses.zh: （形容词或副词的）比较级形式

examples.en: ‘Better’ is the comparative of ‘good’ and ‘more difficult’ is the comparative of ‘difficult’.
examples.zh: better 是 good 的比较级；more difficult 是 difficult 的比较级。

senses.def: the study of how related languages are similar and different, especially in order to discover things about a language that both these languages came from, and that no longer exists
senses.zh: 比较语言学：研究相关语言的相似性和差异性，特别是为了发现有关这两种语言的来源以及不再存在的语言的事物

senses.def: an area of study that involves reading and comparing books from different parts of the world

examples.en: She studied comparative literature with a focus on English, German and Iranian authors.
examples.zh: 她学的是比较文学，主修英国、德国和伊朗作家的作品。

senses.def: as compared to something/somebody else

examples.en: The unit is comparatively easy to install and cheap to operate.
examples.zh: 这种设备比较容易安装而且用起来便宜。

examples.en: He died comparatively young (= at a younger age than most people die).
examples.zh: 他死时年纪并不大。

examples.en: comparatively few/low/rare/recent
examples.zh: 比较少／低／罕见；时间上相对较近的

senses.def: to examine people or things to see how they are similar and how they are different

examples.en: It is interesting to compare their situation and ours.
examples.zh: 把他们的状况与我们的相比很有意思。

examples.en: We compared the two reports carefully.
examples.zh: 我们仔细地比较了两个报告。

examples.en: Online grocery shopping allows you to compare prices more easily.
examples.zh: 在线杂货购物可以让您更轻松地比较价格。

examples.en: How can you compare the two things? They are so different!
examples.zh: 你如何比较这两件事？他们是如此不同！

examples.en: Compare and contrast the characters of Jack and Ralph.
examples.zh: 比较杰克和拉尔夫两个人物的异同。

examples.en: We compared the results of our study with those of other studies.
examples.zh: 我们把我们的研究结果与其他研究结果进行了比较。

examples.en: My own problems seem insignificant compared with other people's.
examples.zh: 与别人的问题相比，我自己的问题算不得什么。

examples.en: I've had some difficulties, but they were nothing compared to yours (= they were not nearly as bad as yours).
examples.zh: 我遇到了一些困难，但与你的困难比起来就算不上什么了。

examples.en: Standards in healthcare have improved enormously compared to 40 years ago.
examples.zh: 与 40 年前相比，卫生保健的水平得到了极大提高。

examples.en: They receive just over three years of schooling, compared to a national average of 7.3.
examples.zh: 他们只接受了三年多的学校教育，而全国平均水平为 7.3 年。

examples.en: an increase of over 11% compared to the same period last year
examples.zh: 与去年同期相比增长超过11%

examples.en: About a third of American adults are obese compared with 24 per cent of Britons
examples.zh: 大约三分之一的美国成年人肥胖，而英国成年人的这一比例为 24%

senses.def: to be similar to somebody/something else, either better or worse

examples.en: This school compares with the best in the country (= it is as good as them).
examples.zh: 这所学校可与全国最好的学校媲美。

examples.en: This house doesn't compare with our previous one (= it is not as good).
examples.zh: 这房子比不上我们以前的。

examples.en: Their prices compare favourably to those of their competitors.
examples.zh: 他们的价格比竞争者的要优惠。

examples.en: The region's wines compare well with those from elsewhere in Germany.
examples.zh: 该地区的葡萄酒与德国其他地方的葡萄酒相当。

senses.def: to show or state that somebody/something is similar to somebody/something else

examples.en: The critics compared his work to that of Martin Amis.
examples.zh: 评论家把他的作品和马丁·埃米斯的相提并论。

examples.en: In her early career she was often compared to Ella Fitzgerald.
examples.zh: 在她早期的职业生涯中，她经常被比作艾拉·菲茨杰拉德。

examples.en: Some observers compare the situation to that of the early 1980s.
examples.zh: 一些观察家将目前的情况与 20 世纪 80 年代初的情况进行比较。

senses.def: if two or more people compare notes

examples.en: We saw the play separately and compared notes afterwards.
examples.zh: 我们各自看了那出戏，后来交换了意见。

examples.en: Let's compare notes on our experiences.
examples.zh: 让我们就各自的经历交换一下看法吧。

senses.def: it is impossible to say that one thing is better than another if the two are completely different
senses.zh: （因两样事物完全不同）不具可比性，不能相提并论

examples.en: They are both great but you can't compare apples and oranges.
examples.zh: 他们两个都很不错，但是不可相提并论。

examples.en: No, you’re trying to compare apples and oranges.
examples.zh: 不，完全没有可比性。

senses.def: better than anything else of the same kind

examples.en: a diamond beyond compare
examples.zh: 无与伦比的钻石。

examples.en: Our professional service promises you a wedding without compare.
examples.zh: 我们的专业服务保证为您打造无与伦比的婚礼。

senses.def: if two or more people compare notes

examples.en: We saw the play separately and compared notes afterwards.
examples.zh: 我们各自看了那出戏，后来交换了意见。

examples.en: Let's compare notes on our experiences.
examples.zh: 让我们就各自的经历交换一下看法吧。

senses.def: the process of comparing two or more people or things

examples.en: For Durkheim, comparison was the most important method of analysis in sociology.
examples.zh: 对于涂尔干来说，比较是社会学最重要的分析方法。

examples.en: Comparison with other oil-producing countries is extremely interesting.
examples.zh: 与其他石油生产国作一比较是很有意思的。

examples.en: The two situations bear no comparison (= they are not at all similar).
examples.zh: 这两种情况无法相提并论。

examples.en: I enclose the two plans for comparison.
examples.zh: 兹附上两份计划以供比较。

senses.def: an occasion when two or more people or things are compared

examples.en: The films are too different for a fair comparison.
examples.zh: 这些电影差异太大，无法进行公平比较。

examples.en: a comparison of the rail systems in Britain and France
examples.zh: 英国和法国铁路系统的比较

examples.en: a comparison of men’s salaries with those of women
examples.zh: 男女薪酬的比较

examples.en: comparisons between Britain and the rest of Europe
examples.zh: 英国与欧洲其他国家之间的各种比较

examples.en: a comparison of the brain to a computer (= showing what is similar)
examples.zh: 将大脑与计算机作比较

examples.en: It is difficult to make a comparison with her previous book—they are completely different.
examples.zh: 这很难与她以前的书相比，两者是截然不同的。

examples.en: You can draw comparisons with the situation in Ireland (= say how the two situations are similar).
examples.zh: 这种情形可与爱尔兰的相比。

examples.en: There is no published information that would allow a direct comparison with other regions or countries.
examples.zh: 没有公开信息可供与其他地区或国家进行直接比较。

senses.def: used especially at the beginning of a sentence when the next thing that is mentioned is compared with something in the previous sentence

examples.en: By comparison, expenditure on education increased last year.
examples.zh: 相比之下，去年教育经费增加了。

examples.en: His problems seemed trivial by comparison.
examples.zh: 相比之下，他的问题显得微不足道。

senses.def: when compared with somebody/something

examples.en: The second half of the game was dull by comparison with the first.
examples.zh: 与上半场相比，比赛的下半场有些沉闷。

examples.en: The tallest buildings in London are small in comparison with New York's skyscrapers.
examples.zh: 伦敦最高的建筑物与纽约的摩天大厦一比就相形见绌。

senses.def: to seem less important when compared with something else

examples.en: Last year's riots pale in comparison with this latest outburst of violence.
examples.zh: 去年的骚乱与最近这次暴乱相比，可说是小巫见大巫。

examples.en: Our problems pale into insignificance when compared to theirs.
examples.zh: 与他们相比，我们的问题显得微不足道。

senses.def: used to emphasize the difference between two people or things that are being compared
senses.zh: （强调比较之下的差别）无法相比，根本不能相提并论

examples.en: In terms of price there's no comparison (= one thing is much more expensive than the other).
examples.zh: 在价格方面无法相比。

senses.def: used especially at the beginning of a sentence when the next thing that is mentioned is compared with something in the previous sentence

senses.def: to seem less important when compared with something else

examples.en: Last year's riots pale in comparison with this latest outburst of violence.
examples.zh: 去年的骚乱与最近这次暴乱相比，可说是小巫见大巫。

examples.en: Our problems pale into insignificance when compared to theirs.
examples.zh: 与他们相比，我们的问题显得微不足道。
