examples.zh: 证据是那样的令人折服，他觉得不得不接受。

examples.en: The company said that it was constrained to raise prices.
examples.zh: 该公司表示，涨价受到限制。

senses.def: to limit somebody/something

examples.en: Research has been constrained by a lack of funds.
examples.zh: 研究工作因经费不足而受限制。

examples.en: Men and women are becoming less constrained by stereotyped roles.
examples.zh: 男性和女性越来越少受到刻板角色的限制。

examples.en: There are a number of factors that constrain agricultural development.
examples.zh: 制约农业发展的因素有很多。

examples.en: She felt constrained from continuing by the threat of losing her job.
examples.zh: 由于受到失去工作的威胁，她感到很难再坚持下去。

senses.def: a thing that limits something, or limits your freedom to do something

examples.en: constraints of time/money/space
examples.zh: 时间／资金／空间的限制

examples.en: financial/economic/legal/political constraints
examples.zh: 财政／经济／法律／政治约束

examples.en: This decision will impose serious constraints on all schools.
examples.zh: 这项决定将使所有的学校受到各种严格的限制。

senses.def: strict control over the way that you behave or are allowed to behave

examples.en: At last we could relax and talk without constraint.
examples.zh: 我们终于可以放松下来，无拘无束地谈话了。

intro.en: These are all words for something that limits what you can do or what can happen.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示限制或限定。

items.def: the greatest or smallest amount of something that is allowed:
items.zh: 指极限、限量、限额

examples.en: The EU has set strict limits on pollution levels.
examples.zh: 欧盟对污染程度作了严格的限定。

items.def: (rather formal) a rule or law that limits what you can do:
items.zh: 指限制规定、限制法规

examples.en: There are no restrictions on the amount of money you can withdraw.
examples.zh: 取款没有限额。

items.def: (often in compounds) the act of limiting or managing something; a method of doing this:
items.zh: （常构成复合词）指限制、约束、管理、管制

examples.en: arms control
examples.zh: 军备控制

items.def: (rather formal) a fact or decision that limits what you can do:
items.zh: 指限制、限定、约束

examples.en: We have to work within severe constraints of time and money.
examples.zh: 我们必须在时间紧迫、资金紧张的限制下工作。

items.def: (rather formal) a decision, a rule, an idea, etc. that limits what you can do; the act of limiting something because it is necessary or sensible to do so:
items.zh: 指约束力、管制措施、制约因素、控制、限制

examples.en: The government has imposed export restraints on some products.
examples.zh: 政府对一些产品实行了出口控制。

items.def: the act or process of limiting something; a rule, fact or condition that limits something:
items.zh: 指限制、控制、起限制作用的规则、事实或条件

examples.en: They would resist any limitation of their powers.
examples.zh: 他们会抵制对他们权力的任何限制。

senses.def: to become tighter or narrower; to make something tighter or narrower

examples.en: Her throat constricted and she swallowed hard.
examples.zh: 她喉咙发紧，使劲地咽了一下唾沫。

examples.en: a drug that constricts the blood vessels
examples.zh: 收缩血管的药

senses.def: to limit what somebody is able to do

examples.en: Film-makers of the time were constricted by the censors.
examples.zh: 那时的电影制作人受到了审查官的限制。

examples.en: constricting rules and regulations
examples.zh: 具有约束性的规章制度

senses.def: the fact of being tight or narrow

examples.en: a feeling of constriction in the chest
examples.zh: 胸闷的感觉

senses.def: the act of limiting what somebody is able to do; a rule or limit that results from this
senses.zh: 收缩：限制某人的能力的行为；由此产生的规则或限制

examples.en: political constrictions
examples.zh: 政治约束

senses.def: to build or make something such as a road, building or machine

examples.en: The building was constructed in 1993.
examples.zh: 这幢大楼建于 1993 年。

examples.en: They constructed a shelter out of fallen branches.
examples.zh: 他们用落下的枯树枝搭了个窝棚。

examples.en: The frame is constructed from lightweight aluminium.
examples.zh: 框架由轻质铝制成。

examples.en: On the smaller islands, houses are often constructed of local materials.
examples.zh: 在较小的岛屿上，房屋通常采用当地材料建造。

senses.def: to form something by putting different things together

examples.en: You must learn how to construct a logical argument.
examples.zh: 你必须学会怎样确立合乎逻辑的论点。

examples.en: to construct a theory
examples.zh: 创立一种理论

examples.en: For these experiments it is necessary to construct a model using data from other sources.
examples.zh: 对于这些实验，有必要使用其他来源的数据构建模型。

examples.en: a well-constructed novel
examples.zh: 构思巧妙的小说

examples.en: his carefully constructed public image
examples.zh: 他精心塑造的公众形象

examples.en: the socially constructed nature of gender roles
examples.zh: 性别角色的社会建构本质

senses.def: to draw a line or shape according to the rules of mathematics

examples.en: to construct a triangle
examples.zh: 画一个三角形

senses.def: an idea or a belief that is based on various pieces of evidence that have not always been proved to be true
senses.zh: （根据不总是真实的各种证据得出的）构想，观念，概念

examples.en: a contrast between lived reality and the construct held in the mind
examples.zh: 现实生活与头脑所持概念之间的明显差别

senses.def: a group of words that form a phrase
a thing that is built or made

synonyms.words: construct ▪ assemble ▪ erect ▪ put something up

intro.en: These words all mean to make something, especially by putting different parts together.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含制造、建造之义。

items.def: to make something, especially a building, by putting parts together:
items.zh: 指制造、建造、修建（尤指房屋）

examples.en: a house built of stone
examples.zh: 用石头建造的房子

items.def: [often passive] (rather formal) to build something such as a road, building or machine
items.zh: 指修建、建造（公路、房屋、机器等）

items.def: (rather formal) to fit together all the separate parts of something such as a piece of furniture or a machine:
items.zh: 指装配、组装（家具、机器等）

examples.en: The cupboard is easy to assemble.
examples.zh: 这个橱柜容易组装。

items.def: (formal) to build something; to put something in position and make it stand upright:
items.zh: 指建立、建造、安装、竖立、搭起

examples.en: Police had to erect barriers to keep crowds back.
examples.zh: 警察只得设立路障来阻截人群。

items.def: to build something or place something somewhere:
items.zh: 指修建、建立、设立、设置

examples.en: They’re putting up new hotels in order to boost tourism in the area.
examples.zh: 他们正在盖新旅馆以促进该地区的旅游业。

senses.def: the process or method of building or making something, especially roads, buildings, bridges, etc.

examples.en: Construction began this year and will take approximately 18 months.
examples.zh: 施工今年已经开始，大约将需要 18 个月。

examples.en: the costs of road construction and maintenance
examples.zh: 道路建设和养护费用

examples.en: Work has begun on the construction of the new airport.
examples.zh: 新机场的修建已经开工。

examples.en: the construction of a new database
examples.zh: 新数据库的建立

examples.en: Our new offices are still under construction (= being built).
examples.zh: 我们的新办公楼尚在修建中。

examples.en: Ethernet cabling was installed during construction.
examples.zh: 以太网布线是在施工期间安装的。

examples.en: the construction industry
examples.zh: 建筑业

examples.en: construction work/workers
examples.zh: 建筑工程／工人

examples.en: a construction company/firm
examples.zh: 建筑公司/公司

examples.en: construction projects/costs/materials
examples.zh: 建设项目/成本/材料

senses.def: the people and activities involved in making buildings

examples.en: 50 000 more jobs will go from construction in the next five years.
examples.zh: 未来五年，建筑业将再失去 5 万个就业岗位。

senses.def: the way that something has been built or made

examples.en: The bridges are similar in construction.
examples.zh: 这些桥的构造相似。

examples.en: ships of steel construction
examples.zh: 钢结构船

examples.en: It has a basic construction of brick under a tiled roof.
examples.zh: 这是一座简易的瓦顶砖砌建筑。

senses.def: a thing that has been built or made

examples.en: The summer house was a simple wooden construction.
examples.zh: 那座避暑别墅是简单的木结构建筑。

senses.def: the way in which words are used together and arranged to form a sentence, phrase, etc.

examples.en: grammatical constructions
examples.zh: 语法结构

senses.def: the creating of something from ideas, opinions and knowledge
senses.zh: （理念、观点和知识的）创造，创立，建立

examples.en: the construction of a new theory
examples.zh: 新理论的创立

examples.en: changes in the social construction of marriage
examples.zh: 婚姻的社会意义的改变

senses.def: the way in which words, actions, statements, etc. are understood by somebody
senses.zh: （对词语、行为、陈述等的）解释，说明，理解

examples.en: What construction do you put on this letter (= what do you think it means)?
examples.zh: 你对这封信如何理解？

examples.en: ruling on the proper construction to be given to section 78 of the Act
examples.zh: 就该法令第78条作出正确解释的裁决

examples.en: a strict construction of the clause
examples.zh: 对该条款的狭义解释

intro.en: These are all words for the way the different parts of something combine together or the way that something has been made.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指事物各个不同部分的组合、构造。

items.def: the way in which the parts of something are connected together or arranged; a particular arrangement of parts:
items.zh: 指结构、构造

examples.en: the structure of the building/​human body
examples.zh: 建筑物／人体结构

items.def: a set of beliefs, ideas or rules that forms the basis of a system or society:
items.zh: 指构成某个体系或社会基础的信仰、观点、准则

examples.en: The report provides a framework for further research.
examples.zh: 报告提供了进一步研究的原则。

items.def: [U] the arrangement of parts in a whole, especially in a work of art or piece of writing:
items.zh: （尤指艺术作品或文章的）结构、形式

examples.en: As a photographer, shape and form were more important to him than colour.
examples.zh: 作为摄影师，形状和结构对他来说比颜色更重要。

items.def: [U] (rather formal) the different parts or people that combine to form something; the way in which they combine:
items.zh: 指不同部分或人的构成、组合方式

examples.en: recent changes in the composition of the workforce
examples.zh: 劳动力组合最近的变化

items.def: [U] the way that something has been built or made:
items.zh: 指建造或构造

examples.en: ships of steel construction
examples.zh: 钢结构船

items.def: (rather formal) the basic structure of a society or an organization that enables it to function successfully:
items.zh: 指社会、机构等的基本结构

examples.en: This is a trend which threatens the very fabric of society.
examples.zh: 这趋势威胁社会的基本结构。

senses.def: thick coloured paper that people cut out to make designs, models, etc.
senses.zh: （做设计、模型等的）彩色美术纸

senses.def: an area of land where something is being built
connected with the making or building of things

examples.en: constructional toys
examples.zh: 拼装玩具

senses.def: having a useful and helpful effect rather than being negative or with no purpose
senses.zh: 建设性的；有助益的；积极的

examples.en: constructive criticism/suggestions/advice
examples.zh: 建设性的批评／提议／忠告

examples.en: His work involved helping hyperactive children to use their energy in a constructive way.
examples.zh: 他的工作包括帮助患有多动症的儿童建设性地利用他们的精力。

examples.en: The government is encouraging all parties to play a constructive role in the reform process.
examples.zh: 政府鼓励所有的政党在改革过程中发挥建设性的作用。

examples.en: You should always welcome constructive criticism of your work.
examples.zh: 你应该总是欣然地接受别人对你工作的建设性批评。

senses.def: a situation in which you are forced to leave your job because it is changed in a way that makes it impossible for you to continue doing it
senses.zh: 推定解雇，变工解雇（指通过改变工作条件而迫使雇员自动离职）

examples.en: She won her claim for constructive dismissal because she had been pressured into resigning.
examples.zh: 由于是被迫辞职，她赢得了推定解雇赔偿的申诉。

senses.def: in a way that has a useful and helpful effect rather than being negative or with no purpose

examples.en: Use your time constructively.
examples.zh: 建设性地利用你的时间。

senses.def: a person or company that builds things, especially cars or aircraft
senses.zh: （尤指汽车或飞机的）建造者，制造者，建造商

examples.en: Riley&Scott, the US racing car constructor
examples.zh: Riley&Scott，美国赛车制造商

senses.def: to understand the meaning of a word, a sentence or an action in a particular way

examples.en: He considered how the remark was to be construed.
examples.zh: 他考虑这话该如何理解。

examples.en: Her words could hardly be construed as an apology.
examples.zh: 她的话怎么想都不像是道歉。

senses.def: a government official who is the representative of his or her country in a foreign city

examples.en: the British consul in Miami
examples.zh: 英国驻迈阿密领事

senses.def: one of the two heads of state who were elected each year to rule the Roman Republic

examples.en: Together Pompey, Crassus and Caesar succeeded in getting Caesar elected consul.
examples.zh: 庞培、克拉苏和凯撒一起成功地让凯撒当选执政官。

senses.def: connected with a consul

examples.en: consular officials
examples.zh: 领事官员

senses.def: the building where a consul

examples.en: the American consulate in Marseilles
examples.zh: 美国驻马赛领事馆

senses.def: to go to somebody for information or advice

examples.en: If the pain continues, consult your doctor.
examples.zh: 如果疼痛持续，要请医生诊治。

examples.en: Have you consulted your lawyer about this?
examples.zh: 你就此事咨询过你的律师吗？

examples.en: a consulting engineer (= one who has expert knowledge and gives advice)
examples.zh: 顾问工程师

examples.en: Consult with your physician about possible treatments.
examples.zh: 向你的医生咨询可行的治疗方案。

senses.def: to discuss something with somebody to get their permission for something, or to help you make a decision
senses.zh: （与某人）商议，商量（以得到许可或帮助决策）

examples.en: You shouldn't have done it without consulting me.
examples.zh: 你不该不和我商量就做了这件事。

examples.en: I expect to be consulted about major issues.
examples.zh: 我认为重大问题必须找我商量。

examples.en: I need to consult with my colleagues on the proposals.
examples.zh: 我需要和我的同事商讨这些建议。

examples.en: We consulted quite widely before deciding what to do.
examples.zh: 在决定做什么之前，我们广泛地征求了意见。

senses.def: to look in or at something to get information

examples.en: He consulted the manual.
examples.zh: 他查阅了使用说明书。

examples.en: If you're not sure which plug to buy, consult the manual.
examples.zh: 如果不确定该买哪种插头，请查阅使用手册。

intro.en: These words all mean to share news, information, ideas or feelings with another person or other people, especially by talking with them.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含交流、交谈之义。

items.def: to speak in order to give information, express feelings or share ideas:
items.zh: 指说话、讲话、谈话

examples.en: We talked on the phone for over an hour.
examples.zh: 我们在电话里谈了一个多小时。

items.def: (rather formal) to talk and share ideas on a subject or problem with other people, especially in order to decide something:
items.zh: 指谈论、讨论、商量

examples.en: Have you discussed the problem with anyone?
examples.zh: 你与谁商量过这个问题吗？

items.def: to talk to somebody about something; to have a conversation with somebody:
items.zh: 指谈话、交谈

examples.en: I’ve spoken to the manager about it.
examples.zh: 那件事我已经和经理谈过了。

items.def: (rather formal) to exchange information or ideas with somebody:
items.zh: 指与某人交流信息或意见

examples.en: We only communicate by email.
examples.zh: 我们只通过电子邮件进行交流。

items.def: to discuss something, especially formally, before making a decision or finding a solution:
items.zh: （尤指正式）讨论、辩论

examples.en: Politicians will be debating the bill later this week.
examples.zh: 政界将在本周晚些时候讨论这项议案。

items.def: (rather formal) to discuss something with somebody in order to get their permission for something, or to help you make a decision:
items.zh: 指（与某人）商议、商量（以得到许可或帮助决策）

examples.en: You shouldn’t have done it without consulting me.
examples.zh: 你不该不和我商量就做了这件事。

senses.def: a company that gives expert advice on a particular subject to other companies or organizations

examples.en: a management/design/computer, etc. consultancy
examples.zh: 管理／设计／计算机等咨询公司

senses.def: expert advice that a company or person is paid to provide on a particular subject

examples.en: consultancy fees
examples.zh: 咨询费

senses.def: a person who knows a lot about a particular subject and is employed to give advice about it to other people

examples.en: a technology/design consultant
examples.zh: 技术／设计顾问

examples.en: She is clearly being coached by image consultants.
examples.zh: 她显然正在接受形象顾问的指导。

examples.en: the president’s consultant on economic affairs
examples.zh: 总统的经济事务顾问

examples.en: He was happy to act as a consultant to the company.
examples.zh: 他很乐意担任公司的顾问。

senses.def: a hospital doctor of the highest rank who is a specialist in a particular area of medicine
senses.zh: 高级顾问医师；会诊医师

examples.en: a consultant in obstetrics
examples.zh: 产科顾问医师

examples.en: a consultant surgeon
examples.zh: 外科顾问医师

senses.def: the act of discussing something with somebody or with a group of people before making a decision about it

examples.en: a consultation document/paper/period/process
examples.zh: 咨询文件／论文／期／过程

examples.en: The decision was taken after close consultation with local residents.
examples.zh: 这项决定是在与当地居民仔细磋商后作出的。

examples.en: acting in consultation with all the departments involved
examples.zh: 和所有有关部门磋商后行事

senses.def: a formal meeting to discuss something

examples.en: There have been extensive consultations between the two countries.
examples.zh: 两国之间进行了广泛磋商。

senses.def: a meeting with an expert, especially a doctor, to get advice or treatment
senses.zh: （向专家请教的）咨询会；（尤指）就诊

examples.en: A 30-minute consultation will cost £500.
examples.zh: 30 分钟的咨询费用为 500 英镑。

senses.def: the act of looking for information in a book, etc.

examples.en: There is a large collection of texts available for consultation online.
examples.zh: 有大量文本可供在线咨询。

synonyms.words: conversation ▪ dialogue ▪ talk ▪ debate ▪ consultation ▪ chat ▪ gossip

intro.en: These are all words for an occasion when people talk about something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示交谈、谈论。

items.def: a detailed conversation about something that is considered to be important:
items.zh: 指重要事情的讨论、谈论、商讨

examples.en: Discussions are still taking place between the two leaders.
examples.zh: 两位领导人仍在进行讨论。

items.def: a talk, usually a private or informal one, involving two people or a small group; the activity of talking in this way:
items.zh: 通常指私下的或非正式的交谈、谈话

examples.en: a telephone conversation
examples.zh: 电话交谈

items.def: conversations in a book, play or film:
items.zh: 指书、戏剧或电影中的对话、对白

examples.en: The novel has long descriptions and not much dialogue.
examples.zh: 这部小说描述多，对话少。

examples.en: The President told waiting reporters there had been a constructive dialogue.
examples.zh: 总统告诉等候的记者，刚才进行了一次富有建设性的对话。

items.def: a conversation or discussion, often one about a problem or something important for the people involved:
items.zh: 常指对有关人员就某个问题或重要的事情进行的交谈、谈话、讨论、商讨

examples.en: I had a long talk with my boss about my career prospects.
examples.zh: 我和老板就我的事业前景进行了一次长谈。

items.def: a formal discussion of an issue at a public meeting or in a parliament. In a debate two or more speakers express opposing views and then there is often a vote on the issue:
items.zh: 指公共集会上或议会里就某问题进行的、常以表决结束的辩论

examples.en: a debate on prison reform
examples.zh: 关于监狱制度改革的辩论

items.def: a formal discussion between groups of people before a decision is made about something:
items.zh: 指团体间在决策前进行的咨询、商讨、磋商

examples.en: There have been extensive consultations between the two countries.
examples.zh: 两国之间进行了广泛磋商。

items.def: a friendly informal conversation; informal talking. The countable use of chat is especially British English:
items.zh: chat 作可数名词尤用于英式英语

items.def: a conversation about other people and their private lives:
items.zh: 指关于他人及其私生活的闲谈、闲聊、说长道短

examples.en: We had a good gossip about the boss.
examples.zh: 我们讲了好一会儿老板的闲话。

intro.en: These are all words for a meeting or occasion when somebody is asked for information, opinions or advice.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示会见、询问、咨询。

items.def: a formal meeting at which somebody is asked questions, for example, to see if they are suitable for a particular job or course of study, or in order to find out their opinions about something:
items.zh: 指面试、面谈

examples.en: a job interview
examples.zh: 求职面试

items.def: the process of asking somebody a lot of questions, especially in an aggressive way, in order to get information; an occasion on which this is done:
items.zh: 指讯问、审问、盘问

examples.en: He confessed after four days under interrogation.
examples.zh: 他在受讯问四天之后招认了。

items.def: a formal meeting with an important person:
items.zh: 指与要人的会见、觐见

examples.en: The Pope granted her a private audience.
examples.zh: 教皇同意私下接见她。

items.def: a meeting with an expert, especially a doctor, to get advice or treatment.
items.zh: 指向专家请教的咨询，尤指就诊

senses.def: giving advice or making suggestions

examples.en: a consultative committee/body/document
examples.zh: 咨询委员会／机构／文件

senses.def: a room where a doctor talks to and examines patients
intended to be bought, used and then replaced

examples.en: consumable electronic goods
examples.zh: 电子消费品

senses.def: goods that are intended to be used fairly quickly and then replaced

examples.en: computer consumables such as printer cartridges
examples.zh: 打印机墨盒之类的电脑耗材

senses.def: to use something, especially fuel, energy or time
senses.zh: 消耗，耗费（尤指燃料、能量或时间）

examples.en: The electricity industry consumes large amounts of fossil fuels.
examples.zh: 电力工业消耗大量的化石燃料。

examples.en: 25 per cent of the world’s population consumes 80 per cent of the planet’s resources.
examples.zh: 世界25%的人口消耗了地球80%的资源。

senses.def: to eat or drink something

examples.en: Before he died, he had consumed a large quantity of alcohol.
examples.zh: 他死亡前喝了大量的酒。

examples.en: a half-consumed loaf of bread
examples.zh: 一条吃了一半的面包

examples.en: Red meat should be consumed in moderation.
examples.zh: 红肉应适量食用。

senses.def: to fill somebody with a strong feeling

examples.en: Carolyn was consumed with guilt.
examples.zh: 卡罗琳深感内疚。

examples.en: Rage consumed him.
examples.zh: 他无比愤怒。

senses.def: to completely destroy something

examples.en: The hotel was quickly consumed by fire.
examples.zh: 那座旅馆很快被大火吞噬。

senses.def: a person who buys goods or uses services

examples.en: an increase in consumer demand
examples.zh: 消费者需求增加

examples.en: links between producers and consumers
examples.zh: 生产者和消费者之间的联系

examples.en: Health-conscious consumers want more information about the food they buy.
examples.zh: 注重身体健康的消费者想得到更多有关他们所购买的食物的信息。

examples.en: a consumer culture/society (= one where buying and selling is considered to be very important)
examples.zh: 消费文化/社会（= 购买和销售被认为非常重要的文化/社会）

examples.en: a consumer watchdog (= somebody whose job is to protect consumers' rights)
examples.zh: 消费监督员

examples.en: The consumer (= consumers as a group) is well served by competition.
examples.zh: 消费者（=作为一个群体的消费者）通过竞争得到了很好的服务。

examples.en: This tool may be considered too expensive for the average consumer.
examples.zh: 对于普通消费者，这个工具可能会被认为过于昂贵。

examples.en: consumers of news/electricity/healthcare
examples.zh: 新闻/电力/医疗保健消费者

examples.en: providers and consumers of public services
examples.zh: 公共服务的提供者和消费者

examples.en: We need to educate consumers about this technology.
examples.zh: 我们需要对消费者进行有关这项技术的教育。

senses.def: a measure of the degree of confidence people have in the economy as a whole and in their own financial situation. If consumer confidence

examples.en: Lower interest rates would boost consumer confidence.
examples.zh: 降低利率会提振消费者信心。

examples.en: A fall in unemployment will help to restore consumer confidence.
examples.zh: 失业人数的下降会有助于恢复消费者的信心。

examples.en: Economists forecast that falling consumer confidence will cut into household purchases.
examples.zh: 经济学家预测，消费者信心的下降会拉低房屋购买量。

senses.def: money that is lent to individual customers to buy goods and services, rather than to businesses

examples.en: Credit unions have an important role in providing low-cost, community-controlled consumer credit.
examples.zh: 信用合作社在提供低成本、社区控制的消费信贷方面发挥着重要作用。

senses.def: goods that are expected to last for a long time after they have been bought, such as cars, televisions, etc.

examples.en: the market for consumer durables
examples.zh: 耐用消费品市场

senses.def: an economic system that depends on people buying a lot of goods and services rather than on production
senses.zh: 消费经济（依赖大量消费而非生产的经济体系）

examples.en: Eastern Europe's emerging consumer economies are prime targets for credit card growth.
examples.zh: 崛起中的东欧消费经济体成为信用卡增长的主要目标。

senses.def: electronic devices such as televisions, computers and smartphones bought by individual customers rather than by businesses
senses.zh: 消费类电子产品（个人而非企业购买）

examples.en: a leading manufacturer of consumer electronics
examples.zh: 消费电子产品的领先制造商

examples.en: the consumer electronics industry
examples.zh: 消费电子行业

senses.def: goods such as food, clothing, etc. bought by individual customers
an organization that makes sure the goods and services people buy or use are safe and that consumers are treated fairly
senses.zh: 消费者团体（保护消费者权益的组织）

examples.en: Consumer groups called for a dedicated and safe space for health information on the internet.
examples.zh: 消费者团体呼吁要为健康相关信息提供专门的网上安全空间。

senses.def: a list of the prices of some ordinary goods and services, which shows how much these prices change each month
senses.zh: 居民消费价格指数；消费价格指数

senses.def: a US magazine, published each month since 1936, which tests products and writes about their quality and value. It is published by the independent Consumers Union that does not make a profit. There are no advertisements in the magazine. Information is also available on the Consumer Reports
senses.zh: 《消费者报告》（自1936年以来每月出版的美国杂志，用于测试产品并撰写其质量和价值。它是由独立的消费者联盟出版的，没有盈利。杂志上没有广告。消费者报告网站上也提供了信息。）

senses.def: the amount of money that consumers spend on goods and services, expressed as a percentage of a country's economy

examples.en: Consumer spending accounts for about 70% of the country's economic activity.
examples.zh: 消费者支出约占该国经济活动的70%。

senses.def: the buying and using of goods and services; the belief that it is good for a society or an individual person to buy and use a large quantity of goods and services
senses.zh: 消费；消费主义（认为大量消费对社会和个人有利）

examples.en: She was appalled by the greed and rampant consumerism she saw in modern society.
examples.zh: 她对现代社会中贪婪和消费主义的大行其道感到震惊。

examples.en: green consumerism (= the buying of products that are not harmful to the environment)
examples.zh: 绿色消费主义

senses.def: connected with buying and using goods and services, or with the beliefs of consumerism
senses.zh: 消费主义的；顾客至上的；保护消费者利益的

examples.en: consumerist values
examples.zh: 消费主义价值观

senses.def: showing great skill; perfect
senses.zh: 技艺精湛的；高超的；完美的

examples.en: She was a consummate performer.
examples.zh: 她是个技艺非凡的表演者。

examples.en: He played the shot with consummate skill.
examples.zh: 他以高超的技巧投球进篮。

examples.en: a consummate liar
examples.zh: 撒谎高手

senses.def: to make a marriage or a relationship complete by having sex
senses.zh: （初次）行房；通过性交使（婚姻或两人的关系）圆满

examples.en: The marriage lasted only a week and was never consummated.
examples.zh: 那段婚姻仅维持了一星期，期间从未行房。

senses.def: to make something complete or perfect
in a way that shows great skill or is perfect
senses.zh: 技艺精湛地；高超地；完美地

senses.def: the act of making a marriage or relationship complete by having sex
the fact of making something complete or perfect

examples.en: The paintings are the consummation of his life's work.
examples.zh: 这些画是他毕生努力的完美结晶。

senses.def: the act of using energy, food or materials; the amount used
senses.zh: （能量、食物或材料的）消耗，消耗量

examples.en: the production of fuel for domestic consumption (= to be used in the country where it is produced)
examples.zh: 供国内消耗的燃料生产

examples.en: Gas and oil consumption always increases in cold weather.
examples.zh: 燃气和燃油的消耗量在天冷时总会增加。

examples.en: The meat was declared unfit for human consumption.
examples.zh: 这种肉被宣布不适于人食用。

examples.en: He was advised to reduce his alcohol consumption.
examples.zh: 他被劝告减少饮酒。

examples.en: Doctors say that children need to increase their consumption of fruit and vegetables.
examples.zh: 医生说儿童需要增加水果和蔬菜的摄入量。

examples.en: Her speech to party members was not intended for public consumption (= to be heard by the public).
examples.zh: 她对党员发表的讲话并不打算公诸大众。

senses.def: the act of buying and using products

examples.en: Consumption rather than saving has become the central feature of contemporary societies.
examples.zh: 现代社会的主要特征是消费而不是储蓄。

examples.en: The industry faced a serious challenge in trying to stimulate consumption.
examples.zh: 在刺激消费方面，这个行业面临着严峻的挑战。

senses.def: a serious disease of the lungs
having consumption
connected with the fact of using up resources

examples.en: our consumptive lifestyle
examples.zh: 我们的消费生活方式

examples.en: Hunting, mining and consumptive activities are not permitted in a National Park.
examples.zh: 国家公园内禁止狩猎、采矿和消耗性活动。

senses.def: a person who has consumption
continued

examples.en: cont. on p. 74
examples.zh: 下接第 74 页

senses.def: the act of communicating with somebody, especially regularly

examples.en: I don't have much contact with my uncle.
examples.zh: 我和叔父甚少联系。

examples.en: We've been unable to establish radio contact with the pilot.
examples.zh: 我们无法与飞行员建立无线电联系。

examples.en: She's lost contact with (= no longer sees or writes to) her son.
examples.zh: 她和儿子失去了联系。

examples.en: I finally made contact with (= succeeded in speaking to or meeting) her in Paris.
examples.zh: 我最终在巴黎与她取得了联系。

examples.en: There is little contact between the two organizations.
examples.zh: 这两个机构相互之间没有什么联系。

examples.en: We're no longer in regular contact.
examples.zh: 我们不再经常联系了。

examples.en: The Foreign Office is currently in close contact with the Indian authorities.
examples.zh: 外交部目前与印度当局保持着密切联系。

examples.en: Have you kept in contact with any of your friends from college (= do you still see them or speak or write to them)?
examples.zh: 你和大学里的朋友还保持联系吗？

examples.en: The organization put me in contact with other people in a similar position (= gave me their addresses or phone numbers).
examples.zh: 这家机构为我提供了其他和我情况相似的人的联系方法。

examples.en: Anyone with any information about the incident is asked to get in contact with the police (= phone them or go to see them).
examples.zh: 任何了解该事件信息的人请与警方联系（=给他们打电话或去见他们）。

examples.en: two people avoiding eye contact (= avoiding looking directly at each other)
examples.zh: 避免目光相遇的两个人

examples.en: Please ensure we have your contact number (= phone number) in case we need to reschedule.
examples.zh: 请确保我们有您的联系电话（=电话号码），以防我们需要重新安排。

examples.en: I'll give you my contact details (= phone number, email address, etc.).
examples.zh: 我会给你我的具体联系方式。

examples.en: The society's website provides contact information.
examples.zh: 协会网站提供联系方式。

senses.def: the state of meeting somebody or having to deal with something
senses.zh: 遇见（某人）；碰上（要处理的事）

examples.en: She always avoided contact with the press.
examples.zh: 她总是避免与媒体接触。

examples.en: He'd prefer a job where he doesn't have to be in direct contact with the public.
examples.zh: 他更喜欢一份不必和公众直接接触的工作。

examples.en: In her job she often comes into contact with (= meets) lawyers.
examples.zh: 她在工作中常与律师接触。

examples.en: Children should be brought into contact with poetry at an early age.
examples.zh: 儿童应该在幼年接触诗歌。

senses.group: meeting somebody/something 遇到某人／某事物

senses.def: an occasion on which you meet or communicate with somebody; a relationship with somebody

examples.en: Even the US, which has no embassy there, is beginning to forge contacts.
examples.zh: 就连在那里没有大使馆的美国也开始建立联系。

examples.en: We have good contacts with the local community.
examples.zh: 我们与当地社区关系甚好。

examples.en: The company has maintained trade contacts with India.
examples.zh: 这家公司和印度一直保持着贸易往来。

senses.def: a person that you know, especially somebody who can be helpful to you in your work
senses.zh: 熟人；（尤指工作中有用的）社会关系

examples.en: social/personal contacts
examples.zh: 社会上的／私下的熟人

examples.en: I've made some useful contacts in journalism.
examples.zh: 我在新闻界结交了一些有用的人。

examples.en: She has several contacts in New York.
examples.zh: 她在纽约有几个联系人。

examples.en: He has a contact at the White House.
examples.zh: 他在白宫有个联系人。

senses.def: the state of touching something

examples.en: a fear of physical contact
examples.zh: 对身体接触的恐惧感

examples.en: The disease is spread by contact.
examples.zh: 该疾病通过接触传播。

examples.en: infections transmitted through sexual contact
examples.zh: 本书不包含插图。

examples.en: His fingers were briefly in contact with the ball.
examples.zh: 他的手指稍稍地碰了一下球。

examples.en: This substance should not come into contact with food.
examples.zh: 这种物质切莫与食物接触。

examples.en: This pesticide kills insects on contact (= as soon as it touches them).
examples.zh: 这种杀虫剂昆虫一触即死。

examples.en: This chemical is liable to explode on contact with water.
examples.zh: 该化学物质与水接触后容易爆炸。

examples.en: She blushed at the sudden contact of his hand against her arm.
examples.zh: 当他的手突然碰到她的手臂时，她脸红了。

senses.def: an electrical connection

examples.en: The switches close the contacts and complete the circuit.
examples.zh: 这些开关可接通形成闭合电路。

senses.def: a contact lens
a person who has recently been near to somebody with a contagious
a place where you go or a person that you speak to when you are dealing with an organization

examples.en: The receptionist is the first point of contact most people have with the clinic.
examples.zh: 多数人与诊所接触的第一个人是接待员。

senses.def: to communicate with somebody, for example by phone, letter or email
senses.zh: 联系，联络（如用电话、信件或电邮）

examples.en: I've been trying to contact you all day.
examples.zh: 我一整天都在设法与你联系。

examples.en: Witnesses to the accident are asked to contact the police.
examples.zh: 事故目击者请与警方联系。

examples.en: Anyone interested is requested to contact a member of the committee.
examples.zh: 任何有兴趣的人请联系委员会成员。

examples.en: For further information, contact your local careers office.
examples.zh: 如需更多信息，请联系您当地的职业办公室。

examples.en: He can be contacted on 01865…
examples.zh: 可以拨打 01865…与他联系。

examples.en: He can be contacted at 212…
examples.zh: 可以拨打 212…与他联系。

examples.en: Anyone with tickets will be contacted by phone, letter or email and offered a full refund.
examples.zh: 我们将通过电话、信件或电子邮件联系持有门票的任何人，并提供全额退款。

senses.def: a place where you go or a person that you speak to when you are dealing with an organization

examples.en: The receptionist is the first point of contact most people have with the clinic.
examples.zh: 多数人与诊所接触的第一个人是接待员。

senses.def: a dance form in which contact, weight and balance between two or more people is the basis for a dance that is invented in the moment, rather than being planned in advance
senses.zh: 接触即兴（一种双人或多人即兴舞蹈形式，其特点是通过身体接触和重力分享来进行舞蹈。它强调合作、倾听和对身体的敏锐觉察。）

examples.en: An egalitarian form, contact improvisation is available to movers of any ability.
examples.zh: 接触即兴创作是一种平等主义的形式，适合任何能力的搬运工。

senses.def: a small round piece of thin plastic that you put on your eye to help you see better

examples.en: to wear contact lenses
examples.zh: 戴隐形眼镜

senses.def: a sport in which players have physical contact with each other
senses.zh: 接触式运动（运动员之间有身体接触）

examples.en: Popular contact sports include rugby and boxing.
examples.zh: 流行的接触运动包括橄榄球和拳击。

senses.def: a person whose job is to identify anyone who has recently been near somebody with a disease and may have caught the infection

examples.en: Thousands of coronavirus contact tracers were recruited by the government.
examples.zh: 政府招募了数千名冠状病毒接触追踪人员。

senses.def: the process of trying to identify anyone who has recently been near somebody with a disease and may have caught the infection
senses.zh: 接触者追踪（找出与传染病患者有密切接触的人）

examples.en: Health officials were conducting contact tracing to determine whether anyone else had been exposed to the virus.
examples.zh: 卫生官员正在进行接触者追踪，以确定是否还有其他人接触过该病毒。

senses.def: in a situation where people can communicate with you, for example by phone or email

examples.en: I'll be contactable on this number:…
examples.zh: 这个号码可以联系到我：…

senses.def: a person who claims to have been taken away by aliens
senses.zh: 被接触者（自称曾被外星人带走或与其有过接触）

senses.def: relating to the technology that allows a smart card
senses.zh: 无触点感应的；非接触式（技术）的

examples.en: contactless cards
examples.zh: 非接触式卡

examples.en: a contactless payment
examples.zh: 一笔非接触式支付款项

senses.def: the spread of a disease by close contact between people

examples.en: There is no risk of contagion.
examples.zh: 没有接触传染的风险。

senses.def: a disease that can be spread by close contact between people
something bad that spreads quickly by being passed from person to person
senses.zh: （不良事物的快速）传播，蔓延，扩散

examples.en: the contagion of political extremism
examples.zh: 政治极端主义的蔓延

senses.def: a contagious

examples.en: Scarlet fever is highly contagious.
examples.zh: 猩红热的接触传染性很强。

examples.en: His enthusiasm was contagious (= spread quickly to other people).
examples.zh: 他的热情富有感染力。

examples.en: a contagious laugh
examples.zh: 有感染力的笑声

examples.en: The new disease proved contagious.
examples.zh: 这种新的疾病证明具有触染性。

senses.def: if a person is contagious
in a way that spreads quickly to other people
if something contains

examples.en: This drink doesn't contain any alcohol.
examples.zh: 这种饮料不含任何酒精。

examples.en: The documents contain sensitive information.
examples.zh: 这些文件包含敏感信息。

examples.en: Electronic products contain hazardous materials that cannot be deposited in landfills.
examples.zh: 电子产品含有不能存放在垃圾填埋场的危险材料。

examples.en: His account contained an element of truth.
examples.zh: 他的叙述含有一点真实成分。

examples.en: to contain an amount/a number/a level of something
examples.zh: 包含一定数量的某物

examples.en: He handed over a brown envelope containing a hundred dollar bills.
examples.zh: 他交出了一个装有一百元钞票的棕色信封。

examples.en: The fish were found to contain traces of mercury.
examples.zh: 这些鱼中检出含有微量汞。

examples.en: The bottle contains (= can hold) two litres.
examples.zh: 此瓶容量为两升。

examples.en: He said he was opposed to some of the provisions contained in the bill.
examples.zh: 他表示，他反对该法案中的一些条款。

examples.en: The stories contained within these pages are highly enjoyable.
examples.zh: 这些书页里的故事非常有趣。

senses.def: to keep your feelings under control

examples.en: She was unable to contain her excitement.
examples.zh: 她无法抑制内心的激动。

examples.en: She could hardly contain her excitement.
examples.zh: 她几乎无法抑制内心的激动。

examples.en: I was so furious I just couldn't contain myself (= I had to express my feelings).
examples.zh: 我气愤极了，简直无法克制自己。

senses.def: to prevent something harmful from spreading or getting worse

examples.en: to contain an epidemic
examples.zh: 防止流行病的蔓延

examples.en: Government forces have failed to contain the rebellion.
examples.zh: 政府军未能遏止叛乱。

senses.def: a box, bottle, etc. in which something can be stored or transported

examples.en: a plastic container
examples.zh: 塑料容器

examples.en: Food will last longer if kept in an airtight container.
examples.zh: 如果贮藏在密封的容器里，食物能保存比较久的时间。

examples.en: These women carry heavy containers of water over long distances.
examples.zh: 这些妇女背着沉重的水容器长途跋涉。

examples.en: containers for nuclear materials
examples.zh: 核材料容器

senses.def: a large metal or wooden box of a standard size in which goods are packed so that they can easily be lifted onto a ship, train, etc. to be transported

examples.en: a shipping container
examples.zh: 集装箱

examples.en: a container ship (= one designed to transport such containers)
examples.zh: 集装箱船

senses.def: a box or pot made of wood, clay

examples.en: Planting bulbs in containers is a great alternative if you don't have a garden.
examples.zh: 如果没有花园，在花盆里种植球茎是一个很棒的选择。

senses.def: the process of packing and transporting things in containers
packed and transported in containers
senses.zh: 封装运输的；集装箱装运的；货柜装运的

examples.en: containerized cargo
examples.zh: 集装箱载运的货物

senses.def: the act of keeping something under control so that it cannot spread in a harmful way

examples.en: the containment of the epidemic
examples.zh: 对流行病的控制

senses.def: the act of keeping another country’s power within limits so that it does not become too powerful

examples.en: a policy of containment
examples.zh: 遏制政策

senses.def: a substance that makes something impure

examples.en: Filters do not remove all contaminants from water.
examples.zh: 过滤器无法过滤掉水中的所有污染物。

senses.def: to make a substance or place dirty or no longer pure by adding a substance that is dangerous or carries disease

examples.en: The drinking water has become contaminated with lead.
examples.zh: 饮用水被铅污染了。

examples.en: contaminated blood/food/soil
examples.zh: 受到污染的血液／食物／土壤

examples.en: a river contaminated by pollution
examples.zh: 被污染的河流

examples.en: These substances can contaminate groundwater.
examples.zh: 这些物质会污染地下水。

senses.def: to influence people’s ideas or attitudes in a bad way
senses.zh: 玷污，毒害，腐蚀（人的思想或品德）

examples.en: They were accused of contaminating the minds of our young people.
examples.zh: 他们被指控毒害我们青少年的心灵。

senses.def: the process or fact of making a substance or place dirty or no longer pure by adding a substance that is dangerous or carries disease

examples.en: radioactive contamination
examples.zh: 放射性污染

examples.en: bacterial/chemical contamination
examples.zh: 细菌/化学污染

examples.en: Environmental contamination resulting from human activities is a major health concern.
examples.zh: 人类活动造成的环境污染是一个主要的健康问题。

senses.def: the act of influencing people's ideas or attitudes in a bad way
senses.zh: 玷污，毒害，腐蚀（人的思想或品德）

examples.en: They feared cultural contamination from the influx of tourists.
examples.zh: 他们担心游客涌入会造成文化污染。

senses.def: continued
to think about whether you should do something, or how you should do something

examples.en: You're too young to be contemplating retirement.
examples.zh: 你考虑退休还太年轻。

examples.en: I have never contemplated living abroad.
examples.zh: 我从未考虑过去国外居住。

examples.en: He continued while she contemplated how to answer.
examples.zh: 她还在考虑如何回答时，他就继续往下说了。

senses.def: to think carefully about and accept the possibility of something happening
senses.zh: 考虑接受（发生某事的可能性）

examples.en: The thought of war is too awful to contemplate.
examples.zh: 战争太可怕了，真不敢去想。

examples.en: How could you even contemplate such an idea?
examples.zh: 你居然想得出这么一个主意？

examples.en: I can't contemplate what it would be like to be alone.
examples.zh: 我不能想象独自一人会是个什么样子。

examples.en: She contemplated that things might get even worse.
examples.zh: 她想到事情可能会变得更糟。

senses.def: to think deeply about something for a long time
senses.zh: 深思熟虑；沉思；苦思冥想

examples.en: to contemplate your future
examples.zh: 仔细盘算未来

examples.en: She lay in bed, contemplating.
examples.zh: 她躺在床上苦思冥想。

senses.def: to look at somebody/something in a careful way for a long time

examples.en: She contemplated him in silence.
examples.zh: 她默默地注视着他。

examples.en: He sat there, contemplating his fingernails.
examples.zh: 他坐在那里，端详着自己的手指甲。

senses.def: the act of thinking deeply about something

examples.en: He sat there deep in contemplation.
examples.zh: 他坐在那里沉思着。

examples.en: Let's take a few moments of quiet contemplation.
examples.zh: 让我们花一些时间安静地沉思一下。

examples.en: The monks dedicate themselves to a life of prayer and contemplation.
examples.zh: 僧侣过着祈祷和冥思的生活。

senses.def: the act of looking at something in a calm and careful way

examples.en: She turned from her contemplation of the photograph.
examples.zh: 她从凝视着的那张照片上移开目光。

senses.def: being considered

examples.en: By 1613 even more desperate measures were in contemplation.
examples.zh: 到 1613 年，甚至考虑要采取更为孤注一掷的措施。

senses.def: being considered

examples.en: By 1613 even more desperate measures were in contemplation.
examples.zh: 到 1613 年，甚至考虑要采取更为孤注一掷的措施。

senses.def: thinking quietly and seriously about something
senses.zh: 沉思默想的；深思熟虑的

examples.en: She was in contemplative mood.
examples.zh: 她陷入沉思之中。

examples.en: He gave her a contemplative look.
examples.zh: 他给了她一个沉思的眼神。

senses.def: spending time thinking deeply about religious matters
senses.zh: （对宗教问题）冥想的，敛心默祷的

examples.en: the contemplative life (= life in a religious community)
examples.zh: 宗教上的默观生活

senses.def: happening or existing at the same time
senses.zh: 同时发生（或存在）的；同时期的；同时代的

examples.en: How do we know that the signature is contemporaneous with the document?
examples.zh: 我们怎样才能知道这个签字和文件是同一个时间的呢？

examples.en: contemporaneous events/accounts
examples.zh: 同一时期的事情／记述

senses.def: in a way that happens or exists at the same time
senses.zh: 同时发生（或存在）的；同时期的；同时代的

examples.en: The later years are recorded contemporaneously with the events they describe.
examples.zh: 后来的岁月与他们所描述的事件同时记录。

senses.def: belonging to the same time
senses.zh: 属同时期的；同一时代的

examples.en: We have no contemporary account of the battle (= written near the time that it happened).
examples.zh: 我们没有当时人们对这一战役的记载。

examples.en: He was contemporary with the dramatist Congreve.
examples.zh: 他与剧作家康格里夫属于同一时代。

examples.en: The amphitheatre is roughly contemporary with the Colosseum in Rome.
examples.zh: 圆形剧场大致与罗马斗兽场同时代。

senses.def: belonging to the present time

examples.en: contemporary society/culture
examples.zh: 当代社会／文化

examples.en: contemporary art/music/dance
examples.zh: 当代艺术／音乐／舞蹈

examples.en: contemporary architecture/literature/painting/politics/history
examples.zh: 当代建筑/文学/绘画/政治/历史

examples.en: He is among the best-known contemporary artists.
examples.zh: 他是最著名的当代艺术家之一。

examples.en: The film paints a depressing picture of life in contemporary Britain.
examples.zh: 这部电影描绘了当代英国一幅沉闷的生活画面。

senses.def: following modern ideas in style or design

examples.en: Try some contemporary colours on your kitchen walls.
examples.zh: 在厨房墙壁上尝试一些现代颜色。

senses.def: a person who lives or lived at the same time as somebody else, especially somebody who is about the same age

examples.en: She and I were contemporaries at college.
examples.zh: 她和我在大学是同学。

examples.en: He was a contemporary of Freud and may have known him.
examples.zh: 他是弗洛伊德的同代人，可能认识弗洛伊德。

examples.en: Give or take a few years, they are contemporaries.
examples.zh: 或多或少几年，他们是同时代的人。

senses.def: the feeling that somebody/something is without value and deserves no respect at all

examples.en: She looked at him with contempt.
examples.zh: 她轻蔑地看着他。

examples.en: I shall treat that suggestion with the contempt it deserves.
examples.zh: 我对那项建议当然会不屑一顾。

examples.en: His treatment of his children is beneath contempt (= so bad that it is not even worth feeling contempt for).
examples.zh: 他对待自己子女的行径为人所不齿。

examples.en: Politicians seem to be generally held in contempt by ordinary people.
examples.zh: 一般百姓似乎普遍鄙视从政者。

examples.en: They had shown a contempt for the values she thought important.
examples.zh: 他们对她所认为重要的价值表示蔑视。

examples.en: His remarks betray a staggering contempt for the truth (= are completely false).
examples.zh: 他的话表明他完全无视事情的真相。

senses.def: a lack of worry or fear about rules, danger, etc.

examples.en: The firefighters showed a contempt for their own safety.
examples.zh: 那些消防队员把他们自己的安全置之度外。

examples.en: She'd developed what she considered a healthy contempt for authority.
examples.zh: 她养成了蔑视权威的习惯，认为这是正常合理的。

senses.def: the crime of refusing to obey an order made by a court; not showing respect for a court or judge

examples.en: He could be jailed for two years for contempt.
examples.zh: 他由于藐视法庭可能被监禁两年。

examples.en: She was held in contempt for refusing to testify.
examples.zh: 她因拒绝作证而被判藐视法庭罪。

senses.def: knowing somebody/something very well may cause you to lose respect for them/it
senses.zh: 亲不敬，熟生蔑；过分亲密就会有所侮慢

senses.def: knowing somebody/something very well may cause you to lose respect for them/it
senses.zh: 亲不敬，熟生蔑；过分亲密就会有所侮慢

senses.def: the crime of refusing to obey an order made by a court; not showing respect for a court or judge

examples.en: Any person who disregards this order will be in contempt of court.
examples.zh: 凡漠视本法令者将被判藐视法庭罪。

examples.en: to be guilty of contempt of court
examples.zh: 犯藐视法庭罪

examples.en: He was charged with contempt of court after shouting at a witness.
examples.zh: 他因对证人大喊大叫而被控犯有藐视法庭罪。

senses.def: not deserving any respect at all
senses.zh: 可轻蔑的；可鄙的；卑劣的

examples.en: contemptible behaviour
examples.zh: 卑劣的行为

senses.def: feeling or showing that you have no respect for somebody/something
senses.zh: 蔑视的；鄙视的；表示轻蔑的

examples.en: She gave him a contemptuous look.
examples.zh: 她鄙夷地看了他一眼。

examples.en: The company has shown a contemptuous disregard for Henry’s complaints.
examples.zh: 公司对亨利的抱怨漠然视之。

examples.en: Her voice sounded almost contemptuous.
examples.zh: 她的语气近乎轻蔑。

examples.en: He was contemptuous of everything I did.
examples.zh: 他对我所做的一切都不屑一顾。

senses.def: in a way that shows that you have no respect for somebody/something
senses.zh: 蔑视的；鄙视的；表示轻蔑的

examples.en: to laugh contemptuously
examples.zh: 轻蔑地大笑

senses.def: to say that something is true, especially in an argument
senses.zh: （尤指在争论中）声称，主张，认为

examples.en: I would contend that the minister's thinking is flawed on this point.
examples.zh: 我倒认为部长的想法在这一点上有漏洞。

senses.def: to compete against somebody in order to gain something

examples.en: Three armed groups were contending for power.
examples.zh: 三个武装集团在争夺权力。

senses.def: to have to deal with a problem or with a difficult situation or person

examples.en: Nurses often have to contend with violent or drunken patients.
examples.zh: 护士经常不得不应付粗暴的或喝醉酒的病人。

senses.def: a person or team with a chance of winning a competition

examples.en: a contender for a gold medal in the Olympics
examples.zh: 奥运金牌的争夺者

examples.en: a leading/serious/strong contender for the party leadership
examples.zh: 该党领导权最重要的／强劲的／有实力的角逐者

examples.en: Germany last night emerged as a contender to stage next year's event.
examples.zh: 德国昨晚现身成为举办明年赛事的竞争者。

senses.def: the things that are contained in something
senses.zh: 所容纳之物；所含之物；内容

examples.en: He tipped the contents of the bag onto the table.
examples.zh: 他把提包里的东西倒在桌子上。

examples.en: Fire has caused severe damage to the contents of the building.
examples.zh: 大火导致那栋大楼里的东西严重损毁。

examples.en: She hadn't read the letter and so was unaware of its contents.
examples.zh: 她没有看过那封信，所以对其内容一无所知。

examples.en: She picked up the glass and drank the contents.
examples.zh: 她拿起玻璃杯把里面的东西喝了下去。

senses.def: the different sections that are contained in a book

examples.en: a table of contents (= the list at the front of a book)
examples.zh: 目录

examples.en: a contents page
examples.zh: 目录页

senses.def: the subject matter of a book, speech, programme, etc.
senses.zh: （书、讲话、节目等的）主题，主要内容

examples.en: Her poetry has a good deal of political content.
examples.zh: 她的诗歌包含大量的政治内容。

examples.en: Your tone of voice is as important as the content of what you have to say.
examples.zh: 你的讲话声调和你要讲的内容同样重要。

examples.en: The content of the course depends on what the students would like to study.
examples.zh: 课程的内容取决于学生愿意学什么。

examples.en: This study is based on a content analysis of press coverage of the president during his time in office.
examples.zh: 这项研究基于对总统在任期间新闻报道的内容分析。

senses.def: the amount of a substance that is contained in something else

examples.en: food with a high fat content
examples.zh: 脂肪含量高的食物

examples.en: water/moisture/protein/DNA content
examples.zh: 水／水分／蛋白质／DNA 含量

examples.en: the alcohol content of a drink
examples.zh: 饮料的酒精含量

senses.def: the information or other material contained on a website or other digital media
senses.zh: （网站或其他数字媒介上的）内容

examples.en: digital/video/online content
examples.zh: 数字／视频／在线内容

examples.en: We plan to spend more on creating content for the website.
examples.zh: 我们计划在制作网站内容方面投入更多。

examples.en: delivering premium content to users
examples.zh: 向用户提供优质内容

examples.en: a method of sharing content over the internet
examples.zh: 在互联网共享内容的方法

examples.en: to stream/access/consume/view content
examples.zh: 流式传输／访问／消费／查看内容

examples.en: content management
examples.zh: 内容管理

senses.def: a feeling of being happy or satisfied

examples.en: She stood for a moment looking with content at her husband.
examples.zh: 她站了一会儿，满意地看着她的丈夫。

senses.def: as much as you want

examples.en: a supervised play area where children can run around to their heart’s content
examples.zh: 一处能让孩子们尽情游玩且有人看管的地方

senses.def: happy and satisfied with what you have

examples.en: He seemed more content, less bitter.
examples.zh: 他看起来比较满意，不那么愤愤不平。

examples.en: He had to be content with third place.
examples.zh: 他只好屈居第三名。

examples.en: Not content with stealing my boyfriend (= not thinking that this was enough), she has turned all my friends against me.
examples.zh: 她夺走了我的男朋友还不满足，又挑起我所有的朋友和我作对。

senses.def: willing to do something

examples.zh: 拟订应变计划

examples.zh: 意外开支准备金

examples.zh: 生命的偶然性是人类生存状态的一部分。

examples.zh: 他一直在不断地改写他的材料。

examples.zh: 我们长期生活在害怕被发现的恐惧中。

examples.zh: 他们渴望确保经济改革计划持续下去。
