senses.def: something that is joined on to something else and forms a part of it

examples.en: There are plans to build a continuation of the bypass next year.
examples.zh: 已有计划明年修建这条支路的延长线。

senses.def: to keep existing or happening without stopping
senses.zh: 持续；继续存在；不断发生

examples.en: If the current trend continues, that number will increase 165 per cent by 2050.
examples.zh: 如果目前的趋势继续下去，到 2050 年，这个数字将增加 165%。

examples.en: Police have not yet made any arrests, but investigations continue.
examples.zh: 警方尚未逮捕任何人，但调查仍在继续。

examples.en: The exhibition continues until 25 July.
examples.zh: 展览举行至 7 月 25 日为止。

examples.en: Fighting continued for four years.
examples.zh: 战斗持续了四年。

examples.en: The rain will continue into the evening.
examples.zh: 这场雨会持续下到晚上。

examples.en: Unions declared that the strike would continue indefinitely.
examples.zh: 工会宣布罢工将无限期地持续下去。

examples.en: Life continued on as normal.
examples.zh: 生活照常进行。

examples.en: Work continues apace on the second phase of the development.
examples.zh: 第二阶段的开发工作仍在快速进行。

examples.en: The tradition continues to this day.
examples.zh: 这一传统延续至今。

examples.en: The violence continues unabated.
examples.zh: 暴力活动持续，丝毫没有好转。

examples.en: The economy is continuing to grow.
examples.zh: 经济正在继续增长。

examples.en: The number of car accident deaths is continuing to decline.
examples.zh: 车祸死亡人数持续下降。

examples.en: Costs continued to rise.
examples.zh: 成本继续上升。

examples.en: The rain continued to fall all afternoon.
examples.zh: 这场雨整整一下午都下个不停。

examples.en: The rain continued falling all afternoon.
examples.zh: 这场雨整整一下午都下个不停。

senses.def: to keep doing something without stopping

examples.en: She wanted to continue working until she was 60.
examples.zh: 她想要继续工作到 60 岁。

examples.en: He vowed to continue fighting.
examples.zh: 他发誓要继续战斗。

examples.en: We will continue to work closely with our international partners on this.
examples.zh: 我们将继续与我们的国际合作伙伴在这方面密切合作。

examples.en: He continued to ignore everything I was saying.
examples.zh: 他仍对我所说的一切置若罔闻。

examples.en: to continue a tradition/trend
examples.zh: 延续传统／趋势

examples.en: The board of inquiry is continuing its investigations.
examples.zh: 调查委员会在继续做调查。

examples.en: An estimated 2 per cent of the population continue their education beyond secondary school.
examples.zh: 据估计，2%的人口在中学毕业后继续接受教育。

examples.en: She moved to New York to continue her studies.
examples.zh: 她搬到纽约继续她的学业。

examples.en: He continued his work in secret.
examples.zh: 他秘密地继续工作。

examples.en: His mother vowed to continue her fight for justice.
examples.zh: 他的母亲发誓要继续为正义而战。

examples.en: Are you going to continue with the project?
examples.zh: 你要继续做这个项目吗？

examples.en: At the age of 70 she still runs 5 kilometres every day and intends to continue for as long as she can.
examples.zh: 70岁的她仍然每天跑5公里，并打算尽可能坚持下去。

senses.def: to go or move further in the same direction

examples.en: The rough track continues, but it quickly disappears into undergrowth.
examples.zh: 崎岖不平的小路还在继续，但很快就消失在灌木丛中。

examples.en: The path continued over rough, rocky ground.
examples.zh: 这条小路穿过了崎岖不平的石头地。

examples.en: He continued on his way.
examples.zh: 他继续走他的路。

examples.en: The road continues through the village of Knightwick.
examples.zh: 这条路继续穿过奈特威克村。

senses.def: to remain in a particular job or condition

examples.en: She will continue in her present job until a replacement can be found.
examples.zh: 在找到替换人员以前，她将继续做她目前的工作。

examples.en: I want you to continue as project manager.
examples.zh: 我要你留任项目经理。

senses.def: to start or start something again after stopping for a time

examples.en: The story continues in our next issue.
examples.zh: 这篇故事我们将在下一期里继续刊载。

examples.en: They had to continue their journey on foot.
examples.zh: 他们不得不徒步继续行程。

examples.en: We shall continue our discussion of retailing in Chapter 7.
examples.zh: 我们将在第七章继续讨论零售业。

examples.en: The story will be continued in our next issue.
examples.zh: 这篇故事我们将在下一期里继续刊载。

senses.def: to start speaking again after stopping

examples.en: Please continue—I didn't mean to interrupt.
examples.zh: 请继续往下说，我并非有意打断你的话。

examples.en: She simply turned her back to me and continued her phone conversation.
examples.zh: 她转过身背对着我，继续讲电话。

examples.en: ‘In fact,’ he continued, ‘I'd like to congratulate you.’
examples.zh: “其实，”他接着说，“我想向你表示祝贺。”

senses.def: education for adults that is available outside the formal education system, for example at evening classes or over the internet

examples.en: We have a thriving continuing education department.
examples.zh: 我们有一个蓬勃发展的继续教育部门。

senses.def: the fact of not stopping or not changing

examples.en: to ensure/provide/maintain continuity of fuel supplies
examples.zh: 确保／提供／保持燃料供给的连续性

senses.def: a logical connection between the parts of something, or between two things

examples.en: The novel fails to achieve narrative continuity.
examples.zh: 这部小说叙述不连贯。

examples.en: There are obvious continuities between diet and health.
examples.zh: 日常饮食与健康之间有着明显的逻辑关联。

senses.def: the organization of a film or television programme, especially making sure that people’s clothes, objects, etc. are the same from one scene to the next
senses.zh: （电影或电视节目前后场景中服装、物品等的）一致性，衔接

senses.def: a musical part played with another instrument, in which a line of low notes is shown with figures to represent the higher notes to be played above them

examples.en: a trio for two violins and continuo
examples.zh: 两小提琴与通奏低音的三声中部

senses.def: happening or existing for a period of time without being interrupted

examples.en: Recovery after the accident will be a continuous process that may take several months.
examples.zh: 事故后的恢复将是一个持续的过程，可能需要几个月的时间。

examples.en: The organization aims to create a culture of continuous improvement .
examples.zh: 这个组织的目标是创造一种持续提升的文化。

examples.en: a continuous stream of data
examples.zh: 连续的数据流

examples.en: a continuous flow of knowledge, information and understanding
examples.zh: 知识、信息和理解的持续流动

examples.en: The rain has been almost continuous for weeks.
examples.zh: 这场雨已经差不多连续下了好几个星期了。

examples.en: She was in continuous employment until the age of sixty-five.
examples.zh: 她连续不断地受雇于人，一直工作到 65 岁。

senses.def: spreading in a line or over an area without any spaces

examples.en: a continuous flow of traffic
examples.zh: 络绎不绝的车流

examples.en: a continuous stream of lava from the volcano
examples.zh: 火山熔岩源源不断的喷发

examples.en: the largest continuous tropical forest in Central America
examples.zh: 中美洲最大的连续热带森林

senses.def: repeated many times

examples.en: For four days the town suffered continuous attacks.
examples.zh: 那座城镇连续四天遭到了袭击。

senses.def: connected with the form of a verb (for example I am waiting

examples.en: the continuous tenses
examples.zh: 进行时态

senses.def: a system of giving a student a final mark based on work done during a course of study rather than on one exam
senses.zh: 连续性评定（学生的最后成绩不是根据一次考试而是根据课程作业）

examples.en: The final grade depends heavily on coursework and continuous assessment.
examples.zh: 最终成绩在很大程度上取决于课程作业和持续评估。

senses.def: a variable

examples.en: Age was reported as a continuous variable.
examples.zh: 年龄在报告中是作为连续变量。

senses.def: in a way that happens or exists for a period of time without being interrupted

examples.en: He has lived and worked in France almost continuously since 1990.
examples.zh: 自 1990 年以来，他几乎一直在法国生活和工作。

examples.en: the continuously changing situation
examples.zh: 不断变化的局势

examples.en: Heat the mixture until thickened, stirring continuously.
examples.zh: 将混合物加热直至变稠，不断搅拌。

senses.def: in a way that is repeated many times

examples.en: This prevents the system from continuously trying to deliver email.
examples.zh: 这可以防止系统不断尝试发送电子邮件。

senses.def: a series of similar items in which each is almost the same as the ones next to it but the last is very different from the first
senses.zh: （相邻两者相似但起首与末尾截然不同的）连续体

examples.en: It is impossible to say at what point along the continuum a dialect becomes a separate language.
examples.zh: 要说出同一语言的方言差异到什么程度才成为另一种语言是不可能的。

senses.def: to become twisted

examples.en: His face contorted with anger.
examples.zh: 他脸都气歪了。

examples.en: Her mouth was contorted in a snarl.
examples.zh: 她龇牙咧嘴地怒吼着。

examples.en: A spasm of pain contorted his face.
examples.zh: 一阵疼痛扭歪了他的脸

senses.def: a movement that twists
senses.zh: （脸部或躯体的）扭曲，变形，走样

examples.en: His facial contortions amused the audience of schoolchildren.
examples.zh: 他扮鬼脸逗得小学生观众都笑起来了。

examples.en: Their bodies had suffered contortion as a result of malnutrition.
examples.zh: 由于营养不良他们的躯体都变了形。

senses.def: a complicated series of actions or thought process

examples.en: We had to go through all the usual contortions to get a ticket.
examples.zh: 我们照例得费尽周折才弄到了一张票。

examples.en: intellectual/mental/logical contortions
examples.zh: 智力／心理／逻辑层面的斗争

senses.def: a performer who does contortions
the outer edges of something; the outline of its shape or form

examples.en: The road follows the natural contours of the coastline.
examples.zh: 这条路沿着海岸线的自然轮廓延伸。

examples.en: She traced the contours of his face with her finger.
examples.zh: 她用一根手指拂过他脸部的轮廓。

senses.def: a line on a map that joins points that are the same height above sea level
senses.zh: （地图上连接相同海拔各点的）等高线

examples.en: a contour map (= a map that includes these lines)
examples.zh: 等高线地图

senses.def: to put dark liquid or powder on your face in order to emphasize its features
senses.zh: 将深色液体或粉末涂在脸上以强调其特征

examples.en: I prefer to only contour my cheeks.
examples.zh: 我更喜欢只画脸颊的轮廓。

examples.en: It looks as if she contours.
examples.zh: 看起来就像她的轮廓。

senses.def: against; opposite

examples.en: contraflow
examples.zh: 一侧双向行驶

examples.en: contradict
examples.zh: 反驳

senses.def: having a pitch

examples.en: a contrabassoon
examples.zh: 低音大管

senses.def: goods that are illegally taken into or out of a country
senses.zh: （非法带入或带出国境的）禁运品，走私货

examples.en: contraband goods
examples.zh: 违禁货物

examples.en: to smuggle contraband
examples.zh: 走私违禁品

senses.def: with a range of notes one octave

examples.en: a contrabass clarinet
examples.zh: 倍低音单簧管。

senses.def: a bassoon
the practice of using artificial methods to avoid becoming pregnant when having sex; the methods of doing this

examples.en: to give advice about contraception
examples.zh: 就避孕方法提供咨询

senses.def: used to prevent a woman from becoming pregnant
senses.zh: 避孕药；避孕用具；避孕措施

examples.en: a contraceptive pill
examples.zh: 避孕药

examples.en: contraceptive advice/precautions/methods
examples.zh: 避孕建议／措施／方法

senses.def: a drug, device or practice used to avoid becoming pregnant when having sex
senses.zh: 避孕药；避孕用具；避孕措施

examples.en: oral contraceptives
examples.zh: 口服避孕药

senses.def: an official written agreement

examples.en: All employees have a written contract of employment.
examples.zh: 每个员工都有一份书面聘用合同。

examples.en: a research/modelling/recording contract
examples.zh: 研究／模特儿／录音合同

examples.en: a lucrative government contract
examples.zh: 利润丰厚的政府合同

examples.en: to enter into/negotiate/sign a contract with the supplier
examples.zh: 与供应商签订合同

examples.en: These clauses form part of the contract between buyer and seller.
examples.zh: 这些条款构成买卖双方所签合同的一部分。

examples.en: a contract for the supply of vehicles
examples.zh: 提供车辆的合约

examples.en: to win/be awarded a contract to build a new school
examples.zh: 获得承建一所新学校的合同

examples.en: to renew/extend/terminate/cancel a contract
examples.zh: 续签／延期／终止／取消合同

examples.en: I was on a three-year contract that expired last week.
examples.zh: 我签订的三年期合同已于上周期满。

examples.en: She is under contract to (= has a contract to work for) a major American computer firm.
examples.zh: 她已签约为一家大型美国计算机公司工作。

examples.en: The phone costs several hundred dollars more out of contract (= without a contract with a phone company).
examples.zh: 这部电话的合约外价格要高出几百美元。

examples.en: The midfielder will be out of contract at the end of the season (= his contract with his club will have finished).
examples.zh: 这名中场球员的合同将在本赛季结束时到期（=他与俱乐部的合同将结束）。

examples.en: a contract worker (= one employed on a contract for a fixed period of time)
examples.zh: 合同工

examples.en: Under the terms of the contract the job should have been finished yesterday.
examples.zh: 根据合同的条款，这项工作本应于昨天完成。

examples.en: They were sued for breach of contract (= not doing what they agreed to do in a contract).
examples.zh: 他们被指控违约。

examples.en: He had a release clause written into his contract.
examples.zh: 他的合同中写有免责条款。

examples.en: The offer has been accepted, subject to contract (= the agreement is not official until the contract is signed).
examples.zh: 此报价已获接受，尚须以签约为准。

senses.def: an agreement to kill somebody for money

examples.en: She took out a contract on her ex-husband.
examples.zh: 她雇好了凶手打算谋杀她的前夫。

examples.en: He has a contract out on you.
examples.zh: 他已雇了人杀你。

senses.def: to become less or smaller; to make something become less or smaller

examples.en: Glass contracts as it cools.
examples.zh: 玻璃遇冷收缩。

examples.en: The universe is expanding rather than contracting.
examples.zh: 宇宙正在膨胀而不是收缩。

examples.en: a contracting market
examples.zh: 萎缩的市场

examples.en: The economy will contract by 2 per cent this year.
examples.zh: 今年经济将萎缩 2%。

examples.en: The heart muscles contract to expel the blood.
examples.zh: 心脏肌肉收缩以挤压出血液。

examples.en: The exercise consists of stretching and contracting the leg muscles.
examples.zh: 此项训练包括伸展和收缩腿部肌肉。

examples.en: ‘I will’ and ‘I shall’ are usually contracted to ‘I'll’ (= made shorter).
examples.zh: I will 和 I shall 通常缩写成 I’ll。

senses.def: to get an illness

examples.en: to contract a virus/a disease/measles
examples.zh: 感染病毒／疾病／麻疹

senses.def: to make a legal agreement with somebody for them to work for you or provide you with a service

examples.en: The player is contracted to play until August.
examples.zh: 这位选手签约参加比赛到八月份。

examples.en: Several computer engineers have been contracted to the finance department.
examples.zh: 有几位计算机工程师与财务部门签订了合同。

examples.en: He can't work for them because he is contracted with another company.
examples.zh: 他因与另一家公司已签约，所以不能为他们工作。

senses.def: to make a legal agreement to work for somebody or provide them with a service

examples.en: She has contracted to work 20 hours a week.
examples.zh: 她已签订每周工作 20 小时的合同。

senses.def: to formally agree to marry somebody/form an alliance
the standard form of the card game bridge
senses.zh: 定约桥牌（桥牌游戏的标准形式，只能按叫到的定约取得成局奖分）

senses.def: to formally agree that you will take part in something

examples.en: You are strongly advised to contract into the scheme.
examples.zh: 强烈建议您签订该计划。

senses.def: to formally agree that you will not take part in something
senses.zh: 订约不参与；退出（或不参加）…合约

examples.en: Many employees contracted out of the pension plan.
examples.zh: 许多雇员退出了养老金计划的合约。

senses.def: to arrange for work to be done by another company rather than your own

examples.en: The local authority has contracted out its waste management services.
examples.zh: 当地政府已将废物管理服务外包。

senses.def: able to contract or, of an opening or tube, become narrower
senses.zh: 可收缩的；（开口或管）可变窄的

senses.def: the process of becoming smaller

examples.en: The design needs to allow for the expansion and contraction of the metal.
examples.zh: 设计需要考虑到金属的膨胀和收缩。

examples.en: The sudden contraction of the markets left them with a lot of unwanted stock.
examples.zh: 股票市场骤然收缩，让他们剩下了许多无人要的股票。

examples.en: Physical stress caused by expansion and contraction can damage components within the computer.
examples.zh: 膨胀和收缩引起的物理压力可能会损坏计算机内部的组件。

examples.en: the contraction of the pipes in cold weather
examples.zh: 寒冷天气下管道的收缩

senses.def: a sudden and painful contracting of muscles, especially the muscles around a woman’s womb
senses.zh: （肌肉的）收缩，挛缩；（尤指分娩时的）子宫收缩

examples.en: The contractions started coming every five minutes.
examples.zh: 子宫开始每隔五分钟收缩一次。

examples.en: Neurons control the contraction of muscles.
examples.zh: 神经元控制肌肉的收缩。

examples.en: The contractions were coming every ten minutes.
examples.zh: 每十分钟就会有一次宫缩。

senses.def: a short form of a word

examples.en: ‘He's’ may be a contraction of ‘he is’ or ‘he has’.
examples.zh: he’s 可以是 he is 或 he has 的缩写形式。

senses.def: a person or company that has a contract to do work or provide goods or services for another company
senses.zh: 承包人；承包商；承包公司

examples.en: a building/roofing/electrical contractor
examples.zh: 建筑／屋顶修建／电气承包商

examples.en: a defence/security/military/civilian contractor
examples.zh: 国防／安全／军事／民用承包商

examples.en: a private/an independent contractor
examples.zh: 私人／独立承包商

examples.en: to employ an outside contractor
examples.zh: 雇用外来承包商

senses.def: connected with the conditions of a legal written agreement; agreed in a contract
senses.zh: 合同的；契约的；按合同（或契约）规定的

examples.en: We have contractual obligations to control prices.
examples.zh: 我们有控制价格的合同义务。

senses.def: in a way that is connected with the conditions of a legal written agreement, or that is agreed in a contract
senses.zh: 合同的；契约的；按合同（或契约）规定的

examples.en: The landowner is contractually obliged to maintain and conserve the land.
examples.zh: 土地所有者有合同义务维护和保护土地。

senses.def: to say that something that somebody else has said is wrong, and that the opposite is true

examples.en: All evening her husband contradicted everything she said.
examples.zh: 整个晚上她说什么丈夫都反驳。

examples.en: You've just contradicted yourself (= said the opposite of what you said before).
examples.zh: 你恰好与你刚才说的自相矛盾。

examples.en: ‘No, it’s not,’ she contradicted (him).
examples.zh: “不，不是的。”她反驳（他）说。

senses.def: to be so different from each other that one of them must be wrong

examples.en: The two stories contradict each other.
examples.zh: 这两种说法相互抵触。

examples.en: This version of events was contradicted by eye-witness reports.
examples.zh: 对事件的这种说法和目击者的报告相矛盾。

senses.def: a lack of agreement between facts, opinions, actions, etc.
senses.zh: （事实、看法、行动等的）不一致，矛盾，对立

examples.en: There is a contradiction between the two sets of figures.
examples.zh: 这两组数据相互矛盾。

examples.en: How can we resolve this apparent contradiction?
examples.zh: 我们怎样才能解决这个明显的矛盾呢？

examples.en: His public speeches are in direct contradiction to his personal lifestyle.
examples.zh: 他的公开言论与他私下的生活方式恰恰相反。

senses.def: the act of saying that something that somebody else has said is wrong or not true; an example of this

examples.en: I think I can say, without fear of contradiction, that…
examples.zh: 就算有人反驳，我也敢说…

examples.en: Now you say you both left at ten—that's a contradiction of your last statement.
examples.zh: 你现在说你们俩是十点钟离开的，这可和你上次的说法不一致。

senses.def: a statement containing two words that contradict

examples.en: A ‘nomad settlement’ is a contradiction in terms.
examples.zh: “游牧者的定居点”是用词上的自相矛盾。

examples.en: The idea is almost a contradiction in terms.
examples.zh: 这主意本身几乎就是自相矛盾的。

senses.def: a statement containing two words that contradict

examples.en: A ‘nomad settlement’ is a contradiction in terms.
examples.zh: “游牧者的定居点”是用词上的自相矛盾。

examples.en: The idea is almost a contradiction in terms.
examples.zh: 这主意本身几乎就是自相矛盾的。

senses.def: containing or showing a lack of agreement between statements, facts, opinions or actions
senses.zh: 相互矛盾的；对立的；不一致的

examples.en: We are faced with two apparently contradictory statements.
examples.zh: 我们面前这两种说法显然是矛盾的。

examples.en: The advice I received was often contradictory.
examples.zh: 我所得到的建议常常是相互矛盾的。

senses.def: in contrast with something/somebody

examples.en: Lionesses, in contradistinction to the females of other animals, are the hunters.
examples.zh: 与其他动物的雌性不同，母狮是猎人。

senses.def: talking about something that is not true. ‘
a system that is used when one half of a large road is closed for repairs, and the traffic going in both directions has to use the other half
senses.zh: （道路一侧关闭维修时实行的）一侧双向行驶

examples.en: A contraflow system is in operation on this section of the motorway.
examples.zh: 这段高速公路的一侧正在实行双向行驶。

senses.def: the white line that is left in the sky by a plane
senses.zh: 凝结尾迹（飞机高空飞行时形成的白色条带）

examples.en: Contrails crossing clear skies can form beautiful patterns.
examples.zh: 划过蓝天的凝结尾迹可以构成美丽的图案。

senses.def: if a drug or treatment is contraindicated
senses.zh: 禁忌使用（某种药物或疗法）

examples.en: This drug is contraindicated in patients with asthma.
examples.zh: 这种药哮喘病人禁用。

senses.def: a medical reason for not giving somebody a particular drug or medical treatment
senses.zh: 禁忌证（指不适宜采用某种治疗或药物的情况）

examples.en: Age alone is not a contraindication to surgery.
examples.zh: 年龄本身并不是手术的禁忌症。

senses.def: a singing voice with a lower range than that of a soprano
senses.zh: 女低音声部；女低音歌手

senses.def: a machine or piece of equipment that looks strange or complicated and possibly does not work well
senses.zh: 奇特（而无用）的装置；复杂的玩意儿

examples.en: She showed us a strange contraption that looked like a satellite dish.
examples.zh: 她给我们看了一个奇怪的玩意儿，样子像卫星电视碟形天线。

senses.def: having two or more tunes played together to form a whole
a person who opposes or rejects popular opinion, especially in financial markets
senses.zh: （尤指金融市场中的）逆向投资者

examples.en: Contrarians warned that the stock markets' giant gains were not justified.
examples.zh: 逆向投资者警告说，股市的大幅上涨并没有充分理由。

senses.def: a child who behaves contrarily
senses.zh: 相反地：一个表现相反的孩子表现得很差，故意与期望或期望相反

senses.def: the quality in children of behaving badly or of choosing to do or say the opposite of what is expected
senses.zh: 乖戾的；好与人作对的；逆反的；犟的

senses.def: used at the beginning of a sentence or clause to introduce a contrast
senses.zh: （用于句首或从句的开头以引出对比）相反，在另一方面

examples.en: You can only vote if you are a member. Contrariwise, not all members have the right to vote.
examples.zh: 只有当您是会员时才可以投票。相反，并非所有成员都有投票权。

senses.def: in the opposite way

examples.en: It worked contrariwise—first you dialled the number, then you put the money in.
examples.zh: 这部电话的操作方式相反，要先拨号码，然后投入钱币。

senses.def: different from something; against something
senses.zh: 与之相异的；相对立的；相反的

examples.en: Contrary to popular belief, many cats dislike milk.
examples.zh: 与普遍的看法相反，许多猫不喜欢牛奶。

examples.en: The government has decided that the publication of the report would be ‘contrary to the public interest’.
examples.zh: 政府认为发表这份报告将会“违背公众的利益”。

examples.en: Contrary to expectations and the weather forecast, we had a fine day for the experiment.
examples.zh: 与预期和天气预报相反，我们的实验度过了美好的一天。

senses.def: completely different in nature or direction
senses.zh: （在性质或方向上）截然不同的，完全相反的

examples.en: contrary advice/opinions/arguments
examples.zh: 完全相反的建议／观点／论点

examples.en: The contrary view is that prison provides an excellent education—in crime.
examples.zh: 截然不同的看法是监狱可以提供极好的教育 － 在犯罪方面。

senses.def: behaving badly; choosing to do or say the opposite of what is expected
senses.zh: 乖戾的；好与人作对的；逆反的；犟的

examples.en: She was such a contrary child—it was impossible to please her.
examples.zh: 这孩子老跟人作对，没法让她高兴。

senses.def: the opposite fact, event or situation
senses.zh: 相反的事实（或事情、情况）

examples.en: In the end the contrary was proved true: he was innocent and she was guilty.
examples.zh: 最后证明事实正好相反：他是无辜的，而她则有罪。

senses.def: used to introduce a statement that says the opposite of the last one

examples.en: ‘It must have been terrible.’ ‘On the contrary, I enjoyed every minute.’
examples.zh: “那一定是很糟糕。”“恰恰相反，我非常喜欢。”

senses.def: used to emphasize that the opposite of what has been said is true

examples.en: I don't find him funny at all. Quite the contrary.
examples.zh: 正相反，我觉得他一点儿也不可笑。

senses.def: showing or proving the opposite

examples.en: Show me some evidence to the contrary (= proving that something is not true).
examples.zh: 给我看看有什么相反的证据吧。

examples.en: I will expect to see you on Sunday unless I hear anything to the contrary (= that you are not coming).
examples.zh: 我星期天等你，除非你说不来了。

senses.def: used to introduce a statement that says the opposite of the last one

examples.en: ‘It must have been terrible.’ ‘On the contrary, I enjoyed every minute.’
examples.zh: “那一定是很糟糕。”“恰恰相反，我非常喜欢。”

senses.def: used to emphasize that the opposite of what has been said is true

examples.en: I don't find him funny at all. Quite the contrary.
examples.zh: 正相反，我觉得他一点儿也不可笑。

senses.def: showing or proving the opposite

examples.en: Show me some evidence to the contrary (= proving that something is not true).
examples.zh: 给我看看有什么相反的证据吧。

examples.en: I will expect to see you on Sunday unless I hear anything to the contrary (= that you are not coming).
examples.zh: 我星期天等你，除非你说不来了。

senses.def: a difference between two or more people or things that you can see clearly when they are compared or put close together; the fact of comparing two or more things in order to show the differences between them

examples.en: The two cities make an interesting contrast.
examples.zh: 这两个城市形成有趣的对比。

examples.en: There is an obvious contrast between the cultures of East and West.
examples.zh: 东西方文化之间有明显的差异。

examples.en: In contrast, the south suffered very little hurricane damage.
examples.zh: 相比之下，南部几乎没有遭到飓风破坏。

examples.en: The situation when we arrived was in marked contrast to the news reports.
examples.zh: 我们到达时的局势与新闻报道的截然不同。

examples.en: The poverty of her childhood stands in total contrast to her life in Hollywood.
examples.zh: 她孩提时的贫困处境与她在好莱坞的生活有着天壤之别。

examples.en: The company lost $7 million this quarter in contrast to a profit of $6.2 million a year earlier.
examples.zh: 这家公司本季度亏损了 700 万美元，与去年同期 620 万美元的盈利形成了对照。

examples.en: to show a sharp/stark/striking contrast with something
examples.zh: 与某事物形成鲜明／明显／显著的对比

examples.en: A wool jacket complements the silk trousers and provides an interesting contrast in texture.
examples.zh: 毛料上衣配真丝长裤，质地上的差异非常有趣。

examples.en: When you look at their new system, ours seems very old-fashioned by contrast.
examples.zh: 看一看他们的新系统，就显得我们的系统陈旧过时了。

examples.en: Careful contrast of the two plans shows some important differences.
examples.zh: 把两个计划仔细地加以对比就可看出一些重要的差异。

senses.def: a person or thing that is clearly different from somebody/something else

examples.en: The work you did today is quite a contrast to (= very much better/worse than) what you did last week.
examples.zh: 你今天的表现与上周截然不同。

senses.def: differences in colour or in light and dark, used in photographs and paintings to create a special effect
senses.zh: （摄影或绘画中的）颜色反差，明暗对比

examples.en: The artist's use of contrast is masterly.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家娴熟地运用了明暗对比。

senses.def: the amount of difference between light and dark in a photograph or the picture on a television screen
senses.zh: （照片或电视图像的）明暗对比度，反差

examples.en: Use this button to adjust the contrast.
examples.zh: 用此按钮调节图像明暗的对比度。

senses.def: to compare two things in order to show the differences between them

examples.en: The poem contrasts youth and age.
examples.zh: 这首诗对比了青年与老年。

examples.en: Compare and contrast the two novels (= discuss how they are similar and how they are different).
examples.zh: 对比一下这两部小说。

examples.en: It is interesting to contrast the British legal system with the American one.
examples.zh: 把英国的法制与美国的加以对比很有意思。

senses.def: to show a clear difference when close together or when compared
senses.zh: （靠近或作比较时）显出明显的差异，形成对比

examples.en: Her actions contrasted sharply with her promises.
examples.zh: 她的行为与她的诺言相差甚远。

examples.en: Her actions and her promises contrasted sharply.
examples.zh: 她的行动与她的诺言相差甚远。

senses.def: showing the differences between things, especially between languages

examples.en: a contrastive analysis of British and Australian English
examples.zh: 对英式英语和澳大利亚英语的对比分析

senses.def: to do something that is not allowed by a law or rule

examples.en: The company was found guilty of contravening safety regulations.
examples.zh: 那家公司被判违反了安全条例。

examples.en: actions that blatantly contravene the rules of civilized warfare
examples.zh: 公然违反文明战争规则的行为

examples.en: national policies that contravene European law
examples.zh: 违反欧洲法律的国家政策

senses.def: the fact of doing something that is not allowed by a law or rule

examples.en: These actions are in contravention of international law.
examples.zh: 这些行为违反了国际法。

senses.def: an unpleasant event or an embarrassing occasion when people disagree
senses.zh: 不幸的事情；令人难堪的龃龉

examples.en: They have been ignoring me since our last contretemps.
examples.zh: 自从我们上次发生意外以来，他们就一直无视我。

senses.def: to give something, especially money or goods, to help achieve or provide something
senses.zh: 捐献，捐赠（尤指金钱或物品）；捐助

examples.en: Do you wish to contribute?
examples.zh: 你想捐助吗？

examples.en: Would you like to contribute to our collection?
examples.zh: 你愿意给我们的募捐捐款吗？

examples.en: to contribute to your pension
examples.zh: 为你的养老金供款

examples.en: Check with your financial planner to make sure that you are contributing the correct amounts.
examples.zh: 请咨询您的理财规划师，确保您的供款金额无误。

examples.en: We contributed £5 000 to the earthquake fund.
examples.zh: 我们向地震基金捐赠了 5 000 英镑。

senses.def: to be one of the causes of something

examples.en: Human error may have been a contributing factor.
examples.zh: 人为过错可能是一个起作用的因素。

examples.en: It is well known that UV radiation contributes to the development of skin cancer.
examples.zh: 众所周知，紫外线辐射会诱发皮肤癌。

examples.en: Investment in transport contributes to overall economic growth.
examples.zh: 交通投资有助于整体经济增长。

examples.en: Medical negligence was said to have contributed to her death.
examples.zh: 据说医务人员的玩忽职守是她死亡的原因之一。

examples.en: England fans are contributing hugely to the success of this event.
examples.zh: 英格兰球迷为本次活动的成功做出了巨大贡献。

examples.en: US policy has contributed to the problem.
examples.zh: 美国的政策加剧了这个问题。

examples.en: Several factors may be contributing to the fall in the number of applicants.
examples.zh: 有几个因素可能是申请人数下降的原因。

senses.def: to increase, improve or add to something

examples.en: Immigrants have contributed to British culture in many ways.
examples.zh: 移民在许多方面都对英国文化有所贡献。

examples.en: Parental involvement contributes significantly to children's learning.
examples.zh: 父母的参与对孩子的学习大有帮助。

examples.en: Hall's work contributed greatly to our knowledge of the disease.
examples.zh: 霍尔的工作极大地增进了我们对该疾病的认识。

examples.en: This book contributes little to our understanding of the subject.
examples.zh: 此书对我们了解这门学科助益甚少。

senses.def: to write things for a newspaper, book, website, etc. or a radio or television programme; to speak during a meeting or conversation, especially to give your opinion
senses.zh: （为书报、网站、电台或电视节目等）撰稿；（在会议或会谈期间）讲话，（尤指）发表意见

examples.en: The blog now has about 20 people contributing regularly.
examples.zh: 这个博客现在有大约 20 人定期供稿。

examples.en: a contributing editor
examples.zh: 特约编辑。

examples.en: We hope everyone will contribute to the discussion.
examples.zh: 我们希望大家都能参与讨论。

examples.en: Associated Press contributed to this report.
examples.zh: 美联社对此报道作出了贡献。

examples.en: He contributed a piece on Canadian law.
examples.zh: 他发表了一篇关于加拿大法律的文章。

examples.en: She contributed a number of articles to the magazine.
examples.zh: 她给这家杂志撰写了一些稿件。

senses.def: a gift or payment that is made to a person or an organization in order to help pay for something

examples.en: All contributions will be gratefully received.
examples.zh: 我们对所有捐资表示感谢。

examples.en: We rely entirely on voluntary contributions.
examples.zh: 我们全靠自愿捐赠。

examples.en: campaign contributions
examples.zh: 竞选捐款

examples.en: to make a substantial contribution to charity
examples.zh: 为慈善事业捐出大笔款项

examples.en: valuable contributions towards the upkeep of the cathedral
examples.zh: 对维修大教堂很重要的捐资

examples.en: She argued that a greater contribution towards reducing Britain's record debts should be asked of the better off.
examples.zh: 她认为，应该要求富裕阶层为减少英国创纪录的债务做出更大的贡献。

examples.en: Financial contributions from individuals paid for office and printing expenses.
examples.zh: 个人捐款支付了办事处开支和印刷费用。

senses.def: a sum of money that you pay regularly to your employer or the government in order to pay for benefits such as health insurance, a pension, etc.
senses.zh: （给雇主或政府用作医疗保险、养老金等津贴的）定期缴款

examples.en: pension contributions
examples.zh: 养老金缴款

examples.en: National Insurance contributions
examples.zh: 国民保险缴款

examples.en: You can increase your monthly contributions to the pension plan.
examples.zh: 你可以增加你的养老金计划每月供款。

examples.en: Pension funds base retirement income on the level of contributions from employees and employers.
examples.zh: 养老基金的退休收入取决于雇员和雇主的缴款水平。

senses.def: an action or a service that helps to cause or increase something, usually (but not necessarily) something good or valuable

examples.en: He made a very positive contribution to the success of the project.
examples.zh: 他对项目的成功作出了非常积极的贡献。

examples.en: a significant contribution to scientific knowledge
examples.zh: 对科学知识的重大贡献

examples.en: The star is being given the award for his ‘outstanding contribution to the entertainment field’.
examples.zh: 这位明星因其“对娱乐领域的杰出贡献”而被授予该奖项。

examples.en: This book represents a major contribution to our understanding of the Holocaust.
examples.zh: 这本书对我们理解大屠杀做出了重大贡献。

examples.en: She feels the world has overlooked his crucial contribution to the development of rock and roll.
examples.zh: 她觉得世界忽视了他对摇滚乐发展的重要贡献。

examples.en: the car’s contribution to the greenhouse effect
examples.zh: 汽车对加剧温室效应所起的作用

examples.en: She was honoured posthumously for her contribution towards the war effort.
examples.zh: 她因在战争中所做的贡献而获得追授嘉奖。

examples.en: These measures would make a valuable contribution towards reducing industrial accidents.
examples.zh: 这些措施将会对减少工业事故起重要的作用。

examples.en: She says the US needs to do more to recognize the contributions of women and minorities to society.
examples.zh: 她说关于承认女性和少数族裔对社会的贡献，美国还有很多事要做。

examples.en: They studied the relative contribution of various risk factors for bowel cancer.
examples.zh: 他们研究了各种危险因素对肠癌的相对影响。

senses.def: an item that forms part of a book, magazine, website broadcast, discussion, etc.
senses.zh: （书、杂志、网站广播、讨论等部分内容的）一则，一条，稿件

examples.en: All contributions for the May issue must be received by Friday.
examples.zh: 所有要在五月这一期发表的稿件必须在星期五以前寄到。

examples.en: an important contribution to the debate
examples.zh: 这次辩论一项重要的内容

examples.en: Thank you for your contributions to the blog.
examples.zh: 感谢您对博客的贡献。

examples.en: There are no contributions by scholars based in North America.
examples.zh: 没有北美学者的投稿。

senses.def: the act of giving something, especially money, to help a person or an organization

examples.en: The institute is totally funded by voluntary contribution.
examples.zh: 研究所的经费全部来自自愿捐款。

synonyms.words: premium ▪ contribution ▪ subscription ▪ repayment ▪ deposit ▪ instalment

intro.en: These are all words for an amount of money that you pay or are expected to pay, or for the act of paying.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指款额、款项、付款。

items.def: an amount of money that you pay or are expected to pay; the act of paying:
items.zh: 指款额、款项、付款

examples.en: ten monthly payments of $50
examples.zh: 每月付款 50 美元，十次付清

items.def: an amount of money that you pay once or regularly for an insurance policy; an extra payment added to the basic rate; a higher amount of money than usual:
items.zh: 指保险费、额外费用、附加费、溢价

examples.en: an insurance premium
examples.zh: 保险费

items.def: a sum of money that you pay regularly to your employer or the government in order to pay for benefits such as health insurance, a pension, etc:
items.zh: 指（给雇主或政府用作医疗保险、养老金等福利的）定期缴款

examples.en: You can increase your monthly contributions to the pension plan.
examples.zh: 你可以增加你的养老金计划每月供款。

items.def: an amount of money you pay in advance to receive a service:
items.zh: 指（服务的）订阅费、用户费

examples.en: a subscription to Netflix
examples.zh: 网飞的订阅费

items.def: (British English英式英语) an amount of money that you pay regularly to a bank, etc. until you have returned all the money that you owe; the act of paying this money:
items.zh: 指按期偿还的款项、分期偿还额、偿还债务、归还借款

examples.en: the repayments on the loan
examples.zh: 贷款的分期偿还额

items.def: an amount of money that you pay as the first part of a larger payment:
items.zh: 指订金

examples.en: We've put down a 5 per cent deposit on the house.
examples.zh: 我们已支付了房款的 5% 作为订金。

items.def: one of a number of payments that you make regularly over a period of time until you have paid for something:
items.zh: 指分期付款的一期付款

examples.en: We paid for the car by/​in instalments.
examples.zh: 我们以分期付款买了这辆车。

senses.def: a person who writes articles for a magazine, book or website, or who talks on a radio or television programme or at a meeting
senses.zh: （杂志、书或网站的）撰稿人，投稿人；（电台、电视节目中的）嘉宾；（会议的）发言人

examples.en: a regular contributor to this magazine
examples.zh: 该杂志的定期撰稿人

examples.en: I am a contributor to several blogs.
examples.zh: 我是几个博客的撰稿人。

senses.def: a person or thing that provides money or goods to help pay for or support something
senses.zh: 捐款者；捐赠者；作出贡献者

examples.en: Older people are important contributors to the economy.
examples.zh: 老一辈人为发展经济作出了重要贡献。

examples.en: the largest net contributor to EU funds
examples.zh: 欧盟基金最大的净捐助者

senses.def: something that helps to cause something

examples.en: Sulphur dioxide is a pollutant and a major contributor to acid rain.
examples.zh: 二氧化硫是一种污染物，并且是形成酸雨的主要因素。

senses.def: helping to cause something
senses.zh: 促成的；促进的；起作用的

examples.en: Alcohol is a contributory factor in 10 per cent of all road accidents.
examples.zh: 所有交通事故中有 10% 是酒后驾车造成的。

examples.en: Smoking is a contributory cause of many diseases.
examples.zh: 吸烟是许多疾病的诱因。

examples.en: He was found guilty of contributory negligence (= that helped to cause an accident).
examples.zh: 他被判犯有共同过失罪（=导致事故发生）。

senses.def: involving payments from the people who will benefit

examples.en: a contributory pension scheme/plan (= paid for by both employers and employees)
examples.zh: 由雇主与雇员共同出资的养老金计划

examples.en: contributory benefits (= ones that you make payments for)
examples.zh: 共醵抚恤金。

senses.def: very sorry for something bad that you have done

examples.en: Her expression was contrite.
examples.zh: 她的表情是悔恨的。

examples.en: He looked so contrite that for a moment she nearly believed he really was sorry about what he had said.
examples.zh: 他看起来如此悔悟，有那么一刻，她几乎相信他真的对自己所说的话感到抱歉。

senses.def: in a way that shows that you are very sorry for something bad that you have done
the feeling of being very sorry for something bad that you have done

examples.en: a look of contrition
examples.zh: 追悔莫及的神色

senses.def: something that somebody has done or written that does not seem natural; the fact of seeming artificial
senses.zh: 非自然之物；人工产物；矫揉造作

examples.en: The film is spoilt by unrealistic contrivances of plot.
examples.zh: 这部电影被不实际的牵强情节给毁了。

examples.en: The story is told with a complete absence of contrivance.
examples.zh: 这个故事讲得毫不矫揉造作。

examples.en: Examinations are a contrivance to see how a student tackles new problems.
examples.zh: 考试是考察学生如何解决新问题的一种手段。

senses.def: a clever or complicated device or tool made for a particular purpose
senses.zh: 精巧（或复杂）的装置；专用工具

examples.en: His workshop was full of mechanical contrivances.
examples.zh: 他的工作室里摆满了机械装置。

senses.def: a clever plan or trick; the act of using a clever plan or trick
senses.zh: 计谋；圈套；采用计谋（或圈套）

examples.en: an ingenious contrivance to get her to sign the document without reading it
examples.zh: 使她未经过目就签署文件的妙计

senses.def: to manage to do something despite difficulties

examples.en: She contrived to spend a couple of hours with him every Sunday evening.
examples.zh: 每周日晚上她都设法与他待上几个小时。

examples.en: Somehow they contrived to live on her tiny income.
examples.zh: 他们设法靠她微薄的收入生活。

senses.def: to succeed in making something happen despite difficulties

examples.en: I decided to contrive a meeting between the two of them.
examples.zh: 我决定设法让他们双方见上一面。

senses.def: to think of or make something, for example a plan or a machine, in a clever way
senses.zh: 巧妙地策划；精巧地制造（如机器）

examples.en: They contrived a plan to defraud the company.
examples.zh: 他们精心策划要欺诈那家公司。

senses.def: the power to make decisions about how a country, an area, an organization, etc. is run
senses.zh: （对国家、地区、机构等的）管理权，控制权，支配权

examples.en: The party expects to gain control of the council in the next election.
examples.zh: 该党期待在下次选举中获得对地方议会的控制权。

examples.en: Militants have taken control of the town.
examples.zh: 激进分子控制了这座城市。

examples.en: The Democrats have lost control of Congress.
examples.zh: 民主党已经失去对国会的控制。

examples.en: A military junta seized control of the country.
examples.zh: 军政府夺取了国家的控制权。

examples.en: The founders eventually regained control of the company.
examples.zh: 创始人最终重新获得了公司的控制权。

examples.en: He defended the tradition of civilian control over the military.
examples.zh: 他捍卫文官控制军队的传统。

examples.en: The city is in the control of enemy forces.
examples.zh: 那座城市现处于敌军的控制之下。

examples.en: The area remains under international control.
examples.zh: 该地区仍在国际控制之下。

senses.def: the ability to make somebody/something do what you want

examples.en: The teacher had no control over the children.
examples.zh: 那位老师管不住学生。

examples.en: He fought hard to retain control over his work.
examples.zh: 他努力争取保持对工作的控制权。

examples.en: She struggled to keep control of her voice.
examples.zh: 她竭力控制住自己的声音。

examples.en: She lost control of her car on the ice.
examples.zh: 她在冰上开车失去了控制。

examples.en: He got so angry he lost control (= shouted and said or did things he would not normally do).
examples.zh: 他气得失去了自制。

examples.en: Owing to circumstances beyond our control, the flight to Rome has been cancelled.
examples.zh: 由于出现了我们无法控制的情况，飞往罗马的航班已被取消。

examples.en: The situation is under control.
examples.zh: 局势得到控制。

examples.en: The coach made the team work hard on ball control (= in a ball game).
examples.zh: 教练让全队努力练习控球。

senses.def: the act of limiting or managing something; a method of doing this

examples.en: traffic control
examples.zh: 交通管制

examples.en: talks on arms control
examples.zh: 军备控制谈判

examples.en: tight controls on government spending
examples.zh: 对政府开支的严格限制

examples.en: Price controls on food were ended.
examples.zh: 对食物价格的控制已告结束。

examples.en: exciting advances in the control of malaria
examples.zh: 疟疾控制方面令人振奋的进展

examples.en: state control of the economy
examples.zh: 国家对经济的控制

examples.en: It was an exercise in damage control (= trying to prevent further damage).
examples.zh: 这是一次损害控制的演习。

examples.en: A pest control officer was called in to deal with the rat problem.
examples.zh: 一名虫害防治员被请来应对鼠害问题。

senses.def: the switches and buttons, etc. that you use to operate a machine or a vehicle
senses.zh: （机器或车辆的）操纵装置，开关，按钮

examples.en: the controls of an aircraft
examples.zh: 飞机的操纵装置

examples.en: the control panel
examples.zh: 控制面板

examples.en: the volume control of a TV
examples.zh: 电视的音量调节器

examples.en: The co-pilot was at the controls when the plane landed.
examples.zh: 副驾驶员操纵着飞机着陆。

senses.def: a person, thing or group used as a standard of comparison for checking the results of a scientific experiment; an experiment whose result is known, used for checking working methods
senses.zh: 对照标准；（检验工作方法的）参照实验

examples.en: The study showed that women with the disease have had fewer children than the controls.
examples.zh: 研究表明，患有这种疾病的女性比对照组女性生育的孩子少。

examples.en: One group was treated with the new drug, and the control group was given a sugar pill.
examples.zh: 一组采用新药治疗，而对照检验组服用的则是糖丸。

senses.def: a place where orders are given or where checks are made; the people who work in this place
senses.zh: 指挥（或检查、控制）站；指挥（或检查、控制）人员

examples.en: We went through passport control and into the departure lounge.
examples.zh: 我们通过护照检查站进入了候机大厅。

senses.def: (on a computer keyboard) a key that you press when you want to perform a particular operation
to direct or manage an organization, an area or a situation
senses.zh: 掌管，管理，控制，操纵（某机构、地区或局势）

examples.en: He's reached retiring age, but he's still firmly in control.
examples.zh: 他虽然已到退休年龄，但仍大权在握。

examples.en: There has been some violence after the match, but the police are now in control of the situation.
examples.zh: 比赛后发生了一些暴力事件，但是现在警方已控制了局势。

examples.en: The elected government is back in control.
examples.zh: 民选政府重新取得了控制权。

senses.def: to be able to organize your life well and keep calm

examples.en: In spite of all her family problems, she's really in control.
examples.zh: 她虽然家庭问题重重，却能完全处之泰然。

senses.def: to be or become impossible to manage or to control

examples.en: The children are completely out of control since their father left.
examples.zh: 这些孩子自他们的父亲离开后就无法无天了。

examples.en: A truck ran out of control on the hill.
examples.zh: 一辆卡车在山上失去了控制。

senses.def: to be being dealt with successfully
senses.zh: 被控制住；处于控制之下

examples.en: Don't worry—everything's under control!
examples.zh: 别担心，一切都控制住了！

senses.def: to succeed in dealing with something so that it does not cause any damage or hurt anyone
senses.zh: 控制得住，抑制得住（从而不造成损害）

examples.en: It took two hours to bring the fire under control.
examples.zh: 花了两个小时才控制住火势。

examples.en: Please keep your dog under control!
examples.zh: 请管好你的狗！

senses.def: to have power over a person, company, country, etc. so that you are able to decide what they must do or how it is run

examples.en: By the age of 21 he controlled the company.
examples.zh: 他 21 岁就掌管了公司。

examples.en: The whole territory is now controlled by the army.
examples.zh: 现在全境都在军队的控制之下。

examples.en: Can't you control your children?
examples.zh: 你就不能管管你这些孩子？

examples.en: a multinational company based in Britain but controlled from South Africa
examples.zh: 一家总部位于英国但由南非控制的跨国公司

examples.en: We want to control our own destiny (= decide what happens to us).
examples.zh: 我们想控制自己的命运（=决定我们会发生什么）。

examples.en: attempts by corporations to control access to information
examples.zh: 公司试图控制信息访问

senses.def: to limit something or make it happen in a particular way

examples.en: It is essential for businesses to control costs.
examples.zh: 企业控制成本很关键。

examples.en: government attempts to control immigration
examples.zh: 政府试图限制移民的措施

examples.en: Local industries were tightly controlled.
examples.zh: 当地工业受到严格控制。

examples.en: Many biological processes are controlled by hormones.
examples.zh: 许多生物变化过程都是由激素控制的。

examples.en: Try to control your breathing.
examples.zh: 尝试控制你的呼吸。

examples.en: They built a reservoir to control the flow of water.
examples.zh: 他们建造了一个水库来控制水流。

examples.en: Parents should control what their kids watch on television.
examples.zh: 父母应该限定孩子看什么样的电视节目。

senses.def: to stop something from spreading or getting worse

examples.en: Firefighters are still trying to control the blaze.
examples.zh: 消防队员仍在尽力控制火势的蔓延。

examples.en: to control a disease
examples.zh: 控制疾病

examples.en: She was given drugs to control the pain.
examples.zh: 给她服用了镇痛药。

examples.en: Most of the symptoms can be controlled with medication.
examples.zh: 大多数症状可以通过药物控制。

senses.def: to make something such as a machine or system work in the way that you want it to
senses.zh: 操纵，控制（机器或系统等）

examples.en: This knob controls the volume.
examples.zh: 此旋钮调节音量。

examples.en: The traffic lights are controlled by a central computer.
examples.zh: 交通信号灯由中心计算机控制。

examples.en: The entrance gates are electronically controlled.
examples.zh: 入口大门是电子控制的。

examples.en: lighting that you can control with your smartphone
examples.zh: 可以用智能手机控制的照明

examples.en: The thermostat can be controlled via an app.
examples.zh: 恒温器可以通过应用程序进行控制。

examples.en: toys that can be controlled from a mobile device
examples.zh: 可以通过移动设备控制的玩具

senses.def: to manage to make yourself remain calm, even though you are upset or angry

examples.en: I was so angry I couldn't control myself.
examples.zh: 我气得无法控制自己。

examples.en: He was finding it difficult to control his feelings.
examples.zh: 他觉得很难克制住自己的感情。

examples.en: You can learn to control your emotions.
examples.zh: 你可以学会控制自己的情绪。

senses.def: to direct or manage an organization, an area or a situation
senses.zh: 掌管，管理，控制，操纵（某机构、地区或局势）

examples.en: He's reached retiring age, but he's still firmly in control.
examples.zh: 他虽然已到退休年龄，但仍大权在握。

examples.en: There has been some violence after the match, but the police are now in control of the situation.
examples.zh: 比赛后发生了一些暴力事件，但是现在警方已控制了局势。

examples.en: The elected government is back in control.
examples.zh: 民选政府重新取得了控制权。

senses.def: to be able to organize your life well and keep calm

examples.en: In spite of all her family problems, she's really in control.
examples.zh: 她虽然家庭问题重重，却能完全处之泰然。

senses.def: to be or become impossible to manage or to control

examples.en: The children are completely out of control since their father left.
examples.zh: 这些孩子自他们的父亲离开后就无法无天了。

examples.en: A truck ran out of control on the hill.
examples.zh: 一辆卡车在山上失去了控制。

senses.def: to be being dealt with successfully
senses.zh: 被控制住；处于控制之下

examples.en: Don't worry—everything's under control!
examples.zh: 别担心，一切都控制住了！

senses.def: to succeed in dealing with something so that it does not cause any damage or hurt anyone
senses.zh: 控制得住，抑制得住（从而不造成损害）

examples.en: It took two hours to bring the fire under control.
examples.zh: 花了两个小时才控制住火势。

examples.en: Please keep your dog under control!
examples.zh: 请管好你的狗！

intro.en: These are all words for something that limits what you can do or what can happen.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示限制或限定。

items.def: the greatest or smallest amount of something that is allowed:
items.zh: 指极限、限量、限额

examples.en: The EU has set strict limits on pollution levels.
examples.zh: 欧盟对污染程度作了严格的限定。

items.def: (rather formal) a rule or law that limits what you can do:
items.zh: 指限制规定、限制法规

examples.en: There are no restrictions on the amount of money you can withdraw.
examples.zh: 取款没有限额。

items.def: (often in compounds) the act of limiting or managing something; a method of doing this:
items.zh: （常构成复合词）指限制、约束、管理、管制

examples.en: arms control
examples.zh: 军备控制

items.def: (rather formal) a fact or decision that limits what you can do:
items.zh: 指限制、限定、约束

examples.en: We have to work within severe constraints of time and money.
examples.zh: 我们必须在时间紧迫、资金紧张的限制下工作。

items.def: (rather formal) a decision, a rule, an idea, etc. that limits what you can do; the act of limiting something because it is necessary or sensible to do so:
items.zh: 指约束力、管制措施、制约因素、控制、限制

examples.en: The government has imposed export restraints on some products.
examples.zh: 政府对一些产品实行了出口控制。

items.def: the act or process of limiting something; a rule, fact or condition that limits something:
items.zh: 指限制、控制、起限制作用的规则、事实或条件

examples.en: They would resist any limitation of their powers.
examples.zh: 他们会抵制对他们权力的任何限制。

senses.def: a place from which an organization or system is managed, or in which devices and controls are kept

examples.en: Every morning 8 500 London buses are overseen by the biggest traffic control centre in the world.
examples.zh: 每天早上 8 500 辆伦敦公交车都受到世界上最大的交通控制中心的监管。

senses.def: a person who always wants to be in control of their own and others’ lives, and to organize how things are done
senses.zh: 好多管事的人；爱指挥别人的人

examples.en: I'm a bit of a control freak—I much prefer driving to being a passenger.
examples.zh: 我有点控制狂——我更喜欢开车而不是当乘客。

examples.en: He's a real control freak.
examples.zh: 他是一个有强烈控制欲的人。

senses.def: a room that is a centre for the operation of a factory, a service or a particular event
senses.zh: （设施、服务系统或特定活动的）控制室

examples.en: a nuclear power plant's control room
examples.zh: 核电厂的控制室

examples.en: He works in the control room of a television station.
examples.zh: 他在电视台的控制室工作。

examples.en: the space shuttle control room
examples.zh: 航天飞机控制室

senses.def: a building at an airport from which the movements of aircraft are controlled
senses.zh: （机场的）指挥塔台，控制塔，指挥调度台

senses.def: that can be controlled
senses.zh: 可控制（或管理、操纵、支配）的

examples.en: Cooking with gas is fast, controllable and clean.
examples.zh: 使用燃气烹饪快速、可控且清洁。

senses.def: a type of economic system in which a government controls its country’s industries and decides what goods should be produced and in what amounts
senses.zh: 管制经济（由政府控制国家工业并决定产品的种类与数量）

senses.def: a scientific experiment in which only one condition is changed in each of several tests in order to find out what effect that condition has on the results of the experiment
senses.zh: 受控实验（在一项研究中，每次实验只改变一个条件，从而判断该条件对实验结果的影响）

examples.en: Controlled experiments show how shore crabs of different sizes respond to ship noise.
examples.zh: 受控实验能够显示不同体型的滨蟹对船舶噪声的反应。

senses.def: an illegal drug

examples.en: to be arrested for possession of a controlled substance
examples.zh: 因持有毒品而被捕

senses.def: a person who manages or directs something, especially a large organization or part of an organization
senses.zh: （尤指大型机构或部门的）管理者，控制者，指挥者

examples.en: He is the new programme controller for BBC2.
examples.zh: 他是英国广播公司第二频道的新任节目总监。

examples.en: the company's controller for global marketing and sales
examples.zh: 公司的全球市场营销和销售总监

examples.en: Her current job is marketing controller for the South East sales region.
examples.zh: 她目前的工作是东南销售区域的营销总监。

senses.def: a device that controls or regulates
senses.zh: （机器或部件的）控制器，调节器

examples.en: a temperature controller
examples.zh: 温度控制器

senses.def: a person who is in charge of the financial accounts of a business company
an electronic device that is used to control video games via a computer or games console
the fact of owning enough shares in a company to be able to make decisions about what the company should do

examples.en: In May 1948, Hughes purchased a controlling interest in RKO Studios.
examples.zh: 1948 年 5 月，休斯购买了雷电华工作室的控股权。

examples.en: He has controlling interests in several ventures.
examples.zh: 他握有好几家企业的控股股权。

senses.def: causing a lot of angry public discussion and disagreement

examples.en: a highly controversial topic
examples.zh: 颇有争议的话题

examples.en: one of the most controversial of London’s new office blocks
examples.zh: 伦敦新办公楼中最具争议的建筑之一

examples.en: A controversial plan to build a new road has met with protests.
examples.zh: 一项有争议的修建新道路的计划遭到了抗议。

examples.en: Winston Churchill and Richard Nixon were both controversial figures.
examples.zh: 温斯顿·丘吉尔和理查德·尼克松都是有争议的人物。

senses.def: in a way that causes a lot of angry public discussion and disagreement

examples.en: Punishments for prisoners include loss of privileges and, more controversially, the stopping of visits.
examples.zh: 对囚犯的惩罚包括丧失特别待遇，以及更具争议的禁止探视。

senses.def: public discussion and argument about something that many people strongly disagree about, think is bad, or are shocked by

examples.en: to arouse/cause controversy
examples.zh: 引起争论

examples.en: a bitter controversy over/about the site of the new airport
examples.zh: 有关新机场选址的激烈争论

examples.en: The controversy surrounding his latest movie continues.
examples.zh: 围绕他最新电影的争议仍在继续。

examples.en: The President resigned amid considerable controversy.
examples.zh: 总统在激烈的争议中辞职了。

senses.def: to say or prove that something is not true

examples.en: This statement is controverted by the evidence.
examples.zh: 这一说法受到证据的质疑。

senses.def: having no respect for authority
senses.zh: 藐视权威的；违抗的；不服从的

senses.def: an injury to part of the body that does not break the skin

examples.en: There were multiple contusions and abrasions on his face and arm.
examples.zh: 他的脸部和手臂有多处挫伤和擦伤。

senses.def: a confusing problem or question that is very difficult to solve
senses.zh: 令人迷惑的难题；复杂难解的问题

examples.en: The role of clouds is one of the big conundrums of climatology.
examples.zh: 云的作用是气候学的一大难题。

senses.def: a question, usually involving a trick with words, that you ask for fun
a large area where towns have grown and joined together, often around a city
senses.zh: 复合城市（常围绕某城市的若干城镇通过发展而连接在一起的聚合体）

examples.en: The region has several medium-sized towns and cities, but no major conurbations.
examples.zh: 那个地区有几个中等规模的城镇，但没有大的都市。

senses.def: to spend time getting your health and strength back after an illness

examples.en: She is convalescing at home after her operation.
examples.zh: 手术后她正在家休养康复。

senses.def: a period of time when you get well again after an illness or a medical operation; the process of getting well

examples.en: You need four to six weeks' convalescence.
examples.zh: 你需要四至六个星期的康复期。

senses.def: a person who is getting well again after an illness or a medical operation
senses.zh: 康复期的；正在康复的；渐愈的

examples.en: I treated him as a convalescent, not as a sick man.
examples.zh: 我把他当作正在康复的人，而不是病人来看待。

senses.def: connected with convalescence
senses.zh: 康复期的；正在康复的；渐愈的

examples.en: a convalescent home (= a type of hospital where people go to get well after an illness)
examples.zh: 康复医院

examples.en: a convalescent child
examples.zh: 逐渐康复的小孩

senses.def: the process in which heat moves through a gas or a liquid as the hotter part rises and the cooler, heavier part sinks

examples.en: convection currents
examples.zh: 对流气流

senses.def: an oven with a fan that moves hot air around to heat food in an even way
senses.zh: 对流烤箱；热风循环烤箱

examples.en: Heat a convection oven to 225°F or a conventional oven to 250°F.
examples.zh: 将对流烤箱加热到 225 华氏度或将普通烤箱加热到 250 华氏度。

senses.def: a device for heating the air in a room using convection
to arrange for people to come together for a formal meeting

examples.en: to convene a meeting
examples.zh: 召开会议

examples.en: A Board of Inquiry was convened immediately after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故后立即成立了调查委员会。

examples.en: They decided to convene an extraordinary general meeting.
examples.zh: 他们决定召开临时股东大会。

senses.def: to come together for a formal meeting

examples.en: The committee will convene at 11.30 next Thursday.
examples.zh: 委员会将在下星期四上午 11:30 开会。

senses.def: a person who arranges meetings of groups or committees

examples.en: He is national convener of the Campaign Against Child Labour.
examples.zh: 他是反对童工运动的全国召集人。

senses.def: a senior official of a trade union at a factory or other place of work
senses.zh: （工厂或基层单位的）资深工会领导人

examples.en: a local Transport Union convener
examples.zh: 当地交通联盟召集人

senses.def: the quality of being useful, easy or suitable for somebody

examples.en: We have provided seats for the convenience of our customers.
examples.zh: 为方便顾客我们备有座位。

examples.en: For (the sake of) convenience, the two groups have been treated as one in this report.
examples.zh: 为方便起见，这两个组在本报告中被视为一组。

examples.en: The position of the house combines quietness and convenience.
examples.zh: 房子的位置既安静又便利。

examples.en: In this resort you can enjoy all the comfort and convenience of modern tourism.
examples.zh: 在这个度假胜地你可享受所有现代旅游的舒适与便利。

senses.def: something that is useful and can make things easier or quicker to do, or more comfortable
senses.zh: 便利的事物（或设施）；方便的用具

examples.en: It was a great convenience to have the school so near.
examples.zh: 学校这么近真是太方便了。

examples.en: The house had all the modern conveniences (= central heating, etc.) that were unusual at that time.
examples.zh: 这座房子拥有在当时并不常见的所有现代化设施。

senses.def: at a time or a place that is suitable for somebody
senses.zh: 在（某人）方便时；在（某人）适宜的地点

examples.en: Can you telephone me at your convenience to arrange a meeting?
examples.zh: 你能不能在你方便时给我来个电话，安排见一次面？

senses.def: as soon as possible

examples.en: Please contact us at your earliest convenience.
examples.zh: 请尽早与我们联系。

senses.def: at a time or a place that is suitable for somebody
senses.zh: 在（某人）方便时；在（某人）适宜的地点

examples.en: Can you telephone me at your convenience to arrange a meeting?
examples.zh: 你能不能在你方便时给我来个电话，安排见一次面？

senses.def: as soon as possible

examples.en: Please contact us at your earliest convenience.
examples.zh: 请尽早与我们联系。

senses.def: food that you buy frozen or in a box or can and that you can prepare and cook very quickly and easily

examples.en: Convenience foods can make life easier.
examples.zh: 方便食品可以让生活更轻松。

examples.en: I lived on a diet of convenience food.
examples.zh: 我以方便食品为生。

examples.en: He has a busy lifestyle and he only eats ready-made convenience food.
examples.zh: 他的生活忙碌，只吃现成的方便食品。

examples.en: The children like convenience food such as pizzas.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢比萨饼之类的方便食品。

senses.def: a small local shop that sells food, newspapers, etc. and has long opening hours

examples.en: We bought some snacks at the convenience store.
examples.zh: 我们在便利店买了一些零食。

senses.def: useful, easy or quick to do; not causing problems
senses.zh: 实用的；便利的；方便的；省事的

examples.en: Fruit is a convenient source of vitamins and energy.
examples.zh: 水果是维生素和能量的便利来源。

examples.en: A bicycle is often more convenient than a car in towns.
examples.zh: 在城镇骑自行车常常比开车更方便。

examples.en: I can't see him now—it isn't convenient.
examples.zh: 我现在不便见他。

examples.en: I'll call back at a more convenient time.
examples.zh: 在比较方便的时候我会回电话的。

examples.en: For now, the most convenient way to access the internet remains the smartphone.
examples.zh: 目前，访问互联网最方便的方式仍然是智能手机。

examples.en: He used his wife's birthday as a convenient excuse for not going to the meeting.
examples.zh: 他说要给妻子过生日，利用这个借口，就不去参加会议了。

examples.en: He said meeting in Adelaide would be convenient for him as well.
examples.zh: 他说在阿德莱德见面对他来说也很方便。

examples.en: When would be convenient for a visit?
examples.zh: 什么时候方便拜访？

examples.en: It is very convenient to pay by credit card.
examples.zh: 用信用卡付款非常方便。

examples.en: It's much more convenient for me to drive there.
examples.zh: 我开车去那里方便多了。

examples.en: You'll find these meals quick and convenient to prepare.
examples.zh: 你会发现准备这样的饭既快又省事。

senses.def: near to a particular place; easy to get to
senses.zh: 附近的；近便的；容易到达的

examples.en: The office is just five minutes from the station, so it's very convenient.
examples.zh: 办公室离车站只有五分钟的路程，所以很方便。

examples.en: The house is very convenient for several schools.
examples.zh: 这座房子离几所学校很近。

examples.en: The house is quite convenient for the shops.
examples.zh: 这房子离店铺很近便。

examples.en: The hotel is convenient to downtown.
examples.zh: 这家旅馆离市中心很近。

senses.def: in a way that is useful, easy or quick to do; in a way that does not cause problems
senses.zh: 实用的；便利的；方便的；省事的

examples.en: The report can be conveniently divided into three main sections.
examples.zh: 报告很容易就可以分成三个主要部分。

examples.en: She conveniently forgot to mention that her husband would be at the party, too (= because it suited her not to say).
examples.zh: 她故意没有提及她丈夫也会参加这个聚会，以免横生枝节。

senses.def: in a way that is near to a particular place or easy to get to
senses.zh: 附近的；近便的；容易到达的

examples.en: The hotel is conveniently situated close to the beach.
examples.zh: 宾馆离海滩很近，位置非常便利。

senses.def: a person who arranges meetings of groups or committees
a senior official of a trade union at a factory or other place of work
senses.zh: （工厂或基层单位的）资深工会领导人

senses.def: a building in which a Christian community of nuns

examples.en: She entered a convent at the age of sixteen.
examples.zh: 她 16 岁当了修女。

examples.en: She spent her whole life in a convent.
examples.zh: 她终生在修道院里度过。

senses.def: a school run by nuns
the way in which something is done that most people in a society expect and consider to be polite or the right way to do it

examples.en: the rigid social conventions of Victorian Britain
examples.zh: 英国维多利亚时期僵化的社会习俗

examples.en: She is a young woman who enjoys flouting conventions.
examples.zh: 她是一个喜欢无视传统习俗的年轻女子。

examples.en: By convention the deputy leader was always a woman.
examples.zh: 按惯例，这一领导职务的副职总是由女性担任。

examples.en: Convention demands that a club member should resign in such a situation.
examples.zh: 公约要求俱乐部成员在这种情况下必须辞职。

senses.def: a large meeting of the members of a profession, a political party, etc.
senses.zh: （从业者、政党成员等的）大会，集会

examples.en: to hold a convention
examples.zh: 召开大会

examples.en: the Democratic Party Convention (= to elect a candidate for president)
examples.zh: 民主党代表大会（选出总统候选人）

senses.def: an official agreement between countries or leaders
senses.zh: （国家或首脑间的）公约，协定，协议

examples.en: the Geneva convention
examples.zh: 日内瓦公约

examples.en: the United Nations convention on the rights of the child
examples.zh: 联合国儿童权利公约

senses.def: a traditional method or style in literature, art or the theatre
senses.zh: （文学、艺术或戏剧的）传统手法，传统风格

examples.en: the conventions of Greek tragedy
examples.zh: 希腊悲剧的传统手法

senses.def: tending to follow what is done or considered acceptable by society in general; normal and ordinary, and perhaps not very interesting
senses.zh: 依照惯例的；遵循习俗的；墨守成规的；普通平凡的

examples.en: conventional behaviour/morality
examples.zh: 循规蹈矩的行为；传统的道德规范

examples.en: She's very conventional in her views.
examples.zh: 她的观点很守旧。

senses.def: following what is traditional or the way something has been done for a long time

examples.en: conventional methods/approaches
examples.zh: 传统方法

examples.en: It's not a hotel, in the conventional sense, but rather a whole village turned into a hotel.
examples.zh: 这不是一家传统意义上的旅馆，而是整个村庄变身而成的度假村。

examples.en: You can use a microwave or cook it in a conventional oven.
examples.zh: 你可以用微波炉或传统烤箱烹制。

senses.def: using the usual scientific methods of Western medicine such as artificial drugs and operations

examples.en: conventional medicine
examples.zh: 传统医学

examples.en: Conventional treatments for this condition have been only partially successful.
examples.zh: 这种疾病的常规治疗只取得了部分成功。

senses.def: not nuclear

examples.en: conventional forces/weapons
examples.zh: 常规部队／武器

examples.en: A conventional war would still cause unacceptable devastation.
examples.zh: 常规战争仍会造成难以接受的破坏。

examples.en: a conventional power station (= using oil or coal as fuel, rather than nuclear power)
examples.zh: 常规电站

senses.def: the view or belief that most people hold
senses.zh: 大多数人的看法；普遍信念

examples.en: Conventional wisdom has it that riots only ever happen in cities.
examples.zh: 人们普遍认为，只有城市里才发生暴乱。

senses.def: the view or belief that most people hold
senses.zh: 大多数人的看法；普遍信念

examples.en: Conventional wisdom has it that riots only ever happen in cities.
examples.zh: 人们普遍认为，只有城市里才发生暴乱。

senses.def: the view or belief that most people hold
senses.zh: 大多数人的看法；普遍信念

examples.en: Conventional wisdom has it that riots only ever happen in cities.
examples.zh: 人们普遍认为，只有城市里才发生暴乱。

senses.def: the fact of tending to follow what is done or considered acceptable by society in general; the fact of being normal and ordinary, and perhaps not very interesting
senses.zh: 依照惯例的；遵循习俗的；墨守成规的；普通平凡的

examples.en: They refused the conventionality of bourgeois life, and worked among artists and poets.
examples.zh: 他们拒绝资产阶级生活的传统，在艺术家和诗人中工作。

examples.en: the conventionalities of society
examples.zh: 社会习俗

senses.def: the fact of following what is traditional or the way that something has been done for a long time

examples.en: a distinctive combination of conventionality and modernity
examples.zh: 传统与现代的独特结合

senses.def: in a way that tends to follow what is done or considered acceptable by society in general; in a way that is normal and ordinary, and perhaps not very interesting
senses.zh: 依照惯例的；遵循习俗的；墨守成规的；普通平凡的

examples.en: conventionally dressed
examples.zh: 衣着传统的

examples.en: Though not conventionally pretty (= not pretty according to generally accepted ideas of what is pretty), she dressed with flair.
examples.zh: 虽然不是传统意义上的漂亮（=按照普遍接受的漂亮观念来说并不漂亮），但她的穿着很有天赋。

senses.def: in a way that follows what is traditional or the way something has been done for a long time

examples.en: conventionally grown food (= grown according to conventional methods)
examples.zh: 用传统方法种植的食物

examples.en: Gross National Product (GNP) is conventionally used to indicate economic development.
examples.zh: 国民生产总值（GNP）通常用来表示经济发展。

senses.def: a person who is attending a convention
to move towards a place from different directions and meet

examples.en: Thousands of supporters converged on London for the rally.
examples.zh: 成千上万的支持者从四面八方汇聚伦敦举行集会。

senses.def: to move towards each other and meet at a point

examples.en: There was a signpost where the two paths converged.
examples.zh: 两条小路的相交处有一路标。

senses.def: if ideas, policies, aims, etc. converge
senses.zh: （思想、政策、目标等）十分相似，相同

examples.en: The aims of the two developments can and should converge.
examples.zh: 这两项发展的目标可以也应该一致。

senses.def: the process of moving together from different directions and meeting; the point where this happens

examples.en: The city was a natural point of convergence for river-based traffic.
examples.zh: 这座城市是河流交通的天然交汇点。

examples.en: The diagram shows the convergence of two oceanic plates.
examples.zh: 该图显示了两个大洋板块的汇聚。

senses.def: the process of becoming very similar or the same

examples.en: The convergence of mobile technology and the internet will continue to revolutionize the way businesses interact with consumers.
examples.zh: 手机技术与互联网的趋同将持续改变企业与消费者互动的方式。

examples.en: convergences between birdsong and composed human music
examples.zh: 鸟鸣与人类音乐的趋同

senses.def: moving together from different directions and meeting

examples.en: convergent lines
examples.zh: 相互会合的线条

senses.def: becoming more similar or the same
senses.zh: （思想、政策、目标等）十分相似，相同

examples.en: convergent opinions/evolution/technology
examples.zh: 趋同的观点/进化/技术

senses.def: knowing about something; familiar with something

examples.en: You need to become fully conversant with the company's procedures.
examples.zh: 你得对公司的程序了如指掌。

senses.def: an informal talk involving a small group of people or only two; the activity of talking in this way

examples.en: a phone conversation
examples.zh: 电话交谈

examples.en: The main topic of conversation was the likely outcome of the election.
examples.zh: 谈话的主题是选举可能的结果。

examples.en: I tried to make conversation (= to speak in order to appear polite).
examples.zh: 出于礼貌，我设法找些话题。

examples.en: I had a long conversation with her the other day.
examples.zh: 前几天我与她作了一次长谈。

examples.en: She was engaged in conversation with a colleague.
examples.zh: 她正在和一位同事交谈。

examples.en: to get into conversation with somebody
examples.zh: 开始与某人攀谈

examples.en: to get into a conversation with somebody
examples.zh: 开始与某人攀谈

examples.en: I overheard a conversation between two colleagues.
examples.zh: 我无意中听到了两位同事的谈话。

examples.en: We had to listen to endless conversations about high prices and food shortages.
examples.zh: 我们不得不听没完没了的关于高物价和食品短缺的谈话。

examples.en: Don was deep in conversation with the girl on his right.
examples.zh: 唐与他右边的女孩在专心交谈。

examples.en: I spent an hour in conversation with him.
examples.zh: 我花了一个小时和他交谈。

examples.en: The conversation turned to gardening.
examples.zh: 话题转到了园艺上。

examples.en: Desperately he struggled to keep the conversation going.
examples.zh: 他拼命地挣扎着让谈话继续下去。

examples.en: I see no point in continuing this conversation.
examples.zh: 我认为继续这场谈话没有意义。

examples.en: She tried to steer the conversation away from the topic of marriage.
examples.zh: 她试图将话题从婚姻话题上转移开。

examples.en: He felt a sudden alarm at the turn the conversation was taking.
examples.zh: 谈话的转折让他突然感到惊慌。

synonyms.words: conversation ▪ dialogue ▪ talk ▪ debate ▪ consultation ▪ chat ▪ gossip

intro.en: These are all words for an occasion when people talk about something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示交谈、谈论。

items.def: a detailed conversation about something that is considered to be important:
items.zh: 指重要事情的讨论、谈论、商讨

examples.en: Discussions are still taking place between the two leaders.
examples.zh: 两位领导人仍在进行讨论。

items.def: a talk, usually a private or informal one, involving two people or a small group; the activity of talking in this way:
items.zh: 通常指私下的或非正式的交谈、谈话

examples.en: a telephone conversation
examples.zh: 电话交谈

items.def: conversations in a book, play or film:
items.zh: 指书、戏剧或电影中的对话、对白

examples.en: The novel has long descriptions and not much dialogue.
examples.zh: 这部小说描述多，对话少。

examples.en: The President told waiting reporters there had been a constructive dialogue.
examples.zh: 总统告诉等候的记者，刚才进行了一次富有建设性的对话。

items.def: a conversation or discussion, often one about a problem or something important for the people involved:
items.zh: 常指对有关人员就某个问题或重要的事情进行的交谈、谈话、讨论、商讨

examples.en: I had a long talk with my boss about my career prospects.
examples.zh: 我和老板就我的事业前景进行了一次长谈。

items.def: a formal discussion of an issue at a public meeting or in a parliament. In a debate two or more speakers express opposing views and then there is often a vote on the issue:
items.zh: 指公共集会上或议会里就某问题进行的、常以表决结束的辩论

examples.en: a debate on prison reform
examples.zh: 关于监狱制度改革的辩论

items.def: a formal discussion between groups of people before a decision is made about something:
items.zh: 指团体间在决策前进行的咨询、商讨、磋商

examples.en: There have been extensive consultations between the two countries.
examples.zh: 两国之间进行了广泛磋商。

items.def: a friendly informal conversation; informal talking. The countable use of chat is especially British English:
items.zh: chat 作可数名词尤用于英式英语

items.def: a conversation about other people and their private lives:
items.zh: 指关于他人及其私生活的闲谈、闲聊、说长道短

examples.en: We had a good gossip about the boss.
examples.zh: 我们讲了好一会儿老板的闲话。

senses.def: an object that is talked about a lot because it is unusual
a type of painting in which a group of people are shown in the countryside or in a home
senses.zh: 人物风俗画；乡村（或室内）风情画

senses.def: a remark that is unexpected or that shocks people so that they do not know how to reply to it
senses.zh: 噎人的话；令人无言以对的话

senses.def: not formal; as used in conversation
senses.zh: 非正式的；用于交谈的；口语的

examples.en: a casual and conversational tone
examples.zh: 不拘礼节的谈话语气

examples.en: I learnt conversational Spanish at evening classes.
examples.zh: 我在夜校学过西班牙语会话。

senses.def: connected with conversation

examples.en: She favours a direct conversational style.
examples.zh: 她喜欢直接的对话风格。

examples.en: They claim the chatbot possesses the full range of human conversational interaction.
examples.zh: 他们声称聊天机器人拥有全方位的人类对话交互能力。

senses.def: a person who is good at talking to others, especially in an informal way

examples.en: Reynolds was a notable conversationalist.
examples.zh: 雷诺兹是一位著名的健谈者。

senses.def: in a way that is not formal; as used in conversation
senses.zh: 非正式的；用于交谈的；口语的

examples.en: ‘Have you been here long?’ he asked conversationally.
examples.zh: “你来这里很久了吗？”他攀谈着问道。

senses.def: in a way that is connected with conversation

examples.en: Chatbots are designed to interact conversationally with humans.
examples.zh: 聊天机器人旨在与人类进行对话交互。

senses.def: to have a conversation with somebody

examples.en: She conversed with the Romanians in French.
examples.zh: 她用法语与罗马尼亚人交谈。

examples.en: The two men were conversing on music and opera.
examples.zh: 两个人正在谈论音乐和歌剧。

senses.def: opposite

examples.en: the converse effect
examples.zh: 相反的效果

senses.def: the opposite of a fact or statement
senses.zh: 相反的事物；（事实或陈述的）反面

examples.en: Building new roads increases traffic and the converse is equally true: reducing the number and size of roads means less traffic.
examples.zh: 修筑新的道路会增加交通流量，反过来也是同样的道理：减少道路的数量和规模就意味着减少交通流量。

senses.def: in a way that is the opposite of something

examples.en: You can add the fluid to the powder, or, conversely, the powder to the fluid.
examples.zh: 可把液体加入粉末，或者相反，把粉末加入液体。

senses.def: the act or process of changing something from one form, use or system to another

examples.en: Their main business is the conversion of farm buildings into family homes.
examples.zh: 他们的主要业务是将农场建筑物改建为家庭住宅。

examples.en: Conversion to gas central heating will save you a lot of money.
examples.zh: 转成燃气中央供暖系统可以省不少钱。

examples.en: No conversion from analogue to digital data is needed.
examples.zh: 不需要把模拟数据转换为数字数据。

examples.en: a metric conversion table (= showing how to change metric amounts into or out of another system)
examples.zh: 公制换算表

examples.en: a firm which specializes in house conversions (= turning large houses into several smaller flats)
examples.zh: 专营房屋改建的公司

senses.def: the process or experience of changing somebody's or your own religion or beliefs
senses.zh: （宗教或信仰的）改变；皈依；归附

examples.en: the conversion of the Anglo-Saxons by Christian missionaries
examples.zh: 基督教传教士使盎格鲁–撒克逊人的信仰改变

examples.en: his conversion from Judaism to Christianity
examples.zh: 他由犹太教改信基督教

examples.en: Late in life she experienced a religious conversion.
examples.zh: 晚年她经历了宗教皈依。

examples.en: She began by supporting monetarist economics, but later underwent quite a conversion when she saw how it increased unemployment.
examples.zh: 她一开始支持货币主义经济学，但后来当她看到货币主义经济学如何增加失业率时，她发生了很大的转变。

senses.def: a way of scoring extra points after scoring a try
senses.zh: （持球过对方球门线触地或达阵后的）附加攻门（得分）

examples.en: The try came in the third minute and Jon Bland added the conversion.
examples.zh: 第三分钟，乔恩・布兰德踢定位球又拿到了附加分。

senses.def: a building or room that has been changed so that it can be used for a different purpose, especially for living in

examples.en: a barn/loft conversion
examples.zh: 谷仓/阁楼改建

senses.def: the practice of attempting to cause a person who is not heterosexual
senses.zh: （尤指试图将同性恋者转变为异性恋者的）性取向转化治疗

examples.en: Legislation to ban gay conversion therapy is to be debated in parliament next month.
examples.zh: 禁止同性恋转化治疗的立法将于下个月在议会进行辩论。

senses.def: a vehicle in which the back part behind the driver has been arranged as a living space
to change or make something change from one form, purpose, system, etc. to another

examples.en: They took just nine months to convert the building.
examples.zh: 他们只用了九个月就完成了大楼的改建。

examples.en: You need to ensure that you've converted the data properly.
examples.zh: 您需要确保正确地转换了数据。

examples.en: The pub is a converted warehouse.
