senses.def: the wife of your son or daughter
a small circuit board
a US organization for women who are descended
senses.zh: 美国独立战争的女儿：这是一个为从事美国独立战争而奋斗或帮助过的人的后代妇女的美国组织。该组织成立于1890年，支持任何它认为对美国有益的事情。

senses.def: to make somebody feel nervous and less confident about doing something
senses.zh: 使胆怯；使气馁；使失去信心

examples.en: She was a brave woman but she felt daunted by the task ahead.
examples.zh: 她是一个勇敢的女人，但对面前的任务却感到信心不足。

examples.en: He had struggled with problems that would daunt the most energetic and resourceful of people.
examples.zh: 他曾与那些令最有活力、最足智多谋的人感到畏惧的问题作斗争。

examples.en: The prospect of going in a helicopter rather daunts me.
examples.zh: 乘坐直升机的前景让我感到害怕。

senses.def: confident about something difficult you have to do

examples.en: Nothing daunted, the people set about rebuilding their homes.
examples.zh: 人们毫不气馁，又开始重建家园。

senses.def: confident about something difficult you have to do

examples.en: Nothing daunted, the people set about rebuilding their homes.
examples.zh: 人们毫不气馁，又开始重建家园。

senses.def: in a way that makes or is likely to make somebody feel nervous and less confident about doing something
senses.zh: 使胆怯；使气馁；使失去信心

senses.def: not easily frightened or stopped from doing something difficult
senses.zh: 无所畏惧的；吓不倒的；勇敢的

senses.def: the oldest son of the king of France
a first name for boys, short for David

(1920-2012) a US jazz musician who played the piano and wrote music. He became famous in the 1950s leading his Dave Brubeck Quartet. They were the first to sell over a million copies of a record that used only jazz musical instruments, Take Five
senses.zh: 戴夫·布鲁贝克（Dave Brubeck）：（1920-2012）美国爵士音乐家，他弹钢琴和写音乐。他在1950年代领导戴夫·布鲁贝克四重奏而出名。他们是第一批仅使用爵士乐器就卖出超过一百万张唱片的乐队Take Take（1959）。

senses.def: a first name for boys
used to describe a situation in which a small or weak person or organization tries to defeat another much larger or stronger opponent

examples.en: The match looks like being a David and Goliath contest.
examples.zh: 比赛看上去像是一场力量悬殊的较量。

senses.def: (1947-2016) an English pop singer, writer of songs, and actor. He was especially known for combining music and images in new ways, and for the characters that he created. These included Major Tom, in his first hit song Space Oddity
senses.zh: 大卫·鲍伊（David Bowie）：（1947-2016）英国流行歌手，歌曲作者和演员。他以新的方式结合音乐和图像以及他创造的角色而闻名。其中包括汤姆少校（Tom少校）的第一首热门歌曲《太空怪诞》（Space Oddity（1969））和齐吉·星尘（Ziggy Stardust）的歌曲和表演于1970年代。通过Ziggy的角色，鲍伊创造了被称为“华丽摇滚”或“闪光摇滚”的风格。他在舞台上的音乐表演是在2006年。他的最终专辑是The Next Day（2013）和Blackstar（2016）。鲍伊还演出戏剧和电影。

senses.def: (1926-2013) a British sports commentator
senses.zh: 大卫·科尔曼（David Coleman）：（1926-2013）英国体育评论员，以他的热情着称，尤其是在BBC电视台的看台和体育之夜。多年来，他还主持了英国广播公司（BBC）的电视问答节目“体育问题”。

senses.def: a novel (1850) by Charles Dickens
senses.zh: 大卫·科波菲（David Copperfield）：查尔斯·狄更斯（Charles Dickens）的小说（1850）。戴维（David）是英国维多利亚时代的一个男孩，他被送往伦敦，度过辛苦和贫穷的生活。他成为一名成功的作家，但嫁给了一个幼稚的女人朵拉（Dora），却没有意识到另一个女人（Agnes）真的爱他。艾格尼丝的父亲被其雇员乌里亚·希普（Uriah Heep）骗走了钱，但最后却被大卫的朋友米卡伯（Micawber）救了。朵拉去世，大卫嫁给艾格尼丝。这部小说部分地基于狄更斯的生活。

senses.def: (1962-2008) a US writer who is best known for his novel Infinite Jest
senses.zh: 大卫·福斯特·华莱士（David Foster Wallace）：（1962-2008）是一位美国作家，他的小说《无限的笑话》（Infinite Jest）（1996）以讽刺（使用幽默来批评）美国的消费文化而闻名。

senses.def: (1939-2013) an English television presenter
senses.zh: 大卫·弗罗斯特（David Frost）：（1939-2013）一位英语电视节目主持人。他在1960年代提出喜剧新闻节目《那是一周》时首次成名。从1960年代开始，他在英国和美国电视台担任电视记者，取得了巨大的成功。自1992年起，他在星期日的访谈节目《与弗罗斯特的早餐》（Breakfast with Frost）就在英国电视上播出。1993年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1717-79) an English actor. He changed the way plays were performed in Britain by introducing a more natural style of acting. His versions of Shakespeare's characters made Shakespeare popular again in the 18th century, and made Garrick the most famous actor of the period. He was also a theatre manager, and introduced many improvements to the way plays were shown.
senses.zh: 大卫·加里克（David Garrick）：（1717-79）英国演员。通过引入更自然的表演风格，他改变了英国的戏剧表演方式。他的莎士比亚角色版本使莎士比亚在18世纪再次流行，并使加里克（Garrick）成为这一时期最著名的演员。他还是剧院经理，并介绍了表演方式的许多改进。

senses.def: (1711-76) a Scottish philosopher
senses.zh: 大卫·休谟：（1711-76），苏格兰哲学家和历史学家，被认为是英国最伟大的思想家之一。他说，人们不能确定任何不是直接通过他们的感官。休谟一生受到极大的尊重，但由于他是一个不可知论者，他无法得到大学的教学工作（他不能说他相信上帝）。他最重要的作品包括《人性论》（1739-40）和英国历史（1754-62）。

senses.def: (1959-93) the leader of the religious group called the Branch Davidians
senses.zh: 大卫·科列什（David Koresh）：（1959-93）宗教团体的领导人，称为分支大卫派。他出生于休斯顿的弗农·韦恩·豪威尔（Vernon Wayne Howell），并成为基督复临安息日会成员，但由于被认为是不良影响而被迫离开。他试图成为好莱坞的流行歌手，但失败了。1981年，他加入了Davidiana分公司，后来成为其领导者并更名。在1993年与美国政府军在得克萨斯州韦科的一场战斗中，他与该组织的大多数成员一起死亡。

senses.def: (1908-91) an English film director. His early films included Brief Encounter
senses.zh: 大卫·利恩（David Lean）：（1908-91）英国电影导演。他的早期电影包括《相遇》（1946年）和狄更斯的小说《大期望》（1946年）和《奥利弗·特克斯》（1948年）。精益电影的后期作品规模更大，包括《桂河大桥》（1957年），《阿拉伯劳伦斯》（1962年），《日瓦戈博士》（1965年）和《印度通行证》（1984年）。1984年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1813-73) a Scottish explorer
senses.zh: 大卫·利文斯通（David Livingstone）：（1813-73）苏格兰探险家和传教士。他因在非洲旅行而出名，并且是1855年第一个看到维多利亚瀑布的欧洲人。在1860年代后期，他在试图寻找尼罗河的发源地时被认为迷路了。记者亨利·莫顿·斯坦利（Henry Morton Stanley）于1871年在乌吉吉去寻找他。利文斯通死于非洲，但他的遗体被带回英格兰，并埋葬在威斯敏斯特大教堂。

senses.def: (1863-1945) a British Liberal politician of Welsh parents, who was Prime Minister of Britain from 1916 to 1922. As Chancellor of the Exchequer
senses.zh: 戴维·劳埃德·乔治（David Lloyd George）：( 1863-1945年）是威尔士父母的英国自由派政治家，他于1916年至1922年担任英国首相。作为财政大臣（1908-15年），他引入了养老金（1908年）和国民保险（1911年） ，是现代福利国家的两个重要要素。第一次世界大战期间他成为总理，但战争结束后，保守党反对他对爱尔兰的独立政策迫使他辞职。他一生都留在议会中，但是他和自由党都没有上台。在1945年去世前不久，他就成为了伯爵。

senses.def: (1910-1983) an English film actor well known for playing pleasant, gently comic roles, usually as an elegant
senses.zh: 大卫·尼文（David Niven）：（1910-1983）一位英国电影演员，以扮演愉快，温柔的喜剧角色而闻名，通常是一位优雅的英国绅士。他的许多电影包括《呼啸山庄》（1939年），《八十天环游世界》（1956年），《粉红豹》（1964年）和《尼罗河上的死亡》（1978年）。他还写了两本关于自己生活的幽默书。

senses.def: David Oliver Selznick (1902-65) a successful US film producer. His films included King Kong
senses.zh: David Oliver Selznick（1902-65）是美国成功的电影制片人。他的电影包括RKO的《金刚》和MMG的Anna Karenina（1935）。1936年组建自己的公司Selznick International Pictures后，他制作了《 A Star is Born，Gone with the Wind and Rebecca》（1940年）。最后两个获得奥斯卡最佳影片奖。

senses.def: (1786-1836) a famous American frontiersman
senses.zh: 戴维·克罗克特（Davy Crockett）：（1786-1836）来自田纳西州的著名美国边防军。他还是安德鲁·杰克逊将军和一名政治家的士兵，当选为美国国会议员（1827-31和1833-5）。他在阿拉莫被杀。许多故事讲述了他的生活。迪斯尼（Walt Disney）在1950年代和他的电影戴维·克罗克特（Davy Crockett）（1955）制作了关于他的电视连续剧。

senses.def: the bottom of the sea, where people who drown
senses.zh: 戴维·琼斯（Davy Jones）的储物柜：海底，据说淹死在海底的人在那里

senses.def: a type of lamp, used in the past by miners
senses.zh: 戴维安全灯（旧时矿工使用）

senses.def: to take a long time to do something or go somewhere

examples.en: Stop dawdling! We're going to be late!
examples.zh: 别磨蹭了，咱们快迟到了！

examples.en: They dawdled along by the river, laughing and talking.
examples.zh: 他们沿河边闲逛，一路谈笑风生。

senses.def: the time of day when light first appears

examples.en: They start work at dawn.
examples.zh: 天一亮他们就开始干活了。

examples.en: It's almost dawn.
examples.zh: 天快亮了。

examples.en: We arrived in Sydney as dawn broke (= as the first light could be seen).
examples.zh: 黎明时分我们到达了悉尼。

examples.en: I woke up just before dawn.
examples.zh: 我正好在拂晓前醒来。

examples.en: summer’s early dawns
examples.zh: 夏日早到的黎明

examples.en: He works from dawn till dusk (= from morning till night).
examples.zh: 他从早到晚地工作。

examples.en: The plane took off, leaving London behind in a blue-grey dawn.
examples.zh: 飞机起飞，在蓝灰色的黎明中离开伦敦。

senses.def: the beginning or first signs of something

examples.en: the dawn of civilization/time/history
examples.zh: 文明／时代／历史的开端

examples.en: Peace marked a new dawn in the country's history.
examples.zh: 和平使这个国家的历史翻开了新的一页。

examples.en: the dawn of a golden age in European art
examples.zh: 欧洲艺术黄金时代的黎明

senses.def: very early in the morning

examples.en: I have to get up at the crack of dawn.
examples.zh: 我必须在黎明时分起床。

senses.def: the moment in the early hours of the morning when it begins to get light
to begin

examples.en: The following morning dawned bright and warm.
examples.zh: 第二天一大早阳光和煦。

examples.en: A new technological age had dawned.
examples.zh: 新技术时代已经开始。

senses.def: to become obvious or easy to understand

examples.en: Slowly the awful truth dawned.
examples.zh: 可怕的事实慢慢地清晰起来。

senses.def: somebody suddenly understood or began to understand something

examples.en: I puzzled over the problem for ages before the light suddenly dawned.
examples.zh: 我对这个问题冥思苦想了很久才豁然开朗。

senses.def: a first name for girls
very early in the morning

examples.en: I have to get up at the crack of dawn.
examples.zh: 我必须在黎明时分起床。

senses.def: the moment in the early hours of the morning when it begins to get light
somebody suddenly understood or began to understand something

examples.en: I puzzled over the problem for ages before the light suddenly dawned.
examples.zh: 我对这个问题冥思苦想了很久才豁然开朗。

senses.def: if something dawns on you
senses.zh: 使开始明白；使渐渐领悟；使开始理解

examples.en: Suddenly it dawned on me that they couldn't possibly have met before.
examples.zh: 我突然明白他们以前不可能见过面。

senses.def: a period of 24 hours

examples.en: ‘What day is it today?’ ‘Monday.’
examples.zh: “今天星期几？”“星期一。”

examples.en: I go to the gym every day.
examples.zh: 我每天都去健身房。

examples.en: We spent five days in Paris.
examples.zh: 我们在巴黎待了五天。

examples.en: I saw Tom three days ago.
examples.zh: 我三天前见过汤姆。

examples.en: We're going away in a few days.
examples.zh: 我们过几天就要离开了。

examples.en: The house should be ready in a few days' time.
examples.zh: 房子应该在几天之内就可以准备好。

examples.en: The situation has been deteriorating for the past few days.
examples.zh: 过去几天，局势一直在恶化。

examples.en: Full payment must be made within 21 days.
examples.zh: 必须在21天内付清全款。

examples.en: On that day Rosa Parks did something that changed history.
examples.zh: 罗莎·帕克斯那天做的事情改变了历史。

examples.en: I saw her again the next day.
examples.zh: 第二天我又见到她了。

examples.en: He called me to apologize three days later.
examples.zh: 三天后他打电话给我道歉。

examples.en: He resigned the following day.
examples.zh: 第二天他就辞职了。

examples.en: We'd had this big argument the day before.
examples.zh: 前一天我们发生了一场激烈的争论。

examples.en: They left the day before yesterday (= two days ago).
examples.zh: 他们前天就走了。

examples.en: We're meeting the day after tomorrow (= in two days).
examples.zh: 我们后天要见面。

examples.en: We can't go there today. We can go another day.
examples.zh: 我们今天不能去那里。我们可以改天再去。

examples.en: New Year’s Day
examples.zh: 元旦

examples.en: Take the medicine three times a day.
examples.zh: 每日服药三次。

examples.en: They are producing 1.5 million barrels of oil per day.
examples.zh: 他们每天生产 150 万桶石油。

examples.en: The helpline is open 24 hours a day.
examples.zh: 服务热线每天 24 小时开放。

senses.def: the time between when it becomes light in the morning and when it becomes dark in the evening

examples.en: What a beautiful day!
examples.zh: 多么美好的一天！

examples.en: The sun was shining all day.
examples.zh: 白天一直阳光明媚。

examples.en: I could sit and watch the river all day long.
examples.zh: 我可以整天坐在这里看那条河。

examples.en: We spent the day gardening.
examples.zh: 我们这一天都在打理花园。

examples.en: He works at night and sleeps during the day.
examples.zh: 他晚上干活，白天睡觉。

examples.en: Nocturnal animals sleep by day and hunt by night.
examples.zh: 夜行动物白天睡觉，晚上猎食。

examples.en: On a sunny day in June…
examples.zh: 在六月一个阳光明媚的日子…

senses.def: the hours of the day when you are active, working, etc., not sleeping
senses.zh: 工作日；一天的活动时间

examples.en: a seven-hour working day
examples.zh: 七小时工作日

examples.en: Have a nice day!
examples.zh: 祝你度过愉快的一天！

examples.en: Did you have a good day?
examples.zh: 你这一天过得顺利吗？

examples.en: Our waiter seemed to be having a bad day.
examples.zh: 我们的服务员这天好像很倒霉。

examples.en: It's been a long day (= I've been very busy).
examples.zh: 忙了一整天了。

examples.en: She didn't do a full day's work.
examples.zh: 她并没干一整天的工作。

examples.en: I took a half day off yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我休假半天。

senses.def: a particular period of time or history

examples.en: in Queen Victoria’s day
examples.zh: 在维多利亚女王时代

examples.en: in the days of the Industrial Revolution
examples.zh: 在工业革命时期

examples.en: back in the early days of computers
examples.zh: 在计算机发展的早期

examples.en: He was the biggest star in Hollywood in those days.
examples.zh: 他是当时好莱坞最大牌的明星。

examples.en: in the old days (= in the past)
examples.zh: 早先

senses.def: a particular period in somebody's life or career
senses.zh: （人生或职业生涯的）时期，阶段

examples.en: I have many happy memories from my student days.
examples.zh: 我的学生时代留下了许多美好的回忆。

examples.en: in his younger days
examples.zh: 他年轻的时候

examples.en: She cared for him for the rest of his days (= the rest of his life).
examples.zh: 她照顾他度过了余生。

examples.en: Much has changed since the days of my youth.
examples.zh: 和我年轻时相比已经有了很大变化。

examples.en: Some players go into management once their playing days are over.
examples.zh: 一些运动员在结束运动生涯后从事管理工作。

senses.def: part of your normal working life and not unusual
senses.zh: 日常工作的一部分；习以为常；不足为奇

examples.en: Swimming with sharks or training a tiger cub—it's all in a day's work for animal wrangler Chris Bolton.
examples.zh: 与鲨鱼一起游泳或训练小老虎——这一切都是动物管理员克里斯·博尔顿 (Chris Bolton) 一天的工作。

senses.def: very soon

examples.en: The letter should arrive any day now.
examples.zh: 信应该很快就到了。

examples.en: We expect more info on this any time now.
examples.zh: 我们期待很快就会有关于此事的更多消息。

senses.def: used to introduce the most important fact after everything has been considered
senses.zh: （考虑到所有情况后引出最重要的事实）最终，到头来

examples.en: At the end of the day, he'll still have to make his own decision.
examples.zh: 最终，他还得自己拿主意。

senses.def: in the past

examples.en: My dad's always talking about how great everything was back in the day.
examples.zh: 我爸爸总是讲过去的一切如何如何的好。

senses.def: at a particular time in the past

examples.en: I was a fan back in the days when the band wasn't yet famous.
examples.zh: 在这个乐队还没出名的时候，我就是他们的歌迷。

senses.def: the moment in the early hours of the morning when it begins to get light
to decide or agree to stop doing something
senses.zh: 结束一天的工作；到此为止；停止

examples.en: After forty years in politics I think it's time for me to call it a day (= to retire).
examples.zh: 从政四十年，我想现在也该退休了。

senses.def: to be successful against somebody/something

examples.en: Despite strong opposition, the ruling party carried the day.
examples.zh: 尽管遭到强烈反对，执政党还是获胜了。

examples.en: Teamwork and persistence can still win the day.
examples.zh: 团队合作和坚持仍然可以赢得胜利。

senses.def: easy to see or understand
each day repeatedly (used especially when something is boring or annoying)
senses.zh: 日复一日，一天又一天（尤指枯燥无味、令人厌烦）

examples.en: She hates doing the same work day after day.
examples.zh: 她讨厌日复一日做同样的工作。

senses.def: all the time; continuously
senses.zh: 日日夜夜；夜以继日；连续不断

examples.en: The store is open day and night.
examples.zh: 这家商店二十四小时营业。

examples.en: The machines are kept running night and day.
examples.zh: 这些机器夜以继日地运转着。

senses.def: all the time; a little at a time and gradually

examples.en: Day by day his condition improved.
examples.zh: 他的健康状况一天天好转。

examples.en: Morale was sinking day by day.
examples.zh: 士气一天天消沉下去。

senses.def: every day for a long period of time
senses.zh: 日复一日，天天（指不间断）

examples.en: Living on junk food day in day out is not good for you.
examples.zh: 每天吃垃圾食品对你没有好处。

senses.def: the time when somebody will have to deal with the result of something that they have done wrong, or be punished for something bad that they have done
senses.zh: 遭报应的日子；受到惩罚的日子

senses.def: a person or thing will not continue to live, exist or be successful for much longer
senses.zh: （指人）死期不远了，得意的日子屈指可数了；（指物）用不了多久了，寿命不长了

examples.en: His days as leader of the party are numbered.
examples.zh: 他作为党的领袖的日子已屈指可数了。

examples.en: Whatever the protests, the school’s days are numbered and it will be closed down.
examples.zh: 无论抗议如何，学校的日子已经屈指可数了，它将被关闭。

senses.def: to spend the last part of your life in a particular state or place
senses.zh: （在某种状态下或某处）度过余生，安度晚年

examples.en: He ended his days in poverty.
examples.zh: 他在贫穷中度过余生。

senses.def: everyone has good luck or success at some point in their life
the time when you have to do something difficult or unpleasant
senses.zh: 倒霉的时候（或日子、时刻）

examples.en: I’d better go and see the dentist—I can’t put off the evil hour any longer.
examples.zh: 我最好还是去看看牙医吧─可不能再拖了。

examples.en: If you keep on borrowing, you are only postponing the evil day when you have to pay it all back.
examples.zh: 如果你继续借钱，你只是在推迟你必须还清所有债务的那一天。

senses.def: the amount of fruit or vegetables that some organizations say you should eat in order to be healthy

examples.en: Start your five a day with a banana for breakfast.
examples.zh: 以一根香蕉作为早餐开始您的一天五。

senses.def: from the beginning

examples.en: It's never worked from day one.
examples.zh: 这从一开始就行不通。

examples.en: This game makes reading and spelling fun from day one.
examples.zh: 这个游戏从一开始就让阅读和拼写变得有趣。

senses.def: with no thoughts or plans for the future

examples.en: They live from day to day, looking after their sick daughter.
examples.zh: 他们过一天算一天，日复一日地照顾着生病的女儿。

senses.def: if a situation changes from day to day
senses.zh: 天天，一天又一天（指经常变化）

examples.en: A baby's need for food can vary from day to day.
examples.zh: 婴儿对食物的需要天天都在变化。

senses.def: if a situation changes from one day to the next
senses.zh: 一天又一天（表示不知未来如何）

examples.en: I never know what to expect from one day to the next.
examples.zh: 一天又一天我从不知道会发生什么。

senses.def: beginning on that day; from that time

examples.en: From that day forth she gave me endless friendship and encouragement.
examples.zh: 从那天起，她给了我无尽的友谊和鼓励。

senses.def: used to say that you prefer a particular thing or person to the one that has just been mentioned
senses.zh: 我宁愿；我更喜欢；我宁可选择

examples.en: We don't go out much. Give me a quiet night in front of the TV any day!
examples.zh: 我们不常出去。我宁愿坐在电视机前安安静静地过一夜！

senses.def: a helpful, kind thing that you do

examples.en: I took Sarah’s children to school so I’ve done my good deed for the day.
examples.zh: 我送了萨拉的孩子去上学，所以今天已经做了善事。

examples.en: She felt that she had done her good deed for the day.
examples.zh: 她当时认为自己做了好事。

senses.def: an earlier period of time in your life or in history that is seen as better/worse than the present

examples.en: That was in the bad old days of rampant inflation.
examples.zh: 那是在物价飞涨、生活艰难的往昔。

senses.def: to no longer be successful, powerful, etc.
senses.zh: 得意之时已过；风光不再；日渐衰败

examples.en: She's had her day as a supermodel.
examples.zh: 她作为超级模特儿的辉煌日子已一去不复返。

senses.def: a friendly way of saying goodbye, especially to customers
to be in poor condition
senses.zh: 穷困潦倒；昔盛今衰；曾辉煌过

examples.en: Our car has seen better days!
examples.zh: 我们的汽车曾辉煌一时！

senses.def: (used when talking about somebody’s age) at least

examples.en: He must be 70 if he's a day!
examples.zh: 他至少 70 岁了！

senses.def: used when you are very surprised at something you have never heard or seen before
senses.zh: （表示惊讶）这辈子（未听说，未见）

examples.en: I've never heard such nonsense in all my born days.
examples.zh: 我这辈子还从没听说过此等废话呢。

senses.def: when you have had time to think calmly about something; in the morning when things are clearer
senses.zh: 有时间冷静考虑时；在头脑更清醒些的第二天早晨

examples.en: These things always look different in the cold light of day.
examples.zh: 这些事情在冷静地考虑后总会显得不同。

senses.def: during the part of somebody’s life when they were most successful, famous, etc.

examples.en: She was a great dancer in her day.
examples.zh: 她曾是红极一时的舞蹈家。

examples.en: Things were very different in my grandfather's day.
examples.zh: 祖父的那个年代情况大不一样。

senses.def: when somebody was young

examples.en: In my day, there were plenty of jobs when you left school.
examples.zh: 我年轻时，毕业后就业机会很多。

examples.en: In Grandfather’s day, owning a television was very unusual.
examples.zh: 在祖父时代，拥有一台电视机是非常不寻常的。

senses.def: a long time ago in the past

examples.en: What was life like in the olden days, Gran?
examples.zh: 从前的生活是什么样的，奶奶？

senses.def: now, in the modern world
senses.zh: 当代；当今；在今天这个时代

examples.en: Slavery continues to exist, even in this day and age.
examples.zh: 即使在今天这个时代，奴役的情况依然存在。

examples.en: Why dress so formally in this day and age?
examples.zh: 都这年月了，怎么还穿得这么正式？

senses.def: used to say that it is too soon to be sure how a situation will develop

examples.en: It’s early days yet. We don’t know if the play will be a success.
examples.zh: 现在还为时尚早。不知道这部剧能否成功。

senses.def: used when several bad or unpleasant things happen on the same day
senses.zh: 真是祸不单行；真是倒霉的一天

examples.en: My car broke down and then I locked myself out—it's just not my day!
examples.zh: 我的汽车抛锚了，我又把钥匙锁到车里，真是祸不单行！

senses.def: after the time when an action could be successful

examples.en: He started working hard much too late in the day—he couldn't possibly catch up.
examples.zh: 他太晚才开始努力工作，不可能赶上了。

senses.def: the whole length of the day
used to say that although you have failed or had a bad experience, you will continue
senses.zh: （虽已失败或经历很糟但仍要）改日再战，卷土重来

senses.def: to make somebody feel very happy on a particular day

examples.en: The phone call from Mike really made my day.
examples.zh: 迈克打来电话，真让我高兴了一整天。

senses.def: to make a particular activity that you enjoy last for a whole day/evening instead of only part of it
senses.zh: 痛痛快快玩一整天（或一晚上）

examples.en: We took a picnic lunch to the river and made a day of it.
examples.zh: 我们在河边吃了一顿野餐午餐，度过了一天。

examples.en: They decided to make a night of it and went on to a club.
examples.zh: 他们打算痛痛快快地玩一晚上，就去了俱乐部。

senses.def: all the time; continuously
senses.zh: 日日夜夜；夜以继日；连续不断

examples.en: The machines are kept running night and day.
examples.zh: 这些机器夜以继日地运转着。

examples.en: The store is open day and night.
examples.zh: 这家商店二十四小时营业。

senses.def: a person or thing that makes people excited for a short time but does not last very long
senses.zh: 昙花一现；轰动一时的人（或事物）

senses.def: to refuse to speak to somebody because you do not like or respect them

examples.en: Since the success of her novel, people shake her hand who once wouldn't have given her the time of day.
examples.zh: 自从她的小说获得成功之后，曾经懒得答理她的人也跟她握起手来。

senses.def: to not have much time

examples.en: Come on! We don't have all day!
examples.zh: 快一点！我们的时间不多了！

senses.def: during a particular period of time when somebody lived

examples.en: the best player of his day
examples.zh: 他那个时代最优秀的运动员

examples.en: Bessie Smith was the Madonna of her day.
examples.zh: 贝西·史密斯是她那个时代的麦当娜。

senses.def: of the present time

examples.en: the political issues of the day
examples.zh: 当前的政治问题

senses.def: that is served on a particular day in a restaurant

examples.en: soup of the day
examples.zh: 当日供应的汤

senses.def: used to emphasize what you are saying when you are surprised, shocked or annoyed
senses.zh: （吃惊或恼火时加强语气）我的天啊

examples.en: Oh my days! Is that true?
examples.zh: 我的天啊！那是真的吗？

senses.def: at some time in the future, or on a particular day in the past

examples.en: One day, I want to leave the city and move to the country.
examples.zh: 有朝一日，我要离开城市搬到乡下去。

examples.en: One day, he walked out of the house with a small bag and never came back.
examples.zh: 一天，他带了个小提包走出家门，再也没有回来。

senses.def: before a long time has passed

examples.en: One of these days you'll come back and ask me to forgive you.
examples.zh: 你很快就会回来请求我原谅的。

senses.def: a day when there are a lot of mistakes and a lot of things go wrong
senses.zh: 诸事不顺的日子；倒霉的日子

examples.en: It's been one of those days!
examples.zh: 这一天真倒霉！

examples.en: It's been one of those days when everything's gone wrong.
examples.zh: 那天真倒霉，一切都乱了套。

senses.def: common, popular or suitable at a particular time or for a particular occasion

examples.en: Pessimism seems to be the order of the day.
examples.zh: 悲观失望似乎是当今司空见惯的情形。

senses.def: recently
senses.zh: 那天，那天早上，那天晚上，那个星期（用于指说话前不久的日子）

examples.en: I saw Jack the other day.
examples.zh: 我前几天看到杰克了。

examples.en: I was in your area the other week.
examples.zh: 前一周我在你的地区。

examples.en: I woke up the other morning and just could not get myself out of bed.
examples.zh: 有一天早上我醒来，却无法起床。

examples.en: I was watching TV the other evening, when…
examples.zh: 那天晚上我正在看电视，当时……

senses.def: to say hello to somebody and have a short conversation with them
senses.zh: （与某人）寒暄，打招呼，闲谈一会儿

senses.def: very obvious
senses.zh: 一清二楚；一目了然；显而易见

senses.def: used to say that a complicated task will take a long time and should not be rushed
senses.zh: 罗马不是一天建成的；复杂的工作不会一蹴而就

senses.def: the time when you are young and do not have much experience of life
senses.zh: 年少不谙世事的岁月；涉世未深的青少年时代

senses.def: to prevent failure or defeat, when this seems certain to happen

examples.en: Salah's late goal saved the day for Liverpool.
examples.zh: 萨拉赫后来的进球为利物浦队挽回了败局。

senses.def: to save something, especially money, for a time when you will really need it
at an unknown time in the future

examples.en: Some day I'll be famous.
examples.zh: 总有一天我会成名的。

examples.en: I hope we meet again some day.
examples.zh: 希望我们将来有一天再见面。

senses.def: to not think about what will happen in the future
senses.zh: 得过且过；做一天和尚撞一天钟；过一天算一天

examples.en: I don't know if he'll get better. We're just taking it one day at a time.
examples.zh: 我不知道他还能不能好转，我们只有过一天算一天。

senses.def: used when you are saying that something is very unlikely to happen
senses.zh: 那样的事永远不可能；哪有那样的事

examples.en: Paul? Apologize? That'll be the day!
examples.zh: 保罗？道歉？那真是太阳从西边出来了！

senses.def: used to talk about the present, especially when you are comparing it with the past
senses.zh: （尤用于拿现在和过去比较）如今，而今

examples.en: These days kids grow up so quickly.
examples.zh: 如今孩子们成长得真快。

senses.def: used to suggest that a time in the past was happier or better than now
senses.zh: （指过去）那才是好时光，那才是好年头

senses.def: exactly

examples.en: It's been three years to the day since we met.
examples.zh: 我们整整三年没见面了。

senses.def: even now, when a lot of time has passed

examples.en: To this day, I still don't understand why he did it.
examples.zh: 我直到今天仍然不明白他当时为什么那样做。

senses.def: part of your normal working life and not unusual
senses.zh: 日常工作的一部分；习以为常；不足为奇

examples.en: Swimming with sharks or training a tiger cub—it's all in a day's work for animal wrangler Chris Bolton.
examples.zh: 与鲨鱼一起游泳或训练小老虎——这一切都是动物管理员克里斯·博尔顿 (Chris Bolton) 一天的工作。

senses.def: very soon

examples.en: The letter should arrive any day now.
examples.zh: 信应该很快就到了。

examples.en: We expect more info on this any time now.
examples.zh: 我们期待很快就会有关于此事的更多消息。

items.idm: at the end of the day

senses.def: used to introduce the most important fact after everything has been considered
senses.zh: （考虑到所有情况后引出最重要的事实）最终，到头来

examples.en: At the end of the day, he'll still have to make his own decision.
examples.zh: 最终，他还得自己拿主意。

senses.def: in the past

examples.en: My dad's always talking about how great everything was back in the day.
examples.zh: 我爸爸总是讲过去的一切如何如何的好。

senses.def: at a particular time in the past

examples.en: I was a fan back in the days when the band wasn't yet famous.
examples.zh: 在这个乐队还没出名的时候，我就是他们的歌迷。

senses.def: the moment in the early hours of the morning when it begins to get light
to decide or agree to stop doing something
senses.zh: 结束一天的工作；到此为止；停止

examples.en: After forty years in politics I think it's time for me to call it a day (= to retire).
examples.zh: 从政四十年，我想现在也该退休了。

senses.def: to be successful against somebody/something

examples.en: Despite strong opposition, the ruling party carried the day.
examples.zh: 尽管遭到强烈反对，执政党还是获胜了。

examples.en: Teamwork and persistence can still win the day.
examples.zh: 团队合作和坚持仍然可以赢得胜利。

senses.def: easy to see or understand
each day repeatedly (used especially when something is boring or annoying)
senses.zh: 日复一日，一天又一天（尤指枯燥无味、令人厌烦）

examples.en: She hates doing the same work day after day.
examples.zh: 她讨厌日复一日做同样的工作。

senses.def: all the time; continuously
senses.zh: 日日夜夜；夜以继日；连续不断

examples.en: The store is open day and night.
examples.zh: 这家商店二十四小时营业。

examples.en: The machines are kept running night and day.
examples.zh: 这些机器夜以继日地运转着。

senses.def: all the time; a little at a time and gradually

examples.en: Day by day his condition improved.
examples.zh: 他的健康状况一天天好转。

examples.en: Morale was sinking day by day.
examples.zh: 士气一天天消沉下去。

senses.def: every day for a long period of time
senses.zh: 日复一日，天天（指不间断）

examples.en: Living on junk food day in day out is not good for you.
examples.zh: 每天吃垃圾食品对你没有好处。

senses.def: the time when somebody will have to deal with the result of something that they have done wrong, or be punished for something bad that they have done
senses.zh: 遭报应的日子；受到惩罚的日子

senses.def: a person or thing will not continue to live, exist or be successful for much longer

examples.zh: 如果你继续借钱，你只是在推迟你必须还清所有债务的那一天。

examples.zh: 以一根香蕉作为早餐开始您的一天五。

examples.zh: 这从一开始就行不通。

examples.en: This game makes reading and spelling fun from day one.
examples.zh: 这个游戏从一开始就让阅读和拼写变得有趣。

examples.zh: 舒舒服服洗个澡放松一下。

examples.zh: 她故意试图将大卫排除在谈话之外，并向他展示他是多么的糟糕。

senses.zh: （某些基督教会中的）女执事，女会吏，女助祭

examples.zh: 我母亲不在了，她是 2017 年去世的。

examples.en: a dead person/animal
examples.zh: 死人；死去的动物

examples.en: dead leaves/wood/skin
examples.zh: 枯叶；枯木；死皮

examples.en: Catherine's dead body lay peacefully on the bed.
examples.zh: 凯瑟琳的尸体安详地躺在床上。

examples.en: He was shot dead by a gunman outside his home.
examples.zh: 他在家门外被持枪歹徒开枪打死。

examples.en: A high school shooting has left six students dead.
examples.zh: 一次高中枪击事件导致 6 名学生死亡。

examples.zh: 她在事故现场被宣布死亡。

examples.en: The poor child looks more dead than alive.
examples.zh: 这孩子看上去半死不活的，真可怜。

examples.en: He was missing, presumed dead.
examples.zh: 他失踪了，推测已经死亡。

examples.en: He dropped dead (= died suddenly) last week.
examples.zh: 他上星期突然就死了。

examples.en: One short year later, Fred would be dead from a heart attack.
examples.zh: 短短一年后，弗雷德就因心脏病去世了。

examples.en: In ten years he'll be dead and buried as a politician.
examples.zh: 他作为从政者十年后就不会有人记得了。

senses.def: not working because of a lack of power

examples.en: a dead battery
examples.zh: 用完的电池

examples.en: Suddenly the phone went dead.
examples.zh: 电话突然没声音了。

examples.en: John's mobile was completely dead.
examples.zh: 约翰的手机完全没电了。

senses.def: no longer believed in or aimed for

examples.en: Many believe the peace plan is dead.
examples.zh: 许多人认为和平计划已成泡影。

examples.en: Unfortunately racism is not yet dead.
examples.zh: 不幸的是种族歧视仍未消亡。

examples.en: Though the idea may be dead, it is far from being buried (= people still talk about it, even though there is nothing new to say).
examples.zh: 尽管这种思想可能已无人相信，但还远没被人遗忘。

senses.def: belonging to the past; no longer practised or fashionable
senses.zh: 过时的；已废弃的；不流行的

examples.en: Is the Western a dead art form?
examples.zh: 西部电影这种艺术形式过时了吗？

examples.en: a dead language (= one that is no longer spoken, for example Latin)
examples.zh: 死语言（不再通用，如拉丁语）

senses.def: finished; not able to be used any more

examples.en: dead matches
examples.zh: 划过的火柴

examples.en: There were two dead bottles of wine on the table.
examples.zh: 桌子上有两个空酒瓶。

senses.def: very quiet, without activity or interest
senses.zh: 死气沉沉的；无活力的；无趣的

examples.en: There were no theatres, no cinemas, no coffee bars. It was dead as anything.
examples.zh: 那时没有剧院，没有电影院，也没有咖啡馆，死气沉沉。

senses.def: without activity; with nobody buying or selling anything

examples.en: ‘The market is absolutely dead this morning,’ said one foreign exchange trader.
examples.zh: “今天早上市场萧条极了。”一个外汇交易员说道。

examples.en: Winter is traditionally the dead season for the housing market.
examples.zh: 冬天历来是住房市场的萧条期。

senses.def: extremely tired; not well

examples.en: half dead with cold and hunger
examples.zh: 饥寒交迫，筋疲力尽

examples.en: She felt dead on her feet and didn't have the energy to question them further.
examples.zh: 她觉得累死了，没有力气继续审问他们了。

senses.def: unable to feel because of cold, etc.

examples.en: My left arm had gone dead.
examples.zh: 我的左胳臂已经麻木了。

senses.def: unable to feel or understand emotions
senses.zh: 无动于衷；麻木不仁；无感觉

examples.en: He was dead to all feelings of pity.
examples.zh: 他毫无同情心。

senses.def: showing no emotion

examples.en: She said, ‘I'm sorry, too,’ in a quiet, dead voice.
examples.zh: 她平静而冷漠地说：“我也很抱歉。”

examples.en: His usually dead grey eyes were sparkling.
examples.zh: 他那平日冷漠的灰眼睛突然亮了起来。

senses.def: complete or exact

examples.zh: 死寂；完全静止

examples.en: the dead centre of the target
examples.zh: 靶子正中心

examples.en: The car gave a sudden jerk and came to a dead stop.
examples.zh: 汽车猛然一颠，猝然停下。

examples.en: Her face was a dead giveaway (= made it very obvious) that something was going on.
examples.zh: 一看她的脸色就知道肯定发生什么事了。

examples.en: This horse is a dead cert for (= will certainly win) the race tomorrow.
examples.zh: 这匹马明天比赛一定能赢。

examples.en: She crumpled to the floor in a dead faint (= completely unconscious).
examples.zh: 她倒在地上全然不省人事。

senses.def: never having been alive

examples.zh: 无生命物质（如岩石）

examples.en: a dead planet (= one with no life on it)
examples.zh: 无生命存在的行星

senses.def: outside the playing area

examples.zh: 比赛还剩五秒时出现死球。

senses.def: to be dead

examples.en: You'll be sorry you said that when I'm dead and gone.
examples.zh: 我死后你会为你说的话感到后悔的。

examples.en: That won't happen until long after I'm dead and gone.
examples.zh: 那种事不会发生，除非我死后很久。

senses.def: to look very like somebody
senses.zh: 酷似，极像（某人）；（和某人）一模一样

examples.en: She's a dead ringer for a girl I used to know.
examples.zh: 她酷似我以前认识的一个女孩。

senses.def: completely dead; no longer interesting or relevant

examples.en: In the second half both teams made substitutions to try and liven things up, but the game was as dead as a dodo.
examples.zh: 下半场两队都纷纷换人，试图活跃气氛，但比赛却死气沉沉。

senses.def: completely dead
a plan, an event, etc. that has failed or is certain to fail and that is therefore not worth discussing
senses.zh: 已失败（或注定要失败、毫无讨论价值）的计划（或事情等）

senses.def: an influence that controls or limits something
senses.zh: （控制或阻碍事物发展的）影响

examples.en: We need to free business from the dead hand of bureaucracy.
examples.zh: 我们必须摆脱官僚主义对工作的严重影响。

examples.zh: 他参加领导层竞选无望成功。

senses.def: in serious trouble

senses.def: (of an accident victim or other patient) already dead when arriving at a hospital

examples.zh: 她在送达医院时即被宣布死亡。

examples.zh: 他甚至没来得及送医院，到院时已经死了。

examples.en: Many of the casualties were dead on arrival.
examples.zh: 许多伤员在到院时已经死亡。

senses.def: very unlikely to be successful; not working when it is delivered
senses.zh: 已不可能成功；到货即损；到达时已无用

examples.zh: 你看上去漂亮极了，今晚肯定把他们迷倒。

senses.zh: （表示强烈反对）除非我死了，我死也不

examples.zh: 除非我死了，否则她别想搬进我们家。

examples.zh: 我们想走的头一条路结果是条死胡同。

examples.zh: 我们的研究工作已陷入绝境。

examples.zh: 这条调查路线可能被证明是一个彻底的死胡同。

examples.zh: 他在当地工厂的工作是没有前途的。

examples.zh: 两名候选人在民意测验中势均力敌。

senses.def: an injury that occurs when somebody's upper leg is hit by somebody else's knee
senses.zh: （大腿被他人用膝部撞击导致的）腿麻，腿部失去知觉

examples.en: The collision forced Dempsey to retire with a dead leg.
examples.zh: 这一撞让登普西腿部失去知觉，被迫退出比赛。

examples.en: The star threatened an intrusive journalist with a dead leg.
examples.zh: 这个明星威胁一名纠缠不休的记者，说要将他的腿撞到失去知觉。

senses.def: a law or an agreement that still exists but that is ignored
senses.zh: 无人遵守的法律；形同虚设的协定；空文

examples.en: The treaty had been a dead letter for many years.
examples.zh: 多年来，该条约一直是一纸空文。

senses.def: a letter that cannot be delivered to an address or to the person who sent it
senses.zh: 死信；无法投递（或退回）的邮件

senses.def: a person or thing that is not helpful or useful

examples.en: He may be a very talented designer, but as a manager he's a dead loss.
examples.zh: 他可能是一个很有天赋的设计师，但作为经理他却很无能。

senses.def: a thing that is very heavy and difficult to lift or move

examples.en: The sleeping child was a dead weight in her arms.
examples.zh: 熟睡的孩子在她怀里就像个沉重的负担。

examples.en: With difficulty she managed to pull his dead weight onto the bed.
examples.zh: 她费了好大的劲儿才把他沉重的身体拖到床上。

senses.def: a person or thing that makes it difficult for something to succeed or change

a writer, scientist, or other famous figure from the past that some people may consider more important than other writers, etc. just because he belongs to the group of people who are most powerful in society
senses.zh: 已过世的白人男性（已去世的男性作家或其他著名人物因为是白人而备受尊敬，而不是因为其作品比其他人更值得尊敬）

examples.en: The gallery has room after room of similar and rather dull paintings (mostly by dead white males).
examples.zh: 画廊里有一个又一个房间，陈列着相似且相当沉闷的画作（大部分是死去的白人男性的作品）。

senses.def: people or things that are no longer useful or necessary in an organization
a place or a period of time in which nothing happens
senses.zh: 空白地带，空白期（没有事情发生）

examples.en: The town is a cultural dead zone.
examples.zh: 这个镇子是个文化荒原。

senses.def: an area that separates two places, groups of people, etc.

examples.en: The UN is trying to maintain a dead zone between the warring groups.
examples.zh: 联合国正试图在交战方之间保留隔离带。

senses.def: a place where a mobile phone does not work because no signal can be received
an area of water in which animals cannot live because there is not enough oxygen
senses.zh: 死水区（因缺氧而使动物无法生存）

senses.def: a lazy person; a person who does not want to work or achieve anything
senses.zh: 懒人，游手好闲的人，二流子

senses.def: a person or company that tries to avoid paying their debts
senses.zh: 赖账者；赖债者；不讲信用的公司

senses.def: a father who does not live with his children and does not pay their mother any money to take care of them
senses.zh: （不与子女同住，也不支付抚养费的）无良父亲，失职父亲

senses.def: a type of lock on a door that needs a key to open or close it
to make something such as a sound, a feeling, etc. less strong
senses.zh: 使（声音、感觉等）减弱，缓和，迟钝

examples.en: He was given drugs to deaden the pain.
examples.zh: 给了他止痛药。

examples.en: The wood panelling in the rooms deadened any noise from outside.
examples.zh: 房间里的木镶板隔音了外面的任何噪音。

senses.def: to remove dead flowers from a plant
a point in time by which something must be done

examples.en: I prefer to work to a deadline.
examples.zh: 我喜欢按规定的期限完成工作。

examples.en: The deadline for applications is 30 April.
examples.zh: 交申请书的截止日期是 4 月 30 日。

senses.def: a complete failure to reach agreement or settle an argument

examples.en: European agriculture ministers failed to break the deadlock over farm subsidies.
examples.zh: 欧洲各国农业部长在农业补贴问题上未能打破僵局。

examples.en: The strike appeared to have reached deadlock.
examples.zh: 罢工好像已陷入僵局。

examples.en: The strike has reached a deadlock.
examples.zh: 罢工已陷入僵局。

senses.def: a type of lock on a door that needs a key to open or close it
in a state of complete failure to reach agreement or settle an argument

examples.en: Despite months of discussion the negotiations remained deadlocked.
examples.zh: 尽管已商讨数月之久，谈判仍处于僵局。

senses.def: causing or likely to cause death

examples.en: a deadly weapon/disease
examples.zh: 致命的武器／疾病

examples.en: He was charged with possession of a deadly weapon.
examples.zh: 他被指控持有致命武器。

examples.en: deadly poison
examples.zh: 剧毒

examples.en: The cobra is one of the world's deadliest snakes.
examples.zh: 眼镜蛇是世界上最致命的蛇类之一。

examples.en: The terrorists have chosen to play a deadly game with the civilian population.
examples.zh: 恐怖分子决意要同平民百姓玩死亡游戏。

examples.en: The loss of skills training was deadly for the economy.
examples.zh: 技能培训的丧失对经济来说是致命的。

senses.def: extreme; complete

examples.en: I'm in deadly earnest.
examples.zh: 我是非常认真的。

examples.en: We sat in deadly silence.
examples.zh: 我们默不作声地坐着。

examples.en: They are deadly enemies (= are full of hatred for each other).
examples.zh: 他们是不共戴天的仇敌。

examples.en: The missile found its target with deadly accuracy.
examples.zh: 导弹以致命的精度找到了目标。

senses.def: extremely effective, so that no defence is possible
senses.zh: 非常有效的；无法防御的

examples.en: His aim is deadly (= so accurate that he can kill easily).
examples.zh: 他弹无虚发。

examples.en: It was the deadly striker's 11th goal of the season.
examples.zh: 这是杀手前锋本赛季的第 11 个进球。

examples.en: The man possessed an absolutely deadly charm.
examples.zh: 这个男人有着绝对致命的魅力。

senses.def: very boring
senses.zh: 非常乏味的；令人厌烦的

examples.en: The lecture was absolutely deadly.
examples.zh: 这讲座简直无聊透了。

senses.def: like a dead person; suggesting death
extremely

examples.en: deadly serious/dull
examples.zh: 极其严肃认真／乏味

senses.def: like a dead person; suggesting death

examples.en: deadly pale/cold
examples.zh: 死一般地苍白；冷得要死

senses.def: a very poisonous plant with purple flowers and black berries
senses.zh: 颠茄（有毒，开紫花，结黑色浆果）

senses.def: one of the seven actions for which you can go to hell
senses.zh: 七罪宗之一，大罪（基督教指罪恶的根源）

examples.en: Greed is one of the seven deadly sins.
examples.zh: 贪婪是七罪宗之一。

senses.def: to call a transgender
senses.zh: 使用弃名错称（用跨性别者变性前的名字称呼他们）

examples.en: She refuses to accept being deadnamed and always complains when it happens.
examples.zh: 她拒绝接受被命名为死亡的事实，并且在这种情况发生时总是抱怨。

senses.def: without any expression or emotion; often pretending to be serious when you are joking
senses.zh: 面无表情的；不带感情色彩的；冷面幽默的

examples.en: deadpan humour
examples.zh: 冷面幽默

examples.en: She looked up, completely deadpan.
examples.zh: 她抬起头，面无表情。

senses.def: unable to hear anything or unable to hear very well

examples.en: to become/go deaf
examples.zh: 变聋

examples.en: She was born deaf.
examples.zh: 她天生耳聋。

examples.en: partially deaf
examples.zh: 部分失聪

senses.def: people who cannot hear

examples.en: television subtitles for the deaf
examples.zh: 聋人电视字幕

senses.def: not willing to listen or pay attention to something

examples.en: He was deaf to my requests for help.
examples.zh: 他对我的求助充耳不闻。

examples.en: The committee remained deaf to our suggestions.
examples.zh: 委员会对我们的建议充耳不闻。

senses.def: very deaf
senses.zh: 全聋；聋得什么也听不见

senses.def: to be ignored or not noticed by other people
senses.zh: 不被理睬；不被注意；被置若罔闻

examples.en: Her advice fell on deaf ears.
examples.zh: 她的忠告没有受到重视。

senses.def: to ignore or refuse to listen to somebody/something

examples.en: He turned a deaf ear to the rumours.
examples.zh: 他对这些谣言置若罔闻。

senses.def: very deaf
senses.zh: 全聋；聋得什么也听不见

senses.def: to be ignored or not noticed by other people
senses.zh: 不被理睬；不被注意；被置若罔闻

examples.en: Her advice fell on deaf ears.
examples.zh: 她的忠告没有受到重视。

senses.def: to ignore or refuse to listen to somebody/something

examples.en: He turned a deaf ear to the rumours.
examples.zh: 他对这些谣言置若罔闻。

senses.def: unable to hear and see anything or unable to hear and see very well

examples.en: Negotiating a public transport system presents all kinds of problems for people who are deaf-blind.
examples.zh: 对于聋哑人来说，协商公共交通系统会带来各种各样的问题。

senses.def: a word for a person who is unable to hear or speak that is now considered offensive
to make somebody unable to hear, either permanently or for a short time

examples.en: The noise of the siren was deafening her.
examples.zh: 汽笛声震得她耳朵都快聋了。

senses.def: very loudly

examples.en: The bird screeched deafeningly.
examples.zh: 那只鸟发出震耳欲聋的叫声。

senses.def: the condition of being unable to hear anything or unable to hear very well

examples.en: Measles can cause deafness and blindness.
examples.zh: 麻疹可导致耳聋和失明。

senses.def: the fact of not being willing to listen or pay attention to something

examples.en: his deafness to criticism
examples.zh: 他对批评充耳不闻

senses.def: to give cards to each player in a game of cards

examples.en: Whose turn is it to deal?
examples.zh: 该谁发牌了？

examples.en: Start by dealing out ten cards to each player.
examples.zh: 首先给每家发十张牌。

examples.en: He dealt me two aces.
examples.zh: 他给我发了两张 A。

senses.def: to buy and sell illegal drugs

examples.en: You can often see people dealing openly on the streets.
examples.zh: 经常可以看到一些人在大街上公然买卖毒品。

examples.en: He was sent to jail for dealing drugs to his friends.
examples.zh: 他因把毒品卖给朋友而被判刑。

senses.def: to shock somebody/something very much; to be very harmful to somebody/something
senses.zh: 使震惊；给予沉重打击；使受到严重伤害

examples.en: Her sudden death dealt a blow to the whole country.
examples.zh: 她突然逝世，举国上下为之震惊。

senses.def: to hit somebody/something
used to tell somebody that they cannot change a situation so they must accept it
senses.zh: （用以告诉某人无法改变现状）接受现实吧

examples.en: That's the way it is, so deal with it!
examples.zh: 就是这个样子，接受现实吧！

senses.def: to do a lot of complicated deals in business or politics, often in a dishonest way
senses.zh: （在商界或政界）工于心计；（以不正当的方式）进行纷繁复杂的交易，周旋

senses.def: an agreement, especially in business, on particular conditions for buying or doing something

examples.en: to sign/strike/finalize/close a deal
examples.zh: 签署／达成／敲定／完成一笔交易

examples.en: to negotiate/broker/agree/reach a deal
examples.zh: 商谈／斡旋／同意／达成一笔交易

examples.en: She is travelling to New York to seal the deal (= conclude it).
examples.zh: 她要去纽约敲定这笔交易。

examples.en: We did a deal with the management on overtime.
examples.zh: 我们与资方在加班问题上达成了一项协议。

examples.en: I'll make a deal with you—I'll work evenings if you'll work weekends.
examples.zh: 我要和你定个协议，如果你周末工作，我就晚上工作。

examples.en: He is trying to cut a deal (= make one) with the rebels.
examples.zh: 他正试图与叛军达成交易。

examples.en: The deal fell through (= no agreement was reached).
examples.zh: 交易没有谈成。

examples.en: I got a good deal on the car (= bought it cheaply).
examples.zh: 我这辆小汽车买得很便宜。

examples.en: They were hoping for a better pay deal.
examples.zh: 他们希望达成一项提高工资的协议。

examples.en: Both sides are willing to agree on a peace deal.
examples.zh: 双方都愿意就和平协议达成一致。

examples.en: Listen. This is the deal (= this is what we have agreed and are going to do).
examples.zh: 听好了，下面是我们达成的协议。

senses.def: the way that somebody/something is treated

examples.en: If elected, the party has promised a new deal (= better and fairer treatment) for teachers.
examples.zh: 该党承诺如果当选将给教师更好的待遇。

examples.en: They knew they'd been given a raw deal (= been treated unfairly).
examples.zh: 他们知道自己受到了不公正待遇。

examples.en: We tried to ensure that everyone got a fair deal.
examples.zh: 我们尽力保证每个人都受到公平待遇。

examples.en: The poorest get a bad deal under this system.
examples.zh: 在这个制度下，最贫穷的人得到了糟糕的待遇。

senses.def: the action of giving out cards to the players

examples.en: It's your deal.
examples.zh: 该你发牌了。

senses.group: in card games 纸牌游戏

senses.def: the soft pale wood of fir

examples.en: a deal table
examples.zh: 松木桌子

senses.def: used to say that you are not impressed by something

examples.en: So he earns more than me. Big deal!
examples.zh: 他是赚得比我多。那又怎么样！

senses.def: an agreement or a plan that has been finally completed or agreed
senses.zh: 达成的协议；决定了的计划

examples.en: The merger is by no means a done deal yet.
examples.zh: 合并之事远未成定局。

senses.def: much; a lot

examples.en: She's feeling a good deal better.
examples.zh: 她感觉好多了。

examples.en: We don't see them a great deal (= often) these days.
examples.zh: 我们这些天没怎么见到他们。

examples.en: They spent a great deal of money.
examples.zh: 他们花了大量的钱。

examples.en: A good deal of research has been done on the subject.
examples.zh: 关于这个主题已经进行了大量的研究。

senses.def: used to say that you agree to somebody's terms

examples.en: ‘I'll cook if you wash the dishes.’ ‘It's a deal!’
examples.zh: “如果你洗碗，我就做饭。”“说定了！”

senses.def: used to say that something is not important or not a problem
senses.zh: 没什么大不了；无所谓；没关系

examples.en: If I don't win it's no big deal.
examples.zh: 如果我赢不了也没什么大不了的。

senses.def: to make an agreement with somebody in which both sides have an advantage
senses.zh: 达成（对双方都有利的）协议

examples.en: Perhaps we could strike a bargain.
examples.zh: 也许我们可以讨价还价。

examples.en: The United States has struck a historic deal with India.
examples.zh: 美国与印度达成了一项历史性协议。

examples.zh: 怎么啦？你想不想出去？

senses.def: something that causes somebody to reject a deal in politics or business

examples.en: The candidate's support for the war is the deal-breaker (= people will not vote for the candidate because of it).
examples.zh: 候选人因为支持这场战争而失去了选民。

examples.en: I would have bought the house, but the small backyard was the deal-breaker for me.
examples.zh: 我本想买下这栋房子，但后院太小对我来说是个阻碍。

examples.en: Lack of accounting clarity can discourage investors and become a deal-breaker.
examples.zh: 缺乏会计透明度会使投资者望而却步，导致交易失败。

senses.def: to buy and sell a particular product

examples.en: The company deals in computer software.
examples.zh: 这个公司经营计算机软件。

senses.def: to accept something as a basis for your decisions, attitudes or actions

examples.en: We don't deal in rumours or guesswork.
examples.zh: 我们不听信谣言，也不胡乱猜测。

senses.def: to include somebody in an activity
senses.zh: 将某人算在里边；让某人参与

examples.en: That sounds great. Deal me in!
examples.zh: 这听起来太棒了。算我一个！

senses.def: to share something out among a group of people

examples.en: The profits were dealt out among the investors.
examples.zh: 利润分给了投资者。

senses.def: to say what punishment somebody should have

examples.en: Many judges deal out harsher sentences to men than to women.
examples.zh: 许多法官对男性比对女性的判决更严厉。

senses.def: to take appropriate action in a particular situation or according to who you are talking to, managing, etc.

examples.en: She is used to dealing with all kinds of people in her job.
examples.zh: 她已习惯于和工作中遇到的各种各样的人打交道。

examples.en: You have not dealt fairly with me.
examples.zh: 你对我不公平。

senses.def: to do business with a person, a company or an organization

examples.en: Our factory deals directly with its customers.
examples.zh: 我们工厂直接与客户交易。

senses.def: to solve a problem, perform a task, etc.

examples.en: Not all complaints are so easily dealt with.
examples.zh: 不是所有的投诉都这么容易处理。

examples.en: The two issues should be dealt with separately.
examples.zh: 这两个问题应该分开解决。

examples.en: We discussed different ways of dealing with the problem.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了处理这个问题的不同方法。

examples.en: Have you dealt with these letters yet?
examples.zh: 这些信件你处理了吗？

examples.en: He's good at dealing with pressure.
examples.zh: 他善于应付压力。

senses.def: to be about something

examples.en: Her poems often deal with the subject of death.

examples.zh: 这些谈判对于工厂来说是生死攸关的问题。

examples.en: Delivering on time is a matter of life and death for a small company.
examples.zh: 是否按订单准时交货对小公司来说关乎存亡。

senses.def: to kill somebody as a punishment

examples.en: The prisoner will be put to death at dawn.
examples.zh: 囚犯将在黎明时被处死。

senses.def: extremely; very much

examples.en: to be bored to death
examples.zh: 腻烦得要命

examples.en: I'm sick to death of your endless criticism.
examples.zh: 你这无休止的指责真让我烦死了。

senses.def: until somebody is dead

examples.en: a fight to the death
examples.zh: 战斗到底

senses.def: an event that destroys or puts an end to something
senses.zh: 导致毁灭的事情；致命的一击

examples.en: They thought the arrival of television would deal a death blow to mass cinema audiences.
examples.zh: 他们认为电视的问世将使观众涌向影院的现象不复存在。

senses.def: a place where prisoners are killed, usually in a war

examples.en: This brutal dictator was responsible for the mass murder in death camps of thousands of civilians.
examples.zh: 这个残忍的独裁者应对死亡集中营里数千名平民的大屠杀负责。

senses.def: an official document, signed by a doctor, that states the cause and time of somebody’s death
willing to face or risk death
senses.zh: 反抗死亡：愿意面对或冒险死亡

examples.en: the death-defying climbers who scale New York City's skyscrapers
examples.zh: 那些玩命的攀登者攀登纽约市的摩天大楼

senses.def: that looks very dangerous to do or to attempt to do
senses.zh: 反抗死亡：要做或尝试做非常危险

examples.en: The audience enjoyed watching death-defying feats of balance.
examples.zh: 观众们喜欢观看挑战死亡的平衡壮举。

examples.en: The performance combines clowning with death-defying aerial stunts.
examples.zh: 表演结合了小丑表演和玩命的空中特技。

senses.def: inheritance tax
an event that means that the end or destruction
senses.zh: 丧钟；死亡的征兆；预示毁灭的事件

examples.en: If he loses this referendum, it will sound the death knell for his leadership.
examples.zh: 如果他在这次公投中失败，这将敲响他领导地位的丧钟。

senses.def: a model of the face of a person who has just died, made by pressing a soft substance over their face and removing it when it becomes hard
senses.zh: （用柔软物质压在死人脸上，变硬后取出制成的）死人面部模型

senses.def: a play (1949) by Arthur Miller
senses.zh: 推销员之死：亚瑟·米勒（Arthur Miller）的一部戏剧（1949），获得普利策奖。讲述的是一个普通人，威利·洛曼（Willie Loman），他因为生活失败而自杀。电影版本是1951年制作的。

senses.def: the number of deaths every year for every 1 000 people in the population of a place
senses.zh: 死亡率（某地每年每 1 000 人的死亡人数）

examples.en: a high/low death rate
examples.zh: 高／低死亡率

senses.def: the number of deaths every year from a particular disease or in a particular group
senses.zh: （某种疾病或某个群体的）死亡率

examples.en: Death rates from heart disease have risen considerably in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来心脏病的死亡率大大上升了。

senses.def: a sound sometimes heard in the throat of a dying person
the cells in a prison for prisoners who are waiting to be killed as punishment for a serious crime

examples.en: prisoners on death row
examples.zh: 死囚区的犯人

senses.def: a human skull
the legal punishment of being killed for a serious crime

examples.en: the first death sentence passed on a woman
examples.zh: 第一个死刑判决是针对女性的

examples.en: to be given/to receive the death sentence for murder
examples.zh: 因谋杀罪被判死刑

senses.def: the path taken by an aircraft that is out of control and is turning round and round quickly while falling towards earth
senses.zh: 死亡旋降（指失控飞机快速旋转坠向地面）

examples.en: The plane went into a death spiral before crashing into the sea.
examples.zh: 飞机开始死亡旋降，最终坠入大海。

senses.def: a situation that is quickly getting worse, often one that ends in disaster
senses.zh: 死亡螺旋（指形势迅速恶化并常以灾难终结）

examples.en: The company is in a desperate death spiral of rising costs and declining sales.
examples.zh: 公司陷入成本上升、销量下滑的可怕死亡螺旋。

senses.def: a group of people who are ordered by a government, the police, etc. to kill other people, especially their political opponents
senses.zh: （受命于政府、警方等的）处决小队，暗杀小组

examples.en: They started forming death squads.
examples.zh: 他们开始组建暗杀小队。

examples.en: People lived in fear of the regime's notorious death squads.
examples.zh: 人民生活在对那个政权臭名昭著的暗杀小组的恐惧之中。

senses.def: the final stages of something just before it comes to an end

examples.en: The regime is now in its death throes.
examples.zh: 这一政权大势已去。

examples.en: witnessing the death throes of car manufacturing in Britain
examples.zh: 见证英国汽车制造业的垂死挣扎

examples.en: By 1740 European feudalism was in its death throes.
examples.zh: 到 1740 年，欧洲的封建主义摇摇欲坠。

senses.def: violent pains and movements at the moment of death
senses.zh: 临终的剧痛；死前的挣扎

examples.en: The shock of seeing the bull in its death throes was worse than I anticipated.
examples.zh: 看到公牛濒临死亡时的震惊比我预想的还要严重。

senses.def: the number of people killed in an accident, a war, a disaster, etc.
senses.zh: （事故、战争、灾难等的）死亡人数

examples.en: The death toll has now risen to 200.
examples.zh: 目前死亡人数已上升至200人。

senses.def: a building, vehicle, etc. that is dangerous and could cause somebody’s death
senses.zh: 死亡陷阱（潜藏祸患的建筑物、车辆等）

examples.en: The cars blocking the exits could turn this place into a death trap.
examples.zh: 堵在出口的汽车会把这里变成死亡陷阱。

examples.en: Oil slicks, overhead cables and pollution are all death traps for birds.
examples.zh: 浮油、架空电缆和污染都是鸟的死亡陷阱。

senses.def: a desert covering part of the US states of California
senses.zh: 死亡谷（加利福尼亚东南和内华达西南低于海平面的沙漠深谷，北美洲最热最干的部分）

senses.def: an official document stating that somebody should receive the punishment of being killed for a crime that they have committed

examples.en: The president signed the death warrant.
examples.zh: 总统签署了死刑执行令。

examples.en: If you pay the ransom, you may be signing your son's death warrant.
examples.zh: 如果你付赎金，可能就要了你儿子的命。

examples.en: By withdrawing the funding, the government signed the project's death warrant.
examples.zh: 政府撤回资金，也就是对这项工程判了死刑。

examples.en: The king refused to sign the death warrant for his old friend.
examples.zh: 国王拒绝签署他老朋友的死刑执行令。

senses.def: a desire to die, often that somebody is not aware of

examples.en: The number of accidents she gets into, you’d think she had a death wish.
examples.zh: 她发生的事故次数之多，你会认为她想死。

examples.en: Freud's theory of the death wish
examples.zh: 弗洛伊德的死亡愿望理论

senses.def: the bed in which somebody is dying or dies

examples.en: a deathbed confession/conversion
examples.zh: 临终告解／皈依

examples.en: He told me the truth on his deathbed (= as he lay dying).
examples.zh: 他临终时向我吐露了实情。

examples.en: She was on her deathbed (= going to die very soon).
examples.zh: 她已生命垂危。

examples.en: You'd have to be practically on your deathbed before the doctor would come and see you!
examples.zh: 你非病到就要一命呜呼的时候医生才会来看你！

senses.def: never dying or forgotten

examples.en: written in his usual deathless prose (= very bad)
examples.zh: 用他那万世不变的笔调写成

senses.def: like a dead person; suggesting death

examples.en: a deathly pallor
examples.zh: 死人般的苍白

examples.en: A deathly hush fell over the room as he walked in.
examples.zh: 他一走进房间，里面顿时一片死寂。

senses.def: like a dead person; suggesting death

examples.en: Her face was deathly pale.
examples.zh: 她的脸色死一般苍白。

examples.en: The house was deathly still.
examples.zh: 房子一片死寂。

examples.en: deathly cold
examples.zh: 死一般的寒冷

senses.def: a small insect that eats into old wood, making sounds like a watch ticking
senses.zh: 红毛窃蠹（专蛀旧木的小甲虫，会发出类似钟表的滴答声）

senses.def: a debutante
a first name for girls, short for Deborah
an event or a situation that is a complete failure and causes people to feel ashamed or embarrassed

examples.en: He should take responsibility for the debacle and resign.
examples.zh: 他应该对这次惨败负责并辞职。

examples.en: Let’s hope this is the end of the debacle over player transfer fees.
examples.zh: 希望球员转会费问题的争论就此结束。

senses.def: to officially prevent somebody from doing something, joining something, etc.
senses.zh: 阻止，禁止（某人做某事、加入某团体等）

examples.en: He was debarred from holding public office.
examples.zh: 他被禁止担任公职。

examples.en: Members of illegal groups were debarred from election to the assembly.
examples.zh: 非法团体的成员被禁止参加议会选举。

examples.en: Such a ban would debar him from the European Championships in May.
examples.zh: 这样的禁令将使他无法参加五月份的欧洲锦标赛。

senses.def: to leave a vehicle, especially a ship or an aircraft, at the end of a journey; to let or make people leave a vehicle

examples.en: The ship can embark and debark passengers simultaneously.
examples.zh: 这艘船可以同时上下客。

senses.def: to make somebody/something less valuable or respected
senses.zh: 降低…的价值；败坏…的名誉

examples.en: Sport is being debased by commercial sponsorship.
examples.zh: 体育运动因受商业赞助而降低了声誉。

senses.def: the fact of making something/somebody less valuable or respected
senses.zh: 降低…的价值；败坏…的名誉

examples.en: He considered advertising a debasement of his art.
examples.zh: 他认为广告是对他艺术的贬低。

senses.def: not certain because people can have different ideas and opinions about the thing being discussed

examples.en: a debatable point
examples.zh: 有争议的观点

examples.en: It is highly debatable whether conditions have improved for low-income families.
examples.zh: 低收入家庭的生活状况是否已得到改善是一个颇有争议的问题。

senses.def: a formal discussion of an issue at a public meeting or in a parliament. In a debate
senses.zh: （在公共集会上或议会里就某问题进行的、常以表决结束的）辩论

examples.en: the first ever televised presidential debate
examples.zh: 有史以来首次电视直播的总统辩论

examples.en: The minister opened the debate (= was the first to speak).
examples.zh: 部长在辩论时率先发言。

examples.en: After a long debate, Congress approved the proposal.
examples.zh: 经过长时间辩论，国会通过了这项提议。

examples.en: a debate on transport policy
examples.zh: 关于运输政策的辩论

examples.en: The motion under debate (= being discussed) was put to a vote.
examples.zh: 辩论中的动议已付诸表决。

senses.def: an argument or a discussion expressing different opinions
senses.zh: （各自发表不同意见的）争论，辩论，讨论

examples.en: The issue has sparked debate across the industry.
examples.zh: 这个问题在整个行业引发了争论。

examples.en: to provoke/stimulate debate
examples.zh: 引起／激起争论

examples.en: a fierce/vigorous debate
examples.zh: 激烈的辩论

examples.en: The theatre's future is a subject of lively public debate.
examples.zh: 剧院的未来是公众热烈辩论的话题。

examples.en: Intense political debate focused on the merits of the two alternative schemes.
examples.zh: 激烈的政治辩论集中在两个备选方案的优点上。

examples.en: There has been heated debate about whether the film should be allowed.
examples.zh: 关于是否应该允许这部电影上映，人们进行了激烈的辩论。

examples.en: There has been much debate on the issue of childcare.
examples.zh: 人们对儿童照管问题议论纷纷。

examples.en: the ongoing debate over American foreign policy
examples.zh: 关于美国对外政策的持续辩论

examples.en: Whether he deserved what happened to him is open to debate (= cannot be certain or decided yet).
examples.zh: 他是否罪有应得还有待讨论。

examples.en: The issue is still under debate.
examples.zh: 这个问题仍存在争论。

senses.def: to discuss something, especially formally, before making a decision or finding a solution

examples.en: Politicians will be debating the bill later this week.
examples.zh: 政界将在本周晚些时候讨论这个议案。

examples.en: It is time to debate the issue of school funding.
examples.zh: 该是讨论一下学校经费问题的时候了。

examples.en: They debated endlessly, without ever reaching a decision.
examples.zh: 他们没完没了地辩论，一直未能作出决定。

examples.en: The question of the origin of the universe is still hotly debated (= strongly argued about) by scientists.
examples.zh: 关于宇宙起源问题，科学家仍在激烈辩论。

examples.en: to be openly/widely/publicly debated
examples.zh: 受到公开／广泛讨论

examples.en: The committee will debate whether to lower the age of club membership to 16.
examples.zh: 委员会将讨论是否把参加俱乐部的年龄限制放宽到 16 岁。

senses.def: to think carefully about something before making a decision

examples.en: She debated with herself for a while, and then picked up the phone.
examples.zh: 她仔细琢磨了一会儿，然后拿起了电话。

examples.en: We're debating whether or not to go skiing this winter.
examples.zh: 我们盘算着今年冬天是否去滑雪。

examples.en: For a moment he debated going after her.
examples.zh: 他仔细思考了片刻要不要去追求她。

synonyms.words: conversation ▪ dialogue ▪ talk ▪ debate ▪ consultation ▪ chat ▪ gossip

intro.en: These are all words for an occasion when people talk about something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示交谈、谈论。

items.def: a detailed conversation about something that is considered to be important:
items.zh: 指重要事情的讨论、谈论、商讨

examples.en: Discussions are still taking place between the two leaders.
examples.zh: 两位领导人仍在进行讨论。

items.def: a talk, usually a private or informal one, involving two people or a small group; the activity of talking in this way:
items.zh: 通常指私下的或非正式的交谈、谈话

examples.en: a telephone conversation
examples.zh: 电话交谈

items.def: conversations in a book, play or film:
items.zh: 指书、戏剧或电影中的对话、对白

examples.en: The novel has long descriptions and not much dialogue.
examples.zh: 这部小说描述多，对话少。

examples.en: The President told waiting reporters there had been a constructive dialogue.
examples.zh: 总统告诉等候的记者，刚才进行了一次富有建设性的对话。

items.def: a conversation or discussion, often one about a problem or something important for the people involved:
items.zh: 常指对有关人员就某个问题或重要的事情进行的交谈、谈话、讨论、商讨

examples.en: I had a long talk with my boss about my career prospects.
examples.zh: 我和老板就我的事业前景进行了一次长谈。

items.def: a formal discussion of an issue at a public meeting or in a parliament. In a debate two or more speakers express opposing views and then there is often a vote on the issue:
items.zh: 指公共集会上或议会里就某问题进行的、常以表决结束的辩论

examples.en: a debate on prison reform
examples.zh: 关于监狱制度改革的辩论

items.def: a formal discussion between groups of people before a decision is made about something:
items.zh: 指团体间在决策前进行的咨询、商讨、磋商

examples.en: There have been extensive consultations between the two countries.
examples.zh: 两国之间进行了广泛磋商。

items.def: a friendly informal conversation; informal talking. The countable use of chat is especially British English:
items.zh: chat 作可数名词尤用于英式英语

items.def: a conversation about other people and their private lives:
items.zh: 指关于他人及其私生活的闲谈、闲聊、说长道短

examples.en: We had a good gossip about the boss.
examples.zh: 我们讲了好一会儿老板的闲话。

intro.en: These words all mean to share news, information, ideas or feelings with another person or other people, especially by talking with them.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含交流、交谈之义。

items.def: to speak in order to give information, express feelings or share ideas:
items.zh: 指说话、讲话、谈话

examples.en: We talked on the phone for over an hour.
examples.zh: 我们在电话里谈了一个多小时。

items.def: (rather formal) to talk and share ideas on a subject or problem with other people, especially in order to decide something:
items.zh: 指谈论、讨论、商量

examples.en: Have you discussed the problem with anyone?
examples.zh: 你与谁商量过这个问题吗？

items.def: to talk to somebody about something; to have a conversation with somebody:
items.zh: 指谈话、交谈

examples.en: I’ve spoken to the manager about it.
examples.zh: 那件事我已经和经理谈过了。

items.def: (rather formal) to exchange information or ideas with somebody:
items.zh: 指与某人交流信息或意见

examples.en: We only communicate by email.
examples.zh: 我们只通过电子邮件进行交流。

items.def: to discuss something, especially formally, before making a decision or finding a solution:
items.zh: （尤指正式）讨论、辩论

examples.en: Politicians will be debating the bill later this week.
examples.zh: 政界将在本周晚些时候讨论这个议案。

items.def: (rather formal) to discuss something with somebody in order to get their permission for something, or to help you make a decision:
items.zh: 指（与某人）商议、商量（以得到许可或帮助决策）

examples.en: You shouldn’t have done it without consulting me.
examples.zh: 你不该不和我商量就做。

senses.def: a person who is involved in a formal debate
senses.zh: 参加讨论者；争论者；辩手

examples.en: He was one of the most accomplished debaters in the government.
examples.zh: 他是政府中最有成就的辩论家之一。

senses.def: a debauched
senses.zh: 道德败坏的；淫荡的；沉湎酒色的；嗜毒的

senses.def: behaviour involving too much sex, alcohol or drugs
senses.zh: 道德败坏；淫荡；沉湎酒色（或毒品）

examples.en: a life of debauchery
examples.zh: 放荡淫逸的生活。

senses.def: a first name for girls, short for Deborah
(1932-2016) a US actor, singer and dancer known for her energy and bright personality. Her films include Singin' in the Rain
senses.zh: 黛比·雷诺兹（Debbie Reynolds）：（1932-2016）是美国演员，歌手和舞蹈演员，她以精力充沛，个性鲜明而闻名。她的电影包括《雨中歌》，《塔米和单身汉》（1957年），《不沉的莫莉·布朗》（1964年）和《母亲》（1996年）。从1955年到1959年，她与歌手埃迪·费舍尔（Eddie Fisher）（1928-2010）结婚，他们的女儿是演员嘉莉·费舍尔（Carrie Fisher）（1956-2016）。

senses.def: any one of a chain of large shops in Britain with various departments selling mainly clothes and household goods. In 2018 Debenhams announced large financial losses and said that it planned to close up to 50 stores.
senses.zh: 英国大型连锁店中的任何一家，其各个部门主要销售服装和日用品。2018年，Debenhams宣布巨额财务损失，并表示计划关闭多达50家商店。

senses.def: an arrangement to invest money in a company in return for a fixed rate of interest. The money is secured against property owned by the company.

examples.en: Payment of interest is made to the debenture holder at a specified rate and at clearly defined intervals.
examples.zh: 利息按照规定的利率和明确规定的时间间隔支付给债券持有人。

senses.def: an unsecured
to make somebody’s body or mind weaker
senses.zh: 使身心衰弱；使衰竭；使虚弱

examples.en: The troops were severely debilitated by hunger and disease.
examples.zh: 军队因饥饿和疾病而严重虚弱。

senses.def: to make a country, an organization, etc. weaker
senses.zh: 削弱（国家、机构等）的力量；使软弱无力

examples.en: Prolonged strike action debilitated the industry.
examples.zh: 长时间的罢工削弱了这个行业的活力。

senses.def: physical weakness, especially as a result of illness
senses.zh: （尤指疾病引起的）体弱，虚弱，衰弱

examples.en: chronic muscle debility
examples.zh: 慢性肌肉无力

senses.def: a written note in a bank account or other financial record of a sum of money owed or spent

examples.en: on the debit side of an account
examples.zh: 账户的借方

examples.en: On the debit side (= a negative result will be that) the new shopping centre will increase traffic problems.
examples.zh: 负面影响是新购物中心会使交通问题加剧。

senses.def: a sum of money taken from a bank account

examples.en: The total debits on the account were £2 000 last month.
examples.zh: 上月账户中的借方总额为 2 000 英镑。

senses.def: when a bank debits
senses.zh: （从银行账户）扣除；记入（账户）的借方；借记

examples.en: The money will be debited from your account each month.
examples.zh: 这笔钱将逐月从你的账户中扣除。

examples.en: The bank will debit your account with any withdrawals made using your payment card.
examples.zh: 银行将把你用支付卡取的所有款项从你的账户中扣除。

examples.en: Your current account is automatically debited with the amount of your purchase.
examples.zh: 你购物的金额会自动记入活期存款账户的借方。

senses.def: a plastic card that can be used to take money directly from your bank account when you pay for something
fashionable and confident
a first name for girls
