to fall to the ground
a game in which players try to throw rings of rope over wooden sticks, especially on a cruise
a flat shoe made of strong cloth or soft leather, with a soft sole
senses.zh: 平底帆布鞋，平底软皮鞋（鞋底防滑）

senses.def: a game in which players throw a ring of rope or rubber backwards and forwards over a net especially on a cruise
a folding chair with a seat made from a long piece of material on a wooden or metal frame, used for example on a beach
a worker on a ship who does work that does not need special skills
a small shelter on the deck
to say something loudly; to speak loudly and with force about something you feel strongly about, especially in public
senses.zh: （尤指在公众前）慷慨激昂地宣讲，慷慨陈词

examples.en: She declaimed the famous opening speech of the play.
examples.zh: 她慷慨激昂地朗诵了这出戏中著名的开场白。

examples.en: He declaimed against the evils of alcohol.
examples.zh: 他慷慨陈词，猛烈抨击酗酒的危害。

examples.en: She stood up and loudly declaimed that prizes are not important.
examples.zh: 她站起来大声宣称奖品并不重要。

examples.en: ‘All the world's a stage,’ he declaimed.
examples.zh: “全世界都是一个舞台，”他大声说道。

senses.def: the act of speaking or of expressing something to an audience in a formal way
a speech or piece of writing that strongly expresses feelings and opinions

examples.en: The most successful newspaper stories are often declamations of patriotism.
examples.zh: 最成功的报纸故事往往是爱国主义的宣言。

senses.def: expressing feelings or opinions in a strong way in a speech or a piece of writing
a first name for boys
an official or formal statement, especially about the plans of a government or an organization; the act of making such a statement

examples.en: to issue/sign a declaration
examples.zh: 发布／签署公告

examples.en: the declaration of war
examples.zh: 宣战

examples.en: the Declaration of Independence (= of the United States)
examples.zh: （美国）独立宣言

examples.en: The declaration asked governments to consider introducing new environmental taxes.
examples.zh: 该宣言要求各国政府考虑征收新的环境税。

senses.def: a written or spoken statement, especially about what people feel or believe

examples.en: a declaration of love/faith/guilt
examples.zh: 表白爱情；表达信念；宣判有罪

examples.en: She had been waiting for him to make a declaration of love.
examples.zh: 她一直在等待他的爱的宣言。

examples.en: The Russian leader received a ringing declaration of support yesterday.
examples.zh: 俄罗斯领导人昨天收到了给予强有力支持的声明。

senses.def: an official written statement giving information

examples.en: a declaration of income
examples.zh: 收益申报表

examples.en: customs declarations (= giving details of goods that have been brought into a country)
examples.zh: 报关单（带入境内物品的详细清单）

examples.en: The company will only provide insurance if the information on the proposal form and declaration is correct and complete.
examples.zh: 只有在投保表和声明中的信息正确且完整的情况下，公司才会提供保险。

examples.en: We were asked to sign a declaration to the effect that we were UK citizens.
examples.zh: 我们被要求签署一份声明，大意是说我们是英国公民。

examples.en: False declaration of hours worked may lead to dismissal.
examples.zh: 虚假申报工作时间可能会导致解雇。

senses.def: an official announcement of the number of votes each candidate has received in an election

examples.en: The declaration of the poll will take place tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 将于明日上午公布投票结果。

senses.def: the act of ending an innings
senses.zh: （一方认为已达足够分数获胜而在该局结束前的）宣布结束赛局，宣布停止击球

examples.en: After England's declaration at 379 for 6, they overwhelmed their hapless opponents.
examples.zh: 英格兰队在比分 379/6 时宣布结束赛局，随后他们彻底击败了倒霉的对手。

intro.en: These are all words for something that you say or write, especially something that gives information or an opinion.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指口头或书面的说明、宣布。

items.def: something that you say or write that gives information or an opinion, often in a formal way:
items.zh: 通常指正式的说明、声明、陈述、报告

examples.en: A government spokesperson made a statement to the press.
examples.zh: 政府发言人向新闻界发表了一份声明。

items.def: something that you say or write that gives an opinion on something or is a response to a question about a particular situation:
items.zh: 指议论、评论、意见

examples.en: She made helpful comments on my work.
examples.zh: 她对我的工作提出了有益的意见。

items.def: a spoken or written statement that informs people about something:
items.zh: 指公告、布告、通告

examples.en: the announcement of a peace agreement
examples.zh: 和平协议公告

items.def: something that you say or write that gives an opinion or thought about somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指谈论、言论、评述

examples.en: He made a number of rude remarks about the food.
examples.zh: 他对这食物作了许多无礼的评论。

items.def: (rather formal) an official or formal statement, especially one that states an intention, belief or feeling, or that gives information:
items.zh: 指官方或正式的公告、宣告、宣言、声明

examples.en: the declaration of war
examples.zh: 宣战

items.def: (rather formal) a comment, especially one based on something you have seen, heard or read:
items.zh: 尤指根据所见、所闻、所读而作的评论

examples.en: He began by making a few general observations about the report.
examples.zh: 开头他先对这个报告作了几点概括性的评论。

senses.def: in the form of a simple statement
to say something officially or publicly

examples.en: The government has declared a state of emergency.
examples.zh: 政府已宣布进入紧急状态。

examples.en: Germany declared war on France on 1 August 1914.
examples.zh: 德国在 1914 年 8 月 1 日向法国宣战。

examples.en: The government has declared war on (= officially stated its intention to stop) illiteracy.
examples.zh: 政府已宣布要扫除文盲。

examples.en: He will probably have to declare bankruptcy.
examples.zh: 他可能不得不宣布破产。

examples.en: Neither side was able to declare victory.
examples.zh: 双方都未能宣布胜利。

examples.en: She declared her intention of running for the presidency.
examples.zh: 她宣布了竞选总统的意图。

examples.en: to declare your interest/candidacy
examples.zh: 声明您的兴趣/候选资格

examples.en: The court declared that strike action was illegal.
examples.zh: 法庭宣判罢工为非法。

examples.en: In the end, they were declared winners of the tournament.
examples.zh: 最终，他们被宣布为比赛的获胜者。

examples.en: The area has been declared a national park.
examples.zh: 这地区已宣布为国家公园。

examples.en: The painting was declared to be a forgery.
examples.zh: 这幅画被判定为赝品。

examples.en: Excess weight has been declared as one of the top ten health risks in the world.
examples.zh: 超重已被宣布为世界十大健康风险之一。

examples.en: I declare this bridge open.
examples.zh: 我宣布这座大桥正式启用。

examples.en: A doctor had declared him unfit to travel.
examples.zh: 医生宣布他不适合旅行。

examples.en: Kenya was officially declared independent on December 12, 1963.
examples.zh: 肯尼亚于 1963 年 12 月 12 日正式宣布独立。

examples.en: The contract was declared void.
examples.zh: 这份合同被宣布无效。

senses.def: to state something clearly and definitely

examples.en: ‘I'll do it!’ Tom declared.
examples.zh: “让我来！”汤姆果断地说。

examples.en: He declared that he was in love with her.
examples.zh: 他声称他已爱上她。

examples.en: Few people dared to declare their opposition to the regime.
examples.zh: 很少有人敢宣称他们反对这个政权。

examples.en: She declared herself extremely hurt by his lack of support.
examples.zh: 她说自己非常伤心，因为没有得到他的支持。

senses.def: to say clearly and openly who you are or what you intend to do

examples.en: He was the first gay player in a professional sports team to declare himself openly.
examples.zh: 他是职业运动队中第一位公开宣布自己身份的同性恋球员。

examples.en: Only two candidates have declared themselves so far.
examples.zh: 到目前为止，只有两位候选人做了竞选宣言。

examples.en: Freemasons were required by law to declare themselves to the authorities.
examples.zh: 法律要求共济会会员必须向当局申报自己的身份。

senses.def: to tell the tax authorities how much money you have earned

examples.en: All income must be declared.
examples.zh: 所有收益必须申报。

senses.def: to tell customs

examples.en: Do you have anything to declare?
examples.zh: 你有什么要申报的吗？

senses.def: to decide to end your innings
senses.zh: （在击球员还未全部出局时）宣布结束赛局，宣布停止击球

examples.en: England declared at 224 for 4 (= 4 batters had scored 224 runs).
examples.zh: 英格兰队在 4 名击球手得 224 分后宣布结束赛局。

intro.en: These words all mean to say something, usually clearly and definitely and often in public.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含表明、宣称、宣布之义。

items.def: (rather formal) to say something officially or publicly; to state something clearly and definitely:
items.zh: 指公布、宣布、表明、宣称

examples.en: to declare war
examples.zh: 宣战

items.def: (rather formal) to formally write or say something, especially in a careful and clear way:
items.zh: 指陈述、说明、声明

examples.en: He has already stated his intention to run for election.
examples.zh: 他已声明打算参加竞选。

items.def: (rather formal) to state something, sometimes in a way that is slightly indirect:
items.zh: 指表明、暗示

examples.en: During our meeting, he indicated his willingness to cooperate.
examples.zh: 在我们会晤期间，他提及了合作的意愿。

items.def: to tell people officially about a decision or plans; to give information about something in a public place, especially through a loudspeaker; to say something in a loud and/​or serious way:
items.zh: 指宣布、宣告、（通过广播）通知

examples.en: They haven’t formally announced their engagement yet.
examples.zh: 他们还没有正式宣布订婚。

senses.def: to say publicly that you do not support somebody/something
to say publicly that you support somebody/something
the act of officially stating that secret government information is no longer secret
to state officially that secret government information is no longer secret

examples.en: declassified information/documents
examples.zh: 已解密的情报／文件

senses.def: to change something to a lower classification (

examples.en: a proposal to declassify marijuana
examples.zh: 大麻解密提案

examples.en: Wildlife experts will decide next month whether to declassify the bird as a threatened species.
examples.zh: 野生动物专家将于下个月决定是否将这种鸟列为受威胁物种。

senses.def: a set of nouns, adjectives or pronouns that change in the same way to show case
senses.zh: （名词、形容词或代词显示格、数、性的）变格

senses.def: the way in which some sets of nouns, adjectives and pronouns change their form or endings to show case
senses.zh: （名词、形容词和代词显示格、数、性的）词形变化

senses.def: to become smaller, fewer, weaker, etc.

examples.en: Support for the party continues to decline.
examples.zh: 对该党的支持继续下降。

examples.en: Sales of whole milk declined by 4 per cent.
examples.zh: 全脂牛奶的销量下降了 4%。

examples.en: The city declined in importance in the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 在 19 世纪，这座城市的重要性下降了。

examples.en: to decline in popularity/value/number
examples.zh: 受欢迎程度/价值/数量下降

examples.en: Jobs in manufacturing have steadily declined.
examples.zh: 制造业的就业岗位已经逐步减少。

examples.en: to decline sharply/significantly/dramatically
examples.zh: 急剧／显著／大幅下降

examples.en: to decline rapidly/markedly/substantially
examples.zh: 迅速/显着/大幅下降

examples.en: Her health began to decline.
examples.zh: 她的健康状况开始下降。

senses.def: to refuse politely to accept or to do something

examples.en: I offered to give them a lift but they declined.
examples.zh: 我主动提议开车送他们，但他们婉言谢绝了。

examples.en: to decline an offer/invitation
examples.zh: 谢绝对方的主动帮助／邀请

examples.en: We politely declined her invitation.
examples.zh: 我们婉言谢绝了她的邀请。

examples.en: She declined a second cup of coffee and called for a taxi.
examples.zh: 她拒绝了第二杯咖啡，并叫了一辆出租车。

examples.en: Their spokesman declined to comment on the allegations.
examples.zh: 他们的发言人拒绝对这些指控加以评论。

senses.def: if a noun, an adjective or a pronoun declines
senses.zh: （名词、形容词或代词）变格，有词形变化；列出词形变化

senses.def: a continuous decrease in the number, value, quality, etc. of something
senses.zh: （数量、价值、质量等的）减少，下降，衰落，衰退

examples.en: There has been a 5 per cent decline in student numbers.
examples.zh: 学生人数下降了 5%。

examples.en: the decline of seabird populations
examples.zh: 海鸟数量的减少

examples.en: a sharp/steep/rapid decline
examples.zh: 急剧的下降

examples.en: a steady/gradual decline
examples.zh: 稳步的／逐渐的下降

examples.en: They have experienced decades of economic decline.
examples.zh: 他们经历了几十年的经济衰退。

examples.en: Industry in Britain has been in decline since the 1970s.
examples.zh: 英国工业自 20 世纪 70 年代以来一直在走下坡路。

examples.en: Many of the city's magnificent buildings fell into decline.
examples.zh: 这座城市的许多宏伟建筑都陷入了衰败。

senses.def: the first novel by the English writer Evelyn Waugh
senses.zh: 衰落与衰落：英国作家伊芙琳·沃（Evelyn Waugh）的第一本小说。它写于1928年，讲述的是一个安静的年轻人的漫画困扰，他不得不离开牛津大学，并在一所非常糟糕的公立学校找到了工作。他的一位学生的有钱母亲将他带入了社交圈，他被判入狱，然后才最终回到牛津大学学习宗教。这部小说获得了立竿见影的成功，奠定了沃恩作为讽刺作家的职业生涯。

senses.def: to remove things that you do not use so that you have more space and can easily find things when you need them

examples.en: Moving is a good opportunity to declutter.
examples.zh: 搬家是清理无用杂物的好时机。

examples.en: a 7-step plan to help you declutter your home
examples.zh: 帮你把家清理干净的 7 步骤计划

examples.en: Declutter one room at a time.
examples.zh: 一次整理一个房间。

examples.en: She helps people declutter their schedules, houses, and minds.
examples.zh: 她帮助人们整理他们的日程、房屋和思想。

senses.def: a concentrated liquid produced by boiling a substance, usually part of a plant to be used as medicine
senses.zh: 汤剂，煎剂（把药材加水煎煮得到的药汁）

examples.en: decoctions made from bark and roots
examples.zh: 用树皮和植物的根煎煮而成的汤剂

examples.en: a decoction of blackberry leaves
examples.zh: 黑莓叶煎剂

senses.def: a method of producing concentrated liquids to use as medicines by boiling parts of plants
senses.zh: 煎煮，熬煮（把药材加水煎煮得到药汁）

examples.en: The healers mainly use decoction to prepare remedies.
examples.zh: 治疗师主要使用煎煮药材的方式来调配药方。

senses.def: to convert something written in code into normal language

examples.en: I was involved in decoding enemy documents.
examples.zh: 我参与了敌方文件的破译工作。

senses.def: to find the meaning of something that is difficult to understand
senses.zh: 费力地解读；艰难地理解

examples.en: I struggled to decode all the jargon they used.
examples.zh: 我很难解读他们使用的所有行话。

senses.def: to receive an electronic signal and change it into a different form, for example pictures that can be shown on a television screen

examples.en: decoding equipment
examples.zh: 电子信号译码设备

senses.def: to understand the meaning of something in a foreign language
a device that changes an electronic signal into a form that people can understand, such as sound and pictures

examples.en: a satellite/video decoder
examples.zh: 卫星／视频解码器

examples.en: A decoder is required for certain television programmes.
examples.zh: 某些电视节目需要解码器。

senses.def: the top edge of a dress, etc. that is designed to be very low in order to show the shoulders and the top part of the breasts
with a very low top that shows a woman's shoulders and the top part of her breasts
senses.zh: 上装非常低，显示出女人的肩膀和乳房的顶部

senses.def: the process of a colony
to allow a colony
senses.zh: 非殖民化，去殖民地化；去除…中的殖民主义影响

examples.en: The conflict dates back to the time the continent was decolonized.
examples.zh: 冲突可追溯到这片大陆去殖民地化的时期。

examples.en: It seemed that Britain had decolonized almost entirely in a mere quarter of a century.
examples.zh: 英国似乎在短短四分之一世纪内就基本完成了非殖民化。

senses.def: to free an institution or area of activity from the cultural and social effects of colonization
senses.zh: 去除…中的殖民主义影响

examples.en: Some students and staff believe there is an urgent need to decolonize the curriculum, for example by studying more works by writers of colour.
examples.zh: 一些师生员工认为亟需去除该课程的殖民主义色彩，比如应研读更多非白人作家的作品。

senses.def: to officially stop using weapons or military equipment
senses.zh: 正式停止使用（武器、军事设施等）；使退役

senses.def: to stop using a nuclear power station and take it apart safely
to be destroyed gradually after death by natural processes

examples.en: a decomposing corpse
examples.zh: 正在腐烂的尸体

examples.en: The garden was dank with decomposing vegetation.
examples.zh: 花园因腐烂的植被而潮湿。

examples.en: a decomposed body
examples.zh: 已经腐烂了的尸体

senses.def: to break down something into smaller and simpler parts; to break a substance down into smaller and simpler parts

examples.en: Water decomposes into oxygen and hydrogen.
examples.zh: 水分解成氧气和氢气。

examples.en: As the waste materials decompose, they produce methane gas.
examples.zh: 废物腐烂时会产生沼气。

senses.def: the process of being destroyed gradually after death by natural processes

examples.en: the decomposition of organic waste
examples.zh: 有机废物的分解

senses.def: the process in which one substance is broken down into two or more simpler substances
to have the air pressure in something reduced to a normal level or to reduce it to its normal level
to return files, etc. to their original size after they have been compressed
senses.zh: 解压缩（将压缩文件等恢复到原大小）

senses.def: to calm down and relax

examples.en: Whenever I can I like to sneak away to relax and decompress.
examples.zh: 只要有可能，我就喜欢偷偷溜走去放松和减压。

examples.en: For some people, yoga is a way of decompressing after a long day.
examples.zh: 对于某些人来说，瑜伽是漫长一天后减压的一种方式。

senses.def: a reduction in air pressure; the act of reducing the pressure of the air

examples.en: decompression of the aircraft cabin
examples.zh: 机舱减压

senses.def: a reduction in air pressure on a person who has experienced high pressure while diving

examples.en: Itching and rashes often occur following decompression.
examples.zh: 减压后经常出现瘙痒和皮疹。

senses.def: the process of expanding computer data to its normal size so that it can be read by a computer

examples.en: The computers have built-in video decompression capabilities.
examples.zh: 计算机具有内置视频解压缩功能。

senses.def: a piece of equipment that divers
senses.zh: 减压舱（潜水员深海作业后待在其中逐渐减压）

examples.en: Divers transfer from the water to a decompression chamber.
examples.zh: 潜水员出水后转移至减压舱。

senses.def: severe pain and difficulty in breathing experienced by divers
senses.zh: 减压病（深潜者过快回到水面后感到的剧烈疼痛和呼吸困难）

examples.en: Symptoms of decompression sickness include visual disturbances and severe headaches.
examples.zh: 减压病的症状包括视力障碍和剧烈头痛。

senses.def: a device for reducing pressure in a vehicle’s engine
senses.zh: （机动车发动机的）减压装置，减压器

senses.def: a computer program that returns files, etc. to their original size after they have been compressed
to make a place less full of people or traffic
senses.zh: 缓解…的拥堵状况；减轻交通堵塞

examples.en: The new driving restrictions are being introduced in a bid to decongest the city.
examples.zh: 开始实施新的驾驶限制措施，以缓解城市交通拥堵。

senses.def: to make a part of somebody's body less blocked with blood or mucus

examples.en: The medicine will decongest your nose and soothe your throat at the same time.
examples.zh: 这种药可以同时缓解鼻塞和喉咙痛。

senses.def: a medicine that helps somebody with a cold to breathe more easily by unblocking

examples.en: a nasal decongestant
examples.zh: 鼻塞通药

senses.def: the action of making a place less full of traffic or people

examples.en: Decongestion of the city centre is high on the council's list of priorities.
examples.zh: 疏解市中心的交通拥堵是市政会亟待解决的事。

senses.def: the action of making a part of somebody's body less blocked with mucus

examples.en: Eucalyptus oil can help with nasal decongestion.
examples.zh: 桉树油有助于疏通鼻塞。

senses.def: to officially stop using a building for religious purposes
senses.zh: 停止把（建筑物等）用于宗教目的；把…改作俗用

examples.en: a deconsecrated church
examples.zh: 改作俗用的教堂

senses.def: the act of officially ending the use of a building for religious purposes
senses.zh: 停止把（建筑物等）用于宗教目的；把…改作俗用

senses.def: to analyse a text in order to show that there is no fixed meaning within the text but that the meaning is created each time in the act of reading
senses.zh: 解构（文本没有固定意义，只有在阅读中才获得意义）

senses.def: to separate something into the parts from which it is made up and put them together again in a different way

examples.en: Picasso deconstructed his subjects into cubes and colours.
examples.zh: 毕加索将他的表现对象拆解重组为一个个小方块和不同的颜色。

senses.def: a theory that states that it is impossible for a text to have one fixed meaning, and emphasizes the role of the reader in the production of meaning
senses.zh: 解构理论（文本不可能只有一个固定含义，强调读者在意义发生过程中的作用）

senses.def: an expert in or supporter of the theory of deconstruction

examples.en: He became world champion in 2007 by default.
examples.zh: 他在2007年因对手缺席而成为世界冠军。

senses.def: if something happens by default
senses.zh: 由于没有特别作出决定（或选择）

examples.en: I became a teacher by default rather than by design.
examples.zh: 我最初没有选择教师这个职业，但后来机缘巧合地成为了一名教师。

senses.def: because of a lack of something

examples.en: They accepted what he had said in default of any evidence to disprove it.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏相反的证据，他们相信了他的话。

senses.def: to fail to do something that you legally have to do, especially by not paying a debt
senses.zh: 违约，不履行义务（尤指不偿还债务）

examples.en: to default on a loan/debt
examples.zh: 拖欠借款／债务

examples.en: defaulting borrowers/tenants
examples.zh: 不偿还债务的借款人；拖欠租金的承租人

senses.def: to happen when you do not make any other choice or change

examples.en: The program defaults to the standard style each time you open it.
examples.zh: 每次打开程序时，程序默认为标准样式。

senses.def: a game or competition can be won by default

senses.zh: 由于没有特别作出决定（或选择）

examples.en: I became a teacher by default rather than by design.
examples.zh: 我最初没有选择教师这个职业，但后来机缘巧合地成为了一名教师。

examples.zh: 由于缺乏相反的证据，他们相信了他的话。

senses.def: a person or an organization that fails to do something they legally have to do, especially by not paying a debt
senses.zh: 违约，不履行义务（尤指不偿还债务）

examples.en: mortgage/fine defaulters
examples.zh: 抵押贷款/罚款违约者

senses.def: to win against somebody in a war, competition, sports game, etc.

examples.en: He defeated the champion in three sets.
examples.zh: 他三盘击败了冠军。

examples.en: to defeat a rival/an opponent
examples.zh: 击败对手

examples.en: The goal is to defeat the enemy by whatever means possible.
examples.zh: 目标是用一切可能的手段打败敌人。

examples.en: a defeated army
examples.zh: 败军

examples.en: Garibaldi defeated the Neapolitan army.
examples.zh: 加里波第击败了那不勒斯军队。

examples.en: The government was defeated by 200 votes to 83.
examples.zh: 政府以 83 票对 200 票遭到了挫败。

examples.en: Davis defeated Morris by eight points in the semi-final.
examples.zh: 戴维斯在半决赛中以八分优势击败莫里斯。

examples.en: Our team was narrowly defeated in the final.
examples.zh: 我们队在决赛中以微弱差距惜败。

examples.en: It was said that he could not be defeated in battle.
examples.zh: 据说他在战斗中是无法被击败的。

senses.def: to stop something from being successful

examples.en: They are united in their determination to defeat global terrorism.
examples.zh: 他们团结一致，决心战胜全球恐怖主义。

examples.en: The proposed bill was decisively defeated in Parliament.
examples.zh: 提案在议会中遭断然否决。

examples.en: The motion was defeated by 19 votes.
examples.zh: 这项动议以差额 19 票被否决。

examples.en: Writing down your password so you remember it defeats the purpose of having a password.
examples.zh: 写下密码以便记住，这违背了拥有密码的本意。

examples.en: Staying late at the office to discuss shorter working hours rather defeats the object of the exercise!
examples.zh: 迟迟待在办公室讨论缩短工作时间恰恰是在阻挠这一目标的实现！

senses.def: if something defeats

examples.en: The instruction manual completely defeated me.
examples.zh: 这操作指南把我完全弄糊涂了。

examples.en: Question 6 defeated us.
examples.zh: 第6题难住了我们。

senses.def: failure to win or to be successful

examples.en: The party faces defeat in the election.
examples.zh: 这个党面临选举失败。

examples.en: They suffered a narrow defeat in the final.
examples.zh: 他们在决赛中以微弱差距惜败。

examples.en: a heavy/humiliating/crushing defeat
examples.zh: 大败；耻辱的失败；惨败

examples.en: The world champion has only had two defeats in 20 fights.
examples.zh: 这个世界冠军在 20 场比赛中只败过两场。

examples.en: They finally had to admit defeat (= stop trying to be successful).
examples.zh: 他们最后只得认输。

examples.en: to concede/accept defeat
examples.zh: 承认/接受失败

examples.en: their defeat by the Brazilians
examples.zh: 他们败给了巴西

examples.en: last week's defeat against Manchester United
examples.zh: 上周输给曼联

examples.en: a punishing defeat at the hands of Iceland in the World Cup
examples.zh: 在世界杯上惨败给冰岛队

examples.en: He was gracious in defeat, acknowledging his opponent's greater skill.
examples.zh: 他虽然失败但不失风度，承认对手的技术更胜一筹。

examples.en: a series of small victories and defeats
examples.zh: 一系列的小胜利和小失败

senses.def: the act of winning a victory over somebody/something

examples.en: The army inflicted a heavy defeat on rebel forces.
examples.zh: 军队重挫叛军。

examples.en: the defeat of fascism
examples.zh: 战胜法西斯主义

senses.def: to win something even though it seemed up until the last moment that you would lose

note.en: The idiom is often reversed for humorous effect to show that a person or team were expected to win, but then lost at the last moment, snatching defeat from the jaws of victory.
note.zh: 这个习语常反用以表示幽默：snatch defeat from the jaws of victory，指原本胜算很大，但在最后一刻落败。

items.idm: snatch victory from the jaws of defeat

senses.def: to win something even though it seemed up until the last moment that you would lose
the attitude of expecting not to succeed, and showing it in a particular situation

examples.en: Stories about job losses should not lead to passive defeatism.
examples.zh: 有关失业的故事不应导致消极的失败主义。

senses.def: a person who expects not to succeed

examples.en: He is a pessimist and a defeatist.
examples.zh: 他是悲观主义者，也是失败主义者。

senses.def: expecting not to succeed, and showing it in a particular situation

examples.en: a defeatist attitude/view
examples.zh: 失败主义的态度／观点

senses.def: to get rid of solid waste from your body through your bowels
the act of getting rid of solid waste from your body through your bowels
a fault in something or in the way it has been made that means that it is not perfect

examples.en: a defect in the glass
examples.zh: 玻璃杯的缺陷

senses.def: a physical problem with part of somebody’s body or the way that it works

examples.en: a speech defect
examples.zh: 言语缺陷

senses.def: to leave a political party, country, etc. to join another that is considered to be an enemy

examples.en: A number of writers and musicians defected from the Soviet Union to the West in the 1960s.
examples.zh: 20 世纪 60 年代，许多作家和音乐家从苏联叛逃到西方。

examples.en: She defected from the party just days before the election.
examples.zh: 就在选举前几天，她从该党叛逃。

senses.def: the act of leaving a political party, country, etc. to join another that is considered to be an enemy

examples.en: There have been several defections from the ruling party.
examples.zh: 执政党有几名党员倒戈。

senses.def: having a fault or faults; not perfect or complete
senses.zh: 有缺点的；有缺陷的；有毛病的

examples.en: If the goods are defective you should get a full refund.
examples.zh: 如果货物有缺陷，您应该获得全额退款。

senses.def: having a physical problem with part of the body or the way that it works
senses.zh: 生理缺陷的;生理障碍的

examples.en: Her hearing was found to be slightly defective.
examples.zh: 经检查，她的听力有点缺陷。

senses.def: in a way that shows a fault or faults, or that something is not perfect or complete
senses.zh: 有缺点的；有缺陷的；有毛病的

senses.def: the condition of having a fault or faults; the condition of not being perfect or complete
senses.zh: 有缺点的；有缺陷的；有毛病的

senses.def: a person who leaves a political party, country, etc. to join another that is considered to be an enemy

examples.en: a Soviet defector to Canada in 1946
examples.zh: 1946 年，一名苏联叛逃者前往加拿大

senses.def: the act of protecting somebody/something from attack, criticism, etc.

examples.en: soldiers who died in defence of their country
examples.zh: 为保卫祖国而献身的战士

examples.en: What points can be raised in defence of this argument?
examples.zh: 有什么论点能提出来为这个说法辩护呢？

examples.en: I have to say in her defence that she knew nothing about it beforehand.
examples.zh: 我得为她说句话，她事先并不知道此事。

examples.en: When her brother was criticized she leapt to his defence.
examples.zh: 她的哥哥受到批评时，她马上跳出来卫护。

examples.en: to spring/jump/rush to the defence of somebody/something
examples.zh: 跳/跳/冲去保卫某人/某物

senses.def: something that provides protection against attack from enemies, the weather, illness, etc.

examples.en: They are responsible for maintaining coastal flood defences.
examples.zh: 他们负责维护海岸防洪。

examples.en: At this point the country had no effective air defences.
examples.zh: 在这个阶段该国没有有效的防空系统。

examples.en: The town walls were built as a defence against enemy attacks.
examples.zh: 城墙是为防御敌人袭击而修建的。

examples.en: a new missile defence system (= for defence against missiles)
examples.zh: 新的导弹防御系统

senses.def: the organization of the people and systems that are used by a government to protect a country from attack

examples.en: the Ministry of Defence
examples.zh: 国防部

examples.en: the Department of Defense
examples.zh: 国防部

examples.en: Issues of national defence are a matter for the government.
examples.zh: 国防问题是政府的事。

examples.en: Further cuts in defence spending are being considered.
examples.zh: 目前正在考虑进一步削减国防开支。

senses.def: something that is said or written in order to support something

examples.en: a defence of Marxism
examples.zh: 为马克思主义辩解

senses.def: what is said in court to prove that a person did not commit a crime; the act of presenting this argument in court

examples.en: Her defence was that she was somewhere completely different at the time of the crime.
examples.zh: 她的辩词是案发时她根本就不在现场。

examples.en: He wanted to conduct his own defence.
examples.zh: 他想自己为自己辩护。

examples.en: The judge rejected her insanity defence.
examples.zh: 法官驳回了她的精神病辩护。

senses.def: the lawyer or lawyers whose job is to prove in court that a person did not commit a crime

examples.en: The defence is/are requesting more time to prepare its/their case.
examples.zh: 辩方正在请求更多时间准备其案件。

examples.en: the defence lawyer/counsel
examples.zh: 辩护律师

examples.en: the defense attorney
examples.zh: 辩护律师

examples.en: a witness for the defence
examples.zh: 辩方证人

senses.def: the players who must prevent the other team from scoring; the position of these players on the sports field

examples.en: Welford cut through the defence to score the winning goal.
examples.zh: 韦尔福特突破防守射进了制胜的一球。

examples.en: She plays in defence.
examples.zh: 她打防守。

examples.en: She plays on defense.
examples.zh: 她打防守。

senses.def: a contest, game, etc. in which the previous winner or winners compete in order to try to win again

examples.en: Barcelona’s defence of the Champions League title
examples.zh: 巴塞罗那队的欧洲冠军联赛卫冕赛

senses.def: to try to stop your opponent from scoring

examples.en: What they need is someone who can both score and play defense.
examples.zh: 他们需要的是一个既能得分又能防守的人。

senses.def: to respond to what others do in order to protect what you already have rather than try to gain more

examples.en: If you believe there will be shocks to the market, wouldn't you want a manager who can play defense?
examples.zh: 如果你相信市场会出现震荡，你难道不想要一个能防守的主教练吗？

senses.def: to try to stop your opponent from scoring

examples.en: What they need is someone who can both score and play defense.
examples.zh: 他们需要的是一个既能得分又能防守的人。

senses.def: to respond to what others do in order to protect what you already have rather than try to gain more

examples.en: If you believe there will be shocks to the market, wouldn't you want a manager who can play defense?
examples.zh: 如果你相信市场会出现震荡，你难道不想要一个能防守的主教练吗？

senses.def: a reaction by a living thing against attacks by enemies or diseases
senses.zh: （生物体应对外来侵略的）防御机制，防卫机制

examples.en: The immune system is the body's major defence mechanism.
examples.zh: 免疫系统是人体主要的防御机制。

examples.en: The body has natural defence mechanisms to protect it from disease.
examples.zh: 人体对疾病具有先天性防御机制。

examples.en: Plants have complex defence mechanisms, both chemical and electrical.
examples.zh: 植物有着复杂的防御机制，通过化学信号和电信号触发反应。

senses.def: a way in which somebody behaves without thinking about it to protect themselves from unpleasant feelings or situations
senses.zh: （心理）防御机制（面对负面情绪和不利处境时为保护自己所采取的无意识反应）

examples.en: He uses humour as a defence mechanism.
examples.zh: 他将幽默作为一种心理防御机制。

examples.en: Buying expensive things despite poverty is often a defence mechanism.
examples.zh: 就算没有钱也要买奢侈品常常是心理防御机制在起作用。

senses.def: weak; not able to protect yourself; having no protection
senses.zh: 软弱的；不能自卫的；无防御的

examples.en: defenceless children
examples.zh: 没有自卫能力的儿童

examples.en: The village is defenceless against attack.
examples.zh: 这个村庄毫无防御能力。

senses.def: the fact of being weak and unable to protect yourself; the fact of having no protection
senses.zh: 软弱的；不能自卫的；无防御的

senses.def: a player who must prevent the other team from scoring

examples.en: Two of the team's regular defencemen are out injured.
examples.zh: 该队的两名常规防守球员因伤未上场。

senses.def: to protect somebody/something from attack

examples.en: The role of the military is to defend the country.
examples.zh: 军队的职能是保卫国家。

examples.en: Troops have been sent to defend the borders.
examples.zh: 已派出部队去守卫边疆。

examples.en: The male birds defend their territory against other males.
examples.zh: 雄鸟保卫自己的领地不被其他雄鸟侵入。

examples.en: The cannons once defended the city from attack by sea.
examples.zh: 大炮曾经保护这座城市免受来自海上的攻击。

examples.en: All our officers are trained to defend themselves against knife attacks.
examples.zh: 我们所有的警察都接受过自卫训练，能够对付持刀袭击。

examples.en: It is impossible to defend against an all-out attack.
examples.zh: 防御全面进攻是不可能的。

senses.def: to protect something that you value and prevent it from being taken away

examples.en: The organization works to defend human rights wherever they are threatened.
examples.zh: 该组织致力在任何人权受到威胁的地方捍卫人权。

examples.en: Freedom must always be defended.
examples.zh: 任何时候都必须捍卫自由。

examples.en: The ruling class will always defend its own interests.
examples.zh: 统治阶级将始终捍卫自己的利益。

examples.en: People must be vigilant in defending civil liberties regardless of external threats.
examples.zh: 无论外部威胁如何，人们都必须保持警惕，捍卫公民自由。

senses.def: to say or write something in support of somebody/something that has been criticized

examples.en: They defended their decision to pull out of the event.
examples.zh: 他们为退出这项活动的决定进行了辩解。

examples.en: The minister vigorously defended the policy.
examples.zh: 部长大力捍卫该政策。

examples.en: How can you defend such behaviour?
examples.zh: 你怎能为这种行为辩解呢？

examples.en: I realized I couldn't logically defend my position.
examples.zh: 我意识到我无法从逻辑上捍卫我的立场。

examples.en: The article seeks to defend him against charges of hypocrisy.
examples.zh: 这篇文章试图为他辩护，反对指控他为伪君子。

examples.en: Her colleagues united in defending her from further personal attacks.
examples.zh: 她的同事团结起来保护她免受进一步的人身攻击。

examples.en: Politicians are skilled at defending themselves against their critics.
examples.zh: 从政者都善于为自己辩解，反驳别人的批评。

senses.def: to protect your own goal to stop your opponents from scoring

examples.en: They were forced to defend for long periods.
examples.zh: 他们被迫长期防守。

examples.en: Moody and Moran defended their goal well.
examples.zh: 穆迪和莫兰很好地捍卫了他们的球门。

senses.def: to take part in a competition that you won the last time and try to win it again
senses.zh: 参加比赛（或选举）保住（头衔、席位等）

examples.en: He is defending champion.
examples.zh: 他在参加卫冕赛。

examples.en: She will be defending her title at next month's championships.
examples.zh: 她将在下月的锦标赛上争取蝉联冠军。

examples.en: The champion successfully defended his title against the American challenger.
examples.zh: 这位冠军打败了美国的挑战者，成功卫冕。

examples.en: He intends to defend his seat in the next election.
examples.zh: 他想在下届选举中寻求连任。

senses.def: to act as a lawyer for somebody who has been charged with a crime

examples.en: He has employed one of the UK's top lawyers to defend him.
examples.zh: 他请了英国一位顶尖律师为他辩护。

examples.en: Who's defending?
examples.zh: 谁在辩护？

examples.en: Smith has announced that she will defend herself in the case.
examples.zh: 史密斯宣布她将在此案中为自己辩护。

senses.def: that can be defended
senses.zh: 可防御的；可保护的；经得起推敲的

examples.en: a defendable strategy
examples.zh: 可防御的策略

examples.en: Their argument is not scientifically defendable.
examples.zh: 他们的论点在科学上是站不住脚的。

senses.def: the person in a trial who is accused of committing a crime, or who is being sued

examples.en: Several witnesses gave evidence for the defendant.
examples.zh: 几位证人提供了有利于被告的证词。

examples.en: The defendant was charged with disturbing the peace.
examples.zh: 被告被控扰乱治安。

examples.en: The jury found the defendant guilty on all counts.
examples.zh: 陪审团裁定被告所有罪名成立。

senses.def: a player who must stop the other team from scoring in games such as football (soccer), hockey, etc.
a person who defends and believes in protecting something

examples.en: a passionate defender of human rights
examples.zh: 热诚的人权卫士

senses.def: a title used by all kings and queens of England since the 16th century. The short form of the title's Latin translation, Fidei Defensor
senses.zh: 护教者16 世纪以来所有英格兰国王和女王均沿用的尊号。其拉丁文名 Fidei Defensor 的缩写形式 FD 或 FID DEF 用于所有英国硬币。原为教皇利奥十世授予英王亨利八世，以表彰其捍卫罗马天主教信仰、反对马丁·路德教义，后因英格兰脱离罗马天主教会而被撤销。亨利八世要求英国议会授予他同样称号，但意指他捍卫英国国教会。

examples.en: a witness for the defense
examples.zh: 辩方证人

senses.def: the players who must prevent the other team from scoring; the position of these players on the sports field

examples.en: Lattimore cut through the defense for a 52-yard touchdown.
examples.zh: 拉铁摩尔突破防守，完成 52 码达阵。

examples.en: She plays on defense.
examples.zh: 她打防守。

examples.en: She plays in defence.
examples.zh: 她打防守。

senses.def: a contest, game, etc. in which the previous winner or winners compete in order to try to win again

examples.en: Osaka begins her defense of the US Open title.
examples.zh: 大阪开始卫冕美国公开赛冠军。

senses.def: weak; not able to protect yourself; having no protection
senses.zh: 软弱的；不能自卫的；无防御的

senses.def: the fact of being weak and unable to protect yourself; the fact of having no protection
senses.zh: 软弱的；不能自卫的；无防御的

senses.def: a player who must prevent the other team from scoring

examples.en: He has been the top-scoring defenseman in the NHL for two seasons.
examples.zh: 他已在两个赛季成为国家冰球联盟得分最高的防守球员。

senses.def: able to be supported by reasons or arguments that show that it is right or should be allowed
senses.zh: 可辩解的；合乎情理的；有正当理由的

examples.en: Are these measures either morally or legally defensible?
examples.zh: 这些措施在道义上或法律上是否站得住脚？

examples.en: Is it morally defensible to deny legal advice to a prisoner?
examples.zh: 拒绝向囚犯提供法律建议在道德上是否合理？

examples.en: There is no defensible basis for this argument.
examples.zh: 这种说法没有任何辩护依据。

senses.def: able to be defended from an attack
protecting somebody/something against attack

examples.en: As a defensive measure he built a series of coastal forts and watchtowers.
examples.zh: 作为防御措施，他建造了一系列沿海堡垒和瞭望塔。

examples.en: These are purely defensive measures.
examples.zh: 这些纯粹是防御措施。

examples.en: Troops took up a defensive position around the town.
examples.zh: 部队在全城采取了守势。

senses.def: behaving in a way that shows that you feel that people are criticizing you
senses.zh: 戒备的；怀有戒心的；自卫的

examples.en: Don't ask him about his plans—he just gets defensive.
examples.zh: 别问他有什么计划，他老存有戒心。

examples.en: He is extremely defensive about his work.
examples.zh: 一谈起他的工作他就变得极有戒心。

examples.en: Her manner was oddly defensive, as he hadn't intended any criticism at all.
examples.zh: 她那种防备的态度真是莫名其妙，因为他一点批评她的意思都没有。

examples.en: Whenever anyone mentions women's rights, he gets rather defensive.
examples.zh: 不论何时有人提及女权问题，他就变得戒心重重。

senses.def: connected with trying to prevent the other team or player from scoring points or goals

examples.en: defensive play
examples.zh: 防守型打法

examples.en: a largely defensive campaign
examples.zh: 以防御为主的战役

senses.def: acting in a way that shows that you expect to be attacked or criticized; having to defend yourself
senses.zh: 处于防御姿态；处于戒备状态；采取守势

examples.en: Their questions about the money put her on the defensive.
examples.zh: 他们问到钱的问题时，她就警觉起来。

examples.en: Warnings of an enemy attack forced the troops onto the defensive.
examples.zh: 敌军显示出进攻的迹象，部队不得不进入戒备状态。

senses.def: acting in a way that shows that you expect to be attacked or criticized; having to defend yourself
senses.zh: 处于防御姿态；处于戒备状态；采取守势

examples.en: Their questions about the money put her on the defensive.
examples.zh: 他们问到钱的问题时，她就警觉起来。

examples.en: Warnings of an enemy attack forced the troops onto the defensive.
examples.zh: 敌军显示出进攻的迹象，部队不得不进入戒备状态。

senses.def: the line of players from the team that does not have the ball who position themselves in front of the ball when it is on the ground before play starts again

examples.en: Aside from Strahan, the defensive line was disappointing last season.
examples.zh: 上赛季除了斯特拉恩之外，防守线锋的表现也令人失望。

senses.def: the position of a player who plays on the defensive line

examples.en: They both have the physical skills to play defensive line in the National Football League.
examples.zh: 他们两人都具备在美国国家橄榄球联盟中担任防守队员的身体素质。

senses.def: medical treatment that may involve more tests, operations, etc. than a person really needs because a doctor is worried that a claim or complaint may be made against them in court if they make a mistake in the treatment they give
senses.zh: 防御性医疗，自卫性医疗（医生担心因误诊被起诉，从而可能让病人做过多的化验、手术等）

senses.def: in a way that shows that you feel that people are criticizing you
senses.zh: 戒备的；怀有戒心的；自卫的

examples.en: ‘I couldn't help it,’ he said defensively.
examples.zh: “我无能为力，”他辩解道。

senses.def: in a way that involves protecting somebody/something against attack

examples.en: The English fought defensively while the Normans repeatedly charged.
examples.zh: 英国人进行防御性战斗，而诺曼人则不断发起进攻。

senses.def: in a way that tries to prevent the other team or player from scoring points or goals, rather than trying to score points or goals yourself

examples.en: They played defensively, happy to settle for a draw.
examples.zh: 他们打得很防守，很高兴能平局。

senses.def: the fact of showing that you feel people are criticizing you
senses.zh: 戒备的；怀有戒心的；自卫的

examples.en: There was a hint of defensiveness in his voice.
examples.zh: 他的声音里带着一丝防御的味道。

senses.def: the quality or action of trying to protect somebody/something against attack
senses.zh: 防御性：试图保护某人/某物免受攻击的质量或行为

examples.en: Defensiveness is a strong characteristic of honeybees.
examples.zh: 防御性是蜜蜂的一个很强的特征。

senses.def: a way of playing that tries to prevent the other team or player from scoring points or goals

examples.en: This rule is intended to balance defensiveness and aggressiveness.
examples.zh: 该规则旨在平衡防御性和攻击性。

senses.def: to delay something until a later time

examples.en: The department deferred the decision for six months.
examples.zh: 这个部门推迟了六个月才作决定。

examples.en: She had applied for deferred admission to college.
examples.zh: 她已申请延期入学。

senses.def: to agree to accept what somebody has decided or what they think about somebody/something because you respect him or her

examples.en: We will defer to whatever the committee decides.
examples.zh: 我们遵从委员会的任何决定。

senses.def: behaviour that shows that you respect somebody/something

examples.en: The women wore veils in deference to the customs of the country.
examples.zh: 这些妇女戴着面纱是遵从这个国家的习俗。

examples.en: The flags were lowered out of deference to the bereaved family.
examples.zh: 降旗是出于对死者家属的尊重。

senses.def: showing that you respect somebody/something, especially somebody older or more senior than you
senses.zh: 有尊严的：表明您尊重某人/某物，尤其是某人比您年长或更高

examples.en: He was always deferential towards his mentor.
examples.zh: 他对他的导师总是毕恭毕敬。

examples.en: a deferential tone
examples.zh: 恭敬的语气

senses.def: in a way that shows that you respect somebody/something, especially somebody older or more senior than you
senses.zh: 尊敬地：以某种方式表明您尊重某人/某物，特别是比您年长或更高的人

senses.def: the action of delaying something until a later time

examples.en: The request for a deferral of the inquiry was refused.
examples.zh: 推迟调查的请求被拒绝。

examples.en: Some students were granted a deferment of payment of tuition fees.
examples.zh: 一些学生获准延期缴纳学费。

senses.def: the act of openly refusing to obey somebody/something

examples.en: a look/an act/a gesture of defiance
examples.zh: 反抗的神色／行动／表示

examples.en: Nuclear testing was resumed in defiance of an international ban.
examples.zh: 尽管国际上明令禁止，核试验又在进行了。

senses.def: (in South Africa in the past, especially in the period after 1952) a series of activities in which black people refused to obey laws that were not fair
senses.zh: 抗法运动（尤指 1952 年之后，南非黑人拒绝遵守不公平的法律规定）

senses.def: openly refusing to obey somebody/something, sometimes in an aggressive way
senses.zh: 公然违抗的；反抗的；挑衅的

examples.en: She had suddenly turned into a defiant teenager.
examples.zh: 她一下子变成了一个叛逆的少年。

examples.en: The terrorists sent a defiant message to the government.
examples.zh: 恐怖分子向政府发出了挑战书。

senses.def: in a way that shows you refuse to obey somebody/something, sometimes aggressively
senses.zh: 公然违抗的；反抗的；挑衅的

examples.en: ‘No,’ she said defiantly.
examples.zh: “不，”她挑衅地说。

senses.def: the use of a controlled
a piece of equipment used to control the movements of the heart muscles by giving the heart an electric shock in a carefully managed way
senses.zh: 除颤器（通过电击心脏控制心肌运动）

senses.def: the state of not having, or not having enough of, something that is essential

examples.en: Vitamin deficiency in the diet can cause illness.
examples.zh: 饮食中缺乏维生素会导致疾病。

examples.en: a deficiency of vitamin B
examples.zh: 缺乏维生素 B

senses.def: a fault or a weakness in something/somebody that makes it or them less successful

examples.en: deficiencies in the computer system
examples.zh: 计算机系统的种种缺陷

examples.en: He considers the lack of central control to be a serious deficiency.
examples.zh: 他认为缺乏中央控制是一个严重的缺陷。

senses.def: not having enough of something, especially something that is essential

examples.en: a diet that is deficient in vitamin A
examples.zh: 缺乏维生素 A 的饮食

examples.en: Their food is deficient in iron.
examples.zh: 他们的食物缺铁。

examples.en: Your diet is deficient in iron.
examples.zh: 你的饮食缺铁。

senses.def: not good enough

examples.en: The report confirmed that the agency's response was woefully deficient.
examples.zh: 报告证实，该机构的应对措施严重不足。

senses.def: the amount by which money spent or owed is greater than money earned in a particular period of time

examples.en: a budget deficit
examples.zh: 政府预算赤字

examples.en: The trade balance has been in deficit for the past five years.
examples.zh: 过去五年来贸易一直是逆差。

senses.def: the amount by which something, especially an amount of money, is too small or smaller than something else

examples.en: There's a deficit of $3 million in the total needed to complete the project.
examples.zh: 完成这项工程所需资金还缺少 300 万美元。

examples.en: The team has to come back from a 2–0 deficit in the first half.
examples.zh: 这支队得在上半场 0:2 落后的局面下扳回比分。

senses.def: government spending of money that comes from borrowing rather than from taxes

examples.en: Many are worried about deficit spending and public debt.
examples.zh: 许多人对政府赤字和公共债务感到担忧。

examples.en: As the government borrows more to pay for its deficit spending, interest rates rise and businesses suffer.
examples.zh: 由于政府增加借款用于赤字开支，利率升高，企业受害。

senses.def: to make something dirty or no longer pure, especially something that people consider important or holy

examples.en: Many victims of burglary feel their homes have been defiled.
examples.zh: 许多家门被撬的人都感到自己的家被玷污了。

examples.en: The altar had been defiled by vandals.
examples.zh: 圣坛受到破坏公物者的肆意践踏。

senses.def: a narrow way through mountains
the act of making something dirty or no longer pure, especially something that people consider important or holy

examples.en: the defilement of war graves
examples.zh: 战争坟墓的玷污

senses.def: with a meaning that can be defined

examples.en: Neither of those terms is easily definable.
examples.zh: 这两个术语都不容易定义。

senses.def: possible to describe or show accurately

examples.en: He sees clearly definable problems that have to be solved.
examples.zh: 他清楚地看到了必须解决的问题。

senses.def: to say or explain what the meaning of a word or phrase is
senses.zh: 解释（词语的含义）；给…下定义

examples.en: The term ‘normal’ is difficult to define.
examples.zh: “正常”这个词很难定义。

examples.en: Life imprisonment is defined as 60 years under state law.
examples.zh: 按照州法律终身监禁定义为 60 年。

senses.def: to describe or show the nature or range of somebody/something

examples.en: The goals of the project are clearly defined.
examples.zh: 项目的目标定得很清晰。

examples.en: At that time women's roles were quite narrowly defined.
examples.zh: 那时，女性的角色定义相当狭窄。

examples.en: to be broadly/loosely defined
examples.zh: 广泛/宽松地定义

examples.en: The difficulty of a problem was defined in terms of how long it took to complete.
examples.zh: 问题的难易度是以解决这个问题所花时间的长短而定的。

examples.en: It is difficult to define what makes him so popular.
examples.zh: 很难解释清楚是什么原因使他如此走红。

examples.en: He defines himself as an independent.
examples.zh: 他把自己定义为一个独立的人。

examples.en: We have never defined ourselves in our own right.
examples.zh: 我们从来没有以自己的权利来定义自己。

senses.def: to make or establish the essential character or somebody/something
senses.zh: 解释（词语的含义）；给…下定义

examples.en: For some, the football club defines their identity.
examples.zh: 对有些人来说，足球俱乐部定义了他们的身份。

examples.en: to define the nature/character of somebody/something
examples.zh: 定义某人/某物的本质/特征

examples.en: The novel told the story of a preacher-poet, who defines himself through his art.
examples.zh: 这部小说讲述了一位传教士兼诗人的故事，他通过自己的艺术来定义自己。

senses.def: to show clearly a line, shape or edge
senses.zh: 画出…的线条；描出…的外形；确定…的界线；界定

examples.en: The mountain was sharply defined against the sky.
examples.zh: 那座山在天空的衬托下显得轮廓分明。

senses.def: a fixed amount of money that will be paid by a pension plan

examples.en: Companies are closing their defined benefit pension plans to new entrants.
examples.zh: 公司正在关闭对新加入者的固定福利养老金计划。

examples.en: If you are in a defined benefit fund, think carefully before leaving it.
examples.zh: 如果您加入了固定福利基金，请在离开之前仔细考虑。

senses.def: fixed payments that are made to a pension plan

examples.en: In a defined contribution plan, it is the employee, not the employer, who bears the risk.
examples.zh: 在设定提存计划中，承担风险的是雇员，而不是雇主。

senses.def: a set of carefully chosen words used to write the explanations in some dictionaries
sure or certain; unlikely to change
senses.zh: 肯定的；确定的；不会改变的

examples.en: Can you give me a definite answer by tomorrow?
examples.zh: 你最晚明天能给我一个确定的答复吗？

examples.en: No definite conclusions can be drawn from this study.
examples.zh: 这项研究无法得出明确的结论。

examples.en: They have very definite ideas on how to bring up children.
examples.zh: 关于如何培养孩子，他们有非常明确的想法。

examples.en: Is it definite that he's leaving?
examples.zh: 他肯定要离开吗？

examples.en: I've heard rumours, but nothing definite.
examples.zh: 我听到一些流言，但都不确定。

examples.en: I'm not sure—I can find out for definite if you like.
examples.zh: 我没把握，如果你愿意，我可以去核实。

examples.en: That's definite then, is it?
examples.zh: 那么，那是确切的了，是吗？

senses.def: easily or clearly seen or understood; obvious

examples.en: The look on her face was a definite sign that something was wrong.
examples.zh: 一看她的神色就知道出事了。

examples.en: There was a definite feeling that things were getting worse.
examples.zh: 人们明显感到事情越来越糟。

examples.en: a definite plus/advantage
examples.zh: 明确的优点/优势

examples.en: There was a definite improvement in the sound
examples.zh: 音质有了明显的改善

senses.def: sure that something is true or that something is going to happen and stating it to other people

examples.en: I'm definite about this.
examples.zh: 我对这事毫无疑问。

examples.en: He was pretty definite about the price.
examples.zh: 他对价格非常确定。

examples.en: She was definite that they weren't coming till next week.
examples.zh: 她确信他们下周之前不会来。

senses.def: something that you are certain about or that you know will happen; somebody who is sure to do something

examples.en: ‘We're moving our office to Glasgow.’ ‘That's a definite, is it?’
examples.zh: “我们的办事处要搬到格拉斯哥去。”“这事儿定了，是吗？”

examples.en: ‘Is Sarah coming to the party?’ ‘Yes, she's a definite.’
examples.zh: “萨拉要来参加聚会吗？”“是的，她肯定来。”

intro.en: These are all words describing something that will definitely happen or is definitely true.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指某事肯定、必定会发生或属实。

items.def: that you can rely on to happen or be true:
items.zh: 指确实、确定、肯定（会发生或是事实）

examples.en: It’s certain that they will agree.
examples.zh: 他们肯定会同意。

items.def: [not before noun] certain to happen, or to do or be something. Bound is only used in the phrase bound to do/​be, etc.:
items.zh: bound 只用于 bound to do/be 等短语中

items.def: certain to happen or be true; that can be trusted or relied on:
items.zh: 指必定、无疑（会发生或是事实）或不容置疑、确切、可靠

examples.en: She’s sure to be picked for the team.
examples.zh: 她肯定会入选该队。

items.def: (rather informal) certain to happen; that is not going to change:
items.zh: 指必将发生、不会改变

examples.en: Is it definite that he’s leaving?
examples.zh: 他肯定要离开吗？

items.def: certain to have a particular result:
items.zh: 指肯定会、必定会（有特定结果）

examples.en: That kind of behaviour is guaranteed to make him angry.
examples.zh: 那样的行为肯定会让他生气。

senses.def: the word the
senses.zh: 定冠词（如英语中的 the）

senses.def: a way of emphasizing that something is true and that there is no doubt about it

examples.en: I definitely remember sending the letter.
examples.zh: 我记得这封信肯定发出去了。

examples.en: ‘Was it what you expected?’ ‘Yes, definitely.’
examples.zh: “那是你所期待的吗？”“当然是。”

examples.en: ‘Would you like to go back there?’ ‘Definitely not!'
examples.zh: “你想回到那里吗？”“绝对不想！”

examples.en: She most definitely did not want my help.
examples.zh: 她绝对不需要我的帮助。

examples.en: The claim is definitely true.
examples.zh: 这个说法绝对是真的。

examples.en: If you want to know more I'd definitely recommend checking out this guide .
examples.zh: 如果您想了解更多信息，我绝对建议您查看本指南。

senses.def: in a way that is certain or that shows that you are certain

examples.en: The date of the move has not been definitely decided yet (= it may change).
examples.zh: 搬迁日期还未完全确定下来。

examples.en: Please say definitely whether you will be coming or not.
examples.zh: 请说清楚，你来还是不来。

senses.def: an explanation of the meaning of a word or phrase, especially in a dictionary
senses.zh: （尤指词典里的词或短语的）定义；释义

examples.en: The dictionary provides clear, simple definitions.
examples.zh: 该词典的释义简单明了。

examples.en: the dictionary definition of this term
examples.zh: 这个术语在词典里的定义

examples.en: a precise/strict definition of a word
examples.zh: 词的精确／严格的定义

examples.en: We need a good working definition of ‘pollution’.
examples.zh: 我们需要为“污染”下一个合适的初步定义。

senses.def: what an idea means

examples.en: What's your definition of happiness?
examples.zh: 你对幸福的定义是什么？

examples.en: a broad/narrow definition of the concept
examples.zh: 概念的广义／狭义定义

examples.en: There is no agreed definition of what a comprehensive school should be.
examples.zh: 对于什么是综合性学校，目前还没有一致的定义。

senses.def: the act of saying what a word or an idea means

examples.en: The term ‘partner’ requires careful definition.
examples.zh: “伴侣”一词需要仔细定义。

examples.en: Neighbours by definition live close by (= this is what being a neighbour means).
examples.zh: 顾名思义，“邻居”就要住在邻近的地方。

senses.def: the quality of being clear and easy to see; the ability of a device to give clear images

examples.en: The clarity and definition of the images are excellent.
examples.zh: 图像的清晰度极佳。

examples.en: The definition of this TV is very good.
examples.zh: 这台电视的清晰度很高。

senses.def: final; not able to be changed
senses.zh: 最后的；决定性的；不可更改的

examples.en: a definitive agreement/answer/statement
examples.zh: 最后的协议／答复／声明

examples.en: The definitive version of the text is ready to be published.
examples.zh: 文本的终稿已备妥，可以发表了。

senses.def: considered to be the best of its kind and almost impossible to improve

examples.en: the definitive biography of Einstein
examples.zh: 最完整可靠的爱因斯坦传记

examples.en: the definitive guide to the golf courses of Europe
examples.zh: 欧洲高尔夫球场的权威指南

senses.def: finally; in a way that cannot be changed or challenged

examples.en: the difficulty of definitively proving guilt
examples.zh: 明确证明有罪的难度

senses.def: to let air or gas out of a tyre, balloon
senses.zh: 放掉（轮胎、气球等的）气；（使）瘪下来

senses.def: to make somebody feel less confident; to make somebody/something feel or seem less important

examples.en: All the criticism had left her feeling totally deflated.
examples.zh: 所有这些批评使她彻底失去了信心。

senses.def: to reduce the amount of money being used in a country so that prices fall or stay steady
a reduction in the amount of money in a country’s economy so that prices fall or remain the same
the action of air being removed from something
causing or affected by a reduction in the amount of money in a country's economy so that prices fall or remain the same

examples.en: deflationary policies
examples.zh: 通货紧缩政策

senses.def: to change direction or make something change direction, especially after hitting something
senses.zh: （尤指击中某物后）偏斜，转向，使偏斜，使转向

senses.def: a period of time when somebody/something has to wait because of a problem that makes something slow or late
senses.zh: 延迟（或耽搁、拖延）的时间

examples.en: Commuters will face long delays on the roads today.
examples.zh: 路远乘车上下班的人今天要在路上耽误很多时间了。

examples.en: to experience/suffer delays
examples.zh: 经历/遭受延误

examples.en: to avoid/minimize further delays
examples.zh: 避免/尽量减少进一步的延误

examples.en: Increased congestion and traffic delays are expected.
examples.zh: 预计拥堵和交通延误将会加剧。

examples.en: a delay of two hours/a two-hour delay
examples.zh: 两小时的延误

examples.en: The strike has led to some delays in train services.
examples.zh: 此次罢工导致了一些列车的延误。

examples.en: We apologize for the delay in answering your letter.
examples.zh: 来信收悉，迟复为歉。

examples.en: These issues have caused serious delays to the project.
examples.zh: 这些问题已导致项目严重延误。

examples.en: Flights to New York may be subject to delay.
examples.zh: 飞往纽约的航班可能会延误。

senses.def: failure to do something quickly or at the right time; the act of delaying

examples.en: There's no time for delay.
examples.zh: 没有时间了，不能拖延了。

examples.en: Report it to the police without delay (= immediately).
examples.zh: 赶快将此事报告警方。

senses.def: to make somebody/something late or force them to do something more slowly

examples.en: My flight was delayed.
examples.zh: 我的航班延误了。

examples.en: Thousands of commuters were delayed for over an hour.
examples.zh: 数千名通勤乘客被耽搁了一个多小时。

examples.en: The government is accused of using delaying tactics (= deliberately doing something to delay a process, decision, etc.).
examples.zh: 政府被指责故意采取拖延战术。

examples.en: What could have delayed him?
examples.zh: 是什么让他耽搁了呢？

senses.def: to not do something until a later time or to make something happen at a later time

examples.en: Don't delay—call us today!
examples.zh: 别拖延，今天就给我们打电话！

examples.en: We can't delay much longer.
examples.zh: 我们不能再拖延了。

examples.en: Heavy hail showers delayed the start of the race.
examples.zh: 强冰雹导致比赛延迟。

examples.en: to delay the launch/release/publication of something
examples.zh: 延迟某物的发布/发布/出版

examples.en: She's suffering a delayed reaction (= a reaction that did not happen immediately) to the shock.
examples.zh: 她正在承受着冲击所带来的滞后反应。

examples.en: The judge will delay his verdict until he receives medical reports on the offender.
examples.zh: 法官将推迟判决，直到收到有关违法者的医疗报告。

examples.en: He delayed telling her the news, waiting for the right moment.
examples.zh: 他没有马上把消息告诉她，等有了适当的时机再说。

senses.def: the act of reducing the number of levels of staff in an organization, especially by removing one or more levels of managers from their jobs
senses.zh: 简化管理架构；减少管理层级

examples.en: The reorganization will involve delayering.
examples.zh: 这次重组将会减少管理层级。

examples.en: the managers who survived delayering
examples.zh: 精简管理层后得以继续留任的经理级人员

examples.en: The point of delayering is to create flatter management structures.
examples.zh: 减少层级的目的是建立扁平化的管理结构。

senses.def: extremely pleasant to taste, smell or look at
senses.zh: 美味可口的；香甜的；宜人的

examples.en: the delectable smell of freshly baked bread
examples.zh: 新烤面包的香味

examples.en: delectable chocolate truffles
examples.zh: 美味的松露巧克力

senses.def: very attractive
senses.zh: 妩媚动人的；有迷惑力的；有吸引力的

examples.en: his delectable body
examples.zh: 他健美的身体

examples.en: Steve’s latest girlfriend, the delectable Tara.
examples.zh: 史蒂夫的最新女友，可爱的塔拉。

senses.def: pleasure or entertainment
a person who is chosen or elected to represent the views of a group of people and vote and make decisions for them

examples.en: Congress delegates rejected the proposals.
examples.zh: 国会代表拒绝了这些提议。

senses.def: a person who attends a conference

examples.en: The conference was attended by delegates from 56 countries.
examples.zh: 此次会议有来自 56 个国家的代表出席。

examples.en: They decided not to send a delegate to the conference.
examples.zh: 他们决定不派代表参加会议。

senses.def: to give part of your work, power or authority to somebody in a lower position than you
senses.zh: 授（权）；把（工作、权力等）委托（给下级）

examples.en: Some managers find it difficult to delegate.
examples.zh: 有些经理认为难以做到下放权力。

examples.en: The job had to be delegated to an assistant.
examples.zh: 这工作得交给助手负责。

senses.def: to choose somebody to do something

examples.en: I've been delegated to organize the Christmas party.
examples.zh: 我被选派来组织圣诞聚会。

senses.def: a group of people who represent the views of an organization, a country, etc.

examples.en: the Dutch delegation to the United Nations
examples.zh: 出席联合国会议的荷兰代表团

examples.en: a delegation of teachers
examples.zh: 教师代表团

examples.en: The Japanese delegation has/have arrived.
examples.zh: 日本代表团已经抵达。

senses.def: the process of giving somebody work or responsibilities that would usually be yours

examples.en: delegation of authority/decision-making
examples.zh: 授予权力／决策权

senses.def: to remove something that has been written or printed, or that has been stored on a computer

examples.en: Your name has been deleted from the list.
examples.zh: 你的名字已从名单上删掉。

examples.en: This command deletes files from the directory.
examples.zh: 这一指令把文档从目录中删除。

examples.en: Mr/Mrs/Ms (delete as appropriate)
examples.zh: 先生／太太／女士（删去不适用者）

examples.en: Delete the word ‘it’ and insert ‘them’.
examples.zh: 删除“它”一词并插入“它们”。

senses.def: a key or command on a computer, phone, etc. that removes text, records or images
senses.zh: （计算机、手机等的）删除（键），删除命令

examples.en: Just use delete to remove a specific record from the database.
examples.zh: 只需使用删除即可从数据库中删除特定记录。

examples.en: I accidentally pressed delete.
examples.zh: 我不小心按了删除键。

senses.def: harmful and damaging
senses.zh: 有害的；造成伤害的；损害的

examples.en: the deleterious effect of stress on health
examples.zh: 压力对健康的有害影响

senses.def: the act of removing something that has been written or printed, or that has been stored on a computer; something that has been removed

examples.en: He made several deletions to the manuscript.
examples.zh: 他在原稿上删去了几处。

senses.def: the process or practice of reducing your level of debt by rapidly selling your assets

examples.en: Given the strong cash performance and accelerated deleverage, the company is to reinstate a modest final dividend this year.
examples.zh: 鉴于强劲的现金表现和加速的去杠杆化，该公司今年将恢复适度的末期股息。

senses.def: to reduce your level of debt by rapidly selling your assets

examples.en: The company is deleveraging dramatically.
examples.zh: 该公司正在大幅去杠杆化。

examples.en: Debt is rapidly decreasing, and the company has deleveraged the balance sheet by 30% since 2019.
examples.zh: 债务正在迅速减少，自2019年以来，该公司已将资产负债表去杠杆化了30%。

senses.def: a shop or part of one that sells cooked meats and cheeses, and special or unusual foods that come from other countries
senses.zh: （出售熟肉、干酪和进口风味食品的）熟食店，熟食柜台

examples.en: There was a wide selection of Italian meats at the deli counter.
examples.zh: 熟食柜台上有多种意大利肉类可供选择。

senses.def: a first name for girls
done on purpose rather than by accident

examples.en: a deliberate act of vandalism
examples.zh: 故意毁坏公物的行为

examples.en: The speech was a deliberate attempt to embarrass the government.
examples.zh: 这一发言蓄意使政府难堪。

examples.en: a deliberate lie/deception
examples.zh: 故意的谎言/欺骗

senses.def: done slowly and carefully
senses.zh: 不慌不忙的；小心翼翼的；从容不迫的

examples.en: She spoke in a slow and deliberate way.
examples.zh: 她说话慢条斯理不慌不忙。

senses.def: to consider something very carefully, usually before making a decision
senses.zh: 仔细考虑；深思熟虑；反复思考

examples.en: The jury deliberated for five days before finding him guilty.
examples.zh: 陪审团认真讨论了五天才裁定他有罪。

examples.en: The sergeant deliberated for a moment and then agreed to unlock the door.
examples.zh: 中士考虑了一会儿，同意打开门。

examples.en: They deliberated (on) whether to continue with the talks.
examples.zh: 他们仔细考虑了是否继续谈判的问题。

examples.en: Customers sometimes deliberate over a purchase for weeks.
examples.zh: 顾客有时会花数周的时间来考虑购买事宜。

examples.en: The jurors are now deliberating the fate of the accused.
examples.zh: 陪审员现在正在审议被告的命运。

senses.def: done in a way that was planned, not by chance

examples.en: She's been deliberately ignoring him all day.
examples.zh: 她故意整天都不理他。

examples.en: an ad campaign that deliberately targets children
examples.zh: 以儿童为特定目标的广告活动

examples.en: She was accused of deliberately misleading Parliament.
examples.zh: 她被指控蓄意误导议会。

examples.en: to deliberately withhold/conceal information
examples.zh: 故意隐瞒/隐藏信息

examples.en: The fire had been started deliberately.
examples.zh: 有人蓄意纵火。

examples.en: Her tone was deliberately insulting.
examples.zh: 她的语气是在有意侮辱人。

senses.def: slowly and carefully
senses.zh: 不慌不忙地；小心翼翼地；从容不迫地

examples.en: He packed up his possessions slowly and deliberately.
examples.zh: 他慢慢地、小心翼翼地收拾好自己的物品。

senses.def: the process of carefully considering or discussing something

examples.en: After ten hours of deliberation, the jury returned a verdict of ‘not guilty’.
examples.zh: 经过十小时的商议，陪审团宣告了“无罪”的裁定。

examples.en: The deliberations of the committee are completely confidential.
examples.zh: 委员会的审议过程是绝对保密的。

senses.def: the quality of being slow and careful in what you say or do

examples.en: She signed her name with great deliberation.
examples.zh: 她非常审慎地签上了自己的名字。

examples.en: With slow deliberation, he tore the letter into pieces.
examples.zh: 他从容不迫地把信撕成碎片。

senses.def: involving or showing careful consideration or discussion

examples.en: We are engaged in a deliberative process.
examples.zh: 我们正在进行认真审议。

examples.en: Parliament is a deliberative assembly.
examples.zh: 议会是一个审议的机构。

examples.en: One of the President's strengths is that he is very deliberative.
examples.zh: 总统的优点之一是他非常深思熟虑。

senses.def: the fact of being, or appearing to be, easy to damage or break

examples.en: the delicacy of the fabric
examples.zh: 织物的精细脆弱

examples.en: the exquisite delicacy of the embroidery
examples.zh: 刺绣的精致

senses.def: the quality of being done carefully and gently

examples.en: Great delicacy of touch is needed to keep the machine balanced.
examples.zh: 保持机器平衡需要非常灵敏的触觉。

examples.en: These objects are very old and should be treated with great delicacy.
examples.zh: 这些物件很旧了，处理起来要非常小心。

senses.def: very careful behaviour in a difficult situation so that nobody is offended

examples.en: She handled the situation with great sensitivity and delicacy.
examples.zh: 她慎重而周到地处理了这个情况。

examples.en: He handled the situation with extreme delicacy.
examples.zh: 他极为小心谨慎地应对这个局面。

senses.def: the fact that a situation is difficult and somebody may be easily offended

examples.en: I need to talk to you about a matter of some delicacy.
examples.zh: 我需要与你谈个有点棘手的问题。

senses.def: a type of food considered to be very special in a particular place

examples.en: local delicacies
examples.zh: 当地的美味佳肴

examples.en: Dr Jaffrey handed us a plate of dates: traditionally the delicacy with which to break the Ramadan fast.
examples.zh: 贾弗里博士递给我们一盘枣子：传统上这是斋戒月开斋时的美味佳肴。

examples.en: The eggs of this bird are considered a great delicacy.
examples.zh: 这种鸟的蛋被视为美味佳肴。

senses.def: easily damaged or broken

examples.en: delicate china teacups
examples.zh: 易碎的瓷茶杯

examples.en: The eye is one of the most delicate organs of the body.
examples.zh: 眼睛是人体最娇弱的器官之一。

examples.en: the delicate ecological balance of the rainforest
examples.zh: 热带雨林极易被破坏的生态平衡

examples.en: Babies have very delicate skin.
examples.zh: 婴儿的皮肤非常娇嫩。

examples.en: a cool wash cycle for delicate fabrics
examples.zh: 精细织物冷洗程序

senses.def: not strong and easily becoming ill

examples.en: a delicate child/constitution
examples.zh: 纤弱的孩子／体质

examples.en: His health had always been delicate.
examples.zh: 他的健康状况一直很脆弱。

senses.def: small and having a beautiful shape or appearance
senses.zh: 纤细的；微小的；精美的；小巧玲珑的

examples.en: his delicate hands
examples.zh: 他纤细的手

senses.def: made or formed in a very careful and detailed way

examples.en: the delicate mechanisms of a clock
examples.zh: 钟的精密机件

senses.def: showing or needing careful or sensitive treatment
senses.zh: 巧妙的；微妙的；需要技巧的；需要小心处理的

examples.en: I admired your delicate handling of the situation.
examples.zh: 我佩服你应付这种局面的娴熟技巧。

examples.en: a delicate problem
examples.zh: 微妙的问题

examples.en: The delicate surgical operation took five hours.
examples.zh: 这精细的外科手术花了五个小时。

senses.def: light and pleasant; not strong
senses.zh: 柔和的；清淡可口的；清香的

examples.en: a delicate fragrance/flavour
examples.zh: 清新的芳香；鲜美的味道

examples.en: a river scene painted in delicate watercolours
examples.zh: 用柔和的水彩画的河景

senses.def: carefully and using a lot of detail
senses.zh: 精致：仔细并使用大量细节

examples.en: a delicately carved chair
examples.zh: 雕刻精美的椅子

senses.def: with care or skill

examples.en: He stepped delicately over the broken glass.
examples.zh: 他小心翼翼地跨过碎玻璃。

senses.def: with careful or sensitive treatment, without hurting anyone's feelings
senses.zh: 精致：经过精心或敏感的治疗，而不会伤害任何人的感觉

examples.en: This matter needs to be delicately handled.
examples.zh: 这件事需要谨慎处理。

senses.def: in a way that is light and pleasant; not strongly
senses.zh: 柔和的；清淡可口的；清香的

examples.en: delicately balanced flavours
examples.zh: 清淡平和的味道

senses.def: a shop or part of one that sells cooked meats and cheeses, and special or unusual foods that come from other countries
senses.zh: （出售熟肉、干酪和进口风味食品的）熟食店，熟食柜台

senses.def: having a very pleasant taste or smell

examples.en: Who cooked this? It's absolutely delicious.
examples.zh: 这是谁做的？太好吃了。

examples.en: to taste/smell/look delicious
examples.zh: 尝起来美味；闻着很香；看上去好吃

examples.en: a delicious meal/recipe/treat
examples.zh: 美味的一餐；美食的食谱；佳肴的款待

examples.en: This dish is delicious with cream.
examples.zh: 这道菜搭配奶油很好吃。

examples.en: The food was delicious.
examples.zh: 食物很好吃。

senses.def: extremely pleasant
senses.zh: 令人愉快的；令人开心的；宜人的

examples.en: the delicious coolness of the breeze
examples.zh: 微风送爽

examples.en: A delicious shiver of excitement ran through his body.
examples.zh: 他兴奋得全身发抖。

senses.def: in a way that tastes or smells very good
senses.zh: 美味：味道或气味非常好

examples.en: deliciously creamy soup
examples.zh: 可口的奶油汤

senses.def: in an extremely pleasant way
senses.zh: 令人愉快的；令人开心的；宜人的

examples.en: The cream felt deliciously cool on my hot skin.
examples.zh: 奶油在我炎热的皮肤上感觉非常凉爽。

senses.def: a feeling of great pleasure

examples.en: a feeling of sheer/pure delight
examples.zh: 十分高兴的心情

examples.en: The children squealed with delight when they saw the puppy.
examples.zh: 孩子们看到小狗时高兴得大声尖叫。

examples.en: She won the game easily, to the delight of all her fans.
examples.zh: 这场比赛她赢得很轻松，令所有的崇拜者大为高兴。

examples.en: He takes (great) delight in (= enjoys) proving others wrong.
examples.zh: 他以证明别人错误为（一大）快事。

examples.en: She took a simple delight in joys that we could all share.
examples.zh: 她对我们大家可以分享的快乐感到简单的喜悦。

examples.en: She couldn't hide her delight at the news.
examples.zh: 听到这个消息，她难掩喜悦。

examples.en: He expressed his delight at seeing us all again.
examples.zh: 他表达了再一次见到我们所有人的喜悦之情。

senses.def: something that gives you great pleasure
senses.zh: 令人高兴的事；乐事；乐趣

examples.en: This guitar is a delight to play.
examples.zh: 这吉他弹起来很惬意。

examples.en: Sample the culinary delights of Morocco.
examples.zh: 品尝摩洛哥的美食。

examples.en: the delights of living in the country
examples.zh: 生活在乡村的乐趣

senses.def: to give somebody a lot of pleasure and joy

examples.en: This news will delight his fans all over the world.
examples.zh: 这消息将使全世界崇拜他的人都感到高兴。

examples.en: a movie that will thrill and delight most audiences
examples.zh: 一部会让大多数观众兴奋和高兴的电影

examples.en: Her lack of reserve delighted him.
examples.zh: 她的毫不矜持让他很高兴。

examples.en: She had a limitless capacity to astonish and delight.
examples.zh: 她总能带给人惊奇和欢乐。

intro.en: These are all words for things that make you happy or that you enjoy.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指令人愉快、高兴的事。

items.def: a thing that makes you happy or satisfied:
items.zh: 乐事；快事

examples.en: the pleasures and pains of everyday life
examples.zh: 日常生活的苦与乐

items.def: a thing or person that brings you great pleasure:
items.zh: 指令人高兴的事或人、乐事、乐趣

examples.en: the delights of living in the country
examples.zh: 生活在乡村的乐趣

items.def: a thing or person that brings you great pleasure or happiness:
items.zh: 指令人高兴的事或人、乐事、乐趣

examples.en: the joys and sorrows of childhood
examples.zh: 童年的欢乐与悲伤

items.def: (rather formal) something that you are proud and lucky to have the opportunity to do:
items.zh: 指荣幸、荣耀、光荣

examples.en: It was a great privilege to hear her sing.
examples.zh: 听她唱歌是莫大的荣幸。

items.def: (informal) a thing that somebody enjoyed or is likely to enjoy very much:
items.zh: 指乐事、乐趣

examples.en: You’ve never been to this area before? Then you’re in for a real treat.
examples.zh: 你以前从来没有到过这一地区？那么你一定会喜之不尽。

items.def: (formal) something that you are very pleased or proud to do because people are showing you great respect:
items.zh: 指荣幸、光荣

examples.en: It was a great honour to be invited here today.
examples.zh: 今天承蒙邀请到此，深感荣幸。

senses.def: to enjoy doing something very much, especially something that makes other people feel embarrassed, uncomfortable, etc.
senses.zh: 以…为乐（尤指做使别人感到尴尬、不舒服的事）

examples.en: He delighted in beating them at their own game.
examples.zh: 他很高兴能在他们自己的游戏中击败他们。

senses.def: in a way that shows you are very pleased

examples.en: She laughed delightedly.
examples.zh: 她高兴地笑了起来。

senses.def: very pleasant
senses.zh: 使人快乐的；令人愉快的；宜人的

examples.en: a delightful book/restaurant/town
examples.zh: 令人愉快的书；舒适的餐馆；宜人的城镇

examples.en: a delightful child
examples.zh: 讨人喜欢的孩子

examples.en: It was a delightful little fishing village.
examples.zh: 那是个舒适宜人的小渔村。

intro.en: These words all describe an experience, feeling or sight that gives you great pleasure.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指经历、感觉或景象令人高兴、使人愉快。

items.def: that you enjoy very much; that gives you great pleasure; extremely good:
items.zh: 指使人愉快的、令人高兴的、精彩的、绝妙的

examples.en: We had a wonderful time last night.
examples.zh: 我们昨天晚上过得非常愉快。

items.def: (especially British English尤用于英式英语, rather informal) that you enjoy very much; that gives you great pleasure; very attractive:
items.zh: 指令人愉快的、有吸引力的、迷人的

examples.en: What a lovely day! (= the weather is very good)
examples.zh: 多么好的天气啊！

items.def: that gives you great pleasure; very attractive:
items.zh: 指令人愉快的、宜人的

examples.en: a delightful little fishing village
examples.zh: 宜人的小渔村

senses.def: in a very pleasant way
senses.zh: 使人快乐的；令人愉快的；宜人的

senses.def: to take goods, letters, etc. to the person or people they have been sent to

examples.zh: 为了节省时间，我让超市把食品送过来。
