senses.zh: 我权天授（法语短语，意为“上帝和我的权利”，自 14 世纪以来一直是英格兰君主的座右铭）

senses.def: to be different from somebody/something

examples.en: They hold differing views.
examples.zh: 他们持有不同的观点。

examples.en: French differs from English in this respect.
examples.zh: 在这方面法语不同于英语。

examples.en: French and English differ in this respect.
examples.zh: 在这方面法语和英语不同。

examples.en: Ideas on childcare may differ considerably between the parents.
examples.zh: 在抚育子女方面父母的观点可能迥然不同。

senses.def: to disagree with somebody
senses.zh: 意见相左；持不同看法；不同意

examples.en: I have to differ with you on that.
examples.zh: 在那一点上我不能同意你的看法。

examples.en: Medical opinion differs as to how to treat the disease.
examples.zh: 关于如何治疗这种疾病医学界有不同的看法。

senses.def: if two people agree to differ/disagree
senses.zh: 同意各自保留不同意见

examples.en: We must just agree to differ on this.
examples.zh: 我们必须同意在这一点上存在不同意见。

examples.en: In the end we agreed to disagree.
examples.zh: 最后我们同意不同意。

examples.en: I think you're wrong. Let's just agree to differ.
examples.zh: 我认为你是错的。咱们还是各自保留不同意见吧。

senses.def: used to say politely that you do not agree with something that has just been said

examples.en: ‘At least she is good at her job.’ ‘Oh, I beg to differ.’
examples.zh: “至少她的工作很出色。”“哦，我不敢苟同。”

senses.def: if two people agree to differ/disagree
senses.zh: 同意各自保留不同意见

examples.en: We must just agree to differ on this.
examples.zh: 我们必须同意在这一点上存在不同意见。

examples.en: In the end we agreed to disagree.
examples.zh: 最后我们同意不同意。

examples.en: I think you're wrong. Let's just agree to differ.
examples.zh: 我认为你是错的。咱们还是各自保留不同意见吧。

senses.def: used to say politely that you do not agree with something that has just been said

examples.en: ‘At least she is good at her job.’ ‘Oh, I beg to differ.’
examples.zh: “至少她的工作很出色。”“哦，我不敢苟同。”

senses.def: the way in which two people or things are not like each other; the way in which somebody/something has changed
senses.zh: 差别；差异；不同（之处）；变化（之处）

examples.en: Americans and Brits speak the same language, but there are big cultural differences.
examples.zh: 美国人和英国人说同一种语言，但文化差异很大。

examples.en: There are no significant differences between the education systems of the two countries.
examples.zh: 这两国的教育制度没有大的差别。

examples.en: He was studying the similarities and differences between humans and animals.
examples.zh: 他在研究人和动物之间的相似与不同之处。

examples.en: I can never tell the difference (= distinguish) between the twins.
examples.zh: 我从来都分不清这对双胞胎。

examples.en: There's no difference in the results.
examples.zh: 结果没有差别。

examples.en: There is a fundamental difference in approach to conservation in Japan.
examples.zh: 在日本，谈话方式有根本的不同。

examples.en: She noticed a marked difference in the children on her second visit.
examples.zh: 她第二次来访时注意到孩子们发生了明显的变化。

examples.en: Her work questions notions of gender difference.
examples.zh: 她的作品质疑性别差异的概念。

examples.en: What a difference! You look great with your hair like that.
examples.zh: 真是判若两人！你梳这种发型显得太好看了。

examples.en: Differences among beetle species may prove to be a key factor.
examples.zh: 甲虫物种之间的差异可能被证明是一个关键因素。

examples.en: Despite their differences, the two are great friends.
examples.zh: 尽管存在分歧，两人还是好朋友。

senses.def: the amount that something is greater or smaller than something else

examples.en: We measured the difference in temperature.
examples.zh: 我们测量了温度的变化。

examples.en: The difference between the two numbers gives you the profit.
examples.zh: 两个数字的差额就是你的利润。

examples.en: There's an age difference of six years between the boys (= one is six years older than the other).
examples.zh: 这两个男孩的年龄相差六岁。

examples.en: There is not much difference in price between the two brands.
examples.zh: 两个品牌的价格相差并不大。

examples.en: I'll lend you £500 and you'll have to find the difference (= the rest of the money that you need).
examples.zh: 我借给你 500 英镑，其余的你自己解决。

senses.def: a disagreement

examples.en: We have our differences, but she's still my sister.
examples.zh: 我们之间虽然不和，但她仍旧是我的妹妹。

examples.en: Why don't you settle your differences and be friends again?
examples.zh: 你们为什么不消除隔阂，言归于好呢？

examples.en: There was a difference of opinion over who had won.
examples.zh: 在谁获胜的问题上发生了争执。

senses.def: to stop not being friendly and become friends again

examples.en: After not speaking to each other for years, the two brothers decided to bury the hatchet.
examples.zh: 多年没有联系后，两兄弟决定冰释前嫌。

senses.def: a point that somebody wants to suggest is a difference when in fact it is not different at all

examples.en: His government did not brand them terrorists, but rather ‘an entity that supports terrorism’. That may prove to be a distinction without a difference.
examples.zh: 他的政府并没有将他们称为恐怖分子，而是将他们称为“支持恐怖主义的实体”。这可能被证明是一种没有区别的区别。

senses.def: to have an important effect on somebody/something; to make somebody feel better
senses.zh: 关系重大；大不相同；使更好受

examples.en: A few kind words at the right time make all the difference.
examples.zh: 在适当的时候说几句体贴话效果迥然不同。

examples.en: Just five minutes' exercise a day could make all the difference.
examples.zh: 每天锻炼 5 分钟就可以使你判若两人。

senses.def: to have an effect/no effect on somebody/something
senses.zh: 有（或没有、有些等）作用，关系，影响

examples.en: The rain didn't make much difference to the game.
examples.zh: 这场雨对比赛没多大影响。

examples.en: Your age shouldn't make any difference to whether you get the job or not.
examples.zh: 你能否得到这工作应该与你的年龄无关。

examples.en: Changing schools made a big difference to my life.
examples.zh: 转学对我的一生有着重大影响。

examples.en: What difference will it make if he knows or not?
examples.zh: 他知不知道有什么关系吗？

examples.en: I don't think it makes a lot of difference what colour it is (= it is not important).
examples.zh: 我认为颜色无关紧要。

examples.en: ‘Shall we go on Friday or Saturday?’ ‘It makes no difference (to me).’
examples.zh: “我们星期五还是星期六去？”“（我）无所谓。”

senses.def: used to say that you think the differences between two things are not important

examples.en: ‘That's not a xylophone, it's a glockenspiel.’ ‘Same difference.’
examples.zh: “那不是木琴而是钟琴。”“反正都差不多。”

senses.def: to agree to forget about your disagreements

examples.en: We need to sink our differences and present a united opposition to the plan.
examples.zh: 我们需要消除分歧并一致反对该计划。

senses.def: (when discussing a price, etc.) to agree on an amount that is at an equal distance between the two amounts that have been suggested

examples.en: I offered €200 but he wanted €300. In the end, we split the difference and I paid him €250.
examples.zh: 我出价 200 欧元，他想要 300 欧元。最后，双方各让一步，我付了他 250 欧元。

examples.en: I wanted to leave early and Ian wanted to leave late, so we split the difference and left at noon.
examples.zh: 我想早些离开，可伊恩想晚一点，于是我们折衷了一下中午走的。

senses.def: used to show that something is interesting or unusual

examples.en: The traditional backpack with a difference—it's waterproof.
examples.zh: 这个传统背包有个与众不同的特点，它能防水。

examples.en: If you want a holiday with a difference, come to Iceland.
examples.zh: 如果你想过一个别样的假期，到冰岛来吧。

senses.def: used to emphasize how much difference there is between two things

examples.en: There's a world of difference between liking someone and loving them.
examples.zh: 喜欢一个人和爱一个人有天壤之别。

senses.def: not the same as somebody/something; not like somebody/something else
senses.zh: 不同的；有区别的；有差异的

examples.en: American English is significantly different from British English.
examples.zh: 美式英语与英式英语有很大差异。

examples.en: It's slightly different to what I'm used to.
examples.zh: 这与我所习惯的略有不同。

examples.en: He's different than the rest.
examples.zh: 他与其他人不同。

examples.en: It's completely different now than it was a year ago.
examples.zh: 现在同一年前完全不一样了。

examples.en: People often give very different accounts of the same event.
examples.zh: 人们对同一件事的叙述常常大为不同。

examples.en: My son's terribly untidy; my daughter's no different.
examples.zh: 我儿子邋遢极了，女儿也不比他强。

examples.en: The room looks different without the furniture.
examples.zh: 没有了家具，这房间看上去就不一样了。

examples.en: Now he spoke in a different and kinder voice.
examples.zh: 现在他用一种不同的、更友善的声音说话。

examples.en: Let's try a different approach.
examples.zh: 让我们尝试一种不同的方法。

senses.def: separate and individual

examples.en: Each chapter deals with a different type of business.
examples.zh: 每一章讲述一种不同的业务。

examples.en: She offered us five different kinds of cake.
examples.zh: 她给我们提供了五种不同的蛋糕。

examples.en: We're helping society in many different ways.
examples.zh: 我们以多种不同的方式帮助社会。

examples.en: The programme was about customs in different parts of the country.
examples.zh: 这个节目介绍全国各地的风俗习惯。

examples.en: They are sold in many different colours.
examples.zh: 这些有多种颜色供选购。

examples.en: I looked it up in three different dictionaries.
examples.zh: 我分别在三本词典里查找过。

senses.def: unusual; not like other people or things

examples.en: ‘Did you enjoy the play?’ ‘Well, it was certainly different!’
examples.zh: “你喜欢这出戏吗？”“哦，的确不同凡响！”

senses.def: to be very different
senses.zh: 另外一回事；又是一回事；另当别论

examples.en: I know which area they live in, but whether I can find their house is a different matter.
examples.zh: 我知道他们住在哪一地区，但能不能找到他们的房子则是另外一回事了。

examples.en: That's a whole different matter.
examples.zh: 那完全是另一回事儿。

examples.en: I don't mind lizards, but snakes are a different matter.
examples.zh: 我不怕蜥蜴，但蛇就不同了。

senses.def: a completely different situation or person from the one previously mentioned
senses.zh: 另一码事；截然不同的人

senses.def: to have information or evidence that the opposite is true
senses.zh: 所知道的不是那么回事；所掌握的情况大不一样（或大相径庭）

examples.en: He says he doesn't care about what the critics write, but I know different.
examples.zh: 他说他并不在乎批评家的评论，可我知道不是那么回事。

senses.def: to behave in a different way from other people; to have different attitudes or ideas

examples.en: She was a gifted and original artist who marched to a different drummer.
examples.zh: 她有天赋，具独创性，是个与众不同的艺术家。

senses.def: to have different aims that cannot be achieved together without causing problems

examples.en: There are different considerations, often pulling in different directions.

senses.def: with nothing between something and the source of the heat or light

examples.en: The plant should not be placed in direct sunlight.
examples.zh: 这种植物不应置于阳光直射之下。

examples.en: Grilling involves subjecting the food to direct heat.
examples.zh: 烧烤涉及将食物直接加热。

senses.def: saying exactly what you mean in a way that nobody can pretend not to understand

examples.en: I asked him a direct question: ‘Did you do it?’
examples.zh: 我直接问了他一个问题：“你做到了吗？”

examples.en: He would not give a direct answer.
examples.zh: 他不会给出直接答案。

examples.en: Her response is refreshingly direct.
examples.zh: 她的回答直截了当，令人耳目一新。

examples.en: Their message is simple and direct: obesity kills.
examples.zh: 他们的信息简单而直接：肥胖致命。

examples.en: You'll have to get used to his direct manner.
examples.zh: 你可得慢慢习惯他这种直率的方式。

examples.en: I prefer a more direct approach.
examples.zh: 我更喜欢更直接的方法。

senses.group: saying what you mean 直爽

senses.def: clearly showing something

examples.en: There is no direct evidence for the beneficial effects of these herbs.
examples.zh: 没有直接证据表明这些草药有益处。

senses.def: exact

examples.en: That's the direct opposite of what you told me yesterday.
examples.zh: 那与你昨天告诉我的截然相反。

examples.en: a direct quote (= one using a person’s exact words)
examples.zh: 直接引语

senses.def: related through parents and children rather than brothers, sisters, aunts, etc.

examples.en: a direct descendant of the country’s first president
examples.zh: 该国第一任总统的嫡系后裔

examples.en: With his death, the direct male line of the House of Capet came to an end.
examples.zh: 随着他的去世，卡佩家族的直系男性世系也随之结束。

senses.def: to control or be in charge of somebody/something

examples.en: He was asked to take command and direct operations.
examples.zh: 他奉命统率并指挥作战行动。

examples.en: A police officer was directing traffic.
examples.zh: 一名警察在指挥交通。

examples.en: How much should the teacher guide and direct the students?
examples.zh: 老师应该在多大程度上指引学生？

examples.en: A new manager has been appointed to direct the project.
examples.zh: 已任命一位新经理来管理这项工程。

examples.en: The campaign was carefully directed from party central office.
examples.zh: 这次运动是由党中央办公室精心指导的。

senses.def: to be in charge of actors in a play or film, or musicians in a band, orchestra
senses.zh: 导演（戏剧或电影）；指挥（管弦乐队）

examples.en: She prefers to act rather than direct.
examples.zh: 她宁愿当演员，不愿当导演。

examples.en: He directed the school play.
examples.zh: 他导演了学校的戏剧。

examples.en: The film was written and directed by Sofia Coppola.
examples.zh: 这部电影是由索菲亚·科波拉创作和导演的。

examples.en: She now directs a large choir.
examples.zh: 她目前担任一个大合唱团的指挥。

senses.def: to aim something at a particular goal or person, or in a particular direction
senses.zh: 把…对准（某目标、某人或某方向）

examples.en: He directed his attention to the next task.
examples.zh: 他把注意力集中在下一项任务上。

examples.en: His anger was mostly directed towards Peter.
examples.zh: 他的愤怒主要针对彼得。

examples.en: All our efforts should be directed towards helping those who need it.
examples.zh: 我们应尽全力帮助那些需要帮助的人。

examples.en: Her criticism was directed at her own superiors.
examples.zh: 她的批评是针对自己的上级的。

examples.en: She directs her gaze straight at the viewer.
examples.zh: 她的目光直视观众。

examples.en: The book is directed at younger readers.
examples.zh: 这本书是针对年轻读者的。

examples.en: Most of his anger was directed against himself.
examples.zh: 他主要是生自己的气。

examples.en: He directed the light straight in her face.
examples.zh: 他把光直接打在她的脸上。

senses.def: to tell or show somebody how to get to somewhere or where to go
senses.zh: 给（某人）指路；为（某人）领路

examples.en: It's not far—I'll direct you.
examples.zh: 路不远，我指给你。

examples.en: Could you direct me to the station?
examples.zh: 请问到车站怎么走？

examples.en: He was directed to a table beside the window.
examples.zh: 他被带到一张靠窗的桌子。

examples.en: The app directs you along the best cycle route to your destination.
examples.zh: 该应用程序会引导您沿着最佳自行车路线到达目的地。

senses.def: to give an official order

examples.en: The police officers had been directed to search the building.
examples.zh: 警察奉命搜查这栋大楼。

examples.en: The judge directed that the mother be given custody of the children.
examples.zh: 法官判决孩子由母亲监护。

examples.en: The judge directed that the mother should be given custody of the children.
examples.zh: 法官判决孩子由母亲监护。

senses.def: to send a letter, etc. to a particular place or to a particular person

examples.en: Direct any complaints to the Customer Services department.
examples.zh: 将投诉寄至用户服务部。

examples.en: I directed my question to the chair.
examples.zh: 我向主席提出了问题。

examples.en: Enquiries should be directed to Mark Davis.
examples.zh: 如有疑问，请联系马克·戴维斯。

senses.def: without stopping or changing direction or vehicle

examples.en: We flew direct to Hong Kong.
examples.zh: 我们直飞香港。

examples.en: The 10.40 goes direct to Leeds.
examples.zh: 10:40 这班火车直达利兹。

examples.en: You can now fly direct from Birmingham airport.
examples.zh: 您现在可以从伯明翰机场直飞。

senses.def: without involving other people, or without anyone or anything in between

examples.en: I prefer to deal with him direct.
examples.zh: 我更愿意直接跟他打交道。

examples.en: an online retailer selling direct to consumers
examples.zh: 直接销售给消费者的在线零售商

examples.en: Customers can buy produce direct from the farmer.
examples.zh: 顾客可以直接从农民那里购买农产品。

examples.en: The money is paid direct into your bank account.
examples.zh: 钱直接存入您的银行账户。

synonyms.words: frank ▪ direct ▪ open ▪ outspoken ▪ straight ▪ blunt

intro.en: These words all describe people saying exactly what they mean without trying to hide feelings, opinions or facts.
intro.zh: 以上各词均形容人坦率、坦诚。

items.def: not hiding the truth about something:
items.zh: 指坦率的、坦诚的

examples.en: Thank you for being so honest with me.
examples.zh: 感谢你对我这么坦诚。

items.def: honest in what you say, sometimes in a way that other people might not like:
items.zh: 指坦率的、直率的（有时可能不讨人喜欢）

examples.en: To be frank with you, I think your son has little chance of passing the exam.
examples.zh: 坦白说，我认为你的儿子不大可能通过考试。

items.def: saying exactly what you mean in a way that nobody can pretend not to understand:
items.zh: 指直接的、直率的、坦率的

examples.en: You’ll have to get used to his direct manner.
examples.zh: 你得慢慢习惯他这种直率的方式。

items.def: (approving) (of a person) not keeping thoughts and feelings hidden:
items.zh: 指为人诚恳的、坦诚的、直率的

examples.en: He was quite open about his reasons for leaving.
examples.zh: 他对离开的原因完全未加隐瞒。

items.def: saying exactly what you think, even if this shocks or offends people:
items.zh: 指直率的、坦诚的、直言不讳的

examples.en: She was outspoken in her criticism of the plan.
examples.zh: 她对该计划的批评直言不讳。

items.def: honest and direct:
items.zh: 指坦诚的、直率的

examples.en: I don’t think you’re being straight with me.
examples.zh: 我觉得你没跟我坦诚相见。

items.def: saying exactly what you think without trying to be polite:
items.zh: 指嘴直的、直言不讳的

examples.en: She has a reputation for blunt speaking.
examples.zh: 她说话出了名的直截了当。

synonyms.words: lead ▪ escort ▪ drive ▪ show ▪ walk ▪ guide ▪ usher ▪ direct

intro.en: These words all mean to go with somebody from one place to another.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含带去、引领之义。

items.def: to go with somebody from one place to another, for example in order to show them something or to show them the way to a place:
items.zh: 指带去、带路、引领

examples.en: It’s too far to walk—I’ll take you by car.
examples.zh: 步行路太远，我开车送你去。

items.def: to go with or go in front of somebody in order to show them the way or to make them go in the right direction:
items.zh: 指带路、领路、引领

examples.en: Firefighters led the survivors to safety.
examples.zh: 消防队员把幸存者带到了安全的地方。

items.def: to go with somebody in order to protect or guard them or to show them the way:
items.zh: 指护卫、护送

examples.en: The President arrived, escorted by twelve bodyguards.
examples.zh: 总统在十二名保镖的护送下到达。

items.def: to take somebody somewhere in a car, taxi, etc:
items.zh: 指驾车送（人）

examples.en: My mother drove us to the airport.
examples.zh: 我母亲开车把我们送到了机场。

items.def: to take somebody to a particular place, in the right direction, or along the correct route:
items.zh: 指引领、带领

examples.en: The attendant showed us to our seats.
examples.zh: 服务员把我们带到我们的座位。

items.def: to go somewhere with somebody on foot, especially in order to make sure that they get there safely; to take an animal, especially a dog, for a walk or make an animal walk somewhere:
items.zh: 指陪伴或护送（人）走、牵着或赶着（动物）走、遛（狗）

examples.en: He always walked her home.
examples.zh: 他经常护送她走回家。

items.def: to show somebody the way to a place, often by going with them; to show somebody a place that you know well:
items.zh: 指给某人领路（或导游）、指引

examples.en: She guided us through the busy streets.
examples.zh: 她带领我们穿过了繁忙的街道。

items.def: (rather formal) to politely take or show somebody where they should go, especially within a building:
items.zh: 指礼貌地引往、引导、引领，尤指在建筑物内

examples.en: She ushered her guests to their seats.
examples.zh: 她把客人引领到座位上。

items.def: (rather formal) to tell or show somebody how to get somewhere or where to go:
items.zh: 指给某人指路、为某人领路

examples.en: A young woman directed them to the station.
examples.zh: 一名年轻女子给他们指了去车站的路。

intro.en: These words all mean to use your position of authority to say to somebody that they must do something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含命令、指挥、要求之义。

items.def: to use your position of authority to tell somebody to do something:
items.zh: 指命令、指挥、要求

examples.en: The company was ordered to pay compensation to its former employee.
examples.zh: 公司被勒令向以前的员工作出补偿。

items.def: to say to somebody that they must or should do something:
items.zh: 指命令、指示、吩咐

examples.en: He was told to sit down and wait.
examples.zh: 有人吩咐他坐下等着。

items.def: (rather formal) to tell somebody to do something, especially in a formal or official way:
items.zh: 尤指以正式或官方的方式指示、命令、吩咐

examples.en: The letter instructed him to report to headquarters immediately.
examples.zh: 那封信指示他立即向总部汇报。

items.def: (formal) to give an official order:
items.zh: 指正式发出指示、命令

examples.en: The judge directed the jury to return a verdict of not guilty.
examples.zh: 法官指示陪审团作出无罪裁决。

items.def: to use your position of authority to tell somebody to do something:
items.zh: 指命令、指挥、要求

examples.en: He commanded his men to retreat.
examples.zh: 他命令手下撤退。

senses.def: the ability to get data immediately from any part of a computer file
the use of strikes, protests, etc. instead of discussion in order to get what you want
senses.zh: 直接行动（用罢工、抗议等方式达到目的）

examples.en: Environmental groups are threatening direct action if plans for the new road go ahead.
examples.zh: 环保组织威胁称，如果新道路计划继续推进，他们将采取直接行动。

senses.def: an amount of money spent by a business on the materials and workers involved in making a product or providing a service
an electric current that flows in one direction only
an instruction to your bank to allow somebody else to take an amount of money from your account on a particular date, especially to pay bills

examples.en: We pay all our bills by direct debit.
examples.zh: 我们以直接借记方式支付所有账单。

senses.def: the system of moving money electronically from one bank account to another

examples.en: The school district pays teachers by direct deposit.
examples.zh: 学区通过直接存款向教师支付工资。

senses.def: the ability to make phone calls without needing to be connected by the operator

examples.en: All our rooms have direct dialling telephones.
examples.zh: 我们所有的房间都有直拨电话。

senses.def: the act of a person or organization from one country investing in a business in another country in order to get control of it
senses.zh: 对外直接投资；国外直接投资；外商直接投资

examples.en: The United States and Japan will work toward promoting more foreign direct investment in each other's markets.
examples.zh: 美国和日本将致力于加大对彼此市场的直接投资。

examples.en: The analysts said other countries could also increase their direct investments in Cuba.
examples.zh: 分析人士称其他国家也可能增加对古巴的直接投资。

senses.def: advertisements that are sent to people through the post

examples.en: Digital marketing and direct mail will both reach the target audience.
examples.zh: 数字营销和直邮都将到达目标受众。

examples.en: a direct mail campaign aimed at US small businesses
examples.zh: 针对美国小企业的直邮活动

senses.def: the business of selling products or services directly to customers who order by mail, phone or email, or over the internet, instead of going to a shop
senses.zh: 直接营销（通过邮寄、电话、电邮或互联网直接向顾客销售产品或服务）

examples.en: Direct marketing provides a number of ways to target specific individuals.
examples.zh: 直接营销提供了多种针对特定个人的方法。

senses.def: a private message that you send on social media
senses.zh: 在社交网站上发送的）私信

senses.def: a noun, noun phrase or pronoun that refers to a person or thing that is directly affected by the action of a verb

examples.en: In ‘I met him in town’, the word ‘him’ is the direct object.
examples.zh: 在 I met him in town 中，him 是直接宾语。

senses.def: government of a region by a central government, when that region has had its own government in the past
a speaker’s actual words; the use of these in writing

examples.en: Only direct speech should go inside inverted commas.
examples.zh: 只有直接引语应放在引号内。

senses.def: a tax that is collected directly from the person who pays it, for example income tax
a system in which tax is collected directly from the person who pays it, for example income tax

used to describe a business method in which a company makes a product, sells it directly to customers over the internet and delivers it to them, rather than selling through shops or using other companies to distribute the product

examples.en: This is one of the direct-to-consumer brands that created brand awareness through podcast advertising.
examples.zh: 这是通过播客广告建立品牌知名度的直接面向消费者的品牌之一。

senses.def: the general position a person or thing moves or points towards

examples.en: They headed in the direction of the village.
examples.zh: 他们朝村子的方向走去。

examples.en: She pointed in my direction.
examples.zh: 她指向我这边。

examples.en: They hit a truck coming in the opposite direction.
examples.zh: 他们撞上一辆迎面开来的卡车。

examples.en: The road was blocked in both directions.
examples.zh: 这条路往返方向都堵死了。

examples.en: The aircraft was flying in a northerly direction.
examples.zh: 飞机正向北飞去。

examples.en: in the right/wrong direction
examples.zh: 方向正确／错误

examples.en: When the police arrived, the crowd scattered in all directions.
examples.zh: 警察赶到后，人群便向四面八方散开了。

examples.en: Has the wind changed direction?
examples.zh: 风向变了吗？

examples.en: I lost all sense of direction (= I didn't know which way to go).
examples.zh: 我完全迷失了方向。

senses.def: instructions about how to do something, where to go, etc.
senses.zh: 用法说明；操作指南；旅行指南

examples.en: Let's stop and ask for directions.
examples.zh: 咱们停下来问问路吧。

examples.en: A farmer gave us directions to the town.
examples.zh: 一个农民给我们指明了去城里的方向。

examples.en: With all pesticides, follow the directions for use carefully.
examples.zh: 所有杀虫剂均应按照说明小心使用。

examples.en: Simple directions for assembling the model are printed on the box.
examples.zh: 模型装配的简要说明印在盒子上。

senses.def: the general way in which a person or thing develops

examples.en: The exhibition provides evidence of several new directions in her work.
examples.zh: 这个展览表明她的创作有几个新动向。

examples.en: I am very unhappy with the direction the club is taking.
examples.zh: 我对俱乐部的发展趋势很不满意。

examples.en: He wants to take the company in a different direction.
examples.zh: 他想把公司带向一个不同的方向。

examples.en: Do you feel your career is heading/headed in the right direction?
examples.zh: 您觉得您的职业生涯正朝着正确的方向发展吗？

examples.en: It's only a small improvement, but at least it's a step in the right direction.
examples.zh: 虽然这只是小小的改进，但至少是朝正确方向迈出的一步。

examples.en: The industry will continue to move in the direction of more automation.
examples.zh: 该行业将继续朝着更加自动化的方向发展。

examples.en: Do you think this represents a radical change of direction for the president?
examples.zh: 您认为这是否代表总统方向的根本转变？

senses.def: the general position a person or thing comes or develops from

examples.en: Support came from an unexpected direction.
examples.zh: 一个出人意料的来源提供了帮助。

examples.en: Let us approach the subject from a different direction.
examples.zh: 咱们从一个不同的角度来探讨这个题目吧。

senses.def: a purpose; an aim

examples.en: We are looking for somebody with a clear sense of direction.
examples.zh: 我们想找一个有明确目标的人。

examples.en: Once again her life felt lacking in direction.
examples.zh: 她的人生似乎又没了方向。

senses.def: the art of managing or guiding somebody/something

examples.en: She was entrusted with the direction of the project.
examples.zh: 她受委托负责这项计划。

examples.en: All work was produced by the students under the direction of John Williams.
examples.zh: 所有作品都是在约翰·威廉斯的指导下由学生创作完成的。

senses.def: the instructions given by somebody directing a film or play
senses.zh: （电影或戏剧导演的）指点，指导

examples.en: There is some clever direction and the film is very well shot.
examples.zh: 由于导演指导有方，影片拍得非常成功。

senses.def: to have different aims that cannot be achieved together without causing problems

examples.en: There are different considerations, often pulling in different directions.
examples.zh: 有各种不同的考虑，常令隔阂愈来愈深。

senses.def: to have different aims that cannot be achieved together without causing problems

examples.en: There are different considerations, often pulling in different directions.
examples.zh: 有各种不同的考虑，常令隔阂愈来愈深。

senses.def: the position to which a vehicle or a part of a machine moves

examples.en: The direction of travel of the sliding part is indicated by an arrow in the drawings.
examples.zh: 图中滑动部件的移动方向由箭头表示。

examples.en: I always prefer to face the direction of travel on a train.
examples.zh: 坐火车时我总是喜欢面朝行车方向。

senses.def: the end goal or point towards which a policy or strategy is moving

examples.en: Centralization is more a direction of travel than a fixed objective.
examples.zh: 权力集中与其说是既定目标，不如说是政策方向。

senses.def: producing or receiving signals, sound, etc. better in one particular direction
senses.zh: （发出或接收信号、声音等）定向的，指向的

examples.en: a directional microphone/aerial
examples.zh: 定向传声器／天线

senses.def: connected with the direction in which something is moving

examples.en: directional stability
examples.zh: 方向稳定性

senses.def: showing or influencing the latest trends in fashion

examples.en: a directional womenswear designer
examples.zh: 定向女装设计师

senses.def: without a direction or purpose
an official instruction

examples.en: a government directive banning mass gatherings
examples.zh: 禁止群众集会的政府指令

senses.def: giving instructions

examples.en: They are seeking a central, directive role in national energy policy.
examples.zh: 他们正寻求在国家能源政策方面起中心指导作用。

senses.def: without stopping or changing direction

examples.en: The path leads directly to the river.
examples.zh: 这条小路直接通向那条河。

examples.en: He drove her directly to her hotel.
examples.zh: 他驾车直接把她送到了她下榻的旅馆。

examples.en: The airline flies directly to Stockholm.
examples.zh: 该航空公司有直飞斯德哥尔摩的航班。

senses.def: with nobody or nothing in between
senses.zh: 直接的；无中间人（或物）的

examples.en: She speaks directly to camera.
examples.zh: 她直接对着镜头说话。

examples.en: She looked directly at us.
examples.zh: 她正视着我们。

examples.en: We have not been directly affected by the cuts.
examples.zh: 我们并未直接受到裁减的影响。

examples.en: directly linked/connected
examples.zh: 直接链接/连接

examples.en: diseases directly related to smoking
examples.zh: 与吸烟直接相关的疾病

examples.en: The president was not directly involved.
examples.zh: 总统没有直接参与。

examples.en: He was not directly responsible for the accident.
examples.zh: 他对事故没有直接责任。

examples.en: products that are delivered directly to consumers
examples.zh: 直接交付给消费者的产品

examples.en: problems either directly or indirectly caused by human error
examples.zh: 人为错误直接或间接引起的问题

examples.en: Your success in life is not directly proportional to the effort you make.
examples.zh: 你人生的成功与你付出的努力并不成正比。

senses.def: exactly in a particular position

examples.en: directly opposite/below/ahead
examples.zh: 正对面；正下方；正前方

examples.en: They remain directly opposed to these new plans.
examples.zh: 他们仍旧截然反对这些新方案。

senses.def: immediately

examples.en: She left directly after the show.
examples.zh: 演出一结束，她马上就走了。

senses.def: soon

examples.en: Tell them I'll be there directly.
examples.zh: 告诉他们我一会儿就到。

senses.def: as soon as

dishonest, secret and often illegal activity by a political group or other organization that is intended to harm the reputation or success of an opponent

examples.en: a dirty tricks campaign
examples.zh: 肮脏卑鄙的竞选运动

senses.def: an unpleasant and dishonest act

examples.en: What a dirty trick to play!
examples.zh: 玩的手段太卑鄙了！

senses.def: a weekend spent away with a sexual partner, often in secret
a word connected with sex in an offensive way

examples.en: He abused us with foul language and dirty words.
examples.zh: 他用脏话和脏话辱骂我们。

senses.def: to be a subject or an idea that people think is bad or morally wrong
senses.zh: 是个坏字眼；是个犯忌的话题（或想法）

examples.en: Profit is not a dirty word around here.
examples.zh: 在这里，赢利不是一个犯忌的字眼。

examples.en: Work is a dirty word to Frank.
examples.zh: 对弗兰克来说，工作是一个难听的字眼。

senses.def: to be a subject or an idea that people think is bad or morally wrong
senses.zh: 是个坏字眼；是个犯忌的话题（或想法）

examples.en: Profit is not a dirty word around here.
examples.zh: 在这里，赢利不是一个犯忌的字眼。

examples.en: Work is a dirty word to Frank.
examples.zh: 对弗兰克来说，工作是一个难听的字眼。

senses.def: to show a lack of respect for somebody, especially by saying offensive things to them

examples.en: If he disses me again, I’ll hit him.
examples.zh: 如果他再骂我，我就打他。

senses.def: not; the opposite of

examples.en: dishonest
examples.zh: 不诚实；腐败

examples.en: disagreeably
examples.zh: 不合意地

examples.en: disadvantage
examples.zh: 不利条件

examples.en: disappear
examples.zh: 消失

senses.def: a physical or mental condition that makes it difficult for somebody to do some things that most other people can do

examples.en: a physical/developmental/intellectual disability
examples.zh: 身体/发育/智力障碍

examples.en: people with invisible disabilities such as hearing loss
examples.zh: 患有听力损失等隐形残疾的人

senses.def: the state of having a physical or mental condition that makes it difficult to do some things that most other people can do
senses.zh: 身体或精神状况使人们难以做一些大多数人都能做的事情

examples.en: learning to live with disability
examples.zh: 学习在残疾状态下生活

examples.en: He qualifies for help on the grounds of disability.
examples.zh: 他因身有残疾有资格得到帮助。

senses.def: to injure or affect somebody permanently so that, for example, they cannot walk or cannot use a part of their body

examples.en: He was disabled in a car accident.
examples.zh: 他在车祸中残废了。

examples.en: a disabling condition
examples.zh: 导致残障的疾病

examples.en: The gunfire could kill or disable the pilot.
examples.zh: 炮火会使飞行员丧命或伤残。

senses.def: to make something unable to work so that it cannot be used

examples.en: The burglars gained entry to the building after disabling the alarm.
examples.zh: 窃贼破坏警报器后便得以进入大楼。

senses.def: a list of players on a sports team who are not able to play because of an injury
senses.zh: 伤病名单（因伤无法参加体育比赛的运动员名单）

examples.en: He will start the season on the disabled list.
examples.zh: 他将在伤病名单上开始本赛季。

senses.def: the state of being disabled

examples.en: The insurance policy covers sudden death or disablement.
examples.zh: 保险单为突然死亡或伤残保险。

senses.def: to tell somebody that what they think is true is, in fact, not true
senses.zh: 去掉（某人）的错误想法；使省悟

senses.def: to cause problems and tend to stop somebody/something from succeeding or making progress
senses.zh: 不利因素；障碍；不便之处

examples.en: Some pension plans may disadvantage women.
examples.zh: 有些养老金计划可能对妇女不利。

examples.en: Many people will be greatly disadvantaged by the new tax system.
examples.zh: 新的税制将造成许多人生活大为贫乏。

senses.def: something that causes problems and tends to stop somebody/something from succeeding or making progress
senses.zh: 不利因素；障碍；不便之处

examples.en: a serious/severe/significant disadvantage
examples.zh: 一个严重不利的条件

examples.en: One major disadvantage of the area is the lack of public transport.
examples.zh: 这个地区的一大不便之处就是缺少公共交通工具。

examples.en: What's the main disadvantage?
examples.zh: 主要的不利条件是什么？

examples.en: Each plan has its own advantages and disadvantages.
examples.zh: 每个计划都有其优点和缺点。

examples.en: There are disadvantages to the plan.
examples.zh: 这个计划有诸多不利因素。

examples.en: The fact that he didn't speak a foreign language put him at a distinct disadvantage.
examples.zh: 他不会说外语使他处于明显的不利地位。

examples.en: I was at a disadvantage compared to the younger members of the team.
examples.zh: 与队里较年轻的队员相比，我处于不利地位。

examples.en: Poor product quality can put a company at a competitive disadvantage.
examples.zh: 产品质量差会使公司处于竞争劣势。

examples.en: I hope my lack of experience won't be to my disadvantage.
examples.zh: 但愿我的经验不足不会使我吃亏。

examples.en: TV companies have basically bought football outright, to the complete disadvantage of the fans.
examples.zh: 电视公司基本上直接购买了足球，这对球迷来说完全不利。

examples.en: The advantages of the scheme far outweighed the disadvantages.
examples.zh: 这个计划的优点远远超过了缺点。

examples.en: Many children in the class suffered severe social and economic disadvantage.
examples.zh: 班上许多孩子社会地位低下，而且有经济困难。

senses.def: causing somebody to be in a worse situation compared to other people

examples.en: The deal will not be disadvantageous to your company.
examples.zh: 这项交易不会对你公司不利。

examples.en: Growing conditions here are disadvantageous.
examples.zh: 这里的生长条件很不利。

senses.def: no longer satisfied with your situation, organization, belief, etc. and therefore no longer supporting it

examples.en: Some disaffected members left to form a new party.
examples.zh: 部分不满的成员已脱党另立新党。

senses.def: the feeling of being no longer satisfied with your situation, organization, belief, etc. and therefore not supporting it

examples.en: There are signs of growing disaffection amongst voters.
examples.zh: 选民中出现日渐不满的迹象。

examples.en: The government’s response to popular disaffection has been simply to increase security.
examples.zh: 政府对民众不满的反应只是加强安全。

senses.def: to end the link between a group, a company or an organization and a larger one

examples.en: The local club has disaffiliated from the National Athletic Association.
examples.zh: 当地俱乐部已退出全国体育联合会。

senses.def: the act of ending the link between a group, a company or an organization and a larger one
to separate something into the different parts that it is made up of

examples.en: One recommendation for future research is disaggregating the data according to age.
examples.zh: 对未来研究的一个建议是将数据按年龄分类。

senses.def: if two people disagree
senses.zh: 不同意；持不同意见；有分歧

examples.en: Even friends disagree sometimes.
examples.zh: 即便是朋友有时也有分歧。

examples.en: No, I disagree. I don't think it would be the right thing to do.
examples.zh: 不，我不赞成。我认为这样做不合适。

examples.en: I must respectfully disagree with my colleague.
examples.zh: 我对同事的意见不敢苟同。

examples.en: Victoria and I obviously disagree on this issue.
examples.zh: 维多利亚和我对此事观点明显不同。

examples.en: He disagreed with his parents on most things.
examples.zh: 他在多数事情上都与父母意见不一。

examples.en: I'm afraid I disagree with you on that point.
examples.zh: 恐怕我在这一点上不同意你的观点。

examples.en: Experts disagree over whether the population will be a burden or a boon in the years ahead.
examples.zh: 对于未来几年人口将成为负担还是福音，专家们意见不一。

examples.en: Jack and Robert disagree about everything.
examples.zh: 杰克和罗伯特在任何事情上都意见不一。

examples.en: I strongly disagree with this decision.
examples.zh: 我强烈反对这个决定。

examples.en: to disagree with a statement/view/conclusion/policy
examples.zh: 不同意某项声明/观点/结论/政策

examples.en: Some people disagree with this argument.
examples.zh: 有些人不同意这一论点。

examples.en: Few would disagree that students learn best when they are interested in the topic.
examples.zh: 学生对自己感兴趣的题目学得最好，这一点几乎所有人都不会有异议。

senses.def: if statements or reports disagree

examples.en: The results of the two approaches disagree.
examples.zh: 两种方法的结果不一致。

examples.en: The two reports disagree on the number of people who will be affected by this change.
examples.zh: 两份报告对于受这一变化影响的人数存在分歧。

examples.en: Clinical diagnoses have frequently been reported to disagree with autopsy results.
examples.zh: 临床诊断经常被报道与尸检结果不一致。

senses.def: if two people agree to differ/disagree
senses.zh: 同意各自保留不同意见

examples.en: We must just agree to differ on this.
examples.zh: 我们必须同意在这一点上存在不同意见。

examples.en: In the end we agreed to disagree.
examples.zh: 最后我们同意不同意。

examples.en: I think you're wrong. Let's just agree to differ.
examples.zh: 我认为你是错的。咱们还是各自保留不同意见吧。

senses.def: if two people agree to differ/disagree
senses.zh: 同意各自保留不同意见

examples.en: We must just agree to differ on this.
examples.zh: 我们必须同意在这一点上存在不同意见。

examples.en: In the end we agreed to disagree.
examples.zh: 最后我们同意不同意。

examples.en: I think you're wrong. Let's just agree to differ.
examples.zh: 我认为你是错的。咱们还是各自保留不同意见吧。

senses.def: if something, especially food, disagrees
senses.zh: （尤指食物）对（某人）不适宜，使不舒服

senses.def: to believe that something is bad or wrong; to disapprove

examples.en: I disagree with violent protests.
examples.zh: 我不赞成暴力抗议。

senses.def: not nice or pleasant

examples.en: a disagreeable smell/experience/job
examples.zh: 难闻的气味；令人不快的经历；不合意的工作

senses.def: rude and unfriendly

examples.en: a disagreeable bad-tempered man
examples.zh: 一个脾气不好难以相处的男人

examples.en: Are you always as disagreeable as this when you don’t get what you want?
examples.zh: 当你没有得到你想要的东西时，你是否总是像这样不愉快？

examples.en: a rather disagreeable woman
examples.zh: 一个相当令人讨厌的女人

senses.def: in a way that is not nice or pleasant

examples.en: The weather was disagreeably hot.
examples.zh: 天气热得令人难受。

senses.def: in a rude and unfriendly way

examples.en: His friend grunted disagreeably.
examples.zh: 他的朋友不悦地哼了一声。

senses.def: a situation where people have different opinions about something and often argue

examples.en: Disagreement arose about exactly how to plan the show.
examples.zh: 在如何拟订具体演出计划的问题上出现了分歧。

examples.en: disagreement on the method to be used
examples.zh: 在要采用的方法上的争论

examples.en: There's no room for disagreement on this point.
examples.zh: 在这一点上没有任何分歧的余地。

examples.en: There is considerable disagreement over the safety of the treatment.
examples.zh: 这种疗法是否安全争论很大。

examples.en: We are in total disagreement as to how to proceed.
examples.zh: 对于如何进行，我们完全不同意。

examples.en: It was a source of disagreement between the two states.
examples.zh: 这就是两国纷争的一个根源。

examples.en: There is disagreement among archaeologists as to the age of the sculpture.
examples.zh: 考古学家在这尊雕塑的年代问题上意见不一。

examples.en: They have had several disagreements with their neighbours.
examples.zh: 他们与邻居发生过好几次争吵。

examples.en: He shook his head in disagreement.
examples.zh: 他不赞同地摇了摇头。

senses.def: a difference between two things that should be the same

examples.en: The comparison shows considerable disagreement between theory and practice.
examples.zh: 这一对比表明理论和实践之间有相当大的出入。

senses.def: to officially refuse to accept something because it has not been done in the correct way

examples.en: to disallow a claim/an appeal
examples.zh: 不接受要求；驳回上诉

examples.en: The second goal was disallowed.
examples.zh: 第二个进球被判无效。

examples.en: The court will disallow evidence obtained through torture.
examples.zh: 法庭不会采信通过酷刑获得的证据。

senses.def: to show clearly the difference between two or more words, phrases, etc. which are similar in meaning
to become impossible to see

examples.en: With that, Matt promptly disappeared.
examples.zh: 说完，马特瞬间消失了。

examples.en: The mirror made the ceiling seem to disappear.
examples.zh: 镜子让天花板似乎消失了。

examples.en: The plane disappeared behind a cloud.
examples.zh: 飞机消失在云层里。

examples.en: Lisa watched until the train disappeared from view.
examples.zh: 莉萨一直看着火车从视线中消失。

examples.en: Lucy watched his tall figure disappear into the cafe.
examples.zh: 露西看着他高大的身影消失在咖啡馆里。

senses.def: to stop existing

examples.en: Her nervousness quickly disappeared once she was on stage.
examples.zh: 她一上台紧张情绪便迅速消失了。

examples.en: The problem won't just disappear.
examples.zh: 这个问题不会就这样不了了之的。

examples.en: Our countryside is disappearing at an alarming rate.
examples.zh: 我们的农村地区正在以惊人的速度消亡。

examples.en: Wildlife is fast disappearing from our countryside.
examples.zh: 野生动物正迅速从我们的乡村消失。

examples.en: These fish have virtually disappeared from their traditional waters.
examples.zh: 这些鱼实际上已经从它们的传统水域中消失了。

senses.def: to be lost or impossible to find

examples.en: I can never find a pen in this house. They disappear as soon as I buy them.
examples.zh: 我在家里从来找不到一支笔。每次我一买来就不翼而飞。

examples.en: Then one day he simply disappeared.
examples.zh: 然后有一天他就消失了。

examples.en: The plane mysteriously disappeared over the Indian Ocean.
examples.zh: 这架飞机在印度洋上空神秘失踪。

examples.en: The child disappeared from his home some time after four.
examples.zh: 这孩子四点多的时候就离家不见了。

senses.def: if a person is disappeared
senses.zh: 使消失，使不存在（因政治原因拘捕或关押）；秘密（或非法）除掉

examples.en: 10 000 people have been disappeared and over 160 000 displaced.
examples.zh: 已有 10 000 人失踪，逾 160 000 人流离失所。

examples.en: One month later, he was disappeared by the regime.
examples.zh: 一个月之后，他被政府带走后失踪。

senses.def: to remove something secretly or illegally so that it cannot be found

examples.en: In the last five years, nearly 5 000 companies have been disappeared from the registry.
examples.zh: 这五年来，已有近 5 000 家公司的注册信息消失。

examples.en: Soon after the blog post went up, someone disappeared it.
examples.zh: 那篇博文发出后不久即被人删除。

senses.def: to disappear completely
senses.zh: 完全消失；消逝得无影无踪

examples.en: Keep looking—they can't just have vanished off the face of the earth.
examples.zh: 继续找，他们不可能就从此消失得无影无踪的。

senses.def: to disappear suddenly in a mysterious way
senses.zh: 消失得无影无踪；不翼而飞；悄然而逝

examples.en: She can’t just have vanished into thin air.
examples.zh: 她不可能凭空消失。

examples.en: At a stroke she could make things vanish into thin air.
examples.zh: 她用手碰到什么就能让它消失不见。

senses.def: to go away or be impossible to find when people need or want you

examples.en: The cat had done a disappearing act.
examples.zh: 那只猫玩起了失踪。

items.idm: disappear/vanish off the face of the earth

senses.zh: 完全消失；消逝得无影无踪

examples.en: At a stroke she could make things vanish into thin air.

examples.zh: 那只猫玩起了失踪。

senses.def: to disappear suddenly in a mysterious way

senses.def: to disappear completely
senses.zh: 完全消失；消逝得无影无踪

examples.en: Keep looking—they can't just have vanished off the face of the earth.
examples.zh: 继续找，他们不可能就从此消失得无影无踪的。

disappear/vanish off the face of the ear.word: disappear/vanish off the face of the earth

senses.def: the fact of being lost or impossible to find

examples.en: Police are investigating the disappearance of a young woman.
examples.zh: 警方正在调查一名年轻女子失踪的案件。

examples.en: a series of mysterious disappearances
examples.zh: 一系列神秘失踪事件

senses.def: the fact of no longer existing; the fact of becoming impossible to see
senses.zh: 失踪：不再存在的事实；变得看不见

examples.en: the disappearance of many species of plants and animals from our planet
examples.zh: 我们这颗行星上许多动植物物种的消失

senses.def: to make somebody feel sad because something that they hope for or expect to happen does not happen or is not as good as they hoped

examples.en: Her decision to cancel the concert is bound to disappoint her fans.
examples.zh: 她决定取消这场音乐会，肯定会使她的歌迷失望。

examples.en: I hate to disappoint you, but I'm just not interested.
examples.zh: 我不想使你扫兴，但我确实不感兴趣。

examples.en: The movie had disappointed her (= it wasn't as good as she had expected).
examples.zh: 这部电影使她失望。

examples.en: I hate to disappoint the children when they've been looking forward to it so much.
examples.zh: 当孩子们如此期待的时候，我不想让他们失望。

examples.en: His latest novel does not disappoint.
examples.zh: 他最近的一部小说没有使人失望。

examples.en: It disappointed me that nobody bothered to say thank you.
examples.zh: 我很失望，所有人都懒得说声谢谢。

senses.def: to prevent something that somebody hopes for from becoming a reality

examples.en: The new government had soon disappointed the hopes of many of its supporters.
examples.zh: 新政府不久便使许多支持者的希望破灭了。

examples.en: If he agrees to the deal he will disappoint the expectations of many colleagues.
examples.zh: 如果他同意这笔交易，他将辜负许多同事的期望。

senses.def: in a disappointed way

examples.en: ‘Is that it?’ she asked disappointedly.
examples.zh: “就这个吗？”她失望地问。

examples.en: Disappointedly we walked away.
examples.zh: 我们失望地走开了。

senses.def: in a way that is not as good, successful, etc. as you had hoped
senses.zh: 令人失望地，让人沮丧地

examples.en: The room was disappointingly small.
examples.zh: 房间小得令人失望。

senses.def: the feeling of being sad because something has not happened or been as good, successful, etc. as you expected or hoped

examples.en: Book early for the show to avoid disappointment.
examples.zh: 欲看演出，从速订票，以免向隅。

examples.en: To our great disappointment, it rained every day of the trip.
examples.zh: 这次旅行天天下雨，让我们大失所望。

examples.en: He found it difficult to hide his disappointment when she didn't arrive.
examples.zh: 她没有来，他感到很难掩饰自己内心的沮丧。

senses.def: a person or thing that is disappointing
senses.zh: 使人失望的人（或事物）；令人扫兴的人（或事物）

examples.en: a bitter/major disappointment
examples.zh: 令人极度失望／大失所望的事

examples.en: That new restaurant was a big disappointment.
examples.zh: 那家新餐馆使人大失所望。

examples.en: He's suffered a whole string of disappointments this week.
examples.zh: 他本周遇到一连串不如意的事。

examples.en: I always felt I was a disappointment to my father.
examples.zh: 我总觉得我使父亲失望了。

senses.def: disapproval
senses.zh: （对不道德的人或事的）反对，不认可

senses.def: a feeling that you do not like an idea, an action or somebody’s behaviour because you think it is bad, not suitable or going to have a bad effect on somebody else

examples.en: to show/express disapproval
examples.zh: 表明／表示反对

examples.en: disapproval of his methods
examples.zh: 不赞同他的方法

examples.en: He shook his head in disapproval.
examples.zh: 他摇了摇头，表示反对。

examples.en: She looked at my clothes with disapproval.
examples.zh: 她不满意地看着我的衣服。

senses.def: to think that somebody/something is not good or suitable; to not approve of somebody/something

examples.en: She wants to be an actress, but her parents disapprove.
examples.zh: 她想当演员，可是她父母不同意。

examples.en: He strongly disapproved of the changes that had been made.
examples.zh: 他强烈反对已进行的变革。

examples.en: A solid majority disapproves the way the president is handling the controversy.
examples.zh: 大多数人都反对总统处理争论的方式。

senses.def: to officially refuse to agree to a plan, request, etc.

examples.en: Parents should get the option to approve or disapprove a child's online purchase.
examples.zh: 家长应该可以选择批准或拒绝孩子的在线购买。

senses.def: in a way that shows that you do not approve of somebody/something
senses.zh: 不赞成的；表示反对的；不以为然的

examples.en: He looked disapprovingly at the row of empty wine bottles.
examples.zh: 他用责备的目光看着那一排空酒瓶。

senses.def: to take a weapon or weapons away from somebody
senses.zh: 缴（某人）的械；解除（某人）的武装

examples.en: Most of the rebels were captured and disarmed.
examples.zh: 大部分叛乱分子被俘获并解除了武装。

senses.def: to reduce the size of an army or to give up some or all weapons, especially nuclear weapons
senses.zh: 裁军；裁减军备（尤指核武器）

examples.en: The government was reluctant to disarm.
examples.zh: 政府不愿意解除武装。

senses.def: to make somebody feel less angry or critical
senses.zh: 消释（某人）的怒气（或批评）

examples.en: He disarmed her immediately by apologizing profusely.
examples.zh: 他一再向她道歉，很快便消解了她的怒气。

examples.en: The best way to disarm your critics is to make them laugh.
examples.zh: 使批评你的人息怒的最好办法是让他们哈哈大笑。

senses.def: the fact of a country reducing the size of its armed forces or the number of weapons, especially nuclear weapons, that it has
senses.zh: 裁军；裁减军备（尤指核武器）

examples.en: They campaigned for nuclear disarmament.
examples.zh: 他们发起了要求核裁军的运动。

examples.en: disarmament talks
examples.zh: 裁军谈判

senses.def: in a way that makes people feel less angry or likely to suspect somebody than they were before
senses.zh: 使人消气的；解人疑虑的

examples.en: She was disarmingly frank about her behaviour.
examples.zh: 她对自己的行为坦诚得令人放心。

senses.def: to make something untidy
a lack of order or organization in a situation or a place

examples.en: The peace talks broke up in disarray.
examples.zh: 和谈在混乱中破裂了。

examples.en: Our plans were thrown into disarray by her arrival.
examples.zh: 我们的计划因她的到来而陷入一片混乱。

examples.en: We’re decorating, so everything’s in complete disarray at home.
examples.zh: 我们正在装修，家里的一切都乱七八糟。

senses.def: to take apart a machine or structure so that it is in separate pieces

examples.en: We had to completely disassemble the engine to find the problem.
examples.zh: 我们只好把发动机全部拆开以寻找故障原因。

senses.def: to translate something from computer code into a language that can be read by humans
senses.zh: 反汇编（将计算机编码译成普通语言）

senses.def: to move apart and go away in different directions

examples.en: The concert ended and the crowd disassembled.
examples.zh: 音乐会结束，人群便散去了。

senses.def: a program used to disassemble
to say or do something to show that you are not connected with or do not support somebody/something; to make it clear that something is not connected with a particular plan, action, etc.
senses.zh: 否认同…有关系；声明不支持；表明无关

senses.def: an unexpected event, such as a very bad accident, a flood or a fire, that kills a lot of people or causes a lot of damage

examples.en: the world's worst humanitarian disaster
examples.zh: 世界上最严重的人道主义灾难

examples.en: an environmental/ecological disaster
examples.zh: 环境／生态灾难

examples.en: a rail/mining/tsunami disaster
examples.zh: 铁路/采矿/海啸灾难

examples.en: Thousands died in the disaster.
examples.zh: 数千人在这场灾祸中丧生。

examples.en: They provided more than $2.3 billion in disaster relief.
examples.zh: 他们提供了超过 23 亿美元的救灾款。

examples.en: It was taking years for disaster victims to settle and rebuild.
examples.zh: 灾民花了数年时间才安顿下来并进行重建。

examples.en: Given the threat of earthquake, we recognized the need for disaster recovery centres.
examples.zh: 鉴于地震的威胁，我们认识到建立灾难恢复中心的必要性。

senses.def: a very bad situation that causes problems

examples.en: Losing your job doesn't have to be such a disaster.
examples.zh: 丢了工作不一定就是大难临头。

examples.en: Disaster struck when the wheel came off.
examples.zh: 车轮脱落，灾难就来了。

examples.en: Archie has to act quickly to avert disaster.
examples.zh: 阿奇必须迅速采取行动以避免灾难。

examples.en: They could think of no way to avoid the impending disaster.
examples.zh: 他们想不出有什么办法可以避免即将发生的灾难。

examples.en: Many business partnerships end in disaster.
examples.zh: 许多商业伙伴关系都以灾难告终。

examples.en: The discovery of the disease among sheep spells financial disaster for farmers.
examples.zh: 在绵羊中发现这种疾病，预示农民将蒙受巨大的经济损失。

examples.en: Letting her organize the party is a recipe for disaster (= something that is likely to go badly wrong).
examples.zh: 让她来组织这次聚会非坏事不可。

senses.def: a complete failure

examples.en: As a teacher, he's a disaster.
examples.zh: 他当老师压根儿就不称职。

examples.en: The play's first night was a total disaster.
examples.zh: 这出戏头一晚就彻底演砸了。

examples.en: a complete/total/absolute/unmitigated disaster
examples.zh: 一场彻底的/彻底的/绝对的/彻底的灾难

senses.def: a thing or person that is very likely to cause danger or a problem in the future because of the condition it is in or the way they behave

examples.en: Any one of these nuclear plants may be a disaster waiting to happen.
examples.zh: 这些核电厂中的任何一个都可能会成为灾难隐患。

items.idm: an accident/a disaster waiting to happen

senses.def: a thing or person that is very likely to cause danger or a problem in the future because of the condition it is in or the way they behave

examples.en: Any one of these nuclear plants may be a disaster waiting to happen.
examples.zh: 这些核电厂中的任何一个都可能会成为灾难隐患。

senses.def: a place where a disaster has happened and that needs special help

examples.en: Only rescue workers are allowed into the disaster area.
examples.zh: 只允许救援人员进入灾难现场。

examples.en: The area has been declared a disaster zone.
examples.zh: 该地区被宣布为受灾地区。

senses.def: a place or situation that has a lot of problems, is a failure, or is badly organized
senses.zh: 问题成堆的地方；灾难性局面

examples.en: Housing is another disaster area for the government.
examples.zh: 住房是政府的另一个灾区。

examples.en: His office was a disaster area with papers piled everywhere.
examples.zh: 他的办公室是一个灾区，文件堆满了各处。

senses.def: very bad, harmful or unsuccessful
senses.zh: 极糟糕的；灾难性的；完全失败的

examples.en: a disastrous harvest/fire/result
examples.zh: 严重歉收／火灾；灾难性的结果

examples.en: Lowering interest rates could have disastrous consequences for the economy.
examples.zh: 降低利率可能给经济带来灾难性后果。

examples.en: It was a disastrous start to the season for the team.
examples.zh: 对于该队来说，这是本赛季一次灾难性的开局。

senses.def: in a way that is very bad, harmful or unsuccessful
senses.zh: 极糟糕的；灾难性的；完全失败的

examples.en: How could everything go so disastrously wrong?
examples.zh: 怎么会事事都出这么大的乱子？

senses.def: to state publicly that you have no knowledge of something or that you are not responsible for something/somebody
senses.zh: 不承认；否认；拒绝对…承担责任

examples.en: They disavowed claims of a split in the party.
examples.zh: 他们否认了党内出现分裂的说法。

senses.def: the act of stating publicly that you have no knowledge of something or that you are not responsible for something/somebody
senses.zh: 不承认；否认；拒绝对…承担责任

examples.en: He never made a public disavowal of violence.
examples.zh: 他从未公开否认暴力。

senses.def: to stop somebody/something from operating as a group; to separate or no longer operate as a group

examples.en: They set about disbanding the terrorist groups.
examples.zh: 他们开始解散恐怖主义组织。

examples.en: The committee formally disbanded in August.
examples.zh: 委员会于八月份正式解散。

senses.def: the act of no longer operating as a group; the act of making somebody/something no longer operate as a group

examples.en: They have called for the disbandment of the paramilitary group.
examples.zh: 他们呼吁解散该准军事组织。

senses.def: to stop a lawyer from working in the legal profession, especially because they have done something illegal

examples.en: He was disbarred from the practice of law in Florida.
examples.zh: 他被取消了在佛罗里达州的律师执业资格。

examples.en: She was in danger of being disbarred after allegations of fraud.
examples.zh: 在被指控欺诈后，她面临着被取消律师资格的危险。

senses.def: the fact or process of stopping a lawyer from working in the legal profession, especially because they have done something illegal

examples.en: He faced disbarment for misconduct.
examples.zh: 他因行为不当而面临吊销资格。

examples.en: The disbarment case against her is still pending.
examples.zh: 针对她的取消律师资格案件仍在审理中。

senses.def: the feeling of not being able to believe something

examples.en: He stared at me in disbelief.
examples.zh: 他满腹疑惑地盯着我。

examples.en: To enjoy the movie you have to suspend your disbelief (= pretend to believe something, even if it seems very unlikely).
examples.zh: 这部电影要看得有乐趣，就得暂且相信那些不合常理的情节。

senses.def: to not believe that something is true or that somebody is telling the truth

examples.en: Why should I disbelieve her story?
examples.zh: 我为什么要怀疑她的说法呢？

examples.en: He had come to disbelieve his own assertions.
examples.zh: 他开始怀疑自己的断言。

examples.en: We have no reason to disbelieve the information.
examples.zh: 我们没有理由不相信这些信息。

senses.def: to not believe that something exists
in a way that shows that you do not believe that something is true or that somebody is telling the truth
to pay money to somebody from a large amount that has been collected for a purpose

examples.en: The funds were to be disbursed in two instalments.
examples.zh: 资金将分两期支付。

examples.en: The regional council disburses grants to local writers.
examples.zh: 地区委员会向当地作家发放补助金。

senses.def: the process of paying money to somebody from a large amount that has been collected for a purpose; an amount of money paid

examples.en: There have been delays in the disbursement of funds.
examples.zh: 资金的支付出现了延误。

examples.en: Several countries have pledged aid disbursements to the region.
examples.zh: 一些国家已承诺向该地区提供援助。

senses.def: a thin flat round object

examples.en: He wears an identity disc around his neck.
examples.zh: 他脖子上挂着圆形身份牌。

examples.en: In a total eclipse, the moon completely covers the disc of the sun.
examples.zh: 出现日全食时，月亮将日轮完全遮住。

senses.def: a CD or DVD
senses.zh: 光盘；激光唱片；数字光盘；数字影碟

examples.en: This disc contains lots of extra features, including an interview with the director.
examples.zh: 这张光盘包含许多额外的功能，包括对导演的采访。

examples.en: This recording is available online or on disc.
examples.zh: 这录音可在线获取，也可购买激光唱片。

examples.en: The series comes as a two-disc box set with three episodes on each disc.
examples.zh: 该剧以两张光盘盒形式发售，每张光盘包含三集。

examples.en: There are lots of extras on this disc.
examples.zh: 这张光盘上有很多额外内容。

senses.def: a disk for a computer

examples.en: He inserted the disc into the machine.
examples.zh: 他把唱片插入机器。

senses.def: a record

examples.en: I have an old vinyl disc of her singing.
examples.zh: 我有一张她的黑胶老唱片。

senses.def: a structure made of cartilage
a brake
an outdoor sport in which players try to throw a plastic disc into a series of metal wire containers in as few turns as possible, played with rules similar to golf
senses.zh: 飞盘高尔夫（规则类似高尔夫，以尽量少的投掷数将飞盘投入金属筐）

examples.en: They have opened a disc golf course which has proved very popular.
examples.zh: 他们开了一个飞盘高尔夫球场，已经非常受欢迎。

senses.def: a person whose job is to introduce and play recorded popular music, on radio or television or at a club, party, etc.
senses.zh: （电台、电视台等的）唱片节目主持人；（俱乐部、聚会等的）打碟师

senses.def: to get rid of something that you no longer want or need

examples.en: The room was littered with discarded newspapers.
examples.zh: 房间里到处是乱扔的报纸。

examples.en: He had discarded his jacket because of the heat.
examples.zh: 因天气炎热他脱掉了夹克。

examples.en: She could now discard all thought of promotion.
examples.zh: 她现在可以打消晋升的念头了。

examples.en: 10 per cent of the data was discarded as unreliable.
examples.zh: 10% 的数据因不可靠而被废弃。

senses.def: to get rid of a card that you do not want
a person or thing that is not wanted or that is thrown away, especially a card in a card game
senses.zh: 被抛弃的人（或物）；（尤指纸牌游戏中的）弃牌

senses.def: to know, recognize or understand something, especially something that is not obvious

examples.en: It is possible to discern a number of different techniques in her work.
examples.zh: 从她的作品中可以辨别出许多不同的创作手法。

examples.en: He discerned a certain coldness in their welcome.
examples.zh: 他觉察到他们的接待有点冷淡。

examples.en: It is often difficult to discern how widespread public support is.
examples.zh: 了解公众支持的广泛程度常常是困难的。

examples.en: I quickly discerned that something was wrong.
examples.zh: 我很快觉察到出了问题。

senses.def: to see or hear something, usually with difficulty

examples.en: We could just discern the house in the distance.
examples.zh: 我们只能勉强分辨出远处的房子。

examples.en: She could clearly discern a figure walking up towards the house.
examples.zh: 她清楚地看见一个人影正走近那幢房子。

senses.def: that can be recognized or understood

examples.en: There is often no discernible difference between rival brands.
examples.zh: 竞争品牌之间通常没有明显的差别。

senses.def: that can be seen or heard, but not very clearly

examples.en: His face was barely discernible in the gloom.
examples.zh: 在黑暗中很难看得清他的脸。

senses.def: the ability to show good judgement about the quality of somebody/something

examples.en: He shows great discernment in his choice of friends.
examples.zh: 他选择朋友很有眼光。

examples.en: She is a woman of the highest taste and discernment.
examples.zh: 她是一位具有最高品味和洞察力的女人。

senses.def: to give somebody official permission to leave the police or the armed forces; to make somebody leave the police or the armed forces
senses.zh: （警察机关或军队）批准（某人）退役，使（某人）退出

examples.en: He was discharged from the army following his injury.
examples.zh: 他受伤后就退伍了。

examples.en: She was discharged from the police force for bad conduct.
examples.zh: 她因行为不端被清除出警察队伍。

examples.en: He was found guilty and dishonourably discharged from the army.
examples.zh: 他被判有罪，遭开除军籍。

senses.group: from the police/army 警方；军队

senses.def: to allow somebody to leave hospital because they are well enough to leave

examples.en: Patients were being discharged from the hospital too early.
examples.zh: 病人都过早获准出院。

examples.en: All the people involved in the accident have now been discharged from hospital.
examples.zh: 目前，事故涉案人员全部已出院。

examples.en: She had discharged herself against medical advice.
examples.zh: 她不听医嘱擅自出院了。

senses.def: to allow somebody to leave prison or court

examples.en: He was conditionally discharged after admitting the theft.
examples.zh: 他承认偷盗行为后被有条件地释放了。

examples.en: She was formally discharged by the court.
examples.zh: 她被法庭正式释放。

senses.def: to allow a member of a jury
senses.zh: 使（陪审团成员）退出；解散（陪审团）

examples.en: If the jury cannot agree, it should be discharged.
examples.zh: 如果陪审团不能达成一致意见，就应该解散。

examples.en: The judge took the unusual step of discharging the entire jury halfway through the trial.
examples.zh: 法官采取了不同寻常的措施，在审判中途解雇了整个陪审团。

senses.def: when a gas or a liquid discharges

examples.en: The river is diverted through the power station before discharging into the sea.
examples.zh: 这条河改道经水电站后流入大海。

examples.en: The factory was fined for discharging chemicals into the river.
examples.zh: 这家工厂因往河里排放化学物质而被罚款。

examples.en: Raw sewage was discharged from the treatment plant directly into the river.
examples.zh: 未经处理的污水从处理厂直接排入河中。

senses.def: if part of the body discharges

examples.en: The wound started discharging pus.
examples.zh: 伤口开始流脓。

senses.def: to release force or power

examples.en: Lightning is caused by clouds discharging electricity.
examples.zh: 闪电是由云层放电产生的。

senses.def: to do everything that is necessary to perform and complete a particular duty

examples.en: to discharge your duties/responsibilities/obligations
examples.zh: 履行职责／责任／义务

examples.en: to discharge a debt (= to pay it)
examples.zh: 清偿债务

senses.def: to fire a gun, etc.; (of a gun, etc.) to be fired

examples.en: The police officer accidentally discharged a firearm while unloading it.
examples.zh: 警察在卸弹时不慎走火。

examples.en: They gave a cheer and charged, discharging a volley of arrows as they came.
examples.zh: 他们欢呼一声，发起冲锋，同时射出一排箭。

examples.en: He knocked her hand down and the gun discharged into the floor.
examples.zh: 他打倒了她的手，枪掉到了地板上。

senses.def: the action of releasing a substance such as a liquid or gas; a substance that comes out from inside somewhere

examples.en: a ban on the discharge of toxic waste
examples.zh: 禁止有毒废物的排放

examples.en: nasal/vaginal discharge (= from the nose/ vagina)
examples.zh: 鼻涕；阴道分泌物

examples.en: a thick discharge from the nose
examples.zh: 鼻腔流出的浓稠分泌物

senses.def: the release of electricity from a charged

examples.en: thunder and lightning caused by electrical discharges
examples.zh: 由放电产生的雷电

senses.def: the act of officially allowing somebody, or of telling somebody, to leave the police or the army

examples.en: The illness resulted in his discharge from the army.
examples.zh: 这场病导致他从部队退伍。

examples.en: His quick discharge came as a surprise to everyone.
examples.zh: 他的快速出院令所有人都感到惊讶。

senses.group: from the police/army 警方；军队

senses.def: the act of allowing somebody to leave hospital because they are well enough to leave

examples.en: Referrals can be discussed before discharge from hospital.
examples.zh: 出院前可对病人转诊进行讨论

senses.def: the act of allowing somebody to leave prison or court

examples.en: He was given an absolute discharge but banned from driving for twelve months.
examples.zh: 他获得无条件释放，但 12 个月内禁止开车。

senses.def: the act of performing a task or a duty or of paying money that is owed
senses.zh: （任务或职责的）履行，执行；（债务的）清偿

examples.en: the discharge of debts/obligations
examples.zh: 债务的清偿；义务的履行

examples.en: Arrangements have been made for the discharge of mortgage payments.
examples.zh: 已作出偿还抵押贷款的安排。

senses.def: the action of firing a gun, etc.

examples.en: an accidental discharge from a dropped gun
examples.zh: 枪掉在地上走火

senses.def: a person who believes in and follows the teachings of a religious or political leader

examples.en: a disciple of the economist John Maynard Keynes
examples.zh: 经济学家约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯的信徒

senses.def: (according to the Bible) one of the people who followed Jesus Christ and his teachings when he was living on earth, especially one of the twelve apostles

examples.en: John, the beloved disciple of Jesus
examples.zh: 耶稣的爱徒约翰

senses.def: a person who believes in using rules and punishments for controlling people
senses.zh: 严格纪律信奉者；严格执行纪律者

examples.en: She's a very strict disciplinarian.
examples.zh: 她执行纪律非常严格。

senses.def: connected with the punishment of people who break rules
senses.zh: 有关纪律的；执行纪律的；惩戒性的

examples.en: a disciplinary hearing (= to decide if somebody has done something wrong)
examples.zh: 纪律审讯

examples.en: The company will be taking disciplinary action against him.
examples.zh: 公司将对他进行纪律处分。

examples.en: She will have to explain her actions before the disciplinary committee.
examples.zh: 她必须向纪律委员会解释自己的行为。

senses.def: connected with an area of knowledge, especially a subject that people study in a university

examples.en: Students need to broaden and deepen their disciplinary knowledge.
examples.zh: 学生需要拓宽和深化他们的学科知识。

senses.def: the practice of training people to obey rules and orders and punishing them if they do not; the controlled

examples.en: The school has a reputation for high standards of discipline.
examples.zh: 这所学校因纪律严格而名闻遐迩。

examples.en: Strict discipline is imposed on army recruits.
examples.zh: 新兵受严格的纪律约束。

examples.en: harsh/rigorous/rigid/iron discipline
examples.zh: 严厉/严格/严格/铁的纪律

examples.en: She keeps good discipline in class.
examples.zh: 她严格执行课堂纪律。

examples.en: to instill/enforce/impose/maintain discipline
examples.zh: 灌输/执行/施加/维持纪律

examples.en: Lack of discipline at home meant that many pupils found it difficult to settle into the ordered environment of the school.
examples.zh: 家里缺乏纪律意味着许多学生很难融入学校有序的环境。

examples.en: a serious breach of discipline
examples.zh: 严重违纪

senses.def: a method of training your mind or body or of controlling your behaviour; an area of activity where this is necessary
senses.zh: 训练方法；行为准则；符合准则的行为

examples.en: Yoga is a good discipline for learning to relax.
examples.zh: 瑜伽是一种学习放松的有效方法。

senses.def: the ability to control your behaviour or the way you live, work, etc.

examples.en: He'll never get anywhere working for himself—he's got no discipline.
examples.zh: 他自己做事是不会有什么成就的——他毫无自制力。

examples.en: Her determination and discipline were admirable.
examples.zh: 她的决心和纪律令人钦佩。

senses.def: an area of knowledge; a subject that people study or are taught, especially in a university

examples.zh: 我出门时开着灯以防夜贼闯入。

examples.zh: 他的父母试图阻止他去当演员。

examples.zh: 尽管遇到这么多挫折，她仍不气馁。

intro.zh: 以上各词均指人粗鲁、无礼。

examples.zh: 你为什么对你的母亲这么没礼貌？

examples.zh: 有些人说他在最近一次讲话中对总统不尊重。
