intro.en: These words all mean to remove dirt from something, especially by using water and/​or soap.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含打扫、洗净之义，尤指用水、肥皂等。

items.def: to remove dirt or dust from something, especially by using water or chemicals:
items.zh: 指除去灰尘、打扫，尤指用水或化学品洗净、擦净

examples.en: The villa is cleaned twice a week.
examples.zh: 这栋别墅一周打扫两次。

items.def: to remove dirt from something using water and usually soap:
items.zh: 指洗、洗涤

examples.en: He quickly washed his hands and face.
examples.zh: 他很快把手和脸洗了。

items.def: to remove dirt, etc. from something using clean water only, not soap; to remove the soap from something with clean water after washing it:
items.zh: 指用清水冲洗、清洗、冲掉皂液

examples.en: Make sure you rinse all the soap out.
examples.zh: 一定要把皂液冲洗干净。

items.def: to clean your skin or a wound.
items.zh: 指清洁（皮肤）、清洗（伤口）

items.def: to clean clothes using chemicals instead of water.
items.zh: 指干洗

senses.def: a shop where clothes, curtains, etc. are cleaned, especially with chemicals
preserved with dry salt, rather than with water that contains salt
senses.zh: 干固化：用干盐保存，而不是用含盐的水保存

senses.def: an area in a port from which the water can be removed, used for building or repairing ships

examples.en: The ship is in dry dock.
examples.zh: 这艘船停在干船坞里。

examples.en: The boat is now ready to be moved to a dry dock.
examples.zh: 该船现已准备好移至干船坞。

senses.def: not crying

examples.en: She remained dry-eyed throughout the trial.
examples.zh: 整个审讯过程中她没掉一滴眼泪。

senses.def: types of food that are solid and dry, such as tea, coffee and flour
cloth and things that are made out of cloth, such as clothes and sheets

examples.en: a dry goods store
examples.zh: 纺织品商店

senses.def: solid carbon dioxide
land, rather than sea

examples.en: It was a great relief to be back on dry land after such a rough crossing.
examples.zh: 渡过汹涌澎湃的大海回到陆地后使人感到如释重负。

examples.en: It was good to be on dry land again after months at sea.
examples.zh: 在海上漂泊数月之后又回到陆地，真是太好了。

senses.def: dried milk in the form of a powder
to become dry or make something dry

examples.en: We went swimming and then lay in the sun to dry off.
examples.zh: 我们去游泳了，然后就躺在太阳下晒干。

examples.en: We dried our boots off by the fire.
examples.zh: 我们把靴子放在火旁烘干。

senses.def: to stop drinking alcohol after you have continuously been drinking too much; to cure somebody of drinking too much alcohol

examples.en: He went to an expensive clinic to dry out.
examples.zh: 他到一家费用昂贵的诊所戒酒瘾。

senses.def: to become or to allow something to become dry, often in a way that is not wanted

examples.en: Water the plant regularly, never letting the soil dry out.
examples.zh: 经常给植物浇水，别让土壤干透了。

examples.en: Hot sun and cold winds can soon dry out your skin.
examples.zh: 火辣辣的太阳和寒风可使你的皮肤很快变干燥。

examples.en: We left the wood in the shed to dry out.
examples.zh: 我们把木头留在棚子里让它干透。

senses.def: cooked in an oven without adding oil or fat
senses.zh: 干烤的，干焙的（不加油脂）

examples.en: dry-roasted peanuts
examples.zh: 干烤花生

senses.def: wood that has decayed
any fungus
a complete practice of a performance or way of doing something, before the real one
a steep slope with an artificial surface for practising skiing
a period of time when it does not rain

examples.en: The long dry spell resulted in severe drought conditions in 13 states of the country.
examples.zh: 长时间无雨导致该国 13 个州严重干旱。

senses.def: a period of time during which somebody is unable to succeed at something

examples.en: That year, he struggled through a six-month dry spell in which he lost 17 consecutive matches.
examples.zh: 那一年，他经历了一段痛苦的低迷期，6 个月里连续 17 场比赛失利。

senses.def: to become completely dry

examples.en: During the drought the river dried up.
examples.zh: 旱灾期间，河流都干涸了。

senses.def: if a supply of something dries up

examples.en: I found that offers of acting work started to dry up.
examples.zh: 我发现表演工作的机会开始枯竭。

examples.en: Funds have completely dried up.
examples.zh: 资金都用完了。

senses.def: to suddenly stop talking because you do not know what to say next
senses.zh: （因不知该说什么而）突然住口，突然说不出话来

examples.en: The play was going very well until one of the actors suddenly dried up.
examples.zh: 这部戏进展得很顺利，直到其中一位演员突然干涸了。

senses.def: to dry dishes with a towel after you have washed them

examples.en: I'll wash and you can dry up.
examples.zh: 我洗盘子，你来擦干。

senses.def: (in stories) a female spirit who lives in a tree
a machine for drying something

examples.en: a hairdryer
examples.zh: 吹风机

examples.en: Don’t put that sweater in the dryer.
examples.zh: 不要将那件毛衣放入烘干机中。

senses.def: a method of farming in areas where there is very little rain, which involves growing crops that do not need much water
if somebody speaks dryly
senses.zh: 干：如果有人说话干，他们是幽默的，但不是在一个明显的方式

examples.en: ‘That's a lovely purple suit you're wearing,’ she said dryly.
examples.zh: “你穿的是一套可爱的紫色西装，”她干巴巴地说。

senses.def: in a way that shows no emotion
senses.zh: 冷冰冰地；冷淡地；不动感情地

examples.en: He smiled dryly and leaned back in his chair.
examples.zh: 他干巴巴地笑了笑，靠在椅子上。

senses.def: in a way that shows that there is no liquid present

examples.en: She coughed dryly.
examples.zh: 她干咳一声。

examples.en: He swallowed dryly and nodded.
examples.zh: 他干巴巴地咽了口口水，点点头。

senses.def: the state of not being wet, or of having no water or moisture

examples.en: The medicine may cause dryness of the mouth.
examples.zh: 该药可能会导致口干。

senses.def: the state of not getting very much rain

examples.en: The result of this summer's dryness was a poor harvest.
examples.zh: 今年夏天干旱的结果是歉收。

senses.def: the state of not having the natural oils that makes skin or hair soft and healthy

examples.en: ingredients that help prevent skin dryness
examples.zh: 有助于防止皮肤干燥的成分

senses.def: the quality in wine of being not sweet

examples.en: These terms refer to the wine's dryness.
examples.zh: 这些术语指的是葡萄酒的干度。

senses.def: the quality in humour of being very clever and expressed in a quiet way that is not obvious

examples.en: Not everyone appreciated the dryness of his humour.
examples.zh: 并不是所有人都欣赏他的冷幽默。

senses.def: the quality, especially in writing, of not being very exciting or interesting

examples.en: He defended her prose against the charge of dryness.
examples.zh: 他为她的散文辩护，反对她的散文枯燥的指控。

senses.def: a stone wall built without mortar
a piece of clothing that fits the whole body and keeps water out, worn by people swimming underwater
a building material made of two sheets of thick paper with plaster
Distinguished Service Cross
digital subscriber line

an official notice from the British government advising the press not to publish certain information because it would harm the country if it were to be made public. 'DSMA' stands for ''Defence and Security Media Advisory'. Until 1993 DSMA-notices
senses.zh: DSMA通知（英国政府向媒体发出的国安机密通知，要求其不得发布某些信息…）

senses.def: Distinguished Service Order
daylight saving time
a school subject in which students learn about the role of technology in modern life and also design and make things for themselves (the abbreviation for ‘
senses.zh: 设计与科技（学校科目，讲授技术在现代生活中的作用以及实用设计技巧，全写为 design and technology）

senses.def: desktop publishing
senses.zh: 桌面出版（用小型计算机和打印机从事出版业务）

senses.def: a physical condition that affects people who regularly drink too much alcohol when they stop drinking alcohol for a while; they feel their body shaking and imagine that they are seeing things that are not really there (the abbreviation for ‘
senses.zh: （酗酒者在戒断期出现的）震颤性谵妄（全写为 delirium tremens）

senses.def: very popular or important now
senses.zh: 流行的；热门的；当下重要的

examples.en: This age group is the target group du jour.
examples.zh: 这个年龄组是眼下受关注的目标组。

examples.en: What are the hot social media platforms du jour?
examples.zh: 当下热门的社交媒体平台有哪些？

senses.def: having two parts or aspects

examples.en: his dual role as composer and conductor
examples.zh: 他兼任作曲家和指挥的双重角色

examples.en: She has dual nationality (= is a citizen of two different countries).
examples.zh: 她具有双重国籍。

examples.en: The piece of furniture serves a dual purpose as a cupboard and as a table.
examples.zh: 这件家具有两个用途，既作橱柜也作饭桌。

senses.def: a road with a narrow piece of land in the middle that divides the lines of traffic moving in opposite directions
senses.zh: （中央有分隔带的）双幅车行道，双向车道

examples.en: Follow the dual carriageway and you'll see signs for the turn-off.
examples.zh: 沿着双车道行驶，您会看到岔路标志。

examples.en: Go across the A403 dual carriageway at the traffic lights.
examples.zh: 在红绿灯处穿过 A403 双车道。

examples.en: He was caught driving the wrong way down the dual carriageway.
examples.zh: 他因在双向车道上逆行被抓。

senses.def: having two sets of instruments so that a teacher, for example, can take control from the driver or pilot
senses.zh: （车辆或飞机的）复式控制装置，复式操纵装置

examples.en: a dual-control vehicle
examples.zh: 有复式操纵装置的汽车

senses.def: two sets of instruments for controlling a vehicle or aircraft, so that a teacher, for example, can take control from the driver
senses.zh: （车辆或飞机的）复式控制装置，复式操纵装置

senses.def: the fact of having a family background in which your parents come from two different countries, cultures, religions, ethnic groups
senses.zh: 双重传统;双重文化传承

examples.en: Many young Londoners are of dual heritage.
examples.zh: 许多年轻的伦敦人都有双重血统。

examples.en: I'm someone who has dual heritage: I'm Somali and Welsh.
examples.zh: 我是一个拥有双重血统的人：我是索马里人和威尔士人。

examples.en: The group represents Irish people with dual heritage.
examples.zh: 该团体代表具有双重血统的爱尔兰人。

examples.en: dual-heritage children
examples.zh: 双重血统儿童

examples.en: people with a dual-heritage background
examples.zh: 具有双重血统的人

senses.def: that can be used for two different purposes

examples.en: a dual-purpose vehicle (= for carrying passengers or goods)
examples.zh: 两用汽车（载客或载货）

examples.en: The church is a modern dual-purpose building, both a place of worship and a community centre.
examples.zh: 教堂是一座现代化的双用途建筑，既是礼拜场所，又是社区中心。

senses.def: the theory that there are two opposite principles in everything, for example good and evil
the state of having two parts
a person who believes in the theory that there are two opposite principles in everything, for example good and evil
connected with the theory that there are two opposite principles in everything, for example good and evil
connected with the theory that there are two opposite principles in everything, for example good and evil
the state of having two parts or aspects
a first name for boys
to give somebody/something a particular name, often in a humorous or critical way

examples.en: The media dubbed anorexia ‘the slimming disease’.
examples.zh: 媒体称厌食症为“瘦身病”。

examples.en: Genetically modified products have been dubbed ‘Frankenfoods’ in the popular press.
examples.zh: 转基因产品被大众媒体称为“弗兰肯食品”。

senses.def: to replace the original speech in a film or television programme with words in another language
senses.zh: 为（影片或电视节目）配音；译制

examples.en: an American movie dubbed into Italian
examples.zh: 用意大利语配音的美国影片

senses.def: to make a piece of music by mixing sounds from different recordings
a version of the speech in a film or television programme in which the original words are replaced with words spoken in another language; the work of creating this version
senses.zh: 电影或电视节目中的演讲版本，其中原始单词被用另一种语言所说的单词替换；创建此版本的工作

examples.en: We met the actors who voice the main characters in the English dub of the series.
examples.zh: 我们见到了为该系列的英文配音中的主要角色配音的演员。

senses.def: a type of West Indian music or poetry with a strong beat
senses.zh: （西印度群岛的）强节奏音乐，强节拍诗歌

senses.def: a substance rubbed into leather to make it softer and more waterproof
senses.zh: 达宾（dubbin）：一种涂在皮革上的物质，使其柔软和防水

senses.def: the fact of being uncertain
not certain about something and suspecting that something may be wrong; not knowing whether something is good or bad

examples.en: I was rather dubious about the whole idea.
examples.zh: 我对这整个想法持怀疑态度。

examples.en: Kate looked dubious, but did as she was asked.
examples.zh: 凯特看上去半信半疑，但还是按要求的做了。

senses.def: probably not honest
senses.zh: 可疑的；不可信的；靠不住的；不诚实的

examples.en: They indulged in some highly dubious business practices to obtain their current position in the market.
examples.zh: 他们采取了一些极为可疑的商业手段以取得目前在市场上的地位。

examples.en: The man who sold it to him was known to be of dubious character.
examples.zh: 那个卖东西给他的男人出了名的不可靠。

senses.def: that you cannot be sure about; that is probably not good

examples.en: They consider the plan to be of dubious benefit to most families.
examples.zh: 他们认为这项计划对大多数家庭不一定有好处。

examples.en: The town has the dubious honour of having the highest burglary rate in England (= it is not really an honour).
examples.zh: 该镇拥有全英格兰入室盗窃率最高的殊荣。

senses.def: in an uncertain way, often because you suspect that something may be wrong; without knowing whether something is good or bad
senses.zh: 怀疑地：以不确定的方式，通常是因为您怀疑某些地方可能有问题；不知道可疑的东西是好是坏（1）

examples.en: Helen looked at him dubiously.
examples.zh: 海伦疑惑地看着他。

senses.def: in a way that is probably dishonest
senses.zh: 可疑地：以一种可能是不诚实的

examples.en: Under the terms of the deal, the billionaires would be allowed to keep their dubiously acquired fortunes.
examples.zh: 根据交易条款，亿万富翁将被允许保留他们可疑获得的财富。

senses.def: in a way that is probably not good
senses.zh: 怀疑地：以一种可能不好的方式

examples.en: He entered the country on dubiously authentic travel documents.
examples.zh: 他以可疑的真实旅行证件进入该国。

senses.def: the capital city of the Republic of Ireland, located on its east coast on the River Liffey. Dublin was the scene of the 1916 Easter Rising
senses.zh: 都柏林（爱尔兰共和国首都，位于东海岸，利菲河畔。1916 年爆发反抗英国的复活节起义。英国对爱尔兰的统治直到 1922 年才告结束，其政治中心位于 13 世纪建造的都柏林城堡。许多伟大的作家和诗人来自都柏林，包括乔纳森 · 斯威夫特、奥斯卡 · 王尔德、萧伯纳、W · B · 叶芝和詹姆斯 · 乔伊斯）

senses.def: a shellfish
a radioactive
a type of strong red wine that is often mixed with other drinks
senses.zh: 一种浓烈的红酒，经常与其他饮料混合使用

senses.def: a type of electronic dance music, developed in England in the late 1990s, that has a strong bass
senses.zh: 回响贝斯（一种电子舞曲，20 世纪 90 年代末兴起于英格兰，有重复性的重低音节奏和鼓点节拍，有时含歌唱）

senses.def: a US town on the Mississippi River
senses.zh: 迪比克（Dubuque）：爱荷华州密西西比河上的美国小镇。它有时被称为一个无聊的美国小社区的典型例子。《纽约客》的一位作家曾经说过，这不是“迪比克的老太太”的杂志。

senses.def: of or belonging to a duke

examples.en: the ducal palace in Rouen
examples.zh: 位于鲁昂的公爵宫。

senses.def: (in the past) a gold coin used in many European countries
senses.zh: 达克特（旧时在多个欧洲国家通用的金币）

senses.def: the wife of a duke

examples.en: the Duchess of York
examples.zh: 约克公爵夫人

senses.def: a woman who has the rank of a duke
an area of land that is owned and controlled by a duke

examples.en: the Duchy of Cornwall
examples.zh: 康沃尔公爵领地

senses.def: a common bird that lives on or near water and has short legs, webbed

examples.en: wild ducks
examples.zh: 野鸭

examples.en: duck eggs
examples.zh: 鸭蛋

examples.en: Every afternoon they went to the park to feed the ducks.
examples.zh: 每天下午他们都去公园喂鸭子。

examples.en: Ducks were quacking noisily on the lake.
examples.zh: 湖面上鸭子嘎嘎叫，很吵闹。

senses.def: a female duck
meat from a duck

examples.en: roast duck with orange sauce
examples.zh: 烤鸭蘸橘子酱

examples.en: Slice the duck breast and serve.
examples.zh: 把鸭胸脯切成薄片后端上来。

examples.en: In a large saucepan, melt the duck fat.
examples.zh: 在一个大平底锅里，将鸭油熔化。

senses.def: a friendly way of speaking to somebody
senses.zh: （表示友好的称呼）乖乖，宝贝儿

examples.en: Anything else, duck?
examples.zh: 还有别的事吗，宝贝儿？

senses.def: a batter

examples.en: He was out for a duck.
examples.zh: 他因得了零分而出局。

senses.def: a plan, an event, etc. that has failed or is certain to fail and that is therefore not worth discussing
senses.zh: 已失败（或注定要失败、毫无讨论价值）的计划（或事情等）

senses.def: to have made all the preparations needed to do something; to be well organized
senses.zh: 为某事做充分准备；把事情安排得井井有条

examples.en: The company has its ducks in a row for a move into the Asian market.
examples.zh: 该公司为进军亚洲市场做好了准备。

examples.en: Get your ducks in a row before you retire.
examples.zh: 在你退休之前把你的事情安排好。

senses.def: (to become used to something) very easily, without any problems or fears
senses.zh: 像鸭子入水般容易，轻而易举，毫不困难，毫无畏惧（习惯于某事）

examples.en: She has taken to teaching like a duck to water.
examples.zh: 她教起书来驾轻就熟。

senses.def: used to say that something, especially criticism, has no effect on somebody/something

examples.en: I can't tell my son what to do; it's water off a duck's back with him.
examples.zh: 我无法告诉我儿子该做什么，他根本听不进去。

senses.def: to move your head or body downwards to avoid being hit or seen
senses.zh: 低下头，弯下身（以免被打中或看见）

examples.en: He had to duck as he came through the door.
examples.zh: 他穿过门口时得弯下身来。

examples.en: We ducked down behind the wall so they wouldn't see us.
examples.zh: 我们弓身躲在墙后不让他们看见。

examples.en: He ducked under the overhanging branches.
examples.zh: 他躲在悬垂的树枝下。

examples.en: He just managed to duck out of sight.
examples.zh: 他总算躲开了别人的视线。

examples.en: She ducked her head and got into the car.
examples.zh: 她低着头进了汽车。

examples.en: She ducked under the railings and ran towards him.
examples.zh: 她躲到栏杆下，朝他跑去。

senses.def: to avoid something by moving your head or body out of the way

examples.en: He ducked the first few blows then started to fight back.
examples.zh: 他躲开最先几拳后便开始反击。

senses.def: to move somewhere quickly, especially in order to avoid being seen
senses.zh: 迅速行进，飞快行走（以免被看见）

examples.en: She ducked into the adjoining room as we came in.
examples.zh: 我们进来时她转身躲进了隔壁房间。

senses.def: to avoid a difficult or unpleasant duty or responsibility
senses.zh: 逃避，回避，推脱，推诿（职责或责任）

examples.en: It's his turn to cook dinner, but I bet he'll try to duck out of it.
examples.zh: 轮到他做饭了，但我敢打赌他会想方设法逃避的。

examples.en: The government is ducking the issue.
examples.zh: 政府在回避这个问题。

senses.def: to push somebody underwater

examples.en: The kids were ducking each other in the pool.
examples.zh: 孩子们在池塘里相互把对方按入水中。

senses.def: a plan, an event, etc. that has failed or is certain to fail and that is therefore not worth discussing
senses.zh: 已失败（或注定要失败、毫无讨论价值）的计划（或事情等）

items.idm: get/have (all) your ducks in a row

senses.def: to have made all the preparations needed to do something; to be well organized
senses.zh: 为某事做充分准备；把事情安排得井井有条

examples.en: The company has its ducks in a row for a move into the Asian market.
examples.zh: 该公司为进军亚洲市场做好了准备。

examples.en: Get your ducks in a row before you retire.
examples.zh: 在你退休之前把你的事情安排好。

items.idm: (take to something) like a duck to water

senses.def: (to become used to something) very easily, without any problems or fears
senses.zh: 像鸭子入水般容易，轻而易举，毫不困难，毫无畏惧（习惯于某事）

examples.en: She has taken to teaching like a duck to water.
examples.zh: 她教起书来驾轻就熟。

senses.def: used to say that something, especially criticism, has no effect on somebody/something

examples.en: I can't tell my son what to do; it's water off a duck's back with him.

examples.zh: 我的妻子在前十分钟后就想躲开。

senses.def: a problem that is easy to deal with, or an opponent who is easy to defeat
senses.zh: 容易处理的问题；容易打败的对手

senses.def: long narrow wooden boards used to make a path over wet ground
senses.zh: （用窄长木板做铺在湿地上的）铺道板，垫路板

senses.def: a young duck
a game in which you make flat stones bounce
a very small plant that grows on the surface of still water
a friendly way of speaking to somebody
senses.zh: （表示友好的称呼）乖乖，宝贝儿

senses.def: very pleasant
senses.zh: 顺心如愿的；令人十分愉快的

examples.en: Everything is just ducky.
examples.zh: 一切顺顺当当的。

senses.def: a pipe or tube carrying liquid, gas, electric or phone wires, etc.
senses.zh: （传送液体、气体、电线、电话线等的）管道，管子

examples.en: a heating/ventilation duct
examples.zh: 暖气导管；通风道

examples.en: Air flows through the ventilation ducts.
examples.zh: 空气流过通风管道。

examples.en: They managed to get out of the building by crawling through a ventilation duct.
examples.zh: 他们设法顺着通风管道爬出了大楼。

senses.def: a tube in the body or in plants through which liquid passes
senses.zh: （人体或植物体内输送液体的）管，导管

senses.def: very strong cloth tape that is waterproof
senses.zh: 强力胶布（常用于维修或粘贴管道漏洞）

senses.def: that can be made into a thin wire
senses.zh: 可拉成细丝的；可延展的；有延性的

senses.def: a system of ducts
material in the form of a duct

examples.zh: 一小截管状材料

senses.def: a thing that has no use, especially because it does not work correctly

examples.en: Two of the fireworks in the box were duds.
examples.zh: 盒子里的烟火有两个是点不着的废品。

senses.def: clothes
that has no use; that does not work correctly
senses.zh: 无用的；不中用的；出故障的

examples.zh: 废电池

examples.zh: 他真是个帅哥。

examples.en: She stormed out in high dudgeon.
examples.zh: 她怒气冲冲地走了。

senses.def: (1935-2002) an English comedian
senses.zh: 达德利·摩尔（Dudley Moore）：（1935-2002）英国喜剧演员，演员和音乐家，在美国生活了很长时间。他首先成为《边缘艺术》中的表演者之一，然后成为彼得·库克（Peter Cook）的合伙人，参加了1960年代和1970年代的一些热门电视喜剧系列，包括《不仅如此》（1965-71）。在1970年代后期，他成为喜剧电影的电影明星，例如10（1979）和Arthur（1980）。他还以钢琴家而闻名，在音乐会和电视上演奏爵士乐和古典音乐。

senses.def: caused by somebody/something; because of somebody/something

examples.en: The team's success was largely due to her efforts.
examples.zh: 这个队的成功主要是她努力的结果。

examples.en: He argues that climate change is mainly due to the actions of industrialized countries.
examples.zh: 他认为，气候变化主要是工业化国家的行为造成的。

examples.en: The increase in reported cases is partly due to growing public awareness of the disease.
examples.zh: 报告病例的增加部分是由于公众对该疾病的认识不断增强。

examples.en: This increase is due in part to the strong economy.
examples.zh: 这一增长的部分原因是强劲的经济。

examples.en: Most of the problems were due to human error.
examples.zh: 多数问题都是人为错误造成的。

examples.en: The delay to the flight was due to the fact that there was ice on the runway.
examples.zh: 航班延误的原因是跑道上有冰。

examples.en: The project had to be abandoned due to a lack of government funding.
examples.zh: 这项工程由于缺乏政府的资助而不得不放弃。

examples.en: Due to staff shortages, we are unable to offer a full buffet service on this train.
examples.zh: 由于人手不足，本次列车无法提供全套餐饮服务。

senses.def: arranged or expected

examples.en: When's the baby due?
examples.zh: 宝宝什么时候出世？

examples.en: The next train is due in five minutes.
examples.zh: 下一班火车预定在五分钟后抵达。

examples.en: My essay's due next Friday (= it has to be given to the teacher by then).
examples.zh: 我的论文下周五必须交。

examples.en: Rose is due to start school in January.
examples.zh: 罗斯一月份就要开始上学了。

examples.en: The band's first album is due for release later this month.
examples.zh: 这个乐队的第一张唱片预定在本月下旬发行。

senses.def: when a sum of money is due

examples.en: Payment is due on 1 October.
examples.zh: 付款期限为 10 月 1 日。

examples.en: Membership fees are now due for the coming year.
examples.zh: 现在需要缴纳来年的会员费。

senses.def: owed to somebody as a debt, because it is their right or because they have done something to deserve it

examples.en: Have they been paid the money that is due to them?
examples.zh: 他们应得的钱付给他们了吗？

examples.en: Our thanks are due to the whole team.
examples.zh: 我们要向全队致谢。

senses.def: owed something; deserving something

examples.en: I'm still due 15 days' leave.
examples.zh: 我还应有 15 天的休假。

examples.en: She's due for promotion soon.
examples.zh: 她很快该晋升了。

senses.def: that is suitable or right in the circumstances

examples.en: After due consideration, we have decided to appoint Mr Davis to the job.
examples.zh: 经过适当考虑之后，我们决定委任戴维斯先生负责这项工作。

examples.en: Due allowance should be made for inexperience.
examples.zh: 应适当考虑缺乏经验的情况。

examples.en: He was charged with driving without due care and attention.
examples.zh: 他被控鲁莽驾驶。

senses.def: to give somebody the praise they deserve, even if you do not really want to

examples.en: Give credit where credit is due—what the man does, he does well.
examples.zh: 有功必奖——这个人做事做得很好。

senses.def: at the right time and not before
senses.zh: 在适当的时候；到一定的时候

examples.en: Your request will be dealt with in due course.
examples.zh: 你的要求将在适当的时候予以处理。

senses.def: used when you are going to disagree, usually quite strongly, with somebody
senses.zh: （通常在表示强烈不同意之前说）恕我直言

examples.en: With all due respect, the figures simply do not support you on this.
examples.zh: 恕我直言，这些数字根本不能支持你的观点。

examples.en: With all due respect, I think you've misunderstood what he said.
examples.zh: 我无意冒犯，但我认为你误解了他的话。

senses.def: a thing that should be given to somebody by right
senses.zh: 应有的权利；应得到的东西

examples.en: He received a large reward, which was no more than his due (= than what he deserved).
examples.zh: 他得到重赏，这也是他应该得到的。

examples.en: She's a slow worker, but to give her her due (= to be fair to her), she does try very hard.
examples.zh: 她做事很慢，但说句公道话，她确实很尽力。

senses.def: charges, for example to be a member of a club

examples.en: to pay your dues
examples.zh: 缴你的会费

examples.en: trade union dues
examples.zh: 工会会费

senses.def: to work hard and gain experience, so that you deserve success or respect
senses.zh: 付出应有的努力（以赢得成功或尊敬）

examples.en: As a young actor, he paid his dues in small roles.
examples.zh: 作为一名年轻演员，他在小角色中付出了自己的代价。

examples.en: She is incredibly qualified and has paid her dues to become president.
examples.zh: 她非常有资格，并为成为总统付出了应有的代价。

senses.def: to do what is required or expected of you

examples.en: Vick paid his dues (= completed his punishment), and since being released from prison has been a model citizen.
examples.zh: 维克服满了刑期，从监狱获释以来，他一直是模范公民。

senses.def: exactly; in a straight line

examples.en: to sail due east
examples.zh: 向正东航行

examples.en: The village lies five miles due north of York.
examples.zh: 这个村庄位于约克正北五英里处。

to fight or argue until an argument has been settled
to fight or argue until an argument has been settled
(1899-1974) a US jazz musician who played the piano and wrote music for the band he led. The band became well known at the Cotton Club
senses.zh: “埃林顿公爵”：（1899-1974年）美国爵士音乐家，他为自己领导的乐队演奏钢琴并创作音乐。乐队在哈林的棉花俱乐部中广为人知，并在卡内基音乐厅（1943）举行了音乐会。埃灵顿写了超过2000篇作品，包括《情绪靛蓝》（Mood Indigo，1930年），《如果没有摇摆不意味着什么》（1932年）和《老婆夫人》（Sophisticated Lady，1933年）。他于1969年获得总统自由勋章。

senses.def: not interesting or exciting
senses.zh: 平淡无奇的；枯燥乏味的

examples.en: Life in a small town could be deadly dull.
examples.zh: 小城镇的生活可能会非常没意思。

examples.en: The countryside was flat, dull and uninteresting.
examples.zh: 那时的乡村单调乏味，了无生气。

examples.en: The first half of the game was pretty dull.
examples.zh: 上半场比赛打得十分沉闷。

examples.en: There's never a dull moment when John's around.
examples.zh: 只要约翰在就不会有沉闷的时候。

senses.def: not bright or shiny
senses.zh: 不明亮的；不鲜明的；无光泽的

examples.en: a dull grey colour
examples.zh: 暗灰色

examples.en: dull, lifeless hair
examples.zh: 无光泽、无弹性的头发

examples.en: Her eyes were dull.
examples.zh: 她目光呆滞。

examples.en: The fire died down to a dull glow.
examples.zh: 火渐渐熄灭，只剩下暗淡的光。

senses.def: not bright, with a lot of clouds

examples.en: It was a dull, grey day.
examples.zh: 那是一个阴沉昏暗的日子。

examples.en: The town seemed deserted in the dull afternoon light.
examples.zh: 在下午暗淡的光线下这座城镇看上去有些荒凉。

senses.def: not clear or loud
senses.zh: 不清晰的；隐约的；低沉的

examples.en: The gates shut behind him with a dull thud.
examples.zh: 他走出后，大门砰的一声闷响关上了。

senses.def: not very severe, but continuous

examples.en: a dull ache/pain
examples.zh: 隐隐的疼痛

senses.def: slow in understanding

examples.en: a dull pupil
examples.zh: 脑子迟钝的小学生

senses.def: not busy; slow
senses.zh: 萧条的；不景气的；呆滞的

examples.en: Don't sell into a dull market.
examples.zh: 不要到萧条的市场去推销。

senses.def: it is not healthy to spend all your time working; you need to relax too
senses.zh: 只工作不玩耍，聪明的孩子也变傻

examples.zh: 我总觉得历史像沟水一样乏味。

senses.def: to make a pain or an emotion weaker or less severe; to become weaker or less severe

examples.en: The tablets they gave him dulled the pain for a while.
examples.zh: 他们给他的药片暂时缓解了疼痛。

examples.en: The heat dulled my enjoyment of the journey.
examples.zh: 炎热的天气削弱了我对旅途的享受。

examples.en: The pain of loss never dulls.
examples.zh: 天人两隔的痛苦永不消减。

senses.def: to make a person slower or less lively

examples.en: He felt dulled and stupid with sleep.
examples.zh: 他睡得迷迷糊糊，昏头昏脑。

senses.def: to become less bright, clean or sharp; to make something less bright, clean or sharp
senses.zh: （使）变得无光泽，变模糊，变低沉

examples.en: His eyes dulled and he slumped to the ground.
examples.zh: 他眼前一黑重重地倒在地上。

examples.en: The endless rain seemed to dull all sound.
examples.zh: 连绵不断的阴雨似乎使所有的声音都变得沉闷起来。

at an early stage, especially in a game or competition
senses.zh: （游戏或比赛的）开始阶段；开局

examples.en: Suddenly we lost three home matches early doors.
examples.zh: 我们在比赛前期就突然输掉了三场主场比赛。

examples.en: The team had the game in the bag early doors after tries from Ellis and Wilkins.
examples.zh: 在埃利斯和威尔金斯的努力下，球队很快就锁定了胜局。

senses.def: the period of time very early in the morning, soon after midnight
senses.zh: 午夜刚过的一段时间；凌晨时分

examples.en: The fighting began in the early hours of Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 战斗在星期六凌晨打响了。

examples.en: The party continued well into the early hours.
examples.zh: 聚会一直持续到第二天凌晨。

senses.def: used to say that it is too soon to be sure how a situation will develop

examples.en: It’s early days yet. We don’t know if the play will be a success.
examples.zh: 现在还为时尚早。不知道这部剧能否成功。

senses.def: near the beginning of a period of time, an event, a piece of work, etc.
senses.zh: 在早期；在初期；在开始阶段

examples.en: We arrived early the next day.
examples.zh: 我们第二天很早就到达了。

examples.en: early in the week/year/season/morning
examples.zh: 一周开始时；年初；季度初；一大早

examples.en: We meet the hero quite early in the film.
examples.zh: 我们在电影的早期就见到了英雄。

examples.en: He started writing music as early as 1989.
examples.zh: 他早在 1989 年就开始作曲了。

examples.en: The best rooms go to those who book earliest.
examples.zh: 最早预订者可得最好的房间。

senses.def: before the usual, expected or planned time

examples.en: Why don't you go home early if you're not feeling well?
examples.zh: 如果你不舒服，为什么不早点回家呢？

examples.en: Get there early to make sure you get good seats.
examples.zh: 尽早到达以确保获得好座位。

examples.en: The bus came five minutes early.
examples.zh: 公共汽车早到了五分钟。

examples.en: I woke up early this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上醒得早。

examples.en: I have to get up ridiculously early.
examples.zh: 我必须早得离谱就起来。

examples.en: She went to bed early.
examples.zh: 她很早就上床睡觉了。

examples.en: The baby arrived earlier than expected.
examples.zh: 婴儿早于预产期出生了。

examples.en: I arrived a few minutes early for my interview.
examples.zh: 我面试早到了几分钟。

examples.en: early flowering plants
examples.zh: 早期开花植物

examples.en: The summer is starting earlier and earlier each year.
examples.zh: 夏天每年都开始得越来越早。

senses.def: before the present time or the time mentioned

examples.en: As I said earlier…
examples.zh: 正如我先前所说…

examples.en: As mentioned/noted/described earlier…
examples.zh: 正如前面提到的／指出的／描述的…

examples.en: a week earlier
examples.zh: 一周前

examples.en: She had seen him earlier in the day.
examples.zh: 她在那天早些时候已见过他。

senses.def: at an early stage of a situation, relationship, period of time, etc.
senses.zh: 在初期；在开始阶段；早先

examples.en: I knew quite early on that I wanted to marry her.
examples.zh: 我老早就知道我想娶她。

senses.def: as soon as possible

examples.en: Please contact us at your earliest convenience.
examples.zh: 请尽早与我们联系。

senses.def: very early in the morning

examples.en: You're up bright and early today!
examples.zh: 你今天起得很早啊！

senses.def: a person who gets up, arrives, etc. very early
senses.zh: 早起者；早到者；赶早者；捷足先登者

examples.en: You’re an early bird this morning!
examples.zh: 你今天起得真早啊！

items.idm: the early bird catches the worm

senses.def: the practice of closing shops on a particular afternoon every week (now no longer very common)
senses.zh: 提早打烊，提前停止营业（指商店每周的某个下午不开门，现已不常见）

examples.en: Wednesday is early closing day in many places.
examples.zh: 周三是许多地方提早关门的日子。

senses.def: an early style of Gothic
senses.zh: 早期英语：13世纪在英国发展起来的哥特式建筑的早期风格。它的主要特征是没有装饰性石雕的高大狭窄的尖窗和厚实的墙壁。索尔兹伯里和威尔斯的大教堂是早期英国风格的典型例子。

senses.def: European music from the period 1250–1750, especially when it is performed using musical instruments of that time
senses.zh: 早期音乐(指中世纪、文艺复兴时期及早期巴罗克时期的音乐(1250-1750)，尤指用当时乐器演奏的重新流行的音乐)

examples.en: The group performs early music on original instruments.
examples.zh: 该乐队用原创乐器演奏早期音乐。

examples.en: the York Early Music Festival
examples.zh: 约克早期音乐节

senses.def: a night when you go to bed earlier than usual

examples.en: I'm getting an early night.
examples.zh: 今晚我要早点睡。

examples.en: She looks like she could do with a few early nights.
examples.zh: 她看上去需要在接下来几天早点睡觉。

senses.def: a thing that tells you in advance that something serious or dangerous is going to happen

examples.en: an early warning of heart disease
examples.zh: 心脏病的早期症状

examples.en: an early warning system (= of enemy attack)
examples.zh: 预警系统

examples.en: The sensors provide early warning of the approach of enemy troops.
examples.zh: 这些探测设备对敌军的到来提供早期预警。

senses.def: to decide that something will be used for a particular purpose, or to state that something will happen to somebody/something in the future
senses.zh: 指定…的用途；预先安排，确定（未来发生的事情）

examples.en: The money had been earmarked for spending on new school buildings.
examples.zh: 这笔款项已指定用于新校舍建设。

examples.en: The factory has been earmarked for closure.
examples.zh: 这家工厂已被指定关闭。

examples.en: She was earmarked early as a possible champion.
examples.zh: 人们早就认定她有可能夺冠。

senses.def: a feature or quality that is typical of somebody/something

examples.en: The incident has all the earmarks of a terrorist attack.
examples.zh: 这一事件具有恐怖袭击的所有特征。

senses.def: a government instruction to spend funds on a specific project
senses.zh: 资金的指定用途；专项拨款

examples.en: Federal earmarks for scientific research can be based on political connections and lobbying.
examples.zh: 联邦政府的科研拨款可能源于政治关系或游说。

examples.en: He's fought a lone fight against earmarks and wasteful spending.
examples.zh: 他孤军奋战，反对特殊专款和开支浪费。

senses.def: a pair of soft thick covers for the ears connected by a band across the top of the head, and worn to protect the ears, especially from cold
senses.zh: （尤指御寒用的）耳罩，耳套，护耳

examples.en: a pair of earmuffs
examples.zh: 一副耳套

senses.def: to get money for work that you do

examples.en: He earns about $40 000 a year.
examples.zh: 他一年大约挣 4 万美元。

examples.en: to earn an income/a wage/a salary
examples.zh: 赚取收入／工资／薪水

examples.en: It's not easy to earn a living as an artist.
examples.zh: 作为一名艺术家谋生并不容易。

examples.en: She must earn a fortune (= earn a lot of money).
examples.zh: 她准是挣了一大笔钱。

examples.en: All the children are earning now.
examples.zh: 所有子女都在挣钱了。

examples.en: His victory in the tournament earned him $50 000.
examples.zh: 他在这次锦标赛中获胜，挣了 5 万美元。

examples.en: They earned enough from their work for food.
examples.zh: 他们从工作中赚到的钱足够买食物了。

senses.def: to get money as profit or interest on money you lend, have in a bank, etc.

examples.en: Your money would earn more in a high-interest account.
examples.zh: 你的钱放在高利息账户里可获利更多。

examples.en: interest earned from investments
examples.zh: 投资利息

senses.def: to get something that you deserve, usually because of something good you have done or because of the good qualities you have

examples.en: He earned a reputation as an expert on tax law.
examples.zh: 他赢得了税法专家的美名。

examples.en: As a teacher, she had earned the respect of her students.
examples.zh: 作为教师，她赢得了学生的尊敬。

examples.en: Their supporters have certainly earned the right to celebrate.
examples.zh: 他们的支持者当然有理由庆祝。

examples.en: I need a rest. I think I've earned it, don't you?
examples.zh: 我需要休息一下。我觉得应该让我歇一歇，你说是不是？

examples.en: She earned a degree in music.
examples.zh: 她获得了音乐学位。

examples.en: Players earn points to progress in the game.
examples.zh: 玩家赚取积分以在游戏中取得进展。

examples.en: Her outstanding ability earned her a place on the team.
examples.zh: 她出色的能力为她在团队中赢得了一席之地。

examples.en: His great strength earned him the nickname ‘the Bull’.
examples.zh: 他强大的力量为他赢得了“公牛”的绰号。

senses.def: to earn enough money to live on

examples.en: I’ve been an actor for 20 years, earning a crust wherever I can.
examples.zh: 我当演员已经 20 年了，尽我所能地赚点钱。

senses.def: to do useful or helpful things in return for being allowed to live or stay somewhere
senses.zh: 挣口饭吃；为有栖身之处而工作

examples.en: He was willing to earn his keep.
examples.zh: 他愿意干活来换取栖身之所。

senses.def: to be worth the amount of time or money that is being spent
senses.zh: 值得所花的时间（或金钱）

examples.en: He felt he no longer deserved such a high salary. He just wasn't earning his keep.
examples.zh: 他认为他不应再得到那么高的薪金了。他根本不配拿那么多钱。

examples.en: All this new technology will have to earn its keep.
examples.zh: 所有这些新技术都必须赢得市场。

senses.def: to get a position or reputation you deserve through work or achievements

examples.en: If you want to earn your stripes in journalism, you need to start at the bottom.
examples.zh: 如果你想在新闻行业取得成功，你需要从底层开始。

examples.en: With elite football, you really do have to earn your stripes.
examples.zh: 对于精英足球来说，你确实必须赢得自己的荣誉。

senses.def: a run
a person who earns money for a job that they do

examples.en: high/low earners
examples.zh: 高薪／低薪的人

examples.en: The survey revealed that top earners in the country tended to be men.
examples.zh: 调查显示这个国家挣钱最多的往往是男人。

senses.def: an activity or a business that makes a profit

examples.en: Tourism is the country's biggest foreign currency earner.
examples.zh: 旅游业是这个国家赚取外汇最多的行业。

examples.en: Her new business has turned out to be a nice little earner.
examples.zh: 她新开的商店结果还真有点赚钱呢。

senses.def: very serious and sincere

examples.en: an earnest young man
examples.zh: 非常认真的年轻人

examples.en: Despite her earnest efforts, she could not find a job.
examples.zh: 尽管她已尽心竭力，但是仍然找不到工作。

examples.en: When I looked over, he was in earnest conversation with his father.
examples.zh: 我回头一看，他正在和父亲认真地交谈。

examples.en: She was nice enough, but perhaps a little too earnest.
examples.zh: 她人很好，但也许有点太认真了。

senses.def: more seriously and with more force or effort than before

examples.en: The work on the house will begin in earnest on Monday.
examples.zh: 这栋房子的修建工作将在星期一正式开始。

examples.en: That was when our troubles started in earnest.
examples.zh: 就在那时，我们的麻烦真正开始了。

senses.def: very serious and sincere about what you are saying and about your intentions; in a way that shows that you are serious

examples.en: You may laugh but I'm in deadly earnest.
examples.zh: 你可以笑，不过我可是正经八百的。

examples.en: I could tell she spoke in earnest.
examples.zh: 我看得出她是郑重其事地说的。

senses.def: more seriously and with more force or effort than before

examples.zh: 这栋房子的修建工作将在星期一正式开始。

examples.en: That was when our troubles started in earnest.

examples.en: You may laugh but I'm in deadly earnest.
examples.zh: 你可以笑，不过我可是正经八百的。

examples.en: I could tell she spoke in earnest.
examples.zh: 我看得出她是郑重其事地说的。

senses.def: in a very serious and sincere way

examples.en: He gazed earnestly into my eyes.
examples.zh: 他认真地凝视着我的眼睛。

senses.def: the quality of being very serious and sincere

examples.en: I had always admired the intense earnestness of his character.
examples.zh: 我一直钦佩他的性格中强烈的认真态度。

senses.def: the money that you earn for the work that you do

examples.en: a rise in average earnings
examples.zh: 平均收入的增加

examples.en: She is claiming compensation for loss of earnings.
examples.zh: 她要求赔偿收入损失。

senses.def: the profit that a company makes

examples.en: The company's earnings per share have fallen to 29p.
examples.zh: 该公司的每股收益降至29便士。

examples.en: Whisky accounts for a large percentage of Scotland's export earnings.
examples.zh: 威士忌占苏格兰出口利润的比例很大。

intro.en: These are all words for money that a person earns or receives for their work.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指收入、工资、薪水。

items.def: money that a person receives for their work, or from investments or business:
items.zh: 指收入、收益、所得

examples.en: people on low incomes
examples.zh: 低收入的人

items.def: money that employees get for doing their job, usually paid every week or every month:
items.zh: 通常指按周或按月领取的工资、工钱

examples.en: a weekly wage of £400
examples.zh: 周薪 400 英镑

items.def: money that employees earn for doing their job:
items.zh: 指工资、薪水

examples.en: The job offers good rates of pay.
examples.zh: 这工作报酬高。

items.def: money that employees earn for doing their job, usually paid every month.
items.zh: 通常指按月发放的薪水、薪金

items.def: money that a person earns from their work:
items.zh: 指薪水、工资、收入

examples.en: a rise in average earnings for factory workers
examples.zh: 工厂工人平均收入的增加

senses.def: connected to and changing according to the amount of money that you earn
senses.zh: 与收入挂钩的；按收益计算的

examples.en: an earnings-related pension scheme
examples.zh: 与收入挂钩的退休金计划

senses.def: a piece of equipment worn in or over the ears that makes it possible to listen to music, the radio, etc. without other people hearing it

examples.en: She was listening to music on her phone through earphones.
examples.zh: 她正在通过耳机听手机上的音乐。

senses.def: the part of a phone or piece of electrical equipment that you hold next to or put into your ear so that you can listen
a piece of soft material that you put into your ear to keep out noise or water
a piece of jewellery that you fasten in or on your ear

examples.en: a pair of earrings
examples.zh: 一对耳环

examples.en: She was wearing a diamond necklace with matching earrings.
examples.zh: 她戴着一条钻石项链和与之相配的耳环。

examples.en: She wore a pair of dangly earrings.
examples.zh: 她戴着一对耳坠。

senses.def: a piece of equipment that fits into your ear and has a microphone
too far away to hear somebody/something or to be heard
senses.zh: 离得太远听不见；在听力范围之外

examples.en: We waited until Ted was safely out of earshot before discussing it.
examples.zh: 我们一直等到特德保准听不见时才讨论这事。

examples.en: He diplomatically moved out of earshot.
examples.zh: 他外交地离开了听不到的地方。

senses.def: near enough to hear somebody/something or to be heard

examples.en: As she came within earshot of the group, she heard her name mentioned.
examples.zh: 她刚走近到能听见这群人说话声时便听到有人提她的名字。

examples.en: He said nothing, for the policeman was still within earshot.
examples.zh: 他什么也没说，因为警察仍在听得见的范围内。

senses.def: the world; the planet that we live on

examples.en: the planet Earth
examples.zh: 行星地球

examples.en: The earth revolves around the sun.
examples.zh: 地球绕太阳公转。

examples.en: a satellite orbiting the earth
examples.zh: 环绕地球运行的卫星

examples.en: the earth's surface/crust
examples.zh: 地表；地壳

examples.en: the history of life on earth
examples.zh: 地球上的生命史

examples.en: I must be the happiest person on earth!
examples.zh: 我一定是世界上最幸福的人！

senses.def: land; the hard surface of the world that is not the sea or the sky; the ground

examples.en: After a week at sea, it was good to feel the earth beneath our feet again.
examples.zh: 出海一周后，重新踏上陆地感到很愉快。

examples.en: fifty feet above the earth
examples.zh: 离地面五十英尺

examples.en: in mines deep under the earth
examples.zh: 在地下深处的矿井里

examples.en: You could feel the earth shake as the truck came closer.
examples.zh: 卡车开近时会感觉到地面在震动。

senses.def: the substance that plants grow in

examples.en: a clod/mound of earth

examples.zh: 我跟他在一起总感到不是很自在。

examples.zh: 我穿着这样正式的衣服觉得很拘谨。

examples.zh: 疼痛立刻减轻了。

examples.zh: 这应该有助于减轻疼痛。

examples.zh: 这项计划对城里的交通拥挤状况应该有所缓解。

examples.zh: 知道她已安顿下来会使我放心些。

examples.zh: 已建造坡道以方便使用轮椅的人出入。

examples.zh: 握方向盘的手放松一点。

to become or help somebody to become familiar with something new, especially a new job
senses.zh: 熟悉，使熟悉（新事物，尤指新工作）

examples.en: It will take a little time for him to ease himself into his new role.
examples.zh: 他需要一点时间才能适应新角色。

examples.en: We waited until the traffic had eased off.
examples.zh: 我们一直等到交通缓解。

examples.en: Ease off the training a few days before the race.
examples.zh: 比赛前几天要减轻训练强度。

examples.zh: 我认为你需要减少咖啡因的摄入。

senses.zh: （尤指故意为难）迫使某人离开（管理岗位等）

examples.zh: 雪小了，人们开始外出。

examples.zh: 你得减少所有这类旅行。

senses.zh: 地役权（穿越或征用某人土地的权利）

senses.zh: 容易地；轻易地；不费力地

examples.zh: 开车可以方便地到达博物馆。

examples.en: The software is easily available.
examples.zh: 该软件很容易获得。

examples.zh: 容易识别/识别/可见

examples.en: I can easily finish it tonight.
examples.zh: 我今晚能毫不费力地把它完成。

examples.en: The major problems of the city can be easily identified.
examples.zh: 城市的主要问题很容易识别。

examples.zh: 学习语言对他来说并非易事。

examples.en: We won easily by six goals to two.
examples.zh: 我们以六比二轻松获胜。

examples.en: Taxis are easily identifiable by their orange and white colours.
examples.zh: 出租车的颜色为橙色和白色，很容易识别。

examples.en: It is small enough to fit easily into a backpack.
examples.zh: 它足够小，可以轻松放入背包中。

examples.zh: 你肯定锁上大门了吗？你很可能是忘了。

examples.en: The situation might all too easily have become a disaster.
examples.zh: 这形势本来是极有可能成为一场大灾难的。

examples.zh: 这无疑是我今年看过的最好的一出戏。

examples.en: She is easily the most experienced teacher in the school.
examples.zh: 她无疑是学校里最有经验的老师。

examples.en: I get bored easily.
examples.zh: 我易生厌倦。

examples.en: He's easily distracted.
examples.zh: 他注意力很容易分散。

examples.zh: 他们彼此之间的轻松是显而易见的。

examples.zh: 学生们根据老师的乐于助人、课程清晰度和课程的难易程度对老师进行评分。

examples.zh: 大风从东面吹来。

examples.zh: 火车线路方便了东西方之间的旅行。

examples.zh: 这个国家的东部特别受游客欢迎。

examples.zh: 欧洲商人于 15 世纪开始与东方进行贸易。

examples.zh: 东方的中央计划体制

examples.zh: 他们住在东海岸。

examples.en: the east bank of the river

examples.zh: 他们住在城市的东边。

examples.zh: 公园和湖泊位于建筑群的东端。

towards the east

examples.zh: 房子朝东。

examples.en: The storm is expected to head east.
examples.zh: 预计风暴将向东移动。

examples.zh: 他们住在牛津以东五英里处。

senses.zh: 东英吉利（East Anglia）：英格兰东部的一个地区，包括诺福克，萨福克以及剑桥郡和艾塞克斯的部分地区。地势平坦，是农业地区，出产大量谷物。

examples.zh: 他是一个地道的伦敦东区人。

examples.en: The whole house echoed.
examples.zh: 整个房子充满回声。

examples.en: The street echoed with the cries of children.
examples.zh: 街上回荡着孩子的哭声。

examples.en: The valley echoed back his voice.
examples.zh: 山谷里回荡着他的声音。

examples.en: The great hall echoed with laughter.
examples.zh: 大厅里回荡着笑声。

senses.def: to repeat an idea or opinion because you agree with it

examples.en: ‘More police, that’s what we need,’ he said, echoing his father’s views on the subject.
examples.zh: “更多的警察，这就是我们需要的，”他说，呼应了他父亲在这个问题上的观点。

examples.en: This is a view echoed by many on the right of the party.
examples.zh: 这是党内许多右翼分子都重复过的观点。

senses.def: to repeat what somebody else has just said, especially because you find it surprising
senses.zh: （尤因感到意外而）重复…话，模仿

examples.en: ‘He's gone!’ Viv echoed.
examples.zh: “他去了！”维夫重复道。

senses.def: the reflecting of sound off a wall or inside a particular space so that a noise appears to be repeated; a sound that is reflected back in this way

examples.en: There was an echo on the phone and I couldn't hear clearly.
examples.zh: 电话里有回音，我听不清楚。

examples.en: The hills sent back a faint echo.
examples.zh: 座座山丘传来微弱的回声。

examples.en: the echo of footsteps running down the corridor
examples.zh: 沿走廊跑的脚步回声

examples.en: ‘So you love him, do you?’ Magda’s voice was a mocking echo of my own.
examples.zh: “所以你爱他，是吗？”玛格达的声音与我的声音类似。

senses.def: the fact of an idea, event, etc. being like another and reminding you of it; something that reminds you of something else

examples.en: Yesterday's crash has grim echoes of previous disasters.
examples.zh: 昨天的撞车事故使人想起之前那些令人痛心的灾难。

senses.def: an opinion or attitude that agrees with or repeats one already expressed or thought

examples.en: His words were an echo of what she had heard many times before.
examples.zh: 他的话她以往听过许多次。

examples.en: The speech found an echo in the hearts of many of the audience (= they agreed with it).
examples.zh: 这次演讲在许多听众的心中引起共鸣。

senses.def: an environment in which somebody encounters only opinions and beliefs similar to their own, and does not have to consider alternatives
senses.zh: 回声室（只能听到与自己相似见解的环境）

examples.en: It can be too easy to slip into an echo chamber that reinforces extreme political views.
examples.zh: 人们很容易陷入强化极端政治观点的回声室。

senses.def: a device that measures the depth of the sea, or that finds objects underwater
a test that uses ultrasound
senses.zh: 心脏超声波检查；心脏超音波检查

examples.en: An echocardiogram showed normal coronary arteries and normal function.
examples.zh: 心脏超声波检查显示冠状动脉血管和心脏功能正常。

senses.def: the use of ultrasound
senses.zh: 超声心动图显像，超声心动图（心脏超声波检查方法）

examples.en: ECG and echocardiography were performed to assess cardiac function.
examples.zh: 做了心电图和超声心动图，以此来评估心脏机能。

senses.def: the act of repeating everything somebody says, as a result of a mental condition
senses.zh: 模仿言语（常因心理问题导致，表现为模仿性地重复他人的话）

senses.def: the use of reflected sound waves for finding things, especially by creatures such as dolphins
senses.zh: （尤指海豚、蝙蝠等动物的）回声定位

senses.def: really and typically

examples.en: echt Viennese cream cakes
examples.zh: 真正的维也纳奶油蛋糕

senses.def: real and typical
a long thin cake for one person, made of light pastry
senses.zh: （巧克力）长形泡芙；奶油松饼；奶油酥饼

examples.en: a chocolate eclair
examples.zh: 巧克力泡芙

senses.def: a condition in which a pregnant woman has high blood pressure and convulsions
senses.zh: 子痫（怀孕引起的高血压和惊厥，对产妇母子造成威胁）

senses.def: not following one style or set of ideas but choosing from or using a wide variety
senses.zh: 不拘一格的；兼收并蓄的

examples.en: She has very eclectic tastes in literature.
examples.zh: 她在文学方面的兴趣非常广泛。

examples.en: His house is an eclectic mixture of the antique and the modern.
examples.zh: 他的家古典与现代气息兼而有之。

senses.def: in a way that does not follow only one style or set of ideas but chooses from or uses a wide variety
senses.zh: 不拘一格的；兼收并蓄的

examples.en: Her work draws eclectically on psychoanalysis and mythology.
examples.zh: 她的作品折衷地借鉴了精神分析和神话。

senses.def: the fact of not following one style or set of ideas but choosing from or using a wide variety
senses.zh: 不拘一格的；兼收并蓄的

examples.en: Critics praised the originality and eclecticism of her work.
examples.zh: 评论家称赞她作品的原创性和折衷主义。

senses.def: an occasion when the moon passes between the earth and the sun so that you cannot see all or part of the sun for a time; an occasion when the earth passes between the moon and the sun so that you cannot see all or part of the moon for a time

examples.en: an eclipse of the sun/moon
examples.zh: 日食；月食

examples.en: a total/partial eclipse
examples.zh: 全食；偏食

senses.def: a loss of importance, power, etc. especially because somebody/something else has become more important, powerful, etc.
senses.zh: （重要性、权势等的）丧失，黯然失色，暗淡

examples.en: The election result marked the eclipse of the right wing.
examples.zh: 选举结果标志着右翼的失势。

examples.en: Her work was in eclipse for most of the 20th century.
examples.zh: 她的作品在 20 世纪大部分时间里都湮没无闻。

senses.def: to cause an eclipse
to make somebody/something seem neither exciting nor important by comparison
senses.zh: 使失色；使相形见绌；使丧失重要性

examples.en: Though a talented player, he was completely eclipsed by his brother.
examples.zh: 他虽是个天才运动员，但与他的哥哥相比就黯然失色了。

senses.def: connected with the environment

examples.en: eco-friendly
examples.zh: 环保的

examples.en: eco-clothing (= clothes made from environmentally friendly materials)
examples.zh: 生态服装

senses.def: a feeling of worry about threats to the environment, such as pollution and climate change

examples.en: Growing awareness of climate change is causing some people to suffer from eco-anxiety.
examples.zh: 人们对气候变化的认识日益增强，这使得一些人产生了生态焦虑。

senses.def: fashionable design or clothing that is produced with concern for the environment
senses.zh: （设计或服装）环保时尚的，生态时尚的

senses.def: (of design or clothing) fashionable and designed or produced with concern for the environment
senses.zh: （设计或服装）环保时尚的，生态时尚的

examples.en: At the market you can find some really nice eco-chic T-shirts, made from organic cotton.
examples.zh: 在市场上，您可以找到一些非常漂亮的生态时尚 T 恤，由有机棉制成。

senses.def: not harmful to the environment

examples.en: eco-friendly products
examples.zh: 环保型产品

senses.def: a person who actively tries to prevent damage to the environment
senses.zh: 环保斗士；环保活动人士

examples.en: Eco-warriors have set up camps around the airport site.
examples.zh: 环保斗士在机场周边扎了营。

examples.en: The eco-warrior discussed causes close to his heart, including organic farming, hedge-laying and healthy school dinners.
examples.zh: 这名环保斗士讨论了他关心的事，包括有机耕作、修筑树篱和学校健康餐。

senses.def: the destruction
connected with the relation of plants and living creatures to each other and to their environment

examples.en: We risk upsetting the ecological balance of the area.
examples.zh: 我们有可能破坏这个地区的生态平衡。

examples.en: an ecological disaster (= one that alters the whole balance of ecology in an area)
examples.zh: 生态灾难

senses.def: interested in and concerned about the ecology
senses.zh: 关注生态环境的；主张生态保护的

examples.en: the ecological movement
examples.zh: 生态保护运动

senses.def: a measure of the amount of the earth’s resources used by a person or a population that lives in a particular way
senses.zh: 生态足迹（测定个人或群体生活所消耗地球资源的指标）

examples.en: the ecological footprint of the average Canadian
examples.zh: 普通加拿大人的生态足迹

examples.en: Ecological footprints are measured in global hectares.
examples.zh: 生态足迹以全球公顷来衡量。

senses.def: in a way that is connected with the relation of plants and living creatures to each other and to their environment

examples.en: The system is both practical and ecologically sound.
examples.zh: 这一系统既实用又合乎生态保护理念。

senses.def: a scientist who studies ecology
a person who is interested in ecology
the relation of plants and living creatures to each other and to their environment; the study of this

examples.en: plant/animal/human ecology
examples.zh: 植物／动物／人类生态学

examples.en: the ecology movement
examples.zh: 生态保护运动

examples.en: Oil pollution could damage the fragile ecology of the coral reefs.
examples.zh: 石油污染可能破坏珊瑚礁脆弱的生态环境。

examples.en: All ecologies on earth are heavily shaped by human activity.
examples.zh: 地球上的所有生态都在很大程度上受到人类活动的影响。

senses.def: connected with the trade, industry and development of wealth of a country, an area or a society
senses.zh: 经济的；经济上的；经济学的

examples.en: They discussed social, economic and political issues.
examples.zh: 他们讨论了社会、经济和政治问题。

examples.en: economic growth/development
examples.zh: 经济增长／发展

examples.en: the worst economic crisis since the war
examples.zh: 战争以来最严重的经济危机

examples.en: There will be no quick economic recovery.
examples.zh: 经济将不会迅速复苏。

examples.en: the government’s economic policy
examples.zh: 政府的经济政策

examples.en: economic activity/cooperation/reform
examples.zh: 经济活动/合作/改革

examples.en: an economic downturn/slowdown
examples.zh: 经济衰退/放缓

examples.en: A public spending programme is out of the question in the current economic climate.
examples.zh: 在当前的经济环境下，公共支出计划是不可能的。

senses.def: producing enough profit to continue
senses.zh: 有利可图的；可赚钱的；合算的

examples.en: The college was not achieving the numbers of students needed to make it economic.
examples.zh: 这所大学没有招收到盈利所需的学生人数。

examples.en: They found it was not economic to sell their milk to the supermarkets.
examples.zh: 他们发现把牛奶卖给超市不划算。

examples.en: It's simply not economic for these small farmers to start buying large amounts of expensive fertilizer.
examples.zh: 这些小农场主开始大量购买高价肥料，这根本无利可图。

intro.en: These words all describe activities or situations that are connected with the use of money, especially by a business or country.
intro.zh: 以上各词尤用于企业或国家的经济活动或状况。

items.def: connected with the trade, industry and development of wealth of a country, an area or a society:
items.zh: 指国家、地区或社会经济的、经济上的、经济学的

examples.en: This book deals with the social, economic and political issues of the period.
examples.zh: 这本书论及了那个时期的社会、经济和政治问题。

items.def: connected with money and finance:
items.zh: 指财政的、财务的、金融的

examples.en: She had got into financial difficulties.
examples.zh: 她陷入了财务困境。

items.def: connected with the buying and selling of goods and services.
items.zh: 指贸易的、商业的

items.def: (formal or finance) connected with money, especially all the money in a country:
items.zh: 指货币的、钱的，尤指一国的货币

examples.en: closer European monetary union
examples.zh: 更为紧密的欧洲货币联盟

items.def: (finance) connected with a budget (= the money available or a plan of how it will be spent).
items.zh: 指财政预算的

intro.en: These words all describe somebody/​something that is making or is likely to make money.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指赚钱的、赢利的、有利可图的。

items.def: making a lot of money, especially by being popular:
items.zh: 指赚钱的、成功的

examples.en: The play was very successful on Broadway.
examples.zh: 那部剧在百老汇大获成功。

items.def: making a profit:
items.zh: 指有利润的、赢利的

examples.en: a highly profitable business
examples.zh: 一家赢利很高的企业

items.def: [only before noun] making or intended to make a profit:
items.zh: 指赢利的、以获利为目的的

examples.en: The movie was not a commercial success (= made no profit).
examples.zh: 这部电影票房收入不佳。

items.def: (of business or work) producing or paying a large amount of money; making a large profit:
items.zh: 指生意或工作赚大钱的、获利多的

examples.en: They do a lot of business in lucrative overseas markets.
examples.zh: 他们在利润丰厚的海外市场上生意很多。

items.def: (often used in negative sentences) (of a process, business or activity) producing enough profit to continue:
items.zh: （常用于否定句中）指（工序、业务或活动）有利可图的、可赚钱的、合算的

examples.en: Small local shops stop being economic when a supermarket opens up nearby.
examples.zh: 附近有超市开业的话，当地的小商店就没有利润可赚了。

senses.def: the idea that there should be completely free movement of people, goods and money between the countries of the European Union
senses.zh: 欧州经济与货币联盟该联盟是欧盟国家之间应实现人员、货物和资金完全自由流动的理念的产物。从 1993 年 1 月 1 日起，欧盟国家之间取消了许多对货物和人员流动的限制。现有欧洲中央银行以及 1999 年引入的单一欧洲货币——欧元，如今欧元是许多欧盟国家的货币。

senses.def: a person who moves from one country or area to another in order to improve their standard of living
senses.zh: 经济移民（为提高生活水平）

examples.en: They claimed they were political refugees and not economic migrants.
examples.zh: 他们宣称自己是政治难民，不是经济移民。

senses.def: providing good service or value in relation to the amount of time or money spent

examples.en: an economical car to run (= one that does not use too much petrol)
examples.zh: 节油型汽车

examples.en: It would be more economical to buy the bigger size.
examples.zh: 买尺寸大点的更实惠。

senses.def: using no more of something than is necessary

examples.en: an economical use of space
examples.zh: 节约利用空间

examples.en: an economical prose style (= one that uses no unnecessary words)
examples.zh: 简练的散文文体

senses.def: not spending more money than necessary

examples.en: He was economical in all areas of his life.
examples.zh: 他在生活的各个方面都精打细算。

senses.def: if you say that somebody has been economical with the truth
senses.zh: 没把实话全讲出来（婉指某人隐瞒了一些重要事实）

senses.def: if you say that somebody has been economical with the truth
senses.zh: 没把实话全讲出来（婉指某人隐瞒了一些重要事实）

senses.def: in a way connected with the trade, industry and development of wealth of a country, an area or a society

examples.en: The factory is no longer economically viable.
examples.zh: 这家工厂在经济上已经维持不下去了。

examples.en: Economically, the centre of Spain has lost its dominant role.
examples.zh: 西班牙中部在经济上已失去了其主导地位。

examples.en: the economically active/inactive population (= those who are employed or available for work/those who are not)
examples.zh: 经济活动／非经济活动人口

examples.en: Changes have taken place both economically and politically.
examples.zh: 经济和政治方面都发生了变化。

senses.def: in a way that provides good service or value in relation to the amount of time or money spent

examples.en: I'll do the job as economically as possible.
examples.zh: 我一定尽可能高效率地工作。

senses.def: in a way that uses no more of something than is necessary
senses.zh: 节俭地；节约地；节省地；简洁地

examples.en: The design is intended to use space as economically as possible.
examples.zh: 这个设计方案是为了尽可能节省空间。

examples.en: She writes elegantly and economically.
examples.zh: 她写作典雅而简练。

examples.en: Learn to express yourself more economically.
examples.zh: 学会更经济地表达自己。

senses.def: the study of how a society organizes its money, trade and industry

examples.en: He studied politics and economics at Yale.
examples.zh: 他曾在耶鲁大学学习政治学和经济学。

examples.en: Keynesian/Marxist economics
examples.zh: 凯恩斯主义／马克思主义经济学

examples.en: trends in modern economics
examples.zh: 现代经济学趋势

senses.def: the way in which money influences, or is organized within, an area of business or society
senses.zh: 经济情况；经济因素；经济意义

examples.en: The economics of the project are very encouraging.
examples.zh: 这项工程的经济情况非常令人鼓舞。

examples.en: The economics of maintaining a safe environment are not just the concern of the government.
examples.zh: 维持安全环境的经济效益不仅仅是政府关心的问题。

senses.def: a person who studies or writes about economics

examples.en: the World Bank's chief economist
examples.zh: 世界银行的首席经济学家

examples.en: Many economists are predicting the economy will improve.
examples.zh: 许多经济学家预测经济将会改善。

senses.def: to use less money, time, etc. than you normally use

examples.en: Old people often try to economize on heating, thus endangering their health.
examples.zh: 老年人常常想方设法节约用暖气，结果损害了他们的健康。

intro.en: These words all mean to spend less money.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含存钱、节俭之义。

items.def: to keep money instead of spending it, often in order to buy a particular thing:
items.zh: 常指为了买某物而攒钱、储蓄

examples.en: I’m saving for a new car.
examples.zh: 我正攒钱想买辆新车。

items.def: to be careful about the amount of money you spend; to plan to spend an amount of money for a particular purpose:
items.zh: 指谨慎花钱、把…编入预算

examples.en: If we budget carefully we’ll be able to afford the trip.
examples.zh: 我们精打细算一点，就能够负担这次旅行。

items.def: to use less money, time, etc. than you normally use
items.zh: 节省；节约；节俭

items.def: (rather informal) to spend less money because there is less available:
items.zh: 指勒紧腰带省吃俭用

examples.en: With the price increases, we are all having to tighten our belts.
examples.zh: 由于物价上涨，我们都只好勒紧裤腰带了。

senses.def: the relationship between production, trade and the supply of money in a particular country or region
senses.zh: 经济；经济情况；经济结构

examples.en: The economy is in recession.
examples.zh: 经济处于衰退之中。

examples.en: The world economy is still suffering from the effects of the pandemic.
examples.zh: 世界经济仍在遭受疫情影响。

examples.en: Tourism clearly dominates the local economy.
examples.zh: 旅游业明显主导着当地经济。

examples.en: He favours tax cuts to stimulate the economy.
examples.zh: 他赞成减税以刺激经济。

examples.en: to boost/revive/grow the economy
examples.zh: 提振／重振／发展经济

examples.en: Over the past few years, the country's economy has grown at a record pace.
examples.zh: 在过去的几年里，该国经济以空前的速度增长。

senses.def: a country, when you are thinking about its economic system
senses.zh: （就经济体制而言）国家；经济制度

examples.en: Ireland was one of the fastest-growing economies in Western Europe in the 1990s.
examples.zh: 在 20 世纪 90 年代爱尔兰是西欧经济发展最快的国家之一。

examples.en: emerging economies (= that are starting to grow)
examples.zh: 新兴经济体（= 开始增长）

examples.en: developed economies
examples.zh: 发达国家

senses.def: the use of resources in a way that avoids waste

examples.en: The company has improved the fuel economy of all its vehicles.
examples.zh: 公司改进了所有车辆的节油性能。

examples.en: It's a false economy to buy cheap clothes (= it seems cheaper but it is not really since they do not last very long).
examples.zh: 买便宜衣服实际上划不来。

examples.en: We're on an economy drive at home (= trying to avoid waste and spend as little money as possible).
examples.zh: 我们正在家里实行勤俭节约。

senses.def: offering good value for money

examples.en: Buy the large economy pack.
examples.zh: 购买大包经济装。

senses.def: ways of saving money

examples.en: We need to make substantial economies.
examples.zh: 我们需要厉行节约。

examples.en: possible economies in phone costs
examples.zh: 电话成本可能节省

senses.def: a way of using as little of something as possible

examples.en: a technique based on economy of effort
examples.zh: 基于省力的技术

examples.en: She writes with a great economy of words (= using only the necessary words).
examples.zh: 她文笔简练。

examples.en: It was impressive to see his economy of movement as he worked the machine.
examples.zh: 当他操作机器时，看到他动作的经济性令人印象深刻。

senses.def: the cheapest class of air travel

examples.en: We flew economy.
examples.zh: 我们乘坐经济舱。

examples.en: an economy fare/ticket/seat/passenger
examples.zh: 经济舱票价／机票／座位／乘客

senses.def: the fact of a person suffering from deep vein thrombosis
senses.zh: 经济舱综合征，经济舱症候群（乘坐飞机导致深静脉血栓形成，被认为在经济舱乘客中更常见）

senses.def: a situation in which the cost of producing an item falls as more items are produced
senses.zh: 随着生产更多商品，生产商品的成本下降的情况

examples.en: We have improved our profitability by achieving economies of scale.
examples.zh: 我们通过实现规模经济提高了盈利能力。

senses.def: all the plants and living creatures in a particular area considered in relation to their physical environment

examples.en: Islands often support delicate ecosystems that evolved without any need for defence.
examples.zh: 岛屿上所维系的生态系统大多很脆弱，是在无需防御的情况下演化而成的。

senses.def: violent activities that are carried out in order to draw attention to issues relating to the environment
senses.zh: 过激环保行为（为引起对环境问题的关注而实施暴力行动）

senses.zh: 生态城（其设计可使城内居民尽量降低对环境的影响）

senses.def: in a very happy, excited and enthusiastic way

examples.zh: 牧师们普遍致力于在港口提供临时服务中心，供海员放松和祈祷。

senses.def: the principle or aim of joining different branches of the Christian Church together

senses.def: (1902-74) a US television personality. He is best remembered as the presenter
senses.zh: 埃德·沙利文（Ed Sullivan）：（1902-74）美国电视名人。记得他是《城镇吐司》（1948-55）的主持人，后来被称为CBS受欢迎的周日综艺节目《埃德·沙利文秀》（1955-71）。

senses.def: a type of round yellow Dutch cheese that is covered with red wax

(1892-1964) a US comedian
senses.zh: 埃迪·坎托（Eddie Cantor）：（ 1892-1964年）美国喜剧演员兼歌手，曾在电影，舞台，广播和电视中表演过。他以开朗的性格，大眼睛和高嗓音而闻名。他于1917年与Ziegfeld Follies一起开始创作，他最著名的歌曲是Makeing Whoopee和If You Knew Susie。1956年，他获得了特别的奥斯卡奖。

senses.def: (1938-60) a US singer of rock and roll
senses.zh: 埃迪·科克伦（Eddie Cochran）：（1938-60），美国摇滚音乐歌手，职业生涯始于1956年。他弹吉他，最受欢迎的歌曲是《 C'mon Everybody》（1958年）和《 Summertime Blues》（1958年）。他死于车祸。科克伦（Cochran）死前已录制了《通往天堂的三个步骤》（3960）。

examples.zh: 波浪翻滚着在岩石周围打漩。

(1809-49) a US writer of short stories and poems. His best remembered works are frightening stories of mystery and death, including The Fall of the House of Usher
senses.zh: 埃德加·爱伦·坡（1809–1849）美国短篇小说家、诗人。以描述神秘和死亡的恐怖故事著称，作品包括《厄舍古屋的倒塌》（1839）和《陷坑与钟摆》（1843）。《莫格街凶杀案》（1841）等小说被认为开创了现代侦探小说的先河。诗作包括《乌鸦》（1845）和《安娜贝尔·李》（1849）。因酗酒早逝。坡的许多小说被改编成电影。

senses.def: (1875-1950) a US writer who created the character of Tarzan
senses.zh: 埃德加·赖斯·巴勒斯（Edgar Rice Burroughs）：（1875-1950）是美国作家，他创造了泰山的角色。该系列的第一本书是《猿人的泰山》（Tarzan，1914年），随后出版了23本。已经拍摄了许多泰山电影。Burroughs还撰写了科幻小说，包括《火星诸神》（The Gods of Mars，1913年）。

senses.def: (1875-1932) an English author. His most popular books are stories about crime and adventure, such as The Four Just Men
senses.zh: 埃德加·华莱士（Edgar Wallace）：（1875-1932）是一位英语作家。他最受欢迎的书籍是有关犯罪和冒险的故事，例如《四个正义者》（1905）和《林格》（1926）。他还是戏剧和电影的成功作家，包括电影金刚（1933）

senses.def: an area of Birmingham
senses.zh: 埃德巴斯顿（Edgbaston）：英格兰伯明翰（Birmingham）的地区，这里有一个同名的国际板球场。伯明翰大学也在埃德巴斯顿。

examples.zh: 我在水边坐了下来。

examples.zh: 别把那只玻璃杯放在离桌边太近的地方。

examples.zh: 她粗暴地撕下那一页，在书中留下了参差不齐的撕痕。

examples.zh: 这场比赛使观众兴奋不已。

examples.zh: 我坐在座位边上等着看接下来会发生什么。

senses.zh: 使某人抓狂；令某人崩溃

examples.en: No one knows exactly what caused his breakdown, but losing his job may have pushed him over the edge.
examples.zh: 没有人确切知道是什么导致了他的崩溃，但失去工作可能已经把他推到了崩溃的边缘。

examples.en: The ballet still had some rough edges.
examples.zh: 这段芭蕾舞还有不足之处。

examples.en: He had a few rough edges knocked off at school.
examples.zh: 他在学校改掉了一些坏毛病。

examples.en: The films are very rough around the edges.
examples.zh: 这些电影有不少瑕疵。

examples.en: Just the sound of her voice sets my teeth on edge.
examples.zh: 我一听到她的声音就浑身不舒服。

intro.en: These words all describe people who are easily frightened or are behaving in a frightened way.
intro.zh: 以上各词均形容人神经质、易紧张焦虑、胆怯。

items.def: easily worried or frightened:
items.zh: 指神经质的、易紧张焦虑的、胆怯的

examples.en: He was of a nervous disposition.
examples.zh: 他生性容易紧张。

items.def: not behaving in a reasonable, calm way, because you are worried about something:
items.zh: 指神经质的、神经过敏的

examples.en: She became neurotic about keeping the house clean.
examples.zh: 她变得对保持房屋清洁有点神经质。

items.def: nervous or easily made angry:
items.zh: 指紧张不安的、烦躁的、易怒的

examples.en: She was always on edge before an interview.
examples.zh: 她在面试前总是紧张不安。

items.def: (informal) anxious and nervous:

examples.en: All this talk of job losses was making him jittery.
examples.zh: 所有这些关于失业的话题使他心神不宁。

examples.en: Some of the odd quirks and edge cases have been ironed out already.
