examples.zh: 这句话通常用来描述总统的政府风格。

senses.def: if a person or their time is employed in doing something

examples.en: She was employed in making a list of all the jobs to be done.
examples.zh: 她忙着把要做的所有工作列一个清单。

senses.def: working for somebody; employed by somebody
senses.zh: 替某人工作；为某人所雇用

examples.en: How long has she been in your employ?
examples.zh: 她为你工作多长时间了？

senses.def: if a person or their time is employed in doing something

examples.en: She was employed in making a list of all the jobs to be done.
examples.zh: 她忙着把要做的所有工作列一个清单。

items.idm: in somebody’s employ | in the employ of somebody

senses.def: working for somebody; employed by somebody
senses.zh: 替某人工作；为某人所雇用

examples.en: How long has she been in your employ?
examples.zh: 她为你工作多长时间了？

senses.def: the extent to which somebody has the skills, knowledge, attitude, etc. that make them suitable for paid work
senses.zh: 就业能力：某人具有使他们适合带薪工作的技能，知识，态度等的程度

examples.en: Acquiring enhanced IT skills will improve your employability.
examples.zh: 获得增强的 IT 技能将提高您的就业能力。

senses.def: having the skills and qualifications that will make somebody want to employ you
senses.zh: 具备受雇条件的；适宜雇用的

examples.en: training schemes that aim to make young people more employable
examples.zh: 旨在提升年轻人受聘机会的培训计划

senses.def: a person who is paid to work for somebody

examples.en: The firm has over 500 employees.
examples.zh: 这家公司有 500 多名雇员。

examples.en: They have eight full-time and two part-time employees.
examples.zh: 他们有八个全职员工和两个兼职员工。

examples.en: government/state/federal employees
examples.zh: 政府／州／联邦雇员

examples.en: He is in charge of hiring and firing employees.
examples.zh: 他负责雇用和解雇员工。

examples.en: employees who work more than 20 hours per week
examples.zh: 每周工作 20 小时以上的雇员

examples.en: employee rights/relations
examples.zh: 雇员权利／关系

examples.en: employee turnover/productivity
examples.zh: 员工流动率/生产力

examples.en: In addition to a competitive salary, the company offers attractive employee benefits.
examples.zh: 除了具有竞争力的薪酬外，公司还提供有吸引力的员工福利。

examples.en: A partnership can also improve employee morale.
examples.zh: 伙伴关系还可以提高员工士气。

senses.def: a person or company that pays people to work for them

examples.en: They're very good employers (= they treat the people that work for them well).
examples.zh: 他们是非常好的雇主。

examples.en: They're one of the largest employers in the area.
examples.zh: 他们是该地区最大的雇主之一。

examples.en: These skills are highly regarded by potential employers.
examples.zh: 这些技能受到潜在雇主的高度重视。

examples.en: A prospective employer will want to see your portfolio.
examples.zh: 未来的雇主会希望看到你的作品集。

examples.en: They had sought references from his former employer before hiring him.
examples.zh: 他们在雇用他之前向他的前雇主寻求了推荐信。

examples.en: The law requires employers to offer a safe work environment.
examples.zh: 法律要求雇主提供安全的工作环境。

senses.def: work, especially when it is done to earn money; the state of being employed

examples.en: full-time/part-time employment
examples.zh: 全职／兼职工作

examples.en: people seeking employment
examples.zh: 找工作的人

examples.en: They are finding it more and more difficult to find employment.
examples.zh: 他们感到找工作越来越难。

examples.en: The steelworks provided employment for thousands of people.
examples.zh: 这家钢铁厂为数千人提供了就业机会。

examples.en: He took up employment with the company in May 2015.
examples.zh: 彼于2015年5月入职该公司。

examples.en: She hoped to secure employment in the IT sector.
examples.zh: 她希望能在IT行业找到工作。

examples.en: Most of last year's graduates are now in paid employment.
examples.zh: 大多数去年的毕业生现在都有挣钱的工作了。

examples.en: There are limited employment opportunities here.
examples.zh: 这里的就业机会有限。

examples.en: Such clauses in employment contracts are common in many states.
examples.zh: 雇佣合同中的此类条款在许多州都很常见。

examples.en: a specialist in employment law
examples.zh: 就业法专家

examples.en: conditions/terms of employment
examples.zh: 雇用条件／条款

examples.en: Please list any pension entitlement you have from previous employments.
examples.zh: 请列出您在以前的工作中享有的任何养老金权利。

senses.def: the situation in which people have work

examples.en: The government is aiming at full employment.
examples.zh: 政府在力求实现充分就业。

examples.en: Changes in farming methods have badly affected employment in the area.
examples.zh: 耕作方法的改变严重影响了这个地区的就业。

senses.def: the act of employing somebody

examples.en: The law prevented the employment of children under ten in the cotton mills.
examples.zh: 法律禁止棉纺厂雇用十岁以下的童工。

examples.en: The company's employment practices have been widely criticized.
examples.zh: 这家公司雇用人员的做法受到广泛批评。

senses.def: the use of something

examples.en: the employment of artillery in the capture of the town
examples.zh: 在攻城时使用大炮

intro.en: These are all words for the jobs that somebody does in return for payment, especially over a long period of time.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指有报酬的工作，尤指长期从事的职业。

items.def: the job that somebody does, especially in order to earn money:
items.zh: 指工作、职业

examples.en: It’s very difficult to find work at the moment.
examples.zh: 目前很难找到工作。

items.def: (rather formal) work, especially when it is done to earn money; the state of being employed or the situation in which people have work:
items.zh: 指工作、职业、受雇、就业

examples.en: Only half the people here are in paid employment.
examples.zh: 这儿只有一半的人有拿工资的工作。

items.def: the job or series of jobs that somebody has in a particular area of work, usually involving more responsibility as time passes:
items.zh: 指生涯、职业

examples.en: He had a very distinguished career in the Foreign Office.
examples.zh: 他在外交部有过一段光辉的事业。

items.def: a type of job that needs special training or skill, especially one that needs a high level of education:
items.zh: 指需要专门技能（尤其是较高教育水平）的职业、专业

examples.en: He hopes to enter the medical profession.
examples.zh: 他希望能从事医务工作。

items.def: (rather formal) a job or profession:
items.zh: 指工作、职业

examples.en: Please state your name, age, and occupation.
examples.zh: 请写明姓名、年龄和职业。

items.def: a job, especially one that involves working with your hands and requires special training and skills:
items.zh: 指行业，尤指手工职业、手艺、行当

examples.en: Carpentry is a highly skilled trade.
examples.zh: 木工是需要纯熟技巧的职业。

senses.def: a business that helps people to find work and employers to find workers

examples.en: I was put in touch with a local employment agency.
examples.zh: 我与当地的一家职业介绍所取得了联系。

senses.def: the use of employment practices that encourage fair treatment of employees from all groups in society

examples.en: Employment equity helps to promote diversity in the workplace, regardless of age, race or gender.
examples.zh: 就业公平有助于促进工作场所的多样性，无论年龄、种族或性别如何。

senses.def: a type of insurance system that is run by the Canadian government that pays money regularly to people who do not have a job
senses.zh: 加拿大就业保险（失业保险金）

senses.def: a type of court that can decide on disagreements
senses.zh: 劳资裁判庭；劳资仲裁庭

examples.en: She took her case to an employment tribunal.
examples.zh: 她向劳资裁判庭提起诉讼。

senses.def: a large shop
a shop that sells a particular type of goods

examples.en: an arts and crafts emporium
examples.zh: 工艺品商店

senses.def: to give somebody the power or authority to do something

examples.en: The courts were empowered to impose the death sentence for certain crimes.
examples.zh: 法院有权因某些罪行判处罪犯死刑。

senses.def: to give somebody more control over their own life or the situation they are in
senses.zh: 增加（某人）自主权；使控制局势

examples.en: The movement actively empowered women and gave them confidence in themselves.
examples.zh: 这场运动使女性更能主动掌握自己的命运，对自己充满信心。

senses.def: the act of giving somebody more control over their own life or the situation they are in
senses.zh: 增加（某人的）自主权；使控制局势

examples.en: female/black/personal empowerment
examples.zh: 女性/黑人/个人赋权

examples.en: the empowerment of the individual
examples.zh: 让人掌握自己的命运

senses.def: the act of giving somebody the power or authority to do something
a woman who is the ruler of an empire

examples.en: the Empress of Egypt
examples.zh: 埃及女皇

senses.def: the wife of an emperor
without showing any feeling or emotion
senses.zh: 空洞的：没有表现出任何感觉或情感

examples.en: She stood staring emptily into space.
examples.zh: 她两眼发直地呆站着。

senses.def: in an unhappy way because there is nothing interesting or pleasant to look forward to
senses.zh: 空虚：以一种不快乐的方式，因为没有什么有趣或令人愉快的期待

examples.en: The rest of his life yawned emptily in front of him.
examples.zh: 余生在他面前空洞地打着哈欠。

senses.def: with no meaning
senses.zh: 空洞的；说话不算数的；无诚意的

examples.en: The word rang emptily.
examples.zh: 这句话空空响起。

senses.def: in a way that shows there are no people or things inside

examples.en: Every third house glared emptily back at me through broken windows.
examples.zh: 每三所房子中就有一半透过破碎的窗户空洞地瞪着我。

senses.def: a feeling of being sad because nothing seems to have any value

examples.en: There was an aching emptiness in her heart.
examples.zh: 她的内心有一种隐隐作痛的空虚感。

senses.def: the fact that there is nothing or nobody in a place

examples.en: The silence and emptiness of the house did not scare her.
examples.zh: 房子的空寂并未使她感到害怕。

senses.def: a place that is empty

examples.en: He stared out at the vast emptiness of the sea.
examples.zh: 他放眼向辽阔无际的海洋望去。

senses.def: with no people or things inside

examples.en: an empty box/glass/bottle
examples.zh: 空盒；空杯；空瓶

examples.en: empty hands (= not holding anything)
examples.zh: 空手

examples.en: an empty plate (= with no food on it)
examples.zh: 空盘子

examples.en: I noticed an empty space on the bookshelf.
examples.zh: 我注意到书架上有一个空的地方。

examples.en: I couldn't see any empty seats (= with nobody sitting in them).
examples.zh: 我一个空位也没看到。

examples.en: The theatre was half empty.
examples.zh: 剧场空了一半。

examples.en: an empty house/room/bus
examples.zh: 空着的房子／房间／公共汽车

examples.en: As it got later, the streets became empty.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，街道变得空荡荡的。

examples.en: The house had been standing empty (= without people living in it) for some time.
examples.zh: 这房子已经有一段时间没人住了。

examples.en: It's not good to drink alcohol on an empty stomach (= without having eaten something).
examples.zh: 空腹饮酒不好。

examples.en: The room was empty of furniture.
examples.zh: 房间里什么家具都没有。

senses.def: with no meaning; not meaning what is said
senses.zh: 空洞的；说话不算数的；无诚意的

examples.en: empty words
examples.zh: 空话

examples.en: an empty promise
examples.zh: 兑现不了的承诺

examples.en: Voters will see through the empty rhetoric.
examples.zh: 选民会看穿空洞的言辞。

examples.en: an empty gesture aimed at pleasing the crowds
examples.zh: 旨在取悦观众的装腔作势

senses.def: unhappy because life does not seem to have a purpose, usually after something sad has happened
senses.zh: 空虚的；无意义的；无目的的

examples.en: Three months after his death, she still felt empty.
examples.zh: 他死后三个月她仍然感到心里空落落的。

examples.en: My life seems empty without you.
examples.zh: 没有你，我的生活似乎就没有了意义。

examples.en: We all feel very empty now she's gone.
examples.zh: 她走了，我们都觉得心里空荡荡的。

senses.def: without a quality that you would expect to be there

examples.en: words that were empty of meaning
examples.zh: 无意义的话

senses.def: used to refer to the attitude of somebody who always looks at the bad things in a situation rather than the good ones

examples.en: For me the glass is half-empty.
examples.zh: 我是一个悲观主义者。

examples.en: If you start to look at things with a glass half-empty mentality, your problems soon pile up.
examples.zh: 如果你开始以悲观的态度看待事物，你的问题很快就会堆积如山。

senses.def: to remove everything that is in a container, etc.

examples.en: She emptied the bins, washed the glasses and went to bed.
examples.zh: 她倒掉垃圾，洗完杯子就上床睡觉了。

examples.en: He emptied his glass and asked for a refill.
examples.zh: 他干了一杯，又要求再斟满一杯。

examples.en: I emptied out my pockets but could not find my keys.
examples.zh: 我把口袋里的东西都掏了出来，仍然找不到我的钥匙。

examples.en: The room had been emptied of all furniture.
examples.zh: 房间里所有的家具都搬走了。

examples.en: She emptied her mind of all thoughts of home.
examples.zh: 她打消了想家的所有念头。

senses.def: to become empty

examples.en: The streets soon emptied when the rain started.
examples.zh: 雨下起来，街上很快便空无一人了。

examples.en: The beach gradually emptied of people.
examples.zh: 海滩上的人渐渐散去。

examples.en: The tank empties out in five minutes.
examples.zh: 水箱五分钟就空了。

senses.def: to take out the contents of something and put them somewhere else
senses.zh: 把…移出，把…腾出（置于别处）

examples.en: He stepped outside to empty the trash.
examples.zh: 他走出去倒垃圾。

examples.en: She emptied the contents of her bag onto the table.
examples.zh: 她把包里的东西全倒在了桌子上。

examples.en: Many factories emptied their waste into the river.
examples.zh: 许多工厂都将废料倒进了这条河里。

examples.en: She emptied the water out of the vase.
examples.zh: 她把水从花瓶里倒了出来。

senses.def: to make sure that everyone leaves a room, building, etc.

examples.en: Police had instructions to empty the building because of a bomb threat.
examples.zh: 由于炸弹的威胁，警方奉命将所有人撤离这栋大楼。

senses.def: to flow or move out from one place to another

examples.en: The Rhine empties into the North Sea.
examples.zh: 莱茵河流入北海。

examples.en: Fans emptied out onto the streets after the concert.
examples.zh: 音乐会结束后，乐迷涌到大街上。

senses.def: to continue working or trying despite having no resources, energy, ideas, etc. left
senses.zh: 勉强支撑（虽精疲力竭仍打起精神继续工作并保持活跃）

examples.en: A lot of the players are running on empty and deserve a good rest.
examples.zh: 很多球员都在空腹状态下奔跑，需要好好休息。

senses.def: used to refer to the attitude of somebody who always looks at the bad things in a situation rather than the good ones

examples.en: For me the glass is half-empty.
examples.zh: 我是一个悲观主义者。

examples.en: If you start to look at things with a glass half-empty mentality, your problems soon pile up.
examples.zh: 如果你开始以悲观的态度看待事物，你的问题很快就会堆积如山。

senses.def: to continue working or trying despite having no resources, energy, ideas, etc. left
senses.zh: 勉强支撑（虽精疲力竭仍打起精神继续工作并保持活跃）

examples.en: A lot of the players are running on empty and deserve a good rest.
examples.zh: 很多球员都在空腹状态下奔跑，需要好好休息。

senses.def: without getting what you wanted; without taking something to somebody

examples.en: The robbers fled empty-handed.
examples.zh: 抢劫犯一无所获地逃走了。

examples.en: She visited every Sunday and never arrived empty-handed.
examples.zh: 她每个星期天都来拜访，没有哪一次不带礼物。

examples.en: We went to the sale expecting to buy a lot, but we came away empty-handed.
examples.zh: 我们去参加促销，本想买很多东西，但我们空手而归。

senses.def: unable to think or behave in an intelligent way
the situation or the home of parents whose children have grown up and left
senses.zh: （儿女长大离家形成的）空巢现象，空巢

examples.en: They got a cat to try and fill the empty nest.
examples.zh: 他们养了一只猫来填补空巢。

examples.en: As parents face empty nests, they may decide to move to a smaller property.
examples.zh: 当父母面临空巢的情况时，他们可能会决定搬到较小的房产。

examples.en: Claire is suffering from empty nest syndrome (= sadness because her children have left home).
examples.zh: 克莱尔患有空巢综合症（=因为孩子们离家而感到悲伤）。

senses.def: a parent whose children have grown up and left home
a goal scored because there is no goaltender

examples.en: Finland scored an empty-netter to win the game after Sweden pulled their goalie.
examples.zh: 瑞典队撤下守门员，芬兰队打入空门，赢得比赛。

senses.def: a system for sending pictures, music and long written messages from one mobile phone to another (the abbreviation for ‘
senses.zh: 增强型消息业务（全写为 enhanced message service，手机传送图片、音乐和长条信息的系统）

senses.def: a message sent by EMS
senses.zh: 增强型消息；音画信息；增强型短消息

senses.def: a person who is trained to provide emergency medical treatment to people who are not in a hospital (the abbreviation for emergency medical technician
senses.zh: 医疗急救员（全写为 emergency medical technician）

examples.en: The EMTs arrived less than ten minutes after the highway accident.
examples.zh: 公路事故发生后不到十分钟急救员就赶到了。

senses.def: a large Australian bird that can run fast but cannot fly
senses.zh: 鸸鹋（产于澳大利亚，体型庞大，善跑但不会飞）

senses.def: Economic and Monetary Union
to try to do something as well as somebody else because you admire them

examples.en: She hopes to emulate her sister's sporting achievements.
examples.zh: 她希望在运动成绩方面赶上她姐姐。

senses.def: to work in the same way as another computer, etc. and perform the same tasks
the act of trying to do something as well as somebody else because you admire them

examples.en: It is not clear that the Western model of development deserves emulation.
examples.zh: 目前尚不清楚西方发展模式是否值得效仿。

examples.en: Arched viaducts spanned valleys in emulation of the Romans.
examples.zh: 模仿罗马人的拱形高架桥横跨山谷。

senses.def: the act of a computer or computer program working in the same way as another computer or program and performing the same tasks
a person who tries to do something as well as somebody else that they admire

examples.en: He was an admirer and emulator of the tenor Mario Lanza.
examples.zh: 他是男高音马里奥·兰扎的崇拜者和模仿者。

senses.def: a device or piece of software that makes it possible to use programs, etc. on one type of computer even though they have been designed for a different type
a substance that is added to something, especially food, to make the different substances in it combine to form a smooth mixture
if two liquids, one of which is thicker than the other, emulsify
any mixture of liquids that do not normally mix together, such as oil and water

examples.en: Reduce the heat until the mixture becomes a thick emulsion.
examples.zh: 减少热量直至混合物变成浓稠乳液。

examples.en: The test solutions were prepared in emulsion form.
examples.zh: 将测试溶液制备成乳液形式。

senses.def: a type of paint used on walls and ceilings that dries without leaving a shiny surface

examples.en: They gave the walls a coat of white emulsion.
examples.zh: 他们给墙壁涂了一层白色乳液。

senses.def: a substance on the surface of photographic

examples.en: photographic/film emulsion
examples.zh: 照相/胶片乳剂

senses.def: to put into the thing or condition mentioned
senses.zh: 置于…之中；使处于…状态；赋予

examples.en: encase
examples.zh: 置于箱中

examples.en: endanger
examples.zh: 使遭遇危险

examples.en: empower
examples.zh: 授权

senses.def: to cause to be

examples.en: enlarge
examples.zh: 扩大

examples.en: embolden
examples.zh: 使更有胆量

senses.def: to make or become

examples.en: blacken
examples.zh: 使变黑

examples.en: sadden
examples.zh: 使悲伤

senses.def: made of; looking like
senses.zh: 由…制成（或构成）的；像…一样的

examples.en: wooden
examples.zh: 木制的

examples.en: golden
examples.zh: 金的

senses.def: as a group rather than separately

examples.en: There are reports of teachers resigning en bloc.
examples.zh: 有一些关于教师集体辞职的报道。

senses.def: all together, and usually in large numbers

examples.en: The young folk were emigrating en masse.
examples.zh: 年轻人大批移民。

senses.def: while talking about something else and without giving much information

examples.en: He mentioned en passant that he was going away.
examples.zh: 他顺便提到他要离开。

senses.def: on the way; while travelling from/to a particular place

examples.en: We stopped for a picnic en route.
examples.zh: 我们在途中停下来野餐。

examples.en: The bus broke down en route from Boston to New York.
examples.zh: 公共汽车在从波士顿到纽约的途中抛锚了。

examples.en: a plane en route for Heathrow
examples.zh: 在飞往希思罗机场途中的飞机

senses.def: joined onto a bedroom and for use only by people in that bedroom

examples.en: Each bedroom in the hotel has a bathroom en suite/an en-suite bathroom.
examples.zh: 旅馆里每间卧室都带浴室。

examples.en: an en-suite bedroom (= a bedroom with a bathroom en suite)
examples.zh: 带浴室的卧室

examples.en: en-suite facilities
examples.zh: 与卧室配套的设备

senses.def: a bathroom that is joined onto a bedroom and for use only by people in that bedroom

examples.en: The en-suite has a power shower.
examples.zh: 配套浴室内有强力淋浴器。

examples.en: Both bedrooms have tiled en-suites.
examples.zh: 两个卧室都带有铺瓷砖的专属浴室。

senses.def: to make it possible for somebody/something to do something

examples.en: This new programme will enable older people to study at college.
examples.zh: 这门新课程使老年人有机会读大学。

examples.en: This approach enables the company to focus on its core business.
examples.zh: 这种方式使公司能够专注于其核心业务。

examples.en: Insulin enables the body to use and store sugar.
examples.zh: 胰岛素使人体能够利用和贮存糖分。

examples.en: The tool enables users to test their computer's exposure to a wide range of online threats.
examples.zh: 该工具使用户能够测试其计算机是否面临各种在线威胁。

senses.def: to make it possible for something to happen or exist by creating the necessary conditions
senses.zh: 使成为可能；使可行；使实现

examples.en: a new train line to enable easier access to the stadium
examples.zh: 到体育场更为便捷的新列车线路

senses.def: to make a system, device or feature ready to use

examples.en: To enable this feature, go to Account Settings and click ‘Security’.
examples.zh: 要启用此功能，请转到帐户设置并单击“安全”。

senses.def: the act of making it possible for something to happen or for somebody to do something

examples.en: The surprising benefit of the changes has been the enablement of innovation.
examples.zh: 这些变革意想不到的好处是激发了创新。

examples.en: Training was focused on the enablement of teachers to provide quality services.
examples.zh: 培训的重点是使教师能够提供优质服务。

senses.def: the act of making a system, device or feature ready to use

examples.en: Most of the hardware enablement is now complete.
examples.zh: 大部分的硬件启用程序现已完成。

examples.en: The aim is to provide safe and secure enablement of network applications.
examples.zh: 目的是提供安全可靠的网络应用支持。

senses.def: a person or thing that makes something possible
senses.zh: 促成者；使成为可能的人（或事物）

examples.en: Air transport is a key enabler of world trade.
examples.zh: 航空运输是世界贸易的重要推动力量。

examples.en: Quality education is the critical enabler for the development of any nation.
examples.zh: 优质教育是任何国家发展的关键推动力。

senses.def: a person or thing that encourages or makes it possible for somebody to engage in behaviour that is negative or that does them harm

examples.en: If you knew about his abusive behavour and did nothing, you are an enabler.
examples.zh: 如果你知道他的虐待行为并且没有采取任何行动，那么你就是一个推动者。

examples.en: Even things like cable television can be an enabler of poor habits.
examples.zh: 甚至像有线电视这样的东西也可能导致不良习惯。

senses.def: a law that allows a person or an organization to do something, especially to make rules
to pass a law

examples.en: legislation enacted by parliament
examples.zh: 由议会通过的法律

senses.def: to perform a play or act a part in a play

examples.en: scenes from history enacted by local residents
examples.zh: 由当地居民演出的历史场面

senses.def: to take place

examples.en: They seemed unaware of the drama being enacted a few feet away from them.
examples.zh: 他们对于正在咫尺之外上演的戏剧性事件似乎浑然不知。

senses.def: to put something into practice

examples.en: This involves identifying problems and enacting solutions.
examples.zh: 这需要找出问题并解决问题。

senses.def: the process of a law becoming official; a law which has been made official

examples.en: the enactment of environmental legislation
examples.zh: 环境立法的颁布

examples.en: legal enactments covering food safety
examples.zh: 涉及食品安全的法律法规

senses.def: a substance made from glass powder that is melted onto metal, pots, etc. and forms a hard shiny surface to protect or decorate them; an object made from enamel

examples.en: a chipped enamel bowl
examples.zh: 掉瓷的搪瓷碗

examples.en: a handle inlaid with enamel
examples.zh: 有珐琅镶饰的把手

examples.en: an exhibition of enamels and jewellery
examples.zh: 搪瓷艺术品和珠宝首饰展览

senses.def: the hard white outer layer of a tooth
a type of paint that dries to leave a hard shiny surface
covered or decorated with enamel
senses.zh: 上了瓷漆（或瓷釉）的；用搪瓷（或珐琅）装饰的

senses.def: liking something a lot

examples.en: He was less than enamoured of the music.
examples.zh: 他不大爱好这种音乐。

examples.en: I'm not exactly enamoured with the idea of spending a whole day with them.
examples.zh: 我不是很喜欢一整天都跟他们待在一起的想法。

senses.def: in love with somebody
enclosed
senses.zh: 随函附上的，附上的（用于商业信函）

senses.def: if a group of people encamp

examples.en: We encamped for the night by the side of a river.
examples.zh: 我们在河边露营了一夜。

examples.en: The royalist army was encamped outside London.
examples.zh: 保皇党军队在伦敦郊外扎营。

senses.def: a group of tents, huts

examples.en: a military encampment
examples.zh: 军营

senses.def: to express the most important parts of something in a few words, a small space or a single object

examples.en: The poem encapsulates many of the central themes of her writing.
examples.zh: 这首诗概括了她许多著作的核心主题。

senses.def: the act of expressing the most important parts of something in a few words, a small space or a single object

examples.en: She gave a succinct and colourful encapsulation of what happened.
examples.zh: 她对所发生的事情进行了简洁而丰富多彩的概括。

senses.def: to surround or cover something completely, especially to protect it

examples.en: The reactor is encased in concrete and steel.
examples.zh: 核反应堆由钢筋混凝土包住。

examples.en: His upper body was completely encased in bandages.
examples.zh: 他的上半身完全被绷带包裹着。

senses.def: to exchange a cheque
senses.zh: 把（支票等）兑现；把…变为现钱

senses.def: the act of exchanging a cheque
senses.zh: 把（支票等）兑现；把…变为现钱

examples.en: Penalties may be charged for early encashment of the policy.
examples.zh: 提前兑现保单可能会受到处罚。

senses.def: the action or state of

examples.en: confidence
examples.zh: 信心

senses.def: a condition in which the brain becomes swollen
a disease in which the functioning of the brain is affected by infection, blood poisoning
to attract somebody strongly and make them feel very interested, excited, etc.

examples.en: The happy family scene had enchanted him.
examples.zh: 一家其乐融融的场面使他陶醉。

examples.en: The play continued to enchant all who watched it.
examples.zh: 该剧继续让所有观看者着迷。

senses.def: to place somebody/something under a magic spell
senses.zh: 使着魔；对…施魔法（或念咒语）

senses.def: (in stories) a man who has magic powers that he uses to control people
in an attractive and pleasant way
senses.zh: 迷人的；令人陶醉的；使人喜悦的

senses.def: a feeling of great pleasure
the state of being under a magic spell

examples.en: It was a place of deep mystery and enchantment.
examples.zh: 这是一个极其神秘的魔法世界。

senses.def: a magic spell

examples.en: They had been turned to stone by an enchantment.
examples.zh: 他们被魔咒变成了石头。

senses.def: (in stories) a woman who has magic powers that she uses to control people
a woman that people find very attractive and interesting
a Mexican dish consisting of a tortilla
the most important person or thing
the whole thing; everything
the most important person or thing
the whole thing; everything
to surround somebody/something completely in a circle

examples.en: Jack's arms encircled her waist.
examples.zh: 杰克的双臂搂着她的腰。

examples.en: The island is encircled by a coral reef.
examples.zh: 这个岛周围都是珊瑚礁。

examples.en: Snow covered the encircling hills.
examples.zh: 雪覆盖了周围的山丘。

senses.def: the act of surrounding somebody/something completely in a circle

examples.en: The encirclement of the world by telegraph by the early 1870s represented a revolution in communications.
examples.zh: 1870 年代初期，电报包围了世界，这代表了通信领域的一场革命。

senses.def: enclosed
senses.zh: 随函附上的，附上的（用于商业信函）

senses.def: an area of a country or city where the people have a different religion, culture or nationality
senses.zh: 飞地（某国或某市境内具有不同宗教、文化或民族的群众聚居区）

examples.en: The northern part of the city is a Christian enclave.
examples.zh: 这座城市的北部是一块基督徒飞地。

senses.def: a word pronounced with very little emphasis, so that it becomes part of the word before, for example ‘n’t’ in ‘can’t’
senses.zh: 一个单词的发音很少，因此使其成为该单词之前的一部分，例如，“ ca n't”中的“ n't”不能

senses.def: to build a wall, fence, etc. around something

examples.en: The yard had been enclosed with iron railings.
examples.zh: 院子用铁栅栏围了起来。

examples.en: All translated words should be enclosed in brackets.
examples.zh: 所有译文都应用括号括起来。

senses.def: to surround something

examples.en: Low hedges enclosed the flower beds.
examples.zh: 矮树篱把花坛围了起来。

examples.en: She felt his arms enclose her.
examples.zh: 她感到他双臂搂住了她。

senses.def: to build a wall or fence around common

examples.en: The land was enclosed in the seventeenth century.
examples.zh: 这片土地在十七世纪被圈为私产。

senses.def: to put something in the same envelope
senses.zh: 附入；随函（或包裹等）附上

examples.en: Please return the completed form, enclosing a recent photograph.
examples.zh: 请将填好的表格寄回，并附上近照一张。

senses.def: a piece of land that is surrounded by a fence or wall and is used for a particular purpose

examples.en: a wildlife enclosure
examples.zh: 野生动物围场

examples.en: the winners’ enclosure (= for the winners of a horse race)
examples.zh: 获胜者围场（=赛马获胜者）

senses.def: the act of placing a fence or wall around a piece of land

examples.en: the enclosure of common land in the seventeenth century
examples.zh: 17 世纪对公用地的圈占

examples.en: The result of the enclosures was that many countrymen lost their only livelihood.
examples.zh: 圈地的结果是许多同胞失去了唯一的生计。

senses.def: something that is placed in an envelope

examples.en: Always state the number of enclosures at the bottom of your letter.
examples.zh: 信尾一定要注明附件的份数。

senses.def: to change ordinary language into letters, symbols, etc. in order to send secret messages
to change information into a form that can be processed by a computer
to be responsible for producing a specific protein

examples.en: These genes encode proteins that play essential roles in cell physiology.
examples.zh: 这些基因编码在细胞生理学中发挥重要作用的蛋白质。

senses.def: to express the meaning of something in a foreign language
a speech or piece of writing that praises somebody or something highly
senses.zh: 高度赞扬的话（或文章）；颂词

senses.def: to include a large number or range of things
senses.zh: 包含，包括，涉及（大量事物）

examples.en: The job encompasses a wide range of responsibilities.
examples.zh: 这项工作涉及的职责范围很广。

examples.en: The group encompasses all ages.
examples.zh: 这个小组各种年龄的人都有。

senses.def: to surround or cover something completely

examples.en: The fog soon encompassed the whole valley.
examples.zh: 大雾很快笼罩了整个山谷。

senses.def: an extra short performance given at the end of a concert or other performance; a request for this made by an audience calling out
senses.zh: （音乐会或其他演出结束时）加演的节目；（观众要求的）再演一个；安可

examples.en: She played a Chopin waltz as an encore.
examples.zh: 她应听众的要求又加演了一首肖邦的圆舞曲。

examples.en: The group got three encores.
examples.zh: 乐团三次得到观众“再来一个”的请求。

senses.def: an audience calls out encore!
senses.zh: （在音乐会结束时观众喊的）再来一个，再唱一首，再奏一曲

senses.def: to experience something, especially something unpleasant or difficult, while you are trying to do something else
senses.zh: 遭遇，遇到（尤指令人不快或困难的事）

examples.en: We encountered a number of difficulties in the first week.
examples.zh: 我们在第一周遇到了一些困难。

examples.en: The report details the problems encountered by families in this situation.
examples.zh: 报告详细介绍了家庭在这种情况下遇到的问题。

examples.en: I had never encountered such resistance before.
examples.zh: 我以前从未遇到过这么大的阻力。

senses.def: to meet somebody, or discover or experience something, especially somebody/something new, unusual or unexpected
senses.zh: 偶然碰到；意外遇见；与…邂逅

examples.en: She was the most remarkable woman he had ever encountered.
examples.zh: 她是他所见到过的最出色的女性。

examples.en: Plant scientists first encountered the phenomenon in the 1930s.
examples.zh: 植物科学家在 20 世纪 30 年代首次遇到这种现象。

senses.def: a meeting, especially one that is sudden, unexpected or violent
senses.zh: （尤指突然、意外或暴力的）相遇，邂逅，遭遇，冲突

examples.en: a chance encounter
examples.zh: 偶然相遇

examples.en: Three of them were killed in the subsequent encounter with the police.
examples.zh: 他们中有三个人后来在与警察的冲突中被杀死。

examples.en: Flaubert was her first encounter with French literature.
examples.zh: 福楼拜是她第一次接触法国文学。

examples.en: The story describes the extraordinary encounter between a man and a dolphin.
examples.zh: 这个故事描述了一个男人与一只海豚之间的奇遇。

examples.en: I've had a number of close encounters (= situations that could have been dangerous) with bad drivers.
examples.zh: 我好几次都险些与技术不佳的司机相撞。

examples.en: It was his first sexual encounter (= first experience of sex).
examples.zh: 那是他的第一次性经历。

senses.def: a sports match against a particular player or team

examples.en: She has beaten her opponent in all of their previous encounters.
examples.zh: 她在以前的所有交锋中都击败了这个对手。

examples.en: They lost their second-round encounter against Germany.
examples.zh: 他们在第二轮比赛中输给了德国队。

senses.def: an incident in which police shoot dead a suspected criminal

examples.en: The two gangsters were later killed in a police encounter.
examples.zh: 这两名歹徒后来在一次警察冲突中被击毙。

senses.def: a group of people who meet regularly in order to help each other with emotional and psychological
senses.zh: 交心心理治疗团体，会心团体（成员定期聚集）

senses.def: to give somebody support, courage or hope

examples.en: We were greatly encouraged by the positive response of the public.
examples.zh: 公众所持的肯定态度给了我们极大的鼓舞。

examples.en: She encouraged many young writers and artists.
examples.zh: 她鼓励了许多年轻作家和艺术家。

examples.en: My parents have always encouraged me in my choice of career.
examples.zh: 在我选择职业时父母总是鼓励我。

examples.en: ‘You're doing fine,’ he encouraged them.
examples.zh: “你们做得很好，”他鼓励他们。

senses.def: to persuade somebody to do something by making it easier for them and making them believe it is a good thing to do

examples.en: Banks actively encouraged people to borrow money.
examples.zh: 银行积极鼓动人们贷款。

examples.en: I strongly encourage everyone to go and see this important film.
examples.zh: 我强烈推荐大家去看这部重要的电影。

examples.en: Speaking your mind is highly encouraged at these sessions.
examples.zh: 这些课非常鼓励你说出自己的想法。

senses.def: to make something more likely to happen or develop

examples.en: There is a clear case for spending public money on encouraging participation in sport.
examples.zh: 政府拨款促进参与体育运动是有明显理由的。

examples.en: to encourage development/investment/growth
examples.zh: 促进发展／投资／增长

examples.en: The government should encourage the use of renewable energy sources.
examples.zh: 政府应鼓励使用可再生能源。

examples.en: They claim that some computer games encourage violent behaviour in young children.
examples.zh: 他们声称有些电脑游戏助长儿童的暴力行为。

examples.en: Music and lighting are used to encourage shoppers to buy more.
examples.zh: 音乐和灯光用于刺激购物者买更多的东西。

senses.def: the act of encouraging somebody to do something; something that encourages somebody
senses.zh: 鼓舞；鼓励；起激励作用的事物

examples.en: a few words of encouragement
examples.zh: 几句鼓励的话

examples.en: He needs all the support and encouragement he can get.
examples.zh: 他需要所能得到的一切支持和鼓励。

examples.en: With a little encouragement from his parents he should do well.
examples.zh: 只要父母给点鼓励，他应该会干得很好。

examples.en: She was given every encouragement to try something new.
examples.zh: 她得到充分的鼓励去尝试新事物。

examples.en: Her words were a great encouragement to them.
examples.zh: 她的话对他们是极大的鼓舞。

senses.def: in a way that gives somebody support, courage or hope

examples.en: to smile encouragingly
examples.zh: 表示鼓励地微微一笑

examples.en: The attendance was encouragingly high.
examples.zh: 出席人数之多令人振奋。

senses.def: to begin to affect or use up too much of somebody’s time, rights, personal life, etc.
senses.zh: 侵占（某人的时间）；侵犯（某人的权利）；扰乱（某人的生活）

examples.en: I won't encroach on your time any longer.
examples.zh: 我不会再占用你的时间了。

examples.en: He never allows work to encroach upon his family life.
examples.zh: 他从不让工作扰乱他的家庭生活。

examples.en: Gradually the negative feelings encroached into her work.
examples.zh: 渐渐地，负面情绪侵入了她的工作。

senses.def: to slowly begin to cover more and more of an area

examples.en: The growing town soon encroached on the surrounding countryside.
examples.zh: 这个不断扩大的城镇不久便将周围的农村变成了市区。

examples.en: the encroaching tide (= that is coming in)
examples.zh: 不断涌向陆地的潮水

senses.def: the act of slowly affecting or using up too much of somebody's time, rights, personal life, etc.
senses.zh: 侵占（某人的时间）；侵犯（某人的权利）；扰乱（某人的生活）

examples.en: the encroachment of partisan ideology
examples.zh: 党派意识形态的侵蚀

examples.en: the regime’s many encroachments on human rights
examples.zh: 这个政权种种侵犯人权的行为

senses.def: the act of slowly covering more and more of an area

examples.en: It is increasingly difficult to shield farmland from urban encroachment.
examples.zh: 保护农田免受城市侵占变得越来越困难。

senses.def: the process of forming a hard outer layer over something; the layer that is formed
covered with a thin hard layer of something; forming a thin hard layer on something
senses.zh: 硬壳覆盖的；形成硬外层的

examples.en: a crown encrusted with diamonds
examples.zh: 镶满钻石的王冠

examples.en: encrusted blood
examples.zh: 已凝结的血

senses.def: to put information into a special code, especially in order to prevent people from looking at it without authority

examples.en: All data is encrypted before it is sent.
examples.zh: 所有数据在发送前都经过加密。

senses.def: the act of putting information into a special code, especially in order to prevent people from looking at it without authority
senses.zh: 将信息放入特殊代码中的行为，特别是为了防止人们未经授权查看信息

examples.en: Firewalls, data encryption and other standard security mechanisms protect the network.
examples.zh: 防火墙、数据加密和其他标准安全机制保护网络。

senses.def: to make it difficult for somebody to do something or for something to happen

examples.en: The police operation was encumbered by crowds of reporters.
examples.zh: 警方的行动被成群的记者所妨碍。

examples.en: The business is encumbered with debt.
examples.zh: 这家公司债务缠身。

senses.def: to be large and/or heavy and make it difficult for somebody to move
senses.zh: 大（或重）得难以移动；使负担沉重

examples.en: The frogmen were encumbered by their diving equipment.
examples.zh: 沉重的潜水装备使蛙人行动困难。

senses.def: a person or thing that prevents somebody from moving easily or from doing what they want

examples.en: I felt I was being an encumbrance to them.
examples.zh: 我感到自己成了他们的累赘。

senses.def: the state or quality of

examples.en: complacency
examples.zh: 自满

senses.def: an official letter written by the Pope and sent to all Roman Catholic bishops

a book or set of books giving information about all areas of knowledge or about different areas of one particular subject, usually arranged in alphabetical order; a similar collection of information in digital form
senses.zh: （纸质、数字版）百科全书；（某一学科的）专科全书

examples.en: a children’s encyclopedia
examples.zh: 一本儿童百科全书

examples.en: an encyclopedia of music
examples.zh: 音乐百科全书

examples.en: an online encyclopedia
examples.zh: 一部网络百科全书

examples.en: I looked the Civil War up in my encyclopedia.
examples.zh: 我在我的百科全书里查了美国内战。

examples.en: There are over 20 000 entries in the encyclopedia.
examples.zh: 这部百科全书有两万多条目。

examples.en: The man is a walking encyclopedia (= knows a lot of facts about different things).
examples.zh: 这个人是一本活百科全书（=知道很多关于不同事物的事实）。

senses.def: connected with encyclopedias
senses.zh: 百科全书的；百科知识的

examples.en: encyclopedic information
examples.zh: 百科知识

examples.en: an encyclopedic dictionary
examples.zh: 百科词典

senses.def: having a lot of information about a wide variety of subjects; containing complete information about a particular subject
senses.zh: 包含各种学科知识的；知识渊博的；博学的

examples.en: She has an encyclopedic knowledge of natural history.
examples.zh: 她具有广博的自然史知识。

examples.en: Penny’s contact book was encyclopedic.
examples.zh: 佩妮的通讯录是百科全书式的。

senses.def: the final part of a period of time, an event, an activity or a story
senses.zh: （时间、事件、活动或故事的）终止，终结，结局，结尾

examples.en: It's the end of an era.
examples.zh: 这是一个时代的终结。

examples.en: the end of the book
examples.zh: 书的末尾

examples.en: at the end of the week
examples.zh: 在周末

examples.en: There’ll be a chance to ask questions at the end.
examples.zh: 最后会有提问的机会。

examples.en: He wants the reports by the end of the month.
examples.zh: 他想在月底之前拿到报告。

examples.en: She remained active as an artist to the end of her life.
examples.zh: 她的艺术生涯一直延续到生命的尽头。

examples.en: I was getting bored towards the end of the talk.
examples.zh: 演讲快结束的时候我变得厌倦起来。

examples.en: We didn't leave until the very end.
examples.zh: 我们直到最后才离开。

examples.en: I'm staying until the end of this week.
examples.zh: 我将待到周末。

examples.en: We had to hear about the whole journey from beginning to end.
examples.zh: 我们只好从头到尾把整个旅行情况听完。

examples.en: He is nearing the end of his career.
examples.zh: 他的职业生涯即将结束。

examples.en: Our end-of-season sale starts next week.
examples.zh: 我们的季末促销将于下周开始。

senses.def: a situation in which something does not exist any more

examples.en: It was the end of all his dreams.
examples.zh: 他所有的梦想都破灭了。

examples.en: That was by no means the end of the matter.
examples.zh: 事情绝不可能到此为止。

examples.en: The war was finally at an end.
examples.zh: 战争终于结束了。

examples.en: The meeting came to an end (= finished).
examples.zh: 会议结束了。

examples.en: The coup brought his corrupt regime to an end.
examples.zh: 政变结束了他的腐败统治。

examples.en: This latest attack could spell the end of the peace process.
examples.zh: 这次最新的袭击可能意味着和平进程的结束。

examples.en: They have called for an end to violence.
examples.zh: 他们呼吁停止暴力。

examples.en: an end to the conflict/war
examples.zh: 冲突／战争的结束

examples.en: Let’s put an end to (= stop) these rumours once and for all.
examples.zh: 让我们对这些流言飞语作一了结吧。

examples.en: There's no end in sight to the present crisis.
examples.zh: 目前的危机无望结束。

examples.en: Cheap air travel marked the end of the golden age of the British seaside holiday.
examples.zh: 廉价航空旅行标志着英国海滨度假黄金时代的结束。

examples.en: The release of ‘The Jazz Singer’ signalled the end of the silent movie era.
examples.zh: 《爵士歌手》的上映标志着无声电影时代的结束。

senses.def: the part of an object or a place that is the furthest away from its centre

examples.en: I joined the end of the queue.
examples.zh: 我站在了这队伍的最后。

examples.en: Go to the end of the line!
examples.zh: 到这个队的最后去！

examples.en: Turn right at the end of the road.
examples.zh: 在路的尽头向右转。

examples.en: His office is the room at the other end of the corridor.
examples.zh: 他的办公室位于走廊另一端的房间。

examples.en: That's his wife sitting at the far end of the table.
examples.zh: 坐在桌子远端的那位就是他妻子。

examples.en: You've got something on the end of your nose.
examples.zh: 你的鼻尖上有点东西。

examples.en: Tie the ends of the string together.
examples.zh: 把绳子两端系在一起。

examples.en: These two products are from opposite ends of the price range.
examples.zh: 这两种产品一种是价格最高的，一种是价格最低的。

examples.en: We've travelled from one end of Mexico to the other.
examples.zh: 我们从墨西哥的一端旅行到了另一端。

examples.en: They live in the end house.
examples.zh: 他们住在最后的那座房子里。

senses.def: an aim or a purpose

examples.en: They are prepared to use violence in pursuit of their ends.
examples.zh: 他们准备使用暴力来达到目的。

examples.en: She is exploiting the current situation for her own ends.
examples.zh: 她在利用目前的形势来达到自己的目的。

examples.en: He joined the society for political ends.
examples.zh: 他为了政治目的加入了这个协会。

examples.en: With this end in view (= in order to achieve this) they employed 50 new staff.
examples.zh: 为了达到这个目标他们雇用了 50 名新职员。

examples.en: We are willing to make any concessions necessary to this end (= in order to achieve this).
examples.zh: 为达到此目的我们愿作出任何必要的让步。

examples.en: They are working towards common ends.
examples.zh: 他们正在为共同的目标而努力。

senses.def: a part of an activity with which somebody is involved, especially in business

examples.en: We need somebody to handle the marketing end of the business.
examples.zh: 我们需要有人来处理业务的推广。

examples.en: Are there any problems at your end?
examples.zh: 你那边有什么问题吗？

examples.en: I have kept my end of the bargain.
examples.zh: 我已履行了我的协议条件。

senses.group: part of activity 部分活动

senses.def: either of two places connected by a phone call, journey, etc.

examples.en: I answered the phone but there was no one at the other end.
examples.zh: 我接了电话，但线路的另一端没人说话。

examples.en: Jean is going to meet me at the other end.
examples.zh: 琼打算在那边终点站接我。

senses.group: of phone line/journey 电话线路；旅程

senses.def: one of the two halves of a sports field

examples.en: The teams changed ends at half-time.
examples.zh: 上半场结束时双方交换了场地。

senses.def: a small piece that is left after something has been used

examples.en: a cigarette end
examples.zh: 烟蒂

senses.def: a person’s death. People say ‘
senses.zh: 辞世，过世（婉辞，与 death 同义）

examples.en: She came to an untimely end (= died young).
examples.zh: 她英年早逝。

examples.en: I was with him at the end (= when he died).
examples.zh: 他临终时我在他身边。

examples.en: He met his end (= died) at the Battle of Waterloo.
examples.zh: 他在滑铁卢战役中阵亡。

senses.def: a lineman

examples.en: a defensive end
examples.zh: 防守端锋

examples.en: He does as good a job as any end in football at helping his teammates.
examples.zh: 在帮助队友方面，他的表现不亚于足球界的任何一端。

senses.def: used to introduce the most important fact after everything has been considered
senses.zh: （考虑到所有情况后引出最重要的事实）最终，到头来

examples.en: At the end of the day, he'll still have to make his own decision.
examples.zh: 最终，他还得自己拿主意。

senses.def: having nothing to do and not knowing what you want to do

examples.en: Come and see us, if you're at a loose end.
examples.zh: 你要是闲着无事就来我们这儿坐坐吧。

senses.def: something unpleasant that happens to somebody, for example punishment or a violent death, usually because of their own actions
senses.zh: 不愉快的结局；可悲的下场

examples.en: He'll come to a sticky end one of these days if he carries on like that.
examples.zh: 如果他继续那样下去，总有一天会落得个可悲的下场。

senses.def: to have almost nothing left of something
senses.zh: 所剩无几；到…的尽头（或极限）

examples.en: I'm at the end of my patience.
examples.zh: 我已忍无可忍。

examples.en: They are at the end of their food supply.
examples.zh: 他们的食物储备快要消耗殆尽。

senses.def: to feel that you cannot deal with a difficult situation any more because you are too tired, worried, etc.
senses.zh: 筋疲力尽；智穷力竭；山穷水尽

examples.en: You’d better let her know you’re safe. She’s at the end of her tether.
examples.zh: 你最好让她知道你很安全。她已经山穷水尽了。

senses.def: to be the person that an action, etc. is directed at, especially an unpleasant one

examples.en: She found herself on the receiving end of a great deal of criticism.
examples.zh: 她发现自己遭到众多的批评。

senses.def: to be so worried by a problem that you do not know what to do next
senses.zh: 智穷计尽；全然不知所措

examples.en: She was at her wits’ end wondering how she’d manage it all in the time.
examples.zh: 她束手无策，不知道自己该如何在这段时间里处理好这一切。

examples.en: I'm at my wits' end trying to cope with his moods.
examples.zh: 我想让他平静下来，可完全不知道该怎么办。

senses.def: when you say that people or situations are the end
senses.zh: 令人讨厌；惹人烦恼；让人无法容忍

senses.def: the first sign of something ending
senses.zh: 结束的前兆；结局的开始

examples.en: The scandal was the beginning of the end of his career as a politician.
examples.zh: 这起丑闻是他政治生涯终结的开始。

senses.def: to become very tired by trying to do too many things and going to bed late and getting up early
senses.zh: 过度劳累；起早贪黑而疲惫不堪

senses.def: a thing that is itself important and not just a part of something more important

examples.en: For her, shopping had become an end in itself.
examples.zh: 对她来说，购物本身就是目的。

examples.en: For him, travelling had become an end in itself rather than a means of seeing new places.
examples.zh: 对他来说，旅行本身已经成为目的，而不是探索新地方的手段。

senses.def: bad or unfair methods of doing something are acceptable if the result of that action is good or positive
senses.zh: 只要目的正当，可以不择手段

examples.en: He defended a morality in which the end justifies the means.
examples.zh: 他为不择手段达到正当目的的道德观进行辩护。

examples.en: That's only OK if you believe that the end justifies the means.
examples.zh: 除非你认为只要目的正确可以不择手段，不然那是不可以接受的。

senses.def: (to reach) the point at which something can no longer continue in the same way

examples.en: A defeat in the second round marked the end of the line for last year's champion.
examples.zh: 第二局的失利表明去年的冠军得主已卫冕无望。

examples.en: The loss of this contract could signal the end of the line for the shipyard.
examples.zh: 失去这份合同可能意味着这个造船厂的倒闭。

examples.en: This latest disagreement could mean the end of the road for the band.
examples.zh: 最近出现的分歧可能意味着乐队要解散了。

senses.def: used when you are stating that there is nothing more that can be said or done about something
senses.zh: 情况就是这样；就这么办

examples.en: If she doesn’t agree, I won’t go ahead. End of story.
examples.zh: 如果她不同意，我就不会继续了。就这么办。

senses.def: in a line, with the ends

examples.en: They arranged the tables end to end.
examples.zh: 他们将桌子连接起来排成一行。

senses.def: to have sex
to be the person in a group who is chosen or forced to perform an unpleasant duty or task
senses.zh: 抽到倒霉签；被派做苦差事

senses.def: to understand something in the wrong way
to suddenly become very angry or emotional
senses.zh: （突然）火冒三丈，大发脾气，非常激动

senses.def: to do everything possible, even if it is difficult, in order to get or achieve something
senses.zh: 走遍天涯海角；历尽千辛万苦

examples.en: I'd go to the ends of the earth to see her again.
examples.zh: 哪怕走遍天涯海角我也要再见她一面。

senses.def: after a long period of time or series of events

examples.en: He tried various jobs and in the end became an accountant.
examples.zh: 他尝试过各种各样的工作，最后当上了会计。

examples.en: In the end, they decided to spend Christmas at home.
examples.zh: 最终他们决定在家里过圣诞节。

senses.def: after everything has been considered

examples.en: You can try your best to impress the interviewers but in the end it's often just a question of luck.
examples.zh: 你可以尽最大的努力给主持面试的人留下深刻的印象，不过最终常常要看运气。

senses.def: to start or be made to start a new and difficult activity that you are not prepared for
senses.zh: （使）陷入未曾料到的艰难处境，一筹莫展

examples.en: Junior hospital doctors are thrown in at the deep end in their first jobs.
examples.zh: 医院的初级医生开始工作时会遇上未曾料到的困难。

examples.en: The company believes in throwing new employees in at the deep end with no training.
examples.zh: 该公司认为应该不经培训就让新员工从困难的部份做起。

senses.def: to continue to be cheerful in a difficult situation
something that shows you are nearly at the end of a long and difficult time or situation
senses.zh: 快要熬出头了；曙光在即

examples.en: For the first time since the start of his treatment, we can now see light at the end of the tunnel.
examples.zh: 自从他的治疗开始以来，我们现在第一次看到了一线希望。

senses.def: to earn just enough money to be able to buy the things you need
senses.zh: 使收支相抵；勉强维持生计

examples.en: Many families struggle to make ends meet.
examples.zh: 许多家庭只能勉强维持生计。

senses.def: to shock or frighten somebody
senses.zh: 惊吓某人；使某人毛骨悚然

examples.en: a chilling tale that will make your hair stand on end
examples.zh: 令人毛骨悚然的恐怖故事

senses.def: a thing or an action that is not interesting or important in itself but is a way of achieving something else
senses.zh: （本身并不重要或有趣的）达到目的的手段

examples.en: He doesn't particularly like the work but he sees it as a means to an end.
examples.zh: 他不怎么喜欢这项工作，只是把它看作达到目的的手段而已。

examples.en: I don't enjoy studying computing—it's just a means to an end.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢学计算机 － 只是把它作为一个途径罢了。

senses.def: very much

examples.en: It upset me no end to hear they'd split up.
examples.zh: 听说他们已离婚，我感到非常不安。

senses.def: a lot of something

examples.en: We had no end of trouble getting them to agree.
examples.zh: 我们费了九牛二虎之力才使他们同意。

senses.def: not the worst thing that could happen to somebody
senses.zh: 天不会塌下来；不是灭顶之灾

examples.en: Failing one exam is not the end of the world.
examples.zh: 一次考试不及格并非世界末日。

examples.en: It won't be the end of the world if you don't get the job.
examples.zh: 如果你得不到这份工作也不会是世界末日。

senses.def: to keep being reminded of something because somebody is always talking to you about it
senses.zh: 被人不断纠缠，没完没了

examples.en: If we don't get her a dog we'll never hear the end of it.
examples.zh: 我们要是不给她弄条狗来，这事就没完没了。

senses.def: in a position standing upright

examples.en: It'll fit if you stand it on end.
examples.zh: 如果把它竖着就放得进去了。

examples.en: Stand the box on end.
examples.zh: 把盒子竖起来。

examples.en: Stand it on end.
examples.zh: 把它竖起来。

senses.def: for the stated length of time, without stopping

examples.en: He would disappear for weeks on end.
examples.zh: 他常常是连续几周不见人影。

senses.def: to kill yourself
a situation in which somebody is treated badly or unfairly
senses.zh: 受到不良（或不公平）对待的处境

senses.def: the place or position of greatest difficulty or responsibility
senses.zh: 最为困难（或责任极其重大）的地方（或职位）

examples.en: He started work at the sharp end of the business, as a salesman.
examples.zh: 他从这一行最为棘手的工作做起，当了推销员。

senses.def: an event or action that is the beginning of something more serious and/or unpleasant
senses.zh: （不好的事物的）端倪，冰山一角

examples.en: The introduction of a tax on workplace parking is seen by many as the thin end of the wedge.
examples.zh: 许多人认为，对工作场所停车征税只是楔子的薄弱环节。

senses.def: continuing until you have done everything you can, or until something is completely finished, despite difficulties and problems
senses.zh: （不怕艰苦）坚持到底，奋斗到底

examples.en: They were prepared to fight to the bitter end for their rights.
examples.zh: 他们甘愿为自己的权利斗争到底。

examples.en: We will fight this case to the bitter end.
examples.zh: 我们会把这场官司打到底。

senses.def: to finish; to reach a point and go no further; to make something finish

examples.en: At last the war ended.
examples.zh: 战争终于结束了。

examples.en: The road ends here.
examples.zh: 这条路到此为止。

examples.en: How does the story end?
examples.zh: 这个故事结局如何？

examples.en: The problems did not end there.
examples.zh: 问题并没有就此结束。

examples.en: Her note ended with the words: ‘See you soon.’
examples.zh: 她的便条以“再见”结束。

examples.en: The speaker ended by suggesting some topics for discussion.
examples.zh: 演讲者最后给出了几个讨论话题。

examples.en: They decided to end their relationship.
examples.zh: 他们决定断绝关系。

examples.en: to end the occupation/conflict/violence
examples.zh: 结束占领/冲突/暴力

examples.en: A back injury effectively ended her career.
examples.zh: 背部的伤实际上结束了她的职业生涯。

examples.en: The team ended the season with a 4–0 win.
examples.zh: 球队以一场 4 比 0 的胜利结束了本赛季。

examples.en: ‘And that was that,’ she ended.
examples.zh: “就这样了。”她最后说。

senses.def: to spend the last part of your life in a particular state or place
senses.zh: （在某种状态下或某处）度过余生，安度晚年

examples.en: He ended his days in poverty.
examples.zh: 他在贫穷中度过余生。

senses.def: if you say that something will end in tears
senses.zh: （告诫时说）以痛苦而告终，结局悲惨

examples.en: After all that excitement the day was bound to end in tears.
examples.zh: 在所有的兴奋过后，这一天注定要以不快而结束。

examples.en: Needless to say, it ended in tears.
examples.zh: 不用说，它以泪水结束。

examples.en: He warned us it would all end in tears.
examples.zh: 他警告我们这一切都会以泪水结束。

senses.def: to kill yourself
used to emphasize how large, important, exciting, etc. you think something is
senses.zh: 最大（或最重要、最激动人心等）的…

examples.en: The movie has a car chase to end all car chases.
examples.zh: 这部影片的汽车追逐场面非常刺激。

examples.en: If she doesn’t agree, I won’t go ahead. End of story.
examples.zh: 如果她不同意，我就不会继续了。就这么办。

senses.def: in a line, with the ends

examples.en: They arranged the tables end to end.
examples.zh: 他们将桌子连接起来排成一行。

senses.def: to have sex

items.idm: get the short end of the stick

senses.def: to be the person in a group who is chosen or forced to perform an unpleasant duty or task
senses.zh: 抽到倒霉签；被派做苦差事

items.idm: get (hold of) the wrong end of the stick

senses.def: to understand something in the wrong way
to suddenly become very angry or emotional
senses.zh: （突然）火冒三丈，大发脾气，非常激动

items.idm: go to the ends of the earth

senses.def: to do everything possible, even if it is difficult, in order to get or achieve something
senses.zh: 走遍天涯海角；历尽千辛万苦

examples.en: I'd go to the ends of the earth to see her again.
examples.zh: 哪怕走遍天涯海角我也要再见她一面。

senses.def: after a long period of time or series of events

examples.en: He tried various jobs and in the end became an accountant.
examples.zh: 他尝试过各种各样的工作，最后当上了会计。

examples.en: In the end, they decided to spend Christmas at home.
examples.zh: 最终他们决定在家里过圣诞节。

senses.def: after everything has been considered

examples.en: You can try your best to impress the interviewers but in the end it's often just a question of luck.
examples.zh: 你可以尽最大的努力给主持面试的人留下深刻的印象，不过最终常常要看运气。

items.idm: jump/be thrown in at the deep end

senses.def: to start or be made to start a new and difficult activity that you are not prepared for
senses.zh: （使）陷入未曾料到的艰难处境，一筹莫展

examples.en: Junior hospital doctors are thrown in at the deep end in their first jobs.
examples.zh: 医院的初级医生开始工作时会遇上未曾料到的困难。

examples.en: The company believes in throwing new employees in at the deep end with no training.
examples.zh: 该公司认为应该不经培训就让新员工从困难的部份做起。

senses.def: to continue to be cheerful in a difficult situation

items.idm: light at the end of the tunnel

senses.def: something that shows you are nearly at the end of a long and difficult time or situation
senses.zh: 快要熬出头了；曙光在即

examples.en: For the first time since the start of his treatment, we can now see light at the end of the tunnel.
examples.zh: 自从他的治疗开始以来，我们现在第一次看到了一线希望。

senses.def: to earn just enough money to be able to buy the things you need
senses.zh: 使收支相抵；勉强维持生计

examples.en: Many families struggle to make ends meet.
examples.zh: 许多家庭只能勉强维持生计。

items.idm: make somebody’s hair stand on end

senses.def: to shock or frighten somebody
senses.zh: 惊吓某人；使某人毛骨悚然

examples.en: a chilling tale that will make your hair stand on end
examples.zh: 令人毛骨悚然的恐怖故事

senses.def: a thing or an action that is not interesting or important in itself but is a way of achieving something else
senses.zh: （本身并不重要或有趣的）达到目的的手段

examples.en: He doesn't particularly like the work but he sees it as a means to an end.
examples.zh: 他不怎么喜欢这项工作，只是把它看作达到目的的手段而已。

examples.en: I don't enjoy studying computing—it's just a means to an end.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢学计算机 － 只是把它作为一个途径罢了。

senses.def: very much

examples.en: It upset me no end to hear they'd split up.
examples.zh: 听说他们已离婚，我感到非常不安。

senses.def: a lot of something

examples.en: We had no end of trouble getting them to agree.
examples.zh: 我们费了九牛二虎之力才使他们同意。

items.idm: not the end of the world

senses.def: not the worst thing that could happen to somebody
senses.zh: 天不会塌下来；不是灭顶之灾

examples.en: Failing one exam is not the end of the world.
examples.zh: 一次考试不及格并非世界末日。

examples.en: It won't be the end of the world if you don't get the job.
examples.zh: 如果你得不到这份工作也不会是世界末日。

items.idm: not/never hear the end of it

senses.def: to keep being reminded of something because somebody is always talking to you about it
senses.zh: 被人不断纠缠，没完没了

examples.en: If we don't get her a dog we'll never hear the end of it.
examples.zh: 我们要是不给她弄条狗来，这事就没完没了。

senses.def: in a position standing upright

examples.en: It'll fit if you stand it on end.
examples.zh: 如果把它竖着就放得进去了。

examples.en: Stand the box on end.
examples.zh: 把盒子竖起来。

examples.en: Stand it on end.
examples.zh: 把它竖起来。

senses.def: for the stated length of time, without stopping

examples.en: He would disappear for weeks on end.
examples.zh: 他常常是连续几周不见人影。

items.idm: put an end to yourself | put an end to it all

senses.def: to kill yourself

items.idm: the rough end of the pineapple

senses.def: a situation in which somebody is treated badly or unfairly
senses.zh: 受到不良（或不公平）对待的处境

senses.def: the place or position of greatest difficulty or responsibility
senses.zh: 最为困难（或责任极其重大）的地方（或职位）

examples.en: He started work at the sharp end of the business, as a salesman.
examples.zh: 他从这一行最为棘手的工作做起，当了推销员。

items.idm: the thin end of the wedge

senses.def: an event or action that is the beginning of something more serious and/or unpleasant
senses.zh: （不好的事物的）端倪，冰山一角

examples.en: The introduction of a tax on workplace parking is seen by many as the thin end of the wedge.
examples.zh: 许多人认为，对工作场所停车征税只是楔子的薄弱环节。

senses.def: continuing until you have done everything you can, or until something is completely finished, despite difficulties and problems
senses.zh: （不怕艰苦）坚持到底，奋斗到底

examples.en: They were prepared to fight to the bitter end for their rights.
examples.zh: 他们甘愿为自己的权利斗争到底。

examples.en: We will fight this case to the bitter end.
examples.zh: 我们会把这场官司打到底。

senses.def: to spend the last part of your life in a particular state or place
senses.zh: （在某种状态下或某处）度过余生，安度晚年

examples.en: He ended his days in poverty.
examples.zh: 他在贫穷中度过余生。

senses.def: if you say that something will end in tears
senses.zh: （告诫时说）以痛苦而告终，结局悲惨

examples.en: After all that excitement the day was bound to end in tears.
examples.zh: 在所有的兴奋过后，这一天注定要以不快而结束。

examples.en: Needless to say, it ended in tears.
examples.zh: 不用说，它以泪水结束。

examples.en: He warned us it would all end in tears.
examples.zh: 他警告我们这一切都会以泪水结束。

senses.def: used to emphasize how large, important, exciting, etc. you think something is
senses.zh: 最大（或最重要、最激动人心等）的…

examples.en: The movie has a car chase to end all car chases.
examples.zh: 这部影片的汽车追逐场面非常刺激。

intro.en: These are all words for something that you are trying to achieve.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指目标、目的。

items.def: a result that you try to achieve:
items.zh: 指试图达到的目标、指标

examples.en: Set yourself targets that you can reasonably hope to achieve.
examples.zh: 给自己制订有望达到的指标。

items.def: (rather formal) something that you are trying to achieve:
items.zh: 指正努力达到的目标、目的

examples.en: What is the main objective of this project?
examples.zh: 这个项目的主要目标是什么？

items.def: something that you hope to achieve:
items.zh: 指希望达到的目标、目的

examples.en: He continued to pursue his goal of becoming an actor.
examples.zh: 他继续追求他成为演员的目标。

items.def: the purpose of something; something that you plan to achieve:
items.zh: 指目的、目标、宗旨

examples.en: The object is to educate people about road safety.
examples.zh: 目的就是教育大众注意交通安全。

items.def: something that you plan to achieve:
items.zh: 指计划达到的目的、目标

examples.en: He joined the society for political ends.
examples.zh: 他为了政治目的加入了这个协会。

senses.def: if you say that something will end in tears
senses.zh: （告诫时说）以痛苦而告终，结局悲惨

examples.en: After all that excitement the day was bound to end in tears.
examples.zh: 在所有的兴奋过后，这一天注定要以不快而结束。

examples.en: Needless to say, it ended in tears.
examples.zh: 不用说，它以泪水结束。

examples.zh: 他警告我们这一切都会以泪水结束。
