senses.def: used when you are stating that there is nothing more that can be said or done about something
senses.zh: 情况就是这样；就这么办

examples.en: If she doesn’t agree, I won’t go ahead. End of story.
examples.zh: 如果她不同意，我就不会继续了。就这么办。

senses.def: in a line, with the ends

examples.en: They arranged the tables end to end.
examples.zh: 他们将桌子连接起来排成一行。

senses.def: to spend the last part of your life in a particular state or place
senses.zh: （在某种状态下或某处）度过余生，安度晚年

examples.en: He ended his days in poverty.
examples.zh: 他在贫穷中度过余生。

senses.def: to have something as an ending

examples.en: The word I'm thinking of ends in ‘-ous’.
examples.zh: 我想到的这个词以 ous 结尾。

senses.def: to have something as a result

examples.en: The game ended in a draw.
examples.zh: 比赛以平局结束。

examples.en: Their long struggle ended in failure.
examples.zh: 他们的长期努力以失败告终。

examples.en: The debate ended in uproar.
examples.zh: 那场辩论最后以大吵大闹收场。

senses.def: the final stage of a period or process

examples.en: One of the hardest parts of the job was that there was no defined end point to the working day.
examples.zh: 这项工作最困难的部分之一是工作日没有明确的终点。

examples.en: These clinical trials help us reach the end points necessary to see if the vaccines work.
examples.zh: 这些临床试验帮助我们达到观察疫苗是否有效所需的终点。

senses.def: something that is produced by a particular activity or process

examples.en: The two alternative processes arrive at the same end product.
examples.zh: 这两种替代工艺得到相同的最终产品。

examples.en: The film's backers were delighted with the end product.
examples.zh: 影片投资者对最终的成片很满意。

senses.def: the final result of a particular activity or process

examples.en: The end result of using this method is that learners leave the classroom discouraged.
examples.zh: 使用这种方法的最终结果是学习者灰心丧气地离开教室。

senses.def: an attempt by the person carrying the ball to run around the end of the line of defending players
senses.zh: 迂回进攻（持球绕过防守线一端向前推进）

senses.def: used to refer to the final stage of a terminal

examples.en: patients with end-stage cancer
examples.zh: 终末期癌症患者

senses.def: a small table next to a sofa

examples.en: There are two armchairs, and a couch with an end table.
examples.zh: 有两张扶手椅和一张带茶几的沙发。

senses.def: to find yourself in a place or situation at the end of a process or period of time

examples.en: I ended up doing all the work myself.
examples.zh: 结果所有的活儿都是我一个人干了。

examples.en: If you go on like this you'll end up in prison.
examples.zh: 如果你继续这样，早晚得进监狱。

examples.en: We moved around a lot when I was young but we ended up in London.
examples.zh: 我年轻时我们经常搬家，但最终还是来到了伦敦。

examples.en: If he carries on driving like that, he'll end up dead.
examples.zh: 如果他继续那样开车，总有一天会把命都丢掉。

senses.def: a person who actually uses a product rather than one who makes or sells it, especially a person who uses a product connected with computers
senses.zh: （尤指计算机产品的）最终用户，直接用户，终端用户

examples.en: Programs are tailored to meet the needs of end users and their own business environments.
examples.zh: 计划经过量身定制，以满足最终用户及其自身业务环境的需求。

examples.en: an end-user application
examples.zh: 最终用户应用程序

examples.en: The company supplies its computers direct to the end user.
examples.zh: 这家公司直接把计算机销售给终端用户。

senses.def: the area at the end of an American football
to put somebody/something in a situation in which they could be harmed or damaged

examples.en: The health of our children is being endangered by exhaust fumes.
examples.zh: 我们孩子的健康正受到废气损害。

examples.en: That one mistake seriously endangered the future of the company.
examples.zh: 仅那一个失误就严重地危及了公司的未来。

examples.en: He denied possessing a rifle with intent to endanger life.
examples.zh: 他否认拥有步枪意图危及生命。

examples.en: Mixing medications and dietary supplements can endanger your health.
examples.zh: 混合药物和膳食补充剂可能会危害您的健康。

examples.en: They are accused of causing an explosion likely to endanger life.
examples.zh: 他们被控引发了一起可能危及生命的爆炸事件。

senses.def: the act of putting somebody/something in a situation in which they could be harmed or damaged

examples.en: The problems that have contributed to the endangerment of the species are largely caused by humans.
examples.zh: 导致物种濒危的问题很大程度上是由人类造成的。

examples.en: The suspect faces child endangerment charges.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人面临危害儿童罪指控。

senses.def: to make somebody/yourself popular

examples.en: Their policies on taxation didn't endear them to voters.
examples.zh: 他们的税收政策并没使他们受到选民的欢迎。

examples.en: She was a talented teacher who endeared herself to all who worked with her.
examples.zh: 她是一位深受同事喜爱的有才华的教师。

examples.en: He had an unfriendly manner which did not exactly endear him to his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他的态度不友好，这让他的同事们不太喜欢他。

senses.def: in a way that causes people to feel love

examples.en: an endearingly old-fashioned idea
examples.zh: 可爱的老式想法

senses.def: a word or an expression that is used to show love
senses.zh: 表示爱慕的话语；亲热的表示

examples.en: They were whispering endearments to each other.
examples.zh: 他们彼此低声倾吐着爱慕之情。

examples.en: ‘Darling’ is a term of endearment.
examples.zh: “亲爱的”是一种昵称。

senses.def: an attempt to do something, especially something new or difficult
senses.zh: （尤指新的或艰苦的）努力，尝试

examples.en: There have been great advances in the field of scientific endeavour.
examples.zh: 在科学探索领域已经取得了巨大的进步。

examples.en: Please make every endeavour to arrive on time.
examples.zh: 请尽全力按时到达。

examples.en: The manager is expected to use his or her best endeavours to promote the artist's career.
examples.zh: 经纪人应以最大的努力来推动艺人的事业发展。

examples.en: The public bombarded the company with complaints in an endeavour to have the price increases revoked.
examples.zh: 公众纷纷向这家公司投诉，力求取消涨价。

senses.def: to try very hard to do something

examples.en: I will endeavour to do my best for my country.
examples.zh: 我将竭尽全力报效祖国。

examples.en: He endeavoured in vain to escape the situation.
examples.zh: 他徒劳地试图逃离困境。

examples.en: The buyer should always endeavour to negotiate terms.
examples.zh: 买方应始终努力协商条款。

senses.def: the name of a former US space shuttle
senses.zh: 奋进号航天飞机（NASA使用的美国前航天飞机的名称。它于1992年首次飞行，并于1993年被宇航员用于维修哈勃太空望远镜。它的最后一次飞行发生在2011年。）

senses.def: regularly found in a particular place or among a particular group of people and difficult to get rid of
senses.zh: 地方性的；（某地或某集体中）特有的，流行的，难摆脱的

examples.en: Malaria is endemic in many hot countries.
examples.zh: 疟疾是许多气候炎热国家的流行病。

examples.en: Corruption is endemic in the system.
examples.zh: 腐败在这种制度下普遍存在。

examples.en: an attitude endemic among senior members of the profession
examples.zh: 此行业中的资深者普遍持有的看法

examples.en: species endemic to (= only found in) Madagascar
examples.zh: 马达加斯加特有的物种

examples.en: the endemic problem of racism
examples.zh: 普遍存在的种族主义问题

senses.def: the final stage of a game of chess
the final stage of a political process or contest between people
senses.zh: （政治进程或竞争的）最后阶段；收官阶段

examples.en: Both sides in these negotiations realize that the endgame is now being played out.
examples.zh: 谈判双方都意识到，现在已经到了最后阶段。

senses.def: a plant with green curly leaves that are eaten raw as a vegetable
a small pale green plant with bitter leaves that are eaten raw or cooked as a vegetable. The root can be dried and used with or instead of coffee.
senses.zh: 菊苣（根干燥后可与咖啡同饮或作其代用品）

senses.def: very large in size or amount and seeming to have no end
senses.zh: 无止境的；无垠的；无穷无尽的；不计其数的

examples.en: endless patience
examples.zh: 无限的耐心

examples.en: endless opportunities for making money
examples.zh: 无数挣钱的机会

examples.en: The possibilities are endless.
examples.zh: 存在着无限的可能性。

examples.en: an endless list of things to do
examples.zh: 列不完的要做的事

examples.en: We don't have an endless supply of money, you know.
examples.zh: 你要知道，我们没有源源不竭的资金供给。

examples.en: I've had enough of their endless arguing.
examples.zh: 我听够了他们无休止的争吵。

senses.def: continuing for a long time and seeming to have no end
senses.zh: 永久的；不断的；无休止的

examples.en: an endless round of parties and visits
examples.zh: 没完没了一个又一个的社交聚会和访问

examples.en: The journey seemed endless.
examples.zh: 旅程似乎没有尽头。

senses.def: having the ends joined together so it forms one piece

examples.en: an endless loop of tape
examples.zh: 环状带

senses.def: in a way that continues for a long time and seems to have no end
senses.zh: 永久的；不断的；无休止的

examples.en: She talks endlessly about her problems.
examples.zh: 她喋喋不休地谈论着自己的问题。

examples.en: an endlessly repeated pattern
examples.zh: 不断重复的模式

senses.def: a note printed at the end of a book or section of a book
relating to glands

examples.en: the endocrine system
examples.zh: 内分泌系统

senses.def: a doctor who studies the endocrine
the branch of medicine that is the study of the endocrine
the custom of marrying only people from your local community
senses.zh: 族内婚，内婚制（只在一个群体内部通婚的风俗）

senses.def: having a cause that is inside itself

examples.en: Money is endogenous to the economy.
examples.zh: 货币对经济来说是内生的。

senses.def: having a cause that is inside the body
used as a first language in a particular country or community and not as a foreign or second language
senses.zh: （在某一国家或地区）本土的，本族的

senses.def: a person whose natural body shape is round, with a lot of fat
senses.zh: 胖型体质者；内胚层体型者

senses.def: based on the way a country’s second language is used by local speakers, rather than the way it is used in the country where it came from originally
senses.zh: 内规范的：基于当地人使用一国第二语言的方式，而不是原本来自该国的国家所使用的第二种方式。

senses.def: the more liquid inner layer of the jelly
a hormone
senses.zh: 内啡肽（内分泌激素，有镇痛作用）

senses.def: to say publicly that you support a person, statement or course of action

examples.en: I wholeheartedly endorse his remarks.
examples.zh: 我真诚地赞同他的话。

examples.en: Members of all parties endorsed a ban on land mines.
examples.zh: 各党派成员都赞同禁用地雷。

senses.def: to say in an advertisement that you use and like a particular product so that other people will want to buy it
senses.zh: （在广告中）宣传，代言（某一产品）

examples.en: I wonder how many celebrities actually use the products they endorse.
examples.zh: 我不知道究竟有多少名人真正使用他们的产品。

senses.def: to put details of a driving offence on somebody’s driving record
senses.zh: （在驾驶执照上）记录违章事项

examples.en: You risk having your licence endorsed.
examples.zh: 你这样做，驾照可能被记录违章。

senses.def: to write your name on the back of a cheque
a public statement or action showing that you support somebody/something

examples.en: The election victory is a clear endorsement of their policies.
examples.zh: 竞选成功显然说明他们的政策得人心。

examples.en: a letter of endorsement
examples.zh: 认可证书

examples.en: This is hardly a ringing endorsement of the plan.
examples.zh: 这并不是对该计划的明确认可。

senses.def: a statement made in an advertisement, usually by somebody famous or important, saying that they use and like a particular product
senses.zh: （通常由名人或要人在广告中为某一产品所做的）宣传，代言

examples.en: We are happy to give the product our full endorsement.
examples.zh: 我们愿意全力宣传该产品。

senses.def: details of a driving offence recorded on somebody’s driving licence

examples.en: How many endorsements can you have before you lose your licence?
examples.zh: 在您失去驾照之前，您可以获得多少个认可？

senses.def: an instrument used in medical operations that consists of a very small camera on a long thin tube that can be put into a person’s body so that the parts inside can be seen
connected with or using an endoscope

examples.en: Endoscopic examination revealed no abnormality.
examples.zh: 内窥镜检查未见异常。

senses.def: a medical operation in which an endoscope
senses.zh: 内镜检查术；内窥镜检查

senses.def: the bones inside the body of an animal that give it shape and support
senses.zh: 内骨骼（动物体内的支撑骨架）

senses.def: the part of the plant seed that provides food for the embryo
needing heat in order to take place
to give a large sum of money to a school, a college or another institution to provide it with an income
senses.zh: （向学校等机构）捐钱，捐赠，资助

examples.en: In her will, she endowed a scholarship in the physics department.
examples.zh: 她在遗嘱里给物理学系捐赠了一笔奖学金。

senses.def: to believe or imagine that somebody/something has a particular quality

examples.en: She had endowed Marcus with the qualities she wanted him to possess.
examples.zh: 她认为马库斯具有她所期望的品质。

examples.en: My imagination endowed Constantinople with all the magic of the East.
examples.zh: 我的想象力赋予君士坦丁堡所有东方的魔力。

senses.def: to give something to somebody/something

examples.en: to endow somebody with a responsibility
examples.zh: 赋予某人以责任

senses.def: money that is given to a school, a college or another institution to provide it with an income; the act of giving this money
a quality or an ability that you are born with

examples.en: Few people are blessed with her mental endowments.
examples.zh: 很少有人拥有她的智力天赋。

senses.def: a type of mortgage
senses.zh: 定期人寿保险按揭；两全人寿保险按揭

senses.def: a type of life insurance in which a person regularly pays money to an insurance company, and receives a sum of money from them at the end of a particular period of time
senses.zh: 定期人寿保险，两全人寿保险（保险期满或保险期内死亡均可得到保险金）

senses.def: a plain or decorated page stuck inside the front or back cover of a book
that can be experienced or dealt with, especially without complaining
senses.zh: 可忍受的；能持久的；耐用的

examples.en: I felt that life was no longer endurable.
examples.zh: 我感到生活再也无法忍受。

senses.def: the ability to continue doing something painful or difficult for a long period of time without giving up

examples.en: He showed remarkable endurance throughout his illness.
examples.zh: 他在整个生病期间表现出非凡的忍耐力。

examples.en: This event tests both physical and mental endurance.
examples.zh: 该比赛项目既是对体力也是对心理承受力的考验。

examples.en: The task was a test of their powers of endurance.
examples.zh: 这项任务是对他们忍耐力的考验。

examples.en: They were humiliated beyond endurance.
examples.zh: 他们被羞辱到忍无可忍的地步。

examples.en: The party turned out to be more of an endurance test than a pleasure.
examples.zh: 这次聚会结果成了一次忍耐力测试，而不是一件乐事。

senses.def: to experience and deal with something that is painful or unpleasant without giving up

examples.en: They had to endure a long wait before the case came to trial.
examples.zh: 在此案审理前他们只得忍受长时间的等待。

examples.en: She could not endure the thought of parting.
examples.zh: 一想到分别她就无法忍受。

examples.en: The pain was almost too great to endure.
examples.zh: 痛苦得几乎难以忍受。

examples.en: a love that endures all things and never fails
examples.zh: 可经受一切考验的永不凋谢的爱情

examples.en: They had to endure the racist taunts of the crowd.
examples.zh: 他们不得不忍受人群的种族主义嘲笑。

examples.en: He can't endure being defeated.
examples.zh: 他无法忍受失败。

examples.en: He can't endure to be defeated.
examples.zh: 他无法忍受失败。

senses.def: to continue to exist for a long time

examples.en: a success that will endure
examples.zh: 将会持续的成功

examples.en: The torn flag has endured as a symbol of freedom.
examples.zh: 撕裂的旗帜一直作为自由的象征而存在。

senses.def: in a way that lasts for a long time

examples.en: an enduringly popular style
examples.zh: 一直流行的式样

senses.def: a long-distance race for bicycles or motor vehicles over rough ground, which is designed to test how long people can continue
senses.zh: （自行车或机动车）越野耐力赛

senses.def: with one end facing up, forwards, or towards the person who is looking at it
senses.zh: 末端朝上（或向前）地；竖着

examples.en: We turned the table endways to get it through the doors.
examples.zh: 我们把桌子竖起来以便挪进门。

examples.en: The first picture was taken from the side of the building, and the second one endways on.
examples.zh: 第一张照片照的是楼房侧面，第二张照的是楼房正面。

senses.def: with the end of one thing touching the end of another
senses.zh: 首尾相连地；两端相接地

examples.en: The stones are laid down endways to make a path.
examples.zh: 石头一块接一块地铺成小路。

senses.def: a liquid that is put into a person’s rectum
senses.zh: 灌肠剂；（尤指手术前的）灌肠

senses.def: a person who hates somebody or who acts or speaks against somebody/something

examples.en: She didn't have an enemy in the world.
examples.zh: 她在世上没有敌人。

examples.en: He has a lot of enemies in the company.
examples.zh: 他在公司里有很多对头。

examples.en: After just one day, she had already made an enemy of her manager.
examples.zh: 刚过一天她就已经与经理为敌了。

examples.en: They united in the face of a common enemy.
examples.zh: 他们团结起来面对共同的敌人。

examples.en: They used to be friends but they are now sworn enemies (= are determined not to become friends again).
examples.zh: 他们过去是朋友，但现在成了死敌。

examples.en: James Moriarty was Sherlock Holmes's mortal enemy.
examples.zh: 詹姆斯·莫里亚蒂是夏洛克·福尔摩斯的死敌。

examples.en: It is rare to find a prominent politician with few political enemies.
examples.zh: 没有什么政敌的杰出从政者是罕见的。

examples.en: The state has a duty to protect its citizens against external enemies.
examples.zh: 国家有义务保护本国公民不受外敌侵犯。

examples.en: Birds are the natural enemies of many insect pests (= they kill them).
examples.zh: 鸟类是许多害虫的天敌。

examples.en: The enemy of my enemy is my friend.
examples.zh: 我敌人的敌人就是我的朋友。

examples.en: ‘We will defeat the enemies of freedom,’ said the president.
examples.zh: 总统说，我们将击败自由的敌人。

senses.def: a country or group that you are fighting a war against; the soldiers, etc. of this country or group

examples.en: The enemy was/were forced to retreat.
examples.zh: 敌军被迫撤退了。

examples.en: to fight/defeat the enemy
examples.zh: 抗击／击败敌人

examples.en: enemy forces/combatants
examples.zh: 敌军；敌方战斗人员

examples.en: The men came under enemy fire.
examples.zh: 这些人遭遇敌方火力。

examples.en: They were dropped by parachute behind enemy lines (= in the area controlled by the enemy).
examples.zh: 他们跳伞进入了敌占区。

senses.def: anything that harms something or prevents it from being successful

examples.en: Poverty and ignorance are the enemies of progress.
examples.zh: 贫穷和愚昧阻碍进步。

senses.def: to be the cause of your own problems
senses.zh: 自讨苦吃；是自己问题的根源

examples.en: Her indecisiveness makes her her own worst enemy.
examples.zh: 她的优柔寡断使她成为自己最大的敌人。

examples.en: Some dancers become their own worst enemies, criticizing themselves for every imperfection.
examples.zh: 一些舞者总是因每一处不完美而责备自己，成了他们自己最大的敌人。

senses.def: to be the cause of your own problems
senses.zh: 自讨苦吃；是自己问题的根源

examples.en: Her indecisiveness makes her her own worst enemy.
examples.zh: 她的优柔寡断使她成为自己最大的敌人。

examples.en: Some dancers become their own worst enemies, criticizing themselves for every imperfection.
examples.zh: 一些舞者总是因每一处不完美而责备自己，成了他们自己最大的敌人。

senses.def: having or needing a lot of energy and enthusiasm
senses.zh: 精力充沛的；充满活力的；需要能量的；积极的

examples.en: He knew I was energetic and dynamic and would get things done.
examples.zh: 他知道我精力充沛、生气勃勃，会把事情办成的。

examples.en: an energetic supporter
examples.zh: 热情支持者

examples.en: The heart responds well to energetic exercise.
examples.zh: 心脏对剧烈运动反应良好。

examples.en: For the more energetic (= people who prefer physical activities), we offer windsurfing and diving.
examples.zh: 我们为喜欢运动的人准备了帆板和潜水运动。

examples.en: I think I'd prefer something a little less energetic.
examples.zh: 我想我更喜欢不太剧烈的活动。

senses.def: with a lot of energy or enthusiasm
senses.zh: 精力充沛的；充满活力的；需要能量的；积极的

examples.en: He energetically denied the charge.
examples.zh: 他极力否认这一指控。

senses.def: to make somebody enthusiastic about something
to give somebody more energy, strength, etc.
senses.zh: 给（某人）增添能量（或精力、活力、干劲）

examples.en: a refreshing and energizing fruit drink
examples.zh: 提神并增加能量的果汁饮料

senses.def: to supply power or energy to a machine, an atom
senses.zh: 为…提供电力（或能量）；使通电

examples.en: positively energized particles
examples.zh: 带正能量的粒子

senses.def: the strength, effort and enthusiasm required for physical or mental activity, work, etc.

examples.en: It's a waste of time and energy.
examples.zh: 那是浪费时间和精力。

examples.en: She's always full of energy.
examples.zh: 她总是充满活力。

examples.en: I don't seem to have any energy these days.
examples.zh: 这些天我好像一点精力都没有。

examples.en: nervous energy (= energy produced by feeling nervous)
examples.zh: 精神紧张而产生的精力

examples.en: For five years, she devoted considerable energy to photography.
examples.zh: 五年来，她将大量的精力投入到摄影上。

examples.en: He expends great energy trying to help them.
examples.zh: 他花费大量精力试图帮助他们。

senses.def: the physical and mental effort that you use to do something

examples.en: She put all her energies into her work.
examples.zh: 她把全部精力都投入到工作中去了。

examples.en: He focused his energies on preparing the lectures.
examples.zh: 他集中精力去备课了。

examples.en: Provide a means of channelling your child's creative energies.
examples.zh: 找个方法来引导您的孩子发挥创造力。

examples.en: I will put all my energies into improving the situation.
examples.zh: 我会拿出所有的精力来改善状况。

senses.def: a source of power, such as fuel, used for driving machines, providing heat, etc.

examples.en: solar/wind/renewable energy
examples.zh: 太阳能；风能；可再生能源

examples.en: to save/conserve energy
examples.zh: 节约能源

examples.en: to generate/produce energy
examples.zh: 产生／制造能量

examples.en: The £500 million programme is centred around energy efficiency and renewable power sources.
examples.zh: 这个耗资 5 亿英镑的项目重点关注能源效率和可再生能源。

examples.en: the country's total energy consumption
examples.zh: 全国能源消费总量

examples.en: an energy crisis (= for example when fuel is not freely available)
examples.zh: 能源危机

examples.en: energy conservation
examples.zh: 能源的节约

senses.def: the ability of matter or radiation

examples.en: kinetic/electrical energy
examples.zh: 动能/电能

senses.def: a person who is full of energy and enthusiasm
senses.zh: 充满活力和热情的人；生龙活虎的人；朝气蓬勃的人

senses.def: a person who is full of energy and enthusiasm
senses.zh: 充满活力和热情的人；生龙活虎的人；朝气蓬勃的人

senses.def: a food that is similar in size and shape to a chocolate bar and contains high-energy foods such as nuts, fruit, cereals
senses.zh: 能量棒，能量条（一种用燕麦和坚果等做成棒状的食品，主要面对需要快速补充能量的人，如从事体育运动的人）

examples.en: Many energy bars contain as much sugar as some chocolate bars.
examples.zh: 许多能量棒的含糖量与某些巧克力棒的含糖量相当。

senses.def: a drink that contains a lot of sugar, caffeine

examples.en: Red Bull is the world's best-selling energy drink.
examples.zh: 红牛是世界上最畅销的能量饮料。

examples.en: It’s unlikely that this drug could give a player a competitive advantage any more than say, an energy drink.
examples.zh: 这种药物不太可能比能量饮料给玩家带来竞争优势。

senses.def: designed to avoid wasting electricity, gas or other forms of energy

examples.en: energy-saving light bulbs
examples.zh: 节能灯泡

examples.en: energy-saving features that can reduce energy bills by 50%
examples.zh: 可使能源成本下降50% 的节能措施

senses.def: to make somebody feel weak and tired
senses.zh: 使感到衰弱（或虚弱、无力）

examples.en: an enervating disease/climate
examples.zh: 使人衰弱的疾病；使人感到乏力的气候

senses.def: the feeling of being weak and tired
senses.zh: 精神：疲倦和疲倦的感觉

senses.def: a person who is young and successful and whose behaviour and ideas may be unusual, causing people to be shocked or embarrassed
senses.zh: 少年得志肆无忌惮的人

senses.def: to make somebody/something weak

examples.en: The soldiers were enfeebled by lack of nutrition.
examples.zh: 士兵们因缺乏营养而虚弱不堪。

senses.def: to hold somebody in your arms in a way that shows love

examples.en: She lay quietly, enfolded in his arms.
examples.zh: 她静静地躺在他怀里。

senses.def: to surround or cover somebody/something completely

examples.en: Darkness spread and enfolded him.
examples.zh: 黑暗弥漫开来，将他笼罩。

examples.en: The summit was enfolded in a circle of white cloud.
examples.zh: 山顶被一圈白云笼罩着。

senses.def: to make sure that people obey a particular law or rule
senses.zh: 强制执行，强行实施（法律或规定）

examples.en: It's the job of the police to enforce the law.
examples.zh: 警察的工作就是执法。

examples.en: The legislation will be difficult to enforce.
examples.zh: 这一法规将难以实施。

examples.en: United Nations troops enforced a ceasefire in the area.
examples.zh: 联合国军队在该地区强制执行停火命令。

examples.en: The creditor should be at liberty to enforce his rights against the company's property.
examples.zh: 债权人应当可以自由地针对公司财产行使其权利。

senses.def: to make something happen or force somebody to do something

examples.en: You can't enforce cooperation between the players.
examples.zh: 队员间的配合不能靠强迫。

senses.def: that somebody in authority can make people obey

examples.en: A gambling debt is not legally enforceable.
examples.zh: 赌债不能通过法律手段强制偿还。

senses.def: the act of making people obey a particular law or rule
senses.zh: （法律或规定的）强制执行，强行实施

examples.en: strict enforcement of regulations
examples.zh: 规章的严格执行

examples.en: law enforcement officers
examples.zh: 执法官员

senses.def: a person whose responsibility is to make sure that other people perform the actions they are supposed to, especially in a government

examples.en: He was appointed the Cabinet enforcer.
examples.zh: 他被任命为内阁执行官。

senses.def: to give somebody the right to vote in an election
the act of giving somebody the right to vote in an election

examples.en: the enfranchisement of foreign residents in local elections
examples.zh: 外国居民在地方选举中的选举权

senses.def: (in writing) engineer; engineering
senses.zh: （书写形式）工程师，工程，工程学

senses.def: electronic news gathering
to succeed in attracting and keeping somebody’s attention and interest

examples.en: It is a movie that engages both the mind and the eye.
examples.zh: 这是一部令人赏心悦目的影片。

examples.en: Their pleas failed to engage any sympathy.
examples.zh: 他们的恳求没有引起任何同情。

examples.en: to engage the public/audience/viewer/reader
examples.zh: 吸引公众/观众/观众/读者

examples.en: It was difficult to engage the students at first.
examples.zh: 一开始很难吸引住学生。

examples.en: The party is attempting to engage young voters politically.
examples.zh: 这个政党设法让年轻选民参与政治。

senses.def: to employ a person, company, etc. to do a particular job

examples.en: She has already engaged a lawyer.
examples.zh: 她已经聘请了律师。

examples.en: We will have to engage the services of a translator.
examples.zh: 我们得聘一名翻译人员。

examples.en: He was immediately engaged as a consultant.
examples.zh: 他立刻被聘为顾问。

examples.en: Karl Böhm engaged her to sing in Vienna.
examples.zh: 卡尔·伯姆邀她在维也纳献唱。

senses.def: to become involved with and try to understand something/somebody
senses.zh: 与…建立密切关系；尽力理解

examples.en: She has the ability to engage with young minds.
examples.zh: 她能够与年轻人心意相通。

senses.def: to begin fighting with somebody
senses.zh: 与（某人）交战；与（某人）开战

examples.en: He ordered his men to engage the enemy.
examples.zh: 他命令他的士兵与敌人开战。

examples.en: The fleet sailed out of Cadiz to engage with the enemy.
examples.zh: 舰队驶出卡迪斯与敌人交战。

senses.def: when a part of a machine engages

examples.en: The cogwheels are not engaging.
examples.zh: 齿轮未啮合在一起。

examples.en: One cogwheel engages with the next.
examples.zh: 齿轮一个个啮合在一起。

examples.en: Engage the clutch before selecting a gear.
examples.zh: 先踩离合器再挂挡。

senses.def: to take part in something; to make somebody take part in something

examples.en: Even in prison, he continued to engage in criminal activities.
examples.zh: 他甚至在监狱里还继续从事犯罪活动。

examples.en: She tried desperately to engage him in conversation.
examples.zh: 她用尽办法要他跟她谈话。

senses.def: an agreement to marry somebody; the period during which two people are engaged

examples.en: Their engagement was announced in the local paper.
examples.zh: 他们订婚的消息已在当地报纸上公布。

examples.en: She has broken off her engagement to Charles.
examples.zh: 她已解除同查尔斯的婚约。

examples.en: an engagement party
examples.zh: 订婚宴会

examples.en: a long/short engagement
examples.zh: 长／短婚约期

examples.en: He announced his engagement to his long-time girlfriend.
examples.zh: 他宣布与相处已久的女友订婚。

senses.def: an arrangement to do something at a particular time, especially something official or something connected with your job
senses.zh: （尤指正式的或与工作有关的）约定，约会，预约

examples.en: an engagement book/diary
examples.zh: 预约簿／日志

examples.en: He has a number of social engagements next week.
examples.zh: 他下周有几次社交约会。

examples.en: It was her first official engagement.
examples.zh: 那是她第一次正式约会。

examples.en: I had to refuse because of a prior engagement.
examples.zh: 我因为已经有预约只好拒绝了。

senses.group: arrangement to do something 约定

senses.def: being involved with somebody/something in an attempt to understand them/it

examples.en: Her views are based on years of engagement with the problems of the inner city.
examples.zh: 她的观点是以多年对内城区问题的了解为基础的。

examples.en: the lack of engagement in politics
examples.zh: 缺乏政治参与

senses.def: fighting between two armies, etc.

examples.en: The general tried to avoid an engagement with the enemy.
examples.zh: 将军竭力避免与敌军交火。

senses.def: an arrangement to employ somebody; the process of employing somebody

examples.en: The terms of engagement are to be agreed in writing.
examples.zh: 聘用条款应有书面协议。

senses.def: a ring that a man traditionally gives to a woman when they agree to get married

examples.en: She wore a diamond engagement ring.
examples.zh: 她戴着一枚钻石订婚戒指。

senses.def: in an interesting or pleasant way that attracts your attention
senses.zh: 有趣的；令人愉快的；迷人的

examples.en: She smiled engagingly.
examples.zh: 她露出迷人的笑容

senses.def: to make a feeling or situation exist
senses.zh: 产生，引起（某种感觉或情况）

examples.en: The issue engendered controversy.
examples.zh: 这个问题引起了争论。

examples.en: problems engendered by the restructuring of the company
examples.zh: 公司改制带来的问题

examples.en: The place engendered immediate feelings of friendship and belonging.
examples.zh: 这个地方立即产生了友谊和归属感。

senses.def: the part of a vehicle that produces power to make the vehicle move

examples.en: a diesel/petrol engine
examples.zh: 柴油／汽油发动机

examples.en: I got in the car and started the engine.
examples.zh: 我上车启动了引擎。

examples.en: My car had to have a new engine.
examples.zh: 我的汽车得换一个新发动机。

examples.en: The engine runs on diesel.
examples.zh: 这款发动机使用柴油。

examples.en: Its engine is powered by both gasoline and electricity.
examples.zh: 其引擎用汽油和电力驱动。

examples.en: The plane suffered catastrophic engine failure.
examples.zh: 这架飞机遭遇了灾难性的发动机故障。

examples.en: Their helicopter had developed engine trouble.
examples.zh: 他们的直升机引擎出了故障。

senses.def: a thing that has an important role in making a particular process happen

examples.en: Agriculture is a key engine of growth in most developing countries.
examples.zh: 在大多数发展中国家，农业是经济增长的重要引擎。

examples.en: Great newspapers serve as an engine for positive change.
examples.zh: 有影响力的大报是积极变革的重要推动力量。

examples.en: Business is the principal engine for generating wealth for society as a whole.
examples.zh: 商业是为整个社会创造财富的主要引擎。

examples.en: He was the engine behind the victory.
examples.zh: 他是胜利背后的引擎。

senses.def: a vehicle that pulls a train
having the type or number of engines
senses.zh: 有…型发动机的；有…个引擎的

examples.en: a twin-engined speedboat
examples.zh: 双引擎快艇

senses.def: a person whose job is driving a railway engine

senses.def: the study of wine
senses.zh: 葡萄酿酒学；葡萄酒酿造学

senses.def: a person who knows a lot about wine
the very great size, effect, etc. of something; the fact of something being very serious

examples.en: the enormity of the task
examples.zh: 任务的艰巨性

examples.en: People are still coming to terms with the enormity of the disaster.
examples.zh: 人们仍在逐渐适应忍受这一灾难带来的严重恶果。

examples.en: The full enormity of the crime has not yet been revealed.
examples.zh: 这一罪行的严重性还没有充分揭示出来。

examples.en: It took time for the full enormity of the attack to sink in.
examples.zh: 需要一定的时间人们才能充分认识到这场袭击的严重恶果。

examples.en: It’s difficult to grasp the sheer enormity of the tragedy.
examples.zh: 很难确切知道这场悲剧的严重程度。

senses.def: a very serious crime

examples.en: the enormities of the Hitler regime
examples.zh: 希特勒政权的滔天罪行

senses.def: extremely large

examples.en: an enormous house/dog
examples.zh: 巨大的房子；大狗

examples.en: an enormous amount of time
examples.zh: 大量的时间

examples.en: Current processors can perform an enormous number of operations per second.
examples.zh: 当前的处理器每秒可以执行大量操作。

examples.en: Universities are under enormous pressure financially.
examples.zh: 大学承受着巨大的财务压力。

examples.en: young dancers who show enormous potential
examples.zh: 展现出巨大潜力的年轻舞者

examples.en: Their house is absolutely enormous!
examples.zh: 他们的房子巨大无比。

senses.def: very; very much

examples.en: enormously rich/powerful/grateful
examples.zh: 非常富有／强大／感激

examples.en: Property prices vary enormously across the country.
examples.zh: 全国各地的房地产价格差异很大。

examples.en: She was looking forward to the meeting enormously.
examples.zh: 她急切期待着这次会面。

senses.def: used before plural or uncountable nouns to mean ‘as many or as much as somebody needs or wants’
senses.zh: （用于复数或不可数名词前）足够的，充足的，充分的

examples.en: Have you made enough copies?
examples.zh: 你复印的份数够吗？

examples.en: Is there enough room for me?
examples.zh: 有足够的地方给我吗？

examples.en: I didn't have enough clothes to last a week.
examples.zh: 我的衣服不够一周穿的。

examples.en: Don't ask me to do it. I've got enough problems as it is.
examples.zh: 别让我做这件事。我目前的问题已够多了。

examples.en: There was food enough for all.
examples.zh: 所有人都有足够的食物。

senses.def: as many or as much as somebody needs or wants

examples.en: Six bottles should be enough.
examples.zh: 六瓶应该够了。

examples.en: Have you had enough (= to eat)?
examples.zh: 你吃饱了吗？

examples.en: If enough of you are interested, we'll organize a trip to the theatre.
examples.zh: 如果你们中有足够多的人感兴趣，我们就组织去看一场戏。

examples.en: There was nowhere near enough for everybody.
examples.zh: 根本不够所有人。

examples.en: We've nearly run out of paper. Do you think there's enough for today?
examples.zh: 我们的纸差不多已用完了。你看够今天用的吗？

senses.def: used to say that something is annoying or boring and that you want it to stop
used when you think that something should not continue any longer
senses.zh: （认为不应再继续）够了，行了，适可而止

senses.def: used to say that you understand a situation and there is no need to say any more

examples.en: ‘He's a politician, remember.’ ‘Enough said.’
examples.zh: “记住，他是一个政客。”“不用多说了。”

senses.def: used when something/somebody is annoying you and you no longer want to do, have or see it or them
senses.zh: 对…已厌烦透了；再也忍受不住；受够了

examples.en: I've had enough of driving the kids around.
examples.zh: 我已受够了开车带孩子们到处去。

senses.def: to the necessary degree

examples.en: I hadn't trained enough for the game.
examples.zh: 为这次比赛我训练得不够。

examples.en: This house isn't big enough for us.
examples.zh: 这房子对我们来说不够大。

examples.en: She's old enough to decide for herself.
examples.zh: 她已到自己作决定的年龄了。

examples.en: We didn't leave early enough.
examples.zh: 我们离开得不够早。

examples.en: They've been in this business long enough to know what they're doing.
examples.zh: 他们入行已久，精于此道。

examples.en: Tell them it's just not good enough.
examples.zh: 告诉他们这确实不够好。

senses.def: to an acceptable degree, but not to a very great degree

examples.en: He seemed pleasant enough to me.
examples.zh: 他对我似乎已相当和气了。

senses.def: to a degree that you do not wish to get any greater

examples.en: I hope my job's safe. Life is hard enough as it is.
examples.zh: 希望我的工作安稳。生活照现在这样已经够苦了。

examples.en: Things are bad enough without you having a meltdown.
examples.zh: 事情已经够糟糕了，你还没有崩溃。

senses.def: to be strong or brave enough

examples.en: He was not man enough to face up to his responsibility.
examples.zh: 他没有足够的勇气去承担责任。

senses.def: used to show that something is surprising
senses.zh: （表示惊奇）奇怪的是，说来也奇怪

examples.en: Funnily enough, I said the same thing myself only yesterday.
examples.zh: 奇怪的是，就在昨天我自己也说过同样的话。

senses.def: used to say that an idea or suggestion seems reasonable
senses.zh: （指想法、建议）有道理，说得对，行

examples.en: ‘We'll meet at 8.’ ‘Fair enough.’
examples.zh: “我们 8 点钟见。”“行。”

examples.en: If you don't want to come, fair enough, but let Bill know.
examples.zh: 你要是不想来，可以，不过要让比尔知道。

senses.def: to achieve all that is wanted

examples.en: The new legislation is welcome but does not go far enough.
examples.zh: 新法规受到欢迎，但力度还不够大。

examples.en: Do these measures go far enough?
examples.zh: 这些措施能不能解决问题？

examples.en: Stop it now. The joke has gone far enough (= it has continued too long).
examples.zh: 行啦，这玩笑开得太久了。

senses.def: quite probably

examples.en: She would be in bed by now, like enough.
examples.zh: 她现在应该已经上床睡觉了，这样就够了。

senses.def: used to say that something is so nearly true that the difference does not matter

examples.en: We've been here twenty years, near enough.
examples.zh: 我们在这里待了差不多二十年了。

senses.def: certainly; in a way that cannot be denied

examples.en: You heard me right enough (= so don't pretend that you did not).
examples.zh: 你肯定听到我说了什么。

senses.def: used to say that something happened as expected

examples.en: I said he'd forget, and sure enough he did.
examples.zh: 我说他会忘记，他果然就忘了。

examples.en: ‘Stop,’ she said, ‘I can hear something.’ Sure enough, in the distance we could hear the sound of a car approaching.
examples.zh: “停下来，”她说，“我能听到一些声音。”果然，我们听到远处有汽车驶近的声音。

senses.def: used to say that something is annoying or boring and that you want it to stop
used when you think that something should not continue any longer
senses.zh: （认为不应再继续）够了，行了，适可而止

examples.en: I've had enough of driving the kids around.
examples.zh: 我已受够了开车带孩子们到处去。

items.idm: be man enough (to do something/for something)

senses.def: to be strong or brave enough

examples.en: He was not man enough to face up to his responsibility.
examples.zh: 他没有足够的勇气去承担责任。

items.idm: curiously, funnily, oddly, strangely, etc. enough

senses.zh: （表示惊奇）奇怪的是，说来也奇怪

examples.en: Funnily enough, I said the same thing myself only yesterday.
examples.zh: 奇怪的是，就在昨天我自己也说过同样的话。

senses.def: used to say that an idea or suggestion seems reasonable
senses.zh: （指想法、建议）有道理，说得对，行

examples.en: ‘We'll meet at 8.’ ‘Fair enough.’
examples.zh: “我们 8 点钟见。”“行。”

examples.en: If you don't want to come, fair enough, but let Bill know.
examples.zh: 你要是不想来，可以，不过要让比尔知道。

senses.def: to achieve all that is wanted

examples.zh: 新法规受到欢迎，但力度还不够大。

examples.en: Do these measures go far enough?
examples.zh: 这些措施能不能解决问题？

examples.en: Stop it now. The joke has gone far enough (= it has continued too long).
examples.zh: 行啦，这玩笑开得太久了。

senses.def: quite probably

examples.en: She would be in bed by now, like enough.
examples.zh: 她现在应该已经上床睡觉了，这样就够了。

senses.def: used to say that something is so nearly true that the difference does not matter

examples.en: We've been here twenty years, near enough.
examples.zh: 我们在这里待了差不多二十年了。

senses.def: certainly; in a way that cannot be denied

examples.en: You heard me right enough (= so don't pretend that you did not).
