examples.zh: 咖啡馆是一座荒凉的混凝土建筑，配有塑料桌椅。

senses.def: a US make of children's toy which consists of a set of long, flat pieces of metal, nuts
senses.zh: 美国制造的儿童玩具，由一组长而扁平的金属，螺母，螺栓和螺钉等组成，用于建立机械模型。它由AC Gilbert于1913年发明。2000年，该品牌被Meccano收购。

senses.def: a novel (1872) by Samuel Butler
senses.zh: 塞缪尔·巴特勒（Samuel Butler）所著的小说（1872），关于一个虚构的地方，称为Erewhon。这是利用讽刺对英国当时对宗教，科学，法律等的态度的攻击。“ Erewhon”一词由“ nowhere”一词的字母组成。

senses.def: a plot of land

examples.zh: 他们有自己的erf并计划建造一座房子。

examples.en: The council is making erven available for housing.
examples.zh: 委员会正在为埃文提供住房。

senses.def: a unit of work or energy

senses.zh: 作格的（可在不改变词义的情况下同时用作及物和不及物的动词，作及物动词时的宾语与作不及物动词时的主语一致）

examples.en: The verb ‘grow’ is ergative because you can say ‘She grew flowers in her garden’ or ‘Flowers grew in her garden’.
examples.zh: grow 为作格动词，因为既可以说 She grew flowers in her garden，也可以说 Flowers grew in her garden。

senses.def: therefore

examples.en: Change from within will take too long. Ergo change must come from outside.
examples.zh: 从内部改变需要太长时间。因此改变必须来自外部。

senses.def: designed to make people’s working environment more comfortable and to help them work more efficiently
senses.zh: 人类工效学的；人体工程学的

examples.en: ergonomic design
examples.zh: 提高工效的设计

examples.en: an ergonomic keyboard/chair
examples.zh: 人体工程学键盘／座椅

senses.def: something that is designed ergonomically
senses.zh: 符合人体工程学：按人体工程学设计的东西的设计方式使人们的工作环境更舒适，并帮助他们更高效地工作

examples.en: The layout is hard to fault ergonomically.
examples.zh: 这一设计从工效学方面看几乎无懈可击。

senses.def: the study of working conditions, especially the design of equipment and furniture, in order to help people work more efficiently
senses.zh: 人类工效学（研究如何改善工作条件，提高工作效率）

examples.en: There is a need for formal ergonomics in any design where the designer himself is not an experienced user.
examples.zh: 在设计师本人不是经验丰富的用户的任何设计中都需要正式的人体工程学。

senses.def: a first name for boys
(1882-1940) an English artist. He is well known for his sculptures, especially his bas-reliefs
senses.zh: 埃里克·吉尔（Eric Gill）：（1882-1940）英国艺术家。他以雕塑而著称，尤其是浅浮雕，例如他在威斯敏斯特大教堂的十字架站（1914-18）以及Prospero和Ariel的雕刻在BBC大楼的前面。他是书法家，还创建了几种新字体，其中最著名的是Gill Sans 。

senses.def: (1923-2012) an English comedian
senses.zh: 埃里克·赛克斯（Eric Sykes）：（1923-2012）英国喜剧演员。他是一个高个子的瘦男人，有着滑稽的悲伤表情，曾在许多电影和电视节目中写作并出演过。他与喜剧演员Hattie Jacques在电视上的合作而闻名。

senses.def: relating to plants of the heather
senses.zh: 杜鹃花科的；欧石南属的

examples.en: Use ericaceous compost for acid-loving plants such as foxgloves.
examples.zh: 欧石南堆肥用于洋地黄等喜酸性土壤的植物。

senses.def: a first name for girls
a country in north-eastern Africa
senses.zh: 厄立特里亚（东北非国家）

senses.def: (a person) from Eritrea
senses.zh: 厄立特里亚人；厄立特里亚的；厄立特里亚人的

senses.def: (1889-1970) a US author of over 140 crime novels and short stories. His best-known character was Perry Mason
senses.zh: 埃勒·斯坦利·加德纳（Erle Stanley Gardner）：（1889-1970年），美国作家，着有140多部犯罪小说和短篇小说。他最著名的人物是佩里·梅森（Perry Mason），但他也写了一系列关于地方检察官道格·塞尔比（Doug Selby）的小说。

senses.def: the sound that people make when they are deciding what to say next
senses.zh: （思索接着说什么时发出的声音）哦，嗯

examples.zh: “咱们走吧？”“哦，好的，咱们走。”

senses.zh: 白色鼬皮（尤用于法官、国王等的服饰）

senses.def: a stoat
the name given to one of the main Roman roads in Britain, from London to York
senses.zh: 从伦敦到约克，英国主要的罗马道路之一的名字

senses.def: a first name for boys
(1881-1951) a British trade union leader and labour
senses.zh: 欧内斯特·贝文（Ernest Bevin）：（1881-1951）英国工会领袖和劳工政治家。他成立了TGWU，并成为其领导者。第二次世界大战期间，他担任劳工和国民服务部长。后来，作为外交大臣（1945-51），他在创建北约方面发挥了重要作用。

senses.def: (1899-1961) a US writer of novels and short stories. He created a style of writing using short, simple sentences, and received the Nobel Prize
senses.zh: 欧内斯特·海明威（1899–1961）美国长篇小说和短篇小说作家。创造了一种使用简明短句的写作风格，1954 年获诺贝尔文学奖。第一次世界大战期间在战场上开救护车，后来作为记者在法国和西班牙报道第二次世界大战和西班牙内战。海明威的小说讲述硬汉的爱情和冒险故事。作品包括《太阳照常升起》（1926）、《永别了，武器》（1929）、《丧钟为谁而鸣》（1940）和《老人与海》（1952）。后受疾病困扰，在爱达荷州的家中开枪自杀。

senses.def: (1871-1937) a British scientist, born in New Zealand. His main interest was in the structure of the atom
senses.zh: 欧内斯特·卢瑟福（Ernest Rutherford）：（1871-1937）英国科学家，出生于新西兰。他的主要兴趣是原子的结构，他在剑桥大学卡文迪许实验室工作了大部分时间。在1902年，他解释了放射性衰变的过程，其中一种化学元素可以转变为另一种化学元素，他于1908年因这项工作而获得了诺贝尔奖。后来的工作确定了α，β和γ射线，他发现并命名了质子（ =原子的一部分）在1919年。他的工作对后来的核技术发展非常重要。他在1931年成为终身同伴。

senses.def: (1874-1922) an Irish explorer
senses.zh: 欧内斯特·沙克尔顿（Ernest Shackleton）：（1874-1922）爱尔兰探险家。从1901年到1904年，他作为斯科特船长小组的成员去了南极，后来又带领了三趟南极之旅。他在第四次旅程中丧生。1909年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: the computer that chooses the numbers of winning Premium Bonds
senses.zh: 电子摇奖机（用于英国有奖债券摇奖，其名由 Electronic Random Number Indicator Equipment 的首字母组成，意即“电子随机号码指示器”）

senses.def: to gradually destroy the surface of something through the action of wind, rain, etc.; to be gradually destroyed in this way

examples.en: The cliff face has been steadily eroded by the sea.
examples.zh: 峭壁表面逐渐被海水侵蚀。

examples.en: The rocks have eroded away over time.
examples.zh: 这些岩石随着时间的推移逐渐风化了。

examples.en: Her confidence has been slowly eroded by repeated failures.
examples.zh: 她的自信心因屡屡失败慢慢消磨掉了。

examples.zh: 偿还的按揭贷款因通货膨胀而贬值。

examples.zh: 这次经历严重挫伤了他的自信心。

examples.en: All my self-esteem has slowly eroded away.
examples.zh: 我所有的自尊都在慢慢地消失。

examples.zh: 他经常给他的祖母跑腿儿。

examples.en: The electricity supply here is quite erratic.
examples.zh: 这里的电力供应相当不稳定。

examples.en: She had learnt to live with his sudden changes of mood and erratic behaviour.
examples.zh: 她已经学会适应他那变幻莫测的情绪和难以捉摸的行为。

examples.en: Mary is a gifted but erratic player (= she does not always play well).
examples.zh: 玛丽是一名有天赋的运动员，但发挥不太稳定。

senses.def: (1909-59) an Australian actor who became famous as the strong and handsome
senses.zh: 埃罗尔·弗林（Errol Flynn）：（1909-59）澳大利亚演员，以许多好莱坞冒险电影的强壮而英俊的英雄而闻名。他因奔跑，跳跃，战斗等角色而被特别记住，例如《罗宾汉历险记》（1938年）。弗林（Flynn）也因与女性的许多事务而闻名。

senses.def: not correct; based on wrong information

examples.en: erroneous conclusions/assumptions
examples.zh: 错误的结论／假设

examples.en: He seems to be under the erroneous impression that she is in love with him.
examples.zh: 他似乎误以为她爱上了他。

examples.en: The theory is based on several erroneous beliefs.
examples.zh: 该理论基于几个错误的信念。

examples.en: Their conclusions are quite erroneous.
examples.zh: 他们的结论是相当错误的。

senses.def: in a way that is not correct or that is based on wrong information

examples.en: The bank erroneously transferred the money to her account.
examples.zh: 银行错误地将钱转入她的账户。

senses.def: a mistake, especially one that causes problems or affects the result of something

examples.en: spelling/typographical/grammatical errors
examples.zh: 拼写／排版／语法错误

examples.en: The report contains some factual errors that must be corrected.
examples.zh: 报告中有些事实性错误必须纠正。

examples.en: They committed the fatal error of misjudging the weather conditions.
examples.zh: 他们犯下了错误判断天气状况的致命错误。

examples.en: There are too many errors in your work.
examples.zh: 你的工作失误太多。

examples.en: I think you have made an error in calculating the total.
examples.zh: 我想你在计算总数时出了差错。

examples.en: A simple error of judgement meant that there was not enough food to go around.
examples.zh: 一个简单的判断错误就意味着食物不够每人一份。

examples.en: an error of fact/principle
examples.zh: 事实/原则错误

examples.en: a serious/grave error
examples.zh: 严重的错误

examples.en: a glaring error (= a mistake that is very obvious)
examples.zh: 明显的错误

examples.en: The computer system was switched off in error (= by mistake).
examples.zh: 计算机系统被错误关闭。

examples.en: There is no room for error in this job.
examples.zh: 这项工作决不允许出差错。

examples.en: His attempts to arrange a party ended up as a comedy of errors (= he made so many mistakes it was funny).
examples.zh: 他尝试安排聚会，结果闹了笑话。

examples.zh: 他们能及时意识到自己在方式方法上的错误吗？

senses.def: the process of solving a problem by trying various methods until you find a method that is successful

intro.en: These are all words for a word, figure or fact that is not said, written down or typed correctly.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指用词、数字、事实等方面的错误、口误、笔误。

items.def: a word or figure that is not said or written down correctly:
items.zh: 指用词或数字上的错误、口误、笔误

examples.en: It’s a common mistake among learners of English.
examples.zh: 这是学英语的人常犯的错误。

items.def: (rather formal) a word, figure, etc. that is not said or written down correctly:

examples.zh: 你的工作失误太多。

items.def: (rather formal) a piece of information that is not exactly correct:
items.zh: 指信息不准确、有误

examples.en: The article is full of inaccuracies.
examples.zh: 这篇文章里不准确的地方比比皆是。

items.zh: 指印刷文本上的错误

senses.def: a process by which a computer corrects mistakes in data

examples.en: The process is manual, time-consuming and error-prone.
examples.zh: 该过程是手动的、耗时且容易出错。

examples.zh: 两名犯人逃走了。

examples.zh: 虽然他不知道那里的生活会是什么样子，但他还是得趁机逃走。

examples.zh: 她设法从燃烧的汽车里逃了出来。

examples.zh: 小时候他常常躲进自己的梦幻世界中。

examples.zh: 这个周末我得写一篇作文。

examples.zh: 你写完关于拿破仑的文章了吗？

examples.zh: 著名非裔美国作家散文集

examples.zh: 这本书中有几篇写社会生活中女性的有趣文章。

examples.zh: 某事物必不可少的一部分／特征

examples.zh: 某事物必不可少的因素／成分／组成部分

examples.zh: 当地政府无法提供燃气、水和电等基本服务。

examples.zh: 维生素在许多身体代谢过程中发挥着重要作用。

examples.en: The museum is closed while essential repairs are being carried out.
examples.zh: 博物馆正在进行大修，在此期间暂停开放。

examples.en: The charity will be taking food and essential supplies to six refugee camps.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构将向六个难民营运送食物和必需品。

examples.en: This book is essential reading for all nature lovers.
examples.zh: 这本书是所有自然爱好者的必备读物。

examples.en: All events are free, but booking is essential.
examples.zh: 所有活动都是免费的，但必须预约。

examples.en: Money is not essential to happiness.
examples.zh: 金钱对于幸福并非必不可少。

examples.en: Experience is essential for this job.
examples.zh: 对于这个工作，经验是非常重要的。

examples.en: It is essential to keep the two groups separate.
examples.zh: 将这两组分开是完全必要的。

examples.en: It is absolutely essential for all those involved in education to be computer-literate
examples.zh: 对于所有参与教育的人来说，掌握计算机知识是绝对必要的

examples.en: It is essential that you have some experience.
examples.zh: 你必须要有些经验。

senses.def: connected with the most important aspect or basic nature of somebody/something

examples.en: The essential difference between Sara and me is in our attitude to money.
examples.zh: 我与萨拉的根本区别在于我们对金钱的态度。

examples.zh: 他描述了在他看来美国的本质是什么。

examples.en: The essential character of the town has been destroyed by the new road.
examples.zh: 这个小镇的根本特质被这条新路毁掉了。

examples.en: The film captures an essential truth of adolescence
examples.zh: 这部电影捕捉到了青春期的一个基本真相

senses.zh: 必不可少的东西；必需品

examples.zh: 我只来得及装上最基本的必需品。

examples.en: The studio had all the essentials like heating and running water.
examples.zh: 工作室里具备所有的基本设施，如暖气和自来水。

examples.en: The relief agencies are trying to provide food and other basic essentials.
examples.zh: 救助机构试图提供食物和其他基本必需品。

examples.zh: 对于这个工作，经验是非常重要的。

items.def: essential:

examples.en: The police play a vital role in our society.
examples.zh: 警察在我们的社会中起着极其重要的作用。

items.def: extremely important because a particular situation or activity depends on it:

examples.zh: 我们把这个问题弄明白是极其重要的。

items.def: extremely important because a particular situation or activity depends on it:
items.zh: 指至关重要的、关键的

examples.en: Your decision is critical to our future.
examples.zh: 你的决定对我们的将来至关重要。

items.def: of the greatest importance in affecting the final result of a particular situation:
items.zh: 指决定性的、关键的

examples.en: She has played a decisive role in the peace negotiations.
examples.zh: 她在和谈中起了关键作用。

items.def: essential; too important to be without:
items.zh: 指必需的、不可或缺的

examples.en: Cars have become an indispensable part of our lives.
examples.zh: 汽车已成了我们生活中必不可少的一部分。

when you think about the true, important or basic nature of somebody/something

examples.zh: 解决这个问题有三种本质上完全不同的方法。

examples.en: The pattern is essentially the same in all cases.
examples.zh: 这种模式在所有情况下基本相同。

examples.en: Essentially, what we are suggesting is that the firm needs to change.
examples.zh: 说到底，我们的建议是公司必须思变。

examples.en: He was, essentially, a teacher, not a manager.
examples.zh: 他本质上来说是个教师而不是经理。

examples.zh: 本文主要是关于她与父母的关系。

examples.zh: 这个委员会创立于 1912 年。

examples.zh: 他们现在希望在古巴建立一个中心。

examples.zh: 该公司去年在佛罗里达州建立了基地。

examples.zh: 建立国家/政府/团体/学校

examples.zh: 建立标准/原则

examples.zh: 我们来制订一些基本原则吧。

examples.zh: 该提案主张建立世界性的监狱检查制度。

examples.zh: 他们要建立一个油泵和管线的网络输送石油。

examples.zh: 新条约设立了自由贸易区。

examples.zh: 建立联系

examples.zh: 这所学校正努力与当地社区建立关系。

examples.zh: 现在他已经牢牢确立了自己在组织中的地位。

examples.zh: 学校因学术卓越而享有盛誉。

examples.zh: 他花了很长时间才确立自己的地位。

examples.zh: 他刚创办自己的公司，但要站稳脚跟还得花上一段时间。

examples.zh: 那次展览帮助确立了她艺术家的地位。

examples.zh: 那时她作为明星的地位已经确立。

examples.en: Not long after that she established herself in business.
examples.zh: 不久之后，她就在商界崭露头角。

senses.zh: 使…获得接受；使…得到认可

examples.en: This success helped to establish the practice of vaccination.
examples.zh: 这一成功使疫苗接种获得了认可。

examples.en: Traditions get established over time.
examples.zh: 传统是随着时间的推移而得到认可的。

examples.zh: 第二次世界大战的爆发确立了君主圣诞广播的传统。

examples.zh: 这个节日已经被确立为年度盛事。

examples.zh: 警方仍在努力确定事故的原因。

examples.zh: 将进行调查以查明真相。

examples.zh: 我们仍在努力确定死者的身份。

examples.zh: 他的罪名已经明确成立。

examples.zh: 这种新药的效果尚未得到科学证实。

examples.zh: 他们已经证实他是摔伤的。

examples.zh: 我们需要查实枪击发生时她在何处。

examples.zh: 此后便证实那匹马被注射了兴奋剂。

examples.zh: 该签证适用于希望在大学、学院或类似教育机构学习的外国人。

examples.zh: 目前她负责管理一个小型政府研究部门。

examples.zh: 反对当权者的年轻人

examples.zh: 这些成员是从当权者的队伍中选拔出来的。

examples.zh: 发言人宣布了新学院的成立。

examples.zh: 他的出访促进了国家间外交关系的建立。

examples.zh: 这位诗人的童年是在乡村庄园度过的。

examples.zh: 她向所有在庄园土地上拥有小屋的人收取租金。

examples.zh: 她的遗产全部留给了女儿。

examples.zh: 深受敬重的科学家

examples.zh: 他被认为是一位敬业且富有想象力的学者。

senses.def: to form an idea of the cost, size, value, etc. of something, but without calculating it exactly

examples.zh: 估计某物的成本／价值／数量

examples.zh: 这颗卫星估计要耗资 4 亿英镑。

examples.zh: 警方估计聚集的人有 3 万。

examples.en: All variables can be estimated from the data.
examples.zh: 所有变量都可以根据数据进行估计。

examples.en: The number of breeding pairs was estimated as the number of pairs building nests.
examples.zh: 繁殖对的数量被估计为筑巢的对的数量。

examples.en: The deal is estimated to be worth around $1.5 million.
examples.zh: 这笔交易估计价值 150 万美元左右。

examples.en: We estimated (that) it would cost about €5 000.
examples.zh: 我们估计要花费大约 5 000 欧元。

examples.en: It is estimated (that) the project will last four years.
examples.zh: 据估计，这项工程将用时四年。

examples.en: It is hard to estimate how many children have dyslexia.
examples.zh: 很难估计有多少儿童患有阅读障碍。

examples.zh: 她以传教的热情将歌剧带给大众。

examples.zh: 太阳使地球上的湿气不断蒸发。

senses.def: to disappear, especially by gradually becoming less and less

examples.zh: 她的信心已消失殆尽。

examples.en: Their lead in the opinion polls evaporated overnight.
examples.zh: 他们在民意调查中的领先地位一夜之间消失了。

senses.def: thick milk sold in cans that has had some of its water content removed
a dish in which scientists heat a liquid, so that it leaves a solid when it has disappeared
the process of a liquid changing or being changed into a gas

examples.en: Heat and wind can cause evaporation.
examples.zh: 热和风会导致蒸发。

examples.en: Snow cover prevents evaporation of water from the soil.
examples.zh: 积雪可以防止土壤中的水分蒸发。

senses.def: the process of gradually becoming less and less

senses.def: the act of avoiding somebody or of avoiding something that you are supposed to do

examples.en: Transport police charged her with fare evasion.
examples.zh: 交通警察指控她逃票。

senses.def: a statement that somebody makes that avoids dealing with something or talking about something honestly and directly

examples.en: His speech was full of evasions and half-truths.
examples.zh: 他的发言尽是些遁词和真假参半的说法。

senses.def: not willing to give clear answers to a question
senses.zh: 回避提问的；推托的；推诿的

examples.en: evasive answers/comments/replies
examples.zh: 含糊其词的回答／意见／答复

examples.en: Tessa was evasive about why she had not been at home that night.
examples.zh: 特萨对她那天晚上不在家的原因避而不谈。

examples.en: John, normally so honest, was now being evasive in the extreme.
examples.zh: 平时很诚实的约翰现在却变得极其回避。

senses.def: to act in order to avoid danger or an unpleasant situation
senses.zh: 采取回避行动（以避免危险或不愉快的处境）

examples.en: The pilot had to take evasive action to avoid a mid-air collision.
examples.zh: 飞行员不得不采取规避行动以避免空中相撞。

senses.def: to act in order to avoid danger or an unpleasant situation

examples.zh: 飞行员不得不采取规避行动以避免空中相撞。

examples.en: ‘I'm not sure,’ she replied evasively.
examples.zh: “我不敢确定。”她躲躲闪闪地答道。

senses.def: the practice of not giving a clear answer to a question

examples.en: Politicians are often accused of evasiveness.
examples.zh: 政客常因左右言他而受人指责。

examples.zh: 圣诞前夕（12 月 24 日）

examples.en: a New Year’s Eve party (= on 31 December)

examples.en: on the eve of the election
examples.zh: 在选举前夕

examples.en: a special election eve show
examples.zh: 选举前夕的一场特别表演

senses.def: evening

examples.en: one midsummer’s eve
examples.zh: 一个仲夏夜

senses.def: a first name for girls
a first name for boys or girls
senses.zh: 伊万林，伊夫琳，伊夫林（男子或女子名）

senses.def: (1903-66) an English writer of novels which are greatly admired for their elegant
senses.zh: 伊芙琳·沃（Evelyn Waugh）：（1903-66）一位英国小说作家，以其优雅的风格和幽默而倍受赞誉。在诸如《衰落与秋天》（1928年）和《一把尘土》（1934年）等小说中，他取笑了1920年代和1930年代英国的上层阶级和上层中产阶级。他在非洲的旅行为诸如《黑恶作剧》（1932年）和《瓢》（1938年）之类的小说提供了思想。1930年，他成为罗马天主教徒，他对天主教信仰的兴趣在更严肃的小说《新娘的再造》（Brideshead Revisited，1945年）中得到了体现，该小说讲述了一个上流社会的英国罗马天主教家庭。沃恩的其他著作还包括根据他在第二次世界大战中当兵的经历而编写的三本书系列，其标题为《荣誉之剑》（Sword of Honor，1952-61）。他以脾气暴躁，粗鲁，举止固执，右翼观点而闻名。

senses.def: used to emphasize something unexpected or surprising

examples.en: She didn't even call to say she wasn't coming.
examples.zh: 她甚至没打电话来说一声她不来了。

examples.en: He never even opened the letter (= so he certainly didn't read it).
examples.zh: 他根本没打开过那封信。

examples.en: It wouldn't have been possible 30 years ago, maybe even 20.
examples.zh: 这在 30 年前甚至 20 年前是不可能的。

examples.en: It was cold there even in summer (= so it must have been very cold in winter).
examples.zh: 那儿即使夏天也很冷。

examples.en: Even a child can understand it (= so adults certainly can).
examples.zh: 这连小孩子也能理解。

senses.def: used when you are comparing things, to make the comparison stronger
senses.zh: （用以加强比较）甚至更，愈加，还

examples.en: You know even less about it than I do.
examples.zh: 你对此事的了解甚至还不如我。

examples.en: She's even more intelligent than her sister.
examples.zh: 她甚至比她姐姐还聪明。

examples.en: The Second World War made things even worse.
examples.zh: 第二次世界大战使情况变得更加糟糕。

examples.en: We face an even greater challenge today.
examples.zh: 今天我们面临着更大的挑战。

senses.def: used to introduce a more exact description of somebody/something
senses.zh: （引出更精确的说法）甚至可以说，其实，实际上

examples.en: It's an unattractive building, ugly even.
examples.zh: 这栋建筑毫不美观，甚至可以说难看。

senses.def: just at the same time as somebody does something or as something else happens

examples.en: Even as he shouted the warning the car skidded.
examples.zh: 他正在高喊注意时，汽车就打滑了。

senses.def: despite the possibility that; no matter whether

examples.en: I'll get there, even if I have to walk.
examples.zh: 我就是走也要走到那儿去。

senses.def: despite the fact that; even though

examples.en: He is a great leader, even if he has many enemies.
examples.zh: 尽管有很多反对者，他仍是一位伟大的领袖。

senses.def: despite what has/had happened
senses.zh: 甚至到现在（或那时）；即便是这样（或那样）；尽管如此（或那样）

examples.en: I've shown him the photographs but even now he won't believe me.
examples.zh: 我把照片给他看了，即便是这样他仍然不相信我。

examples.en: Even then she would not admit her mistake.
examples.zh: 甚至到那时她还是不肯认错。

senses.def: at this or that exact moment

examples.en: The troops are even now preparing to march into the city.
examples.zh: 部队此刻正在准备向城里开进。

senses.def: despite that

examples.en: There are a lot of spelling mistakes; even so, it's quite a good essay.
examples.zh: 尽管有许多拼写错误，它仍不失为一篇佳作。

senses.def: despite the fact that

examples.en: I like her, even though she can be annoying at times.
examples.zh: 尽管她有时可能很烦人，我还是喜欢她。

senses.def: that can be divided exactly by two

senses.def: equal or the same for each person, team, place, etc.

examples.zh: 我们的比分现在相等。

examples.en: the even distribution of food

senses.zh: 均衡的；不相上下的；同一水平的

examples.en: an even contest
examples.zh: 势均力敌的竞赛

examples.en: The two players were pretty even.
examples.zh: 这两个运动员不分上下。

examples.zh: 这两个队势均力敌。

senses.def: calmly; without showing any emotion

examples.en: ‘I warned you not to phone me,’ he said evenly.
examples.zh: “我告诫过你不要给我打电话。”他平静地说。

senses.def: the quality of being calm and not changing or becoming upset
senses.zh: 镇静的；稳重的；平和的，温和的

examples.en: What she liked in him was his evenness of temper.
examples.zh: 她喜欢他的一点是他的性情平和。

senses.def: the fact of not changing much in amount, speed, etc.
senses.zh: （数量、速度等）变化不大的，均匀的，平稳的

examples.en: She possessed a voice of immaculate beauty and evenness of tone.
examples.zh: 她拥有完美美丽的声音和均匀的音调。

senses.def: the fact of being equal or the same for each person, team, place, etc.

examples.en: The population declines took place with remarkable evenness across the nation.
examples.zh: 全国范围内的人口下降非常均匀。

senses.def: the fact that two people or teams are equally balanced or of an equal standard
senses.zh: 均衡的；不相上下的；同一水平的

examples.en: The score, 6–6, illustrated the evenness of the contest.
examples.zh: 6比6的比分，说明了比赛的公平性。

senses.def: the quality of being smooth, level and flat

examples.en: Results will be affected by the degree of evenness of the surface.
examples.zh: 结果会受到表面平整度的影响。

senses.def: the fact of being equally spaced and the same size
senses.zh: 匀称的；均匀的；同样大小的

examples.en: She admired the evenness of his teeth.
examples.zh: 她很欣赏他整齐的牙齿。

senses.def: the service of evening prayer in the Anglican Church
a thing that happens, especially something important
senses.zh: 发生的事情；（尤指）重要事情，大事

examples.en: recent/current/world events
examples.zh: 近期事件；时事；世界大事

examples.en: The tragic events of last Monday occurred only 200 metres from the shore.
examples.zh: 上星期一的惨剧发生在离海岸只有 200 米的地方。

examples.en: Historians long ago established that the event never happened.
examples.zh: 历史学家很久以前就确定这件事从未发生过。

examples.en: TV viewers watched in horror as events unfolded.
examples.zh: 事件渐渐展开，电视观众看得心惊肉跳。

examples.en: a dramatic turn of events (= change in what is happening)
examples.zh: 事件的戏剧性转变

examples.en: Everyone was frightened by the strange sequence of events.
examples.zh: 人人都因接二连三发生的怪事感到惊恐。

examples.en: The police have reconstructed the chain of events leading to the murder.
examples.zh: 警方已经重建了导致谋杀的一系列事件。

examples.en: an unfortunate series of events
examples.zh: 一系列不幸的事件

examples.en: Why should we believe his version of events (= description of what happened from his point of view)?
examples.zh: 为什么我们要相信他的说法？

examples.en: The decisions we take now may influence the course of events (= the way things happen) in the future.
examples.zh: 我们现在的决定可能会影响未来的事态发展。

examples.en: In the normal course of events (= if things had happened as expected) she would have gone with him.
examples.zh: 要是事情发展顺利的话，她已同他一块儿走了。

examples.en: He found that the report he had written had been overtaken by events (= it was no longer relevant).
examples.zh: 他发现他写的报告已经被事件所取代（=不再相关）。

examples.en: A minority of patients suffered adverse events, including heart attacks.
examples.zh: 少数患者遭受了不良事件，包括心脏病发作。

senses.def: a planned public or social occasion

examples.en: Is the city ready to host such a major sporting event?
examples.zh: 这个城市准备好举办这样一个大型的体育盛会了吗？

examples.en: The hospital is organizing a special fundraising event.
examples.zh: 医院正在组织特别筹款活动。

examples.en: They were invited to attend the social event of the year.
examples.zh: 他们受邀参加年度社交活动。

examples.en: As always, the annual event will be held in the grounds of the house.
examples.zh: 与往常一样，一年一度的活动将在庄园内举行。

examples.en: Events are taking place throughout the summer to celebrate the city's centenary.
examples.zh: 整个夏天都会举办庆祝这座城市百年诞辰的活动。

senses.def: one of the races or competitions in a sports programme

examples.en: The 800 metres is the fourth event of the afternoon.
examples.zh: 800 米赛是下午的第四项比赛。

examples.en: Local winners compete in a national event in September.
examples.zh: 各地获胜选手将参加 9 月份的全国比赛。

senses.def: after something has happened

examples.en: I knew nothing about it until after the event.
examples.zh: 事后我才得知这件事。

senses.def: to understand something, or realize what you should have done, only after something has happened

examples.en: Anyone can be wise after the event.
examples.zh: 事后聪明谁都会。

senses.def: the birth of a baby
used to emphasize or show that something is true or will happen despite other circumstances

examples.en: I think she'll agree to do it but in any event, all she can say is ‘no’.
examples.zh: 我想她会同意做的，但无论怎样，她只能说“不”。

examples.en: I think the economy will recover in any event.
examples.zh: 我认为经济无论如何都会复苏的。

senses.def: when the situation actually happened

examples.en: I got very nervous about the exam, but in the event, I needn't have worried; it was really easy.
examples.zh: 我对考试提心吊胆，但其实我本不必担心，这次考试的确很容易。

examples.en: In the event though, the dinner was a very entertaining affair.
examples.zh: 但是结果证明，晚餐还是非常令人愉快的。

senses.def: if something happens

examples.en: In the event of an accident, call this number.
examples.zh: 万一发生事故就拨这个号码。

examples.en: Sheila will inherit everything in the event of his death.
examples.zh: 他一旦故去，所有财产都由希拉继承。

examples.en: In the unlikely event of a crash, please remain calm.
examples.zh: 万一发生碰撞，请保持冷静。

senses.def: if that happens
senses.zh: 如果是那样的话；如果那种事情发生

examples.en: In that event, we will have to reconsider our offer.
examples.zh: 如果是那样的话，我们就得重新考虑我们的建议。

senses.def: the job of arranging events such as festivals, concerts, conferences, etc.

examples.en: This new company will be responsible for the event management of festivals in other cities.
examples.zh: 这家新公司将负责其他城市节日的活动管理。

examples.en: There are many event management companies that can provide artists for your special occasion.
examples.zh: 有许多活动管理公司可以为您的特殊场合提供艺术家。

senses.def: a person whose job is to arrange events such as festivals, concerts, conferences, etc.
senses.zh: 活动运营经理；活动策划人

examples.en: These event managers specialize in themed weddings.
examples.zh: 这几名活动运营经理专门策划主题婚礼。

examples.en: The event managers also take care of music choices.
examples.zh: 活动策划人也负责音乐选择。

senses.def: a person whose job is to arrange events such as festivals, concerts, conferences, etc.
senses.zh: 活动运营经理；活动策划人

examples.en: These event planners specialize in themed weddings.
examples.zh: 这些活动策划者专门从事主题婚礼。

examples.en: The event planners also take care of music choices.
examples.zh: 活动策划者还负责音乐的选择。

senses.def: the job of arranging events such as festivals, concerts, conferences, etc.

examples.en: This new company will be responsible for the event planning of festivals in other cities.
examples.zh: 这家新公司将负责其他城市节日的活动策划。

examples.en: There are many event planning companies that can provide artists for your special occasion.
examples.zh: 有许多活动策划公司可以为您的特殊场合提供艺术家。

senses.def: a rider or horse that takes part in eventing
senses.zh: 马术三项赛骑手；马术三项赛马匹

examples.en: This type of training is excellent for both showjumpers and eventers.
examples.zh: 这类训练对参加场地障碍赛和三项赛的选手都是非常好的。

senses.def: full of things that happen, especially exciting, important or dangerous things
senses.zh: 充满大事的；多事故的；多变故的

examples.en: an eventful day/life/journey
examples.zh: 不平凡的一天；多姿多彩的一生／旅程

examples.en: It had been a long and eventful journey.
examples.zh: 那是一个漫长而又多姿多彩的旅程。

senses.def: evening
the sport of taking part in competitions riding horses. These are often held over three days and include riding across country, jumping and dressage
senses.zh: 马术三项赛，马术三日赛（包括越野赛、障碍赛和盛装舞步）

senses.def: happening at the end of a period of time or of a process

examples.en: the eventual winner of the tournament
examples.zh: 锦标赛的最终胜利者

examples.en: It is impossible to predict what the eventual outcome will be.
examples.zh: 无法预测最终结果会怎么样。

examples.en: The village school may face eventual closure.
examples.zh: 这所乡村学校可能面临最后被关闭。

senses.def: something that may possibly happen, especially something unpleasant
senses.zh: （尤指令人不快的）可能发生的事情，可能出现的结果

examples.en: We were prepared for every eventuality.
examples.zh: 我们已做好准备应付任何可能出现的情况。

examples.en: The money had been saved for just such an eventuality.
examples.zh: 钱积攒下来就是为应付这样的意外。

examples.en: In the eventuality of your passport being stolen, contact the embassy at once.
examples.zh: 如果您的护照被盗，请立即联系大使馆。

examples.en: The instructions he left covered all eventualities.
examples.zh: 他留下的指示涵盖了所有可能发生的情况。

examples.en: This strategy will allow us to cope with all eventualities which may arise.
examples.zh: 这种部署使我们能够应付任何可能出现的情况。

senses.def: at the end of a period of time or a series of events

examples.en: Our flight eventually left five hours late.
examples.zh: 我们的班机最终晚了五个小时起飞。

examples.en: I'll get round to mending it eventually.
examples.zh: 我最后会抽出时间来修理它的。

examples.en: She hopes eventually to attend medical school and become a doctor.
examples.zh: 她希望最终能上医学院，成为一名医生。

senses.def: to happen as a result of something
used in negative sentences and questions, or sentences with if
senses.zh: （用于否定句和疑问句，或与 if 连用的句子）在任何时候，从来

examples.en: Nothing ever happens here.
examples.zh: 这儿从未发生过任何事。

examples.en: Don't you ever get tired?
examples.zh: 难道你从来不累吗？

examples.en: If you're ever in Miami, come and see us.
examples.zh: 你要是什么时候到了迈阿密，就来看看我们吧。

examples.en: ‘Have you ever been to Rome?’ ‘Yes, I have, actually. Not long ago.’
examples.zh: “你去过罗马吗？”“是的，我确实去过，就在不久前。”

examples.en: ‘Have you ever thought of changing your job?’ ‘No, never/No I haven’t.’
examples.zh: “你想过换一下工作吗？”“没有，从未想过。”

examples.en: She hardly ever (= almost never) goes out.
examples.zh: 她几乎从不出门。

examples.en: We've only ever talked on the phone.
examples.zh: 我们只通过电话交谈过。

examples.en: I don't think I ever really thanked you properly.
examples.zh: 我想我从来没有真正地感谢过你。

examples.en: He wondered whether it would ever actually happen.
examples.zh: 他想知道这是否真的会发生。

examples.en: We see them very seldom, if ever.
examples.zh: 我们难得见到他们。

examples.en: I'll never ever do that again!
examples.zh: 我再也不会干那种事了！

examples.en: I'm never speaking to you ever again!
examples.zh: 我再也不会跟你说话了。

senses.def: used for emphasis when you are comparing things
senses.zh: （进行比较时用以加强语气）以往任何时候，曾经

examples.en: It was raining harder than ever.
examples.zh: 当时下着前所未有的大雨。

examples.en: Consumers today have more choices than ever before.
examples.zh: 如今消费者的选择比以往任何时候都多。

examples.en: It's my best-ever score.
examples.zh: 这是我得到过的最好分数。

examples.en: It's the worst film I've ever seen.
examples.zh: 这是我看过的最差的电影。

senses.def: all the time or every time; always

examples.en: Paul, ever the optimist, agreed to try again.
examples.zh: 保罗这个一贯的乐观主义者答应再试一次。

examples.en: She married the prince and they lived happily ever after.
examples.zh: 她与王子成了婚，从此过着幸福的生活。

examples.en: He said he would love her for ever (and ever).
examples.zh: 他说会永远爱她。

examples.en: Their debts grew ever larger (= kept increasing).
examples.zh: 他们的债务不断增加。

examples.en: the ever-growing problem
examples.zh: 日趋严重的问题

examples.en: an ever-present danger
examples.zh: 始终存在的危险

senses.def: used after when
senses.zh: （用于 when、why 等之后表示惊讶）究竟，到底

examples.en: Why ever did you agree?
examples.zh: 你究竟为什么要同意？

senses.def: used to emphasize that somebody does the same thing very often, usually in an annoying way
senses.zh: 某人只会／就知道做某事

examples.en: All he ever does is grumble about things.
examples.zh: 他只会抱怨。

senses.def: used to show that you are surprised or shocked

examples.en: Did you ever hear anything like it?
examples.zh: 你听到过这种事吗？

senses.def: continuously since the time mentioned

examples.en: He's had a car ever since he was 18.
examples.zh: 他从 18 岁起就有汽车了。

examples.en: I was bitten by a dog once and I've been afraid of them ever since.
examples.zh: 我曾被狗咬过，自那以后就一直害怕狗。

senses.def: very; really

examples.en: He looks ever so smart.
examples.zh: 他样子很帅。

examples.en: She's ever such a nice woman.
examples.zh: 她是个非常好的女人。

examples.en: It's ever so easy.
examples.zh: 这非常容易。

senses.def: used to emphasize that something is certainly true
senses.zh: （用以加强语气）确实，无可置疑，真正地

examples.en: That was a disaster if ever there was one!
examples.zh: 那确实是场灾难！

senses.def: used to emphasize something you are talking about
senses.zh: 确实如此；千真万确；一点儿不差

examples.en: ‘You must have been upset by that.’ ‘Was I ever!’
examples.zh: “你一定曾为那事而心烦了。”“可不是嘛！”

senses.def: sometimes used at the end of an informal letter, before you write your name
senses.zh: （有时用于非正式书信末尾署名前）你的永远的朋友

senses.def: an international company that makes electrical batteries with the brand names Eveready™ and Energizer™
senses.zh: 生产电池的国际公司，品牌为Eveready™和Energizer™

senses.def: that has green leaves all through the year

examples.en: evergreen shrubs
examples.zh: 常青灌木

senses.def: always popular

examples.en: a new production of Rossini’s evergreen opera
examples.zh: 经久不衰的罗西尼歌剧的重新制作

senses.def: a tree or bush that has green leaves all through the year

examples.en: Few plants grow under the dense shade cast by the evergreens.
examples.zh: 很少有植物生长在常绿植物浓密的树荫下。

senses.def: continuing forever; never changing
senses.zh: 永久的；永恒的；经久不变的

examples.en: everlasting life/love
examples.zh: 永生；永恒的爱

examples.en: an everlasting memory of her smile
examples.zh: 她的微笑留下的永久回忆

examples.en: To his everlasting credit, he never told anyone what I'd done.
examples.zh: 值得永远称赞的是他从未把我做的事告诉过任何人。

examples.en: The raven is used by the poet as a symbol of everlasting despair.
examples.zh: 诗人用乌鸦作为永恒绝望的象征。

senses.def: continuing too long; repeated too often
senses.zh: 冗长的；持续过长的；重复太多的

examples.en: I'm tired of your everlasting complaints.
examples.zh: 我讨厌你没完没了的抱怨。

senses.def: in a way that continues forever without changing
senses.zh: 永恒：以一种永续不变的方式进行

senses.def: always
one of the two major football clubs in Liverpool
senses.zh: 埃弗顿：英格兰利物浦的两个主要足球俱乐部之一。它成立于1878年，其地名是古迪森公园。埃弗顿队的绰号是太妃糖或太妃糖。

senses.def: used with singular nouns to refer to all the members of a group of things or people
senses.zh: （与单数名词连用，指整体中的）每一个，每个

examples.en: She knows every student in the school.
examples.zh: 她认识学校里的每一个学生。

examples.en: I could hear every word they said.
examples.zh: 他们说的每个字我都能听见。

examples.en: We enjoyed every minute of our stay.
examples.zh: 我们逗留期间每一分钟都过得很愉快。

examples.en: I go to the gym every day.
examples.zh: 我每天都去健身房。

examples.en: every week/month/year
examples.zh: 每周/每月/每年

examples.en: I get that wrong every single time.
examples.zh: 我每一次都把它弄错了。

examples.en: I read every last article in the newspaper (= all of them).
examples.zh: 报纸上的每一篇文章我都读。

examples.en: They were watching her every movement.
examples.zh: 他们注视着她的每一个动作。

examples.en: Every one of their songs has been a hit.
examples.zh: 他们的每首歌都风靡一时。

senses.def: used to say how often something happens or is done
senses.zh: （表示发生的频率）每，每逢，每隔

examples.en: The buses go every 10 minutes.
examples.zh: 公共汽车每隔 10 分钟发一班车。

examples.en: We had to stop every few miles.
examples.zh: 我们每走几英里就得停一停。

examples.en: One in every three marriages ends in divorce.
examples.zh: 三分之一的婚姻都以离婚告终。

examples.en: He has every third day off (= he works for two days, then has one day off, then works for two days and so on).
examples.zh: 他每工作两天休息一天。

examples.en: We see each other every now and again.
examples.zh: 我们偶尔相见。

examples.en: Every now and then he regretted his decision.
examples.zh: 他有时为自己的决定后悔。

senses.def: all possible

examples.zh: 研究人员发现了明确的科学证据，证明日光暴晒与皮肤癌之间有关联。

examples.zh: 这项研究的实验证据证明这种药没有长期副作用。

examples.zh: 据说 70 岁以上的司机很难买到保险。

examples.zh: 在没有相反证据的情况下，应假定遵循了适当的程序。
