examples.en: Other parts of the book contain unnecessarily lengthy explanations.
examples.zh: 本书的其他部分包含不必要的冗长解释。

examples.en: For a full explanation of how the machine works, turn to page 5.
examples.zh: 关于机器工作原理的详细说明，请翻阅第 5 页。

examples.en: The teacher gave the children a detailed explanation of the story.
examples.zh: 老师给孩子们详细讲解了这个故事。

examples.en: He entered into a technical explanation about software and programming.
examples.zh: 他开始从技术的角度解释软件和编程。

synonyms.words: explanation ▪ grounds ▪ basis ▪ excuse ▪ motive ▪ justification ▪ pretext

intro.en: These are all words for a cause or an explanation for something that has happened or that somebody has done.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指事情发生或做某事的原因、理由、解释。

items.def: a cause or an explanation for something that has happened or that somebody has done; a fact that makes it right or fair to do something:
items.zh: 指某事发生或做某事的原因、理由、解释、道理

examples.en: He said no but he didn’t give a reason.
examples.zh: 他说不行，但没有说明原因。

items.def: a statement, fact or situation that tells you why something has happened; a reason given for something:
items.zh: 指解释、说明、阐述

examples.en: The most likely explanation is that his plane was delayed.
examples.zh: 最可能的解释是他的飞机晚点了。

items.def: (rather formal) a good or true reason for saying, doing or believing something:
items.zh: 指说、做或相信某事的充分理由、根据

examples.en: You have no grounds for complaint.
examples.zh: 你没有理由抱怨。

items.def: (rather formal) the reason why people take a particular action:
items.zh: 指原因、缘由

examples.en: On what basis will this decision be made?
examples.zh: 将基于何种原因作出这一决定呢？

items.def: a reason, either true or invented, that you give to explain or defend your behaviour; a good reason that you give for doing something that you want to do for other reasons:
items.zh: 指为自己行为所作的辩护、借口、理由

examples.en: Late again! What’s your excuse this time?
examples.zh: 又迟到了！你这次有什么借口？

items.def: a reason that explains somebody’s behaviour:
items.zh: 指动机、原因

examples.en: There seemed to be no motive for the murder.
examples.zh: 这起谋杀案看不出有什么动机。

items.def: (rather formal) a good reason why something exists or is done:
items.zh: 指事物存在或做某事的正当理由

examples.en: I can see no possible justification for any further tax increases.
examples.zh: 我看不出还能提出什么理由来加税了。

items.def: (rather formal) a false reason that you give for doing something, usually something bad, in order to hide the real reason:
items.zh: 指为掩盖做某事（通常为不好的事）的真正理由而找的借口、托辞

examples.en: He left the party early on the pretext of having to work.
examples.zh: 他借口有事要处理，早早离开了聚会。

senses.def: giving the reasons for something; intended to describe how something works or to make something easier to understand

examples.en: There are explanatory notes at the back of the book.
examples.zh: 书后有注解。

senses.def: a word, especially a rude word, that you use when you are angry, or in pain
senses.zh: （愤怒或痛苦时用的）秽语，咒骂语，感叹语

examples.en: He dropped the book on his foot and muttered several expletives under his breath.
examples.zh: 他把书放在脚上，低声咕哝了几句脏话。

examples.en: ‘Why don't you just [expletive deleted] (= used when you edit out a rude word when reporting what somebody has said)?’
examples.zh: “你为什么不直接[脏话删除]（当你在报告某人所说的话时删除粗鲁的词时使用）？”

senses.def: that can be explained or understood

examples.en: His behaviour is only explicable in terms of (= because of) his recent illness.
examples.zh: 他的行为只能用他最近患病来解释。

senses.def: to explain an idea or a work of literature in a lot of detail
senses.zh: 详细解释，详细分析（想法或文学作品）

examples.en: How can we best explicate ‘King Lear’ and understand it?
examples.zh: 我们怎样才能最好地解释和理解《李尔王》呢？

examples.en: It is impossible to explicate this concept in any meaningful way.
examples.zh: 不可能以任何有意义的方式解释这个概念。

senses.def: a very detailed explanation of an idea or a work of literature
senses.zh: 说明：对一个思想或文学作品的非常详细的解释

examples.en: careful explications of classical texts
examples.zh: 经典文本的仔细解释

senses.def: clear and easy to understand, so that you have no doubt what is meant
senses.zh: 清楚明白的；毫不含糊的

examples.en: He gave me very explicit directions on how to get there.
examples.zh: 他清楚地向我说明了去那儿的路线。

examples.en: The reasons for the decision should be made explicit.
examples.zh: 应该直截了当给出决定的理由。

examples.en: She made some very explicit references to my personal life.
examples.zh: 她毫不隐讳地谈到了我的私生活。

senses.def: saying something clearly, exactly and openly
senses.zh: （说话）清晰的，明确的；直言的；坦率的

examples.en: She was quite explicit about why she had left.
examples.zh: 她对自己离开的原因直言不讳。

senses.def: describing or showing something, especially sexual activity, with a lot of detail
senses.zh: （尤指色情描写或画面）赤裸裸的，露骨的

examples.en: a sexually explicit film
examples.zh: 一部有露骨性爱场面的影片

examples.en: a highly explicit description of torture
examples.zh: 对酷刑的赤裸裸的描述

senses.def: clearly or directly, so that the meaning is easy to understand
senses.zh: 清楚明白地；易于理解地

examples.en: The report states explicitly that the system was to blame.
examples.zh: 报告明确指出问题出在制度上。

examples.en: The text does not explicitly mention him by name.
examples.zh: 文中没有明确提到他的名字。

senses.def: with a lot of detail, especially in describing or showing sexual activity
senses.zh: （尤指色情描写或画面）赤裸裸地，露骨地

examples.en: the explicitly sexual content of the image
examples.zh: 图像中赤裸裸的性内容

senses.def: the quality of stating something clearly or directly, so that the meaning is easy to understand
senses.zh: 明确的：清楚或直接说明某事物的质量，以使含义易于理解

examples.en: The theory has been explained with great clarity and explicitness.
examples.zh: 该理论已得到非常清晰和明确的解释。

senses.def: the fact of describing or showing something, especially sexual activity, with a lot of detail
senses.zh: 露骨：描述或显示某物的事实，尤其是涉及性行为的细节

examples.en: He didn't like the degree of sexual explicitness in the film.
examples.zh: 他不喜欢那部电影里性爱露骨的程度。

senses.def: to burst

examples.en: A second bomb exploded in a crowded market.
examples.zh: 又有一颗炸弹在人员密集的市场里爆炸了。

examples.en: The firework exploded in his hand.
examples.zh: 那个爆竹在他手里响了。

examples.en: Bomb disposal experts exploded the device under controlled conditions.
examples.zh: 拆弹专家对这个爆炸装置实施了可控引爆。

examples.en: There was a huge bang as if someone had exploded a rocket outside.
examples.zh: 突然一声巨响，仿佛有人在外面引爆了火箭似的。

senses.def: to suddenly become very angry or dangerous
senses.zh: 勃然（大怒）；大发（雷霆）；突然发生（危险）

examples.en: Tension between the two sides could explode at any time.
examples.zh: 双方之间的紧张关系随时可能爆发。

examples.en: Suddenly Charles exploded with rage.
examples.zh: 查尔斯勃然大怒。

examples.en: The protest exploded into a riot.
examples.zh: 抗议爆发成一场暴乱。

examples.en: ‘Of course there's something wrong!’ Jem exploded.
examples.zh: “当然是出了毛病！”杰姆大发雷霆道。

senses.group: get angry/dangerous 变得愤怒／危急

senses.def: to suddenly express an emotion

examples.en: We all exploded into wild laughter.
examples.zh: 我们都一下子大笑起来。

senses.def: to suddenly and quickly do something; to move suddenly with a lot of force
senses.zh: 突然做起…来；突然活跃起来

examples.en: After ten minutes the game exploded into life.
examples.zh: 比赛在十分钟后突然激烈起来。

examples.en: He suddenly exploded into action.
examples.zh: 他突然行动起来。

senses.def: to make a sudden very loud noise

examples.en: Thunder exploded overhead.
examples.zh: 雷声在头顶上炸开。

senses.group: make loud noise 发出巨响

senses.def: to increase suddenly and very quickly in number

examples.en: the exploding world population
examples.zh: 迅猛增长的世界人口

senses.def: to show that something is not true, especially something that people believe

examples.en: This study explodes the myth that history graduates mainly become history teachers.
examples.zh: 这项研究打破了历史毕业生主要成为历史教师的神话。

examples.en: The report explodes the theory that there was a conspiracy.
examples.zh: 该报告驳斥了存在阴谋的理论。

senses.group: show something is not true 推翻

synonyms.words: blow up ▪ go off ▪ burst ▪ erupt ▪ detonate

intro.en: These are all words that can be used when something breaks apart violently, causing damage or injury.
intro.zh: 以上各词均可表示爆炸、爆破、爆裂。

items.def: to burst (= to break open or apart) loudly and violently, causing damage; to make something burst in this way:
items.zh: 指爆炸、爆破、爆裂、引爆

examples.en: The jet smashed into a hillside and exploded.
examples.zh: 喷气式飞机撞上山坡爆炸了。

items.def: to be destroyed by an explosion; to destroy something by an explosion:
items.zh: 指爆炸、（被）炸毁

examples.en: A police officer was killed when his car blew up.
examples.zh: 一名警员在其汽车爆炸时遇难。

items.def: (of a bomb) to explode; (of a gun) to be fired:
items.zh: 指（炸弹）爆炸、（枪）开火

examples.en: The bomb went off in a crowded street.
examples.zh: 炸弹在挤满人的大街上爆炸了。

items.def: to break open or apart, especially because of pressure from inside; to make something break in this way:
items.zh: 指（使）爆裂、胀开

examples.en: That balloon’s going to burst.
examples.zh: 那气球马上要爆了。

items.def: (of a volcano) to throw out burning rocks and smoke; (of burning rocks and smoke) to be thrown out of a volcano.
items.zh: 指（火山）爆发、（岩浆、烟）喷出

items.def: (rather formal) (of a bomb) to explode; to make a bomb explode:
items.zh: 指（炸弹）爆炸、使（炸弹）爆炸、引爆、起爆

examples.en: Two other bombs failed to detonate.
examples.zh: 另外两枚炸弹没有爆炸。

senses.def: to treat a person or situation as an opportunity to gain an advantage for yourself

examples.en: He exploited his father's name to get himself a job.
examples.zh: 他利用他父亲的名声为自己找到一份工作。

examples.en: She realized that her youth and inexperience were being exploited.
examples.zh: 她意识到因为自己少不更事而受人利用了。

examples.en: The opposition parties will always exploit government problems to their own advantage.
examples.zh: 反对党总是会利用政府问题为自己谋取利益。

senses.def: to treat somebody unfairly by making them work and not giving them much in return

examples.en: What is being done to stop employers from exploiting young people?
examples.zh: 目前有什么措施制止雇主剥削年轻人呢？

examples.en: The workers are ruthlessly exploited by their employers.
examples.zh: 工人受到雇主残酷的剥削。

senses.def: to use something well in order to gain as much from it as possible

examples.en: She fully exploits the humour of her role in the play.
examples.zh: 她在剧中把她那个角色的幽默发挥得淋漓尽致。

examples.en: The company has been successful in exploiting new technology to the full.
examples.zh: 这家公司在充分利用新技术方面很成功。

senses.def: to develop or use something for business or industry

examples.en: No minerals have yet been exploited in Antarctica.
examples.zh: 南极洲的矿藏还未开采。

examples.en: countries exploiting the rainforests for hardwood
examples.zh: 为获取硬木而开发热带雨林的国家

examples.en: Companies are moving in to exploit the natural resources of the area.
examples.zh: 公司正在进驻以开发该地区的自然资源。

senses.def: a brave, exciting or interesting act
senses.zh: 英勇（或激动人心、引人注目）的行为

examples.en: the daring exploits of Roman heroes
examples.zh: 古罗马英雄的英勇壮举

examples.en: She has wowed everyone with her goalscoring exploits.
examples.zh: 她的进球功绩让所有人惊叹不已。

examples.en: He never liked to talk publicly about his wartime exploits.
examples.zh: 他从不喜欢公开谈论他在战时的功绩。

examples.en: His courage and exploits were legendary.
examples.zh: 他的无畏与英勇事迹是出了名的。

senses.def: a situation in which somebody treats somebody else in an unfair way, especially in order to make money from their work

examples.en: the exploitation of children
examples.zh: 对儿童的剥削

examples.en: Starvation and poverty are the result of global economic exploitation, not lack of resources.
examples.zh: 饥饿和贫困是全球经济剥削的结果，而不是资源缺乏的结果。

senses.def: the use of land, oil, minerals, etc.

examples.en: commercial exploitation of the mineral resources in Antarctica
examples.zh: 南极洲矿物资源的商业开采

senses.def: the fact of using a situation in order to get an advantage for yourself

examples.en: exploitation of the situation for his own purposes
examples.zh: 利用这种局势达到他自己的目的

examples.en: her ruthless exploitation of popular fear
examples.zh: 她无情地利用大众的恐惧心理

senses.def: treating somebody unfairly in order to gain an advantage or to make money

examples.en: an exploitative economic system
examples.zh: 剥削性的经济制度

senses.def: a person who treats people unfairly for his or her own advantage, for example by making them work for very little in return
senses.zh: 剥削者：为了自己的利益而不公平地对待别人的人，例如通过使他们付出很少的回报来

examples.en: ruthless exploiters of children
examples.zh: 对儿童的残酷剥削

senses.def: a person who treats a situation as an opportunity to gain an advantage

examples.en: successful exploiters of media attention
examples.zh: 成功利用媒体注意力的人

senses.def: a person who develops or uses something for business or industry

examples.en: the world's exploiters of fossil fuels
examples.zh: 世界上化石燃料的开采者

senses.def: the act of travelling through a place in order to find out about it or look for something in it

examples.en: Budgets for space exploration have been cut back.
examples.zh: 太空探索的预算被削减了。

examples.en: oil exploration (= searching for oil in the ground)
examples.zh: 石油勘探

examples.en: Lewis and Clark's exploration of the vast uncharted area of the north-west
examples.zh: 刘易斯和克拉克对西北广阔未知地区的探索

senses.def: an examination of something in order to find out about it

examples.en: These findings merit further exploration.
examples.zh: 这些发现值得进一步探讨。

examples.en: the book’s explorations of the human mind
examples.zh: 本书对人类思维的研究

senses.def: done with the intention of examining something in order to find out more about it
senses.zh: 探索的；探究的；探测的；勘探的

examples.en: exploratory surgery
examples.zh: 探索性手术

examples.en: exploratory drilling for oil
examples.zh: 钻井勘探石油

examples.en: an exploratory expedition up the Amazon
examples.zh: 亚马逊探险

examples.en: Exploratory discussions between management and the unions have ended in stalemate.
examples.zh: 管理层和工会之间的探索性讨论以僵局告终。

senses.def: to travel to or around an area or a country in order to learn about it

examples.en: As soon as we arrived on the island we were eager to explore.
examples.zh: 我们一来到岛上就急不可耐地开始探胜。

examples.en: They explored the land to the south of the Murray River.
examples.zh: 他们勘查了墨累河以南的地区。

examples.en: The city is best explored on foot.
examples.zh: 最好是徒步探索这个城市。

examples.en: Westerners did not set out to explore the world until the fifteenth century.
examples.zh: 西方人直到十五世纪才开始探索世界。

examples.en: Bears will sometimes explore urban areas for food.
examples.zh: 熊有时会探索城市地区寻找食物。

examples.en: companies exploring for (= searching for) oil
examples.zh: 石油勘探公司

senses.def: to examine a subject or a possibility completely or carefully in order to find out more about it
senses.zh: 探究；调查研究；探索；探讨

examples.en: to explore a theme/an issue
examples.zh: 探究主题／问题

examples.en: We will explore these ideas in more detail in chapter 7.
examples.zh: 我们将在第 7 章对这些观点作更详细的探讨。

examples.en: to explore the possibilities/options
examples.zh: 研究各种可能性／选项

examples.en: The firm will explore possible joint development projects.
examples.zh: 该公司将探讨有可能联合开发的项目。

examples.en: A team was brought in to explore ways to create the most profit for shareholders.
examples.zh: 引入了一个团队来探索为股东创造最大利润的方法。

examples.en: He intends to explore the relationship between economic class and career choice.
examples.zh: 他打算探讨经济阶层与职业选择之间的关系。

examples.en: a series of programmes in which she explores the world of ballet
examples.zh: 她探索芭蕾世界的一系列节目

senses.def: to feel something with your hands or another part of the body

examples.en: She explored the sand with her toes.
examples.zh: 她用脚趾触探沙子。

senses.def: a person who travels to places where few people have been before or places that are unknown to them, in order to find out more about them

examples.en: Early explorers traded directly with Indigenous people.
examples.zh: 早期的探险家直接与原住民进行贸易。

senses.def: the first US artificial satellite in space. It was sent up on 31 January 1958 from Cape Canaveral
senses.zh: 探索者1：美国第一颗太空人造卫星。它于1958年1月31日由美国陆军从佛罗里达卡纳维拉尔角发射升空。重达30磅/13.5千克的Explorer 1发现了Van Allen辐射带。后来又派出了其他几个探险家来研究太阳的辐射和“风”。

senses.def: a member of the senior branch of the Scout Association
senses.zh: 深资童军，奋进童子军（14 岁至 18 岁）

senses.def: the sudden violent bursting

examples.en: a bomb/nuclear/gas explosion
examples.zh: 炸弹／核／气体爆炸

examples.en: There were two loud explosions and then the building burst into flames.
examples.zh: 两声巨响之后建筑物便燃烧起来。

examples.en: a huge/massive explosion
examples.zh: 大爆炸

examples.en: Bomb Squad officers carried out a controlled explosion of the device.
examples.zh: 炸弹处理小组人员对该爆炸装置实施了可控引爆。

examples.en: Some witnesses said they heard an explosion before the plane hit the ground.
examples.zh: 一些目击者称，他们在飞机落地前听到了爆炸声。

examples.en: The accused denies conspiring to cause an explosion.
examples.zh: 被告否认密谋制造爆炸。

examples.en: 300 people were injured in the explosion.
examples.zh: 有 300 人在爆炸中受伤。

examples.en: a spectacular explosion of fireworks
examples.zh: 壮观的烟花爆炸

senses.def: a large, sudden or rapid increase in the amount or number of something

examples.en: a population explosion
examples.zh: 人口激增

examples.en: an explosion of interest in learning Japanese
examples.zh: 学习日语的兴趣陡然上升

examples.en: an explosion in oil prices
examples.zh: 油价暴涨

senses.def: a sudden, violent expression of emotion, especially anger
senses.zh: （感情，尤指愤怒的）突然爆发，迸发

examples.en: Do you know what brought on that explosion?
examples.zh: 你知道爆炸发生的原因是什么吗？

examples.en: Demonstrators clashed with riot police in an explosion of anger at live animal exports.
examples.zh: 示威者因对活体动物出口的愤怒而与防暴警察发生冲突。

examples.en: The shock waves of this political explosion engulfed the whole of Europe.
examples.zh: 这场政治突变的冲击波袭击了整个欧洲。

senses.def: easily able or likely to explode
senses.zh: 易爆炸的；可能引起爆炸的

examples.en: an explosive device (= a bomb)
examples.zh: 爆炸装置（炸弹）

examples.en: an explosive mixture of chemicals
examples.zh: 易爆化学混合物

examples.en: Hydrogen is highly explosive.
examples.zh: 氢极易爆炸。

senses.def: likely to cause violence or strong feelings of anger or hate
senses.zh: 易爆发的；可能引起冲动的；爆炸性的

examples.en: one of the most explosive issues of our time
examples.zh: 我们这个时代最具爆炸性的问题之一

examples.en: The political situation is potentially explosive.
examples.zh: 政治形势一触即发。

senses.def: often having sudden violent or angry feelings

examples.en: an explosive temper
examples.zh: 暴躁的脾气

senses.def: increasing suddenly and rapidly

examples.en: the explosive growth of the export market
examples.zh: 出口市场的急剧扩大

senses.def: sudden and loud

examples.en: There was an explosive crash and then everything fell silent.
examples.zh: 一声爆炸性的撞击声响起，然后一切都归于沉寂。

senses.def: a substance that is able or likely to cause an explosion

examples.en: plastic explosives
examples.zh: 塑性炸药

examples.en: The bomb was packed with several pounds of high explosive.
examples.zh: 这枚炸弹装有几磅烈性炸药。

senses.def: in a way that involves an explosion
senses.zh: 爆炸性地：以涉及爆炸的方式

examples.en: The compounds react explosively with water.
examples.zh: 该化合物与水发生爆炸性反应。

senses.def: in a way that involves a sudden and rapid increase
senses.zh: 爆炸性地：以一种突然而迅速增加的方式

examples.en: The company has grown explosively over the last two years.
examples.zh: 该公司在过去两年中实现了爆炸性增长。

senses.def: in a way that involves or is likely to cause violence or strong feelings of anger or hate
senses.zh: 易爆发的；可能引起冲动的；爆炸性的

examples.en: a short-tempered and explosively violent gangster
examples.zh: 脾气暴躁、暴力倾向极强的歹徒

examples.en: an explosively subversive message
examples.zh: 具有爆炸性颠覆性的信息

senses.def: in a way that is sudden and loud

examples.en: explosively loud knocking
examples.zh: 爆炸性的敲击声

senses.def: a large exhibition

examples.en: The expo will bring together more than 900 exhibitors from the food industry.
examples.zh: 本届博览会将汇集 900 多家食品行业参展商。

senses.def: a person who supports an idea, theory, etc. and persuades others that it is good
senses.zh: （观点、理论等的）拥护者，鼓吹者，倡导者

examples.en: She was a leading exponent of free trade during her political career.
examples.zh: 她从政期间是自由贸易的主要倡导者。

examples.en: Huxley was an exponent of Darwin’s theory of evolution.
examples.zh: 赫胥黎是达尔文进化论的倡导者。

senses.def: a person who is able to perform a particular activity with skill

examples.en: the most famous exponent of the art of mime
examples.zh: 最著名的哑剧表演艺术大师

examples.en: a leading exponent of the Japanese flute
examples.zh: 日本长笛大师

senses.def: a raised figure or symbol that shows how many times a quantity must be multiplied by itself, for example the figure 4 in a4
of or shown by an exponent

examples.en: 2 4 is an exponential expression.
examples.zh: 24 是个指数式。

examples.en: an exponential curve/function
examples.zh: 指数曲线／函数

senses.def: becoming faster and faster

examples.en: exponential growth/increase
examples.zh: 指数式增长

senses.def: in a way that is connected with or shown by an exponent

examples.en: These time lags are exponentially distributed.
examples.zh: 这些时间滞后呈指数分布。

senses.def: in a way that becomes faster and faster

examples.en: to increase exponentially
examples.zh: 指数式增长

senses.def: the selling and transporting of goods to another country

examples.en: a ban on the export of live cattle
examples.zh: 禁止活牛出口

examples.en: Then the fruit is packaged for export.
examples.zh: 然后水果便包装出口。

examples.en: export earnings/subsidies
examples.zh: 出口收入/补贴

examples.en: an export licence
examples.zh: 出口许可证

examples.en: Their main export market is the United States.
examples.zh: 他们的主要出口市场是美国。

senses.def: a product that is sold to another country

examples.en: the country’s major exports
examples.zh: 该国的主要出口产品

examples.en: a fall in the value of exports
examples.zh: 出口产品值的下跌

examples.en: Oil exports have risen steadily.
examples.zh: 石油出口稳步增长。

examples.en: The country's share of world exports of goods and services was 5.8 per cent.
examples.zh: 该国在世界商品和服务出口中所占的份额为5.8%。

examples.en: Australia wants to increase its agricultural exports to Asia.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚希望增加对亚洲的农产品出口。

examples.en: exports from the United States to the European Union
examples.zh: 美国对欧盟的出口

senses.def: to sell and send goods to another country

examples.en: The islands export sugar and fruit.
examples.zh: 这些岛出口糖和水果。

examples.en: Most US manufacturers both import and export.
examples.zh: 大多数美国制造商既进口又出口。

examples.en: 90 per cent of the engines are exported to Europe.
examples.zh: 90% 的发动机都出口到欧洲。

examples.en: Last year 2 000 birds were exported from the island.
examples.zh: 去年有 2,000 只鸟从这个海岛输出。

senses.def: to introduce an idea or activity to another country or area

examples.en: American pop music has been exported around the world.
examples.zh: 美国流行音乐已传播到世界各地。

senses.def: to send data to another program, changing its form so that the other program can read it
the process of sending goods to another country for sale

examples.en: He was charged with attempted exportation of illegal drugs.
examples.zh: 他被指控企图出口非法毒品。

senses.def: a person, company or country that sells goods to another country
senses.zh: 出口商；出口公司；出口国

examples.en: the world’s largest/major/leading exporter of cars
examples.zh: 世界上最大的／重要的／主要的汽车输出国

examples.en: The country is now a net exporter of fuel (= it exports more than it imports).
examples.zh: 目前这个国家是燃料净输出国。

senses.def: to show something that is usually hidden

examples.en: He smiled suddenly, exposing a set of amazingly white teeth.
examples.zh: 他突然一笑，露出一口雪白的牙齿。

examples.en: Miles of sand are exposed at low tide.
examples.zh: 在低潮时数英里的沙滩就会显现出来。

examples.en: My job as a journalist is to expose the truth.
examples.zh: 我作为记者的职责就是揭露真相。

examples.en: He did not want to expose his fears and insecurity to anyone.
examples.zh: 他不想向任何人显露他的恐惧与不安。

senses.def: to tell the true facts about a person or a situation, and show them/it to be dishonest, illegal, etc.

examples.en: He threatened to expose the racism that existed within the police force.
examples.zh: 他扬言要把警队内部存在的种族歧视公之于众。

examples.en: She was exposed as a liar and a fraud.
examples.zh: 她说谎和欺骗的面目被揭穿了。

senses.def: to put somebody/something in a place or situation where they are not protected from something harmful or unpleasant
senses.zh: 使面临，使遭受（危险或不快）

examples.en: This tactic allowed the rebels to attack without the risk of exposing themselves.
examples.zh: 这一战术使叛军能够在不暴露自己的情况下发动攻击。

examples.en: Children are being exposed to new dangers on the internet.
examples.zh: 儿童正暴露于互联网上前所未有的危险之中。

examples.en: Do not expose babies to strong sunlight.
examples.zh: 不要让婴孩受到强烈的阳光照射。

examples.en: You could be exposing yourself to unnecessary risks when driving alone.
examples.zh: 独自驾驶时您可能会让自己面临不必要的风险。

examples.en: The roof collapsed, exposing the timbers to the elements.
examples.zh: 屋顶倒塌，木材暴露在风中。

senses.group: to something harmful 有害事物

senses.def: to let somebody find out about something by giving them experience of it or showing them what it is like

examples.en: We want to expose the kids to as much art and culture as possible.
examples.zh: 我们想让孩子们尽量受到艺术和文化熏陶。

examples.en: mountain communities that had not been exposed to tourism before
examples.zh: 以前从未接触过旅游业的山区社区

senses.def: to allow light into a camera when taking a photograph
a person who exposes
an account of the facts of a situation, especially when these shock people or have deliberately been kept secret
senses.zh: （尤指对丑闻或隐秘之事的）揭露，曝光

examples.en: a damning exposé of police corruption
examples.zh: 警察腐败的令人震惊的揭露

senses.def: a full explanation of a theory, plan, etc.
senses.zh: （理论、计划等的）解释，说明，阐述

examples.en: a clear and detailed exposition of their legal position
examples.zh: 对他们的法律立场清楚而详尽的说明

senses.def: an event at which people, businesses, etc. show and sell their goods; a trade fair
senses.zh: （产品的）展销；商品交易会；产品博览会

senses.def: intended to explain or describe something
senses.zh: 阐述的；解释的；说明性的

examples.en: The film suffers from too much expository dialogue.
examples.zh: 这部影片的败笔在于论说性对话过多。

senses.def: to argue, disagree or protest about something
the act of arguing, disagreeing or protesting about something; a remark or statement in which somebody argues, disagrees or protests about something
senses.zh: 排泄：争论、不同意或抗议某物的行为;某人就某事争论、不同意或抗议的言论或陈述

senses.def: the state of being in a place or situation where there is no protection from something harmful or unpleasant

examples.en: prolonged exposure to harmful radiation
examples.zh: 长时间接触有害辐射

examples.en: At high exposures, the chemical can affect the liver and kidneys.
examples.zh: 在高暴露量下，该化学物质会影响肝脏和肾脏。

examples.en: the company’s exposure on the foreign exchange markets (= to the risk of making financial losses)
examples.zh: 公司面对外汇市场的风险

senses.group: to something harmful 有害事物

senses.def: the fact of having the true facts about somebody/something told after they have been hidden because they are bad, dishonest or illegal

examples.en: his exposure as a liar and a fraud
examples.zh: 他说谎和欺骗的行径被揭露

examples.en: the exposure of illegal currency deals
examples.zh: 对非法货币交易的揭露

examples.en: full exposure of the links between government officials and the arms trade
examples.zh: 政府官员与军火交易关系的完全揭露

examples.en: There were damaging exposures of the government's own practices.
examples.zh: 政府自身的做法遭到了破坏性的曝光。

senses.def: the fact of being discussed or mentioned on television, in newspapers, etc.
senses.zh: （在电视、报纸等上的）亮相，被报道

examples.en: Her new movie has had a lot of exposure in the media.
examples.zh: 她的新电影媒体有很多报道。

senses.group: on TV/in newspapers, etc. 电视、报章等

senses.def: the fact of experiencing something new or different

examples.en: We try to give our children exposure to other cultures.
examples.zh: 我们努力让孩子体验其他文化。

senses.def: a medical condition caused by being out in very cold weather for too long without protection

examples.en: Two climbers were brought in suffering from exposure.
examples.zh: 两名登山者因冻僵被带了进来。

examples.en: Three of the men died of exposure.
examples.zh: 其中三名男子因暴露而死亡。

senses.def: the length of time for which light is allowed into the camera when taking a photograph

examples.en: I used a long exposure for this one.
examples.zh: 我这张照片用了长曝光。

senses.def: a length of film in a camera that is used to take a photograph
senses.zh: （照一张照片的）软片，底片，胶片

examples.en: There were three exposures left on the roll of film.
examples.zh: 这卷胶卷还有三张没拍。

senses.def: the act of showing something that is usually hidden
a device for measuring the strength of light in a place, so that you can calculate the exposure
to explain something by talking about it in detail

examples.en: He expounded his views on the subject to me at great length.
examples.zh: 他详细地向我阐述了他在这个问题上的观点。

examples.en: the theory of language expounded by Chomsky
examples.zh: 乔姆斯基阐述的语言理论

examples.en: She expounded her theory further in the course of her talk.
examples.zh: 她在发言中进一步详述了她的理论。

examples.en: These ideas were originally expounded by Plato.
examples.zh: 这些思想最初是由柏拉图阐述的。

examples.en: We listened as she expounded on the government's new policies.
examples.zh: 我们听她详细讲解了政府的新政策。

senses.def: to show or make known a feeling, an opinion, etc. by words, looks or actions

examples.en: Teachers have expressed concern about the changes.
examples.zh: 教师对这些变化表示忧虑。

examples.en: to express a view/an opinion
examples.zh: 表达观点／意见

examples.en: to express a hope/desire
examples.zh: 表达希望／愿望

examples.en: to express fears/doubts
examples.zh: 表达恐惧／疑虑

examples.en: Customers expressed interest in trying the product.
examples.zh: 客户表示有兴趣尝试该产品。

examples.en: I'd like to express my gratitude to everyone who helped us.
examples.zh: 我想向所有帮助我们的人表示感谢。

examples.en: Words cannot express how pleased I am.
examples.zh: 言语无法表达我的愉快心情。

senses.def: to speak, write or communicate in some other way what you think or feel

examples.en: Some teenagers have difficulty expressing themselves.
examples.zh: 有些青少年很难表达自己。

examples.en: Perhaps I have not expressed myself very well.
examples.zh: 我大概未把自己的意思表达清楚。

examples.en: She expresses herself most fully in her paintings.
examples.zh: 她把自己的感情在画作中表现得淋漓尽致。

examples.en: He expressed himself freely on the subject of immigration.
examples.zh: 他在移民问题上畅所欲言。

examples.en: They expressed themselves delighted.
examples.zh: 他们表示他们很高兴。

senses.def: to become obvious in a particular way

examples.en: Their pleasure expressed itself in a burst of applause.
examples.zh: 他们的喜悦从一阵热烈的掌声中表现出来。

senses.def: to represent something in a particular way, for example by symbols

examples.en: The figures are expressed as percentages.
examples.zh: 这些数字用百分数表示。

examples.en: Educational expenditure is often expressed in terms of the amount spent per student.
examples.zh: 教育经费通常以用于学生的人均开支表示。

senses.def: to remove air or liquid from something by pressing
senses.zh: 压榨，挤压出（空气或液体）

examples.en: Coconut milk is expressed from grated coconuts.
examples.zh: 椰子汁是从擦碎的椰肉里榨出来的。

senses.def: to send something by express post

examples.en: As soon as I receive payment I will express the book to you.
examples.zh: 我一收到款就把书用快递给你寄去。

senses.def: travelling very fast; operating very quickly

examples.en: an express bus/coach/train
examples.zh: 特快公共汽车／长途汽车／列车

examples.en: express delivery services
examples.zh: 快递服务

senses.def: sent by express

examples.en: express mail
examples.zh: 特快邮件

senses.def: providing an express

examples.en: an air express company
examples.zh: 航空快递公司

senses.def: clearly and openly stated

examples.en: It was his express wish that you should have his gold watch after he died.
examples.zh: 他明确表示死后把金表留给你。

examples.en: I came here with the express purpose of speaking with the manager.
examples.zh: 我特意来这里与经理面谈。

senses.def: using a special fast service

examples.en: I'd like to send this express, please.
examples.zh: 劳驾，我要寄快递。

senses.def: a fast train that does not stop at many places

examples.en: the 8.27 express to Edinburgh
examples.zh: 8:27 开往爱丁堡的特快列车

examples.en: the Gatwick Express
examples.zh: 盖特威克快车

senses.def: a service for sending or transporting things quickly
senses.zh: 快件服务；快递服务；快运服务

senses.def: part of a road on which certain vehicles can travel faster because there is less traffic
a place in a shop where customers can pay without having to wait for a long time
senses.zh: （购物场所收银结账的）快速通道

examples.en: Customers with ten items or less can use the express lane.
examples.zh: 购买十件以内商品的顾客可使用快速购物通道。

senses.def: a word or phrase

examples.en: What's the meaning of the expression ‘on cloud nine’?
examples.zh: on cloud nine 这个表达是什么意思？

examples.en: She uses a lot of slang expressions that I've never heard before.
examples.zh: 她使用了很多我以前从未听过的俚语。

examples.en: Keep a list of useful words and expressions.
examples.zh: 保留一份常用单词和短语表。

examples.en: He's a pain in the butt, if you'll pardon the expression.
examples.zh: 请原谅我这么说，他是一个讨厌透顶的家伙。

senses.def: things that people say, write or do in order to show their feelings, opinions and ideas

examples.en: Freedom of expression (= freedom to say what you think) is a basic human right.
examples.zh: 言论自由是基本的人权。

examples.en: The poet's anger finds expression in (= is shown in) the last verse of the poem.
examples.zh: 诗人的愤怒在诗的最后一节表达出来。

examples.en: Only in his dreams does he give expression to his fears.
examples.zh: 只有在梦里他的恐惧才能得以表露。

examples.en: He describes drawing as a very personal form of artistic expression.
examples.zh: 他把绘画描述为一种非常个人化的艺术表达。

examples.en: Words, as a means of expression, can be limiting.
examples.zh: 言语作为一种表达方式有时是有限的。

examples.en: the expression of emotion/feelings
examples.zh: 情感的表达

examples.en: expressions of concern/sympathy/support
examples.zh: 表示关切／同情／支持

examples.en: We are calling for expressions of interest from people wanting to take part in the project.
examples.zh: 我们呼吁希望参与该项目的人们表现出兴趣。

examples.en: laws which aim to restrict free expression of opinion
examples.zh: 旨在限制言论自由的法律

senses.group: showing feelings/ideas 表达感情／思想

senses.def: a look on a person’s face that shows their thoughts or feelings

examples.en: The actors' gestures and facial expressions are perfect.
examples.zh: 演员的动作和面部表情都很完美。

examples.en: He had a pained expression on his face.
examples.zh: 他脸上露出了痛苦的表情。

examples.en: The blank expression in her eyes showed that she hadn't understood.
examples.zh: 她茫然的眼神表明她没有明白。

examples.en: He looked down at the tiny child and his expression softened.
examples.zh: 他低头看着小孩子，神色柔和了一些。

examples.en: His expression changed from surprise to one of amusement.
examples.zh: 他的神情由惊变喜。

examples.en: Her expression betrayed nothing of her thoughts.
examples.zh: 从她的表情一点也看不出她的想法。

examples.en: She wore an expression of anger.
examples.zh: 她面带愠色。

senses.def: a strong show of feeling when you are playing music, speaking, acting, etc.
senses.zh: （演奏乐曲、说话、表演等时流露的）感情，表情

examples.en: Try to put a little more expression into it!
examples.zh: 尽量注入更多的感情！

examples.en: She plays the violin with great expression.
examples.zh: 她的小提琴演奏很有表现力。

senses.def: a group of signs that represent an idea or a quantity

intro.en: These are all words for a unit of language used to express something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均为表达意思的语言单位。

items.def: a single unit of language that means something and can be spoken or written:
items.zh: 单词；词；字

examples.en: Do not write more than 200 words.
examples.zh: 写的东西不要超过 200 字。

items.def: (rather formal) a word or phrase used as the name of something, especially one connected with a particular type of language:
items.zh: 指词语、术语、措辞

examples.en: technical/​legal/​scientific terms
examples.zh: 专门／法律／科学用语

items.def: a group of words that have a particular meaning when used together:
items.zh: 指短语、词组、惯用法

examples.en: Who coined the phrase ‘fake news’?
examples.zh: 谁创造了 fake news（假新闻）这个词语？

items.def: a word or phrase:
items.zh: 指词语、措辞、表达方式

examples.en: He tends to use a lot of slang expressions that I’ve never heard before.
examples.zh: 他往往用许多我以前从未听说过的俚语。

items.def: a group of words whose meaning is different from the meanings of the individual words:
items.zh: 指习语、成语、惯用语

examples.en: ‘Let the cat out of the bag’ is an idiom meaning to tell a secret by mistake.
examples.zh: let the cat out of the bag（让猫从袋子里跑出来）为成语，意为无意中泄露秘密。

senses.def: a word or phrase written on a piece of music to show what kind of expression or feeling the performer should give to it
senses.zh: 表达标记：写在一段音乐上的词或短语，用以表明表演者应给予的表达或感觉

senses.def: a style and movement in early 20th century art, theatre, cinema and music that tries to express people’s feelings and emotions rather than showing events or objects in a realistic way
in the style of expressionism
senses.zh: 表现主义：以20世纪初期的艺术，戏剧，电影院和音乐形式的表现主义；以这种风格工作

examples.en: expressionist paintings
examples.zh: 表现主义绘画

examples.en: Expressionist painters
examples.zh: 表现主义画家

senses.def: an artist, writer, musician, etc. who worked in the style of expressionism
senses.zh: 表现主义：艺术家，作家，音乐家等，在20世纪初期的艺术，戏剧，电影和音乐中以表现主义的风格工作

senses.def: not showing feelings, thoughts, etc.

examples.en: an expressionless face/tone/voice
examples.zh: 呆板的面孔／声调／声音

senses.def: showing or able to show your thoughts and feelings
senses.zh: 富于表情的；有表现力的；意味深长的

examples.en: She has wonderfully expressive eyes.
examples.zh: 她有一双会说话的眼睛。

examples.en: the expressive power of his music
examples.zh: 他的音乐的表现力

senses.def: showing something; existing as an expression of something

examples.en: Every word and gesture is expressive of the artist's sincerity.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家的真诚从一言一行中表现出来。

senses.def: in a way that shows your thoughts and feelings
senses.zh: 富于表情的；有表现力的；意味深长的

examples.en: He raised his eyebrows expressively.
examples.zh: 他表情丰富地扬起了眉毛。

senses.def: the quality of expressing somebody's thoughts and feelings
senses.zh: 表现力：表达某人的思想和感受的质量

examples.en: the poetic expressiveness of the sonata
examples.zh: 奏鸣曲的诗意表现力

senses.def: clearly; definitely

examples.en: She was expressly forbidden to touch my papers.
examples.zh: 已经明确禁止她动我的文件。

senses.def: for a special and deliberate purpose

examples.en: The rule was introduced expressly for this purpose.
examples.zh: 这项规则是为此特意设置的。

senses.def: a wide road that allows traffic to travel fast through a city or other area where many people live

examples.en: a major accident on the expressway
examples.zh: 高速公路上的严重车祸。

senses.def: to officially take away private property from its owner for public use
to take somebody’s property and use it without permission
the act of officially taking away private property from its owner for use by the government

examples.en: Expropriation of the land was approved.
examples.zh: 征用土地已获批准。

senses.def: the act of taking something that belongs to somebody and using it without permission
senses.zh: 征用：取走属于某人的东西并未经允许而使用的行为

examples.en: the expropriation of resources from overseas colonies
examples.zh: 征用海外殖民地的资源

senses.def: the act of forcing somebody to leave a place; the act of expelling

examples.en: These events led to the expulsion of senior diplomats from the country.
examples.zh: 这些事件导致一些高级外交官被驱逐出境。

examples.en: Troops are engaged in the expulsion of enemy forces from the area.
examples.zh: 部队正在将敌军驱逐出该地区。

senses.def: the act of sending somebody away from a school or an organization, so that they can no longer belong to it; the act of expelling

examples.en: The headteacher threatened the three girls with expulsion.
examples.zh: 校长以开除来威胁这三名女学生。

examples.en: The club faces expulsion from the football league.
examples.zh: 这家俱乐部面临被足协开除。

senses.def: the act of sending or driving a substance out of your body or a container

examples.en: the expulsion of air from the lungs
examples.zh: 从肺中排出空气。

senses.def: to remove or get rid of something, such as a name, piece of information or a memory, from a book or list, or from your mind

examples.en: Details of his criminal activities were expunged from the file.
examples.zh: 他犯罪活动的详细情况已从档案中删去。

examples.en: What happened just before the accident was expunged from his memory.
examples.zh: 事故前一刻发生的事他都记不得了。

examples.en: She sought to expunge every trace of the event from her memory.
examples.zh: 她试图从记忆中抹去这件事的所有痕迹。

examples.en: The word ‘socialism’ has been expunged from the party’s manifesto.
examples.zh: “社会主义”一词已从党的宣言中删除。

senses.def: to remove or leave out parts of a piece of writing or a conversation when printing or reporting it, because you think those parts could offend people
senses.zh: 删除…中的不当之处；略去…中的不雅之处

examples.en: She gave an expurgated account of what had happened.
examples.zh: 她对所发生的事情进行了删节性的叙述。

senses.def: extremely beautiful or carefully made

examples.en: exquisite craftsmanship
examples.zh: 精美的工艺

examples.en: Her wedding dress was absolutely exquisite.
examples.zh: 她的婚纱绝对是精致的。

senses.def: strongly felt

examples.en: exquisite pain/pleasure
examples.zh: 剧烈的疼痛；极大的快乐

senses.def: very sensitive
senses.zh: 微妙的；雅致的；敏锐的；敏感的

examples.en: The room was decorated in exquisite taste.
examples.zh: 这个房间的装饰情趣高雅。

examples.en: an exquisite sense of timing
examples.zh: 时间安排上恰到好处的感觉

senses.def: in a way that is extremely beautiful or carefully made

examples.en: an exquisitely crafted glass sculpture
examples.zh: 制作精美的玻璃雕塑

senses.def: in a way that is very strongly felt

examples.en: Even light pressure was exquisitely painful.
examples.zh: 即使是轻微的压力也会带来剧烈的疼痛。

senses.def: in way that is very sensitive

examples.en: an exquisitely refined auditory sense
examples.zh: 精致细腻的听觉

senses.def: (used as part of a phone number) extension
senses.zh: （用于电话号码）电话分机线，分机号码

examples.en: Ext. 4299
examples.zh: 分机号码 4299

senses.def: still in existence

examples.en: extant remains of the ancient wall
examples.zh: 尚存的古城墙遗迹

examples.en: A limited number of documents from the period are still extant.
examples.zh: 这一时期的少量文件仍然存在。

senses.def: spoken or done without planning or preparation
senses.zh: 即席的：不经计划或准备就说或做的即兴

examples.en: extemporaneous speaking
examples.zh: 即席演讲

senses.def: spoken or done without any previous thought or preparation
senses.zh: （讲话或行动）即兴的，无准备的

examples.en: an extempore speech
examples.zh: 即席讲话

senses.def: without any previous thought or preparation
senses.zh: 即席的；即兴的；无准备的

examples.en: to speak/play extempore
examples.zh: 即兴演讲/演奏

senses.def: the act of speaking or performing without preparing or practising
to speak or perform without preparing or practising

examples.en: She extemporized at the piano.
examples.zh: 她即兴弹奏钢琴。

examples.en: The King then asked Bach to extemporize a six-part fugue.
examples.zh: 国王随后要求巴赫即兴创作一首六声部赋格曲。

senses.def: to make something longer or larger

examples.en: to extend a fence/road/house
examples.zh: 扩建护栏／公路／房子

examples.en: There are plans to extend the children's play area.
examples.zh: 现已有扩大儿童游乐区的计划。

examples.en: The Democratic candidate extended her early lead in the polls.
examples.zh: 民主党候选人扩大了她在民调中早先确立的领先优势。

senses.group: make longer/larger/wider 延长；扩大；扩展

senses.def: to make something last longer

examples.en: to extend a deadline/visa
examples.zh: 延长最后期限／签证

examples.en: Careful maintenance can extend the life of your car.
examples.zh: 精心保养可延长汽车寿命。

examples.en: The show has been extended for another six weeks.
examples.zh: 展览会又延长了六周。

examples.en: The proposal was to extend paid leave to six months.
examples.zh: 该提案是将带薪休假延长至六个月。

examples.en: Contracts were gradually extended from the initial single year.
examples.zh: 合同从最初的一年开始逐渐延长。

examples.en: The repayment period will be extended from 20 years to 25 years.
examples.zh: 还款期限将从 20 年延长到 25 年。

senses.group: make longer/larger/wider 延长；扩大；扩展

senses.def: to make a business, an idea, an influence, etc. cover more areas or operate in more places

examples.en: The school is extending the range of subjects taught.
examples.zh: 学校正在拓宽授课学科的范围。

examples.en: a terrorist organization intent on extending its reach
examples.zh: 意图扩大其影响范围的恐怖组织

examples.en: The service will soon be extended to other areas of the UK.
examples.zh: 该服务很快将扩展到英国其他地区。

examples.en: The company plans to extend its operations into Europe.
examples.zh: 公司打算将业务扩展到欧洲。

senses.group: make longer/larger/wider 延长；扩大；扩展

senses.def: to relate to or include somebody/something

examples.en: The offer does not extend to employees' partners.
examples.zh: 这项优惠不包括雇员的伴侣。

examples.en: His willingness to help did not extend beyond making a few phone calls.
examples.zh: 他帮助的诚意只限于打几个电话罢了。

senses.def: to cover a particular area, distance or length of time
senses.zh: 涉及（范围）；延伸（距离）；延续（时间）

examples.en: Our land extends as far as the river.
examples.zh: 我们的土地一直延伸到河边。

examples.en: His writing career extended over a period of 40 years.
examples.zh: 他的写作生涯超过了 40 年。

examples.en: The wood does not extend very far.
examples.zh: 木头并没有延伸很远。

examples.en: The country's power extends far beyond its military capabilities.
examples.zh: 该国国力远远大于其军事力量。

senses.group: cover area/time/distance 涉及范围／时间／距离

senses.def: to make something reach something or stretch

examples.en: to extend a rope between two posts
examples.zh: 在两根柱子间拉根绳子

senses.group: cover area/time/distance 涉及范围／时间／距离

senses.def: to stretch part of your body, especially an arm or a leg, away from yourself
senses.zh: 伸展，舒展，展开（尤指手臂或腿）

examples.en: He extended his hand to (= offered to shake hands with) the new employee.
examples.zh: 他伸出手来与新雇员握手。

examples.en: to extend the hand of friendship to (= try to have good relations with) another country
examples.zh: 向另一个国家伸出友谊之手

senses.group: part of body 身体部位

senses.def: to offer or give something to somebody

examples.en: I'm sure you will join me in extending a very warm welcome to our visitors.
examples.zh: 我肯定你们会同我一起向来访者表示热烈的欢迎。

examples.en: to extend your sympathy/congratulations/thanks to somebody
examples.zh: 向某人表示同情／祝贺／感谢

examples.en: to extend hospitality to overseas students
examples.zh: 殷勤款待外国留学生

examples.en: The bank refused to extend credit to them (= to lend them money).
examples.zh: 银行拒绝向他们提供信贷。

examples.en: to extend somebody an invitation
examples.zh: 向某人发出邀请

senses.def: to make somebody/something use all their effort, abilities, supplies, etc.

examples.en: Jim didn't really have to extend himself in the exam.
examples.zh: 吉姆大可不必为这次考试那么拼命。

examples.en: Hospitals were already fully extended because of the epidemic.
examples.zh: 这场流行病已使各医院超负荷运转。

senses.def: that can be made longer, or made legally acceptable for a longer time
senses.zh: 可延长的；可延伸的；可延期的

examples.en: an extendable ladder
examples.zh: 伸缩梯

examples.en: The visa is for 14 days, extendable to one month.
examples.zh: 此签证有效期为 14 天，可延期到一个月。

senses.def: a family group with a close relationship among the members that includes not only parents and children but also uncles, aunts, grandparents, etc.
senses.zh: 大家庭（几代同堂的家庭）

examples.en: She grew up surrounded by a large extended family.
examples.zh: 她在一个大家族中长大。

examples.en: It was difficult to maintain contact with members of his extended family.
examples.zh: 与他的大家庭成员保持联系很困难。

examples.en: My whole extended family gets/get together in the holidays.
examples.zh: 我的整个大家庭在假期里聚在一起。

senses.def: the act of increasing the area of activity, group of people, etc. that is affected by something

examples.en: the extension of new technology into healthcare
examples.zh: 将新技术扩展到医疗保健领域

examples.en: a gradual extension of the powers of central government
examples.zh: 中央政府权力的逐渐扩大

examples.en: The bank plans various extensions to its credit facilities.
examples.zh: 银行计划多方面扩展信贷服务。

examples.en: My home life was becoming no more than an extension of my job.
examples.zh: 我的家庭生活只不过是我工作的延伸。

senses.def: a new room or rooms that are added to a house

examples.en: They're building an extension to their house.
examples.zh: 他们正在扩建自家的房屋。

senses.def: a new part that is added to a building

examples.en: a planned two-storey extension to the hospital
examples.zh: 计划在医院增建一栋两层的楼

senses.def: an extra period of time allowed for something
senses.zh: 延期；延长期；放宽的期限

examples.en: He's been granted an extension of the contract for another year.
examples.zh: 他的合同获得延期一年。

examples.en: a visa extension
examples.zh: 延长签证

examples.en: She was given an extension to finish writing her thesis.
examples.zh: 她获准延期完成论文。

examples.en: The pub had an extension (= was allowed to stay open longer) on Christmas Eve.
examples.zh: 这家酒吧已获准在圣诞前夕延长营业时间。

senses.def: a phone line with its own number, connected to a switchboard

examples.en: What's your extension number?
examples.zh: 你的分机号码是多少？

examples.en: Can I have extension 4332 please?
examples.zh: 请接 4332 号分机。

examples.en: I'll give you my extension number, so you can phone me directly.
examples.zh: 我会给你我的分机号码，这样你就可以直接给我打电话。

senses.def: the act of making something longer or larger; the thing that is made longer and larger
senses.zh: 延长；扩大；延长（或扩大）的事物

examples.en: The extension of the subway will take several months.
examples.zh: 扩建地铁需用几个月时间。

examples.en: extensions to the original railway track
examples.zh: 原有铁路线的若干延伸路线

senses.group: making something longer/larger 延伸；扩大

senses.def: pieces of artificial hair that are added to somebody's own hair to make it longer

examples.en: These extensions are very easy to use and won't damage your own hair.
examples.zh: 这些接发器非常易于使用，不会损坏您自己的头发。

senses.def: a part of a college or university that offers courses to students who are not studying full-time
senses.zh: （为非全日制学生开设的）进修部，进修课

examples.en: La Salle Extension University
examples.zh: 拉萨尔大学进修部

examples.en: extension courses
examples.zh: 大学进修课程

senses.def: the set of three letters that are placed after the dot

examples.en: The extension .doc indicates a word-processing file.
examples.zh: 扩展名 .doc 表示文字处理文件。

senses.def: an extra length of electric wire, used when the wire on an electrical device is not long enough
senses.zh: 接长线路，延长线（电器上的电线加长部分）

senses.def: taking the argument or situation one stage further

examples.en: The blame lies with the teachers and, by extension, with the Education Service.
examples.zh: 应受指责的是教师，再则就是教育机构。

senses.def: taking the argument or situation one stage further

examples.en: The blame lies with the teachers and, by extension, with the Education Service.
examples.zh: 应受指责的是教师，再则就是教育机构。

senses.def: (in the US) a person who works for a state university in a country area, and whose job is to give advice to farmers, do research into farming, etc.
senses.zh: （美国州立大学乡村的）农业技术推广研究员

senses.def: an extra length of electric wire, used when the wire on an electrical device is not long enough
senses.zh: 接长线路，延长线（电器上的电线加长部分）

examples.en: We'll have to use an extension lead.
examples.zh: 我们得用延长线。

senses.def: covering a large area; great in amount

examples.en: The house has extensive grounds.
examples.zh: 这栋房子有宽敞的庭院。

examples.en: The fire caused extensive damage.
examples.zh: 火灾造成了巨大的损失。

examples.en: She suffered extensive injuries in the accident.
examples.zh: 她在事故中受了重伤。

examples.en: Extensive repair work is being carried out.
examples.zh: 大规模的修缮工作正在进行。

examples.en: an extensive range of wines
examples.zh: 各种各样的葡萄酒

examples.en: The book includes an extensive bibliography of books and articles.
examples.zh: 本书包含大量书籍和文章的参考书目。

senses.def: including or dealing with a wide range of information

examples.en: Extensive research has been done into this disease.
examples.zh: 对这种疾病已进行了广泛研究。

examples.en: His knowledge of music is extensive.
examples.zh: 他音乐知识很广博。

examples.en: She has extensive experience in computers.
examples.zh: 她在计算机方面经验丰富。

senses.def: in a way that covers a large area

examples.en: She has travelled extensively.
examples.zh: 她游历甚广。

senses.def: in a way that includes or deals with a wide range of information

examples.en: He has written extensively on contemporary art.
examples.zh: 他有大量关于现代艺术的著述。

senses.def: to a large degree; a great amount

examples.en: a spice used extensively in Eastern cooking
examples.zh: 东方烹饪中广泛使用的一种香料

senses.def: a muscle that allows you to make part of your body straight or stretched out
how large, important, serious, etc. something is

examples.en: It is difficult to assess the full extent of the damage.
examples.zh: 损失情况难以全面估计。

examples.en: She was exaggerating the true extent of the problem.
examples.zh: 她夸大了问题的严重性。

examples.en: They have launched an investigation to determine the extent of police misconduct in this case.
examples.zh: 他们已展开调查，以确定警方在此案中不当行为的程度。

examples.en: We don't know the extent of his injuries at this point.
examples.zh: 目前我们还不清楚他的伤势如何。

examples.en: I was amazed at the extent of his knowledge.
examples.zh: 他知识之渊博令我惊奇。

senses.def: the physical size of an area

examples.en: You can't see the full extent of the beach from here.
examples.zh: 从这儿不能看到海滩全貌。

examples.en: The island is 300 square kilometres in extent.
examples.zh: 该岛面积 300 平方公里。

senses.def: used to show how far something is true or how great an effect it has

examples.en: To a certain extent, we are all responsible for this tragic situation.
examples.zh: 我们都在一定程度上对这悲惨的局面负有责任。

examples.en: He had changed to such an extent (= so much) that I no longer recognized him.
examples.zh: 他变得我简直认不出了。

examples.en: To some extent what she argues is true.
examples.zh: 她的论证在某种程度上是符合事实的。

examples.en: The pollution of the forest has seriously affected plant life and, to a lesser extent, wildlife.
examples.zh: 森林污染严重影响了植物的生存，其次也对野生动物造成了影响。

examples.en: To what extent is this true of all schools?
examples.zh: 这在多大程度上符合所有学校的实际情况？

examples.en: The book discusses the extent to which (= how much) family life has changed over the past 50 years.
examples.zh: 本书论述了近 50 年来家庭生活的变化程度。

senses.def: used to show how far something is true or how great an effect it has

examples.en: To a certain extent, we are all responsible for this tragic situation.
examples.zh: 我们都在一定程度上对这悲惨的局面负有责任。

examples.en: He had changed to such an extent (= so much) that I no longer recognized him.
examples.zh: 他变得我简直认不出了。

examples.en: To some extent what she argues is true.
examples.zh: 她的论证在某种程度上是符合事实的。

examples.en: The pollution of the forest has seriously affected plant life and, to a lesser extent, wildlife.
examples.zh: 森林污染严重影响了植物的生存，其次也对野生动物造成了影响。

examples.en: To what extent is this true of all schools?
examples.zh: 这在多大程度上符合所有学校的实际情况？

examples.en: The book discusses the extent to which (= how much) family life has changed over the past 50 years.
examples.zh: 本书论述了近 50 年来家庭生活的变化程度。

senses.def: showing reasons why a wrong or illegal act, or a bad situation, should be judged less seriously or excused

examples.en: There were extenuating circumstances and the defendant did not receive a prison sentence.
examples.zh: 因为有可减轻罪行的情节，所以被告未被判刑。

examples.en: Cases of illness and other extenuating circumstances that may have affected a student’s performance will be dealt with by a personal tutor.
examples.zh: 可能影响学生表现的疾病和其他情有可原的情况将由私人导师处理。

senses.def: the outside of something, especially a building
senses.zh: （尤指建筑物的）外部，外观，表面，外貌

examples.en: The exterior of the house needs painting.
examples.zh: 房子外墙需要油漆。

senses.def: the way that somebody appears or behaves, especially when this is very different from their real feelings or character

examples.en: Beneath his confident exterior, he was desperately nervous.
examples.zh: 他表面上自信，内心极度紧张。

senses.def: on the outside of something; done or happening outdoors
senses.zh: 外面的；外部的；外表的；户外的

examples.en: exterior walls/surfaces
examples.zh: 外墙；外层表面

examples.en: The filming of the exterior scenes was done on the moors.
examples.zh: 外景是在高沼地拍摄的。

examples.en: The exterior lights of the house came on as I approached the door.
examples.zh: 当我走近门口时，房子的外部灯亮了。

senses.def: an angle formed between the side of a shape and the side next to it, when this side is made longer
to kill all the members of a group of people or animals

examples.en: Fur seals were nearly exterminated a few years ago.
examples.zh: 几年前，海狗几乎灭绝。

senses.def: the act of killing all the members of a group of people or animals

examples.en: the extermination of rats and other vermin
examples.zh: 消灭老鼠和其他有害动物

examples.en: The sheer scale of these mass exterminations is horrifying.
examples.zh: 这些大规模灭绝的规模之大令人震惊。

senses.def: a person whose job is to kill particular types of insects and small animals that are not wanted in a building

examples.en: We had mice in our house and had to hire an exterminator.
examples.zh: 我们家有老鼠，不得不请来专业灭鼠人处理。

senses.def: a person who works in an institution but does not live there, especially a doctor or other worker in a hospital
senses.zh: 不住机构内的工作人员；（尤指）非住院医生，非住院的医院员工

senses.def: to order somebody to leave a region or district as a punishment

examples.en: The police have drawn up plans to extern notorious criminals from the city.
examples.zh: 警方已制定计划，将臭名昭著的罪犯逐出该市。

senses.def: connected with or located on the outside of something/somebody

examples.en: the external walls of the building
examples.zh: 建筑物的外墙

examples.en: The lotion is for external use only (= only for the skin and must not be eaten).
examples.zh: 此洗剂仅限外用。

senses.def: happening or coming from outside a place, an organization, your particular situation, etc.

examples.en: A combination of internal and external factors caused the company to close down.
examples.zh: 内外因结合导致了公司的倒闭。

examples.en: external pressures on the economy
examples.zh: 外部因素对经济的压力

examples.en: our perception of the external world
examples.zh: 我们对外部世界的感知

examples.en: Many external influences can affect your state of mind.
examples.zh: 许多外在因素都可能影响人的心情。

examples.en: The information has come from reliable sources external to the government.
examples.zh: 这些信息来自政府之外的可靠来源。

senses.def: coming from or arranged by somebody from outside a school, a university or an organization
senses.zh: 来自（学校或机构）以外的；外来的

examples.en: external examiners/assessors
examples.zh: 校外主考人／评定人

examples.en: An external auditor will verify the accounts.
examples.zh: 外部审计员将核实这些账目。

senses.def: connected with foreign countries

examples.en: The government is committed to reducing the country's external debt.
examples.zh: 政府决心减少国家的外债。

examples.en: the Minister of State for External Affairs
examples.zh: 外交大臣

examples.en: The country was promised military aid in the case of external threat.
examples.zh: 该国已得到承诺，在有外敌威胁时会获得军事援助。

senses.def: the parts of the ear outside the eardrum
a consequence of an industrial or commercial activity that affects other people or things without this being reflected in market prices
senses.zh: 外部性，界外效应（工商业活动所产生的影响，但不通过市场价格反映）

examples.en: Pollution is a negative externality that imposes a cost—reduced happiness—on the victims.
examples.zh: 污染是一种负面外部效应，使部分人的幸福被牺牲而成为受害者。

senses.def: the fact of existing outside the person or thing that is aware of it

examples.en: man’s externality to an indifferent natural world
examples.zh: 相对于冷漠自然界的人类外在性

senses.def: the act of showing what you are thinking or feeling by what you say or do
senses.zh: （以言行）表达；使（思想、感情）表露出来

senses.def: to show what you are thinking and feeling by what you say or do
senses.zh: （以言行）表达；使（思想、感情）表露出来

examples.en: His worries about losing his job were externalized in angry outbursts at home.
examples.zh: 他对失去工作的担忧在家里的愤怒爆发中得到了体现。

senses.def: on the outside of something/somebody

examples.en: The building has been restored externally and internally.
examples.zh: 大楼内外均整修一新。

examples.en: The medication is to be applied externally.
examples.zh: 药物是外用的。

senses.def: in a way that happens or comes from outside a place, an organization, a particular situation, etc.

examples.en: The university has many externally funded research projects.
examples.zh: 这所大学有许多外界资助的研究项目。

examples.en: externally imposed constraints
examples.zh: 外部施加的约束

senses.def: the outer appearance of something

examples.en: It would be easy to judge this situation by externals alone.
examples.zh: 仅凭外部因素就很容易判断这种情况。

senses.def: no longer in existence
senses.zh: 不再存在的；已灭绝的；绝种的

examples.en: an extinct species
examples.zh: 已灭绝的物种

examples.en: to become extinct
examples.zh: 绝种

examples.en: The red squirrel is in danger of becoming extinct in England.
examples.zh: 英格兰的红松鼠正面临灭绝的危险。

examples.en: the fossilised remains of extinct animals
examples.zh: 已灭绝动物的化石遗骸

examples.en: The numbers of these animals have been falling steadily and they are now almost extinct.
examples.zh: 这些动物数量持续下降，现在几近灭绝。

examples.en: The species was presumed extinct.
examples.zh: 这一物种据推定已绝种。

senses.def: no longer in existence in society
senses.zh: 绝迹的；消亡了的；废除了的

examples.en: Servants are now almost extinct in modern society.
examples.zh: 在现代社会里奴仆已近乎不复存在。

senses.def: no longer active
a situation in which a plant, an animal, a way of life, etc. stops existing
senses.zh: （植物、动物、生活方式等的）灭绝，绝种，消亡

examples.en: a tribe threatened with extinction/in danger of extinction
examples.zh: 面临消亡威胁／有消亡危险的部落

examples.en: The island's way of life is doomed to extinction.
examples.zh: 这个岛上的生活方式注定要消失。

examples.en: The mountain gorilla is on the verge of extinction.
examples.zh: 山地大猩猩已濒临灭绝。

examples.en: We know of several mass extinctions in the earth's history.
examples.zh: 我们知道地球历史上出现过几次大规模的灭绝。

examples.en: a campaign to save wild koalas from extinction
examples.zh: 拯救野生考拉免遭灭绝的运动

examples.en: Will technology in music drive creativity to extinction?
examples.zh: 音乐技术会导致创造力灭绝吗？

examples.en: The dormouse in Britain may face extinction if ancient woodland continues to disappear.
examples.zh: 如果古老的林地继续消失，英国的睡鼠可能面临灭绝。

examples.en: A comet colliding with the earth may have caused the mass extinction of the dinosaurs.
examples.zh: 彗星与地球相撞可能导致了恐龙的大规模灭绝。

senses.def: to make a fire stop burning or a light stop shining

examples.en: Firefighters tried to extinguish the flames.
examples.zh: 消防队员奋力救火。

examples.en: All lights had been extinguished.
examples.zh: 所有灯光都熄灭了。

senses.def: to destroy something

examples.en: News of the bombing extinguished all hope of peace.
examples.zh: 轰炸的消息使和平的希望全部破灭。

senses.def: a metal container with water or chemicals inside for putting out small fires
to destroy or get rid of something that is bad or not wanted
senses.zh: 消灭，根除，除掉（坏的或不需要的事物）

senses.def: the act of destroying or getting rid of something that is bad or not wanted
senses.zh: 消灭，根除，除掉（坏的或不需要的事物）

senses.def: to praise somebody/something very much

examples.en: Doctors often extol the virtues of eating less fat.
examples.zh: 医生常常宣扬少吃脂肪的好处。

examples.en: She was extolled as a genius.
examples.zh: 她被誉为天才。

senses.def: to make somebody give you something by threatening them

examples.en: The gang extorted money from over 30 local businesses.
examples.zh: 这帮歹徒向当地 30 多家企业勒索过钱财。

senses.def: the crime of making somebody give you something by threatening them

examples.en: He was arrested and charged with extortion.
examples.zh: 他被逮捕并被指控犯了敲诈勒索罪。

senses.def: much too high

examples.en: They are offering loans at extortionate rates of interest.
examples.zh: 他们在放高利贷。

examples.en: The prices they charge are extortionate.
examples.zh: 他们要价太高了。

senses.def: in a way that is much too expensive

examples.en: extortionately priced
examples.zh: 贵得离谱

senses.def: more than is usual, expected, or than exists already
senses.zh: 额外的；分外的；外加的；附加的

examples.en: extra money/cash/funding
examples.zh: 额外的钱／现金／资金

examples.en: Breakfast is provided at no extra charge.
examples.zh: 供应早餐，不另收费。

examples.en: The rate for a room is £60, but breakfast is extra.
examples.zh: 一个房间收费 60 英镑，早餐费另计。

examples.en: plans to offer increased broadband speeds at no extra cost
examples.zh: 计划免费提供更高的宽带速度

examples.en: Employees are expected to put in extra hours without pay.
examples.zh: 员工被要求无报酬加班。

examples.en: The game comes with lots of extra features.
examples.zh: 该游戏带有许多额外的功能。

examples.en: extra help for single parents
examples.zh: 对单身父母的额外帮助

examples.en: a diet that can help you lose that extra weight
examples.zh: 可以帮助您减掉多余体重的饮食

examples.en: The conference is going to be a lot of extra work.
examples.zh: 这次会议将有很多额外工作。

examples.en: The government has promised an extra £1 billion for healthcare.
examples.zh: 政府承诺为医疗保健再拨款 10 亿英镑。

examples.en: Take extra care on the roads this evening.
examples.zh: 今晚在路上要格外小心。

senses.def: behaving in a way that is too dramatic
senses.zh: 行为方式过于戏剧化或表现出过多的努力

examples.en: Calm down—you're being so extra right now.
examples.zh: 冷静点——你现在太多余了。

examples.en: You can be really extra and buy a dog birthday cake kit.
examples.zh: 您可以额外购买一个狗生日蛋糕套件。

senses.def: a thing that is added to something that is not usual, standard or necessary and that costs more
senses.zh: 额外的事物；另外收费的事物

examples.en: The monthly fee is fixed and there are no hidden extras (= unexpected costs).
examples.zh: 月费是固定的，没有未言明的额外开支。

examples.en: While I was saving I had no money for little extras or luxuries.
examples.zh: 我在存钱，没有钱买额外的小东西或奢侈品。

examples.en: Metallic paint is an optional extra (= a thing you can choose to have or not, but must pay more for if you have it).
examples.zh: 喷金属漆是自由选择的，要额外收费。

examples.en: Regular guests also get added extras like free room service.
examples.zh: 常客还可以获得额外服务，如免费客房服务。

senses.def: a person who is employed to play a very small part in a film, usually as a member of a crowd
senses.zh: （电影里的）临时演员，群众演员

examples.en: We need hundreds of extras for the battle scenes.
examples.zh: 我们拍战斗场面需要上百的临时演员。

senses.def: in addition; more than is usual, expected or exists already

examples.en: to pay/cost extra
examples.zh: 另付费；额外花费

examples.en: We don't charge extra for the activities—everything is included in the admission fee.
examples.zh: 我们对活动不另收费，都包含在入场费中了。

examples.en: I need to earn a bit extra this month.
examples.zh: 我这个月需要挣点外快。

examples.en: Now even bigger! Ten per cent extra!
examples.zh: 现在更大了！加收百分之十！

senses.def: more than usually

examples.en: You need to be extra careful not to make any mistakes.
examples.zh: 你要格外小心，别犯错误。

examples.en: extra cautious/vigilant
examples.zh: 格外谨慎/警惕

examples.en: an extra large T-shirt
examples.zh: 一件特大号的 T 恤衫

examples.en: Do you have this sweatshirt in an extra large size?
examples.zh: 你们有这件特大号的运动衫吗？

examples.en: She tried extra hard.
examples.zh: 她特别努力。

examples.en: He wanted to cook something extra special for dinner that night.
examples.zh: 那天晚上他想做点特别的东西当晚餐。

senses.def: outside; beyond

examples.en: extramarital sex
examples.zh: 婚外性行为

examples.en: extraterrestrial beings
examples.zh: 外星人

senses.def: very; more than usual

examples.en: extra-thin
examples.zh: 特别瘦

examples.en: extra-special
examples.zh: 十分特别

senses.def: a set period of time that is added to the end of a sports game, etc., if there is no winner at the end of the normal period

examples.en: They won by a single goal after extra time.
examples.zh: 他们凭借加时赛中的一个进球而获胜。

examples.en: They scored in extra time.
examples.zh: 他们在加时赛中得分。

senses.def: used to describe good quality oil obtained the first time that olives

examples.en: extra virgin olive oil
examples.zh: 优质初榨橄榄油

senses.def: located or happening outside the body
a short passage from a book, piece of music, etc. that gives you an idea of what the whole thing is like

examples.en: The following extract is taken from her new novel.
examples.zh: 下面一段摘自她的新小说。

senses.def: a substance that has been obtained from something else using a particular process

examples.en: yeast extract
examples.zh: 酵母萃

examples.en: face cream containing natural plant extracts
examples.zh: 含有天然植物提取物的面霜

examples.en: vanilla extract
examples.zh: 香草精

examples.en: extract of apricot
examples.zh: 杏汁

senses.def: to remove or obtain a substance from something, for example by using an industrial or a chemical process

examples.en: a machine that extracts excess moisture from the air
examples.zh: 抽湿机

examples.en: The Egyptians used a primitive form of distillation to extract the essential oils from plants.
examples.zh: 埃及人使用原始的蒸馏方式从植物中提取精油。

examples.en: Animals take in food and extract nutrients from it.
examples.zh: 动物摄入食物，从中提取营养。

senses.def: to obtain information, money, etc., often by taking it from somebody who is unwilling to give it
senses.zh: 索取，设法得到（对方不愿提供的信息、钱财等）

examples.en: Journalists managed to extract all kinds of information about her private life.
examples.zh: 记者们终于得到了有关她私生活的各种信息。

senses.def: to choose information, etc. from a book, a computer, etc. to be used for a particular purpose

examples.en: This article is extracted from his new book.
examples.zh: 本文选自他的新书。

senses.def: to take or pull something out, especially when this needs force or effort

examples.en: The dentist may decide that the wisdom teeth need to be extracted.
examples.zh: 牙医可能会认为智齿需要拔掉。

examples.en: He rifled through his briefcase and extracted a file.
examples.zh: 他在公文包内搜索一番，取出一份文件。

examples.en: I tried extracting the rusty nails with a claw hammer.
examples.zh: 我尝试用羊角锤拔出生锈的钉子。

senses.def: to get a particular feeling or quality from a situation
senses.zh: 获得，得到（某种感觉或品质）

examples.en: They are unlikely to extract much benefit from the trip.
examples.zh: 他们不大可能从这次旅行中获得多大益处。

senses.def: the act or process of removing or obtaining something from something else

examples.en: oil/mineral/coal, etc. extraction
examples.zh: 石油、矿物、煤等的开采

examples.en: the extraction of salt from the sea
examples.zh: 从海水中提取盐

examples.en: Commercial peat extraction is destroying many threatened habitats.
examples.zh: 商业泥炭开采正在破坏许多受威胁的栖息地。

examples.en: Methods of extraction vary from mine to mine.
examples.zh: 不同矿场的开采方法各不相同。

senses.def: having a particular family origin

examples.en: an American of Hungarian extraction
examples.zh: 匈牙利血统的美国人

examples.en: a young American lawyer of Irish extraction
examples.zh: 一位爱尔兰裔的年轻美国律师

senses.def: the process of removing a tooth

examples.en: I didn’t like having my teeth drilled but extractions were infinitely worse.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢钻牙，但拔牙更糟糕。

senses.def: relating to the process of removing or obtaining something, especially minerals
senses.zh: 提取的；提炼的；（尤指矿物）冶炼的

examples.en: extractive industries
examples.zh: 冶金工业

senses.def: a device that removes hot air, unpleasant smells, etc. from a room

examples.en: From her bedroom she could hear the factory’s extractor fan.
examples.zh: 从她的卧室里，她可以听到工厂排风扇的声音。

examples.en: a dust extractor
examples.zh: 除尘器

senses.def: a device or machine that removes something from something else

examples.en: a juice extractor
examples.zh: 榨汁机

senses.def: not part of the usual course of work or studies at a school or college

examples.en: She's involved in many extracurricular activities.
examples.zh: 她参加了许多课外活动。

senses.def: to officially send back somebody who has been accused or found guilty of a crime to the country where the crime was committed

examples.en: The British government attempted to extradite the suspects from Belgium.
examples.zh: 英国政府试图从比利时引渡犯罪嫌疑人。

examples.en: The courts have refused to extradite the suspects from Spain.
examples.zh: 法庭拒绝从西班牙引渡那几名犯罪嫌疑人。

senses.def: the act of officially sending back somebody who has been accused or found guilty of a crime to the country where the crime was committed

examples.en: the extradition of terrorist suspects
examples.zh: 恐怖活动嫌疑人的引渡

examples.en: an extradition treaty
examples.zh: 引渡协议

examples.en: to start extradition proceedings
examples.zh: 启动引渡程序

senses.def: happening outside the normal power of the law
senses.zh: 未按法律程序的；法庭以外的

examples.en: The killing was feared to be an extrajudicial execution carried out by the security forces.
examples.zh: 人们担心这起杀戮是安全部队进行的法外处决。

senses.def: happening outside marriage

examples.en: an extramarital affair
examples.zh: 婚外情

senses.def: arranged by a university, college, etc. for people who only study part-time
senses.zh: 校外的（高等院校为非全日制学生而设的）

examples.en: extramural education/studies/departments
examples.zh: 校外教育／学习／课程部

senses.def: happening or existing outside or separate from a place, an organization, etc.
senses.zh: （地方、机构等）之外的，外部的，以外的

examples.en: The hospital provides extramural care to patients who do not need to be admitted.
examples.zh: 这家医院对无须住院的病人提供院外护理。

senses.def: not directly connected with the particular situation you are in or the subject you are dealing with
senses.zh: 没有直接联系的；无关的

examples.en: We do not want any extraneous information on the page.
examples.zh: 我们不希望这一页上有任何无关的信息。

examples.en: Coughs and extraneous noises can be edited out.
examples.zh: 咳嗽和无关的噪音可以被编辑掉。

examples.en: We shall ignore factors extraneous to the problem.
examples.zh: 我们应该撇开与此问题无直接联系的因素。

examples.en: factors extraneous to the case
examples.zh: 与案件无关的因素

senses.def: an intranet
senses.zh: 外联网（部分开放给外部人员使用的内联网）

examples.en: The firm must control access to its systems, including its website and client extranet.
examples.zh: 公司必须控制对其系统的访问，包括其网站和客户外联网。

senses.def: used to say that somebody is a good example of a particular kind of person

examples.en: Houdini, escape artist extraordinaire
examples.zh: 胡迪尼——擅长表演脱身术的杰出魔术师

senses.def: in a way that is unexpected, surprising or strange
senses.zh: 意想不到的；令人惊奇的；奇怪的

examples.en: He behaves extraordinarily for someone in his position.
examples.zh: 以他的身份地位，做出这样的行为实在令人感到奇怪。

senses.def: in a way that is more, greater or better than usual
senses.zh: 不平常的；不一般的；非凡的；卓越的

examples.en: extraordinarily difficult
examples.zh: 特别困难

examples.en: She did extraordinarily well.
examples.zh: 她做得非常好。

senses.def: unexpected, surprising or strange
senses.zh: 意想不到的；令人惊奇的；奇怪的

examples.en: What an extraordinary thing to say!
examples.zh: 说这话太奇怪了！

examples.en: The president took the extraordinary step of apologizing publicly for his behaviour!
examples.zh: 总统采取了非同寻常的举措，为自己的行为公开道歉！

examples.en: We are a normal family dealing with extraordinary circumstances.
examples.zh: 我们是一个正常的家庭，正在应对非常特殊的情况。

examples.en: It's extraordinary that he managed to sleep through the party.
examples.zh: 真想不到他竟然从聚会开始一直睡到结束。

examples.en: It is extraordinary how little evidence supports this view.
examples.zh: 令人惊奇的是，支持这一观点的证据却很少。

senses.def: not normal or ordinary; greater or better than usual
senses.zh: 不平常的；不一般的；非凡的；卓越的

examples.en: an extraordinary achievement
examples.zh: 卓越的成就

examples.en: She was a truly extraordinary woman.
examples.zh: 她是位非常杰出的女性。

examples.en: They went to extraordinary lengths to explain their behaviour.
examples.zh: 他们竭力为自己的行为辩解。

examples.en: The film tells the extraordinary story of two people struggling to survive in the Arctic.
examples.zh: 影片讲述了两个人在北极艰难求生的非凡故事。

examples.en: The response from the public has been quite extraordinary.
examples.zh: 公众的反应非同一般。

senses.def: arranged for a special purpose and happening in addition to what normally or regularly happens

examples.en: An extraordinary meeting was held to discuss the problem.
examples.zh: 举行了特别会议讨论这个问题。

examples.en: The ruling Socialist Party held an extraordinary congress in July, two months before the annual congress.
examples.zh: 执政的社会党于七月召开了一次特别代表大会，距离年度代表大会还有两个月。

senses.def: employed for a special purpose in addition to the usual staff

examples.en: an envoy extraordinary
examples.zh: 特使

senses.def: (especially in the US) the practice of sending foreign suspects to be questioned in another country where the laws about the treatment of prisoners are less strict
senses.zh: （尤指在美国）非常规引渡（将外籍嫌犯引渡到囚犯待遇法律不严格的其他国家）

senses.def: to estimate something or form an opinion about something, using the facts that you have now and that are relevant to one situation and supposing that they will be relevant to the new one

examples.en: The figures were obtained by extrapolating from past trends.
examples.zh: 这些数字是从过去的趋势推断出来的。

examples.en: Try not to extrapolate too much from your own experience.
examples.zh: 尽量不要从自己的经验中推断太多。

examples.en: We have extrapolated these results from research done in other countries.

examples.zh: 它们的年龄可从其生长速度来推定。

senses.def: costing a lot more money than you can afford or is necessary

examples.zh: 他给我们买了这些他根本无力支付的昂贵礼物。

senses.def: very extreme or impressive but not reasonable or practical

examples.en: I was embarrassed by all the extravagant praise I was getting.
examples.zh: 我对自己得到的所有过分的赞美感到尴尬。

examples.zh: 他有着演员般的夸张动作和响亮的声音。

examples.zh: 这次游行真是一场盛宴。

examples.en: extreme heat/cold/temperatures

examples.zh: 沙漠中极其炎热。

senses.def: not ordinary or usual; serious or severe

examples.en: extreme weather events such as floods and heatwaves
examples.zh: 洪水和热浪等极端天气情况

examples.en: Children will be removed from their parents only in extreme circumstances.
examples.zh: 只有在极端情况下才会让孩子离开父母。

examples.zh: 它会引起恶心，在极端情况下还会导致死亡。

examples.zh: 千万不要做出诸如离开国家之类的极端行为。

examples.zh: 这是我见过的最严重的虐待动物的事例。

senses.def: far from what most people consider to be normal, reasonable or acceptable

examples.zh: 极左／极右观点

examples.en: Fascism was basically an extreme form of nationalism.
examples.zh: 法西斯主义基本上是民族主义的极端形式。

examples.zh: 极端民族主义组织

examples.zh: 他们的想法对我来说太极端了。

examples.zh: 她不喜欢这个主意——听起来太极端了。

examples.zh: 凯里位于爱尔兰的最西端。

examples.zh: 她坐在座位最边上。

examples.zh: 该党极左翼的政客

senses.zh: 极端不同的感情（或境况、行为方式等）；完全相反的事物

examples.en: extremes of love and hate
examples.zh: 爱和恨两种截然不同的感情

examples.en: He used to be very shy, but now he's gone to the opposite extreme (= changed from one extreme kind of behaviour to another).
examples.zh: 他以前很腼腆，现在却走向了另一个极端。

examples.en: She goes from one extreme to the other (= changes from one extreme kind of behaviour to another).
examples.zh: 她从一个极端走向另一个极端（=从一种极端行为转变为另一种极端行为）。

examples.zh: 在另一个极端，顶层 10% 的人获得全国 30% 的收入。

examples.en: He takes a position somewhere these two extremes.
examples.zh: 他在这两个极端之间采取了立场。

senses.def: the greatest or highest degree of something

examples.en: The climate is mild with no extremes of temperature.
examples.zh: 气候温和，没有极端温度。

examples.en: extremes of cold, wind or rain

examples.zh: 山区的极端气候

examples.en: Many of these plants won't tolerate temperature extremes.
examples.zh: 这些植物中有很多都承受不了极端温度。

senses.def: to act or be forced to act in a way that is far from normal or reasonable
senses.zh: 走极端；被迫采取极端行为

examples.en: It's embarrassing the extremes he'll go to in order to impress his boss.
examples.zh: 他为了给上司留下深刻印象，不惜走极端，真令人难堪。

examples.en: Taken to extremes, this kind of behaviour can be dangerous.
examples.zh: 这种行为如果走向极端则可能是非常危险的。

examples.en: In the jungle they were driven to extremes in order to survive.
examples.zh: 在丛林中，他们为了生存被迫采取极端行动。

examples.zh: 盛夏的旺盛生长

examples.zh: 她显得信心十足。
