examples.en: to make/avoid eye contact with somebody (= to look/avoid looking at them at the same time as they look at you)
examples.zh: 与／避免与某人目光接触

examples.en: All eyes were on him (= everyone was looking at him) as he walked on to the stage.
examples.zh: 他走上台时所有的目光都注视着他。

examples.en: a feast/treat/delight for the eyes
examples.zh: 一场视觉盛宴/款待/愉悦

senses.group: part of body 身体部位

senses.def: having the type or number of eyes

examples.en: a blue-eyed child
examples.zh: 一个蓝眼睛的孩子

examples.en: a one-eyed monster
examples.zh: 独眼怪物

senses.group: part of body 身体部位

senses.def: the ability to see

examples.en: A surgeon needs a good eye and a steady hand.
examples.zh: 做外科医生眼要准，手要稳。

examples.en: Her skill at working with wood is coupled to a keen eye for design.
examples.zh: 她兼具高超的木工活手艺与敏锐的设计眼光。

senses.def: a particular way of seeing something

examples.en: He looked at the design with the eye of an engineer.
examples.zh: 他以工程师的眼光看这个设计。

examples.en: She viewed the findings with a critical eye.
examples.zh: 她以批判的眼光看待这些研究结果。

examples.en: To my eye, the windows seem out of proportion.
examples.zh: 在我看来，这些窗子似乎不成比例。

senses.def: the hole in the end of a needle that you put the thread
a small thin piece of metal curved round, that a small hook

examples.en: It fastens with a hook and eye.
examples.zh: 它是用钩眼扣扣上的。

senses.def: a calm area at the centre of a storm, etc.
senses.zh: 风眼（风暴等的中心平静区）

senses.def: a dark mark on a potato from which another plant will grow
a person or thing that is loved more than any other

examples.en: She is the apple of her father's eye.
examples.zh: 她是父亲的掌上明珠。

senses.def: to the horizon

examples.en: The bleak moorland stretched on all sides as far as the eye could see.
examples.zh: 荒凉的旷野向四面伸展开去，一望无际。

senses.def: to open and close your eyes quickly, in a way that is supposed to be attractive
to be watching somebody/something carefully and with a lot of interest
senses.zh: 极注意地看；留神地看；全神贯注地看；目不转睛

examples.en: The kids were all eyes as he slowly unwrapped the package.
examples.zh: 当他慢慢地打开包裹时，孩子们都睁大了眼睛。

senses.def: people all have different ideas about what is beautiful
senses.zh: 情人眼里出西施；对美的判别因人而异

senses.def: in somebody’s presence; in front of somebody
senses.zh: 当着某人的面；就在某人的眼皮底下

examples.en: He had seen his life's work destroyed before his very eyes.
examples.zh: 他曾看到他毕生的劳动成果就在自己的眼前毁于一旦。

examples.en: Before our very eyes, the bird snatched the fish from the plate and flew off.
examples.zh: 那只鸟就在我们眼皮底下从盘子里抓起鱼飞走了。

senses.def: to have a lot of something to deal with

examples.en: We're up to our eyes in work.
examples.zh: 我们工作忙得不可开交。

senses.def: a view of something from a high position looking down

examples.en: From the plane we had a bird's-eye view of Manhattan.
examples.zh: 我们从飞机上把曼哈顿尽收眼底。

senses.def: to look at or examine something quickly
senses.zh: 用眼光瞥（或扫）；匆匆查看；粗略地看一看

examples.en: Could you just run your eyes over this report?
examples.zh: 你就粗略地看一下这报告可以吗？

examples.en: I cast my eyes around the room but couldn't see any familiar faces.
examples.zh: 我环顾整个房间，但看不到任何熟悉的面孔。

senses.def: to attract somebody’s attention
senses.zh: 引起某人注意；惹人注目

examples.en: Can you catch the waiter's eye?
examples.zh: 你能引起服务员的注意吗？

senses.def: to see somebody/something

examples.en: I haven't clapped eyes on them for weeks.
examples.zh: 我几周没见到他们了。

examples.en: I hope I never set eyes on this place again!
examples.zh: 我希望永远不再见到这个地方！

examples.en: Tom fell in love the moment he laid eyes on her.
examples.zh: 汤姆对她一见钟情。

senses.def: to look at or listen to something/somebody carefully and with a lot of attention
pleasant to listen to or look at
senses.zh: 好听的；悦耳的；好看的；悦目的

examples.en: The room was painted in soft pastels that were easy on the eye.
examples.zh: 房间被涂成柔和的粉彩，赏心悦目。

senses.def: pleasant to look at

examples.en: The room was painted in soft pastels that were easy on the eye.
examples.zh: 房间被涂成柔和的粉彩，赏心悦目。

senses.def: used to show that you do not believe somebody/something

examples.en: ‘It's an antique.’ ‘An antique, my eye!’
examples.zh: “这是件文物。”“是文物才怪！”

senses.def: used to say that you should punish somebody by doing to them what they have done to you or to somebody else

examples.en: They advocate a justice system that works on the principle of an eye for an eye.
examples.zh: 他们主张建立一个以眼还眼原则运作的司法系统。

senses.def: used to say that somebody has been greedy
senses.zh: （表示贪吃）眼大肚皮小，眼馋肚饱

senses.def: to look at somebody/something and get great pleasure
senses.zh: 尽情欣赏；大饱眼福；赏心悦目

senses.def: to be seen only by a particular person

examples.en: I'll lend you the letters but they're for your eyes only.
examples.zh: 我会把这些信借给你，但只准你一个人看。

senses.def: to practise so that you are able to make good judgements about a task or activity that you are doing
senses.zh: 能进行准确判断（球的速度和方向）

examples.en: I've got my eye in now—the ball is landing just where I want it.
examples.zh: 我能准确判断——球正好落在我想要的位置。

senses.def: to be able to judge if things look attractive, valuable, etc.
senses.zh: 对…有鉴赏力（或识别力、眼力）

examples.en: I've never had much of an eye for fashion.
examples.zh: 我对时装从来没多少鉴赏力。

examples.en: She has an eye for a bargain.
examples.zh: 她善识便宜货。

senses.def: to be watching somebody carefully, especially to check that they do not do anything wrong

examples.en: And remember, I'll have my eye on you so you'd better behave.
examples.zh: 记住，我会盯着你，所以最好乖乖的。

examples.en: The store detective had his eye on a group of boys who were acting suspiciously.
examples.zh: 商店保安留意着一群行为可疑的男孩子。

senses.def: to be thinking about asking somebody out, offering somebody a job, etc. because you think they are attractive, good at their job, etc.

examples.en: He's got his eye on the new girl in your class.
examples.zh: 他看中了你们班上新来的那个女孩。

senses.def: to be thinking about buying something
to be aware of everything that is happening around you, even things that seem difficult or impossible to see
senses.zh: 脑后长眼；眼光敏锐；什么都能觉察到

examples.en: You can’t get away with anything in her class. She has eyes in the back of her head.
examples.zh: 在她的课堂上你无法逃脱任何惩罚。她的后脑勺长着眼睛。

senses.def: to be able to notice or see everything

examples.en: She's bound to notice that chipped glass. The woman has eyes like a hawk!
examples.zh: 她一定会注意到那只破损的玻璃杯。这个女人的眼睛尖着呢！

senses.def: to look at or watch something while doing something else, especially in a secret way so that other people do not notice
senses.zh: 做另一件事的同时（悄悄）注意

examples.en: During his talk, most of the delegates had one eye on the clock.
examples.zh: 他讲话时大部分代表边听边悄悄看钟。

senses.def: to always be looking for the chance to have a new sexual relationship
senses.zh: 总是找机会寻花问柳；眼神不安分

senses.def: to be very obvious to somebody
very quickly; in a short time
in somebody’s opinion or according to the way that they see the situation
senses.zh: 按某人的意见；在某人眼里；依某人看

examples.en: She can do no wrong in her father's eyes.
examples.zh: 在她父亲看来，她不可能做坏事。

examples.en: To Western eyes, it may seem that the city is overcrowded.
examples.zh: 在西方人看来，这座城市似乎过于拥挤。

senses.def: according to the law, most people in the world, etc.
senses.zh: 从（法律、世人等）的观点看；就…而言

examples.en: In the eyes of the law she is guilty, though few ordinary people would think so.
examples.zh: 从法律的角度看，她是有罪，不过普通人大多不这么认为。

examples.en: In the eyes of the law his knife was an offensive weapon.
examples.zh: 从法律上看，他的刀是攻击性武器。

senses.def: well known to many people through television, newspapers, the internet, etc.
senses.zh: （通过电视、报纸、网络等）为公众熟知，广为人知

examples.en: She doesn't want her children growing up in the public eye.
examples.zh: 她不想让子女在众人瞩目中成长。

senses.def: very quickly

examples.en: Suddenly, in the twinkling of an eye, her whole life had been turned upside down.
examples.zh: 突然，一眨眼的工夫，她的人生就彻底天翻地覆了。

senses.def: to watch somebody/something carefully

examples.en: Over the next few months we will keep a close eye on sales.
examples.zh: 在今后的几个月里我们将密切关注销售情况。

senses.def: to listen or look out for somebody/something that you might hear or see
senses.zh: 留心听；保持警惕；密切注意

senses.def: to take care of somebody/something and make sure that they are not harmed, damaged, etc.

examples.en: We've asked the neighbours to keep an eye on the house for us while we are away.
examples.zh: 我们已请邻居在我们外出时帮我们照看一下房子。

examples.en: Could you keep an eye on my bag while I go to the toilet?
examples.zh: 我去厕所时你能帮我看一下包吗？

senses.def: to continue to give your attention to what is most important
senses.zh: 眼睛盯着大事；密切注意关键问题

senses.def: to look for somebody/something while you are doing other things

examples.en: Police have asked residents to keep an eye out for anything suspicious.
examples.zh: 警方要求居民密切注意一切可疑的情况。

examples.en: I walked around the store, keeping an eye out for bargains.
examples.zh: 我在商店里转悠，留心看有没有便宜货。

senses.def: to look out for somebody/something that you might see
to look out for somebody/something that you might see

examples.en: We kept our eyes peeled for any signs of life.
examples.zh: 我们注意寻找任何生命的迹象。

senses.def: to watch somebody/something carefully in case you need to take action
senses.zh: 对…随时留意；对…小心提防

examples.en: Keep a weather eye on your competitors.
examples.zh: 密切关注竞争对手的天气情况。

senses.def: to look straight at somebody without feeling embarrassed or ashamed
senses.zh: （坦然或问心无愧地）直视某人，正视某人

examples.en: Can you look me in the eye and tell me you're not lying?
examples.zh: 你能问心无愧地看着我说你没撒谎吗？

examples.en: She looked her father straight in the eye and answered his question truthfully.
examples.zh: 她直视着父亲的眼睛，诚实地回答了他的问题。

examples.en: I'll never be able to look her in the face again!
examples.zh: 我再也不能坦然地面对她了！

senses.def: to look at somebody in a way that shows that you find them sexually attractive
senses.zh: 向某人送秋波；向某人抛媚眼

examples.en: He's definitely giving you the eye!
examples.zh: 他肯定是在向你眉目传情！

senses.def: if you meet somebody’s eye(s)

examples.en: She was afraid to meet my eye.
examples.zh: 她不敢和我对视。

examples.en: Their eyes met across the crowded room.
examples.zh: 他们隔着拥挤的房间目光相遇了。

examples.en: She met his gaze without flinching.
examples.zh: 她毫不畏缩地与他对视。

senses.def: if a sight meets your eyes

examples.en: A terrible sight met their eyes.
examples.zh: 一幅可怕的景象映入他们的眼帘。

senses.def: your imagination

examples.en: He pictured the scene in his mind's eye.
examples.zh: 他想象出了这一场面。

senses.def: the normal power of your eyes without the help of an instrument

examples.en: The planet should be visible with/to the naked eye.
examples.zh: 这颗行星肉眼应该就能看得见。

senses.def: to show no surprise or concern when something unusual happens
senses.zh: 不动声色；面不改色；眼睛都不眨一下

examples.en: She didn't bat an eyelid when I told her my news.
examples.zh: 我把我最近的事告诉她时，她一点也不为所动。

senses.def: to be very surprised at something you hear/see
senses.zh: 不相信自己的耳朵（或眼睛）；对所闻（或所见）非常吃惊

examples.en: I couldn't believe my eyes when she walked in.
examples.zh: 她走进来时我简直不相信自己的眼睛。

senses.def: to be very surprised at something you see

examples.en: I couldn't believe my eyes when she walked in.
examples.zh: 她走进来时我简直不相信自己的眼睛。

senses.def: used to say that everyone was very emotional about something
senses.zh: 全场无人不流泪；全场无不为之动容

examples.en: There wasn't a dry eye in the house when they announced their engagement.
examples.zh: 他们宣布订婚时大伙眼睛全湿了。

senses.def: to not share the same views as somebody about something
senses.zh: 与某人看法不一致（或意见不尽相同）；与…不敢苟同

examples.en: The two of them have never seen eye to eye on politics.
examples.zh: 他们俩在政治上从未有过相同的看法。

senses.def: to find somebody/something so interesting, attractive, etc. that you watch them all the time
senses.zh: 目不转睛地盯着；始终注视着

examples.en: He couldn't keep his eyes off the girl sitting opposite him.
examples.zh: 他无法把目光从坐在对面的女孩身上移开。

senses.def: a result, action, etc. that is disappointing or a defeat for somebody/something

examples.en: The appointment of a woman was one in the eye for male domination.
examples.zh: 任命女性担任这个职位是对男权统治的严重打击。

senses.def: to be in love with only one particular person
senses.zh: 只钟情于某人；只爱某人

examples.en: He's only ever had eyes for his wife.
examples.zh: 他始终只爱自己的妻子。

senses.def: to realize or make somebody realize the truth about something
senses.zh: （使人）长见识（或开眼界、认清事实）

examples.en: Travelling really opens your eyes to other cultures.
examples.zh: 旅游真正能使人开阔眼界，认识其他文化。

senses.def: to be very attractive to look at
to hide your real actions or intentions from somebody by making them believe something that is not true
to think about or see something the way that another person sees it

examples.en: Try looking at it through her eyes for a change.
examples.zh: 试试设身处地站在她的角度想想这事吧。

examples.en: Events are seen through the eyes of a Polish refugee.
examples.zh: 事件是通过波兰难民的眼睛来看待的。

senses.def: to see something by accident or not very clearly because you see it from the side of your eye and are not looking straight at it

examples.en: Out of the corner of her eye, she saw him coming closer.
examples.zh: 她用眼一瞟，见他正向她走过来。

senses.def: to pretend that you have not noticed something so that you do not have to deal with it
senses.zh: （对…）视而不见，熟视无睹，置若罔闻

examples.en: You can't just close your eyes to his violence.
examples.zh: 你不能对他的暴力行为视而不见。

examples.en: They seem intent on shutting their eyes to the problems of pollution.
examples.zh: 他们似乎一心要对污染问题视而不见。

senses.def: a person or thing that you are pleased to see; something that is very pleasant to look at
to stop giving your attention to what is most important
a person or thing is more complicated or interesting than you might think at first
senses.zh: 某人（或物）比料想的更为复杂（或有趣）

senses.def: to pretend not to notice something bad that is happening, so you do not have to do anything about it
senses.zh: （对某事）佯装不见，睁一只眼闭一只眼

examples.en: The authorities were either unaware of the problem or they turned a blind eye to it.
examples.zh: 当局要么不知道这个问题，要么对此视而不见。

senses.def: being watched carefully by somebody
senses.zh: 在某人的密切注视下；在某人的监视下

examples.en: The children played under the watchful eye of their father.
examples.zh: 孩子们在父亲悉心看护下玩耍。

examples.en: I want you under my eye.
examples.zh: 我要你待在我能看到的地方。

senses.def: if a person does not know about something that they would normally think was bad, then it cannot hurt them
senses.zh: 眼不见（心不烦）；眼不见为净

examples.en: What does it matter if I use his flat while he’s away? What the eye doesn’t see…!
examples.zh: 我趁他外出时用他的公寓有什么关系呢？反正他又看不见！

senses.def: with the hope of using a particular situation in order to gain some advantage for yourself
fully aware of the possible problems or results of a particular course of action
senses.zh: 明知后果如何；明知有问题；心中有数

examples.en: I went into this with my eyes open so I guess I only have myself to blame.
examples.zh: 我是明明知道做这事的后果的，所以我想只能责怪我自己。

senses.def: very easily, without thinking about it
senses.zh: 闭着眼都能做；轻而易举

examples.en: I've made this trip so often, I could do it with my eyes shut.
examples.zh: 我经常走这条路，闭着眼睛都能找到。

senses.def: with the intention of doing something

examples.en: He bought the warehouse with an eye to converting it into a hotel.
examples.zh: 他买这个仓库是为了将它改建成一家旅馆。

senses.def: to look at somebody/something carefully, especially because you want something or you suspect that something is wrong

examples.en: to eye somebody suspiciously
examples.zh: 怀疑地注视着某人

examples.en: He couldn't help eyeing the cakes hungrily.
examples.zh: 他饥不可耐地盯着蛋糕。

examples.en: They eyed us with alarm.
examples.zh: 他们警觉地注视着我们。

examples.en: The children eyed the cakes greedily.
examples.zh: 孩子们贪婪地盯着蛋糕。

senses.def: a person or thing that is loved more than any other

examples.en: She is the apple of her father's eye.
examples.zh: 她是父亲的掌上明珠。

senses.zh: （表示贪吃）眼大肚皮小，眼馋肚饱

senses.zh: 尽情欣赏；大饱眼福；赏心悦目

senses.def: to be seen only by a particular person

examples.en: I'll lend you the letters but they're for your eyes only.
examples.zh: 我会把这些信借给你，但只准你一个人看。

senses.def: to practise so that you are able to make good judgements about a task or activity that you are doing
senses.zh: 能进行准确判断（球的速度和方向）

examples.en: I've got my eye in now—the ball is landing just where I want it.
examples.zh: 我能准确判断——球正好落在我想要的位置。

senses.def: to be able to judge if things look attractive, valuable, etc.
senses.zh: 对…有鉴赏力（或识别力、眼力）

examples.en: I've never had much of an eye for fashion.
examples.zh: 我对时装从来没多少鉴赏力。

examples.en: She has an eye for a bargain.
examples.zh: 她善识便宜货。

senses.def: to be watching somebody carefully, especially to check that they do not do anything wrong

examples.en: And remember, I'll have my eye on you so you'd better behave.
examples.zh: 记住，我会盯着你，所以最好乖乖的。

examples.en: The store detective had his eye on a group of boys who were acting suspiciously.
examples.zh: 商店保安留意着一群行为可疑的男孩子。

senses.def: to be thinking about asking somebody out, offering somebody a job, etc. because you think they are attractive, good at their job, etc.

examples.en: He's got his eye on the new girl in your class.
examples.zh: 他看中了你们班上新来的那个女孩。

senses.def: to be thinking about buying something

items.idm: have eyes in the back of your head

senses.def: to be aware of everything that is happening around you, even things that seem difficult or impossible to see
senses.zh: 脑后长眼；眼光敏锐；什么都能觉察到

examples.en: You can’t get away with anything in her class. She has eyes in the back of her head.
examples.zh: 在她的课堂上你无法逃脱任何惩罚。她的后脑勺长着眼睛。

senses.def: to be able to notice or see everything

examples.en: She's bound to notice that chipped glass. The woman has eyes like a hawk!
examples.zh: 她一定会注意到那只破损的玻璃杯。这个女人的眼睛尖着呢！

items.idm: have one eye/half an eye on something

senses.def: to look at or watch something while doing something else, especially in a secret way so that other people do not notice
senses.zh: 做另一件事的同时（悄悄）注意

examples.en: During his talk, most of the delegates had one eye on the clock.
examples.zh: 他讲话时大部分代表边听边悄悄看钟。

senses.def: to always be looking for the chance to have a new sexual relationship
senses.zh: 总是找机会寻花问柳；眼神不安分

senses.def: to be very obvious to somebody

items.idm: in the blink of an eye

senses.def: very quickly; in a short time
in somebody’s opinion or according to the way that they see the situation
senses.zh: 按某人的意见；在某人眼里；依某人看

examples.en: She can do no wrong in her father's eyes.
examples.zh: 在她父亲看来，她不可能做坏事。

examples.en: To Western eyes, it may seem that the city is overcrowded.
examples.zh: 在西方人看来，这座城市似乎过于拥挤。

items.idm: in the eyes of the law, world, etc.

senses.def: according to the law, most people in the world, etc.
senses.zh: 从（法律、世人等）的观点看；就…而言

examples.en: In the eyes of the law she is guilty, though few ordinary people would think so.
examples.zh: 从法律的角度看，她是有罪，不过普通人大多不这么认为。

examples.en: In the eyes of the law his knife was an offensive weapon.
examples.zh: 从法律上看，他的刀是攻击性武器。

senses.def: well known to many people through television, newspapers, the internet, etc.
senses.zh: （通过电视、报纸、网络等）为公众熟知，广为人知

examples.en: She doesn't want her children growing up in the public eye.
examples.zh: 她不想让子女在众人瞩目中成长。

items.idm: in the twinkling of an eye

senses.def: very quickly

examples.en: Suddenly, in the twinkling of an eye, her whole life had been turned upside down.
examples.zh: 突然，一眨眼的工夫，她的人生就彻底天翻地覆了。

items.idm: keep a close eye/watch on somebody/something

senses.def: to watch somebody/something carefully

examples.en: Over the next few months we will keep a close eye on sales.
examples.zh: 在今后的几个月里我们将密切关注销售情况。

items.idm: keep your ears/eyes open (for somebody/something)

senses.def: to listen or look out for somebody/something that you might hear or see
senses.zh: 留心听；保持警惕；密切注意

senses.def: to take care of somebody/something and make sure that they are not harmed, damaged, etc.

examples.en: We've asked the neighbours to keep an eye on the house for us while we are away.
examples.zh: 我们已请邻居在我们外出时帮我们照看一下房子。

examples.en: Could you keep an eye on my bag while I go to the toilet?
examples.zh: 我去厕所时你能帮我看一下包吗？

items.idm: keep your eye on the ball

senses.def: to continue to give your attention to what is most important
senses.zh: 眼睛盯着大事；密切注意关键问题

senses.def: to look for somebody/something while you are doing other things

examples.en: Police have asked residents to keep an eye out for anything suspicious.
examples.zh: 警方要求居民密切注意一切可疑的情况。

examples.en: I walked around the store, keeping an eye out for bargains.
examples.zh: 我在商店里转悠，留心看有没有便宜货。

senses.def: to look out for somebody/something that you might see
to look out for somebody/something that you might see

examples.en: We kept our eyes peeled for any signs of life.
examples.zh: 我们注意寻找任何生命的迹象。

items.idm: keep a weather eye on somebody/something

senses.def: to watch somebody/something carefully in case you need to take action
senses.zh: 对…随时留意；对…小心提防

examples.en: Keep a weather eye on your competitors.
examples.zh: 密切关注竞争对手的天气情况。

senses.def: to look straight at somebody without feeling embarrassed or ashamed
senses.zh: （坦然或问心无愧地）直视某人，正视某人

examples.en: Can you look me in the eye and tell me you're not lying?
examples.zh: 你能问心无愧地看着我说你没撒谎吗？

examples.en: She looked her father straight in the eye and answered his question truthfully.
examples.zh: 她直视着父亲的眼睛，诚实地回答了他的问题。

examples.en: I'll never be able to look her in the face again!
examples.zh: 我再也不能坦然地面对她了！

items.idm: make eyes at somebody | give somebody the eye

senses.def: to look at somebody in a way that shows that you find them sexually attractive
senses.zh: 向某人送秋波；向某人抛媚眼

examples.en: He's definitely giving you the eye!
examples.zh: 他肯定是在向你眉目传情！

items.idm: meet somebody’s eye(s) | meet somebody’s gaze, look, etc. | people’s eyes meet

senses.def: if you meet somebody’s eye(s)

examples.en: She was afraid to meet my eye.
examples.zh: 她不敢和我对视。

examples.en: Their eyes met across the crowded room.
examples.zh: 他们隔着拥挤的房间目光相遇了。

examples.en: She met his gaze without flinching.
examples.zh: 她毫不畏缩地与他对视。

senses.def: if a sight meets your eyes

examples.en: A terrible sight met their eyes.
examples.zh: 一幅可怕的景象映入他们的眼帘。

senses.def: your imagination

examples.en: He pictured the scene in his mind's eye.
examples.zh: 他想象出了这一场面。

senses.def: the normal power of your eyes without the help of an instrument

examples.en: The planet should be visible with/to the naked eye.
examples.zh: 这颗行星肉眼应该就能看得见。

senses.def: to show no surprise or concern when something unusual happens
senses.zh: 不动声色；面不改色；眼睛都不眨一下

examples.en: She didn't bat an eyelid when I told her my news.
examples.zh: 我把我最近的事告诉她时，她一点也不为所动。

senses.def: to be very surprised at something you hear/see
senses.zh: 不相信自己的耳朵（或眼睛）；对所闻（或所见）非常吃惊

examples.en: I couldn't believe my eyes when she walked in.
examples.zh: 她走进来时我简直不相信自己的眼睛。

senses.def: to be very surprised at something you see

examples.en: I couldn't believe my eyes when she walked in.
examples.zh: 她走进来时我简直不相信自己的眼睛。

items.idm: not a dry eye in the house

senses.def: used to say that everyone was very emotional about something
senses.zh: 全场无人不流泪；全场无不为之动容

examples.en: There wasn't a dry eye in the house when they announced their engagement.
examples.zh: 他们宣布订婚时大伙眼睛全湿了。

items.idm: not see eye to eye with somebody (on something)

senses.def: to not share the same views as somebody about something
senses.zh: 与某人看法不一致（或意见不尽相同）；与…不敢苟同

examples.en: The two of them have never seen eye to eye on politics.
examples.zh: 他们俩在政治上从未有过相同的看法。

items.idm: not (be able to) take your eyes off somebody/something

senses.def: to find somebody/something so interesting, attractive, etc. that you watch them all the time
senses.zh: 目不转睛地盯着；始终注视着

examples.en: He couldn't keep his eyes off the girl sitting opposite him.
examples.zh: 他无法把目光从坐在对面的女孩身上移开。

senses.def: a result, action, etc. that is disappointing or a defeat for somebody/something

examples.en: The appointment of a woman was one in the eye for male domination.
examples.zh: 任命女性担任这个职位是对男权统治的严重打击。

items.idm: only have eyes for/have eyes only for somebody

senses.def: to be in love with only one particular person
senses.zh: 只钟情于某人；只爱某人

examples.en: He's only ever had eyes for his wife.
examples.zh: 他始终只爱自己的妻子。

senses.def: to realize or make somebody realize the truth about something
senses.zh: （使人）长见识（或开眼界、认清事实）

examples.en: Travelling really opens your eyes to other cultures.
examples.zh: 旅游真正能使人开阔眼界，认识其他文化。

senses.def: to be very attractive to look at

items.idm: pull the wool over somebody’s eyes

senses.def: to hide your real actions or intentions from somebody by making them believe something that is not true

items.idm: see, look at, etc. something through somebody’s eyes

senses.def: to think about or see something the way that another person sees it

examples.en: Try looking at it through her eyes for a change.
examples.zh: 试试设身处地站在她的角度想想这事吧。

examples.en: Events are seen through the eyes of a Polish refugee.
examples.zh: 事件是通过波兰难民的眼睛来看待的。

items.idm: see something out of the corner of your eye

senses.def: to see something by accident or not very clearly because you see it from the side of your eye and are not looking straight at it

examples.en: Out of the corner of her eye, she saw him coming closer.
examples.zh: 她用眼一瞟，见他正向她走过来。

senses.def: to pretend that you have not noticed something so that you do not have to deal with it
senses.zh: （对…）视而不见，熟视无睹，置若罔闻

examples.en: You can't just close your eyes to his violence.
examples.zh: 你不能对他的暴力行为视而不见。

examples.en: They seem intent on shutting their eyes to the problems of pollution.
examples.zh: 他们似乎一心要对污染问题视而不见。

senses.def: a person or thing that you are pleased to see; something that is very pleasant to look at

items.idm: take your eye off the ball

senses.def: to stop giving your attention to what is most important

items.idm: there is more to somebody/something than meets the eye

senses.def: a person or thing is more complicated or interesting than you might think at first
senses.zh: 某人（或物）比料想的更为复杂（或有趣）

senses.def: to pretend not to notice something bad that is happening, so you do not have to do anything about it
senses.zh: （对某事）佯装不见，睁一只眼闭一只眼

examples.en: The authorities were either unaware of the problem or they turned a blind eye to it.
examples.zh: 当局要么不知道这个问题，要么对此视而不见。

senses.def: being watched carefully by somebody
senses.zh: 在某人的密切注视下；在某人的监视下

examples.en: The children played under the watchful eye of their father.
examples.zh: 孩子们在父亲悉心看护下玩耍。

examples.en: I want you under my eye.
examples.zh: 我要你待在我能看到的地方。

items.idm: what the eye doesn’t see (the heart doesn’t grieve over)

senses.def: if a person does not know about something that they would normally think was bad, then it cannot hurt them
senses.zh: 眼不见（心不烦）；眼不见为净

examples.en: What does it matter if I use his flat while he’s away? What the eye doesn’t see…!
examples.zh: 我趁他外出时用他的公寓有什么关系呢？反正他又看不见！

items.idm: with an eye for/on/to the main chance

senses.def: with the hope of using a particular situation in order to gain some advantage for yourself
fully aware of the possible problems or results of a particular course of action
senses.zh: 明知后果如何；明知有问题；心中有数

examples.en: I went into this with my eyes open so I guess I only have myself to blame.
examples.zh: 我是明明知道做这事的后果的，所以我想只能责怪我自己。

senses.def: very easily, without thinking about it
senses.zh: 闭着眼都能做；轻而易举

examples.en: I've made this trip so often, I could do it with my eyes shut.
examples.zh: 我经常走这条路，闭着眼睛都能找到。

items.idm: with an eye to something/to doing something

senses.def: with the intention of doing something

examples.en: He bought the warehouse with an eye to converting it into a hotel.
examples.zh: 他买这个仓库是为了将它改建成一家旅馆。

senses.def: a person or thing that is attractive but not intelligent or useful
senses.zh: 有魅力但不聪明的人；中看不中用的东西

examples.en: The movie is just gorgeous eye candy.
examples.zh: 这部电影简直就是华丽的养眼之物。

senses.def: immediately likely to attract attention because it is particularly interesting, bright or attractive
senses.zh: 惹人注意的；引人注目的

examples.en: an eye-catching advertisement
examples.zh: 醒目的广告

examples.en: beautiful clothes in eye-catching colours
examples.zh: 漂亮的衣服，颜色引人注目

senses.def: liquid medicine that can be put into the eyes

examples.en: I use eye drops to help with my hay fever.
examples.zh: 我使用眼药水来缓解花粉热。

senses.def: the height of a person’s eyes

examples.en: Computer screens should be at eye level.
examples.zh: 计算机屏幕应该与眼睛齐平。

examples.en: an eye-level grill
examples.zh: 与眼睛齐平的铁栅栏

examples.en: a shelf at eye level
examples.zh: 与眼睛等高的架子

senses.def: an event, experience, etc. that is surprising and shows you something that you did not already know
senses.zh: 使人大开眼界的事情（或经历等）

examples.en: The journey so far had been a real eye-opener.
examples.zh: 到目前为止的旅程真是令人大开眼界。

senses.def: causing a feeling of surprise because it shows you something that you did not already know
senses.zh: 令人大开眼界：给您带来惊喜的感觉，因为它向您展示了您不知道的东西

examples.en: It's an eye-opening experience, seeing what goes on behind the scenes.
examples.zh: 这是一次令人大开眼界的体验，可以看到幕后发生的事情。

senses.def: so exciting, large or impressive that it is very surprising or difficult to believe; amazing
senses.zh: 令人瞠目的；令人大为惊奇的；令人惊叹的

examples.en: The company's stock-market value peaked last summer at an eye-popping $30 billion.
examples.zh: 该公司的股票市值去年夏天达到令人瞠目结舌的 300 亿美元。

examples.en: The special effects in the film were truly eye-popping.
examples.zh: 影片的特效实在令人叹为观止。

senses.def: causing somebody to roll their eyes, usually because they are annoyed or because they do not believe or approve of something
senses.zh: 使人翻白眼的；令人不以为然的

examples.en: There were a few eye-rolling moments during the presentation.
examples.zh: 在演示过程中几度让人忍不住翻白眼。

senses.def: the action of rolling your eyes, usually because you are annoyed or you do not believe or approve of something
senses.zh: 翻白眼（通常因为恼火、不相信或不赞成）

examples.en: There’s been a lot of eye-rolling in the office about the latest announcements.
examples.zh: 办公室里有很多人对最近的这些公告大翻白眼。

senses.def: in a way that might cause somebody to roll their eyes, because they are annoyed or do not believe or approve of something
senses.zh: 眼睛滚动：以某种方式可能导致某人滚动眼睛，因为他们感到烦恼或不相信或赞成某事

examples.en: The plot was eye-rollingly predictable.
examples.zh: 剧情的发展是可以预见的。

senses.def: a condition of the eyes caused, for example, by a long period of reading or looking at a computer screen

items.idm: give your eye teeth for something/to do something

examples.en: I'd give my eye teeth to own a car like that.
examples.zh: 我巴不得有一辆那样的汽车。

senses.def: to look at somebody in a way that shows you have a special interest in them, especially a sexual interest

senses.zh: （高得）难以想象的；令人心痛的；催人落泪的

examples.zh: 超乎想象的交通票价飙升

examples.en: an eye-watering £20 million
examples.zh: 令人垂涎的2000万英镑

examples.en: The losses announced so far are eye-watering.
examples.zh: 迄今为止公布的损失令人瞠目结舌。

senses.def: in a way that is so high or extreme that it is difficult or painful to think about it
senses.zh: （高得）难以想象的；令人心痛的；催人落泪的

examples.en: eye-wateringly high interest rates
examples.zh: 高得令人咋舌的利率

senses.def: the whole of the eye, including the round part inside the head that cannot be seen

senses.zh: （尤指能带来潜在收益的）访客数，流量，关注度

examples.en: It's a sad fact that bad news grabs more eyeballs than good news.
examples.zh: 一个令人悲哀的事实是，坏消息比好消息更能吸引流量。

examples.zh: 他们的工作忙得不可开交。

senses.zh: （与某人）面对面，怒目相视，对峙

examples.zh: 抗议者与警察对峙。

examples.zh: 面对面的对抗

examples.zh: 他们在房间的另一边互相注视着对方。

examples.zh: 埃伦扬起眉毛看着我。

examples.en: He had thick black eyebrows and curly hair.
examples.zh: 他有浓密的黑眉毛和卷发。

examples.zh: 他深陷于困境之中。

examples.zh: 一满眼的沙子

to look carefully at something that is interesting or unusual

examples.zh: 珠宝商的眼镜

examples.zh: 假睫毛

examples.zh: 她只要眨一下眼睫毛，男人们便忙不迭地跑过来！

examples.en: Ivy covered the front face of the house.
examples.zh: 常春藤覆盖了房子的正面。

examples.en: A banner hung across the face of the building.
examples.zh: 一条横幅悬挂在建筑物的正面。

examples.en: How many faces does a cube have?
examples.zh: 立方体有几个面？

senses.def: the front part of a clock or watch

examples.en: a dial like the face of a clock
examples.zh: 像钟面一样的表盘

senses.def: the particular character of something

examples.en: the changing face of Britain
examples.zh: 大不列颠变化中的特征

examples.en: This discovery changed the whole face of science.
examples.zh: 这一发现改变了科学的全貌。

examples.en: bureaucracy with a human face
examples.zh: 有人情味的官僚体制

senses.def: a particular aspect of something

examples.en: Social deprivation is the unacceptable face of capitalism.
examples.zh: 社会贫困是资本主义令人不可接受的方面。

examples.en: He has become the public face of the company.
examples.zh: 他已成为公司的公众形象。

senses.def: used to describe something that you have failed to see, even though it was obvious and should have been easy to see

examples.en: The answer was staring us in the face but we never saw it until it was too late.
examples.zh: 答案就在我们眼前，但我们看到时已经太晚了。

senses.def: to be certain to happen

examples.en: Defeat was staring them in the face.
examples.zh: 他们必遭失败。

senses.def: to be unable to avoid something

examples.en: They were staring defeat in the face.
examples.zh: 对他们来说，失败不可避免。

senses.def: to be very obvious to other people from the expression on somebody’s face
senses.zh: 形之于色；表现得十分明显

examples.en: Guilt was written all over his face.
examples.zh: 他满脸愧疚。

senses.def: if a plan, etc. blows up in your face
to do something when you are angry that is meant to harm somebody else but that also harms you
senses.zh: （恼怒之下）伤人害己，损人不利己

senses.def: to disappear completely
senses.zh: 完全消失；消逝得无影无踪

examples.en: Keep looking—they can't just have vanished off the face of the earth.
examples.zh: 继续找，他们不可能就从此消失得无影无踪的。

senses.def: to try to do something as hard and as long as you possibly can but without success
senses.zh: 徒然拼命地干；徒劳无功

examples.en: You can argue till you're blue in the face, but you won't change my mind.
examples.zh: 你可以费尽口舌，但改变不了我的主意。

senses.def: used to say that somebody will/will not get a particular job or position because they have/do not have the appearance, personality, etc. that the employer wants, even when this should not be important
senses.zh: 长相（不）合格；性格（不）合适

examples.en: If your face fits, you'll get the job.
examples.zh: 如果你的脸型合适，你就会得到这份工作。

examples.en: It doesn't matter how well qualified you are; if your face doesn't fit, you don't stand a chance.
examples.zh: 资历多好也没用，如果人家看你不顺眼，你就不会有机会。

senses.def: somebody looks very angry
senses.zh: 某人怒气冲冲；某人满面怒容

examples.en: Mr Hibbs came in with a face like thunder.
examples.zh: 希布斯先生面带怒容走了进来。

senses.def: close to and looking at somebody

examples.en: The two have never met face to face before.
examples.zh: 两个人过去从未见过面。

examples.en: The room fell silent as she came face to face with the man who had tried to kill her.
examples.zh: 当她面对那个试图杀死她的男人时，房间里鸦雀无声。

senses.def: in a situation where you have to accept that something is true and deal with it

examples.en: She was at an early age brought face to face with the horrors of war.
examples.zh: 她年幼时就面临战争的恐怖。

senses.def: with your face and stomach facing upwards/downwards

examples.en: She lay face down on the bed.
examples.zh: 她俯卧在床上。

senses.def: with the front part or surface facing upwards/downwards
senses.zh: 正面朝上／朝下；表面冲上／冲下

examples.en: Place the card face up on the pile.
examples.zh: 把纸牌正面朝上放在这一叠的上面。

examples.en: She placed the cards face down on the table.
examples.zh: 她把牌反扣在桌上。

senses.def: to fall so that you are lying on your front
to fail completely, usually in an embarrassing way

examples.en: His next television venture fell flat on its face.
examples.zh: 他的下一个电视项目丢人现眼，彻底失败了。

senses.def: to eat a lot of food or too much food
to oppose or be the opposite of something that is usual or expected
senses.zh: 悍然不顾；公然违抗；与…相悖

examples.en: Such a proposal is flying in the face of common sense.
examples.zh: 这样的建议违反常识。

senses.def: to do something that other people think is rude or shows a lack of respect, without feeling embarrassed or ashamed
senses.zh: 居然有脸干某事；恬不知耻做某事

examples.en: I don't know how you have the face to complain after everything they've done for you!
examples.zh: 在他们为你做了那么多事之后，你还有脸抱怨，我真不知道你是怎么想的！

senses.def: to be made to look stupid

examples.en: They were left with egg on their faces when only ten people showed up.
examples.zh: 只有十人到场，他们感到很丢面子。

senses.def: annoying somebody by criticizing them or telling them what to do all the time
senses.zh: 批评某人，支使某人（使人恼火）

examples.en: Why are you always in my face?
examples.zh: 为什么你总是惹我生气？

senses.def: despite problems, difficulties, etc.

examples.en: She showed great courage in the face of danger.
examples.zh: 面对危险她表现出了巨大的勇气。

examples.en: The campaign continued in the face of great opposition.
examples.zh: 尽管遭到强烈反对，这项运动仍在继续。

senses.def: as a result of something

examples.en: He was unable to deny the charges in the face of new evidence.
examples.zh: 面对新的证据，他无法否认这些指控。

senses.def: to show in a very obvious way that you have no respect for somebody
to be forced to change from feeling pleased or satisfied to feeling disappointed or annoyed
senses.zh: 转喜为忧；得意变成失意；笑脸变为苦脸

examples.en: He’ll be laughing on the other side of his face when he reads my letter.
examples.zh: 当他读到我的信时，他会在另一边笑。

senses.def: (to have) an unhappy or disappointed expression
senses.zh: 闷闷不乐；哭丧着脸；愁眉苦脸

examples.en: He took one look at her long face and said ‘What’s wrong?’
examples.zh: 他看了一眼她拉长的脸，说：“怎么了？”

examples.en: The news for the company isn't good, to judge from the long faces in the boardroom.
examples.zh: 从董事会里的表情来看，这家公司的消息并不好。

senses.def: to look straight at somebody without feeling embarrassed or ashamed
senses.zh: （坦然或问心无愧地）直视某人，正视某人

examples.en: Can you look me in the eye and tell me you're not lying?
examples.zh: 你能问心无愧地看着我说你没撒谎吗？

examples.en: She looked her father straight in the eye and answered his question truthfully.
examples.zh: 她直视着父亲的眼睛，诚实地回答了他的问题。

examples.en: I'll never be able to look her in the face again!
examples.zh: 我再也不能坦然地面对她了！

senses.def: to be less respected or look stupid because of something you have done

examples.en: Many leaders don't want to lose face by admitting failures.
examples.zh: 许多领导人为免丢脸，不愿承认失败。

senses.def: the state of being less respected by other people or looking stupid because of something you have done

examples.en: Failure to pass the exams means a massive loss of face for the students and their parents.
examples.zh: 考试不及格对学生和家长来说意味着巨大的颜面损失。

senses.def: used to emphasize that you have particular skills or qualities
senses.zh: 并非徒有其表；不只脸蛋漂亮

examples.en: ‘I didn't know you could play the piano.’ ‘I'm not just a pretty face, you know!’
examples.zh: “我不知道你还会弹钢琴呢。”“我可不只是脸蛋儿漂亮，对吧！”

senses.def: used to say that something seems to be good, true, etc. but that this opinion may need to be changed when you know more about it

examples.en: On the face of it, it seems like a great deal.
examples.zh: 表面上看来好像很多。

examples.en: What may, on the face of it, seem obvious often turns out to be far more complicated.
examples.zh: 从表面上看，看似显而易见的事情往往事实证明要复杂得多。

senses.def: very obvious
senses.zh: 一清二楚；一目了然；显而易见

senses.def: to produce an expression on your face to show that you do not like somebody/something or in order to make somebody laugh
senses.zh: （对某人）耷拉着脸，板着脸，做鬼脸

examples.en: What are you pulling a face at now?
examples.zh: 你干吗板着脸？

examples.en: Do you think it’s funny to make faces behind my back?
examples.zh: 你觉得在我背后做鬼脸很有趣吗？

senses.def: to put on make-up
to pretend that you feel confident and happy when you do not
senses.zh: 强装自信快乐；佯装满不在乎

examples.en: I had to put on a brave face and try to show him that I wasn’t worried.
examples.zh: 我不得不装出若无其事的样子，在他面前尽量不露出愁容。

examples.en: He put a brave face on his illness.
examples.zh: 他对自己的病表现出了勇敢的态度。

senses.def: to avoid or help somebody avoid being embarrassed

examples.en: She was fired, but she saved face by telling everyone she'd resigned.
examples.zh: 她被解雇了，但她爱面子，逢人便说是她辞职了。

senses.def: to be determined to oppose somebody/something

examples.en: It is a shame that the council has set its face against the scheme.
examples.zh: 令人遗憾的是，该委员会坚决反对该计划。

senses.def: to appear among your friends or in public

examples.en: She stayed at home, afraid to show her face.
examples.zh: 她待在家里，不敢露面。

senses.def: to shut a door hard when somebody is trying to come in
senses.zh: 将某人拒之门外；让某人吃闭门羹

senses.def: to refuse to talk to somebody or meet them, in a rude way
senses.zh: 拒绝同某人谈话；拒绝见某人

senses.def: a rude way of telling somebody to be quiet or stop talking
senses.zh: （粗暴地要某人停止说话）住口，闭嘴

senses.def: an action that seems to be intended as a deliberate way of offending and showing lack of respect for somebody

examples.en: The closure of the school is a slap in the face to the local community.
examples.zh: 学校的关闭对当地社区来说不啻是一个打击。

senses.def: if you keep a straight face
senses.zh: 绷着的脸；忍着不笑的脸

senses.def: if you say something to somebody’s face

examples.en: He’s a liar, and I’ve told him so to his face many times.
examples.zh: 他是个骗子，我已经当面告诉过他很多次了。

senses.def: used to refer to a person whose name you cannot remember

examples.en: Are you still working for what's her face?
examples.zh: 你还在为那个叫什么的女人干活？

senses.def: to destroy or remove somebody/something completely
senses.zh: 使…从地球上消失；彻底消灭

senses.def: to be opposite somebody/something; to have your face or front pointing towards somebody/something or in a particular direction

examples.en: She turned and faced him.
examples.zh: 她转过身来面对着他。

examples.en: Most of the rooms face the sea.
examples.zh: 多数房间朝海。

examples.en: They face each other across the aisle.
examples.zh: 他们隔着过道面对面。

examples.en: The terrace faces south.
examples.zh: 露台朝南。

examples.en: a north-facing wall
examples.zh: 面北的墙

examples.en: a south-east-facing garden
examples.zh: 一个朝东南的花园

examples.en: to face outwards/inwards/upwards/downwards
examples.zh: 面向外/向内/向上/向下

examples.en: Lie with your palms facing upwards.
examples.zh: 请手掌朝上躺下来。

examples.en: Which direction are you facing?
examples.zh: 你面朝哪个方向？

senses.def: if you face

examples.en: Farmers face serious challenges in these conditions.
examples.zh: 在这种情况下，农民面临重重难关。

examples.en: We are facing a financial crisis.
examples.zh: 我们正面临一次财政[金融]危机。

examples.en: to face charges/trial
examples.zh: 被指控／审判

examples.en: the problems faced by homeless people
examples.zh: 无家可归者面临的问题

examples.en: The project faces numerous difficulties.
examples.zh: 该项目面临诸多困难。

examples.en: They face competition from foreign imports.
examples.zh: 他们面临着来自外国进口产品的竞争。

examples.en: She has faced criticism from some within her party.
examples.zh: 她面临党内一些人的批评。

examples.en: We look at the issues facing schools today.
examples.zh: 我们会探讨一下现今学校遇到的问题。

examples.en: the challenges/problems that face the country
examples.zh: 国家面临的挑战/问题

examples.en: We are faced with the prospect of defeat.
examples.zh: 我们或会落败。

senses.group: somebody/something difficult 难对付的人／事物

senses.def: to accept that a difficult situation exists, although you would prefer not to

examples.en: It's time to face reality—we failed.
examples.zh: 该正视现实了——我们失败了。

examples.en: It's not always easy to face the truth.
examples.zh: 承认事实并不总是一件容易的事。

examples.en: I did something wrong and I will face the consequences.
examples.zh: 我做了错事，我将承担后果。

examples.en: She had to face the fact that her life had changed forever.
examples.zh: 她得正视她的生活已永远改变了这一事实。

examples.en: Face facts—she isn't coming back.
examples.zh: 面对现实吧，她不会回来了。

examples.en: Let's face it, we're not going to win.
examples.zh: 我们得承认，我们赢不了啦。

senses.group: somebody/something difficult 难对付的人／事物

senses.def: if you can’t face

examples.en: I just can't face work today.
examples.zh: 我今天就是没法工作。

examples.en: He wasn't able to face the washing up.
examples.zh: 他无法面对洗碗。

examples.en: I can't face seeing them.
examples.zh: 我真不愿意见到他们。

examples.en: She could never face arguing with him.
examples.zh: 她从来不敢和他争论。

senses.group: somebody/something difficult 难对付的人／事物

senses.def: to talk to or deal with somebody, even though this is difficult or unpleasant

examples.en: How can I face Tom? He'll be so disappointed.
examples.zh: 我怎样才能和汤姆谈呢？他会很失望的。

senses.group: somebody/something difficult 难对付的人／事物

senses.def: to cover a surface with another material

examples.en: a brick building faced with stone
examples.zh: 石料贴面的砖建筑物

senses.def: to accept and deal with criticism or punishment for something you have done

examples.en: The others all ran off, leaving me to face the music.
examples.zh: 其他人都跑掉了，留下我来挨罚。

examples.zh: 学校正在升级其户外游乐设施。

examples.zh: 该功能允许用户在屏幕上输入各种形式的文本，从而创建真正的报纸页面。

examples.zh: 她有语言天赋。

examples.zh: 大英图书馆里有这份文件的复制本。

examples.zh: 首先，说说健康饮食的几点基本事实。

examples.zh: 公司正在亏本，这难道不是事实吗？

examples.zh: 众所周知，狗嗅觉敏锐。

examples.zh: 我肯定她卷入了非法活动。

examples.zh: 指控别人之前，请先弄清事实。

examples.zh: 我们相处得不好，这是事实。

examples.zh: 法官责令双方律师要紧扣案情。

examples.zh: 这个故事是根据真人真事写的。

examples.en: Is the account fact or fiction?
examples.zh: 这种说法是真是假？

examples.en: This is simply historical fact.
examples.zh: 这就是史实。

examples.zh: 区分事实和观点很重要。

examples.zh: 我再也不能无视他不高兴这一事实了。

examples.zh: 我们不会隐瞒我们犯过错误的事实。

examples.zh: 尽管她系了安全带，还是被猛然前抛。

senses.def: to not be successful in achieving something

examples.zh: 许多规定饮食因单调乏味都不奏效。

examples.zh: 他们的所有尝试均以失败告终。

examples.zh: 我未能说服她。

examples.en: He failed in his bid for the presidency.
examples.zh: 他竞选总统失败了。

examples.zh: 该部门未能达到其销售目标。

examples.zh: 他们承诺了很多，但完全没有兑现。

examples.en: The song can't fail to be a hit (= definitely will be a hit).
examples.zh: 这首歌不可能不流行起来。

senses.def: to not pass a test or an exam; to decide that somebody/something has not passed a test or an exam

examples.en: What will you do if you fail?
examples.zh: 如果你考试不及格，你打算怎样做？

examples.en: He failed his driving test.
examples.zh: 他驾驶执照考试不及格。

examples.en: Students who fail the exam can retake it.
examples.zh: 考试不及格的学生可以重考。

examples.en: She was disqualified after failing a drugs test.
examples.zh: 她药检未通过，被取消了资格。

examples.en: The restaurant failed a hygiene inspection.
examples.zh: 该餐厅未通过卫生检查。

examples.en: The examiners failed over half the candidates.
examples.zh: 主考人员评定，半数以上考生不及格。

senses.def: to not do something

examples.zh: 人们未能认识到她的才能。

examples.en: His article fails to mention that he actually supported this change.
examples.zh: 他的文章没有提到他实际上支持这一改变。

examples.en: If you fail to comply, you can be fined.
examples.zh: 如果您不遵守规定，您可能会被罚款。

examples.en: The government has failed to provide the needed resources.
examples.zh: 政府未能提供所需的资源。

examples.zh: 这种评论总会惹恼他。

examples.en: I fail to see (= I don't understand) why you won't even give it a try.
examples.zh: 我不懂为什么你连试一试都不愿意。

examples.en: She cannot fail to (= must) be aware of the situation.
examples.zh: 她不会不知道情况如此。

examples.en: They failed in their duty to protect the public.
examples.zh: 他们没有尽到保护公众的责任。

examples.zh: 我的自行车下山至中途车闸失灵了。

examples.zh: 空调系统在一年里最热的那天瘫痪了。

examples.zh: 不幸的是，他的肾脏衰竭了。

examples.zh: 她的视力日渐衰退。

senses.zh: 使失望；有负于；无能为力

examples.zh: 他失去工作以后，感到辜负了家庭。

examples.zh: 她想勇敢，但却鼓不起勇气。

examples.zh: 上个夏季庄稼又歉收了。

examples.zh: 雨量不足，河流干涸。

examples.zh: 如果所有别的办法都不行，你总还可以卖掉摩托车。

examples.zh: 这项计划的成败取决于你。

examples.zh: 她还在努力适应婚姻失败的事实。

examples.zh: 我的一切努力最后都无济于事。

examples.zh: 他们争取合同的努力以惨败告终。

examples.zh: 整个事情彻底失败了。

examples.zh: 一个团体应该从成功与失败的经验中学习。

examples.zh: 他当教师并不成功。

examples.zh: 不遵守规章制度将被起诉。

examples.zh: 该城市缺乏有效的公共交通系统

examples.zh: 政府未能在能源部门进行改革

examples.zh: 肾/呼吸衰竭

examples.zh: 生产因机械故障而受到阻碍。

examples.zh: 停电使一切陷入黑暗。

examples.zh: 撞车事故的原因被认定是发动机故障。

examples.en: There has been an alarming increase in business failures.
examples.zh: 企业倒闭数字的上升令人担忧。

examples.en: Are we going to see more closures or failures in the ISP business?
examples.zh: 我们是否会看到更多 ISP 业务倒闭或倒闭？

examples.en: Business failures rose by 30% in 2023.
examples.zh: 2023 年，企业倒闭率增加 30%。

examples.en: Bad weather has resulted in crop failure.
examples.zh: 恶劣的天气导致农作物歉收。

examples.en: I would fain do as you ask.
examples.zh: 听候你的吩咐。

senses.def: that cannot be clearly seen, heard or smelt

examples.en: a faint glow/glimmer/light
examples.zh: 微弱的光亮／闪光／光

examples.en: a faint smell of perfume
examples.zh: 淡淡的香水味

examples.en: We saw the faint outline of the mountain through the mist.
examples.zh: 我们透过薄雾看见了朦胧的山峦轮廓。

examples.en: We could hear their voices growing fainter as they walked down the road.
examples.zh: 他们沿路走远时我们听见他们的说话声逐渐模糊。

examples.zh: 他的呼吸变得微弱了。

examples.zh: 她的病还有一点点希望可以治愈。

examples.en: They don't have the faintest chance of winning.
examples.zh: 他们毫无获胜的可能。

senses.def: not enthusiastic

examples.en: a faint show of resistance
examples.zh: 软弱无力装模作样的抵抗

examples.en: a faint smile
examples.zh: 淡淡一笑

examples.en: She suddenly felt faint.
examples.zh: 她突然感到快要昏倒。

examples.zh: 那些走路的人饿得头昏眼花。

senses.zh: 用冷漠的赞扬贬低；寓贬于褒；名褒实贬

senses.zh: 完全不知道；一无所知；茫无头绪

examples.en: I didn't have the faintest idea what you meant.
examples.zh: 我一点也不明白你的意思。

examples.en: He didn’t have the faintest idea how the others would react.
examples.zh: 他完全不知道其他人会有什么反应。

senses.def: to become unconscious when not enough blood is going to your brain, usually because of the heat, a shock, etc.

examples.en: to faint from hunger
examples.zh: 饿昏过去

examples.en: Suddenly the woman in front of me fainted.
examples.zh: 我面前的女人突然昏倒了。

examples.en: I'm nearly fainting with the heat in here.
examples.zh: 这里太热了，我快要晕倒了。

examples.en: I almost fainted (= I was very surprised) when she told me.
examples.zh: 她告诉我时我吃惊得差点儿昏过去。

senses.def: the state of becoming unconscious

examples.zh: 他跌倒在地，昏死过去。

senses.def: to praise somebody/something only a little, in order to show that you do not really like them/it

examples.en: He didn’t have the faintest idea how the others would react.
examples.zh: 他完全不知道其他人会有什么反应。

senses.def: not being confident or brave enough; afraid of failing

examples.en: He tried not to appear faint-hearted.
examples.zh: 他尽量不显得胆怯。

senses.def: in a way that cannot be clearly seen, heard or smelt

examples.en: She could faintly hear music playing.
examples.zh: 她隐隐约约听到音乐在演奏。

examples.en: It smelled faintly of smoke.
examples.zh: 闻起来有淡淡的烟味。

examples.zh: 微弱的火光

senses.zh: 微弱地 在某种程度上

examples.zh: 他显得有点难堪。

examples.zh: 整个事情有点可笑。

senses.def: in a way that is not enthusiastic

examples.zh: 她淡淡一笑。

senses.def: the state of feeling weak and tired and likely to become unconscious

examples.zh: 副作用包括恶心和昏厥。

senses.def: acceptable and appropriate in a particular situation
senses.zh: 可以接受的；合乎情理的；公道的

examples.en: a fair deal/wage/price
examples.zh: 公平交易；合理的工资；公道的价格

examples.en: The punishment was very fair.
examples.zh: 这个处罚很公正。

examples.en: In the end, a draw was a fair result.
examples.zh: 最终，平局是一个公平的结果。

examples.en: I give you fair warning, I’m not always this generous.
examples.zh: 我警告你，我并不总是这么慷慨。

examples.zh: 我们希望以对她公平的方式解决这个问题。

examples.en: Was it really fair to him to ask him to do all the work?
examples.zh: 要他做所有的工作对他真的公平吗？

examples.en: Moving to a new city wouldn't have been fair on the kids.
examples.zh: 搬到一个新城市对孩子们来说并不公平。

examples.en: It's not fair on the students to keep changing the timetable.
examples.zh: 不断改动时间表，这样对待学生不恰当。

examples.en: It's only fair to add that they were not told about the problem until the last minute.
examples.zh: 要补充说明以下情况才合理，即他们是最后一刻才获知这个问题。

examples.en: I think it is fair to say that they are pleased with this latest offer.
examples.zh: 我认为恰当地说，他们对最新的这一次提议很满意。

examples.en: It's fair that they should give us something in return.
examples.zh: 他们理应给我们一些回报。

examples.en: To be fair, she behaved better than we expected.
examples.zh: 说句公道话，她表现得比我们预期的要好。

examples.en: ‘You should really have asked me first.’ ‘Right, okay, fair comment.’
examples.zh: “你本来应该先问我。”“对，是的，是这样。”

senses.def: treating everyone equally and according to the rules or law

examples.zh: 雨不停地下着。

examples.zh: 他们被落石砸伤了。

examples.zh: 这些书有几本掉到了地上。

examples.zh: 标签准是掉了。

examples.zh: 小孩中有一个掉进了河里。

examples.zh: 她在冰上滑了一跤。

examples.zh: 一棵树倒了，差点砸到他的车。

examples.zh: 我摔倒了，划破了膝盖。

examples.zh: 房子看起来好像就要倒塌似的。

examples.zh: 今天股票市场价格继续下跌。

examples.zh: 夜间温度陡降。

examples.zh: 下降的出生率可能会对未来的经济增长产生影响。

examples.zh: 声誉的上升和下降有多种原因。

examples.zh: 他们的利润减少了 30%。

examples.zh: 股价下跌了 30 便士。

examples.zh: 石油销量下降近 11%。

examples.zh: 不久后她就病倒了，而且未能痊愈。

examples.zh: 特洛伊城最终被希腊人攻陷。

examples.zh: 突然一片鸦雀无声。

examples.zh: 今年我的生日适逢星期一。

senses.def: to move in a particular direction or come in a particular position
senses.zh: （向某方向）移动；落（在某位置上）

examples.en: My eye fell on (= I suddenly saw) a curious object.
examples.zh: 我突然见到了一样奇怪的东西。

examples.en: Which syllable does the stress fall on?
examples.zh: 重音在哪个音节？

examples.en: A shadow fell across her face.
examples.zh: 一片阴影掠过她的脸庞。

senses.def: to belong to a particular class, group or area of responsibility
senses.zh: 属于（某类、群体、责任范围）

examples.en: Out of over 400 staff there are just seven that fall into this category.
examples.zh: 400 多个职员中只有 7 人属于这一类。

examples.en: This case falls outside my jurisdiction.
examples.zh: 这个案件不属于我的管辖范围。

examples.en: This falls under the heading of scientific research.
examples.zh: 这一项属于科研类目。

senses.group: belong to group 属于群体

senses.def: an act of falling

examples.en: I had a bad fall and broke my arm.
examples.zh: 我重重地跌了一跤，摔断了手臂。

examples.en: She was killed in a fall from a horse.
examples.zh: 她从马背上掉下来摔死了。

senses.def: an amount of snow, rain, rocks, etc. that falls or has fallen

examples.en: a heavy fall of snow
examples.zh: 一场大雪

examples.en: a rock fall
examples.zh: 岩崩

senses.def: the season of the year between summer and winter, when leaves change colour and the weather becomes colder

examples.en: in the fall of 2023
examples.zh: 2023年秋季

examples.en: last fall
examples.zh: 去年秋天

examples.en: Cool, damp fall weather brings out snails.
examples.zh: 凉爽潮湿的秋季天气催生了蜗牛。

examples.en: He returned to school a month into the fall semester.
examples.zh: 他在秋季学期开始后一个月重返校园。

senses.def: a decrease in size, number, rate or level
senses.zh: （大小）减小；（数量）减少；（比率、水平）降低

examples.en: Share prices suffered a slight fall yesterday.
examples.zh: 股票价格昨日微幅下挫。

examples.en: a sharp fall in prices
examples.zh: 价格的骤降

examples.en: a steep/dramatic fall in profits
examples.zh: 利润的骤降

examples.en: a 3 per cent fall in unemployment
examples.zh: 失业人数减少百分之三

senses.def: a loss of political, economic, etc. power or success; the loss or defeat of a city, country, etc. in war
senses.zh: （政权的）垮台；（经济的）崩溃；（城市、国家等的）沦陷，灭亡

examples.en: the fall of the Roman Empire
examples.zh: 罗马帝国的灭亡

examples.en: the rise and fall of British industry
examples.zh: 英国工业的兴衰

examples.en: the fall of Berlin
examples.zh: 柏林被攻陷

senses.def: a situation in which a person, an organization, etc. loses the respect of other people because they have done something wrong

examples.en: the TV preacher’s spectacular fall from grace
examples.zh: 电视布道者威信的遽降

examples.en: His diary charts his dramatic fall from grace.
examples.zh: 他的日记记录了他如何突如其来地丧失了权力和尊崇。

senses.group: loss of respect 丧失尊敬

senses.def: a large amount of water falling down from a height

examples.en: The falls upstream are full of salmon.
examples.zh: 上游瀑布一带盛产鲑鱼。

examples.en: Niagara Falls
examples.zh: 尼亚加拉瀑布

senses.def: the way in which something falls or happens

examples.en: the fall of the dice
examples.zh: 骰子的掷出

examples.en: the dark fall of her hair (= the way her hair hangs down)
examples.zh: 她那垂泻的黑发

senses.group: way something falls/happens 下落；发生

senses.def: the occasion when Adam and Eve did not obey God and had to leave the Garden of Eden
senses.zh: 人类堕落（指亚当和夏娃违背上帝意旨而被迫离开伊甸园）

senses.def: to be doing something that involves risks and that may end in disaster
senses.zh: 做事莽撞；做招致风险的事

senses.def: to stop somebody from falling onto something hard
senses.zh: 缓和某人的跌势；防止某人跌得很重

examples.en: Luckily, a bush broke his fall.
examples.zh: 幸亏有灌木接着，他摔得不重。

senses.def: if you have too high an opinion of yourself or your abilities, something will happen to make you look stupid
to accept responsibility or punishment for something that you did not do, or did not do alone
senses.zh: 替…承担责任；成为…的替罪羊

examples.en: He took the fall for his boss and resigned.
examples.zh: 他成了老板的替罪羊，辞职了。

examples.en: Who will take the fall for the scandal?
examples.zh: 谁将为丑闻承担责任？

examples.en: Someone has to take the fall.
examples.zh: 总得有人背黑锅。

note.zh: 含 fall 的习语，都可在该等习语中的名词及形容词相关词条找到，如 fall by the wayside 在词条 wayside 下。

senses.def: to be doing something that involves risks and that may end in disaster

examples.zh: 幸亏有灌木接着，他摔得不重。

examples.zh: 谁将为丑闻承担责任？

examples.en: Someone has to take the fall.
examples.zh: 总得有人背黑锅。

senses.def: to fail to be or to get either of two choices, both of which would have been acceptable
to fail or be unable to make progress

examples.en: Many clubs fall by the wayside for financial reasons.
examples.zh: 许多俱乐部因经济原因难以为继而关闭。

examples.en: Proposals for the new service fell by the wayside through lack of public support.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏公众支持，建立新机构的建议半途而废了。

senses.def: if a joke, a story, or an event falls flat
senses.zh: （笑话、故事、事件等）完全失败，根本未达到预期效果

examples.en: Without Jem, the whole evening would have fallen flat.
examples.zh: 如果没有杰姆，整个晚上就会平淡无奇。

senses.def: to fall so that you are lying on your front
to fail completely, usually in an embarrassing way

examples.en: His next television venture fell flat on its face.
examples.zh: 他的下一个电视项目丢人现眼，彻底失败了。

senses.def: to get into trouble with a person or an organization because of doing something wrong or illegal
senses.zh: （因做错事或不法行为）与…发生麻烦，与…产生纠葛，冒犯

examples.en: to fall foul of the law
examples.zh: 触犯了法律

senses.def: to lose the trust or respect that people have for you, especially by doing something bad or morally wrong
senses.zh: （尤指因做了错事或不道德之事而）失去信任，失去尊重，失去恩宠

senses.zh: 受制于某人；被某人控制

examples.en: The town fell into enemy hands.
examples.zh: 那个小镇落入敌人手里了。

examples.en: We don't want this document falling into the wrong hands.
examples.zh: 我们不希望这份文件落入不当的人手中。

examples.en: After the war, the hotel fell into the hands of an American consortium.
examples.zh: 战后，酒店落入美国财团手中。

senses.zh: （和某人）合上步伐，步调一致起来

examples.en: He caught her up and fell into step beside her.
examples.zh: 他赶上她，跟着她的步子往前走。

senses.def: to decrease quickly and suddenly in quantity or quality

examples.en: Sales fell off a cliff in the first quarter of the year.
examples.zh: 第一季度的销售额直线下降。

senses.def: to be ignored or not noticed by other people
senses.zh: 不被理睬；不被注意；被置若罔闻

examples.en: Her advice fell on deaf ears.
examples.zh: 她的忠告没有受到重视。

senses.def: to fail to produce the result or the effect that you hope for; to have little success
senses.zh: 未产生预期的结果（或效果）；没有开花结果

examples.en: His charming smile fell on stony ground with her.
examples.zh: 他迷人的笑容和她一起落在了石头地上。

examples.en: The peace initiatives have already fallen on stony ground.
examples.zh: 和平倡议已经陷入僵局。

examples.en: The hotel fell far short of their expectations.
examples.zh: 旅馆远没有他们预期的那么好。

examples.zh: 泰勒的解决方案没有达到目标。

senses.def: to become sick

examples.en: A week later he fell sick and died.
examples.zh: 一周后，他生病去世了。

examples.en: He fell sick with yellow fever.
examples.zh: 他患了黄热病。

senses.def: to become very old and in bad condition because of long use

examples.en: Our car is falling to pieces, we've had it so long.
examples.zh: 我们的汽车破旧不堪，我们已用它很久了。

examples.en: My old dictionary is falling to pieces.
examples.zh: 我的旧词典都快散架了。

senses.def: to stop working; to be destroyed

examples.en: He's worried the business will fall to pieces without him.
examples.zh: 他担心没有了他企业将会倒闭。

senses.def: to become somebody’s task or responsibility
senses.zh: 成为某人的任务（或责任）；落到某人肩上

examples.en: It fell to her lot to organize the Christmas party.
examples.zh: 筹办圣诞聚会的责任落到了她的身上。

fall to somebody’s lot (to do something).word: fall to somebody’s lot (to do something)

senses.def: to be injured, cheated, damaged or killed by somebody/something

examples.en: Many plants have fallen victim to the sudden frost.
examples.zh: 霜冻来得很突然，很多植物都成为牺牲品。

senses.def: to laugh a lot
senses.zh: 笑得前仰后合；笑破肚皮

examples.en: We all fell about laughing.
examples.zh: 我们都笑得前仰后合。

senses.def: to be in very bad condition so that parts are breaking off

examples.en: My car is falling apart.
examples.zh: 我的汽车要散架了。

senses.def: to have so many problems that it is no longer possible to exist or function

examples.en: Their marriage finally fell apart.
examples.zh: 他们的婚姻终于破裂了。

examples.en: The deal fell apart when we failed to agree on a price.
examples.zh: 我们在价格上未能达成一致意见，生意吹了。

senses.def: to become gradually fewer or smaller; to disappear

examples.en: His supporters fell away as his popularity declined.
examples.zh: 随着他的名望下降，他的支持者渐渐离他而去。

examples.en: The market for their products fell away to almost nothing.
examples.zh: 他们产品的市场几乎萎缩到零。

examples.en: All our doubts fell away.
examples.zh: 我们的一切疑虑都烟消云散。

examples.en: The houses fell away as we left the city.
examples.zh: 随着我们离城市越来越远，房屋也逐渐在视线中消失了。

senses.def: to move or turn back

examples.en: The enemy fell back as our troops advanced.
examples.zh: 我军向前挺进，敌军向后撤退。

senses.def: to decrease in value or amount

examples.en: Share prices fell back after brisk early trading.
examples.zh: 在经历了早市的活跃之后，股价下跌了。

senses.def: to go to somebody for support; to have something to use when you are in difficulty
senses.zh: 求助于；借助于；转而依靠

examples.en: I have a little money in the bank to fall back on.
examples.zh: 我在银行还有一点钱，需要时可以动用。

examples.en: She fell back on her usual excuse of having no time.
examples.zh: 她以惯用的借口推说没有时间。

senses.def: to fail to keep level with somebody/something

examples.en: She soon fell behind the leaders.
examples.zh: 她很快就落在领先者的后面。

senses.def: to not pay or do something at the right time

examples.en: They had fallen behind on their mortgage repayments.
examples.zh: 他们拖欠了按揭还款。

examples.en: He's fallen behind with his school work again.
examples.zh: 他又没有按时做学校作业。

senses.def: to be shown to be not true or not good enough
senses.zh: 不实；不能令人满意；不够好

examples.en: And that's where the theory falls down.
examples.zh: 这就是该理论的不足之处。

senses.def: to be strongly attracted to somebody; to fall in love with somebody

examples.en: They fell for each other instantly.
examples.zh: 他俩一见钟情。

senses.def: to be tricked into believing something that is not true

examples.en: I'm surprised you fell for that trick.
examples.zh: 我感到惊奇，你竟中了那个诡计。

senses.def: a person who is blamed or punished for something wrong that another person has done

examples.en: He realized he’d been set up as the fall guy.
examples.zh: 他意识到自己蒙冤成了替罪羊。

senses.def: if soldiers fall in

examples.en: The sergeant ordered his men to fall in.
examples.zh: 中士命令士兵集合。

senses.def: to agree to something

examples.en: She fell in with my idea at once.
examples.zh: 她立刻同意了我的主意。

senses.def: to meet a person or group by chance and then become involved with them

examples.en: He ended up falling in with a crowd of musicians and actors.
examples.zh: 他最终结识了一群音乐家和演员。

senses.def: to be able to be divided into something

examples.en: My talk falls naturally into three parts.
examples.zh: 我的讲话可以自然分成三个部分。

senses.def: to start doing something that you had not planned to do

examples.en: He says that he fell into politics by chance.
examples.zh: 他说他从政是偶然的。

senses.def: to decrease in quantity or quality

examples.en: Attendance at my lectures has fallen off considerably.
examples.zh: 听我讲课的学生大大减少了。

senses.def: a reduction in the number, amount or quality of something

examples.en: a recent fall-off in sales
examples.zh: 近来销售量的减少

senses.def: to attack or take hold of somebody/something with a lot of energy and enthusiasm

examples.en: They fell on him with sticks.
examples.zh: 他们用棍棒袭击他。

examples.en: The children fell on the food and ate it greedily.
examples.zh: 孩子们扑向食物，狼吞虎咽地吃起来。

senses.def: to be the responsibility of somebody

examples.en: The full cost of the wedding fell on us.
examples.zh: 整个婚礼费用由我们负担了。

senses.def: to become loose and drop

examples.en: His hair is falling out.
examples.zh: 他的头发在脱落。

examples.en: My tooth fell out.
examples.zh: 我的牙齿掉了。

senses.def: if soldiers fall out
to have an argument with somebody so that you are no longer friendly with them
to stop working suddenly

examples.en: My spreadsheet keeps falling over.
examples.zh: 我的电子表格程序不断出故障。

senses.def: to hit your foot against something/somebody when you are walking and fall, or almost fall

examples.en: I rushed for the door and fell over the cat in the hallway.
examples.zh: 我冲向门口，在过道被猫绊了一跤。

senses.def: to try very hard or want very much to do something
senses.zh: 特别卖力；迫不及待；煞费苦心；不遗余力

examples.en: He was falling over himself to be nice to me.
examples.zh: 他尽力对我友好。

senses.def: to not be completed, or not happen

examples.en: Our plans fell through because of lack of money.
examples.zh: 我们的计划由于缺钱而落空了。

senses.def: to become the duty or responsibility of somebody

examples.en: With his partner away, all the work now fell to him.
examples.zh: 他的搭档走了以后，工作现在全落在他的身上。

examples.en: It fell to me to inform her of her son's death.
examples.zh: 把她儿子的死讯告诉她的差事落在了我的头上。

senses.def: to begin to do something

examples.en: She fell to brooding about what had happened to her.
examples.zh: 她开始愤愤地思忖着自己的遭遇。

senses.def: to attack or take hold of somebody/something with a lot of energy and enthusiasm

examples.en: They fell on him with sticks.
examples.zh: 他们用棍棒袭击他。

examples.en: The children fell on the food and ate it greedily.
examples.zh: 孩子们扑向食物，狼吞虎咽地吃起来。

senses.def: to be the responsibility of somebody

examples.en: The full cost of the wedding fell on us.
examples.zh: 整个婚礼费用由我们负担了。

senses.def: to be lucky in finding yourself in a good situation, or in getting out of a difficult situation
senses.zh: 特别走运；安然脱离困境；幸免于难

examples.en: You landed on your feet, getting such a well-paid job with so little experience.
examples.zh: 你站稳了脚跟，在经验很少的情况下得到了一份高薪工作。

examples.en: Jim’s always getting himself in trouble, but he usually seems to fall on his feet.
examples.zh: 吉姆总是给自己惹麻烦，但他似乎总是能站稳脚跟。

senses.def: when somebody/something falls
senses.zh: 不被注意，遭遗漏，被遗忘

examples.en: We tried to contact all former students, but one or two slipped through the cracks.
examples.zh: 我们试图联系所有以前的学生，但一两个人漏掉了。

senses.def: if something complicated or difficult to understand falls

examples.en: Then I found his diary and it all began to fall into place.
examples.zh: 然后我找到了他的日记，一切都开始步入正轨。

senses.def: wrong; based on a false idea

examples.en: a fallacious argument
examples.zh: 谬误的论证

senses.def: a false idea that many people believe is true

examples.en: It is a fallacy to say that the camera never lies.
examples.zh: 说照相机绝不骗人，这是谬见。

senses.def: a false way of thinking about something
senses.zh: 思维方式谬误；谬误推理

examples.en: He detected the fallacy of her argument.
examples.zh: 他发现了她论据中的推理谬误。

senses.def: a plan or course of action that is ready to be used in an emergency if other things fail

examples.en: What's our fallback if they don't come up with the money?
examples.zh: 要是他们拿不出钱，我们如何应变？

examples.en: We need a fallback position if they won't do the job.
examples.zh: 如果他们不干这个工作，我们就需要一个应变的方案。

senses.def: a way of referring to a woman who had a sexual relationship with somebody who was not her husband
senses.zh: 堕落的妇女（旧时指有奸情的）

senses.def: the ability to make mistakes or be wrong

examples.en: human fallibility
examples.zh: 人的易错性

senses.def: able to make mistakes or be wrong

examples.en: Memory is selective and fallible.
examples.zh: 记忆有选择性而且会出错。

examples.en: All human beings are fallible.
examples.zh: 人人都难免犯错误。

senses.def: a reduction in the number, amount or quality of something
a situation where people are no longer friends, because they disagree or have had an argument

examples.en: Dave and I had a falling-out.
examples.zh: 戴夫和我闹翻了。

senses.def: a small meteor
one of the two tubes in the body of a woman or female animal along which eggs pass from the ovaries
dangerous radioactive
the bad results of a situation or an action

examples.en: the political fallout of the current crisis
examples.zh: 当前危机的政治影响

senses.def: not used for growing crops, especially so that the quality of the land will improve

examples.en: Farmers are now paid to let their land lie fallow.
examples.zh: 如今农民让土地休耕能得到回报。

senses.def: when nothing is created or produced; not successful
senses.zh: 休闲的；休眠的；不成功的

examples.en: Contemporary dance is coming onto the arts scene again after a long fallow period.
examples.zh: 当代舞蹈经过一段长时期销声匿迹以后现在又回到了艺术舞台。

senses.def: a small European deer
wrong; not correct or true
senses.zh: 错误的；不正确的；不真实的

examples.en: A whale is a fish. True or false?
examples.zh: 鲸鱼是鱼，对还是错？

examples.en: Predictions of an early improvement in the housing market proved false.
examples.zh: 认为房屋市场很快就好转的预测结果证明是错误的。

examples.en: She gave false information to the insurance company.
examples.zh: 她向保险公司提供了不真实的资料。

examples.en: He used a false name to get the job.
examples.zh: 他用假名得到了这份工作。

examples.en: His career was ruined by false accusations.
examples.zh: 他的职业生涯因不实指控而毁掉。

examples.en: The allegations are completely false.
examples.zh: 这些指控完全是错误的。

examples.en: This claim is simply false.
examples.zh: 这一说法是完全错误的。

examples.en: The law can punish knowingly false statements.
examples.zh: 这项法律可对故意作出的虚假陈述施加惩罚。

senses.def: not natural

examples.en: false teeth/eyelashes
examples.zh: 假牙；假睫毛

examples.en: a false beard
examples.zh: 假胡子

senses.def: not real or what somebody claims it is, but made to look real to cheat people

examples.en: He had been travelling with a false passport.
examples.zh: 他一直持假护照旅行。

examples.en: The case had a false bottom where documents or even a small radio could be hidden.
examples.zh: 那箱子有个假底，里面能够藏文件，甚至藏个小收音机。

senses.def: wrong or not accurate, because it is based on something that is not true or correct

examples.en: a false argument/assumption/belief
examples.zh: 错误的论据／假设／信念

examples.en: to give a false impression of wealth
examples.zh: 给人以富有的错觉

examples.en: to lull somebody into a false sense of security (= make somebody feel safe when they are really in danger)
examples.zh: 哄某人产生虚假的安全感

examples.en: They didn't want to raise any false hopes, but they believed her husband had escaped capture.
examples.zh: 他们并不想让人心存奢望，但是他们相信她的丈夫已逃脱追捕。

examples.en: Buying a cheap computer is a false economy (= will not actually save you money).
examples.zh: 买廉价计算机看似省钱，但其实并不划算。

examples.en: If you don't do the test right, it can lead to false positives.
examples.zh: 如果测试不正确，可能会导致误报。

senses.def: not real or sincere

examples.en: false modesty
examples.zh: 假谦虚

examples.en: She flashed him a false smile of congratulation.
examples.zh: 她向他虚情假意地微微一笑表示祝贺。

senses.def: not faithful

examples.en: a false lover
examples.zh: 不忠诚的情人

senses.def: by pretending to be something that you are not, in order to gain some advantage for yourself
senses.zh: 靠欺诈手段；以虚假的借口

examples.en: She was accused of obtaining money under false pretences.
examples.zh: 她被控诈骗钱财。

senses.def: to give the impression of being sincere/true or not sincere/true
senses.zh: 给人以真实（或空洞、虚假）的印象

examples.en: It may seem a strange story but it rings true to me.
examples.zh: 这个故事也许显得离奇，但我却觉得很真实。

examples.en: His expressions of support rang rather hollow.
examples.zh: 他表达的支持听起来相当空洞。

examples.en: His promise rang hollow.
examples.zh: 他的承诺听起来很空洞。

senses.def: by pretending to be something that you are not, in order to gain some advantage for yourself
senses.zh: 靠欺诈手段；以虚假的借口

senses.def: to give the impression of being sincere/true or not sincere/true

examples.zh: 这个故事也许显得离奇，但我却觉得很真实。

examples.en: His expressions of support rang rather hollow.
examples.zh: 他表达的支持听起来相当空洞。
