examples.zh: 他的承诺听起来很空洞。

intro.en: These words all describe things that are not real, or not naturally produced or grown.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指假的、非天然的、人造的。

items.def: made or produced to copy something natural; not real:
items.zh: 指人工的、人造的、假的

examples.en: artificial flowers
examples.zh: 假花

items.def: made by combining chemical substances rather than being produced naturally by plants or animals:
items.zh: 指人工合成的

examples.en: synthetic drugs
examples.zh: 合成药物

items.def: not natural:
items.zh: 指非天然的、非天生的、假的

examples.en: false teeth
examples.zh: 假牙

items.def: made by people; not natural:
items.zh: 指人造的、非天然的

examples.en: man-made fibres such as nylon
examples.zh: 尼龙之类的人造纤维

items.def: made to look like something else; not real:
items.zh: 指仿制的、人造的、假的

examples.en: a fake-fur jacket
examples.zh: 一件人造毛皮的短上衣

items.def: [only before noun] made to look like something else; not real:
items.zh: 指仿制的、人造的、假的

examples.en: She would never wear imitation pearls.
examples.zh: 她绝不会戴假珍珠。

senses.def: a warning about a danger that does not happen; a belief that something bad is going to happen, when it is not

examples.en: The fire service was called out but it was a false alarm.
examples.zh: 消防人员接到报警后出动，但这是假报火警。

senses.def: a person who has a basic knowledge of a language, but has started to study it again from the beginning
senses.zh: 二次初学者，非真实初学者（对某一语言虽已有基本知识但又从头学习）

senses.def: a situation in which you think that something good is going to happen but it does not

examples.en: a false dawn for the economy
examples.zh: 经济复苏的假象

senses.def: a political or military action that is organized in such a way that it appears that it was carried out by a different country or group that was not in fact responsible for it
senses.zh: 假旗行动（政治或军事行动的发动者隐匿身份，将责任转嫁给其他国家或团体）

examples.en: False-flag attacks were used to justify the invasion.
examples.zh: “假旗”攻击被用作入侵的借口。

examples.en: The military government has repeatedly staged false-flag operations to justify retaliation against rebel groups.
examples.zh: 军政府已多次发动假旗行动，借此为针对叛军的报复行为辩护。

examples.en: It has been claimed that the 2020 shooting was a false flag carried out by contracted mercenaries.
examples.zh: 有人声称，2020 年枪击案是由合同雇佣兵执行的假旗行动。

senses.def: a person who seems to be your friend, but who in fact cannot be trusted
a word in a foreign language that looks similar to a word in your own language, but has a different meaning

examples.en: The English word ‘sensible’ and the French word ‘sensible’ are false friends.
examples.zh: 英语的 sensible 一词和法语的 sensible 一词同形异义。

senses.def: the crime of illegally keeping somebody as a prisoner somewhere
senses.zh: 私禁；非法拘禁；非法拘留

senses.def: a memory of something that did not actually happen
senses.zh: （对事实上并未发生的事情的）伪记忆

senses.def: an action that is not allowed or not recommended and that may cause a bad result
senses.zh: （可能引起不良后果的）不允行为，不明智行动

examples.en: One false move and the bomb might blow up.
examples.zh: 一步弄错，炸弹就可能会爆炸。

senses.def: any of the lower ribs
an unsuccessful attempt to begin something
senses.zh: 不成功的开端；起步失误

examples.en: After a number of false starts, she finally found a job she liked.
examples.zh: 她起初失败了几次，之后终于找到了喜欢的工作。

senses.def: a situation when somebody taking part in a race starts before the official signal has been given
a set of artificial teeth used by somebody who has lost their natural teeth
the state of not being true; the act of telling a lie

examples.en: to test the truth or falsehood of her claims
examples.zh: 检验她陈述的真伪

senses.def: a statement that is not true

examples.en: It is an offence to deliberately publish a serious falsehood.
examples.zh: 故意发布重大虚假消息是违法行为。

senses.def: wrongly; in a way that is based on something that is not true or not correct

examples.en: to be falsely accused of something
examples.zh: 被诬告某事

examples.en: Patients may falsely believe that screening prevents cancer.
examples.zh: 患者可能错误地认为筛查可以预防癌症。

examples.en: She falsely claimed to be a fraud victim.
examples.zh: 她谎称自己是诈骗受害者。

examples.en: He was assaulted and falsely imprisoned.
examples.zh: 他遭到殴打并被错误监禁。

senses.def: in a way that is not real or sincere

examples.en: She smiled falsely at his joke.
examples.zh: 她假装被他的笑话逗笑了。

senses.def: the example used in 1919 by the US Supreme Court
senses.zh: 在拥挤的剧院里错误地大喊大叫：美国最高法院法官奥利弗·温德尔·霍尔姆斯（Oliver Wendell Holmes）在1919年使用的例子表明，在某些情况下言论自由应该受到限制，尽管他大力支持言论自由。

falsely-shouting-fire-in-a-crowded-theat.word: falsely shouting fire in a crowded theater
falsely-shouting-fire-in-a-crowded-theat.uk: /ˌfɔːlsli ʃaʊtɪŋ ˈfaɪər ɪn ə ˌkraʊdɪd ˈθɪətə(r)/
falsely-shouting-fire-in-a-crowded-theat.us: /ˌfɔːlsli ʃaʊtɪŋ ˈfaɪər ɪn ə ˌkraʊdɪd ˈθiːətər/

senses.def: a male singer who sings falsetto
an unusually high voice, especially the voice that men use to sing very high notes
pieces of material used inside a bra
the act of changing a written record or information so that it is no longer true
senses.zh: 篡改，伪造（文字记录、信息）

examples.en: the deliberate falsification of the company’s records
examples.zh: 对公司记录的蓄意篡改

senses.def: to change a written record or information so that it is no longer true
senses.zh: 篡改，伪造（文字记录、信息）

examples.en: to falsify data/records/accounts
examples.zh: 窜改数据╱记录╱账目

examples.en: She was arrested for falsifying information and obstructing the course of justice.
examples.zh: 她因篡改资料和妨碍司法公正而被逮捕。

senses.def: the state of not being true or real; something that is not true or real

examples.en: We need to determine the truth or falsity of these claims.
examples.zh: 我们需要确定这些说法的真实性或虚假性。

examples.en: There are quite a few falsities in this article.
examples.zh: 这篇文章有不少虚假之处。

senses.def: fat, cheerful and eating and drinking a lot
senses.zh: 福斯塔夫式的（源于莎士比亚笔下人物，外形肥胖且喜狂欢闹饮）

examples.en: My uncle was a Falstaffian figure.
examples.zh: 我的叔叔是个福斯塔夫式的人物。

examples.en: a Falstaffian approach to life
examples.zh: 福斯塔夫式的生活方式

senses.def: to become weaker or less effective

examples.en: The economy shows no signs of faltering.
examples.zh: 经济没有衰退的迹象。

examples.en: Her courage never faltered.
examples.zh: 她从未气馁过。

examples.en: The economy is beginning to falter.
examples.zh: 经济开始衰退。

examples.en: The team’s performance faltered badly after the break.
examples.zh: 中场休息后该队的表现严重下滑。

senses.def: to speak in a way that shows that you are not confident
senses.zh: （嗓音）颤抖；结巴地说；支吾其词

examples.en: His voice faltered as he began his speech.
examples.zh: 他开始演讲时说话结结巴巴。

senses.def: to walk or behave in a way that shows that you are not confident

examples.en: She walked up to the platform without faltering.
examples.zh: 她健步走上了讲台。

examples.en: He never faltered in his commitment to the party.
examples.zh: 他对党始终忠贞不渝。

senses.def: a person's family

examples.en: So happy for you and your fam!
examples.zh: 为你和你的家人感到高兴！

examples.en: Had a great time relaxing with friends and fam!
examples.zh: 和朋友家人闲聚，玩得好高兴！

senses.def: the state of being known and talked about by many people

examples.en: to achieve/win instant fame
examples.zh: 一夜成名

examples.en: Daisy Ridley of ‘Star Wars’ fame (= famous for ‘Star Wars’)
examples.zh: 《星球大战》著名演员黛西·雷德利

examples.en: The town's only claim to fame is that there was once a riot there.
examples.zh: 这个镇唯一出名之处就是那里有过一次暴乱。

examples.en: She went to Hollywood in search of fame and fortune.
examples.zh: 她为追逐名利去了好莱坞。

senses.def: a short period of being famous
senses.zh: 短暂的名声；昙花一现的荣誉

examples.en: Everybody wants their fifteen minutes of fame.
examples.zh: 每个人都希望自己走红，哪怕转瞬即逝。

senses.def: to suddenly become famous, especially as a singer or actor
senses.zh: （尤指歌手或演员）一举成名，迅速走红

examples.en: He shot to fame almost overnight.
examples.zh: 他几乎一夜成名。

examples.en: She shot to stardom in a Broadway musical.
examples.zh: 她参演一部百老汇音乐剧，一炮而红。

senses.def: a short period of being famous
senses.zh: 短暂的名声；昙花一现的荣誉

examples.en: Everybody wants their fifteen minutes of fame.
examples.zh: 每个人都希望自己走红，哪怕转瞬即逝。

senses.def: to suddenly become famous, especially as a singer or actor
senses.zh: （尤指歌手或演员）一举成名，迅速走红

examples.en: He shot to fame almost overnight.
examples.zh: 他几乎一夜成名。

examples.en: She shot to stardom in a Broadway musical.
examples.zh: 她参演一部百老汇音乐剧，一炮而红。

senses.def: very well known

examples.en: Next stop is Las Vegas, famed for its casinos.
examples.zh: 下一站是以其赌场而闻名的拉斯维加斯。

examples.en: a famed poet and musician
examples.zh: 一位大名鼎鼎的诗人和音乐家

senses.def: related to or typical of a family
affecting several members of a family

examples.en: familial left-handedness
examples.zh: 家族遗传的左撇子

senses.def: well known to you; often seen or heard and therefore easy to recognize
senses.zh: 熟悉的；常见到的；常听说的

examples.en: to look/sound/seem familiar
examples.zh: 眼熟；耳熟；似曾相识

examples.en: I couldn’t see any familiar faces in the room.
examples.zh: 房间里的人我全都不认识。

examples.en: He's a familiar figure in the neighbourhood.
examples.zh: 他在这个地区是大家熟悉的人物。

examples.en: Then she heard a familiar voice.
examples.zh: 然后她听到了熟悉的声音。

examples.en: The cast contains a number of familiar names.
examples.zh: 演员阵容中有许多熟悉的名字。

examples.en: The song was vaguely familiar.
examples.zh: 那首歌有点耳熟。

examples.en: The smell is very familiar to everyone who lives near a bakery.
examples.zh: 住在面包店附近的人都很熟悉这种气味。

examples.en: Violent attacks are becoming all too familiar (= sadly familiar).
examples.zh: 暴力攻击变成了司空见惯的现象。

senses.def: knowing something very well

examples.en: an area with which I had been familiar since childhood
examples.zh: 我自幼就了若指掌的一个地区

examples.en: You will soon become familiar with the different activities.
examples.zh: 你很快就会熟悉不同的活动。

examples.en: Are you familiar with the computer software they use?
examples.zh: 你熟悉他们使用的计算机软件吗？

examples.en: She would have been familiar with the work of this 18th-century German philosopher.
examples.zh: 她可能熟悉这位 18 世纪德国哲学家的著作。

examples.en: Ishii is clearly intimately familiar with his script and characters.
examples.zh: 石井显然对他的剧本和角色非常熟悉。

senses.def: very informal, sometimes in a way that is unpleasant

examples.en: You seem to be on very familiar terms with your tutor.
examples.zh: 你似乎和你的导师之间很随便。

examples.en: After a few drinks her boss started getting too familiar for her liking.
examples.zh: 老板几杯酒下肚以后就开始令她觉得过分亲昵。

examples.en: He was being overly familiar with Gloria.
examples.zh: 他对格洛丽亚太熟悉了。

senses.def: the state of knowing somebody/something well; the state of recognizing somebody/something

examples.en: His familiarity with the language helped him enjoy his stay.
examples.zh: 他通晓这种语言，所以逗留期间过得很惬意。

examples.en: When she saw the house, she had a feeling of familiarity.
examples.zh: 她见到这座房子就有一种熟悉的感觉。

senses.def: a friendly informal manner

examples.en: She addressed me with an easy familiarity that made me feel at home.
examples.zh: 她和我谈话亲切随和，使我不感到拘束。

examples.en: He treated her with the easy familiarity of an equal.
examples.zh: 他平等待她，态度很随和。

senses.def: knowing somebody/something very well may cause you to lose respect for them/it
senses.zh: 亲不敬，熟生蔑；过分亲密就会有所侮慢

senses.def: knowing somebody/something very well may cause you to lose respect for them/it
senses.zh: 亲不敬，熟生蔑；过分亲密就会有所侮慢

senses.def: knowing somebody/something very well may cause you to lose respect for them/it
senses.zh: 亲不敬，熟生蔑；过分亲密就会有所侮慢

senses.def: the process of learning about something or teaching somebody about something, so that you/they start to understand it

examples.en: a week of training and familiarization
examples.zh: 一周的培训和熟悉

senses.def: to learn about something or teach somebody about something, so that you/they start to understand it

examples.en: You'll need time to familiarize yourself with our procedures.
examples.zh: 你需要时间熟悉我们的程序。

examples.en: As a teacher I try to familiarize students with a wide variety of fiction.
examples.zh: 作为一名老师，我试图让学生熟悉各种各样的小说。

senses.def: in a friendly and informal manner, sometimes in a way that is too informal to be pleasant

examples.en: John Hunt, familiarly known to his friends as Jack
examples.zh: 约翰·亨特，朋友昵称他为杰克

examples.en: He touched her cheek familiarly.
examples.zh: 他亲昵地碰了碰她的面颊。

senses.def: in the way that is well known to people

examples.en: The elephant's nose or, more familiarly, trunk, is the most versatile organ in the animal kingdom.
examples.zh: 象的鼻子，俗称为 trunk，是动物界中功能最多的器官。

senses.def: a group consisting of one or two parents and their children
senses.zh: 家，家庭（包括父母一方或双方与子女）

examples.en: I introduced Neil to the other members of my family.
examples.zh: 我把尼尔介绍给我家里的其他成员。

examples.en: The event promises games and fun for the entire family.
examples.zh: 该活动将为全家人提供游戏和乐趣。

examples.en: This is a summer movie for the whole family.
examples.zh: 这是一部适合全家人观看的暑期电影。

examples.en: Every family has its own story to tell.
examples.zh: 每个家庭都有自己的故事。

examples.en: All my family enjoy skiing.
examples.zh: 我们全家都喜欢滑雪。

examples.en: one-parent/single-parent families
examples.zh: 单亲家庭

examples.en: Taking a family of four to the cinema is expensive.
examples.zh: 一家四口去看电影花费不菲。

examples.en: families with young children
examples.zh: 有小孩的家庭

examples.en: He's a friend of the family (= he is known and liked by the parents and the children).
examples.zh: 他和这家人相熟。

examples.en: From early childhood he was a mystery to the rest of his family.
examples.zh: 从孩提时代起，他对家人来说就是一个谜。

examples.en: I barely earn enough money to pay my rent and feed my family.
examples.zh: 我挣的钱勉强够付房租和养家糊口。

examples.en: She works tirelessly to provide for her family.
examples.zh: 她孜孜不倦地工作来养家糊口。

examples.en: Her family has/have always supported her.
examples.zh: 她的家人一直支持她。

senses.def: a group consisting of one or two parents, their children and close relations
senses.zh: （大）家庭（包括父母一方或双方与子女、近亲）；亲属

examples.en: All our family came to Grandad's eightieth birthday party.
examples.zh: 我们所有亲属都来参加了祖父的八十寿宴。

examples.en: The support of family and friends is vital.
examples.zh: 亲友的支持极为重要。

examples.en: We've only told the immediate family (= the closest relations).
examples.zh: 我们只告诉了直系亲属。

examples.en: the royal family (= the children and close relations of the king or queen)
examples.zh: 王室

examples.en: I always think of you as one of the family.
examples.zh: 我一直把你当成自家人。

examples.en: There are a lot of girls in our family.
examples.zh: 我们家有很多女孩。

examples.en: Nobody outside his family knew that he had a daughter.
examples.zh: 除了他的家人之外，没有人知道他有一个女儿。

examples.en: We all knew her so well that we felt she was almost part of the family.
examples.zh: 我们都跟她很熟，觉得她跟自家人似的。

examples.en: She's family (= she is a relation).
examples.zh: 她是我们家的人。

examples.en: We have family in France.
examples.zh: 我们在法国有家人。

examples.en: My family always tells/tell me what they think.
examples.zh: 我的家人总是告诉我他们的想法。

senses.def: all the people who are related to each other, including those who are now dead

examples.en: Some families have farmed in this area for hundreds of years.
examples.zh: 有些家族在这个地区务农有几百年了。

examples.en: This painting has been in our family for generations.
examples.zh: 这幅画在我们家传了好几代人了。

examples.en: He belonged to an aristocratic family.
examples.zh: 他出身贵族。

examples.en: She is of Muslim heritage on her father's side of the family.
examples.zh: 她的父亲家族有穆斯林血统。

examples.en: My family has/have always lived here.
examples.zh: 我的家人一直住在这里。

senses.def: a couple’s or a person’s children, especially young children

examples.en: They have a large family.
examples.zh: 他们子女成群。

examples.en: I addressed it to Mr and Mrs Jones and family.
examples.zh: 我以此致琼斯伉俪及子女。

examples.en: Do they plan to start a family (= have children)?
examples.zh: 他们打算生孩子吗？

examples.en: This is a wonderful place to raise a family.
examples.zh: 这里是安家的理想之地。

examples.en: She brought up a family of six children on her own.
examples.zh: 她独自抚养了一个有六个孩子的家庭。

examples.en: She chose to stop work to have a family.
examples.zh: 她选择停止工作去组建家庭。

examples.en: My family is/are a lively bunch.
examples.zh: 我的家人是一群充满活力的人。

senses.def: a group into which animals, plants, etc. that have similar characteristics are divided, smaller than an order

examples.en: Lions belong to the cat family.
examples.zh: 狮属于猫科。

examples.en: This bird is a member of the crow family.
examples.zh: 这种鸟属于鸦科。

examples.en: Orchids are the largest family of flowering plants.
examples.zh: 兰花是最大的开花植物科。

senses.def: a group of related languages

examples.en: the Germanic family of languages
examples.zh: 日耳曼语系

senses.def: (to be/become) pregnant
to be a common feature in a particular family
senses.zh: 为一家人所共有；世代相传

examples.en: Heart disease runs in the family.
examples.zh: 这家人都有心脏病。

examples.en: a medical condition which runs in the family
examples.zh: 家族遗传的疾病

senses.def: connected with the family or a particular family

examples.en: family life
examples.zh: 家庭生活

examples.en: The job was starting to affect his family life.
examples.zh: 这项工作开始影响他的家庭生活。

examples.en: your family background
examples.zh: 你的家庭背景

examples.en: Only close family members called her ‘Sally’.
examples.zh: 只有关系亲密的家人才叫她“莎莉”。

examples.en: a family friend (= a friend of the whole family)
examples.zh: 世交

examples.en: family ties/connections
examples.zh: 家庭关系/联系

examples.en: It's a family tradition.
examples.zh: 这是一个家庭传统。

examples.en: She has become interested in her family history.
examples.zh: 她对自己的家族史产生了兴趣。

examples.en: He has a family history of heart disease.
examples.zh: 他有心脏病家族史。

senses.def: owned by a family

examples.en: They had to sell the family home.
examples.zh: 他们不得不卖掉家里的房子。

examples.en: a family business
examples.zh: 家庭企业

examples.en: the family car
examples.zh: 家里人共用的汽车

examples.en: She had to sell the family jewels in order to pay off her gambling debts.
examples.zh: 为了还赌债，她不得不卖掉家里的珠宝。

senses.def: suitable for all members of a family, both adults and children

examples.en: a family show
examples.zh: 家庭节目

examples.en: family entertainment
examples.zh: 适合全家大小一起参加的娱乐。

senses.def: (to be/become) pregnant
to be a common feature in a particular family
senses.zh: 为一家人所共有；世代相传

examples.en: Heart disease runs in the family.
examples.zh: 这家人都有心脏病。

examples.en: a medical condition which runs in the family
examples.zh: 家族遗传的疾病

senses.def: a court that deals with cases that affect families, for example when people get divorced
senses.zh: 家事法庭，家事法院（处理离婚等家庭纠纷）

examples.en: She went before a family court in order to win back custody of the child.
examples.zh: 为了夺回孩子的监护权，她向家庭法院提起诉讼。

senses.def: a doctor who is trained in general medicine and who treats patients in a local community rather than at a hospital
senses.zh: （医院以外的）全科医生，普通医师

senses.def: suitable for or aimed at families with children
senses.zh: 家庭友好型：适合或针对有孩子的家庭

examples.en: a family-friendly event/activity/atmosphere
examples.zh: 适合家庭的活动/活动/氛围

examples.en: family-friendly entertainment
examples.zh: 适合家庭的娱乐活动

examples.en: We need to promote family-friendly work policies.
examples.zh: 我们需要推广家庭友好型工作政策。

senses.def: time when you are allowed to be away from work to deal with family matters, especially the birth of a child or to care for a relative
senses.zh: （为照顾新生儿或家人而休的）家务假

examples.en: Last year I took paid family leave to look after my sick mother.
examples.zh: 去年，我休了带薪探亲假来照顾生病的母亲。

senses.def: a man who has a partner and children; a man who enjoys being at home with his partner and children
senses.zh: 有妻室儿女的人;恋家的男人

examples.en: I see he's become a family man.
examples.zh: 我发觉他已变得很恋家。

examples.en: a devoted family man
examples.zh: 忠于家庭的男人

senses.def: the branch of medicine that is designed to provide general healthcare

examples.en: Chuang practices family medicine in Detroit, caring for people of all ages.
examples.zh: 庄在底特律从事家庭医学工作，为各个年龄段的人提供护理。

senses.def: the part of your name that shows which family you belong to

examples.en: ‘Smith’ is the most common family name in Britain.
examples.zh: 史密斯是英国最常见的姓氏。

examples.en: He wanted a son to carry on the family name.
examples.zh: 他想要个儿子来传宗接代。

senses.def: the process of controlling the number of children you have by using contraception

examples.en: to make an appointment at the family planning clinic
examples.zh: 预约计划生育诊所

examples.en: They give free advice on contraception at the family planning clinic.
examples.zh: 计划生育门诊部提供免费的避孕措施咨询。

senses.def: the work of a doctor who treats people in the community rather than at a hospital and who is not a specialist in one particular area of medicine; a place where a doctor like this works
senses.zh: （社区）全科医疗，家庭医疗；全科诊所

examples.en: Dr. Simon is part of a family practice in our neighborhood.
examples.zh: 西蒙医生是我们社区的一名全科医生。

examples.en: The office provides neurology, internal medicine and family practice services.
examples.zh: 该诊所提供神经科、内科和全科诊疗。

senses.def: a doctor who is trained in general medicine and who treats patients in a local community rather than at a hospital
senses.zh: （医院以外的）全科医生，普通医师

senses.def: a room in a house where the family can relax, watch television, etc.
a room in a hotel for three or four people to sleep in, especially parents and children
(in the UK) a room in a pub where children are allowed to sit
with plates of food on the table from which people can serve themselves
senses.zh: 家庭风格：桌子上有盘食物，人们可以从中用餐

examples.en: The meal was served family style with lots of different dishes to pass around.
examples.zh: 这顿饭是家庭风格的，有很多不同的菜肴可供传递。

senses.def: used to describe a way of serving food in which people serve themselves from plates of food that have been put on the table
senses.zh: 家庭式的：用来描述一种食物的供应方式，即人们从摆在桌上的食物盘子中自助

examples.en: a family-style restaurant/meal/dinner
examples.zh: 家庭式餐厅/餐食/晚餐

senses.def: suitable for all members of a family, both adults and children

examples.en: family-style entertainment
examples.zh: 家庭式娱乐

senses.def: a treatment for mental health problems in which members of a family meet with a therapist

examples.en: The centre offers individual, group and family therapy sessions.
examples.zh: 该中心提供个人、团体和家庭治疗课程。

senses.def: a diagram that shows the relationship between members of a family over a long period of time

examples.en: How far back can you trace your family tree?
examples.zh: 你的家谱可以追溯到多少代？

senses.def: beliefs about what is right, wrong or important in life that people often learn from their families, typically the importance of high moral standards and the traditional family unit of mother, father and children. In the US, family values

examples.en: We're seeing a greater focus on community and family values.
examples.zh: 我们看到人们更加关注社区和家庭价值观。

senses.def: a lack of food during a long period of time in a region

examples.en: a severe famine
examples.zh: 严重饥荒

examples.en: disasters such as floods and famine
examples.zh: 水灾和饥荒这一类灾难

examples.en: the threat of widespread famine in the area
examples.zh: 这一地区内大范围的饥荒威胁

examples.en: to raise money for famine relief
examples.zh: 为赈济饥荒筹款

senses.def: very hungry

examples.en: When's lunch? I'm famished!
examples.zh: 什么时候吃午饭？我饿得要死了！

examples.en: famished refugees
examples.zh: 饥饿的难民

senses.def: known about by many people

examples.en: a famous artist/actor
examples.zh: 著名艺术家／演员

examples.en: The actor was one of many famous faces at the party.
examples.zh: 派对名人云集，这位演员就是其中一人。

examples.en: Loch Ness is probably the most famous lake in Scotland.
examples.zh: 尼斯湖大概是苏格兰最有名的湖。

examples.en: Tiger Woods is one of the most famous names in golf.
examples.zh: 泰格·伍兹是高尔夫界最著名的人物之一。

examples.en: Many rich and famous people have stayed at the hotel.
examples.zh: 许多显贵都曾入住这家酒店。

examples.en: So this is the famous dress! (= the one we have heard a lot about but have not seen).
examples.zh: 这就是那条传说中的连衣裙吧！

examples.en: The song was made famous by Frank Sinatra.
examples.zh: 这首歌因为弗兰克·西纳特拉演唱过而广为流传。

examples.en: This was the book that made her famous.
examples.zh: 这本书让她出名。

examples.en: He became internationally famous for his novels.
examples.zh: 他以小说享誉国际。

examples.en: She was more famous as a writer than as a singer.
examples.zh: 她作为作家比作为歌手名声要大。

senses.def: people who are known about by many people

examples.en: the lifestyles of the rich and famous
examples.zh: 富豪名流的生活方式

senses.zh: 吹牛，胡扯（表示某人盲目乐观）

examples.zh: “一切都在掌握之中。”“净吹牛！”

examples.zh: 有些报纸拒不刊用 Ms 这个词，其中最著名的是《纽约时报》。

examples.zh: 他著名的临终遗言

examples.zh: 我母亲和我婆婆相处得很好。

senses.def: a person who admires somebody/something or enjoys watching or listening to somebody/something very much

examples.en: sports/music fans
examples.zh: 体育迷；音乐迷

examples.en: Movie fans will be familiar with his work already.
examples.zh: 影迷对他的作品肯定已经很熟悉了。

examples.en: Crowds of football fans filled the streets.
examples.zh: 一群群足球迷挤满了街道。

examples.en: I like his films, but I wouldn't say I'm a diehard fan (= one who strongly admires somebody/something in all circumstances).
examples.zh: 我喜欢他的电影，但我不会说我是一个铁杆粉丝（=在任何情况下都强烈钦佩某人/某物的人）。

examples.en: I'm a big fan of her books.
examples.zh: 我非常喜欢她的书。

examples.en: I'm a huge fan of Rihanna.
examples.zh: 我是蕾哈娜的超级粉丝。

examples.en: I'm not a great fan of bushy beards (= I don't like them).
examples.zh: 我不喜欢浓密的胡须。

senses.def: a machine that creates a current of air

examples.en: to switch on the electric fan
examples.zh: 开电扇

examples.en: a fan heater
examples.zh: 风扇式加热器

examples.en: a fan blowing cold air
examples.zh: 一台吹冷风的风扇

senses.def: a thing that you hold in your hand and wave to create a current of cool air
when somebody in authority finds out about something bad or wrong that somebody has done
senses.zh: 做了坏事（或错事）被发现

examples.en: When the shit hits the fan, I don't want to be here.
examples.zh: 事情一旦败露，我就不想待在这儿了。

senses.def: to make air blow onto somebody/something by waving a fan, your hand, etc.

examples.en: He fanned himself with a newspaper to cool down.
examples.zh: 他用一张报纸给自己扇凉。

examples.en: A warm breeze fanned her cheeks.
examples.zh: 温暖的微风拂过她的脸颊。

senses.def: to make a fire burn more strongly by blowing on it

examples.en: Fanned by a westerly wind, the fire spread rapidly through the city.
examples.zh: 火借助西风迅速蔓延全城。

senses.def: to make a feeling, an attitude, etc. stronger

examples.en: His reluctance to answer her questions simply fanned her curiosity.
examples.zh: 他不爽快地回答她的问题，这就激起了她的好奇心。

senses.def: to make a feeling such as anger, hate, etc. worse

examples.en: His writings fanned the flames of racism.
examples.zh: 他的写作煽起了种族主义情绪。

senses.zh: 粉丝群：非常欣赏特定音乐家，乐队，团队，作家等的人群。

examples.en: She is trying to widen her fan base.
examples.zh: 她正在努力扩大她的粉丝基础。

examples.en: A loyal fan base bought the new album.
examples.zh: 忠实的歌迷购买了这张新专辑。

examples.zh: 迪士尼官方粉丝俱乐部的成员

examples.en: Fan club members can get concert tickets at a discount.
examples.zh: 歌迷会成员购买音乐会门票有优惠。

senses.def: a type of literature, usually written on the internet, by people who admire a particular novel, film, etc., with characters taken from these stories
senses.zh: 同人小说（由某小说、电影等的爱好者创作，人物取自原作，常为网络文学）

examples.en: I have a piece of fan fiction on their website.
examples.zh: 他们的网站上有我写的同人小说。

senses.def: letters from fans to the person they admire
senses.zh: 粉丝信：粉丝给他们敬佩的人的信

examples.en: Swifty gets fan mail from all over the world.
examples.zh: 斯威夫特收到来自世界各地的粉丝来信。

senses.def: to spread out or spread something out over an area

examples.en: The police fanned out to surround the house.
examples.zh: 警察散开包围了这座房子。

examples.en: The bird fanned out its tail feathers.
examples.zh: 这只鸟把尾羽展成扇形。

senses.def: an oven with a fan that moves hot air around to heat food in an even way
senses.zh: 对流烤箱；热风循环烤箱

examples.en: Preheat the oven to 200°C, fan oven 180°C, gas mark 6.
examples.zh: 将烤箱预热至 200°C，风扇烤箱 180°C，气体标记 6。

senses.def: a place on the internet where fans can find and share information about somebody/something

examples.en: Debate is raging on blogs and fan sites about whether the player should be replaced.
examples.zh: 博客和球迷网站上关于是否应该更换这名球员的争论非常激烈。

examples.en: This image quickly did the rounds on Star Trek fan sites.
examples.zh: 这张照片很快就在《星际迷航》粉丝网站上流传开来。

senses.def: holding, expressing or connected with extreme or dangerous opinions

examples.en: fanatic followers of the cult leader
examples.zh: 邪教领袖的狂热追随者

examples.en: fanatic ideology
examples.zh: 狂热的意识形态

examples.en: He's fanatic about his religious beliefs.
examples.zh: 他对自己的宗教信仰非常狂热。

examples.en: religious fanatics
examples.zh: 宗教极端分子

examples.zh: 热衷于健美／纵横字谜的人

examples.en: a self-confessed football fanatic
examples.zh: 一位自封的橄榄球迷

senses.def: holding, expressing or connected with extreme or dangerous opinions

examples.en: a fanatical cult
examples.zh: 狂热的邪教

examples.en: fanatical views
examples.zh: 狂热的观点

senses.def: extremely enthusiastic

examples.zh: 球队的狂热支持者

examples.en: their fanatical devotion to the show
examples.zh: 他们对演出的狂热投入

examples.en: She's fanatical about healthy eating.
examples.zh: 她对健康饮食很痴迷。

senses.def: in a way that involves extreme or dangerous opinions

senses.def: in an extremely enthusiastic way

examples.en: fanatically devoted to exercise
examples.zh: 极其热衷于锻炼

senses.def: extreme beliefs or behaviour, especially in connection with religion or politics
senses.zh: （尤指宗教、政治上的）狂热，入迷

examples.en: driven by religious fanaticism
examples.zh: 在宗教狂热的驱使下

examples.en: the fanaticism of football supporters
examples.zh: 足球支持者的狂热

senses.def: a person, especially a boy or young man, who admires a particular person very much, or admires and enjoys something such as a type of music, product, or film very much
senses.zh: （特定计算机游戏﹑漫画﹑电视节目等的）男粉丝

examples.en: a Nintendo fanboy
examples.zh: 任天堂电玩迷

examples.en: On social media the fanboys and fangirls leapt to his defence.
examples.zh: 在社交媒体上，男女粉丝纷纷为他辩护。

senses.def: sexually attractive
based on imagination and not facts or reason

examples.en: Admittedly, this may be a fanciful and unrealistic goal.
examples.zh: 诚然，这可能是一个幻想且不切实际的目标。

examples.en: During their mission, they encounter all kinds of bizarre and fanciful creatures.
examples.zh: 在执行任务的过程中，他们遇到了各种奇异而奇特的生物。

senses.def: decorated in an unusual style that shows imagination
senses.zh: 装饰独出心裁的；式样奇特的；花哨的

examples.en: a fanciful gold border
examples.zh: 别出心裁的金色镶边

senses.def: in a way that is based on imagination and not facts or reason

examples.en: Some critics fancifully suggest this symbol represents the power of evil.
examples.zh: 一些批评家异想天开地认为这个符号代表了邪恶的力量。

senses.def: in a way that is unusual and shows imagination
senses.zh: 幻想：以一种不寻常的方式展现想象力

examples.en: fancifully decorated instruments
examples.zh: 装饰精美的乐器

senses.def: to want something or want to do something

examples.en: Fancy a drink?
examples.zh: 想喝一杯吗？

examples.en: I fancied a change of scene.
examples.zh: 我倒希望换换环境。

examples.en: She didn't fancy (= did not like) the idea of going home in the dark.
examples.zh: 她不想在黑夜里回家。

examples.en: Do you fancy going out this evening?
examples.zh: 今晚你想不想外出？

senses.def: to be sexually attracted to somebody

examples.en: I think she fancies me.
examples.zh: 我觉得她对我动心了。

senses.def: to think that you are very popular, attractive or intelligent

examples.en: He started to chat to me and I could tell that he really fancied himself.
examples.zh: 他和我聊起天来，我看得出他确实自以为了不起。

senses.def: to like the idea of being something or to believe, often wrongly, that you are something

examples.en: She fancies herself (as) a serious actress.
examples.zh: 她自以为是严肃的演员。

examples.en: He fancied himself in love with me, the silly boy.
examples.zh: 他幻想自己爱上了我这个傻孩子。

senses.def: used to show that you are surprised or shocked by something
senses.zh: （表示惊奇或震惊）真想不到，竟然

examples.en: Fancy! She's never been in a plane before.
examples.zh: 真想不到！她竟然从未坐过飞机。

examples.en: Fancy meeting you here!
examples.zh: 竟然在这儿遇到你！

examples.en: ‘She remembered my name after all those years.’ ‘Fancy that!’
examples.zh: “过了那么多年她还记得我的名字。”“真是不可思议！”

senses.def: to think that somebody/something will win or be successful at something, especially in a race
senses.zh: 认为…会成功；（尤指速度竞赛）认为…要赢

examples.en: Which horse do you fancy in the next race?
examples.zh: 下一轮赛马你认为哪匹马会赢？

examples.en: He's hoping to get the job but I don't fancy his chances.
examples.zh: 他希望得到那份工作，不过我认为他的机会不大。

senses.def: to believe or imagine something

examples.en: She fancied (that) she could hear footsteps.
examples.zh: 她觉得好像听到了脚步声。

senses.def: unusually complicated, often in an unnecessary way; intended to impress other people

examples.en: a kitchen full of fancy gadgets
examples.zh: 有各式各样小器具的厨房

examples.en: They added a lot of fancy footwork to the dance.
examples.zh: 他们给这个舞蹈增加了许多复杂的舞步。

examples.en: He's always using fancy legal words.
examples.zh: 他总是使用异常复杂的法律词语。

senses.def: with a lot of decorations or bright colours
senses.zh: 精致的；有精美装饰的；绚丽的；花哨的

examples.en: fancy goods (= things sold as gifts or for decoration)
examples.zh: 饰物礼品

examples.en: He was the fanciest dresser in the room.
examples.zh: 他是房间里最漂亮的梳妆台。

senses.def: expensive or connected with an expensive way of life

examples.en: fancy restaurants with fancy prices
examples.zh: 价格昂贵的豪华餐厅

examples.en: Don't come back with any fancy ideas.
examples.zh: 别又说什么美妙的空想。

senses.def: of high quality
something that you imagine; your imagination

examples.en: night-time fancies that disappear in the morning
examples.zh: 在早上逝去的夜间幻觉

examples.en: a child’s wild flights of fancy
examples.zh: 孩子的异想天开

senses.def: a feeling that you would like to have or to do something

examples.en: She said she wanted a dog but it was only a passing fancy.
examples.zh: 她说想要一条狗，但这不过是一时心血来潮。

senses.def: a small decorated cake
as/whenever, etc. you feel like doing something
senses.zh: 当（或无论何时等）想做某事时

examples.en: We bought a camper van so we could go away whenever the fancy took us.
examples.zh: 我们买了一辆野营车，所以我们什么时候想去野营就可以去。

senses.def: to attract or please somebody

examples.en: She looked through the hotel advertisements until one of them caught her fancy.
examples.zh: 她仔细查看旅馆广告，终于有一家中了她的意。

senses.def: to start liking somebody/something, often without an obvious reason
senses.zh: 喜欢上，爱上（常指没有明显原因）

examples.en: He’s taken quite a fancy to his next-door neighbour.
examples.zh: 他很喜欢他的隔壁邻居。

senses.def: to please somebody

examples.en: See if any of these tickle your fancy.
examples.zh: 看看这里面是否有你喜欢的。

examples.en: If you see something that tickles your fancy, I’ll buy it for you.
examples.zh: 如果你看到一些让你喜欢的东西，我会买给你。

examples.zh: 如果你看到一些让你喜欢的东西，我会买给你。

senses.def: clothes that you wear, especially at parties, to make you appear to be a different character

examples.en: guests in fancy dress
examples.zh: 身着化装服的客人们

examples.en: I went to a fancy-dress party as a pirate.
examples.zh: 我扮作海盗去参加了一场化装晚会。

senses.def: free to do what you like because you are not emotionally involved with anyone

examples.en: I was still footloose and fancy-free (= free to enjoy myself) in those days.
examples.zh: 当时我仍然毫无牵挂、逍遥自在呢。

senses.def: a man that a person is having a romantic relationship with, especially when one or both of them is married to somebody else
senses.zh: （尤指一方或双方已婚的）情夫

senses.def: a woman that a person is having a romantic relationship with, especially when one or both of them is married to somebody else
senses.zh: （尤指一方或双方已婚的）情妇

senses.def: a lively Spanish dance; a piece of music for this dance
senses.zh: 凡丹戈舞（节奏欢快的西班牙舞蹈）；凡丹戈舞曲

senses.def: the state of being a fan of somebody/something

examples.en: The book takes a fascinating look at sports fandom in the United States.
examples.zh: 这本书对美国的体育迷进行了精彩的审视。

examples.en: my 17 years of football fandom
examples.zh: 我迷恋足球的 17 年

examples.en: Readers’ level of Harry Potter fandom was rated on a scale of one to five, based on a detailed questionnaire.
examples.zh: 根据一份详细的调查问卷，读者对《哈利·波特》粉丝的喜爱程度被分为一到五级。

senses.def: the fans of a particular person, team, TV show, etc. considered together as a community

examples.en: This US comedy show has a really strong fandom.
examples.zh: 这个美国喜剧节目有一群十分狂热的爱好者。

senses.def: a building in Boston
senses.zh: 法尼尔厅（Faneuil Hall）：位于马萨诸塞州波士顿的一栋建筑物，被称为“自由摇篮”。它始建于1742年，大火后于1763年再次修建。一楼用于室内市场，楼上有一个大会议室供会议使用。人们在那里见面，计划美国大革命。今天它仍然被用作市场和聚会场所。

senses.def: a short loud piece of music that is played to celebrate somebody/something important arriving
senses.zh: 号角花彩，号角齐鸣（欢迎仪式等上奏的响亮短曲）

examples.en: A fanfare of trumpets will sound for the King.
examples.zh: 将为国王吹响号角。

senses.def: a large amount of activity and discussion in the media to celebrate somebody/something

examples.en: The product was launched amid much fanfare worldwide.
examples.zh: 这个产品在世界各地隆重推出。

examples.en: Despite the fanfare of publicity that accompanied its launch, his latest novel sold only a few hundred copies.
examples.zh: 尽管出版时大肆宣传，他的最新小说只售出了几百本。

senses.def: either of two long sharp teeth at the front of the mouths of some animals, such as a snake or dog

examples.en: The snake sank its fangs into its victim.
examples.zh: 蛇将毒牙刺入猎物身体中。

examples.en: The wolf growled and bared its sharp fangs.
examples.zh: 那匹狼嚎叫着，露出锋利的牙齿。

senses.def: a girl or young woman who admires a particular person very much, or admires and enjoys something such as a type of music, product, or film very much
senses.zh: 女粉丝（迷恋某人或爱好某种音乐、产品或电影等的女孩）

examples.en: an Apple fangirl
examples.zh: 苹果产品女粉丝

examples.en: On social media the fanboys and fangirls leapt to his defence.
examples.zh: 在社交媒体上，男女粉丝纷纷为他辩护。

senses.def: a small window above a door or another window
senses.zh: 气窗（门或窗上方的小窗）

senses.def: (1857-1915) a US writer of books on cooking which have been popular for more than a century. Her Boston Cooking School Cook Book
senses.zh: 房利美农夫（Fannie Farmer）：（1857-1915）是美国一本有关烹饪的书的作家，该书已经流行了一个多世纪。她的波士顿烹饪学校烹饪书（1896年）是第一本使用标准尺寸和说明的书。它发展成《范妮·法默的食谱》，至今仍在销售。

a person’s bottom
nothing at all. People say ‘
senses.zh: 一点都没有，什么都没有（委婉说法，与 fuck all 同义）

senses.def: a novel (1749) by John Cleland (1707-89) about the sexual adventures of a young woman in 18th-century London. Its original title was Memoirs of a Woman of Pleasure
senses.zh: 范妮·希尔（Fanny Hill）：约翰·克莱兰（John Cleland）（1707-89）所著的小说（1749），讲述了18世纪伦敦年轻女性的性冒险。它的原始标题是《快乐女人的回忆录》。1963年，该书在一家公司试图在英国被禁止出版，并在1970年最终出版时大受欢迎。

senses.def: (1809-93) an English actor who was famous for playing parts in Shakespeare plays. She was also known for her opposition to slavery
senses.zh: 范妮·肯伯（Fanny Kemble）：（1809-93）一位英国演员，以在莎士比亚戏剧中扮演角色而闻名。她还因反对美国的奴隶制而闻名，在美国，她曾作为美国农民的妻子生活过一段时间。她的姑姑是西顿夫人。

senses.def: a small bag attached to a belt and worn around the middle part of the body, to keep money, etc. in
a piece of music in a free form, often based on well-known tunes
a film made by Walt Disney
senses.zh: 幻想曲：沃尔特·迪斯尼（Walt Disney）在1940年制作的电影。它以卡通人物（包括米老鼠）为代表的古典音乐。尽管许多人认为这不是呈现严肃音乐的适当方法，但此后此电影一直在公众中流行，并且至今仍在电影院放映。

senses.def: a person who likes to imagine that they are doing something they would like to do, or that something they would like to happen is happening, even though this is very unlikely

examples.en: Billy is a fantasist, trying to escape his dull everyday existence.
examples.zh: 比利是一个幻想家，试图逃离沉闷的日常生活。

senses.def: to imagine that you are doing something that you would like to do, or that something that you would like to happen is happening, even though this is very unlikely

examples.en: He sometimes fantasized about winning the gold medal.
examples.zh: 他有时幻想赢得金牌的情景。

examples.en: I used to fantasize that I lived in a huge castle.
examples.zh: 我曾经幻想过自己住在一座巨大的城堡里。

examples.en: He spent his time fantasizing revenge.
examples.zh: 他把时间花在幻想复仇上。

senses.def: extremely good; excellent

examples.en: He's done a fantastic job.
examples.zh: 他做得非常好。

examples.en: This was a fantastic opportunity for students.
examples.zh: 这对学生来说是个大好机会。

examples.en: You look fantastic!
examples.zh: 你好看极了！

examples.en: It was a fantastic achievement.
examples.zh: 这是一项了不起的成就。

examples.en: The weather was absolutely fantastic.
examples.zh: 天气十分宜人。

examples.en: You've got the job? Fantastic!
examples.zh: 你得到那工作了？太好了！

examples.en: It was fantastic to see so many families enjoying themselves.
examples.zh: 看到这么多的家庭玩得开心真是太好了。

senses.def: very large; larger than you expected
senses.zh: 很大的；大得难以置信的

examples.en: The response to our appeal was fantastic.
examples.zh: 我们的呼吁引起十分强烈的反应。

examples.en: The car costs a fantastic amount of money.
examples.zh: 这轿车的价钱贵得吓人。

senses.def: strange and showing a lot of imagination
senses.zh: 怪诞的；荒诞不经的；富于想象的

examples.en: fantastic dreams of forests and jungles
examples.zh: 关于森林和热带丛林的怪梦

senses.def: impossible to put into practice; impossible to believe
senses.zh: 不切实际的；难以置信的

examples.en: a fantastic scheme/project
examples.zh: 不切实际的计划／方案

examples.en: It may sound rather fantastic, but it's the truth.
examples.zh: 这听起来可能相当离奇，但事实如此。

examples.en: The plot gets increasingly fantastic as the film goes on.
examples.zh: 随着影片播放下去，情节变得越来越离奇。

synonyms.words: cool ▪ fantastic ▪ fabulous ▪ terrific ▪ brilliant ▪ awesome ▪ epic

intro.en: These are all informal words that describe somebody/​something that is very good, impressive, great fun, etc.
intro.zh: 以上各词均为非正式用语，表示美妙的、令人惊叹的、极好玩的等。

items.def: (informal非正式用语) very good; giving a lot of pleasure:
items.zh: 指美妙的、好极的、使人快乐的

examples.en: We had a great time in Madrid.
examples.zh: 我们在马德里玩得很开心。

items.def: (informal非正式用语) used to show that you admire or approve of something, often because it is fashionable, attractive or different:
items.zh: 指因时髦、漂亮或与众不同而令人钦佩的、绝妙的、顶呱呱的

examples.en: I think their new song’s really cool.
examples.zh: 我认为他们的新歌棒极了。

items.def: (informal非正式用语) extremely good; giving a lot of pleasure:
items.zh: 指极好的、了不起的、非常愉快的

examples.en: ‘How was your holiday?’ ‘Fantastic!’
examples.zh: “你假期过得好吗？”“棒极了！”

items.def: (informal非正式用语) extremely good:Jane’s a fabulous cook.简的烹饪技巧堪称一绝。 (Fabulous is slightly more old-fashioned than the other words in this set.)
items.zh: fabulous 较这组词中的其他词稍显过时。

examples.en: Jane’s a fabulous cook.
examples.zh: 简的烹饪技巧堪称一绝。

items.def: (informal非正式用语) extremely good; wonderful:
items.zh: 指极好的、绝妙的、了不起的

examples.en: She’s doing a terrific job.
examples.zh: 她活儿干得真棒。

items.def: (British English, informal英式英语，非正式用语) extremely good; wonderful:
items.zh: 指极好的、绝妙的、了不起的

examples.en: ‘How was the show?’ ‘Brilliant!’
examples.zh: “演出怎么样？”“棒极了！”

items.def: (informal, especially North American English非正式用语，尤用于美式英语) very good, impressive or great fun:
items.zh: 指极好的、令人惊叹的、极好玩的

examples.en: The show was just awesome.
examples.zh: 演出实在棒极了。

items.def: (informal非正式用语) very good, impressive or great fun:
items.zh: 指极好的、令人惊叹的、极好玩的

examples.en: The adventure and action are truly epic in scope.
examples.zh: 惊险刺激的动作场面的确壮观。

senses.def: extremely well
senses.zh: 极好地；出色地；了不起地

examples.en: You did fantastically.
examples.zh: 你做得非常出色。

senses.def: to an extremely large degree
senses.zh: 奇妙地：极大地，巨大地，难以置信地成为

examples.en: fantastically successful
examples.zh: 非常成功

senses.def: very strangely

examples.en: a fantastically shaped piece of stone
examples.zh: 一块奇形怪状的石头

senses.def: a pleasant situation that you imagine but that is unlikely to happen

examples.en: He spoke of his childhood fantasies about becoming a famous football player.
examples.zh: 他谈起儿时想成为足球明星的幻想。

senses.def: a product of your imagination

examples.en: Her books are usually escapist fantasies.
examples.zh: 她的书通常是逃避现实的幻想作品。

senses.def: the act of imagining things; a person’s imagination

examples.en: This is a work of fantasy.
examples.zh: 这是部幻想作品。

examples.en: Stop living in a fantasy world.
examples.zh: 别再生活在幻想世界中了。

examples.en: I live in the real world, not fantasy land.
examples.zh: 我生活在真实世界, 而非梦幻世界

senses.def: a type of story that is set in a world, or a version of our world, that does not really exist and involves magic, monsters

examples.en: She wrote a series of fantasy novels filled with wizards, witches and dragons.
examples.zh: 她写了一系列充满巫师、女巫和龙的奇幻小说。

senses.def: a competition in which you choose players to make your own imaginary team, and score points according to the performance of the real players
senses.zh: 梦幻足球（虚拟比赛方式，组成想象中的球队，根据球员的实际比赛表现计算得分）

examples.en: In his personal time, Stephen blogs for several fantasy hockey leagues.
examples.zh: 在他的个人时间里，斯蒂芬为几个梦幻曲棍球联盟撰写博客。

senses.def: a competition in which you choose players to make your own imaginary team, and score points according to the performance of the real players
senses.zh: 梦幻足球（虚拟比赛方式，组成想象中的球队，根据球员的实际比赛表现计算得分）

senses.def: a magazine that is written and read by fans of a musician, sports team, etc.
senses.zh: （音乐、体育等方面的）爱好者杂志

examples.en: The first science fiction fanzine was published in 1930.
examples.zh: 第一本科幻爱好者杂志于1930年出版。

senses.def: used in writing to mean ‘for the attention of
senses.zh: （书写形式）请…注意；（文件或书信用语）由…处理，由…办理

senses.def: a famous toy shop in Manhattan
senses.zh: 粮农组织在纽约市曼哈顿的一家著名玩具商店，最初由德国移民Frederick Schwarz（1836-1911）于1870年开业。它是世界上最大的之一。FAO Schwarz是最早通过邮购销售商品的公司之一。原店于2015年关闭，但2018年在纽约开设了新店。

senses.def: used in writing to mean ‘frequently asked questions
a Muslim (or sometimes a Hindu) holy man who lives without possessions and survives by receiving food and money from other people
senses.zh: （伊斯兰教或印度教乞讨度日的）托钵僧

senses.def: a long distance away

examples.en: We didn't go far.
examples.zh: 我们没有走远。

examples.en: Have you come far?
examples.zh: 你是远道来的吗？

examples.en: It's not far to the beach.
examples.zh: 到海滩不远。

examples.en: There's not far to go now.
examples.zh: 现在离得不远了。

examples.en: It's too far to walk.
examples.zh: 步行去那儿太远了。

examples.en: The restaurant is not far from here.
examples.zh: 餐厅离这儿不远。

examples.en: countries as far apart as Japan and Brazil
examples.zh: 像日本和巴西这样相隔遥远的国家

examples.en: He looked down at the traffic far below.
examples.zh: 他俯视远在下方行驶的车辆。

examples.en: Far away in the distance, a train whistled.
examples.zh: 远处有一辆火车鸣笛。

examples.en: The farther north they went, the colder it became.
examples.zh: 他们愈往北去，天气就变得愈冷。

examples.en: a concert of music from near and far
examples.zh: 来自四面八方的音乐的演奏会

examples.en: Legends are usually far removed from the reality.
examples.zh: 传说通常与现实相去甚远。

senses.def: used when you are asking or talking about the distance between two places or the distance that has been travelled or is to be travelled
senses.zh: （问到或谈及距离时说）有多远，远（至）

examples.en: How far is it to your house from here?
examples.zh: 从这儿到你家有多远？

examples.en: How far is Boston from New York?
examples.zh: 波士顿 离 纽约有多远?

examples.en: How much further is it?
examples.zh: 还有多远？

examples.en: I'm not sure I can walk so far.
examples.zh: 我没有把握能步行这么远。

examples.en: We'll go by train as far as London, and then take a bus.
examples.zh: 我们坐火车到伦敦，然后转乘公共汽车。

examples.en: We didn't go as far as the others.
examples.zh: 我们不如其他人走得远。

senses.def: a long time from the present; for a large part of a particular period of time

examples.en: The band had their first hit as far back as 2012.
examples.zh: 这支乐队早在 2012 年就推出了第一首大热的歌曲。

examples.en: To answer that question we need to go further back in time.
examples.zh: 要回答这个问题，我们需要追溯到更早的时间。

examples.en: Let's try to plan further ahead.
examples.zh: 咱们尽量计划得更长远些。

examples.en: We worked far into the night.
examples.zh: 我们工作到深夜。

examples.en: The film takes place in a future not too far distant.
examples.zh: 这部电影发生在不遥远的未来。

senses.def: very much; to a great degree
senses.zh: 非常；很大程度上；远远；大大

examples.en: That's a far better idea.
examples.zh: 那个主意好得多。

examples.en: The damage was far worse than I'd expected.
examples.zh: 损失比我预想的严重得多。

examples.en: a drug that gives heart attack victims a far greater chance of survival
examples.zh: 一种为心脏病患者提供更大生存机会的药物

examples.en: There are far more opportunities for young people than there used to be.
examples.zh: 现在年轻人的机会比过去多得多。

examples.en: She always gives us far too much homework.
examples.zh: 她总是让我们做多得不得了的家庭作业。

examples.en: The results far exceeded my expectations.
examples.zh: 结果远超我的预期。

examples.en: The benefits far outweigh the cost.
examples.zh: 其好处远远大于成本。

examples.en: The recent heat and continued drought further reduced yields.
examples.zh: 最近的高温和持续干旱进一步降低了产量。

examples.en: It had been a success far beyond their expectations.
examples.zh: 成功之大远远超过他们的预期。

examples.en: He's fallen far behind in his work.
examples.zh: 他的工作大大落后了。

senses.def: used when you are asking or talking about the degree to which something is true or possible
senses.zh: （问到或谈及程度时说）有多大，直（至）

examples.en: How far can we trust him?

examples.zh: 脱脂酸奶

senses.def: the practice of making unpleasant comments about somebody who is judged to be fat or too heavy
senses.zh: 肥胖羞辱：对被判定为肥胖或过重的人发表不愉快评论的做法

examples.en: Fat shaming is not a way to motivate anyone to lose weight.
examples.zh: 肥胖羞辱并不是激励任何人减肥的方法。

senses.def: causing or ending in death

examples.en: a fatal accident/blow/illness
examples.zh: 致命的事故／一击／疾病

examples.en: a potentially fatal form of cancer
examples.zh: 潜在致死型癌症

examples.en: If she gets ill again it could prove fatal.
examples.zh: 如果她再患病，就会有性命之忧。

senses.def: causing disaster or failure
senses.zh: 灾难性的；毁灭性的；导致失败的

examples.en: a fatal error/mistake
examples.zh: 灾难性的错误

examples.en: Any delay would be fatal.
examples.zh: 任何延误都可能导致失败。

examples.en: There was a fatal flaw in the plan.
examples.zh: 计划中有一个致命的缺陷。

examples.en: It'd be fatal to try and stop them now.
examples.zh: 现在要试图制止他们就会导致灾难性后果。

senses.def: the belief that events are decided by fate

examples.en: There is a mood of profound fatalism amongst party members.
examples.zh: 党员中存在着一种深刻的宿命论情绪。

senses.def: a person who believes that events are decided by fate

examples.en: I'm a fatalist.
examples.zh: 我是宿命论者。

senses.def: showing a belief in fate

examples.en: a fatalistic attitude/outlook
examples.zh: 宿命论的态度/观点

senses.def: in a way that shows a belief in fate
a death that is caused in an accident or a war, or by violence or disease
senses.zh: （事故、战争、暴力事件、疾病中的）死亡

examples.en: Several people were injured, but there were no fatalities.
examples.zh: 有几个人受伤，但没有人死亡。

examples.en: a campaign to reduce the number of fatalities on the roads
examples.zh: 旨在减少道路死亡人数的运动

senses.def: the fact that a particular disease will result in death

examples.en: to reduce the fatality of certain types of cancer
examples.zh: 降低某些癌症的致命性

examples.en: Different forms of cancer have different fatality rates.
examples.zh: 不同类型的癌症死亡率也不同。

examples.en: The fatality rate so far is about 50%.
examples.zh: 目前死亡率约为50%。

senses.def: the belief or feeling that we have no control over what happens to us

examples.en: A sense of fatality gripped her.
examples.zh: 一种命中注定的意识控制着她。

senses.def: in a way that causes or ends in death
senses.zh: 致命的：以导致死亡或死亡的方式

examples.en: fatally injured/wounded
examples.zh: 受致命伤

senses.def: in a way that causes disaster or failure
senses.zh: 灾难性的；毁灭性的；导致失败的

examples.en: The plan was fatally flawed from the start.
examples.zh: 这个计划从一开始就有致命缺陷。

senses.def: a very large mass of solid waste that is found in a sewer
senses.zh: “油脂山”（下水道系统中的巨大固体污物，尤为油脂和弃入马桶的废品）

examples.en: Officials removed a 15-ton lump of wrongly flushed grease and wet wipes, dubbed the ‘fatberg’, from a London sewer.
examples.zh: 官员们从伦敦下水道中移出一块 15 英吨的污物，由不应被冲入马桶的油脂和湿巾混合而成，被称为“油脂山”。

senses.def: the things, especially bad things, that will happen or have happened to somebody/something
senses.zh: 命中注定的事（尤指坏事）；命运的安排

examples.en: The fate of the three men is unknown.
examples.zh: 这三个人命运未卜。

examples.en: She sat outside, waiting to find out her fate.
examples.zh: 她坐在外面，等待命运对她作出的安排。

examples.en: The court will decide our fate/fates.
examples.zh: 法庭将决定我们的命运。

examples.en: Each of the managers suffered the same fate.
examples.zh: 每一个经理命运都是如此。

examples.en: He warned about the scam so others could avoid a similar fate.
examples.zh: 他对这一骗局发出警告，以便其他人可以避免类似的命运。

examples.en: Inhabitants of war-torn areas have been abandoned to their fate.
examples.zh: 饱受战争蹂躏的地区的居民被抛弃了。

examples.en: From that moment our fate was sealed (= our future was decided).
examples.zh: 从那时起我们的命运就已经注定了。

senses.def: the power that is believed to control everything that happens and that cannot be stopped or changed

examples.en: Fate was kind to me that day.
examples.zh: 那天我很幸运。

examples.en: By a strange twist of fate, Andy and I were on the same plane.
examples.zh: 由于命运的奇特安排，我和安迪乘坐了同一架飞机。

senses.def: a terrible thing that could happen

examples.en: At the last minute she was saved from a fate worse than death.
examples.zh: 在最后一刻，她被从比死亡更糟糕的命运中拯救出来。

senses.def: to do something too confidently in a way that might mean that your good luck will come to an end

examples.en: She felt it would be tempting fate to try the difficult climb a second time.
examples.zh: 她觉得再次尝试这种高难度的攀岩就如同玩儿命了。

examples.en: It would be tempting fate to say that we will definitely win the game.
examples.zh: 要说我们肯定会赢得这场比赛，还真有点儿冒险。

senses.def: a terrible thing that could happen

examples.en: At the last minute she was saved from a fate worse than death.
examples.zh: 在最后一刻，她被从比死亡更糟糕的命运中拯救出来。

senses.def: to do something too confidently in a way that might mean that your good luck will come to an end

examples.en: She felt it would be tempting fate to try the difficult climb a second time.
examples.zh: 她觉得再次尝试这种高难度的攀岩就如同玩儿命了。

examples.en: It would be tempting fate to say that we will definitely win the game.
examples.zh: 要说我们肯定会赢得这场比赛，还真有点儿冒险。

intro.en: These are all words for things that happen or the force that causes them to happen.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指机遇、命运、运气。

items.def: the force that causes good or bad things to happen to people:
items.zh: 指机遇、命运、运气

examples.en: This ring has always brought me good luck.
examples.zh: 这戒指总是给我带来好运。

items.def: the way that some things happen without any cause that you can see or understand:
items.zh: 指偶然、碰巧、意外

examples.en: The results could simply be due to chance.
examples.zh: 这结果可能纯属意外。

items.def: the fact of two things happening at the same time by chance, in a surprising way:
items.zh: 指出人意料的巧合、巧事

examples.en: They met through a series of strange coincidences.
examples.zh: 他们因一连串奇妙的巧合而相遇。

items.def: something that happens unexpectedly and is not planned in advance:
items.zh: 指意外、偶然的事

examples.en: Their early arrival was just an accident.
examples.zh: 他们早到仅仅是偶然而已。

items.def: the power that is believed to control everything that happens and that cannot be stopped or changed:
items.zh: 指命运、天数、定数、天意

examples.en: Fate decreed that she would never reach America.
examples.zh: 命中注定她永远到不了美国。

items.def: the power that is believed to control events:
items.zh: 指主宰事物的力量、命运之神

examples.en: I believe there’s some force guiding us—call it God, destiny or fate.
examples.zh: 我认为有某种力量在指引着我们，称之为上帝也罢，天意也罢，或是命运也罢。

senses.def: unable to escape a particular fate
senses.zh: 命中注定的；命运决定的

examples.en: We were fated never to meet again.
examples.zh: 我们注定了永远不能再相见。

examples.en: He believes that everything in life is fated.
examples.zh: 他相信生命中的一切都是注定的。

senses.def: not lucky and ending sadly, especially in death or failure
senses.zh: 注定要倒霉的；时运不济的；（尤指）结局悲惨的

senses.def: having an important, often very bad, effect on future events
senses.zh: 对未来有重大（负面）影响的

examples.en: She looked back now to that fateful day in December.
examples.zh: 她现在回顾十二月里那决定性的一天。

examples.en: his final fateful journey to Moscow
examples.zh: 他最后一次命运攸关的莫斯科之旅

senses.def: a male parent of a child or an animal; a person who is acting as the father to a child

examples.en: My father died in 2017.
examples.zh: 我父亲于 2017 年去世。

examples.en: Ben's a wonderful father.
examples.zh: 本是个极好的父亲。

examples.en: Our new boss is a father of three (= he has three children).
examples.zh: 我们的新老板是三个孩子的父亲。

examples.en: You've been like a father to me.
examples.zh: 你对我一直像父亲一样。

examples.en: He was a wonderful father to both his natural and adopted children.
examples.zh: 他对亲生的和领养的子女都很好。

examples.en: I never met my biological father.
examples.zh: 我从未见过我的亲生父亲。

examples.en: Father, I cannot lie to you.
examples.zh: 爸爸，我不能对你说谎。

senses.def: a person’s ancestors

examples.en: the land of our fathers
examples.zh: 我们祖先的土地

senses.def: the first man to introduce a new way of thinking about something or of doing something
senses.zh: 创始人；奠基者；先驱；鼻祖

examples.en: Henry Moore is considered to be the father of modern British sculpture.
examples.zh: 亨利·穆尔被认为是现代英国雕塑之父。

senses.def: used by Christians to refer to God

examples.en: Father, forgive us.
examples.zh: 天父，宽恕我们吧。

examples.en: God the Father
examples.zh: 天父

senses.def: the title of a priest, especially in the Roman Catholic Church and the Orthodox Church
senses.zh: （尤指天主教和东正教的）神父

examples.en: Father Dominic
examples.zh: 多米尼克神父

senses.def: from one generation of a family to the next
used to say that a son’s character or behaviour is similar to that of his father
very much older than somebody (especially used to suggest that a romantic or sexual relationship between the two people is not appropriate)
senses.zh: 论年龄足以当某人的爹／娘（尤指双方在爱情或性关系方面不相配）

senses.def: we believe a thing because we want it to be true
to become the father of a child by making a woman pregnant

examples.en: He claims to have fathered over 20 children.
examples.zh: 他声称有 20 多个亲生子女。

senses.def: to create new ideas or a new way of doing something
senses.zh: 创立（新思想）；创造，发明（新方法）

senses.def: from one generation of a family to the next
used to say that a son’s character or behaviour is similar to that of his father

items.idm: old enough to be somebody’s father/mother

senses.def: very much older than somebody (especially used to suggest that a romantic or sexual relationship between the two people is not appropriate)
senses.zh: 论年龄足以当某人的爹／娘（尤指双方在爱情或性关系方面不相配）

items.idm: the wish is father to the thought

senses.def: we believe a thing because we want it to be true
the main character in a series of stories by G K Chesterton
senses.zh: 布朗神父：GK切斯特顿的一系列故事的主角。他是解决侦探奥秘的罗马天主教神父。

senses.def: an imaginary old man with red clothes and a long white beard
an older man that somebody respects because he will advise and help them like a father
senses.zh: 父亲般的人；受尊敬的人；长者

examples.en: Adam looked up to Bill as a father figure.
examples.zh: 亚当视比尔为父亲。

senses.def: the father of your husband or wife
(in the past) the title of the person in charge of a branch of any of several British trade unions
senses.zh: 教堂之父：（过去）英国几个工会中任何一个分支机构的负责人的头衔。印刷行业的一些工会称其分支教堂为小教堂。

senses.def: the popular US name for James Madison
senses.zh: 宪法之父：詹姆斯·麦迪逊（James Madison）在美国的流行名称，詹姆斯·麦迪逊是策划和撰写《美国宪法》的团体的主要成员。他后来还提出了构成《权利法案》的《宪法》修正案。

senses.def: a day when fathers receive cards and gifts from their children, usually the third Sunday in June
senses.zh: 父亲节（通常为六月的第三个星期日）

senses.def: an imaginary figure who represents time and looks like an old man carrying a scythe
senses.zh: 时间老人（手拿镰刀和沙漏、象征时间的虚构人物）

senses.def: the state of being a father
(used especially about Germany) the country where a person, or their family, was born, especially when they feel very proud of it
without a father, either because he has died or because he does not live with his children

examples.en: fatherless children/families
examples.zh: 没有父亲的孩子／家庭

examples.en: His long periods abroad left the family virtually fatherless.
examples.zh: 由于长期在国外生活，他的家人几乎失去了父亲。

senses.def: typical of a good father

examples.en: fatherly advice
examples.zh: 慈父般的忠告

examples.en: He keeps a fatherly eye on his players.
examples.zh: 他像父亲一样照管着他的球员。

senses.def: a British pressure group
senses.zh: 父亲4正义：成立于2001年的英国压力组织，其运动是反对其成员认为家庭法院对父亲离婚和分居的不公平待遇，因为父亲有权陪伴孩子。他们的举动引起了很多关注，包括攀登打扮成蝙蝠侠的法院和白金汉宫的墙壁，以及向下议院总理投掷紫色面粉。他们还证明了在家庭法院工作的法官的住所外面。

senses.def: to understand or find an explanation for something
senses.zh: 理解；彻底了解；弄清真相

examples.en: She knew he was angry with her, for some reason she couldn't fathom.
examples.zh: 她知道他生她的气，但搞不清是什么原因。

examples.en: It is hard to fathom the pain felt at the death of a child.
examples.zh: 丧子之痛是难以体会的。

examples.en: He couldn't fathom out what the man could possibly mean.
examples.zh: 他搞不清那男人到底什么意思。

senses.def: a unit for measuring the depth of water, equal to 6 feet or 1.8 metres
senses.zh: 英寻（计量水深的单位，合 6 英尺或 1.8 米）

examples.en: The ship sank in 20 fathoms.
examples.zh: 船沉在水下 20 英寻处。

examples.en: She kept her feelings hidden fathoms deep.
examples.zh: 她把感情深深地隐藏在心中。

senses.def: too deep to be measured

examples.en: the fathomless ocean
examples.zh: 深不可测的海洋

examples.en: fathomless sorrow
examples.zh: 无尽的悲伤

senses.def: a feeling of being extremely tired, usually because of hard work or exercise

examples.en: physical and mental fatigue
examples.zh: 精疲力竭

examples.en: Driver fatigue was to blame for the accident.
examples.zh: 这个事故是驾驶员疲劳所致。

examples.en: I was dropping with fatigue and could not keep my eyes open.
examples.zh: 我快要累倒了，眼睛也睁不开了。

senses.def: a feeling of not wanting to do a particular activity any longer because you have done too much of it

examples.en: Launching too many charity appeals risks bringing on compassion fatigue (= a loss of the ability to feel pity for other people’s suffering).
examples.zh: 发起太多的慈善呼吁可能会导致同情心疲劳（=丧失同情他人痛苦的能力）。

examples.en: The city has lived with masks and restrictions for over a year and people are experiencing pandemic fatigue.
examples.zh: 这座城市在戴口罩和实施限制的情况下生活了一年多，人们正在经历流行病带来的疲劳。

senses.def: weakness in metal or wood caused by repeated bending or stretching

examples.en: The wing of the plane showed signs of metal fatigue.
examples.zh: 机翼显示出金属疲劳的迹象。

senses.def: loose clothes worn by soldiers

examples.en: soldiers in combat fatigues
examples.zh: 身穿作战服的军人

senses.def: duties, such as cleaning and cooking, that soldiers have to do, especially as a punishment
senses.zh: 士兵杂役（如做打扫、帮厨，尤指作为惩罚）

examples.en: We were all put on cookhouse fatigues for a week.
examples.zh: 我们都穿上了一周的厨房工作服。

senses.def: very tired, either physically, mentally or both

examples.en: The troops were already fatigued from the long forced march.
examples.zh: 长途强行军使士兵都已非常疲惫。

senses.def: making you very tired, both physically and mentally
senses.zh: 令人身心交瘁的；劳心劳力的

senses.def: a first name for girls
the quality or fact of having too much flesh
senses.zh: 肥胖：肉过多，体重过重的质量或事实

examples.en: Fatness tends to run in families.
examples.zh: 肥胖往往会遗传。

senses.def: Antoine Domino (1928-2017) a US rock musician who played the piano and sang in a happy, easy style. He was especially popular in the 1950s, when his most successful songs included Ain't That A Shame
senses.zh: “胖子”多米诺：安托万·多米诺（Antoine Domino，1928-2017年），美国摇滚音乐家，以快乐，轻松的风格弹奏钢琴和唱歌。他在1950年代特别受欢迎，当时他最成功的歌曲包括Ai n't That A Shame（1955）和Blueberry Hill（1956）。多米诺骨牌于1986年入选摇滚名人堂。

senses.def: (1904-43) a US jazz musician who sang, played the piano and wrote popular songs. His real name was Thomas Waller. His humorous style influenced many later jazz performers. His hits included Ain't Misbehavin'
senses.zh: （1904-43）美国爵士音乐家，唱歌，弹钢琴和写流行歌曲。他的真名叫托马斯·沃勒。他幽默的风格影响了许多后来的爵士表演者。他的热门歌曲包括Ai n't Misbehavin'（1928年）和Honeysuckle Rose（1929年），他还撰写了非裔美国人音乐节目Keep Shufflin'（1928年）和Hot Chocolates（1929年）。后来他领导了Fats Waller和他的节奏乐队，他们的歌曲包括The Joint Is Jumpin'（1937）和Honey Hush（1939）。

senses.def: an offensive word for a person who you think is fat
to make somebody/something fatter, especially an animal before killing it for food; to become fatter
senses.zh: （使）长胖，长肥；（尤指动物宰杀前）育肥

examples.en: The piglets are taken from the sow to be fattened for market.
examples.zh: 这些小猪被从母猪身边带走，好育肥上市。

examples.en: She's very thin after her illness—but we'll soon fatten her up.
examples.zh: 她病后瘦得很，不过我们会使她迅速胖起来的。

senses.def: unfair treatment of people because of their large body size
treating people unfairly because of their large body size
containing a lot of fat; consisting of fat
senses.zh: 富含脂肪的；肥胖的；脂肪的

examples.en: fatty foods
examples.zh: 高脂食物

examples.en: fatty tissue
examples.zh: 脂肪组织

senses.def: an offensive word for a person who you think is fat
an acid

examples.en: fish that are rich in omega-3 fatty acids
examples.zh: 富含 ω-3 脂肪酸的鱼类

senses.def: (1887-1933) a US comic actor in silent films. He was one of the Keystone Kops
senses.zh: 《胖子》阿巴克（Fatty）Arbuckle：（1887-1933）美国无声电影中的喜剧演员。在成为流行电影的明星之前，他是Keystone Kops之一。1921年，他被怀疑在一次聚会中造成一名女演员死亡。尽管法院认为他无罪，但他的职业生涯已经结束。

senses.def: stupid

examples.en: a fatuous comment/grin
examples.zh: 愚蠢的话语；龇牙咧嘴的傻笑

examples.en: Their arguments are completely fatuous.
examples.zh: 他们的论点完全是愚蠢的。

senses.def: stupidly
a decision or order made under Islamic law
senses.zh: 法特瓦（伊斯兰律法的裁决或教令）

senses.def: a device that controls the flow of water from a pipe

examples.en: the hot/cold faucet
examples.zh: 热水／冷水龙头

examples.en: to turn a faucet on/off
examples.zh: 开／关龙头

senses.def: a police officer
the responsibility for something wrong that has happened or been done

examples.en: Why should I say sorry when it's not my fault?
examples.zh: 不是我的错为什么要我道歉？

examples.en: It's nobody's fault.
examples.zh: 谁都没有错。

examples.en: He believes that the product’s poor image is partly the fault of the press.
examples.zh: 他认为，该产品形象不佳的部分原因在于媒体。

examples.en: It was his fault that we were late.
examples.zh: 我们迟到责任在他。

examples.en: It's your own fault for being careless.
examples.zh: 你粗心大意是你自己的过失。

examples.en: He would not admit fault for the collision.
examples.zh: 他不承认碰撞事故的过错。

examples.en: I think the owners are at fault (= responsible) for not warning us.
examples.zh: 我认为业主没有提醒我们是有责任的。

examples.en: Many people live in poverty through no fault of their own.
examples.zh: 很多人生活贫困并非他们自己有什么过错。

senses.def: a bad or weak aspect of somebody’s character

examples.en: He's proud of his children and blind to their faults.
examples.zh: 他为孩子们感到自豪，对他们的缺点视而不见。

examples.en: I love her for all her faults (= in spite of them).
examples.zh: 尽管她有这么多缺点，我还是爱她。

examples.en: I think my worst fault is impatience.
examples.zh: 我认为我最大的错误是缺乏耐心。

senses.def: something that is wrong or not perfect; something that is wrong with a machine or system that stops it from working correctly

examples.en: The book's virtues far outweigh its faults.
examples.zh: 这本书优点远远大于缺点。

examples.en: a mechanical/technical fault
examples.zh: 机械/技术故障

examples.en: The fire was caused by an electrical fault.
examples.zh: 这次火灾是电路故障引起的。

examples.en: The system, for all its faults, is the best available at the moment.
examples.zh: 这个系统虽然缺点不少，却是现有最好的一个。

examples.en: a major fault in the design
examples.zh: 设计中的一个重大失误

examples.en: We're trying to correct the faults in the program.
examples.zh: 我们正设法修正程序中的毛病。

examples.en: a common fault with this type of machine
examples.zh: 这类机器都有的缺陷

examples.en: The film is not without fault.
examples.zh: 这部电影并非没有缺点。

senses.def: a mistake made when serving

examples.en: He has served a number of double faults in this set.
examples.zh: 他在这盘发球出现了一些双误。

examples.en: Even tennis champions sometimes serve double faults.
examples.zh: 即使是网球冠军有时也会双发失误。

senses.def: a place where there is a break that is longer than usual in the layers of rock in the earth’s crust

examples.en: the San Andreas fault
examples.zh: 圣安德烈亚斯断层

examples.en: a fault line
examples.zh: 断层线

senses.def: to look for and discover mistakes in somebody/something; to complain about somebody/something

examples.en: My mother did nothing but find fault with my manners.
examples.zh: 母亲只是一味说我没有礼貌。

examples.en: My boss finds fault with everything I do.
examples.zh: 我的老板对我所做的一切都挑剔。

senses.def: used to say that somebody has a lot, or even too much, of a particular good quality

examples.en: She is generous to a fault.
examples.zh: 她过分慷慨。

senses.def: to find a mistake or a weakness in somebody/something

examples.en: Her colleagues could not fault her dedication to the job.
examples.zh: 她的同事认为她的敬业精神是无可挑剔的。

examples.en: He had always been polite—she couldn't fault him on that.
examples.zh: 他总是彬彬有礼，在这方面她对他无可指摘。

senses.def: to look for and discover mistakes in somebody/something; to complain about somebody/something

examples.en: My mother did nothing but find fault with my manners.
examples.zh: 母亲只是一味说我没有礼貌。

examples.en: My boss finds fault with everything I do.
examples.zh: 我的老板对我所做的一切都挑剔。

senses.def: used to say that somebody has a lot, or even too much, of a particular good quality

examples.en: She is generous to a fault.
examples.zh: 她过分慷慨。

senses.def: constant criticism, especially about things that are not important

examples.en: When you have to confront your child, avoid blaming, criticizing or fault-finding.
examples.zh: 当你必须面对孩子时，避免责备、批评或吹毛求疵。

senses.def: a place where there is a long break in the rock that forms the surface of the earth and where earthquakes are more likely to happen
senses.zh: 断层线（岩石断裂处，可能发生地震）

examples.en: The fact that Tokyo sits directly on a fault line has resulted in a string of powerful earthquakes over the centuries.
examples.zh: 东京直接位于断层线上，几个世纪以来导致了一系列强烈地震。

senses.def: an issue that people disagree about and may, as a result, lead to conflict

examples.en: The two men are from opposite sides of the nation's political fault line.
examples.zh: 这两个人来自国家政治冲突的对立方。

senses.def: the ability of a system to continue working even when its individual parts fail
senses.zh: 容错（构件发生故障后，系统仍能运作）

examples.en: The old system suffered from a low level of fault tolerance.
examples.zh: 旧系统容错性低。

senses.def: that continues to work even when its individual parts fail
senses.zh: 容错的（构件发生故障后，系统仍能运作）

examples.en: equipment with fault-tolerant features
examples.zh: 具有容错功能的设备

senses.def: having no mistakes
senses.zh: 没有错误的；无缺点的；完美无缺的

examples.en: faultless English
examples.zh: 完美的英语

examples.en: Her piano-playing was faultless.
examples.zh: 她的钢琴演奏无可挑剔。

senses.def: without any mistakes
senses.zh: 没有错误的；无缺点的；完美无缺的

examples.en: The engine performed faultlessly.
examples.zh: 发动机表现完美。

senses.def: not perfect; not working or made correctly
senses.zh: 不完美的；有错误的；有缺陷的

examples.en: Ask for a refund if the goods are faulty.
examples.zh: 商品如有缺陷，可要求退款。

examples.en: The retailers blamed faulty workmanship for the problem.
examples.zh: 零售商认为问题在于做工有缺陷。

examples.en: The accident was caused by a faulty signal.
examples.zh: 这起事故是由信号故障引起的。

senses.def: wrong or containing mistakes, often resulting in bad decisions

examples.en: faulty reasoning
examples.zh: 错误推理

senses.def: (in ancient Roman stories) a god of the woods, with a man’s face and body and a goat's
senses.zh: 农牧神（见于古罗马故事，呈人面人身羊腿羊角）

senses.def: all the animals living in an area or in a particular period of history
senses.zh: （某地区或某时期的）动物群，动物区系

examples.en: the local flora and fauna (= plants and animals)
examples.zh: 当地动植物群

examples.en: land and marine faunas
examples.zh: 陆地和海洋动物区系

senses.def: an agreement in which somebody agrees to do something bad or dishonest, in return for money, success or power
senses.zh: 浮士德式的（交易或协议）（为获得财富、成功或权力而不择手段）

senses.def: because there is nothing else that is better

examples.en: We were obliged, faute de mieux, to drink the local beverage.
examples.zh: 因为没有更好的饮料，我们只好将就着喝当地的。

senses.def: a member of a group of French painters who were important in Fauvism
a style of painting that uses bright colours and in which objects and people are represented in a non-realistic way. It was popular in Paris for a short period from 1905.
senses.zh: 野兽派，野兽主义（一种绘画风格，以鲜明色彩和非现实主义方式表现物体和人物，从 1905 年起在巴黎流行一时）

senses.def: artificial, but intended to look or seem real

examples.en: The chairs were covered in faux animal skin.
examples.zh: 椅子套是人造兽皮的。

examples.en: His accent was so faux.
examples.zh: 他的口音听上去很假。

senses.def: an action or a remark that causes somebody to feel embarrassed because it is not socially correct
senses.zh: 有失检点；失态；失礼；失言

examples.en: I committed a faux pas that my friends have never let me forget.
examples.zh: 我犯了一件失礼的事，我的朋友们永远让我难忘。

senses.def: a type of round, pale green bean. Several fava beans
favourite

examples.en: her fave reality show
examples.zh: 她最喜欢的真人秀

senses.def: a favourite person or thing

examples.en: That song is one of my faves.
examples.zh: 这是我特别喜爱的歌曲之一。

senses.def: a poor area in or near a Brazilian city, with many small houses that are close together and in bad condition
senses.zh: （巴西城市或边缘的）棚户区，贫民窟

senses.def: an icon
senses.zh: 网页图标，网站头像（通常出现在浏览器页面顶端的网址框）

senses.def: a thing that you do to help somebody

examples.en: Could you do me a favour and pick up Sam from school today?
examples.zh: 今天你能帮我个忙去学校接萨姆吗？

examples.en: Can I ask a favour?
examples.zh: 请帮个忙行吗？

examples.en: I would never ask for any favours from her.
examples.zh: 我再也不会请她帮任何忙了。

examples.en: I'll ask Steve to take it. He owes me a favour.
examples.zh: 我要让史蒂夫接受，他欠我一个人情。

examples.en: Thanks for helping me out. I'll return the favour (= help you because you have helped me) some time.
examples.zh: 多谢你帮了我个大忙。总有一天我会报答你的。

examples.en: I'm going as a favour to Ann, not because I want to.
examples.zh: 我去是给安一个面子，而不是我想去。

examples.en: Do yourself a favour (= help yourself) and wear a helmet on the bike.
examples.zh: 要照顾自己，骑车戴上头盔。

senses.def: approval or support for somebody/something

examples.en: Artists sought the favour of wealthy patrons.
examples.zh: 艺术家谋求富有的赞助人的支持。

examples.en: The suggestion to close the road has found favour with (= been supported by) local people.
examples.zh: 关闭这条路的建议已得到当地人的支持。

examples.en: to gain/win/lose favour with somebody
examples.zh: 得到／赢得／失去某人的好感

examples.en: The programme has lost favour with viewers recently.
examples.zh: 近来这个节目已不受观众欢迎。

examples.en: The policy is gaining favour among voters.
examples.zh: 该政策正在赢得选民的青睐。

examples.en: She's not in favour with (= supported or liked by) the media just now.
examples.zh: 目前她没有媒体的捧场。

examples.en: It seems Tim is back in favour with the boss (= the boss likes him again).
examples.zh: 看来蒂姆又赢得了老板的好感。

examples.en: Reality TV has begun to fall out of favour with viewers.
examples.zh: 观众开始不喜欢看真人秀电视节目了。

examples.en: an athlete who fell from favour after a drugs scandal
examples.zh: 在毒品丑闻以后不再受人喜爱的运动员

examples.en: The government looks with favour upon (= approves of) the report's recommendations.
examples.zh: 政府赞同报告所提出的建议。

senses.def: treatment that is generous to one person or group in a way that seems unfair to others

examples.en: As an examiner, she showed no favour to any candidate.
examples.zh: 作为主考人她没有偏袒任何应试者。

senses.def: a small gift given to children at a party
senses.zh: （送给孩子的）聚会小礼品，派对礼物

senses.def: agreement to have sex with somebody

examples.en: demands for sexual favours
examples.zh: 对性交的要求

senses.def: you are likely to succeed because the conditions are good and you have an advantage
to try to get somebody to like or support you by praising or helping them a lot

examples.en: He’s always trying to curry favour with the boss.
examples.zh: 他总是想方设法拍老板马屁。

examples.en: She tried to curry favour with the teachers.
examples.zh: 她试图讨好老师们。

senses.def: used in reply to a question that you think is silly
senses.zh: （回答认为是愚蠢的问题）得了吧

examples.en: ‘Do you think they'll win?’ ‘Do me a favour! They haven't got a single decent player.’
examples.zh: “你认为他们会赢吗？”“得了吧！他们连一个像样的运动员都没有。”

senses.def: to do something that is not helpful to somebody or that gives a bad impression of them
senses.zh: 无助于某人；给某人留下坏印象

examples.en: You're not doing yourself any favours, working for nothing.
examples.zh: 你干活不取报酬，对自己没有任何好处。

examples.en: The orchestra did Beethoven no favours.
examples.zh: 这个交响乐团没有把贝多芬的乐曲演奏好。

senses.def: if you are in favour

examples.en: He argued in favour of a strike.
examples.zh: 他据理力争主张罢工。

examples.en: There were 247 votes in favour (of the motion) and 152 against.
examples.zh: 有 247 票赞成（动议），152 票反对。

examples.en: I'm all in favour of (= completely support) equal pay for equal work.
examples.zh: 我完全支持同工同酬。

examples.en: Most of the ‘don't knows’ in the opinion polls came down in favour of (= eventually chose to support) the Democrats.
examples.zh: 在民意测验中多数未作决定的选民最终决定支持民主党人。

senses.def: in exchange for another thing (because the other thing is better or you want it more)
senses.zh: 为获得（更好或更需要的事物）

examples.en: He abandoned teaching in favour of a career as a musician.
examples.zh: 他弃教从事音乐。

examples.en: Early in his musical career he abandoned blues in favour of jazz.
examples.zh: 他在音乐生涯的早期就放弃了布鲁斯音乐而选择了爵士乐。

senses.def: if something is in somebody’s favour
senses.zh: 有利于某人；有助于某人

examples.en: The exchange rate is in our favour at the moment.
examples.zh: 目前汇率对我们有利。

examples.en: She was willing to bend the rules in Mary's favour.
examples.zh: 她愿意放宽规定以有利于玛丽。

examples.en: The golf tournament went in the Americans' favour.
examples.zh: 美国队在高尔夫锦标赛中获胜。

senses.def: a decision or judgement that is in somebody’s favour
senses.zh: （决定）对某人有利；（判决）判某人正确

examples.en: The court decided in Ms Smith’s favour and she received compensation for unfair dismissal.
examples.zh: 法院做出了对史密斯女士有利的判决，她因不公平解雇而获得了赔偿。

examples.en: The High Court found in favour of the plaintiffs.
examples.zh: 高等法院判定原告胜诉。

senses.def: in a fair way

examples.en: They undertook to make their judgement without fear or favour.
examples.zh: 他们承诺公正无私地做出判断。

senses.def: to prefer one system, plan, way of doing something, etc. to another

examples.en: Many countries favour a presidential system of government.
examples.zh: 很多国家选择总统制政府。

examples.en: It’s a resort favoured by families with young children.
examples.zh: 那是个有小孩子的家庭喜欢去度假的地方。

examples.en: Another solution, which I strongly favour, is lower taxes for everyone.
examples.zh: 我强烈支持的另一个解决方案是降低每个人的税收。

examples.en: With make-up I favour a minimalist approach.
examples.zh: 对于化妆，我喜欢极简主义的方法。

examples.en: She favours hugs over handshakes.
examples.zh: 她喜欢拥抱多于握手。

examples.en: Most patients favour seeing the same GP for all their health needs.
examples.zh: 大多数病人喜欢看同一个全科医生来解决所有的健康问题。

senses.def: to treat one person, group or organization better than you treat others, especially in an unfair way

examples.en: The treaty seems to favour the US.
examples.zh: 这项条约似乎偏向美国。

examples.en: My parents always favoured my older brother.
examples.zh: 我的父母总是偏爱我的哥哥。

examples.en: He favoured some individuals at the expense of others.
examples.zh: 他为了支持某些个人而牺牲了其他人。

examples.en: News coverage should not favour one party over another.
examples.zh: 新闻报道不应偏袒某一政党。

senses.def: to provide suitable conditions for a particular person, group, etc.

examples.en: The warm climate favours many types of tropical plants.
examples.zh: 温暖的气候对多种热带植物生长有利。

senses.def: to look like one of your parents or older relations
senses.zh: 外貌像，长得像（父母或长辈）

examples.en: She definitely favours her father.
examples.zh: 她酷似她父亲。

senses.group: look like parent 外貌像父母

senses.def: to be expected to achieve something, especially in a competition
senses.zh: 有望做某事〔指获胜或成功〕

examples.en: He is favoured to win a third Olympic gold medal.
examples.zh: 他有望赢得第三枚奥运会金牌。

senses.group: look like parent 外貌像父母

items.idm: the cards/odds are stacked in your favour

senses.def: you are likely to succeed because the conditions are good and you have an advantage
to try to get somebody to like or support you by praising or helping them a lot

senses.zh: （决定）对某人有利；（判决）判某人正确

examples.en: The court decided in Ms Smith’s favour and she received compensation for unfair dismissal.
examples.zh: 法院做出了对史密斯女士有利的判决，她因不公平解雇而获得了赔偿。
