examples.zh: 他们承诺公正无私地做出判断。

senses.def: to be expected to achieve something, especially in a competition
senses.zh: 有望做某事〔指获胜或成功〕

examples.en: He is favoured to win a third Olympic gold medal.
examples.zh: 他有望赢得第三枚奥运会金牌。

senses.def: the extent to which somebody/something is liked or approved of
senses.zh: 有利程度：某人/某事被喜欢或认可的程度

examples.en: the president's favourability ratings
examples.zh: 总统的好感度

senses.def: the quality of being good for something and making it likely to be successful or have an advantage

examples.en: the favourability of conditions for plant growth
examples.zh: 有利于植物生长的条件

senses.def: making people have a good opinion of somebody/something

examples.en: She made a favourable impression in the interview.
examples.zh: 她在采访中给人留下了良好的印象。

examples.en: The biography shows him in a favourable light.
examples.zh: 传记刻画出了他的正面形象。

examples.en: She gained a highly favourable impression of the company.
examples.zh: 这家公司给她的印象非常好。

senses.def: positive and showing your good opinion of somebody/something

examples.en: The performance drew a lot of favourable comments from reviewers.
examples.zh: 那场演出获得评论家的许多好评。

examples.en: Reviews of the book have been favourable.
examples.zh: 这本书的评论是好评的。

examples.en: His proposals met with a broadly favourable response.
examples.zh: 他的提议得到了广泛支持。

senses.def: expressing your agreement; giving permission

examples.en: Their demands received a favourable response.
examples.zh: 他们的要求获准了。

senses.def: good for something and making it likely to be successful or have an advantage

examples.en: favourable economic conditions
examples.zh: 有利的经济环境

examples.en: An area with a favourable climate will inevitably be richer than one without.
examples.zh: 气候条件优越的地区必然会比气候恶劣的地区富裕些。

examples.en: The terms of the agreement are favourable to both sides.
examples.zh: 协议条款对双方都有利。

examples.en: The weather was favourable for a barbecue outside.
examples.zh: 天气非常适合户外烧烤。

senses.def: fairly good and not too expensive

examples.en: They offered me a loan on very favourable terms.
examples.zh: 他们提出以十分优惠的条件贷款给我。

examples.en: terms that could hardly be considered favourable
examples.zh: 几乎不能认为是有利的条件

senses.def: blowing in the direction of travel

examples.en: They could not sail without a favourable wind.
examples.zh: 没有顺风，他们就无法航行。

examples.en: These plans will need a favourable economic wind.
examples.zh: 这些计划需要有利的经济风。

senses.def: in a way that is positive and shows a good opinion of somebody/something

examples.en: He speaks very favourably of your work.
examples.zh: 他对你的工作大加赞赏。

examples.en: I was very favourably impressed with her work.
examples.zh: 她的工作给我留下了很好的印象。

senses.def: in a way that is good for something and makes it likely to be successful or have an advantage

examples.en: These figures compare favourably with last year's.
examples.zh: 这些数字比去年的好。

senses.def: liked more than others of the same kind

examples.en: It's one of my favourite movies.
examples.zh: 这是我特别喜欢的电影之一。

examples.en: What is your all-time favourite song?
examples.zh: 你最最喜欢的歌曲是哪首？

examples.en: Who is your favourite writer?
examples.zh: 谁是你特别喜欢的作家？

examples.en: January is my least favourite month.
examples.zh: 一月是我最不喜欢的月份。

senses.def: a performer, politician, sports player, etc., who is popular where they were born
senses.zh: 故乡的骄子（可指演员、政治家、运动员等）

senses.def: (in the US) a candidate for president who is supported by his or her own state in the first part of a campaign
senses.zh: （美国大选第一阶段）本州支持的总统候选人

senses.def: a person or thing that you like more than the others of the same type

examples.en: Which one's your favourite?
examples.zh: 你最喜欢哪一个？

examples.en: The band played all my old favourites.
examples.zh: 乐队演奏了所有我最喜欢的老曲子。

examples.en: One of my personal favourites is a movie that should please every age group.
examples.zh: 我个人最喜欢的电影之一是一部应该让每个年龄段的人都满意的电影。

examples.en: This song is a particular favourite of mine.
examples.zh: 我尤其喜爱这首歌曲。

examples.en: The programme has become a firm favourite with young people.
examples.zh: 这个节目已着实赢得了年轻人的喜爱。

examples.en: These biscuits are great favourites with the children.
examples.zh: 孩子们特别喜欢这种饼干。

senses.def: a person who is liked better by somebody and receives better treatment than others
senses.zh: 受宠的人；得到偏爱的人

examples.en: She loved all her grandchildren but Ann was her favourite.
examples.zh: 她爱所有的孙儿孙女，但最宠安。

examples.en: Parents should never have favourites.
examples.zh: 父母永远不应该有偏爱。

examples.en: She was an extremely good student and a great favourite with the nuns.
examples.zh: 她是个十分出色的学生，修女们都很宠爱她。

examples.en: He is a favourite among his teammates.
examples.zh: 他很受队友的欢迎。

senses.def: a record of a section of an app or the address of a website that enables you to find it quickly
senses.zh: （收藏应用程序或网址的）我的最爱，收藏夹

examples.en: Add the website as a favourite.
examples.zh: 将这个网站加到收藏夹。

examples.en: Have you added this website to your favourites list?
examples.zh: 您是否已将此网站添加到您的收藏夹列表中？

examples.en: I've added the sports section to my favourites.
examples.zh: 我已将体育部分添加到我的收藏夹中。

senses.def: the horse, runner, team, etc. that is expected to win

examples.en: The favourite came third.
examples.zh: 那个有望夺魁者得了第三名。

examples.en: Her horse is the hot favourite for the race.
examples.zh: 她的马在这次赛马中夺魁的呼声最高。

examples.en: The Brazilians still look firm favourites to take the title.
examples.zh: 巴西队似乎仍是夺冠的大热门。

senses.def: the person who is expected by most people to get a particular job or position

examples.en: She's the favourite for the job.
examples.zh: 她最有希望得到这份工作。

examples.en: She's the favourite to succeed him as leader.
examples.zh: 她最有希望接替他成为领导人。

senses.def: to show that you like something that somebody has put on a social media

examples.en: It wasn't long until their original post was favourited over 1 200 times.
examples.zh: 没过多久，他们的原创帖子就被点赞了 1 200 多次。

senses.def: to save the address of a website or other online data so that you can easily find it again
senses.zh: （收藏应用程序或网址的）我的最爱，收藏夹

examples.en: The ‘Favourites’ tab lets you access places you've favourited.
examples.zh: “收藏夹”选项卡可让您访问您收藏的地方。

senses.def: a performer, politician, sports player, etc., who is popular where they were born
senses.zh: 故乡的骄子（可指演员、政治家、运动员等）

senses.def: (in the US) a candidate for president who is supported by his or her own state in the first part of a campaign
senses.zh: （美国大选第一阶段）本州支持的总统候选人

intro.en: These are all words for a person or thing that is chosen, or that is liked more than others.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指选中或特别喜爱的人或事物。

items.def: a person or thing that is chosen:
items.zh: 指入选者、选中的东西

examples.en: She’s the obvious choice for the job.
examples.zh: 她是这个职位当然的人选。

items.def: a person or thing that you like more than the others of the same type:
items.zh: 指同类人或事物中最喜欢的一个

examples.en: Which one’s your favourite?
examples.zh: 你最喜欢哪一个？

items.def: a thing that is liked better or best:
items.zh: 指偏爱的或最喜爱的事物

examples.en: Tastes and preferences vary from individual to individual.
examples.zh: 人的爱好和选择各不相同。

items.def: a number of people or things that have been chosen from a larger group:
items.zh: 指从大群中选出来的一组人或物

examples.en: A selection of reader’s comments are published below.
examples.zh: 下面选登了部分读者评论。

items.def: (rather informal) a person or thing that is chosen:
items.zh: 指入选者、选中的东西

examples.en: She was his pick for best actress.
examples.zh: 她是他认为最好的女演员。

senses.def: the act of unfairly treating one person better than others because you like them better

examples.en: The students accused the teacher of favouritism.
examples.zh: 学生指责老师偏心。

examples.en: She had four children but never showed any favouritism.
examples.zh: 她有四个孩子，但从未表现出任何偏袒。

senses.def: a British comedy television series made in the 1970s and still regularly repeated. The programmes are set in a hotel called Fawlty Towers, where things are always going wrong. The owner, Basil Fawlty, played by John Cleese, always makes the situation worse in his wild and funny attempts to hide the problem
senses.zh: 1970年代制作的英国喜剧电视连续剧，至今仍在定期播放。这些程序设置在一家名为Fawlty Towers的酒店，那里总是出问题。所有者约翰·克莱斯（John Cleese）扮演的罗勒·福尔蒂（Basil Fawlty）总是在疯狂而有趣的隐藏问题的尝试中使情况变得更糟

examples.en: The food was awful and the service was straight out of Fawlty Towers.
examples.zh: 食物很糟糕，服务直接来自福尔蒂塔。

senses.def: light yellow-brown in colour

examples.en: a fawn coat
examples.zh: 浅黄褐色外套

senses.def: a deer
a light yellow-brown colour
to try to please somebody by praising them or paying them too much attention

examples.en: He seemed unaware of the girl’s fawning admiration.
examples.zh: 他似乎没有意识到那女孩对他一味讨好、满怀仰慕。

examples.en: Why is everybody fawning over him as if he were a national hero?
examples.zh: 为什么大家都把他当作民族英雄来奉承呢？

senses.def: a machine that sends and receives documents in an electronic form along phone wires and then prints them

examples.en: Before the internet, the fax was an essential piece of office equipment.
examples.zh: 在互联网出现之前，传真是必不可少的办公设备。

senses.def: a system for sending documents using scanned images over a phone line or the internet

examples.en: In those days we often sent documents by fax.
examples.zh: 那时候我们经常用传真发送文件。

senses.def: a letter or message sent by fax
senses.zh: 传真信件；传真电文；明电

examples.en: You can still send faxes via email.
examples.zh: 现在仍然可以用电子邮件发送传真。

senses.def: to send somebody a document, message, etc. by fax

examples.en: Could you fax me the latest version?
examples.zh: 你可不可以把最新版本传真给我？

examples.en: Could you fax it to me?
examples.zh: 你能把它传真给我吗？

examples.en: I faxed the list of hotels through to them.
examples.zh: 我把旅馆名单传真给了他们。

senses.def: a first name for girls
an outdoor entertainment at which people can play games to win prizes, buy food and drink, etc., usually arranged to make money for a special purpose
senses.zh: 露天游乐会；义卖游乐会

examples.en: Every year the school holds a summer fayre.
examples.zh: 学校每年都举办暑期募捐游乐会。

senses.def: a range of food of a particular type

examples.en: Visitors to the farmers’ market can sample fresh local fayre.
examples.zh: 游客到农贸市场可以尝到当地新鲜的食物。

senses.def: to make you feel confused or shocked, so that you do not know what to do
senses.zh: 使慌乱；使惊慌失措；使困窘

examples.en: She wasn't fazed by his comments.
examples.zh: 她并没有因他的话而惊慌失措。

examples.en: He looked as if nothing could faze him.
examples.zh: 他显得镇静自若，遇事不惊。

senses.def: Federal Bureau of Investigation
football club

examples.en: Liverpool FC
examples.zh: 利物浦足球俱乐部

senses.def: Federal Communications Commission
senses.zh: 联邦通信委员会（美国管理广播、电视、电话和其他通信系统的政府部门）

examples.en: The FCC regulates broadcasters' use of the public airwaves.
examples.zh: 联邦通信委员会监管广播、电视公司对公共波段的使用。

senses.def: the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office
senses.zh: 外交和联邦事务部（英国政府部门，旧称 the Foreign Office，现在仍常见此说法）

senses.def: a British test, now called ‘
senses.zh: 第一英语证书考试，剑桥通用英语第三级（现称 B2 First，英国考试，考查英语作为外语者的中高级口语和写作能力，全写为 First Certificate in English）

senses.def: Food and Drug Administration
foreign direct investment
senses.zh: 对外直接投资；国外直接投资；外商直接投资

senses.def: an independent US government organization that provides insurance for bank accounts. It was created in 1933, and all Federal Reserve Banks
senses.zh: 美国联邦存款保险公司独立的美国政府机构，为银行账户提供保险。创建于 1933 年，所有联邦储备银行都在其保险范围内。如果一家银行倒闭，联邦存款保险公司会向每一名客户支付赔偿金。

senses.def: Franklin D Roosevelt
(in the UK) further education
a promise to be loyal
the bad feeling that you have when you are in danger or when a particular thing frightens you

examples.en: Her eyes showed no fear.
examples.zh: 她的眼神无丝毫畏惧。

examples.en: The child was shaking with fear.
examples.zh: 小孩吓得发抖。

examples.en: I suddenly felt gripped by fear.
examples.zh: 我突然感到一阵恐惧。

examples.en: We were living in a perpetual state of fear and anxiety.
examples.zh: 我们一直生活在恐惧和焦虑的状态中。

examples.en: The attacks created a climate of fear.
examples.zh: 这些袭击造成了恐惧气氛。

examples.en: Terror attacks are a tool to instil fear in the public.
examples.zh: 恐怖袭击是向公众灌输恐惧的工具。

examples.en: He managed to overcome his fears.
examples.zh: 他成功克服了恐惧。

examples.en: Fear of crime can affect people's lives.
examples.zh: 人们担心罪案发生，生活或会受到影响。

examples.en: We lived in constant fear of losing our jobs.
examples.zh: 我们一直生活在担心失去工作的阴影里。

examples.en: Women should be able to work without fear of harassment.
examples.zh: 女性应该能够在工作中不用担心受到骚扰。

senses.def: a feeling of concern about somebody's safety or about something bad that might happen

examples.en: The doctor's report confirmed our worst fears.
examples.zh: 医生的报告证实了我们最大的担忧。

examples.en: Police tried hard to allay the fears of local residents.
examples.zh: 警方努力减轻当地居民的恐惧。

examples.en: her fears for her son’s safety
examples.zh: 她对儿子安全的担忧

examples.en: Alan spoke of his fears for the future.
examples.zh: 艾伦谈到了他对未来的担忧。

examples.en: the fear that he had cancer
examples.zh: 担心他患癌症

examples.en: The announcement sparked fears that interest rates will rise.
examples.zh: 该公告引发了人们对利率将会上升的担忧。

examples.en: The government announced the new measures amid growing security fears.
examples.zh: 政府在安全担忧日益加剧的情况下宣布了新措施。

senses.def: to avoid the danger of something happening

examples.en: We spoke quietly for fear of waking the guards.
examples.zh: 我们悄悄说话，以免惊醒警卫。

examples.en: I had to run away for fear (that) he might one day kill me.
examples.zh: 我只好逃走，生怕他有一天把我杀了。

senses.def: feeling frightened that you might be killed
senses.zh: 害怕会丧生；为生命安全担忧

senses.def: used to say that you definitely do not want to do something
senses.zh: （表示决不愿做某事）绝不，当然不

examples.en: ‘Are you coming climbing?’ ‘No fear!’
examples.zh: “你来爬山吗？”“当然不！”

senses.def: to make somebody very frightened, especially in order to make them do something
senses.zh: 恐吓；（尤指）威胁某人服从

senses.def: to make somebody be afraid, etc.

examples.en: The sound of gunfire struck fear into the hearts of the villagers.
examples.zh: 炮声使村民心惊胆战。

senses.def: in a fair way

examples.en: They undertook to make their judgement without fear or favour.
examples.zh: 他们承诺公正无私地做出判断。

senses.def: to be frightened of somebody/something or frightened of doing something

examples.en: All his employees fear him.
examples.zh: 他的雇员都怕他。

examples.en: They have reason to fear the police.
examples.zh: 他们有理由害怕警察。

examples.en: to fear death/persecution/the unknown
examples.zh: 怕死；害怕遭迫害／未知的事物

examples.en: Everyone feared the coming war.
examples.zh: 每个人都担心即将到来的战争。

examples.en: propaganda designed to make us hate and fear the enemy
examples.zh: 旨在让我们仇恨和恐惧敌人的宣传

examples.en: Don't worry, you have nothing to fear from us.
examples.zh: 别担心，你一点也不必害怕我们。

examples.en: She feared to tell him the truth.
examples.zh: 她不敢把真相告诉他。

examples.en: She feared going out at night.
examples.zh: 她不敢晚上出去。

senses.def: to feel that something bad might have happened or might happen in the future

examples.en: She has been missing for three days now and police are beginning to fear the worst (= think that she is dead).
examples.zh: 她已失踪三天了，警方担心她已遭不测。

examples.en: The government feared a backlash from farmers.
examples.zh: 政府担心农民的强烈反对。

examples.en: Experts fear that terrorists could use the internet to launch attacks.
examples.zh: 专家们担心恐怖分子可能利用互联网发动袭击。

examples.en: They rightly feared that presidents, like kings, might abuse their power.
examples.zh: 他们正确地担心总统会像国王一样滥用权力。

examples.en: He genuinely feared his life was at risk.
examples.zh: 他真的担心自己的生命受到威胁。

examples.en: The company feared losing its tax breaks.
examples.zh: 公司担心失去税收减免。

examples.en: Women and children are feared to be among the victims.
examples.zh: 大家担心受害者中有妇女儿童。

examples.en: The death toll is not as bad as initially feared.
examples.zh: 死亡人数并不像最初担心的那么严重。

examples.en: It is feared (that) he may have been kidnapped.
examples.zh: 人们担心他可能被绑架了。

examples.en: It was feared that unemployment could rise.
examples.zh: 人们担心失业率可能会上升。

examples.en: Hundreds of people are feared dead.
examples.zh: 好几百人恐遭不测。

examples.en: Never fear/Fear not (= Don’t worry), I shall return.
examples.zh: 别担心，我会回来的。

senses.def: used to tell somebody that you think that something bad has happened or is true

examples.en: They are unlikely to get here on time, I fear.
examples.zh: 恐怕他们不大可能准时到达这里。

examples.en: ‘He must be dead then?’ ‘I fear so.’
examples.zh: “那么他肯定死了？”“恐怕是这样。”

examples.en: ‘She's not coming back?’ ‘I fear not.’
examples.zh: “她不打算回来了？”“我想是的。”

senses.def: people with little experience try to do the difficult or dangerous things that more experienced people would not consider doing

items.idm: for fear of something/of doing something | for fear (that)…

senses.def: to avoid the danger of something happening

examples.en: We spoke quietly for fear of waking the guards.
examples.zh: 我们悄悄说话，以免惊醒警卫。

examples.en: I had to run away for fear (that) he might one day kill me.
examples.zh: 我只好逃走，生怕他有一天把我杀了。

senses.def: feeling frightened that you might be killed
senses.zh: 害怕会丧生；为生命安全担忧

senses.def: used to say that you definitely do not want to do something
senses.zh: （表示决不愿做某事）绝不，当然不

examples.en: ‘Are you coming climbing?’ ‘No fear!’
examples.zh: “你来爬山吗？”“当然不！”

items.idm: put the fear of God into somebody

senses.def: to make somebody very frightened, especially in order to make them do something
senses.zh: 恐吓；（尤指）威胁某人服从

items.idm: strike fear, etc. into somebody/sb’s heart

senses.def: to make somebody be afraid, etc.

examples.en: The sound of gunfire struck fear into the hearts of the villagers.
examples.zh: 炮声使村民心惊胆战。

senses.def: in a fair way

examples.en: They undertook to make their judgement without fear or favour.
examples.zh: 他们承诺公正无私地做出判断。

items.idm: fools rush in (where angels fear to tread)

senses.def: people with little experience try to do the difficult or dangerous things that more experienced people would not consider doing

intro.en: These are all words for the bad feeling you have when you are afraid.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示害怕时的恐慌情绪。

items.def: the bad feeling that you have when you are in danger or when a particular thing frightens you:
items.zh: 害怕；惧怕

examples.en: (a) fear of flying
examples.zh: 害怕坐飞机

items.def: a feeling of extreme fear:
items.zh: 指惊恐、恐惧、惊骇

examples.en: Her eyes were wild with terror.
examples.zh: 她的眼睛里充满了恐惧。

items.def: a sudden feeling of great fear that cannot be controlled and prevents you from thinking clearly:
items.zh: 指惊恐、恐慌

examples.en: I had a sudden moment of panic.
examples.zh: 我突然一阵惊慌。

items.def: fear or worry that somebody feels when something dangerous or unpleasant might happen:
items.zh: 指惊恐、惊慌、恐慌

examples.en: The doctor said there was no cause for alarm.
examples.zh: 医生说不必惊慌。

items.def: a feeling of fear, usually sudden:
items.zh: 通常指突如其来的惊吓、恐怖

examples.en: She cried out in fright.
examples.zh: 她吓得大声叫喊。

senses.def: to be worried about somebody/something

examples.en: We fear for his safety.
examples.zh: 我们担心他的安全。

examples.en: They feared for their lives.
examples.zh: 他们担心自己性命不保。

examples.en: He feared for his mother, left alone on the farm.
examples.zh: 他为独自一人留在农场的母亲担忧。

senses.def: nervous and afraid

examples.en: Parents are ever fearful for their children.
examples.zh: 父母总是为子女担忧。

examples.en: fearful of an attack
examples.zh: 担心遭到袭击

examples.en: Fearful of continued unrest, the government imposed a state of emergency.
examples.zh: 由于担心持续的骚乱，政府实施了紧急状态。

examples.en: They were understandably fearful about the future.
examples.zh: 他们自然为未来担忧。

examples.en: She was fearful that she would fail.
examples.zh: 她生怕失败。

senses.def: terrible and frightening
extremely bad

examples.en: We made a fearful mess of the room.
examples.zh: 我们把房间弄得一团糟。

senses.def: in a way that shows somebody is nervous or afraid
senses.zh: 恐惧地：以某种方式表明某人感到紧张或恐惧

examples.en: We watched fearfully.
examples.zh: 我们忧心忡忡地观看着。

senses.def: extremely difficult/expensive/loud, etc.
the fact of being nervous or afraid

examples.en: her fearfulness and lack of trust
examples.zh: 她的恐惧和缺乏信任

senses.def: not afraid, in a way that people admire

examples.en: a fearless mountaineer
examples.zh: 无畏的登山运动员

examples.en: She was fearless and full of energy.
examples.zh: 她勇敢无畏，充满活力。

examples.en: He was known as a powerful king and a fearless warrior.
examples.zh: 他是公认的强有力的国王和无畏的武士。

senses.def: in a way that shows somebody is not afraid, and that people admire
senses.zh: 无所畏惧：以某种方式表明某人不惧怕，人们敬佩

examples.en: She has fearlessly exposed corruption.
examples.zh: 她无畏地揭露腐败。

senses.def: the quality of not being afraid, in a way that people admire

examples.en: He showed complete fearlessness in the face of danger.
examples.zh: 面对危险，他表现出了完全的无所畏惧。

senses.def: the activity of spreading stories deliberately to make people frightened or nervous
senses.zh: 散布恐怖消息的人；制造恐慌的人；危言耸听的人

examples.en: The journalist was accused of fearmongering by mentioning nuclear weapons in her article.
examples.zh: 该记者因在文章中提及核武器而被指控散布恐慌。

senses.def: making people feel very frightened

examples.en: a fearsome dinosaur
examples.zh: 可怕的恐龙

examples.en: He has a fearsome reputation as a fighter.
examples.zh: 作为一名战士，他享有可怕的声誉。

examples.en: a fearsome expression/sight
examples.zh: 可怕的表情/景象

senses.def: the quality of being possible and likely to be achieved

examples.en: a feasibility study on the proposed new airport
examples.zh: 对拟建的新机场的可行性研究

examples.en: I doubt the feasibility of the plan.
examples.zh: 我看这个计划未必可行。

senses.def: that is possible and likely to be achieved

examples.en: a feasible plan/suggestion/idea
examples.zh: 可行的计划／建议／想法

examples.en: It's just not feasible to manage the business on a part-time basis.
examples.zh: 兼职管理业务是搞不好的。

senses.def: a large or special meal, especially for a lot of people and to celebrate something

examples.en: The cooks were busy preparing the wedding feast.
examples.zh: 厨师们正忙着准备婚宴。

senses.def: a day or period of time when there is a religious festival

examples.en: the feast of Christmas
examples.zh: 圣诞佳节

examples.en: on the feast of St John
examples.zh: 在圣约翰节

senses.def: a thing or an event that brings great pleasure
senses.zh: 使人欢快的事物（或活动）

examples.en: a feast of colours
examples.zh: 五彩缤纷

examples.en: The evening was a real feast for music lovers.
examples.zh: 这个晚会真是让音乐爱好者大饱耳福。

examples.en: the cold feed to the water cylinder
examples.zh: 水缸的冷进水管

senses.def: a large meal

examples.en: They needed a bath and a good feed.
examples.zh: 他们需要洗个澡，饱餐一顿。

senses.def: television programmes that are sent from a central station to other stations in a network; the system of sending out these programmes
senses.zh: （电视中心台）网络供给节目（系统）

examples.en: network feed
examples.zh: 网络供给节目系统

senses.def: a special feature on a blog, news website, social media
senses.zh: （博客、新闻网站、社交媒体网站等的）信息推送，信息订阅功能

examples.en: an RSS feed
examples.zh: 简易信息聚合订阅

examples.en: the film's official X feed
examples.zh: 电影的官方 X feed

items.idm: bite the hand that feeds you

senses.def: to harm somebody who has helped you or supported you
to eat a lot of food or too much food
to eat a lot of food or too much food
to have an influence on the development of something by reacting to it in some way
senses.zh: 反过来影响（事物的发展）

examples.en: What the audience tells me feeds back into my work.
examples.zh: 观众给我提的意见反过来对我的作品起到了促进作用。

senses.def: to give information or opinions about something, especially so that it can be improved

examples.en: Test results will be fed back to the schools.
examples.zh: 测验的成绩将反馈给各学校。

senses.def: to have an influence on the development of something

examples.en: The report's findings will feed into company policy.
examples.zh: 公司的政策将会考虑到报告的调研结果。

senses.def: to eat something

examples.en: Butterflies feed on the flowers of garden plants.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶以园林中草木的花为食。

examples.en: The seals feed mainly on fish and squid.
examples.zh: 海豹主要以鱼和鱿鱼为食。

senses.def: to become stronger because of something else
senses.zh: 因…而壮大；从…中得到滋养

examples.en: Racism feeds on fear.
examples.zh: 恐惧心理会助长种族主义。

examples.en: He feeds off the work and reputation of others.
examples.zh: 他以他人的工作和声誉为生。

senses.def: to eat something

examples.en: Butterflies feed on the flowers of garden plants.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶以园林中草木的花为食。

examples.en: The seals feed mainly on fish and squid.
examples.zh: 海豹主要以鱼和鱿鱼为食。

senses.def: to become stronger because of something else
senses.zh: 因…而壮大；从…中得到滋养

examples.en: Racism feeds on fear.
examples.zh: 恐惧心理会助长种族主义。

examples.en: He feeds off the work and reputation of others.
examples.zh: 他以他人的工作和声誉为生。

senses.def: a piece of software that you use to see new information that has been added on a blog, news website, social media
senses.zh: 推送阅读器，订阅器（用户无须访问网站便可看到博客、新闻网站、社交媒体网站等的更新信息）

senses.def: to reach somebody/something after going through a process or system

examples.en: It will take time for the higher rates to feed through to investors.
examples.zh: 需要时日投资者才能最终得到较高的回报率。

senses.def: to give a lot of food to a person or an animal to make them fatter or stronger

examples.en: You look as though you need feeding up.
examples.zh: 你看起来好像需要喂饱。

senses.def: advice, criticism or information about how good or useful something or somebody’s work is

examples.en: customer/user feedback
examples.zh: 客户／用户的意见

examples.en: to provide/give feedback
examples.zh: 提出意见

examples.en: to receive/get feedback
examples.zh: 收到意见

examples.en: I'd appreciate some feedback on my work.
examples.zh: 如果有人对我的工作提出意见我将感激不尽。

examples.en: The teacher will give you feedback on the test.
examples.zh: 老师会对你的测验提供反馈信息。

examples.en: I've heard loads of good feedback about this site.
examples.zh: 我听到了很多关于这个网站的良好反馈。

examples.en: We need both positive and negative feedback from our customers.
examples.zh: 我们需要顾客的意见，不论是赞赏的还是批评的。

senses.def: the unpleasant noise produced by electrical equipment such as an amplifier
a bag containing food for a horse, that you hang from its head
an animal or plant that eats a particular thing or eats in a particular way
senses.zh: （动植物）进某种食物者，以…方式进食者

examples.en: plankton feeders
examples.zh: 以浮游生物为食者

examples.en: opportunistic feeders, like gulls and gannets
examples.zh: 机会主义喂食者，如海鸥和塘鹅

senses.def: a part of a machine that supplies something to another part of the machine

examples.en: An optional 1 500 sheet feeder can be attached to the photocopier.
examples.zh: 复印机上可安装可选的 1 500 页进纸器。

senses.def: a container filled with food for birds or animals
leading to a bigger road, etc.

examples.en: a feeder road to the motorway/freeway
examples.zh: 汇入高速公路的支路

senses.def: supplying goods, services, etc. to a large organization
senses.zh: （向大机构）供应商品的，提供服务的

senses.def: kept to be killed and used for meat
a school from which most of the children go to a particular secondary school
senses.zh: 直属学校（学生毕业后大多进入本地区特定中学或高校）

examples.en: the Sixth Form College and its four feeder schools
examples.zh: 六年级学院及其四所附属学校

senses.def: a plastic bottle with a rubber top that a baby or young animal can drink milk through
an occasion when a group of sharks

examples.en: The smell of blood sent the sharks into a feeding frenzy.
examples.zh: 一闻到血腥味，鲨鱼开始疯狂抢食。

senses.def: a situation in which a lot of people compete with each other in an excited way because they want to get something
senses.zh: （对某物的）集体狂热追求，疯狂竞争

examples.en: News of his resignation created a media feeding frenzy.
examples.zh: 他辞职的消息引起了媒体的疯狂报道。

senses.def: an area or building where farm animals are fed

examples.en: Some industrial cattle feedlots hold up to 200 000 cattle at a time.
examples.zh: 一些产业化养牛场可同时饲养 20 万头牛。

senses.def: a raw material

examples.en: Methane is used as chemical feedstock for many materials, including fertilizers.
examples.zh: 甲烷被用作许多材料的化学原料，包括化肥。

senses.def: food for farm animals, especially food that has been processed

examples.en: animal feedstuffs
examples.zh: 动物饲料

senses.def: to experience a particular feeling or emotion

examples.en: The bus ride made me feel sick.
examples.zh: 我坐公共汽车时晕车。

examples.en: Are you feeling comfortable?
examples.zh: 你感觉舒服吗？

examples.en: She sounded more confident than she felt.
examples.zh: 她的语气听起来比她本人的感觉要有信心。

examples.en: I was feeling guilty.
examples.zh: 我感到歉疚。

examples.en: You'll feel better after a good night's sleep.
examples.zh: 你晚上睡个好觉就会觉得舒服些。

examples.en: I feel sorry for him.
examples.zh: 我为他感到可惜。

examples.en: I feel bad about leaving you like this.
examples.zh: 我为就这样离开你感到难过。

examples.en: She felt betrayed.
examples.zh: 她感到被出卖了。

examples.en: How are you feeling today?
examples.zh: 你今天觉得怎么样？

examples.en: I know exactly how you feel (= I feel sympathy for you).
examples.zh: 我完全理解你的心情。

examples.en: We all felt the same way.
examples.zh: 我们都有同样的感觉。

examples.en: Luckily I was feeling in a good mood.
examples.zh: 幸好我当时情绪好。

examples.en: I felt the need to explain.
examples.zh: 我觉得有必要解释一下。

examples.en: I felt a sense of relief.
examples.zh: 我如释重负。

examples.en: I felt like a complete idiot.
examples.zh: 我感到完全像个傻瓜。

examples.en: She made me feel like a child by doing everything for me.
examples.zh: 她为我做一切，让我感觉自己像个孩子。

examples.en: I feel as if nobody cares.
examples.zh: 我觉得好像没人在乎。

examples.en: She felt as though she was going to cry.
examples.zh: 她感觉自己快要哭了。

examples.en: to feel an idiot/a fool
examples.zh: 觉得自己是个傻瓜

senses.group: well/sick/happy/sad, etc. 健康、不适、愉快、悲伤等

senses.def: to notice or be aware of something because it is touching you or having a physical effect on you
senses.zh: （通过触觉）注意到，意识到，感觉到

examples.en: I could feel the warm sun on my back.
examples.zh: 我背上感受到了阳光的温暖。

examples.en: She felt a sharp pain in her hand.
examples.zh: 她感到手上一阵剧痛。

examples.en: She could not feel her legs.
examples.zh: 她的双腿失去了知觉。

examples.en: I can’t feel his pulse.
examples.zh: 我摸不到他的脉搏。

examples.en: He felt a hand on his shoulder.
examples.zh: 他感到有只手在他肩上。

examples.en: You may feel a slight pressure in your chest.
examples.zh: 您可能会感到胸部有轻微的压力。

examples.en: He felt a hand touching his shoulder.
examples.zh: 他感到有只手在触摸他的肩膀。

examples.en: She could feel herself blushing.
examples.zh: 她可以感到脸都红了。

examples.en: He felt the sweat running down his face.
examples.zh: 他感觉到汗水从脸上流下来。

examples.en: I felt something crawl up my arm.
examples.zh: 我觉得有个东西顺着手臂往上爬。

examples.en: We felt the ground give way under our feet.
examples.zh: 我们感觉到脚下的土地下陷了。

senses.def: to become aware of something even though you cannot see it, hear it, etc.

examples.en: Can you feel the tension in this room?
examples.zh: 你能感觉到这房间里的紧张气氛吗？

examples.en: They all feel pressure from managers to make a sale.
examples.zh: 他们都感受到来自经理的销售压力。

examples.en: I definitely felt the importance of the occasion.
examples.zh: 我确实感受到了这个场合的重要性。

senses.def: to give you a particular feeling or impression

examples.en: This situation doesn't feel right.
examples.zh: 情况感觉不对头。

examples.en: You need to go somewhere that feels safe.
examples.zh: 你需要去一个令你觉得安全的地方。

examples.en: My mouth felt completely dry.
examples.zh: 我感到口干舌燥。

examples.en: It felt strange to be back in my old school.
examples.zh: 我回到母校有一种生疏的感觉。

examples.en: The place still feels like a small fishing village.
examples.zh: 这个地方感觉仍然像一个小渔村。

examples.en: The interview only took ten minutes, but it felt like hours.
examples.zh: 面试只用了十分钟，但觉得像几个小时似的。

examples.en: I've lived here for years, but it still doesn't feel like home.
examples.zh: 我在这里住了很多年了，但仍然没有家的感觉。

examples.en: It feels like rain (= seems likely to rain).
examples.zh: 好像快要下雨了。

examples.en: It's three degrees right now, but with the wind chill factor it feels like minus 12.
examples.zh: 现在气温为 3 度，但考虑到风寒因素，感觉温度为负 12 度。

examples.en: How does it feel to be alone all day?
examples.zh: 整天独自一个人的感受如何？

examples.en: Her head felt as if it would burst.
examples.zh: 她觉得头要爆裂了。

examples.en: It felt as though he had run a marathon.
examples.zh: 他感到好像跑了一个马拉松似的。

senses.def: to have a particular physical quality that you become aware of by touching

examples.en: The water feels warm.
examples.zh: 这水摸着很暖。

examples.en: Its skin feels really smooth.
examples.zh: 它的皮摸起来真光滑。

examples.en: This wallet feels like leather.
examples.zh: 这个钱包摸上去像是皮的。

examples.en: Your hands feel like ice.
examples.zh: 你的手感觉像冰一样。

senses.def: to deliberately move your fingers over something in order to find out what it is like

examples.en: Can you feel the bump on my head?
examples.zh: 你能摸到我头上那个肿块吗？

examples.en: Try to tell what this is just by feeling it.
examples.zh: 凭手摸摸说出这是什么东西。

examples.en: People like to touch and feel the fabric before they buy.
examples.zh: 人们喜欢在购买前触摸和感受面料。

examples.en: Feel how rough this is.
examples.zh: 摸摸这有多粗糙。

senses.def: to think or believe that something is the case; to have a particular opinion or attitude

examples.en: We all felt (that) we were unlucky to lose.
examples.zh: 我们都认为我们输了是运气不好。

examples.en: We've always felt this was our home.
examples.zh: 我们一直觉得这里是我们的家。

examples.en: I felt (that) I had to apologize.
examples.zh: 我以为我得道歉。

examples.en: I feel I could continue playing until I am 35.
examples.zh: 我觉得我可以继续打球到35岁。

examples.en: This is something I feel strongly about.
examples.zh: 我对这件事有很坚定的看法。

examples.en: How do you feel about inviting the children too?
examples.zh: 你觉得把孩子也请来怎么样？

examples.en: I didn't know you felt like that about it.
examples.zh: 我不知道你对此有这样的感觉。

examples.en: She felt it her duty to tell the police.
examples.zh: 她认为报警是她的义务。

examples.en: I feel it a great honour to be chosen.
examples.zh: 我感到非常荣幸被选中。

examples.en: She felt it to be the best course of action to remain.
examples.zh: 她觉得留下来是最好的做法。

examples.en: Why did you feel it necessary to do that?
examples.zh: 为什么你觉得有必要那么做？

examples.en: I felt it advisable to do nothing.
examples.zh: 我觉得最好不要作出行动。

examples.en: We felt it to be unfortunate.
examples.zh: 我们感到很不幸。

examples.en: This decision is, I feel, a huge mistake.
examples.zh: 我认为这个决定是个天大的错误。

senses.def: to experience the effects or results of something, often strongly
senses.zh: 受（强烈）影响；（深深）体验到

examples.en: He feels the cold a lot.
examples.zh: 他很怕冷。

examples.en: Cathy was really feeling the heat.
examples.zh: 凯茜真的感到很热。

examples.en: We're all starting to feel the pressure at work.
examples.zh: 我们都开始感受到工作的压力。

examples.en: I was OK after my run, but I'll feel it tomorrow.
examples.zh: 刚跑完我感觉还好，但明天我就会肌肉酸痛了。

examples.en: She felt her mother's death very deeply.
examples.zh: 她深感丧母之痛。

examples.en: The effects of the recession are being felt everywhere.
examples.zh: 经济衰退的影响无所不在。

examples.en: We all felt the force of her arguments.
examples.zh: 我们都体会到了她的论据的分量。

examples.en: Her loss has been keenly felt.
examples.zh: 她的离世使我们切切实实感到悲痛。

senses.group: be strongly affected 强烈影响

senses.def: to search for something with your hands, feet, etc.

examples.en: She felt in her bag and pulled out a pen.
examples.zh: 她在包里摸了摸，拿出一支笔。

examples.en: If you feel under the desk you'll find a hook.
examples.zh: 如果你摸索桌子下面，你会发现一个钩子。

examples.en: She felt for the step with her foot.
examples.zh: 她用脚感觉脚步声。

examples.en: I had to feel about in the dark for the light switch.
examples.zh: 我得在黑暗中摸索寻找电灯开关。

examples.en: He felt in his pockets for some money.
examples.zh: 他在口袋里摸着想找一些钱。

senses.group: search with hands 用手摸索

senses.def: to be pleased because somebody has made you feel important or special
senses.zh: 被奉承得高兴；感到荣幸

examples.en: He was flattered by her attention.
examples.zh: 她的关注使他感到格外高兴。

examples.en: I felt flattered at being asked to give a lecture.
examples.zh: 承蒙邀请来演讲，我深感荣幸。

examples.en: She was flattered to hear that he had been asking about her.
examples.zh: 听说他一直在打听她，她颇感得意。

examples.en: I suppose we should be flattered that he agreed to come at all.
examples.zh: 我想我们应该为他同意来而感到受宠若惊。

senses.group: search with hands 用手摸索

senses.def: to be or feel unfairly treated
senses.zh: 受到不公平待遇；感到委屈

examples.en: She has every right to feel hard done by—her parents have given her nothing.
examples.zh: 她完全有理由觉得委屈，她父母什么都没给她。

senses.group: search with hands 用手摸索

senses.def: to feel proud and happy

examples.en: I was honoured to have been mentioned in his speech.
examples.zh: 他在讲话中提到了我，真是荣幸。

examples.en: ‘Would you be my best man?’ ‘I’d be honoured.’
examples.zh: “你愿意做我的伴郎吗？”“我很荣幸。”

senses.group: search with hands 用手摸索

senses.def: to feel weak because you are nervous
senses.group: search with hands 用手摸索

senses.def: to realize that you are getting old, especially compared with people you are with who are younger than you
senses.zh: （尤指与较年轻者比）感到自己上年纪了，意识到自己老了
senses.group: search with hands 用手摸索

senses.def: used to tell somebody that they are allowed to do something

examples.en: Feel free to ask questions if you don't understand.
examples.zh: 你要是不懂，可以随便提问。

examples.en: ‘Can I use your phone?’ ‘Feel free.’
examples.zh: “我能用你的电话吗？”“随便用吧。”

senses.group: search with hands 用手摸索

senses.def: to feel happy, confident, etc.

examples.en: It makes me feel good to know my work is appreciated.
examples.zh: 我知道我的工作得到赏识后感到很高兴。

senses.group: search with hands 用手摸索

senses.def: to be certain about something even though you do not have any direct proof and cannot explain why you are certain
senses.zh: 心中感到；本能预感到；直觉确信

examples.en: I know I'm going to fail this exam—I can feel it in my bones.
examples.zh: 我知道这次考试我过不了关，我有这种直觉。

senses.group: search with hands 用手摸索

senses.def: to want to have or do something

examples.en: I feel like a drink.
examples.zh: 我想喝一杯。

examples.en: We all felt like celebrating.
examples.zh: 我们都想庆祝一番。

examples.en: He felt like bursting into tears.
examples.zh: 他想要大哭一场。

examples.en: We'll go for a walk if you feel like it.
examples.zh: 要是你愿意，我们去散散步。

senses.group: search with hands 用手摸索

senses.def: to not have enough money

examples.en: Lots of people who have lost their jobs are starting to feel the pinch.
examples.zh: 大量失业者开始感到日子不好过了。

senses.group: search with hands 用手摸索

senses.def: to move along carefully, for example when it is dark, by touching walls, objects, etc.
senses.group: search with hands 用手摸索

senses.def: to be careful about how you do things, usually because you are in a situation that you are not familiar with

examples.en: She was new in the job, still feeling her way.
examples.zh: 她对这项工作不熟悉，还在摸索着干。

senses.group: search with hands 用手摸索

senses.def: to feel that you must do something because of your sense of moral duty

examples.en: She felt honour-bound to attend as she had promised to.
examples.zh: 她觉得既然答应了就应该出席。

examples.en: He felt honour bound to help her.
examples.zh: 他觉得在道义上应该帮助她。

senses.group: search with hands 用手摸索

senses.def: to look or feel very ill or tired
senses.zh: 看起来病得厉害（或疲惫不堪）；感到很不舒服（或累得要命）
senses.group: search with hands 用手摸索

senses.def: to look/feel extremely good

examples.en: Wow, you look like a million dollars.
examples.zh: 哇，你看起来像百万美元。

senses.group: search with hands 用手摸索

senses.def: to look or feel stupid, weak, ashamed, etc.
senses.zh: 显得（或感觉）矮人一截；愧不如人

examples.en: There’s no need to make me look small in front of all these people.
examples.zh: 没必要在大家面前贬低我。

examples.en: I felt really small when I realized how much time he’d spent on it.
examples.zh: 我意识到他花了那么多时间在这上面，觉得非常惭愧。

senses.group: search with hands 用手摸索

senses.def: to do something to make people very aware of the fact that you are there; to have a strong influence on a group of people or a situation
senses.zh: 突显自己；对（人群或局势）发挥作用

examples.en: She’s only been here a couple of weeks but she is already making her presence felt.
examples.zh: 她来到这里才几周，但她已经让人感受到了她的存在。

examples.en: He certainly made his presence felt in the boardroom.
examples.zh: 他确实在董事会中体现了他的存在。

senses.group: search with hands 用手摸索

senses.def: not to feel as well or lively as usual

examples.en: I’m not feeling up to the mark at the moment.
examples.zh: 我现在感觉不太好。

senses.group: search with hands 用手摸索

senses.def: to not feel healthy and well
senses.zh: 觉得身体不好；感到身体不舒服

examples.en: I’m not quite feeling myself today.
examples.zh: 我今天不太舒服。

senses.group: search with hands 用手摸索

senses.def: the feeling you get when you touch something or are touched

examples.en: You can tell it's silk by the feel.
examples.zh: 你一摸就知道这是丝绸。

examples.en: The model has the look and feel of wood.
examples.zh: 该模型看起来和摸起来都像木头。

examples.en: She loved the feel of the sun on her skin.
examples.zh: 她喜欢太阳照在皮肤上的感觉。

senses.def: an act of feeling or touching

examples.en: I had a feel of the material.
examples.zh: 我摸了一下这种布料。

senses.def: the impression that is created by a place, situation, etc.; atmosphere
senses.zh: （场所、情况等给人的）印象，感受；气氛

senses.def: Bernard Law Montgomery (1887-1976) perhaps the best-known British military leader in the Second World War

examples.en: She fought hard to get this film made.
examples.zh: 经她努力争取，这部电影才得以面世。

examples.en: She gradually fought her way to the top of the company.
examples.zh: 她努力奋斗，逐渐登上公司的高位。

senses.group: try to get/do something 争取

senses.def: to take part in a contest against somebody

examples.en: to fight an election/a campaign
examples.zh: 参加竞选／争取权益的运动

examples.en: She's fighting for a place in the national team.
examples.zh: 她正努力争取加入国家队。

examples.en: There are twelve parties fighting the election.
examples.zh: 有十二个党派参加竞选。

examples.en: The second half was fiercely fought, but neither side managed to score.
examples.zh: 下半场比赛非常激烈，但双方都没有得分。

senses.def: to take part in a boxing

examples.en: Doctors fear he may never fight again.
examples.zh: 医生认为他可能再也不能重返拳坛了。

senses.def: to try to get what you want in court

examples.en: He fought his wife for custody of the children.
examples.zh: 他和妻子打官司争取孩子的监护权。

examples.en: I'm determined to fight the case.
examples.zh: 我决意要打这场官司。

senses.def: to defend your/somebody’s position against other people
to use similar methods in a fight or an argument to those your opponent is using
to make a great effort to stay alive, especially when you are badly injured or seriously ill
senses.zh: （尤指严重伤病时）与死亡作斗争

examples.en: A young cyclist is fighting for his life after the accident.
examples.zh: 一位年轻的自行车手出事故后奋力求生。

senses.def: to be always arguing with each other

examples.en: In our childhood Irina and I fought like cat and dog.
examples.zh: 童年时我和伊丽娜斗得很兇。

senses.def: to be able to win an argument or get what you want without anyone’s help
senses.zh: 独力战胜；独自奋斗成功

examples.en: I wouldn't get involved—he's old enough to fight his own battles.
examples.zh: 我不想参与。他已经长大，能独自应付了。

examples.en: My parents believed in leaving me to fight my own battles.
examples.zh: 我父母认为应该让我自己去打拚。

senses.def: to be unwilling to accept something or do something, and to try to avoid it
senses.zh: 不愿接受（或做）某事；回避；躲避

examples.en: Successive governments have fought shy of such measures.
examples.zh: 一届接一届政府均不愿采取这些措施。

senses.def: to fight until one of the two people or groups is dead, or until one person or group defeats the other
senses.zh: 打到有一方倒下；一决雌雄

examples.en: The soldiers were prepared to fight to the death if they had to.
examples.zh: 士兵们做好了在不得已的情况下战斗到死的准备。

senses.def: to fight in a very determined way for what you want
senses.zh: 坚决斗争；全力以赴地斗争

examples.en: The residents are fighting tooth and nail to stop the new development.
examples.zh: 居民为制止新的房地产开发计划正在全力以赴进行斗争。

examples.en: She fought tooth and nail to keep custody of the children.
examples.zh: 她竭尽全力争取孩子的监护权。

senses.def: used to say that although you have failed or had a bad experience, you will continue
senses.zh: （虽已失败或经历很糟但仍要）改日再战，卷土重来

senses.def: (to try to do) something that you will probably never succeed in doing
senses.zh: （进行）一场打不赢的战争，徒劳之战

examples.en: I’m fighting a losing battle against the mess in this house!
examples.zh: 我正在与这个房子里的混乱进行一场失败的战斗！

examples.en: She wanted him to take some responsibility for his actions, but she knew it was a losing battle.
examples.zh: 她希望他为自己的行为承担一些责任，但她知道这是一场失败的战斗。

senses.def: a struggle against somebody/something using physical force

examples.en: a street/gang fight
examples.zh: 街头／帮派打斗

examples.en: He got into a fight with a man in the bar.
examples.zh: 他在酒吧里和一个男人斗殴。

examples.en: I had a fight with the ticket machine, which was being temperamental.
examples.zh: 我和售票机打了一架，售票机脾气暴躁。

examples.en: A fight broke out between rival groups of fans.
examples.zh: 双方支持者打了起来。

senses.def: an occasion when people fight as a sport, especially in boxing

examples.en: They got tickets to watch the world title fight.
examples.zh: 他们弄到了观看世界拳王争霸赛的票。

examples.en: He is unbeaten in 34 fights.
examples.zh: 他连续34场搏击比赛保持不败。

senses.def: an argument about something

examples.en: Paul and I had this terrible fight last night.
examples.zh: 保罗和我昨晚发生了一场可怕的争吵。

examples.en: Did you have a fight with him?
examples.zh: 你和他争辩了？

examples.en: He is still engaged in a bitter fight with his old company.
examples.zh: 他仍在同他原来的公司进行激烈的斗争。

examples.en: We had a fight over money.
examples.zh: 我们为钱吵了一架。

senses.def: the work of trying to destroy, prevent or achieve something

examples.en: the fight against crime/terrorism
examples.zh: 打击犯罪／恐怖主义

examples.en: He lost his fight against cancer earlier this year.
examples.zh: 今年早些时候，他在与癌症的斗争中失败了。

examples.en: a fight for justice/survival
examples.zh: 为正义／生存而奋斗

examples.en: She just gave up her fight for life.
examples.zh: 她就这样放弃了挣扎求生。

examples.en: Workers won their fight to stop compulsory redundancies.
examples.zh: 工人在阻止强制性裁员的斗争中取得了胜利。

examples.en: The workers are determined to put up a fight (= to fight hard) to save their jobs.
examples.zh: 工人们决心进行斗争（=奋力斗争）以保住自己的工作。

examples.en: Union leaders know that they have a real fight on their hands (= will have to fight very hard).
examples.zh: 工会领导人知道他们要面对一场真正的战斗。

senses.group: trying to get/do something 争取

senses.def: a competition or an act of competing, especially in a sport

examples.en: The team put up a good fight (= they played well) but were finally beaten.
examples.zh: 这个队打得不错，但最后还是输了。

examples.en: She now has a fight on her hands (= will have to play very well) to make it through to the next round.
examples.zh: 现在她得表现突出才能进入下一轮比赛。

examples.en: This will be a straight fight between the two parties.
examples.zh: 两个政党将会直接交锋。

senses.def: a battle, especially for a particular place or position
senses.zh: 战斗（尤指为夺取某一地方或位置）

examples.en: In the fight for Lemburg, the Austrians were defeated.
examples.zh: 在争夺伦贝格的战斗中，奥地利人战败了。

senses.def: the desire or ability to keep fighting for something

examples.en: In spite of many defeats, they still had plenty of fight left in them.
examples.zh: 他们尽管多次失败，但仍然斗志昂扬。

examples.en: Losing their leader took all the fight out of them.
examples.zh: 他们失去了首领以后便丧失了斗志。

senses.def: to want to fight with somebody very much
a sports competition, election, etc. between sides that are so equal in ability that they continue fighting very hard until the end
senses.zh: （体育比赛、选举等的）直到最后才能决出胜负的斗争

examples.en: Six teams are bitter rivals in what will be a fight to the finish.
examples.zh: 六支球队势均力敌，将展开一场殊死搏斗。

examples.en: If the polls are wrong and it's a fight to the finish, the result may not be known until all the votes have been counted.
examples.zh: 如果民调结果有误，又是一场直到最后一刻才见分晓的角逐，那么只有等到统计完所有选票才会知道结果。

senses.def: to be involved in a situation so that you will gain or lose according to the result

examples.en: I really don't have a dog in this fight, so I can just enjoy the game.
examples.zh: 这场战斗我真的没有狗，所以我只能享受比赛。

examples.en: The employees have a dog in the hunt, so their views should be listened to.
examples.zh: 员工们有一只正在狩猎的狗，所以应该听取他们的意见。

senses.def: to deliberately start a fight or an argument with somebody

examples.en: He had drunk too much and was ready to pick a fight with anyone who crossed his path.
examples.zh: 他喝得太多了，准备与任何遇到他的人打架。

examples.en: She tried to pick a quarrel with me.
examples.zh: 她试图与我争吵。

intro.en: These are all words for an effort made to achieve or prevent something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指为达到某目的或为阻止某事而作出的努力。

items.def: a series of planned activities that are intended to achieve a particular social, commercial or political aim:
items.zh: 指为社会、商业或政治目的而进行的一系列有计划的活动或运动

examples.en: the campaign for parliamentary reform
examples.zh: 要求议会进行改革的运动

items.def: a competition or argument between people or groups of people trying to win power or control:
items.zh: 指个人或集体为赢得权力或控制权而进行的较量、争论或斗争

examples.en: She finally won the legal battle for compensation.
examples.zh: 她终于赢得了这场要求赔偿的法律斗争。

items.def: a competition or argument between people or groups of people trying to win power or control:
items.zh: 指个人或集体为赢得权力或控制权而进行的较量、争论或斗争

examples.en: the struggle for independence
examples.zh: 争取独立的斗争

items.def: an organized effort by a group of people to achieve something:
items.zh: 指团体为达到目的而作出的有组织的努力

examples.en: the drive for greater efficiency
examples.zh: 为提高效率而作出的努力

items.def: [sing.] an effort over a long period of time to get rid of or stop something bad:

examples.en: the war against crime
examples.zh: 打击犯罪活动的斗争

items.def: [sing.] the work of trying to stop or prevent something bad or achieve something good; an act of competing, especially in a sport:

examples.en: Workers won their fight to stop compulsory redundancies.

intro.zh: 以上各词均指搏斗、打斗、打架。

items.def: a situation in which two or more people try to defeat each other using physical force:
items.zh: 指搏斗、打斗、打架

examples.en: He got into a fight with a man in the bar.
examples.zh: 他在酒吧里和一个男人斗殴。

items.def: (in the media) a short fight between two groups of people:
items.zh: （新闻用语）指两群人之间短暂的打斗、打架、冲突

examples.en: Clashes broke out between police and demonstrators.
examples.zh: 警方与示威者发生了冲突。

items.def: a noisy and violent fight involving a group of people, usually in a public place:
items.zh: 通常指一群人在公共场合喧闹、斗殴、闹事

examples.en: a drunken brawl in a bar
examples.zh: 在酒吧里酒后闹事

items.def: a fight between two people or groups of people, especially when one of them is trying to escape, or to get something from the other:
items.zh: 指搏斗、扭打，尤指抢夺、挣扎脱身

examples.en: There were no signs of a struggle at the murder scene.
examples.zh: 谋杀现场没有打斗痕迹。

items.def: a short and not very violent fight or struggle:
items.zh: 指短暂而不太激烈的扭打、冲突

examples.en: He was involved in a scuffle with a photographer.
examples.zh: 他和一名摄影记者发生了肢体冲撞。

examples.zh: 别让他们欺侮你。要还击！

examples.en: It is time to fight back against street crime.
examples.zh: 现在是打击街头犯罪行为的时候了。

examples.en: He fought down his disgust.
examples.zh: 他强忍住心里的厌恶。

examples.zh: 我强忍住眼泪。

examples.en: He fought down his disgust.
examples.zh: 他强忍住心里的厌恶。

senses.zh: 以斗争方式解决；辩论出结果

examples.en: The conflict is still being fought out.
examples.zh: 仍在通过战斗解决这次冲突。

examples.en: They hadn't reached any agreement so we left them to fight it out.
examples.zh: 他们未能取得一致意见，所以我们让他们争出个结果。

examples.en: Four teams will fight it out in the play-offs.
examples.zh: 四支球队将在附加赛中一决高下。

senses.def: to resist somebody/something by fighting against them/it

examples.en: The jeweller was stabbed as he tried to fight the robbers off.
examples.zh: 珠宝商在试图抵抗强盗时被刺伤了。

examples.en: Vitamin A helps your body fight off infection.
examples.zh: 维生素 A 有助人体对抗感染。

synonyms.words: dusty ▪ filthy ▪ muddy ▪ soiled ▪ grubby ▪ stained

intro.en: These words all describe somebody/​something that is not clean.
intro.zh: 以上各词均形容人或事物不干净、肮脏。

items.def: not clean; covered with dust, soil, mud, oil, etc:
items.zh: 指肮脏的、龌龊的、污秽的

examples.en: If your hands are dirty, go and wash them.
examples.zh: 要是你的手脏了，就去洗一洗。

items.def: full of dust; covered with dust:
items.zh: 指布满灰尘的、灰尘覆盖的

examples.en: There were shelves full of dusty books.
examples.zh: 有些书架上全是布满灰尘的书。

items.def: very dirty and unpleasant:
items.zh: 指肮脏的、污秽的

examples.en: It’s absolutely filthy in here.
examples.zh: 这里面脏得不得了。

items.def: full of or covered in mud:
items.zh: 指沾满泥的、泥泞的

examples.en: Don’t you come in here with those muddy boots on!
examples.zh: 你不要穿着那双沾满泥浆的靴子进来！

items.def: (rather formal) dirty, especially with waste from the body:
items.zh: 指肮脏的、龌龊的，尤指有人体排泄物的

examples.en: soiled nappies/​diapers
examples.zh: 脏尿布

items.def: (rather informal) rather dirty, usually because it has not been washed:
items.zh: 通常指因未经洗涤而肮脏的、邋遢的、污秽的

examples.en: He hoped she wouldn’t notice his grubby shirt cuffs.
examples.zh: 他希望她不会注意到他肮脏的衬衫袖口。

items.def: (often in compounds) covered with stains; marked with a stain (= a dirty mark that is difficult to remove):
items.zh: 满是污痕的；沾有污渍的

examples.en: a pair of paint-stained jeans
examples.zh: 一条沾满油漆的牛仔裤

senses.def: a liquid that has passed through a filter
the process of filtering

examples.en: a filtration system
examples.zh: 过滤系统

senses.def: a thin flat part that sticks out from the body of a fish, used for swimming and keeping balance
a thin flat part that sticks out from the body of a vehicle, an aircraft, etc., used for improving its balance and movement
senses.zh: 鳍状物，翼（车辆、航空器等用以保持平衡等的突出窄扁部分）

examples.en: tail fins
examples.zh: 垂直尾翼

senses.def: typical of the end of the 19th century, especially of its art, literature and attitudes
senses.zh: （尤指艺术、文学、看法）19 世纪末的

senses.def: to behave dishonestly or to obtain something dishonestly

examples.en: He finagled some tickets for tonight's big game.
examples.zh: 他骗到了几张今晚大赛的门票。

senses.def: being or happening at the end of a series of events, actions, statements, etc.

examples.en: his final act as party leader
examples.zh: 他作为党的领袖所采取的最后行动

examples.en: Jamie is in his final year at Stirling University.
examples.zh: 杰米在斯特林大学读最后一年。

examples.en: the final week/day/minutes of something
examples.zh: 某事的最后一周／一天／几分钟

examples.en: The referee blew the final whistle.
examples.zh: 裁判吹响了终场的哨声。

examples.en: The project is in its final stages.
examples.zh: 这个项目到了最后阶段。

examples.en: The final round of voting takes place on Sunday.
examples.zh: 最后一轮投票将于周日举行。

examples.en: They find each other in the final chapter of the book.
examples.zh: 他们在书的最后一章找到了彼此。

examples.en: I'd like to return to the final point you made.
examples.zh: 我想再谈谈你所说的最后一点。

senses.def: being the result of a particular process

examples.en: I think you will be satisfied with the final product.
examples.zh: 我想您会对最终产品感到满意。

examples.en: The final election results have not been announced.
examples.zh: 最终选举结果尚未公布。

examples.en: No one could have predicted the final outcome.
examples.zh: 谁也没有预想到最终结果会是这样。

examples.en: The panel will complete its work with a final report.
examples.zh: 该小组将完成其工作并提交最终报告。

senses.def: that cannot be argued with or changed
senses.zh: 决定性的；不可改变的；最终的

examples.en: The judge's decision is final.
examples.zh: 法官的判决是最终判决。

examples.en: Who has the final say around here?
examples.zh: 这里谁有最终决定权？

examples.en: I'll give you $500 for it, and that's my final offer!
examples.zh: 我出价 500 美元，不可能再高了！

examples.en: I'm not coming, and that's final! (= I will not change my mind)
examples.zh: 我不来，就这么定了！

senses.def: used to say what is most important after everything has been discussed, or considered

examples.en: In the final analysis, it's a matter of personal choice.
examples.zh: 归根结底，这是个人的选择。

senses.def: the last in a series of bad events, etc. that makes it impossible for you to accept a situation any longer
senses.zh: 压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草；终于使人不堪忍受的最后一件事（或因素等）

senses.def: the last comment or decision about something
senses.zh: （对某事的）最后意见，最后决定

examples.en: He always has to have the last word in any argument.
examples.zh: 在任何争论中总是得他最后说了算。

examples.en: I’m willing to wait one more week, and that’s my final word on the subject.
examples.zh: 我愿意再等一周，这是我对这个问题的最后一句话。

examples.en: The Chairman always has the last word on financial decisions.
examples.zh: 在作财务决策时，总是董事长最后说了算。

senses.def: the last of a series of games or competitions, in which the winner is decided

examples.en: She reached the final of the 100m hurdles.
examples.zh: 她进入了 100 米跨栏的决赛。

examples.en: The players met in last year's final.
examples.zh: 这些选手在去年的决赛上相遇过。

examples.en: The winner of each contest goes through to the grand final.
examples.zh: 每场比赛的胜者进入最后的决赛。

examples.en: The victory secured them a place in the final.
examples.zh: 这场胜利确保了他们进入决赛。

examples.en: a nail-biting final against last year's victor
examples.zh: 和去年冠军打的一场紧张激烈的决赛

senses.def: a series of games or performances that make up the last stage of a competition

examples.en: the 2022 World Cup Finals
examples.zh: 2022 年世界杯决赛阶段

examples.en: the regional/national finals
examples.zh: 地区／全国总决赛

examples.en: She has qualified for the Olympic finals.
examples.zh: 她已获得奥运会决赛资格。

examples.en: They got into the finals of a singing competition.
examples.zh: 他们进入了歌唱比赛的决赛。

senses.def: the last exams taken by university students at the end of their final year

examples.en: to sit/take your finals
examples.zh: 参加大学毕业考试

senses.def: an exam taken by school, university or college students at the end of a semester
senses.zh: 期终考试；期终结业考试

senses.def: used to say what is most important after everything has been discussed, or considered

examples.en: In the final analysis, it's a matter of personal choice.
examples.zh: 归根结底，这是个人的选择。

senses.zh: （对某事的）最后意见，最后决定

senses.def: a clause that expresses purpose or intention, for example one that follows ‘
senses.zh: 目的从句，目的子句（如 in order that、so that 等引导的从句）

senses.def: the four basketball teams that remain to compete in the last part of the annual college tournament
senses.zh: 最终四强：剩下的四支篮球队将参加年度大学比赛的最后一部分；这四支球队参加本次比赛的最后一场比赛的赛事

examples.en: You could win a trip to the World Series, the Super Bowl, or the NCAA Final Four.
examples.zh: 您可能会赢得参加世界大赛、超级碗或 NCAA 四强赛的机会。

senses.def: the last part of a show or a piece of music
senses.zh: （演出的）终场，结局；（音乐的）终曲，末乐章

examples.en: the rousing finale of Beethoven’s Ninth Symphony
examples.zh: 贝多芬《第九交响曲》激动人心的末乐章

examples.en: The festival ended with a grand finale in Hyde Park.
examples.zh: 节日的压轴活动是在海德公园举行的盛大演出。

senses.def: an ending to something of the type mentioned

examples.en: It was a fitting finale to the day's events.
examples.zh: 当天的活动至此顺利结束。

senses.def: a person who takes part in the final of a game or competition, either on their own or as a member of a team

examples.en: an Olympic finalist
examples.zh: 奥运会决赛运动员

examples.en: The team play last year’s beaten finalists.
examples.zh: 该队与去年落败的决赛选手进行比赛。

senses.def: the fact of being final and impossible to change; something that is final and impossible to change

examples.en: the finality of death
examples.zh: 死亡的不可改变

examples.en: There was a note of finality in his voice.
examples.zh: 他的话有斩钉截铁的意味。

examples.en: ‘No’, she said with finality.
examples.zh: “不,"她斩钉截铁地说。

examples.en: Death is the ultimate finality.
examples.zh: 死亡是最后的结局。

senses.def: the act of completing the last part of a plan, trip, project, etc.
senses.zh: 把（计划、旅行、项目等）最后定下来；定案

examples.en: the finalization of a deal/agreement/contract
examples.zh: 交易/协议/合同的最终确定

senses.def: to complete the last part of a plan, trip, project, etc.
senses.zh: 把（计划、旅行、项目等）最后定下来；定案

examples.en: to finalize your plans/arrangements
examples.zh: 把计划／安排最后确定下来

examples.en: They met to finalize the terms of the treaty.
examples.zh: 他们会晤确定条约的条款。

examples.en: to finalize a deal/transaction/sale
examples.zh: 敲定一笔买卖

senses.def: after a long time, especially when there has been some difficulty or delay

examples.en: The performance finally started half an hour late.
examples.zh: 延迟了半小时以后演出终于开始了。

examples.en: The law was finally passed in May 2019.
examples.zh: 这项法律最终于 2019 年 5 月通过。

examples.en: I finally managed to get her attention.
examples.zh: 我终于设法引起了她的注意。

examples.en: Are you finally going to tell me why I’m here?
examples.zh: 你终于要告诉我为什么我会在这里吗？

examples.en: When they finally arrived it was well past midnight.
examples.zh: 他们最终到达时已是午夜后的凌晨。

examples.en: Two years of hard work and waiting were finally over.
examples.zh: 两年的辛勤工作和等待终于结束了。

examples.en: Here, finally, we come to the heart of the problem.
examples.zh: 终于来到问题的核心了。

examples.en: Finally ready, they all set off.
examples.zh: 他们终于准备妥当，一齐出发。

senses.def: used to introduce the last in a list of things

examples.en: And finally, I would like to thank you all for coming here today.
examples.zh: 最后，我感谢大家今天的光临。

examples.en: Finally, stir in the fruit and walnuts.
examples.zh: 最后，把水果和核桃搅拌进去。

senses.def: in a way that ends all discussion about something

examples.en: The matter was not finally settled until later.
examples.zh: 这事后来才得到彻底解决。

examples.en: A Home Office spokesman said nothing had been finally decided upon.
examples.zh: 内政部发言人表示，最终还没有做出任何决定。

senses.def: money used to run a business, an activity or a project

examples.en: The project will only go ahead if they can raise the necessary finance.
examples.zh: 他们筹集到所需的资金，这个项目才能继续下去。

examples.en: to arrange/secure finance
examples.zh: 安排/确保财务

examples.en: Finance for education comes from taxpayers.
examples.zh: 教育经费来自纳税人。

senses.def: the activity of managing money, especially by a government or commercial organization

examples.en: the Minister of Finance
examples.zh: 财政部长

examples.en: the finance director/department/committee
examples.zh: 财务主任／部门／委员会

examples.en: She's got a diploma in banking and finance.
examples.zh: 她拥有银行和金融文凭。

examples.en: the world of high finance (= finance involving large companies or countries)
examples.zh: 高级金融界（关乎大公司或国家的金融）

examples.en: an expert in public/personal/corporate finance
examples.zh: 公共／个人／公司财务专家

examples.en: a finance company
examples.zh: 信贷公司

senses.def: the money available to a person, an organization or a country; the way this money is managed
senses.zh: （个人、组织、国家的）财力，财源，财务管理

examples.en: government/public/personal finances
examples.zh: 政府／公共／个人财力

examples.en: They were unable to manage their finances.
examples.zh: 他们不懂得理财。

examples.en: It's about time you sorted out your finances.
examples.zh: 现在是你整顿财务状况的时候了。

examples.en: Moving house put a severe strain on our finances.
examples.zh: 搬家使我们的经济十分紧张。

examples.en: The firm’s finances are basically sound.
examples.zh: 公司的财务状况大体上还不错。

senses.def: to provide money for a project

examples.en: He took a job to finance his stay in Germany.
examples.zh: 他找了一份工作以赚钱支付在德国逗留的费用。

examples.en: The building project will be financed by the government.
examples.zh: 这个建筑项目将由政府出资。

examples.en: The research is financed through government grants.
examples.zh: 该研究由政府拨款资助。

examples.en: Today just 10% of car purchases are financed with loans.
examples.zh: 如今，只有 10% 的汽车购买是通过贷款融资的。

senses.def: a company that lends money to people or businesses
senses.zh: （向个人或公司贷款的）信贷公司，金融公司

senses.def: connected with money and finance

examples.en: the world's major financial markets/institutions
examples.zh: 世界主要金融市场／机构

examples.en: businesses in the financial sector
examples.zh: 金融领域的企业

examples.en: Tokyo and New York are major financial centres.
examples.zh: 东京和纽约是主要的金融中心。

examples.en: The company offers sophisticated financial services.
examples.zh: 该公司提供先进的金融服务。

examples.en: financial support/aid/assistance
examples.zh: 财政援助

examples.en: an independent financial adviser
examples.zh: 独立财务顾问

examples.en: The current financial crisis is global.
examples.zh: 当前的金融危机波及全球。

examples.en: His motives were purely financial.
examples.zh: 他的动机纯粹是经济上的。

senses.def: having money

intro.en: These words all describe activities or situations that are connected with the use of money, especially by a business or country.
intro.zh: 以上各词尤用于企业或国家的经济活动或状况。

items.def: connected with the trade, industry and development of wealth of a country, an area or a society:
items.zh: 指国家、地区或社会经济的、经济上的、经济学的

examples.en: This book deals with the social, economic and political issues of the period.
examples.zh: 这本书论及了那个时期的社会、经济和政治问题。

items.def: connected with money and finance:
items.zh: 指财政的、财务的、金融的

examples.en: She had got into financial difficulties.
examples.zh: 她陷入了财务困境。

items.def: connected with the buying and selling of goods and services.
items.zh: 指贸易的、商业的

items.def: (formal or finance) connected with money, especially all the money in a country:
items.zh: 指货币的、钱的，尤指一国的货币

examples.en: closer European monetary union
examples.zh: 更为紧密的欧洲货币联盟

items.def: (finance) connected with a budget (= the money available or a plan of how it will be spent).
items.zh: 指财政预算的

senses.def: money that is given or lent to students at a university or college who cannot pay the full cost of their education
senses.zh: （高等院校的）助学金，助学贷款

examples.en: to apply for financial aid
examples.zh: 申请助学金

senses.def: a period of twelve months over which the accounts and taxes of a company or a person are calculated. The British financial year
senses.zh: 财政年度，会计年度（英国的财政年度自 4 月 6 日起）

examples.en: The firm made a loss in the first quarter of the current financial year.
examples.zh: 公司在本财政年度的第一季出现亏损。

senses.def: in a way that is connected with money and finance

examples.en: She is still financially dependent on her parents.
examples.zh: 她在经济上仍然依赖父母。

examples.en: Financially, I'm much better off than before.
examples.zh: 我的经济状况比过去好多了。

examples.en: Such projects are not financially viable without government funding.
examples.zh: 没有政府拨款，这样的项目便没有足够的资金运行。

senses.def: the money situation of an organization or individual

examples.en: Reviewing the financials of a company will provide performance evaluations.
examples.zh: 审查公司的财务状况，可借以评估其表现之优劣。

senses.def: shares in companies that deal in money

examples.en: The fund is invested in energy companies, financials and consumer stocks.
examples.zh: 基金持有能源公司、金融公司和消费品公司的股票。

senses.def: a person who manages or lends large amounts of money for or to businesses or governments

to discover somebody/something unexpectedly or by chance

examples.en: Look what I've found!
examples.zh: 看我发现了什么！

examples.en: We've found a great new restaurant near the office.
examples.zh: 我们在办公室附近发现了一家很棒的新餐馆。

examples.en: A whale was found washed up on the shore.
examples.zh: 一头鲸被发现冲到了岸上。

examples.en: They found a car abandoned on top of the cliff.
examples.zh: 他们发现一辆被遗弃在悬崖顶上的汽车。

senses.def: to get back something/somebody that was lost after searching for it/them

examples.en: I can't find my keys.
examples.zh: 我找不到我的钥匙。

examples.en: I thought I'd lost my wallet but I found it under my desk.
examples.zh: 我以为我丢了钱包，但我在桌子底下发现了它。

examples.en: I wanted to talk to him but he was nowhere to be found.
examples.zh: 我想和他谈谈，但哪儿也找不到他。

examples.en: Can you find my bag for me?
examples.zh: 你能帮我找我的包吗？

examples.en: Can you find me my bag?
examples.zh: 你能帮我找我的包吗？

examples.en: The child was eventually found safe and well.
examples.zh: 小孩最后找到了，安然无恙。

senses.def: to discover something/somebody by searching, studying or thinking carefully
senses.zh: （经寻找、研究或思考）发现，查明，找出，求得

examples.en: They found no evidence to support this claim.
examples.zh: 他们找不到证据支持这个说法。

examples.en: We found a way out.
examples.zh: 我们找到了出路。

examples.en: I managed to find a solution to the problem.
examples.zh: 我设法找出了解决问题的办法。

examples.en: Our website is the place to find answers to all your questions.
examples.zh: 我们的网站是您所有问题的答案的地方。

examples.en: He's struggling to find work.
examples.zh: 他正在努力寻找工作。

examples.en: Scientists are still trying to find a cure for cancer.
examples.zh: 科学家仍在努力寻找治疗癌症的方法。

examples.en: I'm having trouble finding anything new to say on this subject.
examples.zh: 在这个课题上要提出什么新看法，我有困难。

examples.en: Have they found anyone to replace her yet?
examples.zh: 他们找到了代替她的人没有？

examples.en: It's hard to find a babysitter.
examples.zh: 找保姆很难。

examples.en: I'll find that information for you.
examples.zh: 我会为你查出那些信息。

examples.en: I'll find you that information.
examples.zh: 我会为你查出那些信息。

examples.en: His father found him a job.
examples.zh: 他的父亲给他找到了一份工作。

senses.group: by studying/thinking 通过研究／思考

senses.def: to discover that something is true after you have tried it, tested it or experienced it

examples.en: I find (that) it pays to be honest.
examples.zh: 我发现老实人不吃亏。

examples.en: A study found that green tea could be beneficial.
examples.zh: 一项研究发现绿茶可能对身体有益。

examples.en: You'll find your opinions change as you get older.
examples.zh: 随着年龄的增长，你会发现你的观点会改变。

examples.en: We found the beds very comfortable.
examples.zh: 我们发现这些床非常舒适。

examples.en: They found him a plausible witness.
examples.zh: 他们发现他是一个可信的证人。

examples.en: They found him to be charming.
examples.zh: 他们觉得他很招人喜欢。

examples.en: Researchers found this to be the most effective method.
examples.zh: 研究人员发现这是最有效的方法。

examples.en: Her blood was found to contain poison.
examples.zh: 她的血液中发现有毒素。

examples.en: If you are found to have lied, you can be charged.
examples.zh: 如果您被发现撒谎，您可能会被指控。

examples.en: It was found that her blood contained poison.
examples.zh: 她的血液中发现有毒素。

senses.group: by experience/testing 通过体验／试验

senses.def: to have a particular feeling or opinion about something

examples.en: You may find it hard to accept your illness.
examples.zh: 你可能觉得难以接受自己患病。

examples.en: You may find your illness hard to accept.
examples.zh: 你可能觉得难以接受自己患病。

examples.en: Do women find it more difficult to ask for a rise?
examples.zh: 女性是否觉得要求加薪更困难？

examples.en: I found the book very interesting.
examples.zh: 我觉得这本书很有趣。

examples.en: She finds it a strain to meet new people.
examples.zh: 她和生人见面总感到局促不安。

examples.en: She finds meeting new people a strain.
examples.zh: 她发现结识新朋友是一种压力。

senses.def: used to say that something exists, grows, etc. somewhere

examples.en: These flowers are found only in Africa.
examples.zh: 这些花仅见于非洲。

examples.en: Further details can be found on our website.
examples.zh: 更多详细信息可以在我们的网站上找到。

examples.en: You'll find this style of architecture all over the town.
examples.zh: 全城到处可见这种风格的建筑。

examples.en: Find us at www.oup.com.
examples.zh: 请访问 www.oup.com 找到我们。

senses.def: to discover somebody/something/yourself doing something or in a particular situation, especially when this is unexpected
senses.zh: （尤指意外地）发现，发觉（处于某状态、在做某事）

examples.en: She woke up and found herself in a hospital bed.
examples.zh: 她醒来发觉自己躺在医院的床上。

examples.en: I found the house in a mess.
examples.zh: 我发现房子一片狼藉。

examples.en: We came home and found him asleep on the sofa.
examples.zh: 我们回到家发现他在沙发上睡着了。

examples.en: I found myself forced to act.
examples.zh: 我发现自己被迫采取行动。

examples.en: He looked up to find her watching him.
examples.zh: 他抬头一看，发现她在看着他。

examples.en: I suddenly found myself running down the street.
examples.zh: 我不知不觉突然在街上跑了起来。

examples.en: She was surprised to find that everyone had left.
examples.zh: 她惊讶地发现大家都走了。

senses.group: in unexpected situations 处于意外状况

senses.def: to have something available so that you can use it

examples.en: I keep meaning to write, but never seem to find (the) time.
examples.zh: 我一直打算写信，但似乎总找不到时间。

examples.en: How are we going to find £10 000 for a car?
examples.zh: 我们哪里有 10 000 英镑买车呢？

senses.def: to show a quality in yourself, usually with an effort

examples.en: I found the courage to speak.
examples.zh: 我鼓起勇气来发言。

senses.def: to arrive at something naturally; to reach something/somebody

examples.en: Water will always find its own level.
examples.zh: 水总会自行流平。

examples.en: Most of the money finds its way to the people who need it.
examples.zh: 多数的钱都会辗转传到需要的人的手中。

examples.en: The criticism found its mark (= had the effect intended).
examples.zh: 批评击中了要害。

examples.en: I hope this letter finds you in good health.
examples.zh: 我希望这封信能让您身体健康。

senses.def: to make a particular decision in a court case

examples.en: The jury found him guilty.
examples.zh: 陪审团裁决他有罪。

examples.en: How do you find the accused?
examples.zh: 你如何裁定被告？

examples.en: The court found in her favour.
examples.zh: 法庭判决对她有利。

examples.en: My boss finds fault with everything I do.
examples.zh: 我的老板对我所做的一切都挑剔。

examples.en: I only recently joined the firm so I'm still finding my feet.
examples.zh: 我最近才加入这家公司，所以还在适应过程中。

examples.zh: 你能够做到宽恕她吗？

examples.en: He couldn't find it in himself to trust anyone again.

examples.zh: 他认为自己可以在国际象棋比赛中击败任何人，但他在彼得身上遇到了对手。

senses.def: to be able to speak or express your opinion
senses.zh: 能说出自己的看法；能表达自己的意见

examples.zh: 希望你能找到回家的路。

examples.zh: 他弄到最后竟干起了演艺这一行。

examples.zh: 我想和他谈谈，但哪儿也找不到他。

examples.en: The children were nowhere to be seen.
examples.zh: 根本看不到孩子们在哪儿。

examples.en: Our new babysitter is a real find.
examples.zh: 我们新来的临时保姆是难得的好保姆。

examples.en: He made his most spectacular finds in the Valley of the Kings.
examples.zh: 他在国王谷有了他最惊人的发现。

senses.def: to make a decision against somebody in a court case
senses.zh: 作出对…有利（或不利）的裁决；判…胜诉（或败诉）

examples.en: The jury found against the defendant.
examples.zh: 陪审团作出了对被告不利的判决。

senses.def: to make a decision in favour of somebody in a court case
senses.zh: 作出对…有利（或不利）的裁决；判…胜诉（或败诉）

examples.en: The jury found for the defendant.
examples.zh: 陪审团作出了对被告有利的裁决。

senses.def: to get some information about something/somebody by asking, reading, etc.

examples.en: She'd been seeing the boy for a while, but didn't want her parents to find out.
examples.zh: 她和这个男孩约会已有一段时间了，但不想让父母知道。

examples.en: I haven't found anything out about him yet.
examples.zh: 我还没有发现有关他的什么情况。

examples.en: Visit our website to find out more.
examples.zh: 请访问我们的网站了解详情。

examples.en: Can you find out what time the meeting starts?
examples.zh: 你能查清楚会议什么时候开始吗？

examples.en: We found out later that we had been at the same school.
examples.zh: 后来我们才弄清楚我们是校友。

senses.def: to discover that somebody has done something wrong

examples.en: He had been cheating the taxman but it was years before he was found out.
examples.zh: 他过去一直在欺骗税务部门，只是多年以后才被查出来。

senses.def: to meet somebody who is equal to or even better than you in strength, skill or intelligence

examples.en: He thought he could beat anyone at chess but he’s met his match in Peter.
examples.zh: 他认为自己可以在国际象棋比赛中击败任何人，但他在彼得身上遇到了对手。

senses.def: a person who finds something

examples.en: If the money remains unclaimed for a certain time it is returned to the finder.
examples.zh: 如果在一定时间内无人认领这笔钱，则会将其退还给拾得者。

senses.def: anyone who finds something has a right to keep it
senses.zh: 谁找到是谁的；谁捡到的归谁
