senses.def: in good health

examples.en: ‘How are you?’ ‘Fine, thanks.’
examples.zh: “你好吗？”“很好，谢谢。”

examples.en: I was feeling fine when I got up this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上我起床时感觉很好。

examples.en: ‘How’s your throat?’ ‘It’s fine as long as I don’t cough.’
examples.zh: “你的喉咙怎么样？”“只要不咳嗽就没事。”

senses.def: of high quality; good

examples.en: a very fine performance
examples.zh: 十分精彩的演出

examples.en: fine clothes/wines/workmanship
examples.zh: 漂亮的衣服；美酒；精湛的工艺

examples.en: It's a particularly fine example of Saxon architecture.
examples.zh: 这是撒克逊式建筑尤为优秀的范例。

examples.en: the finest collection of paintings in Europe
examples.zh: 欧洲最好的绘画收藏

examples.en: She's a fine actor and an even finer dancer.
examples.zh: 她是一位出色的演员，更是一位出色的舞者。

examples.en: Jim has made a fine job of the garden.
examples.zh: 吉姆把花园拾掇得漂漂亮亮的。

examples.en: people who enjoy the finer things in life (= for example art, good food, etc.)
examples.zh: 享受生活中美好事物的人

examples.en: It was his finest hour (= most successful period) as manager of the England team.
examples.zh: 那是他作为英格兰队主教练的鼎盛时期。

examples.en: This movie features some of her finest work.
examples.zh: 这部电影中能看到她最精湛的部分技艺。

examples.en: He tried to appeal to their finer feelings (= feelings of duty, love, etc.)
examples.zh: 他试图打动他们更美好的情感（即责任感、爱等）。

senses.def: used to tell somebody that an action, a suggestion or a decision is acceptable

examples.en: ‘I'll leave this here, OK?’ ‘Fine.’
examples.zh: “我把这个留在这儿，可以吗？”“可以。”

examples.en: ‘Bob wants to know if he can come too.’ ‘That's fine by me.’
examples.zh: “鲍勃想知道他是否也能来。”“我认为没问题。”

examples.en: If you don't agree, that's fine with him.
examples.zh: 如果你不同意，他也没关系。

examples.en: She has been virtually ignoring me but I'm fine with that.
examples.zh: 她几乎一直不理我，但我无所谓。

senses.def: used to say you are satisfied with something

examples.en: Don't worry. Your speech was fine.
examples.zh: 别担心。你的讲话挺好的。

examples.en: Other than a few damp spots, the place looked fine.
examples.zh: 除了一些潮湿的地方之外，这个地方看起来还不错。

examples.en: to sound/seem fine
examples.zh: 听起来/看起来不错

examples.en: You go on without me. I'll be fine.
examples.zh: 别管我了，你继续吧。我没事的。

examples.en: ‘Can I get you another drink?’ ‘No, thanks. I'm fine.’
examples.zh: “我可以再给你取一杯吗？”“不，谢谢。我够了。”

examples.en: Never mind, Jake. Everything will be just fine.
examples.zh: 没关系，杰克。一切都会好起来的。

examples.en: Your hair is perfectly fine the way it is.
examples.zh: 你的头发本来就很好。

examples.en: This paper's not very good quality, but it's fine for rough work.
examples.zh: 这种纸质量不是很好，但用来写草稿很不错。

examples.en: You're a fine one to talk! (= you are not in a position to criticize, give advice, etc.)
examples.zh: 哪有你说话的分儿！

examples.en: This is a fine (= terrible) mess we're in!
examples.zh: 我们的处境好狼狈啊！

senses.def: bright and not raining

examples.en: a fine day/evening
examples.zh: 晴朗的一天／晚上

examples.en: I hope it stays fine for the picnic.
examples.zh: 我希望野餐那天还是晴天。

examples.en: It was a fine sunny morning.
examples.zh: 那是一个阳光明媚的早晨。

examples.en: That summer saw weeks of fine dry weather.
examples.zh: 那个夏天好几周天气都很干燥晴朗。

senses.def: pleasant to look at

examples.en: a fine view
examples.zh: 美景

examples.en: a fine-looking woman
examples.zh: 漂亮女人

examples.en: a fine figure of a man
examples.zh: 身材俊美的男人

examples.en: The boy looks mighty fine in a uniform.
examples.zh: 这个男孩穿着制服看起来非常漂亮。

senses.def: made of very small grains
senses.zh: 小颗粒制成的；颗粒细微的

examples.en: fine sand
examples.zh: 细沙

examples.en: Use a finer piece of sandpaper to finish.
examples.zh: 用细砂纸最后磨光。

examples.en: The top 8 inches of earth is very fine, made up of river sediment.
examples.zh: 顶部8英寸的泥土非常细，由河流沉积物组成。

examples.en: Dip in beaten egg then fine dry breadcrumbs before frying in olive oil.
examples.zh: 浸入打好的鸡蛋中，然后撒上干面包屑，然后用橄榄油煎炸。

senses.def: attractive and small or thin

examples.en: fine bone china
examples.zh: 精致的骨瓷

examples.en: She has inherited her mother's fine features (= a small nose, mouth, etc.).
examples.zh: 她遗传了她母亲的精致面容。

senses.def: very thin or narrow; made of very thin or narrow wires or threads
senses.zh: 纤细的；很细的；细丝制成的

examples.en: His fine blond hair came down almost to his shoulders.
examples.zh: 他纤细的金发几乎垂至肩部。

examples.en: a fine thread
examples.zh: 细线

examples.en: I need a brush with a fine tip.
examples.zh: 我需要一支笔尖纤细的画笔。

examples.en: a fine sieve/mesh
examples.zh: 细筛；细网

senses.def: difficult to see or describe
senses.zh: 难以看出的；很难描述的

examples.en: You really need a magnifying glass to appreciate all the fine detail.
examples.zh: 确实需要放大镜才能欣赏到一切细微之处。

examples.en: There's no need to make such fine distinctions.
examples.zh: 没有必要做如此细微的区分。

examples.en: There's a fine line between love and hate (= it is easy for one to become the other).
examples.zh: 爱恨只有一线之隔。

examples.en: We still have to iron out the finer details.
examples.zh: 我们仍然需要解决更精细的细节。

senses.def: that you have a lot of respect for

examples.en: He was a fine man.
examples.zh: 他是个优秀的人。

senses.def: sounding important and impressive but unlikely to have any effect
senses.zh: 漂亮的；虚饰的；辞藻华丽的

examples.en: His speech was full of fine words which meant nothing.
examples.zh: 他的演讲华而不实。

senses.def: containing only a particular metal and no other substances that reduce the quality

examples.en: fine gold
examples.zh: 纯金

senses.def: people say chance would be a fine thing
the more complicated or detailed aspects of something

examples.en: She seems at ease discussing the finer points of foreign policy.
examples.zh: 她似乎很轻松地讨论外交政策的细节。

examples.en: He learnt the finer points of cricket during a trip to London.
examples.zh: 他在伦敦之行中学到了板球的精髓。

senses.def: healthy; in good condition
senses.zh: 健康；身心俱佳；状况良好

examples.en: The team is in fine fettle.
examples.zh: 球队状态良好。

examples.en: Park Foods is in fine fettle after selling off all non-core businesses.
examples.zh: 帕克食品公司在出售所有非核心业务后状况良好。

senses.def: used to emphasize something that is expressed clearly and directly, especially a criticism
senses.zh: 直截了当地说，不客气地说（尤指批评）

examples.en: Not to put too fine a point on it, I think you are lying.
examples.zh: 不客气地说，我认为你在撒谎。

senses.def: to be in a difficult or dangerous situation where you could easily make a mistake
senses.zh: 处于困境（或险境）；如履薄冰；走钢丝

examples.en: He was walking a fine line between being funny and being rude.
examples.zh: 他想滑稽而不粗鲁，难以把握分寸。

examples.en: She often seems to tread a thin line between success and failure.
examples.zh: 她似乎经常在成功与失败之间徘徊。

senses.def: in a way that is acceptable or good enough

examples.en: Keep going like that—you're doing fine.
examples.zh: 就这样做下去，你做得蛮不错嘛。

examples.en: Things were going fine until you showed up.
examples.zh: 你一露面就把事情搞糟了。

examples.en: That arrangement suits me fine.
examples.zh: 那种安排对我很合适。

examples.en: An omelette will do me fine (= will be enough for me).
examples.zh: 一份摊鸡蛋我就够了。

senses.def: to leave yourself just enough time to do something

senses.def: a mark made by the pattern of lines on the tip of a person’s finger, often used by the police to identify criminals

examples.en: His fingerprints were all over the gun.
examples.zh: 那把枪上布满了他的指纹。

examples.en: to take a suspect’s fingerprints
examples.zh: 采集嫌疑人的指纹

examples.en: The car was examined for fingerprints.
examples.zh: 检查车上是否有指纹。

senses.def: to make a record of somebody's fingerprints

examples.en: I was booked, fingerprinted and locked up for the night.
examples.zh: 我被立案审查，录了指纹并关了一夜。

synonyms.words: stain ▪ fingerprint ▪ streak ▪ speck ▪ blot ▪ smear ▪ spot

intro.zh: 以上各词均指污点、斑点、污迹。

items.def: a small area of dirt, a spot or a cut on a surface that makes it look less good:
items.zh: 污点；污渍；斑点；疤痕

examples.en: The kids left dirty marks all over the kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 孩子们把厨房的地板弄得污迹斑斑。

items.def: a dirty mark on something that is difficult to remove, especially one made by a liquid:
items.zh: 指污点、污渍

examples.en: blood stains
examples.zh: 血迹

items.def: a mark on a surface made by the pattern of lines on the end of a person’s finger, often used by the police to identify criminals:
items.zh: 指指纹、指印

examples.en: Her fingerprints were all over the gun.
examples.zh: 那支枪上布满了她的指纹。

items.def: a long, thin mark or line that is a different colour from the surface it is on:
items.zh: 指条纹、条痕

examples.en: She had streaks of grey in her hair.
examples.zh: 她头上已是白发绺绺。

items.def: a very small mark, spot or piece of a substance on something:
items.zh: 指小点、污点

examples.en: There isn’t a speck of dust anywhere in the house.
examples.zh: 整间房子一尘不染。

items.def: a spot or dirty mark left on something by a substance such as ink or paint being dropped on a surface
items.zh: 指污点、墨渍

items.def: a mark made by something such as oil or paint being spread or rubbed on a surface
items.zh: 指污迹、油渍、污渍、污点

items.def: a small dirty mark on something:
items.zh: 指污迹、污渍、污点

examples.en: There were grease spots all over the walls.
examples.zh: 墙上满是油渍。

senses.def: the end of the finger that is furthest from the hand

examples.en: Apply the cream gently using your fingertips.
examples.zh: 用指尖轻轻涂抹霜。

senses.def: to have the information, knowledge, etc. that is needed in a particular situation and be able to find it easily and use it quickly
senses.zh: 掌握（信息等）；熟悉，精通（知识等）；对…了如指掌；有…随时可供使用

examples.en: I made sure I had all the facts at my fingertips before attending the meeting.
examples.zh: 在参加会议之前，我确保自己对所有事实了如指掌。

senses.def: in every way

examples.zh: 她是个道道地地的完美主义者。

senses.def: to have the information, knowledge, etc. that is needed in a particular situation and be able to find it easily and use it quickly
senses.zh: 掌握（信息等）；熟悉，精通（知识等）；对…了如指掌；有…随时可供使用

examples.zh: 在参加会议之前，我确保自己对所有事实了如指掌。

senses.def: in every way

examples.en: She's a perfectionist to her fingertips.
examples.zh: 她是个道道地地的完美主义者。

senses.def: a part that decorates the top of a roof, wall, etc.
a part that fits on the end of a curtain pole
too worried about what you eat, wear, etc.; disliking many things
senses.zh: （对衣食等）过分讲究的，过分挑剔的

examples.en: a finicky eater
examples.zh: 过分挑食者

senses.def: needing great care and attention to detail
senses.zh: 需认真仔细对待的；需要注意细节的

examples.en: It's a very finicky job.
examples.zh: 这是个很细致的工作。

senses.def: a substance used for making beer or wine clear
senses.zh: 用于使啤酒或葡萄酒澄清的物质

senses.def: to stop doing something or making something because it is complete

examples.en: Haven't you finished your homework yet?
examples.zh: 难道你还没有完成家庭作业吗？

examples.en: She finished law school last year.
examples.zh: 她去年毕业于法学院。

examples.en: You only get points if you finish the race.
examples.zh: 只有完成比赛才能获得积分。

examples.en: I thought you'd never finish!
examples.zh: 我还以为你永远完不成了呢！

examples.en: We've just finished the project.
examples.zh: 我们刚刚完成了这个项目。

examples.en: Let me just finish what I'm doing.
examples.zh: 让我先做好手头上的事。

examples.en: Be quiet! He hasn't finished speaking.
examples.zh: 安静！他还没有讲完。

examples.en: He finished by telling us about his trip to Spain.
examples.zh: 他最后向我们讲述了他在西班牙的所见所闻。

examples.en: ‘And that was all,’ she finished.
examples.zh: “情况就这些。”她结束时说。

senses.def: to come to an end; to bring something to an end

examples.en: The play finished at 10.30.
examples.zh: 比赛于 10:30 结束。

examples.en: The symphony finishes with a flourish.
examples.zh: 交响乐在响亮的乐曲声中结束。

examples.en: The evening finished with a few songs.
examples.zh: 晚会在几首歌曲中结束了。

examples.en: A cup of coffee finished the meal perfectly.
examples.zh: 饭后一杯咖啡，美餐圆满结束。

senses.def: to eat, drink or use what remains of something
senses.zh: 吃完，喝光，用尽（所剩之物）

examples.en: I quickly finished my tea.
examples.zh: 我迅速把茶喝完。

examples.en: He finished off his drink with one large gulp.
examples.zh: 他一大口喝完了饮料。

examples.en: We might as well finish up the cake.
examples.zh: 我们倒不如把蛋糕吃完。

senses.def: to be in a particular state or position at the end of a race or a competition

examples.en: She was delighted to finish second.
examples.zh: 她为竞赛得了第二名而高兴。

examples.en: He finished 12 seconds outside the world record.
examples.zh: 他的成绩比世界纪录慢 12 秒。

examples.en: The team finished the season in ninth position.
examples.zh: 球队本赛季结束时排名第九。

examples.en: The dollar finished the day slightly down.
examples.zh: 当日结束时美元汇率略有下跌。

senses.def: to make somebody so tired or impatient that they cannot do any more
senses.zh: 使筋疲力尽；使失去耐心

examples.en: Climbing that hill really finished me off.
examples.zh: 登那座山真把我累得筋疲力尽。

examples.en: A lecture from my parents now would just finish me.
examples.zh: 现在父母教训我简直会使我受不了。

senses.def: the last part or the end of something

examples.en: It was a close finish as they had predicted.
examples.zh: 正如他们所预料的，比赛结果难分上下。

examples.en: They won in the end but it was a tight finish.
examples.zh: 他们终于赢了，但比分十分接近。

examples.en: a dramatic finish to the race
examples.zh: 比赛的戏剧性结局

examples.en: The story was a lie from start to finish.
examples.zh: 这样的讲述自始至终都是骗人的。

examples.en: I want to see the job through to the finish.
examples.zh: 我想好好把这工作做完。

examples.en: Several runners needed medical attention at the finish.
examples.zh: 几名赛跑选手在完成比赛后须接受护理。

senses.def: the position in which a person or team finishes a competition

examples.en: a second-/third-/fourth-place finish
examples.zh: 第二名；第三名；第四名

examples.en: The team are aiming for a top-five finish.
examples.zh: 该队的目标是进入前五名。

senses.def: the last layer of paint, polish
senses.zh: 末道漆；抛光；（漆完抛光后的）成品表面

examples.en: a gloss/matt finish
examples.zh: 光泽／无光表面

examples.en: furniture available in a range of finishes
examples.zh: 有各种光泽处理的家具

examples.en: to apply extra coats of finish
examples.zh: 涂上额外的面漆

senses.def: the final details that are added to something to make it complete

examples.en: The bows will give a feminine finish to the curtains.
examples.zh: 窗帘最后配上蝴蝶结显出女性的柔美。

examples.en: This trim really does give the garment a professional finish.
examples.zh: 这件衣服的最后一道工序镶边做得非常专业。

senses.def: a sports competition, election, etc. between sides that are so equal in ability that they continue fighting very hard until the end
senses.zh: （体育比赛、选举等的）直到最后才能决出胜负的斗争

examples.en: Six teams are bitter rivals in what will be a fight to the finish.
examples.zh: 六支球队势均力敌，将展开一场殊死搏斗。

examples.en: If the polls are wrong and it's a fight to the finish, the result may not be known until all the votes have been counted.
examples.zh: 如果民调结果有误，又是一场直到最后一刻才见分晓的角逐，那么只有等到统计完所有选票才会知道结果。

senses.def: a sports competition, election, etc. between sides that are so equal in ability that they continue fighting very hard until the end
senses.zh: （体育比赛、选举等的）直到最后才能决出胜负的斗争

examples.en: Six teams are bitter rivals in what will be a fight to the finish.
examples.zh: 六支球队势均力敌，将展开一场殊死搏斗。

senses.def: to destroy somebody/something, especially somebody/something that is badly injured or damaged
senses.zh: 杀死，彻底摧毁（已严重受伤或受损的人或事物）

examples.en: The hunter moved in to finish the animal off.
examples.zh: 猎人逼到近前，了结了那只动物。

senses.def: to do the last part of something; to make something end by doing one last thing

examples.en: I need about an hour to finish off this report.
examples.zh: 我需要一小时左右结束这篇报告。

examples.en: They finished off the show with one of their most famous songs.
examples.zh: 他们用自己的一首最著名的歌曲作演出的压台戏。

examples.en: He finished off by welcoming new arrivals to the school.
examples.zh: 他最后说欢迎新生来到学校。

senses.def: to be in a particular state or at a particular place after a series of events
senses.zh: 结果成为；以…终结；最终来到

examples.en: If you're not careful, you could finish up seriously ill.
examples.zh: 你要是不小心，可能到头来会得场大病。

senses.def: to end a relationship with somebody

examples.en: She finished with her boyfriend last week.
examples.zh: 上星期她和男友分手了。

senses.def: to stop dealing with a person

examples.en: He'll regret he ever said it once I've finished with him.
examples.zh: 一旦我不再和他打交道，他就会后悔他说过那句话。

senses.def: to no longer need to use something

examples.en: When you've finished with the book, can I see it?
examples.zh: 这本书你看完以后我能看吗？

examples.en: Have you finished with the vacuum cleaner yet? I need it.
examples.zh: 你用完吸尘器了吗？我要用。

senses.def: to stop doing something

examples.en: I've finished with gambling.
examples.zh: 我已戒赌了。

senses.def: to have something at the end

examples.en: We had a five-course lunch and finished up with coffee and mints.
examples.zh: 我们这顿午餐吃了五道菜，最后是咖啡和薄荷糖。

examples.en: To finish with, we'll listen to a few songs.
examples.zh: 最后我们将听几首歌。

senses.def: a person or an animal that finishes a race, etc.

examples.en: The first six finishers go into the final.
examples.zh: 前六名选手进入决赛。

senses.def: the line across a sports track, etc. that marks the end of a race

examples.en: The two horses crossed the finishing line together.
examples.zh: 两匹马同时越过终点线。

senses.def: a private school where young women from rich families are taught how to behave in fashionable society
senses.zh: 精修学校（为富家女子学习上流社会行为举止所办的私立学校）

senses.def: a final detail or action that completes a piece of work and makes it even better

examples.en: He put the finishing touches to his painting.
examples.zh: 他对他的画作了最后的润色。

senses.def: having a definite limit or fixed size

examples.en: a finite number of possibilities
examples.zh: 为数有限的可能

examples.en: The world's resources are finite.
examples.zh: 世界的资源是有限的。

senses.def: a finite

examples.en: ‘Am’, ‘is’, ‘are’, ‘was’ and ‘were’ are the finite forms of ‘be’; ‘being’ and ‘been’ are the non-finite forms.
examples.zh: am、is、are、was 和 were 是 be 的限定形式，being 和 been 是非限定形式。

a novel (1922) by James Joyce
senses.zh: 小说（1922年），詹姆斯·乔伊斯（James Joyce）。它详尽地描述了都柏林男人，他的妻子和朋友的生活和思想中的一天，并且包含了许多关于历史，神话和文学的参考。这是乔伊斯的最后一部小说，以难以阅读而著称。这是一本很长的书，是以实验的方式写的。乔伊斯（Joyce）建立了自己的语法，许多单词是其他语言的发明或借用。这本书最初在巴黎出版，直到1936年才在英国出版。

senses.def: from or connected with Finland
computer programs and other technology used to provide banking

examples.en: Banks need to embrace fintech if they wish to compete.
examples.zh: 如果银行希望参与竞争，就需要拥抱金融科技。

examples.en: fintech startups/entrepreneurs
examples.zh: 金融科技初创企业／企业家

senses.def: a first name for girls
a long narrow area of sea between high cliffs
senses.zh: （尤指挪威两岸峭壁间的）峡湾

senses.def: (1882-1947) a popular mayor
senses.zh: 菲奥雷洛·拉瓜迪亚（Fiorello La Guardia）：（1882-1947）：纽约市受欢迎的市长（1933-45）。他被称为“小花”，这就是Fiorello在意大利语中的意思。他的职业生涯始于共和党政客，并当选美国国会议员（1917-19和1923-33）。作为市长，他介绍了应对健康，住房，交通和犯罪问题的措施。在1937年的一次报纸罢工中，他通过阅读广播中的漫画使孩子们高兴。拉瓜迪亚机场以他的名字命名。

an evergreen
a document prepared by the police on first receiving information about a crime (the abbreviation for ‘
senses.zh: 第一次信息报告（警方首次接案后准备的报告，全写为 first information report）

examples.en: FIRs were filed in all these cases.
examples.zh: 所有这些案件均已提交 FIR。

the flames, light and heat, and often smoke, that are produced when something burns

examples.en: Most animals are afraid of fire.
examples.zh: 大多数动物怕火。

examples.en: When did people start to cook with fire?
examples.zh: 人们什么时候开始用火做饭？

senses.def: flames that are out of control and destroy buildings, trees, etc.

examples.en: Several youths had set fire to the police car (= had made it start burning).
examples.zh: 几个年轻人纵火焚烧警车。

examples.en: The car was on fire.
examples.zh: 汽车在燃烧。

examples.en: A candle had set the curtains on fire.
examples.zh: 蜡烛把窗帘燃起来了。

examples.en: These thatched roofs frequently catch fire (= start to burn).
examples.zh: 这些茅草屋顶屡屡着火。

examples.en: Forest fires raged all over Australia.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚各地森林大火肆虐。

examples.en: Five people died in a house fire.
examples.zh: 房屋失火，五人死亡。

examples.en: Fires were breaking out everywhere.
examples.zh: 到处都在发生火灾。

examples.en: A fire had started in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 厨房着火了。

examples.en: He was accused of deliberately starting a fire.
examples.zh: 他被指控故意纵火。

examples.en: Fire can spread very quickly.
examples.zh: 火势蔓延速度非常快。

examples.en: The fire burned for three days before it was finally contained.
examples.zh: 大火烧了 3 天才最终得到控制。

examples.en: The warehouse was destroyed by fire.
examples.zh: 仓库烧毁了。

examples.en: It took two hours to put out the fire (= stop it burning).
examples.zh: 用了两小时才把火扑灭。

examples.en: Fire crews arrived and began to fight the flames.
examples.zh: 消防队员赶到，开始灭火。

examples.en: We have to comply with fire safety regulations.
examples.zh: 我们必须遵守消防安全法规。

senses.def: a pile of burning fuel, such as wood or coal, used for cooking food or heating a room

examples.en: They cook on an open fire.
examples.zh: 他们用明火做饭。

examples.en: a log/coal/wood fire
examples.zh: 原木火；煤火；木柴火

examples.en: Sam had lit a fire to welcome us home.
examples.zh: 萨姆点燃炉火欢迎我们回家。

examples.en: to make/build a fire
examples.zh: 生火

examples.en: Come and get warm by the fire.
examples.zh: 到炉火边来取暖。

examples.en: We sat in front of a roaring fire.
examples.zh: 我们坐在熊熊的炉火面前。

senses.def: a piece of equipment for heating a room

examples.en: a gas/an electric fire
examples.zh: 煤气／电取暖器

examples.en: Shall I put the fire on?
examples.zh: 我打开暖气好吗？

senses.def: shots from guns

examples.en: The gunmen opened fire on (= started shooting at) the police.
examples.zh: 持枪歹徒向警察开火。

examples.en: Their vehicle came under fire (= was being shot at).
examples.zh: 他们的车遭到射击。

examples.en: The men were under heavy fire (= being shot at many times).
examples.zh: 这些人受到猛烈的射击（=被多次射击）。

examples.en: He was hit by enemy fire.
examples.zh: 他被敌人开枪击中了。

examples.en: a burst of machine-gun fire
examples.zh: 一阵机枪射击

examples.en: artillery/rocket/mortar fire
examples.zh: 火炮/火箭/迫击炮

examples.en: to return fire (= to fire back at somebody who is shooting at you)
examples.zh: 用枪炮还击

examples.en: He ordered his men to hold their fire (= not to shoot).
examples.zh: 他命令士兵停止射击。

examples.en: Protesters exchanged fire with the guards (= they shot at each other).
examples.zh: 抗议者与卫兵交火。

examples.en: A young girl was in the line of fire (= between the person shooting and what he/she was shooting at).
examples.zh: 有一个女孩处于射程之内。

examples.en: I’ll give you covering fire while you try to escape.
examples.zh: 当你试图逃跑时，我会给你火力掩护。

senses.def: strong criticism

examples.en: She directed her fire against the new education policy.
examples.zh: 她大力抨击新的教育政策。

examples.en: The health minister has come under fire from all sides.
examples.zh: 卫生部长受到来自各方的责难。

senses.def: very strong emotion, especially anger or enthusiasm

examples.en: Her eyes were full of fire.
examples.zh: 她的双眼充满激情的火花。

examples.en: The fire seemed to die in him when his wife died.
examples.zh: 妻子去世后，他的热情似乎熄灭了。

senses.def: a person who is full of energy and enthusiasm
senses.zh: 充满活力和热情的人；生龙活虎的人；朝气蓬勃的人

senses.def: a difficult introduction to a new job or activity
senses.zh: 重大的考验；战火的洗礼

senses.def: to make somebody direct their anger, criticism, etc. at you, so that others do not have to face it
senses.zh: （为掩护他人）吸引…的火力，转移…的视线

senses.def: to use similar methods in a fight or an argument to those your opponent is using
a very strong desire to achieve something

examples.en: You need fire in your belly if you want to make it in the music business.
examples.zh: 如果你想在音乐行业取得成功，你需要内心充满火焰。

senses.def: to become friends quickly and have a very friendly relationship
senses.zh: 很快就打得火热；一见如故；一拍即合

senses.def: to delay or be delayed in taking action

examples.en: The project had hung fire for several years for lack of funds.
examples.zh: 这个项目因缺少资金耽搁了好几年。

senses.def: to be involved in several activities or areas of business at the same time, hoping that at least one will be successful
senses.zh: 分散活动（或经营）；广泛撒网

senses.def: if something bad is being said about somebody/something, it usually has some truth in it
senses.zh: 无火不生烟；无风不起浪

senses.def: giving you a painful burning feeling

examples.en: He couldn't breathe. His chest was on fire.
examples.zh: 他无法呼吸。他的胸部火辣辣地疼痛。

senses.def: to be doing really well at something

examples.en: Keep it up. You're on fire!
examples.zh: 继续努力。你表现得很出色！

senses.def: from a bad situation to one that is worse
senses.zh: 跳出油锅又落火坑；逃出虎口又入狼窝；每况愈下

senses.def: to act in a way that is not sensible and take dangerous risks
to be very successful and admired by other people

examples.en: He's never going to set the world on fire with his paintings.
examples.zh: 他的绘画永远不会引起轰动。

senses.def: to shoot bullets, etc. from a gun or other weapon

examples.en: The officer ordered his men to fire.
examples.zh: 军官下令士兵射击。

examples.zh: 一名用假蝇钓鱼的钓鱼爱好者捕到一条创纪录的大鲑鱼。

examples.zh: 这儿有点不大对头。

examples.en: I don’t know what they’re up to. It sounds a distinctly fishy business.
examples.zh: 我不知道他们在干什么，听起来显然值得怀疑。

examples.zh: 他用拳头猛击我。

examples.zh: 她紧握双拳，克制颤抖。

examples.en: He got into a fist fight in the bar.
examples.zh: 他在酒吧与人挥拳斗殴。

examples.en: He banged a heavy fist on the table.
examples.zh: 他重拳重重地敲在桌子上。

examples.zh: 他们承诺，军队将用铁拳打击任何抵抗。

examples.en: The iron hand in the velvet glove approach seems to work best with this age group.
examples.zh: 天鹅绒手套中的铁腕方法似乎最适合这个年龄段的人。

senses.zh: 拳头碰撞：与某人打拳头，以表示“你好”或表示支持或达成协议

examples.en: Several of the politician’s supporters fist-bumped him as he left the stage.
examples.zh: 那名政治人物走下台时几个支持者跟他碰了碰拳头。

senses.def: an action to celebrate success or victory, or to show support, in which you raise your bent arm with your hand tightly closed and then move it quickly and strongly down towards your body

examples.en: When I saw the final score, I gave a fist pump and shouted out ‘YES!’
examples.zh: 看到最终比分，我攥拳大喊“太棒了！”

senses.def: to move your arm and hand in a fist pump
senses.zh: 拳头泵：举起拳头移动手臂和手，以庆祝成功或胜利，或表示支持

examples.en: They sang, they fist-pumped and they cheered the speakers.
examples.zh: 他们唱歌，攥拳，向演讲者欢呼。

examples.zh: 我试穿了那连衣裙，但不合身。

examples.zh: 那件短上衣很合身。

examples.en: My shoes fit perfectly.
examples.zh: 我的鞋子非常合脚。

examples.zh: 紧身连衣裙

examples.zh: 我找不到合身的衣服。

examples.en: The key doesn't fit the lock.
examples.zh: 这把钥匙打不开这把锁。

senses.group: right size/type 恰当的大小／类型

senses.def: to be of the right size, type or number to go somewhere
senses.zh: （大小、式样、数量）可容纳，可装进

examples.en: I'd like to have a desk in the room but it won't fit.
examples.zh: 我想在房间放一张桌子，但是搁不下。

examples.en: This device is small enough to fit in a pocket.
examples.zh: 该设备足够小，可以放入口袋中。

examples.en: His arms fitted snugly around me.
examples.zh: 他的手臂紧紧地搂着我。

senses.group: right size/type 恰当的大小／类型

senses.def: to put clothes on somebody and make them the right size and shape

examples.en: I'm going to be fitted for my wedding dress today.
examples.zh: 今天我要去试穿结婚礼服。

senses.group: right size/type 恰当的大小／类型

senses.def: to put or fix something somewhere

examples.en: They fitted a smoke alarm to the ceiling.
examples.zh: 他们把烟雾报警器安装在天花板上。

examples.en: uPVC windows have been fitted throughout the house.
examples.zh: 整个房子都安装了 uPVC 窗户。

examples.en: The rooms were all fitted with smoke alarms.
examples.zh: 所有的房间都安装了烟雾报警器。

senses.def: to put or join something in the right place

examples.en: The glass fits on top of the jug to form a lid.
examples.zh: 这个玻璃杯放在大罐口上恰好当个盖子。

examples.en: How do these two parts fit together?
examples.zh: 这两部分如何拼在一起呢？

examples.en: We fitted together the pieces of the puzzle.
examples.zh: 我们把拼图玩具的各部分拼合在了一起。

examples.en: If the top of the box fits badly, the contents will spill out.
examples.zh: 如果盒盖盖不严，里面的东西就会洒落出来。

senses.def: to agree with, match or be suitable for something; to make something do this

examples.en: Something doesn't quite fit here.
examples.zh: 这里有点不大协调。

examples.en: His pictures don't fit into any category.
examples.zh: 他的画哪一类也算不上。

examples.en: The words fit perfectly with the music.
examples.zh: 歌词与音乐非常相配。

examples.en: The facts certainly fit your theory.
examples.zh: 这些事实和你的说法丝毫不差。

examples.en: to fit a description/profile
examples.zh: 适合描述/简介

examples.en: The punishment ought to fit the crime.
examples.zh: 罚须当罪。

examples.en: We tailor our programs to fit their needs.
examples.zh: 我们定制我们的计划以满足他们的需求。

examples.en: Most organizations do not fit this model.
examples.zh: 大多数组织不适合这种模式。

examples.en: We should fit the punishment to the crime.
examples.zh: 我们应该根据罪行量刑。

senses.def: to make somebody/something suitable for a particular job or situation
senses.zh: 使胜任（某工作）；使适合（某情况）

examples.en: His experience fitted him perfectly for the job.
examples.zh: 他的经验使他完全胜任这项工作。

examples.en: She was well fitted to the role of tragic heroine.
examples.zh: 她很适合演悲剧女主角。

examples.en: His experience fitted him to do the job.
examples.zh: 他的经验使他适合干这个工作。

examples.en: Natural selection will see to it that animals are well fitted to survive in their environment.
examples.zh: 自然选择将确保动物适应自身的生存环境。

senses.def: to be like a particular person or thing

examples.en: A child answering the description of the missing boy was found safe and well in London yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天在伦敦发现了一个与失踪男孩情况相符的孩子，安然无恙。

examples.en: We're all looking for quick, healthy meals, and pasta fits this description.
examples.zh: 我们都在寻找快速、健康的膳食，而面食就符合这个描述。

senses.def: used to say that somebody will/will not get a particular job or position because they have/do not have the appearance, personality, etc. that the employer wants, even when this should not be important
senses.zh: 长相（不）合格；性格（不）合适

examples.en: If your face fits, you'll get the job.
examples.zh: 如果你的脸型合适，你就会得到这份工作。

examples.en: It doesn't matter how well qualified you are; if your face doesn't fit, you don't stand a chance.
examples.zh: 资历多好也没用，如果人家看你不顺眼，你就不会有机会。

senses.def: to be what is needed in a particular situation or for a particular purpose

examples.en: On paper, several of the applicants fit the bill.
examples.zh: 从书面材料看，有几位申请人符合条件。

senses.def: to be the perfect size or shape for somebody
senses.zh: （大小、形状）完全合适，恰好合身

examples.en: The dress fits me like a glove.
examples.zh: 这件衣服像手套一样适合我。

senses.def: if you feel that a remark applies to you, you should accept it and take it as a warning or criticism
healthy and strong, especially because you do regular physical exercise

examples.en: Top athletes have to be very fit.
examples.zh: 顶级运动员体格必须十分健壮。

examples.en: She tries to keep fit by jogging every day.
examples.zh: 她每天慢跑以保持健康。

examples.en: Hiking helps keep him physically fit.
examples.zh: 远足有助他保持身体健康。

examples.en: All the recruits seemed fit and healthy.
examples.zh: 所有新兵看起来都很健康。

examples.en: my new year's resolution to get fit
examples.zh: 我的新年决心是健身

examples.en: He is back in training after his back injury but is not yet considered match fit (= fit enough to play in a match).
examples.zh: 他在背部受伤后恢复了训练，但尚未被认为适合比赛（=适合参加比赛）。

examples.en: He won't be fit to play in the match on Saturday.
examples.zh: 他身体不适，不能在星期六出场比赛。

examples.en: The judge concluded that the applicant was fit to stand trial.
examples.zh: 法官得出结论，申请人适合出庭受审。

examples.en: He's had a bad cold and isn't fit enough for work yet.
examples.zh: 他得了重感冒，还不能上班。

examples.en: After two days, Douglas was declared fit for duty.
examples.zh: 两天后，道格拉斯被宣布适合执勤。

examples.en: The government aims to make British industry leaner and fitter (= employing fewer people and with lower costs).
examples.zh: 政府旨在使英国的工业更加简而精。

senses.def: suitable; of the right quality; with the right qualities or skills
senses.zh: （质量、素质或技能）适合的，恰当的，合格的

examples.en: The food was not fit for human consumption.
examples.zh: 这食物不适合人吃。

examples.en: It was a meal fit for a king (= of very good quality).
examples.zh: 这饭菜够得上御膳。

examples.en: The children seem to think I'm only fit for cooking and washing!
examples.zh: 孩子们似乎以为我只配做饭洗衣！

examples.en: Your car isn't fit to be on the road!
examples.zh: 你的车子还不适合上马路！

examples.en: He's so angry he's in no fit state to see anyone.
examples.zh: 他气成这个样子，不适合见人。

examples.en: This is not a fit place for you to live.
examples.zh: 这个地方不适合你居住。

examples.en: He was not considered a fit and proper person to run a bank.
examples.zh: 他不被认为是经营银行的合适人选。

examples.en: Schools should be allowed to operate as they deem fit.
examples.zh: 应允许学校按照其认为合适的方式运营。

senses.def: ready or likely to do something extreme
senses.zh: 可能（或准备）做某事至极端程度

examples.en: They worked until they were fit to drop (= so tired that they were likely to fall down).
examples.zh: 他们一直工作到快要累趴下了。

examples.en: I've eaten so much I'm fit to burst.
examples.zh: 我吃得太多，肚子快要撑破了。

examples.en: She was laughing fit to burst (= very much).
examples.zh: 她笑得肚皮都要破了。

extremely fit or healthy
in very good physical condition
(of an institution, a system, a thing, etc.) suitable for the function or purpose that it was designed for
senses.zh: （机构、体系、事物等）符合设计原意的，具有适当功能的

examples.en: The minister argued that the education system wasn’t fit for purpose.
examples.zh: 部长认为教育体系不符合其目的。

examples.en: The new executive flats are fully equipped and fit for purpose.
examples.zh: 新的行政公寓设备齐全且适合用途。

examples.en: I returned the goods as they weren’t fit for purpose.
examples.zh: 我退回了货物，因为它们不符合用途。

senses.def: to consider it right or acceptable to do something; to decide or choose to do something
senses.zh: 认为（做某事）恰当（或适合）；决定，愿意（做某事）

examples.en: You must do as you think fit (= but I don't agree with your decision).
examples.zh: 你认为怎么合适就怎么干（但我不同意你的决定）。

examples.en: The newspaper did not see fit to publish my letter (= and I criticize it for that).
examples.zh: 那份报纸认为我的信件不宜发表（而我批评这种看法）。

examples.zh: 癫痫发作

examples.zh: 他患有头痛和昏厥。

examples.zh: 她的病现已用药物控制，没有发作。

examples.zh: 一阵咳嗽

examples.zh: 他的笑话使我们都笑得前仰后合。

senses.def: a short period of very strong feeling

examples.zh: 一阵愤怒／狂怒／怒火／恼怒之下采取行动

senses.group: of strong feeling 强烈感情

senses.zh: （尤指衣服）合身的程度；容纳于…的状态；贴合度

examples.zh: 这鞋有一条专用的带子，以确保合脚。

examples.en: It was a tight fit with six of us in the boat.
examples.zh: 我们六个人把船挤得满满当当的。

senses.def: the way that two things match each other or are suitable for each other

examples.en: a perfect fit between the recruit and the job
examples.zh: 新聘员工和工作的完美契合

senses.def: frequently starting and stopping again; not continuously

examples.en: Because of other commitments I can only write my book in fits and starts.
examples.zh: 由于还承担着其他任务，我只能断断续续地写书。

senses.zh: 大为震惊；非常心烦意乱；大发脾气

examples.zh: 要是你母亲知道你一直喝酒，会很生气的！

senses.def: (1820-1910) an English nurse who became famous for her work during the Crimean War
senses.zh: 弗洛伦斯·南丁格尔（Florence Nightingale）：（1820-1910）一位英国护士，因在克里米亚战争中的工作而闻名。尽管遭到了陆军官员的反对，她还是大大改善了军事医院的条件，并减少了死于疾病的士兵人数。她过去常常晚上带着灯在医院的病床上走来走去，安慰患者，因此被称为“灯夫人”。后来，她发起了一场运动，以改变英国的医院系统并改善护士的培训。1907年，她成为首位获得勋章的妇女。

examples.zh: 艺术是从那时开始繁荣的。

examples.zh: 黑市交易猖獗。

examples.en: These plants flourish in a damp climate.
examples.zh: 这些植物在潮湿的气候下长势茂盛。

examples.zh: 听说你们都健康幸福，我感到高兴。

examples.zh: 希望我的孙子们能够茁壮成长。

examples.zh: 最后她做了一个夸张的动作，放下钢笔。

examples.zh: 满篇华丽辞藻的演讲

examples.zh: 他的写作平实而直接，没有文体上的华丽。

examples.zh: 公然藐视权威／惯例

examples.zh: 她就爱藐视习俗、我行我素。

examples.zh: 电流的流动

examples.zh: 她试图止住伤口流血。

examples.en: Exercise increases blood flow to the brain.
examples.zh: 运动能增加通往脑部的血流量。

examples.zh: 源源不断的游客涌入该地区

examples.zh: 穿过城市的稳定的交通流

examples.zh: 改善交通流量

examples.zh: 控制流向

examples.zh: 砍伐周围的植被以增加光线和空气流通。

examples.en: to encourage the free flow of information
examples.zh: 鼓励信息自由交流

examples.en: efforts to stem the flow of illegal drugs
examples.zh: 遏制非法毒品流通的努力

examples.en: We are looking to improve data flow by up to 50%.
examples.zh: 我们希望将数据流提高高达 50%。

examples.en: the flow of goods and services to remote areas
examples.zh: 商品和服务对边远地区源源不断的供应

examples.en: You've interrupted my flow—I can't remember what I was saying.
examples.zh: 你打断了我的话，我记不得我在说什么了。

examples.en: He kept up a flow of chatter.
examples.zh: 他一直喋喋不休。

examples.en: As usual, Tom was in full flow (= talking confidently in a way that is hard to interrupt).
examples.zh: 像往常一样，汤姆口若悬河。

senses.def: the way that words, ideas or themes are linked together in speech, writing or music

examples.en: Too many examples can interrupt the smooth flow of the text.
examples.zh: 例子太多会使行文不流畅。

examples.en: I found it hard to follow the flow of the argument.
examples.zh: 我发现很难跟上争论的脉络。

examples.en: I liked the concerto for its natural flow.
examples.zh: 我喜欢这部协奏曲的自然流畅。

examples.zh: 四时更迭

examples.zh: 她默默地坐在那儿，饶有兴致地听着时高时低的谈话声。

examples.zh: 他认识她很久了，能够辨别出她情绪的起伏。

examples.zh: 他失去了控制，泪水开始流淌。

examples.zh: 新的订单终于开始纷至沓来。

examples.zh: 车流不断通过。

examples.en: Election results flowed in throughout the night.
examples.zh: 整夜不断传来选举的结果。

examples.zh: 他们检查了公司 300 名员工之间的信息流动方式。

examples.zh: 铝箔

examples.en: Cover the fish loosely with foil and bake for 30 minutes.
examples.zh: 用箔纸松松地盖住鱼，烘烤 30 分钟。

examples.en: I wrapped the sandwiches in kitchen foil.
examples.zh: 我用箔纸将三明治包起来。

senses.def: paper that is covered in very thin sheets of metal

examples.en: The chocolates are individually wrapped in gold foil.
examples.zh: 巧克力用金箔纸一颗颗独立包装。

senses.def: a person or thing that contrasts with, and therefore emphasizes, the qualities of another person or thing

examples.en: The pale walls provide a perfect foil for the furniture.
examples.zh: 浅色的墙壁完全衬托出家具的特色。

examples.en: His mellow guitar technique is the ideal foil for her soaring voice.
examples.zh: 他圆润的吉他技巧是她高亢嗓音的理想陪衬。

senses.def: a long thin light sword
to stop something from happening, especially something illegal; to prevent somebody from doing something
senses.zh: 挫败，阻止，制止（非法活动等）

examples.en: to foil a plan/crime/plot
examples.zh: 挫败计划／犯罪／阴谋

examples.en: Customs officials foiled an attempt to smuggle the paintings out of the country.
examples.zh: 海关关员阻截了一次企图走私画作出境的阴谋。

examples.en: They were foiled in their attempt to smuggle the paintings.
examples.zh: 他们走私绘画作品的企图未能得逞。

senses.def: to force somebody to accept somebody/something that they do not want

examples.en: The title for her novel was foisted on her by the publishers.
examples.zh: 她的小说书名是出版商强加给她的。

examples.en: When I was young my parents often foisted me upon a reluctant aunt for the weekend.
examples.zh: 当我年轻的时候，我的父母经常把我强加给一位不情愿的阿姨过周末。

senses.def: to force somebody to accept somebody/something that they do not want

examples.en: The title for her novel was foisted on her by the publishers.
examples.zh: 她的小说书名是出版商强加给她的。

examples.en: When I was young my parents often foisted me upon a reluctant aunt for the weekend.
examples.zh: 当我年轻的时候，我的父母经常把我强加给一位不情愿的阿姨过周末。

senses.def: to bend something, especially paper or cloth, so that one part lies on top of another part

examples.en: First, fold the paper in half/in two.
examples.zh: 首先，把纸对折起来。

examples.en: The bird folded its wings.
examples.zh: 那只鸟收起了翅膀。

examples.en: a pile of neatly folded clothes
examples.zh: 一摞折叠整齐的衣服

examples.en: He folded the map up and put it in his pocket.
examples.zh: 他把地图折叠起来，放进了口袋。

examples.en: The blankets had been folded down.
examples.zh: 毛毯已折叠起来。

examples.en: Don't fold back pages to mark your place in a book.
examples.zh: 不要折叠后页来标记您在书中的位置。

examples.en: Fold the dough over on top of itself.
examples.zh: 将面团折叠起来。

senses.def: to bend something so that it becomes smaller or flatter and can be stored or carried more easily; to bend or be able to bend in this way
senses.zh: 折小，叠平，可折小，可叠平（以便贮存或携带）

examples.en: The bed can be folded away during the day.
examples.zh: 这张床在白天可以折叠收起。

examples.en: The central back seat can be folded down to provide a useful tray.
examples.zh: 中央后座可以折叠起来以提供有用的托盘。

examples.en: She folds up the wheelchair and stows it in the trunk.
examples.zh: 她把轮椅折叠起来，放进行李箱。

examples.en: The table folds up when not in use.
examples.zh: 这桌子不用时可以折叠起来。

examples.en: The table folds away when not in use.
examples.zh: 不使用时，桌子可以折叠起来。

examples.en: a TV screen that folds down from the ceiling
examples.zh: 从天花板上折叠下来的电视屏幕

examples.en: The settee folds out into a comfortable bed.
examples.zh: 长椅可折叠成一张舒适的床。

examples.en: The ironing board folds flat for easy storage.
examples.zh: 烫衣板能够折起来，便于存放。

examples.en: When she heard the news, her legs just folded under her (= she fell).
examples.zh: 她听到这消息时双腿发软（倒在地上）。

senses.def: to wrap something around somebody/something

examples.en: She gently folded the baby in a blanket.
examples.zh: 她轻轻地把婴儿裹在毯子里。

examples.en: She folded a blanket around the baby.
examples.zh: 她用毯子把婴儿裹了起来。

senses.def: to close because it is not successful

examples.en: The new musical folded after only twenty performances.
examples.zh: 这部新音乐剧只演出了二十场就宣告失败。

senses.def: to put one of your arms over the other one and hold them against your body

examples.en: He stood watching her with his arms folded across his chest.
examples.zh: 他双臂交叉在胸前看着她。

examples.en: She folded her arms and stared at him.
examples.zh: 她双臂合抱在胸前，直视着他。

senses.def: to bring or hold your hands together

examples.en: She kept her hands folded in her lap.
examples.zh: 她双手合拢，放在腿上。

senses.def: to put your arms around somebody and hold them against your body
multiplied by; having the number of parts mentioned

examples.en: to increase tenfold
examples.zh: 增加到十倍

senses.def: a part of something, especially cloth, that is folded or hangs as if it had been folded

examples.en: the folds of her dress
examples.zh: 她的连衣裙上的褶

examples.en: loose folds of skin
examples.zh: 皮肤松垮的褶皱

senses.def: a mark or line made by folding something, or showing where something should be folded

examples.en: Why is the place I want to find always on the fold of the map?
examples.zh: 为什么我想找的地方总是在地图的褶缝上？

senses.def: an area in a field surrounded by a fence or wall where animals, especially sheep, are kept for safety
a group of people who share the same ideas or beliefs
senses.zh: 志趣相同的人们；同一信仰的人们

examples.en: He called on former Republican voters to return to the fold.
examples.zh: 他号召昔日拥护共和党的选民重新回到支持共和党的行列。

examples.en: She was determined to draw Matthew back into the family fold.
examples.zh: 她决心让马修重新融入家庭。

senses.def: a curve or bend in the line of the layers of rock in the earth’s crust
a hollow place among hills or mountains

examples.en: It was a solitary spot in a fold between two hills.
examples.zh: 这是个人迹罕至的地方，隐藏在两座山之间的山坳里。

senses.def: in/not in a position where you see it first, for example in the top/bottom part of a newspaper page or web page
senses.zh: （报纸或网页）最上／下面部分，最显眼／不显眼部分

examples.en: Your ad will be placed above the fold for prominent exposure.
examples.zh: 你们的广告将放在页面上端的醒目位置。

examples.en: The images all appeared below the fold.
examples.zh: 图像全部出现在首屏下方。

senses.def: to put one of your arms over the other one and hold them against your body

examples.en: He stood watching her with his arms folded across his chest.
examples.zh: 他双臂交叉在胸前看着她。

senses.def: to bring or hold your hands together

examples.en: She kept her hands folded in her lap.
examples.zh: 她双手合拢，放在腿上。

senses.def: to add one substance to another and gently mix them together

examples.en: Fold in the beaten egg whites.
examples.zh: 调入打好的蛋白。

senses.def: to add one substance to another and gently mix them together

examples.en: Fold in the beaten egg whites.
examples.zh: 调入打好的蛋白。

senses.def: designed to be opened out for use and then folded away again so it can be stored easily

examples.en: If you're short of space, having a fold-out bed makes a lot of sense.
examples.zh: 如果你的空间有限，那么拥有一张折叠床很有意义。

examples.en: The book also includes a fold-out map highlighting the 34 restaurants featured.
examples.zh: 该书还包括一张折叠式地图，突出显示了 34 家特色餐厅。

senses.def: that can be made smaller by closing or folding so that it takes up less space
that can be folded

examples.en: The buggy has four wheels and a foldable seat.
examples.zh: 这婴儿车有四个轮子和一个可折叠座椅。

examples.en: a foldable smartphone
examples.zh: 可折叠智能手机

senses.def: that can be folded, especially so that it can be stored in a small space

examples.en: a foldaway bed
examples.zh: 折叠床

senses.def: a cover made of stiff card or plastic for holding loose papers, etc.

examples.en: There were two new buff folders on my desk.
examples.zh: 我桌上有两个崭新的浅褐色文件夹。

senses.def: (in some computer systems) a way of organizing and storing computer files
senses.zh: （某些计算机系统中的）文件夹

senses.def: a printed sheet of paper or a few printed pages folded into a small book

examples.en: The full specification of this remarkable car can be found in the information folder.
examples.zh: 这辆非凡汽车的完整规格可以在信息文件夹中找到。

senses.def: money in the form of notes, not coins

examples.en: Make sure you have plenty of folding money with you.
examples.zh: 确保你身上有足够的折叠钱。

senses.def: the leaves of a tree or plant; leaves and branches together

examples.en: dense green foliage
examples.zh: 茂密的绿叶

senses.def: relating to leaves

examples.en: foliar colour
examples.zh: 叶子的颜色

senses.def: food that is supplied to the leaves of a plant
a vitamin found in green vegetables, liver
senses.zh: 叶酸（见于绿色蔬菜、肝、肾的一种维生素，用于造红细胞）

senses.def: a book made with large sheets of paper, especially as used in early printing

examples.en: a folio edition
examples.zh: 对开本, 对摺本

senses.def: a single sheet of paper from a book
people in general

examples.en: ordinary working-class folk
examples.zh: 普通劳动大众

examples.en: I'd like a job working with old folk or kids.
examples.zh: 我喜欢与老人或小孩打交道的工作。

examples.en: the folks back home (= from the place where you come from)
examples.zh: 家乡的乡亲父老

examples.en: Folks say that he is a hard man.
examples.zh: 据说他不近人情。

examples.en: Like most folks, I enjoy a decent western.
examples.zh: 像大多数人一样，我喜欢看正派的西部片。

senses.def: a friendly way of addressing more than one person

examples.en: Well, folks, what are we going to do today?
examples.zh: 喂，伙计们，我们今天要干什么？

senses.def: the members of your family, especially your parents

examples.en: How are your folks?
examples.zh: 你爸妈好吗？

examples.en: I am going to visit my folks at the weekend.
examples.zh: 我打算这个周末去探望父母。

senses.def: people from a particular country or region, or who have a particular way of life
senses.zh: （某国、某地区或某生活方式的）普通百姓

examples.en: country folk
examples.zh: 乡下人

examples.en: townsfolk
examples.zh: 城里人

examples.en: farming folk
examples.zh: 农民

examples.en: places that appeal to city folk
examples.zh: 吸引城里人的地方

senses.def: music in the traditional style of a country or community

examples.en: a folk festival/concert
examples.zh: 民间音乐节／音乐会

senses.def: traditional and typical of the ordinary people of a country or community

examples.en: We visited an exhibition of folk art.
examples.zh: 我们参观了民间艺术展览。

examples.en: a dance that originated in English folk tradition
examples.zh: 起源于英国民间传统的舞蹈

senses.def: based on the beliefs of ordinary people
senses.zh: 流传民间的；普通百姓的

examples.en: folk wisdom
examples.zh: 民间智慧

examples.en: Garlic is widely used in folk medicine.
examples.zh: 大蒜在民间医学中广泛使用。

senses.def: a traditional dance of a particular area or country; a piece of music for such a dance
senses.zh: 土风舞；民间舞蹈；民间舞曲

senses.def: a popular but wrong belief about the origin of a word or phrase
senses.zh: 民间词源认知，俗词源说法（广为流传但错误的词源学解释）

examples.en: This explanation may simply be a folk etymology.
examples.zh: 这种解释可能只是民间词源。

senses.def: a process by which a word is changed, for example because people believe that it is related to another word, even though it is not, or to make a foreign word sound more familiar

examples.en: Folk etymology has created the cheeseburger and the beanburger, but the first hamburgers were in fact named after the city of Hamburg.
examples.zh: 民间词源创造了 cheeseburger 和 beanburger，但最初 hamburger 一词实际上是以德国汉堡市命名的。

senses.def: a person that the ordinary people of a country or region admire because of something special that person has done
a memory or collection of memories of something in the past that the people of a country or community never forget
senses.zh: 民间共同记忆（一个国家或社群的人不会忘记的往事）

senses.def: a museum that displays interesting or historical objects that were part of the local people's everyday lives, such as clothes and tools. Many British towns and cities have folk museums. Similar museums exist in the US but they are not often called folk museums.
senses.zh: 民间博物馆：一个博物馆，陈列着有趣或历史悠久的物品，这些物品是当地人日常生活的一部分，例如衣服和工具。许多英国城镇都有民间博物馆。在美国也有类似的博物馆，但通常不称为民间博物馆。

senses.def: the traditional music of a country or community

examples.en: He drew his inspiration from traditional Hungarian folk music.
examples.zh: 他从匈牙利传统民间音乐中汲取了灵感。

senses.def: a style of music that combines elements of folk music
a person who sings folk songs
a song in the traditional style of a country or community; songs of this type

examples.en: an Irish folk song
examples.zh: 一首爱尔兰民歌

examples.en: This type of rhyme has survived only in folk song.
examples.zh: 这种韵律仅存于民歌中。

senses.def: a type of song that became popular in the US in the 1960s, played on a guitar and often about political topics
senses.zh: 民谣歌曲（美国 20 世纪 60 年代盛行，吉他伴奏，常以政治为题材）

senses.def: a very old traditional story from a particular place that was originally passed on to people in a spoken form
the traditions and stories of a country or community
senses.zh: 民间传统；民俗；民间传说

examples.en: Irish/Indian folklore
examples.zh: 爱尔兰／印度民俗

examples.en: The story rapidly became part of family folklore.
examples.zh: 这个故事很快就成为家族传说的一部分。

senses.def: a person who studies folklore
senses.zh: 民俗学家；民俗学研究者

senses.def: simple, friendly and informal
senses.zh: 淳朴友好自然的；朴实热情随意的

examples.en: They wanted the store to have a folksy small-town image.
examples.zh: 他们希望这家商店具有小城镇那种朴实热情的形象。

senses.def: done or made in a traditional style that is supposed to be typical of simple customs in the past, but sometimes in a false or artificial way
senses.zh: 有民间传统的；有乡土味的；（故作）土里土气的

examples.en: a folksy ballad
examples.zh: 有民间风味的歌谣

examples.en: The folksy image helped the company hit $1 million sales last year.
examples.zh: 这种亲切的形象帮助该公司去年的销售额达到了 100 万美元。

senses.def: the traditional behaviour or customs of a particular community or group of people
senses.zh: 民俗：特定社区或人群的传统行为或习俗

examples.en: the folkways of central Texas
examples.zh: 德克萨斯州中部的民俗

senses.def: simple, friendly and informal
senses.zh: 淳朴友好自然的；朴实热情随意的

examples.en: They wanted the store to have a folky, small-town image.
examples.zh: 他们希望这家商店有一种民俗、小镇的形象。

senses.def: done or made in a traditional style that is supposed to be typical of simple customs in the past, but sometimes in a false or artificial way
senses.zh: 有民间传统的；有乡土味的；（故作）土里土气的

examples.en: a folky ballad
examples.zh: 一首民谣

senses.def: one of the very small holes in the skin that hair grows from

examples.en: a hair follicle
examples.zh: 毛囊

senses.def: to come or go after or behind somebody/something

examples.en: Follow me please.
examples.zh: 请跟我来。

examples.en: He followed her into the house.
examples.zh: 他跟随她走进房屋。

examples.en: They were followed down the street by a bunch of photographers.
examples.zh: 他们在街上被一群摄影师跟踪。

examples.en: Wherever she led, they followed.
examples.zh: 她引向哪里，他们就跟到哪里。

examples.en: Sam walked in, with the rest of the boys following closely behind.
examples.zh: 萨姆走了进来，其他男孩紧跟其后。

senses.def: to come or go after or behind somebody in order to watch where they go and what they do

examples.en: I think we're being followed.
examples.zh: 我觉得有人跟踪我们。

examples.en: Police followed the car along Station Road where it mounted the kerb again.
examples.zh: 警察沿着车站路跟踪这辆车，然后它又上了路边。

examples.en: As she walked home, she had the feeling she was being followed.
examples.zh: 走回家的路上，她总觉得有人在跟踪她。

senses.def: to come after something/somebody else in time or order; to happen as a result of something else
senses.zh: （时间或顺序上）在…后发生；因…而发生

examples.en: I remember little of the days that followed the accident.
examples.zh: 那次事故以后的日子我记不大清楚了。

examples.en: A period of unrest followed the president's resignation.
examples.zh: 总统辞职之后有一段时期的动荡。

examples.en: The first two classes are followed by a break of ten minutes.
examples.zh: 上完头两节课，有十分钟的课间休息。

examples.en: The main course was followed by fresh fruit.
examples.zh: 主菜以后是新鲜水果。

examples.en: I'll have soup and fish to follow.
examples.zh: 我要汤，然后再来份鱼。

examples.en: A detailed news report will follow shortly.
examples.zh: 下面紧接着是详细的新闻报道。

examples.en: There followed a short silence.
examples.zh: 接着沉默了一会儿。

examples.en: The opening hours are as follows…
examples.zh: 营业时间如下…

examples.en: A new proposal followed on from the discussions.
examples.zh: 讨论之后，出了一个新提案。

examples.en: the workers' revolts that followed in the wake of the student uprising
examples.zh: 发生在学生动乱之后的工人暴动

senses.def: to do something after something else

examples.en: Give your contact details and follow this with a brief profile of yourself.
examples.zh: 给出你的详细联系方式，然后简要介绍一下自己。

examples.en: They follow up their March show with four UK dates next month.
examples.zh: 他们在三月演出以后，就是下个月在英国的四场演出。

senses.def: to accept advice, instructions, etc. and do what you have been told or shown to do
senses.zh: 接受，遵循，听从（忠告、指示等）

examples.en: to follow rules/procedures/guidelines
examples.zh: 遵循规则／程序／指南

examples.en: They said they were just following orders.
examples.zh: 他们说他们只是奉命行事。

examples.en: Follow the instructions very carefully.
examples.zh: 非常仔细地按照说明进行操作。

examples.en: Why didn't you follow my advice?
examples.zh: 你为什么不听我的劝告？

examples.en: Turn right and follow signs to Dundee.
examples.zh: 右转并按照路标前往邓迪。

examples.en: I never follow a recipe completely.
examples.zh: 我从不完全遵循食谱。

examples.en: He followed a strict diet.
examples.zh: 他严格控制饮食。

senses.def: to accept somebody/something as a guide, a leader or an example; to copy somebody/something
senses.zh: 接受…为指导（或领导、榜样）；追随；拥护；仿效

examples.en: I encourage others to follow our example.
examples.zh: 我鼓励其他人仿效我们。

examples.en: The Senate is expected to follow the lead of the House.
examples.zh: 预计参议院将遵循众议院的领导。

examples.en: We believe it is in our best interests to follow the path of economic openness and growth.
examples.zh: 我们相信，走经济开放和增长的道路符合我们的最佳利益。

examples.en: The movie follows the book faithfully.
examples.zh: 这部电影忠于原著。

examples.en: They followed the teachings of Buddha.
examples.zh: 他们信佛教。

examples.en: He always followed the latest fashions (= dressed in fashionable clothes).
examples.zh: 他总是紧跟着服装潮流。

examples.en: Where one airline leads, others follow.
examples.zh: 一家航空公司带头，其他航空公司紧随其后。

examples.en: Laura followed her mother into the medical profession (= became a doctor like her mother).
examples.zh: 劳拉继承母亲的事业当了医生。

senses.def: to click on a link in a website

examples.en: Follow the links to sign up for the webinar.
examples.zh: 点击链接报名参加网络研讨会。

senses.def: to go along a road, path, etc.

examples.en: Follow this road until you get to the school, then turn left.
examples.zh: 沿着这条路走到学校，然后向左拐。

senses.def: to go in the same direction as something or parallel

examples.en: The lane follows the edge of a wood for about a mile.
examples.zh: 小路沿树林边延伸约一英里。

senses.def: to be the logical result of something

examples.en: I don't see how that follows from what you've just said.
examples.zh: 根据你刚才所说的，我不明白怎么会产生那样的结果。

examples.en: Several conclusions follow on from his statement.
examples.zh: 从他的叙述中可以得出一些结论。

examples.en: If a = b and b = c it follows that a = c.
examples.zh: 设 a = b，b = c，则 a = c。

examples.en: It does not necessarily follow that sleep loss would cause these symptoms.
examples.zh: 由此不一定得出失眠会引起这些症状的结论。

senses.def: to understand an explanation or the meaning of something

examples.en: Sorry, I don't follow.
examples.zh: 对不起，我不明白。

examples.en: Do you follow me?
examples.zh: 你听得懂我的话吗？

examples.en: I couldn't really follow his argument.
examples.zh: 我无法真正理解他的论点。

examples.en: The plot is almost impossible to follow.
examples.zh: 故事情节几乎叫人看不懂。

examples.en: to be easy/difficult/hard to follow
examples.zh: 容易/困难/难以遵循

senses.def: to watch or listen to somebody/something very carefully

examples.en: The children were following every word of the story intently.
examples.zh: 孩子们一字不漏地专心听故事。

examples.en: Her eyes followed him everywhere (= she was looking at him all the time).
examples.zh: 她一直在注视着他。

senses.def: to take an active interest in something and be aware of what is happening; to support a sports team
senses.zh: 对…产生浓厚兴趣而关注；支持（某运动队）

examples.en: We've been following this story for months.
examples.zh: 我们已经关注这件事好几个月了。

examples.en: Have you been following the basketball championships?
examples.zh: 你是否一直在关注篮球锦标赛的赛程？

examples.en: Millions of people followed the trial on TV.
examples.zh: 几百万人饶有兴趣地收看了电视转播的审判。

examples.en: In his leisure time he follows West Ham United.
examples.zh: 闲暇时他关注西汉姆联队。

senses.def: to choose to regularly see content from a person, company, etc. using a social media

examples.en: I don’t follow many celebrities on Instagram any more.
examples.zh: 我不再在 Instagram 上关注很多名人了。

senses.def: to be about the life or development of somebody/something

examples.en: The novel follows the fortunes of a village community in Scotland.
examples.zh: 小说叙述了苏格兰一个村落的变迁。

senses.def: to develop or happen in a particular way
senses.zh: 按…方式（或方向）发展；以…方式发生

examples.en: The day followed the usual pattern.
examples.zh: 这一天和平常过得一样。

senses.def: to do the same job, have the same style of life, etc. as somebody else, especially somebody in your family

examples.en: She works in television, following in her father's footsteps.
examples.zh: 她步父亲的后尘，在电视台工作。

examples.en: He wanted to follow in his mother's footsteps and be a ballroom dancer.
examples.zh: 他想象他母亲那样，以跳交际舞为业。

senses.def: to be guided by your sense of smell
to go straight forward

examples.en: The garage is a mile ahead up the hill—just follow your nose.
examples.zh: 汽车修理站在前面一英里处的山坡上，一直往前走就可以到。

senses.def: to act according to what seems right or reasonable, rather than following any particular rules
senses.zh: 凭感觉行事；凭直觉办事

senses.def: to play a card of the same suit
senses.zh: 跟牌（跟着别人出同花色的牌）

senses.def: to act or behave in the way that somebody else has just done
senses.zh: 跟着某人做；仿效某人；照着做

senses.def: a person or event that is so good or successful at something that it will be difficult for anyone/anything else coming after them to be as good or successful
senses.zh: 令人望尘莫及的人；难以企及的事件

examples.en: She has been an excellent principal and will be a hard act to follow.
examples.zh: 她是一位出色的校长，也是一位难以效仿的校长。

examples.en: Their contribution will prove a tough act to follow.
examples.zh: 他们的贡献将被证明是一项艰巨的任务。

senses.def: to do the same job, have the same style of life, etc. as somebody else, especially somebody in your family

examples.zh: 她步父亲的后尘，在电视台工作。

examples.en: He wanted to follow in his mother's footsteps and be a ballroom dancer.

intro.en: These words all mean to know or realize something, for example why something happens, how something works or what something means.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含懂得、理解、认识到之义。

items.def: to know or realize the meaning of words, a language, what somebody says, etc.; to know or realize how or why something happens, how it works or why it is important:
items.zh: 了解；认识到；明了

examples.en: I don’t understand the instructions.
examples.zh: 我不懂这些指令的意思。

items.def: to understand what is happening, what somebody is saying, how something works or how important something is:
items.zh: 指理解、明白、领会（正在发生的事、某人的话、某事如何起作用或重要性如何）

examples.en: ‘It opens like this.’ ‘Oh, I see.’
examples.zh: “这样就打开了。”“哦，我明白了。”

items.def: (informal) to understand a joke, what somebody is trying to tell you, or a situation that they are trying to describe:
items.zh: 指理解、明白（笑话、某人试图告知的事或描述的情况）

examples.en: She didn’t get the joke.
examples.zh: 她听不懂那个笑话。

items.def: to understand an explanation, a story or the meaning of something:
items.zh: 指理解、明白（说明、故事、意思）

examples.en: Sorry—I don’t quite follow.
examples.zh: 对不起，我不太懂你的话。

items.def: to come to understand a fact, an idea or how to do something:
items.zh: 指理解、领会、领悟、明白（事实、想法或如何做某事）

examples.en: They failed to grasp the importance of his words.
examples.zh: 他们没有理解他的话的重要性。

items.def: (often used in negative statements) (formal) to understand a fact, idea or reason:
items.zh: （常用于否定句中）指理解、领悟、明白（事实、想法或原因）

examples.en: The concept of infinity is almost impossible for the human mind to comprehend.
examples.zh: 无穷的概念几乎是人类的大脑无法理解的。

senses.def: to do the same job, have the same style of life, etc. as somebody else, especially somebody in your family
