to go straight forward

examples.en: The garage is a mile ahead up the hill—just follow your nose.
examples.zh: 汽车修理站在前面一英里处的山坡上，一直往前走就可以到。

senses.def: to act according to what seems right or reasonable, rather than following any particular rules
senses.zh: 凭感觉行事；凭直觉办事

senses.def: to keep going with somebody wherever they go

examples.en: Will you stop following me around!
examples.zh: 你不要再到处跟着我了！

senses.def: to keep going with somebody wherever they go

examples.en: Will you stop following me around!
examples.zh: 你不要再到处跟着我了！

senses.def: a children's game in which one player is the 'leader' and the others must do exactly what the leader does, such as jumping, holding out their hands, etc. The phrase is sometimes used to refer to people who do what they are told to do without thinking about it
senses.zh: 学样 (一种儿童游戏，参加者模仿领头人的举动)

examples.en: She warned investors that playing follow-the-leader gets you nowhere.
examples.zh: 她警告投资者，追随领导者不会有任何结果。

senses.def: to go somewhere after somebody else has gone there

examples.en: You go to the beach with the kids and I'll follow on when I've finished work.
examples.zh: 你和孩子们去海滨，我办完事随后就来。

examples.en: You go ahead and we'll follow on later.
examples.zh: 你先走，我们随后就来。

senses.def: to play a second innings
senses.zh: 连打（在第一局得分不足时继续在下一局击球）

senses.def: a second innings
senses.zh: （一局未得到一定分数后的）连打，二局继续击球

senses.def: to come or happen after something and as a result of it

examples.en: My second point follows on from this.
examples.zh: 由此引出我的第二点。

examples.en: The signing of the new contract follows on from a successful sales and distribution agreement.
examples.zh: 新合同的签署是在成功的销售和分销协议之后签署的。

senses.def: a request to see everything that a person, company, etc. posts

examples.en: I've received a lot of follow requests recently.
examples.zh: 最近我收到许多关注请求。

senses.def: a children’s game in which people follow the person in front of them in a line, going wherever they go and copying whatever they do
senses.zh: 学样游戏（参加者模仿领头人的动作）

senses.def: to complete a single movement of the arm when hitting the ball by continuing to move the club, racket
senses.zh: （击球后）完成顺势动作，完成随挥

senses.def: to finish something that you have started
senses.zh: 把…进行到底；完成（开了头的事）

senses.def: the final part of the movement of the arm when hitting the ball after the ball has been hit
the actions that somebody takes in order to complete a plan
senses.zh: （为完成某计划所采取的）后续行动

examples.en: The project could fail if there is inadequate follow-through.
examples.zh: 如果缺少足够的后续行动，该项目可能失败。

senses.def: to add to something that you have just done by doing something else
senses.zh: 对…采取进一步行动；…后接着

examples.en: You should follow up your phone call with an email or a letter.
examples.zh: 你打电话后应该接着发一封电子邮件或写封信。

senses.def: to find out more about something that somebody has told you or suggested to you

examples.en: The police are following up several leads after their TV appeal for information.
examples.zh: 警方在电视上呼吁提供信息后正沿着几条线索继续追查。

senses.def: continuing something that has already started; coming after something similar that was done earlier

examples.en: follow-up treatment at the local hospital
examples.zh: 当地医院后续治疗

examples.en: a follow-up study
examples.zh: 追踪研究

senses.def: an action or a thing that continues something that has already started or comes after something similar that was done earlier

examples.en: The book is a follow-up to her excellent television series.
examples.zh: 这本书是继她的优秀电视系列片之后的又一力作。

examples.en: Despite the success of his last album, there are as yet no plans for any follow-ups.
examples.zh: 尽管他的上一张专辑取得了成功，但目前还没有任何后续专辑的计划。

examples.en: We are planning a follow-up to today's event.
examples.zh: 我们正计划对今天这件事进行追踪报道。

senses.def: a person, company, etc. whose messages on a microblogging

examples.en: None of his current followees are actors.
examples.zh: 他目前的追随者都不是演员。

senses.def: a person who supports and admires a particular person or set of ideas

examples.en: the followers of Mahatma Gandhi
examples.zh: 圣雄甘地的拥护者

senses.def: a person who is very interested in a particular activity and follows all the recent news about it

examples.en: keen followers of football
examples.zh: 足球迷

examples.en: a follower of fashion
examples.zh: 赶时髦者

examples.en: This book is only for the dedicated follower of modernist architecture.
examples.zh: 本书仅供现代主义建筑的忠实追随者阅读。

senses.def: a person who does things after somebody else has done them first

examples.en: She is a leader, not a follower.
examples.zh: 她是领导者，不是追随者。

senses.def: a person who chooses to regularly receive somebody’s messages using a social media
senses.zh: （社交媒体上某人的）关注者，粉丝

examples.en: a celebrity with thousands of followers on X
examples.zh: 在 X 上拥有数千名粉丝的名人

senses.def: a lack of good judgement; the fact of doing something stupid; an activity or idea that shows a lack of judgement
senses.zh: 愚蠢；愚笨；愚蠢的想法（或事情、行为）

examples.en: an act of sheer folly
examples.zh: 纯粹愚蠢的行动

examples.en: Giving up a secure job seems to be the height of folly.
examples.zh: 放弃一份稳定的工作似乎愚蠢至极。

examples.en: It would be folly to turn the offer down.
examples.zh: 拒绝这个建议是愚蠢之举。

examples.en: the follies of youth
examples.zh: 青年时期的愚蠢行为

examples.en: His idealism had been soured by the varied spectacle of human folly.
examples.zh: 他的理想主义因人类愚蠢的各种景象而变质。

senses.def: a building that has no practical purpose but was built in the past for decoration, often in the garden of a large country house
senses.zh: （常见于旧时乡间豪宅花园中的）装饰性建筑

senses.def: to create trouble or violence or make it worse
senses.zh: 挑起，激起，煽动（事端或暴力）

examples.en: They accused him of fomenting political unrest.
examples.zh: 他们指控他煽动政治动乱。

senses.def: fear of missing out
senses.zh: 害怕错过，错失恐惧（担心错过有趣或精彩之事的焦虑情绪）

examples.en: We all live internet lives, and when we see everyone else having more fun than us, we experience anxiety and FOMO.
examples.zh: 我们都过着互联网生活，当我们看到其他人比我们享受更多乐趣时，我们就会感到焦虑和害怕错过。

senses.def: having warm or loving feelings for somebody, especially somebody you have known for a long time
senses.zh: 喜爱（尤指认识已久的人）

examples.en: Over the years, I have grown quite fond of her.
examples.zh: 经过这么多年，我已相当喜欢她了。

examples.en: I’ve always been very fond of your mother.
examples.zh: 我一直非常喜欢你的母亲。

senses.def: finding something pleasant, especially something you have liked or enjoyed for a long time
senses.zh: 喜爱（尤指长期喜爱的事物）

examples.en: fond of music/cooking
examples.zh: 喜好音乐／烹饪

examples.en: We had grown fond of the house and didn't want to leave.
examples.zh: 我们已经喜欢上了这座房子，不想搬家。

senses.def: liking to do something that other people find annoying or unpleasant, and doing it often

examples.en: Sheila's very fond of telling other people what to do.
examples.zh: 希拉爱对别人指手画脚。

examples.en: He's rather too fond of the sound of his own voice (= he talks too much).
examples.zh: 他太爱讲话了。

senses.def: kind and loving

examples.en: a fond look/embrace/farewell
examples.zh: 慈爱的目光；温情的拥抱；深情的告别

examples.en: She waved a fond farewell to her parents and sister.
examples.zh: 她挥手与父母和妹妹深情告别。

examples.en: I have very fond memories of my time in Spain (= I remember it with affection and pleasure).
examples.zh: 我十分怀念从前在西班牙的时光。

senses.def: a hope about something that is not likely to happen

examples.en: I waited all day in the fond hope that she would change her mind.
examples.zh: 我整天等待，痴心地希望她会回心转意。

synonyms.words: like ▪ be fond of somebody ▪ adore ▪ be devoted to somebody ▪ care for somebody ▪ dote on somebody

intro.en: These words all mean to have feelings of liking or caring for somebody.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示喜爱、爱慕、在乎某人。

items.def: to have strong feelings of caring for somebody:
items.zh: 指爱、爱慕

examples.en: I love you.
examples.zh: 我爱你。

items.def: to find somebody pleasant and enjoy being with them:
items.zh: 指喜欢、喜爱

examples.en: She’s nice. I like her.
examples.zh: 她人很好，我喜欢她。

items.def: to have warm or loving feelings for somebody, especially somebody you have known for a long time:
items.zh: 指喜爱（尤指认识已久的人）

examples.en: I’ve always been very fond of your mother.
examples.zh: 我一直非常喜欢你的母亲。

items.def: to love somebody very much:
items.zh: 指热爱、爱慕

examples.en: It’s obvious that she adores him.
examples.zh: 她显然深深地爱着他。

items.def: to love somebody very much and support them in everything:
items.zh: 指深爱、全心全意地支持某人

examples.en: They are devoted to their children.
examples.zh: 他们深爱着自己的孩子。

items.def: to love somebody, especially in a way that is based on a feeling of liking them very much or wanting to protect them, rather than sex:
items.zh: 指深深地爱、非常喜欢，但不指性爱

examples.en: He cared for her more than she realized.
examples.zh: 她不知道他是多么在乎她。

items.def: to feel and show great love for somebody, ignoring their faults:
items.zh: 指溺爱、宠爱、过分喜爱

examples.en: He dotes on his children.
examples.zh: 他溺爱自己的孩子。

synonyms.words: love ▪ be fond of ▪ be keen on something ▪ adore

intro.en: These words all mean to find something pleasant, attractive or of a good enough standard, or to enjoy something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含喜欢、喜爱某事物之义。

items.def: to find something pleasant, attractive or of a good enough standard; to enjoy something:
items.zh: 指喜欢、喜爱

examples.en: Do you like their new house?
examples.zh: 你喜欢他们的新房子吗？

items.def: to like or enjoy something very much:
items.zh: 指非常喜爱、热爱

examples.en: He loved the way she smiled.
examples.zh: 他喜欢她微笑的样子。

items.def: to like or enjoy something, especially something you have liked or enjoyed for a long time:
items.zh: 指喜爱（尤指已爱上很长时间的事物）

examples.en: We were fond of the house and didn’t want to leave.
examples.zh: 我们喜欢上了这座房子，不想搬家。

items.def: (British English英式英语 informal) (often used in negative statements) to like or enjoy something:
items.zh: （常用于否定句）指喜欢、喜爱

examples.en: I’m not keen on spicy food.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢加有香料的食物。

items.def: (informal) to like or enjoy something very much:
items.zh: 指非常喜爱、热爱

examples.en: She adores working with children.
examples.zh: 她热爱参与儿童工作。

senses.def: a thick sweet soft mixture made from sugar and water, used especially to cover cakes
senses.zh: 软糖料（尤用于装饰糕点）

examples.en: fondant icing
examples.zh: 软糖料糖霜

senses.def: a soft sweet that melts in the mouth, made of fondant
to touch and move your hand gently over somebody/something, especially in a sexual way, or in order to show love
senses.zh: （尤指示爱或两性间）爱抚，抚摸

examples.en: He kissed and fondled her face and neck.
examples.zh: 他亲吻并抚摸她的脸庞与脖子。

examples.en: She fondled the dog’s ears affectionately.
examples.zh: 她亲昵地抚摩着那只狗的耳朵。

senses.def: in a way that shows love

examples.en: He looked at her fondly.
examples.zh: 他深情地望着她。

examples.en: I fondly remember my first job as a reporter.
examples.zh: 我深深地记得我初次工作当记者的情景。

examples.en: She is still fondly remembered by her former students.
examples.zh: 她以前的学生仍然十分想念她。

senses.def: in a way that shows hope that is not reasonable or realistic
senses.zh: 天真地；想当然地；一厢情愿地

examples.en: I fondly imagined that you cared for me.
examples.zh: 我天真地以为你很喜欢我。

senses.def: a feeling of love or liking for somebody, especially somebody you have known for a long time
senses.zh: 喜爱（尤指认识已久的人）

examples.en: He will be remembered by the staff with great fondness.
examples.zh: 全体员工都会深深地怀念他。

senses.def: pleasure, especially relating to something you have liked or enjoyed for a long time
senses.zh: 喜爱（尤指长期喜爱的事物）

examples.en: a fondness for animals
examples.zh: 对动物的喜爱

examples.en: It was her father’s fondness for drink that brought about the break-up of her parents’ marriage.
examples.zh: 正是她父亲嗜酒，导致了她父母婚姻的破裂。

senses.def: a Swiss dish of melted cheese and wine into which pieces of bread are dipped
senses.zh: 奶酪火锅（瑞士特色菜，蘸面包片吃）

senses.def: a dish of hot oil into which small pieces of meat, vegetables, etc. are dipped
senses.zh: 热油火锅（在热油中涮肉片、蔬菜等）

senses.def: a large stone bowl in a church that holds water for the ceremony of baptism
senses.zh: 圣洗池（设于教堂中，常为石造）

examples.en: the baptismal font
examples.zh: 洗礼字体

senses.def: the particular size and style of a set of letters that are used in printing, etc.
a space between the bones of a baby’s skull
senses.zh: 囟，囟门（婴儿头顶骨未合缝处）

senses.def: a smooth white food often eaten with soups or stews
senses.zh: 馥馥白糕（将煮熟的芋头或木薯等压碎制成，常与汤或炖菜一起吃）

senses.def: a Chinese dish or sauce made with eggs
senses.zh: 用鸡蛋制成的中国菜或调味酱

senses.def: things that people or animals eat

examples.en: Pat had prepared food and drink for the work party.
examples.zh: 帕特已经为工作聚会准备了食物和饮料。

examples.en: to grow/cook/serve/eat food
examples.zh: 种植/烹饪/提供/吃食物

examples.en: Do you like Italian food?
examples.zh: 你喜欢意大利食物吗？

examples.en: Demand for organic food has been growing fast.
examples.zh: 对有机食品的需求一直在快速增长。

examples.en: Families that eat together consume healthier food.
examples.zh: 一起吃饭的家庭消费更健康的食物。

examples.en: the food industry
examples.zh: 食品工业

examples.en: People worry about food safety (= if food is safe to eat).
examples.zh: 人们担心食品安全。

examples.en: steps to protect the nation's food supply
examples.zh: 保护国家粮食供应的措施

examples.en: Global food shortages and crop failures would have a devastating effect.
examples.zh: 全球粮食短缺和农作物歉收将产生毁灭性影响。

examples.en: baby food (= prepared especially for babies)
examples.zh: 婴儿食品

examples.en: cat/dog/pet food (= for a cat/dog/pet to eat)
examples.zh: 猫粮；狗粮；宠物食品

examples.en: You should eat more fresh foods.
examples.zh: 你应该多吃新鲜食物。

examples.en: The store specializes in frozen foods.
examples.zh: 这家店专营冷冻食品。

senses.def: an idea that makes you think seriously and carefully

examples.en: The programme certainly provides plenty of food for thought.
examples.zh: 该计划确实提供了很多值得深思的内容。

senses.def: not wanting to eat anything

examples.en: He's been off his food all week.
examples.zh: 他一整个星期都没有食欲。

senses.def: an idea that makes you think seriously and carefully

examples.en: The programme certainly provides plenty of food for thought.
examples.zh: 该计划确实提供了很多值得深思的内容。

senses.def: not wanting to eat anything

examples.en: He's been off his food all week.
examples.zh: 他一整个星期都没有食欲。

senses.def: an idea that makes you think seriously and carefully

examples.en: The programme certainly provides plenty of food for thought.
examples.zh: 该计划确实提供了很多值得深思的内容。

senses.def: a place where people in need can go to get free food
senses.zh: 食物银行，食品银行（供贫困人士免费领取食物）

examples.en: Half a million people have visited food banks since April.
examples.zh: 自四月以来，已有五十万人访问过食品银行。

senses.def: an organization that stores basic food supplies for distribution to people in need. The food is often passed on to local food pantries
senses.zh: 食物赈济处，食品救济所（统筹食物供应并发放给地方分发站，再供人领取）

examples.en: All food collected will go to local food banks and pantries.
examples.zh: 所有收集到的食物将送往当地的食物银行和食品储藏室。

senses.def: a series of living creatures in which each type of creature feeds on the one below it in the series

examples.en: Insects are fairly low down (on) the food chain.
examples.zh: 在食物链中，昆虫是级别相当低的生物。

examples.en: Pesticides work their way up the food chain from plants, through insects and birds to humans.
examples.zh: 农药沿着食物链从植物开始，经过昆虫和鸟类，到达人类。

examples.en: efforts to ensure that dioxins do not enter the food chain
examples.zh: 为确保二恶英不进入食物链的努力

senses.def: a system or structure in which the people or organizations that are part of it are seen as having different levels of importance, success, etc.
senses.zh: 食物链：一个系统或结构，其中的人员或组织被视为具有不同程度的重要性，成功等。

examples.en: These guys are at the top of the food chain when it comes to earnings.
examples.zh: 就收入而言，这些人处于食物链的顶端。

senses.def: the series of stages that food passes along as it goes from being grown or produced to being sold and then eaten
senses.zh: 食物链（食品从生产、销售到食用的各个阶段）

examples.en: They are focused on ensuring that contaminated crops do not enter the food chain.
examples.zh: 他们的重点是确保受污染的农作物不会进入食物链。

senses.def: an area in a shopping centre or public building where there are several small restaurants around a central area with tables and chairs

examples.en: I grabbed a bite to eat at the mall's food court.
examples.zh: 我在商场的美食广场随便吃了点东西。

senses.def: of a quality that is good enough to be used for the production of food
senses.zh: 食品级的（指制造食品所用的材料符合安全标准）

examples.en: The entire production line is made of high-quality, food-grade stainless steel.
examples.zh: 整个生产线是用高质量食品級的不锈钢制成的。

senses.def: any one of the categories of foods that share similar characteristics in terms of how they affect the health of the human body
senses.zh: 食物组（具有相似营养特性而被归为一类的食物）

examples.en: The five basic food groups are meat, milk, fruit, vegetables and carbohydrates.
examples.zh: 五大基础食物组是肉、奶、水果、蔬菜和碳水化合物。

examples.en: Choose a variety of foods from each major food group.
examples.zh: 从每个主要食物组中选择多种食物。

senses.def: a large area in a department store
senses.zh: 食堂：百货商店中可以购买食物的大面积区域

examples.en: Selfridge's food hall in London was selling several varieties of French apples.
examples.zh: 伦敦塞尔弗里奇的食品大厅出售多种法国苹果。

senses.def: the state of not having reliable access to enough healthy food that you can afford
senses.zh: 粮食短缺（指无法取得足够维持健康的食物）

examples.en: Households that experience food insecurity have reduced quality or variety of meals.
examples.zh: 经历粮食不安全的家庭的膳食质量或种类有所下降。

examples.en: It is estimated 64 per cent of the population is already exposed to chronic food insecurity.
examples.zh: 据估计，64%的人口已经面临长期粮食不安全的问题。

senses.def: a measurement of the distance food has to be transported from the producer to the consumer and the fuel that this uses
senses.zh: 食物里程（指食物从产地运送到消费者手中的距离及油耗）

examples.en: We keep food miles to a minimum by sourcing products locally.
examples.zh: 我们在当地采购产品，从而将食物里程控制在最低。

examples.en: the campaign to reduce food miles
examples.zh: 减少食物里程的运动

senses.def: an organization that gives food to poor people who live in a particular area. Food pantries
senses.zh: 食品分发站（给当地贫困人口发放食品救济的组织）

examples.en: The proceeds from the sale will support the church's food pantry.
examples.zh: 出售的收益将用于支持教堂的食品储藏室。

senses.def: a small collection of basic food items given to people in need
senses.zh: 为有需要的人提供的一小部分基本食品

examples.en: Aid workers have been distributing food parcels, clothing and blankets.
examples.zh: 援助人员一直在分发食品包、衣物和毯子。

senses.def: an illness of the stomach caused by eating food that contains harmful bacteria
images that show food in a way that makes it look very attractive
senses.zh: 看上去让人垂涎欲滴的图片

examples.en: Looking at food porn online tends to make you feel very hungry.
examples.zh: 在线观看食物色情内容往往会让您感到非常饥饿。

examples.en: Many foodies are food porn addicts.
examples.zh: 许多美食家都是食物色情成瘾者。

senses.def: a piece of equipment that is used to mix or cut up food
senses.zh: 食物料理机；食物加工器

examples.en: Blend the egg yolks, lemon juice and herbs in a food processor.
examples.zh: 用食品加工机将蛋黄、柠檬汁和香草混合在一起。

senses.def: the scientific study of food, for example what it is made of, the effects it has on our body, and how to prepare it and store it safely
senses.zh: 食品科学（研究食品成分、对身体的作用及加工和贮存方法等）

senses.def: the state of having reliable access to enough healthy food that you can afford
senses.zh: 粮食安全（指可取得足够维持健康的食物）

examples.en: The minister said that the proposed changes to the agriculture sector would ensure food security in the country.
examples.zh: 该部长表示，拟议的农业部门改革将确保该国的粮食安全。

senses.def: a piece of paper that is given by the government to people on low income, which they can exchange for food
senses.zh: （政府发给低收入者的）食物券

examples.en: Low-income families receive food stamps to purchase food.
examples.zh: 低收入家庭获得食品券来购买食品。

senses.def: an expert in food technology

examples.en: Food technologists work to help develop healthy, safe and convenient food products.
examples.zh: 食品技术专家致力于帮助开发健康、安全和方便的食品。

senses.def: the use of food science

examples.en: Singapore is a world leader in food technology.
examples.zh: 新加坡是世界食品技术领域的领导者。

examples.en: She has a degree in Food Technology.
examples.zh: 她拥有食品技术学位。

senses.def: a large vehicle with facilities for cooking and selling food
senses.zh: （烹饪并出售食品的）快餐车，美食车

examples.en: The arrival of gourmet food trucks has transformed the street food scene in the city.
examples.zh: 美食车的到来改变了城市的街头美食场景。

senses.def: a system of food chains
senses.zh: 食物网（即相互关联和依存的食物链体系）

examples.en: What part does bacteria have to play in the food web?
examples.zh: 细菌在食物网中扮演什么角色？

senses.def: a person who is very interested in cooking and eating different kinds of food
having or showing great interest in cooking and eating different kinds of food

examples.en: a foodie blog
examples.zh: 美食博客

examples.en: I was trying to upload a batch of foodie stuff for my cookery group.
examples.zh: 我试图为我的烹饪小组上传一批美食。

senses.def: any substance that is used as food

examples.en: basic foodstuffs
examples.zh: 基本食物

examples.en: Cross-border trade in foodstuffs and consumer goods is increasing.
examples.zh: 食品和消费品的跨境贸易不断增加。

examples.en: Rationing of basic foodstuffs was introduced.
examples.zh: 开始实施基本食物配给制。

senses.def: a person who is very interested in cooking and eating different kinds of food
a person who you think behaves or speaks in a way that lacks intelligence or good judgement

examples.en: Don't be such a fool!
examples.zh: 别这么傻了！

examples.en: I felt a fool when I realized my mistake.
examples.zh: 我意识到了自己的错误，觉得自己是个傻瓜。

examples.en: He told me he was an actor and I was fool enough to believe him.
examples.zh: 他告诉我他是演员，而我真傻，竟相信了他的话。

senses.def: (in the past) a man employed by a king or queen to entertain people by telling jokes, singing songs, etc.
senses.zh: （旧时国王或王后豢养供人娱乐的）小丑，弄臣

examples.en: court fools who used to provide entertainment in the royal court
examples.zh: 旧时在皇宫里逗乐的宫廷小丑

senses.def: a cold light dessert
senses.zh: 奶油果泥，蛋奶果泥（甜食）

examples.en: rhubarb fool
examples.zh: 奶油大黄泥

senses.def: to behave in a stupid way in order to make people laugh, especially in a way that may also annoy them
senses.zh: 装傻，扮丑相（以逗人笑，但往往惹人恼怒）

examples.en: Quit playing the fool and get some work done!
examples.zh: 别再装傻了，干点实事吧！

senses.def: used to say that something is very easy to do

examples.en: Any fool could tell she was lying.
examples.zh: 任何人都可以看出她在撒谎。

senses.def: to be too intelligent or know too much about something to be tricked by other people

examples.en: She's nobody's fool when it comes to dealing with difficult patients.
examples.zh: 她对付难缠的病人很有办法。

examples.en: She's nobody's fool. She had the car checked by a mechanic before buying it.
examples.zh: 她才不会受骗呢，买车之前就找机修工检查过了。

senses.def: a person who is not sensible usually spends money too quickly or carelessly, or is cheated by others
senses.zh: 傻瓜口袋漏，有钱留不住；蠢人不积财

senses.def: people with little experience try to do the difficult or dangerous things that more experienced people would not consider doing
to say or do something deliberately so that people will think that somebody is stupid

examples.en: Can't you see she's making a fool of you?
examples.zh: 难道你不明白她是在愚弄你？

examples.en: I will not be made a fool of like this.
examples.zh: 我不会被这样愚弄的。

examples.en: She was angry at having been made a fool of.
examples.zh: 她因为被愚弄而感到生气。

senses.def: to do something stupid that makes other people think that you are a fool

examples.en: I made a complete fool of myself in front of everyone!
examples.zh: 我当众出了大丑了！

senses.def: used to say that you think that somebody was stupid to do something, especially when it causes them problems

examples.en: ‘Someone's bumped my car!’ ‘More fool you for parking it there.’
examples.zh: “有人撞了我的车！”“你把车停在那里，真是太愚弄了。”

examples.en: ‘I know I shouldn’t have given him the money, but I did.’ ‘More fool you!’
examples.zh: “我知道我不应该给他钱，但我还是给了他。”“更骗你了！”

examples.en: I thought it was safe to leave my suitcase there. More fool me.
examples.zh: 我还以为把我的手提箱放在那儿是很安全的，我真是太傻了。

senses.def: an older person who behaves in a stupid way is worse than a younger person who does the same thing, because experience should have taught him or her not to do it
senses.zh: 糊涂莫过老糊涂；老糊涂最糊涂

senses.def: to be very impatient with people that you think are stupid
senses.zh: 不愿迁就笨人；不能容忍愚蠢者

examples.en: She was a forceful personality who didn't suffer fools gladly.
examples.zh: 她是一个性格坚强的人，不乐意受愚弄。

senses.def: to trick somebody into believing something that is not true

examples.en: You don't fool me!
examples.zh: 不要骗我！

examples.en: She certainly had me fooled—I really believed her!
examples.zh: 她确实把我骗了，我真的相信了她的话！

examples.en: You're fooling yourself if you think none of this will affect you.
examples.zh: 你要是认为此事一点也不会影响你，那就是欺骗自己。

examples.en: Don't be fooled into thinking they're going to change anything.
examples.zh: 别上当受骗，以为他们打算作出任何改变。

senses.def: to say or do stupid or silly things, often in order to make people laugh
senses.zh: 说蠢话，干傻事（常为逗乐）

examples.en: Stop fooling around and sit down!
examples.zh: 别干傻事了，坐下来！

examples.en: If you fool about with matches, you'll end up getting burned.
examples.zh: 如果你玩火柴，最后可能烧到自己。

senses.def: used to say that you do not believe something that somebody has just told you
senses.zh: （表示不相信别人的话）休想骗我，说得像真的一样

examples.en: ‘I'm trying as hard as I can!’ ‘You could have fooled me!’
examples.zh: “我要尽力而为！”“说得像真的似的！”

senses.def: showing a lack of intelligence or good judgement

examples.en: That was a damn fool thing to do!
examples.zh: 干那种事真蠢！

examples.en: That fool husband of mine locked us out of the house.
examples.zh: 我那个愚蠢的丈夫把我们锁在门外。

senses.def: to behave in a stupid way in order to make people laugh, especially in a way that may also annoy them
senses.zh: 装傻，扮丑相（以逗人笑，但往往惹人恼怒）

examples.en: Quit playing the fool and get some work done!
examples.zh: 别再装傻了，干点实事吧！

senses.def: used to say that something is very easy to do

examples.en: Any fool could tell she was lying.
examples.zh: 任何人都可以看出她在撒谎。

senses.def: to be too intelligent or know too much about something to be tricked by other people

examples.en: She's nobody's fool when it comes to dealing with difficult patients.
examples.zh: 她对付难缠的病人很有办法。

examples.en: She's nobody's fool. She had the car checked by a mechanic before buying it.
examples.zh: 她才不会受骗呢，买车之前就找机修工检查过了。

items.idm: a fool and his money are soon parted

senses.def: a person who is not sensible usually spends money too quickly or carelessly, or is cheated by others
senses.zh: 傻瓜口袋漏，有钱留不住；蠢人不积财

items.idm: fools rush in (where angels fear to tread)

examples.en: I thought it was safe to leave my suitcase there. More fool me.

senses.zh: 糊涂莫过老糊涂；老糊涂最糊涂

synonyms.words: fool ▪ deceive ▪ betray ▪ take in ▪ trick ▪ con

intro.en: These words all mean to make somebody believe something that is not true, especially in order to get what you want.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含使人误信之义，尤指有目的地这样做。

items.def: to make somebody believe something that is not true, in order to get money or something else from them:
items.zh: 指为得到钱财或其他东西而欺骗、欺诈

examples.en: She is accused of attempting to cheat the taxman.
examples.zh: 她被指控企图蒙骗税务员。

items.def: to make somebody believe something that is not true, especially in order to laugh at them or to get what you want:
items.zh: 指蒙骗、愚弄

examples.en: Just don’t be fooled into investing any money with them.
examples.zh: 别上当受骗，同他们一起搞什么投资。

items.def: to make somebody believe something that is not true, especially somebody who trusts you, in order to get what you want:
items.zh: 尤指利用别人的信任欺骗、蒙骗、诓骗

examples.en: She deceived him into handing over all his savings.
examples.zh: 她把他所有的积蓄都骗走了。

items.def: to hurt somebody who trusts you, especially by lying to or about them or telling their secrets to other people:
items.zh: 指辜负别人的信任、出卖

examples.en: She felt betrayed when she found out the truth about him.
examples.zh: 她发现他的真实情况时，感到受了欺骗。

items.def: [often passive] to make somebody believe something that is not true, usually in order to get what you want:
items.zh: 指为个人目的而欺骗、蒙骗

examples.en: I was taken in by her story.
examples.zh: 我被她的花言巧语蒙骗了。

items.def: to make somebody believe something that is not true, especially in a clever way, in order to get what you want.
items.zh: 尤指以巧妙的方式欺骗、欺诈

items.def: (informal) to make somebody believe something that is not true, especially in order to get money from them or get them to do something for you:
items.zh: 尤指为获取钱财或使人为自己做事而欺骗、哄骗、诈骗

examples.en: They had been conned out of £100 000.
examples.zh: 他们被骗走了 10 万英镑。

fool and his money are soon parted: @@@LINK=a fool and his money are soon parted

senses.def: to waste time instead of doing something that you should be doing
to have a sexual relationship with another person’s partner; to have a sexual relationship with somebody who is not your partner

examples.en: She's been fooling around with a married man.
examples.zh: 她一直和一个有妇之夫鬼混。

senses.def: a task that has no hope of being done successfully

examples.en: He sent me on a fool's errand.
examples.zh: 他派我去干白费力的事。

senses.def: a yellow mineral found in rock, which looks like gold but is not valuable, also called iron pyrites
something that you think is valuable or will earn you a lot of money, but which has no chance of succeeding
a state of happiness that is based on something that is false or cannot last although the happy person does not realize it
senses.zh: 傻瓜的天堂；虚幻的幸福

examples.en: Anyone who thinks there’s an easy solution to the problem is living in a fool’s paradise.
examples.zh: 任何认为问题有简单解决办法的人都生活在愚人的天堂里。

senses.def: behaviour in which you take unnecessary risks

examples.en: There’s no excuse for such foolhardiness—you could have been killed.
examples.zh: 这种鲁莽行为是没有任何借口的——你可能会被杀。

examples.en: He showed his usual disregard for danger—an attitude his friends called bravery and his enemies foolhardiness.
examples.zh: 他表现出了一贯的对危险的漠视——他的朋友们称这种态度为勇敢，而他的敌人则称其为鲁莽。

senses.def: taking unnecessary risks

examples.en: It would be foolhardy to sail in weather like this.
examples.zh: 这种天气出航就是瞎冒险。

senses.def: not showing good sense or judgement

examples.en: There are some very foolish people out there.
examples.zh: 那里有一些非常愚蠢的人。

examples.en: I was foolish enough to believe what Jeff told me.
examples.zh: 我真蠢，竟相信杰夫和我说的话。

examples.en: The accident was my fault—it would be foolish to pretend otherwise.
examples.zh: 这次事故是我的过失，装作没有责任那才傻呢。

examples.en: How could she have been so foolish as to fall in love with him?
examples.zh: 她怎么这么傻，竟爱上了他？

examples.en: a foolish idea/dream/mistake
examples.zh: 荒唐的想法／梦／错误

examples.en: It was a very foolish thing to do.
examples.zh: 干那种事很蠢。

senses.def: made to feel or look silly and embarrassed
senses.zh: 不知所措；出丑；显得尴尬

examples.en: I felt foolish and a failure.
examples.zh: 我自觉是个愚蠢的失败者。

examples.en: He's afraid of looking foolish in front of his friends.
examples.zh: 他怕在朋友面前出丑。

senses.def: in a way that shows a lack of good sense or judgement

examples.en: We foolishly thought that everyone would speak English.
examples.zh: 我们愚蠢地以为所有人都将说英语。

examples.en: Foolishly, I allowed myself to be persuaded to enter the contest.
examples.zh: 我竟傻乎乎地让人说服去参加比赛。

senses.def: behaviour that shows a lack of good sense or judgement

examples.en: Jenny had to laugh at her own foolishness.
examples.zh: 珍妮只能嘲笑自己蠢。

senses.def: very well designed and easy to use so that it cannot fail and you cannot use it wrongly
senses.zh: 使用简便的；完全可靠的；万无一失的

examples.en: This recipe is foolproof—it works every time.
examples.zh: 这个食谱绝对管用，每次都万无一失。

examples.en: No system can ever be completely foolproof.
examples.zh: 任何系统都不可能是完全万无一失的。

examples.en: The system is virtually foolproof.
examples.zh: 这个系统几乎人人都会用。

examples.en: We’re trying to work out a way to make the system foolproof.
examples.zh: 我们正努力想办法使这个系统简单易操作。

fools rush in: @@@LINK=fools rush in (where angels fear to tread)

senses.def: people with little experience try to do the difficult or dangerous things that more experienced people would not consider doing

fools rush in where angels fear to tread: @@@LINK=fools rush in (where angels fear to tread)

senses.def: a large size of paper for writing on
an indoor game for two people or teams, played by moving rows of small models of football (soccer) players in order to move a ball on a board that has marks like a football (soccer) field

examples.en: Thousands of people play foosball in tournaments.
examples.zh: 成千上万的人在锦标赛中玩桌上足球。

examples.en: Two men were playing foosball at the other end of the bar.
examples.zh: 两个男人正在酒吧的另一端玩桌上足球。

examples.en: You can rent a coin-operated foosball table.
examples.zh: 您可以租用投币式足球桌。

senses.def: the lowest part of the leg, below the ankle, on which a person or an animal stands

examples.en: My feet are aching.
examples.zh: 我的脚疼。

examples.en: She kicked the ball with her right foot.
examples.zh: 她用右脚把球踢出去。

examples.en: He's broken several bones in his left foot.
examples.zh: 他左脚断了几根骨头。

examples.en: The whole audience rose to its feet (= stood up) and cheered.
examples.zh: 全场观众起立欢呼。

examples.en: to leap/jump/spring to your feet (= to stand up quickly and easily)
examples.zh: 一下子站起来

examples.en: to scramble/struggle/stagger to your feet (= to stand up slowly and with difficulty)
examples.zh: 爬行/挣扎/摇摇晃晃地站起来（=缓慢而困难地站起来）

examples.en: We came on foot (= we walked).
examples.zh: 我们是走路来的。

examples.en: I've been on my feet (= standing or walking around) all day.
examples.zh: 我一整天没歇脚。

examples.en: Come on lads—on your feet and do some work!
examples.zh: 来吧，小伙子们——站起来，做一些工作！

examples.en: walking around the house in bare feet (= not wearing shoes or socks)
examples.zh: 赤脚在房子里走来走去

examples.en: We were stamping our feet (= hitting them on the ground) to keep warm.
examples.zh: 我们跺脚取暖。

examples.en: Please wipe your feet (= your shoes) on the mat.
examples.zh: 请在垫子上蹭一蹭脚。

examples.en: The hot sand burned the soles of my feet.
examples.zh: 滚烫的沙子灼伤了我的脚底。

examples.en: He is currently resting a foot injury.
examples.zh: 他脚部受伤，目前正在休养。

examples.en: a foot pump (= operated using your foot, not your hand)
examples.zh: 脚踏泵

examples.en: a foot passenger (= one who travels on a ferry without a car)
examples.zh: 步行旅客（无车上渡船者）

senses.group: part of body 身体部位

senses.def: having or using the type or number of foot/feet mentioned
senses.zh: 有…脚（或足的）；有…只脚（的）；用…脚（或足的）

examples.en: bare-footed
examples.zh: 赤脚的

examples.en: four-footed
examples.zh: 四足的

examples.en: a left-footed shot into the corner
examples.zh: 踢入球门一角的左脚一记射门

senses.def: the part of a sock, stocking
senses.group: part of sock 袜子部分

senses.def: a unit for measuring length equal to 12 inches or 30.48 centimetres
senses.zh: 英尺（= 12 英寸或 30.48 厘米）

examples.en: a six-foot high wall
examples.zh: 六英尺高的墙

examples.en: We're flying at 35 000 feet.
examples.zh: 我们在 35 000 英尺高空飞行。

examples.en: ‘How tall are you?’ ‘Five foot nine (= five feet and nine inches).’
examples.zh: “你多高？”“五英尺九英寸。”

examples.en: The town was under several feet of water (= the water was several feet deep).
examples.zh: 这座城镇的积水有几英尺深。

examples.en: We had over a foot of snow in a few hours (= the snow was over a foot deep).
examples.zh: 几个小时内我们的积雪就超过了一英尺（=雪深超过一英尺）。

examples.en: The store has 600 square feet of retail space.
examples.zh: 这家店有 600 平方英尺的零售面积。

senses.def: the lowest part of something; the base or bottom of something

examples.en: The city now reaches to the foot of the surrounding mountains.
examples.zh: 现在，该城市已经延伸到周边山脉的山脚下。

examples.en: At the foot of the stairs she turned to face him.
examples.zh: 她在楼梯底转过身来面对着他。

examples.en: See the foot of this page for a partial bibliography.
examples.zh: 部分参考书目请参见本页底部。

examples.en: The team remains stuck at the foot of the table (= with fewer points than all the other teams).
examples.zh: 该队的积分仍然垫底。

senses.def: the further or lower end of something

examples.en: The nurse hung a chart at the foot of the bed (= the part of the bed where your feet normally are when you are lying in it).
examples.zh: 护士在床尾挂了一张表。

examples.en: He sat at the foot of the table.
examples.zh: 他坐在桌子末端。

senses.def: a unit of rhythm in a line of poetry containing one stressed syllable and one or more syllables without stress. Each of the four divisions in the following line is a foot
senses.zh: 音步（诗行中的节奏单位，每个音步中有一个重读音节）

examples.en: For men / may come / and men / may go.
examples.zh: （此诗行四个部分有四个音步）

senses.def: to be extremely busy; to have too many things to do
senses.zh: 忙得不可开交；要做太多的事

examples.en: Weekdays are slow in the restaurant, but at weekends the staff are rushed off their feet.
examples.zh: 工作日餐厅里的生意很慢，但周末员工们却忙得不可开交。

senses.def: to tie somebody’s hands and feet together so that they cannot move or escape
to prevent somebody from doing what they want by creating rules, limits, etc.
senses.zh: 捆住某人手脚（比喻用条条框框限制）

senses.def: used to say that a situation has changed so that somebody now has power or authority over the person who used to have power or authority over them
senses.zh: 位子掉过来了；宾主易位

senses.def: to suddenly cause somebody’s idea or plan to fail by doing something to stop them from continuing with it
senses.zh: 挖某人的墙脚；破坏某人的计划；拆某人的台

senses.def: to be deliberately slow in doing something or in making a decision
senses.zh: 故意拖拉；故意延迟（作出决定）

senses.def: to be lucky in finding yourself in a good situation, or in getting out of a difficult situation
senses.zh: 特别走运；安然脱离困境；幸免于难

examples.en: You landed on your feet, getting such a well-paid job with so little experience.
examples.zh: 你站稳了脚跟，在经验很少的情况下得到了一份高薪工作。

examples.en: Jim’s always getting himself in trouble, but he usually seems to fall on his feet.
examples.zh: 吉姆总是给自己惹麻烦，但他似乎总是能站稳脚跟。

senses.def: with your feet touching the ground before any other part of your body

examples.en: He landed feet first.
examples.zh: 他落地时双脚先着地。

senses.def: if you leave a place feet first

examples.en: You'll have to carry me out feet first!
examples.zh: 想把我撵走，除非让我横着出去！

senses.def: to become able to act independently and with confidence
senses.zh: 已能独立而有信心地工作；已适应新环境

examples.en: I only recently joined the firm so I'm still finding my feet.
examples.zh: 我最近才加入这家公司，所以还在适应过程中。

senses.def: a strong way of saying that you disagree completely with what has just been said
senses.zh: （完全不同意对方所说）胡说八道

examples.en: ‘Ian can't come because he's tired.’ ‘Tired my foot! Lazy more like!’
examples.zh: “伊恩不能来，因为他累了。”“累个屁！说懒还差不多！”

senses.def: covering your whole body

examples.en: We were covered from head to foot in mud.
examples.zh: 我们浑身是泥。

examples.en: She was dressed from head to toe in red.
examples.zh: 她从头到脚都是红色的。

senses.def: to suddenly become nervous about doing something that you had planned to do

examples.en: He was going to ask her but he got cold feet and said nothing.
examples.zh: 他本来是想问她的，可事到临头他却胆怯得什么也没有说。

senses.def: to start doing something that is new for you
senses.zh: 初次涉足；开始做（新鲜的事情）

examples.en: At that time he was a young actor, just getting his feet wet.
examples.zh: 那时他还是个年轻演员，才初出茅庐。

senses.def: to manage to enter an organization, a field of business, etc. that could bring you success
senses.zh: 设法加入，涉足（某组织、行业等）

examples.en: I always wanted to work in TV but it took me two years to get a foot in the door.
examples.zh: 我一直想做电视工作，但花了两年才进了这个圈子。

senses.def: to want to travel or move to a different place; to want to do something different
senses.zh: 渴望旅行（或换个地方、做别的事）

examples.en: After a few years in one place, I get itchy feet.
examples.zh: 在一个地方待了几年后，我的脚开始发痒。

senses.def: to start a relationship well/badly

examples.en: I seem to have got off on the wrong foot with the new boss.
examples.zh: 看来我和新老板的关系一开头就不好。

senses.def: to have a fault or weakness in your character

examples.en: When the actor was imprisoned for drug offences, his fans were upset to find that their hero had feet of clay.
examples.zh: 当这位演员因吸毒被捕入狱时，他的粉丝们发现他们崇拜的英雄竟然也有不为人知的缺点，感到非常失望。

senses.def: to have a sensible and realistic attitude to life

examples.en: In spite of his overnight stardom he still manages to keep his feet on the ground.
examples.zh: 尽管一夜成名，他仍然脚踏实地。

senses.def: to be involved in or connected with two different groups, especially ones that oppose each other
to be so old or ill that you are not likely to live much longer
senses.zh: 行将就木；命不久矣；大去之期不远

senses.def: to be very awkward
senses.zh: （尤指跳舞或体育运动时）非常笨拙，笨手笨脚

senses.def: to be very successful and admired
wearing socks or stockings
to not delay in getting things done
(to put somebody) at a disadvantage or in difficulty
senses.zh: （使某人）陷入不利局面，处于困境

examples.en: Advances in drone technology have caught lawmakers on the back foot.
examples.zh: 无人机技术的进步教立法者措手不及。

examples.en: The side that’s on the back foot, struggling to defend, will usually give away more penalties.
examples.zh: 处于劣势、防守困难的一方通常会判罚更多的点球。

examples.en: We'd like to put the fossil fuel industry on the back foot.
examples.zh: 我们想让化石燃料行业处于不利地位。

senses.def: completely well or in a normal state again after an illness or a time of trouble
senses.zh: （困境后）恢复，完全复原；（病后）痊愈

examples.en: Sue's back on her feet again after her operation.
examples.zh: 休手术后又恢复健康了。

examples.en: The new chairman hopes to get the company back on its feet within six months.
examples.zh: 新董事长希望在六个月以内使公司恢复元气。

senses.def: at an advantage

examples.en: They allowed the home side to get on the front foot right at the start.
examples.zh: 他们让主队一开始就占据了先机。

senses.def: taking positive steps to achieve something

examples.en: He has been firmly on the front foot, calling for politicians and police to intervene.
examples.zh: 他一直坚定地站在前线，呼吁政界人士和警察进行干预。

senses.def: a way of referring to children when somebody wants, or is going to have, a baby
senses.zh: （用于想要或即将有孩子时）小宝宝的脚步声

examples.en: We can't wait to hear the patter of tiny feet.
examples.zh: 我们恨不得早点儿有个小宝宝。

senses.def: to take help or support away from somebody suddenly
to make a great effort to do something, especially if it is difficult or you are feeling tired
to sit down and relax, especially with your feet raised and supported

examples.en: After a hard day's work, it's nice to get home and put your feet up.
examples.zh: 辛劳一天后回家架起双腿休息是很惬意的。

senses.def: to be very strict in opposing what somebody wishes to do

examples.en: You've got to put your foot down and make him stop seeing her.
examples.zh: 你得坚决制止他再见她。

senses.def: to drive faster

examples.en: She put her foot down and roared past them.
examples.zh: 她猛踩油门，从他们旁边呼啸而过。

senses.def: to say or do something that upsets, offends or embarrasses
senses.zh: （在语言或行为上）使人不安，冒犯别人，使人尴尬

examples.en: I really put my foot in it with Ella—I didn't know she'd split up with Tom.
examples.zh: 我真的冒犯了埃拉，我不知道她和汤姆分手了。

senses.def: to make a mistake

examples.en: In the last two games he has hardly put a foot wrong.
examples.zh: 他在上两局比赛中几乎一点错都没有出。

senses.def: to enter or visit a place

examples.en: the first man to set foot on the moon
examples.zh: 第一个登上月球的人

examples.en: I vowed never to set foot in the place again.
examples.zh: 我发誓再不去那个地方了。

senses.def: to make somebody/something independent or successful

examples.en: His business sense helped set the club on its feet again.
examples.zh: 他的经营意识使俱乐部又重振雄风。

senses.def: to do or say something that will cause you a lot of trouble or harm, especially when you are trying to get an advantage for yourself
to admire somebody very much, especially a teacher or somebody that you try to learn from
to be independent and able to take care of yourself

examples.en: When his parents died he had to learn to stand on his own two feet.
examples.zh: 他的父母去世后他不得不学会自立。

senses.def: to make somebody fall suddenly and deeply in love with you
senses.zh: 使某人立刻迷上自己；使某人对自己一见倾心

examples.en: She’s waiting for some hero to come and sweep her off her feet.
examples.zh: 她正在等待某个英雄的到来，让她神魂颠倒。

senses.def: to sit down and rest, especially when you are tired
senses.zh: （尤指疲乏时）坐下歇歇脚，坐下喘口气

examples.en: Come and sit down and take the weight off your feet for a while.
examples.zh: 来坐下歇一会儿吧。

senses.def: to be able to think and react to things very quickly and effectively without any preparation
in the way; stopping you from working, etc.
senses.zh: 阻碍，妨碍（工作等）；碍手碍脚

examples.en: I don't want you kids under my feet while I'm cooking.
examples.zh: 我做饭时不希望你们这些孩子在我这儿碍手碍脚的。

senses.def: to show what you think about something by going or not going somewhere
senses.zh: 用脚投票（用去或不去某处表示想法）

examples.en: Shoppers voted with their feet and avoided the store.
examples.zh: 购物者对那家商店避而远之。

senses.def: to take care of somebody’s needs so well that they do not have to do anything for themselves
senses.zh: 过分照顾；让…饭来张口，衣来伸手

examples.en: He seems to expect me to wait on him hand and foot.
examples.zh: 他似乎希望我全心全意地伺候他。

senses.def: to make somebody walk so far or so fast that they are very tired

examples.en: I hope I haven’t walked you off your feet.
examples.zh: 希望我没有让你累坏了。

senses.def: to be responsible for paying the cost of something

examples.en: Once again it will be the taxpayer who has to foot the bill.
examples.zh: 这一次掏腰包的又得是纳税人。

examples.en: Who will be footing the bill for the party?
examples.zh: 谁将为派对买单？

senses.def: to be extremely busy; to have too many things to do
senses.zh: 忙得不可开交；要做太多的事

examples.en: Weekdays are slow in the restaurant, but at weekends the staff are rushed off their feet.
examples.zh: 工作日餐厅里的生意很慢，但周末员工们却忙得不可开交。

to prevent somebody from doing what they want by creating rules, limits, etc.
senses.zh: 捆住某人手脚（比喻用条条框框限制）

examples.zh: 我一直想做电视工作，但花了两年才进了这个圈子。

senses.def: to want to travel or move to a different place; to want to do something different
senses.zh: 渴望旅行（或换个地方、做别的事）

examples.en: After a few years in one place, I get itchy feet.
examples.zh: 在一个地方待了几年后，我的脚开始发痒。

items.idm: get/start off on the right/wrong foot (with somebody)

senses.def: to start a relationship well/badly

examples.en: I seem to have got off on the wrong foot with the new boss.
examples.zh: 看来我和新老板的关系一开头就不好。

senses.def: to have a fault or weakness in your character

examples.en: When the actor was imprisoned for drug offences, his fans were upset to find that their hero had feet of clay.
examples.zh: 当这位演员因吸毒被捕入狱时，他的粉丝们发现他们崇拜的英雄竟然也有不为人知的缺点，感到非常失望。

items.idm: have/keep your feet on the ground

senses.def: to have a sensible and realistic attitude to life

examples.en: In spite of his overnight stardom he still manages to keep his feet on the ground.
examples.zh: 尽管一夜成名，他仍然脚踏实地。

items.idm: have/keep a foot in both camps

senses.def: to be involved in or connected with two different groups, especially ones that oppose each other

items.idm: have one foot in the grave

senses.def: to be so old or ill that you are not likely to live much longer
senses.zh: 行将就木；命不久矣；大去之期不远

senses.def: to be very awkward
senses.zh: （尤指跳舞或体育运动时）非常笨拙，笨手笨脚

items.idm: have the world at your feet

senses.def: to be very successful and admired
wearing socks or stockings

items.idm: not let the grass grow under your feet

senses.def: to not delay in getting things done
(to put somebody) at a disadvantage or in difficulty
senses.zh: （使某人）陷入不利局面，处于困境

examples.en: Advances in drone technology have caught lawmakers on the back foot.
examples.zh: 无人机技术的进步教立法者措手不及。

examples.en: The side that’s on the back foot, struggling to defend, will usually give away more penalties.
examples.zh: 处于劣势、防守困难的一方通常会判罚更多的点球。

examples.en: We'd like to put the fossil fuel industry on the back foot.
examples.zh: 我们想让化石燃料行业处于不利地位。

senses.def: completely well or in a normal state again after an illness or a time of trouble
senses.zh: （困境后）恢复，完全复原；（病后）痊愈

examples.en: Sue's back on her feet again after her operation.
examples.zh: 休手术后又恢复健康了。

examples.en: The new chairman hopes to get the company back on its feet within six months.
examples.zh: 新董事长希望在六个月以内使公司恢复元气。

senses.def: at an advantage

examples.en: They allowed the home side to get on the front foot right at the start.
examples.zh: 他们让主队一开始就占据了先机。

senses.def: taking positive steps to achieve something

examples.en: He has been firmly on the front foot, calling for politicians and police to intervene.
examples.zh: 他一直坚定地站在前线，呼吁政界人士和警察进行干预。

senses.def: a way of referring to children when somebody wants, or is going to have, a baby
senses.zh: （用于想要或即将有孩子时）小宝宝的脚步声

examples.en: We can't wait to hear the patter of tiny feet.
examples.zh: 我们恨不得早点儿有个小宝宝。

items.idm: pull the rug (out) from under somebody’s feet

senses.def: to take help or support away from somebody suddenly
to make a great effort to do something, especially if it is difficult or you are feeling tired
to sit down and relax, especially with your feet raised and supported

examples.en: After a hard day's work, it's nice to get home and put your feet up.
examples.zh: 辛劳一天后回家架起双腿休息是很惬意的。

senses.def: to be very strict in opposing what somebody wishes to do

examples.en: You've got to put your foot down and make him stop seeing her.
examples.zh: 你得坚决制止他再见她。

senses.def: to drive faster

examples.en: She put her foot down and roared past them.
examples.zh: 她猛踩油门，从他们旁边呼啸而过。

senses.def: to say or do something that upsets, offends or embarrasses
senses.zh: （在语言或行为上）使人不安，冒犯别人，使人尴尬

examples.en: I really put my foot in it with Ella—I didn't know she'd split up with Tom.
examples.zh: 我真的冒犯了埃拉，我不知道她和汤姆分手了。

senses.def: to make a mistake

examples.en: In the last two games he has hardly put a foot wrong.
examples.zh: 他在上两局比赛中几乎一点错都没有出。

senses.def: to enter or visit a place

examples.en: the first man to set foot on the moon
examples.zh: 第一个登上月球的人

examples.en: I vowed never to set foot in the place again.
examples.zh: 我发誓再不去那个地方了。

senses.def: to make somebody/something independent or successful

examples.en: His business sense helped set the club on its feet again.
examples.zh: 他的经营意识使俱乐部又重振雄风。

senses.def: to do or say something that will cause you a lot of trouble or harm, especially when you are trying to get an advantage for yourself
to admire somebody very much, especially a teacher or somebody that you try to learn from
to be independent and able to take care of yourself

examples.en: When his parents died he had to learn to stand on his own two feet.
examples.zh: 他的父母去世后他不得不学会自立。

senses.def: to make somebody fall suddenly and deeply in love with you
senses.zh: 使某人立刻迷上自己；使某人对自己一见倾心

examples.en: She’s waiting for some hero to come and sweep her off her feet.
examples.zh: 她正在等待某个英雄的到来，让她神魂颠倒。

items.idm: take the weight off your feet

senses.def: to sit down and rest, especially when you are tired
senses.zh: （尤指疲乏时）坐下歇歇脚，坐下喘口气

examples.en: Come and sit down and take the weight off your feet for a while.
examples.zh: 来坐下歇一会儿吧。

senses.def: to be able to think and react to things very quickly and effectively without any preparation
in the way; stopping you from working, etc.
senses.zh: 阻碍，妨碍（工作等）；碍手碍脚

examples.en: I don't want you kids under my feet while I'm cooking.
examples.zh: 我做饭时不希望你们这些孩子在我这儿碍手碍脚的。

senses.def: to show what you think about something by going or not going somewhere
senses.zh: 用脚投票（用去或不去某处表示想法）

examples.en: Shoppers voted with their feet and avoided the store.
examples.zh: 购物者对那家商店避而远之。

items.idm: wait on somebody hand and foot

senses.def: to take care of somebody’s needs so well that they do not have to do anything for themselves
senses.zh: 过分照顾；让…饭来张口，衣来伸手

examples.en: He seems to expect me to wait on him hand and foot.
examples.zh: 他似乎希望我全心全意地伺候他。

senses.def: to make somebody walk so far or so fast that they are very tired

examples.en: I hope I haven’t walked you off your feet.
examples.zh: 希望我没有让你累坏了。

senses.def: to be responsible for paying the cost of something

examples.en: Once again it will be the taxpayer who has to foot the bill.
examples.zh: 这一次掏腰包的又得是纳税人。

examples.en: Who will be footing the bill for the party?
examples.zh: 谁将为派对买单？

synonyms.words: get up ▪ stand up ▪ rise ▪ get to your feet ▪ be on your feet

intro.en: These words all mean to be in a vertical position with your weight on your feet, or to put yourself in this position.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含站立、直立、站起来之义。

items.def: to be in a vertical position with your weight on your feet:
items.zh: 指站立、直立

examples.en: She was too weak to stand.
examples.zh: 她虚弱得站都站不住。

items.def: to get into a standing position from a sitting, kneeling or lying position:
items.zh: 指从坐、跪或躺的姿势站起来

examples.en: Please don’t get up!
examples.zh: 请不要站起来！

items.def: to be in a standing position; to stand after sitting:
items.zh: 指站立、起立

examples.en: Stand up straight!
examples.zh: 立正！

items.def: (formal) to get into a standing position from a sitting, kneeling or lying position:
items.zh: 指从坐、跪或躺的姿势站起来

examples.en: Would you all rise, please, to welcome our visiting speaker.
examples.zh: 请大家起立，欢迎我们的演讲嘉宾。

items.def: to stand up after sitting, kneeling or lying:
items.zh: 指坐、跪或躺后站起来

examples.en: I helped her to get to her feet.
examples.zh: 我扶着她让她站起来。

items.def: to be standing up:
items.zh: 指站着

examples.en: I’ve been on my feet all day.
examples.zh: 我已经站了一整天。

intro.en: These are all words for the lowest part of something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指底部、最下部。

items.def: [usually sing.] the lowest part of something:
items.zh: 指最下部、底部

examples.en: Footnotes are given at the bottom of each page.
examples.zh: 脚注附于每页的下端。

items.def: [usually sing.] the lowest part of something, especially the part or surface on which it rests or stands:
items.zh: 指根基、基底、底座

examples.en: The lamp has a heavy base.
examples.zh: 这台灯的底座很沉。

items.def: [usually pl.] a layer of stone, concrete, etc. that forms the solid underground base of a building:
items.zh: 指地基、房基、基础

examples.en: to lay the foundations of the new school
examples.zh: 给新校舍打地基

items.def: [sing.] the lowest part of something:
items.zh: 指最下部、底部

examples.en: At the foot of the stairs she turned to face him.
examples.zh: 她在楼梯底转过身来面对着他。

synonyms.words: get up ▪ stand up ▪ rise ▪ get to your feet ▪ be on your feet

intro.en: These words all mean to be in a vertical position with your weight on your feet, or to put yourself in this position.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含站立、直立、站起来之义。

items.def: to be in a vertical position with your weight on your feet:
items.zh: 指站立、直立

examples.en: She was too weak to stand.
examples.zh: 她虚弱得站都站不住。

items.def: to get into a standing position from a sitting, kneeling or lying position:
items.zh: 指从坐、跪或躺的姿势站起来

examples.en: Please don’t get up!
examples.zh: 请不要站起来！

items.def: to be in a standing position; to stand after sitting:
items.zh: 指站立、起立

examples.en: Stand up straight!
examples.zh: 立正！

items.def: (formal) to get into a standing position from a sitting, kneeling or lying position:
items.zh: 指从坐、跪或躺的姿势站起来

examples.en: Would you all rise, please, to welcome our visiting speaker.
examples.zh: 请大家起立，欢迎我们的演讲嘉宾。

items.def: to stand up after sitting, kneeling or lying:
items.zh: 指坐、跪或躺后站起来

examples.en: I helped her to get to her feet.
examples.zh: 我扶着她让她站起来。

items.def: to be standing up:
items.zh: 指站着

examples.en: I’ve been on my feet all day.
examples.zh: 我已经站了一整天。

senses.def: to be responsible for paying the cost of something

examples.en: Once again it will be the taxpayer who has to foot the bill.
examples.zh: 这一次掏腰包的又得是纳税人。

examples.en: Who will be footing the bill for the party?
examples.zh: 谁将为派对买单？

senses.def: a disease of cows, sheep, etc., that causes painful places on the mouth and feet
senses.zh: 口蹄疫，口蹄病（牛羊等的疾病，引起口、蹄溃疡）

senses.def: the act of being deliberately slow to do something that you are supposed to do because you do not want to do it

examples.en: Bureaucratic foot-dragging is a big reason behind the lack of low-cost housing, many activists say.
examples.zh: 许多活动人士表示，官僚主义的拖沓是缺乏廉价住房的一个重要原因。

senses.def: a mistake that is made by not keeping behind the line when serving
senses.zh: 脚误，脚部犯规（发球踏线）

senses.def: six infantry
senses.zh: 近卫步兵旅下属团（六个近卫步兵团：近卫步兵第一团，科尔德斯特里姆近卫步兵团，苏格兰近卫步兵团，爱尔兰近卫步兵团，威尔士近卫步兵团，伦敦近卫兵团）

senses.def: a narrow bridge used only by people who are walking
a soldier who fights on foot, not on a horse or in a vehicle
a person in an organization who does work that is important but boring, and who has no power or responsibility
senses.zh: （组织中从事乏味工作而不担责任，但又不可或缺的）群众员工

senses.def: part of a film showing a particular event

examples.en: old film footage of the moon landing
examples.zh: 一段登月的老影片

examples.en: People see live footage of the war at home on their televisions.
examples.zh: 人们在家里的电视上观看战争的现场直播。

senses.def: size or length measured in feet

examples.en: I moved from an apartment into a house with three times the square footage.
examples.zh: 我从一间公寓搬到一所面积是原来三倍大的独栋房子里。

senses.def: a game played by two teams of 11 players, using a round ball that players kick up and down the playing field. Teams try to kick the ball into the other team’s goal.

examples.en: The kids were outside playing football.
examples.zh: 孩子们在外面踢足球。

examples.en: The team played some impressive football.
examples.zh: 这支球队踢出了一些令人印象深刻的足球。

examples.en: We settled down to watch the football on TV.
examples.zh: 我们坐下来观看电视上的足球比赛。

examples.en: On Saturday we went to a football match.
examples.zh: 星期六我们去看了一场足球比赛。

examples.en: a Premier League football team
examples.zh: 英超足球队

examples.en: a football player
examples.zh: 足球运动员

examples.en: I'm not a big football fan.
examples.zh: 我算不上一个狂热的足球迷。

examples.en: This was the best game of football I have seen all season.
examples.zh: 这是我整个赛季看过的最好的足球比赛。

senses.def: a game played by two teams of 11 players, using an oval
senses.zh: 美式足球，美式橄榄球（双方队员各 11 人，球呈椭圆形，球员可足踢、手传或持球奔跑，球越过对方得分线得分）

examples.en: He played football for Iowa State University.
examples.zh: 他是爱荷华州立大学美式足球队队员。

examples.en: We often go to football games together.
examples.zh: 我们经常一起去看足球比赛。

examples.en: a football player/coach
examples.zh: 足球运动员/教练

examples.en: a football field/stadium
examples.zh: 足球场/体育场

senses.def: a form of football played in Canada, similar to American football
senses.zh: 加拿大式橄榄球（与美式橄榄球相似，每队有 12 名队员）

senses.def: a large round or oval

examples.en: As a child he was always kicking a football.
examples.zh: 他小时候总是踢足球。

senses.def: an issue or a problem that frequently causes people to disagree or argue
senses.zh: 屡起争议的事情；被踢来踢去的难题

examples.en: Healthcare should not become a political football.
examples.zh: 保健问题不应该成为被踢来踢去的政治皮球。

senses.def: a leather shoe with studs
senses.zh: 足球鞋（鞋底有防滑橡胶钉）

senses.def: a form of gambling
senses.zh: 池：英国的一种赌博形式，人们试图通过说足球比赛的结果来赢钱

examples.en: They've had a big win on the football pools.
examples.zh: 他们在赌球中赢了一大笔钱。

senses.def: a person who plays football, especially as a profession

examples.en: a professional footballer
examples.zh: 职业足球员

senses.def: connected with the game of football (soccer)
senses.zh: 足球的；与足球比赛有关的

examples.en: footballing skills
examples.zh: 足球技巧

senses.def: a brake
a narrow bridge used only by people who are walking
a line or block of text that appears at the bottom of every page that is printed from a computer
senses.zh: （计算机打印的每页的）页脚，页尾

examples.en: The footer gives the page number of the document.
examples.zh: 页脚给出了文档的页码。

senses.def: a line at the bottom of a page on the internet

examples.en: a website footer
examples.zh: 一个网站页脚

examples.en: You can repeat the navigation links in the footer.
examples.zh: 您可以在页脚中重复导航链接。

senses.def: a person or thing that is a particular number of feet tall or long
senses.zh: …英尺高的人（或东西）；…英尺长的东西

examples.en: His boat is an eighteen-footer.
examples.zh: 他的小船长十八英尺。

examples.en: Both my brothers are six-footers.
examples.zh: 我的两个兄弟都是六英尺高的人。

senses.def: the sound of the steps made by somebody walking

examples.en: He heard her familiar, light footfall in the hall.
examples.zh: 他听到大厅里传来她熟悉的、轻快的脚步声。

senses.def: the number of people that visit a particular shop, shopping centre, etc. over a period of time
senses.zh: 客流，人流（商店、购物中心在一段时间内的访客人数）

examples.en: a campaign to increase footfall
examples.zh: 旨在增加客流的活动

senses.def: a hill or low mountain at the base of a higher mountain or range of mountains

examples.en: the foothills of the Himalayas
examples.zh: 喜马拉雅山脉山麓丘陵

senses.def: a place where your foot can be safely supported when climbing
senses.zh: 立足处（攀登时脚可踩的支撑点）

examples.en: She edged forward feeling for a foothold.
examples.zh: 她向前挪动，寻找立足点。

senses.def: a strong position in a business, profession, etc. from which somebody can make progress and achieve success
senses.zh: （可以此发展或取得成功的）稳固地位，立足点

examples.en: The company is eager to gain a foothold in Europe.
examples.zh: 这家公司急于在欧洲取得一席之地。

examples.en: With this upcoming deal we hope to establish a permanent foothold in the US market.
examples.zh: 通过这项即将到来的交易，我们希望在美国市场建立永久的立足点。

examples.en: I hope the book will provide a foothold for students of the subject.
examples.zh: 我希望这本书能让本专业的学生打下基础。

senses.def: football (= soccer)

examples.en: a game of footie
examples.zh: 一场足球赛

senses.def: a row of lights along the front of the stage in a theatre
senses.zh: 脚灯（舞台前面的一排灯）

senses.def: not important and likely to make you annoyed
senses.zh: 无足轻重的；无聊（而烦人）的

examples.en: footling questions/matters
examples.zh: 无聊的问题/事项

examples.en: Time after time they came with the same footling complaints.
examples.zh: 他们一次又一次地带着同样的无礼抱怨而来。

senses.def: a large box used especially by soldiers to store things in and often kept at the end of a bed

examples.en: All our belongings were stored in metal footlockers.
examples.zh: 我们所有的物品都存放在金属储物柜里。

senses.def: free to go where you like or do what you want because you have no responsibilities
senses.zh: 行动无拘无束的；自由自在的

examples.en: Bert was a footloose, unemployed actor.
examples.zh: 伯特是不受雇于任何人的自由演员。

examples.en: Ah, I was still footloose and fancy-free (= free to enjoy myself) in those days.
examples.zh: 啊，那些日子我还是自由自在、无忧无虑的。

senses.def: a male servant in a house in the past, who opened the door to visitors, served food at table, etc.

examples.en: She summoned a footman, who duly arrived.
examples.zh: 她召唤男仆，男仆马上就来了。

senses.def: an extra piece of information that is given at the bottom of a page, below the main text
an event or person that may be remembered but only as something/somebody that is not important

examples.en: The incident seems destined to become a mere footnote in history.
examples.zh: 这一事件似乎注定只能成为历史的一个注脚。

senses.def: a path that is made for people to walk along, especially in the country

examples.en: a public footpath
examples.zh: 步道

senses.def: a flat part at the side of a road for people to walk on; a pavement
the part of a steam
a mark left on a surface by a person’s foot or shoe or by an animal’s foot

examples.en: footprints in the sand
examples.zh: 沙地足迹

examples.en: muddy footprints on the kitchen floor
examples.zh: 厨房地板上的泥脚印

examples.en: He could identify any animal from its footprints.
examples.zh: 无论什么动物他都可以凭脚印辨认出来。

senses.def: a measure of the amount of the earth’s resources used by a person or a population that lives in a particular way
senses.zh: 生态足迹（测定个人或群体生活所消耗地球资源的指标）

examples.en: These countries are so populous that they can have a very big footprint.
examples.zh: 这些国家人口过多, 可能对环境造成巨大影响。

senses.def: the amount of space that something fills

examples.en: The warehouse system holds an extensive amount of product in a very small footprint because it was built five levels high.
examples.zh: 由于仓库系统建有五层高，因此其占地面积非常小，可容纳大量产品。

senses.def: the area on the earth in which a signal from a communications satellite can be received
a support for your foot or feet, for example on a motorcycle or when you are sitting down
to touch somebody’s feet lightly with your own feet, especially under a table, as an expression of romantic interest
senses.zh: （在桌下）与某人脚碰脚调情，脚挨脚爱抚

senses.def: to work with somebody in a close but secret way
senses.zh: 与他人紧密但秘密地合作

examples.en: She accused the prime minister of playing footsie with the nationalists.
examples.zh: 她指责总理与民族主义者打交道。

senses.def: having painful or tired feet, especially after walking a long way

examples.en: They limped in, weary and footsore.
examples.zh: 他们一瘸一拐地走了进来，疲惫不堪，脚痛。

examples.en: I arrived at dusk, hungry and footsore after walking all day.
examples.zh: 我是在黄昏时分到达的，走了一整天，肚子饿了，脚也酸了。

examples.zh: 该委员会负责维护道路和人行道。

examples.zh: 非法人行道停车

examples.en: Be sure to wear the correct footwear to prevent injuries to your feet.
examples.zh: 一定要穿合适的鞋，以免脚受伤。

senses.def: the way in which a person moves their feet when playing a sport or dancing

examples.en: Both dancers displayed some fancy footwork.
examples.zh: 两名舞者都展示了炫丽的脚步动作。

senses.def: the ability to react quickly and with skill to a difficult situation

examples.en: It was going to take some deft political footwork to save the situation.
examples.zh: 当时得采取一些巧妙的政治手段以挽回局势。

senses.def: football (= soccer)

examples.en: a game of footie
examples.zh: 一场足球赛

senses.def: a man who is too interested in his clothes and the way he looks
senses.zh: 过分讲究衣着和外表的男子

senses.def: too interested in his clothes and the way he looks
used to show who is intended to have or use something or where something is intended to be put

examples.en: There's a letter for you.
examples.zh: 有你一封信。

examples.en: It's a book for children.
examples.zh: 这是本儿童读物。

examples.en: We got a new table for the dining room.
examples.zh: 我们给饭厅添了一张新桌子。

examples.en: This is the place for me (= I like it very much).
examples.zh: 这里很适合我。

senses.def: in order to help somebody/something

examples.en: What can I do for you (= how can I help you)?
examples.zh: 有什么事我可以为你效劳？

examples.en: Can you translate this letter for me?
examples.zh: 你能为我翻译这封信吗？

examples.en: I took her classes for her while she was sick.
examples.zh: 她生病时我为她代课。

examples.en: soldiers fighting for their country
examples.zh: 为祖国战斗的军人

senses.def: used to show purpose or function

examples.en: a machine for slicing bread
examples.zh: 面包切片机

examples.en: Let's go for a walk.
examples.zh: 咱们去散散步。

examples.en: Are you learning English for pleasure or for your work?
examples.zh: 你学英语是出于消遣还是为了工作？

examples.en: What did you do that for (= Why did you do that)?
examples.zh: 你为什么干那件事？

senses.def: used to show a reason or cause

examples.en: The town is famous for its cathedral.
examples.zh: 这个城镇以大教堂著名。

examples.en: She gave me a watch for my birthday.
examples.zh: 她送给我一块手表作为生日礼物。

examples.en: He got an award for bravery.
examples.zh: 他因英勇受奖。

examples.en: I couldn't speak for laughing.
examples.zh: 我笑得说不出话来。

examples.en: He didn’t answer for fear of hurting her.
examples.zh: 他没回答是怕伤她的感情。

senses.def: in order to obtain something

examples.en: He came to me for advice.
examples.zh: 他来征求我的意见。

examples.en: For more information, call this number.
examples.zh: 欲知详情，请拨打此电话号码。

examples.en: There were over fifty applicants for the job.
examples.zh: 有五十多人申请这个工作。

senses.def: used to show a length of time

examples.en: I'm going away for a few days.
examples.zh: 我要离开几天。

examples.en: That's all the news there is for now.
examples.zh: 目前新闻就这么多。

senses.def: used to show a distance

examples.en: The road went on for miles and miles.
examples.zh: 这条道路绵延到很远的地方。

senses.def: used to show where somebody/something is going

examples.en: Is this the bus for Chicago?
examples.zh: 这辆公共汽车是去芝加哥的吗？

examples.en: She knew she was destined for a great future.
examples.zh: 她知道她注定要成大器。

senses.def: used to show that something is arranged or intended to happen at a particular time

examples.en: an appointment for May 12
examples.zh: 5 月 12 日的一次约见

examples.en: We're invited for 7.30.
examples.zh: 我们受到邀请，7 点 30 分出席。

senses.def: used to show the occasion when something happens

examples.en: I'm warning you for the last time—stop talking!
examples.zh: 我最后一次警告你，闭嘴！

senses.def: in exchange for something

examples.en: Copies are available for two dollars each.
examples.zh: 两美元一份。

examples.en: I'll swap these two bottles for that one.
examples.zh: 我要拿这两瓶换那一瓶。

senses.def: employed by

examples.en: She's working for an insurance company.
examples.zh: 她在一家保险公司工作。

senses.def: about; in connection with somebody/something

examples.en: They are anxious for her safety.
examples.zh: 他们为她的安全担心。

examples.en: Fortunately for us, the weather changed.
examples.zh: 我们运气好，天气变了。

senses.def: as a representative of

examples.en: I am speaking for everyone in this department.
examples.zh: 我代表这个部门全体人员讲话。

senses.def: meaning

examples.en: Shaking your head for ‘No’ is not universal.
examples.zh: 以摇头表示“不”，并非放诸四海而皆准。

senses.def: in support of somebody/something

examples.en: Are you for or against the proposal?
examples.zh: 你支持还是反对这个建议？

examples.en: They voted for independence in a referendum.
examples.zh: 他们在全民公决投票中赞成独立。

examples.en: There's a strong case for postponing the exam.
examples.zh: 有充分理由推迟考试。

examples.en: I'm all for (= strongly support) people having fun.
examples.zh: 我完全赞成人们尽情玩乐。

examples.en: ‘What does Naomi think about the move?’ ‘She’s all for it.’
examples.zh: “内奥米对此举有何看法？”“她完全赞成。”

senses.def: considering what can be expected from somebody/something

examples.en: The weather was warm for the time of year.
examples.zh: 在一年的这个时节这天气算是暖和的了。

examples.en: She's tall for her age.
examples.zh: 从她这个年龄看她个子算是高的。

examples.en: He’s not bad for a beginner.
examples.zh: 就新手而论，他已经很不错了。

examples.en: That's too much responsibility for a child.
examples.zh: 对于一个孩子来说，这责任是太重了。

senses.def: used to say how difficult, necessary, pleasant, etc. something is that somebody might do or has done
senses.zh: 对（某人）来说（困难、必需、愉快等）

examples.en: It's useless for us to continue.
examples.zh: 我们继续做下去也无用。

examples.en: There's no need for you to go.
examples.zh: 你不必走。

examples.en: For her to have survived such an ordeal was remarkable.
examples.zh: 她经历了那样的苦难活下来了，真不简单。

examples.en: The box is too heavy for me to lift.
examples.zh: 这只箱子太沉，我搬不动。

examples.en: Is it clear enough for you to read?
examples.zh: 这个你读起来清不清楚？

senses.def: used to show who can or should do something

examples.en: It's not for me to say why he left.
examples.zh: 由我说出他离开的原因不合适。

examples.en: How to spend the money is for you to decide.
examples.zh: 怎样花这笔钱由你决定。

senses.def: better, happier, etc. following something

examples.en: You'll feel better for a good night's sleep.
examples.zh: 你晚上睡个好觉就会觉得好些。

examples.en: This room would look more cheerful for a spot of paint.
examples.zh: 这个房间油漆一下就会显得更加悦目。

senses.def: to be going to get into trouble or be punished

examples.en: We'd better hurry or we'll be in for it.
examples.zh: 我们最好赶快，不然要受罚的。

senses.def: despite

examples.en: For all its clarity of style, the book is not easy reading.
examples.zh: 这本书虽然文体清晰，但读起来并不容易。

senses.def: used to say that something is not important or of no interest or value to you/somebody
senses.zh: （表示对某人不重要、无价值或无所谓）

examples.en: For all I know she's still living in Boston.
examples.zh: 据我所知，她还住在波士顿。

examples.en: You can do what you like, for all I care.
examples.zh: 你想干什么就可以干什么，我才不管呢。

examples.en: For all the good it's done we might as well not have bothered.
examples.zh: 那件事带来的好处不多，我们本不该操心的。

senses.def: used to say that something is a typical example of its kind

examples.en: She might at least have called to explain. There's gratitude for you.
examples.zh: 她本来至少可以来电话解释一下。她就这么表示感谢。

senses.def: used to introduce the reason for something mentioned in the previous statement

examples.en: We listened eagerly, for he brought news of our families.
examples.zh: 我们急不可待地听着，因为他带来了我们家人的消息。

examples.en: I believed her—for surely she would not lie to me.
examples.zh: 我相信她的话，因为她肯定不会向我撒谎。

senses.def: to be going to get into trouble or be punished

senses.def: used when you are stating what the reality of a situation is

examples.en: There's still another ten minutes of the game to go, but for practical purposes it's already over.
examples.zh: 比赛虽然还有十分钟，但实际上等于已经结束了。

senses.def: for (such) a long time

examples.en: Will you be away for long?
examples.zh: 你要离开很久吗？

examples.en: I'm sorry I haven't written to you for so long.
examples.zh: 真抱歉，我这么长时间未给你写信。

senses.def: because of a lack of something; because something is not available

examples.en: The project failed for want of financial backing.
examples.zh: 这个项目由于缺少财政支援而告吹。

examples.en: We call our music ‘postmodern’ for the want of a better word.
examples.zh: 由于没有更合适的词来表达，我们把我们的音乐称作“后现代风格”。

examples.zh: 我们去散步是因为想做点更好的事。

examples.zh: 她买这幅画是为了一首歌。

examples.en: The property is going for a song because they need to sell it fast.
examples.zh: 该物业正在购买一首歌，因为他们需要快速出售它。

examples.zh: 千万要小心。

examples.en: Oh, for heaven's sake!

examples.en: For pity's sake, help me!

senses.zh: （表示愤怒或惊讶）哎呀，我的天哪，真是岂有此理

examples.zh: 真是岂有此理！你为什么非得干那种事？

examples.en: I'd like an excuse to get rid of him for good and all.
examples.zh: 我想要一个借口永远摆脱他。

senses.zh: 作为额外增添；外加的项目

examples.zh: 按每人 50 克大米的分量，再额外加一勺。

examples.zh: 比如说，如果你发现有职员偷东西，你会怎么办？

examples.zh: 比如谋杀、小偷小摸和逃税，都有不同的动机和后果。
