senses.zh: 看在旧日的情分上；念及老交情

senses.def: used to emphasize that a particular person does something and that you believe other people do too
senses.zh: 就是其中之一（表达意见时用以加强语气）

examples.en: I, for one, would prefer to postpone the meeting.
examples.zh: 主张推迟会期的，我就是一个。

senses.def: used to introduce one of two or more possible reasons for doing something
senses.zh: （用以引出两个或更多的理由之一）一来，一方面

examples.en: ‘Why don't you get a car?’ ‘Well, for one thing, I can't drive!’
examples.zh: “你为什么不买辆汽车呢？”“啊，首先，我不会开车！”

senses.def: as a beginning or first part of a process

examples.en: For openers, the band played a track from their new album.
examples.zh: 作为开场，乐队演奏了他们新专辑中的一首曲目。

senses.def: used to show that you are annoyed about something

examples.en: For Pete’s sake turn down that music!
examples.zh: 行行好，把音乐声关小点！

examples.en: Oh, for Pete’s sake, why can’t I get this thing to work!
examples.zh: 哦，天哪，为什么我不能让这玩意儿动起来呢！

for pity's sake: @@@LINK=for Christ’s, God’s, goodness’, heaven’s, pity’s, etc. sake

senses.def: what somebody claims it is or serious

examples.en: This is not a fire drill—it's for real.
examples.zh: 这不是救火演习，是真失火了。

examples.en: He managed to convince voters that he was for real.
examples.zh: 他使得投票者相信了他是严肃认真的。

examples.en: I don’t think her tears were for real.
examples.zh: 我认为她的眼泪不是真的。

senses.def: available to rent

for sake: @@@LINK=for the sake of somebody/something | for somebody’s/something’s sake
for sb's benefit: @@@LINK=for the benefit of somebody | for somebody’s benefit
for sb's sake: @@@LINK=for the sake of somebody/something | for somebody’s/something’s sake

senses.def: intended to be seen but not used
senses.zh: 供展览的；装门面的；中看不中用的

examples.en: These items are just for show—they're not for sale.
examples.zh: 这些物品仅供展览，不卖。

for somebody's benefit: @@@LINK=for the benefit of somebody | for somebody’s benefit
for somebody's sake: @@@LINK=for the sake of somebody/something | for somebody’s/something’s sake
for somebody's/something's sake: @@@LINK=for the sake of somebody/something | for somebody’s/something’s sake

senses.def: to be seen only by a particular person

examples.en: I'll lend you the letters but they're for your eyes only.
examples.zh: 我会把这些信借给你，但只准你一个人看。

for something's sake: @@@LINK=for the sake of somebody/something | for somebody’s/something’s sake

senses.def: because of the interest or value something has, not because of the advantages it may bring
senses.zh: 为某事本身的缘故；鉴于某事本身的价值

examples.en: I believe in education for its own sake.
examples.zh: 我相信教育本身就是有价值的。

examples.en: art for art’s sake
examples.zh: 为艺术而艺术

senses.def: used to emphasize the first of a list of reasons, opinions, etc., or to say what happens first
senses.zh: （强调一系列理由、意见等的第一条或表示首先发生的事）首先，作为开头

examples.en: There are a number of problems—for starters, where is the money coming from?
examples.zh: 存在很多问题——首先，钱从哪里来？

examples.en: The winners will be flown to Paris—and that’s just for starters.
examples.zh: 获胜者将飞往巴黎——这只是开始。

for sth's sake: @@@LINK=for the sake of somebody/something | for somebody’s/something’s sake

senses.def: without doubt

examples.en: No one knows for sure what happened.
examples.zh: 没有人确切地知道发生了什么事。

examples.en: I think he'll be back on Monday, but I can't say for sure.
examples.zh: 我想他星期一会回来，不过我不敢肯定。

examples.en: One thing is for sure—it's not going to be easy.
examples.zh: 有一点可以肯定，事情不会很容易。

examples.en: ‘Will you be there?’ ‘For sure.’
examples.zh: “你去吗？”“肯定去。”

senses.def: used to add a comment on something that you have just said

examples.en: I didn't like it much. Nor did the kids, for that matter.
examples.zh: 我不怎么喜欢它。孩子们也同样不喜欢。

senses.def: if you can have something for the asking
senses.zh: 只需要求，一经索取（便可获得）

examples.en: The job is yours for the asking.
examples.zh: 只要开口，这份工作就是你的了。

for the benefit of: @@@LINK=for the benefit of somebody | for somebody’s benefit
for the benefit of sb: @@@LINK=for the benefit of somebody | for somebody’s benefit
for the benefit of somebody: @@@LINK=for the benefit of somebody | for somebody’s benefit

senses.def: especially in order to help or be useful to somebody
senses.zh: 为帮助某人；为某人的利益

examples.en: I have attached some lecture notes for the benefit of those people who were absent last week.
examples.zh: 为了帮助那些上周缺席的人，我附上了一些讲义。

examples.en: Don't go to any trouble for my benefit!
examples.zh: 别为我费功夫！

for the benefit of somebody | for somebo.word: for the benefit of somebody | for somebody’s benefit

senses.def: until the end of a particular situation, especially a war
senses.zh: 直到结束；（尤指战争）期间

examples.en: His wife and children had gone for the duration to the Lake District to escape the bombs.
examples.zh: 他的妻子和孩子这段时间一直前往湖区躲避炸弹。

senses.def: just for pleasure rather than for a reason
however hard you try

examples.en: I cannot for the life of me imagine why they want to leave.
examples.zh: 我怎么也想象不出他们为什么要走。

for the love of: @@@LINK=(just) for love | (just) for the love of something

senses.def: used when you are expressing anger and the fact that you are impatient
senses.zh: （表示愤怒和不耐烦）看在上帝的分上，哎呀，求求你

examples.en: For the love of God, tell me what he said!
examples.zh: 看在上帝的分上，告诉我他说了些什么！

for the love of something: @@@LINK=(just) for love | (just) for the love of something
for the love of sth: @@@LINK=(just) for love | (just) for the love of something

senses.def: for a short period of time but not permanently

examples.en: I'm changing my email address but for the meantime you can use the old one.
examples.zh: 我要更换电邮地址，不过那个旧的暂时也还可以用。

senses.def: for a short period of time but not permanently

examples.en: We need some new curtains, but these will do for the meanwhile.
examples.zh: 我们需要一些新的窗帘，但这些暂时还可以用。

senses.def: for now; for a short time

examples.en: This house is big enough for the moment, but we'll have to move if we have children.
examples.zh: 这房子现在还够大。要是有了孩子，我们还得搬。

senses.def: mostly; usually

examples.en: The contributors are, for the most part, professional scientists.
examples.zh: 投稿者大多是专业科学家。

senses.def: for now; for a short time

examples.en: This house is big enough for the present, but we'll have to move if we have children.
examples.zh: 这房子目前来说足够大了，但是如果我们有了孩子，我们就得搬家了。

senses.def: apart from that; considering other matters

examples.en: The book has some interesting passages about the author's childhood. For the rest, it is extremely dull.
examples.zh: 这本书中关于作者童年的一些章节倒还有意思。除此之外，便无聊至极。

for the sake of sb: @@@LINK=for the sake of somebody/something | for somebody’s/something’s sake
for the sake of somebody: @@@LINK=for the sake of somebody/something | for somebody’s/something’s sake
for the sake of somebody/something: @@@LINK=for the sake of somebody/something | for somebody’s/something’s sake

senses.def: in order to help somebody/something or because you like somebody/something
senses.zh: 为了某人（或某事）起见；因某人（或某事）的缘故

examples.en: They stayed together for the sake of the children.
examples.zh: 为了孩子，他们还待在一起。

examples.en: You can do it. Please, for my sake.
examples.zh: 这个你是能做的。求你了，就算为了我。

examples.en: I hope you're right, for all our sakes (= because this is important for all of us).
examples.zh: 我希望你没事，这对我们大家都好。

for the sake of somebody/something | for.word: for the sake of somebody/something | for somebody’s/something’s sake

for the sake of something: @@@LINK=for the sake of somebody/something | for somebody’s/something’s sake

senses.def: for a short period of time but not permanently

examples.en: You can leave your suitcase here for the time being.
examples.zh: 你可以暂时把衣箱留在这儿。

senses.def: used to say that you would like to do something, even though you know that it would not be sensible

examples.en: I'd kill him for two pins.
examples.zh: 我恨不得杀了他。

examples.en: For two pins I’d tell her what I really think of her.
examples.zh: 为了两枚别针，我会告诉她我对她的真实看法。

senses.def: used to emphasize that what you are saying is only your own opinion or suggestion and may not be very helpful
senses.zh: （所说的只是个人意见）无论管不管用，不论好坏

examples.en: I prefer this colour, for what it's worth.
examples.zh: 无论好坏，我喜欢这个颜色。

senses.def: if you say, for example, that something is too hot for your liking

examples.en: The town was too crowded for my liking.
examples.zh: 这座城镇太拥挤了，我不喜欢。

examples.en: The weather was too hot for their liking.
examples.zh: 天气太热了，他们不喜欢。

senses.def: as payment, reward or thanks for something you have done

examples.en: I told her what I thought and got a mouthful of abuse for my pains!
examples.zh: 我跟她讲了我的想法，而得到的回报竟是破口大骂！

senses.def: a song that people sing to praise somebody who has done something that they admire. If the person is a woman, they sing For She's a Jolly Good Fellow
senses.zh: 因为他是一个快乐的好伙伴：人们唱这首歌来赞美某人所做的事，他们很欣赏。如果这个人是一个女人，他们会唱歌，因为她是一个快乐的好伙伴。这首歌通常是在没有计划或准备的情况下演唱的，因此有时会抬起人的肩膀来唱歌。这些词是：

for-he-s-a-jolly-good-fellow.word: For He's a Jolly Good Fellow

senses.def: for/in the period of time when you can predict what is going to happen, based on the present circumstances

examples.en: The statue will remain in the museum for the foreseeable future.
examples.zh: 短期内这座雕像将留在博物馆。

examples.en: It's unlikely that the hospital will be closed in the foreseeable future (= soon).
examples.zh: 这家医院不大可能很快就关闭。

senses.def: to search widely for food

examples.en: The female only leaves the young when she forages for food.
examples.zh: 雌性只有在觅食时才会离开幼崽。

examples.en: The pigs are allowed to forage around in a large orchard.
examples.zh: 猪可以在大果园里四处觅食。

senses.def: to search for something, especially using the hands

examples.en: Her assistant was foraging in a cupboard for some envelopes.
examples.zh: 她的助手正在橱柜里找信封。

senses.def: food for horses and cows

examples.en: forage crops/grass
examples.zh: 饲料作物；饲草

senses.def: an attempt to become involved in a different activity or profession

examples.en: the company’s first foray into the computer market
examples.zh: 该公司对计算机市场的初次涉足

senses.def: a short sudden attack made by a group of soldiers

examples.en: Those on the front line make regular forays into occupied territory.
examples.zh: 前线人员定期侵入被占领土。

senses.def: a short journey to find a particular thing or to visit a new place
senses.zh: 短途（寻物）；短暂访问（新地方）

examples.en: weekend shopping forays to France
examples.zh: 周末赴法国购物

examples.en: the perfect venue for a foray into the Dales or a trip across the North York Moors
examples.zh: 游览山谷或穿越北约克荒原的完美场所

senses.def: to stop yourself from saying or doing something that you could or would like to say or do
senses.zh: 克制；自制；忍住（不说话或不做某事）

examples.en: He wanted to answer back, but he forbore from doing so.
examples.zh: 他想顶嘴，但是忍住了。

examples.en: She forbore to ask any further questions.
examples.zh: 她克制自己，不再进一步提问。

senses.def: a person in your family who lived a long time ago
the quality of being patient and kind towards other people, especially when they have done something wrong

examples.en: The mortgage company had acted with forbearance, only taking them to court as a last resort.
examples.zh: 抵押贷款公司表现得很克制，只是将他们告上法庭作为最后的手段。

examples.en: We are very grateful for the cooperation and forbearance of all the staff.
examples.zh: 我们非常感谢全体员工的配合和包容。

senses.def: a US business magazine, started in 1917, containing news stories and articles about world business and finance. It is best known for its lists of various categories of businesses and people, such as the Forbes 400, a list of the 400 richest Americans.
senses.zh: 《福布斯》美国商业杂志，1917年创办，刊载关于世界商业和金融的新闻报道和文章。以各类企业和人物排行榜闻名于世，如福布斯400富豪榜，即400名最富有的美国富豪排行榜。

senses.def: to order somebody not to do something; to order that something must not be done

examples.en: He forbade them from mentioning the subject again.
examples.zh: 他不准他们再提这个话题。

examples.en: Her father forbade the marriage.
examples.zh: 她的父亲不允许这桩婚事。

examples.en: Smoking is strictly forbidden.
examples.zh: 严禁吸烟。

examples.en: You cannot do that. I absolutely forbid it.
examples.zh: 你不能那样做，我决不允许。

examples.en: You are all forbidden to leave.
examples.zh: 你们都不准离开。

examples.en: My doctor has forbidden me sugar.
examples.zh: 医生禁止我吃糖。

examples.en: She knew her mother would forbid her going.
examples.zh: 她知道她妈妈是不会让她去的。

senses.def: to make it difficult or impossible to do something

examples.en: Lack of space forbids further treatment of the topic here.
examples.zh: 由于篇幅所限，这里不能深入阐述这个问题。

senses.def: used to say that you hope that something will not happen

examples.en: ‘Maybe you'll end up as a lawyer, like me.’ ‘God forbid!’
examples.zh: “也许你会像我一样，最终成为律师。”“但愿不会这样！”

note.en: Some people find this use of God offensive.
note.zh: 有人认为此处用 God 含冒犯意。

senses.def: used to say that you hope that something will not happen

examples.en: ‘Maybe you'll end up as a lawyer, like me.’ ‘God forbid!’
examples.zh: “也许你会像我一样，最终成为律师。”“但愿不会这样！”

senses.def: a thing that is not allowed and that therefore seems very attractive
senses.zh: 禁果（唯其禁止，故特别诱人）

examples.en: Well, you know what they say— forbidden fruit tastes sweetest.
examples.zh: 好吧，你知道他们怎么说——禁果味道最甜。

senses.def: in a way that seems unfriendly and frightening

examples.en: a forbiddingly elegant restaurant
examples.zh: 一家极其优雅的餐厅

senses.def: violent physical action used to obtain or achieve something

examples.en: The release of the hostages could not be achieved without the use of force.
examples.zh: 不使用武力不可能使人质获释。

examples.en: If persuasion doesn't work, they use force.
examples.zh: 如果说服无效，他们就使用武力。

examples.en: The government has relied on brute force to respond to public discontent.
examples.zh: 政府依靠暴力来回应公众的不满。

examples.en: The rioters were taken away by force.
examples.zh: 聚众闹事者被强行带走。

examples.en: The empire was held together by military force.
examples.zh: 这个帝国是靠军事力量聚拢起来的。

examples.en: plans to seize power by force of arms (= by military force)
examples.zh: 计划通过武力夺取政权（=通过军事力量）

senses.def: physical strength, especially as shown when something hits something else

examples.en: the force of the explosion/impact
examples.zh: 爆炸力；冲击力

examples.en: The shopping centre took the full force of the blast.
examples.zh: 购物中心承受了全部爆炸力。

examples.en: You have to apply some force to move the lever.
examples.zh: 必须加一些力才能撬动杠杆。

examples.en: She hits the ball with amazing force for someone so small.
examples.zh: 她个头虽小，击球的力量却大得惊人。

senses.def: the strong effect or influence of something

examples.en: They realized the force of her argument.
examples.zh: 他们领悟到了她那论据的威力。

examples.en: a leader who inspired others with the force of his personality
examples.zh: 一位用自己的人格力量激励他人的领导者

examples.en: He controlled himself by sheer force of will.
examples.zh: 他全凭意志力控制住了自己。

examples.en: Grant drove the point home with considerable force.
examples.zh: 格兰特颇为有力地把这个问题讲透彻了。

examples.en: She spoke with force and deliberation.
examples.zh: 她讲话铿锵有力，字斟句酌。

senses.def: a person or thing that has a lot of power or influence
senses.zh: 力量大的人（或事物）；影响大的人（或事物）

examples.en: the forces of good/evil
examples.zh: 善／恶的力量

examples.en: They believe that market forces should determine prices.
examples.zh: 他们认为价格应由市场力量决定。

examples.en: Ron is the driving force (= the person who has the most influence) behind the project.
examples.zh: 罗恩是这个计划的主心骨。

examples.en: She's a force to be reckoned with (= a person who has a lot of power and influence and should therefore be treated seriously).
examples.zh: 她是个有影响力的人物，需要认真对待。

examples.en: a force for good/evil
examples.zh: 向善／邪恶的力量

examples.en: The expansion of higher education should be a powerful force for change.
examples.zh: 高等教育的扩展对变革应该是一个强大的推动力。

examples.en: He was finally defeated by forces beyond his control.
examples.zh: 他最终被他无法控制的力量打败了。

examples.en: Social media has become a major force in political campaigns.
examples.zh: 社交媒体已成为政治运动的主要力量。

senses.group: somebody/something with power 具有力量的人／事物

senses.def: the authority of something

examples.en: The court ruled that these standards have force in English law.
examples.zh: 法院裁定，这些标准在英格兰法律中有效。

examples.en: The contract was not signed and has no binding force.
examples.zh: 合同没有签署因而没有约束力。

examples.en: These guidelines do not have the force of law.
examples.zh: 这些指导原则不具有法律效力。

examples.en: The culprits must expect to face the full force of the law.
examples.zh: 罪犯必须面对法律的全部制裁。

senses.def: a group of people who have been organized for a particular purpose
senses.zh: （为某目的组织起来的）一群人

examples.en: a member of the sales force
examples.zh: 销售团队中的一员

examples.en: The sales force is/are working extra hard.
examples.zh: 销售人员正在加倍努力工作。

examples.en: She has attracted a force of passionate young individuals who are committed to the organization.
examples.zh: 她吸引了一批致力于该组织的充满热情的年轻人。

senses.def: a trained and organized group of police, soldiers or other military personnel

examples.en: Rebel forces now control most of the capital.
examples.zh: 叛军现在已控制首都的大部份地区。

examples.en: Government forces captured the rebel positions.
examples.zh: 政府军占领了叛军阵地。

examples.en: coalition/allied forces
examples.zh: 联军/盟军

examples.en: The peacekeeping force has/have now been dispatched.
examples.zh: 维和部队已经派出。

examples.en: He called on the local population to rise up against the occupying forces.
examples.zh: 他号召当地人民起来反抗占领军。

examples.en: American special forces pride themselves on their elite status.
examples.zh: 美国特种部队以其精英地位而自豪。

examples.en: The government deployed military forces to attack terrorist strongholds.
examples.zh: 政府派出军队进攻恐怖分子据点。

examples.en: The British were ordered to withdraw their forces immediately.
examples.zh: 英国奉命立即撤军。

senses.def: the army, navy
senses.zh: 兵力，武装力量（陆海空三军）

examples.en: life in the forces
examples.zh: 部队生活

examples.en: Daisy intends to join the forces when she leaves school this summer.
examples.zh: 黛西打算今年夏天离开学校后加入部队。

senses.def: the weapons and soldiers that an army, etc. has, considered as things that may be used

examples.en: strategic nuclear forces
examples.zh: 战略核部队

examples.en: The government is negotiating cuts to nuclear forces.
examples.zh: 政府正在协商缩减核部队。

senses.def: the police force

examples.en: He joined the force twenty years ago.
examples.zh: 他二十年前加入了警队。

senses.def: an effect that causes things to move in a particular way

examples.en: The moon exerts a force on the earth.
examples.zh: 月球对地球有引力。

examples.en: the force of gravity
examples.zh: 重力

examples.en: the sun's magnetic force
examples.zh: 太阳的磁力

examples.en: Because of the increased mass, more force is needed to accelerate the object.
examples.zh: 由于质量增加，需要更大的力来加速物体。

senses.def: a unit for measuring the strength of the wind on the Beaufort scale

examples.en: a force 9 gale
examples.zh: 9 级大风

examples.en: a gale force wind
examples.zh: 一场大风级的风

senses.def: to cause a law, rule, etc. to start being used
senses.zh: （使法律、规则等）开始生效，开始实施

examples.en: They are hoping to bring the new legislation into force before the end of the year.
examples.zh: 他们希望在年底前实施新法。

senses.def: to start being used

examples.en: When do the new regulations come into force?
examples.zh: 新规章什么时候开始执行？

examples.en: The new law comes into force as from midnight tomorrow.
examples.zh: 新法律从明天零点起开始生效。

senses.def: if you do something from or out of force of habit

examples.en: It's force of habit that gets me out of bed at 6.15 each morning.
examples.zh: 习惯的力量让我每天早上 6.15 起床。

senses.def: a person with a very strong personality who is full of energy, very determined and difficult for others to resist
senses.zh: 精力充沛且富有魅力的人；令人折服的人

examples.en: Gerard is a force of nature, continually pursuing his target when everyone else is ready to give up.
examples.zh: 杰拉德具有一股自然的力量，当其他人都准备放弃时，他会继续追求自己的目标。

(1821-93) a British artist. He was a friend of the Pre-Raphaelites
senses.zh: 福特·马多克斯·布朗（Ford Madox Brown）：（1821-93）英国艺术家。他是拉斐尔前派的朋友，他的绘画风格与他们相似。他最著名的作品是《最后的英格兰》（1852-5）和《作品》（1852-65），其中充满了现实的细节。

senses.def: (1873-1939) an English writer. He wrote many novels, poems and critical studies (= books judging the qualities of works of literature, etc.)
senses.zh: 福特·马多克斯·福特（Ford Madox Ford）：（1873-1939）英国作家。他撰写了许多小说，诗歌和批判研究（即判断文学作品质量的书籍等），并与约瑟夫·康拉德（Joseph Conrad）合作了两本小说，《继承者》（1901）和《浪漫》（1903）。他最著名的小说《好士兵》（The Good Soldier，1915年）和四首第一次世界大战小说系列（称为《游行的尽头》（阅兵式）（1924-8年））为人们描绘了瞬息万变的英国上流社会。

examples.zh: 兴奋之下我完全忘了我弟弟。

examples.zh: 尽量不再想发生过的事情。

examples.en: In a novel, form and content are equally important.
examples.zh: 小说的形式和内容同样重要。

senses.def: how fit and healthy somebody is; the state of being fit and healthy

examples.en: After six months' training the whole team is in superb form.
examples.zh: 经过半年的训练，全队状态极佳。

examples.en: I really need to get back in form.
examples.zh: 我实在需要恢复状态。

examples.en: The horse was clearly out of form.
examples.zh: 这匹马显然状态不佳。

senses.def: how well somebody/something is performing; the fact that somebody/something is performing well

examples.en: Midfielder Elliott has shown disappointing form recently.
examples.zh: 中场队员埃利奥特近来表现令人失望。

examples.en: She signalled her return to form with a convincing victory.
examples.zh: 她令人信服的胜利显示她已恢复状态。

examples.en: When she's on form, nobody in the world is funnier.
examples.zh: 当她状态良好时，世界上没有人比她更有趣了。

examples.en: The whole team was on good form and deserved the win.
examples.zh: 全队表现良好，获胜是理所当然的。

examples.en: On current/present form the party is heading for another election victory.
examples.zh: 就该党目前情况来看，下届选举又会胜利。

examples.en: She was in great form (= happy and cheerful and full of energy) at the wedding party.
examples.zh: 在婚宴上她欢欣雀跃。

senses.def: the usual way of doing something

examples.en: What's the form when you apply for a research grant?
examples.zh: 申请科研补助金按常规应该怎么办？

examples.en: conventional social forms
examples.zh: 常规社会习俗

examples.en: True to form (= as he usually does) he arrived an hour late.
examples.zh: 他和往常一样迟到了一小时。

examples.en: Partners of employees are invited as a matter of form (= because that is the usual way things are done).
examples.zh: 按惯例，员工的伴侣受到了邀请。

senses.group: way of doing things 做事方式

senses.def: the way of doing things that is socially acceptable/not socially acceptable

examples.en: When I was a boy it was always considered bad form to talk about food or money.
examples.zh: 当我还是个孩子的时候，谈论食物或金钱总是被认为是不礼貌的。

examples.en: Good form dictated that she should dress more casually in the country.
examples.zh: 良好的身材要求她在乡下应该穿得更随意一些。

senses.group: way of doing things 做事方式

senses.def: a class in a school

examples.en: Who's your form teacher?
examples.zh: 你们的年级老师是谁？

senses.def: a student in the form

examples.en: a third-former
examples.zh: 三年级学生

senses.def: of any type

examples.en: I don't approve of violence in any shape or form.
examples.zh: 我不赞成任何形式的暴力行为。

examples.en: I can't stand insects in any shape or form.
examples.zh: 无论什么样的昆虫我都很害怕。

examples.en: I do not condone bullying in any way, shape or form.
examples.zh: 我不容忍任何方式、形式或形式的欺凌行为。

senses.def: to gradually form into a particular shape; to gradually develop

examples.en: In her body a new life was taking form.
examples.zh: 一个新的生命在她的体内逐渐形成。

senses.def: to produce something in a particular way or make it have a particular shape

examples.en: Bend the wire so that it forms a ‘V’.
examples.zh: 把铁丝弯成 V 形。

examples.en: Rearrange the letters to form a new word.
examples.zh: 重新排列字母，组成另一单词。

examples.en: Games can help children learn to form letters.
examples.zh: 游戏可以帮助儿童学会组合字母。

examples.en: Do you know how to form the past tense?
examples.zh: 你知道怎样构成过去时吗？

examples.en: Form the dough into balls with your hands.
examples.zh: 用手把生面团揉成一些球儿。

examples.en: The chain is formed from 136 links.
examples.zh: 这根链条由 136 个环组成。

examples.en: The table was formed of two large slabs of stone.
examples.zh: 桌子是由两块大石板组成的。

senses.def: to move or arrange objects or people so that they are in a group with a particular shape; to become arranged in a group like this

examples.en: First get students to form groups of four.
examples.zh: 首先让学生分成四人一组。

examples.en: to form a line/queue/circle
examples.zh: 排成一队／圈

examples.en: Queues were already forming outside the theatre.
examples.zh: 剧院外已经在排队了。

examples.en: The teams formed up into lines.
examples.zh: 各队已整好了队列。

examples.en: Everyone formed into a circle.
examples.zh: 大家围成一个圈。

examples.en: The regiment was formed into ranks on a nearby lane.
examples.zh: 该团在附近的一条小巷上列队。

senses.def: to begin to exist and gradually develop into a particular shape; to make something begin to exist in a particular shape

examples.en: Flowers appeared, but fruits failed to form.
examples.zh: 开了花，但没有结果。

examples.en: Storm clouds are forming on the horizon.
examples.zh: 天边出现了暴雨云。

examples.en: These hills were formed by glaciation.
examples.zh: 这些山丘是冰川作用形成的。

examples.en: a perfectly formed body
examples.zh: 完美的人体

senses.group: start to exist 开始存在

senses.def: to start to exist and develop; to make something start to exist and develop

examples.en: A plan formed in my head.
examples.zh: 一个计划在我的头脑中形成。

examples.en: to form a relationship/bond/partnership with somebody/something
examples.zh: 与某人（某事物）建立关系／联系／伙伴关系

examples.en: I formed many close friendships at college.
examples.zh: 我大学时结交了许多密友。

examples.en: People can and do form emotional bonds with cats and dogs.
examples.zh: 人们可以而且确实与猫和狗建立了情感联系。

examples.en: I didn't see enough of the play to form an opinion about it.
examples.zh: 我对这部戏剧了解得不够，说不出什么意见。

examples.en: I formed the view that the only option was to cancel the project.
examples.zh: 我认为唯一的选择就是取消该项目。

examples.en: The plan came in a flash of inspiration, fully formed.
examples.zh: 这个计划来自灵光一闪，在脑中已完整成形。

senses.group: start to exist 开始存在

senses.def: to start a group of people, such as an organization, a committee, etc.; to come together in a group of this kind

examples.en: They hope to form the new government.
examples.zh: 他们希望组建新政府。

examples.en: to form an alliance/a coalition/a committee
examples.zh: 组建联盟/联盟/委员会

examples.en: He formed a band with some friends from school.
examples.zh: 他和学校里的一些朋友组成一支乐队。

examples.en: a newly formed political party
examples.zh: 新建立的政党

examples.en: I decided to form my own company.
examples.zh: 我决定成立自己的公司。

examples.en: The band formed in 2017.
examples.zh: 这支乐队成立于 2017 年。

examples.en: Willing volunteers formed teams of helpers to carry everything in.
examples.zh: 志愿者自愿组成了协助小组把所有的东西搬进来。

examples.en: On September 27 a new coalition administration was formed.
examples.zh: 新一届联合政府于 9 月 27 日成立。

examples.en: Some of the insects will leave to form a new colony.
examples.zh: 其中一些昆虫会离群去组成一个新的群体。

examples.en: The anarchists started to form volunteer militias.
examples.zh: 无政府主义者开始组建义勇军。

senses.def: to be something; to have a particular function or pattern

examples.en: The castle forms the focal point of the city.
examples.zh: 这座城堡是城市的中心。

examples.en: The survey formed part of a larger programme of research.
examples.zh: 这个调查是研究计划的一部分。

examples.en: These drawings will form the basis of the exhibition.
examples.zh: 这些画作将成为展览的基本部分。

examples.en: This family forms the core of the film.
examples.zh: 这个家庭构成了影片的核心。

examples.en: The trees form a natural protection from the sun's rays.
examples.zh: 树木起天然的保护作用，遮挡了太阳的光线。

senses.def: to have an influence on the way that something develops

examples.en: Positive and negative experiences form a child's character.
examples.zh: 正反两方面的经历都影响儿童性格的形成。

senses.def: of any type

examples.en: I don't approve of violence in any shape or form.
examples.zh: 我不赞成任何形式的暴力行为。

examples.en: I can't stand insects in any shape or form.
examples.zh: 无论什么样的昆虫我都很害怕。

examples.en: I do not condone bullying in any way, shape or form.
examples.zh: 我不容忍任何方式、形式或形式的欺凌行为。

senses.def: to gradually form into a particular shape; to gradually develop

examples.en: In her body a new life was taking form.
examples.zh: 一个新的生命在她的体内逐渐形成。

intro.en: These are all words for the way the different parts of something combine together or the way that something has been made.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指事物各个不同部分的组合、构造。

items.def: the way in which the parts of something are connected together or arranged; a particular arrangement of parts:
items.zh: 指结构、构造

examples.en: the structure of the building/​human body
examples.zh: 建筑物／人体结构

items.def: a set of beliefs, ideas or rules that forms the basis of a system or society:
items.zh: 指构成某个体系或社会基础的信仰、观点、准则

examples.en: The report provides a framework for further research.
examples.zh: 报告提供了进一步研究的原则。

items.def: [U] the arrangement of parts in a whole, especially in a work of art or piece of writing:
items.zh: （尤指艺术作品或文章的）结构、形式

examples.en: As a photographer, shape and form were more important to him than colour.
examples.zh: 作为摄影师，形状和结构对他来说比颜色更重要。

items.def: [U] (rather formal) the different parts or people that combine to form something; the way in which they combine:
items.zh: 指不同部分或人的构成、组合方式

examples.en: recent changes in the composition of the workforce
examples.zh: 劳动力组合最近的变化

items.def: [U] the way that something has been built or made:
items.zh: 指建造或构造

examples.en: ships of steel construction
examples.zh: 钢结构船

items.def: (rather formal) the basic structure of a society or an organization that enables it to function successfully:
items.zh: 指社会、机构等的基本结构

examples.en: This is a trend which threatens the very fabric of society.
examples.zh: 这趋势威胁社会的基本结构。

synonyms.words: do ▪ create ▪ develop ▪ produce ▪ generate ▪ form

intro.en: These words all mean to make something from parts or materials, or to cause something to exist or happen.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含制造、使产生之义。

items.def: to create or prepare something by combining materials or putting parts together; to cause something to exist or happen:
items.zh: 指制造、做、组装、使产生

examples.en: She makes her own clothes.
examples.zh: 她自己做衣服。

items.def: (rather informal) to make or prepare something, especially something artistic or something to eat:
items.zh: 指制作、准备（尤指艺术品或食品）

examples.en: He did a beautiful drawing of a house.
examples.zh: 他画了一栋漂亮的房子。

items.def: to make something exist or happen, especially something new that did not exist before:
items.zh: 指创造、创作、创建

examples.en: Scientists disagree about how the universe was created.
examples.zh: 科学家对宇宙是怎样形成的有分歧。

items.def: (used especially in business contexts) to think of and produce a new product:
items.zh: （尤用于商务语境）指开发、研制（产品）

examples.en: to develop new software
examples.zh: 开发新软件

items.def: to make things to be sold; to create something using skill:
items.zh: 指生产、制造（商品），（运用技巧）制作、造出

examples.en: a factory that produces microchips
examples.zh: 微芯片制造厂

items.def: to produce or create something, especially power, money or ideas:
items.zh: 指创造、产生（电、财富或主意）

examples.en: to generate electricity
examples.zh: 发电

items.def: [often passive] to make something from something else; to make something into something else:
items.zh: 指制作、组成、制成

examples.en: Rearrange the letters to form a new word.
examples.zh: 重新排列字母，组成另一单词。

senses.def: to show people that all members of a group have the same opinion about things
senses.zh: 形成统一战线；表现一致

examples.en: The prime minister stressed the need to present a united front.
examples.zh: 首相强调了团结一致的必要性。

form, present, etc. a united front.word: form, present, etc. a united front

senses.def: fitting your body closely, so that the shape of your body can be clearly seen

examples.en: She wore a form-fitting red dress.
examples.zh: 她穿了一条紧身连衣裙。

examples.en: The jacket is form-fitting but not tight.
examples.zh: 这件夹克合身但不紧身。

senses.def: a letter that is sent to a large number of people, often to answer a common complaint or question

examples.en: Do you know how to spot when a company has sent you a form letter?
examples.zh: 您知道如何识别公司何时向您发送了套用信函吗？

senses.def: very correct and suitable for official or important occasions
senses.zh: 适合正式场合的；正规的；庄重的

examples.en: ladies in formal evening wear
examples.zh: 穿晚礼服的女士们

examples.en: The dinner was a formal affair.
examples.zh: 这是正式宴会。

examples.en: He kept the tone of the letter formal and businesslike.
examples.zh: 他使这封信保持正式公文的语气。

examples.en: His manner was stiffly formal.
examples.zh: 他的举止十分僵硬。

senses.def: official; following an agreed or official way of doing things

examples.en: formal legal processes
examples.zh: 正式法律程序

examples.en: to make a formal complaint
examples.zh: 正式提出投诉

examples.en: There has been no formal announcement of her resignation yet.
examples.zh: 她辞职的消息尚未正式宣布。

examples.en: There followed a formal request for military aid.
examples.zh: 随后提出了正式的军事援助请求。

examples.en: Formal diplomatic relations between the two countries were re-established in December.
examples.zh: 两国于十二月重新建立了正式外交关系。

examples.en: It is time to put these arrangements on a slightly more formal basis.
examples.zh: 是应该把这些安排做得略为正式一点了。

senses.def: received in a school, college or university, with lessons, exams, etc., rather than gained just through practical experience

examples.en: He has no formal teaching qualifications.
examples.zh: 他没有正规的教学资历证明。

examples.en: Young children are beginning their formal education as early as four years old.
examples.zh: 幼儿早在四岁时就开始接受正规教育。

examples.en: Inness received little formal artistic training.
examples.zh: 英尼斯几乎没有接受过正规的艺术训练。

senses.def: connected with the way something is done rather than what is done
senses.zh: 方式上的；做法上的；形式上的

examples.en: Getting approval for the plan is a purely formal matter; nobody will seriously oppose it.
examples.zh: 计划报批纯粹是一个形式上的问题，没有人会当真反对的。

examples.en: The monarch retains largely formal duties.
examples.zh: 君主基本保留着形式上的职责。

examples.en: Critics have concentrated too much on the formal elements of her poetry, without really looking at what it is saying.
examples.zh: 评论家过多地集中评论她诗歌的形式，而没有真正看其内容。

senses.def: arranged in a regular manner, according to a clear, exact plan

examples.en: delightful formal gardens, with terraced lawns and an avenue of trees
examples.zh: 精心布置的有片片草坪和林荫道的宜人花园

examples.en: Large French doors on the first floor open out onto a formal garden.
examples.zh: 一楼的大型法式门通向一个正式的花园。

senses.def: a gas with a strong smell
a liquid made by mixing formaldehyde

examples.en: His most famous artistic offering consists of a dead shark floating in a tank of formaldehyde.
examples.zh: 他最著名的艺术作品是漂浮在甲醛罐中的死鲨鱼。

senses.def: a liquid made by mixing formaldehyde
a style or method in art, music, literature, etc. that pays more attention to the rules and the correct arrangement and appearance of things than to inner meaning and feelings

examples.en: The defence of formalism is always that it serves to control an excess of feeling.
examples.zh: 对形式主义的辩护始终是，它有助于控制过度的情感。

senses.def: paying more attention to the rules of correct arrangement and appearance of things than to inner meaning and feelings

examples.en: formalist theory
examples.zh: 形式主义理论

senses.def: an artist, musician, writer, etc. whose style or method is to pay more attention to the rules and the correct arrangement and appearance of things than to inner meaning and feelings
a thing that you must do as a formal or official part of a legal process, a social situation, etc.

examples.en: to go through all the formalities necessary in order to get a gun licence
examples.zh: 办理取得持枪执照的全部必要手续

examples.en: Let's skip the formalities and get down to business.
examples.zh: 咱们省去繁文缛节，开始讨论实质问题吧。

examples.en: It only took a few minutes to complete the legal formalities.
examples.zh: 完成法律手续只花了几分钟。

senses.def: a thing that you must do as part of an official process, but that has little meaning and will not affect what happens

examples.en: He already knows he has the job so the interview is a mere formality.
examples.zh: 他已经知道自己得到了这个工作，所以面试仅仅是走走过场。

examples.en: Your acceptance into the club will be a mere formality.
examples.zh: 只需要办一个简单的手续你就可以加入俱乐部。

senses.def: correct and formal behaviour

examples.en: Different levels of formality are appropriate in different situations.
examples.zh: 不同规格的礼节适用于不同场合。

examples.en: She greeted him with stiff formality.
examples.zh: 她拘谨地按礼节向他致意。

senses.def: the act of making an arrangement, a plan or a relationship official
senses.zh: 使（安排、计划、关系）成为正式的

examples.en: the formalization of business relationships
examples.zh: 业务关系的正规化

senses.def: the act of giving something a fixed structure or form by introducing rules
senses.zh: （通过规则）使有固定体系，使定形

examples.en: the formalization of decision-making
examples.zh: 决策的正规化

senses.def: to make an arrangement, a plan or a relationship official
senses.zh: 使（安排、计划、关系）成为正式的

examples.en: They decided to formalize their relationship by getting married.
examples.zh: 他们决定结婚，正式确定关系。

senses.def: to give something a fixed structure or form by introducing rules
senses.zh: （通过规则）使有固定体系，使定形

examples.en: The college has a highly formalized system of assessment.
examples.zh: 这所学院有一套十分固定的评估体系。

senses.def: in a very correct way that is suitable for official or important occasions
senses.zh: 适合正式场合的；正规的；庄重的

examples.en: ‘How do you do?’ she said formally.
examples.zh: “你好！”她很正式地说。

senses.def: officially; in a way that follows an agreed or official way of doing things

examples.en: The accounts were formally approved by the board.
examples.zh: 账目已由董事会正式批准。

senses.def: through lessons, exams, etc. received in a school, college or university rather than just through practical experience

examples.en: Although not formally trained as an art historian, he is widely respected for his knowledge of the period.
examples.zh: 虽然他不是科班出身的艺术史学家，但因对这一时期的通晓而受到广泛尊重。

senses.def: in the way that something appears or is presented
senses.zh: 正式地：以某种形式出现或呈现的方式

examples.en: Formally, the distinction between town and country workers was clear, but in practice there was some overlap.
examples.zh: 形式上，城镇工人和乡村工人之间的区别是明确的，但实际上存在一些重叠。

senses.def: in a regular manner, according to a clear, exact plan

examples.en: The gardens were formally arranged.
examples.zh: 花园被正式布置。

senses.def: the general arrangement, plan, design, etc. of something

examples.en: The format of the new quiz show has proved popular.
examples.zh: 事实证明新的知识竞赛节目的形式很受欢迎。

senses.def: the shape and size of a book, magazine, etc.

examples.en: They've brought out the magazine in a new format.
examples.zh: 他们用新的开本出版这一杂志。

examples.en: The book is now available in a slightly smaller format.
examples.zh: 这本书现在有略小一些的开本在售。

senses.def: the way in which data is stored or held to be worked on by a computer

examples.en: The images are stored in a digital format within the database.
examples.zh: 图像以数字格式存储在数据库中。

examples.en: The drive supports the following DVD formats.
examples.zh: 这个驱动器支持下列 DVD 格式。

senses.def: to arrange text in a particular way on a page or a screen
to prepare a computer disk for storing digital information
the action of forming something; the process of being formed

examples.en: the formation of a new government
examples.zh: 组成新政府

examples.en: evidence of recent star formation in the galaxy
examples.zh: 银河系新恒星形成的证据

senses.def: a thing that has been formed, especially in a particular place or in a particular way

examples.en: Massive rock formations rise abruptly some 1 500 feet above the canyon floor.
examples.zh: 巨大的岩层突然升起，高出峡谷底部约 1 500 英尺。

senses.def: a particular arrangement or pattern

examples.en: formation flying
examples.zh: 编队飞行

examples.en: aircraft flying in formation
examples.zh: 编队飞行的飞机

examples.en: The team usually plays in a 4-4-2 formation.
examples.zh: 这支球队比赛通常排出的是 4–4–2 阵形。

senses.def: the activity of performing a dance as part of a group that consists of several couples. Formation dancing
senses.zh: 编队舞蹈：一种舞蹈活动，是由几对夫妇组成的小组的一部分。编队舞蹈通常在比赛中进行。

senses.def: having an important and lasting influence on the development of something or of somebody’s character
senses.zh: （对某事物或性格的发展）有持续重大影响的

examples.en: the formative years of childhood
examples.zh: 童年性格形成的时期

examples.en: formative influences in the development of the labour movement
examples.zh: 对工人运动发展的形成性影响

senses.def: that existed in earlier times

examples.en: This fine ruin was, in former times, a royal castle.
examples.zh: 这个保留完好的遗址以前是座皇家城堡。

examples.en: This beautiful old building has been restored to its former glory.
examples.zh: 这座美丽的老建筑物已恢复了昔日的壮观。

examples.en: her former life as a Russian ballerina
examples.zh: 她的前身是俄罗斯芭蕾舞演员

senses.def: that used to have a particular position or status in the past

examples.en: the 41-year-old former world champion
examples.zh: 41岁的前世界冠军

examples.en: the former president/prime minister
examples.zh: 前总统；前总理

senses.def: an American fort
senses.zh: 提康德罗加堡（Fort Ticonderoga）：1755年，法国人在纽约州东北部由卡里永堡（Fort Carillon）建造的美国要塞（国防的坚固军事建筑）。英国军队于1759年在法国和印度战争中占领了它，并将其命名为Fort Ticonderoga。在美国独立战争期间，它于1775年由本尼迪克特·阿诺德（Benedict Arnold）和伊桑·艾伦（Ethan Allen）领导的“绿山男孩”（Green Mountain Boys）占领，但1777年约翰·布尔戈因将军（John Burgoyne）将军再次占领了它。它现在是一座博物馆。

examples.zh: 让家里人吃味道好又健康的餐食并不需要花许多钱。

examples.zh: 她希望她在美国的首次演出将是她走上名利双收之路的第一步。

examples.zh: 他积累了近20亿美元的财富。

examples.zh: 她投入了很大一部分个人财富来确保公司的生存。

examples.zh: 我有幸与一些卓越的主管人员共事。

examples.zh: 他运气好，几乎立刻找到了工作。

examples.en: the fortunes of war

examples.zh: 当公众品味发生变化时，该公司的命运发生了巨大逆转。

senses.def: a person’s fate

examples.zh: 他们去找人算命。

examples.zh: 许多人移民到澳大利亚寻求财富。

examples.zh: 我打个盹儿就会感到好得多。

senses.def: an event or medium where people can exchange opinions and ideas on a particular issue; a meeting organized for this purpose

examples.zh: 举行药物滥用问题国际论坛

examples.zh: 电视现在成了政治辩论的重要平台。

senses.def: a website or web page where users can put comments about a particular issue or topic and reply to other users' comments

examples.zh: 互联网论坛

examples.en: It's a forum where new parents can exchange questions, advice and support.
examples.zh: 这是一个新父母可以交流问题、建议和支持的论坛。

senses.def: (in ancient Rome) a public place where meetings were held

examples.en: She leaned forward and kissed him on the cheek.
examples.zh: 她倾身向前，吻了他的面颊。

examples.en: He took two steps forwards.
examples.zh: 他向前走了两步。

examples.zh: 他们跑向前去欢迎她。

examples.zh: 队伍缓缓前行。

examples.zh: 转动手腕，使手掌朝前。

examples.zh: 他站在火边，前后摇晃着。

senses.def: towards the future; ahead in time

examples.en: Looking forward, we hope to expand our operations in several of our overseas branches.
examples.zh: 展望未来，我们希望拓展几家海外分公司的业务。

examples.zh: 下一个场面是描述故事中五年后的情况。

examples.en: The series moves back and forward through time.
examples.zh: 该系列随着时间的推移来回移动。

examples.en: from this day forward

examples.zh: 我们认为，这项协定是向前迈出了重要的一步。

examples.en: Cutting our costs is the only way forward.
examples.zh: 降低成本是我们发展的唯一途径。

examples.zh: 我们的讨论没有取得任何进展。

examples.en: The project will go forward (= continue) as planned.
examples.zh: 这个项目将按计划继续进行。

examples.en: The 21st century has seen trade between the two countries leap forward.
examples.zh: 进入21世纪，两国贸易实现跨越式发展。

senses.def: earlier; sooner

examples.en: It was decided to bring the meeting forward two weeks.
examples.zh: 已决定把会议提前两周。

senses.def: in or towards the front part of a ship or plane
senses.zh: 在（或向）船头；在（或向）机首

examples.en: The main cabin is situated forward of (= in front of) the mast.
examples.zh: 主舱在桅杆的前面。

examples.zh: 她坐在摇椅上前后摇晃着。

examples.en: The film skips backwards and forwards through time.
examples.zh: 影片随着时间的推移来回跳跃。

senses.def: in the future, starting from now

examples.en: We have a very solid financial position going forward.
examples.zh: 今后我们会有非常稳健的财务状况。

examples.en: The strategy going forward is still undecided.
examples.zh: 未来的策略尚未确定。

examples.en: Moving forward, we need to have a real plan.
examples.zh: 展望未来，我们需要有一个真正的计划。

senses.def: to make a great effort to do something, especially if it is difficult or you are feeling tired

examples.zh: 门开了，挡住他前进的路。

examples.zh: 飞机前舱门的一个门闩可能脱落了。

examples.zh: 历史的向前发展

examples.zh: 一开始就为未来作点打算能节约很多开支。

examples.en: The plans are still no further forward than they were last month.
examples.zh: 计划无丝毫进展，仍是上个月的老样子。

senses.def: behaving towards somebody in a manner that is too confident or too informal

examples.en: I hope you don't think I'm being too forward.
examples.zh: 我希望你不要认为我太冒失。

senses.def: to send or pass goods or information to somebody

examples.zh: 我们将于下星期给你寄上新的商品目录。

examples.zh: 我们将于下星期给你寄上新的商品目录。

examples.zh: 我把杰夫发给我的电子邮件转发给你。

examples.en: to forward a request/complaint/proposal
examples.zh: 提出要求／投诉／建议

examples.en: Could you forward any mail to us in New York?
examples.zh: 你能不能把所有信件转寄到纽约给我们？

examples.en: I put ‘please forward’ on the envelope.
examples.zh: 我在信封上写了“请转递”。

examples.zh: 他把这项任务看作事业发展的途径。

examples.zh: 她使用各种手段来推进剧情。

examples.en: They have done a great deal to forward the cause of world peace.
examples.zh: 他们为推动世界和平事业做出了巨大贡献。

examples.zh: 化石燃料燃烧时会产生大量二氧化碳。

examples.zh: 俱乐部的宗旨是促进团体内部的关系。

examples.zh: 在过去十年间，他们抚育了 60 多个儿童。

examples.zh: 我们不能领养孩子，所以决定代养一个。

examples.zh: 污浊难闻的空气／气息

examples.zh: 臭烘烘的监狱

examples.zh: 人们把这次的流行病归咎于污浊的饮用水。

examples.zh: 她的情绪很糟。

examples.zh: 他爆发出滔滔不绝的脏话。

examples.en: I'm sick of her foul mouth (= habit of swearing).
examples.zh: 我讨厌她一开口就骂人的那张臭嘴。

examples.en: He called us the foulest names imaginable.
examples.zh: 他用可以想象到的最恶毒的名字来称呼我们。

senses.def: very bad, with strong winds and rain

examples.en: a foul night
examples.zh: 风雨交加的夜晚

senses.def: very evil or cruel

examples.zh: 邪恶的罪行；恶毒的谋杀

examples.zh: 哈珀因铲球犯规而受到处罚。

examples.zh: 她决心要赢，那怕是不择手段。

senses.zh: （因做错事或不法行为）与…发生麻烦，与…产生纠葛，冒犯

examples.zh: 触犯了法律

examples.zh: 禁止狗在草地便溺。

examples.zh: 越来越多的海滩因石油泄漏而受到污染。

examples.zh: 绳索缠住了螺旋桨。

examples.zh: 缆绳缠在螺旋桨上了。

examples.en: A rope fouled up (= became twisted) as we pulled the sail down.
examples.zh: 我们收帆时有一根绳索缠住了。

items.zh: repulsive 通常指人或其行为习惯刺激感官或有违道德而令人厌恶。

examples.zh: 警方立即开始调查，但没有怀疑谋杀。

examples.zh: 快要犯满离场也意味着他们失去了明星球员斯蒂芬·库里。

examples.zh: 这趋势威胁社会的基本结构。

senses.def: a first name for girls

senses.zh: （公司授予的）特许经销权；（国家授予的）特别经营权，特许

examples.zh: 他在当地开着一家比萨饼专卖店。

examples.zh: 成年人普选权

examples.en: The 1918 Reform Act extended the franchise to women over 30.
examples.zh: 1918 年改革法案将选举权扩大到 30 岁以上的女性。

senses.def: a set of films in which the same characters appear in related stories
senses.zh: 电影系列（一部电影衍生出一系列续集的系列电影）

examples.en: Disney has successfully revived the ‘Star Wars’ franchise, with four films already released and more in the works.
examples.zh: 迪士尼成功复兴了《星球大战》系列电影，四部电影已经上映，还有更多电影正在制作中。

senses.def: to give or sell a franchise
senses.zh: 授予（或出售）特许经销权（或经营权）

examples.zh: 餐饮特许经营权已授予一家私人公司。

senses.zh: （职业运动队的）王牌球员，建队基石

examples.en: If he played like this more consistently then he could be a franchise player.
examples.zh: 如果他能更稳定地打出这样的表现，那么他可能会成为一名特许球员。

senses.def: a first name for boys
(1561-1626) an English lawyer, politician and philosopher
senses.zh: 弗朗西斯·培根（1561–1626）英国律师、政治家、哲学家。职业生涯早期平步青云，1618 年成为国王詹姆斯一世的大法官，后因被控受贿而入狱，虽仅四天即获释，但终身未能重返公职。作品有《学术的进展》（1605），体现出对世界的科学兴趣，在当时可谓让人耳目一新。1856 年以来，有人称其为莎士比亚戏剧的真正作者，因为他们认为莎士比亚的教育和社会背景不足以让他写出如此伟大的文学作品。

senses.def: (1909-92) an Irish painter who lived in England from 1928. He often painted people who were in pain or who were being treated in a cruel way, making their bodies look ugly and twisted
senses.zh: 弗朗西斯·培根（1909–1992，爱尔兰画家，1928 年起定居英国，常描绘受苦或受虐者，以丑陋和扭曲变形的形象来凸显痛苦感；一旦他对自己的某幅作品不满意，就会毁掉它）

senses.def: (1584-1616) an English writer of plays, many of which he wrote with John Fletcher
senses.zh: 弗朗西斯·博蒙特（Francis Beaumont）：（1584-1616）一位英国戏剧作家，他与约翰·弗莱彻（John Fletcher）一起写作。他最著名的剧作是《烧杵骑士》（1607年），他可能独自写过。他还帮助本·琼森（Ben Jonson）撰写了几本戏剧。

senses.def: (1901-72) an English yachtsman
senses.zh: 弗朗西斯·奇切斯特（Francis Chichester）：（1901-72）英国游艇手。1960年，他赢得了横跨大西洋的第一场比赛，该比赛是人们独自乘游艇航行的。1966-7岁时，他以65岁高龄独自一人环游世界而闻名。1967年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1916-2004) an English scientist. His work with James Watson at the Cavendish Laboratory
senses.zh: 弗朗西斯·克里克（Francis Crick）：（1916-2004）英国科学家。他与卡文迪许实验室（Cavendish Laboratory）的詹姆斯·沃森（James Watson）合作，于1953年发现了DNA结构。克里克（Crick），沃森（Watson）和莫里斯·威尔金斯（Maurice Wilkins）于1962年因这项工作而获得了诺贝尔奖。克里克后来的职业涉及视觉系统和大脑，他在1994年出版了关于这一主题的书《惊人的假说》。他于1992年成为优异勋章的成员。

senses.def: (c. 1540-96) an English sailor who fought against the Spanish and was the first Englishman to sail around the world. After a career attacking and robbing
senses.zh: 弗朗西斯·德雷克（Francis Drake）：（大约1540-96年）是一位与西班牙人作战的英国水手，并且是第一位环游世界的英国人。在袭击和抢劫加勒比海的西班牙船只之后，伊丽莎白一世女王给了他五艘船，以环游世界，一路攻击西班牙的船只。三年后（1580年），他乘坐唯一一艘幸存的战舰“金色后腿”号返回伊丽莎白女王，任命他为骑士。1587年，西班牙人准备进攻英格兰，但德雷克率领突袭加的斯港并烧毁了西班牙船只。1588年西班牙人进行的名为“舰队”的进攻终于来了，德雷克是击败它的领导人之一。有一个流行的故事，他是在首次出现无敌舰队时就在打碗，而且他冷静地完成了比赛，然后将注意力转移到敌人身上。

senses.def: (1840-79) a Welsh priest known for his diary, which describes country life in Wales in the 1870s
senses.zh: 弗朗西斯·基尔弗特（Francis Kilvert）：（1840-79）以他的日记而闻名的威尔士神父，他描述了1870年代威尔士的乡村生活

senses.def: (1824-97) an English writer and teacher. He was professor
senses.zh: 弗朗西斯·帕格拉夫（Francis Palgrave）：（1824-97）是一位英语作家和老师。1885年至1895年，他曾担任牛津大学的诗歌教授。他因精选英国诗歌而被人们铭记，该诗出版为《金库》，至今仍被称为帕尔格雷夫的库。他还写了几本自己的诗集。

senses.def: (c. 1532-90) an English politician. He was a close adviser
senses.zh: 弗朗西斯·沃尔辛厄姆（Francis Walsingham）：（约1532-90年）英国政治家。他曾是伊丽莎白女王一世的亲密顾问，并于1577年被任命为骑士。通过建立间谍组织，他帮助揭示了针对女王的巴宾顿剧情，并于1587年在西班牙人到达之前就警告了政府。舰队。

senses.def: a member of a religious organization started in 1209 by St Francis of Assisi in Italy
senses.zh: 方济各会修士（方济各会于 1209 年由圣方济各创办）

senses.def: relating to St Francis or to this organization
senses.zh: 圣方济各的；方济各会的

examples.en: a Franciscan monk
examples.zh: 方济各会修士

examples.zh: 亲法的人

examples.zh: 非洲西部说法语的国家。

examples.zh: 法语电视频道

examples.zh: 母语为法语的加拿大人

senses.def: a tropical American tree or bush with groups of white, pink, or yellow flowers
senses.zh: 鸡蛋花树（或灌木）（产于美洲热带）

senses.def: a perfume
the use of English words in French, from the French words français
senses.zh: （法语中的）英语外来语法语中对英语单词的使用。franglais一词来源于两个法语单词，即français（法语）和anglais（英语）。许多法国人不喜欢诸如le weekend（周末）或le fair play（公平竞争）之类的英语外来语，因为他们认为这些外来语会使法语变得不纯正。

senses.def: language that is a mixture of French and English that sounds funny
senses.zh: （听起来很滑稽的）夹杂英语的法语

examples.en: ‘C'est pas une good news,’ he said in his best franglais.
examples.zh: “这不是一个好消息，”他用自己最好的夹杂着英语的法语说。

senses.def: honest and direct in what you say, sometimes in a way that other people might not like

examples.en: a full and frank discussion
examples.zh: 坦诚而充分的讨论

examples.en: a frank admission of guilt
examples.zh: 坦率承认心里有愧

examples.en: He was very frank about his relationship with the actress.
examples.zh: 他对自己和那位女演员的关系直言不讳。

examples.en: To be frank with you, I think your son has little chance of passing the exam.
examples.zh: 坦诚相告，我认为你的儿子不大可能通过考试。

senses.def: to stamp a mark on an envelope
senses.zh: （在信件上）盖邮资已付印记，盖免付邮资印记

senses.def: a first name for boys, sometimes short for Francis
senses.zh: 弗兰克（男子名，有时为 Francis 缩写）

synonyms.words: frank ▪ direct ▪ open ▪ outspoken ▪ straight ▪ blunt

intro.en: These words all describe people saying exactly what they mean without trying to hide feelings, opinions or facts.
intro.zh: 以上各词均形容人坦率、坦诚。

items.def: not hiding the truth about something:
items.zh: 指坦率的、坦诚的

examples.en: Thank you for being so honest with me.
examples.zh: 感谢你对我这么坦诚。

items.def: honest in what you say, sometimes in a way that other people might not like:
items.zh: 指坦率的、直率的（有时可能不讨人喜欢）

examples.en: To be frank with you, I think your son has little chance of passing the exam.
examples.zh: 坦诚相告，我认为你的儿子不大可能通过考试。

items.def: saying exactly what you mean in a way that nobody can pretend not to understand:
items.zh: 指直接的、直率的、坦率的

examples.en: You’ll have to get used to his direct manner.
examples.zh: 你得慢慢习惯他这种直率的方式。

items.def: (approving) (of a person) not keeping thoughts and feelings hidden:
items.zh: 指为人诚恳的、坦诚的、直率的

examples.en: He was quite open about his reasons for leaving.
examples.zh: 他对离开的原因完全未加隐瞒。

items.def: saying exactly what you think, even if this shocks or offends people:
items.zh: 指直率的、坦诚的、直言不讳的

examples.en: She was outspoken in her criticism of the plan.
examples.zh: 她对该计划的批评直言不讳。

items.def: honest and direct:
items.zh: 指坦诚的、直率的

examples.en: I don’t think you’re being straight with me.
examples.zh: 我觉得你没跟我坦诚相见。

items.def: saying exactly what you think without trying to be polite:
items.zh: 指嘴直的、直言不讳的

examples.en: She has a reputation for blunt speaking.
examples.zh: 她说话出了名的直截了当。

senses.def: (1897-1991) a US film director known especially for his comedies. His best films show an ordinary, good person fighting against evil people in business or government. Capra received Oscars
senses.zh: 弗兰克·卡普拉（Frank Capra）：（1897-1991）美国电影导演，以喜剧闻名。他的最佳影片显示了一个普通的善良的人，与企业或政府中的邪恶分子作斗争。卡普拉（Capra）因《发生了一个夜晚》（1934）获得了奥斯卡奖，《迪兹先生去城镇》（1936）和《你不能随身带》（1938）获得了奥斯卡奖。

senses.def: (1869-1959) a leading US architect who helped to develop modern architecture. His 'prairie-style' houses used long, low lines and open spaces inside, and his ' organic
senses.zh: 弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特（Frank Lloyd Wright）：（1869-1959）是美国领先的建筑师，曾帮助开发现代建筑。他的“草原风格”房屋在室内使用了较长，矮小的线条和开放空间，而他的“有机”建筑物则设计为与自然环境相匹配，并经常使用其材料。莱特最著名的建筑之一是古根海姆博物馆。

senses.def: (1920-98) an English broadcaster
senses.zh: 弗兰克·缪尔（Frank Muir）：（1920-98）英国广播公司和喜剧作家，他与丹尼斯·诺登（Denis Norden）一起为广播和电视撰写了几部成功的喜剧系列，其中包括《从这里取走》（1947-58）。他出现在许多流行的面板游戏和测验节目中，并且以其幽默的幽默而闻名。他还写了一本小说和儿童读物。

senses.def: (1915-98) one of the most popular US singers from the 1940s to the 1960s, who continued performing into the 1980s. He also acted in many films. His popular name was 'Old Blue Eyes', and he was known for his romantic voice. He became famous in the 1940s with the big band of Tommy Dorsey. His many successful records included All the Way
senses.zh: 弗兰克·辛纳屈（Frank Sinatra）：（1915-98）从1940年代到1960年代一直是美国最受欢迎的歌手之一，并一直持续到1980年代。他还参演过许多电影。他的俗名是“老蓝眼睛”，以浪漫的嗓音而闻名。他在1940年代与汤米·多尔西（Tommy Dorsey）的大乐队一起出名。他的许多成功唱片包括《 All Way》（1957年），《 Witchcraft》（1958年），《 Trangers in the Night》（1966年）和《 My Way》（1968年）。他的电影包括《在城镇上》（1949年），《从这里到永恒》（1953年），其中他获得了奥斯卡奖以及《上流社会》（1956年）。他的四次婚姻中有两次是与演员艾娃·加德纳（Ava Gardner）和米娅·法罗（Mia Farrow）结婚的。

senses.def: (1907-96) an English engineer, best known for inventing the jet
senses.zh: 弗兰克·惠特尔（Frank Whittle）：（1907-96）是一位英国工程师，以发明喷气发动机而闻名，喷气发动机是当今大多数飞机上使用的发动机类型，它通过向后方释放高速气流来向前移动。1948年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1940-93) a US singer and writer of rock
senses.zh: 弗兰克·扎帕（Frank Zappa）：（ 1940-93年），美国摇滚歌手和作家，在嬉皮士中特别受欢迎。他于1964年加入“灵魂巨人”小组，一年后更名为“发明之母”。他们以“迷幻摇滚”，狂野的舞台表演和故意令人震惊的歌曲而闻名。他们的专辑包括Freak Out（1966）。Zappa后来在没有乐队的情况下制作了专辑Hot Rats（1970）。

senses.def: food that has been genetically modified
senses.zh: 转基因食品；基因改造食品

senses.def: used to talk about something that somebody creates or invents that goes out of control and becomes dangerous, often destroying the person who created it
senses.zh: 失控的受造物（常毁灭创造者）

examples.en: The organization has now become a Frankenstein monster beyond the control of the people who created it.
examples.zh: 该组织现在已经成为一个弗兰肯斯坦怪物，超出了创建者的控制范围。

examples.en: If you were going to do a Frankenstein and put a swimmer together from scratch, you would build Michael Phelps.
examples.zh: 如果你要从头开始制作一个弗兰肯斯坦并组装一个游泳运动员，你会建造迈克尔·菲尔普斯。

examples.en: Can genetic engineering shake off its Frankenstein image?
examples.zh: 基因工程能否摆脱弗兰肯斯坦的形象？

senses.def: a long thin smoked sausage
senses.zh: 法兰克福熏肠（常用于做热狗）

senses.def: an old US ballad
senses.zh: 弗兰基（Frankie）和约翰尼（Johnny）：美国的一首古老民谣，讲述一个女人谋杀情人并被绞死的女人。在故事中，弗兰基（Frankie）在孟菲斯的一家旅馆里看到约翰尼（Johnny）和爱丽丝·普瑞（Alice Pry），并向他开了三枪。大多数经文以“他是她的男人，但他做错了她”为结尾

senses.def: (1921-92) an English comedian
senses.zh: 弗兰基·豪威尔（Frankie Howerd）：（1921-92）是一位英国喜剧演员，以夸张的讲笑话而闻名，当听众以为他以粗鲁的方式表现出幽默时，他似乎感到震惊。他可能在上庞贝（Up-Pompeii！）（1970-71）的演出中被最佳地记住，这是一部有关古罗马人的电视喜剧系列。

senses.def: (1913-2007) a US singer, songwriter
senses.zh: 弗兰基·莱恩（Frankie Laine）：（1913-2007）是一位美国歌手，词曲作者和演员，声音很强，在1950年代特别受欢迎，当时他的13张唱片每张销量都超过一百万张。他们包括耶洗别（1951），拉威德（1952），正午（1952）和我相信（1953）。

senses.def: a substance that is burnt to give a pleasant smell, especially during religious ceremonies
senses.zh: 乳香（点燃时散发出香味，尤用于宗教礼仪）

senses.def: a machine that prints an official mark on a letter to show that the cost of posting it has been paid, or does not need to be paid

senses.def: Franklin Delano Roosevelt (1882-1945) a Democratic
senses.zh: 富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福（Franklin Delano Roosevelt，1882-1945 年）是一位民主党政治家，成为第 32 任美国总统（1933-45 年），也被非正式地称为“罗斯福”，也是唯一一位当选四次的总统。 1921 年，他患上了小儿麻痹症（一种影响神经系统的严重疾病），结果在没有帮助的情况下几乎无法行走。在成为总统之前，他曾担任纽约州州长（1929-33 年）。作为总统，他推出了帮助美国从大萧条中复苏的新政计划。罗斯福是一个性格开朗的人，他通过广播中的炉边谈话给美国人带来了信心。在美国加入第二次世界大战之前，他支持英国的租借计划。战争结束前夕，他在担任总统期间去世。另请参阅《四大自由》、《曼哈顿计划》、《雅尔塔》“我们唯一值得恐惧的就是恐惧本身。”FD Roosevelt 1933

(1899-1987) a US dancer, singer and actor. His many musical films included Top Hat

senses.def: (1915-2001) an English astrophysicist
senses.zh: 弗雷德·霍伊尔（Fred Hoyle）：（1915-2001）英国天体物理学家（研究恒星结构等的科学家）。他发展了有关恒星起源和生命本身的理论，并撰写了许多科普著作。他还写过科幻小说。1972年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1909-97) an English tennis player who won the Wimbledon
senses.zh: 弗雷德·佩里（Fred Perry）：（1909-97）一位英国网球选手，连续三年（1934-36）赢得了温网男子冠军。从那时起，没有英国人赢得过比赛。在从事网球事业之前，佩里（Perry）在1929年曾获得男子乒乓球世界冠军。后来，他创立了一家运动服装公司。

senses.def: (1931-2006) a famous English cricket
senses.zh: 弗雷德·特鲁曼（Fred Trueman）：（1931-2006）一位著名的英国板球运动员。他是一名快速投球手，曾为约克郡（1949-68）和英格兰（1952-65）效力。他以球员的进取态度而闻名，因此他有时被称为“ Fiery Fred”，并且经常与板球当局发生麻烦。他是比赛历史上第一个投球手，在测试赛中（国际比赛中）使用300个小门。在不再是一名球员之后，他定期出现在广播节目“特别比赛”中。在英国，板球运动使人们对他的喜爱和娱乐性都很高。

senses.def: (1907-97) a US film director who won Oscars
senses.zh: 弗雷德·津内曼：（1907-97），美国电影导演曾凭借《从这里到永恒》（1953年）和《四季人》（1966年）获得奥斯卡奖，但并不是他最著名的电影《高中午》（1952年）。他出生于奥地利，1929年去了好莱坞。他的其他电影包括俄克拉荷马州！（1955年），《努恩的故事》（1959年）和《杰克尔日》（1973年）。

a married couple at the centre of one of the most famous and terrible criminal cases in Britain in the 20th century. Over a number of years they together murdered a number of young women and buried them in the garden and cellar
senses.zh: 弗雷德里克（Frederick）和罗斯玛丽·韦斯特（Rosemary West）：一对已婚夫妇，是20世纪英国最著名和最可怕的刑事案件之一。多年来，他们一起谋杀了许多年轻妇女，并将其埋在格洛斯特克伦威尔街的房屋花园和地窖中。这些尸体于1994年被发现，这所房子被称为“恐怖之屋”。

senses.def: (1904-88) a British ballet
senses.zh: 弗雷德里克·阿什顿（Frederick Ashton）：（1904-88）英国芭蕾舞演员兼编舞（为舞蹈设计步法和动作的人）。他是皇家芭蕾舞团的第一位编舞，后来是导演（1963-70年）。他最著名的芭蕾舞剧是《立面》，《 La Fille MalGardée》和《乡村月份》。1962年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1862-1934) an English composer

senses.def: (1817-95) an African American who escaped slavery

senses.def: (1918-2013) an English scientist. He was the first scientist to receive two Nobel Prizes

senses.def: not being used

examples.en: He held out his free hand and I took it.
examples.zh: 他伸出空着的一只手，我就抓住了。

examples.en: Is this seat free?
examples.zh: 这个座位空着吗？

senses.def: costing nothing

examples.en: Admission is free.
examples.zh: 免费入场。

examples.en: free software/tickets
examples.zh: 免费软件／门票

examples.en: We even offer a free web design service.
examples.zh: 我们甚至提供免费网页设计服务。

examples.en: We''ll give you a fabulous free gift with each copy you buy.
examples.zh: 您每购买一本，我们都会赠送一份精美的免费礼物。

examples.en: Use of the pool is free to members.
examples.zh: 会员可以免费使用游泳池。

examples.en: Updates are free for registered users.
examples.zh: 注册用户可以免费更新。

examples.en: You can't expect people to work for free (= without payment).
examples.zh: 你不能指望人无偿工作。

senses.def: not under the control or in the power of somebody else; able to do what you want
senses.zh: 能随自己意愿的；随心所欲的

examples.en: I have no ambitions other than to have a happy life and be free.
examples.zh: 我没有雄心大志，只求自由自在地过幸福生活。

examples.en: Students have a free choice of modules in their final year.
examples.zh: 学生在最后一学年可以自由选择课程单元。

examples.en: You are free to leave at any time.
examples.zh: 你随时可以离开。

examples.en: The government wants to leave companies free to make their own decisions.
examples.zh: 政府想给公司自主决策的权利。

examples.en: The organization wants to remain free from government control.
examples.zh: 该组织希望继续免受政府控制。

examples.en: We want an independent state free of foreign interference.
examples.zh: 我们想要一个不受外国干涉的独立国家。

examples.en: ‘Can I sit here?’ ‘Please, feel free (= of course you can).’
examples.zh: “我能坐这儿吗？”“请，您随意。”

examples.en: Feel free to email me if you have any questions.
examples.zh: 如果您有任何疑问，请随时给我发电子邮件。

senses.def: not limited or controlled by anyone else
senses.zh: 不受限制的；不受控制的

examples.en: A true democracy needs free speech and a free press.
examples.zh: 真正的民主需要言论自由和新闻自由。

examples.en: He called for free and fair elections.
examples.zh: 他呼吁举行自由公正的选举。

examples.en: They gave me free access to all the files.
examples.zh: 他们让我自由查阅所有档案资料。

senses.def: not a prisoner or slave
senses.zh: 自由的（不是囚犯或奴隶）

examples.en: He walked out of jail a free man.
examples.zh: 他获释出狱，成为自由人。

examples.en: The hostages were all set free.
examples.zh: 人质全部获释。

examples.en: The hacker is currently free on bail.
examples.zh: 该黑客目前已获保释。

senses.def: not tied up or in a cage
senses.zh: 未拴住的；非关在笼中的

examples.en: The researchers set the birds free.
examples.zh: 研究人员把鸟放了。

examples.en: Our livestock is free to roam.
examples.zh: 我们的牲畜可以自由漫步。

senses.def: clear; not blocked

examples.en: Ensure there is a free flow of air around the machine.
examples.zh: 要确保机器周围空气畅通。

examples.en: the free movement of traffic
examples.zh: 交通自由流动

senses.def: not containing or affected by something harmful or unpleasant
senses.zh: 不含有害物的；不受…伤害（或影响等的）

examples.en: free from artificial colours and flavourings
examples.zh: 不含人工色素和人工调味料

examples.en: Everyone deserves to live free from fear.
examples.zh: 每个人都应该过上没有恐惧的生活。

examples.en: free of defects/problems/symptoms
examples.zh: 无缺陷/问题/症状

examples.en: Beef producers want their herds free of disease.
examples.zh: 牛肉生产商希望他们的牛群不生病。

examples.en: It was several weeks before he was completely free of pain.
examples.zh: 过了几星期他的疼痛才完全消除。

examples.en: We've managed to keep the garden free of weeds this year.
examples.zh: 今年，我们彻底清除了花园里的杂草。

senses.def: without the thing mentioned

examples.en: pure, additive-free ingredients
examples.zh: 纯粹而无添加剂的原料

examples.en: a trouble-free life
examples.zh: 无忧无虑的生活

examples.en: After six months of treatment he is cancer-free.
examples.zh: 经过六个月的治疗，他的癌症痊愈了。

senses.def: not attached to something; not stuck somewhere and unable to move

examples.en: Pull gently on the free end of the rope.
examples.zh: 轻拉绳索松开的一端。

examples.en: She finally managed to pull herself free.
examples.zh: 她终于设法挣脱了。

examples.en: They tied him up but he managed to get free.
examples.zh: 他们把他捆了起来，但他设法挣脱了。

examples.en: They had to be cut free from their car after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故后，得破开汽车把他们救出来。

examples.en: The boat had broken free of its moorings.
examples.zh: 那条船的系泊绳索松脱了。

examples.en: They swam free of the wreckage.
examples.zh: 他们游出了残骸。

senses.group: not attached/able to move 未缚住；能活动

senses.def: ready to give something, especially when it is not wanted

examples.en: He's too free with his opinions.
examples.zh: 他太随便发表意见了。

senses.group: ready to give 乐于给予

senses.def: a free
senses.zh: 不拘泥原文的；（翻译）根据大意的；意译的

senses.def: to have done something successfully, especially when it was difficult

examples.en: I could see the finish line and thought I was home free.
examples.zh: 我可以看到终点线，以为我已经回家了。

senses.def: informal; relaxed
senses.zh: 随便；无拘束；轻松；自由自在

examples.en: Life was never going to be so free and easy again.
examples.zh: 生活绝不会再那样无拘无束了。

senses.def: if you give somebody a free pass
senses.zh: 饶恕某人,放某人一马;侥幸逃脱,免受惩罚,被原谅

examples.en: This time he gets a free pass but if he does it again, he’ll be sent to jail.
examples.zh: 这一次他侥幸逃脱了惩罚，但如果他再犯，他将被送进监狱。

examples.en: Just because someone has expensive designer gear, it doesn't mean they have a free pass to be mean to my staff.
examples.zh: 仅仅因为某人拥有昂贵的设计师服装，并不意味着他们就可以随便对我的员工恶语相向。

senses.def: to get, have, etc. the opportunity to do what you want to do and to make your own decisions
senses.zh: 可以全权处理；有自主权

examples.en: I was given a free hand in designing the syllabus.
examples.zh: 我获准全权制订教学大纲。

senses.def: to get or take something without paying because somebody else is paying for it
senses.zh: 白白得到好处（因他人已代付款）

senses.def: to give somebody complete freedom of action; to allow a feeling to be expressed freely
senses.zh: 对…不加约束；放任自由；充分表达（感情）

examples.en: The designer was given free rein.
examples.zh: 设计者可以自由发挥。

examples.en: The script allows full rein to her larger-than-life acting style.
examples.zh: 剧本允许她充分展现她那夸张的表演风格。

examples.en: When I paint I just give my imagination free rein.
examples.zh: 画画时我只是任凭想象自由驰骋。

senses.def: used as a reply when somebody suggests that you should not do something, or when somebody has asked permission or said they are going to do something
senses.zh: 这是个自由的国家（用于回答，表示自己或对方可自由决定做什么）

examples.en: It's a free country; I'll say what I like!
examples.zh: 这是个自由的国家，我想说什么就说什么！

examples.en: Wear what you like. It's a free country.
examples.zh: 穿你喜欢的衣服。这是一个自由的国家。

examples.en: ‘It's a free country!’ he shouted. ‘I can do what I like!’
examples.zh: “这是一个自由的国家！”他喊道，“我可以做我喜欢的事情。”

senses.def: used to say that it is not possible to get something for nothing
senses.zh: （表示白得东西是不可能的）没有免费的午餐

senses.def: to be allowed to leave court, etc., without receiving any punishment

examples.en: She was acquitted and walked free from court.
examples.zh: 她被无罪释放，自由离开法庭。

senses.def: without payment

examples.en: Children under five travel free.
examples.zh: 五岁以下儿童免费乘坐。

examples.en: We will send you our booklet free of charge.
examples.zh: 我们将免费寄送小册子给你。

senses.def: in a way that is not tied but is able to move about

examples.en: Attach the top and let the ends hang free.
examples.zh: 固定住顶部，让末端自由下垂。

examples.en: He yanked the door hard, and at last it swung free.
examples.zh: 他用力拉门，门终于自由了。

examples.en: Her long hair hung free down her back.
examples.zh: 她的长发随意地垂在背后。

senses.def: to use something a lot, even though it does not belong to you

examples.en: Does she know that you're making free with her belongings?
examples.zh: 她知道你随意拿走她的东西吗？

senses.def: to be allowed to go where it likes; not tied to anything or kept in a cage
senses.zh: 四处自由走动；未关起来；未受束缚

examples.en: Horses should be able to run free on large plots of land.
examples.zh: 马应该能够在大片土地上自由奔跑。

senses.def: to allow somebody to leave prison or somewhere they have been kept against their will

examples.en: The hijackers agreed to free a further ten hostages.
examples.zh: 劫持者同意再释放十名人质。

examples.en: By the end of May nearly 100 of an estimated 2 000 political prisoners had been freed.
examples.zh: 至五月底，估计 2 000 名政治犯中已经有近 100 人获释。

examples.en: She led an operation that freed 70 trafficked workers.
examples.zh: 她领导了一项行动，解救了 70 名被贩运的工人。

examples.en: They succeeded in freeing their friends from prison.
examples.zh: 他们成功把朋友从监狱里解救出来。

senses.def: to move somebody/something that is caught or fixed on something

examples.en: She struggled to free herself.
examples.zh: 她挣扎着以求脱身。

examples.en: A good kick finally freed the door.
examples.zh: 使劲一踢，门终于开了。

examples.en: Three people were freed from the wreckage.
examples.zh: 有三人被救出残骸。

examples.en: He managed to free his arms from their bonds.
examples.zh: 他设法将双臂从捆绑中挣脱出来。

senses.group: somebody/something trapped 被困住的人／物

senses.def: to remove something that is unpleasant or not wanted from somebody/something

examples.en: These exercises help free the body of tension.
examples.zh: 这些锻炼可使紧张的身体放松。

examples.en: The police are determined to free the town of violent crime.
examples.zh: 警方决心消灭该城镇的暴力犯罪。

examples.en: The centre aims to free young people from dependency on drugs.
examples.zh: 这个中心的宗旨是使年轻人解除对毒品的依赖。

senses.def: to make somebody/something available for a particular purpose

examples.en: We freed time each week for a project meeting.
examples.zh: 我们每周都腾出时间开一次项目会议。

examples.en: The government has promised to free up more resources for education.
examples.zh: 政府保证调拨更多资源用于教育。

senses.def: to give somebody the extra time to do something that they want to do

examples.en: Winning the prize freed him to paint full-time.
examples.zh: 获奖使他能腾出时间整天作画。

examples.en: Using the content management software frees up staff.
examples.zh: 使用内容管理软件可以把员工解放出来。

examples.zh: 我可以看到终点线，以为我已经回家了。

examples.zh: 你不必找借口——你是一名自由球员。

examples.zh: 许多图像似乎是通过自由联想得出的。

examples.zh: 弗洛伊德坚持将自由联想作为分析的主要动力。

senses.zh: 自由教会（不属于国教的基督教会）

senses.zh: 自由攀登（使用极少的辅助工具）

examples.en: a free fall display
examples.zh: 自由下落表演

senses.def: a sudden drop in the value of something that cannot be stopped

examples.en: Share prices have gone into free fall.
examples.zh: 股价猛跌不止。

senses.def: not attached to or controlled by anything

examples.en: a free-floating exchange rate
examples.zh: 自由浮动汇率

examples.en: free-floating algae
examples.zh: 自由漂浮的藻类

senses.def: a situation in which there are no rules or controls and everyone acts for their own advantage

examples.en: The lowering of trade barriers has led to a free-for-all among exporters.
examples.zh: 降低贸易壁垒导致出口商各自为政。

examples.en: a price-cutting free-for-all
examples.zh: 竞相削价

senses.def: a noisy fight or argument in which a lot of people take part
senses.zh: 混战；众人激烈争辩；大吵大闹

examples.en: Prompt action by prison staff prevented a violent free-for-all.
examples.zh: 监狱工作人员迅速采取行动，阻止了一场暴力混战。

senses.zh: 自由语素；自由形式；自由形位

examples.en: The plural ‘s’ is not a free form, as it must always be attached to a noun.
examples.zh: 表示复数的 s 不是自由语素，必须附着于名词。

senses.def: not created according to standard forms or structures
senses.zh: 不按传统格式的；独创的

examples.en: a free-form jazz improvisation
examples.zh: 自由创作的爵士乐即兴演出

senses.def: not containing ingredients that could make somebody ill if they have a food allergy
senses.zh: （食品）去除特定成分的，无敏的

examples.en: You can find the new vegan mayonnaise in the free-from aisle in the supermarket.
examples.zh: 超市的无敏食品区已经上架新款纯素蛋黄酱。

senses.def: an opportunity to hit the ball and score runs
senses.zh: （投球犯规后判给击球手的）罚球

examples.en: He smashed a four off the free hit.
examples.zh: 他罚球，打出一个四分。

senses.def: an opportunity to hit the ball without any opposition, which is given to one team when the other team commits a foul

examples.en: The referee awarded a free hit for obstruction.
examples.zh: 裁判判阻挡犯规，罚任意球。

senses.def: (in the UK) a pub that can sell different types of beer because it is not owned and controlled by one particular brewery
senses.zh: （英国，不受某个啤酒厂约束的）酒吧，酒馆

senses.def: an opportunity to kick the ball without any opposition, that is given to one team when the other team does something wrong

examples.en: to take a free kick
examples.zh: 发任意球

senses.def: the practice of having sex without being married or having several sexual relationships at the same time
an economic system in which the price of goods and services is affected by supply and demand rather than controlled by a government

examples.en: She was a supporter of the free market economy.
examples.zh: 她是自由市场经济的拥护者。

examples.en: to compete in a free market
examples.zh: 在自由市场上竞争

senses.def: a person who believes that prices should be allowed to rise and fall according to supply and demand and not be controlled by a government
a unit of language that can be used by itself
senses.zh: 自由语素；自由形式；自由形位

senses.def: including in the price the cost of taking goods to a ship and putting them on it
senses.zh: 船上交货的；离岸价格的

senses.def: a free local newspaper that is delivered to people's homes every week. Most British and US towns and cities have free papers, which contain mostly advertisements and some local news. Some people dislike receiving them and ask for them not to be delivered to their homes.
senses.zh: 免费报纸每周送到人们家中的本地免费报纸。大多数英美城镇都有这种报纸，里面主要刊登广告和一些本地新闻。有些人并不喜欢收到这些报纸，会要求拒收。

senses.def: an official decision not to punish somebody for a crime, or to say that somebody is not guilty of a crime

senses.zh: 空课时（学生或教师没有课的时候）

senses.def: a port at which tax is not paid on goods that have been brought there temporarily before being sent to a different country
an atom
connected with a system of farming in which animals are kept in natural conditions and can move around freely

examples.en: free-range chickens
examples.zh: 散养的鸡

examples.en: free-range eggs
examples.zh: 散养的鸡产的蛋

senses.def: connected with a way of bringing up children that gives them a lot of freedom to do things on their own
senses.zh: 与养育孩子的方式有关，这种养育孩子的方式给予他们很大的自由来自己做事

examples.en: I wanted the kids to have a free-range childhood.
examples.zh: 我希望孩子们有一个自由放养的童年。

examples.en: free-range parenting
examples.zh: 自由放养养育

senses.def: using a system of farming in which animals are kept in natural conditions and can move around freely

examples.en: Our turkeys are reared free-range.
examples.zh: 我们的火鸡是散养的。

senses.def: the activity or art of moving through a city by running, jumping and climbing under, around and through things in a way that shows expression and style
senses.zh: 自由跑（指在城市中具有表现力和风格的奔跑、跳跃、攀爬、环绕、穿越的行为或艺术）

examples.en: Free running treats the urban landscape as an adult playground.
examples.zh: 自由奔跑将城市景观视为成人游乐场。

examples.en: an online game based on the sport of free running

senses.zh: 前面的；前部的；在前的；正面的

examples.en: the front garden
examples.zh: 前花园

examples.en: the front yard
examples.zh: 前花园

examples.en: the front wheels of the car
examples.zh: 汽车的前轮

examples.en: the front cover of the book
examples.zh: 书的封面

examples.en: We had seats in the front row.
examples.zh: 我们坐在前排座位。

examples.en: an animal’s front legs
examples.zh: 动物的前腿

examples.en: a front-seat passenger
examples.zh: 前排座位的一个乘客

senses.def: produced with the front of the tongue in a higher position than the back, for example /
being given a lot of attention because it is considered important
senses.zh: 处于前列重要地位；受到重视；为当务之急

examples.en: Anything that keeps education on the front burner is good.
examples.zh: 任何重视教育的事都是好事。

senses.def: at an advantage

examples.en: They allowed the home side to get on the front foot right at the start.
examples.zh: 他们让主队一开始就占据了先机。

senses.def: taking positive steps to achieve something

examples.en: He has been firmly on the front foot, calling for politicians and police to intervene.
examples.zh: 他一直坚定地站在前线，呼吁政界人士和警察进行干预。

senses.def: to face something or be in front of something; to have the front pointing towards something

examples.en: The cathedral fronts the city's main square.
examples.zh: 大教堂面向城市的主广场。

examples.en: The line of houses fronted straight onto the road.
examples.zh: 这排房子正对着马路。

senses.def: having the front made of or covered with something

examples.en: a glass-fronted bookcase
examples.zh: 正面是玻璃的书柜

senses.def: to lead or represent an organization, a group, etc.

examples.en: He fronts a multinational company.
examples.zh: 他领导一家跨国公司。

examples.en: A former art student fronted the band (= was the main singer).
examples.zh: 乐队的主唱曾是一位艺术院校学生。

examples.en: The band is fronted by former art student, Jim Oliver.
examples.zh: 该乐队由前艺术系学生吉姆·奥利弗 (Jim Oliver) 领衔。

senses.def: to present a television programme, a show, etc.

examples.en: The former footballer will front a new television sports quiz.
examples.zh: 这位前足球运动员将参加一项新的电视体育测验。

senses.group: present TV programme 主持电视节目

senses.def: to give more importance to a part of a sentence by placing it at or near the beginning of the sentence, as in ‘That I would like to see.’
senses.zh: （为强调而）将（句子某一部分）前置

senses.def: if you put on a piece of clothing back to front

examples.en: I think you've got that sweater on back to front.
examples.zh: 我觉得你把毛衣前后穿反了。

senses.def: in somebody’s presence; in front of somebody
senses.zh: 当着某人的面；就在某人的眼皮底下

examples.en: He had seen his life's work destroyed before his very eyes.
examples.zh: 他曾看到他毕生的劳动成果就在自己的眼前毁于一旦。

examples.en: Before our very eyes, the bird snatched the fish from the plate and flew off.
examples.zh: 那只鸟就在我们眼皮底下从盘子里抓起鱼飞走了。

senses.def: with immediate payment of cash

examples.en: to pay for something cash up front
examples.zh: 预先支付现金

items.idm: form, present, etc. a united front

senses.def: to show people that all members of a group have the same opinion about things
senses.zh: 形成统一战线；表现一致

examples.en: The prime minister stressed the need to present a united front.
examples.zh: 首相强调了团结一致的必要性。

senses.def: in or into the most important position

examples.en: The issue has moved front and center in his presidential campaign.
examples.zh: 这个问题已成为他总统竞选活动的焦点。

senses.def: in a position that is further forward than somebody/something but not very far away

examples.en: Their house is the one with the big garden in front.
examples.zh: 他们的房子是前面有大花园的那一座。

senses.def: in first place in a race or competition

examples.en: The blue team is currently in front with a lead of six points.
examples.zh: 蓝队目前以六分领先。

senses.def: in a position that is further forward than somebody/something but not very far away

examples.en: The car in front of me stopped suddenly and I had to brake.
examples.zh: 我前面那辆车突然停下来，我也只好刹车。

examples.en: The bus stops right in front of our house.
examples.zh: 公共汽车就停在我们的房子前面。

examples.en: He was standing in front of me in the line.
examples.zh: 在队列中他站在我的前面。

examples.en: She is now entitled to put ‘Professor’ in front of her name.
examples.zh: 她现在有权在自己的名字前加上“教授”。

senses.def: in a position facing somebody/something

examples.en: to perform in front of a big crowd/audience
examples.zh: 在一大群人／一大批观众面前表演

examples.en: She spends all day sitting in front of (= working at) her computer.
examples.zh: 她整天坐在计算机前（工作）。

examples.en: She's a natural in front of the camera (= being filmed/photographed).
examples.zh: 她在镜头前表现得非常自然。

senses.def: if you do something in front of

examples.en: Please don't talk about it in front of the children.
examples.zh: 请不要当着孩子们的面谈那件事。

senses.def: still to come; not yet passed

examples.en: Don't give up. You still have your whole life in front of you.
examples.zh: 不要放弃，你的人生才刚刚开始。

senses.def: to take an active part in what you are telling or persuading others to do

examples.en: There's only a small audience out front tonight.
examples.zh: 今夜观众席上人很少。

examples.en: He cooked while she sat out front and waited tables.
examples.zh: 他做饭，而她则坐在前面伺候餐桌。

senses.def: in the area near to the entrance to a building

examples.en: I’ll wait for you out (the) front.
examples.zh: 我在大门外等你。

senses.def: as payment in advance

examples.en: We'll pay you half up front and the other half when you've finished the job.
examples.zh: 我们先付一半给你，工作完成后再付另一半。

senses.def: at an advantage

senses.def: taking positive steps to achieve something

senses.def: in or into the most important position
