senses.def: in or into the most important position

examples.en: The issue has moved front and center in his presidential campaign.
examples.zh: 这个问题已成为他总统竞选活动的焦点。

senses.def: the desk inside the entrance of a hotel, an office building, etc. where guests or visitors go when they first arrive

examples.en: I worked the front desk as one of my first jobs.
examples.zh: 我最初的工作之一是站前台。

examples.en: She called the front desk to let them know when she would be arriving.
examples.zh: 她打电话给前台，让他们知道她什么时候到达。

senses.def: the main entrance to a house, usually at the front

examples.en: There's someone at the front door.
examples.zh: 前门有个人。

senses.def: the part of a car or other vehicle that faces forward

examples.en: I could hear a crunching noise coming from the front end of the car.
examples.zh: 我听到汽车前端发出嘎吱嘎吱的声音。

senses.def: the part of a computer system that the user sees and uses directly

examples.en: One of our designers created the graphics for the front end of the website.
examples.zh: 我们的一位设计师为网站的前端制作了图像。

senses.def: the first part of a process, period of time, etc.

examples.en: We need to focus on the front end of the process.
examples.zh: 我们需要重点关注这一过程的最初阶段。

examples.en: I’m spending two nights in Kyoto at the front end of the trip.
examples.zh: 这次旅行的头两个晚上我会待在京都。

senses.def: directly used by a user, and allowing the user to use other devices or programs
senses.zh: 前端的；前置的；用户直接调用的

senses.def: relating to the part of a vehicle that faces forward

examples.en: The vehicle sustained significant front-end damage.
examples.zh: 车辆前端严重受损。

senses.def: paid or charged at the beginning of an act of buying or selling
senses.zh: 前端：在购买或出售行为开始时付费或收费

examples.en: a front-end fee/payment
examples.zh: 前端费用/付款

senses.def: a large vehicle with equipment for digging at the front, worked by a system of hydraulics
to represent a group or an organization and try to hide its secret or illegal activities
senses.zh: 为…掩护（秘密或非法活动）

examples.en: He fronted for them in several illegal property deals.
examples.zh: 他为他们在几次非法房地产交易中作了掩护。

senses.def: to spread the costs of a project so that more of the money is spent in the earlier stages
senses.zh: 将（成本）的大头提前花费

examples.en: a need to front-load budget spending
examples.zh: 前期花费大部分预算支出的需要

examples.en: the positive effects of front-loading funds
examples.zh: 前期投入大部分资金的好处

senses.def: to organize work on a project or information in a document so that the more important work or information is done or placed first
senses.zh: 将（项目或文章）的重点前置

examples.en: Teach your students to front-load their research.
examples.zh: 教学生从事研究时学会前紧后松。

senses.def: the first nine holes of a course

examples.en: Most players think the front nine is the easier part of the course.
examples.zh: 大部分球员认为球场的前九洞更容易打。

senses.def: in the parts of a theatre that are used by the audience
senses.zh: 在（剧院的）前场；在观众席

examples.en: There was an expectant atmosphere front of house.
examples.zh: 剧院的观众席里有一种期待的气氛。

examples.en: I work front of house.
examples.zh: 我负责观众席的事务。

senses.def: the parts of a theatre that are used by the audience

examples.en: New seating will be installed and the front of house will be improved.
examples.zh: 将安装新座位，并对前厅进行改进。

senses.def: the business of dealing with an audience at a theatre, for example selling tickets and programmes
senses.zh: （剧院的）前台事务，观众厅工作

examples.en: a front-of-house manager
examples.zh: 前台经理

examples.en: the front-of-house staff
examples.zh: 剧院观众席工作人员

senses.def: the people in a business who deal with the public
senses.zh: 前端部门，前台部门（企业里跟公众打交道的岗位）

senses.def: the first page of a newspaper, where the most important news is printed

examples.en: The story was on the front pages of all the tabloids.
examples.zh: 所有小报都在头版报道了这件事。

senses.def: appearing on the front page of a newspaper, where the most important news is printed

examples.en: The divorce made front-page news.
examples.zh: 这场离婚事件成了头版新闻。

senses.def: a living room

examples.en: They sat in the front room, watching TV.
examples.zh: 他们坐在前屋里看电视。

senses.def: a person, an animal or an organization that seems most likely to win a race or competition
senses.zh: （赛跑或竞赛中）最可能获胜者，领先者

examples.en: He is one of the front runners in the presidential election.
examples.zh: 他是总统选举的领先者之一。

examples.en: Woods emerged last night as the early front runner to succeed Ellis as party leader.
examples.zh: 伍兹昨晚成为接替埃利斯成为党魁的早期领跑者。

senses.def: that seems most likely to win a race or competition

examples.en: Wilson was the front-running candidate in the run-up to the elections.
examples.zh: 威尔逊在选举前领先其他候选人。

examples.en: Montes is now hoping to move to a front-running Formula One team.
examples.zh: 蒙特斯现在希望转会到一支领先的一级方程式车队。

senses.def: to arrive or appear in a place

examples.en: He fronted up to the meeting ten minutes late.
examples.zh: 他迟到了十分钟才到会。

senses.def: a system in which power from the engine is sent to the front wheels of a vehicle
the front of a building, especially when this faces a road or river
senses.zh: （建筑物，尤指临街或临河的）正面

examples.en: the baroque frontage of Milan Cathedral
examples.zh: 米兰大教堂巴罗克风格的正面

examples.en: The building’s street frontages are mostly of glass.
examples.zh: 该建筑的临街面大部分是玻璃的。

senses.def: land that is next to a building, a street or an area of water
senses.zh: 临街（或建筑物、河等的）土地

examples.en: They bought two miles of river frontage along the Colorado.
examples.zh: 他们买了两英里科罗拉多河沿河的土地。

senses.def: a side road that runs next to a main road, that you use to reach houses, stores, etc.
senses.zh: 临街：与主路相邻的一条小路，可用于到达房屋，商店等。

senses.def: connected with the front of something

examples.en: Airbags protect the driver in the event of a severe frontal impact.
examples.zh: 汽车若遇到正面猛烈撞击，安全气囊可以保护驾车者。

senses.def: a frontal
senses.zh: （攻击或抨击）正面的，劈头盖脸的，直截了当的

examples.en: They launched a frontal attack on company directors.
examples.zh: 他们直截了当地对公司董事进行抨击。

senses.def: connected with a weather front

examples.en: a cold frontal system
examples.zh: 冷锋系

senses.def: connected with the front part of the head

examples.en: the frontal lobes of the brain
examples.zh: 大脑额叶

senses.def: either of the two parts at the front of the brain that are connected with behaviour, learning and personality
senses.zh: 额叶（与行为、学习和个性有关）

senses.def: in a very strong or direct way
senses.zh: 正面：非常强烈或直接的方式

examples.en: Two articles in this issue frontally attack the government's energy policy.
examples.zh: 本期有两篇文章正面攻击政府的能源政策。

senses.def: towards the front of something; with the front of something facing forwards
senses.zh: 正面地：朝向某物的前方 正面朝前

examples.en: frontally oriented
examples.zh: 正面导向

senses.def: an important member of the government or the opposition in the British parliament, who sits in the front rows of seats
a line that separates two countries, etc.; the land near this line

examples.en: the frontier between the land of the Saxons and that of the Danes
examples.zh: 撒克逊人土地和丹麦人土地的边界

examples.en: a customs post on the frontier with Italy
examples.zh: 与意大利交界的边境上的海关关卡

examples.en: a frontier town/zone/post
examples.zh: 边陲小镇；边疆地带；边防站

senses.def: the edge of land where people have settled and built towns, beyond which the country is wild and unknown, especially in the western US in the 19th century
senses.zh: （尤指 19 世纪美国西部的）开发地区边缘地带，边远地区

examples.en: a remote frontier settlement
examples.zh: 边远地区定居点

examples.en: America's wild frontier
examples.zh: 美国的荒野地带

senses.def: the limit of something, especially the limit of what is known about a particular subject or activity

examples.en: to push back the frontiers of science (= to increase knowledge of science)
examples.zh: 开拓科学新领域

examples.en: to roll back the frontiers of government (= to limit the powers of the government)
examples.zh: 限制政府权力

examples.en: Space is the final frontier for us to explore.
examples.zh: 太空是我们探索的最后一个领域。

intro.en: These are all words for a line that marks the edge of something and separates it from other areas or things.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指边界、分界线。

items.def: the line that separates two countries or areas; the land near this line:
items.zh: 指国界、边界、边疆、边境

examples.en: a national park on the border between Kenya and Tanzania
examples.zh: 位于肯尼亚和坦桑尼亚边界的国家公园

items.def: a line that marks the edges of an area of land and separates it from other areas:
items.zh: 指边界、界限、分界线

examples.en: The fence marked the boundary between my property and hers.
examples.zh: 那道篱笆曾是我和她的房产之间的地界。

items.def: (British English英式英语) the line that separates two countries or areas; the land near this line:
items.zh: 指国界、边界、边疆、边境

examples.en: The river formed the frontier between the land of the Saxons and that of the Danes.
examples.zh: 这条河曾是撒克逊人与古斯堪的纳维亚人土地的分界线。

senses.def: a man living on the frontier
senses.zh: （尤指 19 世纪美国西部的）开拓者，拓荒者，边远地区居民

senses.def: a woman living on the frontier
senses.zh: （尤指居住在定居区和非定居区之间的）边疆女居民

senses.def: a picture at the beginning of a book, on the page opposite the page with the title on it
senses.zh: （与书名页相对一页上的）卷首插图

senses.def: in the most important or dangerous position; doing essential work that puts you at risk

examples.en: frontline troops
examples.zh: 一线部队

examples.en: nurses and other frontline staff
examples.zh: 护士和其他一线工作人员

examples.en: frontline healthcare workers
examples.zh: 一线医护人员

senses.def: a person who represents an organization and tries to make its activities seem acceptable to the public, although in fact they may be illegal or dishonest
senses.zh: （某组织的）代表，头面人物；（非法或欺骗活动的）掩护者

examples.en: He acted as a frontman for a drugs cartel.
examples.zh: 他给一个毒品集团当掩护。

senses.def: a man who is the main singer in a pop or rock band
senses.zh: （流行或摇滚乐队的）领唱，主唱

senses.def: a person who presents a television programme
a woman who is the main singer in a pop or rock band
senses.zh: （流行或摇滚乐队的）女领唱，女主唱

examples.en: The band's frontwoman hit the stage and started belting it out.
examples.zh: 乐队的主唱登上舞台并开始高歌。

senses.def: a weather condition in which the temperature drops below 0° Celsius (= freezing point
senses.zh: 严寒天气；霜冻；冰点以下的温度

examples.en: It will be a clear night with some ground frost.
examples.zh: 今夜晴，部分地面有霜冻。

examples.en: a sharp/hard/severe frost
examples.zh: 酷寒

examples.en: There were ten degrees of frost (= the temperature dropped to -10° Celsius) last night.
examples.zh: 昨夜零下 10 摄氏度。

examples.en: frost damage
examples.zh: 霜冻害

senses.def: the thin white layer of ice that forms when the temperature drops below 0° Celsius

examples.en: The car windows were covered with frost.
examples.zh: 车窗玻璃结了霜。

senses.def: to cover something or to become covered with a thin white layer of ice

examples.en: The mirror was frosted up.
examples.zh: 镜子蒙了一层霜。

examples.en: The windows had frosted over.
examples.zh: 窗子结满了霜。

senses.def: to cover a cake with frosting
a medical condition in which parts of the body, especially the fingers and toes, become damaged as a result of extremely cold temperatures

examples.en: The climbers were all suffering from frostbite.
examples.zh: 登山者都被冻伤了。

senses.def: damaged as a result of extremely cold temperatures
a well-known breakfast cereal
senses.zh: 一种著名的早餐麦片，由家乐氏（Kellogg's）生产，在美国称为Frosted Flakes。它由覆盖有糖的玉米小块组成，并与牛奶一起食用。它最著名的广告人物是老虎·托尼（Tony the Tiger），他说：“他们被Gr-rr吃了！”

senses.def: in an unfriendly way that suggests that somebody does not approve of something

examples.en: ‘No, thank you,’ she said frostily.
examples.zh: “不了，谢谢。”她冷冷地说。

senses.def: extremely cold; cold with frost

examples.en: a frosty morning
examples.zh: 严寒的早晨

examples.en: He breathed in the frosty air.
examples.zh: 他吸进冰冷的空气。

examples.en: It’s frosty outside.
examples.zh: 外面结霜了。

senses.def: covered with frost

examples.en: I looked out over the frosty fields.
examples.zh: 我向外望着结霜的田野。

senses.def: unfriendly, in a way that suggests that somebody does not approve of something

examples.en: a frosty look/reply
examples.zh: 冷冰冰的样子；冷淡的答复

examples.en: My questions were met with a frosty silence.
examples.zh: 我的问题得到了冷漠的沉默。

examples.en: The latest proposals were given a frosty reception.
examples.zh: 对最新的建议反应冷淡。

senses.def: a mass of small bubbles, especially on the surface of a liquid

examples.en: a glass of beer with thick froth on top
examples.zh: 上面有厚厚一层泡沫的一杯啤酒

examples.en: The horse’s bit was covered with white froth.
examples.zh: 马衔上沾满了白色的泡沫。

examples.en: The barmen around here always top up your beer with too much froth.
examples.zh: 这里的酒保总是给你的啤酒加太多泡沫。

senses.def: ideas, activities, etc. that seem attractive and fun but have no real value
senses.zh: 华而不实的想法（或活动等）

senses.def: something that looks like a mass of small bubbles on liquid

examples.en: a froth of black lace
examples.zh: 气泡状的黑色花边

senses.def: if a liquid froths

examples.en: a cup of frothing coffee
examples.zh: 一杯起泡的咖啡

examples.en: The water gushed and frothed.
examples.zh: 水喷涌而出，泛起泡沫。

senses.def: to produce a lot of saliva

examples.en: The dog was frothing at the mouth.
examples.zh: 这条狗口吐白沫。

examples.en: He frothed at the mouth (= was very angry) when I asked for more money.
examples.zh: 我还要钱时他气得七窍生烟。

senses.def: having a mass of small bubbles on the surface

examples.en: frothy coffee

examples.zh: 发挥功能

examples.zh: 你在这个部门的职责是什么？

examples.zh: 心脏的功能就是把血液输往全身。

examples.zh: 这个设计旨在使形式和功能协调一致。

examples.zh: 大厅可以举办婚礼和其他公开活动。

examples.zh: 现在我们有一个功能正常的淋浴器。

examples.zh: 尽管供电中断，医院继续照常运作。

examples.zh: 许多孩子在上大课时学习效果不好。

examples.zh: 不喝咖啡我无法正常工作。

examples.zh: 这沙发还可当床用。

examples.zh: 我需要钱才能成为一名艺术家。

examples.zh: 弹性纤维是皮肤的重要功能成分。

examples.zh: 这个过程在功能上相当于蜜蜂的集群。

senses.zh: 橡胶套鞋（雨天套在平常穿的鞋上，现已很少见）

examples.en: a pair of galoshes
examples.zh: 一双橡胶套鞋

senses.def: to move in a heavy, careless or noisy way
senses.zh: 笨拙（或懒散）地挪动；脚步声嘈杂地行进

examples.en: Who’s that galumphing around upstairs?
examples.zh: 楼上那个蹦蹦跳跳的是谁？

senses.def: producing an electric current by the action of a chemical on metal
making people react in a sudden and dramatic way
senses.zh: 突然的；令人震惊的；使人激动的

senses.def: to make somebody take action by shocking them or by making them excited
senses.zh: 使震惊；使振奋；激励；刺激

examples.en: The win galvanized the whole team.
examples.zh: 胜利使全队振奋起来。

examples.en: The urgency of his voice galvanized them into action.
examples.zh: 他急迫的声音激励他们行动起来。

examples.en: We need new approaches that will galvanize the industry to deal with its problems.
examples.zh: 我们需要新的方法来激励行业解决问题。

senses.def: to cover metal with zinc

examples.en: a galvanized bucket
examples.zh: 镀锌桶

examples.en: galvanized steel
examples.zh: 镀锌钢

senses.def: a city in the Republic of Ireland, located on the west coast
senses.zh: 戈尔韦（爱尔兰共和国西海岸城市）

senses.def: a country in West Africa where the official language is English. It is a long narrow country, on each bank of the Gambia river, surrounded by Senegal. The capital city is Banjul. Gambia was formed when Britain and France both had empires
(a person) from Gambia
senses.zh: 冈比亚人；冈比亚的；冈比亚人的

senses.def: a thing that somebody does, or something that somebody says at the beginning of a situation or conversation, that is intended to give them some advantage

examples.en: an opening gambit (= the first thing you say)
examples.zh: 开场白

examples.en: The opposition have dismissed promises of tax cuts as a pre-election gambit.
examples.zh: 反对派否认减税承诺是选举前的策略。

examples.en: She gazed out of the window, rehearsing conversational gambits.
examples.zh: 她凝视着窗外，排练着谈话的技巧。

senses.def: a move or moves made at the beginning of a game of chess
senses.zh: （国际象棋中为获得优势而采取的）开局让棋法

senses.def: to risk money on a card game, horse race, etc.

examples.en: to gamble at cards
examples.zh: 赌纸牌

examples.en: to gamble on the horses
examples.zh: 赌马

examples.en: I gambled all my winnings on the last race.
examples.zh: 我把赢的钱全押在最后一场比赛上了。

senses.def: to risk losing something in the hope of being successful
senses.zh: 冒风险；碰运气；以…为赌注

examples.en: He's gambling his reputation on this deal.
examples.zh: 他在以自己的声誉为这笔交易作赌注。

examples.en: It was wrong to gamble with our children's future.
examples.zh: 拿我们孩子的未来冒险是错误的。

examples.en: She gambled that he wouldn't read it before she reached the airport.
examples.zh: 她打赌在她到达机场之前他不会读这封信。

senses.def: an action that you take when you know there is a risk but when you hope that the result will be a success

examples.en: She knew she was taking a gamble but decided it was worth it.
examples.zh: 她知道是在冒险，但她认为冒这个险值得。

examples.en: They invested money in the company right at the start and the gamble paid off (= brought them success).
examples.zh: 他们一开始就把资金投到这家公司，结果这一冒险获得了成功。

examples.en: It was the biggest gamble of his political career.
examples.zh: 这是他政治生涯中最大的赌博。

senses.def: to lose something such as money, possessions, etc. by gambling

examples.en: Every weekend he drinks and gambles away his earnings.
examples.zh: 每个周末他都会喝酒赌博，输光自己的收入。

examples.en: He had gambled all their money away.
examples.zh: 他把他们的钱都输光了。

senses.def: to take a risk with something, hoping that you will be successful

examples.en: He gambled on being able to buy a ticket at the last minute.
examples.zh: 他碰运气看能否在最后一刻买到票。

senses.def: to take a risk with something, hoping that you will be successful

examples.en: He gambled on being able to buy a ticket at the last minute.
examples.zh: 他碰运气看能否在最后一刻买到票。

senses.def: a person who risks money on a card game, horse race, etc.

examples.en: He was a compulsive gambler (= found it difficult to stop).
examples.zh: 他嗜赌成性。

senses.def: a person who is willing to risk losing something in the hope of being successful
senses.zh: 冒风险；碰运气；以…为赌注

examples.en: She is an eternal optimist and gambler at heart.
examples.zh: 她是一个永远的乐观主义者和内心的赌徒。

senses.def: to jump or run about in a lively way

examples.en: lambs gambolling in the meadow
examples.zh: 在草地上蹦蹦跳跳的小羊羔

senses.def: an activity that you do to have fun, often one that has rules and that you can win or lose; the equipment for a game

examples.en: The kids were playing a game with their balloons.
examples.zh: 孩子们正在用气球玩游戏。

examples.en: The children invented a new game.
examples.zh: 孩子们发明了一种新游戏。

examples.en: a video/computer game
examples.zh: 电子／电脑游戏

examples.en: I play online games with my friends.
examples.zh: 我和朋友玩线上游戏。

examples.en: a game of chance/skill
examples.zh: 靠运气决定胜负／凭技巧取胜的游戏

examples.en: Buy your games and software from us.
examples.zh: 在我们这里购买游戏和软件。

senses.def: a sport with rules in which people or teams compete against each other

examples.en: ball games, such as football or tennis
examples.zh: 诸如足球或网球等球类运动

examples.en: How I hated team games at school!
examples.zh: 我上学的时候多么讨厌团队运动！

examples.en: the game of golf/cricket/basketball
examples.zh: 高尔夫/板球/篮球运动

examples.en: Broadcasters have injected vast amounts of money into the game of football.
examples.zh: 广播公司向足球比赛投入了大量资金。

senses.def: an occasion of playing a game

examples.en: to win/lose a game
examples.zh: 赢／输一场比赛

examples.en: They lost their first home game of the season.
examples.zh: 他们输掉了本赛季的第一场主场比赛。

examples.en: a baseball/basketball game
examples.zh: 棒球／篮球比赛

examples.en: a football game
examples.zh: 足球赛

examples.en: We're going to the ball game (= baseball game).
examples.zh: 我们要去看棒球比赛。

examples.en: Are you coming to watch the game?
examples.zh: 你来看比赛吗？

examples.en: to play a game of chess
examples.zh: 下国际象棋

examples.en: Let's have a game of table tennis.
examples.zh: 咱们来打场乒乓球赛吧。

examples.en: Saturday’s League game against Swansea
examples.zh: 星期六对斯旺西的联赛比赛

examples.en: today's game with Manchester United
examples.zh: 今天与曼联的比赛

examples.en: They're in training for the big game.
examples.zh: 他们正在为大赛进行训练。

senses.def: the way in which somebody plays a game
senses.zh: 比赛（或游戏）时用的手法；比赛（或游戏）技巧

examples.en: Maguire raised his game to collect the £40 000 first prize.
examples.zh: 马圭尔的比赛技巧有所提升，摘得 4 万英镑的一等奖。

examples.en: Stretching exercises can help you avoid injury and improve your game.
examples.zh: 伸展运动有助于防止身体受伤，并能提高比赛技巧。

senses.def: a large organized sports event

examples.en: She's hoping to participate in the next Olympic Games.
examples.zh: 她希望参加下一届奥运会。

examples.en: To stage the Games (= the Olympic Games or a similar event) is an honour.
examples.zh: 举办奥运会是一种荣幸。

senses.def: sport as a lesson or an activity at school

examples.en: I always hated games at school.
examples.zh: 我念书的时候一直不喜欢体育活动。

senses.def: a section of some games

examples.en: two games all (= both players have won two games)
examples.zh: 各赢两局

examples.en: Zverev won the opening game of the third set.
examples.zh: 兹维列夫赢得第三盘首盘比赛。

senses.def: a type of activity or business

examples.en: How long have you been in this game?
examples.zh: 你干这行当多长时间了？

examples.en: the game of politics
examples.zh: 政治活动

examples.en: I'm new to this game myself.
examples.zh: 我本人对这个不熟悉。

examples.en: Getting dirty was all part of the game to the kids.
examples.zh: 对孩子来说弄脏是很正常的事。

senses.def: a secret and clever plan; a trick

examples.en: So that's his game (= now I know what he has been planning).
examples.zh: 原来这就是他的鬼把戏。

senses.def: wild animals or birds that people hunt for sport or food
at an advantage/disadvantage because you have done more/less preparation or know more/less than other people, especially those you are competing against
senses.zh: 领先（或落后）于竞争对手（或能力相匹敌者）

examples.en: We'll be able to extract insights out of the data that will enable us to stay ahead of the game.
examples.zh: 我们将能够从数据中提取见解，使我们能够保持领先地位。

examples.en: Politicians are behind the game in understanding how fast the world is changing.
examples.zh: 政治家们在背后理解世界变化的速度。

senses.def: to defeat or do better than somebody in an activity which they have chosen or in which they think they are strong
senses.zh: 赢某人的看家本领；打败某人的强项

senses.def: to not be considered to be serious
senses.zh: 不当一回事；当儿戏；闹着玩

examples.en: For her the whole project was just a game.
examples.zh: 对她来说，整个计划不过是场儿戏而已。

senses.def: to be working as a prostitute
to no longer have a chance of winning a game or succeeding in an activity that you are taking part in
to still/once again have a good chance of winning a game or succeeding in an activity that you are taking part in
senses.zh: 没有出局；仍有获胜（或成功）的机会

examples.en: The team was still in the game, just one goal down.
examples.zh: 这个队还没出局，只落后一球。

examples.en: He’s been fighting to get the struggling company back in the game.
examples.zh: 他一直在努力让这家陷入困境的公司重返市场。

senses.def: activities that are not serious and that other people may think are bad

examples.en: Teaching isn't all fun and games, you know.
examples.zh: 教学并非全是嬉戏和玩耍，你晓得吧。

senses.def: said to somebody who has done something wrong, when they are caught and the crime or trick has been discovered
senses.zh: （对做坏事被抓或罪行败露者说的话）戏该收场了，别再演戏了

examples.en: Maggie knew that he had recognized her and the game was up.
examples.zh: 玛吉知道他已经认出了她，比赛结束了。

senses.def: used after something has happened that makes it clear that a contest is not yet decided and anyone could still win
senses.zh: （赛场局势发生变化后表明）胜负难料

examples.en: We were losing 2–0 with ten minutes to go, and then we scored. It was game on!
examples.zh: 离终场还有十分钟，我们以 0:2 落后，随后我们进球了。谁输谁赢还说不定呢！

senses.def: used to say that it is no longer possible for somebody/something to succeed, survive or continue

examples.en: Given her recent slump in form, it might be game over already this season.
examples.zh: 考虑到她最近低迷的表现，本赛季可能败局已定。

examples.en: This technology could mean game over for gasoline-powered vehicles.
examples.zh: 这项技术可能意味着汽油车的终结。

examples.en: The slightest mistake and it's game over for him.
examples.zh: 稍有差池，他就完蛋了。

senses.def: to tell a secret, especially by accident; to show something that should be kept hidden

examples.en: Don't let him talk to anybody or he'll give the game away.
examples.zh: 不要让他和任何人谈话，否则他会泄露秘密的。

senses.def: an activity that is unlikely to be successful or make a profit
senses.zh: 徒劳无功的事；不易成功的事；不易获利的事

senses.def: the most important aspect of an activity; the most important quality needed for an activity
senses.zh: 问题的实质；最为重要的方面

examples.en: Hard work is the name of the game if you want to succeed in business.
examples.zh: 要想生意兴旺，勤奋工作是关键。

senses.def: the advantages to be gained from doing something are not great enough, considering the effort or cost involved

examples.en: If the price goes up again, he may decide that the game’s not worth the candle.
examples.zh: 如果价格再次上涨，他可能会认为这款游戏得不偿失。

senses.def: a way of considering an activity, etc. that considers only the number of people doing something, things achieved, etc., not with who or what they are
senses.zh: 数字游戏（即只注重参与的人数、达成了几项结果等，而不考虑参与者是谁、结果是什么）

examples.en: MPs were playing the numbers game as the crucial vote drew closer.
examples.zh: 在至关重要的表决临近时，下院议员们玩起了数字游戏。

senses.def: performing badly/well, especially when compared with how well you usually perform

examples.en: He was off his game and missed two early penalties.
examples.zh: 他缺席了比赛并错过了两个早期的点球。

senses.def: the most important thing of a particular type, or the only thing that is available
senses.zh: 同类中最重要的事物；唯一的选择

senses.def: to play a cruel game with somebody in your power by changing your behaviour very often, so that they become nervous and do not know what to expect
senses.zh: 和某人玩起猫捉老鼠的游戏；耍弄

examples.en: He thought the police were playing some elaborate game of cat and mouse and waiting to trap him.
examples.zh: 他以为警察正在玩一场精心设计的猫捉老鼠的游戏，等着诱捕他。

examples.en: Young car thieves enjoy playing cat and mouse with the police.
examples.zh: 年轻的盗车贼喜欢与警察玩猫捉老鼠的把戏。

senses.def: to do something that helps somebody else’s plans, especially by accident, when you did not intend to help them
to behave in a fair and honest way

examples.en: You can’t do that—it’s not playing the game!
examples.zh: 你不能这么做——这不是在玩游戏！

senses.def: to not be honest with somebody, especially in order to gain an advantage over them

examples.en: Don't play silly games with me; I know you did it.
examples.zh: 别跟我兜圈子，我知道是你干的。

senses.def: the standards of behaviour that most people accept or that actually operate in a particular area of life or business
senses.zh: 游戏规则；大家共同遵守的行为标准

senses.def: (to have) a personal interest in an organization or activity, and therefore in its success

examples.en: When management and unions sit down at the negotiating table, both sides have skin in the game.
examples.zh: 当管理层和工会坐在谈判桌上时，双方都利益攸关。

examples.en: The neutral fan with no skin in the game can just sit back and enjoy the spectacle.
examples.zh: 没有参与游戏的中立球迷可以坐下来欣赏这一奇观。

senses.def: to talk in a way that sounds convincing, but may not be sincere
senses.zh: 说得好听；说得天花乱坠

examples.en: The senior managers talk a good game about customer relations, but really they don't care about the customer.
examples.zh: 高级管理人员说起客户关系头头是道，但实际上他们不在乎客户。

senses.def: used to tell somebody who has played a trick on you that you can do the same thing to them
senses.zh: （表示也会对方耍的花招）这一套你会我也会

senses.def: to improve the level at which you can compete, especially in a sport
senses.zh: （尤指体育运动）提高竞技水平，增强本领

examples.en: She's really upped her game since she joined the tennis club.
examples.zh: 自从加入了网球俱乐部，她的比赛水平确实提高了。

examples.en: With these two snazzy new restaurants opening up, the other eating places in the area are going to have to up their game.
examples.zh: 随着这两家时髦的新餐厅开业，该区的其他餐饮店将不得不努力增强自己的竞争力。

senses.def: used to ask why somebody is behaving as they are
to risk money playing a game of chance
to play video games
to use something in a way that is unfair but legal, in order to get what you want
senses.zh: 不公平地利用；钻法律空子图利

examples.en: Some companies only received a government grant because they gamed the system.
examples.zh: 一些公司钻了这个制度的空子而得到了政府补助。

examples.en: The government finance programme is being gamed by some high-profile banks.
examples.zh: 政府财政计划正在被一些备受关注的银行利用。

senses.def: to treat somebody who trusts you in an unfair way in order to get what you want

examples.en: He gamed his publishers, his family and his friends in order to make a success of his autobiography.
examples.zh: 为了使自己的自传成功，他利用了他的出版商、家人和朋友。

senses.def: ready and willing to do something new, difficult or dangerous

examples.en: She's game for anything.
examples.zh: 她什么事都敢试。

examples.en: We need a volunteer for this exercise. Who's game to try?
examples.zh: 我们需要有人自告奋勇来做这个练习，谁愿意来试试？

senses.def: at an advantage/disadvantage because you have done more/less preparation or know more/less than other people, especially those you are competing against
senses.zh: 领先（或落后）于竞争对手（或能力相匹敌者）

examples.en: We'll be able to extract insights out of the data that will enable us to stay ahead of the game.
examples.zh: 我们将能够从数据中提取见解，使我们能够保持领先地位。

examples.en: Politicians are behind the game in understanding how fast the world is changing.
examples.zh: 政治家们在背后理解世界变化的速度。

senses.def: (1912-97) a British conductor
senses.zh: 乔治·索尔蒂（Georg Solti）：（1912-97）英国指挥，出生于匈牙利。他负责许多著名的乐团，包括芝加哥交响乐团和皇家歌剧院的乐团，并被认为是他那个时代的主要指挥之一。1971年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: a first name for boys
(1887-1995) a US writer of plays and director and producer of Broadway shows, mostly musical. He wrote nearly 50 plays, including The Boys from Syracuse
senses.zh: 乔治·雅培（George Abbott）：（ 1887-1995年），美国戏剧作家，百老汇节目的导演和制片人，主要是音乐剧。他写了近50部戏剧，包括根据《错误的喜剧》和《该死的洋基》（1955年）改编的《锡拉丘兹的男孩》（1938年）。百老汇的乔治·阿伯特剧院以他的名字命名。他活到了108岁，但在100岁时仍在写作。

senses.def: two English brothers (1847-1912 and 1854-1919), best known for writing The Diary of a Nobody
senses.zh: 乔治（George）和韦登·格罗斯史密斯（Weedon Grossmith）：两个英国兄弟（1847-1912和1854-1919），以撰写《没人的日记》而著称。韦登还对这本书进行了说明。

senses.def: (1904-83) a US choreographer
senses.zh: 乔治·巴兰钦（George Balanchine）：（1904-83）美国编舞者，出生于俄罗斯。与Diaghilev合作之后，他去了美国，开始了纽约市芭蕾舞团的演出。

senses.def: (1856-1950) an Irish writer of plays, novels and articles about music and literature who lived in England for much of his life. He is best known for his plays, which are full of intelligent and amusing
senses.zh: 乔治·伯纳德·肖（George Bernard Shaw）：（1856-1950）是爱尔兰人的戏剧，小说和关于音乐与文学的文章的作家，他一生都住在英国。他以其戏剧而闻名，他的戏剧充满了对社会的聪明有趣的评论和批评。他还以他的社会变革运动而闻名。他是Fabian协会的最早成员之一，也是女权主义和素食主义的支持者。他最著名的作品包括《魔鬼的门徒》（1897年），《大芭芭拉》（1905年）和《皮格马利翁》（1913年）。他于1925年获得诺贝尔文学奖。去世后，他留下了钱来发明一个新的字母，从而简化了英语拼写系统。

senses.def: (1946-2005) a football player from Northern Ireland who played for Manchester United
senses.zh: 乔治·贝斯特（George Best）：（1946-2005）来自北爱尔兰的足球运动员，曾效力于曼联（1963-73）和北爱尔兰。他是一位令人兴奋的进攻球员，许多人认为他是有史以来最出色的球员之一。

senses.def: (1815-64) an English mathematician
senses.zh: 乔治·布尔（George Boole）：（1815-64）一位英国数学家，发明了一种称为布尔代数的数学逻辑。它以最简单的形式成为计算机的语言。

senses.def: (1896-1996) a US comedian
senses.zh: 乔治·伯恩斯（George Burns）：（1896-1996）美国喜剧演员，一直表演直到接近100岁。他以雪茄大，说话慢和幽默的歌唱而闻名。他和他的妻子格雷西·艾伦（Gracie Allen）（1906-64）一起在舞台上，电影和广播电视中加入。他获得了《阳光男孩》（1975）的“最佳男配角”奖，并在《哦，上帝！》（1977年）中饰演了上帝，并随后拍了两部电影。

senses.def: (1770-1827) a British Tory
senses.zh: 乔治·坎宁（George Canning）：（1770-1827）英国保守党首相（1827）。他出任总理后不久就去世了，他在担任英国外交大臣期间（1822-7年）的历史更令人记忆深刻，当时他为英国在欧洲和南美的许多独立运动提供了支持。他还因与对手卡斯尔雷格勋爵（Lord Castlereagh）进行决斗（用枪战解决分歧而闻名）。

senses.def: (1792-1878) an English artist who was famous for his political cartoons. He also drew illustrations for the books of many famous authors, including Charles Dickens
senses.zh: 乔治·克鲁克香克（George Cruickshank）：（1792-1878）是一位以政治漫画而闻名的英国艺术家。他还为许多著名作家的书籍绘制插图，包括查尔斯·狄更斯和沃尔特·斯科特。

senses.def: (1899-1983) a US film director. He is best remembered for his film comedies, including The Philadelphia Story
senses.zh: 乔治·库克（1899-1983）美国电影导演。他的电影喜剧片给人留下了最深刻的印象，其中包括《费城故事》（1940年），《帕特和麦克》（1952年）和《我的淑女》（1964年），并因此获得了奥斯卡奖。

senses.def: (1834-96) a cartoonist
senses.zh: 乔治·杜莫里尔（George du Maurier）：（1834-96）是漫画家和小说作家，是英国和法国父母的儿子。他以《庞克》中有关富人的社交生活的漫画（幽默画）而闻名。他的小说也很成功，小说中的特里比（Trilby）中他的角色之一斯文加利（Svengali）的名字已成为英语的一部分。他是Daphne du Maurier的祖父。

senses.def: (1854-1932) the American who invented a camera small enough to carry and film in a flexible roll. He started a company in 1884 that later became the Eastman Kodak Company. His Kodak
senses.zh: 乔治·伊士曼（George Eastman）：（1854-1932）美国人，他发明了一种小巧的相机，可以灵活地携带和拍摄胶卷。他于1884年创立了一家公司，后来成为伊士曼柯达公司。他的柯达盒式相机于1888年首次出售，而布朗尼相机则在1900年出售。这使摄影首次为许多普通人所用。

senses.def: (1819-80) the man's name that the English author Mary Ann Evans used on her books. Her works include Adam Bede
senses.zh: 乔治·艾略特（1819–1880）英国女作家玛丽·安·埃文斯使用的男性化笔名。著有《亚当·比德》、《弗洛斯河上的磨坊》、《织工马南》（1861）、《米德尔马契》和《丹尼尔·德龙达》（1876）等。作品生动描绘维多利亚时代的社会和家庭生活。与乔治·亨利·刘易斯未婚同居多年，这在当时非同寻常。1878 年刘易斯去世。后艾略特嫁给一个比她小二十岁的男人，不久去世。

senses.def: (1904-61) an English singer and comedy actor from Lancashire
senses.zh: 乔治·福比（George Formby）：（1904-61）来自兰开夏郡的英国歌手和喜剧演员。他的职业生涯始于音乐厅，后来拍了许多成功的电影。他总是扮演一个有点傻的角色，带有强烈的北方口音和灿烂的笑容，并且在演奏四弦琴（一种像小吉他一样的乐器）的同时演唱具有双重意义的歌曲。

senses.def: (1624-91) an English Christian religious leader. He established the Society of Friends
senses.zh: 乔治·福克斯：（1624-91）英国基督教宗教领袖。在度过一生的大部分时间并告诉人们他相信人们应该在自己内找到上帝之后，他于1650年代成立了“友人协会”（贵格会）。他经常因信仰而入狱。

senses.def: (1685-1759) a German composer
senses.zh: 乔治·弗雷德里克·汉德尔（George Frederick Handel）（1685-1759）是一位德国作曲家，他于1712年住在伦敦，一直住到他去世，并于1726年成为英国公民。汉德尔的音乐一直特别受英国人欢迎。他撰写了40部歌剧，但他最著名的作品是他的20部歌剧，这些音乐剧基于圣经中关于耶稣基督的到来的故事，尤其是弥赛亚的故事。他还为乔治一世国王的仪式写音乐，包括水上音乐（1717）和皇家烟花音乐（1749）。汉德尔于1751年停止写作音乐，因为他失明了。他被埋葬在威斯敏斯特大教堂的诗人角落。

senses.def: (1898-1937) a US composer
senses.zh: 乔治·格什温（George Gershwin）：（1898-1937）是美国作曲家，曾写过许多流行歌曲。他还写严肃的音乐，介绍爵士乐和其他形式的流行音乐。他最著名的作品包括《蓝色狂想曲》（1924年）和非裔美国歌剧《波吉与贝丝》（1935年）。他还写了几部音乐喜剧节目，包括《 Lady Be Good》（1924年），《 Strike up the Band》（1927年）和《 Thee I Sing》（1931年），并获得了普利策奖。乔治·格什温（George Gershwin）的弟弟艾拉（Ira（1896-1983））为他的许多歌曲写了歌。

senses.def: (1811-78) an English architect. He was one of the leading figures of the Gothic Revival
senses.zh: 乔治·吉尔伯特·斯科特（George Gilbert Scott）：（1811-78）英国建筑师。他是英格兰哥特式复兴的主要人物之一，并设计了伦敦的圣潘克拉斯车站和伦敦的阿尔伯特纪念馆，并修复了许多旧教堂。1872年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1943-2001) an English guitar player, singer and song writer who was a member of the Beatles
senses.zh: 乔治·哈里森：（1943-2001）是甲壳虫乐队的成员的英语吉他演奏家，歌手和歌曲作者。后来他取得了成功的独奏事业，尤其是在1970年代，并获得了唱片《 My Sweet Lord》（1970）等唱片。他还参与了电影制作，并支持信仰受到印度宗教影响的宗教团体。

senses.def: (died 1786) an English maker of furniture noted for his simple and graceful
senses.zh: 乔治·赫普怀特·乔治（George Hepplewhite）：（卒于1786年）是英国家具制造商，以其简单而优雅的风格而著称。他的书《橱柜制造商和室内装潢工人的指南》（1788年）产生了很大的影响，但是没有一件幸存下来的家具幸存下来。

senses.def: (1593-1633) an English poet and priest. He was one of the metaphysical poets
senses.zh: 乔治·赫伯特（George Herbert）：（1593-1633）英国诗人和牧师。他是形而上学的诗人之一，他用简单的语言处理诸如疑惑，苦难和欢乐之类的宗教主题。寺院收藏在他去世后于1633年出版。

senses.def: (1660-1727) king of Great Britain and Ireland (1714-27). He was the first of the Hanoverian
senses.zh: 乔治一世（1660–1727）大不列颠及爱尔兰国王（1714–1727 在位），汉诺威王朝第一代国王。安妮女王驾崩后，从德国来到英国继承王位。在英国不受欢迎，主要原因是不会说英语，英国人也不喜欢和他同来的两个德国情妇。他很少参与国务，政事主要交由内阁处理，在位期间，内阁地位大大提高。

senses.def: (1683-1760) king of Great Britain and Ireland (1727-60). He was the only son of George I
senses.zh: 乔治二世（1683–1760）大不列颠及爱尔兰国王（1727–1760 在位），乔治一世的独子。和父亲一样，对政务兴趣不大，使君主立宪制得以发展。但热爱军事，在奥地利王位继承战争（1740–1748）中与法国人作战，是英国最后一位率军作战的国王。

senses.def: (1738-1820) king of Great Britain and Ireland (1760-1820). He was the grandson
senses.zh: 乔治三世（1738–1820）大不列颠及爱尔兰国王（1760–1820 在位），乔治二世之孙。政治上进取，与诺斯勋爵、威廉·皮特等首相密切合作。强烈反对美国独立，因输掉美国独立战争而遭公众指责。多次患病，1811 年病重，遂由其子摄政。

senses.def: (1762-1830) king of Great Britain and Ireland (1820-30). Before becoming king, he ruled as Prince Regent
senses.zh: 乔治四世（1762–1830）大不列颠及爱尔兰国王（1820–1830 在位）。即位前，因其父乔治三世病重而摄政。情人众多，生活放纵，沉湎于吃喝玩乐和赌博。

senses.def: George Michael Cohan (1878-1942) a US actor and writer of musical plays that praised America. His best-known songs include Give My Regards to Broadway
senses.zh: 乔治·科汉（George M Cohan）：乔治·迈克尔·科汉（George Michael Cohan，1878-1942年），美国演员和音乐剧作家，赞美美国。他最著名的歌曲包括《致百老汇》（1904年），《老旗》（1904年）和第一次世界大战歌曲《那边》（1917年），为此他从国会获得了特别奖章。电影《扬基·涂鸦·丹迪（Yankee Doodle Dandy）》（1942年）讲述了他的一生，詹姆斯·卡涅（James Cagney）饰演科恩（Cohan）。

senses.def: (1963-2016) a popular British pop singer and song writer from the early 1980s. He was born in London and had a Greek Cypriot father and an English mother. He first became famous as a member of the group Wham!
senses.zh: 乔治·迈克尔（George Michael）：（1963-2016）是1980年代初期流行的英国流行歌手和歌曲作者。他出生在伦敦，有一个希族塞人父亲和一个英国母亲。他最初是作为Wham！乐队的成员而闻名，然后在1985年独自开始了自己的成功事业。他的专辑包括Faith（1987），Listen Without Prejudice Volume 1（1990）和Patience（2004）。

senses.def: (1903-50) an English writer of essays and novels. He was born in India and educated at Eton
senses.zh: 乔治·奥威尔（1903–1950）英国散文家、小说家。生于印度，在伊顿公学接受教育。第一份工作是在缅甸的英国警察部队服役（1922–1927），但他背叛了自己的出身，之后数年在巴黎和伦敦过着贫困的生活。这段经历被写入《巴黎伦敦落魄记》（1933）。下一本书《通向威根码头之路》（1937）描述了大萧条时期英国工人阶级的生活。在西班牙内战中加入共和军一方，写下《向加泰罗尼亚致敬》（1938）。最著名的两部小说是写于 20 世纪 40 年代的《动物农场》和《一九八四》，以不同方式表达了他对社会主义革命，尤其是对苏联的失望。

senses.def: (1885-1945) a senior US Army officer during the Second World War
senses.zh: 乔治·帕顿（George Patton）：（1885-1945）第二次世界大战期间的美国陆军高级军官。他的俗名是“ Old Blood and Guts”。D日后，巴顿将军率领美国第3军迅速穿越法国进入德国。他是一个强硬的人，要求严格的纪律，并受到士兵的爱戴或憎恨。乔治·斯科特（George C Scott）在电影《巴顿》（Patton，1970年）中讲述了他的故事，该片获得了三项奥斯卡奖。

senses.def: (1869-1954) an English music hall
senses.zh: 乔治·罗贝（George Robey）：（1869-1954）是英国音乐厅的表演者，以《如果你是世界上唯一的女孩》这首歌而闻名（1916年）。1954年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1734-1802) an English painter. He was one of the most fashionable portrait painters of the late 18th century and was famous for his use of bright colours. He painted many pictures using Lady Emma Hamilton
senses.zh: 乔治·罗姆尼：（1734-1802）英国画家。他是18世纪后期最时尚的肖像画家之一，并以鲜艳的色彩闻名。他以艾玛·汉密尔顿夫人（Emma Hamilton）为模型绘制了许多图片。

senses.def: (1922-2002) a US film director. His best-known films include Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid
senses.zh: 乔治·罗伊·希尔：（1922-2002）美国电影导演。他最著名的电影包括布奇·卡西迪（Butch Cassidy）和圣丹斯（Sundance Kid）（1969），获得奥斯卡金像奖（The Sting）（1973）的奥斯卡金像奖，以及根据加尔普（The Garve）拍摄的世界（1982）。

senses.def: (1919-2011) an English jazz pianist
senses.zh: 乔治·希灵（George Shearing）：（1919-2011）一位英国爵士钢琴家兼作曲家（音乐作家），他天生瞎了。他创作了许多流行音乐，包括《鸟国》中的摇篮曲（1952）。他于1947年移居美国。

senses.def: (1930-2010) the former main owner of the New York Yankees baseball team, known as The Boss
senses.zh: 乔治·史坦布伦纳（George Steinbrenner）：（ 1930-2010年）纽约洋基棒球队（The Boss）的前主要老板。据说他对俱乐部运营的干扰比业主通常要多，并且以向著名球员支付高薪以及经常更换球队经理而闻名。

senses.def: (1781-1848) an English engineer. He designed some of the first steam
senses.zh: 乔治·斯蒂芬森（1781–1848）英国工程师。设计了英国最早的一些蒸汽机车和铁路，包括 1825 年斯托克顿–达灵顿铁路上和 1826 年利物浦–曼彻斯特铁路上的第一批客运列车机车。

senses.def: (1724-1806) an English artist. He is famous for his paintings of horses, which show the animals in realistic detail, often with their owners, and sometimes in imaginary situations.
senses.zh: 乔治·斯塔布斯（George Stubbs）：（1724-1806）英国艺术家。他以马画着称，经常以动物的主人或有时在虚幻的情况下向动物展示逼真的细节。

senses.def: (1865-1936) king of Great Britain and Northern Ireland (1910-36). He was the son of Edward VII
senses.zh: 乔治五世（1865–1936）大不列颠及北爱尔兰王国国王（1910–1936 在位）。爱德华七世之子。在第一次世界大战中支持英军而受到英国人民的爱戴。1917 年放弃所有德国头衔，并将姓氏从萨克森–科堡–哥达改为温莎。

senses.def: (1895-1952) king of Great Britain and Northern Ireland (1936-52). He was the second son of George V
senses.zh: 乔治六世（1895–1952）大不列颠及北爱尔兰王国国王（1936–1952 在位）。乔治五世次子，在其兄爱德华八世退位后即位。第二次世界大战中伦敦遭轰炸，他留守伦敦，因而深受英国人民爱戴。是最后一位被称为“皇帝”的英国国王，也是第一位英联邦元首。

senses.def: (1919-98) a US politician. He was governor
senses.zh: 乔治·华莱士：（1919-98）美国政治家。他曾担任阿拉巴马州州长，并试图在1960年代在该州的公立学校中保持种族隔离。

senses.def: (1732-99) the first US President (1789-97), who had led its army to success in the American Revolution
senses.zh: 乔治·华盛顿（1732–1799）美国第一任总统（1789–1797），统领军队赢得美国独立战争，被称为“国父”。1775 年大陆会议上被任命为美国军队总司令。率军在福吉谷艰难度过严冬，之后取得多次胜利，直至最后约克敦大捷。坚定支持美国宪法。1789 年当选美国第一任总统。支持建立一个强大的中央政府，但不喜欢党派之争。后再度当选总统，但拒绝第三次参选，回到弗农山庄家中。华盛顿深得美国人敬仰，被认为是最杰出、最高尚的总统之一，最伟大的国家领袖，或许也是美国独立战争期间唯一能够团结殖民地人民的人物。一个有关他童年的故事广为流传：他砍倒了父亲的樱桃树，但承认了自己的行为，说：“我不能撒谎。”这个故事也许并不真实，但被视为他诚实品格的象征。华盛顿优秀的个人品质和公正的政治立场在他生前已得到认可，如今看来更是令人敬佩。人们以各种方式纪念他：树立华盛顿纪念碑，以他的名字命名美国首都、一个州、许多县，以及政府大楼、学校、街道、山脉等，他的形象出现在 1 美元纸币和 25 美分硬币上。

senses.def: a fashionable and expensive district of Washington, DC
senses.zh: 乔治敦（Georgetown）：华盛顿特区一个时尚而昂贵的地区。它位于波托马克河上，是这座城市最古老的地区。乔治敦大学是美国最好的大学之一，成立于1789年。

examples.zh: 工会同意，员工只有在午餐期间和下班后被允许关闭地理跟踪功能的情况下才可以携带 GPS 手机。

a first name for boys
(1925-95) an English zoologist
senses.zh: 杰拉尔德·杜雷尔（Gerald Durrell）：（1925-95）是一位英语动物学家，并且是一生中有关研究和收集动物的书籍的作者。其中包括《我的家庭和其他动物》（1956年）和《我的行李中的动物园》（1960年）。他是劳伦斯·杜雷尔（Lawrence Durrell）的弟弟。

senses.def: (1913-2006) the 38th US President. He was a Republican
senses.zh: 杰拉尔德·福特（1913–2006）美国第 38 任总统。共和党人，理查德·尼克松的副总统，1974 年水门事件后接替尼克松继任总统。因赦免尼克松而受到批评。福特无法改变当时美国糟糕的经济状况，在此后的 1976 年大选中败给吉米·卡特。

senses.zh: （1925-59）是英国漫画家和音乐家，出生于德国。他的幽默绘画，尤其是音乐家的幽默绘画，在贺卡等上仍然很受欢迎。

senses.def: (1844-89) an English Jesuit priest who wrote poems about religious ideas and the beauty of nature, using a form of verse
senses.zh: 杰拉德·曼利·霍普金斯（Gerard Manley Hopkins）：（1844-89）一位英国耶稣会牧师，他使用一种被称为“簧上韵律”的诗句形式写下有关宗教观念和自然之美的诗。他最著名的作品是《德国残骸》，《染色美女》和《风悬》。他的诗在他的朋友罗伯特·布里奇斯（Robert Bridges）死后于1918年首次出版，并影响了后来的诗人，包括奥登（WH Auden）和迪伦·托马斯（Dylan Thomas）。

senses.def: (c. 1829-1909) an Apache
senses.zh: 杰罗尼莫（Geronimo）：（约1829-1909年）阿帕奇（Apache）带领他的人民在亚利桑那州与美国军队和定居在那里的白人对抗。经过十年的战斗（1876-86），Geronimo投降了，并最终以农民的身份定居在俄克拉荷马州。在第二次世界大战中，美军伞兵从飞机上跳下来时常常喊着他的名字，以鼓起勇气。如今，人们经常在从高处跳下或做危险的事情时这样做。

examples.zh: 他的讲话至少是改善两国关系的一个姿态。

examples.en: She gestured for them to come in.

examples.en: Try to get some sleep.
examples.zh: 尽量睡会儿吧。

examples.en: You can also get information on careers in social work from their website.
examples.zh: 您还可以从他们的网站获取有关社会工作职业的信息。

examples.en: I think someone's trying to get your attention.
examples.zh: 我认为有人想引起你的注意。

examples.en: She really knows how to get results.
examples.zh: 她真的知道如何获得结果。

senses.def: to buy something

examples.en: Where did you get that skirt?
examples.zh: 你在哪儿买的那条裙子？

examples.en: Did you manage to get tickets for the concert?
examples.zh: 你弄到音乐会的票了吗？

examples.en: Can I get a Coke?
examples.zh: 给我来罐可乐好吗？

examples.en: Did you get a present for your mother?
examples.zh: 给你母亲买礼物了吗？

examples.en: Did you get your mother a present?
examples.zh: 给你母亲买礼物了吗？

examples.en: Why don't you get yourself a car?
examples.zh: 你为什么不买辆汽车呢？

examples.en: $100 will get you the basic model.
examples.zh: 100美元就能买到基本款。

examples.en: You can get yourself the basic model for $100.
examples.zh: 您可以花 100 美元购买基本型号。

senses.def: to obtain or receive an amount of money by selling something

examples.en: If you sell it at auction you can expect to get roughly £800.
examples.zh: 如果你在拍卖会上出售它，预计可以得到大约 800 英镑。

examples.en: How much did you get for your car?
examples.zh: 你的汽车卖了多少钱？

examples.en: We got £420 000 for the house.
examples.zh: 我们的房子卖了42万英镑。

senses.def: to go to a place and bring somebody/something back

examples.en: Quick—go and get a cloth!
examples.zh: 快，去拿块布来！

examples.en: Somebody get a doctor!
examples.zh: 谁赶紧叫个医生来！

examples.en: She went to get help.
examples.zh: 她去寻求帮助。

examples.en: I have to go and get my mother from the airport (= collect her).
examples.zh: 我得去机场接我母亲。

examples.en: Get a drink for John.
examples.zh: 给约翰拿杯饮料来。

examples.en: Get John a drink.
examples.zh: 给约翰拿杯饮料来。

senses.def: to achieve or be given a particular mark or grade in an exam

examples.en: He got a ‘C’ in Chemistry and a ‘B’ in English.
examples.zh: 他化学得了 C，英语得了 B。

senses.def: to start to develop an illness; to suffer from a pain, etc.

examples.en: I got this cold off (= from) you!
examples.zh: 我这感冒是被你传染的！

examples.en: She gets (= often suffers from) really bad headaches.
examples.zh: 她经常头痛得厉害。

examples.en: I think I'm getting a cold.
examples.zh: 我觉得自己感冒了。

senses.def: to receive something as a punishment

examples.en: He got ten years (= was sent to prison for ten years) for armed robbery.
examples.zh: 他因持枪抢劫被判刑十年。

senses.def: to connect to the internet or a phone network; to receive broadcasts from a particular television or radio station

examples.en: 95 per cent of the UK can now get superfast broadband.
examples.zh: 英国 95% 的地区现在可以接入超高速宽带。

examples.en: I couldn't get any mobile phone reception.
examples.zh: 我手机完全没信号。

examples.en: We can't get Channel 5 in our area.
examples.zh: 我们地区收不到 5 频道的节目。

senses.def: to be connected with somebody by phone
senses.zh: 与（某人）电话联系；与（某人）通电话

examples.en: I wanted to speak to the manager but I got her assistant instead.
examples.zh: 我想和经理谈谈，但我找到了她的助理。

senses.def: to arrive at or reach a place or point

examples.en: We got to San Diego at 7 o'clock.
examples.zh: 我们 7 点钟到达了圣迭戈。

examples.en: We're aiming to get to the party at about nine.
examples.zh: 我们想要在9点左右去到聚会地点。

examples.en: You got in very late last night.
examples.zh: 你昨晚回来得很晚。

examples.en: I got back an hour ago.
examples.zh: 我一个钟头前回来的。

examples.en: Wait till we get home.
examples.zh: 等我们回家再说。

examples.en: What time did you get here?
examples.zh: 你什么时候到达这儿的？

examples.en: Let me know when you get there.
examples.zh: 你到达那里就告诉我。

examples.en: I haven't got very far with the book I'm reading.
examples.zh: 我那本书还没读多少呢。

senses.def: to move to or from a particular place or in a particular direction, sometimes with difficulty; to make somebody/something do this
senses.zh: （使）到达，离开，沿…移动，艰难地移动

examples.en: The bridge was destroyed so we couldn't get across the river.
examples.zh: 大桥已经毁坏，我们无法过河了。

examples.en: She got into bed.
examples.zh: 她上床睡觉了。

examples.en: He got down from the ladder.
examples.zh: 他从梯子上下来了。

examples.en: We didn't get (= go) to bed until 3 a.m.
examples.zh: 我们直到凌晨 3 点才上床睡觉。

examples.en: Where do we get on the bus?
examples.zh: 我们在哪儿上公共汽车？

examples.en: I'm getting off (= leaving the train) at the next station.
examples.zh: 我在下一站下车。

examples.en: Where have they got to (= where are they)?
examples.zh: 他们到什么地方去了？

examples.en: We must be getting home; it's past midnight.
examples.zh: 我们得回家了，已过半夜了。

examples.en: We couldn't get the piano through the door.
examples.zh: 我们无法将钢琴搬过这道门。

examples.en: We'd better call a taxi and get you home.
examples.zh: 我们最好叫辆出租车送你回家。

examples.en: The general had to get his troops across the river.
examples.zh: 将军必须让部队过河。

examples.en: I can't get the lid off.
examples.zh: 我打不开盖子。

senses.def: to use a bus, taxi, plane, etc.
senses.zh: 搭乘，乘坐（公共汽车、出租车、飞机等）

examples.en: We're going to be late—let's get a taxi.
examples.zh: 我们要迟到了，咱们坐出租车吧。

examples.en: I usually get the bus to work.
examples.zh: 我通常坐公共汽车上班。

senses.def: to reach a particular state or condition; to make somebody/something/yourself reach a particular state or condition

examples.en: to get angry/bored/hungry/fat
examples.zh: 发怒；生厌；感到饿；发胖

examples.en: to get better/worse
examples.zh: 变好；变坏

examples.en: You'll soon get used to the climate here.
examples.zh: 你会很快习惯这儿的气候的。

examples.en: We ought to go; it's getting late.
examples.zh: 我们该走了，天色越来越晚了。

examples.en: to get dressed/undressed (= to put your clothes on/take your clothes off)
examples.zh: 穿上╱脱下衣服

examples.en: They plan to get married in the summer.
examples.zh: 他们打算夏天结婚。

examples.en: She's upstairs getting ready.
examples.zh: 她在楼上做准备。

examples.en: As he's got older his tastes have changed.
examples.zh: 随着年龄的增长，他的口味变了。

examples.en: She was getting sick of hearing him complain.
examples.zh: 她已经听腻了他的抱怨。

examples.en: There's nothing to get excited about.
examples.zh: 没有什么可激动的。

examples.en: He got drunk and passed out.
examples.zh: 他喝醉了，昏倒了。

examples.en: I was starting to get tired.
examples.zh: 我开始感到有些累了。

examples.en: I wouldn't go there alone; you might get (= be) mugged.
examples.zh: 我不会一个人去那儿，说不准会碰上抢劫的。

examples.en: My car got (= was) stolen at the weekend.
examples.zh: 我的汽车周末被偷了。

examples.en: Don't get your dress dirty!
examples.zh: 别把你的连衣裙弄脏了！

examples.en: He got his fingers caught in the door.
examples.zh: 他的手指给门夹了。

examples.en: I'm trying to get the children ready for school.
examples.zh: 我正在努力让孩子们做好上学的准备。

senses.def: to reach the point at which you feel, know, are, etc. something
senses.zh: 开始（感觉到、认识到、成为）；达到…地步（或程度）

examples.en: After a time you get to realize that these things don't matter.
examples.zh: 过段时间你会明白这些事情并不要紧。

examples.en: You'll like her once you get to know her.
examples.zh: 你一旦了解了她就会喜欢她的。

examples.en: His drinking is getting to be a problem.
examples.zh: 他的酗酒越来越成问题了。

examples.en: She's getting to be an old lady now.
examples.zh: 她现在都快是个老太婆了。

senses.def: to cause something to happen or be done
senses.zh: 使（某事）发生；使完成（某事）

examples.en: I must get my hair cut.
examples.zh: 我得理发了。

examples.en: I'll never get all this work finished.
examples.zh: 这么多的工作我怎么也干不完。

examples.en: She has a reputation for getting things done.
examples.zh: 她以执行力强闻名。

senses.group: get something done 使完成某事

senses.def: to make, persuade, etc. somebody/something to do something
senses.zh: 使，让（某人或物做某事）；说服（某人做某事）

examples.en: I couldn't get the car to start this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上没法让这汽车发动起来。

examples.en: He got his sister to help him with his homework.
examples.zh: 他让姐姐帮助他做家庭作业。

examples.en: You'll never get him to understand.
examples.zh: 你永远不会使他明白的。

examples.en: It's not hard to get him talking—the problem is stopping him!
examples.zh: 让他谈话并不难，难的是让他住口！

examples.en: Can you really get that old car going again?
examples.zh: 你真能让那老爷车再跑起来吗？

senses.def: to start doing something

examples.en: I got talking to her.
examples.zh: 我开始与她谈起来。

examples.en: We need to get going soon.
examples.zh: 我们需要马上出发。

senses.def: to have the opportunity to do something
senses.zh: 有机会（做某事）；得到（做某事的）机会

examples.en: He got to try out all the new software.
examples.zh: 他得以试用了所有的新软件。

examples.en: It's not fair—I never get to go first.
examples.zh: 这不公平，我从来没有机会先走。

senses.def: to prepare a meal

examples.en: Who's getting the lunch?
examples.zh: 谁来做午饭？

examples.en: You sit down and relax. I'll get supper.
examples.zh: 你坐着放松一下，我来做晚饭。

examples.en: I must go home and get tea for the kids.
examples.zh: 我得回家为孩子们准备茶点。

examples.en: I must go home and get the kids their tea.
examples.zh: 我得回家为孩子们准备茶点。

senses.def: to answer the phone or a door when somebody calls, knocks, etc.

examples.en: Will you get the door?
examples.zh: 你会开门吗？

senses.def: to catch or take hold of somebody, especially in order to harm or punish them
senses.zh: （尤指为伤害或惩罚）抓住，捉住，逮住

examples.en: He was on the run for a week before the police got him.
examples.zh: 他逃跑一周后警方才将他逮住。

examples.en: to get somebody by the arm/wrist/throat
examples.zh: 抓住某人的胳膊／手腕；掐住某人的喉咙

examples.en: She fell overboard and the sharks got her.
examples.zh: 她从船上跌入水中被鲨鱼咬了。

examples.en: He thinks everybody is out to get him (= trying to harm him).
examples.zh: 他认为所有人都想害他。

examples.en: I'll get you for that!
examples.zh: 这事我跟你没完！

senses.def: to hit or wound somebody

examples.en: The bullet got him in the neck.
examples.zh: 子弹击中了他的颈部。

senses.def: to understand somebody/something

examples.en: I don't get you.
examples.zh: 我搞不懂你的意思。

examples.en: She didn't get the joke.
examples.zh: 她不明白那笑话的含义。

examples.en: I don't get it—why would she do a thing like that?
examples.zh: 我不明白，她怎么会干那种事？

examples.en: I get the message—you don't want me to come.
examples.zh: 我明白这意思，你是不希望我来。

senses.def: used to say that something happens or exists

examples.en: You get (= There are) all these kids hanging around in the street.
examples.zh: 所有这些孩子都在街上闲逛。

examples.en: They still get cases of typhoid there.
examples.zh: 他们那儿仍有伤寒病发生。

senses.def: to make somebody feel confused because they do not understand something

examples.en: ‘What's the capital of Bhutan?’ ‘You've got me there!’ (= I don't know)
examples.zh: “不丹的首都在什么地方？”“你可把我难倒了！”

senses.def: to annoy somebody

examples.en: What gets me is having to do the same thing all day long.
examples.zh: 使我感到烦恼的是整天都得干同样的事。

senses.def: to be becoming old
to be becoming late

examples.en: The time's getting on—we ought to be going.
examples.zh: 时间越来越晚了，我们该走了。

senses.def: to be nearly a particular time, age or number
senses.zh: 接近（某时刻、年龄或数目）

examples.en: It must be getting on for midnight.
examples.zh: 一定快到半夜了。

examples.en: He's getting on for eighty.
examples.zh: 他近八十岁了。

senses.def: used to say that you are shocked, surprised, etc. by something
senses.zh: 因…而感到震惊（或惊讶等）

examples.en: I can't get over how rude she was.
examples.zh: 她这么粗鲁真使我感到惊讶。

senses.def: to have a short holiday in a place where you can relax
to leave a place in order to go somewhere else

examples.en: It's been lovely to see you, but it's probably time we got going.
examples.zh: 很高兴见到你，但我们差不多该走了。

senses.def: to start happening or being done

examples.en: The project hasn't really got going yet.
examples.zh: 这个项目还没有真正启动。

senses.def: to make somebody angry, worried or excited
senses.zh: 激怒某人；使某人担忧（或激动）

senses.def: to succeed in starting a machine, vehicle, process, etc.
senses.zh: 把（机器、车辆等）发动起来；启动（机器、车辆、进程等）

examples.en: We finally managed to get the car going.
examples.zh: 我们终于把车发动了。

senses.def: to be punished or spoken to angrily about something

examples.en: If your dad finds out you'll really get it!
examples.zh: 要是你爸爸发现了，有你受的！

senses.def: to have sex with somebody
to have an erection
to not help somebody make progress or succeed
senses.zh: 使无所进展（或成就）；徒劳

examples.en: This line of investigation is getting us nowhere.
examples.zh: 这种调查方式不会使我们得到任何结果。

examples.en: Being rude to me won't get you anywhere.
examples.zh: 你对我撒野也没有用。

senses.def: to make some progress/no progress

examples.en: After six months' work on the project, at last I feel I'm getting somewhere.
examples.zh: 那个项目干了六个月之后，我终于感到有了一些进展。

examples.en: I don't seem to be getting anywhere with this essay.
examples.zh: 这篇文章我似乎没有任何收获。

senses.def: to achieve your aim or complete a task
senses.zh: 达到目的；完成任务；获得成功

examples.en: I'm sure you'll get there in the end.
examples.zh: 我相信你最终会成功的。

examples.en: It's not perfect but we're getting there (= making progress).
examples.zh: 虽然这并非完美无瑕，但我们正朝着目标前进。

senses.def: used to say that you are going to tell somebody something that they will find surprising or interesting
senses.zh: 听好了（用于表示要告诉大家令人吃惊或有趣的事情）

examples.en: OK, get this guys—there are only two left!
examples.zh: 好吧，听好了，伙计们，只剩两个了！

examples.en: So get this—I did all the work and he got the money.
examples.zh: 听好了——我做了所有的工作，他却得到了钱。

senses.def: used to express surprise or disapproval
senses.zh: （表示惊奇或不赞成）你怎么这么自私（或愚蠢、忘恩负义等）

senses.def: you have to admit that something unpleasant is true
senses.zh: 不容否认，只好承认（不愉快的事实）

senses.def: used to ask, especially in an angry way, what somebody is/was suggesting
senses.zh: （尤指气愤地问）你（或他等）这话是什么意思，你（或他等）用意何在

examples.en: I'm partly to blame? What exactly are you getting at?
examples.zh: 我应负部分责任？你究竟是什么意思？

senses.def: used to say that somebody has suddenly started to behave in a strange or different way
senses.zh: （表示某人突然行为反常起来）…怎么啦

examples.en: What's got into Alex? He never used to worry like that.
examples.zh: 亚历克斯怎么啦？他以前从未那样愁过。

examples.en: I’m sorry for laughing like that—I don’t know what got into me.
examples.zh: 我很抱歉这样笑——我不知道我怎么了。

note.en: Most idioms containing get are at the entries for the nouns and adjectives in the idioms, for example get somebody’s goat is at goat.
note.zh: 大多数含 get 的习语，都可在该等习语中的名词及形容词相关词条找到，如 get sb’s goat 在词条 goat 下。

senses.def: to be becoming old
to be becoming late

examples.en: The time's getting on—we ought to be going.
examples.zh: 时间越来越晚了，我们该走了。

senses.def: to be nearly a particular time, age or number
senses.zh: 接近（某时刻、年龄或数目）

examples.en: It must be getting on for midnight.
examples.zh: 一定快到半夜了。

examples.en: He's getting on for eighty.
examples.zh: 他近八十岁了。

senses.def: used to say that you are shocked, surprised, etc. by something
senses.zh: 因…而感到震惊（或惊讶等）

examples.en: I can't get over how rude she was.
examples.zh: 她这么粗鲁真使我感到惊讶。

senses.def: to have a short holiday in a place where you can relax
to leave a place in order to go somewhere else

examples.en: It's been lovely to see you, but it's probably time we got going.
examples.zh: 很高兴见到你，但我们差不多该走了。

senses.def: to start happening or being done

examples.en: The project hasn't really got going yet.
examples.zh: 这个项目还没有真正启动。

senses.def: to make somebody angry, worried or excited
senses.zh: 激怒某人；使某人担忧（或激动）

senses.def: to succeed in starting a machine, vehicle, process, etc.
senses.zh: 把（机器、车辆等）发动起来；启动（机器、车辆、进程等）

examples.en: We finally managed to get the car going.
examples.zh: 我们终于把车发动了。

senses.def: to be punished or spoken to angrily about something

examples.en: If your dad finds out you'll really get it!
examples.zh: 要是你爸爸发现了，有你受的！

senses.def: to have sex with somebody
to have an erection

items.idm: get somebody nowhere/not get somebody anywhere

senses.def: to not help somebody make progress or succeed
senses.zh: 使无所进展（或成就）；徒劳

examples.en: This line of investigation is getting us nowhere.
examples.zh: 这种调查方式不会使我们得到任何结果。

examples.en: Being rude to me won't get you anywhere.
examples.zh: 你对我撒野也没有用。

senses.def: to make some progress/no progress

examples.en: After six months' work on the project, at last I feel I'm getting somewhere.
examples.zh: 那个项目干了六个月之后，我终于感到有了一些进展。

examples.en: I don't seem to be getting anywhere with this essay.
examples.zh: 这篇文章我似乎没有任何收获。

senses.def: to achieve your aim or complete a task
senses.zh: 达到目的；完成任务；获得成功

examples.en: I'm sure you'll get there in the end.
examples.zh: 我相信你最终会成功的。

examples.en: It's not perfect but we're getting there (= making progress).
examples.zh: 虽然这并非完美无瑕，但我们正朝着目标前进。

senses.def: used to say that you are going to tell somebody something that they will find surprising or interesting
senses.zh: 听好了（用于表示要告诉大家令人吃惊或有趣的事情）

examples.en: OK, get this guys—there are only two left!
examples.zh: 好吧，听好了，伙计们，只剩两个了！

examples.en: So get this—I did all the work and he got the money.
examples.zh: 听好了——我做了所有的工作，他却得到了钱。

items.idm: how selfish, stupid, ungrateful, etc. can you get?

senses.def: used to express surprise or disapproval
senses.zh: （表示惊奇或不赞成）你怎么这么自私（或愚蠢、忘恩负义等）

items.idm: there’s no getting away from something | you can’t get away from something

senses.def: you have to admit that something unpleasant is true
senses.zh: 不容否认，只好承认（不愉快的事实）

items.idm: what are you, was he, etc. getting at?

senses.def: used to ask, especially in an angry way, what somebody is/was suggesting
senses.zh: （尤指气愤地问）你（或他等）这话是什么意思，你（或他等）用意何在

examples.zh: 我应负部分责任？你究竟是什么意思？

senses.zh: （表示某人突然行为反常起来）…怎么啦

examples.zh: 亚历克斯怎么啦？他以前从未那样愁过。

intro.en: These words all mean to know or realize something, for example why something happens, how something works or what something means.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含懂得、理解、认识到之义。

items.def: to know or realize the meaning of words, a language, what somebody says, etc.; to know or realize how or why something happens, how it works or why it is important:

examples.zh: 你什么时候到达希思罗机场？

senses.def: to win an election

examples.en: The Republican candidate stands a good chance of getting in.
examples.zh: 共和党候选人很可能当选。

examples.en: She first got into Parliament (= became an MP) in 2015.
examples.zh: 她于 2015 年首次进入议会（即成为议员）。

senses.def: to be admitted to a school, university, etc.
senses.zh: 被录取；被接受入学（或入会等）

examples.en: She's got into Durham to study law.
examples.zh: 她被录取到杜伦大学学习法律。

senses.def: to call somebody to your house to do a job
to collect or gather something

examples.en: to get the crops/harvest in
examples.zh: 收获作物／庄稼

senses.def: to buy a supply of something

examples.en: Remember to get in some beers for this evening.
examples.zh: 记住为今天的晚会买些啤酒。

senses.def: to manage to do or say something

examples.en: I got in an hour's work while the baby was asleep.
examples.zh: 我趁孩子睡觉抽空干了一小时的活。

examples.en: She talks so much it's impossible to get a word in.
examples.zh: 她说起话来滔滔不绝，让人一句话都插不进去。

senses.def: to take part in an activity

examples.en: He's hoping to get in on any discussions about the new project.
examples.zh: 他盼望着参加有关这一新项目的任何讨论。

senses.def: to become friendly with somebody, especially in order to gain an advantage
senses.zh: （尤指为捞取好处与某人）成为朋友，拉关系，套近乎

senses.def: to arrive at a place

examples.en: The train got in late.
examples.zh: 火车晚点到达。

examples.en: What time do you get into Heathrow?
examples.zh: 你什么时候到达希思罗机场？

senses.def: to win an election

examples.en: The Republican candidate stands a good chance of getting in.
examples.zh: 共和党候选人很可能当选。

examples.en: She first got into Parliament (= became an MP) in 2015.
examples.zh: 她于 2015 年首次进入议会（即成为议员）。

senses.def: to be admitted to a school, university, etc.
senses.zh: 被录取；被接受入学（或入会等）

examples.en: She's got into Durham to study law.
examples.zh: 她被录取到杜伦大学学习法律。

senses.def: to put on a piece of clothing, especially with difficulty

examples.en: I can't get into these shoes—they're too small.
examples.zh: 这双鞋太小，我穿不进去。

senses.def: to start a career in a particular profession

examples.en: What's the best way to get into journalism?
examples.zh: 进入新闻界的最佳途径是什么？

senses.def: to become involved in something; to start something

examples.en: I got into conversation with an Italian student.
examples.zh: 我与一位意大利学生谈了起来。

examples.en: to get into a fight
examples.zh: 参与斗殴

examples.en: Are you sure you know what you're getting into?
examples.zh: 我这项工作进展得不太快。

senses.def: to develop a particular habit

examples.en: Don't let yourself get into bad habits.
examples.zh: 别让自己染上恶习。

examples.en: You should get into the routine of saving the document you are working on every ten minutes.
examples.zh: 你应该养成每十分钟将正在编辑的文件存盘一次的习惯。

examples.en: How did she get into (= start taking) drugs?
examples.zh: 她是怎么染上毒品的？

senses.def: to become interested in something

examples.en: I'm really getting into jazz these days.
examples.zh: 我最近迷上了爵士乐。

senses.def: to become familiar with something; to learn something

examples.en: I haven't really got into my new job yet.
examples.zh: 我还未真正熟悉我的新工作。

senses.def: to reach a particular state or condition; to make somebody reach a particular state or condition

examples.en: He got into trouble with the police while he was still at school.
examples.zh: 他还在上学时就曾犯事落入警察手里。

examples.en: Three people were rescued from a yacht which got into difficulties.
examples.zh: 从遇险的游艇中营救出了三人。

examples.en: Are you sure this is allowed? I don't want to get you into trouble.
examples.zh: 您确定这是允许的吗？我不想给你带来麻烦。

examples.en: She got herself into a real state (= became very anxious) before the interview.
examples.zh: 她面试前格外地焦虑不安。

senses.def: used especially to tell somebody to stop touching you or another person
senses.zh: （尤用于告诉别人）别碰，走远点

examples.en: Get off me, that hurts!
examples.zh: 放开我，好痛哟！

senses.def: to leave a place or start a journey; to help somebody do this

examples.en: We got off straight after breakfast.
examples.zh: 我们早饭后就立即动身了。

examples.en: He got the children off to school.
examples.zh: 他打发孩子们上学去了。

senses.def: to go to sleep; to make somebody do this

examples.en: I had great difficulty getting off to sleep.
examples.zh: 我很难入睡。

examples.en: They couldn't get the baby off till midnight.
examples.zh: 他们直到半夜才把宝宝哄入睡。

senses.def: to leave work with permission

examples.en: Could you get off (work) early tomorrow?
examples.zh: 你明天可以提早下班吗？

senses.def: to stop discussing a particular subject; to make somebody do this

examples.en: Please can we get off the subject of dieting?
examples.zh: 我们别再谈论节食这个话题行吗？

examples.en: I couldn't get him off politics once he had started.
examples.zh: 他一谈起政治我就没法让他停下。

senses.def: to send something by post or email

examples.en: I must get that email off.
examples.zh: 我必须把那封电子邮件发出去。

examples.en: I must get these packages off first thing tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天我第一件事就是要把这些包裹拿走。

senses.def: to have no or almost no injuries in an accident
senses.zh: （在事故中）幸免于难，并无大恙

examples.en: She was lucky to get off with just a few bruises.
examples.zh: 她幸免于难，只有几处碰伤。

senses.def: to receive no or almost no punishment; to help somebody do this

examples.en: He was lucky to get off with a small fine.
examples.zh: 他侥幸逃脱惩罚，交了一小笔罚款就了事。

examples.en: A good lawyer might be able to get you off.
examples.zh: 请位好律师或许能使你脱罪。

senses.def: to be excited by something, especially in a sexual way
senses.zh: 因…而兴奋，因…而激动（尤指性兴奋）

senses.def: to have a sexual or romantic experience with somebody; to start a sexual relationship with somebody
senses.zh: （与某人）发生性关系，谈恋爱，开始性关系

examples.en: Steve got off with Tracey at the party.
examples.zh: 史蒂夫在聚会上就与特蕾西亲热起来。

senses.def: used to talk or ask about how well somebody is doing in a particular situation

examples.en: He's getting on very well at school.
examples.zh: 他在学校学得很好。

examples.en: How did you get on at the interview?
examples.zh: 你面试的情况怎么样？

senses.def: to be successful in your career, etc.

examples.en: Parents are always anxious for their children to get on.
examples.zh: 父母总是急切地盼望孩子们事业有成。

examples.en: I don't know how he's going to get on in life.
examples.zh: 我不知道他将如何出人头地。

senses.def: to manage or survive

examples.en: We can get on perfectly well without her.
examples.zh: 没有她我们也能过得很好。

examples.en: I just can't get along without a secretary.
examples.zh: 没有秘书我简直寸步难行。

senses.def: to have a friendly relationship with somebody

examples.en: She's never really got on with her sister.
examples.zh: 她从未与妹妹真正和睦相处过。

examples.en: She and her sister have never really got on.
examples.zh: 她与妹妹一直合不来。

examples.en: We get along just fine together.
examples.zh: 我们相处得还算融洽。

senses.def: to contact somebody by phone, letter or email
senses.zh: （用电话、书信或电子邮件）与某人联系

examples.en: The heating isn't working; I'll get on to the landlord about it.
examples.zh: 暖气不热，我得与房东联系一下。

senses.def: to become aware of somebody’s activities, especially when they have been doing something bad or illegal
senses.zh: 觉察，察觉，识破（某人的不法行为）

examples.en: He had been stealing money from the company for years before they got on to him.
examples.zh: 他一直窃取公司的钱，多年后他们才发觉。

senses.def: to begin to talk about a new subject
senses.zh: 开始讨论，转而谈论（新课题）

examples.en: It's time we got on to the question of costs.
examples.zh: 我们该讨论成本问题了。

senses.def: to have a friendly relationship with somebody

examples.en: She's never really got on with her sister.
examples.zh: 她从未与妹妹真正和睦相处过。

examples.en: She and her sister have never really got on.
examples.zh: 她与妹妹一直合不来。

examples.en: We get along just fine together.
examples.zh: 我们相处得还算融洽。

senses.def: used to talk or ask about how well somebody is doing a task
senses.zh: （谈及或问及工作情况）进展，进步

examples.en: I'm not getting on very fast with this job.
examples.zh: 我这个工作进展不太快。

senses.def: to continue doing something, especially after you have been interrupted

examples.en: Be quiet and get on with your work.
examples.zh: 安静下来，继续干你的事。

examples.en: Get on with it! We haven't got all day.
examples.zh: 继续干吧！我们的时间并不多。

senses.def: to become known

examples.en: If this gets out there'll be trouble.
examples.zh: 这事要是被人知道就麻烦了。

senses.def: to produce or publish something

examples.en: Will we get the book out by the end of the year?
examples.zh: 我们这本书将在年底前出版吗？

senses.def: to say something with difficulty

examples.en: She managed to get out a few words of thanks.
examples.zh: 她终于勉强说了几句道谢的话。

senses.def: to leave or go out of a place

examples.en: You ought to get out of the house more.
examples.zh: 你应该多到户外去走走。

examples.en: She screamed at me to get out.
examples.zh: 她冲着我大声喊，让我出去。

senses.def: a way of avoiding something, especially a responsibility or duty
senses.zh: 回避（责任或义务）的办法；借口

examples.en: He said he'd come but he's looking for a get-out.
examples.zh: 他说过他会来，但眼下他又在找借口。

examples.en: a get-out clause in the contract
examples.zh: 合约里的规避条款

senses.def: to avoid a responsibility or duty
senses.zh: 逃避，规避，摆脱（责任或义务）

examples.en: We promised we'd go—we can't get out of it now.
examples.zh: 我们答应过要去的，现在我们不能食言。

examples.en: I wish I could get out of going to that meeting.
examples.zh: 但愿我能不去参加那个会。

senses.def: to stop having a particular habit

examples.en: I can't get out of the habit of waking at six in the morning.
examples.zh: 我早上六点钟醒的习惯改不了。

senses.def: to persuade somebody to tell or give you something, especially by force

examples.en: The police finally got a confession out of her.
examples.zh: 警方最终逼迫她招了供。

senses.def: to gain or obtain something good from somebody/something

examples.en: She seems to get a lot out of life.
examples.zh: 她似乎从生活中获益良多。

examples.en: He always gets the best out of people.
examples.zh: 他总能使人发挥最大的潜力。

senses.def: to deal with or gain control of something

examples.en: She can't get over her shyness.
examples.zh: 她无法克服羞怯心理。

examples.en: I think the problem can be got over without too much difficulty.
examples.zh: 我认为这个问题不太难解决。

senses.def: to return to your usual state of health, happiness, etc. after an illness, a shock, the end of a relationship, etc.
senses.zh: 从疾病（或震惊、断绝关系等）中恢复常态

examples.en: He was disappointed at not getting the job, but he'll get over it.
examples.zh: 他没得到这份工作非常失望，不过他会想得开的。

examples.en: OK, so you lost. Get over it!
examples.zh: 好吧，那你就输了。克服它吧！

senses.def: to make something clear to somebody
senses.zh: 向（某人）讲清某事；让（某人）明白某事

examples.en: He didn't really get his meaning over to the audience.
examples.zh: 他没能把他的意思清楚传递给观众。

senses.def: to complete something unpleasant but necessary
senses.zh: 完成，结束（令人不快但免不了的事）

examples.en: I'll be glad to get the exam over and done with.
examples.zh: 考试结束后我就高兴了。

senses.def: to stop thinking that you are so important; to stop being so serious
senses.zh: 别自以为是；别太当真了

examples.en: Just get over yourself and stop moaning!
examples.zh: 别太当真了，停止抱怨吧！

examples.en: He needs to grow up a bit and get over himself.
examples.zh: 他需要更成熟一点，不再那么自以为是。

senses.def: to persuade somebody to agree or to do what you want, usually by doing nice things for them
senses.zh: （常用讨好卖乖的手段）说服某人同意，哄骗某人依顺，笼络某人

examples.en: She knows how to get round her dad.
examples.zh: 她知道怎样讨她爸爸的欢心。

senses.def: to deal with a problem successfully

examples.en: A clever lawyer might find a way of getting round that clause.
examples.zh: 高明的律师也许能找到绕过那个条款的办法。

senses.def: to find the time to do something

examples.en: I meant to do the ironing but I didn't get round to it.
examples.zh: 我本想熨衣服的，可就是抽不出时间。

examples.en: I hope to get round to answering your query next week.
examples.zh: 我希望下周能抽出时间回答你的问题。

senses.def: to use up a large amount of something

examples.en: We got through a fortune while we were in New York!
examples.zh: 我们在纽约时花掉了一大笔钱！

senses.def: to manage to do or complete something

examples.en: Let's start—there's a lot to get through.
examples.zh: 咱们开始吧，有很多事要处理呢。

senses.def: to be successful in an exam, etc.
to help somebody to be successful in an exam
senses.zh: 帮助某人顺利通过考试

examples.en: She got all her students through the exam.
examples.zh: 她帮助她所有的学生顺利通过了考试。

senses.def: to be officially accepted; to make something be officially accepted

examples.en: They got the bill through Congress.
examples.zh: 他们使此议案在国会获得通过。

senses.def: to make contact with somebody by phone

examples.en: I tried calling you several times but I couldn't get through.
examples.zh: 我试着给你打了几次电话，但都没打通。

senses.def: to reach somebody

examples.en: Thousands of refugees will die if these supplies don't get through to them.
examples.zh: 如果这些供给品运不到，数以千计的难民就会死去。

senses.def: to reach the next stage of a competition

examples.en: Sakkari has got through to the final.
examples.zh: 萨卡里已经进入决赛。

senses.def: to make somebody understand or accept what you say, especially when you are trying to help them
senses.zh: （尤指在努力帮助某人时）使某人理解，使某人接受（所讲的话）

examples.en: I find it impossible to get through to her.
examples.zh: 我发觉根本无法让她听懂。

senses.def: to finish or complete a task
to annoy or affect somebody
senses.zh: 使烦恼；使生气；对某人产生影响

examples.en: The pressure of work is beginning to get to him.
examples.zh: 工作的压力使他烦恼起来。

senses.def: to collect people or things in one place

examples.en: I'm trying to get a team together for Saturday.
examples.zh: 我正设法召集一帮人过周六呢。

senses.def: to meet with somebody socially or in order to discuss something

examples.en: We must get together for a drink sometime.
examples.zh: 我们什么时候得聚在一起喝一杯。

examples.en: Management should get together with the union.
examples.zh: 资方应与工会在一起开个会。

senses.def: an informal meeting; a party

examples.en: a family get-together at Christmas
examples.zh: 圣诞节家庭聚会

examples.en: I’m going back for the usual family get-together at Thanksgiving.
examples.zh: 我像往年一样，感恩节回去和家人团聚。

examples.en: Most of the students were more interested in social get-togethers than going to lectures.
examples.zh: 大多数学生对社交聚会比听讲座更感兴趣。

senses.def: to stand up after sitting, lying, etc.

examples.en: The class got up when the teacher came in.
examples.zh: 老师进来时全班起立。

senses.def: if the sea or wind gets up
to get out of bed; to make somebody get out of bed

examples.en: He always gets up early.
examples.zh: 他一向起得早。

examples.en: Could you get me up at 6.30 tomorrow?
examples.zh: 明天你 6:30 叫我起床行吗？

senses.def: to arrange or organize something

examples.en: We're getting up a party for her birthday.
examples.zh: 我们正在筹备她的生日聚会。

senses.def: a set of clothes, especially strange or unusual ones
senses.zh: （尤指奇特的）一套衣服，穿戴，装束

senses.def: energy and a strong wish to get things done
to dress yourself/somebody as somebody/something else

examples.en: She was got up as an Indian princess.
examples.zh: 她被打扮成了印度公主。

get-up-on-the-wrong-side-of-the-bed: @@@LINK=get out of bed on the wrong side

senses.def: to reach a particular point

examples.en: We got up to page 72 last lesson.
examples.zh: 我们上一课学到第 72 页。

senses.def: to be busy with something, especially something surprising or unpleasant
senses.zh: 忙于，从事（尤指令人吃惊或不快的事）

examples.en: What on earth will he get up to next?
examples.zh: 他下一步究竟要干什么？

examples.en: She's been getting up to her old tricks again!
examples.zh: 她又在故伎重演了！

senses.def: to be dismissed from a job

examples.en: The whole department has been given the chop.
examples.zh: 整个部门的员工都已被解雇。

senses.def: to be stopped or ended

examples.en: Three more schemes have got the chop.
examples.zh: 又有三个方案被砍掉了。

senses.def: to get/be given/have the right to speak during a discussion or debate
to express the strong opinions that you have about a particular subject

examples.en: She’s on her soapbox about animal rights again!
examples.zh: 她又在发表有关保护动物权益的激烈演讲了！

examples.en: I’ve got no urge to be a politician or stand on a soapbox.
examples.zh: 我没有想成为一名政客或站在肥皂剧上的冲动。

senses.def: to be punished/punish somebody severely
senses.zh: （受到）严惩；（被）痛打一顿，申斥一顿

examples.en: I'll give her what for if she does that again.
examples.zh: 她若再这样做，看我怎么收拾她。

senses.def: to move close to somebody so that you can talk about something without other people hearing
senses.zh: 凑近（某人）说悄悄话；交头接耳

senses.def: to make no progress or have no success; to not enable somebody to make progress or have success

examples.en: We discussed it all morning but got nowhere.
examples.zh: 我们就此事讨论了一上午，可是毫无进展。

examples.en: Talking to him will get you nowhere.
examples.zh: 和他谈话你会一无所获。

examples.en: His career was going nowhere fast.
examples.zh: 他的事业停滞不前。

examples.en: The campaign over pay and conditions was getting nowhere.
examples.zh: 争取提高工资和改善工作条件的运动在原地踏步。

senses.def: to have made all the preparations needed to do something; to be well organized
senses.zh: 为某事做充分准备；把事情安排得井井有条

examples.en: The company has its ducks in a row for a move into the Asian market.
examples.zh: 该公司为进军亚洲市场做好了准备。

examples.en: Get your ducks in a row before you retire.
examples.zh: 在你退休之前把你的事情安排好。

get/have (all) your ducks in a row.word: get/have (all) your ducks in a row

senses.def: to get/have an understanding of something or be naturally good at doing it
senses.zh: 善于理解某事物；有…的天才

examples.en: She has a real feel for languages.
examples.zh: 她有语言天才。

senses.def: to understand or know about somebody/something, especially so that you can deal with it or them later

examples.en: I can't get a handle on these sales figures.
examples.zh: 我搞不懂这些销售数字。

senses.def: to manage to enter an organization, a field of business, etc. that could bring you success
senses.zh: 设法加入，涉足（某组织、行业等）

examples.en: I always wanted to work in TV but it took me two years to get a foot in the door.
examples.zh: 我一直想做电视工作，但花了两年才进了这个圈子。

get/have a/your foot in the door.word: get/have a/your foot in the door

senses.def: to suddenly become nervous about doing something that you had planned to do

examples.en: He was going to ask her but he got cold feet and said nothing.
examples.zh: 他本来是想问她的，可事到临头他却胆怯得什么也没有说。

senses.def: to want to travel or move to a different place; to want to do something different
senses.zh: 渴望旅行（或换个地方、做别的事）

examples.en: After a few years in one place, I get itchy feet.
examples.zh: 在一个地方待了几年后，我的脚开始发痒。

senses.def: to be sexually attracted to somebody
to become/be frightened about something
to have sex
if you say that people have their noses in the trough
senses.zh: 掉进钱眼里；一心发大财

get/have your nose/snout in the trough.word: get/have your nose/snout in the trough

senses.def: to get or do what you want, especially when somebody has tried to stop you

examples.en: She always gets her own way in the end.
examples.zh: 到最后总是她说了算。

get/have/take somebody's measure: @@@LINK=get/take/have the measure of somebody/something | get/have/take somebody’s measure

senses.def: to get/keep somebody’s support
senses.zh: 得到（或保持）某人的支持

examples.en: The party needs to keep the major national newspapers onside if it's going to win the next election.
examples.zh: 这个政党要想在下次大选中获胜，就需要得到全国各大报纸的继续支持。

senses.zh: 格伦科（Glencoe）：苏格兰高地的山谷。1692年，这里是格伦科大屠杀的现场。麦克唐纳氏族的大约40名成员被坎贝尔氏族的成员和英国国王威廉三世的士兵杀死。麦当劳之所以被杀，是因为他们支持了第一次雅各布派叛乱，并且迟迟不承认威廉和玛丽为国王和王后。

a pair of famous golf courses (called the King's course and the Queen's course) belonging to a hotel in central Scotland. In 1977 the leaders of the Commonwealth governments met there to sign the Gleneagles Principle, in which they agreed to have no contact in sport with South Africa because of the political situation there at the time.
senses.zh: 格伦伊格尔斯（Gleneagles）：属于苏格兰中部一家酒店的一对著名的高尔夫球场（称为国王球场和女王球场）。1977年，英联邦国家政府的领导人在此开会，签署了《格伦伊格尔斯原则》。在该原则中，由于当时的政治局势，他们同意与南非在体育运动方面不存在任何接触。
