of high quality or an acceptable standard
senses.zh: 好的；优质的；符合标准的；可接受的

examples.en: a good book
examples.zh: 一本好书

examples.en: good food
examples.zh: 符合标准的食品

examples.en: The piano was in really good condition.
examples.zh: 这架钢琴状况优良。

examples.en: Your work is just not good enough.
examples.zh: 你的工作就是不够好。

examples.en: The results were pretty good.
examples.zh: 结果相当不错。

examples.en: Sorry, my English is not very good.
examples.zh: 对不起，我的英语不太好。

examples.en: They've done a reasonably good job.
examples.zh: 他们做得相当不错。

examples.en: Keep up the good work!
examples.zh: 继续好好干！

examples.en: It's a good way to make friends.
examples.zh: 这是交朋友的好方法。

examples.en: The sound and picture are both of good quality.
examples.zh: 声音和图像的质量都很好。

examples.en: Things are looking good at the moment.
examples.zh: 目前情况很好。

examples.en: You'll never marry her—she's much too good for you.
examples.zh: 你永远娶不到她，她对你来说高不可攀。

senses.def: pleasant; that you enjoy or want
senses.zh: 令人愉快的；令人满意的

examples.en: Did you have a good time in London?
examples.zh: 你在伦敦过得愉快吗？

examples.en: This is very good news.
examples.zh: 这消息真叫人高兴。

examples.en: Let's hope we have good weather tomorrow.
examples.zh: 希望明天是个好天。

examples.en: It's good to see you again.
examples.zh: 再次见到你真高兴。

examples.en: There are loads of good things about working here.
examples.zh: 在这里工作好处多多。

examples.en: We are still friends, though, which is good.
examples.zh: 不过我们仍然是朋友，这令人感到欣慰。

senses.def: sensible, logical or strongly supporting what is being discussed
senses.zh: 合情理的；有说服力的；有充分根据的

examples.en: Thank you, good question.
examples.zh: 谢谢，问题提得好。

examples.en: Yes, that's a good point.
examples.zh: 是的，那一点说得对。

examples.en: I have good reason to be suspicious.
examples.zh: 我的怀疑有充分理由。

examples.en: What a good idea!
examples.zh: 多好的主意啊！

examples.en: This is a good example of what I mean.
examples.zh: 这个例子很能说明我的意思。

senses.def: showing or getting approval or respect
senses.zh: 赞同的；赢得赞许的；令人尊敬的

examples.en: The play had good reviews.
examples.zh: 这部戏受到好评。

examples.en: The hotel has a good reputation.
examples.zh: 这家旅馆声誉良好。

examples.en: He comes from a good family.
examples.zh: 他出身名门。

senses.def: able to do something well

examples.en: a good player
examples.zh: 优秀的选手

examples.en: a good actor/cook
examples.zh: 好演员；好厨师

examples.en: to be good at languages/your job
examples.zh: 精通多种语言；工作熟练

examples.en: Nick has always been good at finding cheap flights.
examples.zh: 尼克总能找到价格便宜的航班。

senses.def: able to use something or deal with people well
senses.zh: 灵巧的；精明的；善于应付…的

examples.en: She's good with her hands (= able to make things, etc.).
examples.zh: 她手很巧。

examples.en: He's very good with children.
examples.zh: 他对孩子很有一套。

examples.en: She's good with figures.
examples.zh: 她擅长算术。

senses.def: morally right; behaving in a way that is morally right
senses.zh: 符合道德的；正派的；高尚的

examples.en: She has tried to lead a good life.
examples.zh: 她努力规规矩矩地生活。

examples.en: I took Sarah's children to school so I've done my good deed for the day.
examples.zh: 我送了萨拉的孩子去上学，所以今天已经做了善事。

examples.en: Giving her that money was a good thing to do.
examples.zh: 把那笔钱给她是做了一件善事。

examples.en: He is a very good man.
examples.zh: 他是个非常高尚的人。

examples.en: She prayed that God would make her a better person.
examples.zh: 她祈求上帝让她成为一个更好的人。

senses.def: following strictly a set of rules or principles

examples.en: It is good practice to supply a written report to the buyer.
examples.zh: 向买主提供书面报告是诚信的做法。

examples.en: She was a good Catholic girl.
examples.zh: 她是个虔诚的天主教徒。

senses.def: willing to help; kind to other people
senses.zh: 乐于助人的；心地善良的；好心的

examples.en: You've always been such a good friend.
examples.zh: 你一直都是我的好朋友。

examples.en: He was very good to me when I was ill.
examples.zh: 我生病时他对我关怀备至。

examples.en: She looked into it for me, which was very good of her.
examples.zh: 她帮我查了一下，这对她来说非常好。

examples.en: It was very good of you to come.
examples.zh: 你能来真是太好了。

examples.en: I had to take a week off work but my colleagues were very good about it.
examples.zh: 我得请一周的假，同事们对此非常谅解。

senses.def: behaving well or politely

examples.en: You can stay up late if you're good.
examples.zh: 你要是听话就可以晚一点睡觉。

examples.en: Get dressed now, there's a good girl.
examples.zh: 现在把衣服穿好，好姑娘。

examples.en: ‘That's a good dog,’ I said, patting its head.
examples.zh: “真是一条乖乖狗。”我拍着它的头说道。

senses.def: healthy or strong

examples.en: Can you speak into my good ear?
examples.zh: 对着我这只没毛病的耳朵说好吗？

examples.en: I don't feel too good today.
examples.zh: 我今天感觉不太舒服。

examples.en: ‘How are you?’ ‘I'm good.’ (= used as a general reply to a greeting)
examples.zh: “你好吗？”“我很好。”

senses.def: having a useful or helpful effect on somebody/something

examples.en: Living so close to a chemicals factory can't be good.
examples.zh: 住得离化工厂这么近可不是什么好事。

examples.en: Too much sun isn't good for you.
examples.zh: 晒太阳太多对你并没有好处。

examples.en: Vegetables are good for you.
examples.zh: 多吃蔬菜对你有好处。

examples.en: policies that are good for business
examples.zh: 有利于业务的政策

examples.en: The deal will be good for the country as a whole.
examples.zh: 这笔交易对整个国家都有好处。

examples.en: It's probably good for you to get some criticism now and then.
examples.zh: 偶尔受点批评或许对你还有好处。

examples.en: Shut your mouth, if you know what's good for you (= used as a threat).
examples.zh: 你不想找麻烦就把嘴闭上。

senses.def: suitable or appropriate
senses.zh: 合适的；适宜的；恰当的；适合…的

examples.en: Now is a good time to buy a house.
examples.zh: 现在买房子正是时候。

examples.en: Do you really think this is a good use of your time?
examples.zh: 你真的认为这是好好利用时间吗？

examples.en: Students are not allowed to miss classes without good reason.
examples.zh: 学生无正当理由不许缺课。

examples.en: She would be good for the job.
examples.zh: 她干这工作很合适。

examples.en: Can we change our meeting? Monday isn't good (= convenient) for me.
examples.zh: 我们另约时间见面吧，星期一我不方便。

examples.en: This is as good a place as any to spend the night.
examples.zh: 有这么个地方过夜就很好了。

senses.def: used in speaking to show that you approve of or are pleased about something that has been said or done, or to show that you want to move on to a new topic of conversation
senses.zh: （用于口语，表示赞同、满意或转换话题）

examples.en: ‘Dinner's ready.’ ‘Good—I'm starving.’
examples.zh: “晚饭好了。”“太好了，我正饿得很。”

examples.en: ‘I got the job.’ ‘Oh, good.’
examples.zh: “我得到这工作了。”“啊，太好了。”

examples.en: Good, I think we've come to a decision.
examples.zh: 好的，我们就这样决定吧。

senses.def: used as a form of praise

examples.en: Good old Jack!
examples.zh: 好心的杰克！

examples.en: ‘I've ordered some drinks.’ ‘Good man!’
examples.zh: “我叫了些饮料。”“真是好人！”

senses.def: used in exclamations

examples.en: Good heavens!
examples.zh: 天啊！

examples.en: Good God!
examples.zh: 上帝呀！

senses.def: great in number, amount or degree
senses.zh: （数量或程度）相当大的，相当多的

examples.en: a good number of people
examples.zh: 相当多的人

examples.en: The kitchen is a good size.
examples.zh: 这厨房相当大。

examples.en: We spent a good while (= quite a long time) looking for the house.
examples.zh: 我们花了好长时间找这房子。

examples.en: He devoted a good deal of (= a lot of) attention to the problem.
examples.zh: 他在这个问题上花了相当多的精力。

examples.en: There's a good chance (= it is likely) that I won't be here next year.
examples.zh: 我明年很可能不在这儿。

senses.def: not less than; rather more than

examples.en: We waited for a good hour.
examples.zh: 我们等了至少一小时。

examples.en: It's a good three miles to the station.
examples.zh: 到车站至少有三英里。

senses.def: done to a high level or a great degree; complete

examples.en: We had a good laugh about it afterwards.
examples.zh: 我们后来对此笑了个痛快。

examples.en: You'll feel better after a good sleep.
examples.zh: 好好睡上一觉你会感觉好些。

senses.def: funny or clever

examples.en: a good story/joke
examples.zh: 有趣的故事／笑话

examples.en: That's a good one!
examples.zh: 那真有意思！

senses.def: having enough energy, health, strength, etc. to last for a particular length of time or distance
senses.zh: （精力、健康、力量等）足以维持…的，能持续…的

examples.en: You're good for (= you will live) a few years yet.
examples.zh: 你还可以活上几年。

senses.group: for particular time/distance 特定的时间／距离

senses.def: acceptable for something

examples.en: The ticket is good for three months.
examples.zh: 这张票三个月内有效。

senses.group: for particular time/distance 特定的时间／距离

senses.def: likely to provide something

examples.en: He's always good for a laugh.
examples.zh: 他总能逗人发笑。

examples.en: Bobby should be good for a few drinks.
examples.zh: 博比喝上几杯应该是没问题的。

senses.group: likely to provide 可能提供

senses.def: very nearly
senses.zh: 与…几乎一样；几乎；简直是

examples.en: The matter is as good as settled.
examples.zh: 这事实际上可以说解决了。

examples.en: He as good as called me a coward (= suggested that I was a coward without actually using the word ‘coward’).
examples.zh: 他就差说我是懦夫了。

examples.en: She’s as good as won.
examples.zh: 她就像赢了一样好。

senses.group: likely to provide 可能提供

senses.def: used when you are saying that a situation is not going to get any better
senses.zh: （形势）不会有什么好转，还是老样子
senses.group: likely to provide 可能提供

senses.def: (of a thing) to be prepared and ready for use; (of a person) to be prepared and ready to do something

examples.en: By tomorrow afternoon the document will be good to go.
examples.zh: 到明天下午文件就可以备妥。

examples.en: I’ve spent several months training for this race so now I’m good to go.
examples.zh: 为了这场比赛我花了几个月的时间训练，现在我准备好了。

senses.group: likely to provide 可能提供

senses.def: completely

examples.en: I won't go until I'm good and ready.
examples.zh: 我要完全准备就绪后才走。

senses.group: likely to provide 可能提供

senses.def: several

examples.en: There are still a good few empty seats.
examples.zh: 还有好几个空座位。

senses.group: likely to provide 可能提供

senses.def: used to praise somebody for doing something well

examples.en: ‘I passed first time.’ ‘Good for you!’
examples.zh: “我第一次就过了。”“你真行！”

senses.group: likely to provide 可能提供

senses.def: a lot of somebody/something

examples.en: There were a good many people there.
examples.zh: 那里有好多人。

senses.group: likely to provide 可能提供

senses.def: behaviour that is morally right or acceptable
senses.zh: 合乎道德的行为；正直的行为；善行

examples.en: Do they even know the difference between good and evil?
examples.zh: 他们到底知不知道善与恶的区别？

examples.en: Is religion always a force for good?
examples.zh: 宗教一向是诲人行善的力量吗？

senses.def: people who live a moral life; people who are admired for the work they do to help other people
senses.zh: 有道德的人；高尚的人；好人

examples.en: a gathering of the great and the good
examples.zh: 群贤荟萃

senses.def: something that helps somebody/something

examples.en: Cuts have been made for the good of the company.
examples.zh: 实行裁减是为了公司的利益。

examples.en: I'm only telling you this for your own good.
examples.zh: 我把这事告诉你只是为你好。

examples.en: The results of the research should be used for the common good (= the advantage of everyone).
examples.zh: 这项研究的成果应该服务于公共利益。

examples.en: policy decisions that serve the public good
examples.zh: 服务公共利益​​的政策决定

examples.en: What's the good of (= how does it help you) earning all that money if you don't have time to enjoy it?
examples.zh: 要是没时间去享受，赚那么多钱有什么用？

examples.en: What good is it redecorating if you're thinking of moving?
examples.zh: 如果你打算搬走，那重新装饰有什么用呢？

senses.def: used to say that if something happens, it will be good, even if it is not exactly what you were expecting

examples.en: If these measures also reduce unemployment, that is all to the good.
examples.zh: 要是这些措施也能降低失业率，那就不失为好事。

senses.def: to not be useful; to have no useful effect
senses.zh: 没（或没什么、没多大）用处（或好处）

examples.en: This gadget isn't much good.
examples.zh: 这小玩意儿没多大用处。

examples.en: It's no good complaining—they never listen.
examples.zh: 抱怨毫无用处，他们根本不听。

examples.en: It's no good trying to talk me out of leaving.
examples.zh: 想说服我不要离开是没用的。

examples.en: This book is no good to me: I need the new edition.
examples.zh: 这本书对我没用，我需要新版本的。

examples.en: Was his advice ever any good?
examples.zh: 他的建议有过用处吗？

senses.def: to not be interesting or fun

examples.en: His latest film isn't much good.

examples.zh: 我们到达时，所有的好位子都给人占了。

examples.zh: 他总是设法成为头版人物。

examples.zh: 试图解决这个非常困难的问题

a village in the English Lake District
senses.zh: 格拉斯米尔（Grasmere）：位于英国湖区的一个村庄，威廉·华兹华斯（William Wordsworth）一生都在这里生活，而诗人湖曾在此相遇。华兹华斯的房子，鸽子小屋和他被埋葬的教堂都深受游客欢迎。村庄在一个小湖旁，也叫格拉斯米尔。

senses.def: to take a strong hold of somebody/something

examples.zh: 凯紧紧抓住他的手腕。

senses.def: to understand something completely

examples.en: They failed to grasp the importance of his words.
examples.zh: 他们没有理解他的话的重要性。

examples.en: She was unable to grasp how to do it.
examples.zh: 她弄不明白这事该怎么做。

examples.en: It took him some time to grasp that he was now a public figure.
examples.zh: 他过了些时候才意识到自己已是个公众人物了。

senses.def: to take an opportunity without hesitating and use it
senses.zh: 急忙抓住，毫不犹豫地抓住（机会）

examples.en: I grasped the opportunity to work abroad.
examples.zh: 我毫不犹豫地抓住了去国外工作的机会。

senses.def: to try all possible means to find a solution or some hope in a difficult or unpleasant situation, even though this seems very unlikely
senses.zh: （在危难中）抓救命稻草，不放过任何微小的机会

examples.en: I know I’m just clutching at straws here, but is it possible that the doctors are wrong?
examples.zh: 我知道我只是抓住救命稻草，但医生有可能错了吗？

senses.def: to deal with a difficult situation without hesitating

examples.en: The government now has the opportunity to grasp the nettle of prison reform.
examples.zh: 政府现在有机会解决监狱改革的难题。

senses.def: a strong hold of somebody/something or control over somebody/something

examples.en: I grabbed him, but he slipped from my grasp.
examples.zh: 我紧抓着他，可他还是从我手里溜掉了。

examples.en: She felt a firm grasp on her arm.
examples.zh: 她感到手臂被紧紧地抓住了。

examples.en: Don't let the situation escape from your grasp.
examples.zh: 别让局面失去控制。

examples.en: As soon as he relaxed his grasp on the rope, it was pulled out of his hands.
examples.zh: 当他松开绳子时，绳子就从他手中被抽走了。

senses.def: a person’s understanding of a subject or of difficult facts

examples.en: He has a good grasp of German grammar.
examples.zh: 他德语语法掌握得很好。

examples.en: These complex formulae are beyond the grasp of the average pupil.
examples.zh: 这些复杂的公式是一般小学生不能理解的。

examples.en: As the drugs took hold, her grasp of reality began to slip slowly away.
examples.zh: 随着药物的作用，她对现实的把握开始慢慢消失。

senses.def: the ability to get or achieve something

examples.en: Success was within her grasp.
examples.zh: 她有把握获得成功。

examples.en: Just when victory seemed within grasp, the referee blew his whistle.
examples.zh: 就在胜利似乎触手可及之时，裁判的哨声响了。

senses.def: to try all possible means to find a solution or some hope in a difficult or unpleasant situation, even though this seems very unlikely

synonyms.words: hold on ▪ cling ▪ clutch ▪ grip ▪ grasp ▪ clasp ▪ hang on

intro.en: These words all mean to have somebody/​something in your hands or arms.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示抓住、抱住。

items.def: to have somebody/​something in your hand or arms:
items.zh: 指抓住、抱住、托住、夹住

examples.en: She was holding a large box.
examples.zh: 她提着一只大箱子。

items.def: to continue to hold somebody/​something; to put your hand on somebody/​something and not take your hand away:
items.zh: 指抓紧、不放开

examples.en: Hold on and don’t let go until I say so.
examples.zh: 握紧，我让你松手时才松开。

items.def: to hold on to somebody/​something tightly, especially with your whole body:
items.zh: 尤指用身体紧抱、紧握、抓紧

examples.en: Survivors clung to pieces of floating debris.
examples.zh: 生还者紧紧抱住漂浮在水面上的残骸。

items.def: to hold somebody/​something tightly, especially in your hand; to take hold of something suddenly:
items.zh: 尤指用手抓紧、紧握、抱紧、突然抓住

examples.en: She stood there, the flowers still clutched in her hand.
examples.zh: 她站在那里，手里仍然紧握着花束。

items.def: to hold on to something very tightly with your hand:
items.zh: 指用手紧握、紧抓

examples.en: Grip the rope as tightly as you can.
examples.zh: 尽可能紧紧抓住绳子。

items.def: to take a strong hold of somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指抓紧、抓牢

examples.en: He grasped my hand and shook it warmly.
examples.zh: 他热情地抓住我的手握了起来。

items.def: (formal) to hold somebody/​something tightly in your hand or in your arms:
items.zh: 指紧握、攥紧、抱紧

examples.en: They clasped hands (= held each other’s hands).
examples.zh: 他们相互紧握着对方的手。

items.def: to hold on to something very tightly, especially in order to support yourself or stop yourself from falling:
items.zh: 尤指为支撑自己或防止跌倒而紧紧抓住某物

examples.en: Hang on tight. We’re off!
examples.zh: 抓紧，我们出发了！

intro.en: These words all mean to know or realize something, for example why something happens, how something works or what something means.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含懂得、理解、认识到之义。

items.def: to know or realize the meaning of words, a language, what somebody says, etc.; to know or realize how or why something happens, how it works or why it is important:
items.zh: 了解；认识到；明了

examples.en: I don’t understand the instructions.
examples.zh: 我不懂这些指令的意思。

items.def: to understand what is happening, what somebody is saying, how something works or how important something is:
items.zh: 指理解、明白、领会（正在发生的事、某人的话、某事如何起作用或重要性如何）

examples.en: ‘It opens like this.’ ‘Oh, I see.’
examples.zh: “这样就打开了。”“哦，我明白了。”

items.def: (informal) to understand a joke, what somebody is trying to tell you, or a situation that they are trying to describe:
items.zh: 指理解、明白（笑话、某人试图告知的事或描述的情况）

examples.en: She didn’t get the joke.
examples.zh: 她听不懂那个笑话。

items.def: to understand an explanation, a story or the meaning of something:
items.zh: 指理解、明白（说明、故事、意思）

examples.en: Sorry—I don’t quite follow.
examples.zh: 对不起，我不太懂你的话。

items.def: to come to understand a fact, an idea or how to do something:
items.zh: 指理解、领会、领悟、明白（事实、想法或如何做某事）

examples.en: They failed to grasp the importance of his words.
examples.zh: 他们没有理解他的话的重要性。

items.def: (often used in negative statements) (formal) to understand a fact, idea or reason:
items.zh: （常用于否定句中）指理解、领悟、明白（事实、想法或原因）

examples.en: The concept of infinity is almost impossible for the human mind to comprehend.
examples.zh: 无穷的概念几乎是人类的大脑无法理解的。

examples.zh: 把草地变成农田

examples.zh: 狮子适应了干燥、开阔的草原，黄色的皮毛最适合这样的环境。

examples.zh: 擦成细丝的苹果、胡萝卜、干酪等

examples.en: Grate the cheese and sprinkle it over the tomatoes.
examples.zh: 将奶酪磨碎，撒在西红柿上。

examples.en: a teaspoon of freshly grated nutmeg
examples.zh: 一茶匙刚磨好的肉豆蔻

senses.def: to annoy somebody

examples.en: Her voice really grates on me.
examples.zh: 她的声音真叫我难受。

examples.en: He kept staring at her and it began to grate on her nerves.
examples.zh: 他一直盯着她看，这开始刺激她的神经。

examples.en: It grated with him when people implied he wasn't really British.
examples.zh: 当有人暗示他不是地道的英国人时，他很是恼火。

senses.def: when two hard surfaces grate
senses.zh: （使）发出刺耳的声音，发出吱吱嘎嘎的摩擦声

examples.en: The rusty hinges grated as the gate swung back.
examples.zh: 大门荡了回去，生锈的铰链发出吱嘎吱嘎的刺耳声。

examples.en: He grated his knife across the plate.
examples.zh: 他用刀子划过盘子时发出刺耳的声音。

senses.def: feeling or showing thanks because somebody has done something kind for you or has done as you asked

examples.en: Thank you for doing this. I really am so grateful.
examples.zh: 谢谢你这样做。我实在是太感激了。

examples.en: We are very grateful to all those who contributed.
examples.zh: 我们非常感谢所有做出贡献的人。

examples.en: She said she was grateful for the support shown by the community.
examples.zh: 她表示，她感谢社会各界的支持。

examples.en: I am extremely grateful to all the teachers for their help.
examples.zh: 我非常感谢所有老师的帮助。

examples.en: She seems to think I should be grateful to have a job at all.
examples.zh: 她似乎认为我有份工作就该谢天谢地了。

examples.en: He was grateful that she didn't tell his parents about the incident.
examples.zh: 他感到庆幸的是，她未将此事告诉他父母。

examples.en: Grateful thanks are due to the following people for their help…
examples.zh: 向下列给予过帮助的人表示衷心的感谢…

examples.en: Kate gave him a grateful smile.
examples.zh: 凯特感激地对他笑了笑。

senses.def: used to make a request, especially in a letter or in a formal situation
senses.zh: （尤用于书信或正式场合提出请求）感激不尽，请

examples.en: I would be grateful if you could send the completed form back as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 如能尽快把表格填好寄回，将不胜感激。

examples.en: I would be most grateful if you would keep this matter confidential.
examples.zh: 如果您能保守此事的机密，我将不胜感激。

examples.en: We would be grateful for any information you can give us.
examples.zh: 如能提供信息我们将感激不尽。

senses.def: in a way that shows thanks because somebody has done something kind for you or has done as you asked

examples.en: He nodded gratefully.
examples.zh: 他感激地点了点头。

examples.en: All donations will be gratefully received.
examples.zh: 如蒙慨捐，不胜铭感。

examples.en: I gratefully acknowledge the help of many people here today.
examples.zh: 我非常感谢今天在座的许多人的帮助。

senses.def: a kitchen utensil
senses.zh: 礤床儿，磨碎器（厨房用具）

examples.en: a cheese/nutmeg grater
examples.zh: 奶酪磨碎器；擦肉豆蔻的礤床儿

senses.def: the state of feeling pleasure when something goes well for you or when your desires are satisfied; something that gives you pleasure
senses.zh: 满足；满意；快感；令人喜悦的事物

examples.en: sexual gratification
examples.zh: 性满足

examples.en: A feed will usually provide instant gratification to a crying baby.
examples.zh: 喂食通常可使正在哭闹的婴儿立即得到满足。

examples.en: Much to my gratification, my work got a special mention in her speech.
examples.zh: 令我欣慰的是，我的工作在她的演讲中得到了特别提及。

senses.def: to please or satisfy somebody

examples.en: It gratified him to think that it was all his work.
examples.zh: 他想到这都是他的工作成果，感到十分欣慰。

examples.en: I was gratified by their invitation.
examples.zh: 收到他们的邀请，我感到很高兴。

senses.def: to satisfy a wish, need, etc.

examples.en: He only gave his consent in order to gratify her wishes.
examples.zh: 他只是为满足她的愿望才同意的。

senses.def: in a way that gives pleasure and makes you feel satisfied
senses.zh: 令人欣慰的：以一种使人愉悦并使您感到满意的方式

examples.en: This year, gratifyingly, we have made a small profit.
examples.zh: 今年，可喜的是，我们小赚了一笔。

senses.def: a cooked dish that is covered with a layer of cheese or breadcrumbs
senses.zh: 脆皮烙菜（表面为干酪或面包屑）

examples.en: a gratin of tomatoes and basil with a crunchy crust
examples.zh: 西红柿和罗勒的烤盘，外皮松脆

examples.en: gratin potatoes
examples.zh: 烤土豆

senses.def: done or given without having to be paid for

examples.en: I knew his help wouldn't be given gratis.
examples.zh: 我知道他的帮助不会是无偿的。

senses.def: done or given without having to be paid for

examples.en: a gratis copy of a book
examples.zh: 免费赠阅的样书

senses.def: the feeling of being grateful and wanting to express your thanks

examples.en: He smiled at them with gratitude.
examples.zh: 他向他们微笑表示谢意。

examples.en: I would like to express my gratitude to everyone for their hard work.
examples.zh: 我要对所有辛勤劳动的人表示感谢。

examples.en: I feel a deep sense of gratitude to her.
examples.zh: 我深深地感谢她。

examples.en: She was presented with the gift in gratitude for her long service.
examples.zh: 这礼物赠送给她以表达对她长期服务的感激之情。

examples.en: I owe you a great debt of gratitude (= feel extremely grateful).
examples.zh: 我对你感激不尽。

senses.def: done without any good reason or purpose and often having harmful effects
senses.zh: 无正当理由（或目的）的；无谓的

examples.en: gratuitous violence on television
examples.zh: 电视上无谓的暴力镜头

examples.en: It was a completely gratuitous insult which the singer’s agent was forced to apologize for.
examples.zh: 这是一种完全无端的侮辱，歌手的经纪人被迫为此道歉。

senses.def: without any good reason or purpose, in a way that may have harmful effects
senses.zh: 无正当理由（或目的）的；无谓的

examples.en: The film was gratuitously offensive.
examples.zh: 这部影片无端地让人反感。

senses.def: money that you give to somebody who has provided a service for you

examples.zh: 我们的工作人员可能不接受小费。

senses.def: money that is given to employees when they leave their job

examples.zh: 我们给祖母扫了墓。

examples.zh: 法国和比利时的英国战争坟墓

examples.en: The plague victims were buried in a mass grave.
examples.zh: 死于瘟疫的人被集体掩埋。

examples.en: There were flowers on the grave.
examples.zh: 坟上有些花。

senses.def: a way of referring to death or a person’s death

examples.en: Is there life beyond the grave (= life after death)?
examples.zh: 人死后有来生吗？

examples.en: He followed her to the grave (= died soon after her).
examples.zh: 他紧跟着她离开了人世。

examples.en: She smoked herself into an early grave (= died young as a result of smoking).
examples.zh: 她因抽烟而早逝。

senses.def: to do something that will have very harmful results for you
senses.zh: 自掘坟墓；自取灭亡；自己害自己

senses.def: a way of referring to the whole of a person’s life, from birth until death
to be so old or ill that you are not likely to live much longer
senses.zh: 行将就木；命不久矣；大去之期不远

senses.def: a formal promise that you will do something or that something will happen

examples.en: They are demanding certain guarantees before they sign the treaty.
examples.zh: 他们要求得到某些保证后才签署条约。

examples.en: to give a guarantee of good behaviour
examples.zh: 保证行为端正

examples.en: He gave me a guarantee that it would never happen again.
examples.zh: 他向我保证这种事情绝不会再发生。

senses.def: a written promise given by a company that something you buy will be replaced or repaired without payment if it goes wrong within a particular period

examples.en: The television comes with a year's guarantee.
examples.zh: 这电视机有一年的保修期。

examples.en: We provide a 5-year guarantee against rust.
examples.zh: 我们保证 5 年不生锈。

examples.en: The watch is still under guarantee.
examples.zh: 这只手表仍在保修期内。

senses.def: something that makes something else certain to happen

examples.en: Career success is no guarantee of happiness.
examples.zh: 事业成功并不是幸福的保证。

examples.en: Arriving early is no guarantee of getting a place.
examples.zh: 提早到达并不能保证获得席位。

examples.en: There's no guarantee that she'll come (= she may not come).
examples.zh: 不能保证她一定会来。

senses.def: money or something valuable that you give or promise to a bank, for example, to make sure that you will do what you have promised

examples.en: We had to offer our house as a guarantee when getting the loan.
examples.zh: 我们在贷款时不得不拿房子作抵押。

senses.def: a written promise to pay back money that somebody else owes, or do something that somebody else promised to do, if they cannot do it themselves

examples.en: A close relative, usually a parent, can provide a guarantee for the loan.
examples.zh: 近亲属，通常为父母，可为贷款作担保。

senses.def: to be certain to have a particular result

examples.en: If we try to keep it a secret, she's guaranteed to find out.
examples.zh: 如果我们试图保密，她肯定会发现。

examples.en: That kind of behaviour is guaranteed to make him angry.
examples.zh: 那样的行为肯定会让他生气。

examples.en: The film is virtually guaranteed to do well at the box office.
examples.zh: 这部影片几乎可以肯定会大收旺场。

intro.en: These are all words describing something that will definitely happen or is definitely true.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指某事肯定、必定会发生或属实。

items.def: that you can rely on to happen or be true:
items.zh: 指确实、确定、肯定（会发生或是事实）

examples.en: It’s certain that they will agree.
examples.zh: 他们肯定会同意。

items.def: [not before noun] certain to happen, or to do or be something. Bound is only used in the phrase bound to do/​be, etc.:
items.zh: bound 只用于 bound to do/be 等短语中

items.def: certain to happen or be true; that can be trusted or relied on:
items.zh: 指必定、无疑（会发生或是事实）或不容置疑、确切、可靠

examples.en: She’s sure to be picked for the team.
examples.zh: 她肯定会入选该队。

items.def: (rather informal) certain to happen; that is not going to change:
items.zh: 指必将发生、不会改变

examples.en: Is it definite that he’s leaving?
examples.zh: 他肯定要离开吗？

items.def: certain to have a particular result:
items.zh: 指肯定会、必定会（有特定结果）

examples.en: That kind of behaviour is guaranteed to make him angry.
examples.zh: 那样的行为肯定会让他生气。

senses.def: a person who agrees to be responsible for somebody or for making sure that something happens or is done

examples.en: The United Nations will act as guarantor of the peace settlement.
examples.zh: 联合国将充当和平协议的保证人。

senses.def: a person, such as a soldier, a police officer or a prison officer, who protects a place or people, or prevents prisoners from escaping

examples.en: prison/border guards
examples.zh: 监狱看守；边防卫士

examples.en: The building is protected by armed guards.
examples.zh: 大楼由武装警卫把守。

examples.en: The prisoner slipped past the guards on the gate and escaped.
examples.zh: 犯人从门卫身旁溜出去逃走了。

examples.en: A guard was posted outside the building.
examples.zh: 建筑物外驻了一名警卫。

senses.def: the act or duty of protecting property, places or people from attack or danger; the act or duty of preventing prisoners from escaping

examples.en: a sentry on guard (= at his or her post, on duty)
examples.zh: 执勤哨兵

examples.en: to be on guard duty
examples.zh: 担任警戒任务

examples.en: The escaped prisoner was brought back under armed guard.
examples.zh: 越狱逃犯由武装警卫押回。

examples.en: The terrorist was kept under police guard.
examples.zh: 这名恐怖分子当时在警方的看管之下。

senses.def: a group of people, such as soldiers or police officers, who protect somebody/something

examples.en: the captain of the guard
examples.zh: 卫队长

examples.en: the changing of the guard (= when one group replaces another)
examples.zh: 卫队换岗

examples.en: The guard is/are being inspected today.
examples.zh: 今天卫队接受检阅。

examples.en: Fellow airmen provided a guard of honour at his wedding.
examples.zh: 空军战友们为他的婚礼充当仪仗队。

examples.en: The president always travels with an armed guard.
examples.zh: 总统出行总有武装卫队保驾。

senses.def: (in the UK and some other countries) special regiments
senses.zh: （英国和其他一些国家的）禁军，御林军，近卫军

examples.en: the Scots Guards
examples.zh: 苏格兰卫队

examples.en: a Guards officer
examples.zh: 近卫团军官

senses.def: something that covers a part of a person’s body or a dangerous part of a machine to prevent injury
senses.zh: 防护罩；防护装置；防护用品

examples.en: All players wear helmets and face guards.
examples.zh: 所有球员都戴头盔和面罩。

examples.en: Ensure the guard is in place before operating the machine.
examples.zh: 一定要在防护措施做好后才开机器。

senses.def: conductor
a position you take to defend yourself, especially in a sport such as boxing

examples.en: to drop/keep up your guard
examples.zh: 放弃／保持防御姿势

examples.en: In spite of the awkward questions the minister never let his guard fall for a moment.
examples.zh: 尽管遇到些令人尴尬的问题，部长从没有放松警惕。

senses.def: one of the two players on a basketball team who are mainly responsible for staying close to players of the other team to stop them from scoring
one of the two players on an American football
senses.group: in American football 美式足球

senses.def: to be very careful and prepared for something difficult or dangerous

examples.en: He was always on his guard against moneymaking schemes.
examples.zh: 他对赚钱的计划总是保持着警惕。

senses.group: in American football 美式足球

senses.def: to stop being careful and preparing yourself for possible danger or difficulty

examples.en: You can never drop your guard with a two-year-old.
examples.zh: 照顾两岁的孩子，绝不能掉以轻心。

examples.en: Even when he's winning, he never drops his guard.
examples.zh: 即使他赢了，他也不会放松警惕。

senses.group: in American football 美式足球

senses.def: to watch or protect somebody/something

examples.en: Four soldiers stood guard over the coffin.
examples.zh: 有四名士兵守护灵柩。

examples.en: One of the men kept guard, while the other broke into the house.
examples.zh: 一人放哨，另一人则闯进了房子里。

senses.group: in American football 美式足球

senses.def: not careful or prepared for something difficult or dangerous

examples.en: The lawyer’s apparently innocent question was designed to catch the witness off (his) guard.
examples.zh: 律师看似不经意的问题是为了使证人措手不及。

senses.group: in American football 美式足球

senses.def: to protect property, places or people from attack or danger

examples.en: Armed officers guarded the entrance.
examples.zh: 武装人员把守着入口。

examples.en: The dog was guarding its owner's luggage.
examples.zh: 狗守护着主人的行李。

examples.en: political leaders guarded by the police
examples.zh: 由警方保卫的政界领袖们

examples.en: You can't get in; the whole place is guarded.
examples.zh: 你进不去，整个地区都戒备森严。

examples.en: The recipe is a closely guarded secret.
examples.zh: 这个秘方受到严密保护。

senses.group: in American football 美式足球

senses.def: to prevent prisoners from escaping

examples.en: The prisoners were guarded by soldiers.
examples.zh: 犯人由士兵看守。

senses.group: in American football 美式足球

senses.def: to stay close to a player from the other team to stop them from passing the ball or scoring

examples.en: He was given the job of guarding the Rocks' star player.
examples.zh: 他被分派负责盯防岩石队的明星球员。

senses.group: in American football 美式足球

senses.def: to be very careful and prepared for something difficult or dangerous

examples.en: He was always on his guard against moneymaking schemes.
examples.zh: 他对赚钱的计划总是保持着警惕。

senses.def: to stop being careful and preparing yourself for possible danger or difficulty

examples.en: You can never drop your guard with a two-year-old.
examples.zh: 照顾两岁的孩子，绝不能掉以轻心。

examples.en: Even when he's winning, he never drops his guard.
examples.zh: 即使他赢了，他也不会放松警惕。

senses.def: to watch or protect somebody/something

examples.en: Four soldiers stood guard over the coffin.
examples.zh: 有四名士兵守护灵柩。

examples.en: One of the men kept guard, while the other broke into the house.
examples.zh: 一人放哨，另一人则闯进了房子里。

senses.def: not careful or prepared for something difficult or dangerous

examples.en: The lawyer’s apparently innocent question was designed to catch the witness off (his) guard.
examples.zh: 律师看似不经意的问题是为了使证人措手不及。

senses.def: to take care to prevent something or to protect yourself from something

examples.en: to guard against accidents/disease
examples.zh: 防止事故；预防疾病

senses.def: a dog that is kept to guard a building
a bar placed on the edge of a path, a boat, etc. to protect people and prevent them falling over the edge
a strong low fence or wall at the side of a road or between the two halves of a major road such as a motorway
senses.zh: （高速公路或州际公路上的）防撞护栏，防撞墙

senses.def: the part of a train where the person who is in charge of the train used to ride
in a careful way that does not show feelings or give much information
senses.zh: 谨慎的；有保留的；不明确表态的

senses.def: a building for soldiers who are guarding the entrance to a military camp or for keeping military prisoners in

examples.en: He spent 20 days in the guardhouse for answering back to a sergeant.
examples.zh: 他因向中士回话而在警卫室待了 20 天。

senses.def: a person who protects something

examples.en: Farmers should be guardians of the countryside.
examples.zh: 农民应是农村的守卫者。

examples.en: The police are guardians of law and order.
examples.zh: 警察是法律和治安的护卫者。

examples.en: The people act as guardians of the land.
examples.zh: 人们担当起守护这片土地的卫士。

senses.def: a person who is legally responsible for the care of another person, especially a child whose parents have died
senses.zh: （尤指双亲已故孩子的）监护人

examples.en: I was left alone to live with my aunt, who became my legal guardian.
examples.zh: 我被孤零零地撇下跟姨妈生活，她成了我的法定监护人。

examples.en: The court appoints a legal guardian for the child.
examples.zh: 法庭给这个孩子指定了一名合法监护人。

senses.def: a spirit that some people believe protects and guides them, especially when they are in danger

examples.en: A delightful guide was my guardian angel for the first week of the tour.
examples.zh: 令人愉快的导游是我第一周旅行的守护神。

senses.def: an educated middle-class
senses.zh: 《卫报》读者 （受过教育的英国中产阶级，被认为是经常阅读《卫报》的典型人物，通常持左翼观点）

examples.en: It's a policy that is sure to be popular among Guardian readers, if no one else.
examples.zh: 这项政策肯定会受到《卫报》读者的欢迎（如果没有其他人的话）。

senses.def: the state or position of being responsible for somebody/something
senses.zh: 监护；监护地位；监护人的身份

examples.en: to grant somebody guardianship of the children
examples.zh: 授予某人子女的监护权

examples.en: The land is under the guardianship of the people who use it.
examples.zh: 土地由使用它的人监护。

senses.def: a room for soldiers who are guarding the entrance to a building or for keeping military prisoners in
any of the regiments
senses.zh: 卫队团：英军卫队或家庭骑兵中的任何团

senses.def: a soldier in the Guards or in the National Guard in the US
senses.zh: 近卫军士兵；（美国）国民警卫队士兵

senses.def: a country in Central America
(a person) from Guatemala
senses.zh: 危地马拉人；危地马拉的；危地马拉人的

senses.def: the fruit of a tropical American tree that has yellow skin and is pink or yellow inside
senses.zh: 番石榴（热带美洲水果，黄皮，果肉呈粉红色）

senses.def: various things that are not important

examples.en: All the gubbins that came with the computer is still in the box.
examples.zh: 这台电脑的所有零星配件还在箱子里。

senses.def: connected with the job of state governor

examples.en: a gubernatorial candidate
examples.zh: 州长候选人

examples.en: gubernatorial duties
examples.zh: 州长的职责

senses.def: a type of cow kept for its rich milk
a thick sweater made with dark blue wool that has been specially treated so that it does not let water through, worn originally by fishermen
senses.zh: 格恩西防水羊毛衫（深蓝色，原为渔民所穿）

senses.def: a football sweater, especially one of the type without arms worn by Australian Rules players
senses.zh: 足球运动衫；（尤指澳大利亚式橄榄球运动员穿的）运动背心

senses.def: the second largest of the Channel Islands
senses.zh: 根西岛：海峡群岛第二大岛。它以牛奶制品，旅游中心和人们少缴税款的地方而闻名。它的首都是圣彼得港。

senses.def: to be recognized as being good (originally meaning to be chosen for a football team)
to be recognized as being good (originally meaning to be chosen for a football team)
a member of a small group of soldiers who are not part of an official army and who fight against official soldiers, usually to try to change the government

examples.en: urban guerrillas (= those who fight in towns)
examples.zh: 城市游击队员

examples.en: guerrilla war/warfare (= fought by guerrillas on one or both sides)
examples.zh: 游击战

examples.en: a guerrilla movement
examples.zh: 游击运动

senses.def: organized in an informal way and without official permission or approval
senses.zh: 游击的；非正式的；没有官方认可的

examples.en: Guerrilla actors took to the streets in army fatigues to protest against the war.
examples.zh: 非正式演员穿着士兵服走上街头举行反战示威。

examples.en: guerrilla marketing (= marketing that uses unusual methods in order to achieve the greatest effect for the smallest amount of money)
examples.zh: 游击营销（用不一般的方式以最少金钱取得最大成效）

examples.en: guerrilla gardening (= growing plants on land that you do not own to make it more attractive)
examples.zh: 游击园艺（在不属于自己的土地上栽种植物以美化环境）

senses.def: to try and give an answer or make a judgement about something without being sure of all the facts

examples.en: I don't really know. I'm just guessing.
examples.zh: 我并不知道，我只是猜测。

examples.en: We can only guess at her reasons for leaving.
examples.zh: 对她离去的原因我们只能猜测。

examples.en: He guessed right/wrong.
examples.zh: 他猜对／错了。

examples.en: I'd guess that she's about 30.
examples.zh: 我估计她大约 30 岁。

examples.en: Can you guess where I've been?
examples.zh: 你能猜出我去什么地方了吗？

examples.en: Can you guess his age?
examples.zh: 你能猜出他的年龄吗？

senses.def: to find the right answer to a question or the truth without knowing all the facts

examples.en: She guessed the answer straight away.
examples.zh: 她一下子就猜中了答案。

examples.en: You'll never guess what she told me.
examples.zh: 你永远猜不到她对我说了什么。

examples.en: You would never guess (that) she had problems. She’s always so cheerful.
examples.zh: 你怎么也猜不到她有难以解决的问题。她总是那么乐观。

examples.en: So it was Rob who broke the window? I might have guessed!
examples.zh: 原来是罗伯打破了窗户？我本来可以猜到的。

examples.en: If I had to guess, I'd say she was the one responsible for this.
examples.zh: 如果非要我猜的话，我会说她要对此负责。

senses.def: used to show that you are going to say something surprising or exciting
senses.zh: （引出令人惊奇或激动的事）你猜

examples.en: Guess what! He's asked me out!
examples.zh: 你猜怎么着！他约我出去了！

examples.en: Guess who I've just seen!
examples.zh: 你猜我刚才见到谁了！

senses.def: to suppose that something is true or likely

examples.en: I guess (that) you’ll be looking for a new job now.
examples.zh: 我想你现在要找新工作了吧。

examples.en: I guess I'm just lucky.
examples.zh: 我认为我只是幸运而已。

examples.en: He didn't see me, I guess.
examples.zh: 我想他没看见我。

examples.en: ‘Are you ready to go?’ ‘Yeah, I guess so.’
examples.zh: “你准备好出发了吗？”“是的，应该可以了。”

examples.en: ‘They aren't coming, then?’ ‘I guess not.’
examples.zh: “这么说，他们不来了？”“我想是吧。”

senses.def: to not tell somebody about your plans or what is going to happen next
senses.zh: 让某人捉摸不定（或猜不透）

examples.en: It's the kind of book that keeps you guessing right to the end.
examples.zh: 这是一本让你从头猜到尾的书。

senses.def: an attempt to give an answer or an opinion when you cannot be certain if you are right

examples.en: to have/make a guess
examples.zh: （对某事）作猜测

examples.en: to take a guess
examples.zh: 推测

examples.en: Go on! Have a guess!
examples.zh: 继续！猜猜看！

examples.en: If I might hazard a guess, I'd say she was about thirty.
examples.zh: 让我来猜的话，我说她大约三十岁。

examples.en: Who do you think I saw yesterday? I'll give you three guesses.
examples.zh: 你猜我昨天碰到谁了？我让你猜三次。

examples.en: They might be here by 3—but that's just a rough guess (= not exact).
examples.zh: 他们可能 3 点钟到，不过这只是一个大致的猜测。

examples.en: But this is clearly just a wild guess (= not sensible or accurate) at what his motives could have been.
examples.zh: 但这显然是对他原先动机的胡乱猜测而已。

examples.en: The article is based on guesses about what might happen in the future.
examples.zh: 这篇文章的依据是对未来可能发生的事情的猜测。

examples.en: the market's best guess as to the possible performance of the company
examples.zh: 市场对公司可能业绩的最佳估计

examples.en: My guess is that we won't hear from him again.
examples.zh: 我想我们再不会收到他的消息了。

examples.en: At a guess, there were forty people at the party.
examples.zh: 估计有四十人参加了聚会。

senses.def: something that nobody can be certain about

examples.en: What will happen next is anybody's guess.
examples.zh: 下一步会发生什么事，谁也说不准。

senses.def: a guess that is based on some degree of knowledge, and is therefore likely to be correct

examples.en: Let's make an educated guess.
examples.zh: 咱们做个有根据的猜测吧。

senses.def: used to tell somebody that you do not know any more about a subject than the person that you are talking to does
senses.zh: 我和你一样不知道；我和你一样心中无数

examples.en: ‘Who's going to win?’ ‘Your guess is as good as mine.’
examples.zh: “谁会赢？”“我和你一样不知道。”

senses.def: to make a mistake
senses.zh: 犯错误；做错事；搞错；弄错

examples.en: Unless I miss my guess, your computer needs a new hard drive.
examples.zh: 我的判断没错的话，你的电脑需要更换一个新的硬盘驱动器。

examples.en: If you miss your guess, you lose 10 points.
examples.zh: 如果你猜错了，你会失去 10 分。

senses.def: to not tell somebody about your plans or what is going to happen next
senses.zh: 让某人捉摸不定（或猜不透）

examples.en: It's the kind of book that keeps you guessing right to the end.
examples.zh: 这是一本让你从头猜到尾的书。

examples.zh: 下一步会发生什么事，谁也说不准。

senses.def: a guess that is based on some degree of knowledge, and is therefore likely to be correct

examples.en: Let's make an educated guess.
examples.zh: 咱们做个有根据的猜测吧。

senses.def: a game in which you have to guess the answers to questions
a situation in which you do not know what is going to happen or what somebody is going to do
an attempt to calculate something that is based more on guessing than on information
to attempt to calculate something based more on guessing than on information
senses.zh: 尝试更多地基于猜测而不是信息来计算某些东西

examples.en: It's impossible even to guesstimate the cost.
examples.zh: 甚至无法猜测成本。

examples.en: I guesstimated (that) maybe 30% of people were wearing masks.
examples.zh: 我估计大概有 30% 的人戴着口罩。

examples.en: Can you guesstimate how many times the average person looks at their phone in a day?
examples.zh: 您能猜一下普通人一天看手机多少次吗？

senses.def: the process of trying to find an answer by guessing when you do not have enough information to be sure

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to show your approval of somebody by clapping

examples.en: Ladies and gentlemen, let’s give a big hand to our special guests tonight.
examples.zh: 女士们、先生们，让我们以热烈的掌声欢迎今晚的特邀嘉宾。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to help somebody
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to ask somebody for something, especially money, in a very polite way that makes you seem less important
senses.zh: 谦卑地要，恭敬地讨（尤指钱）

examples.en: There’s no way he’ll go cap in hand to his brother.
examples.zh: 他不可能向他的兄弟屈服。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: permission to marry somebody, especially a woman

examples.en: He asked the general for his daughter's hand in marriage.
examples.zh: 他请求将军把女儿许配给他。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: working closely with somebody, especially in a secret and/or illegal way
senses.zh: 同某人密切合作（尤指勾结）
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: if two people are hand in hand

examples.en: They walked through the park hand in hand.
examples.zh: 他们手牵着手穿过公园。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: if two things go hand in hand

examples.en: Poverty and poor health often go hand in hand.
examples.zh: 贫困和健康不良常有连带关系。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: easily and without any doubt
senses.zh: 容易地；易如反掌地；毋庸置疑地

examples.en: They won hands down.
examples.zh: 他们轻松取胜。

examples.en: It is hands down the best movie this year.
examples.zh: 这无疑是今年最好的电影。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: used to tell somebody not to touch something/somebody

examples.en: Get your hands off my boyfriend!
examples.zh: 把你的手从我男朋友身上拿开！

examples.en: Hey, hands off! That's my drink!
examples.zh: 嘿，别动！那是我的饮料！

examples.en: She warned her brother to keep his hands off her bag.
examples.zh: 她警告她的兄弟不许碰她的包。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: used to tell a group of people to raise one hand in the air if they know the answer to a question, etc.

examples.en: Hands up all those who want to go swimming.
examples.zh: 想去游泳的人举手。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: used by somebody who is threatening people with a gun to tell them to raise both hands in the air
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to be responsible for somebody’s death
senses.zh: 对某人的死亡罪责难逃

examples.en: a dictator with the blood of thousands on his hands
examples.zh: 手上沾满千万人鲜血的独裁者

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to be very busy or too busy to do something else
senses.zh: 忙得不可开交；应接不暇

examples.en: They certainly have their hands full with four kids in the house.
examples.zh: 家里有四个孩子，他们肯定忙得不可开交。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to be unable to do what you want to do because of rules, promises, etc.

examples.en: I really wish I could help but my hands are tied.
examples.zh: 我的确想帮忙，但却多有不便。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to have complete control or influence over somebody
senses.zh: 完全控制某人；把某人攥在手心里

examples.en: Even before he plays a note, he has the audience in the palm of his hand.
examples.zh: 甚至在他演奏一个音符之前，他就已经将观众掌握在了手中。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to have nothing to do or not be busy
senses.zh: 无所事事；没事可干；闲着
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to be in a position where you have power or control over somebody/something

examples.en: She had the whip hand and it was useless to resist.
examples.zh: 她有鞭子手，反抗是没有用的。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: a way of doing something or of treating people that is much stronger and less sensitive than it needs to be
senses.zh: 严厉手段；粗暴方式；暴虐方式

examples.en: the heavy hand of management
examples.zh: 粗暴的管理方式

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to give somebody support in a difficult situation
senses.zh: （困难时）给某人支持；拉某人一把

examples.en: Do you want me to come along and hold your hand?
examples.zh: 你想让我过去帮你一把吗？

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to admit that you have made a mistake or are responsible for something bad
senses.zh: 承认犯错；承认对坏事负有责任

examples.en: I have to hold my hands up and admit that some of the problems have been all my own fault.
examples.zh: 我必须承认有些问题完全是我自己的错。

examples.en: The solicitor confirmed that his clients were holding their hands up to the offences.
examples.zh: 律师证实，他的当事人对这些罪行表示抗议。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: being taken care of or dealt with by somebody that you think you can rely on
senses.zh: 由可信任的人负责（或处理等）

examples.en: Can I leave these queries in your capable hands?
examples.zh: 我能否请你这个能手来解答这些疑问？

examples.en: He retired feeling confident that his company was in safe hands.
examples.zh: 他退休时确信自己的公司已托付给了可靠的人。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: if you have time or money in hand

examples.en: We managed to redecorate the house and still have some savings in hand.
examples.zh: 我们设法重新装修了房子，手头还有一些积蓄。

examples.en: She completed the first part of the exam with over an hour in hand.
examples.zh: 她在一个多小时内完成了考试的第一部分。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: if you have a particular situation in hand

examples.en: Don’t worry about the travel arrangements—everything is in hand.
examples.zh: 别担心旅行安排 ── 一切都已经安排妥当。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: the job, question, etc. in hand

examples.en: Please confine your comments to the topic in hand.
examples.zh: 请将您的评论限制在当前主题范围内。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: if somebody works a week, month, etc. in hand
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: being taken care of or controlled by somebody
senses.zh: 受某人照料；受某人控制

examples.en: The matter is now in the hands of my lawyer.
examples.zh: 这件事现在正由我的律师处理。

examples.en: At that time, the castle was in enemy hands.
examples.zh: 那时城堡在敌人手中。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: being taken care of well by somebody
senses.zh: 在可靠的人手里；受到妥善照管

examples.en: I've left the kids in safe hands—with my parents.
examples.zh: 我把孩子托付给了靠得住的人，在我父母那儿。

examples.en: Their problem was in the safe hands of the experts.
examples.zh: 他们的问题交给行家处理了。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: if you use the words an iron fist/hand

examples.en: They promised that the army would strike with an iron fist at any resistance.
examples.zh: 他们承诺，军队将用铁拳打击任何抵抗。

examples.en: The iron hand in the velvet glove approach seems to work best with this age group.
examples.zh: 天鹅绒手套中的铁腕方法似乎最适合这个年龄段的人。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: used to say that you are too busy to do anything else
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: if two people join hands
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to work together in doing something

examples.en: Education has been reluctant to join hands with business.
examples.zh: 教育界一向不肯与商界联手。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to occasionally do something that you used to do a lot so that you do not lose your skill at it
senses.zh: 偶尔操练某事以保持熟练

examples.en: She retired last year but still teaches the odd class to keep her hand in.
examples.zh: 她去年退休了，但偶尔还上课，以免技巧生疏。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to be very familiar with somebody/something

examples.en: This is where I grew up. I know this area like the back of my hand.
examples.zh: 我在这儿长大的，我对这地方再熟悉不过了。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to catch somebody that you are annoyed with

examples.en: Wait till I get my hands on him!
examples.zh: 等我抓住他再说！

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to find or get something

examples.en: I know their address is here somewhere, but I can't lay my hands on it right now.
examples.zh: 我知道他们的地址就放在这块儿，但我一时找不到。

examples.en: I desperately need to get my hands on some money by Monday.
examples.zh: 我迫切需要在周一之前拿到一些钱。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to spend all the money you earn on basic needs such as food without being able to save any money
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to make/lose money very fast and in large quantities
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: used to say that a job is made easier if a lot of people help
senses.zh: 人多好办事；众人拾柴火焰高
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to do no work

examples.en: She hasn't done a hand's turn all week.
examples.zh: 她闲了整整一星期。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to do nothing to help somebody
senses.zh: 一点忙也不帮；油瓶倒了都不扶

examples.en: The children never lift a finger to help around the house.
examples.zh: 孩子们从不帮着做家务。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to hold out your hand for somebody to shake
senses.zh: 伸出手（以便同别人握手）
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: no longer your responsibility
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: on both/all sides; in both/all directions
senses.zh: 在双方面／各个方面；在两个／各个方向

examples.en: Mist curled from the water on either hand.
examples.zh: 双手的水面上都升起了雾气。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: available, especially to help

examples.en: The emergency services were on hand with medical advice.
examples.zh: 随时都有急诊服务，并提供医疗咨询。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: if you have somebody/something on your hands

examples.en: Let me take care of the invitations—you've enough on your hands with the caterers.
examples.zh: 让我来负责发邀请吧，你负责洽办酒席就够忙了。

examples.en: They’ll have a fight on their hands if they want to close down the school.
examples.zh: 如果他们想关闭学校，他们将面临一场战斗。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: used to introduce different points of view, ideas, etc., especially when they are opposites
senses.zh: （引出不同的，尤指对立的观点、思想等）一方面…，另一方面…

examples.en: On the one hand they'd love to have kids, but on the other, they don't want to give up their freedom.
examples.zh: 一方面，他们想要孩子，但另一方面，他们又不想放弃自由自在的生活。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: difficult or impossible to control

examples.en: Unemployment is getting out of hand.
examples.zh: 失业问题越来越难以控制。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: if you reject, etc. something out of hand

examples.en: All our suggestions were dismissed out of hand.
examples.zh: 我们的建议均遭到了草率的拒绝。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: no longer your responsibility

examples.en: I'm afraid the matter is now out of my hands.
examples.zh: 恐怕这件事现已不归我管。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to fail to achieve success by judging your position to be stronger than it really is
senses.zh: 因不自量力而毁掉胜机；高估自己的地位；错估形势
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: a person who can do, or is doing, a job
senses.zh: 一个能做事的人；人手；正在工作的人

examples.en: We need an extra pair of hands if we're going to finish on time.
examples.zh: 要想按时完成，我们就要再增加一个人。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to do exactly what an enemy, opponent, etc. wants so that they gain the advantage in a particular situation
senses.zh: 干敌人（或对手等）所希望的事；做有利于敌人（或对手等）的事；授人以可乘之机

examples.en: If we get the police involved, we'll be playing right into the protesters' hands.
examples.zh: 如果出动警察，那将正中抗议者的下怀。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to spend money or give it to somebody

examples.en: I've heard he doesn't like putting his hand in his pocket.
examples.zh: 我听说他手很紧。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: easily controlled or influenced by another person
senses.zh: （像）某人手中的面团；任某人摆布；易受某人的影响

examples.en: She'll persuade him. He's like putty in her hands.
examples.zh: 她会说服他的。他就像她手里的面团一样。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to hit or threaten to hit somebody
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: a person that you can trust to do a job well

examples.en: Colleagues regard him as a safe pair of hands.
examples.zh: 同事认为他办事可靠。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: by being told about something by somebody else who has seen it or heard about it, not by experiencing, seeing, etc. it yourself
senses.zh: 经过二手三手地；间接地；非亲身经历

examples.en: I'm fed up of hearing about these decisions third hand!
examples.zh: 得从别人那里听说这些决定，我受够了！

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to make your plans or intentions known
senses.zh: 摊牌；让对方摸着底细；公开自己的意图
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: a way of voting for or against something in which people raise their hands to vote

examples.en: The vote was passed by a show of hands.
examples.zh: 表决以举手方式通过。

examples.en: Let’s have a show of hands. Who’s in favour of the proposal?
examples.zh: 让我们举手吧。谁支持这项提议？

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to stop yourself from doing something; to prevent you from doing something

examples.en: It was prudence, not logic, that stayed his hand.
examples.zh: 阻止他行动的是谨慎，而不是逻辑。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to make yourself do something that you are afraid of
senses.zh: 鼓起勇气（做自己害怕做的事）；敢作敢为

examples.en: Taking her courage in both hands, she opened the door and walked in.
examples.zh: 她壮着胆打开门，走了进去。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to deal with somebody in a strict way in order to improve their behaviour
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to deal with a particular situation yourself because you are not happy with the way that others are dealing with it
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to do something illegal in order to punish somebody for doing something wrong, instead of letting the police deal with them

examples.en: After a series of burglaries in the area, the police are worried that residents might take the law into their own hands.
examples.zh: 在该地区发生一系列入室盗窃案后，警方担心居民可能会自行执法。

examples.en: When police failed to arrest the suspect, local people took the law into their own hands and beat him up.
examples.zh: 警察没有逮捕嫌疑犯，当地人便擅自执法，把他痛打一顿。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to risk being killed
senses.zh: 冒生命危险；豁出性命；把脑袋别在裤腰带上

examples.en: You take your life in your hands just crossing the road here.
examples.zh: 你在这里过马路简直是冒险玩命。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to stop doing something or taking part in something, especially because you are not successful
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to raise both hands in the air to show that you are feeling annoyed or upset about something
senses.zh: 举起双手表示不满（或生气）

examples.en: We threw up our hands in despair at the scale of the problem.
examples.zh: 我们对问题的严重性感到绝望。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: that you can reach or get easily

examples.en: I'm afraid I don't have the latest figures to hand.
examples.zh: 恐怕我手头没有最新的数据。

examples.en: Keep a pen and paper to hand for details of this week’s competition.
examples.zh: 请准备好笔和纸，了解本周比赛的详细信息。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to do something such as an activity or a sport for the first time
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to start doing something or be able to do something, especially when you do it well
senses.zh: （尤指成功、顺利地）着手做，能够做

examples.en: Jim can turn his hand to most jobs around the house.
examples.zh: 吉姆能担当起家里的大部分杂活。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to take care of somebody’s needs so well that they do not have to do anything for themselves
senses.zh: 过分照顾；让…饭来张口，衣来伸手

examples.en: He seems to expect me to wait on him hand and foot.
examples.zh: 他似乎希望我全心全意地伺候他。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to refuse to be responsible for or involved with somebody/something
senses.zh: 拒绝对…负责；脱离关系；洗手不干

examples.en: When her son was arrested again she washed her hands of him.
examples.zh: 她的儿子再次被捕，她就与他脱离了关系。

examples.en: I’ve washed my hands of the whole sordid business.
examples.zh: 我已经彻底洗手不干那种肮脏的勾当了。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to win something very easily
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to press somebody’s hand very hard when you shake hands
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to hold your hands together, and twist
senses.zh: （尤指出于焦急或烦恼）扭绞双手
senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to pass or give something to somebody

examples.en: She handed the letter to me.
examples.zh: 她把信交给我。

examples.en: She handed me the letter.
examples.zh: 她把信交给我。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to allow somebody to have something, sometimes too easily

examples.en: Missed chances by United players handed a surprise victory to Stoke.
examples.zh: 曼联球员错失良机，斯托克城队意外获胜。

examples.en: This decision effectively handed Burke control of the company.
examples.zh: 这一决定实际上把公司的控制权拱手让给了伯克。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: to give something to somebody without that person making any effort
senses.zh: 把某事物拱手送给某人

examples.en: Nobody's going to hand you success on a plate.
examples.zh: 没有人会把胜利白白地送给你的。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: used to say that somebody deserves praise for something

examples.en: You've got to hand it to him—he's a great cook.
examples.zh: 你必须把它交给他——他是一位出色的厨师。

senses.group: measurement for horse 马的测量

senses.def: everyone helps or must help, especially in a difficult situation

examples.en: There are 30 people coming to dinner tonight, so it's all hands on deck.
examples.zh: 今天晚上有 30 人来吃饭，要全体动员了。

senses.def: close to you in time or distance

examples.en: Help was at hand.
examples.zh: 援助近在咫尺。

examples.en: The property is ideally located with all local amenities close at hand.
examples.zh: 这处房地产的位置很理想，离当地的生活设施都近。

items.idm: at the hands of somebody | at somebody’s hands

senses.def: if you experience something at the hands of somebody
senses.zh: 某人导致；出自某人之手

examples.en: They suffered years of repression at the hands of the old regime.
examples.zh: 他们多年来遭受旧政权的镇压。

senses.def: to show skill at making or doing things with your hands
to tie somebody’s hands and feet together so that they cannot move or escape
to prevent somebody from doing what they want by creating rules, limits, etc.
senses.zh: 捆住某人手脚（比喻用条条框框限制）

items.idm: a bird in the hand is worth two in the bush

senses.def: it is better to keep something that you already have than to risk losing it by trying to get much more
senses.zh: 一鸟在手胜过双鸟在林（满足于现有的总比因过分追求而失去一切好）

items.idm: bite the hand that feeds you

senses.def: to harm somebody who has helped you or supported you
by a person rather than a machine

examples.en: The fabric was painted by hand.
examples.zh: 这个织品是手染的。

examples.en: Delicate clothes should be washed by hand.
examples.zh: 易损衣物应该手洗。

examples.en: We can apply the power of computational tools in solving mathematical problems that cannot be solved by hand.
examples.zh: 我们可以运用计算工具的力量来解决手工无法解决的数学问题。

senses.def: if a letter is delivered by hand
if you pay for goods and services cash in hand
senses.zh: 现金支付（尤指受款人可避税）

examples.en: a cash-in-hand payment of £20
examples.zh: 20英镑的现金支付

senses.def: to pass to a different owner

examples.en: The house has changed hands several times.
examples.zh: 这房子已几易其主。

senses.def: near; in a place where somebody/something can be reached easily
senses.zh: 在附近；在触手可及的地方

examples.en: There are good cafes and a restaurant close at hand.
examples.zh: 附近有几家挺不错的咖啡馆和一家餐馆。

senses.def: an influence that controls or limits something
senses.zh: （控制或阻碍事物发展的）影响

examples.en: We need to free business from the dead hand of bureaucracy.
examples.zh: 我们必须摆脱官僚主义对工作的严重影响。

items.idm: the devil makes work for idle hands

senses.def: people who do not have enough to do often start to do wrong

examples.en: She blamed the crimes on the local jobless teenagers. ‘The devil makes work for idle hands,’ she would say.
examples.zh: 她认为那些违法活动是当地的无业青少年所为，总是说：“人一闲，惹麻烦。”

senses.def: to trust somebody and be willing to do what they say
senses.zh: 甘愿听命于某人；顺从某人

examples.en: She'll have them eating out of her hand in no time.
examples.zh: 她很快就会让他们俯首帖耳的。

items.idm: fall into somebody’s hands/the hands of somebody

senses.def: to become controlled by somebody
senses.zh: 受制于某人；被某人控制

examples.en: The town fell into enemy hands.
examples.zh: 那个小镇落入敌人手里了。

examples.en: We don't want this document falling into the wrong hands.
examples.zh: 我们不希望这份文件落入不当的人手中。

examples.en: After the war, the hotel fell into the hands of an American consortium.
examples.zh: 战后，酒店落入美国财团手中。

senses.def: strong control or discipline
senses.zh: 牢固控制；严格纪律；铁腕

examples.en: Some children need a firm hand to make them behave.
examples.zh: 有些孩子需要严厉的指导才能让他们表现得规矩。

senses.def: by experiencing, seeing, etc. something yourself rather than being told about it by somebody else

examples.en: The President visited the area to see the devastation at first hand.
examples.zh: 总统亲临该地区视察受损情况。

senses.def: to bring or hold your hands together

examples.en: She kept her hands folded in her lap.
examples.zh: 她双手合拢，放在腿上。

senses.def: to make somebody do something that they do not want to do or make them do it sooner than they had intended
senses.zh: 迫使某人做某事（或提前行动）

examples.en: They decided to strike to force the management’s hand.
examples.zh: 他们决定罢工，迫使管理层下手。

items.idm: gain, get, have, etc. the upper hand

senses.def: to get an advantage over somebody so that you are in control of a particular situation
senses.zh: 占上风；处于有利地位；有优势；有控制权

senses.def: to do physical work

examples.en: He's not frightened of getting his hands dirty.
examples.zh: 他不怕体力劳动。

items.idm: get, have, etc. a free hand

senses.def: to get, have, etc. the opportunity to do what you want to do and to make your own decisions
senses.zh: 可以全权处理；有自主权

examples.en: I was given a free hand in designing the syllabus.
examples.zh: 我获准全权制订教学大纲。

senses.def: to show your approval of somebody by clapping

examples.en: Ladies and gentlemen, let’s give a big hand to our special guests tonight.
examples.zh: 女士们、先生们，让我们以热烈的掌声欢迎今晚的特邀嘉宾。

senses.def: to help somebody
to ask somebody for something, especially money, in a very polite way that makes you seem less important
senses.zh: 谦卑地要，恭敬地讨（尤指钱）

examples.en: There’s no way he’ll go cap in hand to his brother.
examples.zh: 他不可能向他的兄弟屈服。

senses.def: permission to marry somebody, especially a woman

examples.en: He asked the general for his daughter's hand in marriage.
examples.zh: 他请求将军把女儿许配给他。

senses.def: working closely with somebody, especially in a secret and/or illegal way
senses.zh: 同某人密切合作（尤指勾结）

senses.def: if two people are hand in hand

examples.en: They walked through the park hand in hand.
examples.zh: 他们手牵着手穿过公园。

senses.def: if two things go hand in hand

examples.en: Poverty and poor health often go hand in hand.
examples.zh: 贫困和健康不良常有连带关系。

senses.def: easily and without any doubt
senses.zh: 容易地；易如反掌地；毋庸置疑地

examples.en: They won hands down.
examples.zh: 他们轻松取胜。

examples.en: It is hands down the best movie this year.
examples.zh: 这无疑是今年最好的电影。

senses.def: used to tell somebody not to touch something/somebody

examples.en: Get your hands off my boyfriend!
examples.zh: 把你的手从我男朋友身上拿开！

examples.en: Hey, hands off! That's my drink!
examples.zh: 嘿，别动！那是我的饮料！

examples.en: She warned her brother to keep his hands off her bag.
examples.zh: 她警告她的兄弟不许碰她的包。

senses.def: used to tell a group of people to raise one hand in the air if they know the answer to a question, etc.

examples.en: Hands up all those who want to go swimming.
examples.zh: 想去游泳的人举手。

senses.def: used by somebody who is threatening people with a gun to tell them to raise both hands in the air

items.idm: have somebody’s blood on your hands

senses.def: to be responsible for somebody’s death
senses.zh: 对某人的死亡罪责难逃

examples.en: a dictator with the blood of thousands on his hands
examples.zh: 手上沾满千万人鲜血的独裁者

senses.def: to be very busy or too busy to do something else
senses.zh: 忙得不可开交；应接不暇

examples.en: They certainly have their hands full with four kids in the house.
examples.zh: 家里有四个孩子，他们肯定忙得不可开交。

senses.def: to be unable to do what you want to do because of rules, promises, etc.

examples.en: I really wish I could help but my hands are tied.
examples.zh: 我的确想帮忙，但却多有不便。

items.idm: have somebody in the palm of your hand

senses.def: to have complete control or influence over somebody
senses.zh: 完全控制某人；把某人攥在手心里

examples.en: Even before he plays a note, he has the audience in the palm of his hand.
examples.zh: 甚至在他演奏一个音符之前，他就已经将观众掌握在了手中。

items.idm: have time on your hands | have time to kill

senses.def: to have nothing to do or not be busy
senses.zh: 无所事事；没事可干；闲着

items.idm: have/hold, etc. the whip hand (over somebody/something)

senses.def: to be in a position where you have power or control over somebody/something

examples.en: She had the whip hand and it was useless to resist.
examples.zh: 她有鞭子手，反抗是没有用的。

senses.def: a way of doing something or of treating people that is much stronger and less sensitive than it needs to be
senses.zh: 严厉手段；粗暴方式；暴虐方式

examples.en: the heavy hand of management
examples.zh: 粗暴的管理方式

senses.def: to give somebody support in a difficult situation
senses.zh: （困难时）给某人支持；拉某人一把

examples.en: Do you want me to come along and hold your hand?
examples.zh: 你想让我过去帮你一把吗？

senses.def: to admit that you have made a mistake or are responsible for something bad
senses.zh: 承认犯错；承认对坏事负有责任

examples.en: I have to hold my hands up and admit that some of the problems have been all my own fault.
examples.zh: 我必须承认有些问题完全是我自己的错。

examples.en: The solicitor confirmed that his clients were holding their hands up to the offences.
examples.zh: 律师证实，他的当事人对这些罪行表示抗议。

items.idm: in somebody’s capable, safe, etc. hands

senses.def: being taken care of or dealt with by somebody that you think you can rely on
senses.zh: 由可信任的人负责（或处理等）

examples.en: Can I leave these queries in your capable hands?
examples.zh: 我能否请你这个能手来解答这些疑问？

examples.en: He retired feeling confident that his company was in safe hands.
examples.zh: 他退休时确信自己的公司已托付给了可靠的人。

senses.def: if you have time or money in hand

examples.en: We managed to redecorate the house and still have some savings in hand.
examples.zh: 我们设法重新装修了房子，手头还有一些积蓄。

examples.en: She completed the first part of the exam with over an hour in hand.
examples.zh: 她在一个多小时内完成了考试的第一部分。

senses.def: if you have a particular situation in hand

examples.en: Don’t worry about the travel arrangements—everything is in hand.
examples.zh: 别担心旅行安排 ── 一切都已经安排妥当。

senses.def: the job, question, etc. in hand

examples.en: Please confine your comments to the topic in hand.
examples.zh: 请将您的评论限制在当前主题范围内。

senses.def: if somebody works a week, month, etc. in hand

items.idm: in the hands of somebody | in somebody’s hands

senses.def: being taken care of or controlled by somebody
senses.zh: 受某人照料；受某人控制

examples.en: The matter is now in the hands of my lawyer.
examples.zh: 这件事现在正由我的律师处理。

examples.en: At that time, the castle was in enemy hands.
examples.zh: 那时城堡在敌人手中。

items.idm: in safe hands | in the safe hands of somebody

senses.def: being taken care of well by somebody
senses.zh: 在可靠的人手里；受到妥善照管

examples.en: I've left the kids in safe hands—with my parents.
examples.zh: 我把孩子托付给了靠得住的人，在我父母那儿。

examples.en: Their problem was in the safe hands of the experts.
examples.zh: 他们的问题交给行家处理了。

items.idm: an iron fist/hand (in a velvet glove)

senses.def: if you use the words an iron fist/hand

examples.en: They promised that the army would strike with an iron fist at any resistance.
examples.zh: 他们承诺，军队将用铁拳打击任何抵抗。

examples.en: The iron hand in the velvet glove approach seems to work best with this age group.
examples.zh: 天鹅绒手套中的铁腕方法似乎最适合这个年龄段的人。

items.idm: I’ve only got one pair of hands

senses.def: used to say that you are too busy to do anything else
if two people join hands
to work together in doing something

examples.en: Education has been reluctant to join hands with business.
examples.zh: 教育界一向不肯与商界联手。

senses.def: to occasionally do something that you used to do a lot so that you do not lose your skill at it
senses.zh: 偶尔操练某事以保持熟练

examples.en: She retired last year but still teaches the odd class to keep her hand in.
examples.zh: 她去年退休了，但偶尔还上课，以免技巧生疏。

items.idm: know somebody/something inside out | know somebody/something like the back of your hand

senses.def: to be very familiar with somebody/something

examples.en: This is where I grew up. I know this area like the back of my hand.
examples.zh: 我在这儿长大的，我对这地方再熟悉不过了。

senses.def: to catch somebody that you are annoyed with

examples.en: Wait till I get my hands on him!
examples.zh: 等我抓住他再说！

senses.def: to find or get something

examples.en: I know their address is here somewhere, but I can't lay my hands on it right now.
examples.zh: 我知道他们的地址就放在这块儿，但我一时找不到。

examples.en: I desperately need to get my hands on some money by Monday.
examples.zh: 我迫切需要在周一之前拿到一些钱。

senses.def: to spend all the money you earn on basic needs such as food without being able to save any money
to make/lose money very fast and in large quantities
used to say that a job is made easier if a lot of people help
senses.zh: 人多好办事；众人拾柴火焰高

senses.def: to do no work

examples.en: She hasn't done a hand's turn all week.
examples.zh: 她闲了整整一星期。

items.idm: not lift/raise a finger/hand (to do something)

senses.def: to do nothing to help somebody
senses.zh: 一点忙也不帮；油瓶倒了都不扶

examples.en: The children never lift a finger to help around the house.
examples.zh: 孩子们从不帮着做家务。

senses.def: to hold out your hand for somebody to shake
senses.zh: 伸出手（以便同别人握手）

senses.def: no longer your responsibility
on both/all sides; in both/all directions
senses.zh: 在双方面／各个方面；在两个／各个方向

examples.en: Mist curled from the water on either hand.
examples.zh: 双手的水面上都升起了雾气。

senses.def: available, especially to help

examples.en: The emergency services were on hand with medical advice.
examples.zh: 随时都有急诊服务，并提供医疗咨询。

senses.def: if you have somebody/something on your hands

examples.en: Let me take care of the invitations—you've enough on your hands with the caterers.
examples.zh: 让我来负责发邀请吧，你负责洽办酒席就够忙了。

examples.en: They’ll have a fight on their hands if they want to close down the school.
examples.zh: 如果他们想关闭学校，他们将面临一场战斗。

items.idm: (on the one hand…) on the other (hand)…

senses.def: used to introduce different points of view, ideas, etc., especially when they are opposites
senses.zh: （引出不同的，尤指对立的观点、思想等）一方面…，另一方面…

examples.en: On the one hand they'd love to have kids, but on the other, they don't want to give up their freedom.
examples.zh: 一方面，他们想要孩子，但另一方面，他们又不想放弃自由自在的生活。

senses.def: difficult or impossible to control

examples.en: Unemployment is getting out of hand.
examples.zh: 失业问题越来越难以控制。

senses.def: if you reject, etc. something out of hand

examples.en: All our suggestions were dismissed out of hand.
examples.zh: 我们的建议均遭到了草率的拒绝。

senses.def: no longer your responsibility

examples.en: I'm afraid the matter is now out of my hands.
examples.zh: 恐怕这件事现已不归我管。

senses.def: to fail to achieve success by judging your position to be stronger than it really is
senses.zh: 因不自量力而毁掉胜机；高估自己的地位；错估形势

senses.def: a person who can do, or is doing, a job
senses.zh: 一个能做事的人；人手；正在工作的人

examples.en: We need an extra pair of hands if we're going to finish on time.
examples.zh: 要想按时完成，我们就要再增加一个人。

senses.def: to do exactly what an enemy, opponent, etc. wants so that they gain the advantage in a particular situation
senses.zh: 干敌人（或对手等）所希望的事；做有利于敌人（或对手等）的事；授人以可乘之机

examples.en: If we get the police involved, we'll be playing right into the protesters' hands.
examples.zh: 如果出动警察，那将正中抗议者的下怀。

items.idm: put your hand in your pocket

senses.def: to spend money or give it to somebody

examples.en: I've heard he doesn't like putting his hand in his pocket.
examples.zh: 我听说他手很紧。

senses.def: easily controlled or influenced by another person
senses.zh: （像）某人手中的面团；任某人摆布；易受某人的影响

examples.en: She'll persuade him. He's like putty in her hands.
examples.zh: 她会说服他的。他就像她手里的面团一样。

senses.def: to hit or threaten to hit somebody
a person that you can trust to do a job well

examples.en: Colleagues regard him as a safe pair of hands.
examples.zh: 同事认为他办事可靠。

senses.def: by being told about something by somebody else who has seen it or heard about it, not by experiencing, seeing, etc. it yourself
senses.zh: 经过二手三手地；间接地；非亲身经历

examples.en: I'm fed up of hearing about these decisions third hand!
examples.zh: 得从别人那里听说这些决定，我受够了！

senses.def: to make your plans or intentions known
senses.zh: 摊牌；让对方摸着底细；公开自己的意图

senses.def: a way of voting for or against something in which people raise their hands to vote

examples.en: The vote was passed by a show of hands.
examples.zh: 表决以举手方式通过。

examples.en: Let’s have a show of hands. Who’s in favour of the proposal?
examples.zh: 让我们举手吧。谁支持这项提议？

senses.def: to stop yourself from doing something; to prevent you from doing something

examples.en: It was prudence, not logic, that stayed his hand.
examples.zh: 阻止他行动的是谨慎，而不是逻辑。

items.idm: take your courage in both hands

senses.def: to make yourself do something that you are afraid of
senses.zh: 鼓起勇气（做自己害怕做的事）；敢作敢为

examples.en: Taking her courage in both hands, she opened the door and walked in.
examples.zh: 她壮着胆打开门，走了进去。

senses.def: to deal with somebody in a strict way in order to improve their behaviour

items.idm: take something into your own hands

senses.def: to deal with a particular situation yourself because you are not happy with the way that others are dealing with it

items.idm: take the law into your own hands

senses.def: to do something illegal in order to punish somebody for doing something wrong, instead of letting the police deal with them

examples.en: After a series of burglaries in the area, the police are worried that residents might take the law into their own hands.
examples.zh: 在该地区发生一系列入室盗窃案后，警方担心居民可能会自行执法。

examples.en: When police failed to arrest the suspect, local people took the law into their own hands and beat him up.
examples.zh: 警察没有逮捕嫌疑犯，当地人便擅自执法，把他痛打一顿。

items.idm: take your life in your hands

senses.def: to risk being killed
senses.zh: 冒生命危险；豁出性命；把脑袋别在裤腰带上

examples.en: You take your life in your hands just crossing the road here.
examples.zh: 你在这里过马路简直是冒险玩命。

senses.def: to stop doing something or taking part in something, especially because you are not successful
to raise both hands in the air to show that you are feeling annoyed or upset about something
senses.zh: 举起双手表示不满（或生气）

examples.en: We threw up our hands in despair at the scale of the problem.
examples.zh: 我们对问题的严重性感到绝望。

senses.def: that you can reach or get easily

examples.en: I'm afraid I don't have the latest figures to hand.
examples.zh: 恐怕我手头没有最新的数据。

examples.en: Keep a pen and paper to hand for details of this week’s competition.
examples.zh: 请准备好笔和纸，了解本周比赛的详细信息。

senses.def: to do something such as an activity or a sport for the first time
to start doing something or be able to do something, especially when you do it well
senses.zh: （尤指成功、顺利地）着手做，能够做

examples.en: Jim can turn his hand to most jobs around the house.
examples.zh: 吉姆能担当起家里的大部分杂活。

items.idm: wait on somebody hand and foot

senses.def: to take care of somebody’s needs so well that they do not have to do anything for themselves
senses.zh: 过分照顾；让…饭来张口，衣来伸手

examples.en: He seems to expect me to wait on him hand and foot.
examples.zh: 他似乎希望我全心全意地伺候他。

senses.def: to refuse to be responsible for or involved with somebody/something
senses.zh: 拒绝对…负责；脱离关系；洗手不干

examples.en: When her son was arrested again she washed her hands of him.
examples.zh: 她的儿子再次被捕，她就与他脱离了关系。

examples.en: I’ve washed my hands of the whole sordid business.
examples.zh: 我已经彻底洗手不干那种肮脏的勾当了。

senses.def: to win something very easily
to press somebody’s hand very hard when you shake hands
to hold your hands together, and twist
senses.zh: （尤指出于焦急或烦恼）扭绞双手

items.idm: hand something to somebody on a plate

senses.def: to give something to somebody without that person making any effort
senses.zh: 把某事物拱手送给某人

examples.en: Nobody's going to hand you success on a plate.
examples.zh: 没有人会把胜利白白地送给你的。

items.idm: have (got) to hand it to somebody

senses.def: used to say that somebody deserves praise for something

examples.en: You've got to hand it to him—he's a great cook.
examples.zh: 你必须把它交给他——他是一位出色的厨师。

senses.def: working closely with somebody, especially in a secret and/or illegal way
senses.zh: 同某人密切合作（尤指勾结）

senses.def: if two people are hand in hand

examples.en: They walked through the park hand in hand.
examples.zh: 他们手牵着手穿过公园。

senses.def: if two things go hand in hand

examples.en: Poverty and poor health often go hand in hand.
examples.zh: 贫困和健康不良常有连带关系。

hand something to on a plate: @@@LINK=hand something to somebody on a plate
hand something to sb on a plate: @@@LINK=hand something to somebody on a plate

senses.def: to give something to somebody without that person making any effort
senses.zh: 把某事物拱手送给某人

examples.en: Nobody's going to hand you success on a plate.
examples.zh: 没有人会把胜利白白地送给你的。
