hand sth to sb on a plate: @@@LINK=hand something to somebody on a plate
hand sth to somebody on a plate: @@@LINK=hand something to somebody on a plate
hand to on a plate: @@@LINK=hand something to somebody on a plate
hand to somebody on a plate: @@@LINK=hand something to somebody on a plate

senses.def: to offer or pass something, especially food or drinks, to all the people in a group
senses.zh: 传递，分发（尤指食物或饮料）

senses.def: to give or return something to the person who owns it or to where it belongs

examples.en: She picked up the wallet and handed it back to him.
examples.zh: 她捡起钱包，交还给他。

examples.en: Decision-making powers should be handed back to local communities.
examples.zh: 决策权应该交还给当地社区。

senses.def: small bags that you can keep with you on an aircraft
senses.zh: 手提行李（可随身带到飞机上）

senses.def: cream that you put on your hands to prevent dry skin
to give or leave something to somebody who is younger than you
senses.zh: 把某事物传下去；传给（后代）

examples.en: These skills used to be handed down from father to son.
examples.zh: 这些技艺以往都是父子相传。

examples.en: Most of his clothes were handed down to him by his older brother.
examples.zh: 他的衣服大多是哥哥传下来的。

senses.def: to officially give a decision/statement, etc.

examples.en: The judge has handed down his verdict.
examples.zh: 法官已经宣布了裁决结果。

senses.def: a thing or person that is very likely to cause danger or a problem in the future because of the condition it is in or the way they behave

examples.en: Any one of these nuclear plants may be a disaster waiting to happen.
examples.zh: 这些核电厂中的任何一个都可能会成为灾难隐患。

senses.def: people say accidents will happen
used to say that it is not possible to know what the result of something will be
senses.zh: 什么事都可能发生；结果难以预料

senses.def: used when you say something that is surprising, or something connected with what somebody else has just said

examples.en: I agree with you, as it happens.
examples.zh: 我恰恰和你意见一致。

examples.en: As it happens, I have a spare set of keys in my office.
examples.zh: 碰巧我在办公室有一套备用钥匙。

items.idm: in the event of something | in the event that something happens

senses.def: if something happens

examples.en: In the event of an accident, call this number.
examples.zh: 万一发生事故就拨这个号码。

examples.en: Sheila will inherit everything in the event of his death.
examples.zh: 他一旦故去，所有财产都由希拉继承。

examples.en: In the unlikely event of a crash, please remain calm.
examples.zh: 万一发生碰撞，请保持冷静。

senses.def: by chance

examples.en: It just so happened they'd been invited too.
examples.zh: 他们碰巧也获得邀请。

senses.def: used to express the idea that we must accept that bad things often happen without reason
senses.zh: 天有不测风云；坏事难免会发生

senses.def: used to tell somebody not to worry about something they have done
senses.zh: 这类事在所难免；别为做过的事担忧

examples.en: ‘Sorry—I've broken a glass.’ ‘Never mind. These things happen.’
examples.zh: “抱歉——我打碎了一个玻璃杯。”“没关系。”这些事情都会发生。

senses.def: to find something by chance
if something happens to

examples.en: It's the best thing that has ever happened to me.
examples.zh: 这是我所遇到的最好的事。

examples.en: What's happened to your car?
examples.zh: 你的车出什么毛病了？

examples.en: I hope nothing (= nothing unpleasant) has happened to them.
examples.zh: 我希望他们没出事。

examples.en: Do you know what happened to Gill Lovecy (= have you any news about her)?
examples.zh: 你有吉尔·洛夫西的消息吗？

senses.def: chance, especially when it results in something good

examples.en: I found this delightful hotel by happenstance.
examples.zh: 我偶然发现了这家令人愉快的酒店。

senses.def: in a cheerful way; with feelings of pleasure

examples.en: children playing happily on the beach
examples.zh: 在海滩上嬉戏的孩子们

examples.en: to be happily married
examples.zh: 婚姻美满

examples.en: I think we can manage quite happily on our own.
examples.zh: 我想我们自己完全能够应付。

examples.en: And they all lived happily ever after (= used as the end of a fairy tale).
examples.zh: 从此他们都过着幸福美满的生活（用作童话故事的结尾）。

senses.def: by good luck

examples.en: Happily, the damage was only slight.
examples.zh: 所幸的是，损伤不大。

senses.def: willingly

examples.en: I'll happily help, if I can.
examples.zh: 如果我能帮忙，我倒很乐意。

examples.en: A majority of those interviewed said they would happily accept a tax increase if the money went to health and education.
examples.zh: 大多数受访者表示，如果资金用于医疗和教育，他们很乐意接受增税。

senses.def: in a way that is suitable or appropriate

examples.en: This suggestion did not fit very happily with our existing plans.
examples.zh: 这个建议与我们目前的计划不太契合。

senses.def: the state of feeling or showing pleasure

examples.en: to find true happiness
examples.zh: 找到真正的幸福

examples.en: Fame did not bring her happiness.
examples.zh: 名声并没有给她带来幸福。

examples.en: the pursuit of happiness
examples.zh: 对幸福的追求

examples.en: Her eyes shone with happiness.
examples.zh: 她双眼闪烁着幸福的光芒。

examples.en: Their grandchildren are a constant source of happiness.
examples.zh: 他们的孙子是他们幸福的源泉。

senses.def: the state of being satisfied that something is good or right

examples.en: The meeting expressed happiness about the progress made.
examples.zh: 会上大家对进展表示满意。

intro.en: These are all words for the good feeling that you have when you are happy or when you have achieved something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指幸福、欣慰、满意的感觉和满足的心情。

items.def: the good feeling that you have when you have achieved something or when something that you wanted to happen does happen:
items.zh: 指取得成就、实现愿望时的满足、满意、欣慰

examples.en: He derived great satisfaction from knowing that his son was happy.
examples.zh: 得知儿子很幸福他深感欣慰。

items.def: the good feeling that you have when you are happy:
items.zh: 指幸福、快乐

examples.en: Money can’t buy you happiness.
examples.zh: 金钱不能为你买到幸福。

items.def: a feeling of being pleased or satisfied that you get when you or people who are connected with you have done something well or own something that other people admire:
items.zh: 指自豪、骄傲、得意感

examples.en: The sight of her son graduating filled her with pride.
examples.zh: 儿子毕业的情景让她充满了自豪。

items.def: (rather formal) a feeling of being happy or satisfied with what you have:
items.zh: 指对所拥有的一切感到满意、满足

examples.en: They found contentment in living a simple life.
examples.zh: 他们在简朴的生活中得到满足。

items.def: a feeling of being happy or satisfied with what you do or have done:
items.zh: 指对所做的事感到满意、满足

examples.en: her search for personal fulfilment
examples.zh: 她对个人成就的追求

senses.def: feeling or showing pleasure; pleased
senses.zh: 感到（或显得）快乐的；高兴的

examples.en: a happy family
examples.zh: 幸福的家庭

examples.en: a happy smile/face
examples.zh: 快活的微笑／面容

examples.en: You don't look very happy today.
examples.zh: 你今天好像不太高兴。

examples.en: He always seemed happy enough.
examples.zh: 他看起来总是很快乐。

examples.en: I've never felt so happy.
examples.zh: 我从来没有感到如此幸福过。

examples.en: Money won't make you happy.
examples.zh: 钱不会让你快乐。

examples.en: We are happy to announce the engagement of our daughter.
examples.zh: 我们高兴地宣布，我们的女儿已订婚。

examples.en: I'm very happy for you.
examples.zh: 我真为你感到高兴。

examples.en: I’m happy (that) you could come.
examples.zh: 我很高兴你能来。

senses.group: feeling/giving pleasure 感到／给予快乐

senses.def: giving or causing pleasure
senses.zh: 给予（或带来）快乐的；使人高兴的；幸福的

examples.en: She had a very happy life.
examples.zh: 她有过非常幸福的生活。

examples.en: a happy marriage/childhood/occasion
examples.zh: 幸福的婚姻／童年／时刻

examples.en: I have many happy memories from that time.
examples.zh: 那时我有很多快乐的回忆。

examples.en: The story has a happy ending.
examples.zh: 故事的结局很圆满。

examples.en: Those were the happiest days of my life.
examples.zh: 那是我一生中最幸福的一段时光。

examples.en: It had been a gloriously happy time.
examples.zh: 那是一段特别令人开心的日子。

senses.group: feeling/giving pleasure 感到／给予快乐

senses.zh: （表示祝愿，如 Happy Birthday 生日快乐、Happy New Year 新年好等）

senses.def: satisfied that something is good or right; not anxious

examples.zh: 我不知道你做了什么，但老板不高兴。

examples.en: I said I'd go just to keep him happy.
examples.zh: 我说我要去只是为了让他高兴。

examples.en: Are you happy with that arrangement?
examples.zh: 你对这一安排满意吗？

examples.en: I'm not happy with his work this term.
examples.zh: 我对他这学期的表现不满意。

examples.en: She was happy enough with her performance.
examples.zh: 她对于自己的表现还算满意。

examples.en: If there's anything you're not happy about, come and ask.
examples.zh: 你如果有什么不满意的，来说一声。

examples.en: I'm not too happy about her living alone.
examples.zh: 我不太放心让她一个人住。

senses.def: willing or pleased to do something

examples.en: I'm perfectly happy to leave it till tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我非常愿意把它留到明天再做。

examples.en: People seemed quite happy to help.
examples.zh: 人们似乎很乐意提供帮助。

examples.en: He will be more than happy to come with us.
examples.zh: 他巴不得和我们一起来。

examples.en: We'd be only too happy to accept your invitation.
examples.zh: 我们万分高兴地接受您的邀请。

senses.def: lucky; successful

examples.en: By a happy coincidence, we arrived at exactly the same time.
examples.zh: 碰巧运气好，我们恰恰同时到达。

examples.en: He is in the happy position of never having to worry about money.
examples.zh: 他运气真好，从来不用为金钱操心。

senses.def: suitable and appropriate for a particular situation

examples.en: That wasn't the happiest choice of words.
examples.zh: 那样的措辞并不是十分恰当。

senses.def: (not) pleased about a situation

examples.en: She wasn't a happy bunny at all.
examples.zh: 她一点儿都不满意。

senses.def: the birth of a baby
a course of action that is not extreme
something that is in the middle between two choices or two ways of doing something

examples.en: She tried to strike a happy medium between making the questions too hard and making them too easy.
examples.zh: 她试图在问题太难和太简单之间找到一个平衡点。

senses.zh: （生日祝福）生日快乐，长命百岁

synonyms.words: happy ▪ pleased ▪ delighted ▪ proud ▪ relieved ▪ thrilled

intro.en: These words all describe people feeling happy about something that has happened or is going to happen.
intro.zh: 以上各词均形容人对已经发生或将要发生的事感到高兴、愉快。

items.def: [not usually before noun] happy about something or grateful for it:
items.zh: 指高兴、愉快、感激

examples.en: He was glad he’d come.
examples.zh: 他很高兴他来了。

items.def: pleased about something nice that you have to do or something that has happened to somebody:
items.zh: 指对必须做的或发生于某人身上的事感到高兴、快乐

examples.en: We are happy to announce the engagement of our daughter.
examples.zh: 我们高兴地宣布，我们的女儿已订婚。

items.def: [not before noun] happy about something that has happened or something that you have to do:
items.zh: 指对已经发生或必须做的事感到高兴、愉快、满意

examples.en: She was very pleased with her exam results.
examples.zh: 她对考试成绩非常满意。

items.def: very pleased about something; very happy to do something; showing your delight:
items.zh: 指高兴的、乐意的、愉快的

examples.en: I’m delighted at your news.
examples.zh: 听到你的消息我非常高兴。

items.def: pleased and satisfied about something that you own or have done, or are connected with:
items.zh: 指骄傲的、自豪的、得意的、满足的

examples.en: proud parents
examples.zh: 自豪的父母

items.def: feeling happy because something unpleasant has stopped or has not happened; showing this:
items.zh: 指感到宽慰的、放心的、显得开心的

examples.en: You’ll be relieved to know your jobs are safe.
examples.zh: 现在你们知道工作保住了，可以放心了。

items.def: [not before noun] (rather informal) extremely pleased and excited about something:
items.zh: 指非常兴奋、极为激动

examples.en: I was thrilled to be invited.
examples.zh: 我获得邀请，感到非常兴奋。

intro.en: These words all describe feeling, showing or giving pleasure.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示快乐、愉快、满意。

items.def: feeling, showing or giving pleasure; satisfied with something or not worried about it:
items.zh: 指快乐的、满意的、放心的

examples.en: a happy marriage/​memory/​childhood
examples.zh: 幸福的婚姻／回忆／童年

items.def: pleased because you have achieved something or because something has happened as you wanted it to; showing this:
items.zh: 指满意的、满足的、欣慰的

examples.en: She’s never satisfied with what she’s got.
examples.zh: 她对自己所得到的从不感到满足。

items.def: [not before noun] happy and satisfied with what you have:
items.zh: 指满意、满足

examples.en: I’m perfectly content just to lie in the sun.
examples.zh: 我在阳光下躺着就感到非常满足。

items.def: happy and comfortable with what you have; showing this:
items.zh: 指满意的、满足的、惬意的

examples.en: a contented baby
examples.zh: 心满意足的小宝贝

items.def: (rather formal) very happy; making people very happy
items.zh: 指高兴的、快乐的、令人愉快的

items.def: making people very happy; showing this happiness:
items.zh: 指令人愉快的、极乐的、幸福的

examples.en: three blissful weeks away
examples.zh: 无忧无虑的三周假期

senses.def: a simple song which is traditionally sung for somebody on their birthday, especially before they blow out the candles
senses.zh: 祝您生日快乐：一首简单的歌曲，传统上是在某人生日那天演唱的，尤其是在他们吹灭生日蛋糕上的蜡烛之前。如果此人的名字叫彼得，那首歌是：

senses.def: connected with a Christian group that holds very enthusiastic religious services, showing a lot of feeling
senses.zh: （基督徒在祈祷仪式等）热情过头的

examples.en: It was one of those happy-clappy services.
examples.zh: 这是那些令人高兴的服务之一。

senses.def: two people who are in a happy romantic relationship, especially when they are engaged or have recently married
senses.zh: 幸福的夫妻：两个处于幸福浪漫关系中的人，尤其是在订婚或最近结婚时

examples.en: Please raise your glasses to the happy couple, Tim and Kallah!
examples.zh: 请向蒂姆和卡拉这对幸福的夫妇举杯！

examples.en: The happy couple is/are pictured here cutting the wedding cake.
examples.zh: 照片中这对幸福的夫妇正在切结婚蛋糕。

senses.def: a children’s card game played with special cards with pictures of family members on them. The aim is to get as many whole families as possible.
senses.zh: 快乐家庭游戏（用家人照片作为纸牌的游戏，赢得最多完整家庭纸牌者获胜）

senses.def: to do things that normal happy families do, especially when you want it to appear that your family is happy

examples.en: I'm not going to play happy families just for the benefit of your parents.
examples.zh: 我不会仅仅为了顾全你父母而装出合家欢的假象。

senses.def: to do things that normal happy families do, especially when you want it to appear that your family is happy

examples.en: I'm not going to play happy families just for the benefit of your parents.
examples.zh: 我不会仅仅为了顾全你父母而装出合家欢的假象。

senses.def: not caring or worrying about the future

examples.en: a happy-go-lucky attitude
examples.zh: 无忧无虑的态度

examples.en: a happy-go-lucky sort of person
examples.zh: 乐天派的人

senses.def: a time, usually in the early evening, when a pub or a bar sells alcoholic drinks at lower prices than usual
senses.zh: 欢乐时光（酒吧的减价时段）

senses.def: a place that somebody only has to think about in order to feel happy and relaxed

examples.en: I loved everything about my school — it was my happy place.
examples.zh: 我喜欢学校的一切——那是我快乐的地方。

senses.def: relating to or involving the sense of touch

examples.en: Players use a haptic device such as a joystick to control the game.
examples.zh: 玩家用操纵杆之类的触觉设备玩游戏。

senses.def: an act of killing yourself by cutting open your stomach with a sword
senses.zh: 切腹，剖腹自尽（尤指旧时日本武士为免受屈辱而自杀的行为）

senses.def: not permitted by Islamic law
senses.zh: 伊斯兰教教法所禁止的

examples.en: haram meat
examples.zh: 非清真肉食

senses.def: a meeting that is held in order to collect money for something, for example a community project
senses.zh: （为社区项目等举行的）募捐会，筹款会

examples.en: They held a harambee meeting to raise funds for a new classroom.
examples.zh: 他们为筹款建新教室而办了个募捐会。

senses.def: the act of joining with other people to achieve a difficult task

examples.en: the spirit of harambee
examples.zh: 众志成城的精神

senses.def: to speak loudly and angrily in a way that criticizes somebody/something or tries to persuade people to do something
senses.zh: 呵斥；大声谴责；慷慨激昂地劝说

examples.en: He walked to the front of the stage and began to harangue the audience.
examples.zh: 他走到讲台前，开始对观众进行长篇大论。

senses.def: a long loud angry speech that criticizes somebody/something or tries to persuade people to do something
senses.zh: 义愤填膺的谴责；慷慨激昂的劝说

senses.def: to annoy or worry somebody by putting pressure on them or saying or doing unpleasant things to them

examples.en: He has complained of being harassed by the police.
examples.zh: 他投诉受到警方侵扰。

examples.en: She claims she has been sexually harassed at work.
examples.zh: 她声称在工作中受到性骚扰。

senses.def: to make repeated attacks on an enemy
senses.zh: 反复进攻；不断攻击（敌人）

examples.en: Our convoys are being continually harassed by enemy submarines.
examples.zh: 我们的船队不断受到敌方潜艇的攻击。

examples.en: Greenpeace has been harassing whaling operations at sea.
examples.zh: 绿色和平组织一直在海上对捕鲸作业进行阻挠。

senses.def: the act of annoying or worrying somebody by putting pressure on them or saying or doing unpleasant things to them

examples.en: sexual/racial harassment
examples.zh: 性/种族骚扰

examples.en: workplace/street harassment (= that happens at work/in the street)
examples.zh: 工作场所/街头骚扰（= 发生在工作/街头的骚扰）

senses.def: the act of making repeated attacks on an enemy

examples.en: guerrilla harassment of the enemy
examples.zh: 敌人的游击袭扰

senses.def: a sign that shows that something is going to happen soon, often something bad
an area of water on the coast, protected from the open sea by strong walls, where ships can shelter

examples.en: Several boats lay at anchor in the harbour.
examples.zh: 港湾里停泊着几条船。

examples.en: to enter/leave harbour
examples.zh: 进入／离开港口

examples.en: the harbour front/mouth/wall
examples.zh: 港湾；港口；突堤

examples.en: She felt as though she'd reached a safe harbour after sailing in a vast, unfriendly sea.
examples.zh: 她感觉自己仿佛在一片浩瀚、不友好的大海中航行后到达了安全的港湾。

senses.def: to hide and protect somebody who is hiding from the police

examples.en: Police believe someone must be harbouring the killer.
examples.zh: 警方相信一定有人窝藏了杀人犯。

senses.def: to keep feelings or thoughts, especially negative ones, in your mind for a long time
senses.zh: 怀有，心怀（尤指负面感情或想法）

examples.en: The arsonist may harbour a grudge against the company.
examples.zh: 纵火犯可能对公司怀恨在心。

examples.en: She began to harbour doubts about the decision.
examples.zh: 她开始对这个决定产生怀疑。

examples.en: to harbour thoughts of revenge
examples.zh: 怀有报复的念头

examples.en: He still harbours ambitions of playing professional soccer.
examples.zh: 他仍然怀有踢职业足球的雄心。

examples.en: He still harboured doubts about her honesty.
examples.zh: 他仍然对她的诚实心怀怀疑。

senses.def: to contain something and allow it to develop

examples.en: Your dishcloth can harbour many germs.
examples.zh: 洗碗布中可能藏有很多病菌。

examples.en: These woodlands once harboured a colony of red deer.
examples.zh: 这些林地曾经栖息着一群马鹿。

examples.en: The Fife coast harbours many insects which are rare elsewhere in Britain.
examples.zh: 法夫郡海岸栖息着许多在英国其他地方很少见的昆虫。

senses.def: an official in charge of a harbour
difficult to do, understand or answer
senses.zh: 难做的；难懂的；难以回答的

examples.en: a hard choice/decision/question
examples.zh: 艰难的选择／决定；难以回答的问题

examples.en: It is hard to believe that she's only nine.
examples.zh: 很难相信她只有九岁。

examples.en: It's hard to see how they can lose.
examples.zh: 很难理解他们怎么会输。

examples.en: It's hard to imagine a more cynical political strategy.
examples.zh: 很难想象有什么政治策略比这更自私自利的了。

examples.en: ‘When will the job be finished?’ ‘It's hard to say (= it is difficult to be certain)’ .
examples.zh: “这项工作什么时候能完成？”“难说。”

examples.en: It's getting harder and harder to earn enough to pay the rent.
examples.zh: 越来越难以挣到足够付房租的钱。

examples.en: I find his attitude very hard to take (= difficult to accept).
examples.zh: 他的态度让我难以接受。

examples.en: We're finding reliable staff hard to come by (= difficult to get).
examples.zh: 我们觉得难以找到可靠的职员。

examples.en: Houses like this are extremely hard to find.
examples.zh: 像这样的房屋极其难找到。

examples.en: You are hard to please, aren’t you?
examples.zh: 你很难取悦，不是吗？

examples.en: I found it hard to believe what they told me.
examples.zh: 我发现很难相信他们告诉我的事。

examples.en: It must be hard for her, bringing up four children on her own.
examples.zh: 她一个人抚养四个孩子一定很艰难。

examples.en: It's hard for old people to change their ways.
examples.zh: 老年人难以改变他们的习惯。

senses.def: full of difficulty and problems, especially because of a lack of money

examples.en: Times were hard at the end of the war.
examples.zh: 战争后期生活很艰苦。

examples.en: She's had a hard life.
examples.zh: 她一生艰苦。

examples.en: Life got very hard.
examples.zh: 生活变得非常艰难。

examples.en: Conditions were extremely hard in the camps.
examples.zh: 营地的生活条件极其恶劣。

senses.def: needing or using a lot of physical strength or mental effort
senses.zh: 耗费体力（或脑力）的；辛苦的

examples.en: It's hard work shovelling snow.
examples.zh: 铲雪是个苦活儿。

examples.en: This is the hardest part of my job.
examples.zh: 这是我工作中最难的部分。

examples.en: It was one of the hardest things I ever did.
examples.zh: 这是我做过的最难的事情之一。

examples.en: I've had a long hard day.
examples.zh: 我度过了漫长辛苦的一天。

examples.en: This season has been a hard slog.
examples.zh: 这个赛季是一个艰难的赛季。

examples.en: They had put in hours of hard graft.
examples.zh: 他们投入了数小时的艰苦努力。

senses.def: putting a lot of effort or energy into an activity

examples.en: She's a very hard worker.
examples.zh: 她工作很卖力。

examples.en: He's hard at work on a new novel.
examples.zh: 他正忙着写一本新小说。

examples.en: When I left they were all still hard at it (= working hard).
examples.zh: 我离开的时候他们都还在努力工作。

senses.def: done with a lot of strength or force

examples.en: He gave the door a good hard kick.
examples.zh: 他狠狠踢了一下门。

examples.en: a hard punch
examples.zh: 砰的一拳

senses.def: solid or stiff and difficult to bend or break

examples.en: Wait for the concrete to go hard.
examples.zh: 等待混凝土凝结。

examples.en: a hard mattress
examples.zh: 硬床垫

examples.en: Diamonds are the hardest known mineral.
examples.zh: 钻石是已知的最坚硬的矿石。

senses.def: showing no kind feelings or sympathy
senses.zh: 冷酷无情的；硬心肠的；无同情心的

examples.en: My father was a hard man.
examples.zh: 我父亲是个不讲情面的人。

examples.en: She gave me a hard stare.
examples.zh: 她狠狠地看了我一眼。

examples.en: His voice was hard.
examples.zh: 他的声音很硬。

examples.en: He said some very hard things to me.
examples.zh: 他对我说了些很不近人情的话。

senses.def: showing no signs of fear or weakness; ready to fight or compete
senses.zh: 勇敢无畏的；不软弱退缩的

examples.en: Come and get me if you think you're hard enough.
examples.zh: 你要是觉得自己有种，就冲着我来吧。

examples.en: You think you're really hard, don't you?
examples.zh: 你是不是以为自己真的很勇猛？

examples.en: He's as hard and uncompromising as any professional sportsman.
examples.zh: 他和任何职业运动员一样努力、不妥协。

senses.def: definitely true and based on information that can be proved
senses.zh: 确凿的；可证实的；可靠的

examples.en: Is there any hard evidence either way?
examples.zh: 不管正反，有什么确凿证据吗？

examples.en: The newspaper story is based on hard facts.
examples.zh: 报纸的这篇报道有可靠的事实根据。

senses.def: very cold and severe

examples.en: It had been a hard winter.
examples.zh: 那年的冬天特别冷。

examples.en: There was a hard frost that night.
examples.zh: 那天晚上寒冷多霜。

senses.def: strongly alcoholic

examples.en: hard liquor
examples.zh: 烈酒

examples.en: a drop of the hard stuff (= a strong alcoholic drink)
examples.zh: 少许烈酒

senses.def: containing calcium
senses.zh: 硬的（含钙及镁等可溶性盐较多）

examples.en: a hard water area
examples.zh: 硬水区

examples.en: Our water is very hard.
examples.zh: 我们的水很硬。

senses.def: used to describe a letter c
senses.zh: 硬音的（如字母 c 或 g 在 cat 或 go 等词中的发音）

senses.def: to treat or criticize somebody in a very severe or strict way
senses.zh: 严厉对待，严格批评（某人或某事）

examples.en: Don't be too hard on him—he's very young.
examples.zh: 别对他太苛刻了，他还很小呢。

senses.def: to be difficult for or unfair to somebody/something

examples.en: It's hard on people who don't have a car.
examples.zh: 对于没有车的人来说，这不公平。

senses.def: to be likely to hurt or damage something
senses.zh: 可能损伤，可能损坏（某物）

examples.en: Looking at a computer screen all day can be very hard on the eyes.
examples.zh: 成天盯着计算机屏幕可能会对眼睛造成严重损害。

senses.def: in a situation where you have to choose between two things, both of which are unpleasant
to argue in an aggressive way and force somebody to agree on the best possible price or arrangement
to deliberately make a situation difficult and unpleasant for somebody
senses.zh: 给某人找茬儿；使某人不好过

examples.en: They really gave me a hard time at the interview.
examples.zh: 面试时他们确实是在难为我。

senses.def: that cannot be changed in any circumstances

examples.en: There are no hard and fast rules about this.
examples.zh: 这事没有什么硬性的规定。

examples.en: This situation isn’t hard and fast.
examples.zh: 这种情况并不是一成不变的。

senses.def: showing no fear, sympathy or kind behaviour
senses.zh: 冷酷无情；铁石心肠；毫无惧色

senses.def: used as a way of saying that you are sorry about something, usually ironically
senses.zh: （常作反话）太不幸了，真够倒霉

senses.def: difficult to understand or needing a lot of effort

examples.en: I'm finding his latest novel very hard going.
examples.zh: 我觉得他最近的这部小说很晦涩。

senses.def: used to tell somebody that you feel sorry for them

examples.en: ‘Failed again, I'm afraid.’ ‘Oh, hard luck.’
examples.zh: “恐怕我又失败了。”“哦，太不幸了。”

senses.def: a difficult problem or situation to deal with
senses.zh: 棘手的问题；不好对付的情形

senses.def: a person or event that is so good or successful at something that it will be difficult for anyone/anything else coming after them to be as good or successful
senses.zh: 令人望尘莫及的人；难以企及的事件

examples.en: She has been an excellent principal and will be a hard act to follow.
examples.zh: 她是一位出色的校长，也是一位难以效仿的校长。

examples.en: Their contribution will prove a tough act to follow.
examples.zh: 他们的贡献将被证明是一项艰巨的任务。

senses.def: by having an unpleasant experience or by making mistakes
senses.zh: 通过痛苦的经历；通过出错

examples.en: She won't listen to my advice so she'll just have to learn the hard way.
examples.zh: 她不肯听我的忠告，所以只好吃了苦头才知道厉害。

examples.en: He learned about the dangers of drugs the hard way.
examples.zh: 他吃了一番苦头后才懂得了毒品的危险。

senses.def: to have difficulty doing something
senses.zh: 干某事很困难（或很吃力、很费力）

examples.en: You'll have a job convincing them that you're right.
examples.zh: 要让他们信服你是对的还要费点劲。

examples.en: He had a hard job to make himself heard.
examples.zh: 他好不容易才使别人听见他的声音。

senses.def: to use more time or energy on a task than is necessary
senses.zh: 在某事上耗费过多时间（或精力）；费冤枉力

senses.def: used after you have been arguing with somebody or have beaten them in a contest but you would still like to be friendly with them
senses.zh: （与人争论或战胜某人后向其表达善意）别往心里去，别记恨

examples.en: It looks like I'm the winner again. No hard feelings, Dave, eh?
examples.zh: 看来我又赢了。你不会不高兴吧，戴夫？

examples.en: Someone has to lose. No hard feelings, eh?
examples.zh: 总有人会失败的。别难过，好吗？

senses.def: to make yourself seem more attractive or interesting by not immediately accepting an invitation to do something
senses.zh: 故作姿态；故意摆谱；拿架子

senses.def: to consider a problem or possibility very carefully and without hurrying
senses.zh: 极其慎重地考虑（问题或可能性）

examples.en: We need to take a long, hard look at all the options.
examples.zh: 我们需要十分谨慎地考虑所有的可选方案。

senses.def: needing too much effort

examples.en: I can't be bothered making a hot meal—it's too much like hard work.
examples.zh: 我懒得做热饭热菜，太麻烦了。

senses.def: with great effort; with difficulty

examples.en: to work hard
examples.zh: 努力工作

examples.en: You must try harder.
examples.zh: 你得更加努力。

examples.en: She tried her hardest not to show how disappointed she was.
examples.zh: 她竭力不流露出自己有多失望。

examples.en: He was still breathing hard after his run.
examples.zh: 他跑完步，现在还气喘吁吁的。

examples.en: You shouldn't train too hard—be careful about injuries.
examples.zh: 你不应该训练得太辛苦——小心受伤。

examples.en: He is fighting hard to keep his job.
examples.zh: 他正在努力奋斗以保住自己的工作。

examples.en: She trained hard twice a day.
examples.zh: 她每天刻苦训练两次。

examples.en: Our victory was hard won (= won with great difficulty).
examples.zh: 我们的胜利来之不易。

senses.def: with great force

examples.en: Don't hit it so hard!
examples.zh: 别这么用力打！

examples.en: I pressed the accelerator hard and the car sped off.
examples.zh: 我用力踩下油门，汽车飞驰而去。

examples.en: Small businesses have been hit hard/hard hit by the recession.
examples.zh: 小企业受到了经济衰退的沉重打击。

senses.def: carefully and completely

examples.en: to think hard
examples.zh: 认真思考

examples.en: We thought long and hard before deciding to move house.
examples.zh: 我们经过长久慎重的考虑之后才决定搬家。

examples.en: They need to look hard at the facts of this case.
examples.zh: 他们需要认真审视这个案件的事实。

senses.def: heavily; a lot or for a long time
senses.zh: 沉重地；大量地；长时间地

examples.en: It was raining hard when we set off.
examples.zh: 我们出发时正下着大雨。

senses.def: at a sharp angle to the left/right

examples.en: Turn hard right at the next junction.
examples.zh: 在下个路口处向右急转弯。

senses.def: to be or feel unfairly treated
senses.zh: 受到不公平待遇；感到委屈

examples.en: She has every right to feel hard done by—her parents have given her nothing.
examples.zh: 她完全有理由觉得委屈，她父母什么都没给她。

senses.def: to find it very difficult to do something

examples.en: He was hard put to it to explain her disappearance.
examples.zh: 他很难对她的消失作出解释。

senses.def: to have too few or too little of something

examples.en: We're hard up for ideas.
examples.zh: 我们再想不出主意了。

senses.def: very soon after

examples.en: His death followed hard on hers.
examples.zh: 她死后不久，他也死了。

senses.def: very close behind somebody/something; very soon after something

examples.en: He turned and fled with Peter hot on his heels.
examples.zh: 他转身逃跑，彼得穷追不舍。

examples.en: They reached the border with the police hot on their heels.
examples.zh: 他们到了边境，警察紧追其后。

examples.en: Further successes came hot on the heels of her first best-selling novel.
examples.zh: 她的第一部畅销小说之后是接二连三的成功。

examples.en: News of rising unemployment followed hard on the heels of falling export figures.
examples.zh: 出口数字下降之后紧接着就是失业率上升的消息。

senses.def: used to say that things change very slowly
senses.zh: （旧习惯、传统等）难以改变，根深蒂固

examples.zh: 他对妻子的死感到很难过。

examples.zh: 我们向公司提供计算机硬件。

examples.zh: 我们去了五金店买了一些螺母和螺栓。

examples.zh: 许多道德观念似乎是人们出生时便根植在脑中的。

examples.zh: 硬木地板

examples.zh: 环保主义者呼吁结束热带硬木贸易。

examples.zh: 适应力强的绵羊品种

examples.zh: 这些顽强的山民似乎在寒冷中茁壮成长。

examples.zh: 一些勇敢的人出来观看曲棍球比赛。

examples.zh: 这些植物非常耐寒，可以抵御霜冻。

examples.zh: 他沿着街道狂奔而去。

examples.zh: 她总是去法国出差。

examples.zh: 她送他回公寓，告诉他有一封紧急信件到达。

senses.def: a type of small white bean that is usually dried before it is sold and then left in water before cooking

senses.zh: 用胡椒和油制成的辛辣的北非调味酱

senses.def: used only as an order to tell somebody to listen

examples.zh: 听！我听到楼梯上有脚步声！

senses.def: used only as an order to draw attention to somebody who has just said something stupid or who is showing that they are too proud

examples.zh: 瞧他那副德行！他以为他是谁呀？

examples.zh: 她总是念叨以前的世道。

examples.zh: 这些最新的款式使人想起 70 年代的服装。

senses.def: a humorous character in some traditional plays, who wears special brightly coloured clothes with a diamond pattern

examples.zh: 这种细菌对人类无害。

examples.zh: 作者通过巧妙的情节来实现这种协调。

senses.def: the process of making systems or rules similar in different countries or organizations
senses.zh: 使（不同国家或组织的体制或规则）相一致；使协调

examples.en: tax harmonization
examples.zh: 税收统一

senses.def: the act of playing or singing music that combines with the main tune to make a pleasant sound

examples.en: The harmonizations are especially beautiful and imaginative.
examples.zh: 和声特别美丽且富有想象力。

senses.def: if two or more things harmonize

examples.en: The new building does not harmonize with its surroundings.
examples.zh: 那栋新楼与周围环境不协调。

examples.en: Which Bordeaux vintage will best harmonize with the lamb?
examples.zh: 哪种波尔多葡萄酒最适合与羊肉搭配？

senses.def: to make systems or rules similar in different countries or organizations
senses.zh: 使（不同国家或组织的体制或规则）相一致；使协调

examples.en: the need to harmonize tax levels across the European Union
examples.zh: 使欧盟各国的税收标准相一致的必要

senses.def: to play or sing music that combines with the main tune to make a pleasant sound

examples.en: Sally sang the melody while I harmonized.
examples.zh: 当我和声时，莎莉唱着旋律。

examples.en: The singers harmonize well.
examples.zh: 歌手们配合得很好。

examples.en: to harmonize with the lead singer
examples.zh: 与主唱和谐一致

senses.def: a tax that is added to the price of goods and services in parts of Canada
senses.zh: 统一销售税：加拿大部分地区商品和服务价格所加的一种税

senses.def: a state of peaceful existence and agreement

examples.en: social/racial harmony
examples.zh: 社会／种族融洽

examples.en: They lived together in perfect harmony.
examples.zh: 他们和谐地生活在一起。

examples.en: the need to be in harmony with our environment
examples.zh: 同我们的环境协调的必要

senses.def: the way in which different notes that are played or sung together combine to make a pleasant sound

examples.en: to sing in harmony
examples.zh: 用和声唱

examples.en: They began to sing in perfect four-part harmony.
examples.zh: 他们开始以完美的四部和声演唱。

examples.en: passionate lyrics and stunning vocal harmonies
examples.zh: 充满激情的歌词和绝妙的和声演唱

senses.def: an attractive combination of related things

examples.en: the harmony of colour in nature
examples.zh: 自然界色彩的协调

examples.en: The designer’s aim is to produce a harmony of shape and texture.
examples.zh: 设计者的目标是要使外观与材料的特性两者统一起来。

senses.def: Lord Northcliffe
senses.zh: 哈姆斯沃思：诺思克里夫勋爵，罗瑟米尔勋爵

senses.def: a set of narrow pieces of leather and metal pieces that is put around the head and body of an animal, especially a horse, so that the animal can be controlled and fastened to a carriage

examples.en: The sight of horses in harness hauling timber was common a hundred years ago.
examples.zh: 一百年前，套着挽具的马匹拉木材的情景很常见。

senses.def: a set of straps
senses.zh: （用于人，起固定或保护作用的）系带，保护带

examples.en: She fastened the safety harness tightly around her waist before starting the descent.
examples.zh: 她把安全带牢牢地系在腰部后才开始下降。

senses.def: doing your normal work, especially after a rest or a holiday
senses.zh: （尤指休息或假期结束后）做正常工作

senses.def: working closely with somebody in order to achieve something

examples.en: They’ll be working in harness with other doctors to compile the report.
examples.zh: 他们将与其他医生合作编写这份报告。

senses.def: to put a harness
senses.zh: 给（马等）上挽具；用挽具把…套到…上

examples.en: to harness a horse
examples.zh: 给马上挽具

examples.en: We harnessed two ponies to the cart.
examples.zh: 我们把两匹矮种马套到了车上。

examples.en: In some way, I felt harnessed to my job—I just couldn't leave.
examples.zh: 在某种程度上，我感觉自己被工作束缚住了——我就是无法离开。

senses.def: to control and use the force or strength of something to produce power or to achieve something
senses.zh: 控制，利用（以产生能量等）

examples.en: attempts to harness the sun’s rays as a source of energy
examples.zh: 利用日光作为能源的尝试

examples.en: We must harness the skill and creativity of our workforce.
examples.zh: 我们必须尽量发挥全体职工的技能和创造力。

examples.en: How can this energy be harnessed effectively for the good of humankind?
examples.zh: 怎样才能有效利用这种能源为人类造福？

examples.en: They are attempting to harness the power of the sun.
examples.zh: 他们在试图利用太阳能。

senses.def: doing your normal work, especially after a rest or a holiday
senses.zh: （尤指休息或假期结束后）做正常工作

senses.def: working closely with somebody in order to achieve something

examples.en: They’ll be working in harness with other doctors to compile the report.
examples.zh: 他们将与其他医生合作编写这份报告。

senses.def: a first name for boys
(c. 1019-66) the last Anglo-Saxon
senses.zh: 哈罗德二世：（c。1019-66）英格兰的最后一位盎格鲁撒克逊国王。他的军队于1066年在英格兰南海岸的黑斯廷斯战役中被征服者威廉·诺曼军队击败。哈罗德在战斗中去世，威廉成为英格兰国王。

senses.def: (1893-1971) a US comic actor in over 500 silent films. His typical character was shy and wore glasses, and often got into dangerous situations. The best known of these was a scene in Safety Last
senses.zh: 哈罗德·劳埃德（Harold Lloyd）：（1893-1971）是美国喜剧演员，参与了500多部无声电影。他典型的性格是害羞，戴着眼镜，经常陷入危险的境地。其中最著名的是《安全末日》（Safety Last，1923年）中的一幕，其中劳埃德（Lloyd）用手从高大建筑物外部的大钟上悬挂下来。他的其他电影包括《新生》（1925年）和《小子弟弟》（1927年）。他于1952年获得特别奖。

senses.def: (1894-1986) a British Conservative politician. He entered Parliament in 1924 and was Foreign Secretary
senses.zh: 哈罗德·麦克米伦（Harold Macmillan）：（1894-1986）英国保守党政客。他于1924年进入议会，是外交大臣（1955）和财政大臣（1955-7），然后成为总理（1957-63）。上任后，他专注于改善英国的国际关系和鼓励经济增长，并以“你从来没有那么好”这一短语而闻名（摘自美国大选）。由于他的成功，他有时被媒体称为“ Supermac”。1963年的普罗菲莫（Profumo）事件损害了他的政党，并于当年晚些时候因身体不适辞职，由亚历克·道格拉斯·霍姆爵士（Alec Douglas-Home）接任。麦克米伦（Macmillan）是几本书的作者，其中包括《风之风》（1966）。他于1984年成为伯爵。

senses.def: (1886-1968) a British diplomat
senses.zh: 哈罗德·尼科尔森（Harold Nicolson）：（1886-1968）英国外交官（代表海外国家的人），创作了125本书，其中以《日记与信件》（1968年）最为人所知。他于1935年至1945年担任国会议员，并于1953年被任命为骑士。他于1913年与维塔·萨克维尔·韦斯特（Vita Sackville-West）结婚，他们的婚姻一直持续到1962年她去世，尽管他们俩都有同性恋事务。

senses.def: (1930-2008) an English writer of plays who had a major influence on modern British theatre. His characters were often ordinary, unimportant people who found it difficult to communicate properly with each other, and his plays combined humour with an atmosphere of danger and unhappiness. The word Pinteresque is sometimes used to describe these qualities. Pinter's best-known plays include The Birthday Party
senses.zh: 哈罗德·品特（Harold Pinter）：（ 1930-2008年），英语戏剧作家，对现代英国戏剧有重大影响。他的角色通常是普通的，无关紧要的人，彼此之间很难进行适当的交流，而且他的戏剧将幽默与危险和不快乐的气氛结合在一起。品特式（Pinteresque）一词有时用于描述这些品质。品特（Pinter）最著名的戏剧包括生日派对（1958），看守者（1960），归乡（1965），旧时代（1971），无人区（1975）和背叛（1978）。他还写了许多电影剧本，包括《围墙之间》（1969），《法国中尉的女人》（1982）和《陌生人的安慰》（1983）。品特还担任演员和导演，并且是反对战争和侵犯人权的运动家。他于2005年获得诺贝尔文学奖。

senses.def: (1916-97) a US author of popular novels that contain a lot of sex and violence. More than 50 million copies of his books were sold and many of them were made into films. The best known is The Carpetbaggers
senses.zh: 哈罗德·罗宾斯（Harold Robbins）：（1916-97）美国作家，其中包含很多性暴力。出售了超过5000万本他的书籍，其中许多被制成电影。最著名的是The Carpetbaggers（1961），售出了600万本。其他还包括《从不爱一个陌生人》（1948年），《丹尼·费舍尔的石头》（1952年），《贝蒂》（1971年），《食人鱼》（1986年）和《种马》（1996年）。

senses.def: (1946-2004) a British doctor who was found guilty of murdering 15 of his patients, mostly older women, by giving them injections
senses.zh: 哈罗德·希普曼（Harold Shipman）：（1946-2004）一位英国医生，他因给他们注射毒品谋杀15名患者（主要是老年妇女）而被定罪，并于2000年被判终身监禁。对该案进行公开调查后发现在23年的时间里，他杀死了至少200名其他患者，这使他成为英国最严重的连环杀手（一个人一个接一个地杀了几个人）。船夫在监狱自杀。

senses.def: (1916-95) an English Labour politician who was twice Prime Minister (1964-70 and 1974-6). His government aimed to make Britain a more modern country, encouraging more people to be involved in science and technology, but had to face serious economic problems. Many people were surprised when he resigned
senses.zh: 哈罗德·威尔逊（Harold Wilson）：（1916-95）曾两次出任总理（1964-70和1974-6）的英国工党政治家。他的政府旨在使英国成为一个更现代化的国家，鼓励更多的人参与科学技术，但必须面对严重的经济问题。1976年他辞职（放弃职位）时，许多人感到惊讶。后来发现，MI5在1960年代和1970年代推翻威尔逊政府的行为是不诚实的。他于1976年被任命为骑士，1983年被任命为终身陪伴。

senses.def: a large musical instrument with strings stretched from top to bottom on a frame, played with the fingers

examples.en: By means of pedals, a harp can be set in any desired key.
examples.zh: 利用踏板可以给竖琴调出任何一种调子。

senses.def: to keep talking about something in a boring or annoying way

examples.en: Don’t keep harping on about my age!
examples.zh: 别总对我的年龄唠叨个没完！

examples.en: He is always harping on about the war.
examples.zh: 他总是对那场战争说个没完。

senses.def: a grey seal
senses.zh: 竖琴海豹，鞍纹海豹（背部有鞍形斑纹）

senses.def: a first name for girls

a luxury fashion magazine published once a month. It was first published in the US in 1867 and has been published in Britain since 1929. It contains articles about fashion and the social life of the rich and famous, and also articles on more general topics. It is published in many different versions for countries across the world.
senses.zh: 每月发行一次的豪华时尚杂志。它于1867年在美国首次出版，自1929年以来在英国出版。它包含有关富人和名人的时尚和社会生活的文章，以及有关更一般主题的文章。它为世界各地的国家提供了许多不同的版本。

senses.def: a US magazine known for its news articles, essays on politics and literature, and short stories. One of the oldest US magazines, it was started in 1850 by Harper & Brothers.
senses.zh: 《哈珀杂志》：以新闻报道，政治和文学论文以及短篇小说而著称的美国杂志。它是美国最古老的杂志之一，于1850年由Harper＆Brothers创办。

senses.def: John Brown
senses.zh: 哈珀斯渡口（美国西弗吉尼亚州杰斐逊县的一个小镇，因1859年10月约翰·布朗和一群废奴主义者袭击并占领当地的联邦政府军火库而著名）

senses.def: a person who plays the harp
a weapon like a spear

examples.en: Traditionally whales were hunted with harpoons.
examples.zh: 传统上，鲸鱼是用鱼叉捕猎的。

senses.def: to hit something with a harpoon

examples.en: Thousands of whales have been harpooned in these waters.
examples.zh: 数以千计的鲸鱼在这些水域被鱼叉捕获。

senses.def: an early type of musical instrument similar to a piano, but with strings that are plucked
a person who plays the harpsichord
(in ancient Greek and Roman stories) a cruel creature with a woman’s head and body and a bird’s wings and feet
senses.zh: 鸟身女妖，哈比（古希腊和古罗马神话中的怪物）

senses.def: an offensive word for a woman who you think is cruel or unpleasant
an offensive word for an angry or unpleasant woman
senses.zh: 凶狠暴躁的女人（尤指老太婆）

senses.def: a bird of prey
a British military aircraft made by Hawker Siddeley, which is the only plane to be able to take off straight up into the air or land straight down from the air without needing a runway
senses.zh: 鹞式战斗机（英国军机，由霍克·西德利公司研制…）

senses.def: a first name for girls
(1811-96) a US writer whose best-known work, Uncle Tom's Cabin
senses.zh: 哈里特·比彻·斯托（(1811-96) 美国作家，其最著名的作品《汤姆叔叔的小屋》增加了北方各州对南方奴隶制运动的支持。她写了 16 本书，其中包括几本有关新英格兰生活的书，例如《部长的求爱》(1859 年)和《老城居民》(1869 年)。）

senses.def: (1821-1913) an African American woman who was enslaved
senses.zh: （1821-1913）一位非洲裔美国妇女，从出生起就被奴役，但在 1849 年逃脱并积极参与结束奴隶制的运动。她因帮助300多名奴隶通过地下铁路逃亡而被昵称为“摩西”。内战期间，她还担任美国陆军的间谍。

senses.def: any of the studies of public opinion carried out by the US company Harris Insights & Analytics
senses.zh: 美国公司Harris Insights＆Analytics进行的任何舆论研究

senses.def: a type of thick woollen
senses.zh: 一种用于制作外套，夹克等的厚羊毛布。它是在外赫布里底群岛的刘易斯和哈里斯岛上手工制成的。盖尔语名称为“ Clo Mhor”，意为“大布”。

examples.en: a Harris tweed jacket.
examples.zh: 哈里斯粗花呢夹克。

senses.def: a first name for boys
a large, expensive department store
senses.zh: 位于伦敦市中心Knightsbridge地区的大型昂贵百货商店。它声称能够提供任何物品并提供任何服务。它始于1834年，当时是由查尔斯·亨利·哈罗德（Charles Henry Harrod）（1799-1885）拥有的一家出售食品的小商店。1849年移至骑士桥。

senses.def: a spa
senses.zh: 哈罗盖特（Harrogate）：英格兰北部约克郡的温泉镇。许多退休人员住在那儿。它有一个大型会议中心。

senses.def: a piece of farming equipment that is pulled over land that has been ploughed
to use a harrow
to make somebody feel very shocked, frightened or upset

examples.en: They remain harrowed by the eight weeks of bombing.
examples.zh: 他们仍然因八周的轰炸而痛苦不堪。

senses.def: a well-known British public school
senses.zh: 耙：一所著名的英国公立学校，位于伦敦西北部，建于1572年。它被认为是英国主要的男校之一，许多重要的人都在那里接受了教育，包括温斯顿·丘吉尔。

senses.def: a way of showing that you disagree with or disapprove
to show that you disagree with or disapprove
to annoy or upset somebody by continuously asking them questions or for something

examples.en: She has been harried by the press all week.
examples.zh: 整个星期她都受到新闻界的不断烦扰。

examples.en: The superintendent sent him to harry the forensic lab over the blood tests.
examples.zh: 警官派他一次又一次地去法医检验室询问验血结果。

senses.def: to make repeated attacks on an enemy

examples.en: They harried the retreating army.
examples.zh: 他们骚扰撤退的军队。

senses.def: a first name for boys or girls, short for Harold
senses.zh: 哈里（男子或女子名，Harold 或 Henry 或 Harriet缩写）

senses.def: any ordinary person rather than the people you know or people who have special skills or qualities
senses.zh: （不熟悉或无特长的）任何人；闲人；生人

examples.en: We don't want any Tom, Dick or Harry using the club bar.
examples.zh: 我们不想随便让什么人都来使用会所的酒吧。

senses.def: any ordinary person rather than the people you know or people who have special skills or qualities
senses.zh: （不熟悉或无特长的）任何人；闲人；生人

examples.en: We don't want any Tom, Dick or Harry using the club bar.
examples.zh: 我们不想随便让什么人都来使用会所的酒吧。

senses.def: a character in Tom Brown's Schooldays
senses.zh: 哈里·闪光曼（Harry Flashman）：汤姆·布朗（Tom Brown）上学时期的角色。他是一个残酷的大男孩，对汤姆和其他小男孩不满意。在20世纪，乔治·麦克唐纳·弗雷泽（George MacDonald Fraser）写了一系列小说，讲述了成年后闪电侠的冒险经历。

senses.def: (1874-1926) a US performer of magic, born in Hungary, who became famous for escaping from chains, locked boxes, etc. His name is often used to refer to a person or an animal that seems able to escape from any situation.
senses.zh: 哈里·霍迪尼（Harry Houdini）：（1874-1926）是美国魔术演员，出生于匈牙利，以逃脱铁链，锁盒等而闻名。他的名字经常被用来指代似乎能够逃脱的人或动物。任何情况。

examples.en: It will take a political Houdini escape trick for him to avoid being destroyed by the scandal.
examples.zh: 他需要胡迪尼的政治逃亡伎俩才能避免被丑闻摧毁。

senses.def: (1870-1950) a Scottish comic singer who wore Highland dress
senses.zh: 哈里·劳德（Harry Lauder）：（1870-1950）是苏格兰的喜剧歌手，在舞台上穿着高地服饰，并因诸如《我爱拉西》和《鲁明》中的罗阿明之类的歌曲而广受欢迎。1919年，他因在第一次世界大战期间招待士兵而被授予骑士勋章。

senses.def: the main character in a series of seven very successful books by British author J K Rowling, including Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
senses.zh: 哈利•波特英国作家J•K•罗琳所著的七本畅销小说《哈利波特》系列作品中的主要人物。该系列包括《哈利•波特与魔法石》（1997年）、《哈利•波特与火焰杯》（2000年）、《哈利•波特与混血王子》（2005年）等。哈利是一个会魔法的年轻巫师，这些作品写的是他在霍格沃茨魔法学校的冒险经历。虽然这些书是为儿童写的，但也很受成人欢迎。小说改编成电影，大获成功。2016年还推出了一部描述成年哈利的戏剧《哈利波特与被诅咒的孩子》。

senses.def: (1884-1972) the 33rd US President (1945-53). He was Vice-President under Franklin D Roosevelt
senses.zh: 哈里·杜鲁门（Harry S Truman）：（1884-1972）美国第33任总统（1945-53）。他是富兰克林·罗斯福（Franklin D Roosevelt）时期的副总统，在他于1945年去世时被替换为他，然后赢得了1948年的选举。他同意将第一枚原子弹投掷到日本。他的政府开始了《马歇尔计划》，并帮助建立了联合国和北约。杜鲁门强烈反对共产主义。他创立了杜鲁门主义，并使美国卷入了朝鲜战争。他还开始了“公平交易”计划，这使他在普通百姓中很受欢迎。在成为总统之前，他曾在密苏里州参议院代表民主党。

senses.def: (1921-2001) a Welsh comic performer and singer. He is best known for appearing in the radio comedy series The Goon Show
senses.zh: 哈里·塞科姆（1921-2001）是威尔士喜剧演员和歌手。他以出演广播喜剧系列The Goon Show而闻名。1981年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: cruel, severe and unkind

examples.en: The punishment was harsh and unfair.
examples.zh: 处罚很重而且不公平。

examples.en: The minister received some harsh criticism.
examples.zh: 部长受到了严厉的批评。

examples.en: the harsh treatment of prisoners
examples.zh: 严酷对待囚犯

examples.en: He regretted his harsh words.

he who laughs last laughs longest.word: he who laughs last laughs longest

senses.def: the person who provides the money for something can also control how it is spent
senses.zh: 花钱的人说了算；财大者气粗

he who pays the piper calls the tune.word: he who pays the piper calls the tune

senses.def: used to say that somebody notices every opportunity to gain an advantage

he, she, etc. doesn’t miss a trick.word: he, she, etc. doesn’t miss a trick

senses.def: he had
he would
he will
a strong man with big muscles, especially one who likes to show other people how strong he is
senses.zh: 强健的男子（尤指好显示其体魄者）

senses.def: he is
he has
the part of the body on top of the neck containing the eyes, nose, mouth and brain

examples.en: She nodded her head in agreement.
examples.zh: 她点头表示同意。

examples.en: He shook his head in disbelief.
examples.zh: 他摇头表示不信。

examples.en: The boys hung their heads in shame.
examples.zh: 男孩子们羞愧地低着头。

examples.en: She turned her head to look at him.
examples.zh: 她转过头看着他。

examples.en: They bowed their heads in prayer.
examples.zh: 他们低下头祈祷。

examples.en: She tilted her head back and closed her eyes.
examples.zh: 她把头向后仰，闭上了眼睛。

examples.en: to raise/lift/lower your head
examples.zh: 抬头；低头

examples.en: He was shot in the head and died ten minutes later.
examples.zh: 他头部中弹，十分钟后死亡。

examples.en: The driver suffered head injuries.
examples.zh: 司机头部受伤。

examples.en: He still has a good head of hair (= a lot of hair).
examples.zh: 他的头发依然很多。

senses.group: part of body 身体部位

senses.def: the mind or brain

examples.en: I sometimes wonder what goes on in that head of yours.
examples.zh: 我有时不明白你脑子里在想些什么。

examples.en: I wish you'd use your head (= think carefully before doing or saying something).
examples.zh: 我希望你凡事多用用脑子。

examples.en: The thought never entered my head.
examples.zh: 我从未有过那种想法。

examples.en: His head was spinning (= he felt dizzy or confused) after only one drink.
examples.zh: 仅仅喝了一口酒，他就感到头晕目眩。

examples.en: I can't work it out in my head—I need a calculator.
examples.zh: 我没法心算出来，我得用计算器。

examples.en: She started hearing voices in her head.
examples.zh: 她开始听到脑子里有声音。

examples.en: Who's been putting such weird ideas into your head (= making you believe that)?
examples.zh: 是谁让你产生这些怪念头的？

examples.en: I can't get that tune out of my head.
examples.zh: 我忘不掉那个曲调。

examples.en: Try to put the exams out of your head (= stop thinking about them).
examples.zh: 尽量别想考试的事了。

senses.def: the size of a person’s or animal’s head

examples.en: She's a good head taller than her sister.
examples.zh: 她比妹妹足足高出了一个头。

examples.en: The favourite won by a short head (= a distance slightly less than the length of a horse's head).
examples.zh: 最被看好的那匹马以不足一马头的优势获胜。

senses.def: a continuous pain in your head

examples.en: I woke up with a really bad head this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早晨醒来时头痛得厉害。

senses.def: the person in charge of a group of people or an organization

examples.en: the heads of government/state
examples.zh: 政府首脑；国家元首

examples.en: She resigned as head of department.
examples.zh: 她辞去了部门主管的职务。

examples.en: I've asked the department head for an appointment.
examples.zh: 我已经向部门主管提出了预约。

examples.en: a former head of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange
examples.zh: 香港联合交易所的前总裁

examples.en: He is deputy head of the National Railway Museum.
examples.zh: 他是国家铁路博物馆的副馆长。

examples.en: the crowned heads (= the kings and queens) of Europe
examples.zh: 欧洲各国君主

examples.en: I was head coach of a Little League basketball team in Pittsburgh.
examples.zh: 我当时是匹兹堡一个小联盟篮球队的主教练。

examples.en: the head gardener/chef/waiter
examples.zh: 园艺主管；厨师长；餐馆服务员领班

senses.def: the person in charge of a school or college

examples.en: I've been called in to see the Head.
examples.zh: 我接到通知去见校长。

examples.en: the deputy head
examples.zh: 副校长

senses.def: the side of a coin that has a picture of the head of a person on it, used as one choice when a coin is tossed

examples.en: I called heads and it came down tails.
examples.zh: 我要了正面，可落下来却是反面朝上。

senses.group: side of coin 硬币的面

senses.def: the end of a long narrow object that is larger or wider than the rest of it

examples.en: the head of a nail
examples.zh: 钉子的头

senses.group: end of object 物体一端

senses.def: the top or highest part of something

examples.en: at the head of the page
examples.zh: 在页眉处

examples.en: They finished the season at the head of their league.
examples.zh: 赛季结束时他们在联赛中位居榜首。

senses.def: the place where a river begins
the most important seat at a table
senses.zh: 上座（桌子旁最重要的座位）

examples.en: The President sat at the head of the table.
examples.zh: 总统坐在桌子的上首。

senses.def: the position at the front of a line of people

examples.en: The prince rode at the head of his regiment.
examples.zh: 王子骑马走在卫队的前头。

senses.group: of line of people 人的行列

senses.def: the mass of leaves or flowers at the end of a stem

examples.en: Remove the dead heads to encourage new growth.
examples.zh: 把枯萎了的残花除掉以促使新的生长。

senses.def: the mass of small bubbles on the top of a glass of beer
the part of a spot on your skin that contains a thick yellow liquid (= pus
the component of a sound or video recording system that converts data on the disk or tape into digital electronic data (and the other way round)
senses.group: in recording system 录音／录影系统

senses.def: used to say how many animals of a particular type are on a farm, in a herd
senses.zh: （表示农场或牧群等的牲畜的数目）头

examples.en: 200 head of sheep
examples.zh: 200 只绵羊

senses.group: number of animals 动物数量

senses.def: oral

examples.en: to give head
examples.zh: 进行口交

senses.def: the central part of a phrase, which has the same grammatical
senses.zh: （短语的）中心成分，中心词，主导词

senses.def: to force people to stop arguing and behave in a sensible way
senses.zh: 强行制止人们争吵并使之恢复理智

senses.def: to keep trying to do something that will never be successful
senses.zh: 用头撞墙；徒劳无益；枉费心机

examples.en: Trying to reason with them was like banging my head against a brick wall.
examples.zh: 试图和他们讲道理只是白费口舌。

senses.def: to be much better than other people or things
senses.zh: 比其他人（或事物）好得多；出类拔萃；鹤立鸡群

examples.en: His performance stood head and shoulders above the rest.
examples.zh: 他的表现远远超过其他人。

senses.def: to shout at somebody in an angry way, especially without reason
senses.zh: 气愤地对某人大喊大叫；（尤指毫无道理地）呵斥某人

senses.def: if you bring
senses.zh: （使）事情达到紧要关头，需要当机立断

examples.en: The chairman's resignation finally brought matters to a head.
examples.zh: 主席的辞职最终使事情到了紧要关头。

examples.en: The dispute finally came to a head in March that year.
examples.zh: 这场争论最终在当年三月达到了白热化阶段。

examples.en: Things came to a head when several of the nurses made a formal complaint.
examples.zh: 一些护士正式投诉后，事情到了非处理不可的地步了。

senses.def: to refuse to admit that a problem exists or refuse to deal with it
senses.zh: 采取鸵鸟政策；不正视现实；回避问题

senses.def: to be unable to understand something
senses.zh: 不理解某事；不明白某事

examples.en: I couldn't make head nor tail of what he was saying.
examples.zh: 我弄不懂他在说些什么。

senses.def: to make somebody feel confused, upset and/or annoyed
senses.zh: 使某人困惑（或烦恼、生气）

examples.en: Shut up! You're doing my head in.
examples.zh: 闭嘴！你让我烦死了。

senses.def: to be able to do something very easily and without having to think too much
to make somebody remember something by repeating it a lot of times
senses.zh: 向某人反复灌输；对某人反复讲述

senses.def: covering your whole body

examples.en: We were covered from head to foot in mud.
examples.zh: 我们浑身是泥。

examples.en: She was dressed from head to toe in red.
examples.zh: 她从头到脚都是红色的。

senses.def: to sleep

examples.en: I managed to get my head down for an hour.
examples.zh: 我将就着睡了一小时。

senses.def: to avoid attracting attention to yourself
senses.zh: 避免引起注意；保持低姿态

senses.def: to be able to understand or accept something

examples.en: She's dead. I can't get my head round it yet.
examples.zh: 她死了。我仍然无法相信这事。

senses.def: to start to understand or think something

examples.en: When will you get it into your head that I don't want to discuss this any more!
examples.zh: 你何时才能明白我不想再谈论这件事了！

examples.en: For some reason she's got it into her head that I don't like her.
examples.zh: 不知什么原因，她觉得我不喜欢她。

senses.def: to allow somebody to do what they want without trying to stop them
to give somebody hopes about something that may not be possible or likely; to make somebody act or think in an unreasonable way
senses.zh: 使某人抱有空想（或做不切实际的事）

examples.en: Who's been putting ideas into his head?
examples.zh: 是谁一直在让他想入非非的？

senses.def: to deal with somebody in a very direct and determined way

examples.en: The company will be going head to head with the giant of the pharmaceuticals market.
examples.zh: 该公司将与医药市场巨头正面交锋。

senses.def: to make you feel drunk

examples.en: That glass of wine has gone straight to my head.
examples.zh: 那杯酒一下子就把我弄得头昏脑涨。

senses.def: to make you feel too proud of yourself in a way that other people find annoying
senses.zh: 使人过于骄傲；冲昏头脑

senses.def: to be aware of everything that is happening around you, even things that seem difficult or impossible to see
senses.zh: 脑后长眼；眼光敏锐；什么都能觉察到

examples.en: You can’t get away with anything in her class. She has eyes in the back of her head.
examples.zh: 在她的课堂上你无法逃脱任何惩罚。她的后脑勺长着眼睛。

senses.def: to be a sensible person
to be good at something

examples.en: to have a head for figures/business
examples.zh: 长于算术；有生意头脑

senses.def: if somebody does not have a head for heights
to be reading

examples.en: She always has her nose in a book.
examples.zh: 她总是在埋头读书。

senses.def: to be thinking about something that is not connected with what you are doing
to have ideas, plans, etc. that are not realistic
senses.zh: 有不切实际的想法（或计划等）；想入非非

senses.def: to be a sensible person
to have somewhere to live

examples.en: Thanks to Bob’s generosity, I still have a roof over my head.
examples.zh: 感谢鲍勃的慷慨，我仍然有栖身之所。

senses.def: for each person

examples.en: The meal worked out at $20 a head.
examples.zh: 这一餐算下来每人 20 美元。

senses.def: moving forwards or downwards with your head in front of the rest of your body

examples.en: He fell head first down the stairs.
examples.zh: 他倒栽葱摔下楼梯。

senses.def: without thinking carefully about something before acting

examples.en: She got divorced and rushed head first into another marriage.
examples.zh: 她离婚后又仓促再婚了。

senses.def: your head feels as though it is going round and round and you cannot balance, especially because you are ill or confused or have had a shock; to make you feel like this

examples.en: Her head was spinning from the pain.
examples.zh: 她因疼痛而头晕目眩。

examples.en: His theories on economics are enough to make your head spin.
examples.zh: 他的经济理论足以让你头晕。

senses.def: the pressure produced by steam

examples.en: The old engine still manages to build up a good head of steam.
examples.zh: 旧火车头仍然能够产生很大的蒸汽压力。

senses.def: a situation in which somebody/something becomes gradually more active or successful
senses.zh: 初见成效；开始获得成功

examples.en: This campaign has been steadily building up a head of steam.
examples.zh: 这场运动已在稳步积累成效。

examples.en: United have recently gathered a head of steam in the title race.
examples.zh: 联队近来已在冠军争夺战中积累势头。

senses.def: loving somebody very much

examples.en: He's fallen head over heels in love with his boss.
examples.zh: 他深深迷恋上了他的上司。

senses.def: used to ask somebody which side of a coin they think will be facing upwards when it is tossed
senses.zh: （掷硬币作决定时说）正面还是反面

senses.def: used to say that some people will be punished because of something that has happened
senses.zh: 有些人将（为某事）受到惩罚

senses.def: to say something that is exactly right
to force somebody to do something that they do not want to do, by making threats
senses.zh: 威胁某人；胁迫某人就范

senses.def: to be proud of or not feel ashamed about something that you have done

examples.en: She managed to hold her head high and ignore what people were saying.
examples.zh: 她勉力昂首挺胸，不理会人家的闲言碎语。

senses.def: used to threaten somebody that you will hit them
senses.zh: （威胁要打人）我非揍你不可，我要揍扁你

senses.def: involved in something that is too difficult for you to deal with

examples.en: After a week in the new job, I soon realized that I was in over my head.
examples.zh: 新工作刚做了一个星期，我便意识到自己做不了。

senses.def: to remain calm in a difficult situation

examples.en: She needed to keep a clear head if she was to remain in control.
examples.zh: 她要想继续控制局势就必须保持清醒的头脑。

senses.def: to deal with a difficult situation, especially one in which you have financial problems, and just manage to survive
senses.zh: 勉强逃脱困境；设法不举债；挣扎求存

examples.en: I’m not sure how much longer we’ll be able to keep our heads above water.
examples.zh: 我不确定我们还能坚持多久。

senses.def: to avoid attracting attention to yourself
senses.zh: 避免引起注意；保持低姿态

examples.en: If I were you, I’d keep your head down for a couple of weeks.
examples.zh: 如果我是你，我会低着头几周。

senses.def: to laugh very loudly and for a long time
to laugh, etc. a lot and very loudly
to act according to what you feel rather than to what you think is sensible
in a bad mood; in an angry way

examples.en: I should keep out of his way. He’s like a bear with a sore head this morning.
examples.zh: 我应该远离他。今天早上他就像一头头疼的熊。

senses.def: to become unable to act in a calm or sensible way
to make somebody feel annoyed, anxious or upset

examples.en: When they spend all this time on social media, they are seeing things that mess with their heads.
examples.zh: 当他们把所有时间都花在社交媒体上时，他们看到的东西会让他们心烦意乱。

senses.def: to be crazy
to not spend time/effort on something, because it is not important or you are not interested in it
senses.zh: 不为某事花费时间（或精力）；不操心

senses.def: to not hurt somebody physically in any way
senses.zh: 不动某人一根头发；丝毫不伤害某人

senses.def: just guessing or using your memory, without taking time to think carefully or check the facts
senses.zh: 单凭猜测（或记忆）；信口地；不假思索地

examples.en: I can't remember the name off the top of my head, but I can look it up for you.
examples.zh: 我一时想不起这个名字，不过我可以给你查一查。

senses.def: used to describe a young person who acts in a more sensible way than you would expect for a person of their age
used to tell somebody that they will have to accept any unpleasant results of something that they decide to do
senses.zh: 你（自己）必须承担任何后果

examples.en: Tell him the truth if you want to, but on your own head be it!
examples.zh: 你想把真相告诉他就告诉他吧，但后果自负！

senses.def: crazy
not knowing what you are saying or doing because of the effects of alcohol or drugs
senses.zh: （酒后或使用药物后）胡言乱语，行为乖张，神志不清

senses.def: too difficult or complicated for somebody to understand
senses.zh: 超过某人理解力；过于复杂

examples.en: A lot of the jokes went (= were) right over my head.
examples.zh: 那些笑话有很多我完全听不懂。

senses.def: to a higher position of authority than somebody
senses.zh: 职位比某人高；超过某人

examples.en: I couldn't help feeling jealous when she was promoted over my head.
examples.zh: 她受到提拔职位超过了我，我不由得感到嫉妒。

examples.en: I’m not happy that you went over my head to ask for this time off.
examples.zh: 你越过我向上级请假，我很不满。

senses.def: an amount of money that is offered for capturing or killing somebody
senses.zh: 缉拿（或杀害）某人的悬赏金

examples.en: Ever since he killed the gang’s leader, there has been a price on his head.
examples.zh: 自从他杀死了帮派头目之后，他的人头就被悬赏了。

senses.def: to risk losing your job, damaging your reputation, etc. by doing or saying something
senses.zh: 冒（失业、损失名誉等）的险

examples.en: It's not a matter that I'm prepared to put my head on the block for.
examples.zh: 我不准备为这件事冒险。

senses.def: to think about or discuss something as a group
senses.zh: 集体思考（或讨论）；集思广益

senses.def: if something unpleasant rears its head
to make you feel that you can still hear something

examples.en: His warning was still ringing in my ears.
examples.zh: 他的警告依然在我耳边回响。

senses.def: to think hard in order to find an answer to something
senses.zh: 苦苦琢磨；苦思冥想；绞尽脑汁

examples.en: Experts have been scratching their heads over the increase in teenage crime.
examples.zh: 专家们一直对青少年犯罪率的上升感到摸不着头脑。

senses.def: to make people think about something in a completely different way
senses.zh: 使人完全改变思路；使人从反面思考

senses.def: to be remembered for a long time

examples.en: One of his paintings in particular sticks in my mind.
examples.zh: 他有一幅画我记得特别清楚。

senses.def: to suddenly start thinking something, especially something that other people think is stupid
senses.zh: 突发奇想；突然开始想某事

senses.def: to suddenly decide to do something, especially something that other people think is stupid
a physical condition in which your head is painful or you cannot think clearly as a result of an illness or of drinking too much alcohol
senses.zh: （由于疾病或饮酒过量）晕头涨脑，稀里糊涂

examples.en: You’re going to have a thick head in the morning!
examples.zh: 早上你的头会很厚！

senses.def: to make a person feel too proud in a way that other people find annoying
used to say that two people can achieve more than one person working alone
used to tell somebody to think about something, especially when they have asked for your opinion or said something stupid
senses.zh: 你动动脑子；你仔细想想

examples.en: ‘Why don't you want to see him again?’ ‘Oh, use your head!’
examples.zh: “你为什么不愿再见到他？”“唔，你好好想想吧！”

senses.def: (in nouns) a person who is very enthusiastic about a particular thing or is addicted

examples.en: a gearhead
examples.zh: 技术设备发烧友

examples.en: a crackhead
examples.zh: 强效可卡因瘾君子

examples.en: a smackhead
examples.zh: 吸白粉成瘾的人

examples.en: a pothead
examples.zh: 大麻瘾君子

senses.def: to move in a particular direction

examples.en: Where are we heading?
examples.zh: 我们要往哪儿去？

examples.en: Where are you two headed?
examples.zh: 你们两个去哪儿？

examples.en: Let's head back home.
examples.zh: 咱们回家吧。

examples.en: She headed for the door.
examples.zh: 她朝着门走去。

examples.en: We headed north.
examples.zh: 我们朝北方走。

examples.en: Head towards the mall.
examples.zh: 前往购物中心。

examples.en: The boat was heading out to sea.
examples.zh: 那条船正在出海。

examples.en: Can you forecast where the economy is heading?
examples.zh: 你能预测经济的发展方向吗？

senses.def: to lead or be in charge of something

examples.en: She has been appointed to head the research team.
examples.zh: 她受命领导研究小组。

examples.en: to head a committee/delegation
examples.zh: 领导委员会/代表团

examples.en: to head an investigation/inquiry
examples.zh: 领导调查/询问

examples.en: a terrorist group headed by a former army officer
examples.zh: 由一名前军官领导的恐怖组织

examples.en: He heads up the bank's corporate arm.
examples.zh: 他领导该银行的企业部门。

examples.en: The committee will be headed jointly by two men.
examples.zh: 委员会将由两人共同领导。

examples.en: The delegation will be headed by Lord Arthur.
examples.zh: 代表团将由亚瑟勋爵率领。

examples.en: Eight out of ten children came from a family headed by both natural parents.
examples.zh: 十分之八的孩子来自于亲生父母为户主的家庭。

examples.en: He ended up heading a minority government.
examples.zh: 他最终领导了一个少数派政府。

senses.def: to be at the top of a list of names or at the front of a line of people
senses.zh: 位于排行之首；排在前头

examples.en: Italy heads the table after two games.
examples.zh: 两场比赛之后意大利队排名榜首。

examples.en: Orlando, Florida, heads the list of most popular summer destinations.
examples.zh: 佛罗里达州奥兰多位居最受欢迎的夏季旅游目的地之首。

examples.en: to head a march/procession

examples.zh: 校园里有个卫生院，在国民保健体系下为学生提供医疗保健服务。

senses.def: a medical examination to assess the condition of a person’s body or mind

examples.en: A routine health check revealed that his blood pressure was high.
examples.zh: 他在一次例行体检中检查出高血压。

senses.def: an assessment of the condition of something

examples.en: The bank offers business advice and financial health checks.
examples.zh: 这家银行提供商业建议和财务状况评估服务。

senses.def: a private club where people go to do physical exercise in order to stay or become healthy and fit
a place where people can stay for short periods of time in order to try to improve their health by eating special food, doing physical exercise, etc.
senses.zh: 健身会馆，休闲健身中心（提供特定饮食、身体锻炼等短期休养服务）

senses.def: food that does not contain any artificial substances and is therefore thought to be good for your health

examples.en: a health food store/shop
examples.zh: 健康食品店

senses.def: HMO
a person who works in healthcare
senses.zh: 专业医疗人员；医务工作者

examples.en: There is a shortage of qualified health professionals.
examples.zh: 有专业资格的医务工作者短缺。

senses.def: a medical examination of somebody to make sure that they are healthy

examples.en: There is compulsory health screening for everyone applying for a work permit.
examples.zh: 每个申请工作许可证的人都必须接受强制性健康检查。

examples.en: Employees are offered annual health screenings.
examples.zh: 员工每年都会接受健康检查。

senses.def: a public service providing medical care

examples.en: a shortage of labour in the health service
examples.zh: 公共医疗卫生系统中人员的缺乏

examples.en: Federal health policies should ensure the provision of adequate health services.
examples.zh: 联邦卫生政策应确保提供充足的卫生服务。

examples.en: The health service can't provide cosmetic surgery.
examples.zh: 公共医疗卫生服务不提供整容手术。

senses.def: a place where people can relax and receive health and beauty treatments, with, for example, steam
senses.zh: 休闲健身中心（提供休闲、健身、美容等服务，如蒸汽浴和运动设施）

examples.en: a superb health spa, which includes sauna, Turkish bath and fitness rooms
examples.zh: 内设桑拿浴室、土耳其浴室和健身房的第一流的休闲健身中心

senses.def: the practice of travelling abroad in order to have medical treatment
senses.zh: 医疗旅游（出国接受医疗服务）

senses.def: (in the UK) a trained nurse whose job is to visit people in their homes, for example new parents, and give them advice on some areas of medical care

examples.en: The baby's weight is monitored by the health visitor.
examples.zh: 婴儿的体重由家访护士跟踪记录。

examples.en: Health visitors give families support for infant care and development.
examples.zh: 社区保健护士给家庭提供婴儿护理和发育方面的帮助。

senses.def: the service of providing medical care

examples.en: the costs of healthcare for the elderly
examples.zh: 老年人的医疗费用

examples.en: community healthcare
examples.zh: 社区医疗保健

examples.en: healthcare workers/professionals
examples.zh: 医护人员；医疗专业人员

senses.def: good for your health
in a way that is good for your health
in a healthy way; in a way that avoids somebody/something becoming ill
senses.zh: 健康地；健康地；健康地 以避免某人/某事生病的方式

examples.en: A good gardener knows how to keep things growing healthily.
examples.zh: 一个好的园丁知道如何保持植物健康生长。

senses.def: in a way that is good for your health

examples.en: to eat healthily
examples.zh: 吃得健康

senses.def: in a way that shows that you are in good health

examples.en: His tanned skin shone healthily.
examples.zh: 他晒黑的皮肤散发着健康的光泽。

senses.def: in a way that is normal and sensible

examples.en: The relationship developed and matured healthily.
examples.zh: 两国关系健康地发展和成熟。

senses.def: in a way that is successful and working well

examples.en: The shops and businesses are not functioning healthily.
examples.zh: 商店和企业运转不正常。

examples.en: The economy grew healthily.
examples.zh: 经济健康发展。

senses.def: the quality of having good health and not being likely to become ill

examples.en: Basic care of your plants will promote healthiness.
examples.zh: 对植物的基本护理将促进健康。

senses.def: the quality of being good for your health

examples.en: Buy organic if you're concerned about the healthiness of your food.
examples.zh: 如果您担心食物的健康状况，请购买有机食品。

senses.def: the quality of showing that you are in good health

examples.en: His skin seems to glow with healthiness.
examples.zh: 他的皮肤似乎焕发着健康的光芒。

senses.def: the quality of being normal and sensible
senses.zh: 健康：正常和明智的品质

examples.en: the healthiness of her reaction
examples.zh: 她的反应是否健康

senses.def: the quality of being successful and working well; the quality of showing this success

examples.en: This is evidence of the healthiness of the state's economy.
examples.zh: 这是该州经济健康的证据。

senses.def: the quality of being large and showing success
senses.zh: 大而显得成功的；可观的

examples.en: the healthiness of his bank balance
examples.zh: 他的银行余额是否健康

senses.def: the part of a person's life during which they are healthy

examples.en: The expert said that we need to extend our healthspan.
examples.zh: 专家说，我们需要延长健康寿命。

senses.def: having good health and not likely to become ill

examples.en: a healthy child/baby/adult
examples.zh: 健康的孩子／宝宝／成人

examples.en: The researchers then measured brain activity in two groups of healthy subjects.
examples.zh: 研究人员随后测量了两组健康受试者的大脑活动。

examples.en: a healthy animal/tree
examples.zh: 健壮的动物；健康的树

examples.en: Stay healthy by eating well and exercising regularly.
examples.zh: 通过良好饮食和经常性锻炼保持健康。

examples.en: She was finally starting to look healthy again.
examples.zh: 她终于开始看起来又健康了。

examples.en: The newborn was perfectly healthy.
examples.zh: 新生儿非常健康。

examples.en: People are living longer and living healthier lives.
examples.zh: 人们的寿命越来越长，生活也越来越健康。

senses.def: good for your health

examples.en: a healthy diet/lifestyle
examples.zh: 健康的饮食／生活方式

examples.en: healthy eating/food/living
examples.zh: 健康的饮食／食品／生活

examples.en: The farm provides a healthy work environment.
examples.zh: 农场提供健康的工作环境。

senses.def: showing that you are in good health

examples.en: to have a healthy appetite
examples.zh: 胃口好

senses.def: normal and sensible

examples.en: The child showed a healthy curiosity.
examples.zh: 这孩子的好奇心很正常。

examples.en: She has a healthy respect for her rival's talents.
examples.zh: 她很有风度地尊重对手的才能。

examples.en: It's not healthy the way she clings to the past.
examples.zh: 她那种沉湎于过去的态度不明智。

senses.def: successful and working well

examples.en: The economy is extremely healthy at the moment.
examples.zh: 目前经济极为繁荣。

examples.en: Your car doesn't sound very healthy.
examples.zh: 你的车听声音好像不太正常。

senses.def: large and showing success
senses.zh: 大而显得成功的；可观的

examples.en: a healthy bank balance
examples.zh: 一大笔银行结余

examples.en: a healthy profit
examples.zh: 丰厚的利润

synonyms.words: all right ▪ OK ▪ fine ▪ healthy ▪ strong ▪ fit

intro.en: These words all describe somebody who is not ill and is in good health.
intro.zh: 以上各词均形容人健康、身体好。

items.def: [not usually before noun] (rather informal) in good health:
items.zh: 指健康、身体好

examples.en: I’m not feeling very well.
examples.zh: 我感觉身体不太好。

items.def: [not before noun] (rather informal) not feeling ill; not injured:
items.zh: 指感觉身体还好、没有生病、没有受伤

examples.en: Are you feeling all right?
examples.zh: 你感觉还好吗？

items.def: [not before noun] (informal) not feeling ill; not injured:
items.zh: 指感觉身体还好、没有生病、没有受伤

examples.en: She says she’s OK now, and will be back at work tomorrow.
examples.zh: 她说她现在身体还可以，明天就回来上班。

items.def: [not before noun] (not used in negative statements) (rather informal) completely well:
items.zh: 指身体很好、健康

examples.en: ‘How are you?’ ‘Fine, thanks.’
examples.zh: “你好吗？”“很好，谢谢。”

items.def: in good health and not likely to become ill:
items.zh: 指健康、健壮

examples.en: Keep healthy by exercising regularly.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼以保持健康。

items.def: in good health and not suffering from an illness:
items.zh: 指健康、身体好

examples.en: After a few weeks she was feeling stronger.
examples.zh: 几周之后她感觉身体好些了。

items.def: (especially British English尤用于英式英语) in good physical health, especially because you take regular physical exercise:
items.zh: 指健壮，尤指因经常锻炼而身体健康

examples.en: I go swimming every day in order to keep fit.
examples.zh: 我每天游泳以保持健康。

senses.def: an untidy pile of something

examples.en: The building was reduced to a heap of rubble.
examples.zh: 大楼变成了一堆废墟。

examples.en: a compost heap
examples.zh: 一堆堆肥

examples.en: His clothes lay in a heap on the floor.
examples.zh: 他的衣服堆在地板上。

examples.en: Worn-out car tyres were stacked in heaps.
examples.zh: 汽车废轮胎散乱地堆放着。

senses.def: a lot of something

examples.en: There's heaps of time before the plane leaves.
examples.zh: 离飞机起飞还有很多时间。

examples.en: I've got a heap of things to do.
examples.zh: 我有一大堆事情要做。

senses.def: a car that is old and in bad condition
high up/low down in the structure of an organization or a society
senses.zh: 在（机构或社会的）顶层／底层

examples.en: These workers are at the bottom of the economic heap.
examples.zh: 这些工人处在经济结构的底层。

senses.def: to fall down heavily and not move

examples.en: He collapsed in a heap on the floor.
examples.zh: 他瘫倒在地，蜷作一团。

senses.def: a lot better, etc.

examples.en: Help yourself—there's heaps more.
examples.zh: 请随便取用，还多着呢。

examples.en: He looks heaps better than when I last saw him.
examples.zh: 他看上去比我上回见他时好多了。

senses.def: to put things in an untidy pile

examples.en: Rocks were heaped up on the side of the road.
examples.zh: 路边堆积着石头。

examples.en: She looked at the vegetables heaped on the table.
examples.zh: 她看着桌上堆满的蔬菜。

senses.def: to put a lot of something in a pile on something

examples.en: She heaped food on my plate.
examples.zh: 她往我的盘子里放了很多食物。

examples.en: She heaped my plate with food.
examples.zh: 她往我的盘子里放了很多食物。

senses.def: to give a lot of something such as praise or criticism to somebody
senses.zh: 对（某人）大加赞扬（或批评等）

examples.en: He heaped praise on his team.
examples.zh: 他高度赞扬了他的队。

examples.en: He heaped his team with praise.
examples.zh: 他高度赞扬了他的队。

senses.def: to speak about somebody/something in a way that shows that you do not respect them or have a good opinion of them

examples.en: Opposition politicians poured scorn on the proposals.
examples.zh: 反对派政界人士对这些提议嗤之以鼻。

senses.def: to be aware of sounds with your ears

examples.en: I can't hear very well.
examples.zh: 我听觉不太好。

examples.en: He heard a noise and went to investigate.
examples.zh: 他听到有声响，于是过去查看。

examples.en: She could hear voices in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 她能听到厨房里有声音。

examples.en: I could hear the sound of traffic in the background.
examples.zh: 我可以听到背景中的交通声。

examples.en: She heard footsteps behind her.
examples.zh: 她听到背后有脚步声。

examples.en: I couldn’t hear anything.
examples.zh: 我什么都听不见。

examples.en: to hear a scream/a cry/a shot/an explosion
examples.zh: 听到尖叫声/哭声/枪声/爆炸

examples.en: He could hear a dog barking.
examples.zh: 他听得到狗叫。

examples.en: Did you hear him go out?
examples.zh: 你听到他出去了吗？

examples.en: I heard a car drive off.
examples.zh: 我听到一辆汽车开走了。

examples.en: Didn't you hear what I said?
examples.zh: 难道你没有听到我的话？

examples.en: She has been heard to make threats to her former lover.
examples.zh: 有人听见她威胁她先前的恋人。

senses.def: to listen or pay attention to somebody/something

examples.en: Did you hear that play on the radio last night?
examples.zh: 你昨晚收听了那出广播剧吗？

examples.en: He knows that the crowd wants to hear those songs.
examples.zh: 他知道观众想听这些歌曲。

examples.en: Langgard's music is rarely heard outside Denmark.
examples.zh: 兰加德的音乐在丹麦以外的地方很少有人听到。

examples.en: to hear both sides of the argument
examples.zh: 听取双方的争论

examples.en: Be quiet—I can't hear myself think! (= it is so noisy that I can't think clearly)
examples.zh: 安静点，我都给吵昏头了！

examples.en: Have you ever heard him lecture?
examples.zh: 你听过他讲课吗？

examples.en: We'd better hear what they have to say.
examples.zh: 我们最好还是听听他们有什么话要说。

senses.def: to be told about something

examples.en: Haven't you heard? She resigned.
examples.zh: 你还没听说吗？她辞职了。

examples.en: ‘I'm getting married.’ ‘So I've heard.’
examples.zh: “我要结婚了。”“我听说了。”

examples.en: Things are going well from what I hear.
examples.zh: 从我所听到的来看，事情进展不错。

examples.en: I was sorry to hear about your accident.
examples.zh: 获悉你遇到意外，我很难过。

examples.en: Come on! I want to hear all about it.
examples.zh: 快点！我想听与这有关的一切。

examples.en: Wait till he hears about this.
examples.zh: 等他听到这件事。

examples.en: I've heard about people like you.
examples.zh: 我听说过像你这样的人。

examples.en: We had heard nothing for weeks.
examples.zh: 我们好几个星期都没得到任何消息了。

examples.en: to hear a story/rumour/report
examples.zh: 听到说法／谣言／报道

examples.en: When I heard the news, I was devastated.
examples.zh: 听到这个消息，我非常震惊。

examples.en: I was delighted to hear your good news.
examples.zh: 得知你的好消息我很高兴。

examples.en: I was surprised to hear (that) he was married.
examples.zh: 听说他结婚了，我很惊讶。

examples.en: I hear you've been away this weekend.
examples.zh: 我听说你这个周末外出了。

examples.en: I’ve heard it said (that) they met in Italy.
examples.zh: 我听说他们是在意大利认识的。

examples.en: Did you hear what happened?
examples.zh: 你听说发生什么事了吗？

examples.en: We are waiting to hear what the lawyers have to say.
examples.zh: 我们正在等待律师的说法。

senses.def: to listen to and judge a case in court

examples.en: The appeal was heard in private.
examples.zh: 这件上诉案不公开审理。

examples.en: Today the jury began to hear the evidence.
examples.zh: 今天陪审团开始听证。

senses.def: to imagine that you can see or hear something that is in fact not there
used to ask somebody if they have heard a particular joke before
used to show that you agree with or approve of what somebody has just said, especially during a speech
senses.zh: （表示赞同，尤指在听演讲时）对！对！

senses.def: to hear/see somebody/something for the last time

examples.en: That was the last I ever saw of her.
examples.zh: 那是我最后一次见到她。

examples.en: Unfortunately, I don't think we've heard the last of this affair.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，我认为这件事还没有了结。

senses.def: to hear people talking about something

examples.en: I've often heard tell of such things.
examples.zh: 我常听到人谈起这种事。

senses.def: used to tell somebody that you have listened to their opinion, especially when you are going to express a different opinion
senses.zh: 我明白你的意思（但我不一定同意）

examples.en: I hear what you're saying, but you're wrong.
examples.zh: 我明白你的意思，但你错了。

senses.def: used to say that you do not really believe somebody’s promises or excuses because they are the same ones you have heard before
senses.zh: （表示不相信某人的许诺或辩解）这种话我听得多了

senses.def: used to give the most recent news you have about somebody/something
senses.zh: （提供最新消息时说）我最近听到的消息

examples.en: The last I heard he was still working at the garage.
examples.zh: 我最近听到的消息是他还在汽车修理厂工作。

senses.def: used to say that somebody/something deserves praise
senses.zh: （表示值得称赞）咱们为…鼓掌，让我们为…喝彩

examples.en: Let's hear it for the teachers, for a change.
examples.zh: 咱们变换一下，这回为老师们鼓鼓掌。

senses.def: to express your feelings, opinions, etc. in a way that makes people notice and consider them
senses.zh: （为引起他人注意）发表意见，表达感情

examples.en: The programme gives ordinary viewers a chance to make their voices heard.
examples.zh: 该节目为普通观众提供了表达自己声音的机会。

examples.en: a society in which individuals are able to make their voices heard
examples.zh: 一个人人都能够发表意见的社会

senses.def: to keep being reminded of something because somebody is always talking to you about it
senses.zh: 被人不断纠缠，没完没了

examples.en: If we don't get her a dog we'll never hear the end of it.
examples.zh: 我们要是不给她弄条狗来，这事就没完没了。

senses.def: it was extremely quiet

examples.en: The audience was so quiet you could have heard a pin drop.
examples.zh: 观众安静得连针落地的声音也听得见。

senses.def: used to tell somebody in an angry way to pay attention and obey you
senses.zh: （生气地要某人听从）听到我的话没有

examples.en: You can't go—do you hear me?
examples.zh: 你不能走，听清楚了吗？
