senses.zh: 改变态度，改变看法（通常指变得更友好、有益等）

examples.en: Dan did not want to get married but recently he’s had a change of heart.
examples.zh: 丹原本不想结婚，但最近他改变了主意。

examples.en: She said she's not coming, but she might have a change of heart.
examples.zh: 她说她不会来，但她可能会改变主意。

senses.def: having a lot of importance and interest for somebody
senses.zh: 为某人所重视关心；为某人所爱

items.idm: cross my heart (and hope to die)

senses.def: used to emphasize that you are telling the truth or will do what you promise

examples.en: I saw him do it—cross my heart.
examples.zh: 我看见是他干的，我可以发誓。

senses.def: used to compare two things and say that one of them is better

examples.en: Look at him dance! Eat your heart out, Fred Astaire (= he dances even better than Fred Astaire).
examples.zh: 看看他跳的舞！比弗雷德·阿斯泰尔跳得还好。

items.idm: find it in your heart/yourself to do something

senses.def: to be able or willing to do something

examples.en: Can you find it in your heart to forgive her?
examples.zh: 你能够做到宽恕她吗？

examples.en: He couldn't find it in himself to trust anyone again.
examples.zh: 他再也不愿意相信任何人了。

senses.def: in a way that is sincere

examples.en: I beg you, from the bottom of my heart, to spare his life.
examples.zh: 我诚心诚意地恳求你饶他一命吧。

examples.en: It was clearly an offer that came from the heart.
examples.zh: 那很明显是由衷的提议。

examples.en: I could tell he spoke from the heart.
examples.zh: 我看得出他这番话是发自内心的。

senses.def: to make somebody feel positive, especially when they thought that they had no chance of achieving something
to give your love to one person
used to ask somebody to be kind and/or reasonable
senses.zh: 发发善心吧；讲点情理吧

examples.en: Have a heart! I’ve nowhere else to stay!
examples.zh: 有一颗心！我没有别的地方可以住！

senses.def: to be a very kind person
senses.zh: 有金子般的心；心肠很好

senses.def: to be a person who does not show other people sympathy
to want somebody to be happy and successful even though your actions may not show this
senses.zh: 关心…的幸福和成功；暗暗地替…着想

examples.en: Although he was sometimes too strict with his children, he had their best interests at heart.
examples.zh: 尽管他有时对孩子们过于严厉，但他是为他们着想。

items.idm: have/hold a place in somebody's heart

senses.def: to be very dear to somebody

examples.en: He'll always have a place in my heart.
examples.zh: 他将永远留在我心里。

senses.def: with a lot of energy and enthusiasm
senses.zh: 精力充沛地；起劲地；充满活力地

examples.en: They threw themselves heart and soul into the project.
examples.zh: 他们全心全意地投入了这个项目。

senses.def: used to say that you do not feel sympathy for somebody

examples.en: ‘I have to go to Brazil on business.’ ‘My heart bleeds for you!’
examples.zh: “我要出差去巴西。”“真够可怜的！”

items.idm: your heart goes out to somebody

senses.def: used to say that you feel a lot of sympathy for somebody

examples.en: Our hearts go out to the families of the victims.
examples.zh: 我们很同情那些受害者的家人。

items.idm: somebody’s heart is in their mouth

senses.def: somebody feels nervous or frightened about something
senses.zh: 提心吊胆；心提到了嗓子眼儿

examples.en: My heart was in my mouth as I opened the envelope.
examples.zh: 打开信封时，我的心提到了嗓子眼儿。

items.idm: somebody’s heart is in the right place

senses.def: used to say that somebody’s intentions are kind and sincere even though they sometimes do the wrong thing
senses.zh: 本意是好的；心眼儿是好的

items.idm: your heart is not in something

senses.def: used to say that you are not very interested in or enthusiastic about something
senses.zh: 对某事不很感兴趣（或不热衷）

examples.en: Her heart isn't in her job.
examples.zh: 她对工作没有兴趣

senses.def: used to say that somebody has a sudden feeling of happiness or excitement

examples.en: My heart leapt at the news.
examples.zh: 听到这个消息我的心狂跳起来。

examples.en: Her heart leaped with joy.
examples.zh: 她心花怒放。

senses.def: used to say that somebody has a sudden feeling of fear, excitement, etc.
senses.zh: （表示突然感到恐惧、兴奋等）心里咯噔一下

examples.en: My heart missed a beat when I saw who it was.
examples.zh: 当我看到那人是谁时，我的心漏了一拍。

senses.def: used to say that somebody suddenly feels sad or depressed about something
senses.zh: （表示突然感到悲伤或沮丧）心里一沉

examples.en: My heart sank when I saw how much work there was left.
examples.zh: 我看到还有那么多活没干，心顿时沉了下去。

examples.en: She watched him go with a sinking heart.
examples.zh: 她心情沉重地看着他走了。

items.idm: home is where the heart is

senses.def: a home is where the people you love are
happy and cheerful
if you know something in your heart
senses.zh: 在内心深处；内心强烈地感觉到

examples.en: She knew in her heart of hearts that she was making the wrong decision.
examples.zh: 她心底里明白她在作出错误的决定。

examples.en: In my heart, I knew it wasn't true.
examples.zh: 我心里明白那不是真的。

items.idm: it does somebody’s heart good (to do something)

senses.def: it makes somebody feel happy when they see or hear something
senses.zh: （看到或听到某事时）使人感到高兴，使人心旷神怡

examples.en: It does my heart good to see the old place being taken care of so well.
examples.zh: 看到故居被照管得这么好，真叫人高兴。

items.idm: let your heart rule your head

senses.def: to act according to what you feel rather than to what you think is sensible
to stop hoping for something or trying to do something because you no longer feel confident
to fall in love with somebody/something

items.idm: a man/woman after your own heart

senses.def: a man/woman who likes the same things or has the same opinions as you
senses.zh: 趣味相投者；情投意合者

items.idm: not have the heart (to do something)

senses.def: to be unable to do something because you know that it will make somebody sad or upset
using only your memory

examples.en: She's learnt the whole speech off by heart.
examples.zh: 她把整篇讲话都背熟了。

examples.en: I've seen the show so often I know all the songs by heart.
examples.zh: 我经常看这个节目，里面所有的歌我都记住了。

items.idm: out of the goodness of your heart

senses.def: because of kind feelings, without thinking about what advantage there will be for you
senses.zh: 出于好心（不考虑是否从中获益）

examples.en: You're not telling me he offered to lend you the money out of the goodness of his heart?
examples.zh: 你该不是说他是纯粹出于好心才主动借钱给你的吧？

items.idm: pour out/open your heart to somebody

senses.def: to tell somebody all your problems, feelings, etc.
senses.zh: 向某人敞开心扉；倾诉衷肠

examples.en: Finally, he broke down in tears and poured out his heart to her.
examples.zh: 最后他潸然泪下，向她倾诉衷肠。

items.idm: set your heart on something | have your heart set on something

senses.def: to want something very much

examples.en: They’ve set their heart on a house in the country.
examples.zh: 他们下定决心要在乡下买房子。

senses.def: very unhappy or disappointed
to cry noisily for a long time because you are very sad
senses.zh: 悲切地哭泣；很伤心地哭泣

examples.en: She flung herself at his chest and sobbed her heart out.
examples.zh: 她扑到他的胸口，悲戚地哭起来。

senses.def: to make somebody fall in love with you

items.idm: strike fear, etc. into somebody/sb’s heart

senses.def: to make somebody be afraid, etc.

examples.en: The sound of gunfire struck fear into the hearts of the villagers.
examples.zh: 炮声使村民心惊胆战。

senses.def: to feel more positive about something, especially when you thought that you had no chance of achieving something
senses.zh: （由于某事）增强信心；重新振作起来

examples.en: The government can take heart from the latest opinion polls.
examples.zh: 政府可以从最近的民意测验中找回信心。

senses.def: to be very upset by something that somebody says or does
senses.zh: 对某事感到烦恼；十分介意（某人的话或行为）；耿耿于怀

examples.en: You shouldn’t take everything he says to heart.
examples.zh: 你不应该把他所说的一切都放在心上。

items.idm: tear at your heart | tear your heart out

senses.def: to strongly affect you in an emotional way
senses.zh: 使伤心；使心如刀绞；使愁肠寸断

items.idm: tear/rip the heart out of something

senses.def: to destroy the most important part or aspect of something

examples.en: Closing the factory tore the heart out of the community.
examples.zh: 工厂的关闭让社区的心都碎了。

senses.def: as much as you want

examples.en: a supervised play area where children can run around to their heart’s content
examples.zh: 一处能让孩子们尽情游玩且有人看管的地方

senses.def: to make somebody feel happy or sympathetic
senses.zh: 使人内心感到高兴（或同情）

examples.en: Doesn’t that story just warm the cockles of your heart?
examples.zh: 这个故事是不是温暖了你的心呢？

senses.def: the way to make somebody like or love you
senses.zh: 赢得某人喜爱的办法；攻心策

examples.en: The way to a man's heart is through his stomach (= by giving him good food).
examples.zh: 取得男人欢心的方法就是让他吃好。

items.idm: wear your heart on your sleeve

senses.def: to allow your feelings to be seen by other people
senses.zh: 让感情外露；把心事挂在脸上

examples.en: He’s not one to wear his heart on his sleeve.
examples.zh: 他不会轻易表达自己的情感。

items.idm: what the eye doesn’t see (the heart doesn’t grieve over)

senses.def: if a person does not know about something that they would normally think was bad, then it cannot hurt them
senses.zh: 眼不见（心不烦）；眼不见为净

examples.en: What does it matter if I use his flat while he’s away? What the eye doesn’t see…!
examples.zh: 我趁他外出时用他的公寓有什么关系呢？反正他又看不见！

senses.def: to make somebody love you

items.idm: with all your heart/your whole heart

senses.def: completely

examples.en: I hope with all my heart that things work out for you.
examples.zh: 我衷心希望你一切顺利。

examples.en: I wish you well with all my heart.
examples.zh: 我衷心祝福你。

senses.def: thinking and behaving like a young person even when you are old

examples.en: My father is 76 but he’s still young at heart.
examples.zh: 我父亲已经76岁了，但他内心仍然年轻。

examples.en: He's over 70, but he's young at heart.
examples.zh: 他 70 多岁了，但内心依然年轻。

senses.def: with a lot of energy and enthusiasm
senses.zh: 精力充沛地；起劲地；充满活力地

examples.en: They threw themselves heart and soul into the project.
examples.zh: 他们全心全意地投入了这个项目。

heart is in the right place: @@@LINK=somebody’s heart is in the right place

senses.def: a sudden serious medical condition in which the flow of blood to the heart is blocked, sometimes causing death

examples.en: She died of a massive heart attack.
examples.zh: 她死于严重的心脏病发作。

examples.en: He suffered a fatal heart attack while cycling.
examples.zh: 他骑自行车时，致命的心脏病发作。

examples.en: The risk of heart attack is more than doubled for women with diabetes.
examples.zh: 患有糖尿病的女性心脏病发作的风险增加一倍以上。

examples.en: You're going to give me a heart attack one of these days!
examples.zh: 总有一天你会让我得心脏病的！

senses.def: a serious medical condition in which the heart does not work correctly
a machine that replaces the functions of the heart and lungs, for example during a medical operation on the heart
senses.zh: 心肺机（手术等时发挥心肺功能）

senses.def: a British song written in 1770, with words by the English actor David Garrick
senses.zh: 橡树之心：1770年创作的一首英国歌曲，由英国演员大卫·加里克（David Garrick）演唱，以颂扬英国水手的素质和成就。它指的是橡木树的木材被用来建造船只的事实。

senses.def: a bud
senses.zh: 棕榈心：棕榈的芽，可作为食物

senses.def: how fast your heart is beating

examples.en: Before the examination, each patient's heart rate was measured.
examples.zh: 检查前，测量了每位患者的心率。

senses.def: causing very sad feelings
senses.zh: 令人悲痛的；使人心碎的

examples.en: a heart-rending story
examples.zh: 令人心痛的故事

senses.def: the process of examining carefully your feelings or reasons for doing something, especially when this is difficult or painful

examples.en: This decision came after a great deal of heart-searching.
examples.zh: 这个决定是经过一番深思熟虑后做出的。

senses.def: causing feelings of great excitement or worry
senses.zh: 使人非常兴奋的；令人十分担忧的

examples.en: For one heart-stopping moment she thought they were too late.
examples.zh: 一时间她十分担心他们已经太晚了。

senses.def: (used especially in newspapers) a famous man, usually an actor or a singer, that a lot of women find attractive
senses.zh: （尤用于报章，常指男性演员或歌手）万人迷，大众情人

examples.en: a Hollywood heart-throb
examples.zh: 好莱坞的万人迷

senses.def: a conversation in which two people talk honestly about their feelings and personal problems

examples.en: to have a heart-to-heart with somebody
examples.zh: 和某人谈心

senses.def: honest and personal

examples.en: a heart-to-heart talk
examples.zh: 坦诚交谈

senses.def: causing feelings of happiness and pleasure

examples.en: a heart-warming story
examples.zh: 感人的故事

examples.en: It’s heart-warming to hear of the success you’ve had with the appeal.
examples.zh: 听到您的上诉取得成功，我感到很温暖。

senses.def: causing very sad feelings
senses.zh: 令人悲痛的；使人心碎的

examples.en: Their stories are heart-wrenching.
examples.zh: 他们的故事令人心痛。

examples.en: a heart-wrenching decision/experience/image
examples.zh: 令人心痛的决定／经历／画面

senses.def: a feeling of being very sad or worried

examples.en: The relationship caused her a great deal of heartache.
examples.zh: 这段恋情使她非常伤心。

examples.en: the heartaches of being a parent
examples.zh: 为人父母的烦恼

senses.def: the movement or sound of the heart as it sends blood around the body

examples.en: a rapid/regular heartbeat
examples.zh: 急速／正常的心跳

examples.en: She was suddenly aware of her racing heartbeat.
examples.zh: 她突然觉察到自己的心跳加剧了。

examples.en: The first track on the album begins with the sound of a heartbeat.
examples.zh: 专辑中的第一首歌是以心跳声开始的。

examples.en: Her heartbeats steadied.
examples.zh: 她的心跳平稳了下来。

senses.def: an important feature of something, that is responsible for making it what it is

examples.en: The candidate said that he understood the heartbeat of the Hispanic community in California.
examples.zh: 这位候选人说他了解加利福尼亚州的拉美裔美国人社区的特点。

senses.def: very close to something

examples.en: Her game is just a heartbeat away from perfection.
examples.zh: 她的比赛距离完美仅一步之遥。

senses.def: very quickly, without thinking about it

examples.en: If I was offered another job, I'd leave in a heartbeat.
examples.zh: 如果能找到另外一份工作，我马上就走。

senses.def: very close to something

examples.en: Her game is just a heartbeat away from perfection.
examples.zh: 她的比赛距离完美仅一步之遥。

senses.def: very quickly, without thinking about it

examples.en: If I was offered another job, I'd leave in a heartbeat.
examples.zh: 如果能找到另外一份工作，我马上就走。

senses.def: a feeling of being very sad

examples.en: They suffered the heartbreak of losing a child through cancer.
examples.zh: 他们因癌症夺去了一个孩子而肝肠寸断。

senses.def: extremely sad

examples.en: a heartbreaking story
examples.zh: 令人心碎的故事

examples.en: It's heartbreaking to see him wasting his life like this.
examples.zh: 看到他如此虚耗人生，真让人伤心。

senses.def: extremely sad because of something that has happened

examples.en: He was heartbroken when she left him.
examples.zh: 她离开了他，他伤心极了。

examples.en: Friends are tonight trying to comfort the heartbroken teenager.
examples.zh: 今晚，朋友们试图安慰这位伤心欲绝的青少年。

senses.def: a pain that feels like something burning in your chest caused by acid
senses.zh: （胃酸逆流引起的）胃灼热，烧心

senses.def: to give somebody hope

examples.en: I was heartened by all the support I received.
examples.zh: 得到这么多的支持，我很受鼓舞。

senses.def: showing strong feelings that are sincere

examples.en: a heartfelt apology/plea/sigh
examples.zh: 真切的道歉／恳求／叹息

examples.en: heartfelt sympathy/thanks
examples.zh: 由衷的同情／感谢

senses.def: the floor at the bottom of a fireplace
senses.zh: 壁炉炉床；壁炉前的地面

examples.en: A log fire roared in the open hearth.
examples.zh: 柴火在敞开着的壁炉里熊熊燃烧。

examples.en: The cat dozed in its favourite spot on the hearth.
examples.zh: 猫躺在壁炉前它最喜欢的地方打盹儿。

senses.def: home and family life

examples.en: a longing for hearth and home
examples.zh: 对温暖家庭的渴望

senses.def: a rug
with obvious pleasure and enthusiasm
senses.zh: 尽情地；开怀地；劲头十足地

examples.en: to laugh/sing/eat heartily
examples.zh: 开怀大笑；放声歌唱；大吃

senses.def: in a way that shows that you feel strongly about something

examples.en: I heartily agree with her on this.
examples.zh: 在这一点上我十分赞同她。

examples.en: The school heartily approves of parental involvement.
examples.zh: 学校衷心赞同家长的参与。

examples.en: His latest book is heartily recommended to all those who enjoy historical mysteries.
examples.zh: 他的最新著作衷心推荐给所有喜欢历史悬疑的人。

senses.def: extremely

examples.en: heartily glad/relieved
examples.zh: 极为高兴；愁云尽扫

senses.def: the act of showing friendly feelings for somebody

examples.en: The guests arrived and shook hands with great heartiness.
examples.zh: 客人们到场并亲切握手。

senses.def: the fact of being loud, cheerful and full of energy
senses.zh: 喧闹而活泼的；吵闹快活且精力充沛的

examples.en: All the laughter and heartiness began to wear me down.
examples.zh: 所有的欢笑和热情开始让我疲惫不堪。

examples.en: The hymn was sung with the usual heartiness.
examples.zh: 赞美诗以平常的热情唱了起来。

senses.def: the quality in a meal of being large and making you feel full; the quality in somebody's appetite
senses.zh: 丰盛：饱餐的质量，使您感到饱；某人食欲大的质量

examples.en: The cuisine combines the finesse of French cooking with the heartiness of German food.
examples.zh: 菜肴融合了法式烹饪的精致与德国美食的丰盛。

senses.def: the quality of showing strong feeling about something
senses.zh: 爽朗：对某事表现出强烈感觉的质量

examples.en: The applause was magnificent in its spontaneity and heartiness.
examples.zh: 热烈的掌声是自发的、热烈的。

senses.def: the central part of a country or an area
senses.zh: （国家或地区的）腹地，中心区域

examples.en: the great Russian heartlands
examples.zh: 广袤的俄罗斯中心地带

senses.def: an area that is important for a particular activity or political party
senses.zh: （活动或政党的）重要场所，核心区域

examples.en: the industrial heartland of Germany
examples.zh: 德国的工业中心区

examples.en: the traditional Tory heartland of Britain’s boardrooms
examples.zh: 保守党的传统领地：英国的各董事会

examples.en: The party has lost seats in its traditional heartland of southern Thailand.
examples.zh: 该党在泰国南部这一传统势力范围已经失去了一些席位。

senses.def: feeling no sympathy for other people

examples.en: The decision does seem a little heartless.
examples.zh: 这个决定的确有点不近人情。

examples.en: What a heartless thing to say!
examples.zh: 这么说话太无情了！

examples.en: Police were quick to condemn this heartless theft.
examples.zh: 警方很快谴责了这起无情的盗窃行为。

examples.en: How can you be so heartless!
examples.zh: 你怎么能这么狠心！

senses.def: in a way that shows no sympathy for other people
behaviour or an attitude that shows no sympathy for other people
senses.zh: 无情：行为或态度不表示对他人的同情残酷

senses.def: extremely unhappy or disappointed

items.idm: pull, tug, etc. at somebody's heartstrings

senses.def: to cause strong feelings of love or sympathy in somebody
senses.zh: 触动某人心弦；引发深切的爱（或同情）

examples.en: It's a sad story that really tugs at your heartstrings.
examples.zh: 这是一个悲伤的故事，感人至深。

senses.def: the hard older inner layers of the wood of a tree
a type of worm
senses.zh: 心丝虫（寄生在狗等心脏中的线虫）；心丝虫病

examples.en: Dogs should be checked annually for heartworm and intestinal parasites.
examples.zh: 每年应检查狗是否有心丝虫和肠道寄生虫。

senses.def: showing friendly feelings for somebody

examples.en: a hearty welcome
examples.zh: 热情的欢迎

examples.en: The Colonel gave me a hearty handshake.
examples.zh: 上校热情地与我握手。

senses.def: loud, cheerful and full of energy
senses.zh: 喧闹而活泼的；吵闹快活且精力充沛的

examples.en: a hearty and boisterous fellow
examples.zh: 活泼爱吵闹的家伙

examples.en: a hearty voice
examples.zh: 响亮的嗓子

examples.en: Her laugh was far too hearty to be genuine.
examples.zh: 她笑得过于热烈，显得不真诚。

senses.def: large; making you feel full

examples.en: a hearty breakfast
examples.zh: 丰盛的早餐

senses.def: large; making you want to eat a lot

examples.en: to have a hearty appetite
examples.zh: 胃口极好

examples.zh: 把烤箱的温度设定为低／高／中挡。

examples.zh: 加入米，然后将温度降低。

examples.zh: 调高温度，把糖变成焦糖。

examples.zh: 工厂里的高温令人无法忍受。

examples.en: They worked all afternoon in the intense heat.
examples.zh: 他们冒着酷热工作了一下午。

examples.en: Return the pan to the heat and stir.
examples.zh: 把锅放回灶上再搅拌。

examples.zh: 把汤小火炖 10 分钟，然后离火。

examples.zh: 把烤盘放在厨灶或炉盘上用中火烤。

senses.def: the process of supplying heat to a room or building; a system used to do this
senses.zh: 供暖；供暖系统；暖气设备

examples.en: The heat wasn't on and the house was freezing.
examples.zh: 暖气没有开，房子里冰冷。

examples.zh: 这房子里装了电热供暖。

examples.en: They are afraid to turn the heat on because it's so expensive.
examples.zh: 由于费用昂贵他们不敢打开供暖器。

examples.zh: 他在激烈争吵时说了许多他后来感到后悔的话。

examples.zh: 联队进了第二个球，这使对手的压力更大了。

examples.zh: 她在预赛中获胜。

examples.zh: 他在预赛中成绩很好，且有望在决赛中也有同样出色的表现。

examples.en: He fell in the first heat.
examples.zh: 他在预赛第一场就败下阵来。

examples.zh: 把油烧热后加入洋葱。

examples.zh: 系统产生的能量足以给几千户人家供暖。

examples.zh: 烤箱加热时，把面团擀好。

examples.zh: 有时热闪电可能会呈现橙色。

examples.zh: 野生小马在荒原上自由漫步。

examples.zh: 沼泽地被石南丛生和沙质灌木丛所取代。

examples.zh: 漫长的夏季热浪导致大部分农作物死亡。

examples.zh: 我用力把箱子弄下楼梯。

examples.zh: 我抓住他的手臂，把他扶起来。

examples.zh: 我仿佛觉得自己已经死了，进了天堂。

examples.zh: 我告诉她爸爸在天堂，和上帝在一起。

examples.zh: 我们的孩子就像是上天的恩赐。

examples.zh: 这可不太像我所想象的那么美妙！

examples.zh: 购物是我的最爱，所以我如同进了天堂。

examples.zh: 一个星期远离办公室真是快活极了。

examples.zh: 那个岛堪称人间天堂。

examples.zh: 塔斯马尼亚是徒步旅行者和露营者的天堂。

examples.zh: 四棵大树参天而立。

examples.zh: 突然天开了，所有人都赶紧寻找掩护。

examples.zh: 那噪声究竟是怎么回事？

examples.zh: 你到底上哪儿去了？

senses.def: extremely happy
senses.zh: 身处七重天；极乐；极为幸福

examples.zh: 他得到擢升，简直乐上天了。

senses.def: seeming to be perfect

examples.zh: 每个人都认为他们的婚姻是天作之合。

senses.def: to do everything you possibly can in order to achieve something

senses.def: to have a strong unpleasant smell
senses.zh: 发出难闻气味；难闻透顶

senses.def: to seem to be very dishonest or morally unacceptable
used to say that you are pleased about something

examples.zh: 谢天谢地，你平安无事！

examples.zh: “这可要谢天谢地！”她宽慰地舒了一口气。

examples.en: Thank heavens I've found my keys.
examples.zh: 谢天谢地，我找到钥匙了。

senses.zh: （用于动词之后，强调希望、愿望等）的确，真

examples.zh: 我真希望你能学会集中注意力！

senses.def: happening unexpectedly and at exactly the right time

senses.def: used to say that you are frightened of the idea of something happening

examples.zh: 千万不要鼓励学生思考！

senses.def: connected with heaven

examples.en: our heavenly Father (= God)

examples.en: the heavenly kingdom
examples.zh: 天国

senses.def: connected with the sky

examples.zh: 天体

senses.def: very pleasant
senses.zh: 十分舒适的；很愉快的；美好的

examples.en: a heavenly morning/feeling
examples.zh: 愉快的早晨／感觉

examples.en: This place is heavenly.
examples.zh: 这个地方好极了。

examples.en: It was a heavenly morning for a ride.
examples.zh: 适合兜风的绝好早晨。

senses.def: towards heaven or the sky

examples.zh: 翻白眼（表示生气或不耐烦）

senses.def: to a great degree; in large amounts

examples.zh: 雨下得很大。

examples.zh: 酗酒

examples.en: to be bleeding heavily
examples.zh: 大量流血

examples.en: to be heavily taxed
examples.zh: 被课以重税

examples.en: heavily armed police (= carrying a lot of weapons)
examples.zh: 全副武装的警察

examples.en: a heavily pregnant woman (= one whose baby is nearly ready to be born)
examples.zh: 临产期孕妇

examples.en: They are both heavily involved in politics.
examples.zh: 他们俩都深深卷入政治中。

examples.en: He relies heavily on his parents.
examples.zh: 他极度依赖父母。

examples.en: She has been heavily criticized in the press.
examples.zh: 她受到报界的猛烈抨击。

examples.zh: 他们的音乐深受重金属和朋克摇滚的影响。

examples.en: Last year the college invested heavily in new technology.
examples.zh: 去年，学院在新技术方面投入巨资。

examples.en: These companies depend heavily on government support.
examples.zh: 这些公司严重依赖政府的支持。

examples.en: The country's economy is heavily dependent on foreign investment and aid.
examples.zh: 该国经济严重依赖外国投资和援助。

examples.en: The book draws heavily on case studies in Ethiopia.
examples.zh: 这本书大量借鉴了埃塞俄比亚的案例研究。

senses.def: with a lot of force or effort

examples.zh: 她重重地摔倒在地。

senses.def: with a large, solid and strong body
slowly and loudly

examples.zh: 她喘着粗气。

examples.en: He was snoring heavily.
examples.zh: 他发着粗重的鼾声。

senses.def: in a slow way that sounds as though you are worried or sad

examples.en: He sighed heavily.
examples.zh: 他长叹了一声。

senses.def: in a way that makes you feel uncomfortable or anxious

examples.en: Silence hung heavily in the room.
examples.zh: 房间里寂若死灰。

examples.en: The burden of guilt weighed heavily on his mind.
examples.zh: 愧疚之情压得他透不过气来。

examples.zh: 满载重物的货车

examples.en: The car was heavily laden on the way home.
examples.zh: 回家的路上，车子装得很重。

senses.def: the fact of weighing a lot and being difficult to lift or move

examples.en: Olivia felt the heaviness of her backpack increase the longer she ran.
examples.zh: 奥莉薇娅感觉跑得越远，背包就越重。

senses.def: the feeling in a part of the body of weighing a lot and being difficult to move

examples.zh: 腿部沉重的感觉

examples.zh: 由于雪下得很大，屋顶看不见。

senses.def: the quality of being large and solid

examples.en: the heaviness of the dark wood panelling
examples.zh: 深色木镶板的沉重

senses.def: the quality in a material of being thick

examples.zh: 缝纫机开始失去抵抗布料重量的力量。

senses.def: the quality of being full of or loaded with something

examples.en: The heaviness of the jungle hung in the air.
examples.zh: 空气中弥漫着丛林的沉重气息。

senses.def: the quality in food or a meal of being large in amount or very solid

examples.en: The salad worked well to combat the heaviness of the meal.
examples.zh: 沙拉很好地缓解了饭菜的沉重感。

senses.def: the fact in a book, programme, style, etc. of being serious and difficult to understand or enjoy

examples.en: Humour is sometimes used to counter the heaviness of death and tragedy.
examples.zh: 幽默有时被用来对抗死亡和悲剧的沉重。

senses.def: the fact of being hot and not having enough fresh air, in a way that is unpleasant

examples.en: I felt the heaviness of the heat as we came out of the Palace.
examples.zh: 当我们走出宫殿时，我感受到了沉重的炎热。

senses.def: the fact in soil of being wet, sticky and difficult to dig or move over
senses.zh: 黏重难挖的；泥泞难行的

examples.en: water trapped by the coldness of ice or the heaviness of mud
examples.zh: 因冰的寒冷或泥土的沉重而滞留的水

senses.def: a very sad feeling
a very sad feeling
a very sad feeling
weighing a lot; difficult to lift or move

examples.en: a heavy weight/load
examples.zh: 重物；重载

examples.en: She was struggling with a heavy suitcase.
examples.zh: 她正费力地拎着一只沉重的手提箱。

examples.en: My brother is much heavier than me.
examples.zh: 我弟弟比我重得多。

examples.en: He tried to push the heavy door open.
examples.zh: 他试图推开那扇沉重的门。

examples.en: How heavy is it (= how much does it weigh)?
examples.zh: 这东西有多重？

examples.en: Her father carried a heavy burden of responsibility.
examples.zh: 她父亲肩负着重大责任。

senses.def: more or worse than usual in amount, degree, etc.
senses.zh: （在数量、程度等方面）超出一般的，比一般严重的

examples.en: the noise of heavy traffic
examples.zh: 繁忙交通的噪声

examples.en: heavy rain/rainfall/snow
examples.zh: 暴雨；强降水；大雪

examples.en: the effects of heavy drinking
examples.zh: 过量饮酒的后果

examples.en: There was heavy fighting in the capital last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚首都发生了激烈战斗。

examples.en: The British suffered heavy losses in the battle.
examples.zh: 英国人在这场战斗中损失惨重。

examples.en: His unit came under heavy fire from insurgents.
examples.zh: 他的部队遭到叛乱分子的猛烈攻击。

examples.en: The penalty for speeding can be a heavy fine.
examples.zh: 超速驾驶可能会被处以高额罚款。

examples.en: She spoke with heavy irony.
examples.zh: 她的话充满了讽刺。

senses.group: worse than usual 比一般严重

senses.def: doing the thing mentioned more, or more deeply, than usual
senses.zh: （做某事）过量的，超出一般的，过度的

examples.en: a heavy drinker/smoker
examples.zh: 酒瘾／烟瘾大的人

examples.en: a heavy sleeper
examples.zh: 睡得很死的人

senses.group: drinker/smoker/sleeper 喝酒／抽烟／睡觉的人

senses.def: large and solid

examples.en: big, dark rooms full of heavy furniture
examples.zh: 装满厚实家具、又大又暗的房间

examples.en: He was tall and strong, with heavy features.
examples.zh: 他长得高大壮实，浓眉大眼。

senses.def: thick

examples.en: heavy curtains
examples.zh: 厚窗帘

examples.en: a heavy coat
examples.zh: 厚外套

senses.def: full of or loaded with something

examples.en: trees heavy with apples
examples.zh: 挂满苹果的树

examples.en: The air was heavy with the scent of flowers.
examples.zh: 空气中弥漫着浓郁的花香。

examples.en: His voice was heavy with sarcasm.
examples.zh: 他的语气带着十足的讽刺意味。

examples.en: She was heavy with child (= pregnant).
examples.zh: 她怀孕了。

senses.def: large and powerful

examples.en: a wide range of engines and heavy machinery/equipment
examples.zh: 各种各样的发动机和重型机械／设备

examples.en: heavy lorries/trucks
examples.zh: 重型卡车

senses.def: involving a lot of work or activity; very busy
senses.zh: 工作（或活动）多的；繁忙的

examples.en: a heavy schedule
examples.zh: 安排很紧的日程

examples.en: She'd had a heavy day.
examples.zh: 她忙了一天。

senses.def: hard, especially because it requires a lot of physical strength

examples.en: heavy lifting
examples.zh: 搬抬重物

examples.en: A gardener comes in to do the heavy work for me.
examples.zh: 一个园丁来为我干重活。

senses.def: falling or hitting something with a lot of force

examples.en: a heavy fall/blow
examples.zh: 重重的跌落／一击

senses.def: large in amount or very solid

examples.en: a heavy lunch/dinner/meal
examples.zh: 丰盛的午餐／正餐／一餐

examples.en: Avoid heavy foods that are difficult to digest.
examples.zh: 避免吃难消化的油腻食物。

senses.def: carrying heavy weapons

examples.en: the heavy infantry/cavalry
examples.zh: 重步兵；重骑兵

senses.def: loud and deep

examples.en: heavy breathing
examples.zh: 粗重的呼吸声

examples.en: a heavy groan/sigh
examples.zh: 深沉的呻吟／叹息

senses.def: using a lot of something

examples.zh: 老旧的汽车耗油多。

examples.en: Don't go so heavy on the garlic.
examples.zh: 别用这么多蒜。

senses.def: serious; difficult to understand or enjoy

examples.en: We found the play very heavy.
examples.zh: 我们觉得这部戏很艰涩。

examples.en: The discussion got a little heavy.
examples.zh: 讨论变得有点严肃。

senses.def: dangerous because of big waves, etc.

examples.en: strong winds and heavy seas
examples.zh: 风急浪高

examples.en: The heavy Atlantic swells pounded the beach.
examples.zh: 大西洋的巨浪拍打着海滩。

senses.def: hot and without enough fresh air, in a way that feels unpleasant

examples.zh: 天气很闷热，我觉得暴风雨要来了。

senses.def: wet, sticky and difficult to dig or to move over
senses.zh: 黏重难挖的；泥泞难行的

senses.def: very strict and severe

examples.zh: 别对她这么苛刻，这不是她的过错。

senses.def: to become very serious, because strong feelings are involved

examples.zh: 他们开始对我大喊大叫。情势变得很激烈。

examples.en: Then he got heavy and tried to kiss me.
examples.zh: 然后他变得很重并试图吻我。

examples.en: Things were starting to get a bit heavy so I decided to leave.
examples.zh: 事情开始变得有点沉重，所以我决定离开。

senses.zh: 有本难念的经；有苦难要忍受

examples.en: We all have our crosses to bear.
examples.zh: 家家有本难念的经。

senses.def: used to describe somebody/something that is difficult to deal with or understand
senses.zh: 难以打交道；难以处理；难以理解

examples.en: She's a bit heavy going.
examples.zh: 她有点难缠。

examples.en: I found the course rather heavy going.
examples.zh: 我觉得这门课相当难。

senses.def: a way of doing something or of treating people that is much stronger and less sensitive than it needs to be
senses.zh: 严厉手段；粗暴方式；暴虐方式

examples.en: the heavy hand of management

senses.def: a very sad feeling

examples.en: I returned home with a heavy heart.
examples.zh: 我怀着沉重的心情回到家。

senses.def: a group of strong, often violent people employed to do something such as protect somebody

examples.zh: 这个国家的人们学习语言的天气如此艰难。

(1922-2012) a US writer and journalist. She became editor of the magazine Cosmopolitan
senses.zh: 海伦·古利·布朗（Helen Gurley Brown）：（ 1922-2012年）美国作家和记者。她于1965年成为《国际都市》杂志的编辑，并将其从一本普通杂志改为一本针对女性的杂志，并刊登了有关“新女性”，爱情和性的文章。尽管她为此受到批评，但国际化大受欢迎，其他女性杂志也将其复制。布朗还写了《性与单身女孩》（Sex and the Single Girl，1962年）和《一切都拥有》（Having It All，1982年）。

senses.def: (1880-1968) a US author and public speaker who became blind and deaf
senses.zh: 海伦·凯勒（1880–1968）美国作家和公共演说家。19 个月大时失明、失聪。1887 年开始跟随安妮·沙利文学习读、写、使用手语和说话。1904 年获拉德克利夫学院学位，之后一直鼓励像她一样的残障人士克服困难。作品包括《我的生活》（1902）和《走出黑暗》（1913）。1912 年加入世界产业工人联盟，也是美国公民自由联盟的首批成员之一。关于她生平的戏剧《奇迹缔造者》曾三次被拍成电影。

senses.def: Moody
(1906-98) a US tennis player in the 1920s and 1930s who was the best woman player of her time. Her popular name was 'Queen Helen'. She won eight Wimbledon
senses.zh: 海伦·威尔斯·穆迪（Helen Wills Moody）：（1906-98）1920年代和1930年代的美国网球运动员，是当时最好的女子网球运动员。她的俗名是“海伦皇后”。她赢得了八项温网比赛（1927-30、1932-3、1935和1938年），创下了52年的纪录。她总共获得31项比赛胜利，其中包括7次美国公开赛和4次法国公开赛。她还在1924年奥运会上获得了金牌。在1929年结婚之前，她曾饰演海伦·威尔斯（Helen Wills）。1959年，她入选国际网球名人堂。

senses.def: (1871-1965) a US businesswoman
senses.zh: 海伦娜·鲁宾斯坦（Helena Rubinstein）：（1871-1965）是一位美国女商人，出生于波兰，创立了以她的名字命名的著名化妆品公司。她于1902年在澳大利亚开始业务，后来在伦敦，巴黎和纽约开设了美容院。第一次世界大战后，她的业务发展成为一家大型国际公司。她创立了海伦娜·鲁宾斯坦基金会（Helena Rubinstein Foundation），该基金会为教育项目（尤其是纽约的妇女和儿童）捐款。

examples.en: There was a loud bang and then all hell broke loose.
examples.zh: 一声巨响之后顿时一片混乱。

items.idm: beat/kick (the) hell out of somebody/something | knock hell out of somebody/something

senses.def: to hit somebody/something very hard

examples.en: He was a dirty player and loved to kick hell out of the opposition.
examples.zh: 他是个不讲体育道德的球员，喜欢猛力冲撞对方。

items.idm: bug the hell/crap/shit out of somebody

senses.def: to annoy somebody very much

examples.en: The song just bugs the hell out of me.
examples.zh: 这首歌真他妈的烦死我了。

senses.def: to be punished or spoken to angrily about something

examples.en: If your dad finds out you'll really catch hell!
examples.zh: 如果你爸爸知道了，你就真的要下地狱了！

senses.def: a lot of trouble

examples.en: There'll be hell to pay when he finds out.
examples.zh: 一旦他发现了真相，那麻烦就大了。

senses.def: just for fun; for no real reason
senses.zh: 只是闹着玩；没有真正动机

examples.en: They stole the car just for the hell of it.
examples.zh: 他们偷这辆汽车只是为了寻求刺激。

senses.def: used to describe a very unpleasant person or thing; the worst that you can imagine

examples.en: They are the neighbours from hell.
examples.zh: 这些邻居太可恶了。

senses.def: to leave a place very quickly

examples.en: Let's get the hell out of here.
examples.zh: 我们马上离开这里吧。

senses.def: to make life unpleasant for somebody
senses.zh: 让某人受罪；使某人不好受

examples.en: He used to give his mother hell when he was a teenager.
examples.zh: 他十几岁时常常给他母亲惹麻烦。

examples.en: My new shoes are giving me hell (= are hurting me).
examples.zh: 我的新鞋磨得我脚疼死了。

senses.def: to shout at or speak angrily to somebody

examples.en: Dad will give us hell when he sees that mess.
examples.zh: 爸爸要是看见那乱糟糟的样子会骂我们的。

items.idm: go to hell in a handbasket

senses.def: to get into a very bad state

examples.en: This firm's gone to hell in a handbasket since the new management took over.
examples.zh: 自从新管理层接手后，这家公司就陷入了困境。

senses.def: as quickly as possible

examples.en: to ride hell for leather
examples.zh: 拼命快骑

items.idm: hell hath no fury (like a woman scorned)

senses.def: used to refer to somebody, usually a woman, who has reacted very angrily to something, especially the fact that her husband or partner has been unfaithful
senses.zh: （尤指女人因丈夫或情人不忠而）大发雷霆；醋劲大发

items.idm: a/one hell of a… | a/one helluva…

senses.def: used to give emphasis to what a person is saying

examples.en: The firm was in a hell of a mess when he took over.
examples.zh: 他接手时公司一团糟。

examples.en: This holiday is going to cost a hell of a lot of money.
examples.zh: 这个假期要花很多钱。

examples.en: It must have been one hell of a party.
examples.zh: 那肯定是一次很棒的聚会。

examples.en: It’s taken him a hell of a long time to get here.
examples.zh: 他花了很长时间才到达这里。

examples.en: That's one helluva big house you've got.
examples.zh: 你的房子真是大极了。

senses.def: despite any difficulties

examples.en: I was determined to go, come hell or high water.
examples.zh: 我决心要去，不管有什么困难。

senses.def: used to express anger or surprise

examples.en: Hell’s teeth, I promised I’d be back by two.
examples.zh: 天哪，我答应过两点钟就回来。

items.idm: like a bat out of hell

senses.def: very fast
senses.zh: 闪电般；飞快地；一溜烟地

examples.en: She was driving like a bat out of hell.
examples.zh: 她开车就像一只从地狱里出来的蝙蝠。

senses.def: used for emphasis

examples.en: She worked like hell for her exams.
examples.zh: 她为了考试而拼命复习。

examples.en: My broken finger hurt like hell.
examples.zh: 我骨折的手指痛得要命。

senses.def: used when you are refusing permission or saying that something is not true

examples.en: ‘I'm coming with you.’ ‘Like hell you are (= you certainly are not).’
examples.zh: “我要和你一起去。”“鬼才信呢。”

items.idm: not have/stand a cat in hell’s chance (of doing something)

senses.def: to have no chance at all

items.idm: not have a hope (in hell) (of doing something)

senses.def: to have no chance at all

examples.en: She doesn't have a hope of winning.
examples.zh: 她根本无望取胜。

examples.en: You don't have a hope in hell of finding a job.
examples.zh: 你找工作，门儿都没有。

items.idm: not have a snowball’s chance in hell

senses.def: to have no chance at all

examples.en: There isn't a snowball's chance in hell that I'll wear that thing!
examples.zh: 我根本不可能穿那玩意儿！

senses.def: to affect something/somebody badly
senses.zh: 对…造成严重影响；严重损害…

examples.en: Driving on these rough roads has played hell with my tyres.
examples.zh: 在这些崎岖不平的道路上行驶对我的轮胎造成了很大的伤害。

senses.def: to protest angrily, especially in a way that causes trouble for somebody
senses.zh: 愤怒抗议；（尤指）大吵大闹

items.idm: the road to hell is paved with good intentions

senses.def: it is not enough to intend to do good things; you must actually do them
senses.zh: 黄泉路上徒有好意多；光说不练是不够的

items.idm: scare, annoy, etc. the hell out of somebody

senses.def: to frighten, annoy, etc. somebody very much
senses.zh: 使某人十分恐惧（或恼怒等）

senses.def: used to say that somebody has been through a difficult situation

examples.en: We'd been to hell and back together and we were still good friends.
examples.zh: 我们曾经患难与共，现在依然是好友。

senses.def: used to express anger or dislike and to say that you no longer care about somebody/something and will take no notice of them
senses.zh: （表示愤怒或厌恶，不再在乎）见鬼去吧，随便

examples.en: ‘To hell with him,’ she thought, ‘I'm leaving.’
examples.zh: “让他见鬼去吧，”她想，“我走了。”

senses.def: as quickly as possible

examples.en: to ride hell for leather
examples.zh: 拼命快骑

senses.def: used to refer to somebody, usually a woman, who has reacted very angrily to something, especially the fact that her husband or partner has been unfaithful

senses.def: determined to do something even though the results may be bad

examples.en: He seems hell-bent on drinking himself to death.
examples.zh: 他一个劲地喝酒，似乎命都不要了。

senses.def: extremely difficult or bad

examples.en: hellacious traffic
examples.zh: 糟糕透顶的交通

examples.en: a hellacious storm
examples.zh: 可怕的暴风雨

a person from Greece, especially ancient Greece
of or connected with ancient or modern Greece
of or connected with the Greek history, language and culture of the 4th–1st centuries BC
senses.zh: （公元前 4 至前 1 世纪）希腊化（时期）的

senses.def: the fires that are believed by some religious people to burn in hell, where bad people go to be punished after they die
a very unpleasant place

examples.en: The town is an industrial hellhole.
examples.zh: 这个小镇是一个工业地狱。

senses.def: a badly behaved child who annoys other people
extremely unpleasant

examples.en: His school days were hellish.
examples.zh: 他的学生时代苦不堪言。

examples.en: We’ve had a hellish time lately.
examples.zh: 我们最近度过了一段地狱般的时光。

senses.def: used as a greeting
senses.zh: （用于问候、发电邮、接电话或引起注意）哈啰，喂，你好

examples.en: Hello John, how are you?
examples.zh: 哈啰，约翰，你好吗？

examples.en: Hello, is there anybody there?
examples.zh: 喂，那里有人吗？

examples.en: Say hello to Liz for me.
examples.zh: 替我向利兹问好。

examples.en: They exchanged hellos (= said hello to each other) and forced smiles.
examples.zh: 他们相互打个招呼，勉强笑笑。

senses.def: used to show that you are surprised by something

examples.en: Hello, hello, what's going on here?
examples.zh: 嘿，嘿，这是在干吗？

senses.def: used to show that you think somebody has said something stupid or is not paying attention
senses.zh: （认为别人说了蠢话或分心）喂，嘿

examples.en: Hello? You didn't really mean that, did you?
examples.zh: 嘿？你不会真是那个意思吧？

examples.en: I'm like, ‘Hello! Did you even listen?’
examples.zh: 我说：“嘿！你到底有没有听我说话？”

senses.def: a popular magazine published each week in Britain which contains photographs of and articles about famous people, and is known for saying only good things about them. It was first published in Britain in 1988 as a British version of the Spanish magazine ¡Hola!
senses.zh: 你好！：每周在英国发行的一本流行杂志，其中载有名人的照片和文章，并因只说出好话而闻名。它于1988年在英国首次发行，当时是西班牙杂志《 Hola！》的英文版。你好！网站每天都会更新新闻。

senses.def: a person who causes trouble by behaving loudly and often violently, especially when they have drunk too much alcohol
senses.zh: 吵闹捣蛋的人；胡打瞎闹的人；（尤指）耍酒疯的人

senses.def: a member of a group of people, usually men, who ride powerful motorcycles, wear leather clothes and used to be known for their wild and violent behaviour
senses.zh: 地狱天使（穿皮衣、骑大马力摩托车横冲直撞，通常为男性）

senses.def: used to express anger or surprise

examples.en: Hell’s teeth, I promised I’d be back by two.
examples.zh: 天哪，我答应过两点钟就回来。

in charge of an organization, project, etc.

examples.en: Sarah is at the helm.
examples.zh: 莎拉是掌舵人。

senses.def: controlling the direction in which a boat or ship moves

examples.en: The skipper remained at the helm all night.
examples.zh: 船长整晚都在掌舵。

senses.def: to take charge of an organization, project, etc.

examples.en: Lucenti took over the helm when the previous director retired.
examples.zh: 前任董事退休后，卢森蒂接任掌舵人。

senses.def: to begin controlling the direction in which a boat or ship moves
to manage an organization

examples.en: He was called in to helm a bureau in charge of resources allocation at district level.
examples.zh: 他奉召去主管一个局，负责地区资源分配。

senses.def: to direct a film or television programme

examples.en: She has already helmed a couple of fantastic short films.
examples.zh: 她已经执导过几部精彩的短片。

senses.def: to control the direction of a boat or ship

examples.en: The key to becoming a good skipper is being able to sail and helm a boat.
examples.zh: 成为一名优秀船长的关键是能够航行和掌舵。

senses.def: in charge of an organization, project, etc.

examples.en: Sarah is at the helm.
examples.zh: 莎拉是掌舵人。

senses.def: controlling the direction in which a boat or ship moves

examples.en: The skipper remained at the helm all night.
examples.zh: 船长整晚都在掌舵。

senses.def: to take charge of an organization, project, etc.

examples.en: Lucenti took over the helm when the previous director retired.
examples.zh: 前任董事退休后，卢森蒂接任掌舵人。

senses.def: to begin controlling the direction in which a boat or ship moves
a type of hard hat that protects the head, worn, for example, by a police officer, a soldier or a person riding a bike or motorbike or playing some sports

examples.en: Police in riot helmets lined the streets.
examples.zh: 戴着防暴头盔的警察站在沿街两边。

examples.en: A protective helmet should be worn at all times.
examples.zh: 随时都应该头戴防护帽。

examples.en: Cycle helmets dramatically reduce the risk and severity of head injuries.
examples.zh: 自行车头盔可显着降低头部受伤的风险和严重程度。

senses.def: wearing a helmet

examples.en: helmeted firefighters
examples.zh: 戴头盔的消防员

senses.def: a person who controls the direction in which a boat or ship moves
a woman who controls the direction in which a boat or ship moves
to make it easier or possible for somebody to do something by doing something for them or by giving them something that they need

examples.en: What can I do to help?
examples.zh: 我能提供什么帮助吗？

examples.en: I was only trying to help!
examples.zh: 我不过是想尽量帮帮忙！

examples.en: He always helps with the housework.
examples.zh: 他总是帮着做家务。

examples.en: They are trying their best to do a good job and help others.
examples.zh: 他们正在尽力做好工作，帮助别人。

examples.en: Jo will help us with some of the organization.
examples.zh: 乔将帮我们做一部分组织工作。

examples.en: Following these steps will help in protecting our environment.
examples.zh: 遵循这些步骤将有助于保护我们的环境。

examples.en: Come and help me lift this box.
examples.zh: 来帮我抬这个箱子。

examples.en: This charity aims to help people to help themselves.
examples.zh: 这个慈善机构的宗旨是帮助人们自力更生。

examples.en: The college's aim is to help students achieve their aspirations.
examples.zh: 大学的目标是帮助学生实现他们的抱负。

examples.en: She helped organize the party.
examples.zh: 她协助筹备了晚会。

examples.en: Some history may help to explain why this is.
examples.zh: 一些历史可能有助于解释为什么会这样。

senses.group: make easier/better 使更容易／更好

senses.def: to improve a situation; to make it easier for something to happen

examples.en: The support of our families has helped enormously.
examples.zh: 家庭的支持给了我们巨大的帮助。

examples.en: It helped being able to talk about it.
examples.zh: 能谈谈这件事很有好处。

examples.en: It certainly helped that her father is a duke!
examples.zh: 她父亲是个公爵，这对她确有帮助！

examples.en: The money raised will help towards (= partly pay for) the cost of organizing the championships.
examples.zh: 募集的资金将用于支付筹办锦标赛的部分费用。

examples.en: It doesn't really help matters knowing that everyone is talking about us.
examples.zh: 知道大家都在议论我们也于事无补。

examples.en: This should help to reduce the pain.
examples.zh: 这个应有助于减轻痛楚。

examples.en: We need new measures to help fight terrorism.
examples.zh: 我们需要采取新措施来助力打击恐怖主义。

senses.group: make easier/better 使更容易／更好

senses.def: to help somebody move or do some other action by letting them lean on you, guiding them, etc.

examples.en: She helped him to his feet.
examples.zh: 她扶他站了起来。

examples.en: We were helped ashore by local people.
examples.zh: 我们被当地人救上岸。

senses.group: somebody to move 移动某人

senses.def: to give yourself/somebody food, drinks, etc.

examples.en: If you want another drink, just help yourself.
examples.zh: 你要是想再喝一杯就请自便。

examples.en: Can I help you to some more salad?
examples.zh: 我再给你来点色拉好吗？

senses.def: to take something without permission

examples.en: He'd been helping himself to the money in the cash register.
examples.zh: 他一直在偷现金出纳机中的钱。

senses.def: used to say that it is impossible to prevent or avoid something
senses.zh: 某人忍不住（或无法抑制）做某事；不可能避免某事

examples.en: I can't help thinking he knows more than he has told us.
examples.zh: 我总觉得他没把他知道的事全告诉我们。

examples.en: He can’t help being shy.
examples.zh: 他忍不住害羞。

examples.en: She couldn't help but wonder what he was thinking.
examples.zh: 她不禁琢磨着他在想些什么。

examples.en: It couldn't be helped (= there was no way of avoiding it and we must accept it).
examples.zh: 这是不可避免的。

examples.en: He never does more work than he can help (= he does as little as possible).
examples.zh: 他工作能少做就尽量少做。

examples.en: I always end up having an argument with her, I don't know why, I just can't help it.
examples.zh: 我总是和她闹得不欢而散，我不知道为什么，我就是忍不住。

examples.en: I couldn't help it if the bus was late (= it wasn't my fault).
examples.zh: 公共汽车晚点了，我没办法。

examples.en: She burst out laughing—she couldn't help herself (= couldn't stop herself).
examples.zh: 她突然大笑起来，不能自已。

examples.en: She won’t be invited again, not if I can help it (= if I can do anything to prevent it).
examples.zh: 她不会再被邀请，如果我能帮助它（=如果我能做任何事情来阻止它）。

senses.def: to help somebody
used to say that you are afraid somebody will be in danger or that something bad will happen to them
senses.zh: （表示担心某人将有危险或有难）

examples.en: God help us if this doesn't work.
examples.zh: 如果这个行不通，那就要靠上帝了。

senses.def: used to swear that what you are saying is true, especially in a court of law
senses.zh: 我发誓，上帝作证（尤用于法庭）

senses.def: the act of helping somebody to do something

examples.en: Thank you for all your help.
examples.zh: 感谢你的一切帮助。

examples.en: to ask/call/appeal for help
examples.zh: 寻求帮助

examples.en: The offer of help came too late.
examples.zh: 提供帮助来得太晚了。

examples.en: Do you need any help with that?
examples.zh: 这事你需要帮忙吗？

examples.en: Can I be of any help to you?
examples.zh: 我能帮你什么忙吗？

examples.en: With help from a parent, a child can do simple cooking.
examples.zh: 在家长的帮助下，孩子可以做一些简单的饭菜。

examples.en: She recovered with the help of her family and friends.
examples.zh: 她在家人和朋友的帮助下恢复了健康。

examples.en: He attended university with the help of a scholarship.
examples.zh: 他在奖学金的帮助下上了大学。

examples.en: None of this would have been possible without their help.
examples.zh: 如果没有他们的协助，这事没有一样能办成。

examples.en: They have at last decided to enlist the help of experts.
examples.zh: 他们最终决定请专家帮忙。

examples.en: They can usually manage by themselves, but occasionally need outside help.
examples.zh: 他们一般能够自己应付，偶尔也需要外援。

senses.group: making easier/better 使较容易／较好

senses.def: the act of helping somebody who is in danger

examples.en: Quick, get help!
examples.zh: 快，找人援救！

examples.en: She screamed for help.
examples.zh: 她高声喊救命。

examples.en: I heard a cry for help.
examples.zh: 我听到有人呼救。

senses.group: for somebody in danger 对处于危险中的人

senses.def: advice, money, etc. that is given to somebody in order to solve their problems
senses.zh: 有助益的东西（如忠告、钱等）

examples.en: professional/medical/financial help
examples.zh: 专业／医疗／财政援助

examples.en: I decided to seek legal help.
examples.zh: 我决定寻求法律帮助。

examples.en: The organization offers practical help in dealing with paperwork.
examples.zh: 这个机构提供文件处理方面的实际帮助。

examples.en: You should qualify for help with the costs of running a car.
examples.zh: 你应该符合条件获取养车补助。

examples.en: The charity provides emergency help for refugees.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构为难民提供紧急帮助。

examples.en: Get help from someone who understands the legal side.
examples.zh: 向了解法律方面的人寻求帮助。

senses.def: a function on a computer, phone, etc. that provides information on how to use the computer, phone, etc.

examples.en: The online help is very good.
examples.zh: 线上帮助功能很有用。

examples.en: a help file/page/menu/screen
examples.zh: 帮助文件／页面／菜单／屏幕

senses.group: on a computer/phone, etc. 计算机、电话等

senses.def: the fact of being useful

examples.en: The map wasn't much help.
examples.zh: 这张地图没多大用处。

examples.en: Was the information I gave you any help?
examples.zh: 我给你的信息对你有帮助吗？

examples.en: Just shouting at him isn't going to be a lot of help.
examples.zh: 光是对他大喊大叫不会有多大用处。

examples.en: I managed to understand it with the help of a dictionary.
examples.zh: 我借助词典查清楚了它的意思。

examples.en: The course they sent me on was of no help whatsoever!
examples.zh: 他们给我提供的课程毫无帮助！

senses.def: a person or thing that helps somebody

examples.en: She was more of a hindrance than a help.
examples.zh: 她非但没帮上忙，反而碍事。

examples.en: It's a great help having you around.
examples.zh: 有你在真是帮了大忙。

examples.en: Your advice was a big help.
examples.zh: 你的建议很有帮助。

examples.en: She's been a big help to her father.
examples.zh: 她一直是父亲的好帮手。

examples.en: You're a great help, I must say!
examples.zh: 我得说，你可没少帮忙！

senses.def: the person or people employed by somebody to clean their house, etc.

examples.en: The help cleans/clean the house every Wednesday.
examples.zh: 每个星期三帮忙打扫/打扫房子。

senses.def: it is not possible to avoid doing something that may harm somebody in some way

examples.en: There's no help for it. We shall have to call the police.
examples.zh: 没法子了。我们只得叫警察了。

senses.def: used to call for help because you are in a dangerous situation
senses.zh: 救命（遇到危险时用于呼救）

examples.en: Help, I'm stuck!
examples.zh: 救命，我被卡住了！

note.en: Some people find this use of God offensive.
note.zh: 有人认为此处用 God 含冒犯意。

items.idm: somebody cannot help (doing) something | somebody cannot help but do something

senses.def: used to say that it is impossible to prevent or avoid something
senses.zh: 某人忍不住（或无法抑制）做某事；不可能避免某事

examples.en: I can't help thinking he knows more than he has told us.
examples.zh: 我总觉得他没把他知道的事全告诉我们。

examples.en: He can’t help being shy.
examples.zh: 他忍不住害羞。

examples.en: She couldn't help but wonder what he was thinking.
examples.zh: 她不禁琢磨着他在想些什么。

examples.en: It couldn't be helped (= there was no way of avoiding it and we must accept it).

examples.en: He never does more work than he can help (= he does as little as possible).
examples.zh: 他工作能少做就尽量少做。

examples.en: I always end up having an argument with her, I don't know why, I just can't help it.
examples.zh: 我总是和她闹得不欢而散，我不知道为什么，我就是忍不住。

examples.en: I couldn't help it if the bus was late (= it wasn't my fault).

examples.en: She burst out laughing—she couldn't help herself (= couldn't stop herself).
examples.zh: 她突然大笑起来，不能自已。

examples.en: She won’t be invited again, not if I can help it (= if I can do anything to prevent it).
examples.zh: 她不会再被邀请，如果我能帮助它（=如果我能做任何事情来阻止它）。

senses.def: a British charity that provided help for old people both in Britain and abroad. It was established in 1961 and worked to reduce poverty, loneliness
senses.zh: 帮助老年人：一家英国慈善机构，为英国和国外的老年人提供帮助。它成立于1961年，致力于减少与老年人有关的贫困，孤独感和偏见，并增进对老年人的了解以及老年人的护理标准。2009年，它与“关注年龄”组织一起成立了名为“年龄英国”的新慈善机构。

examples.zh: 他动员了一批自愿帮忙的人。

examples.en: We rely on volunteer helpers.
examples.zh: 我们依靠志愿者帮助者。

examples.zh: 有用的提示／指点／建议／评论

examples.en: Sorry I can't be more helpful.
examples.zh: 对不起，我帮不上更多的忙。

examples.en: This approach may be helpful for people with very severe symptoms.
examples.zh: 这种方法可能对症状非常严重的人有帮助。

examples.en: You may find it helpful to read this before making any decisions.
examples.zh: 先看看这个再下决定或许有帮助。

examples.zh: 获得更详细的信息会很有帮助。

examples.en: It would be helpful for me to see the damage for myself.

examples.en: The staff couldn't have been more helpful.

examples.en: She’s one of the most helpful people I know.
examples.zh: 她是我认识的最乐于助人的人之一。

examples.zh: 他们无助地看着自己的房子被大火吞噬。

examples.en: Then he became aware of Carter’s two henchmen on either side of him.

having eleven syllables

senses.zh: （史前的）围成一圈的直立木（或石）结构

senses.def: a town on the Thames
senses.zh: 亨利（Henley）：牛津郡泰晤士河畔的一个小镇。它以在Henley帆船赛期间在那里举行的划船比赛而闻名，该比赛始于1839年，每年7月进行5天。这是一项时尚活动，许多有名望的人都参加，并且是每年夏天举行的体育和文化活动之一，合称为季节。

senses.def: a red-brown dye
senses.zh: 散沫花染剂（棕红色，尤用于染发和涂饰皮肤）

senses.def: often criticized and told what to do by somebody else, usually a wife or female partner, and too weak to disagree
a first name for girls
a unit for measuring the inductance
a first name for boys
(1813-98) an English engineer and inventor
senses.zh: 亨利·贝塞默（Henry Bessemer）：（1813-98）是一位英国工程师和发明家，最著名的发明是贝塞默方法，该方法是通过将空气吹入熔融铁中以除去其中的其他物质来制造钢。1879年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1934-2011) a popular English boxer
senses.zh: 亨利·库珀（Henry Cooper）：（1934-2011）一位受欢迎的英国拳击手，曾两次获得英国重量级冠军（1959-69和1970-71）。他因击倒了穆罕默德·阿里（Muhammad Ali）而在英国被人铭记，尽管他输掉了比赛并从未成为世界冠军。他在2000年被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1817-62) a US writer and poet who believed strongly in the rights of individual people. As an experiment he lived a simple life for two years (1845-7) in a small wooden house near Concord
senses.zh: 亨利·戴维·梭罗（Henry David Thoreau）：（1817-62）美国作家和诗人，他坚信个人的权利。作为一项实验，他在马萨诸塞州康科德附近的一间小木屋里过着简单的生活，生活了两年（1845-7），然后在瓦尔登（Walden）或《树林中的生活》（Life in the Woods，1854）中写下了这一简单的生活。他还撰写了《公民抗命》（1849年），该著作影响了圣雄甘地和马丁·路德·金等领导人以和平方式进行抗议。

senses.def: (1707-54) an English writer. In the 1730s he wrote political plays that made fun of the government, until the government became more strict about censoring
senses.zh: 亨利·菲尔丁（Henry Fielding）：（1707-54）英国作家。在1730年代，他写了一些政治剧本来嘲笑政府，直到政府对审查剧本（包括删除或更改令人反感的部分）变得更加严格为止。然后，他开始写小说。他最著名的作品汤姆·琼斯（Tom Jones）有着漫长而复杂的故事，展现了当时英国社会的清晰鲜明的画面。它对英语小说的发展产生了重要影响。菲尔丁于1748年成为和平大法官，并负责组建“弓街赛跑者”。

senses.def: (1905-82) a US actor who often played calm, honest characters. He was a Hollywood
senses.zh: 亨利·方达（Henry Fonda）：（1905-82）美国演员，经常饰演镇定，诚实的角色。他在40余年的电影中担任好莱坞明星已有40余年，在他的最后一部电影《金塘》（1981年）中仅获奥斯卡奖。他的其他成就包括《愤怒的葡萄》（1940年）和《十二个愤怒的人》（1957年）。他是演员Jane Fonda和Peter Fonda的父亲。

senses.def: (1863-1947) the American who created the Ford car and changed the motor industry by introducing new ways of making cars in great numbers. He began the Ford Motor Company
senses.zh: 亨利·福特（Henry Ford）：（1863-1947）美国人，他创造了福特汽车，并通过引入大量制造汽车的新方式改变了汽车工业。他于1903年成立福特汽车公司，五年后生产了第一台T型车。他变得非常富有和成功，并建立了国际福特基金会。

senses.def: (c. 1550-c. 1611) an English explorer
senses.zh: 亨利·哈德森（Henry Hudson）：（约1550年至1611年）是一位英国探险家，他在1609–10年寻找西北通道时，发现了现在所谓的哈德逊河和哈德逊湾，这是北部非常大的海-加拿大东部通过哈得逊海峡与北大西洋相连。1611年，他的一些人在那里对他不利，并将他和12岁的儿子放进小船。他们再也见不到。

senses.def: (1068-1135) king of England (1100-35). The youngest of three sons of William I
senses.zh: 亨利一世（1068–1135）英格兰国王（1100–1135 在位）。威廉一世幼子，因大哥威廉二世去世，二哥罗伯特参加十字军东征，继承王位。改革国家行政系统，建立法官全国巡回裁决案件的制度。

senses.def: (1133-89) king of England (1154-89). He was the grandson
senses.zh: 亨利二世（1133–1189）英格兰国王（1154–1189 在位）。亨利一世的外孙，英王斯蒂芬死后继位，金雀花王朝的第一位国王。削弱贵族势力，加强国家权力。试图削弱教会，与坎特伯雷大主教托马斯·贝克特发生冲突，致贝克特被谋杀。在位期间，英格兰确立了对爱尔兰的控制。亨利还推行各种司法制度，这可以被视为普通法的开端。

senses.def: (1207-72) king of England (1216-72) and the son of King John
senses.zh: 亨利三世（1207–1272）英格兰国王（1216–1272 在位），约翰王之子。重用外国人，财政决策失误，遭贵族不满。1264 年，西蒙·德·蒙特福特发动贵族叛乱，打败并囚禁了亨利。1265 年，亨利的儿子（即后来的爱德华一世）领兵击败叛军，帮助亨利夺回权力。

senses.def: (1838-1905) an English actor who became famous in the late 19th century for his theatre performances of Shakespeare
senses.zh: 亨利·欧文（Henry Irving）：（1838-1905）英国演员，由于莎士比亚戏剧的戏剧表演而在19世纪后期成名。他经常和埃伦·特里（Ellen Terry）一起表演。1895年，他被任命为骑士，成为首位获得这一荣誉的演员。

senses.def: (1366-1413) king of England (1399-1413) after his cousin Richard II
senses.zh: 亨利四世（1366–1413）英格兰国王（1399–1413 在位），在其堂兄理查二世之后即位。本名亨利·博林布鲁克，冈特的约翰之子，理查最主要的反对者。1398 年遭理查流放，但 1399 年返回英格兰，击败理查，被议会迎立为国王。在位期间，威尔士和英格兰北部都发生过叛乱。亨利被迫接受国王必须通过议会治理国家的原则。1407 年，议会掌控了国家财政。

senses.def: two plays (c. 1597-8) by Shakespeare
senses.zh: 莎士比亚根据亨利四世当英格兰国王时期创作的两部戏剧（约 1597-8 年）。该剧的主角是哈尔王子（亨利四世的儿子，后来的亨利五世）和他的朋友福斯塔夫。在第 1 部分中，哈尔与福斯塔夫和其他人在伦敦一家小酒馆“野猪头”（= 酒吧）喝酒、开玩笑，他的父亲担心他不够认真，不足以成为国王。然而，最终他接受了自己的责任，并参加了一场战斗，击败了针对父亲的叛乱。在第二部分中，哈尔仍然与福斯塔夫友好，但当亨利四世去世，哈尔成为国王时，他用著名的台词拒绝了他：“我不认识你，老人”。

henry-iv-parts-1-and-2.uk: /ˌhenri ðə ˌfɔːθ ˌpɑːts ˌwʌn ən ˈtuː/
henry-iv-parts-1-and-2.us: /ˌhenri ðə ˌfɔːrθ ˌpɑːrts ˌwʌn ən ˈtuː/

senses.def: (1843-1916) a writer, born in the US, whose novels are often about Americans in Europe. They contrast the Americans' innocent ideas with the Europeans' understanding of the world. James settled in London in 1876 and became British in 1915. His novels include Daisy Miller
senses.zh: 亨利·詹姆斯（1843–1916）作家，生于美国。其小说多描写在欧洲的美国人，将美国人的天真对比欧洲人的世故。1876 年定居伦敦，1915 年成为英国公民。作品包括《黛西·米勒》（1879）、《一位女士的画像》（1881）、鬼故事《螺丝在拧紧》（1898）、《鸽翼》（1902）、《专使》（1903）和《金碗》（1904）。一些作品被拍成电影。

senses.def: (1924-94) a US composer
senses.zh: 亨利·曼奇尼（Henry Mancini）：（1924-94）美国电影音乐作曲家和歌曲作者。1961年，他在蒂芙尼（Tiffany's）的早餐会上获得了奥斯卡奖，其中包括歌曲《月亮河》（Moon River），而维克多/维多利亚（1982）则获得了奥斯卡奖。

senses.def: (1891-1980) a US author whose work had an important influence on the writers of the beat generation
senses.zh: 亨利·米勒：（1891-1980年），美国作家的作品对节拍一代的作家产生了重要影响。他的早期著作《癌症的热带》（1934年）和在巴黎出版的《魔兽世界》（1939年）由于对性别的详细说明，在英国和美国被禁了多年。他的其他书籍包括三本系列，合称为《罗西十字军》（1949-60）。

senses.def: (1898-1986) an English sculptor
senses.zh: 亨利·摩尔（Henry Moore）：（1898-1986）是一位享誉国际的英国雕塑家。他最著名的是他的大型雕塑，由石头，木头或青铜制成，并具有光滑的曲线。在这些作品中，人物形象应被视为雕塑所在环境的一部分。他的许多雕塑都在公共场所。

senses.def: (c. 1635-88) a Welsh sailor and pirate
senses.zh: 亨利·摩根（Henry Morgan）：（约1635-88年）威尔士水手和海盗，主要在加勒比海地区活动。1671年，他与西班牙人作战，1674年，他攻占了巴拿马。同年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1841-1904) a Welsh journalist and explorer
senses.zh: 亨利·莫顿·斯坦利（Henry Morton Stanley）：（1841-1904）是威尔士的新闻工作者和探险家。1859年，他去美国生活，并担任《纽约先驱报》的记者。1869年，他被他的报纸派遣去寻找探险家戴维·利文斯通（David Livingstone），人们认为他已经在非洲迷路了。斯坦利（Stanley）于1871年在宇治治（Ujiji）找到了他，据说对他打招呼是“我想是利文斯通博士吗？” 斯坦利继续探索非洲，直到1890年代初，并于1892年回到英国居住。他成为国会议员（1895-1900），并于1899年被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1659-95) an English baroque
senses.zh: 亨利·珀塞尔（Henry Purcell）：（1659-95）英国巴洛克作曲家。许多人认为他是当时最伟大的英国作曲家。他创作了许多不同类型的音乐，包括歌曲，教堂音乐和戏剧音乐，而他的《狄多和埃涅阿斯》（1689年）被认为是第一部英文歌剧。他对后来的作曲家尤其是汉德尔产生了重要影响。

senses.def: (1756-1823) a Scottish painter. He worked in Edinburgh and produced many pictures of important Scottish figures of the time, often in Highland dress
senses.zh: 亨利·雷本（Henry Raeburn）：（1756-1823）苏格兰画家。他在爱丁堡工作，并制作了许多当时重要的苏格兰人物的照片，而且经常穿着高地服饰。他最著名的绘画可能是达丁顿湖上的牧师罗伯特·沃克（1784）。1822年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1387-1422) king of England (1413-22) and son of Henry IV
senses.zh: 亨利五世（1387–1422）英格兰国王（1413–1422 在位）。亨利四世之子，被认为是英国爱国主义的象征，尤其因为莎士比亚剧作《亨利五世》。百年战争期间，率领英军进入法国，在 1415 年阿金库尔战役中击败法军，将法国的一个地区置于英国控制之下。

senses.def: a play (1599) by Shakespeare
senses.zh: 亨利五世（Henry V）：莎士比亚戏剧（1599年），庆祝国王亨利五世在法国的军事胜利。它包含几篇著名的爱国演说，包括国王在阿辛古尔战役之前的著名演说。该剧有两部电影版本，第一部是劳伦斯·奥利维尔（Laurence Olivier）亲自执导的亨利（1944），第二部是肯尼思·布拉纳（Kenneth Branagh）的导演，1989年，他也扮演了主角。

senses.def: (1421-71) king of England (1422-61 and 1470-1) and son of Henry V
senses.zh: 亨利六世（1421–1471）英格兰国王（1422–1461，1470–1471 在位）。亨利五世之子。因在位期间英格兰最终输掉百年战争而不受爱戴。对他的不满导致玫瑰战争，最终兰开斯特家族被约克家族打败，亨利被关进监狱，爱德华成为国王。1470 年，亨利在“立王者”沃里克伯爵的帮助下夺回王位，但 1471 年再次失败，在伦敦塔中被害。爱德华再次成为国王。亨利六世建立了伊顿公学和剑桥大学国王学院。

senses.def: three plays (c. 1590-92) by Shakespeare
senses.zh: 亨利六世，第1部分，第2部分和第3部分：莎士比亚的三部戏剧（约1590-92年），设定于玫瑰战争期间。它们是莎士比亚的最早戏剧之一，有些人认为他可能只写过其中一部分。

henry-vi-parts-1-2-and-3.uk: /ˌhenri ðə ˌsɪksθ ˌpɑːts ˌwʌn ˌtuː ən ˈθriː/
henry-vi-parts-1-2-and-3.us: /ˌhenri ðə ˌsɪksθ ˌpɑːrts ˌwʌn ˌtuː ən ˈθriː/

senses.def: (1457-1509) king of England (1485-1509), the first Tudor
senses.zh: 亨利七世：（1457-1509）英格兰国王（1485-1509），第一位都铎王朝。生于亨利·都铎（Henry Tudor），他在法国长大。1485年，他领导了一次反抗理查三世的叛乱，在博斯沃思菲尔德战役中击败了他，成为国王。1486年，他与爱德华（Edward）的女儿结婚，合并了兰开斯特宫（他所属的房子）和约克宫（York），因此结束了《玫瑰大战》。尽管在他的统治期间发生了叛乱，包括由兰伯特·西姆内尔（Lambert Simnel）和珀金·沃贝克（Perkin Warbeck）领导的叛乱，但亨利在该国建立了更大的秩序，引入了更现代的政府体制，并大大改善了该国的财务状况。

senses.def: (1491-1547) king of England (1509-47) and son of Henry VII
senses.zh: 亨利八世（1491–1547）英格兰国王（1509–1547 在位）。亨利七世之子。是最有名的英格兰国王之一，部分原因是他娶过六位妻子。

senses.def: a play (1613) by Shakespeare
senses.zh: 《亨利八世》 莎士比亚剧作（1613），可能是他的最后一部剧作。有些人认为这部剧是与他人合著的，也许是和约翰·弗莱彻。剧情围绕亨利八世与阿拉贡的凯瑟琳的离婚事件展开。

senses.def: (1807-82) one of the most popular US poets. He wrote long poems which helped to create romantic American legends
senses.zh: 亨利·沃兹沃思·朗费罗（Henry Wadsworth Longfellow）：（1807-82）是美国最受欢迎的诗人之一。他写了很长的诗歌，帮助创造了浪漫的美国传奇。他们包括伊万杰琳（1847），海瓦莎之歌（1855），乡村铁匠（1841），迈尔斯·斯坦迪什的求爱（1858）和保罗·里维尔的骑马（1861）。朗费罗还在哈佛大学（1836-54）教授现代语言。

senses.def: (1869-1944) an English conductor
senses.zh: 亨利·伍德（Henry Wood）：（1869-1944）英国指挥，以建立舞会而闻名。他是当时最伟大的指挥家之一，为提高英国的音乐水平做出了许多贡献。他介绍了许多外国新作曲家的作品，并首次允许女性在乐队中演奏。他在1911年被任命为骑士。

senses.def: to be a sign that something is going to happen

examples.en: These talks could herald a new era of peace.
examples.zh: 这些谈判可能预示着新的和平时代的来临。

examples.en: She felt a dull ache in her right temple, heralding a migraine.
examples.zh: 她感到右侧太阳穴隐隐作痛，预示着偏头痛。

examples.en: Bringing the baby home heralds the start of a very different lifestyle.

examples.en: Voices and footsteps outside heralded their return.
examples.zh: 外面的说话声和脚步声预示着他们回来了。

examples.zh: 这份报告被宣称是未来运输的蓝图。

examples.en: I think of primroses as the heralds of spring.

(1852-1928) a British Liberal prime minister (1908-16). His government introduced the first benefits of the welfare state
senses.zh: 赫伯特·亨利·阿斯奎斯（Herbert Henry Asquith）：（1852-1928）英国自由党首相（1908-16）。他的政府引入了福利国家的第一笔福利，例如老人退休金。他还负责降低上议院的权力，并领导英国参加第一次世界大战。他于1925年成为伯爵。

senses.def: (1874-1964) the 31st US President (1929-33) and a member of the Republican Party. He had earlier been the US Secretary of Commerce (1921-9). A year after he became President, the Great Depression
senses.zh: 赫伯特·胡佛（1874–1964）美国第 31 任总统（1929–1933），共和党人。曾任美国商务部长（1921–1929）。总统任内一年，美国进入大萧条。因政府未能阻止大萧条而备受指责。在 1932 年大选中败给富兰克林·D·罗斯福。第二次世界大战后，负责推行欧洲粮食计划。

senses.def: (1898-1979) a US political philosopher
senses.zh: 赫伯特·马尔库塞（Herbert Marcuse）：（1898-1979）是美国政治哲学家，出生于德国。他于1934年移居美国，并在几所大学任教，包括1952年的哈佛大学和1965年的加利福尼亚大学圣地亚哥分校。马尔库塞的思想受到马克思和弗洛伊德思想的强烈影响。他在1960年代特别受欢迎，并支持年轻人改变社会的努力。他的著作包括《爱与文明》（1955年），《苏联马克思主义》（1958年）和《一维人》（1964年）。

senses.def: (1888-1965) a British Labour Party
senses.zh: 赫伯特·莫里森（Herbert Morrison）：（1888-1965）是英国工党政客，曾担任多个政府高级职位。作为交通部长，他于1931年建立了伦敦交通局。在第二次世界大战期间，他担任内政部长，从1945年至1951年，他担任下议院领导人。他在1951年短暂担任外交大臣，并在1951年至1955年担任党的副主席。

any animal that eats only plants

senses.def: a Belgian detective who appears as a character in many of the mystery novels by Agatha Christie
senses.zh: 赫尔克里·波洛（Hercule Poirot）：一位比利时侦探，在阿加莎·克里斯蒂（Agatha Christie）的许多神秘小说中都扮演过角色。他的外表非常整齐，小胡子整齐。他经常认为英国人很奇怪，书中的英国人被他的口音逗乐了。他非常聪明，并运用自己的才智或所谓的“小灰格”来解决所有犯罪。许多故事都被改编成1980年代和1990年代流行的英国电视连续剧Poirot。

examples.zh: 在两三代之内，大多数移民已经失去或几乎失去了他们的传统语言。
