senses.def: a person from the country who is considered to be stupid and to have little experience of life

examples.en: I was just a hick from Texas then.
examples.zh: 那时我不过是从得克萨斯州来的土包子。

senses.def: a red mark on the skin that is caused by somebody biting or sucking
senses.zh: 爱痕（在皮肤上吻或咬出的红色痕迹）

senses.def: the hard wood of the North American hickory tree
the title and first line of an old nursery rhyme
senses.zh: 山胡桃木，山胡桃木，码头：老童谣的标题和第一行。完整的歌曲是：

senses.def: a centre for showjumping
senses.zh: 希克斯特德（Hickstead）：英格兰萨塞克斯（Sussex）的跳马中心。它于1960年开业，并在那里举行了许多国内和国际比赛。现在也有其他与骑马相关的运动比赛。

senses.def: harmonized index of consumer prices
senses.zh: 消费者物价调和指数（欧洲中央银行用以显示普通商品和服务每月价格变化情况，英国于 2003 年开始使用并称之为“消费物价指数”）

senses.def: the secret intention behind what somebody says or does
senses.zh: （言语或行为背后的）隐秘意图，秘密目的

examples.en: There are fears of a hidden agenda behind this new proposal.
examples.zh: 人们担心这一新提议的背后有不可告人的目的。

senses.def: to put or keep somebody/something in a place where they/it cannot be seen or found

examples.en: He hid the letter in a drawer.
examples.zh: 他把信藏在抽屉里。

examples.en: I keep my private papers hidden.
examples.zh: 我藏起了我的私人文件。

examples.en: They hid me from the police in their attic.
examples.zh: 他们把我藏在他们的阁楼上躲避警察。

senses.def: to go somewhere where you hope you will not be seen or found

examples.en: Quick, hide!
examples.zh: 快，躲起来！

examples.en: I hid under the bed.
examples.zh: 我躲在床底下。

examples.en: We hid from our pursuers in an empty house.
examples.zh: 我们藏身在一处空房子里，躲过了追踪者。

examples.en: She hides herself away in her office all day.
examples.zh: 她成天躲在办公室里。

senses.def: to cover somebody/something so that they/it cannot be seen

examples.en: He hid his face in his hands.
examples.zh: 他用手捂住了脸。

examples.en: The house was hidden by trees.
examples.zh: 那所房子被树丛遮住了。

examples.en: The brim of his hat hid half his face.
examples.zh: 帽子的边缘遮住了他的半张脸。

examples.en: No amount of make-up could hide the scar.
examples.zh: 无论用多少化妆品都无法掩盖疤痕。

senses.def: to keep something secret, especially your feelings

examples.en: They didn't try to hide the fact that the film was a remake.
examples.zh: 这部电影是翻拍的，他们并没有试图掩盖这一事实。

examples.en: I have never tried to hide the truth about my past.
examples.zh: 我从未设法隐瞒我的过去。

examples.en: She struggled to hide her disappointment.
examples.zh: 她竭力掩饰她的失望。

examples.en: They claim that they have nothing to hide (= there was nothing wrong or illegal about what they did).
examples.zh: 他们声称他们没什么可隐瞒的。

examples.en: His brusque manner hides a shy and sensitive nature.
examples.zh: 他粗鲁的举止之下藏着胆怯敏感的天性。

examples.en: I could not hide my joy at seeing him again.
examples.zh: 我无法掩饰再次见到他的喜悦。

senses.def: to refuse to admit that a problem exists or refuse to deal with it
senses.zh: 采取鸵鸟政策；不正视现实；回避问题

senses.def: to hide the real situation or facts when these are not good or pleasant

examples.en: It's a shabby old sofa but cushions and throws can hide a multitude of sins.
examples.zh: 这是一张破旧的旧沙发，但垫子和休闲毯可以隐藏许多罪过。

senses.def: to not let people know that you are good at something
used to say that whatever you do, you cannot escape the consequences of your actions
senses.zh: 该来的总会来，躲也躲不过；躲得了一时，躲不了一世

senses.def: a place from which people can watch wild animals or birds, without being seen by them
senses.zh: （观看野生动物的）隐蔽处，藏身处

senses.def: an animal’s skin, especially when it is bought or sold or used for leather
senses.zh: （尤指买卖或用作皮革的）皮，毛皮

examples.en: boots made from buffalo hide
examples.zh: 用水牛皮做的靴子

examples.en: a black hide belt
examples.zh: 黑色皮带

examples.en: The hide is tanned for leather.
examples.zh: 兽皮被鞣制成革。

senses.def: used to refer to somebody’s life or safety when they are in a difficult situation

examples.en: All he's worried about is his own hide (= himself).
examples.zh: 他所担心的只是他自己的生命安全。

senses.def: to punish somebody severely
not to see somebody/something for some time
senses.zh: （一段时间）不见某人（或某物）的踪影

examples.en: I haven't seen hide nor hair of her for a month.
examples.zh: 我有一个月没见过她了。

senses.def: to try to avoid death, punishment, etc., especially by leaving others in an extremely difficult situation
senses.zh: （尤指不惜置他人于困境而）保全自己的性命，使自己免受惩罚

examples.en: To save his own skin, he lied and blamed the accident on his friend.
examples.zh: 为了自保，他竟然说谎，把事故的责任推到朋友身上。

items.idm: bury/hide your head in the sand

senses.def: to refuse to admit that a problem exists or refuse to deal with it
senses.zh: 采取鸵鸟政策；不正视现实；回避问题

items.idm: cover/hide a multitude of sins

senses.def: to hide the real situation or facts when these are not good or pleasant

examples.en: It's a shabby old sofa but cushions and throws can hide a multitude of sins.
examples.zh: 这是一张破旧的旧沙发，但垫子和休闲毯可以隐藏许多罪过。

items.idm: hide your light under a bushel

senses.def: to not let people know that you are good at something

items.idm: you can run but you can't hide

senses.def: used to say that whatever you do, you cannot escape the consequences of your actions
senses.zh: 该来的总会来，躲也躲不过；躲得了一时，躲不了一世

senses.def: to punish somebody severely

items.idm: not see hide nor hair of somebody/something

senses.def: not to see somebody/something for some time
senses.zh: （一段时间）不见某人（或某物）的踪影

examples.en: I haven't seen hide nor hair of her for a month.
examples.zh: 我有一个月没见过她了。

senses.def: to try to avoid death, punishment, etc., especially by leaving others in an extremely difficult situation
senses.zh: （尤指不惜置他人于困境而）保全自己的性命，使自己免受惩罚

examples.en: To save his own skin, he lied and blamed the accident on his friend.
examples.zh: 为了自保，他竟然说谎，把事故的责任推到朋友身上。

intro.en: These words all mean to put or keep somebody/​something in a place where they/​it cannot be seen or found, or to keep the truth or your feelings secret.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含藏、隐藏、掩盖、隐瞒之义。

items.def: to put or keep somebody/​something in a place where they/​it cannot be seen or found; to keep something secret, especially your feelings:
items.zh: 指藏、隐藏、掩盖（尤指感情）

examples.en: He hid the letter in a drawer.
examples.zh: 他把信藏在抽屉里。

items.def: (formal) to hide somebody/​something; to keep something secret:
items.zh: 指隐藏、隐瞒、掩盖

examples.en: The paintings were concealed beneath a thick layer of plaster.
examples.zh: 那些画藏在厚厚的灰泥层下面。

items.def: to place something over or in front of something in order to hide it:
items.zh: 指掩蔽、遮盖

examples.en: She covered her face with her hands.
examples.zh: 她双手掩面。

items.def: to hide or change the nature of something, so that it cannot be recognized:
items.zh: 指掩蔽、掩饰、伪装，以免被认出

examples.en: He tried to disguise his accent.
examples.zh: 他竭力掩饰自己的口音。

items.def: to hide a feeling, smell, fact, etc. so that it cannot be easily seen or noticed:
items.zh: 指掩饰、掩藏（情感、气味、事实等），以免被看出或注意到

examples.en: She masked her anger with a smile.
examples.zh: 她用微笑来掩饰她的愤怒。

items.def: to hide somebody/​something by making them/​it look like the things around, or like something else:
items.zh: 指通过使人或事物与周围环境或其他事物相似而达到伪装、掩饰的目的

examples.en: The soldiers camouflaged themselves with leaves and twigs.
examples.zh: 士兵用树叶和树枝来伪装自己。

senses.def: to not let people know that you are good at something

hide your light under a bushel.word: hide your light under a bushel

senses.def: a children’s game in which one player covers his or her eyes while the other players hide, and then tries to find them
to use somebody/something to protect yourself from criticism or punishment, especially in a way that people think is weak or shows a lack of courage
senses.zh: （尤指怯懦无能地）躲在…后面，拿…当挡箭牌

examples.en: She hides behind empty excuses and company policy.
examples.zh: 她拿空洞的借口和公司规定来逃避责任。

examples.en: Unscrupulous employers cannot get away with hiding behind the law.
examples.zh: 不道德的雇主无法逃避法律的制裁。

senses.def: to use something to keep secret your real identity, character or purpose
senses.zh: 用…隐藏真实身份（或本性、目的）

examples.en: He hid behind a false identity.
examples.zh: 他隐姓埋名。

examples.en: criminals who hide behind a veneer of respectability
examples.zh: 隐藏在体面外表背后的罪犯

senses.def: a place where you can go to hide or to be alone

examples.en: He escaped to his hideaway in the country at weekends.
examples.zh: 周末他逃到乡下的藏身之处。

senses.def: having old-fashioned ideas, rather than accepting new ways of thinking

examples.en: She wanted a life that was less hidebound by rules and conventions.
examples.zh: 她想要一种不那么墨守成规的生活。

senses.def: very ugly or unpleasant
senses.zh: 十分丑陋的；令人厌恶的

examples.en: a hideous face/building/dress
examples.zh: 丑陋的面孔／建筑物／衣服

examples.en: Their new colour scheme is hideous!
examples.zh: 他们新的颜色搭配难看极了！

examples.en: a hideous crime
examples.zh: 骇人听闻的罪行

examples.en: The whole experience had been like some hideous nightmare.
examples.zh: 整个经历就像一场可怕的噩梦。

examples.en: When they refused to let me leave my hotel, I thought, at first, it was all some hideous mistake.
examples.zh: 当他们拒绝让我离开酒店时，我一开始以为这只是一个可怕的错误。

senses.def: in a very ugly or unpleasant way
senses.zh: 十分丑陋的；令人厌恶的

examples.en: His back was hideously burned.
examples.zh: 他的背部被严重烧伤。

senses.def: a place where somebody goes when they do not want anyone to find them

examples.en: The guerrillas had a hideout in the mountains.
examples.zh: 游击队在山里有一个藏身之处。

senses.def: a place where somebody hides, especially in order to avoid being with other people
a place where somebody/something can be hidden

examples.en: As darkness fell, she emerged from her hiding place.
examples.zh: 夜幕降临时，她从藏身之处出来了。

examples.en: They used the cave as a hiding place for their weapons.
examples.zh: 他们将那个洞穴作为藏匿武器的地方。

senses.def: to go quickly
arranged in a hierarchy
senses.zh: 按等级划分的；等级制度的

examples.en: a hierarchical society/structure/organization
examples.zh: 分等级的社会／结构／组织

examples.en: The company’s structure is rigidly hierarchical.
examples.zh: 公司的组织结构等级森严。

senses.def: in a hierarchy
senses.zh: 按等级划分的；等级制度的

examples.en: This directory is a hierarchically organized database.
examples.zh: 该目录是一个分层组织的数据库。

senses.def: a system, especially in a society or an organization, in which people are organized into different levels of importance from highest to lowest
senses.zh: 等级制度（尤指社会或组织）

examples.en: the social/political hierarchy
examples.zh: 社会／政治等级制度

examples.en: She's quite high up in the management hierarchy.
examples.zh: 她位居管理层要职。

senses.def: the group of people in control of a large organization or institution

examples.en: It was on orders from the party hierarchy that she dropped the investigation.
examples.zh: 她是根据党内高层的命令放弃调查的。

examples.en: The hierarchy has/have remained silent on this issue.
examples.zh: 高层在这个问题上一直保持沉默。

senses.def: a system that ideas or beliefs can be arranged into according to their importance

examples.en: a hierarchy of needs
examples.zh: 不同层次的需要

senses.def: a picture or symbol of an object, representing a word, syllable or sound, especially as used in ancient Egyptian and other writing systems
senses.zh: 象形文字（尤指古埃及等所用的书写符号）

examples.en: The meanings of ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs were unknown until the 19th century.
examples.zh: 直到 19 世纪，古埃及象形文字的含义才为人所知。

senses.def: using hieroglyphs
senses.zh: 象形文字，象形符号（尤指古埃及等所用的文字）

examples.en: a hieroglyphic inscription
examples.zh: 象形文字铭文

senses.def: writing that uses hieroglyphs
senses.zh: 象形文字（指书写符号系统）

senses.def: untidy and not in any order

examples.en: a higgledy-piggledy collection of houses
examples.zh: 一片错落杂乱的房屋

senses.def: in an untidy way that lacks any order

examples.en: Files were strewn higgledy-piggledy over the floor.
examples.zh: 文件乱七八糟地扔了一地。

senses.def: measuring a long distance from the bottom to the top

examples.en: What's the highest mountain in the US?
examples.zh: 美国哪座山最高？

examples.en: The house has a high wall all the way round it.
examples.zh: 这栋房子的四周围着高墙。

examples.en: shoes with high heels
examples.zh: 高跟鞋

examples.en: He has a round face with a high forehead.
examples.zh: 他圆脸，高额头。

senses.group: from bottom to top 从底到顶

senses.def: used to talk about the distance that something measures from the bottom to the top

examples.en: How high is Mount Aconcagua?
examples.zh: 阿空加瓜山有多高？

examples.en: It's only a low wall—about a metre high.
examples.zh: 那只不过是一堵矮墙，约一米高。

examples.en: The grass was waist-high.
examples.zh: 那片草齐腰高。

examples.en: knee-high boots
examples.zh: 齐膝高的靴子

senses.group: from bottom to top 从底到顶

senses.def: at a level that is a long way above the ground or above the level of the sea

examples.en: a high branch/shelf/window
examples.zh: 高处的树枝／搁板／窗

examples.en: The rooms had high ceilings.
examples.zh: 那些房间的天花板很高。

examples.en: streaks of high cloud
examples.zh: 高云条纹

examples.en: They were flying at high altitude.
examples.zh: 他们正在高空飞行。

examples.en: the grasslands of the high prairies
examples.zh: 高地草原

senses.group: far above ground 离地面远

senses.def: greater or better than normal in quantity or quality, size or degree
senses.zh: （数量、质量、体积或程度）高的，超乎寻常的

examples.en: a high price/cost/speed/temperature
examples.zh: 高价；高成本；高速；高温

examples.en: a high rate of inflation
examples.zh: 高通货膨胀率

examples.en: high levels of pollution
examples.zh: 重度污染

examples.en: Demand is high at this time of year.
examples.zh: 一年的这个时期需求很大。

examples.en: high-quality goods
examples.zh: 优质商品

examples.en: a high risk of injury
examples.zh: 受伤风险高

examples.en: a high standard of craftsmanship
examples.zh: 高水平的手工艺

examples.en: A high proportion of our staff are female.
examples.zh: 我们的员工中女性比例很高

examples.en: Originally, an even higher percentage of land was wetlands.
examples.zh: 最初，湿地所占的土地比例甚至更高。

examples.en: A high degree of accuracy is needed.
examples.zh: 需要高度的准确性。

examples.en: The cost in terms of human life was high.
examples.zh: 付出了很大的生命代价。

examples.en: Sales were significantly higher than in previous years.
examples.zh: 销售额大幅高于前几年。

examples.en: The tree blew over in the high winds.
examples.zh: 树被大风刮倒了。

examples.en: We had high hopes for the business (= we believed it would be successful).
examples.zh: 我们对这项生意寄予了很大希望。

senses.group: greater than normal 超出常规

senses.def: containing a lot of a particular substance

examples.en: a high potassium content
examples.zh: 高钾含量

examples.en: a high-fat diet
examples.zh: 高脂肪的饮食

examples.en: foods that are high in fat
examples.zh: 高脂肪食物

examples.en: Oranges are high in vitamin C.
examples.zh: 橙子含有丰富的维生素C。

senses.def: near the top in rank, status or importance
senses.zh: 上层的；地位（或重要性）高的

examples.en: She has held high office under three prime ministers.
examples.zh: 她曾在三任首相手下任过要职。

examples.en: The case was referred to a higher court.
examples.zh: 案件转到了上级法院。

examples.en: the distinction between high art and popular art
examples.zh: 高雅艺术与通俗艺术的区别

examples.en: Job security is high on his list of priorities.
examples.zh: 工作保障是他要优先考虑的。

senses.def: of great value

examples.en: to play for high stakes
examples.zh: 豪赌

examples.en: My highest card is ten.
examples.zh: 我最大的牌是十。

examples.en: At the moment, the euro is high against the dollar, which makes for a good exchange rate.
examples.zh: 目前欧元兑美元汇率处于高点，兑换货币很划算。

examples.en: The high dollar is still a major problem for importers.
examples.zh: 高美元仍然是进口商面临的主要问题。

senses.def: when a river or the tide

examples.en: The river was very high and threatening to flood.
examples.zh: 这条河水位很高，有发洪水的危险。

senses.def: morally good

examples.en: a man of high ideals/principles
examples.zh: 有崇高理想／道德准则的人

senses.def: showing a lot of approval or respect for somebody
senses.zh: 十分赞同的；非常尊敬的

examples.en: She is held in very high regard by her colleagues.
examples.zh: 她很受同事们的敬重。

examples.en: You seem to have a high opinion of yourself!
examples.zh: 你似乎自我评价很高嘛！

senses.def: at the upper end of the range of sounds that humans can hear; not deep or low

examples.en: She has a high voice.
examples.zh: 她嗓音很尖。

examples.en: That note is definitely too high for me.
examples.zh: 那个音对我来说实在太高了。

senses.def: used to describe the middle or the most attractive part of a period of time

examples.en: high noon
examples.zh: 正午

examples.en: high summer
examples.zh: 盛夏

senses.group: of period of time 时段

senses.def: beginning to go bad and having a strong smell
senses.zh: 开始变质的；开始发馊的

senses.def: behaving in an excited way because of the effects of alcohol or drugs

examples.en: He was high on drugs.
examples.zh: 他吸毒得很厉害。

senses.def: produced with part of the tongue in the highest possible position without limiting the flow of air
to behave in a way that shows you think you are better than other people
senses.zh: 趾高气扬；自命不凡；自以为了不起

senses.def: friends, people, etc. in positions of power and influence
senses.zh: 身居高位的朋友（或人士等）

examples.en: He has friends in high places.
examples.zh: 他有身居高位的朋友。

senses.def: to enjoy yourself very much
despite any difficulties

examples.en: I was determined to go, come hell or high water.
examples.zh: 我决心要去，不管有什么困难。

senses.def: in a position out of the water

examples.en: Their yacht was left high and dry on a sandbank.
examples.zh: 他们的帆船搁浅在沙丘上了。

senses.def: in a difficult situation, without help or money
senses.zh: 处境艰难；无依无靠；身无分文

senses.def: behaving as though you think you are more important than other people
senses.zh: 趾高气扬；神气活现；自高自大

senses.def: behaving in a very excited way, especially because of being strongly affected by alcohol or drugs
senses.zh: （尤指因酗酒或吸毒）异常兴奋，神情恍惚

senses.def: the amount of attention somebody/something has from the public
senses.zh: 惹人／不惹人注目；高／低姿态

examples.en: This issue has had a high profile in recent months.
examples.zh: 近几个月来，这个议题一直是关注的焦点。

examples.en: I advised her to keep a low profile for the next few days (= not to attract attention).
examples.zh: 我建议她未来几天保持低调。

examples.en: The story was given a low profile in today's papers.
examples.zh: 今天的报纸低调报道了这件事。

senses.def: in an angry or offended mood, and showing other people that you are angry

examples.en: He stomped out of the room in high dudgeon.
examples.zh: 他愤怒地噔噔走出了屋子。

examples.en: She stormed out in high dudgeon.
examples.zh: 她怒气冲冲地走了。

senses.def: used to say that you think somebody should do something soon
senses.zh: 差不多／现在是…的时候了

examples.en: It's about time you cleaned your room!
examples.zh: 你该打扫自己的房间了！

senses.def: of a high quality or degree; of the highest quality or greatest degree
senses.zh: 高质量的；高品质的；一流的

examples.en: The job requires diplomatic skills of a high order.
examples.zh: 这项工作要求高超的外交技巧。

examples.en: She was a snob of the first order.
examples.zh: 她是天字第一号势利鬼。

senses.def: to have a strong unpleasant smell

examples.zh: 清除浏览器历史记录可防止网站跟踪你的活动。

senses.def: a relationship between two people, groups, companies, etc. that started in the past and continued for a period of time, especially one involving bad or complicated feelings

examples.zh: 当然，我和安娜·梅之间有过节，就像你说的。

examples.zh: 我们不会谈论那件事的，那都已经过去了。

examples.en: That's past history now.
examples.zh: 那是以前的事了。

examples.en: They had an affair once, but that's past history now.
examples.zh: 他们曾有过一段风流韵事，但那是过去的事了。

examples.zh: 多年以后，家族历史又在伊夫的女儿们身上重演。

examples.zh: 他有犯罪前科，曾入狱两年。

senses.def: histrionic

examples.en: histrionic gestures
examples.zh: 演戏般的手势

senses.def: in a very emotional way that is intended to attract attention and that does not seem sincere
senses.zh: 矫揉造作的；装腔作势的

senses.def: very emotional behaviour that is intended to attract attention in a way that does not seem sincere
senses.zh: 矫揉造作的；装腔作势的

examples.en: She was used to her mother's histrionics.
examples.zh: 她已经习惯了她妈妈装腔作势的样子。

senses.def: to bring your hand, or an object you are holding, against somebody/something quickly and with force

examples.en: I was afraid he was going to hit me.
examples.zh: 我怕他会打我。

examples.en: She hit him with her umbrella.
examples.zh: 她用雨伞打他。

examples.en: Someone hit him in the face.
examples.zh: 有人打了他的脸。

examples.en: He hit the nail squarely on the head with the hammer.
examples.zh: 他用锤子正对着钉子敲下去。

senses.def: to come against something/somebody with force, especially causing damage or injury

examples.en: The bus hit the bridge.
examples.zh: 公共汽车撞到了桥上。

examples.en: The boy was hit by a speeding car.
examples.zh: 男孩被超速行驶的汽车撞了。

examples.en: The boat hit against an object under the surface of the water.
examples.zh: 船撞到了水下的一样东西。

senses.def: to knock a part of your body against something

examples.en: I must have hit my knee.
examples.zh: 我肯定撞到了膝盖。

examples.en: He hit his head on the low ceiling.
examples.zh: 他的头碰了低矮的天花板。

examples.en: As she stood up, she hit her hand against the edge of the table.
examples.zh: 当她站起来时，她的手撞到了桌子边缘。

senses.def: to reach and touch a person or thing suddenly and with force

examples.en: The town was hit by bombs again last night.
examples.zh: 这个镇子昨晚又一次遭到了轰炸。

examples.en: He was hit by a sniper.
examples.zh: 他被狙击手击中。

examples.en: Not all the bullets hit their targets.
examples.zh: 不是所有的子弹都击中目标。

senses.def: to bring a bat

examples.en: She hit the ball and ran to first base.
examples.zh: 她击球后跑向一垒。

examples.en: I hit the ball too hard and it went out of the court.
examples.zh: 我用力过猛，把球打出了场外。

examples.en: We've hit our ball over the fence!
examples.zh: 我们把球击过围栏去了！

senses.def: to score points by hitting a ball

examples.en: to hit a home run
examples.zh: 打出本垒打

senses.def: to press something such as a button to operate a machine, etc.

examples.en: Hit the brakes!
examples.zh: 踩刹车！

examples.en: He picked up the phone and hit several buttons.
examples.zh: 他拿起电话按了几个键。

examples.en: I found the impulse to hit the fast-forward button to be quite overwhelming.
examples.zh: 我发现按下快进按钮的冲动非常强烈。

examples.en: I accidentally hit the wrong key.
examples.zh: 我不小心按错了键。

examples.en: Enter your password and then hit ‘Return’.
examples.zh: 输入您的密码，然后点击“返回”。

senses.def: to have a bad effect on somebody/something
senses.zh: 产生不良影响；打击；危害

examples.en: The tax increases will certainly hit people on low incomes.
examples.zh: 增税肯定会打击低收入人群。

examples.en: His death didn't really hit me at first.
examples.zh: 他的死起初并没有对我产生影响。

examples.en: A tornado hit on Tuesday night.
examples.zh: 星期二晚上发生了一次龙卷风。

examples.en: Rural areas have been worst hit by the strike.
examples.zh: 这次罢工对农村地区的打击最沉重。

examples.en: Spain was one of the hardest hit countries.
examples.zh: 西班牙是遭受打击最严重的国家之一。

examples.en: It hit him very hard when Rosie left.
examples.zh: 罗西的离开对他打击很大。

senses.group: have bad effect 有坏影响

senses.def: to attack somebody/something

examples.en: We hit the enemy when they least expected it.
examples.zh: 我们在敌人最意想不到的时候发动了进攻。

senses.def: to reach a place

examples.en: Follow this footpath and you'll eventually hit the road.
examples.zh: 沿着这条小路走，终会走上大路。

examples.en: The President hits town tomorrow.
examples.zh: 总统明天到镇子上来。

senses.def: to reach a particular level

examples.en: Temperatures hit 40° yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天气温高达 40 度。

examples.en: The euro hit a record low in trading today.
examples.zh: 今天欧元的兑换价降到了历史最低水平。

examples.en: We hit top form (= played our best) in yesterday’s match.
examples.zh: 我们在昨天的比赛中达到了最佳状态（=发挥了最好的水平）。

examples.en: The film doesn't always hit its targets (= succeed in what it is attempting to do).
examples.zh: 电影并非总能实现其目标。

senses.def: to experience something difficult or unpleasant
senses.zh: 遇到（困难）；经历（不愉快的事情）

examples.en: We seem to have hit a problem.
examples.zh: 我们似乎遇到了问题。

examples.en: Everything was going well but then we hit trouble.
examples.zh: 原本一切都进行得很顺利，但后来我们遇到了麻烦。

senses.def: to come suddenly into your mind

examples.en: The idea hit me like a tornado.
examples.zh: 这个想法猛然闯进我的脑海。

examples.en: I couldn't remember where I'd seen him before, and then it suddenly hit me.
examples.zh: 起初我想不起以前在哪里见过他，后来猛然记起来了。

examples.en: That's when it really hit me that we were in deep trouble.
examples.zh: 那时我才真正意识到我们陷入了大麻烦。

senses.def: to become widely available for sale

examples.en: the latest board game to hit the market
examples.zh: 最新上市的桌面游戏

examples.en: to hit the shops/stores/shelves
examples.zh: 在商店上架发售

examples.en: Her shocking autobiography is about to hit the streets.
examples.zh: 她那本惊世的自传即将面世。

senses.def: to be an important item of news in the media
senses.zh: 成为头条新闻；登上头条

examples.en: He always manages to grab the headlines.
examples.zh: 他总是设法成为头版人物。

senses.def: to be very successful

examples.en: The band has hit big in the US.
examples.zh: 乐队在美国大获成功。

senses.def: if a plan, somebody’s career, etc. hits the buffers

examples.en: The former tennis star’s comeback trail hit the buffers yesterday when she lost in straight sets.
examples.zh: 这位前网球明星的复出之路昨天遭遇了挫折，因为她直落两盘失利。

senses.def: to fall to the ground
to affect somebody very deeply

examples.en: The business over the lawsuit had really knocked her for six.
examples.zh: 诉讼的事把她折腾得够呛。

senses.def: to start doing something and continue very quickly and successfully
senses.zh: 迅速而顺利地投入某事；一炮打响；一举成功

senses.def: to go to bed

examples.en: I decided to hit the sack and have an early night.
examples.zh: 我决定上床睡觉，早早休息一晚。

senses.def: if a remark, etc. hits/strikes home
senses.zh: （言语等）正中要害，说到点子上

examples.en: Her face went pale as his words hit home.
examples.zh: 他的话切中要害，她的脸变白了。

senses.def: to be very obvious to somebody
used to tell somebody to start doing something, such as playing music
senses.zh: （要某人开始做某事，如演奏音乐）开始吧

examples.en: Hit it, Louis!
examples.zh: 开始吧，路易斯！

senses.def: to have a good friendly relationship with somebody

examples.en: We hit it off straight away.
examples.zh: 我们一见如故。

senses.def: to make or win a lot of money quickly and unexpectedly
senses.zh: 突然意外赚大钱（或赢大钱）；发大财

senses.def: to succeed/fail in achieving or guessing something
senses.zh: 达到／没有达到目的；猜测正确／错误

examples.en: He blushed furiously and Robyn knew she had hit the mark.
examples.zh: 他满脸通红，萝宾知道自己击中了要害。

examples.en: The film misses the mark because it just isn't believable.
examples.zh: 这部电影没有达到目标，因为它根本不可信。

senses.def: to say something that is exactly right
to mention a subject that makes somebody feel angry, upset, embarrassed, etc.

examples.en: You touched a raw nerve when you mentioned his first wife.
examples.zh: 你谈起他的第一任妻子，这就触到了他的痛处。

examples.en: My remarks about divorce had unwittingly touched a raw nerve.
examples.zh: 我关于离婚的言论无意间触到了别人的痛处。

examples.en: The article struck a raw nerve as it revived unpleasant memories.
examples.zh: 这篇文章唤起了不愉快的回忆，触及痛处。

senses.def: to suddenly be in a successful situation, especially one that makes you rich

examples.en: The band really hit pay dirt with their last album.
examples.zh: 乐队的上一张专辑确实大获成功。

senses.def: to do, say or write something that is suitable/not suitable for a particular occasion
senses.zh: 做（或说、写）得得体／不得体

examples.en: It is a bizarre tale and the author hits just the right note of horror and disbelief.
examples.zh: 这是一个离奇的故事，作者恰到好处地表达了恐惧和难以置信。

examples.en: Unfortunately, the president struck the wrong note in his speech, ignoring the public mood.
examples.zh: 不幸的是，总统在讲话中语调错误，无视公众情绪。

senses.def: to start a journey

examples.en: The following spring I hit the road.
examples.zh: 第二年春天我就上路了。

senses.def: to suddenly become very angry
if something hits the spot
senses.zh: 发挥正当作用；适得其用；恰到好处

senses.def: to begin to do something with confidence and at a good speed after a slow, uncertain start
senses.zh: 进入状态；开始顺利地做某事

examples.en: After a nervous start, he finally hit his stride in the second set.
examples.zh: 经过紧张的开局后，他终于在第二盘中大踏步前进。

examples.en: The team took time to hit stride.
examples.zh: 球队花了一些时间才取得进展。

examples.en: The show finally hit its stride in the second season.
examples.zh: 这个节目在第二季终于进入了状态。

senses.def: to reach a point when you cannot continue or make any more progress
senses.zh: 筋疲力尽；陷入绝境；遇到不可逾越的障碍

examples.en: We hit a wall and we weren't scoring.
examples.zh: 我们已经筋疲力尽，得不到分了。

examples.en: I’ve hit a wall with my marathon training.
examples.zh: 我的马拉松训练碰壁了。

examples.en: What do you do when you hit the wall at work?
examples.zh: 工作中遇到困难时你会怎么做？

senses.def: to continue to hurt somebody when they are already defeated
to affect somebody where they will feel it most
senses.zh: 刺着某人痛处；击中要害

examples.en: She hit the woodwork twice before scoring.
examples.zh: 她两度击中门框后射门得分。

senses.def: to be so surprised by something that you do not know how to react
senses.zh: 因吃惊而不知所措；惊呆了

senses.zh: 做了坏事（或错事）被发现

examples.en: When the shit hits the fan, I don't want to be here.
examples.zh: 事情一旦败露，我就不想待在这儿了。

senses.def: an act of hitting somebody/something with your hand or with an object held in your hand

examples.en: Give it a good hit.
examples.zh: 用力打它一下。

examples.en: He made the winning hit.
examples.zh: 他击出了制胜的一球。

senses.def: an occasion when something that has been thrown, fired, etc. at an object reaches that object; the fact of being hit by something

examples.en: We finished the first round with a score of two hits and six misses.
examples.zh: 我们在第一轮结束时的分数是两次击中，六次未中。

examples.en: One of the tanks took a direct hit.
examples.zh: 其中一辆坦克被打个正着。

examples.en: The aircraft suffered seven hits in the raid.
examples.zh: 这架飞机在袭击中遭受了七次袭击。

examples.en: Few structures can withstand a hit from a speeding car.
examples.zh: 建筑物很少能承受高速行驶车辆的撞击。

examples.en: Enemy planes scored a hit on a supply ship.
examples.zh: 敌机击中了一艘补给舰。

senses.def: a person or thing that is very popular

examples.en: He's just about to star in the hit musical, ‘Chicago’.
examples.zh: 他即将出演热门音乐剧《芝加哥》。

examples.en: a hit show/comedy
examples.zh: 热门节目/喜剧

examples.zh: 她的新系列节目极为成功，引起轰动。

examples.en: a big/huge hit
examples.zh: 一个大的/巨大的打击

examples.en: The duo were a real hit in last year's show.
examples.zh: 这一对搭档在去年的演出中大出风头。

examples.en: The film scored a major international hit.
examples.zh: 这部电影在国际上取得了巨大成功。

examples.en: The films have proved a hit with older audiences.
examples.zh: 这些电影在老年观众中广受欢迎。

senses.group: something popular 受欢迎的事物

senses.zh: 风行一时的流行歌曲（或唱片）

examples.en: They are about to release an album of their greatest hits.
examples.zh: 他们即将发行收录他们最热门歌曲的专辑。

examples.en: She played all her old hits.
examples.zh: 她演奏了她所有曾轰动一时的老曲子。

examples.en: a hit single/song
examples.zh: 风靡一时的单曲／歌曲

senses.def: an occasion on which a web page is displayed or a file is downloaded from the internet

examples.en: Our website is getting a lot of hits from the USA.
examples.zh: 我们的网站得到很多来自美国的点击。

examples.en: How many hits did you get?
examples.zh: 你获得了多少点击量？

senses.def: the fact of finding an item of data that matches a search

examples.en: The search generated 1 848 hits.
examples.zh: 这一搜索得到了 1 848 个相关结果。

senses.def: a violent crime or murder

senses.def: to keep somebody’s attention or interest
senses.zh: 使（注意力或兴趣）持续不减；吸引住

examples.en: There wasn't much in the museum to hold my attention.
examples.zh: 博物馆中没有很多让我感兴趣的东西。

examples.en: These discussions held little interest for Lucy.
examples.zh: 露西对这些讨论没什么兴趣。

senses.def: to keep something at the same level, rate, speed, etc.; to stay at the same level, rate, etc.
senses.zh: （使）保持同样程度（或比率、速度等）

examples.en: Hold your speed at 70.
examples.zh: 把速度保持在 70。

examples.en: Interest rates have been held at 8% for a year now.
examples.zh: 利率已维持在 8% 一年了。

examples.en: They are trying to hold public spending to £300 billion.
examples.zh: 他们试图将公共支出控制在 3000 亿英镑。

examples.en: The company's shares held at £3.47.
examples.zh: 该公司的股票价格为 3.47 英镑。

examples.en: In trading today the dollar held steady against the yen.
examples.zh: 在今天的交易中，美元对日元的汇率保持稳定。

senses.def: to keep something so that it can be used later

examples.en: Employees do not have access to personal records held on computer.
examples.zh: 雇员没有机会看到存储在计算机中的个人记录。

examples.en: Our solicitor holds our wills.
examples.zh: 律师保存着我们的遗嘱。

examples.en: We can hold your reservation for three days.
examples.zh: 您的预订我们可以保留三天。

senses.def: to wait until you can speak to the person you have phoned

examples.en: That extension is busy right now. Can you hold?
examples.zh: 分机现在占线。您能等一会吗？

examples.en: She asked me to hold the line.
examples.zh: 她要我别挂断电话。

senses.def: to own or have something

examples.en: Employees hold 30% of the shares.
examples.zh: 雇员持有 30% 的股份。

examples.en: He was born in South Africa but he holds a British passport.
examples.zh: 他出生在南非，但持有英国护照。

examples.en: Applicants must hold a full driving licence.
examples.zh: 申请人须持有正式驾驶执照。

senses.def: to defend something against attack; to have control of something

examples.en: The rebels held the radio station.
examples.zh: 叛乱者占据了电台。

senses.def: to remain strong and safe or in position
senses.zh: 承受住；坚持住；保持原位

examples.en: They were afraid the dam wouldn't hold.
examples.zh: 他们担心大坝会承受不住。

senses.def: to remain the same

examples.en: How long will the fine weather hold?
examples.zh: 好天气会持续多久？

examples.en: If their luck holds, they could still win the championship.
examples.zh: 如果他们的好运持续下去，他们仍能赢得冠军。

senses.def: to have a belief or an opinion about somebody/something

examples.en: He holds strange views on education.
examples.zh: 他对教育的看法不同寻常。

examples.en: She is held in high regard by her students (= they have a high opinion of her).
examples.zh: 学生对她评价很高。

examples.en: to be held in high esteem
examples.zh: 受到高度尊重

examples.en: He has very firmly held religious beliefs.
examples.zh: 他的宗教信仰极其坚定。

senses.def: to consider that something is true

examples.en: I still hold that the government's economic policies are mistaken.
examples.zh: 我仍然认为政府的经济政策是错误的。

examples.en: Parents will be held responsible for their children's behaviour.
examples.zh: 父母将要对孩子的行为负责。

examples.en: These vases are held to be the finest examples of Greek art.
examples.zh: 这些花瓶被视为希腊艺术的最佳典范。

senses.def: to be in close contact with the road and easy to control, especially when driven fast
to continue to move in a particular direction
to make a note continue for a particular time
be able to drink a reasonable amount of alcohol without becoming drunk

examples.en: I can hold my drink as well as anyone.
examples.zh: 我的酒量不比任何人差。

senses.def: to win a game in which you are serving
senses.zh: 保住发球局，保发（发球方在该局获胜）

examples.en: Zverev held serve to take the set.
examples.zh: 兹维列夫保住发球胜盘。

examples.en: Halep held to love.
examples.zh: 哈勒普坚持爱。

senses.def: used to tell somebody to stop doing something or not to do something

examples.en: Hold your fire! (= don't shoot)
examples.zh: 别开枪！

examples.en: Hold the front page! (= don't print it until a particular piece of news is available)
examples.zh: 把头版暂时空着！

examples.en: Give me a hot dog, but hold the (= don't give me any) mustard.
examples.zh: 给我来份热狗，但别加芥末。

senses.def: to be true

examples.en: The same argument does not hold good in every case.
examples.zh: 同样的论点并非在所有的情况下都适用。

senses.def: used to ask somebody to wait, or not to move

examples.en: Hold it a second—I don't think everyone's arrived yet.
examples.zh: 请稍候，我想人还没有到齐。

senses.def: to hold somebody/something very tightly because you are afraid
senses.zh: （害怕得）死死抓住不放，紧紧抓住不松手

senses.def: a person cannot be prevented from doing something

examples.en: Once she gets on to the subject of politics there's no holding her.
examples.zh: 她一谈起政治就滔滔不绝。

senses.def: the action of holding somebody/something; the way you are holding somebody/something

examples.en: His hold on her arm tightened.
examples.zh: 他把她的胳膊抓得更紧了。

examples.en: He lost his hold on the rock and was swept away by the tide.
examples.zh: 他没有抓牢岩石，被潮水卷走了。

examples.en: Make sure you've got a steady hold on the camera.
examples.zh: 一定要拿稳相机。

examples.en: She tried to keep hold of the child's hand.
examples.zh: 她尽力拉住那孩子的手不放。

senses.def: a particular way of holding somebody, especially in a fight or in a sport such as wrestling
senses.zh: 压，握，锁，扣（尤指打斗或摔跤等运动的招式）

examples.en: He still had me in a tight hold.
examples.zh: 他仍然紧紧锁住我。

examples.en: The wrestler put his opponent into a head hold.
examples.zh: 那位摔跤手给对手来了个头部擒拿。

examples.en: The exercise called for the recruits to get out of various holds.
examples.zh: 演习要求新兵摆脱各种困境。

senses.group: in sport/a fight 体育运动；打斗

senses.def: influence, power or control over somebody/something

examples.en: He struggled to get a hold of his anger.
examples.zh: 他竭力压制自己的怒火。

examples.en: What she knew about his past gave her a hold over him.
examples.zh: 她知道他的过去，所以能够控制他。

examples.en: This crisis had weakened his hold on power.
examples.zh: 这场危机削弱了他对权力的控制。

senses.def: a place where you can put your hands or feet when climbing
senses.zh: 支撑点（可手攀或脚踏的地方）

examples.en: She put her foot firmly in the hold and pulled herself up.
examples.zh: 她把脚牢牢地踩在船舱里，然后把自己拉了起来。

senses.def: the part of a ship or plane where the goods being carried are stored
to have or take somebody/something in your hands

examples.en: He caught hold of her wrists so she couldn't get away.
examples.zh: 他抓住她的手腕，使她无法挣脱。

examples.en: Lee got hold of the dog by its collar.
examples.zh: 李拉住了狗的项圈。

examples.en: Quick, grab a hold of that rope.
examples.zh: 快，抓住那条绳子。

examples.en: Gently, she took hold of the door handle and turned it.
examples.zh: 她轻轻地握住门把手扭动了它。

senses.def: to contact or find somebody

examples.en: Where have you been? I've been trying to get hold of you all day.
examples.zh: 你去哪了？我一整天都在找你。

examples.en: Eventually, we got hold of Dan in New York.
examples.zh: 最终，我们在纽约联系到了丹。

examples.en: Do you know where I can get hold of a good plumber?
examples.zh: 你知道我在哪里可以找到一个好的水管工吗？

senses.def: to find something that you want or need

examples.en: I need to get hold of Tom's address.
examples.zh: 我需要找到汤姆的地址。

examples.en: It's almost impossible to get hold of tickets for the final.
examples.zh: 几乎不可能搞到决赛的门票。

examples.en: The police do not know how the boy got hold of the knife.
examples.zh: 警方不知道男孩是如何拿到这把刀的。

examples.en: How did the press get hold of the story?
examples.zh: 新闻界是怎么得到这个消息的？

senses.def: to learn or understand something
to understand something in the wrong way
with no rules or limits on what somebody is allowed to do

examples.en: There will be no holds barred in his interview with the president this evening.
examples.zh: 今晚他将在采访总统时毫无保留。

senses.def: delayed until a later time or date

examples.en: She put her career on hold to have a baby.
examples.zh: 她中断了事业以便生孩子。

examples.en: The project is on hold until more money is available.
examples.zh: 这项工程暂停，等到有更多的资金时再进行。

examples.en: The department has placed its plans on hold pending the results of the elections.
examples.zh: 该部门已搁置其计划，等待选举结果。

senses.def: if a person on the phone is put on hold

examples.en: I’ll just pop you on hold.
examples.zh: 我会让你暂停。

senses.def: to begin to have complete control over somebody/something; to become very strong
senses.zh: 开始完全控制；变得十分强大

examples.en: Panic took hold of him and he couldn't move.
examples.zh: 他突然惊慌得动弹不得。

examples.en: They got out of the house just before the flames took hold.
examples.zh: 他们就在大火吞噬房子之前逃了出来。

examples.en: It is best to treat the disease early before it takes a hold.
examples.zh: 最好还是病向浅中医。

note.en: Most idioms containing hold are at the entries for the nouns and adjectives in the idioms, for example hold the fort is at fort.
note.zh: 大多数含 hold 的习语，都可在该等习语中的名词及形容词相关词条找到，如 hold the fort 在词条 fort 下。

senses.def: to be true

examples.en: The same argument does not hold good in every case.
examples.zh: 同样的论点并非在所有的情况下都适用。

senses.def: used to ask somebody to wait, or not to move

examples.en: Hold it a second—I don't think everyone's arrived yet.

senses.def: a person cannot be prevented from doing something

examples.en: Once she gets on to the subject of politics there's no holding her.
examples.zh: 她一谈起政治就滔滔不绝。

examples.zh: 他抓住她的手腕，使她无法挣脱。

examples.en: Lee got hold of the dog by its collar.
examples.zh: 李拉住了狗的项圈。

examples.en: Do you know where I can get hold of a good plumber?
examples.zh: 你知道我在哪里可以找到一个好的水管工吗？

examples.en: It's almost impossible to get hold of tickets for the final.

examples.en: The police do not know how the boy got hold of the knife.
examples.zh: 警方不知道男孩是如何拿到这把刀的。

examples.en: How did the press get hold of the story?
examples.zh: 新闻界是怎么得到这个消息的？

senses.def: to learn or understand something

examples.zh: 今晚他将在采访总统时毫无保留。

examples.zh: 我会让你暂停。

senses.zh: 开始完全控制；变得十分强大

examples.zh: 他突然惊慌得动弹不得。

examples.en: They got out of the house just before the flames took hold.
examples.zh: 他们就在大火吞噬房子之前逃了出来。

examples.zh: 最好还是病向浅中医。

synonyms.words: hold on ▪ cling ▪ clutch ▪ grip ▪ grasp ▪ clasp ▪ hang on

intro.en: These words all mean to have somebody/​something in your hands or arms.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示抓住、抱住。

items.def: to have somebody/​something in your hand or arms:
items.zh: 指抓住、抱住、托住、夹住

examples.en: She was holding a large box.
examples.zh: 她提着一只大箱子。

items.def: to continue to hold somebody/​something; to put your hand on somebody/​something and not take your hand away:
items.zh: 指抓紧、不放开

examples.en: Hold on and don’t let go until I say so.
examples.zh: 握紧，我让你松手时才松开。

items.def: to hold on to somebody/​something tightly, especially with your whole body:
items.zh: 尤指用身体紧抱、紧握、抓紧

examples.en: Survivors clung to pieces of floating debris.
examples.zh: 生还者紧紧抱住漂浮在水面上的残骸。

items.def: to hold somebody/​something tightly, especially in your hand; to take hold of something suddenly:
items.zh: 尤指用手抓紧、紧握、抱紧、突然抓住

examples.en: She stood there, the flowers still clutched in her hand.
examples.zh: 她站在那里，手里仍然紧握着花束。

items.def: to hold on to something very tightly with your hand:
items.zh: 指用手紧握、紧抓

examples.en: Grip the rope as tightly as you can.
examples.zh: 尽可能紧紧抓住绳子。

items.def: to take a strong hold of somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指抓紧、抓牢

examples.en: He grasped my hand and shook it warmly.
examples.zh: 他热情地抓着我的手握了起来。

items.def: (formal) to hold somebody/​something tightly in your hand or in your arms:
items.zh: 指紧握、攥紧、抱紧

examples.en: They clasped hands (= held each other’s hands).
examples.zh: 他们相互紧握着对方的手。

items.def: to hold on to something very tightly, especially in order to support yourself or stop yourself from falling:
items.zh: 尤指为支撑自己或防止跌倒而紧紧抓住某物

examples.en: Hang on tight. We’re off!
examples.zh: 抓紧，我们出发了！

senses.def: to have all the advantages in a situation

examples.en: The union soon realized that the management held all the aces.
examples.zh: 工会很快意识到管理层掌握着所有王牌。

senses.def: to be able to control a particular situation because you have an advantage over other people
senses.zh: 能控制局势；应付自如；占上风

senses.def: to entertain people by telling them interesting or funny things
senses.zh: （讲趣闻或笑话）使人快乐，逗人乐

examples.en: I met Giles holding court with some tourists in a cafe.
examples.zh: 我在一家咖啡馆遇到了贾尔斯和一些游客。

senses.def: to continue to believe in an idea, etc. despite difficulties
to believe something strongly and not change your mind

examples.en: She held firm to her principles.
examples.zh: 她坚持自己的原则。

senses.def: to be true

examples.en: The same argument does not hold good in every case.
examples.zh: 同样的论点并非在所有的情况下都适用。

senses.def: used to ask somebody to wait, or not to move

examples.en: Hold it a second—I don't think everyone's arrived yet.
examples.zh: 请稍候，我想人还没有到齐。

senses.def: to not support or be in favour of somebody/something
senses.zh: 不支持，不赞成（某人或某事）；不为…辩护

examples.en: I hold no brief for either side in this war.
examples.zh: 这次战争的双方我都不支持。

hold out little hope: @@@LINK=hold out little, etc. hope (of something/that…) | not hold out any, much, etc. hope (of something/that…)
hold out little hope of: @@@LINK=hold out little, etc. hope (of something/that…) | not hold out any, much, etc. hope (of something/that…)
hold out little hope of something: @@@LINK=hold out little, etc. hope (of something/that…) | not hold out any, much, etc. hope (of something/that…)
hold out little hope of sth: @@@LINK=hold out little, etc. hope (of something/that…) | not hold out any, much, etc. hope (of something/that…)
hold out little hope of that…: @@@LINK=hold out little, etc. hope (of something/that…) | not hold out any, much, etc. hope (of something/that…)
hold out little hope that…: @@@LINK=hold out little, etc. hope (of something/that…) | not hold out any, much, etc. hope (of something/that…)

senses.def: to offer little, etc. reason for believing that something will happen

examples.en: The doctors did not hold out much hope for her recovery.
examples.zh: 医生们对她的痊愈不抱什么希望。

examples.en: I don't hold out much hope of finding a buyer.
examples.zh: 我不太指望能找到买主。

hold out little, etc. hope (of something.word: hold out little, etc. hope (of something/that…) | not hold out any, much, etc. hope (of something/that…)

senses.def: to keep somebody as a prisoner and demand that other people pay you an amount of money before you set them free
to take action that puts somebody in a very difficult situation in order to force them to do what you want

examples.en: The company refused to be held to ransom by the union.
examples.zh: 这家公司拒绝了工会的要挟。

senses.def: to care very much for somebody/something; to value somebody/something highly
senses.zh: 非常关心；十分看重；极为珍视

examples.en: He had destroyed everything we held dear.
examples.zh: 他把我们珍视的一切都给毁了。

senses.def: to give somebody support in a difficult situation
senses.zh: （困难时）给某人支持；拉某人一把

examples.en: Do you want me to come along and hold your hand?
examples.zh: 你想让我过去帮你一把吗？

senses.def: to speak during a discussion or debate, especially for a long time so that nobody else is able to say anything
senses.zh: 发言；长篇大论地发言（尤指使他人无法发言）

examples.en: She held the floor for over an hour.
examples.zh: 她发言占了一个多小时。

senses.def: to have the responsibility for something or care of somebody while other people are away or out
senses.zh: 代为负责（某事）；代为照看（某人）

examples.en: Why not have a day off? I'll hold the fort for you.
examples.zh: 你干吗不休息一天？我来替你当班。

senses.def: to hope that your plans will be successful or that something will take place in the way that you want it to
senses.zh: 希望（计划）成功；期望如愿以偿

examples.en: Let's hold thumbs that you get the job.
examples.zh: 我们期望你如愿得到这份工作啊。

hold up your head: @@@LINK=hold your head high | hold up your head

senses.def: to stop breathing for a short time

examples.en: Hold your breath and count to ten.
examples.zh: 屏住呼吸，数到十。

examples.en: How long can you hold your breath for?
examples.zh: 你能屏气多长时间？

senses.def: to be nervous while you are waiting for something that you are anxious about

examples.en: He held his breath while the results were read out.
examples.zh: 宣读结果时，他屏住了呼吸。

senses.def: people say don’t hold your breath!
senses.zh: 别眼巴巴等着；有你等的

examples.en: She said she'd do it this week, but don't hold your breath!
examples.zh: 她说她这个星期要干，不过你可别眼巴巴干等！

hold your cards close to your chest: @@@LINK=hold/keep/play your cards close to your chest
hold your head high: @@@LINK=hold your head high | hold up your head

senses.def: to be proud of or not feel ashamed about something that you have done

examples.en: She managed to hold her head high and ignore what people were saying.
examples.zh: 她勉力昂首挺胸，不理会人家的闲言碎语。

hold your head high | hold up your head.word: hold your head high | hold up your head

senses.def: used to tell somebody that they should wait a moment and not be so excited that they take action without thinking about it first
to remain in a strong position when somebody is attacking you, competing with you, etc.
senses.zh: 坚守立场；（使自己）立于不败之地

examples.en: Business isn't good but we're managing to hold our own.
examples.zh: 生意不景气，但我们正设法坚持下去。

examples.en: She can hold her own against anybody in an argument.
examples.zh: 她在辩论中不会让任何人占上风。

examples.en: The patient is holding her own although she is still very sick.
examples.zh: 这名病人的病情仍然很重，但她还在坚持着。

senses.def: to say nothing although you would like to give your opinion
to say nothing although you would like to give your opinion
to allow something that somebody has done to make you have a lower opinion of them
senses.zh: 因某人的所为而对其评价低

examples.en: I admit I made a mistake—but don't hold it against me.
examples.zh: 我承认我做错了，但别因此而看不起我。

senses.def: to prevent somebody/something from moving forward or crossing something

examples.en: The police were unable to hold back the crowd.
examples.zh: 警察阻拦不住人群。

examples.en: The dam was not strong enough to hold back the flood waters.
examples.zh: 水坝不太坚固，挡不住洪水。

senses.def: to prevent the progress or development of somebody/something

examples.en: Do you think that mixed-ability classes hold back the better students?
examples.zh: 你认为把能力参差的学生混在一班会妨碍高水平学生进步吗？

examples.en: We are determined that nothing should hold back the peace talks.
examples.zh: 我们决心不让任何事情阻碍和谈。

senses.def: to not tell somebody something they want or need to know

examples.en: to hold back information
examples.zh: 隐瞒信息

examples.en: I think he's holding something back. I'm sure he knows more than he admits.
examples.zh: 我认为他有所保留。我确信他知道的比他承认的还要多。

senses.def: to stop yourself from expressing how you really feel
senses.zh: 抑制，控制（感情等）；不露声色

examples.en: She just managed to hold back her anger.
examples.zh: 她勉强压住了自己的怒火。

examples.en: He bravely held back his tears.
examples.zh: 他勇敢地没让眼泪流出来。

senses.def: to hesitate or to make somebody hesitate to act or speak

examples.en: She held back, not knowing how to break the terrible news.
examples.zh: 她踌躇着，不知如何说出这一可怕的消息。

examples.en: I wanted to tell him the truth, but something held me back.
examples.zh: 我本想告诉他真实情况，但又开不了口。

senses.def: to prevent somebody from moving, using force

examples.en: It took three men to hold him down.
examples.zh: 三个人才把他制伏了。

senses.def: to prevent somebody from having their freedom or rights
senses.zh: 剥夺某人的自由（或权利）

examples.en: The people are held down by a repressive regime.
examples.zh: 人民受到了专制政权的压迫。

senses.def: to keep something at a low level

examples.en: The rate of inflation must be held down.
examples.zh: 通货膨胀率必须控制在低水平。

senses.def: to keep a job for some time

examples.en: He was unable to hold down a job after his breakdown.
examples.zh: 他精神崩溃以后就没能保住工作。

senses.def: to limit something, especially a noise

examples.en: Hold it down, will you? I'm trying to sleep!
examples.zh: 小点声行吗？我要睡觉！

senses.def: to speak for a long time about something in a way that other people might find boring
to not express how you really feel

examples.en: to hold in your feelings/anger
examples.zh: 不流露感情；忍住怒火

senses.def: to not start

examples.en: The rain held off just long enough for us to have our picnic.
examples.zh: 雨还好，等到我们用完野餐才下起来。

senses.def: to not do something immediately

examples.en: Many buyers are holding off until prices are lower.
examples.zh: 许多买家在推迟购买，等待价格降下来。

examples.en: Could you hold off making your decision for a few days?
examples.zh: 你能推迟几天再作决定吗？

senses.def: to stop somebody/something defeating you

examples.en: She held off all the last-minute challengers and won the race in a new record time.
examples.zh: 她最后一刻甩掉了所有对手，以新的纪录赢得了赛跑冠军。

senses.def: used to tell somebody to wait or stop

examples.en: Hold on a minute while I get my breath back.
examples.zh: 稍等一下，让我喘口气。

examples.en: Hold on! This isn't the right road.
examples.zh: 等一下！这条路不对。

senses.def: to survive in a difficult or dangerous situation
senses.zh: （在困境或危险中）坚持住，挺住

examples.en: They managed to hold on until help arrived.
examples.zh: 他们勉强坚持到救援到来。

senses.def: used on the phone to ask somebody to wait until they can talk to the person they want

examples.en: Can you hold on? I'll see if he's here.
examples.zh: 等一下行吗？我去看看他在不在。

senses.def: to keep something in position

examples.en: These nuts and bolts hold the wheels on.
examples.zh: 这些螺母和螺栓把轮子固定住了。

examples.en: The knob is only held on by sticky tape.
examples.zh: 这个旋钮只是用胶带粘住的。

senses.def: to keep holding something/somebody

examples.en: Hold on and don't let go until I say so.
examples.zh: 握紧，等我让你松手时再松开。

examples.en: He held on to the back of the chair to stop himself from falling.
examples.zh: 他扶住椅子后背，以免摔倒。

examples.en: It’s very windy—you’d better hold on to your hat.
examples.zh: 风很大，你最好按住帽子。

senses.def: to keep holding something/somebody

senses.zh: 保住（优势）；不送（或不卖）某物

examples.zh: 你应该继续保留住你的石油股份。

examples.en: She took an early lead in the race and held on to it for nine laps.
examples.zh: 赛跑一开始她便冲到了前面，并一直保持领先了九圈。

senses.def: to keep something for somebody else or for longer than usual
senses.zh: （替别人或更长时间地）保存某物

examples.en: I'll hold on to your mail for you until you get back.
examples.zh: 你回来之前我将一直替你保管邮件。

senses.def: to keep something that is an advantage for you; to not give or sell something to somebody else
senses.zh: 保住（优势）；不送（或不卖）某物

examples.zh: 赛跑一开始她便冲到了前面，并一直保持领先了九圈。

examples.en: I'll hold on to your mail for you until you get back.
examples.zh: 你回来之前我将一直替你保管邮件。

senses.def: to last, especially in a difficult situation

examples.en: We can stay here for as long as our supplies hold out.
examples.zh: 我们可以在这里一直待到我们的储备品用完。

senses.def: to resist or survive in a dangerous or difficult situation

examples.en: The rebels held out in the mountains for several years.
examples.zh: 反叛分子在山区顽抗了几年。

senses.def: to offer a chance, hope or possibility of something
senses.zh: 提供机会；给予希望；使有可能

examples.en: Doctors hold out little hope of her recovering.
examples.zh: 医生对她的痊愈不抱很大的希望。

senses.def: to put your hand or arms, or something in your hand, towards somebody, especially to give or offer something
senses.zh: 伸出手（或胳膊）；递出东西

examples.en: I held out my hand to steady her.
examples.zh: 我伸出手扶住她。

examples.en: He held out the keys and I took them.
examples.zh: 他伸手把钥匙递过来，我接了。

senses.def: to cause a delay in reaching an agreement because you hope you will gain something

examples.en: The union negotiators are holding out for a more generous pay settlement.
examples.zh: 工会谈判代表拖延着，以期达成较优厚的薪酬协议。

senses.def: to refuse to tell or give somebody something
to not deal with something immediately; to leave something to be dealt with later

examples.en: The matter was held over until the next meeting.
examples.zh: 这件事被推迟到下次会议。

senses.def: to show a film, play, etc. for longer than planned

examples.zh: 这部电影十分受欢迎，因此又继续放映了一周。

examples.zh: 联赛积分领先的队伍被逼成了 0:0 的平局。

senses.def: to remain, or to keep something, united

examples.en: A political party should hold together.
examples.zh: 一个政党应当团结一致。

examples.en: It's usually the drummer who holds the band together.
examples.zh: 通常是鼓手将乐队凝聚在一起。

senses.def: to be logical or consistent

examples.en: Their case doesn't hold together when you look at the evidence.
examples.zh: 你看一下证据就知道他们的论点前后不一致。

senses.def: if a machine or an object holds together

senses.zh: 支持住；承受住；支撑得住

examples.en: She's holding up well under the pressure.
examples.zh: 她承受住了压力。

senses.def: to support somebody/something and stop them from falling
to delay or block the movement or progress of somebody/something

examples.en: An accident is holding up traffic.
examples.zh: 一场事故造成了交通阻塞。

examples.en: The project was held up by various legal problems.
examples.zh: 这项工程因各种法律问题而受阻。

senses.def: to use or present somebody/something as an example
senses.zh: 举出（例子）；提出（作为榜样）

examples.en: She's always holding up her children as models of good behaviour.
examples.zh: 她总是举例说自己的孩子表现如何好。

examples.en: His ideas were held up to ridicule.
examples.zh: 他的想法被当成了笑料。

senses.def: to steal from a bank, shop, etc. using a gun

examples.en: Masked men held up a security van in South London yesterday.
examples.zh: 几个蒙面男子昨天在伦敦南部抢劫了一辆押款车。

senses.def: a situation in which something is prevented from happening for a short time

examples.en: What's the hold-up?
examples.zh: 遇到什么障碍了？

examples.en: We should finish by tonight, barring hold-ups.
examples.zh: 倘若没有延误，我们应该在今晚完工。

examples.en: Sorry I'm late. There was a hold-up on the motorway.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我来晚了。公路上堵车了。

senses.def: an act of stealing from a bank, etc. using a gun

examples.en: a hold-up at the local supermarket
examples.zh: 在当地超市被拦

senses.def: stockings
to agree with something

examples.en: I don't hold with the use of force.
examples.zh: 我不赞成使用武力。

examples.en: They don't hold with letting children watch as much TV as they want.
examples.zh: 他们不赞成让孩子随心所欲地看太多电视。

senses.def: to hold somebody/something very tightly because you are afraid
senses.zh: （害怕得）死死抓住不放，紧紧抓住不松手

senses.def: to prevent an enemy from coming close or a problem from having a bad effect
senses.zh: 不让（敌人）接近；防止（问题）恶化

examples.en: I'm trying to keep my creditors at bay.
examples.zh: 我在竭力避开债主。

examples.en: Charlotte bit her lip to hold the tears at bay.
examples.zh: 夏洛特咬住嘴唇不让眼泪流出来。

senses.def: to keep something under control so that it does not spread or get worse

examples.en: Maggie managed to keep her temper in check.
examples.zh: 玛吉设法控制住自己的脾气。

examples.en: The epidemic was held in check by widespread vaccination.
examples.zh: 这种传染病靠广泛的预防注射已受到控制。

examples.en: You need to keep your temper in check!
examples.zh: 你得控制自己的脾气！

senses.zh: 承认犯错；承认对坏事负有责任

examples.zh: 我必须承认有些问题完全是我自己的错。

examples.en: The solicitor confirmed that his clients were holding their hands up to the offences.
examples.zh: 律师证实，他的当事人对这些罪行表示抗议。

senses.def: to continue with your opinions or intentions when somebody is opposing you and wants you to change
senses.zh: 坚持主张；坚持意图；坚持立场；不让步

examples.en: Don't let him persuade you—stand your ground.
examples.zh: 别听他的，坚持自己的主张吧。

examples.en: She held her ground in the debate.
examples.zh: 她在辩论中坚持自己的立场。

senses.def: to face a situation and refuse to run away
senses.zh: 坚守阵地；不撤退；不退却

examples.en: It is not easy to hold your ground in front of someone with a gun.
examples.zh: 面对持枪者而不退缩并不容易。

senses.def: a large bag made of strong cloth or soft leather, used when you are travelling for carrying clothes, etc.

examples.zh: 他在花园里挖了个深坑。

examples.zh: 炸弹在地上炸了一个大坑。

examples.en: The hook should be honed to a needle-sharp point.
examples.zh: 钩子应磨至针尖。

senses.def: to direct your thoughts or attention towards something

examples.en: The detectives honed in on the suspect.
examples.zh: 侦探们锁定了嫌疑人。

senses.def: to aim at something and move straight towards it

examples.en: The missile honed in on the target.
examples.zh: 导弹瞄准了目标。

senses.def: always telling the truth, and never stealing or cheating

examples.en: an honest man/woman
examples.zh: 诚实的男人／女人

examples.en: They were honest, hard-working people, trying to farm their land.
examples.zh: 他们是诚实、勤劳的人，努力耕种自己的土地。

senses.def: not hiding the truth about something

examples.en: Are you being completely honest about your feelings?
examples.zh: 你丝毫没有隐瞒你的感情吗？

examples.en: Thank you for being so honest with me.
examples.zh: 感谢你对我这么坦诚。

examples.en: Give me your honest opinion.
examples.zh: 告诉我你的真实意见。

examples.en: He gave an honest answer to a difficult question.
examples.zh: 他诚实地回答了一个难题。

examples.en: We need to have more open and honest discussions about mental health.
examples.zh: 我们需要对心理健康进行更公开和诚实的讨论。

examples.en: The meeting was described as ‘a frank and honest exchange of views’.
examples.zh: 这次会议被描述为“一次坦诚、诚实的意见交换”。

examples.en: To be honest (= what I really think is), it was one of the worst books I've ever read.
examples.zh: 说实在的，那是我读过的最差的书之一。

examples.en: I'll be honest, I really don't agree with what she did.
examples.zh: 说实话，我真的不同意她的做法。

examples.en: Let's be honest, this plan is not going to work.
examples.zh: 老实说，这个计划行不通。

examples.en: The film has won accolades for being both brutally honest and very funny.
examples.zh: 这部影片既坦率得近乎残酷，又不失趣味，因而赢得了赞誉。

examples.en: If I am perfectly honest, I wasn't expecting much from this album.
examples.zh: 如果我完全诚实的话，我对这张专辑并没有抱太大期望。

examples.en: I just want the honest truth.
examples.zh: 我只想要诚实的事实。

senses.def: showing an honest mind or attitude
senses.zh: 真诚的；显示内心诚意的；表示态度诚恳的

examples.en: She's got an honest face.
examples.zh: 她有一张真诚的面孔。

examples.en: She seems honest enough.
examples.zh: 她看上去很诚实。

examples.en: He made an honest mistake and deserves a second chance.
examples.zh: 他犯了一个无心之过，应该再给他一次机会。

senses.def: earned or resulting from hard work

examples.en: He hasn't done an honest day's work in his life.
examples.zh: 他一辈子从未努力认真干过一天活儿。

examples.en: It's quite a struggle to make an honest living.
examples.zh: 要老老实实地过日子是十分辛苦的。

examples.en: She claimed she was just trying to earn an honest penny.
examples.zh: 她声称自己只是想诚实地赚一分钱。

senses.def: used to emphasize that you are not lying

examples.en: I didn't mean it, honest!
examples.zh: 我不是有意的，真的！

senses.def: used to emphasize that what you are saying is true

examples.zh: 老天爷作证，玛丽，我不是开玩笑。

senses.zh: 与跟自己发生过性关系（尤指已怀孕）的女人结婚

note.zh: 有人认为此处用 God 含冒犯意。

synonyms.words: frank ▪ direct ▪ open ▪ outspoken ▪ straight ▪ blunt

intro.en: These words all describe people saying exactly what they mean without trying to hide feelings, opinions or facts.
intro.zh: 以上各词均形容人坦率、坦诚。

items.def: not hiding the truth about something:
items.zh: 指坦率的、坦诚的

examples.en: Thank you for being so honest with me.
examples.zh: 感谢你对我这么坦诚。

items.def: honest in what you say, sometimes in a way that other people might not like:
items.zh: 指坦率的、直率的（有时可能不讨人喜欢）

examples.en: To be frank with you, I think your son has little chance of passing the exam.
examples.zh: 坦白说，我认为你的儿子不大可能通过考试。

items.def: saying exactly what you mean in a way that nobody can pretend not to understand:
items.zh: 指直接的、直率的、坦率的

examples.en: You’ll have to get used to his direct manner.
examples.zh: 你得慢慢习惯他这种直率的方式。

items.def: (approving) (of a person) not keeping thoughts and feelings hidden:
items.zh: 指为人诚恳的、坦诚的、直率的

examples.en: He was quite open about his reasons for leaving.
examples.zh: 他对离开的原因完全未加隐瞒。

items.def: saying exactly what you think, even if this shocks or offends people:
items.zh: 指直率的、坦诚的、直言不讳的

examples.en: She was outspoken in her criticism of the plan.
examples.zh: 她对该计划的批评直言不讳。

items.def: honest and direct:
items.zh: 指坦诚的、直率的

examples.en: I don’t think you’re being straight with me.
examples.zh: 我觉得你没跟我坦诚相见。

items.def: saying exactly what you think without trying to be polite:
items.zh: 指嘴直的、直言不讳的

examples.en: She has a reputation for blunt speaking.
examples.zh: 她说话出了名的直截了当。

senses.def: used to emphasize that what you are saying is true

examples.en: Honest to God, Mary, I'm not joking.
examples.zh: 老天爷作证，玛丽，我不是开玩笑。

senses.def: used to emphasize that you are not lying

examples.en: I didn't mean it, honest!
examples.zh: 我不是有意的，真的！

senses.def: a person or country that tries to get other people or countries to reach an agreement or to solve a problem, without getting involved with either side
senses.zh: （人际或国际纠纷中的）公正调解者，调停者

senses.def: simple and good
senses.zh: 实实在在的；真正的；地道的

examples.en: honest-to-goodness country food
examples.zh: 真正的乡下食物

senses.def: in an honest way

examples.en: I can't believe he got that money honestly.
examples.zh: 我不相信他是靠正当手段弄到那笔钱的。

senses.def: used to emphasize that what you are saying is true, however surprising it may seem

examples.en: I didn't tell anyone, honestly!
examples.zh: 我确实没告诉过任何人！

examples.en: I honestly can't remember a thing about last night.
examples.zh: 我实在想不起昨晚的事了。

examples.en: You can't honestly expect me to believe that!
examples.zh: 你休想指望我相信那种事！

senses.def: used to show that you think something is bad and are annoyed by it

examples.en: Honestly! Whatever will they think of next?
examples.zh: 真是的！他们接下来还会想出什么？

senses.def: the quality of being honest

examples.en: She answered all my questions with her usual honesty.
examples.zh: 她像平常一样老老实实地回答了我的所有问题。

examples.en: His honesty is not in question.
examples.zh: 他的诚实是毋庸置疑的。

senses.def: used to state a fact or an opinion that, though true, may seem disappointing

examples.en: The book isn't, in all honesty, as good as I expected.
examples.zh: 说实话，这本书并没有我预期的那么好。

examples.en: In all honesty, the book was not as good as I expected.
examples.zh: 说实话，这本书不像我期待的那么好。

examples.en: Who in honesty can blame her?
examples.zh: 说实在的谁能责怪她？

senses.def: a sweet, sticky yellow-brown substance made by bees that is spread on bread, etc. like jam

examples.en: How do bees make honey?
examples.zh: 蜜蜂如何酿蜜？

examples.en: a jar of locally produced honey
examples.zh: 一罐当地酿造的蜂蜜

examples.en: to gather honey from the hive
examples.zh: 从蜂箱中采蜜

senses.def: a way of addressing somebody that you like or love

examples.en: Have you seen my keys, honey?
examples.zh: 你见到我的钥匙了吗，宝贝？

senses.def: a person that you like or love and think is very kind

examples.en: He can be a real honey when he wants to be.
examples.zh: 他高兴的时候挺招人喜欢的。

senses.def: a place where life is pleasant and easy and people are very happy

items.idm: the land of milk and honey

senses.def: a place where life is pleasant and easy and people are very happy

examples.en: He dreamed of emigrating to Canada—the land of milk and honey.
examples.zh: 他梦想移民到加拿大——牛奶和蜂蜜的土地。

senses.def: a well-known breakfast food that consists of small pieces of crisp
senses.zh: Honey Monster Puffs™（蜂蜜怪兽泡芙）：一种著名的早餐食品，由小块的酥脆小麦覆盖着糖制成，然后与牛奶一起食用。它最著名的广告角色是一个大型的毛茸茸的黄色生物，称为“蜂蜜怪兽”。直到2014年为止，它们都被称为Sugar Puffs，但是其中糖的含量却减少了，因此他们被改名为Honey Monster Puffs，因为客户不再被糖的吸引所吸引。

senses.def: (of a person) speaking sweetly or softly, or in a way that is intended to please, often without being sincere; (of a statement, piece of text, etc.) written or spoken in this way
senses.zh: 甜言蜜语的；花言巧语的

examples.en: As a handsome, honey-tongued politician, he convinced the nation that going to war was a good idea.
examples.zh: 作为一名相貌英俊、巧舌如簧的政客，他使国民相信开战是个好主意。

examples.en: a honey-tongued lie
examples.zh: 甜言蜜语的谎话

examples.en: His beautiful verses contain echoes of Shakespeare’s honey-tongued romantic poetry.
examples.zh: 他美丽的诗句中有对莎士比亚甜蜜恭维的情诗的模仿。

senses.def: a bee that makes honey

examples.en: More than 130 agricultural plants in the US are pollinated by honeybees.
examples.zh: 美国有超过 130 种农业植物通过蜜蜂授粉。

senses.def: a structure of cells with six sides, made by bees for holding their honey
filled with holes, tunnels, etc.
senses.zh: 蜂窝状的；多洞的；多孔道的

examples.en: The cliffs are honeycombed with caves.
examples.zh: 悬崖上布满了蜂窝状的洞穴。

senses.def: a type of melon
soft and intended to please, but often not sincere
senses.zh: 柔顺讨好的；甜言蜜语的

examples.en: She spoke in honeyed tones.
examples.zh: 她用甜蜜的语气说话。

examples.en: ‘Of course I love you, darling,’ she said in honeyed tones.
examples.zh: “我当然爱你，亲爱的，”她用甜蜜的语气说道。

senses.def: tasting or smelling like honey

examples.en: We sniffed the honeyed air.
examples.zh: 我们嗅着甜蜜的空气。

examples.en: The walls are made of a honeyed stone.
examples.zh: 墙壁是用蜂蜜石砌成的。

senses.def: a holiday taken by a couple who have just got married

examples.en: We went to Venice for our honeymoon.
examples.zh: 我们去威尼斯度的蜜月。

examples.en: They're on their honeymoon.
examples.zh: 他们正在度蜜月。

examples.en: They go on honeymoon the day after the wedding.
examples.zh: 他们在婚礼的第二天就去度蜜月。

senses.def: the period of time at the start of a new activity when nobody is criticized and people feel enthusiastic

examples.en: The honeymoon period for the government is now over.
examples.zh: 这届政府的蜜月期现在已经过去了。

senses.def: to spend your honeymoon

examples.en: They are honeymooning in Paris.
examples.zh: 他们正在巴黎度蜜月。

senses.def: a person who is on their honeymoon

examples.en: The Seychelles is the perfect place for honeymooners.
examples.zh: 塞舌尔是度蜜月的理想之地。

senses.def: a place, thing or person that a lot of people are attracted to
senses.zh: 富有吸引力的地方（或事物、人）

examples.en: The toy section of the store is a honeypot for children.
examples.zh: 商店的玩具区是儿童的蜜罐。

examples.en: It is possible to escape the tourist honeypots by heading north.
examples.zh: 向北行驶可以逃离旅游蜜罐。

senses.def: a climbing plant with white, yellow or pink flowers with a sweet smell
senses.zh: 忍冬，金银花（蔓生，开白色、黄色或粉红色花，气味芬芳）

examples.en: She rushed from the room at the sound of the taxi honking.
examples.zh: 一听到出租车的喇叭声她就从房间里冲了出来。

examples.en: Why did he honk at me?
examples.zh: 他为什么冲我按喇叭？

examples.en: People honked their horns as they drove past.
examples.zh: 人们开车经过时大按喇叭。

senses.zh: 杭基汤克音乐，酒吧爵士乐（用钢琴演奏的活泼爵士乐）

examples.en: a honky-tonk piano/singer
examples.zh: 下流酒吧钢琴/歌手
