senses.zh: 檀香山（美国夏威夷州首府，瓦胡岛东南海岸的主要港口）

senses.def: great respect for somebody

examples.en: the guest of honor (= the most important one)
examples.zh: (正餐等的)主客,贵宾

examples.en: the seat/place of honor (= given to the most important guest)
examples.zh: 荣誉座位/位置（= 给予最重要的客人）

examples.en: They stood in silence as a mark of honor to her.
examples.zh: 他们肃立以示对她的敬意。

examples.en: This biography does great honor to the poet's achievements.
examples.zh: 这本传记对诗人的成就给予了极大的赞扬。

senses.def: something that you are very pleased or proud to do because people are showing you great respect

examples.en: It was a great honor to be invited here today.
examples.zh: 今天承蒙邀请到此，深感荣幸。

examples.en: It was my honor and privilege to be Helen's friend.
examples.zh: 能够成为海伦的朋友是我的荣幸。

examples.en: It is a great honor to represent my country at the Olympics.
examples.zh: 能够代表我的国家参加奥运会是一种莫大的荣誉。

senses.def: the quality of knowing and doing what is morally right

examples.en: a man of honor
examples.zh: 守信义的人

examples.en: a sense of honor
examples.zh: 荣誉感

examples.en: Proving his innocence has become a matter of honor.
examples.zh: 证实他的清白已经成了一件道义上的事。

senses.def: a good reputation; respect from other people

examples.en: upholding the honor of your country
examples.zh: 捍卫祖国的荣誉

examples.en: The family honor is at stake.
examples.zh: 家族名誉岌岌可危。

senses.def: a person or thing that causes others to respect and admire something/somebody
senses.zh: 引起尊敬（或尊重、崇敬）的人（或事物）

examples.en: She is an honor to the profession.
examples.zh: 她是这个职业的荣耀。

senses.def: an award, official title, etc. given to somebody as a reward for something that they have done
senses.zh: （为表扬某人的）奖励，荣誉称号，头衔

examples.en: to win the highest honor
examples.zh: 赢得最高荣誉

examples.en: She received nearly every honor bestowed upon a poet.
examples.zh: 她几乎获得了授予诗人的所有荣誉。

examples.en: He was buried with full military honors (= with a special military service as a sign of respect).
examples.zh: 他有经营/开办企业所必需的技能。

examples.en: He wears his scars like badges of honor (= rewards that you can see).
examples.zh: 他把伤疤当作荣誉的象征。

senses.def: a university course that is of a higher level than a basic course (in the US also used to describe a class in school that is at a higher level than other classes)
senses.zh: 大学荣誉学位课程；（美国学校的）优等班

examples.en: an honors degree/course
examples.zh: 荣誉学位／课程

examples.en: a First Class Honors degree
examples.zh: 一级荣誉学位

examples.en: I took an honors class in English.
examples.zh: 我选了一个英语优等班课程。

senses.def: if you pass an exam or graduate from a university or school with honors
a title of respect used when talking to or about a judge or a US mayor
senses.zh: 法官大人；（美国）市长阁下

examples.en: No more questions, Your Honor.
examples.zh: 没有其他问题了，法官大人。

senses.def: the cards that have the highest value
to do something to make somebody feel very proud and pleased
senses.zh: 使增光；赏光；给…带来荣誉

examples.en: Would you do me the honor of dining with me?
examples.zh: 你能赏光和我一块吃饭吗？

senses.def: to perform a social duty or ceremony, such as pouring drinks, making a speech, etc.
senses.zh: 履行社交责任；执行仪式

examples.en: Would you do the honors and draw the winning ticket?
examples.zh: 能劳驾为我们抽出获奖的票吗？

senses.def: to be given the opportunity to do something that makes you feel proud and happy
senses.zh: 得到某殊荣；有幸做某事

examples.en: May I have the honor of the next dance?
examples.zh: 能赏光和我跳下一曲舞吗？

examples.en: She had the honor of being the first living artist to have her work exhibited in the Louvre.
examples.zh: 她有幸成为第一位在卢浮宫展出作品的在世艺术家。

examples.en: I had the rare honor of being allowed into the artist's studio.
examples.zh: 我曾极有幸地获准进入那位艺术家的工作室。

examples.en: Max was given the dubious honor (= it may not really have made him feel proud and happy) of organizing the children's party.
examples.zh: 马克斯得到了为孩子们组织聚会这一所谓的殊荣。

senses.def: used to say that even criminals have standards of behaviour that they respect
to feel that you must do something because of your sense of moral duty

examples.en: He felt honor-bound to help her.
examples.zh: 他觉得在道义上应该帮助她。

senses.def: no particular person, team, etc. is doing better than the others in a competition, an argument, etc.
in order to show great respect for somebody/something

examples.en: a ceremony in honor of those killed in the explosion
examples.zh: 纪念爆炸中遇难者的仪式

examples.en: A banquet was held in her honor.
examples.zh: 为她举行了一场宴会。

senses.def: used to promise very seriously that you will do something or that something is true
senses.zh: 用人格担保；以名誉担保

examples.en: I swear on my honor that I knew nothing about this.
examples.zh: 我以人格担保我根本不知道这件事。

senses.def: to be trusted to do something

examples.en: You're on your honor not to go into my room.
examples.zh: 依你的人格，相信你不会进我的房间。

senses.def: a thing that somebody considers to be very important for their honour or reputation
to do something that shows great respect for somebody/something

examples.en: It was a simple ceremony to honor the Goddess of water.
examples.zh: 这是一个简单的仪式，以纪念水之女神。

examples.en: our honored guests
examples.zh: 我们的贵宾

examples.en: The President honored us with a personal visit.
examples.zh: 总统亲临，使我们感到荣幸。

examples.en: I'm glad to see that you've decided to honor us with your presence!
examples.zh: 很高兴看到你已决定大驾光临！

examples.en: Actors and musicians gathered to honor McGrath's memory with a performance of his work.
examples.zh: 一众演员和音乐家聚在一起，纪念这位已故歌手。

senses.def: to give public praise, an award or a title to somebody for something they have done
senses.zh: 给予表扬（或奖励、头衔、称号）

examples.en: She has never been properly honored in her own country.
examples.zh: 她在自己的国家从未受到过适当的荣誉。

examples.en: He has been honored with an award for his charity work.
examples.zh: 他因其慈善工作而荣获奖项。

examples.en: The town has honored his bravery by erecting a memorial.
examples.zh: 这个城镇为了表彰他的勇敢，建立了一座纪念碑。

senses.def: to do what you have agreed or promised to do

examples.en: I have every intention of honoring our contract.
examples.zh: 我完全愿意执行我们的合约。

examples.en: She is determined to honor her husband's dying wish.
examples.zh: 她决心实现丈夫的遗愿。

examples.en: They have failed to honor the peace agreement.
examples.zh: 他们未能履行和平协议。

senses.def: to feel proud and happy

examples.en: I was honored to have been mentioned in his speech.
examples.zh: 他在讲话中提到了我，真是荣幸。

examples.en: ‘Would you be my best man?’ ‘I'd be honored.’
examples.zh: “你愿意做我的伴郎吗？”“我很荣幸。”

items.idm: do somebody an honor | do somebody the honor (of doing something)

senses.def: to do something to make somebody feel very proud and pleased
senses.zh: 使增光；赏光；给…带来荣誉

examples.en: Would you do me the honor of dining with me?
examples.zh: 你能赏光和我一块吃饭吗？

senses.def: to perform a social duty or ceremony, such as pouring drinks, making a speech, etc.
senses.zh: 履行社交责任；执行仪式

examples.en: Would you do the honors and draw the winning ticket?
examples.zh: 能劳驾为我们抽出获奖的票吗？

senses.def: to be given the opportunity to do something that makes you feel proud and happy
senses.zh: 得到某殊荣；有幸做某事

examples.en: May I have the honor of the next dance?
examples.zh: 能赏光和我跳下一曲舞吗？

examples.en: She had the honor of being the first living artist to have her work exhibited in the Louvre.
examples.zh: 她有幸成为第一位在卢浮宫展出作品的在世艺术家。

examples.en: I had the rare honor of being allowed into the artist's studio.
examples.zh: 我曾极有幸地获准进入那位艺术家的工作室。

examples.en: Max was given the dubious honor (= it may not really have made him feel proud and happy) of organizing the children's party.
examples.zh: 马克斯得到了为孩子们组织聚会这一所谓的殊荣。

senses.def: used to say that even criminals have standards of behaviour that they respect
to feel that you must do something because of your sense of moral duty

examples.en: He felt honor-bound to help her.
examples.zh: 他觉得在道义上应该帮助她。

senses.def: no particular person, team, etc. is doing better than the others in a competition, an argument, etc.

items.idm: in honor of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honor

senses.def: in order to show great respect for somebody/something

examples.en: a ceremony in honor of those killed in the explosion
examples.zh: 纪念爆炸中遇难者的仪式

examples.en: A banquet was held in her honor.
examples.zh: 为她举行了一场宴会。

senses.def: used to promise very seriously that you will do something or that something is true
senses.zh: 用人格担保；以名誉担保

examples.en: I swear on my honor that I knew nothing about this.
examples.zh: 我以人格担保我根本不知道这件事。

senses.def: to be trusted to do something

examples.en: You're on your honor not to go into my room.
examples.zh: 依你的人格，相信你不会进我的房间。

senses.def: a thing that somebody considers to be very important for their honour or reputation
to feel proud and happy

examples.en: I was honored to have been mentioned in his speech.
examples.zh: 他在讲话中提到了我，真是荣幸。

examples.en: ‘Would you be my best man?’ ‘I'd be honored.’
examples.zh: “你愿意做我的伴郎吗？”“我很荣幸。”

senses.def: a list of people who are being praised officially for something they have done
a list of the best students in a college or high school
senses.zh: （大、中学的）优秀生名单，光荣榜

senses.def: (in the US) an organization for students with the best grades at school or college
an agreement in which people are trusted to obey rules
senses.zh: 诚信制度（信赖人能自动守规则的制度）

senses.def: deserving great respect
showing high moral standards
allowing somebody to keep their good name and the respect of others
a title of respect used for an official of high rank
a payment made for somebody’s professional services
given as an honour, without the person having to have the usual qualifications

examples.en: an honorary doctorate/degree
examples.zh: 荣誉博士学位；荣誉学位

senses.def: not paid

examples.en: the honorary president
examples.zh: 名誉校长

examples.en: The post of treasurer is a purely honorary position.
examples.zh: 司库的职位纯属义务性质。

senses.def: treated like a member of a group without actually belonging to it

examples.en: He came to be seen by the family as an honorary grandpa.
examples.zh: 他逐渐被家人视为名誉爷爷。

examples.en: Many people treat their pets almost as honorary humans.
examples.zh: 许多人对待他们的宠物几乎就像对待荣誉的人一样。

senses.def: a person or thing that wins an award

examples.en: The author is a Pulitzer Prize honoree.
examples.zh: 这名作者是普利策奖获得者。

examples.en: It’s a party for the new honorees.
examples.zh: 这是一场为新获奖者举办的派对。

senses.def: showing respect for the person you are speaking to

examples.en: an honorific title
examples.zh: 尊称

senses.def: given to a person as a sign of honour and respect, without their having to take an exam

examples.en: She was awarded a degree honoris causa.
examples.zh: 她获授名誉学位。

senses.def: great respect for somebody

examples.en: the guest of honour (= the most important one)
examples.zh: 贵宾

examples.en: the seat/place of honour (= given to the most important guest)
examples.zh: 上座；上席

examples.en: They stood in silence as a mark of honour to her.
examples.zh: 他们肃立以示对她的敬意。

examples.en: This biography does great honour to the poet's achievements.
examples.zh: 这部传记为诗人的成就增光添彩。

senses.def: something that you are very pleased or proud to do because people are showing you great respect

examples.en: It was a great honour to be invited here today.
examples.zh: 今天承蒙邀请到此，深感荣幸。

examples.en: It is a great honour to represent my country at the Olympics.
examples.zh: 能够代表我的国家参加奥运会是一种莫大的荣誉。

examples.en: It was my honour and privilege to be Helen's friend.
examples.zh: 能够成为海伦的朋友是我的荣幸。

examples.en: The city has the dubious honour (= something that does not make you pleased or proud) of being the road rage capital of Europe.
examples.zh: 这座城市拥有欧洲路怒之都的可疑荣誉（= 一些不会让你高兴或自豪的事情）。

examples.en: She shared the honour of being the season's top scorer with Khadija Shaw.
examples.zh: 她与卡迪嘉·肖 (Khadija Shaw) 分享了本赛季最佳射手的荣誉。

senses.def: the quality of knowing and doing what is morally right

examples.en: a man of honour
examples.zh: 品德高尚的人

examples.en: Proving his innocence has become a matter of honour.
examples.zh: 证实他的清白已经成了一件道义上的事。

senses.def: a good reputation; respect from other people

examples.en: upholding the honour of your country
examples.zh: 捍卫祖国的荣誉

examples.en: The family honour is at stake.
examples.zh: 家族名誉岌岌可危。

senses.def: a person or thing that causes others to respect and admire something/somebody
senses.zh: 引起尊敬（或尊重、崇敬）的人（或事物）

examples.en: She is an honour to the profession.
examples.zh: 她是这一行业的光荣。

senses.def: an award, official title, etc. given to somebody as a reward for something that they have done
senses.zh: （为表扬某人的）奖励，荣誉称号，头衔

examples.en: the New Year’s Honours list (= in Britain, a list of awards and titles given on January 1 each year)
examples.zh: （英国）元旦受勋者名册

examples.en: to receive/win the highest honour
examples.zh: 获得／赢得最高荣誉

examples.en: to bestow an honour on somebody
examples.zh: 授予某人荣誉

examples.en: She received nearly every honour bestowed upon a poet.
examples.zh: 她几乎获得了授予诗人的所有荣誉。

examples.en: He received numerous honours, including the OBE in 1961.
examples.zh: 他获得了无数荣誉，包括 1961 年荣获 OBE 勋章。

examples.en: He was buried with full military honours (= with a special military service as a sign of respect).
examples.zh: 他以隆重的军葬礼下葬。

examples.en: He wears his scars like badges of honour (= rewards that you can see).
examples.zh: 他把伤疤当作荣誉的象征。

senses.def: a university course that is of a higher level than a basic course (in the US also used to describe a class in school that is at a higher level than other classes)
senses.zh: 大学荣誉学位课程；（美国学校的）优等班

examples.en: an honours degree/course
examples.zh: 荣誉学位／课程

examples.en: a First Class Honours degree
examples.zh: 一级荣誉学位

examples.en: I took an honors class in English.
examples.zh: 我选了一个英语优等班课程。

senses.def: if you pass an exam or graduate from a university or school with honours

examples.en: He passed with second-class honours.
examples.zh: 他以二级优等成绩通过了考试。

senses.def: a title of respect used when talking to or about a judge or a US mayor
senses.zh: 法官大人；（美国）市长阁下

examples.en: No more questions, Your Honour.
examples.zh: 没有其他问题了，法官大人。

examples.en: It was a simple ceremony to honour the Goddess of water.
examples.zh: 这是一个简单的仪式，以纪念水之女神。

examples.en: Actors and musicians gathered to honour the memory of the late singer.
examples.zh: 一众演员和音乐家聚在一起，纪念这位已故歌手。

examples.en: The President honoured us with a personal visit.
examples.zh: 总统亲临，使我们感到荣幸。

examples.en: I'm glad to see that you've decided to honour us with your presence!
examples.zh: 很高兴看到你已决定大驾光临！

senses.def: to give public praise, an award or a title to somebody for something they have done
senses.zh: 给予表扬（或奖励、头衔、称号）

examples.en: She has never been properly honoured in her own country.
examples.zh: 她在自己的国家从未受到过适当的荣誉。

examples.en: He was honoured with nearly every prize in the ceramic field.
examples.zh: 他几乎获得了陶瓷领域的所有奖项。

examples.en: They were honoured for their achievements over the past year.
examples.zh: 他们因过去一年所取得的成就而受到表彰。

examples.en: He has been honoured with a knighthood for his scientific work.
examples.zh: 他因科研成就而获授爵士头衔。

examples.en: The exhibition was honored as best show in a public space.
examples.zh: 此展览被誉为公共场所最好的展示。

examples.en: The town has honoured his bravery by erecting a memorial.
examples.zh: 这个城镇为了表彰他的勇敢，建立了一座纪念碑。

senses.def: to do what you have agreed or promised to do

examples.en: I have every intention of honouring our contract.
examples.zh: 我完全愿意执行我们的合约。

examples.en: She is determined to honour her husband’s dying wish.
examples.zh: 她决心实现丈夫的遗愿。

examples.en: They have failed to honour the peace agreement.
examples.zh: 他们未能履行和平协议。

intro.en: These are all words for things that make you happy or that you enjoy.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指令人愉快、高兴的事。

items.def: a thing that makes you happy or satisfied:
items.zh: 乐事；快事

examples.en: the pleasures and pains of everyday life
examples.zh: 日常生活的苦与乐

items.def: a thing or person that brings you great pleasure:
items.zh: 指令人高兴的事或人、乐事、乐趣

examples.en: the delights of living in the country
examples.zh: 生活在乡村的乐趣

items.def: a thing or person that brings you great pleasure or happiness:
items.zh: 指令人高兴的事或人、乐事、乐趣

examples.en: the joys and sorrows of childhood
examples.zh: 童年的欢乐与悲伤

items.def: (rather formal) something that you are proud and lucky to have the opportunity to do:
items.zh: 指荣幸、荣耀、光荣

examples.en: It was a great privilege to hear her sing.
examples.zh: 听她唱歌是莫大的荣幸。

items.def: (informal) a thing that somebody enjoyed or is likely to enjoy very much:
items.zh: 指乐事、乐趣

examples.en: You’ve never been to this area before? Then you’re in for a real treat.
examples.zh: 你以前从来没有到过这一地区？那么你一定会喜之不尽。

items.def: (formal) something that you are very pleased or proud to do because people are showing you great respect:
items.zh: 指荣幸、光荣

examples.en: It was a great honour to be invited here today.
examples.zh: 今天承蒙邀请到此，深感荣幸。

senses.def: a system in which people are trusted to obey rules and not cheat

examples.en: Honour codes make cheating socially unacceptable.
examples.zh: 荣誉准则使作弊行为在社会上变得不可接受。

senses.def: the murder of a relative, usually a girl or woman, because she has done something that is thought to bring shame on her family
senses.zh: 名节处死（在女性礼教很严格的国家或社会中由父﹑兄等处死被认为败坏名节的女性）

examples.en: She was the victim of a so-called ‘honour killing’.
examples.zh: 她是所谓“荣誉谋杀”的受害人。

examples.en: The minister vowed to push through new laws against honour killing.
examples.zh: 这位部长发誓要推动制定反对名誉杀人的新法律。

senses.def: deserving great respect

examples.en: She had a long and honourable career in government.
examples.zh: 她从政时间长，且名声清白。

examples.en: They managed an honourable 2–2 draw.
examples.zh: 他们奋力打成了 2:2 平局，值得敬佩。

examples.en: With a few honourable exceptions, the staff were found to be incompetent.
examples.zh: 除了几个优秀的人以外，其他职员都不能胜任工作。

senses.def: showing high moral standards

examples.en: He was an honourable man who could not lie.
examples.zh: 他是个高尚的人，不会说谎。

senses.def: allowing somebody to keep their good name and the respect of others

examples.en: an honourable compromise
examples.zh: 体面的妥协

examples.en: They urged her to do the honourable thing and resign.
examples.zh: 他们力劝她辞职以保全名节。

examples.en: He received an honourable discharge from the army.
examples.zh: 他获准体面退伍。

senses.def: (in the UK) a title used by a child of some ranks of the nobility

senses.zh: （英国议会议员辩论时相互间的尊称）

examples.en: If my Honourable Friend would give me a chance to answer,…
examples.zh: 如果尊敬的阁下能给我答辩的机会…

examples.en: Would the Honourable Member agree that…?
examples.zh: 尊敬的议员是否同意……？

examples.en: the Honorable Alan Simpson, US senator
examples.zh: 美国参议员艾伦·辛普森

senses.def: special praise given in a competition for work that is of a very high standard but does not win a prize
senses.zh: 荣誉奖，优秀奖，鼓励奖（颁给竞赛中表现优秀但未获奖者）

examples.en: Three other entries received honourable mentions.
examples.zh: 另外三项参赛作品获得荣誉奖。

senses.def: in a way that deserves respect and approval; in a way that shows high moral standards
senses.zh: 诚实地：以值得尊重和认可的方式；表现出很高的道德水平

examples.en: to behave honourably
examples.zh: 行为高尚

senses.def: in a way that allows somebody to keep their good name and the respect of others

examples.en: He was honourably discharged from the army on medical grounds.
examples.zh: 他因健康原因光荣退伍。

senses.def: a person or thing that wins an award

examples.en: The author is a Pulitzer Prize honouree.
examples.zh: 这名作者是普利策奖获得者。

examples.en: It’s a party for the new honourees.
examples.zh: 这是一场为新获奖者举办的派对。

examples.en: Tim Smith BA (Hons)
examples.zh: （荣誉）文学士蒂姆·史密斯

senses.def: noisy excitement, especially about something unimportant
senses.zh: 闹嚷；激动；（尤指）小题大做，大惊小怪

senses.def: strong alcoholic drink, especially something that has been made illegally

examples.zh: 他被扣为人质几近一年。

examples.zh: 政府正就释放人质进行谈判。

examples.zh: 她被宣布为敌意证人并受到讯问。

examples.zh: 她语气中带着几乎未加掩饰的敌意。

examples.en: a cessation of hostilities (= an end to fighting)

examples.zh: 天气很热，而且气温在不断升高。

examples.zh: 你喜欢这种炎热的天气吗？

examples.zh: 炎热干燥的夏天

examples.en: an unusually hot day
examples.zh: 异常炎热的一天

examples.zh: 那是历史记载中最热的七月。

examples.zh: 天气热的时候，我们经常去海滩。

examples.zh: 我无法在炎热的国家生活。

examples.zh: 放在烤箱里用高温烤。

examples.en: Eat it while it's hot.
examples.zh: 趁热吃了它吧。

examples.en: I touched his forehead. He felt hot and feverish.
examples.zh: 我摸了摸他的前额，感到很烫，是在发烧。

examples.zh: 有人觉得太热了吗？

examples.zh: 我觉得很热。

examples.en: Her cheeks were hot with embarrassment.
examples.zh: 她的双颊窘得发烫。

examples.zh: 伦敦很热而且灰尘多。

examples.en: It had been a long hot journey.
examples.zh: 那次旅行路又远天又热。

examples.zh: 辛辣的食物

examples.zh: 你只需加辣椒就能增加咖喱菜的辣味。

examples.zh: 今天我们进入了竞选活动最激烈的阶段。

examples.zh: 她似乎是这份工作最热门的人选。

examples.zh: 别问我，我不大了解英国历史。

examples.zh: 当时你想要我，我也想要你。

examples.zh: 我今晚有一场令人激动的约会。

examples.zh: 有些裸露场面被认为太过火了，不适合在百老汇上演。

senses.zh: （尤指在滑雪、单板滑雪或冲浪运动中）炫技，表演高难动作

senses.def: a sudden hot and uncomfortable feeling in the skin, especially experienced by women during the menopause
senses.zh: 热潮红（皮肤的灼热阵感，尤见于更年期女性）

senses.def: the ability to be successful or to win, especially when this is temporary
senses.zh: 热手效应，手感好（尤指持续时间不长的连续得分的能力）

examples.en: When he has the hot hand, he's unstoppable.
examples.zh: 当他有热手效应时，他简直不可阻挡。

examples.en: The team decided to ride the hot hand (= use the player who is playing best at that time) and play Johnson.
examples.zh: 球队决定趁着约翰逊状态火热，让他上场。

senses.def: a hatchback

examples.en: This is one of the most powerful hot hatches ever made.
examples.zh: 这是史上动力最强的掀背车。

examples.en: The new model comes in a hot-hatch version that is great fun to drive.
examples.zh: 新车型是一款大马力掀背车，驾驶乐趣十足。

senses.def: acting too quickly, without thinking of what might happen

examples.en: The riots were started by a few hot-headed youths.
examples.zh: 骚乱是由一些头脑发热的年轻人发起的。

senses.def: a key on a computer keyboard that you can press to perform a set of operations quickly, rather than having to press a number of different keys
senses.zh: 热键，快捷键（按下后可迅速进行一系列操作）

senses.def: a person or thing that is completely unsuccessful and lacks any order or control
senses.zh: 彻底失败的人（或事物）；一团糟；混乱局面

examples.en: That whole storyline was just a crazy hot mess.
examples.zh: 整个故事情节简直乱七八糟。

senses.def: very short, tight shorts
very bright pink in colour

examples.en: hot pink flowers
examples.zh: 艳粉色花朵

senses.def: a very bright pink colour

examples.en: a jacket in hot pink
examples.zh: 艳粉色夹克

senses.def: a problem, situation, etc. that is difficult and unpleasant to deal with
senses.zh: 棘手的问题（或情况等）；烫手山芋

examples.en: The issue of taxing domestic fuel has become a political hot potato.
examples.zh: 对国内燃油征税的问题已成为政治热点。

senses.def: a car that has been changed and improved to give it extra power and speed
an electrical socket
senses.zh: 热靴（照相机连接闪光灯的插口）

senses.def: a person who is sexually attractive

examples.en: She's pretty hot stuff.
examples.zh: 她很性感。

senses.def: a film, book, etc. that is exciting in a sexual way

examples.en: His latest novel is hot stuff.
examples.zh: 他的最新小说很热门。

senses.def: a person who shows a lot of skill at something

examples.en: She's really hot stuff at tennis.
examples.zh: 她的确是网球高手。

senses.def: something that is likely to cause people to disagree or be angry
senses.zh: 容易引发争议（或众怒）的事物

examples.en: These new proposals are proving to be hot stuff.
examples.zh: 这些新的建议结果证明是有争议性的。

senses.def: to fit or replace a computer part with the power still connected
senses.zh: 热插拔，热交换（通电时插入或更换计算机部件）

senses.def: a comment made in order to attract attention, usually produced quickly and relating to a recent event
senses.zh: （尤指互联网上的）热门文章或讲话，往往因观点极端而引起争议;热门

examples.en: Her hot take on the issue immediately sparked off a reaction on her social media feed.
examples.zh: 她对这个问题的激烈看法立即在她的社交媒体上引起了反响。

senses.def: tending to become very angry easily
a heated bath, often outside, that several people can sit in together to relax
senses.zh: 热水浴池（常置于室外，可供数人坐在里面休息）

senses.def: to become more exciting or to show an increase in activity

examples.en: Things are really hotting up in the election campaign.
examples.zh: 竞选活动的确日益激烈了。

examples.en: The title race is certainly hotting up.
examples.zh: 冠军争夺战无疑正在白热化。

examples.en: The pace is hotting up.
examples.zh: 节奏正在升温。

senses.def: a rubber container that is filled with hot water and put in a bed to make it warm
to start the engine of a vehicle by using a piece of wire instead of a key, usually in order to steal the vehicle
senses.zh: 热线发动，短路点火（不用钥匙而用电线短路方法发动汽车，通常为了盗窃汽车）

examples.en: He hot-wired a truck and drove it through a prison fence.
examples.zh: 他给一辆卡车安装了热线，然后将其开过监狱的栅栏。

senses.def: an area where a disease appeared for the first time or where there is a high risk of catching it

examples.en: The hospital screens all patients who have recently visited hot zones.
examples.zh: 该医院对所有最近去过疫区的病人进行筛查。

senses.def: a place where a lot of a particular activity, especially something bad or violent, is happening

examples.en: The area was a hotbed of crime.
examples.zh: 这个地区以前是犯罪活动的温床。

senses.def: a number of things mixed together without any particular order or reason
senses.zh: 杂乱无章的一堆东西；大杂烩

examples.en: a hotchpotch of ideas
examples.zh: 大杂烩

senses.def: a building where people stay, usually for a short time, paying for their rooms and meals

examples.en: a two-star/five-star, etc. hotel
examples.zh: 两星级、五星级等旅馆

examples.en: a luxury/boutique hotel
examples.zh: 豪华／精品酒店

examples.en: a new resort hotel and conference centre
examples.zh: 新的度假酒店和会议中心

examples.en: We stayed in a friendly family-run hotel.
examples.zh: 我们入住了一家温馨的家庭旅店。

examples.en: hotel rooms/guests
examples.zh: 旅馆的房间／客人

examples.en: online hotel booking sites
examples.zh: 在线酒店预订网站

senses.def: a pub
a restaurant
a person who owns or manages a hotel
a file that is used to correct a fault in a computer program

examples.en: I got an error message when I tried to install the hotfix.
examples.zh: 当我尝试安装修补程序时收到错误消息。

examples.en: a list of the latest hotfixes
examples.zh: 最新修补程序列表

senses.def: moving quickly and in a hurry

examples.en: He had just arrived hotfoot from London.
examples.zh: 他刚从伦敦匆匆赶来。

senses.def: to walk or run somewhere quickly

examples.en: When the police arrived, they hotfooted it out of there.
examples.zh: 警察到达时，他们匆忙逃离了那里。

senses.def: to walk or run somewhere quickly

examples.en: When the police arrived, they hotfooted it out of there.
examples.zh: 警察到达时，他们匆忙逃离了那里。

senses.def: to walk or run somewhere quickly

examples.en: When the police arrived, they hotfooted it out of there.
examples.zh: 警察到达时，他们匆忙逃离了那里。

senses.def: a person who often acts too quickly, without thinking of what might happen
a heated building, usually made of glass, used for growing plants that need special conditions

examples.en: hothouse flowers
examples.zh: 温室花卉

senses.def: a place or situation that encourages the rapid development of somebody/something, especially ideas and emotions
senses.zh: 有利于迅速发展的地方（或环境）；（尤指有利于思想感情发展的）温床

examples.en: In the hothouse atmosphere of college there are plenty of opportunities for falling in love.
examples.zh: 在大学的温室氛围中，有很多坠入爱河的机会。

senses.def: a special phone line that people can use in order to get information or to talk about something
senses.zh: 热线；电话咨询服务专线

examples.en: a 24-hour confidential hotline
examples.zh: 24小时保密热线

examples.en: An emergency hotline has been set up for the relatives of those involved in the disaster.
examples.zh: 已经为受灾人员的亲属设立了紧急热线。

senses.def: a direct phone line between the heads of government in different countries
senses.zh: （各国政府首脑之间通话的）热线

examples.en: the hotline to the White House
examples.zh: 白宫热线

senses.def: a place in an electronic document that is connected to another electronic document or to another part of the same document
a list of popular, fashionable or important people or things
senses.zh: 热点（或重要）人物名单；热点（或重要）事物清单

senses.def: done in an angry or excited way or with a lot of strong feeling

examples.en: a hotly debated topic
examples.zh: 激烈辩论的话题

examples.en: Recent reports in the press have been hotly denied.
examples.zh: 新闻界最近的报道遭到了坚决否认。

examples.en: ‘Nonsense!’ he said hotly.
examples.zh: “废话！”他怒气冲冲地说。

examples.en: The results were hotly disputed.
examples.zh: 结果引起了极大争议。

senses.def: done with a lot of energy and determination

examples.en: hotly contested elections
examples.zh: 竞争激烈的选举

examples.en: She ran out of the shop, hotly pursued by the store detective.
examples.zh: 她冲出商店，商店保安在后面猛追。

senses.def: a flat, heated metal surface, for example on a cooker, that is used for cooking food or for keeping it hot
senses.zh: 烤盘，加热板（置于炉灶等之上，用于烹调或食物保温）

senses.def: an American and European brand of electrical goods for the home
senses.zh: 美国和欧洲的家用电器品牌

examples.en: a Hotpoint washing machine
examples.zh: 热点洗衣机

senses.def: a hot dish of meat, potato, onion, etc. cooked slowly in liquid in the oven
senses.zh: 焖罐（内装炖的肉、土豆、洋葱等）

senses.def: a person who is extremely successful in their career or at a particular sport
senses.zh: 很有成就的人；运动高手

senses.def: extremely successful, especially in a career or at a particular sport
senses.zh: 很有成就的人；运动高手

examples.en: a hotshot lawyer
examples.zh: 业绩非凡的律师

senses.def: a place where fighting is common, especially for political reasons
senses.zh: 多事之地；（尤指政治原因的）热点地区

examples.en: UN peacekeeping forces have helped ease tensions in world hotspots since 1948.
examples.zh: 自 1948 年以来，联合国维和部队帮助缓解了世界热点地区的紧张局势。

senses.def: a place with a particular kind of danger or problem
senses.zh: 高风险区域；问题显著的地方

examples.en: They identified eight pollution hotspots at the mouth of the Thames.
examples.zh: 他们确定了泰晤士河河口的八个污染重点地区。

senses.def: a place where there is a lot of activity or entertainment
senses.zh: 活动多的地方；热闹的娱乐场所

senses.def: a place that is very hot and dry, where a fire has been burning or is likely to start

examples.en: Fire crews worked to douse hotspots left by two fires that consumed acres of forest.
examples.zh: 消防人员努力扑灭两场烧毁数英亩森林的火灾留下的热点地区。

senses.def: an area on a computer screen that you can click on to start an operation such as loading a file
senses.zh: （屏幕上点击后即可启动程序的）热点区

senses.def: a place in a hotel, restaurant, airport, etc. that is fitted with a special device that enables you to connect a computer to the internet without using wires
senses.zh: 热点（旅馆、饭店、机场等安装设备可无线上网的地方）

senses.def: a person who is very sexually attractive
senses.zh: 热辣性感的人；帅哥；辣妹

examples.en: Hugh’s a hottie.
examples.zh: 休是个辣妹。

examples.en: my friend's hottie brother
examples.zh: 我朋友的帅哥

senses.def: a person or an animal that is very good at escaping
a type of food, originally from the Middle East, that is a soft mixture of chickpeas
senses.zh: 鹰嘴豆泥（中东食品，将鹰嘴豆、芝麻、油、柠檬汁和大蒜捣碎混合而成）

senses.def: a dog that can run fast and has a good sense of smell, used for hunting

examples.en: The hounds picked up a scent.
examples.zh: 猎犬闻到了一股气味。

examples.en: In drag hunting, hounds chase an artificial scent.
examples.zh: 在追猎训练中，猎狗追踪的是一种人工臭迹。

examples.en: We could hear the hounds barking in the distance.
examples.zh: 我们可以听到远处猎犬的吠叫声。

senses.def: to keep following somebody and not leave them alone, especially in order to get something from them or ask them questions

examples.en: They were hounded day and night by the press.
examples.zh: 他们日夜遭到新闻界的跟踪。

examples.en: The travellers say the police are hounding them.
examples.zh: 旅行者们说警察正在追捕他们。

senses.def: (especially in the southern US) a dog used in hunting
to force somebody to leave a job or a place, especially by making their life difficult and unpleasant
senses.zh: 逼迫某人离职（或离开某地）

examples.en: They were hounded out of the country.
examples.zh: 他们被驱逐出境。

examples.en: He claims he has been hounded from his job by jealous colleagues.
examples.zh: 他声称他被嫉妒的同事们赶走。

examples.en: She was finally hounded out of her job.
examples.zh: 她最终被赶出了工作。

senses.def: to force somebody to leave a job or a place, especially by making their life difficult and unpleasant
senses.zh: 逼迫某人离职（或离开某地）

examples.en: They were hounded out of the country.
examples.zh: 他们被驱逐出境。

examples.en: He claims he has been hounded from his job by jealous colleagues.
examples.zh: 他声称他被嫉妒的同事们赶走。

examples.en: She was finally hounded out of her job.
examples.zh: 她最终被赶出了工作。

senses.def: a type of large pattern with pointed shapes, often in black and white, used especially in cloth for jackets and suits
senses.zh: （尤指布料上的）犬牙织纹，犬牙花纹

senses.def: 60 minutes; one of the 24 parts that a day is divided into

examples.en: I spent an hour on the phone.
examples.zh: 我打了一个小时电话。

examples.en: It will take about an hour to get there.
examples.zh: 到那里大约需要一小时。

examples.en: It usually takes me two hours to walk there.
examples.zh: 我通常需要两个小时才能步行到那里。

examples.en: The interview lasted half an hour.
examples.zh: 会见持续了半小时。

examples.en: It was a three-hour exam.
examples.zh: 那是三小时的考试。

examples.en: Most cats sleep 13–16 hours a day.
examples.zh: 大多数猫每天睡 13 到 16 个小时。

examples.en: Architects can expect to spend 40 hours a week in meetings.
examples.zh: 架构师预计每周要花 40 个小时在会议上。

examples.en: I waited for a couple of hours and then I left.
examples.zh: 我等了几个小时，然后就走了。

examples.en: He'll be back in an hour.
examples.zh: 他一小时后回来。

examples.en: In less than twenty-four hours it would be Christmas.
examples.zh: 再过不到二十四小时，圣诞节就到了。

examples.en: We're paid by the hour.
examples.zh: 我们是论小时获得报酬的。

examples.en: Top speed is 120 miles per hour.
examples.zh: 最高时速为 120 英里。

examples.en: The rate of pay is £10.50 an hour.
examples.zh: 时薪 10.5 英镑。

examples.en: We hope to be there within the hour (= in less than an hour).
examples.zh: 我们希望一小时内到达那里。

examples.en: York was within an hour's drive.
examples.zh: 开车到约克不会超过一小时。

examples.en: He crossed the line in a time of 2 hours and 40 minutes.
examples.zh: 他用时2小时40分钟冲过终点线。

examples.en: Chicago is two hours away (= it takes two hours to get there).
examples.zh: 到芝加哥需要两小时。

examples.en: We're four hours ahead of New York (= referring to the time difference).
examples.zh: 我们比纽约早四个小时。

examples.en: I sat there, hour after hour, staring at a blank computer screen.
examples.zh: 我一小时又一小时地坐在那里，盯着空白的电脑屏幕。

senses.def: a period of about an hour, used for a particular purpose

examples.en: I spent my lunch hour shopping.
examples.zh: 我用午餐时间去购物了。

senses.def: a fixed period of time during which people work, an office is open, etc.

examples.en: Opening hours are from 10 to 6 each day.
examples.zh: 营业时间为每天 10 点到 6 点。

examples.en: Most people in this kind of job tend to work long hours.
examples.zh: 多数从事这种工作的人往往工作时间很长。

examples.en: The library is open during normal working hours.
examples.zh: 图书馆在正常工作时间开放。

examples.en: What are your office hours?
examples.zh: 你的办公时间是几点到几点？

examples.en: a hospital’s visiting hours
examples.zh: 医院的探视时间

examples.en: Britain's licensing hours (= when pubs are allowed to open) used to be very restricted.
examples.zh: 英国的酒吧营业时间从前受到很严格的限制。

examples.en: This is the only place to get a drink after hours (= after the normal closing time for pubs).
examples.zh: 这是酒吧正常关门时间之后唯一能喝一杯的地方。

examples.en: You can contact me on this number out of hours (= when the office is closed).
examples.zh: 非办公时间你可以用这个号码和我联系。

senses.def: a long time

examples.en: It took hours getting there.
examples.zh: 花了好长时间才到那里。

examples.en: It took us hours to find out what was wrong.
examples.zh: 我们花了几个小时才找出问题所在。

examples.en: ‘How long did it last?’ ‘Oh, hours and hours.’
examples.zh: “持续了多久？”“噢，很久很久。”

examples.en: Where have you been? I've been waiting hours.
examples.zh: 你去哪儿了？我已经等了好几个小时了

examples.en: I've been waiting for hours.
examples.zh: 我等了很久了。

senses.def: a particular point in time

examples.en: You can't turn him away at this hour of the night.
examples.zh: 天这么晚了，你不能把他赶走。

examples.en: The hour had come for us to leave.
examples.zh: 我们离开的时间到了。

senses.def: the time when something important happens

examples.en: This was often thought of as the country's finest hour.
examples.zh: 一般认为这是该国最美好的一段时光。

examples.en: She thought her last hour had come.
examples.zh: 她以为她生命的最后时刻到了。

examples.en: Don't desert me in my hour of need.
examples.zh: 不要在我困难的时候离开我。

examples.en: She helped me in my hour of need.
examples.zh: 她在我困难的时候帮助过我。

senses.def: the time when it is exactly 1 o’clock, 2 o’clock, etc.

examples.en: The clock struck the hour.
examples.zh: 钟敲过整点了。

examples.en: ten minutes past the hour
examples.zh: 整点过十分

examples.en: There's a bus every hour on the hour
examples.zh: 每小时整点有一班公共汽车。

senses.def: used when giving the time according to the 24-hour clock, usually in military or other official language
senses.zh: （按 24 小时制给出的时间，通常用于军事或其他官方用语）点钟

examples.en: The first missile was launched at 2300 hours (= at 11 p.m.).
examples.zh: 首枚导弹是在 23 点（晚上 11 点）发射的。

senses.def: any time, especially a time that is not usual or suitable
senses.zh: 任何时间（尤指非正常或不合适的时间）

examples.en: He's started staying out till all hours (= until very late at night).
examples.zh: 他已经开始在外面待得很晚了。

examples.en: She thinks she can call me at all hours of the day and night.
examples.zh: 她以为她可以不分昼夜随时给我打电话。

senses.def: at the last possible moment; just in time
senses.zh: 在最后时刻；刚好来得及

senses.def: very early, especially when this is annoying

examples.en: The job involved getting up at some unearthly hour to catch the first train.
examples.zh: 这工作需要起大早赶头班火车。

senses.def: very early or very late and therefore annoying
senses.zh: 一大早（或很晚）；在十分不便的时间

examples.en: I apologize for calling you at this ungodly hour.
examples.zh: 原谅我这种时候给你打电话。

senses.def: the time when you have to do something difficult or unpleasant
senses.zh: 倒霉的时候（或日子、时刻）

examples.en: I’d better go and see the dentist—I can’t put off the evil hour any longer.
examples.zh: 我最好还是去看看牙医吧─可不能再拖了。

examples.en: If you keep on borrowing, you are only postponing the evil day when you have to pay it all back.
examples.zh: 如果你继续借钱，你只是在推迟你必须还清所有债务的那一天。

senses.def: if you keep regular, strange, etc. hours
senses.zh: 做事（尤指作息）时间有规律（或怪异等）

senses.def: to spend time doing something that is not important while you are waiting for something else to happen

examples.en: We killed time playing cards.
examples.zh: 我们打纸牌消磨时间。

senses.def: the period of time very early in the morning, soon after midnight
senses.zh: 午夜刚过的一段时间；凌晨时分

examples.en: We worked well into the small hours.
examples.zh: 我们一直工作到了午夜之后。

examples.en: The fighting began in the early hours of Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 战斗在星期六凌晨打响了。

examples.en: The party continued well into the early hours.
examples.zh: 聚会一直持续到第二天凌晨。

senses.def: any time, especially a time that is not usual or suitable
senses.zh: 任何时间（尤指非正常或不合适的时间）

examples.en: He's started staying out till all hours (= until very late at night).
examples.zh: 他已经开始在外面待得很晚了。

examples.en: She thinks she can call me at all hours of the day and night.
examples.zh: 她以为她可以不分昼夜随时给我打电话。

senses.def: at the last possible moment; just in time
senses.zh: 在最后时刻；刚好来得及

senses.def: very early, especially when this is annoying

examples.en: The job involved getting up at some unearthly hour to catch the first train.
examples.zh: 这工作需要起大早赶头班火车。

senses.def: very early or very late and therefore annoying
senses.zh: 一大早（或很晚）；在十分不便的时间

examples.en: I apologize for calling you at this ungodly hour.
examples.zh: 原谅我这种时候给你打电话。

senses.def: the time when you have to do something difficult or unpleasant
senses.zh: 倒霉的时候（或日子、时刻）

examples.en: I’d better go and see the dentist—I can’t put off the evil hour any longer.
examples.zh: 我最好还是去看看牙医吧─可不能再拖了。

examples.en: If you keep on borrowing, you are only postponing the evil day when you have to pay it all back.
examples.zh: 如果你继续借钱，你只是在推迟你必须还清所有债务的那一天。

senses.def: if you keep regular, strange, etc. hours
senses.zh: 做事（尤指作息）时间有规律（或怪异等）

items.idm: kill time | kill an hour, a couple of hours, etc.

senses.def: to spend time doing something that is not important while you are waiting for something else to happen

examples.en: We killed time playing cards.
examples.zh: 我们打纸牌消磨时间。

senses.def: the period of time very early in the morning, soon after midnight
senses.zh: 午夜刚过的一段时间；凌晨时分

examples.en: We worked well into the small hours.
examples.zh: 我们一直工作到了午夜之后。

examples.en: The fighting began in the early hours of Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 战斗在星期六凌晨打响了。

examples.en: The party continued well into the early hours.
examples.zh: 聚会一直持续到第二天凌晨。

senses.def: the small hand on a clock or watch that points to the hour
a glass container holding sand that takes exactly an hour to pass through a small opening between the top and bottom sections
senses.zh: 沙漏（玻璃容器上部的沙子经一小孔漏到下部，全部漏完正好一小时）

senses.def: a woman who has an hourglass
senses.zh: （女人身材）丰乳肥臀的，上凸下翘的

senses.def: done or happening every hour

examples.en: an hourly bus service
examples.zh: 每小时一班的公共汽车

examples.en: Trains leave at hourly intervals.
examples.zh: 火车每隔一小时发出一列。

senses.def: an hourly wage, fee, rate, etc.
senses.zh: （工资、酬金、费用等）按钟点计算的，论小时的

examples.en: an hourly rate of $30 an hour
examples.zh: 每小时 30 美元的收费

senses.def: every hour

examples.en: Reapply sunscreen hourly and after swimming.
examples.zh: 每小时以及游泳后重新抹一次防晒霜。

examples.en: Dressings are changed four hourly (= every four hours) to help prevent infection.
examples.zh: 每四小时更换一次敷料，以防感染。

senses.def: a building for people to live in, usually for one family

examples.en: We live in a two-bedroom house.
examples.zh: 我们住在一个两居室的房子里。

examples.en: It was so hot outside we stayed in the house.
examples.zh: 外面太热了，我们待在屋里。

examples.en: He went into the house.
examples.zh: 他进了房子。

examples.en: I had to get out of the house.
examples.zh: 我不得不离开家。

examples.en: A light was on inside the house.
examples.zh: 房子里亮着一盏灯。

examples.en: There was a police van parked outside the house.
examples.zh: 屋外停着一辆警车。

examples.en: Let's have a party at my house.
examples.zh: 我们在我家里聚会吧。

examples.en: We need to build more houses in a way that respects the needs of the environment.
examples.zh: 我们需要以尊重环境需求的方式建造更多房屋。

examples.en: Investors were buying houses to rent them out.
examples.zh: 投资者购买房屋是为了出租。

examples.en: What time do you leave the house in the morning (= to go to work)?
examples.zh: 你早晨几点出门（去上班）？

examples.en: We're moving house (= leaving our house and going to live in a different one).
examples.zh: 我们要搬家了。

examples.en: House prices (= prices of houses and flats) in London are still rising.
examples.zh: 伦敦的房价仍在上涨。

examples.en: We went on a tour of the house and grounds (= for example, at a country house, open to the public).
examples.zh: 我们参观了房子和庭院（=例如，在向公众开放的乡村别墅）。

examples.en: They went from house to house, begging for food.
examples.zh: 他们挨家挨户地乞讨食物。

senses.def: all the people living in a house
senses.zh: 住在一所房子里的人；全家人

examples.en: Be quiet or you'll wake the whole house!
examples.zh: 安静点，别把全家人都吵醒！

senses.def: a building used for a particular purpose, for example for holding meetings in or keeping animals or goods in

examples.en: an opera house
examples.zh: 歌剧院

examples.en: a henhouse
examples.zh: 鸡舍

senses.def: used in the names of office buildings

examples.en: Their offices are on the second floor of Chester House.
examples.zh: 他们的办公室在切斯特大厦三楼。

senses.def: a company involved in a particular kind of business; an institution of a particular kind

examples.en: a fashion/banking/publishing house
examples.zh: 时装公司；银行；出版社

examples.en: a religious house (= a convent or a monastery)
examples.zh: 宗教会所

senses.def: a restaurant

examples.en: a steakhouse
examples.zh: 牛排餐馆

examples.en: a coffee house
examples.zh: 咖啡馆

examples.en: a bottle of house wine (= the cheapest wine available in a particular restaurant, sometimes not listed by name)
examples.zh: 一瓶本店特价酒

senses.def: a group of people who meet to discuss and make the laws of a country

examples.en: Legislation requires approval by both houses of parliament.
examples.zh: 立法须要得到议会两院的一致通过。

senses.def: the House of Commons or the House of Lords in the UK; the House of Representatives in the US
senses.zh: （英国）下议院，上议院；（美国）众议院

senses.def: a group of people discussing something in a formal debate

examples.en: I urge the house to vote against the motion.
examples.zh: 我呼吁参加辩论的诸位投票反对这项动议。

senses.def: the part of a theatre where the audience sits; the audience at a particular performance

examples.en: playing to a full/packed/empty house (= to a large/small audience)
examples.zh: 演出座无虚席／满座／观众寥寥无几

examples.en: The spotlight faded and the house lights came up.
examples.zh: 聚光灯渐渐熄灭，观众席的灯亮了。

senses.def: (in some British schools) an organized group of students of different ages who compete against other groups in sports competitions, etc. and who may, in boarding schools
senses.zh: （英国某些学校为进行体育比赛或按宿舍将学生分成的）社，舍

senses.def: an old and famous family

examples.en: the House of Windsor (= the British royal family)
examples.zh: 温莎王室

senses.def: a type of electronic dance music with a fast beat
senses.zh: 货仓音乐，浩室音乐（一种快节奏电子舞曲）

senses.def: to make everyone laugh or cheer
senses.zh: （尤指剧院的演出）博得满堂大笑（或喝彩）

senses.def: to remove people or things that are not necessary or wanted
senses.zh: 清除不必要的人（或事物）；裁减

examples.en: The new manager said he wanted to clean house.
examples.zh: 新上任的经理说他要裁员。

senses.def: to make your house clean
to eat a lot of somebody else’s food

examples.zh: 他还要待多久？他正在把我们从家中吃掉。

senses.zh: 很快就打得火热；一见如故；一拍即合

senses.zh: 绕圈子；拐弯抹角；不直截了当

examples.zh: 你确实绕遍了房子，不是吗？为什么不直接进入正题呢？

senses.def: to cook, clean and do all the other jobs around the house

examples.en: Who will keep house for you when I'm not here?
examples.zh: 我不在的时候谁来帮你看家？

senses.def: used to say that everyone was very emotional about something
senses.zh: 全场无人不流泪；全场无不为之动容

examples.en: There wasn't a dry eye in the house when they announced their engagement.
examples.zh: 他们宣布订婚时大伙眼睛全湿了。

senses.def: drinks or meals that are on the house

examples.en: Have a drink on the house.
examples.zh: 来一杯免费饮料吧。

senses.def: you should not criticize other people, because they will easily find ways of criticizing you
senses.zh: 身居玻璃房，投石招祸殃；自身毛病多，勿挑他人错

senses.def: to play at being a family in its home

examples.en: The children were playing house, giving dinner to their dolls.
examples.zh: 孩子们在玩过家家，喂玩具娃娃吃饭。

senses.def: to organize your own business or improve your own behaviour before you try to criticize somebody else
senses.zh: 先管好自己的事；律人先律己

senses.def: very safe

examples.zh: 他们一同在布赖顿的一个小公寓里建立了家庭。

examples.en: They want to set up house together.
examples.zh: 他们想共同建设住房。

examples.en: The government is committed to housing the refugees.
examples.zh: 政府承诺收容难民。

examples.en: They can barely afford to feed, clothe and house their family.
examples.zh: 他们几乎买不起家人的食物、衣服和住房。

examples.en: People whose homes were flooded were temporarily housed in community centres.
examples.zh: 房屋被洪水淹没的人们被暂时安置在社区中心。

examples.en: The prison normally houses about 200 medium-security prisoners.
examples.zh: 该监狱通常关押着大约 200 名中等安全级别的囚犯。

senses.def: to be the place where something is kept or where something operates from
senses.zh: 是（某物）的贮藏处（或安置处）；收藏；安置

examples.en: The library houses a collection of 15 000 books.
examples.zh: 该图书馆藏书 15 000 册。

examples.en: The gallery houses 2 000 works of modern art.
examples.zh: 美术馆收藏了 2 000 件现代艺术作品。

examples.en: The building also houses the offices of the District Medical Officer.
examples.zh: 该大楼还是地区医疗官办公室的所在地。

examples.en: The museum is housed in the Old Court House.
examples.zh: 博物馆设在旧法院大楼里。

examples.zh: 爱尔兰电影资料馆收藏的大部分电影资料都是英文的。

examples.en: She was placed under house arrest.
examples.zh: 她遭到了软禁。

examples.en: The former dictator is under house arrest in his country mansion.
examples.zh: 下台的独裁者被软禁在他的乡间府邸里。

senses.def: trained to defecate
senses.zh: 经训练在户外（或专用盒子里）便溺的

senses.def: a visit made to a patient or client in their own home by a doctor or other professional
senses.zh: 上门服务；（医生）出诊，上门看病

examples.en: Many personal trainers have started to make house calls.
examples.zh: 许多私人教练开始上门服务。

senses.def: a very small creature that lives in houses and can cause allergies
a person who is staying with you in your house for a short time
a person who is looking for a house to buy
senses.zh: 找房子，看房子（以便购买）

senses.def: the activity of looking for a house to buy
senses.zh: 找房子，看房子（以便购买）

examples.en: We're going house-hunting at the weekend.
examples.zh: 周末我们去找房子。

senses.def: a man who stays at home to cook, clean, take care of the children, etc. while his wife, husband or partner goes out to work
senses.zh: 操持家务的丈夫；“家庭主夫”

senses.def: a small black and white European bird like a swallow
a type of electronic dance music with a fast beat
senses.zh: 货仓音乐，浩室音乐（一种快节奏电子舞曲）

senses.def: a plan, an organization, etc. that is so badly arranged that it could easily fail
senses.zh: 不可靠的计划；摇摇欲坠的组织

examples.en: The enormous national debt amassed in the last eight years makes all this apparent prosperity nothing but a house of cards.
examples.zh: 过去八年积累的巨额国债使所有表面的繁荣只不过是纸牌屋。

senses.def: a structure built out of playing cards
a church or other religious building
(in the UK) a doctor who has finished medical school and who is working at a hospital to get further practical experience
a magazine that is published by a company for its employees and customers, with articles about its products and services
senses.zh: （公司）内部刊物（刊发给员工和客户参阅，包含产品和服务介绍）

examples.en: ‘The Beaver’ used to be the house organ of the Hudsons Bay Corp.
examples.zh: 《海狸报》曾是哈德逊湾公司的内刊。

examples.en: The paper is the house organ of the US political elite.
examples.zh: 该报是美国政治精英的内部机关报。

senses.def: a party held at which the guests stay at a house for a few days; the guests at this party
senses.zh: 家庭聚会，家庭聚会的全体宾客（常留宿几天）

examples.en: We were invited to a grand country house party.
examples.zh: 我们被邀请参加一个盛大的乡村别墅聚会。

senses.def: spending a lot of time making your house look clean and attractive, and thinking that this is important
to live in somebody’s house while they are away in order to take care of it for them

examples.en: A friend of mine needs someone to house-sit and feed her cats.
examples.zh: 我的一个朋友需要有人看家并喂她的猫。

senses.def: a person who lives in and looks after somebody's house while they are away
senses.zh: 房屋保姆：居住在一个人中并在其不在的时候照看他的房子的人

examples.en: A home in Brighton with two cats needs a house sitter for two weeks.
examples.zh: 布莱顿的一户有两只猫的家庭需要一名保姆两周。

examples.en: If you need a house sitter, I'm totally reliable and love pets, and if I break anything l'll buy a new one.
examples.zh: 如果你需要一名保姆，我非常可靠并且喜欢宠物，如果我弄坏了任何东西，我会买一个新的。

senses.def: a common small grey and brown bird that makes its nest
the way a company such as a publisher
senses.zh: （出版社等书面材料的）特有样式，特有风格

senses.def: visiting every house in a particular area

examples.zh: 挨家收集／搜查

examples.en: The police are making house-to-house enquiries.
examples.zh: 警察正在逐户调查。

senses.def: trained to defecate
senses.zh: 经训练在户外（或专用盒子里）便溺的

senses.def: a party given by somebody who has just moved into a new home

examples.en: a house-warming present/gift
examples.zh: 乔迁礼物/礼物

senses.def: a boat that people can live in, usually kept at a particular place on a river or canal
unable to leave your house because you cannot walk very far as a result of being ill or old
senses.zh: （因病或年迈）不能离家的，出不了门的

senses.def: people who are housebound
a boy or man who works as a servant in a house
a person who enters a house illegally by using force, in order to steal things from it
the crime of entering a house illegally by using force, in order to steal things from it
a long loose dress worn at home over underwear or night clothes
a common fly that lives in houses
a large number of people in a house

examples.en: He grew up in a houseful of women.
examples.zh: 他在一个满是女人的家庭里长大。

examples.en: They had a houseful so we didn't stay.
examples.zh: 他们满屋子都是人，所以我们没有留下来。

senses.def: all the people living together in a house or flat

examples.en: Most households now own at least one car.
examples.zh: 大多数家庭现在至少有一辆汽车。

examples.en: The average household spends more on housing than on food.
examples.zh: 一般家庭在住房上的花销多于食物。

examples.en: young people from low-income households
examples.zh: 低收入家庭的年轻人

examples.en: a one-parent/single-parent/two-parent household
examples.zh: 单亲/单亲/双亲家庭

examples.en: families with a male/female head of household
examples.zh: 户主为男性／女性的家庭

examples.en: Household incomes have remained stagnant.
examples.zh: 家庭收入一直停滞不前。

examples.en: Who does most of the household chores?
examples.zh: 大部分家务活谁做？

examples.en: Packaging makes up about a third of household waste.
examples.zh: 包装物大约占生活垃圾的三分之一。

senses.def: a person, thing or name that has become very well known
senses.zh: 家喻户晓的人（或事物、品牌等）

examples.en: She became a household name in the 1960s.
examples.zh: 她在 20 世纪 60 年代成为家喻户晓的人物。

examples.en: His name has become a household word since he first appeared in the series.
examples.zh: 自从他在这部连续剧中首次出镜之后，他的名字已变得家喻户晓。

senses.def: a person who owns or rents the house that they live in

examples.en: Police are warning local householders to keep windows closed.
examples.zh: 警方警告当地住户关闭窗户。

examples.en: Single householders receive a 20% discount on their council tax.
examples.zh: 单身户主缴纳市政税享有20%的减税。

examples.en: They are launching a new energy saving campaign aimed at householders.
examples.zh: 他们正在发起一项针对住户的新节能运动。

senses.def: a person, usually a woman, whose job is to manage the shopping, cooking, cleaning, etc. in a house or an institution
senses.zh: 管家，杂务主管（通常为女性）

examples.en: Do come in. My housekeeper will make you a cup of tea.
examples.zh: 请进，我的管家会给你泡杯茶。

examples.en: Miss Mack had been housekeeper at the Hall for many years.
examples.zh: 麦克小姐已在大宅里当了多年的管家。

senses.def: a person whose job is to manage the cleaning of rooms in a hotel
the work involved in taking care of a house, especially shopping and managing money
senses.zh: 家务（尤指采购和管理开支）

examples.en: My financial problems were made worse by my bad housekeeping.
examples.zh: 我持家无方，使得经济状况更加糟糕。

senses.def: the department in a hotel, a hospital, an office building, etc. that is responsible for cleaning the rooms, etc.
senses.zh: （旅馆、医院、写字楼等的）总务处，后勤部

examples.en: Call housekeeping and ask them to bring us some clean towels.
examples.zh: 给总务处打电话，让他们给我们送些干净的毛巾来。

senses.def: the money used to buy food, cleaning materials and other things needed for taking care of a house
jobs that are done to enable an organization or computer system to work well

examples.en: The company has made considerable savings through good housekeeping, such as avoiding wastage.
examples.zh: 公司通过如避免浪费等有效的内部管理方法节约了数量可观的资金。

examples.en: Most large companies now use computers for accounting and housekeeping operations.
examples.zh: 多数大公司现在用计算机进行会计运算和内务操作。

senses.def: a female servant in a large house who cleans the rooms, etc. and often lives there
a condition in which the area around the kneecap
senses.zh: 女仆膝，髌前滑囊炎（膝盖骨周围肿胀发炎）

a man employed to do general jobs in a house, hotel, etc.
senses.zh: （家庭或旅馆等的）男勤杂工，男仆

(1896-1977) an American who directed, produced and wrote films in a Hollywood
senses.zh: 霍华德·霍克斯（Howard Hawks）：（1896-1977）是一位美国人，他在好莱坞职业生涯中执导，制作和撰写电影，历时52年。他执导的许多著名明星包括《育儿》（1938年）中的卡里·格兰特（Cary Grant）和凯瑟琳·赫本（Katharine Hepburn），约克中士（1941年）的加里·库珀（Gary Cooper），大睡眠（1946年）的汉弗莱·鲍嘉（Humphrey Bogart）和劳伦·巴考尔（Lauren Bacall），1953年《绅士偏爱的金发女郎》中的玛丽莲·梦露（Marilyn Monroe） ）和约翰·韦恩（John Wayne）在里奥·布拉沃（1959）。鹰队在1974年获得了特别的奥斯卡奖。

senses.def: (1905-76) a rich American who produced and directed films, and built planes. He owned an oil company and the Hughes Aircraft Company. His films included Hell's Angels
senses.zh: 霍华德·休斯（Howard Hughes）：（1905-76）一位富有的美国人，他制作并导演电影，并制造飞机。他拥有一家石油公司和休斯飞机公司。他的电影包括《地狱的天使》（1930年）和《暴徒》（1941年）。他建立了几架最快的飞机（1935-8），并设计了世界上最大的飞机（1947）。休斯在1948年获得了RKO的控制权，在1959年获得了TWA的控制权，并在1960年代帮助发展了拉斯维加斯。他一生的最后25年对公众隐瞒。关于休斯的电影《飞行员》（2005年）由莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥（Leonardo DiCaprio）主演。

senses.def: any of a group of US hotels. In the past the company owned a chain of restaurants which became famous for their bright orange roofs and their 28 types of ice cream. The company was founded by Howard Dearing Johnson (1897-1972) in Quincy, Massachusetts

senses.def: a university in Washington, DC, which was established in 1867 for both black and white people and which educated many freed slaves after the American Civil War. Many well-known black Americans studied there, including US Vice-President Kamala Harris. It is named after General Oliver O Howard, who helped to establish it and was its president from 1869 to 1873.

examples.en: The sums of money involved are potentially huge.
examples.zh: 涉及的金额可能很大。

examples.en: A huge crowd had gathered in the square.
examples.zh: 广场上聚集了一大群人。

examples.en: Huge amounts of data were lost.
examples.zh: 大量数据丢失了。

examples.en: I wasn't a huge fan of the movie.
examples.zh: 我那时候不是这部电影的超级粉丝。

examples.en: Becoming a mother made a huge difference to me.
examples.zh: 成为母亲使我发生了巨大的改变。

examples.en: Anti-social behaviour affects a huge number of people daily.
examples.zh: 反社会行为每天影响千千万万的人。

examples.en: The party was a huge success.
examples.zh: 聚会办得非常成功。

examples.en: This is going to be a huge problem for us.
examples.zh: 这将是我们的一大难题。

senses.def: very successful

examples.en: I think this band is going to be huge.
examples.zh: 我想这支乐队要走红了。

senses.def: extremely

examples.en: hugely entertaining/important/popular/successful
examples.zh: 极其有趣／重要／受欢迎／成功

senses.def: very much

examples.en: They intended to invest hugely in new technology.
examples.zh: 他们打算在新技术方面投入大量资金。

examples.en: He turned around, grinning hugely.
examples.zh: 他转过身来，咧着嘴乐。

senses.def: a first name for boys
(1910-1999) an English architect and artist. He was the director of architecture for the Festival of Britain
senses.zh: 休·卡森（Hugh Casson）：（1910-1999）是一位英国建筑师和艺术家。他曾担任英国艺术节的建筑总监，并设计了几座重要建筑物。他还出版了有关绘画的书籍，并曾担任皇家学院院长（1976-84年）。1952年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1887-1962) a British Labour politician who became Chancellor of the Exchequer
senses.zh: 休·道尔顿（Hugh Dalton）（1887-1962）是一位英国工党政治家，于1945年成为财政大臣。他必须在1947年辞职，因为他在告诉下议院之前已经向记者提供了一些信息。然而，他很快又重返政坛，并于1960年成为终身同伴。

senses.def: (1926-2017) the American who began Playboy
senses.zh: 休·赫夫纳（Hugh Hefner）：（1926-2017）美国人，他于1953年创立《花花公子》杂志，后来创立了一家更大的公司，其中包括《花花公子俱乐部》。他以他的“花花公子大厦”而闻名，在那儿他举办派对并招待出现在他杂志上的妇女。

senses.def: (c. 1485-1555) an English bishop
senses.zh: 休·拉蒂默（Hugh Latimer）：（约1485-1555年）一位英国主教，成为英格兰宗教改革的主要人物之一。玛丽一世成为皇后后，他反对她的天主教政策，并与另外两名主教尼古拉斯·里德利（Nicholas Ridley（约1500-55年）和托马斯·克兰默（Thomas Cranmer）一道被烧死在牛津。

senses.def: (1892-1978) a Scottish poet. He wrote in the Scottish dialect
senses.zh: 休·麦克迪米德（Hugh MacDiarmid）：（1892-1978）苏格兰诗人。他以苏格兰方言Lallans写作，并以他的诗《醉汉在蓟上看》（1926年）而闻名。他是共产党员，也是苏格兰独立的支持者，是苏格兰民族党的首批成员之一。

senses.def: a first name for boys

a French Protestant in the 16th and 17th centuries. After 1685 the Huguenots were attacked by the Catholic majority. Thousands left France for other countries, including Britain and the US, where many became very successful, especially in the silver and textile
senses.zh: 雨格诺（Huguenot）：16和17世纪的法国新教徒。1685年后，雨果诺派人遭到天主教徒的多数袭击。数以千计的人离开法国前往其他国家，包括英国和美国，其中许多人都非常成功，尤其是在银和纺织行业。

senses.def: people use Huh?
senses.zh: （用于问题、建议等之后，尤希望对方同意）

examples.en: So you won't be coming tonight, huh?
examples.zh: 那么你今晚就不来了吗，嗯？

examples.en: Let's get out of here, huh?
examples.zh: 我们离开这里吧，嗯？

senses.def: people say Huh!
senses.zh: （表示愤怒、惊奇、异议等，或认为没有什么了不起）

examples.en: Huh! Is that all you've done?
examples.zh: 噢！你做的就是这么多了吗？

examples.en: ‘Try to understand.’ ‘Huh! What is there to understand?’
examples.zh: “试着去理解。”有什么可理解的？

senses.def: people say Huh?

examples.en: ‘Are you feeling OK?’ ‘Huh?’
examples.zh: “你感觉好吗？”“啊？”

senses.def: a Hawaiian dance that is performed with gentle movements of the hips

examples.en: A group of women danced a traditional hula.
examples.zh: 一群妇女跳了一曲传统草裙舞。

senses.def: a large plastic ring that you move in a circle around the middle part of your body by moving your hips
the main part of an old vehicle or large structure that is no longer used

examples.en: the rusting hulks of cars
examples.zh: 锈蚀的汽车残骸

examples.en: the hulk of a wrecked ship
examples.zh: 遇难轮船的残骸

senses.def: an old ship kept in one place and used as a prison
senses.zh: （被拆除装置后永久停泊的）废弃船（尤指用于储藏，或旧时用作监狱）

examples.en: prison hulks
examples.zh: 监狱废船

senses.def: a large heavy person
senses.zh: 大块头的人；身体笨重的人

examples.en: a great hulk of a man
examples.zh: 粗笨的大汉

senses.def: a very large object, especially one that causes you to feel nervous or afraid
senses.zh: （尤指令人紧张或害怕的）庞然大物

senses.def: very large or heavy, often in a way that causes you to feel nervous or afraid
senses.zh: 很大的；很沉重的；大得吓人的

examples.en: a hulking figure crouching in the darkness
examples.zh: 黑暗中蹲伏着的一个庞大身影

examples.en: The cruise ship was a hulking great monstrosity.
examples.zh: 这艘游轮是一个巨大的怪物。

senses.def: the main, bottom part of a ship, that goes in the water

examples.en: a wooden/steel hull
examples.zh: 木质／钢质船体

examples.en: They climbed onto the upturned hull and waited to be rescued.
examples.zh: 他们爬上了倾覆的船体，等候救援。

senses.def: to remove the outer layer that covers peas
senses.zh: 剥去（豆子、谷物等）的外壳；摘掉（草莓）的花萼

examples.en: First wash and hull the strawberries.
examples.zh: 首先将草莓洗净并去皮。

examples.en: hulled barley
examples.zh: 去壳大麦

senses.def: a port and industrial centre in Humberside
senses.zh: 船体：英格兰东北部亨伯赛德的港口和工业中心。它在亨伯河上。

senses.def: a lot of loud noise, especially made by people who are annoyed or excited about something

examples.en: They looked outside to find out what all the hullabaloo was about.
examples.zh: 他们向外面看去，想知道到底发生了什么事。

examples.en: The government can expect a real hullabaloo when these measures are announced.
examples.zh: 当这些措施宣布时，政府预计会引起真正的喧嚣。

senses.def: used as a greeting
senses.zh: （用于问候、发电邮、接电话或引起注意）哈啰，喂，你好

examples.en: Hullo John, how are you?
examples.zh: 你好，约翰，你好吗？

examples.en: Hullo, is there anybody there?
examples.zh: 喂，有人在吗？

examples.en: Say hullo to Liz for me.
examples.zh: 代我向莉兹问好。

examples.en: They exchanged hullos (= said hullo to each other) and forced smiles.
examples.zh: 他们互相打招呼，强作笑容。

senses.def: used to show that you are surprised by something

examples.en: Hullo, hullo, what's going on here?
examples.zh: 哈啰，哈啰，这是怎么回事？

senses.def: used to show that you think somebody has said something stupid or is not paying attention
senses.zh: （认为别人说了蠢话或分心）喂，嘿

examples.en: Hullo? You didn't really mean that, did you?
examples.zh: 喂？你其实不是这个意思，是吗？

examples.en: I'm like, ‘Hullo! Did you even listen?’
examples.zh: 我就像，‘哈喽！你到底有没有听？

senses.def: to sing a tune with your lips closed

examples.en: She was humming softly to herself.
examples.zh: 她在轻声哼着曲子。

examples.en: He began to hum along with the music.
examples.zh: 他开始跟着音乐哼唱。

examples.en: What's that tune you're humming?
examples.zh: 你哼的是什么曲子？

senses.def: to make a low continuous sound

examples.en: The computers were humming away.
examples.zh: 计算机在嗡嗡作响。

examples.en: The overhead wires hummed with power.
examples.zh: 通了电后，架空电线嗡嗡地响着。

senses.def: to be full of activity

examples.en: The streets were beginning to hum with life.
examples.zh: 街道开始热闹起来。

examples.en: The whole room was humming now.
examples.zh: 整个房间现在热闹非凡。

examples.en: Things were beginning to hum.
examples.zh: 事情开始变得热闹起来.

senses.def: to take a long time to make a decision or before you say something
senses.zh: 犹豫不决；支支吾吾；嗯嗯呃呃

examples.en: We hummed and hawed for weeks before deciding to buy the house.
examples.zh: 我们在决定买房之前犹豫了好几个星期。

senses.def: a low continuous sound

examples.en: the hum of bees/traffic/voices
examples.zh: 蜜蜂的嗡嗡声；车辆的呜呜声；人的嘈杂声

examples.en: The room filled with the hum of conversation.
examples.zh: 房间里充满了嘈杂的谈话声。

examples.en: the background hum of the air-conditioning
examples.zh: 空调发出的隐隐的嗡嗡声

senses.def: to take a long time to make a decision or before you say something
senses.zh: 犹豫不决；支支吾吾；嗯嗯呃呃

examples.en: We hummed and hawed for weeks before deciding to buy the house.
examples.zh: 我们在决定买房之前犹豫了好几个星期。

senses.def: to take a long time to make a decision or before you say something
senses.zh: 犹豫不决；支支吾吾；嗯嗯呃呃

examples.en: We hummed and hawed for weeks before deciding to buy the house.
examples.zh: 我们在决定买房之前犹豫了好几个星期。

senses.def: of or connected with people rather than animals, machines or gods

examples.en: the human body/brain
examples.zh: 人体；人脑

examples.en: a terrible loss of human life
examples.zh: 生命的惨重损失

examples.en: human development/activity/behaviour
examples.zh: 人类发展／活动／行为

examples.en: Human remains (= the body of a dead person) were found inside the house.
examples.zh: 在房子里发现了尸体。

examples.en: Contact with other people is a basic human need.
examples.zh: 和他人接触是人的基本需要。

examples.en: This food is not fit for human consumption.
examples.zh: 这种食物不适合人食用。

examples.en: one of the greatest leaders in human history
examples.zh: 人类历史上最伟大的领导者之一

examples.en: He tried to use a bystander as a human shield.
examples.zh: 他试图利用一名旁观者作为人盾。

examples.en: Firefighters formed a human chain (= a line of people) to carry the children to safety.
examples.zh: 消防队员组成人链把孩子们救到了安全的地方。

examples.en: After washing her face, she felt almost human (= like her normal self) again.
examples.zh: 洗完脸后，她感觉自己恢复了原本的样子。

senses.def: showing the weaknesses and desires that are typical of people, which means that other people should not criticize the person too much
senses.zh: 显示人性弱点（或欲望的）的；人本性的

examples.en: human weaknesses/failings
examples.zh: 人性的弱点／缺点

examples.en: It's only human to want the best for your children.
examples.zh: 为自己的孩子谋求最好的条件是人之常情。

senses.def: having the same feelings and emotions as most ordinary people

examples.en: He's really very human when you get to know him.
examples.zh: 你若了解他，就知道他确实很有人情味。

examples.en: Perhaps she's human after all, he thought.
examples.zh: 也许她毕竟是人类，他想。

examples.en: The public is always attracted to politicians who have the human touch (= the ability to make ordinary people feel relaxed when they meet them).
examples.zh: 公众总是对平易近人的政治人物有好感。

senses.def: a person who is involved in a subject, issue, etc. and makes it easier for ordinary people to understand and have sympathy with it
senses.zh: （某主题、话题等的）标志性人物

examples.en: He is the human face of party politics.
examples.zh: 他是政党政治的标志性人物。

senses.def: kind behaviour, considered to be natural to humans
senses.zh: 人的善良天性；恻隐之心

senses.def: that considers the needs of ordinary people
senses.zh: 考虑老百姓需要的；有人情味的；人性化的

examples.en: This was science with a human face.
examples.zh: 这是大众需要的科学。

senses.def: a person rather than an animal or a machine

examples.en: Dogs can hear much better than humans.
examples.zh: 狗的听觉比人灵敏得多。

examples.en: That is no way to treat another human being.
examples.zh: 那绝不是对待他人的方式。

examples.en: the colonization of Europe by modern humans
examples.zh: 现代人类对欧洲的殖民

senses.def: a person who is involved in a subject, issue, etc. and makes it easier for ordinary people to understand and have sympathy with it
senses.zh: （某主题、话题等的）标志性人物

examples.en: He is the human face of party politics.
examples.zh: 他是政党政治的标志性人物。

senses.def: kind behaviour, considered to be natural to humans
senses.zh: 人的善良天性；恻隐之心

senses.def: that considers the needs of ordinary people
senses.zh: 考虑老百姓需要的；有人情味的；人性化的

examples.en: This was science with a human face.
examples.zh: 这是大众需要的科学。

senses.def: the skills, knowledge and experience of a person or group of people, seen as something valuable that an organization or country can make use of

examples.en: The education system is central to the development of skills and human capital.
examples.zh: 教育制度对技能的培养和人力资本的发展至关重要。

examples.en: to build/develop/invest in human capital.
examples.zh: 积累／开发／投资于人力资本

examples.en: The greatest resource any country has is the creativity of its citizens: what economists call human capital.
examples.zh: 一个国家所拥有的最大资源是其公民的创造能力，即经济学家所说的人力资本。

senses.def: the fact of making mistakes as a natural result of being human; mistakes of this kind

examples.en: We must allow for human error.
examples.zh: 我们必须考虑到人为错误。

senses.def: the fact that a mistake is made by a person, rather than as a result of technology failing to work correctly; mistakes of this kind
senses.zh: （相对于技术错误的）人为失误，人为误差

examples.en: The plane crash was caused by human error, not mechanical failure.
examples.zh: 这次飞机失事是人为失误造成的，不是机械故障。

senses.def: the scientific study of how human activity affects or is affected by the surface of the earth

examples.en: She is a lecturer in the human geography of China.
examples.zh: 她是中国人文地理学讲师。

examples.en: Human geography covers topics ranging from cultural differences and politics to agriculture and food production.
examples.zh: 人文地理学涵盖的主题从文化差异和政治到农业和粮食生产。

senses.def: the part of a story in the media that people find interesting because it describes the experiences, feelings, etc. of the people involved

examples.en: a human interest story
examples.zh: 有人情味的报道

examples.en: a story devoid of human interest
examples.zh: 一个缺乏人类趣味的故事

senses.def: the ways of behaving, thinking and feeling that are shared by most people and are considered to be normal

examples.en: Her kindness has restored my faith in human nature (= the belief that people are good).
examples.zh: 她的善良使我重新燃起了对人性的信心。

examples.en: It's only human nature to be worried about change.
examples.zh: 对变革有忧虑不过是人之常情。

senses.def: people’s skills and abilities, seen as something a company, an organization, etc. can make use of

examples.en: She’s responsible for making the best use of human resources.
examples.zh: 她负责最有效地利用人力资源。

senses.def: the department in a company that deals with employing and training people

examples.en: the human resources director
examples.zh: 人事部主管

examples.en: She works in human resources.
examples.zh: 她在人事部工作。

examples.en: Human resources is/are encouraging more staff to take up training opportunities.
examples.zh: 人力资源部门正在鼓励更多员工接受培训机会。

senses.def: one of the basic rights that everyone has to be treated fairly and not in a cruel way, especially by their government

examples.en: The country has a poor record on human rights.
examples.zh: 这个国家人权记录不佳。

examples.en: to campaign for human rights
examples.zh: 争取人权

examples.en: The constitution guarantees basic human rights.
examples.zh: 宪法保障基本人权。

examples.en: This is a fundamental human right.
examples.zh: 这是一项基本的人权。

examples.en: A government that violates human rights cannot be tolerated.
examples.zh: 侵犯人权的政府是不能容忍的。

examples.en: human rights abuses/violations
examples.zh: 对人权的侵犯／践踏

examples.en: human rights activists/campaigners
examples.zh: 人权活动家

senses.def: a person or group of people forced to stay near a possible target for attack, in order to prevent an attack

examples.en: The gunman used the hostages as a human shield.
examples.zh: 枪手把人质当作人肉盾牌。

senses.def: a person who illegally transports people across international borders
the crime of illegally transporting people across international borders

examples.en: We need more effective measures to combat human smuggling.
examples.zh: 我们需要采取更有效的措施来打击人口走私。

senses.def: a person who illegally transports or controls people and forces them to work in the sex trade or other forms of forced labour

examples.en: The government vowed to crack down on human traffickers.
examples.zh: 政府发誓要严厉打击人口贩运者。

senses.def: the crime of transporting or controlling people and forcing them to work in the sex trade or other forms of forced labour

examples.en: gangs involved in human trafficking and sexual exploitation
examples.zh: 参与人口贩运和性剥削的团伙

senses.def: being kind towards people and animals by making sure that they do not suffer more than is necessary

examples.en: a caring and humane society
examples.zh: 充满关怀和人道的社会

examples.en: These regulations ensure the humane treatment of all refugees.
examples.zh: 这些规定确保所有难民得到人道待遇。

examples.en: Campaigners claim that the animals are not being kept in humane conditions.
examples.zh: 活动人士声称，这些动物的饲养条件不人道。

examples.en: the humane killing of animals
examples.zh: 对动物的人道毁灭

senses.def: in a way that is kind towards people and animals by making sure they do not suffer more than is necessary

examples.en: to treat somebody humanely
examples.zh: 仁慈地对待某人

examples.en: meat that has been humanely produced
examples.zh: 用人道屠宰方式生产的肉

examples.en: The dog was humanely destroyed.
examples.zh: 那条狗被人道毁灭了。

senses.def: a system of thought that considers that solving human problems with the help of reason is more important than religious beliefs. It emphasizes the fact that the basic nature of humans is good.
a person who believes in humanism
believing in or based on humanism

examples.en: humanist ideals
examples.zh: 人文主义理想

senses.def: believing in or based on humanism

examples.en: humanistic ideals
examples.zh: 人文主义理想

senses.def: connected with helping people who are suffering and improving the conditions that they are living in
senses.zh: 人道主义的；人道主义精神的

examples.en: to provide humanitarian aid to the war zone
examples.zh: 给战区提供人道主义援助

examples.en: humanitarian issues
examples.zh: 人道主义问题

examples.en: a humanitarian organization
examples.zh: 人道主义组织

examples.en: They are calling for the release of the hostages on humanitarian grounds.
examples.zh: 他们站在人道主义立场要求释放人质。

senses.def: describing an event or situation that causes or involves a lot of human suffering, especially one that requires aid to be provided to a large number of people
senses.zh: 人道主义的：描述导致或涉及很多人痛苦的事件或情况，尤其是需要向大量人提供援助的事件或情况

examples.en: a humanitarian crisis
examples.zh: 人道主义危机

examples.en: These floods are the worst humanitarian disaster the country has seen.
examples.zh: 这次洪灾是该国经历过的最严重的人道主义灾难。

examples.en: The expulsion of thousands of people represents a humanitarian catastrophe of enormous proportions.
examples.zh: 驱逐成千上万人意味着人道主义的巨大灾难。

senses.def: a person who tries to help people who are suffering and improve the conditions that they are living in
senses.zh: 人道主义的（主张减轻人类苦难、改善人类生活）；慈善的

senses.def: the beliefs and practices of people who try to help people who are suffering and improve the conditions that they are living in
senses.zh: 人道主义：试图帮助遭受苦难的人并改善其生活条件的人们的信念和做法

senses.def: people in general

examples.en: He was found guilty of crimes against humanity.
examples.zh: 他被判犯有反人类罪。

examples.en: He believed in serving the greater good of humanity.
examples.zh: 他相信为人类更大的利益服务。

examples.en: We are talking about nothing less than the survival of humanity.
examples.zh: 我们谈论的无非是人类的生存。

senses.def: the state of being a person rather than a god, an animal or a machine

examples.en: The story was used to emphasize the humanity of Jesus.
examples.zh: 人们用这个故事来强调耶稣人性的一面。

examples.en: united by a sense of common humanity
examples.zh: 因一种同是人的情感而团结在一起

senses.def: the quality of being kind to people and animals by making sure that they do not suffer more than is necessary; the quality of being humane

examples.en: The judge was praised for his courage and humanity.
examples.zh: 法官的勇气和人道受到称赞。

senses.def: the subjects of study that are about the way people think and behave, for example literature, language, history and philosophy

examples.en: The college offers a wide range of courses in the arts and humanities.

examples.en: You'll have to hurry if you want to catch that train.
examples.zh: 如果你想赶上那趟火车就得抓紧时间了。

examples.en: We need to hurry or we'll be late for school.
examples.zh: 我们得快点，不然上学就要迟到了。

examples.en: The kids hurried to open their presents.
examples.zh: 孩子们急忙打开礼物。

senses.def: to move quickly in a particular direction

examples.en: He picked up his bags and hurried across the courtyard.
examples.zh: 他拎起提包匆匆穿过院子。

examples.en: She hurried away without saying goodbye.
examples.zh: 她连声再见都没说就急忙离开了。

examples.en: She hurried after Gary to apologize to him.
examples.zh: 她赶紧追上加里，向他道歉。

examples.en: She hurried down the street.
examples.zh: 她快步沿着街道走去。

examples.en: I hurried home to tell him the news.
examples.zh: 我赶紧回家告诉他这个消息。

senses.def: to make somebody do something more quickly

examples.en: I don't want to hurry you but we close in twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 我并不想催你，但我们再过二十分钟就要关门。

examples.en: She was hurried into making an unwise choice.
examples.zh: 她在催逼之下作出了不明智的选择。

senses.def: to deal with something quickly

examples.en: Her application was hurried through.
examples.zh: 她的申请很快得到了处理。

senses.def: to do something too quickly

examples.en: A good meal should never be hurried.
examples.zh: 美餐绝不能狼吞虎咽。

senses.def: the need or wish to get something done quickly

examples.en: Take your time—there's no hurry.
examples.zh: 悠着点，不用急。

examples.en: What's the hurry? The train doesn't leave for an hour.
examples.zh: 慌什么？火车还有一个小时才开呢。

examples.en: In my hurry to leave, I forgot my passport.
examples.zh: 我匆忙动身，忘了带护照。

senses.def: very quickly or more quickly than usual

examples.en: He had to leave in a hurry.
examples.zh: 他不得不赶快离开了。

senses.def: not having enough time to do something

examples.en: Sorry, I haven't got time to do it now—I'm in a hurry.
examples.zh: 对不起，我现在没时间做这个，我忙着呢。

examples.en: Alice was in a tearing hurry as usual.
examples.zh: 艾丽斯一如往常地来去匆匆。

examples.en: I was late for work and in a big hurry.
examples.zh: 我上班迟了，心急火燎。

senses.def: impatient to do something

examples.en: My daughter is in such a hurry to grow up.
examples.zh: 我女儿恨不得一下子就长大。

examples.en: Why are you in such a hurry to sell?
examples.zh: 你为什么如此迫不及待地要卖出？

examples.en: They were in a hurry to set off.
examples.zh: 他们急着要启程。

senses.def: having plenty of time
senses.zh: 有足够的时间，不着急（做某事）

examples.en: I don't mind waiting—I'm not in any particular hurry.
examples.zh: 我可以等，我没什么特别急的事。

examples.en: Serve this lady first—I’m in no hurry.
examples.zh: 先招待这位女士吧，我不急。

senses.def: not wanting or not willing to do something

examples.en: We were in no hurry to get back to work after the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期结束后我们不想急着回去工作。

examples.en: She's in no hurry to find out how much her fuel bill comes to.
examples.zh: 她并不急于了解她的燃油费是多少。

senses.def: used to say that somebody does not want to do something again because it was not pleasant or fun

examples.en: I won't be going there again in a hurry—the food was terrible.
examples.zh: 我再不愿去那里了，那里吃的东西糟透了。

senses.def: very quickly or more quickly than usual

examples.en: He had to leave in a hurry.
examples.zh: 他不得不赶快离开了。

senses.def: not having enough time to do something

examples.en: Sorry, I haven't got time to do it now—I'm in a hurry.
examples.zh: 对不起，我现在没时间做这个，我忙着呢。

examples.en: Alice was in a tearing hurry as usual.
examples.zh: 艾丽斯一如往常地来去匆匆。

examples.zh: 我上班迟了，心急火燎。

senses.zh: 有足够的时间，不着急（做某事）

examples.en: I don't mind waiting—I'm not in any particular hurry.
examples.zh: 我可以等，我没什么特别急的事。

examples.en: Serve this lady first—I’m in no hurry.
examples.zh: 先招待这位女士吧，我不急。
