examples.en: We were in no hurry to get back to work after the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期结束后我们不想急着回去工作。

examples.en: She's in no hurry to find out how much her fuel bill comes to.
examples.zh: 她并不急于了解她的燃油费是多少。

items.idm: somebody will not do something again in a hurry

senses.def: used to say that somebody does not want to do something again because it was not pleasant or fun

examples.en: I won't be going there again in a hurry—the food was terrible.
examples.zh: 我再不愿去那里了，那里吃的东西糟透了。

senses.def: to continue speaking without giving anyone else time to say anything
senses.zh: 喋喋不休；啰唆得没完没了

examples.en: She hurried on before he could interrupt her.
examples.zh: 在他打断她之前，她快步走了下去。

senses.def: to do something more quickly because there is not much time

examples.en: I wish the bus would hurry up and come.
examples.zh: 我希望公共汽车能快点来。

examples.en: Hurry up! We're going to be late.
examples.zh: 快点！我们要迟到了。

examples.en: Hurry up with the scissors. I need them.
examples.zh: 快点用剪刀。我需要用。

examples.en: Hurry up or we'll be late!
examples.zh: 快一些，不然咱们要迟到了。〈phr.〉

senses.def: to make somebody do something more quickly; to make something happen more quickly

examples.en: Can you do anything to hurry my order up?
examples.zh: 你能不能设法让我点的东西快点送来？

senses.def: to cause physical pain to somebody/yourself; to injure somebody/yourself

examples.en: He hurt his back playing squash.
examples.zh: 他打壁球时背部受伤了。

examples.en: Strong light hurts my eyes.
examples.zh: 强光刺痛我的眼睛。

examples.en: Did you hurt yourself?
examples.zh: 你伤着自己了吗？

examples.en: Stop it. You're hurting me.
examples.zh: 住手。你弄疼我了。

examples.en: No one was seriously hurt in the accident.
examples.zh: 事故中没有人受重伤。

examples.en: My back is really hurting me today.
examples.zh: 我今天背疼得厉害。

examples.en: My shoes hurt—they're too tight.
examples.zh: 我的鞋子太紧，穿着夹脚。

senses.def: to feel painful

examples.en: My feet hurt.
examples.zh: 我脚疼。

examples.en: My head hurts.
examples.zh: 我的头疼。

examples.en: Ouch! That hurt!
examples.zh: 哎哟！好疼！

examples.en: It hurts when I bend my knee.
examples.zh: 我的膝盖一弯就疼。

examples.en: It hurts if I move my neck.
examples.zh: 脖子一动就会痛。

examples.en: It hurts to breathe.
examples.zh: 一呼吸就痛。

senses.def: to make somebody unhappy or upset

examples.en: What really hurt was that he never answered my calls.
examples.zh: 真正令人伤心的是他从来不接我的电话。

examples.en: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to hurt you.
examples.zh: 对不起，我不是故意伤害你的。

examples.en: I didn't want to hurt his feelings.
examples.zh: 我并没有想伤害他的感情。

examples.en: It always hurts to lose, especially in the final.
examples.zh: 输球总是让人痛苦，尤其是在决赛中。

examples.en: It hurt me to think that he would lie to me.
examples.zh: 一想到他竟然对我说谎，我就很伤心。

senses.def: to feel unhappy or upset

examples.en: I know you're hurting and I want to help you.
examples.zh: 我知道你心烦，我想帮助你。

senses.def: to have a bad effect on somebody/something

examples.en: Hard work never hurt anyone.
examples.zh: 努力工作绝无害处。

examples.en: Many people on low incomes will be hurt by the government's plans.
examples.zh: 很多低收入的人将受到政府这些方案的打击。

examples.en: High interest rates are hurting the local economy.
examples.zh: 高利率正在损害本地经济。

senses.def: to be in a difficult situation because you need something, especially money

examples.en: His campaign is already hurting for money.
examples.zh: 他从事的社会运动已经因缺乏经费而难以为继了。

senses.def: to affect somebody where they will feel it most
senses.zh: 刺着某人痛处；击中要害

senses.def: used to say that somebody should do a particular thing
senses.zh: （做某事）不会有什么损害；（某人）应该做某事

examples.en: It wouldn't hurt you to help with the housework occasionally.
examples.zh: 你应该偶尔帮忙做做家务。

senses.def: to be kind and gentle and unwilling to cause unhappiness
senses.zh: 连一只苍蝇都不肯伤害；心地善良

senses.def: injured physically

examples.en: None of the passengers were badly hurt.
examples.zh: 乘客中没有人严重受伤。

examples.en: Steve didn't look seriously hurt.
examples.zh: 史蒂夫看起来没受重伤。

examples.en: Stop that or you'll get hurt!
examples.zh: 不要那样做，否则你会受伤的！

senses.def: upset and offended by something that somebody has said or done

examples.en: a hurt look/expression
examples.zh: 伤心的眼神／表情

examples.en: You have every right to feel hurt.
examples.zh: 你伤心是完全合理的。

examples.en: She was deeply hurt that she had not been invited.
examples.zh: 她未被邀请，感到十分难过。

examples.en: Martha's hurt pride showed in her eyes.
examples.zh: 从玛莎的眼神可以看出她的自尊受到了伤害。

senses.def: a feeling of unhappiness because somebody has been unkind or unfair to you

examples.en: There was hurt and real anger in her voice.
examples.zh: 她的声音里有难过，也有真正的愤怒。

examples.en: He apologized for any hurt caused by his remarks.
examples.zh: 他为自己的言论造成的任何伤害表示歉意。

examples.en: It was a hurt that would take a long time to heal.
examples.zh: 那是需要很长时间才能愈合的创伤。

examples.en: It's time to forgive past hurts and open your heart.
examples.zh: 是时候原谅过去的伤害并敞开心扉了。

senses.def: to affect somebody where they will feel it most
senses.zh: 刺着某人痛处；击中要害

senses.def: used to say that somebody should do a particular thing
senses.zh: （做某事）不会有什么损害；（某人）应该做某事

examples.en: It wouldn't hurt you to help with the housework occasionally.
examples.zh: 你应该偶尔帮忙做做家务。

senses.def: to be kind and gentle and unwilling to cause unhappiness
senses.zh: 连一只苍蝇都不肯伤害；心地善良

synonyms.words: wound ▪ hurt ▪ bruise ▪ sprain ▪ pull ▪ strain

intro.en: These words all mean to harm yourself or somebody else physically, especially in an accident.
intro.zh: 以上各词主要指在事故中伤害、使受伤。

items.def: to harm yourself or somebody else physically, especially in an accident:
items.zh: 尤指在事故中伤害、使受伤

examples.en: He injured his knee playing hockey.
examples.zh: 他打曲棍球时弄伤了膝盖。

items.def: [often passive] (rather formal) to injure part of the body, especially by making a hole in the skin using a weapon:
items.zh: 指使身体受伤，尤指用武器伤害

examples.en: 50 people were seriously wounded in the attack.
examples.zh: 这次攻击中有 50 人受重伤。

items.def: to cause physical pain to somebody/​yourself; to injure somebody/​yourself:
items.zh: 指（使）疼痛、受伤

examples.en: Did you hurt yourself?
examples.zh: 你伤着自己了吗？

items.def: to make a blue, brown or purple mark (= a bruise) appear on the skin after somebody has fallen or been hit; to develop a bruise
items.zh: 指摔伤、撞伤、（使）出现瘀伤

items.def: to injure part of your body, especially your ankle, wrist or knee, by suddenly twisting it, causing pain and swelling
items.zh: 指扭伤（踝、腕、膝）

items.def: to damage a muscle, etc., by using too much force
items.zh: 指拉伤、扭伤（肌肉等）

items.def: to injure yourself or part of your body by making it work too hard:
items.zh: 指损伤、拉伤、扭伤

examples.en: Don’t strain your eyes by reading in poor light.
examples.zh: 别在光线不足的地方看书把眼睛给伤了。

synonyms.words: ache ▪ burn ▪ sting ▪ tingle ▪ itch ▪ throb

intro.en: These are all words that can be used when part of your body feels painful.
intro.zh: 以上各词均可指身体部位感到疼痛。

items.def: (of part of your body) to feel painful; (of an action) to cause pain:
items.zh: 指（身体部位）感到疼痛、（某一动作）引起疼痛

examples.en: My feet hurt.
examples.zh: 我脚疼。

items.def: to feel a continuous pain that is not severe:
items.zh: 指（持续地）疼痛、隐痛

examples.en: I’m aching all over.
examples.zh: 我周身疼痛。

items.def: (of part of your body) to feel very hot and painful:
items.zh: 指（身体部位）火辣辣地痛、发烫

examples.en: Our eyes were burning from the chemicals in the air.
examples.zh: 空气中弥漫的化学物质熏得我们的眼睛火辣辣地痛。

items.def: to make somebody feel a sharp burning pain or uncomfortable feeling in part of their body; (of part of your body) to feel this pain:
items.zh: 指（使）身体部位感觉刺痛、灼痛

examples.en: My eyes were stinging from the smoke.
examples.zh: 烟熏得我眼睛痛。

items.def: (of part of your body) to feel as if a lot of small sharp points are pushing into the skin there:
items.zh: 指（身体部位）感到刺痛

examples.en: The cold air made her face tingle.
examples.zh: 冷空气冻得她的脸发痛。

items.def: to have an uncomfortable feeling on your skin that makes you want to scratch; to make your skin feel like this:
items.zh: （使）发痒

examples.en: I itch all over.
examples.zh: 我浑身痒。

items.def: (of part of your body) to feel pain as a series of regular beats:
items.zh: 指（身体部位）有规律地抽动、抽痛

examples.en: His head throbbed painfully.
examples.zh: 他的头一抽一跳地痛。

intro.en: These words all mean to have a bad effect on somebody/​something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含伤害、损害之义。

items.def: to cause physical harm to something, making it less attractive, useful or valuable; to have a bad effect on somebody/​something’s life, health, happiness or chances of success:
items.zh: 指毁坏、破坏、伤害、损害

examples.en: The fire badly damaged the town hall.
examples.zh: 火灾使市政厅遭到严重破坏。

items.def: (rather informal) to have a bad effect on somebody/​something’s life, health, happiness or chances of success:
items.zh: 指伤害、损害

examples.en: Hard work never hurt anyone.
examples.zh: 努力工作绝无害处。

items.def: to have a bad effect on somebody/​something’s life, health, happiness or chances of success:
items.zh: 指伤害、损害

examples.en: Pollution can harm marine life.
examples.zh: 污染会危及海洋生物。

items.def: (rather formal) to damage somebody’s health, abilities or chances:
items.zh: 指损害、削弱（健康、能力或机会）

examples.en: Even one drink can impair driving performance.
examples.zh: 即使一杯酒也可能影响驾驶操作。

senses.def: making you feel upset and offended

examples.en: I cannot forget the hurtful things he said.
examples.zh: 我无法忘记他说的那些伤感情的话。

examples.en: She made some very hurtful remarks.
examples.zh: 她说了些非常伤感情的话。

examples.en: The bad reviews of her new book were very hurtful to her.
examples.zh: 对她的新书的负面评论使她很难过。

examples.en: What he said was deeply hurtful to me.
examples.zh: 他的话深深地刺伤了我。

senses.def: in a way that makes you feel upset and offended

examples.en: He said, rather hurtfully, that he had better things to do than come and see me.
examples.zh: 他相当刻薄地说，来看我还不如去干别的事。

senses.def: to move very fast in a particular direction

examples.en: A runaway car came hurtling towards us.
examples.zh: 一辆失控的汽车朝我们猛冲过来。

senses.def: the man that somebody is married to; a married man

examples.en: This is my husband, Steve.
examples.zh: 这位是我的丈夫，史蒂夫。

examples.en: How did you meet your husband?
examples.zh: 你是怎么认识你丈夫的？

examples.en: She's finally decided to leave her husband.
examples.zh: 她终于决定离开她的丈夫。

examples.en: She lost her husband (= he died) recently.
examples.zh: 她新近丧夫

examples.en: her late husband
examples.zh: 她的亡夫

examples.en: his husband of four years
examples.zh: 他结婚四年的丈夫

examples.en: It had been a shock to find himself a husband and father.
examples.zh: 发现自己已为人夫、为人父，他着实吃了一惊。

senses.def: a man and woman who are married to each other

examples.en: They lived together as husband and wife (= as if they were married) for years.
examples.zh: 他们像夫妻一样共同生活了很多年。

examples.en: a husband-and-wife team
examples.zh: 夫妻队

senses.def: to use something very carefully and make sure that you do not waste it

examples.en: Times are hard and we have to husband our resources.
examples.zh: 时代很艰难，我们必须节约资源。

examples.en: She waited, husbanding her strength for her next visitors.
examples.zh: 她等待着，为下一位访客节省体力。

senses.def: a man and woman who are married to each other

examples.en: They lived together as husband and wife (= as if they were married) for years.
examples.zh: 他们像夫妻一样共同生活了很多年。

examples.en: a husband-and-wife team
examples.zh: 夫妻队

senses.def: a man and woman who are married to each other

examples.en: They lived together as husband and wife (= as if they were married) for years.
examples.zh: 他们像夫妻一样共同生活了很多年。

examples.en: a husband-and-wife team
examples.zh: 夫妻队

senses.def: farming, especially when done carefully and well

examples.en: animal/crop husbandry
examples.zh: 畜牧业；种植业

senses.def: the careful use of food, money and supplies
to be quiet; to stop talking or crying

examples.en: Hush now and try to sleep.
examples.zh: 别出声了，睡吧。

senses.def: to make somebody/something become quieter; to make somebody stop talking, crying, etc.
senses.zh: 使安静下来；使停止说话（或叫喊等）

examples.en: She tenderly hushed the baby in her arms.
examples.zh: 她温柔地把怀里的孩子安静下来。

senses.def: a period of silence, especially following a lot of noise, or when people are expecting something to happen

examples.en: There was a deathly hush in the theatre.
examples.zh: 戏院里一片寂静。

examples.en: A hush descended over the waiting crowd.
examples.zh: 等候的人群变得鸦雀无声。

examples.en: Can we have a bit of hush? (= please be quiet)
examples.zh: 大家能安静一点吗？

senses.def: a popular old lullaby
senses.zh: 嘘，再见，宝贝：一种流行的老催眠曲。在美国，歌曲的名称和第一行是Rock-a-bye，baby。曲调与Lilliburlero相似。

senses.def: secret and not known about by many people

examples.en: Their wedding was very hush-hush.
examples.zh: 他们的婚礼非常秘密。

senses.def: money that is paid to somebody to prevent them from giving other people information that could be embarrassing or damaging
senses.zh: 封口费（用于防止某人透露令人尴尬或有损害的消息）

examples.en: The company paid hush money to the victims to keep them quiet.
examples.zh: 公司给受害人付了封口费。

senses.def: small fried cakes made of cornmeal
senses.zh: 黄金玉米球（尤见于美国南部的一种糕点，用玉米粉炸成小球状）

senses.def: a make of shoes made mostly of soft leather with rubber soles
senses.zh: 暇步士鞋（一个鞋品牌，其鞋子大多用柔软的皮革制成，橡胶鞋底，款式多样）

senses.def: to hide information about a situation because you do not want people to know about it

examples.en: He claimed that the whole affair had been hushed up by the council.
examples.zh: 他声称整个事件都被市政会一手捂住了。

senses.def: the dry outer layer that covers nuts, fruits and seeds, especially grain
senses.zh: （尤指谷类、果实和种子的）外壳，外皮

examples.en: Brown rice has not had the husks removed.
examples.zh: 糙米没有去除外壳。

examples.en: There was only the husk left of his former self.
examples.zh: 只剩下他以前的躯壳了。

senses.def: to remove the husks

examples.en: Husk the ears of corn and brush them with melted butter.
examples.zh: 玉米穗去壳，刷上融化的黄油。

examples.en: husked corn
examples.zh: 去壳玉米

senses.def: in a way that sounds deep, quiet and rough, sometimes in an attractive way

examples.en: ‘You’re beautiful,’ he murmured huskily.
examples.zh: “你真漂亮。”他沙哑地低声说道。

senses.def: a deep, quiet and rough quality of the voice, sometimes considered attractive
senses.zh: 哈士奇：声音深沉，安静且粗糙，有时被认为具有吸引力

senses.def: the quality in a man of being big, strong and sexually attractive
sounding deep, quiet and rough, sometimes in an attractive way

examples.en: She spoke in a husky whisper.

senses.def: used to encourage people and to tell them that they are doing something right

examples.en: That's the idea! You're doing fine.
examples.zh: 对啦！你做得不错。

senses.def: used to show that something is hard for somebody else to imagine

examples.en: You've no idea how much traffic there was tonight.
examples.zh: 你难以想象今晚的交通有多拥挤。

intro.en: These are all words for talking about what somebody/​something intends to do or achieve.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指意图、目的、目标。

items.def: what something is supposed to achieve; what somebody is trying to achieve:
items.zh: 指目的、目标

examples.en: Our campaign’s main purpose is to raise money.
examples.zh: 我们这次活动的主要目的是募款。

items.def: what somebody is trying to achieve; what something is supposed to achieve:
items.zh: 指目标、目的

examples.en: She went to London with the aim of finding a job.
examples.zh: 她去伦敦是为了找工作。

items.def: what you intend to do:
items.zh: 指打算、计划、意图

examples.en: I have no intention of going to the wedding.
examples.zh: 我无意去参加婚礼。

items.def: what you intend to do or achieve:
items.zh: 指计划、打算

examples.en: There are no plans to build new offices.
examples.zh: 现在没有建新办公楼的计划。

items.def: (rather informal) the purpose or aim of something:
items.zh: 指意图、目的、理由

examples.en: What’s the point of all this violence?
examples.zh: 这些暴行的意图何在？

items.def: (rather informal) the purpose of something; somebody’s aim:
items.zh: 指目的、意图

examples.en: The whole idea of going was so that we could meet her new boyfriend.
examples.zh: 我们去的唯一目的就是要见她的新男朋友。

senses.def: perfect; most suitable
senses.zh: 完美的；理想的；最合适的

examples.en: an ideal location/place
examples.zh: 理想的地点／地方

examples.en: This beach is ideal for children.
examples.zh: 这个海滩很适合孩子。

examples.en: She's the ideal candidate for the job.
examples.zh: 她是这项工作最合适的人选。

examples.en: The trip to Paris will be an ideal opportunity to practise my French.
examples.zh: 去巴黎旅行将是我练习法语的绝好机会。

examples.en: The prime minister admitted the current situation was ‘not ideal’ (= was bad).
examples.zh: 首相承认目前的情况“不理想”。

examples.en: It was not the ideal solution to the problem.
examples.zh: 这不是问题的理想解决方案。

examples.en: Harvesting is being done in less than ideal conditions.
examples.zh: 收割的条件不太理想。

senses.def: existing only in your imagination or as an idea; not likely to be real

examples.en: the search for ideal love
examples.zh: 对理想中的爱的寻求

senses.def: used to say that something is what you would like to happen or what should happen, but you know it cannot

examples.en: In an ideal world we would be recycling and reusing everything.
examples.zh: 我们要是能回收并再利用所有的东西就再理想不过了。

senses.def: an idea or standard that seems perfect, and worth trying to achieve or obtain
senses.zh: 理想；看似完美的思想（或标准）

examples.en: He was accused of betraying his political ideals.
examples.zh: 他被指控背叛了自己的政治理想。

examples.en: She found it hard to live up to his high ideals.
examples.zh: 她觉得很难达到他的高标准要求。

examples.en: advancing the ideals of freedom and democracy
examples.zh: 推进自由和民主的理想

senses.def: a person or thing that you think is perfect

examples.en: It's my ideal of what a family home should be.
examples.zh: 这是我心目中完美的家庭住宅。

examples.en: This agreement falls far short of the ideal.
examples.zh: 这份协议远不完美。

senses.def: used to say that something is what you would like to happen or what should happen, but you know it cannot

examples.en: In an ideal world we would be recycling and reusing everything.
examples.zh: 我们要是能回收并再利用所有的东西就再理想不过了。

senses.def: a popular British magazine published every month for people who want to decorate or improve their homes. It was first published in 1920.
senses.zh: 理想住宅：每月都会出版的一本流行的英国杂志，专门为想要装修或改善住房的人们提供。它于1920年首次出版。

senses.def: the belief that a perfect life, situation, etc. can be achieved, even when this is not very likely

examples.en: He was full of youthful idealism.
examples.zh: 他满脑子都是年轻人的理想主义。

examples.en: Idealism has no place in modern politics.
examples.zh: 在当代政治生活中，理想主义根本行不通。

senses.def: the belief that our ideas are the only things that are real and that we can know about
senses.zh: 唯心主义；唯心论；观念论；理念论

senses.def: a person who believes that a perfect life, situation, etc. can be achieved, even when this is not very likely

examples.en: He's too much of an idealist for this government.
examples.zh: 他在这届政府中是一个过度的理想主义者。

senses.def: a person who believes in the theory of idealism
senses.zh: 唯心主义；唯心论；观念论；理念论

senses.def: having a strong belief in perfect standards and trying to achieve them, even when this is not realistic

examples.en: She's still young and idealistic.
examples.zh: 她还年轻并且耽于空想。

senses.def: in a way that shows a strong belief in perfect standards and trying to achieve them, even when this is not realistic
the act of considering or representing somebody/something as being perfect or better than they really are

examples.en: the idealization of a past golden age
examples.zh: 过去黄金时代的理想化

senses.def: to consider or represent somebody/something as being perfect or better than they really are

examples.en: It is tempting to idealize the past.
examples.zh: 人都爱把过去的日子说得很美好。

examples.en: an idealized view of married life
examples.zh: 对于婚姻生活的理想化的看法

senses.def: perfectly; in the most suitable way
senses.zh: 完美的；理想的；最合适的

examples.en: She's ideally suited for this job.
examples.zh: 她是这份工作的理想人选。

senses.def: in an imagined way; in a way that is not likely to happen or be real

examples.en: Ideally, I'd like to live in New York, but that's not possible.
examples.zh: 按理想来说，我希望住在纽约，但那是不可能的。

senses.def: to form an idea of something; to imagine something
to form ideas; to think
the act of forming ideas or thoughts
senses.zh: 构想：形成构想或思想的行为

examples.en: Ideation is how designers continuously generate fresh ideas.
examples.zh: 创意是设计师不断产生新想法的方式。

senses.def: an idea or thought that is formed in somebody's mind
senses.zh: 在某人头脑中形成的想法或想法

examples.en: help for people who have experienced suicidal ideations
examples.zh: 为有过自杀念头的人提供帮助

senses.def: an idea or a desire that is so strong that you cannot think about anything else
senses.zh: 执着的想法（或欲望）；固有观念

senses.def: from the same book, article, author, etc. as the one that has just been mentioned
senses.zh: （指出自同一书、文章、作者等）同前，同上

senses.def: a piece of music or a short film that is broadcast between programmes so that people can recognize a radio station or television channel
senses.zh: （电台或电视节目之间插播的）标志曲，标志短片

examples.en: The idents act as a branding device.
examples.zh: 标识充当品牌设备。

examples.en: The new idents have a ‘circle’ theme.
examples.zh: 新标识有一个“圆”主题。

examples.en: They are still working on the station ident.
examples.zh: 他们仍在研究车站标识。

senses.def: an act of showing, proving or recognizing who or what somebody/something is

examples.en: ‘We have a positive ident on the plane,’ Commander Garcia said.
examples.zh: 加西亚指挥官说：“我们在飞机上找到了明确的身份。”

senses.def: similar in every detail

examples.en: a row of identical houses
examples.zh: 完全一样的一排房子

examples.en: The two pictures are similar, although not identical.
examples.zh: 这两幅画很相似，虽然不完全相同。

examples.en: Her dress is almost identical to mine.
examples.zh: 她的连衣裙和我的几乎一模一样。

examples.en: The name on the ticket should be identical with the one in the passport.
examples.zh: 票上的名字应该和护照上的相同。

senses.def: the same

examples.en: This is the identical room we stayed in last year.
examples.zh: 这就是我们去年住的那个房间。

senses.def: either of two children or animals born from the same mother at the same time who have developed from a single egg. Identical twins
senses.zh: 单卵性双胞胎之一（性别相同，外貌相似）

senses.def: in exactly the same way

examples.en: The children were dressed identically.
examples.zh: 孩子们穿得一模一样。

senses.def: that can be recognized

examples.en: identifiable characteristics
examples.zh: 可识别的特征

examples.en: The house is easily identifiable by the large tree outside.
examples.zh: 这房子很容易从外面的这棵大树辨认出来。

examples.en: Pollution release needs to be made a more clearly identifiable criminal offence.
examples.zh: 排污行为需要成为更加明确的刑事犯罪。

examples.en: The offender was clearly identifiable in the footage obtained by the police.
examples.zh: 从警方获得的视频中可以清楚地看出罪犯的身份。

senses.def: the process of showing, proving or recognizing who or what somebody/something is

examples.en: The identification of the crash victims was a long and difficult task.
examples.zh: 坠机事故中伤亡者的辨认工作费时而且困难重重。

examples.en: Accurate identification of these birds is difficult.
examples.zh: 准确识别这些鸟类很困难。

examples.en: Each product has a number for easy identification.
examples.zh: 每件产品都有号码以便于识别。

examples.en: The vehicle's identification number is stamped on the engine.
examples.zh: 车辆识别码就印在发动机上。

examples.en: Biometric identification methods include fingerprints and facial recognition scanners.
examples.zh: 生物识别方法包括指纹和面部识别扫描仪。

examples.en: Only one witness could make a positive identification.
examples.zh: 只有一位目击者能够明确指认。

examples.en: The hospital had mixed up the patients' identification tags.
examples.zh: 医院把病人的身份标牌弄混了。

senses.def: the process of recognizing that something exists, or is important

examples.en: The early identification of children with special educational needs is very important.
examples.zh: 早期确认儿童有特殊教育需求很重要。

senses.def: official papers or a document that can prove who you are

examples.en: Can I see some identification, please?
examples.zh: 请出示某种身份证件好吗？

examples.en: To vote, Florida law requires a photo identification with a signature.
examples.zh: 佛罗里达州的法律要求必须持有带照片和签名的身分证明才能参加选举。

senses.def: a strong feeling of sympathy, understanding or support for somebody/something
senses.zh: 强烈的同情感（或谅解、支持）

examples.en: her emotional identification with the play’s heroine
examples.zh: 她与剧中女主人公在情感上的共鸣

examples.en: their increasing identification with the struggle for independence
examples.zh: 他们对争取独立的斗争越来越大的支持

senses.def: the process of making a close connection between one person or thing and another

examples.en: the voters’ identification of the Democrats with high taxes
examples.zh: 选民把民主党和高税收画上等号

senses.def: a card with a person’s name, date of birth, photograph, etc. on it that proves who they are
a row of people, including one person who is suspected of a crime, who are shown to a witness to see if they can recognize the suspect
senses.zh: 辨认行列，列队认人（把嫌疑犯同其他人排在一起，让目击者辨认）

senses.def: a series of characters used to refer to a program or set of data within a program
senses.zh: 标识符（用来命名程序或其中的数据集）

senses.def: to recognize somebody/something and be able to say who or what they are

examples.en: She was able to identify her attacker.
examples.zh: 她认出了袭击她的人。

examples.en: Passengers were asked to identify their own suitcases before they were put on the plane.
examples.zh: 乘客被要求先确认自己的旅行箱再送上飞机。

examples.en: Many of those arrested refused to identify themselves (= would not say who they were).
examples.zh: 很多被逮捕的人拒不透露身份。

examples.en: The bodies were identified as those of two suspected terrorists.
examples.zh: 经确认，这些尸体是两名恐怖分子嫌疑人的尸体。

examples.en: two species of waterbirds that can be identified by their distinctive beaks
examples.zh: 可以靠它们独特的喙来辨别的两种水鸟

senses.def: to find or discover somebody/something

examples.en: First of all we must identify the problem areas.
examples.zh: 首先我们必须找出问题所在。

examples.en: Scientists have identified the gene responsible for the disease.
examples.zh: 科学家们已经确定了导致这种疾病的基因。

examples.en: As yet they have not identified a buyer for the company.
examples.zh: 迄今为止他们还没有为公司找到买主。

examples.en: to identify a need/factor/source/cause
examples.zh: 确定需求/因素/来源/原因

examples.en: They are trying to identify what is wrong with the present system.
examples.zh: 他们正试图弄清现行制度的弊端所在。

senses.def: to make it possible to recognize who or what somebody/something is

examples.en: In many cases, the clothes people wear identify them as belonging to a particular social class.
examples.zh: 很多情况下，人们的穿着显示出他们的社会阶层。

examples.en: a serial number that uniquely identifies the disk
examples.zh: 用于逐一区分光盘的序列号

synonyms.words: know ▪ recognize ▪ name ▪ make somebody/​something out

intro.en: These words all mean to be able to see or hear somebody/​something and especially to be able to say who or what they are.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含认出、辨别出之义。

items.def: to be able to say who or what somebody/​something is:
items.zh: 指能认出、能辨认出

examples.en: She was able to identify her attacker.
examples.zh: 她认出了袭击她的人。

items.def: to be able to say who or what something is when you see or hear it because you have seen or heard it before Know is used especially to talk about sounds that seem familiar and when somebody recognizes the quality or opportunity that somebody/​something represents:
items.zh: know 尤指认出熟悉的声音、辨别出人或事物所表现出的特质以及发现机会

items.def: to know who somebody is or what something is when you see or hear them/​it, because you have seen or heard them/​it before:
items.zh: 指认识、认出、辨别出

examples.en: I recognized him as soon as he came in the room.
examples.zh: 他一进屋我就认出了他。

items.def: to say the name of somebody/​something in order to show that you know who/​what they are:
items.zh: 指能说出…的名称、叫出…的名字

examples.en: The victim has not yet been named.
examples.zh: 受害人的姓名仍未得知。

items.def: to manage to see or hear somebody/​something that is not very clear:
items.zh: 指看清、听清、分清、辨认清楚

examples.en: I could just make out a figure in the darkness.
examples.zh: 黑暗中我只看出了一个人的轮廓。

senses.def: to recognize or decide that you belong to a particular category
senses.zh: 认为自己属于（某种类别）

examples.en: young people who identify as transgender
examples.zh: 认为自己是跨性别者的年轻人

senses.def: to feel that you can understand and share the feelings of somebody else
senses.zh: 与某人产生共鸣；谅解；同情

examples.en: I didn't enjoy the book because I couldn't identify with any of the main characters.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢这本书，因为我无法与其中的任何主要角色产生共鸣。

examples.en: I can't identify with men like him.
examples.zh: 像他那样的男人我没法认同。

senses.def: to consider somebody to be something

examples.en: He was not the ‘tough guy’ the public identified him with.
examples.zh: 他并不是公众所认定的那种硬汉。

senses.def: to consider something to be the same as something else

examples.en: You should not identify wealth with happiness.
examples.zh: 你不应该认为财富就等于幸福。

senses.def: to support somebody/something; to consider yourself to have a special connection with somebody/something

examples.en: He identified himself with the common people.
examples.zh: 他把自己看作是普通民众的一员。

senses.def: very similar in a way that copies something else rather than showing original thought

examples.en: This historic town will remain unspoilt by identikit coffee houses.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的小镇将不会被千篇一律的咖啡馆所破坏。

examples.en: Endless identikit Mariahs and Beyoncés were belting out the same old tunes.
examples.zh: 无数模仿玛丽亚和碧昂丝的人在高声唱着同样的老调。

senses.def: a picture of a person who is wanted by the police, made by putting together photographs of different features of faces from information that is given by somebody who has seen the person
senses.zh: 通缉犯拼像（根据目击者提供的信息拼凑而成）

senses.def: who or what somebody/something is

examples.en: The police are trying to discover the identity of the killer.
examples.zh: 警方正努力调查杀人凶手的身份。

examples.en: to establish/reveal/confirm the identity of somebody/something
examples.zh: 确定／透露／确认某人／某事物的身份

examples.en: Their names have been changed for the purposes of this article to protect their identities.
examples.zh: 为了保护他们的身份，本文中他们的名字已被更改。

examples.en: Their identities were kept secret.
examples.zh: 他们的身份保密。

examples.en: Do you have any proof of identity?
examples.zh: 你有身份证明吗？

examples.en: The thief used a false identity.
examples.zh: 窃贼使用了假身份。

examples.en: He falls in love with her but can't reveal his true identity.
examples.zh: 他爱上了她，但无法透露自己的真实身份。

examples.en: Each object in the collection has a unique identity number.
examples.zh: 每一件收藏品都有一个独特的标识号。

examples.en: She went through an identity crisis in her teens (= was not sure of who she was or of her place in society).
examples.zh: 她在十多岁时经历了一次身份危机。

senses.def: the characteristics, feelings or beliefs that make people different from others
senses.zh: 特征；特有的感觉（或信仰）

examples.en: national/cultural/personal identity
examples.zh: 国家／文化／个人身份

examples.en: ethnic/racial identity
examples.zh: 民族／种族认同

examples.en: The region's sense of identity remained strong.
examples.zh: 该地区的认同感仍然很强。

examples.en: a plan to strengthen the corporate identity of the company
examples.zh: 加强公司的企业形象的计划

examples.en: Scotland has never lost its identity as a separate nation.
examples.zh: 苏格兰从来没有失去她作为一个独立国家的认同。

examples.en: She was searching for a clearer conception of her identity as a writer.
examples.zh: 她正在寻找对自己作为作家身份的更清晰的概念。

senses.def: the state or feeling of being very similar to and able to understand somebody/something

examples.en: The two companies started working together as a result of a clear identity of interests.
examples.zh: 由于明确的利益一致，两家公司开始合作。

examples.en: He feels a strong sense of identity with his fellow soldiers.
examples.zh: 他对自己的战友有一种强烈的认同感。

examples.en: There's a close identity between fans and their team.
examples.zh: 球迷和他们的球队之间有密切的同一性。

senses.def: a card with a person’s name, date of birth, photograph, etc. on it that proves who they are
a row of people, including one person who is suspected of a crime, who are shown to a witness to see if they can recognize the suspect
senses.zh: 辨认行列，列队认人（把嫌疑犯同其他人排在一起，让目击者辨认）

senses.def: political positions that are based on the social groups that people see themselves as belonging to, for example based on religion, race or social background, rather than on traditional political parties
senses.zh: 身份政治（政治立场不以传统党派划分，而是取决于宗教、种族、社会背景等）

examples.en: Identity politics has dominated this year's election campaigns.
examples.zh: 身份政治主导了今年的竞选活动。

examples.en: He believes identity politics are divisive and harmful.
examples.zh: 他认为身份政治是分裂且有害的。

senses.def: using somebody else’s name and personal information in order to obtain credit cards and other goods or to take money out of the person’s bank accounts
senses.zh: 身份盗窃（利用别人的名字、个人信息等获得信用卡、其他物品或从别人的账户中提取现金等）

examples.en: Victims of identity theft can find themselves saddled with false criminal records.
examples.zh: 身份盗窃的受害者可能会发现自己背负着虚假的犯罪记录。

examples.en: The number of identity thefts in Britain rose to 42 029 last year.
examples.zh: 去年英国的身份盗窃案件上升至 42 029 起。

senses.def: a person who somebody else’s name and personal information in order to obtain credit cards and other goods or to take money out of the person’s bank accounts
senses.zh: 身份窃贼：为了获取信用卡和其他商品或从该人的银行帐户中取出钱财而使用他人的姓名和个人信息的人

examples.en: Identity thieves can wreck a consumer's credit for years.
examples.zh: 身份窃贼可能会损害消费者的信用多年。

senses.def: a symbol that is used in a writing system, for example Chinese, to represent the idea of a thing, rather than the sounds of a word
a sign or a symbol for something
based on or connected with an ideology

examples.en: ideological differences
examples.zh: 意识形态差异

examples.en: This was rejected for ideological reasons.
examples.zh: 这因为意识形态的原因被拒。

examples.en: His agenda has been purely ideological.
examples.zh: 他的目的纯粹是意识形态的。

senses.def: in a way that is based on or connected with an ideology
senses.zh: 意识形态上的：以意识形态为基础或与意识形态有关的方式

examples.en: ideologically correct
examples.zh: 意识形态上正确

examples.en: Particular films may be ideologically driven.
examples.zh: 有些电影是受到意识形态驱使的。

senses.def: a person whose actions are influenced by belief in a set of principles (= by an ideology
a set of ideas that an economic or political system is based on

examples.en: Marxist/capitalist ideology
examples.zh: 马克思主义／资本主义思想体系

senses.def: a set of beliefs, especially one held by a particular group, that influences the way people behave

examples.en: the ideology of gender roles
examples.zh: 性别角色的观念形态

examples.en: alternative ideologies
examples.zh: 非传统的意识形态

senses.def: the middle day of the month in the ancient Roman system, from which other days were calculated
senses.zh: 月中日（古罗马历每月居中的一天）

examples.en: the ides of March
examples.zh: 3 月 15 日

senses.def: very stupid behaviour; the state of being very stupid

senses.def: the kind of language and grammar used by particular people at a particular time or place

examples.zh: 有时朋友们会再用儿时的语言交谈。

senses.zh: （写作、音乐、艺术等的）典型风格

intro.en: These are all words for a unit of language used to express something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均为表达意思的语言单位。

items.def: a single unit of language that means something and can be spoken or written:
items.zh: 单词；词；字

examples.en: Do not write more than 200 words.
examples.zh: 写的东西不要超过 200 字。

items.def: (rather formal) a word or phrase used as the name of something, especially one connected with a particular type of language:
items.zh: 指词语、术语、措辞

examples.en: technical/​legal/​scientific terms
examples.zh: 专门／法律／科学用语

items.def: a group of words that have a particular meaning when used together:
items.zh: 指短语、词组、惯用法

examples.en: Who coined the phrase ‘fake news’?
examples.zh: 谁创造了 fake news（假新闻）这个词语？

items.def: a word or phrase:

examples.en: He tends to use a lot of slang expressions that I’ve never heard before.
examples.zh: 他往往用许多我以前从未听说过的俚语。

items.def: a group of words whose meaning is different from the meanings of the individual words:
items.zh: 指习语、成语、惯用语

examples.en: ‘Let the cat out of the bag’ is an idiom meaning to tell a secret by mistake.
examples.zh: “让猫从袋子里跑出来”是惯用语，意思是无意中泄露秘密。

senses.def: containing expressions that are natural to a native speaker
senses.zh: 表达方式地道的；符合（某一）语言习惯的

examples.en: She speaks fluent and idiomatic English.

senses.def: containing an idiom

senses.def: in a way that sounds natural to a native speaker
senses.zh: 表达方式地道的；符合（某一）语言习惯的

senses.def: having no obvious cause

examples.en: The most common type of epilepsy is idiopathic epilepsy, which has no identifiable cause.
examples.zh: 最常见的癫痫类型是特发性癫痫，其病因不明。

senses.def: a person’s particular way of behaving, thinking, etc., especially when it is unusual; an unusual feature

examples.en: Wearing a raincoat, even on a hot day, is one of her idiosyncrasies.
examples.zh: 即使在炎热的天气里也穿着雨衣，这是她的特质之一。

examples.en: The car has its little idiosyncrasies.
examples.zh: 这辆车有它的一些小脾气。

senses.def: unusual and particular to a person or thing
senses.zh: 特质：不寻常，特别是对人或事物

examples.en: His teaching methods are idiosyncratic but successful.
examples.zh: 他的教学方法很奇特，但很成功。

senses.def: a rude way to refer to somebody who you think is very stupid

examples.en: When I lost my passport, I felt such an idiot.
examples.zh: 我丢了护照时觉得自己像个大傻瓜。

examples.en: What idiot pressed the switch?
examples.zh: 是哪个白痴按下了开关？

a board with words written on it for a television presenter
a person who has an unusually high level of ability in a particular skill, for example in art or music, or in remembering things, but who has serious learning or social difficulties in other areas
senses.zh: 独通一行的人；独开一窍的人

senses.def: very stupid

(on social media

senses.def: not in use

examples.en: to lie/stand/remain idle
examples.zh: 闲置着

senses.def: without work

examples.en: Over ten per cent of the workforce is now idle.
examples.zh: 现在有超过百分之十的劳动力闲置。

examples.en: He never stayed idle for long.
examples.zh: 他闲散的时间从来不长。

senses.def: with no particular purpose or effect

examples.en: idle chatter/curiosity
examples.zh: 无聊的唠叨／好奇

examples.en: It was just an idle threat (= not serious).
examples.zh: 那只不过是吓唬吓唬而已。

examples.en: It is idle to pretend that their marriage is a success.
examples.zh: 佯装他们的婚姻有多美满是无意义的。

senses.def: not spent doing work or something particular

examples.en: In idle moments, he carved wooden figures.
examples.zh: 他空闲时就刻木雕。

senses.def: people who do not have enough to do often start to do wrong

examples.en: She blamed the crimes on the local jobless teenagers. ‘The devil makes work for idle hands,’ she would say.
examples.zh: 她认为那些违法活动是当地的无业青少年所为，总是说：“人一闲，惹麻烦。”

senses.def: to spend time doing nothing important

examples.en: They idled the days away, talking and watching television.
examples.zh: 他们天天在闲聊和看电视中消磨时光。

examples.en: They idled along by the river (= walked slowly and with no particular purpose).
examples.zh: 他们沿着河边闲逛。

senses.def: to run slowly while the vehicle is not moving

examples.en: She left the car idling at the roadside.
examples.zh: 她把汽车挂空挡停在路边。

senses.def: to close a factory, etc. or stop providing work for the workers, especially temporarily
senses.zh: （尤指暂时地）关闭（工厂等），使停工

examples.en: The strikes have idled nearly 4 000 workers.
examples.zh: 罢工使近 4 000 名工人闲着没事干。

senses.def: people who do not have enough to do often start to do wrong

examples.zh: 她认为那些违法活动是当地的无业青少年所为，总是说：“人一闲，惹麻烦。”

senses.def: the fact of tending to be lazy and not work hard

examples.en: It was sheer idleness that I never pursued this enquiry.
examples.zh: 我从来没有进行过这样的探究，纯粹是懒惰。

senses.def: the fact of not having work or of not being in use

examples.en: After a period of enforced idleness, she found a new job.
examples.zh: 她在被迫闲散了一段时间之后找到了份新工作。

a South Indian rice cake cooked using steam
without any particular reason, purpose or effort; doing nothing
senses.zh: 毫无目的地；漫不经心地；闲散地

examples.en: She sat in the sun, idly sipping a cool drink.
examples.zh: 她坐在阳光下懒洋洋地抿着冷饮。

examples.en: He wondered idly what would happen.
examples.zh: 他漫不经心地幻想着会发生什么事。

examples.en: We can't stand idly by (= do nothing) and let people starve.
examples.zh: 我们不能袖手旁观，任由人们挨饿。

a person or thing that is loved and admired very much
senses.zh: 受到热爱和崇拜的人（或物）；偶像

examples.en: a pop/teen idol
examples.zh: 流行／青少年偶像

examples.en: the idol of countless teenagers
examples.zh: 无数青少年崇拜的偶像

examples.en: He has been my idol since I was a child.
examples.zh: 他是我从小的偶像。

examples.en: a fallen idol (= somebody who is no longer popular)
examples.zh: 陨落的明星

senses.def: a statue that is worshipped
connected with the practice of worshipping

examples.en: Praying to an image was regarded as idolatrous.
examples.zh: 向神像祈祷被认为是偶像崇拜。

senses.def: having or showing too much love or praise for somebody/something
senses.zh: 偶像崇拜：对某人/某物拥有或表现出太多的爱或称赞

examples.en: She loved her eldest son with idolatrous devotion.
examples.zh: 她对长子的爱如偶像崇拜一般。

senses.def: the practice of worshipping
too much love or praise for somebody/something

examples.en: football fans whose support for their team borders on idolatry
examples.zh: 对球队几乎到了盲目崇拜地步的足球迷

senses.def: great love and praise for somebody, possibly too much
to admire or love somebody very much, possibly too much

examples.en: a pop star idolized by millions of fans
examples.zh: 受数百万歌迷崇拜的流行音乐歌星

examples.en: They idolize their kids.
examples.zh: 他们溺爱自己的孩子。

examples.en: Young children often idolize their parents.
examples.zh: 年幼的孩子常常崇拜他们的父母。

senses.def: a person who has been forced to move within their own country because of war, a natural disaster, etc. (the abbreviation for internally displaced person
senses.zh: 境内流离失所者（全写为 internally displaced person）

examples.en: There are many IDPs all over the country.
examples.zh: 全国各地有许多境内流离失所者。

examples.en: A number of schools were converted into IDP camps.
examples.zh: 一些学校被改造为境内流离失所者营地。

senses.def: a happy and peaceful place, event or experience, especially one connected with the countryside
senses.zh: （尤指乡下的）愉快恬静的地方（或事情、经历）

senses.def: a short poem or other piece of writing that describes a peaceful and happy scene
senses.zh: 描述恬静愉快情景的短诗（或短文）；田园诗

senses.def: peaceful and beautiful; perfect, without problems
senses.zh: 平和美丽的；完美无瑕的

examples.en: a house set in idyllic surroundings
examples.zh: 在田园风光的环境中的房子

examples.en: to lead an idyllic existence
examples.zh: 过着诗情画意的生活

examples.en: The cottage sounds idyllic.
examples.zh: 小屋看来恬静宜人。

senses.def: in a peaceful and beautiful way; perfectly, without problems
senses.zh: 平和美丽的；完美无瑕的

examples.en: a house idyllically set in wooded grounds
examples.zh: 与周围的林地完美交融的房屋

senses.def: a series of 12 poems by Lord Tennyson
senses.zh: 国王的田园诗：1842年至1885年之间，坦尼森勋爵（Lord Tennyson）创作的12首诗系列。它们讲述亚瑟王和圆桌骑士的故事，在维多利亚时代的读者中很受欢迎。

senses.def: a bomb made and used by people who are not members of the military forces of a country (the abbreviation for ‘
senses.zh: 简易爆炸装置，土制炸弹（全写为 improvised explosive device）

examples.en: Various types of IED are being used in attacks on security forces.
examples.zh: 各种类型的简易爆炸装置被用来攻击安全部队。

examples.en: IEDs such as car bombs
examples.zh: 简易爆炸装置，例如汽车炸弹

senses.def: International English Language Testing System
senses.zh: 国际英语测试系统考试，雅思考试（英国、爱尔兰、澳大利亚、加拿大、南非和新西兰大学入学水平的英语应用能力考试）

senses.def: used to say that one thing can, will or might happen or be true, depending on another thing happening or being true

examples.en: If you see him, give him this note.
examples.zh: 你要是见到他，就把这个便条给他。

examples.en: I'll only stay if you offer me more money.
examples.zh: 你给我更多的钱我才会留下。

examples.en: If necessary I can come at once.
examples.zh: 如果有必要，我可以马上来。

examples.en: You can stay for the weekend if you like.
examples.zh: 你如果愿意就留在这里过周末吧。

examples.en: If anyone calls, tell them I'm not at home.
examples.zh: 要是有人打电话来，就说我不在家。

examples.en: If he improved his IT skills, he'd (= he would) easily get a job.
examples.zh: 他如果提高了自己的信息技术技能，就会容易找到工作。

examples.en: You would know what was going on if you'd (= you had) listened.
examples.zh: 你若是注意听了就会知道发生什么事了。

examples.en: They would have been here by now if they'd caught the early train.
examples.zh: 假若他们赶上了早班火车，现在就该到这里了。

examples.en: If I was in charge, I'd do things differently.
examples.zh: 假若由我负责，我不会这样办事的。

examples.en: If I were in charge…
examples.zh: 假若由我负责…

senses.def: when; whenever; every time

examples.en: If metal gets hot it expands.
examples.zh: 金属受热就膨胀。

examples.en: She glares at me if I go near her desk.
examples.zh: 我一走近她的办公桌，她就对我瞪眼。

senses.def: used after ask
senses.zh: （用于 ask、know、find out、wonder 等之后，引出两个或以上的可能性之一）是否

examples.en: Do you know if he's married?
examples.zh: 你知道他是否结婚了？

examples.en: I wonder if I should wear a coat or not.
examples.zh: 我不知道该不该穿外套。

examples.en: He couldn't tell if she was laughing or crying.
examples.zh: 他弄不清楚她是在笑还是在哭。

examples.en: Listen to the tune and see if you can remember the words.
examples.zh: 听听曲调，看你能否记起歌词。

senses.def: used after verbs or adjectives expressing feelings
senses.zh: （用于表示情感的动词或形容词之后）

examples.en: I am sorry if I disturbed you.
examples.zh: 很抱歉，打搅您了。

examples.en: I'd be grateful if you would keep it a secret.
examples.zh: 你如果能对此保密，我将不胜感激。

examples.en: Do you mind if I turn the TV off?
examples.zh: 我关上电视可以吗？

senses.def: used to admit that something is possible, but to say that it is not very important
senses.zh: （承认某事可能，但不很重要）即使，虽然

examples.en: If she has any weakness, it is her Italian.
examples.zh: 如果要说她有什么缺点，那就是她的意大利语不大行。

examples.en: So what if he was late. Who cares?
examples.zh: 他就是迟到了又怎么样。谁在乎？

senses.def: used to ask somebody to listen to your opinion

examples.en: If you ask me, she's too scared to do it.
examples.zh: 依我看，她被吓得不敢做了。

examples.en: If you think about it, those children must be at school by now.
examples.zh: 想想吧，那些孩子现在一定在学校了。

examples.en: If you remember, Mary was always fond of animals.
examples.zh: 记得吧，玛丽总是喜欢动物。

senses.def: used before an adjective or adverb to introduce a contrast
senses.zh: 用在形容词或副词之前以引入对比

examples.en: He's a good driver, if a little over-confident.
examples.zh: 他是个好司机，虽然有点过于自信。

examples.en: We'll only do it once—if at all.
examples.zh: 我们就是干也只会干一次。

senses.def: used with will
senses.zh: （与 will 或 would 连用，表示客气地请求）

examples.en: If you will sit down for a few moments, I'll tell the manager you're here.
examples.zh: 请稍坐，我这就告诉经理说您来了。

examples.en: If you would care to leave your name, we'll contact you as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 麻烦您留下姓名，我们会尽快与您联系的。

senses.def: used before could
senses.zh: （置于 could、may 或 might 之前，提出建议或客气地打断别人的话）

examples.en: If I may make a suggestion, perhaps we could begin a little earlier next week.
examples.zh: 我来提个建议吧，或许我们下个星期可以早一点开始。

senses.def: despite the possibility that; no matter whether

examples.en: I'll get there, even if I have to walk.
examples.zh: 我就是走也要走到那儿去。

senses.def: despite the fact that; even though

examples.en: He is a great leader, even if he has many enemies.
examples.zh: 尽管有很多反对者，他仍是一位伟大的领袖。

senses.def: used to say something about an event that may or may not happen
senses.zh: （谈及可能发生或不发生的事时说）

examples.en: If and when we ever meet again I hope he remembers what I did for him.
examples.zh: 倘若我们再次见面，我希望他还记得我为他做的事。

senses.def: used to express an opinion about something, or after a negative statement to suggest that the opposite is true
senses.zh: （表达看法，或用在否定句之后表示反面意见才对）

examples.en: I'd say he was more like his father, if anything.
examples.zh: 依我看，如果一定要说他像谁的话，他比较像他的父亲。

examples.en: She's not thin—if anything she's on the plump side.
examples.zh: 她并不瘦，其实她还有点胖呢。

senses.def: used to give somebody advice

examples.en: If I were you I'd start looking for another job.
examples.zh: 我要是你，就会去另找工作了。

senses.def: used to introduce a different suggestion, after a sentence with if
senses.zh: （用在 if 引导的句子之后）不然，要不

examples.en: I'll go if you're going. If not (= if you are not), I'd rather stay at home.
examples.zh: 你去我就去。不然的话，我宁愿待在家里。

senses.def: used after a yes/no
senses.zh: （用于 yes／no 疑问句之后，表示如果答案是 no，将会或应该发生什么）

examples.en: Are you ready? If not, I'm going without you.
examples.zh: 你准备好了吗？否则我就自己去了。

examples.en: Do you want that cake? If not, I'll have it.
examples.zh: 你要那块蛋糕吗？不然我就要了。

senses.def: used to suggest that something may be even larger, more important, etc. than was first stated

examples.en: They cost thousands if not millions of pounds to build.
examples.zh: 建设要耗费数千英镑，甚至可能是数百万英镑。

senses.def: used to say that you wish something was true or that something had happened

examples.en: If only I were rich.
examples.zh: 但愿我很富有。

examples.en: If only I knew her name.
examples.zh: 我要是知道她的名字就好了。

examples.en: If only he'd remembered to send that letter.
examples.zh: 要是他没忘记发那封信就好了。

examples.en: If only I had gone by taxi.
examples.zh: 我要是乘出租车去就好了。

senses.def: if that is the case
senses.zh: 如果是这样；要是那样的话

examples.en: Do you do research in your studies? If so, what research methods do you use?
examples.zh: 你学习时会做研究吗？如果有，你用什么研究方法？

senses.def: used to say that something that is happening is surprising
senses.zh: （表示所发生的事情令人惊讶）

examples.en: I'm surprised they've invited me to their wedding—it's not as if I know them well.
examples.zh: 我很惊讶他们居然请我参加他们的婚礼，我跟他们似乎并不熟。

senses.def: used to state the only situation in which something can happen

examples.en: Only if a teacher has given permission is a student allowed to leave the room.
examples.zh: 学生只有得到老师的许可才能离开教室。

examples.en: Only if the red light comes on is there any danger to employees.
examples.zh: 只有红灯闪亮时才有危及职工的险情。

senses.def: a situation that is not certain

examples.en: If he wins—and it's a big if—he'll be the first Scot to win for fifty years.
examples.zh: 如果他获胜——这是一个很大的假设——他将成为五十年来第一个获胜的苏格兰人。

examples.en: There are still a lot of ifs and buts before everything's settled.
examples.zh: 在一切得以解决之前还有很多不确定因素。

senses.def: a poem published in 1910 by Rudyard Kipling
senses.zh: 如果：鲁德亚德·基普林于1910年出版的一首诗。它由一个长句组成，开头是"如果"一词，给男孩如何成为男人的建议。它是维多利亚时代的传统，现在似乎相当过时，但这首诗仍然非常受欢迎，经常被评为英国读者最喜欢的诗。

senses.def: despite the possibility that; no matter whether

examples.en: I'll get there, even if I have to walk.
examples.zh: 我就是走也要走到那儿去。

senses.def: despite the fact that; even though

examples.en: He is a great leader, even if he has many enemies.
examples.zh: 尽管有很多反对者，他仍是一位伟大的领袖。

senses.def: used to say something about an event that may or may not happen
senses.zh: （谈及可能发生或不发生的事时说）

examples.en: If and when we ever meet again I hope he remembers what I did for him.
examples.zh: 倘若我们再次见面，我希望他还记得我为他做的事。

senses.def: used to express an opinion about something, or after a negative statement to suggest that the opposite is true
senses.zh: （表达看法，或用在否定句之后表示反面意见才对）

examples.en: I'd say he was more like his father, if anything.
examples.zh: 依我看，如果一定要说他像谁的话，他比较像他的父亲。

examples.en: She's not thin—if anything she's on the plump side.
examples.zh: 她并不瘦，其实她还有点胖呢。

senses.def: used to give somebody advice

examples.zh: 我们收到的很多申请表简直不知所云。

examples.zh: 那天早上，我收到了一封来自我的客户的有点文盲的信。

examples.zh: 音乐盲

examples.zh: 这种病毒能使人类生病。

examples.zh: 他患有一种罕见的血液病。

examples.zh: 她久病不愈而亡。

examples.zh: 心脏病

examples.zh: 儿童期小病

items.zh: 指轻微的传染病、小病

senses.def: an action performed by speaking or writing, for example ordering, warning or promising
senses.zh: 以言行事（指通过言语实施行为，如命令、警告或承诺）

senses.def: performed by speaking or writing, for example ordering, warning or promising
senses.zh: 言外的：通过讲话或书写来执行的，例如命令，警告或承诺

examples.en: an illocutionary act
examples.zh: 语内表现的行为.

senses.def: not sensible or thought out in a logical way
senses.zh: 悖理的；不合逻辑的；乖戾的

examples.en: illogical behaviour/arguments
examples.zh: 乖戾的行为；不合逻辑的论点

examples.en: She has an illogical fear of insects.
examples.zh: 她毫无道理地害怕昆虫。

examples.en: From all this evidence he drew a strange and illogical conclusion.
examples.zh: 仅凭这条证据，他竟得出了一个奇怪的、不合情理的结论。

senses.zh: 悖理的；不合逻辑的；乖戾的

senses.def: for a reason or in a way that is not sensible or well thought out

examples.en: She felt illogically happy when she heard the news.
examples.zh: 当她听到这个消息时，她感到莫名的高兴。

senses.def: a measurement of the amount of light that reaches an area of a surface
senses.zh: （光）照度（单位面积所受到的光通量）

senses.def: to shine light on something

examples.en: Floodlights illuminated the stadium.
examples.zh: 泛光灯照亮了体育场。

examples.en: The earth is illuminated by the sun.
examples.zh: 太阳照亮地球。

senses.def: to make something clearer or easier to understand

examples.en: This text illuminates the philosopher's early thinking.
examples.zh: 这篇文章解释了这位哲学家的早期思想。

senses.def: to decorate a street, building, etc. with bright lights for a special occasion
to make a person’s face, etc. seem bright and excited

examples.en: Her smile illuminated her entire being.
examples.zh: 微笑使她整个人神采奕奕。

senses.def: light or a place that light comes from

examples.en: The only illumination in the room came from the fire.
examples.zh: 屋子里唯一的光亮来自炉火。

senses.def: bright coloured lights used to decorate a town or building for a special occasion

examples.en: Christmas illuminations
examples.zh: 圣诞节的彩灯

senses.def: a coloured decoration, usually painted by hand, in an old book
senses.zh: （旧时书上通常用手工绘制的）彩饰，彩图

senses.def: understanding or explanation of something

examples.en: spiritual illumination
examples.zh: 精神上的启发

examples.en: In that flash of illumination, he realized where he had gone wrong.
examples.zh: 在那一道亮光中，他意识到自己错在哪里了。

senses.def: to shine light on or in something

examples.en: The moon's rays illumined the darkness.
examples.zh: 月光照亮了黑暗。

senses.def: to make something clearer or easier to understand

examples.zh: 刘易斯在他的书中阐明了这个问题的关键方面。

senses.def: to make a person’s face, etc. seem bright and excited

examples.en: A strange radiance illumined her face.
examples.zh: 一种奇异的光芒照亮了她的脸。

senses.def: a false idea or belief, especially about somebody or about a situation

examples.en: She's under the illusion that (= believes wrongly that) she'll get the job.
examples.zh: 她存有幻想，认为会得到那份工作。

examples.en: The new president has no illusions about the difficulties facing her country (= she knows that the country has serious problems).
examples.zh: 新任总统清楚地知道她的国家面临的困难。

examples.en: I have no illusions about her feelings for me (= I know the truth is that she does not love me).
examples.zh: 我并不幻想她会喜欢我。

examples.en: He could no longer distinguish between illusion and reality.
examples.zh: 他再也分不清幻想与现实之间的区别了。

examples.en: I don’t want to have my illusions shattered!
examples.zh: 我不想让我的幻想破灭！

senses.def: something that seems to exist but in fact does not, or seems to be something that it is not

examples.zh: 房间里的镜子常给人一种空间增大的错觉。

examples.en: The idea of absolute personal freedom is an illusion.
examples.zh: 绝对个人自由的观念是一种幻想。

senses.def: a person who performs tricks that seem strange or impossible to believe
not real although seeming to be

examples.zh: 有一种迷惑人的纵深感。

examples.en: the illusive security of yesteryear
examples.zh: 昔日虚幻的安全感

senses.def: not real, although seeming to be
senses.zh: 虚假的；幻觉的；迷惑人的

examples.en: an illusory sense of freedom
examples.zh: 虚幻的自由感

examples.en: Any power he may seem to have is purely illusory.
examples.zh: 他貌似有权，但他的权力纯属虚幻。

senses.def: to use pictures, photographs, diagrams, etc. in a book, etc.
senses.zh: 加插图于；给（书等）做图表

examples.en: She illustrated her own books.
examples.zh: 她给自己的书画了插图。

examples.en: His lecture was illustrated with photos taken during the expedition.
examples.zh: 他在演讲中使用了探险时拍摄的照片。

senses.def: to make the meaning of something clearer by using examples, pictures, etc.

examples.en: To illustrate my point, let me tell you a little story.
examples.zh: 为了说明我的观点，让我来给你们讲个小故事。

examples.en: Last year's sales figures are illustrated in Figure 2.
examples.zh: 图 2 显示了去年的销售数字。

examples.en: He is showing these silent films to help illustrate his story of survival.
examples.zh: 他正在放映这些无声电影，用以更好地说明他劫后余生的过程。

examples.en: Each topic is illustrated with concrete examples of economic practice.
examples.zh: 每一个主题都用经济实践的具体例子加以说明。

examples.en: Here's an example to illustrate what I mean.
examples.zh: 这儿有个例子可以说明我的意思。

examples.en: The incident illustrates the need for better security measures.
examples.zh: 这次事件说明了加强安全措施的必要性。

examples.en: This story illustrates how little has changed.
examples.zh: 这个故事说明了变化有多么小。

examples.en: These data illustrate that many parents are not aware of the risks.
examples.zh: 这些数据说明许多家长并没有意识到这些风险。

examples.zh: 50 张全彩色插图

examples.zh: 动物、鸟类和植物的详细插图

examples.zh: 一卷由爱德华·伯恩—琼斯绘制插图的乔叟著作

examples.zh: 他为儿童读物制作插图。

examples.zh: 书籍插图的艺术

senses.def: a story, an event or an example that clearly shows the truth about something

examples.zh: 这些统计数字清楚地阐明了我要陈述的要点。

examples.zh: 我用这个案例来说明。

examples.zh: 作为说明，让我援引她的一首诗。

examples.zh: 你能给我举个实例来解释你的意思吗？

examples.zh: 在某些情况下，人们必须等上好几周才能得到约见。

examples.zh: 这篇报道重点列举了一些不公正的实例。

examples.zh: 水族馆里有一些罕见的热带鱼，很有趣。

examples.zh: 这些统计数字清楚地阐明了我要陈述的要点。

examples.zh: 那位作曲家是许多造访过这个城市的杰出人物之一。

examples.zh: 大多数简单的传单都会有文字和图像。

examples.zh: 我们的档案里已经有超过 22 000 幅数字图像。

examples.zh: 视觉图像正在逐渐取代文字。

examples.zh: 洞穴壁上装饰着鹿和猎人的画像。

examples.zh: 想想我们报纸上充斥的战争图片。

examples.zh: 印度教神灵象头神的木雕像

examples.zh: 大教堂内正在举办圣尼古拉斯肖像展。

examples.zh: 圣经中说，人类是按照上帝的形象创造的。

examples.en: He stared at his own image reflected in the water.
examples.zh: 他凝视着自己在水中的倒影。

examples.en: Slowly, an image began to appear on the screen.
examples.zh: 屏幕上慢慢地出现了一幅图像。

examples.en: Click on the image for a larger version.
examples.zh: 点击图像查看大图。

examples.en: Police will study the images from CCTV cameras.
examples.zh: 警方将研究闭路电视摄像头记录下的影像。

examples.en: The camera captured an image of the suspect and his car.
examples.zh: 摄像机拍下了嫌疑人和他的车的图像。

examples.zh: 该卫星提供地球表面的高分辨率图像。

examples.zh: 图像质量太低。

examples.zh: 他的公众形象和本人截然不同。

examples.en: The advertisements are intended to improve the company's image.
examples.zh: 这些广告旨在提高公司的形象。

examples.en: Image is very important in the music world.
examples.zh: 在音乐界，个人形象很重要。

examples.en: It was years before the country was able to project an image of stability again.
examples.zh: 多年之后，这个国家才得以再次树立起稳定的形象。

examples.en: The campaign aims to create a new image for the city.
examples.zh: 这项活动的目的是为这座城市打造新形象。

examples.zh: 儿童图书中模式化的女性形象

examples.en: to have a positive/negative image
examples.zh: 拥有正面/负面形象
