examples.zh: 公司按形象顾问的建议改了名字。

senses.def: a mental picture that you have of what somebody/something is like or looks like

examples.en: images of the past
examples.zh: 对过去的印象

examples.en: I had a mental image of what she would look like.
examples.zh: 我能想象出她的样貌如何。

examples.en: Dieting always seems to conjure up images of endless cottage cheese salads.
examples.zh: 一提起节食就会让人想到上顿接下顿、没完没了的农家鲜干酪色拉。

senses.def: a word or phrase used with a different meaning from its normal one, in order to describe something in a way that produces a strong picture in the mind

examples.en: Her writings are full of poetic images of the countryside.
examples.zh: 她的作品里充满了富有诗意的乡村意象。

senses.def: to look very like somebody/something else

examples.en: He's the image of his father.
examples.zh: 他酷似他的父亲。

senses.def: to look very like somebody/something else

examples.en: He's the image of his father.
examples.zh: 他酷似他的父亲。

senses.def: language that produces pictures in the minds of people reading or listening

examples.en: poetic imagery
examples.zh: 诗的意象

senses.def: pictures, photographs, etc.

examples.en: satellite imagery (= for example, photographs of the earth taken from space)
examples.zh: 卫星影像（如从太空拍摄地球的照片）

senses.def: a very high-quality colour printer used for producing magazines, etc.
senses.zh: 图像集成机，影像排版机（一种高精度成像输出的设备）

senses.def: used with superlatives, and with all
senses.zh: （与形容词最高级或与 all、every 连用，表示强调或概括）想象得到的

examples.en: The house has the most spectacular views imaginable.
examples.zh: 从这所房子可以看到所能想象的最壮丽的景色。

examples.en: They stock every imaginable type of pasta.
examples.zh: 他们备有各种能想到的意大利面食。

examples.en: Each trainee must be able to respond effectively to all imaginable crises.
examples.zh: 每个学员必须能够有效应对所有可以想象的危机。

senses.def: possible to imagine

examples.en: These technological developments were hardly imaginable 30 years ago.
examples.zh: 这些科技新产品在 30 年前几乎是不可想象的。

senses.def: existing only in your mind or imagination
senses.zh: 想象中的；幻想的；虚构的

examples.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the middle of the earth.
examples.zh: 赤道是一条环绕地球中部的假想线。

examples.en: I had an imaginary friend when I was a child.
examples.zh: 我小时候有一个想象中的朋友。

examples.en: As children they invented the imaginary world of Gondal.
examples.zh: 当他们还是孩子的时候，他们发明了贡达尔的想象世界。

examples.en: We must listen to their problems, real or imaginary.
examples.zh: 我们必须倾听他们的问题，不管是真实的还是想象的。

senses.def: a number expressed as the square root
the ability to create pictures in your mind; the part of your mind that does this

examples.en: a vivid/fertile imagination
examples.zh: 生动的／丰富的想象

examples.en: He has no imagination.
examples.zh: 他没有想象力。

examples.en: It doesn't take much imagination to guess what she meant.
examples.zh: 不难猜出她的意思。

examples.en: I won't tell you his reaction—I'll leave that to your imagination.
examples.zh: 我不告诉你他的反应，你自己想象一下吧。

examples.en: Don't let your imagination run away with you (= don't use too much imagination).
examples.zh: 不要一味凭空想象。

examples.en: The new policies appear to have captured the imagination of the public (= they find them interesting and exciting)
examples.zh: 新政策似乎投合了公众的喜好。

examples.en: His stories really stretch children’s imaginations.
examples.zh: 他的故事确实拓展了孩子们的想象力。

examples.en: Nobody hates you—it's all in your imagination.
examples.zh: 没人讨厌你，都是你在胡思乱想。

examples.en: This is an image which persists in the popular imagination.
examples.zh: 这是一个一直存在于大众想象中的形象。

examples.en: Use your imagination! (= used to tell somebody that they will have to guess the answer to the question they have asked you, usually because it is obvious or embarrassing)
examples.zh: 你自己动动脑筋嘛！

senses.def: something that you have imagined rather than something that exists

examples.en: She was no longer able to distinguish between imagination and reality.
examples.zh: 她再也分不清幻想和现实了。

examples.en: Is it my imagination or have you lost a lot of weight?
examples.zh: 是我的错觉，还是你确实瘦了许多？

senses.def: the ability to have new and exciting ideas

examples.en: His writing lacks imagination.
examples.zh: 他写的东西缺乏想象。

examples.en: With a little imagination, you could turn this place into a palace.
examples.zh: 稍微动点脑筋，就能把这个地方变得富丽堂皇。

examples.en: We are looking for someone with ingenuity and imagination.
examples.zh: 我们正在寻找具有聪明才智和想象力的人。

senses.def: to allow more of somebody’s body to be seen than usual

examples.en: Her tight-fitting dress left nothing to the imagination.
examples.zh: 她的紧身连衣裙令身材显露无遗。

senses.def: used to say strongly that something is not true, even if you try to imagine or believe it
senses.zh: 任凭怎么想也不；再怎么说也不

examples.en: She could not, by any stretch of the imagination, be called beautiful.
examples.zh: 再怎么说，她也称不上漂亮。

examples.en: By no stretch of the imagination could the trip be described as relaxing.
examples.zh: 无论如何想象，这次旅行都不能用轻松来形容。

senses.def: to allow more of somebody’s body to be seen than usual

examples.en: Her tight-fitting dress left nothing to the imagination.
examples.zh: 她的紧身连衣裙令身材显露无遗。

items.idm: not by any stretch of the imagination | by no stretch of the imagination

senses.def: used to say strongly that something is not true, even if you try to imagine or believe it
senses.zh: 任凭怎么想也不；再怎么说也不

examples.en: She could not, by any stretch of the imagination, be called beautiful.
examples.zh: 再怎么说，她也称不上漂亮。

examples.en: By no stretch of the imagination could the trip be described as relaxing.
examples.zh: 无论如何想象，这次旅行都不能用轻松来形容。

senses.def: having or showing new and exciting ideas

examples.en: an imaginative approach/idea/child
examples.zh: 有创意的方法／思想／孩子

examples.en: recipes that make imaginative use of seasonal vegetables
examples.zh: 妙用时令蔬菜的菜谱

examples.en: You’ll need to be a little more imaginative if you want to hold their attention.
examples.zh: 如果你想吸引他们的注意力，你需要更有想象力。

senses.def: in a way that shows new and exciting ideas

examples.en: The stables have been imaginatively converted into offices.
examples.zh: 马厩被别出心裁地改造成了办公室。

senses.def: to form a picture in your mind of what something might be like

examples.en: The house was just as she had imagined it.
examples.zh: 这房子正如她所想象的。

examples.en: Imagine my surprise when I opened the door to find him standing there.
examples.zh: 想象一下，当我打开门发现他站在那里时，我有多么吃惊。

examples.en: I can't imagine life without the children now.
examples.zh: 我现在无法设想没有了孩子们的生活。

examples.en: It's hard to imagine a more cynical political strategy.
examples.zh: 很难想象有什么政治策略比这更自私自利的了。

examples.en: Close your eyes and imagine (that) you are in a forest.
examples.zh: 闭上眼睛，设想自己在森林里。

examples.en: Can you imagine what it must be like to lose your job after 20 years?
examples.zh: 你能想象得出干了 20 年之后被辞退会是什么样的滋味吗？

examples.en: Imagine earning that much money!
examples.zh: 想想看，竟赚那么多的钱！

examples.en: She imagined walking into the office and handing in her resignation.
examples.zh: 她想象着自己走进办公室，递上辞呈。

examples.en: I can just imagine him saying that!
examples.zh: 我完全想象得出他这样说！

examples.en: I had imagined her to be older than that.
examples.zh: 我本来以为她的年龄还要大一些。

examples.en: He loved to imagine himself as the hero.
examples.zh: 他喜欢把自己想象成英雄。

examples.en: I find it difficult to imagine her a grandmother.
examples.zh: 我发现很难想象她是祖母。

examples.en: I can imagine him really angry.
examples.zh: 我可以想象得出他怒气冲冲的样子。

examples.en: ‘He was furious.’ ‘I can imagine.’
examples.zh: “他气疯了。”“我想象得出。”

senses.def: to believe something that is not true

examples.en: He’s always imagining (that) we’re talking about him behind his back.
examples.zh: 他总是胡乱猜想我们在背后说他的闲话。

examples.en: There's nobody there. You're imagining things.
examples.zh: 那里根本没有人。你在胡思乱想。

senses.def: to think that something is probably true

examples.en: ‘Can we still buy tickets for the concert?’ ‘I imagine so.’
examples.zh: “我们还能买到音乐会的票吗？”“我想可以吧。”

examples.en: I don’t imagine (that) they’ll refuse.
examples.zh: 我认为他们不会拒绝。

intro.en: These words all mean to form an idea in your mind of what somebody/​something might be like.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含想象、设想之义。

items.def: to form an idea in your mind of what somebody/​something might be like:
items.zh: 指想象、设想

examples.en: The house was just as she had imagined it.
examples.zh: 这房子正如她所想象的。

items.def: to imagine something that might happen or might have happened:
items.zh: 指猜想、想象、试想

examples.en: We couldn’t think where you’d gone.
examples.zh: 我们猜想不出来你到哪里去了。

items.def: to consider something as a future possibility; to imagine somebody as something:
items.zh: 指设想、想象

examples.en: I can’t see her changing her mind.
examples.zh: 我无法想象她会改变主意。

items.def: (especially British English尤用于英式英语) to imagine what will happen in the future:
items.zh: 指想象、设想、展望

examples.en: I don’t envisage working with him again.
examples.zh: 我想象不出再与他一起工作的可能。

items.def: to imagine what a situation will be like in the future, especially a situation that you intend to work towards:
items.zh: 指展望、想象

examples.en: They envision an equal society, free from poverty and disease.
examples.zh: 他们向往一个没有贫穷和疾病的平等社会。

senses.def: a person who invents something exciting, especially a machine for people to ride on in a theme park
senses.zh: 构想工程师（发明主题公园中的机动游戏等）

senses.def: to invent something exciting, especially a machine for people to ride on in a theme park
senses.zh: 构想，发明（刺激好玩的东西，如主题公园的机动游戏等）

senses.def: the process of capturing, storing and showing an image on a computer screen

examples.en: imaging software
examples.zh: 成像软件

senses.def: things that you imagine, that exist only in your mind
a style in early 20th century British and American poetry that made use of clear images (= ideas or things meant to represent something else)
senses.zh: 意象主义（20 世纪早期英美的诗歌流派，运用清晰的意象来表达意义）

senses.def: a mental image of somebody as being perfect that you do not realize you have and that influences your behaviour
senses.zh: 无意识意象（无意识地对他人形成的理想形象）

senses.def: the final and fully developed adult stage of an insect, especially one with wings
a religious man who leads the prayers in a mosque
senses.zh: 伊玛目（在清真寺内领拜的人）

senses.def: the title of a Muslim religious leader
senses.zh: 伊玛目（伊斯兰教领袖头衔）

senses.def: technology that allows films to be shown on extremely large screens
senses.zh: IMAX 技术（令电影可以在超大银幕上放映）

senses.def: a cinema or screen that uses IMAX
a situation in which two or more things are not the same size or are not treated the same, in a way that is unfair or causes problems

examples.en: a global imbalance of/in power
examples.zh: 全球权力的不平衡

examples.en: Attempts are being made to redress (= put right) the imbalance between our import and export figures.
examples.zh: 我们正努力纠正进出口的不平衡。

examples.en: Postnatal depression is usually due to hormonal imbalance.
examples.zh: 产后抑郁症通常是荷尔蒙失调引起的。

senses.def: a rude way to say ‘very stupid’
senses.zh: 表示“非常愚蠢”的粗鲁方式

examples.en: imbecile remarks
examples.zh: 蠢话

senses.def: a word used to describe a person with a very low level of intelligence that is now considered offensive
senses.zh: 这个词用来形容智力水平很低的人，现在被认为是无礼的

senses.def: a rude way to refer to somebody who you think is very stupid

examples.en: They behaved like imbeciles.
examples.zh: 他们表现得像傻瓜。

senses.def: a word for a person with a very low level of intelligence that is now considered offensive
a rude way to refer to the fact of being very stupid or to an idea, remark, etc. that you consider very stupid
senses.zh: 一种粗鲁的方式来指称非常愚蠢的事实或您认为非常愚蠢的想法、言论等

senses.def: a word for a very low level of intelligence that is now considered offensive
senses.zh: 一个表示智力水平非常低的词，现在被认为是具有攻击性的

senses.def: to fix something in a substance or solid object
senses.zh: 把…牢牢地嵌入（或插入、埋入）

examples.en: an operation to remove glass that was imbedded in his leg
examples.zh: 手术去除嵌在他腿上的玻璃

examples.en: The bullet imbedded itself in the wall.
examples.zh: 子弹嵌入了墙壁。

examples.en: These attitudes are deeply imbedded in our society (= felt very strongly and difficult to change).
examples.zh: 这些态度深深植根于我们的社会（=感觉非常强烈且难以改变）。

senses.def: to send a journalist, photographer, etc. to an area where there is fighting, so that they can travel with the army and report what is happening
senses.zh: 派遣（战地记者、摄影记者等）

examples.en: imbedded reporters in the war zone
examples.zh: 驻战区记者

senses.def: to place a sentence inside another sentence. In the sentence ‘I’m aware that she knows’, she knows
senses.zh: 嵌入：将一个句子放在另一个句子中。在“我知道她知道”这句话中，她知道这是一个嵌入式句子。

senses.def: to drink something, especially alcohol
to receive and understand ideas or information

examples.en: He imbibed elements of oriental mysticism from the years he spent in India.
examples.zh: 在印度度过的岁月里，他吸收了东方神秘主义的元素。

senses.def: a meeting, especially one between politicians and members of the public, that is held in order to discuss general issues or a particular problem
senses.zh: 讨论会；（尤指政界人士和公众的）对话会

examples.en: a government imbizo on poverty
examples.zh: 政府关于贫困问题的讨论会

examples.en: The minister of labour will be holding an imbizo with farmers in the area.
examples.zh: 劳工部长将与这一地区的农民举行对话会。

senses.def: a person who writes and performs poems praising an important figure
senses.zh: 赞美诗人（为重要人物写诗、诵诗）

examples.en: An imbongi will introduce the chief with praise poems in his honour.
examples.zh: 一名因邦吉 (imbongi) 会用赞美诗来介绍这位酋长。

senses.def: a complicated, confused or embarrassing situation that causes many problems, especially in politics
senses.zh: （尤指政治上的）乱局，尴尬处境

senses.def: to fill somebody/something with strong feelings, opinions or values
senses.zh: 使充满，灌输，激发（强烈感情、想法或价值）

examples.en: Her voice was imbued with an unusual seriousness.
examples.zh: 她的声音里充满着一种不寻常的严肃语气。

examples.en: He was imbued with a desire for social justice.
examples.zh: 他满怀着寻求社会正义的愿望。

senses.def: International Monetary Fund
senses.zh: 国际货币基金组织（联合国专门机构，关注贸易和经济的发展）

senses.def: in my humble opinion
senses.zh: 依我愚见（尤用于电邮、短信、社交媒体等）

examples.en: IMHO this film is a classic.
examples.zh: 依我愚见，这部电影是一部杰作。

senses.def: to copy somebody/something

examples.en: Her style of painting has been imitated by other artists.
examples.zh: 她的绘画风格为其他画家所模仿。

examples.en: Art imitates Nature.
examples.zh: 艺术是对大自然的仿制。

examples.en: Teachers provide a model for children to imitate.
examples.zh: 教师是孩子仿效的典范。

examples.en: No computer can imitate the complex functions of the human brain.
examples.zh: 任何计算机都无法模拟人脑的复杂功能。

examples.en: Dolphins learn to imitate sounds very accurately and quickly.
examples.zh: 海豚学会非常准确和快速地模仿声音。

senses.def: to copy the way a person speaks or behaves, in order to make people laugh
senses.zh: 模仿（某人的言谈举止）；作滑稽模仿

examples.en: She knew that the girls used to imitate her and laugh at her behind her back.
examples.zh: 她知道那些女孩子过去常在背地里模仿她、嘲笑她。

examples.en: He tried to imitate my Scots accent and we both laughed.
examples.zh: 他试着模仿我的苏格兰口音，结果我俩都大笑起来。

senses.def: a copy of something, especially something expensive

examples.en: a poor/cheap imitation of the real thing
examples.zh: 低劣的仿制品

examples.en: This latest production is a pale imitation of the original (= it is not nearly as good).
examples.zh: 最新出品的版本远不如原版精彩。

examples.en: imitation leather/pearls
examples.zh: 人造革；假珍珠

senses.def: the act of copying somebody/something

examples.en: A child learns to talk by imitation.
examples.zh: 小孩子通过模仿学会说话。

examples.en: Many corporate methods have been adopted by American managers in imitation of Japanese practice.
examples.zh: 美国的管理人员采用了很多取法日本的公司经营之道。

examples.en: The poems, some in imitation of Ossian, are graceful if unremarkable.
examples.zh: 这些诗歌有些效仿了莪相的风格，即使算不上优秀也称得上优雅。

senses.def: an act of copying the way somebody talks and behaves, especially to make people laugh
senses.zh: 模仿（某人）的言谈举止；（尤指）滑稽模仿

examples.en: He does an imitation of the prime minister.
examples.zh: 他模仿首相。

examples.en: She does a perfect imitation of a turkey.
examples.zh: 她完美地模仿了火鸡。

intro.en: These words all describe things that are not real, or not naturally produced or grown.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指假的、非天然的、人造的。

items.def: made or produced to copy something natural; not real:
items.zh: 指人工的、人造的、假的

examples.en: artificial flowers
examples.zh: 假花

items.def: made by combining chemical substances rather than being produced naturally by plants or animals:
items.zh: 指人工合成的

examples.en: synthetic drugs
examples.zh: 合成药物

items.def: not natural:
items.zh: 指非天然的、非天生的、假的

examples.en: false teeth
examples.zh: 假牙

items.def: made by people; not natural:
items.zh: 指人造的、非天然的

examples.en: man-made fibres such as nylon
examples.zh: 尼龙之类的人造纤维

items.def: made to look like something else; not real:
items.zh: 指仿制的、人造的、假的

examples.en: a fake-fur jacket
examples.zh: 一件人造毛皮的短上衣

items.def: [only before noun] made to look like something else; not real:
items.zh: 指仿制的、人造的、假的

examples.en: She would never wear imitation pearls.
examples.zh: 她绝不会戴假珍珠。

senses.def: that copies somebody/something

examples.en: movies that encourage imitative crime
examples.zh: 助长模拟犯罪行为的电影

examples.en: His work has been criticized for being imitative and shallow.
examples.zh: 他的作品被批抄袭而且肤浅。

examples.en: The style is imitative of Basque architecture.
examples.zh: 风格模仿巴斯克建筑。

senses.def: a person or thing that copies somebody/something else
senses.zh: 模仿者；模拟…的人（或事物）

examples.en: The band's success has inspired hundreds of would-be imitators.
examples.zh: 乐队的成功激励了数以百计未来的追随者。

examples.en: plant-based imitators of milk, cheese and butter
examples.zh: 牛奶、奶酪和黄油的植物仿制品

senses.def: perfectly clean and tidy, with no marks or flaws
senses.zh: 十分整洁的；一尘不染的

examples.en: She always looks immaculate.
examples.zh: 她总是打扮得干净利落。

examples.en: an immaculate uniform/room
examples.zh: 整洁的制服／房间

examples.en: The property is in immaculate condition.
examples.zh: 该物业状况完美。

examples.en: The suit he was wearing was immaculate.
examples.zh: 他穿着的西装完美无瑕。

examples.en: Though old, the books were in immaculate condition.
examples.zh: 虽然很旧，但这些书都完好无损。

senses.def: containing no mistakes or faults

examples.en: an immaculate performance
examples.zh: 完美的演出

examples.en: The incident ruined an otherwise immaculate safety record.
examples.zh: 这一事件打破了原本无事故的优良安全纪录。

examples.en: His sense of timing was immaculate.
examples.zh: 他的时机感非常完美。

senses.def: in an extremely clean and tidy way

examples.en: immaculately dressed
examples.zh: 衣着整洁

senses.def: in a way that contains no mistakes

examples.en: His book is immaculately researched.
examples.zh: 他的书经过完美的研究。

senses.def: present as a natural part of something; present everywhere
senses.zh: 内在的；固有的；无所不在的

examples.en: God is immanent in the world.
examples.zh: 上帝无所不在。

senses.def: not important in a particular situation

examples.en: The cost is immaterial.
examples.zh: 费用并不重要。

examples.en: It is immaterial to me whether he stays or goes.
examples.zh: 他的去留与我无关。

examples.en: These facts are immaterial to the problem.
examples.zh: 这些事实对这个问题无关紧要。

senses.def: not having a physical form

examples.en: an immaterial God
examples.zh: 无形的上帝

examples.en: the immaterial mind/soul
examples.zh: 非物质的思想/灵魂

senses.def: behaving in a way that is not sensible and is typical of people who are much younger
senses.zh: （行为）不成熟的，不够老练的，幼稚的

examples.en: immature behaviour
examples.zh: 不成熟的行为

senses.def: not fully developed or grown

examples.en: immature plants
examples.zh: 未长成的植物

examples.en: The immature birds have shorter tails and brown, speckled plumage.
examples.zh: 发育未全的鸟尾巴较短，羽毛呈褐色，有斑点。

senses.def: behaviour that is not sensible and is typical of people who are much younger
senses.zh: （行为）不成熟的，不够老练的，幼稚的

examples.en: emotional immaturity
examples.zh: 情感不成熟

senses.def: the state of not being fully developed or grown

examples.en: the immaturity of renal function in some infants
examples.zh: 部分婴儿肾功能不成熟

senses.def: too large, great, etc. to be measured
senses.zh: 不可估量的；无限的；无穷的

examples.en: to cause immeasurable harm
examples.zh: 造成不可估量的损害

examples.en: Her contribution was of immeasurable importance.
examples.zh: 他的贡献极其重要。

senses.def: to a degree that is too large, great, etc. to be measured
senses.zh: 不可估量的；无限的；无穷的

examples.en: Housing standards improved immeasurably after the war.
examples.zh: 战后住房水平大大提高。

examples.en: Stress has an immeasurably more serious effect on our lives than we realize.
examples.zh: 压力对我们生活的影响之大远超我们的想象。

senses.def: the quality in something that makes it seem as if it is happening now, close to you, and is therefore important and requires attention quickly

examples.en: the immediacy of the threat
examples.zh: 威胁的紧迫性

examples.en: Email lacks the immediacy of online chat.
examples.zh: 电子邮件缺乏在线交谈的即时性。

examples.en: The book had a lack of immediacy for most people.
examples.zh: 对多数人而言，该书缺乏时效性。

examples.en: The drawings convey both immediacy and a sense of violence.
examples.zh: 这些画既表现了紧迫性也表现了暴力感。

senses.def: lack of delay; speed

examples.en: Our aim is immediacy of response to emergency calls.
examples.zh: 我们的目标是对紧急求救电话立刻作出回应。

senses.def: happening or done without delay

examples.en: an immediate reaction/response
examples.zh: 即时的反应／回应

examples.en: to take immediate action
examples.zh: 立即采取行动

examples.en: RAM stores information for immediate access.
examples.zh: 随机存储器储存的信息可以马上读取。

examples.en: This decision will have an immediate impact on students.
examples.zh: 这一决定将对学生产生直接影响。

examples.en: The company announced the immediate availability of an updated version of the software.
examples.zh: 该公司宣布立即推出该软件的更新版本。

senses.def: existing now and needing attention quickly

examples.en: Our immediate concern is to help the families of those who died.
examples.zh: 我们的当务之急是帮助那些死者的亲属。

examples.en: The hospital says she's out of immediate danger.
examples.zh: 医院说她眼下已脱离危险。

examples.en: weapons of mass destruction that were an immediate threat to international security
examples.zh: 对国际安全构成直接威胁的大规模毁灭性武器

examples.en: The report focuses on some of the more immediate problems facing us.
examples.zh: 报告重点关注我们所面对的一些较为急迫的问题。

examples.en: He said there was no immediate need to appeal for international assistance.
examples.zh: 他表示，目前没有必要立即呼吁国际援助。

senses.def: next to or very close to a particular place or time

examples.en: in the immediate vicinity
examples.zh: 近在咫尺

examples.en: in the immediate aftermath of the war
examples.zh: 受战争直接影响

examples.en: The prospects for the immediate future are good.
examples.zh: 短期内前景乐观。

examples.en: The director is standing on her immediate right.
examples.zh: 主管就挨在她的右边站着。

examples.en: my immediate predecessor in the job (= the person who had the job just before me)
examples.zh: 我的职位的前一任

senses.def: nearest in relationship or rank
senses.zh: （关系或级别）最接近的，直系的，直接的

examples.en: The funeral was attended by her immediate family (= her parents, children, brothers and sisters) only.
examples.zh: 只有她的直系亲属参加了葬礼。

examples.en: He is my immediate superior (= the person directly above me) in the company.
examples.zh: 他在公司里是我的顶头上司。

senses.def: having a direct effect

examples.en: The immediate cause of death is unknown.
examples.zh: 造成死亡的直接原因不明。

senses.def: starting now

examples.en: She has resigned with immediate effect.
examples.zh: 她已辞职，而且立即生效。

senses.def: starting now

examples.en: She has resigned with immediate effect.
examples.zh: 她已辞职，而且立即生效。

senses.def: without delay

examples.en: She answered almost immediately.
examples.zh: 她几乎立刻就回答了。

examples.en: They immediately began arguing.
examples.zh: 他们立刻吵了起来。

examples.en: The point of my question may not be immediately apparent.
examples.zh: 我的问题的要点可能不是一下子就能看出来的。

examples.en: It is immediately clear that he is out of his depth.
examples.zh: 很明显，他已经超出了他的能力范围。

examples.en: Details were not immediately available.
examples.zh: 详细信息尚未立即公布。

senses.def: next to or very close to a particular place or time

examples.en: Turn right immediately after the church.
examples.zh: 一过教堂就向右拐。

examples.en: the land immediately adjacent to the river
examples.zh: 紧邻河流的土地

examples.en: the years immediately before the war
examples.zh: 战前的最后几年

examples.en: in the two weeks immediately prior to the exam
examples.zh: 考试前两周

examples.en: Who is immediately above a colonel in rank?
examples.zh: 谁的军衔直接高于上校？

examples.en: the period immediately following her birth
examples.zh: 她刚出生的那段时间

examples.en: The film takes place in the days immediately preceding the invasion.
examples.zh: 这部电影发生在入侵前几天。

senses.def: closely and directly

examples.en: Counselling is being given to those most immediately affected by the tragedy.
examples.zh: 目前正在向惨剧的最直接受害者提供辅导服务。

senses.def: as soon as

examples.en: Immediately she'd gone, I remembered her name.
examples.zh: 她刚走开我就想起了她的名字。

senses.def: that has existed for longer than people can remember
senses.zh: 古老的；远古的；无法追忆的

examples.en: an immemorial tradition
examples.zh: 古老的传统

examples.en: My family has lived in this area from time immemorial (= for a very long time).
examples.zh: 我的家族在这个地区已经生活了不知有多少年了。

senses.def: extremely large or great

examples.en: There is still an immense amount of work to be done.
examples.zh: 还有非常非常多的工作要做。

examples.en: The benefits are immense.
examples.zh: 效益是极大的。

examples.en: a project of immense importance
examples.zh: 极其重要的工程

examples.en: To my immense relief, he didn’t notice my mistake.
examples.zh: 他没有注意到我的错误，这让我大松了一口气。

senses.def: extremely; very much

examples.en: immensely popular/difficult/grateful
examples.zh: 非常受欢迎／艰难／感激

examples.en: We enjoyed ourselves immensely.
examples.zh: 我们玩得好极了。

senses.def: the large size of something

examples.en: the immensity of the universe
examples.zh: 宇宙的浩瀚无垠

examples.en: We were overwhelmed by the sheer immensity of the task.
examples.zh: 任务太重，把我们都吓倒了。

senses.def: to put somebody/something into a liquid, especially so that they or it are completely covered

examples.en: The seeds will swell when immersed in water.
examples.zh: 这些种子浸泡在水里就会膨胀。

senses.def: to become or make somebody completely involved in something

examples.en: She immersed herself in her work.
examples.zh: 她埋头工作。

examples.en: I immediately immersed myself in the task.
examples.zh: 我立即专心投入工作。

examples.en: Clare and Phil were immersed in conversation in the corner.
examples.zh: 克莱尔和菲尔在角落里深谈。

senses.def: the act of putting somebody/something into a liquid, especially so that they or it are completely covered; the state of being covered by a liquid

examples.en: Immersion in cold water resulted in rapid loss of heat.
examples.zh: 浸泡在冷水中导致热量迅速散失。

examples.en: baptism by total immersion (= putting the whole body underwater)
examples.zh: 浸水式洗礼

senses.def: the state of being completely involved in something

examples.en: his long immersion in politics
examples.zh: 他长期潜心从政

examples.en: The course offers the opportunity for total immersion in the language and culture.
examples.zh: 本课程提供了全面沉浸在该国语言和文化中的机会。

examples.en: a five-week French immersion programme (= in which the student will hear and use only French)
examples.zh: 为期五周的法语沉浸式课程（=学生只能听到和使用法语）

senses.def: a device that provides hot water for a house by heating water in a tank
that seems to surround the player or viewer so they feel totally involved in the experience, often by using three-dimensional

examples.en: Immersive games can be used for training and education.
examples.zh: 沉浸式游戏可用于培训和教育。

senses.def: a person who has come to live permanently in a different country from the one they were born in

examples.en: immigrants from other European countries
examples.zh: 来自其他欧洲国家的移民

examples.en: immigrants to the United States
examples.zh: 移民往美国的人

examples.en: Immigrants and their descendants have played a vital role in building this nation.
examples.zh: 移民及其后代在建设这个国家方面发挥了至关重要的作用。

examples.en: The president vowed to continue deporting illegal immigrants.
examples.zh: 总统发誓要继续驱逐非法移民。

examples.en: The program protects undocumented immigrants who came to the US as children.
examples.zh: 该计划保护儿童时期来到美国的无证移民。

examples.en: immigrant workers/communities/groups
examples.zh: 移民工人／社区／团体

intro.en: These words all describe people who have moved to a different country.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示移居外国的人。

items.def: a person who has either chosen or been forced to leave their country and come to live permanently in a different country:
items.zh: 指移民、外侨

examples.en: immigrants from other European countries
examples.zh: 来自其他欧洲国家的移民

items.def: a person who moves from one place to another in order to find work or better living conditions:
items.zh: 指为了找工作或改善生活而迁移的人

examples.en: The country has a large seasonal migrant population.
examples.zh: 该国有大量季节性移民。

items.def: a person who has been forced to leave their country or home, because there is a war or for political, religious or social reasons:
items.zh: 指避难者、逃亡者、难民

examples.en: There has been a steady flow of refugees from the war zone.
examples.zh: 难民持续从交战地区涌出。

items.def: a person who has been forced to leave their own country because they are in danger and who arrives in another country asking to be allowed to stay there:
items.zh: 指寻求避难者、寻求庇护的移民

examples.en: to provide accommodation and support for asylum seekers
examples.zh: 为寻求庇护的人提供住宿和援助

items.def: a person living in a country that is not their own, usually by choice:
items.zh: 指通常自愿选择居住在国外的人、侨民

examples.en: American expatriates in Paris
examples.zh: 居住在巴黎的美国人

senses.def: to come and live permanently in a country after leaving your own country

examples.en: About 6.6 million people immigrated to the United States in the 1970s.
examples.zh: 20世纪70年代大约有660万人移居美国。

senses.def: the process of coming to live permanently in a different country from the one you were born in; the number of people who do this

examples.en: legal/illegal immigration
examples.zh: 合法/非法移民

examples.en: We are strongly supportive of immigration and multiculturalism.
examples.zh: 我们强烈支持移民和多元文化主义。

examples.en: laws restricting immigration into the US
examples.zh: 美国限制外来移民的法律

examples.en: There was an increase in immigration from Eastern Europe.
examples.zh: 来自东欧的移民有所增加。

examples.en: immigration policy/reform
examples.zh: 移民政策；移民政策的改革

senses.def: the place at a port, an airport, etc. where the passports and other documents of people coming into a country are checked

examples.en: We landed at Heathrow and went through customs and immigration.
examples.zh: 我们在希思罗机场降落，之后办理了海关和移民入境检查手续。

examples.en: immigration officers
examples.zh: 移民局官员

examples.en: The men were interviewed by immigration officials.
examples.zh: 这些人接受了移民官员的面谈。

senses.def: the fact of being likely to happen very soon

examples.en: the imminence of death
examples.zh: 死之将至

senses.def: likely to happen very soon

examples.en: the imminent threat of invasion
examples.zh: 迫在眉睫的入侵威胁

examples.en: The system is in imminent danger of collapse.
examples.zh: 这个体制面临着崩溃的危险。

examples.en: An announcement about his resignation is imminent.
examples.zh: 马上就要宣布他的辞职。

examples.en: An attack seems imminent.
examples.zh: 袭击似乎迫在眉睫。

senses.def: very soon

examples.en: A decision is expected imminently.
examples.zh: 预计很快就会做出决定。

senses.def: that cannot be mixed together
not moving

examples.en: She stood immobile by the window.
examples.zh: 她一动不动地靠窗站着。

senses.def: unable to move
senses.zh: 不能移动的；不能活动的

examples.en: His illness has left him completely immobile.
examples.zh: 他的病使他完全丧失了活动能力。

examples.en: The plaster cast is used to keep the leg immobile.
examples.zh: 石膏用于保持腿部不动。

senses.def: the state of not moving

examples.en: the prolonged immobility of flight passengers during long-haul flights
examples.zh: 长途飞行期间航班乘客长时间不动

senses.def: the condition of being unable to move
senses.zh: 静止不动：无法移动的状态

examples.en: She suffers bouts of immobility and pain.
examples.zh: 她时常感到无法动弹和疼痛。

senses.def: the act of preventing somebody/something from moving or from working in the normal way

examples.en: Treating a tendon rupture requires immobilization of the ankle.
examples.zh: 治疗肌腱断裂需要固定踝关节。

senses.def: to prevent something/somebody from moving or from working in the normal way
senses.zh: 使不动；使不能正常运作

examples.en: a device to immobilize the car engine in case of theft
examples.zh: 遇到有人盗车时使汽车引擎发动不了的装置

examples.en: Always immobilize a broken leg immediately.
examples.zh: 腿断了应立即加以固定。

examples.en: The firm has been immobilized by a series of strikes.
examples.zh: 一连串的罢工使得这家公司无法正常运营。

examples.en: Some snakes inject their prey with poison in order to immobilize it.
examples.zh: 有些蛇向猎物注射毒液以使其无法动弹。

senses.def: a device that is fitted to a car to stop it moving if somebody tries to steal it
senses.zh: 汽车防盗器（遇到有人盗车时使汽车开不动的装置）

senses.def: extreme; not reasonable
senses.zh: 极端的；不适度的；不合理的；过度的

examples.en: immoderate drinking
examples.zh: 无节制的饮酒

senses.def: in a way that is extreme or not reasonable
senses.zh: 极端的；不适度的；不合理的；过度的

senses.def: having or showing a very high opinion of yourself and your abilities

examples.en: I am immodest enough to think that I played an important part in her decision.
examples.zh: 我不谦虚地认为我在她的决定中发挥了重要作用。

senses.def: that may shock people because it involves sex or attracts attention in a sexual way

examples.en: an immodest dress
examples.zh: 太过暴露的连衣裙

senses.def: to kill somebody/yourself by burning them/yourself
the act of killing somebody/yourself by burning them/yourself
senses.zh: 献祭：通过焚烧某人/自己来杀死某人/自己的行为

senses.def: not considered to be good or honest by most people

examples.en: It's immoral to steal.
examples.zh: 偷盗是不道德的。

examples.en: There's nothing immoral about wanting to earn more money.
examples.zh: 想多赚点钱没什么不道德。

senses.def: not following accepted standards of sexual behaviour

examples.en: an immoral act/life/person
examples.zh: 淫荡的举动／生活／人

examples.en: They were charged with living off immoral earnings (= money earned by working as a prostitute).
examples.zh: 她们被控靠卖淫为生。

senses.def: behaviour that is not considered to be good or honest by most people

examples.en: the immorality of war
examples.zh: 战争的邪恶

senses.def: behaviour that does not follow accepted standards of sexual behaviour

examples.en: a life of immorality
examples.zh: 放荡的生活

examples.en: sexual immorality
examples.zh: 性方面的不道德

senses.def: in a way that is not considered to be good or honest by most people
in a way that does not follow accepted standards of sexual behaviour
that lives or lasts forever

examples.en: the belief that we have an immortal soul
examples.zh: 相信我们有不朽的灵魂

examples.en: In the poem, Satan vows revenge and immortal hate.
examples.zh: 在诗中，撒旦发誓复仇和不朽的仇恨。

examples.en: He believed himself immortal.
examples.zh: 他认为自己能长生不老。

examples.en: She believed that her immortal soul was in danger.
examples.zh: 她认为自己不灭的灵魂受到了威胁。

senses.def: famous and likely to be remembered forever
senses.zh: 流芳百世的；名垂千古的

examples.en: the immortal Goethe
examples.zh: 名垂千古的歌德

examples.en: In the immortal words of Henry Ford, ‘If it ain't broke, don't fix it.’
examples.zh: 按照亨利·福特的不朽名言：“如果东西没坏掉，就不要去修理它。”

senses.def: a person who is so famous that they will be remembered forever
senses.zh: 不朽的人物；名垂千古的人物

examples.en: She is one of the Hollywood immortals.
examples.zh: 她是一位千古流芳的好莱坞名人。

senses.def: a god or other being who is believed to live forever
a person who supports the idea that, with the help of science, people need never die

examples.en: Older immortalists see cryonics as their last chance.
examples.zh: 年长的永生主义者将人体冷冻视为他们最后的机会。

examples.en: Cryonics is the cornerstone of the immortalists’ movement.
examples.zh: 人体冷冻学是永生论运动的基石。

senses.def: the state of living or lasting forever

examples.en: belief in the immortality of the soul
examples.zh: 灵魂不灭的信念

examples.en: He is well on his way to show business immortality.
examples.zh: 他势将在演艺界名垂千古。

examples.en: Some religions include a doctrine of personal immortality.
examples.zh: 有些宗教里有肉体永生的信条。

senses.def: to prevent somebody/something from being forgotten in the future, especially by mentioning them in literature, making films about them, painting them, etc.
senses.zh: 使不朽，使名垂千古（尤指通过文学艺术作品等）

examples.en: The poet fell in love with her and immortalized her in his verse.
examples.zh: 诗人爱上了她，并以诗歌使她名传后世。

senses.def: that cannot be moved

examples.en: an immovable object
examples.zh: 固定的物体

examples.en: immovable property (= houses, land, etc.)
examples.zh: 不动产

senses.def: impossible to change or persuade

examples.en: On this issue he is completely immovable.
examples.zh: 他在这个问题上坚定不移。

senses.def: that cannot catch or be affected by a particular disease or illness

examples.en: Adults are often immune to German measles.
examples.zh: 成人往往对风疹有免疫力。

senses.def: not affected by something, especially something that you might expect to be harmful

examples.en: You'll eventually become immune to criticism.
examples.zh: 你终有一日会不再在意批评。

examples.en: Few people are immune to her charms.
examples.zh: 很少有人能免疫她的魅力。

examples.en: Our business is far from immune to economic conditions.
examples.zh: 我们的业务远不能免受经济状况的影响。

senses.def: protected from something and therefore able to avoid it

examples.en: No one should be immune from prosecution.
examples.zh: 任何人都不应免于被起诉。

examples.en: Not even the monarch was immune from criticism by the press.
examples.zh: 就连君主也未能幸免于媒体的批评。

senses.def: the reaction of the body to the presence of an antigen
senses.zh: 免疫应答（机体对抗原的应答）

senses.def: the system in your body that produces substances to help it fight against infection and disease
the body’s ability to avoid or not be affected by infection and disease

examples.en: immunity to infection
examples.zh: 对传染病的免疫力

examples.en: The vaccine provides longer immunity against flu.
examples.zh: 这种疫苗对流感的免疫效力时间较长。

senses.def: the state of not being affected by something, especially something that you might expect to be harmful

examples.en: the president's seeming immunity to criticism
examples.zh: 总统不受批评影响的样子

senses.def: the state of being protected from something

examples.en: The spies were all granted immunity from prosecution.
examples.zh: 这些间谍都获准免予公诉。

examples.en: parliamentary/congressional immunity (= protection against particular laws that is given to politicians)
examples.zh: 议会／国会豁免权

examples.en: Officials of all member states receive certain privileges and immunities.
examples.zh: 各成员国的官员均享有某些特权和豁免权。

senses.def: the act of protecting a person or an animal from a disease, especially by giving them an injection
senses.zh: 保护人或动物免于疾病的行为，尤指给他们注射疫苗

examples.en: an immunization programme to prevent epidemics
examples.zh: 流行病免疫接种计划

senses.def: to protect a person or an animal from a disease, especially by giving them an injection

examples.en: a campaign to immunize children against the common killer diseases
examples.zh: 一项针对常见致命疾病的儿童免疫运动

examples.en: Children have been routinely immunized against polio since 1958.
examples.zh: 自 1958 年以来，儿童都按常规接种防治小儿麻痹症的疫苗。

examples.en: They immunized some mice with a dose of the live vaccine.
examples.zh: 他们给一些老鼠注射了一针减毒活疫苗进行免疫。

senses.def: having an immune system
senses.zh: 免疫功能低下的，免疫系统受损伤削弱的

examples.en: The virus could have serious consequences for immunocompromised people.
examples.zh: 该病毒可能会对免疫功能低下的人造成严重后果。

senses.def: a medical condition in which your body does not have the normal ability to resist infection

examples.en: human immunodeficiency virus or HIV
examples.zh: 人体免疫缺陷病毒，即 HIV

senses.def: connected with the scientific study of protection against disease
the scientific study of protection against disease
a drug that stops the body from reacting against antigens
having an immune system

examples.en: People who are severely immunosuppressed can get a booster vaccine.
examples.zh: 免疫严重抑制的人可以接种加强疫苗。

senses.def: the act of stopping the body from reacting against antigens
to shut somebody in a place so that they cannot get out

examples.en: At the age of 86 he was immured in his house by infirmity.
examples.zh: 86岁时，他因体弱多病被禁在家中。

examples.en: a society immured in ignorance and superstition
examples.zh: 一个充满无知和迷信的社会

senses.def: the fact of never changing or being changed
that cannot be changed; that will never change
senses.zh: 不可改变的；永恒不变的

examples.en: This decision should not be seen as immutable.
examples.zh: 不该把这个决定看作是不可改变的。

senses.def: in my opinion
senses.zh: 在我看来（尤用于电邮、短信、社交媒体等）

examples.en: It's a nice performance, not among his best, IMO.
examples.zh: 我觉得这场演出不错，但不算他的最佳表现。

senses.def: a first name for girls
(in stories) a small creature like a little man, that has magic powers and behaves badly
a child who behaves badly, but not in a serious way
the powerful effect that something has on somebody/something

examples.en: a positive/a negative/an adverse impact
examples.zh: 好的／不好的影响

examples.en: a significant/major/huge impact
examples.zh: 重大／巨大的影响

examples.en: to have/make an impact
examples.zh: 产生影响

examples.en: to reduce/minimize the impact of something
examples.zh: 减少某事物的影响；把影响减到最小

examples.en: the environmental impact of tourism
examples.zh: 旅游业对环境的影响

examples.en: the economic impact of leaving the European Union
examples.zh: 退出欧盟对经济的影响

examples.en: Her speech made a profound impact on everyone.
examples.zh: 她的讲话对每个人都有深远的影响。

examples.en: He has had a lasting impact on the lives of many of his students.
examples.zh: 他对许多学生的生活产生了持久的影响。

examples.en: The project's impact on the environment should be minimal.
examples.zh: 该项目对环境的影响应该是最小的。

examples.en: The report assesses the impact of the disease on mortality and population growth.
examples.zh: 这份报告评估了这种疾病对死亡率和人口增长的影响。

examples.en: It is too early to notice any impact from the recent changes to the rules.
examples.zh: 现在判断最近规则变化的影响还为时过早。

examples.en: an environmental impact assessment
examples.zh: 环境影响评估

examples.en: a victim impact statement
examples.zh: 受害者影响陈述

senses.def: the act of one object hitting another; the force with which this happens

examples.en: craters made by meteorite impacts
examples.zh: 陨石撞击而成的陨石坑

examples.en: The impact of the blow knocked Jack off balance.
examples.zh: 这一记猛击把杰克打了个趔趄。

examples.en: A well-designed sports shoe should absorb the impact on the 28 bones in each foot.
examples.zh: 设计精良的运动鞋应能减轻冲击力，保护单足的 28 块骨头。

examples.en: The bomb explodes on impact (= when it hits something).
examples.zh: 炸弹受到撞击就会爆炸。

examples.en: The car is fitted with side impact bars (= to protect it from a blow from the side).
examples.zh: 这辆车的两侧都安装了保险杠。

senses.def: to have an effect on somebody/something

examples.en: Her father's death impacted greatly on her childhood years.
examples.zh: 父亲去世对她的童年造成巨大影响。

examples.en: These restrictions will impact on all farmers in Ireland.
examples.zh: 这些限制将影响爱尔兰的所有农民。

examples.en: environmental factors that may negatively impact children's development
examples.zh: 可能对儿童发育产生不良影响的环境因素

examples.en: The company's performance was impacted by the high value of the pound.
examples.zh: 公司的业绩受到了英镑高值的冲击。

senses.def: to hit something with great force
having a major impact or effect

examples.en: It was a hugely impactful advertising campaign.
examples.zh: 那场宣传活动效果非常好。

senses.def: to damage something or make something worse

examples.en: His age impaired his chances of finding a new job.
examples.zh: 他的年龄削弱了他找到新工作的机会。

intro.en: These words all mean to have a bad effect on somebody/​something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含伤害、损害之义。

items.def: to cause physical harm to something, making it less attractive, useful or valuable; to have a bad effect on somebody/​something’s life, health, happiness or chances of success:
items.zh: 指毁坏、破坏、伤害、损害

examples.en: The fire badly damaged the town hall.
examples.zh: 火灾使市政厅遭到严重破坏。

items.def: (rather informal) to have a bad effect on somebody/​something’s life, health, happiness or chances of success:
items.zh: 指伤害、损害

examples.en: Hard work never hurt anyone.
examples.zh: 努力工作绝无害处。

items.def: to have a bad effect on somebody/​something’s life, health, happiness or chances of success:
items.zh: 指伤害、损害

examples.en: Pollution can harm marine life.
examples.zh: 污染会危及海洋生物。

items.def: (rather formal) to damage somebody’s health, abilities or chances:
items.zh: 指损害、削弱（健康、能力或机会）

examples.en: Even one drink can impair driving performance.
examples.zh: 即使一杯酒也可能影响驾驶操作。

senses.def: an injury, illness or condition that means that part of your body or brain does not work as it normally would or as it does in most people
senses.zh: （身体或智力方面的）缺陷，障碍，损伤；某种缺陷

examples.en: impairment of kidney function
examples.zh: 肾功能受损

examples.en: visual impairments
examples.zh: 视力受损

examples.en: He drove in a state of serious impairment due to alcohol.
examples.zh: 由于酗酒，他在严重受损的情况下开车。

examples.en: The drug is approved for mild cognitive impairment.
examples.zh: 该药被批准用于治疗轻度认知障碍。

senses.def: an African antelope
senses.zh: 黑斑羚（栖息在非洲，角弯曲）

senses.def: to push a sharp pointed object through something

examples.en: She impaled a lump of meat on her fork.
examples.zh: 她用叉子叉起一块肉。

senses.def: if you impale

examples.en: He had fallen and been impaled on some iron railings.
examples.zh: 他摔下去，穿在了铁栏杆上。

senses.def: that cannot be felt physically
senses.zh: 触摸不到的；感觉不着的

senses.def: very difficult to understand
to choose the members of a jury
senses.zh: 选任（陪审员）；选任…为陪审员

senses.def: to pass information, knowledge, etc. to other people
to give a particular quality to something

examples.en: The spice imparts an Eastern flavour to the dish.
examples.zh: 这种调味品给菜肴添加了一种东方风味。

senses.def: not supporting one person or group more than another
senses.zh: 公正的；不偏不倚的；中立的

examples.en: an impartial inquiry/observer
examples.zh: 公正的调查／观察者

examples.en: to give impartial advice
examples.zh: 提出不偏不倚的建议

examples.en: As chairperson, I must remain impartial.
examples.zh: 作为主席，我必须保持公正。

senses.def: the fact of not supporting one person or group more than another

examples.en: political/judicial impartiality
examples.zh: 政治/司法公正

senses.def: in a way that does not support one person or group more than another
senses.zh: 公正的；不偏不倚的；中立的

examples.en: The trustees failed to act impartially.
examples.zh: 受托人未能公正行事。

senses.def: impossible to travel on or through, especially because it is in bad condition or it has been blocked by something
senses.zh: 不能通行的（尤指因路况恶劣或被阻断）

examples.en: The mountain roads are totally impassable to cars in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天的山路根本无法通行汽车。

examples.en: After the storm, many roads were made impassable by fallen trees.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，许多道路因倒下的树木而无法通行。

examples.en: The river formed an impassable barrier for migrating animals.
examples.zh: 这条河对迁徙的动物形成了不可逾越的屏障。

examples.en: The river’s broad mudflats were thought completely impassable.
examples.zh: 人们曾经以为这条河的泥滩部份太宽，根本无法通行。

senses.def: a difficult situation in which no progress can be made because the people involved cannot agree what to do

examples.en: to break/end the impasse
examples.zh: 打破／结束僵局

examples.en: Negotiations have reached an impasse.
examples.zh: 谈判已陷入僵局。

examples.en: The Governor attempted to resolve Minnesota’s current budget impasse.
examples.zh: 州长试图解决明尼苏达州目前的预算难题。

examples.en: The proposal offered both sides a way out of the diplomatic impasse.
examples.zh: 这一提议为双方摆脱外交僵局提供了出路。

senses.def: showing strong feelings about something

examples.en: an impassioned plea/speech/defence
examples.zh: 热切的恳求；充满激情的讲话／辩护

examples.en: He made an impassioned plea for the rebels to lay down their arms.
examples.zh: 他慷慨激昂地请求叛乱分子放下武器。

examples.en: She wrote an impassioned letter to her local newspaper to complain about the new road.
examples.zh: 她给当地的报纸写了一封措辞激烈的信，投诉新修的马路。

senses.def: not showing any feeling or emotion
senses.zh: 无表情的；无动于衷的；不动声色的

examples.en: her impassive expression/face
examples.zh: 她冷漠的表情／面容

examples.en: The two men remained impassive throughout the trial.
examples.zh: 这两个男人在审讯期间自始至终都面无表情。

senses.def: without showing any feeling or emotion
senses.zh: 无表情的；无动于衷的；不动声色的

examples.en: The accused listened impassively as the judge sentenced him.
examples.zh: 法官宣判时被告漠然地听着。

senses.def: a painting technique in which the paint is put on so thickly that it stands out from the surface
senses.zh: 厚涂法（使用大量颜料堆叠，使其高出画布或画板表面）

senses.def: a picture painted using this method
the feeling of being annoyed by somebody/something, especially because you have to wait for a long time

examples.en: impatience with the slow pace of the talks
examples.zh: 对谈判进展缓慢感到不耐烦

examples.en: impatience at the lack of political progress
examples.zh: 对缺乏政治进展感到不耐烦

senses.def: the desire to do something soon or for something to happen soon

examples.en: She was bursting with impatience to tell me the news.
examples.zh: 她迫不及待要告诉我这个消息。

examples.en: his apparent impatience for war
examples.zh: 他对战争明显不耐烦

senses.def: the fact of being unable or unwilling to accept something unpleasant
senses.zh: （对不愉快的事）不能容忍，不愿接受

examples.en: his impatience of discipline
examples.zh: 他对纪律缺乏耐心

senses.def: a small plant with a lot of red, pink, or white flowers, often grown indoors or in gardens

examples.en: The impatiens fill the flowering beds with a myriad of color and variation.
examples.zh: 凤仙花让花坛充满了无数的颜色和变化。

senses.def: annoyed by somebody/something, especially because you have to wait for a long time

examples.en: I'd been waiting for twenty minutes and I was getting impatient.
examples.zh: 我等了二十分钟，有点不耐烦了。

examples.en: The children were growing impatient.
examples.zh: 孩子们越来越不耐烦了。

examples.en: Try not to be too impatient with her.
examples.zh: 尽量别对她太没耐心。

examples.en: Sarah was becoming increasingly impatient at their lack of interest.
examples.zh: 他们缺乏兴趣，萨拉对此越来越不能忍耐了。

examples.en: An impatient driver behind me sounded his horn.
examples.zh: 我后面的一个司机不耐烦了, 按响了喇叭。

examples.en: She waved them away with an impatient gesture.
examples.zh: 她用不耐烦的手势挥手让他们走开。

senses.def: wanting to do something soon; wanting something to happen soon

examples.en: She was clearly impatient to leave.
examples.zh: 她显然是迫不及待地想离开。

examples.en: impatient for change
examples.zh: 急于求变

senses.def: unable or unwilling to accept something unpleasant
senses.zh: （对不愉快的事）不能容忍，不愿接受

examples.en: impatient of criticism
examples.zh: 不愿接受批评

senses.def: in a way that shows you are annoyed, especially because you have to wait for a long time

examples.en: ‘Come on,’ I said impatiently, ‘We have only an hour until the tour.’
examples.zh: “走吧，”我不耐烦地说，“距离巡演只剩下一个小时了。”

senses.def: with the feeling that you want to do something soon, or want something to happen soon

examples.en: We sat waiting impatiently for the movie to start.
examples.zh: 我们坐着，焦急地等待电影开演。

senses.def: to charge an important public figure with a serious crime
senses.zh: 控告（显要公职人员）犯重大罪行；弹劾

examples.en: The President was impeached by Congress for lying.
examples.zh: 总统因说谎遭国会弹劾。

senses.def: to raise doubts about something

examples.en: to impeach somebody’s motives
examples.zh: 怀疑某人的动机

senses.def: for which a politician or a person who works for the government can be impeached

examples.en: an impeachable offense
examples.zh: 可弹劾的罪行

senses.def: the act of charging an important public figure with a serious crime
senses.zh: 控告（显要公职人员）犯重大罪行；弹劾

examples.en: the possible impeachment of the President of the United States
examples.zh: 美国总统可能被弹劾

senses.def: without mistakes or faults
senses.zh: 无错误的；无瑕疵的；完美的

examples.en: impeccable manners/taste
examples.zh: 无可挑剔的举止／品味

examples.en: Her written English is impeccable.
examples.zh: 她写的英语无可挑剔。

examples.en: He was dressed in a suit and an impeccable white shirt.
examples.zh: 他身穿一套礼服和一件洁白的衬衣。

senses.def: in a way that has no mistakes or faults
senses.zh: 无错误的；无瑕疵的；完美的

examples.en: to behave impeccably
examples.zh: 举止无可挑剔

examples.en: impeccably dressed
examples.zh: 衣着十分得体

senses.def: having little or no money

examples.en: an impecunious student
examples.zh: 穷学生

senses.def: a measurement of the total resistance
to delay or stop the progress of something

examples.en: Work on the building was impeded by severe weather.
examples.zh: 楼房的施工因天气恶劣而停了下来。

examples.en: A number of practical difficulties impeded the process.
examples.zh: 许多实际困难阻碍了这一进程。

examples.en: In what ways did economic factors impede progress?
examples.zh: 经济因素在哪些方面阻碍了进步？

senses.def: something that delays or stops the progress of something

examples.en: The level of inflation is a serious impediment to economic recovery.
examples.zh: 通货膨胀是影响经济复苏的严重障碍。

examples.en: Their boycott of the talks constitutes a serious impediment to peace negotiations.
examples.zh: 他们对会谈的抵制成了和平谈判的重大障碍。

examples.en: There are no legal impediments to their appealing against the decision.
examples.zh: 在法律上没有障碍阻止他们对判决提出上诉。

senses.def: a problem, for example a stammer
senses.zh: （生理问题导致的）言语[听觉，行动]障碍

examples.en: a speech impediment
examples.zh: 言语障碍

examples.en: a sight/hearing impediment
examples.zh: 视力/听力障碍

senses.def: the bags and other equipment that you need for an activity or expedition, especially when they take up a lot of space or are difficult to carry
senses.zh: 行囊；妨碍行进的重负（行李）；辎重

examples.en: The kitchen must have as much space as possible for herbs, spices, pots and pans, cook books and all my other impedimenta.
examples.zh: 厨房必须有尽可能多的空间来放置香草、香料、锅碗瓢盆、烹饪书和所有其他障碍物。

senses.def: if an idea or feeling impels

examples.en: He felt impelled to investigate further.
examples.zh: 他觉得有必要作进一步调查。

examples.en: There are various reasons that impel me to that conclusion.
examples.zh: 有各种原因促使我作出那个结论。

examples.en: She was impelled by the urgent need to see him again.
examples.zh: 她迫切需要再次见到他。

senses.def: that is going to happen very soon
senses.zh: 即将发生的；迫在眉睫的

examples.en: his impending retirement
examples.zh: 他即将到来的退休

examples.en: warnings of impending danger/disaster
examples.zh: 对马上到来的危险／灾难的预警

examples.en: They were all filled with a sense of impending doom.
examples.zh: 他们都充满了一种厄运即将来临的预感。

senses.def: the fact that something cannot be entered, passed through or seen
senses.zh: 不可进入的；穿不过的；无法透视的

senses.def: the fact of being impossible to understand
senses.zh: 不可理解的；高深莫测的

senses.def: that cannot be entered, passed through or seen through
senses.zh: 不可进入的；穿不过的；无法透视的

examples.en: an impenetrable jungle
examples.zh: 无法穿越的丛林

examples.en: impenetrable darkness
examples.zh: 漆黑

senses.def: impossible to understand
senses.zh: 不可理解的；高深莫测的

examples.en: an impenetrable mystery
examples.zh: 不解之谜

examples.en: Her expression was impenetrable.
examples.zh: 她的表情令人难以捉摸。

examples.en: Their jargon is impenetrable to an outsider.
examples.zh: 他们的行话外人听不懂。

senses.def: in a way that is impossible to understand
senses.zh: 不可理解的；高深莫测的

examples.en: an impenetrably obscure writer
examples.zh: 一个难以理解的默默无闻的作家

senses.def: in a way that cannot be entered, passed through or seen through
senses.zh: 不可进入的；穿不过的；无法透视的

examples.en: The passage was impenetrably dark.
examples.zh: 通道漆黑得无法穿透。

senses.def: not feeling ashamed or sorry about something bad you have done
very important and needing immediate attention or action
senses.zh: 重要紧急的；迫切的；急需处理的

examples.en: It is absolutely imperative that we finish by next week.
examples.zh: 我们必须于下周完工。

examples.en: It is imperative to continue the treatment for at least two months.
examples.zh: 必须继续治疗至少两个月。

senses.def: expressing authority

examples.en: an imperative tone
examples.zh: 命令的语调

senses.def: expressing an order

examples.en: an imperative sentence
examples.zh: 祈使句

senses.def: a thing that is very important and needs immediate attention or action; a factor that makes something necessary
senses.zh: 重要紧急的事；必要的事

examples.en: the economic imperative of quality education for all
examples.zh: 向全民提供优质教育对经济发展的重要性

examples.en: the biological imperatives that guide male and female behaviour
examples.zh: 指导男性和女性行为的生物法则

senses.def: the form of a verb that expresses an order; a verb in this form
senses.zh: 祈使语气；祈使语气动词

examples.en: ‘Go away!’ is an imperative.
examples.zh: Go away! 是祈使句。

examples.en: In ‘Go away!’ the verb is in the imperative.
examples.zh: Go away! 中的动词是祈使语气动词。

senses.def: very small and therefore unable to be seen or felt
senses.zh: （小得）无法察觉的，感觉不到的

examples.en: imperceptible changes in temperature
examples.zh: 难以觉察的气温变化

examples.en: There was an almost imperceptible pause as she gathered her breath to speak.
examples.zh: 当她屏住呼吸准备说话时，出现了几乎难以察觉的停顿。

examples.en: The differences were imperceptible to all but the most trained eye.
examples.zh: 只有最训练有素的眼睛才能察觉到这些差异。

examples.en: The slight change in the taste was imperceptible to most people.
examples.zh: 这种味道的细微改变是多数人难以察觉的。

senses.def: in a very small way that cannot be seen or felt
senses.zh: （小得）无法察觉的，感觉不到的

examples.en: The daylight faded almost imperceptibly into night.
examples.zh: 天光渐暗，夜晚悄然降临。

senses.def: containing faults or mistakes; not complete or perfect
senses.zh: 有缺点的；有缺陷的；不完全的；不完美的

examples.en: an imperfect world
examples.zh: 不完美的世界

examples.en: an imperfect understanding of English
examples.zh: 对英语的不透彻理解

examples.en: All our sale items are slightly imperfect.
examples.zh: 我们所有的特价商品都略有瑕疵。

senses.def: the form of a verb that expresses action in the past that is not complete. It is often called the past progressive
senses.zh: 过去未完成时（常称为过去进行时）

examples.en: In ‘while I was washing my hair’, the verb is in the imperfect.
examples.zh: while I was washing my hair 中的动词是过去未完成时。

senses.def: a fault or weakness in somebody/something

examples.en: They learned to live with each other's imperfections.
examples.zh: 他们学会了容忍对方的缺点。

examples.en: The only slight imperfection in the painting is a scratch in the corner.
examples.zh: 这幅油画唯一的小瑕疵是边角上有道划痕。

examples.en: Nature is full of imperfection.
examples.zh: 大自然充满了不完美之处。

senses.def: in a way that contains faults or mistakes; not completely or perfectly
senses.zh: 有缺点的；有缺陷的；不完全的；不完美的

examples.en: a distant culture that is imperfectly understood by the outside world
examples.zh: 外界无法完全理解的遥远文化

senses.def: connected with an empire

examples.en: the imperial family/palace/army
examples.zh: 皇室家族；皇宫；皇家陆军

examples.en: imperial power/expansion
examples.zh: 皇权；帝国的扩张

senses.def: connected with the system for measuring length, weight and volume using pounds, inches, etc.
a leading British college for the study of science, in South Kensington
senses.zh: 伦敦帝国理工学院以理科为主的英国一流大学，位于伦敦的南肯辛顿。1907年建立时是伦敦大学的一部分，但在2007年成为一所独立院校，除提供科学研究的机会外，也开设科学、医学、工程和商业课程。这所大学有自己的核反应堆，设在阿斯科特附近的希尔伍德园的研究站内。

senses.def: a system in which one country controls other countries, often after defeating them in a war

examples.en: Roman imperialism
examples.zh: 罗马帝国统治

senses.def: the fact of a powerful country increasing its influence over other countries through business, culture, etc.
senses.zh: （商业、文化等向外国的）扩张；扩张主义

examples.en: cultural/economic imperialism
examples.zh: 文化／经济扩张

senses.def: connected with a system in which one country controls other countries, often after defeating them in a war

examples.en: an imperialist power
examples.zh: 帝国主义国家

examples.en: imperialist ambitions
examples.zh: 帝国主义野心

senses.def: increasing its influence over other countries through business, culture, etc.
senses.zh: （商业、文化等向外国的）扩张；扩张主义

examples.en: culturally imperialist attitudes
examples.zh: 文化帝国主义态度

senses.def: a person, such as a politician, who supports imperialism
senses.zh: 帝国主义者；帝国统治拥护者

senses.def: to put something/somebody in danger

examples.en: To ignore this challenge would be to imperil all law and order.
examples.zh: 忽视这一挑战将危及所有法律和秩序。

senses.def: expecting people to obey you and treating them as if they are not as important as you
senses.zh: 专横的；蛮横的；盛气凌人的

examples.en: The professor was as imperious as ever.
examples.zh: 教授还是一如既往的专横。

examples.en: She put out an imperious hand to stop him.
examples.zh: 她伸出一只专横的手阻止他。

examples.en: an imperious gesture/voice/command
examples.zh: 盛气凌人的姿势／语调／命令

examples.en: He waved an imperious hand.
examples.zh: 他霸道地挥了挥手。

senses.def: in a way that shows you expect people to obey you and treats them as if they are not as important as you
senses.zh: 专横的；蛮横的；盛气凌人的

examples.en: ‘Get it now,’ she demanded imperiously.
examples.zh: “现在就给我拿来。”她蛮横地要求道。

senses.def: that will last for a long time or forever
senses.zh: 不会腐烂的；不坏的；不朽的

senses.def: the state of not lasting or staying the same forever
senses.zh: 非永久的；短暂的；暂时的

senses.def: that will not last or stay the same forever
senses.zh: 非永久的；短暂的；暂时的

senses.def: not allowing a liquid or gas to pass through
senses.zh: 不能渗透的；不透气的；不透水的

examples.en: impermeable rock
examples.zh: 不透水的岩石

examples.en: The insulating material should be impermeable to water vapour.
examples.zh: 绝缘材料应不透水蒸气。

senses.def: that cannot be allowed

examples.en: an impermissible invasion of privacy
examples.zh: 对个人隐私的非法侵犯

examples.en: He said that this behaviour was impermissible in a democratic society.
examples.zh: 他表示，这种行为在民主社会是不被允许的。

examples.en: The opposition argued that combining state and party posts in this way was impermissible.
examples.zh: 反对派认为，以这种方式合并国家和政党职位是不允许的。

senses.def: having no friendly human feelings or atmosphere; making you feel unimportant

examples.en: a vast impersonal organization
examples.zh: 庞大而不讲人情的组织

examples.en: an impersonal hotel room
examples.zh: 冷冰冰的旅馆房间

examples.en: Business letters need not be formal and impersonal.
examples.zh: 商业信函不一定就得刻板而缺乏人情味。

examples.en: a cold impersonal stare
examples.zh: 冷漠的凝视

senses.def: not referring to any particular person; not concerned with people as individuals

examples.en: Let's keep the criticism general and impersonal.
examples.zh: 我们批评时应有普遍性，不要针对个人。

examples.en: His touch was as impersonal as that of a doctor.
examples.zh: 他的接触就像医生一样客观。

examples.en: You should write your report in an impersonal manner.
examples.zh: 您应该以客观的方式撰写报告。

senses.def: an impersonal
senses.zh: （动词或句子）无人称的，非人称的

senses.def: a pronoun (in English, the pronoun ‘
senses.zh: 非人称代词（如 it was raining 中的 it）

senses.def: a lack of friendly human feelings or atmosphere that may have the effect of making you feel unimportant

examples.en: the cold impersonality of some modern cities
examples.zh: 某些现代城市的冷漠无情

senses.def: the fact of not referring to any particular person

examples.en: He always strived for objectivity and impersonality in his criticisms.
examples.zh: 他的批评总是力求客观、客观。

senses.def: in a way that lacks friendly human feelings or atmosphere and may make you feel unimportant

examples.en: He treated her coldly and impersonally, like a stranger.
examples.zh: 他对待她冷漠无情，就像对待陌生人一样。

senses.def: in a way that does not refer to any particular person; in a way that is not concerned with people as individuals
senses.zh: 客观地：以不涉及任何特定人的方式；以与个人无关的方式

examples.en: Doctors learn to look at patients impersonally.
examples.zh: 医生学会客观地看待病人。

senses.def: using ‘it’ or ‘there’ as the subject
senses.zh: 客观地：以“它”或“那里”为主题

examples.en: Some verbs can be used impersonally.
examples.zh: 有些动词可以非人称地使用。

senses.def: to pretend to be somebody in order to trick people or to entertain them

examples.en: He was caught trying to impersonate a security guard.
examples.zh: 他企图假扮警卫被抓获。

examples.en: They do a pretty good job of impersonating Laurel and Hardy.
examples.zh: 他们扮演劳莱和哈台很成功。

senses.def: an act of pretending to be somebody in order to trick people or to entertain them

examples.en: He did an extremely convincing impersonation of the singer.
examples.zh: 他模仿那位歌手惟妙惟肖。

senses.def: a person who copies the way another person talks or behaves in order to entertain people
senses.zh: 模仿他人的滑稽演员；扮演他人的人

examples.en: The show included a female impersonator (= a man dressed as a woman).
examples.zh: 演出中有一位男扮女装的滑稽演员。

senses.def: rude behaviour or comments that show no respect for somebody who is older or more important

examples.en: She had the impertinence to ask my age!
examples.zh: 她竟然问我的年龄，简直太无礼了！

senses.def: rude and not showing respect for somebody who is older or more important

examples.en: an impertinent question/child
examples.zh: 没有礼貌的提问／孩子

examples.en: Would it be impertinent to ask why you're leaving?
examples.zh: 冒昧问一下，你为什么要离开？

examples.en: She found the question highly impertinent.
examples.zh: 她觉得那个问题极不礼貌。

synonyms.words: cheeky ▪ insolent ▪ disrespectful ▪ impolite ▪ impertinent ▪ discourteous

intro.en: These are all words for people showing a lack of respect for other people.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指人粗鲁、无礼。

items.def: having or showing a lack of respect for other people and their feelings:
items.zh: 指粗鲁的、无礼的、粗野的

examples.en: Why are you so rude to your mother?
examples.zh: 你为什么对你的母亲这么没礼貌？

items.def: (British English英式英语, informal) (especially of children) rude in a funny or an annoying way:
items.zh: 厚脸皮的、鲁莽的、放肆的

examples.en: You cheeky monkey!
examples.zh: 你这厚脸皮的猴崽子！

items.def: (rather formal) very rude, especially to somebody who is older or more important Insolent is used especially to talk about the behaviour of children towards adults.
items.zh: insolent 尤用于形容孩子对成年人的行为。

items.def: (rather formal) showing a lack of respect for somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指不尊敬、无礼、轻蔑

examples.en: Some people said he had been disrespectful to the president in his last speech.
examples.zh: 有些人说他在最近一次讲话中对总统不尊重。

items.def: (rather formal) not behaving in a pleasant way that follows the rules of society:
items.zh: 指不礼貌、粗鲁

examples.en: Some people think it is impolite to ask someone’s age.
examples.zh: 有些人认为询问别人的年龄是不礼貌的。

items.def: (rather formal) not showing respect for somebody who is older or more important Impertinent is often used by people such as parents and teachers when they are telling children that they are angry with them for being rude:
items.zh: impertinent 常用于父母、老师等对孩子的粗鲁行为表示气愤

items.def: (formal) having bad manners and not showing respect:
items.zh: 指不礼貌、失礼、粗鲁

examples.en: He didn’t wish to appear discourteous.
examples.zh: 他不想显得没礼貌。

senses.def: in a rude way that shows no respect for somebody who is older or more important
the ability to not get upset or worried by a difficult situation
senses.zh: 冷静的；不易生气的；沉着的

senses.def: not easily upset or worried by a difficult situation; calm
senses.zh: 冷静的；不易生气的；沉着的

examples.en: Above all he was imperturbable and never upset when things appeared to go against him.
examples.zh: 最重要的是，当事情似乎对他不利时，他镇定自若，从不沮丧。

examples.en: She faces challenges with imperturbable calm.
examples.zh: 她以镇定自若的态度面对挑战。

senses.def: in a calm way, without getting too upset or worried by a difficult situation
senses.zh: 冷静的；不易生气的；沉着的

senses.def: not affected or influenced by something

examples.en: impervious to criticism/pain
examples.zh: 能忍受批评／疼痛的

examples.en: She was impervious to his charms.
examples.zh: 对他的魅力她无动于衷。

senses.def: not allowing a liquid or gas to pass through
senses.zh: 不能渗透的；不透气的；不透水的

examples.en: an impervious rock/layer
examples.zh: 不透水的岩石／地层

examples.en: impervious to moisture
examples.zh: 防潮的

senses.def: a disease that causes painful areas on the skin
the fact of tending to act or do things quickly and without thinking carefully about the results
acting or done quickly and without thinking carefully about the results

examples.en: an impetuous young woman
examples.zh: 莽撞的年轻女子

examples.en: an impetuous decision
examples.zh: 草率的决定

senses.def: quickly and without thinking carefully about the results
something that encourages a process or activity to develop more quickly

examples.en: The debate seems to have lost much of its initial impetus.
examples.zh: 辩论会似乎没有开始时那么大的冲劲了。

examples.en: to give (a) new/fresh impetus to something
examples.zh: 给某事物以新的推进力

examples.en: The Prime Minister’s support will give (an) added impetus to the campaign against crime.
examples.zh: 总理的支持将为打击犯罪运动提供更多动力。

examples.en: His articles provided the main impetus for change.
examples.zh: 他的那些文章是促进变革的主要推动力。

senses.def: the force or energy with which something moves

examples.en: The slope added impetus to his speed.
examples.zh: 斜坡令他跑得更快。

senses.def: a lack of respect for God and religion
senses.zh: （尤指对上帝和宗教）的不敬，不恭

senses.def: to have a clear and definite effect on something/somebody, especially a bad one
senses.zh: 对…有明显作用（或影响）；妨碍；侵犯

examples.en: He never allowed his work to impinge on his private life.
examples.zh: 他从不让他的工作妨碍私生活。

examples.en: The preparations for war were beginning to impinge.
examples.zh: 备战的影响开始显现。

senses.def: showing a lack of respect for God and religion
senses.zh: （对上帝或宗教）不敬的，不恭的

senses.def: showing a lack of respect for somebody/something in a way that is funny rather than serious
senses.zh: 顽童似的；顽皮的；淘气的

examples.en: an impish grin/look
examples.zh: 顽皮的笑脸／表情

examples.en: He takes an impish delight in shocking the press.
examples.zh: 他以震惊媒体为乐。

senses.def: in a way that shows a lack of respect for somebody/something in a way that is funny rather than serious
senses.zh: 顽童似的；顽皮的；淘气的

examples.en: to grin/smile impishly
examples.zh: 顽皮地咧嘴一笑

senses.def: that cannot be changed

examples.en: implacable hatred
examples.zh: 难以化解的仇恨

senses.def: unwilling to stop opposing somebody/something

examples.en: an implacable enemy
examples.zh: 死敌

examples.en: She remained implacable (= she would not change her feelings and opinions).
examples.zh: 她仍然不屈不挠（=她不会改变自己的感受和观点）。

senses.def: in a strongly negative way that cannot be changed

examples.en: to be implacably opposed to the plan
examples.zh: 执意反对这个计划

examples.en: implacably sad
examples.zh: 难以平息的悲伤

senses.def: to fix an idea, attitude, etc. in somebody’s mind

examples.en: Prejudices can easily become implanted in the mind.
examples.zh: 偏见容易在头脑中扎根。

senses.def: to put something (usually something artificial) into a part of the body, usually in a medical operation
senses.zh: （通常以手术方式）植入（人造器官等）

examples.en: an electrode implanted into the brain
examples.zh: 植入大脑中的电极

examples.en: an operation to implant an artificial heart
examples.zh: 植入人造心脏的手术

senses.def: to become fixed inside the body of a person or an animal so that it can start to develop
senses.zh: 被移植到（人或动物体内发育）

examples.en: The embryo is placed into the uterus where it has a chance to implant.
examples.zh: 胚胎被放入子宫，在那里它有机会着床。

senses.def: something that is put into a part of the body, usually in a medical operation
senses.zh: （植入人体中的）植入体，植入物

examples.en: silicone breast implants
examples.zh: 硅酮乳房植入体

examples.en: Dental implants can replace missing teeth.
examples.zh: 种植牙可以替代缺失的牙齿。

senses.def: that can be placed inside a person's body

examples.en: The condition can be treated with an implantable defibrillator.
examples.zh: 这种情况可以用植入式除颤器来治疗。

senses.def: the act of putting something (usually something artificial) into a part of the body, usually in a medical operation
senses.zh: 将（人造器官等）置入；（通常指通过手术）将…植入

examples.en: heart procedures such as pacemaker implantation
examples.zh: 心脏手术，例如起搏器植入

senses.def: the process by which an egg or an embryo
senses.zh: 被移植到（人或动物体内发育）

examples.en: the implantation of the fertilized ovum
examples.zh: 受精卵着床

senses.def: the act of fixing an idea, attitude, etc. in somebody's mind
senses.zh: 灌输，注入（观念、看法等）；（在思想上）生根

examples.en: the implantation of Western notions of democracy
examples.zh: 西方民主观念的植入

senses.def: the fact of not seeming reasonable or likely to be true; something that does not seem reasonable or likely to be true
senses.zh: 不合情理；不可信；不真实

examples.en: the implausibility of this theory
examples.zh: 这个理论的不合理性

examples.en: The plot is riddled with holes and implausibilities.
examples.zh: 情节充满漏洞和难以置信。

senses.def: not seeming reasonable or likely to be true
senses.zh: 似乎不合情理的；不像真实的

examples.en: an implausible claim/idea/theory
examples.zh: 悖于情理的要求／思想／理论

examples.en: It was all highly implausible.
examples.zh: 这毫无道理。

examples.en: Her explanation is not implausible.
examples.zh: 她的解释并非没有道理。

senses.def: in a way that does not seem reasonable or likely to be true
senses.zh: 不合情理；不可信；不真实

examples.en: He argued, somewhat implausibly, that the accident could not have been prevented.
examples.zh: 他争辩说那起事故不可能避免，但他的说法颇不令人信服。

examples.en: She quoted an implausibly high figure.
examples.zh: 她引用了一个令人难以置信的高数字。

senses.def: to make something that has been officially decided start to happen or be used

examples.en: to implement changes/decisions/policies/reforms
examples.zh: 实行变革；执行决议／政策；实施改革

examples.en: A new work programme for young people will be implemented.
examples.zh: 将实施一项新的年轻人工作计划。

senses.def: a tool or an instrument, often one that is quite simple and that is used outdoors
senses.zh: 工具，器具（常指简单的户外用具）

examples.en: agricultural implements
examples.zh: 农具

examples.en: Make sure that all sharp implements, such as scythes, have covers.
examples.zh: 一定要确保所有锋利的工具，比如长柄镰刀，都罩上护套。

senses.def: the act of making something that has been officially decided start to happen or be used

examples.en: the implementation of the new system
examples.zh: 新制度的实施

senses.def: to show or suggest that somebody is involved in something bad or criminal

examples.en: He tried to avoid saying anything that would implicate him further.
examples.zh: 他尽力避免说出任何会进一步牵连他的事情。

senses.def: to show or suggest that something is the cause of something bad

examples.en: The results implicate poor hygiene as one cause of the outbreak.
examples.zh: 这些结果说明卫生条件差是疾病暴发的一个原因。

senses.def: to be involved in a crime; to be responsible for something bad
senses.zh: 与某罪行有牵连；对某坏事负有责任

examples.en: Senior officials were implicated in the scandal.
examples.zh: 一些高级官员受到这一丑闻的牵连。

examples.en: These groups are very strongly implicated in the violence.
examples.zh: 这些团体与这起暴力事件有很大关联。

senses.def: to be involved in a crime; to be responsible for something bad
senses.zh: 与某罪行有牵连；对某坏事负有责任

examples.en: Senior officials were implicated in the scandal.
examples.zh: 一些高级官员受到这一丑闻的牵连。

examples.en: These groups are very strongly implicated in the violence.
examples.zh: 这些团体与这起暴力事件有很大关联。

senses.def: a possible effect or result of an action or a decision
senses.zh: 可能的影响（或作用、结果）

examples.en: They failed to consider the wider implications of their actions.
examples.zh: 他们没有考虑到他们的行动会产生更广泛的影响。

examples.en: The development of the site will have implications for the surrounding countryside.
examples.zh: 这个地点的开发将会影响周围的乡村。

senses.def: something that is suggested or indirectly stated (= something that is implied)

examples.en: I resent the implication that I don't care about my father.
examples.zh: 我讨厌别人暗示我不关心父亲。

examples.en: He criticized the Director and, by implication, the whole of the organization.
examples.zh: 他抨击主管，其实是间接批评了整个机构。

senses.def: the fact of being involved, or of involving somebody, in something, especially a crime

examples.en: He resigned after his implication in a sex scandal.
examples.zh: 他因卷入一桩性丑闻而辞职。

senses.def: the act of suggesting that you feel or think something is true, without saying so directly
something that you can understand from what is said, but that is not stated directly

examples.en: An implicature of ‘Some of my friends came’ is ‘Some of my friends did not come’.
examples.zh: “我的一些朋友来了”这句话的言外之意是“我的一些朋友没有来”。

senses.def: suggested without being directly expressed

examples.en: Implicit in his speech was the assumption that they were guilty.
examples.zh: 他话语中的言外之意是设定他们有罪。

examples.en: implicit criticism
examples.zh: 含蓄的批评

examples.en: These assumptions are implicit in his writing.
examples.zh: 这些假设隐含在他的著作中。

senses.def: forming part of something (although perhaps not directly expressed)

examples.en: The ability to listen is implicit in the teacher's role.
examples.zh: 作为教师自然懂得倾听。

senses.def: complete and not doubted

examples.en: She had the implicit trust of her staff.
examples.zh: 她得到了全体职员的绝对信任。

senses.def: an unfair belief about a group of people that you are not aware of and that affects your behaviour and decisions

examples.en: The company is undertaking research into implicit bias in its recruitment processes.
examples.zh: 该公司正在对其招聘流程中的隐性偏见进行研究。

examples.en: Implicit bias training is compulsory for all staff.
examples.zh: 所有员工都必须接受隐性偏见培训。

senses.def: in a way that is suggested without being directly expressed

examples.en: It reinforces, implicitly or explicitly, the idea that money is all-important.
examples.zh: 这或隐或显地强化了金钱至上这一观念。

senses.def: completely and without any doubt

examples.en: I trust John implicitly.
examples.zh: 我毫无保留地信任约翰。

senses.def: to collapse into the centre
senses.zh: 向心聚爆；内爆；向内坍塌

examples.en: The windows on both sides of the room had imploded.
examples.zh: 房间两边的窗户都向内爆碎了。

senses.def: to fail suddenly and completely

examples.en: They lost money when the market imploded.
examples.zh: 当市场崩溃时，他们赔了钱。

senses.def: to ask somebody to do something in an anxious way because you want or need it very much

examples.en: She implored him to stay.
examples.zh: 她恳求他留下。

examples.en: ‘Help me,’ he implored.
examples.zh: “救救我吧。”他哀求道。

examples.en: Tell me it's true. I implore you.
examples.zh: 告诉我那是真的。求求你。

senses.def: the act of collapsing into the centre
the sudden or complete failure of something

examples.en: the country's economic implosion
examples.zh: 该国经济的崩溃

senses.def: to suggest that something is true or that you feel or think something, without saying so directly

examples.en: Are you implying (that) I am wrong?
examples.zh: 你的意思是不是说我错了？

examples.en: His silence seemed to imply agreement.
examples.zh: 他的沉默似乎暗示着同意。

examples.en: High-yield bonds, as the name implies, offer a high rate of interest.
examples.zh: 高收益债券，顾名思义，提供高利率。

examples.en: It was implied that we were at fault.
examples.zh: 这意味着我们错了。

senses.def: to make it seem likely that something is true or exists

examples.en: The survey implies (that) more people are moving house than was thought.
examples.zh: 调查显示，准备搬家的人比想象的要多。

examples.en: It was implied in the survey that…
examples.zh: 这次调查表明…

examples.en: Popularity does not necessarily imply merit.
examples.zh: 受欢迎的东西不一定就是好的。

examples.en: The fact that she was here implies a degree of interest.
examples.zh: 她到场就说明了她有一定程度的兴趣。

senses.def: to make something necessary in order to be successful

examples.en: The project implies an enormous investment in training.
examples.zh: 这个项目需要在培训方面做巨大的投资。

examples.en: Sustainable development implies a long-term perspective.
examples.zh: 可持续发展需要有长远眼光。

senses.def: not polite

examples.en: Some people think it is impolite to ask someone's age.
examples.zh: 有些人认为询问别人的年龄是不礼貌的。

senses.def: in a way that is not polite
behaviour or comments that are not polite
not wise

examples.en: It would have been impolitic to refuse his offer.
examples.zh: 当时若拒绝了他的好意就太不明智了。

senses.def: difficult to measure or understand
senses.zh: 难以衡量（或估量）的事物

examples.en: imponderable mysteries
examples.zh: 难以估量的奥秘

senses.def: something that is difficult to measure or estimate
senses.zh: 难以衡量（或估量）的事物

examples.en: We can't predict the outcome. There are too many imponderables.
examples.zh: 我们无法预测结果。难以逆料的情况太多了。

senses.def: a product or service that is brought into one country from another
senses.zh: 进口品；输入的产品（或服务）

examples.en: food imports from abroad
examples.zh: 从外国进口的食物

examples.en: cheap imports into the United States
examples.zh: 进口到美国的廉价商品

senses.def: the act of bringing a product or service into one country from another

examples.en: The report calls for a ban on the import of hazardous waste.
examples.zh: 这份报告呼吁禁止进口危险废弃物。

examples.en: imports of oil
examples.zh: 石油的进口

examples.en: import duties/tariffs
examples.zh: 进口关税

examples.en: import controls/restrictions/quotas
examples.zh: 进口管制／限制／配额

examples.en: an import licence
examples.zh: 进口许可证

examples.en: A restricted import quota was set for meat products.
examples.zh: 肉类产品有进口配额限制。

examples.en: the UK's net imports of food
examples.zh: 英国食品净进口

examples.en: Most of their oil revenues are used to finance imports of consumer and capital goods.
examples.zh: 他们的石油收益大多用于进口消费品和资本财货。

senses.def: importance

examples.zh: 非常重要的事情

examples.zh: 她并不想勉强家人接受自己的价值观。

examples.zh: 显而易见，有少数几个人设法把自己的意志强加于别人。

senses.zh: 坚不可摧的；牢不可破的

examples.zh: 坚不可摧的要塞

senses.zh: 不可战胜的；难以改变的

examples.zh: 这个队以 5:1 的绝对优势领先。

examples.zh: 我们面试了数名应聘者，但没有觉得哪一位特别出色。

examples.zh: 大峡谷总是给人们留下深刻的印象。

examples.zh: 大峡谷永远令人叹为观止。

examples.zh: 她记得我的名字，令我很佩服。

examples.zh: 他让我们认识到立刻采取行动的必要。

examples.zh: 他们在训练中深刻地感受到了他们的责任。

examples.zh: 她的话语我铭记在心里。

examples.zh: 他给我的第一印象不错。

examples.zh: 她给人的印象是特别忙。

examples.zh: 我并不觉得他们不满于当时的状况。

examples.zh: 给我的印象是一切都是匆忙完成的。

examples.zh: 依我看问题还是挺多的。

examples.zh: 尽量微笑。不要让人误以为你很冷漠。

examples.zh: 他不想给人一种进步的假象。

examples.zh: 如果你想给人留下好印象，我建议你穿西装。

examples.zh: 你如果真的想给人留下好印象，就得表现得更好一点。

examples.zh: 他的印度之行对他的触动很大。

examples.zh: 我的话丝毫没有对她起作用。

examples.zh: 整件事给玛格丽特留下了持久的印象。

examples.zh: 这位新来的球员没能立即为球队发挥作用。

examples.zh: 我认为这个论点没有给兄弟们留下任何印象。

examples.zh: 这些事件给所有目击者留下了不可磨灭的印象。

examples.zh: 那一刻的静止无声给来访者留下了深刻的印象。

examples.zh: 这是一位艺术家对未来新运动场作的印象画。

examples.zh: 我还以为已经完工了呢。

examples.zh: 士兵们四散奔逃，以为这是敌人的袭击。
