examples.zh: 我以为你要到明天才来呢。

intro.en: These words all mean to have an idea that something is true or possible or to have a particular opinion about somebody/​something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含以为、认为之义。

items.def: to have an idea that something is true or possible, although you are not completely certain; to have a particular opinion about somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指认为、以为某人／某事…但不肯定

examples.en: Do you think (that) they’ll come?
examples.zh: 你认为他们会来吗？

items.def: to have an idea that something is true or possible, although you are not completely certain; to have a particular opinion about somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指认为、以为某人／某事…但不肯定

examples.en: Police believe (that) the man may be armed.
examples.zh: 警方认为那个人可能携有武器。

items.def: to have a particular opinion about something that has happened or about what you/​somebody ought to do:
items.zh: 指认为（已发生的事情…）、相信（应该…）

examples.en: We all felt (that) we were unlucky to lose.
examples.zh: 我们都认为我们输了是运气不好。

items.def: (informal) to think that something is true or possible:
items.zh: 指认为、以为

examples.en: I reckon (that) I’m going to get that job.
examples.zh: 我认为我会得到那份工作。

items.def: to have an idea that something is true:
items.zh: 指以为某事…

examples.en: I was under the impression that the work had already been completed.
examples.zh: 我还以为已经完工了呢。

senses.def: easily influenced or affected by somebody/something

examples.en: children at an impressionable age
examples.zh: 处于易受外界影响的年龄的儿童

examples.en: He is in a highly impressionable state.
examples.zh: 他正处于极易受影响的状态。

examples.en: She was a bad influence on the child, who was at an impressionable age.
examples.zh: 她对处于易受影响年龄的孩子产生了不好的影响。

senses.def: a style in painting developed in France in the late 19th century that uses colour to show the effects of light on things and to suggest atmosphere rather than showing exact details
senses.zh: 印象主义，印象派（19 世纪下半叶兴起于法国的绘画风格，主要表现光与色的效果，不着眼于准确的细节）

senses.def: an artist who paints in the style of Impressionism

examples.en: Impressionists such as Monet and Pissarro
examples.zh: 莫奈和毕沙罗等的印象派画家

senses.def: a person who entertains people by copying the way a famous person speaks or behaves
senses.zh: 模仿演员（常模仿名人言行）

senses.def: in the style of Impressionism

examples.en: Impressionist landscapes
examples.zh: 印象派风景画

examples.en: an Impressionist artist
examples.zh: 印象派艺术家

senses.def: giving a general idea rather than particular facts or details
senses.zh: 给人以大致印象的；不精确的；凭印象的

senses.def: making you admire them, because they are very large, good, skilful
senses.zh: 令人赞叹的；令人敬佩的

examples.en: an impressive performance
examples.zh: 令人赞叹的演出

examples.en: an impressive array/list/collection
examples.zh: 令人印象深刻的数组/列表/集合

examples.en: an impressive display of skill
examples.zh: 给人深刻印象的技艺表演

examples.en: He has an impressive record of 63 wins from 71 fights.
examples.zh: 他在 71 场比赛中取得了 63 场胜利的骄人战绩。

examples.en: an impressive building with a huge tower
examples.zh: 有高塔的壮观建筑

examples.en: one of the most impressive novels of recent years
examples.zh: 近年来最出色的小说之一

examples.en: Several of the younger players also looked impressive.
examples.zh: 几位年轻球员的表现也令人印象深刻。

examples.en: She was very impressive in the interview.
examples.zh: 她在面试中表现得非常好。

senses.def: in a way that makes you admire somebody/something, because they are/it is very large, good, skilful
senses.zh: 令人赞叹的；令人敬佩的

examples.en: impressively high
examples.zh: 巍然高耸

examples.en: impressively organized
examples.zh: 安排得井井有条，令人折服

examples.en: This is an engaging and impressively researched book.
examples.zh: 这是一本引人入胜且研究令人印象深刻的书。

examples.en: He paused impressively (= to make an impression).
examples.zh: 他令人印象深刻地停了下来（=给人留下印象）。

senses.def: official approval of something, given by a person in a position of authority

examples.en: The project cannot go ahead without the imprimatur of the Treasury.
examples.zh: 如果没有财政部的批准，该项目就无法进行。

senses.def: to have a great effect on something so that it cannot be forgotten, changed, etc.
senses.zh: 产生重大影响；铭刻；使铭记

examples.en: The terrible scenes were indelibly imprinted on her mind.
examples.zh: 那些可怕的场景深深地印在了她的脑海里。

examples.en: He imprints his own personal style on his work.
examples.zh: 他在自己的作品中留下了自己的个人风格。

examples.en: His work is imprinted with his own personal style.
examples.zh: 他的作品带有他个人风格的印记。

senses.def: to print or press a mark or design onto a surface

examples.en: Their footprints were imprinted in the snow.
examples.zh: 他们的脚印印在雪地里。

examples.en: clothes imprinted with the logos of sports teams
examples.zh: 印着运动队标志的衣服

senses.def: a mark made by pressing something onto a surface

examples.en: the imprint of a foot in the sand
examples.zh: 沙滩上的足迹

examples.en: The blow made a sharp imprint on the skin.
examples.zh: 这一击在皮肤上留下了尖锐的印记。

senses.def: the lasting effect that a person or an experience has on a place or a situation

examples.en: Colonialism has left an indelible imprint on the island.
examples.zh: 殖民主义在岛上留下了不可磨灭的印记。

examples.en: The sinister atmosphere of the place left an indelible imprint on my memory.
examples.zh: 这个地方凶险的氛围让我终生难忘。

senses.def: the name of the publisher
senses.zh: 出版商名称（通常印在第一页的书名下面）

examples.en: They publish under several imprints.
examples.zh: 他们以几个出版商标识出版。

senses.def: to put somebody in a prison or another place from which they cannot escape

examples.en: They were imprisoned for a crime they didn't commit.
examples.zh: 他们因未犯下的罪行而被监禁。

examples.en: I feel imprisoned in my own home.
examples.zh: 我感觉自己被囚禁在自己的家里。

senses.def: the act of putting somebody in a prison or another place from which they cannot escape; the state of being there

examples.en: to be sentenced to life imprisonment for murder
examples.zh: 因谋杀罪被判终身监禁

senses.def: the fact of not being likely to be true or to happen; something that is not likely to be true or to happen
senses.zh: 不可能的事实：不可能真实存在或不可能发生的事实；不太可能是真实的或不可能出现的

examples.en: the improbability of finding them alive
examples.zh: 他们生还希望的渺茫

examples.en: statistical improbability
examples.zh: 统计学上的不可能性

senses.def: not likely to be true or to happen
senses.zh: 不大可能真实的（或发生的）；不大可能的

examples.en: an improbable story
examples.zh: 大概不是真实的故事

examples.en: It all sounded highly improbable.
examples.zh: 一切听上去很荒唐。

examples.en: It seems improbable that the current situation will continue.
examples.zh: 当前的局势似乎不大可能继续下去。

senses.def: seeming strange because it is not what you would expect

examples.en: Her hair was an improbable shade of yellow.
examples.zh: 她的头发带有怪怪的黄色。

senses.def: used for saying that something is not likely to be true or to happen
senses.zh: 不大可能真实的（或发生的）；不大可能的

examples.en: He claimed, improbably, that he had never been there.
examples.zh: 他声称他从来没有去过那里，这不大可能。

senses.def: in a way that is strange because it is not what you would expect

examples.en: an improbably happy ending
examples.zh: 牵强的圆满结局

senses.def: without preparation or planning
senses.zh: 无准备的；即兴的；即席的

examples.en: Roy came up and just started speaking impromptu.
examples.zh: 罗伊走过来，开始即兴讲话。

senses.def: done without preparation or planning
senses.zh: 无准备的；即兴的；即席的

examples.en: an impromptu speech
examples.zh: 即兴讲演

examples.en: They often held impromptu meetings in their house.
examples.zh: 他们经常在家里即兴聚会。

senses.def: dishonest, or morally wrong
senses.zh: 不诚实的；不正当的；不道德的

examples.en: He had been indulging in improper business practices.
examples.zh: 他一直参与不正当的商业活动。

examples.en: She was suspended for improper conduct.
examples.zh: 她因行为不当而被停职。

examples.en: There was nothing improper about our relationship (= it did not involve sex).
examples.zh: 我们的关系没有什么不正当的。

examples.en: places where it is considered improper for people to kiss in public
examples.zh: 人们认为不宜在公共场合接吻的地方

senses.def: not right or appropriate for the situation
senses.zh: 不合适的；不适当的；不得体的

examples.en: It would be improper to comment at this stage.
examples.zh: 在这个阶段发表评论并不恰当。

senses.def: wrong; not correct

examples.en: improper use of the term
examples.zh: 该术语的不当使用

senses.def: a fraction
in a way that is dishonest or morally wrong
senses.zh: 不当：不诚实或不道德的方式。

examples.en: to behave improperly
examples.zh: 行为不端

senses.def: in a way that is not right or appropriate for the situation
senses.zh: 不合时宜：以不正确或不适合该情况的方式

examples.en: He was improperly dressed for the occasion.
examples.zh: 他的衣着不适合该场合。

senses.def: in a way that is wrong and not correct
senses.zh: 以错误的方式，不正确的方式。

examples.en: improperly cooked meat
examples.zh: 烹调不当的肉

senses.def: behaviour or actions that are dishonest, morally wrong or not appropriate for a person in a position of responsibility
senses.zh: （身居要职者）不诚实（或不正当、不合适）的行为举止

examples.en: There was no evidence of impropriety.
examples.zh: 没有行为不当的证据。

examples.en: accusations of financial impropriety
examples.zh: 财务不当指控

examples.en: He said that he would resign his post if the public felt he had engaged in improprieties.
examples.zh: 他表示，如果公众认为他有不当行为，他将辞职。

senses.def: a type of performance, often involving comedy, that has not been scripted

examples.en: The pressure of 35 minutes of improv proves too much.
examples.zh: 事实证明，35 分钟的即兴表演压力太大了。

examples.en: Some of his former students have formed two new improv troupes in the city.
examples.zh: 他以前的一些学生在城里组建了两个新的即兴剧团。

senses.def: to become better than before; to make something/somebody better than before

examples.en: Overall the situation has improved dramatically.
examples.zh: 总的来说，情况改善了很多。

examples.en: Things are improving every day.
examples.zh: 情况每天都在改善。

examples.en: You should see your score improve significantly.
examples.zh: 你应该会看到你的分数显著提高。

examples.en: Working conditions have greatly improved.
examples.zh: 工作环境大有改善。

examples.en: His quality of life has improved dramatically since the operation.
examples.zh: 手术后他的生活质量大大改善了。

examples.en: The doctor says she should continue to improve (= after an illness).
examples.zh: 医生说她还会继续康复。

examples.en: I hope my French will improve when I go to France.
examples.zh: 我希望当我去法国时我的法语会有所提高。

examples.en: This vital service helps to improve the quality of life for people with cancer.
examples.zh: 这个极其重要的服务有助改善癌症患者的生活。

examples.en: measures to improve public health
examples.zh: 改善公共卫生的措施

examples.en: This was a much improved performance by the team.
examples.zh: 团队这次表现好多了。

examples.en: The goal was to improve the efficiency of the department.
examples.zh: 目标是提高部门的效率。

examples.en: Engineers are working to improve this technology.
examples.zh: 工程师们正在努力改进这项技术。

examples.en: He's a guy who wants to improve himself, to be the best.
examples.zh: 他是一个想改善自己、做到最好的人。

senses.def: showing signs of improvement

examples.en: The good news is that the weather is on the improve.
examples.zh: 好消息是天气正在好转。

senses.def: showing signs of improvement

examples.en: The good news is that the weather is on the improve.
examples.zh: 好消息是天气正在好转。

senses.def: to achieve or produce something that is of a better quality than something else
senses.zh: 改进；做出比…更好的成绩

examples.en: We've certainly improved on last year's figures.
examples.zh: 我们的业绩的确超过了去年的数字。

senses.def: to achieve or produce something that is of a better quality than something else
senses.zh: 改进；做出比…更好的成绩

examples.en: We've certainly improved on last year's figures.
examples.zh: 我们的业绩的确超过了去年的数字。

senses.def: the act of making something better; the process of something becoming better

examples.en: The economy has shown significant improvement over the past 9 months.
examples.zh: 过去 9 个月，经济大有改善。

examples.en: We expect to see further improvement over the coming year.
examples.zh: 我们期望来年会有更进一步的改善。

examples.en: Sales figures continue to show signs of improvement.
examples.zh: 销售额持续显示出增加的迹象。

examples.en: There were areas that needed improvement.
examples.zh: 有些领域需要改进。

examples.en: There is a need for continuous improvement in performance.
examples.zh: 需要不断改善表现。

examples.en: I think there is room for improvement in any organization.
examples.zh: 我认为任何组织都有改进的空间。

senses.def: a change in something that makes it better; something that is better than it was before

examples.en: a significant/dramatic improvement
examples.zh: 重大的／巨大的改进

examples.en: a slight/steady improvement
examples.zh: 轻微的／稳定的提升

examples.en: There has been a marked improvement in the quality of teaching.
examples.zh: 教学质量明显提高了。

examples.en: The work should lead to an improvement in water quality.
examples.zh: 这项工作应该会改善水质。

examples.en: The decade saw vast improvements in cardiology techniques.
examples.zh: 这十年见证了心脏病学技术的巨大进步。

examples.en: We have made some mechanical improvements to the car.
examples.zh: 我们对汽车做了一些机械上的改进。

examples.en: This is a great improvement on your previous work.
examples.zh: 你的工作比先前有很大进步。

examples.en: The results are certainly an improvement over last year.
examples.zh: 结果肯定比去年有所进步。

senses.def: the fact of tending to not think about or plan for the future or to spend money in a careless way
senses.zh: 不顾将来的；没有长远打算的；挥霍的；不节俭的

examples.en: the problems created by the king’s extravagance and improvidence
examples.zh: 国王的挥霍无度和缺乏远见造成的问题

senses.def: not thinking about or planning for the future; spending money in a careless way
senses.zh: 不顾将来的；没有长远打算的；挥霍的；不节俭的

senses.def: the act of inventing music, the words in a play, a statement, etc. while you are playing or speaking, instead of planning it in advance; something that is invented in this way
senses.zh: （音乐、台词、演讲词等的）即兴创作；即兴创作的音乐（或台词、演讲词等）

examples.en: jazz improvisation
examples.zh: 爵士乐即兴演奏

senses.def: to make or do something using whatever is available, usually because you do not have what you really need

examples.en: There isn't much equipment. We're going to have to improvise.
examples.zh: 设备不多，我们只能将就着用。

examples.en: We improvised some shelves out of planks of wood and bricks.
examples.zh: 我们用木板和砖头临时搭了些架子。

examples.en: We hastily improvised a screen out of an old blanket.
examples.zh: 我们连忙用一条旧毯子临时搭了个屏风。

examples.en: You can quickly improvise a shield to protect your arm.
examples.zh: 你可以快速找一样物品来当作盾牌护住手臂。

senses.def: to invent music, the words in a play, a statement, etc. while you are playing or speaking, instead of planning it in advance
senses.zh: 即兴创作（音乐、台词、演讲词等）

examples.en: ‘It'll be ready some time next week, I expect,’ she said, improvising.
examples.zh: “我估计下个星期内会准备好的。”她随口说道。

examples.en: He improvised on the melody.
examples.zh: 他即兴演奏了那首曲子。

examples.en: an improvised speech
examples.zh: 即席讲演

senses.def: a bomb made and used by people who are not members of the military forces of a country
senses.zh: 简易爆炸装置，土制炸弹（全写为 improvised explosive device）

examples.en: An improvised explosive device was triggered at a checkpoint, injuring two soldiers.
examples.zh: 一个简易爆炸装置在一个检查站被引爆，造成两名士兵受伤。

senses.def: the fact of not being wise or sensible
not wise or sensible

examples.en: It would be imprudent to invest all your money in one company.
examples.zh: 把所有的钱都投资在一家公司是不明智的。

senses.def: in a way that is not wise or sensible
rude behaviour; behaviour that does not show respect for other people
senses.zh: 无礼：粗鲁的举止；不尊重他人的行为

examples.en: I’ve had enough of your impudence, young lady.
examples.zh: 我已经受够了你的无礼，年轻的女士。

examples.en: He had the impudence to correct me.
examples.zh: 他居然厚颜无耻地纠正我。

senses.def: rude; not showing respect for other people

examples.en: an impudent young fellow
examples.zh: 莽撞的年轻人

examples.en: an impudent remark
examples.zh: 粗鲁的话

senses.def: to express doubts about whether something is right, honest, etc.

examples.en: There were no real grounds for impugning the decision.
examples.zh: 没有真正的理由质疑这一决定。

senses.def: a sudden strong wish or need to do something, without stopping to think about the results
senses.zh: 冲动；心血来潮；一时的念头

examples.en: He had a sudden impulse to stand up and sing.
examples.zh: 他突然心血来潮，想站起来唱歌。

examples.en: I resisted the impulse to laugh.
examples.zh: 我强忍着没有笑出来。

examples.en: Her first impulse was to run away.
examples.zh: 她的第一个念头就是逃走。

examples.en: The door was open and on (an) impulse she went inside.
examples.zh: 门开着，她一时心血来潮就走了进去。

examples.en: He tends to act on impulse.
examples.zh: 他往往凭一时冲动行事。

senses.def: a force or movement of energy that causes something else to react

examples.en: nerve/electrical impulses
examples.zh: 神经冲动；电路脉冲

examples.en: The impulse is conducted along the length of the wire.
examples.zh: 脉冲沿着电线的长度传导。

senses.def: something that causes somebody/something to do something or to develop and make progress

examples.en: to give an impulse to the struggling car industry
examples.zh: 给予挣扎中的汽车工业一点刺激

examples.en: He was motivated by the impulse for social reform.
examples.zh: 他的动力来自于社会改革的冲动。

senses.def: something that you buy without planning to do so in advance, and without thinking about it carefully

examples.en: It was an impulse buy.
examples.zh: 这是一时心血来潮买的。

examples.en: Vending machine purchases are often impulse buys.
examples.zh: 自动售货机购买通常是冲动购买。

senses.def: buying goods without planning to do so in advance, and without thinking about it carefully
a strong desire to do something
a reason for doing something

examples.en: The impulsion for launching the case against her looks very politicized.
examples.zh: 对她提起诉讼的冲动看起来非常政治化。

senses.def: acting suddenly without thinking carefully about what might happen because of what you are doing
senses.zh: 凭冲动行事的；易冲动的

examples.en: an impulsive decision/gesture
examples.zh: 冲动的决定／姿态

examples.en: You're so impulsive!
examples.zh: 你太冲动了！

examples.en: He has an impulsive nature.
examples.zh: 他生性冲动。

examples.en: He told me not to be impulsive but to think it over.
examples.zh: 他告诉我不要凭冲动行事，而是要仔细考虑一下。

senses.def: suddenly, without thinking carefully about what might happen because of what you are doing
senses.zh: 凭冲动行事的；易冲动的

examples.en: Impulsively he reached out and took her hand.
examples.zh: 他一时冲动，伸手握住了她的手。

senses.def: the fact of tending to act suddenly without thinking carefully about what might happen because of what you are doing
senses.zh: 凭冲动行事的；易冲动的

senses.def: the fact of not getting punished for something

examples.en: They continue to break the law with impunity.
examples.zh: 他们继续违法而不受惩罚。

examples.en: Those involved in such attacks often enjoy complete impunity.
examples.zh: 参与此类袭击的人往往完全有罪不罚。

senses.def: not pure or clean; not consisting of only one substance but mixed with one or more substances often of poorer quality
senses.zh: 不纯的；不洁的；有杂质的

examples.en: impure gold
examples.zh: 不纯的金子

examples.en: ailments that arise due to poor sanitation and impure drinking water
examples.zh: 由于卫生条件差和饮用水不纯净而引起的疾病

senses.def: morally bad, especially because they are connected with sex
senses.zh: 道德败坏的；（尤指）淫乱的

examples.en: impure thoughts/motives
examples.zh: 不纯洁的想法/动机

senses.def: a substance that is present in small amounts in another substance, making it dirty or of poor quality

examples.en: A filter will remove most impurities found in water.
examples.zh: 过滤器会滤掉水中的大部分杂质。

examples.en: The substance is free of impurities.
examples.zh: 该物质不含杂质​​。

examples.en: The water contains impurities which make it unsuitable for drinking.
examples.zh: 水里含有杂质，不适合饮用。

senses.def: the state of being dirty or not pure
a statement in which you say, often unfairly, that somebody is responsible for something or has a particular quality
senses.zh: （常指不公正地把责任等）归咎于

examples.en: He denied the imputation.
examples.zh: 他否认了这种指责。

senses.def: to say, often unfairly, that somebody is responsible for something or has a particular quality
senses.zh: （常指不公正地把责任等）归咎于

examples.en: I denied the motives that my employer was imputing to me.
examples.zh: 雇主把责任归咎于我，我否认有那样的动机。

senses.def: at a point within an area or a space
senses.zh: 在（某范围或空间内的）某一点

examples.en: a country in Africa
examples.zh: 非洲的一个国家

examples.en: The kids were playing in the street.
examples.zh: 孩子们在街上玩。

examples.en: It's in that drawer.
examples.zh: 它放在那个抽屉里。

examples.en: I read about it in the paper.
examples.zh: 我是在报纸上读到这事的。

senses.def: within the shape of something; surrounded by something
senses.zh: 在（某物的形体或范围）中；在…内；在…中

examples.en: She was lying in bed.
examples.zh: 她躺在床上。

examples.en: sitting in an armchair
examples.zh: 坐在扶手椅里

examples.en: Leave the key in the lock.
examples.zh: 把钥匙留在锁孔里。

examples.en: Soak it in cold water.
examples.zh: 把这东西浸泡在冷水里。

senses.def: into something

examples.en: He dipped his brush in the paint.
examples.zh: 他把毛刷在涂料里蘸了蘸。

examples.en: She got in her car and drove off.
examples.zh: 她钻进汽车里，开走了。

senses.def: forming the whole or part of something/somebody; contained within something/somebody
senses.zh: 构成…的整体（或部分）；包含在…之内

examples.en: There are 31 days in May.
examples.zh: 五月份有 31 天。

examples.en: all the paintings in the collection
examples.zh: 收藏品中的所有画作

examples.en: I recognize his father in him (= his character is similar to his father's).
examples.zh: 我在他身上看到了他父亲的气质。

senses.def: during a period of time

examples.en: in 2021
in the 18th century
examples.zh: 在 18 世纪

examples.en: in spring/summer/autumn/winter
examples.zh: 在春天／夏天／秋天／冬天

examples.en: in the fall
examples.zh: 在秋天

examples.en: in March
examples.zh: 在三月

examples.en: in the morning/afternoon/evening
examples.zh: 在上午／下午／晚上

examples.en: I'm getting forgetful in my old age.
examples.zh: 我现在上了年纪，变得健忘了。

senses.def: after a particular length of time

examples.en: to return in a few minutes/hours/days/months.
examples.zh: 几分钟／几小时／几天／几个月后回来

examples.en: It will be ready in a week's time (= one week from now).
examples.zh: 只需一周的时间就会准备好。

examples.en: She learnt to drive in three weeks (= after three weeks she could drive).
examples.zh: 她花了三个星期就学会开车。

senses.def: for a particular period of time

examples.en: I haven't seen him in years.
examples.zh: 我有好些年没见过他了。

examples.en: It's the first letter I've had in ten days.
examples.zh: 这是我十天来收到的第一封信。

senses.def: wearing something

examples.en: dressed in their best clothes
examples.zh: 穿着他们最好的衣服

examples.en: the man in the hat
examples.zh: 戴帽子的男子

examples.en: to be in uniform
examples.zh: 穿着制服

examples.en: She was all in black.
examples.zh: 她穿着一身黑。

senses.def: used to describe something that is all around you

examples.en: We went out in the rain.
examples.zh: 我们冒雨出去了。

examples.en: He was sitting alone in the darkness.
examples.zh: 他独自坐在黑暗中。

senses.def: used to show the language, material, etc. used

examples.en: Say it in English.
examples.zh: 用英语说吧。

examples.en: She wrote in pencil.
examples.zh: 她用铅笔写的。

examples.en: Put it in writing.
examples.zh: 把它写下来。

examples.en: I paid in cash.
examples.zh: 我用现金支付。

examples.en: He spoke in a loud voice.
examples.zh: 他大声说话。

senses.def: used to show a state or condition

examples.en: I'm in love!
examples.zh: 我恋爱了！

examples.en: The house is in good repair.
examples.zh: 这所房子保养得不错。

examples.en: I must put my affairs in order.
examples.zh: 我必须整理整理我的事务。

examples.en: a man in his thirties
examples.zh: 一名三十多岁的男子

examples.en: The daffodils were in full bloom.
examples.zh: 水仙花正盛开。

senses.def: involved in something; taking part in something

examples.en: to act in a play
examples.zh: 参加演戏

senses.def: used to show somebody’s job or profession

examples.en: He is in the army.
examples.zh: 他在军队服役。

examples.en: She's in computers.
examples.zh: 她从事计算机业。

examples.en: in business
examples.zh: 从商

senses.def: used to show the form, shape, arrangement or quantity of something
senses.zh: （显示某物的形式、形状、安排或数量）

examples.en: a novel in three parts
examples.zh: 分为三部的小说

examples.en: Roll it up in a ball.
examples.zh: 把它卷成一个球。

examples.en: They sat in rows.
examples.zh: 他们一排一排地坐着。

examples.en: People flocked in their thousands to see her.
examples.zh: 现场聚集了数以千计的人争相一睹她的风采。

senses.def: used to show the quality or thing that a judgement is being made about

examples.en: She was not lacking in courage.
examples.zh: 她并不缺乏勇气。

examples.en: a country rich in minerals
examples.zh: 矿藏丰富的国家

examples.en: three metres in length
examples.zh: 三米长

senses.def: while doing something; while something is happening

examples.en: In attempting to save the child from drowning, she nearly lost her own life.
examples.zh: 她在抢救落水的儿童时，自己差点丧命。

examples.en: In all the commotion I forgot to tell him the news.
examples.zh: 在一阵混乱之中我忘了告诉他那个消息。

senses.def: used to introduce the name of a person who has a particular quality
senses.zh: （引出具某种品质的人的名字）

examples.en: We're losing a first-rate editor in Jen.
examples.zh: 我们即将失去珍这位一流的编辑。

senses.def: used to show a rate or relative amount

examples.en: a gradient of one in five
examples.zh: 五分之一的坡度

examples.en: a tax rate of 22 pence in the pound
examples.zh: 每英镑 22 便士的税率

senses.def: for the reason that; because

examples.en: She was fortunate in that she had friends to help her.
examples.zh: 她很幸运，有一些朋友帮助她。

senses.def: into an object, an area or a substance

examples.en: She opened the door and went in.
examples.zh: 她打开门进去了。

examples.en: The kids were playing by the river and one of them fell in.
examples.zh: 孩子们在河边玩耍时，其中一个落水了。

senses.def: contained within an object, an area or a substance

examples.en: We were locked in.
examples.zh: 我们被锁在里面了。

examples.en: I can't drink coffee with milk in.
examples.zh: 我不能喝加牛奶的咖啡。

senses.def: at home or at a place of work

examples.en: Nobody was in when we called.
examples.zh: 我们打电话过去时没有人在。

examples.en: I didn't hear you come in.
examples.zh: 我没听到你进来。

senses.def: at the place where people can get on or off, for example the station

examples.en: The bus is due in (= it should arrive) at six.
examples.zh: 公共汽车应该在六点钟到站。

senses.def: received

examples.en: Applications must be in by April 30.
examples.zh: 申请务必于 4 月 30 日之前寄到。

senses.def: at or towards its highest point on land

examples.en: Is the tide coming in or going out?
examples.zh: 是在涨潮还是在落潮？

senses.def: elected

examples.en: Several new councillors got in at the last election.
examples.zh: 几位新政务委员在最近一轮选举中当选。

senses.def: if a team or team member is in

examples.en: Her serve was just in.
examples.zh: 她发的球刚好落在界内。

examples.en: The ball landed in.
examples.zh: 球落地了。

senses.def: to be present when something happens

examples.en: They were in at the start.
examples.zh: 开始时他们在场。

senses.def: to be going to experience something soon, especially something unpleasant
senses.zh: 即将经历，即将遭受（不愉快的事）

examples.en: He's in for a shock!
examples.zh: 他很快就会感到震惊的！

examples.en: I'm afraid we're in for a storm.
examples.zh: 看来我们就要遇到暴风雨了。

senses.def: to be/become involved in something; to share or know about something

examples.en: I'd like to be in on the plan.
examples.zh: 我很想参与这项计划。

examples.en: Is she in on the secret?
examples.zh: 她知道这个秘密吗？

senses.def: to be (very) friendly with somebody, and likely to get an advantage from the friendship
senses.zh: 和…（十分）友好（很可能从中得到好处）

senses.def: going regularly to a place

examples.en: He was in and out of jail for most of his life.
examples.zh: 他大半生的时间都是监狱的常客。

senses.def: popular and fashionable

examples.en: Purple is the in colour this spring.
examples.zh: 紫色是今年春天的流行色。

examples.en: Exotic pets are the in thing right now.
examples.zh: 奇异的宠物眼下很时髦。

examples.en: Short skirts are in again.
examples.zh: 现在又时兴穿短裙了。

senses.def: to have influence with somebody
all the details, especially the complicated or difficult ones
senses.zh: （尤指复杂或难的）全部细节，详情

examples.en: the ins and outs of the problem
examples.zh: 问题的来龙去脉

examples.en: He quickly learned the ins and outs of the job.
examples.zh: 他很快就掌握了工作的全部诀窍。

senses.def: something that allows you to join a group of people, an industry, etc. that it is difficult to join, or to understand something that it is difficult to understand
senses.zh: （加入难以进入的群体、行业等的）敲门砖；（弄懂难以理解的事物的）窍门，诀窍

senses.def: inch

examples.en: Height: 6ft 2in.
examples.zh: 高：6 英尺 2 英寸。

examples.zh: 无限的

examples.zh: 不合逻辑的

examples.en: immorally
examples.zh: 不道德地

examples.en: irrelevance
examples.zh: 不相关

examples.zh: 使愤怒

examples.en: imperil
examples.zh: 使陷于危险

examples.en: a sit-in
examples.zh: 静坐示威

examples.en: a teach-in
examples.zh: 研讨会

examples.zh: 她很幸运，有一些朋友帮助她。

examples.zh: 开始时他们在场。

examples.zh: 他很快就会感到震惊的！

examples.en: I'm afraid we're in for a storm.
examples.zh: 看来我们就要遇到暴风雨了。

senses.def: to be/become involved in something; to share or know about something

examples.zh: 我很想参与这项计划。

examples.en: Is she in on the secret?
examples.zh: 她知道这个秘密吗？

senses.def: to be (very) friendly with somebody, and likely to get an advantage from the friendship
senses.zh: 和…（十分）友好（很可能从中得到好处）

senses.def: going regularly to a place

examples.en: He was in and out of jail for most of his life.
examples.zh: 他大半生的时间都是监狱的常客。

senses.def: to have influence with somebody
all the details, especially the complicated or difficult ones
senses.zh: （尤指复杂或难的）全部细节，详情

examples.en: the ins and outs of the problem
examples.zh: 问题的来龙去脉

examples.en: He quickly learned the ins and outs of the job.
examples.zh: 他很快就掌握了工作的全部诀窍。

senses.def: something that allows you to join a group of people, an industry, etc. that it is difficult to join, or to understand something that it is difficult to understand
senses.zh: （加入难以进入的群体、行业等的）敲门砖；（弄懂难以理解的事物的）窍门，诀窍

senses.def: in a position that forms a straight line with something

examples.en: An eclipse happens when the earth and moon are in line with the sun.
examples.zh: 地球和月亮与太阳处在一条直线上就会发生日食或月食。

senses.def: in a particular way

examples.en: How could they behave in such a fashion?
examples.zh: 他们的态度怎么会这样呢？

examples.en: I strive to get my work done in a timely fashion.
examples.zh: 我努力按时完成工作。

examples.en: The troops embarked in an orderly fashion.
examples.zh: 部队井然有序地登船。

examples.en: Each chapter is structured in a similar fashion.
examples.zh: 每一章的结构都很相似。

examples.en: She was proved right, in dramatic fashion, when the whole department resigned.
examples.zh: 整个部门的人都辞了职，戏剧性地证明她是对的。

senses.def: used to give extra details about something that has just been mentioned

examples.en: I used to live in France; in fact, not far from where you're going.
examples.zh: 我曾在法国住过；确切地说，离你要去的地方不远。

senses.def: used to emphasize a statement, especially one that is the opposite of what has just been mentioned
senses.zh: （用以强调，尤其与刚提到的相反）事实上，实际上

examples.en: I thought the work would be difficult. In actual fact, it's very easy.
examples.zh: 我原以为这工作会很难，事实上却很容易。

senses.def: used to introduce a statement that defends somebody who has just been criticized, or that explains another statement that may seem unreasonable
senses.zh: 要公正对待，不能怪（某人）

examples.en: In all fairness to him, he did try to stop her leaving.
examples.zh: 不能怪他，他确实曾设法阻止她离开。

examples.en: I have in fairness to say that, as yet, there is no hard evidence to support these charges.
examples.zh: 我必须公平地说，到目前为止，还没有确凿的证据支持这些指控。

examples.en: In all fairness to him, I should say that most of his story is true.
examples.zh: 公平地讲，应该说他所叙述的大部份是真实的。

senses.def: used to state a fact or an opinion that, though true, may seem disappointing

examples.en: The book isn't, in all honesty, as good as I expected.
examples.zh: 说实话，这本书并没有我预期的那么好。

examples.en: In all honesty, the book was not as good as I expected.
examples.zh: 说实话，这本书不像我期待的那么好。

examples.en: Who in honesty can blame her?
examples.zh: 说实在的谁能责怪她？

senses.def: believing your actions to be fair
senses.zh: （认为行为）公正地，公平地，凭良心

examples.en: We cannot in all conscience refuse to help.
examples.zh: 凭良心我们不能拒绝去帮助别人。

senses.def: in serious trouble

examples.en: If they don't win today, the team is in deep doo-doo.
examples.zh: 今天要是输了比赛，这个队可就惨了。

senses.def: with the flowers fully open

examples.en: The roses were in full bloom.
examples.zh: 玫瑰花盛开。

examples.en: He loved watching the garden come into bloom.
examples.zh: 他喜欢看花园里鲜花盛开。

examples.en: daffodils in bloom
examples.zh: 盛开的水仙花

senses.def: containing more water and flowing more strongly than usual

examples.en: After heavy rain, the river was in spate.
examples.zh: 大雨过后，河水暴涨。

examples.en: Celia was in full spate (= completely involved in talking and not likely to stop or able to be interrupted).
examples.zh: 西莉亚口若悬河，滔滔不绝。

senses.def: in good condition or order
senses.zh: 状态良好；健康极佳；井然有序

examples.en: He keeps in trim by running every day.
examples.zh: 他每天跑步保持身体健康。

examples.en: The team need to get in trim for the coming season.
examples.zh: 这个球队需要为下个赛季做好准备。

senses.def: in an impressive way

examples.en: She always celebrates her birthday in style.
examples.zh: 她的生日总是过得很排场。

examples.en: He won the championship in great style.
examples.zh: 他赢得了冠军，尽显大将风度。

senses.def: so soon or so quickly that it is surprising
senses.zh: 短暂（或快）得令人吃惊；立刻；马上；一会儿

examples.en: The kids will be leaving home in no time.
examples.zh: 孩子们很快就要离开家了。

senses.def: controlled or strongly influenced by somebody/something

examples.en: His gaze held her in thrall.
examples.zh: 他的目光让她着迷。

examples.en: She was in thrall to her emotions.
examples.zh: 她被自己的情绪所束缚。

in (somebody’s/something’s) thrall | in.word: in (somebody’s/something’s) thrall | in thrall to somebody/something

senses.def: added together as a total or single amount

examples.en: Businesses are, in the aggregate, deeper in debt than ever before.
examples.zh: 总的来说，企业的债务负担比以往任何时候都要沉重。

senses.def: instead of somebody/something

examples.en: You can use milk in place of cream in this recipe.
examples.zh: 这道食谱可以用牛奶代替奶油。

examples.en: He was unable to come to the ceremony, but he sent his son to accept the award in his place.
examples.zh: 他不能亲自来参加仪式，但派了他儿子前来代他领奖。

in (the) place of somebody/something | i.word: in (the) place of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s place

senses.def: wearing a shirt without a jacket, etc. on top of it

examples.en: It was a hot day and most of the men were in shirtsleeves.
examples.zh: 这一天天很热，大多数男子只穿着衬衫。

senses.def: very confused, worried or excited
senses.zh: 晕头转向；急得团团转；十分激动

examples.en: Her resignation put her colleagues in a spin.
examples.zh: 她的辞职令同事们摸不着头脑。

senses.def: in a difficult situation

examples.en: The captain's knee injury leaves the team in a tight corner.
examples.zh: 队长的膝盖受伤使球队陷入困境。

examples.en: She’ll always help if you’re in a tight spot.
examples.zh: 如果你遇到困难，她总是会提供帮助。

examples.en: This could put the banks in a corner.
examples.zh: 这可能会让银行陷入困境。

examples.zh: 如果你有困难，她总是会帮助你。

senses.def: on a large/small scale

examples.en: The new delivery service has taken off in a big way.
examples.zh: 新的递送服务迅速走红。

examples.en: Many people are investing in a small way in the stock market.
examples.zh: 许多人都在小量地向证券市场投资。

examples.en: He then started spending money in a big way.
examples.zh: 他那时开始大把地花钱。

examples.zh: 自从听到那消息，我一直茫然不知所措。

senses.def: if you see something or put something in a good, bad, etc. light
senses.zh: 从好（或坏、有利等）的角度
