examples.zh: 你切切不要从负面的角度来看待发生的事。

examples.en: They want to present their policies in the best possible light.
examples.zh: 他们想尽可能从好的方面来介绍他们的政策。

in a good, bad, favourable, etc. light.word: in a good, bad, favourable, etc. light

senses.def: very quickly, without thinking about it

examples.en: If I was offered another job, I'd leave in a heartbeat.
examples.zh: 如果能找到另外一份工作，我马上就走。

senses.def: in a difficult situation

examples.en: He had got himself into a hole and it was going to be difficult to get out of it.
examples.zh: 他使自己陷入了困境，难以摆脱。

senses.def: in a bad mood, especially because somebody has annoyed or upset you

examples.en: She went off in a huff.
examples.zh: 她怒气冲冲地走了。

senses.def: very quickly or more quickly than usual

examples.en: He had to leave in a hurry.
examples.zh: 他不得不赶快离开了。

senses.def: not having enough time to do something

examples.en: Sorry, I haven't got time to do it now—I'm in a hurry.
examples.zh: 对不起，我现在没时间做这个，我忙着呢。

examples.en: Alice was in a tearing hurry as usual.
examples.zh: 艾丽斯一如往常地来去匆匆。

examples.en: I was late for work and in a big hurry.
examples.zh: 我上班迟了，心急火燎。

senses.def: impatient to do something

examples.en: My daughter is in such a hurry to grow up.
examples.zh: 我女儿恨不得一下子就长大。

examples.en: Why are you in such a hurry to sell?
examples.zh: 你为什么如此迫不及待地要卖出？

examples.en: They were in a hurry to set off.
examples.zh: 他们急着要启程。

in a hurry to do something.word: in a hurry to do something

senses.def: in a nervous, angry or excited state

examples.en: Dad was in a right lather about something.
examples.zh: 爸爸因为某件事而大发雷霆。

senses.def: if you think about it in a particular way; true in some but not all ways
senses.zh: 可以说；不妨说；从某种意义上说

examples.en: All these points of view are related, in a manner of speaking.
examples.zh: 所有这些观点都在某方面相互关联。

senses.def: in a difficult or unpleasant situation
if something happens several times in a row

examples.en: This is her third win in a row.
examples.zh: 这是她连续获得的第三次胜利。

senses.def: if something happens for several days, etc. in a row

examples.en: Inflation has fallen for the third month in a row.
examples.zh: 通货膨胀率连续第三个月在下降。

examples.en: It rained for five days in a row.
examples.zh: 雨一连下了 5 天。

in a single go: @@@LINK=at/in a single go | at a/one go
in a spot: @@@LINK=in a (tight) spot | in a tight corner

senses.def: (in the Roman Catholic Church) having been forgiven by God for the wrong or evil things you have done
senses.zh: （天主教指灵魂上没有大罪的状态）受天主眷爱，蒙受恩宠

examples.en: He died in a state of grace.
examples.zh: 他死的时候灵魂得到了宽恕。

in a tight corner: @@@LINK=in a (tight) spot | in a tight corner
in a tight spot: @@@LINK=in a (tight) spot | in a tight corner

senses.def: very quickly or suddenly
senses.zh: 转眼之间；弹指一挥间；瞬息间

examples.en: He was gone in a trice.
examples.zh: 转眼之间他就没影儿了。

senses.def: existing separately from other people, events, etc. when there should be a connection

examples.en: This kind of decision cannot ever be made in a vacuum.
examples.zh: 这种决定绝不能脱离实际。

in a way: @@@LINK=in a way | in one way | in some ways

senses.def: to some extent; not completely
senses.zh: 在某种程度上；不完全地

examples.en: In a way it was one of our biggest mistakes.
examples.zh: 从某种意义上来说，这是我们所犯的最大错误之一。

in a way | in one way | in some ways.word: in a way | in one way | in some ways

senses.def: used for giving a very short, usually negative, answer or comment

examples.en: ‘Would you like to help us?’ ‘In a word, no.’
examples.zh: “你愿意帮助我们吗？”“一句话，不愿意。”

in a world of your own: @@@LINK=(be/live) in a world of your own

senses.def: not being used, or being stopped for a period of time
senses.zh: 搁置；暂停使用；暂时中止

examples.en: Legal proceedings are in abeyance, while further enquiries are made.
examples.zh: 法律诉讼程序已暂停，同时正在进行进一步调查。

senses.def: in large quantities

examples.en: Fruit and vegetables grew in abundance on the island.
examples.zh: 该岛盛产水果和蔬菜。

examples.en: Exotic plants grew there in great abundance.
examples.zh: 那里生长着大量奇花异草。

senses.def: in agreement with

examples.en: This action would not be in accord with our policy.
examples.zh: 这一行动不会符合我们的方针。

examples.en: Botanists are not in complete accord about how many species exist.
examples.zh: 植物学家对总共存在多少物种的看法并不完全一致。

senses.def: according to a rule or the way that somebody says that something should be done

examples.en: in accordance with legal requirements
examples.zh: 根据法律要求

examples.en: We acted in accordance with my parents’ wishes.
examples.zh: 我们按照父母的意愿行事。

senses.def: if somebody/something is in action

examples.en: Just press the button to see your favourite character in action.
examples.zh: 只要按一下按键就可以看到你最喜欢的角色表演。

examples.en: I've yet to see all the players in action.
examples.zh: 我还得看所有参赛者的实地比赛。

examples.en: I have not yet seen the machines in action.
examples.zh: 我还没有见过这些机器运转。

senses.def: used when you want to mention another person or thing after something else

examples.en: In addition to these arrangements, extra ambulances will be on duty until midnight.
examples.zh: 除了这些安排以外，另增救护车值班至午夜。

examples.en: There is, in addition, one further point to make.
examples.zh: 此外，还有一点要说。

senses.def: before the time that is expected; before something happens

examples.en: a week/month/year in advance
examples.zh: 提前一星期／一个月／一年

examples.en: The rent is due one month in advance.
examples.zh: 租金预先一个月支付。

examples.en: Thanks in advance for your help.
examples.zh: 提前对您的帮助表示感谢。

examples.en: We try to plan well in advance.
examples.zh: 我们尝试提前做好计划。

examples.en: It would have helped to know in advance that you were coming.
examples.zh: 提前知道你要来会很有帮助。

examples.en: The fee is payable in advance.
examples.zh: 这项费用可以预付。

examples.en: People were evacuated from the coastal regions in advance of the hurricane.
examples.zh: 飓风袭来之前，沿海地带的人已经撤离。

senses.def: more developed than somebody/something else

examples.en: Galileo's ideas were well in advance of the age in which he lived.
examples.zh: 伽利略的思想远远超越了他所处的时代。

senses.def: in order to help something/somebody
senses.zh: 为了辅助某事物／帮助某人

examples.en: collecting money in aid of charity
examples.zh: 为资助慈善事业的募捐

senses.def: as a total

examples.en: There were twelve of us in all for dinner.
examples.zh: 我们一共十二人吃饭。

examples.en: That's £25.40 in all.
examples.zh: 总计 25.40 英镑。

senses.def: used to describe a situation which exists in reality but that is not officially recognized
senses.zh: （表示实际存在但未得到正式认可）在只缺正式名分的情况下

examples.en: He runs the company in all but name.
examples.zh: 他虽没有名分，却实际上在管理这家公司。

senses.def: without knowing that something is likely to offend or upset somebody
senses.zh: 不知情地（并非有意冒犯）

examples.en: I asked if she was married in all innocence.
examples.zh: 我不知就里，所以才问她是否已婚。

senses.def: used when you are very surprised at something you have never heard or seen before
senses.zh: （表示惊讶）这辈子（未听说，未见）

examples.en: I've never heard such nonsense in all my born days.
examples.zh: 我这辈子还从没听说过此等废话呢。

senses.def: it is very likely that

examples.en: In all probability he failed to understand the consequences of his actions.
examples.zh: 他很可能未了解到行动的后果。

examples.en: In all probability she wouldn't come even if we invited her.
examples.zh: 即使我们邀请她，她十有八九也不会来。

senses.def: very seriously; not as a joke
senses.zh: 非常严肃地；认认真真地；说实在的

examples.en: He told us in all seriousness that he was going to join a circus.
examples.zh: 他严肃地告诉我们他要参加马戏团。

examples.en: You can't in all seriousness think they'll give you the job!
examples.zh: 别真以为他们会给你这份工作！

senses.def: in all kinds of weather, good and bad
senses.zh: 不论天气好坏；风雨无阻

examples.en: She goes out jogging in all weathers.
examples.zh: 无论天气好坏，她都出去慢跑锻炼。

examples.en: The lifeboat crews go out in all weather(s).
examples.zh: 救生船人员在任何天气情况下都出动救援。

senses.def: used to say that something is what you would like to happen or what should happen, but you know it cannot

examples.en: In an ideal world we would be recycling and reusing everything.
examples.zh: 我们要是能回收并再利用所有的东西就再理想不过了。

senses.def: in a quiet voice

examples.en: ‘I must leave now,’ he said in an undertone.
examples.zh: “我得走了。”他小声说。

examples.en: The couple at the next table were speaking in undertones.
examples.zh: 邻桌的夫妇在轻声交谈。

senses.def: going regularly to a place

examples.en: He was in and out of jail for most of his life.
examples.zh: 他大半生的时间都是监狱的常客。

senses.def: of any type

examples.en: I don't approve of violence in any shape or form.
examples.zh: 我不赞成任何形式的暴力行为。

examples.en: I can't stand insects in any shape or form.
examples.zh: 无论什么样的昆虫我都很害怕。

examples.en: I do not condone bullying in any way, shape or form.
examples.zh: 我不容忍任何方式、形式或形式的欺凌行为。

senses.def: whatever happens or may have happened

examples.en: There's no point complaining now—we're leaving tomorrow in any case.
examples.zh: 现在抱怨毫无意义，不管怎样我们明天都要离开。

senses.def: used to emphasize or show that something is true or will happen despite other circumstances

examples.en: I think she'll agree to do it but in any event, all she can say is ‘no’.
examples.zh: 我想她会同意做的，但无论怎样，她只能说“不”。

examples.en: I think the economy will recover in any event.
examples.zh: 我认为经济无论如何都会复苏的。

in any event | at all events.word: in any event | at all events

senses.def: if money or a person is paid in arrears

examples.en: You will be paid monthly in arrears.
examples.zh: 你的工资将按月后付。

senses.def: knowing that what you are doing is wrong

examples.en: They had entered into the contract in bad faith.
examples.zh: 他们是恶意签订合同的。

in bad repair: @@@LINK=in good, bad, etc. repair | in a good, bad, etc. state of repair
in bad worst possible taste: @@@LINK=be in bad, poor, the worst possible, etc. taste

senses.def: used to refer to sexual activity

examples.en: What's he like in bed?
examples.zh: 他的床上功夫怎么样？

examples.en: I caught them in bed together (= having sex).
examples.zh: 我撞见他们睡在一起。

in behalf: @@@LINK=in behalf of somebody | in somebody’s behalf
in behalf of: @@@LINK=in behalf of somebody | in somebody’s behalf
in behalf of sb: @@@LINK=in behalf of somebody | in somebody’s behalf
in behalf of somebody: @@@LINK=in behalf of somebody | in somebody’s behalf

senses.def: in order to help somebody

examples.en: He began a petition in behalf of the farmers.
examples.zh: 他开始为了帮助农民而请愿。

in behalf of somebody | in somebody’s be.word: in behalf of somebody | in somebody’s behalf

senses.def: in a few words, without details

examples.en: In brief, the meeting was a disaster.
examples.zh: 总之，那会议糟透了。

examples.en: Now the rest of the news in brief.
examples.zh: 现在简要报道其他新闻。

senses.def: in a judge’s private room, without the press or the public being present
senses.zh: 在法官的私室里；秘密地；不公开地

examples.en: The trial was held in camera.
examples.zh: 审判秘密进行。

senses.def: if something happens

examples.en: In case of fire, ring the alarm bell.
examples.zh: 如遇火警，即按警铃。

senses.def: in the same style as something

examples.en: The new wing of the museum was not really in character with the rest of the building.
examples.zh: 博物馆新建的配楼与大楼其他部分的风格有些不一样。

senses.def: typical/not typical of a person’s character
senses.zh: 符合（或不符合）某人的性格

examples.en: Her behaviour last night was completely out of character.
examples.zh: 她昨晚的举止与她的性格截然不符。

examples.en: The lawyer argued that his client's violent behaviour was out of character.
examples.zh: 律师争辩说当事人的暴力行为与他的性格完全不符。

senses.def: all together

examples.en: ‘Thank you,’ they said in chorus.
examples.zh: “谢谢。”他们齐声说道。

senses.def: by everyone in a group

examples.en: They hold the property as tenants in common.
examples.zh: 作为共同租赁人，他们共同占用这份房地产。

senses.def: in the same way as somebody/something

examples.en: Britain, in common with many other industrialized countries, has experienced major changes over the last 100 years.
examples.zh: 与其他许多工业化国家一样，英国在过去 100 年里经历了重大的变化。

examples.en: India, in common with many other countries, has experienced major changes over the last 100 years.
examples.zh: 像其他许多国家一样，印度在过去 100 年里经历了重大变化。

senses.def: together with or at the same time as somebody/something

examples.en: She arrived in company with the ship's captain.
examples.zh: 她与船长一起到达。

examples.en: The US dollar went through a difficult time, in company with the oil market.
examples.zh: 美元与石油市场同时经历了艰难时期。

senses.def: working together with somebody/something
following the rules of something; conforming
senses.zh: 遵循（规则）；与…相符合（或一致）

examples.en: regulations that are in conformity with European law
examples.zh: 符合欧洲法律的条例

senses.def: together with somebody/something

examples.en: The police are working in conjunction with tax officers on the investigation.
examples.zh: 警方正和税务官员协同进行调查。

examples.en: The software can be used in conjunction with any other application.
examples.zh: 该软件可与任何其他应用程序一起使用。

senses.def: for reasons connected with somebody/something

examples.en: A man has been arrested in connection with the murder of the teenager.
examples.zh: 一名男子因与这起谋杀少年案有关而被捕。

examples.en: I am writing to you in connection with your recent job application.
examples.zh: 我写此信与你最近求职一事有关。

senses.def: as a result of something

examples.en: The scheme was subsequently abandoned in consequence of general apathy.
examples.zh: 由于普遍的冷漠，该计划随后被放弃。

examples.en: It had been a humiliating day for Flora and she bore the director a grudge in consequence.
examples.zh: 这对弗洛拉来说是耻辱的一天，她因此对导演怀恨在心。

examples.en: The employer is liable for compensation payable in consequence of injury to one of its employees.
examples.zh: 由于对一名员工造成伤害，雇主有责任给予相应赔偿。

senses.def: as payment for something

examples.en: a small sum in consideration of your services
examples.zh: 对你服务的微薄酬金

senses.def: being considered

examples.en: By 1613 even more desperate measures were in contemplation.
examples.zh: 到 1613 年，甚至考虑要采取更为孤注一掷的措施。

senses.def: with a chance of winning something

examples.en: Only three teams are now in contention for the title.
examples.zh: 现在只有三个队有机会夺冠。

senses.def: in contrast with something/somebody

examples.en: Lionesses, in contradistinction to the females of other animals, are the hunters.
examples.zh: 与其他动物的雌性不同，母狮是猎人。

senses.def: as a group; together

examples.en: We drove in convoy because I didn't know the route.
examples.zh: 因为我不熟悉路线，所以我们结队行驶。

senses.def: going through a particular process

examples.en: The new textbook is in course of preparation.
examples.zh: 新的教科书正在准备之中。

senses.def: in trouble or difficulty
because of a lack of something

examples.en: They accepted what he had said in default of any evidence to disprove it.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏相反的证据，他们相信了他的话。

senses.def: wanted by a lot of people

examples.en: Good secretaries are always in demand.
examples.zh: 优秀的秘书总是很抢手。

senses.def: in a detailed, careful and complete way

examples.en: I haven't looked at the report in depth yet.
examples.zh: 我还没有细看这份报告。

examples.en: an in-depth study
examples.zh: 深入研究

examples.en: I studied phonology in depth at college.
examples.zh: 我在大学里深入学习了音系学。

senses.def: in small amounts or numbers over a period of time
senses.zh: 少量；一点一滴；零零星星

examples.en: She paid me in dribs and drabs, not all at once.
examples.zh: 她一点一点地付给我钱，而不是一次付清。

senses.def: at the right time and not before
senses.zh: 在适当的时候；到一定的时候

examples.en: Your request will be dealt with in due course.
examples.zh: 你的要求将在适当的时候予以处理。

senses.def: as two copies that are exactly the same in every detail

examples.en: The contract is prepared in duplicate, so that both parties can sign it.
examples.zh: 这份合同一式两份，这样双方都可以签署。

senses.def: more seriously and with more force or effort than before

examples.en: The work on the house will begin in earnest on Monday.
examples.zh: 这栋房子的修建工作将在星期一正式开始。

examples.en: That was when our troubles started in earnest.
examples.zh: 就在那时，我们的麻烦真正开始了。

senses.def: very serious and sincere about what you are saying and about your intentions; in a way that shows that you are serious

examples.en: You may laugh but I'm in deadly earnest.
examples.zh: 你可以笑，不过我可是正经八百的。

examples.en: I could tell she spoke in earnest.
examples.zh: 我看得出她是郑重其事地说的。

senses.def: used when you are stating what the facts of a situation are

examples.en: In effect, the two systems are identical.
examples.zh: 实际上，这两种系统完全一样。

examples.en: His refusal to support her had, in effect, forced her resignation.
examples.zh: 他拒绝支持她实际上迫使她辞职。

examples.en: By asking for these particular qualifications, you are, in effect, excluding a lot of potentially good candidates.
examples.zh: 通过询问这些特定的资格，您实际上排除了许多潜在的优秀候选人。

examples.en: The border closure meant, in effect, that no trade took place between the countries.
examples.zh: 边境关闭实际上意味着两国间不再有贸易往来。

senses.def: in use

examples.en: These laws are in effect in twenty states.
examples.zh: 这些法律在二十个州有效。

examples.en: Some laws from the 18th century are still in effect.
examples.zh: 18 世纪的一些法律仍然有效。

senses.def: existing but not yet fully developed
senses.zh: 在胚胎阶段；在萌芽时期；尚未成熟

examples.en: The idea already existed in embryo in his earlier novels.
examples.zh: 这个想法在他早期的小说中已初见端倪。

in employ: @@@LINK=in somebody’s employ | in the employ of somebody
in equal measure: @@@LINK=in no small measure | in some, equal, etc. measure

senses.def: if you are in favour

examples.en: He argued in favour of a strike.
examples.zh: 他据理力争主张罢工。

examples.en: There were 247 votes in favour (of the motion) and 152 against.
examples.zh: 有 247 票赞成（动议），152 票反对。

examples.en: I'm all in favour of (= completely support) equal pay for equal work.
examples.zh: 我完全支持同工同酬。

examples.en: Most of the ‘don't knows’ in the opinion polls came down in favour of (= eventually chose to support) the Democrats.
examples.zh: 在民意测验中多数未作决定的选民最终决定支持民主党人。

senses.def: in exchange for another thing (because the other thing is better or you want it more)
senses.zh: 为获得（更好或更需要的事物）

examples.en: He abandoned teaching in favour of a career as a musician.
examples.zh: 他弃教从事音乐。

examples.en: Early in his musical career he abandoned blues in favour of jazz.
examples.zh: 他在音乐生涯的早期就放弃了布鲁斯音乐而选择了爵士乐。

senses.def: feeling frightened that you might be killed
senses.zh: 害怕会丧生；为生命安全担忧

senses.def: healthy; in good condition
senses.zh: 健康；身心俱佳；状况良好

examples.en: The team is in fine fettle.
examples.zh: 球队状态良好。

examples.en: Park Foods is in fine fettle after selling off all non-core businesses.
examples.zh: 帕克食品公司在出售所有非核心业务后状况良好。

in fits and starts: @@@LINK=in stops and starts | by/in fits and starts

senses.def: pregnant

in for a in for a pound: @@@LINK=in for a penny, in for a pound
in for a penny: @@@LINK=in for a penny, in for a pound
in for a penny for a pound: @@@LINK=in for a penny, in for a pound

senses.def: used to say that since you have started to do something, it is worth spending as much time or money as you need to in order to complete it
senses.zh: 一不做，二不休；有始有终

in for a penny, in for a pound.word: in for a penny, in for a pound

in for a pound: @@@LINK=in for a penny, in for a pound
in for the long haul: @@@LINK=be in sth for the long haul

senses.def: in large numbers

examples.en: Protesters turned out in force.
examples.zh: 有很多抗议者到场。

senses.def: being used

examples.en: The new regulations are now in force.
examples.zh: 新规章现已生效。

senses.def: in a position that is further forward than somebody/something but not very far away

examples.en: Their house is the one with the big garden in front.
examples.zh: 他们的房子是前面有大花园的那一座。

senses.def: in first place in a race or competition

examples.en: The blue team is currently in front with a lead of six points.
examples.zh: 蓝队目前以六分领先。

senses.def: in a position that is further forward than somebody/something but not very far away

examples.en: The car in front of me stopped suddenly and I had to brake.
examples.zh: 我前面那辆车突然停下来，我也只好刹车。

examples.en: The bus stops right in front of our house.
examples.zh: 公共汽车就停在我们的房子前面。

examples.en: He was standing in front of me in the line.
examples.zh: 在队列中他站在我的前面。

examples.en: She is now entitled to put ‘Professor’ in front of her name.
examples.zh: 她现在有权在自己的名字前加上“教授”。

senses.def: in a position facing somebody/something

examples.en: to perform in front of a big crowd/audience
examples.zh: 在一大群人／一大批观众面前表演

examples.en: She spends all day sitting in front of (= working at) her computer.
examples.zh: 她整天坐在计算机前（工作）。

examples.en: She's a natural in front of the camera (= being filmed/photographed).
examples.zh: 她在镜头前表现得非常自然。

senses.def: if you do something in front of

examples.en: Please don't talk about it in front of the children.
examples.zh: 请不要当着孩子们的面谈那件事。

senses.def: still to come; not yet passed

examples.en: Don't give up. You still have your whole life in front of you.
examples.zh: 不要放弃，你的人生才刚刚开始。

senses.def: including the whole of something

examples.en: The address must be printed in full.
examples.zh: 地址必须以印刷体详尽填写。

senses.def: talking or shouting loudly and in an enthusiastic way

examples.en: The Leeds supporters were in full cry.
examples.zh: 利兹队的球迷在激动地呐喊。

senses.def: to the greatest possible degree

examples.en: My expectations had been met in full measure.
examples.zh: 我的期望得到了最大的满足。

senses.def: having reached a very lively level
senses.zh: 在热烈进行中；处于兴盛阶段

examples.en: When we arrived the party was already in full swing.
examples.zh: 我们赶到时，聚会已进入高潮。

senses.def: that can be seen completely, directly in front of somebody/something
senses.zh: 完全看得见；在眼皮底下

examples.en: He was shot in full view of a large crowd.
examples.zh: 他在众目睽睽之下被人枪杀了。

senses.def: from now on

examples.en: Please be more careful in future.
examples.zh: 今后请多加小心。

examples.en: In future, make sure the door is never left unlocked.
examples.zh: 从今以后，千万别忘记锁好门。

senses.def: usually; mainly

examples.en: In general, Japanese cars are very reliable and breakdowns are rare.
examples.zh: 日本汽车通常是很可靠的，发生故障的情况极少。

senses.def: as a whole

examples.en: This is a crucial year for your relationships in general and your love life in particular.
examples.zh: 这一年总体上对你们的关系，特别是你们的爱情生活是非常关键的。

in God's name: @@@LINK=in God’s/Heaven’s name | in the name of God/Heaven
in God's/Heaven's name: @@@LINK=in God’s/Heaven’s name | in the name of God/Heaven

senses.def: used especially in questions to show that you are angry, surprised or shocked
senses.zh: （尤用于疑问句，表示愤怒、惊奇或震惊）看在上帝的分上，到底，究竟

examples.en: What in God's name was that noise?
examples.zh: 那噪声究竟是怎么回事？

examples.en: Where in the name of Heaven have you been?
examples.zh: 你到底上哪儿去了？

in God’s/Heaven’s name | in the name of.word: in God’s/Heaven’s name | in the name of God/Heaven

in good best possible taste: @@@LINK=be in good, the best possible, etc. taste

senses.def: if you say that somebody is in good company
senses.zh: 无伤大雅（表示不必为错误等担忧，因为他人，尤其是更重要的人也犯过同样的错误）

examples.en: If you worry about your relationship with your teenage son or daughter, you are in good company. Many parents share these worries.
examples.zh: 你要是担心跟十几岁的孩子关系处不好，那很正常。很多家长都有同样的担心。

senses.def: believing that what you are doing is right; believing that something is correct

examples.en: We printed the report in good faith but have now learnt that it was incorrect.
examples.zh: 我们好意印发了这份报告，但现在才知道它并不正确。

examples.en: He bought the painting in good faith (= he did not know that it had been stolen).
examples.zh: 他出于善意购买了这幅画（他不知道它被偷了）。

senses.def: happy and cheerful

in good repair: @@@LINK=in good, bad, etc. repair | in a good, bad, etc. state of repair

senses.def: early; with enough time so that you are not in a hurry

examples.en: Get to the airport in good time.
examples.zh: 早早到机场。

senses.def: in good, bad, etc. condition or health
senses.zh: 状况良好（或不好等）；身体健康（或不好等）

examples.en: My car's in pretty good nick for its age.
examples.zh: 我的车就其车龄而言，状况相当不错。

senses.def: in good, etc. condition

examples.en: The house is not in good repair.
examples.zh: 房子修得不好。

in good, bad, etc. repair | in a good, b.word: in good, bad, etc. repair | in a good, bad, etc. state of repair

senses.def: if you have time or money in hand

examples.en: We managed to redecorate the house and still have some savings in hand.
examples.zh: 我们设法重新装修了房子，手头还有一些积蓄。

examples.en: She completed the first part of the exam with over an hour in hand.
examples.zh: 她在一个多小时内完成了考试的第一部分。

senses.def: if you have a particular situation in hand

examples.en: Don’t worry about the travel arrangements—everything is in hand.
examples.zh: 别担心旅行安排 ── 一切都已经安排妥当。

senses.def: the job, question, etc. in hand

examples.en: Please confine your comments to the topic in hand.
examples.zh: 请将您的评论限制在当前主题范围内。

senses.def: if somebody works a week, month, etc. in hand

in hands: @@@LINK=in the hands of somebody | in somebody’s hands

senses.def: doing your normal work, especially after a rest or a holiday
senses.zh: （尤指休息或假期结束后）做正常工作

senses.def: working closely with somebody in order to achieve something

examples.en: They’ll be working in harness with other doctors to compile the report.
examples.zh: 他们将与其他医生合作编写这份报告。

in Heaven's name: @@@LINK=in God’s/Heaven’s name | in the name of God/Heaven

senses.def: in a manner that is appropriate to or typical of a person or thing but that may seem unusual to other people

examples.en: I expect she does love you in her own way.
examples.zh: 我想她的确是以她特有的方式爱你。

examples.en: The building is very attractive in its own way.
examples.zh: 这座建筑以其自己的方式非常有吸引力。

examples.en: He was attractive in his own way.
examples.zh: 他有他的迷人之处。

in her, his, its, etc. (own) way.word: in her, his, its, etc. (own) way

senses.def: in an angry or offended mood, and showing other people that you are angry

examples.en: He stomped out of the room in high dudgeon.
examples.zh: 他愤怒地噔噔走出了屋子。

examples.en: She stormed out in high dudgeon.
examples.zh: 她怒气冲冲地走了。

senses.def: used when you are saying that you do not understand why somebody has done something
senses.zh: （表示不理解他人的无知）以其（无限的）智慧

examples.en: The government in its wisdom has decided to support the ban.
examples.zh: 政府竟愚蠢到决定支持这项禁令。

in honor: @@@LINK=in honor of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honor
in honor of: @@@LINK=in honor of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honor
in honor of sb: @@@LINK=in honor of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honor
in honor of somebody: @@@LINK=in honor of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honor
in honor of somebody/something: @@@LINK=in honor of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honor

senses.def: in order to show great respect for somebody/something

examples.en: a ceremony in honor of those killed in the explosion
examples.zh: 纪念爆炸中遇难者的仪式

examples.en: A banquet was held in her honor.
examples.zh: 为她举行了一场宴会。

in honor of somebody/something | in some.word: in honor of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honor

in honor of something: @@@LINK=in honor of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honor
in honor of sth: @@@LINK=in honor of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honor
in honour: @@@LINK=in honour of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honour
in honour of: @@@LINK=in honour of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honour
in honour of sb: @@@LINK=in honour of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honour
in honour of somebody: @@@LINK=in honour of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honour
in honour of somebody/something: @@@LINK=in honour of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honour

senses.def: in order to show great respect for somebody/something

examples.en: a ceremony in honour of those killed in the explosion
examples.zh: 为纪念爆炸中的死难者所举行的仪式

examples.en: A banquet was held in her honour.
examples.zh: 为欢迎她而设宴。

in honour of somebody/something | in som.word: in honour of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honour

in honour of something: @@@LINK=in honour of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honour
in honour of sth: @@@LINK=in honour of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honour

senses.def: following somebody closely and determined to catch them

examples.en: She sped away in her car with journalists in hot pursuit.
examples.zh: 她开车迅速离去，记者们则在后面穷追不舍。

senses.def: used to show that you think a particular word, description, etc. is not true or appropriate
senses.zh: （对正确性或适合性表示质疑）所谓的，加引号的

examples.en: The manager showed us to our ‘luxury apartment’, in inverted commas.
examples.zh: 经理带我们去看了我们所谓的“豪华单元房”。

senses.def: separately; alone

examples.en: To make sense, these figures should not be looked at in isolation.
examples.zh: 这些数据不应孤立起来看，否则就没有意义。

examples.en: Words are pronounced differently in isolation from how they are pronounced in context.
examples.zh: 单词的发音与它们在上下文中的发音不同。

senses.def: as a whole, rather than in parts
senses.zh: 作为整体；整个地；全面地

examples.en: The poem is too long to quote in its entirety.
examples.zh: 这首诗太长，不能全部引用。

senses.def: considered separately from other things; in its true nature

examples.en: In itself, it's not a difficult problem to solve.
examples.zh: 这本身并不是个难解决的问题。

senses.def: in a dangerous position or situation and likely to be lost or harmed
senses.zh: 处于危险境地；受到威胁

examples.en: The civil war has put thousands of lives in jeopardy.
examples.zh: 内战使数千人的生命处于危险之中。

examples.en: The future of the school and 50 jobs are in jeopardy.
examples.zh: 学校的未来和 50 个工作岗位都处于危险之中。

examples.en: Thousands of jobs could be in jeopardy.
examples.zh: 数以千计的工作岗位可能面临危险。

senses.def: as a joke

examples.en: The remark was made half in jest.
examples.zh: 这话是半开玩笑说出的。

examples.en: ‘Many a true word is spoken in jest,’ thought Rosie (= people often say things as a joke that are actually true).
examples.zh: “许多真话都是在玩笑中说出的。”罗西想。

senses.def: as an explanation of why something exists or why somebody has done something

examples.en: All I can say in justification of her actions is that she was under a lot of pressure at work.
examples.zh: 我唯一能为她的行为辩解的理由是她工作压力很大。

examples.en: the argument which he put forward in justification
examples.zh: 他用以辩解的理由

senses.def: appropriate or expected in a particular situation; in agreement with something

examples.en: The latest results are in keeping with our earlier findings.
examples.zh: 最新结果与我们先前的发现一致。

senses.def: consisting of goods or services, not money
senses.zh: 以实物支付；以货代款；以服务偿付

examples.en: As well as his salary, he gets benefits in kind.
examples.zh: 除了薪水外，他还有非现金福利。

senses.def: with the same thing

examples.en: She insulted him and he responded in kind.
examples.zh: 她侮辱了他，他也以其人之道还治其人之身。

senses.def: to a great extent

examples.en: Their success is due in large measure to their determination.
examples.zh: 他们的成功在很大程度上归功于他们的决心。

in large measure | in large part.word: in large measure | in large part

senses.def: to a great extent

examples.en: Their success is due in large part to their determination.
examples.zh: 他们的成功在很大程度上应归功于他们的决心。

in large part | in large measure.word: in large part | in large measure

senses.def: making secret plans with somebody

examples.en: Those two crooks seem to be in league with each other.
examples.zh: 这两个骗子似乎是勾结在一起的。

senses.def: instead of

examples.en: They took cash in lieu of the prize they had won.
examples.zh: 他们没有领奖品而是领了现金。

examples.en: We work on Saturdays and have a day off in lieu during the week.
examples.zh: 我们每周星期六上班，用其他的日子补休一天。

senses.def: likely to get something

examples.en: She is in line for promotion.
examples.zh: 她有可能得到提升。

in memory of: @@@LINK=in memory of somebody | to the memory of somebody
in memory of sb: @@@LINK=in memory of somebody | to the memory of somebody
in memory of somebody: @@@LINK=in memory of somebody | to the memory of somebody

senses.def: intended to show respect and remind people of somebody who has died

examples.en: He founded the charity in memory of his late wife.
examples.zh: 他创办了这一慈善事业以纪念他已故的妻子。

examples.en: The statue was erected to the memory of my father.
examples.zh: 这座雕像是为了纪念我父亲而竖立的。

in memory of somebody | to the memory of.word: in memory of somebody | to the memory of somebody

senses.def: on a small scale

examples.en: The developments in this town represent in microcosm what is happening in the country as a whole.
examples.zh: 这座城镇的发展以小见大，体现了整个国家的发展。

senses.def: on a very small scale

examples.en: a doll’s house with everything in miniature
examples.zh: 样样东西都很小的玩具小屋

examples.en: Through play, children act out in miniature the dramas of adult life.
examples.zh: 通过游戏，孩子们演出了成年人生活的缩影。

senses.def: new or as good as new; in perfect condition

examples.en: We sell first editions of rare books in mint condition.
examples.zh: 我们出售完好无损的初版珍本书籍。

senses.def: thinking that something is something else

examples.en: Children may eat pills in mistake for sweets.
examples.zh: 孩子可能会把药片错当成糖果吃。

senses.def: with the aim of making a crime seem less serious or easier to forgive
senses.zh: 旨在减轻罪行；意在开脱罪责

examples.en: In mitigation, the defence lawyer said his client was seriously depressed at the time of the assault.
examples.zh: 为了减轻罪行，辩护律师说他的当事人在袭击人的时候精神极度压抑。

senses.def: used to show that a statement has more than one meaning
senses.zh: （所说的话）不止一个意思；在很多方面

examples.en: With the first goal he used his head in more ways than one.
examples.zh: 他进第一个球时从多方面动了脑筋。

senses.def: stored and not in use, often for a long time

examples.en: The plan has been put in mothballs.
examples.zh: 该计划已被封存。

senses.def: used when you are giving your opinion

examples.en: That's cheating in my book.
examples.zh: 依我看那是欺骗。

senses.def: in my, your, etc. situation

examples.en: I wouldn't like to be in your place.
examples.zh: 我可不想处于你的境地。

in name: @@@LINK=in the name of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s name

senses.def: officially recognized but not existing in reality

examples.en: He's party leader in name only.
examples.zh: 他只是名义上的政党领袖。

in no hurry: @@@LINK=in no hurry (to do something) | not in a/any hurry (to do something)

senses.def: having plenty of time
senses.zh: 有足够的时间，不着急（做某事）

examples.en: I don't mind waiting—I'm not in any particular hurry.
examples.zh: 我可以等，我没什么特别急的事。

examples.en: Serve this lady first—I’m in no hurry.
examples.zh: 先招待这位女士吧，我不急。

senses.def: not wanting or not willing to do something

examples.en: We were in no hurry to get back to work after the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期结束后我们不想急着回去工作。

examples.en: She's in no hurry to find out how much her fuel bill comes to.
examples.zh: 她并不急于了解她的燃油费是多少。

in no hurry (to do something) | not in a.word: in no hurry (to do something) | not in a/any hurry (to do something)

in no hurry to do: @@@LINK=in no hurry (to do something) | not in a/any hurry (to do something)
in no hurry to do something: @@@LINK=in no hurry (to do something) | not in a/any hurry (to do something)
in no hurry to do sth: @@@LINK=in no hurry (to do something) | not in a/any hurry (to do something)
in no small measure: @@@LINK=in no small measure | in some, equal, etc. measure

senses.def: to a large extent or degree; to some, etc. extent or degree
senses.zh: 在很大（或某种、同样等）程度上

examples.en: The introduction of a new tax accounted in no small measure for the downfall of the government.
examples.zh: 这届政府的垮台在很大程度上归因于征收一种新税。

examples.en: Our thanks are due in equal measure to every member of the team.
examples.zh: 我们同样感谢每一位队员。

in no small measure | in some, equal, et.word: in no small measure | in some, equal, etc. measure

senses.def: clearly and strongly
senses.zh: 明确有力地；毫不含糊地

examples.en: I told him what I thought of him in no uncertain terms.
examples.zh: 我直言不讳地说出了我对他的看法。

senses.def: used to give an amount, a measurement, etc. using older or more traditional units that may be more familiar to some people
senses.zh: （数量、大小等）按旧制，用过去的单位来算

examples.en: The fish measured 29 centimetres (that's a foot in old money).
examples.zh: 这条鱼长 29 厘米（合旧制一英尺）。

senses.def: a long time ago in the past

examples.en: In olden times people would gather in town squares to gossip and exchange stories.
examples.zh: 在过去，人们会聚集在城镇广场上闲聊和交换故事。

senses.def: all together on one occasion

examples.en: I'd rather do the journey in one go, and not stop on the way.
examples.zh: 我宁愿一次走完全程，中途不停。

examples.en: They ate the packet of biscuits all in one go.
examples.zh: 他们一下子把那包饼干全吃光了。

in one way: @@@LINK=in a way | in one way | in some ways

senses.def: forming part of a parliament but not part of the government

examples.en: They returned to power after six years in opposition.
examples.zh: 他们在野六年后重新掌权。

examples.en: The Conservative Party is now in opposition.
examples.zh: 保守党现在处于反对党的地位。

senses.def: disagreeing strongly with somebody/something, especially with the aim of preventing something from happening
senses.zh: 强烈反对（或抵制）某人／某事物

examples.en: We found ourselves in opposition to several colleagues on this issue.
examples.zh: 我们在这一问题上与几个同事意见相左。

examples.en: Protest marches were held in opposition to the proposed law.
examples.zh: 为抗议新提出的法案举行了示威游行。

senses.def: contrasting two people or things that are very different

examples.en: Leisure is often defined in opposition to work.
examples.zh: 休闲常被定义为工作的反面。

senses.def: that can be used because it is all correct and legal

examples.en: Is your work permit in order?
examples.zh: 你的工作许可证有效吗？

senses.def: as it should be

examples.en: Is everything in order, sir?
examples.zh: 一切都正常吗，先生？

senses.def: if something is in order

examples.en: I think a drink would be in order.
examples.zh: 我想应该喝杯饮料了吧。

examples.en: Would it be in order for us to examine the manuscript?
examples.zh: 按规定我们可以检查原稿吗？

senses.def: allowed according to the rules of a meeting, etc.

examples.en: Is it in order to speak now?
examples.zh: 依规定现在可以发言了吗？

senses.def: so that something can happen

examples.en: All those concerned must work together in order that agreement can be reached on this issue.
examples.zh: 一切有关人员必须通力合作，以便能在这个问题上达成协议。

senses.def: used to introduce an explanation of something
senses.zh: 换句话说；也就是说；换言之

examples.en: They asked him to leave—in other words he was fired.
examples.zh: 他们请他走人，也就是说，他被解雇了。

examples.en: They're letting me go—in other words, I've been sacked.
examples.zh: 他们让我走人。换句话说，我被解雇了。

senses.def: involved in something that is too difficult for you to deal with

examples.en: After a week in the new job, I soon realized that I was in over my head.
examples.zh: 新工作刚做了一个星期，我便意识到自己做不了。

senses.def: in groups of two objects or people

examples.en: Students worked in pairs on the project.
examples.zh: 学生两人一组做这个项目。

examples.en: These candles only come in pairs.
examples.zh: 这些蜡烛只成对出售。

senses.def: with and at the same time as something/somebody else

examples.en: The new degree and the existing certificate courses would run in parallel.
examples.zh: 新的学位课程和现有的证书课程将同时开设。

examples.en: Ann wanted to pursue her own career in parallel with her husband’s.
examples.zh: 安想跟丈夫同时追求各自的事业。

senses.def: partly; to some extent

examples.en: Her success was due in part to luck.
examples.zh: 她的成功在某种程度上是由于运气好。

examples.en: Your salary depends in part on your qualifications.
examples.zh: 你的薪水多少会取决于你的资历。

senses.def: especially or particularly

examples.en: He loves science fiction in particular.
examples.zh: 他特别喜爱科幻小说。

senses.def: special or specific

examples.en: Peter was lying on the sofa doing nothing in particular.
examples.zh: 彼得躺在沙发上，无所事事。

examples.en: Is there anything in particular you'd like for dinner?
examples.zh: 晚饭你有具体想吃的吗？

examples.en: She directed the question at no one in particular.
examples.zh: 她的问题并没有针对任何个人。

senses.def: done or said when your main focus is something different

examples.en: He only mentioned it in passing and didn't give any details.
examples.zh: 他只是随口提及而已，并没有谈任何细节。

senses.def: if something is in pawn

examples.en: All her jewellery was in pawn.
examples.zh: 她的首饰全典当了。

senses.def: for all time in the future

examples.en: They do not own the land in perpetuity.
examples.zh: 他们并不永久拥有这片土地。

examples.en: The trust fund will ensure preservation of the site in perpetuity.
examples.zh: 该信托基金将确保该遗址的永久保存。

senses.def: if you do something in person

examples.en: You have to pick up the package in person.
examples.zh: 您必须亲自领取包裹。

examples.en: She appeared in person to collect her prize.
examples.zh: 她亲自到场领奖。

senses.def: working/not working together in the right way

examples.en: The traffic lights were out of phase.
examples.zh: 红绿灯信号不协调。

senses.def: in the correct position; ready for something

examples.en: Carefully lay each slab in place.
examples.zh: 要仔细铺好每一块石板。

examples.en: He allowed the curtain to swish back into place.
examples.zh: 他让窗帘摇回原位。

senses.def: working or ready to work

examples.en: All the arrangements are now in place for their visit.
examples.zh: 他们来访的一切事宜都安排好了。

examples.en: How long has the import ban been in place?
examples.zh: 进口禁令实施多久了？

senses.def: in one exact place, without moving in any direction

examples.en: Running in place is good exercise.
examples.zh: 原地跑步是很好的运动。

in place of: @@@LINK=in (the) place of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s place
in place of sb: @@@LINK=in (the) place of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s place
in place of somebody: @@@LINK=in (the) place of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s place
in place of somebody/something: @@@LINK=in (the) place of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s place
in place of something: @@@LINK=in (the) place of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s place
in place of sth: @@@LINK=in (the) place of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s place

senses.def: simply and clearly expressed, without using technical language

examples.en: a document written in plain English
examples.zh: 用通俗易懂的英语写的文件

examples.en: If you could put it in plain English I might be able to understand.
examples.zh: 如果你能用通俗易懂的英语说出来，我也许能理解。

examples.en: Teachers should encourage students to write in plain English.
examples.zh: 教师应鼓励学生用平白的英文写作。

senses.def: used to say what is true in a situation

examples.en: In point of fact, she is their adopted daughter.
examples.zh: 实际上，她是他们的养女。

in poor worst possible taste: @@@LINK=be in bad, poor, the worst possible, etc. taste

senses.def: in reality

examples.en: Prisoners have legal rights, but in practice these rights are not always respected.
examples.zh: 囚犯虽有合法的权利，但实际上这些权利常未受到尊重。

examples.en: The idea sounds fine in theory, but would it work in practice?
examples.zh: 这种想法理论上好像不错，但是做起来行得通吗？

senses.def: rather than somebody/something

examples.en: She was chosen in preference to her sister.
examples.zh: 她被选中了，而不是她妹妹。

examples.en: They bought French planes in preference to British ones.
examples.zh: 他们没有买英国产的飞机，而是买了法国产的。

in presence: @@@LINK=in the presence of somebody | in somebody’s presence

senses.def: if something can be done in principle

examples.en: In principle there is nothing that a human can do that a machine might not be able to do one day.
examples.zh: 原则上，总会有一天，凡是人能做的事，机器就能做。

senses.def: in general but not in detail

examples.en: They have agreed to the proposal in principle but we still have to negotiate the terms.
examples.zh: 他们已基本同意了这项提议，但我们还得磋商各项条款。

examples.en: I agree with you in principle, but we'll need to discuss the details.
examples.zh: 我原则上同意你的意见，但是我们需要讨论一下细节问题。

senses.def: still available from the company that publishes it

examples.en: Is this edition still in print?
examples.zh: 这一版本仍在印行吗？

senses.def: printed in a book, newspaper, etc.

examples.en: It was the first time he had seen his name in print.
examples.zh: 那是他第一次见到自己的名字被刊印出来。

senses.def: with nobody else present

examples.en: Is there somewhere we can discuss this in private?
examples.zh: 有没有什么地方能让我们单独谈谈这件事？

senses.def: happening at this time

examples.en: Work on the new offices is now in progress.
examples.zh: 新办公楼正在施工。

examples.en: Please be quiet—examination in progress.
examples.zh: 考试正在进行，请安静。

senses.def: when other people, especially people you do not know, are present
senses.zh: 公开地；在别人（尤指生人）面前

examples.en: She has not been seen in public since the attempted coup.
examples.zh: 自从未遂政变以来，她就没有在公开场合露面。

examples.en: They never argue in public.
examples.zh: 他们从不在公共场合争论。

examples.en: He rarely appears in public these days.
examples.zh: 这些日子他很少公开露面。

senses.def: in order to do something; in the process of doing something

examples.en: They may need to borrow money in pursuance of their legal action.
examples.zh: 他们在诉讼过程中可能需要借贷。

senses.def: that is being discussed

examples.en: On the day in question we were in Cardiff.
examples.zh: 在所说的那一天，我们在加的夫。

senses.def: in doubt; uncertain

examples.en: The future of public transport is not in question.
examples.zh: 公共交通的未来发展是不容置疑的。

examples.en: His sincerity is not in question.
examples.zh: 他的真诚不容置疑。

senses.def: wearing very old torn clothes

examples.en: The children were dressed in rags.
examples.zh: 孩子们穿着破衣烂衫。

examples.en: I saw people dressed in rags begging on the street.
examples.zh: 我看见衣衫褴褛的人在街上乞讨。

senses.def: used to say that a situation is different from what has just been said or from what people believe

examples.en: Outwardly she seemed confident but in reality she felt extremely nervous.
examples.zh: 表面上看，她显得信心十足，而实际上她紧张得要命。

examples.en: In reality, human beings and dinosaurs never lived on earth at the same time.
examples.zh: 事实上，人类和恐龙从未同时生活在地球上。

examples.en: The media portray her as happy and successful, but in reality she has a difficult life.
examples.zh: 媒体把她描述得快乐而成功，而事实上她过着艰难的生活。

senses.def: available to be used in the future or when needed

examples.en: The money was being kept in reserve for their retirement.
examples.zh: 他们把钱存着以备退休后使用。

examples.en: 200 police officers were held in reserve.
examples.zh: 200 名警察随时待命。

senses.def: having an official position in a particular place such as a college or university
senses.zh: （在大学等处）有正式职位，常驻

examples.en: creative writing classes given by the writer in residence
examples.zh: 由驻校作家开设的创意写作课程

senses.def: about; relating to

examples.en: A writ was served on the firm in respect of their unpaid bill.
examples.zh: 公司由于欠账而收到了传票。

senses.def: in payment for something

examples.en: money received in respect of overtime worked
examples.zh: 得到的加班费

senses.def: thinking about a past event or situation, often with a different opinion of it from the one you had at the time

examples.en: In retrospect, I think that I was wrong.
examples.zh: 回首往事，我觉得当时我错了。

examples.en: The decision seems extremely odd, in retrospect.
examples.zh: 回想起来，这个决定显得极其荒谬。

senses.def: as a way of thanking somebody or paying them for something they have done

examples.en: Can I buy you lunch in return for your help?
examples.zh: 感谢你帮忙，我请你吃午饭好吗？

examples.en: She gave them all the help she could, and asked for nothing in return.
examples.zh: 她尽其所能地帮助了他们，而且不求回报。

examples.en: If I do this for you, what do I get in return?
examples.zh: 如果我为你做这件事，我能得到什么回报？

senses.def: as a response or reaction to something

examples.en: I asked her opinion, but she just asked me a question in return.
examples.zh: 我征求她的意见，她却只是反问了我一句。

senses.def: in the opposite order or way

examples.en: The secret number is my phone number in reverse.
examples.zh: 这个密码是我的电话号码的逆序排列。

examples.en: We did a similar trip to you, but in reverse.
examples.zh: 我们走了和你相似的旅程，但方向相反。

senses.def: if you write or draw something in rough

examples.en: Write it out in rough first then copy it neatly into your notebook.
examples.zh: 先粗略地写下来，然后整齐地抄到笔记本上。

senses.def: looking or feeling very healthy
destroyed or severely damaged
senses.zh: 破败的；严重受损的；已成废墟的

examples.en: Years of fighting have left the area in ruins.
examples.zh: 经年的战事已经使得这个地区满目疮痍。

examples.en: The church now lies in ruins.
examples.zh: 教堂现在成了废墟。

examples.en: The scandal left his reputation in ruins.
examples.zh: 这件丑闻使他身败名裂。

examples.en: Their plans for a comeback now lie in ruins.
examples.zh: 他们的东山再起的计划现在已经泡汤了。

senses.def: working well

examples.en: The engine is now in perfect working order.
examples.zh: 发动机现在运转完全正常。

in safe hands: @@@LINK=in safe hands | in the safe hands of somebody

senses.def: being taken care of well by somebody
senses.zh: 在可靠的人手里；受到妥善照管

examples.en: I've left the kids in safe hands—with my parents.
examples.zh: 我把孩子托付给了靠得住的人，在我父母那儿。

examples.en: Their problem was in the safe hands of the experts.
examples.zh: 他们的问题交给行家处理了。

in safe hands | in the safe hands of som.word: in safe hands | in the safe hands of somebody

in sb's behalf: @@@LINK=in behalf of somebody | in somebody’s behalf
in sb's employ: @@@LINK=in somebody’s employ | in the employ of somebody
in sb's hands: @@@LINK=in the hands of somebody | in somebody’s hands
in sb's honor: @@@LINK=in honor of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honor
in sb's honour: @@@LINK=in honour of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honour
in sb's name: @@@LINK=in the name of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s name
in sb's place: @@@LINK=in (the) place of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s place
in sb's presence: @@@LINK=in the presence of somebody | in somebody’s presence
in sb's trust: @@@LINK=in somebody’s trust | in the trust of somebody

senses.def: without other people knowing about it

examples.en: The meeting was held in secret.
examples.zh: 会议是秘密召开的。

examples.en: She admired him, in secret of course.
examples.zh: 她当然暗地里钦佩他。

examples.en: The film stars were married in secret to avoid publicity.
examples.zh: 这对影星为了避开公众注意，秘密结了婚。

senses.def: extremely happy
senses.zh: 身处七重天；极乐；极为幸福

examples.en: Now that he's been promoted he's in seventh heaven.
examples.zh: 他得到擢升，简直乐上天了。

senses.def: in a few words

examples.en: His novels belong to a great but vanished age. They are, in short, old-fashioned.
examples.zh: 他的小说属于一个辉煌但已逝去的时代。一句话，已经过时了。

senses.def: quickly and without trouble
not existing in large enough quantities to satisfy demand

examples.en: Basic foodstuffs were in short supply.
examples.zh: 基本食物紧缺。

examples.en: Sunshine will be in short supply for the west coast.
examples.zh: 西海岸将不会有充足的阳光。

examples.en: Safe drinking water is in desperately short supply.
examples.zh: 安全饮用水极度短缺。

senses.def: very badly damaged

examples.en: The country's economy is in shreds.
examples.zh: 国家经济已是百孔千疮。

examples.en: Her nerves were in shreds.
examples.zh: 她的神经崩溃了。

senses.def: torn in many places

examples.en: The document was in shreds on the floor.
examples.zh: 那份文件在地上，已经破烂不堪。

senses.def: for short periods rather than continuously

examples.en: Sleep came to him in brief snatches.
examples.zh: 他时睡时醒。

in some measure: @@@LINK=in no small measure | in some, equal, etc. measure
in some ways: @@@LINK=in a way | in one way | in some ways
in somebody's behalf: @@@LINK=in behalf of somebody | in somebody’s behalf
in somebody's employ: @@@LINK=in somebody’s employ | in the employ of somebody
in somebody's hands: @@@LINK=in the hands of somebody | in somebody’s hands
in somebody's honor: @@@LINK=in honor of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honor
in somebody's honour: @@@LINK=in honour of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honour
in somebody's name: @@@LINK=in the name of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s name

in somebody's presence: @@@LINK=in the presence of somebody | in somebody’s presence
in somebody's trust: @@@LINK=in somebody’s trust | in the trust of somebody
in somebody's/something's honor: @@@LINK=in honor of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honor
in somebody's/something's honour: @@@LINK=in honour of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honour
in somebody's/something's name: @@@LINK=in the name of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s name
in somebody's/something's place: @@@LINK=in (the) place of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s place

senses.def: being taken care of or dealt with by somebody that you think you can rely on
senses.zh: 由可信任的人负责（或处理等）

examples.en: Can I leave these queries in your capable hands?
examples.zh: 我能否请你这个能手来解答这些疑问？

examples.en: He retired feeling confident that his company was in safe hands.
examples.zh: 他退休时确信自己的公司已托付给了可靠的人。

in somebody’s capable, safe, etc. hands.word: in somebody’s capable, safe, etc. hands

senses.def: during the part of somebody’s life when they were most successful, famous, etc.

examples.en: She was a great dancer in her day.
examples.zh: 她曾是红极一时的舞蹈家。

examples.en: Things were very different in my grandfather's day.
examples.zh: 祖父的那个年代情况大不一样。

senses.def: when somebody was young

examples.en: In my day, there were plenty of jobs when you left school.
examples.zh: 我年轻时，毕业后就业机会很多。

examples.en: In Grandfather’s day, owning a television was very unusual.
examples.zh: 在祖父时代，拥有一台电视机是非常不寻常的。

senses.def: working for somebody; employed by somebody
senses.zh: 替某人工作；为某人所雇用

examples.en: How long has she been in your employ?
examples.zh: 她为你工作多长时间了？

in somebody’s employ | in the employ of.word: in somebody’s employ | in the employ of somebody

senses.def: in somebody’s opinion or according to the way that they see the situation
senses.zh: 按某人的意见；在某人眼里；依某人看

examples.en: She can do no wrong in her father's eyes.
examples.zh: 在她父亲看来，她不可能做坏事。

examples.en: To Western eyes, it may seem that the city is overcrowded.
examples.zh: 在西方人看来，这座城市似乎过于拥挤。

senses.def: annoying somebody by criticizing them or telling them what to do all the time
senses.zh: 批评某人，支使某人（使人恼火）

examples.en: Why are you always in my face?
examples.zh: 为什么你总是惹我生气？

senses.def: if something is in somebody’s favour
senses.zh: 有利于某人；有助于某人

examples.en: The exchange rate is in our favour at the moment.
examples.zh: 目前汇率对我们有利。

examples.en: She was willing to bend the rules in Mary's favour.
examples.zh: 她愿意放宽规定以有利于玛丽。

examples.en: The golf tournament went in the Americans' favour.
examples.zh: 美国队在高尔夫锦标赛中获胜。

senses.def: a decision or judgement that is in somebody’s favour
senses.zh: （决定）对某人有利；（判决）判某人正确

examples.en: The court decided in Ms Smith’s favour and she received compensation for unfair dismissal.
examples.zh: 法院做出了对史密斯女士有利的判决，她因不公平解雇而获得了赔偿。

examples.en: The High Court found in favour of the plaintiffs.
examples.zh: 高等法院判定原告胜诉。

senses.def: being taken care of by somebody

examples.en: Her secrets were safe in his keeping.
examples.zh: 她的秘密由他保守。

senses.def: following behind somebody

examples.en: In the train of the rich and famous came the journalists.
examples.zh: 记者蜂拥在豪绅名流之后。

senses.def: being taken care of by somebody

examples.en: The family pet was left in the trust of a neighbour.
examples.zh: 这家的宠物委托邻居代管。

in somebody’s trust | in the trust of so.word: in somebody’s trust | in the trust of somebody

senses.def: instead of somebody/something

examples.en: Foxton was dismissed and John Smith was appointed in his stead.
examples.zh: 福克斯顿被解职，受命接替他的是约翰·史密斯。

in something's honor: @@@LINK=in honor of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honor
in something's honour: @@@LINK=in honour of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honour
in something's name: @@@LINK=in the name of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s name
in something's place: @@@LINK=in (the) place of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s place

senses.def: in large amounts or to a great degree

examples.en: He'd got his revenge now, and in spades.
examples.zh: 现在他报了仇，痛快淋漓地报了仇。

senses.def: in your thoughts

examples.en: I shall be with you in spirit (= thinking about you though not with you physically).
examples.zh: 我的心将和你在一起。

senses.def: if you say that somebody did something in spite of

examples.en: In spite of his age, he still leads an active life.
examples.zh: 尽管年事已高，他依旧过着一种忙碌的生活。

examples.en: They went swimming in spite of all the danger signs.
examples.zh: 他们无视那么多警告牌，还是去游泳了。

examples.en: English became the official language for business in spite of the fact that the population was largely Chinese.
examples.zh: 虽然当地居民主要是中国人，英语却成了商业上正式使用的语言。

senses.def: if you do something in spite of yourself

examples.en: He fell asleep, in spite of himself.
examples.zh: 他还是不由自主地睡着了。

examples.en: In spite of herself, tears welled up in her eyes.
examples.zh: 她的眼里不由自主地涌出了泪水。

senses.def: in short periods of great activity, powerful movement, etc., rather than in a steady, continuous way

examples.en: The water came out of the tap in spurts.
examples.zh: 水急速地从水龙头里喷出来。

examples.en: His breath came in short spurts.
examples.zh: 他的呼吸急促。

in sth's honor: @@@LINK=in honor of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honor
in sth's honour: @@@LINK=in honour of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s honour
in sth's name: @@@LINK=in the name of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s name
in sth's place: @@@LINK=in (the) place of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s place

senses.def: laughing a lot

examples.en: The play had us in stitches.
examples.zh: 那出戏让我们笑得前仰后合。

in stops and starts: @@@LINK=in stops and starts | by/in fits and starts

senses.def: frequently starting and stopping again; not continuously

examples.en: Babies do not grow at a steady rate but in stops and starts.
examples.zh: 婴儿成长的速度并非一成不变，而是长长停停，停停长长。

in stops and starts | by/in fits and sta.word: in stops and starts | by/in fits and starts

senses.def: waiting to happen to somebody
senses.zh: 即将发生（在某人身上）；等待着（某人）

examples.en: We don't know what life holds in store for us.
examples.zh: 我们不知道等待我们的将是什么样的生活。

examples.en: If she had known what lay in store for her, she would never have agreed to go.
examples.zh: 要是她事先知道会有什么遭遇的话，她是决不会同意去的。

examples.en: They think it'll be easy but they have a surprise in store.
examples.zh: 他们以为事情容易，到时候他们会吃惊的。

senses.def: used to introduce a short statement of the main points of a discussion, speech, etc.

examples.en: In sum, we have no chance of winning the case.
examples.zh: 总而言之，我们没有胜算。

senses.def: happening because something else has happened

examples.en: Share prices slipped in sympathy with the German market.
examples.zh: 受德国市场影响，股票价格出现下跌。

senses.def: moving or working at exactly the same time and speed as somebody/something else

examples.en: The soundtrack is not in sync with the picture.
examples.zh: 音画不同步。

senses.def: in agreement with somebody/something; working well with somebody/something

examples.en: His opinions were in sync with those of his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他的看法和同事的一致。

senses.def: if somebody/something works or happens in tandem
senses.zh: 并行；并驾齐驱；协同工作；同时实行

examples.en: The two systems are designed to work in tandem.
examples.zh: 这两套系统是为同步工作而设计的。

examples.en: Two designers worked in tandem on the plans.
examples.zh: 两位设计师协同制定了该计划。

examples.en: Stock prices pushed sharply higher this afternoon in tandem with a rise in the dollar.
examples.zh: 今天下午，随着美元的上涨，股价大幅上涨。

senses.def: torn in many places

examples.en: His clothes were in tatters.
examples.zh: 他的衣服破旧不堪。

senses.def: damaged too badly to be saved
senses.zh: 被毁坏的；破败的；坍塌的

examples.en: Her reputation was in tatters.
examples.zh: 她已名誉扫地。

examples.en: The government's education policy lies in tatters.
examples.zh: 政府的教育政策彻底破产了。

senses.def: used to show what aspect of a subject you are talking about or how you are thinking about it

examples.en: The job is great in terms of salary, but it has its disadvantages.
examples.zh: 就薪金而言，这个工作倒是挺不错的，但也有一些不利之处。

examples.en: This title ranks alongside the Olympics in terms of importance.
examples.zh: 这个头衔的重要性与奥运会齐名。

examples.en: What does this mean in terms of cost?
examples.zh: 就费用而言，这意味着什么？

examples.en: In terms of cost—how much were you thinking of charging?
examples.zh: 说到费用，你们想要多少？

examples.en: In terms of extra staff—how many will we need?
examples.zh: 就额外员工而言——我们需要多少人？

examples.en: In practical terms this law may be difficult to enforce.
examples.zh: 实际上，这条法规可能很难实施。

examples.en: The decision was disastrous in political terms.
examples.zh: 从政治上来看，这个决定是灾难性的。

examples.en: He's talking in terms of starting a completely new career.
examples.zh: 他正在谈论开创全新的事业。

in terms of something | in… terms.word: in terms of something | in… terms

senses.def: for the reason that; because

examples.en: She was fortunate in that she had friends to help her.
examples.zh: 她很幸运，有一些朋友帮助她。

senses.def: if that happens or has happened; if that is the situation
senses.zh: 既然那样；假使那样的话

examples.en: ‘I’ve made up my mind.’ ‘In that case, there’s no point discussing it.’
examples.zh: “我已经拿定主意了。”“既然如此，讨论这件事就毫无意义了。”

senses.def: if that happens
senses.zh: 如果是那样的话；如果那种事情发生

examples.en: In that event, we will have to reconsider our offer.
examples.zh: 如果是那样的话，我们就得重新考虑我们的建议。

senses.def: in a general way, without referring to a particular real person, thing or situation

examples.en: Legal questions rarely exist in the abstract; they are based on real cases.
examples.zh: 法律问题很少以抽象理论形式存在，它们是以真实的案例为基础的。

examples.en: I’m just talking in the abstract now.
examples.zh: 我现在只是在抽象地谈论。

senses.def: while you are doing something

examples.en: He was caught in the act of stealing a car.
examples.zh: 他偷汽车时被当场逮个正着。

examples.en: It is often difficult to tell when someone is using drugs unless they are caught in the act.
examples.zh: 通常很难判断某人何时使用毒品，除非当场被抓获。

senses.def: felt by a number of people to exist or to be happening
senses.zh: 在传播中；流行；可感觉到

examples.en: There's romance in the air.

examples.zh: 艾丽斯站着凝视远方。

examples.zh: 五英里的沙子一直延伸到远处。

examples.zh: 科技热潮使得股价飙升到极高的水平。

examples.zh: 她跟不上其他人的舞步。

examples.zh: 他在漫长的一生中目睹了许许多多的变化。

examples.zh: 这家公司今后几年将面临重大的挑战。

examples.zh: 他看见谁就对谁吼叫。

examples.zh: 政府在提供基本服务方面的无能

examples.zh: 青少年的语言成人往往完全听不懂。

examples.zh: 不确切的说法

examples.zh: 我们不能根据不准确的信息进行预测。

examples.zh: 我们所有的地图误差都非常大。

examples.zh: 统计图表可能不准确且具有误导性。

examples.zh: 这部作品被错误地描述为第一部美国侦探小说。

examples.zh: 他们指责政府在铁路安全问题上无所作为。

examples.zh: 有些动物白天不活动。

examples.zh: 他不得不正视自身作为父亲的不足。

senses.zh: 不充分的；不足的；不够的

examples.zh: 供应短缺

examples.zh: 这个系统要完成它的任务还不够完善。

examples.zh: 食物供应还不足以应付饥民的需求。

examples.zh: 我觉得我作为父亲（或母亲）完全不称职。

examples.zh: 工作人员似乎没有得到足够的介绍和培训。

senses.def: the fact of doing something by accident, without intending to

examples.zh: 我们无意之中未付账就离开了。

examples.zh: 这次旅行带孩子不妥当。

examples.zh: 政府介入这场争端是非常不可取的。

examples.zh: 最后一个问题尤其愚蠢。
