senses.zh: 非人的；（似非人所为而）恐怖的

examples.en: There was a strange inhuman sound.
examples.zh: 有一种不像人发出的奇怪声音。

senses.def: not caring about the pain or problems of other people or animals; very cruel
senses.zh: （对待人或动物）残忍的，不人道的

examples.en: inhumane treatment of animals/prisoners
examples.zh: 对动物／囚犯的非人对待

senses.def: in a very cruel way, showing no care for the pain or problems of other people or animals
cruel behaviour or treatment; the fact of not having the usual human qualities of showing sympathy and being kind
senses.zh: 残酷的行为（或对待）；无人性；不人道

examples.en: man’s inhumanity to man
examples.zh: 人类相残

examples.en: the inhumanities of the prison system
examples.zh: 监狱制度的不人道

senses.def: the act of burying dead people, used especially in relation to ancient times
(1573-1652) an English architect and stage designer who introduced Palladianism
senses.zh: （1573-1652）是一位英国建筑师和舞台设计师，向英国介绍了Palladianism（一种意大利风格）。在他的建筑物中，有格林威治的女王之家，伦敦的考文特花园广场和林肯的旅馆领域。他还与本·琼森（Ben Jonson）合作为国王詹姆斯一世（James I）制作假面（带有音乐和舞蹈的戏剧）。

senses.def: harmful to something; not helping something

examples.en: These policies are inimical to the interests of society.
examples.zh: 这些政策有损于社会的利益。

senses.def: not friendly

examples.en: an inimical stare
examples.zh: 敌意的注视

senses.def: too good or individual for anyone else to copy with the same effect
senses.zh: 无与伦比的；无法仿效的

examples.en: John related in his own inimitable way the story of his trip to Tibet.
examples.zh: 约翰以他自己特有的方式讲述了他的西藏之行。

examples.en: the inimitable Frank Sinatra
examples.zh: 无与伦比的弗兰克·辛纳屈

senses.def: very wrong and unfair
senses.zh: 极其错误的；极不公正的

examples.en: an iniquitous system/practice
examples.zh: 很不公正的制度／做法

senses.def: the fact of being very wrong and unfair; something that is very wrong and unfair
senses.zh: 很不公正，十分错误，很不正当（的事）

examples.en: the iniquity of racial prejudice
examples.zh: 种族偏见的罪恶

examples.en: the iniquities of the criminal justice system
examples.zh: 刑事司法系统的不公正之处

senses.def: happening at the beginning; first

examples.en: There is an initial payment of £60 followed by ten instalments of £25.
examples.zh: 首期付款60英镑，接下来还有十次25英镑的分期付款。

examples.en: The government will make an initial investment of $ 4.7 billion in the company.
examples.zh: 政府将对该公司初始投资47亿美元。

examples.en: in the initial stages (= at the beginning) of the campaign
examples.zh: 运动的最初阶段

examples.en: an initial phase/period
examples.zh: 初始阶段/时期

examples.en: an initial assessment/investigation/report
examples.zh: 初步评估/调查/报告

examples.en: My initial reaction was to decline the offer.
examples.zh: 我最初的反应是婉言谢绝这个提议。

examples.en: Her initial response was one of anger.
examples.zh: 她最初的反应是愤怒。

senses.def: the first letter of a person’s first name or middle name

examples.en: ‘What initial is it, Mrs Owen?’ ‘It's J, J for Jane.’
examples.zh: “首字母是什么，欧文太太？”“是 J，Jane 的 J。”

examples.en: ‘What's your middle initial?’ ‘M—I'm John M Butler.’
examples.zh: “你的中间名首字母是什么？”“M——我是约翰·M·巴特勒。”

examples.en: We have the same initials and surname.
examples.zh: 我们有相同的名字首字母和姓氏。

senses.def: the first letters of all the names of a person or thing

examples.en: John Fitzgerald Kennedy was often known by his initials JFK.
examples.zh: 人们常以姓名的首字母 JFK 称约翰·菲茨杰拉德·肯尼迪。

examples.en: Just write your initials.
examples.zh: 写下你的姓名首字母即可。

senses.def: to mark or sign something with your initials
senses.zh: 用姓名的首字母作标记（或签名）于

examples.en: Please initial each page and sign in the space provided.
examples.zh: 请在每一页写上姓名首字母并在规定的空白处签字。

examples.en: The agreement was finally initialled on May 8.
examples.zh: 该协议最终于5月8日草签。

senses.def: the act of selling shares in a company for the first time
senses.zh: 首次公开发行股票；新股首发；新股上市

senses.def: a word formed from the first letters of the words that make up the name of something, with each letter pronounced separately, for example ‘CD’ is an initialism for ‘compact disc’
senses.zh: 首字母缩略词（缩略词按每个字母单独发音，如 CD）

senses.def: the act of making a computer program or system ready for use or of formatting
senses.zh: 初始化（计算机程序或系统）；预置；格式化（磁盘）

senses.def: to make a computer program or system ready for use or format
senses.zh: 初始化（计算机程序或系统）；预置；格式化（磁盘）

examples.en: The other option is to initialize the hard drive and reload all your programs.
examples.zh: 另一种选择是初始化硬盘并重新加载所有程序。

senses.def: at the beginning

examples.en: Initially, the system worked well.
examples.zh: 系统起初运作得很好。

examples.en: More people had been infected than was initially thought.
examples.zh: 感染的人数比最初想象的要多。

examples.en: He was initially reluctant to join the project.
examples.zh: 他起初不愿意参加这个项目。

examples.en: The scientific work will be conducted, at least initially, at our laboratories.
examples.zh: 科学工作至少在最初将在我们的实验室进行。

senses.def: to make something begin

examples.en: to initiate legal proceedings against somebody
examples.zh: 对某人提起诉讼

examples.en: The government has initiated a programme of economic reform.
examples.zh: 政府已开始实施经济改革方案。

senses.def: to explain something to somebody and/or make them experience it for the first time
senses.zh: 使了解；传授；教…开始尝试

examples.en: She was initiated into classical music by her mother.
examples.zh: 她是在母亲的影响下开始接触古典音乐的。

examples.en: His uncle initiated him into the pleasures of sailing.
examples.zh: 他的叔叔让他开始享受航海的乐趣。

senses.def: to make somebody a member of a particular group, especially as part of a secret ceremony
senses.zh: （尤指在秘密仪式上）使加入，接纳，吸收

examples.en: Hundreds are initiated into the sect each year.
examples.zh: 每年有好几百人被接纳到这个教派中。

senses.def: a person who has been allowed to join a particular group, organization, or religion and is learning its rules and secrets
senses.zh: 新加入某组织（或机构、宗教）的人；新入会的人

senses.def: the act of somebody becoming a member of a group, often with a special ceremony; the act of introducing somebody to an activity or skill
senses.zh: （常指通过特别仪式的）入会；介绍某人初试某活动（或技艺）

examples.en: There was an established initiation ceremony for new boys.
examples.zh: 对于新来的男孩，有一种既定的入会仪式。

examples.en: The gym charges an initiation fee of $125.
examples.zh: 健身房收取 125 美元的入会费。

examples.en: her initiation into the world of marketing
examples.zh: 她初次涉足营销界

senses.def: the act of starting something

examples.en: It is generally the police who deal with the initiation of criminal proceedings.
examples.zh: 通常由警察负责启动刑事诉讼。

senses.def: a new plan for dealing with a particular problem or for achieving a particular purpose

examples.en: a United Nations peace initiative
examples.zh: 联合国的和平倡议

examples.en: Most policy initiatives come from the White House.
examples.zh: 大多数政策倡议是由白宫发起的。

examples.en: to launch an initiative
examples.zh: 发起新计划

examples.en: The money was intended to support initiatives in bilingual education.
examples.zh: 这笔资金旨在支持双语教育举措。

examples.en: new initiatives to improve animal welfare
examples.zh: 改善动物福利的新计划

examples.en: a government initiative to combat unemployment
examples.zh: 政府应付失业问题的新方案

examples.en: a joint initiative by the Scottish and UK governments
examples.zh: 苏格兰和英国政府的联合倡议

examples.en: an initiative for peace and human rights
examples.zh: 旨在维护和平、保障人权的新举措

senses.def: the ability to decide and act on your own without waiting for somebody to tell you what to do

examples.en: He said I was lazy and had no initiative.
examples.zh: 他说我懒，没有主动性。

examples.en: You won't get much help. You'll have to use your initiative.
examples.zh: 你不会得到多少帮助的。你得自己想办法。

examples.en: She needs to show more initiative if she wants to succeed.
examples.zh: 如果她想成功，她需要表现出更多的主动性。

examples.en: Too much bureaucracy represses creativity and initiative.
examples.zh: 过多的官僚主义压制了创造力和主动性。

examples.en: She did it on her own initiative (= without anyone telling her to do it).
examples.zh: 她是主动这么做的。

senses.def: the power or opportunity to act and gain an advantage before other people do
senses.zh: 主动权；首先行动的机会

examples.en: to seize/regain the initiative
examples.zh: 掌握先机；重获主动权

examples.en: It was up to the US to take the initiative in repairing relations.
examples.zh: 应该由美国主动修补关系。

senses.def: (in some states of the US) a process by which ordinary people can suggest a new law by signing a petition
senses.zh: （美国某些州的）公民立法提案程序

examples.en: a ballot initiative to establish a local minimum wage
examples.zh: 制定当地最低工资的公民立法提案程序

examples.en: The rights of referendum and initiative foster active participation by citizens.
examples.zh: 公投权和倡议权促进公民的积极参与。

senses.def: the person who starts something

examples.en: the initiator of the project
examples.zh: 此项目的发起人

senses.def: to put a drug or other substance into a person’s or an animal’s body using a syringe

examples.en: Adrenaline was injected into the muscle.
examples.zh: 往肌肉里注射了肾上腺素。

examples.en: The anaesthetic is injected locally.
examples.zh: 麻醉剂是局部注射的。

examples.en: She has been injecting herself with insulin since the age of 16.
examples.zh: 她从 16 岁起就开始自行注射胰岛素。

examples.en: The animals were injected with small amounts of the chemical.
examples.zh: 这些动物被注射了少量的化学物质。

examples.en: She ran courses to train other beauticians how to inject.
examples.zh: 她开设课程来培训其他美容师如何注射。

senses.def: to put a liquid or other substance into something using a syringe

examples.en: The fruit is injected with chemicals to reduce decay.
examples.zh: 水果注入了化学药品以防腐坏。

examples.en: Chemicals are injected into the fruit to reduce decay.
examples.zh: 水果注入了化学药品以防腐坏。

examples.en: Foam is injected into the walls where it expands and provides insulation.
examples.zh: 泡沫被注入到墙壁中，泡沫在其中膨胀并提供隔热作用。

senses.def: to add a particular quality to something

examples.en: His comments injected a note of humour into the proceedings.
examples.zh: 他的发言给整个活动增添了一丝幽默的气氛。

examples.en: They are hoping a change of leader will inject new energy into the movement.
examples.zh: 他们希望领导人的更迭能为这场运动注入新的活力。

examples.en: trying to inject some new life into their marriage
examples.zh: 试图为他们的婚姻注入一些新的生命

senses.def: to give money to an organization, a project, etc. so that it can function

examples.en: They are refusing to inject any more capital into the industry.
examples.zh: 他们拒绝对这一产业投入更多的资金。

senses.def: an act of injecting

examples.en: to give somebody an injection
examples.zh: 给某人打针

examples.en: He was treated with penicillin injections.
examples.zh: 他接受了青霉素注射。

examples.en: daily injections of insulin
examples.zh: 每天的胰岛素注射

examples.en: An anaesthetic was administered by injection.
examples.zh: 麻醉剂已注射入体内。

examples.en: In some US states execution is by lethal injection.
examples.zh: 美国的一些州是通过注射毒剂来执行死刑的。

senses.def: a large sum of money that is spent to help improve a situation, business, etc.

examples.en: The theatre faces closure unless it gets an urgent cash injection.
examples.zh: 剧院面临着倒闭，除非有大笔救急现金投入。

senses.def: an act of forcing a liquid or other substance into something

examples.en: a 2-litre direct injection engine
examples.zh: 2升直喷发动机

senses.def: given a shape by being heated and poured into a mould
a way of shaping plastic or rubber by heating it and pouring it into a mould

examples.en: plastic light fittings produced by injection moulding
examples.zh: 通过注塑成型生产的塑料灯具

senses.def: not sensible or wise; not appropriate in a particular situation

examples.en: an injudicious remark
examples.zh: 不当的言语

senses.def: in a way that is not sensible or wise; in a way that is not appropriate in a particular situation
an official order given by a court that demands that something must or must not be done

examples.en: to seek/obtain an injunction
examples.zh: 请求／得到强制令

examples.en: She took out an injunction to prevent the press from publishing the information.
examples.zh: 她拿到了一份阻止新闻媒体发布这条消息的禁制令。

examples.en: The court granted an injunction against the defendants.
examples.zh: 法庭对被告发出了禁制令。

senses.def: a warning or an order from somebody in authority

examples.en: The ordinary members will follow the injunction of the party leadership.
examples.zh: 普通党员要听从党的领导的指示。

senses.def: to harm yourself or somebody else physically, especially in an accident

examples.en: He injured his knee playing hockey.
examples.zh: 他打曲棍球时弄伤了膝盖。

examples.en: Three people were killed and five injured in the crash.
examples.zh: 撞车事故中有三人死亡，五人受伤。

examples.en: She injured herself during training.
examples.zh: 她在训练时受了伤。

examples.en: She was seriously injured in a riding accident.
examples.zh: 她骑马时发生意外，受了重伤。

examples.en: During the Second World War he was badly injured by a bomb.
examples.zh: 第二次世界大战期间，他被炸弹炸成重伤。

examples.en: She was hit by an unmarked police car and severely injured.
examples.zh: 她被一辆没有标记的警车撞到，受了重伤。

examples.en: The man was critically injured after falling from a ladder.
examples.zh: 该男子从梯子上摔下来后受重伤。

senses.def: to damage somebody’s reputation, interests, feelings, etc.
senses.zh: 损害，伤害（名誉、利益、感情等）

examples.en: This could seriously injure the company's reputation.
examples.zh: 这会严重损害公司的声誉。

examples.en: espionage activity that was likely to injure the national interest
examples.zh: 可能损害国家利益的间谍活动

synonyms.words: wound ▪ hurt ▪ bruise ▪ sprain ▪ pull ▪ strain

intro.en: These words all mean to harm yourself or somebody else physically, especially in an accident.
intro.zh: 以上各词主要指在事故中伤害、使受伤。

items.def: to harm yourself or somebody else physically, especially in an accident:
items.zh: 尤指在事故中伤害、使受伤

examples.en: He injured his knee playing hockey.
examples.zh: 他打曲棍球时弄伤了膝盖。

items.def: [often passive] (rather formal) to injure part of the body, especially by making a hole in the skin using a weapon:
items.zh: 指使身体受伤，尤指用武器伤害

examples.en: 50 people were seriously wounded in the attack.
examples.zh: 这次攻击中有 50 人受重伤。

items.def: to cause physical pain to somebody/​yourself; to injure somebody/​yourself:
items.zh: 指（使）疼痛、受伤

examples.en: Did you hurt yourself?
examples.zh: 你伤着自己了吗？

items.def: to make a blue, brown or purple mark (= a bruise) appear on the skin after somebody has fallen or been hit; to develop a bruise
items.zh: 指摔伤、撞伤、（使）出现瘀伤

items.def: to injure part of your body, especially your ankle, wrist or knee, by suddenly twisting it, causing pain and swelling
items.zh: 指扭伤（踝、腕、膝）

items.def: to damage a muscle, etc., by using too much force
items.zh: 指拉伤、扭伤（肌肉等）

items.def: to injure yourself or part of your body by making it work too hard:
items.zh: 指损伤、拉伤、扭伤

examples.en: Don’t strain your eyes by reading in poor light.
examples.zh: 别在光线不足的地方看书把眼睛给伤了。

senses.def: causing or likely to cause harm or damage

examples.en: injurious to health
examples.zh: 有害健康的

examples.en: injurious effects
examples.zh: 有害影响

senses.def: harm done to a person’s or an animal’s body, for example in an accident

examples.en: Two people sustained minor injuries.
examples.zh: 两人受轻伤。

examples.en: One of the girls suffered serious injuries.
examples.zh: 其中一个女孩受了重伤。

examples.en: He was lucky to escape injury.
examples.zh: 他很幸运，没有受伤。

examples.en: The passengers escaped with only minor injuries.
examples.zh: 乘客们成功逃脱，仅受轻伤。

examples.en: As a result of the accident, several passengers sustained serious head injuries.
examples.zh: 几名乘客因这起事故头部受了重伤。

examples.en: One youth was treated for injuries to his arm.
examples.zh: 一个年轻人因手臂受伤接受了治疗。

examples.en: He died from multiple injuries caused by the accident.
examples.zh: 他因事故造成多处受伤而死亡。

examples.en: There were no injuries in the crash (= no people injured).
examples.zh: 撞车事故中无人受伤。

examples.en: No damage or injuries were reported.
examples.zh: 没有损坏或受伤的报告。

examples.en: These new guidelines will help save lives and prevent injury.
examples.zh: 这些新指南将有助于拯救生命并防止伤害。

examples.en: Taking a few simple precautions will reduce your risk of injury.
examples.zh: 采取一些简单的预防措施可以降低受伤的风险。

examples.en: This could result in serious injury or even death.
examples.zh: 这可能会导致严重伤害甚至死亡。

examples.en: Two players are out of the team because of injury.
examples.zh: 两名队员因伤退出了比赛。

examples.en: Don't do that. You'll do yourself an injury (= hurt yourself).
examples.zh: 别那样做。你会把自己弄伤的。

senses.def: damage to a person’s feelings

examples.en: Damages may be awarded for emotional injury.
examples.zh: 可能会判处精神伤害赔偿。

senses.def: to make a bad relationship with somebody worse by offending them even more
senses.zh: 伤害之余又侮辱；（冒犯别人）令关系恶化

examples.en: Then, to add insult to injury, they told me I couldn't get on the flight.
examples.zh: 更糟糕的是，他们随后又告诉我说我不能登机。

examples.en: It adds insult to injury that banks are allowed to increase their charges without our knowledge or consent.
examples.zh: 银行可以在我们不知情或者未同意的情况下提高收费，这可真是雪上加霜。

examples.en: Only 300 people came to the match and, to add insult to injury, the floodlights went out during the second half.
examples.zh: 只有区区300 人来看比赛，更糟糕的是，下半场连泛光灯都不亮了。

senses.def: to make a bad relationship with somebody worse by offending them even more
senses.zh: 伤害之余又侮辱；（冒犯别人）令关系恶化

examples.en: Then, to add insult to injury, they told me I couldn't get on the flight.
examples.zh: 更糟糕的是，他们随后又告诉我说我不能登机。

examples.en: It adds insult to injury that banks are allowed to increase their charges without our knowledge or consent.
examples.zh: 银行可以在我们不知情或者未同意的情况下提高收费，这可真是雪上加霜。

examples.en: Only 300 people came to the match and, to add insult to injury, the floodlights went out during the second half.
examples.zh: 只有区区300 人来看比赛，更糟糕的是，下半场连泛光灯都不亮了。

senses.def: time added at the end of a game of football (soccer), hockey, etc. because the game has been interrupted by injured players needing treatment
senses.zh: 伤停补时（足球、曲棍球等比赛为弥补因队员受伤处理而延迟结束的时间）

examples.en: They scored two goals in injury time.
examples.zh: 他们在伤停补时阶段进了两个球。

senses.def: the fact of a situation being unfair and of people not being treated equally; an unfair act or an example of unfair treatment
senses.zh: 不公正，不公平（的对待或行为）

examples.en: We are committed to fighting against poverty and injustice.
examples.zh: 我们致力于消除贫困和不公正。

examples.en: a burning sense of injustice
examples.zh: 强烈感觉到遭受不公正待遇

examples.en: Social and political injustice seemed to be getting worse rather than better.
examples.zh: 社会和政治不公正似乎变得更糟而不是更好。

examples.en: She was enraged at the injustice of the remark.
examples.zh: 她被那句话的不公激怒了。

examples.en: The report exposes the injustices of the system.
examples.zh: 报告揭露了这个制度的种种不公正。

senses.def: to judge yourself/somebody unfairly

examples.en: We may have been doing him an injustice. This work is good.
examples.zh: 我们可能冤枉他了。这工作干得不错。

examples.en: Perhaps I'm doing you an injustice.
examples.zh: 我可能冤枉你了。

senses.def: to judge yourself/somebody unfairly

examples.en: We may have been doing him an injustice. This work is good.
examples.zh: 我们可能冤枉他了。这工作干得不错。

examples.en: Perhaps I'm doing you an injustice.
examples.zh: 我可能冤枉你了。

senses.def: coloured liquid for writing, drawing and printing

examples.en: written in ink
examples.zh: 用墨水写的

examples.en: different coloured inks
examples.zh: 各种颜色的墨水

senses.def: a tattoo

examples.en: She likes to wear clothes that show off her ink.
examples.zh: 她喜欢穿能展示墨水的衣服。

examples.en: He lifted up his shirt so that we could see his two new inks.

examples.zh: 不能手术治疗的脑瘤

examples.en: a coroner’s inquest into his death
examples.zh: 进行验尸以探究他的死因

examples.en: At the inquest they heard that the car had driven off after the accident.
examples.zh: 在调查中，他们得知这辆车在事故发生后就开走了。

senses.def: a discussion about something that has failed

examples.en: An inquest was held on the team's poor performance.
examples.zh: 对该队在比赛中的差劲表现进行了检讨。

examples.en: There will inevitably be an inquest into the team's poor performance.
examples.zh: 对该队的差劲表现必然要进行检讨。

senses.def: to ask somebody for some information

examples.en: I called the school to inquire about the application process.
examples.zh: 我给学校打电话询问申请流程。

examples.en: She inquired as to your whereabouts.
examples.zh: 她询问你的下落。

examples.en: He inquired why you were so late.
examples.zh: 他问你为什么这么晚。

examples.en: He inquired her name.
examples.zh: 他询问她的名字。

examples.en: ‘What is your name?’ he inquired.
examples.zh: “你叫什么名字？”他问道。

intro.en: These words all mean to say or write something in the form of a question, in order to get information.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含口头或书面询问之义。

items.def: to say or write something in the form of a question, in order to get information:
items.zh: 指口头或书面提问、询问

examples.en: ‘Where are you going?’ she asked.
examples.zh: “你去哪里？”她问道。

items.def: (rather formal) to ask somebody for information:
items.zh: 指询问、查询

examples.en: I called the station to enquire about train times.
examples.zh: 我打电话到车站询问了火车时刻。

items.def: to make a very strong request for information:
items.zh: 指严正地问、质问

examples.en: ‘And where have you been?’ he demanded angrily.
examples.zh: “那你去了哪里？”他怒气冲冲地质问道。

senses.def: to ask for information about somebody, especially about their health or about what they are doing
to find out more information about something

examples.en: A committee was appointed to inquire into the allegations.
examples.zh: 任命了一个委员会来调查这些指控。

senses.def: to ask somebody something
senses.zh: 向某人打听（或询问、了解）

examples.en: ‘Will you be staying for lunch?’ she inquired of Charles.
examples.zh: “你会留下来吃午饭吗？”她问查尔斯。

senses.def: a person who asks for information
showing an interest in learning new things
senses.zh: 爱探索的；好奇的；好问的

examples.en: a child with an inquiring mind
examples.zh: 一个有好奇心的孩子

senses.def: asking for information

examples.en: an inquiring look
examples.zh: 追究的神情。

examples.en: He raised an inquiring eyebrow in my direction.
examples.zh: 他向我的方向扬起了询问的眉毛。

senses.def: in a way that asks for information
senses.zh: 询问地：以询问信息的方式

examples.en: She looked at him inquiringly.
examples.zh: 她询问地看着他。

senses.def: an official process to find out the cause of something or to find out information about something

examples.en: a murder inquiry
examples.zh: 谋杀案调查

examples.en: a public inquiry into the environmental effects of the proposed new road
examples.zh: 对拟议新道路的环境影响进行公开调查

examples.en: to hold/conduct/launch an inquiry into the affair
examples.zh: 对事件进行/进行/启动调查

senses.def: a request for information about somebody/something; a question about somebody/something

examples.en: inquiries from prospective students about courses
examples.zh: 未来学生对课程的询问

examples.en: We received over 300 inquiries about the job.
examples.zh: 我们收到了 300 多个有关该职位的询问。

examples.en: Greetings and inquiries about family members tend to be in the local dialect.
examples.zh: 对家人的问候和询问往往用当地方言。

examples.en: I'll have to make a few inquiries and get back to you.
examples.zh: 我得做一些调查并回复你。

examples.en: For further inquiries, please call…
examples.zh: 如需进一步咨询，请致电...

examples.en: All inquiries should be addressed to the customer services department.
examples.zh: 所有询问均应向客户服务部门提出。

examples.en: Two men have been helping police with their inquries (= are being questioned about a crime, but have not been charged with it).
examples.zh: 两名男子一直在帮助警方进行询问（=正在接受有关犯罪的询问，但尚未受到指控）。

senses.def: the act of asking questions or collecting information about somebody/something

examples.en: scientific inquiry
examples.zh: 科学研究

examples.en: The police are following several lines of inquiry.
examples.zh: 警方正沿几条线索进行调查。

examples.en: a commission/committee of inquiry
examples.zh: 调查委员会/调查委员会

senses.def: a place where you can get information

examples.en: Ask at inquiries to see if your bag has been handed in.
examples.zh: 请通过询问处询问您的行李是否已上交。

senses.def: the organization set up by the Roman Catholic Church to punish people who opposed its beliefs, especially from the fifteenth to the seventeenth century
senses.zh: （尤指 15 到 17 世纪天主教的）宗教裁判所，异端裁判所

senses.def: a series of questions that somebody asks you, especially when they ask them in an unpleasant way
senses.zh: 一连串的提问；（尤指）盘问，责难

examples.en: She then subjected me to an inquisition about my romantic life.
examples.zh: 然后她对我进行了关于我的浪漫生活的调查。

senses.def: asking too many questions and trying to find out about what other people are doing, etc.

examples.en: Don't be so inquisitive. It's none of your business!
examples.zh: 别这么追根问底的。这与你无关！

senses.def: very interested in learning about many different things
senses.zh: 好学的；好奇的；兴趣广泛的

examples.en: a highly inquisitive mind
examples.zh: 非常好学的头脑

examples.en: The young man possessed a sharp and inquisitive mind.
examples.zh: 这个年轻人头脑敏锐、勤学好问。

senses.def: in a way that shows you are trying to find out about what other people are doing, etc.

examples.en: Cath looked at her aunt inquisitively.
examples.zh: 凯丝好奇地看着她的阿姨。

senses.def: a strong interest in learning about many different things
senses.zh: 好学的；好奇的；兴趣广泛的

examples.en: She was impressed by the inquisitiveness of the children.
examples.zh: 孩子们的好奇心给她留下了深刻的印象。

senses.def: a desire to find out about what other people are doing, etc, especially by asking a lot of questions
senses.zh: 好奇心：渴望了解别人在做什么，等等，尤其是通过问很多问题来表示好奇心（1）

senses.def: a person who asks a lot of difficult questions, especially in a way that makes you feel threatened
senses.zh: 连续不断地发问的人；（尤指）盘问者

senses.def: an officer of the inquisition
asking for information, especially in a threatening
senses.zh: 询问：询问信息，尤其是以威胁的方式持续很长时间

examples.en: He questioned her in a cold inquisitorial voice.
examples.zh: 他用审判似的冰冷声音质问她。

senses.def: a meeting that is inquorate
something that is achieved, especially by reducing the power or success of something else
senses.zh: （尤指通过消耗或削弱其他事物取得的）进展

examples.en: This deal is their first major inroad into the American market.
examples.zh: 这交易是他们进军美国市场的首次重大收获。

senses.def: if one thing makes inroads into

examples.en: Tax rises have made some inroads into the country's national debt.
examples.zh: 增加税收已使国债有所减少。

examples.en: By the 1950s, television had made great inroads into the territory of the news magazines.
examples.zh: 到了 20 世纪 50 年代，电视已经大举进军新闻杂志的领域。

senses.def: if one thing makes inroads into

examples.en: Tax rises have made some inroads into the country's national debt.
examples.zh: 增加税收已使国债有所减少。

examples.en: By the 1950s, television had made great inroads into the territory of the news magazines.
examples.zh: 到了 20 世纪 50 年代，电视已经大举进军新闻杂志的领域。

senses.def: a sudden flow towards the inside

examples.en: an inrush of air/water
examples.zh: 空气／水的涌入

senses.def: dirty and unpleasant, possibly connected with immoral
senses.zh: 肮脏的；污七八糟的；乌烟瘴气的；下流的

examples.en: an insalubrious part of town
examples.zh: 城里不卫生的地方

senses.def: very stupid, crazy or dangerous
senses.zh: 十分愚蠢的；疯狂的；危险的

examples.en: I must have been insane to agree to the idea.
examples.zh: 我肯定是犯傻了，居然同意了这个想法。

senses.def: extremely annoyed; angry

examples.en: This job is driving me insane.
examples.zh: 这工作令我快气疯了。

examples.en: She was driving me insane with her constant chatter.
examples.zh: 她唠叨个没完，快把我逼疯了。

senses.def: shocking
senses.zh: 令人震惊或非常令人印象深刻；非常大、高、好等等。

examples.en: The prices are insane.
examples.zh: 价格太疯狂了。

examples.en: We sold insane amounts of ice cream that day.
examples.zh: 那天我们卖出了惊人数量的冰淇淋。

examples.en: It's insane how talented this guy is.
examples.zh: 这家伙的天赋真是太疯狂了。

senses.def: having a serious mental illness that makes somebody unable to think or behave normally
senses.zh: 精神失常的；精神错乱的

examples.en: Doctors certified him as insane.
examples.zh: 医生证明他精神失常。

examples.en: The prisoners were slowly going insane.
examples.zh: 囚犯正慢慢地变得精神错乱起来。

senses.def: people who are insane
senses.zh: 精神失常的人；精神错乱的人

examples.en: a hospital for the insane
examples.zh: 精神病院

senses.def: to an unreasonable degree

examples.en: He is insanely jealous.
examples.zh: 他嫉妒得发疯。

senses.def: in a crazy way

examples.en: She laughs insanely.
examples.zh: 她笑得很疯狂。

senses.def: dirty and likely to spread disease

examples.en: They were forced to live in overcrowded and insanitary conditions.
examples.zh: 他们被迫生活在拥挤且不卫生的环境中。

senses.def: the state of being insane
senses.zh: 精神失常；精神错乱；精神病

examples.en: He was found not guilty, by reason of insanity.
examples.zh: 他因精神失常而获判无罪。

examples.en: The legal definition of insanity varies from one jurisdiction to another.
examples.zh: 精神错乱的法律定义因司法管辖区而异。

senses.def: actions that are very stupid and possibly dangerous
senses.zh: 十分愚蠢的行为；荒唐的行为

examples.en: It would be sheer insanity to attempt the trip in such bad weather.
examples.zh: 天气这么糟糕还要去旅行，太荒唐了。

examples.en: Congress must put a stop to this insanity.
examples.zh: 国会必须制止这种疯狂行为。

examples.en: But the show does capture the various insanities and absurdities of his life.
examples.zh: 但这部剧确实捕捉到了他生活中的各种疯狂和荒谬。

senses.def: always wanting more of something; not able to be satisfied

examples.en: an insatiable appetite/curiosity/thirst
examples.zh: 永不满足的食欲／好奇心／渴望

examples.en: There seems to be an insatiable demand for more powerful computers.
examples.zh: 人们对计算机性能的要求似乎永无止境。

examples.en: The public seems to have an insatiable appetite for celebrity news.
examples.zh: 公众对名人新闻的渴求似乎永无餍足。

senses.def: in a way that cannot be satisfied
senses.zh: 不能满足地：以无法满足的方式

examples.en: insatiably curious/greedy/hungry
examples.zh: 永不满足的好奇/贪婪/饥饿

senses.def: the inner nature of a person or thing as shown in a work of art, especially in a poem
senses.zh: （艺术作品尤其是诗歌中所表现的人或物的）内在特性，本质

senses.def: to write or cut words, your name, etc. onto something
senses.zh: 在…上写（词语、名字等）；题；刻

examples.en: His name was inscribed on the trophy.
examples.zh: 他的名字刻在奖杯上。

examples.en: The names of the king and queen were inscribed above the door.
examples.zh: 门上方刻着国王和王后的名字。

examples.en: The trophy was inscribed with his name.
examples.zh: 奖杯上刻着他的名字。

examples.en: She signed the book and inscribed the words ‘with grateful thanks’ on it.
examples.zh: 她在书上签了名，并在上面写道“谨致由衷感谢”。

examples.en: He was presented with an inscribed gold watch.
examples.zh: 他收到了一块刻有铭文的金表。

senses.def: words written in the front of a book or cut in stone or metal
senses.zh: （书首页的）题词；（石头或金属上）刻写的文字，铭刻，碑文

examples.en: There was an inscription carved over the doorway.
examples.zh: 门口刻着一段铭文。

examples.en: There are no inscriptions or markings to identify the tombs.
examples.zh: 没有任何铭文或标记来识别坟墓。

senses.def: the fact of being impossible to understand or interpret, for example because somebody does not show any emotion so you don't know what they are thinking or feeling
senses.zh: 难以理解：无法理解或解释的事实，例如因为某人没有表现出任何情感，所以您不知道他们在想什么或感觉到

senses.def: impossible to understand or interpret

examples.en: He was wearing that inscrutable look again.
examples.zh: 他又流露出那种难以捉摸的表情。

examples.en: Her face had become inscrutable.
examples.zh: 她的脸色变得深不可测。

examples.en: Unfortunately, this language is largely inscrutable to non-specialists.
examples.zh: 不幸的是，这种语言对于非专业人士来说基本上是难以理解的。

senses.def: in a way that is impossible to understand or interpret, for example because somebody does not show any emotion so you don't know what they are thinking or feeling
senses.zh: 难以理解：以一种无法理解或解释的方式，例如因为某人没有表现出任何情绪，所以您不知道他们在想什么或感觉到什么

senses.def: a measurement of the length of the inside of somebody’s leg, used for making or choosing trousers of the correct size
any small creature with six legs and a body divided into three parts. Insects

examples.en: Most birds spend most of the day eating insects.
examples.zh: 大多数鸟类一天的大部分时间都在吃昆虫。

examples.en: There are about 30 million species of insects in the world.
examples.zh: 世界上大约有 3000 万种昆虫。

examples.en: insect species
examples.zh: 昆虫种类

examples.en: insect repellent (= a chemical that keeps insects away)
examples.zh: 驱虫剂

examples.en: an insect bite
examples.zh: 昆虫咬伤

examples.en: The pesticide is lethal to all insect life.
examples.zh: 这种杀虫剂可以杀死所有昆虫。

examples.en: methods to ensure the plants are as free of disease and insect pests as possible
examples.zh: 确保植物尽可能免受病虫害的方法

senses.def: connected with the use of chemicals to kill insects
senses.zh: 杀虫剂：与使用化学物质杀死昆虫有关

senses.def: a chemical used for killing insects

examples.en: crops sprayed with insecticides
examples.zh: 喷洒杀虫剂的农作物

senses.def: any animal that eats insects
that eats insects
able to capture and digest
senses.zh: 食虫性：能够捕获和消化昆虫

senses.def: not confident about yourself or your relationships with other people

examples.en: He's very insecure about his appearance.
examples.zh: 他对自己的长相很没信心。

examples.en: She felt nervous and insecure.
examples.zh: 她感到局促不安。

senses.def: not safe or protected
senses.zh: 不安全的；无保障的；不牢靠的

examples.en: Jobs nowadays are much more insecure than they were ten years ago.
examples.zh: 当今的工作比十年前要不安稳得多了。

examples.en: As an artist he was always financially insecure.
examples.zh: 作为一名艺术家，他在经济上总是没有保障。

examples.en: Many people use insecure passwords or they use the same password for everything.
examples.zh: 许多人使用不安全的密码，或者他们对所有事情都使用相同的密码。

examples.en: Insecure doors and windows (= for example, without good locks) make life easy for burglars.
examples.zh: 门窗不牢靠方便了窃贼。

examples.en: They are worried about losing their jobs and becoming financially insecure.
examples.zh: 他们担心失去工作和经济上没有保障。

senses.def: likely to move, fall down, etc.

examples.en: an insecure ladder/footbridge
examples.zh: 不牢固的梯子／人行桥

senses.def: in a way that shows you are not confident about yourself or your relationships with other people

examples.en: insecurely attached children
examples.zh: 不安全依恋的孩子

senses.def: in a way that is not safe or protected
senses.zh: 不安全的；无保障的；不牢靠的

examples.en: insecurely stored passwords
examples.zh: 不安全存储的密码

examples.en: people who are insecurely housed
examples.zh: 居住不安全的人

senses.def: in a way that is likely to move, fall down, etc.
senses.zh: 不安全地：以可能移动，掉落等的方式

examples.en: The unit was insecurely mounted.
examples.zh: 该装置安装不牢固。

senses.def: a lack of confidence about yourself or your relationships with other people; something that makes you feel like this

examples.en: feelings of insecurity
examples.zh: 不安全感

examples.en: We all have our fears and insecurities.
examples.zh: 每个人都有自己害怕和没有把握的东西。

examples.en: The incident brought back childhood insecurities.
examples.zh: 这一事件带回了童年的不安全感。

senses.def: the state of not being safe or protected

examples.en: job insecurity
examples.zh: 工作无保障

examples.en: the insecurity of wireless networks
examples.zh: 无线网络的不安全

examples.en: There are two ways you can suffer from online insecurity that are easy to address:…
examples.zh: 您可能会通过两种方式遭受网络不安全的困扰，但这些问题很容易解决：……

senses.def: to put sperm

examples.en: The cows are artificially inseminated.
examples.zh: 这些母牛是人工授精的。

senses.def: the state of being unconscious

examples.en: He was found lying in a state of drugged insensibility.
examples.zh: 他被发现躺在地上，处于服药昏迷状态。

senses.def: the fact of not being able to react to a particular thing
senses.zh: （对某事物的）麻木，无反应能力

examples.en: insensibility to pain
examples.zh: 对疼痛无感觉

senses.def: unable to feel something or react to it
senses.zh: （对某事物）无感觉，无反应能力，麻木

examples.en: insensible to pain/cold
examples.zh: 感觉不到疼痛／冷

senses.def: not aware of a situation or of something that might happen

examples.en: They were not insensible of the risks.
examples.zh: 他们对这些危险并非没有意识。

senses.def: unconscious as the result of injury, illness, etc.

examples.en: He was beaten till nearly insensible.
examples.zh: 他被打得几乎昏迷不醒。

senses.def: without feeling or being aware of something
senses.zh: 荒谬地：没有感觉或不知道某事

examples.en: She found herself insensibly drawn into a closer relationship.
examples.zh: 她发现自己不知不觉地陷入了更亲密的关系。

senses.def: in an unconscious state

examples.en: He collapsed insensibly to the ground.
examples.zh: 他不省人事地倒在了地上。

senses.def: not realizing or caring how other people feel, and therefore likely to hurt or offend them
senses.zh: （对他人的感受）未意识到的，漠不关心的

examples.en: an insensitive remark
examples.zh: 冷漠的言论

examples.en: She's completely insensitive to my feelings.
examples.zh: 她全然不顾我的感情。

senses.def: not aware of changing situations, and therefore of the need to react to them
senses.zh: （对变化）懵然不知的，麻木不仁的

examples.en: The government seems totally insensitive to the mood of the country.
examples.zh: 政府似乎对全国民众的心情完全懵然不知。

examples.en: Many of the institutions were insensitive to the needs of their patients.
examples.zh: 许多机构对病人的需要漠不关心。

senses.def: not able to feel or react to something

examples.en: insensitive to pain/cold
examples.zh: 感觉不到疼痛／寒冷

examples.en: He seems completely insensitive to criticism.
examples.zh: 他似乎对批评麻木不仁。

senses.def: without realizing or caring how other people feel, and therefore likely to hurt or offend them
senses.zh: （对他人的感受）未意识到的，漠不关心的

examples.en: The police handled the matter extremely insensitively.
examples.zh: 警方对此事的处理极其麻木不仁。

examples.en: The community feels it has been treated insensitively by the central government.
examples.zh: 社区认为中央政府对待他们麻木不仁。

senses.def: a lack of care for or awareness
senses.zh: 麻木不仁：对他人的感受缺乏关心或意识

examples.en: racial/cultural insensitivity
examples.zh: 种族/文化不敏感

examples.en: His comments demonstrate gross insensitivity towards people struggling to pay their bills.
examples.zh: 他的言论表明他对那些难以支付账单的人们完全不敏感。

senses.def: a lack of awareness of changing situations, and therefore of the need to react to them
senses.zh: （对变化）懵然不知的，麻木不仁的

examples.en: Centralizing innovative processes in parent firms only encourages insensitivity to differences in local markets.
examples.zh: 将创新流程集中在母公司只会鼓励对当地市场差异的不敏感。

senses.def: a lack of ability to react to a particular chemical or drug
senses.zh: 不敏感：缺乏对特定化学物质或药物反应的能力

examples.en: insulin insensitivity
examples.zh: 胰岛素不敏感

senses.def: the fact that two or more things cannot be separated
senses.zh: 不可分割性：两个或多个事物无法分离

examples.en: the inseparability of style and content
examples.zh: 风格和内容密不可分

senses.def: not able to be separated
senses.zh: （与某事物）不可分离的，分不开的

examples.en: Our economic fortunes are inseparable from those of Europe.
examples.zh: 我们的经济命运和欧洲的息息相关。

senses.def: if people are inseparable

examples.en: As children, Laura and I were inseparable.
examples.zh: 小时候，劳拉和我形影不离。

examples.en: George later became our inseparable companion.
examples.zh: 乔治后来成为我们形影不离的伴侣。

examples.en: The two brothers are almost inseparable.
examples.zh: 这哥俩几乎形影不离。

senses.def: in a way that cannot be separated
senses.zh: （与某事物）不可分离的，分不开的

examples.en: Our lives were inseparably linked.
examples.zh: 我们的生活息息相通。

senses.def: to put something into something else or between two things

examples.en: Insert coins into the slot and press for a ticket.
examples.zh: 把硬币放进投币口，按钮取票。

examples.en: They inserted a tube in his mouth to help him breathe.
examples.zh: 他们在他嘴里插了根导管帮助他呼吸。

examples.en: She picked up a knife and inserted it between the top of the drawer and the desk.
examples.zh: 她拿起一把刀，插在抽屉顶部和书桌之间。

senses.def: to add something to a piece of writing

examples.en: Position the cursor where you want to insert a word.
examples.zh: 把光标移到你想插入字词的地方。

examples.en: The program will automatically insert the replacement text.
examples.zh: 程序将自动插入替代文本。

examples.en: Later, he inserted another paragraph into his will.
examples.zh: 后来他在他的遗嘱中又加了一段。

examples.en: The English translation is inserted between the lines of text.
examples.zh: 英语译文插在原文字里行间。

senses.def: an extra section added to a book, newspaper or magazine, especially to advertise something

examples.en: an 8-page insert on the new car models
examples.zh: 附加的 8 页新型汽车广告

senses.def: something that is put inside something else, or added to something else

examples.en: These inserts fit inside any style of shoe.
examples.zh: 这些鞋垫适合任何式样的鞋。

senses.def: the act of putting something inside something else; a thing that is put inside something else

examples.en: An examination is carried out before the insertion of the tube.
examples.zh: 插入导管前先要进行检查。

examples.en: Acupuncture involves the insertion of needles into specific points of the body.
examples.zh: 针灸涉及将针插入身体的特定部位。

senses.def: a thing that is added to a book, piece of writing, etc.; the act of adding something
senses.zh: （书、文章等中）添加的东西；添加；插入

examples.en: the insertion of an extra paragraph
examples.zh: 插入一个附加段落

senses.def: a small picture, map, etc. inside a larger one
senses.zh: （套印在大图片、地图等中的）小图，小地图

examples.en: For the Shetland Islands, see inset.
examples.zh: 关于设得兰群岛，见小地图。

senses.def: something that is added on to something else, or put inside something else

examples.en: The windows have beautiful stained glass insets.
examples.zh: 窗户上镶着漂亮的彩色玻璃。

senses.def: to fix something into the surface of something else, especially as a decoration

examples.en: The tables were inset with ceramic tiles.
examples.zh: 桌子上镶嵌着瓷砖。

examples.en: Ceramic tiles were inset into the tables.
examples.zh: 桌子上镶嵌着瓷砖。

senses.def: to put a small picture, map, etc. inside the borders of a bigger one
senses.zh: （在大图片、地图等中）套印小图

senses.def: the abbreviation for 'in-service training', used to refer to the system of training given to teachers working in British state schools
senses.zh: 在职培训（in-service training 缩写）

senses.def: a day on which classes at a school are cancelled so that teachers can get further training
senses.zh: （英国中小学教师的）在职培训日（inservice training day 的简略说法，教师到校参加培训或其他校务活动，学生不到校）

senses.def: an Islamic expression meaning ‘
senses.zh: 凭真主的意愿，但凭安拉安排（表示希望某事发生）

examples.en: I know times are tough, but we will get through this together, inshallah.
examples.zh: 我知道日子艰难，但我们会一起渡过难关的，安拉保佑。

senses.def: towards or close to the land

examples.en: The boat came inshore.
examples.zh: 船驶近海岸。

senses.def: in the sea but close to the shore

examples.en: an inshore breeze
examples.zh: 海岸边的微风

examples.en: an inshore lifeboat (= that stays close to the land)
examples.zh: 近海救生艇

senses.def: on or to the inner part of something/somebody; within something/somebody

examples.en: Go inside the house.
examples.zh: 进屋里吧。

examples.en: Inside the box was a gold watch.
examples.zh: 盒子里装着一只金表。

examples.en: She made a film about what life was like inside the refugee camp.
examples.zh: 她制作了一部关于难民营内生活的电影。

examples.en: You'll feel better with a good meal inside you.
examples.zh: 你肚子饱了感觉就会好些的。

examples.en: Inside most of us is a small child screaming for attention.
examples.zh: 我们大多数人的内心都藏着一个呼求关注的小孩。

senses.def: in less than the amount of time mentioned

examples.en: The job is unlikely to be finished inside (of) a year.
examples.zh: 这项工作不大可能在一年之内完成。

senses.def: on or to the inside

examples.en: She shook it to make sure there was nothing inside.
examples.zh: 她把它晃了晃，以确定里面没有东西。

examples.en: He went inside (= indoors) to get his car keys.
examples.zh: 他走进屋里去取汽车钥匙。

examples.en: ‘Get inside!’ he said and closed the door.
examples.zh: “进去吧！”他说着关上了门。

examples.en: We had to move inside (= indoors) when it started to rain.
examples.zh: 开始下雨了，我们只好躲进屋里。

examples.en: I pretended not to care but I was screaming inside.
examples.zh: 我佯装不在乎，但内心却在尖叫。

senses.def: in prison

examples.en: He was sentenced to three years inside.
examples.zh: 他被判三年监禁。

senses.def: the inner part, side or surface of something

examples.en: The inside of the box was blue.
examples.zh: 盒子的内面呈蓝色。

examples.en: the insides of the windows
examples.zh: 窗户的内侧

examples.en: The cake has a slight crust while the inside is soft and moist.
examples.zh: 蛋糕有轻微的外皮，但内部柔软湿润。

examples.en: PVC is used in dishwashers for lining the inside.
examples.zh: PVC 用于洗碗机的内部衬里。

examples.en: The door was locked from the inside.
examples.zh: 门从里面锁上了。

examples.en: The shell is smooth on the inside.
examples.zh: 贝壳内壁光滑。

senses.def: the part of a road nearest the edge, that is used by slower vehicles

examples.en: He tried to overtake on the inside.
examples.zh: 他试图从慢车道超车。

senses.def: the part of a curved road or track nearest to the middle or shortest side of the curve
senses.zh: （道路或跑道拐弯处的）内侧，里道，内圈

examples.en: The French runner is coming up fast on the inside.
examples.zh: 法国的赛跑选手正从内圈迅速赶上来。

senses.def: a person’s stomach and bowels

examples.en: She was so nervous, her insides were like jelly.
examples.zh: 她紧张得六神无主。

examples.en: He complained of a pain in his insides.
examples.zh: 他抱怨内脏疼痛。

senses.def: with the part that is usually inside facing out

examples.en: You've got your sweater on inside out.
examples.zh: 你把毛线衫里外穿反了。

examples.en: Turn the bag inside out and let it dry.
examples.zh: 把包里面翻到外面晾干。

senses.def: to be very familiar with somebody/something

examples.en: This is where I grew up. I know this area like the back of my hand.
examples.zh: 我在这儿长大的，我对这地方再熟悉不过了。

senses.def: belonging to a group or an organization and therefore able to get information that is not available to other people
senses.zh: 属于某团伙（或组织）的；知情的

examples.en: The thieves must have had someone on the inside helping them.
examples.zh: 这些窃贼肯定有内应。

senses.def: to make a place very untidy when you are searching for something

examples.en: The burglars had turned the house inside out.
examples.zh: 窃贼把房子翻了个底朝天。

senses.def: to cause large changes

examples.en: The new manager turned the old systems inside out.
examples.zh: 新任经理对旧体制进行了彻底的改革。

senses.def: forming the inner part of something; not on the outside

examples.en: the inside pages of a newspaper
examples.zh: 报纸的内页

examples.en: an inside pocket
examples.zh: 里袋

examples.en: I was driving in the inside lane (= the part nearest the edge, not the middle of the road).
examples.zh: 我当时驾车在慢车道上行驶。

senses.def: known or done by somebody in a group or an organization
senses.zh: 从内部了解到的；内线干的

examples.en: inside information
examples.zh: 内部情报

examples.en: Any newspaper would pay big money to get the inside story on her marriage.
examples.zh: 任何一家报纸都愿出高价购买她婚姻的内幕消息。

examples.en: The robbery appeared to have been an inside job.
examples.zh: 这次抢劫像是内部人干的。

senses.def: with the part that is usually inside facing out

examples.en: You've got your sweater on inside out.
examples.zh: 你把毛线衫里外穿反了。

examples.en: Turn the bag inside out and let it dry.
examples.zh: 把包里面翻到外面晾干。

examples.zh: 我在这儿长大的，我对这地方再熟悉不过了。

senses.def: belonging to a group or an organization and therefore able to get information that is not available to other people

senses.def: to cause large changes

examples.zh: 新任经理对旧体制进行了彻底的改革。

senses.def: expert knowledge about baseball

examples.en: He taught New York baseball fans a good deal of inside baseball.
examples.zh: 他向纽约的棒球迷传授了很多棒球专业知识。

senses.def: technical information about any subject

examples.en: Readers weren't very interested in the inside baseball of the news business.
examples.zh: 读者对新闻行业的内幕不太感兴趣。

examples.en: This is inside baseball stuff.
examples.zh: 这是内幕消息。

senses.def: with the part that is usually inside facing out

examples.zh: 你把毛线衫里外穿反了。

examples.en: Turn the bag inside out and let it dry.
examples.zh: 把包里面翻到外面晾干。

senses.def: a joke that is only understood by a particular group of people
senses.zh: 圈子里的笑话；行内笑话

senses.def: a measurement of the length of the inside of somebody’s leg, used for making or choosing trousers of the correct size
a position in which you have an advantage over somebody else

examples.en: Mike has the inside track on that story (= knows most about it).
examples.zh: 迈克对那个故事了解最多。

senses.def: a person who knows a lot about a group or an organization, because they are part of it

examples.en: The situation was described by one insider as ‘absolute chaos’.
examples.zh: 据一名内部人士说，实情是乱作一团。

examples.en: an insider’s view of the movie industry
examples.zh: 业内人士对电影行业的看法

senses.def: the crime of buying or selling shares in a company with the help of information known only by those connected with the business, before this information is available to everybody
senses.zh: 内线交易，内幕交易（根据内线消息买卖股票的违法行为）

examples.en: a Wall Street dealer convicted of insider trading
examples.zh: 一名华尔街交易商被判内幕交易罪

senses.def: spreading gradually or without being noticed, but causing serious harm

examples.en: the insidious effects of polluted water supplies
examples.zh: 供水系统污染的潜在恶果

senses.def: by spreading gradually or without being noticed, but causing serious harm

examples.en: This kind of advertising acts insidiously on young minds.
examples.zh: 这种广告对年轻人的思想具有阴险的作用。

senses.def: an understanding of what something is like

examples.en: There are many valuable insights in her book.
examples.zh: 她的书中有许多宝贵的见解。

examples.en: His work offers several useful insights.
examples.zh: 他的工作提供了一些有用的见解。

examples.en: The book gives us fascinating insights into life in Mexico.
examples.zh: 这本书生动地表现了墨西哥的生活。

examples.en: I hope you have gained some insight into the difficulties we face.
examples.zh: 希望你已经对我们面临的困难多了些了解。

examples.en: She has some interesting insights on the principles that have guided US foreign policy.
examples.zh: 她对指导美国外交政策的原则有一些有趣的见解。

examples.en: The book provides important insights about the doctor-patient relationship.
examples.zh: 这本书提供了有关医患关系的重要见解。

senses.def: the ability to see and understand the truth about people or situations

examples.en: He has insight, vision and a deep humanity.
examples.zh: 他有洞察力、远见和深厚的人性。

examples.en: She was a writer of great insight.
examples.zh: 她是拥有深刻洞察力的作家。

examples.en: With a flash of insight I realized what the dream meant.
examples.zh: 我突然明白了这个梦意味着什么。

senses.def: showing a clear understanding of a person or situation
senses.zh: 有深刻了解的；富有洞察力的

examples.en: an insightful historian
examples.zh: 一位富有洞察力的历史学家

examples.en: One particular author seems to be more insightful than the rest.
examples.zh: 一位特定的作者似乎比其他人更有洞察力。

examples.en: She provides a clear and insightful account of the events.
examples.zh: 她对事件进行了清晰而富有洞察力的描述。

senses.def: the symbol, badge
senses.zh: （级别或成员的）标记，象征；徽章；证章

examples.en: the royal insignia
examples.zh: 皇家徽章

examples.en: His uniform bore the insignia of a captain.
examples.zh: 他的制服上有上尉徽章。

examples.en: I recognized a few of the red, yellow and blue insignias on the olive-green overcoats of the soldiers.
examples.zh: 我认出了士兵橄榄绿大衣上的一些红色、黄色和蓝色徽章。

senses.def: the fact of not being big or valuable enough to be considered important
senses.zh: 微不足道的；无足轻重的

examples.en: Her own problems paled into insignificance beside this terrible news.
examples.zh: 和这个可怕的消息相比，她自己的问题显得无足轻重。

examples.en: Success took him from insignificance to wealth and fame.
examples.zh: 成功使他从无名小卒走向财富和名誉。

senses.def: not big or valuable enough to be considered important
senses.zh: 微不足道的；无足轻重的

examples.en: an insignificant difference
examples.zh: 微不足道的差别

examples.en: The levels of chemicals in the river are not insignificant.
examples.zh: 河水中的化学物质含量不容忽视。

examples.en: He made her feel insignificant and stupid.
examples.zh: 他使她感到卑微愚蠢。

examples.en: These results are statistically insignificant.
examples.zh: 在统计学的意义上，这些结果无关紧要。

examples.en: an event that was considered insignificant
examples.zh: 一个被认为无关紧要的事件

senses.def: in a way that is not large or important enough to have an effect on something or to be noticed
saying or doing something that you do not really mean or believe

examples.en: an insincere smile
examples.zh: 虚情假意的微笑

senses.def: in a way that you do not really mean or believe
the act or practice of saying or doing something that you do not really mean or believe

examples.en: She accused him of insincerity.
examples.zh: 她指责他缺乏诚意。

senses.def: to suggest indirectly that something unpleasant is true
senses.zh: 暗示，旁敲侧击地指出（不快的事）

examples.en: The article insinuated that he was appointed because of family connections.
examples.zh: 文章暗示，他被任命是因为家庭关系。

examples.en: What are you trying to insinuate?
examples.zh: 你拐弯抹角想说什么？

examples.en: an insinuating smile
examples.zh: 暗示的微笑

senses.def: to succeed in gaining somebody’s respect, trust, etc. so that you can use the situation to your own advantage
senses.zh: 用巧计取得（某人的尊重、信任等）

examples.en: In the first act, the villain insinuates himself into the household of the man he intends to kill.
examples.zh: 在第一幕中，坏人混进了他企图谋杀的男子的家庭。

senses.def: to slowly move yourself or a part of your body into a particular position or place

examples.en: She insinuated her right hand under his arm.
examples.zh: 她悄悄把右手插到他胳膊底下。

senses.def: something unpleasant that somebody indirectly suggests is true
senses.zh: 旁敲侧击的话；影射；暗示

examples.en: She resented the insinuation that she was too old for the job.
examples.zh: 她憎恶暗示她太老不适合这项工作的话。

examples.en: Why did you make those veiled insinuations about me?
examples.zh: 你为什么对我说那些含沙射影的话？

examples.en: insinuations against the unsuccessful candidate
examples.zh: 对落选者的旁敲侧击

senses.def: the act of indirectly suggesting that something unpleasant is true
senses.zh: 旁敲侧击；含沙射影；巧妙进入

examples.en: His reputation was ruined by insinuation and rumour.
examples.zh: 他的名声被影射和谣言毁了。

senses.def: having almost no taste

examples.en: a cup of insipid coffee
examples.zh: 一杯淡而无味的咖啡

senses.def: not interesting or exciting
senses.zh: 平淡无奇的；枯燥乏味的

examples.en: After an hour of insipid conversation, I left.
examples.zh: 经过一个小时乏味的谈话之后，我离开了。

examples.en: The band are an insipid imitation of the Beatles.
examples.zh: 该乐队是披头士乐队的平淡模仿。

senses.def: to demand that something happen or that somebody agree to do something

examples.en: I didn't really want to go but he insisted.
examples.zh: 我不大想去，但他硬要我去。

examples.en: Stay and have lunch. I insist!
examples.zh: 留下来吃午饭吧，就这么定了！

examples.en: ‘Please come with us.’ ‘Very well then, if you insist.’
examples.zh: “请和我们一起去吧。”“好吧，你一定要我去，我就去。”

examples.en: She insisted on him wearing a suit.
examples.zh: 她坚持要他穿西装。

examples.en: She insisted on his wearing a suit.
examples.zh: 她坚持要他穿西装。

examples.en: He insists that she come.
examples.zh: 他执意要她来。

examples.en: He insists that she should come.
examples.zh: 他执意要她来。

senses.def: to state clearly that something is true, especially when other people do not believe you

examples.en: He insisted on his innocence.
examples.zh: 他坚持说他是无辜的。

examples.en: He insisted (that) he was innocent.
examples.zh: 他坚持说他是无辜的。

examples.en: The government has always insisted that this was not the case.
examples.zh: 政府一直坚称事实并非如此。

examples.en: ‘It's true,’ she insisted.
examples.zh: “那是真的。”她坚持道。

intro.en: These words all mean to say that somebody should do or have something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含要求之义。

items.def: to make a very strong request for something; to say very definitely that somebody should have or do something:
items.zh: 指强烈要求、坚决要求

examples.en: She demanded an immediate explanation.
examples.zh: 她强烈要求立即作出解释。

items.def: [often passive] (rather formal) to make somebody do or have something, especially because it is necessary according to a law or set of rules or standards:
items.zh: 指要求做（某事）、达到（某水平），尤指根据法规或规定

examples.en: All candidates will be required to take a short test.
examples.zh: 所有候选人都要做一个小测验。

items.def: to demand that somebody should do, have or be something, especially because it is their duty or responsibility:
items.zh: 指要求、认为应得、指望，尤因义务或责任

examples.en: I expect to be paid promptly for the work.
examples.zh: 我要求即时付工钱。

items.def: to demand that something happens or that somebody agrees to do something:
items.zh: 指坚决要求、坚持

examples.en: I didn’t want to go but he insisted.
examples.zh: 我并不想去，但他硬要我去。

items.def: to expect or demand something:
items.zh: 指期望、要求

examples.en: You’re asking too much of him.
examples.zh: 你对他要求过分了。

senses.def: to demand something and refuse to be persuaded to accept anything else

examples.en: We insisted on a refund of the full amount.
examples.zh: 我们坚决要求全额退款。

examples.en: Charles was determined to insist on his rights.
examples.zh: 查尔斯决心坚持自己的权利。

examples.en: They insisted upon being given every detail of the case.
examples.zh: 他们坚持要求说明事情的来龙去脉。

senses.def: to continue doing something even though other people think it is annoying

examples.en: They insist on playing their music late at night.
examples.zh: 已是深夜，他们却依然在放音乐。

senses.def: to demand something and refuse to be persuaded to accept anything else

examples.en: We insisted on a refund of the full amount.
examples.zh: 我们坚决要求全额退款。

examples.en: Charles was determined to insist on his rights.
examples.zh: 查尔斯决心坚持自己的权利。

examples.en: They insisted upon being given every detail of the case.
examples.zh: 他们坚持要求说明事情的来龙去脉。

senses.def: an act of demanding or saying something clearly and refusing to accept any opposition or excuses

examples.en: At her insistence, the matter was dropped.
examples.zh: 在她的坚持下，这件事被搁置了。

examples.en: their insistence on strict standards of behaviour
examples.zh: 他们对严格行为规范的坚决主张

examples.en: No one was convinced by his insistence that he was not to blame.
examples.zh: 没有人相信他坚持认为自己不应该受到责备。

senses.def: demanding something and refusing to accept any opposition or excuses
senses.zh: 坚决要求的；坚持的；固执的

examples.en: She didn't want to go but her brother was insistent.
examples.zh: 她不想去，但她哥哥非得要她去。

examples.en: They were insistent on having a contract for the work.
examples.zh: 他们坚持要就这项工作立一份合同。

examples.en: Why are you so insistent that we leave tonight?
examples.zh: 你为什么一定要我们今晚离开？

examples.en: He was most insistent that we shouldn't leave the door unlocked.
examples.zh: 他坚决要求我们不要不锁门。

examples.en: She was insistent about inviting him.
examples.zh: 她坚持要邀请他。

senses.def: continuing for a long period of time in a way that cannot be ignored
senses.zh: 持续不断的；再三的；反复的

examples.en: insistent demands
examples.zh: 再三的要求

examples.en: the insistent ringing of the telephone
examples.zh: 没完没了的电话铃声

senses.def: in a way that demands something and refuses to accept any opposition or excuses
senses.zh: 坚决要求的；坚持的；固执的

examples.en: They insistently refused to accept any cash compensation.
examples.zh: 他们坚决拒绝接受任何现金补偿。

senses.def: in a way that continues for a long time and cannot be ignored
senses.zh: 坚持：以持续很长时间并且不容忽视的方式

examples.en: He tried to ignore his insistently ringing phone.
examples.zh: 他试图忽略不断响起的电话铃声。

senses.def: the state of being drunk; wild and noisy behaviour that is typical of this state
to the degree that
the amount of light from the sun that reaches a particular area
a piece of material in the shape of your foot that is placed inside a shoe to make it more comfortable
the fixed inner sole
extremely rude behaviour that shows a lack of respect for somebody

examples.en: Her insolence cost her her job.
examples.zh: 她的蛮横态度使她丢了工作。

senses.def: extremely rude and showing a lack of respect

examples.en: an insolent child/smile
examples.zh: 粗野的孩子；侮慢的微笑

examples.en: His tone was insolent.
examples.zh: 他的语气很无礼。

synonyms.words: cheeky ▪ insolent ▪ disrespectful ▪ impolite ▪ impertinent ▪ discourteous

intro.en: These are all words for people showing a lack of respect for other people.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指人粗鲁、无礼。

items.def: having or showing a lack of respect for other people and their feelings:
items.zh: 指粗鲁的、无礼的、粗野的

examples.en: Why are you so rude to your mother?
examples.zh: 你为什么对你的母亲这么没礼貌？

items.def: (British English英式英语, informal) (especially of children) rude in a funny or an annoying way:
items.zh: 厚脸皮的、鲁莽的、放肆的

examples.en: You cheeky monkey!
examples.zh: 你这厚脸皮的猴崽子！

items.def: (rather formal) very rude, especially to somebody who is older or more important Insolent is used especially to talk about the behaviour of children towards adults.
items.zh: insolent 尤用于形容孩子对成年人的行为。

items.def: (rather formal) showing a lack of respect for somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指不尊敬、无礼、轻蔑

examples.en: Some people said he had been disrespectful to the president in his last speech.
examples.zh: 有些人说他在最近一次讲话中对总统不尊重。

items.def: (rather formal) not behaving in a pleasant way that follows the rules of society:
items.zh: 指不礼貌、粗鲁

examples.en: Some people think it is impolite to ask someone’s age.
examples.zh: 有些人认为询问别人的年龄是不礼貌的。

items.def: (rather formal) not showing respect for somebody who is older or more important Impertinent is often used by people such as parents and teachers when they are telling children that they are angry with them for being rude:
items.zh: impertinent 常用于父母、老师等对孩子的粗鲁行为表示气愤

items.def: (formal) having bad manners and not showing respect:
items.zh: 指不礼貌、失礼、粗鲁

examples.en: He didn’t wish to appear discourteous.
examples.zh: 他不想显得没礼貌。

senses.def: in an extremely rude way that shows a lack of respect for somebody
that cannot be solved or explained
senses.zh: 无法解决的；不能解释的

examples.en: The problem seemed insoluble.
examples.zh: 问题似乎难以解决。

senses.def: that does not dissolve

examples.en: These chemicals are practically insoluble in water.
examples.zh: 这些化学物质几乎不溶于水。

senses.def: the state of not having enough money to pay what you owe; an occasion when this happens

examples.en: The company is close to insolvency.
examples.zh: 这家公司即将破产。

examples.en: UK food suppliers said they expected more insolvencies in their sector this year.
examples.zh: 英国食品供应商表示，他们预计今年该行业将出现更多破产事件。

senses.def: not having enough money to pay what you owe
senses.zh: 无力偿付债务的；破产的

examples.en: The company has been declared insolvent.
examples.zh: 这家公司被宣布破产了。

senses.def: the condition of being unable to sleep

examples.en: to suffer from insomnia
examples.zh: 失眠

senses.def: a person who regularly finds it difficult to sleep
the state of not being worried about anything

examples.en: She hid her worries behind an air of insouciance.
examples.zh: 她掩饰着自己的烦恼，表现得无忧无虑。

senses.def: not worrying or caring about anything
inspector

examples.en: Chief Insp. (Paul) King
examples.zh: 总巡官（保罗·）金

senses.def: to look closely at something/somebody, especially to check that everything is as it should be

examples.en: The teacher walked around inspecting their work.
examples.zh: 老师走来走去检查他们的作业。

examples.en: Make sure you inspect the goods before signing for them.
examples.zh: 要确保在签收货物之前进行检验。

examples.en: The plants are regularly inspected for disease.
examples.zh: 会定期检查这些植物是否有病害。

senses.def: to officially visit a school, factory, etc. in order to check that rules are being obeyed and that standards are acceptable

examples.en: Public health officials were called in to inspect the premises.
examples.zh: 公共卫生官员奉召来视察了建筑物。

examples.en: The Tourist Board inspects all recommended hotels at least once a year.
examples.zh: 旅游局至少每年视察一次所有举荐的旅馆。

intro.en: These words all mean to look closely to make sure that everything is correct, in good condition, or acceptable.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含仔细检查、审查之义。

items.def: to look at something closely to make sure that everything is correct, in good condition, safe or acceptable:
items.zh: 指检查、审查、核查，以确保完好、正常和安全

examples.en: Check your work before handing it in.
examples.zh: 交作业前先检查一遍。

items.def: to look at somebody/​something closely to see if there is anything wrong or to find the cause of a problem:
items.zh: 指仔细检查或检验人或事物，以确认有无问题或找出问题所在

examples.en: The goods were examined for damage on arrival.
examples.zh: 货物到达时已检查是否有破损。

items.def: to look at somebody/​something closely to make sure that everything is acceptable; to officially visit a school, factory, etc. in order to check that rules are being obeyed and that standards are acceptable:
items.zh: 指检查、查看、审视，以确保一切妥当；视察（学校、工厂等）

examples.en: Make sure you inspect the goods before signing for them.
examples.zh: 要确保在签收货物之前进行检验。

items.def: to check something carefully for mistakes, damage or anything dangerous:
items.zh: 指仔细检查是否有错误、损坏或危险

examples.en: Go over your work for spelling mistakes before you hand it in.
examples.zh: 交作业前仔细检查一下拼写错误。
