intro.zh: 以上各词均含仔细检查、审查之义。

items.def: to look at something closely to make sure that everything is correct, in good condition, safe or acceptable:
items.zh: 指检查、审查、核查，以确保完好、正常和安全

examples.en: Check your work before handing it in.
examples.zh: 交作业前先检查一遍。

items.def: to look at somebody/​something closely to see if there is anything wrong or to find the cause of a problem:
items.zh: 指仔细检查或检验人或事物，以确认有无问题或找出问题所在

examples.en: The goods were examined for damage on arrival.
examples.zh: 货物到达时已检查是否有破损。

items.def: to look at somebody/​something closely to make sure that everything is acceptable; to officially visit a school, factory, etc. in order to check that rules are being obeyed and that standards are acceptable:
items.zh: 指检查、查看、审视，以确保一切妥当；视察（学校、工厂等）

examples.en: Make sure you inspect the goods before signing for them.
examples.zh: 要确保在签收货物之前进行检验。

items.def: to check something carefully for mistakes, damage or anything dangerous:
items.zh: 指仔细检查是否有错误、损坏或危险

examples.en: Go over your work for spelling mistakes before you hand it in.
examples.zh: 交作业前仔细检查一下拼写错误。

senses.def: an official visit to a school, factory, etc. in order to check that rules are being obeyed and that standards are acceptable

examples.en: Regular inspections are carried out at the prison.
examples.zh: 经常有人来视察这座监狱。

examples.en: The head went on a tour of inspection of all the classrooms.
examples.zh: 校长巡视了所有教室。

senses.def: the act of looking closely at something/somebody, especially to check that everything is as it should be

examples.en: The documents are available for inspection.
examples.zh: 这些文件可供查阅。

examples.en: Engineers carried out a thorough inspection of the track.
examples.zh: 工程师对轨道进行了彻底检查。

examples.en: Following an 8 a.m. pitch inspection by the referee, today's game has been called off due to a waterlogged pitch.
examples.zh: 上午8点，裁判检查了球场后，由于球场积水，今天的比赛被取消。

examples.en: On closer inspection, the notes proved to be forgeries.
examples.zh: 经进一步检查发现钞票都是伪造的。

senses.def: an officer of middle rank in the police force

examples.en: Inspector Maggie Forbes
examples.zh: 玛吉·福布斯巡官

examples.en: He reached the rank of inspector.
examples.zh: 他达到了巡官的级别。

senses.def: a person whose job is to visit schools, factories, etc. to check that rules are being obeyed and that standards are acceptable

examples.en: a school/health/safety inspector
examples.zh: 督学；卫生／安全检查员

senses.def: (in the UK) a person whose job is to check tickets on a bus or train
senses.zh: （公共汽车或火车上的）查票员

senses.def: a very popular British television series shown during the 1980s and early 1990s, set in and around Oxford. The main character is a police detective, Inspector Morse, who with his assistant, Sergeant Lewis, solves complicated murder cases. The series was originally based on the 13 novels about Inspector Morse by Colin Dexter.
senses.zh: 莫尔斯探长（Inspector Morse）：1980年代至1990年代初在牛津及其周边地区放映的非常受欢迎的英国电视连续剧。主要人物是警察侦探莫尔斯（Morse），他与助手路易斯警长（Sergeant Lewis）一起解决了复杂的谋杀案。该系列最初是基于科林·德克斯特（Colin Dexter）撰写的13部关于摩斯督察的小说。

senses.def: (in the UK) a person who is responsible for collecting the tax that people must pay on the money they earn
an official group of inspectors

examples.en: The schools inspectorate has/have published a report on science teaching.
examples.zh: 督学团发表了关于科学教学的报告。

senses.def: the process that takes place when somebody sees or hears something that causes them to have exciting new ideas or makes them want to create something, especially in art, music or literature

examples.en: Dreams can be a rich source of inspiration for an artist.
examples.zh: 梦境有可能是艺术家灵感的丰富源泉。

examples.en: Both poets drew their inspiration from the countryside.
examples.zh: 两位诗人都从乡村得到他们的灵感。

examples.en: Her work lacks inspiration (= it does not contain any exciting new ideas).
examples.zh: 她的作品缺乏灵感（=它不包含任何令人兴奋的新想法）。

examples.en: Looking for inspiration for a new dessert? Try this recipe.
examples.zh: 正在寻找制作新式甜食的灵感吗？试试这份食谱吧。

examples.en: She had the time and the inspiration to develop her talent.
examples.zh: 她有时间和灵感来发展自己的才能。

senses.def: a person or thing that is the reason why somebody creates or does something
senses.zh: 启发灵感的人（或事物）；使人产生动机的人（或事物）

examples.en: He says my sister was the inspiration for his heroine.
examples.zh: 他说我姐姐是他的女主人公的原型。

examples.en: Clark was the inspiration behind Saturday's victory.
examples.zh: 克拉克是星期六那场胜利的灵魂人物。

senses.def: a person or thing that makes you want to be better, more successful, etc.

examples.en: His charity work is an inspiration to us all.
examples.zh: 他的慈善工作对我们所有人来说都是一种鼓舞。

examples.en: She became an inspiration and a role model for a new generation of women.
examples.zh: 她成为新一代女性的灵感和榜样。

senses.def: a sudden good idea

examples.en: He had an inspiration: he'd give her a dog for her birthday.
examples.zh: 他突然想到一个好主意，他要送她一条狗作为生日礼物。

examples.en: It came to me in a flash of inspiration.
examples.zh: 那是我灵机一动想到的。

senses.def: providing exciting new ideas; making somebody want to create something, especially in art, literature or music
senses.zh: 启发灵感的；鼓舞人心的

examples.en: an inspirational leader
examples.zh: 有感召力的领袖

senses.def: to give somebody the desire, confidence or enthusiasm to do something well

examples.en: The actors' enthusiasm inspired the kids.
examples.zh: 演员们的热情鼓舞着孩子们。

examples.en: The actors inspired the kids with their enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 演员以热情鼓舞着孩子们。

examples.en: His superb play inspired the team to a thrilling 5–0 win.
examples.zh: 他的出色表现使球队士气大振，以 5:0 大获全胜。

examples.en: We hope to inspire others to pursue their dreams.
examples.zh: 我们希望激励其他人追求他们的梦想。

senses.def: to give somebody the idea for something, especially something artistic or that shows imagination
senses.zh: 赋予灵感；引起联想；启发思考

examples.en: The choice of decor was inspired by a trip to India.
examples.zh: 选用这种装饰格调是从一次印度之行中得到的启发。

examples.en: His tragic story later inspired a Hollywood film.
examples.zh: 他的悲惨故事后来成为了一部好莱坞电影的灵感来源。

senses.def: to make somebody have a particular feeling or emotion

examples.en: Henry did not inspire confidence as a figure of authority.
examples.zh: 亨利没有给人身为一个权威人物的感觉。

examples.en: Her work didn't exactly inspire me with confidence.
examples.zh: 她的工作让我对她没什么信心。

examples.en: As a general, he inspired great loyalty in his troops.
examples.zh: 作为一位将军，他得到了部队的精诚效忠。

senses.def: a person or thing that inspires you

examples.en: My best friend is my style inspo.
examples.zh: 我最好的朋友是我的时尚灵感来源。

senses.def: the quality or state of being likely to change or fail suddenly

examples.en: political and economic instability
examples.zh: 政治和经济的不稳定

senses.def: a mental condition in which somebody’s behaviour is likely to change suddenly
senses.zh: （精神的）不稳定状态，变化无常

examples.en: mental/emotional instability
examples.zh: 精神／情绪的不稳定

examples.en: He showed increasing signs of mental instability.
examples.zh: 他表现出越来越多的精神不稳定迹象。

senses.def: a social media
senses.zh: Instagram 社交媒体网站（可分享照片和短视频）

examples.en: She shared photos on Instagram with her fans.
examples.zh: 她在 Instagram 上分享照片给她的粉丝观看。

examples.en: Some people left some hateful comments on my last Insta post.
examples.zh: 有些人在我上一篇 Insta 帖子上留下了一些充满仇恨的评论。

senses.def: to fix equipment or furniture into position so that it can be used

examples.en: They're planning to install a new drainage system.
examples.zh: 他们计划安装新的排水系统。

examples.en: Make sure the equipment is properly installed.
examples.zh: 检查清楚设备是否安装正确。

examples.en: A hidden camera had been installed in the room.
examples.zh: 房间里安装了隐藏摄像头。

senses.def: to put a new program onto a computer

examples.en: to install software/an app
examples.zh: 安装软件／应用程序

examples.en: Do not download and install programs from websites that you are unfamiliar with.
examples.zh: 不要从您不熟悉的网站下载和安装程序。

examples.en: Be selective about the apps you install on your device.
examples.zh: 在设备上安装应用程序时要小心选择。

senses.def: to put somebody in a new position of authority, often with an official ceremony

examples.en: He was installed as President last May.
examples.zh: 他于去年五月份正式就任总统。

examples.en: She was recently installed as president of the National Medical Association.
examples.zh: 她最近被任命为国家医学会主席。

senses.def: to make somebody/yourself comfortable in a particular place or position

examples.en: We installed ourselves in the front row.
examples.zh: 我们舒舒服服地坐进了前排。

examples.en: She saw her guests safely installed in their rooms and then went downstairs.
examples.zh: 她看到宾客们都在各自房间里安顿好了才下了楼。

senses.def: the act of fixing equipment or furniture in position so that it can be used

examples.en: installation costs
examples.zh: 安装费

examples.en: Installation of the new system will take several days.
examples.zh: 新系统的安装需要几天时间。

senses.def: a piece of equipment or a machine that has been fixed in position so that it can be used

examples.en: a heating installation
examples.zh: 供暖装置

senses.def: the act of putting a new program onto a computer

examples.en: installation of the software
examples.zh: 软件的安装

senses.def: a place where specialist equipment is kept and used

examples.en: a military installation
examples.zh: 军事设施

senses.def: the act of placing somebody in a new position of authority, often with a ceremony

examples.en: the installation of the new chancellor
examples.zh: 新任校长的就职

senses.def: a piece of modern sculpture that is made using sound, light, etc. as well as objects
senses.zh: 现代雕塑装置（除物体外用声、光等元素）

senses.def: a method of buying an article by making regular payments for it over several months or years. The article only belongs to the person who is buying it when all the payments have been made.
one of a number of payments that are made regularly over a period of time until something has been paid for

examples.en: We paid for the car by/in instalments.
examples.zh: 我们以分期付款买了这辆车。

examples.en: The final instalment on the loan is due next week.
examples.zh: 贷款的最后一期付款下个星期到期。

examples.en: The loan can be repaid in 24 monthly instalments.
examples.zh: 贷款可在 24 个月内分期偿还。

examples.en: They were unable to keep up (= continue to pay regularly) the instalments.
examples.zh: 他们未能继续按时交付这笔分期付款。

senses.def: one of the parts of a story that appears regularly over a period of time in a newspaper, on television, etc.
senses.zh: （报章连载小说的）一节；（电视连续剧的）一集

examples.en: The ‘Screwtape Letters’ were published in instalments from May to November 1941.
examples.zh: 《斯克鲁塔普书简》从1941年5 月到11 月连载发表。

examples.en: Now for the second instalment of our exclusive three-part series.
examples.zh: 现在是我们独家播放的三集电视剧的第二集。

synonyms.words: premium ▪ contribution ▪ subscription ▪ repayment ▪ deposit ▪ instalment

intro.en: These are all words for an amount of money that you pay or are expected to pay, or for the act of paying.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指款额、款项、付款。

items.def: an amount of money that you pay or are expected to pay; the act of paying:
items.zh: 指款额、款项、付款

examples.en: ten monthly payments of $50
examples.zh: 每月付款 50 美元，十次付清

items.def: an amount of money that you pay once or regularly for an insurance policy; an extra payment added to the basic rate; a higher amount of money than usual:
items.zh: 指保险费、额外费用、附加费、溢价

examples.en: an insurance premium
examples.zh: 保险费

items.def: a sum of money that you pay regularly to your employer or the government in order to pay for benefits such as health insurance, a pension, etc:
items.zh: 指（给雇主或政府用作医疗保险、养老金等福利的）定期缴款

examples.en: You can increase your monthly contributions to the pension plan.
examples.zh: 你可以增加你的养老金计划每月供款。

items.def: an amount of money you pay in advance to receive a service:
items.zh: 指（服务的）订阅费、用户费

examples.en: a subscription to Netflix
examples.zh: 网飞的订阅费

items.def: (British English英式英语) an amount of money that you pay regularly to a bank, etc. until you have returned all the money that you owe; the act of paying this money:
items.zh: 指按期偿还的款项、分期偿还额、偿还债务、归还借款

examples.en: the repayments on the loan
examples.zh: 贷款的分期偿还额

items.def: an amount of money that you pay as the first part of a larger payment:
items.zh: 指订金

examples.en: We've put down a 5 per cent deposit on the house.
examples.zh: 我们已支付了房款的 5% 作为订金。

items.def: one of a number of payments that you make regularly over a period of time until you have paid for something:
items.zh: 指分期付款的一期付款

examples.en: We paid for the car by/​in instalments.
examples.zh: 我们以分期付款买了这辆车。

senses.def: a particular example or case of something

examples.en: The report highlights a number of instances of injustice.
examples.zh: 这篇报告重点列举了一些不公正的实例。

examples.en: He admitted two instances of taking money from the till.
examples.zh: 他承认有两起从收银台拿钱的例子。

examples.en: There have been several instances of that happening.
examples.zh: 这种情况已经发生过好几次了。

examples.en: In most instances, there will be no need for further treatment.
examples.zh: 多数情况下，不必继续治疗。

examples.en: In rare instances, viral infections in the mother may be passed to the unborn child.
examples.zh: 在极少数情况下，母亲体内的病毒感染可能会传染给未出生的孩子。

examples.en: I would normally suggest taking time off work, but in this instance I'm not sure that would do any good.
examples.zh: 我通常会建议休假，但就这个情况而言，我不敢保证休假会有什么好处。

examples.en: Students described many instances in which they had felt uncomfortable speaking in class.
examples.zh: 同学们描述了感觉在课堂上发言不自在的种种情况。

examples.en: This is one of the few instances where the director does not succeed.
examples.zh: 这是这位导演少数不成功的作品之一。

senses.def: for example

examples.en: What would you do, for instance, if you found a member of staff stealing?
examples.zh: 比如说，如果你发现有职员偷东西，你会怎么办？

examples.en: Murder, petty theft and tax evasion, for instance, all have different motives and consequences.
examples.zh: 比如谋杀、小偷小摸和逃税，都有不同的动机和后果。

senses.def: as the first part of a series of actions

examples.en: In the first instance, notify the police and then contact your insurance company.
examples.zh: 首先是报警，然后与你的保险公司联系。

examples.en: In the first instance, a letter from your employer may be all you need.
examples.zh: 首先，你所需要的或许只是雇主写的一封信。

senses.def: to give something as an example

examples.en: I refer to the situation instanced above.
examples.zh: 我指的是上面举例的情况。

senses.def: for example

examples.en: What would you do, for instance, if you found a member of staff stealing?
examples.zh: 比如说，如果你发现有职员偷东西，你会怎么办？

examples.en: Murder, petty theft and tax evasion, for instance, all have different motives and consequences.
examples.zh: 比如谋杀、小偷小摸和逃税，都有不同的动机和后果。

senses.def: as the first part of a series of actions

examples.en: In the first instance, notify the police and then contact your insurance company.
examples.zh: 首先是报警，然后与你的保险公司联系。

examples.en: In the first instance, a letter from your employer may be all you need.
examples.zh: 首先，你所需要的或许只是雇主写的一封信。

intro.en: These are all words for a thing or situation that is typical of a particular group or set, and is sometimes used to support an argument.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指事例、实例、例证。

items.def: something such as an object, a fact or a situation that shows, explains or supports what you say; a thing that is typical of or represents a particular group or set:
items.zh: 指实例、例证、典型、范例、样品

examples.en: Can you give me an example of what you mean?
examples.zh: 你能给我举个实例来解释你的意思吗？

items.def: a particular situation or a situation of a particular type; a situation that relates to a particular person or thing:
items.zh: 指具体情况、事例、实例、特定情况

examples.en: In some cases people have had to wait several weeks for an appointment.
examples.zh: 在某些情况下，人们必须等上好几周才能得到约见。

items.def: (rather formal) a particular situation or a situation of a particular type:
items.zh: 指例子、事例、实例

examples.en: The report highlights a number of instances of injustice.
examples.zh: 这篇报告重点列举了一些不公正的实例。

items.def: an example of something, especially an animal or plant:
items.zh: 尤指动植物的样品、实例

examples.en: The aquarium has some interesting specimens of unusual tropical fish.
examples.zh: 水族馆里有一些罕见的热带鱼，很有趣。

items.def: (rather formal) a story, an event or an example that clearly shows the truth about something:
items.zh: 指说明事实的故事、实例、示例

examples.en: The statistics are a clear illustration of the point I am trying to make.
examples.zh: 这些统计数字清楚地阐明了我要陈述的要点。

senses.def: happening immediately

examples.en: This account gives you instant access to your money.
examples.zh: 这个账户让你随时调动款项。

examples.en: The show was an instant success.
examples.zh: 演出一炮打响。

examples.en: People today seem to want instant gratification.
examples.zh: 现今的人们似乎想要即时的满足。

senses.def: that can be made quickly and easily, usually by adding hot water
senses.zh: 速食的；即食的；速溶的；方便的

examples.en: instant coffee
examples.zh: 速溶咖啡

senses.def: a very short period of time

examples.en: I'll be back in an instant.
examples.zh: 我马上就回来。

examples.en: Just for an instant I thought he was going to refuse.
examples.zh: 刹那间我以为他会拒绝。

senses.def: a particular point in time

examples.en: At that (very) instant, the door opened.
examples.zh: 就在那时，门开了。

examples.en: I recognized her the instant (that) (= as soon as) I saw her.
examples.zh: 我一眼就认出她了。

examples.en: Come here this instant (= immediately)!
examples.zh: 马上过来！

senses.def: coffee that can be made quickly and easily by adding hot water

examples.en: Do you want some coffee? Is instant OK?
examples.zh: 你想喝点咖啡吗？即时可以吗？

senses.def: a written message sent using a system on the internet that allows people to communicate with each other very quickly
senses.zh: 即时通信（互联网的快捷信息传递系统）

examples.en: to send an instant message
examples.zh: 发送即时消息

examples.en: Word spreads by email and instant message.
examples.zh: 消息通过电子邮件和即时通信广为传播。

senses.def: to send a written message using a system on the internet that allows people to communicate with each other very quickly

examples.en: She spent most of the evening instant-messaging.
examples.zh: 她把晚上的大部分时间都花在了即时通信上。

examples.en: He instant-messaged me last night.
examples.zh: 他昨晚给我发了即时消息。

examples.en: Can you instant-message me the news?
examples.zh: 你能把那条消息即时发送给我吗？

senses.def: a computer program that allows one or more users to chat online using written messages that are sent and received quickly

examples.en: When I’m away from home, I chat to my friends and family using an instant messenger.
examples.zh: 我不在家的时候，就用即时通信软件和朋友、家人聊天。

senses.def: part of something, for example a sports game on television, that is immediately repeated, often more slowly, so that you can see a goal or another exciting or important moment again
senses.zh: （体育比赛等电视画面的）即时重放，慢镜头回放

examples.en: Instant replays can occasionally prove the referee wrong.
examples.zh: 比赛中即时回放有时能证实裁判的误判。

senses.def: happening immediately

examples.en: an instantaneous response
examples.zh: 即时的反应

examples.en: Death was almost instantaneous.
examples.zh: 当时生命垂危。

senses.def: immediately

examples.en: The show sold out instantaneously.
examples.zh: 该剧立即售空。

senses.def: immediately

examples.en: Her voice is instantly recognizable.
examples.zh: 她的声音一下子就听出来了。

examples.en: The driver was killed instantly.
examples.zh: 司机当场死亡。

senses.def: in the place of somebody/something

examples.en: Lee was ill so I went instead.
examples.zh: 李病了，所以我代他去了。

examples.en: He didn't reply. Instead, he turned on his heel and left the room.
examples.zh: 他没有回答，反而转身离开了房间。

examples.en: She said nothing, preferring instead to save her comments till later.
examples.zh: 她什么也没说，而是想稍后再作评论。

examples.en: She might have pursued a successful career in business, but she chose instead to become a nun.
examples.zh: 她本可以在商业上追求成功的职业生涯，但她选择成为一名修女。

examples.en: The UN resisted any tougher sanctions, opting instead for more time to give talks a chance.
examples.zh: 联合国拒绝接受任何更严厉的制裁，而是选择给予更多时间进行谈判。

examples.en: While the Conservatives put the emphasis on the economy, Labour focused instead on public services.
examples.zh: 保守党把重点放在经济上，而工党则把重点放在公共服务上。

senses.def: in the place of somebody/something

examples.en: We just had soup instead of a full meal.
examples.zh: 我们没有吃全餐，只喝了汤。

examples.en: Now I can walk to work instead of going by car.
examples.zh: 现在我可以步行去上班，而不必开车了。

senses.def: the top part of the foot between the ankle and toes
the part of a shoe that covers the instep
to make something start or happen, usually something official

examples.en: The government has instigated a programme of economic reform.
examples.zh: 政府已实施了经济改革方案。

senses.def: to cause something bad to happen

examples.en: They were accused of instigating violence.
examples.zh: 他们被指控煽动暴力。

examples.en: Those found guilty of instigating the unrest will be punished.
examples.zh: 那些煽动骚乱的人将受到惩罚。

senses.def: the act of causing something to begin or happen

examples.en: An appeal fund was launched at the instigation of the President.
examples.zh: 总统授意发起了一项救援基金。

examples.en: It was done at his instigation.
examples.zh: 那件事是在他的鼓动下干的。

examples.en: He was involved in the instigation of acts of terrorism
examples.zh: 他参与煽动恐怖主义行为

senses.def: a person who causes something to happen, especially something bad
senses.zh: 发起人；（尤指）唆使者，煽动者，怂恿者

examples.en: the instigators of the riots
examples.zh: 煽动骚乱的人

senses.def: to gradually put an idea or attitude into somebody's mind; to make somebody feel, think or behave in a particular way over a period of time
senses.zh: 逐渐灌输，逐步培养（感受、思想或行为）

examples.en: to instil confidence/discipline/fear into somebody
examples.zh: 逐步使某人树立信心／守纪律／产生恐惧

examples.en: His father instilled him with a desire to fight injustice and corruption.
examples.zh: 他的父亲循循善诱，使他产生了与不公和腐败作斗争的愿望。

senses.def: a natural quality that makes people and animals tend to behave in a particular way using the knowledge and abilities that they were born with rather than thought or training

examples.en: She did not seem to have any of the usual maternal instincts.
examples.zh: 她似乎没有任何平常的母性本能。

examples.en: Children do not know by instinct the difference between right and wrong.
examples.zh: 儿童并非生来就会分辨是非。

examples.en: His first instinct was to run away.
examples.zh: 他的本能反应就是逃跑。

examples.en: Horses have a well-developed instinct for fear.
examples.zh: 马天性易受惊吓。

examples.en: Even at school, he showed he had an instinct for (= was naturally good at) business.
examples.zh: 他早在求学时期就表现出经商的天赋。

senses.def: a feeling that makes you do something or believe that something is true, even though it is not based on facts or reason

examples.en: I've always trusted my instincts in the past.
examples.zh: 过去我一直相信我的直觉。

examples.en: It's best to follow your first instincts in matters like this.
examples.zh: 在此类问题上最好遵循您的第一直觉。

examples.en: Her instincts about him had been right.
examples.zh: 她那时对他的直觉是对的。

examples.en: He had a gut instinct for when people were lying to him.
examples.zh: 他有一种本能，知道别人何时在对他撒谎。

examples.en: I acted purely on instinct.
examples.zh: 我的行为完全出自本能。

senses.def: based on instinct

examples.en: instinctive knowledge
examples.zh: 本能的知识

examples.en: She's an instinctive player.
examples.zh: 她是个依靠直觉的选手。

examples.en: My instinctive reaction was to deny everything.
examples.zh: 我的本能反应是否认一切。

senses.def: by using instinct
senses.zh: 本能地：通过使用本能，而不是思想或训练

examples.en: He knew instinctively that something was wrong.
examples.zh: 他凭直觉知道出事了。

senses.def: based on instinct
an organization that has a particular purpose, especially one that is connected with education or a particular profession; the building used by this organization

examples.en: The report was compiled by Germany's five leading economic research institutes.
examples.zh: 该报告由德国五家领先的经济研究机构编制。

examples.en: The course is offered at six colleges and institutes of higher education.
examples.zh: 该课程在六所学院和高等教育机构提供。

examples.en: He is a member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants.
examples.zh: 他是特许会计师协会会员。

examples.en: She was a senior researcher at the institute.
examples.zh: 她是研究所的高级研究员。

senses.def: to introduce a system, policy, etc. or start a process
senses.zh: 建立，制定（体系、政策等）；开始；实行

examples.en: The new management intends to institute a number of changes.
examples.zh: 新任管理层打算实行一些改革。

examples.en: They could institute criminal proceedings against you.
examples.zh: 他们可能对你提起刑事诉讼。

senses.def: a large important organization that has a particular purpose, for example a university or bank

examples.en: The deal is backed by one of the country's largest financial institutions.
examples.zh: 这笔交易得到了该国最大的一家金融机构的支持。

examples.en: He has worked as a visiting lecturer for various educational institutions.
examples.zh: 他曾担任多家教育机构的客座讲师。

examples.en: The system is targeted mainly at academic and research institutions.
examples.zh: 该系统主要是针对学术和研究机构而设的。

examples.en: the Smithsonian Institution
examples.zh: 史密森学会

examples.en: The region boasts several institutions of higher education.
examples.zh: 该地区有多所高等教育机构。

senses.def: a hospital, prison or other building where people are made to stay and are cared for
senses.zh: 慈善机构；社会福利机构

examples.en: They had him committed to an institution.
examples.zh: 他们把他委托给一个机构。

examples.en: We want this to be like a home, not an institution.
examples.zh: 我们希望这里像个家，而不像收容所。

senses.def: a custom or system that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people

examples.en: He claimed this threatened ‘the sacred institution of marriage’.
examples.zh: 他声称此举威胁了“神圣的婚姻传统”。

examples.en: Fish and chips became a national institution in Britain.
examples.zh: 炸鱼和薯条已经成了英国的一种文化。

senses.def: the act of starting or introducing something such as a system or a law

examples.en: the institution of new safety procedures
examples.zh: 新安全规程的制定

senses.def: a person who is well known because they have been in a particular place or job for a long time
senses.zh: （某地或某工作领域）出名的人

examples.en: You must know him—he's an institution around here!
examples.zh: 你一定认识他，他是这一带的知名人物！

senses.def: connected with a large important organization, for example a university or bank

examples.en: institutional investors
examples.zh: 机构投资者

senses.def: in or like a place where people are sent to live and be cared for, for example a hospital, prison or special school
senses.zh: 在或类似人们被送去居住和接受照顾的地方，例如医院、监狱或特殊学校

examples.en: institutional care
examples.zh: 慈善机构的照顾

examples.en: The hotel rooms are rather drab and institutional.
examples.zh: 酒店的房间相当单调且陈旧。

senses.def: established as part of the normal systems, practices, etc. of an organization, society or culture
senses.zh: 作为组织、社会或文化的正常系统、实践等的一部分而建立

examples.en: institutional racism
examples.zh: 系统性种族主义

senses.def: the fact of being sent to live in an institution such as a prison or hospital for a period of time
senses.zh: 机构化：被送往监狱或医院等机构生活一段时间

examples.en: She came from a background of abuse, poverty and teenage institutionalization.
examples.zh: 她的背景是遭受虐待、贫困和青少年被送入收容机构。

senses.def: the act of making something become established as part of the normal systems, practices, etc. of an organization, society or culture
senses.zh: 使某事物成为组织、社会或文化的正常系统、实践等一部分的行为

examples.en: the institutionalization of cryptocurrencies
examples.zh: 加密货币的制度化

examples.en: The institutionalization of corruption paralysed the system.
examples.zh: 腐败的制度化使整个体系瘫痪。

senses.def: to send somebody to live and be cared for in an institution
senses.zh: 把（某人）送到收容机构（医院或监狱）

senses.def: to make something become established as part of the normal systems, practices, etc. of an organization, society or culture
as part of the normal systems, practices, etc. of an organization, society or culture
senses.zh: 作为组织、社会或文化的正常系统、实践等的一部分

examples.en: The organization was branded as institutionally racist.
examples.zh: 该组织被贴上制度性种族主义的标签。

senses.def: in or by an institution (= a large organization such as a hospital, university, prison, etc.)

examples.en: an institutionally endorsed public statement from the professor
examples.zh: 教授得到机构认可的公开声明

senses.def: to tell somebody to do something, especially in a formal or official way

examples.en: The letter instructed him to report to headquarters immediately.
examples.zh: 那封信指示他立即向总部汇报。

examples.en: You will be instructed where to go as soon as the plane is ready.
examples.zh: 飞机一准备好就会通知你去何处。

examples.en: She arrived at 10 o'clock as instructed.
examples.zh: 她依照指示于 10 点钟到达。

examples.en: He instructed that a wall be built around the city.
examples.zh: 他下令在城的周围筑一道城墙。

examples.en: He instructed that a wall should be built around the city.
examples.zh: 他下令在城的周围筑一道城墙。

examples.en: ‘Put it there,’ she instructed (them).
examples.zh: “把它放在那儿。”她吩咐（他们）道。

senses.def: to teach somebody something, especially a practical skill

examples.en: All our staff have been instructed in sign language.
examples.zh: 我们的员工都接受过手语训练。

senses.def: to give somebody information about something

examples.en: We have been instructed that a decision will not be made before the end of the week.
examples.zh: 我们已获悉周末前不会作出决定。

senses.def: to employ somebody to represent you in a legal situation, especially as a lawyer

intro.en: These words all mean to use your position of authority to say to somebody that they must do something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含命令、指挥、要求之义。

items.def: to use your position of authority to tell somebody to do something:
items.zh: 指命令、指挥、要求

examples.en: The company was ordered to pay compensation to its former employee.
examples.zh: 公司被勒令向以前的员工作出补偿。

items.def: to say to somebody that they must or should do something:
items.zh: 指命令、指示、吩咐

examples.en: He was told to sit down and wait.
examples.zh: 有人吩咐他坐下等着。

items.def: (rather formal) to tell somebody to do something, especially in a formal or official way:
items.zh: 尤指以正式或官方的方式指示、命令、吩咐

examples.en: The letter instructed him to report to headquarters immediately.
examples.zh: 那封信指示他立即向总部汇报。

items.def: (formal) to give an official order:
items.zh: 指正式发出指示、命令

examples.en: The judge directed the jury to return a verdict of not guilty.
examples.zh: 法官指示陪审团作出无罪裁决。

items.def: to use your position of authority to tell somebody to do something:
items.zh: 指命令、指挥、要求

examples.en: He commanded his men to retreat.
examples.zh: 他命令手下撤退。

senses.def: detailed information on how to do or use something

examples.en: Follow the instructions on the packet carefully.
examples.zh: 仔细按照包装上的说明操作。

examples.en: Always read the instructions before you start.
examples.zh: 使用前务请阅读操作说明。

examples.en: Step-by-step instructions are provided.
examples.zh: 提供了分步说明。

examples.en: The plant comes with full instructions on how to care for it.
examples.zh: 这棵植物附有详尽的护养说明。

examples.en: The tin or packet should be clearly labelled with instructions for use.
examples.zh: 罐头或包装上应清楚地贴上使用说明标签。

examples.en: The website has easy instructions for making dozens of costumes for children.
examples.zh: 网站介绍了几十套儿童服装的简单制作方法。

examples.en: According to the instructions, you can get started in one hour.
examples.zh: 按照说明，一小时就可以上手。

senses.def: something that somebody tells you to do

examples.en: Climbers should always follow the instructions of their guide.
examples.zh: 登山者无论何时都应遵循向导的指示。

examples.en: to ignore/carry out somebody's instructions
examples.zh: 忽视╱执行某人的命令

examples.en: Police are awaiting instructions from senior officers before proceeding.
examples.zh: 警方正在等待高级官员的指示，然后再采取行动。

examples.en: His instructions to his staff were very clear.
examples.zh: 他对员工的指示非常明确。

examples.en: She gave him detailed instructions on the procedure to be followed.
examples.zh: 她就工作程序给了他详细的指示。

examples.en: The government has issued specific instructions on reducing waste disposal.
examples.zh: 政府已经发布了减少废物处理的具体指令。

examples.en: I had received the necessary instructions for the work the day before.
examples.zh: 前一天我已经收到了必要的工作指示。

examples.en: He left strict instructions that the box should only be opened after his death.
examples.zh: 他严令那个箱子在他死后才能打开。

examples.en: I have explicit instructions not to let anyone else in.
examples.zh: 我收到明确的指示，不得让任何人进来。

examples.en: I'm under instructions to keep my speech short.
examples.zh: 我接到指示讲话要简短。

examples.en: He phoned you on my instructions.
examples.zh: 他按我的指示打电话给你。

senses.def: a piece of information that tells a computer to perform a particular operation

examples.en: The chip runs at speeds of up to 100MHz and executes two instructions per clock cycle.
examples.zh: 芯片以100 兆赫的速度运行，每个脉冲周期可以执行两条指令。

senses.def: the act of teaching something to somebody

examples.en: Religious instruction is banned in all state schools in the country.
examples.zh: 该国禁止所有公立学校传授宗教教义。

examples.en: the language/medium of instruction used in the school
examples.zh: 学校使用的授课语言

examples.en: She had no formal instruction in music.
examples.zh: 她没有受过正规的音乐教育。

examples.en: basic instruction on using the internet
examples.zh: 互联网基本使用方法的说明

examples.en: driver under instruction (= being taught how to drive)
examples.zh: 驾驶员接受指导（= 被教导如何驾驶）

senses.def: directions to a lawyer who has been employed to represent somebody
senses.zh: 给受雇代表某人的律师的指示

examples.en: Lawyers may not accept instructions in cases where they would have a conflict of interests.
examples.zh: 律师遇到有利益冲突的情况时不可以接受委托。

senses.def: giving detailed information on how to do or use something (= giving instructions)
senses.zh: 说明用法的；操作指南的

examples.en: an instruction manual
examples.zh: 用法说明

examples.en: an instruction book/sheet
examples.zh: 说明书

examples.en: I had to refer to the instruction booklet.
examples.zh: 我得查阅说明书。

senses.def: that teaches people something

examples.en: instructional materials
examples.zh: 教材

senses.def: giving a lot of useful information
senses.zh: 富有教益的；增长知识的

examples.en: It was a most instructive experience.
examples.zh: 那是使人获益良多的经历。

examples.en: It is instructive to see how other countries are tackling the problem.

examples.zh: 这项政策旨在使有特殊需要的儿童融入普通学校。

senses.def: a small microchip
the act or process of combining two or more things so that they work together

examples.en: The aim is to promote closer economic integration.
examples.zh: 目的是进一步促进经济一体化。

examples.en: His music is an integration of tradition and new technology.
examples.zh: 他的音乐结合了传统和新技术。

senses.def: the act or process of mixing people who have previously been separated, usually because of colour, race, religion, etc.
senses.zh: （不同肤色、种族、宗教信仰等的人的）混合，融合

examples.en: racial integration in schools
examples.zh: 学校对不同种族学生的接纳

examples.en: measures to promote the social integration of people with learning difficulties
examples.zh: 促进有学习困难的人融入社会的措施

examples.en: the use of sport to facilitate the integration of child refugees into society
examples.zh: 利用体育促进儿童难民融入社会

senses.def: in which many different parts are closely connected and work successfully together
senses.zh: 各部分密切协调的；综合的；完整统一的

examples.en: The company takes an integrative approach to resource management.
examples.zh: 该公司采用综合方法进行资源管理。

senses.def: in which the usual scientific methods of Western medicine are combined with other types of treatment
senses.zh: 将西医常用的科学方法与其他类型的治疗相结合

examples.en: The doctor is an expert in integrative biology.
examples.zh: 这位医生是综合生物学方面的专家。

senses.def: medical treatment that combines alternative medicine
senses.zh: 将替代医学（=不属于西医科学方法的治疗类型）与西方国家使用的标准医疗类型相结合的医疗治疗

examples.en: They offer a course in integrative medicine, with the goal of teaching future physicians about whole-person care.
examples.zh: 他们提供综合医学课程，目的是向未来的医生传授全人护理知识。

senses.def: the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles

examples.en: personal/professional/artistic integrity
examples.zh: 个人的／职业上的／艺术家的诚实正直

examples.en: She behaved with absolute integrity.
examples.zh: 她的行为表现绝对诚实正直。

examples.en: a man of great integrity
examples.zh: 一个非常正直的人

senses.def: the state of being whole and not divided

examples.en: to respect the territorial integrity of the nation
examples.zh: 尊重该国的领土完整

senses.def: the ability to think in a logical way and understand things, especially at an advanced level; your mind
senses.zh: （尤指高等的）智力，逻辑思维领悟力

examples.en: a man of considerable intellect
examples.zh: 相当有才智的人

senses.def: a very intelligent person
senses.zh: 智力高的人；才智超群的人

examples.en: She was one of the most formidable intellects of her time.
examples.zh: 她是当时的一名盖世英才。

senses.def: connected with or using a person’s ability to think in a logical way and understand things

examples.en: Gifted children typically show great intellectual curiosity and a wide range of interests.
examples.zh: 天才儿童通常表现出极大的求知欲和广泛的兴趣。

examples.en: an intellectual novel
examples.zh: 智识小说

senses.def: well educated and enjoying activities in which you have to think seriously about things

examples.en: She's very intellectual.
examples.zh: 她很聪慧。

senses.def: a person who is well educated and enjoys activities in which they have to think seriously about things

examples.en: He was a leading intellectual of his day.
examples.zh: 他是那个时代杰出的知识分子。

senses.def: an idea, a design, etc. that somebody has created and that the law prevents other people from copying

examples.en: intellectual property rights
examples.zh: 知识产权

senses.def: the use of your ability to think in a logical way and understand things rather than of your emotions
senses.zh: （尤指高等的）智力，逻辑思维领悟力

examples.en: He rejected the cold intellectualism he perceived in French cinema.
examples.zh: 他拒绝接受他在法国电影中所看到的冷酷的知性主义。

senses.def: to deal with or explain things by thinking about them in a logical way, rather than responding emotionally

examples.en: Religious faith cannot be intellectualized.
examples.zh: 无法对宗教信仰做理性探究。

examples.en: She said she did not intellectualize music and let the violins just wash over her.
examples.zh: 她说她没有将音乐理智化，让小提琴淹没了她。

examples.en: I think a lot of people have a tendency to intellectualize too much.
examples.zh: 我认为很多人都有过于理智化的倾向。

senses.def: in a way that is connected with or using a person's ability to think in a logical way and understand things

examples.en: intellectually challenging
examples.zh: 考验智力的

senses.def: the ability to learn, understand and think in a logical way about things; the ability to do this well

examples.en: a person of high/average/low intelligence
examples.zh: 智力高的／一般的／低下的人

examples.en: He didn't even have the intelligence to call for an ambulance.
examples.zh: 他连呼叫救护车的心眼都没有。

examples.en: As a director, he tends to underestimate the intelligence of his audience.
examples.zh: 作为导演，他往往会低估观众的智商。

examples.en: Please don't insult my intelligence by lying to me.
examples.zh: 请不要用假话侮辱我的智力。

senses.def: secret information that is collected, for example about a foreign country, especially one that is an enemy; the people that collect this information
senses.zh: （尤指关于敌国的）情报；情报人员

examples.en: the head of military intelligence
examples.zh: 军事情报主管

examples.en: the collection of foreign intelligence
examples.zh: 收集外国情报

examples.en: the director of national intelligence
examples.zh: 国家情报总监

examples.en: They hope to gather more intelligence on any further plots.
examples.zh: 他们希望收集更多情报，以确认是否还有其他阴谋。

examples.en: We've obtained secret intelligence about enemy plans.
examples.zh: 我们获得了关于敌方计划的秘密情报。

examples.en: The government had intelligence from several different sources.
examples.zh: 政府从多个不同来源获得情报。

examples.en: intelligence agencies/services
examples.zh: 情报机构

examples.en: an intelligence officer/official/agent
examples.zh: 情报官员／人员

examples.en: the intelligence community (= all the people that collect this information)
examples.zh: 情报界

examples.en: intelligence sources (= people who give this information)
examples.zh: 情报来源

examples.en: intelligence reports
examples.zh: 情报人员的报告

senses.def: a measurement of a person’s intelligence that is calculated from the results of special tests
a test to measure how well a person is able to understand and think in a logical way about things
good at learning, understanding and thinking in a logical way about things; showing this ability
senses.zh: 有才智的；悟性强的；聪明的

examples.en: a highly intelligent child
examples.zh: 非常聪明的孩子

examples.en: She is clearly extremely intelligent.
examples.zh: 她显然非常聪明。

examples.en: to have an intelligent conversation/discussion/debate
examples.zh: 作理智的对话／讨论／辩论

examples.en: to ask an intelligent question
examples.zh: 问一个机智的问题

senses.def: able to understand and learn things
senses.zh: 有智力的；有理解和学习能力的

examples.en: Elephants are intelligent creatures and enjoy interacting with humans.
examples.zh: 大象是聪明的动物，喜欢与人类互动。

examples.en: a search for intelligent life on other planets
examples.zh: 在其他行星上探索有智力的生命

senses.def: able to store information and use it in new situations

examples.en: intelligent robots/algorithms
examples.zh: 智能机器人／算法

intro.en: These words all describe people who are good at learning, understanding and thinking about things, and the actions that show this ability.
intro.zh: 以上各词均形容人有才智、悟性强、聪明。

items.def: good at learning, understanding and thinking in a logical way about things; showing this ability:
items.zh: 指有才智的、悟性强的、聪明的

examples.en: He’s a highly intelligent man.
examples.zh: 他是一个很有才智的人。

items.def: (especially North American English尤用于美式英语) quick at learning and understanding things; showing the ability to make good business or personal decisions:
items.zh: 指聪明的、机敏的、精明的

examples.en: She’s smarter than her brother.
examples.zh: 她比她哥哥聪明。

items.def: (sometimes disapproving, especially British English尤用于英式英语) quick at learning and understanding things; showing this ability:
items.zh: 指聪明的、聪颖的

examples.en: How clever of you to work it out!
examples.zh: 你解决了这个问题真是太聪明了。

items.def: extremely intelligent or showing a lot of skill:
items.zh: 指聪颖的、技艺高的

examples.en: He’s a brilliant young scientist.
examples.zh: 他是一个才华横溢的青年科学家。

items.def: intelligent; quick to learn:
items.zh: 指聪明的、悟性强的

examples.en: She’s probably the brightest student in the class.
examples.zh: 她大概是班里最聪明的学生。

senses.def: the belief that the universe and living things were created by an intelligent being
senses.zh: 智创论，智能设计论，智慧设计论（相信宇宙及生物是智能创造的结果）

examples.en: the legal battle about the teaching of intelligent design as science
examples.zh: 围绕将智创论作为科学进行教授的法律战

examples.en: There were calls for intelligent design to be taught as well as evolution.
examples.zh: 有人呼吁教授智能设计和进化论。

senses.def: in a way that shows the ability to learn, understand and think in a logical way about things

examples.en: intelligently designed products
examples.zh: 智能设计的产品

examples.en: She spoke intelligently on the subject.
examples.zh: 她在这个问题上的发言很明智。

senses.def: a computer or program that behaves intelligently

examples.en: Smart cards can store large amounts of data and interact intelligently with a smart card reader.
examples.zh: 智能卡可以存储大量数据并与智能卡读卡器智能交互。

senses.def: the people in a country or society who are well educated and are interested in culture, politics, literature, etc.

examples.en: The intelligentsia was/were less influential than before.
examples.zh: 知识分子的影响力比以前小了。

senses.def: the fact of being able to be easily understood

examples.en: Neruda became so popular due to the quality and intelligibility of his poetry.
examples.zh: 聂鲁达因其诗歌的质量和易懂性而变得如此受欢迎。

senses.def: that can be easily understood

examples.en: His lecture was readily intelligible to all the students.
examples.zh: 他的讲课学生们都能轻松地听懂。

examples.en: The child’s speech was barely intelligible.
examples.zh: 那个小孩子的话很难懂。

senses.def: in a way that can be easily understood

examples.en: With speech therapy, he is learning to speak intelligibly.
examples.zh: 通过言语治疗，他正在学习清晰地说话。

senses.def: an organization of countries that owns and operates an international satellite system
senses.zh: 国际通信卫星组织；国际电信卫星组织

senses.def: a lack of control over yourself, especially when this is a habit
senses.zh: 节制：对自己的控制力不足，尤其是当这是一种习惯时

senses.def: the habit of regularly drinking too much alcohol
showing a lack of control over yourself

examples.en: intemperate language
examples.zh: 过激的言语

senses.def: regularly drinking too much alcohol
to have a plan, result or purpose in your mind when you do something

examples.en: We finished later than we had intended.
examples.zh: 我们完成时已超出原定时间。

examples.en: I fully intended (= definitely intended) to pay for the damage.
examples.zh: 我确实诚心想赔偿损失。

examples.en: I never intended to hurt you.
examples.zh: 我从来都没想伤害你。

examples.en: The train we had originally intended to catch had already left.
examples.zh: 我们原本打算搭乘的火车已经开走了。

examples.en: The writer clearly intends his readers to identify with the main character.
examples.zh: 作者显然想使读者能与主人公产生共鸣。

examples.en: I don't intend staying long.
examples.zh: 我不打算长期逗留。

examples.en: The company intends a slowdown in expansion.
examples.zh: 公司准备放慢扩展速度。

examples.en: He intended her no harm (= it was not his plan to harm her).
examples.zh: 他无意伤害她。

examples.en: It is intended that production will start next month.
examples.zh: 计划在下个月开始生产。

examples.en: We intend that production will start next month.
examples.zh: 我们计划下个月开始生产。

senses.def: to plan that something should have a particular meaning

examples.en: What exactly did you intend by that remark?
examples.zh: 你那句话到底想说什么？

examples.en: He intended it as a joke.
examples.zh: 他只想开个玩笑。

senses.def: very great; very strong

examples.en: We were all suffering in the intense heat.
examples.zh: 我们都深受酷热之苦。

examples.en: intense cold/pain
examples.zh: 剧烈寒冷/疼痛

examples.en: They watched with intense interest.
examples.zh: 他们饶有兴趣地观看。

examples.en: intense pleasure/desire/anger
examples.zh: 强烈的快乐/欲望/愤怒

examples.en: The President is under intense pressure to resign.
examples.zh: 总统承受着沉重的辞职压力。

examples.en: His business affairs have been under intense scrutiny.
examples.zh: 他的商业事务一直受到密切关注。

examples.en: He was startled by the intense blue of her eyes.
examples.zh: 她深蓝色的眼睛让他吃了一惊。

senses.def: serious and often involving a lot of action in a short period of time

examples.en: There is intense competition for the top jobs.
examples.zh: 高层职位的竞争非常激烈。

examples.en: It was a period of intense activity.
examples.zh: 那是活动激烈的时期。

senses.def: having or showing very strong feelings, opinions or thoughts about somebody/something
senses.zh: 有强烈感情（或意见、想法）的；尖锐的；热切的

examples.en: an intense look
examples.zh: 热切的神情

examples.en: She's very intense about everything.
examples.zh: 她对一切都非常热衷。

senses.def: in a very great or very strong way

examples.en: She disliked him intensely.
examples.zh: 她非常讨厌他。

examples.en: an intensely personal moment
examples.zh: 一个非常个人化的时刻

senses.def: in a serious way that often involves a lot of action in a short period of time

examples.en: A team of firefighters worked intensely for more than half an hour to free him.
examples.zh: 消防队员奋力奋战半个多小时才将他救出。

senses.def: in a way that shows very strong feelings, opinions or thoughts about somebody/something
senses.zh: 有强烈感情（或意见、想法）的；尖锐的；热切的

examples.en: He looked intensely into her eyes.
examples.zh: 他专注地看着她的眼睛。

senses.def: the fact of increasing in degree or strength

examples.en: an intensification of the conflict
examples.zh: 冲突激化

senses.def: the fact of farming methods becoming more intensive

examples.en: Intensification of agriculture has had a devastating effect on wildlife.
examples.zh: 农业集约化对野生动物造成了毁灭性影响。

senses.def: a word, especially an adjective or an adverb, for example so
senses.zh: 强调成分，强化词（尤指形容词或副词，如 so 或 very）

senses.def: to increase in degree or strength; to make something increase in degree or strength

examples.en: Violence intensified during the night.
examples.zh: 在夜间暴力活动加剧了。

examples.en: The fighting in the area has intensified sharply.
examples.zh: 该地区的战事陡然升级。

examples.en: The opposition leader has intensified his attacks on the government.
examples.zh: 反对派领袖加强了对政府的攻击。

examples.en: The reforms served only to intensify the misery of the poorer peasants.
examples.zh: 这些改革只是让贫困农民的日子更苦了。

senses.def: the state or quality of being intense

examples.en: intensity of light/sound/colour
examples.zh: 光／声音／色彩的强度

examples.en: intensity of feeling/concentration/relief
examples.zh: 感情的强烈；高度精神集中；大为宽慰

examples.en: He was watching her with an intensity that was unnerving.
examples.zh: 他用一种令她心慌的专注神情看着她。

examples.en: The storm resumed with even greater intensity.
examples.zh: 风暴更猛烈地再度肆虐。

senses.def: the strength of something, for example light, that can be measured

examples.en: varying intensities of natural light
examples.zh: 自然光不断变化的强度

examples.en: a band of light with high intensity
examples.zh: 一束强光

senses.def: involving a lot of work or activity done in a short time
senses.zh: 短时间内集中紧张进行的；密集的

examples.en: an intensive language course
examples.zh: 速成语言课程

examples.en: two weeks of intensive training
examples.zh: 两周的强化训练

examples.en: intensive diplomatic negotiations
examples.zh: 紧张的外交谈判

examples.en: highly intensive courses for business and professional people
examples.zh: 为商务和职业人士开设的高度强化课程

senses.def: complete and extremely detailed; done with a lot of care

examples.en: His disappearance has been the subject of intensive investigation.
examples.zh: 他失踪一事一直是大力调查的重点。

senses.def: aimed at producing as much food as possible using as little land or as little money as possible

examples.en: Traditionally reared animals grow more slowly than those reared under intensive farming conditions.
examples.zh: 按传统方式饲养的家畜比集约饲养的长得慢。

examples.en: intensive agriculture
examples.zh: 集约农业

senses.def: continuous care and attention, often using special equipment, for people in hospital who are very seriously ill or injured
senses.zh: （医院里的）特别护理；重症监护

examples.en: She needed intensive care for several days.
examples.zh: 她需要几天的特别护理。

examples.en: intensive care patients/beds
examples.zh: 特别护理病房的病人／床位

senses.def: the part of a hospital that provides intensive care
senses.zh: 重症监护室；加强监护病房

examples.en: The baby was in intensive care for 48 hours.
examples.zh: 婴儿在加护病房看护了 48 小时。

examples.en: She’s still critically ill in intensive care.
examples.zh: 她仍处于重症监护室，病情危重。

senses.def: in a complete and extremely detailed way; with a lot of care
senses.zh: 密集地：以完整且极其详细的方式；小心翼翼

examples.en: This case has been intensively studied.
examples.zh: 这一案件已经过深入研究。

senses.def: in a way that involves a lot of work or activity done in a short time
senses.zh: 短时间内集中紧张进行的；密集的

examples.en: She was studying intensively six days a week.
examples.zh: 她每周有六天集中学习。

senses.def: in a way that is aimed at producing as much food as possible using as little land or as little money as possible

examples.en: intensively farmed land
examples.zh: 集约耕作的农田

senses.def: what you intend to do

examples.en: She denies possessing the drug with intent to supply.
examples.zh: 她否认拥有毒品是为了提供给别人。

examples.en: He was charged with wounding with intent.
examples.zh: 他被指控故意伤人。

examples.en: a letter/statement of intent
examples.zh: 意向书

examples.en: His intent is clearly not to placate his critics.
examples.zh: 他的目的显然不是要安抚批评他的人。

senses.def: in the effects that something has, if not in reality; almost completely

examples.en: By 1981 the docks had, to all intents and purposes, closed.
examples.zh: 到 1981 年，这些码头几乎等于关闭了。

examples.en: The two items are, for all intents and purposes, identical.
examples.zh: 这两件物品几乎完全一样。

senses.def: showing strong interest and attention

examples.en: an intent gaze/look
examples.zh: 专注的目光／神情

examples.en: His eyes were suddenly intent.
examples.zh: 他的目光突然专注起来。

examples.en: His face filled with an intent curiosity.
examples.zh: 他的脸上充满了强烈的好奇心。

examples.en: Her gaze was suddenly intent.
examples.zh: 她的目光突然变得专注起来。

senses.def: determined to do something, especially something that will harm other people
senses.zh: 决心做（尤指伤害他人的事）

examples.en: They were intent on murder.
examples.zh: 他们存心谋杀。

examples.en: Are you intent upon destroying my reputation?
examples.zh: 你是不是存心要败坏我的名誉？

examples.en: They are clearly intent on maintaining standards.
examples.zh: 他们显然下定决心要维持标准。

senses.def: giving all your attention to something

examples.en: I was so intent on my work that I didn't notice the time.
examples.zh: 我专心工作，以致忘了时间。

examples.en: The bright brown eyes were intent on Marie.
examples.zh: 明亮的棕色眼睛专注地看着玛丽。

examples.en: She was very intent on her work.
examples.zh: 她专心工作。

senses.def: in the effects that something has, if not in reality; almost completely

examples.en: By 1981 the docks had, to all intents and purposes, closed.
examples.zh: 到 1981 年，这些码头几乎等于关闭了。

examples.en: The two items are, for all intents and purposes, identical.
examples.zh: 这两件物品几乎完全一样。

senses.def: what you intend or plan to do; your aim

examples.en: I have no intention of going to the wedding.
examples.zh: 我无意去参加婚礼。

examples.en: I have every intention of paying her back what I owe her.
examples.zh: 我一心想把我欠她的还给她。

examples.en: She left England with the intention of travelling in Africa.
examples.zh: 她离开英国，打算去非洲旅行。

examples.en: He has announced his intention to retire.
examples.zh: 他已经宣布他打算退休。

examples.en: The Prime Minister declared her intention to remain in office despite declining support.
examples.zh: 尽管支持率下降，总理仍宣布打算继续留任。

examples.en: The original intention was to devote three months to the project.
examples.zh: 最初的计划是在这个项目上投入三个月的时间。

examples.en: His intentions in making this proposal are clear.
examples.zh: 他提出这个建议的意图是明确的。

examples.en: It was not my intention that she should suffer.
examples.zh: 我没有要她吃苦头的意思。

examples.en: She's full of good intentions but they rarely work out.
examples.zh: 她虽然是一片好心，却往往事与愿违。

examples.en: I did it with the best (of) intentions (= meaning to help), but I only succeeded in annoying them.
examples.zh: 我的原意是要帮忙，却惹得他们生气了。

senses.def: it is not enough to intend to do good things; you must actually do them
senses.zh: 黄泉路上徒有好意多；光说不练是不够的

examples.en: There were no other buildings to interrupt the view of the valley.
examples.zh: 没有别的建筑物遮挡住观赏山谷的视线。

senses.def: something that temporarily stops an activity or a situation; a time when an activity is stopped

examples.en: The game continued after a short interruption because of rain.
examples.zh: 比赛因雨短暂中断后继续进行。

examples.en: The birth of her son was a minor interruption to her career.
examples.zh: 她儿子的出生对她的事业造成一个小小的中断。

examples.en: There's been an interruption in the power supply.
examples.zh: 曾经发生停电。

examples.en: I managed to work for two hours without interruption.
examples.zh: 我总算连续工作了两小时。

senses.def: the act of interrupting somebody/something and of stopping them from speaking

examples.en: He ignored her interruptions.
examples.zh: 他没有理会她的打岔。

examples.en: She spoke for 20 minutes without interruption.
examples.zh: 她连续讲了 20 分钟。

senses.def: involving or held between different schools
senses.zh: 校际的；两个学校之间的

examples.en: an interscholastic athletic program
examples.zh: 校际体育运动计划

senses.def: to meet or cross each other

examples.en: a pattern of intersecting streets
examples.zh: 纵横交错的街道图

examples.en: The lines intersect at right angles.
examples.zh: 线条垂直相交。

examples.en: The path intersected with a busy road.
examples.zh: 小路与一条繁忙的大路相交。

senses.def: to divide an area by crossing it

examples.en: The landscape is intersected with spectacular gorges.
examples.zh: 大地上峡谷纵横，非常壮观。

senses.def: a place where two or more roads, lines, etc. meet or cross each other
senses.zh: 十字路口；交叉路口；交点

examples.en: Traffic lights have been placed at all major intersections.
examples.zh: 所有主要的交叉路口都安装了交通信号灯。

examples.en: It is a busy intersection, almost invariably clogged with traffic.
examples.zh: 这是个繁忙的交叉路口，交通几乎总是堵塞。

examples.en: The accident occurred at the intersection of Mulholland Drive with Canyonback Road.
examples.zh: 事故发生在 Mulholland Drive 与 Canyonback Road 的交叉口。

senses.def: the act of intersecting
relating to different social categories such as race, class and gender
senses.zh: 与种族、阶级和性别等不同社会类别相关，以及这些类别结合起来导致额外不利或歧视的方式

examples.en: Intersectional feminism includes all women, whatever their ethnicity, class, sexual orientation, etc.
examples.zh: 交叉女权主义包括所有女性，无论其种族、阶级、性取向等。

examples.en: She is excited to represent her intersectional identities as a low-income student and a woman of color in STEM.
examples.zh: 她很高兴能够在 STEM 中展现自己作为低收入学生和有色人种女性的交叉身份。

senses.def: the network of connections between social categories such as race, class and gender
senses.zh: 种族、阶级和性别等社会类别之间的联系网络，特别是当这可能导致额外的不利或歧视时

examples.en: An awareness of intersectionality can allow us to better understand our unconscious prejudices.
examples.zh: 对交叉性的认识可以让我们更好地理解我们无意识的偏见。

senses.def: describing or relating to a person or animal that has both male and female sex organs or other sexual characteristics; born with sexual characteristics that do not fit the categories of either ‘

examples.en: an intersex child
examples.zh: 间性儿童

examples.en: to be born with intersex traits
examples.zh: 天生有间性特征

senses.def: the condition of having both male and female sex organs or other sexual characteristics
to put something in something else or among or between other things

examples.en: Lectures will be interspersed with practical demonstrations.
examples.zh: 讲课中将不时插入实际示范。

examples.en: Interspersed in the narrative are the personal stories of several important women architects.
examples.zh: 叙述中穿插着几位重要女建筑师的个人故事。

examples.en: a scattering of alpine flowers interspersed among crags of weathered rock
examples.zh: 散布在风化岩石峭壁中的高山花朵

examples.en: a series of short films, liberally interspersed with commercial breaks
examples.zh: 一系列短片，随意穿插商业广告

senses.def: between states, especially in the US
senses.zh: （尤指美国）州与州之间的，州际的

examples.en: interstate commerce
examples.zh: 州际贸易

senses.def: a wide road, with at least two lanes

examples.en: We were driving down the interstate.
examples.zh: 我们正驱车顺州际公路而行。

examples.en: You can take Interstate 10 all the way into Baton Rouge.
examples.zh: 沿 10 号州际公路一直走就能进入巴吞鲁日。

senses.def: between the stars in the sky
a small break or space in something
in or related to small spaces between the parts of an organ or between groups of cells or tissues

examples.en: interstitial cells
examples.zh: 间质细胞

senses.def: the relationship between texts, especially literary texts
senses.zh: （尤指文学文本之间的）互文性

senses.def: if two or more things intertwine

examples.en: intertwining branches
examples.zh: 缠绕在一起的树枝

examples.en: a necklace of rubies intertwined with pearls
examples.zh: 缠着珍珠的红宝石项链

senses.def: to be or become very closely connected with something/somebody else

examples.en: Their political careers had become closely intertwined.
examples.zh: 他们的政治生涯已经紧密地结合在一起了。

senses.def: a period of time between two events

examples.en: The interval between major earthquakes might be 200 years.
examples.zh: 大地震之间的间隔时间可能有 200 年。

examples.en: He knocked on the door and after a brief interval it was opened.
examples.zh: 他敲了敲门，过了一会儿门开了。

senses.def: a short period of time separating parts of a play, film or concert
senses.zh: （戏剧、电影或音乐会的）幕间休息，休息时间

examples.en: There will be an interval of 20 minutes after the second act.
examples.zh: 第二幕结束后将休息 20 分钟。

senses.def: a short period during which something different happens from what is happening the rest of the time

examples.en: She's delirious, but has lucid intervals.
examples.zh: 她神志昏乱，但有时清醒。

examples.en: The day should be mainly dry with sunny intervals.
examples.zh: 白天大部分时间干燥无雨，间有阳光。

examples.en: The intervals between his various illnesses grew shorter and shorter.
examples.zh: 他生病间隔的时间越来越短了。

senses.def: a difference in pitch

examples.en: an interval of one octave
examples.zh: 一个八度音程

senses.def: an activity in interval training

examples.en: You can do intervals by alternating power walking with easy jogging.
examples.zh: 你可以交替做快速步行和轻松慢跑来进行间歇训练。

senses.def: with time between

examples.en: Buses to the city leave at regular intervals.
examples.zh: 开往城里的公共汽车每隔一定时间发出一班。

examples.en: The runners started at 5-minute intervals.
examples.zh: 赛跑的人每隔 5 分钟出发一批。

senses.def: with spaces between

examples.en: Flaming torches were positioned at intervals along the terrace.
examples.zh: 沿排房每隔一段距离插着燃烧着的火炬。

examples.en: The flags were spaced at two-metre intervals.
examples.zh: 旗帜的间隔为两米。

senses.def: with time between

examples.en: Buses to the city leave at regular intervals.
examples.zh: 开往城里的公共汽车每隔一定时间发出一班。

examples.en: The runners started at 5-minute intervals.
examples.zh: 赛跑的人每隔 5 分钟出发一批。

senses.def: with spaces between

examples.en: Flaming torches were positioned at intervals along the terrace.
examples.zh: 沿排房每隔一段距离插着燃烧着的火炬。

examples.en: The flags were spaced at two-metre intervals.
examples.zh: 旗帜的间隔为两米。

senses.def: sports training consisting of different activities that require different speeds or amounts of effort
senses.zh: 间歇训练（包括不同速度或强度的活动）

senses.def: to become involved in a situation in order to improve or help it

examples.en: She might have been killed if the neighbours hadn't intervened.
examples.zh: 要不是邻居介入，她可能会没命了。

examples.en: The President intervened personally in the crisis.
examples.zh: 总统亲自出面处理这场危机。

examples.en: She went over to intervene between the two men.
examples.zh: 她走过去为两个男人进行调解。

examples.en: They would not intervene against the rebels themselves.
examples.zh: 他们自己不会插手反对叛乱分子。

examples.en: attempts to intervene with the authorities on the prisoners' behalf
examples.zh: 代表犯人与当局交涉的尝试

examples.en: They intervened to halt the attack.
examples.zh: 他们介入阻止了袭击。

senses.def: to interrupt somebody when they are speaking in order to say something

examples.en: ‘But,’ she intervened, ‘what about the others?’
examples.zh: “但是，”她插嘴说，“其他的怎么办呢？”

senses.def: to happen in a way that delays something or prevents it from happening

examples.en: They were planning to get married and then the war intervened.
examples.zh: 他们当时正准备结婚，却因爆发战事而受阻。

senses.def: to exist between two events or places

examples.en: I saw nothing of her during the years that intervened.
examples.zh: 这期间的几年中我根本没有见过她。

senses.def: action taken to improve or help a situation

examples.en: calls for government intervention to save the steel industry
examples.zh: 呼吁政府出面挽救钢铁业

examples.en: In the second group of states, direct intervention in the economy was limited.
examples.zh: 对于第二组别的国家，对经济的直接干预是有限的。

senses.def: action by a country to become involved in the affairs of another country when they have not been asked to do so
senses.zh: （对他国事务的）介入，干预，干涉行为

examples.en: armed/military intervention
examples.zh: 武装／军事干涉

examples.en: NATO intervention in the troubled region
examples.zh: 北约对这一动荡地区的干预行动

senses.def: action taken to improve a medical condition or illness

examples.en: a medical/surgical intervention
examples.zh: 医疗／手术干预

examples.en: Most patients make a recovery without further intervention.
examples.zh: 大多数患者无需进一步干预即可康复。

senses.def: the act of interrupting somebody when they are speaking in order to say something

examples.en: People resented his repeated interventions in the debate.
examples.zh: 人们讨厌他一再干涉辩论。

senses.def: an occasion when a group of people meet to take action with a friend or family member who has an addiction
senses.zh: （对有毒瘾或酒瘾的朋友或家人的）帮助戒毒，帮助戒酒

examples.en: Her daughters staged an intervention.
examples.zh: 她的女儿们介入帮她戒瘾。

examples.en: Family intervention is an essential component of treatment for adolescent drug abuse.
examples.zh: 家庭干预是青少年药物滥用治疗的重要组成部分。

senses.def: the policy or practice of a government influencing the economy of its own country, or of becoming involved in the affairs of other countries
senses.zh: 政府干预（政策）；干涉主义

senses.def: a person who believes in the policy or practice of a government influencing the economy of its own country, or of becoming involved in the affairs of other countries

examples.en: liberal/humanitarian interventionists
examples.zh: 自由主义/人道主义干预主义者

senses.def: connected with the policy or practice of a government influencing the economy of its own country, or of becoming involved in the affairs of other countries

examples.en: interventionist policies
examples.zh: 干涉主义政策

senses.def: a formal meeting at which somebody is asked questions to see if they are suitable for a particular job, or for a course of study at a college, university, etc.

examples.en: a job interview
examples.zh: 求职面试

examples.en: She's been called for (an) interview.
examples.zh: 她已获通知约见。

examples.en: He has an interview next week for the manager's job.
examples.zh: 他下周要接受一个经理职位的面试。

examples.en: I got an interview with a PR company for a trainee position.
examples.zh: 我接受了一家公关公司实习生职位的面试。

examples.en: In the interview they asked me about my future plans.
examples.zh: 他们在面试中问我未来的计划。

examples.en: He came across very well at the interview.
examples.zh: 他在采访中给人的印象非常好。

senses.def: a meeting (often a public one) at which a journalist asks somebody questions in order to find out their opinions

examples.en: a television/TV/radio/newspaper interview
examples.zh: 电视／电台／报纸采访

examples.en: to do/give an interview (= to agree to answer questions)
examples.zh: 接受采访

examples.en: to conduct an interview (= to ask somebody questions in public)
examples.zh: 进行采访

examples.en: The interview was published in all the papers.
examples.zh: 各家报纸都刊载了这次访谈。

examples.en: Yesterday, in an interview on German television, the minister denied the reports.
examples.zh: 部长昨天在德国电视台播放的访问中否认了那些报道。

examples.en: an in-depth interview with the new governor
examples.zh: 对新任州长的深入采访

examples.en: an exclusive interview about her new book
examples.zh: 关于她的新书的独家专访

examples.en: The film begins with an interview by two local student reporters.
examples.zh: 影片以两名当地学生记者的采访开始。

senses.def: a private meeting between people when questions are asked and answered

examples.en: a telephone/phone interview
examples.zh: 电话会谈

examples.en: She's had an interview with the careers adviser.
examples.zh: 她已经接受了职业顾问的面试。

examples.en: He gave a very full account in long interviews with experienced police officers.
examples.zh: 他在与经验丰富的警官的长时间采访中给出了非常全面的叙述。

examples.en: Interviews and questionnaires are the most important tools in market research.
examples.zh: 访谈和问卷调查是市场研究中最重要的工具。

senses.def: to talk to somebody and ask them questions at a formal meeting to find out if they are suitable for a job, course of study, etc.
senses.zh: 对（某人）进行面试（或面谈）

examples.en: The university interviews all potential candidates.
examples.zh: 大学面试所有潜在的候选人。

examples.en: Which post are you being interviewed for?
examples.zh: 你参加哪个职位的面试？

examples.en: We interviewed ten people for the job.
examples.zh: 我们为这份工作面试了十人。

examples.en: The deadline for applications is 15 October and we will be interviewing early in November.
examples.zh: 申请的截止日期是10月15日，我们将在11月初进行面试。

senses.def: to talk to somebody and answer questions at a formal meeting to get a job, a place on a course of study, etc.

examples.en: The website gives you tips on interviewing for colleges.
examples.zh: 这个网站为你提供大学面试的窍门。

examples.en: If you don't interview well you are unlikely to get the job.
examples.zh: 如果面试时表现不好，你很可能不会得到这份工作。

senses.def: to ask somebody questions about their life, opinions, etc., especially on the radio or television or for a newspaper or magazine

examples.en: Next week, I will be interviewing Spielberg about his latest movie.
examples.zh: 下周我将访问斯皮尔伯格，谈论他的最新电影。

examples.en: The prime minister declined to be interviewed.
examples.zh: 首相婉拒了采访。

examples.en: I heard her being interviewed on the news earlier.
examples.zh: 我早些时候听到她在新闻中接受采访。

senses.def: to ask somebody questions at a private meeting

examples.en: The police are waiting to interview the injured man.
examples.zh: 警察正等待着向受伤的男子问话。

examples.en: After 14 days, patients were interviewed about the recurrence of any symptoms.
examples.zh: 14 天后，对患者进行访谈，了解是否有任何症状复发。

intro.en: These are all words for a meeting or occasion when somebody is asked for information, opinions or advice.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示会见、询问、咨询。

items.def: a formal meeting at which somebody is asked questions, for example, to see if they are suitable for a particular job or course of study, or in order to find out their opinions about something:
items.zh: 指面试、面谈

examples.en: a job interview
examples.zh: 求职面试

items.def: the process of asking somebody a lot of questions, especially in an aggressive way, in order to get information; an occasion on which this is done:
items.zh: 指讯问、审问、盘问

examples.en: He confessed after four days under interrogation.
examples.zh: 他在受讯问四天之后招认了。

items.def: a formal meeting with an important person:
items.zh: 指与要人的会见、觐见

examples.en: The Pope granted her a private audience.
examples.zh: 教皇同意私下接见她。

items.def: a meeting with an expert, especially a doctor, to get advice or treatment.
items.zh: 指向专家请教的咨询，尤指就诊

senses.def: the person who answers the questions in an interview
senses.zh: 参加面试者；接受采访者

senses.def: the person who asks the questions in an interview

examples.en: The interviewer made the candidates feel relaxed.
examples.zh: 面试官让应聘者感到轻松。

examples.en: Interviewers rarely ask about his personal life.
examples.zh: 采访记者极少问他个人生活方面的问题。

examples.en: She once told an interviewer, ‘A dancer’s life is very hard.’
examples.zh: 她曾在一次采访中说过“舞蹈家的生活很苦”。

senses.def: happening or existing between two wars, especially the First and the Second World Wars
senses.zh: 两次战争之间的；（尤指）两次世界大战之间的

examples.en: the interwar years/period
examples.zh: 两次世界大战之间的时期

senses.def: to twist

examples.en: The blue fabric was interwoven with red and gold thread.
examples.zh: 蓝布中交织着红色和金色的线。

examples.en: The problems are inextricably interwoven (= very closely connected).
examples.zh: 问题盘根错节。

senses.def: to be able to connect, communicate, or exchange data
the state of not having made a will

examples.en: the law of intestacy
examples.zh: 无遗嘱法

senses.def: not having made a will
connected with the intestines

examples.en: intestinal surgery/infection
examples.zh: 肠道手术/感染

examples.en: the intestinal tract/wall
examples.zh: 肠道；肠壁

senses.def: the courage and strength of mind necessary to do something difficult or unpleasant (used when you want to avoid using the word guts
senses.zh: 勇气，决心，毅力（guts 的委婉语）

examples.en: He did not have the intestinal fortitude to implement the changes.
examples.zh: 他没有胆量实行变革。

examples.en: It’s rare to find a politician with the intestinal fortitude to take a controversial stance.
examples.zh: 很少有政治家能够有毅力采取有争议的立场。

senses.def: a long tube in the body between the stomach and the anus

examples.en: bacteria in the small intestine
examples.zh: 小肠中的细菌

senses.def: the state of having a close personal relationship with somebody

examples.en: She isn't capable of real intimacy.
examples.zh: 她不能与人真正亲密相处。

examples.en: The old intimacy between them had gone for ever.
examples.zh: 他们往日的亲密已经不复存在了。

examples.en: He enjoys an intimacy with the president.
examples.zh: 他和总统有密切往来。

senses.def: a private and comfortable atmosphere

examples.en: The room had a peaceful sense of intimacy about it.
examples.zh: 房间有一种宁静舒适的气氛。

examples.en: The noise destroyed the intimacy of their conversation.
examples.zh: 噪声破坏了他们交谈的那份亲密。

senses.def: a thing that a person says or does to somebody that they know very well
sexual activity, especially an act of sexual intercourse
having a close and friendly relationship

examples.en: intimate friends
examples.zh: 密友

examples.en: We're not on intimate terms with our neighbours.
examples.zh: 我们和邻居来往不多。

senses.def: private and personal, often in a sexual way
senses.zh: 个人隐私的（常指性方面的）

examples.en: The article revealed intimate details about his family life.
examples.zh: 文章披露了他的家庭生活中的隐私。

examples.en: the most intimate parts of the body
examples.zh: 身体最私密的部位

senses.def: encouraging close, friendly relationships, sometimes of a sexual nature
senses.zh: 宜于密切关系的；温馨的；便于有性关系的

examples.en: an intimate restaurant
examples.zh: 幽静温馨的餐厅

examples.en: He knew an intimate little cafe where they would not be disturbed.
examples.zh: 他知道有一家私密的小咖啡馆，在那里他们不会被打扰。

senses.def: very detailed

examples.en: an intimate knowledge of the English countryside
examples.zh: 对英格兰乡村的透彻了解

senses.def: very close

examples.en: an intimate connection between class and educational success
examples.zh: 社会阶层和优良教育之间的密切联系

senses.def: having a sexual relationship with somebody
to let somebody know what you think or mean

examples.en: He has already intimated to us his intention to retire.
examples.zh: 他已经向我们透露了他退休的打算。

examples.en: He has already intimated (that) he intends to retire.
examples.zh: 他已经透露了他退休的打算。

senses.def: a close personal friend

examples.en: He was a wartime minister and intimate of Churchill.
examples.zh: 他是战时部长，也是丘吉尔的密友。

senses.def: in a very close and friendly way
senses.zh: 亲密接触：以非常亲密和友好的方式

examples.en: The characters in the film become intimately involved in each other's lives.
examples.zh: 影片中的角色紧密地融入彼此的生活。

senses.def: in a private and personal, and often a sexual, way
senses.zh: 个人隐私的（常指性方面的）

examples.en: She was talking intimately with a young man.
examples.zh: 她正在和一个年轻人亲密地交谈。

examples.en: They touched each other intimately.
examples.zh: 他们相互爱抚。

senses.def: if you know somebody/something intimately
senses.zh: 亲密地：如果您熟识某人/某物，则可以非常详细和完整地了解他们/它

examples.en: They were intimately familiar with the US laws and regulations.
examples.zh: 他们非常熟悉美国的法律法规。

examples.en: an area of the country that he knew intimately
examples.zh: 这个国家他很熟悉的一个地区

senses.def: connected or involved in a very close way
senses.zh: 亲密：非常紧密地联系或参与

examples.en: The two issues are intimately connected.
examples.zh: 这两个问题密切相关。

examples.en: She was intimately involved in the project.
examples.zh: 她已投到这个项目中去。

senses.def: the act of stating something or of making it known, especially in an indirect way

examples.en: There was no intimation from his doctor that his condition was serious.
examples.zh: 他的医生没有透露他的病情很严重。

senses.def: to frighten or threaten somebody so that they will do what you want

examples.en: They were accused of intimidating people into voting for them.
examples.zh: 他们被控胁迫选民投他们的票。

examples.en: She refused to be intimidated by their threats.
examples.zh: 她没有被他们的威胁吓倒。

senses.def: the act of frightening or threatening somebody so that they will do what you want

examples.en: the intimidation of witnesses

examples.zh: 主席自我介绍并开始讨论。

examples.zh: 她确保向所有新同事介绍了自己。
