senses.group: bringing into use/to a place 采用；引进

senses.def: a thing that is brought into use or introduced to a place for the first time
senses.zh: 新采用（或新引进）的事物

examples.en: The book lists plants suitable for the British flower garden, among them many new introductions.
examples.zh: 这本书列出了适合英国花园种植的花草，其中有很多新引进的品种。

senses.group: bringing into use/to a place 采用；引进

senses.def: a person’s first experience of something

examples.en: This album was my first introduction to modern jazz.
examples.zh: 这张专辑让我初次接触了现代爵士乐。

senses.def: a book or course for people beginning to study a subject

examples.en: ‘Global Politics: An Introduction’
examples.zh: 《全球政治学导论》

examples.en: It's a useful introduction to an extremely complex subject.
examples.zh: 这是对一门极为复杂的学科的有益入门教程。

examples.en: ‘An Introduction to Astronomy’
examples.zh: 《天文学入门》

examples.en: The course provides a brief introduction to philosophy.
examples.zh: 该课程简要介绍了哲学。

senses.def: a short section at the beginning of a piece of music

examples.en: an eight-bar introduction
examples.zh: 有八个小节的前奏

examples.en: After a lengthy musical introduction, the dancers finally appear.
examples.zh: 一段冗长的音乐铺垫之后，舞蹈演员们总算现身了。

senses.def: written or said at the beginning of something as an introduction to what follows

examples.en: introductory chapters/paragraphs/remarks
examples.zh: 序篇；引言段；开场白

senses.def: intended as an introduction to a subject or an activity for people who have never done it before

examples.en: introductory courses/lectures
examples.zh: 基础课程／讲座

examples.en: The booklist at the end of the chapter contains some introductory reading on the subject.
examples.zh: 章节末尾的书单列出了一些有关该主题的导读材料。

senses.def: offered for a short time only, when a product is first on sale

examples.en: a special introductory price of just $10
examples.zh: 仅 10 美元的优惠上市价

examples.en: This introductory offer is for three days only.
examples.zh: 本试销优惠只为期三天。

senses.def: the careful examination of your own thoughts, feelings and reasons for behaving in a particular way

examples.en: These situations are best resolved with the minimum of introspection or self-analysis.
examples.zh: 这些情况最好通过最少的内省或自我分析来解决。

examples.en: You can’t always get to a real understanding of your own psychology through introspection alone.
examples.zh: 仅通过内省，你无法总是真正了解自己的心理。

senses.def: tending to think a lot about your own thoughts, feelings, etc.

examples.en: There were a lot of family problems and Jim became increasingly introspective.
examples.zh: 由于家里出了很多事，吉姆越来越满怀心事。

examples.en: an introspective piece of writing
examples.zh: 一篇反思性的文章

senses.def: the quality of being quiet and more interested in your own thoughts and feelings than in spending time with other people

examples.en: Some people claim that an individual’s degree of extroversion or introversion is inherited.
examples.zh: 有些人声称一个人的外向或内向程度是遗传的。

senses.def: a quiet person who is more interested in their own thoughts and feelings than in spending time with other people
senses.zh: 内向的人；不喜欢与人交往的人

examples.en: He was described as an introvert, a reserved man who spoke little.
examples.zh: 他被描述为一个内向、沉默寡言的人。

senses.def: more interested in your own thoughts and feelings than in spending time with other people

examples.en: I'm a very shy and introvert person.
examples.zh: 我是一个非常害羞和内向的人。

senses.def: more interested in your own thoughts and feelings than in spending time with other people

examples.en: Her teachers perceived her as shy and introverted.
examples.zh: 她的老师认为她害羞且内向。

examples.en: She was as naturally extroverted as Paul was painfully introverted.
examples.zh: 她天生性格外向，而保罗却极其内向。

examples.en: They targeted rather introverted and socially inept individuals.
examples.zh: 他们针对的是相当内向和社交无能的人。

senses.def: to go or be somewhere where you are not wanted or are not supposed to be

examples.en: I'm sorry to intrude, but I need to talk to someone.
examples.zh: 对不起打扰了，不过我有话要找人谈。

examples.en: legislation to stop newspapers from intruding on people’s private lives
examples.zh: 禁止报章侵犯他人私生活的立法

examples.en: We should not intrude upon their private grief.
examples.zh: 我们不该过问他们不愿公开的伤心事。

senses.def: to enter into something in a way that is not wanted or to have an unpleasant effect on it

examples.en: The sound of the telephone intruded into his dreams.
examples.zh: 电话铃声把他从梦中扰醒了。

senses.def: a person who enters a building or an area illegally

examples.en: The intruder fired at least one more shot at the guard and then fled.
examples.zh: 入侵者向警卫至少开了一枪，然后逃跑了。

examples.en: Intruder alarms are being fitted in many schools as a way of improving security.
examples.zh: 作为提高安全性的一种方式，许多学校都安装了入侵警报器。

senses.def: a person who is somewhere where they are not wanted
senses.zh: 不受欢迎的人；不速之客

examples.en: The people in the room seemed to regard her as an unwelcome intruder.
examples.zh: 屋子里的人似乎把她当成不受欢迎的外人。

senses.def: something that affects a situation or people’s lives in a way that they do not want
senses.zh: 侵扰性的事物；扰乱；侵犯

examples.en: They claim the noise from the new airport is an intrusion on their lives.
examples.zh: 他们声称新机场的噪声侵扰了他们的生活。

examples.en: This was another example of press intrusion into the affairs of the royals.
examples.zh: 这是新闻界侵扰王室成员私事的又一实例。

senses.def: the act of entering a place that is private or where you may not be wanted

examples.en: She apologized for the intrusion but said she had an urgent message.
examples.zh: 她为径自闯进来道歉，但说她有紧急消息。

examples.en: He leapt back in shock at this sudden intrusion.
examples.zh: 面对这一突然的闯入，他惊得往后一跳。

senses.def: too direct, easy to notice, etc. in a way that is annoying or upsetting
senses.zh: 侵入的；闯入的；侵扰的；烦扰的

examples.en: intrusive questions
examples.zh: 唐突的问题

examples.en: The constant presence of the media was very intrusive.
examples.zh: 媒体一直在场，十分令人讨厌。

senses.def: produced in order to link two words together when speaking, for example the /
to put a tube into a hollow space in the body, for example to allow a person to breathe

examples.en: They managed to intubate the victim inside the wrecked car.
examples.zh: 他们设法为失事汽车里的受害者插了管。

examples.en: to intubate the trachea
examples.zh: 给气管插管

examples.en: We made the decision not to intubate.
examples.zh: 我们决定不插管。

senses.def: the act of putting a tube into a hollow space in the body, for example to allow a person to breathe

examples.en: The patient required intubation during the operation.
examples.zh: 患者在手术过程中需要插管。

senses.def: to know that something is true based on your feelings rather than on facts, what somebody tells you, etc.

examples.en: She intuited that something was badly wrong.
examples.zh: 她凭直觉感到出了大问题。

senses.def: the ability to know something by using your feelings rather than considering the facts

examples.en: Intuition told her that he had spoken the truth.
examples.zh: 直觉告诉她，他说的是实话。

examples.en: He was guided by intuition and personal judgement.
examples.zh: 他以直觉和个人判断为指导。

examples.en: The answer came to me in a flash of intuition.
examples.zh: 直觉一闪，我就得到了答案。

senses.def: an idea or a strong feeling that something is true although you cannot explain why

examples.en: I had an intuition that something awful was about to happen.
examples.zh: 我直觉感到要出乱子了。

senses.def: obtained by using your feelings rather than by considering the facts

examples.en: He had an intuitive sense of what the reader wanted.
examples.zh: 他能直觉地感到读者需要什么。

senses.def: able to understand something by using feelings rather than by considering the facts

examples.en: She was an intuitive person, quickly understanding what people wanted and needed.
examples.zh: 她是一个直觉敏锐的人，很快就能理解人们想要什么和需要什么。

senses.def: easy to understand and to use
by using your feelings rather than by considering the facts

examples.en: Intuitively, she knew that he was lying.
examples.zh: 她凭直觉知道他在说谎。

examples.en: He intuitively understood the need for privacy.
examples.zh: 他直觉地理解隐私的必要性。

senses.def: computer software, etc. that works intuitively

examples.en: intuitively designed
examples.zh: 直观设计

senses.def: a member of an indigenous
senses.zh: 来自加拿大北部以及格陵兰岛和阿拉斯加部分地区的土著人民的成员。这个名字有时也被错误地用来指代来自西伯利亚和阿拉斯加南部和西部的人。

senses.def: the language of the Inuit people
the language of the Inuit people
to give or send somebody so many things that they cannot deal with them all
senses.zh: 使不胜负荷；使应接不暇

examples.en: We have been inundated with offers of help.
examples.zh: 主动援助多得使我们应接不暇。

examples.en: She's inundated with work at the moment.
examples.zh: 她现在正被工作淹没。

examples.en: Fans inundated the radio station with calls.
examples.zh: 歌迷们纷纷给广播电台打电话。

senses.def: to cover an area of land with a large amount of water

examples.en: Flood waters inundate the river plain each spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天洪水都会淹没河流平原。

examples.en: Many sheep were lost in the floods and the city was inundated.
examples.zh: 许多羊在洪水中消失，城市被淹没。

senses.def: the fact of large amounts of water covering an area that is usually dry

examples.en: the annual inundation of the Nile valley
examples.zh: 尼罗河谷每年都会被洪水淹没

senses.def: a very large number of things or people

examples.en: an inundation of campaign posters
examples.zh: 大量的竞选海报

senses.def: to make somebody/yourself get used to something unpleasant so that they/you are no longer strongly affected by it
senses.zh: 使习惯于，使适应（不愉快的事物）

examples.en: The prisoners quickly became inured to the harsh conditions.
examples.zh: 囚犯们很快就适应了苛刻的条件。

examples.en: He gradually inured himself to her absence.
examples.zh: 他渐渐习惯了她的缺席。

senses.def: to enter a country, town, etc. using military force in order to take control of it

examples.en: Troops invaded on August 9th that year.
examples.zh: 军队是在那年的 8 月 9 日入侵的。

examples.en: When did the Romans invade Britain?
examples.zh: 古罗马人是何时侵略不列颠的？

senses.def: to enter a place in large numbers, especially in a way that causes damage or problems
senses.zh: （尤指造成损害或问题地）涌入，侵入

examples.en: Demonstrators invaded the government buildings.
examples.zh: 大批示威者闯进了政府办公大楼。

examples.en: As the final whistle blew, fans began invading the pitch.
examples.zh: 随着终场哨声的吹响，球迷们开始涌入球场。

examples.en: The cancer cells may invade other parts of the body.
examples.zh: 癌细胞可能扩散到身体的其他部位。

senses.def: to affect something in an unpleasant or annoying way

examples.en: Do the press have the right to invade her privacy in this way?
examples.zh: 新闻界有权以这种方式干扰她的私生活吗？

examples.en: You feel tense with worrying thoughts constantly invading your sleep.
examples.zh: 您感到紧张，担心的想法不断侵入您的睡眠。

senses.def: an army or a country that enters another country by force in order to take control of it; a soldier fighting in such an army
senses.zh: 武装入侵的军队（或国家）；侵略者

examples.en: a foreign invader
examples.zh: 外国侵略者

examples.en: They prepared to repel the invaders.
examples.zh: 他们准备赶走侵略军。

examples.en: The white blood cells attack cells infected with an invader.
examples.zh: 白细胞攻击受到感染的细胞。

senses.def: not legally or officially acceptable
senses.zh: （法律上或官方）不承认的；无效的

examples.en: The treaty was declared invalid because it had not been ratified.
examples.zh: 条约没有得到批准，因此被宣布无效。

examples.en: People with invalid papers are deported to another country.
examples.zh: 持无效证件的人被驱逐到别国。

examples.en: This action would render the agreement invalid.
examples.zh: 这一行动会导致协议无效。

senses.def: not based on all the facts, and therefore not correct
senses.zh: 无充分事实的；站不住脚的

examples.en: an invalid argument
examples.zh: 站不住脚的论点

senses.def: of a type that the computer cannot recognize

examples.en: An error code will be displayed if any invalid information has been entered.
examples.zh: 输入了无效信息将显示错误代码。

examples.en: invalid characters
examples.zh: 无效字符

senses.def: a person who needs other people to take care of them, because of illness that they have had for a long time

examples.en: She had been a delicate child and her parents had treated her as an invalid.
examples.zh: 她小时候很虚弱，父母就把她当个病人照料。

examples.en: He was found guilty of murdering his invalid father.
examples.zh: 他被判谋杀了生病的父亲。

examples.en: Her husband was an invalid and couldn’t come to the door to open it.
examples.zh: 她的丈夫身体不好，无法上门开门。

senses.def: to force somebody to leave the armed forces because of an illness or injury

examples.en: He was invalided out of the army in 1943.
examples.zh: 他于 1943 年因伤病退役。

senses.def: to prove that an idea, a story, an argument, etc. is wrong

examples.en: This new piece of evidence invalidates his version of events.
examples.zh: 这条新证据推翻了他对事件经过的说法。

examples.en: Flawed research methods may invalidate the study’s conclusions.
examples.zh: 错误的研究方法可能会使得研究结论站不住脚。

senses.def: if you invalidate

examples.en: Misuse of the mattress will invalidate the guarantee
examples.zh: 床垫因使用不当造成的损坏不予保修。

senses.def: the act of saying that a document, contract, election, etc. is no longer legally or officially acceptable

examples.en: the invalidation of the regulation by the High Court
examples.zh: 高等法院宣布该规例无效

senses.def: the act of proving that an idea, a story, an argument, etc. is wrong

examples.en: the invalidation of the theory
examples.zh: 理论的无效

senses.def: the state of being unable to take care of yourself because of illness or injury
the state of not being legally or officially acceptable
extremely useful

examples.en: invaluable information
examples.zh: 宝贵的信息

examples.en: The book will be invaluable for students in higher education.
examples.zh: 这本书对于高校学生将有重大价值。

examples.en: The research should prove invaluable in the study of children's language.
examples.zh: 这项调查对于儿童语言的研究应极有价值。

senses.def: always the same; never changing
senses.zh: 始终如一的；永无变化的

examples.en: Her routine was invariable.
examples.zh: 她的日常生活总是千篇一律。

examples.en: his invariable courtesy and charm
examples.zh: 他那一贯的彬彬有礼和魅力

examples.en: an invariable principle
examples.zh: 一贯原则

examples.en: This is an invariable law: true at all times and places.
examples.zh: 这是一条不变的法则：无论何时何地都是如此。

senses.def: always

examples.en: This acute infection of the brain is almost invariably fatal.
examples.zh: 这种急性大脑传染病几乎总是导致死亡。

examples.en: This is not invariably the case.
examples.zh: 事情并非总是如此。

examples.en: Invariably the reply came back, ‘Not now!’
examples.zh: 答复无例外地又是：“现在不行！”

senses.def: always the same; never changing
the act of an army entering another country by force in order to take control of it

examples.en: the German invasion of Poland in 1939
examples.zh: 德国于 1939 年对波兰的侵略

examples.en: the threat of invasion
examples.zh: 入侵的威胁

examples.en: an invasion force/fleet
examples.zh: 侵略军；入侵舰队

senses.def: the fact of a large number of people or things arriving somewhere, especially people or things that are unpleasant

examples.en: the annual tourist invasion
examples.zh: 一年一度游客的涌入

examples.en: Farmers are struggling to cope with an invasion of slugs.
examples.zh: 农民正在努力对付大批侵入的蛞蝓。

examples.en: Robberies and home invasions are grim facts of daily life.
examples.zh: 抢劫和侵入民宅都是日常生活中令人难以接受的事情。

senses.def: an act or a process that affects somebody/something in a way that is not welcome

examples.en: The singer described the photographs of her as an invasion of privacy.
examples.zh: 这位歌手称她的照片侵犯了隐私。

senses.def: spreading very quickly and difficult to stop

examples.en: invasive cancer
examples.zh: 扩散性肿瘤

senses.def: involving cutting into the body

examples.en: invasive surgery
examples.zh: 开刀手术

senses.def: brought into an environment where they are not naturally found, and causing harm to that environment or other living things in it
senses.zh: 入侵的（指危害本地生态的外来物种）

examples.en: This toad is an invasive species that has now become widespread.
examples.zh: 这种蟾蜍是入侵物种，现已广泛分布。

examples.en: The plant was introduced to the West Coast and is invasive in North America.
examples.zh: 这种植物被引入美国西海岸，成为北美的入侵物种。

senses.def: affecting somebody's thoughts or privacy
senses.zh: 影响某人的想法或隐私

examples.en: I found the constant background noise very invasive.
examples.zh: 我发现持续不断的背景噪音非常具有侵入性。

examples.en: They asked her a lot of intimate and invasive questions.
examples.zh: 他们问了她很多私密和侵入性的问题。

senses.def: rude language and unpleasant remarks that somebody shouts when they are very angry

examples.en: The gesture infuriated him and he let out a stream of invective.
examples.zh: 这个举动激怒了他，他破口大骂。

examples.en: a speech full of invective against the government
examples.zh: 充满谩骂政府的演讲

senses.def: to criticize somebody/something strongly
to achieve control over somebody in a clever and dishonest way, especially so that they will do what you want

examples.en: He inveigled himself into her affections (= dishonestly made her love him).
examples.zh: 他骗取了她的爱。

senses.def: to produce or design something that has not existed before

examples.en: Who invented the steam engine?
examples.zh: 谁发明了蒸汽机？

examples.en: I wish mobile phones had never been invented!
examples.zh: 我希望手机从未被发明！

examples.en: The term ‘sociology’ was invented by Auguste Comte.
examples.zh: sociology（社会学）这个词是奥古斯特•孔德创造出来的。

senses.def: to say or describe something that is not true, especially in order to trick people

examples.en: What excuse did he invent this time?
examples.zh: 他这次编了什么借口？

examples.en: Many children invent an imaginary friend.
examples.zh: 很多儿童都有一个假想朋友。

senses.def: a thing or an idea that has been invented

examples.en: Fax machines were a wonderful invention at the time.
examples.zh: 传真机在当时是一项了不起的发明。

examples.en: He failed to patent his invention and never made a penny from it.
examples.zh: 他未能为自己的发明申请到专利，因而一分钱也没赚到。

senses.def: the act of inventing something

examples.en: Such changes have not been seen since the invention of the printing press.
examples.zh: 自从发明了印刷机，这种变革还没有出现过。

examples.en: After the war, Westinghouse devoted himself to invention.
examples.zh: 战后，西屋电气致力于发明。

senses.def: the act of inventing a story or an idea and pretending that it is true; a story invented in this way

examples.en: This story is apparently a complete invention.
examples.zh: 这个故事显然完全是虚构的。

examples.en: Most of what she says is pure invention.
examples.zh: 她所说的大部分内容纯粹是发明。

examples.en: What would he tell his parents? Some invention and quick thinking—that’s what was needed.
examples.zh: 他会跟他的父母说什么？胡编乱造加上随机应变－这就是他所需要的。

senses.def: the ability to have new and interesting ideas

examples.en: John was full of invention—always making up new dance steps and sequences.
examples.zh: 约翰有丰富的创造力，总能编出新的舞步和连续舞步。

examples.en: Her powers of invention were somewhat limited.
examples.zh: 她的发明能力有些有限。

senses.def: a difficult new problem forces people to think of a solution to it

items.idm: necessity is the mother of invention

senses.def: a difficult new problem forces people to think of a solution to it
able to think of new and interesting ideas

examples.en: She has a highly inventive mind.
examples.zh: 她的头脑非常善于创新。

senses.def: new and interesting

examples.en: This is a courageous and inventive piece of film-making.
examples.zh: 这部电影的拍摄手法大胆创新。

senses.def: in a way that shows that you can think of new and interesting ideas
the ability to think of new and interesting ideas; the fact of showing this ability
senses.zh: 思考新的有趣想法的能力；展示这种能力

examples.en: the inventiveness of modern advertising
examples.zh: 现代广告的创意

senses.def: a person who has invented something or whose job is inventing things

examples.en: He made a career as an inventor of quick-selling gadgets.
examples.zh: 他以发明畅销小器具为职业。

examples.en: Trevor Bayliss, inventor of the clockwork radio
examples.zh: 特雷弗•贝利斯－发条式收音机的发明者

senses.def: a written list of all the objects, furniture, etc. in a particular building
senses.zh: （建筑物里的物品、家具等的）清单；财产清单

examples.en: an inventory of the museum’s contents
examples.zh: 博物馆馆藏清单

senses.def: all the goods in a store

examples.en: The inventory will be disposed of over the next twelve weeks.
examples.zh: 在未来的十二个星期将进行库存清仓。

examples.en: inventory control
examples.zh: 库存管理

senses.def: all of the stock of a business, including materials, components, work in progress and finished products
senses.zh: (会计中)企业的所有存货，包括材料、组件、在制品和成品

examples.en: Business inventories rose 0.7% in October.
examples.zh: 10 月份商业库存增长 0.7%。

senses.def: to make a complete list of something; to include something in a list

examples.en: I've inventoried my father's collection of prints.
examples.zh: 我把父亲收藏的版画列成了清单。

examples.en: Every book was inventoried.
examples.zh: 每本书都被清点了。

senses.def: a city in Scotland, located at the mouth of the River Ness
senses.zh: 因弗内斯（苏格兰城市，位于尼斯河口）

senses.def: opposite in amount or position to something else

examples.en: A person's wealth is often in inverse proportion to their happiness (= the more money they have, the less happy they are).
examples.zh: 一个人的财富常常与他的幸福成反比。

examples.en: There is often an inverse relationship between the power of the tool and how easy it is to use.
examples.zh: 工具的功能越强大，操作起来往往越费事。

senses.def: the exact opposite of something
in a way that is opposite in amount or position to something else

examples.en: The temperature of a black hole is inversely proportional to its mass.
examples.zh: 黑洞的温度与其质量成反比。

senses.def: the act of changing the position or order of something to its opposite, or of turning something into a position in which the top of it is where the bottom of it normally is

examples.en: the inversion of normal word order
examples.zh: 正常词序的倒装

examples.en: an inversion of the truth
examples.zh: 颠倒是非

senses.def: to change the normal position of something, especially by turning it into a position in which the top of it is where the bottom of it normally is or by arranging it in the opposite order

examples.en: Place a plate over the cake tin and invert it.
examples.zh: 在蛋糕烤模上盖一个盘子，然后将其翻过来。

examples.en: In questions, the subject and verb are often inverted.
examples.zh: 在疑问句中，主语和动词经常颠倒。

examples.en: The shape looked like an inverted V.
examples.zh: 形状看起来像一个倒V字形。

senses.def: any animal with no backbone
without a backbone

examples.en: invertebrate pests
examples.zh: 无脊椎害虫

senses.def: a pair of marks (‘ ’) or ( “ ” ) placed around a word, sentence, etc. to show that it is what somebody said or wrote, that it is a title or that you are using it in an unusual way
used to show that you think a particular word, description, etc. is not true or appropriate
senses.zh: （对正确性或适合性表示质疑）所谓的，加引号的

examples.en: The manager showed us to our ‘luxury apartment’, in inverted commas.
examples.zh: 经理带我们去看了我们所谓的“豪华单元房”。

senses.def: used to show that you think a particular word, description, etc. is not true or appropriate
senses.zh: （对正确性或适合性表示质疑）所谓的，加引号的

examples.en: The manager showed us to our ‘luxury apartment’, in inverted commas.
examples.zh: 经理带我们去看了我们所谓的“豪华单元房”。

senses.def: the attitude that considers everything connected with high social status to be bad and that is proud of low social status
senses.zh: 倒转势利眼（憎恨一切与上流社会有关的事物，而为下等阶层感到自豪）

senses.def: to buy property, shares in a company, etc. in the hope of making a profit

examples.en: Now is a good time to invest.
examples.zh: 现在是投资的好时机。

examples.en: She advised us to invest in the property market.
examples.zh: 她建议我们投资房地产市场。

examples.en: If you want to invest your money, you are probably better off with bonds.
examples.zh: 如果您想投资，那么投资债券可能会更好。

examples.en: He invested his life savings in his daughter's business.
examples.zh: 他把一生的积蓄投资在女儿的生意上。

examples.en: She personally invested $980 000 in the company.
examples.zh: 她个人向该公司投资了980万美元。

senses.def: to spend money on something in order to make it better or more successful

examples.en: The company plans to invest still further.
examples.zh: 该公司计划进一步投资。

examples.en: The government has invested heavily in public transport.
examples.zh: 政府已对公共交通投入了大量资金。

examples.en: The industry has failed to invest in new product development.
examples.zh: 该行业没能为新产品的开发进行投资。

examples.en: Tokyo instead invested on infrastructure.
examples.zh: 相反，东京投资于基础设施。

examples.en: The rest of the required funds will be invested by the council.
examples.zh: 其余所需资金将由理事会投资。

examples.en: The college is to invest $2 million in a new conference hall.
examples.zh: 这所学院计划投入 200 万美元建造新的会议大厅。

examples.en: In his time managing the club he has invested millions on new players.
examples.zh: 他在管理俱乐部期间投入了几百万培养新运动员。

senses.def: to spend time, energy, effort, etc. on something that you think is good or useful

examples.en: She had invested all her adult life in the relationship.
examples.zh: 她把成年后的时间全用于维护那段关系。

examples.en: He had invested so much personal energy turning the company around.
examples.zh: 他投入了如此多的个人精力来扭转公司的局面。

examples.en: Are you willing to invest the time and effort necessary to make the scheme work?
examples.zh: 你愿意投入必要的时间和精力，以便推行这一计划吗？

senses.def: to give somebody power or authority, especially as part of their job

examples.en: The new position invested her with a good deal of responsibility.
examples.zh: 新职位赋予她重大的责任。

examples.en: The interview was broadcast on the same day he was invested as President.
examples.zh: 这次采访是在他成为总统的当天播放的。

senses.def: to buy something that is expensive but useful

examples.en: Don't you think it's about time you invested in a new coat?
examples.zh: 你不觉得该花点钱买件新外套了吗？

senses.def: to be willing to work hard and give your time and energy to something; to believe strongly in something
senses.zh: 愿意努力工作并为某事付出时间和精力；坚信某事

examples.en: We are invested in providing a top-quality service to our customers.
examples.zh: 我们致力于为客户提供最优质的服务。

senses.def: to make somebody/something seem to have a particular quality

examples.en: Being a model invests her with a certain glamour.
examples.zh: 当模特儿似乎给她增添了一定的魅力。

senses.def: to carefully examine the facts of a situation, an event, a crime, etc. to find out the truth about it or how it happened

examples.en: The FBI has been called in to investigate.
examples.zh: 联邦调查局奉命进行调查。

examples.en: the senior investigating officer
examples.zh: 高级调查官

examples.en: ‘What was that noise?’ ‘I'll go and investigate.’
examples.zh: “那是什么声音？”“我去看一下。”

examples.en: Detectives are currently investigating possible links between the murders.
examples.zh: 警探正在调查这些谋杀案之间可能存在的关联。

examples.en: to investigate a crime/a complaint/an incident
examples.zh: 调查罪案／投诉／事件

examples.en: The allegations have not yet been thoroughly investigated.
examples.zh: 这些指控尚未得到彻底调查。

examples.en: The report calls for a commission to investigate the matter further.
examples.zh: 报告呼吁成立一个委员会进一步调查此事。

examples.en: The case will be investigated in detail to determine whether the claims are true.
examples.zh: 将对案件进行详细调查，以确定这些说法是否属实。

examples.en: Police are investigating what happened.
examples.zh: 警察正在调查发生了什么事。

senses.def: to try to find out information about somebody’s character, activities, etc.

examples.en: This is not the first time he has been investigated by the police for fraud.
examples.zh: 这不是警方第一次调查他是否有欺诈行为。

examples.en: She is being investigated over allegations of illegal business dealings.
examples.zh: 她因非法商业交易指控而接受调查。

examples.en: They were investigated on suspicion of drug smuggling.
examples.zh: 他们因涉嫌走私毒品而受到调查。

senses.def: to find out information and facts about a subject or problem by study or research

examples.en: The study investigates the effects of feeding a high-energy diet to cows.
examples.zh: 这项研究调查了给奶牛喂高能量饲料的效果。

examples.en: Researchers are investigating how foreign speakers gain fluency.
examples.zh: 研究人员正在调查非母语者是怎样提升讲这门语言的流利程度的。

senses.def: an official examination of the facts about a situation, crime, etc.

examples.en: a criminal/murder/police investigation
examples.zh: 刑事／凶案／警方调查

examples.en: an accident investigation team
examples.zh: 事故调查组

examples.en: The president has promised a full investigation.
examples.zh: 总统已承诺进行全面调查。

examples.en: The authorities have launched an investigation to determine why the ferry sank.
examples.zh: 当局已展开调查以确定渡轮沉没的原因。

examples.en: She remains under investigation for fraud.
examples.zh: 她涉嫌欺诈，仍在接受调查。

examples.en: He is under investigation for assaulting a teenager.
examples.zh: 他因袭击一名青少年而受到调查。

examples.en: The police are conducting ongoing investigations into the man's death.
examples.zh: 警方一直在调查该男子死亡这一事件。

examples.en: Officials are calling for an investigation into the incident.
examples.zh: 官员们呼吁对这一事件进行调查。

examples.en: On investigation, the noise turned out to be only a door banging.
examples.zh: 调查后发现那原来只是关门的砰的一声。

examples.en: He is suspended pending a thorough investigation (= until an investigation has happened) of the allegations.
examples.zh: 他被停职，等待对指控进行彻底调查（=直到调查完成）。

senses.def: a scientific or academic examination of the facts of a subject or problem

examples.en: Further investigation revealed a flaw in this theory.
examples.zh: 继续调查后发现这个理论有一个缺陷。

examples.en: Refer patients with these symptoms for further investigation.
examples.zh: 将有这些症状的患者转诊以进行进一步检查。

examples.en: the results of a preliminary investigation into stress at work
examples.zh: 关于工作压力的初步调查结果

senses.def: involving examining an event or a situation to find out the truth

examples.en: The article was an excellent piece of investigative journalism.
examples.zh: 这是一篇优秀的调查研究报道。

examples.en: The police have full investigatory powers.
examples.zh: 警察拥有调查全权。

senses.def: a person who examines a situation such as an accident or a crime to find out the truth

examples.en: air safety investigators
examples.zh: 飞行安全调查人员

examples.en: a private investigator (= a detective)
examples.zh: 私人侦探

senses.def: the fact of somebody formally receiving an official title or special powers; a ceremony at which this happens
the act of investing money in something

examples.en: foreign/private investment
examples.zh: 外国／私人投资

examples.en: capital/business/property investment
examples.zh: 资本/商业/房产投资

examples.en: to attract/encourage investment
examples.zh: 吸引／鼓励投资

examples.en: This country needs investment in education.
examples.zh: 这个国家需要对教育进行投资。

examples.en: This initiative involves considerable long-term investment by the university.
examples.zh: 这一举措涉及大学大量的长期投资。

examples.en: an investment trust/fund/firm
examples.zh: 投资信托／基金／公司

examples.en: an investment adviser
examples.zh: 投资顾问

examples.en: investment opportunities/decisions/strategies
examples.zh: 投资机会/决策/策略

senses.def: the money that you invest, or the thing that you invest in

examples.en: a minimum investment of $10 000
examples.zh: 1 万美元的最低投资额

examples.en: a substantial/significant/major investment
examples.zh: 重大投资

examples.en: Our investments are not doing well.
examples.zh: 我们的投资境况不佳。

examples.en: We bought the house as an investment (= to make money).
examples.zh: 我们买这所房子作为投资。

examples.en: The area is trying to attract £11 million of private investment to stimulate the local economy.
examples.zh: 该地区正试图吸引1100万英镑的私人投资来刺激当地经济。

examples.en: a high return on investment
examples.zh: 投资的高收益

examples.en: investment returns/income
examples.zh: 投资回报/收入

examples.en: Bonds should be part of your investment portfolio.
examples.zh: 你的投资组合中应该包括债券。

senses.def: a thing that is worth buying because it will be useful or helpful
senses.zh: 值得买的东西；有用的投资物

examples.en: A microwave is a good investment.
examples.zh: 微波炉值得买。

senses.def: the act of giving time or effort to a particular task in order to make it successful

examples.en: The project has demanded considerable investment of time and effort.
examples.zh: 该项目已让我们投入了相当多的时间和精力。

examples.en: parents' emotional investment in their children
examples.zh: 父母对子女的感情投入

senses.def: a bank that deals mainly with buying and selling shares and other investments for businesses and private investors
a person who owns or has an important job at a bank that deals with large businesses, helping with buying and selling large numbers of shares in different companies
senses.zh: 商人银行家：在一家与大型企业打交道的银行中拥有或担任重要工作的人，帮助买卖不同公司的大量股票

senses.def: the business activity of banks that deal with large businesses, helping with buying and selling large numbers of shares in different companies
a person or an organization that invests money in something

examples.en: small investors (= private people)
examples.zh: 小额投资者

examples.en: institutional investors
examples.zh: 机构投资者

senses.def: always doing something or enjoying something, and unlikely to stop

examples.en: an inveterate liar
examples.zh: 积习难改的说谎者

examples.en: He was an inveterate traveller.
examples.zh: 他是一位狂热的旅行者。

senses.def: done or felt for a long time and unlikely to change
senses.zh: 长期形成的；根深蒂固的

examples.en: inveterate hostility
examples.zh: 根深蒂固的敌意

senses.def: unpleasant and unfair; likely to offend somebody or make them jealous
senses.zh: 讨厌而不公正的；易引起反感的；招人嫉妒的

examples.en: We were in the invidious position of having to choose whether to break the law or risk lives.
examples.zh: 我们处于左右为难的窘境，不知是要违法还是要拿生命冒险。

examples.en: It would be invidious to single out any one person to thank.
examples.zh: 单独感谢任何一个人都易引起反感。

examples.en: Union leaders called the new rules ‘invidious and divisive’.
examples.zh: 工会领导人称新规则“令人反感且分裂”。

senses.def: to watch people while they are taking an exam to make sure that they have everything they need, that they keep to the rules, etc.

examples.en: to invigilate an exam
examples.zh: 监考

senses.def: the act of watching people while they are taking an exam to make sure that they have everything they need, that they keep to the rules, etc.
a person who watches people while they are taking an exam to make sure that they have everything they need, that they keep to the rules, etc.

examples.en: If you have a problem, ask the invigilator.
examples.zh: 有问题就问监考人。

senses.def: to make somebody feel healthy and full of energy
senses.zh: 使生气勃勃；使精神焕发

examples.en: The cold water invigorated him.
examples.zh: 冷水让他打起了精神。

examples.en: They felt refreshed and invigorated after the walk.
examples.zh: 散步之后他们感到精神焕发。

senses.def: to make a situation, an organization, etc. efficient and successful
senses.zh: 使蒸蒸日上；使兴旺发达

examples.en: They are looking into ways of invigorating the department.
examples.zh: 他们正在寻找激发这个部门活力的方法。

senses.def: the quality of being too strong to be defeated or changed
senses.zh: 不可战胜的；不能改变的

examples.en: He had an aura of invincibility.
examples.zh: 他身上有一种无敌的气势。

senses.def: too strong to be defeated or changed
senses.zh: 不可战胜的；坚不可摧的；难以改变的

examples.en: The team seemed invincible.
examples.zh: 这个队似乎战无不胜。

examples.en: an invincible belief in his own ability
examples.zh: 对他自己的能力坚定不移的信念

senses.def: the fact of having to be respected and not attacked or destroyed
senses.zh: 不容亵渎的；不可侵犯的；不容破坏的

senses.def: that must be respected and not attacked or destroyed
senses.zh: 不容亵渎的；不可侵犯的；不容破坏的

examples.en: the inviolable right to life
examples.zh: 不可侵犯的生命权

examples.en: inviolable territory
examples.zh: 不可侵犯的领土

examples.en: an inviolable rule
examples.zh: 不容违背的规则

senses.def: that has been, or must be, respected and cannot be attacked or destroyed
senses.zh: 未受（或不容）侵犯的；未受（或不容）亵渎的；不容破坏的

examples.en: Their privacy remained inviolate.
examples.zh: 他们的隐私仍然不受侵犯。

senses.def: the fact or state of not being able to be seen
senses.zh: 隐形：看不见的事实或状态

examples.en: The ink had faded to invisibility.
examples.zh: 墨水已褪色看不见了。

senses.def: that cannot be seen

examples.en: a wizard who could make himself invisible
examples.zh: 能隐身的术士

examples.en: She felt invisible in the crowd.
examples.zh: 她觉得自己淹没在人群中。

examples.en: stars invisible to the naked eye
examples.zh: 肉眼看不见的星球

senses.def: ignored or treated as if they/it cannot be seen
senses.zh: 被忽略或被视为看不见

examples.en: Homeless people feel that they are invisible.
examples.zh: 无家可归的人感觉自己是隐形的。

examples.en: It's interesting how women are rendered invisible in these statistics.
examples.zh: 从这些统计数字中根本看不出女性的存在，所用的手法真是有趣。

senses.def: connected with a service that a country provides, such as banks or tourism, rather than goods
senses.zh: 无形的（与服务而非商品有关）

examples.en: invisible earnings
examples.zh: 无形收益

senses.def: a novel (1897) by H G Wells
senses.zh: 隐形人：HG Wells的小说（1897），讲述了一个看不见的人。后来被制作成受欢迎的电影和电视连续剧。

senses.def: a novel (1952) by Ralph Ellison
senses.zh: 看不见的人：拉尔夫·埃里森（Ralph Ellison）的一部小说（1952）

senses.def: in a way that cannot be seen

examples.en: He looked at me and nodded, almost invisibly.
examples.zh: 他看着我点了点头，这一动作几乎让人察觉不到。

senses.def: a spoken or written request to somebody to do something or to go somewhere

examples.en: to issue/extend an invitation
examples.zh: 发出／致送邀请

examples.en: to accept/turn down/decline an invitation
examples.zh: 接受／拒绝／婉拒邀请

examples.en: I received an invitation to the party
examples.zh: 我获邀参加这次聚会。

examples.en: She repeated her invitation for dinner at her place.
examples.zh: 她再次邀请她去她家吃晚饭。

examples.en: We got a wedding invitation from Alex and Chris.
examples.zh: 我们收到了亚历克斯和克里斯的婚礼请柬。

examples.en: I have an open invitation (= not restricted to a particular date) to visit my friend in Japan.
examples.zh: 我在日本的朋友邀请我随时去看他。

senses.def: the act of inviting somebody or of being invited

examples.en: He produced an official letter of invitation.
examples.zh: 他出示了一封正式邀请函。

examples.en: Admission is by invitation only.
examples.zh: 获邀者方可参加。

examples.en: A concert was held at the invitation of the mayor.
examples.zh: 在市长的邀请下举办了一场音乐会。

senses.def: a card or piece of paper that you use to invite somebody to something

examples.en: We've already sent out the invitations.
examples.zh: 我们已经发出了请柬。

examples.en: Have you ordered the wedding invitations yet?
examples.zh: 你定制婚礼请帖了吗？

senses.def: something that encourages somebody to do something or encourages something to happen, usually something bad

examples.en: Leaving the doors unlocked is an open invitation to burglars.
examples.zh: 出门不上锁无异于开门揖盗。

examples.en: Putting the kids in charge was an invitation to disaster.
examples.zh: 让孩子们负责就等于招致灾难。

senses.def: a competition, especially a sports event, that you can take part in only if you are invited
if a competition, especially a sports event, is invitational
to ask somebody to come to a social event
senses.zh: 邀请（某人出席社交场合）

examples.en: Have you been invited to their party?
examples.zh: 你接到参加他们的聚会的邀请了吗？

examples.en: She very kindly invited me to lunch.
examples.zh: 她友好地邀请我一起吃午餐。

examples.en: I'd have liked to have gone but I wasn't invited.
examples.zh: 我倒是想去，但我没接到邀请。

examples.en: My mother invited a few friends that she hadn't seen for 20 years.
examples.zh: 我妈妈邀请了几个她二十年未见的朋友。

examples.en: Let's invite them all for dinner.
examples.zh: 我们邀请他们所有人一起吃饭吧。

examples.en: They have invited me to go to Paris with them.
examples.zh: 他们邀请我和他们一同去巴黎。

senses.def: to ask somebody formally to go somewhere or do something; to make a formal or polite request for something
senses.zh: 正式邀请，请求（某人做某事）

examples.en: The bishop invited representatives from all the parishes in the diocese.
examples.zh: 主教邀请了教区所有堂区的代表。

examples.en: Successful candidates will be invited for interview next week.
examples.zh: 通过甄别的候选人将获邀于下周参加面试。

examples.en: Clarke was not invited to the meeting.
examples.zh: 克拉克没有被邀请参加会议。

examples.en: The ministry had invited tenders for the demolition of the buildings.
examples.zh: 该部已就拆除这些建筑物进行招标。

examples.en: He invited questions from the audience.
examples.zh: 他请听众提问。

examples.en: Readers are invited to email their comments to us.
examples.zh: 欢迎读者通过电子邮件向我们反馈意见。

examples.en: He was invited to attend the Paris Peace Conference in 1919.
examples.zh: 1919年，他应邀出席巴黎和会。

examples.en: Audience members are invited to participate in the discussion.
examples.zh: 邀请观众参与讨论。

examples.en: In 1956 she was invited to join the Bolshoi Ballet as a soloist.
examples.zh: 1956年，她受邀加入莫斯科大剧院芭蕾舞团担任独舞演员。

senses.def: to make something, especially something bad or unpleasant, likely to happen

examples.en: Such comments are just inviting trouble.
examples.zh: 这种评论简直是在自找麻烦。

examples.en: Such harsh punishments invited prisoners to respond with defiance.
examples.zh: 如此严厉的惩罚导致囚犯做出反抗。

senses.def: an invitation

examples.en: Thanks for your invite.
examples.zh: 感谢你的邀请。

senses.def: to ask somebody to go somewhere with you and other people
senses.zh: 邀请某人一道去；请某人同行

examples.en: I got myself invited along.
examples.zh: 我争得受邀一同前往。

senses.def: to ask somebody to come to your home

senses.def: Joseph John Thomson (1856-1940) an English physicist
senses.zh: 汤姆森（JJ Thomson）：约瑟夫·约翰·汤姆森（1856-1940）是一位英国物理学家，他因发现电子而于1906年获得诺贝尔物理学奖。他还负责管理位于英国剑桥的卡文迪许实验室，该实验室成为世界领先的原子物理学研究中心。他的儿子乔治·汤姆森（George Thomson，1892-1975年）和他的七个助手都获得了诺贝尔奖。1908年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: James Matthew Barrie (1860-1937) a Scottish writer of plays and novels. His best-known works are the plays The Admirable Crichton
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·马修·巴里（James Matthew Barrie，1860-1937年），苏格兰戏剧和小说作家。他最著名的作品是戏剧《令人敬佩的克里顿》（1902年）和彼得·潘（1904年）。

senses.def: John Millington Synge (1871-1909) an Irish writer of plays. W B Yeats
senses.zh: JM辛格（JM Synge）：约翰·米林顿·辛格（John Millington Synge，1871-1909年），爱尔兰戏剧作家。WB Yeats说服他写有关爱尔兰农民的生活。他的戏剧戏剧性地使用了普通乡下人的语言。他最著名的作品《西方世界的花花公子》（1907年）讲述了一个男人来到一个小社区并假装杀死了父亲的故事。许多爱尔兰人对爱尔兰农民欢迎凶手并尊重他的想法感到愤怒。该剧最初在都柏林修道院剧院上演时曾引起抗议，但现在被认为是爱尔兰文学中最伟大的戏剧之一。

senses.def: Joseph Mallord William Turner (1775-1851) a major English artist, famous for his landscape
senses.zh: 约翰·特纳（JMW Turner）：约瑟夫·马洛德·威廉·特纳（Joseph Mallord William Turner，1775-1851年），一位主要的英国艺术家，以风景和海景画（即乡村和海洋的风景）而闻名。他作品的一个特征是他对光线和天气条件的独到见解。他的风格对后来的艺术运动有很大影响，尤其是印象派和抽象表现主义。特纳一生的大部分时间都在英国和欧洲旅行，为他的画作素描。他最著名的画作包括《战斗的泰米尔人》（The FightingTémaire，1838年）和《雨，蒸汽和速度》（Rain，Steam and Speed，1844年），这两幅作品都在伦敦国家美术馆展出。他去世后，他的许多画作成为不列颠国家的财产，现存放在伦敦的泰特英国美术馆。1987年，克洛尔美术馆（Clore Gallery）被添加到泰特美术馆（Tate），以展示特纳的作品。

senses.def: Jean Paul Getty (1892-1976) a US businessman who was one of the richest men in the world. He became President of the Getty Oil Company in 1947 and was estimated to be worth more than $1 billion by 1968. He collected art and in 1954 established the J Paul Getty Museum which is now in Los Angeles, California
senses.zh: 保罗·盖蒂（J Paul Getty）：让·保罗·盖蒂（Jean Paul Getty，1892-1976年），美国商人，是世界上最富有的人之一。1947年，他成为盖蒂石油公司（Getty Oil Company）的总裁，到1968年，他的身价估计超过10亿美元。他收集了艺术品，并于1954年建立了J Paul Getty博物馆，该博物馆现在位于加利福尼亚的洛杉矶。他于1950年代初定居英国。

senses.def: John Pierpoint Morgan (1837-1913) a powerful US industrial leader and financier
senses.zh: J皮尔波因特·摩根（J Pierpoint Morgan）：约翰·皮尔波因特·摩根（John Pierpoint Morgan）（1837-1913）是一位强大的美国工业领袖和金融家，他建立了美国钢铁公司，并且对许多其他商业领域（包括铁路和航运）感兴趣。摩根在1871年成为其父亲银行的合伙人，并在1895年将其命名为JP Morgan and Company。他将自己的大型艺术品收藏交给了纽约现代艺术博物馆。

senses.def: John Ronald Reuel Tolkien (1882-1973) an English writer, best known as the author of The Hobbit
senses.zh: John Ronald Reuel Tolkien（1882-1973）是一位英国作家，最知名的作品是《霍比特人》（1937）和《指环王》（1954-5）的作者。托尔金还是牛津大学的教授。

senses.def: Julius Robert Oppenheimer (1904-67) the scientist in charge of the US Manhattan Project
senses.zh: 罗伯特·奥本海默（J Robert Oppenheimer）：朱利叶斯·罗伯特·奥本海默（Julius Robert Oppenheimer，1904-67年）是负责制造第一枚原子弹的美国曼哈顿计划（1942-5）的科学家。第二次世界大战后，奥本海默（Oppenheimer）领导了高级研究所。在1950年代，他反对制造氢弹，并且由于人们认为他持有左翼观点，因此暂时不允许他从事政府研究项目。

senses.def: James Strom Thurmond (1902-2003) a US Senator who served longer than any other in the history of the Senate. He represented South Carolina
senses.zh: J斯特罗姆·瑟蒙德（J Strom Thurmond）：詹姆斯·斯特罗姆·瑟蒙德（James Strom Thurmond，1902-2003年），美国参议员，任期比参议院历史上任何其他议员都要长。他从1954年开始担任南卡罗来纳州的代表，直到100岁退休。1948年，他还曾当选为美国权利党总统，并担任南卡罗来纳州州长（1947-51）。瑟蒙德起初是民主党人，但后来改为共和党。

senses.zh: 詹姆斯·布尔格（James Bulger）：（1990-3）一个男孩，他两岁时在英格兰默西塞德郡被谋杀。谋杀之举尤其令人震惊，因为他被两个男孩杀死，这些男孩只有十岁，是英国250年以来被判犯有谋杀罪的最年轻的人。

senses.def: (1899-1986) a US film actor who usually played tough characters and criminals, as in the films The Public Enemy
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·卡涅（James Cagney）：（1899-1986）是美国电影演员，通常扮演硬汉和罪犯，如电影《公共敌人》（1931）和《天使与肮脏的面孔》（1938）。然而，他在洋基（Dankee）丹迪（Dandy）（1942年）中担任舞者和歌手，从而获得了奥斯卡奖。

senses.def: (1912-2005) a British Labour politician and Prime Minister (1976-9). During his time as Prime Minister there were many strikes in Britain, including the winter of discontent
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·卡拉汉（James Callaghan）：（1912-2005）英国劳工政治家兼总理（1976-9）。在他担任总理期间，英国发生了许多罢工，包括冬天的不满，工党在下次大选中失败。卡拉汉于1987年成为终身同伴。

senses.def: (1831-79) a Scottish scientist who made important contributions to many areas of physics
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·克莱克·麦克斯韦（James Clerk Maxwell）：（1831-79）苏格兰科学家，他在物理学的许多领域做出了重要贡献，包括气体，彩色视觉，电和磁。他的工作还影响了电话和彩色摄影的发展。

senses.def: (1931-55) a US actor who has come to represent the popular image of a young person resisting authority. He appeared in only three films, East of Eden
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·迪恩（James Dean）：（1931-55）一位美国演员，已经代表了年轻人抗拒权威的流行形象。他只出现在三部电影中，分别是《伊甸园之东》（1955年），《反叛的无因》（1955年）和《巨人》（1956年）。他的海报仍然很受欢迎，尤其是在年轻人中。

senses.def: (1789-1851) the first major US writer of novels. He wrote mostly about frontiersmen
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·费尼莫尔·库珀（(1789-1851) 美国第一位主要小说作家。他主要写关于拓荒者和北美原住民的文章。他最著名的著作包括《最后的莫希干人》(1826 年)和《猎鹿人》(1841 年)。他还写了有关水手和美国海军历史的小说。）

senses.def: (1854-1941) a Scottish anthropologist
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·弗雷泽（James Frazer）：（1854-1941）一位苏格兰人类学家。他最著名的作品是《金枝》，该书研究了许多习俗和宗教。尽管现在大多数人类学家不同意他关于人类信仰发展的观点，但他对英国人类学科学的发展产生了重要影响。

senses.def: (1757-1815) an English caricaturist
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·吉雷（James Gillray）：（1757-1815）一位英国讽刺漫画家。他经常取笑政府和王室，并对英国政治漫画的发展产生了深远的影响。

senses.def: (1720-78) the Englishman who invented the spinning jenny
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·哈格里夫斯（James Hargreaves）：（1720-78）发明纺纱詹妮（Jenny）的英国人，这是一种纺棉机，有助于引发英国的工业革命。

senses.def: (1943-2013) an English writer of horror stories, which include The Rats
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·赫伯特（James Herbert）：（1943-2013）英国恐怖故事作家，其中包括《老鼠》（1974），《雾》（1975），《神殿》（1983），《幽灵的幽灵》（1994）和《曾经》（2001）。他们中的许多人已经被拍成电影。

senses.def: born James Alfred Wight (1916-95) writer, born in Sunderland and grew up in Scotland,who is well known for his humorous books about the life of a country vet
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·赫里奥特（James Herriot）：詹姆斯·阿尔弗雷德·怀特（James Alfred Wight，1916-95年）出生，出生于桑德兰，在苏格兰长大。他以幽默的著作着称约克郡乡村兽医的生活而著称。这些书被制作成一个受欢迎的电视连续剧，叫做《大大小小的所有生物》（1977-90）。

senses.def: (1566-1625) the king of England from 1603 to 1625 and of Scotland (as James VI) from 1567 to 1625. His mother was Mary Queen of Scots
senses.zh: 詹姆斯一世（1566–1625）英格兰国王（1603–1625 在位），苏格兰国王（称詹姆斯六世，1567–1625 在位）。母亲是苏格兰玛丽女王。作为伊丽莎白一世的亲戚，在伊丽莎白一世去世后成为英格兰国王，将苏格兰和英格兰合在一起统治。但他并不受拥戴，1605 年，天主教敌对势力策划了针对他的火药阴谋案。死后由其子查理一世继位。詹姆斯一世时期的文学和艺术有独特风格。

senses.def: (1633-1701) the king of England and Scotland from 1685 to 1688. He was the son of Charles I
senses.zh: 詹姆斯二世（1633–1701）英格兰和苏格兰国王（1685–1688 在位）。查理一世之子，查理二世之弟，在查理二世去世后即位。信奉罗马天主教，因而遭到很多人反对，1688 年被新教徒威廉三世取代。1689 年，詹姆斯前往爱尔兰，企图夺回权力，但在博因河战役中被击败。在法国度过余生。

senses.def: (1882-1941) an Irish author who is considered to be one of the greatest writers of the 20th century. He left Ireland in 1904 and spent the rest of his life abroad, in Trieste, Zürich and Paris. His novels Ulysses
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·乔伊斯（James Joyce）：（1882-1941）是一位爱尔兰作家，被认为是20世纪最伟大的作家之一。他于1904年离开爱尔兰，并在特里斯特，苏黎世和巴黎度过了余生。他的小说《尤利西斯》（Ulysses，1922年）和《芬尼根斯·韦克》（Finnegans Wake，1939年）引入了新的小说创作方式，特别是“意识流”风格，展现了人们快速变化的思想。他还利用了发明的单词和不寻常的句子结构。在他的一生中，对他的工作还没有很好的理解，而在1936年之前，尤利西斯在英国和美国被禁止使用，因为它被认为具有攻击性。他的早期著作包括《都柏林人》（短篇小说集）（1914年）和《青年艺术家肖像》（1914-15年），这本书反映了乔伊斯在都柏林长大的经历，以及戏剧《流放》（1918年）。 。

senses.def: James Knox Polk (1795-1849) the 11th US President (1845-9) and a member of the Democratic Party
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·K·波克（James K Polk）：詹姆斯·诺克斯·波克（James Knox Polk，1795-1849年），美国第11任总统（1845-9），民主党成员。他曾在美国众议院（1825-39）任职，最近四年曾担任众议院议长，然后是田纳西州州长（1839-41）。在他担任总统期间，美国将得克萨斯州加入了联邦，并参加了墨西哥战争，墨西哥战争也增加了加利福尼亚州和西南部的大多数地区。

senses.def: (1751-1836) the fourth US President (1809-17) and one of America's Founding Fathers
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·麦迪逊（James Madison）：（1751-1836）美国第四任总统（1809-17）和美国开国元勋之一。由于他在该文件上的重要工作，他被称为宪法之父。他曾在托马斯·杰斐逊（Thomas Jefferson）总统任下任国务卿（1801-8），然后当选为民主共和党总统。他在1812年战争期间任职，当时英国人在1814年烧毁了白宫。后来他帮助建立了弗吉尼亚大学，是最后一位开国元勋去世。

senses.def: (1834-1903) a US artist who was educated in France and lived mostly in London after 1859. His best-known painting is usually called Whistler's Mother
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·麦克尼尔·惠斯勒（James McNeill Whistler）：（1834-1903）是一位美国艺术家，他在法国接受教育，1859年后主要居住在伦敦。他最著名的画作通常被称为惠斯勒的母亲。在一个著名的法律案件中，他将约翰·拉斯金（John Ruskin）告上法庭，以公开批评他的画作《黑与金的夜曲：坠落的火箭》。惠斯勒胜诉，但只获得一分钱的四分之一。

senses.def: (1907-97) a US writer who won the Pulitzer Prize
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·米凯纳（James Michener）：（1907-97）是一位美国作家，根据他在南太平洋的故事而获得普利策南太平洋故事奖（1947）。它被改编为音乐剧和电影《南太平洋》。然后，米歇纳（Michener）主要写历史小说和冒险小说，其中许多篇幅很长，而且都是经过认真研究的。其中包括托科里桥（1953），夏威夷（1959），百年纪念（1974），切萨皮克（1978）和阿拉斯加（1988）。他的几本书被拍了。

senses.def: (1758-1831) the fifth US President. He is best remembered for the Monroe Doctrine
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·梦露：（1758-1831）美国第五任总统。他最怀念的是门罗主义，该主义旨在将新的欧洲利益排除在美洲之外。他参加了美国独立战争，并帮助建立了民主共和党。他当选为美国参议员（1790-94），两次当选弗吉尼亚州州长（1799-1802和1811）。他担任总统的时间被称为“美好时代”。1819年，他从西班牙购买了佛罗里达，解决了美国与加拿大边界上的英国争端，并签署了《密苏里妥协案》。

senses.def: (1837-1915) a Scottish lexicographer
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·默里（1837–1915）苏格兰词典编纂者，1884 至 1933 年间出版的《新牛津英语词典》（后称《牛津英语词典》）的第一任编辑。

senses.def: (1908-97) a popular US actor who usually played good, honest characters. He was a tall man, known for speaking in a slow and hesitating way. He won an Oscar
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·斯图尔特（James Stewart）：（1908-97）是一位受欢迎的美国演员，通常饰演诚实善良的角色。他是个高个子，以说话缓慢而犹豫不决而闻名。因其对电影业的贡献，他凭借《费城故事》（1940年）获得了奥斯卡奖，并于1984年获得了特别奖。他的其他电影包括：《美好的生活》，《后窗》（1954年），《格伦·米勒的故事》（1954年），《拉勒米的人》（1955年），《圣路易斯精神》（1957年）和《射击者》（1986年）。斯图尔特在第二次世界大战中被授予杰出飞行十字勋章，后来成为美国空军预备队准将。

senses.def: (1926-92) an English architect. He is well known for designing modern buildings with many straight lines and bright colours. Some people with traditional ideas about architecture do not approve of his work. He designed buildings for the universities of Oxford
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·斯特林（James Stirling）：（1926-92）英国建筑师。他以设计具有许多直线和鲜艳色彩的现代建筑而闻名。有些对建筑有传统观念的人不赞成他的工作。他为牛津大学，剑桥大学和莱斯特大学设计了建筑，他最著名的建筑包括英国泰特美术馆的新部分，克洛尔美术馆和德国斯图加特的美术馆。他在1992年被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1688-1766) the son of James II
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·斯图尔特（James Stuart）：（1688-1766）詹姆斯二世的儿子，也被称为老假人。他的支持者雅各布派人称他为苏格兰的詹姆斯八世和英格兰的三世。他一生中都住在法国和意大利，并声称他有权担任英国国王。他于1715年来到苏格兰，领导了十五次叛乱，但被英国人击败。

senses.def: James Thomas Farrell (1904-79) a US writer of novels, short stories and poems. His realistic novels were about the Irish in the poor section of Chicago
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·T·法雷尔（James T Farrell）：詹姆斯·托马斯·法雷尔（James Thomas Farrell，1904-79年），美国小说，短篇小说和诗歌作家。他的写实小说是关于芝加哥贫困地区的爱尔兰人的。他在1932年到1935年之间写了三本关于Studs Lonigan角色的小说，在1936年到1953年之间写了关于丹尼·奥尼尔的五本小说。他的诗集于1965年出版。

senses.def: (1894-1961) a US writer of humorous stories who also drew comic drawings for them. They are often about men and women defeated by the ordinary problems of life. From 1927, most of his best work was published in The New Yorker
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·瑟伯（James Thurber）：（1894-1961）美国幽默故事作家，他还为他们绘制漫画图画。他们通常是关于被普通的生活问题打败的男人和女人。从1927年开始，他的大部分最佳作品发表在《纽约客》杂志上。他的故事集包括《我的世界》和《欢迎来到这里》（1942年），其中包括他最著名的故事《沃尔特·米蒂的秘密生活》

senses.def: (1736-1819) a Scottish inventor
senses.zh: 詹姆斯·瓦特（James Watt）：（1736-1819）是苏格兰的一位发明家，他的工作对蒸汽机的发展起了重要作用。他的发动机设计在当时的现有发动机上进行了改进，因为它们使用的燃料少得多。瓦特的发动机是第一种适用于工厂的发动机，因此是导致工业革命的重大工业进步之一。

senses.def: of a style of writing that is extremely complicated, with long sentences containing many difficult ideas (after the author Henry James
senses.zh: 詹姆士时代：一种极其复杂的写作风格，长句子包含许多困难的想法（作者亨利·詹姆斯（Henry James）以这种方式写作，尤其是在后来的小说中）

senses.def: the first permanent community of English people in North America, in what is now Virginia
senses.zh: 詹姆斯敦英国人在北美洲的第一个定居地，位于今美国弗吉尼亚州。伦敦公司于1607年5月14日建立了詹姆斯敦，以英王詹姆斯一世命名。约翰•史密斯是早期的领导者。1612年第一批烟草农场在这里建立。这里至今还保存了原来的教堂塔楼和一些墓地，吸引很多游人来参观。

senses.def: a first name for boys, short for James
senses.zh: 杰米（男子名，James缩写，女子名）

senses.def: a child’s word for pyjamas

examples.en: I was in my jammies, watching TV.
examples.zh: 我穿着睡衣，看电视。

senses.def: covered with jam
senses.zh: 涂有果酱的；满是果酱的

examples.en: jammy fingers
examples.zh: 满是果酱的手指

senses.def: lucky, especially because something good has happened to you without you making any effort

examples.en: ‘What did you get for Maths?’ ‘A.’ ‘You jammy bastard.’
examples.zh: “你数学得了多少分？”“A。”“你这个混蛋。”

senses.def: a first name for girls, short for Janet
senses.zh: 简（女子名，Janet 或 Janice 缩写）

senses.def: a first name for girls
(1860-1935) an American who worked to improve social conditions and shared the 1931 Nobel Prize
senses.zh: 简·亚当斯（Jane Addams）：（1860-1935）一位致力于改善社会条件并分享1931年诺贝尔和平奖的美国人。她和艾伦·盖茨·斯塔尔（Ellen Gates Starr）于1889年在芝加哥创办了赫尔之家，以帮助穷人。从1915年到1929年，亚当斯担任国际和平与自由妇女联盟主席。

senses.def: (1775-1817) an English writer whose novels have had a strong influence on the development of English literature. In them she describes the personal relationships and social life of the English upper middle class
senses.zh: 简·奥斯汀（1775–1817）英国作家，其小说对英国文学发展影响深远。以轻松幽默的笔触描述当时英国中上阶层的人际关系和社交生活。终身未婚。最著名的作品有《理智与情感》（1811）、《傲慢与偏见》（1813）、《爱玛》（1816）和《劝导》（1818）。多部小说被拍成电影。

senses.def: used to refer to a woman whose name is not known or is kept secret, especially in a court of law
senses.zh: 无名女士，某女（不知姓名或在法庭等上隐匿真名的女当事人）

senses.def: an average woman
a novel (1847) by Charlotte Brontë
senses.zh: 简·爱（Jane Eyre）：夏洛特·勃朗特（CharlotteBrontë）的小说（1847）。简·艾尔（Jane Eyre）是一位孤儿，在童年时期非常不开心之后，成为爱德华·罗切斯特（Edward Rochester）女儿的私人老师。简和罗切斯特先生坠入爱河，当她发现自己已经有一个患有精神疾病的妻子时，就要结婚。几年后，恋人再次见面并结婚，尽管罗切斯特此时已在一场大火中受了重伤。这部小说仍然很受欢迎，主要是因为害羞的简与神秘而暴力的罗切斯特之间的鲜明对比。

senses.def: (1921-2011) a US film actor who became a sex symbol. She was discovered by Howard Hughes
senses.zh: 简·罗素（Jane Russell）：（1921-2011）是一位美国电影演员，后来成为性别象征。她是由霍华德·休斯（Howard Hughes）发现的，后者使她成为了The Outlaw（1943）的明星。她的其他电影包括The Paleface（1948）和Gentlemen Prefer Blondes（1953）。

senses.def: (c. 1509-37) the third wife of King Henry VIII
senses.zh: 简·西摩（Jane Seymour）：（约1509-37年）亨利八世国王的第三任妻子。她于1536年与他结婚，但在其儿子爱德华（Edward VI）出生后不久就去世了。

senses.def: a first name for girls
(1938-2016) the first woman to become US Attorney General
senses.zh: 珍妮特·里诺（Janet Reno）：（ 1938-2016年）第一位成为美国司法部长的女性。她从1993年至2001年担任这个职位，这是20世纪司法部长最长的时期。她因在1993年袭击了由大卫·科雷什（David Koresh）在德克萨斯州韦科（Waco）的大卫·科威特分校（David Branch）袭击而被批评，并于2000年下令对年轻的伊莱安·冈萨雷斯（EliánGonzález）进行有争议的逮捕，以便将他重返古巴。在2002年，她竞争成为佛罗里达州州长，但未成功。

senses.def: to make an unpleasant sound, like two pieces of metal hitting each other; to make something do this
senses.zh: （使）发出金属撞击声，发出丁零当啷的刺耳声

examples.en: The shop bell jangled loudly.
examples.zh: 商店的钟发出丁零当啷的巨大响声。

examples.en: The band is known for its distinctive jangling guitar sound.
examples.zh: 该乐队以其独特的刺耳吉他声而闻名。

examples.en: He jangled the keys in his pocket.
examples.zh: 他把兜里的钥匙弄得丁零当啷乱响。

senses.def: if your nerves jangle
senses.zh: 刺激，烦扰（神经）；（使）烦躁不安

examples.en: She was suddenly wide awake, her nerves jangling.
examples.zh: 她突然间清醒过来，神经焦躁不安。

senses.def: a hard noise like that of metal hitting metal
senses.zh: 金属撞击声；丁零当啷的刺耳声

senses.def: a first name for girls
(1943-70) a US singer popular in the 1960s, especially with hippies

examples.zh: 我不过在做我分内的事。

examples.en: These projects will help create jobs in rural areas.
examples.zh: 这些项目将有助于在农村地区创造就业机会。

examples.en: The alternative would have been to cut jobs to contain costs.
examples.zh: 另一种选择是裁员以控制成本。

examples.en: The closure of the factory will mean the loss of over 800 jobs.
examples.zh: 工厂的关闭将意味着800多个工作岗位的流失。

senses.def: a particular task or piece of work that you have to do
senses.zh: （一项）任务；（一件）工作，活儿，事情

examples.en: I've got various jobs around the house to do.
examples.zh: 我在家里有各种各样的活儿要干。

examples.en: Sorting these papers out is going to be a long job.
examples.zh: 整理这些文件是很费工夫的事。

examples.en: The builder has a couple of jobs on at the moment.
examples.zh: 目前这家建筑商有几项工程在进行。

examples.en: She's taken on the job of organizing the Christmas party.
examples.zh: 她承担了筹备圣诞派对的工作。

senses.def: a responsibility or duty

examples.en: He said he wouldn't do it because it wasn't his job.
examples.zh: 他说他不愿意做，因为那不是他的职责。

examples.en: It's not my job to lock up!
examples.zh: 上锁不是我的事儿！

examples.en: It's the job of the press to expose wrongdoing.
examples.zh: 揭露丑恶行为是新闻界的职责。

senses.def: a crime, especially stealing

examples.en: a bank job
examples.zh: 银行抢劫案

examples.en: He got six months for that last job he did.
examples.zh: 他上次犯罪获刑 6 个月。

examples.en: an inside job (= done by somebody in the organization where the crime happens)
examples.zh: 内部人员作的案

examples.en: The gang bungled the job and got caught.
examples.zh: 这个团伙因罪行败露而被捕。

senses.def: a particular kind of thing

examples.en: It's real wood—not one of those plastic jobs.
examples.zh: 这是实木的，不是那种塑料产品。

senses.def: an item of work that is done by a computer as a single unit
senses.zh: 作业（计算机批处理任务中的基本单位）

examples.en: The job can be processed overnight.
examples.zh: 这个活儿连夜就可以处理完。

senses.def: not paying enough attention to what you need to do
senses.zh: 因漫不经心而未尽到职责

examples.en: They were asleep on the job as the financial crisis deepened.
examples.zh: 金融危机恶化之时他们疏于职守。

examples.en: Let's hope the regulators are not asleep at the wheel.
examples.zh: 希望监管机构不会麻痹大意。

examples.en: Somebody must have been asleep at the switch to allow this to happen.
examples.zh: 肯定有人在开关处睡着了，才会发生这种情况。

senses.def: unemployed for a short time. People say ‘
senses.zh: 暂时待业（以避免用 unemployed 一词）

examples.en: He's between jobs at the moment so he's using the time to do some voluntary work.
examples.zh: 他正在换工作，于是利用这段时间做一些志愿工作。

senses.def: a very difficult or unpleasant job or time
senses.zh: 费力（或令人讨厌）的事；难熬（或令人不快）的日子

examples.en: I've had a devil of a job finding you.
examples.zh: 我费了九牛二虎之力才找到你。

senses.def: to do something well, badly, etc.
senses.zh: 干得好（或差等）；将…办好（或坏等）

examples.en: They did a very professional job.
examples.zh: 他们干得非常内行。

examples.en: You've certainly made an excellent job of the kitchen (= for example, painting it).
examples.zh: 你们把厨房弄得好极了。

examples.en: We haven’t done a very good job on the publicity for the show.
examples.zh: 我们对节目的宣传工作做得不太好。

senses.def: to be effective or successful in doing what you want

examples.en: This extra strong glue should do the job.
examples.zh: 这种超黏度胶应该管用。

examples.en: Try wedging it open—that should do the job.
examples.zh: 找个楔子把它撑开 － 应该管用。

senses.def: to cause somebody/yourself to lose their/your job because the role is no longer required
senses.zh: （取消工作岗位而）使（某人）失业

examples.en: Our aim as a charity is to help people so successfully that we do ourselves out of a job.
examples.zh: 作为一家慈善机构，我们的目标是帮助人们，直到社会不再需要我们这个工作，才是大功告成。

senses.def: to decide to stop trying to help somebody or to do something because there is no hope of success
senses.zh: 对…不再抱有希望；因没有希望而决定放弃

senses.def: used to tell somebody that they have done well at something
used to say that you are pleased about a situation or that somebody is lucky that something happened
senses.zh: 令人满意的状况；幸运的事；好事

examples.en: It's a good job you were there to help.
examples.zh: 幸亏你来帮忙。

senses.def: to have difficulty doing something
senses.zh: 干某事很困难（或很吃力、很费力）

examples.en: You'll have a job convincing them that you're right.
examples.zh: 要让他们信服你是对的还要费点劲。

examples.en: He had a hard job to make himself heard.
examples.zh: 他好不容易才使别人听见他的声音。

senses.def: work that you are paid to do or that must be done
senses.zh: 分内的事；必须干的工作

examples.en: There was a job of work waiting for him that he was not looking forward to.
examples.zh: 有一件他不想干但又必须完成的工作在等待着他。

senses.def: people use the expression jobs for the boys
senses.zh: 为亲信安排的工作（或职位）；任人唯亲

senses.def: exactly what is needed in a particular situation
senses.zh: 正需要的东西；求之不得的东西

examples.en: That cup of tea was just the job.
examples.zh: 那杯茶来得正是时候。

senses.def: to accept a bad or difficult situation and do as well as you can
not worth doing because it is against the rules or because it might cause you to lose your job
senses.zh: 工作所不允许的事；违反原则的事；可能丢饭碗的事

examples.en: It's more than my job's worth to let you in without a ticket.
examples.zh: 没有票就让你进去，我可能会丢饭碗的。

senses.def: while doing a particular job
senses.zh: 在上班时；在干活时；在工作岗位上

examples.en: No sleeping on the job!
examples.zh: 上班时严禁睡觉！

examples.en: on-the-job training
examples.zh: 在职培训

senses.def: having sex
senses.zh: 在交媾；在性交；在干那事

senses.def: to stop working in order to go on strike
the quality of being extremely patient and not complaining

examples.en: You need the patience of Job to deal with some of our customers.
examples.zh: 和我们的一些顾客打交道需要有极大的耐心。
