keep quiet about sth: @@@LINK=keep quiet about something | keep something quiet
keep sb in mind: @@@LINK=bear/keep somebody/something in mind | bear/keep in mind that…

senses.def: to give somebody interesting things to do, or to entertain them so that they do not become bored
senses.zh: 使某人快乐；使某人消遣

examples.en: Playing with water can keep children amused for hours.
examples.zh: 嬉水可以使孩子们玩好几个小时都不烦。

senses.def: to refuse to be friendly with somebody; to not let somebody be friendly towards you
senses.zh: 对…冷淡；同…疏远；与…保持一定距离

examples.en: The manager prefers to keep employees at a distance.
examples.zh: 经理更喜欢与员工保持距离。

senses.def: to avoid having a close relationship with somebody
senses.zh: 与某人保持距离；不亲近某人

examples.en: He keeps all his clients at arm's length.
examples.zh: 他不与任何委托人过分亲密。

examples.en: She kept him at arm's length for months.
examples.zh: 几个月来，她一直与他保持一定的距离。

senses.def: to stay with somebody so that they are not alone

examples.en: I'll keep you company while you're waiting.
examples.zh: 你等待时我会陪伴你。

examples.en: I'll stay and keep you company.
examples.zh: 我会留下来陪你。

senses.def: to be enough for somebody until they get what they are waiting for
senses.zh: 足以使某人维持（或支撑）

examples.en: Have an apple to keep you going till dinner time.
examples.zh: 吃个苹果就能挨到吃晚饭了。

senses.def: to not tell somebody about your plans or what is going to happen next
senses.zh: 让某人捉摸不定（或猜不透）

examples.en: It's the kind of book that keeps you guessing right to the end.
examples.zh: 这是一本让你从头猜到尾的书。

keep somebody in mind: @@@LINK=bear/keep somebody/something in mind | bear/keep in mind that…

senses.def: to make sure that somebody is ready to deal with anything that might happen by doing things that they are not expecting
senses.zh: （通过出其不意的行动）使保持警觉

examples.en: Surprise visits help to keep the staff on their toes.
examples.zh: 突击巡察有助于使员工不致懈怠偷懒。

examples.en: The threat of inspections kept us all on our toes.
examples.zh: 可能要来人视察，这让我们保持着警觉。

senses.def: to regularly give somebody the most recent information about something and how it is developing

examples.en: I’ll keep you posted on his progress.
examples.zh: 我将随时向你通报他的进展。

senses.def: to say or do pleasant things in order to keep somebody in a good mood so that they will agree to do something for you

examples.en: You’d better keep her sweet if you want her to lend you the money.
examples.zh: 如果你想让她借钱给你，你最好让她保持甜蜜。

senses.def: to make somebody have to wait or be delayed, especially because you arrive late
senses.zh: （尤指因迟到）让人等候，使人耽搁

examples.en: I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.
examples.zh: 对不起，让你久等了。

senses.def: to keep something secret and not tell people about it

examples.en: He’s got two children? Well he’s kept that dark, hasn’t he!
examples.zh: 他有两个孩子？好吧，他一直保持黑暗，不是吗！

keep something for a rainy day: @@@LINK=save, keep, etc. something for a rainy day
keep something in mind: @@@LINK=bear/keep somebody/something in mind | bear/keep in mind that…

senses.def: to react to something in a sensible way and not think it is worse or more serious than it really is
senses.zh: 恰当地处事；看待事物恰如其分

examples.en: The problem of hooliganism should be kept in proportion. Only a small number of young people act in this way.
examples.zh: 流氓行为问题应该保持适当的比例。只有少数年轻人有这样的行为。

senses.def: to represent your country or organization
senses.zh: 代表自己的国家（或组织）

examples.en: Our exporters keep the flag flying at international trade exhibitions.
examples.zh: 我们的出口商在国际贸易展览会上代表我们的国家参展。

senses.def: to have enough money to avoid going hungry; to stop somebody feeling hungry

keep the wolf from the door.word: keep the wolf from the door

keep under lock and key: @@@LINK=(keep something/put something/be) under lock and key

senses.def: to hide the truth about a bad situation and pretend that everything is going well

examples.en: When she lost all her money she was determined to keep up appearances.
examples.zh: 她的钱全没了，但她决意强装体面。

senses.def: to try to have all the possessions and social achievements that your friends and neighbours have
senses.zh: （与朋友和邻居在物质和社会成就方面）攀比，比富有，比排场，比阔气

senses.def: to change and develop your ideas, way of working, etc. so that you do what is modern and what is expected

examples.en: Many complained that the Royal Family had failed to move with the times.
examples.zh: 许多人抱怨王室未能与时俱进。

senses.def: to act as a wicketkeeper

keep your cards close to your chest: @@@LINK=hold/keep/play your cards close to your chest

senses.def: to remain calm in a difficult situation

examples.en: He kept his cool on the convention floor when he was heckled by a young Republican.
examples.zh: 他在会议厅遭到一个年轻的共和党人诘问时很沉着。

senses.def: to make sure you are not too near somebody/something
to avoid getting too friendly or involved with a person, group, etc.
senses.zh: 疏远；避免（与…）亲近；避免介入

examples.en: She was warned to keep her distance from Charles if she didn't want to get hurt.
examples.zh: 有人告诫她说，如果不想受到伤害，就离查尔斯远一点。

senses.def: to listen out for somebody/something that you might hear
to listen or look out for somebody/something that you might hear or see
senses.zh: 留心听；保持警惕；密切注意

senses.def: to continue to be cheerful in a difficult situation
to continue to give your attention to what is most important
senses.zh: 眼睛盯着大事；密切注意关键问题

keep your eye on the ball.word: keep your eye on the ball

senses.def: to look out for somebody/something that you might see
to look out for somebody/something that you might see

examples.en: We kept our eyes peeled for any signs of life.
examples.zh: 我们注意寻找任何生命的迹象。

senses.def: to look out for somebody/something that you might see

examples.en: We kept our eyes skinned for any signs of life.
examples.zh: 我们密切关注是否有任何生命迹象。

senses.def: used to tell somebody to stop shouting and become calm when they are angry
to occasionally do something that you used to do a lot so that you do not lose your skill at it
senses.zh: 偶尔操练某事以保持熟练

examples.en: She retired last year but still teaches the odd class to keep her hand in.
examples.zh: 她去年退休了，但偶尔还上课，以免技巧生疏。

keep your head: @@@LINK=keep your head | keep a clear/cool head

senses.def: to deal with a difficult situation, especially one in which you have financial problems, and just manage to survive
senses.zh: 勉强逃脱困境；设法不举债；挣扎求存

examples.en: I’m not sure how much longer we’ll be able to keep our heads above water.
examples.zh: 我不确定我们还能坚持多久。

senses.def: to remain calm in a difficult situation

examples.en: She needed to keep a clear head if she was to remain in control.
examples.zh: 她要想继续控制局势就必须保持清醒的头脑。

keep your head | keep a clear/cool head.word: keep your head | keep a clear/cool head

senses.def: to not talk about something to somebody because it is a secret or because it will upset or annoy them

examples.en: I've warned them to keep their mouths shut about this.
examples.zh: 我警告过他们对此事要守口如瓶。

examples.en: Now she's upset—why couldn't you keep your mouth shut?
examples.zh: 瞧她现在心烦意乱的样子，你就不能闭上嘴？

examples.en: The athletes were warned to keep their mouths shut about politics.
examples.zh: 运动员们被警告不要谈论政治。

senses.def: to avoid doing anything wrong or illegal
senses.zh: 循规蹈矩；不做违法的事

examples.en: Since leaving prison, he's managed to keep his nose clean.
examples.zh: 自从出狱以来，他已做到规规矩矩。

senses.def: to not become involved in things that should not really involve you
senses.zh: 不插手，不介入（他人的事）

keep your nose out of something.word: keep your nose out of something

senses.def: to work hard for a long period of time without stopping

keep your nose to the grindstone.word: keep your nose to the grindstone

senses.def: to keep your opinions, plans, etc. secret
senses.zh: 将自己意见（或计划等）保密；不暴露自己的意图

examples.en: Emily doubted what he told her but kept her own counsel.
examples.zh: 艾米丽怀疑他告诉她的话，但保留了自己的建议。

senses.def: to remain cheerful despite difficulties
senses.zh: （在困难中）振作精神，打起精神

examples.en: Keep your pecker up! Things are bound to get better.
examples.zh: 保持你的鸡鸡向上！事情一定会变得更好。

senses.def: to remain ready for a possible emergency
senses.zh: 时刻准备应急；枕戈待旦；有备无患

senses.def: used to tell somebody not to get angry

examples.en: Keep your shirt on! It was only a joke.
examples.zh: 别生气！开个玩笑而已。

senses.def: to make a student stay at school after normal hours as a punishment
to continue working at something

examples.en: Come on, keep at it—you've nearly finished!
examples.zh: 快，要坚持，你马上就要完成了！

senses.def: to make somebody continue working at something
senses.zh: 使某人继续做（或坚持干）某事

examples.en: He kept us at it all day.
examples.zh: 他让我们不停地干了一天。

senses.def: to avoid going near somebody/something

examples.en: Keep away from the edge of the cliff.
examples.zh: 切莫靠近悬崖边。

senses.def: to prevent somebody/something from going somewhere
senses.zh: 不让接近某人（或某事物）；使离开

examples.en: Her illness kept her away from work for several weeks.
examples.zh: 她病得好几周都上不了班。

senses.def: to stay at a distance from somebody/something

examples.en: Keep well back from the road.
examples.zh: 离公路远些。

senses.def: to make a student stay at school after normal hours as a punishment
to make a student repeat a year at school because of poor grades
to make somebody stay at a distance from somebody/something

examples.en: Barricades were erected to keep back the crowds.
examples.zh: 设置了障碍，使人群无法靠近。

senses.def: to prevent a feeling, etc. from being expressed
senses.zh: 抑制（或阻止）感情等的流露

examples.en: She was unable to keep back her tears.
examples.zh: 她无法忍住泪水。

senses.def: to continue to have a part of something
senses.zh: 保留（或扣留）某物的一部分

examples.en: He kept back half the money for himself.
examples.zh: 他把那笔钱留了一半给自己。

senses.def: to refuse to tell somebody something

examples.en: I'm sure she's keeping something back from us.
examples.zh: 我肯定她有什么事瞒着我们。

senses.def: a charity that campaigns to encourage people to care for the environment and to persuade them not to leave rubbish in public places. The phrase is widely used on signs, etc. put up around the country.
senses.zh: 保持英国整洁：这是一项旨在鼓励人们爱护环境并说服他们不要在公共场所留下垃圾的慈善活动。该短语广泛用于在全国各地张贴的标志等上。

senses.def: to hide yourself by not standing up straight

examples.en: Keep down! You mustn't let anyone see you.
examples.zh: 蹲下！千万不要让人看见你。

senses.def: to prevent a person, group, etc. from expressing themselves freely

examples.en: The people have been kept down for years by a brutal regime.
examples.zh: 多年来人们一直受到残暴统治的压制。

examples.en: You can’t keep Laura down—she’s so full of life.
examples.zh: 你不能让劳拉失望——她是如此充满活力。

senses.def: to make something stay at a low level; to avoid increasing something
senses.zh: 使保持在低水平；抑制某事物的增长

examples.en: to keep down wages/prices/the cost of living
examples.zh: 保持低工资／物价／生活费用

examples.en: Keep your voice down—I don't want anyone else to hear.
examples.zh: 小声点儿，别让人听见。

examples.en: Keep the noise down (= be quiet).
examples.zh: 小声点儿。

senses.def: to not bring something back through the mouth from the stomach; to not vomit
senses.zh: 不使（胃中食物）吐出；不呕吐

examples.en: She's had some water but she can't keep any food down.
examples.zh: 她喝了点儿水，但一吃东西就吐。

senses.def: physical exercises that you do, usually in a class with other people, in order to improve your strength and to stay healthy

examples.en: a keep-fit class
examples.zh: 健身班

senses.def: to prevent yourself from doing something
senses.zh: 忍住（或克制自己）不做某事

examples.en: She could hardly keep from laughing.
examples.zh: 她差一点儿笑了出来。

examples.en: I just managed to keep myself from falling.
examples.zh: 我差一点就摔倒了。

senses.def: to prevent somebody from doing something
senses.zh: 阻止（或防止、阻碍）某人做某事

examples.en: I hope I'm not keeping you from your work.
examples.zh: 希望我没有妨碍你工作。

examples.en: I must go now. I've kept you from your dinner too long.
examples.zh: 我得走了，已经耽误太长时间，影响你吃晚饭了。

examples.en: The church bells keep me from sleeping.
examples.zh: 教堂的钟声使我不能入睡。

senses.def: to avoid telling somebody something
senses.zh: 不将某事告诉某人；瞒着某人

examples.en: I think we ought to keep the truth from him until he's better.
examples.zh: 我想我们应该等他身体好些再告诉他实情。

examples.en: They don’t keep anything from each other.
examples.zh: 他们之间无话不谈。

senses.def: to make something stay out of something
senses.zh: 使置于某物之外；使与某物分开

examples.en: She could not keep the dismay from her voice.
examples.zh: 她无法使自己沉重的心情不流露在话音之中。

senses.def: to avoid expressing an emotion

examples.en: He could scarcely keep in his indignation.
examples.zh: 他几乎控制不住自己的愤怒。

senses.def: to make somebody stay indoors or in a particular place
senses.zh: 使某人留在室内（或某地）；使不外出

senses.def: to provide somebody/yourself with a regular supply of something
to make sure that you stay friendly with somebody, because you will get an advantage from doing so
senses.zh: （为得到好处而）与某人友好相处，不得罪某人

senses.def: if rain, snow, etc. keeps off
to avoid eating, drinking or smoking something

examples.en: I'm trying to keep off fatty foods.
examples.zh: 我尽量不吃高脂肪食物。

senses.def: to avoid mentioning a particular subject

examples.en: It's best to keep off politics when my father's around.
examples.zh: 我父亲在场时最好不要谈论政治。

senses.def: to prevent somebody/something from coming near, touching, etc. somebody/something
senses.zh: 使…不接近（或不接触、远离）某人／事物

examples.en: They lit a fire to keep off wild animals.
examples.zh: 他们点燃篝火防止野兽靠近。

examples.en: Keep your hands off (= do not touch) me!
examples.zh: 别碰我！

senses.def: to continue

examples.en: The rain kept on all night.
examples.zh: 雨彻夜不停。

examples.en: Keep on until you get to the church.
examples.zh: 一直往前走到教堂。

examples.en: I want to keep on with part-time work for as long as possible.
examples.zh: 我希望做兼职工作能一直持续下去。

senses.def: to continue to employ somebody
to continue to rent a house, flat, etc.

examples.en: We’re planning to keep the house on over the summer.
examples.zh: 我们计划整个夏天让房子保持运转。

senses.def: to speak to somebody often and in an annoying way about somebody/something
senses.zh: （对…）纠缠不休；老是困扰；老是唠叨

examples.en: He does keep on so!
examples.zh: 他就是这样纠缠不休！

examples.en: I'll do it—just don't keep on at me about it!
examples.zh: 我会做的，就别再对我唠叨了！

senses.def: to not enter a place; to stay outside

examples.en: The sign said ‘Private Property—Keep Out!’
examples.zh: 告示牌上写着“私人产业，不得入内！”

senses.def: to prevent somebody/something from entering a place

examples.en: Keep that dog out of my study!
examples.zh: 别让那狗进我的书房！

senses.def: to avoid something; to prevent somebody from being involved in something or affected by something
senses.zh: 避免某事；使不卷入某事；使置身于…之外；使不受…的影响

examples.en: That child can't keep out of mischief.
examples.zh: 那孩子总是胡闹。

examples.en: Keep the baby out of the sun.
examples.zh: 别让宝宝晒着。

senses.def: to avoid leaving a path, road, etc.
senses.zh: 不偏离（或不离开）道路等

examples.en: Keep to the track—the land is very boggy around here.
examples.zh: 顺着道儿走，这一带到处是沼泽地。

senses.def: to talk or write only about the subject that you are supposed to talk or write about

examples.en: Nothing is more irritating than people who do not keep to the point.
examples.zh: 最烦人的就是那些谈话不着边际的人。

senses.def: to do what you have promised or agreed to do

examples.en: to keep to an agreement/an undertaking/a plan
examples.zh: 遵守协议；信守承诺；执行计划

senses.def: to stay in and not leave a particular place or position
senses.zh: 坚守，不离开（某地或某个位置）

examples.en: She's nearly 90 and mostly keeps to her room.
examples.zh: 她快 90 岁了，大部分时间都待在房间里。

senses.def: to avoid meeting people socially or becoming involved in their affairs
senses.zh: 离群索居；不与人往来；不管别人的事

examples.en: Nobody knows much about him; he keeps himself very much to himself.
examples.zh: 谁对他都不太了解，因为他很少和人交往。

senses.def: to not tell other people about something
senses.zh: 对…秘而不宣（或保守秘密）；不将…说出去

examples.en: I'd be grateful if you kept this information to yourself.
examples.zh: 你要是不把这消息传出去，我会不胜感激的。

examples.en: Kindly keep your opinions to yourself in future!
examples.zh: 今后请保留您的意见！

senses.def: to control or oppress

examples.en: The local people are kept under by the army.
examples.zh: 当地居民受军队管制。

examples.zh: 他们以极低的价格出售了股票。

senses.def: using a lot of force

examples.en: a knock-down punch
examples.zh: 强有力的一拳

senses.def: (of a fight or an argument) very aggressive and unpleasant
having legs that turn towards each other at the knees
legs that turn towards each other at the knees

a type of joke that depends on the way in which some words in English sound like other words. The person telling the joke says ‘Knock-knock’, someone answers ‘Who's there?’, and the first person says a name that isn't what it seems. A typical example might be: ‘Knock-knock.’ ‘Who's there?’ ‘Lucy.’ ‘Lucy who?’ ‘Lucy Lastic (= loose elastic
senses.zh: 敲门笑话利用英语谐音制造逗趣效果的一种笑话。一个人说knock-knock（敲门声），另一人回道“谁呀？”，前面的人说出一个名字，但这个名字其实隐含另外一个意思。以下是个典型的例子：“咚咚。”“谁呀？”“露西。”“露西什么？”“露西•拉斯蒂克”。最后一句与loose elastic（很松的橡皮带）发音相似。

senses.def: to stop doing something, especially work
senses.zh: 停止某事；中断某事；（尤指）下班，收工

examples.en: Do you want to knock off early today?
examples.zh: 你今天想早点儿歇工吗？

examples.en: What time do you knock off work?
examples.zh: 你什么时候下班？

examples.en: Let's knock off for lunch.
examples.zh: 咱们收工吃午饭吧。

senses.def: to murder somebody
to complete something quickly and without much effort

examples.en: He knocks off three novels a year.
examples.zh: 他一年轻松完成三部小说。

examples.zh: 偷窃一大批录音设备

examples.en: to knock off a bank
examples.zh: 盗窃银行

senses.def: to reduce the price or value of something

examples.en: They knocked off $60 because of a scratch.
examples.zh: 因为有擦痕，他们将价格减了 60 美元。

examples.en: The news knocked 13% off the company's shares.
examples.zh: 这消息使公司股价下跌 13%。

senses.def: an object such as a fashion item or an electronic device that is a cheaper copy of the original, more expensive version

examples.en: It's an expensive knock-off, but a knock-off all the same.
examples.zh: 这是个高价仿冒品，但不管怎么说，依然是仿冒品。

examples.en: knock-off designer handbags
examples.zh: 假名牌包

senses.def: causing other events to happen one after another in a series

examples.en: The increase in the price of oil had a knock-on effect on the cost of many other goods.
examples.zh: 石油价格上涨对其他许多商品的价格引起了连锁反应。

senses.def: to make somebody go to sleep or become unconscious
senses.zh: 使入睡；使昏睡；使不省人事

examples.en: The blow knocked her out.
examples.zh: 这一击把她打昏了。

senses.def: to hit an opponent so that they cannot get up within a limited time and therefore lose the fight
to surprise and impress somebody very much
senses.zh: 使大吃一惊；使倾倒；给某人留下深刻印象

examples.en: The movie just knocked me out.
examples.zh: 这电影着实令我赞叹不已。

senses.def: to make somebody/yourself very tired
senses.zh: 使筋疲力尽；使疲惫不堪

examples.en: Why knock yourself out for little income?
examples.zh: 为何收入微薄而让自己陷入困境？

senses.def: to defeat somebody so that they cannot continue competing

examples.en: England had been knocked out of the World Cup.
examples.zh: 英格兰队已被淘汰出世界杯足球赛。

senses.def: to produce something, especially quickly and easily
senses.zh: 完成；快速而轻易地做成

examples.en: He knocks out five books a year.
examples.zh: 他一年轻松写出五本书。

senses.def: to go ahead and do what you want

examples.en: You guys go and have fun. Knock yourselves out.
examples.zh: 你们去玩吧。想干什么就干什么。

examples.en: If you like something and can afford it, I say knock yourself out.
examples.zh: 如果你喜欢某样东西并且能买得起，我建议你把自己淘汰掉。

senses.def: to hit somebody and make them fall to the ground

examples.en: She was knocked down by a bus.
examples.zh: 她被一辆公共汽车撞倒在地。

examples.en: He knocked his opponent down three times in the first round.
examples.zh: 他第一局就将对手击倒三次。

senses.def: to hit somebody and make them fall to the ground
to make or complete something quickly and often not very well

examples.en: I knocked some bookshelves together from old planks.
examples.zh: 我用旧木板拼拼凑凑做了些书架。

senses.def: to make two rooms or buildings into one by removing the wall between them
senses.zh: 把两间屋（或两座建筑物）打通

examples.en: The house consists of two cottages knocked together.
examples.zh: 这房子是将两栋小屋的隔墙打通合二为一的。

to wake somebody by knocking

to prepare or make something quickly and without much effort
senses.zh: 迅速准备好；快速并轻易做成

examples.en: She knocked up a meal in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 她十分钟就做好了一顿饭。

senses.def: a short practice before a game or match, especially of tennis
to try and persuade somebody to stop behaving in a stupid way, sometimes using rough or violent methods
senses.zh: 开导某人别干傻事；强使某人理智行事

examples.en: Try and talk some sense into her before she makes the wrong decision.
examples.zh: 尽力说服她，别让她作出错误的决策。

examples.en: Where would I be without you to knock some sense into my head?
examples.zh: 如果没有你给我灌输一些理智，我会在哪里？

senses.def: to shock or surprise somebody

examples.en: The result of the election knocked most people for a loop.
examples.zh: 选举的结果使大多数人感到震惊。

senses.def: knockabout
a metal object attached to the outside of the door of a house, etc. that you hit against the door to attract attention
a person who is always criticizing somebody/something
senses.zh: 吹毛求疵的人；一味批评的人

senses.def: a woman’s breasts
advertising in which an opponent’s product is criticized
senses.zh: 诋毁性广告（针对竞争对手）

examples.en: Knocking copy is simply lazy journalism.
examples.zh: 诋毁性报道不过是一种偷懒的新闻写作方式。

senses.def: a brothel
a hard hit that makes an opponent fall to the ground and be unable to get up, so that they lose the fight
senses.zh: 击败对手的一击；击倒对手获胜

examples.en: The match ended in knockout in the fifth round.
examples.zh: 比赛在第五轮比赛中以淘汰赛告终。

examples.en: Sanchez won by a second-round knockout.
examples.zh: 桑切斯在第二轮淘汰赛中获胜。

senses.def: a person or thing that is very attractive or impressive

examples.en: She’s an absolute knockout.

examples.en: They are changing the format of the tournament from a knockout to a league.
examples.zh: 他们即将把比赛的形式从淘汰赛改为联赛。

examples.zh: 航班的取消对他的计划造成了沉重打击。

examples.zh: 将这两根绳子打结系在一起。

examples.zh: 在绳子上打个结。

examples.en: Sailors had to know lots of different knots.
examples.zh: 水手们必须了解许多不同的结。

senses.def: a way of twisting

examples.en: She had her hair in a knot.
examples.zh: 她把头发打了个髻。

examples.en: hair full of knots and tangles

a small group of people standing close together

examples.en: Little knots of people had gathered at the entrance.
examples.zh: 入口处聚集了一小群人。

senses.def: a tight, hard feeling in the stomach, throat, etc. caused by nerves, anger, etc.
senses.zh: （由紧张、恼怒等引起的胃、喉等的）痉挛，郁结，哽咽，哽塞

examples.en: My stomach was in knots.
examples.zh: 我（紧张得）胃痉挛。

examples.en: I could feel a knot of fear in my throat.
examples.zh: 我很害怕，感到喉咙发紧。

senses.def: to have information in your mind as a result of experience or because you have learned or been told it

examples.en: No one knows the answer.
examples.zh: 没有人知道答案。

examples.en: I need to know your name.
examples.zh: 我需要知道你的名字。

examples.en: The truth about what happened is not yet known.
examples.zh: 事情的真实情况还不清楚。

examples.en: All I know is that she used to work in a bank (= I have no other information about her).
examples.zh: 我只知道她曾在银行工作过。

examples.en: I know (that) people’s handwriting changes as they get older.
examples.zh: 我知道人们的笔迹随着年龄的增长而变化。

examples.en: We know from experience that turning a hobby into a business is not easy.
examples.zh: 经验告诉我们，把业余爱好变成事业并不容易。

examples.en: I know for a fact (that) he didn't go to the party.
examples.zh: 我确定他没有去参加聚会。

examples.en: ‘There's no one in.’ ‘How do you know?’
examples.zh: “一个人都没有。”“你怎么知道呢？”

examples.en: ‘You've got a flat tyre.’ ‘I know.’
examples.zh: “你的车胎瘪了。”“我知道。”

examples.en: ‘What's the answer?’ ‘I don't know.’
examples.zh: “答案是什么？”“我不知道。”

examples.en: As you know, Emma and I are old friends.
examples.zh: 如你所知，艾玛和我是老朋友。

examples.en: ‘Isn’t that his car?’ ‘I wouldn’t know./How should I know?’ (= I don’t know and I am not the person you should ask.)
examples.zh: “那不是他的汽车吗？”“我怎么会知道呢？”

examples.en: ‘What are you two whispering about?’ ‘You don't want to know’ (= because you would be shocked or wouldn't approve).
examples.zh: “你们俩在说什么悄悄话？”“你还是不知道的好。”

examples.en: It is widely known that CFCs can damage the ozone layer.
examples.zh: 众所周知氯氟烃会破坏臭氧层。

examples.en: I knew where he was hiding.
examples.zh: 我知道他藏在哪里。

examples.en: No one knows for sure who did it.
examples.zh: 没有人确切知道是谁干的。

examples.en: You know about Amanda's baby, don't you?
examples.zh: 你知道阿曼达的小宝宝吧？

examples.en: I don't know about you, but I'm ready for something to eat.
examples.zh: 不管你怎么样，反正我要吃点东西。

examples.en: I know next to nothing (= know almost nothing) about opera.
examples.zh: 我对歌剧几乎一无所知。

examples.en: I know of someone who can help us.
examples.zh: 我知道有人能帮助我们。

examples.en: ‘Is anyone else coming?’ ‘Not that I know of.’
examples.zh: “还有别的人要来吗？”“据我所知没有了。”

examples.en: Does he know to come here (= that he should come here) first?
examples.zh: 他知道要先到这儿来吗？

examples.en: We know her to be honest.
examples.zh: 我们知道她很诚实。

examples.en: Strobe lights are known to cause seizures.
examples.zh: 已知频闪灯会引起癫痫发作。

senses.def: to realize, understand or be aware of something

examples.en: As soon as I walked in the room I knew (that) something was wrong.
examples.zh: 我刚走进屋就意识到出了事。

examples.en: She knew she was dying.
examples.zh: 她知道自己快死了。

examples.en: ‘Martin was lying all the time.’ ‘I should have known.’
examples.zh: “马丁一直在撒谎。”“我本该察觉到的。”

examples.en: I knew perfectly well what she meant.
examples.zh: 我完全懂她的意思。

examples.en: I know exactly how you feel.
examples.zh: 我非常清楚你的感受。

examples.en: This case is hopeless and he knows it (= although he will not admit it).
examples.zh: 这个案子毫无希望，这一点他是清楚的。

senses.def: to feel certain about something

examples.en: He knew (that) he could trust her.
examples.zh: 他确信她是可以信赖的。

examples.en: I know it's here somewhere!
examples.zh: 我肯定它在这儿某个地方！

examples.en: I know things will turn out all right.
examples.zh: 我知道事情会好起来的。

examples.en: I don't know that I can finish it by next week.
examples.zh: 我没有把握能在下周完成。

examples.en: I just knew that it was something I wanted to do.
examples.zh: 我只知道这就是我想做的事情。

examples.en: ‘You were right—someone's been spreading rumours about you.’ ‘I knew it!’
examples.zh: “你说得对，有人一直在散布你的谣言。”“我早就知道！”

examples.en: ‘She's the worst player in the team.’ ‘Oh, I don't know (= I am not sure that I agree)—she played well yesterday.’
examples.zh: “她是最糟的队员。”“哦，是吗？她昨天表现可不错。”

senses.def: to be familiar with a person, place, thing, etc.

examples.en: I've known David for 20 years.
examples.zh: 我认识戴维已有 20 年了。

examples.en: Do you two know each other (= have you met before)?
examples.zh: 你们俩认识吗？

examples.en: She was a secretary when I first knew her.
examples.zh: 我最初认识她时，她是个秘书。

examples.en: She's very nice when you get to know her.
examples.zh: 你了解她以后就会觉得她非常可爱。

examples.en: Knowing Ben, we could be waiting a long time (= it is typical of him to be late).
examples.zh: 本这个人我们了解，能叫我们等很长时间。

examples.en: This man is known to the police (= as a criminal).
examples.zh: 这男人是在警方挂了号的。

examples.en: I don’t know anyone in Oxford.
examples.zh: 我在牛津不认识任何人。

examples.en: I know Paris well.
examples.zh: 我很熟悉巴黎。

examples.en: Do you know the play (= have you seen or read it before)?
examples.zh: 你知道这出戏吗？

examples.en: How many of your neighbours do you know by name?
examples.zh: 你知道多少个邻居的名字？

examples.en: The new rules could mean the end of football as we know it (= in the form that we are familiar with).
examples.zh: 这些新规则可能意味着我们熟悉的足球终结了。

senses.def: to have learned a skill or language and be able to use it

examples.en: Do you know any Japanese?
examples.zh: 你会日语吗？

examples.en: Do you know how to use spreadsheets?
examples.zh: 你知道电子表格的使用方法吗？

senses.def: to think that somebody/something is a particular type of person or thing or has particular characteristics

examples.en: He has become widely known as an expert in child psychology.
examples.zh: 他作为儿童心理学专家，已经广为人知。

examples.en: It's known as the most dangerous part of the city.
examples.zh: 人们都认为那是市内最危险的地段。

examples.en: She is best known for her work on the human brain.
examples.zh: 她在对人脑的研究方面最为知名。

examples.en: He is internationally known for his work with vaccines.
examples.zh: 他以其疫苗研究闻名国际。

examples.en: He's known to be an outstanding physicist.
examples.zh: 他被公认为杰出的物理学家。

senses.def: to give somebody/something a particular name or title

examples.en: Iran was formerly known as Persia.
examples.zh: 伊朗旧称波斯。

examples.en: The H5N1 virus is more commonly known as bird flu.
examples.zh: H5N1 病毒通常被称为禽流感。

examples.en: Peter Wilson, also known as ‘The Tiger’
examples.zh: 彼得·威尔逊，也称“老虎”

examples.en: He was known as Bonzo to his friends.
examples.zh: 他的朋友称他为邦佐。

examples.en: The country was not yet known by the name of England.
examples.zh: 那时这个国家还不叫英格兰。

senses.def: to be able to recognize somebody/something

examples.en: I couldn't see who was speaking, but I knew the voice.
examples.zh: 我看不到是谁在讲话，但我能辨认出声音。

examples.en: She knows a bargain when she sees one.
examples.zh: 她一看就知道有没有便宜可捡。

senses.def: to understand the difference between one person or thing and another

examples.en: I hope we have taught our children to know right from wrong.
examples.zh: 我希望我们教给了孩子分辨是非的能力。

senses.def: to have seen, heard or experienced something

examples.en: I’ve never known it (to) snow in July before.
examples.zh: 我以前从未见到过七月份下雪。

examples.en: He has been known to spend all morning in the bathroom.
examples.zh: 听说他整个上午都待在盥洗室里。

senses.def: to have personal experience of something

examples.en: He has known both poverty and wealth.
examples.zh: 他贫富生活都亲身经历过。

examples.en: She may be successful now, but she has known what it is like to be poor.
examples.zh: 她现在算是成功了，但她尝过贫穷的滋味。

examples.en: She thought she would never know the joy of seeing a child grow up in her care.
examples.zh: 她原以为她绝不会体验到看着孩子在自己的照料下长大的乐趣。

senses.def: used to say that you think you know, remember, understand, etc. something but you cannot be completely sure, especially because you do not know all the facts
senses.zh: 就我所知；据我所记得的；依我看

examples.en: As far as we knew, there was no cause for concern.
examples.zh: 就我们所知，没有什么需要担心的。

examples.en: As far as I can see, you've done nothing wrong.
examples.zh: 依我看，你没有做错任何事。

examples.en: She lived in Chicago, as far as I can remember.
examples.zh: 据我所记得的，她过去住在芝加哥。

senses.def: very quickly or suddenly
senses.zh: 转眼之间；一下子；瞬息间

examples.en: We were whisked off in a taxi before we knew where we were.
examples.zh: 还没等我们弄清怎么回事，出租车就一阵风似的把我们带走了。

senses.def: to have no way of realizing or being aware that you have done something wrong
senses.zh: 无从知道，并不知道（做错了事）

examples.en: ‘I'm sorry, I called when you were in bed.’ ‘Don't worry—you weren't to know.’
examples.zh: “对不起，你睡觉时打电话打扰你了。”“别在意，你不是故意的嘛。”

senses.def: used to say that it is easier and wiser to stay in a bad situation that you know and can deal with rather than change to a new situation that may be much worse
senses.zh: 熟悉的魔鬼比不熟悉的魔鬼好；不要嫌熟悉的环境不好，换个不熟悉的环境可能更糟

senses.def: used to emphasize that you do not know something and that it is not important to you
senses.zh: （强调不知道对自己无关紧要的事）不知道，说不定，亦未可知

examples.en: She could be dead for all I know.
examples.zh: 她说不定已经死了。

senses.def: used to emphasize that you do not know something

examples.en: God knows what else they might find.
examples.zh: 谁知道他们还可能找到什么。

examples.en: ‘Where are they?’ ‘Goodness knows.’
examples.zh: “他们在哪儿？”“天晓得。”

senses.def: used to emphasize the truth of what you are saying
senses.zh: （强调所言属实）老天作证，确实，的确

examples.en: She ought to pass the exam—goodness knows she's been working hard enough.

senses.def: used to agree with somebody or to show sympathy

examples.en: ‘What a ridiculous situation!’ ‘I know.’
examples.zh: “这境况真荒唐！”“的确是。”

examples.zh: 我狼狈地跌在地上，扭伤了脚踝。

examples.zh: 孩子们在学校附近的荒地玩耍。

items.zh: （常作 the country）尤指具有自然特征的乡下、乡村

examples.en: She lives in the country.
examples.zh: 她住在乡下。

examples.zh: 这种林地与田野的格局是典型的英格兰乡村景色。

items.zh: countryside 通常用于强调乡村地区的美丽或宁静

items.def: (formal) land. Terrain is used when you are describing the natural features of an area, for example if it is rough, flat, etc:
items.zh: terrain 用于描述某地区的地形或地势

items.def: (usually the land) the countryside; the way people live in the country as opposed to in towns and cities:
items.zh: （通常作 the land）指与城镇相对的农村、农村生活方式

examples.en: Many younger people are leaving the land to find work in the cities.
examples.zh: 许多较年轻的人陆续离开农村到城市去找工作。

examples.zh: 我们在山口停下来欣赏风景。

senses.zh: 陆桥：介于两块大块土地之间的一块狭窄的土地，尤其是很久以前存在的土地，人类和动物可以穿越但后来被海覆盖

senses.def: an act of buying or taking land illegally or in a way that is considered morally wrong

examples.zh: 该市拥有大部分水权，这些水权是在 1900 年代初期通过征地购买的。

examples.en: Residents fear a land grab by the wealthy elite.
examples.zh: 居民担心富绅们抢夺土地。

examples.zh: 该公司因购买互联网域名而被指控在网上抢占土地。

examples.en: The move was considered a land grab for younger TV viewers.
examples.zh: 此举被认为是抢夺年轻电视观众。

senses.def: a member of an organized criminal group employed to protect land and property through the use of violence

examples.zh: 最近，有关土地警卫恐吓居民的报道变得越来越普遍。

examples.zh: 她被逮捕并送上了法庭。

examples.zh: 他脾气急躁，以前就惹过麻烦。

examples.zh: 你这可把我坑苦了！

senses.zh: 希望与荣耀之地：爱德华·埃尔加（Edward Elgar）的一首歌的标题和首行，最初是他的盛况和环境游行的一部分。AC Benson的话非常爱国（在英国表示自豪）。传统上，这首歌是在毕业典礼的最后一夜表演的，听众在唱歌。

senses.def: the fact of feeling or showing strong sexual desire
senses.zh: 好色的；淫荡的；淫欲的；猥亵的

senses.def: a device that gives out light in which all the waves oscillate

examples.en: a laser beam
examples.zh: 激光束

examples.en: a laser navigation device
examples.zh: 激光导航装置

examples.en: The barcodes on the products are read by lasers.
examples.zh: 产品上的条码是用激光读取的。

examples.en: a laser show (= lasers used as entertainment)
examples.zh: 激光表演

examples.en: She's had laser surgery on her eye.
examples.zh: 她做了眼部激光手术。

examples.en: laser treatment/therapy
examples.zh: 激光治疗／疗法

senses.def: a piece of equipment that uses a laser
senses.zh: 激光条码扫描仪；激光测速仪

senses.def: a weapon that uses a powerful laser

examples.en: The character wears a silver spacesuit and carries a futuristic laser gun.
examples.zh: 该角色穿着银色宇航服并携带未来派激光枪。

senses.def: a device in the shape of a pen that sends out a line of light that is used to point to something when making a presentation

examples.en: She highlighted the relevant part of the image with a laser pointer.
examples.zh: 她用激光笔突出显示了图像的相关部分。

senses.def: a printer that produces good-quality printed material by means of a laser
a plastic disc like a large CD on which large amounts of information, such as video or music, can be stored, now generally replaced by the DVD
to hit somebody/something with great force

examples.en: The rain lashed at the windows.
examples.zh: 雨点猛烈地打在窗户上。

examples.en: Branches lashed at my face.
examples.zh: 树枝狠狠地打在我的脸上。

examples.en: Huge waves lashed the shore.
examples.zh: 巨浪拍打着海岸。

senses.def: to hit a person or an animal with a whip
to criticize somebody/something in a very angry way
to fasten something tightly to something else with ropes

examples.en: Several logs had been lashed together to make a raft.
examples.zh: 几根原木捆扎在一起做成了木筏。

examples.en: During the storm everything on deck had to be lashed down.
examples.zh: 暴风雨中甲板上所有的东西都必须系牢。

senses.def: to move or to move something quickly and violently from side to side

examples.en: The crocodile's tail was lashing furiously from side to side.
examples.zh: 鳄鱼的尾巴在急速地左右甩动。

examples.en: The cat hissed and lashed its tail wildly from side to side.
examples.zh: 猫发出嘶嘶声，尾巴疯狂地左右摆动。

senses.def: one of the hairs growing on the edge of the eyelids

examples.en: his long dark lashes
examples.zh: 他又长又黑的睫毛

examples.en: She lowered her lashes in sudden embarrassment.
examples.zh: 她突然窘迫地垂下了眼睛。

senses.def: a hit with a whip

examples.en: They each received 20 lashes for stealing.
examples.zh: 他们因盗窃每人挨了 20 鞭。

examples.en: to feel the lash of somebody’s tongue (= to be spoken to in an angry and critical way)
examples.zh: 领教某人言语如鞭的厉害

senses.def: the thin leather part at the end of a whip

examples.en: The lash struck him across the back.
examples.zh: 鞭子打在他的背上。

intro.en: These words all mean to hit somebody/​something many times, especially hard.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含多次击打之义，尤指用力打。

items.def: to hit somebody/​something a lot of times, especially very hard:
items.zh: 指反复敲打、使劲锤砸

examples.en: Someone was beating at the door.
examples.zh: 有人在捶门。

items.def: to hit somebody/​something hard a lot of times, especially in way that causes serious injury or damage:
items.zh: 指连续猛击，尤指造成伤害或破坏

examples.en: He had been badly battered around the head and face.
examples.zh: 他被打得鼻青脸肿。

items.def: to hit somebody/​something hard a lot of times, especially in a way that makes a lot of noise:
items.zh: 指连续猛击，尤指发出砰砰的撞击声

examples.en: Heavy rain pounded on the roof.
examples.zh: 暴雨砰砰地砸在屋顶上。

items.def: to hit somebody/​something with a lot of force:
items.zh: 指猛击、狠打

examples.en: The rain lashed at the window.
examples.zh: 雨点猛烈地打在窗户上。

items.def: to hit somebody/​something hard a lot of times, in a way that is noisy or violent:
items.zh: 指大声、猛烈地反复敲打、连续击打

examples.en: He hammered the door with his fists.
examples.zh: 他不断地用拳头擂门。

senses.def: to suddenly try to hit somebody/something

examples.en: She suddenly lashed out at the boy.
examples.zh: 她突然狠狠地打那个男孩。

examples.en: He lashed out with his riding whip.
examples.zh: 他用马鞭猛击。

senses.def: to criticize somebody in an angry way

examples.en: In a bitter article he lashed out at his critics.
examples.zh: 他写了一篇尖刻的文章，猛烈驳斥批评他的人。

examples.en: She suddenly lashed out in anger.
examples.zh: 她顿时愤怒地破口大骂。

senses.def: to spend a lot of money on something
a girl; a young woman
a serious disease, usually caught from rats
senses.zh: 拉沙热（通常由鼠传播的烈性疾病，尤见于西非）

senses.def: a South Asian drink made from yogurt
a dog that first appeared as a character in the film Lassie Come Home
senses.zh: 拉西（Lassie）：这只狗首次出现在电影《拉西回家》（Lassie Come Home，1943年）中，并随后出现在其他几部电影，广播和电视连续剧以及一部电视动画片中，所有这些电影主要用于儿童。Lassie是一只聪明的狗，经常使人们摆脱危险。

senses.def: a state of feeling very tired in mind or body; lack of energy

examples.en: I was overcome by lassitude.
examples.zh: 我感到疲倦。

senses.def: a long rope with one end tied into a loop
to catch an animal using a lasso

examples.en: to lasso a calf
examples.zh: 套住小牛

senses.def: happening or coming after all other similar things or people

examples.en: We caught the last bus home.
examples.zh: 我们赶上了回家的末班公共汽车。

examples.en: It's the last house on the left.
examples.zh: 是左边尽头那栋房子。

examples.en: She was last to arrive.
examples.zh: 她是最后到的。

senses.def: most recent

examples.en: last night/Tuesday/month/summer/year
examples.zh: 昨晚；上个星期二；上个月；去年夏季；去年

examples.en: The critics all hated her last book.
examples.zh: 评论家都很不喜欢她的新书。

examples.en: This last point is crucial.
examples.zh: 刚讲的这一点是关键的。

examples.en: The last time I saw him was in May.
examples.zh: 我上次见到他是在五月份。

senses.def: that is the only one that remains

examples.en: This is our last bottle of water.
examples.zh: 这是我们最后的一瓶水了。

examples.en: He knew this was his last hope of winning.
examples.zh: 他知道这是他取胜的最后希望。

examples.en: I wouldn’t marry you if you were the last person on earth!
examples.zh: 就算世界上只剩下你一个人，我也不会跟你结婚！

senses.def: used to emphasize that somebody/something is the least likely or suitable
senses.zh: （强调）最不可能的，最不适当的

examples.en: The last thing she needed was more work.
examples.zh: 她最不需要的就是更多的工作。

examples.en: He's the last person I'd trust with a secret.
examples.zh: 我要是有什么秘密，告诉谁也不能告诉他。

senses.def: after a long time

examples.en: At long last his prayers had been answered.
examples.zh: 他的祷告终于应验了。

senses.def: to be going to die or stop functioning very soon; to be very weak or in bad condition
senses.zh: 濒临死亡；奄奄一息；行将就木；快不能用了

senses.def: the day, week, etc. just before the most recent one; two days, weeks, etc. ago
senses.zh: 前天；上上星期；上上月；两天（或两周等）以前

examples.en: I haven't seen him since the summer before last.
examples.zh: 我已有两个夏天没见过他了。

senses.def: every person or thing in a group

examples.en: We spent every last penny we had on the house.
examples.zh: 我们把所有的钱都花在房子上了。

senses.def: people sometimes say Famous last words!
senses.zh: 吹牛，胡扯（表示某人盲目乐观）

examples.en: ‘Everything's under control.’ ‘Famous last words!’
examples.zh: “一切都在掌握之中。”“净吹牛！”

senses.def: early in the morning/late in the evening
senses.zh: 一早／晚上最后（要做的事）

examples.en: I need the report on my desk first thing Monday morning.
examples.zh: 星期一一早这个报告就得放在我的办公桌上。

examples.en: I took the dog for a walk last thing before going to bed.
examples.zh: 晚上就寝前我去遛狗了。

senses.def: to be successful when you were not expected to be, making your opponents look stupid
senses.zh: （在本未指望时）笑在最后，取得最后胜利

examples.en: We'll have the last laugh if she finds out that you're the one who played the trick.
examples.zh: 如果她发现是你耍的花招，我们就是最后的赢家了。

senses.def: used to say what is most important after everything has been discussed, or considered

examples.en: In the final analysis, it's a matter of personal choice.
examples.zh: 归根结底，这是个人的选择。

senses.def: when there are no other possible courses of action

examples.en: In the last resort we can always walk home.
examples.zh: 顶多我们走回家就是了。

senses.def: the last moment of a person’s life
the point at which you/something can no longer continue living, fighting, existing, etc.
senses.zh: 奄奄一息；苟延残喘；临终；垂死

senses.def: the latest possible time before an important event
senses.zh: （重大事情前的）最后一刻，紧要关头

examples.en: They changed the plans at the last minute.
examples.zh: 事到临头他们却改变了计划。

examples.en: Don't leave your decision to the last moment.
examples.zh: 别等到最后一刻才来作决定。

senses.def: the person or thing you rely on when everything else has failed
senses.zh: 最后可依赖的人（或事物）

examples.en: I've tried everyone else and now you're my last resort.
examples.zh: 其他人我都试过了，现在就靠你了。

senses.def: the last in a series of bad events, etc. that makes it impossible for you to accept a situation any longer
senses.zh: 压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草；终于使人不堪忍受的最后一件事（或因素等）

senses.def: the most recent, fashionable, advanced, etc. thing
senses.zh: 最新（或时髦、先进等）的事物

examples.en: These apartments are the last word in luxury.
examples.zh: 这些公寓最为豪华。

senses.def: the last comment or decision about something
senses.zh: （对某事的）最后意见，最后决定

examples.en: He always has to have the last word in any argument.
examples.zh: 在任何争论中总是得他最后说了算。

examples.en: I’m willing to wait one more week, and that’s my final word on the subject.
examples.zh: 我愿意再等一周，这是我对这个问题的最后一句话。

examples.en: The Chairman always has the last word on financial decisions.
examples.zh: 在作财务决策时，总是董事长最后说了算。

senses.def: used to emphasize that something is true of all the people being described

examples.en: They answered ‘Yes,’ to a man.
examples.zh: 他们异口同声地回答：“是。”

examples.en: They were all destroyed, to the last man.
examples.zh: 他们无一例外全部被歼。

senses.def: seven days before the day that you mention
senses.zh: 一个星期前的昨天（或星期一等）

examples.en: She started work a week yesterday.
examples.zh: 她在一个星期前的昨天就开始工作了。

senses.def: after anyone or anything else; at the end

examples.en: He came last in the race.
examples.zh: 这次赛跑他得了最后一名。

examples.en: They arrived last of all.
examples.zh: 他们来得比谁都晚。

senses.def: most recently

examples.en: When did you see him last?
examples.zh: 你最后一次是什么时候见过他？

examples.en: I saw him last/I last saw him in New York two years ago.
examples.zh: 我上一次是两年前在纽约见到他的。

examples.en: They last won the cup in 2006.
examples.zh: 他们上一次获得奖杯是在 2006 年。

senses.def: in every way that is important; completely

examples.en: She regarded herself, first and last, as a musician.
examples.zh: 她认为她自己是一个不折不扣的音乐家。

senses.def: used to tell somebody not to be too proud of their present success; in the end another person may be more successful
senses.zh: 别高兴得太早；笑到最后才笑得最好

senses.def: used when mentioning the last person or thing of a group, in order to say that they are not less important than the others
senses.zh: （提及最后的人或事物时说）最后但同样重要的

examples.en: Last but not least, I'd like to thank all the catering staff.
examples.zh: 最后但同样重要的是，我要感谢所有的餐饮工作人员。

senses.def: used, for example in a situation when people are losing their jobs, to say that the last people to be employed will be the first to go
senses.zh: （形容裁员等情况）最后雇用的人最先被解雇，后来者先走

senses.def: the person or thing that comes or happens after all other similar people or things
senses.zh: 最后来的人（或发生的事）

examples.en: Sorry I'm late—am I the last?
examples.zh: 对不起，我来晚了。我是最后到的人吗？

examples.en: They were the last to arrive.
examples.zh: 他们是最后到达的人。

senses.def: the only part or items that remain of something

examples.en: These are the last of our apples.
examples.zh: 这是我们最后剩下的几个苹果。

examples.en: We finished the last of the milk at breakfast.
examples.zh: 早餐时我们喝完了最后一杯牛奶。

senses.def: the latest

examples.en: That was the last I heard of him.
examples.zh: 那是我最后一次听到他的消息。

senses.def: the least likely

examples.en: Known for their self-sufficiency, fishermen would be the last to admit to mental strain.
examples.zh: 渔民以自给自足著称，最不可能承认有精神压力。

senses.def: after much delay, effort, etc.; in the end
senses.zh: （经过长时间的延误或努力等之后）终于，最终

examples.en: At last we're home!
examples.zh: 我们终于到家了！

examples.en: At long last the package arrived.
examples.zh: 包裹终于送到了。

senses.def: to die
from beginning to end; during the whole time

examples.en: It's a fine performance that commands attention from first to last.
examples.zh: 这是个精彩的演出，自始至终都扣人心弦。

senses.def: to hear/see somebody/something for the last time

examples.en: That was the last I ever saw of her.
examples.zh: 那是我最后一次见到她。

examples.en: Unfortunately, I don't think we've heard the last of this affair.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，我认为这件事还没有了结。

senses.def: used to give the most recent news you have about somebody/something
senses.zh: （提供最新消息时说）我最近听到的消息

examples.en: The last I heard he was still working at the garage.
examples.zh: 我最近听到的消息是他还在汽车修理厂工作。

senses.def: the one before the last one

examples.en: She finished second to last.
examples.zh: 她得了倒数第二。

senses.def: until the last possible moment, especially until death
senses.zh: 直到最后一刻；（尤指）直至死亡

examples.en: He died protesting his innocence to the last.
examples.zh: 他至死都坚决辩称自己无罪。

senses.def: a block of wood or metal in the shape of a foot, used in making and repairing shoes
to continue for a particular period of time

examples.en: Each game lasts about an hour.
examples.zh: 每场比赛约一小时。

examples.en: How long does the play last?
examples.zh: 那出戏要演多长时间？

examples.en: Nothing lasts forever.
examples.zh: 没有什么是永恒的。

examples.en: The meeting only lasted for a few minutes.
examples.zh: 会议只开了几分钟。

examples.en: The trial is expected to last until the end of the week.
examples.zh: 审判预计要持续到本周末。

senses.def: to continue to exist or to function well
senses.zh: 继续存在；持续起作用；持久

examples.en: This weather won't last.
examples.zh: 这种天气持续不了多久。

examples.en: Our product looks better and lasts longer.
examples.zh: 我们的产品外观更好，更经久耐用。

examples.en: He's making a big effort now, and I hope it lasts.
examples.zh: 现在他正加紧努力，我希望他能坚持下去。

examples.en: It was fun while it lasted.
examples.zh: 这在当时颇为有趣。

examples.en: These shoes should last you till next year.
examples.zh: 你这双鞋应该能穿到明年。

senses.def: to survive something or manage to stay in the same situation, despite difficulties
senses.zh: （在困境等中）坚持下去；熬过（困境等）

examples.en: She won't last long in that job.
examples.zh: 她那份工作干不了多久。

examples.en: Can you last out until I can get help?
examples.zh: 你能撑到我找来帮手吗？

examples.en: He was injured early on and didn't last the match.
examples.zh: 他开赛后不久就受了伤，没法坚持到底。

examples.en: Doctors say that she probably won't last out the night (= she will probably die before the morning).
examples.zh: 医生都说她很可能活不过今晚。

senses.def: to be enough for somebody to use, especially for a particular period of time
senses.zh: 够用，足够维持（尤指某段时间）

examples.en: Will the coffee last out till next week?
examples.zh: 咖啡够喝到下周吗？

examples.en: We’ve got enough food to last us (for) three days.
examples.zh: 我们的食物足够维持三天。

examples.en: She hoped they had enough firewood to last through the night.
examples.zh: 她希望他们有足够的柴火挺过这一夜。

examples.en: Get your free sample while supplies last!
examples.zh: 获取免费样品，售完即止！

senses.def: after a long time

examples.en: At long last his prayers had been answered.
examples.zh: 他的祷告终于应验了。

senses.def: to be going to die or stop functioning very soon; to be very weak or in bad condition
senses.zh: 濒临死亡；奄奄一息；行将就木；快不能用了

items.idm: the day, week, month, etc. before last

senses.zh: 前天；上上星期；上上月；两天（或两周等）以前

examples.en: I haven't seen him since the summer before last.
examples.zh: 我已有两个夏天没见过他了。

senses.def: every person or thing in a group

examples.zh: 我们把所有的钱都花在房子上了。

senses.def: when there are no other possible courses of action

the point at which you/something can no longer continue living, fighting, existing, etc.

senses.def: the latest possible time before an important event

examples.en: They changed the plans at the last minute.
examples.zh: 事到临头他们却改变了计划。

examples.en: Don't leave your decision to the last moment.
examples.zh: 别等到最后一刻才来作决定。

senses.def: the person or thing you rely on when everything else has failed
senses.zh: 最后可依赖的人（或事物）

examples.en: I've tried everyone else and now you're my last resort.
examples.zh: 其他人我都试过了，现在就靠你了。

items.idm: the last/final straw | the straw that breaks the camel’s back

senses.def: the last in a series of bad events, etc. that makes it impossible for you to accept a situation any longer
senses.zh: 压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草；终于使人不堪忍受的最后一件事（或因素等）

senses.def: the most recent, fashionable, advanced, etc. thing
senses.zh: 最新（或时髦、先进等）的事物

examples.en: These apartments are the last word in luxury.
examples.zh: 这些公寓最为豪华。

senses.def: the last comment or decision about something
senses.zh: （对某事的）最后意见，最后决定

examples.en: He always has to have the last word in any argument.
examples.zh: 在任何争论中总是得他最后说了算。

examples.en: I’m willing to wait one more week, and that’s my final word on the subject.
examples.zh: 我愿意再等一周，这是我对这个问题的最后一句话。

examples.en: The Chairman always has the last word on financial decisions.
examples.zh: 在作财务决策时，总是董事长最后说了算。

items.idm: to a man | to the last man

examples.zh: 这场胜利使他们连超三个队，跃居第二位。

senses.def: to gain knowledge or skill by studying, from experience, from being taught, etc.

examples.en: to learn a language/skill/trade
examples.zh: 学习一种语言／一项技能／一门手艺

examples.en: He had the opportunity to learn English in Australia.
examples.zh: 他有机会在澳大利亚学习英语。

examples.en: I learned a lot from my father.
examples.zh: 我从父亲那里学到了许多东西。

examples.en: Everyone in the class had the opportunity to learn from each other.
examples.zh: 班上的每个人都有机会互相学习。

examples.en: You can learn a great deal just from watching other players.
examples.zh: 你只要注意看其他运动员怎么做就能学到许多东西。

examples.en: She's very keen to learn about Japanese culture.
examples.zh: 她热衷于学习日本文化。

examples.en: The book is about how children learn.
examples.zh: 这本书是有关小孩怎样学习的。

examples.en: She received no training but quickly learnt on the job (= while doing the job).
examples.zh: 她没有接受过任何培训，但很快就在工作中学到了东西（=在做工作时）。

examples.en: He's learning to play the trumpet.
examples.zh: 他正在学吹小号。

examples.en: Most people learn to read as children.
examples.zh: 大多数人在孩童时期就学会了阅读。

examples.en: Today we learnt how to use the new software.
examples.zh: 今天我们学习了怎样使用这个新软件。

examples.en: Students need to learn what to do in an emergency.
examples.zh: 学生们需要学会如何应对紧急情况。

senses.def: to study and repeat something in order to be able to remember it

examples.en: I learnt the poem by heart.
examples.zh: 我把这首诗背下来了。

examples.en: We have to learn one of Hamlet's speeches for school tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我们明天上学得背诵一段哈姆雷特的台词。

examples.en: You'll have to learn your lines by next week.
examples.zh: 你下周前必须把台词背熟。

senses.def: to gradually change your attitudes about something so that you behave in a different way
senses.zh: 认识到；意识到；（从…）吸取教训

examples.en: Some people never learn, do they?
examples.zh: 有些人从来不学习，是不是？

examples.en: I'm sure she'll learn from her mistakes.
examples.zh: 我肯定她会从错误中吸取教训。

examples.en: Why do people so often fail to learn from experience?
examples.zh: 为什么人们常常无法从经验中学习？

examples.en: He’ll just have to learn (that) he can’t always have his own way.
examples.zh: 他一定要明白不能老是随心所欲。

examples.en: They quickly learn that bad behaviour is a sure-fire way of getting attention.
examples.zh: 他们很快就会发现，不良行为是引起关注的必经之路。

examples.en: They eventually learned to love living in the countryside.
examples.zh: 他们最终学会了热爱乡村生活。

examples.en: I soon learned not to ask too many questions.
examples.zh: 我很快就意识到不能问太多的问题。

senses.def: to become aware of something by hearing about it from somebody else

examples.en: I first learnt of his death many years later.
examples.zh: 许多年后我才第一次得知他的死讯。

examples.en: We only learned about the problems in May of this year.
examples.zh: 我们是今年5月份才了解到这个问题的。

examples.en: We were very surprised to learn (that) she had got married again.
examples.zh: 我们听说她又结婚了，感到很惊讶。

examples.en: We only learned who the new teacher was a few days ago.
examples.zh: 我们几天前才得知新教师是谁。

examples.en: How did they react when they learned the news?
examples.zh: 他们听到这个消息有什么反应？

examples.en: It has been learned that 500 jobs are to be lost at the factory.
examples.zh: 据悉工厂将要裁减 500 个工作岗位。

senses.def: to know something because of something unpleasant that has happened to you
senses.zh: 付出过代价（或吃了苦头）才知道

examples.en: She is a tough competitor, as I know to my cost.
examples.zh: 她是一个强有力的竞争对手，我知道这是我付出的代价。

senses.def: to find out how to behave by learning from your mistakes or from unpleasant experiences, rather than from being told
to learn what to do or not to do in the future because you have had a bad experience in the past
to show somebody/know/learn how a particular job should be done
senses.zh: 向某人演示／知道／学会如何做某事

senses.def: used to express surprise at something new or unexpected you have been told
senses.zh: （对得知的事物感到惊讶或意外）真是得活到老学到老，真想不到

examples.en: a slow/quick learner
examples.zh: 迟钝的／聪明的学生

examples.zh: 英语学习词典

examples.en: learner-centred teaching methods
examples.zh: 以学生为中心的教学方法

examples.zh: 年轻/成人学习者

examples.zh: 学习语言的人

senses.def: a person who is learning to drive a car

examples.en: Learners are not allowed to drive without a licensed driver in the vehicle.
examples.zh: 在车内没有持照驾驶员的情况下，学员不得驾驶汽车。

senses.def: a person who is learning to drive who has not yet passed the driving test

examples.en: The learner driver often grips the wheel too tightly.
examples.zh: 学车者经常把方向盘握得太紧。

senses.def: an official document that you must have when you start to learn to drive
senses.zh: 实习驾驶执照；学员驾照

senses.def: the rate at which you learn a new subject or a new skill; the process of learning from the mistakes you make
senses.zh: 学习曲线；吸取教训过程曲线

examples.en: We have all been on a steep learning curve to master the new procedures.
examples.zh: 为了掌握新程序，我们都经历了一段陡峭的学习曲线。

examples.en: We expect a learning curve as we develop the project.
examples.zh: 我们期望在开发项目时有一个学习曲线。

senses.def: difficulty in learning and understanding things or in managing everyday activities, which affects somebody for their whole life
senses.zh: 学习无能（先天性或由疾病、受伤引起）

examples.en: a child with severe learning difficulties
examples.zh: 有严重学习障碍的孩子

examples.en: A student may need extra support with a specific learning difficulty.
examples.zh: 学生可能因特定的学习困难而需要额外的支持。

examples.en: Because of my learning difficulties, I struggle to order tickets online.
examples.zh: 由于我的学习困难，我很难在网上订票。

senses.def: difficulty in learning and understanding things or in managing everyday activities, which affects somebody for their whole life
senses.zh: 学习无能（先天性或由疾病、受伤引起）

examples.en: She works in a school for children with learning disabilities.
examples.zh: 她在一所为有学习障碍的儿童开办的学校里工作。

examples.en: You may get extra help if your child has a learning disability.
examples.zh: 如果你的孩子有学习障碍，你可以得到更多的帮助。

senses.def: a set of resources on the internet that aim to teach a particular topic or skill and that can be used by teachers or students. They include material on the topic itself and sometimes practice material and tests.
senses.zh: 学习对象，学习物件（供教师或学生使用的网上学习资源，包括教材、练习题和测验题等）

senses.def: a legal agreement that allows you to use a building, a piece of equipment or some land for a period of time, usually in return for rent
senses.zh: （房屋、设备或土地的）租约，租契

examples.en: to take out a lease on a house
examples.zh: 办理房屋租约

examples.en: The lease expires/runs out next year.
examples.zh: 这份租约明年到期。

examples.en: Under the terms of the lease, you have to pay maintenance charges.
examples.zh: 按租约的条款，你得支付维修费。

senses.def: the chance to live or last longer, or with a better quality of life
senses.zh: 延年益寿；生活质量更好

examples.en: Since her hip operation she's had a new lease of life.
examples.zh: 她自髋关节手术以后活得更有劲了。

senses.def: to use or let somebody use something, especially property or equipment, in exchange for rent or a regular payment
senses.zh: 租用，租借，出租（尤指房地产或设备）

examples.en: We lease all our computer equipment.
examples.zh: 我们所有的计算机设备都是租来的。

examples.en: This page will explain why you should lease your next car, and why it can be suitable for you.
examples.zh: 本页将解释为什么您应该租赁下一辆车，以及为什么它适合您。

examples.en: They lease the land from a local farmer.
examples.zh: 他们从当地一位农场主手中租得这块土地。

examples.en: A local farmer leased them the land.
examples.zh: 这块地是当地的一个农场主租给他们的。

examples.en: Parts of the building are leased out to tenants.
examples.zh: 这栋大楼有一部分租出去了。

senses.def: the chance to live or last longer, or with a better quality of life
senses.zh: 延年益寿；生活质量更好

examples.en: Since her hip operation she's had a new lease of life.
examples.zh: 她自髋关节手术以后活得更有劲了。

senses.def: the process of allowing the former owner of a property to continue to use it if they pay rent to the new owner; a legal agreement where this happens
senses.zh: 售后回租（将地产出售后再租回）；售后回租契约

examples.en: a leaseback arrangement
examples.zh: 回租安排

senses.def: in a way that enables property to be used for a limited period of time, according to the arrangements in a lease
senses.zh: 根据租约的安排，使财产能够在有限的时间内使用

examples.en: to purchase land leasehold
examples.zh: 租赁土地

senses.def: that can be used for a limited period of time, according to the arrangements in a lease

examples.en: a leasehold property
examples.zh: 租赁的房地产

senses.def: the right to use a building or a piece of land according to the arrangements in a lease
senses.zh: （按租约使用房屋或土地的）租赁保有权

examples.en: to obtain/own the leasehold of a house
examples.zh: 获得／拥有一所房子的租赁保有权

senses.def: a person who is allowed to use a building or a piece of land according to the arrangements in a lease
a long piece of leather, chain or rope used for holding and controlling a dog

examples.en: All dogs must be kept on a leash in public places.
examples.zh: 在公共场所所有的狗必须用绳牵住。

examples.en: Once she was away from the road, she could let the dogs off the leash.
examples.zh: 一旦离开公路后，她便可以给狗解开链子了。

senses.def: to want to do something very much

examples.en: Like all youngsters, he's straining at the leash to leave home.
examples.zh: 跟所有年轻人一样，他也急于离开家生活。

senses.def: to control an animal, especially a dog, with a leash
senses.zh: 用皮带等系住，拴住（尤指狗）

senses.def: to want to do something very much

examples.en: Like all youngsters, he's straining at the leash to leave home.
examples.zh: 跟所有年轻人一样，他也急于离开家生活。

senses.def: a bad situation will pass or be forgotten most quickly if nothing more is said about it
senses.zh: 只要没人再说，事情就会过去

senses.def: the smallest number that the bottom numbers of a group of fractions

something that is simple enough to seem interesting to, or to be understood by, the highest number of people in a particular group; the sort of people who are least intelligent or accept something that is of low quality
senses.zh: 大众化的东西；最平庸的人

senses.def: the smallest number that a group of numbers can be divided into exactly
used to limit or make what you have just said less definite
senses.zh: （用以减轻前面所说的话的肯定性）至少

examples.en: It isn't cheap to get there, leastways not at this time of year.
examples.zh: 去那里费用可不低，至少在一年中的这个时节是这样。

senses.def: material made by removing the hair or fur from animal skins and preserving the skins using special processes

examples.en: a leather jacket
examples.zh: 皮夹克

examples.en: The soles are made of leather.
examples.zh: 鞋底是皮革做的。

examples.en: a leather-bound book
examples.zh: 皮面装订的书

examples.en: I'm looking for a pair of boots in dark brown leather.
examples.zh: 我想买一双深棕色的皮靴。

senses.def: clothes made from leather
senses.zh: （尤指骑摩托车人穿的）皮衣，皮外套

examples.en: a biker in black leathers
examples.zh: 穿黑皮衣的摩托车手

examples.zh: 拼命快骑

senses.def: a very large sea turtle
an artificial material that looks and feels like leather
that looks or feels hard and tough like leather

examples.en: leathery skin
examples.zh: 粗糙的皮肤

senses.def: to go away from a person or a place

examples.en: Come on, it's time we left (= time for us to leave).
examples.zh: 快点，我们该走了。

examples.en: She left without saying goodbye.
examples.zh: 她不辞而别。

examples.en: The plane leaves for Dallas at 12.35.
examples.zh: 飞机于 12:35 起飞前往达拉斯。

examples.en: What time do you have to leave for work?
examples.zh: 你几点下班去上班？

examples.en: The plane leaves Heathrow at 12.35.
examples.zh: 飞机于 12:35 在希思罗机场起飞。

examples.en: I hate leaving home.
examples.zh: 我讨厌离开家。

examples.en: She left the house around 8 this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上八点左右离开家。

examples.en: The whole family was forced to leave the country.
examples.zh: 全家人被迫离开这个国家。

senses.def: to stop living at a place, belonging to a group, working for an employer, etc.
senses.zh: 离开居住地点（或群体、工作单位等）

examples.en: My assistant is threatening to leave.
examples.zh: 我的助理以辞职相要挟。

examples.en: He didn't leave home until he was 30.
examples.zh: 他直到 30 岁才离开家。

examples.en: She left school at 16.
examples.zh: 她16岁就离开了学校。

examples.en: I went to see him, but was told he had left town.
examples.zh: 我去看他，但被告知他已经离开小镇了。

examples.en: The Mayor left office in 2018.
examples.zh: 市长于 2018 年卸任。

examples.en: Why did you leave your last job?
examples.zh: 你为什么离开上一份工作？

examples.en: People leave for better-paid jobs elsewhere.
examples.zh: 人们离职另找薪酬更高的工作。

examples.en: Many of her relatives had left Ireland for America.
examples.zh: 她的许多亲戚都离开爱尔兰去了美国。

senses.def: to leave your wife, husband or partner permanently

examples.en: I was afraid you'd leave if you knew the truth.
examples.zh: 我怕你知道真相就会离开。

examples.en: I'll never leave you.
examples.zh: 我将对你不离不弃。

examples.en: She left him for a colleague.
examples.zh: 她离开他跟一个同事好了。

senses.def: to go away from a place without taking something/somebody with you

examples.en: I'll have to go back—I've left my jacket.
examples.zh: 我得回去一下。我把夹克忘了。

examples.en: They left the children and went out for the evening.
examples.zh: 他们留下孩子们出去过夜。

examples.en: I've left my bag on the bus.
examples.zh: 我把包忘在公共汽车上了。

examples.en: You can leave your things here.
examples.zh: 你可以把你的东西留在这里。

examples.en: He wasn't well, so we had to leave him behind.
examples.zh: 他身体不适，因此我们只好把他留下。

examples.en: Don't leave any of your belongings behind.
examples.zh: 别忘了带上自己的随身物品。

senses.group: somebody/something in place/condition 地方；状态

senses.def: to make or allow somebody/something to remain in a particular condition, place, etc.
senses.zh: 使保留，让…处于（某种状态、某地等）

examples.en: Leave the door open, please.
examples.zh: 请把门开着吧。

examples.en: The bomb blast left 25 people dead.
examples.zh: 那颗炸弹炸死了 25 个人。

examples.en: His help left her free to focus on her research.
examples.zh: 他的帮助让她可以自由地专注于她的研究。

examples.en: Don't leave her waiting outside in the rain.
examples.zh: 别让她在外边雨里等着。

examples.en: We were left feeling rather disappointed.
examples.zh: 我们感到相当失望。

examples.en: Leave the rice to cook for 20 minutes.
examples.zh: 把大米煮 20 分钟。

examples.en: He ate up his vegetables but left the chicken.
examples.zh: 他吃光了蔬菜，但把鸡肉留下了。

senses.group: somebody/something in place/condition 地方；状态

senses.def: to remain to be used, sold, etc.

examples.en: Is there any coffee left?
examples.zh: 还有咖啡剩下吗？

examples.en: He's spent all the money—there's nothing left.
examples.zh: 他已经花光了所有的钱——什么也没有剩下。

examples.en: You still have a few minutes left.
examples.zh: 你还有几分钟。

examples.en: How many tickets do you have left?
examples.zh: 你还剩下多少张票？

examples.en: They are fighting to save what is left of their business.
examples.zh: 他们在拼命抢救他们仅余的业务。

examples.en: Not much is left of the old town.
examples.zh: 老城区已所剩无几。

examples.en: The only course of action left to me was to notify her employer.
examples.zh: 我可以采取的唯一措施就是通知她的雇主。

senses.group: somebody/something in place/condition 地方；状态

senses.def: to make something happen or remain as a result
senses.zh: 使发生；造成，使留下为（某种结果）

examples.en: Red wine leaves a stain.
examples.zh: 红葡萄酒会留下污渍。

examples.en: The Romans left their mark on Britain.
examples.zh: 罗马人在英国留下了自己的印记。

examples.en: Leave room on the spreadsheet to add the results later.
examples.zh: 在电子表格上留出空间以便稍后添加结果。

examples.en: They've left a space here where you can put your name.
examples.zh: 他们在这里留了一个空间，你可以在其中写下你的名字。

examples.en: She left me with the impression that she was unhappy.
examples.zh: 她给我的印象是她不快乐。

examples.en: I'm afraid you leave me no choice.
examples.zh: 恐怕你没有给我选择的余地。

senses.group: somebody/something in place/condition 地方；状态

senses.def: to deliver, write or record something to be seen or heard later

examples.en: Lots of people had left comments under the post.
examples.zh: 很多人在帖子下面留了言。

examples.en: Someone called, but they didn't leave a message.
examples.zh: 有人打来电话，但没有留言。

examples.en: Someone left this note for you.
examples.zh: 有人给你送来了这张便条。

examples.en: Someone left you this note.
examples.zh: 有人给你送来了这张便条。

senses.def: to not do something or deal with something immediately

examples.en: Leave the dishes—I'll do them later.
examples.zh: 盘子先搁着吧，我等会儿再洗。

examples.en: Why do you always leave everything until the last moment?
examples.zh: 你怎么什么事都留到最后一刻才处理？

examples.en: Let's leave that topic for another day.
examples.zh: 让我们把这个话题留到日后再谈。

senses.group: something to do later 以后要做的事

senses.def: to allow somebody to take care of something

examples.en: You can leave the cooking to me.
examples.zh: 你可以把做饭的事交给我。

examples.en: They didn't leave anything to chance (= everything was planned carefully).
examples.zh: 他们把一切都安排周全，不凭运气。

examples.en: ‘Where shall we eat?’ ‘I’ll leave it entirely (up) to you (= you can decide).’
examples.zh: “我们上哪儿吃去？”“我全交给你来决定好了。”

examples.en: I leave it to you to decide what order to do things in.
examples.zh: 事情应该按什么顺序来做，就由你来决定了。

examples.en: She left her assistant in charge.
examples.zh: 她委托助手来负责。

examples.en: Leave it with me—I'm sure I can sort it out.
examples.zh: 把这事交给我吧，我一定会解决的。

examples.en: They left me with all the clearing up.
examples.zh: 他们把什么都留给我来收拾。

examples.en: Can I leave you to lock up the shop?
examples.zh: 关店的事我能交给你吗？

examples.en: I was left to cope on my own.
examples.zh: 就剩下我一个人来单独对付。

senses.group: responsibility to somebody 留给某人的责任

senses.def: to give something to somebody when you die

examples.en: He left a large estate.
examples.zh: 他留下了一大笔遗产。

examples.en: She left £1 million to her daughter.
examples.zh: 她遗留给女儿 100 万英镑。

examples.en: She left her daughter £1 million.
examples.zh: 她遗留给女儿 100 万英镑。

senses.def: to have family who continue to live after your death

examples.en: He leaves a wife and two children.
examples.zh: 他遗下妻子和两个孩子。

senses.def: to have a particular amount left over

examples.en: Seven from ten leaves three.

senses.def: to be alone

senses.def: to stay at a steady level of development or progress after a period of sharp rises or falls
senses.zh: （经过急剧的涨落后）保持平稳发展

examples.en: Sales have levelled off after a period of rapid growth.
examples.zh: 销售经过一段时间的快速增长后呈稳定状态。

senses.def: to win points and get new skills, weapons, etc. for your character
senses.zh: 升级（角色可获得新技能、武器等）

examples.en: Players battle with monsters, gain experience, and level up to become more powerful.
examples.zh: 玩家与怪物战斗，获得经验并升级，变得更加强大。

examples.en: It’s all about levelling up your skills and character abilities.
examples.zh: 这一切都是为了提升你的技能和性格能力。

senses.def: to make standards, amounts, etc. be of the same high or higher level
senses.zh: 把（标准、数量等）拉平；使达到更高水平

senses.def: to tell somebody the truth and not hide any unpleasant facts from them
senses.zh: 对某人说实话；直言相告

senses.def: an event or a situation that makes everyone equal whatever their age, importance, etc.
senses.zh: 使人人平等的事（或局面）

examples.zh: 凡人皆要面对的死亡

senses.def: in a calm and steady way

examples.en: She looked at him levelly.
examples.zh: 她平静地看着他。

senses.def: a handle used to operate a vehicle or a machine
senses.zh: （车辆或机器的）操纵杆，控制杆

examples.en: Pull the lever towards you to adjust the speed.
examples.zh: 把操纵杆往你身前拉动以调节速度。

senses.def: a long piece of wood, metal, etc. used for lifting or opening something by somebody placing one end of it under an object and pushing down on the other end

examples.en: We had to use a lever to prise open the window.
examples.zh: 我们不得不用杠杆撬开窗户。

examples.en: Use a tyre lever to get the tyre off.
examples.zh: 使用撬胎棒将轮胎取下。

senses.def: an action that is used to put pressure on somebody to do something they do not want to do

examples.en: The threat of sanctions is our most powerful lever for peace.
examples.zh: 实施制裁的威胁是我们争取和平最有力的施压手段。

senses.def: to move something with a lever

examples.en: I levered the lid off the pot with a knife.
examples.zh: 我用刀撬掉了罐盖。

examples.en: The intruders had levered off the bolts.
examples.zh: 入侵者撬开了螺栓。

examples.en: They managed to lever the door open.
examples.zh: 他们设法撬开了门。

senses.def: the ability to influence what people do

examples.en: diplomatic leverage
examples.zh: 外交影响力

examples.en: Retailers can exert leverage over producers by threatening to take their business elsewhere.
examples.zh: 零售商可以用另谋厂家来威胁生产商，向他们施加压力。

senses.def: the act of using a lever

examples.en: A longer piece of wood would give you greater leverage.
examples.zh: 更长的木头会给你更大的杠杆作用。

examples.en: Position the piece of wood so that maximum leverage can be applied.
examples.zh: 把这块木头放在最容易使上劲儿的地方。

senses.def: the relationship between the amount of money that a company owes and the value of its shares
senses.zh: 杠杆比率；资本与负债比率

senses.def: the practice of borrowing money for an investment, in the hope of increasing profits in the future
senses.zh: 为了增加未来利润而借钱进行投资的做法

examples.en: While leverage presents opportunities for increasing the total return on investments, it also has the potential to increase losses.
examples.zh: 虽然杠杆提供了增加总投资回报的机会，但它也有可能增加损失。

senses.def: to get as much advantage or profit as possible from something that you have

examples.en: The company needs to leverage its resources.
examples.zh: 该公司需要充分利用其资源。

examples.en: This system will help you to leverage your time so that you get more done.
examples.zh: 该系统将帮助您充分利用时间，完成更多工作。

senses.def: to use borrowed money to buy an investment, in the hope of increasing profits in the future
senses.zh: 用借来的钱进行投资，希望在未来增加利润

examples.en: The company was heavily leveraged and at risk of insolvency.
examples.zh: 该公司杠杆率很高，面临破产风险。

senses.def: the act of buying a company using money that is borrowed based on the value of the company being bought
senses.zh: 杠杆收购（以收购公司的价值抵押贷款来收购该公司的手段）

senses.zh: 托马斯·霍布斯（Thomas Hobbes）在1651年出版的一本书。该书讨论了人类社会以及统治者与人之间的关系。结论是，只有一个强大的权力机构才能防止“每个人对每个人的战争”。该书还包含一个著名的短语，描述人类生活为“孤独，贫穷，讨厌，野蛮和短暂”。

senses.def: to rise and float in the air with no physical support, apparently by means of magic or by using special mental powers; to make something rise in this way
senses.zh: （用魔法或特殊精神力量）升空，空中飘浮，使升空，使飘浮

senses.zh: 列维敦（Levittown）：第二次世界大战后不久由威廉·列维特（William Levitt）设计和建造的三个美国城镇的名称，以满足从战争中返回的士兵及其家人对廉价房屋的需求

two US explorers
senses.zh: 刘易斯和克拉克：两位美国探险家，他们于1804-5年进行了刘易斯和克拉克探险。总统托马斯·杰斐逊（Thomas Jefferson）派遣梅里韦瑟·刘易斯（Meriwether Lewis）（1774-1809）和威廉·克拉克（William Clark（1770-1838））领导对美国新路易斯安那州购买交易的调查，并记录他们所看到的。他们于1804年从圣路易斯出发，在18个月后到达太平洋，然后于1806年返回。他们的旅程鼓励了许多美国人迁往西方。电影《遥远的地平线》（The Far Horizons，1955）中讲述了它的故事。

senses.def: (1832-98) an English writer, best known for his children's books Alice in Wonderland
senses.zh: 刘易斯·卡罗尔（1832–1898）英国作家，以童话《爱丽丝梦游仙境》和《镜中世界》而闻名，也写胡诌诗。牛津大学数学教师。真名查尔斯·道奇森。

senses.zh: LBGTQI，性少数群体（指女同性恋、男同性恋、双性恋、跨性别者、酷儿（或性别存疑者）和双性人）

senses.zh: 莉·阿伯纳（Li'l Abner）：美国流行的漫画连环画（1934-77），由Al Capp（1909-79）绘制。这些故事是关于住在Dogpatch的乡下人的，主要人物是Li'l（Little）Abner，他的漂亮女友Daisy Mae和他的母亲Mammy Yokum。这些角色曾在1956年的百老汇音乐剧和后来的电影中使用，这两个电影都被称为Li'l Abner。

senses.def: the state of being legally responsible for something
senses.zh: （法律上对某事物的）责任，义务

examples.en: The company cannot accept liability for any damage caused by natural disasters.
examples.zh: 该公司对自然灾害造成的任何损失概不承担责任。

examples.en: The company has liabilities to its employees.
examples.zh: 公司对员工负有责任。

examples.en: The defendant admitted liability to compensate the claimant.
examples.zh: 被告承认对原告负有赔偿责任。

senses.def: a person or thing that causes you a lot of problems

examples.en: Since his injury, Jones has become more of a liability than an asset to the team.
examples.zh: 琼斯负伤以来，与其说他是全队的骨干倒不如说他已成为队里的累赘。

examples.en: The debate on immigration is proving to be something of a liability for the Prime Minister.
examples.zh: 事实证明，关于移民的辩论对总理来说是一种负担。

senses.def: the amount of money that a person or company owes

examples.en: The company is reported to have liabilities of nearly $90 000.
examples.zh: 据说公司负债近 9 万美元。

examples.en: Our financial advisers will concentrate on minimizing your tax liabilities and maximizing your income.
examples.zh: 我们的财务顾问将全力帮你尽可能减少纳税，增加收入。

senses.def: legally responsible for paying the cost of something

examples.en: You will be liable for any damage caused.
examples.zh: 你必须对造成的任何损失负赔偿责任。

examples.en: The court ruled he could not be held personally liable for his wife's debts.
examples.zh: 法庭裁定他个人不负有偿付妻子债务的责任。

senses.def: likely to do something

examples.en: We're all liable to make mistakes when we're tired.
examples.zh: 人在疲劳时都可能出差错。

examples.en: The bridge is liable to collapse at any moment.
examples.zh: 那座桥随时可能坍塌。

senses.def: likely to be affected by something

examples.en: You are more liable to injury if you exercise infrequently.
examples.zh: 不经常运动就更容易受伤。

senses.def: likely to be punished by law for something

examples.en: Offenders are liable to fines of up to $500.
examples.zh: 违者可能被处以最多 500 美元的罚款。

examples.en: Advertisers pretending to be private individuals will be liable to prosecution.
examples.zh: 冒充私人的广告商将受到起诉。

senses.def: having to do something by law
senses.zh: 必须按法律做（某事）；负有…责任

examples.en: People who earn under a certain amount are not liable to pay tax.
examples.zh: 收入低于一定数额者不必纳税。

examples.en: At 60, he was no longer liable for conscription.
examples.zh: 60岁时，他不再需要服兵役。

senses.def: to work closely with somebody and exchange information with them

examples.en: He had to liaise directly with the police while writing the report.
examples.zh: 写报告的时候他不得不直接与警方取得联系。

examples.en: The tax office liaises closely with our department on such matters.
examples.zh: 在这些事务上，税务局与我们部门联系很紧密。

senses.def: to act as a link between two or more people or groups

examples.en: Her job is to liaise between students and teachers.
examples.zh: 她的工作是做师生间的联系人。

senses.def: a relationship between people or organizations involving the exchange of information or ideas

examples.zh: 我们希望建立更密切的客户联络。

examples.en: Our role is to ensure liaison between schools and parents.
examples.zh: 我们的职责是确保学校与家长间的联系。

examples.en: We work in close liaison with the police.
examples.zh: 我们与警方密切配合。

senses.def: a person whose job is to make sure there is a good relationship between two groups or organizations

examples.en: the White House liaison to organized labor
examples.zh: 白宫与工人组织的联络人

examples.en: We hired someone as customer liaison.
examples.zh: 我们雇用了一名客户联络员。

senses.def: a secret sexual relationship, especially if one or both partners are already in a relationship with somebody else
senses.zh: （尤指一方或双方已有恋人或伴侣的）出轨，私通

examples.en: He finally admitted to several sexual liaisons.
examples.zh: 他最终承认有过几次通奸。

examples.zh: 她与丈夫最好的朋友有染。

examples.zh: 我们需要任命一个人担任新闻联络官。

senses.zh: 自由民主党成员（或支持者）

examples.en: a Lib-Lab deal/agreement/plan
examples.zh: 一项自由党—工党协议／计划

examples.zh: 他控告那家报社犯有诽谤罪。

senses.zh: Wladziu Valentino Liberace（1919-87）是美国钢琴演奏家，穿着昂贵的色彩鲜艳的衣服，演奏风格非常夸张。他因其受欢迎的电视节目（1952-7）赢得了艾美奖，并且是拉斯维加斯的一颗星多年。Liberace演奏并有时会演唱浪漫歌曲，并且钢琴上总是点着蜡烛。他死于与艾滋病有关的疾病。

examples.zh: 即使在以自由主义闻名的纽约，她的观点也被认为过于激进。

senses.def: to eat or drink something by licking

examples.en: The cat licked up the milk.
examples.zh: 猫把牛奶舔光了。

examples.en: She licked the honey off the spoon.
examples.zh: 她舔光了调羹上的蜂蜜。

senses.def: to touch something lightly

examples.en: Flames were soon licking the curtains.
examples.zh: 火焰很快就烧着了窗帘。

examples.en: The flames were now licking at their feet.
examples.zh: 火焰现正在他们脚下蔓延。

senses.def: to easily defeat somebody or deal with something

examples.en: We thought we had them licked.
examples.zh: 我们以为已经轻易地把他们对付过去了。

examples.en: It was a tricky problem but I think we've licked it.
examples.zh: 这是一个棘手的问题，但我认为我们轻而易举地把它解决了。

senses.def: to train somebody so that they do a particular job, task, etc. well
senses.zh: 把某人培养成材（或训练出来）

examples.en: It took him just two weeks to knock the new recruits into shape.
examples.zh: 他只用了两周时间就让新兵们都成型了。

senses.def: to show too much respect for somebody in authority because you want to please them

examples.zh: 把这孩子留在我身边吧——我很快就会把他舔干净！

to show that you are excited about something and want it to happen soon

examples.en: They were licking their lips at the thought of clinching the deal.
examples.zh: 他们一想到马上要做成这笔交易就显得急不可待了。

examples.zh: 在惨败于格里姆斯比之后，利兹联队仍在重整旗鼓。

senses.def: an act of licking

examples.zh: 我能尝一口你的冰激凌吗？

senses.def: a small amount of paint, used to make a place look better

examples.en: What this room needs is a lick of paint.
examples.zh: 这房间所需要的是刷点儿涂料。

senses.def: a short piece of music played on a guitar in jazz or pop music
senses.zh: （爵士乐或流行乐中吉他演奏的）小过门

examples.en: a guitar/blues lick
examples.zh: 吉他／布鲁斯小过门

senses.def: a cover over a container that can be removed or opened by turning it or lifting it

examples.en: They use old dustbin lids as drums.
examples.zh: 他们用旧垃圾箱盖当桶。

examples.en: I can't get the lid off this jar.
examples.zh: 我打不开这广口瓶的盖子。

senses.def: either of the pieces of skin above and below the eye that cover it when you blink

examples.en: He was watching her through half-closed lids.
examples.zh: 他正透过半闭的眼睛瞅着她。

senses.def: to become very angry and lose control of what you are saying or doing
senses.zh: 发火；气得丧失自制力；气得发疯

examples.en: She’ll flip her lid when she finds out.
examples.zh: 当她发现时，她会翻开盖子。

examples.en: He struggled to keep the lid on his anger.
examples.zh: 他努力压抑自己的愤怒。
