examples.en: They were stuck in a line of traffic.
examples.zh: 他们塞在汽车长龙里面了。

examples.en: a straight/long line of trees
examples.zh: 排成一条直线的树；一长排树

senses.group: row of people/things 人或物的行列

senses.def: a queue of people

examples.en: A line formed at each teller window.
examples.zh: 银行每个出纳员的窗口前都排起了队。

examples.en: to stand/wait in line
examples.zh: 排队等候

examples.en: If you want a ticket, get in line.
examples.zh: 购票请排队。

examples.en: There's a line for the women's bathroom.
examples.zh: 女厕所要排队。

examples.en: They have to stand in line for groceries.
examples.zh: 他们必须排队购买杂货。

senses.group: row of people/things 人或物的行列

senses.def: a phone connection; a particular phone number

examples.en: The phone lines were jammed (= very busy) with people calling to complain.
examples.zh: 电话被投诉的人打爆了。

examples.en: I tried to call but the line was busy.
examples.zh: 我试图打电话，但占线。

examples.en: I was talking to John when the line suddenly went dead.
examples.zh: 我正和约翰谈话，突然电话断了。

examples.en: Lines are open from 7.30 am until midnight seven days a week.
examples.zh: 线路每周 7 天从早上 7.30 开放至午夜。

examples.en: If you hold the line (= stay on the phone and wait), I'll see if she is available.
examples.zh: 请你不要挂断电话，我去看看她能不能接电话。

examples.en: It's your mother on the line.
examples.zh: 是你妈妈的电话。

examples.en: Your bill includes line rental.
examples.zh: 你的账单包括电话线路的租用费。

senses.def: a railway track or other transport route; a section of a transport system or route
senses.zh: （交通系统的）线；铁路线；（一段）交通线

examples.en: The train was delayed because a tree had fallen across the line.
examples.zh: 火车晚点是因为有一棵树横倒在铁轨上。

examples.en: a rail line
examples.zh: 铁路线

examples.en: a railway line
examples.zh: 铁路线

examples.en: the East Coast line
examples.zh: 东海岸铁路线

examples.en: We got off the bus near the end of the line at San Gerardo.
examples.zh: 我们在靠近终点站的圣杰拉尔多下了大巴车。

examples.en: Various tram lines are currently experiencng severe delays.
examples.zh: 目前，多条有轨电车线路都出现严重延误。

examples.en: We live on the Northern Line.
examples.zh: 我们住在北在线。

senses.def: the direction that somebody/something is moving or located in

examples.en: Just keep going in a straight line.
examples.zh: 继续沿着直线走。

examples.en: The town is in a direct line between London and the coast.
examples.zh: 这个镇在伦敦与海岸之间的直线上。

examples.en: Be careful to stay out of the line of fire (= the direction somebody is shooting in).
examples.zh: 注意待在射击路线以外。

examples.en: They followed the line of the river for three miles.
examples.zh: 他们沿着那条河走了三英里。

senses.def: a route from one place to another especially when it is used for a particular purpose

examples.en: Their aim was to block guerrilla supply lines.
examples.zh: 他们的目的是封锁游击队的供给线。

senses.def: a row of words on a page or the empty space where they can be written; the words of a song or poem or other piece of writing
senses.zh: 一排，一行（文字、空行、歌词、诗等）

examples.en: Look at line 5 of the text.
examples.zh: 看正文第 5 行。

examples.en: Write the title of your essay on the top line.
examples.zh: 把文章的标题写在首行。

examples.en: I can only remember the first two lines of that song.
examples.zh: 我只记得那首歌的头两句歌词。

examples.en: She quoted a few lines of Shakespeare.
examples.zh: 她引用了莎士比亚的几句台词。

examples.en: A team of programmers wrote 200 000 lines of code (= computer programming language).
examples.zh: 有一组程序员写了 200 000 行代码。

examples.en: Avoid a line break (= starting a new line) in the middle of a word.
examples.zh: 避免在单词中间出现换行。

senses.def: the words spoken by an actor in a play or film

examples.en: to learn your lines
examples.zh: 背台词

examples.en: I keep forgetting my lines.
examples.zh: 我总是忘记台词。

examples.en: The way she delivers the line is hilarious.
examples.zh: 她说这句话的方式很搞笑。

examples.en: He quoted a line from the film ‘Casablanca’.
examples.zh: 他引用了电影《卡萨布兰卡》中的一句台词。

examples.en: He delivers his lines in a flat, uninflected way.
examples.zh: 他以一种平淡、不屈折的方式表达他的台词。

examples.en: In a musical, actors often sing their lines.
examples.zh: 在音乐剧中，演员经常演唱台词。

examples.en: In the audition you will be asked to read a few lines.
examples.zh: 在试镜中，您将被要求读几行。

examples.en: She is obviously reading lines from a script.
examples.zh: 她显然正在读剧本中的台词。

examples.en: He read his lines in a monotone.
examples.zh: 他单调地念着台词。

examples.en: The film includes some great lines.
examples.zh: 这部电影有一些很棒的台词。

examples.en: an unoriginal plot enlivened by a few good lines of dialogue
examples.zh: 一些好的对话让非原创的情节变得生动起来

examples.en: That's when he utters the memorable line ‘Frankly, my dear, I don't give a damn.’
examples.zh: 就在那时，他说出了令人难忘的台词“坦白说，亲爱的，我不在乎。”

examples.en: She started coughing in the middle of the line.
examples.zh: 她在队伍中间开始咳嗽。

examples.en: It was a small part with few lines.
examples.zh: 这是一个很小的部分，只有几条线。

examples.en: Actors always want more lines.
examples.zh: 演员总是想要更多的台词。

senses.def: a punishment in which a child has to write out a particular sentence a number of times

examples.en: The teacher gave me 100 lines.
examples.zh: 老师罚我抄写 100 行。

senses.def: a remark, especially when somebody says it to achieve a particular purpose
senses.zh: （尤指为达到某种目的说的）话，言语

examples.en: Don't give me that line about having to work late again.
examples.zh: 别再跟我说不得不工作到很晚这样的话。

examples.en: That's the worst chat-up line I've ever heard.
examples.zh: 我听过的调情的话里没有比这更差劲的了。

senses.def: a long piece of rope, string, etc., especially when it is used for a particular purpose

examples.en: They dropped the sails and threw a line to a man on the dock.
examples.zh: 他们放下风帆，把船缆抛给码头上的人。

examples.en: Towels were hanging on the line (= clothes line).
examples.zh: 毛巾挂在晒衣绳上。

examples.en: He had a fish on his line.
examples.zh: 他的钓线上有一条鱼。

examples.en: 150 feet of nylon line
examples.zh: 150 英尺尼龙线

senses.def: a pipe or thick wire that carries water, gas or electricity from one place to another

examples.en: water/gas/sewage lines
examples.zh: 水管；输气管道；排污管

examples.en: Telephone lines were brought down in the storm.
examples.zh: 电话线被暴风雨吹断了。

examples.en: There were two fuel lines coming into the engine.
examples.zh: 有两条燃料线路接入发动机。

examples.en: The telegraph lines connecting the two cities had been cut.
examples.zh: 连接两个城市的电报线已被切断。

senses.def: an imaginary limit or border between one place or thing and another

examples.en: a district line
examples.zh: 一条区线

examples.en: lines of longitude and latitude
examples.zh: 经线和纬线

examples.en: She drove from her home in Garfield County across the line into Mesa County.
examples.zh: 她从加菲尔德县的家开车穿过线进入梅萨县。

senses.def: the division between one area of thought or behaviour and another or between one group of people and another
senses.zh: （思想、行为或群体之间的）界限，界线

examples.en: Mass consumption blurred the lines of class distinction.
examples.zh: 大众消费模糊了阶层划分。

examples.en: We want to cut across lines of race, sex and religion.
examples.zh: 我们要超越种族、性别和宗教的界限。

examples.en: Music offers a way to cross cultural lines.
examples.zh: 音乐提供了一种跨越文化界限的方式。

examples.en: There is a fine line between informing the public and alarming them.
examples.zh: 让公众知情和令公众惊恐仅一线之隔。

senses.def: an attitude or a belief, especially one that somebody states publicly

examples.en: The company line is that discrimination in any form is not tolerated.
examples.zh: 公司的方针是不容忍任何形式的歧视。

examples.en: He supported the official line on education.
examples.zh: 他支持官方的教育理念。

examples.en: The government is taking a firm line on terrorism.
examples.zh: 政府现在对恐怖主义采取强硬的态度。

senses.def: a method or way of doing or thinking about something

examples.en: His research follows quite different lines.
examples.zh: 他的研究遵循截然不同的路线。

examples.en: I don't follow your line of reasoning.
examples.zh: 我不理解你的推理方法。

examples.en: a line of thought/thinking
examples.zh: 一条思路/思路

examples.en: She decided to try a different line of argument (= way of persuading somebody of something).
examples.zh: 她决定换一种说理方式。

examples.en: somebody’s first line of attack/defence
examples.zh: 某人进行抨击／辩护的第一着

examples.en: The police are pursuing a new line of inquiry (= way of finding out information).
examples.zh: 警方正在实施一种新的调查方法。

senses.def: a series of people, things or events that follow one another in time
senses.zh: 按时间顺序排列的人（或物、事件）；家系；家族

examples.en: to pass something down through the male/female line
examples.zh: 通过父系／母系代代相传某物

examples.en: She came from a long line of doctors.
examples.zh: 她来自一个医生世家。

examples.en: This novel is the latest in a long line of thrillers that he has written.
examples.zh: 这部小说是他写的系列惊险小说中最近出版的一部。

examples.en: That was the first in a whole line of mistakes and bad decisions.
examples.zh: 这是一系列错误和错误决定中的第一个。

examples.en: The book traces a historical line from Beethoven to the present day.
examples.zh: 这本书追溯了从贝多芬至今的历史脉络。

senses.def: a series of people in order of importance
senses.zh: 一系列按重要性排列的人

examples.en: a line of command
examples.zh: 一系列按职务排序的指挥人员

examples.en: There is some benefit to having a clear line of authority.
examples.zh: 拥有明确的权限有一定的好处。

examples.en: Orders came down the line from the very top.
examples.zh: 命令从最高领导人逐级传达下来。

examples.en: He is second in line to the chairman.
examples.zh: 他的地位仅次于主席。

examples.en: to be next in line to the throne
examples.zh: 为王位第一顺位继承人

senses.def: the edge, outline or shape of somebody/something

examples.en: He traced the line of her jaw with his finger.
examples.zh: 他用手指顺着她的下巴外缘抚摸。

examples.en: a beautiful sports car with sleek lines
examples.zh: 线条流畅、美观的跑车

examples.en: I prefer simple lines in skirts and trousers.
examples.zh: 我更喜欢裙子和裤子的简单线条。

senses.def: a system of making something, in which the product moves from one worker to the next until it is finished
a type or area of business, activity or interest

examples.en: My line of work pays pretty well.
examples.zh: 我的职业报酬颇丰厚。

examples.en: What line of business are they in?
examples.zh: 他们从事什么业务？

examples.en: You can't do much in the art line without training.
examples.zh: 没经过训练，你在艺术行业是不会有多大作为的。

senses.def: a type of product

examples.en: Some lines sell better than others.
examples.zh: 有些品种的货物销售得好些，有些则较差。

examples.en: new product lines
examples.zh: 新产品线

examples.en: We are starting a new line in casual clothes.
examples.zh: 我们将着手经营一组新的休闲服系列。

senses.def: a company that provides transport for people or goods

examples.en: a shipping/bus line
examples.zh: 航运／公共汽车公司

examples.en: the White Star Line
examples.zh: 白星线

senses.def: a row or series of military defences where the soldiers are fighting during a war

examples.en: They were trapped behind enemy lines (= in the area controlled by the enemy).
examples.zh: 他们在敌人后方遭到围困。

senses.def: an amount of cocaine
senses.zh: （准备吸用的）散放成一条细线的可卡因

senses.def: connected with the income that a company receives and the costs it has to pay in its daily business, which affect the profit it makes
senses.zh: （公司收入和支出）线上的，经常性的

examples.en: All these costs are above the line and directly hit profits.
examples.zh: 所有这些成本支出都是线上的，直接影响利润。

senses.def: connected with advertising in the mass media

examples.en: They planned an advertising campaign with both above-the-line and social media components.
examples.zh: 他们策划了一场广告活动，包括线上广告和社交媒体广告。

senses.def: at some point during an activity or a process
senses.zh: 在某一环节；在某一时刻

examples.en: Somewhere along the line a large amount of money went missing.
examples.zh: 有一笔巨款在某一环节上不翼而飞。

examples.en: We'll make a decision on that further down the line.
examples.zh: 我们将在以后的阶段对此问题作出决策。

examples.en: The muddle seems to have happened further down the line.
examples.zh: 混乱似乎发生在更远的地方。

senses.def: in the way that is mentioned

examples.en: The new system will operate along the same lines as the old one.
examples.zh: 新系统的运作方式将与旧系统一样。

examples.en: They voted along class lines.
examples.zh: 他们按各社会等级进行投票。

senses.def: similar to the way or thing that is mentioned
senses.zh: 类似于（提及的方式或东西）

examples.en: Those aren't his exact words, but he said something along those lines.
examples.zh: 那些不是他的原话，但他说的大致就是这个意思。

examples.en: The hotel was built along the lines of a French chateau.
examples.zh: 该酒店是按照法国城堡的风格建造的。

senses.def: used to say that people or groups have shown which side they intend to support in an argument or contest that is going to begin
senses.zh: 战线已经划清（指争战之际各拥一方形成对垒之势）

senses.def: to be working or functioning

examples.en: The new working methods will come on line in June.
examples.zh: 新的操作方法将在六月实行。

senses.def: to be in a position where you can be shot at

examples.en: attempts to prevent civilians from being in the firing line
examples.zh: 试图阻止平民进入前线

senses.def: to be in a position where people can criticize or blame you
senses.zh: 处于易受批评（或责备）的地位

examples.en: The employment secretary found himself in the firing line over recent job cuts.
examples.zh: 劳工部长因近期的工作岗位削减而备受责难。

senses.def: connected with unusual costs or income that a company pays or receives, that are not part of its daily business and are taken away or added after calculating profits
senses.zh: （公司收入或支出）线下的，非经常性的

examples.en: There was a £4 million extraordinary charge below the line.
examples.zh: 有一项 400 万英镑的非经常性支出。

senses.def: connected with advertising by means of direct mail, email, social media
senses.zh: （广告）线下的（见于邮寄传单、电子邮件、社交媒体、活动等）

examples.en: We are planning social networking, digital marketing and below-the-line activities across the country.
examples.zh: 我们计划在全国范围内开展社交网络、数字营销和线下活动。

senses.def: connected with a section at the end of an online article or blog post
senses.zh: （线上文章或博客帖子）评论区的

examples.en: There were numerous comments below the line.
examples.zh: 底下有很多评论。

senses.def: to behave or make somebody/something behave in the same way as other people or how they should behave
senses.zh: 使一致；使规范；使符合；（和…）一致

examples.en: The other members of the board must be brought into line.
examples.zh: 必须使董事会的其他成员保持一致。

examples.en: The actions of investors do not always fall into line with financial theory.
examples.zh: 投资者的行动并不总是符合金融理论。

senses.def: to do something that is not considered to be acceptable behaviour

examples.en: He crossed the line by making details of their very private conversation public.
examples.zh: 他把他们私密谈话的细节公之于众，这太过分了。

senses.def: to go to the front of a line of people without waiting for your turn
senses.zh: 插队；加塞儿；不按次序排队

examples.en: Somebody cut in line in front of me.
examples.zh: 有人在我前面插队。

senses.def: to say that something is finished and not worth discussing any more
(to reach) the point at which something can no longer continue in the same way

examples.en: A defeat in the second round marked the end of the line for last year's champion.
examples.zh: 第二局的失利表明去年的冠军得主已卫冕无望。

examples.en: The loss of this contract could signal the end of the line for the shipyard.
examples.zh: 失去这份合同可能意味着这个造船厂的倒闭。

examples.en: This latest disagreement could mean the end of the road for the band.
examples.zh: 最近出现的分歧可能意味着乐队要解散了。

senses.def: strong control or discipline
senses.zh: 牢固控制；严格纪律；铁腕

examples.en: Some children need a firm hand to make them behave.
examples.zh: 有些孩子需要严厉的指导才能让他们表现得规矩。

senses.def: completely

examples.en: What I said was not true, but he fell for it (= believed it) hook, line and sinker.
examples.zh: 我的话并非实话，但他完全相信了。

senses.def: in a position that forms a straight line with something

examples.en: An eclipse happens when the earth and moon are in line with the sun.
examples.zh: 地球和月亮与太阳处在一条直线上就会发生日食或月食。

senses.def: likely to get something

examples.en: She is in line for promotion.
examples.zh: 她有可能得到提升。

senses.def: while doing a job
senses.zh: 在执行任务时；在履行职责时

examples.en: A police officer was injured in the line of duty yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天，一名警察在执行任务时受伤。

senses.def: similar to something or so that one thing is closely connected with another

examples.en: Annual pay increases will be in line with inflation.
examples.zh: 每年加薪幅度将与通货膨胀挂钩。

senses.def: to tell somebody clearly what you think, especially when they will not like what you say

examples.en: The manager laid it on the line—some people would have to lose their jobs.
examples.zh: 经理开门见山地说，有些人将要失去工作。

senses.def: (to establish) a clear limit to what you will do or accept

examples.en: It’s time to draw a line in the sand and stop allowing workplace bullying to continue.
examples.zh: 是时候划清界限，停止让职场欺凌行为继续存在了。

senses.def: (to choose, etc.) the easiest way of doing something
at risk

examples.en: If we don't make a profit, my job is on the line.
examples.zh: 我们要是赚不了钱，我就有失业的危险。

senses.def: not forming a straight line
different from something
senses.zh: 与…不同（或不一致）；不符合

examples.en: London prices are way out of line with the rest of the country.
examples.zh: 伦敦的物价与英国其他地方的有很大的差异。

senses.def: behaving in a way that is not acceptable or right
senses.zh: 行为不当；举止令人难以接受

senses.def: to behave in a way that people think is not acceptable

examples.en: She realized she had overstepped the mark and quickly apologized.
examples.zh: 她意识到自己已经逾越了界限，并迅速道歉。

senses.def: to tell somebody a story or make an excuse that is not true
to look for or discover a meaning in something that is not openly stated
senses.zh: 领悟隐含的意义；看出言外之意

examples.en: Reading between the lines, I think Clare needs money.
examples.zh: 斟酌一下她的言外之意，我觉得克莱尔需要钱。

senses.def: to sign a document to show that you have agreed to buy something or do something
senses.zh: 在签字处签上姓名（表示同意）；签名同意

examples.en: Just sign on the dotted line and the car is yours.
examples.zh: 只要在虚线上签名，这车就归你了。

senses.def: to behave badly or break the rules
senses.zh: 表现不好；不守规矩；越轨；出格

examples.en: His boss warned him that if he stepped out of line once more he would be fired.
examples.zh: 他的老板警告他，如果他再次越界，他将被解雇。

senses.def: to say or do what somebody in authority tells you to say or do, even if you do not share the same opinions, etc.
senses.zh: 顺从当局（或集体）；遵循…路线

examples.en: One or two of them refused to toe the line.
examples.zh: 其中一两个人不遵守规矩。

examples.en: MPs rarely fail to toe the party line.
examples.zh: 议员们很少不遵循党的路线。

senses.def: to be in a difficult or dangerous situation where you could easily make a mistake
senses.zh: 处于困境（或险境）；如履薄冰；走钢丝

examples.en: He was walking a fine line between being funny and being rude.
examples.zh: 他想滑稽而不粗鲁，难以把握分寸。

examples.en: She often seems to tread a thin line between success and failure.
examples.zh: 她似乎经常在成功与失败之间徘徊。

senses.def: to cover the inside of something with a layer of another material, especially to keep it clean or make it stronger

examples.en: Butter and line a 25 cm cake tin.
examples.zh: 在 25 厘米的蛋糕罐中涂上黄油并铺上衬里。

examples.en: Line the pan with greaseproof paper.
examples.zh: 在烤盘里垫一层防油纸。

examples.en: a coat lined with silk
examples.zh: 有绸子里的外衣

senses.def: to form a layer on the inside of something

examples.en: the membranes that line the nose
examples.zh: 在鼻腔里形成的一层内膜

examples.en: White tiles line the walls.
examples.zh: 墙壁上铺着白色瓷砖。

senses.def: to form lines or rows along something

examples.en: Crowds lined the streets to watch the race.
examples.zh: 人群站在街道两旁观看比赛。

examples.en: Trees line the road on both sides.
examples.zh: 道路两旁种满了树木。

examples.en: Jars line the shelves.
examples.zh: 架子上摆满了罐子。

examples.en: The walls were lined with books.
examples.zh: 靠墙是一排排的图书。

senses.def: to get richer or make somebody richer, especially by taking unfair advantage of a situation or by being dishonest
senses.zh: （尤指通过占便宜或欺诈而）中饱私囊，（使）发财

examples.en: Health services are lining the drug companies’ pockets, according to the report.
examples.zh: 报告称，医疗服务正在让制药公司中饱私囊。

senses.def: connected with the income that a company receives and the costs it has to pay in its daily business, which affect the profit it makes
senses.zh: （公司收入和支出）线上的，经常性的

examples.en: All these costs are above the line and directly hit profits.
examples.zh: 所有这些成本支出都是线上的，直接影响利润。

senses.def: connected with advertising in the mass media

examples.en: They planned an advertising campaign with both above-the-line and social media components.
examples.zh: 他们策划了一场广告活动，包括线上广告和社交媒体广告。

senses.def: at some point during an activity or a process
senses.zh: 在某一环节；在某一时刻

examples.en: Somewhere along the line a large amount of money went missing.
examples.zh: 有一笔巨款在某一环节上不翼而飞。

examples.en: We'll make a decision on that further down the line.
examples.zh: 我们将在以后的阶段对此问题作出决策。

examples.en: The muddle seems to have happened further down the line.
examples.zh: 混乱似乎发生在更远的地方。

senses.def: in the way that is mentioned

examples.en: The new system will operate along the same lines as the old one.
examples.zh: 新系统的运作方式将与旧系统一样。

examples.en: They voted along class lines.
examples.zh: 他们按各社会等级进行投票。

senses.def: similar to the way or thing that is mentioned
senses.zh: 类似于（提及的方式或东西）

examples.en: Those aren't his exact words, but he said something along those lines.
examples.zh: 那些不是他的原话，但他说的大致就是这个意思。

examples.en: The hotel was built along the lines of a French chateau.
examples.zh: 该酒店是按照法国城堡的风格建造的。

senses.def: used to say that people or groups have shown which side they intend to support in an argument or contest that is going to begin
senses.zh: 战线已经划清（指争战之际各拥一方形成对垒之势）

senses.def: to be working or functioning

examples.en: The new working methods will come on line in June.
examples.zh: 新的操作方法将在六月实行。

senses.def: to be in a position where you can be shot at

examples.en: attempts to prevent civilians from being in the firing line
examples.zh: 试图阻止平民进入前线

senses.def: to be in a position where people can criticize or blame you
senses.zh: 处于易受批评（或责备）的地位

examples.en: The employment secretary found himself in the firing line over recent job cuts.
examples.zh: 劳工部长因近期的工作岗位削减而备受责难。

senses.def: connected with unusual costs or income that a company pays or receives, that are not part of its daily business and are taken away or added after calculating profits
senses.zh: （公司收入或支出）线下的，非经常性的

examples.en: There was a £4 million extraordinary charge below the line.
examples.zh: 有一项 400 万英镑的非经常性支出。

senses.def: connected with advertising by means of direct mail, email, social media
senses.zh: （广告）线下的（见于邮寄传单、电子邮件、社交媒体、活动等）

examples.en: We are planning social networking, digital marketing and below-the-line activities across the country.
examples.zh: 我们计划在全国范围内开展社交网络、数字营销和线下活动。

senses.def: connected with a section at the end of an online article or blog post
senses.zh: （线上文章或博客帖子）评论区的

examples.en: There were numerous comments below the line.
examples.zh: 底下有很多评论。

items.idm: bring somebody/something, come, get, fall, etc. into line (with somebody/something)

senses.def: to behave or make somebody/something behave in the same way as other people or how they should behave
senses.zh: 使一致；使规范；使符合；（和…）一致

examples.en: The other members of the board must be brought into line.
examples.zh: 必须使董事会的其他成员保持一致。

examples.en: The actions of investors do not always fall into line with financial theory.
examples.zh: 投资者的行动并不总是符合金融理论。

senses.def: to do something that is not considered to be acceptable behaviour

examples.en: He crossed the line by making details of their very private conversation public.
examples.zh: 他把他们私密谈话的细节公之于众，这太过分了。

senses.def: to go to the front of a line of people without waiting for your turn
senses.zh: 插队；加塞儿；不按次序排队

examples.en: Somebody cut in line in front of me.
examples.zh: 有人在我前面插队。

senses.def: to say that something is finished and not worth discussing any more
(to reach) the point at which something can no longer continue in the same way

examples.en: A defeat in the second round marked the end of the line for last year's champion.
examples.zh: 第二局的失利表明去年的冠军得主已卫冕无望。

examples.en: The loss of this contract could signal the end of the line for the shipyard.
examples.zh: 失去这份合同可能意味着这个造船厂的倒闭。

examples.en: This latest disagreement could mean the end of the road for the band.
examples.zh: 最近出现的分歧可能意味着乐队要解散了。

senses.def: strong control or discipline
senses.zh: 牢固控制；严格纪律；铁腕

examples.en: Some children need a firm hand to make them behave.
examples.zh: 有些孩子需要严厉的指导才能让他们表现得规矩。

senses.def: completely

examples.en: What I said was not true, but he fell for it (= believed it) hook, line and sinker.
examples.zh: 我的话并非实话，但他完全相信了。

senses.def: in a position that forms a straight line with something

examples.en: An eclipse happens when the earth and moon are in line with the sun.
examples.zh: 地球和月亮与太阳处在一条直线上就会发生日食或月食。

senses.def: likely to get something

examples.en: She is in line for promotion.
examples.zh: 她有可能得到提升。

senses.def: while doing a job
senses.zh: 在执行任务时；在履行职责时

examples.en: A police officer was injured in the line of duty yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天，一名警察在执行任务时受伤。

senses.def: similar to something or so that one thing is closely connected with another

examples.en: Annual pay increases will be in line with inflation.
examples.zh: 每年加薪幅度将与通货膨胀挂钩。

senses.def: to tell somebody clearly what you think, especially when they will not like what you say

examples.en: The manager laid it on the line—some people would have to lose their jobs.
examples.zh: 经理开门见山地说，有些人将要失去工作。

senses.def: (to establish) a clear limit to what you will do or accept

examples.en: It’s time to draw a line in the sand and stop allowing workplace bullying to continue.
examples.zh: 是时候划清界限，停止让职场欺凌行为继续存在了。

items.idm: (choose, follow, take, etc.) the line/path of least resistance

senses.def: (to choose, etc.) the easiest way of doing something
at risk

examples.en: If we don't make a profit, my job is on the line.
examples.zh: 我们要是赚不了钱，我就有失业的危险。

senses.def: not forming a straight line
different from something
senses.zh: 与…不同（或不一致）；不符合

examples.en: London prices are way out of line with the rest of the country.
examples.zh: 伦敦的物价与英国其他地方的有很大的差异。

senses.def: behaving in a way that is not acceptable or right
senses.zh: 行为不当；举止令人难以接受

senses.def: to behave in a way that people think is not acceptable

examples.en: She realized she had overstepped the mark and quickly apologized.
examples.zh: 她意识到自己已经逾越了界限，并迅速道歉。

senses.def: to tell somebody a story or make an excuse that is not true
to look for or discover a meaning in something that is not openly stated
senses.zh: 领悟隐含的意义；看出言外之意

examples.en: Reading between the lines, I think Clare needs money.
examples.zh: 斟酌一下她的言外之意，我觉得克莱尔需要钱。

senses.def: to sign a document to show that you have agreed to buy something or do something
senses.zh: 在签字处签上姓名（表示同意）；签名同意

examples.en: Just sign on the dotted line and the car is yours.
examples.zh: 只要在虚线上签名，这车就归你了。

items.idm: step out of line | be/get out of line

senses.def: to behave badly or break the rules
senses.zh: 表现不好；不守规矩；越轨；出格

examples.en: His boss warned him that if he stepped out of line once more he would be fired.
examples.zh: 他的老板警告他，如果他再次越界，他将被解雇。

senses.def: to say or do what somebody in authority tells you to say or do, even if you do not share the same opinions, etc.
senses.zh: 顺从当局（或集体）；遵循…路线

examples.en: One or two of them refused to toe the line.
examples.zh: 其中一两个人不遵守规矩。

examples.en: MPs rarely fail to toe the party line.
examples.zh: 议员们很少不遵循党的路线。

items.idm: walk/tread a fine/thin line (between A and B)

senses.def: to be in a difficult or dangerous situation where you could easily make a mistake
senses.zh: 处于困境（或险境）；如履薄冰；走钢丝

examples.en: He was walking a fine line between being funny and being rude.
examples.zh: 他想滑稽而不粗鲁，难以把握分寸。

examples.en: She often seems to tread a thin line between success and failure.
examples.zh: 她似乎经常在成功与失败之间徘徊。

senses.def: to get richer or make somebody richer, especially by taking unfair advantage of a situation or by being dishonest
senses.zh: （尤指通过占便宜或欺诈而）中饱私囊，（使）发财

examples.en: Health services are lining the drug companies’ pockets, according to the report.
examples.zh: 报告称，医疗服务正在让制药公司中饱私囊。

senses.def: to get richer or make somebody richer, especially by taking unfair advantage of a situation or by being dishonest
senses.zh: （尤指通过占便宜或欺诈而）中饱私囊，（使）发财

examples.en: Health services are lining the drug companies’ pockets, according to the report.
examples.zh: 报告称，医疗服务正在让制药公司中饱私囊。

senses.def: caught with a line and hook

examples.en: We sell only line-caught wild fish.
examples.zh: 我们只卖钓来的野生鱼。

examples.en: line-caught fish from sustainable waters
examples.zh: 从可持续水域捕获的鱼

senses.def: a type of dancing in which people stand in a line without partners and do the same steps together, especially to country music

examples.en: She does line dancing and yoga in the evenings.
examples.zh: 晚上她跳队列舞，做瑜伽。

senses.def: a drawing that consists only of lines
a powerful hit in a straight line near to the ground
senses.zh: 平直球，平飞球（贴近地面猛力击打的直线球）

senses.def: a diagram that shows the relationship between the measurements of two things as points that are joined together by lines

examples.en: The line graph shows changes in individual patients over time.
examples.zh: 这个折线图显示了单个患者随时间的变化。

senses.def: a piece of information that appears on a separate line in an organization’s written accounts
senses.zh: 行项目（书面账目中单列一行的信息）

examples.en: There is an expense line item for $4 160 for hotel accommodation.
examples.zh: 有一项支出明细为 4 160 美元的酒店住宿费用。

senses.def: the power of a president or governor
senses.zh: 单项否决权，部分条款否决权（美国总统或州长有权否决法案的某部分条文，而其他部分则可以通过）

examples.en: He used a line-item veto to eliminate a $1 million increase to the California Arts Council.
examples.zh: 他使用单项否决权取消了向加州艺术委员会增加 100 万美元的资金。

senses.def: an official who helps the umpire

examples.en: The pass was ruled incomplete by the line judge.
examples.zh: 边裁判定这个传球未完成。

senses.def: the system of organizing a company, etc. in which information and instructions are passed from each manager to the person one rank below them
senses.zh: （公司等的）分级管理制，线性管理

senses.def: a person who is one rank above somebody in a company and who is responsible for passing information and instructions to them
senses.zh: 直属经理：比公司中的职员高一等的人，负责向他们传递信息和指示

examples.en: Review your training needs with your line manager.
examples.zh: 和你的顶头上司检视一下你的培训需求。

senses.def: an amount of money that a financial organization such as a bank is willing to lend to a person or organization

examples.en: to open/secure a line of credit
examples.zh: 开立/确保信用额度

examples.en: The studio also refinanced a loan agreement with the bank to extend its line of credit to $450 million.
examples.zh: 该工作室还为与银行的贷款协议进行了再融资，将其信贷额度扩大至 4.5 亿美元。

senses.def: an imaginary line around the earth that is always the same distance from the equator
one of the lines that is drawn from the North Pole to the South Pole on a map of the world
the imaginary line separating the two teams, where the football is placed at the beginning of each play
senses.zh: 争球线：将两支球队分开的假想线，橄榄球在每场比赛的开始位置

examples.en: I noticed we were eight yards back from the line of scrimmage instead of seven.
examples.zh: 我注意到我们距离争球线有八码，而不是七码。

senses.def: an imaginary line that goes from somebody’s eye to something that they are looking at

examples.en: There was a column directly in my line of sight, so I could only see half the stage.
examples.zh: 有一根柱子正挡着我的视线，所以我只能看见舞台的一半。

senses.def: a situation that happens when the ball goes out of play, when players from each team stand in opposite lines and jump to try to catch the ball when it is thrown back in
senses.zh: （球出界后再抛球入场时的）争边球

senses.def: a machine that prints very quickly, producing a complete line of print at a time
to stand in a line or row; to form a queue
senses.zh: 排成一行；站队；排队（等候）

examples.en: Line up, children!
examples.zh: 孩子们，站成一排！

examples.en: Cars lined up waiting to board the ship.
examples.zh: 汽车排队等候上船。

senses.def: to arrange people or things in a straight line or row
senses.zh: 使站成一队；使排列成一行

examples.en: The suspects were lined up against the wall.
examples.zh: 嫌疑犯靠墙站成了一排。

examples.en: He lined the bottles up along the shelf.
examples.zh: 他把瓶子排列在架子上。

senses.def: to arrange for an event or activity to happen, or arrange for somebody to be available to do something
senses.zh: 组织，安排（活动）；邀集（人做某事）

examples.en: Mark had a job lined up when he left college.
examples.zh: 马克大学毕业时，工作已经安排好了。

examples.en: I've got a lot lined up this week (= I'm very busy).
examples.zh: 我这周有许多事要做。

examples.en: She's lined up a live band for the party.
examples.zh: 她为聚会安排了一个乐队来现场演奏。

senses.def: to move one thing into a correct position in relation to another thing
senses.zh: 使…（与相关的另一物）排齐；使…对齐

examples.en: To get good TV reception, the dish must be accurately lined up with the satellite.
examples.zh: 为了获得良好的电视接收效果，碟形天线必须与卫星精确对准。

senses.def: the people who are going to take part in a particular event

examples.en: an impressive line-up of speakers
examples.zh: 给人印象深刻的演讲者阵容

examples.en: Jones has not been included in the quarter-final line-up.
examples.zh: 琼斯没有进入四分之一决赛阵容。

examples.en: the starting line-up (= the players who will begin the game)
examples.zh: 比赛首发队员阵容

examples.en: The team returns this season with a new car and a new line-up of drivers.
examples.zh: 代表队以新的赛车和车手阵容重返本赛季。

senses.def: a set of items, events etc. arranged to follow one another

examples.en: A horror movie completes this evening's TV line-up.
examples.zh: 今晚电视节目最后安排了一部恐怖影片。

senses.def: a row of people, including one person who is suspected of a crime, who are shown to a witness to see if they can recognize the suspect
senses.zh: 辨认行列，列队认人（把嫌疑犯同其他人排在一起，让目击者辨认）

examples.en: He was identified in an April 21 police line-up.
examples.zh: 4 月 21 日，他在警察队伍中被认出。

senses.def: the series of families that somebody comes from originally

examples.en: a French nobleman of ancient lineage
examples.zh: 出身于古老世家的法国贵族

senses.def: coming in a direct line from an earlier or later generation of the same family as somebody

examples.en: a lineal descendant of the company’s founder
examples.zh: 公司创始人的直系后裔

senses.def: the typical features of something

examples.en: Her actions were marked with the lineaments of her character.
examples.zh: 她的一举一动都体现了她的性格特征。

senses.def: of or in lines

examples.en: In his art he broke the laws of scientific linear perspective.
examples.zh: 他在自己的绘画艺术中打破了科学的直线透视法规律。

senses.def: going from one thing to another in a single series of stages

examples.en: Students do not always progress in a linear fashion.
examples.zh: 学生的进步不会总是直线式的。

examples.en: The author abandons the conventions of linear narrative and normal chronology.
examples.zh: 作者放弃了线性叙事和正常时间顺序的惯例。

senses.def: of length

examples.en: linear measurement (= for example metres, feet, etc.)
examples.zh: 长度测量

senses.def: able to be represented by a straight line on a graph

examples.en: linear equations
examples.zh: 线性方程

senses.def: broadcast and watched at regular times according to a schedule
senses.zh: 线性的，依计划按时播出的

examples.en: People are watching linear TV much less these days, preferring on-demand platforms like Netflix.
examples.zh: 如今人们很少收看按时播放的电视节目，他们更喜欢像网飞这样的点播平台。

examples.en: the simplicity of traditional linear channel programming
examples.zh: 传统线性通道编程的简单性

senses.def: the later of two early forms of writing found on stones in Crete
senses.zh: （希腊克里特岛上发现的）线形文字乙

senses.def: the fact that something consists of or is arranged in lines
senses.zh: 线性：由线组成或排列成线

examples.en: the linearity of the building design
examples.zh: 建筑设计的线性度

senses.def: the fact that something goes from one thing to another in a single series of stages

examples.en: She abandoned the linearity of the conventional novel.
examples.zh: 她摒弃了传统小说的线性叙事模式。

senses.def: the fact that something can be represented by a straight line on a graph
in a line or in lines

examples.en: The house is a long structure, with rooms linearly arranged.
examples.zh: 房子呈长条状，房间呈直线排列。

senses.def: in a way that involves going from one thing to another in a single series of stages

examples.en: The complex narrative structure has a deeper impact than if the story were told linearly.
examples.zh: 复杂的叙事结构比线性讲述的故事具有更深远的影响。

senses.def: in a way that can be represented by a straight line on a graph

examples.en: Temperatures increased linearly as depths increased.
examples.zh: 温度随着深度的增加而线性增加。

senses.def: a defensive
a player in the front line of an American football
a person whose job is to repair phone or electricity power lines
senses.zh: （修理电话线或电线的）架线工，线务员

senses.def: a type of cloth made from flax

examples.en: a linen tablecloth
examples.zh: 亚麻桌布

examples.en: a fine linen shirt
examples.zh: 精纺亚麻布衬衫

senses.def: sheets, tablecloths

examples.en: a linen cupboard
examples.zh: 家庭日用织品壁橱

examples.en: a linen closet
examples.zh: 家庭日用织品壁橱

examples.en: I've put fresh linen on the bed.
examples.zh: 我已经在床上铺上了新的床单。

senses.def: to discuss your personal affairs in public, especially something embarrassing
senses.zh: 公开谈论个人的事；（尤指）家丑外扬

items.idm: air/wash your dirty laundry/linen in public

senses.def: to discuss your personal affairs in public, especially something embarrassing
senses.zh: 公开谈论个人的事；（尤指）家丑外扬

senses.def: a large ship that carries passengers

examples.en: an ocean liner
examples.zh: 远洋客轮

examples.en: He got a job on a luxury cruise liner.
examples.zh: 他在一艘豪华游轮上找到了一份工作。

senses.def: a piece of material used to cover the inside surface of something

examples.en: nappy liners
examples.zh: 尿布衬垫

senses.def: make-up
information about the music or the performers that comes with a CD or DVD or is printed on the cover of a record
senses.zh: （唱片或光盘的）封套内容简介

senses.def: an official who helps the referee
senses.zh: （足球等比赛中的）边线裁判员，巡边员，司线员

senses.def: a person whose job is to repair phone or electricity power lines
senses.zh: （修理电话线或电线的）架线工，线务员

senses.def: a female official who helps the referee
senses.zh: （足球等比赛中的）女边线裁判员，女巡边员，女司线员

senses.def: a low-growing plant that is a type of heather
senses.zh: 欧石楠（低矮灌木，生长在荒野里）

senses.def: small; not important

examples.en: duckling
examples.zh: 小鸭

examples.en: princeling
examples.zh: 小国的国君

senses.def: to continue to exist for longer than expected

examples.zh: 房间里仍飘溢着她那淡淡的香水味。

examples.zh: 这次内战到 20 世纪 30 年代还拖了好几年。

examples.zh: 她多待了几分钟，想跟尼克谈一谈。

examples.en: We lingered over breakfast on the terrace.
examples.zh: 我们在平台上慢条斯理地吃着早餐。

examples.en: His eyes lingered on the diamond ring on her finger.
examples.zh: 他一直注视着她手指上的钻戒。

examples.zh: 他心脏病发作后又拖了几个月才去世。

examples.zh: 我吃了虾扁面条。

senses.def: a connection between two or more people or things

examples.en: Police suspect there may be a link between the two murders.
examples.zh: 警方怀疑那两桩凶杀案可能有关联。

examples.en: There is evidence for a strong causal link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.
examples.zh: 有证据表明，曝晒与患上皮肤癌大有关联。

examples.en: to establish/find a link
examples.zh: 建立联系；找到关联

examples.en: These photographs are a direct link with the past.
examples.zh: 这些照片与过去有着直接的联系。

examples.en: Many of them had no previous links to terrorism.
examples.zh: 他们中的许多人以前与恐怖主义没有任何联系。

senses.def: a relationship between two or more people, countries or organizations

examples.en: to establish trade links with Asia
examples.zh: 与亚洲建立贸易关系

examples.en: Producers are forging direct links with consumers.
examples.zh: 生产者正在与消费者建立直接联系。

examples.en: The department tries to maintain close links with industry.
examples.zh: 该部门努力与产业界保持密切联系。

examples.en: Social workers provide a vital link between hospital and community.
examples.zh: 社会工作者是医院和社区之间的重要联系环节。

examples.zh: 该协议将加强两国之间的联系。

senses.def: a means of travelling or communicating between two places

examples.zh: 高速的铁路交通

examples.en: a video link
examples.zh: 视频线路

examples.en: The canal was an important transport link between England and Wales.
examples.zh: 这条运河是连接英格兰和威尔士的重要交通干线。

examples.zh: 驾驶员通过无线电链路与总部联系。

examples.en: We're trying to establish a link via satellite.
examples.zh: 我们正试图通过卫星建立联系。

examples.en: The speech was broadcast via a satellite link.
examples.zh: 这次演讲是通过卫星播放的。

senses.def: a place in an electronic document that is connected to another electronic document or to another part of the same document

examples.en: You can find all the details by clicking this link.
examples.zh: 点击此链接可找到所有详细信息。

examples.en: Follow the links to watch our exclusive trailer.
examples.zh: 点击链接观看我们的独家预告片。

examples.en: I've posted a link to the article, for those who are interested.
examples.zh: 我附上了文章的链接，提供给感兴趣的人。

examples.zh: 链子太长，所以我取下了几个环。

senses.def: a chain of long thin sausages

examples.en: You need four Italian sausage links.
examples.zh: 你需要四个意大利香肠串。

senses.def: one of the stages in a process or a line of argument
senses.zh: 链条中的一个环节；整个过程中的一个阶段

examples.en: Food production, processing and marketing are different links in the chain from farmer to consumer.
examples.zh: 食品生产、加工和销售是从农民到消费者的链条中的不同环节。

examples.en: Death is the last link in the chain.
examples.zh: 死亡是链条中的最后一环。

senses.def: the point at which a system or an organization is most likely to fail

examples.en: She went straight for the one weak link in the chain of his argument.
examples.zh: 她迳直攻击他的论点中的一个薄弱环节。

senses.def: to make a physical or electronic connection between one object, machine, place, etc. and another
senses.zh: 把（物体、机器、地方等）连接起来

examples.en: The video cameras are linked to a powerful computer.
examples.zh: 这些摄像机是与一台功能强大的计算机相连接的。

examples.en: The Channel Tunnel links Britain with the rest of Europe.
examples.zh: 英吉利海峡隧道把英国和欧洲其他国家连接起来了。

examples.en: A pedestrian bridge links the two buildings.
examples.zh: 一座人行桥把这两座建筑物连接起来。

examples.en: When computers are networked, they are linked together so that information can be transferred between them.
examples.zh: 计算机联网连接，即彼此可互传信息。

examples.en: The computers are linked into a network.
examples.zh: 这些计算机是联网的。

senses.def: if something links

examples.zh: 这两个因素直接联系在一起。

examples.en: The personal and social development of the child are inextricably linked (= they depend on each other).
examples.zh: 儿童在自身和与人交往两方面的成长是相辅相成的。

examples.zh: 紧密地/紧密地联系在一起

examples.en: Exposure to ultraviolet light is closely linked to skin cancer.
examples.zh: 受紫外线照射与皮肤癌紧密相关。

examples.en: Unemployment is consistently linked with a variety of negative health effects.
examples.zh: 失业总是与各种各样的负面健康效应有关联。

examples.en: There was no evidence linking the men to the crime.
examples.zh: 没有证据表明这些人与罪案有关。

examples.en: What links Jane Austen and Oscar Wilde (= what is the connection between them)?
examples.zh: 简·奥斯汀和奥斯卡·王尔德之间有什么联系？

examples.zh: 我只关联与食物有关的帖子。

examples.zh: 我想将我的博客链接到您的网站。

examples.zh: 谢谢你关联到我的文章。

examples.zh: 侦探认为这起入室盗窃案与去年此地区一类似案件有关。

examples.zh: 报章报道把他的名字与那名歌手连在一起。

examples.zh: 两个女孩挽着胳臂沿街漫步而行。

examples.zh: 食品生产、加工和销售是从农民到消费者的链条中的不同环节。

examples.en: Death is the last link in the chain.

senses.def: the point at which a system or an organization is most likely to fail

examples.en: She went straight for the one weak link in the chain of his argument.
examples.zh: 她迳直攻击他的论点中的一个薄弱环节。

examples.zh: 首都和第二大城市之间没有像样的公路连接。

examples.en: They are planning to build a link road between Mill Road and London Road to ease congestion.
examples.zh: 他们计划在磨坊路和伦敦路之间建一条连接道路，以缓解拥堵。

examples.zh: 你需要四根意大利香肠。

senses.zh: 链接诱饵（旨在尽可能多地吸引人点击和创建链接的内容，借此提高自身网站在搜索引擎的搜索排名）

examples.zh: 为了推广他的网站，他创建了链接诱饵。

senses.zh: 莱纳斯·鲍林（Linus Pauling）：（1901-94）是一位美国科学家，因发现化学物质如何结合而获得1954年诺贝尔奖。他以反对核武器试验和销毁所有此类武器的运动而闻名。为此，他获得了1962年诺贝尔和平奖。他还认为，人们应该服用大量的维生素C来预防感冒和其他疾病。

examples.zh: 过去两个月，已有13头狮子被偷猎者杀害。

examples.zh: 那女助手噘起了嘴。

examples.zh: 你的上／下嘴唇

senses.zh: 小红帽：在许多欧洲国家中都有一个传统的故事。一个叫小红帽的女孩去森林里看望祖母，但是当她到达时，狼吃掉了祖母，穿上了衣服。小红帽（Little Red Riding Hood）对祖母的外观感到惊讶，并说：“祖母，你有多大眼睛！” 狼答道：“最好和你见面。” “祖母，你有多大的牙齿！” 女孩说。“最好和你一起吃饭，”狼回答，然后吃掉了她。猎人割开狼的胃，他们逃脱了，小红帽和她的祖母被救了出来。

senses.zh: 小石城（美国阿肯色州首府和最大城市）

senses.def: a very popular US book (1868-9) written mainly for girls by Louisa May Alcott
senses.zh: 小女人：美国非常流行的一本书（1868-9），主要由露易莎·梅·奥尔科特（Louisa May Alcott）为女孩撰写。这个故事基于她自己的家庭，讲述的是三月的四姐妹家庭，他们生活在19世纪的新英格兰。女孩是梅格，乔，贝丝和艾米。电影版本是1933年与凯瑟琳·赫本（Katharine Hepburn），1949年与伊丽莎白·泰勒（Elizabeth Taylor）以及1994年与Winona Ryder制作的。奥尔科特再写了两本相同的人物：《小矮人》（Little Men，1871年）和《乔的男孩》（Jo's Boys，1886年）。

senses.def: used when you are saying that something is almost true, or is equal to something

examples.en: Last year's figures were little short of disastrous.
examples.zh: 去年的数字简直是灾难。

examples.en: The transformation has been nothing short of a miracle.
examples.zh: 这种转化堪称奇迹。

senses.def: the fact of being not important or not powerful

examples.zh: 我们意识到自己在事物计划中的渺小。

examples.en: the littleness of his mind
examples.zh: 他思想的渺小

senses.def: the quality of being small or smaller than others

examples.en: the littleness of her hands and feet
examples.zh: 她的手和脚很小

senses.def: a company that used to own department stores

senses.def: a former name for a type of gambling
senses.zh: Littlewoods池：以前根据足球比赛的结果进行赌博的名称。Littlewoods Pools最早于1923年成立，并于2007年与另外两家公司一起成立了The Football Pools。

examples.zh: 沿海各州

senses.def: the part of a country that is near the coast

examples.zh: 亨利八世下令，教堂礼拜时要用英语祈祷书代替原先的拉丁文祈祷书。

examples.zh: 这个地方看起来很适合居住。

senses.def: worth living

examples.zh: 我们过去住在伦敦。

examples.en: people living in rural areas
examples.zh: 农村居民

examples.zh: 我们生活在一个技术进步已成为常态的世界。

examples.zh: 她需要找个住的地方。

examples.zh: 这是一个非常好的住处。

examples.en: Both her children still live at home.

examples.zh: 他在那里生活和工作直至 2015 年去世。

senses.def: to remain alive

examples.zh: 医生说他只能活六个月了。

examples.en: Spiders can live for several days without food.
examples.zh: 蜘蛛几天不吃食依然可存活。

examples.en: Women live longer than men in general.
examples.zh: 女性一般比男性长寿。

examples.en: Who wants to live forever? I don't.
examples.zh: 谁想长生？反正我不想。

examples.en: She lived to see her first grandchild.
examples.zh: 她一直活到抱上第一个孙子。

examples.en: He lived to the age of 95.
examples.zh: 他活到了95岁。

examples.en: I shall remember this day for as long as I live.
examples.zh: 我有生之年永远不会忘记这一天。

examples.en: I absolutely could not live without my phone!
examples.zh: 没有手机我绝对活不下去！

examples.zh: 亨德尔是什么时期的人？

examples.en: Luther lived at a time when the Bible was only available in Latin.
examples.zh: 路德生活在圣经只有拉丁文版本的时代。

examples.en: He's the greatest player who ever lived.
examples.zh: 他是史上最出色的运动员。

senses.def: to spend your life in a particular way

examples.en: He lived in poverty most of his life.
examples.zh: 他大半辈子过的都是穷日子。

examples.en: to live in fear/peace/harmony
examples.zh: 生活在恐惧/和平/和谐中

examples.en: Most of the people live well, with nice houses and plenty to eat.
examples.zh: 大多数人生活很好，有不错的住房，食物充足。

examples.en: She lived a very peaceful life.
examples.zh: 她过着十分宁静的生活。

examples.en: They lived their lives to the full.
examples.zh: 他们过着充实的生活。

examples.en: She lived and died a single woman.
examples.zh: 她过了一辈子的独身生活。

examples.en: He was living quietly with his family.
examples.zh: 他和家人过着宁静的生活。

examples.en: All she wanted was to get married and live happily ever after.
examples.zh: 她所期望的就是结婚，然后幸福地生活。

examples.en: He's now living a life of luxury in Australia.
examples.zh: 他目前在澳大利亚过着奢华的生活。

examples.en: She tried to live vicariously through her children.
examples.zh: 她试图和自己的孩子同喜同悲。

examples.en: They lived frugally off a diet of beans and lentils.
examples.zh: 他们生活节俭，只吃豆子和小扁豆。

examples.en: They'll have enough money to live comfortably.
examples.zh: 他们会有足够的钱过舒适的生活。

examples.en: Tonight she felt like living dangerously.
examples.zh: 今晚她想冒冒险。

examples.en: the need to live as harmoniously as possible with everyone else
examples.zh: 与每个人尽可能和睦相处的必要

senses.group: type of life 生活方式

senses.def: to continue to exist or be remembered

examples.en: This moment will live in our memory for many years to come.
examples.zh: 这一时刻将在我们的记忆中留存许多年。

examples.en: Her words have lived with me all my life.
examples.zh: 她的话我一辈子都铭记着。

senses.def: to have a full and exciting life
senses.zh: 享受充实而令人兴奋的生活

examples.en: I don't want to be stuck in an office all my life—I want to live!
examples.zh: 我不想一辈子都憋在办公室里，我要享受人生乐趣！

senses.def: to have enough money to be able to live a very comfortable life
if two people are or live in each other’s pockets
to still be alive after the time when you were expected to die

examples.en: He’s been living on borrowed time ever since his last heart attack.
examples.zh: 自从上次心脏病发作以来，他一直过着借来的时光。

senses.def: to be doing something that other people are likely to soon stop you from doing
senses.zh: 做很快就会遭到制止的事；好景不长

examples.en: According to the latest opinion polls, the government is living on borrowed time.
examples.zh: 根据最新的民意调查，政府的生存时间是借来的。

senses.def: the way of life of a different social group, especially one much richer than you
senses.zh: 另一类人的生活方式（尤指比自己富有得多的人）

senses.def: to live a happy and comfortable life with no problems or responsibilities
senses.zh: 无忧无虑地生活；安逸地生活；舒适愉快地生活

examples.en: The two crooks had been living the life of Riley.
examples.zh: 这两个骗子一直过着莱利的生活。

examples.en: He planned to retire early and then lead the life of Riley.
examples.zh: 他打算提前退休，然后过莱利的生活。

senses.def: to be very enthusiastic about something

examples.en: He just lives and breathes football.
examples.zh: 他非常热衷于足球。

senses.def: used to say that you should accept other people’s opinions and behaviour even though they are different from your own
senses.zh: 自己活也让别人活；宽以待人；互相宽容

senses.def: to earn money by clever or sometimes dishonest means

senses.def: to have a way of life that seems perfect

examples.en: With her own TV show and a flat in Paris, she is living the dream.
examples.zh: 她有自己专属的电视节目，在巴黎还有一间公寓，过着理想的生活。

senses.def: to spend all the money you earn on basic needs such as food without being able to save any money

to live together and have a sexual relationship without being married
to enjoy yourself in an exciting way, usually spending a lot of money
senses.zh: 尽情欢乐；狂欢；纵情挥霍享乐

senses.def: to keep something important about yourself a secret from other people, so that they do not know what you really think, what you are really like, etc.

examples.en: He lived a lie for thirty years, ‘married’ to two women.
examples.zh: 他坑蒙拐骗地生活了 30 年，同两个女人“结婚”。

senses.zh: 风餐露宿（通常因为无家可归或贫穷）

examples.en: young people sleeping rough on the streets

examples.zh: 除非你与世隔绝生活了几十年，否则应该知道北极海冰正在融化。

examples.en: Long live public libraries!
examples.zh: 公共图书馆永存！

examples.zh: 你从未去过纽约？你真是白活了！

senses.def: used to express surprise at something new or unexpected you have been told
senses.zh: （对得知的事物感到惊讶或意外）真是得活到老学到老，真想不到

examples.zh: 世界杯赛的实况转播

senses.def: to look at somebody in a careful or critical way
senses.zh: 上下仔细打量，挑剔地审视（某人）

senses.def: to (not) have your normal healthy appearance

examples.en: You're not looking yourself today (= you look tired or ill/sick).
examples.zh: 今天你看上去气色不太好。

senses.def: to become more and more successful

examples.en: Her first novel was published in 2007 and since then she hasn't looked back.
examples.zh: 她的第一部小说于 2007 年发表，自此她便一发而不可收。

senses.def: not attractive
judging by the appearance of somebody/something

examples.en: To look at him you'd never think he was nearly fifty.
examples.zh: 看他的外表，谁也想不到他年近五十了。

senses.def: an act of looking at somebody/something

examples.en: Here, have a look at this.
examples.zh: 来，看一看这个。

examples.en: Take a look at these figures!
examples.zh: 看一下这些数字吧！

examples.en: Make sure you get a good look at their faces.
examples.zh: 你一定要仔细看清他们的面孔。

examples.en: One look at his face and Jenny stopped laughing.
examples.zh: 只看了一眼他那张脸，珍妮就止住了笑。

examples.en: Alex and Michael exchanged looks (= they looked at each other).
examples.zh: 亚历克斯和迈克尔相互看了一眼。

examples.en: It's an interesting place. Do you want to take a look around?
examples.zh: 这个地方很好玩，你要不要到处看看？

senses.def: an act of trying to find something/somebody

examples.en: I've had a good look for it, but I can't find it.
examples.zh: 我仔细找过了，可是找不着。

examples.en: I had a look for websites on Egyptian music, but didn't find anything.
examples.zh: 我搜索了关于埃及音乐的网站，但什么也没找到。

examples.en: I had a furtive look in her bag when her back was turned.
examples.zh: 当她转过身去时，我偷偷翻了一下她的包。

senses.def: an act of examining a problem or situation carefully

examples.en: I gave the figures a quick look.
examples.zh: 我快速检查了这些数字。

examples.en: a brief/an in-depth look
examples.zh: 快速查看；深入审视

examples.en: We'll be taking a close look at these proposals (= examining them carefully).
examples.zh: 我们会仔细审查这些方案。

examples.en: I think it's time to take a fresh look at our sales techniques.
examples.zh: 我想现在该是重新审视一下我们的销售技巧的时候了。

examples.en: You should take a long, hard look at your reasons for wanting to join the army.
examples.zh: 你应该全面、严肃地审视自己想参军的理由。

examples.en: The book concludes with a look towards the future.
examples.zh: 这本书结束时展望了未来。

senses.group: examine a problem/situation 调查问题／情况

senses.def: an expression in your eyes or face

examples.en: He didn't like the look in her eyes.
examples.zh: 他不喜欢她的眼神。

examples.en: She had a worried look on her face.
examples.zh: 她一脸担忧的样子。

examples.en: He gave me a funny look.
examples.zh: 他用异样的目光看了我一眼。

examples.en: I got a black look from Amy.
examples.zh: 埃米恶狠狠地看了我一眼。

examples.en: a look of disgust/horror/shock/surprise
examples.zh: 厌恶／恐惧／震惊／惊讶的表情

senses.def: the way somebody/something looks; the appearance of somebody/something

examples.en: Looks can be deceptive.
examples.zh: 外表有时是靠不住的。

examples.en: a fabric with the look of silk
examples.zh: 丝绸样的织物

examples.en: Use high-quality paper to give your CV a more professional look.
examples.zh: 用好点的纸，这样你的简历看上去更专业一些。

examples.en: I don't like the look of that guy (= I don't trust him, judging by his appearance).
examples.zh: 我不喜欢他那副样子。

examples.en: It's going to rain today by the look of it (= judging by appearances).
examples.zh: 看样子今天要下雨了。

examples.en: From the looks of things, he was not at all happy.
examples.zh: 从目前的情况来看，他并没有感到高兴。

senses.def: a person’s appearance, especially when the person is attractive

examples.en: She has her father's good looks.
examples.zh: 她有父亲俊秀的容貌。

examples.en: He lost his looks (= became less attractive) in later life.
examples.zh: 他英俊的相貌在晚年已不复存在。

senses.def: a fashion; a style

examples.en: They've given the place a completely new look.
examples.zh: 他们使得这地方焕然一新。

examples.en: Wear the top with jeans for a more casual look.
examples.zh: 穿这件上衣搭配牛仔裤，这样看起来更休闲。

senses.def: to look at somebody in a way that shows you are annoyed with them
senses.zh: 厌恶地瞪某人一眼；给某人一个白眼

senses.def: used to describe the very angry or unpleasant way somebody is/was looking at you
senses.zh: 眼神吓死人；一脸怒气；满脸不高兴

examples.en: If looks could kill, she thought, seeing the expression that came over his face when he saw her, she’d be dead on the pavement.
examples.zh: 看到他看自己时脸上的表情，她想，如果目光能杀人，她就已经被杀死在人行道上了。

examples.en: I don’t know what I’ve done to upset him, but if looks could kill…
examples.zh: 我不知道做了什么惹他生气了，但看他那吓人的样子…

senses.def: to consider a problem or possibility very carefully and without hurrying
senses.zh: 极其慎重地考虑（问题或可能性）

examples.en: We need to take a long, hard look at all the options.
examples.zh: 我们需要十分谨慎地考虑所有的可选方案。

senses.def: used to make somebody pay attention to what you are going to say, often when you are annoyed
senses.zh: （常为不悦时唤起他人注意）喂，听我说

examples.en: Look, I think we should go now.
examples.zh: 喂，我想我们现在得走了。

examples.en: Look, that's not fair.
examples.zh: 嘿，那样不公平。

note.en: Most idioms containing look are at the entries for the nouns and adjectives in the idioms, for example look daggers at somebody is at dagger.
note.zh: 大多数含 look 的习语，都可在该等习语中的名词及形容词相关词条找到，如 look daggers at sb 在词条 dagger 下。

senses.def: used in a shop to say that you are not ready to buy something
senses.zh: （在商店中表示无意购买某物）只是看一看

examples.en: ‘Can I help you?’ ‘I'm just looking, thank you.’
examples.zh: “请问您要买什么？”“谢谢，我只是看看。”

senses.def: to try to find ways of doing something
senses.zh: 试图找到做某事的方法

examples.en: The government is looking to reduce inflation.
examples.zh: 政府正在力求降低通货膨胀率。

senses.def: to be considered bad behaviour or bad manners
senses.zh: 被视为举止不佳；失礼；不得体

examples.en: It looks bad not going to your own brother's wedding.
examples.zh: 连亲兄弟的婚礼都不参加，这太不像话了。

senses.def: to show that something bad might happen
senses.zh: 显示不好的事可能发生；看来不利于

examples.en: He's had another heart attack; things are looking bad for him, I'm afraid.
examples.zh: 他又犯了一次心脏病，恐怕他情况不妙。

senses.def: to show success or that something good might happen
senses.zh: 显现成功（或好事可能发生）；看来充满希望

examples.en: This year's sales figures are looking good.
examples.zh: 今年的销售数字情况看好。

senses.def: used to protest about something

examples.en: Now look here, it wasn't my fault.
examples.zh: 喂，那不是我的错！

senses.def: used to give an example that proves what you are saying or makes it clearer

examples.en: Look how lazy we've become.
examples.zh: 瞧我们变得有多懒。

examples.en: Be careful climbing that ladder. Look what happened last time.
examples.zh: 爬那梯子时小心点儿。上次不就出事了嘛。

senses.def: used to say that something is exactly what somebody needs and so they do not need to consider any other options
senses.zh: 不需要再考虑其他选择

examples.en: Those looking for an enjoyable evening need look no further than the hotel's nightclub.
examples.zh: 对于那些想要度过一个愉快的夜晚的人，不用另寻他处，酒店的夜总会就是一个好选择。

examples.zh: 看到他看自己时脸上的表情，她想，如果目光能杀人，她就已经被杀死在人行道上了。

intro.en: These words all mean to turn your eyes in a particular direction.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含看、观看之义。

items.def: to turn your eyes in a particular direction:
items.zh: 指看、瞧

examples.en: If you look carefully you can just see our house from here.
examples.zh: 你要是仔细看，从这里就可以看见我们的房子。

items.def: to look at somebody/​something for a time, paying attention to what happens:
items.zh: 指看、注视、观看、观察

examples.en: to watch television
examples.zh: 看电视

items.def: to watch a game, television programme, performance, etc.:
items.zh: 指观看（比赛、电视节目、演出等）

examples.en: In the evening we went to see a movie.
examples.zh: 晚上我们去看了一场电影。

items.def: (formal) to look at something, especially when you look carefully; to watch television, a film, etc.:
items.zh: 指看、观看（尤指仔细观察）；看（电视、电影等）

examples.en: People came from all over the world to view her work.
examples.zh: 观众从世界各地涌来欣赏她的作品。

items.def: (formal) to watch somebody/​something carefully, especially to learn more about them or it:
items.zh: 指观察、注视、监视

examples.en: The patients were observed over a period of several months.
examples.zh: 这些病人被观察了数月之久。

intro.en: These are all words for an act of looking, when you turn your eyes in a particular direction.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示看的动作。

items.def: an act of looking at somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指看、瞧

examples.en: Here, have a look at this.
examples.zh: 来，看一看这个。

items.def: a quick look:
items.zh: 指匆匆一看、一瞥、扫视

examples.en: She stole a glance at her watch.
examples.zh: 她偷偷看了看表。

items.def: a long, steady look at somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指凝视、注视

examples.en: She felt embarrassed under his steady gaze.
examples.zh: 她在他凝视的目光下感到很尴尬。

items.def: a long look at somebody/​something, especially in a way that is unfriendly or that shows surprise:
items.zh: 尤指不友善或吃惊的盯、凝视、注视

examples.en: She gave the officer a blank stare and shrugged her shoulders.
examples.zh: 她面无表情地盯着那个军官，耸了耸肩。

items.def: a look at somebody/​something for a very short time, when you do not see the person or thing completely:
items.zh: 指一瞥、一看

examples.en: He caught a glimpse of her in the crowd.
examples.zh: 他在人群里一眼瞥见了她。

items.def: a long, angry look at somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指长久的怒视、瞪眼

examples.en: She fixed her questioner with a hostile glare.
examples.zh: 她带着敌意瞪着向她提问的人。

senses.def: to look ugly or silly
senses.zh: 模样丑陋；看上去傻乎乎的

senses.def: to refuse or criticize something that is given to you for nothing
senses.zh: 白送的马还看牙口；拒受馈赠；对礼物吹毛求疵

examples.en: I’m never one to look a gift horse in the mouth.
examples.zh: 我从来都不是一个对礼物视而不见的人。

look a gift horse in the mouth.word: look a gift horse in the mouth

senses.def: to look at or react to somebody/something in a critical way or in a way that shows you do not trust or believe them
senses.zh: （挑剔或怀疑地）斜眼看，侧眼看，瞟

examples.en: The opposition party looked askance at most of the government’s proposed policies.
examples.zh: 反对党对政府提出的大部分政策持怀疑态度。

examples.en: She looked askance at him when he began to eat before everybody else.
examples.zh: 当他开始先于其他人吃饭时，她斜眼看着他。

examples.en: A waiter in a tuxedo looked askance at his jeans.
examples.zh: 一名身穿燕尾服的服务员斜眼看着他的牛仔裤。

look askance (at somebody/something) | l.word: look askance (at somebody/something) | look (at somebody/something) askance

senses.def: to show that something bad might happen
senses.zh: 显示不好的事可能发生；看来不利于

examples.en: He's had another heart attack; things are looking bad for him, I'm afraid.
examples.zh: 他又犯了一次心脏病，恐怕他情况不妙。

senses.def: to be considered bad behaviour or bad manners
senses.zh: 被视为举止不佳；失礼；不得体

examples.en: It looks bad not going to your own brother's wedding.
examples.zh: 连亲兄弟的婚礼都不参加，这太不像话了。

senses.def: used to advise somebody to think about the possible results or dangers of something before doing it
to behave in a way that suggests that you think that you are better than somebody or that something is not good enough for you

examples.en: People who live in that area tend to look down their noses at their poorer neighbours.
examples.zh: 住在那个地区的人往往瞧不起比他们穷的邻居。

examples.en: They tend to look down their noses at people who drive small cars.
examples.zh: 他们往往看不起开小型汽车的人。

look down your nose at somebody/somethin.word: look down your nose at somebody/something

senses.def: to behave in a way that is likely to cause an argument, violence, etc.
senses.zh: 自找麻烦；自寻烦恼；惹是生非

examples.en: Drunken youths hang around outside looking for trouble.
examples.zh: 喝醉的年轻人在街头游荡滋事。

senses.def: to show success or that something good might happen
senses.zh: 显现成功（或好事可能发生）；看来充满希望

examples.en: This year's sales figures are looking good.
examples.zh: 今年的销售数字情况看好。

senses.def: used to protest about something

examples.en: Now look here, it wasn't my fault.
examples.zh: 喂，那不是我的错！

examples.en: Look how lazy we've become.
examples.zh: 瞧我们变得有多懒。

examples.en: Be careful climbing that ladder. Look what happened last time.
examples.zh: 爬那梯子时小心点儿。上次不就出事了嘛。

senses.def: to approve of something/somebody
senses.zh: 赞同，接受，认可（某事或人）

examples.en: He hoped they would look kindly on his request.
examples.zh: 他希望他们接受他的请求。

look like nothing on earth: @@@LINK=be, feel, look, taste, etc. like nothing on earth

senses.def: to look dirty and untidy
senses.zh: 穿着邋遢；衣衫褴褛；不修边幅

senses.def: used to say that something is exactly what somebody needs and so they do not need to consider any other options
senses.zh: 不需要再考虑其他选择

examples.en: Those looking for an enjoyable evening need look no further than the hotel's nightclub.
examples.zh: 对于那些想要度过一个愉快的夜晚的人，不用另寻他处，酒店的夜总会就是一个好选择。

senses.def: to be cheerful or positive about a bad situation, for example by thinking only of the advantages and not the disadvantages
senses.zh: （对坏情况）持乐观态度，看到光明的一面

examples.en: Look on the bright side. You managed to do more than I did.
examples.zh: 看好的一面吧，你比我当初做的多多了。

senses.def: used in orders to tell somebody to be quick or to hurry

examples.en: You'd better look sharp or you'll be late.
examples.zh: 你得快点，不然就迟到了。

senses.def: to look straight at somebody without feeling embarrassed or ashamed
senses.zh: （坦然或问心无愧地）直视某人，正视某人

examples.en: Can you look me in the eye and tell me you're not lying?
examples.zh: 你能问心无愧地看着我说你没撒谎吗？

examples.en: She looked her father straight in the eye and answered his question truthfully.
examples.zh: 她直视着父亲的眼睛，诚实地回答了他的问题。

examples.en: I'll never be able to look her in the face again!
examples.zh: 我再也不能坦然地面对她了！

senses.def: to look at somebody in a careful or critical way
senses.zh: 上下仔细打量，挑剔地审视（某人）

senses.def: to deliberately avoid seeing somebody/something

examples.en: Prison officers know what's going on, but look the other way.
examples.zh: 狱警知道出了什么事，但扭过头去装作没看见。

senses.def: to be careful that you do not lose the success or advantage that you have over other people
senses.zh: 小心翼翼地保持成就（或优势）

examples.en: With so many good new actors around the older ones are having to look to their laurels.
examples.zh: 有这么多优秀的新演员在身边，老演员们不得不固步自封。

look who's talking: @@@LINK=you're a fine one to talk | look who's talking | you can/can't talk

senses.def: used to tell somebody that they should not criticize somebody else for something because they do the same things too
senses.zh: （用以表示自己同样不对时不要批评别人）还有脸说别人

examples.en: ‘George is so careless with money.’ ‘Look who's talking!’
examples.zh: “乔治真是乱花钱。”“亏你还有脸说别人！”

look who’s talking | you can/can’t talk.word: look who’s talking | you can/can’t talk | you’re a fine one to talk

senses.def: to seem as old as you really are and not younger or older

examples.en: She doesn’t look her age; I thought she was ten years younger.
examples.zh: 她看起来不像她的年龄；我以为她年轻了十岁。

senses.def: to be responsible for or to take care of somebody/something/yourself

examples.en: Who's going to look after the children while you're away?
examples.zh: 你不在时谁来照料小孩？

examples.en: I'm looking after his affairs while he's in hospital.
examples.zh: 他住院时由我处理他的事务。

examples.en: Don't worry about me—I can look after myself (= I don't need any help).
examples.zh: 别担心我，我能照顾好自己。

senses.def: to make sure that things happen to somebody’s advantage

examples.en: He's good at looking after his own interests.
examples.zh: 他善于照顾自己的利益。

senses.def: to think about what is going to happen in the future
a method of teaching people to read by recognizing whole words, rather than by associating letters with sounds
senses.zh: 视读法，直呼法（一种识字教学方法，根据对整词的辨认而不是字母与发音的联系）

senses.def: to turn your head so that you can see something

examples.en: People came out of their houses and looked around.
examples.zh: 人们走出家门四处察看。

senses.def: to visit a place or building, walking around it to see what is there

examples.en: Let's look around the town this afternoon.
examples.zh: 咱们今天下午在城里逛逛吧。

senses.def: to search for something in a number of different places

examples.en: We're looking around for a house in this area.
examples.zh: 我们正在这个地区四处找住房。

senses.def: to examine something closely

examples.en: Your ankle's swollen—I think the doctor ought to look at it.
examples.zh: 你的脚踝肿了，我认为得找医生检查一下。

examples.en: I haven't had time to look at (= read) the papers yet.
examples.zh: 我还没来得及看这些论文。

examples.en: Look at the machine quite carefully before you buy it.
examples.zh: 先仔细查看一下这台机器再买。

senses.def: to think about, consider or study something

examples.en: The company is looking at ways to reduce waste.
examples.zh: 公司正在研究减少废弃物的方法。

examples.en: The implications of the new law will need to be looked at.
examples.zh: 新法规可能造成的影响需要仔细研究一下。
