senses.def: to start being brave or strong in order to deal with a difficult situation
senses.zh: 拿出男人气概；勇对难境

examples.en: I decided to man up and tell them what I really thought.
examples.zh: 我决定勇敢地告诉他们我的真实想法。

senses.def: a spiritual power, authority or energy within people, places or things

examples.en: From adversity came this huge pride and mana that have driven us.
examples.zh: 从逆境中产生的巨大自豪感和力量驱使着我们。

examples.en: In this game, mana is required for casting spells.
examples.zh: 在这个游戏中，施展法术需要法力。

senses.def: one of two metal bands joined by a chain, used for fastening a prisoner’s ankles or wrists
to put manacles

examples.en: His hands were manacled behind his back.
examples.zh: 他的双手被铐在背后。

examples.en: The captives were chained and manacled.
examples.zh: 俘虏被锁链和手铐锁住。

senses.def: to control or be in charge of a business, a team, an organization, land, etc.
senses.zh: 管理，负责（公司、队伍、组织等）

examples.en: to manage a business/factory/bank/hotel/soccer team
examples.zh: 管理企业／工厂／银行／酒店／足球队

examples.en: to manage a department/project
examples.zh: 负责一个部门／项目

examples.en: I think that Forestry Tasmania manages the forest.
examples.zh: 我认为这片森林归塔斯马尼亚林业局管理。

examples.en: The school has been badly managed for several years.
examples.zh: 多年来，学校管理不善。

examples.en: We need people who are good at managing.
examples.zh: 我们需要擅长管理的人。

senses.def: to succeed in doing something, especially something difficult
senses.zh: 完成（困难的事）；勉力完成

examples.en: I don't know exactly how we'll manage it, but we will, somehow.
examples.zh: 我说不准我们如何去完成这件事，但不管怎样我们一定会完成的。

examples.en: Can you manage another piece of cake? (= eat one)
examples.zh: 你还能再吃块蛋糕吗？

examples.en: We managed to get to the airport in time.
examples.zh: 我们设法及时赶到了机场。

examples.en: How did you manage to persuade him?
examples.zh: 你是怎么说服他的？

examples.en: She somehow managed to escape through the window.
examples.zh: 她设法从窗户逃走了。

examples.en: He always manages to say the wrong thing.
examples.zh: 他总是哪壶不开提哪壶。

examples.en: They managed to find a place to stay.
examples.zh: 他们设法找到了住的地方。

examples.en: We couldn't have managed without you.
examples.zh: 没有你，我们就办不成了。

examples.en: ‘Need any help?’ ‘No, thanks. I can manage.’
examples.zh: “要帮忙吗？”“不了，谢谢。我应付得了。”

senses.group: do something difficult 做难做的事

senses.def: to succeed in achieving or producing something

examples.en: In spite of his disappointment, he managed a weak smile.
examples.zh: 尽管很失望，他还是勉强露出一丝微笑。

examples.en: Davies manages light humour without seeming silly.
examples.zh: 戴维斯表现出些许幽默感，又不显得荒唐。

senses.group: do something difficult 做难做的事

senses.def: to be able to solve your problems, deal with a difficult situation, etc.
senses.zh: 能解决（问题）；应付（困难局面等）

examples.en: She's 82 and can't manage on her own any more.
examples.zh: 她 82 岁了，照顾不了自己的生活了。

examples.en: How do you manage without a car?
examples.zh: 没有车你怎么应付的？

examples.en: I can manage without a dishwasher.
examples.zh: 没有洗碗机我也能将就。

examples.en: I don’t know how she manages on her own with four kids.
examples.zh: 我不知道她一个人带着四个孩子是怎么生活的。

senses.group: deal with problems 处理问题

senses.def: to be able to live or survive without having much money, support, sleep, etc.

examples.en: young families who are just about managing
examples.zh: 勉强维持生计的年轻家庭

examples.en: She was finding it difficult to manage financially.
examples.zh: 她发现财力上难以为继。

examples.en: He has to manage on less than £100 a week.
examples.zh: 他只能靠每周不到 100 英镑来维持生活。

examples.en: Many find it difficult to manage on their weekly income.
examples.zh: 许多人发现很难靠每周的薪水过活。

examples.en: He generally managed on five hours' sleep a night.
examples.zh: 他常常靠每晚五个小时的睡眠支撑着。

examples.en: Everyone will just have to manage with less.
examples.zh: 每个人都将设法用更少的收入维生。

senses.def: to use money, time, information, etc. in a sensible way
senses.zh: 明智地使用（金钱、时间、信息等）

examples.en: Don't tell me how to manage my affairs.
examples.zh: 用不着你来告诉我怎样管我自己的事。

examples.en: a computer program that helps you manage data efficiently
examples.zh: 帮助你有效地处理数据的电脑程序

examples.en: This enables pension funds to manage risk.
examples.zh: 这使得养老基金能够管理风险。

senses.def: to be able to do something at a particular time

examples.en: Let's meet up again—can you manage next week sometime?
examples.zh: 我们再见一次面吧。下周找个时间，行吗？

senses.def: to keep somebody/something under control; to be able to deal with somebody/something

examples.en: It's like trying to manage an unruly child.
examples.zh: 这就像试图管住一个任性的孩子。

examples.en: Can you manage that suitcase?
examples.zh: 你弄得动那个箱子吗？

examples.en: She manages horses better than anyone I know.
examples.zh: 在我认识的人中，属她最擅长驭马。

examples.en: I really liked the chapter about how to manage stress.
examples.zh: 我真的很喜欢如何应付压力那一章。

senses.def: to control how land is used, so that it is used in a sensible way

examples.en: The landowners manage their land to provide habitat for the desired species.
examples.zh: 土地所有者合理使用土地，为受欢迎的物种提供栖息地。

examples.en: All the timber comes from sustainably managed forests.
examples.zh: 所有木材均来自可持续经营的森林。

senses.def: possible to deal with or control

examples.en: Use conditioner regularly to make your hair soft and manageable.
examples.zh: 经常使用护发剂来使你的头发柔软而且易于梳理。

examples.en: The debt has been reduced to a more manageable level.
examples.zh: 债务减到了比较能够应付的程度。

examples.en: It is important to present new information in manageable chunks.
examples.zh: 以可管理的块的形式呈现新信息非常重要。

examples.en: The journey is easily manageable in half an hour.
examples.zh: 这段路程半个小时就能轻松走完。

senses.def: a healthcare
senses.zh: 管理式医疗体系（只能选择指定的医生和医院，或者对规定外的医疗额外收费，以控制医保支出）

examples.en: In an era of managed care, therapists are challenged to make therapy more cost-conscious without sacrificing effectiveness.
examples.zh: 在管理式医疗时代，治疗师面临的挑战是在不牺牲疗效的情况下使治疗更具成本意识。

senses.def: the activity of running and controlling a business or similar organization

examples.en: a career in management
examples.zh: 管理方面的职业

examples.en: hotel/project management
examples.zh: 酒店／项目管理

examples.en: a management training course
examples.zh: 管理培训课程

examples.en: the day-to-day management of the business
examples.zh: 企业的日常管理

examples.en: The report blames bad management.
examples.zh: 报告归咎于管理不善。

examples.en: Effective financial management is essential.
examples.zh: 有效的财务管理至关重要。

examples.en: The company's top-down management style made decision-making slow and inflexible.
examples.zh: 该公司自上而下的管理风格导致决策缓慢且缺乏灵活性。

senses.def: the people who run and control a business or similar organization

examples.en: The management is/are considering closing the factory.
examples.zh: 经营者在考虑关闭这家工厂。

examples.en: The shop is now under new management.
examples.zh: 这家商店现由新的经营者管理。

examples.en: junior/middle/senior management
examples.zh: 初级／中级／高级管理人员

examples.en: the bank's/airline's/hospital's management
examples.zh: 银行／航空公司／医院的管理层

examples.en: a management decision/job
examples.zh: 资方的决定；管理工作

examples.en: A new board and management team took over.
examples.zh: 新的董事会和管理团队接管了。

examples.en: My role is to act as a mediator between employees and management.
examples.zh: 我的角色就是协调雇员与管理层之间的关系。

examples.en: Most managements are keen to avoid strikes.
examples.zh: 大多数经营者都很希望避免罢工的发生。

senses.def: the act or skill of dealing with people or situations in a successful way
senses.zh: （成功的）处理手段；（有效的）处理能力

examples.en: classroom management
examples.zh: 课堂组织能力

examples.en: a waste management system/company/plan
examples.zh: 废弃物管理系统／公司／计划

examples.en: management of staff/patients/resources
examples.zh: 员工／患者／资源管理

examples.en: Diet plays an important role in the management of heart disease.
examples.zh: 饮食对于心脏病的治疗有重要作用。

senses.def: a person whose job is to give professional advice about how to run a company or an organization more effectively

examples.en: a firm of management consultants
examples.zh: 管理咨询公司

senses.def: a short statement that gives the important facts, conclusions and suggestions of a report, usually printed at the beginning of a report
senses.zh: 报告摘要，内容撮要（常印在报告开头的简短说明或总结）

senses.def: a person who is in charge of running a business, a shop or a similar organization or part of one
senses.zh: （企业、店铺等的）经理，经营者，老板

examples.en: a bank/hotel manager
examples.zh: 银行／酒店经理

examples.en: the sales/marketing/human resources manager
examples.zh: 销售部／市场部／人力资源部经理

examples.en: a portfolio/an asset manager
examples.zh: 投资组合/资产管理人

examples.en: The company always needs project managers.
examples.zh: 公司总是需要项目经理。

examples.en: I'm a senior manager in a multinational company.
examples.zh: 我在一家跨国公司任高级经理。

examples.en: a meeting of area managers
examples.zh: 地区经理会议

examples.en: If you have any questions, speak to your manager.
examples.zh: 有问题请和你的上司讲。

senses.def: a person who deals with the business affairs of an actor, a musician, etc.
senses.zh: （演员、音乐家等的）经理人，经纪人，个人经理

examples.en: The comedian is unavailable for comment, according to her manager.
examples.zh: 据经纪人说，这名喜剧演员无法作出评论。

examples.en: The band's manager said that the gig sold out in hours.
examples.zh: 乐队经纪人说，现场演出的门票几个小时就卖完了。

senses.def: a person who trains and organizes a sports team

examples.en: the new manager of Italy
examples.zh: 意大利队的新主教练

examples.en: He will be the club's caretaker manager until a new manager is appointed.
examples.zh: 在任命新的主教练之前，他将是俱乐部的代理教练。

senses.def: a person who is good at managing resources

examples.en: She's a good manager who never throws any food away.
examples.zh: 她很会过日子，从不扔掉食物。

examples.en: TV ads depicted the candidate as a would-be efficient manager of the US economy.
examples.zh: 电视广告将这名候选人描绘成未来美国经济的高效管理者。

senses.def: a woman who is in charge of a small business, for example, a shop, restaurant or hotel
connected with the work of a manager

examples.en: Does she have any managerial experience?
examples.zh: 她有没有什么管理经验？

senses.def: the person who is in charge of a business

examples.en: He became managing director of Esso in 1968.
examples.zh: 1968 年，他成为埃索公司董事总经理。

senses.def: a person who manages the work of preparing books, magazines or newspapers to be published or news, etc. to be broadcast
senses.zh: 执行编辑：负责准备要出版的书籍，杂志或报纸或要播报的新闻等工作的人

examples.en: She is a former managing editor of ‘Dairy Field’ magazine.
examples.zh: 她是《Dairy Field》杂志的前任执行编辑。

senses.def: at some time in the future (used when a person cannot or will not say exactly when)
senses.zh: 在将来某时；在以后的不确定时间

senses.def: a large water animal with front legs and a strong tail but no back legs that lives along the Atlantic coasts of West Africa and North and South America
senses.zh: 海牛（水生哺乳动物，栖息于西非海岸和美洲）

senses.def: a large city in north-west England, in the county of Greater Manchester
senses.zh: 曼彻斯特（英格兰西北部大城市，位于大曼彻斯特郡。在 18 世纪成为重要的工业城市，生产供国内外销售的羊毛和棉制品。亦是具有左翼政治传统的文化和文人中心。著名建筑有建于 1867-76 年的维多利亚市政厅，1996 年开业的布里奇沃特国际音乐厅）

senses.def: the largest city in the US state of New Hampshire
senses.zh: 曼彻斯特（美国新罕布什尔州最大城市）

senses.def: a football team from Manchester
senses.zh: 曼彻斯特市：一支来自英格兰曼彻斯特的足球队。它成立于1894年，曾在足总杯中夺冠，并在英国和欧洲取得了许多其他成功。

senses.def: a newspaper for the Greater Manchester
senses.zh: 曼彻斯特晚报：大曼彻斯特地区的报纸每天（星期日除外）每天出现，于1868年首次出版

senses.def: a football team from Manchester
senses.zh: 曼彻斯特联队；曼联队英格兰曼彻斯特的一支足球队，主场是老特拉福德球场。球队成立于1902年，多次赢得足总杯，在英国和欧洲的其他赛事中也屡创佳绩。1958年，曼联队的几名球员在慕尼黑遭遇飞机失事而丧生。

senses.def: a person from Manchester in north-west England
from or connected with the city of Manchester in north-west England
senses.zh: （英格兰西北部的）曼彻斯特人

examples.en: a Mancunian singer
examples.zh: 曼彻斯特歌手

senses.def: a round picture that represents the universe in Hindu and Buddhist traditions
senses.zh: 曼荼罗（某些东方宗教用以代表宇宙的圆形图）

senses.def: a powerful official of high rank, especially in the civil service
senses.zh: 政界要员；（尤指）内务官员

senses.def: a government official of high rank in China in the past
the standard form of Chinese, which is the official language of China
a type of small orange with loose skin that comes off easily
a small collar
the authority to do something, given to a government or other organization by the people who vote for it in an election
senses.zh: （政府或组织等经选举而获得的）授权

examples.en: It is undemocratic to govern an area without an electoral mandate.
examples.zh: 没有选民授权就统辖一个地区是不民主的。

examples.en: The election victory gave the party a clear mandate to continue its programme of reform.
examples.zh: 选举获胜使得这个政党拥有了明确的继续推行改革的权力。

examples.en: a mandate for an end to the civil war
examples.zh: 停止内战的权力

senses.def: the period of time for which a government is given power

examples.en: The presidential mandate is limited to two terms of four years each.
examples.zh: 总统的任期不得超过两届，每届四年。

senses.def: an official order given to somebody to perform a particular task

examples.en: The members' vote gave the union a mandate to call a strike.
examples.zh: 会员投票授权工会发起罢工。

examples.en: They accused him of acting without a mandate.
examples.zh: 他们指控他未经授权而行事。

senses.def: the power given to a country to govern another country or region, especially in the past
senses.zh: （尤指旧时授予某国对别国或地区的）委任统治权

examples.en: The Cook Islands mandate was given to New Zealand.
examples.zh: 库克群岛托管地授予新西兰。

examples.en: The mandate ran until 1947.
examples.zh: 委托统治权一直延续到1947 年。

senses.def: to order somebody to behave, do something or vote in a particular way; to order something to be done

examples.en: The law mandates that imported goods be identified as such.
examples.zh: 法律规定进口货物必须如实标明。

examples.en: The new law would mandate children to study a foreign language from second grade.
examples.zh: 新法律将强制儿童从二年级开始学习外语。

examples.en: The government began mandating better car safety.
examples.zh: 政府开始下令提高轿车的安全性。

senses.def: to give somebody, especially a government or a committee, the authority to do something

examples.en: The assembly was mandated to draft a constitution.
examples.zh: 大会获授权起草一份章程。

examples.en: We need to be sure that the directors are mandated to act.
examples.zh: 我们需要确保董事有权采取行动。

senses.def: required by law

examples.en: The offence carries a mandatory life sentence.
examples.zh: 这种罪行依照法律要判无期徒刑。

examples.en: It is mandatory for blood banks to test all donated blood for the virus.
examples.zh: 血库必须检查所有捐献的血是否含有这种病毒。

senses.def: a small cake made of fried dough
the jawbone
the upper or lower part of a bird’s beak
either of the two parts that are at the front and on either side of an insect’s mouth, used especially for biting and crushing
a Hindu temple
a musical instrument with metal strings (usually eight) arranged in pairs, and a curved back, played with a plectrum
a poisonous plant used to make drugs, especially ones to make people sleep, thought in the past to have magic powers
senses.zh: 茄参（可制药，旧时认为具有魔力）

senses.def: an African monkey with a red and blue face, the male having a blue bottom
senses.zh: 山魈（西非大型猴子，脸部红蓝相间，尾很短）

senses.def: a first name for girls, short for Amanda
senses.zh: 曼迪（女子名 Amanda 缩写）

senses.def: the long hair on the neck of a horse or a lion

examples.en: She spent ages braiding her horse's mane.
examples.zh: 她花了很长时间辫马鬃。

examples.en: The horse's mane streamed in the wind.
examples.zh: 马鬃迎风飘动。

senses.def: a person’s long or thick hair

examples.en: She tossed back her mane of chestnut hair.
examples.zh: 她把栗色的头发向后甩去。

senses.def: a building or area surrounded by a fence in which horses and riders are trained
senses.zh: 被栅栏包围的建筑物或区域，训练马匹和骑手

senses.def: a movement performed with care and skill
senses.zh: 细致巧妙的移动；机动动作

examples.en: a complicated/skillful maneuver
examples.zh: 复杂/熟练的动作

examples.en: You will be asked to perform some standard maneuvers during your driving test.
examples.zh: 在驾驶考试期间，您将被要求执行一些标准操作。

senses.def: a clever plan, action or movement that is used to give somebody an advantage

examples.en: diplomatic maneuvers
examples.zh: 外交演习

examples.en: a complex maneuver in a game of chess
examples.zh: 国际象棋游戏中的复杂动作

examples.en: The amendment was somehow introduced by political maneuver.
examples.zh: 该修正案在某种程度上是出于政治操纵而提出的。

senses.def: military exercises involving a large number of soldiers, ships, etc.

examples.en: The army is on maneuvers in the desert.
examples.zh: 军队正在沙漠中进行演习。

senses.def: the chance to change the way that something happens and influence decisions that are made
senses.zh: 改变事态的机会；回旋余地

examples.en: Small farmers have limited room for maneuver.
examples.zh: 小农户的回旋余地有限。

senses.def: to move or turn with skill or care; to move or turn something with skill or care

examples.en: The yachts maneuvered for position.
examples.zh: 游艇操纵位置。

examples.en: There was very little room to maneuver.
examples.zh: 回旋余地很小。

examples.en: She maneuvered the car carefully into the garage.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼地把车开进车库。

senses.def: to control or influence a situation in a way that shows skill but is sometimes dishonest

examples.en: The new laws have left us little room to maneuver (= not much opportunity to change or influence a situation).
examples.zh: 新法律给我们留下的回旋余地很小（=没有太多机会改变或影响局势）。

examples.en: She maneuvered her way to the top of the company.
examples.zh: 她凭借自己的努力登上了公司的高层。

senses.def: the chance to change the way that something happens and influence decisions that are made
senses.zh: 改变事态的机会；回旋余地

examples.en: Small farmers have limited room for maneuver.
examples.zh: 小农户的回旋余地有限。

senses.def: that can easily be moved into different positions
senses.zh: 可调遣的；机动的；灵活的

examples.en: a highly maneuverable vehicle
examples.zh: 高度机动的车辆

senses.def: done in a brave and determined way
senses.zh: 有男子气概地；勇敢坚定地

examples.en: a manful attempt/effort
examples.zh: 勇敢的尝试/努力

senses.def: using a lot of effort in a brave and determined way
senses.zh: 有男子气概地；勇敢坚定地

examples.en: They rose manfully to the challenge.
examples.zh: 他们勇敢地面对挑战。

senses.def: a Japanese style of comic strip
a chemical element. Manganese
a skin disease that affects mammals
a plant with a large root that is used as food for farm animals
a long open box that horses and cows can eat from
a person who stops other people from enjoying something that the person cannot use or does not want themselves
a person who stops other people from enjoying something that the person cannot use or does not want themselves
a type of very small pea
to tear or twist

examples.en: His hand was mangled in the machine.
examples.zh: 他的手卷到机器里轧烂了。

(1897-1995) the first US woman elected to both the US House of Representatives (1940-49) and the US Senate (1949-73). She was also, in 1964, the first woman to be named by a major political party as a possible candidate for US President. Smith was a member of the Republican Party

senses.def: (1901-78) a US anthropologist
senses.zh: 玛格丽特·米德（Margaret Mead）：（1901-78）美国人类学家。她研究了儿童在不同文化中的成长方式，特别是在太平洋岛屿，并指出人类行为受到社会的强烈影响。有人批评她的研究，但她使人类学非常流行。她的著作包括萨摩亚的成年（1928），新几内亚的成长（1930），男女（1949）和文化与承诺（1970）。

senses.def: (1892-1972) an English comedy actor. She is best remembered for playing rather eccentric
senses.zh: 玛格丽特·卢瑟福：（1892-1972）英国喜剧演员。她因扮演比较古怪的老年女性而广为人知，例如电影版《 Blithe Spirit》（1945年）和《 Importance of认真认真》（1952年）。她还在阿加莎·克里斯蒂（Agatha Christie）小说的电影版本中扮演马普尔小姐（Miss Marple）的角色。1967年，她成为了一位贵妇。

senses.def: (1925-2013) a British Conservative politician who became Britain's first woman prime minister and was one of the longest serving British prime ministers of the 20th century. She became a Member of Parliament
senses.zh: 玛格丽特·撒切尔（Margaret Thatcher）：（1925-2013）英国保守党政客，成为英国第一位女总理，并且是20世纪任职时间最长的英国总理之一。她于1959年成为国会议员，并于1970年被任命为教育和科学大臣时成为内阁成员。1975年，她在一次党内选举中击败了爱德华·希思，并在1979年保守党赢得大选时成为总理。她认为国家不应该干预商业活动，并且将许多国家所有的产业私有化。她通过一系列法律降低了工会的权力，并在1985年的矿工罢工中击败了矿工。她希望人们不要依靠福利国家，而要自己支付医疗，教育和养老金。人们常常批评撒切尔夫人的政策，并指责她为许多英国工业的衰落和高失业率。然而，她被视为非常坚定和爱国的总理，在福克兰群岛战争之后，她变得特别受欢迎。因此，她经常被称为“铁娘子”。在赢得三届大选后，她于1991年被自己党内成员批评她对欧洲联盟的态度而被迫辞职。约翰·梅杰（John Major）继任总理。她在1992年成为终身同伴。因此，她经常被称为“铁娘子”。在赢得三届大选后，她于1991年被自己党内成员批评她对欧洲联盟的态度而被迫辞职。约翰·梅杰（John Major）继任总理。她在1992年成为终身同伴。因此，她经常被称为“铁娘子”。在赢得三届大选后，她于1991年被自己党内成员批评她对欧洲联盟的态度而被迫辞职。约翰·梅杰（John Major）继任总理。她在1992年成为终身同伴。

examples.en: She beat the other runners by a margin of ten seconds.
examples.zh: 她以领先十秒的优势战胜了其他赛跑者。

examples.en: Members voted by a margin of 7–1 to become a public limited company.
examples.zh: 成员们以 7 比 1 的票数投票决定成为一家公众有限公司。

senses.def: the difference between the cost of buying or producing something and the price that it is sold for

examples.en: What are your average operating margins?
examples.zh: 你的平均营业利润率是多少？

examples.en: a gross margin of 45 per cent
examples.zh: 45% 的毛利

senses.def: an extra amount of something such as time, space, money, etc. that you include in order to make sure that something is successful
senses.zh: 余地；备用的时间（或空间、金钱等）

examples.en: a safety margin
examples.zh: 安全距离

examples.en: The narrow gateway left me little margin for error as I reversed the car.
examples.zh: 门口狭窄，弄得我倒车时几乎不能出任何差错。

senses.def: the extreme edge or limit of a place

examples.en: the eastern margin of the Indian Ocean
examples.zh: 印度洋的东岸

senses.def: the part that is not included in the main part of a group or situation

examples.en: people living on the margins of society
examples.zh: 生活在社会边缘的人

senses.def: an amount that is added to a basic wage, paid for special skill or responsibility
senses.zh: （基本工资以外的）技术津贴，职务补贴

senses.def: an amount that you allow when you calculate something, for the possibility that a number is not completely accurate

examples.en: The survey has a margin of error of 2.5 per cent.
examples.zh: 测量的误差幅度为 2.5%。

senses.def: small and not important
senses.zh: 小的；微不足道的；不重要的

examples.en: a marginal improvement in weather conditions
examples.zh: 天气条件的略微好转

examples.en: The story will only be of marginal interest to our readers.
examples.zh: 我们的读者对这则故事不会很感兴趣。

examples.en: The difference between the two estimates is marginal.
examples.zh: 两个估价之间的差距非常微小。

senses.def: relating to or resulting from small changes

examples.en: All three companies reported marginal revenue growth.
examples.zh: 这三家公司均报告了边际收入增长。

senses.def: not part of a main or important group or situation

examples.en: marginal groups in society
examples.zh: 社会中的非主流群体

examples.en: Welsh was considered a marginal language.
examples.zh: 威尔士语被认为是边缘语言。

senses.def: won or lost by a very small number of votes and therefore very important or interesting as evidence of public opinion
senses.zh: （议席或选区）边缘的（以微弱票数决定成败）

examples.en: a marginal seat/constituency
examples.zh: 边缘席位／选区

senses.def: written in the margin

examples.en: marginal notes/comments
examples.zh: 页边的注解／评论

senses.def: that cannot produce enough good crops to make a profit
a seat in a parliament, on a local council, etc. that was won by a very small number of votes
senses.zh: （议会或地方委员会的）边缘席位

examples.en: a Labour marginal
examples.zh: 工党的边缘席位

senses.def: notes written in the margins
facts or details that are not very important
senses.zh: 无足轻重的事情；细枝末节

senses.def: the process or result of making somebody feel as if they are not important and cannot influence decisions or events; the fact of putting somebody in a position in which they have no power
senses.zh: 使显得微不足道；使处于边缘；使无实权

examples.en: the marginalization of older people
examples.zh: 老年人的边缘化

senses.def: to make somebody feel as if they are not important and cannot influence decisions or events; to put somebody in a position in which they have no power
senses.zh: 使显得微不足道；使处于边缘；使无实权

senses.def: very slightly; not very much
senses.zh: 轻微地；很少地；微不足道地

examples.en: They now cost marginally more than they did last year.
examples.zh: 现在并不比去年贵多少。

examples.en: He’s in a new job but he’s only marginally better off.
examples.zh: 他换了新工作，但也多挣不了多少钱。

senses.def: (1919-91) a British ballet
senses.zh: 玛格特·丰汀（Margot Fonteyn）：（ 1919-91年）英国芭蕾舞演员，以自然的舞蹈表达情感方式而享誉国际。她因在1960年代由弗雷德里克·阿什顿（Frederick Ashton）执导的芭蕾舞剧中与鲁道夫·努里耶夫（Rudolf Nureyev）的表演而被人们最为铭记。

senses.def: a small white garden flower with a yellow centre
a first name for girls
(1923-77) a US opera
senses.zh: 玛丽亚·卡拉斯（Maria Callas）：（1923-77）是一位美国歌剧歌手，与希腊父母在一起。她强烈的嗓音和个性使歌剧在美国更受欢迎。她与亚里斯多德·奥纳西斯（Aristotle Onassis）有着悠久的浪漫友谊，后者后来嫁给了杰基·肯尼迪（Jackie Kennedy）。卡拉斯（Callas）被公认为20世纪最伟大的歌手之一。

senses.def: a musician who plays traditional Mexican music, usually as part of a small group that travels from place to place; the type of music played by these musicians
senses.zh: 马里亚奇音乐演奏者，墨西哥传统音乐演奏者（常为街头乐队成员）；马里亚奇音乐；墨西哥街头音乐

examples.en: a mariachi band
examples.zh: 马里亚奇乐队

senses.def: relating to the Virgin Mary in the Christian church
a first name for girls
(1902-93) a US singer. In 1939 she was prevented from entering a hall to give a concert by the Daughters of the American Revolution
senses.zh: 玛丽安·安德森（Marian Anderson）：（1902-93）美国歌手。1939年，由于她是黑人，她被美国革命之女禁止进入大厅举行音乐会，所以她免费走了林肯纪念堂台阶的音乐会。1955年，她成为第一位在纽约大都会歌剧院演出的黑人歌手。

senses.def: (1887-1972) a US poet, known for her clever and intellectual
senses.zh: 玛丽安·摩尔（Marianne Moore）：（1887-1972）美国诗人，以她的聪明才智和诗歌而著称，曾获得普利策诗歌精选奖（1952）。她的其他收藏包括《诗歌》（1921年），《观察》（1924年）和《诗歌全集》（1967年）。

senses.def: a type of farming in which fish or other sea animals and plants are kept or grown for food
a first name for girls
used to talk about a place where all the people who should be there have disappeared in a mysterious way

the title of a magazine for women published every month in Britain and the US. It contains articles on fashion, beauty, travel, the arts, shopping, and lifestyle. Marie Claire was first published in France in 1937.
senses.zh: 玛丽·克莱尔（Marie Claire）：每月在英国和美国出版的女性杂志的标题。它包含有关时尚，美容，旅行，艺术，购物和生活方式的文章。玛丽·克莱尔（Marie Claire）于1937年在法国首次出版。

senses.def: (1870-1922) one of the most popular of all English music hall
senses.zh: 玛丽·劳埃德（Marie Lloyd）：（1870-1922）是所有英语音乐厅表演者中最受欢迎的人之一。她以鸡肋幽默和漫画歌曲而著称，例如《小小的你喜欢的东西》和《哦，波特先生》，这震惊了一些人，因为他们常常以幽默的方式提及性。

senses.def: (1888-1982) a British ballet
senses.zh: 玛丽·兰伯特（Marie Rambert）：（1888-1982）英国芭蕾舞演员兼导演，出生于波兰。在与谢尔盖·迪亚吉列夫（Sergei Diaghilev）的公司（1912-13）跳舞之后，她在伦敦（1920）开设了一所芭蕾舞学校，后来发展成为现在被称为兰伯特的舞蹈公司。她在1962年当上了贵妇。

senses.def: a Marie Rose
senses.zh: 玛丽·罗斯（Marie Rose）：玛丽·罗斯（Marie Rose）酱是一种冷粉红色的酱，配以海鲜

examples.en: prawns Marie Rose
examples.zh: 鸡尾酒虾（以Marie Rose Sauce为蘸料的海鲜菜品，曾在20世纪70年代至80年代末在英国非常流行）

senses.def: (1880-1958) a Scottish scientist who was one of the first people to write and teach people about sex and contraception
senses.zh: 玛丽·斯托斯（Marie Stopes）：（1880-1958）是一位苏格兰科学家，他是最早撰写和教人们性与避孕方法（防止女性怀孕的方法）的人之一。她在1918年撰写了两本与此主题相关的重要著作，《已婚的爱和明智的父母》。尽管当时她受到教会和医学界的批评，但它们都非常受欢迎和成功。

senses.def: Madame Tussaud's
senses.zh: 玛丽·杜莎夫人蜡像馆：杜莎夫人蜡像馆

senses.def: an orange or yellow garden flower. There are several types of marigold
a drug (illegal in many countries) made from the dried flowers of the cannabis
a first name for girls
(1926-62) a US actor who became Hollywood's
senses.zh: 玛丽莲·梦露（Marilyn Monroe）：（1926-62）是美国好莱坞最著名的性象征，尽管她常常不开心。她的电影包括：尼亚加拉（1952），绅士爱美的金发女郎（1953），七年之痒（1954），巴士站（1956），王子与歌舞女郎（1957），《热喜欢的人》（1959）和《失恋》（1961） ）。她的第二和第三任丈夫是棒球运动员乔·迪马吉奥和作家亚瑟·米勒。许多书籍和电影都讲述了她的故事，而埃尔顿·约翰（Elton John）的歌曲《风中的烛光》的原始版本与她有关。在服用过多药物以帮助睡眠后，她可能意外死亡。许多人认为她与肯尼迪总统及其兄弟罗伯特·肯尼迪（Robert Kennedy）有恋爱关系。

senses.def: a musical instrument like a xylophone
a specially designed harbour

examples.en: a new £250 million marina and leisure development
examples.zh: 预算为2.5亿英镑的开发小船坞和娱乐设施的新项目

senses.def: a mixture of oil, wine, spices
if you marinade
senses.zh: 腌，浸泡（食物）；（食物）腌，浸泡

senses.def: a sauce made from tomatoes and onions and served especially with pasta
senses.zh: 意大利式番茄酱，番茄洋葱酱汁（尤用来搭配意大利面食）

examples.en: To put it bluntly, the marinara tastes as if it comes from a jar.
examples.zh: 坦白地说，这种意大利酱汁味道像是从罐头瓶里取出来的。

senses.def: if you marinate
senses.zh: 腌，浸泡（食物）；（食物）腌，浸泡

senses.def: connected with the sea and the creatures and plants that live there

examples.en: marine life
examples.zh: 海洋生物

examples.en: a marine biologist (= a scientist who studies life in the sea)
examples.zh: 海洋生物学家

senses.def: connected with ships or trade at sea
senses.zh: 海船的；货船的；海上贸易的

senses.def: a soldier who is trained to serve on land or at sea, especially one in the US Marine Corps or the British Royal Marines
senses.zh: （尤指美国或英国皇家）海军陆战队士兵

examples.en: My brother has joined the marines.
examples.zh: 我哥哥加入了海军陆战队。

senses.def: a sailor
the name of a series of flights of NASA
senses.zh: 水手：NASA飞船经过其他行星或绕过其他行星的一系列飞行的名称。水手1号失败并于1962年在飞行中被摧毁，但在同一年，水手2飞越了金星。水手9号于1971年进入绕火星的轨道（即太空中的圆形路径），并拍摄了7 000多张照片。水手10号在1974年和1975年再次飞越金星和水星。

senses.def: a puppet
a type of potato
connected with marriage or with the relationship between a married couple

examples.en: marital difficulties/breakdown
examples.zh: 婚姻纠葛／破裂

senses.def: the fact of whether you are single, married, divorced, etc.

examples.en: questions about age, sex and marital status
examples.zh: 关于年龄、性别、婚姻状况的问题

senses.def: connected with the sea or ships
senses.zh: 海的；海事的；海运的；船舶的

examples.en: a maritime museum
examples.zh: 海洋博物馆

examples.en: the country’s maritime history
examples.zh: 该国的航海历史

senses.def: near the sea

examples.en: maritime Antarctica
examples.zh: 南极近海地区

senses.def: a plant with leaves that smell sweet and are used in cooking as a herb
senses.zh: 牛至（叶子芳香，常在干后用作烹调辅料）

senses.def: to write or draw a symbol, line, etc. on something in order to give information about it

examples.en: The flood level is marked by a white line on the wall.
examples.zh: 洪水水位在墙上用白线作了标记。

examples.en: Items marked with an asterisk can be omitted.
examples.zh: 打星号的项目可以删去。

examples.en: Prices are marked on the goods.
examples.zh: 价格标在商品上。

examples.en: The teacher marked her absent (= made a mark by her name to show that she was absent).
examples.zh: 老师在她的名字旁做了个缺课的记号。

examples.en: Why have you marked this wrong?
examples.zh: 你为什么批这道题为错？

examples.en: Do not open any mail marked ‘Confidential’.
examples.zh: 不要打开任何标有“机密”的邮件。

examples.en: Certain words were marked as important.
examples.zh: 有些词语被当作重点标了出来。

senses.def: to give marks to students’ work
senses.zh: 给（学生作业）打分，评分，评成绩

examples.en: I hate marking exam papers.
examples.zh: 我讨厌阅卷。

examples.en: I spend at least six hours a week marking.
examples.zh: 我每周至少要花六个小时批改作业。

examples.en: If you don't hand your homework in on time, I won't mark it.
examples.zh: 如果你不按时交作业，我就不给你批改。

senses.def: to make a mark on something in a way that damages it or makes it look less good; to become damaged or be made to look less good in this way
senses.zh: 留下痕迹；弄污；使有污点

examples.en: A large purple scar marked his cheek.
examples.zh: 他的面颊上有一块大紫疤。

examples.en: The surfaces are made from a material that doesn't mark.
examples.zh: 这些台面是由不会留下污渍的材料做的。

examples.en: The paperweight had fallen onto the desk, badly marking the surface.
examples.zh: 镇纸掉到了桌上，在桌面砸出了深深的印痕。

senses.def: to show the position of something

examples.en: Yellow arrows mark the way.
examples.zh: 黄色箭头指示方向。

examples.en: The cross marks the spot where the body was found.
examples.zh: 十字记号标明了发现死尸的地点。

examples.en: The route has been marked in red.
examples.zh: 路线用红色标明了。

examples.en: The boundary was marked with a dotted line.
examples.zh: 边界用虚线标示。

senses.def: to celebrate or officially remember an event that you consider to be important

examples.en: a ceremony to mark the 50th anniversary of the end of the war
examples.zh: 纪念战争结束 50 周年的庆典

examples.en: The event marked a milestone in the hotel's success story.
examples.zh: 这次活动是见证酒店成功历程的重要里程碑事件。

senses.def: to be a sign that something new is going to happen
senses.zh: 是…的迹象；成为…的征兆；表明

examples.en: This agreement marks the start of a new phase in international relations.
examples.zh: 这一协议标志着国际关系新时期的到来。

examples.en: This speech may mark a change in government policy.
examples.zh: 这篇演讲表明政府的政策可能会有变化。

examples.en: ‘Lyrical Ballads’ conveniently marks the beginning of nineteenth-century poetry.
examples.zh: 《抒情歌谣集》适时地标志19 世纪诗歌的开始。

senses.def: to give somebody/something a particular quality or character

examples.en: a life marked by suffering
examples.zh: 痛苦的一生

examples.en: The town is still deeply marked by the folk memory of the Depression.
examples.zh: 这座小镇仍然深深地烙印着大萧条时期的民间记忆。

examples.en: He was marked as an enemy of the poor.
examples.zh: 他被列为穷人的敌人。

examples.en: Christianity has indelibly marked the culture and consciousness of Europe.
examples.zh: 基督教给欧洲的文化及思想观念留下了恒久的印记。

senses.group: give particular quality 赋予特征

senses.def: used to tell somebody to pay careful attention to something

examples.en: There'll be trouble over this, mark my words.
examples.zh: 记住我的话，这件事是会有麻烦的。

examples.en: You mark what I say, John.
examples.zh: 约翰，注意听着。

senses.def: to stay close to an opponent in order to prevent them from getting the ball

examples.en: Hughes was marking Taylor.
examples.zh: 休斯在盯防泰勒。

examples.en: Our defence had him closely marked.
examples.zh: 我方后卫已经紧紧地钉住了他。

senses.def: to pass the time while you wait for something more interesting

examples.en: I'm just marking time in this job—I'm hoping to get into journalism.
examples.zh: 我干这件工作只是在等待时机，我希望能从事新闻工作。

senses.def: to make marching
used to remind somebody of something they should consider in a particular case
senses.zh: 无论如何；尽管如此；反正；然而

examples.en: She hasn't had much success yet. Mark you, she tries hard.
examples.zh: 她还没取得什么成功，可是她非常努力。

senses.def: a written or printed symbol that is used as a sign of something, for example the quality of something or who made or owns it
senses.zh: 符号；记号；（显示质量、制造者或所有者等的）标记

examples.en: I put a mark in the margin to remind me to check the figure.
examples.zh: 我在页边做了个记号来提醒自己核对一下这个数字。

examples.en: Any piece of silver bearing his mark is extremely valuable.
examples.zh: 带有他的印记的每一件银器都极有价值。

examples.en: A faint pencil mark showed where the house was on the map.
examples.zh: 淡淡的铅笔记号标示出房子在地图上的位置。

examples.en: Every image is made up of hundreds of brush marks.
examples.zh: 每幅图像都由数百个笔迹组成。

senses.def: a number or letter that is given to show the standard of somebody’s work or performance or is given to somebody for answering something correctly

examples.en: to get a good/poor mark in English
examples.zh: 英语得分高／低

examples.en: to give somebody a high/low mark
examples.zh: 给某人高分／低分

examples.en: What's the pass mark (= the mark you need in order to pass)?
examples.zh: 合格分数是多少？

senses.def: a point given for a correct answer in an exam or competition

examples.en: You get two marks for each correct answer.
examples.zh: 每个正确答案得两分。

examples.en: You will lose marks for bad grammar.
examples.zh: 语法错误会扣分。

examples.en: I got full marks (= all the possible points) in the spelling test.
examples.zh: 我拼写测验得了满分。

examples.en: ‘You're wearing a tie!’ ‘Full marks for observation.’
examples.zh: “你打领带啦！”“你真眼尖，给你打满分。”

senses.def: a small area of dirt, a spot or a cut on a surface that makes it look less good

examples.en: The children left dirty marks all over the kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 孩子们把厨房的地板弄得污渍斑斑。

examples.en: There was a red mark on his arm.
examples.zh: 他的手臂上有一块红印子。

examples.en: a burn/scratch mark
examples.zh: 一块灼伤的／抓伤的疤痕

examples.en: Detectives found no marks on the body.
examples.zh: 侦探没有在尸体上发现任何痕迹。

senses.def: a spot or area of colour on the body of a person or an animal that helps you to recognize them
senses.zh: （人或动物身上有助于识别的）斑点，记号，色斑

examples.en: a horse with a white mark on its head
examples.zh: 头上有块白斑的马

examples.en: He was about six feet tall, with no distinguishing marks.
examples.zh: 他身高约六英尺，身上没什么特别的斑痕。

examples.en: Look for a bird with a blue mark on its wings.
examples.zh: 寻找翅膀上有蓝色标记的鸟。

senses.def: a sign that a quality or feeling exists
senses.zh: （品质或情感的）标志，迹象，表示

examples.en: On the day of the funeral businesses remained closed as a mark of respect.
examples.zh: 葬礼那天，商户停业以示敬意。

examples.en: Such coolness under pressure is the mark of a champion.
examples.zh: 在压力下仍能这样保持冷静，这就是冠军相。

senses.def: a level or point that something reaches that is thought to be important

examples.en: Unemployment has passed the four million mark.
examples.zh: 失业人数已突破四百万大关。

examples.en: Ratings had soared towards the 20 million mark.
examples.zh: 收视率飙升至2000万大关。

examples.en: The needle was flickering around the 80 mark.
examples.zh: 指针在 80 标记附近闪烁。

examples.en: She was leading at the halfway mark.
examples.zh: 赛程到一半时是她领先。

senses.def: a particular type or model of a machine or vehicle

examples.en: the Mark II engine
examples.zh: II 型发动机

senses.def: a particular level of temperature in a gas oven

examples.en: Preheat the oven to gas Mark 6.
examples.zh: 将烤箱预热到 6 挡。

senses.group: in gas oven 煤气烤箱

senses.def: a cross made on a document instead of a signature
senses.zh: （不会写名字的人在文件上代替签名的）花押
senses.group: for signing document 签署文件

senses.def: a target

synonyms.words: stain ▪ fingerprint ▪ streak ▪ speck ▪ blot ▪ smear ▪ spot

intro.en: These are all words for a small area of dirt or another substance on a surface.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指污点、斑点、污迹。

items.def: a small area of dirt, a spot or a cut on a surface that makes it look less good:
items.zh: 污点；污渍；斑点；疤痕

examples.en: The kids left dirty marks all over the kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 孩子们把厨房的地板弄得污迹斑斑。

items.def: a dirty mark on something that is difficult to remove, especially one made by a liquid:
items.zh: 指污点、污渍

examples.en: blood stains
examples.zh: 血迹

items.def: a mark on a surface made by the pattern of lines on the end of a person’s finger, often used by the police to identify criminals:
items.zh: 指指纹、指印

examples.en: Her fingerprints were all over the gun.
examples.zh: 那支枪上布满了她的指纹。

items.def: a long, thin mark or line that is a different colour from the surface it is on:
items.zh: 指条纹、条痕

examples.en: She had streaks of grey in her hair.
examples.zh: 她头上已是白发绺绺。

items.def: a very small mark, spot or piece of a substance on something:
items.zh: 指小点、污点

examples.en: There isn’t a speck of dust anywhere in the house.
examples.zh: 整间房子一尘不染。

items.def: a spot or dirty mark left on something by a substance such as ink or paint being dropped on a surface

items.def: a mark made by something such as oil or paint being spread or rubbed on a surface

items.def: a small dirty mark on something:

examples.en: There were grease spots all over the walls.
examples.zh: 墙上满是油渍。

intro.en: These are all words for a small part on a surface that is a different colour from the rest.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指斑点、色斑。

items.def: an area of something, especially one which is different from the area around it:
items.zh: 指色斑、斑点、（与周围不同的）小块、小片

examples.en: a white dog with a black patch on its head
examples.zh: 头上有一块黑斑的白狗

items.def: a small round mark on something, especially one that is printed:
items.zh: 指点、小点、小圆点，尤指印出来的点

examples.en: The letters ‘i’ and ‘j’ have dots over them.
examples.zh: 字母 i 和 j 上面都有一点。

items.def: an area of colour that is easy to notice on the body of a person or animal:
items.zh: 指人或动物身上的斑、记号、色斑

examples.en: The horse had a white mark on its head.
examples.zh: 这匹马头上有块白斑。

items.def: a small round area that is a different colour or feels different from the surface it is on:
items.zh: 指斑点

examples.en: Which has spots, a leopard or a tiger?

senses.def: (1903-70) a US painter, born in Russia, who was a leading figure in the abstract expressionism
senses.zh: 马克·罗斯科（Mark Rothko）：（1903-70）是美国画家，出生于俄罗斯，是抽象表现主义运动的主要人物。他以产生非常大的图片而闻名，在该图片中，垂直排列有强烈色带和柔和边缘的条带，从而产生了平静的效果。

senses.def: (1835-1910) the leading US humorous writer of the 19th century. His real name was Samuel Langhorne Clemens. He is best known for the novels The Adventures of Tom Sawyer
senses.zh: 马克·吐温（Mark Twain）：（1835-1910）是19世纪美国主要幽默作家。他的真名是塞缪尔·兰霍恩·克莱门斯。他以小说《汤姆·索亚历险记》（1876年）和《哈克贝利·芬恩历险记》（1885年）而著称，但他也写了旅行书和随笔，其中许多都是基于他在密西西比河上的生活经历。他的其他著作包括历史小说《王子与乞Pa》（1882年）和亚瑟王朝廷的康涅狄格洋基队（1889年）以及《密西西比河上的生活》（1889年），这是他早年的生平。

(1929-68) the most important leader of the US civil rights movement
senses.zh: 马丁·路德·金：（1929-68）美国民权运动最重要的领导人。金是一位非裔美国浸信会大臣，他领导了一系列和平运动，反对南部各州的种族隔离。1957年，他成立了南方基督教领袖会议。1963年，他带领约25万人参加了向华盛顿特区举行的抗议游行，在那里他在林肯纪念堂发表了著名的“我有一个梦想”演讲。1964年，他被授予诺贝尔和平奖。四年后，他在田纳西州的孟菲斯被伯爵·雷谋杀。金的妻子科雷塔·斯科特·金（Coretta Scott King，1927-2006年）继续他的工作。他的生日（1月15日）是许多州的法定假日。

senses.def: a national holiday in the US on the third Monday in January to celebrate the birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr., who was active in the struggle to win more rights for African Americans
senses.zh: 马丁·路德·金纪念日（美国假日，在一月份第三个星期一，纪念积极争取非裔美国人权利的马丁·路德·金的生日）

senses.def: (1918-84) an English astronomer
senses.zh: 马丁·莱尔（Martin Ryle）：（1918-84）英国天文学家。他的工作有助于建立“大爆炸”理论，该理论认为，宇宙中的所有物质都是从几百万年前的一个微小点爆炸的。（这与弗雷德·霍伊尔（Fred Hoyle）等人的“稳态”理论相反。）莱尔（Ryle）于1966年被授予骑士勋章，并于1974年获得诺贝尔奖。

senses.def: (1782-1862) the eighth US President (1837-41). His popular name was the 'Little Magician' because of his political skills. He was a lawyer and a Democrat
senses.zh: 马丁·范布伦（Martin Van Buren）：（1782-1862）美国第八任总统（1837-41）。由于他的政治才能，他的俗名是“小魔术师”。他是一名律师和一名民主党人，最初在安德鲁·杰克逊（Andrew Jackson）的领导下担任国务卿（1829-31）和副总统（1832-6）。尤其因建立独立的财政系统以应对该国的财政困难而被人们铭记。

senses.def: (1844-1926) a US artist known especially for her paintings of mothers and children. She worked mostly in France, where she was a student of Degas and became a member of the Impressionist group. One of her most famous paintings is Woman Bathing
senses.zh: 玛丽·卡萨特（Mary Cassatt）：（1844-1926）是一位美国画家，以其母亲和儿童的绘画而闻名。她主要在法国工作，当时她是Degas的学生，并成为印象派团体的成员。她最著名的画作之一是《女人沐浴》（Woman Bathing，1891年）。

senses.def: Mary Tudor (1516-58) the queen of England and Ireland from 1553 to 1558. She was the daughter of King Henry VIII
senses.zh: 玛丽一世玛丽·都铎（1516–1558），英格兰和爱尔兰女王（1553–1558 在位）。亨利八世和阿拉贡的凯瑟琳之女，在爱德华六世去世后成为女王。登基后首先处决了争夺王位的简·格雷夫人。玛丽决心让罗马天主教重回英国，1554 年与信奉天主教的西班牙腓力二世结婚，遭到众多新教徒反对，玛丽下令将其中数百人烧死，因此被称为“血腥玛丽”。被她烧死的人中有托马斯·克兰默和休·拉蒂默。玛丽没有后嗣，死后由其同父异母的妹妹伊丽莎白一世继位。

senses.def: (1662-94) the queen of England, Scotland and Ireland from 1688 to 1694. She was the elder
senses.zh: 玛丽二世（1662–1694）英格兰、苏格兰和爱尔兰女王（1688–1694 在位）。詹姆斯二世的长女，1677 年嫁给荷兰表兄奥兰治的威廉（即后来的威廉三世）。詹姆斯二世在 1688 年光荣革命中被推翻后，玛丽和威廉共同执政，直到 32 岁早逝。

senses.def: (1912-89) a US writer whose intelligent novels made comments about American society. These include The Groves of Academe
senses.zh: 玛丽·麦卡锡（Mary McCarthy）：（1912-89）是一位美国作家，其聪明的小说对美国社会做出了评论。其中包括Academe的Groves（1952），The Group（1963）和Cannibals and Missionaries（1979）。她还写了有关文学，旅行书和《天主教少女时代》（1957年）的书，讲述了自己的早年生活。她嫁给了作家埃德蒙·威尔逊（Edmund Wilson）（1895-1972）。

senses.def: (1893-1979) one of the most famous actors in US silent films, born in Canada, who became known as 'America's Sweetheart'. She had long curls
senses.zh: 玛丽·皮克福德（Mary Pickford）：（1893-1979）是美国无声电影中最著名的演员之一，出生于加拿大，被誉为“美国的甜心”。她长卷发，扮演无辜的角色。1919年，她加入了道格拉斯·费尔班克斯（Douglas Fairbanks，她的丈夫从1920年至1936年），查理·卓别林和DW格里菲斯（DW Griffith），成立了电影公司United Artists。她的电影包括桑尼布鲁克农场的丽贝卡（1917）和波莉安娜（1920）。1976年，她因对电影业的贡献而获得特别奥斯卡奖。

senses.def: a popular Walt Disney
senses.zh: 玛丽·波平斯（Mary Poppins）：沃尔特·迪斯尼（Walt Disney）的一部热门电影（1964年），根据澳大利亚作家PL Travers的角色制作。玛丽是一个保姆，可以打着伞飞，做其他魔术。朱莉·安德鲁斯（Julie Andrews）扮演角色，并因此获得了奥斯卡奖。电影的歌曲包括获得奥斯卡金像奖的Chim-Chim-Cheree和Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious。根据故事改编的舞台剧于2004年在伦敦开幕。

senses.def: Mary Stuart (1542-87) the queen of Scotland from 1542 to 1567. She was the daughter of King James V of Scotland and the cousin
senses.zh: 苏格兰女王玛丽：玛丽·斯图尔特（1542-87）从1542年到1567年是苏格兰女王。她是苏格兰国王詹姆斯五世的女儿，也是伊丽莎白女王一世的表亲，在她出生后不久就成为苏格兰女王。她直到1561年才统治苏格兰，后来在法国长大，1559年在法国短暂当选女王。她是罗马天主教徒，返回苏格兰后与苏格兰新教徒发生了宗教纠纷。1567年，她被迫放弃权力，转而支持儿子詹姆斯六世（后来的英格兰国王詹姆斯一世），并搬到了英格兰，被俘虏。在随后的几年中，天主教团体曾多次企图让她的英国女王取代伊丽莎白一世，伊丽莎白最终下令切断玛丽的头。她的冒险

senses.def: (1797-1851) an English writer, best known as the author of Frankenstein
senses.zh: 玛丽·雪莱（Mary Shelley）：（1797-1851）英国作家，最著名的科学怪人作家。她是玛丽·沃斯通克拉夫特（Mary Wollstonecraft）的女儿，也因在16岁时与诗人雪莱（Shelley）逃亡而回想起。她与雪莱（Shelley）结婚，当时他的第一任妻子1816年自杀身亡。

senses.def: (1936-2017) a US comic actor who had her own popular television series, The Mary Tyler Moore Show
senses.zh: 玛丽·泰勒·摩尔（Mary Tyler Moore）：（1936-2017）是美国漫画演员，她在CBS（1970-77）拥有自己的人气电视连续剧《玛丽·泰勒·摩尔秀》。该节目由她扮演电视记者，获得了三项艾美奖（1973-74年和1976年）。她后来出演电视连续剧《玛丽（1986）》，《安妮·麦奎尔（Annie McGuire）（1989）和《纽约新闻》（1995）。摩尔的电影包括《普通人》（1980年）和《与灾难调情》（1996年）。

senses.def: William Masters and Virginia Johnson two US doctors who became well known for their study of human sexual behaviour. They discovered that women can enjoy sex as much as men. They wrote several books about their research, including Human Sexual Response

senses.zh: 矩阵丘吉尔（Matrix Churchill）：一家英国工程公司，于1992年出名，当时其三名董事被指控违反英国政府的官方政策向伊拉克出售了军事装备。当时担任政府贸易大臣的艾伦•克拉克（Alan Clark）在法庭上承认，他曾建议该公司对其出口的产品不完全诚实，因此针对董事的诉讼失败了。这在英国引起了巨大的政治丑闻。董事被判无罪，此事成为正式调查的主题。

senses.zh: 马特·巴斯比（Matt Busby）：（1909-94）英国足球运动员兼经理。他在1930年代曾是曼彻斯特城和利物浦的成功球员，但最著名的是曼联（1945-69）的经理。1958年，几名成员巴斯比的团队被称为“巴斯比宝贝”，他们在慕尼黑的一次飞机失事中丧生。坠毁后，巴斯比重建了该团队，成为英格兰最成功的球队，并于1968年赢得了欧洲杯。巴斯比1968年被任命为骑士。

senses.def: used (to ask) if somebody is upset, unhappy, etc. or if there is a problem

examples.en: What's the matter? Is there something wrong?
examples.zh: 怎么了？出了什么事儿吗？

examples.en: Is anything the matter?
examples.zh: 有什么问题吗？

examples.en: Is something the matter with Bob? He seems very down.
examples.zh: 鲍勃有什么事儿吧？他好像情绪很低落。

examples.en: There's something the matter with my eyes.
examples.zh: 我的眼睛出了点毛病。

examples.en: ‘We've bought a new TV.’ ‘What was the matter with the old one?’
examples.zh: “我们买了台新电视。”“那台旧的怎么了？”

examples.en: What's the matter with you today (= why are you behaving like this)?
examples.zh: 你今天是怎么了？

examples.en: What on earth was the matter with her, she wondered. She’d come here to enjoy herself and here she was, stuck on her own in the hotel.
examples.zh: 她想知道她到底出了什么问题。她来这里是为了享受自己，而她却独自一人被困在酒店里。

senses.def: a subject or situation that you must consider or deal with

examples.en: It's a private matter.
examples.zh: 这是件私事儿。

examples.en: They had important matters to discuss.
examples.zh: 他们有些重要的问题要讨论。

examples.en: She may need your help with some business matters.
examples.zh: 她也许需要你帮助处理一些生意方面的事情。

examples.en: financial/legal/political matters
examples.zh: 财政／法律／政治事务

examples.en: They've agreed in theory, but now we need to discuss practical matters.
examples.zh: 他们在理论上是同意了，但现在我们需要讨论实际问题。

examples.en: The matter should be referred to a senior manager.
examples.zh: 此事应提交给高级经理。

examples.en: Do I have any choice in the matter?
examples.zh: 在这件事上我有选择权吗？

examples.en: I always consulted him on matters of policy.
examples.zh: 我总是向他咨询一些政策问题。

examples.en: It's a matter for the police (= for them to deal with).
examples.zh: 这事须由警方处理。

examples.en: It was a matter of some concern to most of those present (= something they were worried about).
examples.zh: 这是当时在场的多数人关心的问题。

examples.en: It should have been a simple matter to check.
examples.zh: 检查核对本来应该是件很容易的事。

examples.en: It was no easy matter getting him to change his mind.
examples.zh: 让他改变主意可不是件容易的事儿。

examples.en: Let's get on with the matter in hand (= what we need to deal with now).
examples.zh: 我们继续解决手头的问题吧。

examples.en: I wasn't prepared to let the matter drop (= stop discussing it).
examples.zh: 我没打算把这件事搁下不提。

examples.en: We have sent these concerns to Professor Tribe, and now consider the matter closed (= it is finished).
examples.zh: 我们已将这些疑虑发送给 Tribe 教授，现在认为此事已经结束（= 已经结束）。

examples.en: I did not feel that we had got to the heart of the matter (= the most important part).
examples.zh: 我认为我们还没有触及问题的关键。

examples.en: And that is the crux of the matter (= the most important thing about the situation).
examples.zh: 这就是问题的症结所在。

examples.en: And then there's the little matter of the fifty pounds you owe me.
examples.zh: 还有件小事儿，你欠我五十英镑呢。

senses.def: the present situation, or the situation that you are talking about

examples.en: Unfortunately, there is nothing we can do to improve matters.
examples.zh: 很遗憾，我们无力改善目前的状况。

examples.en: I'd forgotten the keys, which didn't help matters.
examples.zh: 我忘记带钥匙了，这让我情况更糟。

examples.en: And then, to make matters worse, his parents turned up.
examples.zh: 接着，更糟糕的是，他的父母亲来了。

examples.en: I decided to take matters into my own hands (= deal with the situation myself).
examples.zh: 我决定亲自处理问题。

examples.en: Matters came to a head (= the situation became very difficult) with his resignation.
examples.zh: 随着他的辞职，局面恶化得难以收拾。

senses.def: a situation that involves something or depends on something

examples.en: Learning to drive is all a matter of coordination.
examples.zh: 学开车主要是靠协调。

examples.en: Some people prefer the older version to the new one. It's a matter of taste.
examples.zh: 有些人喜欢老版本而不喜欢新版本。这只是个人喜好问题。

examples.en: She resigned over a matter of principle.
examples.zh: 她因为原则问题而辞职。

examples.en: The government must deal with this as a matter of urgency.
examples.zh: 政府必须将此事当作紧急的事情来处理。

examples.en: Just as a matter of interest (= because it is interesting, not because it is important), how much did you pay for it?
examples.zh: 我只是感兴趣，你这是花多少钱买的？

examples.en: ‘I think this is the best so far.’ ‘Well, that's a matter of opinion (= other people may think differently).’
examples.zh: “我认为这是迄今为止最好的。”“唔，仁者见仁，智者见智嘛。”

examples.en: It's not pure fantasy ! It's a plain matter of fact.
examples.zh: 这不是纯粹的幻想！这是明显的事实。

examples.en: Getting the effect you want is a matter of trial and error.
examples.zh: 要得到想要的效果需要反复试验。

examples.en: That's not a problem. It's simply a matter of letting people know in time.
examples.zh: 这没问题，不就是及时通知大家吗。

examples.en: Planning a project is just a matter of working out the right order to do things in.
examples.zh: 规划一个项目就是要设计出正确的工作顺序。

senses.group: a matter of (doing) something 关乎…

senses.def: physical substance that everything in the world is made of; not mind or spirit

examples.en: to study the properties of matter
examples.zh: 研究物质的属性

examples.en: This swirling mass of energy and matter is classed as a spiral galaxy.
examples.zh: 这种由能量和物质组成的漩涡团被归类为螺旋星系。

senses.def: a substance or things of a particular sort

examples.en: Add plenty of organic matter to improve the soil.
examples.zh: 施用大量的有机肥料以改良土壤。

examples.en: elimination of waste matter from the body
examples.zh: 体内废物的排除

examples.en: She didn't approve of their choice of reading matter.
examples.zh: 她不赞同他们选用的阅读材料。

examples.en: There were small lumps of matter floating on the surface.
examples.zh: 表面漂浮着一些小块的物质。

senses.def: used to add a comment on something that you have just said, usually adding something that you think the other person will be interested in

examples.en: It's a nice place. We've stayed there ourselves, as a matter of fact.
examples.zh: 那个地方不错。事实上，我们在那儿待过。

senses.def: used to disagree with something that somebody has just said

examples.en: ‘I suppose you'll be leaving soon, then?’ ‘No, as a matter of fact I'll be staying for another two years.’
examples.zh: “我想你快要离开了吧？”“不。事实上，我还要再待两年呢。”

senses.def: to be very different
senses.zh: 另外一回事；又是一回事；另当别论

examples.en: I know which area they live in, but whether I can find their house is a different matter.
examples.zh: 我知道他们住在哪一地区，但能不能找到他们的房子则是另外一回事了。

examples.en: That's a whole different matter.
examples.zh: 那完全是另一回事儿。

examples.en: I don't mind lizards, but snakes are a different matter.
examples.zh: 我不怕蜥蜴，但蛇就不同了。

senses.def: to be something serious that you should not joke about
senses.zh: 不是开玩笑的事；严肃的事

senses.def: used to emphasize a statement, especially one that is the opposite of what has just been mentioned
senses.zh: （用以强调，尤其与刚提到的相反）事实上，实际上

examples.en: A new car would be wonderful but the fact of the matter is that we can't afford one.
examples.zh: 有新车好是好，不过实际情况是我们买不起。

senses.def: used to add a comment on something that you have just said

examples.en: I didn't like it much. Nor did the kids, for that matter.
examples.zh: 我不怎么喜欢它。孩子们也同样不喜欢。

senses.def: used to say that something will definitely happen, although you are not sure when
senses.zh: 早晚的事；只是时间问题

examples.en: It's only a matter of time before they bring out their own version of the software.
examples.zh: 他们推出自己的软件只是个时间问题。

senses.def: (as) the usual and correct thing to do
senses.zh: （作为）理所当然的事；（当作）常规

examples.en: We always check people's addresses as a matter of course.
examples.zh: 我们总是照例核对一下人们的地址。

senses.def: only a few hours, minutes, etc.
senses.zh: 只有几个小时、几分钟（或几英寸、几米等）之多；不多于…

examples.en: It was all over in a matter of minutes.
examples.zh: 几分钟就全部结束了。

examples.en: The bullet missed her by a matter of inches.
examples.zh: 子弹几乎擦着她的身体飞过。

senses.def: used to describe a situation that is very important or serious
senses.zh: 生死攸关的事；成败的关键

examples.en: You mustn't let anyone know— it's a matter of life and death.
examples.zh: 你千万别告诉任何人－这可是件生死攸关的事。

examples.en: These talks are a matter of life or death for the factory.
examples.zh: 这些谈判对于工厂来说是生死攸关的问题。

examples.en: Delivering on time is a matter of life and death for a small company.
examples.zh: 是否按订单准时交货对小公司来说关乎存亡。

examples.zh: 如果事情不成，没关系，我再租一两年。

examples.zh: 不管你如何小心，这些东西都维持不了很久。

examples.zh: 无论什么时间，你到了那儿就给我打电话。

senses.zh: 事关紧要；要紧；有重大影响

examples.zh: “很抱歉，我又忘了把那本书带来了。”“没事儿。”

examples.zh: “你说什么？”“噢，没什么。”

examples.zh: 他死了以后，好像一切都无所谓了。

examples.zh: 她试图引起重要人物的注意。

examples.zh: 对于她来说，在这个世界上没有比孩子更重要的了。

examples.zh: 议员们正在解决对当地人最重要的事情。

examples.zh: 是谁干的真的很重要吗？

examples.zh: 无论你走多快（=不会有任何区别），你都会被淋湿。

examples.en: It doesn't matter to me what you do.
examples.zh: 你做什么我无所谓。

examples.en: It didn't matter that the weather was bad.
examples.zh: 天气不好并没什么影响。

examples.en: What does it matter if I spent $100 on it—it's my money!
examples.zh: 我花 100 美元买这东西有什么问题，那是我的钱！

examples.en: As long as you're happy, that's all that matters.
examples.zh: 你幸福就行了，这才是最重要的。

examples.en: He's been in prison, you know—not that it matters (= that information does not affect my opinion of him).

examples.zh: 有三种尺寸，分别是小号、中号和大号。

examples.en: a man of medium height/build
examples.zh: 中等身材的人

examples.en: a medium steak (= one cooked quite well but not too much)
examples.zh: 一份中等大小的牛排（= 一块煮得很好，但不要太多）

examples.en: Cook over a medium heat for 15 minutes.
examples.zh: 用中火煮 15 分钟。

examples.en: a medium dry white wine
examples.zh: 半干白葡萄酒

examples.en: Choose medium to large tomatoes.
examples.zh: 挑选个头中等到大个的西红柿。

senses.def: used to describe what will happen a long, short, etc. time in the future

examples.en: Such a development seems unlikely, at least in the short term (= it will not happen for quite a long time).
examples.zh: 发生这样的情况看来可能性不大，起码短期之内应当如此。

examples.en: In the longer term, children of depressed mothers are more likely to suffer from childhood depression.
examples.zh: 从长远来看，抑郁母亲的孩子更有可能患上童年抑郁症。

examples.en: In the long term, our efforts will pay off.
examples.zh: 从长远来看，我们的努力会得到回报。

senses.def: a way of communicating information, etc. to people
senses.zh: （传播信息等的）媒介，手段，方法

examples.en: the medium of radio/television
examples.zh: 广播／电视媒介

examples.en: electronic/audiovisual media
examples.zh: 电子／视听媒体

examples.en: The internet is the modern medium of communication.
examples.zh: 网络是现代传媒。

examples.en: A T-shirt can be an excellent medium for getting your message across.
examples.zh: T 恤衫可以成为一种极好的信息传递媒介。

senses.def: something that is used for a particular purpose

examples.en: English is the medium of instruction (= the language used to teach other subjects).
examples.zh: 用英语进行教学。

examples.en: Video is a good medium for learning a foreign language.
examples.zh: 视频是学习外语的一种好方法。

senses.def: the material used for storing computer files, such as on magnetic tape
senses.zh: 存储介质（如磁带或光盘）

examples.en: Copy files to and from the device as you would with any other storage medium.
examples.zh: 就像使用任何其他存储介质一样，将文件复制到设备或从设备复制文件。

senses.def: the material or the form that an artist, a writer or a musician uses
senses.zh: （文艺创作中使用的）材料，形式

examples.en: the medium of paint/poetry/drama
examples.zh: 绘画／诗歌／戏剧的表现手法

examples.en: Watercolour is his favourite medium.
examples.zh: 水彩画是他最喜欢的表现方式。

senses.def: a substance that something exists or grows in or that it travels through

examples.en: The bacteria were growing in a sugar medium.
examples.zh: 细菌在糖基中生长。

senses.def: a person who claims to be able to communicate with the spirits of dead people

senses.def: of average size

examples.zh: 中波 648 米

senses.zh: （伤员等的）空运救护，飞行送院

senses.zh: 欧楂果（开始凋萎时方能食用）

senses.def: a mixture of people or things of different kinds
senses.zh: 混杂物；混合物；混杂的人群

examples.en: a medley of flavours/smells
examples.zh: 各种味道／气味混合在一起

examples.en: The building was a medley of styles from different periods.
examples.zh: 该建筑融合了不同时期的风格。

senses.def: a swimming race in which swimmers use a different stroke

senses.def: a type of French red wine
senses.zh: 美达克（法国西南部一地区）红酒

senses.def: medicine; medication

examples.en: He’d forgotten to take his meds.
examples.zh: 他忘了吃药。

senses.def: the part of the brain that controls the way the heart and lungs work
senses.zh: 延髓（大脑最下部，位于脊髓顶端，控制心跳、血压以及呼吸）

senses.def: quiet, gentle, and always ready to do what other people want without expressing your own opinion

examples.en: They called her Miss Mouse because she was so meek and mild.
examples.zh: 他们称她为“鼠小姐”，因为她总是那么懦弱温和。

examples.en: They hung their heads in meek submission.
examples.zh: 他们温顺地低着头。

senses.def: people who are meek

examples.en: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
examples.zh: 温柔的人有福了，因为他们必承受土地。

senses.def: quietly, without protesting or expressing your own opinion

examples.en: He meekly did as he was told.
examples.zh: 他顺从地按要求去做了。

senses.def: the quality of being quiet, gentle, and always ready to do what other people want without expressing your own opinion
a small southern African animal with a long tail, which often stands up on its back legs. Meerkats
to be in the same place as somebody by chance and talk to them

examples.en: Maybe we'll meet again some time.
examples.zh: 说不定我们什么时候还会再见面。

examples.en: Did you meet anyone in town?
examples.zh: 你在城里碰见什么人了吗？

examples.en: I've never met anyone like her.
examples.zh: 我从没见过像她这样的人。

examples.en: A year or so later I happened to meet him again.
examples.zh: 大约一年后我碰巧又遇见了他。

examples.en: I hope we'll meet again soon.
examples.zh: 希望我们很快再见面。

senses.def: to come together formally in order to discuss something

examples.en: The committee meets on Fridays.
examples.zh: 委员会每周五开会。

examples.en: The Prime Minister met other European leaders for talks.
examples.zh: 首相与其他欧洲首脑举行会谈。

examples.en: The President met with senior White House aides.
examples.zh: 总统会见了白宫的高级幕僚。

examples.en: The evening gave collectors the opportunity to meet with leading art dealers.
examples.zh: 当晚，收藏家有机会与领先的艺术品经销商见面。

examples.en: They met to discuss the project while both were in Paris.
examples.zh: 他们俩在巴黎时见面讨论了这个项目。

senses.def: to come together socially after you have arranged it

examples.en: The town needs a space where young people can meet.
examples.zh: 这个小镇需要一个年轻人可以聚会的空间。

examples.en: Let's meet for a drink after work.
examples.zh: 下班后我们一起去喝一杯吧。

examples.en: We're meeting them outside the theatre at 7.
examples.zh: 我们 7 点钟在剧院外面和他们会合。

examples.en: I met a friend for a walk round the lake.
examples.zh: 我遇见一个朋友在湖边散步。

senses.def: to go to a place and wait there for a particular person or thing to arrive

examples.en: Will you meet me at the airport?
examples.zh: 你到机场接我好吗？

examples.en: The hotel bus meets all incoming flights.
examples.zh: 所有抵达航班，酒店都有车接机。

examples.en: I met him off the train.
examples.zh: 我到火车站接他了。

senses.def: to see and know somebody for the first time; to be introduced to somebody
senses.zh: 相识；结识；被引见介绍（给某人）

examples.en: I don't think we've met.
examples.zh: 我想我们没见过面吧。

examples.en: Where did you first meet your husband?
examples.zh: 你是在哪儿和你丈夫初次相识的？

examples.en: Pleased to meet you (= when you first meet somebody).
examples.zh: 很高兴认识你。（用于初次见面）

examples.en: Nice meeting you (= when you leave somebody after meeting them for the first time).
examples.zh: 认识你很高兴。（用于初次见面后分手时）

examples.en: There's someone I want you to meet.
examples.zh: 我想介绍你认识一个人。

examples.en: Have you met Miranda?
examples.zh: 你见过米兰达了吗？

examples.en: I love meeting people.
examples.zh: 我喜欢与人结识。

examples.en: When these two finally met, the connection was electric.
examples.zh: 这两人终于见上面的时候，气氛很是热烈。

examples.en: the place where they had first met
examples.zh: 他们初次见面的地方

examples.en: an interactive site where people can meet online
examples.zh: 人们可以在线会面的交互式网站

examples.en: Jasper Johns worked at various jobs before meeting Rauschenberg in 1954.
examples.zh: 贾斯珀·琼斯 (Jasper Johns) 在 1954 年遇见劳森伯格之前曾从事过多种工作。

senses.group: for the first time 初次

senses.def: to do or satisfy what is needed or what somebody asks for

examples.en: How can we best meet the needs of all the different groups?
examples.zh: 我们如何才能最好地满足各个群体的需要呢？

examples.en: The airport must be expanded to meet demand.
examples.zh: 必须扩建机场以满足需求。

examples.en: He had failed to meet his performance targets.
examples.zh: 他未能达到自己的绩效目标。

examples.en: to meet a challenge/goal
examples.zh: 迎接挑战/目标

examples.en: The oil industry is working to meet clean air requirements.
examples.zh: 石油工业正在努力满足清洁空气的要求。

examples.en: Patients were included in the study if they met the following criteria.
examples.zh: 如果患者符合以下标准，则被纳入研究。

examples.en: 50% of the candidates failed to meet the standard required.
examples.zh: 50%的申请人达不到指定的标准。

examples.en: Until these conditions are met, we cannot proceed with the sale.
examples.zh: 除非这些条件得到满足，否则我们不能继续这项交易。

examples.en: I can't possibly meet that deadline.
examples.zh: 我不可能如期完成。

senses.def: to play, fight, etc. together as opponents in a competition

examples.en: Smith and Jones met in last year's final.
examples.zh: 史密斯和琼斯在去年的决赛中相遇。

examples.en: Smith met Jones in last year's final.
examples.zh: 在去年的决赛中，史密斯与琼斯交锋。

senses.def: to experience something, often something unpleasant

examples.en: Others have met similar problems.
examples.zh: 其他人遇到过同样的问题。

examples.en: How she met her death will probably never be known.
examples.zh: 她的死因也许永远无人知晓。

examples.en: They were determined to meet the challenge head-on.
examples.zh: 他们决心直面挑战。

senses.def: to be received or treated by somebody in a particular way
senses.zh: 遭遇（某事）；受到某种对待

examples.en: The announcement was met by loud boos from fans.
examples.zh: 这一宣布遭到了球迷的大声嘘声。

senses.def: to touch something; to join

examples.en: The curtains don't meet in the middle.
examples.zh: 这窗帘中间合不拢。

examples.en: That's where the river meets the sea.
examples.zh: 这条河就在这里流入大海。

examples.en: His hand met hers.
examples.zh: 他的手碰到她的手。

senses.def: to pay something

examples.en: The cost will be met by the company.
examples.zh: 费用将由公司支付。

senses.def: to meet somebody who is equal to or even better than you in strength, skill or intelligence

examples.en: He thought he could beat anyone at chess but he’s met his match in Peter.
examples.zh: 他认为自己可以在国际象棋比赛中击败任何人，但他在彼得身上遇到了对手。

senses.def: to earn just enough money to be able to buy the things you need
senses.zh: 使收支相抵；勉强维持生计

examples.en: Many families struggle to make ends meet.
examples.zh: 许多家庭只能勉强维持生计。

senses.def: if you meet somebody’s eye(s)

examples.en: She was afraid to meet my eye.
examples.zh: 她不敢和我对视。

examples.en: Their eyes met across the crowded room.
examples.zh: 他们隔着拥挤的房间目光相遇了。

examples.en: She met his gaze without flinching.
examples.zh: 她毫不畏缩地与他对视。

senses.def: if a sight meets your eyes

examples.en: A terrible sight met their eyes.
examples.zh: 一幅可怕的景象映入他们的眼帘。

senses.def: to reach an agreement with somebody by giving them part of what they want
senses.zh: 和某人妥协；对某人作出让步

examples.en: If he was prepared to apologize, the least she could do was meet him halfway and accept some of the blame.
examples.zh: 如果他准备道歉，她至少可以向他妥协，承担一些责任。

senses.zh: 接受考验的时刻；检验成败的时刻；检验真伪的时刻

examples.zh: 检验成败的时刻到了：消费者真的会购买这种产品吗？

examples.en: a track meet

intro.en: These words all mean to write or speak about somebody/​something, often in order to give an example or prove something.

examples.zh: 没人跟我提过这事儿。

examples.zh: 我答应过再不提这事了。

senses.def: (1913-2010) a British Labour politician. He was Secretary of State
senses.zh: 迈克尔·富特（Michael Foot）：（1913-2010）英国劳工政治家。1980年至1983年，当工党输掉大选时，他曾担任国务卿（1974-6），下议院领袖（1976-9）和工党领袖。他以左翼观点（例如反对核武器）而闻名，但作为思想家，演说家和作家，他受到英国政治两方面的尊重。

senses.def: (1905-90) an English film director. He is best known for the films he made with his partner Emeric Pressburger in the 1940s and 1950s. Films such as The Life and Death of Colonel Blimp

senses.def: (1908-85) an English actor. He is especially remembered for his stage roles in plays by Shakespeare
