senses.def: to be something that only exists in somebody’s imagination

examples.en: These problems are all in your mind, you know.
examples.zh: 你知道，这些问题都只是你的凭空想象而已。

senses.def: to remember somebody/something; to remember or consider that…
senses.zh: 将…记在心中；记住；考虑到

examples.en: You don't have to do anything about it now… just bear it in mind.
examples.zh: 你现在不需要做任何事情......只要记住它即可。

senses.def: to be extremely bored, etc.
senses.zh: 感到非常无聊（或害怕等）；烂醉如泥；晕头转向

senses.def: if something is etched
senses.zh: 铭记在心；永志不忘；牢记心头

senses.def: if something is etched
senses.zh: 铭记在心；永志不忘；牢记心头

senses.def: to be unable to decide what you think about somebody/something, or whether to do something or not

examples.en: I was in two minds about the book (= I didn't know if I liked it or not).
examples.zh: 我说不清我是否喜欢这本书。

examples.en: She's in two minds about accepting his invitation.
examples.zh: 是否接受他的邀请，她犹豫不决。

senses.def: to think very hard about one particular thing

examples.en: She bent her mind to the problem of escape.
examples.zh: 她一心想着逃跑的问题。

senses.def: to think very hard about or put a lot of effort into one particular thing

examples.en: She bent her mind to the problem of escape.
examples.zh: 她一心想着逃跑的问题。

senses.def: to have the same opinion about somebody/something
senses.zh: 对…意见一致；对…看法相同

senses.def: to be unable to think or behave in a reasonable way, especially because of extreme shock or worry
senses.zh: 无法以合理的方式思考或行为，尤其是因为极度震惊或担忧

examples.en: You're lending them money? You must be out of your tiny mind!
examples.zh: 你要把钱借给他们？你真是疯到家了。

senses.def: to be extremely worried, etc.
senses.zh: 极度焦虑（或愁苦等）；忧心忡忡

senses.def: to produce a very strong feeling of pleasure or shock

examples.en: Wait till you hear this. It'll blow your mind.
examples.zh: 等着听听这个吧。它会让你大感意外的。

examples.en: a collection of photographs that will blow your mind
examples.zh: 将会冲击你大脑的一批照片

senses.def: if something boggles the mind
senses.zh: 使人无法想象；使人难以接受

examples.en: The vastness of space really boggles the mind.
examples.zh: 太空之辽阔的确使人难以想象。

examples.en: ‘He says he's married to his cats!’ ‘The mind boggles!’
examples.zh: “他说他和他的那些猫结婚了！”“难以置信！”

senses.def: to remember somebody/something

examples.en: She couldn't call to mind where she had seen him before.
examples.zh: 她想不起来曾在哪里见过他。

senses.def: to remind you of somebody/something

examples.en: The painting brings to mind some of Picasso's early works.
examples.zh: 这幅油画使人想起了毕加索早期的一些作品。

senses.def: to make yourself think about something that happened in the past

examples.en: I want you to cast your minds back to the first time you met.
examples.zh: 我要你们回忆初次见面的情景。

senses.def: to change a decision or an opinion

examples.en: Nothing will make me change my mind.
examples.zh: 什么都不能让我改变主意。

examples.en: What made you change your mind?
examples.zh: 是什么使你改变主意的？

senses.def: an act of changing what you think about a situation, etc.
to refuse to think about something as a possibility
senses.zh: 对…拒不考虑（或置之不理、置若罔闻）

senses.def: if something comes/springs to mind

examples.en: When discussing influential modern artists, three names immediately come to mind.
examples.zh: 讨论现代有影响力的艺术家时，有三个名字一下子出现在脑海中。

examples.en: I'm sure someone can help you, but no one immediately springs to mind.
examples.zh: 我相信一定有人能帮到你，但一时又想不起来有谁。

senses.def: to come into your mind

examples.en: It never crossed my mind that she might lose (= I was sure that she would win).
examples.zh: 我从来没想过她会失败。

examples.en: The thought never crossed my mind!
examples.zh: 我一点儿都没想到过这个！

senses.def: to tell somebody that you think their behaviour is bad or are angry with them
senses.zh: 对某人的行为表示不满；对某人发火

senses.def: used to say that you and another person must both be very clever because you have had the same idea or agree about something
used to say that you think you will do something, although you are not sure
senses.zh: 想去做某事，可能会做某事（但不确定）

examples.en: I've half a mind to come with you tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天我可能会和你一起去。

senses.def: used to say that you think that what somebody has done is bad and should do something about it, although you probably will not
senses.zh: 很想做某事（以示警告，但未必会做）

examples.en: I've a good mind to write and tell your parents about it.
examples.zh: 我真想写信给你父母，告诉他们这件事。

senses.def: to be thinking of somebody/something, especially for a particular job, etc.
senses.zh: 心中有适当人选（或想做的事等）

examples.en: Do you have anyone in mind for this job?
examples.zh: 你有没有想到什么人可以做这项工作？

examples.en: Watching TV all evening wasn't exactly what I had in mind!
examples.zh: 我才不愿整个晚上看电视呢！

examples.en: What kind of party do you have in mind?
examples.zh: 你打算举办什么样的聚会？

senses.def: to intend to do something

examples.en: For a long time he had it in mind to write a novel about his experiences.
examples.zh: 很长一段时间以来，他一直想写一部关于自己经历的小说。

senses.def: to have a very bad memory; to forget things easily
to have your own opinion and make your own decisions without being influenced by other people

examples.en: She has a mind of her own and isn't afraid to say what she thinks.
examples.zh: 她有主见，并且敢于表达自己的观点。

examples.en: My computer seems to have a mind of its own!
examples.zh: 我的电脑好像也有它自己的想法！

senses.def: to be willing to listen to or accept new ideas or suggestions
senses.zh: 愿意聆听（或接受）意见；（对…）不怀成见；思想开明

examples.en: Try to keep an open mind until you've heard all the facts.
examples.zh: 在听完所有的事实前先不要存任何看法。

senses.def: (not) thinking clearly; (not) able to make sensible decisions
senses.zh: （没有）想清楚；（不）能够做出明智的决定

examples.en: Who in their right mind would spend $50 000 on a pair of shoes?
examples.zh: 哪个心智正常的人会花 50 万美元买一双鞋？

senses.def: to have very clear and definite ideas about what you want to do
senses.zh: 知道自己想做什么；有主见

senses.def: to become mentally ill

examples.en: He feared he was losing his mind.
examples.zh: 他那时害怕自己会失去理智。

senses.def: to decide something

examples.en: They're both beautiful—I can't make up my mind.
examples.zh: 两个都很漂亮，我难以决定。

examples.en: Have you made up your minds where to go for your honeymoon?
examples.zh: 你们决定好到哪里去度蜜月了吗？

examples.en: You'll never persuade him to stay—his mind's made up (= he has definitely decided to go).
examples.zh: 你根本无法劝他留下来，他已经拿定主意了。

examples.en: Come on—it's make your mind up time!
examples.zh: 嗨，你该作出决定了！

senses.def: a close understanding between people with similar ideas, especially when they meet to do something or meet for the first time
senses.zh: 彼此间的深刻理解（尤指初会时就意见一致）

examples.en: a meeting of minds between the two artists
examples.zh: 两位艺术家之间的思想碰撞

senses.def: the use of the power of your mind to deal with physical problems
senses.zh: 精神胜过物质（用精神力量处理物质问题）

examples.en: He said that keeping running in spite of the pain was just a question of mind over matter.
examples.zh: 他说，尽管疼痛，但仍坚持跑步，只是一个思想胜过物质的问题。

senses.def: your imagination

examples.en: He pictured the scene in his mind's eye.
examples.zh: 他想象出了这一场面。

senses.def: to give no attention to somebody/something

examples.en: People call him names sometimes, but he doesn't pay them any mind.
examples.zh: 人们有时会骂他，但他不在乎。

senses.def: not responsible for your actions because of a mental illness
senses.zh: 精神失常，神志不清（无须对自己的行为负责）

senses.def: if somebody/something is on your mind

examples.en: You've been on my mind all day.
examples.zh: 我一整天都在为你担心。

examples.en: Don't bother your father tonight—he's got a lot on his mind.
examples.zh: 今晚就别打扰你父亲了，他的烦心事儿已经够多了。

senses.def: to become or make somebody aware of new ideas or experiences

examples.en: He’s eager to open the minds of his audience to different kinds of music.
examples.zh: 他渴望让听众接受不同类型的音乐。

senses.def: used to say somebody will quickly be forgotten when they are no longer with you
to make somebody think and worry about it all the time

examples.en: The thought that he could have helped more preyed on his mind.
examples.zh: 他本可以帮助更多人，这个念头萦绕在他的心头。

examples.en: It's been preying on my mind ever since it happened.
examples.zh: 事情发生后我的内心就一直在受折磨。

senses.def: to try to forget about something unpleasant
senses.zh: 刻意忘掉（不愉快的事）；把…丢到脑后

examples.en: I tried to push the thought to the back of my mind.
examples.zh: 我尽量把这个念头忘掉。

senses.def: to make somebody think of somebody/something; to remind somebody of somebody/something
to do or say something to make somebody stop worrying about something
to decide you want to achieve something and give this all your attention

examples.en: She could have been a brilliant pianist if she'd put her mind to it.
examples.zh: 如果她专心致志，坚持到底，她本可以成为一名杰出的钢琴家。

examples.en: You can do whatever you set your mind to.
examples.zh: 无论什么事情只要你下定决心就可以去做。

senses.def: to stop thinking about somebody/something; to deliberately forget somebody/something

examples.en: I just can't get her out of my mind.
examples.zh: 我就是忘不掉她。

senses.def: if something slips your mind

examples.en: I’m sorry I didn’t tell you. It completely slipped my mind.
examples.zh: 很抱歉我没有告诉你。我完全忘记了它。

senses.def: to say exactly what you think, in a very direct way
senses.zh: 说心里话；说实在的；坦率地说

examples.en: She’s never hesitated about speaking her mind.
examples.zh: 她从不犹豫说出自己的想法。

examples.en: Everyone should have the right to speak their mind.
examples.zh: 每个人都有权说出自己的想法。

senses.def: to be remembered for a long time

examples.en: One of his paintings in particular sticks in my mind.
examples.zh: 他有一幅画我记得特别清楚。

senses.def: to make you forget about something unpleasant for a short time
senses.zh: 转移一下注意力；暂时将不好的事忘记

examples.en: Painting helped take her mind off her troubles.
examples.zh: 绘画帮助她摆脱了烦恼。

senses.def: in my opinion
senses.zh: 我认为；依我看；依我之见

examples.en: It was a ridiculous thing to do, to my mind.
examples.zh: 依我看，这样做是很荒唐的。

senses.def: a particular way of thinking about things
to be upset, annoyed or worried by something
senses.zh: 对（某事）烦恼，苦恼，焦虑；介意

examples.en: I don't mind the cold—it's the rain I don't like.
examples.zh: 冷我不在乎，我是讨厌下雨。

examples.en: I hope you don't mind the noise.
examples.zh: 希望你不介意这声音。

examples.en: He wouldn't have minded so much if she'd told him the truth.
examples.zh: 如果她把真相告诉他，他就不会那么焦虑了。

examples.en: Did she mind about not getting the job?
examples.zh: 没得到这份工作她是不是很介意？

examples.en: Did she mind not getting the job?
examples.zh: 没得到这份工作她是不是很介意？

examples.en: Do your parents mind you leaving home?
examples.zh: 你父母舍得你离开家吗？

examples.en: Do your parents mind your leaving home?
examples.zh: 你父母舍得你离开家吗？

examples.en: She never minded how hot it was.
examples.zh: 她从不在乎天气有多热。

examples.en: He minded that he hadn't been asked.
examples.zh: 没被邀请，他很是耿耿于怀。

senses.def: used to ask for permission to do something, or to ask somebody in a polite way to do something
senses.zh: （请求允许或客气地请人做事）介意

examples.en: Do you mind if I open the window?
examples.zh: 我开开窗户好吗？

examples.en: Are you married, if you don't mind me asking?
examples.zh: 如果你不介意，请问你结婚了吗？

examples.en: Are you married, if you don't mind my asking?
examples.zh: 如果你不介意，请问你结婚了吗？

examples.en: Would you mind explaining that again, please?
examples.zh: 请你再解释一遍行吗？

examples.en: Do you mind driving? I'm feeling pretty tired.
examples.zh: 你来开车好吗？我太累了。

examples.en: Would you mind terribly if I went on my own?
examples.zh: 如果我自己去，你会很在意吗？

senses.def: to not care or not be concerned about something

examples.en: ‘Would you like tea or coffee?’ ‘I don't mind—either's fine.’
examples.zh: “你要茶还是要咖啡？”“无所谓，什么都行。”

examples.en: Don't mind her—she didn't mean what she said.
examples.zh: 别理她，她只是随便说说。

examples.en: Don't mind me (= don't let me disturb you)—I'll just sit here quietly.
examples.zh: 别管我，我就在这儿静静地坐坐。

senses.group: not care/worry 不关心；不担心

senses.def: to be willing to do something

examples.en: I don't mind helping if you can't find anyone else.
examples.zh: 如果你找不到别人，我乐意帮忙。

examples.en: They had thought the boys wouldn't mind sharing; as it turned out, they minded bitterly.
examples.zh: 他们原以为这些男孩子不会介意跟别人合用，可结果却发现他们十分在意。

senses.def: used to tell somebody to be careful about something or warn them about a danger

examples.en: Mind (= Don't fall on) that step!
examples.zh: 注意台阶！

examples.en: Mind your head! (= for example, be careful you don't hit it on a low ceiling)
examples.zh: 小心，别碰着头！

examples.en: Mind your language! (= don't speak in a rude or offensive way)
examples.zh: 说话注意点！

examples.en: Mind how you go! (= often used when you say goodbye to somebody)
examples.zh: 您走好！

examples.en: Mind where you're treading!
examples.zh: 当心脚下！

examples.en: Mind you don't cut yourself—that knife's very sharp.
examples.zh: 小心别伤着，这刀子快得很。

examples.en: You must be home for dinner, mind.
examples.zh: 记住，你一定得回来吃饭。

senses.def: to pay attention to what somebody says, and obey them

examples.en: And the moral of the story is: always mind your mother!
examples.zh: 这个故事的寓意是：一定要听母亲的话！

senses.def: to take care of somebody/something

examples.en: Who's minding the children this evening?
examples.zh: 今天晚上谁看孩子？

examples.en: Could you mind my bags for a moment?
examples.zh: 你能不能照看一下我的袋子？

senses.def: used to show that you are annoyed about something that somebody has just said or done

examples.en: Do you mind? I was here before you.
examples.zh: 你别这样好不好？我比你先到。

senses.def: used to emphasize what you are saying, especially when you are talking about something that may be embarrassing for you
senses.zh: 我不在乎承认（或告诉等）

examples.en: I was scared, I don't mind telling you!
examples.zh: 说真的，我吓坏了。

senses.def: used to say politely that you would like something you have been offered
senses.zh: （礼貌地表示愿意接受）好的，可以

examples.en: ‘Cup of tea, Brian?’ ‘I don't mind if I do.’
examples.zh: “喝杯茶吧，布赖恩？”“好的。”

senses.def: used to check that somebody does not object to something you want to do, or to ask somebody politely to do something
senses.zh: （想要确保对方不反对，或客气地请人做事）你不会在意吧，你若不介意的话

examples.en: I'd like to ask you a few questions, if you don't mind.
examples.zh: 如果你不介意的话，我想问你几个问题。

examples.en: Can you read that form carefully, if you wouldn't mind, and then sign it.
examples.zh: 请您仔细看一看那份表格，然后签个字，行吗？

senses.def: used to show that you object to something that somebody has said or done
senses.zh: （表示反对某人所做的事或所说的话）如蒙你不在意

examples.en: I give the orders around here, if you don't mind.
examples.zh: 不好意思，在这里我说了算。

senses.def: used to refuse an offer politely

examples.en: ‘Will you come with us tonight?’ ‘I won't, if you don't mind—I've got a lot of work to do.’
examples.zh: “你今晚和我们一起去吗？”“对不起，我不去了，我有好多事要做。”

senses.def: used when you are going to criticize somebody or say something that might upset them
senses.zh: （批评等之前说）你不会在意我这么说吧

examples.en: That colour doesn't really suit you, if you don't mind my saying so.
examples.zh: 这颜色并不十分适合你。我这么说，你不会介意吧。

senses.def: used to say politely that you would very much like something/to do something

examples.en: I wouldn't mind a cup of coffee, if it's no trouble.
examples.zh: 要是不麻烦的话，我很想来杯咖啡。

examples.en: I wouldn't mind having his money!
examples.zh: 我倒是愿意接受他的钱！

senses.def: to be careful about what you say in order not to upset or offend somebody

examples.en: Watch your language, young man!
examples.zh: 年轻人，注意你的措辞！

examples.en: The referee told the players to mind their language.
examples.zh: 裁判让队员注意言辞。

senses.def: to think about your own affairs and not ask questions about or try to get involved in other people’s lives

examples.en: ‘What are you reading?’ ‘Mind your own business!’
examples.zh: “你在读什么呢？”“少管闲事！”

examples.en: I was just sitting there, minding my own business, when a man started shouting at me.
examples.zh: 我就坐在那儿，也没招谁惹谁，忽然有个男人对我大喊大叫。

senses.def: to behave in the most polite way you can
to be in charge of something for a short time while somebody is away

examples.en: Who's minding the shop while the boss is abroad?
examples.zh: 老板出国期间由谁代管？

senses.def: to walk carefully
to behave in a careful and sensible way

examples.en: You’d better watch your step with him if you don’t want trouble.
examples.zh: 如果你不想惹麻烦的话，你最好和他在一起时小心点。

senses.def: used to add something to what you have just said, especially something that makes it less strong
senses.zh: （对刚说过的话加以补充，尤使语气减弱）请注意，告诉你吧

examples.en: I've heard they're getting divorced. Mind you, I'm not surprised—they were always arguing.
examples.zh: 听说他们要离婚了。告诉你吧，我并不感到意外，因为他们总是争吵。

senses.def: used to tell somebody not to worry or be upset

examples.en: Have you broken it? Never mind, we can buy another one.
examples.zh: 你把它打碎了？没关系，我们可以再买一个。

senses.def: used to suggest that something is not important
senses.zh: （表示并不重要）没关系，无所谓

examples.en: This isn't where I intended to take you—but never mind, it's just as good.
examples.zh: 我没想带你到这里来。不过没什么，这里也不错。

senses.def: used to emphasize that what is true about the first thing you have said is even more true about the second

examples.en: I never thought she'd win once, never mind twice!
examples.zh: 我还以为她一次都赢不了，更别说两次了！

senses.def: used to tell somebody they shouldn’t think about something or do something because it is not as important as something else, or because you will do it
senses.zh: （因为某事是次要的，或因为你要做某事）别想它，先别管

examples.en: Never mind your car—what about the damage to my fence?
examples.zh: 先别管你的车，我的围栏撞坏了，怎么办？

examples.en: Never mind washing the dishes—I'll do them later.
examples.zh: 别管洗餐具的事了，等一下我会洗。

senses.def: used to say that one thing is a surprising contrast to another
senses.zh: 不料（表示与之相反的惊人事实）

examples.en: The big house is a status symbol—never mind the fact that most of the rooms will be empty.
examples.zh: 这间大宅子是地位的象征，但实际上大多数房间将会空置。

senses.def: used to tell somebody not to ask about something because you are not going to tell them
senses.zh: （表明不会告诉对方）不要问，别管

examples.en: ‘Who told you about it?’ ‘Never you mind!’
examples.zh: “谁告诉你这事儿的？”“别问了！”

examples.en: Never you mind how I found out—it's true, isn't it?
examples.zh: 别问我是怎么知道的。这是真的，对不对？

senses.def: a British charity that works to help people with mental illnesses. It collects money to pay for support services, gives advice to people who are affected by a mental illness, and aims to make people more aware of mental health issues. It was established in 1946 as the National Association for Mental Health, and changed its name to MIND in 1972. In the 1990s this became Mind.
senses.zh: Mind（英国慈善机构，致力于帮助精神疾病患者。它筹集资金用于支付支持服务费用，向精神疾病患者提供咨询建议，并旨在提高人们对精神健康问题的认识。该机构成立于1946年，最初名为国家精神卫生协会，于1972年改名为MIND。到了1990年代，这个机构变成了Mind。）

items.idm: at/in the back of your mind

senses.def: if a thought, etc. is at the back of your mind

examples.en: At the back of my mind was a small, warning voice, telling me it was wrong.
examples.zh: 我的脑海深处有一个微小的警告声音，告诉我这是错误的。

examples.en: The problem was always at the back of my mind.
examples.zh: 这个问题我一直记着。

senses.def: to be something that only exists in somebody’s imagination

examples.en: These problems are all in your mind, you know.
examples.zh: 你知道，这些问题都只是你的凭空想象而已。

items.idm: bear/keep somebody/something in mind | bear/keep in mind that…

senses.def: to remember somebody/something; to remember or consider that…
senses.zh: 将…记在心中；记住；考虑到

examples.en: You don't have to do anything about it now… just bear it in mind.
examples.zh: 你现在不需要做任何事情......只要记住它即可。

items.idm: be bored, frightened, pissed, stoned, etc. out of your mind

senses.def: to be extremely bored, etc.
senses.zh: 感到非常无聊（或害怕等）；烂醉如泥；晕头转向

items.idm: be etched on your heart/memory/mind

senses.def: if something is etched
senses.zh: 铭记在心；永志不忘；牢记心头

senses.def: if something is etched
senses.zh: 铭记在心；永志不忘；牢记心头

items.idm: be in two minds about something/about doing something

senses.def: to be unable to decide what you think about somebody/something, or whether to do something or not

examples.en: I was in two minds about the book (= I didn't know if I liked it or not).
examples.zh: 我说不清我是否喜欢这本书。

examples.en: She's in two minds about accepting his invitation.
examples.zh: 是否接受他的邀请，她犹豫不决。

senses.def: to think very hard about one particular thing

examples.en: She bent her mind to the problem of escape.
examples.zh: 她一心想着逃跑的问题。

senses.def: to think very hard about or put a lot of effort into one particular thing

examples.en: She bent her mind to the problem of escape.
examples.zh: 她一心想着逃跑的问题。

items.idm: be of one/the same mind (about somebody/something)

senses.def: to have the same opinion about somebody/something
senses.zh: 对…意见一致；对…看法相同

senses.def: to be unable to think or behave in a reasonable way, especially because of extreme shock or worry
senses.zh: 无法以合理的方式思考或行为，尤其是因为极度震惊或担忧

examples.en: You're lending them money? You must be out of your tiny mind!
examples.zh: 你要把钱借给他们？你真是疯到家了。

items.idm: be out of your mind with worry, etc.

senses.def: to be extremely worried, etc.
senses.zh: 极度焦虑（或愁苦等）；忧心忡忡

senses.def: to produce a very strong feeling of pleasure or shock

examples.en: Wait till you hear this. It'll blow your mind.
examples.zh: 等着听听这个吧。它会让你大感意外的。

examples.en: a collection of photographs that will blow your mind
examples.zh: 将会冲击你大脑的一批照片

senses.def: if something boggles the mind
senses.zh: 使人无法想象；使人难以接受

examples.en: The vastness of space really boggles the mind.
examples.zh: 太空之辽阔的确使人难以想象。

examples.en: ‘He says he's married to his cats!’ ‘The mind boggles!’
examples.zh: “他说他和他的那些猫结婚了！”“难以置信！”

senses.def: to remember somebody/something

examples.en: She couldn't call to mind where she had seen him before.
examples.zh: 她想不起来曾在哪里见过他。

senses.def: to remind you of somebody/something

examples.en: The painting brings to mind some of Picasso's early works.
examples.zh: 这幅油画使人想起了毕加索早期的一些作品。

senses.def: to make yourself think about something that happened in the past

examples.en: I want you to cast your minds back to the first time you met.
examples.zh: 我要你们回忆初次见面的情景。

senses.def: to change a decision or an opinion

examples.en: Nothing will make me change my mind.
examples.zh: 什么都不能让我改变主意。

examples.en: What made you change your mind?
examples.zh: 是什么使你改变主意的？

senses.def: an act of changing what you think about a situation, etc.
to refuse to think about something as a possibility
senses.zh: 对…拒不考虑（或置之不理、置若罔闻）

senses.def: if something comes/springs to mind

examples.en: When discussing influential modern artists, three names immediately come to mind.
examples.zh: 讨论现代有影响力的艺术家时，有三个名字一下子出现在脑海中。

examples.en: I'm sure someone can help you, but no one immediately springs to mind.
examples.zh: 我相信一定有人能帮到你，但一时又想不起来有谁。

senses.def: to come into your mind

examples.en: It never crossed my mind that she might lose (= I was sure that she would win).
examples.zh: 我从来没想过她会失败。

examples.en: The thought never crossed my mind!
examples.zh: 我一点儿都没想到过这个！

items.idm: give somebody a piece of your mind

senses.def: to tell somebody that you think their behaviour is bad or are angry with them
senses.zh: 对某人的行为表示不满；对某人发火

senses.def: used to say that you and another person must both be very clever because you have had the same idea or agree about something

items.idm: have a good mind to do something | have half a mind to do something

senses.def: used to say that you think you will do something, although you are not sure
senses.zh: 想去做某事，可能会做某事（但不确定）

examples.en: I've half a mind to come with you tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天我可能会和你一起去。

senses.def: used to say that you think that what somebody has done is bad and should do something about it, although you probably will not
senses.zh: 很想做某事（以示警告，但未必会做）

examples.en: I've a good mind to write and tell your parents about it.
examples.zh: 我真想写信给你父母，告诉他们这件事。

senses.def: to be thinking of somebody/something, especially for a particular job, etc.
senses.zh: 心中有适当人选（或想做的事等）

examples.en: Do you have anyone in mind for this job?
examples.zh: 你有没有想到什么人可以做这项工作？

examples.en: Watching TV all evening wasn't exactly what I had in mind!
examples.zh: 我才不愿整个晚上看电视呢！

examples.en: What kind of party do you have in mind?
examples.zh: 你打算举办什么样的聚会？

items.idm: have it in mind to do something

senses.def: to intend to do something

examples.en: For a long time he had it in mind to write a novel about his experiences.
examples.zh: 很长一段时间以来，他一直想写一部关于自己经历的小说。

items.idm: have a memory/mind like a sieve

senses.def: to have a very bad memory; to forget things easily

items.idm: have a mind of your own

senses.def: to have your own opinion and make your own decisions without being influenced by other people

examples.en: She has a mind of her own and isn't afraid to say what she thinks.
examples.zh: 她有主见，并且敢于表达自己的观点。

examples.en: My computer seems to have a mind of its own!
examples.zh: 我的电脑好像也有它自己的想法！

senses.def: to be willing to listen to or accept new ideas or suggestions
senses.zh: 愿意聆听（或接受）意见；（对…）不怀成见；思想开明

examples.en: Try to keep an open mind until you've heard all the facts.
examples.zh: 在听完所有的事实前先不要存任何看法。

senses.def: (not) thinking clearly; (not) able to make sensible decisions
senses.zh: （没有）想清楚；（不）能够做出明智的决定

examples.en: Who in their right mind would spend $50 000 on a pair of shoes?
examples.zh: 哪个心智正常的人会花 50 万美元买一双鞋？

senses.def: to have very clear and definite ideas about what you want to do
senses.zh: 知道自己想做什么；有主见

senses.def: to become mentally ill

examples.en: He feared he was losing his mind.
examples.zh: 他那时害怕自己会失去理智。

items.idm: make up your mind | make your mind up

senses.def: to decide something

examples.en: They're both beautiful—I can't make up my mind.
examples.zh: 两个都很漂亮，我难以决定。

examples.en: Have you made up your minds where to go for your honeymoon?
examples.zh: 你们决定好到哪里去度蜜月了吗？

examples.en: You'll never persuade him to stay—his mind's made up (= he has definitely decided to go).
examples.zh: 你根本无法劝他留下来，他已经拿定主意了。

examples.en: Come on—it's make your mind up time!
examples.zh: 嗨，你该作出决定了！

senses.def: a close understanding between people with similar ideas, especially when they meet to do something or meet for the first time
senses.zh: 彼此间的深刻理解（尤指初会时就意见一致）

examples.en: a meeting of minds between the two artists
examples.zh: 两位艺术家之间的思想碰撞

senses.def: the use of the power of your mind to deal with physical problems
senses.zh: 精神胜过物质（用精神力量处理物质问题）

examples.en: He said that keeping running in spite of the pain was just a question of mind over matter.
examples.zh: 他说，尽管疼痛，但仍坚持跑步，只是一个思想胜过物质的问题。

senses.def: your imagination

examples.en: He pictured the scene in his mind's eye.
examples.zh: 他想象出了这一场面。

senses.def: to give no attention to somebody/something

examples.en: People call him names sometimes, but he doesn't pay them any mind.
examples.zh: 人们有时会骂他，但他不在乎。

senses.def: not responsible for your actions because of a mental illness
senses.zh: 精神失常，神志不清（无须对自己的行为负责）

senses.def: if somebody/something is on your mind

examples.en: You've been on my mind all day.
examples.zh: 我一整天都在为你担心。

examples.en: Don't bother your father tonight—he's got a lot on his mind.
examples.zh: 今晚就别打扰你父亲了，他的烦心事儿已经够多了。

senses.def: to become or make somebody aware of new ideas or experiences

examples.en: He’s eager to open the minds of his audience to different kinds of music.
examples.zh: 他渴望让听众接受不同类型的音乐。

items.idm: out of sight, out of mind

senses.def: used to say somebody will quickly be forgotten when they are no longer with you
to make somebody think and worry about it all the time

examples.en: The thought that he could have helped more preyed on his mind.
examples.zh: 他本可以帮助更多人，这个念头萦绕在他的心头。

examples.en: It's been preying on my mind ever since it happened.
examples.zh: 事情发生后我的内心就一直在受折磨。

items.idm: push something to the back of your mind

senses.def: to try to forget about something unpleasant
senses.zh: 刻意忘掉（不愉快的事）；把…丢到脑后

examples.en: I tried to push the thought to the back of my mind.
examples.zh: 我尽量把这个念头忘掉。

items.idm: put somebody in mind of somebody/something

senses.def: to make somebody think of somebody/something; to remind somebody of somebody/something
to do or say something to make somebody stop worrying about something

items.idm: put/set/turn your mind to something | set your mind on something

senses.def: to decide you want to achieve something and give this all your attention

examples.en: She could have been a brilliant pianist if she'd put her mind to it.
examples.zh: 如果她专心致志，坚持到底，她本可以成为一名杰出的钢琴家。

examples.en: You can do whatever you set your mind to.
examples.zh: 无论什么事情只要你下定决心就可以去做。

items.idm: put/get something out of your mind

senses.def: to stop thinking about somebody/something; to deliberately forget somebody/something

examples.en: I just can't get her out of my mind.
examples.zh: 我就是忘不掉她。

senses.def: if something slips your mind

examples.en: I’m sorry I didn’t tell you. It completely slipped my mind.
examples.zh: 很抱歉我没有告诉你。我完全忘记了它。

senses.def: to say exactly what you think, in a very direct way
senses.zh: 说心里话；说实在的；坦率地说

examples.en: She’s never hesitated about speaking her mind.
examples.zh: 她从不犹豫说出自己的想法。

examples.en: Everyone should have the right to speak their mind.
examples.zh: 每个人都有权说出自己的想法。

senses.def: to be remembered for a long time

examples.en: One of his paintings in particular sticks in my mind.
examples.zh: 他有一幅画我记得特别清楚。

senses.def: to make you forget about something unpleasant for a short time
senses.zh: 转移一下注意力；暂时将不好的事忘记

examples.en: Painting helped take her mind off her troubles.
examples.zh: 绘画帮助她摆脱了烦恼。

senses.def: in my opinion
senses.zh: 我认为；依我看；依我之见

examples.en: It was a ridiculous thing to do, to my mind.
examples.zh: 依我看，这样做是很荒唐的。

senses.def: a particular way of thinking about things
used to show that you are annoyed about something that somebody has just said or done

examples.en: Do you mind? I was here before you.
examples.zh: 你别这样好不好？我比你先到。

items.idm: I don’t mind admitting, telling you…, etc.

senses.def: used to emphasize what you are saying, especially when you are talking about something that may be embarrassing for you
senses.zh: 我不在乎承认（或告诉等）

examples.en: I was scared, I don't mind telling you!
examples.zh: 说真的，我吓坏了。

items.idm: I don’t mind if I do

senses.def: used to say politely that you would like something you have been offered
senses.zh: （礼貌地表示愿意接受）好的，可以

examples.en: ‘Cup of tea, Brian?’ ‘I don't mind if I do.’
examples.zh: “喝杯茶吧，布赖恩？”“好的。”

items.idm: if you don’t mind | if you wouldn’t mind

senses.def: used to check that somebody does not object to something you want to do, or to ask somebody politely to do something
senses.zh: （想要确保对方不反对，或客气地请人做事）你不会在意吧，你若不介意的话

examples.en: I'd like to ask you a few questions, if you don't mind.
examples.zh: 如果你不介意的话，我想问你几个问题。

examples.en: Can you read that form carefully, if you wouldn't mind, and then sign it.
examples.zh: 请您仔细看一看那份表格，然后签个字，行吗？

senses.def: used to show that you object to something that somebody has said or done
senses.zh: （表示反对某人所做的事或所说的话）如蒙你不在意

examples.en: I give the orders around here, if you don't mind.
examples.zh: 不好意思，在这里我说了算。

senses.def: used to refuse an offer politely

examples.en: ‘Will you come with us tonight?’ ‘I won't, if you don't mind—I've got a lot of work to do.’
examples.zh: “你今晚和我们一起去吗？”“对不起，我不去了，我有好多事要做。”

items.idm: if you don’t mind me/my saying so…

senses.def: used when you are going to criticize somebody or say something that might upset them
senses.zh: （批评等之前说）你不会在意我这么说吧

examples.en: That colour doesn't really suit you, if you don't mind my saying so.
examples.zh: 这颜色并不十分适合你。我这么说，你不会介意吧。

senses.def: used to say politely that you would very much like something/to do something

examples.en: I wouldn't mind a cup of coffee, if it's no trouble.
examples.zh: 要是不麻烦的话，我很想来杯咖啡。

examples.en: I wouldn't mind having his money!
examples.zh: 我倒是愿意接受他的钱！

senses.def: to be careful about what you say in order not to upset or offend somebody

examples.en: Watch your language, young man!
examples.zh: 年轻人，注意你的措辞！

examples.en: The referee told the players to mind their language.
examples.zh: 裁判让队员注意言辞。

senses.def: to think about your own affairs and not ask questions about or try to get involved in other people’s lives

examples.en: ‘What are you reading?’ ‘Mind your own business!’
examples.zh: “你在读什么呢？”“少管闲事！”

examples.en: I was just sitting there, minding my own business, when a man started shouting at me.
examples.zh: 我就坐在那儿，也没招谁惹谁，忽然有个男人对我大喊大叫。

senses.def: to behave in the most polite way you can
to be in charge of something for a short time while somebody is away

examples.en: Who's minding the shop while the boss is abroad?
examples.zh: 老板出国期间由谁代管？

senses.def: to walk carefully
to behave in a careful and sensible way

examples.en: You’d better watch your step with him if you don’t want trouble.
examples.zh: 如果你不想惹麻烦的话，你最好和他在一起时小心点。

senses.def: used to add something to what you have just said, especially something that makes it less strong
senses.zh: （对刚说过的话加以补充，尤使语气减弱）请注意，告诉你吧

examples.en: I've heard they're getting divorced. Mind you, I'm not surprised—they were always arguing.
examples.zh: 听说他们要离婚了。告诉你吧，我并不感到意外，因为他们总是争吵。

senses.def: used to tell somebody not to worry or be upset

examples.en: Have you broken it? Never mind, we can buy another one.
examples.zh: 你把它打碎了？没关系，我们可以再买一个。

senses.def: used to suggest that something is not important
senses.zh: （表示并不重要）没关系，无所谓

examples.en: This isn't where I intended to take you—but never mind, it's just as good.
examples.zh: 我没想带你到这里来。不过没什么，这里也不错。

senses.def: used to emphasize that what is true about the first thing you have said is even more true about the second

examples.en: I never thought she'd win once, never mind twice!
examples.zh: 我还以为她一次都赢不了，更别说两次了！

senses.def: used to tell somebody they shouldn’t think about something or do something because it is not as important as something else, or because you will do it
senses.zh: （因为某事是次要的，或因为你要做某事）别想它，先别管

examples.en: Never mind your car—what about the damage to my fence?
examples.zh: 先别管你的车，我的围栏撞坏了，怎么办？

examples.en: Never mind washing the dishes—I'll do them later.
examples.zh: 别管洗餐具的事了，等一下我会洗。

senses.def: used to say that one thing is a surprising contrast to another
senses.zh: 不料（表示与之相反的惊人事实）

examples.en: The big house is a status symbol—never mind the fact that most of the rooms will be empty.
examples.zh: 这间大宅子是地位的象征，但实际上大多数房间将会空置。

senses.def: used to tell somebody not to ask about something because you are not going to tell them
senses.zh: （表明不会告诉对方）不要问，别管

examples.en: ‘Who told you about it?’ ‘Never you mind!’
examples.zh: “谁告诉你这事儿的？”“别问了！”

examples.en: Never you mind how I found out—it's true, isn't it?
examples.zh: 别问我是怎么知道的。这是真的，对不对？

senses.def: the use of the power of your mind to deal with physical problems
senses.zh: 精神胜过物质（用精神力量处理物质问题）

examples.en: He said that keeping running in spite of the pain was just a question of mind over matter.
examples.zh: 他说，尽管疼痛，但仍坚持跑步，只是一个思想胜过物质的问题。

senses.def: to be in charge of something for a short time while somebody is away

examples.en: Who's minding the shop while the boss is abroad?
examples.zh: 老板出国期间由谁代管？

senses.def: to be in charge of something for a short time while somebody is away

examples.en: Who's minding the store while the boss is abroad?
examples.zh: 老板在国外，谁来照管店？

senses.def: used to add something to what you have just said, especially something that makes it less strong
senses.zh: （对刚说过的话加以补充，尤使语气减弱）请注意，告诉你吧

examples.en: I've heard they're getting divorced. Mind you, I'm not surprised—they were always arguing.
examples.zh: 听说他们要离婚了。告诉你吧，我并不感到意外，因为他们总是争吵。

senses.def: to behave in the most polite way you can
causing changes in the brain that affect mood or thoughts

examples.en: Taking mind-altering drugs can affect your concentration.
examples.zh: 服用致幻药物会影响专注力。

examples.en: mind-altering substances/chemicals
examples.zh: 致幻物质／化学品

senses.def: having a strong effect on your mind, like a drug
senses.zh: 改变心理状态的，致幻的，使人极度兴奋的（如毒品）

examples.en: a mind-bending experience/concept/drug
examples.zh: 令人恍惚的经历；烧脑的概念；致幻药物

senses.def: very exciting, impressive or surprising
senses.zh: 非常令人兴奋的；给人印象极深的；非常令人吃惊的

examples.en: Watching your baby being born is a mind-blowing experience.
examples.zh: 看你的孩子出生是一次非常难忘的经历。

examples.en: the mind-blowing beauty of Africa
examples.zh: 非洲令人惊叹的美丽

senses.def: very difficult to imagine or to understand; extremely surprising
senses.zh: 难以想象的；难以理解的；令人惊愕的

examples.en: a problem of mind-boggling complexity
examples.zh: 复杂得难以想象的问题

examples.en: It’s mind-boggling to me that this is allowed to happen.
examples.zh: 让我难以置信的是，竟然允许这种事发生。

senses.def: something that you do or say in order to make somebody feel less confident, especially to gain an advantage for yourself
senses.zh: （尤指为了压倒对方而展开的）心理游戏，心理战术

examples.en: Don't believe him—he likes to play mind games with people.
examples.zh: 别相信他——他喜欢和人玩心理游戏。

senses.def: a diagram that presents information with a central idea in the middle and connected ideas arranged around it

examples.en: For each topic covered, create a mind map.
examples.zh: 对于涵盖的每个主题，创建一个思维导图。

senses.def: very boring
senses.zh: 非常乏味的；令人厌烦的

examples.en: mind-numbing conversation
examples.zh: 很无聊的谈话

senses.def: in a way that is extremely boring
senses.zh: 非常乏味地；令人厌烦地

examples.en: The lecture was mind-numbingly tedious.
examples.zh: 这堂课乏味透顶。

senses.def: used to tell somebody to move so that you can pass

examples.en: Mind out—you're in the way there!
examples.zh: 请让一让，你挡着路啦！

senses.def: used to warn somebody of danger

examples.en: Have some of my plum jam—but mind out for the stones.
examples.zh: 尝尝我的李子酱，但得当心有核儿。

senses.def: a person who knows what somebody else is thinking without being told

examples.en: What do you mean exactly? I’m not a mind reader!
examples.zh: 你到底是什么意思？我不是读心术的人！

senses.def: to be careful about what you say in order not to upset or offend somebody

examples.en: Watch your language, young man!
examples.zh: 年轻人，注意你的措辞！

examples.en: The referee told the players to mind their language.
examples.zh: 裁判让队员注意言辞。

senses.def: to walk carefully
to behave in a careful and sensible way

examples.en: You’d better watch your step with him if you don’t want trouble.
examples.zh: 如果你不想惹麻烦的话，你最好和他在一起时小心点。

senses.def: a person whose job is to take care of and protect another person

examples.en: a star surrounded by her minders
examples.zh: 被保镖簇拥着的女明星

examples.en: Her minders hurried her past the journalists and into a waiting car.

senses.zh: 英国煤矿工人多次罢工，给政府带来了重大问题。 1972 年，全国矿工联盟 (NUM) 经其成员投票后发起罢工，要求增加工资。英国各地停电（=电力供应中断），宣布进入紧急状态，矿工们获胜，获得了大幅加薪。 1974年，矿工们再次投票支持全国罢工，保守党爱德华·希思(Edward Heath)就政府和矿工在国家中谁拥有更多权力的问题召开了大选。保守党在选举中失败，新工党政府大幅提高矿工工资，结束了罢工。 1984-5年，矿工们再次举行罢工，因为当时负责英国所有矿山的国家煤炭委员会计划关闭多个矿山，导致超过2万个工作岗位流失。保守党首相玛格丽特·撒切尔认为这次罢工是对旨在削弱工会权力的新劳资关系法的一次考验。罢工期间，矿工和警察之间发生了很多暴力事件，但随着罢工的持续，越来越多的矿工重返工作岗位，最终没有达成任何协议而结束。因此，政府获胜，而国民党失败。从那时起，大多数矿井都关闭了，许多矿工失业了。

examples.zh: 他觉得这本书歪曲了他的观点。

examples.zh: 现在不走我就赶不上飞机了。

examples.zh: 你父亲非常惦念你。

senses.zh: 孤独的心小姐：美国作家纳塔奈尔·韦斯特（Nathanael West）创作的小说（1933年）。它是在大萧条时期写的，是关于人类的苦难的。这是一个记者的故事，该记者以“孤独之心小姐”的名字作为报纸专栏的作者，为有个人问题的读者提供建议。当他过多地与他的一位读者接触时，他就被杀死了。寂寞的心专栏一词有时用于表示处理人们个人问题的定期报纸特刊。

senses.zh: 六姐妹的姓氏，其中五人因各种原因成名。南希·米特福德（Nancy Mitford，1904-73 年）创作了有关上流社会家庭女孩的幽默小说，包括《爱情的追求》（1945 年）和《寒冷气候下的爱情》（1949 年）。 1956年，她写了一篇文章，用“U”和“non-U”等表达方式来描述上流社会接受或不接受的语言和行为，这些表达方式成为语言的一部分。杰西卡·米特福德（Jessica Mitford，1917-96 年）也成为一名作家，以其左翼政治观点而闻名。她写的《荣誉与叛逆》（Hons and Rebels，1960）讲述了她自己和她的姐妹们儿时的生活。她后来住在美国，她的著作包括有关美国殡葬业的《美国死亡方式》（1963 年）。戴安娜·米特福德（Diana Mitford，1916-2003 年）和尤尼蒂·米特福德（Unity Mitford，1914-48 年）因同情法西斯而闻名。 1936 年，戴安娜王妃与英国法西斯领导人奥斯瓦尔德·莫斯利结婚，尤妮蒂成为阿道夫·希特勒的密友。最小的妹妹黛博拉·米特福德（Deborah Mitford，1920-2014 年）嫁给了德文郡公爵的儿子，并于 1950 年成为德文郡公爵夫人。当查茨沃斯家族的豪宅向公众开放时，她积极参与管理这座豪宅。

examples.zh: 酒只可少量饮用。

examples.zh: 她总是衣着朴素。

examples.zh: 我们发现改进现有设备比购买新设备要便宜些。

examples.zh: 请您稍等一下，好吗？

examples.zh: 请稍候。

examples.en: He thought for a moment before replying.
examples.zh: 他想了一下才回答。

examples.en: For one brief moment I thought, ‘I can handle this.’
examples.zh: 有那么一瞬间，我想：“我能处理好这件事。”

examples.zh: 我一会儿就回来。

examples.zh: 你这会儿有时间吗？

examples.zh: 这用不了多少时间。

examples.zh: 我们到得一点也不早。

examples.en: Moments later (= a very short time later), I heard a terrible crash.
examples.zh: 过了一会儿，我听到一声可怕的撞击声。

examples.en: We're busy at the moment (= now).
examples.zh: 我们这会儿很忙。

examples.en: At that very moment, the phone rang.
examples.zh: 就在那时，电话铃响了。

examples.zh: 你要时刻清楚自己在干些什么。

examples.en: I agreed in a moment of weakness.
examples.zh: 我一时心软就答应了。

examples.en: From that moment on, she never felt really well again.
examples.zh: 从那时候开始，她就再也没真正好受过。

senses.def: a good time for doing something; an opportunity

examples.en: I'm waiting for the right moment to tell him the bad news.
examples.zh: 我得找个适当的时机告诉他这个坏消息。

examples.en: Have I caught you at a bad moment?
examples.zh: 我是不是来得不是时候？

senses.def: a particular time in somebody's life, or in the course of an event or the development of something
senses.zh: （人生、事件或事物发展过程中的）一段时光，一段时间

examples.en: That was one of the happiest moments of my life.
examples.zh: 那是我一生中最快乐的一段时光。

examples.en: Her finest moment came when she won Wimbledon.
examples.zh: 赢得温布尔登网球赛是她最得意的时刻。

examples.en: The film has many memorable moments.
examples.zh: 这部电影有许多难忘的片段。

examples.en: a great moment in the country's history
examples.zh: 该国历史上的一个重要时刻

examples.en: This referendum is a defining moment for our nation.
examples.zh: 这次公投是我们国家的一个决定性时刻。

examples.en: I managed to capture the moment on film.
examples.zh: 我设法把这一刻拍了下来。

examples.en: Enjoy your moment of fame!
examples.zh: 享受你的高光时刻吧！

examples.en: Hurry up! He'll be back any moment now.
examples.zh: 快点！他随时都会回来。

examples.en: He might wake up at any moment.
examples.zh: 他随时都可能醒过来。

senses.def: not long in advance; without warning or time for preparation
senses.zh: 随时；一经通知立即；没有准备时间

examples.en: This was the best room we could get at such short notice.
examples.zh: 这是我们临时能弄到的最好的房间了。

examples.en: You must be ready to leave at a moment's notice.
examples.zh: 你必须随时准备出发。

senses.def: now, at the present time

examples.en: At this moment in time, I don't know what my decision will be.
examples.zh: 此时此刻，我不知道自己会作出什么决定。

senses.def: to be popular for a short time (used about something that is not usually popular)

examples.en: The previously unfashionable Tyrol is currently having a moment.
examples.zh: 以前不流行的蒂罗尔现在正迎来一段辉煌的时刻。

examples.en: Classic '70s hairstyles are having a moment once more.
examples.zh: 20 世纪 70 年代的经典发型如今再次流行。

senses.def: to not act normally for a short time, for example when you forget where you are or what you are doing
senses.zh: 一时不在状态；一时恍惚

examples.en: Sorry, I was just having a moment. What time is it?
examples.zh: 对不起，我有点犯糊涂。现在几点了？

examples.en: Oh, sorry—were you two having a moment?
examples.zh: 哦，对不起，你们俩刚才不方便打扰？

senses.def: for now; for a short time

examples.en: This house is big enough for the moment, but we'll have to move if we have children.
examples.zh: 这房子现在还够大。要是有了孩子，我们还得搬。

examples.en: The job isn't exciting all the time, but it has its moments.
examples.zh: 这工作并不总是很带劲，但也有让人兴奋的时候。

examples.en: I found the play rather boring, but it had its moments.
examples.zh: 我觉得这部剧很无聊，但也有它的精彩时刻。

examples.en: The time goes so quickly—you just have to remember to stay in the moment.
examples.zh: 时间过得太快了，你只需要记住活在当下。

examples.zh: 事到临头他们却改变了计划。

examples.en: Don't leave your decision to the last moment.
examples.zh: 别等到最后一刻才来作决定。

senses.def: as soon as…

examples.en: I want to see him the moment he arrives.
examples.zh: 他一到我就要见到他。

examples.en: The moment she walked through the door I thought she looked different.
examples.zh: 当她走进门的那一刻，我觉得她看起来不一样了。

examples.en: I felt at home here from the very moment I arrived.
examples.zh: 从我到这儿的那一刻起我就有回到家的感觉。

senses.def: a time when somebody/something is tested, or when important decisions are made
senses.zh: 考验的时刻；（决策的）关键时刻

examples.zh: 关键时刻是实习飞行员接管飞机控制权的时刻。

senses.def: certainly not; not at all

examples.en: I don't think for a moment that she'll accept but you can ask her.
examples.zh: 我觉得她一定不会接受的，不过你可以去问问她。

senses.def: very important

examples.en: matters of great moment
examples.zh: 极其重要的事

senses.zh: 红极一时；盛行一时；广为谈论

examples.en: She's the fashion designer of the moment.
examples.zh: 她是当前最红的时装设计师。

senses.def: suddenly, without planning in advance
senses.zh: 一时冲动之下；心血来潮

examples.en: I phoned him up on the spur of the moment.
examples.zh: 我一时冲动，给他打了电话。

examples.en: a spur-of-the-moment decision
examples.zh: 心血来潮的决定

examples.zh: 诀窍在于找到（正确的）心理时刻向他要更多的钱。

senses.def: to claim that your side of an argument is morally better than your opponents’ side; to argue in a way that makes your side seem morally better

senses.group: person needing food 需要食物的人

senses.def: the place where a river joins the sea

examples.en: A number of industries sprang up around the mouth of the river.
examples.zh: 河口周边涌现出一批工业企业。

examples.en: Pelicans are found close to river mouths.
examples.zh: 在河口附近发现了鹈鹕。

examples.en: the mouth of a cave/pit
examples.zh: 山洞口；矿井口

examples.en: Up ahead was the tunnel mouth.
examples.zh: 再往前走就是隧道入口。

examples.en: Watch your mouth! (= stop saying things that are rude and/or offensive)
examples.zh: 说话注意点儿！

senses.group: way of speaking 讲话方式

examples.en: a round, wide-mouthed face
examples.zh: 圆脸、宽嘴

examples.en: a narrow-mouthed cave
examples.zh: 洞口狭窄的山洞

senses.def: having a particular way of speaking

examples.en: a rather crude-mouthed individual
examples.zh: 言谈非常粗鲁的人

examples.zh: 这家餐馆并没有做广告，而是依靠口碑来赢得顾客。

examples.zh: 打开信封时，我的心提到了嗓子眼儿。

examples.en: I've warned them to keep their mouths shut about this.
examples.zh: 我警告过他们对此事要守口如瓶。

examples.en: Now she's upset—why couldn't you keep your mouth shut?
examples.zh: 瞧她现在心烦意乱的样子，你就不能闭上嘴？

examples.en: The athletes were warned to keep their mouths shut about politics.
examples.zh: 运动员们被警告不要谈论政治。

senses.def: to make you feel upset or ashamed afterwards
senses.zh: 使后来感到沮丧（或羞耻）；留下坏印象

examples.en: The whole business left a bad taste in my mouth.
examples.zh: 整件事让我苦不堪言。

senses.def: to spend all the money you earn on basic needs such as food without being able to save any money
to refuse or criticize something that is given to you for nothing
senses.zh: 白送的马还看牙口；拒受馈赠；对礼物吹毛求疵

examples.en: I’m never one to look a gift horse in the mouth.
examples.zh: 我从来都不是一个对礼物视而不见的人。

senses.def: used when you realize that you have said something that you should not have said
senses.zh: 我真多嘴；真不该说出来

examples.en: They serve steaks that just melt in your mouth.

senses.zh: （在语言或行为上）使人不安，冒犯别人，使人尴尬

examples.en: I really put my foot in my mouth with Ella—I didn't know she'd split up with Tom.
examples.zh: 我真的对艾拉表示怀疑——我不知道她已经和汤姆分手了。

examples.en: He felt after the interview that the police officers had been trying to put words into his mouth.
examples.zh: 问过话，他感觉警察逼他说出他们要他说的话。

senses.def: to move your lips as if you were saying something, but without making a sound

examples.en: He mouthed a few obscenities at us and then moved off.
examples.zh: 他不出声地朝我们骂了几句脏话，然后走了。

senses.def: to say something that you do not really feel, believe or understand

senses.def: to be careful what you say in order not to offend somebody or make them angry
senses.zh: 说话当心；嘴上留个把门的

senses.def: to talk or complain loudly about something
senses.zh: 大声地讲述；大声地抱怨

senses.def: a small musical instrument that you hold against your lips and play by blowing or taking air in through it
the act of breathing into the mouth of an unconscious person in order to fill their lungs with air

examples.en: He pulled the boy from the river and gave him mouth-to-mouth.
examples.zh: 他把河里的男孩拖上岸并对他做人工呼吸。

senses.def: a small painful area in the mouth
mouth-watering
senses.zh: （食物）令人垂涎的，非常好吃的

examples.en: a mouth-watering display of cakes
examples.zh: 令人垂涎的蛋糕展示

examples.en: mouth-watering travel brochures
examples.zh: 诱人的旅游手册

senses.def: the way an item of food or drink feels in the mouth

examples.en: The drink has a creamy mouthfeel.
examples.zh: 这种饮料口感柔滑细腻。

senses.def: an amount of food or drink that you put in your mouth at one time

examples.en: She took a mouthful of water.
examples.zh: 她喝了一大口水。

examples.en: Thank you, but I couldn’t eat another mouthful.
examples.zh: 谢谢你，但我再也吃不了一口了。

examples.en: He talked eagerly between mouthfuls of salad.
examples.zh: 他一边吃沙拉，一边急切地说话。

senses.def: a word or a phrase that is long and complicated or difficult to pronounce
senses.zh: 又长又拗口的词（或短语）

examples.en: My name’s Zacharias. You can call me Zach if it’s too much of a mouthful.
examples.zh: 我的名字是撒迦利亚。如果太拗口的话，你可以叫我扎克。

examples.en: Dr Solomon’s Anti-Virus Toolkit for Windows (what a mouthful!)
examples.zh: 所罗门博士的 Windows 反病毒工具包（真是拗口！）

senses.def: to speak angrily to somebody, perhaps swearing at them
senses.zh: 对某人恶言恶语；大骂某人

examples.en: He gave the referee a mouthful.
examples.zh: 他给了裁判一口。

senses.def: to say something important

examples.en: You said a mouthful there, buddy.
examples.zh: 老兄，你说到点子上了。

senses.def: to speak angrily to somebody, perhaps swearing at them
senses.zh: 对某人恶言恶语；大骂某人

examples.en: He gave the referee a mouthful.
examples.zh: 他给了裁判一口。

senses.def: to say something important

examples.en: You said a mouthful there, buddy.
examples.zh: 老兄，你说到点子上了。

senses.def: a cover that a sports player wears in their mouth to protect the teeth and gums
the part of a phone or radio device that is next to your mouth when you speak

examples.en: I could see the referee talking into his mouthpiece.
examples.zh: 我可以看到裁判用他的话筒说话。

examples.en: He put his hand over the mouthpiece and called his wife to the phone.
examples.zh: 他用手捂住话筒，叫妻子来接电话。

senses.def: the part of a musical instrument that you place between your lips
a person, newspaper, etc. that speaks to represent another person or group of people

examples.en: The newspaper has become the official mouthpiece of the opposition party.
examples.zh: 这份报纸已经成为反对党的官方喉舌。

examples.en: The Press Secretary serves as the President's mouthpiece.
examples.zh: 新闻部长担任总统的代言人。

examples.en: The media is controlled by the state and acts as a mouthpiece for the ruling party.
examples.zh: 这家媒体由国家控制，是执政党的喉舌。

senses.def: a liquid used to make the mouth fresh and healthy
used to describe a person who talks a lot, sometimes expressing their opinions strongly and in a rude way

examples.en: I know she can be mouthy and annoying at times but she's a really good friend who'll always stand by you.
examples.zh: 我知道她有时会多嘴而且烦人，但她是一个真正的好朋友，会永远支持你。

senses.def: that can be moved from one place or position to another

examples.en: movable partitions
examples.zh: 可移动的隔板

examples.en: a doll with a movable head
examples.zh: 头可活动的洋娃娃

senses.def: able to be taken from one house, etc. to another
a thing that can be moved from one house, etc. to another; a personal possession
a religious festival, such as Easter, whose date changes from year to year
senses.zh: 因年而异的宗教节日（日期每年都可有变化）

examples.en: Precise launch times for new products are something of a movable feast.
examples.zh: 新产品的准确发布时间是一场流动的盛宴。

senses.def: to change position or make somebody/something change position in a way that can be seen, heard or felt

examples.en: Don't move—stay perfectly still.
examples.zh: 别动，一点都别动。

examples.en: The bus was already moving when I jumped onto it.
examples.zh: 我跳上车的时候，公共汽车已经开动了。

examples.en: The ball was really moving (= moving fast) when it reached him.
examples.zh: 当球到达他身边时，它确实在移动（=移动得很快）。

examples.en: He could hear someone moving around in the room above.
examples.zh: 他能听到楼上屋里有人走动。

examples.en: Phil moved towards the window.
examples.zh: 菲尔朝窗户走去。

examples.en: You can hardly move in this pub on Saturdays (= because it is so crowded).
examples.zh: 这家酒吧星期六总是挤得令人无法挪动。

examples.en: You can't move for books in her room.
examples.zh: 她的屋里书多得让人挪不开步。

examples.en: Temperatures will drop as the cold front moves down across France.
examples.zh: 随着冷锋席卷法国，气温将会下降。

examples.en: I can't move my fingers.
examples.zh: 我的手指动不了了。

examples.en: We moved our chairs a little nearer.
examples.zh: 我们把椅子挪近了一点。

examples.en: She moved the ball toward the opponent's goal.
examples.zh: 她将球移向对手的球门。

examples.en: He moved his arm away from his face.
examples.zh: 他将手臂从脸上移开。

senses.def: to change the place where you live, have your work, etc.

examples.en: We don't like it here so we've decided to move.
examples.zh: 我们不喜欢这地方，所以决定搬走。

examples.en: The company's moving to Scotland.
examples.zh: 公司准备迁往苏格兰。

examples.en: People move from place to place today in ever greater numbers.
examples.zh: 如今，人们从一个地方搬到另一个地方的人数越来越多。

examples.en: She's been all on her own since her daughter moved away.
examples.zh: 自从她女儿搬走以后，她一直独自生活。

examples.en: We moved house last week.
examples.zh: 我们上星期搬家了。

senses.def: to make somebody change from one job, class, etc. to another

examples.en: I'm being moved to the New York office.
examples.zh: 我要调到纽约办事处去。

senses.def: to change the position of a piece

examples.en: It's your turn to move.
examples.zh: 该你走棋了。

examples.en: She moved her queen.
examples.zh: 她走了一步王后棋。

senses.group: in board games 桌面游戏

senses.def: to leave, begin something, etc. quickly

examples.en: Let's move—it's time we went shopping.
examples.zh: 我们走吧，该去买东西了。

senses.def: to change; to change something

examples.en: The government has not moved on this issue.
examples.zh: 政府在这个问题上立场没有转变。

examples.en: Things have moved on a lot since the days when I was young.
examples.zh: 自从我年轻的时候以来，事情已经发生了很大的变化。

examples.en: Let's move the meeting to Wednesday.
examples.zh: 我们把开会时间改到星期三吧。

senses.group: change ideas/time 改变主意／时间

senses.def: to make progress in the way or direction mentioned

examples.en: Time is moving on.
examples.zh: 时代在进步。

examples.en: Share prices moved ahead today.
examples.zh: 今天的股票价格上升了。

examples.en: After that, things moved forward at lightning speed
examples.zh: 此后，事情以迅雷不及掩耳之势向前推进

examples.en: Things are not moving as fast as we hoped.
examples.zh: 事情的进展不像我们希望的那么快。

examples.en: Things certainly move fast in the blogosphere.
examples.zh: 博客圈里的事情发展确实很快。

examples.en: Finally things are moving in the right direction.
examples.zh: 事情终于朝着正确的方向发展了。

senses.def: to take action; to do something

examples.en: The police moved quickly to dispel the rumours.
examples.zh: 警察迅速采取行动来消除谣言。

examples.en: The firm has moved to reassure customers that they will continue to provide good service.
examples.zh: 该公司已采取行动向客户保证他们将继续提供优质服务。

senses.def: to cause somebody to have strong feelings, especially of sympathy or of being sad
senses.zh: 使感动（尤指因为同情或悲伤）；打动

examples.en: We were deeply moved by her plight.
examples.zh: 她的困境深深地打动了我们。

examples.en: Grown men were moved to tears at the horrific scenes.
examples.zh: 这样悲惨的场面甚至让铮铮汉子潸然泪下。

senses.def: to cause somebody to do something
senses.zh: 促使，迫使（某人做某事）；使去做

examples.en: She felt moved to address the crowd.
examples.zh: 她不由得想给大家讲一番话。

examples.en: He works when the spirit moves him (= when he wants to).
examples.zh: 他只有在想干活的时候才干活。

senses.group: make somebody do something 促使

senses.def: to sell goods; to be sold

examples.en: How quickly can we move this stock?
examples.zh: 这批货我们能多快脱手？

examples.en: These copies are moving fast—they'll soon be sold out.
examples.zh: 这些副本的销售速度很快，很快就会售空。

senses.def: to suggest something formally so that it can be discussed and decided

examples.en: The Opposition moved an amendment to the Bill.
examples.zh: 反对党对法案提出修正案。

examples.en: I move that a vote be taken on this.
examples.zh: 我提议就此进行投票。

senses.def: a rude way of telling somebody to hurry

examples.en: If you get your ass in gear, we can make it out of here tonight.
examples.zh: 如果你全力以赴，我们今晚就可以离开这里。

senses.def: to begin, leave, etc. quickly
senses.zh: 马上行动；迅速开始（或离去等）

examples.en: It's late—we'd better get moving.
examples.zh: 天不早了，咱们走吧。

senses.def: to cause something to make progress

examples.en: The new director has really got things moving.
examples.zh: 新来的主任确实使事情有了进展。

senses.def: in the future, starting from now

examples.en: We have a very solid financial position going forward.
examples.zh: 今后我们会有非常稳健的财务状况。

examples.en: The strategy going forward is still undecided.
examples.zh: 未来的策略尚未确定。

examples.en: Moving forward, we need to have a real plan.
examples.zh: 展望未来，我们需要有一个真正的计划。

senses.def: to change and develop your ideas, way of working, etc. so that you do what is modern and what is expected

examples.en: Many complained that the Royal Family had failed to move with the times.
examples.zh: 许多人抱怨王室未能与时俱进。

senses.def: a rude way of telling somebody to hurry

examples.en: If you move your ass, we can make it out of here tonight.
examples.zh: 如果你动动你的屁股，我们今晚就可以离开这里。

senses.def: to do everything you possibly can in order to achieve something
to do something more quickly because there is not much time

examples.en: Move it! We’re going to be late!
examples.zh: 快点！我们要迟到了！

senses.def: to make a great effort to do something

examples.en: The director moved mountains to remake this classic film.
examples.zh: 导演费尽心血翻拍了这部经典电影。

senses.def: a change of place or position

examples.en: Don't make a move!
examples.zh: 别动！

examples.en: Every move was painful.
examples.zh: 每动一下都很痛。

examples.en: She felt he was watching her every move.
examples.zh: 她觉得他在注意她的一举一动。

synonyms.words: know ▪ recognize ▪ name ▪ make somebody/​something out

intro.en: These words all mean to be able to see or hear somebody/​something and especially to be able to say who or what they are.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含认出、辨别出之义。

items.def: to be able to say who or what somebody/​something is:
items.zh: 指能认出、能辨认出

examples.en: She was able to identify her attacker.
examples.zh: 她认出了袭击她的人。

items.def: to be able to say who or what something is when you see or hear it because you have seen or heard it before Know is used especially to talk about sounds that seem familiar and when somebody recognizes the quality or opportunity that somebody/​something represents:
items.zh: know 尤指认出熟悉的声音、辨别出人或事物所表现出的特质以及发现机会

items.def: to know who somebody is or what something is when you see or hear them/​it, because you have seen or heard them/​it before:
items.zh: 指认识、认出、辨别出

examples.en: I recognized him as soon as he came in the room.
examples.zh: 他一进屋我就认出了他。

items.def: to say the name of somebody/​something in order to show that you know who/​what they are:
items.zh: 指能说出…的名称、叫出…的名字

examples.en: The victim has not yet been named.
examples.zh: 受害人的姓名尚未公布。

items.def: to manage to see or hear somebody/​something that is not very clear:
items.zh: 指看清、听清、分清、辨认清楚

examples.en: I could just make out a figure in the darkness.
examples.zh: 黑暗中我只看出了一个人的轮廓。

senses.def: to publish the names of people or organizations who have done something wrong or illegal

examples.en: Businesses which fail in their duty to protect the environment should be named and shamed.

senses.def: to give the names of the people involved in something, especially something wrong or illegal

examples.en: He has accused the government of corruption and claims he is prepared to name names.

examples.en: Detectives believe that a hitman was sent to silence the witness before he could name names.
examples.zh: 侦探相信有人找杀手在证人作证前灭了口。

senses.def: the act of using rude or offensive words about somebody

examples.en: They were subjected to name-calling and jokes at their expense.

senses.def: to mention the names of famous people you know or have met in order to impress other people
senses.zh: 提到所认识的名人以引起别人的注意

examples.en: He name-dropped relentlessly all evening.
examples.zh: 他整个晚上都在不停地点名。

examples.en: She managed to name-drop eight celebrities within five minutes.
examples.zh: 她在五分钟内成功说出了八位名人的名字。

senses.def: the extent to which the name of a politician, company, brand, etc. is familiar to the public

examples.en: He already has strong name recognition with voters around Iowa.
examples.zh: 他已经在爱荷华州各地的选民中享有很高的知名度。

a small piece of cloth that is sewn

senses.def: a US organization, established in 1899, which tries to persuade the government to pass laws to protect people who buy goods or use services. It is private and does not make a profit. It also informs consumers of their rights, has a National Fraud Information Center and publishes several magazines.
senses.zh: 全国消费者同盟：成立于1899年的美国组织，试图说服政府通过法律来保护购买商品或使用服务的人们。它是私人的，不能赚钱。它还会告知消费者他们的权利，拥有一个国家欺诈信息中心，并出版了几本杂志。

senses.def: a meeting held by a political party, especially in the US, to choose a candidate to take part in the election for President
senses.zh: （尤指美国政党推选总统候选人的）全国代表大会

senses.def: the clothes traditionally worn by people from a particular country, especially on special occasions or for formal ceremonies

examples.en: Some of the singers wore the Welsh national costume.
examples.zh: 一些歌手穿了威尔士的民族服装。

senses.def: a test taken by British primary school children to check their progress in subjects of the National Curriculum
senses.zh: 国家课程测试：英国小学生参加的一项考试，目的是检查他们在国家课程中的学习进度。测试年龄分别为7岁和11岁。通常使用旧名称SAT（标准评估任务）进行测试。

senses.def: the total amount of money that the government of a country owes

examples.en: The country has a national debt of 80% of GNP.
examples.zh: 该国的国债占国民生产总值的80%。

senses.def: any of 155 forests in the US protected and managed by the USDA Forest Service
senses.zh: 国家森林：受美国农业部森林服务局保护和管理的美国155种森林中的任何一种。与国家公园不同，它们被用于商业活动，但以受控方式进行。

senses.def: a forest which is being created in an area of 200 square miles/520 square kilometres in central England, across Leicestershire
senses.zh: 国家森林公园：一种在英格兰中部，横跨莱斯特郡，德比郡和斯塔福德郡的200平方英里/ 520平方公里的地区正在创建的森林。该项目由国家森林公司（National Forest Company）管理，始于1990年，目的是鼓励种植更多的树木，以使三分之一的土地被树木覆盖，该土地过去曾用于采矿。国家森林将几个古老的森林联系在一起。该项目的目的是种植约2000万棵树。

senses.def: a US magazine published each month by the National Geographic Society and available in many countries in different editions. It is famous for its beautiful photographs and maps as well as its articles about different countries, societies and animals. The Society also publishes books and other magazines, and has its own television channel.
senses.zh: 国家地理杂志：美国国家地理学会每月发行的美国杂志，在许多国家有不同版本。它以精美的照片和地图以及有关不同国家，社会和动物的文章而闻名。该协会还出版书籍和其他杂志，并拥有自己的电视频道。

senses.def: the system of power lines that joins the places where electricity is produced, and takes electricity to all parts of the country
(in the UK) a system of payments that have to be made by employers and employees to provide help for people who are sick, old or unemployed

examples.en: to pay National Insurance (contributions)
examples.zh: 缴纳国民保险（缴费）

senses.def: any of several areas of land in Britain that are protected by law in order to preserve the plants and animals that live there, or to preserve other features of the environment. Marine Nature Reserves in Britain also give protection to plants and animals living in areas of water or coastline
senses.zh: 国家自然保护区：英国几处土地上的任何一块，都受到法律保护，以保护居住在该地区的动植物或保护环境的其他特征。英国的海洋自然保护区还保护生活在水或海岸线地区的动植物。

senses.def: an area of land that is protected by the government for people to visit because of its natural beauty and historical or scientific interest

examples.en: Yellowstone National Park
examples.zh: 黄石国家公园

examples.en: The area was designated a national park.
examples.zh: 该地区被指定为国家公园。

senses.def: the US government organization in charge of the National Park System. This includes national parks
senses.zh: 国家公园管理局：负责国家公园系统的美国政府组织。这包括国家公园和其他类型的保护区，包括国家历史公园，国家军事公园，国家古迹，国家纪念馆，国家保护区和国家娱乐区。国家公园管理局由伍德罗·威尔逊总统于1916年建立，是美国内政部的一部分。

senses.def: a system that encourages people to save some of their money and enables the government to borrow money from the people. It used to be known as National Savings and before that as the Post Office Savings Bank (founded in 1861). It used to operate through post offices all over Britain, but now it operates mainly online and by mail. It offers various ways of saving and investing money, including ISAs
senses.zh: 国民储蓄和投资：这是一种鼓励人们储蓄一些钱并使政府能够从人民那里借钱的系统。它以前被称为国民储蓄银行，在此之前被称为邮局储蓄银行（成立于1861年）。它曾经在英国各地的邮局经营，但现在主要在网上和通过邮局经营。它提供了各种储蓄和投资方式，包括ISA和Premium Bonds。英国许多人在NS＆I中有钱，这为政府的公共部门借贷需求筹集了数十亿英镑。

senses.def: an area of natural beauty which is protected and preserved, and which people can visit and enjoy. These areas cover about 15% of Scotland.
senses.zh: 国家风景区（供人游览的自然景观保护区，约占苏格兰面积的 15%）

senses.def: the system in some countries in which young people have to do military training for a period of time

examples.en: to do your national service
examples.zh: 服兵役

senses.def: the policies of the German Nazi party
senses.zh: （德国纳粹党推行的）民族社会主义，纳粹主义

senses.def: a person who supported the policies of the German Nazi party
senses.zh: （德国纳粹党推行的）国家社会主义，纳粹主义

senses.def: supporting or connected with the policies of the German Nazi party
senses.zh: （德国纳粹党推行的）国家社会主义，纳粹主义

senses.def: a long route through beautiful country where people can walk or ride
senses.zh: （修于美丽乡间的）国家级步道，观光道

senses.def: the desire by a group of people who share the same ethnic group

examples.en: Scottish nationalism
examples.zh: 苏格兰国家主义

senses.def: a feeling of loving your country very much and being very proud of it; a feeling that your country is better than any other
senses.zh: 民族主义；民族自豪感；民族优越感

examples.en: The war was fuelled by aggressive nationalism and feelings of cultural superiority.
examples.zh: 这场战争因激进的民族主义和文化优越感而进一步激发。

senses.def: wanting your country to become independent

examples.en: the nationalist movement/party
examples.zh: 民族主义运动/政党

senses.def: loving your country very much and being very proud of it; feeling that your country is better than any other
senses.zh: 民族主义者；怀有本民族优越感者

examples.en: nationalist sentiments
examples.zh: 民族主义情绪

senses.def: a person who wants their country to become independent

examples.en: Scottish nationalists
examples.zh: 苏格兰国家主义者

examples.en: leading a nationalist uprising
examples.zh: 领导一次民族主义者的起义

senses.def: a person who loves their country very much and is very proud of it; a person who feels that their country is better than any other
loving your country very much and being very proud of it, so that you think that it is better than any other
the legal status of belonging to a particular nation

examples.en: to take/have/hold French nationality
examples.zh: 获得／拥有／持有法国国籍

examples.en: All applicants will be considered regardless of age, sex, religion or nationality.
examples.zh: 所有申请者，不论其年龄、性别、宗教信仰还是国籍，都将被考虑。

examples.en: The college attracts students of all nationalities.
examples.zh: 这所大学吸引着各国的学生。

examples.en: She has dual nationality (= is a citizen of two countries).
examples.zh: 她具有双重国籍。

senses.def: a group of people with the same language, culture and history who form part of a political nation

examples.en: Kazakhstan alone contains more than a hundred nationalities.
examples.zh: 单是哈萨克斯坦就有一百多个民族。

senses.def: the process of putting an industry or a company under the control of the government, which becomes its owner
to put an industry or a company under the control of the government, which becomes its owner

examples.en: The government announced plans to nationalize the public transport system.
examples.zh: 政府宣布了将公共交通系统国有化的计划。

examples.en: nationalized industries
examples.zh: 国有化行业

senses.def: relating to a country as a whole; relating to a particular country
senses.zh: 全国性地；与某国相关地

examples.en: The programme was broadcast nationally.
examples.zh: 这个节目曾在全国播放过。

examples.en: Meetings were held locally and nationally.
examples.zh: 举行的会议有地方性的，也有全国性的。

examples.en: He's a talented athlete who competes nationally and internationally.
examples.zh: 他是一位有才华的运动员，既参加国内比赛，也参加国际比赛。

examples.en: Unemployment in Scotland has only risen by 11.4% compared with 15.8% nationally.
examples.zh: 苏格兰失业率仅上升 11.4%，而全国失业率为 15.8%。

senses.def: the fact or feeling of being a nation
senses.zh: 国籍：成为一个国家的事实或感觉

examples.en: Citizenship is about the sense of nationhood.
examples.zh: 公民身份涉及国家意识。

senses.def: happening or existing in all parts of a particular country
senses.zh: 全国性的；遍及全国的；全国范围的

examples.en: a nationwide campaign
examples.zh: 全国性运动

examples.en: The police conducted a nationwide hunt for the missing prisoners.
examples.zh: 警方在全国范围内寻找失踪的囚犯。

examples.en: The company has over 500 stores nationwide.
examples.zh: 这家公司在全国各地有 500 多家商店。

senses.def: the world's largest building society
senses.zh: 全国范围：世界上最大的建筑协会，在英国许多城镇都有分支机构。它最初成立于1846年，自1970年以来被称为全国性建筑协会。

senses.def: connected with the place where you were born and lived for the first years of your life
senses.zh: 出生地的；儿时居住地的

examples.en: your native land/country/city
examples.zh: 你的故乡／祖国／故里

examples.en: Her native language is Korean.
examples.zh: 她的母语是朝鲜语。

examples.en: It is a long time since he has visited his native Chile.
examples.zh: 他很久没有回故乡智利了。

senses.def: connected with the place where you have always lived or have lived for a long time

examples.en: native Berliners
examples.zh: 土生土长的柏林人

senses.def: connected with the people who originally lived in a country before other people came there

examples.en: The native peoples depend on the forest for their livelihoods.
examples.zh: 土著族群以森林为生。

examples.en: The island's native population began disappearing due to exposure to diseases.
examples.zh: 由于感染疾病，岛上的原住民开始消失。

examples.en: The festival is a celebration of native art and culture.
examples.zh: 这个节日是对本土艺术和文化的庆祝。

senses.def: existing naturally in a place
senses.zh: 原产于某地的；土产的；当地的

examples.en: the native plants of America
examples.zh: 美国的土生植物

examples.en: native species
examples.zh: 当地的物种

examples.en: The tiger is native to India.
examples.zh: 这种虎原产于印度。

examples.en: Some animals are in danger because their native habitat is being destroyed.
examples.zh: 一些动物由于其原生栖息地遭到破坏而处于危险之中。

senses.def: that you have naturally without having to learn it

examples.en: native cunning
examples.zh: 与生俱来的狡猾

examples.en: He had to rely on his native wit.
examples.zh: 他必须依靠他与生俱来的智慧。

senses.def: found in a pure state

examples.en: native gold/silver/copper
examples.zh: 自然金／银／铜

examples.en: Native copper was probably the first metal to be made into tools and weapons.
examples.zh: 天然铜可能是第一种被制成工具和武器的金属。

senses.def: designed for or built into a particular system, especially using the language or computer code associated with a particular computer or processor

examples.en: Native apps still generally perform better than web apps, but the gap is shrinking.
examples.zh: 原生应用程序通常仍然比网络应用程序表现更好，但差距正在缩小。

examples.en: Early programmers worked in native computer code or machine language.
examples.zh: 早期的程序员使用本机计算机代码或机器语言进行工作。

senses.def: to try to live and behave like the local people

examples.en: You will be able to meet local people, eat local food and ‘go native’.
examples.zh: 您将能够结识当地人，品尝当地美食并“回归本土”。

senses.def: a person who was born in a particular country or area
senses.zh: 出生于某国（或某地）的人

examples.en: a native of New York
examples.zh: 纽约人

examples.en: The 18 year-old Rome native excels in ballet, hip-hop and tap.
examples.zh: 这位 18 岁的罗马人擅长芭蕾、嘻哈和踢踏舞。

senses.def: a person who lives in a particular place, especially somebody who has lived there a long time

examples.en: You can always tell the difference between the tourists and the natives.
examples.zh: 游客与当地人之间的区别一望即知。

examples.en: She speaks Italian like a native.
examples.zh: 她的意大利语说得和意大利人一样。

examples.en: Athens in the summer is too hot even for the natives.
examples.zh: 即使对于当地人来说，夏天的雅典也太热了。

senses.def: a word used in the past by Europeans to describe a person who lived in a place originally, before white people arrived there
senses.zh: （旧时欧洲人用以称呼先于白人居住在某地的人）土著

examples.en: disputes between early settlers and natives
examples.zh: 早期移民和土著之间的纷争

senses.def: an animal or a plant that lives or grows naturally in a particular area

examples.en: The kangaroo is a native of Australia.
examples.zh: 袋鼠是产于澳大利亚的动物。

examples.en: The plants are natives of southern European limestone mountains.
examples.zh: 这些植物原产于南欧石灰岩山脉。

senses.def: to try to live and behave like the local people

examples.en: You will be able to meet local people, eat local food and ‘go native’.
examples.zh: 您将能够结识当地人，品尝当地美食并“回归本土”。

senses.def: of or connected with any of the groups of people who were the original people living in America

examples.en: Native American languages
examples.zh: 美洲土著语言

examples.en: She has Native American ancestry.
examples.zh: 她有美洲原住民血统。

senses.def: a member of any of the groups of people who were the original people living in America

examples.en: the cultural heritage of Native Americans
examples.zh: 美洲土著的文化遗产

senses.def: a member of any of the groups of people who were the original people living in what is now Canada; a member of any of the First Nations
senses.zh: 加拿大土著居民；加拿大印第安人（或因纽特人、米提人）

senses.def: a novel (1940) by the African American writer Richard Wright
senses.zh: 土著儿子：非裔美国人作家理查德·赖特（Richard Wright）的小说（1940）这是关于芝加哥一个年轻而贫穷的非洲裔美国人的，因为他的肤色而受到恶劣对待。他杀害了一个白人女孩，并被判处死刑。这本书是对种族主义的强烈攻击，对其他作家也有重大影响。

senses.def: a person who speaks a language as their first language and has not learned it as a foreign language
senses.zh: 说本族语的人；母语使用者

examples.en: Her English vocabulary is better than that of many native speakers I know.
examples.zh: 她的英语词汇量比我认识的许多母语人士都要好。

senses.def: the belief that the rights of people born in a country are more important than those of people who have come to live there from another country

examples.en: The surge in nativism in the country is of great concern.
examples.zh: 该国的本土主义浪潮十分令人担忧。

senses.def: the birth of Jesus Christ, celebrated by Christians at Christmas
a picture or a model of the baby Jesus Christ and the place where he was born
a play about the birth of Jesus Christ, usually performed by children at Christmas
senses.zh: 圣诞剧（通常由儿童于圣诞节时演出）

examples.en: The children always perform a nativity play every Christmas.
examples.zh: 每年圣诞节孩子们都演耶稣诞生的戏剧。

senses.def: North Atlantic Treaty Organization
senses.zh: 北约；北大西洋公约组织

senses.def: the organization which controls aircraft travelling to and from the UK. It has four main centres in England and Scotland.
senses.zh: 英国国家航空交通服务公司（管控往返于英国的航班，在英格兰和苏格兰设四个中心）

senses.def: a long and friendly conversation, especially about unimportant things

examples.en: to have a good natter
examples.zh: 好好聊聊

senses.def: to talk for a long time, especially about unimportant things

examples.en: I can’t stand here nattering—I’ve got work to do.
examples.zh: 我不能站在这里喋喋不休——我还有工作要做。

examples.en: We nattered away for hours.
examples.zh: 我们聊了好几个小时。

examples.en: What are you two nattering on about?
examples.zh: 你们两个在吵什么？

senses.def: a small European toad
in a neat and fashionable way

examples.en: nattily dressed
examples.zh: 穿得神气而整齐。

senses.def: in a way that is well designed or clever

examples.en: nattily getting around the small-screen problem
examples.zh: 巧妙地解决了小屏幕问题

senses.def: neat and fashionable

examples.en: a natty suit
examples.zh: 笔挺时新的套装

senses.def: well designed; clever

examples.en: a natty little briefcase
examples.zh: 设计精巧的小公文包

senses.def: existing in nature; not made or caused by humans

examples.en: the natural world (= of trees, rivers, animals and birds)
examples.zh: 自然界

examples.en: We should respect animals and the natural environment, which is their home.
examples.zh: 我们应该尊重动物和自然环境，因为自然环境是它们的家园。

examples.en: a country’s natural resources (= its coal, oil, forests, etc.)
examples.zh: 一国的自然资源

examples.en: wildlife in its natural habitat
examples.zh: 自然栖息地里的野生生物

examples.en: The natural beauty of flowers inspired Monet's experiments in colour.
examples.zh: 花朵的自然之美激发了莫奈的色彩实验。

examples.en: All the materials used are natural.
examples.zh: 所有使用的材料都是天然的。

examples.en: My hair soon grew back to its natural colour (= after being dyed).
examples.zh: 我的头发很快又长回了原来的颜色。

examples.en: The clothes are available in warm natural colours.
examples.zh: 这些衣服有各种自然的暖色调可供挑选。

senses.def: having little or no processing
senses.zh: 天然的；原味的；未经加工的

examples.en: natural yogurt (= with no flavour added)
examples.zh: 原味酸奶

examples.en: I try to eat a sugar-free, natural food diet.
examples.zh: 我尽量吃无糖的天然食物。

examples.en: Natural treatments have no unwanted side effects.
examples.zh: 自然疗法没有不良副作用。

examples.en: We made bread with a natural raising agent.
examples.zh: 我们用天然膨松剂制作面包。

senses.def: normal; as you would expect
senses.zh: 正常的；自然的；意料之中的

examples.en: to die of natural causes (= not by violence, but normally, of old age)
examples.zh: 自然死亡

examples.en: Singing for her was as natural as breathing.
examples.zh: 唱歌对她来说就像呼吸一样自然。

examples.en: He thought social inequality was all part of the natural order of things.
examples.zh: 他认为社会不平等完全合乎事物的自然规律。

examples.en: She was the natural choice for the job.
examples.zh: 她是那份工作的当然人选。

examples.en: It's only natural to worry about your children.
examples.zh: 为孩子操心是很自然的。

examples.en: It's perfectly natural for you to feel annoyed.
examples.zh: 你感到烦恼，这是再正常不过的了。

examples.en: It's natural that he would want to see his own son.
examples.zh: 他想见自己的儿子是很自然的。

senses.def: used to describe behaviour or abilities that are part of the character that a person or an animal was born with
senses.zh: 天生的；本能的；与生俱来的

examples.en: the natural agility of a cat
examples.zh: 猫天生的敏捷灵活

examples.en: the natural processes of language learning
examples.zh: 学习语言的自然过程

examples.en: She has a natural ability with children.
examples.zh: 她天生懂得与孩子相处。

examples.en: Daniel's natural talent is for engineering.
examples.zh: 丹尼尔的工程学天赋。

examples.en: It was my natural instinct to defend myself.
examples.zh: 保护自己是我的本能。

examples.en: When body temperature is beginning to fall there is a natural tendency to fall asleep.
examples.zh: 当体温开始下降时，人们就会自然地入睡。

senses.def: having an ability that you were born with
senses.zh: 天赋的；天生具有某种能力的

examples.en: He's a natural leader.
examples.zh: 他是个天生的领袖。

examples.en: She's a natural rebel.
examples.zh: 她是一个天生的叛逆者。

senses.def: relaxed and not pretending to be somebody/something different
senses.zh: 不拘束的；不做作的；自然的

examples.en: It's difficult to look natural when you're feeling nervous.
examples.zh: 当你紧张的时候，很难显得轻松自然。

examples.en: There's something really natural about her.
examples.zh: 她身上有一种非常自然的东西。

senses.def: related by blood

examples.en: His natural mother was unable to care for him so he was raised by an aunt.
examples.zh: 他的生母不能照顾他，所以他是姑姑抚养大的。

senses.def: born to parents who are not married

examples.en: She was a natural daughter of King James II.
examples.zh: 她是国王詹姆斯二世的私生女。

senses.def: based on human reason alone
senses.zh: 符合人的理性的；正常的；自然的

examples.en: I am a firm believer in human rights and natural law.
examples.zh: 我坚信人权和自然法。

examples.en: It goes against natural justice to punish a child for the crimes of its parents.
examples.zh: 因为父母的罪行而惩罚孩子是违反自然正义的。

senses.group: based on human reason 符合理性
