examples.zh: 我们决定在第三方领土上会晤。

senses.def: the position of the gears

examples.en: to leave the car in neutral
examples.zh: 将车的排挡置于空挡位

senses.def: a person or country that does not support either side in a disagreement
a colour that is not bright or strong, such as grey or light brown

examples.en: The room was decorated in neutrals.
examples.zh: 房间用了中性色来装饰。

senses.def: in a place that has no connection with either of the people or sides who are meeting and so does not give an advantage to either of them
senses.zh: 在中立地区；在第三方地区

examples.en: We decided to meet on neutral ground.
examples.zh: 我们决定在第三方领土上会晤。

senses.def: an area that covers the central part of the rink
an imaginary area between the teams where no player except the centre
senses.zh: 中立区（比赛开始前对阵双方之间除中锋外的球员不准进入的区域）

senses.def: a person who does not support either side in a war
not supporting either side in a war

examples.en: a neutralist state
examples.zh: 中立国家

senses.def: the state of not supporting either side in a disagreement

examples.en: Switzerland declared its neutrality.
examples.zh: 瑞士宣布中立。

examples.en: I'm afraid we cannot guarantee the neutrality of the courts.
examples.zh: 恐怕我们无法保证法庭的中立性。

senses.def: the act of stopping something from having an effect

examples.en: the neutralization of monetary policy
examples.zh: 货币政策的中性化

senses.def: the act of making a substance neutral

examples.en: the neutralization of peroxides
examples.zh: 过氧化物的中和

senses.def: to stop something from having any effect

examples.en: The latest figures should neutralize the fears of inflation.
examples.zh: 最新的数据应该可以消除对通货膨胀的担忧。

examples.en: This strategy effectively neutralized what the Conservatives had hoped would be a vote-winner.
examples.zh: 这一策略有效地冲淡了保守党希望在选举中获胜的心态。

senses.def: to make a substance neutral

examples.en: Lime was used to neutralize the acidity of the soil.
examples.zh: 石灰用于中和土壤的酸度。

senses.def: to make a country or an area neutral

examples.en: The treaty neutralized the Black Sea.
examples.zh: 该条约使黑海地区保持中立。

senses.def: in a way that does not support or help either side in a disagreement
senses.zh: 中立的；持平的；无倾向性的

examples.en: The facts must be presented neutrally and objectively.
examples.zh: 事实必须中立、客观地呈现。

senses.def: in a way that deliberately does not express any strong feeling

examples.en: ‘Thank you,’ he replied neutrally.
examples.zh: “谢谢，”他中立地回答。

senses.def: with neither a positive nor a negative electrical charge

examples.en: neutrally charged particles
examples.zh: 带中性电荷的粒子

senses.def: an extremely small particle
a very small piece of matter (= a substance)
a bomb that can kill people by giving out neutrons
senses.zh: 中子弹（可杀人，但对建筑物损坏不大）

senses.def: a state in the western US, sometimes called the Silver State because of the large amounts of silver that were discovered there in the 19th century. It consists mostly of desert and mountains. Its capital is Carson City and the largest city is Las Vegas
senses.zh: 内华达（美国西部的州，主要由沙漠和山脉组成。首府卡森城，最大城市拉斯韦加斯）

senses.def: not at any time; not on any occasion

examples.en: You never help me.
examples.zh: 你从不帮我。

examples.en: He'll never forget her.
examples.zh: 他永远也忘不了她。

examples.en: He has never been abroad.
examples.zh: 他从未出过国。

examples.en: She had never seen so much snow.
examples.zh: 她从未见过这么多雪。

examples.en: She left the country, vowing never to return again.
examples.zh: 她离开了这个国家，发誓再也不会回来。

examples.en: ‘Would you vote for him?’ ‘Never.’
examples.zh: “你会投他一票吗？”“决不。”

examples.en: ‘I work for a company called Orion Technology.’ ‘Never heard of them.’
examples.zh: “我在一家名为奥里昂科技的公司工作。”“从来没听说过。”

examples.en: Never in all my life have I seen such a horrible thing.
examples.zh: 我一辈子也没见过这么恐怖的事。

examples.en: Never ever tell anyone your password.
examples.zh: 千万不要把你的密码告诉任何人。

examples.en: Never before has English cuisine been so stylish.
examples.zh: 英国菜从未如此雅致。

senses.def: used to emphasize a negative statement instead of ‘not’
senses.zh: （与 not 同义，语气较强）一点都不，从未

examples.en: I never knew (= didn't know until now) you had a twin sister.
examples.zh: 我从来不知道你还有个双胞胎姐姐。

examples.en: I never realized just how easy it is.
examples.zh: 我从来没有意识到这有多么容易。

examples.en: Someone might find out, and that would never do (= that is not acceptable).
examples.zh: 也许有人会发现，那是绝对不行的。

examples.en: He never so much as smiled (= did not smile even once).
examples.zh: 他从未笑过。

examples.en: Most people have never even heard of Iggy.
examples.zh: 大多数人根本没有听说过伊吉。

examples.en: ‘I told my boss exactly what I thought of her.’ ‘You never did!’ (= ‘Surely you didn't!’)
examples.zh: “我对老板说了我对她的真实看法。”“不可能！”

examples.en: ‘You took my bike.’ ‘No, I never.’
examples.zh: “你把我的自行车骑走了吧。”“没有，我没骑。”

examples.en: Never fear (= Do not worry), everything will be all right.
examples.zh: 别担心，一切都会好的。

senses.def: used to say that nothing is impossible
senses.zh: 不要说不可能；没有不可能的事

examples.en: Many thought the book could not become a movie, but with Hollywood never say never.
examples.zh: 许多人认为这本书不可能改编成电影，但在好莱坞没有不可能的事。

senses.def: on hire purchase

examples.en: to buy a new car on the never-never
examples.zh: 以分期付款的方式购买一辆新车

senses.def: used to express surprise or disapproval
senses.zh: （表示惊奇或不赞同）不会吧，不行的

examples.en: Well, I never! Fancy getting married and not telling us!
examples.zh: 嗬，好家伙！ 想偷偷结婚不告诉我们！

senses.def: used to show that you are very surprised about something because you do not believe it is possible
senses.zh: （表示惊讶，因为觉得不可能）不会吧

examples.en: ‘I got the job.’ ‘Never!’
examples.zh: “我得到那份工作了。”“不可能吧！”

senses.def: used to tell somebody not to worry or be upset

examples.en: Have you broken it? Never mind, we can buy another one.
examples.zh: 你把它打碎了？没关系，我们可以再买一个。

senses.def: used to suggest that something is not important
senses.zh: （表示并不重要）没关系，无所谓

examples.en: This isn't where I intended to take you—but never mind, it's just as good.
examples.zh: 我没想带你到这里来。不过没什么，这里也不错。

senses.def: used to emphasize that what is true about the first thing you have said is even more true about the second

examples.en: I never thought she'd win once, never mind twice!
examples.zh: 我还以为她一次都赢不了，更别说两次了！

senses.def: used to say that nothing is impossible
senses.zh: 不要说不可能；没有不可能的事

examples.zh: 许多人认为这本书不可能改编成电影，但在好莱坞没有不可能的事。

examples.zh: 以分期付款的方式购买一辆新车

senses.zh: （表示惊奇或不赞同）不会吧，不行的

examples.zh: 我没想带你到这里来。不过没什么，这里也不错。

examples.en: I never thought she'd win once, never mind twice!
examples.zh: 我还以为她一次都赢不了，更别说两次了！

senses.def: used to tell somebody never to come to your home again
senses.zh: 再不要跨进我的门槛；再不许踏进我的家门

examples.en: Go! And never darken my door again!
examples.zh: 走吧！ 下次不要再到我家来了！

senses.def: used to tell somebody not to worry or be upset

examples.en: Have you broken it? Never mind, we can buy another one.
examples.zh: 你把它打碎了？没关系，我们可以再买一个。

senses.zh: （表示并不重要）没关系，无所谓

examples.en: This isn't where I intended to take you—but never mind, it's just as good.
examples.zh: 我没想带你到这里来。不过没什么，这里也不错。

examples.en: I never thought she'd win once, never mind twice!
examples.zh: 我还以为她一次都赢不了，更别说两次了！

senses.def: used to tell somebody they shouldn’t think about something or do something because it is not as important as something else, or because you will do it
senses.zh: （因为某事是次要的，或因为你要做某事）别想它，先别管

examples.en: Never mind your car—what about the damage to my fence?
examples.zh: 先别管你的车，我的围栏撞坏了，怎么办？

examples.en: Never mind washing the dishes—I'll do them later.
examples.zh: 别管洗餐具的事了，等一下我会洗。

senses.def: used to say that one thing is a surprising contrast to another
senses.zh: 不料（表示与之相反的惊人事实）

examples.en: The big house is a status symbol—never mind the fact that most of the rooms will be empty.
examples.zh: 这间大宅子是地位的象征，但实际上大多数房间将会空置。

senses.def: do not stop hoping
senses.zh: 别泄气；别气馁；不言放弃

senses.def: used to say that nothing is impossible
senses.zh: 不要说不可能；没有不可能的事

examples.en: Many thought the book could not become a movie, but with Hollywood never say never.
examples.zh: 许多人认为这本书不可能改编成电影，但在好莱坞没有不可能的事。

senses.def: used to say that two things are so different that they cannot exist together
senses.zh: 二者永远合不到一起；泾渭分明；大相径庭

senses.def: to do something a lot, especially in a way that annoys people

examples.en: He went to Harvard—as he never tires of reminding us.
examples.zh: 他上过哈佛，他总是不厌其烦地一再提醒我们这一点。

senses.def: used to tell somebody not to ask about something because you are not going to tell them
senses.zh: （表明不会告诉对方）不要问，别管

examples.en: ‘Who told you about it?’ ‘Never you mind!’
examples.zh: “谁告诉你这事儿的？”“别问了！”

examples.en: Never you mind how I found out—it's true, isn't it?
examples.zh: 别问我是怎么知道的。这是真的，对不对？

senses.def: seeming to last forever
senses.zh: 永无止境的；没完没了的

examples.en: Housework is a never-ending task.
examples.zh: 家务活儿做起来真是没完没了。

senses.def: an imaginary place where everything is wonderful

examples.en: a never-never land of low prices and widespread subsidies
examples.zh: 低廉价格和广泛补贴的理想之地

senses.def: to become more and more successful
senses.zh: 越来越兴旺发达；不断取得成功

examples.en: Her first novel was published in 2007 and since then she hasn't looked back.
examples.zh: 她的第一部小说于 2007 年发表，自此她便一发而不可收。

senses.def: never again
despite something that you have just mentioned

examples.en: There is little chance that we will succeed in changing the law. Nevertheless, it is important that we try.
examples.zh: 我们几乎没有可能改变法律。不过，重要的是我们要努力争取。

examples.en: Our defeat was expected but it is disappointing nevertheless.
examples.zh: 我们的失败是意料中的事，尽管如此，还是令人失望。

examples.en: The old system had its flaws, but nevertheless it was preferable to the new one.
examples.zh: 旧系统有其缺陷，但它比新系统更好。

senses.def: (1869-1940) a British conservative (1937-40) and son of Joseph Chamberlain
senses.zh: 内维尔·张伯伦：（1869-1940）英国保守派（1937-40年）和约瑟夫·张伯伦的儿子。他主要被人们记住他的姑息政策。他于1938年签署了《慕尼黑协定》，试图避免对德国和意大利的战争，但他表示，如果德国进攻波兰，英国将保卫波兰。这导致了第二次世界大战的开始。英国参战后不久，英国军队在挪威被击败，他离开了政府。

senses.def: (1924-2016) an English conductor
senses.zh: 内维尔·马林纳（Neville Marriner）：（1924-2016）是一位英语指挥，他于1959年成立了圣马丁野战学院。他还指挥了美国的乐团。1985年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (a person) from Nevis
senses.zh: 尼维斯人；尼维斯的；尼维斯人的

senses.def: not existing before; recently made, invented, introduced, etc.
senses.zh: 刚出现的；新的；新近推出的

examples.en: Have you read her new novel?
examples.zh: 你看过她新出的小说了吗？

examples.en: We retrain staff to use the new technology.
examples.zh: 我们对员工进行重新培训以使用新技术。

examples.en: The company is trialling a new security system.
examples.zh: 该公司正在试验一种新的安全系统。

examples.en: Have you seen Danielle's new baby?
examples.zh: 你看到丹妮尔的新生儿了吗？

examples.en: a new addition to the family (= a baby)
examples.zh: 家庭的新成员

examples.en: The school secretary wants to introduce new ways of doing things in the office.
examples.zh: 学校秘书想要引入在办公室做事的新方法。

examples.en: This idea isn't new.
examples.zh: 这主意不新鲜。

examples.en: The latest model has over 100 new features.
examples.zh: 最新的款式有一百多种新功能。

examples.en: Check out the band's new album.
examples.zh: 看看乐队的新专辑。

senses.group: not existing before 从前没有

senses.def: something that is new

examples.en: It was a good mix of the old and the new.
examples.zh: 这是新旧的完美结合。

senses.group: not existing before 从前没有

senses.def: recently bought

examples.en: Let me show you my new dress.
examples.zh: 给你看看我新买的连衣裙。

examples.en: The car still looks new.
examples.zh: 这车看上去仍然很新。

examples.en: They are very proud of their spanking new kitchen.
examples.zh: 他们对自己的新厨房感到非常自豪。

senses.def: not used or owned by anyone before
senses.zh: 没被用过的；未曾被人占有过的；崭新的

examples.en: A second-hand car costs a fraction of a new one.
examples.zh: 二手车的花费只是新车的零头。

examples.en: They are building 500 new houses in the town.
examples.zh: 他们正在镇上建造 500 栋新房子。

senses.group: not used before 从未用过

senses.def: different from the previous one

examples.en: I like your new hairstyle.
examples.zh: 我喜欢你的新发型。

examples.en: When do you start your new job?
examples.zh: 你什么时候开始你的新工作？

examples.en: He's made a lot of new friends.
examples.zh: 他交了许多新朋友。

examples.en: Do you have her new phone number?
examples.zh: 你有她的新电话号码吗？

senses.def: already existing but not seen, experienced, etc. before; not familiar
senses.zh: 刚体验到的；初见的；不熟悉的

examples.en: This is a new experience for me.
examples.zh: 对于我来说，这是一次从未有过的经历。

examples.en: I'd like to learn a new language.
examples.zh: 我想学习一门新的语言。

examples.en: the discovery of a new star
examples.zh: 一颗新星的发现

examples.en: Scientists have identified an entirely new species.
examples.zh: 科学家发现了一个全新的物种。

examples.en: Manga is drawing in a whole new generation of readers.
examples.zh: 漫画正在吸引全新一代的读者。

examples.en: to try/learn/do something new
examples.zh: 尝试／学习／做新的事情

examples.en: Our system is probably new to you.
examples.zh: 你也许不熟悉我们的系统。

examples.en: Hard work is nothing new to Bill.
examples.zh: 艰苦的工作对比尔来说并不是什么新鲜事。

senses.def: not yet familiar with something because you have only just started, arrived, etc.
senses.zh: 初来乍到的；初学乍练的；新鲜的

examples.en: You're new here, aren't you?
examples.zh: 你是新来的，是吗？

examples.en: New arrivals should have their passports ready for inspection.
examples.zh: 刚刚到达的人应准备好护照以供检查。

examples.en: We offer intensive training to all new recruits.
examples.zh: 我们对所有新兵进行强化训练。

examples.en: I should tell you, I'm completely new to this kind of work.
examples.zh: 我得告诉你，我干这活儿完全是个新手。

examples.en: I am new to the town.
examples.zh: 我刚刚来到这座小镇。

senses.def: just beginning or beginning again
senses.zh: 刚开始的；初始的；重新开始的

examples.en: a new day
examples.zh: 新的一天

examples.en: It was a new era in the history of our country.
examples.zh: 这是我国历史上的一个新纪元。

examples.en: She went to Australia to start a new life.
examples.zh: 她去澳大利亚开始新的生活了。

senses.def: used in compounds to describe something that has recently happened
senses.zh: （用于构成复合词）新的，新近的

examples.en: He was enjoying his new-found freedom.
examples.zh: 他享受着刚刚获得的自由。

senses.def: modern; of the latest type

examples.en: the new morality
examples.zh: 现代的道德

examples.en: They called themselves the New Romantics.
examples.zh: 他们自称新浪漫主义者。

senses.def: having fresh energy, courage or health
senses.zh: 富有朝气的；生气勃勃的

examples.en: Since he changed jobs he's looked like a new man.
examples.zh: 他跳槽之后像换了一个人似的。

senses.group: with fresh energy 有新鲜活力

senses.def: only recently produced or developed
senses.zh: 新近产生的；新开发的；时鲜的

examples.en: The new buds are appearing on the trees now.
examples.zh: 树上现在露出了新芽。

examples.en: new potatoes (= ones dug from the soil early in the season)
examples.zh: 早土豆

senses.def: a situation or society that changes in a way that is meant to improve people’s lives but is often a source of extra problems
senses.zh: 美好的新世界（本欲改善人们的生活，实则带来预料不到的问题）

examples.en: the brave new world of technology
examples.zh: 科技进步的美好新世界

examples.en: the architects' vision of a brave new world of pristine concrete
examples.zh: 建筑师想象中的由崭新混凝土建筑构成的美好新世界

senses.def: to make a new discovery or do something that has not been done before

examples.en: Her architectural designs have broken new ground.
examples.zh: 她的建筑设计开辟了新天地。

senses.def: to improve something by introducing new ideas and making people more interested in it
senses.zh: （给某事物）带来起色，注入活力

examples.en: The results of their research have breathed new life into the debate.
examples.zh: 他们的研究结果为这场争论注入了新的活力。

senses.def: used to describe a situation in which everybody suddenly realizes that they were wrong to believe that somebody/something was very good, important, etc.
senses.zh: 皇帝的新装；原来皇帝没穿衣服；恍然大悟；如梦初醒

examples.en: Is this artist's white canvas a case of the emperor's new clothes or is it something beautiful, even moving?
examples.zh: 这位艺术家的白色画布是皇帝的新装还是美丽的、甚至令人感动的东西？

examples.en: Soon investors will realize that the emperor has no clothes and there will be a big sell-off in stocks.
examples.zh: 投资者很快会了解事实真相，股票将被大肆抛售。

senses.def: in very good condition, as it was when it was new

examples.en: I've had your coat cleaned—it's as good as new now.
examples.zh: 你的外套洗好了，像新的一样。

senses.def: used to say that something has become very fashionable and can be thought of as replacing something else
senses.zh: （表示某事物已非常时髦，被视为可替代其他事物）

examples.en: Brown is the new black.
examples.zh: 棕色取代了黑色变得时髦起来。

examples.en: Comedy is the new rock and roll.
examples.zh: 喜剧的风头直追摇滚乐。

examples.en: Fifty is the new forty.
examples.zh: 四十尚未老，五十正当年。

senses.def: new members or employees, especially young ones, with new ideas or ways of doing things
senses.zh: 新成员（尤指年轻、有新思想或方法的）；新生力量；新鲜血液

examples.en: This company badly needs to bring in some new blood.
examples.zh: 这家公司急需引进一些新鲜血液。

senses.def: a person who has just started to work for an organization, department, etc., especially in a senior job, and who is likely to make a lot of changes
senses.zh: 新就职者；（尤指）刚上任的新官

examples.en: Well, you know what they say—a new broom sweeps clean.
examples.zh: 唉，你知道他们说什么，新官上任三把火。

senses.def: a person who is new to a place, an organization, etc.

examples.en: Despite his six years in politics, he was still regarded by many as the new kid on the block.
examples.zh: 尽管他已经从政六年，但很多人仍把他视为初出茅庐的新手。

senses.def: a situation that used to be unusual but is now what you should expect

examples.en: This is not a temporary blip—this is the new normal.
examples.zh: 这不是暂时现象，而是新常态。

examples.zh: 壁龛足够大，只能容纳两支小蜡烛。

examples.zh: 在每个生态位内，相似的动物都会避免相互竞争。

senses.def: a novel (1839) by Charles Dickens
senses.zh: 尼古拉斯·尼克尔比：查尔斯·狄更斯的小说（1839年）。尼古拉斯·尼克尔比（Nicholas Nickleby）是一个年轻人，父亲去世后，他必须赚足够的钱养活自己的母亲和妹妹。他首先在邪恶的Wackford Squeers经营的学校Dotheboys Hall担任老师。尼古拉斯对那里的情况以及对一个可怜的男孩Smike的残酷对待感到震惊。尼古拉斯（Nicholas）和斯米克（Smike）一起逃离学校，后来在文森特·克鲁姆斯（Vincent Crummles）运营的一家剧院公司工作。小说中还有许多其他相关的故事，但它的主要重要性在于，它向维多利亚社会展示了其许多学校的恶劣状况，实际上导致许多学校被关闭或改善。

senses.def: (1923-2007) a US journalist and author who became famous with his first novel, The Naked and the Dead
senses.zh: 诺曼·梅勒（Norman Mailer）：（1923-2007）是美国新闻工作者和作家，他的第一本小说《赤裸与死者》（The Naked and Dead）关于第二次世界大战而闻名。他的许多书都是关于真实的人和事的，他赢得了夜间军队的1968年普利策奖，1967年向华盛顿特区的和平游行和1979年的《行刑者之歌》，这是一部基于加里事实的小说。吉尔莫在监狱中。梅勒的其他小说包括《美国梦》（1965），《性囚》（1971），《古代之夜》（1983）和《哈洛的鬼魂》（1991）。他参与了许多自由抗议运动，例如反对越南战争。

senses.def: (1894-1978) a US magazine artist who drew over 300 covers for the Saturday Evening Post

senses.def: (1934-2012) a US military officer and general
senses.zh: 诺曼·施瓦茨科普夫（Norman Schwarzkopf）：( 1934-2012年）美国军官兼将军。在1991年领导美国和盟军在海湾战争中取得成功之后，他开始受到欢迎。他赢得了许多国家的荣誉，包括女王授予的荣誉骑士勋章。由于脾气暴躁，他被称为“ Stormin Norman”。

senses.def: (1898-1993) a US religious leader who wrote The Power of Positive Thinking
senses.zh: 诺曼·文森特·皮尔（Norman Vincent Peale）：（1898-1993）是美国宗教领袖，他撰写了《积极思考的力量》（1952），这是最成功的“自助”书籍之一，为人们提供如何改善生活质量的建议。他也有广播电视节目，并定期在报纸和杂志上撰文。他曾是纽约大理石学院改革教会的负责人（1932-84年）。他的其他著作包括《生活的艺术》（The Art of Living，1948年）和《积极因素的力量》（Power of the Positive Factor，1987年）。

examples.zh: 他在岛上每过一天，就在手杖上刻一个新的记号。

examples.zh: 她提醒自己要向艾伦问问这事。

examples.zh: 自我提醒：为度假多做预订。

examples.en: Just a quick note to say thank you for a wonderful evening.
examples.zh: 仅以此短笺感谢您安排的美好夜晚。

examples.en: She left a note for Ben on the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 她在厨房的餐桌上给本留了个便条。

examples.en: He wrote a note to his parents saying he was leaving.
examples.zh: 他给父母写了一张便条，说他要走了。

senses.zh: （听讲或读书等时的）记录，笔记

examples.en: He sat taking notes of everything that was said.
examples.zh: 他坐在那儿记下了所说的每一件事。

examples.en: Can I borrow your lecture notes?
examples.zh: 我可以借你的课堂笔记看看吗？

examples.en: Patients' medical notes have gone missing.
examples.zh: 患者的病历丢失了。

examples.en: He kept notes on the birds, mammals, reptiles and plants he saw on walks.
examples.zh: 他详细记录了散步时看到的鸟类、哺乳动物、爬行动物和植物。

senses.def: information about a performance, an actor’s career, a piece of music, etc. printed in a special book or on a record cover, etc.
senses.zh: （有关演出、演员经历、音乐等的）图书资料或录音等封套介绍

examples.en: The booklet has full notes on each artist.
examples.zh: 这本小册子对每一位艺人都有详尽的介绍。

examples.en: The catalogue contains detailed notes on each painting.
examples.zh: 该目录包含每幅画的详细注释。

examples.en: The sleeve notes include a short biography of the performers on this recording.
examples.zh: 封套上的介绍包括本唱片中的演奏者生平简介。

examples.en: a new edition of ‘Hamlet’, with explanatory notes
examples.zh: 附注释的新版《哈姆雷特》

examples.en: See note 3, page 259.
examples.zh: 见第 259 页注释 3。

examples.en: a £5 note
examples.zh: 一张面值为 5 英镑的纸币

examples.en: We only exchange notes and traveller's cheques.
examples.zh: 我们只兑换纸币和旅行支票。

examples.en: a thick wad of notes
examples.zh: 厚厚的一沓钞票

senses.def: a single sound of a particular length and pitch

examples.en: He played the first few notes of the tune.
examples.zh: 他演奏了这支曲子开始的几个音。

examples.en: high/low notes
examples.zh: 高音；低音

examples.en: I played a lot of wrong notes because I was so nervous.
examples.zh: 我弹错了好多音，因为我太紧张了。

senses.def: a particular quality in something, for example in somebody’s voice or the atmosphere at an event; a comment on something with a particular quality

examples.en: There was a note of amusement in his voice.
examples.zh: 他的语气中有觉得好笑的意味。

examples.en: It's good to finish on a positive note.
examples.zh: 以积极的调子结束很好。

examples.en: On a more serious note (= speaking more seriously)…
examples.zh: 说点严肃的…

examples.en: On a slightly different note (= changing the subject slightly), let’s talk about…
examples.zh: 咱们略微换一下话题，谈谈…

examples.en: The year ended on an optimistic note.
examples.zh: 这一年以乐观的基调结束。

examples.en: As a side note, the entire festival is free.
examples.zh: 顺便提一下，整个会演是免费的。

examples.en: a sick note from your doctor
examples.zh: 医生开具的病假证明

examples.en: The buyer has to sign a delivery note as proof of receipt.
examples.zh: 购买者必须签收送货单表明货已收到。

examples.en: Students returning to school after absence must bring a note from their parents.
examples.zh: 缺课后返校的学生必须携带家长的便条。

senses.def: an official letter from the representative of one government to another

examples.en: an exchange of diplomatic notes
examples.zh: 外交照会的互换

senses.def: if two or more people compare notes

examples.en: We saw the play separately and compared notes afterwards.
examples.zh: 我们各自看了那出戏，后来交换了意见。

examples.en: Let's compare notes on our experiences.
examples.zh: 让我们就各自的经历交换一下看法吧。

senses.zh: 做（或说、写）得得体／不得体

examples.zh: 这是一个离奇的故事，作者恰到好处地表达了恐惧和难以置信。

examples.zh: 不幸的是，总统在讲话中语调错误，无视公众情绪。

examples.zh: 著名的科学家

examples.zh: 这家博物馆没有什么很有价值的东西。

examples.en: She sounded a note of warning in her speech.
examples.zh: 她在讲话中透出了警告的意味。

examples.en: The touch of cynicism struck a slightly sour note.
examples.zh: 愤世嫉俗的感觉让人感到有点酸涩。

examples.en: Take note of what he says.
examples.zh: 牢记他说的话。

examples.zh: 根据新规则，对非法比赛的处罚加重。玩家们注意了。

examples.en: He took careful note of the suspicious-looking man in the corner of the bar.
examples.zh: 他十分注意酒吧角落里那个形迹可疑的人。

examples.en: The frescoes are worthy of note.
examples.zh: 这些壁画值得关注。

senses.def: to notice or pay careful attention to something

examples.en: Note the fine early Baroque altar inside the chapel.
examples.zh: 注意小教堂里精致的早期巴罗克风格的祭坛。

examples.en: Please note (that) the office will be closed on Monday.
examples.zh: 请注意办事处星期一将关闭。

examples.en: Note how these animals sometimes walk with their tails up in the air.
examples.zh: 注意这些动物有时会翘起尾巴走路。

examples.en: It should be noted that dissertations submitted late will not be accepted.
examples.zh: 注意迟交的论文将不予接受。

examples.en: We are also noted for our delicious home-made patisserie.
examples.zh: 我们美味的自制糕点也引起了注意。

senses.def: to mention something because it is important or interesting

examples.en: There are a few points here that are worth noting.
examples.zh: 这里有几点值得一提。

examples.en: The report noted that deaths on the roads had fallen by 2 per cent in the last year.
examples.zh: 报告指出，去年道路死亡人数下降了 2%。

examples.en: It is worth noting that the most successful companies had the lowest prices.

senses.def: a small advertisement or announcement in a newspaper or magazine

examples.en: notices of births, marriages and deaths
examples.zh: 出生喜报、结婚启事和讣告

senses.def: a short announcement made at the beginning or end of a meeting, a church service, etc.
senses.zh: （会议、宗教活动等开头或结尾时的）通知

examples.en: There are just two notices this week.
examples.zh: 本周只有两项通知。

senses.def: the fact of somebody paying attention to somebody/something or knowing about something

examples.en: Don't take any notice of what you read in the papers.
examples.zh: 别在意你在报上看到的东西。

examples.en: Take no notice of what he says.
examples.zh: 别理会他说的话。

examples.en: These protests have really made the government sit up and take notice (= realize the importance of the situation).
examples.zh: 这些抗议活动着实引起了政府的注意。

examples.en: It was Susan who brought the problem to my notice (= told me about it).
examples.zh: 是苏珊把这个问题告诉我的。

examples.en: Normally, the letter would not have come to my notice (= I would not have known about it).
examples.zh: 通常情况下，我是不会看到这封信的。

examples.en: The work received little notice in the national media.
examples.zh: 全国性媒体并没有怎么留意这一作品。

examples.en: It will not have escaped your notice that there have been some major changes in the company.
examples.zh: 你肯定注意到公司已经发生了一些重大的变化。

senses.def: information or a warning given in advance of something that is going to happen

examples.en: You are welcome to come and stay as long as you give us plenty of notice.
examples.zh: 只要你及早通知，我们都欢迎你来住宿。

examples.en: With this account, you must give 90 days' notice if you want to withdraw money.
examples.zh: 对于此账户，如果您想提款，必须提前 90 天通知。

examples.en: I'm sorry it's such short notice—we didn't know ourselves until today.
examples.zh: 很抱歉，这么晚才通知，我们自己也是直到今天才知道。

examples.en: Prices may be altered without notice.
examples.zh: 价格变动不另行通知。

examples.en: The bar is closed until further notice (= until you are told that it is open again).
examples.zh: 酒吧停止营业，直到另行通知。

examples.en: Councils can issue fixed penalty notices (= sums of money that must be paid) for litter and graffiti.
examples.zh: 市政部门可以对乱丢垃圾者和涂鸦者开定额罚单。

examples.en: This new law serves notice that criminals will not go unpunished.
examples.zh: 这项新法律表明罪犯不会逍遥法外。

senses.def: a formal letter or statement saying that you will or must leave your job or house at the end of a particular period of time

examples.en: He has handed in his notice.
examples.zh: 他递交了辞呈。

examples.en: They gave her two weeks' notice.
examples.zh: 他们给了她通知，限期两周内离开。

examples.en: We received an eviction notice today.
examples.zh: 我们今天收到了强制搬迁通知。

examples.en: 500 workers have been issued with redundancy notices.
examples.zh: 已向 500 名工人发出了裁员通知。

examples.en: Tenants must give written notice to the landlord of their intention to move out of the property.
examples.zh: 租户必须向房东发出书面通知，表明他们打算搬出该房产。

examples.en: Dozens of families on the estate have been given notice to quit (= told to leave their homes).
examples.zh: 该庄园的数十个家庭已收到退出通知（=被告知离开家园）。

examples.en: She's on a week's notice, which doesn't give her long to find another job.
examples.zh: 她在之前一个星期才得到通知，没有足够时间再找一份工作。

senses.group: when leaving job/house 辞职；搬迁

senses.def: a short article in a newspaper or magazine, giving an opinion about a book, play, etc.
senses.zh: （报刊上对书、戏剧等的）评论，短评

examples.en: The play got good notices in the national press.
examples.zh: 该剧在全国媒体上引起了广泛关注。

senses.group: review of book/play 书评；剧评

senses.def: not long in advance; without warning or time for preparation
senses.zh: 随时；一经通知立即；没有准备时间

examples.en: This was the best room we could get at such short notice.
examples.zh: 这是我们临时能弄到的最好的房间了。

examples.en: You must be ready to leave at a moment's notice.
examples.zh: 你必须随时准备出发。

senses.group: review of book/play 书评；剧评

items.idm: at short notice | at a moment’s notice

senses.def: not long in advance; without warning or time for preparation
senses.zh: 随时；一经通知立即；没有准备时间

examples.en: This was the best room we could get at such short notice.
examples.zh: 这是我们临时能弄到的最好的房间了。

examples.en: You must be ready to leave at a moment's notice.
examples.zh: 你必须随时准备出发。

intro.en: These words all mean to see something, especially when you pay careful attention to it.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含看到、注意到之义。

items.def: to see, hear or become aware of somebody/​something; to pay attention to somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指看（或听）到、注意到、意识到、注意、留意

examples.en: The first thing I noticed about the room was the smell.
examples.zh: 我首先注意到的是屋子里的气味。

items.def: (rather formal) to notice or pay careful attention to something:
items.zh: 指注意、留意

examples.en: Please note (that) the office will be closed on Monday.
examples.zh: 请注意办事处星期一将关闭。

items.def: to discover or notice something, especially something that is not easy to see, hear, etc:
items.zh: 指发现、查明、侦察出

examples.en: The tests are designed to detect the disease early.
examples.zh: 这些检查旨在及早查出疾病。

items.def: (formal) to see or notice somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指看到、注意到、观察到

examples.en: Have you observed any changes lately?
examples.zh: 最近你注意到什么变化没有？

items.def: (rather formal) to see something happen:
items.zh: 指当场看到、目击

examples.en: Police have appealed for anyone who witnessed the incident to contact them.
examples.zh: 警方呼吁目击这一事件的人与他们联系。

senses.def: easy to see or notice; clear or definite

examples.en: The new filing system is a noticeable improvement on the old one.
examples.zh: 这种新的存档系统比过去那种有着显著的改进。

examples.en: There is a noticeable difference between the two brands.
examples.zh: 这两个品牌之间有明显的区别。

examples.en: Her scars are hardly noticeable now.
examples.zh: 她的伤疤现在几乎看不出来了。

examples.en: This effect is particularly noticeable in younger patients.
examples.zh: 这种作用在年轻一些的病人身上尤为明显。

examples.en: It was noticeable that none of the family were present.
examples.zh: 很明显这一家没有人在场。

senses.def: in a way that is easy to see or notice; clearly or definitely
senses.zh: 以容易看见或注意的方式；清楚地或明确地

examples.en: Her hand was shaking noticeably.
examples.zh: 她的手明显在颤抖。

examples.en: Marks were noticeably higher for girls than for boys.
examples.zh: 女生的成绩明显高于男生。

examples.en: The question of childcare was noticeably absent from the discussion.
examples.zh: 引人注目的是，儿童保育问题在讨论中未被提及。

senses.def: a board for putting notices on

examples.en: Please check the noticeboard by the library for news of future events.
examples.zh: 有关未来活动讯息，请查看图书馆旁的告示牌。

examples.en: The note was pinned on the church noticeboard.
examples.zh: 这张纸条被钉在教堂的布告栏上。

senses.def: so dangerous or serious that it must by law be reported officially to the authorities
senses.zh: 依法须报告当局的；依法须向官方汇报的

examples.en: Is meningitis a notifiable disease?
examples.zh: 脑膜炎是法定报告疾病吗？

examples.en: notifiable offences
examples.zh: 应予通报的罪行

senses.def: official information of something; the act of giving or receiving this information

examples.en: advance/prior notification (= telling somebody in advance about something)
examples.zh: 预先通告

examples.en: written notification
examples.zh: 书面通知

examples.en: You should receive (a) notification of our decision in the next week.
examples.zh: 关于我们的决定，下周你会接到通知。

examples.en: The police are entitled to inspect the premises without notification.
examples.zh: 警方有权不预先通知就搜查房屋。

examples.en: They failed to give notification of their intention to demolish the building.
examples.zh: 他们没有通知说打算拆除这栋大楼。

senses.def: an automated

examples.en: If you're serious about doing a digital detox, you have to resist checking your notifications.
examples.zh: 如果你当真想做数字排毒，远离电子设备，那就必须忍住不去查看通知。

examples.en: You will receive a notification when your package is delivered.
examples.zh: 包裹送达时，你会收到通知。

senses.def: to formally or officially tell somebody about something

examples.en: Competition winners will be notified by post.
examples.zh: 将发信通知竞赛的优胜者。

examples.en: You must notify us in writing if you wish to cancel your subscription.
examples.zh: 如果您想取消订阅，您必须以书面形式通知我们。

examples.en: The police must be notified of the date of the demonstration.
examples.zh: 必须向警方报告游行示威的日期。

examples.en: The date of the demonstration must be notified to the police.
examples.zh: 游行示威的日期必须报告警方。

examples.en: Members have been notified that there will be a small increase in the fee.
examples.zh: 会员已经得到通知，费用将有小幅上调。

senses.def: an idea, a belief or an understanding of something

examples.en: a political system based on the notions of equality and liberty
examples.zh: 建立在自由平等观念基础上的政治体系

examples.en: She had only a vague notion of what might happen.
examples.zh: 她对可能发生的事只有一个模糊的概念。

examples.en: He has no notion of the difficulty of the problem.
examples.zh: 他不知道问题的难度。

examples.en: The author challenges preconceived notions of storytelling.
examples.zh: 作者对一些关于叙事的固有观念提出质疑。

examples.en: She dismissed the very notion of compromise.
examples.zh: 她驳斥了妥协的概念。

examples.en: I have to reject the notion that greed can be a good thing.
examples.zh: 我不能接受那种认为贪欲也可以是件好事的想法。

examples.en: I haven't the faintest notion how to get there.
examples.zh: 我完全不知道怎么去那里。

examples.en: I don't have any romantic notions about rural living.
examples.zh: 我对农村生活没有任何浪漫的幻想。

senses.def: based on a guess, estimate or theory; not existing in reality
senses.zh: 猜测的；估计的；理论上的；想象的

examples.en: My calculation is based on notional figures, since the actual figures are not yet available.
examples.zh: 我是按估计的数字计算的，因为还没有实际数字。

senses.def: in a way that does not exist in reality but only as an idea or theory
senses.zh: 概念上：以一种不存在于现实中而仅作为一种思想或理论存在的方式

examples.en: This tax cut is notionally for one year, but reversing it would be difficult.
examples.zh: 这次减税名义上为期一年，但扭转它会很困难。

senses.def: the state of being famous for being bad in some way

examples.en: She achieved notoriety for her affair with the senator.
examples.zh: 她因为和参议员私通而声名狼藉。

examples.en: This make of car has a certain notoriety for rust problems.
examples.zh: 这种型号的汽车因生锈问题而声名狼藉。

examples.en: He gained a certain notoriety as a gambler.
examples.zh: 他落了个赌徒的恶名。

senses.def: well known for being bad
senses.zh: 声名狼藉的；臭名昭著的

examples.en: a notorious criminal
examples.zh: 恶名昭彰的罪犯

examples.en: a location made notorious by battles between local gangs
examples.zh: 因当地帮派之间的争斗而臭名昭著的地方

examples.en: The country is notorious for its appalling prison conditions.
examples.zh: 这个国家因监狱状况恶劣而臭名远扬。

examples.en: The bar has become notorious as a meeting-place for drug dealers.
examples.zh: 这家酒吧因作为毒品贩子接头的场所而声名狼藉。

examples.en: an area which is notorious as a centre for drug trafficking
examples.zh: 作为贩毒中心而臭名昭著的地区

senses.def: in a way that is well known for being bad
senses.zh: 声名狼藉的；臭名昭著的

examples.en: Mountain weather is notoriously difficult to predict.
examples.zh: 众所周知，山区天气很难预测。

examples.en: She is notoriously bad at keeping in touch.
examples.zh: 众所周知，她不善于保持联系。

examples.en: The local bus service is notoriously unreliable.
examples.zh: 当地的巴士服务是出了名的不可靠。

senses.def: a fashionable area of west London. It is especially famous for the Notting Hill Carnival
senses.zh: 诺丁山：伦敦西部的时尚地区。它以诺丁山狂欢节（Notting Hill Carnival）而闻名，诺丁山狂欢节是每年八月银行假期在这里举行的丰富多彩的街头节日。

senses.def: a large town in the county of Nottinghamshire
senses.zh: 诺丁汉（诺丁汉郡特伦特河畔的大城镇。传统上以蕾丝行业著称。有一座精美的罗马天主教大教堂和两所大学）

senses.def: one of the two football clubs of Nottingham
senses.zh: 诺丁汉森林：诺丁汉的两个足球俱乐部之一。另一个是诺茨县。

senses.def: a county in the Midlands
senses.zh: 诺丁汉郡：英格兰中部的一个县，以煤炭开采业的中心而闻名（尤其是在过去）。它的行政中心是诺丁汉。

senses.def: one of the two football clubs of Nottingham
senses.zh: 诺茨郡：诺丁汉的两个足球俱乐部之一。另一个是诺丁汉森林。诺茨郡（Notts County）是英国最古老的职业足球俱乐部，始建于1862年。

senses.def: without being affected by something; despite something

examples.en: Notwithstanding some major financial problems, the school has had a successful year.
examples.zh: 虽然有些重大的经费问题，这所学校一年来还是很成功。

examples.en: The bad weather notwithstanding, the event was a great success.
examples.zh: 尽管天气恶劣，活动还是取得了巨大的成功。

senses.def: despite this

examples.en: Notwithstanding, the problem is a significant one.
examples.zh: 然而，这个问题仍很重要。

senses.def: although; despite the fact that

examples.en: He was found guilty, notwithstanding that the evidence was very weak.
examples.zh: 尽管证据非常薄弱，他还是被判有罪。

senses.def: a hard sweet that has to be chewed
senses.zh: 牛轧糖（含果仁、樱桃等，呈粉红色或白色）

senses.def: the figure 0

examples.en: A million is written with six noughts.
examples.zh: 一百万写出来有六个零。

examples.en: nought point one (= written 0.1)
examples.zh: 零点一

examples.en: I give the programme nought out of ten for humour.
examples.zh: 我给这个节目的幽默打零分。

examples.en: This car can accelerate from nought to sixty in ten seconds.
examples.zh: 这辆车可以在十秒内从零加速到六十。

senses.def: used in particular phrases to mean ‘nothing’

examples.en: All our efforts have come to nought (= have not been successful).
examples.zh: 我们所付出的努力都已付诸东流。

senses.def: the week before the start of a new term (= one of the three periods which the academic year is divided into)
senses.zh: 第四周：牛津大学新学期开始前的一周

senses.def: a simple game in which two players take turns to write Os or Xs in a set of nine squares. The first player to complete a row of three Os or three Xs is the winner.
senses.zh: 井字游戏，圈叉游戏（二人轮流在井字形九格中画 O 或 X，先将三个 O 或 X 连成一线者为胜）

senses.def: a word that refers to a person (such as Ann

examples.en: ‘Car’ is a concrete noun.
examples.zh: car 是具体名词。

examples.en: Proper nouns begin with a capital letter.
examples.zh: 专有名词以大写字母开头。

senses.def: a word or group of words in a sentence that behaves in the same way as a noun, that is as a subject, an object, a complement

examples.en: In the sentence ‘I spoke to the driver of the car’, ‘the driver of the car’ is a noun phrase.
examples.zh: 在句子 I spoke to the driver of the car 中，the driver of the car 是名词短语。

senses.def: to keep a person, an animal or a plant alive and healthy with food, etc.

examples.en: All the children were well nourished and in good physical condition.
examples.zh: 所有这些孩子都营养良好，身体健康。

examples.en: Most plants are nourished by water drawn up through their roots.
examples.zh: 大多数植物靠根部吸收的水分得以生长。

examples.en: a lotion containing almond extract to nourish and revitalize the skin
examples.zh: 含有杏仁提取物的乳液，可滋养和恢复肌肤活力

senses.def: to allow a feeling, an idea, etc. to develop or grow stronger

examples.en: By investing in education, we nourish the talents of our children.
examples.zh: 我们通过教育投资，培养孩子们的才能。

examples.en: There were hopes that the talks would nourish the fragile growth of good relations between the two countries.
examples.zh: 人们希望会谈能够滋养两国之间脆弱的良好关系。

senses.def: food that is needed to stay alive, grow and stay healthy

examples.en: Can plants obtain adequate nourishment from such poor soil?
examples.zh: 土壤这样贫瘠，植物能获得足够的养分吗？

examples.en: As a child, she was starved of intellectual nourishment.
examples.zh: 她小时候缺乏汲取知识的机会。

examples.en: These seeds can be a great source of nourishment to birds in winter.
examples.zh: 这些种子可以成为鸟类冬季营养的重要来源。

examples.en: lack of adequate nourishment
examples.zh: 营养不足

examples.en: You need natural, fresh food with lots of nourishment.
examples.zh: 你需要营养丰富、天然又新鲜的食物。

senses.def: intelligence and the ability to think and act in a practical way

examples.en: None of them had the nous to shut the door when the fire started.
examples.zh: 当火灾发生时，他们都没有理智去关门。

senses.def: typical of people who have recently become rich and like to show how rich they are in a very obvious way

examples.en: nouveau riche businessmen/tastes
examples.zh: 暴发户商人/品味

senses.def: a person who has recently become rich and likes to show how rich they are in a very obvious way
a modern style of cooking that avoids heavy foods and serves small amounts of different dishes arranged in an attractive way on the plate
senses.zh: 新式烹饪（讲求食物清淡，量少而精美）

senses.def: a star that suddenly becomes much brighter for a short period
senses.zh: 新星（短期内突然变得很亮）

senses.def: a province
senses.zh: 新斯科舍（加拿大东部省份，由新斯科舍半岛和邻近的布雷顿角岛组成，首府哈利法克斯）

senses.def: a story long enough to fill a complete book, in which the characters and events are usually imaginary

examples.en: to write/publish/read a novel
examples.zh: 创作／出版／阅读小说

examples.en: detective/historical/romantic novels
examples.zh: 侦探／历史／言情小说

examples.en: the novels of Jane Austen
examples.zh: 简·奥斯汀的小说

examples.en: Her latest novel is set in Cornwall.
examples.zh: 她的最新小说以康沃尔为背景。

examples.en: a best-selling novel
examples.zh: 畅销小说

examples.en: Highsmith's debut novel was a bestseller in 1949.
examples.zh: 海史密斯的处女作于 1949 年成为畅销书。

senses.def: the type of literature that novels represent

examples.en: The novel is the most adaptable of all literary forms.
examples.zh: 小说是所有文学体裁中最适合改编的。

senses.def: different from anything known before; new, interesting and often seeming slightly strange
senses.zh: 新颖的；与众不同的；珍奇的

examples.en: a novel feature
examples.zh: 新特征

examples.en: Job-sharing is still a novel concept and it will take a while for employers to get used to it.
examples.zh: 工作共享仍然是一个新概念，雇主需要一段时间才能适应。

examples.en: The plan sounded rather novel.
examples.zh: 这个计划听上去挺有新意。

examples.en: It was an American who came up with the novel idea of drive-in restaurants.
examples.zh: 是一个美国人想出了“免下车”餐馆这个新奇的点子。

senses.def: a short novel, especially a romantic novel that is considered to be badly written
senses.zh: 中篇小说（尤指被认为很蹩脚的言情小说）

senses.def: a person who writes novels

examples.en: a romantic/historical novelist
examples.zh: 言情／历史小说家

senses.def: typical of or used in novels

examples.en: a novelistic device/convention
examples.zh: 新颖的装置/惯例

senses.def: a short novel
the quality of being new, different and interesting

examples.en: It was fun working there at first but the novelty soon wore off (= it became boring).
examples.zh: 开始的时候在那里工作很有趣，但这股新鲜劲很快就过去了。

examples.en: There's a certain novelty value in this approach.
examples.zh: 这种方法有一定的新意。

examples.en: We must not mistake novelty for originality and quality.
examples.zh: 我们决不能将新颖性误认为原创性和质量。

senses.def: a thing, person or situation that is interesting because it is new, unusual or has not been known before

examples.en: Electric cars are no longer a novelty on our roads.
examples.zh: 电动汽车在我们的道路上不再是新鲜事。

senses.def: a small cheap object sold as a toy or a decoration
different and unusual; intended to be humorous and to catch people’s attention

examples.en: a novelty teapot
examples.zh: 新颖独特的茶壶

senses.def: the 11th month of the year, between October and December

examples.en: She was born in November.
examples.zh: 她出生于十一月。

examples.en: The meeting is on the fifth of November/November the fifth.
examples.zh: 会议时间是十一月五号/十一月五号。

examples.en: The meeting is on November fifth.
examples.zh: 会议于十一月五日举行。

examples.en: We went to Japan last November.
examples.zh: 去年11月我们去了日本。

examples.en: I arrived at the end of November.
examples.zh: 我是11月底到达的。

examples.en: last November's election
examples.zh: 去年11月的选举

examples.en: It was a cold November night.
examples.zh: 那是十一月一个寒冷的夜晚。

senses.def: a powerful form of energy produced by changing matter into energy by splitting the nuclei
a family that consists of father, mother and children, when it is thought of as a unit in society
senses.zh: 核心家庭，小家庭（只包括父母和子女）

examples.en: Many people nowadays do not live in the conventional nuclear family.
examples.zh: 如今，许多人并不生活在传统的核心家庭中。

examples.en: the nuclear family of parents and children
examples.zh: 父母与子女组成的核心家庭

not having or allowing nuclear energy, weapons or materials

examples.zh: 无核区

senses.def: a substance that can be used as a source of nuclear energy
the act or process of combining the nuclei
the most extreme possible response to a particular situation
senses.zh: 核选择（指可能做出的最极端反应）

examples.en: Currency controls would be the nuclear option.
examples.zh: 货币管制将是最极端的选择。

senses.def: a scientist who studies nuclear physics
the area of physics which deals with the nucleus
a powerful form of energy produced by changing matter into energy by splitting the nuclei
a large structure used to produce nuclear energy
waste material which is radioactive
a period of great cold and darkness
senses.zh: 核冬天（科学家预测核战争后因烟尘遮蔽阳光而致的一段寒冷昏暗的时期）

senses.def: either of two substances, DNA and RNA, that are present in all living cells
a test for viruses and bacteria that shows the nucleic acids

examples.en: A nucleic acid test can detect HIV and hepatitis C at an early stage.
examples.zh: 核酸检测可以早期发现艾滋病毒和丙型肝炎。

senses.def: one of the many small molecules
senses.zh: 核苷酸（构成 DNA 和 RNA 的小分子）

senses.def: the part of an atom
the central part of some cells, containing the genetic
the central part of something around which other parts are located or collected

examples.en: These paintings will form the nucleus of a new collection.
examples.zh: 这些画将构成新的收藏系列的基础。

senses.def: not wearing any clothes

examples.en: He worked as a nude model in an artist's studio.
examples.zh: 他在一家艺术家工作室担任裸体模特。

examples.en: The model and influencer posed nude for a photo shoot.
examples.zh: 这位模特和影响者裸体拍照。

senses.def: involving people who are not wearing any clothes

examples.en: He had a collection of nude photographs in his studio.
examples.zh: 他的工作室里有一系列裸体照片。

examples.en: Are there any nude scenes in the movie?
examples.zh: 电影里有裸体镜头吗？

examples.en: Some of the resorts allow nude sunbathing on the beaches.
examples.zh: 有些度假胜地允许在海滩上裸身晒日光浴。

senses.zh: 裸体画；人物裸体作品；裸体人像

examples.zh: 一个斜倚着的裸体人像

senses.def: to push somebody gently, especially with your elbow

examples.en: He nudged me and whispered, ‘Look who's just come in.’
examples.zh: 他用胳膊肘碰了我一下，低声说：“瞧谁进来了。”

senses.def: to push somebody/something gently or gradually in a particular direction

examples.en: He nudged the ball past the goalie and into the net.
examples.zh: 他轻松地将球推过守门员，送入网中。

examples.en: She nudged me out of the way.
examples.zh: 她将我轻轻地推开了。

examples.en: He nudged the conversation towards the subject of money.
examples.zh: 他将谈话逐步引到钱这个话题上。

examples.en: She tried to nudge him into changing his mind (= persuade him to do it).
examples.zh: 她试图慢慢说服他改变主意。

senses.def: to move forward by pushing with your elbow

examples.en: He nudged his way through the crowd.
examples.zh: 他用胳膊肘开路穿过人群。

senses.def: to reach or make something reach a particular level

examples.en: Inflation was nudging 20 per cent.
examples.zh: 通货膨胀接近 20%。

examples.en: This afternoon's sunshine could nudge the temperature above freezing.
examples.zh: 今天下午的阳光可使温度达到冰点以上。

senses.def: a slight push, usually with the elbow

examples.en: She gave me a gentle nudge in the ribs to tell me to shut up.
examples.zh: 她用胳膊肘轻轻捅了一下我的腰，让我住口。

examples.en: He can work hard but he needs a nudge now and then.
examples.zh: 他能够努力工作，但偶尔需要督促一下。

senses.def: used to suggest something to do with sex without actually saying it
senses.zh: （暗指与性行为有关的事）你懂的

examples.en: They've been spending a lot of time together, nudge nudge, wink wink.
examples.zh: 他们花很多时间厮混在一起，你懂我的意思吧。

senses.def: used to suggest something to do with sex without actually saying it

examples.en: They've been spending a lot of time together, nudge nudge, wink wink.
examples.zh: 他们花很多时间厮混在一起，你懂我的意思吧。

senses.def: used to suggest something to do with sex without actually saying it

examples.en: They've been spending a lot of time together, nudge nudge, wink wink.
examples.zh: 他们花很多时间厮混在一起，你懂我的意思吧。

senses.def: showing or including people wearing no clothes

examples.en: nudie photographs
examples.zh: 裸体照片

senses.def: the practice of not wearing any clothes because you believe this is more natural and healthy
senses.zh: 裸体主义（认为裸体更自然更有益健康）

senses.def: a person who does not wear any clothes because they believe this is more natural and healthy

examples.en: a nudist beach/camp
examples.zh: 裸泳海滩；裸体营

senses.def: the state of wearing no clothes

examples.en: The committee claimed that there was too much nudity on television.
examples.zh: 委员会宣称电视里的裸体镜头太多。

senses.def: a way of writing the word ‘

examples.en: Boston is the best team there is. 'Nuff said.
examples.zh: 波士顿是最好的球队。无须多讲。

senses.def: a way of spelling ‘
having no purpose or value
a small piece of a valuable metal or mineral, especially gold, that is found in the earth
senses.zh: 天然贵重金属块；（尤指）天然金块

senses.def: a small round piece of some types of food

examples.en: chicken nuggets
examples.zh: 鸡肉块

senses.def: a small thing such as an idea or a fact that people think of as valuable
senses.zh: 有价值的小东西；有用的想法（或事实）

examples.en: a useful nugget of information
examples.zh: 一条有用的信息

senses.def: a thing, person or situation that is annoying or causes trouble or problems
senses.zh: 麻烦事；讨厌的人（或东西）

examples.en: I don't want to be a nuisance so tell me if you want to be alone.
examples.zh: 我不想讨人嫌，你要是想一个人待着就说一声。

examples.en: I hope you're not making a nuisance of yourself.
examples.zh: 我希望你没有讨人嫌。

examples.en: It's a nuisance having to go back tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天不得不回去，真烦人。

examples.en: What a nuisance!
examples.zh: 真麻烦！

senses.def: behaviour by somebody that annoys other people and that a court can order the person to stop

examples.en: He was charged with causing a public nuisance.
examples.zh: 他被控妨害公共利益罪。

senses.def: a phone call that is not wanted and is unnecessary or annoying, for example by somebody trying to sell something or trying to make a joke

examples.en: People can face severe penalties for making nuisance calls to the emergency services.
examples.zh: 给紧急服务机构打骚扰电话的人可能会面临严厉的处罚。

senses.def: a quality that makes something useful because it causes problems for your opponents
to attack a place with nuclear weapons
a nuclear weapon
having the value zero

examples.en: a null result
examples.zh: 毫无结果

senses.def: having no legal force; not valid

examples.en: The contract was declared null and void.
examples.zh: 合同被宣布无效。

examples.en: They declared the agreement null and void.
examples.zh: 他们宣布协议无效。

senses.def: having no legal force; not valid

examples.en: The contract was declared null and void.
examples.zh: 合同被宣布无效。

examples.en: They declared the agreement null and void.
examples.zh: 他们宣布协议无效。

senses.def: having no legal force; not valid

examples.en: The contract was declared null and void.
examples.zh: 合同被宣布无效。

examples.en: They declared the agreement null and void.
examples.zh: 他们宣布协议无效。

senses.def: the idea that an experiment that is done using two groups of people will show the same results for each group
senses.zh: 零假设，原假设，虚无假设（即用两组人分别实验而结果相同）

senses.def: a stream, an artificial channel for water, a river bed
to make something such as an agreement or order lose its legal force

examples.en: Judges were unwilling to nullify government decisions.
examples.zh: 法官们不愿废止政府决定。

senses.def: to make something lose its effect or power

examples.en: An unhealthy diet will nullify the effects of training.
examples.zh: 不健康的饮食会抵消锻炼的效果。

senses.def: the fact of something, for example a marriage, having no legal force or no longer being officially recognized; something which is no longer officially recognized
senses.zh: 无法律约束力；无效；无法律效力的事物

examples.en: a decree of nullity (= a statement saying that a marriage is no longer legal)
examples.zh: 无效判决

examples.en: The decision of the committee can now be regarded as a nullity.
examples.zh: 委员会的决定现在可以被视为无效。

senses.def: if a part of your body is numb

examples.en: to be/go numb
examples.zh: 麻木；失去知觉

examples.en: numb with cold
examples.zh: 冻僵

examples.en: I've just been to the dentist and my face is still numb.
examples.zh: 我刚刚去看了牙医，脸上现在还没知觉呢。

senses.def: unable to feel, think or react in the normal way

examples.en: He felt numb with shock.
examples.zh: 他惊呆了。

senses.def: to make a part of your body unable to feel anything, for example because of cold

examples.en: His fingers were numbed with the cold.
examples.zh: 他的手指冻僵了。

senses.def: to make somebody unable to feel, think or react in a normal way, for example because of an emotional shock

examples.en: We sat there in silence, numbed by the shock of her death.
examples.zh: 我们默默地坐在那里发愣，因为她的死使我们感到震惊。

senses.def: a word or symbol that represents an amount or a quantity

examples.en: Think of a number and multiply it by two.
examples.zh: 想出一个数，然后乘以二。

examples.en: a high/low number
examples.zh: 高位数；低位数

examples.en: even numbers (= 2, 4, 6, etc.)
examples.zh: 偶数

examples.en: odd numbers (= 1, 3, 5, etc.)
examples.zh: 奇数

examples.en: You owe me 27 dollars? Make it 30, that's a good round number.
examples.zh: 你欠我 27 美元？凑到 30 吧，讨个整数好记。

senses.def: used before a figure to show the position of something in a series

examples.en: They live at number 26.
examples.zh: 他们住在 26 号。

examples.en: The song reached number 5 in the charts.
examples.zh: 这首歌在排行榜中位列第 5。

senses.group: position in series 序列中的位置

senses.def: a set of figures that is used to identify something or communicate by phone, etc.

examples.en: Ask for the customer's name and phone number.
examples.zh: 问一下客户的姓名和电话号码。

examples.en: Customers can reach us by calling an 0800 number (= a free phone number in the UK).
examples.zh: 客户可以通过拨打 0800 号码（= 英国的免费电话号码）联系我们。

examples.en: I'm sorry, I think you have the wrong number (= wrong phone number).
examples.zh: 对不起，我想你打错了。

examples.en: Call this number and ask to speak to John.
examples.zh: 打这个号码，找约翰接电话。

examples.en: What is your account number, please?
examples.zh: 请问你的账号是多少？

examples.en: Can I have your credit card number?
examples.zh: 我可以知道你的信用卡号码吗？

examples.en: Please give your landline and mobile phone numbers.
examples.zh: 请提供您的固定电话和手机号码。

senses.def: a quantity of people or things

examples.en: A large number of people have applied for the job.
examples.zh: 许多人申请了这工作。

examples.en: In a small number of cases the illness is fatal.
examples.zh: 这种疾病在少数病例中是致命的。

examples.en: The number of homeless people has increased dramatically.
examples.zh: 无家可归者的人数急剧增加了。

examples.en: The total number of students has doubled in the last six years.
examples.zh: 过去六年里，学生总数翻了一番。

examples.en: Huge numbers of (= very many) animals have died.
examples.zh: 有大量的动物死去。

examples.en: A number of (= some) problems have arisen.
examples.zh: 已经出现了一些问题。

examples.en: I could give you any number of (= a lot of) reasons for not going.
examples.zh: 我可以给你许多不去的理由。

examples.en: Use a pedometer to count the number of steps you take.
examples.zh: 使用计步器来计算您所走的步数。

examples.en: Our aim is to reduce the number of road accidents.
examples.zh: 我们的目标是减少道路事故的数量。

examples.en: This year we have increased the number of events from six to ten.
examples.zh: 今年我们将活动数量从六场增加到十场。

examples.en: We were eight in number (= there were eight of us).
examples.zh: 我们有八个人。

examples.en: Nurses are leaving the profession in increasing numbers.
examples.zh: 越来越多的护士退出这一职业。

examples.en: Sheer weight of numbers (= the large number of soldiers) secured them the victory.
examples.zh: 他们只是靠重兵取胜。

examples.en: The course will have to be repeated owing to pressure of numbers (= too many students).
examples.zh: 由于人数压力（=学生太多），该课程必须重复进行。

examples.en: staff/student numbers
examples.zh: 员工／学生数量

senses.def: a group or quantity of people

examples.en: one of our number (= one of us)
examples.zh: 我们中的一人

examples.en: The prime minister is elected by MPs from among their number.
examples.zh: 首相是下院议员从他们当中选出的。

senses.def: the version of a magazine, etc. published on a particular day, in a particular month, etc.

examples.en: the October number of ‘Vogue’
examples.zh: 《时尚》十月号

examples.en: The back numbers of ‘The Times’ were kept in a basement.
examples.zh: 《泰晤士报》的旧号被保存在地下室里。

senses.def: a song or dance, especially one of several in a performance
senses.zh: 一首歌，一段舞蹈（尤指演出的节目）

examples.en: They sang a slow romantic number.
examples.zh: 他们演唱了一首舒缓的浪漫歌曲。

senses.def: a thing, such as a dress or a car, that is admired

examples.en: She was wearing a black velvet number.
examples.zh: 她穿着一件时髦的黑天鹅绒礼服。

senses.group: thing admired 令人羡慕的东西

senses.def: the form of a word, showing whether one or more than one person or thing is being talked about
senses.zh: 数（表示所叙述的人或事物是一个或多个）

examples.en: The word ‘men’ is plural in number.
examples.zh: men 一词是复数形式。

examples.en: The subject of a sentence and its verb must agree in number.
examples.zh: 句子的主语和动词的数必须一致。

senses.def: following a set of simple instructions identified by numbers

examples.en: painting by numbers
examples.zh: 按数字顺序着色

senses.def: following closely the accepted rules for doing something
senses.zh: 严格遵循规则；一板一眼

senses.def: an easy job; a pleasant situation that other people would like
senses.zh: 轻松的工作；美差；令人羡慕的轻松状态

examples.en: It’s all right for him—he’s got a very cushy number.
examples.zh: 这对他来说没什么问题——他有一个非常轻松的号码。

senses.def: to do something that will harm somebody/something, especially when it feels like it is done deliberately, from a desire to hurt (even if this is not actually the case)

examples.en: Throat cancer did a number on me a few years ago.
examples.zh: 几年前，喉癌对我造成了很大的影响。

examples.en: The Covid-19 pandemic did a number on global stock markets.
examples.zh: Covid-19 大流行对全球股市造成了巨大影响。

senses.def: to know what somebody is really like and what they plan to do
senses.zh: 了解某人的底细；对某人知根知底

examples.en: He thinks he can fool me but I've got his number.
examples.zh: 他以为他能糊弄我，但我清楚他的真面目。

senses.def: the time has come when you will die or lose everything
a way of considering an activity, etc. that considers only the number of people doing something, things achieved, etc., not with who or what they are
senses.zh: 数字游戏（即只注重参与的人数、达成了几项结果等，而不考虑参与者是谁、结果是什么）

examples.en: MPs were playing the numbers game as the crucial vote drew closer.
examples.zh: 在至关重要的表决临近时，下院议员们玩起了数字游戏。

senses.def: a person who does the same job as you in another organization
senses.zh: （另一个单位内）与自己职位相当的人

examples.en: The Foreign Secretary is currently having talks with his opposite number in the White House.
examples.zh: 外交大臣现正和白宫的对等官员会谈。

senses.def: being in a group makes you safer and makes you feel more confident
being in a group gives you more power

examples.en: There's strength in numbers, so encourage your friends and family to join us.
examples.zh: 人多力量大，鼓励你的亲朋好友参加吧。

senses.def: the combined power, strength or influence of a group
senses.zh: 人多势众；团队力量（或影响）

examples.en: They won the argument by sheer weight of numbers.
examples.zh: 他们纯粹靠人多势众在争论中获胜。

senses.def: to give a number to something as part of a series or list

examples.en: All the seats in the stadium are numbered.
examples.zh: 运动场里所有的座位都编了号。

examples.en: I couldn't work out the numbering system for the hotel rooms.
examples.zh: 我搞不清楚酒店房间的编号系统。

examples.en: Every paper was carefully numbered and indexed.
examples.zh: 每篇论文都经过仔细编号和索引。

examples.en: The coins are individually numbered.
examples.zh: 硬币均单独编号。

examples.en: Each pigeonhole is clearly numbered by floor and by room.
examples.zh: 每一个信件格都按楼层和房间清楚编了号。

examples.en: Park your car on the even-numbered side of the street.
examples.zh: 将车停在街道的偶数一侧。

examples.en: Number the car's features from 1 to 10 according to importance.
examples.zh: 将车的特征按重要性从 1 到 10 编号。

examples.en: The doors were numbered 2, 4, 6 and 8.
examples.zh: 门上的编号为 2、4、6 和 8。

senses.def: to make a particular number when added together

examples.en: The crowd numbered more than a thousand.
examples.zh: 聚集的人群共计一千多人。

examples.en: We numbered 20 (= there were 20 of us in the group).
examples.zh: 我们总共 20 人。

examples.en: The African student population in France currently numbers nearly 8,000.
examples.zh: 目前在法国的非洲学生人数接近8,000人。

senses.group: make something as total 总计

senses.def: to include somebody/something in a particular group; to be included in a particular group

examples.en: I number her among my closest friends.
examples.zh: 我把她算作我最好的朋友之一。

examples.en: He numbers among the best classical actors in Britain.
examples.zh: 他被看作英国最好的古典剧目演员之一。

senses.def: a person or thing will not continue to live, exist or be successful for much longer
senses.zh: （指人）死期不远了，得意的日子屈指可数了；（指物）用不了多久了，寿命不长了

examples.en: His days as leader of the party are numbered.
examples.zh: 他作为党的领袖的日子已屈指可数了。

examples.en: Whatever the protests, the school’s days are numbered and it will be closed down.
examples.zh: 无论抗议如何，学校的日子已经屈指可数了，它将被关闭。
