senses.def: an act of sexual intercourse
senses.zh: （为防止受孕而在射精前抽出阴茎的）不完全性交

senses.def: to ensure a new employee or customer becomes familiar with an organization or its products or services
senses.zh: 使（新员工）熟悉工作；引导（新客户）了解产品（或服务）

examples.en: The goal is to get new clients onboarded quickly.
examples.zh: 目的是让新客户快速熟悉产品。

examples.en: We are delighted to have onboarded such a talented pool of individuals.
examples.zh: 我们很高兴拥有如此才华横溢的人才库。

senses.def: to become familiar with how something works, especially a piece of technology or software
senses.zh: 熟悉，上手（尤指技术或软件）

examples.en: The problem is that many new users struggle to onboard.
examples.zh: 问题是许多新用户很难加入。

examples.en: The system is fast to onboard, easy to use and simple to manage.
examples.zh: 该系统安装速度快、易于使用且易于管理。

senses.def: on one occasion only; one time

examples.en: I've only been there once.
examples.zh: 我只去过那里一次。

examples.en: He cleans his car once a week.
examples.zh: 他每周洗一次汽车。

examples.en: She only sees her parents once every six months.
examples.zh: 她每半年只探望一次父母。

examples.en: For optimum effect, these drops are used once daily.
examples.zh: 为了获得最佳效果，这些滴剂每天使用一次。

examples.en: I had met Lou once before.
examples.zh: 我以前见过卢一次。

examples.en: Last year the region received rain only once.
examples.zh: 去年该地区只下过一次雨。

examples.en: He only did it the once.
examples.zh: 这种事儿他仅仅干过一次。

examples.en: Rome is a city you should visit at least once in your life.
examples.zh: 罗马是您一生中至少应该参观一次的城市。

examples.en: They meet once a week at a Paris café.
examples.zh: 他们每周在巴黎的一家咖啡馆见面一次。

senses.def: at some time in the past

examples.en: I once met your mother.
examples.zh: 我曾经见过你母亲。

examples.en: He once lived in Zambia.
examples.zh: 他曾在赞比亚生活过。

examples.en: This book was famous once, but nobody reads it today.
examples.zh: 这本书曾名噪一时，但现在却无人问津。

examples.en: She remembers once travelling with her father to Kilkenny.
examples.zh: 她记得有一次和父亲一起去基尔肯尼旅行。

examples.en: I famously once said that I was a fighter and not a quitter.
examples.zh: 我曾经说过一句名言：我是一个斗士，而不是一个放弃者。

examples.en: He once told an interviewer that his biggest regret was missing his father's funeral.
examples.zh: 他曾告诉采访者，他最大的遗憾是错过了父亲的葬礼。

examples.en: It was once thought to be the best hotel in Europe.
examples.zh: 它曾被认为是欧洲最好的酒店。

senses.def: used in negative sentences and questions, and after if
senses.zh: （用于否定句、疑问句和 if 后）曾，根本

examples.en: He never once offered to help.
examples.zh: 他从没有主动提出过帮忙。

examples.en: If she once decides to do something, you won't change her mind.
examples.zh: 她一旦决定干什么，谁也改变不了她的主意。

examples.zh: 一进大门，萨姆就沿着小路匆匆而上。

examples.en: All at once she lost her temper.
examples.zh: 她突然大发脾气。

examples.en: I can't do two things at once.

examples.zh: 只有这一次他按时到了。

examples.en: Can't you be nice to each other just this once?

to clean something quickly

examples.en: Do you want one or two?
examples.zh: 你要一个还是两个？

examples.en: There's only room for one person.
examples.zh: 只有一个人的空间。

examples.en: One more, please!
examples.zh: 请再来一个！

examples.zh: 一间卧室的公寓房

examples.en: I'll see you at one (= one o'clock).
examples.zh: 我一点钟见你。

senses.def: used in formal language or for emphasis before hundred
senses.zh: （正式用语或表示强调，用在 hundred、thousand 等或度量单位之前）一

examples.en: It cost one hundred and fifty pounds.
examples.zh: 那东西花了一百五十英镑。

examples.en: He lost by less than one second.
examples.zh: 他以不到一秒钟的差距输了比赛。

senses.def: used for emphasis to mean ‘a single’ or ‘just one’
senses.zh: （表示强调）单独一个，仅仅一个

examples.en: There's only one thing we can do.
examples.zh: 我们能做的只有一件事。

senses.def: a person or thing, especially when they are part of a group
senses.zh: （尤指一组中的）一个人，一件事物

examples.en: One of my friends lives in Brighton.
examples.zh: 我有一个朋友住在布赖顿。

examples.en: One place I'd really like to visit is Bali.
examples.zh: 我真正想去的一个地方就是巴厘岛。

senses.def: used for emphasis to mean ‘the only one’ or ‘the most important one’
senses.zh: （表示强调）唯一的一个，最重要的一个

examples.en: He's the one person I can trust.
examples.zh: 他是我唯一可以信赖的人。

examples.en: Her one concern was for the health of her baby.
examples.zh: 她唯一操心的就是孩子的健康。

examples.en: It's the one thing I can't stand about him.
examples.zh: 这是我最不能容忍他的一件事。

senses.def: used when you are talking about a time in the past or the future, without actually saying which one
senses.zh: （用于一般地谈论过去或将来的某个时间）

examples.en: I saw her one afternoon last week.
examples.zh: 我在上周的一个下午见到了她。

examples.en: One day (= at some time in the future) you'll understand.
examples.zh: 总有一天你会明白的。

senses.def: the same

examples.en: They all went off in one direction.
examples.zh: 他们都朝同一个方向走了。

senses.def: used for emphasis instead of a
senses.zh: （代替 a 或 an，表示强调）

examples.en: That was one hell of a game!
examples.zh: 那一场比赛简直不得了！

examples.en: She's one snappy dresser.
examples.zh: 她的穿着很入时。

senses.def: used with a person’s name to show that the speaker does not know the person
senses.zh: （与人名连用，表示说话人不认识的人）某一个

examples.en: He worked as an assistant to one Mr Ming.
examples.zh: 他给一位明先生当助手。

senses.def: in agreement; all together

examples.en: We spoke as one on this matter.
examples.zh: 在这个问题上我们口径一致。

senses.def: to feel that you completely agree with somebody/something, or that you are part of something

examples.en: a place where you can feel at one with nature
examples.zh: 一个能让你感到与大自然融为一体的地方

senses.def: a return to the situation you were in at the beginning of a project, task, etc., because you have made no real progress
senses.zh: （因无进展）回到起点，从头再来

examples.en: If this suggestion isn't accepted, we'll be back to square one.
examples.zh: 如果这个建议得不到采纳，我们就得从头再来了。

senses.def: to be the only person to have a particular opinion or to vote a particular way
senses.zh: 是唯一持不同意见者；是唯一投此票者

senses.def: used to emphasize that a particular person does something and that you believe other people do too
senses.zh: 就是其中之一（表达意见时用以加强语气）

examples.en: I, for one, would prefer to postpone the meeting.
examples.zh: 主张推迟会期的，我就是一个。

senses.def: to understand or guess something immediately

examples.en: ‘Oh, so she’s his sister!’ ‘Got it in one!’
examples.zh: “哦，原来她是他的妹妹！”“合二为一！”

senses.def: to get an advantage over somebody/something

examples.en: I'm not going to let them get one over on me!
examples.zh: 我决不让他们胜过我！

senses.def: to do something better than somebody else or than you have done before
senses.zh: 胜人一筹；（比自己过去）做得更好

examples.en: She did well this year and next year she hopes to go one better.
examples.zh: 今年她干得不错，她希望明年更上一层楼。

senses.def: used to say that somebody/something has different roles, contains different things or is used for different purposes
senses.zh: 集于一身（或一体）；多功能；多用途

examples.en: She's a mother and company director in one.
examples.zh: 她既是母亲又是公司董事。

examples.en: It's a public relations office, a press office and a private office all in one.
examples.zh: 那是公关办公室，也是新闻办公室，又是私人办公室：三合一。

senses.def: first one person or thing, and then another, and then another, up to any number or amount
senses.zh: 一个接一个地；陆续地；络绎不绝地

examples.en: The bills kept coming in, one after another.
examples.zh: 账单纷至沓来。

senses.def: everyone

examples.en: Happy New Year to one and all!
examples.zh: 祝各位新年快乐！

senses.def: used to emphasize that somebody is famous
senses.zh: 绝无仅有的；唯一的；有名的

examples.en: Here she is, the one and only Rihanna!
examples.zh: 她来了，盖世无双的蕾哈娜！

senses.def: used for emphasis to mean ‘the same’

examples.en: I never realized Ruth Rendell and Barbara Vine were one and the same (= the same person using two different names).
examples.zh: 我从未意识到鲁思·兰德尔和芭芭拉·瓦因原来是同一个人。

senses.def: separately and in order

examples.en: I went through the items on the list one by one.
examples.zh: 我逐条看了清单上的条目。

senses.def: a few

examples.en: We've had one or two problems—nothing serious.
examples.zh: 我们有一些问题，不过没什么大不了的。

senses.def: having an advantage over somebody
used to say that all types of the things mentioned are very similar
senses.zh: 所有的…都大同小异；知其一便知其全部

examples.en: I don't like science fiction novels much. When you've read one, you've read them all.
examples.zh: 我不太喜欢科幻小说。读过一本，就知道其他的内容了。

senses.def: a very long time ago

examples.en: I've been going there every summer since the year one.
examples.zh: 从第一年起我每年夏天都去那里。

senses.def: used to avoid repeating a noun, when you are referring to somebody/something that has already been mentioned, or that the person you are speaking to knows about
senses.zh: （用来避免重复已提过的或是听者已知的事物的名称）

examples.en: I'd like an ice cream. Are you having one, too?
examples.zh: 我想买份冰激凌，你也要一份吗？

examples.en: Our car's always breaking down. But we're getting a new one soon.
examples.zh: 我们的汽车老出毛病，但我们快要买新的了。

examples.en: She was wearing her new dress, the red one.
examples.zh: 她穿着她的新衣服，那件红的。

examples.en: Steve's the one with the blue jacket.
examples.zh: 史蒂夫是穿蓝色夹克的那个。

examples.en: My favourite band? Oh, that's a hard one (= a hard question).
examples.zh: 我最喜爱的乐队？哦，这可就难说了。

examples.en: What made you choose the one rather than the other?
examples.zh: 你怎么选了这个而不是那个？

examples.en: How about those ones over there?
examples.zh: 你看那边那些怎么样？

senses.def: used when you are identifying the person or thing you are talking about

examples.en: Our house is the one next to the school.
examples.zh: 我家的房子就是学校旁边的那座。

examples.en: The students who are most successful are usually the ones who come to all the classes.
examples.zh: 成绩最好的学生往往是出全勤的那些。

senses.def: a person or thing belonging to a particular group

examples.en: It's a present for one of my children.
examples.zh: 这是送给我的一个孩子的礼物。

examples.en: We think of you as one of the family.
examples.zh: 我们把你看作家中的一员。

senses.def: a person of the type mentioned

examples.en: 10 o’clock is too late for the little ones.
examples.zh: 十点钟对那些小家伙来说就太晚了。

examples.en: He ached to be home with his loved ones.
examples.zh: 他渴望着回家与亲人团聚。

examples.en: She was never one to criticize.
examples.zh: 她是个从不爱批评人的人。

senses.def: used to mean ‘people in general’ or ‘I’, when the speaker is referring to himself or herself

examples.en: One should never criticize if one is not sure of one's facts.
examples.zh: 一个人如果对自己掌握的事实没有把握，就绝不该随便批评。

examples.en: One gets the impression that they disapprove.

examples.en: The report puts the onus of children’s early education firmly on the parents.
examples.zh: 报告将儿童早期教育的责任坚定地放在了家长身上。

senses.def: continuing or moving forward

examples.en: Ticket prices include your flight and onward rail journey.
examples.zh: 票价包括您的机票和接续的铁路旅费。

examples.en: the onward march of time
examples.zh: 时间的流逝。

senses.def: a popular Christian hymn
senses.zh: 从此以后，基督教士兵：一种流行的基督教赞美诗（即宗教歌曲），节奏强烈，曾经在英国的学校中经常演唱过。音乐是亚瑟·沙利文（Arthur Sullivan）创作的。

senses.def: continuing from a particular time

examples.en: They lived there from the 1980s onwards.
examples.zh: 他们从 20 世纪 80 年代起一直住在那里。

examples.en: The pool is open from 7 a.m. onwards.
examples.zh: 游泳池从早上 7 点起开放。

senses.def: forward

examples.en: We drove onwards towards the coast.
examples.zh: 我们驱车前往海滨。

senses.def: a type of stone that has layers of different colours in it, usually used to make or decorate objects
used for expressing surprise, especially about something sexual
senses.zh: （表示惊讶，尤指对性方面）啊，哎呀

senses.def: a large amount of something

examples.en: Bob makes oodles of money, you know.
examples.zh: 你知道，鲍勃赚了很多钱。

senses.def: used for expressing surprise, happiness or pain
senses.zh: （表示惊讶、高兴或疼痛）哎呀，啊哈，哎哟

senses.def: a type of dark tea from China, made from leaves that have been dried but not fully fermented
senses.zh: 乌龙茶(中国的一种黑茶，由干燥但未完全发酵的茶叶制成)

examples.en: Many health benefits are claimed for oolong tea.
examples.zh: 乌龙茶据称对健康有许多好处。

senses.def: used to refer to the sound produced by a group of brass
senses.zh: （铜管乐器组发出的）嗡姆吧声

examples.en: an oompah band
examples.zh: 铜管乐队

senses.def: energy; a special good quality

examples.en: a styling product to give your hair more oomph
examples.zh: 使头发更靓丽的一种定型剂

senses.def: used when somebody has had or almost had a slight accident, broken something, etc.
senses.zh: （差点出事故、摔破物品等时说）哎

examples.en: Oops! I spilled some juice.
examples.zh: 哎呀！我洒了一些果汁。

senses.def: used when you have done something embarrassing, said something rude by accident, told a secret, etc.

examples.en: Oops, I shouldn't have said that.
examples.zh: 唉，我不应该那么说。

senses.def: said when you have fallen down, dropped something, etc. or when somebody else has
senses.zh: （自己或他人摔倒、掉东西等时说）天哪，哎呀

senses.def: if a thick liquid oozes

examples.en: Blood oozed out of the wound.
examples.zh: 血从伤口慢慢流出来。

examples.en: A trickle of blood oozed from the corner of his mouth.
examples.zh: 一滴血从他的嘴角渗出。

examples.en: Mud and slime oozed through the cracks.
examples.zh: 泥土和粘液从裂缝中渗出。

examples.en: Cream oozed out at the sides.
examples.zh: 奶油从侧面渗出。

examples.en: an ugly swelling oozing with pus
examples.zh: 流着脓水的烂疮

examples.en: The wound was oozing blood.
examples.zh: 伤口流着血。

examples.en: a plate of toast oozing butter
examples.zh: 一盘渗着黄油的烤面包片

senses.def: to show a particular quality or feeling strongly; (of a particular quality or feeling) to be shown strongly
senses.zh: 洋溢着，充满（某种特质或情感）；（某种特质或情感）尽显，洋溢

examples.en: She walked into the party oozing confidence.
examples.zh: 她信心十足地来到聚会上。

examples.en: His voice oozed with sex appeal.
examples.zh: 他的声音充溢着性感。

examples.en: He was oozing with contempt for us.
examples.zh: 他流露出对我们的蔑视。

examples.en: She shook her head, disgust oozing from every pore.
examples.zh: 她摇了摇头，每个毛孔都流露出厌恶。

senses.def: very soft mud, especially at the bottom of a lake or river
the very slow flow of a thick liquid
full of very soft mud

examples.en: an oozy river bed
examples.zh: 浑浊的河床

senses.def: thick and flowing very slowly

examples.en: oozy mud/cheese
examples.zh: 软泥/奶酪

senses.def: a medical operation

examples.en: I'm going in for my op on Monday.
examples.zh: 星期一我要住院动手术。

senses.def: the department in a company that manages the way it produces goods or delivers services and makes sure its business practices are efficient
senses.zh: 公司中负责生产商品或提供服务的方式并确保其业务实践高效的部门

examples.en: She works in Sales OPs.
examples.zh: 她在销售运营部工作。

senses.def: military activity; military operations

examples.en: to go out on ops
examples.zh: 展开行动

examples.en: special ops
examples.zh: 特别行动

examples.en: black ops (= secret military activities, especially illegal ones)
examples.zh: （尤指非法的）秘密军事活动

examples.en: He was in charge of a covert ops team.
examples.zh: 他是一个秘密行动小组的首领。

senses.def: opus
senses.zh: （按作曲家的创作时间排列的）编号乐曲

examples.en: Webern’s Five Pieces, Op. 10
examples.zh: 韦伯恩的第十号作品的五首小曲

senses.def: a style of modern art that uses patterns and colours in a way that makes the images seem to move as you look at them
senses.zh: 奥普艺术，光效应艺术（利用色彩图形使画面产生视觉动感的现代艺术）

senses.def: used in formal writing to refer to a book or an article that has already been mentioned
senses.zh: （用于正式文章中，指前文提到的书或文章）同上

senses.def: the page in a newspaper opposite the editorial
senses.zh: （报章上与社论版位置相对的）评论版

senses.def: a shop that sells clothes and other goods given by people to raise money for a charity
senses.zh: 慈善商店（通过出售捐赠的衣物等募集慈善资金）

senses.def: the fact of being difficult to see through; the fact of being opaque

examples.en: sheets of frosted glass with varying degrees of opacity
examples.zh: 具有不同程度不透明度的磨砂玻璃片

senses.def: the fact of being difficult to understand; the fact of being opaque

examples.en: the opacity of the poet’s language
examples.zh: 诗人语言的晦涩

senses.def: a white or almost clear semi-precious

examples.en: an opal ring
examples.zh: 欧泊戒指

senses.def: changing colour like an opal
senses.zh: 像欧泊般变色的；色彩变幻的

examples.en: an opalescent sky
examples.zh: 色彩变幻的天空

senses.def: not clear enough to see through or allow light through
senses.zh: 不透明的；不透光的；浑浊的

examples.en: opaque glass
examples.zh: 不透明的玻璃

examples.en: opaque tights
examples.zh: 不透明的连裤袜

senses.def: difficult to understand; not clear

examples.en: The jargon in his talk was opaque to me.
examples.zh: 他谈话中使用的行话对我是一团迷雾。

senses.def: an instruction written in machine code
Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries
senses.zh: 石油输出国组织；欧佩克

senses.def: allowing things or people to go through; not closed or blocked

examples.en: A wasp flew in the open window.
examples.zh: 一只黄蜂飞进了开着的窗子。

examples.en: She had left the door wide open.
examples.zh: 她把房门敞开着。

examples.en: The castle gates swung open.
examples.zh: 城堡的大门打开了。

examples.en: The door burst open and the children rushed in.
examples.zh: 门突然撞开了，孩子们闯了进来。

examples.en: She held the door open for them.
examples.zh: 她一直为他们留着门。

examples.en: In spite of the snow, the roads remained open.
examples.zh: 虽然下雪，道路仍可通行。

examples.en: The mountain pass is kept open all year.
examples.zh: 山口全年开放。

examples.en: open borders
examples.zh: 开放的边界

examples.en: Borders between the countries are open and passports are not required.
examples.zh: 国家之间的边界是开放的，不需要护照。

examples.en: Taylor headed the ball into the open goal.
examples.zh: 泰勒将球顶入空门。

senses.def: with eyelids

examples.en: She had difficulty keeping her eyes open (= because she was very tired).
examples.zh: 她连睁开眼睛的力气都没有了。

examples.en: He was breathing through his open mouth.
examples.zh: 他张着嘴呼吸。

examples.en: She stared at him, her mouth hanging open.
examples.zh: 她死死盯着他，嘴巴半张着。

senses.def: spread out; with the edges apart

examples.en: The flowers are all open now.
examples.zh: 花现在都开了。

examples.en: The book lay open on the table.
examples.zh: 书摊开在桌子上。

examples.en: She put the money into his open hand.
examples.zh: 她把钱放到他张开的手中。

senses.def: not fastened or covered, so that things can easily come out or be put in

examples.en: Leave the envelope open.
examples.zh: 别封上信封。

examples.en: The bag burst open and everything fell out.
examples.zh: 袋子爆开了，里边的东西都散落出来。

examples.en: I tried to pry open the locket.
examples.zh: 我试图把盒式项链坠撬开。

examples.en: The children ripped open the presents excitedly.
examples.zh: 孩子们兴奋地撕开礼物。

senses.def: not fastened

examples.en: Her coat was open.
examples.zh: 她的外衣敞着。

senses.def: not surrounded by anything; not closed in

examples.en: open country/countryside (= without forests, buildings, etc.)
examples.zh: 空旷的田野

examples.en: a city with a lot of parks and wide open spaces
examples.zh: 有很多公园和大片空地的城市

examples.en: driving along the open road (= part of a road in the country, where you can drive fast)
examples.zh: 沿开阔的道路开车

examples.en: We left port and headed for the open sea.
examples.zh: 我们离港驶向开阔海域。

senses.def: with no cover or roof on

examples.en: an open drain
examples.zh: 一条明沟

examples.en: people working in the open air (= not in a building)
examples.zh: 在户外作业的人

examples.en: The hall of the old house was open to the sky.
examples.zh: 旧房子的门厅是露天的。

examples.en: an open wound (= with no skin covering it)
examples.zh: 开放性伤口

examples.en: They were living in a tent, cooking their meals on an open fire.
examples.zh: 他们住在帐篷里，在篝火上做饭。

examples.en: She sliced open the side of her thumb cutting up a tomato.
examples.zh: 她切开拇指一侧，切一个西红柿。

examples.en: an open flame
examples.zh: 明火

senses.def: if a shop, bank, business, etc. is open

examples.en: Is the museum open on Sundays?
examples.zh: 博物馆每星期天都开放吗？

examples.en: The new store will be open in the spring.
examples.zh: 新商店将在春天开业。

examples.en: I declare this festival open.
examples.zh: 我宣布庆祝活动开始。

examples.en: The bank is open for business again.
examples.zh: 银行恢复开门营业了。

senses.def: if a competition, meeting, etc. is open
senses.zh: 对大众开放的；公开的；人人可以参加的

examples.en: an open debate/championship/scholarship
examples.zh: 公开的辩论会；人人可以参加的锦标赛；人人均可申请的奖学金

examples.en: She was tried in open court (= the public could go and listen to the trial).
examples.zh: 她被公开审判。

examples.en: The debate was thrown open to the audience.
examples.zh: 辩论会对听众开放。

senses.def: if a competition, building, etc. is open
senses.zh: （比赛、建筑物等）对特定群体开放

examples.en: The competition is open to young people under the age of 18.
examples.zh: 这项比赛的参赛对象是 18 岁以下的青少年。

examples.en: The house is not open to the public.
examples.zh: 这所住宅不对外开放。

examples.en: The car park is only open to residents.
examples.zh: 这个停车场仅供住户使用。

senses.def: to be available and ready to use

examples.en: Is the offer still open?
examples.zh: 这个报价还有效吗？

examples.en: I want to keep my Swiss bank account open.
examples.zh: 我想保留我的瑞士银行账户。

examples.en: What options are open to us?
examples.zh: 我们有什么选择？

examples.en: My advice is to keep your options open.
examples.zh: 我的建议是保持你的选择余地。

examples.en: We have kept the door open for future discussions.
examples.zh: 我们为未来的讨论敞开了大门。

senses.def: if a phone line or other channel of communication is open
senses.zh: （电话线或其他沟通渠道）开放，畅通

examples.en: Lines are open 8 am to 7 pm weekdays.
examples.zh: 电话线路的开放时间是工作日的上午 8 点至晚上 7 点。

examples.en: It is important to keep communication channels open.
examples.zh: 保持沟通渠道畅通很重要。

examples.en: Nominations are now open for this year's Design Awards.
examples.zh: 今年的设计奖提名现已开放。

senses.def: likely to suffer something such as criticism, injury, etc.

examples.en: The system is open to abuse.
examples.zh: 这项制度容易被滥用。

examples.en: He has laid himself wide open to political attack.
examples.zh: 他在政治上已经处于极易受到攻击的境地。

examples.en: Carlsen had left his bishop open (= not protected, in a game of chess).
examples.zh: 卡尔森让他的主教处于空位（=在国际象棋比赛中不受保护）。

senses.def: known to everyone; not kept hidden
senses.zh: 人人皆知的；不保密的；公开的

examples.en: an open quarrel
examples.zh: 公开的争吵

examples.en: We need more open government, starting with a Freedom of Information Act.
examples.zh: 我们需要更加透明的政府，首先是要通过知情权法案。

examples.en: their open display of affection
examples.zh: 他们的公开秀恩爱

examples.en: His eyes showed open admiration as he looked at her.
examples.zh: 他看她的时候，眼神里明显流露着敬佩之情。

examples.en: One more border skirmish could lead to open war.
examples.zh: 再有一次边境冲突，就可能导致公开的战争。

senses.def: honest; not keeping thoughts and feelings hidden

examples.en: a frank and open discussion
examples.zh: 开诚布公的讨论

examples.en: She was always open with her parents.
examples.zh: 她总是与父母无话不谈。

examples.en: He was quite open about his reasons for leaving.
examples.zh: 他对离开的原因完全未加隐瞒。

senses.def: willing to listen to and think about new ideas
senses.zh: 思想开明的；不固执己见的

examples.en: He was in an open frame of mind.
examples.zh: 他思想开明。

examples.en: They are very open to new ideas.
examples.zh: 他们乐于接受新思想。

examples.en: I'm open to suggestions for what you would like to do in our classes.
examples.zh: 我很乐意听听你们对课堂活动的建议。

senses.def: not yet finally decided or settled

examples.en: The race is still wide open (= anyone could win).
examples.zh: 赛跑胜负未定。

examples.en: Which route is better remains an open question (= it is not decided).
examples.zh: 哪条路线较好还没有定论。

examples.en: In an interview try to ask open questions (= to which the answer is not just ‘yes’ or ‘no’).
examples.zh: 主持面试时要尽量问一些开放式的问题。

senses.def: allowing something; making something possible

examples.en: The price is not open to negotiation.
examples.zh: 价格不容商议。

examples.en: Some phrases in the contract are open to interpretation.
examples.zh: 合同中的某些条文容有不同诠释。

examples.en: What she means precisely is open to debate.
examples.zh: 她的确切含义还有待商榷。

senses.group: making something possible 使可能发生

senses.def: that does not have to be used on a particular day
senses.zh: （使用）日期未定的；不定日期的

examples.en: I have an open ticket, so I can travel any day I like.
examples.zh: 我有一张不定日期机票，所以我可以随便哪天去旅行。

examples.en: I didn't know how long I would be staying so I bought an open return.
examples.zh: 我不知道我会待多久，所以我买了一次开放式退货。

senses.def: with wide spaces between the threads

examples.en: an open weave
examples.zh: 稀疏织法

senses.def: produced with the tongue in the lowest possible position
if something is an open secret
to open suddenly or violently; to make something open in this way

examples.en: The door burst open.
examples.zh: 门突然开了。

examples.en: Firefighters burst the door open and rescued them.
examples.zh: 消防队员撞开门，把他们救了出来。

senses.def: (to provide) the means of getting or reaching something; (to create) the opportunity for something
senses.zh: （为…提供）达到目的的手段；（为…创造）机会

examples.en: The agreement will open the door to increased international trade.
examples.zh: 此协议将会提供增进国际贸易的机会。

examples.en: Our courses are the door to success in English.
examples.zh: 我们的课程是通向掌握英语的成功之路。

senses.def: to be willing to listen to or accept new ideas or suggestions
senses.zh: 愿意聆听（或接受）意见；（对…）不怀成见；思想开明

examples.en: Try to keep an open mind until you've heard all the facts.
examples.zh: 在听完所有的事实前先不要存任何看法。

senses.def: to listen or look out for somebody/something that you might hear or see
senses.zh: 留心听；保持警惕；密切注意

senses.def: to look for somebody/something while you are doing other things

examples.en: Police have asked residents to keep an eye out for anything suspicious.
examples.zh: 警方要求居民密切注意一切可疑的情况。

examples.en: I walked around the store, keeping an eye out for bargains.
examples.zh: 我在商店里转悠，留心看有没有便宜货。

senses.def: to avoid making a decision now so that you still have a choice in the future
senses.zh: 保留选择余地；暂不决定

examples.en: At the moment I'm keeping my options open and applying for as many different jobs as possible.
examples.zh: 目前，我保持开放的选择并申请尽可能多的不同工作。

senses.def: available to buy without any limits
if you describe somebody or their life as an open book
an invitation to somebody to visit you at any time
if something is an open invitation
senses.zh: 容易引诱人犯罪的行为

examples.en: Leaving your camera on the seat in the car is an open invitation to thieves.
examples.zh: 把照相机留在汽车座位上无异于开门揖盗。

senses.def: fully aware of the possible problems or results of a particular course of action
senses.zh: 明知后果如何；明知有问题；心中有数

examples.en: I went into this with my eyes open so I guess I only have myself to blame.
examples.zh: 我是明明知道做这事的后果的，所以我想只能责怪我自己。

senses.def: if you welcome somebody with open arms
to move a door, window, lid

examples.en: Mr Chen opened the car door for his wife.
examples.zh: 陈先生为妻子打开车门。

examples.en: She opened all the windows wide to let some fresh air in.
examples.zh: 她敞开所有窗户让新鲜空气进来。

examples.en: He opened the lid of the piano.
examples.zh: 他打开钢琴的盖子。

examples.en: Do you have a key that opens this gate?
examples.zh: 你有打开这扇门的钥匙吗？

examples.en: The door opened and Alan walked in.
examples.zh: 门开了，艾伦走了进去。

examples.en: The doors of the bus open automatically.
examples.zh: 公交车的车门自动打开。

senses.def: to remove or undo

examples.en: Shall I open another bottle?
examples.zh: 要不要我再开一瓶？

examples.en: He opened the letter and read it.
examples.zh: 他拆开信读起来。

examples.en: She opened her bag and took out her passport.
examples.zh: 她打开包拿出了她的护照。

examples.en: Go on then, open the box.
examples.zh: 然后继续，打开盒子。

examples.en: I can't open this jar.
examples.zh: 我打不开这个罐子。

senses.def: if you open

examples.en: When I opened my eyes a nurse was standing over me.
examples.zh: 当我睁开眼睛时，一名护士站在我身边。

examples.en: Her eyes opened and she smiled.
examples.zh: 她睁开眼睛，微笑着。

senses.def: if you open

examples.en: He hardly ever opens his mouth (= speaks).
examples.zh: 他几乎从不开口。

examples.en: I opened my mouth to call for help.
examples.zh: 我张开嘴呼救。

examples.en: Her mouth opened but no sound came out.
examples.zh: 她的嘴张开，但没有发出声音。

senses.def: to turn the cover or the pages of a book, newspaper, etc. so that it is no longer closed

examples.en: Open your books at page 25.
examples.zh: 把书翻到第 25 页。

examples.en: When you open the pages of a magazine you are assailed by images of perfection.
examples.zh: 当你打开杂志的页面时，你会被完美的图像所困扰。

senses.def: to start a computer program or file so that you can use it on the screen; to become available on a computer screen
senses.zh: 启动，打开（计算机程序或文件）；（计算机程序等）开启

examples.en: Open the camera app and tap ‘Options’.
examples.zh: 打开相机应用程序并点击“选项”。

examples.en: to open a file/page/window/tab
examples.zh: 打开文件／页面／窗口／选项卡

examples.en: The page opens in a new tab.
examples.zh: 页面会在新选项卡中打开。

senses.def: to spread out or unfold

examples.en: What if the parachute doesn't open?
examples.zh: 降落伞打不开怎么办？

examples.en: The flowers are starting to open.
examples.zh: 花开始绽放了。

examples.en: Open the map on the table.
examples.zh: 把地图摊在桌子上。

examples.en: He opened his arms wide to embrace her.
examples.zh: 他张开双臂拥抱她。

senses.def: to make it possible for people, cars, goods, etc. to pass through a place
senses.zh: 让（行人、车辆、货物等）通行；开放

examples.en: When did the country open its borders?
examples.zh: 这个国家是何时开放边界的？

examples.en: The road will be opened again in a few hours after police have cleared it.
examples.zh: 待警察清理完以后，道路在几小时内就会重新开放。

examples.en: The bridge was opened to traffic in March 2017.
examples.zh: 大桥于 2017 年 3 月通车。

senses.def: to start business for the day; to start business for the first time

examples.en: What time does the bank open?
examples.zh: 这家银行什么时候开门？

examples.en: A theme park opened on the same site.
examples.zh: 主题公园在同一地点开业。

examples.en: The store opens for business on Friday.
examples.zh: 商店周五营业。

examples.en: The company opened its doors for business a month ago.
examples.zh: 该公司一个月前开业。

examples.en: His dream was to open a restaurant.
examples.zh: 他的梦想是开一家餐馆。

examples.en: We just opened an office in Dallas.
examples.zh: 我们刚刚在达拉斯开设了办事处。

senses.def: to be ready for people to go to

examples.en: The new hospital opens on July 1st.
examples.zh: 这家新医院七月一日开诊。

examples.en: When does the play open?
examples.zh: 这个剧什么时候上演？

examples.en: The building opened to the public in 2019.
examples.zh: 大楼于 2019 年向公众开放。

senses.def: to start an activity or event; to begin using or doing something

examples.en: You need just one pound to open an account with us.
examples.zh: 你只需一英镑就可在我行开立一个账户。

examples.en: Who is going to open the conference?
examples.zh: 谁来宣布会议开幕？

examples.en: The police have opened an investigation into the death.
examples.zh: 警察已开始对这桩命案进行调查。

examples.en: Troops opened fire on (= started shooting at) the crowd.
examples.zh: 军队向人群开火了。

examples.en: Sanches opened the scoring (= scored the first goal or point).
examples.zh: 桑谢斯首开纪录（=第一个进球或得分）。

examples.en: They will open the new season with a performance of ‘Carmen’.
examples.zh: 他们将以上演《卡门》来开启新的戏剧季。

senses.def: to start in a particular way; to make something start in a particular way

examples.en: How does the play open?
examples.zh: 这部剧怎么开场呢？

examples.en: The story opens with a murder.
examples.zh: 这个故事以谋杀案开始。

examples.en: He opened with a version of Elvis's ‘Can't Help Falling in Love’.
examples.zh: 他以埃尔维斯《情不自禁爱上你》的一个版本开始了。

examples.en: The film opens on a close-up of her face.
examples.zh: 影片以她脸部的特写镜头开始。

examples.en: I opened the story with Viola because I wanted the reader to ‘meet’ everybody through her eyes.
examples.zh: 我把薇奥拉作为故事的开场人物，因为我想让读者通过她的眼睛去“结识”每个人。

senses.def: to perform a ceremony showing that a building can start being used
senses.zh: 为（建筑物）揭幕；宣布启用

examples.en: The King officially opened the bridge in March.
examples.zh: 国王于三月正式开放了这座桥。

senses.def: to make it possible to reach, have, use or do something
senses.zh: 开放；使可以达到（或取得、使用等）

examples.en: This decision opens the possibility of a fresh election.
examples.zh: 这一决定使新一轮选举成为可能。

examples.en: The bus pass has opened a new world for me.
examples.zh: 公交卡为我打开了一个新世界。

examples.en: Computer modelling opened new avenues for research.
examples.zh: 计算机建模开辟了新的研究途径。

examples.en: The country opened its markets to the rest of the world for the first time.
examples.zh: 该国首次向世界其他地区开放了市场。

senses.group: make something possible 使可能发生

senses.def: it begins to rain heavily

examples.en: All at once the heavens opened and everyone rushed for cover.
examples.zh: 突然天开了，所有人都赶紧寻找掩护。

senses.group: make something possible 使可能发生

senses.def: to provide opportunities for somebody to do something and be successful
senses.group: make something possible 使可能发生

senses.def: to realize or make somebody realize the truth about something
senses.zh: （使人）长见识（或开眼界、认清事实）

examples.en: Travelling really opens your eyes to other cultures.
examples.zh: 旅游真正能使人开阔眼界，认识其他文化。

senses.group: make something possible 使可能发生

senses.def: to become or make somebody aware of new ideas or experiences

examples.en: He’s eager to open the minds of his audience to different kinds of music.
examples.zh: 他渴望让听众接受不同类型的音乐。

senses.group: make something possible 使可能发生

senses.def: to make it possible for somebody to do something or for something to happen

examples.en: The agreement could open the way for the country to pay off its debts.
examples.zh: 这一协定使得该国有望还清债务。

senses.group: make something possible 使可能发生

senses.def: to tell somebody all your problems, feelings, etc.
senses.zh: 向某人敞开心扉；倾诉衷肠

examples.en: Finally, he broke down in tears and poured out his heart to her.
examples.zh: 最后他潸然泪下，向她倾诉衷肠。

senses.group: make something possible 使可能发生

senses.def: outdoors; the countryside

examples.en: Children need to play out in the open.
examples.zh: 孩子需要在户外玩耍。

senses.def: not hidden or secret

examples.en: Government officials do not want these comments in the open.
examples.zh: 政府官员不想公开这些评论。

examples.en: They intend to bring their complaints out into the open.
examples.zh: 他们想把心中的种种不满公开讲出来。

senses.def: if something is an open secret
to open suddenly or violently; to make something open in this way

examples.en: The door burst open.
examples.zh: 门突然开了。

examples.en: Firefighters burst the door open and rescued them.
examples.zh: 消防队员撞开门，把他们救了出来。

senses.def: (to provide) the means of getting or reaching something; (to create) the opportunity for something
senses.zh: （为…提供）达到目的的手段；（为…创造）机会

examples.en: The agreement will open the door to increased international trade.
examples.zh: 此协议将会提供增进国际贸易的机会。

examples.en: Our courses are the door to success in English.
examples.zh: 我们的课程是通向掌握英语的成功之路。

senses.def: to be willing to listen to or accept new ideas or suggestions
senses.zh: 愿意聆听（或接受）意见；（对…）不怀成见；思想开明

examples.en: Try to keep an open mind until you've heard all the facts.
examples.zh: 在听完所有的事实前先不要存任何看法。

senses.def: to listen or look out for somebody/something that you might hear or see
senses.zh: 留心听；保持警惕；密切注意

senses.def: to look for somebody/something while you are doing other things

examples.en: Police have asked residents to keep an eye out for anything suspicious.
examples.zh: 警方要求居民密切注意一切可疑的情况。

examples.en: I walked around the store, keeping an eye out for bargains.
examples.zh: 我在商店里转悠，留心看有没有便宜货。

senses.def: to avoid making a decision now so that you still have a choice in the future
senses.zh: 保留选择余地；暂不决定

examples.en: At the moment I'm keeping my options open and applying for as many different jobs as possible.
examples.zh: 目前，我保持开放的选择并申请尽可能多的不同工作。

senses.def: available to buy without any limits
if you describe somebody or their life as an open book
an invitation to somebody to visit you at any time
if something is an open invitation
senses.zh: 容易引诱人犯罪的行为

examples.en: Leaving your camera on the seat in the car is an open invitation to thieves.
examples.zh: 把照相机留在汽车座位上无异于开门揖盗。

senses.def: fully aware of the possible problems or results of a particular course of action
senses.zh: 明知后果如何；明知有问题；心中有数

examples.en: I went into this with my eyes open so I guess I only have myself to blame.
examples.zh: 我是明明知道做这事的后果的，所以我想只能责怪我自己。

senses.def: if you welcome somebody with open arms
it begins to rain heavily

examples.en: All at once the heavens opened and everyone rushed for cover.
examples.zh: 突然天开了，所有人都赶紧寻找掩护。

senses.def: to provide opportunities for somebody to do something and be successful
to realize or make somebody realize the truth about something
senses.zh: （使人）长见识（或开眼界、认清事实）

examples.en: Travelling really opens your eyes to other cultures.
examples.zh: 旅游真正能使人开阔眼界，认识其他文化。

senses.def: to become or make somebody aware of new ideas or experiences

examples.en: He’s eager to open the minds of his audience to different kinds of music.
examples.zh: 他渴望让听众接受不同类型的音乐。

items.idm: open the way for somebody/something (to do something)

senses.def: to make it possible for somebody to do something or for something to happen

examples.en: The agreement could open the way for the country to pay off its debts.
examples.zh: 这一协定使得该国有望还清债务。

items.idm: pour out/open your heart to somebody

senses.def: to tell somebody all your problems, feelings, etc.
senses.zh: 向某人敞开心扉；倾诉衷肠

examples.en: Finally, he broke down in tears and poured out his heart to her.
examples.zh: 最后他潸然泪下，向她倾诉衷肠。

synonyms.words: frank ▪ direct ▪ open ▪ outspoken ▪ straight ▪ blunt

intro.en: These words all describe people saying exactly what they mean without trying to hide feelings, opinions or facts.
intro.zh: 以上各词均形容人坦率、坦诚。

items.def: not hiding the truth about something:
items.zh: 指坦率的、坦诚的

examples.en: Thank you for being so honest with me.
examples.zh: 感谢你对我这么坦诚。

items.def: honest in what you say, sometimes in a way that other people might not like:
items.zh: 指坦率的、直率的（有时可能不讨人喜欢）

examples.en: To be frank with you, I think your son has little chance of passing the exam.
examples.zh: 坦白说，我认为你的儿子不大可能通过考试。

items.def: saying exactly what you mean in a way that nobody can pretend not to understand:
items.zh: 指直接的、直率的、坦率的

examples.en: You’ll have to get used to his direct manner.
examples.zh: 你得慢慢习惯他这种直率的方式。

items.def: (approving) (of a person) not keeping thoughts and feelings hidden:
items.zh: 指为人诚恳的、坦诚的、直率的

examples.en: He was quite open about his reasons for leaving.
examples.zh: 他对离开的原因完全未加隐瞒。

items.def: saying exactly what you think, even if this shocks or offends people:
items.zh: 指直率的、坦诚的、直言不讳的

examples.en: She was outspoken in her criticism of the plan.
examples.zh: 她对该计划的批评直言不讳。

items.def: honest and direct:
items.zh: 指坦诚的、直率的

examples.en: I don’t think you’re being straight with me.
examples.zh: 我觉得你没跟我坦诚相见。

items.def: saying exactly what you think without trying to be polite:
items.zh: 指嘴直的、直言不讳的

examples.en: She has a reputation for blunt speaking.
examples.zh: 她说话出了名的直截了当。

synonyms.words: begin ▪ start off ▪ kick off ▪ commence ▪ open

intro.en: These words are all used to talk about things happening from the beginning, or people doing the first part of something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均用以指事情开始发生或开始做某事。

items.def: to begin to happen or exist; to begin in a particular way or from a particular point:
items.zh: 指开始发生或存在、以…开始、以…为起点

examples.en: When does the class start?
examples.zh: 什么时候上课？

items.def: to start to happen or exist; to start in a particular way or from a particular point; to start speaking:
items.zh: 指开始发生或存在、以…开始、以…为起点、开始讲话

examples.en: When does the concert begin?
examples.zh: 音乐会什么时候开始？

items.def: (rather informal) to start happening or doing something; to start by doing or being something:
items.zh: 指进行或开展起来、首先进行、一开始是

examples.en: The discussion started off mildly enough.
examples.zh: 讨论颇为温和地开展起来。

items.def: (informal) to start an event or activity, especially in a particular way; (of an event, activity, etc.) to start, especially in a particular way:
items.zh: 尤指以…开始（活动）、（活动）以…开始

examples.en: Tom will kick off with a few comments.
examples.zh: 汤姆讲话时要先发表几点意见。

items.def: (formal) to start happening:
items.zh: 指开始发生

examples.en: The meeting is scheduled to commence at noon.
examples.zh: 会议定于午间召开。

items.def: to start an event or activity in a particular way; (of an event, a film or a book) to start, especially in a particular way:
items.zh: 指以…开始（活动）、（活动、电影或书）以…开头／开篇

examples.en: The story opens with a murder.
examples.zh: 这个故事以谋杀案开始。

senses.def: to realize or make somebody realize the truth about something
senses.zh: （使人）长见识（或开眼界、认清事实）

examples.en: Travelling really opens your eyes to other cultures.
examples.zh: 旅游真正能使人开阔眼界，认识其他文化。

senses.def: to become or make somebody aware of new ideas or experiences

examples.en: He’s eager to open the minds of his audience to different kinds of music.
examples.zh: 他渴望让听众接受不同类型的音乐。

senses.def: the fact of something being available to anyone who wants it
senses.zh: 开放获取；开放存取；向所有人开放

examples.en: Technology, she stressed, provides open access to education.
examples.zh: 她强调，科技让所有人有获取教育的机会。

senses.def: happening or existing outside rather than inside a building

examples.en: an open-air swimming pool
examples.zh: 露天游泳池

senses.def: a legal case or other matter that is easy to decide or solve
senses.zh: 容易解决的案件（或问题）

examples.en: The murder was an open-and-shut case.
examples.zh: 这桩谋杀案很容易侦破。

senses.def: an occasion when all the drinks at a party or other event have been paid for by somebody else or are included in the ticket price
senses.zh: （聚会等场合的）酒水免费，酒水已付

senses.def: the practice of openly carrying a gun in public

examples.en: Open carry is legal in most states.
examples.zh: 露天携带在大多数州都是合法的。

examples.en: open carry laws
examples.zh: 开放套利法

senses.def: a day when people can visit a school, an organization, etc. and see the work that is done there
senses.zh: （学校、机关等的）开放日，开放参观日

senses.def: allowing people or goods freedom to come into a country; allowing people to go to a place or get information without controls or limits
senses.zh: 门户开放的；自由往来的

examples.en: the country’s open-door policy for refugees
examples.zh: 这个国家对难民的开放政策

examples.en: You are welcome to visit the school at any time; we have an open-door policy.
examples.zh: 欢迎您随时来学校参观；我们有开放政策。

senses.def: a policy within a company or other organization designed to allow people to freely communicate with the people in charge
senses.zh: （公司或机构中下属与主管）直接沟通的；政策开明的

examples.en: We operate an open-door policy here, and are always willing to listen to our students' suggestions.
examples.zh: 我们这里实行“开门政策”，愿意随时听取学生的建议。

senses.def: a situation that allows something to happen, or that allows people to go to a place or get information without controls or limits

examples.en: The government's policy is an open door to disaster.
examples.zh: 政府的政策为灾难敞开了大门。

examples.en: An insecure computer system is an open door to criminals.
examples.zh: 不安全的电脑系统给罪犯提供了可乘之机。

senses.def: without any limits, aims or dates fixed in advance
senses.zh: 无限制的；无确定目标的；无期限的

examples.en: an open-ended discussion
examples.zh: 无限制的自由讨论

examples.en: The contract is open-ended.
examples.zh: 本合同是无限期的。

senses.def: a slice of bread with meat, cheese, etc. on top but without a second slice of bread to cover this
senses.zh: 单片三明治，露馅三明治（顶层无面包片覆盖）

senses.def: generous and giving willingly

examples.en: an open-handed host
examples.zh: 一位慷慨大方的东道主

senses.def: using the flat part of the hand

examples.en: an open-handed blow
examples.zh: 用巴掌打

senses.def: a medical operation on the heart, during which the patient’s blood is kept flowing by a machine
senses.zh: 体外循环心脏手术；心脏直视手术；开心术

senses.def: kind and friendly
a place or a time at which visitors are welcome

examples.en: It's always open house at their place.
examples.zh: 他们的房舍随时对外开放参观。

examples.en: Our basement is an open house for our kids' friends.
examples.zh: 我们的地下室是为孩子们的朋友开放的房子。

examples.en: We usually host an open house for Chinese New Year.
examples.zh: 我们通常会在农历新年期间举办开放日活动。

senses.def: a day when people can visit a school, an organization, etc. and see the work that is done there
senses.zh: （学校、机关等的）开放日，开放参观日

senses.def: a time when people who are interested in buying a particular house or apartment can look around it
senses.zh: （为欲购房者而设的）看房时间

senses.def: to lead to another room, area or place

examples.en: This door opens onto the yard.
examples.zh: 这扇门通向院子。

examples.en: The two rooms open into each other.
examples.zh: 两个房间相互敞开。

senses.def: allowing somebody to fly to one place and fly back from another place
senses.zh: 开口的，缺口的，不同点进出的（可选择回程出发地）

senses.def: a letter of complaint or protest to an important person or group that is printed in a newspaper so that the public can read it

examples.en: The editor published an open letter to the president.
examples.zh: 编辑发表了一份给总统的公开信。

senses.def: relating to a radio or television programme that the public can take part in by phone
senses.zh: （电台或电视节目）公众可打电话参与的，开放式的，互动式的

examples.en: an open-line radio show
examples.zh: 互动式电台节目

senses.def: a phone communication in which conversations can be heard or recorded by others
senses.zh: 可被监听（或录音）的电话；开放线路电话

senses.def: a situation in which companies can trade without limits, and prices depend on the amount of goods and the number of people buying them

examples.en: to buy/sell/trade on the open market
examples.zh: 在自由市场上买／卖／交易

senses.def: a marriage or relationship in which both partners agree that each may have sexual relationships with others
senses.zh: 开放式婚姻（婚姻双方均同意对方可以有其他性关系的婚姻）

examples.en: Brian struggled to reconcile Anna's open marriage with his conservative views.
examples.zh: 布莱恩努力调和安娜的开放婚姻与他的保守观点。

examples.en: Her husband of 30 years proposed an open marriage, an idea that was devastating to her.
examples.zh: 与她结婚 30 年的丈夫提出了开放式婚姻，这个想法对她来说是毁灭性的打击。

senses.def: an occasion in a club when anyone can sing, play music or tell jokes
senses.zh: 开放麦（俱乐部中开放给所有人上台即兴表演的活动）

examples.en: open-mic night
examples.zh: 开放麦之夜

senses.def: willing to listen to, think about or accept different ideas
senses.zh: 愿意考虑不同意见的；思想开明的

examples.en: I encourage the children to be open-minded about new ideas and experiences.
examples.zh: 我鼓励孩子接受新观念和尝试新事物。

senses.def: the quality of being willing to listen to, think about or accept different ideas
senses.zh: 愿意考虑不同意见的；思想开明的

senses.def: with your mouth open because you are surprised or shocked
senses.zh: （因惊愕）张着口的，瞠目结舌的，目瞪口呆的

examples.en: The kids stared open-mouthed at the screen.
examples.zh: 孩子们目瞪口呆地盯着屏幕。

senses.def: worn without a tie and with the top button undone
senses.zh: 未打领带也未扣领扣的；敞领的

senses.def: to lead to another room, area or place

examples.en: This door opens onto the yard.
examples.zh: 这扇门通向院子。

examples.en: The two rooms open into each other.
examples.zh: 两个房间相互敞开。

senses.def: to become bigger or wider
