examples.en: He opined that Prague was the most beautiful city in Europe.
examples.zh: 他认为布拉格是欧洲最美丽的城市。

examples.en: The headmistress opined that the outing would make a nice change for them.
examples.zh: 校长认为这次郊游对他们来说是一个很好的改变。

senses.def: your feelings or thoughts about somebody/something, rather than a fact

examples.en: He has very strong political opinions.
examples.zh: 他的政见颇为坚定。

examples.en: We were invited to give our opinions about how the work should be done.
examples.zh: 我们应邀就如何开展工作提出意见。

examples.en: I've recently changed my opinion of her.
examples.zh: 我最近改变了对她的看法。

examples.en: You will have the chance to voice your opinions on the matter.
examples.zh: 你将有机会就此事发表意见。

examples.en: We all have opinions about what is wrong with the process.
examples.zh: 对于流程中的问题，我们都有自己的看法。

examples.en: The chairman expressed the opinion that job losses were inevitable.
examples.zh: 主席认为，失业在所难免。

examples.en: I formed the opinion that he was not to be trusted.
examples.zh: 我得出的结论是他不可信。

examples.en: It is our opinion that he should resign.
examples.zh: 我们认为他应该辞职。

examples.en: In my personal opinion, it's a very sound investment.
examples.zh: 依我看，这是十分稳健的投资。

examples.en: If you want my opinion, I think you'd be crazy not to accept.
examples.zh: 既然要我说嘛，我认为你不接受那才傻呢。

examples.en: In my humble opinion, you were wrong.
examples.zh: 以我的拙见，你错了。

examples.en: He writes an opinion piece in the ‘New York Times’.
examples.zh: 他在《纽约时报》发表文章表态。

senses.def: the beliefs or views of a group of people

examples.en: legal/medical/political opinion (= the beliefs of people working in the legal, etc. profession)
examples.zh: 法学界／医学界／政界的观点

examples.en: There is a difference of opinion (= people disagree) as to the merits of the plan.
examples.zh: 关于这个计划的优缺点，大家有意见分歧。

examples.en: Opinion is divided (= people disagree) on the issue.
examples.zh: 大家对这件事意见分歧。

examples.en: to split/polarize opinion
examples.zh: 意见分裂/两极分化

examples.en: to sway/shape/influence opinion
examples.zh: 影响/影响意见

examples.en: Popular opinion is shifting in favour of change.
examples.zh: 大众舆论正在转向支持变革。

examples.en: There is a wide body of opinion that supports this proposal.
examples.zh: 支持这项提议的大有人在。

examples.en: Which is the better is a matter of opinion (= people have different opinions about it).
examples.zh: 哪一个比较好只是看法问题。

examples.en: Opinion among fans is mixed, but most approve the new direction.
examples.zh: 粉丝们的意见不一，但大多数人都赞同这一新方向。

senses.def: advice from a professional person

examples.en: The couple sought the opinions of other doctors who confirmed the diagnosis.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇征求了其他确认了这一诊断的医生的意见。

examples.en: Get an expert opinion before you invest.
examples.zh: 在投资之前，先征求专家意见。

examples.en: I'd like a second opinion (= advice from another person) before I make a decision.
examples.zh: 我在作决定之前，想听听别人的意见。

examples.en: They called in a psychologist to give an independent opinion.
examples.zh: 他们征询一位心理学家的独立意见。

senses.def: to believe or think that…

examples.en: We are strongly of the opinion that great caution should be exercised in dealing with this matter.
examples.zh: 我们强烈认为，在处理此事时应格外谨慎。

senses.def: your opinion that is the result of careful thought
senses.zh: 成熟的意见；经过深思熟虑的意见

examples.en: It is my considered opinion that you are wrong.
examples.zh: 我经过深思熟虑后认为你错了。

senses.def: to think that somebody/something is good, bad, etc.
senses.zh: 对…有（好的、不好的、高的、低的等）评价

examples.en: The boss has a very high opinion of her.
examples.zh: 老板对她评价很高。

senses.def: to believe or think that…

examples.en: We are strongly of the opinion that great caution should be exercised in dealing with this matter.
examples.zh: 我们强烈认为，在处理此事时应格外谨慎。

senses.def: your opinion that is the result of careful thought
senses.zh: 成熟的意见；经过深思熟虑的意见

examples.en: It is my considered opinion that you are wrong.
examples.zh: 我经过深思熟虑后认为你错了。

items.idm: have a good, bad, high, low, etc. opinion of somebody/something

senses.def: to think that somebody/something is good, bad, etc.
senses.zh: 对…有（好的、不好的、高的、低的等）评价

examples.en: The boss has a very high opinion of her.
examples.zh: 老板对她评价很高。

senses.def: the process of questioning people who are representative of a larger group in order to get information about the general opinion

examples.en: The president has a clear lead in the opinion polls.
examples.zh: 总统在民意调查中明显领先。

senses.def: having very strong opinions that you are not willing to change

examples.en: I’ve never met anyone so arrogant and opinionated.
examples.zh: 我从未见过如此傲慢和固执己见的人。

senses.def: any of a class of drugs that are similar to opium
senses.zh: 阿片类物质（作用类似于鸦片，医学上用于镇痛；有些人为寻求刺激非法服用会成瘾）

examples.en: The study involved patients who had been prescribed opioids for chronic pain.
examples.zh: 究涉及因慢性疼痛而服用阿片类药物的患者。

senses.def: relating to opioids

examples.en: Opioid addiction has become a serious problem.
examples.zh: 阿片类药物成瘾已经成为一个严重的问题。

senses.def: a powerful drug made from the juice of a type of poppy

examples.en: opium poppies
examples.zh: 罂粟

examples.en: the opium trade
examples.zh: 鸦片贸易

senses.def: a small American or Australian animal that lives in trees and carries its young in a pouch
senses.zh: 负鼠（产于美洲或澳大利亚的小动物，在树上生活，携幼崽于母兽育儿袋中）

senses.def: a person that you are playing or fighting against in a game, competition, argument, etc.

examples.en: a political opponent
examples.zh: 政敌

examples.en: a worthy/formidable/fierce/tough/staunch opponent
examples.zh: 值得尊敬的／可怕的／凶猛的／强硬的／坚定的对手

examples.en: The team's opponents are unbeaten so far this season.
examples.zh: 该队的竞争对手本赛季尚无败绩。

senses.def: a person who is against something and tries to change or stop it

examples.en: opponents of abortion
examples.zh: 反对堕胎的人

examples.en: opponents of the regime
examples.zh: 反对政权的人

examples.en: the most outspoken opponents of the war
examples.zh: 最直言不讳的战争反对者

examples.en: Opponents argue that the scheme would be prohibitively expensive.
examples.zh: 反对者辩称，该计划的成本将高得令人却步。

examples.en: There were violent clashes between supporters and opponents of the government.
examples.zh: 政府的支持者和反对者之间发生了暴力冲突。

senses.def: suitable for doing a particular thing, so that it is likely to be successful

examples.en: The offer could not have come at a more opportune moment.
examples.zh: 那个建议提得正是时候。

examples.en: Chapman decided the time was opportune for talking business.
examples.zh: 查普曼认为现在是谈生意的好时机。

examples.en: It was an opportune time to look at the offer in more detail.
examples.zh: 现在正是更详细地了解该报价的好时机。

senses.def: done or happening at the right time to be successful

examples.en: an opportune remark
examples.zh: 适时的言辞

examples.en: The publication of the book now is quite opportune.
examples.zh: 现在本书的出版恰逢其时。

senses.def: at a suitable time or the right time

examples.en: He hailed a taxi that opportunely appeared.
examples.zh: 他招呼了一辆恰巧出现的出租车。

examples.en: A slight shower came opportunely to refresh the atmosphere.
examples.zh: 一场小雨恰巧降临，让气氛焕然一新。

senses.def: the practice of using situations unfairly to gain advantage for yourself without thinking about how your actions will affect other people

examples.en: political opportunism
examples.zh: 政治机会主义

senses.def: making use of an opportunity, especially to get an advantage for yourself; not done in a planned way
senses.zh: 机会主义的；投机的；见风转舵的

examples.en: an opportunist crime
examples.zh: 临时起意的偶发犯罪

examples.en: Smith marked his debut match with an opportunist goal.
examples.zh: 史密斯以一个机会主义进球标志着他的首场比赛。

senses.def: a person who makes use of an opportunity, especially to get an advantage
senses.zh: 机会主义的；投机的；见风转舵的

examples.en: 80 per cent of burglaries are committed by casual opportunists.
examples.zh: 80% 的入室行窃案为临时起意者所为。

senses.def: making use of an opportunity, especially to get an advantage for yourself; not done in a planned way
senses.zh: 机会主义的；投机的；见风转舵的

senses.def: harmful to people whose immune system
senses.zh: 机会致病性的（对免疫系统差的人有害）

examples.en: an opportunistic infection
examples.zh: 机会性感染

senses.def: a time when a particular situation makes it possible to do or achieve something

examples.en: Don't miss this opportunity!
examples.zh: 勿失良机！

examples.en: You'll have the opportunity to ask any questions at the end.
examples.zh: 你们最后将有机会提问任何问题。

examples.en: I'd like to take this opportunity to thank my colleagues for their support.
examples.zh: 我谨借此机会感谢同事的支持。

examples.en: The conference offers a unique opportunity for professionals to meet each other.
examples.zh: 这次研讨会为专业人士提供了难得的见面机会。

examples.en: The internship provides an opportunity for students to learn about the challenges involved.
examples.zh: 实习为学生提供了了解所涉及挑战的机会。

examples.en: There was no opportunity for further discussion.
examples.zh: 没有机会进行深入讨论了。

examples.en: There’ll be plenty of opportunity for relaxing once the work is done.
examples.zh: 工作一完成，放松的机会有的是。

examples.en: At least give him the opportunity of explaining what happened.
examples.zh: 至少要给他机会解释一下发生了什么事。

examples.en: career/employment/job opportunities
examples.zh: 职业发展／就业／工作机会

examples.en: a business/an investment opportunity
examples.zh: 一个企业/一个投资机会

examples.en: He is rude to me at every opportunity (= whenever possible).
examples.zh: 他动不动就对我粗鲁无礼。

examples.en: They intend to close the school at the earliest opportunity (= as soon as possible).
examples.zh: 他们打算尽早关闭学校。

examples.en: I would definitely go if the opportunity arose.
examples.zh: 要是有机会，我一定会去的。

examples.en: a window of opportunity (= a period of time when the circumstances are right for doing something)
examples.zh: 行事的良机

senses.def: the third Mars Rover
senses.zh: 机会：第三辆火星探测器车于2004年降落在火星上并将该行星的照片发送回了NASA

senses.def: the fact that when you choose one option, you lose the potential benefits of the other options
senses.zh: 机会成本（作出某个选择而放弃其他机会可能造成的损失）

examples.en: There may be an opportunity cost to not having your money invested elsewhere.
examples.zh: 不把资金投到其他地方可能会有机会成本。

examples.en: Consider the opportunity cost of accepting a job because you are, by default, rejecting everything else out there.
examples.zh: 考虑接受一份工作的机会成本，因为默认情况下你会拒绝其他一切。

examples.en: The programme lost money when opportunity costs were taken into account.
examples.zh: 如果考虑到机会成本，该计划就会亏损。

examples.en: We need to consider the opportunity cost represented by lost capacity at closed plants.
examples.zh: 我们需要考虑关闭工厂产能损失所代表的机会成本。

senses.def: a shop that sells clothes and other goods given by people to raise money for a charity
senses.zh: 慈善商店（通过出售捐赠的衣物等募集慈善资金）

senses.def: capable of touching the other fingers on the same hand in order to hold things
senses.zh: 与其他手指对生的（可握住东西）

examples.en: the opposable thumb of humans and monkeys
examples.zh: 人类和猴子的对生拇指

senses.def: to disagree strongly with somebody’s plan, policy, etc. and try to change it or prevent it from succeeding
senses.zh: 反对（计划、政策等）；抵制；阻挠

examples.en: This party would bitterly oppose the re-introduction of the death penalty.
examples.zh: 该党会强烈反对恢复死刑。

examples.en: He threw all those that opposed him into prison.
examples.zh: 他把所有反对他的人都投进了监狱。

examples.en: to oppose a war/bill/plan
examples.zh: 反对战争/法案/计划

examples.en: Do you support or oppose this proposal?
examples.zh: 您支持还是反对这个提议？

examples.en: The children strongly opposed the idea.
examples.zh: 孩子们强烈反对这个想法。

examples.en: He vehemently opposed the War of 1812.
examples.zh: 他强烈反对1812年的战争。

examples.en: She is adamantly opposed to the war.
examples.zh: 她坚决反对战争。

examples.en: I would oppose changing the law.
examples.zh: 我将反对改变这个法规。

examples.en: Her father opposed her becoming a missionary.
examples.zh: 她的父亲反对她成为传教士。

senses.def: to compete with somebody in a contest

examples.en: He intends to oppose the prime minister in the leadership election.
examples.zh: 在领导层选举中，他欲与首相一决高下。

senses.def: on the other side of a particular area from somebody/something and usually facing them

examples.en: Answers are given on the opposite page.
examples.zh: 答案在对页上。

examples.en: We live further down on the opposite side of the road.
examples.zh: 我们住在马路对面再远一点的地方。

examples.en: It's not easy having a relationship when you live at opposite ends of the country.
examples.zh: 人虽同国却各处东西；在这种情况下保持交往，谈何容易。

senses.def: facing the speaker or somebody/something that has been mentioned

examples.en: I could see smoke coming from the windows of the house directly opposite.
examples.zh: 我能看到烟从正对面的窗户里冒出来。

examples.en: He sat down in the chair opposite.
examples.zh: 他在对面的椅子上坐了下来。

senses.def: as different as possible from something

examples.en: I watched them leave and then drove off in the opposite direction.
examples.zh: 我目送他们离开，然后开车向相反的方向驶去。

examples.en: She tried calming him down but it seemed to be having the opposite effect.
examples.zh: 她试着让他平静下来，却似乎适得其反了。

examples.en: students at opposite ends of the ability range
examples.zh: 能力差距两极的学生

examples.en: a story about a pair of young boys from opposite extremes of society
examples.zh: 一个关于一对来自社会对立极端的小男孩的故事

examples.en: She took a view opposite to that of Fraser.
examples.zh: 她持与弗雷泽相反的观点。

senses.def: a person who does the same job as you in another organization
senses.zh: （另一个单位内）与自己职位相当的人

examples.en: The Foreign Secretary is currently having talks with his opposite number in the White House.
examples.zh: 外交大臣现正和白宫的对等官员会谈。

senses.def: the other sex

examples.en: He found it difficult to talk to members of the opposite sex.
examples.zh: 他觉得很难与异性交谈。

senses.def: to have different aims that cannot be achieved together without causing problems

examples.en: There are different considerations, often pulling in different directions.
examples.zh: 有各种不同的考虑，常令隔阂愈来愈深。

senses.def: a person or thing that is as different as possible from somebody/something else
senses.zh: 对立的人（或物）；对立面；反面

examples.en: Hot and cold are opposites.
examples.zh: 热和冷是对立面。

examples.en: What is the opposite of heavy?
examples.zh: 重的反义词是什么？

examples.en: She says the exact opposite of what she means—it's confusing.
examples.zh: 她心口不一，令人困惑。

examples.en: The effect was exactly the opposite to what he intended.
examples.zh: 结果与他想要的正好相反。

examples.en: I thought she would be small and blonde but she's the complete opposite.
examples.zh: 我原以为她是一位身材娇小的金发女郎，但她恰恰相反。

examples.en: Archie and Mike are polar opposites forced to live under the same roof.
examples.zh: 阿奇和迈克性格截然相反，被迫生活在同一屋檐下。

examples.en: ‘Is it better now?’ ‘Quite the opposite, I'm afraid.’
examples.zh: “现在好点了吗？”“恐怕正相反。”

examples.en: I ask you to do something and you go and do the opposite—why?
examples.zh: 我要你做什么，你总是反其道而行之。为什么？

examples.en: I have never been asked to leave. In fact the opposite is the case.
examples.zh: 我从未被要求离开。事实上，情况恰恰相反。

senses.def: used to say that people who are very different are often attracted to each other
on the other side of a particular area from somebody/something, and usually facing them

examples.en: I sat opposite him during the meal (= on the other side of the table).
examples.zh: 席间我坐在他的对面。

examples.en: The bank is opposite the supermarket (= on the other side of the road).
examples.zh: 银行在超市的正对面。

examples.en: Write your address opposite (= next to) your name.
examples.zh: 在姓名旁边写上你的地址。

senses.def: acting in a film or play as the partner of somebody

examples.en: She starred opposite Tom Hanks.
examples.zh: 她与汤姆·汉克斯联袂主演。

senses.def: on the other side of a particular area from somebody/something and usually facing them

examples.en: There's a newly married couple living opposite (= on the other side of the road).
examples.zh: 对面住了一对新婚夫妇。

examples.en: See opposite (= on the opposite page) for further details.
examples.zh: 详见对页。

senses.def: a person who does the same job as you in another organization
senses.zh: （另一个单位内）与自己职位相当的人

examples.en: The Foreign Secretary is currently having talks with his opposite number in the White House.
examples.zh: 外交大臣现正和白宫的对等官员会谈。

senses.def: the other sex

examples.en: He found it difficult to talk to members of the opposite sex.
examples.zh: 他觉得很难与异性交谈。

senses.def: to have different aims that cannot be achieved together without causing problems

examples.en: There are different considerations, often pulling in different directions.
examples.zh: 有各种不同的考虑，常令隔阂愈来愈深。

senses.def: used to say that people who are very different are often attracted to each other
used to say that people who are very different are often attracted to each other
the act of strongly disagreeing with somebody/something, especially with the aim of preventing something from happening

examples.en: Opposition came primarily from students.
examples.zh: 反对意见主要来自学生。

examples.en: Delegates expressed strong opposition to the plans.
examples.zh: 代表强烈反对这些计划。

examples.en: He spent five years in prison for his opposition to the regime.
examples.zh: 他因为反对那个政权而过了五年的铁窗生活。

examples.en: They mounted an effective opposition to the bill.
examples.zh: 他们发起了对此议案的有力抵抗。

examples.en: There was widespread opposition to the war.
examples.zh: 人们普遍反对战争。

examples.en: The army met with fierce opposition in every town.
examples.zh: 军队在每一座城镇都遭遇到了顽强的抵抗。

examples.en: The proposal faced stiff opposition.
examples.zh: 该提案遭到强烈反对。

examples.en: We cannot back down at the first sign of opposition.
examples.zh: 我们不能在第一次出现反对迹象时就退缩。

examples.en: opposition forces (= people who are arguing, fighting, etc. with another group)
examples.zh: 反对势力

examples.en: Greens are prominent among opposition groups in several countries.
examples.zh: 绿党在一些国家的反对派团体中占有重要地位。

senses.def: the act of competing against somebody in a contest

examples.en: She won against determined opposition from last year's champion.
examples.zh: 她顶住了去年冠军的顽强抵抗，获得了胜利。

examples.en: He is expected to face stiff opposition from countryman, Scott, who has also emerged as a leading contender.
examples.zh: 预计他将面临同胞斯科特的强烈反对，斯科特也已成为主要竞争者。

senses.def: the people you are competing against in business, a competition, a game, etc.
senses.zh: （商业、竞赛、游戏等的）对手，敌手，竞争者

examples.en: He's gone to work for the opposition.
examples.zh: 他去为竞争对手工作了。

examples.en: The opposition is/are mounting a strong challenge to our business.
examples.zh: 对方正对我方企业逐渐形成强大的挑战。

examples.en: Liverpool couldn't match the opposition in the final and lost 2–0.
examples.zh: 利物浦队在决赛中不敌对手，以 0:2 输掉比赛。

senses.def: the main political party that is opposed to the government; the political parties that are in a parliament but are not part of the government

examples.en: the leader of the Opposition
examples.zh: 反对党领袖

examples.en: Opposition MPs/politicians/parties
examples.zh: 反对党议员／政客；反对党

examples.en: the Opposition spokesperson on education
examples.zh: 反对党教育发言人

examples.en: They received support from the main opposition leaders.
examples.zh: 他们得到了主要反对派领导人的支持。

examples.en: He has led the political opposition for the past decade.
examples.zh: 在过去十年中，他一直领导着政治反对派。

senses.def: the state of being as different as possible; two things that are as different as possible

examples.en: the opposition between good and evil
examples.zh: 善与恶的对立

examples.en: His poetry is full of oppositions and contrasts.
examples.zh: 他的诗歌充满了对立与对比。

senses.def: forming part of a parliament but not part of the government

examples.en: They returned to power after six years in opposition.
examples.zh: 他们在野六年后重新掌权。

examples.en: The Conservative Party is now in opposition.
examples.zh: 保守党现在处于反对党的地位。

senses.def: disagreeing strongly with somebody/something, especially with the aim of preventing something from happening
senses.zh: 强烈反对（或抵制）某人／某事物

examples.en: We found ourselves in opposition to several colleagues on this issue.
examples.zh: 我们在这一问题上与几个同事意见相左。

examples.en: Protest marches were held in opposition to the proposed law.
examples.zh: 为抗议新提出的法案举行了示威游行。

senses.def: contrasting two people or things that are very different

examples.en: Leisure is often defined in opposition to work.
examples.zh: 休闲常被定义为工作的反面。

senses.def: forming part of a parliament but not part of the government

examples.en: They returned to power after six years in opposition.
examples.zh: 他们在野六年后重新掌权。

examples.en: The Conservative Party is now in opposition.
examples.zh: 保守党现在处于反对党的地位。

senses.def: disagreeing strongly with somebody/something, especially with the aim of preventing something from happening
senses.zh: 强烈反对（或抵制）某人／某事物

examples.en: We found ourselves in opposition to several colleagues on this issue.
examples.zh: 我们在这一问题上与几个同事意见相左。

examples.en: Protest marches were held in opposition to the proposed law.
examples.zh: 为抗议新提出的法案举行了示威游行。

senses.def: contrasting two people or things that are very different

examples.en: Leisure is often defined in opposition to work.
examples.zh: 休闲常被定义为工作的反面。

senses.def: strongly disagreeing with somebody/something

examples.en: oppositional groups
examples.zh: 反对派团体

examples.en: The party had tried to exclude all oppositional voices.
examples.zh: 该党曾试图排除所有反对声音。

senses.def: as different as possible from one another

examples.en: two quite different and somewhat oppositional stances
examples.zh: 两种截然不同且有些对立的立场

senses.def: to treat somebody in a cruel and unfair way, especially by not giving them the same freedom, rights, etc. as other people

examples.en: The regime is accused of oppressing religious minorities.
examples.zh: 人们指控这个政权压迫少数宗教群体。

examples.en: Throughout history, our people have been oppressed and exploited.
examples.zh: 纵观历史，我国人民一直受到压迫和剥削。

senses.def: to make somebody only able to think about things that make them sad or worried

examples.en: The gloomy atmosphere in the office oppressed her.
examples.zh: 办公室的低沉气氛使她感到郁闷。

examples.en: He was beginning to feel oppressed by his surroundings.
examples.zh: 他开始对周围的环境感到压抑。

senses.def: cruel and unfair treatment of people, especially by not giving them the same freedom, rights, etc. as other people

examples.en: victims of oppression
examples.zh: 受压迫者

examples.en: the struggle against racial oppression
examples.zh: 反对种族压迫的斗争

examples.en: They have freed themselves from oppression.
examples.zh: 他们将自己从压迫中解放出来。

senses.def: treating people in a cruel and unfair way and not giving them the same freedom, rights, etc. as other people

examples.en: oppressive laws
examples.zh: 对部分人的压制性法律

examples.en: an oppressive regime
examples.zh: 残暴的政权

examples.en: The political situation has grown increasingly oppressive.
examples.zh: 政治局势变得越来越压抑。

senses.def: extremely hot and unpleasant and not having enough fresh air

examples.en: oppressive heat
examples.zh: 难熬的酷暑

senses.def: making you feel unhappy and anxious
senses.zh: 令人苦恼的；令人焦虑的

examples.en: an oppressive relationship
examples.zh: 令人苦恼的关系

examples.en: The silence between them started to grow oppressive.
examples.zh: 他们之间的沉默开始变得令人压抑。

senses.def: in a cruel and unfair way that does not give people the same freedom, rights, etc. as other people

examples.en: The government has been behaving oppressively.
examples.zh: 政府一直表现得很压制。

senses.def: extremely hot and unpleasant and without any fresh air

examples.en: It was an oppressively hot day.
examples.zh: 那是一个闷热的日子。

senses.def: in a way that makes you feel unhappy and anxious
senses.zh: 令人苦恼的；令人焦虑的

examples.en: The decor of the house was oppressively gloomy.
examples.zh: 屋子里的装饰阴沉得令人压抑。

senses.def: the fact of a government treating people in a cruel and unfair way, not giving them freedom, rights, etc.

examples.en: the oppressiveness of the regime
examples.zh: 这个政权的高压统治

senses.def: the fact of the weather being extremely hot and unpleasant with a lack of fresh air

examples.en: the oppressiveness of the climate
examples.zh: 气候的闷热

senses.def: the fact of a situation or relationship making you feel unhappy and anxious

examples.en: the oppressiveness of life in a small town
examples.zh: 小镇生活的压抑

senses.def: a person or group of people that treats somebody in a cruel and unfair way, especially by not giving them the same rights, etc. as other people
senses.zh: 压迫者；残暴的统治者；暴君

examples.en: They cannot forget the humiliation they suffered at the hands of their oppressors.
examples.zh: 他们不能忘记自己在压迫者手中所遭受的屈辱。

senses.def: expressing severe criticism of somebody

examples.en: an opprobrious remark
examples.zh: 严厉的谴责

senses.def: severe criticism of a person, country, etc. by a large group of people

examples.en: The bombing has attracted international opprobrium.
examples.zh: 这次爆炸事件引起了国际社会的谴责。

examples.en: The government did not deserve the opprobrium heaped on it by the national press.
examples.zh: 政府不应该受到全国媒体的严厉谴责。

senses.def: to choose to take or not to take a particular course of action

examples.en: After graduating she opted for a career in music.
examples.zh: 毕业后她选择了从事音乐工作。

examples.en: After a lot of thought, I opted against buying a motorbike.
examples.zh: 经过反复考虑，我决定不买摩托车。

examples.en: Many workers opted to leave their jobs rather than take a pay cut.
examples.zh: 许多工人宁愿离职也不接受减薪。

synonyms.words: select ▪ pick ▪ decide ▪ opt ▪ go for

intro.en: These words all mean to decide which thing or person you want out of the ones that are available.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含选择、挑选人或物之义。

items.def: to decide which thing or person you want out of the ones that are available:
items.zh: 指选择、选取人或物

examples.en: You choose—I can’t decide.
examples.zh: 你来选吧，我拿不定主意。

items.def: [often passive] to choose somebody/​something, usually carefully, from a group of people or things:
items.zh: 指仔细选择、挑选

examples.en: He was selected for the team.
examples.zh: 他已入选进队了。

items.def: (rather informal) to choose somebody/​something from a group of people or things:
items.zh: 指选择、挑选

examples.en: She picked the best cake for herself.
examples.zh: 她为自己挑了一块最好的蛋糕。

items.def: to choose between two or more possibilities:
items.zh: 指在两个或更多可能的情况中作出抉择、决定、选择

examples.en: We’re still trying to decide on a venue.
examples.zh: 我们仍在设法选定一个活动地点。

items.def: to choose to take or not to take a particular course of action:
items.zh: 指选择是否采取某种行动

examples.en: After graduating she opted for a career in music.
examples.zh: 毕业后她选择了从事音乐工作。

items.def: (rather informal) to choose something:
items.zh: 指选择某物

examples.en: I think I’ll go for the fruit salad.
examples.zh: 我想要水果色拉。

senses.def: to choose to be part of a system or an agreement
to choose not to take part in something

examples.en: Employees may opt out of the company's pension plan.
examples.zh: 雇员可选择不参加该公司的养老金计划。

senses.def: to choose not to be under the control of the local authority
senses.zh: 选择不受地方当局管理

senses.def: the action of a school or hospital that decides to manage its own money and is therefore no longer controlled by a local authority
senses.zh: （学校、医院从地方当局财政管辖的）退出，脱离

examples.en: Nurses and health workers voted against the opt-out.
examples.zh: 护士和保健员表决反对脱离地方当局管理。

examples.en: an opt-out school
examples.zh: 脱离地方当局财政管辖的学校

senses.def: the act of choosing not to be involved in an agreement

examples.en: an opt-out clause
examples.zh: 退出的条款

examples.en: MPs hoped to reverse Britain's opt-out from the treaty.
examples.zh: 国会议员希望推翻英国退出该条约的决定。

senses.def: connected with the eye or the sense of sight

examples.en: the optic nerve (= from the eye to the brain)
examples.zh: 视神经

senses.def: a device for measuring out exact amounts of strong alcoholic drinks in a bar
senses.zh: 奥普蒂克量杯（酒吧用以量烈性酒）

senses.def: connected with the sense of sight or the relationship between light and sight

examples.en: optical effects
examples.zh: 视觉效果

senses.def: used to help you see something more clearly

examples.en: optical aids
examples.zh: 助视器

examples.en: optical instruments such as microscopes and telescopes
examples.zh: 显微镜和望远镜等光学仪器

senses.def: using light for reading or storing information

examples.en: optical storage
examples.zh: 光存储器

examples.en: an optical disk/drive/mouse
examples.zh: 光盘；光驱；光学鼠标

senses.def: the process of reading printed documents by machine so that the information can be processed by a computer or sent over a network
senses.zh: 光学字符识别（用光学方法识别印刷字符）

senses.def: a thin glass string through which light can be transmitted
something that tricks your eyes and makes you think that you can see something that is not there, or makes you see something as different from what it really is
in a way that is connected with the sense of sight or the relationship between light and sight

examples.en: an optically dazzling painting
examples.zh: 一幅令人眼花缭乱的画作

senses.def: in a way that is connected with helping somebody see things more clearly
senses.zh: 视觉上：与帮助某人更清楚地看到事物有关的一种方式

examples.en: an optically correct lens
examples.zh: 光学正确的镜头

senses.def: in a way that uses light for reading or storing information

examples.en: The paper ballots were optically scanned.
examples.zh: 纸质选票经过光学扫描。

senses.def: a pair of glasses
a person whose job is to examine people’s eyes and to recommend and sell glasses
a person whose job is to make and supply glasses, but who does not test people's eyes
the shop where an optician

examples.en: to go to the optician’s
examples.zh: 去配眼镜

senses.def: a person who makes lenses
the scientific study of sight and light
the way in which an action or event is seen and understood by the public

examples.en: In politics, optics matter.
examples.zh: 在政治上，公众认知很重要。

examples.en: His decision to cut employee benefits may have been necessary, but the optics were terrible.
examples.zh: 他削减员工福利的决定可能是必要的，但结果却很糟糕。

senses.def: the best possible; producing the best possible results

examples.en: The optimal economic position for households is represented by point B on the chart.
examples.zh: 家庭的最佳经济地位由图表上的 B 点表示。

examples.en: The optimal temperature for the development of larvae is in the range 18–26˚C.
examples.zh: 幼虫发育的最佳温度在18-26℃范围内。

senses.def: in the best possible or most effective way

examples.en: Without enough oxygen, the brain cannot function optimally.
examples.zh: 没有足够的氧气，大脑就无法发挥最佳功能。

examples.en: Optimally, the bulbs should be put in the ground in December or January.
examples.zh: 最好在十二月或一月将球茎放入地下。

senses.def: a feeling that good things will happen and that something will be successful

examples.en: a mood of cautious optimism
examples.zh: 谨慎乐观的心情

examples.en: There are very real grounds for optimism.
examples.zh: 的确有理由可以乐观。

examples.en: We may now look forward with optimism.
examples.zh: 我们现在可以乐观地展望未来。

examples.en: optimism about/for the future
examples.zh: 对未来的乐观

examples.en: Both sides have expressed optimism about the chances of an early agreement.
examples.zh: 双方都对尽早达成协议的可能性表示乐观。

senses.def: a person who always expects good things to happen or things to be successful

examples.en: I'm an eternal optimist—I'm sure things will get better.
examples.zh: 我是一个永远的乐观主义者。我相信情况会变得更好。

examples.en: He’s an incurable optimist.
examples.zh: 他是一个无可救药的乐观主义者。

examples.en: Pete, ever the optimist, said things were bound to improve.
examples.zh: 一向乐观的皮特说，事情必定是会好转的。

senses.def: expecting good things to happen or something to be successful; showing this feeling

examples.en: We are now taking a more optimistic view.
examples.zh: 我们现在抱较乐观的态度。

examples.en: in an optimistic mood
examples.zh: 以乐观的情绪

examples.en: She's not very optimistic about the outcome of the talks.
examples.zh: 她对会谈的结果不太乐观。

examples.en: They are cautiously optimistic that the reforms will take place.
examples.zh: 他们对是否实行改革表示审慎的乐观。

examples.en: I think you're being a little over-optimistic.
examples.zh: 我看你是有点过于乐观了。

examples.en: On an optimistic note, the survey found children around the world are very resilient.
examples.zh: 乐观的是，调查发现世界各地的儿童都具有很强的适应能力。

senses.def: in a way that shows that you expect good things to happen or something to be successful

examples.en: He spoke optimistically about better relations between the two countries.
examples.zh: 他乐观地谈到两国关系将会变得更好。

senses.def: to make something as good as it can be; to use something in the best possible way

examples.en: to optimize the use of resources
examples.zh: 充分利用资源

senses.def: to change data, software, etc. in order to make it work more efficiently or to make it suitable for a particular purpose

examples.en: It is important that websites are optimized for mobile devices.
examples.zh: 重要的是，网站要为适应移动设备而进行优化。

senses.def: the best possible; producing the best possible results

examples.en: the optimum use of resources
examples.zh: 对资源的充分利用

examples.en: the optimum conditions for effective learning
examples.zh: 保证学习效果的最佳条件

examples.en: The optimum storage temperature is 60℉.
examples.zh: 最佳储存温度为 60°F。

senses.def: the best possible result, set of conditions, etc.

examples.en: For efficient fuel consumption a speed of 60 mph is about the optimum.
examples.zh: 时速60英里节油效果大致最佳。

senses.def: the process of choosing to leave a previous system in order to become more independent. The Conservative government in the 1990s encouraged many secondary state schools
senses.zh: 退出：选择离开以前的系统以变得更加独立的过程。1990年代，保守党政府鼓励许多州立中学退出地方教育局的控制，直接从中央政府那里获得资金，使它们更像是独立企业。还鼓励医院选择通过申请成为医院信托来退出。

senses.def: something that you can choose to have or do; the freedom to choose what you do
senses.zh: 可选择的事物；选择；选择权；选择的自由

examples.en: As I see it, we have two options…
examples.zh: 据我看，我们有两种选择…

examples.en: There are various options open to you.
examples.zh: 你有多种选择。

examples.en: to explore/consider/look at all your options
examples.zh: 探究／考虑／检视所有选项

examples.en: We are currently studying all the options available.
examples.zh: 我们现在正研究所有可能的选择。

examples.en: Going to college was not an option for me.
examples.zh: 上大学不是我能选的道路。

examples.en: Selling the house was our only option.
examples.zh: 除了卖房我们别无选择。

examples.en: Waiting a year may be your best option.
examples.zh: 等待一年可能是你的最佳选择。

examples.en: We felt this was the most viable option.
examples.zh: 我们觉得这是最可行的办法。

examples.en: I had no option but to (= I had to) ask him to leave.
examples.zh: 我别无选择，只有请他离开。

examples.en: Students have the option of studying abroad in their second year.
examples.zh: 学生在二年级时可以选择出国学习。

examples.en: He was given one month’s imprisonment without the option of a fine.
examples.zh: 不得以罚款相抵。

examples.en: A savings plan that gives you the option to vary your monthly payments.
examples.zh: 一项允许可调每月存款额度的储蓄方案。

examples.en: This particular model comes with a wide range of options (= things you can choose to have when buying something but which you will have to pay extra for).
examples.zh: 这一型号有各式各样的配件可供选择。

examples.en: In most cases, I would go for the cheaper option.
examples.zh: 在大多数情况下，我会选择更便宜的选择。

examples.en: Farming is not an attractive career option for many young people.
examples.zh: 对于许多年轻人来说，农业并不是一个有吸引力的职业选择。

examples.en: The poor villagers are left with no option but to risk their lives.
examples.zh: 贫穷的村民别无选择，只能冒着生命危险。

examples.en: Your doctor will discuss treatment options with you.
examples.zh: 您的医生将与您讨论治疗方案。

examples.en: Failure is not an option.
examples.zh: 失败不是一种选择。

senses.def: a subject that a student can choose to study, but that they do not have to do

examples.en: The course offers options in design and computing.
examples.zh: 这一课程开了设计和计算机技术的选修科目。

senses.def: the right to buy or sell something at some time in the future

examples.en: share options (= the right to buy shares in a company)
examples.zh: 认股选择权

examples.en: We have an option on the house.
examples.zh: 我们有权购买这所房子。

examples.en: He has promised me first option on his car (= the opportunity to buy it before anyone else).
examples.zh: 他答应我可以优先买他的汽车。

examples.en: The property is for rent with an option to buy at any time.
examples.zh: 这房子供出租，但可随时买下。

examples.en: They exercised an option on their lease to buy the building.
examples.zh: 他们根据租约行使了购买该建筑物的选择权。

examples.en: She took up an option in her contract to buy three million shares.
examples.zh: 她行使合约赋予的期权，购买了 300 万股股份。

senses.def: one of the choices you can make when using a computer program

examples.en: Choose the ‘Cut’ option from the Edit menu.
examples.zh: 从编辑菜单上选“剪切”项。

examples.en: Look at the on-screen menu and select the ‘File’ option.
examples.zh: 检查屏幕上的菜单，然后选择“文件”选项。

senses.def: to avoid making a decision now so that you still have a choice in the future
senses.zh: 保留选择余地；暂不决定

examples.en: At the moment I'm keeping my options open and applying for as many different jobs as possible.
examples.zh: 目前，我保持开放的选择并申请尽可能多的不同工作。

senses.def: a choice that is thought to be easier because it involves less effort, difficulty, etc.

examples.en: They are anxious that the new course should not be seen as a soft option.
examples.zh: 他们盼望新办法不会被视为捷径。

examples.en: He decided to take the easy option and give them what they wanted.
examples.zh: 他决定顺水推舟，他们要什么就给什么。

examples.en: She could have taken the easy option and left.
examples.zh: 她本可以采取简单的选择并离开。

senses.def: to buy or sell the right to own or use something at some time in the future

examples.en: The novel has been optioned for the screen by his production company.
examples.zh: 这部小说改编成影视作品的权利已经被他的制作公司买下了。

examples.en: We've optioned all her books, including future ones.
examples.zh: 我们选择了她的所有书籍，包括未来的书籍。

examples.en: This is his first script to be optioned by a film company.
examples.zh: 这是他第一个被电影公司选中的剧本。

senses.def: to avoid making a decision now so that you still have a choice in the future
senses.zh: 保留选择余地；暂不决定

examples.en: At the moment I'm keeping my options open and applying for as many different jobs as possible.
examples.zh: 目前，我保持开放的选择并申请尽可能多的不同工作。

senses.def: a choice that is thought to be easier because it involves less effort, difficulty, etc.

examples.en: They are anxious that the new course should not be seen as a soft option.
examples.zh: 他们盼望新办法不会被视为捷径。

examples.en: He decided to take the easy option and give them what they wanted.
examples.zh: 他决定顺水推舟，他们要什么就给什么。

examples.en: She could have taken the easy option and left.
examples.zh: 她本可以采取简单的选择并离开。

intro.en: These are all words for something that you choose to do in a particular situation.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指某种情况下的选择。

items.def: something that you can choose to have or do; the freedom to choose what you do:
items.zh: 指可选择的事物、选择、选择权、选择的自由

examples.en: As I see it, we have two options…
examples.zh: 据我看，我们有两种选择…

items.def: the freedom to choose what you do; something that you can choose to have or do:
items.zh: 指选择权、选择的自由、选择、可选择的事物

examples.en: If I had the choice, I would stop working tomorrow.
examples.zh: 如果让我选择，我明天就停止工作。

items.def: something that you can choose to have or do out of two or more possibilities:
items.zh: 指可供选择的事物、其中一种选择

examples.en: You can be paid in cash weekly or by cheque monthly: those are the two alternatives.
examples.zh: 你的工资可以按周以现金支取，或按月以支票支取。二者可选其一。

items.def: one of the different things that you can do in a particular situation:
items.zh: 指某种情况下可选择的事物

examples.en: We need to explore a wide range of possibilities.
examples.zh: 我们需要探究各种可能的情况。

senses.def: that you can choose to do or have if you want to

examples.en: Certain courses are compulsory; others are optional.
examples.zh: 有些课程是必修的，另一些是选修的。

examples.en: This model comes with a number of optional extras (= things you can choose to have but which you will have to pay extra for).
examples.zh: 这一型号有一系列可供选择的附件，价格另计。

examples.en: These features can be offered as an optional part of the package.
examples.zh: 这些功能可以作为软件包的可选部分提供。

senses.def: a person whose job is to examine people’s eyes and to recommend and sell glasses

examples.en: I went to visit my optometrist.
examples.zh: 我去验光配镜了。

senses.def: the job of measuring how well people can see and checking their eyes for disease
a liquid for washing painful eyes. A bottle of Optrex
senses.zh: 一种用于冲洗痛苦眼睛的液体。一瓶Optrex可以用洗眼器购买。

senses.def: a display of great wealth

examples.en: the opulence of Ancient Rome
examples.zh: 古罗马的富足

examples.en: a life of opulence
examples.zh: 富裕的生活

senses.def: made or decorated using expensive materials
senses.zh: 豪华的；富丽堂皇的；华丽的

examples.en: opulent fabrics/surroundings
examples.zh: 华丽的面料/环境

senses.def: the state that exists when people obey laws, rules or authority

examples.en: The army has been sent to maintain order in the capital.
examples.zh: 军队已被派去维持首都的秩序。

examples.en: The police struggled to restore order.
examples.zh: 警察努力恢复秩序。

examples.zh: 有些教师觉得难以维持课堂秩序。

examples.zh: 他很快就平定了叛乱分子。

examples.zh: 这部电影因对公共秩序构成潜在威胁而被禁。

senses.def: a request for food or drinks in a restaurant, bar, etc.

examples.en: The waiter came to take their orders.
examples.zh: 服务员来给他们点餐。

examples.zh: 您在前台下订单。

examples.en: a food/drink(s) order

examples.en: an order for steak and fries
examples.zh: 点一份牛排炸薯条

senses.def: food or drinks that you ask for in a restaurant, bar, etc.

examples.zh: 服务员把我点的餐送来了。

senses.def: a request to make or supply goods

examples.en: I would like to place an order for ten copies of this book.
examples.zh: 这本书我想订购十册。

examples.en: Complete the online order form.
examples.zh: 填写在线订单。

examples.en: The stationery order has arrived.
examples.zh: 订购的文具到货了。

senses.def: something that somebody is told to do by somebody in authority

examples.zh: 狗可以训练得听从命令。

examples.en: Their defence was that they were only following orders.
examples.zh: 他们的辩护是，他们只是执行命令。

examples.zh: 她只听从总裁的指示。

examples.zh: 将军下令前进。

examples.en: He issued orders for the work to begin.
examples.zh: 他下令开始工作。

examples.en: I'm under orders not to let anyone in.
examples.zh: 我奉命不准任何人进入。

examples.en: Interest rates can be controlled by order of the central bank.
examples.zh: 利率可由中央银行指示控制。

examples.en: No sugar for me—doctor's orders.
examples.zh: 我不要糖，这可是医生的嘱咐。

senses.def: a formal written instruction for somebody to be paid money or to do something

examples.en: You can cash the order at any post office.
examples.zh: 你可以在任何一家邮局兑现这张汇票。

examples.en: the natural order of things
examples.zh: 天地万物的自然秩序

examples.zh: 他被视为现存制度的大敌。

examples.zh: 世界新秩序似乎正在形成。

examples.en: The old order in Europe saw rapid change in the late 1980s.
examples.zh: 欧洲的旧秩序在 20 世纪 80 年代末发生了迅速变化。

senses.def: a social class

examples.zh: 底层社会

senses.def: a group into which animals, plants, etc. that have similar characteristics are divided, smaller than a class

examples.en: the order of primates
examples.zh: 灵长目

examples.zh: 本笃会

examples.zh: 该修会致力于祈祷和服务的生活。

senses.def: as it should be

examples.zh: 一切都正常吗，先生？

senses.def: if something is in order

examples.zh: 我想应该喝杯饮料了吧。

examples.en: Would it be in order for us to examine the manuscript?
examples.zh: 按规定我们可以检查原稿吗？

senses.def: allowed according to the rules of a meeting, etc.

examples.zh: 依规定现在可以发言了吗？

examples.zh: 发动机现在运转完全正常。

examples.zh: 政府努力维持治安。

examples.en: She was a snob of the first order.

senses.def: about something; approximately something

examples.zh: 她的年收入为 8 万英镑左右。

examples.zh: 我点了一杯咖啡和一份三明治。

examples.zh: 如要索取报告副本，请访问我们的网站。

senses.def: (1895-1960) a US writer of songs. He wrote the words for many famous Broadway
senses.zh: 奥斯卡·哈默斯坦（Oscar Hammerstein）：（1895-1960）美国歌曲作者。他为许多著名的百老汇音乐剧写词，其中大部分也被拍成电影。在理查德·罗杰斯（Richard Rodgers）的陪伴下，他的演出包括俄克拉荷马州和音乐之声。早期的成功包括与西格蒙德·隆伯格（Sigmund Romberg）的《沙漠之歌》（The Desert Song）（1926），与杰罗姆·科恩（Jerome Kern）和卡门·琼斯（Carmen Jones）（1943）的《 Show Boat》（1927）。

senses.def: (1854-1900) an Irish writer of plays, poetry and one novel, The Picture of Dorian Gray
senses.zh: 奥斯卡·王尔德（Oscar Wilde）：（1854-1900）是一位爱尔兰戏剧，诗歌和小说作家，《多利安·格雷的图片》（The Picture of Dorian Gray，1891年）。他移居伦敦后成名，在那里他写了最成功的喜剧剧，包括温德米尔夫人的《范（1892）》和《认真的重要性》。他以幽默和机智的言论以及同性恋（也被他的性伴侣吸引）而闻名。1895年，他因同性恋而被判入狱，当时这是非法的。他在诗《雷丁监狱的歌谣》中描述了自己的监狱经历。被释放后，他在法国和意大利度过了余生。如今，他的许多聪明和有趣的言论仍在重复，他的机智被称为怀尔德恩。

senses.zh: 我们的小镇：美国作家桑顿·怀尔德（Thornton Wilder）的一部戏剧（1938年），该剧获得了普利策奖。它坐落在虚构的格罗弗角小镇中，与普通百姓的简单生活有关。一个叫做舞台管理员的角色直接向观众评论这个故事。该剧仍然经常由业余团体表演。

senses.def: the one or ones that belong to us

examples.en: Their house is very similar to ours, but ours is bigger.
examples.zh: 他们的房子和我们的十分相像，但我们的要大些。

examples.en: No, those are Ellie's kids. Ours are upstairs.
examples.zh: 不，那些是埃利的孩子。我们的都在楼上。

examples.en: He's a friend of ours.
examples.zh: 他是我们的朋友。

senses.def: our home

examples.en: Do you fancy coming to ours for Sunday dinner?
examples.zh: 周日来我们家吃晚饭怎么样？

senses.def: used instead of ourselves
senses.zh: 在we泛指“人们”时用以代替 ourselves

examples.en: We all unconsciously choose which aspects of ourself we choose to present to the world.
examples.zh: 我们都无意识地选择向世界展示自己的哪些方面。

senses.def: the reflexive form of we

examples.en: We shouldn't blame ourselves for what happened.
examples.zh: 我们不应该为发生的事责怪自己。

examples.en: Let's just relax and enjoy ourselves.
examples.zh: 咱们轻松一下，好好享受享受。

examples.en: We'd like to see it for ourselves.
examples.zh: 我们想亲眼看看它。

senses.def: used to emphasize we
senses.zh: （用于强调或代替 we 或 us）我们自己，亲自

examples.en: We've often thought of going there ourselves.
examples.zh: 我们常想亲自到那里去一趟。

examples.en: The only people there were ourselves.
examples.zh: 那里除了我们，没有别人。

senses.def: alone; without anyone else
without help
for us alone to have or use; not shared with others
senses.zh: 专属我们自己的；独享的

examples.en: We had the pool all to ourselves.
examples.zh: 这个游泳池完全供我们自己使用。

senses.def: alone; without anyone else
without help
for us alone to have or use; not shared with others
senses.zh: 专属我们自己的；独享的

examples.en: We had the pool all to ourselves.
examples.zh: 这个游泳池完全供我们自己使用。

senses.def: having the nature or quality of

examples.en: poisonous
examples.zh: 有毒的

examples.en: mountainous
examples.zh: 多山的

senses.def: the name of several English rivers. The longest, the Great Ouse, is in the east of England and flows from Northamptonshire
senses.zh: 几条英国河流的名称。最长的大乌斯（Great Ouse）位于英格兰东部，从北安普敦郡穿过芬斯，流进国王林恩（King's Lynn）的华盛顿（Wash）。东北还有另一只乌斯河，流经约克和亨伯河。第三个Ouse在伦敦和南海岸之间开始，流入纽黑文的英吉利海峡。

senses.def: in a way that shows the nature or quality of
senses.zh: -很好：以某种方式显示产品的性质或质量

examples.en: gloriously
examples.zh: 光荣地

senses.def: the fact of having the nature or quality of
senses.zh: 具有以下性质或质量的事实：

examples.en: spaciousness
examples.zh: 宽敞

senses.def: to force somebody out of a job or position of power, especially in order to take their place

examples.en: He was ousted as chairman.
examples.zh: 他的主席职务被革除了。

examples.en: The rebels finally managed to oust the government from power.
examples.zh: 反叛者最后总算推翻了政府。

examples.en: She is a strong supporter of the recently ousted president.
examples.zh: 她是最近被罢黜的总统的坚定支持者。

senses.def: the act of removing somebody from a position of authority in order to put somebody else in their place; the fact of being removed in this way

examples.en: the president’s ouster by the military
examples.zh: 军方对总统的废黜

senses.def: away from the inside of a place or thing

examples.en: She ran out into the corridor.
examples.zh: 她跑出来，冲进走廊。

examples.en: She shook the bag and some coins fell out.
examples.zh: 她抖了抖袋子，几个硬币掉了出来。

examples.en: I got out of bed.
examples.zh: 我起了床。

examples.en: He opened the box and out jumped a frog.
examples.zh: 他打开盒子，从里面跳出一只青蛙来。

examples.en: Out you go! (= used to order somebody to leave a room)
examples.zh: 滚出去！

examples.en: He ran out the door.
examples.zh: 他跑出门去。

senses.def: away from or not at home or their place of work
senses.zh: 不在家；不在工作地点；外出

examples.en: I called Liz but she was out.
examples.zh: 我打电话给利兹，但她不在家。

examples.en: Let's go out this evening (= for example to a restaurant or club).
examples.zh: 咱们今天晚上出去吧。

examples.en: We haven't had a night out for weeks.
examples.zh: 我们已经好几个星期晚上没出去过了。

examples.en: Mr Green is out of town this week.
examples.zh: 格林先生本周到外地去了。

examples.en: I got an out of office reply to my email.
examples.zh: 我发了电邮，然后收到“我不在办公室”的回复邮件。

senses.def: outside; not in a building

examples.en: It's cold out.
examples.zh: 外面很冷。

examples.en: There were children playing out in the street.
examples.zh: 孩子们在街上玩耍。

senses.def: used to show that something/somebody is removed from a place, job, etc.

examples.en: This detergent is good for getting stains out.
examples.zh: 这种洗涤剂能清除斑渍。

examples.en: We want this government out.
examples.zh: 我们想要这届政府下台。

examples.en: He got thrown out of the restaurant.
examples.zh: 他被逐出了餐馆。

senses.def: away from the edge of a place

examples.en: The boy dashed out into the road.
examples.zh: 男孩子向路中间冲去。

examples.en: Don't lean out of the window.
examples.zh: 不要探出窗外。

senses.def: used to show where something comes from

examples.en: He drank his beer out of the bottle.
examples.zh: 他从瓶口直接喝啤酒。

examples.en: a romance straight out of a fairy tale
examples.zh: 童话故事般的爱情

examples.en: I paid for the damage out of my savings.
examples.zh: 我用自己的积蓄赔偿了损失。

examples.en: We'll get the truth out of her.
examples.zh: 我们会从她那里套出实情。

senses.def: used to show what something is made from

examples.en: a statue made out of bronze
examples.zh: 一尊青铜像

senses.def: used to show that somebody/something does not have any of something

examples.en: We're out of milk.
examples.zh: 我们没有牛奶了。

examples.en: He's been out of work for six months.
examples.zh: 他已经失业六个月了。

examples.en: You're out of luck—she left ten minutes ago.
examples.zh: 你真不走运，她十分钟前才离开。

senses.def: used to show that somebody/something is not or no longer in a particular state or condition

examples.en: Try and stay out of trouble.
examples.zh: 尽量别惹麻烦。

examples.en: I watched the car until it was out of sight.
examples.zh: 我目送汽车，直到看不见为止。

senses.def: used to show that somebody is no longer involved in something

examples.en: It was an awful job and I'm glad to be out of it.
examples.zh: 那件差事简直是受罪，我很高兴摆脱掉了。

examples.en: He gets out of the army in a few weeks.
examples.zh: 几周之后他就要离开部队。

examples.en: They'll be out (= of prison) on bail in no time.
examples.zh: 他们马上就要获得保释出狱。

examples.en: Brown goes on to the semi-finals but Lee is out.
examples.zh: 布朗进入了半决赛，但李被淘汰了。

senses.def: from a particular number or set

examples.en: You scored six out of ten.
examples.zh: 总分十分你得了六分。

examples.en: Two out of three people think the President should resign.
examples.zh: 有三分之二的人认为总统应当辞职。

senses.def: clearly and loudly so that people can hear

examples.en: to call/cry/shout out
examples.zh: 大声叫／哭／喊

examples.en: Read it out loud.
examples.zh: 请大声朗读。

examples.en: Nobody spoke out in his defence.
examples.zh: 没有人站出来替他辩护。

senses.def: a long or a particular distance away from a place or from land
senses.zh: 远离（某地或陆地）；离（某地或陆地）

examples.en: She's working out in Australia.
examples.zh: 她远在澳大利亚工作。

examples.en: He lives right out in the country.
examples.zh: 他住在远离此地的乡间。

examples.en: The boats are all out at sea.
examples.zh: 船全都出海了。

examples.en: The ship sank ten miles out of Stockholm.
examples.zh: 那艘船在距离斯德哥尔摩十英里处沉入海中。

senses.def: available to everyone; known to everyone

examples.en: When does her new book come out?
examples.zh: 她的新书什么时候出版？

examples.en: Word always gets out (= people find out about things) no matter how careful you are.
examples.zh: 无论你多么小心，总会有消息走漏。

examples.en: Out with it! (= say what you know)
examples.zh: 你就说出来吧！

senses.def: used to show the reason why something is done

examples.en: I asked out of curiosity.
examples.zh: 我因为好奇问了问。

examples.en: She did it out of spite.
examples.zh: 她那么做是出于恶意。

senses.def: not in the library; borrowed by somebody else

examples.en: The book you wanted is out on loan.
examples.zh: 你要的那本书借出去了。

senses.def: at or towards its lowest point on land

examples.en: I like walking on the wet sand when the tide is out.
examples.zh: 我喜欢退潮后走在湿润的沙滩上。

senses.def: if the sun, moon or stars are or come out
fully open

examples.en: There should be some snowdrops out by now.
examples.zh: 现在应该有雪花莲开放了。

senses.def: if a team or team member is out

examples.en: The West Indies were all out for 364 (= after scoring 364 runs in cricket).
examples.zh: 西印度群岛队以 364 分全队出局。

senses.def: if a player is out

examples.en: If you have no more cards, you are out. The winner is the one with the most cards.
examples.zh: 没牌即出局。牌最多的为赢家。

senses.def: if the ball is out

examples.en: The umpire said the ball was out.
examples.zh: 裁判员判球出界。

examples.en: The ball landed out.
examples.zh: 球落地了。

senses.def: not correct or exact; wrong

examples.en: I was slightly out in my calculations.
examples.zh: 我的计算出了点小错。

examples.en: Your guess was a long way out (= completely wrong).
examples.zh: 你的猜测完全错了。

examples.en: The estimate was out by more than $100.
examples.zh: 这个估计差了 100 多美元。

senses.def: not possible or not allowed

examples.en: Swimming is out until the weather gets warmer.
examples.zh: 天气转暖前，游泳是不可能的。

senses.def: not fashionable

examples.en: Black is out this year.
examples.zh: 今年黑色不时兴了。

senses.def: not or no longer burning or lit

examples.en: Suddenly all the lights went out.
examples.zh: 突然间所有的灯光都灭了。

examples.en: The fire had burnt itself out.
examples.zh: 炉火烧尽熄灭了。

senses.def: at an end

examples.en: It was summer and school was out.
examples.zh: 夏天，学校放假了。

examples.en: She was to regret her words before the day was out.
examples.zh: 她到不了天黑就会为自己说的话后悔。

senses.def: unconscious

examples.en: He was out for more than an hour and came round in the hospital.
examples.zh: 他昏迷了一个多小时，在医院才苏醒过来。

examples.en: She was knocked out cold.
examples.zh: 她完全被打昏了。

senses.def: on strike

examples.en: The dockers stayed out for several months.
examples.zh: 码头工人罢工了数月。

senses.def: to the end; completely

examples.en: Hear me out before you say anything.
examples.zh: 你听我说完再讲话。

examples.en: We left them to fight it out (= settle a disagreement by fighting or arguing).
examples.zh: 我们让他们争吵下去，争出个输赢。

senses.def: to be trying to get or do something

examples.en: I'm not out for revenge.
examples.zh: 我不是来寻报复的。

examples.en: She's out for what she can get (= trying to get something for herself).
examples.zh: 她力图得到自己能得的。

examples.en: The company is out to capture the Canadian market.
examples.zh: 这家公司竭尽全力抢占加拿大市场。

senses.def: going regularly to a place

examples.en: He was in and out of jail for most of his life.
examples.zh: 他大半生的时间都是监狱的常客。

senses.def: able to go outside again after an illness
travelling around a place

examples.en: We've been out and about talking to people all over the country.
examples.zh: 我们游遍了全国，和各地的人交谈。

senses.def: going or leaving

examples.en: As soon as I get my money I'm out of here!
examples.zh: 我一拿到钱就走！

senses.def: sad because you are not included in something
senses.zh: （觉得自己是外人而）不是味儿

examples.en: We've only just moved here so we feel a little out of it.
examples.zh: 我们刚搬到这里，所以心里觉得有点不适应。

senses.def: not aware of what is happening, usually because of drinking too much alcohol, or taking drugs
senses.zh: （因酒或药物作用而对周围事情）茫然不觉，昏昏然

examples.en: He looks completely out of it.
examples.zh: 他看上去神志不清。

senses.def: a way of avoiding having to do something

examples.en: She was desperately looking for an out.
examples.zh: 她在拼命找一条脱身之计。

senses.def: all the details, especially the complicated or difficult ones
senses.zh: （尤指复杂或难的）全部细节，详情

examples.en: the ins and outs of the problem
examples.zh: 问题的来龙去脉

examples.en: He quickly learned the ins and outs of the job.
examples.zh: 他很快就掌握了工作的全部诀窍。

senses.def: having told other people that you are gay
senses.zh: 已公开同性恋身份的；出柜的

examples.en: I had been out since I was 17.
examples.zh: 我从 17 岁起就公开表示我是同性恋。

examples.en: an out gay man
examples.zh: 已公开同性恋身份的男子

senses.def: to say publicly that somebody is gay

examples.en: He is the latest politician to be outed by the media.
examples.zh: 他是最新一位被媒体揭露的政客。

senses.def: to say something publicly about somebody/something that they would prefer to keep secret
senses.zh: 揭露，公布（别人想要保守的秘密）

examples.en: The man who claimed to have found the diaries has been outed as a fraud.
examples.zh: 声称找到日记的人被揭露是个骗子。

examples.en: Their motives were outed as purely financial.
examples.zh: 他们的动机被揭露为纯粹是为了经济目的。

senses.def: greater, better, further, longer, etc.

examples.en: outnumber
examples.zh: 在数量上压倒

examples.en: outwit
examples.zh: 在智慧上胜过

examples.en: outgrow
examples.zh: 长得比…快

examples.en: outlive
examples.zh: 活得比…长

senses.def: outside; outward

examples.zh: 附属建筑物

examples.en: outpatient
examples.zh: 门诊病人

examples.en: outlying
examples.zh: 偏远的

examples.en: outgoing
examples.zh: 向外的

examples.zh: 他做饭，而她则坐在前面伺候餐桌。

examples.zh: 我在大门外等你。

senses.def: in a voice that can be heard by other people

examples.zh: 我放声大笑。

examples.en: Please read the letter out loud.
examples.zh: 请把信大声念出来。

senses.def: larger, more serious, etc. in relation to something than is necessary or appropriate

examples.en: They earn salaries out of all proportion to their ability.
examples.zh: 他们挣的工资与其能力不相称。

examples.en: The media have blown the incident up out of all proportion.
examples.zh: 媒体大肆渲染这件事。

senses.def: if something such as a name is picked out of a/the hat
not able to work or be used because of injury or damage
senses.zh: 不能工作；失去作用；停止运转

examples.en: Jon will be out of action for weeks with a broken leg.
examples.zh: 乔恩断了一条腿，将有几个星期不能工作。

examples.en: The photocopier is out of action today.
examples.zh: 复印机今天出故障了。

examples.en: She is out of action following an ankle injury.
examples.zh: 她因脚踝受伤而无法参加比赛。

senses.def: outside the area of play which is allowed

examples.en: His shot went out of bounds.
examples.zh: 他的球出界了。

senses.def: not reasonable or acceptable
senses.zh: 不合理的；令人无法接受的

examples.en: His demands were out of bounds.
examples.zh: 他的要求不合理。

senses.def: if a place is out of bounds
having difficulty breathing after exercise
senses.zh: （运动后）喘不上气，透不过气来

examples.en: We were out of breath after only five minutes.
examples.zh: 我们五分钟后便气喘吁吁了。

examples.en: I'm a bit out of breath after my run.
examples.zh: 跑步后我有点上气不接下气。

senses.def: having stopped operating as a business because there is no more money or work available

examples.en: The new regulations will put many small businesses out of business.
examples.zh: 新法规将使很多小企业关闭。

examples.en: Some travel companies will probably go out of business this summer.
examples.zh: 今年夏天一些旅游公司很可能歇业。

examples.en: The company went out of business during the recession.
examples.zh: 这家公司在经济衰退时期停业了。

senses.def: without a chance of winning something

examples.en: The Jaguars are now out of contention.
examples.zh: 美洲虎队现在没有机会赢了。

senses.def: not inside a building

examples.en: You should spend more time out of doors in the fresh air.
examples.zh: 你应多花点时间在户外呼吸新鲜空气。

senses.def: too far away to hear somebody/something or to be heard
senses.zh: 离得太远听不见；在听力范围外

examples.en: We waited until Ted was safely out of earshot before discussing it.
examples.zh: 我们一直等到特德保准听不见时才讨论这事。

examples.en: He diplomatically moved out of earshot.
examples.zh: 他外交地离开了听不到的地方。

senses.def: difficult or impossible to control

examples.en: Unemployment is getting out of hand.
examples.zh: 失业问题越来越难以控制。

senses.def: if you reject, etc. something out of hand

examples.en: All our suggestions were dismissed out of hand.
examples.zh: 我们的建议均遭到了草率的拒绝。

senses.def: in a safe place where somebody/something cannot be hurt or injured or do any damage to somebody/something

examples.en: She put the knife in a drawer, out of harm’s way.
examples.zh: 为安全起见，她把刀放在抽屉里。

examples.en: I prefer the children to play in the garden where they’re out of harm’s way.
examples.zh: 我比较喜欢让孩子在花园里玩耍，因为那里安全。

senses.def: too far away to hear somebody/something or to be heard
senses.zh: 离得太远听不见；在听力范围外

examples.en: She had moved out of hearing.
examples.zh: 她走远了，已经听不到。
