examples.en: Last season he came second overall in the South African championships.
examples.zh: 上赛季他在南非锦标赛中获得总成绩第二名。

examples.en: She kept the lead and won overall.
examples.zh: 她保持领先并获得总冠军。

senses.def: generally; when you consider everything
senses.zh: 一般来说；大致上；总体上

examples.en: Overall, this is a very useful book.
examples.zh: 总的来说，这是一本很有用的书。

examples.en: I think overall we're doing a good job.
examples.zh: 我认为总的来说我们做得很好。

examples.en: Students were satisfied overall with what they had achieved.
examples.zh: 学生们对他们所取得的成就总体上感到满意。

senses.def: a loose coat worn over other clothes to protect them from dirt, etc.

examples.en: The lab assistant was wearing a white overall.
examples.zh: 实验室助手穿着一件白罩衣。

senses.def: a loose piece of clothing like a shirt and trousers in one piece, made of heavy cloth and usually worn over other clothing by workers doing dirty work

examples.en: The mechanic was wearing a pair of blue overalls.
examples.zh: 机修工穿着一件蓝色工装连衣裤。

senses.def: a piece of clothing that consists of trousers with an extra piece of cloth covering the chest, held up by narrow pieces of cloth over the shoulders
more votes in an election or vote than all the other people or parties together
senses.zh: 总体多数（票数超过其他人或政党票数的总和）

senses.def: the difference between the number of members that the government has in a parliament and the number that all the other political parties have together
senses.zh: 总体优势（执政党在议会中的议员人数与所有其他政党议员总数的差额）

examples.en: a huge 101-seat overall majority
examples.zh: 多达 101 个席位的总体优势

senses.def: unsuccessful or likely to be unsuccessful because of needing too much effort, money or time
senses.zh: 所需投入过大的，目标过高的（因而未成功或成功机会甚微）

examples.en: Her plans were overambitious.
examples.zh: 她的计划都过于宏大。

examples.en: We were overambitious in what we tried to do.
examples.zh: 我们对自己想做的事情过于雄心勃勃。

senses.def: too determined to be successful, rich, powerful, etc.
senses.zh: 进取心过强的；野心过大的

examples.en: He suffered from overambitious parents who pushed him too hard.
examples.zh: 他的父母野心太大，对他要求太严格。

senses.def: very important, because it includes or influences many things
senses.zh: 非常重要的；首要的；概莫能外的

examples.en: an overarching aim/concept/issue
examples.zh: 总体目标/概念/问题

examples.en: the overarching themes of violence and disorder
examples.zh: 暴力和骚乱的首要主题

senses.def: an overarm
senses.zh: 肩上投球（投球时举手过肩）

senses.def: if you throw a ball overarm
senses.zh: 肩上投球（投球时手臂后伸，再举手过肩）

senses.def: to impress somebody so much that they feel nervous or frightened

examples.en: The younger players were overawed by the occasion and played badly.
examples.zh: 年轻球员们对此感到震惊，表现不佳。

senses.def: to lose your balance and fall; to make somebody/something lose their balance and fall

examples.en: He overbalanced and fell into the water.
examples.zh: 他失去了平衡，落入水中。

examples.en: The ladder overbalanced on top of her.
examples.zh: 梯子翻倒在她身上。

examples.en: He took a wild swing with the bat that overbalanced him.
examples.zh: 他猛烈地挥动球棒，结果失去了平衡。

senses.def: trying to control other people in an unpleasant way

examples.en: an overbearing parent
examples.zh: 专横的父母

examples.en: an overbearing manner
examples.zh: 专断的作风

examples.en: She found him rude and overbearing.
examples.zh: 她认为他既无礼又专横。

examples.en: I wasn’t the least impressed or intimidated by her overbearing attitude.
examples.zh: 她专横的态度并没有给我留下任何深刻的印象或吓倒。

senses.def: a condition in which a person or animal’s upper jaw

examples.en: She was a fifth-grader when she got braces to correct an overbite and a gap between her two front teeth.
examples.zh: 当她上五年级时，她戴上了牙套来矫正覆牙合和两颗门牙之间的缝隙。

senses.def: that is made to seem larger, more impressive or more important than it really is
senses.zh: 过分的；夸张的；虚饰过度的

examples.en: overblown ambitions/egos
examples.zh: 过高的野心/自负

senses.def: past the best, most beautiful stage

examples.en: overblown roses
examples.zh: 盛极而衰的玫瑰

senses.def: over the side of a boat or a ship into the water

examples.en: to fall/jump overboard
examples.zh: 从船上落入／跳入水中

examples.en: Huge waves washed him overboard.
examples.zh: 巨浪把他冲下甲板卷入海中。

senses.def: to be too excited or enthusiastic about something or about doing something

examples.en: Don't go overboard on fitness.
examples.zh: 别过分热衷健身运动。

senses.def: to get rid of somebody/something that you think is not useful

examples.en: He threw all his old friends overboard once he was promoted.
examples.zh: 升职后，他把所有的老朋友都抛弃了。

senses.def: to be too excited or enthusiastic about something or about doing something

examples.en: Don't go overboard on fitness.
examples.zh: 别过分热衷健身运动。

senses.def: to get rid of somebody/something that you think is not useful

examples.en: He threw all his old friends overboard once he was promoted.
examples.zh: 升职后，他把所有的老朋友都抛弃了。

senses.def: to sell more tickets on a plane or reserve more rooms in a hotel than there are places available
senses.zh: 超额预订（飞机座位或旅馆客房）

examples.en: The flight was heavily overbooked.
examples.zh: 该班机售票大大超出机位数量。

senses.def: a bridge over a railway or road
to give somebody/something more work, worry, etc. than they can deal with

examples.en: He did not appear to be overburdened with guilt.
examples.zh: 他似乎并没有背负过多的负罪感。

senses.def: the situation in which an industry or a factory cannot sell as much as it is designed to produce

examples.en: the problems of overcapacity in the car industry
examples.zh: 汽车行业产能过剩问题

senses.def: covered with clouds; not bright

examples.en: an overcast sky/day
examples.zh: 阴沉的天空／天气

examples.en: Today it will be dull and overcast.
examples.zh: 今天将为阴天。

examples.en: The sky was overcast and we needed to use artificial light.
examples.zh: 天色昏暗，我们需要用人工照明。

senses.def: too careful
senses.zh: 过于谨慎的；过分小心的

senses.def: to make somebody pay too much for something

examples.en: Make sure they don't overcharge you for the drinks.
examples.zh: 注意别让他们多收饮料费。

examples.en: We were overcharged by £5.
examples.zh: 我们让人家多收了 5 英镑。

senses.def: a long warm coat worn in cold weather
to succeed in dealing with or controlling a problem that has been preventing you from achieving something

examples.en: She overcame injury to win the Olympic gold medal.
examples.zh: 她战胜了伤痛，赢得了奥运会金牌。

examples.en: The two parties managed to overcome their differences on the issue.
examples.zh: 两个政党设法弥合了在这个问题上的分歧。

examples.en: He finally managed to overcome his fear of flying
examples.zh: 他终于克服了对飞行的恐惧

examples.en: He overcame a strong temptation to run away.
examples.zh: 他抵制了要逃跑的强烈诱惑。

senses.def: to defeat somebody

examples.en: In the final game Sweden easily overcame France.
examples.zh: 在决赛中，瑞典队轻松战胜了法国队。

senses.def: to affect somebody very strongly
senses.zh: 使受巨大影响；使难以承受

examples.en: Her parents were overcome with grief at the funeral.
examples.zh: 在葬礼上她的父母悲痛欲绝。

examples.en: Overcome by curiosity, the boy looked through the window.
examples.zh: 出于好奇，男孩向窗外看去。

examples.en: The dead woman had been overcome by smoke.
examples.zh: 这个女人是被烟呛死的。

senses.def: to do too much when trying to correct a problem and so cause a different problem
senses.zh: 过度补偿（为纠正某事而做得过分）；矫枉过正

examples.en: She overcompensated for her shyness by talking too much and laughing too loud.
examples.zh: 她努力克服羞怯，却矫枉过正，说话太多，笑声太大。

senses.def: too confident
to cook food for too long
too critical
senses.zh: 过分挑剔的；吹毛求疵的

senses.def: with too many people or things in it

examples.en: overcrowded cities/prisons
examples.zh: 拥挤不堪的城市／监狱

examples.en: Too many poor people are living in overcrowded conditions.
examples.zh: 有太多贫民生活在十分拥挤的条件下。

senses.def: the situation when there are too many people or things in one place

examples.en: overcrowding in prisons/prison overcrowding
examples.zh: 监狱人满为患/监狱人满为患

senses.def: to make something grow too large
senses.zh: 发育过度的；过于发达的

examples.en: Too many push-ups can overdevelop the chest muscles.
examples.zh: 太多的俯卧撑会过度发展胸部肌肉。

senses.def: to build too many new houses, factories, etc. on an area of land
senses.zh: 过度开发：在一块土地上建造太多新房屋，工厂等

examples.en: We do not want to overdevelop North Yorkshire and ruin what is such a beautiful county.
examples.zh: 我们不想过度开发北约克郡并毁掉如此美丽的县。

senses.def: the process of building too many new houses, factories, etc. on an area of land
senses.zh: 过度开发：在一块土地上建造太多新房屋，工厂等的过程

examples.en: Residents said the proposed 174 homes represent overdevelopment of the site.
examples.zh: 居民表示，拟建的 174 套住宅代表了该地块的过度开发。

senses.def: to do something too much; to make something seem larger, better, worse or more important than it really is
senses.zh: 做得过分；做得过火；夸张

examples.en: She really overdid the sympathy (= and so did not seem sincere).
examples.zh: 她真是同情得过火了。

senses.def: to use too much of something

examples.en: Don't overdo the salt in the food.
examples.zh: 菜里别放太多盐。

examples.en: Use illustrations where appropriate but don't overdo it.
examples.zh: 要适当地使用插图，但不宜过多。

senses.def: to cook something for too long

examples.en: The fish was overdone and very dry.
examples.zh: 这鱼烧的时间太长，都干掉了。

senses.def: to work, study, etc. too hard or for too long

examples.en: He's been overdoing things recently.
examples.zh: 他最近过于努力了。

examples.en: I overdid it in the gym and hurt my back.
examples.zh: 我在健身房练得过火了，结果弄伤了背。

senses.def: to work, study, etc. too hard or for too long

examples.en: He's been overdoing things recently.
examples.zh: 他最近过于努力了。

examples.en: I overdid it in the gym and hurt my back.
examples.zh: 我在健身房练得过火了，结果弄伤了背。

senses.def: to work, study, etc. too hard or for too long

examples.en: He's been overdoing things recently.
examples.zh: 他最近过于努力了。

examples.en: I overdid it in the gym and hurt my back.
examples.zh: 我在健身房练得过火了，结果弄伤了背。

senses.def: a person, organization or country that is successful or in a stronger position than others, especially when they seem to have an unfair advantage
senses.zh: （尤指不公正地）占上风者，占优势者；特权阶层

examples.en: political leaders who support the interests of the overdog
examples.zh: 支持特权阶层利益的政治领导人

examples.en: The judge had a reputation as a champion of the overdog.
examples.zh: 法官以支持强者而著称。

examples.en: This newspaper aims to defend the underdog and bite the ankle of the overdog.
examples.zh: 这份报纸旨在为弱者发声，并抨击强者。

senses.def: too much of a drug taken at one time, so that it is dangerous

examples.en: a drug/drugs overdose
examples.zh: 药物剂量过大

examples.en: She took a massive overdose of sleeping pills.
examples.zh: 她服用了过量的安眠药。

senses.def: to take too much of a drug at one time, so that it is dangerous

examples.en: He had overdosed on heroin.
examples.zh: 他过量服用了海洛因。

examples.en: I had overdosed on sun.
examples.zh: 我晒太阳的时间过长了。

senses.def: the amount of money that you owe to a bank when you have spent more money than is in your bank account; an arrangement that allows you to do this

examples.en: She had run up an overdraft of £3 000.
examples.zh: 她已经透支了 3 000 英镑

examples.en: to pay off/clear an overdraft
examples.zh: 付清透支

examples.en: The savings account has no overdraft facility.
examples.zh: 储蓄账户没有透支功能。

senses.def: to take out more money from a bank account than it contains

examples.en: Customers who overdraw their accounts will be charged a fee.
examples.zh: 透支的客户须付手续费。

senses.def: wearing clothes that are too formal or too smart for a particular occasion
senses.zh: 穿着太正式的；打扮过分的

senses.def: an extra high gear

examples.en: to be in overdrive
examples.zh: 在超速挡驾驶

senses.def: to start being very active and working very hard
senses.zh: 加劲；加倍努力；拼命工作

examples.en: As the wedding approached, the whole family went into overdrive.
examples.zh: 随着婚礼将近，全家人都忙得不亦乐乎。

senses.def: to start being very active and working very hard
senses.zh: 加劲；加倍努力；拼命工作

examples.en: As the wedding approached, the whole family went into overdrive.
examples.zh: 随着婚礼将近，全家人都忙得不亦乐乎。

senses.def: to record new sounds over the sounds on an original recording so that both can be heard
senses.zh: 把（录音）配到原带上；叠录

senses.def: not paid, done, returned, etc. by the required or expected time
senses.zh: （到期）未付的，未做的，未还的；过期的

examples.en: an overdue payment/library book
examples.zh: 逾期的欠款；逾期未还图书馆的书

examples.en: The rent is now overdue.
examples.zh: 现在房租已属拖欠。

examples.en: Her baby is two weeks overdue.
examples.zh: 她的胎儿已超过预产期两周了。

examples.en: This car is overdue for a service.
examples.zh: 这辆汽车早就该保养了。

senses.def: that should have happened or been done before now
senses.zh: 早该发生的；早应完成的

examples.en: overdue reforms
examples.zh: 迟来的改革

examples.en: A book like this is long overdue.
examples.zh: 像这样的书早就该有人出版了。

senses.def: to eat more than you need or more than is healthy
too much emphasis or importance

examples.en: an overemphasis on curing illness rather than preventing it
examples.zh: 过分强调治病而不是预防

senses.def: to give too much emphasis or importance to something

examples.en: The importance of preparation cannot be overemphasized (= is very great).
examples.zh: 准备工作的重要性再怎么强调也不过分。

senses.def: to estimate something to be larger, better, more important, etc. than it really is

examples.en: They overestimated his ability when they promoted him.
examples.zh: 他们提拔他的时候高估了他的能力。

examples.en: The importance of these findings cannot be overestimated (= is very great).
examples.zh: 这些发现的重要性怎么估量都不为过。

senses.def: an estimate about the size, cost, etc. of something that is too high

examples.en: I thought it would cost about £300, but luckily that turned out to be an overestimate.
examples.zh: 我原以为它会花费大约 300 英镑，但幸运的是，事实证明这个数字被高估了。

senses.def: the act or result of estimating something to be larger, better, more important, etc. than it really is

examples.en: Revenue assumptions may be prone to overestimation.
examples.zh: 收入假设可能容易被高估。

examples.en: This can result in an overestimation of the risk.
examples.zh: 这可能会导致风险的高估。

senses.def: too excited and not behaving in a calm or sensible way
senses.zh: 过度兴奋的；兴奋得忘乎所以的

examples.en: Don't get the children overexcited just before bedtime.
examples.zh: 临睡前不要让孩子过于兴奋。

senses.def: to affect the quality of a photograph or film by allowing too much light to enter the camera
to allow somebody/something to be seen too much on television, in the newspapers, etc.

examples.en: The club is careful not to let the younger players be overexposed, and rarely allows them to be interviewed.
examples.zh: 俱乐部不想让年轻队员过度曝光，因而很少允许他们接受采访。

senses.def: the fact of having no protection from the harmful effects of too much light or too much time in the sun
senses.zh: 过度暴露：没有保护措施以免受到太多光线或太多时间在阳光下的有害影响

examples.en: skin cancer caused by overexposure to the sun
examples.zh: 过度暴露在阳光下引起的皮肤癌

senses.def: the fact of being seen too much on television, in the newspapers, etc.

examples.en: The actor may be suffering from overexposure this year.
examples.zh: 这位演员今年可能遭遇了曝光过度的困扰。

senses.def: to be involved in more work or activities, or to spend more money, than you can manage without problems
senses.zh: 承担过多工作；开支过大

examples.en: They should not overextend themselves on the mortgage.
examples.zh: 他们不应该让自己承担过重的按揭贷款。

senses.def: to give somebody/something too much food
to take too many fish from the sea, a river, etc., so that the number of fish there becomes very low

examples.en: Our oceans are overfished and choked with plastic waste.
examples.zh: 我们的海洋因过度捕捞而被塑料垃圾堵塞。

examples.en: Sustainable fishing is very difficult when there are financial incentives to overfish.
examples.zh: 当存在过度捕捞的经济激励时，可持续捕捞就非常困难。

senses.def: the action of flying over a place

examples.en: a ban on overflights by military aircraft
examples.zh: 禁止军用飞机飞越领空

senses.def: to be so full that the contents go over the sides

examples.en: The bath is overflowing!
examples.zh: 浴盆溢水了！

examples.en: Plates overflowed with party food.
examples.zh: 聚会上的食物碟满盘盈。

examples.en: His bag was overflowing with clothes.
examples.zh: 他的包里装满了衣服。

examples.en: Her heart overflowed with love.
examples.zh: 她的心里充满了爱。

examples.en: The river overflowed its banks.
examples.zh: 河水涨出了堤岸。

senses.def: to have too many people in it

examples.en: The streets were overflowing with the crowds.
examples.zh: 街上到处挤满了人。

examples.en: The hospitals are filled to overflowing (= with patients).
examples.zh: 医院都人满为患。

senses.def: to spread beyond the limits of a place or container that is too full

examples.en: The meeting overflowed into the street.
examples.zh: 集会的人群延伸到了大街上。

examples.en: The chemicals overflowed from their storage tank.
examples.zh: 化学品从储存罐溢出。

senses.def: a number of people or things that do not fit into the space available

examples.en: A new office block was built to accommodate the overflow of staff.
examples.zh: 新建了一座办公大楼以便容纳多出的员工。

examples.en: an overflow car park
examples.zh: 备用停车场

senses.def: the action of liquid flowing out of a container, etc. that is already full; the liquid that flows out

examples.en: an overflow of water from the lake
examples.zh: 漫出的湖水

examples.en: an overflow of powerful emotions
examples.zh: 横流的激情

senses.def: a pipe that allows extra liquid to flow away safely when a container is full
a fault that happens because a number or data item is too large for the computer to represent it exactly
senses.zh: 溢出，溢流（运算产生的数值位数或字的长度等超过存储单元的长度）

senses.def: to fly over a place

examples.en: We overflew the war zone, taking photographs.
examples.zh: 我们飞越战区摄影。

examples.en: the noise from overflying planes
examples.zh: 过往飞机发出的噪声

senses.def: liking somebody/something too much
an item of clothing that is worn over other clothes
a statement that is not accurate because it is too general; the act of making a statement that is too general
senses.zh: 做过分概括的陈述；说话过于笼统

senses.def: to make a statement that is not accurate because it is too general
senses.zh: 做过分概括的陈述；说话过于笼统

senses.def: giving too much of something
senses.zh: （施与某物时）过于慷慨，过分大方

examples.en: She is not overgenerous with praise.
examples.zh: 她不说过头的恭维话。

senses.def: if land is overgrazed
on or above the surface of the ground, rather than under it

examples.en: overground trains
examples.zh: 地上列车

senses.def: on or above the surface of the ground, rather than under it

examples.en: The new railway line will run overground.
examples.zh: 新铁路线将采用地上铺设。

senses.def: covered with plants that have been allowed to grow wild and have not been controlled
senses.zh: 植物蔓生的；杂草丛生的

examples.en: an overgrown path
examples.zh: 长满野草的小径

examples.en: The path was completely overgrown.
examples.zh: 路上杂草丛生。

examples.en: The garden's completely overgrown with weeds.
examples.zh: 花园里长满了杂草。

examples.en: The canal bank was thickly overgrown with last year’s brambles.
examples.zh: 运河河畔密密麻麻地长满了去年的黑莓。

senses.def: that has grown too large
senses.zh: 过度发展的；长得过大的

examples.en: an overgrown village
examples.zh: 膨胀过大的村庄

examples.en: They act like a pair of overgrown children (= they are adults but they behave like children).
examples.zh: 他俩的举动就像一对大孩子。

senses.def: too much growth of something, especially something that grows on or over something else

examples.en: an overgrowth of moss in the lawn
examples.zh: 草坪上长满了苔藓

examples.en: to remove the overgrowth of a dog’s claws
examples.zh: 去除狗爪子的过度生长

senses.def: if you throw a ball overhand
senses.zh: 肩上投球（投球时举手过肩）

senses.def: an overhand
senses.zh: 举手投球：将球向后移动，然后将其抬高到肩膀上方，这是球的一掷

senses.def: to stick out over and above something else
senses.zh: 悬垂；悬挂；突出于某物之上

examples.en: Timber-framed houses overhang the narrow streets.
examples.zh: 木结构房屋悬在狭窄的街道上。

examples.en: The path was cool and dark with overhanging trees.
examples.zh: 小路树木掩映，凉爽幽暗。

senses.def: the part of something that sticks out over and above something else

examples.en: The roof has an overhang to protect the walls from the rain.
examples.zh: 屋顶有飞檐突出，保护墙壁不受雨淋。

senses.def: the amount by which something hangs over and above something else
the state of being extra to what is required; the things that are extra

examples.en: attempts to reduce the overhang of unsold goods
examples.zh: 减少滞销商品积压的尝试

senses.def: done too soon or doing something too soon, especially without enough thought
senses.zh: 过于匆忙的；过急的；过于草率的

examples.en: an overhasty decision
examples.zh: 过于草率的决定

examples.en: We were overhasty in making the choice.
examples.zh: 我们当初作选择时太仓促了。

senses.def: an examination of a machine or system, including doing repairs on it or making changes to it

examples.en: a complete/major overhaul
examples.zh: 彻底检修；大修

examples.en: A radical overhaul of the tax system is necessary.
examples.zh: 有必要彻底改革税制。

senses.def: to examine every part of a machine, system, etc. and make any necessary changes or repairs

examples.en: The engine has been completely overhauled.
examples.zh: 发动机已彻底检修过了。

senses.def: to come from behind a person you are competing against in a race and go past them

examples.en: He managed to overhaul the leader on the final lap.
examples.zh: 他在最后一圈发力超过了领先的选手。

senses.def: above your head; in the sky

examples.en: Planes flew overhead constantly.
examples.zh: 飞机不断从头顶上飞过。

examples.en: Thunder boomed in the sky overhead.
examples.zh: 雷声在天空中隆隆作响。

senses.def: above your head; raised above the ground
senses.zh: 头上方的；地面以上的；高架的

examples.en: overhead power lines
examples.zh: 架空电力线

senses.def: connected with the general costs of running a business or an organization, for example paying for rent or electricity

examples.en: overhead costs
examples.zh: 营运开支

senses.def: regular costs that you have when you are running a business or an organization, such as rent, electricity, wages, etc.
senses.zh: 经费；营运费用；经常性开支

senses.def: a piece of equipment that projects an image onto a wall or screen so that many people can see it

examples.en: I gave that talk back in the days of overhead projectors and transparencies.
examples.zh: 在投影仪和幻灯片盛行的时代，我曾做过这样的演讲。

senses.def: regular costs that you have when you are running a business or an organization, such as rent, electricity, wages, etc.
senses.zh: 经费；营运费用；经常性开支

examples.en: High overheads mean small profit margins.
examples.zh: 经费开销大意味着利润低。

intro.en: These are all words for money spent by a government, an organization or a person.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指政府、机构或个人的开支、支出、花费。

items.def: the total amount of money that needs to be spent by a business:
items.zh: 指成本

examples.en: labour/​production costs
examples.zh: 人工／生产成本

items.def: the amount of money that is spent, especially by a government or an organization:
items.zh: 尤指政府或机构的开支、支出、花销

examples.en: public spending
examples.zh: 公共开支

items.def: (rather formal) an amount of money spent by a government, an organization or a person:
items.zh: 指政府、机构或个人的开支、支出、花费

examples.en: expenditure on education
examples.zh: 教育支出

items.def: money that has to be spent by a person or an organization; money that you spend while you are working that your employer will pay back to you later:
items.zh: 指个人或机构必需的开支、花费或报销的费用

examples.en: legal expenses
examples.zh: 律师费

items.def: the regular costs of running a business or an organization, such as rent, electricity and wages:
items.zh: 指经费、运营费用、经常性开支

examples.en: High overheads mean small profit margins.
examples.zh: 经费开销大意味着利润低。

items.def: the money that you have to spend in order to start a new business or project, or in order to save yourself money or time later:
items.zh: 指启动新业务或项目所必要的开支、费用或为了节省后期投入而使用的经费

examples.en: The best equipment is costly but is well worth the outlay.
examples.zh: 最好的设备花费大，但这种开支很值得。

senses.def: to hear, especially by accident, a conversation in which you are not involved

examples.en: I overheard a conversation between two boys on the bus.
examples.zh: 我在公共汽车上无意中听到两个男孩的对话。

examples.en: We talked quietly so as not to be overheard.
examples.zh: 我们低声交谈，以免别人听到。

examples.en: We overheard them arguing.
examples.zh: 我们碰巧听到他们吵嘴。

examples.en: I overheard him say he was going to France.
examples.zh: 我偶然听见他说他要去法国。

senses.def: to become or to make something become too hot

examples.en: The engine is overheating.
examples.zh: 发动机过热了。

examples.en: It's vital not to overheat the liquid.
examples.zh: 最关键的是不要让液体过热。

senses.def: to be too active, with rising prices
senses.zh: 发展过热，过于活跃（以致物价高涨）

senses.def: to have too much of something nice, especially food or drink
senses.zh: 过多地享用（尤指食物或饮料）

senses.def: to give somebody more than is good for them

examples.en: His parents overindulged him.
examples.zh: 他的父母过于溺爱他。

senses.def: the fact of having too much of something nice, especially food or drink
senses.zh: （尤指在饮食方面）过度放任（自己）

examples.en: The holidays are always a time of overindulgence.
examples.zh: 假期总是一个放纵过度的时刻。

senses.def: too high

examples.en: overinflated house prices
examples.zh: 过高的房价

senses.def: made to seem better, worse, more important, etc. than it really is
senses.zh: 夸张的；夸大的；言过其实的

senses.def: filled with too much air

examples.en: Overinflated tyres burst more easily.
examples.zh: 充气过量的轮胎更容易爆裂。

senses.def: extremely happy or pleased

examples.en: He was overjoyed at my success.
examples.zh: 我的成功使他欣喜若狂。

examples.en: We were overjoyed to hear their good news.
examples.zh: 听到他们的好消息，我们都大喜过望。

examples.en: She was overjoyed that her article had been published.
examples.zh: 她的文章发表了，这使她高兴极了。

senses.def: too much of something that reduces the effect it has
senses.zh: 过犹不及；做得过火的事

examples.en: There is a danger of overkill if you plan everything too carefully.
examples.zh: 如果事事过分谨小慎微，那结果难免有适得其反的危险。

senses.def: across the land; by land, not by sea or by air
senses.zh: 横跨陆地的；通过陆路的

examples.en: to travel overland
examples.zh: 经陆路前往

senses.def: across the land; by land, not by sea or by air
senses.zh: 横跨陆地的；通过陆路的

examples.en: an overland route
examples.zh: 陆上路线

senses.def: if one thing overlaps

examples.en: A fish’s scales overlap each other.
examples.zh: 鱼鳞一片片上下交叠。

examples.en: The floor was protected with overlapping sheets of newspaper.
examples.zh: 地板用一张搭着一张的报纸保护着。

senses.def: to make two or more things overlap

examples.en: You will need to overlap the pieces of wood slightly.
examples.zh: 你得使这些木片像鱼鳞片似的搭叠起来。

senses.def: if two events overlap
to cover part of the same area of interest, knowledge, responsibility, etc.

examples.en: Our jobs overlap slightly, which sometimes causes difficulties.
examples.zh: 我们的工作略有重叠，所以有时引起一些困难。

examples.en: The language of science overlaps with that of everyday life.
examples.zh: 有些科学用语也用于日常生活。

examples.en: The themes of this novel overlap those explored by other writers of the period.
examples.zh: 这部小说的主题与同时代其他作家探索的主题重叠。

senses.def: a shared area of interest, knowledge, responsibility, etc.

examples.en: There is (a) considerable overlap between the two subjects.
examples.zh: 两门科目之间有相当多的共通之处。

senses.def: the amount by which one thing covers another thing

examples.en: an overlap of 5 cm on each roof tile
examples.zh: 每片房瓦上 5 厘米的重叠度

senses.def: a period of time in which two events or activities happen together
senses.zh: （两事发生的）重叠时间，交接时期

examples.en: There will be an overlap of a week while John teaches Ann the job.
examples.zh: 将有一周的交接期可以让约翰教导安如何接手工作。

senses.def: on the other side of the page of a book, etc.
senses.zh: 在（书页等的）背面；在后面

examples.en: Complete the form overleaf.
examples.zh: 填好背面的表格。

examples.en: The changes are explained in detail overleaf.
examples.zh: 修改处在背面有详细的说明。

senses.def: to lie over something

examples.en: overlying rock
examples.zh: 压在上面的岩石

senses.def: to put too great a load on something

examples.en: an overloaded truck
examples.zh: 一辆超载的卡车

senses.def: to give somebody too much of something

examples.en: He's overloaded with responsibilities.
examples.zh: 他担负的责任过多。

examples.en: Don't overload the students with information.
examples.zh: 不要给学生灌输过多的信息。

senses.def: to put too great a demand on a computer, an electrical system, etc. causing it to fail
senses.zh: 使（计算机）超载运行；使（电路）超负荷

examples.en: The lights went out because the system was overloaded.
examples.zh: 由于线路过载，电灯灭了。

senses.def: too much of something

examples.en: In these days of technological change we all suffer from information overload.
examples.zh: 在这科技日新月异的时代，过多的信息使人人都应接不暇。

examples.en: An electrical overload caused the fuse to blow.
examples.zh: 用电超负荷导致保险丝熔断。

senses.def: too long

examples.en: an overlong agenda
examples.zh: 过长的议程表

examples.en: By the interval the show already felt overlong.
examples.zh: 到了演出的间隙，就已经感觉太长了。

senses.def: to fail to see or notice something

examples.en: He seems to have overlooked one important fact.
examples.zh: 他好像忽略了一个重要的事实。

examples.en: In my hurry to finish the exam I had overlooked part of one of the questions.
examples.zh: 由于急于完成考试，我忽略了其中一题的一部分。

senses.def: to see something wrong or bad but decide to ignore it
senses.zh: （对不良现象等）不予理会，视而不见

examples.en: We could not afford to overlook such a serious offence.
examples.zh: 对这样严重的违法行为，我们决不能视若无睹。

examples.en: He’s so friendly people are prepared to overlook his faults.
examples.zh: 他待人友好，所以人们愿意忽略他的缺点。

examples.en: I was prepared to overlook her mistakes this time.
examples.zh: 我不准备计较她这次的过失。

senses.def: if a building, etc. overlooks

examples.en: a restaurant overlooking the lake
examples.zh: 一家濒湖餐厅

examples.en: Our back yard is overlooked by several houses.
examples.zh: 好几栋房子都看得见我家的后院。

senses.def: to not consider somebody for a job or position, even though they might be suitable

examples.en: She's been overlooked for promotion several times.
examples.zh: 几次提职时都没有考虑她。

senses.def: (especially in the past) a person who has power over many other people

examples.en: feudal overlords
examples.zh: 封建领主

senses.def: too; very

examples.en: I'm not overly fond of pasta.
examples.zh: 我不怎么喜欢吃意大利面食。

examples.en: We think you are being overly optimistic.
examples.zh: 我们认为你过于乐观了。

senses.def: having more workers than are needed
senses.zh: 人浮于事的；人员过多的

senses.def: the fact of a company, office, etc. having more workers than are needed
senses.zh: 人浮于事的；人员过多的

examples.en: the problems of overmanning in industry
examples.zh: 产业界从业人员过多的问题

senses.def: too much; very much

examples.en: They adapted to the new arrangements without overmuch fuss.
examples.zh: 他们毫不费力地适应了新的安排。

senses.def: too much; very much

examples.en: She didn't worry overmuch about it.
examples.zh: 她对此不太担忧。

examples.en: Details did not concern him overmuch.
examples.zh: 他并不太关心细节。

senses.def: during or for the night

examples.en: We stayed overnight in London after the theatre.
examples.zh: 我们看完戏后在伦敦住了一晚。

senses.def: suddenly or quickly

examples.en: Don't expect it to improve overnight.
examples.zh: 不要指望这事一下子就改善了。

examples.en: She became famous overnight.
examples.zh: 她一夜成名。

senses.def: happening during the night; for a night
senses.zh: 夜间的；晚上的；只供一夜的

examples.en: an overnight flight
examples.zh: 夜间飞行

examples.en: overnight accommodation
examples.zh: 一夜住宿

examples.en: She took only an overnight bag (= containing the things needed for a night spent away from home).
examples.zh: 她只带了一个外出住宿一晚的用品旅行袋。

senses.def: happening suddenly or quickly
senses.zh: 突然的；很快的；一夜之间的

examples.en: The play was an overnight success.
examples.zh: 这部剧作一夜成名。

senses.def: a bridge that carries one road over another one
to pay somebody too much; to pay somebody more than their work is worth

examples.en: I think he’s grossly overpaid for what he does.
examples.zh: 我认为他为他所做的事情付出了太多的代价。

senses.def: the act of paying somebody too much; an amount paid that is too much
senses.zh: 多付：多付某人的行为；支付的金额太多

examples.en: overpayment of housing benefit
examples.zh: 多付住房福利

examples.en: Most suppliers automatically refund overpayments.
examples.zh: 大多数供应商会自动退还多付款项。

senses.def: to give too much importance to something

examples.en: His role in the negotiations has been overplayed.
examples.zh: 他在谈判中的作用被夸大了。

senses.def: to fail to achieve success by judging your position to be stronger than it really is
senses.zh: 因不自量力而毁掉胜机；高估自己的地位；错估形势

senses.def: to fail to achieve success by judging your position to be stronger than it really is
senses.zh: 因不自量力而毁掉胜机；高估自己的地位；错估形势

senses.def: to fail to achieve success by judging your position to be stronger than it really is
senses.zh: 因不自量力而毁掉胜机；高估自己的地位；错估形势

senses.def: with too many people living in it
the fact of a country or city having too many people living in it

examples.en: the problems of overpopulation
examples.zh: 人口过多引起的种种问题

senses.def: to defeat or gain control over somebody completely by using greater strength

examples.en: Police finally managed to overpower the gunman.
examples.zh: 警察最终制伏了持枪歹徒。

examples.en: Manchester United completely overpowered their rivals to win 4–0.
examples.zh: 曼联以4-0彻底击败对手。

senses.def: to be so strong or great that it affects somebody/something seriously
senses.zh: 压倒；令人折服；使难以忍受

examples.en: Finally the cold overpowered him.
examples.zh: 最后，寒冷压倒了他。

examples.en: The flavour of the garlic overpowered the meat.
examples.zh: 大蒜的味道盖过了肉味。

senses.def: in a way that is very strong or powerful
senses.zh: 强烈的；极强大的；坚强的

senses.def: too expensive; costing more than it is worth
senses.zh: 价格太高的；过于昂贵的

examples.en: The drinks in the bar were all overpriced.
examples.zh: 酒吧里的饮料都价格过高。

examples.en: ridiculously overpriced designer clothes
examples.zh: 贵得离谱的名牌衣服

intro.en: These words all describe something that costs a lot of money.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示昂贵、花钱多。

items.def: costing a lot of money; charging high prices:
items.zh: 指昂贵的、花钱多的、价格高的

examples.en: I can’t afford it—it’s just too expensive for me.
examples.zh: 我买不起，对我来说这太贵了。

items.def: (rather formal) costing a lot of money, especially more than you want to pay:
items.zh: 指昂贵的、花钱多的、价钱比愿意付的为高

examples.en: You want to avoid costly legal proceedings if you can.
examples.zh: 可能的话，你应该避免昂贵的法律诉讼。

items.def: too expensive; costing more than it is worth:
items.zh: 指价格太高的、过于昂贵的

examples.en: ridiculously overpriced designer clothes
examples.zh: 贵得离谱的名牌衣服

items.def: (informal) expensive:
items.zh: 指昂贵的、价格高的

examples.en: Houses in the village are now too pricey for local people to afford.
examples.zh: 如今该村镇的房价太高，当地人根本买不起。

items.def: [not usually before noun] (British English英式英语) expensive:
items.zh: 指昂贵、价格高

examples.en: Everything’s so dear now, isn’t it?
examples.zh: 现在什么东西都那么贵，是不是？

senses.def: to print something on a document, etc. that already has printing on it
to produce more of something than is wanted or needed
the act of producing more of something than is wanted or needed
too anxious to protect somebody from being hurt, in a way that limits their freedom
senses.zh: 过分保护的；袒护的；溺爱的

examples.en: overprotective parents
examples.zh: 溺爱子女的父母

senses.def: having more experience or training than is necessary for a particular job, so that people do not want to employ you
to have too high an opinion of somebody/something; to put too high a value on somebody/something

examples.en: In my opinion, Hirst's work has been vastly overrated.
examples.zh: 依我看，赫斯特的作品被大大地高估了。

senses.def: to fail by trying to achieve more than is possible

examples.en: In making these promises, the company had clearly overreached itself.
examples.zh: 这家公司作出这些承诺，显然是不自量力。

senses.def: to react too strongly, especially to something unpleasant
senses.zh: 反应过激，反应过火（尤指对不愉快的事情）

examples.en: The financial markets overreacted to the news.
examples.zh: 金融市场对这条消息反应过于强烈。

senses.def: the act of reacting too strongly, especially to something unpleasant
senses.zh: 反应过激，反应过火（尤指对不愉快的事情）

examples.en: an overreaction by the stock market
examples.zh: 股市反应过度

examples.en: The school is accused of overreaction to the complaints of a few parents.
examples.zh: 学校被指责对一些家长的投诉反应过度。

senses.def: to use your authority to reject somebody’s decision, order, etc.

examples.en: The chairman overrode the committee's objections and signed the agreement.
examples.zh: 主席不顾委员会的反对，径行签署了协议。

senses.def: to be more important than something

examples.en: Considerations of safety override all other concerns.
examples.zh: 对安全的考虑高于一切。

senses.def: to interrupt the action of a device that usually works by itself in order to control it yourself
senses.zh: 超控（使自动控制暂时失效，改用手动控制）

examples.en: A special code is needed to override the time lock.
examples.zh: 这定时锁要用特定密码才能打开。

senses.def: too ripe

examples.en: overripe fruit
examples.zh: 熟过头的水果

senses.def: to change a decision or reject an idea from a position of greater power

examples.en: to overrule a decision/an objection
examples.zh: （以权力）推翻决议／异议

examples.en: The verdict was overruled by the Supreme Court.
examples.zh: 最高法院驳回了那个裁决。

senses.def: the act of taking more time or money than was intended

examples.en: a cost overrun
examples.zh: 超支

senses.def: to fill or spread over an area quickly, especially in large numbers

examples.en: The house was completely overrun with mice.
examples.zh: 这房子简直成了老鼠的天下。

examples.en: Enemy soldiers had overrun the island.
examples.zh: 敌军士兵侵占了该岛。

examples.en: The tiny village was overrun by tourists.
examples.zh: 这个小村庄挤满了游客。

senses.def: to take more time or money than was intended

examples.en: Her lectures never overrun.
examples.zh: 她讲课从不拖堂。

examples.en: You've overrun your time by 10 minutes.
examples.zh: 你超时 10 分钟了。

senses.def: connected with foreign countries, especially those separated from your country by the sea or ocean

examples.en: The firm is expanding into overseas markets.
examples.zh: 该公司正在向海外市场扩张。

examples.en: overseas development/trade
examples.zh: 海外发展／贸易

examples.en: overseas visitors/students
examples.zh: 外国访客／学生

examples.en: This was her first overseas trip as prime minister.
examples.zh: 这是她第一次作为首相出访海外。

senses.def: to or in a foreign country, especially those separated from your country by the sea or ocean

examples.en: to live/work/go overseas
examples.zh: 在国外生活／工作；出国

examples.en: The product is sold both at home and overseas.
examples.zh: 这个产品行销国内外。

examples.en: He was working overseas for an oil company.
examples.zh: 当时他供职于一家石油公司，驻外工作。

senses.def: any of several small territories
senses.zh: 海外领地由英国政府任命的总督管辖的小块领土（主要是岛屿或群岛），如福克兰群岛、直布罗陀和圣赫勒拿岛。英国政府负责其防务及其他方面的政务，如警察和行政部门。英国的海外领地以前称为附属领地或直辖殖民地。

senses.def: to watch somebody/something and make sure that a job or an activity is done correctly

examples.en: United Nations observers oversaw the elections.
examples.zh: 联合国观察员监督了选举。

senses.def: a person whose job is to make sure that other workers do their work
a person or an organization that is responsible for making sure that a system is working as it should
senses.zh: （某体系的）监督者，监督机构，督察

senses.def: to say that somebody/something is better than they really are

examples.en: He has a tendency to oversell himself.
examples.zh: 他爱自我吹嘘。

senses.def: to sell too much or more of something than is available

examples.en: The seats on the plane were oversold.
examples.zh: 飞机上的座位超卖了。

senses.def: too easily upset or offended
senses.zh: 过于敏感的；爱生气的；动不动就发脾气的

senses.def: having stronger sexual desire than is usual
to make somebody/something seem less important, or successful
senses.zh: 使显得逊色；使黯然失色

examples.en: He had always been overshadowed by his elder sister.
examples.zh: 他与他姐姐相比总是相形见绌。

examples.en: Domestic policy was soon overshadowed by political unrest abroad.
examples.zh: 国内政策很快就被国外的政治动荡所掩盖。

senses.def: to make an event less pleasant than it should be

examples.en: News of the accident overshadowed the day's events.
examples.zh: 出事的消息给这一天的活动蒙上了阴影。

senses.def: to throw a shadow over something

examples.en: The garden is overshadowed by tall trees.
examples.zh: 花园中大树浓荫密布。

senses.def: to give more information than people want to hear about your personal life

examples.en: Her tendency to overshare is sometimes embarrassing!
examples.zh: 她喜欢过度分享自己的私生活，有时真叫人尴尬！

senses.def: a person who gives more information than people want to hear about his or her personal life
senses.zh: 过度分享者：提供比人们想知道的更多有关他或她的个人生活的信息的人

senses.def: a shoe worn over another shoe, especially in wet weather or to protect a floor
senses.zh: 套鞋，罩鞋（在雨天时或为保护地板而穿）

senses.def: to go further than the place you intended to stop or turn

examples.en: The aircraft overshot the runway.
examples.zh: 飞机冲出了跑道。

examples.en: She had overshot by 20 metres.
examples.zh: 她超过了 20 米。

senses.def: to do more or to spend more money than you originally planned
senses.zh: 超过（原计划）；突破（预计费用）

examples.en: The department may overshoot its cash limit this year.
examples.zh: 这个部门今年可能要突破现金限额。

senses.def: the fact of making a mistake because you forget to do something or you do not notice something

examples.en: I didn't mean to leave her name off the list; it was an oversight.
examples.zh: 我不是有意在名单上漏掉她的名字的，这是个疏忽。

examples.en: You can never entirely eliminate human error and oversight.
examples.zh: 人为的错误和疏失是没有可能根除的。

senses.def: the state of being in charge of somebody/something

examples.en: The committee has oversight of finance and general policy.
examples.zh: 该委员会负责处理财政和一般性政策。

senses.def: a description of a situation, a problem, etc. that is too simple and that ignores some of the facts
senses.zh: 陈述过于简略；说明过于简单化

examples.en: This is a gross oversimplification of the facts.
examples.zh: 这是对事实严重的过度简化。

senses.def: to describe a situation, a problem, etc. in a way that is too simple and ignores some of the facts
senses.zh: 陈述过于简略；说明过于简单化

examples.en: It's easy to oversimplify the issues involved.
examples.zh: 很容易把涉及的问题看得太简单。

examples.en: an oversimplified view of human nature
examples.zh: 对人性过于简单化的看法

senses.def: bigger than the normal size; too big
senses.zh: 过大的；硕大的；大得超过正常的

examples.en: She wore a pair of baggy jeans and an oversized T-shirt.
examples.zh: 她穿着一条宽松的牛仔裤和一件超大号的T恤。

examples.en: Many children are being taught in oversized classes.
examples.zh: 许多孩子在超大班级中接受教育。

senses.def: to sleep longer than you intended

examples.en: I overslept and missed the bus.
examples.zh: 我睡过了头，因此误了班车。

senses.def: an act of spending too much money or more than you planned; the amount of money spent
senses.zh: 花钱过多；比（预计的）花得多；超支

examples.en: a £1 million overspend
examples.zh: 100 万英镑的超支额

senses.def: to spend too much money or more than you planned
senses.zh: 花钱过多；比（预计的）花得多；超支

examples.en: The company has overspent on marketing.
examples.zh: 这个公司在市场推广方面开支过多。

examples.en: Many departments have overspent their budgets this year.
examples.zh: 许多部门今年开支都超过了预算。

senses.def: people who move out of a city because it is too crowded to an area where there is more space

examples.en: New towns were designed to house London's overspill.
examples.zh: 新的城镇是为容纳伦敦的过剩人口而设计的。

senses.def: having more workers than are needed
senses.zh: 人浮于事的；人员过多的

senses.def: to say something in a way that makes it seem more important than it really is

examples.en: He tends to overstate his case when talking politics.
examples.zh: 他一谈政治便流于夸夸其谈。

examples.en: The seriousness of the crime cannot be overstated.
examples.zh: 这一罪行的严重性怎么说也不为过。

examples.en: Her musical talent has been a little overstated.
examples.zh: 她的音乐天赋有点被夸大了。

senses.def: a statement that you say in a way that makes it seem more important than it really is; the act of saying something in this way

examples.en: It is not an overstatement to say a crisis is imminent.
examples.zh: 说危机迫在眉睫绝非言过其实。

senses.def: to stay longer than the length of time you are expected or allowed to stay

examples.en: They overstayed their visa.
examples.zh: 他们居留超过了签证期限。

senses.def: to stay somewhere as a guest longer than you are wanted
senses.zh: 做客太久而不再受欢迎

examples.en: Sensing that he had outstayed his welcome, he quickly said his goodbyes and left.
examples.zh: 他感觉到自己逗留的时间太长已经不再受欢迎，赶快说声再见就离开了。

senses.def: to stay somewhere as a guest longer than you are wanted
senses.zh: 做客太久而不再受欢迎

examples.en: Sensing that he had outstayed his welcome, he quickly said his goodbyes and left.
examples.zh: 他感觉到自己逗留的时间太长已经不再受欢迎，赶快说声再见就离开了。

senses.def: to go beyond what is normal or allowed
senses.zh: 超越（正常或允许的）范围；越权；僭越

examples.en: to overstep your authority
examples.zh: 越权

examples.en: He tends to overstep the boundaries of good taste.
examples.zh: 他往往文雅过度而流于庸俗。

senses.def: to behave in a way that people think is not acceptable

examples.en: She realized she had overstepped the mark and quickly apologized.
examples.zh: 她意识到自己已经逾越了界限，并迅速道歉。

senses.def: to behave in a way that people think is not acceptable

examples.en: She realized she had overstepped the mark and quickly apologized.
examples.zh: 她意识到自己已经逾越了界限，并迅速道歉。

senses.def: to behave in a way that people think is not acceptable

examples.en: She realized she had overstepped the mark and quickly apologized.
examples.zh: 她意识到自己已经逾越了界限，并迅速道歉。

senses.def: to buy or make more of something than you need or can sell
senses.zh: 库存过多（货物）；进（货）过多

senses.def: to put too many animals in a place where there is not enough room or food for them
senses.zh: （在空间、食物不足的地方）畜养过多的动物

senses.def: to do more than you are capable of; to make somebody/something do more than they are capable of
senses.zh: （使）勉强维持，硬撑着，超负荷运转

examples.en: This will overstretch the prison service's resources.
examples.zh: 这将使监狱的资源不堪负荷。

examples.en: Credit cards can tempt you to overstretch yourself (= spend more money than you can afford).
examples.zh: 信用卡能诱使你超额消费。

senses.def: if an activity, service, etc. is oversubscribed
senses.zh: （活动、服务等）供不应求的，未能达到需求量的

examples.en: The popular secondary schools in the town are usually oversubscribed.
examples.zh: 镇上受欢迎的中学通常都被超额认购。

senses.def: done in an open way and not secretly
senses.zh: 公开的；明显的；不隐瞒的

examples.en: There was little overt support for the project.
examples.zh: 对这个项目公开表示支持的很少。

examples.en: an overt display of affection
examples.zh: 公开示爱

senses.def: to go past a moving vehicle or person ahead of you because you are going faster than they are

examples.en: He pulled out to overtake a truck.
examples.zh: 他驶出车流，以超过一辆卡车。

examples.en: It's dangerous to overtake on a bend.
examples.zh: 在弯道强行超车是危险的。

senses.def: to become greater in number, amount or importance than something else
senses.zh: （在数量或重要性方面）大于，超过

examples.en: Nuclear energy may overtake oil as the main fuel.
examples.zh: 核能可能会超过石油成为主要燃料。

examples.en: We mustn't let ourselves be overtaken by our competitors.
examples.zh: 我们决不能让竞争对手超过我们。

examples.en: Quinine has been overtaken by newer drugs.
examples.zh: 奎宁已被新药取代。

senses.def: if something unpleasant overtakes
senses.zh: （不愉快的事情）突然发生，突然降临

examples.en: The climbers were overtaken by bad weather.
examples.zh: 登山者突然遭遇了恶劣天气。

examples.en: Sudden panic overtook her.
examples.zh: 她突然感到一阵恐慌。

examples.en: Our original plan was overtaken by events (= the situation changed very rapidly) and we had to make a new one.
examples.zh: 我们原来的计划没赶上变化，只好再订一个新的。

senses.def: to do more than you are able or want to do; to make somebody/something do more than they are able or want to do
senses.zh: 使用过度；（使）超负荷工作

examples.en: to overtax your strength
examples.zh: 透支体力

examples.en: Take it easy. Don't overtax yourself.
examples.zh: 轻松一点，别让自己劳累过度。

senses.def: to make a person or an organization pay too much tax
senses.zh: （对人或机构）课税过重，多收税款

senses.def: to think about something too much or for too long
senses.zh: 过度思虑；考虑时间过长

examples.en: He has a tendency to overthink things.
examples.zh: 他总是过度思虑。

examples.en: The change has enabled him to relax and not overthink.
examples.zh: 这种变化让他放松下来，不去想太多。

senses.def: to remove a leader or a government from a position of power by force

examples.en: The president was overthrown in a military coup.
examples.zh: 总统在军事政变中被赶下台。

senses.def: the act of taking power by force from a leader or government

examples.en: He was president until his overthrow in 1995.
examples.zh: 他一直担任总统，直到 1995 年被推翻。

senses.def: time that you spend working at your job after you have worked the normal hours

examples.en: to do/work overtime
examples.zh: 加班

examples.en: overtime pay/earnings/hours
examples.zh: 加班费／收入／时间

examples.en: The union announced a ban on overtime.
examples.zh: 工会宣布禁止加班。

senses.def: the money somebody earns for doing overtime

examples.en: They pay $150 a day plus overtime.
examples.zh: 他们支付每天 150 美元的报酬，外加加班费。

senses.def: a set period of time that is added to the end of a sports game, etc., if there is no winner at the end of the normal period

examples.en: The game went into overtime.
examples.zh: 比赛进入了加时赛。

senses.def: to be very active or too active

examples.en: There was nothing to worry about. It was just her imagination working overtime.
examples.zh: 没什么可担心的。那只是她的想象力太丰富了。

senses.def: to be very active or too active

examples.en: There was nothing to worry about. It was just her imagination working overtime.
examples.zh: 没什么可担心的。那只是她的想象力太丰富了。

senses.def: extremely tired, so that you are easily annoyed
in a way that is open and not secret

examples.en: overtly political activities
examples.zh: 明显有政治目的的活动

senses.def: an attitude or an emotion that is suggested and is not expressed in a direct way
senses.zh: 弦外之音；言外之意；暗示

examples.en: There were political overtones to the point he was making.
examples.zh: 他的论点有政治寓意。

senses.def: to rise above something, especially a barrier

examples.en: The river overtopped its banks during a series of storms last month.
examples.zh: 上月连续暴雨，河水漫过堤岸。

examples.en: Levees along the Mississippi could be overtopped or breached at any time.
examples.zh: 密西西比河的防洪堤随时会被淹没或决口。

senses.def: to be higher than something/somebody

examples.en: The city walls are overtopped by church spires and minarets.
examples.zh: 教堂尖塔和宣礼塔高过城墙。

senses.def: above; over the top of

examples.en: Plant the seeds in the tray with a layer of soil below and overtop.
examples.zh: 将种子种入育苗盘，上下均铺一层土。

examples.en: Sprinkle the mixture overtop the batter.
examples.zh: 将混合物撒在面糊上。

examples.en: Sweet, pure melodies soar overtop of simple rock instrumentals.
examples.zh: 甜美纯净的旋律飞扬，盖过了简单的摇滚乐曲。

senses.def: a situation in which a place of interest is visited by too many tourists

examples.en: In many places overtourism is provoking a backlash from local communities.
examples.zh: 过度旅游在许多地方正激起当地社群的强烈抵制。

senses.def: to train too hard or for too long
a piece of music written as an introduction to an opera
senses.zh: （歌剧或芭蕾舞的）序曲，前奏曲

examples.en: Prokofiev’s overture to ‘Romeo and Juliet’
examples.zh: 普罗科菲耶夫《罗密欧与朱丽叶》序曲

senses.def: a suggestion or an action by which somebody tries to make friends, start a business relationship, have discussions, etc. with somebody else

examples.en: He began making overtures to a number of merchant banks.
examples.zh: 他开始主动同一些投资银行接触。

examples.en: Maggie was never one to reject a friendly overture.
examples.zh: 玛吉从来不会拒绝别人友好的表示。

senses.def: if something overturns

examples.en: The car skidded and overturned.
examples.zh: 汽车打滑翻倒了。

examples.en: He stood up quickly, overturning his chair.
examples.zh: 他猛然站起来，弄翻了椅子。

senses.def: to officially decide that a legal decision, etc. is not correct, and to make it no longer legally recognized

examples.en: to overturn a decision/conviction/verdict
examples.zh: 撤销决定／定罪／裁决

examples.en: His sentence was overturned by the appeal court.
examples.zh: 上诉法庭撤销了对他的判决。

examples.en: He hopes that councillors will overturn the decision.
examples.zh: 他希望议员们能够推翻这一决定。

senses.def: to show that a belief or an idea is not correct

examples.en: She completely overturned my preconceptions about film stars.
examples.zh: 她彻底打破了我对电影明星的成见。

examples.en: This argument seems convincing, but is easily overturned.
examples.zh: 这一论点看似令人信服，却很容易被推翻。

senses.def: the act of using something too much or too often

examples.en: The problem of antibiotic overuse and misuse is not easy to control.
examples.zh: 抗生素过度使用和滥用的问题并不容易控制。

examples.en: An overuse of graphics in reports can be an unwelcome distraction.
examples.zh: 报告中过度使用图形可能会造成不受欢迎的干扰。

senses.def: to use something too much or too often

examples.en: ‘Nice’ is a very overused word.
examples.zh: nice 一词用得实在太滥了。

senses.def: to put too high a value on something

examples.en: Intelligence cannot be overvalued.
examples.zh: 智力是无比重要的。

examples.en: overvalued currencies/stocks
examples.zh: 估价过高的货币／股票

senses.def: a general description or an outline of something

examples.en: The second chapter will provide an overview of the issues involved.
examples.zh: 第二章将对相关议题作出概述。

senses.def: showing that you are too confident or proud
senses.zh: 傲慢的；自负的；过于自信的

senses.def: too heavy, in a way that may be unhealthy

examples.en: I was a few pounds overweight.
examples.zh: 我超重了几磅。

examples.en: A number of medical conditions are due to being overweight.
examples.zh: 一些疾病的起因是体重超标。

examples.en: You don’t look overweight.
examples.zh: 你看上去不超重。

senses.def: above an allowed weight
senses.zh: 超过限制重量的；过重的

examples.en: overweight baggage
examples.zh: 超重的行李

senses.def: to have such a strong emotional effect on somebody that it is difficult for them to resist or know how to react

examples.en: She was overwhelmed by feelings of guilt.
examples.zh: 她感到愧疚难当。

examples.en: The beauty of the landscape overwhelmed me.
examples.zh: 秀丽的风光令我深深地陶醉。

senses.def: to defeat somebody completely

examples.en: The army was overwhelmed by the rebels.
examples.zh: 军队被叛乱者完全击败了。

examples.en: He totally overwhelmed the Spaniard, 6–2, 6–3,6–2, in the final.
examples.zh: 他在决赛中以6-2、6-3、6-2彻底击败了西班牙人。

senses.def: to be so bad or so great that a person cannot deal with it; to give too much of a thing to a person

examples.en: We were overwhelmed by requests for information.
examples.zh: 各方的问讯使我们应接不暇。

senses.def: to cover somebody/something completely

examples.en: The wave broke through the wall and overwhelmed the town.
examples.zh: 海浪冲破了城墙，淹没了小镇。

senses.def: in a way that is very great or very strong; in a way that is so powerful that you cannot resist it or decide how to react
senses.zh: 巨大的；压倒性的；无法抗拒的

examples.en: They voted overwhelmingly against the proposal.
examples.zh: 他们以压倒性的多数票反对这项提案。

senses.def: to spend the winter months in a place; to stay alive or to keep something alive during the winter
to work too hard; to make a person or an animal work too hard

examples.en: You look tired. Have you been overworking?
examples.zh: 你似乎很疲倦，是不是近来劳累过度了？

examples.en: She overworks her staff.
examples.zh: 她让员工过度劳累。

examples.en: The staff are grossly overworked.
examples.zh: 员工累得疲惫不堪。

senses.def: the fact of working too hard

examples.en: His illness was brought on by money worries and overwork.
examples.zh: 他的病是因操心钱和劳累过度而造成的。

senses.def: to replace information on the screen or in a file by putting new information over it
very worried and upset; excited in a nervous way
senses.zh: 过度紧张的；过分忧烦的；紧张激动的

examples.en: She was still a little overwrought.
examples.zh: 她还是有些过于紧张。

examples.en: The child is usually too emotionally overwrought to listen to reason.
examples.zh: 这孩子通常太受感情左右, 而不顾理智。

senses.def: showing too much energy or enthusiasm
senses.zh: 过于热心的；激情过高的

examples.en: An overzealous fan ran onto the stage during the concert.
examples.zh: 音乐会上，一名狂热的歌迷冲到了台上。

senses.def: either of the tubes that carry eggs from the ovaries
relating to sheep
producing eggs rather than live babies
an object that is like an egg in shape
like an egg in shape
producing babies by means of eggs that are hatched
to produce an egg (called an ovum
the process of producing an egg (called an ovum

examples.en: methods of predicting ovulation
examples.zh: 预测排卵时间的方法

senses.def: the part of the ovary
a female cell of an animal or a plant that can develop into a young animal or plant when fertilized
used to express sudden pain
senses.zh: （突然感到疼痛时发出的声音）哎哟，啊唷

examples.en: Ow! That hurt!
examples.zh: 哎呦！疼死我了！

senses.def: to have to pay somebody for something that you have already received or return money that you have borrowed

examples.en: She still owes her father £3 000.
examples.zh: 她还欠她父亲 3 000 英镑。

examples.en: I'm still owed three days' leave.
examples.zh: 还欠我三天假。

examples.en: He owes more money than he can afford to pay.
examples.zh: 他欠下了无法还清的债务。

examples.en: Exactly how much do we owe?
examples.zh: 我们究竟欠了多少钱？

examples.en: She still owes £3 000 to her father.
examples.zh: 她还欠她父亲 3 000 英镑。

examples.en: The country owes billions of dollars to foreign creditors.
examples.zh: 这个国家欠外国债主十亿元。

examples.en: Most hospitals owe money to pharmaceutical companies for medicines and equipment.
examples.zh: 大多数医院欠制药公司的药品和设备资金。

examples.en: How much do I owe you for the groceries?
examples.zh: 买这些杂货我得给你多少钱？

senses.def: to feel that you ought to do something for somebody or give them something, especially because they have done something for you

examples.en: I owe a debt of gratitude to all my family.
examples.zh: 我很感激我的全家人。

examples.en: You owe it to your staff to be honest with them.
examples.zh: 与下属坦诚相待，这是你对他们应有的态度。

examples.en: I owe a duty to my family.
examples.zh: 我对我的家人负有责任。

examples.en: You owe me a favour!
examples.zh: 你还欠我一个人情！

examples.en: Thanks for sticking up for me—I owe you one (= I owe you a favour).
examples.zh: 谢谢你支持我，我欠你一个人情。

examples.en: I think you owe us an explanation.
examples.zh: 我认为你应当给我们一个解释。

examples.en: I think we're owed an apology.
examples.zh: 我认为得有人向我们道歉。

senses.def: to exist or be successful because of the help or influence of somebody/something

examples.en: He owes his success to hard work.
examples.zh: 他的成功是靠勤奋工作。

examples.en: The play owes much to French tragedy.
examples.zh: 这部戏颇受法国悲剧的影响。

examples.en: I owe everything to him.
examples.zh: 我的一切都归功于他。

examples.en: The town owes its existence to the minerals that lie below the mountains.
examples.zh: 该镇的存在归功于山下的矿物。

senses.def: the oldest university in Britain, in the town of Oxford, England. There is evidence of teaching at Oxford as early as 1096, but the university developed rapidly from the middle of the 12th century. It has a high reputation for academic achievement. The university consists of a number of separate colleges, the earliest of which is University College (established 1249). Other famous colleges include All Souls, Balliol, Christ Church, Magdalen, New College, St John's and Trinity. Among the university's famous buildings are the Bodleian Library
senses.zh: 牛津大学英国最古老的大学，位于英格兰的牛津镇。牛津的教学活动可追溯到1096年，从12世纪中叶起牛津大学开始迅速发展。这所大学享有崇高的学术声望。它由多个独立的学院组成，最古老的是大学学院（创建于1249年）。其他著名学院包括万灵学院、贝利奥尔学院、基督堂学院、莫德林学院、新学院、圣约翰学院和三一学院。牛津大学的著名建筑有博德利图书馆和谢尔登剧院。

examples.zh: 携伴来参加新年迪斯科舞会吧！

examples.zh: 男性/女性/同性伴侣

examples.en: He developed his own program in partnership with an American expert.
examples.zh: 他与一位美国专家合作开发出自己的程序。

senses.def: a relationship between two people, organizations, etc.; the state of having this relationship

examples.en: Marriage should be an equal partnership.
examples.zh: 婚姻应当是平等的伴侣关系。

examples.en: the school’s partnership with parents
examples.zh: 学校与家长的合作

examples.en: a partnership between the United States and Europe
examples.zh: 美国与欧洲的合作

senses.def: a business owned by two or more people who share the profits

examples.en: a junior member of the partnership
examples.zh: 企业的次要合伙人

senses.def: a brown bird with a round body and a short tail, that people hunt for sport or food; the meat of this bird
the act of giving birth
a social occasion, often in a person’s home, at which people eat, drink, talk, dance and enjoy themselves

examples.en: a dinner/tea/cocktail party
examples.zh: 晚宴；茶会；鸡尾酒会

examples.en: I was at a birthday party for my friend's five-year-old daughter.
examples.zh: 我参加了朋友女儿的五岁生日聚会。

examples.en: to have/throw/give a party
examples.zh: 开派对

examples.en: to hold/host a party
examples.zh: 举办/主办聚会

examples.en: Did you go to the party?
examples.zh: 你去参加聚会了吗？

examples.en: party games
examples.zh: 联欢会游戏

senses.def: a political organization that you can vote for in elections and whose members have the same aims and ideas

examples.en: Do you belong to a political party?
examples.zh: 你加入哪个政党了吗？

examples.en: the ruling/opposition party
examples.zh: 执政党；反对党

examples.en: the Democratic/Republican/Conservative/Labour Party
examples.zh: 民主党；共和党；保守党；工党

examples.en: The party is/are completely united on this issue.
examples.zh: 党在这个问题上是完全一致的。

examples.en: the party leader/conference
examples.zh: 党的领导人／会议

examples.en: a party member/activist/official
examples.zh: 党员；政党的活动家／官员

senses.def: a group of people who are doing something together such as travelling or visiting somewhere
senses.zh: （一起旅行或参观等的）群，队，组

examples.en: The school is taking a party of 40 children to France.
examples.zh: 学校将带领一个 40 人的儿童团队前往法国。

examples.en: The theatre gives a 10 per cent discount to parties of more than ten.
examples.zh: 剧场给十人以上的团体打九折。

examples.en: a rescue/wedding/hunting party
examples.zh: 救援/婚礼/狩猎派对

examples.en: A party of tourists was/were photographing the monument.
examples.zh: 一群游客正在给纪念碑拍照。

senses.def: one of the people or groups of people involved in a legal agreement or argument

examples.en: the guilty/innocent party
examples.zh: 有罪的／无罪的一方

examples.en: The contract can be terminated by either party with three months' notice.
examples.zh: 合同的任何一方如提前三个月通知，均可终止本合同。

examples.en: The judge’s decision satisfied most of the parties concerned.
examples.zh: 法官的判决令大多数当事人感到满意。

senses.def: to be involved in an agreement or action

examples.en: to be party to a decision
examples.zh: 参与作出决议

examples.en: He refused to be a party to any violence.
examples.zh: 他拒绝参与任何暴力活动。

senses.def: to contribute something useful to a discussion, project, etc.
senses.zh: 为（讨论、项目等）作出贡献

examples.en: What Hislop brought to the party was real commitment and energy.
examples.zh: 希斯洛普对党的贡献是他全身心的投入和十足的干劲。

senses.def: to enjoy yourself, especially by eating, drinking alcohol and dancing

examples.en: They were out partying every night.
examples.zh: 他们每晚都外出寻欢作乐。

examples.en: That guy Jake—he really knows how to party!
examples.zh: 杰克那个家伙——他真的知道如何参加派对！

senses.def: to be involved in an agreement or action

examples.en: to be party to a decision
examples.zh: 参与作出决议

examples.en: He refused to be a party to any violence.
examples.zh: 他拒绝参与任何暴力活动。

senses.def: to contribute something useful to a discussion, project, etc.
senses.zh: 为（讨论、项目等）作出贡献

examples.en: What Hislop brought to the party was real commitment and energy.
examples.zh: 希斯洛普对党的贡献是他全身心的投入和十足的干劲。

senses.def: a person who enjoys parties, being with a lot of other people and staying up late
senses.zh: 热衷聚会的人；社交动物

examples.en: I'm not really a party animal but I like quiet dinners with friends.
examples.zh: 我不怎么热衷于参加聚会，但挺喜欢和朋友一起安安静静地吃晚餐。

senses.def: a small gift given to children at a party
senses.zh: （送给孩子的）聚会小礼品，派对礼物

senses.def: a person who enjoys going to parties or who is a guest at a particular party
senses.zh: 爱参加聚会的人；聚会的客人

examples.en: Carly has always been an enthusiastic party-goer.
examples.zh: 卡莉一直是派对的狂热爱好者。

examples.en: He seemed shy among the other party-goers.
examples.zh: 在其他参加聚会的人中，他显得很害羞。

senses.def: the official opinions and policies of a political party, which members are expected to support
to say or do what somebody in authority tells you to say or do, even if you do not share the same opinions, etc.
senses.zh: 顺从当局（或集体）；遵循…路线

examples.en: One or two of them refused to toe the line.
examples.zh: 其中一两个人不遵守规矩。

examples.en: MPs rarely fail to toe the party line.
examples.zh: 议员们很少不遵循党的路线。

senses.def: to say or do what somebody in authority tells you to say or do, even if you do not share the same opinions, etc.
senses.zh: 顺从当局（或集体）；遵循…路线

examples.en: One or two of them refused to toe the line.
examples.zh: 其中一两个人不遵守规矩。

examples.en: MPs rarely fail to toe the party line.
examples.zh: 议员们很少不遵循党的路线。

senses.def: an election system in which people vote for a party, not a candidate, and successful candidates are chosen from a list, based on how many votes each party has received
senses.zh: 政党名单比例代表制（选民投票给政党，而非候选人…）

examples.en: Members of Parliament in the country are elected from party lists and do not represent constituencies.
examples.zh: 该国议员是从参选的各党派名单中选出，而不是代表各个选区。

senses.def: a thing that somebody often does to entertain people, especially at parties, for example singing a song

examples.en: He was always good for a song and his party piece was John Lennon's ‘Imagine’.
examples.zh: 他总是擅长唱歌，他的派对作品是约翰·列侬的《想象》。

senses.def: made by or relating to a political party

examples.en: Party political concerns should never take precedence over the good of the country as a whole.
examples.zh: 党的政治利益决不能凌驾于国家整体利益之上。

senses.def: a short broadcast on radio or television made by a political party to try to persuade people to vote for it, for example, in a general election
senses.zh: （大选期间的）政党宣传节目，党派政治广播

senses.def: political activity that involves getting support for a particular political party or attacking another party

examples.en: The President should stand above party politics.
examples.zh: 总统应当置身于政党政治之上。

examples.en: Many people think that party politics should not enter into local government.
examples.zh: 许多人都认为，地方政府内不应拉帮结派。

examples.en: Party politics is/are increasingly being defined by culture wars.
examples.zh: 政党政治越来越多地被文化战争所定义。

senses.def: a person who does not want to take part in a pleasant activity and stops other people from having fun
a college or university that has a reputation for attracting students who like to have parties and enjoy themselves rather than being serious about their studies
senses.zh: 派对大学（对热衷于派对甚于学习的学生有吸引力的大学）

examples.en: My cousin studied in Florida at some party school.
examples.zh: 我表弟在佛罗里达州某所派对大学就读。

senses.def: the sort of mood in which you can enjoy a party and have fun
senses.zh: 社交情结；爱社交的心情

examples.en: Why don’t you relax and get into the party spirit?
examples.zh: 为什么不放松一下，融入派对气氛呢？

senses.def: a wall that divides two buildings or rooms and belongs to both owners
a person from a low social or economic position who has suddenly become rich or powerful
a dance, often part of a ballet
the standard unit for measuring pressure
a language used for writing programs for computer systems
senses.zh: 帕斯卡语言；Pascal（计算机系统编程）语言

senses.def: relating to Easter
relating to the Jewish Passover
a long piece of cloth made of fine soft wool from a type of goat
the official language of Afghanistan, also spoken in northern Pakistan
senses.zh: 普什图语（阿富汗官方语言，也用于巴基斯坦北部地区）

senses.def: a lively dance containing steps based on a Latin American style of marching
senses.zh: 一种活泼的舞蹈，其中包含基于拉丁美洲行军风格的台阶

senses.def: to achieve the required standard in an exam, a test, etc.

examples.en: I'm not really expecting to pass first time.
examples.zh: 我真不指望第一次就能合格。

examples.en: She passed with flying colours (= very easily).
examples.zh: 她以高分通过。

examples.en: She hasn't passed her driving test yet.
examples.zh: 她还没有通过驾驶执照考试。

examples.en: pass an exam/examination
examples.zh: 通过考试/考试

senses.def: to test somebody and decide that they are good enough, according to an agreed standard

examples.en: The examiners passed all the candidates.
examples.zh: 主考人评定考生全部及格。

senses.def: to move past or to the other side of somebody/something

examples.en: Several people were passing but nobody offered to help.
examples.zh: 有几个人路过，却没有人主动伸出援手。

examples.en: I hailed a passing taxi.
examples.zh: 我招手叫了一辆路过的出租车。

examples.en: The security guard refused to let us pass.
examples.zh: 保安不让我们通过。

examples.en: to pass a barrier/sentry/checkpoint
examples.zh: 通过障碍／岗哨／检查站

examples.en: You'll pass a bank on the way to the train station.
examples.zh: 你在去火车站的路上会经过一家银行。

examples.en: She passed me in the street without even saying hello.
examples.zh: 她在街上与我擦肩而过，却连一声招呼也没打。

examples.en: Nobody has passed this way for hours.
examples.zh: 几个小时以来都没有人经过这条路。

examples.en: There was a truck behind that was trying to pass me.
examples.zh: 后面有一辆卡车想要超过我。

senses.def: to go or move in the direction mentioned
senses.zh: 沿某方向前进；向某方向移动

examples.en: The procession passed slowly along the street.
examples.zh: 队伍沿街缓缓行进。

examples.en: We passed through a security checkpoint.
examples.zh: 我们通过了一个安全检查站。

examples.en: A plane passed low overhead.
examples.zh: 一架飞机从头上低空飞过。

examples.en: The air cools as it passes along the pipe.
examples.zh: 空气通过管道时会冷却。

examples.en: After passing through tall gates, you follow a long curving drive.
examples.zh: 穿过高高的大门后，您将沿着一条长长的弯曲车道行驶。

examples.en: We passed through the Spanish Quarter on our way here.
examples.zh: 我们来这里的路上经过了西班牙区。

examples.en: Almost 7 million people pass through the museum's doors each year.
examples.zh: 每年有近 700 万人走进博物馆的大门。

examples.en: The number of people passing through British airports rose 3%.
examples.zh: 通过英国机场的人数增加了3%。

examples.en: The train passes through a desolate industrial landscape.
examples.zh: 火车穿过一片荒凉的工业区。

examples.en: As the water passes through, the membrane filters out most of the impurities.
examples.zh: 当水通过时，膜会过滤掉大部分杂质。

examples.en: As they passed under the bridge they heard a noise above them.
examples.zh: 当他们经过桥下时，他们听到上面有声音。

examples.en: As water passes over rocks, it dissolves many minerals.
examples.zh: 当水流过岩石时，它会溶解许多矿物质。

examples.en: They passed down winding streets.
examples.zh: 他们穿过蜿蜒的街道。

examples.en: A train was passing noisily over the bridge.
examples.zh: 一列火车从桥上驶过，声音喧闹。

examples.en: They became used to hearing warplanes pass overhead.
examples.zh: 他们已经习惯了听到战机从头顶飞过的声音。

senses.def: to make something move in the direction or into the position mentioned
senses.zh: 使沿（某方向）移动；使达到（某位置）

examples.en: He passed the rope around the post three times to secure it.
examples.zh: 他把绳索在柱子上绕了三匝缠紧。

examples.en: She passed her hand across her forehead.
examples.zh: 她用手抹了一下额头。

senses.def: to give something to somebody by putting it into their hands or in a place where they can easily reach it

examples.en: Pass the salt, please.
examples.zh: 请把盐递过来。

examples.en: Pass that book over.
examples.zh: 把那本书递过来。

examples.en: He passed a note to his friend.
examples.zh: 他把一张纸条递给他的朋友。

examples.en: Pass me the salt.
examples.zh: 请把盐递给我。

examples.en: Pass me over that book.
examples.zh: 递给我那本书。

senses.def: to give somebody information or a message

examples.en: His wife had been passing information to the police.
examples.zh: 他的妻子一直在向警方传递信息。

examples.en: They devised a method of passing secret messages.
examples.zh: 他们设计了一种传递秘密消息的方法。

senses.def: to kick, hit or throw the ball to a player of your own side

examples.en: She passed the ball to Kerr.
examples.zh: 她把球传给了科尔。

examples.en: Why do they keep passing back to the goalie?
examples.zh: 他们为什么老是把球回传给守门员？

examples.en: They should pass more.
examples.zh: 他们应该通过更多。

senses.def: when time passes

examples.en: Almost fifty years have passed since that day.
examples.zh: 从那天起，已经过去了将近五十年。

examples.en: Six months passed and we still had no news of them.
examples.zh: 半年过去了，我们仍然没有他们的音讯。

examples.en: The time passed quickly.
examples.zh: 时间过得飞快。

examples.en: We grew more anxious with every passing day.
examples.zh: 一天天过去，我们的焦虑与日俱增。

senses.def: to spend time, especially when you are bored or waiting for something

examples.en: We sang songs to pass the time.
examples.zh: 我们借唱歌消磨时间。

examples.en: How do you pass the long winter nights?
examples.zh: 你如何度过漫长的冬夜？

senses.def: to come to an end; to be over

examples.en: They waited for the storm to pass.
examples.zh: 他们等待暴风雨过去。

examples.en: It's just a phase which will eventually pass.
examples.zh: 这只是一个最终会过去的阶段。

examples.en: This is a record of an era long since passed (= that ended a long time ago).
examples.zh: 这是一个早已过去的时代的记录（=很久以前就结束了）。

senses.def: to change from one state or condition to another

examples.en: She had passed from childhood to early womanhood.
examples.zh: 她已由童年进入了少女期。

senses.def: to be given to another person after first belonging to somebody else, especially after the first person has died
senses.zh: 转移给，遗留给（继承人等）

examples.en: On his death, the title passed to his eldest son.
examples.zh: 他死后，封号传给长子。

senses.def: to become greater than a particular total

examples.en: Unemployment has now passed the three million mark.
examples.zh: 失业人数现已突破三百万大关。

senses.def: to accept a proposal, law, etc. by voting; to be accepted in this way
senses.zh: 表决通过（动议、法律等）；（动议、法律等）经表决通过

examples.en: to pass a bill/law/resolution
examples.zh: 通过一项法案／法律／决议

examples.en: The Kansas State House narrowly passed the legislation last year.
examples.zh: 去年堪萨斯州众议院勉强通过了这项立法。

examples.en: In 1996, Congress unanimously passed the Food Quality Protection Act.
examples.zh: 1996年，国会一致通过了《食品质量保护法》。

examples.en: The bill is expected to pass the Senate.
examples.zh: 该法案预计将在参议院获得通过。

examples.en: The bill passed by 360 votes to 280.
examples.zh: 这个法案以 360 票对 280 票获得通过。

senses.def: to be allowed

examples.en: I don't like it, but I'll let it pass (= will not object).
examples.zh: 我不喜欢，但我也不会反对。

examples.en: Her remarks passed without comment (= people ignored them).
examples.zh: 人们对她的言论未予理睬。

senses.def: to happen; to be said or done

examples.en: They'll never be friends again after all that has passed between them.
examples.zh: 经过了这么多事情，他们已经友谊难再了。

examples.en: His departure passed unnoticed.
examples.zh: 他神不知、鬼不觉地离开了。

senses.def: to say that you do not know the answer to a question, especially during a quiz
senses.zh: 不知道，过（尤在回答竞赛问题时所用）

examples.en: ‘What's the capital of Peru?’ ‘I'll have to pass on that one.’
examples.zh: “秘鲁的首都是哪里？”“过。”

examples.en: ‘Who wrote ‘Catch-22’?’ ‘Pass (= I don't know).’
examples.zh: “谁写了《第二十二条军规》？”“不知道。”

senses.def: to say that you do not want something that is offered to you

examples.en: Thanks. I'm going to pass on dessert, if you don't mind.
examples.zh: 谢谢，您若不介意，我就免了饭后甜点吧。

senses.def: to say or state something, especially officially

examples.en: The court waited in silence for the judge to pass sentence.
examples.zh: 全体出庭人员默默等待法官宣判。

examples.en: It's not for me to pass judgement on your behaviour.
examples.zh: 我无权评判你的行为。

examples.en: The man smiled at the girl and passed a friendly remark.
examples.zh: 男子对姑娘微微一笑，又说了句亲切的话。

senses.def: to go beyond the limits of what you can believe, understand, etc.

examples.en: It passes belief (= is impossible to believe) that she could do such a thing.
examples.zh: 很难相信她会做出这等事来。

senses.def: to refuse to play a card or make a bid
senses.group: in card games 纸牌游戏

senses.def: to send something out from the body as or with waste matter

examples.en: If you're passing blood you ought to see a doctor.
examples.zh: 如果便中带血，你就应该找大夫看看。

senses.group: from the body 排出体外

senses.def: to happen

examples.en: How did such a disaster come to pass?
examples.zh: 这样的灾难是怎样发生的？

examples.en: I wondered how it came to pass that a thinking man bore the prejudices of his unthinking parents.
examples.zh: 我想知道一个有思想的人如何忍受他无思想的父母的偏见。

senses.group: from the body 排出体外

senses.def: if words do not pass your lips
senses.group: from the body 排出体外

senses.def: if food or drink does not pass your lips
senses.group: from the body 排出体外

senses.def: to collect money from a number of people, for example to buy a present for somebody
senses.group: from the body 排出体外

senses.def: to be accepted as of a good enough standard
senses.group: from the body 排出体外

senses.def: to say hello to somebody and have a short conversation with them
senses.zh: （与某人）寒暄，打招呼，闲谈一会儿
senses.group: from the body 排出体外

senses.def: to urinate
senses.group: from the body 排出体外

senses.def: an official document or ticket that shows that you have the right to enter or leave a place, to travel on a bus or train, etc.

examples.en: a boarding pass (= for a plane)
examples.zh: 登机牌

examples.en: There is no admittance without a security pass.
examples.zh: 无保安通行证不得入内。

examples.en: We had backstage passes to the show.
examples.zh: 我们有演出的后台通行证。

senses.def: a successful result in an exam or test

examples.en: She got a pass in French.
examples.zh: 她法语考试及格了。

examples.en: 12 passes and 3 fails
examples.zh: 12 门及格，3 门不及格

examples.en: Two A-level passes are needed for this course.
examples.zh: 本课程要求有两个高级证书考试的及格成绩。

examples.en: The pass mark is 50 per cent.
examples.zh: 50 分及格。

examples.en: The school has a 90 per cent pass rate (= 90 per cent of students pass their exams).
examples.zh: 该校学生的及格率为 90%。

senses.def: (in some sports) an act of hitting or throwing the ball to another player in your team

examples.en: a long pass to Turner
examples.zh: 给特纳的一个长传

senses.def: a road or way over or through mountains

examples.en: a mountain pass
examples.zh: 山口

examples.en: They came over the top of the pass and started down towards the coast.
examples.zh: 他们翻过山口顶部，开始朝海岸走去。

senses.def: an act of going or moving past or over something

examples.en: The helicopter made several passes over the village before landing.
examples.zh: 直升机在村落上空盘旋数次才降落。

senses.def: a stage in a process, especially one that involves separating things from a larger group

examples.en: In the first pass all the addresses are loaded into the database.
examples.zh: 第一步，所有地址均输入数据库。

senses.def: a choice or suggestion that is rejected or dismissed
senses.zh: 被拒绝或驳回的选择或建议

examples.en: If you don't like spicy food, you may want to give that dish a pass.
examples.zh: 如果你不喜欢辛辣的食物，你可能不想吃这道菜。

examples.en: No, I don't think it'll work. I'll take a pass on that.
examples.zh: 不，我认为这不会起作用。我会接受这一点。

senses.group: something that is rejected 被拒绝的东西

senses.def: to reach a sad or difficult state
senses.zh: 陷于不妙的（或困难的）境地；落到这步田地

examples.en: I never thought things would come to such a pass as this.
examples.zh: 我没想到事情会发展到这样的地步。

examples.en: Things have come to a such a pass when we can’t afford to pay the heating bills!
examples.zh: 事情已经发展到这样的地步，我们已经付不起取暖费了！

senses.group: something that is rejected 被拒绝的东西

examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，青铜雕像已经呈现出坚硬的绿色铜绿。

examples.zh: 在那个社会，土地继承是父传子的。

examples.zh: 圣克利斯托弗，旅行主保

examples.zh: 对艺术的资助来自企业和个人。

senses.zh: （1932-63）美国乡村音乐歌手。她最受欢迎的歌曲是《我摔碎了》（1961）和《疯狂》（1961）。她在一次空难中丧生。电影《甜梦》（Sweet Dreams，1985）是她一生的故事。

senses.zh: （用于想要或即将有孩子时）小宝宝的脚步声

examples.zh: 变化中的城市生活模式

examples.zh: 成年人的行为模式往往受童年经历影响。

examples.zh: 模仿日本概念而设计的新方法

senses.def: meat, fish, etc. cut into very small pieces and formed into a small round flat shape
