senses.def: a first name for boys
a character in American legends
senses.zh: 保罗·本扬（Paul Bunyan）：美国传奇人物。据说他是一个非常大而又健壮的伐木工人（一个正在砍伐树木的人）。他有一只叫做贝贝的蓝牛。讲述了有关他的荒唐故事。英国海军用其中之一从他的婴儿床上用木头建造了七艘船。另一个人说，贝贝很大，以至于每次他需要鞋子时都必须开设一个新的铁矿。

senses.def: (1938-2016) a popular English television entertainer best known for his magic tricks on The Paul Daniels Magic Show
senses.zh: 保罗·丹尼尔斯（Paul Daniels）：（1938-2016）一位受欢迎的英国电视艺人，以在《保罗·丹尼尔斯魔术表演》中的魔术技巧和流行语而闻名，“您会喜欢-不多，但您会喜欢。”

senses.def: a traditional dance in which the dancers change partners repeatedly each time the music stops. It is sometimes used at parties as a way of introducing a lot of guests who do not know each other. It was named after John Paul Jones
senses.zh: 保罗·琼斯（Paul Jones）：一种传统舞蹈，每当音乐停止播放时，舞者就会反复更换伴侣。有时在聚会上使用它来介绍很多彼此不认识的客人。它以约翰·保罗·琼斯的名字命名。

senses.def: (1899-1946) an English painter who did many types of work, including theatre and book design, but who is remembered especially for the pictures he painted as an official war artist in both world wars
senses.zh: 保罗·纳什（Paul Nash）（1899-1946）是一位英国画家，做了很多类型的工作，包括剧院和书籍设计，但由于他在两次世界大战中作为正式的战争画家所画的照片而被人们铭记

senses.def: (1925-2008) a US actor who also produced and directed films. He is perhaps best remembered for his part in Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid
senses.zh: 保罗·纽曼（Paul Newman）：（ 1925-2008年）美国演员，还制作和导演电影。也许在他的《布奇·卡西迪》和《圣丹斯小子》（1969）中，他是最令人难忘的。他的其他电影包括《热铁皮屋顶上的猫》（1958年），《骗子》（1961年），《酷手卢克》（1967年），《刺痛》（1973年），《无人的傻瓜》（1994年）和《灭亡之路》（2002年）。1985年，他获得了特别的奥斯卡奖，并凭借《钱的颜色》（1986）获得了奥斯卡奖。纽曼与演员乔安妮·伍德沃德（Joanne Woodward）结婚，他经常与演员一起出演电影。他还是NASCAR赛车手，并拥有一家名为Newman's Own的食品公司，该公司的利润用于慈善事业。

保罗·里维尔（Paul Revere）：（1735-1818）美国革命的美国英雄。他因1775年4月19日从波士顿到列克星敦的夜晚骑马而向人们发出警告，警告人们英国武装部队已经登陆。朗费罗（Longfellow）的著名诗《保罗·里维尔（Paul Revere）的骑》（Ride）中对此进行了描述。里维尔（Revere）曾是参与波士顿茶党的人之一。他是设计和制作银制品的艺术家，他对波士顿大屠杀的插图有助于鼓励美国独立战争。

senses.def: a poem (1861) by Henry Wadsworth Longfellow
senses.zh: 保罗·里维尔（Paul Revere）的《骑术：亨利·沃兹沃思·朗费罗（Henry Wadsworth Longfellow）的一首诗（1861）。这是关于保罗·里维尔（Paul Revere）警告美国人英国士兵即将来临的旅程。这首诗使骑行成为美国历史上最著名的事件之一。

senses.def: (1898-1976) a US singer and actor famous for his rich, deep voice. He appeared in the London production of Show Boat
senses.zh: 保罗·罗伯逊（Paul Robeson）：（1898-1976）美国歌手和演员，以其丰富而深刻的声音而闻名。他参加了1928年在伦敦制作的《表演船》（Show Boat），并在其中演唱了奥尔曼河。他的其他成功作品包括纽约的皇帝琼斯（1925）和伦敦的奥赛罗（1930）和纽约的奥赛罗（1943）。因为他表达了支持共产主义的政治观点，并批评了美国政府对非裔美国人的待遇，所以他的护照被拿走了好几年。他后来在返回纽约之前居住在欧洲（1958-63年）。

senses.def: (1920-78) an English author. He served as a soldier in India during the Second World War
senses.zh: 保罗·斯科特：（1920-78）英国作家。在第二次世界大战期间，他曾在印度当过士兵，最著名的是拉吉四重奏，这是在英国统治印度的最后几年里在印度创作的四本小说系列。小说的电视版本以《皇冠上的珠宝》为名制作。斯科特（Scott）撰写的另一本关于印度的小说《保持生命》（Staying On）在1977年获得了布克奖。

senses.def: (1890-1967) a US musician, also known as the 'King of Jazz', who led bands and orchestras
senses.zh: 保罗·怀特曼（Paul Whiteman）：（1890-1967）美国音乐家，也被称为“爵士之王”，他带领乐队和乐队演奏“交响爵士乐”，将爵士乐和古典音乐混在一起。乔治·格什温（George Gershwin）为怀特曼（Whiteman）的乐团写了蓝调狂想曲（Rhapsody），他们是1924年首演的。该乐团1926年进行了欧洲巡回演出，并在伦敦的阿尔伯特音乐厅（Albert Hall）演出。

examples.en: The patient was perceived to have difficulty in breathing.
examples.zh: 发现病人呼吸困难。

senses.def: the number, amount or rate of something, expressed as if it is part of a total that is 100; a part or share of a whole

examples.en: What percentage of the population is/are overweight?
examples.zh: 体重超重的人占人口多大的百分比？

examples.en: A high percentage of the female staff are part-time workers.
examples.zh: 女职员中，兼职工作的人占很高的比例。

examples.en: a large/small/low percentage
examples.zh: 大／小／低的比例

examples.en: The figure is expressed as a percentage.
examples.zh: 数字是用百分率表示的。

examples.en: The results were analysed in percentage terms.
examples.zh: 结果是按百分比分析的。

examples.en: Interest rates are expected to rise by one percentage point (= a unit of one per cent).
examples.zh: 利率预计提高一个百分点。

senses.def: a share of the profits of something

examples.en: He gets a percentage for every car sold.
examples.zh: 他每售出一辆车便可得到一份提成。

examples.en: The artist's agent receives commission on a percentage basis.
examples.zh: 艺术家的经纪人按照一定百分比收取佣金。

senses.def: one of the 100 equal groups that a larger group of people can be divided into, according to their place on a scale measuring a particular value

examples.en: Overall these students rank in the 21st percentile on the tests—that is, they did worse than 79 per cent of all children taking the test.
examples.zh: 这些考生的总体百分位排名占第 21 位。就是说，79% 的应试儿童比他们考得好。

senses.def: great enough for you to notice it

examples.en: a perceptible change/increase/decline/impact
examples.zh: 可以察觉的变化／增长／下降／影响

examples.en: The price increase has had no perceptible effect on sales.
examples.zh: 这次提价没有对销售产生明显的影响。

examples.en: Her foreign accent was barely perceptible.
examples.zh: 她的外国口音几乎听不出来。

examples.en: The difference is scarcely perceptible to the average reader.
examples.zh: 这种差别一般读者几乎是察觉不到的。

examples.en: a clearly perceptible decline in public confidence
examples.zh: 可清楚感觉到的公众信心的下降

senses.def: that you can notice or feel with your senses

examples.en: the perceptible world
examples.zh: 可感知的世界

senses.def: in a way that is great enough for you to notice; in a way that you can notice or feel with your senses

examples.en: Income per head rose perceptibly.
examples.zh: 人均收入明显增长。

examples.en: His voice softened perceptibly.
examples.zh: 他的声音明显软化了。

examples.en: It was perceptibly colder.
examples.zh: 天气明显感觉更冷了。

senses.def: an idea, a belief or an image you have as a result of how you see or understand something

examples.en: a campaign to change public perception of the police
examples.zh: 改变警察公众形象的运动

examples.en: There is a general public perception that standards in schools are falling.
examples.zh: 公众普遍认为，学校的水平都在下降。

senses.def: the way you notice things, especially with the senses

examples.en: Everyone's perception of reality is slightly different.
examples.zh: 每个人对现实的感受都稍有不同。

examples.en: visual perception
examples.zh: 视觉

senses.def: the ability to understand the true nature of something

examples.en: She showed great perception in her assessment of the family situation.
examples.zh: 她对家庭状况的分析显示出敏锐的洞察力。

examples.en: They have little perception of how ordinary people live their lives.
examples.zh: 他们对普通人的生活方式知之甚少。

senses.def: having or showing the ability to see or understand things quickly, especially things that are not obvious
senses.zh: 理解力强的；有洞察力的；思维敏捷的

examples.en: a highly perceptive comment
examples.zh: 见地高明的评论

examples.en: It was very perceptive of you to notice that.
examples.zh: 你能注意到此事，真够敏锐的。

examples.en: The article gives a perceptive analysis of the way bureaucracies work.
examples.zh: 这篇文章深入分析了官僚体制的运行方式。

senses.def: connected with seeing, hearing and understanding

examples.en: our innate perceptive abilities
examples.zh: 我们天生的五官感觉能力

senses.def: in a way that shows the ability to see or understand things quickly, especially things that are not obvious
senses.zh: 理解力强的；有洞察力的；思维敏捷的

examples.en: Wyndham wrote perceptively about English society.
examples.zh: 温德姆对英国社会的描写颇具洞察力。

senses.def: the ability to see or understand things quickly, especially things that are not obvious
senses.zh: 理解力强的；有洞察力的；思维敏捷的

senses.def: an artificial network which is intended to copy the brain’s ability to recognize things and see the differences between things
senses.zh: 感知机（模拟大脑识别事物和差异的人工网络）

senses.def: relating to the ability to perceive

examples.en: perceptual skills
examples.zh: 知觉技能

senses.def: to land and stay on a branch, etc.

examples.en: A robin was perching on the fence.
examples.zh: 一只知更鸟落在篱笆上。

senses.def: to sit or to make somebody sit on something, especially on the edge of it

examples.en: We perched on a couple of high stools at the bar.
examples.zh: 我们坐在酒吧的几张高脚凳上。

examples.en: She perched herself on the edge of the bed.
examples.zh: 她坐在床沿上。

examples.en: My father used to perch me on the front of his bike.
examples.zh: 我父亲常常把我放在他自行车的前面。

senses.def: to be placed on the top or the edge of something

examples.en: The hotel perched precariously on a steep hillside.
examples.zh: 旅店立在陡峭的山坡上状似摇摇欲坠。

examples.en: The castle is perched high above the valley.
examples.zh: 城堡高高地矗立在山谷之上。

senses.def: a place where a bird rests, especially a branch or bar for this purpose, for example in a bird’s cage
a high seat or position

examples.en: He watched the game from his precarious perch on top of the wall.
examples.zh: 他无视安全，高坐在墙头上观看比赛。

senses.def: a freshwater
to make somebody lose their position as somebody/something successful or admired

synonyms.words: sit down ▪ be seated ▪ take a seat ▪ perch

intro.en: These words all mean to rest your weight on your bottom with your back straight, for example on a chair.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含坐下之义。

items.def: to rest your weight on your bottom with your back straight, for example on a chair:
items.zh: 指坐

examples.en: May I sit here?
examples.zh: 我可以坐在这儿吗？

items.def: to move from a standing position to a sitting position:
items.zh: 指坐下、就座

examples.en: Please sit down.
examples.zh: 请坐。

items.def: (formal) to be sitting:
items.zh: 指坐着

examples.en: She was seated at the head of the table.
examples.zh: 她坐在桌子的上座。

items.def: to sit down Take a seat is used especially as a polite way of inviting somebody to sit down:
items.zh: take a seat 尤作请人就座的礼貌用语

items.def: (rather informal) to sit on something, especially on the edge of something:
items.zh: 指坐在…上，尤指坐在…边沿

examples.en: She perched herself on the edge of the bed.
examples.zh: 她坐在床沿上。

senses.def: perhaps
having or showing the ability to understand things, especially things that are not obvious
senses.zh: 敏锐的；理解透彻的；明察秋毫的

examples.en: percipient comments
examples.zh: 深透的评语

examples.en: She was a percipient interpreter of the public mood.
examples.zh: 她是公众情绪的敏锐诠释者。

senses.def: to move gradually through a surface that has very small holes or spaces in it

examples.en: Water had percolated down through the rocks.
examples.zh: 水从岩缝间渗漏下去。

examples.en: Nitrates may take 20 years to percolate through to the underground streams.
examples.zh: 硝酸盐可能需要 20 年才能渗透到地下溪流中。

senses.def: to gradually become known or spread through a group or society

examples.en: It had percolated through to us that something interesting was about to happen.
examples.zh: 我们听到传言说，将要发生一件有趣的事。

examples.en: Changes percolate through gradually.
examples.zh: 变化逐渐渗透。

senses.def: to make coffee in a percolator
senses.zh: （用渗滤式咖啡壶）滤煮；滤煮咖啡

senses.def: the process of a liquid, gas, etc. moving gradually through a surface that has very small holes or spaces in it

examples.en: The tiles seal off the soil and prevent water percolation.
examples.zh: 瓷砖密封土壤并防止水渗透。

senses.def: the process of becoming known or spread through a group or society

examples.en: Eco-tourism will help percolation of money to the local level and help the community.
examples.zh: 生态旅游将有助于资金渗透到当地并帮助社区。

senses.def: the process of making coffee in a percolator
senses.zh: （咖啡）（在渗滤式咖啡壶中）滤煮

senses.def: a pot for making coffee, in which boiling water is forced up a central tube and then comes down again through the coffee
musical instruments that you play by hitting them with your hand or with a stick, for example drums

examples.en: percussion instruments
examples.zh: 打击乐器

examples.en: The track features Joey Langton on percussion.
examples.zh: 唱片的这段乐曲的打击乐部分是由乔伊·兰顿演奏的。

senses.def: the players of percussion
a drill
senses.zh: 风动冲击凿岩机，冲击式钻机

senses.def: a person who plays percussion
connected with sounds made by hitting things, especially percussion
senses.zh: 打击声的；（尤指）打击乐器声的

examples.en: percussive effects
examples.zh: 打击效果

senses.def: made or done through the skin

examples.en: a percutaneous injection
examples.zh: 皮下注射

senses.def: (1792-1822) one of the major poets of the English Romantic
senses.zh: 珀西·比希·雪莱（1792–1822）英国浪漫主义运动的主要诗人之一。以诗风优美著称。是无神论者和无政府主义者，对自由的热爱和左翼政治观点体现在《解放了的普罗米修斯》（1820）等诗作中。曾两次与年轻女子私奔，在生命的最后几年与第二任妻子玛丽住在意大利，死于一次海上事故。他最著名的诗有《西风颂》和《致云雀》。

senses.def: (1882-1961) an Australian composer
senses.zh: 珀西·格兰杰（Percy Grainger）：（1882-1961）澳大利亚作曲家兼钢琴家，一生大部分时间都在英国和美国生活。他以收集和整理英国民间音乐而闻名。

senses.def: punishment that lasts forever after death
a journey, especially a long slow one
a grey and white bird of prey
in a way that allows no discussion or possibility of refusing
senses.zh: 专横地；霸道地；不容商量地

examples.en: She peremptorily rejected the request.
examples.zh: 她断然拒绝了请求。

examples.en: He insisted peremptorily on speaking to Rachel.
examples.zh: 他硬要跟雷切尔说话。

senses.def: expecting to be obeyed immediately and without questioning or refusing
senses.zh: 强硬的；强制的；不容分辩的

examples.en: a peremptory summons
examples.zh: 强制性传票

examples.en: The email was peremptory in tone.
examples.zh: 这封电子邮件的语气很霸道。

examples.en: with a peremptory wave of his hand
examples.zh: 他霸道地一挥手

senses.def: continuing for a very long time; happening again and again
senses.zh: 长久的；持续的；反复出现的

examples.en: the perennial problem of water shortage
examples.zh: 缺水这个老问题

examples.en: that perennial favourite, hamburgers
examples.zh: 汉堡包，永远受人喜爱的食品

examples.en: Colonialism in different forms is a perennial theme of history.
examples.zh: 不同形式的殖民主义是历史永恒的主题。

senses.def: living for two years or more
any plant that lives for more than two years

examples.en: a hardy perennial
examples.zh: 耐寒的多年生植物

senses.def: in a way that continues for a very long time; in a way that happens again and again
senses.zh: 长久的；持续的；反复出现的

examples.en: a perennially popular subject
examples.zh: 长年热门的主题

senses.def: the reform
senses.zh: 改革，重建（20 世纪 80 年代的经济、政治体制改革政策）

senses.def: having everything that is necessary; complete and without faults or weaknesses

examples.en: in perfect condition
examples.zh: 状况极佳

examples.en: He smiled, revealing a perfect set of teeth.
examples.zh: 他笑了，露出一副完美的牙齿。

examples.en: Well I'm sorry—but nobody's perfect (= used when somebody has criticized you).
examples.zh: 呃，对不起。不过，人无完人嘛。

examples.en: In a perfect world, everybody would have everything they needed.
examples.zh: 在一个完美的世界里，每个人都应有尽有。

examples.en: What's your idea of the perfect partner?
examples.zh: 你心目中的完美伴侣是什么样的？

senses.def: completely correct; exact and accurate
senses.zh: 完全正确的；准确的；地道的

examples.en: She speaks perfect English.
examples.zh: 她讲一口地道的英语。

examples.en: a perfect fit/match
examples.zh: 完美的匹配

examples.en: What perfect timing!
examples.zh: 时机掌握得恰到好处！

senses.def: the best of its kind

examples.en: a perfect example of the painter’s early style
examples.zh: 这位画家早期风格的典范

examples.en: the perfect crime (= one in which the criminal is never discovered)
examples.zh: 一桩无头案

senses.def: excellent; very good

examples.en: The weather was perfect.
examples.zh: 天气好极了。

examples.en: I have this dress that would just look perfect on you!
examples.zh: 我有这件衣服，很适合你！

senses.def: exactly right for somebody/something

examples.en: Hawaii is the perfect place for a honeymoon.
examples.zh: 夏威夷是度蜜月的最佳去处。

examples.en: She's the perfect candidate for the job.
examples.zh: 她是这项工作的最佳人选。

examples.en: You and Jeff are perfect for each other.
examples.zh: 你和杰夫是绝配。

examples.en: ‘Will 2.30 be OK for you?’ ‘Perfect, thanks.’
examples.zh: “2:30 对你合适吗？”“正合适，谢谢。”

senses.def: total; complete

examples.en: I don't know him—he's a perfect stranger.
examples.zh: 我不认识他，他是百分之百的陌生人。

examples.en: I have a perfect right to ask you—and you have the right not to answer.
examples.zh: 我完全有权询问你，但你有权不回答。

senses.def: connected with the form of a verb that consists of part of the verb have

examples.en: ‘I have eaten’ is the present perfect tense of the verb ‘to eat’, ‘I had eaten’ is the past perfect and ‘I will have eaten’ is the future perfect.
examples.zh: I have eaten 是动词 eat 的现在完成时；I had eaten 是过去完成时；I will have eaten 是将来完成时。

senses.def: used to say that something is what you would like to happen or what should happen, but you know it cannot

examples.en: In an ideal world we would be recycling and reusing everything.
examples.zh: 我们要是能回收并再利用所有的东西就再理想不过了。

to make something perfect or as good as you can

examples.en: As a musician, she has spent years perfecting her technique.
examples.zh: 身为音乐家，她多年来不断在技艺上精益求精。

examples.en: They have perfected the art of winemaking.
examples.zh: 他们完善了酿酒艺术。

senses.def: the form of a verb that expresses actions completed by the present or a particular point in the past or future, formed in English with part of the verb have
used to say that something is what you would like to happen or what should happen, but you know it cannot

examples.zh: 我们要是能回收并再利用所有的东西就再理想不过了。

intro.en: These words all describe something that is extremely good.
intro.zh: 以上各词均形容某事物极好。

items.def: extremely good.
items.zh: 出色的；非凡的；非常棒的

items.def: extremely good. Outstanding is used especially about how well somebody does something or how good somebody is at something:
items.zh: outstanding 尤指在做某事上或某方面杰出

items.def: so good that it could not be better. Perfect is used especially about conditions or how suitable something is for a purpose:
items.zh: perfect 尤指条件状况极好或很合适

items.def: (informal) extremely good or impressive:
items.zh: 指极佳的、卓越的、出色的

examples.en: The facilities at the hotel are superb.
examples.zh: 旅馆的设施棒极了。

senses.def: a way of making a book in which the pages are stuck together with glue
the ability to identify or sing a musical note correctly without the help of an instrument
senses.zh: 绝对音高，绝对音感（指不须借助乐器准确识别或唱出音符的能力）

examples.en: Having perfect pitch means that I can hear a note and tell you that it's a G, or a B flat or whatever.
examples.zh: 拥有完美的音高意味着我可以听到一个音符并告诉你这是一个 G 音，或者是降 B 音或其他什么。

senses.def: an occasion when several bad things happen at the same time, creating a situation that could not be worse
senses.zh: 祸不单行；屋漏偏逢连夜雨

examples.en: The company blamed a perfect storm of bad trading conditions for a 90 per cent fall in profits.
examples.zh: 该公司将利润下降 90% 归咎于糟糕的交易条件。

examples.en: The company was hit by a perfect storm of negative conditions that converged on it.
examples.zh: 该公司遭受了一系列不利因素互相叠加的严重打击。

senses.def: the state of being perfect

examples.en: physical perfection
examples.zh: 体格健全

examples.en: The novel achieves a perfection of form that is quite new.
examples.zh: 小说的形式新颖完美。

examples.en: His performance was perfection (= something perfect).
examples.zh: 他的表演真是炉火纯青。

examples.en: The fish was cooked to perfection.
examples.zh: 这鱼烹得恰到好处。

senses.def: the act of making something perfect by doing the final improvements

examples.en: They have been working on the perfection of the new model.
examples.zh: 他们一直在努力完善新型号。

examples.en: a sequence of developmental stages towards the perfection of his violin technique
examples.zh: 他的小提琴技艺走向完美的连续发展阶段

senses.def: advice that is good but that is difficult or impossible to follow
senses.zh: 听上去完美却难以实行的建议

senses.def: advice that is good but that is difficult or impossible to follow
senses.zh: 听上去完美却难以实行的建议

senses.def: the fact of liking to do things perfectly and not being satisfied with anything less

examples.en: Her perfectionism is evident at work and at home.
examples.zh: 她的完美主义在工作和家庭中都很明显。

senses.def: a person who likes to do things perfectly and is not satisfied with anything less

examples.en: He was a perfectionist in his art and could be difficult to work for.
examples.zh: 他在艺术上是一个完美主义者，很难为他工作。

examples.en: perfectionist standards
examples.zh: 完美主义标准

examples.en: To reach that level of playing you have to be an absolute perfectionist.
examples.zh: 为了达到这样的演奏水平，你必须是一个绝对的完美主义者。

senses.def: completely

examples.en: It's perfectly normal to feel like this.
examples.zh: 有这样的感觉是完全正常的。

examples.en: It's perfectly good as it is (= it doesn't need changing).
examples.zh: 现在这样已经非常好了。

examples.en: I thought he'd be upset, but he seems perfectly fine.
examples.zh: 我以为他会不高兴，但他看起来很好。

examples.en: You know perfectly well what I mean.
examples.zh: 我的意思你是一清二楚的。

examples.en: To be perfectly honest, I didn't want to go anyway.
examples.zh: 说真心话，反正我不想去。

examples.en: He stood perfectly still until the danger had passed.
examples.zh: 他一动不动地站在那里，直到危险解除。

examples.en: ‘Do you understand?’ ‘Perfectly.’
examples.zh: “你明白吗？”“完全明白。”

examples.en: How perfectly awful!
examples.zh: 简直是一塌糊涂！

examples.en: They’re perfectly within their rights to ask to see the report.
examples.zh: 他们完全有权利要求查看报告。

examples.en: He is perfectly suited to the role.
examples.zh: 他非常适合这个角色。

examples.en: Sparkling wine is a perfectly acceptable alternative to champagne.
examples.zh: 起泡酒是香槟的完美替代品。

senses.def: in a perfect way

examples.en: The TV works perfectly now.
examples.zh: 这台电视机现在状况好极了。

examples.en: This dress fits perfectly.
examples.zh: 这件连衣裙非常合身。

senses.def: that cannot be trusted
senses.zh: 不可信任的；背叛的；不忠的

senses.def: unfair treatment of somebody who trusts you

examples.en: In Act 2 he learns of Giovanni’s perfidy and swears revenge.
examples.zh: 在第二幕中，他得知乔瓦尼的背信弃义，并发誓要报仇。

examples.zh: 爆炸震破了他的耳膜。

examples.en: a perforated line (= a row of small holes in paper, made so that a part can be torn off easily)
examples.zh: 齿孔线

examples.zh: 沿齿孔把邮票撕开。

examples.zh: 他在管子的内壁上开了一个小孔。

senses.def: the process of splitting or tearing in such a way that a hole is left

examples.zh: 过大的压力会导致胃壁穿孔。

senses.def: because it is necessary or cannot be avoided

examples.en: They had perforce to abandon the attempt on the summit.
examples.zh: 他们不得不放弃登顶尝试。

senses.def: to entertain an audience by playing a piece of music, acting in a play, etc.

examples.en: to perform a song/dance/play

to die, especially in a sudden violent way

examples.en: A family of four perished in the fire.
examples.zh: 一家四口死于此次火灾之中。

examples.en: Thousands perished at the hands of the invading forces.
examples.zh: 数千人惨死在侵略军手里。

senses.def: to be lost or destroyed

examples.en: Early buildings were made of wood and have perished.
examples.zh: 早期建筑物为木质结构，已经消失殆尽。

senses.def: if a material such as rubber perishes
used to say that you find a suggestion unacceptable or that you hope that something will never happen
senses.zh: （用于拒绝一项建议或希望某事永不发生）没门儿，甭想了，下辈子吧

examples.en: Me get married? Perish the thought!
examples.zh: 我结婚？下辈子再说吧！

senses.def: used to say that you find a suggestion unacceptable or that you hope that something will never happen
senses.zh: （用于拒绝一项建议或希望某事永不发生）没门儿，甭想了，下辈子吧

examples.en: Me get married? Perish the thought!
examples.zh: 我结婚？下辈子再说吧！

senses.def: used to say that you find a suggestion unacceptable or that you hope that something will never happen
senses.zh: （用于拒绝一项建议或希望某事永不发生）没门儿，甭想了，下辈子吧

examples.en: Me get married? Perish the thought!
examples.zh: 我结婚？下辈子再说吧！

senses.def: likely to decay

examples.en: perishable goods/foods
examples.zh: 易腐烂变质的商品／食物

examples.en: Many fresh foods are highly perishable.
examples.zh: 许多新鲜食物都极易腐败。

senses.def: types of food that decay
a child, especially one who behaves badly
senses.zh: 小孩；（尤指）淘气包，讨厌鬼

senses.def: the wave-like movements of the intestine
the membrane
a serious condition in which the inside wall of the body becomes swollen
a small plant that grows along the ground
a small shellfish
to tell a lie in court after you have sworn to tell the truth
a person who tells a lie in court after they have sworn to tell the truth
the crime of telling a lie in court after you have sworn to tell the truth

examples.en: to commit perjury
examples.zh: 犯伪证罪

examples.en: The defence witnesses were found guilty of perjury.
examples.zh: 辩方证人被判犯有伪证罪。

senses.def: something you receive as well as your wages for doing a particular job
senses.zh: （工资之外的）补贴，津贴，额外待遇

examples.en: Perks offered by the firm include a car and free health insurance.
examples.zh: 公司给予的额外待遇包括一辆汽车和免费健康保险。

examples.en: Not having to get up early is just one of the perks of being retired.
examples.zh: 不必早起只是退休生活的好处之一。

senses.def: to become or to make somebody become more cheerful or lively, especially after they have been ill or sad

examples.en: He soon perked up when his friends arrived.
examples.zh: 朋友一来他就精神起来了。

examples.en: A cup of coffee will perk you up.
examples.zh: 一杯咖啡会让你精神焕发。

senses.def: to increase, or to make something increase in value, etc.

examples.en: Share prices had perked up slightly by close of trading.
examples.zh: 收盘时股价略有上扬。

senses.def: to make something more interesting, more attractive, etc.

examples.en: ideas for perking up bland food
examples.zh: 给无味的食品增添味道的主意

examples.en: Stencilling is a cheap and easy way to perk up old furniture.
examples.zh: 模板印刷是使旧家具焕然一新的一种廉价且简单的方法。

senses.def: (c. 1474-99) a man who claimed that he should be made the king of England because he was really Richard, Duke of York, brother of Edward V
senses.zh: 珀金·沃贝克（Perkin Warbeck）：（约1474-99年）一个声称自己应被任命为英格兰国王的人，因为他确实是理查德，约克公爵，爱德华五世的兄弟和塔中两位王子中的较小者。约克宫和法国国王当时支持他反对国王亨利七世。他曾多次尝试发动叛乱，反对亨利七世，但在1497年，他被捕，然后被关押在伦敦塔一段时间，随后被处决。

senses.def: the quality of being cheerful and full of energy
senses.zh: 高兴的；快活的；精力充沛的

senses.def: cheerful and full of energy
senses.zh: 高兴的；快活的；精力充沛的

examples.en: She hasn’t been her usual perky self lately.
examples.zh: 她最近一反常态。

senses.def: an act of speaking or writing which has an action as its aim, but which does not itself perform that action, for example persuading or convincing
senses.zh: 以言成事，言后行为（指言语的目的是达成行为，但本身并不执行这个动作，如劝导或说服）

senses.def: connected with an act of speaking or writing which has an action as its aim, but which does not itself perform that action, for example persuading or convincing
senses.zh: 言外的：与以某项行动为目标但实际上并不执行该行动的讲话或写作行为有关的，例如说服或说服

senses.def: a way of changing the style of your hair by using chemicals to create curls

examples.en: to have a perm
examples.zh: 烫鬈发

examples.en: I’m thinking of having a perm.
examples.zh: 我正在考虑烫发。

examples.en: You’ll just have to let the perm grow out if you don’t like it.
examples.zh: 如果你不喜欢烫发，就只能让烫发自然生长。

senses.def: to give somebody’s hair a perm

examples.en: to have your hair permed
examples.zh: 烫鬈发

examples.en: a shampoo for permed hair
examples.zh: 适用于烫过的头发的洗发液

senses.def: an approach to life and growing food that copies the way things happen in nature in order to create ways for people to live without damaging the environment
senses.zh: 可持续农业，永续农业（模仿自然生态来耕种和建造生活设施，以减少对环境的破坏）

examples.en: The garden utilizes organic and permaculture gardening principles.
examples.zh: 该花园采用有机和永续农业园艺原理。

examples.en: I'm interested in permaculture and implementing sustainable design.
examples.zh: 我对永续农业和实施可持续设计感兴趣。

senses.def: a layer of soil that is permanently frozen, in very cold regions of the world
senses.zh: （寒带）永久冻土，永冻土，多年冻土

senses.def: a hyperlink
senses.zh: 永久链接，固定链接（固定指向同一电子文件）

examples.en: On my homepage you can click on the permalink to any of my blog posts.
examples.zh: 在我的主页，你可以点击永久链接连到我的任何一篇博文。

senses.def: the state of lasting for a long time or for all time in the future

examples.en: The spoken word is immediate but lacks permanence.
examples.zh: 口头之言便捷，但不持久。

examples.en: We no longer talk of the permanence of marriage.
examples.zh: 我们不再说婚姻要天长地久了。

examples.en: lacking a sense of permanence in his life
examples.zh: 生活缺乏永恒感

senses.def: lasting for a long time or for all time in the future; existing all the time

examples.en: She was unable to find a permanent job.
examples.zh: 她找不到固定工作。

examples.en: Holiday camps employ only a very small number of permanent staff.
examples.zh: 度假营只雇用极少数的长期工作人员。

examples.en: They are now living together on a permanent basis.
examples.zh: 他们现在是长期同住。

examples.en: The accident has not done any permanent damage.
examples.zh: 那场事故没有造成什么永久性损伤。

examples.en: a permanent fixture (= a person or an object that is always in a particular place)
examples.zh: 固定于某处的人／东西

examples.en: a permanent resident of the United States
examples.zh: 美国永久居民

examples.en: She doesn't intend to make London her permanent home.
examples.zh: 她并不打算把伦敦作为她永久的家。

examples.en: The gallery hosts various exhibitions and a permanent collection.
examples.zh: 画廊举办各种展览和永久收藏。

examples.en: We decided to make the arrangement permanent.
examples.zh: 我们决定保持这一安排长久不变。

senses.def: a perm
a person who has been given the right to live and work in a country for as long as they want (but is not a citizen with the right to vote, etc.)

examples.en: A worker on a temporary visa is not eligible for the benefits accessible to permanent residents.
examples.zh: 持有临时签证的工人没有资格享受永久居民可享受的福利。

senses.def: an official card that shows that somebody from another country is allowed to live and work in Canada
a senior officer in the British civil service
a perm
in a way that lasts for a long time or for all time in the future; in a way that exists all the time

examples.en: The stroke left his right side permanently damaged.
examples.zh: 中风使他的右半身永久受损。

examples.en: She had decided to settle permanently in France.
examples.zh: 她已经决定永久定居法国。

examples.en: This door is kept permanently locked.
examples.zh: 这扇门永久锁着。

senses.def: the brown skin colour that a person with pale skin gets from being in the sun, when they have this skin colour all year
senses.zh: 持久古铜色（指晒黑后终年不退的肤色）

examples.en: You should avoid the blonde hair and permatan look.
examples.zh: 你应该避免金发和永久的外观。

examples.en: You don’t want to look like a politician with a permatan.
examples.zh: 你不想看起来像一个拥有永久权利的政客。

senses.def: the quality of allowing a liquid or gas to pass through

examples.en: an increase/decrease/change in permeability
examples.zh: 渗透性的增加/减少/变化

examples.en: The force at the cell surface may change the permeability of the cell membrane.
examples.zh: 细胞表面的力可能会改变细胞膜的渗透性。

senses.def: allowing a liquid or gas to pass through

examples.en: permeable rocks
examples.zh: 渗透性岩石

examples.en: gas-permeable contact lenses
examples.zh: 透气隐形眼镜

examples.en: The skin of amphibians is permeable to water.
examples.zh: 两栖动物的皮肤是透水的。

senses.def: to spread to every part of an object or a place

examples.en: The smell of leather permeated the room.
examples.zh: 屋子里弥漫着皮革的气味。

examples.en: The air was permeated with the odour of burning rubber.
examples.zh: 空气中弥漫着橡胶燃烧的气味。

examples.en: rainwater permeating through the ground
examples.zh: 渗入地下的雨水

senses.def: to affect every part of something

examples.en: a belief that permeates all levels of society
examples.zh: 深入社会各阶层的看法

examples.en: A feeling of unease permeates the novel.
examples.zh: 小说中弥漫着一种不安的感觉。

examples.en: Dissatisfaction among the managers soon permeated down to members of the workforce.
examples.zh: 管理人员的不满情绪很快传染给了全体职工。

senses.def: the process of a liquid, gas, etc. spreading to every part of an object or a place

examples.en: The product's solvent, ethanol, may enhance its permeation through the skin.
examples.zh: 该产品的溶剂乙醇可以增强其对皮肤的渗透性。

senses.def: the fact of affecting every part of something

examples.en: the growing permeation of online social networks in our everyday life
examples.zh: 在线社交网络日益渗透到我们的日常生活中

senses.def: acceptable according to the law or a particular set of rules

examples.en: permissible levels of nitrates in water
examples.zh: 水中硝酸盐含量的容许度

examples.en: It is not permissible for employers to discriminate on grounds of age.
examples.zh: 资方不得以年龄为由歧视职工。

senses.def: the act of allowing somebody to do something, especially when this is done by somebody in a position of authority

examples.en: You must ask permission for all major expenditure.
examples.zh: 一切重大开支均须报请批准。

examples.en: After much persuasion, permission was granted to speak to the refugees at the camp.
examples.zh: 经过反复劝说，终于获准与难民营的难民交谈。

examples.en: The school has been refused permission to expand.
examples.zh: 学校扩充未得到许可。

examples.en: All minors must seek parental permission to marry.
examples.zh: 所有未成年人结婚都必须获得父母的许可。

examples.en: No official permission has been given for the event to take place.
examples.zh: 这项活动尚未得到正式批准，不能举行。

examples.en: You shouldn't rent out your property without seeking permission from your mortgage lender.
examples.zh: 未经抵押贷款人许可，您不应出租您的财产。

examples.en: He had to get permission from his parents to audition for the show.
examples.zh: 他参加试镜前得先获得父母的许可。

examples.en: She took the car without permission.
examples.zh: 她未经许可擅自使用了汽车。

examples.en: With your permission, I'd like to say a few words.
examples.zh: 如蒙允许，我想讲几句话。

examples.en: poems reprinted by kind permission of the author
examples.zh: 经作者惠允后重印的诗歌

senses.def: an official written statement allowing somebody to do something

examples.en: The publisher is responsible for obtaining the necessary permissions to reproduce illustrations.
examples.zh: 出版者负责取得准许复制插图的必要许可文件。

examples.en: The report recommends that all planning permissions for quarrying in national parks should expire in ten years.
examples.zh: 报告建议，国家公园内的所有采石规划许可应在十年内到期。

senses.def: allowing or showing a freedom of behaviour that many people do not approve of, especially in sexual matters
senses.zh: 放任的；纵容的；姑息的；（尤指两性关系）放纵的

examples.en: permissive attitudes
examples.zh: 纵容的态度

examples.en: permissive parents (= who allow their children a lot of freedom)
examples.zh: 放任的父母

senses.def: the fact of allowing or showing a freedom of behaviour that many people do not approve of, especially in sexual matters
senses.zh: 放任的；纵容的；姑息的；（尤指两性关系）放纵的

examples.en: the growth of permissiveness
examples.zh: 宽容的增长

senses.def: to allow somebody to do something or to allow something to happen

examples.en: Mobile phones are not permitted in the examination room.
examples.zh: 手机不允许带入考场。

examples.en: We were not permitted any contact with each other.
examples.zh: 我们被禁止互相联系。

examples.en: Visitors are not permitted to take photographs.
examples.zh: 参观者请勿拍照。

examples.en: The owners have been unwilling to permit the use of their land.
examples.zh: 业主一直不愿意允许他人使用他们的土地。

examples.en: There are fines for exceeding permitted levels of noise pollution.
examples.zh: 噪音超标会处以罚款。

examples.en: Jim permitted himself a wry smile.
examples.zh: 吉姆勉强苦笑了一下。

examples.en: The bill was designed to permit new fathers to take time off work.
examples.zh: 该法案旨在允许新生儿的父亲休假。

examples.en: She would not permit herself to look at them.
examples.zh: 她避免看他们。

examples.en: Permit me to offer you some advice.
examples.zh: 请允许我向你提些建议。

senses.def: to make something possible

examples.en: We hope to visit the cathedral, if time permits.
examples.zh: 如果时间允许，我们希望能参观一下主教座堂。

examples.en: I'll come tomorrow, weather permitting (= if the weather is fine).
examples.zh: 天气好的话，我明天过来。

examples.en: The password permits access to all files on the hard disk.
examples.zh: 这个密码可调出硬盘上的所有文档。

examples.en: The length of the report does not permit a detailed discussion of the problems.
examples.zh: 报告的篇幅不允许对问题进行详细讨论。

examples.en: Cash machines permit you to withdraw money at any time.
examples.zh: 取款机可让你随时取款。

senses.def: an official document that gives somebody the right to do something, especially for a limited period of time
senses.zh: 许可证，特许证（尤指限期的）

examples.en: a parking/building permit
examples.zh: 停车／建筑许可证

examples.en: to apply for a permit
examples.zh: 申请许可证

examples.en: The agency issued permits for exploratory drilling.
examples.zh: 该机构签发了勘探钻井许可证。

examples.en: The company failed to obtain the necessary permits for the landfill project.
examples.zh: 该公司未能获得垃圾填埋场项目所需的许可证。

examples.en: You cannot enter the military base without a permit.
examples.zh: 未经许可不得进入军事基地。

senses.def: any of the different ways in which a set of things can be ordered
senses.zh: 排列（方式）；组合（方式）；置换

examples.en: The possible permutations of x, y and z are xyz, xzy, yxz, yzx, zxy and zyx.
examples.zh: x、y 和 z 的可能的组合方式为 xyz、xzy、yxz、yzx、zxy 和 zyx。

senses.def: having a very harmful effect on somebody/something, especially in a way that is not easily noticed
senses.zh: 有害的，恶性的（尤指不易觉察地）

examples.en: the pernicious influence of TV violence on children
examples.zh: 电视暴力对儿童的有害影响

examples.en: Ageism is equally as offensive and pernicious as sexism.
examples.zh: 年龄歧视与性别歧视一样具有攻击性和危害性。

senses.def: worrying too much about details that are not important; showing this
the final part of a speech in which the speaker gives a summary of the main points
a long speech that is not very interesting
a clear liquid used to kill bacteria and to bleach
senses.zh: 过氧化物；过氧化氢；双氧水

examples.en: a woman with peroxide blonde hair
examples.zh: 漂染金发的女子

senses.def: a perpetrator

examples.en: The perp stole a police car and got away.
examples.zh: 那个罪犯偷了一辆警车逃跑了。

senses.def: the act of walking into or out of a police station, courthouse
senses.zh: 罪犯示众（警方押解被拘捕者出入警察局、法庭等处，以便媒体公示）

senses.def: forming an angle of 90° with another line or surface; vertical

examples.en: Are the lines perpendicular to each other?
examples.zh: 这些直线相互垂直吗？

examples.en: The staircase was almost perpendicular (= very steep).
examples.zh: 楼梯几乎成垂直的了。

senses.def: connected with a style of architecture common in England in the 14th and 15th centuries
senses.zh: 垂直式的（英格兰 14、15 世纪盛行的建筑风格）

senses.def: a line, position or direction that is exactly perpendicular

examples.en: The wall is a little out of the perpendicular.
examples.zh: 墙壁有点倾斜。

senses.def: to commit a crime or do something wrong or evil

examples.en: to perpetrate a crime/fraud/massacre
examples.zh: 犯罪；行骗；进行屠杀

examples.en: security breaches perpetrated by people working for the company
examples.zh: 公司工作人员犯下的安全漏洞

examples.en: violence perpetrated against women and children
examples.zh: 针对妇女和儿童的暴力行为

senses.def: the act of committing a crime or doing something wrong or evil
a person who commits a crime or does something that is wrong or evil

examples.en: the perpetrators of the crime
examples.zh: 该项罪行的犯案者

examples.en: We will do everything in our power to bring the perpetrators to justice.
examples.zh: 我们将竭尽全力将肇事者绳之以法。

senses.def: continuing for a long period of time without stopping or being interrupted
senses.zh: 不间断的；持续的；长久的

examples.en: the perpetual noise of traffic
examples.zh: 持续不断的交通噪声

examples.en: We lived for years in a perpetual state of fear.
examples.zh: 多年来我们一直生活在恐惧中。

examples.en: mountain peaks covered with perpetual snows and ice
examples.zh: 山峰终年被冰雪覆盖

senses.def: frequently repeated, in a way that is annoying
senses.zh: 一再反复的；无尽无休的；没完没了的

examples.en: How can I work with these perpetual interruptions?
examples.zh: 打扰不断，让我怎么工作？

senses.def: lasting for the whole of somebody’s life

examples.en: He was elected perpetual president.
examples.zh: 他被选为终身会长。

examples.en: She's a perpetual student.
examples.zh: 她是个终身学习者。

examples.en: The harshest punishment was perpetual exile.
examples.zh: 最严厉的惩罚是永久流放。

senses.def: a state in which something moves continuously without stopping, or appears to do so

examples.en: We're all in a state of perpetual motion in this office (= we're always moving around or changing things).
examples.zh: 我们这个办公室里大家总在忙得团团转。

examples.en: Scientists have never discovered the secret of perpetual motion.
examples.zh: 科学家们从未发现永动机的秘密。

examples.en: His travel schedule keeps him in perpetual motion.
examples.zh: 他的旅行计划使他不停地到处奔波。

senses.def: in a way that continues for a long time without stopping
senses.zh: 永久地：以持续很长时间而不连续停止

examples.en: a perpetually changing environment
examples.zh: 不断变化的环境

senses.def: repeatedly, in a way that is annoying
senses.zh: 一再反复的；无尽无休的；没完没了的

examples.en: a writer who is perpetually ignored by critics
examples.zh: 一个永远被评论家忽视的作家

senses.def: in a way that lasts forever
senses.zh: 永久地：永久地永久地成为

examples.en: Water provides cost-free energy for generating electricity that is perpetually renewable.
examples.zh: 水为发电提供了免费的能源，并且是永久可再生的。

senses.def: to make something such as a bad situation, a belief, etc. continue for a long time
senses.zh: 使永久化；使持久化；使持续

examples.en: to perpetuate injustice
examples.zh: 持续造成不公正

examples.en: Comics tend to perpetuate the myth that ‘boys don't cry’.
examples.zh: 连环画往往在延续着“男儿有泪不轻弹”的神话。

examples.en: This system perpetuated itself for several centuries.
examples.zh: 这一制度维持了几个世纪。

senses.def: the act of making something such as a bad situation, a belief, etc. continue for a long time
senses.zh: 使诸如坏境，信念等之类的事情持续很长时间的行为

examples.en: the perpetuation of classic stereotypes of women
examples.zh: 对妇女的经典陈规定型观念的延续

senses.def: for all time in the future

examples.en: They do not own the land in perpetuity.
examples.zh: 他们并不永久拥有这片土地。

examples.en: The trust fund will ensure preservation of the site in perpetuity.
examples.zh: 该信托基金将确保该遗址的永久保存。

senses.def: if something perplexes

examples.en: They were perplexed by her response.
examples.zh: 她的答复令他们困惑不解。

senses.def: in a confused and anxious way because you are unable to understand something
the state of feeling confused and worried because you do not understand something

examples.en: His comments have been the source of much perplexity and debate.

senses.def: a small CD or cassette
senses.zh: 随身听（带耳机的小型音乐播放机，可播放 CD 或磁带）

senses.def: a person who is paid by somebody to help them exercise, especially by deciding what types of exercise are best for them
the various aspects of a person’s character that combine to make them different from other people

examples.en: His wife has a strong personality.
examples.zh: 他妻子的个性很强。

examples.en: My outgoing personality has definitely helped me succeed.
examples.zh: 我外向的性格无疑帮助我取得了成功。

examples.en: He maintained order by sheer force of personality.
examples.zh: 他凭借强大的人格力量维护秩序。

examples.en: normal human personality traits (= qualities), such as shyness
examples.zh: 正常的人格特征，如害羞

examples.en: Participants identified their own personality type and explored the implications.
examples.zh: 参与者辨认出各自的性格类型，并探讨其影响。

examples.en: The characters' names reflect their personalities.
examples.zh: 人物的名字反映了他们的个性。

examples.en: There are likely to be tensions and personality clashes in any social group.
examples.zh: 任何社会团体都很可能出现关系紧张和性格冲突。

examples.en: People’s clothes are often an expression of their personality.
examples.zh: 人们的衣着往往是其个性的体现。

senses.def: the qualities of a person’s character that make them interesting and attractive

examples.en: We need someone with lots of personality to head the project.
examples.zh: 我们需要一位富有魅力的人来主持这个项目。

senses.def: a famous person, especially one who works in entertainment or sport
senses.zh: 名人，风云人物（尤指娱乐界或体育界的）

examples.en: a well-known TV/radio/sports personality
examples.zh: 电视／广播／体育明星

examples.en: Various personalities from the world of music were invited.
examples.zh: 邀请了音乐界的许多名流。

senses.def: a person whose strong character attracts attention
senses.zh: 性格鲜明的人；个性突出的人

examples.en: Their son is a real personality.
examples.zh: 他们的儿子真是有个性。

senses.def: the qualities of a place or thing that make it interesting and different

examples.en: The problem with many modern buildings is that they lack personality.
examples.zh: 许多现代建筑物的问题在于缺乏特色。

examples.en: Interesting displays can add personality to your store window.
examples.zh: 有趣的展品可以为商店的橱窗增添个性。

senses.def: a situation in which people are encouraged to show extreme enthusiasm and love for a famous person, especially a political leader
senses.zh: （尤指对政治领袖的）个人迷信，个人崇拜

examples.en: An extraordinary personality cult had been created around the leader.
examples.zh: 在这位领导人的周围兴起了一场异乎寻常的个人崇拜。

examples.en: the personality cult of the president
examples.zh: 对总统的个人崇拜

senses.def: a condition in which somebody thinks, feels and behaves very differently from most other people in a way that causes them to have serious difficulties in their life and in their relationships with other people
senses.zh: 人格障碍，性格障碍（有严重异常人格特质，以致难以与人正常交往或影响社会功能）

senses.def: to mark something in some way to show that it belongs to a particular person

examples.en: All the towels were personalized with their initials.
examples.zh: 所有毛巾上都标有物主姓名的首字母。

examples.en: This program enables messages to be personalized automatically.
examples.zh: 该程序可以自动对消息进行个性化处理。

senses.def: to design or change something so that it is suitable for the needs of a particular person

examples.en: All our courses are personalized to the needs of the individual.
examples.zh: 我们的全部课程都是针对个人需要设计的。

senses.def: to refer to particular people when discussing a general subject

examples.en: The mass media tends to personalize politics.
examples.zh: 大众传媒往往把政治个人化。

senses.def: used to show that you are giving your own opinion about something
senses.zh: 就本人而言；就个人意见

examples.en: Personally, I prefer the second option.
examples.zh: 就我个人而言，我倾向第二种选择。

examples.en: ‘Is it worth the effort?’ ‘Speaking personally, yes.’
examples.zh: “值得为它费功夫吗？”“就本人而言，值得。”

examples.en: I personally think it would be the wrong thing to do.
examples.zh: 我个人认为这样做是错误的。

senses.def: by a particular person rather than by somebody acting for them

examples.en: All emails will be answered personally.
examples.zh: 所有电邮都将由本人亲自回复。

examples.en: Do you know him personally (= have you met him, rather than just knowing about him from other people)?
examples.zh: 你认识他本人吗？

examples.en: I’ll deal with the matter personally.
examples.zh: 我会亲自处理这件事。

examples.en: He’s no longer personally involved in the day-to-day running of the company.
examples.zh: 他个人不再参与公司的日常运营。

examples.en: He did not benefit personally from the fraud.
examples.zh: 他个人并没有从欺诈中获益。

examples.en: I have never personally witnessed public violence.
examples.zh: 我从未亲眼目睹过公共暴力。

senses.def: in a way that is connected with one particular person rather than a group of people

examples.en: He was personally criticized by inspectors for his incompetence.
examples.zh: 他因不称职而受到检查员的个别批评。

examples.en: You will be held personally responsible for any loss or breakage.
examples.zh: 如有丢失或损坏，将由你个人负责。

senses.def: in a way that is intended to be offensive

examples.en: I'm sure she didn't mean it personally.
examples.zh: 我相信她绝无冒犯之意。

senses.def: in a way that is connected with somebody’s personal life rather than with their job or official position

examples.en: Have you had any dealings with any of the suspects, either personally or professionally?
examples.zh: 你是否与任何嫌疑人有过私人或业务来往？

senses.def: to be offended by something
senses.zh: 认为某事针对自己而不悦

examples.en: I'm afraid he took your remarks personally.
examples.zh: 恐怕你的话激怒了他。

examples.en: Please don’t take this personally, but would you mind leaving us alone for a few moments?
examples.zh: 请不要认为这是针对你个人的，但是你介意让我们单独呆一会儿吗？

senses.def: to be offended by something
senses.zh: 认为某事针对自己而不悦

examples.en: I'm afraid he took your remarks personally.
examples.zh: 恐怕你的话激怒了他。

examples.en: Please don’t take this personally, but would you mind leaving us alone for a few moments?
examples.zh: 请不要认为这是针对你个人的，但是你介意让我们单独呆一会儿吗？

senses.def: the personal column
senses.zh: 人物：报纸或杂志上的个人专栏；网站上个人广告的空间

examples.en: Her quest for a companion led her to place an ad in the personals.
examples.zh: 她对伴侣的追求促使她在交友中投放了一则广告。

senses.def: a person who has a lot of a particular quality or characteristic
senses.zh: 体现某品质或特点的人；化身；典型

examples.en: She was the personification of elegance.
examples.zh: 她是典雅的化身。

senses.def: the practice of representing objects, qualities, etc. as humans, in art and literature; an object, quality, etc. that is represented in this way
senses.zh: 拟人；人格化；拟人化的东西（或品质等）

examples.en: the personification of autumn in Keats’s poem
examples.zh: 济慈诗歌中对秋天的拟人化处理

senses.def: to be an example of a quality or characteristic, or to have a lot of it

examples.en: These children personify all that is wrong with the education system.
examples.zh: 这些儿童充分体现了教育制度的缺陷。

examples.en: He is kindness personified.
examples.zh: 他是仁慈的化身。

senses.def: to show or think of an object, quality, etc. as a person

examples.en: The river was personified as a goddess.
examples.zh: 这条河被人格化为一位女神。

senses.def: the people who work for an organization or one of the armed forces
senses.zh: （组织或军队中的）全体人员，职员

examples.en: There is a severe shortage of skilled personnel.
examples.zh: 熟练员工严重短缺。

examples.en: sales/technical/medical/security/military, etc. personnel
examples.zh: 推销、技术、医务、保安、军事等人员

senses.def: the department in a company that deals with employing and training people

examples.en: the personnel department/manager
examples.zh: 人事部门／经理

examples.en: She works in personnel.
examples.zh: 她在人事部工作。

examples.en: Personnel is/are currently reviewing pay scales.
examples.zh: 人事部现在正审核工资级别。

senses.def: a military vehicle for carrying soldiers
a particular attitude towards something; a way of thinking about something

examples.en: a global perspective
examples.zh: 全球的视角

examples.en: A historical perspective may help us understand the issue.
examples.zh: 历史的视角也许能帮助我们理解这个问题。

examples.en: Recent events seem less serious when put into an international perspective.
examples.zh: 从国际角度来看，最近发生的事件似乎不那么严重。

examples.en: The aim is to offer a fresh perspective.
examples.zh: 目的是提供一个新的视角。

examples.en: Try to see the issue from a different perspective.
examples.zh: 试以不同的角度看待这件事。

examples.en: a report that looks at the education system from the perspective of deaf people
examples.zh: 从聋人的角度看待教育制度的报告

examples.en: The exhibition provides us with a unique perspective on her work.
examples.zh: 这次展览为我们提供了一个欣赏她作品的独特视角。

senses.def: the ability to think about problems and decisions in a reasonable way without making them seem worse or more important than they really are
senses.zh: 客观判断力；权衡轻重的能力

examples.en: She was aware that she was losing all sense of perspective.
examples.zh: 她意识到自己正在失掉一切正确判断的能力。

examples.en: Try to keep these issues in perspective.
examples.zh: 要尽量恰当地处理这些问题。

examples.en: Talking to others can often help to put your own problems into perspective.
examples.zh: 跟别人谈谈往往有助于正确处理自己的问题。

examples.en: It is important not to let things get out of perspective.
examples.zh: 重要的是不要把事情轻重倒置。

senses.def: the art of creating an effect of depth and distance in a picture by representing people and things that are far away as being smaller than those that are nearer the front

examples.en: The artist plays with perspective to confuse the eye.
examples.zh: 艺术家利用透视来迷惑眼睛。

examples.en: We learnt how to draw buildings in perspective.
examples.zh: 我们学习如何用透视法画建筑物。

examples.en: The tree on the left is out of perspective.
examples.zh: 左侧的树不成比例。

senses.def: a view, especially one in which you can see far into the distance

examples.en: a perspective of the whole valley
examples.zh: 山谷全景

senses.def: a strong clear plastic material that is often used instead of glass
able to understand somebody/something quickly and accurately; showing this
senses.zh: 敏锐的；有洞察力的；精辟的

examples.en: a perspicacious remark
examples.zh: 入木三分的评论

examples.en: He was perspicacious enough to realize that things were soon going to change.
examples.zh: 他很敏锐，意识到事情很快就会发生变化。

senses.def: the ability to understand somebody/something very quickly and accurately
senses.zh: 敏锐的；有洞察力的；精辟的

senses.def: drops of liquid that form on your skin when you are hot

examples.en: Beads of perspiration stood out on his forehead.
examples.zh: 他的前额上挂着汗珠。

examples.en: Her skin was damp with perspiration.
examples.zh: 她的皮肤上汗津津的。

senses.def: the act of perspiring

examples.en: Perspiration cools the skin in hot weather.
examples.zh: 热天出汗可使皮肤降温。

senses.def: to produce sweat

examples.en: The game of squash left me perspiring profusely.
examples.zh: 壁球比赛让我大汗淋漓。

examples.en: He mopped his perspiring face with a handkerchief.
examples.zh: 他用手帕擦了擦满是汗的脸。

examples.en: She was perspiring a little with the heat.
examples.zh: 她热得微微出了点儿汗。

senses.def: easy to persuade
senses.zh: 可以说服的;容易说服的

examples.en: Contacting the most persuadable voters is critical for any political campaign.
examples.zh: 联系最有说服力的选民对于任何政治竞选活动都至关重要。

senses.def: to make somebody do something by giving them good reasons for doing it

examples.en: Try to persuade him to come.
examples.zh: 尽量劝他来。

examples.en: Please try and persuade her.
examples.zh: 请尽力说服她。

examples.en: She's always easily persuaded.
examples.zh: 她向来禁不住劝。

examples.en: I'm sure he'll come with a bit of persuading.
examples.zh: 我相信，劝一劝他就会来的。

examples.en: I didn't want to go, but my friends persuaded me into it.
examples.zh: 我本来不想去，但朋友劝我去了。

examples.en: I allowed myself to be persuaded into entering the competition.
examples.zh: 我禁不住人家的劝说，就参加了比赛。

examples.en: There was no way to persuade him out of it (= persuade him not to do it).
examples.zh: 没有办法说服他不那么做。

examples.en: My sister persuaded me out of dying my hair.
examples.zh: 我姐姐劝我不要染头发。

senses.def: to make somebody believe that something is true

examples.en: It will be difficult to persuade them that there's no other choice.
examples.zh: 很难让他们相信别无选择。

examples.en: She had persuaded herself that life was not worth living.
examples.zh: 她自认为人生没有价值。

examples.en: No one was persuaded by his arguments.
examples.zh: 没人相信他的论点。

examples.en: I am still not fully persuaded of the plan's merits.
examples.zh: 我还不能完全信服这个计划的优点。

senses.def: a person or thing that is able to make people believe that something is true or a good idea
senses.zh: 说服者：能够使人们相信某事是真实的或好主意的人或事

examples.en: His deep understanding of the issues made him a powerful persuader.
examples.zh: 他对问题的深刻理解使他成为一个强有力的说服者。

examples.en: Lucrative contracts are always a powerful persuader.
examples.zh: 利润丰厚的合同总是具有强大的说服力。

senses.def: the act of persuading somebody to do something or to believe something

examples.en: It didn't take much persuasion to get her to tell us where he was.
examples.zh: 我们没费什么口舌就让她说出了他的下落。

examples.en: After a little gentle persuasion, he agreed to come.
examples.zh: 耐心劝说一下，他同意来了。

examples.en: She has great powers of persuasion.
examples.zh: 她的游说能力极强。

examples.en: I wasn’t intending to sell, but I’m open to persuasion.
examples.zh: 我本来不想卖，但我愿意接受说服。

senses.def: a particular set of beliefs, especially about religion or politics

examples.en: Politicians of all persuasions condemned the attacks.
examples.zh: 各种派系的政治家都谴责了这次袭击。

examples.en: every shade of religious persuasion
examples.zh: 形形色色的宗教信仰

senses.def: of the type mentioned

examples.en: peers of the Liberal persuasion
examples.zh: 自由党贵族

senses.def: a romantic novel (1818) by Jane Austen
senses.zh: 说服力：简·奥斯丁的浪漫小说（1818年），是她最后写的书。主角是安妮·艾略特（Anne Elliot），她拒绝弗雷德里克·温特沃斯（Frederick Wentworth）的求婚，但对此感到后悔，并在几年后再次问她时接受了。

senses.def: of the type mentioned

examples.en: peers of the Liberal persuasion
examples.zh: 自由党贵族

senses.def: able to persuade somebody to do or believe something
senses.zh: 有说服力的；令人信服的

examples.en: There are several persuasive arguments in favour of the move.
examples.zh: 有几个有说服力的论据支持此举。

examples.en: He can be very persuasive.
examples.zh: 他有时很会说服人。

examples.en: the persuasive power of advertising
examples.zh: 广告的说服力

senses.def: in a way that can persuade somebody to do or believe something
senses.zh: 有说服力的；令人信服的

examples.en: They argue persuasively in favour of a total ban on handguns.
examples.zh: 他们主张全面禁用手枪，理据令人信服。

senses.def: the ability to persuade somebody to do or believe something
senses.zh: 有说服力的；令人信服的

examples.en: the persuasiveness of this argument
examples.zh: 这个论点的说服力

senses.def: showing a lack of respect, often in a humorous way

examples.en: a pert reply
examples.zh: 无礼的答复

senses.def: small and with an attractive shape

examples.en: a pert nose
examples.zh: 小巧笔挺的鼻子

examples.en: pert features
examples.zh: 俊俏的面庞

senses.def: to exist or to apply in a particular situation or at a particular time

examples.en: Living conditions are vastly different from those pertaining in their country of origin.
examples.zh: 生活条件与他们的出生国大不相同。

examples.en: Those laws no longer pertain.
examples.zh: 那些法律已不适用了。

senses.def: to be connected with something/somebody

examples.en: the laws pertaining to adoption
examples.zh: 有关收养的法律

senses.def: a light material used for making clothes and equipment for camping, climbing, etc.
senses.zh: 一种轻质材料，用于制作用于露营，攀登等的衣服和设备。

senses.def: a town in eastern Scotland, on the river Tay
senses.zh: 珀斯（苏格兰东部城镇，在泰河河口的顶端，是珀斯-金罗斯区的行政中心，1210年到1452年曾是苏格兰的首府）

senses.def: the capital of the state of Western Australia, on the Indian Ocean
senses.zh: 珀斯（西澳大利亚州首府，临印度洋；由英国人建于1829年，1890年在该地区发现黄金以及在1897年开放弗里曼特尔港后，该城市迅速发展）

senses.def: determined to achieve a particular aim despite difficulties or opposition
senses.zh: 坚定不移的；坚决的；义无反顾的

senses.def: the quality of being determined to achieve a particular aim despite difficulties or opposition
senses.zh: 坚定不移的；坚决的；义无反顾的

examples.en: With his usual pertinacity, he pursued this new line of enquiry.
examples.zh: 他以一贯的执着追求了这一新的探究方向。

senses.def: the quality of being appropriate to a particular situation
appropriate to a particular situation

examples.en: a pertinent question/fact
examples.zh: 有关的问题／事实

examples.en: Please keep your comments pertinent to the topic under discussion.
examples.zh: 请勿发表与讨论主题无关的言论。

senses.def: in a way that is appropriate to a particular situation

examples.en: The report examines the causes of rising unemployment, and, more pertinently, offers some solutions.
examples.zh: 该报告探讨了失业率上升的原因，并更有针对性地提供了一些解决方案。

senses.def: in a way that shows a lack of respect, often in a humorous way
senses.zh: 认真地：表现出缺乏尊重，通常以幽默的方式

examples.en: ‘I know!’ she said pertly and hung up.
examples.zh: “我知道！”她毫不客气地说，然后挂断了电话。

senses.def: in a way that is small and attractive
senses.zh: 聪明地：以一种小巧而迷人的方式

examples.en: the frank, grey eyes and the little nose, turning pertly outward
examples.zh: 坦率的灰色眼睛和小鼻子，乖巧地向外转动

senses.def: to make somebody worried or anxious

examples.en: Her sudden appearance did not seem to perturb him in the least.
examples.zh: 她的突然出现似乎一点也没有令他不安。

examples.en: I was perturbed by his lack of interest.
examples.zh: 我对他缺乏兴趣感到不安。

senses.def: the state of feeling anxious about something
a small change in the quality, behaviour or movement of something

examples.en: temperature perturbations
examples.zh: 温度的些微变化

senses.def: whooping cough
a country in South America
the act of reading something, especially in a careful way

examples.en: The agreement was signed after careful perusal.
examples.zh: 协议是仔细阅读后才签署的。

senses.def: to read something, especially in a careful way

examples.en: A copy of the report is available for you to peruse at your leisure.
examples.zh: 此报告有副本，供你闲暇时细读。

senses.def: (a person) from Peru
senses.zh: 秘鲁人；秘鲁的；秘鲁人的

senses.def: a pervert
senses.zh: 性行为反常者，性变态者

senses.def: a look at somebody/something that shows sexual interest in them or it, in an unpleasant way
senses.zh: 色眯眯的一瞥；淫欲的目光

senses.def: to look at or behave towards somebody/something showing sexual interest, in a way that is considered unpleasant or not acceptable

examples.en: It's sick the way they perv over women.
examples.zh: 他们对女人的性变态真是恶心。

examples.en: An adult should not be perving on a teenager's social media posts.
examples.zh: 成年人不应该沉迷于青少年的社交媒体帖子。

senses.def: to spread through and be easy to notice in every part of something

examples.en: a pervading mood of fear
examples.zh: 普遍的恐惧情绪

examples.en: the sadness that pervades most of her novels
examples.zh: 充斥她大部分小说的悲怆情绪

examples.en: The entire house was pervaded by a sour smell.
examples.zh: 整栋房子都充满了酸味。

senses.def: existing in all parts of a place or thing; spreading gradually to affect all parts of a place or thing
senses.zh: 遍布的；充斥各处的；弥漫的

examples.en: a pervasive smell of damp
examples.zh: 四处弥漫的潮湿味儿

examples.en: Her influence is all-pervasive (= it affects everyone and everything).
examples.zh: 她的影响力是无处不在的（=它影响到每个人、每件事）。

examples.en: A sense of social change is pervasive in her novels.
examples.zh: 她的小说里充满社会变化的意识。

examples.en: the increasingly pervasive subculture in modern society
examples.zh: 在现代社会中日益普及的亚文化

senses.def: in a way that exists in all parts of a place or thing; in a way that spreads gradually to affect all parts of a place or thing
senses.zh: 遍布的；充斥各处的；弥漫的

senses.def: the fact of existing in all parts of a place or thing; the process of spreading gradually to affect all parts of a place or thing
senses.zh: 遍布的；充斥各处的；弥漫的

examples.en: The pervasiveness of gun violence in their neighbourhood inspired them to film the documentary.
examples.zh: 他们社区中普遍存在的枪支暴力激发了他们拍摄这部纪录片的灵感。

senses.def: showing a deliberate and determined desire to behave in a way that most people think is wrong, unacceptable or unreasonable
senses.zh: 执拗的；任性的；不通情理的

examples.en: a perverse decision (= one that most people do not expect and think is wrong)
examples.zh: 悖谬的决定

examples.en: She finds a perverse pleasure in upsetting her parents.

senses.def: (1937-95) an English comedy actor and writer who first became famous in the stage show Beyond the Fringe
senses.zh: 彼得·库克（Peter Cook）：（1937-95）英国喜剧演员和作家，他在1960年代的舞台表演《边缘边缘》中首次成名。他与达德利·摩尔（Dudley Moore）饰演达德（Dud）和皮特（Pete）的表演最令人难忘，他们两个人认为自己是哲学上的，但胡说八道。他帮助创办了《私眼》杂志，直到去世，他一直是该杂志的主要所有者之一。他的漫画作品《悲惨的故事：我是唯一的孪生兄弟》于2002年出版。

senses.def: (1930-2017) an English theatre, opera
senses.zh: 彼得·霍尔（Peter Hall）：（ 1930-2017年）英国戏剧，歌剧和电影导演。他曾经营皇家莎士比亚剧团（1960-68）和国家剧院（1973-88），还参与了格林德伯恩的歌剧演出。1977年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1938-2005) the main person presenting the news on ABC World News Tonight
senses.zh: 彼得·詹宁斯（Peter Jennings）：（ 1938-2005年）是20多年来在美国电视台的ABC世界新闻今晚播报的主要人物。詹宁斯（Jennings）出生于加拿大，他26岁时就开始在美国广播公司（ABC）工作，他是美国播出电视新闻的最年轻的人。

senses.def: a department store

senses.def: (1934-2016) an English composer
senses.zh: 彼得·麦克斯韦·戴维斯（Peter Maxwell Davies）：( 1934-2016年）现代古典音乐的英国作曲家，主要以室内乐和歌剧闻名，其中包括《灯塔》（The Lighthouse）（1979年）。1987年，他被任命为骑士。

examples.zh: 那场运动因缺乏支持者而最终不了了之。

examples.zh: 大道延伸到一条泥土小径。

examples.zh: 谈话变得紧张并最终逐渐消失。

senses.def: a children's play by J M Barrie
senses.zh: 彼得·潘（Peter Pan）：JM Barrie的儿童戏剧。彼得·潘（Peter Pan）是一个男孩，住在一个叫做“永不降落”的神奇地方，从不长大。一天晚上，他拜访了伦敦的三个孩子，并带他们去了Never Never Land。他们与彼得，一个叫小叮当的童话，一群海盗和一条鳄鱼一起进行了一系列冒险。这是一个非常受欢迎的戏剧，传统上每年圣诞节在伦敦演出。1953年，这部电影被成功拍成迪士尼电影。

senses.def: a person who looks unusually young for their age, or who behaves in a way that would be more appropriate for somebody younger

senses.def: a character in several of Beatrix Potter's
senses.zh: 彼得·兔子（Peter Rabbit）：比阿特丽克斯·波特（Beatrix Potter）的多个儿童故事中的角色，包括她的第一本《彼得·兔子的故事》。他是一只经常遇到麻烦的小兔子。

senses.def: (1919-62) a British landlord
senses.zh: 彼得·拉赫曼（Peter Rachman）：（1919-62）英国房东，他因在1950年代对伦敦的租户的严厉对待而闻名，收取高额租金，有时用暴力威胁人们。恶劣对待房客有时被称为拉赫曼主义。

senses.def: (1909-89) an English artist and writer, the son of Captain Scott
senses.zh: 彼得·斯科特（Peter Scott）：（1909-89）英国画家，作家，斯科特上尉的儿子。1946年，他在斯利姆布里奇（Slimbridge）创立了野禽基金会（Wildfowl Trust），并因保护植物和动物（尤其是鸟类）的工作而于1973年被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1925-80) an English comedy actor. His skill at copying other people's voices in an amusing
senses.zh: 彼得·塞勒斯（Peter Sellers）：（1925-80）英国喜剧演员。通过广播节目The Goon Show，他以有趣的方式复制他人声音的技巧广为人知。到1960年代，他已成为主要的喜剧电影明星，最著名的是在《奇异博士》（1963年）中扮演三个不同的角色，以及在《粉红豹》系列电影中饰演Inspector Clouseau。

senses.def: (1921-2004) an English actor, writer and film director. He was best known for playing unusual characters, e.g. in Death on the Nile
senses.zh: 彼得·乌斯蒂诺夫（1921-2004），英国演员，作家和电影导演。他以扮演不同寻常的角色而闻名，例如在《尼罗河上的死亡》（Death on the Nile，1978年）中扮演侦探Hercule Poirot。他还因在舞台和电视上讲有趣的故事以及复制许多不同外国口音的能力而受到赞誉。乌斯季诺夫写了几部戏剧和小说。1990年，他被任命为骑士。

intro.en: These words all mean to decide which thing or person you want out of the ones that are available.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含选择、挑选人或物之义。

items.def: to decide which thing or person you want out of the ones that are available:
items.zh: 指选择、选取人或物

examples.en: You choose—I can’t decide.
examples.zh: 你来选吧，我拿不定主意。

items.def: [often passive] to choose somebody/​something, usually carefully, from a group of people or things:
items.zh: 指仔细选择、挑选

examples.en: He was selected for the team.
examples.zh: 他已入选进队了。

items.def: (rather informal) to choose somebody/​something from a group of people or things:
items.zh: 指选择、挑选

examples.en: She picked the best cake for herself.
examples.zh: 她为自己挑了一块最好的蛋糕。

items.def: to choose between two or more possibilities:
items.zh: 指在两个或更多可能的情况中作出抉择、决定、选择

examples.en: We’re still trying to decide on a venue.
examples.zh: 我们仍在设法选定一个活动地点。

items.def: to choose to take or not to take a particular course of action:
items.zh: 指选择是否采取某种行动

examples.en: After graduating she opted for a career in music.
examples.zh: 毕业后她选择了从事音乐工作。

items.def: (rather informal) to choose something:
items.zh: 指选择某物

examples.en: I think I’ll go for the fruit salad.
examples.zh: 我想要水果色拉。

items.def: a thing that is liked better or best:

examples.en: Tastes and preferences vary from individual to individual.

senses.def: used to describe a way of putting something together by choosing things from among a large variety of different items

examples.en: a pick-and-mix programme of study
examples.zh: 综合课程

senses.def: to eat food slowly, taking small amounts or bites because you are not hungry
senses.zh: 磨蹭着吃；（因为不饿而）小口吃

examples.en: She sat at the table in silence, picking at her dinner.
examples.zh: 她静静地坐在桌边，吃着晚饭。

senses.def: to pull or touch something several times

examples.en: He tried to undo the knot by picking at it with his fingers.
examples.zh: 他用手指不停地扯，想把绳结解开。

senses.def: something that makes you feel better, happier, healthier, etc., especially medicine or an alcoholic drink
senses.zh: 提神物品，兴奋剂（尤指药物或酒精饮料）

examples.en: Use the facial scrub when your skin needs an extra pick-me-up.
examples.zh: 当您的皮肤需要额外提神时，请使用面部磨砂膏。

examples.en: This deal would offer the best possible pick-me-up to the town's ailing economy.
examples.zh: 这笔交易对该镇每况愈下的经济是一服最好的强心剂。

senses.def: to aim carefully at a person, an animal or an aircraft, especially one of a group, and then shoot them

examples.en: Snipers were picking off innocent civilians.
examples.zh: 狙击手专拣无辜的平民射击。

senses.def: to remove something from something such as a tree, a plant, etc.

examples.en: Pick off all the dead leaves.
examples.zh: 把枯叶全部摘掉。

senses.def: to treat somebody unfairly, by blaming, criticizing or punishing them
senses.zh: （跟某人）闹别扭；故意刁难挑剔

examples.en: She was picked on by the other girls because of her size.
examples.zh: 她因为个头的关系被其他女孩欺负。

senses.def: to choose somebody/something

examples.en: He picked on two of her statements which he said were untrue.
examples.zh: 他从她的话中挑出了两处他认为不真实的地方。

senses.def: to choose somebody/something carefully from a group of people or things

examples.en: She was picked out from dozens of applicants for the job.
examples.zh: 她从大批的求职者中被选中承担这项工作。

examples.en: He picked out the ripest peach for me.
examples.zh: 他给我挑了那个熟得最透的桃子。

examples.en: He was picked out as the best player.
examples.zh: 他被选为最佳选手。

senses.def: to recognize somebody/something from among other people or things

examples.en: See if you can pick me out in this photo.
examples.zh: 看你能不能在这张照片上认出我来。

examples.en: We couldn’t pick out any familiar landmarks.
examples.zh: 我们找不到任何熟悉的地标。

senses.def: to play a tune on a musical instrument slowly without using written music

examples.en: He picked out the tune on the piano with one finger.
examples.zh: 他凭记忆用一个手指在钢琴上慢慢弹出了那支曲子。

senses.def: to discover or recognize something after careful study

examples.en: Read the play again and pick out the major themes.
examples.zh: 请重读剧本，把主题找出来。

senses.def: to make something easy to see or hear
senses.zh: 使显著；使容易看见（或听见）

examples.en: a sign painted cream, with the lettering picked out in black
examples.zh: 印着醒目黑字的乳白色标牌

examples.en: The car lights picked out a cat running across the road.
examples.zh: 汽车灯照出了一只猫正在过马路。

senses.def: to examine a group of things carefully, especially to choose the ones you want

examples.en: Pick over the lentils and remove any little stones.
examples.zh: 仔细挑拣豆子，把小石子拣出去。

examples.en: I picked through the facts of the case.
examples.zh: 我仔细审查本案的事实。

senses.def: to get better, stronger, etc.; to improve

examples.en: Trade usually picks up in the spring.
examples.zh: 贸易一般在春天回升。

examples.en: The wind is picking up now.
examples.zh: 现在风愈刮愈大了。

examples.en: Sales have picked up 14 per cent this year.
examples.zh: 今年销售额增长了 14%。

senses.def: to start again; to continue

examples.en: Let's pick up where we left off yesterday.
examples.zh: 咱们从昨天停下的地方继续吧。

senses.def: to put things away and make things neat, especially for somebody else

examples.en: All I seem to do is cook, wash and pick up after the kids.
examples.zh: 烧饭、洗衣、跟在孩子屁股后头收拾东西，好像这就是我全部的活儿。

senses.def: to answer a phone

examples.en: The phone rang and rang and nobody picked up.
examples.zh: 电话铃响了又响，但没人接。

senses.def: to go somewhere in your car and collect somebody who is waiting for you

examples.en: I'll pick you up at five.
examples.zh: 我五点钟来接你。

senses.def: to allow somebody to get into your vehicle and take them somewhere

examples.en: The bus picks up passengers outside the airport.
examples.zh: 公共汽车在机场外接送乘客。

senses.def: to rescue somebody from the sea or from a dangerous place, especially one that is difficult to reach

examples.en: A lifeboat picked up survivors.
examples.zh: 救生艇把幸存者救起来。

examples.en: The stranded climbers were picked up by a rescue helicopter.
examples.zh: 被困的登山者被救援直升机接走。

senses.def: to start talking to somebody you do not know because you want to have a sexual relationship with them

examples.en: He goes to clubs to pick up girls.
examples.zh: 他到俱乐部去泡妞。

senses.def: to arrest somebody

examples.en: He was picked up by police and taken to the station for questioning.
examples.zh: 警察把他抓到局子里问话去了。

senses.def: to make somebody feel better

examples.en: Try this—it will pick you up.
examples.zh: 尝尝这个，能让你提提神的。

senses.def: to take hold of somebody/something and lift them/it up

examples.en: She went over to the crying child and picked her up.
examples.zh: 她走到啼哭的孩子身边，把她抱了起来。

senses.def: to get information or a skill by chance rather than by making a deliberate effort

examples.en: to pick up bad habits
examples.zh: 染上坏习惯

examples.en: Here's a tip I picked up from my mother.
examples.zh: 告诉你一个窍门，是我从妈妈那里学来的。

examples.en: She picked up Spanish when she was living in Mexico.
examples.zh: 她旅居墨西哥时顺便学会了西班牙语。

examples.en: Where did you pick up that idea?
examples.zh: 你从哪里得到这个想法的？

senses.def: to identify or recognize something

examples.en: Scientists can now pick up early signs of the disease.
examples.zh: 现在科学家能够辨认这种疾病的早期症状。

senses.def: to collect something from a place

examples.en: I picked up my coat from the cleaners.
examples.zh: 我从干洗店取回了外衣。

senses.def: to receive an electronic signal, sound or picture

examples.en: We were able to pick up the BBC World Service.
examples.zh: 我们能收到英国广播公司国际广播节目。

examples.en: The survivors were rescued after their sounds were picked up by a television crew's microphone.
examples.zh: 幸存者的声音被电视台的麦克风拾取后获救。

senses.def: to buy something, especially cheaply or by chance

examples.en: We managed to pick up a few bargains at the auction.
examples.zh: 我们从拍卖场买到了几件便宜货。

senses.def: to get or obtain something

examples.en: I seem to have picked up a terrible cold from somewhere.
examples.zh: 我似乎从什么地方染上了重感冒。

examples.zh: 我今天得到 30 英镑的小费。

senses.def: to find and follow a route

examples.zh: 几英里以后我们就能上高速公路。

senses.def: to return to an earlier subject or situation in order to continue it

examples.en: He picks up this theme again in later chapters of the book.
examples.zh: 在该书的后几章，他又重回到这个主题上。

examples.en: She left the band last year to pick up her career as a solo performer.
examples.zh: 她去年离开了乐队，开始了自己的独唱生涯。

senses.def: to notice something that is not very obvious; to see something that you are looking for

examples.zh: 我听到远处传来微弱的汽车声。

senses.def: to put things away neatly

examples.zh: 她没有领悟他话中的幽默。

senses.def: to mention something that somebody has said or done that you think is wrong
senses.zh: 提到某人的错误；挑毛病；算旧账

examples.zh: 我知道他迟早会提起我那个小过失的。

examples.zh: 她没有浪费时间自怜，而是振作起来继续干。

senses.zh: 古代英国人民的成员。他们与苏格兰人结盟后，居住在公元1世纪至9世纪之间的苏格兰北部。对Picts知之甚少，但它们以装饰有神秘符号的石雕而闻名。

examples.zh: 作者把经济状况描绘得一片惨淡。

examples.zh: 新闻报道勾勒出一个深陷危机的国家。

examples.zh: 电视报道对就业形势的描绘比研究显示的情况要乐观得多。

senses.zh: 头脑中的情景；记忆；印象

examples.zh: 我清楚地记得很小的时候祖父低头向我微笑的情景。

examples.zh: 他利用意象在读者的脑海中形成图像。

examples.zh: 几年前的情况就大不相同。

examples.zh: 农业的总体形势是令人鼓舞的。

examples.zh: 我能清楚地想象这个场面。

examples.zh: 我还能回忆起我童年时住的那座房子。

examples.zh: 我们很难想象他居然是有几个十几岁儿子的父亲了。

examples.zh: 他还没回家的时候，她想象着他已横尸路边了。
