senses.def: to feel sorry for somebody because of their situation; to feel pity

examples.en: He pitied people who were stuck in dead-end jobs.
examples.zh: 他很同情那些工作上毫无前途的人。

examples.en: Compulsive gamblers are more to be pitied than condemned.
examples.zh: 对嗜赌成瘾者要多些同情，少些谴责。

examples.en: I pity her having to work such long hours.
examples.zh: 她不得不加班加点工作，真让我同情。

senses.def: unfortunately

examples.en: ‘Was the bicycle insured?’ ‘No, more's the pity!’
examples.zh: “自行车上保险没有？”“没有。真倒霉！”

senses.def: in a way that shows pity
senses.zh: 怜悯的，同情的（常带优越感）

senses.def: the central point, pin or column on which something turns or balances
the central or most important person or thing
senses.zh: 最重要的人（或事物）；中心；核心

examples.en: West Africa was the pivot of the cocoa trade.
examples.zh: 西非曾是可可豆贸易的中心。

examples.en: The pivot on which the old system turned had disappeared.
examples.zh: 维系旧制度的支柱已经消失了。

examples.en: She is the pivot of community life.
examples.zh: 她是社区生活的枢纽。

senses.def: to turn or balance on a central point (= a pivot

examples.en: Windows that pivot from a central point are easy to clean.
examples.zh: 沿中轴转动的窗子容易擦洗。

examples.en: She pivoted around and walked out.
examples.zh: 她一转身走了出去。

senses.def: to change direction; to change the way in which something is done

examples.en: The company is pivoting towards mobile and away from social media.
examples.zh: 该公司正在转向移动设备，远离社交媒体。

examples.en: We are pivoting towards delivering all of our software as a service.
examples.zh: 我们正致力于将所有软件作为服务提供。

senses.def: to depend completely on something

examples.en: The entire plot pivots around this meeting.
examples.zh: 整个剧情都是围绕着这次会议展开的。

senses.def: to depend completely on something

examples.en: The most scandalous news stories pivot on money, not sex.
examples.zh: 最丑闻的新闻报道以金钱为中心，而不是性。

senses.def: to depend completely on something

examples.en: The entire plot pivots around this meeting.
examples.zh: 整个剧情都是围绕着这次会议展开的。

senses.def: to depend completely on something

examples.en: The most scandalous news stories pivot on money, not sex.
examples.zh: 最丑闻的新闻报道以金钱为中心，而不是性。

senses.def: of great importance because other things depend on it

examples.en: a pivotal role in European affairs
examples.zh: 在欧洲事务中的关键作用

examples.en: Accountancy, law and economics are pivotal to a successful career in any financial services area.
examples.zh: 会计学、法学和经济学在任何金融服务领域都是事业成功的关键。

senses.def: photographs or pictures

examples.en: They showed us their wedding pix.
examples.zh: 他们给我们看了他们的婚礼照片。

senses.def: any of the small individual areas on a computer screen, which together form the whole image
senses.zh: 像素（组成屏幕图像的最小独立元素）

senses.def: to divide an image into pixels
senses.zh: 使像素化；将（图像）分解成像素

senses.def: to show an unclear image on television, consisting of a small number of large pixels
(in stories) a creature like a small person with pointed ears, who has magic powers
senses.zh: （传说中的）小精灵，小仙子，小妖怪

senses.def: an Italian dish consisting of a flat round bread base with cheese, tomatoes, vegetables, meat, etc. on top

examples.en: a ham and mushroom pizza
examples.zh: 火腿蘑菇比萨饼

examples.en: Is there any pizza left?
examples.zh: 还有比萨饼吗？

examples.en: What do you want on your pizza?
examples.zh: 你的比萨饼上想放什么？

examples.en: a slice of cheese and tomato pizza
examples.zh: 一片奶酪西红柿比萨饼

senses.def: a US company with a large number of restaurants in the US, Britain and other countries that serve pizzas
a lively and exciting quality or style

examples.en: We need someone with youth, glamour and pizzazz.
examples.zh: 我们需要一位年富力强、魅力十足、风度翩翩的人。

senses.def: a restaurant that serves mainly pizzas
played using the fingers instead of a bow
pyjamas

examples.en: My new jeans are as comfy as a pair of PJs.
examples.zh: 我的新牛仔裤像睡衣一样舒服。

senses.def: package

examples.en: 1 pkg. yeast
examples.zh: 1 袋酵母

senses.zh: （有草木的）大路；绿化道路；林荫大道

examples.en: slow traffic from The Southern State Pkwy
examples.zh: 从 Southern State Pkwy 出发的交通缓慢

senses.def: (in writing) plural
(used in written addresses) place

examples.en: Grosvenor Pl.
examples.zh: 格罗夫诺街

senses.def: Port of London Authority
a large written or printed notice that is put in a public place or carried on a stick in a march
senses.zh: 标语牌；广告牌；招贴；海报

examples.en: They were carrying placards and banners demanding that he resign.
examples.zh: 人们手持标语牌和横幅，要求他下台。

senses.def: to make somebody feel less angry about something

examples.en: I saw the anger in her eyes and stepped forward with a placating smile.
examples.zh: 我看到她眼中的愤怒，带着安抚的微笑走上前去。

examples.en: The concessions did little to placate the students.
examples.zh: 让步根本未能平息学生的愤怒。

senses.def: designed to make somebody feel less angry by showing that you are willing to satisfy or please them
senses.zh: 和解的；安抚性的；安慰的

examples.en: a placatory remark/smile/gesture
examples.zh: 抚慰的话／微笑／姿态

senses.def: a particular position, point or area

examples.en: Keep your purse in a safe place.
examples.zh: 把钱包放在安全的地方。

examples.en: I can't be in two places at once.
examples.zh: 我不能同时身处两地。

examples.en: They organized several demonstrations in public places.
examples.zh: 他们在公共场所组织了多次示威活动。

examples.en: I happened to be in the right place at the right time.
examples.zh: 我碰巧在合适的时间出现在了合适的地方。

examples.en: Is this the place where it happened?
examples.zh: 这就是事发现场吗？

examples.en: This would be a good place for a picnic.
examples.zh: 这可是个野餐的好地方。

examples.en: There is a time and place for these questions, but not right here and now.
examples.zh: 这些问题有一个特定的时间和地点，但不是此时此地。

examples.en: If you're looking for a new service provider, this list is a good place to start.
examples.zh: 如果您正在寻找新的服务提供商，可以从这张清单开始。

senses.def: a particular city, town, building, etc.
senses.zh: 某处地方（如城镇或建筑物等）

examples.en: I can't remember all the places we visited in Thailand.
examples.zh: 我记不清在泰国参观过的所有地方。

examples.en: I used to live in York and I'm still fond of the place.
examples.zh: 我以前住在约克，现在仍然喜欢那里。

examples.en: The police searched the place.
examples.zh: 警察搜查了那个地方。

examples.en: Let's get out of this place!
examples.zh: 咱们离开这儿吧！

examples.en: We were looking for a place to eat.
examples.zh: 我们想找个吃饭的地方。

examples.en: a place to live/stay
examples.zh: 居住／停留的地方

examples.en: Please write your full name and date and place of birth.
examples.zh: 请写下您的全名以及出生日期和地点。

senses.def: a building or an area of land used for a particular purpose
senses.zh: 有某用途的建筑（或土地）

examples.en: The town has many excellent eating places.
examples.zh: 镇上有许多很棒的餐馆。

examples.en: I couldn't find a parking place anywhere.
examples.zh: 我怎么也找不到停车位。

examples.en: churches and other places of worship
examples.zh: 教堂和其他礼拜场所

examples.en: He can usually be contacted at his place of work.
examples.zh: 一般都能在他的工作单位找到他。

examples.en: They seem to have no fixed employment or place of residence.
examples.zh: 他们似乎没有固定的工作或居住地。

senses.def: a particular area on a surface, especially on a person’s body
senses.zh: 表面的某处；（尤指）身体某处

examples.en: He broke his arm in three places.
examples.zh: 他胳膊上有三处骨折。

examples.en: The paint was peeling off the wall in places.
examples.zh: 墙上有几处油漆剥落了。

examples.en: The footbath is bumpy in places.
examples.zh: 足浴池有些地方凹凸不平。

senses.group: area on surface 表面区域

senses.def: a point in a book, speech, piece of music, etc., especially one that somebody has reached at a particular time
senses.zh: 段；点；节；（尤指）读到的（或说到的）某点

examples.en: She had marked her place with a bookmark.
examples.zh: 她把书签夹在读到的地方。

examples.en: Excuse me, I seem to have lost my place.
examples.zh: 对不起，我好像忘记说到哪里了。

examples.en: The audience laughed in all the right places.
examples.zh: 观众该笑的地方都笑了。

examples.en: The film is scary in places.
examples.zh: 这部电影有些地方很可怕。

examples.en: This is one of the few places in his work where he mentions his childhood.
examples.zh: 这是他作品中为数不多的提及童年的地方之一。

senses.group: in book/speech, etc. 书、讲话等

senses.def: the natural or correct position for something

examples.en: Is there a place on the form to put your address?
examples.zh: 表格上有填写地址的位置吗？

examples.en: There is a place to sign and date at the bottom of the form.
examples.zh: 表格底部有一个签名和日期的地方。

examples.en: Put it back in its place when you've finished with it.
examples.zh: 用毕放回原处。

examples.en: He remembered the saying ‘A place for everything and everything in its place.’
examples.zh: 他记得这样一句话：“万物皆有其所在，万物各就其位。”

senses.def: a position, seat, etc., especially one that is available for or being used by a person or vehicle
senses.zh: （尤指占用或空着的）座位，位置，泊位

examples.en: Come and sit here—I've saved you a place.
examples.zh: 到这儿来坐吧。我给你留了个座位。

examples.en: I don't want to lose my place in the line.
examples.zh: 我可不想失去排队的位置。

examples.en: Would you like to change places with me so you can see better?
examples.zh: 你想跟我换个位子看得更清楚点吗？

examples.en: I've set a place for you at the table.
examples.zh: 我在餐桌上给你安排好了座位。

senses.def: an opportunity to take part in something, especially to study at a school or university or on a course
senses.zh: 求学机会；进修机会；入学名额

examples.en: She's been offered a place at Bath to study Business.
examples.zh: 她已被录取到巴斯大学读商科。

examples.en: There are very few places left on the course.
examples.zh: 这门课程没剩几个名额了。

senses.def: the position of being a member of a sports team

examples.en: She has won a place in the Olympic team.
examples.zh: 她已获得奥运代表队的队员资格。

examples.en: He lost his place in the first team.
examples.zh: 他失去了在一队的资格。

senses.def: a position among the winners of a race or competition; a position in the next stage of a competition
senses.zh: （比赛优胜者的）名次；（进入下一阶段比赛的）资格

examples.en: She took third place.
examples.zh: 她获得了第三名。

examples.en: He finished in third place.
examples.zh: 他得了第三名。

examples.en: Victory earned them a place in the final.
examples.zh: 这次胜利使他们在决赛中获得了一席之地。

senses.def: the role or importance of somebody/something in a particular situation, usually in relation to others

examples.en: He is assured of his place in history.
examples.zh: 他必定会被载入史册。

examples.en: They felt that they had no place in society and nowhere to go.
examples.zh: 他们觉得自己在社会上没有地位，也无处可去。

examples.en: It took her a while to find her place in the world.
examples.zh: 她花了一段时间才找到自己在这世上的位置。

examples.en: Anecdotes have no place in (= are not acceptable in) an academic essay.
examples.zh: 学术文章容不得奇闻逸事。

examples.en: Accurate reporting takes second place to lurid detail.
examples.zh: 准确的报道在其次，耸人听闻的细节最重要。

examples.en: My father believed that people should know their place (= behave according to their social position).
examples.zh: 我父亲认为人应该安分守己。

examples.en: It's not your place (= your role) to give advice.
examples.zh: 还轮不到你来做指导。

senses.def: a house or flat; a person’s home

examples.en: What about dinner at my place?
examples.zh: 到我家吃晚饭好不好？

examples.en: I'm fed up with living with my parents, so I'm looking for a place of my own.
examples.zh: 我腻烦跟父母同住了，所以正在找一个属于自己的住处。

examples.en: I thought I’d better clean the place up.
examples.zh: 我想最好还是把住处打扫干净。

senses.def: a suitable or safe area for somebody to be

examples.en: These streets are no place for a child to be out alone at night.
examples.zh: 这些街道可不是小孩子夜间单独去的地方。

senses.def: the position of a figure after a decimal point

examples.en: Convert the decimal to a percentage by moving the decimal point two places to the right.
examples.zh: 通过将小数点向右移动两位，将小数转换为百分比。

senses.def: used as part of a name for a short street or square
senses.zh: （作短街道或广场名称的一部分）

examples.en: 66 Portland Place
examples.zh: 波特兰街 66 号

senses.def: everywhere

examples.en: New restaurants are appearing all over the place.
examples.zh: 新餐馆如雨后春笋般纷纷出现了。

senses.def: not neat or tidy; not well organized

examples.en: Your calculations are all over the place (= completely wrong).
examples.zh: 你的计算错得一塌糊涂。

senses.def: to be getting more and more successful in your life or career

examples.en: a young architect who’s really going places
examples.zh: 一个春风得意的青年建筑师

senses.def: to behave in a very confident way that annoys other people, for example by telling them what to do

examples.en: She was acting as if she owned the place.
examples.zh: 她的一举一动好像在说这是她的地盘似的。

senses.def: to be feeling happy, sad, worried, etc. about something; to be in a good, bad, unhappy, etc. state

examples.en: I'm happy now. I'm in a good place.
examples.zh: 我现在很高兴，感觉良好。

examples.en: Me and Ed are in a good space right now.
examples.zh: 我和艾德现在处境很好。

examples.en: The economy is in a better place than it was a year ago.
examples.zh: 经济状况比一年前要好。

examples.en: He was in a bad place, mentally and emotionally.
examples.zh: 他的处境很糟糕，无论是精神上还是情感上。

examples.en: She was in a dark place after her mother's death.
examples.zh: 母亲去世后，她陷入了黑暗。

senses.def: to be able to take advantage of opportunities when they come

examples.en: His success was down to being in the right place at the right time.
examples.zh: 他的成功是因为把握住了时机。

senses.def: in a situation where you have to choose between two things, both of which are unpleasant
to be in somebody else’s situation

examples.en: I'm perfectly happy—I wouldn't change places with anyone.
examples.zh: 我幸福极了，谁也甭想跟我交换位置。

senses.def: if something complicated or difficult to understand falls

examples.en: Then I found his diary and it all began to fall into place.
examples.zh: 然后我找到了他的日记，一切都开始步入正轨。

senses.def: friends, people, etc. in positions of power and influence
senses.zh: 身居高位的朋友（或人士等）

examples.en: He has friends in high places.
examples.zh: 他有身居高位的朋友。

senses.def: to be replaced by somebody/something

examples.en: Houses and factories gave place to open fields as the train gathered speed.
examples.zh: 火车逐渐加速，驶过了房屋和工厂进入旷野。

senses.def: to be very dear to somebody

examples.en: He'll always have a place in my heart.
examples.zh: 他将永远留在我心里。

senses.def: used to say that somebody’s intentions are kind and sincere even though they sometimes do the wrong thing
senses.zh: 本意是好的；心眼儿是好的

senses.def: used to introduce a piece of advice you are giving to somebody

examples.en: If I were in your place, I'd resign immediately.
examples.zh: 换了我是你的话，我就立即辞职。

senses.def: used at the end of a sentence to talk about why something was done or whether it should have been done or not
senses.zh: （用于句尾，谈论某事为何或是否应该做）究竟，到底，当初

examples.en: I still don't understand why you chose that name in the first place.
examples.zh: 我仍不明白你究竟为什么取了这么个名字。

examples.en: I should never have taken that job in the first place.
examples.zh: 我当初就不该接受那份工作。

senses.def: used at the beginning of a sentence to introduce the different points you are making in an argument

examples.en: Well, in the first place he has all the right qualifications.
examples.zh: 嗯，首先，他符合一切条件。

senses.def: in my, your, etc. situation

examples.en: I wouldn't like to be in your place.
examples.zh: 我可不想处于你的境地。

senses.def: in the correct position; ready for something

examples.en: Carefully lay each slab in place.
examples.zh: 要仔细铺好每一块石板。

examples.en: He allowed the curtain to swish back into place.
examples.zh: 他让窗帘摇回原位。

senses.def: working or ready to work

examples.en: All the arrangements are now in place for their visit.
examples.zh: 他们来访的一切事宜都安排好了。

examples.en: How long has the import ban been in place?
examples.zh: 进口禁令实施多久了？

senses.def: in one exact place, without moving in any direction

examples.en: Running in place is good exercise.
examples.zh: 原地跑步是很好的运动。

senses.def: instead of somebody/something

examples.en: You can use milk in place of cream in this recipe.
examples.zh: 这道食谱可以用牛奶代替奶油。

examples.en: He was unable to come to the ceremony, but he sent his son to accept the award in his place.
examples.zh: 他不能亲自来参加仪式，但派了他儿子前来代他领奖。

senses.def: an unusual or unpleasant event is not likely to happen in the same place or to the same people twice
senses.zh: 倒霉的事不可能在同一场所（或同一人身上）重复发生；一事不过二

senses.def: to look extremely clean and neat
not in the correct place

examples.en: Some of these files seem to be out of place.
examples.zh: 有些档案似乎没放对地方。

senses.def: not suitable for a particular situation

examples.en: Her remarks were out of place.
examples.zh: 她出言不当。

examples.en: I felt completely out of place among all these successful people.
examples.zh: 夹在这些事业有成的人中间我觉得自己格格不入。

senses.def: a position in which you are comfortable or have an advantage over other people
senses.zh: 舒适状态；有利地位；优越境况

senses.def: the position in which something is most easily seen, that is given to the most important thing in a particular group
senses.zh: 显要位置；最突出（或最重要）的位置

examples.en: The photo was given pride of place on the mantelpiece.
examples.zh: 这张照片被放在壁炉架上最显眼的位置。

senses.def: to make somebody feel stupid or embarrassed for showing too much confidence
senses.zh: 挫某人的锐气；杀某人的威风；使明白自己的身份

examples.en: At first she tried to take charge of the meeting but I soon put her in her place.
examples.zh: 起初她试图主导会议，但我很快就把她轰下去了。

senses.def: to imagine that you are in somebody else’s situation
senses.zh: 设身处地替别人着想；设想自己处于别人的境地

examples.en: Of course I was upset—just put yourself in my place.
examples.zh: 我当然不高兴，你设身处地为我想想。

senses.def: to stay indoors during an emergency in order to protect yourself and others

examples.en: Residents of the city have been ordered to shelter in place for at least the next three weeks.
examples.zh: 该市居民被要求未来至少三周实行居家避疫。

senses.def: to happen, especially after previously being arranged or planned
senses.zh: （尤指根据安排或计划）发生，进行

examples.en: The film festival takes place in October.
examples.zh: 电影节将于十月举行。

examples.en: We may never discover what took place that night.
examples.zh: 我们可能永远不会知道那一夜发生了什么事。

senses.def: to replace somebody/something

examples.en: She couldn't attend the meeting so her assistant took her place.
examples.zh: 她不能参加会议，所以她的助手代她出席。

examples.en: Computers have taken the place of typewriters in most offices.
examples.zh: 在大多数办公室，电脑已经取代了打字机。

senses.def: to go to the physical position that is necessary for an activity

examples.en: Take your places for dinner.
examples.zh: 请各位入席。

senses.def: to take or accept the status in society that is correct or that you deserve
senses.zh: 得到应有的社会地位；名副其实

senses.def: to put something in a particular place, especially when you do it carefully or deliberately

examples.en: He placed his hand on her shoulder.
examples.zh: 他把手搭在她的肩上。

examples.en: A bomb had been placed under the seat.
examples.zh: 座位下面放了一枚炸弹。

examples.en: The parking areas in the town are few, but strategically placed.
examples.zh: 城内停车场虽少，但都设在关键地方。

senses.def: used to express the attitude somebody has towards something/somebody
senses.zh: 以某种态度对待（或看待）

examples.en: They place a high value on punctuality.
examples.zh: 他们对守时极为重视。

examples.en: Great importance is placed on education.
examples.zh: 教育受到高度重视。

examples.en: The blame was placed squarely on the doctor.
examples.zh: 责任明确地落在医生身上。

examples.en: We have always placed emphasis on delivering customer satisfaction.
examples.zh: 我们一直重视让客户满意。

senses.def: to give instructions about something or make a request for something to happen

examples.en: to place an order/a bet
examples.zh: 下订单；下赌注

examples.en: We placed an advertisement for the position on an online jobs portal.
examples.zh: 我们在在线招聘门户网站上发布了该职位的广告。

senses.def: to put somebody/yourself in a particular situation
senses.zh: 使（人）处于某位置；安置；安顿

examples.en: to place somebody in command
examples.zh: 让某人指挥

examples.en: She was placed in the care of an uncle.
examples.zh: 她由一位叔父照顾。

examples.en: His resignation placed us in a difficult position.
examples.zh: 他的辞职使我们处境艰难。

examples.en: The job places great demands on me.
examples.zh: 这项工作对我的要求很高。

examples.en: He has placed himself above party politics.
examples.zh: 他把自己置于党派政治之上。

examples.en: highly placed officials in the government
examples.zh: 身居高位的政府官员

examples.en: You will be placed on the waiting list.
examples.zh: 您将被列入等候名单。

examples.en: to place restrictions/a burden on somebody
examples.zh: 给某人施加限制/负担

examples.en: They are placing lives at risk.
examples.zh: 他们将生命置于危险之中。

senses.def: to find a suitable job, home, etc. for somebody

examples.en: The agency placed about 2 000 secretaries last year.
examples.zh: 去年，这家中介所为大约 2 000 名秘书找到了工作。

examples.en: The children were placed with foster parents.
examples.zh: 这些小孩已安顿好，交给寄养父母了。

examples.en: children who are difficult to place in foster homes
examples.zh: 很难适应收养家庭生活的孩子

senses.def: to decide that somebody/something has a particular position or rank compared with other people or things

examples.en: I would place her among the top five tennis players in the world.
examples.zh: 我会把她排在世界五名顶尖网球选手之列。

examples.en: Nursing attracts people who place relationships high on their list of priorities.
examples.zh: 护理工作对重视人际关系的人具有吸引力。

senses.def: used to describe a person, a team, a horse, etc. finishing in a particular position in a race

examples.en: He was placed fifth in last Saturday's race.
examples.zh: 在上周六的径赛中，他名列第五。

examples.en: My horse has been placed several times (= it was among the first three or four to finish the race).
examples.zh: 我的马在竞赛中屡获名次。

examples.en: His horse placed in the last race (= it was among the first three to finish the race, usually in second place).
examples.zh: 他的马在上次比赛中得了名次（常指亚军）。

senses.def: to recognize somebody/something and be able to identify them/it

examples.en: I've seen her before but I just can't place her.
examples.zh: 我从前见过她，不过现在认不出她来。

examples.en: His accent was impossible to place.
examples.zh: 他的口音无法辨认。

senses.def: to be in a good, very good, etc. position or have a good, etc. opportunity to do something
senses.zh: 有良好的（或理想的、独特的等）机遇；处于有利等的位置

examples.en: Engineering graduates are well placed for a wide range of jobs.
examples.zh: 工程科毕业生在很多职业中处于优势。

examples.en: The company is ideally placed to take advantage of the new legislation.
examples.zh: 这家公司条件理想得很，恰好可以充分利用新法规。

examples.en: The company is ideally placed to win the contract.
examples.zh: 公司处境理想，有望赢得合同。

senses.def: to be located in a pleasant or convenient place
senses.zh: 坐落在方便宜人的地方；位于合宜的地点

examples.en: The hotel is well placed for restaurants, bars and clubs.
examples.zh: 这家宾馆位置很好，附近有很多餐厅、酒吧和俱乐部。

senses.def: to say something publicly or officially so that it may be written down and repeated

examples.en: He didn't want to go on the record as either praising or criticizing the proposal.
examples.zh: 他不想公开赞扬或批评这项提议。

examples.en: I should like to place on record my sincere thanks to all those who have given support.
examples.zh: 我谨向所有给予支持的人们表示诚挚的感谢。

senses.def: to think that somebody/something is particularly important or valuable

examples.en: The company places a high premium on initiative.
examples.zh: 该公司高度重视主动性。

examples.en: They put a high premium on customer loyalty.
examples.zh: 他们非常重视客户忠诚度。

senses.def: to admire somebody so much that you do not see their faults
senses.zh: 把某人奉为完人；盲目崇拜某人

senses.def: everywhere

examples.en: New restaurants are appearing all over the place.
examples.zh: 新餐馆如雨后春笋般纷纷出现了。

senses.def: not neat or tidy; not well organized

examples.en: Your calculations are all over the place (= completely wrong).
examples.zh: 你的计算错得一塌糊涂。

senses.def: to be getting more and more successful in your life or career

examples.en: a young architect who’s really going places
examples.zh: 一个春风得意的青年建筑师

items.idm: behave/act as if you own the place | think you own the place

senses.def: to behave in a very confident way that annoys other people, for example by telling them what to do

examples.en: She was acting as if she owned the place.
examples.zh: 她的一举一动好像在说这是她的地盘似的。

items.idm: be in a good, bad, dark, etc. place

senses.def: to be feeling happy, sad, worried, etc. about something; to be in a good, bad, unhappy, etc. state

examples.en: I'm happy now. I'm in a good place.
examples.zh: 我现在很高兴，感觉良好。

examples.en: Me and Ed are in a good space right now.
examples.zh: 我和艾德现在处境很好。

examples.en: The economy is in a better place than it was a year ago.
examples.zh: 经济状况比一年前要好。

examples.en: He was in a bad place, mentally and emotionally.
examples.zh: 他的处境很糟糕，无论是精神上还是情感上。

examples.en: She was in a dark place after her mother's death.
examples.zh: 母亲去世后，她陷入了黑暗。

items.idm: be in the right place at the right time

senses.def: to be able to take advantage of opportunities when they come

examples.en: His success was down to being in the right place at the right time.
examples.zh: 他的成功是因为把握住了时机。

items.idm: (caught/stuck) between a rock and a hard place

senses.def: in a situation where you have to choose between two things, both of which are unpleasant
to be in somebody else’s situation

examples.en: I'm perfectly happy—I wouldn't change places with anyone.
examples.zh: 我幸福极了，谁也甭想跟我交换位置。

senses.def: if something complicated or difficult to understand falls

examples.en: Then I found his diary and it all began to fall into place.
examples.zh: 然后我找到了他的日记，一切都开始步入正轨。

items.idm: friends, people, etc. in high places

senses.def: friends, people, etc. in positions of power and influence
senses.zh: 身居高位的朋友（或人士等）

examples.en: He has friends in high places.
examples.zh: 他有身居高位的朋友。

senses.def: to be replaced by somebody/something

examples.en: Houses and factories gave place to open fields as the train gathered speed.
examples.zh: 火车逐渐加速，驶过了房屋和工厂进入旷野。

items.idm: have/hold a place in somebody's heart

senses.def: to be very dear to somebody

examples.en: He'll always have a place in my heart.
examples.zh: 他将永远留在我心里。

items.idm: somebody’s heart is in the right place

senses.def: used to say that somebody’s intentions are kind and sincere even though they sometimes do the wrong thing
senses.zh: 本意是好的；心眼儿是好的

items.idm: if I was/were in your place

senses.def: used to introduce a piece of advice you are giving to somebody

examples.en: If I were in your place, I'd resign immediately.
examples.zh: 换了我是你的话，我就立即辞职。

senses.def: used at the end of a sentence to talk about why something was done or whether it should have been done or not
senses.zh: （用于句尾，谈论某事为何或是否应该做）究竟，到底，当初

examples.en: I still don't understand why you chose that name in the first place.
examples.zh: 我仍不明白你究竟为什么取了这么个名字。

examples.en: I should never have taken that job in the first place.
examples.zh: 我当初就不该接受那份工作。

items.idm: in the first, second, etc. place

senses.def: used at the beginning of a sentence to introduce the different points you are making in an argument

examples.en: Well, in the first place he has all the right qualifications.
examples.zh: 嗯，首先，他符合一切条件。

senses.def: in my, your, etc. situation

examples.en: I wouldn't like to be in your place.
examples.zh: 我可不想处于你的境地。

senses.def: in the correct position; ready for something

examples.en: Carefully lay each slab in place.
examples.zh: 要仔细铺好每一块石板。

examples.en: He allowed the curtain to swish back into place.
examples.zh: 他让窗帘摇回原位。

senses.def: working or ready to work

examples.en: All the arrangements are now in place for their visit.
examples.zh: 他们来访的一切事宜都安排好了。

examples.en: How long has the import ban been in place?
examples.zh: 进口禁令实施多久了？

senses.def: in one exact place, without moving in any direction

examples.en: Running in place is good exercise.
examples.zh: 原地跑步是很好的运动。

items.idm: in (the) place of somebody/something | in somebody’s/something’s place

senses.def: instead of somebody/something

examples.en: You can use milk in place of cream in this recipe.
examples.zh: 这道食谱可以用牛奶代替奶油。

examples.en: He was unable to come to the ceremony, but he sent his son to accept the award in his place.
examples.zh: 他不能亲自来参加仪式，但派了他儿子前来代他领奖。

items.idm: lightning never strikes (in the same place) twice

senses.def: an unusual or unpleasant event is not likely to happen in the same place or to the same people twice
senses.zh: 倒霉的事不可能在同一场所（或同一人身上）重复发生；一事不过二

items.idm: not have a hair out of place

senses.def: to look extremely clean and neat
not in the correct place

examples.en: Some of these files seem to be out of place.
examples.zh: 有些档案似乎没放对地方。

senses.def: not suitable for a particular situation

examples.en: Her remarks were out of place.
examples.zh: 她出言不当。

examples.en: I felt completely out of place among all these successful people.
examples.zh: 夹在这些事业有成的人中间我觉得自己格格不入。

senses.def: a position in which you are comfortable or have an advantage over other people
senses.zh: 舒适状态；有利地位；优越境况

senses.def: the position in which something is most easily seen, that is given to the most important thing in a particular group
senses.zh: 显要位置；最突出（或最重要）的位置

examples.en: The photo was given pride of place on the mantelpiece.
examples.zh: 这张照片被放在壁炉架上最显眼的位置。

senses.def: to make somebody feel stupid or embarrassed for showing too much confidence
senses.zh: 挫某人的锐气；杀某人的威风；使明白自己的身份

examples.en: At first she tried to take charge of the meeting but I soon put her in her place.
examples.zh: 起初她试图主导会议，但我很快就把她轰下去了。

items.idm: put yourself in somebody else’s/somebody’s place

senses.def: to imagine that you are in somebody else’s situation
senses.zh: 设身处地替别人着想；设想自己处于别人的境地

examples.en: Of course I was upset—just put yourself in my place.
examples.zh: 我当然不高兴，你设身处地为我想想。

senses.def: to stay indoors during an emergency in order to protect yourself and others

examples.en: Residents of the city have been ordered to shelter in place for at least the next three weeks.
examples.zh: 该市居民被要求未来至少三周实行居家避疫。

senses.def: to happen, especially after previously being arranged or planned
senses.zh: （尤指根据安排或计划）发生，进行

examples.en: The film festival takes place in October.
examples.zh: 电影节将于十月举行。

examples.en: We may never discover what took place that night.
examples.zh: 我们可能永远不会知道那一夜发生了什么事。

items.idm: take somebody’s/something’s place | take the place of somebody/something

senses.def: to replace somebody/something

examples.en: She couldn't attend the meeting so her assistant took her place.
examples.zh: 她不能参加会议，所以她的助手代她出席。

examples.en: Computers have taken the place of typewriters in most offices.
examples.zh: 在大多数办公室，电脑已经取代了打字机。

senses.def: to go to the physical position that is necessary for an activity

examples.en: Take your places for dinner.
examples.zh: 请各位入席。

senses.def: to take or accept the status in society that is correct or that you deserve
senses.zh: 得到应有的社会地位；名副其实

items.idm: be well, ideally, uniquely, better, etc. placed for something/to do something

senses.def: to be in a good, very good, etc. position or have a good, etc. opportunity to do something
senses.zh: 有良好的（或理想的、独特的等）机遇；处于有利等的位置

examples.en: Engineering graduates are well placed for a wide range of jobs.
examples.zh: 工程科毕业生在很多职业中处于优势。

examples.en: The company is ideally placed to take advantage of the new legislation.
examples.zh: 这家公司条件理想得很，恰好可以充分利用新法规。

examples.en: The company is ideally placed to win the contract.
examples.zh: 公司处境理想，有望赢得合同。

senses.def: to be located in a pleasant or convenient place
senses.zh: 坐落在方便宜人的地方；位于合宜的地点

examples.en: The hotel is well placed for restaurants, bars and clubs.
examples.zh: 这家宾馆位置很好，附近有很多餐厅、酒吧和俱乐部。

items.idm: put/place something on (the) record | be/go on (the) record (as saying…)

senses.def: to say something publicly or officially so that it may be written down and repeated

examples.en: He didn't want to go on the record as either praising or criticizing the proposal.
examples.zh: 他不想公开赞扬或批评这项提议。

examples.en: I should like to place on record my sincere thanks to all those who have given support.
examples.zh: 我谨向所有给予支持的人们表示诚挚的感谢。

items.idm: put/place/set a premium on somebody/something

senses.def: to think that somebody/something is particularly important or valuable

examples.en: The company places a high premium on initiative.
examples.zh: 该公司高度重视主动性。

examples.en: They put a high premium on customer loyalty.
examples.zh: 他们非常重视客户忠诚度。

items.idm: to put/place somebody on a pedestal

senses.def: to admire somebody so much that you do not see their faults
senses.zh: 把某人奉为完人；盲目崇拜某人

synonyms.words: site ▪ area ▪ position ▪ point ▪ location ▪ scene ▪ spot ▪ venue

intro.en: These are all words for a particular area or part of an area, especially one used for a particular purpose or where somebody/​something is situated or happens.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示地点、场所、位置。

items.def: a particular point, area, city, town, building, etc., especially one used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens:
items.zh: 指有特定用途或事情发生的地点、场所、城镇、建筑物、地方

examples.en: This would be a good place for a picnic.
examples.zh: 这可是个野餐的好地方。

items.def: the place where something, especially a building, is or will be located; a place where something happened or that is used for a particular purpose:
items.zh: 尤指建筑物的地点、位置，事情发生或有特定用途的地点、场所

examples.en: They’ve chosen a site for the new school.
examples.zh: 他们为新学校选了校址。

items.def: a part of a room, building or particular space that is used for a special purpose; a particular place on an object:
items.zh: 指（房间、建筑物、处所内划为某用途的）地方、场地，物体上的区、部位

examples.en: the hotel reception area
examples.zh: 旅馆接待处

items.def: the place where a person or thing is located; the place where somebody/​something is meant to be:
items.zh: 指位置、方位、恰当的位置

examples.en: From his position at the top of the hill, he could see the harbour.
examples.zh: 他在山头那个位置可以俯瞰海港。

items.def: a particular place within an area, where something happens or is supposed to happen:
items.zh: 指某事发生或将要发生的地点、某个地方

examples.en: the point at which the river divides
examples.zh: 河流分岔点

items.def: a place where something happens or exists, especially a place that is not named or not known:
items.zh: 指事情发生或存在的地方、地点、位置，尤指无名或鲜为人知的地方

examples.en: The company is moving to a new location.
examples.zh: 公司准备迁移新址。

items.def: a place where something happens, especially something unpleasant:
items.zh: 尤指不愉快事件发生的地点、现场

examples.en: the scene of the accident
examples.zh: 事故现场

items.def: a particular point or area, especially one that has a particular character or where something particular happens:
items.zh: 尤指具有某种特点或某一事件发生的地点、场所

examples.en: The lake is one of the local beauty spots.
examples.zh: 这个湖是当地的一个风景点。

items.def: the place where people meet for an organized event such as a performance or sports event.
items.zh: 指演出、体育比赛等的聚会地点、场馆、会场

place on record: @@@LINK=put/place something on (the) record | be/go on (the) record (as saying…)
place on the record: @@@LINK=put/place something on (the) record | be/go on (the) record (as saying…)

senses.def: a small card with a person’s name on it, placed on a table to show where they are to sit
a kick made by putting the ball on the ground first
a mat
a name of a town or other place

examples.en: an expert on the origin of place names
examples.zh: 地名考源专家。

senses.def: a set or an arrangement of knives, forks and spoons, and/or plates and dishes for one person
a substance that has no physical effects, given to patients who do not need medicine but think that they do, or used when testing new drugs
senses.zh: 安慰剂，安慰药（给无实际治疗需要者或测试新药时使用）

examples.en: the placebo effect (= the effect of taking a placebo and feeling better)
examples.zh: 安慰剂效应

examples.en: Half of the people taking part in the experiment were given a placebo.
examples.zh: 参与药物试验者有半数所服用的是无效对照剂。

examples.en: The placebo effect means that any treatment will improve patients merely because they want to recover.
examples.zh: 安慰剂效应意味着任何治疗都会改善患者的病情，仅仅是因为他们想要康复。

senses.def: a symbol or piece of text that temporarily replaces something that is missing
senses.zh: （临时替代缺失部分的）占位符，占位文字

senses.def: an item which is necessary in a sentence, but does not have real meaning, for example the word ‘it’ in ‘It’s a shame she left.’
senses.zh: 位标（句子中必要但无实际意义的词项，如 It’s a shame she left 中的 it）

senses.def: a person who is given an official position as a reward for supporting a politician or government
senses.zh: 获赠官禄者（因支持某从政者或政府而得官职）

senses.def: the act of finding somebody a suitable job or place to live

examples.en: a job placement service
examples.zh: 职业介绍所

examples.en: placement with a foster family
examples.zh: 安置到寄养家庭

senses.def: a job, often as part of a course of study, where you get some experience of a particular kind of work

examples.en: The course includes a placement in Year 3.
examples.zh: 本课程第 3 年有实习课。

examples.en: The third year is spent on placement in selected companies.
examples.zh: 第三年是在选定的公司里实习。

senses.def: the act of placing something somewhere

examples.en: This procedure ensures correct placement of the catheter.
examples.zh: 这个程序可保证导管的正确置入。

senses.def: a test which is designed to find the appropriate level for students in a course or programme of study
senses.zh: （课程等的）分班考试，分级考试

senses.def: an organ inside the uterus
of or related to the placenta
having a placenta

examples.en: placental mammals
examples.zh: 胎盘哺乳动物

senses.def: the process of getting gold or other valuable minerals, usually from a river or lake, by washing away the sand that surrounds it
senses.zh: 砂矿开采；淘选采矿法；淘金

examples.en: placer mining operations
examples.zh: 砂金采矿作业

senses.def: not easily excited or annoyed

examples.en: a placid baby/horse
examples.zh: 安静的婴儿；驯良的马

examples.en: The cattle are placid, so easy to work with.
examples.zh: 这群牛性情温顺，很容易饲养。

senses.def: calm and peaceful, with very little movement

examples.en: the placid waters of the lake
examples.zh: 平静的湖水

senses.def: the quality in a person or an animal of not being easily excited or annoyed
senses.zh: 柔和度：人或动物不易兴奋或烦恼的品质

examples.en: Nothing could disturb her sweetness and placidity.
examples.zh: 没有什么可以打扰她的甜蜜和平静。

senses.def: the fact of being calm and peaceful, with very little movement
senses.zh: 镇定与和平，几乎没有动静

examples.en: the placidity of the English countryside
examples.zh: 英国乡村的宁静

senses.def: in a way that shows that you are not easily excited or annoyed
senses.zh: 平静地：以某种方式表明您不容易兴奋或烦恼

examples.en: ‘Of course,’ said Helen placidly.
examples.zh: “当然。”海伦平静地说道。

senses.def: in a calm and peaceful way, with very little movement

examples.en: The river sparkled placidly in the sun.
examples.zh: 河水在阳光下波光粼粼。

senses.def: the practice of copying another person's ideas, words or work and pretending that they are your own; an example of this

examples.en: There were accusations of plagiarism.
examples.zh: 曾有过剽窃的指控。

examples.en: a text full of plagiarisms
examples.zh: 满篇剽窃他人著作的文章

senses.def: a person who copies another person's ideas, words or work and pretends that they are their own
to copy another person’s ideas, words or work and pretend that they are your own

examples.en: He was accused of plagiarizing his colleague's results.
examples.zh: 他被指控剽窃同事的成果。

senses.def: a disease spread by rats

examples.en: a decline in population following outbreaks of plague
examples.zh: 瘟疫爆发后人口的下降

senses.def: any disease that spreads quickly and kills a lot of people

examples.en: the plague of AIDS
examples.zh: 艾滋病这种严重的传染病

senses.def: large numbers of an animal or insect that come into an area and cause great damage
senses.zh: （大批动物或昆虫肆虐造成的）灾害，祸患

examples.zh: 收音机里播放着我最喜爱的歌曲。

senses.def: to start working; to make a video or DVD start working

examples.en: These videos won't play on my computer.
examples.zh: 这些视频在我的电脑上不能播放。

examples.en: Click below to play videos.
examples.zh: 点击下方播放视频。

examples.en: Nothing happens when I try to play a DVD.
examples.zh: 当我尝试播放 DVD 时没有任何反应。

examples.en: A short video was played to the court showing the inside of the house.
examples.zh: 法庭上播放了一段展示房子内部情况的短视频。

senses.def: to act in a play, film, etc.; to act the role of somebody

examples.en: to play a role/part
examples.zh: 扮演一个角色

examples.en: The part of Elizabeth was played by Cate Blanchett.
examples.zh: 伊丽莎白一角由凯特·布兰切特扮演。

examples.en: He had always wanted to play Othello.
examples.zh: 他一直想扮演奥赛罗。

examples.en: He was chosen to play the role of Judas.
examples.zh: 他被选为扮演犹大的角色。

examples.en: She usually plays historical characters.
examples.zh: 她通常扮演历史人物。

examples.en: She played opposite Brad Pitt (= she and Brad Pitt played the two leading roles).
examples.zh: 她与布拉德·皮特演对手戏。

senses.def: to pretend to be something that you are not

examples.en: The children were dressed as soldiers, but they were just playing.
examples.zh: 孩子们扮成士兵，但他们只是在装着玩。

examples.en: I decided it was safer to play dead.
examples.zh: 我拿定主意装死会更安全些。

examples.en: He walks around playing the outraged victim in all this.
examples.zh: 在这一切中，他四处走动，扮演着愤怒的受害者。

senses.def: to behave as though you are a particular type of person

examples.en: This is no time to play the hero.
examples.zh: 这不是充英雄的时候。

examples.en: Don't play the innocent with me: you know what happened.
examples.zh: 别跟我装无辜：你知道发生了什么。

senses.def: to be performed

examples.en: A production of ‘Carmen’ was playing to packed houses.
examples.zh: 《卡门》一剧上演场场爆满。

senses.def: to give a performance in a particular place

examples.en: The band are playing 11 cities around the country.
examples.zh: 乐队正在全国 11 个城市巡演。

examples.en: I've played some fantastic venues.
examples.zh: 我在一些很棒的场馆里演出过。

senses.def: to have an effect or influence on something

examples.en: Social media played an important part in the last election.
examples.zh: 社交媒体在上一次选举中发挥了重要作用。

examples.en: Farming plays a crucial role in maintaining the landscape.
examples.zh: 农业在维护景观方面发挥着至关重要的作用。

examples.en: High environmental temperatures may also play a role.
examples.zh: 环境温度高也可能产生影响。

examples.en: Businesses can play their part by contributing some of their profits.
examples.zh: 企业可以通过贡献部分利润来发挥自己的作用。

examples.en: All countries have a part to play in protecting the environment.
examples.zh: 所有国家都有责任为保护环境做出贡献。

senses.def: to trick somebody for fun

examples.en: Children ran around the village playing tricks.
examples.zh: 孩子们在村子里跑来跑去捉弄人。

examples.en: I played a trick on him just to see his reaction.
examples.zh: 我捉弄他只是为了看看他的反应。

senses.def: to deal with a situation in the way mentioned

examples.en: He played the situation carefully for maximum advantage.
examples.zh: 他谨慎应付局面以获得最大利益。

senses.def: to do something without being serious about it or putting much effort into it

examples.en: He was just playing at it before—now he's serious.
examples.zh: 以前他只是敷衍应付，现在他认真了。

examples.en: They were playing at being villains, like in the movies.
examples.zh: 他们装扮成电影里的坏人。

examples.en: Officials are playing politics with farm programs.
examples.zh: 官员们正在农业项目上玩弄政治手段。

senses.group: not do something seriously 不认真做

senses.def: to be willing to work with other people in a helpful way, especially so that somebody can get what they want

examples.en: He needs another loan, but the bank won't play.
examples.zh: 他还需要一笔贷款，但银行不配合。

senses.group: be willing to help 愿意帮忙

senses.def: to move or appear quickly and lightly, often changing direction or shape

examples.en: Sunlight played on the surface of the lake.
examples.zh: 阳光在湖面上闪烁。

examples.en: A small smile played on her lips.
examples.zh: 她的嘴角浮现出一丝微笑。

senses.def: when a fountain

examples.en: Two huge fountains were playing outside the entrance.
examples.zh: 入口处有两个巨大的喷泉正在演奏。

senses.def: to have plenty of money, time, etc. for doing something
to masturbate
used to ask in an angry way about what somebody is doing
senses.zh: （气愤时的质问语）某人在搞什么名堂？

examples.en: What do you think you are playing at?
examples.zh: 你以为你在搞什么名堂？

senses.def: a piece of writing performed by actors in a theatre or on television or radio

examples.en: a stage/radio play
examples.zh: 舞台剧；广播剧

examples.en: She wrote a play for the students to perform.
examples.zh: 她写了一个剧本让学生们表演。

examples.en: to put on/stage a play
examples.zh: 上演一出戏

examples.en: to produce/direct a play
examples.zh: 制作／导演一出戏

examples.en: a play by Shakespeare
examples.zh: 一出莎士比亚的戏剧

senses.def: things that people, especially children, do for pleasure rather than as work

examples.en: the importance of learning through play
examples.zh: 寓教于乐的重要性

examples.en: Making time for both work and play is not easy.
examples.zh: 腾出时间工作和娱乐并不容易。

examples.en: the happy sounds of children at play
examples.zh: 儿童嬉戏的欢闹声

examples.en: The site offers sports facilities, including tennis courts, and a children's play area.
examples.zh: 酒店提供体育设施，包括网球场和儿童游乐区。

senses.def: the playing of a game
senses.zh: 比赛；赛风；比赛中的表现

examples.en: Rain stopped play.
examples.zh: 因雨停赛。

examples.en: There was some excellent play in yesterday's match.
examples.zh: 昨天的比赛有精彩的场面。

examples.en: The spectators were asked to be quiet during play.
examples.zh: 比赛期间要求观众保持安静。

examples.en: This video game has fast and exciting game play.
examples.zh: 这个电子游戏节奏很快，相当刺激。

examples.en: Does online play have a negative effect on gaming?
examples.zh: 在线游戏会对游戏产生负面影响吗？

senses.def: an action or move in a game

examples.en: He made several nice defensive plays.
examples.zh: 他完成了几次漂亮的防守。

examples.en: They are playing better now, making big plays at key times.
examples.zh: 他们现在打得更好了，在关键时刻打出精彩表现。

senses.def: the activity or operation of something; the influence of something on something else

examples.en: the free play of market forces
examples.zh: 市场力量的自由调节作用

examples.en: More powerful forces are in play.
examples.zh: 更强大的力量正在发挥作用。

examples.en: The financial crisis has brought new factors into play.
examples.zh: 财政危机已引发了新的变数。

examples.en: Personal feelings should not come into play when you are making business decisions.
examples.zh: 做商业决定时不应掺入个人感情。

examples.en: Other issues such as market power could be at play.
examples.zh: 市场力量等其他问题也可能发挥作用。

senses.def: the possibility of free and easy movement

examples.en: We need more play in the rope.
examples.zh: 我们需要再松一松绳子。

senses.def: a light, quick movement that keeps changing
senses.zh: 轻快变幻的动作；闪烁；闪现

examples.en: the play of sunlight on water
examples.zh: 阳光在水面上的闪烁

senses.def: it is not healthy to spend all your time working; you need to relax too
senses.zh: 只工作不玩耍，聪明的孩子也变傻

to make use of something

examples.en: Chess is a game that calls into play all your powers of concentration.
examples.zh: 国际象棋是一项需要全神贯注的活动。

senses.def: to spend time playing with a toy, game, etc.

examples.en: I had a play with the new computer game.
examples.zh: 我玩了一下这个新的电脑游戏。

senses.def: inside/outside the area allowed by the rules of the game

examples.en: She just managed to keep the ball in play.
examples.zh: 她把球勉强保持在界内。

senses.def: to emphasize the importance of a particular fact

examples.en: He made great play of the fact that his uncle was a duke.
examples.zh: 他特别强调自己的叔叔是位公爵。

senses.def: to try to obtain something; to do things that are intended to produce a particular result
senses.zh: 企图得到；处心积虑做事

examples.en: She was making a play for the sales manager's job.
examples.zh: 她千方百计要取得销售部经理的位置。

senses.def: the humorous use of a word or phrase that can have two different meanings
the stage that has been reached in a process, etc. which has not yet been completed

examples.en: What is the current state of play in the peace talks?
examples.zh: 和平谈判目前进展得怎么样？

senses.def: the score in a sports match, especially in cricket

note.en: Most idioms containing play are at the entries for the nouns and adjectives in the idioms, for example play the game is at game.
note.zh: 大多数含 play 的习语，都可在该等习语中的名词及形容词相关词条找到，如 play the game 在词条 game 下。

synonyms.words: fun ▪ recreation ▪ relaxation ▪ play ▪ pleasure ▪ amusement

intro.en: These are all words for things or activities used to entertain people when they are not working.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指休闲、娱乐或相关活动。

items.def: films, television, music, etc. used to entertain people:
items.zh: 指娱乐片、文娱节目、表演会等

examples.en: There are three bars, with live entertainment seven nights a week.
examples.zh: 有三家酒吧每周七个晚上都有现场文艺节目。

items.def: (rather informal) behaviour or activities that are not serious but are meant to be enjoyed:
items.zh: 指嬉戏、逗乐、玩笑

examples.en: It wasn’t serious—it was all done in fun.
examples.zh: 那不是认真的，全是闹着玩的。

items.def: (rather formal) things people do for pleasure when they are not working:
items.zh: 指娱乐、消遣

examples.en: His only form of recreation is playing football.
examples.zh: 他唯一的娱乐就是踢足球。

items.def: (rather formal) things people do to rest and enjoy themselves when they are not working; the ability to relax:
items.zh: 指休闲活动、消遣

examples.en: I go hill-walking for relaxation.
examples.zh: 我要是想放松放松，就到山上走走。

items.def: things that people, especially children, do for pleasure rather than as work:
items.zh: 尤指孩子游戏、玩耍、娱乐

examples.en: the happy sounds of children at play
examples.zh: 儿童嬉戏的欢闹声

items.def: the activity of enjoying yourself, especially in contrast to working:
items.zh: 指玩乐、休闲，尤与工作相对

examples.en: Are you in Paris for business or pleasure?
examples.zh: 你来巴黎公干还是游玩？

items.def: the fact of being entertained by something:
items.zh: 指娱乐、消遣、游戏

examples.en: What do you do for amusement round here?
examples.zh: 你在这儿以什么消遣？

senses.def: to play a cruel game with somebody in your power by changing your behaviour very often, so that they become nervous and do not know what to expect
senses.zh: 和某人玩起猫捉老鼠的游戏；耍弄

examples.en: He thought the police were playing some elaborate game of cat and mouse and waiting to trap him.
examples.zh: 他以为警察正在玩一场精心设计的猫捉老鼠的游戏，等着诱捕他。

examples.en: Young car thieves enjoy playing cat and mouse with the police.
examples.zh: 年轻的盗车贼喜欢与警察玩猫捉老鼠的把戏。

play (a game of) cat and mouse with some.word: play (a game of) cat and mouse with somebody | play a cat-and-mouse game with somebody

senses.def: to be careful; to avoid risks

examples.en: Play safe—keep out of the sun in the middle of the day.
examples.zh: 安全行事——中午避免阳光直射。

senses.def: to affect something/somebody badly
senses.zh: 对…造成严重影响；严重损害…

examples.en: Driving on these rough roads has played hell with my tyres.
examples.zh: 在这些崎岖不平的道路上行驶对我的轮胎造成了很大的伤害。

senses.def: to not be honest with somebody, especially in order to gain an advantage over them

examples.en: Don't play silly games with me; I know you did it.
examples.zh: 别跟我兜圈子，我知道是你干的。

senses.def: to play music by remembering how it sounds rather than by reading it
senses.zh: 凭记忆演奏；不看乐谱弹奏

examples.en: She usually plays the guitar by ear, rather than reading the music.
examples.zh: 他通常凭记忆来弹吉他，而不是靠看乐谱。

examples.en: Chris was in the park playing ball with the kids.
examples.zh: 克里斯在公园里和孩子们一起玩球。

senses.def: to be willing to work with other people in a helpful way, especially so that somebody can get what they want

examples.en: We contacted the airline about a refund but they wouldn’t play ball.
examples.zh: 我们联系了航空公司要求退款，但他们不肯配合。

senses.def: if somebody plays by their own rules

examples.en: If he wanted a loan he would have to play by the bank's rules.
examples.zh: 如果他想贷款的话，必须按银行的规定行事。

senses.def: to deal fairly and honestly with people
senses.zh: 按规则玩游戏；处事公正诚实；循规蹈矩

senses.def: to try to equal somebody that you are competing against in a sport or game or in business

examples.en: After our bad start to the season we were always playing catch-up.
examples.zh: 我们在赛季初表现不佳，之后一直在努力追赶。

examples.en: When it comes to digital technology, we're always playing catch-up with Japan.
examples.zh: 在数字技术方面，我们一直在追赶日本。

senses.def: to play a game in which people do something dangerous for as long as they can to show how brave they are. The person who stops first has lost the game.

examples.en: The children had been playing chicken by running across the railway line.
examples.zh: 孩子们一直在跑过铁路线玩胆小鬼游戏。

senses.def: to try to start a romantic relationship between two people
senses.zh: 扮演丘比特角色；牵线撮合

examples.en: She played Cupid to her two best friends when she set them up on a date together.
examples.zh: 她安排两位好友约会，为他们牵线撮合。

senses.def: to try to stop your opponent from scoring

examples.en: What they need is someone who can both score and play defense.
examples.zh: 他们需要的是一个既能得分又能防守的人。

senses.def: to respond to what others do in order to protect what you already have rather than try to gain more

examples.en: If you believe there will be shocks to the market, wouldn't you want a manager who can play defense?
examples.zh: 如果你相信市场会出现震荡，你难道不想要一个能防守的主教练吗？

senses.def: to behave or play a game in an unfair way

examples.en: We would have won if the other team hadn’t played dirty.
examples.zh: 要不是对方球队使诈犯规，我们本来能赢的。

senses.def: to treat somebody/something in a way that shows that you feel no responsibility or respect for them
senses.zh: 反复无常；若即若离；玩弄

senses.def: to touch somebody’s feet lightly with your own feet, especially under a table, as an expression of romantic interest
senses.zh: （在桌下）与某人脚碰脚调情，脚挨脚爱抚

senses.def: to work with somebody in a close but secret way
senses.zh: 与他人紧密但秘密地合作

examples.en: She accused the prime minister of playing footsie with the nationalists.
examples.zh: 她指责总理与民族主义者打交道。

senses.def: to find or create reasons why something has to be delayed, often so you have longer to prepare for it

examples.en: His legal team, clearly playing for time, sought to have the case heard a month later.
examples.zh: 他的律师团队明显是在拖延时间，请求一个月后对案子听证。

senses.def: to behave as if you control events or other people’s lives
senses.zh: 俨然如主宰一切的上帝

examples.en: It is unfair to ask doctors to play God and end someone's life.
examples.zh: 让医生扮演上帝的角色去结束一个人的生命是不公平的。

senses.def: to be a third person with two people who have a romantic relationship and want to be alone together
senses.zh: 当电灯泡（夹在情侣之间，不知趣）

senses.def: to do things that normal happy families do, especially when you want it to appear that your family is happy

examples.en: I'm not going to play happy families just for the benefit of your parents.
examples.zh: 我不会仅仅为了顾全你父母而装出合家欢的假象。

senses.def: to make yourself seem more attractive or interesting by not immediately accepting an invitation to do something
senses.zh: 故作姿态；故意摆谱；拿架子

senses.def: to stay away from school without permission
to stay away from school without permission
to play at being a family in its home

examples.en: The children were playing house, giving dinner to their dolls.
examples.zh: 孩子们在玩过家家，喂玩具娃娃吃饭。

senses.def: to do exactly what an enemy, opponent, etc. wants so that they gain the advantage in a particular situation
senses.zh: 干敌人（或对手等）所希望的事；做有利于敌人（或对手等）的事；授人以可乘之机

examples.en: If we get the police involved, we'll be playing right into the protesters' hands.
examples.zh: 如果出动警察，那将正中抗议者的下怀。

senses.def: to decide how to deal with a situation as it develops rather than by having a plan to follow
senses.zh: 见机行事；随机应变；根据情况需要行动

examples.en: I’m not sure how many people are expected—we’ll just have to play it by ear.
examples.zh: 我不知道会有多少人，我们只好随机应变了。

senses.def: to deal with a situation in a calm way and not show what you are really feeling
senses.zh: 沉着应付；冷静处理；不动声色

examples.en: I decided to play it cool and act like I had actually forgotten all about it.
examples.zh: 我决定表现得很冷静，表现得好像我实际上已经忘记了这一切。

senses.def: to be honest and not try to trick somebody
to pretend to be asleep or not aware of something, in order to trick somebody
to be treated as less important than somebody/something; to have a less important position than somebody/something else
senses.zh: 当二把手；当副手；居次要地位

examples.en: I’m not going to play second fiddle to anyone.
examples.zh: 我不会在任何人面前充当次要角色。

examples.en: The narrative in this book plays second fiddle to the excellent photographs.
examples.zh: 这本书中的叙述仅次于精彩的照片。

senses.def: to behave in a stupid and annoying way

examples.en: Stop playing silly buggers and give me a hand with this!
examples.zh: 别胡闹了，帮我一把!

senses.def: to do something that helps somebody else’s plans, especially by accident, when you did not intend to help them
to have sexual relationships with a lot of different people
to behave in a fair and honest way

examples.en: You can’t do that—it’s not playing the game!
examples.zh: 你不能这么做——这不是在玩游戏！

senses.def: to buy and sell stocks

examples.en: He is a skilled investor who knows how to play the market—and win.

examples.en: a pleasantly cool room
examples.zh: 凉爽宜人的房间

examples.en: I was pleasantly surprised by my exam results.
examples.zh: 我的考试成绩真让我喜出望外。

senses.def: in a friendly and polite way

examples.en: ‘Can I help you?’ he asked pleasantly.
examples.zh: “需要帮忙吗？”他和颜悦色地问。

senses.def: the fact of being fun or attractive or of giving pleasure
senses.zh: 愉悦：有趣或吸引人或给予快乐

examples.en: She remembered the pleasantness of the evening.
examples.zh: 她对那个愉快的夜晚记忆犹新。

senses.def: the quality of being friendly and polite
senses.zh: 愉快：友善和礼貌的品质

examples.en: good behaviour, politeness and pleasantness
examples.zh: 良好的行为、礼貌和愉快

senses.def: a friendly remark made in order to be polite

examples.en: After exchanging the usual pleasantries, they got down to serious discussion.
examples.zh: 互致寒暄之后，他们便开始严肃的讨论了。

senses.def: used as a polite way of asking for something or telling somebody to do something
senses.zh: （用于客气地请求或吩咐）请，请问

examples.en: Please sit down.
examples.zh: 请坐。

examples.en: Two coffees, please.
examples.zh: 请来两杯咖啡。

examples.en: Quiet please!
examples.zh: 请安静！

examples.en: Please could I leave early today?
examples.zh: 请问我今天早走一会儿行吗？

senses.def: used to add force to a request or statement
senses.zh: （用于加强请求或陈述的语气）请千万，请务必，的确

examples.en: Please don't leave me here alone.
examples.zh: 请千万别把我一个人留在这儿。

examples.en: Please, please don't forget.
examples.zh: 请务必务必不要忘记。

examples.en: Please, I don't understand what I have to do.
examples.zh: 我的确不明白我该做什么。

senses.def: used as a polite way of accepting something
senses.zh: （表示接受的客气话）太感谢了，太好了

examples.en: ‘Would you like some help?’ ‘Yes, please.’
examples.zh: “您需要帮忙吗？”“是的。太感谢了。”

examples.en: ‘Coffee?’ ‘Please.’
examples.zh: “要咖啡吗？”“那太好了。”

senses.def: used to ask somebody to stop behaving badly
senses.zh: （用于让别人停止不规矩行为）别闹了，行行好

examples.en: Children, please! I'm trying to work.
examples.zh: 孩子们，别闹了！我在干活呢。

examples.en: John! Please!
examples.zh: 约翰！老实点儿吧！

senses.def: used when you are replying to somebody who has said something that you think is stupid
senses.zh: （认为对方说话荒唐时用）得了吧，算了吧

examples.en: Oh, please! You cannot be serious.
examples.zh: 喔，得了吧！你准是在打哈哈。

senses.def: to make somebody happy

examples.en: You can't please everybody.
examples.zh: 你无法让每个人都满意。

examples.en: Children are usually easy to please.
examples.zh: 孩子们通常很容易取悦。

examples.en: He's a difficult man to please.
examples.zh: 他是个难以取悦的人。

examples.en: I was pleased by the results.
examples.zh: 我对结果很满意。

examples.en: There's just no pleasing some people (= some people are impossible to please).
examples.zh: 有些人你是没法让他们满意的。

examples.en: I did it to please my parents.
examples.zh: 我这么做是要让父母高兴。

examples.en: You must be pleased by their confidence in you.
examples.zh: 他们对你很有信心，你一定为此高兴。

examples.en: It pleased him to see the children playing with their gifts.
examples.zh: 看到孩子们玩着他们的礼物，他很高兴。

examples.en: She's always very eager to please.
examples.zh: 她总是急欲取悦别人。

examples.en: This film is sure to please horror fans.
examples.zh: 这部电影肯定会令恐怖迷们满意。

examples.en: These guys aim to please and they never fail.
examples.zh: 这些人的目标是取悦他人，而且他们永远不会失败。

senses.def: often used after as
senses.zh: （常用在 as 或 what、where 等词后）想，选择，喜欢

examples.en: You may stay as long as you please.
examples.zh: 你想待多久就待多久。

examples.en: She always does exactly as she pleases.
examples.zh: 她总是我行我素。

examples.en: I'm free now to live wherever I please.
examples.zh: 我现在想住哪里就住哪里。

senses.def: used when politely asking somebody to do something

examples.en: Take a seat, if you please.
examples.zh: 请坐吧。

senses.def: used to say that you are annoyed or surprised at somebody’s actions
senses.zh: （用于对某人的行为表示气愤或惊异）你们听听，岂有此理

examples.en: And now, if you please, he wants me to rewrite the whole thing!
examples.zh: 哼！你们听听，他竟要我全部重写！

senses.def: to be very attractive to look at
used to say that you very much hope or wish that something will happen or not happen
senses.zh: （表示殷切期望）但愿老天帮忙，上帝保佑

examples.en: Please God, don't let him be dead.
examples.zh: 老天爷呀！千万别让他死啊。

senses.def: used to tell somebody that you are annoyed with them and do not care what they do
senses.zh: （表示恼怒和不关心）随你的便，悉听尊便

examples.en: ‘I don't think I'll bother finishing this.’ ‘Please yourself.’
examples.zh: “我想我不会费力做完这件事。”“随你的便。”

senses.def: to be able to do whatever you like

examples.en: There were no children to cook for, so we could just please ourselves.
examples.zh: 因为不用给孩子做饭，我们就可以自便了。

senses.def: too proud of something you have done

examples.en: He was looking very pleased with himself.
examples.zh: 他显得沾沾自喜。

senses.def: in a way that gives you pleasure or makes you feel satisfied
senses.zh: 令人高兴的；令人满意的

examples.en: She had a pleasingly direct manner.
examples.zh: 她为人直爽，令人愉快。

senses.def: giving pleasure

examples.en: a pleasurable experience
examples.zh: 愉快的经历

examples.en: We do everything we can to make your trip pleasurable.
examples.zh: 我们会尽力使你的旅途愉快。

senses.def: with pleasure

examples.en: He sipped his coffee pleasurably.
examples.zh: 他怡然地品着咖啡。

senses.def: a state of feeling or being happy or satisfied
senses.zh: 高兴；快乐；愉快；欣慰；满意

examples.en: His eyes lit up with pleasure.
examples.zh: 他高兴得双眼放光。

examples.en: Encourage your child to read for pleasure.
examples.zh: 鼓励您的孩子为了快乐而阅读。

examples.en: He takes no pleasure in his work.
examples.zh: 他从他的工作中得不到丝毫乐趣。

examples.en: She took pleasure in shocking her parents.
examples.zh: 她以震惊父母为乐。

examples.en: A large number of people fail to derive any pleasure at all from horror movies.
examples.zh: 很多人根本无法从恐怖电影中获得任何乐趣。

examples.en: He gets a lot of pleasure out of watching his children perform.
examples.zh: 观看儿女表演带给他很多乐趣。

examples.en: She had the pleasure of seeing him look surprised.
examples.zh: 看他好像吃了一惊，她感到开心。

examples.en: We request the pleasure of your company at the marriage of our daughter Lisa.
examples.zh: 敬请光临小女莉萨的婚礼。

examples.en: May I have the pleasure of the next dance?
examples.zh: 你肯赏光和我跳下一曲舞吗？

examples.en: the sheer pleasure of performing music
examples.zh: 演奏音乐的纯粹乐趣

examples.en: I was touched by her genuine pleasure at her mother's present.
examples.zh: 收到母亲的礼物，她感到由衷的高兴，这使我深受感动。

examples.en: The band's pleasure at being back in Dublin was clear.
examples.zh: 乐队对于回到都柏林的喜悦是显而易见的。

examples.en: It gives me great pleasure to introduce our guest speaker.
examples.zh: 我很荣幸来介绍我们的演讲嘉宾。

examples.en: Caring for a sick relative is a task that brings both pleasure and pain.
examples.zh: 照顾生病的亲戚是一项既带来快乐又带来痛苦的任务。

examples.en: The photographs are now available for your viewing pleasure.
examples.zh: 这些照片目前可供一饱眼福。

senses.def: the activity of enjoying yourself, especially in contrast to working

examples.en: Are you in Paris on business or pleasure?
examples.zh: 你来巴黎是公干还是游玩？

examples.en: a pleasure boat/trip
examples.zh: 游船/旅行

senses.def: a thing that makes you happy or satisfied

examples.en: the simple pleasures of the countryside
examples.zh: 乡村淳朴的乐趣

examples.en: the pleasures and pains of everyday life
examples.zh: 日常生活的苦与乐

examples.en: Swimming is one of my greatest pleasures.
examples.zh: 游泳是我最大的乐趣之一。

examples.en: Chocolate is one of life’s little pleasures.
examples.zh: 吃块巧克力是生活中小小的乐事之一。

examples.en: This movie was one of the unexpected pleasures of the Film Festival.
examples.zh: 这部电影是电影节的意外惊喜之一。

examples.en: It's a pleasure to meet you.
examples.zh: 很高兴认识你。

examples.en: ‘Thanks for doing that.’ ‘It's a pleasure.’
examples.zh: “这事真是麻烦您了。”“不客气。”

senses.def: as you want; as somebody else wants
senses.zh: 根据你的（或某人的）意愿；随意

examples.en: The land can be sold at the owner's pleasure.
examples.zh: 这块地可随主人的意愿出售。

senses.def: something that you enjoy, even though you feel it is not really a good thing

examples.en: Daytime TV is one of my guilty pleasures.
examples.zh: 收看不用动脑子的日间电视节目是我的一大心虚乐事。

senses.def: used as a polite way of replying when somebody thanks you for doing something, to show that you were happy to do it
senses.zh: （对别人表示感谢的一种礼貌回答）不客气，很乐意效劳

senses.def: used as a polite way of accepting or agreeing to something
senses.zh: （客气地接受或同意）当然了，很愿意

examples.en: ‘May I sit here?’ ‘Yes, with pleasure.’
examples.zh: “我可以坐在这儿吗？”“当然可以。”

synonyms.words: pleasure ▪ (a) good time ▪ enjoyment ▪ (a) great time

intro.en: These are all words for the feeling of enjoying yourself, or activities or time that you enjoy.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示愉快、快乐的事、欢乐的时光。

items.def: (rather informal) the feeling of enjoying yourself; activities that you enjoy:
items.zh: 指享乐、乐趣、享乐的事

examples.en: We had a lot of fun at Sarah’s party.
examples.zh: 我们在萨拉的聚会上玩得很开心。

items.def: (rather formal) the feeling of enjoying yourself or being satisfied:
items.zh: 指高兴、快乐、愉快、满意

examples.en: Reading for pleasure and reading for study are not the same.
examples.zh: 读书以自娱和读书以学习是不相同的。

items.def: (rather informal) a time that you spend enjoying yourself:
items.zh: 指欢乐、愉快的时光

examples.en: We had a good time in Spain.
examples.zh: 我们在西班牙过得很愉快。

items.def: (rather formal) the feeling of enjoying yourself:
items.zh: 指愉快、快乐、乐趣

examples.en: I get a lot of enjoyment from music.
examples.zh: 我从音乐中获得很多乐趣。

items.def: (rather informal) a time that you spend enjoying yourself very much:
items.zh: 指非常欢乐、愉快的时光

examples.en: We had a really great time together.
examples.zh: 我们一起度过了非常快乐的时光。

synonyms.words: fun ▪ recreation ▪ relaxation ▪ play ▪ pleasure ▪ amusement

intro.en: These are all words for things or activities used to entertain people when they are not working.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指休闲、娱乐或相关活动。

items.def: films, television, music, etc. used to entertain people:
items.zh: 指娱乐片、文娱节目、表演会等

examples.en: There are three bars, with live entertainment seven nights a week.
examples.zh: 有三家酒吧每周七个晚上都有现场文艺节目。

items.def: (rather informal) behaviour or activities that are not serious but are meant to be enjoyed:
items.zh: 指嬉戏、逗乐、玩笑

examples.en: It wasn’t serious—it was all done in fun.
examples.zh: 那不是认真的，全是闹着玩的。

items.def: (rather formal) things people do for pleasure when they are not working:
items.zh: 指娱乐、消遣

examples.en: His only form of recreation is playing football.
examples.zh: 他唯一的娱乐就是踢足球。

items.def: (rather formal) things people do to rest and enjoy themselves when they are not working; the ability to relax:
items.zh: 指休闲活动、消遣

examples.en: I go hill-walking for relaxation.
examples.zh: 我要是想放松放松，就到山上走走。

items.def: things that people, especially children, do for pleasure rather than as work:
items.zh: 尤指孩子游戏、玩耍、娱乐

examples.en: the happy sounds of children at play
examples.zh: 儿童嬉戏的欢闹声

items.def: the activity of enjoying yourself, especially in contrast to working:
items.zh: 指玩乐、休闲，尤与工作相对

examples.en: Are you in Paris for business or pleasure?
examples.zh: 你来巴黎公干还是游玩？

items.def: the fact of being entertained by something:
items.zh: 指娱乐、消遣、游戏

examples.en: What do you do for amusement round here?
examples.zh: 你在这儿以什么消遣？

intro.en: These are all words for things that make you happy or that you enjoy.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指令人愉快、高兴的事。

items.def: a thing that makes you happy or satisfied:
items.zh: 乐事；快事

examples.en: the pleasures and pains of everyday life
examples.zh: 日常生活的苦与乐

items.def: a thing or person that brings you great pleasure:
items.zh: 指令人高兴的事或人、乐事、乐趣

examples.en: the delights of living in the country
examples.zh: 生活在乡村的乐趣

items.def: a thing or person that brings you great pleasure or happiness:
items.zh: 指令人高兴的事或人、乐事、乐趣

examples.en: the joys and sorrows of childhood
examples.zh: 童年的欢乐与悲伤

items.def: (rather formal) something that you are proud and lucky to have the opportunity to do:
items.zh: 指荣幸、荣耀、光荣

examples.en: It was a great privilege to hear her sing.
examples.zh: 听她唱歌是莫大的荣幸。

items.def: (informal) a thing that somebody enjoyed or is likely to enjoy very much:
items.zh: 指乐事、乐趣

examples.en: You’ve never been to this area before? Then you’re in for a real treat.
examples.zh: 你以前从来没有到过这一地区？那么你一定会喜之不尽。

items.def: (formal) something that you are very pleased or proud to do because people are showing you great respect:
items.zh: 指荣幸、光荣

examples.en: It was a great honour to be invited here today.
examples.zh: 今天承蒙邀请到此，深感荣幸。

senses.def: a boat used for short pleasure trips
a permanent fold in a piece of cloth, made by sewing

examples.en: a shirt with narrow pleats at the front
examples.zh: 前面有窄褶的衬衫

senses.def: having pleats

examples.en: a pleated skirt
examples.zh: 有褶的裙子

senses.def: a plastic material that looks like leather

examples.en: a pleather jacket
examples.zh: 塑料皮革上衣

senses.def: an offensive word for an ordinary person, especially one who is poor or not well educated
a first-year student at a military or naval
connected with ordinary people or people of the lower social classes
senses.zh: 平民的；百姓的；下层社会的

examples.en: Such recreational activities were an essential part of plebeian culture.
examples.zh: 这种娱乐活动是平民文化的重要组成部分。

senses.def: having or showing no culture or education

examples.en: plebeian tastes
examples.zh: 庸俗的趣味

senses.def: a person from a lower social class (used originally in ancient Rome)
senses.zh: 下层人，平民，庶民（原用于古罗马）

senses.def: a vote by the people of a country or a region on an issue that is very important

examples.en: to hold a plebiscite on the country’s future system of government
examples.zh: 就国家未来的政府体制举行公民投票

senses.def: a small piece of metal, plastic, etc. used for plucking
to formally promise to give or do something
senses.zh: 保证给予（或做）；正式承诺

examples.en: Japan has pledged $100 million in humanitarian aid.
examples.zh: 日本已承诺提供一亿美元人道主义援助。

examples.en: The government pledged their support for the plan.
examples.zh: 政府保证支持这个计划。

examples.en: We all had to pledge allegiance to the flag (= state that we are loyal to our country).
examples.zh: 我们都必须对国旗宣誓效忠。

examples.en: The group has pledged to continue campaigning.
examples.zh: 这个组织发誓继续投入运动。

examples.en: The group has pledged that they will continue campaigning.
examples.zh: 这个组织发誓他们将继续投入运动。

senses.def: to make somebody or yourself formally promise to do something

examples.en: They were all pledged to secrecy.
examples.zh: 他们都宣誓保密。

examples.en: The government has pledged itself to root out corruption.
examples.zh: 政府已承诺铲除腐败。

senses.def: to leave something with somebody as a pledge
to promise to become a junior member of a fraternity
senses.zh: 宣誓参加美国大学生联谊会

examples.en: Do you think you'll pledge this semester?
examples.zh: 这学期你会加入大学生联谊会吗？

examples.en: My brother pledged Sigma Nu (= promised to join the Sigma Nu fraternity)
examples.zh: 我哥哥宣誓加入了 ΣΝ 兄弟会。

senses.def: a serious promise

examples.en: a pledge of support
examples.zh: 支援的许诺

examples.en: Will the government honour its election pledge not to raise taxes?
examples.zh: 政府会履行其竞选诺言，不增加税收吗？

examples.en: to fulfil/break/abandon a pledge
examples.zh: 履行/违背/放弃承诺

examples.en: Management has made a pledge that there will be no job losses this year.
examples.zh: 资方保证今年不会削减工作职位。

senses.def: a sum of money or something valuable that you leave with somebody to prove that you will do something or pay back money that you owe
to make a promise never to drink alcohol
to make a promise never to drink alcohol
to be attended by everyone who has the right to attend

examples.en: The new committee holds its first plenary session this week.
examples.zh: 新委员会本周举行第一次全会。

senses.def: without any limit; complete

examples.en: The Council has plenary powers to administer the agreement.
examples.zh: 理事会拥有全权执行这项协议。

senses.def: a plenary
having full powers to take action, make decisions, etc. to represent a government, especially in a foreign country
senses.zh: 拥有采取行动、做出决定等的全部权力。代表政府，尤指在外国

examples.en: plenipotentiary powers
examples.zh: 全权

examples.en: a plenipotentiary representative
examples.zh: 全权代表

senses.def: a person who has full powers to take action, make decisions, etc. to represent their government, especially in a foreign country
