senses.def: in a way that has a strong effect on your feelings, especially when it makes you feel sad
senses.zh: 令人沉痛的；悲惨的；酸楚的

examples.en: Their experiences of war are poignantly described.
examples.zh: 书中对他们的战争经历进行了深刻的描述。

senses.def: a tropical plant with large red or pink leaves that grow to look like flowers, often grown indoors in pots
a thing that somebody says or writes giving their opinion or stating a fact

examples.en: She made several interesting points in the article.
examples.zh: 她在文章中提出了几个有趣的观点。

examples.en: I take your point (= understand and accept what you are saying).
examples.zh: 我赞同你的看法。

examples.en: He's just saying that to prove a point (= to show his idea is right).
examples.zh: 他那样说只是为了证明他的看法。

examples.en: OK, you've made your point!
examples.zh: 好了，你已经把话说清楚了！

senses.def: the main or most important idea in something that is said or done

examples.en: The point is you shouldn't have to wait so long to see a doctor.
examples.zh: 关键是看病不该等那么长时间。

examples.en: I wish he would get to the point (= say it quickly).
examples.zh: 但愿他快点说正题。

examples.en: I'll come straight to the point: we need more money.
examples.zh: 我就直说吧：我们还需要钱。

examples.en: Do you see my point (= understand)?
examples.zh: 你明白我的意思吗？

examples.en: I think I missed the point (= did not understand).
examples.zh: 我想我没听懂。

examples.en: You have a point (= your idea is right)—it would be better to wait till this evening.
examples.zh: 你说的有道理，还是等到今天晚上比较好。

examples.en: ‘There won’t be anywhere to park.’ ‘Oh, that’s a (good) point.’ (= I had not thought of that)
examples.zh: “会找不到地方停车。”“嗯，还真是。”

examples.en: It just isn't true. That's the whole point (= the only important fact).
examples.zh: 最重要的是，那根本不是事实。

examples.en: I thought the whole point was getting the same amount done with less effort.
examples.zh: 我认为重点是用更少的努力完成相同的工作量。

examples.en: ‘He's been married before.’ ‘That's beside the point (= not important).’
examples.zh: “他结过婚。”“那不重要。”

examples.en: I know it won't cost very much but that's not the point (= not the important thing).
examples.zh: 我知道那花不了多少钱，但这不是重点。

examples.en: The point behind the film was to help people understand the motivations of the criminals.
examples.zh: 影片的目的是帮助人们了解犯罪分子的动机。

senses.def: the purpose or aim of something

examples.en: What's the point of all this violence?
examples.zh: 这些暴行的意图何在？

examples.en: ‘Why don't you try again?’ ‘What's the point?’
examples.zh: “你为什么不再试一次呢？”“有用吗？”

examples.en: The point of the lesson is to compare the two countries.
examples.zh: 本课的目的是比较这两个国家。

examples.en: I don't see the point of doing it all again.
examples.zh: 我就不明白，再做一次有什么意义。

examples.en: There's no point in getting angry.
examples.zh: 发火是没有用的。

senses.def: a particular detail or fact

examples.en: Can you explain that point again?
examples.zh: 你能再解释一下那一点吗？

examples.en: Summarize the main points of the argument.
examples.zh: 请总结论述的要点。

examples.en: I should like to highlight the key points.
examples.zh: 我想强调几个要点。

examples.en: An important point has been missed out.
examples.zh: 漏了一个要点。

examples.en: You raise an interesting point.
examples.zh: 你提出了一个有趣的问题。

senses.def: a particular quality or feature that somebody/something has

examples.en: Tact is not one of her strong points.
examples.zh: 她不善于圆通处事。

examples.en: Read the manual to learn the program's finer points (= small details).
examples.zh: 读一下指南，以了解这一程序的细节。

examples.en: Living in Scotland has its good points but the weather is not one of them.
examples.zh: 在苏格兰生活有其优点，但天气不好。

examples.en: One of the hotel's plus points (= good features) is that it is very central.
examples.zh: 这个旅馆的一大优点是它位于市中心。

examples.en: There is not a single weak point in his essay.
examples.zh: 他的文章没有任何弱点。

senses.def: a particular time or stage of development

examples.en: We had reached the point when there was no money left.
examples.zh: 我们曾落到身无分文的地步。

examples.en: The climber was at the point of death when they found him.
examples.zh: 当他们发现那个登山者的时候，他已奄奄一息。

examples.en: At one point he looked like winning.
examples.zh: 有一刻他似乎就要赢了。

examples.en: Many people experience anxiety at some point in their lives.
examples.zh: 许多人在一生中的某个时刻都会经历焦虑。

examples.en: At this point in time we just have to wait.
examples.zh: 到这种时刻，我们只好等待了。

examples.en: At this point I don't care what you decide to do.
examples.zh: 到这个时候，我不在乎你决定要怎么做了。

examples.en: Up to that point we were living in London.
examples.zh: 那时我们正住在伦敦。

senses.def: a particular place or area

examples.en: I'll wait for you at the meeting point in the arrivals hall.
examples.zh: 我将在到港大厅的迎接处等你。

examples.en: the point at which the river divides
examples.zh: 河流分岔点

examples.en: Draw a line from point A to point B.
examples.zh: 从 A 点到 B 点画一条线。

examples.en: No parking beyond this point.
examples.zh: 请勿越界停车。

senses.def: one of the marks of direction around a compass

examples.en: the points of the compass (= N, S, E, W, etc.)
examples.zh: 罗盘上的罗经点

senses.def: an individual unit that adds to a score in a game or sports competition

examples.en: to win/lose a point
examples.zh: 赢／输一分

examples.en: Australia finished 20 points ahead.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚队终局领先 20 分。

examples.en: Players score points for finding words not found by any other player.
examples.zh: 玩家发现其他玩家未发现的单词即可得分。

examples.en: You get bonus points for answering the mystery question.
examples.zh: 回答神秘问题即可获得奖励积分。

examples.en: They won on points (= by scoring more points rather than by completely defeating their opponents).
examples.zh: 他们以点数取胜。

senses.def: a mark or unit on a scale of measurement

examples.en: The party's share of the vote fell by ten percentage points.
examples.zh: 该党的得票率下跌了十个百分点。

senses.def: a unit of credit towards an award or benefit

examples.en: Applicants are awarded points on criteria such as education, skills and knowledge of English.
examples.zh: 申请人将根据教育、技能和英语水平等标准评分。

examples.en: Let children trade their earned points for privileges, like extra playtime.
examples.zh: 让孩子们用赚取的积分换取特权，例如额外的游戏时间。

senses.def: the sharp, thin end of something

examples.en: the point of a pencil/knife/pin
examples.zh: 铅笔／刀／大头针尖

senses.def: a narrow piece of land that stretches into the sea

examples.en: The ship sailed around the point.
examples.zh: 那条船绕过了岬角。

examples.en: Pagoda Point
examples.zh: 宝塔角

senses.def: a small round mark used in writing, especially the mark that separates a whole number from the part that comes after it

examples.en: two point six (2.6)
examples.zh: 二点六

examples.en: a decimal point
examples.zh: 小数点

examples.en: We broadcast on ninety-five point nine (95.9) FM.
examples.zh: 我们以调频 95.9 播音。

senses.def: a very small dot

examples.en: The stars were points of light in the sky.
examples.zh: 天空中的点点光亮就是星星。

senses.def: a place in a wall, etc. where a piece of equipment can be connected to electricity

examples.en: a power/shaver/telephone point
examples.zh: 电源／剃须刀／电话插座

senses.def: the hard tops of the toes of a kind of shoe that a ballet
a piece of track at a place where a railway line divides that can be moved to allow a train to change tracks
a unit of measurement for the size of letters in printing or on a computer screen, etc.
senses.zh: （印刷物或计算机屏幕上字体大小的单位）点，磅值

examples.en: Change the text to 10 point.
examples.zh: 把文本字体大小变为 10 点。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: to repeat an idea, argument, etc. many times to emphasize it, especially when it has already been mentioned or understood
senses.zh: 一再强调观点（或论点等）

examples.en: I don’t want to belabour the point, but it’s vital you understand how important this is.
examples.zh: 我不想赘述这一点，但了解这一点的重要性至关重要。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: a clear example of the problem, situation, etc. that is being discussed

examples.en: Many professions feel they deserve higher pay, and nurses are a case in point.
examples.zh: 许多行业的从业人员觉得他们应该得到更高的报酬，护士就是很好的例子。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: the more complicated or detailed aspects of something

examples.en: She seems at ease discussing the finer points of foreign policy.
examples.zh: 她似乎很轻松地讨论外交政策的细节。

examples.en: He learnt the finer points of cricket during a trip to London.
examples.zh: 他在伦敦之行中学到了板球的精髓。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: used when you have to decide something or say what you really think
senses.zh: 必须作决定（或亮明观点）时

examples.en: When it comes to the point, he always changes his mind.
examples.zh: 他总是关键时候变卦。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: used to say what is true in a situation

examples.en: In point of fact, she is their adopted daughter.
examples.zh: 实际上，她是他们的养女。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: to continue to repeat or explain something that has already been said and understood
senses.zh: 一再重复，反复解释（已说明的事）

examples.en: I understand what you’re saying—there’s no need to labour the point.
examples.zh: 我理解你说的话——没必要一再解释了。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: to be or make sure you do something because it is important or necessary
senses.zh: （因重要或必要）保证做，必定做

examples.en: I made a point of closing all the windows before leaving the house.
examples.zh: 我离家前必定要把所有的窗子都关好。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: a matter about which there may be difference of opinion or a lack of understanding
senses.zh: 悬而未决的事；有争议的问题

examples.en: Whether this should be enforced by law or not is a moot point.
examples.zh: 这是否应该通过法律强制执行是一个有争议的问题。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: used to say that something is more important than something else

examples.en: I couldn't do the job—I've never been to Spain and, more to the point, I don't speak Spanish.
examples.zh: 这个工作我做不了 － 我从未去过西班牙；而更重要的是，我不会说西班牙语。

examples.en: More to the point, did they get away?
examples.zh: 更重要的是，他们逃走了吗？

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: used to emphasize something that is expressed clearly and directly, especially a criticism
senses.zh: 直截了当地说，不客气地说（尤指批评）

examples.en: Not to put too fine a point on it, I think you are lying.
examples.zh: 不客气地说，我认为你在撒谎。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: appropriate or relevant to the situation

examples.en: The quotation was directly on point.
examples.zh: 这段话引用得恰到好处。

examples.en: Let's stay on point.
examples.zh: 咱们不要偏离主题。

examples.en: None of the replies was on point.
examples.zh: 所有的回答都没有说到点子上。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: perfect; exactly right for the occasion

examples.en: The music here is totally on point.
examples.zh: 这里的音乐恰到好处。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: to be close to doing something; to be going to do something very soon

examples.en: I was just on the point of calling you.
examples.zh: 我刚才正要叫你。

examples.en: We were on the point of giving up.
examples.zh: 我们当时几乎要放弃了。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: a place where you go or a person that you speak to when you are dealing with an organization

examples.en: The receptionist is the first point of contact most people have with the clinic.
examples.zh: 多数人与诊所接触的第一个人是接待员。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: a place where a journey starts
senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: an idea, a theory or an event that is used to start a discussion, an activity, etc.

examples.en: The author takes Freud's dream theories as the point of departure for his essay.
examples.zh: 作者以弗洛伊德的释梦理论作为他论文的出发点。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: a thing that somebody considers to be very important for their honour or reputation
senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: the time when you must continue with what you have decided to do, because it is not possible to get back to an earlier situation
senses.zh: 欲罢不能的时刻；已无退路；不可能回头

examples.en: We have passed the point of no return.
examples.zh: 我们已经过了无法回头的地步。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: used to say that you accept that somebody else is right when they have disagreed with you or criticized you
senses.zh: （接受相反的意见）同意，好吧，算你有理

examples.en: Point taken. Let's drop the subject.
examples.zh: 好吧。咱们就抛开这个话题吧。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: to show that you are better than somebody, especially by making clever remarks, for example in an argument
senses.zh: （尤指在辩论等活动中机灵地）驳倒，挫败

examples.en: He was always trying to score points off his teachers.
examples.zh: 他总是想从老师那里得到分数。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: a subject that makes you feel angry or upset when it is mentioned

examples.en: It's a sore point with Sue's parents that the children have not been baptized yet.
examples.zh: 孩子们至今未受洗礼，这是休的父母的一块心病。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: to allow or do something that is not usually acceptable, especially because of a particular situation

examples.en: I was hoping they would stretch a point and let me stay on for a while.
examples.zh: 我希望他们能延长一点，让我继续呆一段时间。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: expressed in a simple, clear way without any extra information or feelings

examples.en: The letter was short and to the point.
examples.zh: 这封信简短扼要。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: to a degree that can be described as something

examples.en: He was rude to the point of being aggressive.
examples.zh: 他粗鲁到蛮不讲理的地步。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: to some extent; to some degree but not completely

examples.en: I agree with you up to a point.
examples.zh: 我在某种程度上同意你的看法。

senses.group: size of letters 字符大小

senses.def: to stretch out your finger or something held in your hand towards somebody/something in order to show somebody where a person or thing is

examples.en: ‘What's your name?’ he asked, pointing at the child with his pen.
examples.zh: 他用笔指着小孩问：“你叫什么名字？”

examples.en: ‘That's my mother,’ she said, pointing at a photo on the wall.
examples.zh: “那是我的母亲，”她指着墙上的照片说道。

examples.en: He pointed to the spot where the house used to stand.
examples.zh: 他指出那所房子原来所在的地方。

examples.en: She shook her head and pointed to him again.
examples.zh: 她摇摇头，再次指着他。

examples.en: He said my name and pointed towards me.
examples.zh: 他叫我的名字，然后用手指着我。

examples.en: She pointed in my direction.
examples.zh: 她指向我这边。

examples.en: It's rude to point!
examples.zh: 用手指人很不礼貌啊！

examples.en: She pointed her finger in my direction.
examples.zh: 她指着我这个方向。

examples.en: She pointed with her finger at the map.
examples.zh: 她用手指着地图。

senses.group: show with finger 用手指示意

senses.def: to aim something at somebody/something

examples.en: He pointed the gun at her head.
examples.zh: 他举枪对准了她的头。

examples.en: A hundred camera lenses were being pointed at her.
examples.zh: 一百架相机镜头对着她。

examples.en: He simply points the camera and shoots with simplicity and realism.
examples.zh: 他只需将相机对准并拍摄，简单而真实。

senses.def: to face in or be directed towards a particular direction

examples.en: The telescope was pointing in the wrong direction.
examples.zh: 望远镜对错了方向。

examples.en: The signpost pointed straight ahead.
examples.zh: 路标直指前方。

examples.en: A compass needle points north.
examples.zh: 罗盘指针指向北方。

examples.en: The gun was pointing straight at me.
examples.zh: 枪直对着我。

examples.en: The sign pointed right.
examples.zh: 标志指向右边。

senses.def: to direct your cursor
senses.zh: （在屏幕上）用光标指着；链接（浏览器）到

examples.en: Shopping on the Web is pretty simple—you just point and click and wait.
examples.zh: 网上购物很简单，只需将光标对准，点击并等待。

examples.en: Point your browser to www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com.
examples.zh: 用浏览器打开网页 www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com。

senses.def: to lead to or suggest a particular development or logical argument

examples.en: The evidence seems to point in that direction.
examples.zh: 证据似乎指向那个方向。

examples.en: The fans are looking to the new players to point the way to victory.
examples.zh: 球迷都在指望新球员指明胜利之路。

senses.def: to show somebody which way to go

examples.en: I wonder if you could point me in the right direction for the bus station.
examples.zh: 请问您能指点我到公共汽车站往哪个方向走吗？

examples.en: A series of yellow arrows pointed the way to reception.
examples.zh: 连续的黄色箭头标出了通往接待处的路。

examples.en: ‘You must cross that field,’ she said, pointing the way.
examples.zh: “你必须从田野中穿过去， ”她指 路说。

senses.def: to stretch your toes and foot so that they form a straight line with your leg

examples.en: Reach up with your arms and point your toes.
examples.zh: 手臂向上伸展，脚尖绷直。

senses.def: to put mortar

examples.en: The house needs pointing before winter.
examples.zh: 房子在冬天之前需要指点。

senses.def: to accuse somebody of doing something

examples.en: The article points an accusing finger at the authorities.
examples.zh: 那篇文章谴责了当局。

senses.def: to repeat an idea, argument, etc. many times to emphasize it, especially when it has already been mentioned or understood
senses.zh: 一再强调观点（或论点等）

examples.en: I don’t want to belabour the point, but it’s vital you understand how important this is.
examples.zh: 我不想赘述这一点，但了解这一点的重要性至关重要。

senses.def: a clear example of the problem, situation, etc. that is being discussed

examples.en: Many professions feel they deserve higher pay, and nurses are a case in point.
examples.zh: 许多行业的从业人员觉得他们应该得到更高的报酬，护士就是很好的例子。

senses.def: the more complicated or detailed aspects of something

examples.en: She seems at ease discussing the finer points of foreign policy.
examples.zh: 她似乎很轻松地讨论外交政策的细节。

examples.en: He learnt the finer points of cricket during a trip to London.
examples.zh: 他在伦敦之行中学到了板球的精髓。

senses.def: a place where you go or a person that you speak to when you are dealing with an organization

examples.en: The receptionist is the first point of contact most people have with the clinic.
examples.zh: 多数人与诊所接触的第一个人是接待员。

senses.def: a place where a journey starts
an idea, a theory or an event that is used to start a discussion, an activity, etc.

examples.en: The author takes Freud's dream theories as the point of departure for his essay.
examples.zh: 作者以弗洛伊德的释梦理论作为他论文的出发点。

senses.def: a thing that somebody considers to be very important for their honour or reputation
the time when you must continue with what you have decided to do, because it is not possible to get back to an earlier situation
senses.zh: 欲罢不能的时刻；已无退路；不可能回头

examples.en: We have passed the point of no return.
examples.zh: 我们已经过了无法回头的地步。

senses.def: used to say that you accept that somebody else is right when they have disagreed with you or criticized you
senses.zh: （接受相反的意见）同意，好吧，算你有理

examples.en: Point taken. Let's drop the subject.
examples.zh: 好吧。咱们就抛开这个话题吧。

senses.def: to show that you are better than somebody, especially by making clever remarks, for example in an argument
senses.zh: （尤指在辩论等活动中机灵地）驳倒，挫败

examples.en: He was always trying to score points off his teachers.
examples.zh: 他总是想从老师那里得到分数。

senses.def: a subject that makes you feel angry or upset when it is mentioned

examples.en: It's a sore point with Sue's parents that the children have not been baptized yet.
examples.zh: 孩子们至今未受洗礼，这是休的父母的一块心病。

senses.def: to allow or do something that is not usually acceptable, especially because of a particular situation

examples.en: I was hoping they would stretch a point and let me stay on for a while.
examples.zh: 我希望他们能延长一点，让我继续呆一段时间。

senses.def: expressed in a simple, clear way without any extra information or feelings

examples.en: The letter was short and to the point.
examples.zh: 这封信简短扼要。

senses.def: to a degree that can be described as something

examples.en: He was rude to the point of being aggressive.
examples.zh: 他粗鲁到蛮不讲理的地步。

senses.def: to some extent; to some degree but not completely

examples.en: I agree with you up to a point.
examples.zh: 我在某种程度上同意你的看法。

senses.def: to accuse somebody of doing something

examples.en: The article points an accusing finger at the authorities.
examples.zh: 那篇文章谴责了当局。

intro.en: These are all words for talking about what somebody/​something intends to do or achieve.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指意图、目的、目标。

items.def: what something is supposed to achieve; what somebody is trying to achieve:
items.zh: 指目的、目标

examples.en: Our campaign’s main purpose is to raise money.
examples.zh: 我们这次活动的主要目的是募款。

items.def: what somebody is trying to achieve; what something is supposed to achieve:
items.zh: 指目标、目的

examples.en: She went to London with the aim of finding a job.
examples.zh: 她去伦敦是为了找工作。

items.def: what you intend to do:
items.zh: 指打算、计划、意图

examples.en: I have no intention of going to the wedding.
examples.zh: 我无意去参加婚礼。

items.def: what you intend to do or achieve:
items.zh: 指计划、打算

examples.en: There are no plans to build new offices.
examples.zh: 现在没有建新办公楼的计划。

items.def: (rather informal) the purpose or aim of something:
items.zh: 指意图、目的、理由

examples.en: What’s the point of all this violence?
examples.zh: 这些暴行的意图何在？

items.def: (rather informal) the purpose of something; somebody’s aim:
items.zh: 指目的、意图

examples.en: The whole idea of going was so that we could meet her new boyfriend.
examples.zh: 我们去的唯一目的就是要见她的新男朋友。

synonyms.words: site ▪ area ▪ position ▪ point ▪ location ▪ scene ▪ spot ▪ venue

intro.en: These are all words for a particular area or part of an area, especially one used for a particular purpose or where somebody/​something is situated or happens.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示地点、场所、位置。

items.def: a particular point, area, city, town, building, etc., especially one used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens:
items.zh: 指有特定用途或事情发生的地点、场所、城镇、建筑物、地方

examples.en: This would be a good place for a picnic.
examples.zh: 这可是个野餐的好地方。

items.def: the place where something, especially a building, is or will be located; a place where something happened or that is used for a particular purpose:
items.zh: 尤指建筑物的地点、位置，事情发生或有特定用途的地点、场所

examples.en: They’ve chosen a site for the new school.
examples.zh: 他们为新学校选了校址。

items.def: a part of a room, building or particular space that is used for a special purpose; a particular place on an object:
items.zh: 指（房间、建筑物、处所内划为某用途的）地方、场地，物体上的区、部位

examples.en: the hotel reception area
examples.zh: 旅馆接待处

items.def: the place where a person or thing is located; the place where somebody/​something is meant to be:
items.zh: 指位置、方位、恰当的位置

examples.en: From his position at the top of the hill, he could see the harbour.
examples.zh: 他在山头那个位置可以俯瞰海港。

items.def: a particular place within an area, where something happens or is supposed to happen:
items.zh: 指某事发生或将要发生的地点、某个地方

examples.en: the point at which the river divides
examples.zh: 河流分岔点

items.def: a place where something happens or exists, especially a place that is not named or not known:
items.zh: 指事情发生或存在的地方、地点、位置，尤指无名或鲜为人知的地方

examples.en: The company is moving to a new location.
examples.zh: 公司准备迁移新址。

items.def: a place where something happens, especially something unpleasant:
items.zh: 尤指不愉快事件发生的地点、现场

examples.en: the scene of the accident
examples.zh: 事故现场

items.def: a particular point or area, especially one that has a particular character or where something particular happens:
items.zh: 尤指具有某种特点或某一事件发生的地点、场所

examples.en: The lake is one of the local beauty spots.
examples.zh: 这个湖是当地的一个风景点。

items.def: the place where people meet for an organized event such as a performance or sports event.
items.zh: 指演出、体育比赛等的聚会地点、场馆、会场

senses.def: to accuse somebody of doing something

examples.en: The article points an accusing finger at the authorities.
examples.zh: 那篇文章谴责了当局。

senses.def: a place where you go or a person that you speak to when you are dealing with an organization

examples.en: The receptionist is the first point of contact most people have with the clinic.
examples.zh: 多数人与诊所接触的第一个人是接待员。

senses.def: used to say that you accept that somebody else is right when they have disagreed with you or criticized you
senses.zh: （接受相反的意见）同意，好吧，算你有理

examples.en: Point taken. Let's drop the subject.
examples.zh: 好吧。咱们就抛开这个话题吧。

senses.def: able to be used with a mouse
easy to use, without a person needing to move or change controls on it
fired with the gun touching or very close to the person or thing it is aimed at
senses.zh: 挨着的；近身的；近距离的

examples.en: The officer was shot dead at point-blank range.
examples.zh: 这位军官被近距离开枪打死。

senses.def: very definite and direct and not very polite

examples.en: a point-blank refusal
examples.zh: 断然拒绝

senses.def: with the gun touching or very close to the person or thing it is aimed at
senses.zh: 挨着的；近身的；近距离的

examples.en: She fired point-blank at his chest.
examples.zh: 她抵住他的胸口开了枪。

senses.def: in a very definite and direct way that is not very polite

examples.en: He refused point-blank to be photographed.
examples.zh: 他断然拒绝被拍照。

senses.def: the job of controlling traffic that is done by a police officer standing in the middle of the road

examples.en: to be on point duty
examples.zh: 指挥交通

senses.def: the player who directs the team’s attacking players
senses.zh: （球队进攻的）控球后卫，组织后卫

senses.def: a soldier who goes in front of the others to look for danger

examples.en: the president’s point man on education (= the person who is responsible for it)
examples.zh: 总统在教育方面的特派员

senses.def: the activity of giving a medical test to somebody at the place where they are being treated
senses.zh: 在某人接受治疗的地方对其进行医学检查的活动

examples.en: Point-of-care testing means that patients can get much faster results.
examples.zh: 即时检测意味着患者可以更快地获得结果。

senses.def: a question about whether the rules of behaviour in a formal discussion or meeting are being followed correctly
senses.zh: 议事规划问题；议事程序问题

examples.en: to raise a point of order
examples.zh: 提出议事程序问题

examples.en: On a point of order, Mr. Chairman, can associate members vote on this subject?
examples.zh: 关于程序问题，主席先生，准成员可以就此议题进行投票吗？

senses.def: something that you already know that helps you understand a situation or explain something to somebody

examples.en: Unemployment serves as a useful point of reference in examining social problems.
examples.zh: 失业情况是研究社会问题的有效参照。

senses.def: the place where a product is sold

examples.en: More information on healthy foods should be provided at the point of sale.
examples.zh: 销售点应提供更多有关健康食品的资料。

senses.def: the place where a product or a service is actually used
senses.zh: （产品的）使用地点；（服务的）提供地点

examples.en: Medical care is still free at the point of use.
examples.zh: 医疗保健在实际提供点仍然是免费的。

senses.def: the particular attitude or opinion that somebody has about something

examples.en: Why can't you ever see my point of view?
examples.zh: 你怎么老不明白我的观点呢？

examples.en: There are a number of different points of view on this issue.
examples.zh: 在这个问题上意见纷纭。

examples.en: From my point of view (= as far as I am concerned), the party was a complete success.
examples.zh: 依我看，这次聚会非常圆满。

senses.def: a particular way of considering or judging a situation

examples.en: These statistics are important from an ecological point of view.
examples.zh: 从生态学的角度看，这些统计数字很重要。

examples.en: From the point of view of higher education, the cuts will be a disaster.
examples.zh: 从高等教育的角度来看，削减将是一场灾难。

examples.en: The book is written from the father's point of view.
examples.zh: 这本书是从父亲的角度写的。

senses.def: to stretch your finger out towards somebody/something in order to show somebody which person or thing you are referring to

examples.en: I'll point him out to you next time he comes in.
examples.zh: 他下次进来的时候，我指给你看。

examples.en: The guide pointed out various historic monuments.
examples.zh: 导游介绍了各处历史遗迹。

senses.def: to mention something in order to give somebody information about it or make them notice it

examples.en: She tried in vain to point out to him the unfairness of his actions.
examples.zh: 她试图向他指出他的做法不公正，但无济于事。

examples.en: He pointed out the dangers of driving alone.
examples.zh: 他指出单独驾车的危险性。

examples.en: As you so rightly pointed out, our funds are not unlimited.
examples.zh: 你所言极是，我们的资金并不是没有限度的。

examples.en: I should point out that not one of these paintings is original.
examples.zh: 我应当指出，这些画中没有一幅是真迹。

examples.en: ‘It's not very far,’ she pointed out.
examples.zh: “那里不太远。”她说道。

senses.def: to mention something that you think is important and/or the reason why a particular situation exists
senses.zh: 提出，指出（重要的事或理由）

examples.en: The board of directors pointed to falling productivity to justify their decision.
examples.zh: 董事会指出生产率下降一事为其决策辩护。

examples.en: Pointing to the results of a recent survey, he claimed voters were most interested in education and unemployment.
examples.zh: 他指出最近的一项调查结果，声称选民对教育和失业最感兴趣。

examples.en: They point to the fact that exercising can improve your mood.
examples.zh: 他们指出，锻炼可以改善情绪。

senses.def: to suggest that something is true or likely

examples.en: All the signs point to a successful year ahead.
examples.zh: 一切迹象都预示着来年将一帆风顺。

examples.en: The evidence before us points clearly to his innocence.
examples.zh: 我们面前的证据清楚地表明他是无辜的。

senses.def: a race on horses that goes over a marked course across fields and has fences or walls for the horses to jump over
to emphasize something so that it becomes easier to notice

examples.en: The conference merely pointed up divisions in the party.
examples.zh: 这次会议只是显现了该党内部的分歧。

senses.def: the hard tops of the toes of a kind of shoe that a ballet
in a way that is clearly intended to show what you mean or to express criticism
senses.zh: 明确地；尖锐地；直言不讳地

examples.en: She yawned and looked pointedly at her watch.
examples.zh: 她打了个哈欠，又刻意看了看手表。

examples.en: When he sees me, he pointedly ignores me.
examples.zh: 当他看到我时，他故意不理我。

senses.def: a piece of advice

examples.en: Here are some pointers on how to go about the writing task.
examples.zh: 关于这项写作任务，有以下几点建议。

senses.def: a sign that something exists; a sign that shows how something may develop in the future

examples.en: The surge in car sales was regarded as an encouraging pointer to an improvement in the economy.
examples.zh: 汽车销售量的激增被视为经济回升的标志。

examples.en: His symptoms gave no obvious pointer to a possible diagnosis.
examples.zh: 对他的症状无法作出明确的诊断。

senses.def: a thin piece of metal that points to the numbers on a dial
a stick used to point to things on a map or picture on a wall
a small symbol, for example an arrow

examples.en: Move the mouse pointer to the menu bar.
examples.zh: 将鼠标光标移到菜单栏。

senses.def: a large dog used in hunting, trained to stand still with its nose pointing towards the birds that are being hunted
senses.zh: 指示猎狗，指示犬（经训练用以指示猎物等）

senses.def: a child’s word for the index finger
a style of painting that was developed in France in the late nineteenth century in which very small marks of colour are used to build up the picture
senses.zh: 点彩画法，点描技法（19 世纪末兴起于法国的绘画风格）

senses.def: an artist who paints in the style of pointillism
senses.zh: （法国十九世纪末）点彩派画家（将原色彩点堆砌，营造出远观时仿佛融为一体的图象）

examples.en: Seurat, the French pointillist
examples.zh: 法国点彩画家修拉

senses.def: in the style of pointillism
senses.zh: （法国十九世纪末）点彩画派的（将原色彩点堆砌，营造出远观时仿佛融为一体的图象）

senses.def: a mouse or other device which allows you to move the cursor
having no purpose; not worth doing
senses.zh: 无意义的；无目标的；不值得做的

examples.en: We searched until we knew it would be pointless to continue.
examples.zh: 我们搜索又搜索，直到觉得继续下去也枉然时才罢手。

examples.en: Trying to foresee the future is a pointless exercise.
examples.zh: 试图预测未来是毫无意义的事。

senses.def: in a way that has no purpose or is not worth doing
senses.zh: 无意义的；无目标的；不值得做的

examples.en: He argued pointlessly with his parents.
examples.zh: 他无谓地和父母争论。

senses.def: the fact of having no purpose or not being worth doing
senses.zh: 无意义的；无目标的；不值得做的

examples.en: the pointlessness of war
examples.zh: 战争的无意义

senses.def: with a point at one end

examples.en: pointy ears
examples.zh: 尖耳朵

examples.en: Don't try to argue when you find yourself at the pointy end of a knife (= when somebody is threatening you with a knife).
examples.zh: 有人用刀尖顶着你时，不要试图去争辩。

senses.def: a calm and confident manner with control of your feelings or behaviour

examples.en: His performance was full of maturity and poise.
examples.zh: 他的表演充满了成熟和从容。

examples.en: She seemed embarrassed for a moment but quickly recovered her poise.
examples.zh: 她看上去有短暂的尴尬，但很快就恢复镇定。

senses.def: the ability to move or stand in an attractive way with good control of your body

examples.en: the natural poise and balance of the body
examples.zh: 身体的自然姿态与平衡

senses.def: to be or hold something steady in a particular position, especially above something else
senses.zh: （尤指在…上方）保持（某种姿势）；（使）保持平稳

examples.en: The hawk poised in mid-air ready to swoop.
examples.zh: 老鹰在半空中盘旋，准备俯冲。

examples.en: He was poising himself to launch a final attack.
examples.zh: 他稳定住自己，以发动最后的攻击。

examples.en: She poised the javelin in her hand before the throw.
examples.zh: 她把标枪握稳，然后投了出去。

senses.def: a substance that causes death or harm if it gets into the body

examples.en: Some mushrooms contain a deadly poison.
examples.zh: 有些蘑菇含有致命毒素。

examples.en: How did he die? Was it poison?
examples.zh: 他是怎么死的？是中毒吗？

examples.en: The dog was killed by rat poison (= poison intended to kill rats).
examples.zh: 狗被耗子药毒死了。

examples.en: to hunt with poison arrows
examples.zh: 用毒箭狩猎

examples.en: bombs containing poison gas
examples.zh: 毒气弹

examples.en: She had laced his drink with poison.
examples.zh: 她在他的饮料中掺了毒药。

senses.def: an idea, a feeling, etc. that is extremely harmful
senses.zh: 极有害的思想（或心情等）；精神毒药

examples.en: the poison of racial hatred
examples.zh: 种族仇恨这种害人的思想

senses.def: used to say that different people like different things; what one person likes very much, another person does not like at all
senses.zh: 兴趣爱好因人而异；一人手中宝，他人脚下草

senses.def: used to ask somebody what alcoholic drink they would like
to harm or kill a person or an animal by giving them poison

examples.en: He was believed to poison his enemies.
examples.zh: 人们相信他毒害了他的敌人。

examples.en: Thousands are at risk of being poisoned by fumes from faulty heaters.
examples.zh: 数千人面临因加热器故障产生的烟雾中毒的危险。

examples.en: Poisoning the rats is expensive and harmful to the environment.
examples.zh: 毒害老鼠成本高昂，而且对环境有害。

examples.en: In the last chapter, she poisons herself with arsenic.
examples.zh: 在最后一章中，她用砒霜毒死了自己。

senses.def: to put poison in or on something

examples.en: a poisoned arrow
examples.zh: 毒箭

examples.en: Someone had been poisoning his food.
examples.zh: 有人一直在他的食物里下毒。

examples.en: Large sections of the river have been poisoned by toxic waste from factories.
examples.zh: 工厂的有毒废弃物污染了大段大段的河流。

examples.en: Exhaust fumes are poisoning our cities.
examples.zh: 废气正在毒害我们的城市。

examples.en: The chocolates had been poisoned with cyanide.
examples.zh: 这些巧克力中被掺入了氰化物。

senses.def: to have a bad effect on something

examples.en: His comment served only to poison the atmosphere still further.
examples.zh: 他的评论只是令气氛更加恶化了。

examples.en: She succeeded in poisoning their minds against me.
examples.zh: 她成功地令他们仇视我。

examples.en: I hope that if we do have disagreements they won't poison our relationship.
examples.zh: 我希望即使我们确实存在分歧，也不会破坏我们的关系。

senses.def: a thing that seems attractive when it is given to somebody but which soon becomes unpleasant

examples.en: He inherited a poisoned chalice when he took over the job as union leader.
examples.zh: 他接手工会领导职务，看似风光，实则会给他带来很多麻烦。

items.idm: one man’s meat is another man’s poison

senses.def: used to say that different people like different things; what one person likes very much, another person does not like at all
senses.zh: 兴趣爱好因人而异；一人手中宝，他人脚下草

senses.def: used to ask somebody what alcoholic drink they would like
a thing that seems attractive when it is given to somebody but which soon becomes unpleasant

examples.en: He inherited a poisoned chalice when he took over the job as union leader.
examples.zh: 他接手工会领导职务，看似风光，实则会给他带来很多麻烦。

senses.def: a North American climbing plant that causes painful spots on the skin when you touch it
senses.zh: 毒常春藤，气根毒藤（原产于北美，接触后会引起皮炎）

senses.def: a North American bush that causes painful spots on the skin when you touch it
senses.zh: 栎叶漆，毒栎（原产于北美，接触后会引起皮炎）

senses.def: an unpleasant letter that is not signed and is intended to upset the person who receives it
senses.zh: 恶意的匿名信；匿名诽谤信

examples.en: He had been sending poison pen letters to people at work.
examples.zh: 他一直在给工作的人们寄送匿名诽谤信。

examples.en: He had been sending poison pen letters to his neighbours, hoping to make them move away.
examples.zh: 他一直给邻居寄恶意的匿名信，希望他们搬走。

senses.def: a form of defence used by a company to prevent, or to reduce the effect of, a takeover
senses.zh: 毒丸行动，自戕式防御（企业为反并购而采取的一种防御措施，如出售某些重要资产等）

senses.def: a person who murders somebody by using poison
senses.zh: 投毒杀人者；毒死别人的人

senses.def: causing death or illness if swallowed

examples.en: poisonous chemicals/fumes/plants
examples.zh: 有毒化学品／烟雾／植物

examples.en: a poisonous substance
examples.zh: 有毒物质

examples.en: This gas is highly poisonous.
examples.zh: 这种气体有剧毒。

examples.en: The leaves of certain trees are poisonous to cattle.
examples.zh: 某些树的叶子会毒害牛。

senses.def: producing a poison that can cause death or illness if the animal or insect bites you
senses.zh: 分泌毒素的；能毒伤人的

examples.en: poisonous snakes
examples.zh: 毒蛇

examples.en: a tiny spider with a poisonous bite
examples.zh: 一只被毒咬的小蜘蛛

senses.def: extremely unpleasant or unfriendly
senses.zh: 极端讨厌（或不友善）的；恶毒的；邪恶的

examples.en: a poisonous person
examples.zh: 有毒的人

examples.zh: 办公室里的恶劣气氛

examples.zh: 他们生活在市内的富人区。

examples.zh: 他在悬崖之巅，海港景色一览无余。

examples.zh: 酒店坐落在较高的位置，俯瞰着湖泊。

examples.zh: 这个党对教育改革的态度

examples.en: My parents always took the position that early nights meant healthy children.
examples.zh: 我的父母总是认为孩子早睡就会身体健康。

senses.def: a person or organization’s level of importance when compared with others

examples.en: the position of women in society
examples.zh: 妇女的社会地位

examples.en: the company’s dominant position in the world market
examples.zh: 那个公司在全球市场中的主导地位

examples.en: Atkins occupies a remarkable position in the history of photography.
examples.zh: 阿特金斯在摄影史上占有显着的地位。

examples.en: Wealth and position (= high social status) were not important to her.
examples.zh: 财富与地位对她并不重要。

senses.group: level of importance 重要程度

senses.def: a job

examples.en: He held a senior position in a large company.
examples.zh: 他在一家大公司担任高级职务。

examples.en: I should like to apply for the position of Sales Director.
examples.zh: 我想申请销售总监一职。

examples.en: They are advertising for a clinic coordinator and hope to fill the position by June.
examples.zh: 他们正在招聘一名诊所协调员，希望在六月之前填补该职位。

examples.en: We need more women in leadership positions.
examples.zh: 我们需要更多女性担任领导职务。

senses.def: a place in a race, competition, or test, when compared to others

examples.en: United's 3–0 win moved them up to third position.
examples.zh: 联队 3:0 的胜利使他们排名升至第三。

senses.def: the place where somebody plays and the responsibilities they have in some team games

examples.en: What position does he play?
examples.zh: 他打哪个位置？

examples.en: Nakata had to play out of position when the defender was injured.
examples.zh: 后卫队员受伤，中田不得已变换了自己的位置。

senses.def: a place where a group of people involved in fighting have put men and guns

examples.en: They attacked the enemy positions at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时分，他们向敌军阵地发起进攻。

examples.en: The defence stuck firmly to its position.
examples.zh: 防守方坚守阵地。

senses.def: to put somebody/something in a particular position

examples.en: She quickly positioned herself behind the desk.
examples.zh: 她迅速在桌子后面她的位置上坐好。

examples.en: Large television screens were positioned at either end of the stadium.
examples.zh: 体育场的两端安装了大型电视屏幕。

examples.en: Position your hands correctly on the shaft of the club.
examples.zh: 将您的手正确地放在球杆的杆身上。

examples.en: The company is now well positioned to compete in foreign markets.
examples.zh: 现在这家公司已准备好在国外市场竞争。

synonyms.words: site ▪ area ▪ position ▪ point ▪ location ▪ scene ▪ spot ▪ venue

intro.en: These are all words for a particular area or part of an area, especially one used for a particular purpose or where somebody/​something is situated or happens.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示地点、场所、位置。

items.def: a particular point, area, city, town, building, etc., especially one used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens:
items.zh: 指有特定用途或事情发生的地点、场所、城镇、建筑物、地方

examples.en: This would be a good place for a picnic.
examples.zh: 这可是个野餐的好地方。

items.def: the place where something, especially a building, is or will be located; a place where something happened or that is used for a particular purpose:
items.zh: 尤指建筑物的地点、位置，事情发生或有特定用途的地点、场所

examples.en: They’ve chosen a site for the new school.
examples.zh: 他们为新学校选了校址。

items.def: a part of a room, building or particular space that is used for a special purpose; a particular place on an object:
items.zh: 指（房间、建筑物、处所内划为某用途的）地方、场地，物体上的区、部位

examples.en: the hotel reception area
examples.zh: 旅馆接待处

items.def: the place where a person or thing is located; the place where somebody/​something is meant to be:
items.zh: 指位置、方位、恰当的位置

examples.en: From his position at the top of the hill, he could see the harbour.
examples.zh: 他在山头那个位置可以俯瞰海港。

items.def: a particular place within an area, where something happens or is supposed to happen:
items.zh: 指某事发生或将要发生的地点、某个地方

examples.en: the point at which the river divides
examples.zh: 河流分岔点

items.def: a place where something happens or exists, especially a place that is not named or not known:
items.zh: 指事情发生或存在的地方、地点、位置，尤指无名或鲜为人知的地方

examples.en: The company is moving to a new location.
examples.zh: 公司准备迁移新址。

items.def: a place where something happens, especially something unpleasant:
items.zh: 尤指不愉快事件发生的地点、现场

examples.en: the scene of the accident
examples.zh: 事故现场

items.def: a particular point or area, especially one that has a particular character or where something particular happens:
items.zh: 尤指具有某种特点或某一事件发生的地点、场所

examples.en: The lake is one of the local beauty spots.
examples.zh: 这个湖是当地的一个风景点。

items.def: the place where people meet for an organized event such as a performance or sports event.
items.zh: 指演出、体育比赛等的聚会地点、场馆、会场

synonyms.words: circumstances ▪ position ▪ conditions ▪ things ▪ the case ▪ state of affairs

intro.en: These are all words for the conditions and facts that are connected with and affect the way things are.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指情况、状况。

items.def: all the things that are happening at a particular time and in a particular place:
items.zh: 指情况、状况、形势、局面

examples.en: the present economic situation
examples.zh: 目前的经济形势

items.def: the facts that are connected with and affect a situation, an event or an action; the conditions of a person’s life, especially the money they have:
items.zh: 指条件、环境、状况、境况，（尤指）经济状况

examples.en: The ship sank in mysterious circumstances.
examples.zh: 那艘船神秘地沉没了。

items.def: the situation that somebody is in, especially when it affects what they can and cannot do:
items.zh: 指处境、地位、状况

examples.en: She felt she was in a position of power.
examples.zh: 她觉得她自己有权力。

items.def: the circumstances in which people live, work or do things; the physical situation that affects how something happens:
items.zh: 指居住、工作或做事情的环境、境况、条件，影响某事发生的物质环境、状态、条件

examples.en: We were forced to work outside in freezing conditions.
examples.zh: 我们被迫在户外天寒地冻的环境下工作。

items.def: (rather informal) the general situation, as it affects somebody:
items.zh: 指形势、局面、情况、事态

examples.en: Hi, Jane! How are things?
examples.zh: 喂，简，近来怎么样？

items.def: the true situation:
items.zh: 指实情、事实

examples.en: If that is the case (= if the situation described is true), we need more staff.
examples.zh: 如果真是那样，我们就需要更多的员工了。

items.def: a situation:
items.zh: 指事态、情况、形势

examples.en: How did this unhappy state of affairs come about?
examples.zh: 这种不幸的情况是怎么发生的呢？

intro.en: These are all words for a position doing work for which you receive regular payment.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示工作、职位。

items.def: work for which you receive regular payment:
items.zh: 工作；职业；职位

examples.en: He’s trying to get a job in a bank.
examples.zh: 他正设法在银行找一个工作。

items.def: (rather formal) a job:
items.zh: 指职位、职务

examples.en: a senior position in a large corporation
examples.zh: 在一家大公司的高级职务

items.def: a job, especially an important one in a large organization:
items.zh: 指职位，尤指大机构的要职

examples.en: a key post in the new government
examples.zh: 在新政府中的要职

items.def: a job that is available for somebody to do:
items.zh: 指空缺的职位、空职

examples.en: We have several vacancies for casual workers.
examples.zh: 我们有几个临时工的空缺。

items.def: (rather formal, especially British English尤用于英式英语) a job or position of responsibility:
items.zh: 指承担一定责任的职务、职位

examples.en: This is a permanent appointment, requiring commitment and hard work.
examples.zh: 这是一个固定职位，需要专心致志和勤奋工作。

senses.def: a written report from an organization or a government department that explains or recommends a particular course of action
senses.zh: （机构或政府部门的）行动报告，施政说明，建议书

senses.def: connected with the position of somebody/something
senses.zh: 位置上的；地位上的；职位上的

examples.en: The team has made some positional changes because two players are injured.
examples.zh: 因有两名队员受伤，这个队将队员做了些位置上的调整。

senses.def: good or useful
senses.zh: 良好的；有助益的；正面的

examples.en: The tests have so far yielded positive results.
examples.zh: 到目前为止，测试已取得积极结果。

examples.en: The contributions have a positive impact on the lives of hundreds of children.
examples.zh: 这些捐赠能够改善数以百计儿童的生活。

examples.en: Overseas investment has had a positive effect on exports.
examples.zh: 海外投资对出口有积极影响。

examples.en: His family have been a very positive influence on him.
examples.zh: 他的家庭对他有十分良好的影响。

examples.en: The only positive outcome of that day was that our country came together.
examples.zh: 那天唯一的好结果是我们的国家团结起来了。

examples.en: to make a positive contribution to a discussion
examples.zh: 给讨论会提出好的建言

senses.def: expressing agreement or support

examples.en: It's always nice to get positive feedback.
examples.zh: 得到赞赏的回应总是令人高兴。

examples.en: We've had a very positive response to the idea.
examples.zh: 我们这个想法反响很好。

examples.en: The company expects a positive reaction to these new products.
examples.zh: 该公司预计这些新产品将得到积极的反应。

examples.en: There were some overwhelmingly positive reviews.
examples.zh: 有一些压倒性的积极评价。

examples.en: I should probably say something positive.
examples.zh: 我或许应该说一些积极的话。

senses.def: directed at dealing with something or producing a successful result
senses.zh: 积极的；建设性的；朝着成功的

examples.en: We must take positive steps to deal with the problem.
examples.zh: 我们必须采取积极措施处理这个问题。

examples.en: In the last few years, positive changes have been made.
examples.zh: 在过去的几年里作出了积极的改变。

examples.en: It will require positive action by all in the industry.
examples.zh: 这将需要业内全体同人和衷共济。

senses.def: thinking about what is good in a situation; feeling confident and sure that something good will happen

examples.en: a positive attitude/outlook
examples.zh: 乐观的态度／前景

examples.en: the power of positive thinking
examples.zh: 乐观思想的力量

examples.en: She tried to be more positive about her new job.
examples.zh: 她尝试对新工作乐观一点。

examples.en: On the positive side, profits have increased.
examples.zh: 从好的方面看，利润增加了。

examples.en: The report ended on a positive note.
examples.zh: 报告的结尾显得很乐观。

examples.en: There were times when it was difficult to remain positive.
examples.zh: 曾有过一些很难保持乐观的时候。

examples.en: Analysts remain positive on the outlook for the shares over the long term.
examples.zh: 分析师对该股的长期前景仍持乐观态度。

examples.en: Another positive sign is that many companies have recently raised their dividend payouts.
examples.zh: 另一个积极的迹象是许多公司最近提高了股息支付。

examples.en: The goal was to create a positive image of older workers.
examples.zh: 目标是塑造老年工人的积极形象。

senses.def: showing clear evidence that a particular substance or medical condition is present

examples.en: a positive pregnancy test
examples.zh: 呈阳性反应的怀孕检测

examples.en: The athlete tested positive for steroids.
examples.zh: 这个运动员类固醇检测呈阳性。

examples.en: If your test results are positive, it means that blood was detected.
examples.zh: 如果您的检测结果呈阳性，则意味着检测到血液。

examples.en: to be HIV positive
examples.zh: 艾滋病病毒化验呈阳性

examples.en: The test proved positive.
examples.zh: 测试结果呈阳性。

senses.def: completely sure that something is correct or true

examples.en: I can't be positive about what time it happened.
examples.zh: 我说不准这事是什么时间发生的。

examples.en: She was positive that he had been there.
examples.zh: 她确信他曾在场。

examples.en: I'm absolutely positive it was him.
examples.zh: 我绝对肯定就是他。

examples.en: ‘Are you sure?’ ‘Positive.’
examples.zh: “你敢肯定吗？”“绝对肯定。”

senses.def: giving clear and definite proof or information

examples.en: The results show a positive correlation between exercise and self-esteem.
examples.zh: 结果显示锻炼与自尊之间存在正相关。

examples.en: We have no positive evidence that she was involved.
examples.zh: 我们没有确凿证据证明她参与其事。

examples.en: This is proof positive that he stole the money.
examples.zh: 这就是他偷钱的确证。

senses.def: complete and definite

examples.en: He has a positive genius for upsetting people.
examples.zh: 他气人的本事可大呢。

examples.en: It was a positive miracle that we survived.
examples.zh: 我们能够生还，完全是个奇迹。

senses.def: expressing something that is true, did happen, etc.; not containing words such as ‘no’, ‘not’, ‘never’, etc.

examples.en: A positive statement has a negative question tag.
examples.zh: 积极的陈述有消极的问号。

senses.def: greater than zero
containing or producing the type of electricity that is carried by a proton

examples.en: a positive charge
examples.zh: 正电荷

examples.en: the positive terminal of a battery
examples.zh: 电池的正极

senses.def: a good or useful quality or aspect

examples.en: What are the positives and negatives of going this route?
examples.zh: 走这条路线的优劣各是什么？

examples.en: I get a lot of positives from my job.
examples.zh: 我从工作中得到了很多积极的东西。

examples.en: The deal is seen as a positive for both companies.
examples.zh: 这笔交易被视为对两家公司来说都是积极的。

senses.def: the result of a test or an experiment that shows that a substance or condition is present

examples.en: The result can be a false positive—indicating a problem where none actually exists.
examples.zh: 结果可能是假阳性，即显示有问题，但其实没有问题。

senses.group: result of test 化验结果

senses.def: a developed film showing light and dark areas and colours as they actually were, especially one printed from a negative

intro.en: These words all describe somebody who knows without doubt that something is true or will happen.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指确信、肯定、有把握。

items.def: [not before noun] without any doubt that you are right, that something is true, that you will get something or that something will happen:
items.zh: 指确信、肯定、有把握、必定

examples.en: ‘Is that John over there?’ ‘I’m not sure.’
examples.zh: “那边那个人是约翰吗？”“我说不准。”

items.def: completely sure that something will happen in the way that you want or expect:
items.zh: 指肯定、确信、有把握

examples.en: I’m quite confident that you’ll get the job.
examples.zh: 我肯定你能得到那份工作。

items.def: [not before noun] completely sure that something is true or right, especially because the evidence seems to prove it or somebody else has persuaded you to believe it:
items.zh: 指坚信、深信、确信，尤指有证据证明或经说服

examples.en: I’m convinced that she’s innocent.
examples.zh: 我坚信她是清白无辜的。

items.def: [not usually before noun] sure that you are right or that something is true:
items.zh: 指确信、肯定、无疑

examples.en: Are you absolutely certain about this?
examples.zh: 你对这事绝对确信无疑吗？

items.def: [not before noun] (rather informal) completely sure that something is true:
items.zh: 指有绝对把握、确信、肯定

examples.en: She was positive that he’d been there.
examples.zh: 她确信他曾到过那儿。

items.def: (often used in negative statements and questions) having no doubt or confusion about something:
items.zh: （常用于否定句与疑问句中）指无疑的、清楚的、明白的

examples.en: My memory isn’t really clear on that point.
examples.zh: 那一点我记不太清楚了。

senses.def: the practice or policy of making sure that jobs or advantages are given to people from groups that are often treated unfairly because of their race, sex, etc.
senses.zh: 积极区别对待政策（对因种族、性别等原因遭歧视的群体在就业等方面给予特别照顾）

examples.en: positive discrimination in favour of under-represented ethnic groups
examples.zh: 有利于代表性不足的族裔群体的积极歧视

examples.en: Some colleges feel there is a real need for positive discrimination in favour of applicants from poorer backgrounds.
examples.zh: 有些院校认为确有必要对那些来自较贫困家庭的申请人实行积极的特别照顾。

senses.def: the process of checking everything about a person’s background and character when they apply for a job in which they will have to deal with secret information, especially in the civil service
senses.zh: 道德审查（对申请从事保密工作者的背景和品行进行检查）

senses.def: used to emphasize the truth of a statement, especially when this is surprising or when it contrasts with a previous statement

examples.en: Some diets may be positively dangerous.
examples.zh: 有些饮食可能是非常危险的。

examples.en: The instructions were not just confusing, they were positively misleading.
examples.zh: 这些指示不单令人费解，而且肯定会误导人。

examples.en: Tonight’s performance is positively the last time the band will appear together.
examples.zh: 今晚的演出无疑是乐队最后一次一起亮相。

senses.def: in a way that shows you are thinking of the good things about a situation, not the bad

examples.en: Very few of those interviewed spoke positively about their childhood.
examples.zh: 接受采访的人当中，很少有人说他们的童年是快乐的。

examples.en: Thinking positively is one way of dealing with stress.
examples.zh: 保持乐观是对付压力的一种方法。

examples.en: She was portrayed very positively in the movie.
examples.zh: 那部电影把她刻画得很正面。

senses.def: in a way that shows you approve of or agree with something/somebody

examples.en: The industry has responded positively to these developments.
examples.zh: 该行业对这些发展做出了积极的回应。

examples.en: Investors reacted positively to news of the takeover.
examples.zh: 投资者对公司收购的消息反应积极。

senses.def: in a way that leaves no possibility of doubt

examples.en: Her attacker has now been positively identified by police.
examples.zh: 袭击她的人现在已被警方确认。

senses.def: in a way that contains or produces the type of electricity that is opposite to that carried by an electron

examples.en: positively charged protons
examples.zh: 带正电的质子

senses.def: a system of philosophy based on things that can be seen or proved, rather than on ideas
senses.zh: 实证主义；实证哲学；实证论

senses.def: believing in or based on the philosophy of positivism

examples.en: a positivist approach
examples.zh: 实证主义方法

senses.def: a person who believes in or acts according to the philosophy of positivism
the practice of being positive in your attitude and focusing on what is good in a situation

examples.en: We want to send a message of positivity and optimism even in these dark times.
examples.zh: 即使在这些黑暗时期，我们也希望传达积极和乐观的信息。

senses.def: the fact that a particular substance, condition or feature is present

examples.en: the positivity of tumour cells
examples.zh: 肿瘤细胞阳性

examples.en: The state's Covid test positivity rate jumped to 14.5 per cent.
examples.zh: 该州的新冠病毒检测阳性率跃升至 14.5%。

senses.def: a particle
possible

examples.en: I'll be there if poss.
examples.zh: 如果可能，我会去那里的。

examples.en: as soon as poss
examples.zh: 尽快

senses.def: a group of people who are similar in some way, or who spend time together
senses.zh: 一群，一队，一伙（有共同之处的人）

examples.en: a little posse of helpers
examples.zh: 一小伙帮忙的人

examples.en: He was sat at a corner table and surrounded by a posse of attentive waiters.
examples.zh: 他坐在角落的桌子旁，周围是一群细心的服务员。

examples.en: She arrived at the theatre followed by the usual press posse.
examples.zh: 她到达剧院时，跟随着通常的记者队伍。

senses.def: (in the US in the past) a group of people who were brought together by a sheriff
senses.zh: （美国旧时由县治安官调集、协助捉拿罪犯的）地方武装团队

senses.def: a group of young men involved in crime connected with drugs
senses.zh: （与毒品有关的）青年犯罪团伙

senses.def: to have or own something

examples.en: He was charged with possessing a shotgun without a licence.
examples.zh: 他被控无照拥有猎枪。

examples.en: I'm afraid this is the only suitcase I possess.
examples.zh: 恐怕我只有这一个箱子。

examples.en: The gallery possesses a number of the artist's early works.
examples.zh: 这家画廊藏有那位画家的一些早期作品。

examples.en: Belgium was the first European country to possess a fully fledged rail network.
examples.zh: 比利时是第一个拥有成熟铁路网络的欧洲国家。

senses.def: to have a particular quality or feature

examples.en: I'm afraid he doesn't possess a sense of humour.
examples.zh: 恐怕他没有什么幽默感。

examples.en: workers who possess the requisite skills for the task
examples.zh: 具备完成任务所需技能的工人

examples.en: He credited her with a maturity she did not possess.
examples.zh: 他认为她很成熟，其实不然。

examples.en: Isaak 's songwriting possesses a timeless quality.
examples.zh: Isaak 的歌曲创作具有永恒的品质。

examples.en: Young adults possess incredible purchasing power.
examples.zh: 年轻人拥有令人难以置信的购买力。

senses.def: to have a powerful effect on somebody and control the way that they think, behave, etc.

examples.en: A terrible fear possessed her.
examples.zh: 一种可怕的恐惧占据了她的心。

examples.en: I was possessed by a desire to tell her everything.
examples.zh: 我被那渴望向她吐露一切的想法控制住了。

senses.def: to make somebody do something that seems strange or unreasonable

examples.en: What possessed him to say such a thing?
examples.zh: 他着了什么魔竟说出这种话来？

senses.def: something that you own or have with you at a particular time

examples.en: Prisoners were allowed no personal possessions.
examples.zh: 囚犯不允许携带任何个人财物。

examples.en: One of Jane's most prized possessions was her photo album.
examples.zh: 简最珍爱的物件之一是她的相册。

examples.en: The ring is one of her most treasured possessions.
examples.zh: 这只戒指是她最珍贵的财产之一。

examples.en: Please make sure you have all your possessions with you when leaving the plane.
examples.zh: 下飞机时请确保随身携带所有物品。

senses.def: the state of having or owning something

examples.en: The possession of a passport is essential for foreign travel.
examples.zh: 出国旅行必须持有护照。

examples.en: They had exclusive possession of the property as tenants.
examples.zh: 作为业主，他们对房产享有独有权。

examples.en: On her father's death, she came into possession of (= received) a vast fortune.
examples.zh: 她父亲死后，她继承了一大笔财产。

examples.en: You cannot legally take possession of the property (= start using it after buying it) until three weeks after the contract is signed.
examples.zh: 契约签署三周以后，你才能合法取得这份产业的所有权。

examples.en: The manuscript is just one of the treasures in their possession.
examples.zh: 这部手稿只是他们的珍藏之一。

examples.en: The gang was caught in possession of stolen goods.
examples.zh: 这伙人被逮住，人赃俱获。

examples.en: drug possession
examples.zh: 持有毒品

examples.en: weapons/firearms possession
examples.zh: 拥有武器/枪支

senses.def: the state of having control of the ball

examples.en: to win/get/lose possession of the ball
examples.zh: 赢得／得到／失去对球的控制

examples.en: The home team had most of the possession in the first half.
examples.zh: 上半场主队占据大部分控球权。

examples.en: The team was struggling to retain possession of the ball.
examples.zh: 该队拚命想保住对球的控制。

senses.def: the state of having illegal drugs or weapons with you at a particular time
senses.zh: 持有违禁物；私藏毒品（或武器）

examples.en: She was charged with possession.
examples.zh: 她被控持有违禁物品。

examples.en: They were charged with unlawful possession of firearms.
examples.zh: 他们被指控非法持有枪支。

senses.def: a country that is controlled or governed by another country

examples.en: The former colonial possessions are now independent states.
examples.zh: 这些前殖民地现已是独立的国家。

examples.en: the country's overseas possessions
examples.zh: 该国的海外领地

senses.def: the situation when somebody’s mind is believed to be controlled by the Devil
senses.group: by evil spirit 受恶魔控制

senses.def: if you already have or control something, it is difficult for somebody else to take it away from you, even if they have the legal right to it
senses.zh: 现实占有，败一胜九；占有者在诉讼中总占上风
senses.group: by evil spirit 受恶魔控制

items.idm: possession is nine tenths of the law

senses.def: if you already have or control something, it is difficult for somebody else to take it away from you, even if they have the legal right to it
senses.zh: 现实占有，败一胜九；占有者在诉讼中总占上风

synonyms.words: stuff ▪ property ▪ possessions ▪ junk ▪ belongings ▪ goods ▪ valuables

intro.en: These are all words for objects or items, especially ones that you own or have with you at a particular time.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指东西、物品，尤指个人拥有或随身携带的物件。

items.def: (rather informal) objects, clothing or tools that you own or that are used for a particular purpose:
items.zh: 指个人拥有或作特定用途的物品、衣服、用具

examples.en: Shall I help you pack your things?
examples.zh: 我帮你打点行装好吗？

items.def: [U] (informal) used to refer to a group of objects when you do not know their names, when the names are not important or when it is obvious what you are talking about:
items.zh: 指名称不详、名称无关紧要或所指明确的东西、物品、玩意儿

examples.en: Where’s all my stuff?
examples.zh: 我那些东西都哪儿去了？

items.def: [U] (rather formal) a thing or things that are owned by somebody:
items.zh: 指所有物、财产、财物

examples.en: This building is government property.
examples.zh: 这座大楼是政府的财产。

items.def: things that you own, especially something that can be moved:
items.zh: 指个人财产、私人物品（尤指动产）

examples.en: Prisoners were allowed no personal possessions except letters and photographs.
examples.zh: 囚犯除信件和照片外不允许有任何私人物品。

items.def: [U] things that are considered useless or of little value:
items.zh: 指无用的东西、无价值的东西

examples.en: I’ve cleared out all that old junk from the attic.
examples.zh: 我把阁楼里所有的废旧杂物都清除干净了。

items.def: possessions that can be moved, especially ones that you have with you at a particular time:
items.zh: 指动产，尤指随身物品

examples.en: Please make sure you have all your belongings with you when leaving the plane.
examples.zh: 请确保在下飞机前带好所有的随身物品。

items.def: (specialist or rather formal) possessions that can be moved:
items.zh: 指动产、（可搬运的）私人财产

examples.en: He was found guilty of handling stolen goods.
examples.zh: 他被判犯销赃罪。

items.def: things that are worth a lot of money, especially small personal things such as jewellery or cameras:
items.zh: 尤指私人的贵重物品（如首饰、相机等）

examples.en: Never leave cash or other valuables lying around.
examples.zh: 现金或其他贵重物品请勿乱放。

senses.def: if you already have or control something, it is difficult for somebody else to take it away from you, even if they have the legal right to it
senses.zh: 现实占有，败一胜九；占有者在诉讼中总占上风

possession is nine tenths of the law.word: possession is nine tenths of the law

senses.def: demanding total attention or love; not wanting somebody to be independent
senses.zh: 要求悉心关爱的；占有欲强的

examples.en: Some parents are too possessive of their children.
examples.zh: 有些父母过分要求子女百依百顺。

senses.def: not liking to lend things or share things with others
senses.zh: 不愿分享的；有独占欲望的

examples.en: Jimmy's very possessive about his toys.
examples.zh: 吉米的玩具谁也碰不得。

examples.en: Why should he feel so possessive about some old photos?
examples.zh: 他为什么如此不希望将一些旧照片给别人看？

senses.def: showing that something belongs to somebody/something
senses.zh: 表示所属关系的；所有格的

examples.en: possessive pronouns (= yours, theirs, etc.)
examples.zh: 物主代词

senses.def: a pronoun or a form of a word that expresses the fact that something belongs to somebody/something

examples.en: ‘Ours’ and ‘their’ are possessives.
examples.zh: ours 和 their 是所有格形式。

senses.def: the special form of a word that expresses belonging
in a way that demands total attention or love; in a way that shows that you do not want somebody to be independent
senses.zh: 要求悉心关爱的；占有欲强的

examples.en: His arm was draped possessively over her shoulder.
examples.zh: 他的手臂占有欲十足地搭在她的肩膀上。

senses.def: in a way that shows that somebody does not like to lend things or share things with other people
senses.zh: 不愿分享的；有独占欲望的

examples.en: ‘That's mine!’ she said possessively.
examples.zh: “那是我的！”她霸道地说。

senses.def: the fact of demanding total attention or love and not wanting somebody to be independent
senses.zh: 要求悉心关爱的；占有欲强的

examples.en: I couldn't stand his jealousy and possessiveness.
examples.zh: 我忍受不了他的嫉妒心和占有欲。

examples.en: Her obsessive possessiveness of her brother prevented him from marrying.
examples.zh: 她对哥哥的强烈占有欲阻止了他结婚。

senses.def: the fact of not liking to lend things or share things with others
senses.zh: 不愿分享的；有独占欲望的

examples.en: I felt no possessiveness over my own words.
examples.zh: 我对自己的话没有任何占有欲。

senses.def: a person who owns or has something

examples.en: He is now the proud possessor of a driving licence.
examples.zh: 他现在有了驾驶执照，颇有些飘飘然。

examples.en: She has that star quality that makes its possessor the focus of attention.
examples.zh: 她具有明星气质，使其拥有者成为关注的焦点。

senses.def: in the past, a drink made with hot milk and beer or wine
senses.zh: 牛奶甜酒（旧时用热牛奶加啤酒或葡萄酒调制而成）

senses.def: a dessert
senses.zh: 奶油水果甜点（水果常用柠檬）

senses.def: if a baby possets
a thing that may happen or be true; the fact that something might happen or be true, but is not certain

examples.en: Bankruptcy is a real possibility if sales don't improve.
examples.zh: 如果销售情况不改善，真有破产的可能。

examples.en: What had seemed impossible now seemed a distinct possibility.
examples.zh: 过去看似不可能的事，现在显然有可能了。

examples.en: Reaching the final seems a remote possibility.
examples.zh: 进入决赛的可能性似乎很小。

examples.en: There's a strong possibility that it will rain.
examples.zh: 很有可能会下雨。

examples.en: There is now no possibility that she will make a full recovery.
examples.zh: 她现在已不可能完全康复。

examples.en: We cannot exclude the possibility that another person may have been involved.
examples.zh: 我们不能排除其他人参与其中的可能性。

examples.en: I have considered the possibility that she is dead.
examples.zh: 我考虑过她死了的可能性。

examples.en: He refused to rule out the possibility of a tax increase.
examples.zh: 他拒绝排除加税的可能性。

examples.en: There is a real possibility of war.
examples.zh: 确实存在发生战争的可能性。

examples.en: The company has raised the possibility of legal action.
examples.zh: 该公司已提出采取法律行动的可能性。

examples.en: I am excited about the possibility of going to the Olympics.
examples.zh: 我有可能会参加奥运会，我为此感到兴奋。

examples.en: This is a one-year appointment, with the possibility of renewal for an additional year.
examples.zh: 这是一个为期一年的任命，可以再续约一年。

senses.def: one of the different things that you can do in a particular situation

examples.en: The possibilities are endless.
examples.zh: 有无数种可能的做法。

examples.en: Selling the house is just one possibility that is open to us.
examples.zh: 卖掉房子只是我们可以选择的其中一种做法。

examples.en: We have to investigate every possibility.
examples.zh: 我们必须调查每一种可能性。

examples.en: Police are considering a wide range of possibilities.
examples.zh: 警方正在考虑多种可能性。

examples.en: to exhaust all the possibilities
examples.zh: 用尽一切可能的手段

examples.en: She explored the possibility of studying in the US.
examples.zh: 她研究了去美国留学的可能性。

senses.def: something that gives you a chance to achieve something

examples.en: There are countless possibilities for future research.
examples.zh: 未来有无数的研究机会。

examples.en: The course offers a range of exciting possibilities for developing your skills.
examples.zh: 这门课程提供各种令人兴奋的训练技能的机会。

examples.en: In a bookshop, the possibilities for browsing are endless.
examples.zh: 在书店里，浏览的可能性是无限的。

examples.en: Career possibilities for women are much greater than they were fifty years ago.
examples.zh: 女性的职业发展机会比五十年前多很多。

senses.def: if something has possibilities

examples.en: The house is in a bad state of repair but it has possibilities.
examples.zh: 这房子虽亟待修缮，但仍有可资利用的价值。

examples.en: He was the first to see the possibilities of the plan.
examples.zh: 他是第一个看到这个计划的可能性的人。

senses.def: possible/not possible

examples.en: A successful outcome is not beyond the realms of possibility.
examples.zh: 最后并非没有可能成功。

examples.en: It is not beyond the bounds of possibility that we'll all meet again one day.
examples.zh: 我们大家将来有一天再度聚在一起，并非绝不可能。

senses.def: possible/not possible

examples.en: A successful outcome is not beyond the realms of possibility.
examples.zh: 最后并非没有可能成功。

examples.en: It is not beyond the bounds of possibility that we'll all meet again one day.
examples.zh: 我们大家将来有一天再度聚在一起，并非绝不可能。

intro.en: These are all words for something that you choose to do in a particular situation.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指某种情况下的选择。

items.def: something that you can choose to have or do; the freedom to choose what you do:
items.zh: 指可选择的事物、选择、选择权、选择的自由

examples.en: As I see it, we have two options…
examples.zh: 据我看，我们有两种选择…

items.def: the freedom to choose what you do; something that you can choose to have or do:
items.zh: 指选择权、选择的自由、选择、可选择的事物

examples.en: If I had the choice, I would stop working tomorrow.
examples.zh: 如果让我选择，我明天就停止工作。

items.def: something that you can choose to have or do out of two or more possibilities:
items.zh: 指可供选择的事物、其中一种选择

examples.en: You can be paid in cash weekly or by cheque monthly: those are the two alternatives.
examples.zh: 你的工资可以按周以现金支取，或按月以支票支取。二者可选其一。

items.def: one of the different things that you can do in a particular situation:
items.zh: 指某种情况下可选择的事物

examples.en: We need to explore a wide range of possibilities.
examples.zh: 我们需要探究各种可能的情况。

senses.def: that can be done or achieved

examples.en: New technology has made it possible to communicate more easily.
examples.zh: 新技术使沟通变得更容易。

examples.en: It is possible to get there by bus.
examples.zh: 可以乘公共汽车到那里。

examples.en: It's just not physically possible to finish all this by the end of the week.
examples.zh: 要在本周末完成这一切，这在客观上是办不到的。

examples.en: Would it be possible for me to leave a message for her?
examples.zh: 我可以给她留个话儿吗？

examples.en: This wouldn't have been possible without you.
examples.zh: 若没有你，这事就办不成了。

examples.en: I'd like the money back by next week if possible.
examples.zh: 如果可能的话，我希望可以在下周之前收到退款。

examples.en: Try to avoid losing your temper if at all possible (= if you can).
examples.zh: 尽可能别发脾气。

examples.en: Use public transport whenever possible (= when you can).
examples.zh: 尽可能多用公共交通。

examples.en: The doctors did all that was humanly possible to save him.
examples.zh: 医生们竭尽全力抢救他。

examples.en: We spent every possible moment on the beach.
examples.zh: 我们一有时间就到海滩边去。

examples.en: Expansion was made possible by the investment of government money.
examples.zh: 政府资金的投资使扩张成为可能。

examples.en: This film was better than I thought possible.
examples.zh: 这部电影比我想象的要好。

senses.def: that might exist or happen but is not certain to

examples.en: the possible side effects of the drug
examples.zh: 这种药可能产生的副作用

examples.en: a possible future president
examples.zh: 未来可能当选总统的人

examples.en: Frost is possible, although unlikely, at this time of year.
examples.zh: 每年这个时节都有可能下霜，只是并不常见。

examples.en: It is quite possible that the river will flood again.
examples.zh: 这条河很可能再次泛滥。

examples.en: It's just possible that I gave them the wrong directions.
examples.zh: 我也许给他们指错了方向。

examples.en: ‘You might be wrong, of course!’ ‘It’s possible, but I doubt it.’
examples.zh: “当然，也许是你弄错了！”“有可能吧，但我觉得不一定。”

examples.en: With the possible exception of the Beatles, no other band has become so successful so quickly.
examples.zh: 可能除了披头士乐队这个例外，还没有哪个乐队走红得这么快。

examples.en: ‘Do you think he’ll resign?’ ‘Anything’s possible where he’s concerned.’
examples.zh: “你认为他会辞职吗？”“他什么都做得出来。”

examples.en: a possible outcome/effect/consequence
examples.zh: 可能的结果/效果/后果

examples.en: We have to look at every possible scenario.
examples.zh: 我们必须考虑每一种可能的情况。

senses.def: reasonable or acceptable in a particular situation

examples.en: There are several possible explanations.
examples.zh: 有几种合理的解释。

examples.en: Please suggest possible ways in which you would improve the existing program.
examples.zh: 请提出改进​​现有计划的可能方法。

examples.en: a possible solution
examples.zh: 一个可能的解决方案

examples.en: One possible cause/reason is…
examples.zh: 一个可能的原因/理由是……

senses.def: used after adjectives to emphasize that something is the best, worst, etc. of its type
senses.zh: （用于形容词后表示强调）最…的

examples.en: It was the best possible surprise anyone could have given me.
examples.zh: 那是我曾感受过的最大惊喜。

examples.en: Don't leave your packing until the last possible moment.
examples.zh: 打点行李不要拖到最后一刻。

examples.en: Jacobs faces the maximum possible sentence of five years imprisonment.
examples.zh: 雅各布斯面临的最高刑罚是五年监禁。

senses.def: as quickly, much, soon, etc. as you can

examples.en: We will get your order to you as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 我们将会把您的订货尽早送达。

examples.en: Try to give as much detail as possible in your answer.
examples.zh: 尝试在回答中提供尽可能详细的信息。

examples.en: She did as much as possible to help him.
examples.zh: 她尽可能帮助他。

senses.def: a situation in which you have all the possible advantages/disadvantages together
senses.zh: 各种情况的所有不利因素

examples.en: In the best of all possible worlds, you should be able to develop your career and enjoy a rewarding family life.
examples.zh: 在最好的情况下，您应该能够发展自己的事业并享受充实的家庭生活。

senses.def: the benefits of two or more completely different situations that you can enjoy at the same time
senses.zh: 两种（或多种）不同情况的优点；两全其美

examples.en: If you enjoy the coast and the country, you'll get the best of both worlds on this walk.
examples.zh: 你要是喜欢海滨和乡村，那么这次散步你会一举两得。

examples.en: Maybe in the best of all possible worlds things would be different.
examples.zh: 也许在最好的情况下，事情会有所不同。

senses.def: a situation in which you have all the possible disadvantages at the same time
senses.zh: 所有可能的不利因素都有了；困难重重

senses.def: a person or thing that is suitable for a particular job, purpose, etc. and might be chosen
senses.zh: 合适的人（或物）；恰当人选（或事项）

examples.en: Out of all the people interviewed, there are only five possibles.
examples.zh: 在所有面试过的人中，仅有五个合适的人选。

items.idm: as quickly, much, soon, etc. as possible

senses.def: as quickly, much, soon, etc. as you can

examples.en: We will get your order to you as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 我们将会把您的订货尽早送达。

examples.en: Try to give as much detail as possible in your answer.
examples.zh: 尝试在回答中提供尽可能详细的信息。

examples.en: She did as much as possible to help him.
examples.zh: 她尽可能帮助他。

items.idm: the best/worst of all possible worlds

senses.def: a situation in which you have all the possible advantages/disadvantages together
senses.zh: 各种情况的所有不利因素

examples.en: In the best of all possible worlds, you should be able to develop your career and enjoy a rewarding family life.
examples.zh: 在最好的情况下，您应该能够发展自己的事业并享受充实的家庭生活。

items.idm: the best of both worlds/all possible worlds

senses.def: the benefits of two or more completely different situations that you can enjoy at the same time
senses.zh: 两种（或多种）不同情况的优点；两全其美

examples.en: If you enjoy the coast and the country, you'll get the best of both worlds on this walk.
examples.zh: 你要是喜欢海滨和乡村，那么这次散步你会一举两得。

examples.en: Maybe in the best of all possible worlds things would be different.
examples.zh: 也许在最好的情况下，事情会有所不同。

items.idm: the worst of all (possible) worlds

senses.def: a situation in which you have all the possible disadvantages at the same time
senses.zh: 所有可能的不利因素都有了；困难重重

senses.def: used to say that something might exist, happen or be true, but you are not certain

examples.en: It was possibly their worst performance ever.
examples.zh: 这也许是他们迄今为止最糟糕的表现。

examples.en: She found it difficult to get on with her, possibly because of the difference in their ages.
examples.zh: 她觉得很难与她相处，这可能是因为她们年龄上的差距。

examples.en: ‘Will you be around next week?’ ‘Possibly.’
examples.zh: “你下周过来吗？”“也许吧。”

examples.en: ‘I’m sure he didn’t mean to be rude.’ ‘Quite possibly (= you may be right), but the damage has been done.’
examples.zh: “我确信他并不是有意无礼。”“很有可能（=你可能是对的），但损害已经造成了。”

examples.en: Last year, his mother died, possibly due to heart failure.
examples.zh: 去年，他的母亲去世了，可能是由于心力衰竭。

examples.en: a popular but possibly dangerous type of extreme diet
examples.zh: 一种流行但可能危险的极端饮食类型

senses.def: used with can/could
senses.zh: （与 can 或 could 连用，强调惊奇、恼怒等）

examples.en: You can't possibly mean that!
examples.zh: 你绝不会是那个意思吧！

examples.en: How could you possibly think that I had anything to do with it!
examples.zh: 你怎么可能认为这件事跟我有关系！

examples.en: He turned out to be the nicest guy you could possibly imagine.
examples.zh: 事实证明，他是你能想象到的最好的人。

examples.en: What could possibly go wrong?
examples.zh: 可能出什么事呢？

senses.def: used with could
senses.zh: （与 could 连用，表示委婉的请求）

examples.en: Could you possibly open that window?
examples.zh: 请你把那扇窗子打开好吗？

senses.def: used with can/could
senses.zh: （与 can 或 could 连用）尽量，尽可能

examples.en: I will come as soon as I possibly can.
examples.zh: 我会尽快赶来的。

examples.en: They tried everything they possibly could to improve the situation.
examples.zh: 他们为改善局面用尽了一切办法。

examples.en: We don’t want these rumours to spread if we can possibly avoid it.
examples.zh: 如果可以避免的话，我们不希望这些谣言传播开来。

examples.en: I don't see what more he could possibly do.
examples.zh: 我看不出他还能做什么。

senses.def: used with negatives, especially can't/couldn't
senses.zh: （与 can’t、couldn’t 等否定词连用，以加强语气）

examples.en: I can't possibly tell you that!
