a situation in which a person, group or country tries to control a situation by using their power, threats of force, etc.

examples.en: International politics frequently means power politics.
examples.zh: 国际政治常常意味着强权政治。

examples.en: They took the view that Casper was playing power politics with their jobs at stake.
examples.zh: 他们认为卡斯珀在玩强权政治，用他们的职位作赌注。

examples.en: Power politics plays/play an important role here.
examples.zh: 强权政治在这里发挥着重要作用。

senses.def: a policy or system in which different groups or political parties share responsibility for making decisions, taking political action, etc.
senses.zh: 权力分掌（按联盟成员或政党分配决策和政治行动等的权力）

senses.def: a shower that has an electric pump
senses.zh: 电泵淋浴器；强力淋浴器

senses.def: a building or group of buildings where electricity is produced

examples.en: a coal-fired power station
examples.zh: 燃煤火力发电厂

examples.en: a nuclear power station
examples.zh: 核电站

senses.def: a system that uses power from the engine to help the driver change direction

examples.en: Does the car have power steering?
examples.zh: 这辆车有动力转向装置吗？

senses.def: a tool that has an electric motor and is held in the hand

examples.en: If you're happy using power tools like drills and sanders, you can do most of the work yourself.
examples.zh: 要是你乐于使用钻头和砂轮磨光机等电动工具，那么大可以自己完成大部分工作。

senses.def: an action or a way of behaving in which a person gets great pleasure from having control over others

examples.en: He's been on a power trip ever since he got promoted.
examples.zh: 他升职后一直在展示自己的权力。

senses.def: to prepare a machine to start working by supplying it with electricity, etc.; (of a machine) to start working

examples.en: Back at the hotel, I powered up my laptop.
examples.zh: 回到酒店后，我打开了笔记本电脑。

examples.en: The system wouldn't power on.
examples.zh: 系统无法开机。

senses.def: the moment when a machine is switched on and starts working

examples.en: Does the computer beep on power-up?
examples.zh: 电脑开机时发出“哔”的响声吗？

senses.def: in computer games, an advantage that a character can get if a player wins a certain number of points, for example more strength
senses.zh: 威力升级（玩电脑游戏者赢得一定点数时人物获得力量提升等）

senses.def: a person who can use the more advanced features of computer software
senses.zh: （计算机软件）高级功能使用者，高级用户

examples.en: This new processor is aimed at the power user.
examples.zh: 这款新处理器针对的是高级用户。

senses.def: the activity of walking very quickly as a form of exercise
a small device with a battery for charging a mobile phone or other electronic device

examples.en: Take a PowerBank with you if you can't afford for your phone to die.
examples.zh: 你要是不能让手机没电，就随身带个充电宝。

senses.def: a fast boat with a powerful engine that is used especially for racing
being able to control and influence people and events

examples.en: an incredibly powerful organization
examples.zh: 影响力极大的组织

examples.en: extremely/immensely/enormously powerful
examples.zh: 极其/极其/极其强大

examples.en: The US remains the most powerful nation in the world.
examples.zh: 美国仍然是世界上最强大的国家。

examples.en: She is still a powerful figure in the party.
examples.zh: 她在党内仍然是个很有权势的人物。

examples.en: a rich and powerful man
examples.zh: 一个有钱有势的人

examples.en: Fortunately we have some powerful allies.
examples.zh: 幸运的是，我们有一些强大的盟友。

examples.en: Over time these groups have grown more powerful.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，这些团体变得越来越强大。

examples.en: Europe has become increasingly powerful on the world stage.
examples.zh: 欧洲在世界舞台上变得越来越强大。

senses.def: having great power or force; very effective
senses.zh: 强有力的；力量大的；很有效的

examples.en: a powerful engine
examples.zh: 大功率引擎

examples.en: a powerful voice
examples.zh: 洪亮的嗓音

examples.en: a powerful telescope
examples.zh: 高倍望远镜

examples.en: A huge and powerful storm is on track to hit Florida.
examples.zh: 一场巨大而强大的风暴即将袭击佛罗里达州。

examples.en: I traded my computer in for a more powerful model.
examples.zh: 我把我的电脑换成了更强大的型号。

examples.en: Capitalism is an immensely powerful force in modern society.
examples.zh: 资本主义是现代社会中一股强大的力量。

examples.en: Gene technology is a very powerful tool.
examples.zh: 基因技术是一个非常强大的工具。

examples.en: Humour can be a powerful weapon.
examples.zh: 幽默可以是一种强大的武器。

senses.def: having a strong effect on your thoughts, feelings or body
senses.zh: （对人的思想、情感或身体）有强烈作用的

examples.en: a powerful image/symbol/speech
examples.zh: 有力的图像／象征／演说

examples.en: He was prescribed a more powerful painkiller.
examples.zh: 医生给他开了一种更强力的止痛药。

examples.en: Fear is a powerful emotion.
examples.zh: 恐惧是一种强烈的情绪。

examples.en: Her background has had a powerful influence on her film-making.
examples.zh: 她的背景对她的电影制作产生了巨大的影响。

examples.en: A successful prosecution would send a powerful message.
examples.zh: 如果起诉成功，将发出一个有力的信息。

senses.def: physically strong

examples.en: a powerful body
examples.zh: 健壮的体魄

examples.en: a powerful athlete
examples.zh: 矫健的运动员

examples.en: When she trots she covers ground like a powerful horse rather than a pony.
examples.zh: 当她小跑时，她像一匹强大的马而不是小马一样覆盖地面。

senses.def: in a way that shows power or force; in a way that is very effective
senses.zh: 有力地：以显示力量或力量的方式；以非常有效的方式

examples.en: She argued powerfully for reform.
examples.zh: 她雄辩滔滔，力主改革。

senses.def: in a way that has a strong effect on your mind or body
senses.zh: （对身心）有强烈作用的，效力大的

examples.en: a powerfully emotive song
examples.zh: 激动人心的歌曲

senses.def: in a physically strong way

examples.en: He is powerfully built (= he has a large strong body).
examples.zh: 他身体魁梧健壮。

senses.def: a group or an organization that is strong and effective in its activities
senses.zh: 强大的集团；有力量的组织

examples.en: China has been described as an economic powerhouse.
examples.zh: 中国被誉为经济强国。

senses.def: a person who is very strong and full of energy
senses.zh: 精力充沛的人；身强力壮的人

senses.def: without power to control or to influence somebody/something

examples.en: powerless minorities
examples.zh: 弱势的少数族群

examples.en: When the enemy attacked, we were completely powerless against them.
examples.zh: 敌人进攻的时候，我们毫无抵御能力。

examples.en: As children we all feel powerless.
examples.zh: 作为孩子，我们都感到无能为力。

senses.def: completely unable to do something

examples.en: I saw what was happening, but I was powerless to help.
examples.zh: 我眼看着事情发生，却无力相助。

examples.en: The Embassy seemed powerless to intervene.
examples.zh: 大使馆似乎无力干预。

senses.def: the state of being unable to control or influence somebody/something

examples.en: a feeling/sense of powerlessness
examples.zh: 无能为力的感觉

senses.def: a person who does powerlifting
senses.zh: （分三项依次进行的）力量举重

senses.def: the sport of lifting weights in three different ways, in a set order
senses.zh: （分三项依次进行的）力量举重

senses.def: (c. 1550-1618) the leader of the Powhatan people and the Powhatan Confederacy of 30 groups in Virginia
senses.zh: 波瓦坦（(约 1550-1618 年) 波瓦坦人民和弗吉尼亚州和马里兰州部分地区 30 个群体的波瓦坦联盟的领导人。他是波卡洪塔斯的父亲，在她嫁给一位英国人后，波瓦坦与詹姆斯敦社区实现了和平。）

senses.def: a ceremony in many native North American cultures in which people meet, sing and dance
senses.zh: 帕瓦（美洲土著的一种集会）

senses.def: a meeting or discussion
a large region in central Wales, on the border with England. Since 1996 it has been governed by a unitary authority
senses.zh: 在威尔士中部的一个大区域，与英格兰接壤。自1996年以来，它一直由统一机构管理。它的行政中心是兰德林多德韦尔斯镇。

senses.def: a disease spread by sexual contact
a serious disease that caused a high temperature, left permanent marks on the skin and often caused death
if somebody describes something as poxy
senses.zh: 无价值的；无足轻重的；鸡毛蒜皮的

senses.def: pages

examples.en: See pp. 100–117.

senses.def: used in front of a person’s name when somebody signs a business letter for that person
senses.zh: （置于信末署名前，表示由别人代签）

examples.en: pp Chris Baker (= from Chris Baker, but signed by somebody else because Chris Baker is away)
examples.zh: 代表克里斯·贝克

senses.def: very quietly (from Italian ‘
senses.zh: 很弱（源于意大利语 pianissimo）

senses.def: clothing and equipment that is worn or used to protect people against infection or injury (the abbreviation for personal protective equipment
senses.zh: 个人防护装备（全写为 personal protective equipment）

examples.en: It is critical that medical staff wear the appropriate PPE.
examples.zh: 医护人员穿戴合适的个人防护装备至关重要。

senses.def: pixels per inch
senses.zh: 每英寸像素（图像质量度量单位）

senses.def: preferred provider organization
a Member of Parliament in the UK who is given the job of helping a minister (the abbreviation for ‘
senses.zh: （英国）议会私人秘书（全写为 Parliamentary Private Secretary，协助各大臣工作的议员）

senses.def: pay-per-view
senses.zh: （电视节目的）每收视一次付费

senses.def: the business of giving the public information about a particular organization or person in order to create a good impression (the abbreviation for ‘
senses.zh: 公关，公共关系（全写为 public relations）

examples.en: a PR department/agency/campaign
examples.zh: 公关部门／机构／活动

examples.en: The article is very good PR for the theatre.
examples.zh: 这篇文章能大大提升剧院的公共形象。

senses.def: a system that gives each party in an election a number of seats in relation to the number of votes its candidates receive (the abbreviation for ‘
senses.zh: 比例代表制（按参选各党派的得票比例分配席位，全写为 proportional representation）

senses.def: the quality of being able to be done, or of being likely to be successful

examples.en: We were doubtful about the practicability of the plan.
examples.zh: 我们怀疑这个计划是否切实可行。

senses.def: able to be done; likely to be successful

examples.en: at the earliest practicable opportunity
examples.zh: 在尽可能早的时机

examples.en: You should report any such incident to your manager as soon as (is) practicable.
examples.zh: 您应尽快向您的经理报告任何此类事件。

examples.en: The only practicable alternative is to postpone the meeting.
examples.zh: 另外唯一可行的办法就是推迟会期。

examples.en: Employers should provide a safe working environment, as far as is reasonably practicable.
examples.zh: 只要条件许可，雇主就须提供安全的工作环境。

examples.en: Working at night wasn’t a practicable proposition.
examples.zh: 晚上工作并不是一个可行的建议。

senses.def: in a way that is possible

examples.en: Please reply as soon as is practicably possible.
examples.zh: 请尽早回复。

senses.def: connected with real situations rather than with ideas or theories
senses.zh: 实际的；真实的；客观存在的

examples.en: to have gained practical experience of the work
examples.zh: 获得实际工作经验

examples.en: He offered her some practical advice.
examples.zh: 他给了她一些实用的建议。

examples.en: What are the practical implications of the proposal?
examples.zh: 该提案有哪些实际影响？

examples.en: There are some obvious practical applications of the research.
examples.zh: 这项研究有一些明显的实际用途。

examples.en: In practical terms, it means spending less.
examples.zh: 具体来说，那样会少花些钱。

examples.en: From a practical point of view, it isn't a good place to live.
examples.zh: 实际一点看，这里不是理想的住处。

examples.en: Yoga helps with practical matters such as injury prevention.
examples.zh: 瑜伽有助于解决诸如预防伤害等实际问题。

examples.en: Of how much practical use was the conference?
examples.zh: 这次会议有多少实际作用呢？

examples.en: Try to find a course which will allow you to develop the practical skills employers want.
examples.zh: 尝试找到一门可以让您培养雇主想要的实用技能的课程。

examples.en: The fog could present some practical difficulties.
examples.zh: 雾可能会带来一些实际困难。

senses.group: connected with real things 真实

senses.def: right or sensible; likely to be successful

examples.en: I soon realized that it would have been more practical to walk.
examples.zh: 我很快意识到步行会更实用。

examples.en: It wouldn't be practical for us to go all that way just for the weekend.
examples.zh: 我们跑那么远只为了去度个周末实在很不切实际。

examples.en: It was difficult to find a practical solution to the problem.
examples.zh: 很难找到切实可行的解决这一问题的方案。

examples.en: The government is taking practical steps to deal with this issue.
examples.zh: 政府正在采取切实可行的措施来解决这个问题。

examples.en: Travel by boat was often faster and more practical than travel along the primitive roads.
examples.zh: 乘船旅行往往比沿着简陋的公路旅行更快捷、更实际。

senses.def: useful or suitable

examples.en: a practical little car, ideal for the city
examples.zh: 理想的城市实用小汽车

examples.en: Cool, loose-fitting clothes are practical in a hot climate.
examples.zh: 凉爽、宽松的衣服在炎热的气候下很实用。

examples.en: a briefcase that is practical for both travelling and days at the office
examples.zh: 适合旅行和办公室使用的公文包

examples.en: a feature that makes the system more practical
examples.zh: 使系统更实用的特性

senses.def: sensible and realistic

examples.en: Let's be practical and work out the cost first.
examples.zh: 咱们实际一点儿，先计算一下成本费用。

examples.en: He always adopted a severely practical tone.
examples.zh: 他总是采取一种严肃务实的语气。

examples.en: Sarah is quite practical about love and relationships.
examples.zh: 莎拉对于爱情和人际关系非常务实。

senses.def: good at making or repairing things
senses.zh: 心灵手巧的；善于制作（或修补）的

examples.en: Bob's very practical. He does all the odd jobs around the house.
examples.zh: 鲍勃心灵手巧，家里的零活他都包了。

senses.group: good at making things 长于制作

senses.def: almost complete or total

examples.en: She married a practical stranger.
examples.zh: 她等于是嫁了个陌生人。

examples.en: They’re a practical certainty to win the game.
examples.zh: 他们实际上已经确定了赢得比赛。

senses.def: used when you are stating what the reality of a situation is

examples.en: There's still another ten minutes of the game to go, but for practical purposes it's already over.
examples.zh: 比赛虽然还有十分钟，但实际上等于已经结束了。

senses.def: a lesson or an exam in science or technology in which students have to do or make things, not just read or write about them
senses.zh: 实习课；实践课；实验考核

examples.en: a biology practical
examples.zh: 生物学实践

examples.en: The second part of the exam is a three-hour practical.
examples.zh: 考试第二部分是三个小时的实际操作。

examples.en: I passed the written exam but failed the practical.
examples.zh: 我通过了笔试，但是实验课考试不及格。

examples.en: The course involves lectures, demonstrations and practicals.
examples.zh: 这门课程包括讲课、演示和实习。

senses.def: used when you are stating what the reality of a situation is

examples.en: There's still another ten minutes of the game to go, but for practical purposes it's already over.
examples.zh: 比赛虽然还有十分钟，但实际上等于已经结束了。

senses.def: a trick that is played on somebody to make them look stupid and to make other people laugh
a person who plays tricks on people to make them look stupid and to make other people laugh

examples.en: He’s a real practical joker.
examples.zh: 他是一个真正的恶作剧者。

senses.def: a nurse with practical experience but less training than a registered nurse
senses.zh: 职业护士（有实际经验，但所受训练不及注册护士）

senses.def: the quality of being suitable, or likely to be successful

examples.en: I have doubts about the practicality of their proposal.
examples.zh: 我怀疑他们的建议是否行得通。

examples.en: Victorian engineers combined practicality with beauty.
examples.zh: 维多利亚时代的工程师将实用性与美观结合起来。

senses.def: the quality of being sensible and realistic

examples.en: I was impressed by her practicality.
examples.zh: 她做事踏实，着实令我赞佩。

senses.def: the real facts and circumstances rather than ideas or theories

examples.en: It sounds like a good idea; let's look at the practicalities and work out the costs.
examples.zh: 这个主意听起来不错。咱们来看看实际运作，计算一下费用。

senses.def: almost; very nearly

examples.en: The theatre was practically empty.
examples.zh: 剧院几乎是空的。

examples.en: I meet famous people practically every day.
examples.zh: 我几乎每天都见到名人。

examples.en: My essay is practically finished now.
examples.zh: 我的论文现在差不多写完了。

examples.en: With that crack in it, the vase is worth practically nothing.
examples.zh: 有了那道裂纹，这只花瓶可说是一文不值。

examples.en: There's practically no difference between the two options.
examples.zh: 这两种选择几乎没什么差别。

senses.def: in a realistic or sensible way; in real situations

examples.en: Practically speaking, we can't afford it.
examples.zh: 实际说来，我们买不起这东西。

examples.en: It sounds like a good idea, but I don't think it will work practically.
examples.zh: 这个主意听起来不错，但我认为它实际上行不通。

senses.def: doing an activity or training regularly so that you can improve your skill; the time you spend doing this

examples.en: conversation practice
examples.zh: 会话练习

examples.en: It takes a lot of practice to play the violin well.
examples.zh: 拉好小提琴需要多加练习。

examples.en: There's a basketball practice every Friday evening.
examples.zh: 每星期五晚上有篮球训练。

examples.en: She does an hour's piano practice every day.
examples.zh: 她每天练一小时钢琴。

examples.en: With practice you will become more skilled.
examples.zh: 熟能生巧。

examples.en: I've had a lot of practice in saying ‘no’ recently!
examples.zh: 最近我常常练习说“不”！

examples.en: It takes years of practice to get it right.
examples.zh: 需要多年的练习才能做到正确。

examples.en: We had an extra practice session on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五我们进行了额外的练习。

senses.group: for improving skill 提高技巧

senses.def: action rather than ideas

examples.en: the theory and practice of teaching
examples.zh: 教学的理论与实践

examples.en: She's determined to put her new ideas into practice.
examples.zh: 她决心要把自己的新想法付诸实践。

examples.en: the complications that arise in actual practice
examples.zh: 实际操作中出现的错综复杂的情况

senses.def: a way of doing something that is the usual or expected way in a particular organization or situation

examples.en: Wearing gloves should be standard practice when handling pesticides.
examples.zh: 处理农药时戴手套应该是标准做法。

examples.en: These methods remain current practice.
examples.zh: 这些方法仍然是当前的实践。

examples.en: It is a common practice to include recommendations for further action in such reports.
examples.zh: 在此类报告中包含进一步行动的建议是一种常见的做法。

examples.en: Everyone knows it is good business practice to listen to your customers.
examples.zh: 人人都知道聆听客户的意见是良好的商业习惯。

examples.en: childcare policy and practice
examples.zh: 儿童保育政策和实践

examples.en: a review of pay and working practices
examples.zh: 对薪金和工作制度的审查

examples.en: Religious practices differ from group to group.
examples.zh: 宗教习俗因派别不同而不同。

examples.en: I am constantly adopting new practices on my farm.
examples.zh: 我在我的农场里不断采用新方法。

examples.en: The government has changed its accounting practices.
examples.zh: 政府改变了其会计做法。

examples.en: We will follow the practice of going in alphabetical order.
examples.zh: 我们将沿用按照字母顺序排列的惯例。

examples.en: The company has ended its practice of pumping raw sewage out to sea.
examples.zh: 该公司已经结束了将原污水排入大海的做法。

senses.group: way of doing something 做法

senses.def: a thing that is done regularly; a habit or a custom

examples.en: the German practice of giving workers a say in how their company is run
examples.zh: 德国人在公司经营上给予工人发言权的做法

examples.en: It is his practice to read several books a week.
examples.zh: 他习惯于每周读几本书。

senses.def: the work or the business of some professional people such as doctors, dentists and lawyers; the place where they work
senses.zh: （医生、律师的）工作，业务活动，工作地点

examples.en: the practice of medicine
examples.zh: 行医

examples.en: clinical/medical practice
examples.zh: 临床实践；医务工作

examples.en: Students should have prior experience of veterinary practice.
examples.zh: 学生应有兽医工作的经验。

examples.en: My solicitor is no longer in practice.
examples.zh: 我的律师已不再执业了。

examples.en: a successful medical/dental/law practice
examples.zh: 成功的诊所／牙医诊所／律师事务所

senses.def: to be/become less good at doing something than you were because you have not spent time doing it recently

examples.en: Don't ask me to speak French! I'm out of practice.
examples.zh: 可别让我讲法语！我已经生疏了。

examples.en: If you don't play regularly you soon get out of practice.
examples.zh: 如果不经常演奏，你很快就会荒疏。

examples.zh: 南希对古董和二手珍品的热爱给她的家带来了欢乐的感觉。

a student who is taking classes in preparation for medical school
premedication

examples.zh: 您可以点击下面的链接预订。

examples.zh: 该游戏现在可以预订了。

examples.zh: 预订专辑的粉丝将立即收到一首可供下载的曲目。

examples.zh: 在前期制作上花费的每一分钟的价值是任何其他阶段的十倍。

senses.def: done before the process of producing something, especially a film, begins

examples.en: the pre-production script

senses.def: a competition or game in which teams or players take part to decide if they are good enough to be in another competition
relating to a competition or game in which teams or players take part to decide if they are good enough to be in another competition

examples.en: players who fail at the pre-qualifying stage
examples.zh: 在预选赛中淘汰掉的选手

senses.def: connected with or in the style of the Pre-Raphaelites
senses.zh: 拉斐尔前派绘画风格的

examples.zh: 拉斐尔前派风格的绘画

senses.def: looking like a person in a painting by one of the Pre-Raphaelites
senses.zh: 似拉斐尔前派绘画中人物的（如皮肤白皙，有浓密的深红色长发）

senses.def: a member of a group of British nineteenth-century artists who painted in a style similar to Italian artists of the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries, before the time of Raphael
senses.zh: 拉斐尔前派画家（英国 19 世纪的画家，风格近似拉斐尔之前的 14、15 世纪意大利画家）

senses.zh: 预先录制（音乐、电视节目等）

senses.zh: （用广告等）提前促销（未上市的产品、服务等）

examples.en: Putting a trial version on your website is a great way of pre-selling your product.
examples.zh: 在网站上放一个试用版是预售产品的好方法。

senses.def: to sell something in advance of when it is available

examples.zh: 这些农民预售他们的作物。

examples.en: MTV were able to pre-sell the film in foreign markets.
examples.zh: MTV 能够在国外市场预售这部电影。

senses.def: before the tax has been taken away

examples.en: pre-tax profits/losses/income
examples.zh: 税前利润／亏损／收入

senses.def: to teach something, especially new words, to students before a test or exercise
senses.zh: 考试（或练习）前教授（新词等）；先期教授

senses.zh: （约 11 或 12 岁的）大儿童，小少年；10 岁出头的儿童

examples.zh: 十岁出头的几年

senses.def: a young person of about 11 or 12 years of age
senses.zh: （约 11 或 12 岁的）大儿童，小少年；10 岁出头的儿童

senses.def: happening or existing before a war, especially before the Second World War

examples.en: the pre-war years
examples.zh: 战前的年代

examples.en: pre-war Britain
examples.zh: 战前的英国

senses.def: to wash cloth before it is used, or clothing before it is sold
senses.zh: 预洗（未使用或待售的布料或衣物）

senses.def: to give clothing an extra wash before the main wash, especially in a machine
senses.zh: （尤指用洗衣机等在常规洗涤程序前）预洗

senses.def: an extra wash before the main wash
a substance which is applied to clothing before washing, in order to make it cleaner
senses.zh: （洗涤之前使用的）衣物除渍精

senses.def: to give a religious talk in a public place, especially in a church during a service
senses.zh: 布道，讲道（尤指教堂中礼拜时）

examples.en: She preached to the congregation about forgiveness.
examples.zh: 她向会众宣讲宽恕的道理。

examples.en: The minister preached a sermon on the parable of the lost sheep.
examples.zh: 牧师讲道时用了亡羊的比喻。

senses.def: to tell people about a particular religion, way of life, system, etc. in order to persuade them to accept it
senses.zh: 宣传，宣扬，宣讲（教义、生活方式、体制等）

examples.en: to preach the word of God
examples.zh: 传布上帝的道

examples.en: He preached the virtues of capitalism to us.
examples.zh: 他向我们宣扬资本主义的优点。

examples.en: She preached about the benefits of a healthy lifestyle.
examples.zh: 她宣讲了健康生活的好处。

senses.def: to give somebody advice on moral standards, behaviour, etc., especially in a way that they find annoying or boring

examples.en: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to preach.
examples.zh: 很抱歉，我并没有说教的意思。

examples.en: You're preaching at me again!
examples.zh: 你又在对我说教了！

senses.def: to do the things yourself that you tell other people to do
senses.zh: 身体力行；躬行所言；言行一致

senses.def: to speak to people in support of views that they already hold
senses.zh: 向教徒宣教；教读书人写大字

examples.en: I realize I may be preaching to the converted, but I think he's gorgeous.
examples.zh: 我意识到我可能是在向皈依者布道，但我认为他很漂亮。

senses.def: to do the things yourself that you tell other people to do
senses.zh: 身体力行；躬行所言；言行一致

senses.def: to speak to people in support of views that they already hold
senses.zh: 向教徒宣教；教读书人写大字

examples.en: I realize I may be preaching to the converted, but I think he's gorgeous.
examples.zh: 我意识到我可能是在向皈依者布道，但我认为他很漂亮。

senses.def: to speak to people in support of views that they already hold
senses.zh: 向教徒宣教；教读书人写大字

examples.en: I realize I may be preaching to the choir, but I think he's gorgeous.
examples.zh: 我知道我这话可能多余，不过我觉得他棒极了。

senses.def: to speak to people in support of views that they already hold

examples.en: I realize I may be preaching to the converted, but I think he's gorgeous.
examples.zh: 我意识到我可能是在向皈依者布道，但我认为他很漂亮。

senses.def: a person, often a member of the clergy

examples.en: a preacher famous for her inspiring sermons
examples.zh: 以发人深省的讲道出名的传道者

examples.en: a lay preacher (= who is not a priest, etc. but who has been trained to give religious talks)
examples.zh: 在俗传道员

senses.def: trying to give advice or to persuade people to accept an opinion on what is right and wrong
an introduction to a book or a written document; an introduction to something you say

examples.en: The aims of the treaty are stated in its preamble.
examples.zh: 条约的宗旨已在序言中说明。

examples.en: the Preamble to the US Constitution
examples.zh: 美国宪法序言

examples.en: She gave him the bad news without preamble.
examples.zh: 她开门见山地把坏消息告诉了他。

senses.def: planned or arranged in advance
senses.zh: 预先安排的；预先准备的；预定的

examples.en: a prearranged signal
examples.zh: 预先约定的暗号

senses.def: a statement saying or proving that a criticism is false or unfair before the criticism has actually been made
senses.zh: （对未提出的指责等的）预先驳斥

senses.def: that will develop into cancer if not treated

examples.en: precancerous cells
examples.zh: 癌前细胞

senses.def: people whose employment and income are not secure, especially when considered as a class
senses.zh: 失业前：就业和收入没有保障的人，尤其是在被当成阶级的时候

examples.en: The precariat, the poorest and most deprived grouping, made up 15% of the population.
examples.zh: 不稳定无产者是最贫穷、最贫困的群体，占人口的 15%。

examples.en: Members of the precariat are generally so worried about keeping their jobs that they will take wage cuts and give up all employment rights.
examples.zh: 不稳定阶层成员通常非常担心保住工作，因此他们会接受减薪并放弃所有就业权利。

senses.def: not safe or certain; dangerous
senses.zh: 不稳的；不确定的；不保险的；危险的

examples.en: He earned a precarious living as an artist.
examples.zh: 作为一个艺术家，他过的是朝不保夕的生活。

examples.en: The museum is in a financially precarious position.
examples.zh: 这家博物馆的财政状况不稳定。

examples.en: The world is a precarious and unstable place.
examples.zh: 世界是一个岌岌可危、不稳定的地方。

examples.en: They have a somewhat precarious existence.
examples.zh: 他们的生存有些不稳定。

senses.def: likely to fall or cause somebody to fall

examples.en: That ladder looks very precarious.
examples.zh: 那梯子看来摇摇晃晃的。

examples.en: The path down to the beach is very precarious in wet weather.
examples.zh: 通往海滨的小路在雨天非常湿滑危险。

senses.def: in a way that is not safe or certain; dangerously
senses.zh: 不稳的；不确定的；不保险的；危险的

examples.en: The economy is precariously close to recession.
examples.zh: 经济濒临衰退。

senses.def: in a way that means something is likely to fall or that might cause somebody to fall
senses.zh: 不稳定：在一种方式，这意味着的东西可能会下降或可能导致某人下降

examples.en: He balanced the glass precariously on the arm of his chair.
examples.zh: 他把玻璃杯放在椅子的扶手上，随时可能摔下。

senses.def: the state of not being safe or certain; the state of being dangerous
senses.zh: 不稳定：不安全或不确定状态;危险状态

examples.en: the precariousness of his financial situation
examples.zh: 他的财务状况不稳定

senses.def: the state of not being safe or certain

examples.en: The precarity of the property market is very worrying for the economy.
examples.zh: 房地产市场的不稳定对经济来说非常令人担忧。

senses.def: a state of not having a secure job or income, especially over a long period of time

examples.en: Since the financial crisis many more people have been experiencing extreme precarity.
examples.zh: 自金融危机以来，更多的人经历了极度不稳定。

examples.en: Economic precarity is at the heart of the gig economy.
examples.zh: 经济不稳定是零工经济的核心。

senses.def: made into blocks ready to use

examples.en: precast concrete slabs
examples.zh: 混凝土预制板

senses.def: something that is done in advance in order to prevent problems or to avoid danger

examples.en: safety precautions
examples.zh: 安全防范措施

examples.en: precautions against fire
examples.zh: 防火措施

examples.en: You must take all reasonable precautions to protect yourself and your family.
examples.zh: 你必须采取一切合理的预防措施，保护自己和家人。

examples.en: I'll keep the letter as a precaution.
examples.zh: 我要保存这封信，以防万一。

senses.def: a way of referring to contraception

examples.en: We didn't take any precautions and I got pregnant.
examples.zh: 我们没有采取任何避孕措施，所以我怀孕了。

senses.def: done in order to prevent problems or to avoid danger

examples.en: He was kept in the hospital overnight as a precautionary measure.
examples.zh: 为了谨慎起见，他被安排整晚留院观察。

senses.def: to happen before something or come before something/somebody in order
senses.zh: 在…之前发生（或出现）；先于

examples.en: the years preceding the war
examples.zh: 战前的几年

examples.en: His resignation was preceded by weeks of speculation.
examples.zh: 在他辞职之前，有关的猜测已持续了几个星期。

examples.en: She preceded me in the job.
examples.zh: 她是我这工作的前任。

examples.en: in the moments which immediately preceded the earthquake
examples.zh: 就在地震发生之前的时刻

senses.def: to go in front of somebody

examples.en: She preceded him out of the room.
examples.zh: 她先于他走出屋子。

senses.def: to do or say something to introduce something else

examples.en: She preceded her speech with a vote of thanks to the committee.
examples.zh: 她讲话的开头是对委员会的鸣谢。

senses.def: the condition of being more important than somebody else and therefore coming or being dealt with first

examples.en: She had to learn that her wishes did not take precedence over other people's needs.
examples.zh: 她必须懂得，自己的愿望不能先于别人的需要。

examples.en: The speakers came onto the platform in order of precedence (= the most important one first).
examples.zh: 演讲人按级别鱼贯上台。

examples.en: Environmental concerns must be given precedence over commercial interest.
examples.zh: 环境问题必须优先于商业利益。

senses.def: an official action or decision that has happened in the past and that is seen as an example or a rule to be followed in a similar situation later
senses.zh: 可援用参考的具体例子；实例；范例

examples.en: The ruling set a precedent for future libel cases.
examples.zh: 这项裁决为今后的诽谤案提供了判例。

senses.def: a similar action or event that happened earlier
senses.zh: 先前出现的事例；前例；先例

examples.en: historical precedents
examples.zh: 历史前例

examples.en: There is no precedent for a disaster of this scale.
examples.zh: 这种规模的灾难是空前的。

examples.en: Such protests are without precedent in recent history.
examples.zh: 这类抗议事件在近代史上没有发生过。

examples.en: The achievements of this period were without precedent in history.
examples.zh: 这一时期取得的成就是史无前例的。

senses.def: the way that things have always been done

examples.en: to break with precedent (= to do something in a different way)
examples.zh: 打破常规

senses.def: a rule about how to behave or what to think

examples.en: moral precepts
examples.zh: 道德戒律

senses.def: a commercial area in a town where cars cannot go

examples.en: a pedestrian/shopping precinct
examples.zh: 步行区；购物区

senses.def: one of the parts into which a town or city is divided in order to organize elections

examples.en: voters in key precincts
examples.zh: 关键选区的选民

senses.def: a part of a city that has its own police station; the police station in this area
senses.zh: 警区；分区警察局；派出所

examples.en: Detective Hennessy of the 44th precinct
examples.zh: 第 44 警区的亨尼西警探

examples.en: The murder occurred just a block from the precinct.
examples.zh: 谋杀案就发生在和警察分局相隔一个街区的地方。

senses.def: the area around a place or a building, sometimes surrounded by a wall
senses.zh: （建筑物等的）外围，围墙内区域

examples.en: the cathedral/college precincts
examples.zh: 大教堂／学院周围

examples.en: within the precincts of the castle
examples.zh: 在城堡的围墙内

senses.def: the fact of being precious
rare and worth a lot of money

examples.en: a precious vase
examples.zh: 稀世花瓶

examples.en: The crown was set with precious jewels—diamonds, rubies and emeralds.
examples.zh: 王冠上镶嵌着稀世宝石，有钻石、红宝石和绿宝石。

examples.en: precious metals
examples.zh: 珍贵金属(如 金、银、铂)

senses.def: valuable or important and not to be wasted

examples.en: Clean water is a precious commodity in that part of the world.
examples.zh: 在世界的那个地方，洁净的水是宝贵的东西。

examples.en: You're wasting precious time!
examples.zh: 你在浪费宝贵的时间！

senses.def: loved or valued very much

examples.en: precious memories/possessions
examples.zh: 珍贵的回忆／财物

examples.en: You are infinitely precious to me.
examples.zh: 你对我来说是无比珍贵的。

senses.def: used to show you are angry that another person thinks something is very important

examples.en: I didn't touch your precious car!
examples.zh: 我没碰你那辆宝贝车！

senses.def: very formal, exaggerated
senses.zh: 道貌岸然的；矫揉造作的

senses.def: used to emphasize the fact that there is very little of something or that there are very few of something

examples.en: There's precious little to do in this town.
examples.zh: 这个镇上没有多少可做的事。

examples.en: Precious few people can afford those prices.
examples.zh: 很少有人能负担得起这些价格。

intro.en: These words all describe something that is worth a lot of money or very important to somebody.
intro.zh: 以上各词均用以形容物品值钱、宝贵。

items.def: worth a lot of money:
items.zh: 指值钱的、贵重的

examples.en: The thieves took three pieces of valuable jewellery.
examples.zh: 窃贼盗走了三件贵重的首饰。

items.def: rare and worth a lot of money; loved or valued very much:
items.zh: 指珍稀的、珍贵的、宝贵的

examples.en: a precious Chinese vase, valued at half a million pounds
examples.zh: 价值 50 万英镑的稀世中国花瓶

items.def: extremely valuable; loved or valued very much:
items.zh: 指无价的、极珍贵的、极宝贵的

examples.en: a priceless collection of antiques
examples.zh: 价值连城的古文物收藏

items.def: too valuable or special to be replaced
items.zh: 指因贵重或独特而不能替代的

senses.def: a very valuable metal such as gold or silver

examples.en: a craftsman in precious metals
examples.zh: 贵金属工匠

examples.en: coins made of precious metal
examples.zh: 贵金属制成的硬币

senses.def: a rare valuable stone, such as a diamond, that is used in jewellery

examples.en: a ring set with a precious stone
examples.zh: 镶有宝石的戒指

senses.def: the great personal value of something
senses.zh: 珍贵：某物的巨大个人价值

examples.en: the preciousness of an old friendship
examples.zh: 故交的珍贵

senses.def: the value and importance of something that you do not want to waste
senses.zh: 珍贵：您不想浪费的东西的价值和重要性

examples.en: I feel a sense of the preciousness of every moment in my life.
examples.zh: 我感受到生命中每一刻的珍贵。

senses.def: great formality
senses.zh: 珍贵：别人说的话和做事的形式化和缺乏自然性

examples.en: His writings reveal an unattractive preciousness of style.
examples.zh: 他的文章流露出令人反感的做作风格。

senses.def: a very steep side of a high cliff

examples.en: The country was now on the edge of a precipice (= very close to disaster).
examples.zh: 这个国家现在岌岌可危。

senses.def: to make something, especially something bad, happen suddenly or sooner than it should
senses.zh: 使…突然降临；加速（坏事的发生）

examples.en: His resignation precipitated a leadership crisis.
examples.zh: 他的辞职立即引发了领导层的危机。

senses.def: to suddenly force somebody/something into a particular state or condition

examples.en: The assassination of the president precipitated the country into war.
examples.zh: 总统被暗杀使国家骤然陷入战争状态。

senses.def: happening very quickly or suddenly and usually without enough care and thought

examples.en: the precipitate resignation of the director
examples.zh: 董事突然辞职

examples.en: To force a decision now would be precipitate.
examples.zh: 现在强行做出决定未免过于草率。

senses.def: a solid substance that has been separated from a liquid in a chemical process

examples.en: A yellow precipitate should form immediately.
examples.zh: 应立即形成黄色沉淀。

senses.def: very quickly or suddenly and usually without enough care and thought

examples.en: to act precipitately
examples.zh: 贸然行事

senses.def: rain, snow, etc. that falls; the amount of this that falls
senses.zh: 降水，降水量（包括雨、雪、冰等）

examples.en: There is heavy precipitation in some parts of the country.
examples.zh: 全国部分地区有强降水。

examples.en: Acid precipitation may cause a reduction in forest productivity.
examples.zh: 酸降可能导致森林生产力下降。

examples.en: an increase in annual precipitation
examples.zh: 年降水量的增加

examples.en: Annual precipitation ranges from 500 to 2 200 mm.
examples.zh: 年降水量500～2 200毫米。

examples.en: In these areas precipitation was formerly too low to support growth.
examples.zh: 在这些地区，以前降水量太少，无法支持生长。

senses.def: a chemical process in which solid material is separated from a liquid

examples.en: calcium phosphate precipitation
examples.zh: 磷酸钙沉淀

senses.def: very steep, high and often dangerous

examples.en: precipitous cliffs
examples.zh: 险峻的峭壁

examples.en: a precipitous drop at the side of the road
examples.zh: 道路一旁陡降的坡面

senses.def: sudden and great

examples.en: a precipitous decline in exports
examples.zh: 出口的急剧下降

senses.def: done very quickly, without enough thought or care

examples.en: a precipitous action
examples.zh: 贸然行动

senses.def: in a way that is very steep, high and often dangerous

examples.en: The land dropped precipitously down to the rocky shore.
examples.zh: 地势陡降，下方是礁石漫布的海岸。

senses.def: suddenly and to a very great extent

examples.en: The dollar plunged precipitously.
examples.zh: 美元急剧下跌。

senses.def: very quickly, and without enough thought or care

examples.en: We don't want to act precipitously.
examples.zh: 我们不想仓促行事。

senses.def: to make a short version of a speech or a piece of writing that gives the main points or ideas

examples.en: to precis a scientific report
examples.zh: 写科研报告的摘要

senses.def: a short version of a speech or a piece of writing that gives the main points or ideas

examples.en: to write/give/make a precis of a report
examples.zh: 写／提供／做一份报告摘要

senses.def: clear and accurate
senses.zh: 准确的；确切的；精确的；明确的

examples.en: precise details/instructions/measurements
examples.zh: 确切的细节；明确的指令；精确的尺寸

examples.en: Can you give a more precise definition of the word?
examples.zh: 你能给这个词下个更确切的定义吗？

examples.en: I can be reasonably precise about the time of the incident.
examples.zh: 我可以相当准确地说出这件事发生的时间。

senses.def: used to emphasize that something happens at a particular time or in a particular way

examples.en: We were just talking about her when, at that precise moment, she walked in.
examples.zh: 我们正谈论着她，恰好在这个时候，她走进来了。

examples.en: Doctors found it hard to establish the precise nature of her illness.
examples.zh: 医生们难以判定她的确切病因。

senses.def: taking care to be exact and accurate, especially about small details
senses.zh: 细致的；精细的；认真的；一丝不苟的

examples.en: a skilled and precise worker
examples.zh: 熟练而认真的工人

examples.en: small, precise movements
examples.zh: 细微的动作

examples.en: We've tried to make the process as precise as possible.
examples.zh: 我们努力使该过程尽可能准确。

examples.en: She's rather prim and precise.
examples.zh: 她拘谨严肃，一丝不苟。

senses.def: used to show that you are giving more detailed and accurate information about something you have just mentioned

examples.en: The shelf is about a metre long—well, 98cm, to be precise.
examples.zh: 架子长约一米。嗯，精确地说，是 98 厘米。

senses.def: used to show that you are giving more detailed and accurate information about something you have just mentioned

examples.en: The shelf is about a metre long—well, 98cm, to be precise.
examples.zh: 架子长约一米。嗯，精确地说，是 98 厘米。

senses.def: exactly

examples.en: They look precisely the same to me.
examples.zh: 依我看，他们的长相一模一样。

examples.en: That's precisely what I meant.
examples.zh: 那恰恰是我的意思。

examples.en: It's not clear precisely how the accident happened.
examples.zh: 事故究竟是怎么发生的不是很清楚。

examples.en: The meeting starts at 2 o'clock precisely.
examples.zh: 会议在两点整开始。

senses.def: accurately; carefully

examples.en: to describe something precisely
examples.zh: 精确地描述某事物

examples.en: She pronounced the word very slowly and precisely.
examples.zh: 她缓慢而清晰地读出这个字。

senses.def: used to emphasize that something is very true or obvious

examples.en: It's precisely because I care about you that I don't like you staying out late.
examples.zh: 正因为我关心你，我才不要你太晚回家。

examples.en: The children are precisely the ones who will suffer if they get divorced.
examples.zh: 如果离婚，受苦的恰恰是孩子。

senses.def: used to emphasize that you agree with a statement, especially because you think it is obvious or is similar to what you have just said
senses.zh: （加强同意的语气）对，的确如此，一点也不错

examples.en: ‘It's not that easy, is it?’ ‘No, precisely.’
examples.zh: “事情并不那么容易吧？”“对，的确不容易。”

senses.def: used to show that you are giving more detailed and accurate information about something you have just mentioned
senses.zh: 更确切地说；更严格地说

examples.en: The problem is due to discipline, or, more precisely, the lack of discipline, in schools.
examples.zh: 问题出在纪律上，或者更确切地说，是学校缺乏纪律。

senses.def: used to show that you are giving more detailed and accurate information about something you have just mentioned
senses.zh: 更确切地说；更严格地说

examples.en: The problem is due to discipline, or, more precisely, the lack of discipline, in schools.
examples.zh: 问题出在纪律上，或者更确切地说，是学校缺乏纪律。

senses.def: the quality of being exact, accurate and careful

examples.en: Her writing is imaginative but lacks precision.
examples.zh: 她的文章想象力丰富，但是不够细致。

examples.en: He chose his words with precision.
examples.zh: 他用词确切。

examples.en: done with mathematical precision
examples.zh: 以数学般的精准完成的

examples.en: Historians can’t estimate the date with any (degree of) precision.
examples.zh: 历史学家无法准确估算这个日期。

examples.en: precision instruments/tools
examples.zh: 精密仪器／工具

senses.def: to prevent something from happening or somebody from doing something; to make something impossible
senses.zh: 使行不通；阻止；妨碍；排除

examples.en: Lack of time precludes any further discussion.
examples.zh: 由于时间不足，不可能深入讨论。

examples.en: Your failure to become a member this year does not preclude the possibility of your applying next year.
examples.zh: 您今年未能成为会员并不排除您明年申请的可能性。

examples.en: My lack of interest in the subject precluded me from gaining much enjoyment out of it.
examples.zh: 由于对这个科目缺乏兴趣，我没有从中获得多少乐趣。

examples.en: We cannot have a system that precludes people from seeking independent legal advice.
examples.zh: 我们不能建立一个阻止人们寻求独立法律建议的制度。

examples.en: His religious beliefs precluded him/his serving in the army.
examples.zh: 他的宗教信仰不允许他服兵役。

senses.def: having developed particular abilities and ways of behaving at a much younger age than usual

examples.en: a precocious child who started her acting career at the age of 5
examples.zh: 5 岁便开始演艺生涯的超常儿童

examples.en: sexually precocious
examples.zh: 性早熟

examples.en: From an early age she displayed a precocious talent for music.
examples.zh: 她年纪轻轻就表现出不凡的音乐天赋。

senses.def: in a way that shows particular abilities and ways of behaving at a much younger age than usual

examples.en: a precociously talented child
examples.zh: 早慧的天才儿童

senses.def: the fact of a child having developed particular abilities and ways of behaving at a much younger age than usual

examples.en: his unusual precocity
examples.zh: 他的异常早熟

senses.def: the knowledge that something will happen in the future, which somebody has because of a dream or a sudden feeling
senses.zh: 预知，早知，先知（由梦境或突如其来的感觉感知到未来会发生的事）

senses.def: formed before you have enough information or experience of something

examples.en: Before I started the job, I had no preconceived notions of what it would be like.
examples.zh: 开始做这项工作之前，我并未预想过它的实际情况。

senses.def: an idea or opinion that is formed before you have enough information or experience
senses.zh: 事先形成的观念；先入之见；预想；成见

examples.en: a book that will challenge your preconceptions about rural life
examples.zh: 一本改变你对农村生活成见的书

senses.def: something that must happen or exist before something else can exist or be done

examples.en: A ceasefire is an essential precondition for negotiation.
examples.zh: 停火是谈判的必要前提。

examples.en: The talks will be held without preconditions.
examples.zh: 会谈将无条件举行。

examples.en: Certain problems have to be solved as a precondition to any agreement.
examples.zh: 作为任何协议的先决条件，必须解决某些问题。

examples.en: The reduction of inflation is the precondition of renewed growth.
examples.zh: 通货膨胀的降低是恢复增长的前提。

senses.def: associated with a part of the mind from which memories and thoughts that have not been repressed
senses.zh: 前意识的（指能被带到意识区域的未受压抑的记忆和思想）

senses.def: prepared and partly cooked in advance so that it can be quickly heated and eaten later
a person or thing that comes before somebody/something similar and that leads to or influences its development

examples.en: a stringed instrument that was the precursor of the guitar
examples.zh: 一种弦乐器，是吉他的前身

examples.en: events that were precursors to revolution
examples.zh: 革命前兆的事件

senses.def: to be built or formed, or to happen, at an earlier date than something else in the past
senses.zh: 早于；先于…建成（或形成、发生等）

examples.en: Few of the town's fine buildings predate the earthquake of 1755.
examples.zh: 该城那些精美的建筑很少是 1755 年大地震前建成的。

senses.def: the act of an animal killing and eating other animals

examples.en: Goldfish are particularly prone to predation by cats and birds such as herons.
examples.zh: 金鱼特别容易被猫和苍鹭等鸟类捕食。

senses.def: an animal that kills and eats other animals

examples.en: Some animals have no natural predators.
examples.zh: 有些动物没有天敌。

examples.en: the relationship between predator and prey
examples.zh: 捕食性动物与猎物之间的关系

senses.def: a person or an organization that uses weaker people for their own advantage
senses.zh: 弱肉强食的人（或机构）；剥削者；掠夺者

examples.en: to protect domestic industry from foreign predators
examples.zh: 保护本国工业不受外来剥削

senses.def: living by killing and eating other animals
using weaker people for their own financial or sexual advantage
senses.zh: （在金钱或性关系上）欺负弱小的，压榨他人的

examples.en: a predatory insurance salesman
examples.zh: 用高压手段推销的保险推销员

examples.en: a predatory look
examples.zh: 狞视

senses.def: the practice of lending money to people who cannot afford to pay it back, often by hiding the true cost of the loan
senses.zh: 掠夺性贷款（常通过隐瞒贷款的真实成本将钱借给无力偿还者）

examples.en: Many people say that the collapse of the housing market was due to predatory lending.
examples.zh: 很多人说房地产市场的崩溃是掠夺性贷款造成的。

senses.def: the fact of a company selling its goods at such a low price that other companies can no longer compete and have to stop selling similar goods
senses.zh: 掠夺性定价；为挤垮对手的大削价

senses.def: in or relating to the part of the day just before the first light appears

examples.en: The aircraft took off in the predawn darkness.
examples.zh: 飞机在黎明前的黑暗中起飞。

senses.def: to die before somebody

examples.en: His wife predeceased him.
examples.zh: 他的妻子先于他去世。

senses.def: a person who did a job before somebody else

examples.en: The new president reversed many of the policies of his predecessor.
examples.zh: 新任总统彻底改变了其前任的许多政策。

examples.en: her immediate predecessor in the post
examples.zh: 她的前任

examples.en: my predecessor at the Ministry of Defence
examples.zh: 我的国防部前任

senses.def: a thing, such as a machine, that has been followed or replaced by something else
senses.zh: 原先的东西；被替代的事物

examples.en: This computer has a larger memory than its predecessor.
examples.zh: 这台计算机比其前身具有更大的内存。

senses.def: the theory or the belief that everything that happens has been decided or planned in advance by God or by fate
already decided or planned by God or by fate
senses.zh: 命中注定的；上天安排的

examples.en: It seems she was predestined to be famous.
examples.zh: 她好像是命中注定要出名似的。

senses.def: to decide something in advance so that it does not happen by chance

examples.en: The sex of the embryo is predetermined at fertilization.
examples.zh: 胚胎的性别早在受精时就决定了。

examples.en: The way in which surveys are carried out often predetermines the results that are obtained.
examples.zh: 进行调查的方式通常预先决定了所获得的结果。

senses.def: a word that can be used before a determiner, such as all
senses.zh: 前位限定词，前位限定成分（置于限定词前，如 all the students 中的 all 和 twice the price 中的 twice）

senses.def: a difficult or an unpleasant situation, especially one where it is difficult to know what to do

examples.en: the club’s financial predicament
examples.zh: 俱乐部的财政困境

examples.en: I'm in a terrible predicament.
examples.zh: 我的处境十分尴尬。

senses.def: a part of a sentence containing a verb that makes a statement about the subject of the verb, such as went home
senses.zh: 谓语（句子成分，对主语加以陈述，如 John went home 中的 went home）

senses.def: to base something on a particular belief, idea or principle

examples.en: Democracy is predicated upon the rule of law.
examples.zh: 民主是以法治为基础的。

senses.def: to state that something is true

examples.en: The article predicates that the market collapse was caused by weakness of the dollar.
examples.zh: 这篇文章声言，市场的崩溃是美元疲软造成的。

senses.def: coming after a verb such as be, become, get, seem, look
senses.zh: 作表语的，谓语性的（例如 asleep，用于 be、become、get、seem、look 等动词后；与 attributive 相对）

senses.def: in a sentence position that is after a verb such as be
senses.zh: 作表语的，谓语性的（例如 asleep，用于 be、become、get、seem、look 等动词后；与 attributive 相对）

senses.def: to say that something will happen in the future

examples.en: a reliable method of predicting earthquakes
examples.zh: 预报地震的可靠方法

examples.en: Nobody could predict the outcome.
examples.zh: 谁也无法预料结果如何。

examples.en: to predict the future
examples.zh: 预测未来

examples.en: He predicts a bright future for the business in the next financial year.
examples.zh: 他预计下一个财政年度的业务前景光明。

examples.en: The party is predicting a majority of 20 seats.
examples.zh: 该党预计获得 20 个席位的多数席位。

examples.en: It is impossible to predict what will happen.
examples.zh: 未来的事不可能预知。

examples.en: She predicted (that) the election result would be close.
examples.zh: 她预言选举结果将很接近。

examples.en: He predicted (that) it would be a bestseller.
examples.zh: 他预测这将是一本畅销书。

examples.en: It was predicted that inflation would continue to fall.
examples.zh: 据预报，通货膨胀率将继续下降。

examples.en: The trial is predicted to last for months.
examples.zh: 预料审讯将持续数月之久。

examples.en: This figure is predicted to rise to one billion by the year 2030.
examples.zh: 预计到 2030 年，这一数字将增至 10 亿。

senses.def: the quality something has when it is possible for you to know in advance that it will happen or what it will be like

examples.en: Many young offenders commit further crimes with alarming predictability.
examples.zh: 许多年轻罪犯以惊人的可预测性犯下更多罪行。

senses.def: the quality somebody/something has when they are exactly as you would expect and therefore boring
senses.zh: 可预测性：某人/某物在完全符合您的期望时所具有的质量，因此很无聊

examples.en: the dull predictability of most of this poetry
examples.zh: 这首诗的大部分内容都是乏味的可预测性

senses.def: if something is predictable

examples.en: a predictable result
examples.zh: 可预见的结果

examples.en: The ending of the book was entirely predictable.
examples.zh: 那本书的结局是完全预料得到的。

examples.en: The disease follows a highly predictable pattern.
examples.zh: 这种疾病的模式非常有规律。

examples.en: In March and April, the weather is much less predictable.
examples.zh: 三四月份的天气非常不好预测。

senses.def: behaving or happening in a way that you would expect and therefore boring
senses.zh: 意料之中的；老套乏味的

examples.en: He's very nice, but I find him rather dull and predictable.
examples.zh: 他为人很不错，但我觉得他相当呆板乏味。

examples.en: Rock music is getting so predictable these days.
examples.zh: 如今，摇滚音乐变得越来越容易预测。

examples.en: She had been in a number of predictable sitcoms.
examples.zh: 她曾出演过许多可预测的情景喜剧。

senses.def: in such a way that you know in advance that something will happen or what it will be like

examples.en: Prices were predictably high.
examples.zh: 价格高昂是意料中的事。

examples.en: Predictably, the new regulations proved unpopular.
examples.zh: 正如所料，新规定果然不得人心。

senses.def: in a way that you would expect and which is therefore boring
senses.zh: 意料之中的；老套乏味的

examples.en: Everyone was predictably outraged by her comments.
examples.zh: 不出所料，每个人都对她的言论感到愤怒。

senses.def: a statement that says what you think will happen; the act of making such a statement

examples.en: The results of the experiment confirmed our predictions.
examples.zh: 实验结果一如我们所料。

examples.en: I've learned not to make predictions about the weather.
examples.zh: 我懂得了不要预测天气的道理。

examples.en: It's difficult to make accurate predictions about the effects on the environment.
examples.zh: 很难准确预测对环境产生的影响。

examples.en: Experts preview the game and offer their prediction on the outcome.
examples.zh: 专家们预览比赛并对结果做出预测。

examples.en: Not many people agree with the government's prediction that the economy will improve.
examples.zh: 政府预测经济将会改善，但没有多少人赞同。

examples.en: Their prediction of fifty million visitors turned out to be optimistic.
examples.zh: 事实证明，他们对 5000 万游客的预测是乐观的。

examples.en: What are your predictions for the economy?
examples.zh: 你预测经济前景会怎样？

examples.en: Skilled readers make use of context and prediction.
examples.zh: 阅读能力强的人会利用上下文及推测来理解文意。

senses.def: connected with the ability to show what will happen in the future

examples.en: the predictive power of science
examples.zh: 科学的预测能力

examples.en: More research is needed to improve the predictive value of the tests.
examples.zh: 要提高测试的预测值，还需要进行更多的研究。

senses.def: allowing you to enter text on a computer or a mobile phone more quickly by using the first few letters of each word to predict what you want to say
senses.zh: 预测输入的（根据输入的字母来预测可能的字词）

examples.en: predictive text input
examples.zh: 预测文字输入

examples.en: predictive messaging
examples.zh: 可预测输入的信息传送

senses.def: something that can show what will happen in the future
senses.zh: 有预测作用的事物；预示物

examples.en: Cholesterol level is not a strong predictor of heart disease in women.
examples.zh: 胆固醇水平在预示女性患心脏病方面并不是一个很准确的因素。

senses.def: put in a simple form that is easy to understand
if you have a predilection for

examples.en: an artist with a predilection for bright colours
examples.zh: 偏爱鲜艳色彩的艺术家

senses.def: to influence somebody so that they are likely to think or behave in a particular way

examples.en: He believes that some people are predisposed to criminal behaviour.
examples.zh: 他认为有些人容易犯罪。

examples.en: Her good mood predisposed her to enjoy the play.
examples.zh: 她当时兴致高，所以一定喜欢那出戏。

senses.def: to make it likely that you will have a particular illness or condition
senses.zh: 使易于患（某种病）；容易诱发

examples.en: Stress can predispose people to heart attacks.
examples.zh: 压力容易使人患心脏病。

senses.def: a condition that makes somebody/something likely to behave in a particular way or to have a particular illness
senses.zh: 倾向；癖性；（易患某种病的）体质

examples.en: a genetic predisposition to liver disease
examples.zh: 易患肝病的遗传体质

examples.en: There was an inherited predisposition to alcoholism.
examples.zh: 有酗酒的遗传倾向。

examples.en: These are parents with a predisposition to worry.
examples.zh: 这些是容易担心的父母。

senses.def: the situation of being greater in number or amount than other things or people

examples.en: a predominance of female teachers in primary schools
examples.zh: 小学中女教师占多数

examples.en: A survey of judges showed the overwhelming predominance of upper-class backgrounds.
examples.zh: 一项对法官的调查显示，上流社会背景的法官占压倒性优势。

senses.def: the state of having more power or influence than others

examples.en: the ongoing struggle for global predominance
examples.zh: 争夺全球主导地位的持续斗争

senses.def: most obvious or easy to notice

examples.en: a predominant feature
examples.zh: 显著特征

examples.en: Yellow is the predominant colour this spring in the fashion world.
examples.zh: 黄色是今春时装界的流行色。

senses.def: having more power or influence than others

examples.en: a predominant culture
examples.zh: 主流文化

examples.en: a way of thinking that is predominant in modern social life
examples.zh: 现代社会生活中占主导地位的一种思维方式

senses.def: mostly; mainly

examples.en: She works in a predominantly male environment.
examples.zh: 她在一个男性居多的环境里工作。

senses.def: to be greater in amount or number than something/somebody else in a place, group, etc.

examples.en: a colour scheme in which red predominates
examples.zh: 以红色为主的色彩组合

examples.en: Women predominated in the audience.
examples.zh: 观众以妇女为主。

examples.en: Young men tend to predominate in the crime statistics.
examples.zh: 年轻人在犯罪统计中往往占主导地位。

senses.def: to have the most influence or importance
senses.zh: 占主导地位；有最大影响（或重要性）

examples.en: Private interest was not allowed to predominate over the public good.
examples.zh: 私人利益不得凌驾于公众利益之上。

senses.def: mostly; mainly

examples.en: Earlier research predominately focused on the pain experienced by patients.
examples.zh: 早期的研究主要集中在患者经历的疼痛上。

senses.def: a premature
to spend a lot of time making yourself look attractive and then admiring your appearance
senses.zh: 刻意打扮，精心修饰（并自我欣赏）

examples.en: Will you stop preening yourself in front of the mirror?
examples.zh: 你别对着镜子打扮个没完行不行？

senses.def: to feel very pleased with yourself about something and show other people how pleased you are
senses.zh: 顾盼自雄；沾沾自喜；得意扬扬

senses.def: to clean itself or make its feathers smooth with its beak
a prefabricated

examples.en: prefabs built after the war
examples.zh: 战后修建的预制房屋

senses.def: made in sections that can be put together later
senses.zh: 预制的；用预制构件组装的

examples.en: Prefabricated houses were quickly put up after the war.
examples.zh: 战后，活动板房迅速建成。

senses.def: the practice of making sections of something, especially a building, that can be put together later

examples.en: Prefabrication was the solution for widespread overcrowding.
examples.zh: 预制构件是解决广泛的过度拥挤问题的解决方案。

senses.def: an introduction to a book, especially one that explains the author’s aims

examples.en: I read it in the preface to her new book.
examples.zh: 我在她的新书的序言中读到了这句话。

examples.en: In his preface he claimed that he had created a new kind of music.

examples.zh: 认真准备考试十分重要。

senses.zh: 给…开（药）；让…采用（疗法）；开（处方）

examples.en: Valium is usually prescribed to treat anxiety.
examples.zh: 安定剂通常用于治疗焦躁。

examples.en: He may be able to prescribe you something for that cough.
examples.zh: 他也许能给你开一些咳嗽药。

senses.def: to say what should be done or how something should be done

examples.en: The prescribed form must be completed and returned to this office.
examples.zh: 必须把指定的表格填好并交回本办事处。

examples.en: Police regulations prescribe that an officer's number must be clearly visible.
examples.zh: 警政制度规定，警察的编号必须清晰可见。

examples.en: The syllabus prescribes precisely which books should be studied.
examples.zh: 教学大纲明确规定了哪些是必读的书。

senses.def: an official piece of paper on which a doctor writes the type of medicine you should have, and which enables you to get it from a chemist's

examples.en: The doctor gave me a prescription for antibiotics.
examples.zh: 医生给我开了抗生素。

examples.en: Antibiotics are only available on prescription.
examples.zh: 抗生素只能凭处方购买。

examples.en: Antibiotics are only available by prescription.
examples.zh: 抗生素只能凭处方购买。

examples.en: They are not available without a prescription.
examples.zh: 这些药没有处方不能出售。

examples.en: prescription drugs/medication(s)
examples.zh: 处方药

senses.def: medicine that your doctor has ordered for you

examples.en: The pharmacist will make up your prescription.
examples.zh: 药剂师会给你依处方配药。

senses.def: the act of prescribing

examples.en: The prescription of drugs is a doctor's responsibility.
examples.zh: 开药是医生的责任。

senses.def: a plan or a suggestion for making something happen or for improving it

examples.en: a prescription for happiness
examples.zh: 增进幸福的秘诀

examples.en: Both parties will be outlining their prescription for economic recovery.
examples.zh: 双方将概述经济复苏的方案。

senses.def: money paid (usually to a chemist
senses.zh: 处方费（透过国民医疗服务体系获取药品须支付的费用，通常付给药剂师。药物不论种类费用相同，通常低于其实际成本。特定群体，如老人、儿童、孕妇和失业者免付处方费）

senses.def: telling people what should be done

examples.en: prescriptive methods of teaching
examples.zh: 灌输式教学法

senses.def: telling people how a language should be used, rather than describing how it is used

examples.en: a prescriptive grammar of English
examples.zh: 规定性英语语法

senses.def: made legal or acceptable because they have existed for a long time
senses.zh: 约定俗成的；相沿成习的

examples.en: prescriptive powers
examples.zh: 相沿成习的权力

senses.def: taking place before the regular sports season begins
senses.zh: 常规赛季前的；季前赛的

examples.en: She suffered an ankle sprain during preseason practice.
examples.zh: 她在季前赛的训练中扭伤了脚踝。

examples.en: It's just a preseason game, but it will give them the chance to see how their young players perform.
examples.zh: 这只是一场季前赛，但却让他们有机会看到年轻球员的表现。

senses.def: the period of time before the regular sports season begins

examples.en: Herndon missed portions of the preseason.
examples.zh: 赫恩登错过了季前赛的部分比赛。

senses.def: to choose somebody/something in advance
the fact of being in a particular place

examples.en: He hardly seemed to notice my presence.
examples.zh: 他似乎没有注意到我在场。

examples.en: Her presence during the crisis had a calming effect.
examples.zh: 危难时有她在，对大家的心情有稳定作用。

examples.en: Your presence is requested at the meeting.
examples.zh: 务请出席会议。

examples.en: They married in the presence of their family members.
examples.zh: 他们在家人在场的情况下结婚了。

senses.def: the fact of being in a particular place or thing

examples.en: The test can identify the presence of abnormalities in the unborn child.
examples.zh: 这项检查能鉴定胎儿是否有不正常现象。

examples.en: One of the first things I note when I walk into a client's home is the presence or absence of pictures around the room.
examples.zh: 当我走进客户家时，我注意到的第一件事就是房间周围是否有图片。

examples.en: The company now has a strong presence in Germany.
examples.zh: 该公司目前在德国有很强的势力。

senses.def: a group of people, especially soldiers, who have been sent to a place to deal with a particular situation
senses.zh: （派遣的）一个队；（尤指执行任务的）部队

examples.en: The government is maintaining a heavy police presence in the area.
examples.zh: 政府在这一地区派驻了大批警察。

examples.en: The United States has a substantial military presence in the country.
examples.zh: 美国在该国派有大量驻军。

senses.def: a person or spirit that you cannot see but that you feel is near
senses.zh: 感觉在附近的人（或鬼魂）

examples.en: She felt a presence behind her.
examples.zh: 她觉得有什么东西跟在背后。

senses.def: the quality of making a strong impression on other people by the way you talk or behave; a person who has this quality

examples.en: a man of great presence
examples.zh: 气度不凡的男子

examples.en: She has a strong voice but absolutely no stage presence.
examples.zh: 她的嗓音很有力量，但她完全没有舞台感。

examples.en: She has a great screen presence.
examples.zh: 她在屏幕上非常引人注目。

examples.en: He remained a dominant presence in the art world.
examples.zh: 他在艺术界仍占主导地位。

senses.def: with somebody in the same place

examples.en: The document was signed in the presence of two witnesses.
examples.zh: 本文件由两位证人见证签署。

examples.en: She asked them not to discuss the matter in her presence.
examples.zh: 她要求他们不要当着她的面讨论这个问题。

examples.en: He should never have made those remarks in your presence.
examples.zh: 他怎么都不该当着你的面说那些话。

senses.def: when something exists in a particular place
senses.zh: 存在…的情况下；有…的存在

examples.en: Litmus paper turns red in the presence of an acid.
examples.zh: 石蕊试纸遇到酸就变红。

senses.def: to do something to make people very aware of the fact that you are there; to have a strong influence on a group of people or a situation
senses.zh: 突显自己；对（人群或局势）发挥作用

examples.en: She’s only been here a couple of weeks but she is already making her presence felt.
examples.zh: 她来到这里才几周，但她已经让人感受到了她的存在。

examples.en: He certainly made his presence felt in the boardroom.
examples.zh: 他确实在董事会中体现了他的存在。

items.idm: in the presence of somebody | in somebody’s presence

examples.en: The document was signed in the presence of two witnesses.
examples.zh: 本文件由两位证人见证签署。

examples.en: She asked them not to discuss the matter in her presence.
examples.zh: 她要求他们不要当着她的面讨论这个问题。

examples.en: He should never have made those remarks in your presence.
examples.zh: 他怎么都不该当着你的面说那些话。

senses.def: when something exists in a particular place

examples.en: Litmus paper turns red in the presence of an acid.
examples.zh: 石蕊试纸遇到酸就变红。

senses.def: to do something to make people very aware of the fact that you are there; to have a strong influence on a group of people or a situation
senses.zh: 突显自己；对（人群或局势）发挥作用

examples.en: She’s only been here a couple of weeks but she is already making her presence felt.
examples.zh: 她来到这里才几周，但她已经让人感受到了她的存在。

examples.en: He certainly made his presence felt in the boardroom.
examples.zh: 他确实在董事会中体现了他的存在。

senses.def: the ability to react quickly and stay calm in a difficult or dangerous situation
senses.zh: 镇定；处变不惊；遇事不慌

examples.en: The boy had the presence of mind to turn off the gas.
examples.zh: 那男孩子镇定地关掉了煤气。

senses.def: existing or happening now

examples.en: I am not satisfied with the present situation.
examples.zh: 我对现状不满意。

examples.en: The present study has two main aims.
examples.zh: 本研究有两个主要目的。

examples.en: the present owner of the house
examples.zh: 现在的房主

examples.en: a list of all club members, past and present
examples.zh: 过去和现在的全部会员名单

examples.en: We do not have any more information at the present time.
examples.zh: 目前我们没有进一步的消息。

examples.en: A few brief comments are sufficient for present purposes.
examples.zh: 就当前而言，几句简短的话已经足够了。

examples.en: You can’t use it in its present condition.
examples.zh: 照它目前这种情形，是无法使用的。

senses.def: being in a particular place

examples.en: I wasn’t present when the doctor examined him.
examples.zh: 医生给他做检查时我不在场。

examples.en: The mistake was obvious to all those present.
examples.zh: 这个错误对于在场的所有人来说都是显而易见的。

examples.en: There were 200 people present at the meeting.
examples.zh: 有 200 人出席会议。

examples.en: Most fathers wish to be present at the birth of their child.
examples.zh: 大多数父亲都希望在孩子出生时在场。

examples.en: Simply to be physically present was all that was required.
examples.zh: 所要求的只是本人亲自出席。

senses.def: existing in a particular place or thing

examples.en: The threat of force was always present.
examples.zh: 武力威胁一直存在。

examples.en: the ever present risk of pollution
examples.zh: 一直存在的污染危险

examples.en: Levels of pollution present in the atmosphere are increasing.
examples.zh: 大气中的污染程度正在加深。

examples.en: Analysis showed that traces of arsenic were present in the body.
examples.zh: 分析显示，尸体中有微量砷。

senses.def: used to say that all the things or people who should be there are now there
senses.zh: 全到无误；应在场的都在场了

senses.def: used after being rude or critical about somebody to say that the people you are talking to are not included in the criticism
senses.zh: 在座诸位除外；与这里的各位无关

examples.en: The people in this office are so narrow-minded, present company excepted, of course.
examples.zh: 这个办公室里的人都是心胸狭隘的人，当然，现在的公司除外。

senses.def: a thing that you give to somebody as a gift

examples.en: What can I get him for a birthday present?
examples.zh: 我给他送点什么生日礼物呢？

examples.en: Christmas/wedding presents
examples.zh: 圣诞节／结婚礼物

examples.en: I want to give you a little present.
examples.zh: 我想送你一件小礼物。

examples.en: He gave her the painting as a present.
examples.zh: 他把那幅画当作礼物送给了她。

examples.en: We have a present for you.
examples.zh: 我们有一件礼物给你。

examples.en: I still need to buy a present for my boyfriend.
examples.zh: 我还需要给男朋友买礼物。

examples.en: That dress was a present from my sister.
examples.zh: 那件衣服是我姐姐送给我的礼物。

senses.def: the time now

examples.en: You've got to forget the past and start living in the present.
examples.zh: 你必须忘掉过去，开始把握现在。

examples.en: I'm sorry he's out at present (= now).
examples.zh: 很抱歉他这会儿不在。

examples.en: The book covers the period from the early 1990s to the present.
examples.zh: 这本书涵盖了从 20 世纪 90 年代初到现在的时期。

senses.def: the form of a verb that expresses an action that is happening now or at the time of speaking
for now; for a short time

examples.en: This house is big enough for the moment, but we'll have to move if we have children.
examples.zh: 这房子现在还够大。要是有了孩子，我们还得搬。

senses.def: for now; for a short time

examples.en: This house is big enough for the present, but we'll have to move if we have children.
examples.zh: 这房子目前来说足够大了，但是如果我们有了孩子，我们就得搬家了。

senses.def: now is the best time to do something, not in the future
senses.zh: 现在是做…的最佳时机；现在不做更待何时

senses.def: to show or offer something for other people to look at or consider

examples.en: Are you presenting a paper at the conference?
examples.zh: 你会在研讨会上发表论文吗？

examples.en: She presented some data on the 2024 presidential election.
examples.zh: 她提供了有关 2024 年总统选举的一些数据。

examples.en: The paper presents no evidence of a link.
examples.zh: 该论文没有提供任何链接的证据。

examples.en: The results presented here confirm our prediction.
examples.zh: 这里给出的结果证实了我们的预测。

examples.en: Findings are presented in Table 9.
examples.zh: 结果如表 9 所示。

examples.en: He presents a convincing case.
examples.zh: 他展示了一个有说服力的案例。

examples.en: The committee will present its final report to Parliament in June.
examples.zh: 委员会将于六月向议会提交最后的报告。

examples.en: Eight options were presented for consideration.
examples.zh: 提出了八项备选方案供审议。

senses.group: something to be considered 考虑的事

senses.def: to give something to somebody, especially formally at a ceremony

examples.en: The local MP will start the race and present the prizes.
examples.zh: 当地议员将鸣枪开赛，并颁发奖品。

examples.en: Last year she was presented with an award for lifetime achievement.
examples.zh: 她去年获颁了终身成就奖。

examples.en: On his retirement, colleagues presented him with a set of golf clubs.
examples.zh: 在他退休之际，同事们赠给他一套高尔夫球杆。

examples.en: The sword was presented by the family to the museum.
examples.zh: 这家人把宝剑捐赠给了博物馆。

senses.def: to show or describe something/somebody in a particular way

examples.en: The company has decided it must present a more modern image.
examples.zh: 公司已决定，必须展现出更加现代的形象。

examples.en: It is essential that we present a united front (= show that we all agree).
examples.zh: 至关重要的是我们要表现得团结一致。

examples.en: You need to present yourself better.
examples.zh: 你需要更善于展示自己。

examples.en: He likes to present himself as a radical politician.
examples.zh: 他喜欢表现出一副激进政治家的样子。

examples.en: The press presents this as a kind of victory.
examples.zh: 媒体将此视为一种胜利。

examples.en: The article presents these proposals as misguided.
examples.zh: 文章认为这些提案失当。

senses.group: something in particular way 方式

senses.def: to cause something to happen or be experienced

examples.en: The course presents an excellent learning opportunity.
examples.zh: 该课程提供了一个极好的学习机会。

examples.en: Freezing temperatures can present problems.
examples.zh: 冰冻温度可能会带来问题。

examples.en: Each year has presented slightly different challenges.
examples.zh: 每年都会面临略有不同的挑战。

examples.en: Use of these chemicals may present a fire risk.
examples.zh: 使用这些化学品有可能导致失火。

examples.en: Irradiation presents environmental dangers.
examples.zh: 辐射会带来环境危险。

examples.en: None of these parasites presents a threat to human health.
examples.zh: 这些寄生虫都不会对人类健康构成威胁。

examples.en: Your request shouldn't present us with any problems.
examples.zh: 你的请求应该不会给我们造成任何问题。

examples.en: I was presented with the opportunity to play abroad.
examples.zh: 我获得了出国踢球的机会。

senses.def: to suddenly happen or become available

examples.en: One major problem did present itself, though.
examples.zh: 不过，确实出现了一个重大问题。

examples.en: As soon as the opportunity presented itself, she would get another job.
examples.zh: 一有机会，她就会另谋新职。

examples.en: Thankfully, a solution presented itself to him surprisingly soon.
examples.zh: 谢天谢地，他意外地很快就找到了答案。

senses.def: to appear in a radio or television programme and introduce the different items in it

examples.en: She used to present a gardening programme on TV.
examples.zh: 她曾在电视上主持一个园艺节目。

senses.group: radio/TV programme 广播／电视节目

senses.def: to produce a show, play, broadcast, etc. for the public

examples.en: Compass Theatre Company presents a new production of ‘King Lear’.
examples.zh: 罗经剧团推出了全新制作的《李尔王》。

examples.en: The string orchestra of the Music School of Lemgo will present a concert in the Guildhall.
examples.zh: 莱姆戈音乐学院的弦乐团将在市政厅举办音乐会。

senses.def: to introduce somebody formally, especially to somebody of higher rank or status

examples.en: May I present my fiancé to you?
examples.zh: 请允许我向您介绍我的未婚夫。

senses.def: to officially appear somewhere

examples.en: You will be asked to present yourself for interview.
examples.zh: 将请你到场面试。

examples.en: She was ordered to present herself in court on 20 May.
examples.zh: 她被传唤于 5 月 20 日出庭。

senses.def: to offer or express something in speech or writing

examples.en: Please allow me to present my apologies.
examples.zh: 请允许我致歉。

senses.def: to give somebody a cheque

examples.en: A cheque presented by Mr Jackson was returned by the bank.
examples.zh: 银行退回了杰克逊先生提交的支票。

examples.en: The builders presented a bill for several hundred pounds.
examples.zh: 承建商送来了一份数百英镑的账单。

senses.def: to have or show particular symptoms

examples.en: The patient presented with a chest complaint.
examples.zh: 患者出现胸部不适。

examples.en: This illness rarely presents as a chest wall tumour in young patients.
examples.zh: 这种疾病在年轻患者中很少表现为胸壁肿瘤。

examples.en: All these patients presented a chief complaint of frequent headaches.
examples.zh: 所有这些患者的主诉都是频繁头痛。

senses.def: to hold a rifle
