items.zh: 指认为、以为某人／某事…但不肯定

examples.en: Police believe (that) the man may be armed.
examples.zh: 警方认为那个人可能携有武器。

items.def: to have a particular opinion about something that has happened or about what you/​somebody ought to do:
items.zh: 指认为（已发生的事情…）、相信（应该…）

examples.en: We all felt (that) we were unlucky to lose.
examples.zh: 我们都认为我们输了是运气不好。

items.def: (informal) to think that something is true or possible:
items.zh: 指认为、以为

examples.en: I reckon (that) I’m going to get that job.
examples.zh: 我认为我会得到那份工作。

items.def: to have an idea that something is true:
items.zh: 指以为某事…

examples.en: I was under the impression that the work had already been completed.
examples.zh: 我还以为已经完工了呢。

senses.def: to expect something to happen or to rely on something happening

examples.en: They hadn't reckoned on a rebellion.
examples.zh: 他们没有料到会发生叛乱。

examples.en: We'd reckoned on having good weather.
examples.zh: 我们原指望会有好天气。

senses.def: to calculate the total amount or number of something

examples.en: He reckoned up the cost of everything in his mind.
examples.zh: 他在脑子里把所有费用都合计了一下。

senses.def: to consider or treat somebody/something as a serious opponent, problem, etc.

examples.en: They were already a political force to be reckoned with.
examples.zh: 他们已经成为一支不容忽视的政治力量。

senses.def: to consider something as a possible problem that you should be prepared for
senses.zh: 把（可能出现的问题）考虑进去

examples.en: I didn't reckon with getting caught up in so much traffic.
examples.zh: 我没有考虑到堵车会这么严重。

examples.en: We have to reckon with an element of chance.
examples.zh: 我们必须考虑到机会的因素。

senses.def: to not consider somebody/something as a possible problem that you should be prepared for

examples.en: They had reckoned without the determination of the opposition.
examples.zh: 他们没料到会遭到坚决反对。

senses.def: to get something back or to ask to have it back after it has been lost, taken away, etc.

examples.en: You'll have to go to the police station to reclaim your wallet.
examples.zh: 你得到警察局去认领你的钱包。

examples.en: The team reclaimed the title from their rivals.
examples.zh: 这个队从对手手中夺回了冠军。

senses.def: to make land that is naturally too wet or too dry suitable to be built on, farmed, etc.

examples.en: The site for the airport will be reclaimed from the swamp.
examples.zh: 这片湿地将会被开发来建机场。

examples.en: reclaimed land
examples.zh: 复垦土地

senses.def: if a piece of land is reclaimed by
senses.zh: 重新变为沙漠（或森林等）；沙化；荒漠化；抛荒

senses.def: to obtain materials from waste products so that they can be used again
senses.zh: 回收（废品中有用的东西）

examples.en: 80% of aluminium could be reclaimed.
examples.zh: 80%的铝可以回收。

senses.def: to rescue somebody from a bad or criminal way of life
senses.zh: 挽救；感化；使纠正；使悔过自新

senses.def: the process of turning land that is naturally too wet or too dry into land that is suitable to be built on, farmed, etc.

examples.en: land reclamation
examples.zh: 土地开垦

senses.def: the process of obtaining materials from waste products so that they can be used again
senses.zh: 回收（废品中有用的东西）

examples.en: There are opportunities for a company that can develop more efficient water reclamation and purification technology.
examples.zh: 对于能够开发更有效的水回收和净化技术的公司来说，这是有机会的。

senses.def: the act of getting something back after it has been lost, taken away, etc.

examples.en: The group urges the reclamation of our democracy from corporate power.
examples.zh: 该组织敦促从企业权力中夺回我们的民主。

senses.def: to put something in a different class or category
senses.zh: 将…重新分类；将…重新归类

examples.en: The International Astronomical Union reclassified Pluto as a dwarf planet in 2006.
examples.zh: 2006年，国际天文学联合会将冥王星重新归类为矮行星。

senses.def: to sit or lie in a relaxed way, with your body leaning backwards

examples.en: She was reclining on a sofa.
examples.zh: 她倚靠在沙发上。

examples.en: a reclining figure (= for example in a painting)
examples.zh: 半躺着的人像

senses.def: when a seat reclines

examples.en: a reclining chair
examples.zh: 躺椅

senses.def: a soft comfortable chair with a back that can be pushed back at an angle so that you can lean back in it
a person who lives alone and likes to avoid other people

examples.en: to lead the life of a recluse
examples.zh: 过隐居的生活

senses.def: living alone and avoiding other people

examples.en: a reclusive millionaire
examples.zh: 独居的百万富翁

senses.def: the act of remembering who somebody is when you see them, or of identifying what something is

examples.en: He glanced briefly towards her but there was no sign of recognition.
examples.zh: 他瞥了她一眼，但似乎没认出她来。

examples.en: the automatic recognition of handwriting and printed text by computer
examples.zh: 计算机对手写和印刷文本的自动识别

senses.def: the act of accepting that something exists, is true or is official

examples.en: a growing recognition that things need to change
examples.zh: 越来越认识到事情需要改变

examples.en: There is a general recognition of the urgent need for reform.
examples.zh: 人们普遍认识到迫切需要改革。

examples.en: to seek international/official/formal recognition as a sovereign state
examples.zh: 寻求国际上的／官方的／正式的承认，承认它是一个主权国家

examples.en: The government granted full diplomatic recognition to the republics.
examples.zh: 政府给予各共和国充分的外交承认。

senses.def: public praise and reward for somebody’s work or actions

examples.en: She gained only minimal recognition for her work.
examples.zh: 她的工作仅仅得到极少的赞誉。

examples.en: He received the award in recognition of his success over the past year.
examples.zh: 他受到了奖励，这是对他过去一年的成绩的肯定。

senses.def: to change so much that you can hardly recognize it
senses.zh: 变得面目全非；沧海桑田

examples.en: The town has changed beyond recognition since I was last here.
examples.zh: 自从我上次离开这里以来，这座小镇已经变得让人认不出来了。

examples.en: Capitalism has been reformed almost out of all recognition.
examples.zh: 资本主义已经被改革得几乎面目全非。

items.idm: to change, alter, etc. beyond/out of (all) recognition

senses.def: to change so much that you can hardly recognize it
senses.zh: 变得面目全非；沧海桑田

examples.en: The town has changed beyond recognition since I was last here.
examples.zh: 自从我上次离开这里以来，这座小镇已经变得让人认不出来了。

examples.en: Capitalism has been reformed almost out of all recognition.
examples.zh: 资本主义已经被改革得几乎面目全非。

senses.def: easy to know or identify
senses.zh: 容易认出的；易于识别的

examples.en: The building was easily recognizable as a prison.
examples.zh: 很容易看出这座建筑是所监狱。

examples.en: After so many years she was still instantly recognizable.
examples.zh: 过了这么多年，还是一眼就能认出她。

senses.def: to such a degree that the qualities of somebody/something are easy to see or identify

examples.en: the creation of a recognizably modern army
examples.zh: 建立一支公认的现代化军队

senses.def: a promise by somebody who is accused of a crime to appear in court on a particular date; a sum of money paid as a guarantee of this promise
senses.zh: 保证书；具结；保释金；保证金

senses.def: to know who somebody is or what something is when you see or hear them or it, because you have seen or heard them or it before

examples.en: I recognized him as soon as he came in the room.
examples.zh: 他一进屋我就认出了他。

examples.en: Do you recognize this tune?
examples.zh: 你能听出这是哪支曲子吗？

examples.en: You might not recognize the name but you'll know her face.
examples.zh: 你可能不认识这个名字，但你一定认识她的脸。

examples.en: I recognized the voice immediately.
examples.zh: 我立刻就认出了这个声音。

examples.en: I recognized her by her red hair.
examples.zh: 我从她的红头发认出了她。

examples.en: I recognized him from the photo in the paper.
examples.zh: 我从报纸上的照片中认出了他。

examples.en: He recognized the man as one of the police officers.
examples.zh: 他认出那个人是其中一名警察。

senses.def: to admit or to be aware that something exists or is true

examples.en: They recognized the need to take the problem seriously.
examples.zh: 他们承认需要严肃对待这个问题。

examples.en: Most of us recognize the importance of diet.
examples.zh: 我们大多数人都认识到饮食的重要性。

examples.en: The government does recognize the value of the arts in this country.
examples.zh: 政府确实认识到这个国家艺术的价值。

examples.en: You must recognize the fact that the situation has changed.
examples.zh: 你必须认识到情况已经发生变化的事实。

examples.en: Lead paint was recognized as a problem nearly 50 years ago.
examples.zh: 大约 50 年前，含铅油漆就被认为是一个问题。

examples.en: Lead paint was recognized to be a problem nearly 50 years ago.
examples.zh: 大约 50 年前，含铅油漆就被认为是一个问题。

examples.en: Nobody recognized how urgent the situation was.
examples.zh: 当时没有人意识到形势有多么紧急。

examples.en: We recognized that the task was not straightforward.
examples.zh: 我们意识到这个任务并非轻而易举。

examples.en: It is widely recognized that driver fatigue is a problem on motorways.
examples.zh: 普遍认为，疲劳驾驶是高速公路上的一个问题。

examples.en: It was recognized that this solution could only be temporary.
examples.zh: 人们意识到这只是个临时的解决方案。

senses.def: to accept and approve of somebody/something officially

examples.en: The UK has refused to recognize the new regime.
examples.zh: 英国已拒绝承认这个新的政权。

examples.en: These qualifications are recognized throughout the EU.
examples.zh: 这些资格在整个欧盟都认可。

examples.en: internationally recognized human rights
examples.zh: 国际公认的人权

examples.en: The court explicitly recognized the group's right to exist.
examples.zh: 法院明确承认该团体的生存权。

examples.en: The organization has not been officially recognized as a trade union.
examples.zh: 该组织尚未被正式承认为工会。

examples.en: Such crimes are recognized by international law as crimes against humanity.
examples.zh: 国际法将此类罪行认定为危害人类罪。

examples.en: He is recognized to be their natural leader.
examples.zh: 人们都承认他是他们的当然领袖。

senses.def: to be thought of as very good or important by people in general

examples.en: The book is now recognized as a classic.
examples.zh: 这本书现在是一部公认的经典著作。

examples.en: She's a recognized authority on the subject.
examples.zh: 她在这个学科上是公认的权威。

senses.def: to give somebody official thanks for something that they have done or achieved

examples.en: His services to the state were recognized with the award of a knighthood.
examples.zh: 他被封为爵士，以表彰他对国家的贡献。

synonyms.words: know ▪ recognize ▪ name ▪ make somebody/​something out

intro.en: These words all mean to be able to see or hear somebody/​something and especially to be able to say who or what they are.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含认出、辨别出之义。

items.def: to be able to say who or what somebody/​something is:
items.zh: 指能认出、能辨认出

examples.en: She was able to identify her attacker.
examples.zh: 她认出了袭击她的人。

items.def: to be able to say who or what something is when you see or hear it because you have seen or heard it before Know is used especially to talk about sounds that seem familiar and when somebody recognizes the quality or opportunity that somebody/​something represents:
items.zh: know 尤指认出熟悉的声音、辨别出人或事物所表现出的特质以及发现机会

items.def: to know who somebody is or what something is when you see or hear them/​it, because you have seen or heard them/​it before:
items.zh: 指认识、认出、辨别出

examples.en: I recognized him as soon as he came in the room.
examples.zh: 他一进屋我就认出了他。

items.def: to say the name of somebody/​something in order to show that you know who/​what they are:
items.zh: 指能说出…的名称、叫出…的名字

examples.en: The victim has not yet been named.
examples.zh: 受害人的姓名仍未得知。

items.def: to manage to see or hear somebody/​something that is not very clear:
items.zh: 指看清、听清、分清、辨认清楚

examples.en: I could just make out a figure in the darkness.
examples.zh: 黑暗中我只看出了一个人的轮廓。

intro.en: These words all mean to agree, often unwillingly, that something is true.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含承认之义，常指不情愿地承认某事属实。

items.def: to agree, often unwillingly, that something is true:
items.zh: 指承认（常指不情愿地承认某事属实）

examples.en: It was a stupid thing to do, I admit.
examples.zh: 我承认，那次干的是件蠢事。

items.def: (rather formal) to accept that something exists, is true or has happened:
items.zh: 指承认某事物存在或属实

examples.en: She refuses to acknowledge the need for reform.
examples.zh: 她拒不承认改革的必要性。

items.def: to admit or be aware that something exists or is true:
items.zh: 指承认、意识到

examples.en: They recognized the need to take the problem seriously.
examples.zh: 他们承认需要严肃对待这个问题。

items.def: (rather formal) to admit, often unwillingly, that something is true or logical:
items.zh: 指承认（常指不情愿地承认某事属实或合乎逻辑）

examples.en: He was forced to concede (that) there might be difficulties.
examples.zh: 他被迫承认可能有困难。

items.def: (rather formal) to admit something that you feel ashamed or embarrassed about; to admit, especially formally or to the police, that you have done something wrong or illegal:
items.zh: 指承认自己感到羞愧或尴尬的事，也指供认、坦白、承认错误或罪行

examples.en: She was reluctant to confess her ignorance.
examples.zh: 她不愿意承认自己无知。

senses.def: to move your body quickly away from somebody/something because you find them or it frightening or unpleasant

examples.en: She recoiled from his touch.
examples.zh: 她躲开他的触摸。

examples.en: He recoiled in horror at the sight of the corpse.
examples.zh: 他一见到尸体就吓得往后缩了。

senses.def: to react to an idea or a situation with strong dislike or fear
senses.zh: 对…作出厌恶（或恐惧）的反应

examples.en: She recoiled from the idea of betraying her own brother.
examples.zh: 背叛自己亲兄弟的这个想法使她感到恐惧。

examples.en: Tell him the truth? I recoiled at the thought.
examples.zh: 告诉他真相吗？我一想到这个就退缩了。

senses.def: to move suddenly backwards when it is fired
a sudden movement backwards, especially of a gun when it is fired
senses.zh: 反冲；（尤指枪炮的）后坐力

examples.en: The recoil was so violent it almost tore the weapon from his grasp.
examples.zh: 后坐力如此猛烈，几乎将武器从他手中夺走。

senses.def: to remember something, especially by making an effort to remember it

examples.en: She could no longer recollect the details of the letter.
examples.zh: 她想不起那封信的细节了。

examples.en: As far as I can recollect, she wasn't there on that occasion.
examples.zh: 据我回忆，当时她不在场。

examples.en: I don't recollect what he said.
examples.zh: 我不记得他说过什么。

examples.en: I recollect that we were all gathered in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我记得当时我们都被召集到厨房里。

examples.en: I recollect him/his saying that it was dangerous.
examples.zh: 我记得他说那很危险。

examples.en: ‘It was just before the war,’ she recollected.
examples.zh: “那是在战争即将发生之际。”她回忆道。

senses.def: the ability to remember something; the act of remembering something

examples.en: I have no recollection of meeting her before.
examples.zh: 我不记得以前见过她。

examples.en: My recollection of events differs from his.
examples.zh: 我记忆中的情况和他的不一样。

examples.en: To the best of my recollection (= if I remember correctly) I was not present at that meeting.
examples.zh: 如果我没记错的话，我没有出席那次会议。

senses.def: a thing that you remember from the past

examples.en: to have a clear/vivid/dim/vague recollection of something
examples.zh: 对某事的记忆清晰／历历在目／模糊不清／依稀如烟

examples.en: his early recollections of his father
examples.zh: 他对父亲的早期记忆

senses.def: to begin again; to start doing something again

examples.en: Work on the bridge will recommence next month.
examples.zh: 下个月将重新开始这座桥的建造工作。

examples.en: The two countries agreed to recommence talks the following week.
examples.zh: 两国同意于随后的一周重新开始会谈。

examples.en: to recommence production/manufacture/trading
examples.zh: 重新开始生产/制造/贸易

senses.def: to tell somebody that something is good or useful, or that somebody would be suitable for a particular job, etc.

examples.en: The hotel's new restaurant comes highly recommended (= a lot of people have praised it).
examples.zh: 这家酒店的新餐厅得到了人们的普遍赞扬。

examples.en: Can you recommend a good hotel?
examples.zh: 你能推荐一家好的旅馆吗？

examples.en: I recommend the book to all my students.
examples.zh: 我向我所有的学生都推荐这本书。

examples.en: She was recommended for the post by a colleague.
examples.zh: 她由同事推荐到这个岗位。

examples.en: This game is recommended for children aged 12 and above.
examples.zh: 建议 12 岁及以上儿童玩此游戏。

examples.en: The guidelines recommend low-fat dairy products as excellent sources of calcium
examples.zh: 该指南推荐低脂乳制品作为钙的极好来源。

senses.def: to advise a particular course of action; to advise somebody to do something

examples.en: The report recommended a 10% pay increase.
examples.zh: 报告提议工资增加 10%。

examples.en: It is dangerous to exceed the recommended dose.
examples.zh: 超过建议服用的剂量会有危险。

examples.en: a recommended price of $50
examples.zh: 建议售价 50 美元

examples.en: He recommended reading the book before seeing the movie.
examples.zh: 他建议先看这本书，再去看这部电影。

examples.en: I recommend using the latest version of the browser.
examples.zh: 我建议使用最新版本的浏览器。

examples.en: My doctor recommended against surgery.
examples.zh: 我的医生建议不要动手术。

examples.en: Medical guidelines recommend against using this drug to treat migraines.
examples.zh: 医学指南建议不要使用这种药物来治疗偏头痛。

examples.en: I recommend that he see a lawyer.
examples.zh: 我建议他去找个律师。

examples.en: I recommend that he should see a lawyer.
examples.zh: 我建议他去找个律师。

examples.en: It is strongly recommended that the machines should be checked every year.
examples.zh: 强烈建议每年都要检查机器。

examples.en: We'd recommend you to book your flight early.
examples.zh: 我们建议你早点儿预订航班。

examples.en: Can you recommend how much we should charge?
examples.zh: 我们该收多少钱，你能给个建议吗？

senses.def: to make somebody/something seem attractive or good
senses.zh: 使显得吸引人；使受欢迎

examples.en: This system has much to recommend it.
examples.zh: 这套系统有很多可取之处。

intro.en: These words all mean to tell somebody what you think they should do in a particular situation.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含劝告、建议之义。

items.def: to tell somebody what you think they should do in a particular situation; to say what you think the price or level of something should be:
items.zh: 指劝告、建议（针对方法、售价、水平等）

examples.en: We’d recommend you to book your flight early.
examples.zh: 我们建议你早点儿预订航班。

items.def: to tell somebody what you think they should do in a particular situation:
items.zh: 指劝告、忠告、建议

examples.en: I’d advise you not to tell him.
examples.zh: 我劝你别告诉他。

items.def: (formal) to support or recommend something publicly:
items.zh: 指拥护、公开支持、提倡

examples.en: The group does not advocate the use of violence.
examples.zh: 该团体不支持使用暴力。

items.def: (formal) to recommend something strongly:
items.zh: 指大力推荐、竭力主张

examples.en: The situation is dangerous and the UN is urging caution.
examples.zh: 局势岌岌可危，联合国力主谨慎行事。

senses.def: an official suggestion about the best thing to do

examples.en: to accept/reject a recommendation
examples.zh: 接受／拒绝一项建议

examples.en: Her report lists numerous recommendations for the improvement of safety.
examples.zh: 她的报告列出了许多提高安全性的建议。

examples.en: The committee made recommendations to the board on teachers' pay and conditions.
examples.zh: 委员会就教师的工资和工作条件问题向董事会提出建议。

examples.en: The major recommendation is for a change in the law.
examples.zh: 主要的提议是变革法律。

examples.en: recommendations on the use of vaccines
examples.zh: 关于疫苗使用的建议

examples.en: The commission will make recommendations on how to reduce emissions of greenhouse gases.
examples.zh: 该委员会将就如何减少温室气体排放提出建议。

examples.en: We will be implementing all the recommendations from the report.
examples.zh: 我们将执行报告中的所有建议。

examples.en: The council will follow any recommendations made by the fire investigators.
examples.zh: 该委员会将遵循火灾调查人员提出的任何建议。

examples.en: We accept the 16 recommendations of the report.
examples.zh: 我们接受报告中的16条建议。

examples.en: I had the operation on the recommendation of my doctor.
examples.zh: 我根据医生的建议做了手术。

senses.def: the act of telling somebody that something is good or useful or that somebody would be suitable for a particular job, etc.

examples.en: It's best to find a builder through personal recommendation.
examples.zh: 最好通过私人介绍寻找施工人员。

examples.en: We chose the hotel on their recommendation (= because they recommended it).
examples.zh: 我们根据他们的推荐选了这家酒店。

examples.en: Here's the list of my top restaurant recommendations.
examples.zh: 这是我推荐的顶级餐厅名单。

examples.en: The girl lived up to her mother’s recommendation of being ‘good with children’.
examples.zh: 这个女孩遵循了母亲关于“善待孩子”的建议。

senses.def: a formal letter or statement that somebody would be suitable for a particular job, etc.

examples.en: The company gave her a glowing recommendation.
examples.zh: 这家公司为她写了一封评价很高的推荐信。

examples.en: Will you write me a recommendation letter?
examples.zh: 请您帮我写封推荐信好吗？

senses.def: a price that a company recommends for one of its products. Shops may then sell the product at this price, but are not legally required to do so.
something, usually money, that you are given because you have suffered in some way, or as a payment for something

examples.en: There must be adequate recompense for workers who lose their jobs.
examples.zh: 必须给失业的工人足够的补偿。

examples.en: I received $1 000 in recompense for loss of earnings.
examples.zh: 我得到了 1 000 美元的收入损失赔偿。

senses.def: to do something for somebody or give them a payment for something that they have suffered

examples.en: There was no attempt to recompense the miners for the loss of their jobs.
examples.zh: 没有人表示要对失业矿工给予补偿。

examples.en: Higher pay is on offer to recompense players for the extra hours they’ll be working.
examples.zh: 提供更高的工资来补偿球员的额外工作时间。

examples.en: She believes that offenders should recompense their victims in some way.
examples.zh: 她认为，犯罪者应该以某种方式补偿受害者。

senses.def: reconnaissance
if an idea or opinion is reconcilable
senses.zh: 和解的：如果一个想法或观点与另一个和解，则可以将两者融合在一起

examples.en: The theory was not reconcilable with his religious beliefs.
examples.zh: 该理论与他的宗教信仰不一致。

senses.def: if differences or disagreements
to find an acceptable way of dealing with two or more ideas, needs, etc. that seem to be opposed to each other
senses.zh: 使和谐一致；调和；使配合

examples.en: an attempt to reconcile the need for industrial development with concern for the environment
examples.zh: 协调工业发展的需要和环境保护之间关系的努力

examples.en: It was hard to reconcile his career ambitions with the needs of his children.
examples.zh: 他很难兼顾事业上的抱负和孩子们的需要。

senses.def: to make people become friends again after an argument or a disagreement

examples.en: The pair were reconciled after Jackson made a public apology.
examples.zh: 杰克逊公开道歉之后，这两个人又言归于好了。

examples.en: He has recently been reconciled with his wife.
examples.zh: 他最近已经和妻子和好了。

senses.def: to make somebody/yourself accept an unpleasant situation because it is not possible to change it

examples.en: He could not reconcile himself to the prospect of losing her.
examples.zh: 他一想到有可能失去她，就觉得难以忍受。

examples.en: No amount of designer labels could reconcile her to missing out on the trip.
examples.zh: 再多的设计师品牌也无法让她甘心错过这次旅行。

senses.def: an end to a disagreement

examples.en: The pair are bravely attempting a reconciliation.
examples.zh: 这对男女正在尽力尝试和解。

examples.en: Their change of policy brought about a reconciliation with Britain.
examples.zh: 他们的政策改变促成了与英国的和解。

examples.en: He is striving to bring about a reconciliation between the two conflicting sides.
examples.zh: 他正在努力使冲突双方达成和解。

senses.def: the process of making it possible for two different ideas, facts, etc. to exist together without being opposed to each other

examples.en: the reconciliation between environment and development
examples.zh: 环境保护与发展之间的和谐统一

examples.en: the reconciliation of town and country
examples.zh: 城乡协调

examples.en: the reconciliation of modern society with traditional teaching
examples.zh: 现代社会与传统教学之间的协调

senses.def: not known about or understood by many people

examples.en: a recondite subject
examples.zh: 一门深奥的学科

senses.def: to repair a machine so that it is in good condition and works well
senses.zh: 修复（机器）；使（机器）恢复正常运转

examples.en: Once the engine’s reconditioned it’ll be as good as new.
examples.zh: 一旦发动机修复完毕，它就会像新的一样。

examples.en: We are specialists in new and reconditioned pianos.
examples.zh: 我们是新钢琴和翻新钢琴的专家。

senses.def: to make changes to the way that something is arranged to work, especially computer equipment or a program
senses.zh: 重新配置（计算机设备等）；重新设定（程序等）

examples.en: You may need to reconfigure the firewall if you add a new machine to your network.
examples.zh: 如果在网络中增加新计算机，可能就得重新设定防火墙。

senses.def: to check again that something is definitely correct or as previously arranged

examples.en: You have to reconfirm your flight 24 hours before travelling.
examples.zh: 你必须在乘飞机之前 24 小时再次确认你的航班。

senses.def: the activity of getting information about an area for military purposes, using soldiers, planes, etc.

examples.en: to make an aerial reconnaissance of the island
examples.zh: 对这座岛进行空中侦察

examples.en: Time spent on reconnaissance is seldom wasted.
examples.zh: 花在侦察上的时间很少会白费。

examples.en: a reconnaissance aircraft/mission/satellite
examples.zh: 侦察机／任务／卫星

senses.def: to connect something again; to connect to something again

examples.en: I replaced the taps and reconnected the water supply.
examples.zh: 我更换了水龙头，再次接通了自来水。

examples.en: Once you have removed the virus it is safe to reconnect to the internet.
examples.zh: 病毒一清除，就可以安全地重新连接互联网。

senses.def: to get information about an area, especially for military purposes, by using soldiers, planes, etc.
to take control again of a country or city by force, after having lost it
senses.zh: 重新占领（国家或城市）；再征服；夺回

senses.def: to think about something again, especially because you might want to change a previous decision or opinion

examples.en: to reconsider your decision/position
examples.zh: 重新考虑你的决定／立场

examples.en: The company was forced to reconsider its plans for expansion.
examples.zh: 该公司被迫重新考虑其扩张计划。

examples.en: Recent information may persuade the board to reconsider.
examples.zh: 最近得到的信息也许会使董事会重新考虑。

examples.en: You may need to reconsider what you want to do.
examples.zh: 您可能需要重新考虑您想做什么。

senses.def: the act or process of thinking about something again, especially because you might want to change a previous decision or opinion

examples.en: They called for a reconsideration of the issue.
examples.zh: 他们呼吁重新考虑这个问题。

senses.def: to form an organization or a group again in a different way

examples.en: The group reconstituted itself as a political party.
examples.zh: 这个团体重新组建为一个政党。

senses.def: to bring dried food, etc. back to its original form by adding water
senses.zh: 使（脱水食物等）恢复原状；使还原

examples.en: reconstituted orange juice
examples.zh: 加水还原的橙汁

senses.def: the act of forming of an organization or a group again in a different way

examples.en: During 1863 he had overseen the society's reconstitution.
examples.zh: 1863 年期间，他监督了协会的重建。

senses.def: to build or make something again that has been damaged or that no longer exists

examples.en: Old London Bridge was bought by an American and reconstructed in the US.
examples.zh: 旧伦敦桥被一个美国人买下，并在美国重新组装。

examples.en: They have tried to reconstruct the settlement as it would have been in Iron Age times.
examples.zh: 他们已试着按铁器时代的样子重建这个小村落。

senses.def: to be able to describe or show exactly how a past event happened, using the information you have gathered

examples.en: Investigators are trying to reconstruct the circumstances of the crash.
examples.zh: 调查人员正试图重现撞车时的情形。

senses.def: the process of changing or improving the condition of something or the way it works; the process of putting something back into the state it was in before

examples.en: the reconstruction of the educational system
examples.zh: 重建教育体系

examples.en: the post-war reconstruction of Germany
examples.zh: 德国的战后重建

examples.en: a reconstruction period
examples.zh: 重建时期

senses.def: the activity of building again something that has been damaged or destroyed

examples.en: the reconstruction of the sea walls
examples.zh: 海堤的修复

senses.def: a copy of something that no longer exists

examples.en: The doorway is a nineteenth-century reconstruction of Norman work.
examples.zh: 门廊是 19 世纪时模仿诺曼式建筑修建的。

senses.def: an act of acting out events that are known to have happened, in order to try and get more information or better understanding about what happened, especially a crime
senses.zh: （尤指犯罪过程的）再现影片，模拟还原片

examples.en: Last night police staged a reconstruction of the incident.
examples.zh: 昨天晚上，警方放映了再现事故经过的影片。

examples.en: The police have staged a reconstruction of the events leading up to the murder.
examples.zh: 警方放映了再现导致谋杀案发生的系列事件的短片。

senses.def: (in the US) the period after the Civil War when the southern states returned to the US and laws were passed that gave rights to African Americans
senses.zh: 重建时期（美国南北战争后南方各州重新加入联邦）

senses.def: that involves reconstructing

examples.en: reconstructive surgery
examples.zh: 整形手术

senses.def: if a meeting, parliament, etc. reconvenes
a written account of something that is kept so that it can be looked at and used in the future

examples.en: You should keep a record of your expenses.
examples.zh: 你应该记下你的各项开支。

examples.en: medical/dental records
examples.zh: 病历；牙科病历

examples.en: It was the worst flood since records began.
examples.zh: 这是有记录以来最严重的水灾。

examples.en: According to official records, there were 21 murders in the city that year.
examples.zh: 根据官方记录，该市当年发生了 21 起谋杀案。

examples.en: Last summer was the wettest on record.
examples.zh: 去年夏天是有记录以来降雨量最大的。

examples.en: people who leave no trace in the historical record (= written documents that provide evidence about the past)
examples.zh: 在历史记录中没有留下踪迹的人

senses.def: the best result or the highest or lowest level that has ever been reached, especially in sport
senses.zh: （尤指体育运动中最高或最低的）纪录

examples.en: She holds the world record for the 100 metres.
examples.zh: 她保持着 100 米的世界纪录。

examples.en: to break the record (= to achieve a better result than there has ever been before)
examples.zh: 破纪录

examples.en: to set a new record
examples.zh: 刷新纪录

examples.en: There was a record number of candidates for the post.
examples.zh: 这个职位的候选人数量空前。

examples.en: I got to work in record time.
examples.zh: 我以历来最快的速度赶到单位上班。

examples.en: The UK's biggest banks made record profits last year.
examples.zh: 英国最大的银行去年的利润创历史新高。

examples.en: Unemployment has reached a record high (= the highest level ever).
examples.zh: 失业数字已经达到了历来的最高纪录。

senses.def: the facts that are known about somebody/something’s past behaviour, character, achievements, etc.
senses.zh: （有关过去的）事实；记录；经历；功过

examples.en: The airline has a good safety record.
examples.zh: 这家航空公司的安全记录一向很好。

examples.en: The report criticizes the government's record on housing.
examples.zh: 这份报告批评了政府在住房问题上的所作所为。

examples.en: He has an impressive record of achievement.
examples.zh: 他所取得的一系列成就令人赞叹。

senses.def: rocks, fossils

examples.en: Fossil records suggest that the region was covered in water until relatively recently.
examples.zh: 化石记录表明该地区不久之前还一直淹没在水中。

examples.en: evidence in the geological record
examples.zh: 地质学记载中的证据

examples.en: This period of barbarian rule is poorly represented in the archaeological record.
examples.zh: 考古学资料对这一时期野蛮统治的记载非常贫乏。

senses.def: the fact of having committed crimes in the past

examples.en: Does he have a record?
examples.zh: 他有没有前科？

examples.en: teenagers with a criminal record
examples.zh: 有犯罪记录的青少年

senses.def: a thin, round piece of plastic on which music, etc. is recorded

examples.en: to play a record
examples.zh: 播放唱片

examples.en: a record collection
examples.zh: 收藏的唱片

senses.def: a piece or collection of music released as a record

examples.en: a record company (= one which produces and sells records)
examples.zh: 唱片公司

examples.en: They released their first record in 1963.
examples.zh: 1963 年，他们发行了第一张唱片。

examples.en: The band had a hit record in 1973.
examples.zh: 乐队在 1973 年有一张唱片爆红。

examples.en: His new record is available on CD or as a download.
examples.zh: 他的新专辑可以通过购买 CD 或从网上下载获得。

senses.def: used to show that you want what you are saying to be officially written down and remembered
senses.zh: （希望载入正式记录）（仅）供记录

examples.en: Just for the record I would like to clarify something my colleague said earlier.
examples.zh: 作为记录，我想澄清我同事之前所说的一些事情。

senses.def: used to emphasize a point that you are making, so that the person you are speaking to takes notice

examples.en: And, for the record, he would be the last person I'd ask.
examples.zh: 需要强调的是，他是我最不愿意去找的人。

senses.def: in a way that keeps repeating a statement or opinion in an annoying way

examples.en: I hate sounding like a broken record, but I have to say again, we must do more to help.
examples.zh: 我讨厌听起来像是一张破唱片，但我不得不再说一遍，我们必须提供更多帮助。

senses.def: something that has been recorded as being true
if you tell somebody something off the record
senses.zh: 非正式的；私下的；不得发表的

examples.en: Strictly off the record, some members of staff will have to be made redundant.
examples.zh: 严格来说，一些员工将不得不被裁员。

senses.def: to say something publicly or officially so that it may be written down and repeated

examples.en: He didn't want to go on the record as either praising or criticizing the proposal.
examples.zh: 他不想公开赞扬或批评这项提议。

examples.en: I should like to place on record my sincere thanks to all those who have given support.
examples.zh: 我谨向所有给予支持的人们表示诚挚的感谢。

senses.def: to give people the correct information about something in order to make it clear that what they previously believed was in fact wrong

examples.en: To put the record straight, I do not support that idea and never have done.
examples.zh: 澄清一下，我不支持这个想法，也从来没有这样做过。

senses.def: to keep a permanent account of facts or events by writing them down, filming them, storing them in a computer, etc.

examples.en: Her childhood is recorded in the diaries of those years.
examples.zh: 她的童年生活都记在当年的日记里。

examples.en: You should record all your expenses during your trip.
examples.zh: 你应该记下你一路上的所有开支。

examples.en: His job is to record how politicians vote on major issues.
examples.zh: 他的工作就是记录政治家是如何对重大问题投票的。

examples.en: She recorded in her diary that they crossed the Equator on 15 June.
examples.zh: 她在日记中记载他们是在 6 月 15 日越过赤道的。

examples.en: It is recorded that, by the year 630, four hundred monks were attached to the monastery.
examples.zh: 据记载，到 630 年有 400 个僧侣隶属该寺院。

senses.def: to make a copy of music, a film, etc. or to convert sound or a performance into a permanent form, so that you can listen to or watch it again

examples.en: Did you remember to record that programme for me?
examples.zh: 你记得为我录下那个节目了吗？

examples.en: a recorded concert
examples.zh: 录制的音乐会

examples.en: Tell me when the machine starts recording.
examples.zh: 机器开始录时告诉我一声。

examples.en: He recorded the class rehearsing before the performance.
examples.zh: 他录下了演出前班级的排练。

senses.def: to perform music so that it can be copied, stored and played back
senses.zh: 演奏音乐供录制；灌（唱片）

examples.en: The band is back in the US recording their new album.
examples.zh: 乐队回美国录制新唱片去了。

examples.en: to record a song
examples.zh: 录制歌曲

examples.en: They spent the summer touring and recording.
examples.zh: 他们整个夏天都在巡回演出和录制唱片。

senses.def: to make an official or legal statement about something
senses.zh: 发表正式（或法律方面的）声明；申明

examples.en: The coroner recorded a verdict of accidental death.
examples.zh: 验尸官得出了意外死亡的结论。

examples.en: It is with great regret that we record the death of one of our founder members.
examples.zh: 我们非常遗憾地记录了我们的一位创始人成员的去世。

senses.group: make official statement 正式声明

senses.def: to show a particular measurement or amount

examples.en: The thermometer recorded a temperature of 40°C.
examples.zh: 温度计显示气温达到了 40 摄氏度。

senses.group: of measuring instrument 测量仪器

senses.def: to achieve a particular score or result

examples.en: The team recorded their first win of the season.
examples.zh: 该队取得了本赛季的第一场胜利。

examples.en: to record a victory/high score
examples.zh: 记录胜利/高分

senses.def: used to show that you want what you are saying to be officially written down and remembered
senses.zh: （希望载入正式记录）（仅）供记录

examples.en: Just for the record I would like to clarify something my colleague said earlier.
examples.zh: 作为记录，我想澄清我同事之前所说的一些事情。

senses.def: used to emphasize a point that you are making, so that the person you are speaking to takes notice

examples.en: And, for the record, he would be the last person I'd ask.
examples.zh: 需要强调的是，他是我最不愿意去找的人。

senses.def: in a way that keeps repeating a statement or opinion in an annoying way

examples.en: I hate sounding like a broken record, but I have to say again, we must do more to help.
examples.zh: 我讨厌听起来像是一张破唱片，但我不得不再说一遍，我们必须提供更多帮助。

senses.def: something that has been recorded as being true
if you tell somebody something off the record
senses.zh: 非正式的；私下的；不得发表的

examples.en: Strictly off the record, some members of staff will have to be made redundant.
examples.zh: 严格来说，一些员工将不得不被裁员。

items.idm: put/place something on (the) record | be/go on (the) record (as saying…)

senses.def: to say something publicly or officially so that it may be written down and repeated

examples.en: He didn't want to go on the record as either praising or criticizing the proposal.
examples.zh: 他不想公开赞扬或批评这项提议。

examples.en: I should like to place on record my sincere thanks to all those who have given support.
examples.zh: 我谨向所有给予支持的人们表示诚挚的感谢。

senses.def: to give people the correct information about something in order to make it clear that what they previously believed was in fact wrong

examples.en: To put the record straight, I do not support that idea and never have done.
examples.zh: 澄清一下，我不支持这个想法，也从来没有这样做过。

senses.def: a person or thing that achieves a better result or higher level than has ever been achieved before
having achieved a better result or higher level than has ever been achieved before

examples.en: a record-breaking jump
examples.zh: 破纪录的一跳

senses.def: a person who has achieved the best result that has ever been achieved in a sport
a piece of equipment for playing records in order to listen to the music, etc. on them
that can or should be recorded

examples.en: recordable workplace injuries
examples.zh: 可记录的工作场所伤害

senses.def: that you can record something on

examples.en: recordable media/discs
examples.zh: 可刻录媒体/光盘

senses.def: a method of sending a letter or package in which the person sending it gets an official note to say it has been posted and the person receiving it must sign a form when it is delivered
senses.zh: 挂号邮寄（寄件人会收到发件通知，收件人须签收）

examples.en: I’d like to send this (by) recorded delivery.
examples.zh: 这个邮件要挂号。

senses.def: a machine for recording sound or pictures or both

examples.en: The cockpit voice recorder indicated that the crew did not call for any checklist.
examples.zh: 驾驶舱录音机显示机组人员没有要求提供任何检查单。

examples.en: a tape/cassette/video/DVD recorder
examples.zh: 磁带／盒式录音机；录像机；DVD 录像机

senses.def: a musical instrument in the shape of a pipe that you blow into, with holes that you cover with your fingers
a judge in a court in some parts of the UK and the US
senses.zh: （英国和美国部分地区的）刑事法院法官，法官

senses.def: a person who keeps a record of events or facts

examples.en: In natural history the careful observer and recorder was very important in the advance of the science.
examples.zh: 在自然历史中，细心的观察者和记录者对于科学的进步非常重要。

senses.def: a person whose job is making sound recordings, especially in a recording studio

examples.en: He was a recording engineer and producer.
examples.zh: 他是一名录音工程师和制作人。

senses.def: a person whose job is making sound recordings, especially in a recording studio
senses.zh: （尤指录音棚的）录音员，录音师

examples.en: The cinematographer and sound recordist were fantastic.
examples.zh: 电影摄影师和录音师都很棒。

senses.def: to tell somebody about something, especially something that you have experienced

examples.en: She was asked to recount the details of the conversation to the court.
examples.zh: 她被要求向法庭陈述谈话细节。

examples.en: They recounted what had happened during those years.
examples.zh: 他们叙述了那些年里发生的事。

examples.en: ‘It was before the war,’ he recounted.
examples.zh: “那是在战前。”他叙述道。

senses.def: to count something again, especially votes
an act of telling somebody about something, especially something that you have experienced
senses.zh: （尤指对亲身经历的）讲述，叙述

examples.en: By the time we got home, I had finished my recount of the events.
examples.zh: 我们到家时，我已经讲完了这些事情的经过。

senses.def: an act of counting again to find the total number of something, especially votes at an election when the result is very close

examples.en: The defeated candidate demanded a recount.
examples.zh: 落选的候选人要求重新计票。

senses.def: to get back an amount of money that you have spent or lost

examples.en: We hope to recoup our initial investment in the first year.
examples.zh: 我们希望我们的前期投资在第一年就能赚回来。

examples.en: The firm is hoping to recoup losses on car sales in the UK with this new model.
examples.zh: 该公司希望通过这款新车型弥补英国汽车销售的损失。

senses.def: the fact of having to, or being able to, use something that can provide help in a difficult situation

examples.en: Your only recourse is legal action.
examples.zh: 你的唯一依靠就是诉诸法律。

examples.en: The government, when necessary, has recourse to the armed forces.
examples.zh: 政府在必要时可以动用军队。

examples.en: She made a complete recovery without recourse to surgery.
examples.zh: 她未做手术就完全恢复了健康。

senses.def: to get well again after being ill, hurt, etc.

examples.zh: 他欣赏着自己在镜中的影像。

senses.def: the action or process of sending back light, heat, sound, etc. from a surface

examples.en: There is reflection of heat from the metal surface.
examples.zh: 金属表面反射传导热。

senses.def: a sign that shows the state or nature of something

examples.en: Your clothes are often a reflection of your personality.
examples.zh: 穿着常常反映出一个人的个性。

examples.en: This account is only a pale reflection of the true state of affairs.
examples.zh: 这一报道苍白无力，没有反映事态的真实面貌。

examples.en: The increase in crime is a sad reflection on (= shows something bad about) our society today.
examples.zh: 犯罪的增加令人遗憾地反映了当今社会不太好的一面。

senses.def: careful thought about something, sometimes over a long period of time

examples.en: A week off would give him time for reflection.
examples.zh: 歇上一周会使他有时间考虑考虑。

examples.en: She decided on reflection to accept his offer after all.
examples.zh: 经过审慎的思考，她还是决定接受他的提议。

examples.en: It may be that, on mature reflection, you decide to cancel the plan.
examples.zh: 经过成熟的反思，您可能决定取消该计划。

senses.def: your written or spoken thoughts about a particular subject or topic

examples.en: a book of her reflections on childhood
examples.zh: 一本关于她童年生活的回忆录

senses.def: an account or a description of something

examples.en: The article is an accurate reflection of events that day.
examples.zh: 这篇文章准确地记录了那天发生的事。

senses.def: thinking deeply about things

examples.en: a quiet and reflective man
examples.zh: 文静而爱沉思的男子

examples.en: There was a reflective, rather sad side to her character.
examples.zh: 她的性格中有沉思的、相当悲伤的一面。

senses.def: reflective
senses.zh: （指物体表面）反射热的，反光的

examples.en: reflective car number plates
examples.zh: 反光的汽车牌照

examples.en: On dark nights children should wear reflective clothing.
examples.zh: 在漆黑的夜晚，儿童应该穿反光的衣服。

senses.def: typical of a particular situation or thing; showing the state or nature of something
senses.zh: 典型的；代表性的；体现状态（或本质）的

examples.en: His abilities are not reflective of the team as a whole.
examples.zh: 他的能力并不代表整队的水平。

examples.en: Everything you do or say is reflective of your personality.
examples.zh: 你的一言一行都体现你的个性。

senses.def: in a way that shows somebody is thinking deeply about things

examples.en: She sipped her tea reflectively.
examples.zh: 她若有所思地喝了一口茶。

senses.def: the degree to which a material reflects light or radiation
a surface that reflects light
a small piece of special glass or plastic that is put on a bicycle, or on clothing, so that it can be seen at night when light shines on it
senses.zh: （夜间光线照射后能反光的）反光玻璃（或塑料），反光体

senses.def: an action or a movement of your body that happens naturally in response to something and that you cannot control; something that you do without thinking
senses.zh: 反射动作；本能反应；反射作用

examples.en: The doctor tested her reflexes.
examples.zh: 医生检测了她的反射动作。

examples.en: to have quick/slow reflexes
examples.zh: 反射动作快／慢

examples.en: a reflex response/reaction
examples.zh: 反射性反应

examples.en: Only the goalkeeper's reflexes (= his ability to react quickly) stopped the ball from going in.
examples.zh: 只是因为守门员反应迅速，球才没有进。

examples.en: Almost as a reflex action, I grab my pen as the phone rings.
examples.zh: 几乎是一种本能反应，电话铃一响，我就抓起笔。

senses.def: an angle of more than 180°
an old spelling of reflection
a reflexive

examples.en: In ‘He cut himself’, ‘cut’ is a reflexive verb and ‘himself’ is a reflexive pronoun.
examples.zh: 在 He cut himself 一句中，cut 是反身动词，himself 是反身代词。

senses.def: a person who practises reflexology
senses.zh: （以按摩脚跟来松弛患者神经的）反射治疗师

senses.def: a type of alternative treatment in which somebody’s feet are rubbed in a particular way in order to cure a health problem in other parts of their body or to make them feel mentally relaxed
senses.zh: 反射疗法（通过脚部按摩治疗身体其他部位疾病或松弛神经）

senses.def: to make a boat or ship float again, for example after it has become stuck on the bottom in shallow water

examples.en: A salvage team had battled for five days to refloat the ship.
examples.zh: 打捞队奋战了五天才将这艘船重新浮起。

senses.def: a method of joining metals together by heating and melting solder
the fact of changing text on a computer screen so that it takes more or less space
senses.zh: 文档重整，页面重排（调整文本在计算机屏幕上的显示密度）

senses.def: the fact of the liquid contents of the stomach flowing back into the oesophagus

examples.en: He has acid reflux.
examples.zh: 他有胃酸反流的毛病。

senses.def: to give attention, effort, etc. to something new or different
senses.zh: 将（注意力、精力等）转向；调整…的重点

examples.en: Policy must refocus on people instead of places.
examples.zh: 政策重心必须改变，针对人而非地方。

examples.en: We need to refocus attention on the real issues facing this country.
examples.zh: 我们需要将注意力转向国家所面临的实际问题。

senses.def: to adapt or be changed again so that things can be seen clearly; to change something again so that you can see things clearly
the act of planting new trees in an area where there used to be a forest
change that is made to a social system, an organization, etc. in order to improve or correct it

examples.en: a government committed to reform
examples.zh: 致力于改革的政府

examples.en: economic/electoral/constitutional, etc. reform
examples.zh: 经济、选举、宪法等改革

examples.en: the reform of the educational system
examples.zh: 教育体制的改革

examples.en: reforms in education
examples.zh: 教育改革

examples.en: far-reaching/major/sweeping reforms
examples.zh: 意义深远的／重大的／彻底的变革

senses.def: to improve a system, an organization, a law, etc. by making changes to it

examples.en: proposals to reform the social security system
examples.zh: 改革社会保障制度的建议

examples.en: The law needs to be reformed.
examples.zh: 法律需要进行改革。

examples.en: a reforming administration
examples.zh: 改革政府

senses.def: to improve your behaviour; to make somebody do this

examples.en: He has promised to reform.
examples.zh: 他许诺要改过自新。

examples.en: She thought she could reform him.
examples.zh: 她觉得她可以使他洗心革面。

senses.def: to give a new format

examples.en: You should be able to install the drive software without needing to reformat the hard drive.
examples.zh: 您应该能够安装驱动器软件，而无需重新格式化硬盘。

senses.def: the act of improving or changing somebody/something
new ideas in religion in 16th century Europe that led to attempts to reform
senses.zh: 宗教改革（欧洲 16 世纪改革天主教从而导致新教的产生）；宗教改革时期

senses.def: a type of school that young criminals are sent to instead of prison
senses.zh: 少年犯管教所；青少年教养院

senses.def: a church that has accepted the principles of the Reformation
senses.zh: （基督教）新教教会归正会，归正宗（尤指加尔文教派）

senses.def: a person who works to achieve political or social change

examples.en: Charlotte Mason (1842–1923), educational reformer, was born 1 January 1842 in Bangor.
examples.zh: 夏洛特·梅森（Charlotte Mason，1842-1923 年），教育改革家，1842 年 1 月 1 日出生于班戈。

examples.en: Many social reformers have been regarded as criminals and law-breakers in the past.
examples.zh: 很多推动社会变革的人在过去被认为是罪犯和不法分子。

senses.def: wanting or trying to change political or social situations
senses.zh: 主张改革的；改革派的；改良主义的

examples.en: a reformist leader
examples.zh: 改革派领导人

examples.en: a reformist movement
examples.zh: 改良主义运动

senses.def: a person who wants or is trying to change political or social situations
senses.zh: 主张改革的；改革派的；改良主义的

examples.en: the trial of three prominent reformists
examples.zh: 对三位著名改革派的审判

senses.def: to create or prepare something again

examples.en: It is never too late to reformulate your goals.
examples.zh: 重订目标决不会为时过晚。

senses.def: to say or express something in a different way

examples.en: Let me try to reformulate the problem.
examples.zh: 让我换个说法讲这个问题吧。

senses.def: the act of creating or preparing something again

examples.en: the reformulation of party policy
examples.zh: 重新制定党的政策

senses.def: the act of saying or expressing something in a different way

examples.en: a reformulation of the committee's recommendations
examples.zh: 重新拟定委员会的建议

senses.def: the practice of forcing refugees

examples.en: Such deportations of asylum seekers amount to refoulement and constitute a serious violation of the 1951 Refugee Convention.
examples.zh: 这种驱逐寻求庇护者的行为相当于驱回，严重违反了 1951 年《难民公约》。

senses.def: to make waves, such as those of light, sound or energy, change direction when they go through at an angle
senses.zh: 使（光波、声波、能量波等）折射；使产生折射

examples.en: Light is refracted when passed through a prism.
examples.zh: 光通过棱镜时产生折射。

senses.def: the fact of light, radio waves, etc. changing direction when they go through water, air, glass, etc. at an angle

examples.en: The degree to which the light changes direction is called the angle of refraction.
examples.zh: 光改变方向的程度称为折射角。

senses.def: causing, caused by or relating to refraction
a measurement of how much an object or a substance refracts
an instrument for measuring a refractive index
something such as a lens
difficult to control; behaving badly
senses.zh: 难以驾驭的；行为乖戾的

senses.def: difficult to treat or cure
senses.zh: 耐治性的；顽固性的；难治性的

senses.def: to stop yourself from doing something, especially something that you want to do

examples.en: They appealed to the protesters to refrain from violence.
examples.zh: 他们呼吁抗议者避免使用暴力。

examples.en: Both sides should refrain from actions that would make the situation worse.
examples.zh: 双方都应避免采取使局势变得更糟的行动。

examples.en: Please refrain from smoking.
examples.zh: 请勿吸烟。

examples.en: He has refrained from criticizing the government in public.
examples.zh: 他克制住了自己，没有在公开场合批评政府。

senses.def: a comment or complaint that is often repeated
senses.zh: 经常重复的评价（或抱怨）

examples.en: Complaints about poor food in schools have become a familiar refrain.
examples.zh: 抱怨学校饭菜差已是耳熟能详的老调了。

examples.en: The protest began with a small group, but then the others took up the refrain.
examples.zh: 抗议活动一开始只有一小群人，但随后其他人也开始抗议。

senses.def: the part of a song or a poem that is repeated after each verse

examples.en: The choir's sopranos took up the refrain.
examples.zh: 合唱队的女高音开始唱副歌部份。

senses.def: to make somebody feel less tired or less hot

examples.en: The long sleep had refreshed her.
examples.zh: 一场酣睡使她重又精力充沛。

examples.en: The following morning she awoke refreshed.
examples.zh: 第二天早上，她醒来时神清气爽。

examples.en: He refreshed himself with a cool shower.
examples.zh: 他冲了个凉水澡凉快凉快。

senses.def: to fill somebody’s glass or cup again

examples.en: Let me refresh your glass.
examples.zh: 我给你再斟一杯吧。

examples.en: He went into the kitchen to refresh their drinks.
examples.zh: 他走进厨房去给他们续杯饮料。

senses.def: to remind yourself/somebody of something, especially with the help of something that can be seen or heard

examples.en: He had to refresh his memory by looking at his notes.
examples.zh: 他不得不靠看笔记来提醒自己。

senses.def: to make the most recent information show, for example on an internet page

examples.en: Click here to refresh this document.
examples.zh: 点击此处以刷新文件。

examples.en: The page refreshes automatically.
examples.zh: 页面会自动更新。

senses.def: the frequency with which the image on a computer or electronic screen is updated, usually expressed in hertz
senses.zh: （显示器上图像的）刷新率（通常用赫兹表示）

examples.en: For a smooth gaming experience, a phone needs to have a fast refresh rate.
examples.zh: 为获得流畅的游戏体验，手机需要有快速的刷新率。

senses.def: a short period of training to improve your skills or to teach you about new ideas and developments in your job
in a way that makes you feel less tired or hot
senses.zh: 使人精力充沛的；使人凉爽的

examples.en: The house was refreshingly cool inside.
examples.zh: 屋内清凉宜人。

senses.def: in a pleasant way

examples.en: refreshingly different
examples.zh: 别具一格

senses.def: drinks and small amounts of food that are provided or sold to people in a public place or at a public event
senses.zh: （在公共场所或公开活动上供应或销售的）饮料，小食

examples.en: Light refreshments will be served during the break.
examples.zh: 中间休息时有点心供应。

examples.en: Tickets include the price of refreshments.
examples.zh: 票价包含点心饮料费。

examples.en: What are we going to have for refreshments?
examples.zh: 我们吃什么茶点？

senses.def: food and drink

examples.en: In York we had a short stop for refreshment.
examples.zh: 在约克，我们稍作停留，吃了点东西。

examples.en: Can we offer you some refreshment?
examples.zh: 您要吃点什么吗？

examples.en: a refreshment room/kiosk/tent
examples.zh: 小吃部；饮食亭；活动小吃摊

examples.en: liquid refreshment (= alcoholic drink)
examples.zh: 酒

senses.def: the fact of making somebody feel stronger or less tired or hot

examples.en: a place to rest and find refreshment for mind and body
examples.zh: 休息和恢复身心活力的场所

senses.def: beans that have been boiled and fried in advance and are heated again when needed, used especially in Mexican cooking
a chemical substance used in the refrigeration
senses.zh: 制冷剂，冷冻剂，制冷物质

senses.def: to make food, etc. cold in order to keep it fresh or preserve it

examples.en: Once opened, this product should be kept refrigerated.
examples.zh: 本产品开封后应冷藏。

examples.en: a refrigerated lorry/truck
examples.zh: 冷藏卡车

senses.def: the act or process of keeping food, etc. cold in order to keep it fresh or preserve it

examples.en: Keep all meat products under refrigeration.
examples.zh: 所有肉制品都要冷藏。

senses.def: a piece of electrical equipment in which food is kept cold so that it stays fresh

examples.en: This dessert can be served straight from the refrigerator.
examples.zh: 这甜点从冰箱里拿出后即可食用。

senses.def: to fill something, especially a plane, with fuel in order to continue a journey; to be filled with fuel
senses.zh: （尤指给飞机）补充燃料，加燃料；加油

examples.en: to refuel a plane
examples.zh: 给飞机加油

examples.en: The planes needed to refuel before the next mission.
examples.zh: 这些飞机需要添加燃料才能再次飞行。

examples.en: a refuelling stop
examples.zh: 加油停留

senses.def: shelter or protection from danger, trouble, etc.

examples.en: A further 300 people have taken refuge in the US embassy.
examples.zh: 又有 300 人在美国大使馆避难。

examples.en: The region was a place of refuge for outlaws and bandits.
examples.zh: 该地区是亡命之徒和土匪的避难所。

examples.en: They were forced to seek refuge from the fighting.
examples.zh: 他们被迫寻求庇护，以躲避战争。

examples.en: As the situation at home got worse she increasingly took refuge in her work.
examples.zh: 随着家庭情况的恶化，她越来越在工作中寻求慰藉。

senses.def: a place, person or thing that provides shelter or protection for somebody/something

examples.en: The marshes are a wetland refuge for seabirds, waders and wild fowl.
examples.zh: 那片沼泽是海鸟、涉禽和野禽的湿地藏身处。

examples.en: He regarded the room as a refuge from the outside world.
examples.zh: 他把这个屋子当作是逃避外界的避难所。

senses.def: a building that provides a temporary home for people in need of shelter or protection from somebody/something

examples.en: The best option for a female victim of domestic abuse is to contact a women's refuge.
examples.zh: 对受到家庭暴力伤害的女性而言，最佳的做法是联系妇女救助中心。

examples.en: During the great fire of 1871 the church served as a refuge for people who were homeless.
examples.zh: 1871 年大火期间，教堂成为无家可归者的避难所。

senses.def: an area in the middle of a road where you can stand and wait for cars to go past until it is safe for you to cross
senses.zh: 交通岛（供行人避让车辆）

senses.def: a person who has been forced to leave their country or home, because there is a war or for political, religious or social reasons

examples.en: There has been a steady flow of refugees from the war zone.
examples.zh: 难民持续从交战地区涌出。

examples.en: political/economic refugees
examples.zh: 政治避难者；由于经济危机而造成的难民

examples.en: political refugees
examples.zh: 政治难民

examples.en: a refugee camp
examples.zh: 难民营

intro.en: These words all describe people who have moved to a different country.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示移居外国的人。

items.def: a person who has either chosen or been forced to leave their country and come to live permanently in a different country:
items.zh: 指移民、外侨

examples.en: immigrants from other European countries
examples.zh: 来自其他欧洲国家的移民

items.def: a person who moves from one place to another in order to find work or better living conditions:
items.zh: 指为了找工作或改善生活而迁移的人

examples.en: The country has a large seasonal migrant population.
examples.zh: 该国有大量季节性移民。

items.def: a person who has been forced to leave their country or home, because there is a war or for political, religious or social reasons:
items.zh: 指避难者、逃亡者、难民

examples.en: There has been a steady flow of refugees from the war zone.
examples.zh: 难民持续从交战地区涌出。

items.def: a person who has been forced to leave their own country because they are in danger and who arrives in another country asking to be allowed to stay there:
items.zh: 指寻求避难者、寻求庇护的移民

examples.en: to provide accommodation and support for asylum seekers
examples.zh: 为寻求庇护的人提供住宿和援助

items.def: a person living in a country that is not their own, usually by choice:
items.zh: 指通常自愿选择居住在国外的人、侨民

examples.en: American expatriates in Paris
examples.zh: 居住在巴黎的美国人

senses.def: very bright
a sum of money that is paid back to you, especially because you paid too much or because you returned goods to a shop

examples.en: a tax refund
examples.zh: 税金退款

examples.en: to claim/demand/receive a refund
examples.zh: 要求／接受退款

examples.en: If there is a delay of 12 hours or more, you will receive a full refund of the price of your trip.
examples.zh: 如果延误达到或超过 12 小时，你会得到旅费全额退款。

senses.def: to give somebody their money back, especially because they have paid too much or because they are not satisfied with something they bought

examples.en: Tickets cannot be exchanged or money refunded.
examples.zh: 门票不可退换。

examples.en: Your money will be refunded in full.
examples.zh: 您会得到全额退款。

examples.en: We will refund your money to you in full if you are not entirely satisfied.
examples.zh: 如果你并不感到完全满意，我们会退还全部金额。

examples.en: If you are not satisfied with the goods, the price will be refunded to you.
examples.zh: 如果对商品不满意，我们会给您退款。

examples.en: We will refund you your money in full.
examples.zh: 我们会给你全额退款。

senses.def: if something you have paid for is refundable
senses.zh: 可退款：如果您所支付的费用可退款，则对您不满意或无法使用它可以将钱退还

examples.en: Tickets are not refundable.
examples.zh: 不能退票。

senses.def: a sum of money that you pay that is refundable
senses.zh: 可退还：您所支付的可退还款项将在满足特定条件时稍后退还

examples.en: a refundable deposit
examples.zh: 可退还的押金

senses.def: to clean and decorate a room, building, etc. in order to make it more attractive, more useful, etc.

examples.en: The theatre has been extensively refurbished.
examples.zh: 这个剧院进行了彻底的清理装修。

senses.def: the act or process of cleaning and decorating a room, building, etc. in order to make it more attractive, more useful, etc.

examples.en: The hotel is closed for refurbishment.
examples.zh: 酒店停业装修。

examples.en: This is just one of several planned refurbishments.
examples.zh: 这仅是几个规划了的翻修项目之一。

senses.def: an act of saying or showing that you will not do, give or accept something

examples.en: the refusal of a request/an invitation/an offer
examples.zh: 拒绝请求／邀请／建议

examples.en: a blunt/flat/curt refusal
examples.zh: 率直的／断然的／粗率的拒绝

examples.en: His refusal to discuss the matter is very annoying.
examples.zh: 他拒绝商量这件事，令人很恼火。

senses.def: to say or show that you will not do something that somebody has asked you to do

examples.en: Go on, ask her; she can hardly refuse.
examples.zh: 去吧，去求她，她不大可能拒绝。

examples.en: He flatly refused to discuss the matter.
examples.zh: 他断然拒绝商讨这件事。

examples.en: She refused to accept that there was a problem.
examples.zh: 她拒不承认有问题存在。

examples.en: My brother refused to allow anyone to help him.
examples.zh: 我哥哥拒绝任何人帮助他。

examples.en: She refused to comment further.
examples.zh: 她拒绝进一步发表评论。

examples.en: He has steadfastly refused to answer my questions.
examples.zh: 他坚决拒绝回答我的问题。

examples.en: They simply refuse to give up.
examples.zh: 他们只是拒绝放弃。

examples.en: The demand for an apology was pointedly refused.
examples.zh: 道歉的要求遭到了断然拒绝。

senses.def: to say that you do not want something that has been offered to you

examples.en: I politely refused their invitation.
examples.zh: 我礼貌地回绝了他们的邀请。

examples.en: The job offer was simply too good to refuse.
examples.zh: 这个工作机会太好了，简直无法推掉。

examples.en: I must refuse your generous offer.
examples.zh: 我必须拒绝你的慷慨提议。

examples.en: She offered them cups of tea and it seemed churlish to refuse.
examples.zh: 她不停给他们倒茶，回绝的话又好像没礼貌。

senses.def: to say that you will not allow something; to say that you will not give or allow somebody something that they want or need
senses.zh: 不准许；拒绝给（所需之物）

examples.en: He refused our request for an interview.
examples.zh: 他拒绝了我们的采访请求。

examples.en: The bank refused his demand for a full refund.
examples.zh: 银行拒绝了他全额退款的要求。

examples.en: The authorities refused permission for the new housing development.
examples.zh: 当局不允许新住宅开发。

examples.en: The judge refused her application for bail.
examples.zh: 法官拒绝了她的保释申请。

examples.en: The government has refused all demands for a public inquiry.
examples.zh: 政府拒绝了所有公开调查的要求。

examples.en: They refused him a visa.
examples.zh: 他们拒绝给他签证。

examples.en: The judge refused them permission to appeal.
examples.zh: 法官拒绝他们上诉。

examples.en: She would never refuse her kids anything.
examples.zh: 她对孩子百依百顺。

senses.def: to fail to do what you want or expect it to do

examples.en: The car refused to start.
examples.zh: 汽车发动不起来。

examples.en: The problem simply refuses to go away.
examples.zh: 问题一直解决不了。

examples.en: My ear infection is refusing to heal.
examples.zh: 我的耳朵感染无法痊愈。

senses.def: waste material that has been thrown away

examples.en: domestic/household refuse
examples.zh: 生活垃圾

examples.en: the city refuse dump
examples.zh: 城市垃圾场

examples.en: refuse collection/disposal
examples.zh: 垃圾收集／处理

senses.def: a person whose job is to remove waste from outside houses, etc.
a person who refuses to obey an order or law as a protest
senses.zh: 拒绝服从指令（或法规）的人；反抗者；抗议者

senses.def: that can be proved to be wrong
senses.zh: 可辩驳的：相反不可辩驳的事实证明是错误的

senses.def: proof or a statement that something is not true or is wrong

examples.en: a refutation of previously held views
examples.zh: 对过去所持观点的否定

senses.def: to prove that something is wrong

examples.en: to refute an argument/a theory, etc.
examples.zh: 驳斥一个论点、理论等

senses.def: to say that something is not true or fair

examples.en: She refutes any suggestion that she behaved unprofessionally.
examples.zh: 谁要是表示她不在行，她都予以反驳。

senses.def: registration

examples.en: an 18 reg car (= a car with ‘18’ in its registration number, showing the year that it was registered)
examples.zh: 汽车牌照号码含 18 的汽车

senses.def: to get back something you no longer have, especially an ability or a quality
senses.zh: 重新获得，恢复（尤指能力或品质等）

examples.en: I struggled to regain some dignity.
examples.zh: 我努力恢复自己的一点儿尊严。

examples.en: The party has regained control of the region.
examples.zh: 这一政党重新获得了这个地区的控制权。

examples.en: She paused on the edge, trying to regain her balance.
examples.zh: 她在边缘上暂停下来，努力恢复平衡。

examples.en: She soon regained her composure.
examples.zh: 她很快就恢复了镇定。

examples.en: He did not regain consciousness (= wake up after being unconscious) for several days.
examples.zh: 他好几天都没有恢复知觉。

senses.def: to get back to a place that you have left

examples.en: They finally managed to regain the beach.
examples.zh: 他们最后终于回到了海滩。

senses.def: typical of a king or queen, and therefore impressive

examples.en: regal power
examples.zh: 王权

examples.en: the regal splendour of the palace
examples.zh: 帝王宫殿之豪华气派

examples.en: She dismissed him with a regal gesture.
examples.zh: 她像女王般挥手打发他离开。

examples.en: Her height gave her an almost regal appearance.
examples.zh: 她的身高让她看起来近乎高贵。

examples.en: her rather regal bearing
examples.zh: 她颇有帝王风范

senses.def: to entertain somebody with stories, jokes, etc.
senses.zh: （通过讲故事或说笑话等）使愉悦，使开心

examples.en: He regaled us with tales of his days as a jazz pianist.
examples.zh: 他给我们讲述他当爵士乐钢琴师时的事，逗我们开心。

senses.def: the special clothes that are worn or objects that are carried at official ceremonies
senses.zh: （正式场合上的）特别服饰，特别物品

examples.en: a portrait of the queen in full regalia
examples.zh: 盛装女王的肖像

senses.def: in a way that is typical of a king or queen, and therefore impressive

examples.en: She waved regally to the crowd.
examples.zh: 她气派十足地朝人群挥手。

senses.def: to think about somebody/something in a particular way

examples.en: They regarded people outside their own town with suspicion.
examples.zh: 他们对非本镇人都持有怀疑的态度。

examples.en: Her work is very highly regarded.
examples.zh: 她的工作受到高度评价。

examples.en: He regards himself as a patriot.
examples.zh: 他自认为是个爱国者。

examples.en: Capital punishment was regarded as inhuman and immoral.
examples.zh: 死刑过去被认为是非人道且不道德的。

examples.en: She is widely regarded as the current leader's natural successor.
examples.zh: 人们普遍认为她是现任领导的当然继任者。

senses.def: to look at somebody/something, especially in a particular way

examples.en: He regarded us suspiciously.
examples.zh: 他以怀疑的眼光看着我们。

senses.def: relating to or in connection with somebody/something

examples.en: I have little information as regards her fitness for the post.
examples.zh: 至于说她是否适合这个职位，我无可奉告。

examples.en: As regards the first point in your letter…
examples.zh: 关于你信中所提到的第一点…

senses.def: attention to or thought and care for somebody/something

examples.en: to have scant/little/no regard for somebody/something
examples.zh: 几乎不／很少／不顾及某人／某事物

examples.en: to pay/show little regard for other people’s property
examples.zh: 支付/不关心他人的财产

examples.en: Social services should pay proper regard to the needs of inner-city areas.
examples.zh: 社会服务机构应该对市中心贫民区的需求给予应有的关注。

examples.en: He was driving without regard to speed limits.
examples.zh: 他开着车，根本不理会速度限制。

senses.def: respect for somebody/something

examples.en: He held her in high regard (= had a good opinion of her).
examples.zh: 他对她非常敬重。

examples.en: I had great regard for his abilities.
examples.zh: 我非常敬佩他的能力。

examples.en: Children no longer have proper regard for their parents and teachers.
examples.zh: 孩子们不再尊重父母和老师。

senses.def: used to send good wishes to somebody at the end of an email or letter, or when asking somebody to give your good wishes to another person who is not present
senses.zh: （用于邮件或信函结尾或转达问候）致意，问候

examples.en: With best/kind regards, Yours…
examples.zh: 谨此致意，…敬上

examples.en: Give your brother my regards when you see him.
examples.zh: 看到你哥哥时，代我向他问好。

senses.def: to remember and think carefully about something

examples.en: It is always necessary to have regard to the terms of the contract.
examples.zh: 记住合同条款总是必要的。

examples.en: New sites for waste disposal will be determined having regard to environmental matters.
examples.zh: 新的废物处理地点将根据环境问题确定。

examples.en: When exercising its discretion, the court will have regard to all the circumstances.
examples.zh: 法庭行使裁量权时会仔细考虑所有情况。

senses.def: relating to somebody/something

examples.en: a country’s laws in regard to human rights
examples.zh: 一个国家关于人权的法律

examples.en: The company's position with regard to overtime is made clear in their contracts.
examples.zh: 公司关于加班的立场在合同中有明确说明。

examples.en: I am writing with regard to your recent order.
examples.zh: 我就您新近的订单向您致函。

senses.def: relating to what has just been mentioned

examples.en: I have nothing further to say in this regard.
examples.zh: 在这方面，我没什么要说的了。
