intro.en: These words all mean to think about somebody/​something in a particular way.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含认为、视为、看待之义。

items.def: to think of somebody/​something in a particular way:
items.zh: 指认为、视为、看待

examples.en: He seemed to regard the whole thing as a joke.
examples.zh: 他似乎是把整件事当成玩笑。

items.def: to say that somebody/​something has particular qualities or characteristics:
items.zh: 指认为…是、把…看作

examples.en: I wouldn’t call German an easy language.
examples.zh: 我并不认为德语是一门容易学的语言。

items.def: to have a particular feeling or opinion about something:
items.zh: 指认为、感到

examples.en: You may find your illness hard to accept.
examples.zh: 你可能觉得难以接受自己患病。

items.def: to think of somebody/​something in a particular way:
items.zh: 指认为、视为、看待

examples.en: Who do you consider (to be) responsible for the accident?
examples.zh: 你认为谁对这个事故负有责任？

items.def: to have an opinion of something:
items.zh: 指认为、看待

examples.en: Try to see things from her point of view.
examples.zh: 设法从她那个角度去看问题。

items.def: to think of somebody/​something in a particular way:
items.zh: 指认为、视为、看待

examples.en: How do you view your position within the company?
examples.zh: 你如何看待你自己在公司中的位置？

senses.def: paying no attention, even if the situation is bad or there are difficulties

examples.en: The weather was terrible but we carried on regardless.
examples.zh: 天气非常恶劣，但我们并不理会，照常进行。

senses.def: paying no attention to something/somebody; treating something/somebody as not being important

examples.en: The club welcomes all new members regardless of age.
examples.zh: 俱乐部对所有新成员不分年龄一律欢迎。

examples.en: He went ahead and did it, regardless of the consequences.
examples.zh: 他说干就干了，没有考虑后果。

examples.en: The amount will be paid to everyone regardless of whether they have children or not.
examples.zh: 不管有没有孩子，每个人都会得到相同的金额。

senses.def: a sporting event in which races between rowing boats
senses.zh: 赛艇会；划船比赛；帆船比赛

senses.def: a period of government by a regent
of or in the style of the period 1811–20 in the UK, when George, Prince of Wales, was regent
senses.zh: 摄政时期的，摄政时期的风格的（英国 1811–1820 年间，威尔士亲王乔治任摄政王，代替父亲管理国家）

examples.en: Regency architecture
examples.zh: 摄政时期风格的建筑

senses.def: to make an area, institution, etc. develop and grow strong again
senses.zh: 使振兴；使复兴；发展壮大

examples.en: The money will be used to regenerate the commercial heart of the town.
examples.zh: 这笔钱将用来重振市镇的商业中心。

senses.def: to grow again; to make something grow again

examples.en: Once destroyed, brain cells do not regenerate.
examples.zh: 脑细胞一旦遭到破坏，就不能再生。

examples.en: If the woodland is left alone, it will regenerate itself in a few years.
examples.zh: 如果林地不受干扰，几年后就会再生。

senses.def: the process of making an area, institution, etc. develop and grow strong again
senses.zh: 使一个地区、机构等重新发展和壮大的过程

examples.en: economic regeneration
examples.zh: 经济复兴

senses.def: the process of growing again

examples.en: the regeneration of cells in the body
examples.zh: 身体细胞的再生

senses.def: having the effect of making something develop or grow strong again

examples.en: the regenerative powers of nature
examples.zh: 大自然的再生力

senses.def: a person who rules a country because the king or queen is too young, old, ill, etc.

examples.en: to act as regent
examples.zh: 担任摄政王

senses.def: used after a noun such as prince

examples.en: the Prince Regent
examples.zh: 摄政王

senses.def: a park in central London, designed by John Nash
senses.zh: 摄政公园（Regent's Park）：位于伦敦市中心的公园，由约翰·纳什（John Nash）为摄政王设计，于1828年完工。它包含一个室外剧院，花园，运动场和一个大湖，伦敦动物园位于北侧。公园周围是摄政风格的几座宏伟建筑，被称为梯田。

senses.def: a main street in central London, designed in 1813-23 by John Nash
senses.zh: 摄政街（Regent Street）：伦敦市中心的主要街道，由约翰·纳什（John Nash）于1813-23年设计，并以摄政王亲王的名字命名。它与牛津广场（Oxford Circus）和皮卡迪利广场（Piccadilly Circus）并存，其中包括几家著名的商店，包括Liberty和Hamley，以及诸如CaféRoyal的餐馆。

senses.def: a type of popular music with strong rhythms, developed in Jamaica in the 1960s
senses.zh: 雷鬼乐（20 世纪 60 年代于牙买加兴起的一种节奏强劲的流行音乐）

senses.def: a type of dance music, developed in Puerto Rico in the 1980s, which is a mixture of reggae
senses.zh: 雷鬼顿（混合雷鬼乐、萨尔萨舞曲和嘻哈或说唱乐的一种舞曲，20 世纪 80 年代兴起于波多黎各，常包含西班牙语唱词或说唱）

senses.def: a registration
the crime of killing a king or queen; a person who is guilty of this crime
a method or system of government, especially one that has not been elected in a fair way
senses.zh: （尤指未通过公正选举的）统治方式，统治制度，政权，政体

examples.en: a fascist/totalitarian/military, etc. regime
examples.zh: 法西斯、极权主义、军事等政权

examples.en: an oppressive/brutal regime
examples.zh: 压迫民众的／残暴的政权

senses.def: a method or system of organizing or managing something

examples.en: Our tax regime is one of the most favourable in Europe.
examples.zh: 我们的税收管理体制是欧洲最受欢迎的税收体制之一。

senses.def: a set of rules about food and exercise or medical treatment that you follow in order to stay healthy or to improve your health
senses.zh: 生活规则；养生之道；养生法

examples.en: a dietary regime
examples.zh: 饮食规则

senses.def: the situation when one government is replaced by another, especially using military force

examples.en: The invasion was part of an attempt to bring about regime change in the country.
examples.zh: 这次入侵是该国试图实现政权更迭的一部分。

examples.en: Thousands of people went out onto the streets, demanding a regime change.
examples.zh: 数千人走上街头，要求政权更迭。

senses.def: a set of rules about food and exercise or medical treatment that you follow in order to stay healthy or to improve your health
senses.zh: 生活规则；养生之道；养生法

examples.en: a strict regimen
examples.zh: 严格的养生法

examples.en: a daily regimen of exercise
examples.zh: 每日锻炼计划

senses.def: a large group of soldiers that is commanded by a colonel

examples.en: an armoured/a cavalry/an infantry/a tank regiment
examples.zh: 一个装甲兵团/一个骑兵团/一个步兵团/一个坦克团

examples.en: the Parachute Regiment
examples.zh: 伞兵团

examples.en: He enlisted in the Lancashire regiment.
examples.zh: 他加入了兰开夏军团。

examples.en: The regiment was/were ordered to the front.
examples.zh: 该团被命令前往前线。

senses.def: a large number of people or things
connected with a particular regiment

examples.en: a regimental flag
examples.zh: 团旗

examples.en: regimental headquarters
examples.zh: 团部

senses.def: the act of forcing strict discipline and/or organization on somebody/something

examples.en: She rebelled against the regimentation of school life.
examples.zh: 她曾反抗死板的学校生活。

senses.def: involving strict discipline and/or organization

examples.en: The school imposes a very regimented lifestyle on its students.
examples.zh: 学校将非常死板的生活方式强加给学生。

senses.def: arranged in strict groups, patterns, etc.
senses.zh: 严格规划的；排列整齐的

examples.en: regimented lines of trees
examples.zh: 排列整齐的树木

senses.def: a word meaning ‘queen’, used, for example, in the titles of legal cases which are brought by the state when there is a queen in the UK
senses.zh: 女王（英国女王在位时用于政府诉讼案案目等）

examples.en: Regina v Jones
examples.zh: 女王诉琼斯案

senses.def: the capital city of the Canadian province
senses.zh: 里贾纳（加拿大萨斯喀彻温省首府，位于加拿大中部）

senses.def: a large area of land, usually without exact limits or borders
senses.zh: （通常界线不明的）地区，区域，地方

examples.en: mountainous/coastal regions
examples.zh: 山区；沿海地区

examples.en: the northern/southern/central, etc. region
examples.zh: 北部/南部/中部等地区

examples.en: This is one of the most densely populated regions of North America.
examples.zh: 这里是北美人口最为稠密的地区之一。

examples.en: There are more than two million people living in the region.
examples.zh: 该地区居住着两百多万人。

examples.en: Many new species have been discovered in the Amazon region.
examples.zh: 亚马逊地区发现了许多新物种。

examples.en: Businesses across the region are supporting the project.
examples.zh: 该地区的企业正在支持该项目。

examples.en: The plant is found throughout the western region of the country.
examples.zh: 该植物遍布该国西部地区。

senses.def: one of the areas that a country is divided into, that has its own customs and/or its own government

examples.en: Bilbao is the largest city in the Basque region in northern Spain.
examples.zh: 毕尔巴鄂是西班牙北部巴斯克地区最大的城市。

examples.en: The country is divided into 17 autonomous regions.
examples.zh: 该国分成 17 个自治区。

senses.def: all of a country except the capital city
senses.zh: （一国除首都以外的）全部地区，所有区域

examples.en: People in the regions should not have to travel to London to fly to the United States.
examples.zh: 该地区的人们不必前往伦敦飞往美国。

senses.def: a part of the body, usually one that has a particular character or problem
senses.zh: （通常指有某种特性或问题的）身体部位

examples.en: pains in the abdominal region
examples.zh: 腹部的疼痛

senses.def: used when you are giving a number, price, etc. to show that it is not exact
senses.zh: （表示不确切的数字等）大约，差不多

examples.en: He earns somewhere in the region of €50 000.
examples.zh: 他大约赚 5 万欧元。

senses.def: used when you are giving a number, price, etc. to show that it is not exact
senses.zh: （表示不确切的数字等）大约，差不多

examples.en: He earns somewhere in the region of €50 000.
examples.zh: 他大约赚 5 万欧元。

senses.def: of or relating to a region

examples.en: services available at a local and regional level
examples.zh: 在当地和本地区可提供的服务

examples.en: the conflict between regional and national interests
examples.zh: 地方利益和国家利益的冲突

examples.en: a regional assembly/council/government
examples.zh: 地方议会／理事会／政府

examples.en: a regional director/manager
examples.zh: 区域总监/经理

examples.en: national initiatives for regional development
examples.zh: 国家区域发展倡议

examples.en: a regional office/centre/agency
examples.zh: 区域办事处/中心/机构

senses.def: one of the elected members of the Scottish Parliament
senses.zh: 大区议员苏格兰议会中代表各大区的当选议员。此外还有代表各选区的议员。选举时，投票人投给一名选区议员和一名大区议员。所有议员在议会中地位平等。

senses.def: a feature of a language that exists in a particular part of a country, and is not part of the standard language
the desire of the people who live in a particular region of a country to have more independent control in political and economic decisions
senses.zh: 地方分权主义；地域主义

examples.en: Regionalism is on the rise in Europe.
examples.zh: 欧洲地区主义正在兴起。

examples.en: the cause of English regionalism
examples.zh: 英国地方主义的根源

senses.def: in a way that is connected with a region

examples.en: regionally based television companies
examples.zh: 地方性的电视公司

senses.def: to record your/somebody’s/something’s name on an official list

examples.en: You can also register online.
examples.zh: 你也可以在线注册。

examples.en: to register a birth/marriage/death
examples.zh: 登记出生／结婚／死亡

examples.en: to register a company/trademark
examples.zh: 注册公司／商标

examples.en: The site has 114 million registered users.
examples.zh: 该网站拥有 1.14 亿注册用户。

examples.en: a registered charity
examples.zh: 注册慈善机构

examples.en: We expect about 50 per cent of registered voters to vote in the election.
examples.zh: 我们预计大约 50% 的登记选民将在选举中投票。

examples.en: The police has registered a case against the company.
examples.zh: 警方已对该公司立案。

examples.en: The regulations require doctors and patients to register in a database.
examples.zh: 该法规要求医生和患者在数据库中注册。

examples.en: The ship was registered in Panama.
examples.zh: 这艘船是在巴拿马注册的。

examples.en: Six other families were also registered at the same address.
examples.zh: 另外六个家庭也登记在同一地址。

examples.en: to register at a hotel
examples.zh: 在旅馆登记

examples.en: She is officially registered disabled.
examples.zh: 她正式登记为伤残者。

examples.en: They encouraged all eligible citizens to register as voters.
examples.zh: 他们鼓励所有符合资格的公民登记为选民。

examples.en: He then registered the name as a trademark.
examples.zh: 然后他将这个名字注册为商标。

examples.en: to register with a doctor/dentist
examples.zh: 向医生／牙医登记

examples.en: All childminders should be registered with the local authority.
examples.zh: 所有保姆都应在地方当局注册。

examples.en: About 700 people registered for the conference.
examples.zh: 大约 700 人报名参加这次会议。

examples.en: The drug has not been registered for use in Australia.
examples.zh: 该药物尚未在澳大利亚注册使用。

examples.en: More than 5 000 people registered to take part in the contest.
examples.zh: 超过 5 000 人报名参加比赛。

examples.en: 78 per cent reported that they were registered to vote.
examples.zh: 78% 的人表示他们已登记投票。

senses.group: put name on list 登记姓名

senses.def: to make your opinion known officially or publicly
senses.zh: （正式地或公开地）发表意见，提出主张

examples.en: Many saw the vote as a way to register a protest.
examples.zh: 许多人将投票视为表达抗议的一种方式。

senses.group: give opinion publicly 公开发表意见

senses.def: if a measuring instrument registers

examples.en: The thermometer registered 32°C.
examples.zh: 温度计显示读数为 32 摄氏度。

examples.en: The earthquake registered 3 on the Richter scale.
examples.zh: 地震震级为里氏 3 级。

examples.en: The stock exchange has registered huge losses this week.
examples.zh: 本周证券交易遭到重创。

senses.group: on measuring instrument 测量仪器

senses.def: to show or express a feeling

examples.en: Her face registered disapproval.
examples.zh: 她脸上流露出不赞同的神色。

examples.en: Shock registered on everyone's face.
examples.zh: 人人都面露震惊之色。

senses.def: to notice something and remember it; to be noticed

examples.en: He barely registered our presence.
examples.zh: 他几乎没有注意到我们在场。

examples.en: I told her my name, but it obviously didn't register.
examples.zh: 我把名字告诉了她，但她显然没有在意。

examples.en: He vaguely registered that the women had gone.
examples.zh: 他模糊地记得那几名妇人已经走了。

examples.en: Slowly, my mind began to register where I was: in the hospital.
examples.zh: 慢慢地，我开始注意到我待的地方竟是一家医院。

senses.def: to send something by mail, paying extra money to protect it against loss or damage

examples.en: Can I register this, please?
examples.zh: 请给我把这个挂号邮寄。

examples.en: a registered letter
examples.zh: 挂号信

senses.def: an official list or record of names, items, etc.; a book that contains such a list

examples.en: The bride and groom signed the register.
examples.zh: 新娘和新郎在登记册上签名。

examples.en: Could you sign the hotel register please, sir?
examples.zh: 先生，请在旅馆登记簿上签字好吗？

examples.en: They keep a register of all those who have contributed to the fund.
examples.zh: 他们为所有向基金捐款的人做登记。

examples.en: to be on the register of electors
examples.zh: 登记在选民名册上

examples.en: an entry in a register
examples.zh: 登记簿的项目

examples.en: Income information will also appear in the register.
examples.zh: 收入信息也将出现在登记册中。

examples.en: The teacher took the register (= checked who was present at school).
examples.zh: 老师点了名（检查是否到课）。

examples.en: Dr Shaw was struck off the medical register for misconduct.
examples.zh: 肖医生因行为不端被从医生名册上除名。

senses.def: the range, or part of a range, of a human voice or a musical instrument

examples.en: in the upper/middle/lower register
examples.zh: 在高／中／低声区

senses.def: the level and style of a piece of writing or speech, that is usually appropriate to the situation that it is used in
senses.zh: （适合特定场合使用的）语体风格；语域

examples.en: The essay suddenly switches from a formal to an informal register.
examples.zh: 这篇文章的语体风格突然从正式转为非正式。

examples.en: He has adopted an informal register so as not to alienate his audience.
examples.zh: 他采用了非正式的讲话形式以拉近和观众的距离。

senses.def: an opening, with a cover that you can have open or shut, that allows hot or cold air from a heating or cooling system into a room
senses.zh: （供暖或制冷设备的）调风口，节气门，百叶型风口
senses.group: for hot/cold air 冷／热空气

senses.def: a machine used in shops, restaurants, etc. for keeping money in, and that shows and records the amount of money received for each thing that is sold
senses.zh: 现金收入记录机；现金出纳机

senses.def: the official way of referring to a registry office

examples.en: The Leas married in a register office.
examples.zh: 利夫妇是在户籍登记处登记结婚的。

senses.def: a method of sending a letter or package in which the person sending it can claim money if it arrives late or is lost or damaged
a nurse who has a degree in nursing
a nurse who has an official qualification
senses.zh: （获得正式资格的）注册护士；合格的护士

senses.def: the sign or name of a product, etc. that is officially recorded and protected so that nobody else can use it
a person whose job is to keep official records, especially of births, marriages and deaths
the senior officer who organizes the affairs of a college or university
senses.zh: （大学的）教务长，教务主任，注册主任

senses.def: a doctor working in a British hospital who is training to become a specialist in a particular area of medicine

examples.en: a paediatric registrar
examples.zh: 儿科住院医生

senses.def: the act of making an official record of something/somebody

examples.en: the registration of letters and parcels
examples.zh: 信件和包裹的挂号

examples.en: the registration of students for a course
examples.zh: 学生的选课登记

examples.en: registration fees
examples.zh: 注册费

examples.en: the registration of a child’s birth
examples.zh: 婴儿出生登记

senses.def: a document showing that an official record has been made of something

examples.en: my Democratic party registration
examples.zh: 我加入民主党的登记

examples.en: the information on the registration roll
examples.zh: 注册名单上的信息

examples.en: I traced my family history using the civil registration records.
examples.zh: 我根据公民注册记录追溯到了我的家族史。

senses.def: the series of letters and numbers that are shown on a number plate
senses.zh: 车辆的登记号码；牌照号码

examples.en: The police are looking for a black car with German registration plates.
examples.zh: 警方正在寻找一辆挂着德国牌照的黑色轿车。

senses.def: the time when a teacher looks at the list of students on the class register and checks that the students are present
the series of letters and numbers that are shown on a number plate
senses.zh: 车辆的登记号码；牌照号码

examples.en: I gave the registration number of the car to the police.
examples.zh: 我把该车的车牌号告诉了警察。

senses.def: a metal or plastic plate on the front and back of a vehicle that shows its registration number

examples.en: She could just about read the registration plate of the car speeding away from the accident.
examples.zh: 她几乎能看清那辆从事故现场飞驰而去的汽车的车牌。

senses.def: a place where registers are kept; an official list or register

examples.en: The registry holds records of all major operations.
examples.zh: 登记处有所有重大手术的记录。

examples.en: a central registry for all applicants
examples.zh: 申请者的主登记处

senses.def: (in the UK) a place where civil
senses.zh: 户籍登记处（在英国可举办不涉及宗教仪式的婚礼，并负责登记出生及婚丧等事项）

examples.en: to get married in/at a registry office
examples.zh: 在户籍登记处登记结婚

senses.def: a registration
to return to an earlier or less advanced form or way of behaving
the process of going back to an earlier or less advanced form or state

examples.en: He began to show signs of regression to his childhood.
examples.zh: 他开始表现出回归童年的迹象。

senses.def: becoming or making something less advanced

examples.en: The policy has been condemned as a regressive step.
examples.zh: 这项政策被认为是一种倒退而受到谴责。

senses.def: having less effect on the rich than on the poor
senses.zh: 递减的（对富人的影响比对穷人的小）

examples.en: A regressive tax structure is one in which the average tax rate falls as income level rises.
examples.zh: 累退税收结构是平均税率随着收入水平上升而下降的税收结构。

senses.def: to feel sorry about something you have done or about something that you have not been able to do

examples.en: If you don't do it now, you'll only regret it.
examples.zh: 你如果现在不做，以后一定会后悔的。

examples.en: The decision could be one he lives to regret.
examples.zh: 这一决定也许会有让他后悔的一天。

examples.en: I soon came to regret my action.
examples.zh: 我很快就对自己的行为感到后悔。

examples.en: ‘I've had a wonderful life,’ she said, ‘I don't regret a thing.’
examples.zh: “我一辈子生活得很好，”她说，“我没什么可遗憾的。”

examples.en: She regretted the words the moment they were out of her mouth.
examples.zh: 这句话一出口，她就后悔了。

examples.en: He bitterly regretted ever having mentioned it.
examples.zh: 他非常懊悔提起那件事。

examples.en: I never regretted dropping out of college.
examples.zh: 我从不后悔从大学退学。

examples.en: I deeply regret what I said.
examples.zh: 我非常后悔说了那些话。

examples.en: I regret that I never got to meet him in person.
examples.zh: 很遗憾我始终没能见到他本人。

senses.def: used to say in a polite or formal way that you are sorry or sad about a situation
senses.zh: （有礼貌地或正式地表示抱歉、痛惜或悲伤）

examples.en: The airline regrets any inconvenience.
examples.zh: 航空公司对所造成的任何不便表示歉意。

examples.en: The president said that his country deeply regretted the incident.
examples.zh: 总统称整个国家都对这一事件深表遗憾。

examples.en: The United States regrets the loss of innocent civilian lives.
examples.zh: 美国对无辜平民的丧生表示遗憾。

examples.en: I regret that I am unable to accept your kind invitation.
examples.zh: 很遗憾，我不能接受你的友好邀请。

examples.en: I very much regret that I cannot be with you this evening.
examples.zh: 我非常遗憾今晚不能和你们在一起。

examples.en: We regret to inform you that your application has not been successful.
examples.zh: 我们很遗憾地通知您，您的申请未获通过。

examples.en: I regret to say that we cannot let you have the picture.
examples.zh: 我很遗憾地告诉您，我们不能让您看到照片。

examples.en: It is to be regretted that so many young people leave school without qualifications.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是那么多年轻人肄业离校。

senses.def: a sad feeling because of something that has happened or something that you have done or not done

examples.en: a feeling/pang/twinge of regret
examples.zh: 一阵痛悔之情

examples.en: It is a matter of regret that no proper investigation was carried out at the time.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，当时没有进行适当的调查。

examples.en: What is your greatest regret (= the thing that you are most sorry about doing or not doing)?
examples.zh: 你最大的遗憾是什么？

examples.en: It is with great regret that I accept your resignation.
examples.zh: 接受你的辞呈，我感到非常遗憾。

examples.en: She expressed her regret at the decision.
examples.zh: 她对这个决定表示失望。

examples.en: She admitted her regrets at having had to give up her youthful ambitions.
examples.zh: 她承认自己对不得不放弃年轻时的抱负感到遗憾。

examples.en: I have no regrets about leaving Newcastle (= I do not feel sorry about it).
examples.zh: 我一点也不后悔离开纽卡斯尔。

examples.en: He confessed to a few regrets about his time in Parliament.
examples.zh: 他承认对自己在议会的经历有些遗憾。

examples.en: There has still been no official expression of regret for their deaths.
examples.zh: 目前官方还没有对他们的死亡表示哀悼。

examples.en: He said he felt deep regret for having been part of a government that had brutally violated human rights.
examples.zh: 他说他为自己身在一个粗暴侵犯人权的政府而深感遗憾。

examples.en: He gave up teaching in 2009, much to the regret of his students.
examples.zh: 他于 2009 年放弃了教学，这使他的学生深感遗憾。

senses.def: feeling or showing that you are sad or disappointed because of something that has happened or something that you have done or not done
senses.zh: 后悔的；失望的；令人惋惜的；遗憾的

examples.en: a regretful look
examples.zh: 失望的眼神

senses.def: in a way that shows you are sad or disappointed about something
senses.zh: 遗憾地；痛惜地；失望地；懊悔地

examples.en: ‘I'm afraid not,’ he said regretfully.
examples.zh: 他遗憾地说：“恐怕不行。”

examples.en: Emma shook her head regretfully.
examples.zh: 埃玛遗憾地摇了摇头。

senses.def: used to show that you are sorry that something is the case and you wish the situation were different

examples.en: There is, regretfully, no space in this article to examine all these issues.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，本文没有篇幅来探讨所有这些问题。

examples.en: Regretfully, mounting costs have forced the museum to close.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，成本不断增加，博物馆不得不关闭。

senses.def: that you are sorry about and wish had not happened
senses.zh: 令人惋惜的；可惜的；令人遗憾的

examples.en: It is regrettable that the police were not informed sooner.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是没有早些报警。

examples.en: The loss of jobs is highly regrettable.
examples.zh: 失去工作非常令人遗憾。

examples.en: a regrettable incident
examples.zh: 令人遗憾的事件

senses.def: used to describe something that you are sorry about and wish had not happened
senses.zh: 令人惋惜的；可惜的；令人遗憾的

examples.en: Regrettably, crime has been increasing in this area.
examples.zh: 令人遗憾的是该区域的犯罪活动不断增多。

examples.en: This fine restaurant has, regrettably, gone out of business.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，这家精致的餐厅已经倒闭了。

examples.en: There is regrettably little evidence to support this argument.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，几乎没有证据支持这一论点。

senses.def: to arrange the way people or soldiers work together in a new way, especially in order to continue fighting or attacking somebody

examples.en: They regrouped their forces and renewed the attack.
examples.zh: 他们重新聚集兵力，再次发动进攻。

examples.en: After its election defeat, the party needs to regroup.
examples.zh: 选举失败后，这个党需要改组。

examples.en: The cavalry regrouped and attacked again.
examples.zh: 骑兵重新集结，再次进攻。

examples.en: They are now regrouping for another attempt.
examples.zh: 他们现在正在重新集结，准备进行另一次尝试。

senses.def: to return to a normal state after an unpleasant experience or a period of difficulty, and become ready to make an effort again with new enthusiasm or strength

examples.en: Summer is a time to relax, regroup and catch up on all those things you've been putting off all year.
examples.zh: 夏天是休养整顿、处理一年中积压事务的时候。

senses.def: following a pattern, especially with the same time or space in between each thing and the next
senses.zh: 规则的；有规律的；间隙均匀的；定时的

examples.en: regular breathing
examples.zh: 均匀的呼吸

examples.en: a regular pulse/heartbeat
examples.zh: 正常的脉搏／心跳

examples.en: A light flashed at regular intervals.
examples.zh: 一盏灯有规律地闪着亮光。

examples.en: There is a regular bus service to the airport.
examples.zh: 有公共汽车定时开往机场。

examples.en: regular meetings/visits
examples.zh: 定期会议／访问

examples.en: We also hold a regular monthly meeting.
examples.zh: 我们还每月定期举行会议。

examples.en: The equipment is checked on a regular basis.
examples.zh: 设备定期进行检查。

examples.en: She writes a regular column for a national newspaper.
examples.zh: 她为一家全国性报纸定期写专栏。

examples.en: a regular geometric pattern
examples.zh: 正几何图形

senses.def: done or happening often
senses.zh: 频繁的；经常做（或发生）的

examples.en: Do you take regular exercise?
examples.zh: 你经常锻炼吗？

examples.en: I'm still in regular contact with friends I met at university.
examples.zh: 我和我在大学认识的朋友仍然经常联系。

examples.en: Domestic violence is a regular occurrence in some families.
examples.zh: 在某些家庭中，家庭暴力是常事。

examples.en: a painter whose work is a regular feature of the Summer Exhibition
examples.zh: 在夏季展览上经常展出作品的一位画家

examples.en: The key to good anti-virus software is regular updates.
examples.zh: 好的防病毒软件的关键是定期更新。

senses.def: doing the same thing or going to the same place often
senses.zh: 经常做某事的；常去某地的

examples.en: regular readers/customers/users
examples.zh: 热心读者；老客户；老用户

examples.en: She is a regular contributor to many journals and magazines
examples.zh: 她是许多期刊和杂志的固定撰稿人。

examples.en: regular offenders (= against the law)
examples.zh: 惯犯

examples.en: He was a regular visitor to her house.
examples.zh: 他是她家的常客。

senses.def: changing their form in the same way as most other verbs and nouns

examples.en: The past participle of regular verbs ends in ‘-ed’.
examples.zh: 规则动词的过去分词以 -ed 结尾。

senses.def: usual

examples.en: I couldn't see my regular doctor today.
examples.zh: 我今天找不到平常给我看病的医生。

examples.en: On Monday he would have to return to his regular duties.
examples.zh: 星期一，他就得回去正常上班了。

examples.en: It's important to follow the regular procedure.
examples.zh: 按照惯常的程序行事是很重要的。

examples.en: He was mistaken for one of the regular crew.
examples.zh: 他被误认为是一名普通船员。

examples.en: the last match of the regular season
examples.zh: 常规赛季的最后一场比赛

senses.def: of a standard size
senses.zh: 标准尺寸的；中等大小的；中号的

examples.en: Regular or large fries?
examples.zh: 中号的还是大号的炸薯条？

senses.def: ordinary; without any special or extra features

examples.en: Do you want regular or diet cola?
examples.zh: 你要普通的还是低热量的可乐？

examples.en: I just want to buy a regular white shirt—nothing fancy.
examples.zh: 我只想买一件普通的白衬衫——没什么花哨的。

examples.en: He's just a regular guy who loves his dog.
examples.zh: 他也不过是个十分疼爱自己狗儿的平凡人。

senses.def: having an even shape

examples.en: a face with regular features
examples.zh: 五官端正的脸庞

examples.en: He flashed a smile, showing two rows of white, regular teeth.
examples.zh: 他露出一抹笑容，露出两排洁白整齐的牙齿。

examples.en: Her face was perfectly regular.
examples.zh: 她的面貌极其端正。

senses.def: lasting or happening over a long period

examples.en: The need to earn a regular income restricted the time he could spend pursuing his real interests.
examples.zh: 赚取固定收入的需要限制了他追求真正兴趣的时间。

examples.en: She couldn't find any regular employment.
examples.zh: 她找不到任何固定工作。

senses.def: belonging to or connected with the permanent armed forces or police force of a country

examples.en: the regular army
examples.zh: 正规军

examples.en: regular soldiers
examples.zh: 正规军士兵

senses.def: used for emphasis to show that somebody/something is an exact or clear example of the thing mentioned

examples.en: The whole thing was a regular disaster.
examples.zh: 整个事情完全是一场灾难。

senses.def: very regularly; happening at the same time in the same way

examples.en: He is home by six every day, regular as clockwork.
examples.zh: 他每天 6 点前必定准时回到家。

senses.def: a customer who often goes to a particular shop, pub, restaurant, etc.

examples.en: He's one of our regulars.
examples.zh: 他是我们的一位老主顾。

senses.def: a person who often plays in a particular team, takes part in a particular television show, etc.
senses.zh: 主力（或正式）队员；（电视节目的）常任主持人；经常参加某项活动的人

examples.en: We are missing six first-team regulars because of injury.
examples.zh: 我们有六位一线主力队员因伤不能出场。

senses.def: a professional soldier who belongs to a country’s permanent army
very regularly; happening at the same time in the same way

examples.en: He is home by six every day, regular as clockwork.
examples.zh: 他每天 6 点前必定准时回到家。

senses.def: the fact that the same thing happens again and again, and usually with the same length of time between each time it happens

examples.en: Aircraft passed overhead with monotonous regularity.
examples.zh: 飞机一次又一次反复从头顶飞过。

senses.def: the fact that something is arranged in an even way or in an organized pattern
senses.zh: 匀称；端正；有规则的分布

examples.en: the striking regularity of her features
examples.zh: 她的五官非常端正

examples.en: Is there any regularity in English word stress?
examples.zh: 英语单词的重音有什么规律吗？

senses.def: a thing that has a pattern to it
senses.zh: 有规则的东西；有规律的事物

examples.en: They had observed regularities in the behaviour of the animals.
examples.zh: 他们曾观察过这些动物的习性。

examples.en: the patterns and regularities of social life
examples.zh: 社会生活的模式和规律

senses.def: to make a situation that already exists legal or official

examples.en: Undocumented workers got the opportunity to regularize their immigration status.
examples.zh: 无证工人有机会合法化其移民身份。

senses.def: at regular intervals

examples.en: We meet regularly to discuss the progress of the project.
examples.zh: 我们定期会面，讨论工程进展情况。

examples.en: the introduction of direct, regularly scheduled flights to Beijing
examples.zh: 开通直飞北京的定期航班

examples.en: The water in the fish tank should be changed regularly.
examples.zh: 鱼缸里的水要定期更换。

senses.def: often

examples.en: I go there quite regularly.
examples.zh: 我经常去那儿。

examples.en: He admitted that he regularly used drugs.
examples.zh: 他承认他经常吸毒。

examples.en: The couple regularly attended Mass.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇经常参加弥撒。

examples.en: As Home Secretary he had regularly visited Belfast.
examples.zh: 作为内政大臣，他经常访问贝尔法斯特。

examples.en: She appeared regularly at the Metropolitan Opera.
examples.zh: 她经常在大都会歌剧院亮相。

senses.def: in an even or balanced way

examples.en: The plants were spaced regularly, about 50 cm apart.
examples.zh: 这些植株分布均匀，间距大约为 50 厘米。

senses.def: to control something by means of rules

examples.en: The department is responsible for regulating the insurance industry.
examples.zh: 该部门负责监管保险业。

examples.en: The activities of credit companies are regulated by law.
examples.zh: 信贷公司的业务受法律的制约。

examples.en: The government accepts whaling in principle as long as it is carefully regulated.
examples.zh: 只要受到严格监管，政府原则上接受捕鲸。

examples.en: It is up to the regulating authority to put the measures into effect.
examples.zh: 应该由管理部门落实这些措施。

senses.def: to control the speed, pressure, temperature, etc. in a machine or system
senses.zh: 调节，控制（速度、压力、温度等）

examples.en: This valve regulates the flow of water.
examples.zh: 这个阀门调节水流。

senses.def: an official rule made by a government or some other authority
senses.zh: 章程；规章制度；规则；法规

examples.en: too many rules and regulations
examples.zh: 过多的规章制度

examples.en: fire/building regulations
examples.zh: 消防/建筑法规

examples.en: the strict regulations governing the sale of weapons
examples.zh: 关于武器销售的严格规定

examples.en: To comply with government hygiene regulations, there must be a separate sink for hand washing.
examples.zh: 按照政府的卫生管理条例，必须专门配备一个洗手池。

examples.en: It's against safety regulations to fix these doors open.
examples.zh: 这些门一直开着是违反安全规定的。

examples.en: Under the new regulations spending on office equipment will be strictly controlled.
examples.zh: 根据新的规定，办公设备开支将受到严格控制。

senses.def: controlling something by means of rules

examples.en: the voluntary regulation of the press
examples.zh: 新闻出版业的自律

senses.def: that must be worn or used according to the official rules
senses.zh: 规定的；必须穿戴的；必须使用的

examples.en: in regulation uniform
examples.zh: 穿着规定的制服

examples.en: She was wearing the regulation school uniform.
examples.zh: 她穿着规定的校服。

senses.def: a person or an organization that officially controls an area of business or industry and makes sure that it is operating fairly
senses.zh: （某行业等的）监管者，监管机构

examples.en: Ofgas, the gas industry regulator
examples.zh: 天然气监管办公室，天然气行业的监管机构

examples.en: banking regulators
examples.zh: 银行监管机构

senses.def: a device that controls something such as speed, temperature or pressure
senses.zh: （速度、温度、压力的）自动调节器

examples.en: a pressure regulator
examples.zh: 压力调节器

senses.def: having the power to control an area of business or industry and make sure that it is operating fairly
senses.zh: （对工商业）具有监管权的，监管的

examples.en: regulatory bodies/authorities/agencies
examples.zh: 监管部门／机构

examples.en: regulatory procedures
examples.zh: 监管程序

senses.def: to bring food that has been swallowed
senses.zh: 使（咽下的食物）返回到口中；反刍

examples.en: The bird regurgitates half-digested fish to feed its young.
examples.zh: 鸟类把半消化的鱼吐出来喂自己的雏鸟。

senses.def: to repeat something you have heard or read without really thinking about it or understanding it
the act of bringing food that has been swallowed
senses.zh: 使（咽下的食物）返回到口中；反刍

examples.en: If regurgitation becomes severe, surgery might be required.
examples.zh: 如果反流变得严重，可能需要手术。

senses.def: the act of repeating something without really thinking about it or understanding it

examples.en: The book was described as a regurgitation of old ideas.
examples.zh: 这本书被描述为旧思想的反省。

senses.def: the process of treating somebody who has a problem with drugs or alcohol

examples.en: to go into rehab
examples.zh: 进行康复治疗

examples.en: a rehab clinic
examples.zh: 康复诊所

senses.def: to help somebody to return to a normal, healthy life after they have been in prison or very ill
senses.zh: 使（重病患者）康复；使（长期服刑者）恢复正常生活

examples.en: We must do more to rehabilitate young offenders.
examples.zh: 我们必须采取更多措施来改造青少年罪犯。

examples.en: efforts to treat and rehabilitate drug addicts
examples.zh: 努力治疗和康复吸毒成瘾者

senses.def: to begin to consider that somebody is good or acceptable after a long period during which they were considered bad or unacceptable
senses.zh: 恢复…的名誉；给…平反昭雪

examples.en: He played a major role in rehabilitating Magritte as an artist.
examples.zh: 他对恢复玛格里特艺术家的名誉起了重要的作用。

senses.def: to return a building or an area to its previous good condition
senses.zh: 使（建筑物或地区）恢复原状；修复

examples.en: Billions of pounds are being spent on rehabilitating inner-city areas.
examples.zh: 数十亿英镑被用于重建市中心地区。

senses.def: the process of helping somebody to return to a normal, healthy life after they have been in prison or very ill
senses.zh: 恢复（正常生活）;康复;（囚犯）获得改造

examples.en: a drug rehabilitation centre
examples.zh: 戒毒康复中心

examples.en: the rehabilitation of offenders
examples.zh: 罪犯的改过自新

senses.def: the act of starting to consider that somebody is good or acceptable after a long period during which they were considered bad or unacceptable

examples.en: the rehabilitation of Magritte as an artist
examples.zh: 为艺术家玛格里特正名

senses.def: the process of returning a building, place or area of activity to its previous good condition
senses.zh: （建筑物、地区或领域的）恢复原状；修复；复兴

examples.en: the rehabilitation of the steel industry
examples.zh: 钢铁工业的复兴

senses.def: to arrange ideas, pieces of writing or pieces of film into a new form but without any great change or improvement
senses.zh: （稍微改动）重新推出；以新形式表达旧内容

examples.en: He just rehashes songs from the 60s.
examples.zh: 他只是把 60 年代的歌曲稍加改编而已。

senses.def: an arrangement of ideas, pieces of writing or pieces of film into a new form but without any great change or improvement
senses.zh: （稍微改动）重新推出；以新形式表达旧内容

examples.en: The movie is just a rehash of the best TV episodes.
examples.zh: 这部电影只是把电视剧里最精彩的几集拼凑在一起。

senses.def: to hear or consider a case again in court
time that is spent practising a play or piece of music in preparation for a public performance

examples.en: to have a rehearsal
examples.zh: 进行排练

examples.en: We only had six days of rehearsal.
examples.zh: 我们只有六天的排练时间。

examples.en: The leading man broke his leg in the middle of rehearsals.
examples.zh: 男主角在排练过程中摔断了腿。

examples.en: rehearsals for ‘Romeo and Juliet’
examples.zh: 《罗密欧与朱丽叶》的几次排练

examples.en: Our new production of ‘Hamlet’ is currently in rehearsal.
examples.zh: 我们的新版《哈姆雷特》正在排练之中。

examples.en: a rehearsal room
examples.zh: 排练房

senses.def: an experience or event that helps to prepare you for something that is going to happen in the future

examples.en: These training exercises are designed to be a rehearsal for the invasion.
examples.zh: 这些训练是为了入侵而进行的演习。

examples.en: Life is not a rehearsal.
examples.zh: 人生不是一场排练。

senses.def: the act of repeating something that has been said before

examples.en: We listened to his lengthy rehearsal of the arguments.
examples.zh: 我们听着他没完没了地重复他的论点。

senses.def: (especially in North America) a special meal after the practice for a marriage ceremony, usually held the night before the wedding
senses.zh: （尤指北美国家的）婚礼彩排晚宴

senses.def: to practise or make people practise a play, piece of music, etc. in preparation for a public performance

examples.en: We were given only two weeks to rehearse.
examples.zh: 只给了我们两个星期排练。

examples.en: We're rehearsing for the show.
examples.zh: 我们正在为演出进行排练。

examples.en: Today, we'll just be rehearsing the final scene.
examples.zh: 今天，我们只排演最后一幕。

examples.en: The actors were poorly rehearsed.
examples.zh: 演员排练得不够。

senses.def: to prepare in your mind or practise privately what you are going to do or say to somebody

examples.en: She walked along rehearsing her excuse for being late.
examples.zh: 她一边走一边默诵着她迟到的托辞。

examples.en: He had his speech well rehearsed.
examples.zh: 他反复练习演讲稿。

examples.en: She mentally rehearsed what she would say to Jeff.
examples.zh: 她在心里预演了一遍她要对杰夫说的话。

senses.def: to repeat ideas or opinions that have often been expressed before
to heat cooked food again after it has been left to go cold

examples.en: It’s even better if you cook it the day before and then reheat it.
examples.zh: 如果你前一天煮熟然后重新加热就更好了。

examples.en: Reheat the sauce carefully without boiling it.
examples.zh: 重新给酱汁加热，但小心不要煮沸了。

senses.def: a wine bottle which holds six times as much wine as an ordinary bottle
senses.zh: 一个葡萄酒瓶，其容纳的葡萄酒是普通瓶子的六倍，相比于jeroboam，methuselah，nebuchadnezzar

senses.def: to find a new owner for a pet, especially a dog or cat, usually after caring for it for a time

examples.en: The organization rescues stray dogs and rehomes them.
examples.zh: 这个组织救助流浪狗，并给它们找新主人。

examples.en: We had to rehome the cat.
examples.zh: 我们不得不给猫重新安家。

senses.def: to provide somebody with a different home to live in

examples.en: Thousands of earthquake victims are still waiting to be rehoused.
examples.zh: 数千名地震灾民仍在等待安排新住处。

senses.def: to drink liquids after exercising or when it is very hot

examples.en: It's going to be extremely hot so make sure that you rehydrate regularly during the game.
examples.zh: 天气会非常热，因此请确保在比赛期间定期补充水分。

senses.def: the period during which a king, queen, emperor

examples.en: By the end of his reign, the vast empire was in decline.
examples.zh: 在他统治末期，庞大的帝国走向衰落。

examples.en: The house was built during the reign of Henry VIII.
examples.zh: 这所住宅是亨利八世统治时期建造的。

senses.def: the period during which somebody is in charge of an organization, a team, etc.

examples.en: Sir Alex Ferguson's reign at Manchester United
examples.zh: 弗格森爵士在曼联的统治

examples.en: The story only came out during the final days of his reign as Chief Executive.
examples.zh: 这个故事直到他担任行政长官的最后几天才被曝光。

senses.def: to rule as king, queen, emperor

examples.en: It was the first visit by a British reigning monarch to Russia.
examples.zh: 这是英国君主首次访问俄罗斯。

examples.en: Queen Victoria reigned from 1837 to 1901.
examples.zh: 维多利亚女王自 1837 年至 1901 年在位。

examples.en: Herod reigned over Palestine at that time.
examples.zh: 那时，希律王统治巴勒斯坦。

senses.def: to be the best or most important in a particular situation or area of skill
senses.zh: 成为最佳；成为最重要的

examples.en: She will face the reigning champion in her first round match.
examples.zh: 在第一轮比赛中，她将面对上届的冠军。

examples.en: In the field of classical music, he still reigns supreme.
examples.zh: 在古典音乐领域，他仍然是最为杰出的。

senses.def: to be the most obvious feature of a place or moment

examples.en: At last silence reigned (= there was complete silence).
examples.zh: 最后，万籁俱寂。

examples.en: For a while, chaos and confusion reigned.
examples.zh: 一时之间，一片混乱和混乱。

senses.def: a period during which there is a lot of violence and many people are killed by the political leader or people in power

examples.en: His 12-year reign of terror left thousands dead.
examples.zh: 他12年的恐怖统治造成数千人死亡。

senses.def: to start burning again; to make something start burning again

examples.en: The oven burners reignite automatically if blown out.
examples.zh: 烤炉的火如果吹灭了会自动再点燃。

examples.en: You may need to reignite the pilot light.
examples.zh: 你得重新点燃长明火。

examples.en: Their passion was reignited by a romantic trip to Venice.
examples.zh: 去威尼斯的浪漫之旅重新燃起了他们的激情。

senses.def: a method of making sick people well again based on the idea that energy can be directed into a person’s body by touch
senses.zh: 灵气疗愈（通过触摸向病人体内输送能量的治疗方法）

senses.def: to pay back money to somebody which they have spent or lost

examples.en: We will reimburse any expenses incurred.
examples.zh: 我们将付还所有相关费用。

examples.en: You will be reimbursed for any loss or damage caused by our company.
examples.zh: 如我公司给您造成损失或有所损坏，您都将得到赔偿。

senses.def: the act of paying back money to somebody which they have spent or lost; the amount that is paid back

examples.en: You will receive reimbursement for any additional costs incurred.
examples.zh: 您将获得任何额外费用的报销。

senses.def: a long narrow leather band that is attached to a metal bar in a horse’s mouth (= a bit

examples.en: She pulled gently on the reins.
examples.zh: 她轻轻地拉着缰绳。

senses.def: a pair of long narrow pieces of cloth or other material worn by a small child and held by an adult in order to stop the child from walking off and getting lost
senses.zh: （把儿童和成人的手系在一起以防走失的）牵引绳，防走失带

senses.def: the state of being in control or the leader of something

examples.en: It was time to hand over the reins of power (= to give control to somebody else).
examples.zh: 是该让权的时候了。

examples.en: The vice-president was forced to take up the reins of office.
examples.zh: 副总统被迫走马上任。

senses.def: to give somebody complete freedom of action; to allow a feeling to be expressed freely
senses.zh: 对…不加约束；放任自由；充分表达（感情）

examples.en: The designer was given free rein.
examples.zh: 设计者可以自由发挥。

examples.en: The script allows full rein to her larger-than-life acting style.
examples.zh: 剧本允许她充分展现她那夸张的表演风格。

examples.en: When I paint I just give my imagination free rein.
examples.zh: 画画时我只是任凭想象自由驰骋。

senses.def: to control somebody/something carefully or strictly
senses.zh: 对…严加控制（或约束）；牢牢驾驭

examples.en: It’s essential to keep a tight rein on public spending.
examples.zh: 严格控制公共支出至关重要。

examples.zh: 我们需要严格控制公共开销。

examples.zh: 她尽量克制着自己的感情。

to be born again in another body after you have died; to make somebody be born again in this way

examples.en: They believe humans are reincarnated in animal form.
examples.zh: 他们相信人死后转生为动物。

examples.en: They believe humans are reincarnated as animals.
examples.zh: 他们相信人类转世为动物。

examples.en: They were afraid she would reincarnate as a vampire.
examples.zh: 他们害怕她会转世化身成吸血鬼。

senses.def: the belief that after somebody’s death their soul lives again in a new body

examples.en: Do you believe in reincarnation?
examples.zh: 你相信轮回转世说吗?

senses.def: a person or an animal whose body contains the soul of a dead person

examples.en: He thinks he’s the reincarnation of Attila the Hun.
examples.zh: 他认为自己是匈奴王阿提拉的转世。

senses.def: a large deer

examples.en: herds of reindeer
examples.zh: 驯鹿群

senses.def: to make a feeling, an idea, etc. stronger

examples.en: The experience reinforced my sense of loss.
examples.zh: 这次经历让我感到更加失落。

examples.en: Such jokes tend to reinforce gender stereotypes.
examples.zh: 此类笑话往往会强化性别刻板印象。

examples.en: The climate of political confusion has only reinforced the country's economic decline.
examples.zh: 政局混乱只是加速了国家经济的衰退。

examples.en: Success in the talks will reinforce his reputation as an international statesman.
examples.zh: 谈判成功将会增强他作为国际政治家的声望。

senses.def: to make a structure or material stronger, especially by adding another material to it

examples.en: All buildings are now reinforced to withstand earthquakes.
examples.zh: 所有建筑现都已加固，以抗地震。

examples.en: reinforced plastic/steel/concrete
examples.zh: 增强塑料／钢材；钢筋混凝土

examples.en: The door was built of oak, heavily reinforced with iron.
examples.zh: 这道门用橡木制成，用铁牢牢加固。

senses.def: to send more people or equipment in order to make an army, etc. stronger
senses.zh: 给…加强力量（或装备）；使更强大

examples.en: The UN has undertaken to reinforce its military presence along the borders.
examples.zh: 联合国已经着手增强边境驻军。

senses.def: concrete
extra soldiers or police officers who are sent to a place because more are needed

examples.en: to send in reinforcements
examples.zh: 派出增援部队

senses.def: the act of making something stronger, especially a feeling or an idea
senses.zh: （感情或思想等的）巩固，加强，强化

examples.en: the reinforcement of existing prejudices by the media
examples.zh: 媒体强化现有偏见

senses.def: to give back a job or position that had been taken away from somebody
senses.zh: 使恢复原职；使重返岗位

examples.en: He was reinstated in his post.
examples.zh: 他重新回到了自己的岗位。

senses.def: to return something to its previous position or status
senses.zh: 把…放回原处；使恢复原状

examples.en: There have been repeated calls to reinstate the death penalty.
examples.zh: 不断有人呼吁恢复死刑。

examples.en: Tennis has now been reinstated as an Olympic sport.
examples.zh: 网球现已恢复为奥运会比赛项目。

senses.def: the act of giving somebody back a job or position that had been taken away from them
senses.zh: 使恢复原职；使重返岗位

examples.en: They are demanding the immediate reinstatement of seven of their colleagues.
examples.zh: 他们要求立即恢复七名同事的职务。

senses.def: the act of returning something to its previous position or status
senses.zh: 把…放回原处；使恢复原状

examples.en: the reinstatement of tennis as an Olympic sport
examples.zh: 恢复网球作为奥林匹克运动项目

senses.def: the practice of one insurance company buying insurance from another company against any losses that result from claims that are made against it
senses.zh: 再保险，分保保险（指一保险公司向其他公司购买保险以减少索赔损失）

senses.def: to interpret something in a new or different way

examples.en: This new production radically reinterprets the play.
examples.zh: 这部新作品从根本上重新诠释了该剧。

senses.def: the act of interpreting something in a new or different way

examples.en: a radical reinterpretation of the existing text by the Supreme Court
examples.zh: 最高法院对现有文本的彻底重新解释

examples.en: his reinterpretation of Hamlet
examples.zh: 他对哈姆雷特的重新诠释

senses.def: to start to use something again

examples.en: to reintroduce the death penalty
examples.zh: 恢复死刑

examples.en: plans to reintroduce trams to the city
examples.zh: 市内重新启用有轨电车的计划

senses.def: to put a type of animal, bird or plant back into a region where it once lived

examples.en: The centre has a fifty per cent success rate of reintroducing animals to the wild.
examples.zh: 该中心野外放生的成功率为 50%。

senses.def: the act of bringing something into use or existence again

examples.en: They have deferred the reintroduction of the ferry service.
examples.zh: 他们推迟了轮渡服务的重新开放。

examples.en: the reintroduction of trams in the city
examples.zh: 城市中重新引入有轨电车

senses.def: the act of putting a type of animal, bird or plant back into a region where it once lived

examples.en: the reintroduction of wolves to Scotland
examples.zh: 将狼重新引入苏格兰

examples.en: In the case of tigers, plans for reintroduction into Asian countries at some future time may be unrealistic.
examples.zh: 就老虎而言，未来某个时候将老虎重新引入亚洲国家的计划可能不切实际。

examples.en: Reintroductions began in 2012 with the release of birds bred in captivity.
examples.zh: 人工繁育鸟类放归工作始于2012年。

senses.def: to present yourself/something in a new form or with a new image
senses.zh: 以新形象示人；以新形式出现

examples.en: The former wild man of rock has reinvented himself as a respectable family man.
examples.zh: 过去的那位摇滚狂人已经改变形象，成了一位体面的爱家的男人。

senses.def: to waste time creating something that already exists and works well
senses.zh: 重复发明；无谓地重复；浪费时间做无用功

examples.en: There’s no point in us reinventing the wheel.
examples.zh: 我们没有必要重新发明轮子。

senses.def: to waste time creating something that already exists and works well
senses.zh: 重复发明；无谓地重复；浪费时间做无用功

examples.en: There’s no point in us reinventing the wheel.
examples.zh: 我们没有必要重新发明轮子。

senses.def: to waste time creating something that already exists and works well
senses.zh: 重复发明；无谓地重复；浪费时间做无用功

examples.en: There’s no point in us reinventing the wheel.
examples.zh: 我们没有必要重新发明轮子。

senses.def: to put profits that have been made on an investment back into the same investment or into a new one
senses.zh: 再投资；把（利润）用于再投资

senses.def: the act of putting profits that have been made on an investment back into the same investment or into a new one; the amount of money that is put back
senses.zh: 再投资；把（利润）用于再投资

examples.en: a proposal to raise £1.3 billion for reinvestment in all forms of transport in London
examples.zh: 提议筹集 13 亿英镑用于伦敦所有交通形式的再投资

senses.def: to give new energy or strength to something/somebody
senses.zh: 给…增添精力（或力量）；使再振作

examples.en: We need to reinvigorate the economy of the area.
examples.zh: 我们需要给这个地区的经济注入新的活力。

examples.en: I felt reinvigorated after a rest and a shower.
examples.zh: 我休息了一会儿，冲了个淋浴，感到精神焕发。

senses.def: to publish or produce again a book, record, etc. that has not been available for some time

examples.en: The novel was reissued in paperback.
examples.zh: 这本小说重新发行了平装本。

examples.en: old jazz recordings reissued as digital downloads
examples.zh: 数字化后重新发布、可供下载的旧爵士乐录音

senses.def: an old book or record that has been published or produced again after not being available for some time
senses.zh: 再版书；重新发行的唱片（或其他录制品）

senses.def: to repeat something that you have already said, especially to emphasize it

examples.en: to reiterate an argument/a demand/an offer
examples.zh: 重申论点；重复一项要求／建议

examples.en: The government has reiterated its commitment to economic reform.
examples.zh: 政府已重申改革经济的决心。

examples.en: Let me reiterate that we are fully committed to this policy.
examples.zh: 我再说一遍，我们对这项政策是全力以赴、坚定不移的。

examples.en: ‘I said “money”,’ he reiterated.
examples.zh: “我说的是‘钱’。”他重申道。

senses.def: the act of repeating something that you have already said, especially to emphasize it

examples.en: a reiteration of her previous statement
examples.zh: 重申她先前说过的话

senses.def: to refuse to accept or consider something

examples.en: to reject an argument/a hypothesis/a notion/a plan
examples.zh: 拒绝接受论点／假设／概念／计划

examples.en: to reject a claim/an offer/a request/an application
examples.zh: 拒绝索赔／提议／请求／申请

examples.en: The bank has the option of accepting or rejecting this offer.
examples.zh: 银行可以选择接受或拒绝此要约。

examples.en: The prime minister rejected any idea of reforming the system.
examples.zh: 首相对任何改革体制的想法都不予考虑。

examples.en: The proposal was firmly rejected.
examples.zh: 这项提议被断然否决。

examples.en: School officials flatly rejected the proposal.
examples.zh: 学校官员断然拒绝了这一提议。

examples.en: All our suggestions were rejected out of hand.
examples.zh: 我们所有的建议都被一口拒绝了。

examples.en: The Government rejected calls for an inquiry.
examples.zh: 政府拒绝了调查要求。

senses.def: to refuse to accept somebody for a job, position, etc.

examples.en: Please reject the following candidates…
examples.zh: 请排除以下候选人…

examples.en: I've been rejected by all the universities I applied to.
examples.zh: 所有我申请的大学都没有录取我。

examples.en: Some applicants were rejected outright.
examples.zh: 有些申请人被直接拒绝。

examples.en: We considered offering him the job, but finally rejected him.
examples.zh: 我们考虑过要给他这份工作，但最后还是拒绝了他。

senses.group: somebody for job 找工作者

senses.def: to decide not to use, sell, publish, etc. something because its quality is not good enough
senses.zh: （因质量差）不用，不出售，不出版

examples.en: Imperfect articles are rejected by our quality control.
examples.zh: 我们严把质量关，不完美的物件都被退回。

examples.en: The book was at first rejected by publishers.
examples.zh: 这本书最初被出版商拒绝。

senses.def: to not accept a new organ after a transplant

examples.en: Her body has already rejected two kidneys.
examples.zh: 她的身体已经对两个肾脏发生过排斥反应。

senses.def: to fail to give a person or an animal enough love or care

examples.en: The lioness rejected the smallest cub, which died.
examples.zh: 母狮不理会最小的幼狮，任由它死去。

examples.en: When her husband left home she felt rejected and useless.
examples.zh: 丈夫离家后，她觉得遭到了抛弃，且认为自己一无是处。

senses.def: something that cannot be used or sold because there is something wrong with it
senses.group: something that cannot be used 无用之物

senses.def: a person who has not been accepted as a member of a team, society, etc.
senses.zh: 不合格者；被剔除者；被拒收者

examples.en: one of society’s rejects
examples.zh: 一名社会弃儿

senses.def: the act of refusing to accept or consider something

examples.en: Her proposal met with unanimous rejection.
examples.zh: 她的建议遭到一致否决。

senses.def: the act of refusing to accept somebody for a job, position, etc.

examples.en: a rejection letter (= a letter in which you are told, for example, that you have not been accepted for a job)
examples.zh: 回绝信

senses.def: the decision not to use, sell, publish, etc. something because its quality is not good enough
senses.zh: （因质量差）不用，不出售，不出版

examples.en: I've had letters of rejection from several publishers.
examples.zh: 我收过几家出版社的退稿信。

examples.en: Everyone from George Orwell to JK Rowling has had rejection slips (= formal notice from a publisher that a book, etc. is rejected).
examples.zh: 从乔治·奥威尔到 J.K. 罗琳，每个人都收到过退稿单。

senses.def: the failure of somebody's body to accept a new organ after a transplant

examples.en: He had a second lung transplant after rejection of the first.
examples.zh: 他在第一次肺移植手术发生排斥反应后又做了第二次。

senses.def: failure to give a person or an animal enough love or care

examples.en: painful feelings of rejection
examples.zh: 受冷落的痛苦感受

senses.def: to make changes to something; to arrange something in a different way
senses.zh: 更改；重新安排；重新布置

senses.def: to express great happiness about something

examples.en: When the war ended, people finally had cause to rejoice.
examples.zh: 战争结束，人们终于可以欢欣鼓舞了。

examples.en: The motor industry is rejoicing at the cut in car tax.
examples.zh: 汽车行业对汽车减税感到非常高兴。

examples.en: They rejoiced to see their son well again.
examples.zh: 他们看到儿子恢复了健康，无比高兴。

examples.en: I rejoice that justice has prevailed.
examples.zh: 我非常高兴正义得到伸张。

senses.def: to have a name that sounds funny

examples.en: He rejoiced in the name of Owen Owen.
examples.zh: 他有个滑稽的名字叫欧文·欧文。

senses.def: to have a name that sounds funny

examples.en: He rejoiced in the name of Owen Owen.
examples.zh: 他有个滑稽的名字叫欧文·欧文。

senses.def: to have a name that sounds funny

examples.en: He rejoiced in the name of Owen Owen.
examples.zh: 他有个滑稽的名字叫欧文·欧文。

senses.def: to join somebody/something again after leaving them
senses.zh: 重新加入；和…重新在一起

examples.en: to rejoin a club
examples.zh: 重新加入俱乐部

examples.en: She turned off her phone and rejoined them at the table.
examples.zh: 她关掉电话，再回到餐桌旁和他们坐在一起。

examples.en: The path goes through a wood before rejoining the main road.
examples.zh: 这条小路穿过一片树林后与大路交汇。

senses.def: to say something as an answer, especially something quick, critical or funny

examples.en: ‘You're wrong!’ she rejoined.
examples.zh: “你错了！”她反驳道。

senses.def: a reply, especially a quick, critical or funny one

examples.en: ‘No!’ was his curt rejoinder.
examples.zh: 他草率地回答了一声‘不！’

senses.def: to make somebody/something look or feel younger, more lively or more modern
senses.zh: 使年轻；使更有活力；使更新潮

examples.en: His new job seemed to rejuvenate him.
examples.zh: 他的新工作似乎让他重新焕发了活力。

examples.en: special creams to rejuvenate the skin
examples.zh: 使皮肤恢复活力的特殊面霜

senses.def: the act or process of making somebody/something look or feel younger, more lively or more modern
senses.zh: 变得年轻;焕发生机,恢复活力

examples.en: a £1 billion city centre rejuvenation project
examples.zh: 耗资10亿英镑的市中心复兴项目

senses.def: to make a feeling or relationship become active again
senses.zh: 使（感情或关系）重新活跃；使复苏

examples.en: to rekindle feelings/hopes
examples.zh: 再次引发感情；重新点燃希望

examples.en: The sight of her after so many years rekindled his passion.
examples.zh: 时隔多年再次见到她，他的热情再次燃起。

senses.def: the fact of becoming ill again after making an improvement

examples.en: to have/suffer a relapse
examples.zh: 旧病复发

examples.en: a risk of relapse
examples.zh: 旧病复发的危险

senses.def: to go back into a previous condition or into a worse state after making an improvement
senses.zh: 退回原状；（好转后）再倒退

examples.en: They relapsed into silence.
examples.zh: 他们再次陷入了沉默。

examples.en: He relapsed into his old bad habits.
examples.zh: 他重染恶习。

examples.en: Two days after leaving the hospital she relapsed into a coma.
examples.zh: 出院两天后，她再度昏迷。

senses.def: making you feel that you can understand and have sympathy with somebody/something
senses.zh: 让你觉得你可以理解并同情某人/某事

examples.en: Kat is the most relatable character in the film.
examples.zh: 凯特是影片中最容易引起共鸣的角色。

examples.en: She believes that her busy schedule makes her more relatable to voters.
examples.zh: 她相信繁忙的日程让她更容易与选民产生共鸣。

senses.def: that can be related to something else

examples.en: The growth of the welfare state is clearly relatable to the growth of democracy.
examples.zh: 福利国家的发展显然与民主的发展相关。

senses.def: show or make a connection between two or more things
senses.zh: 联系；使有联系；把…联系起来

examples.en: I found it difficult to relate the two ideas in my mind.
examples.zh: 我觉得很难把这两种想法联系在一起。

examples.en: In the future, pay increases will be related to productivity.
examples.zh: 以后，工资的上涨将和业绩挂钩。

examples.en: Attempts to relate studies on animals to those on humans are not really comparing like with like.
examples.zh: 试图将对动物的研究和对人类的研究联系起来并不是对两种相似的事物进行比较。

senses.def: to give a spoken or written report of something; to tell a story

examples.en: Then he related a story about his days working in a research laboratory.
examples.zh: 然后他讲述了一个他在科研实验室工作时的故事。

examples.en: She relates her childhood experiences in the first chapters.
examples.zh: 在开始的几章中，她叙述了自己童年的经历。

examples.en: He related the facts of the case to journalists.
examples.zh: 他给记者们讲述了这件事的实际情况。

examples.en: She related how he had run away from home as a boy.
examples.zh: 她追述了他小时候是如何离家出走的。

examples.en: The story relates that an angel appeared and told him to sing.
examples.zh: 这个故事讲述一个天使现身，叫他唱歌。

senses.def: a British organization that gives advice to people who are having difficulties in a relationship, and has a number of centres around the country where couples can talk with trained staff. It also gives advice by phone and on its website. It was formed in 1938 as the Marriage Guidance Council and changed its name in 1988.
senses.zh: 有关系：一家英国组织，为有关系困难的人提供建议，并在全国各地设有许多中心，夫妻可以与经过培训的工作人员交谈。它还通过电话和在其网站上提供建议。它成立于1938年，当时是婚姻指导委员会，并于1988年更名。

senses.def: to be connected with something/somebody; to refer to something/somebody

examples.en: We shall discuss the problem as it relates to our specific case.
examples.zh: 我们应针对我们的具体情况来讨论这个问题。

examples.en: The second paragraph relates to the situation in Scotland.
examples.zh: 第二段谈到苏格兰的形势。

examples.en: theories relating to education and learning
examples.zh: 有关教育和学习的理论

senses.def: to be able to understand and have sympathy with somebody/something
senses.zh: 能够理解并同情；了解；体恤

examples.en: Many adults can't relate to children.
examples.zh: 许多成年人并不了解儿童的想法。

examples.en: Our product needs an image that people can relate to.
examples.zh: 我们的产品需要一个大家能理解的形象。

senses.def: the fact of being connected with something/somebody in some way

examples.en: the sense of relatedness and interdependence of all life
examples.zh: 所有生命的关联性和相互依存感

senses.def: the way in which two people, groups or countries behave towards each other or deal with each other
senses.zh: （人、团体、国家之间的）关系，联系

examples.en: diplomatic/international/foreign relations
examples.zh: 外交／国际／对外关系

examples.en: US-Chinese relations
examples.zh: 美中关系

examples.en: teacher-student relations
examples.zh: 师生关系

examples.en: Relations with neighbouring countries are under strain at present.
examples.zh: 目前，与邻国的关系正处于紧张状态。

examples.en: We seek to improve relations between our two countries.
examples.zh: 我们寻求改进我们两国间的关系。

examples.en: to have sexual relations (= to have sex)
examples.zh: 发生性关系

senses.def: the way in which two or more things are connected

examples.en: the relation between rainfall and crop yields
examples.zh: 降雨量和农作物产量之间的关系

examples.en: the relation of the farmer to the land
examples.zh: 农民和土地的关系

examples.en: The fee they are offering bears no relation to the amount of work involved.
examples.zh: 他们支付的酬金和所需的工作量无关。

examples.en: Little of what he said has any relation to fact.
examples.zh: 他所说的几乎与事实无关。

examples.en: I have some comments to make in relation to (= about) this matter.
examples.zh: 关于这件事我有几点看法。

examples.en: Its brain is small in relation to (= compared with) its body.
examples.zh: 和它的身体相比，它的大脑很小。

senses.def: a person who is in the same family as somebody else

examples.en: a close/near/distant relation of mine
examples.zh: 我的一个近亲／远亲

examples.en: a relation by marriage
examples.zh: 姻亲

examples.en: a party for friends and relations
examples.zh: 亲戚朋友的聚会

examples.en: He's called Brady too, but we're no relation (= not related).
examples.zh: 他也叫布雷迪，但我们不是亲戚。

examples.en: Is he any relation to you?
examples.zh: 他是你的什么亲戚吗？

examples.en: What relation is Rita to you?
examples.zh: 丽塔是你的什么亲戚？

senses.def: existing or considered in relation to something else
a database
the way in which two people, groups or countries behave towards each other or deal with each other
senses.zh: （人、团体、国家之间的）关系，联系

examples.en: a personal/working relationship
examples.zh: 父子／工作关系

examples.en: a master-servant relationship
examples.zh: 主仆关系

examples.en: This is an opportunity to build positive customer relationships.
examples.zh: 这是建立积极的客户关系的机会。

examples.en: The relationship between the police and the local community has improved.
examples.zh: 警察和当地民众之间的关系已经得到改善。

examples.en: the bilateral relationship between the US and China
examples.zh: 美国和中国之间的双边关系

examples.en: She has a very close relationship with her sister.
examples.zh: 她和她妹妹非常亲密。

examples.en: I have established a good working relationship with my boss.
examples.zh: 我与老板已经建立起良好的工作关系。

examples.en: We have a relationship of trust with our clients.
examples.zh: 我们与客户建立了信任关系。

senses.def: a loving and/or sexual friendship between two people

examples.en: Their affair did not develop into a long-term relationship.
examples.zh: 他们的暧昧关系未能发展成为持久的恋情。

examples.en: It was his first sexual relationship.
examples.zh: 这是他第一段性爱关系。

examples.en: Money problems have put a strain on their relationship.
examples.zh: 钱的问题让他们关系紧张。

examples.en: She was having a relationship with a younger man.
examples.zh: 她在和一个年轻男子谈恋爱。

examples.en: She got involved in a romantic relationship with a colleague.
examples.zh: 她与一位同事陷入了恋爱关系。

examples.en: The relationship between Joe and Carmen is at the heart of the film.
examples.zh: 乔和卡门之间的恋情是这部电影的核心。

examples.en: Are you in a relationship?
examples.zh: 你在恋爱吗？

examples.en: People in same-sex relationships want equal pension rights.
examples.zh: 同性关系中的人们希望享有平等的养老金权利。

senses.def: the way in which two or more things are connected

examples.en: The study demonstrated associations, but no causal relationship.
examples.zh: 该研究证明了相关性，但没有因果关系。

examples.en: They examine the relationship between poverty and crime.
examples.zh: 他们研究贫困与犯罪之间的关系。

examples.en: She explores the intimate relationship between creation and pain.
examples.zh: 她探索创作与痛苦之间的密切关系。

examples.en: There is often an inverse relationship between the power of the tool and how easy it is to use.
examples.zh: 工具的功能越强大，操作起来往往越费事。

examples.en: There is a symbiotic relationship (= in which both depend on the other and both get benefits) between our urban centres and the countryside.
examples.zh: 我们的城市中心和乡村之间存在着一种共生关系（即双方相互依存、双方受益）。

examples.en: This comment bore no relationship to the subject of our conversation.
examples.zh: 这个意见与我们所谈论的话题毫不相干。

examples.en: the complex relationship of culture to politics
examples.zh: 文化与政治的复杂关系

examples.en: They measured height in relationship to weight.
examples.zh: 他们测量了身高与体重的关联。

examples.en: Job insecurity had a significant relationship with alcohol abuse.
examples.zh: 工作不安全感与酗酒有显着关系。

senses.def: the way in which a person is related to somebody else in a family

examples.en: They have a very healthy father-son relationship.
examples.zh: 他们的父子关系很好。

examples.en: I'm not sure of the exact relationship between them—I think they're cousins.
examples.zh: 我不太清楚他们之间的确切关系，我想他们是表亲吧。

examples.en: their relationship to each other
examples.zh: 他们彼此的关系

examples.en: He claimed to have a distant relationship with royalty.
examples.zh: 他声称与王室有远亲关系。

senses.def: considered and judged by being compared with something else

examples.en: You must consider the relative merits of the two plans.
examples.zh: 你必须考虑相比较之下两个计划各自的优点。

examples.en: We need to assess the relative importance of each of these factors.
examples.zh: 我们需要评估每个因素的相对重要性。

examples.en: We need to assess the relative strengths and weaknesses of each system.
examples.zh: 我们需要评估每个系统的相对优势和劣势。

senses.def: referring to an earlier noun, sentence or part of a sentence
senses.zh: （指代前面的名词、句子或句子的一部分）

examples.en: In ‘the man who came’, ‘who’ is a relative pronoun and ‘who came’ is a relative clause.
examples.zh: 在 the man who came 中，who 是关系代词，而 who came 是关系从句。

senses.def: that exists or that has a particular quality only when compared with something else

examples.en: They now live in relative comfort (= compared with how they lived before).
examples.zh: 他们现在过得比较舒适。

examples.en: We won the game with relative ease.
examples.zh: 我们比较轻松地赢了这场比赛。

examples.en: Given the failure of the previous plan, this turned out to be a relative success.
examples.zh: 由于前面那个计划失败了，这个计划算是比较成功的。

examples.en: It's all relative though, isn't it? We never had any money when I was a kid and $500 was a fortune to us.
examples.zh: 不过，一切都是相对的，不是吗？我小的时候，我们根本没有钱，500 美元对于我们来说就是很大的一笔钱了。

senses.def: in comparison with somebody/something else; in relation to somebody/something

examples.en: the position of the sun relative to the earth
examples.zh: 太阳与地球的相对位置

examples.en: The movements of the continents relative to each other can be measured.
examples.zh: 大陆相对于彼此的运动是可以测量的。

examples.en: The company employs too many people relative to the size of its business.
examples.zh: 相对于业务量，该公司雇用的员工太多。

senses.def: having a connection with somebody/something; concerning somebody/something

examples.en: He may have information relative to the case.
examples.zh: 他可能掌握与此案相关的信息。

senses.def: a person who is in the same family as somebody else

examples.en: a close/distant relative
examples.zh: 近亲；远亲

examples.en: her friends and relatives
examples.zh: 她的亲友

examples.en: He was visiting relatives in Scotland.
examples.zh: 他当时正在苏格兰探望亲戚。

senses.def: a thing that belongs to the same group as something else

examples.en: The ibex is a distant relative of the mountain goat.
examples.zh: 北山羊与石山羊有较远的亲缘关系。

examples.en: He believes that interior design is the poor relative of architecture.
examples.zh: 他认为室内装潢设计较建筑学来说要低一等。

senses.def: in comparison with somebody/something else; in relation to somebody/something

examples.zh: 太阳与地球的相对位置

examples.en: The company employs too many people relative to the size of its business.
