examples.zh: 他可能掌握与此案相关的信息。

senses.def: the average mass
the mass of a substance divided by the mass of the same volume of water or air
to a fairly large degree, especially in comparison to something else
senses.zh: 相当程度上；相当地；相对地

examples.en: relatively large/small/high/low
examples.zh: 相对大／小／高／低

examples.en: Lack of exercise is also a risk factor for heart disease but it's relatively small when compared with the others.
examples.zh: 缺乏锻炼也是导致心脏病的一个因素。但和其他因素相比危险较小。

examples.en: I found the test relatively easy.
examples.zh: 我觉得这次测验比较容易。

examples.en: These students had a relatively simple task.
examples.zh: 这些学生的任务相对简单。

examples.en: We had relatively few applications for the job.
examples.zh: 申请我们这项工作的人相对较少。

examples.en: I have relatively little to do this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午我没什么可做的。

examples.en: It all happened in a relatively short period of time.
examples.zh: 这一切都发生在相对较短的时间内。

examples.en: At the time, the internet was a relatively new phenomenon.
examples.zh: 当时，互联网是一个相对较新的现象。

examples.en: He was charged with a relatively minor offence.
examples.zh: 他被指控犯有相对较轻的罪行。

examples.en: In the early 1960s divorce was still relatively rare.
examples.zh: 在 20 世纪 60 年代初，离婚仍然相对较少。

senses.def: used when you are comparing something with all similar things
senses.zh: （和所有类似事物比较）相对而言

examples.en: Relatively speaking, these jobs provide good salaries.
examples.zh: 相对来说，这些工作报酬都不低。

examples.en: The colleges had become, relatively speaking, short of funds.
examples.zh: 相对来说，这些学院资金开始紧拙。

senses.def: used when you are comparing something with all similar things
senses.zh: （和所有类似事物比较）相对而言

examples.en: Relatively speaking, these jobs provide good salaries.
examples.zh: 相对来说，这些工作报酬都不低。

examples.en: The colleges had become, relatively speaking, short of funds.
examples.zh: 相对来说，这些学院资金开始紧拙。

senses.def: used when you are comparing something with all similar things
senses.zh: （和所有类似事物比较）相对而言

examples.en: Relatively speaking, these jobs provide good salaries.
examples.zh: 相对来说，这些工作报酬都不低。

examples.en: The colleges had become, relatively speaking, short of funds.
examples.zh: 相对来说，这些学院资金开始紧拙。

senses.def: the belief that truth and right and wrong cannot be judged generally but can be judged only in relation to other things, such as your personal situation
senses.zh: 相对主义（认为真理和对错不是绝对的，只能根据其他事物来判断，如个人处境）

senses.def: a person who believes in relativism
senses.zh: 相对主义者，持相对论者

examples.en: a moral and political relativist
examples.zh: 道德和政治相对主义者

senses.def: supporting or connected with relativism

examples.en: a relativist view
examples.zh: 相对主义观点

senses.def: Einstein’s theory of the universe based on the principle that all movement is relative and that time is a fourth dimension
the state of being relative
to start or present something again in a new or different way, especially a product for sale

examples.en: to relaunch a product/magazine
examples.zh: 重新推出产品/杂志

examples.en: The band are hoping to relaunch their career with a new song and a new image.
examples.zh: 乐队希望以新歌和新形象重新开始他们的职业生涯。

senses.def: the act of starting or presenting something again in a new or different way, especially a product for sale

examples.en: a party to mark the relaunch of the magazine
examples.zh: 纪念杂志重新发行的聚会

senses.def: to rest while you are doing something that you enjoy, especially after work or effort

examples.en: Just relax and enjoy the movie.
examples.zh: 休息休息，看看电影吧。

examples.en: I'm going to spend the weekend just relaxing.
examples.zh: 这个周末，我什么也不干，就是休息。

examples.en: He was relaxing at home, watching TV.
examples.zh: 他正在家里放松，看电视。

examples.en: She finished her lunch and then relaxed in the sun.
examples.zh: 她吃完午饭，然后在阳光下放松。

examples.en: The boys had been relaxing on the beach at their resort.
examples.zh: 男孩们一直在度假村的海滩上放松。

examples.en: You need a little time to relax and unwind.
examples.zh: 您需要一点时间来放松身心。

examples.en: When I get home from work I like to relax with the newspaper.
examples.zh: 我下班回到家里，喜欢看看报纸，放松一下。

examples.en: Sit back and relax with a cup of tea.
examples.zh: 坐下来喝杯茶放松一下。

senses.def: to become or make somebody become calmer and less worried

examples.en: I'll only relax when I know you're safe.
examples.zh: 我只有知道你安然无恙才会放心。

examples.en: I can't relax until I've spoken to her myself.
examples.zh: 在我亲自和她交谈之前我不能放松。

examples.en: 'You need to try and relax,' Jane said.
examples.zh: “你需要试着放松一下，”简说。

examples.en: Relax! Everything will be OK.
examples.zh: 别着急！一切都会好的。

examples.en: A herbal tea will relax you.
examples.zh: 一杯花草茶会让你放松。

senses.def: to become or make something become less tight or stiff

examples.en: Allow your muscles to relax completely.
examples.zh: 让你的肌肉完全放松。

examples.en: The massage relaxed my tense back muscles.
examples.zh: 按摩使得我背部紧张的肌肉松弛下来。

examples.en: He relaxed his grip on her arm.
examples.zh: 他本来抓着她的胳膊，现在松开了手。

examples.en: He closed his eyes and forced himself to relax his tensed body.
examples.zh: 他闭上眼睛，强迫自己放松紧绷的身体。

examples.en: The dictator refuses to relax his grip on power.
examples.zh: 独裁者拒绝放松对权力的控制。

examples.en: His severe expression relaxed into a half-smile.
examples.zh: 他一改严肃的表情，露出了一丝笑容。

senses.def: to allow rules, laws, etc. to become less strict

examples.en: to relax rules/restrictions/regulations/requirements
examples.zh: 放宽规则／限制／规定／要求

examples.en: government plans to relax the licensing laws to allow round-the-clock drinking
examples.zh: 政府计划放宽许可法以允许全天候饮酒

examples.en: The council has relaxed the ban on dogs in city parks.
examples.zh: 政务委员会已经放宽了对带狗到市内公园里去的禁令。

senses.def: to allow your attention or effort to become weaker

examples.en: You cannot afford to relax your concentration for a moment.
examples.zh: 你必须集中精力，一刻都不能松懈。

senses.def: a drug that is used to make the body relax

examples.en: a muscle relaxant
examples.zh: 肌肉松弛药

senses.def: a way of resting and enjoying yourself; time spent resting and enjoying yourself
senses.zh: 放松；休息；消遣；用于放松消遣的时间

examples.en: I go hill-walking for relaxation.
examples.zh: 我要是想放松一下，就到山上走走。

examples.en: Fishing is his favourite relaxation.
examples.zh: 钓鱼是他最喜欢的消遣活动。

examples.en: a few days of relaxation
examples.zh: 几天的休息时间

senses.def: the state of feeling calm and not anxious or worried

examples.en: Some people take up yoga to aid relaxation.
examples.zh: 有些人练习瑜伽来帮助放松。

examples.en: It's a good idea to learn some relaxation techniques.
examples.zh: 掌握一些消遣放松的方法挺不错的。

senses.def: the fact of a part of the body, especially a muscle, becoming less tight

examples.en: an ointment that helps muscle relaxation
examples.zh: 有助于肌肉放松的药膏

examples.en: drugs that cause the relaxation of the muscle
examples.zh: 使肌肉放松的药物

senses.def: the act of making a rule or some form of control less strict or severe

examples.en: the relaxation of foreign currency controls
examples.zh: 对外汇管制的放宽

examples.en: a relaxation of travel restrictions
examples.zh: 旅游限制的放宽

synonyms.words: fun ▪ recreation ▪ relaxation ▪ play ▪ pleasure ▪ amusement

intro.en: These are all words for things or activities used to entertain people when they are not working.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指休闲、娱乐或相关活动。

items.def: films, television, music, etc. used to entertain people:
items.zh: 指娱乐片、文娱节目、表演会等

examples.en: There are three bars, with live entertainment seven nights a week.
examples.zh: 有三家酒吧每周七个晚上都有现场文艺节目。

items.def: (rather informal) behaviour or activities that are not serious but are meant to be enjoyed:
items.zh: 指嬉戏、逗乐、玩笑

examples.en: It wasn’t serious—it was all done in fun.
examples.zh: 那不是认真的，全是闹着玩的。

items.def: (rather formal) things people do for pleasure when they are not working:
items.zh: 指娱乐、消遣

examples.en: His only form of recreation is playing football.
examples.zh: 他唯一的娱乐就是踢足球。

items.def: (rather formal) things people do to rest and enjoy themselves when they are not working; the ability to relax:
items.zh: 指休闲活动、消遣

examples.en: I go hill-walking for relaxation.
examples.zh: 我要是想放松一下，就到山上走走。

items.def: things that people, especially children, do for pleasure rather than as work:
items.zh: 尤指孩子游戏、玩耍、娱乐

examples.en: the happy sounds of children at play
examples.zh: 儿童嬉戏的欢闹声

items.def: the activity of enjoying yourself, especially in contrast to working:
items.zh: 指玩乐、休闲，尤与工作相对

examples.en: Are you in Paris for business or pleasure?
examples.zh: 你来巴黎公干还是游玩？

items.def: the fact of being entertained by something:
items.zh: 指娱乐、消遣、游戏

examples.en: What do you do for amusement round here?
examples.zh: 你在这儿以什么消遣？

senses.def: a race between teams in which each member of the team runs or swims one section of the race

examples.en: the 4 × 100m relay
examples.zh: 4 × 100 米接力赛

examples.en: a relay team
examples.zh: 接力队

examples.en: the sprint relay
examples.zh: 短跑接力赛

examples.en: She ran in the 4 × 400 relay.
examples.zh: 她参加了4 × 400 米接力。

senses.def: a fresh set of people or animals that take the place of others that are tired or have finished a period of work
senses.zh: 接班的人（或动物）；轮换者

examples.en: The wagons were pulled by relays of horses.
examples.zh: 货车由一组接一组的马匹轮流拉

examples.en: Rescuers worked in relays to save the trapped miners.
examples.zh: 救援人员接力营救被困矿工。

senses.def: an electronic device that receives radio or television signals and sends them on again with greater strength

examples.en: a relay station
examples.zh: 中继站

senses.def: to receive and send on information, news, etc. to somebody

examples.en: He relayed the message to his boss.
examples.zh: 他将这个消息转给了他的老板。

examples.en: Instructions were relayed to him by phone.
examples.zh: 通过电话将指令转达给了他。

examples.en: I'll relay to the customer and let you know what they say.
examples.zh: 我会转达给客户并让您知道他们说了什么。

senses.def: to broadcast television or radio signals
senses.zh: 播放，转播（电视或广播信号）

examples.en: The game was relayed by satellite to audiences all over the world.
examples.zh: 这场比赛通过卫星向全世界的观众进行了转播。

senses.def: to lay something again or in a different way

examples.en: The council are going to relay the road surface outside our house next month.
examples.zh: 议会将于下个月在我们家外面铺设路面。

senses.def: to let somebody come out of a place where they have been kept or stuck and unable to leave or move

examples.en: to release a prisoner
examples.zh: 释放囚犯

examples.en: The hostages were released unharmed.
examples.zh: 人质被释放，未受到伤害。

examples.en: He was released without charge after questioning by police.
examples.zh: 他经警方审问后被免予起诉并释放了。

examples.en: You will be released on bail and a date for your hearing will be set.
examples.zh: 您将被保释，听证会的日期也将确定。

examples.en: to release somebody from prison/jail/hospital
examples.zh: 释放某人出狱；让某人出院

examples.en: Firefighters took two hours to release the driver from the wreckage.
examples.zh: 消防队员花了两个小时将司机从汽车残骸中救出来。

examples.en: He was later released from police custody.
examples.zh: 他后来被警方释放。

examples.en: Death released him from his suffering.
examples.zh: 死亡使他从痛苦中解脱了。

senses.def: to stop holding something or stop it from being held so that it can move, fly, fall, etc. freely
senses.zh: 放开；松开；使自由移动（或飞翔、降落等）

examples.en: He refused to release her arm.
examples.zh: 他不肯放开她的胳膊。

examples.en: Intense heat is released in the reaction.
examples.zh: 反应过程中产生高热。

examples.en: 10 000 balloons were released at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 典礼上放飞了一万个气球。

examples.en: The chemical reaction releases energy in the form of light.
examples.zh: 化学反应以光的形式释放能量。

examples.en: the need to limit the amount of greenhouse gases being released into the atmosphere
examples.zh: 限制温室气体排放量的必要性

examples.en: The birds were cleaned and fed and released again into the wild.
examples.zh: 那些鸟儿经清洗并喂食后给放回到野外。

senses.def: to express feelings such as anger or worry in order to get rid of them

examples.en: She burst into tears, releasing all her pent-up emotions.
examples.zh: 她放声大哭，发泄出全部郁积起来的情感。

examples.en: She laughed, the tension inside her suddenly released.
examples.zh: 她笑了起来，绷紧的神经立刻松弛了下来。

senses.def: to remove something from a fixed position, allowing something else to move or function

examples.en: to release the clutch/handbrake/switch
examples.zh: 松开离合器／手闸／开关

examples.en: Now release the clutch and move away from the kerb.
examples.zh: 现在松开离合器，驶离路边。

senses.group: part of machine 机器部件

senses.def: to make information available to the public

examples.en: to release a statement/report/document/poll/study
examples.zh: 发布声明／报告／文件／民意调查／研究结果

examples.en: to release figures/results/information/data
examples.zh: 发布数字／结果／信息／数据

examples.en: Police have released no further details about the accident.
examples.zh: 关于这次事故，警方没有透露更多的细节。

examples.en: The suspect's name has not been released to the public.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人的姓名尚未向公众公布。

examples.en: The newly released files reveal the extent of his involvement in the scandal.
examples.zh: 新公布的文件揭示了他卷入丑闻的程度。

senses.def: to make a film, recording or other product available to the public
senses.zh: 发行，发布（电影、录音等产品）

examples.en: He's planning to release a solo album.
examples.zh: 他计划发行一张个人专辑。

examples.en: to release a film/video
examples.zh: 发行电影／视频

examples.en: They've released a new version of the original film.
examples.zh: 他们发布了原电影的新版本。

examples.en: There have been a lot of new products released onto the market.
examples.zh: 已经有很多新产品投放市场。

examples.en: The series has just recently been released on DVD.
examples.zh: 该系列最近刚刚发行了 DVD 版。

senses.def: to make something available that had previously been limited

examples.en: The new building programme will go ahead as soon as the government releases the funds.
examples.zh: 政府一拨付资金，新的建筑项目就动工。

senses.def: to free somebody from a duty, responsibility, contract, etc.
senses.zh: 免除，解除（某人的职责、责任、合同等）；解雇

examples.en: The club is releasing some of its older players.
examples.zh: 俱乐部正在解聘一些老队员。

examples.en: The new law released employers from their obligation to recognize unions.
examples.zh: 新的法律免除了雇主承认工会的义务。

senses.group: free somebody from duty 免除职责

senses.def: to make something less tight

examples.en: You need to release the tension in these shoulder muscles.
examples.zh: 你需要放松肩部肌肉。

examples.en: to release a catch/a screw/a nut/the clutch/the brakes
examples.zh: 松开锁扣／螺丝／螺母／离合器／刹车

senses.group: make less tight 使不紧张

senses.def: the act of setting a person or an animal free; the state of being set free

examples.en: The government has been working to secure the release of the hostages.
examples.zh: 政府一直在努力争取使人质获释。

examples.en: The judges ordered the release of prisoners who were political opponents of the government.
examples.zh: 法官下令释放政府政治反对派囚犯。

examples.en: The public demanded her release.
examples.zh: 公众要求释放她。

examples.en: Following his release from prison, he moved to London.
examples.zh: 他从监狱获释后搬到了伦敦。

examples.en: The release of female prisoners from government jails was part of the deal.
examples.zh: 从政府监狱释放女囚犯是该协议的一部分。

examples.en: He was granted early release (= from prison).
examples.zh: 他得以提前获释。

examples.en: She can expect an early release from prison.
examples.zh: 她有望早一点出狱。

examples.en: Upon his release from jail he found work in a restaurant kitchen.
examples.zh: 出狱后，他在一家餐馆的厨房找到了工作。

examples.en: Upon her release, she fled Germany, living first in Geneva, then Paris.
examples.zh: 获释后，她逃离德国，先住在日内瓦，然后住在巴黎。

senses.def: the act of making a film, recording or other product available to the public

examples.en: The new software is planned for release in April.
examples.zh: 新软件计划四月份发行。

examples.en: It is very difficult for a Brazilian film to get an American release.
examples.zh: 巴西电影要在美国上映非常困难。

examples.en: The film never received a theatrical release (= was not shown in cinemas).
examples.zh: 这部电影从未在影院上映（=未在电影院上映）。

examples.en: The movie goes on general release (= will be widely shown in cinemas) next week.
examples.zh: 这部电影将于下周公开上映。

examples.en: I hadn't seen the movie since its original release.
examples.zh: 自从这部电影最初上映以来我就没有看过它了。

examples.en: the release of a film/report
examples.zh: 电影/报告的发行

examples.en: Upon its release, the film received considerable acclaim.
examples.zh: 影片上映后，获得了广泛好评。

examples.en: It's still seven weeks till the film's official release.
examples.zh: 距离电影正式上映还有七周。

examples.en: A release date has not been announced yet.
examples.zh: 发布日期尚未公布。

senses.group: making something available 使可得到

senses.def: a thing that is made available to the public, especially a new film or music recording
senses.zh: 新发行的东西；（尤指）新电影，新专辑

examples.en: recent/new releases
examples.zh: 最近发行的／新发行的产品

examples.en: the latest releases
examples.zh: 最新发行的产品

examples.en: There are several interesting album releases due out on Friday.
examples.zh: 有几张有趣的专辑将于周五发行。

examples.en: This is a debut release that'll simply take your breath away.
examples.zh: 这是一个让您惊叹不已的首次发布。

senses.group: making something available 使可得到

senses.def: the act of making information available to the public

examples.en: the release of the report
examples.zh: 报告的公开发布

examples.en: The company issued a news release after the board meeting.
examples.zh: 公司在董事会会议后发布了新闻稿。

senses.group: making something available 使可得到

senses.def: the act of letting a gas, chemical, etc. move or flow freely
senses.zh: （气体、化学物质等的）释放，排放

examples.en: Release of these hormones gives the body a temporary increase in strength and energy.
examples.zh: 这些激素的释放能使力量和体能短时间内增加。

examples.en: disasters resulting from accidental releases of toxic substances
examples.zh: 有毒物质意外泄漏造成的灾难

examples.en: The aim is to control the risks of exposure to chemicals by preventing release at source.
examples.zh: 目的是通过防止源头释放来控制接触化学品的风险。

examples.en: the release of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere
examples.zh: 二氧化碳向大气层的排放

examples.en: to monitor radiation releases
examples.zh: 监测辐射的释放

senses.def: the feeling that you are free from pain, worry or some other unpleasant feeling

examples.en: a sense of release after the exam
examples.zh: 考试后的解脱感

examples.en: I think her death was a merciful release.
examples.zh: 我认为她的死是一种幸运的解脱。

examples.en: It’s just a release of tension.
examples.zh: 这只是一种压力的释放。

senses.group: from unpleasant feeling 不愉快的感觉

senses.def: a version of a product, especially computer software, that is fully developed and nearly ready to be made available to the public. It comes after the beta version
senses.zh: 候选发布版本（尤指计算机软件的一个版本，在测试版之后发布，已开发完成，准备推出供用户使用）

senses.def: to give somebody a lower or less important position, rank, etc. than before
senses.zh: 使贬职；使降级；降低…的地位

examples.en: She was then relegated to the role of assistant.
examples.zh: 随后她被降级做助手了。

examples.en: He relegated the incident to the back of his mind.
examples.zh: 他将这个事件抛到了脑后。

senses.def: to move a sports team from playing with one group of teams to playing in a lower group
the fact of a sports team being moved from playing with one group of teams to playing in a lower group

examples.en: teams threatened with relegation
examples.zh: 有降级危险的球队

examples.en: The team finds itself in the relegation zone after a run of poor results.
examples.zh: 接连赛绩不佳之后，这个队发现他们落入了降级区。

senses.def: the fact of being given a lower or less important position, rank, etc. than before

examples.en: Malenkov's relegation from prime minister to minister for power stations
examples.zh: 马林科夫从总理降级为发电站部长

senses.def: to finally agree to something after refusing

examples.en: ‘Well, just for a little while then,’ she said, finally relenting.
examples.zh: “好吧，不过只能待一会儿。”她最后终于答应了。

examples.en: The government has relented on this issue.
examples.zh: 政府在这个问题上态度有所缓和。

senses.def: to become less determined, strong, etc.

examples.en: After two days the rain relented.
examples.zh: 两天后，雨势减弱了。

examples.en: The police will not relent in their fight against crime.
examples.zh: 警方将继续严厉打击犯罪活动。

examples.en: The government considered making everybody pay the tax but relented.
examples.zh: 政府曾考虑让每个人都缴税，但后来态度软化了。

senses.def: not stopping; not getting less strong
senses.zh: 不停的；持续强烈的；不减弱的

examples.en: her relentless pursuit of perfection
examples.zh: 她对完美的不懈追求

examples.en: The sun was relentless.
examples.zh: 太阳还是那么热。

senses.def: refusing to give up or be less strict or severe
senses.zh: 不放弃的；严格的；苛刻的；无情的

examples.en: a relentless enemy
examples.zh: 残酷的敌人

senses.def: in a way that continues strongly, without stopping, giving up or getting less strong

examples.en: The rebels relentlessly pursued the idea of a separate state.
examples.zh: 叛军坚持不懈地追求独立国家的想法。

senses.def: a close connection with the subject you are discussing or the situation you are in

examples.en: I don't see the relevance of your question.
examples.zh: 你的问题似乎不太相关。

examples.en: What he said has no direct relevance to the matter in hand.
examples.zh: 他所说的话和眼下的事没有直接关系。

senses.def: the fact of being valuable and useful to people in their lives and work

examples.en: a classic play of contemporary relevance
examples.zh: 至今依然意义重大的经典剧作

senses.def: closely connected with the subject you are discussing or the situation you are in

examples.en: relevant information/facts/documents/factors
examples.zh: 相关信息／事实／文件／因素

examples.en: The incident is still under investigation by the relevant authorities.
examples.zh: 这一事件相关部门仍在调查。

examples.en: a relevant suggestion/question/point
examples.zh: 相关的提议／问题／观点

examples.en: The decision was in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Police Act 1996.
examples.zh: 该决定是根据1996年《警察法》的相关规定作出的。

examples.en: Do you have the relevant experience?
examples.zh: 你有相关的经验吗？

examples.en: These comments are not directly relevant to this inquiry.
examples.zh: 这些意见与这项调查没有直接联系。

examples.en: This book is particularly relevant for the study of Irish history of this period.
examples.zh: 本书对于研究这一时期的爱尔兰历史特别重要。

examples.en: It was clearly relevant to consider what effect the proposed works would have on the land.
examples.zh: 考虑拟议的工程将对土地产生什么影响显然是相关的。

senses.def: the fact of being valuable and useful to people in their lives and work

examples.en: Her novel is still relevant today.
examples.zh: 她的小说今天仍有现实意义。

examples.en: Past imperial glories are hardly relevant to the present day.
examples.zh: 昔日的帝国荣耀如今近乎荡然无存。

senses.def: in a way that is important and connected to a particular situation
senses.zh: 相关地：以重要且与特定情况相关的方式

examples.en: The applicant has experience in teaching and, more relevantly, in industry.
examples.zh: 这名申请者有教学经验，更重要的是，还有行业经验。

senses.def: the quality of being able to be trusted to do what somebody wants or needs

examples.en: The incident cast doubt on her motives and reliability.
examples.zh: 这件事令人对她的动机起疑，觉得她未必可靠。

senses.def: the quality of being likely to be correct or true

examples.en: The reliability of these results has been questioned.
examples.zh: 这些结果的可信程度已受到质疑。

examples.en: Lawyers sought to cast doubt on the reliability of her statements.
examples.zh: 律师们试图说明她的陈述的可信性值得怀疑。

senses.def: the quality of being able to work or operate for long periods without breaking down or needing attention

examples.en: The aircraft has an exceptional record of reliability.
examples.zh: 这架飞机性能稳定，极少故障。

senses.def: that can be trusted to do something well; that you can rely on

examples.en: We are looking for someone who is reliable and hard-working.
examples.zh: 我们在物色可靠而又勤奋的人。

examples.en: a reliable friend
examples.zh: 可信赖的朋友

examples.en: He was a very reliable and honest man who would never betray anyone.
examples.zh: 他是一个非常可靠和诚实的人，永远不会背叛任何人。

senses.def: that is likely to be correct or true

examples.en: reliable information/data
examples.zh: 可靠的信息／数据

examples.en: Our information comes from a reliable source.
examples.zh: 我们的消息来源可靠。

examples.en: Prosecution lawyers tried to show that she was not a reliable witness.
examples.zh: 控方律师试图说明她不是个可信的目击证人。

examples.en: How reliable are the local weather forecasts?
examples.zh: 当地天气预报的可靠性如何？

examples.en: These tests are a reliable indicator of future performance.
examples.zh: 这些测试是评估未来表现的可靠指标。

senses.def: able to work or operate for long periods without breaking down or needing attention
senses.zh: 性能可靠的；稳定耐用的

examples.en: My car's not as reliable as it used to be.
examples.zh: 我的车不像过去那样耐用了。

senses.def: in a way that can be trusted or relied on

examples.en: I am reliably informed (= told by somebody who knows the facts) that the company is being sold.
examples.zh: 我得到可靠消息说这家公司要被出售。

senses.def: the state of needing somebody/something in order to survive, be successful, etc.; the fact of being able to rely on somebody/something

examples.en: Heavy reliance on one client is risky when you are building up a business.
examples.zh: 创业时过分依赖某一个客户是有风险的。

examples.en: Such learning methods encourage too great a reliance upon the teacher.
examples.zh: 这样的学习方法会造成对老师的过分依赖。

examples.en: The study programme concentrates more on group work and places less reliance on (= depends less on) lectures.
examples.zh: 这个学习计划较注重小组活动而不倚重讲座。

examples.en: I wouldn't place too much reliance on (= trust) these figures.
examples.zh: 我不会太相信这些数字的。

examples.en: an increasing reliance on overseas aid
examples.zh: 对海外援助的依赖日益增加

senses.def: needing somebody/something in order to survive, be successful, etc.

examples.en: The hostel is heavily reliant upon charity.
examples.zh: 这家收容所在很大程度上依赖赞助。

examples.en: Businesses have become increasingly reliant on complicated computing systems.
examples.zh: 企业越来越依赖复杂的计算系统。

examples.en: The service has become heavily reliant on government support.
examples.zh: 服务业变得高度依赖政府扶持。

senses.def: an object, a tradition, a system, etc. that has survived from the past

examples.en: The building stands as the last remaining relic of the town's cotton industry.
examples.zh: 这座建筑物是小镇棉纺业仅存的遗迹。

examples.en: Videotapes may already seem like relics of a bygone era.
examples.zh: 录像带似乎已成为过去时代的遗物。

examples.en: The pictures on the walls were relics from the days before her marriage.
examples.zh: 墙上的照片是她结婚前几天的遗物。

examples.en: Our transportation system is a relic of the past.
examples.zh: 我们的交通系统是过去的遗迹。

senses.def: a part of the body or clothing of a holy person, or something that they owned, that is kept after their death and respected as a religious object

examples.en: holy relics
examples.zh: 圣人遗物

senses.def: the feeling of happiness that you have when something unpleasant stops or does not happen

examples.en: I felt a huge sense of relief when I heard they were all OK.
examples.zh: 听说他们都平安无事，我倍感轻松。

examples.en: We all breathed a sigh of relief when he left.
examples.zh: 他走了以后，我们大家都如释重负地松了口气。

examples.en: Much to my relief the car was not damaged.
examples.zh: 令我非常庆幸的是车并没有损坏。

examples.en: News of their safety came as a great relief.
examples.zh: 他们平安的消息给大家带来了巨大的安慰。

examples.en: She sighed with relief.
examples.zh: 她松了口气。

examples.en: He smiled in relief as he saw them both.
examples.zh: 当他看到他们两个时，他松了口气。

examples.en: She had gone through hell and there was no relief in sight for her.
examples.zh: 她已经经历了地狱，而且看不到任何解脱的迹象。

examples.en: This was a great relief to him.
examples.zh: 这让他松了一大口气。

examples.en: It was a relief to be able to talk to someone about it.
examples.zh: 能和别人谈谈这件事，感到舒心多了。

examples.en: It was a relief to her to realize that she was not the only one with this problem.
examples.zh: 当她意识到自己并不是唯一有这个问题的人时，她松了一口气。

examples.en: His mother spoke of her relief that he was now safely home.
examples.zh: 他母亲说，他现在安全回家了，她松了一口气。

examples.en: It is actually a relief that it's finally happened.
examples.zh: 事实上，这件事终于发生了，真是令人松了口气。

examples.en: She expressed relief at the outcome of the investigation.
examples.zh: 她表示对调查结果感到宽慰。

examples.en: He described his relief at securing his freedom.
examples.zh: 他描述了获得自由后的欣慰。

examples.en: What a relief!
examples.zh: 可轻松了！

senses.group: removal of anxiety/pain 焦虑／痛苦的消除

senses.def: the act of removing or reducing pain, worry, etc.
senses.zh: （焦虑、痛苦等的）减轻，消除，缓和

examples.en: modern methods of pain relief
examples.zh: 消除疼痛的新办法

examples.en: the relief of symptoms/suffering/poverty/pain
examples.zh: 症状／痛苦／贫穷／疼痛的消除

examples.en: The drugs only provided temporary relief from the pain.
examples.zh: 这些药物只能暂时缓解疼痛。

examples.en: All the tables in the shade were occupied by people seeking relief from the heat.
examples.zh: 所有阴凉处的桌子都挤满了寻求避暑的人们。

examples.en: Massage can bring some relief from tension.
examples.zh: 按摩可以缓解紧张情绪。

senses.group: removal of anxiety/pain 焦虑／痛苦的消除

senses.def: food, money, medicine, etc. that is given to help people in places where there has been a war or natural disaster
senses.zh: （给灾区或交战地区人民提供的）救济，救援物品

examples.en: disaster relief
examples.zh: 救灾物资

examples.en: relief efforts/operations
examples.zh: 救济工作／行动

examples.en: relief organizations/supplies/work
examples.zh: 救援组织/物资/工作

examples.en: We raised £5 000 for famine relief.
examples.zh: 我们为赈济饥荒筹集了5 000英镑。

examples.en: One relief agency worker described the situation as ‘catastrophic’.
examples.zh: 一名救援机构工作人员将情况描述为“灾难性的”。

senses.def: financial help given by the government to people who need it
a reduction in the amount of tax you have to pay

examples.en: relief on mortgage interest payments
examples.zh: 支付按揭利息的税收减免

senses.def: something that is interesting or fun that replaces something boring, difficult or unpleasant for a short period of time
senses.zh: （暂时替代单调乏味事物的）调剂，轻松场面

examples.en: a few moments of light relief in an otherwise dull performance
examples.zh: 沉闷的表演中几处轻松的情节

examples.en: There was little comic relief in his speech.
examples.zh: 他的演讲少有轻松幽默的地方。

examples.en: The calm of the countryside came as a welcome relief from the hustle and bustle of city life.
examples.zh: 离开喧嚣忙碌的城市生活，来到宁静的乡村，是一种令人愉快的调剂。

senses.def: a person or group of people that replaces another when they have finished working for the day or when they are sick

examples.en: The next crew relief comes/come on duty at 9 o'clock.
examples.zh: 下一批船员将于 9 点钟来值班。

examples.en: We have a pool of relief drivers available to us.
examples.zh: 我们有一些换班的司机可供调用。

senses.def: the act of freeing a town, etc. from an enemy army that has surrounded it

examples.en: the relief of Mafeking
examples.zh: 马弗京城的解围。

senses.def: a way of decorating wood, stone, etc. by cutting designs into the surface of it so that some parts stick out more than others; a design that is made in this way

examples.en: The column was decorated in high relief (= with designs that stick out a lot) with scenes from Greek mythology.
examples.zh: 柱子上饰有描述希腊神话中的场面的高浮雕。

examples.en: The bronze doors are covered with sculpted reliefs.
examples.zh: 青铜门上覆有浮雕。

senses.def: the effect of colours, light, etc. that makes an object easier to notice than others around it
senses.zh: （色彩、光等产生的）醒目效果；醒目；光彩夺目

examples.en: The snow-capped mountain stood out in sharp relief against the blue sky.
examples.zh: 顶端积雪的高山在蓝天的映衬下格外醒目。

senses.group: making something easy to notice 使突出

senses.def: the quality of a particular situation, problem, etc. that makes it easier to notice than before
senses.zh: 突出的品质；令人注目的特征

examples.en: Their differences have been thrown into sharp relief by the present crisis.
examples.zh: 目前的危机使得他们的分歧更加引人注目。

examples.en: The proximity of the wealthy suburb to the squatter camp throws the plight of the squatters into even sharper relief.
examples.zh: 贫民区靠近富裕的市郊，使得棚户区的贫困境况更加触目惊心。

senses.group: making something easy to notice 使突出

senses.def: a map that uses various colours, etc. to show the different heights of hills, valleys, etc.
senses.zh: （用不同颜色表示地势高低的）地形图，地势图，地貌图

senses.def: a pitcher
a road that vehicles can use to avoid an area of heavy traffic, especially a road built for this purpose
senses.zh: （交通高峰时减缓拥挤的）辅路，疏导路，旁道

examples.en: It's part of the relief road system around the city.
examples.zh: 它是城市周围救援道路系统的一部分。

examples.en: There is a detailed map showing where the new relief road is going to go.
examples.zh: 有一张详细的地图显示了新救援道路的走向。

examples.en: There were plans for an M4 relief road to the south of Newport.
examples.zh: 计划在纽波特以南修建一条 M4 救援公路。

senses.def: to remove or reduce an unpleasant feeling or pain
senses.zh: 解除，减轻，缓和（不快或痛苦）

examples.en: to relieve the symptoms of a cold
examples.zh: 减轻感冒的症状

examples.en: to relieve anxiety/guilt/stress
examples.zh: 消除焦虑／内疚；缓解压力

examples.en: Being able to tell the truth at last seemed to relieve her.
examples.zh: 最后能够讲出真话似乎使她感到轻松。

senses.def: to make a problem less serious
senses.zh: 减轻（问题的严重性）；缓和；缓解

examples.en: efforts to relieve poverty
examples.zh: 缓解贫困的努力

examples.en: to relieve traffic congestion
examples.zh: 缓解交通拥堵

examples.en: Aid workers called for further effort from governments to relieve the famine.
examples.zh: 救援人员呼吁各方政府进一步努力赈济饥荒。

senses.def: to make something less boring, especially by introducing something different

examples.en: We played cards to relieve the boredom of the long wait.
examples.zh: 长时间等待实在无聊，我们就打扑克来解闷儿。

examples.en: The black and white pattern is relieved by tiny coloured flowers.
examples.zh: 五彩缤纷的小花使得黑白图案不那么单调。

senses.def: to replace somebody at the end of their period of duty

examples.en: to relieve a sentry
examples.zh: 换岗

examples.en: You'll be relieved at six o'clock.
examples.zh: 六点钟有人来换你的班。

senses.def: to free a town, etc. from an enemy army that has surrounded it
senses.zh: 将（城镇从敌人的围困中）解围

senses.def: a polite way of referring to going to the toilet
senses.zh: （去厕所的一种委婉说法）方便，解手

examples.en: I had to relieve myself behind a bush.
examples.zh: 我只好在灌木丛后面方便了一下。

senses.def: to help somebody by taking something heavy or difficult from them
senses.zh: 替…拿重物；帮助…减轻（负担）

examples.en: Let me relieve you of some of your bags.
examples.zh: 我来帮你拿几个袋子吧。

examples.en: The new secretary will relieve us of some of the paperwork.
examples.zh: 新来的秘书会减轻我们文案工作的一些负担。

examples.en: Free pre-school education would relieve households of a large financial burden.
examples.zh: 免费学前教育将为家庭减轻很大的经济负担。

senses.def: to steal something from somebody

examples.en: A boy with a knife relieved him of his wallet.
examples.zh: 一个持刀的家伙偷了他的钱包。

senses.def: to dismiss somebody from a job, position, etc.

examples.en: General Beale was relieved of his command.
examples.zh: 比尔将军被解除了指挥权。

senses.def: a thing or person that removes or reduces pain, feelings of worry or unhappiness, or a problem
senses.zh: 解除（或减轻）苦痛的人（或物）；缓解忧虑的人（或物）

examples.en: a pain reliever (= a drug used to reduce or remove pain)
examples.zh: 止痛药

examples.en: Exercise can be a great stress reliever.
examples.zh: 运动可以大幅度地缓解压力。

senses.def: a pitcher

examples.en: Wilson began his major-league career as a reliever.
examples.zh: 威尔逊以中继投手的身份开始了他的大联盟职业生涯。

examples.en: The manager often has relievers warming up when the game starts.
examples.zh: 比赛开始时，主教练经常让中继队员热身。

senses.def: the belief in the existence of a god or gods, and the activities that are connected with the worship
senses.zh: 宗教；宗教信仰；精神信仰

examples.en: Is there always a conflict between science and religion?
examples.zh: 科学和宗教信仰之间是否永远存在着冲突？

examples.en: They are Jewish by religion.
examples.zh: 他们是犹太教徒。

senses.def: one of the systems of faith that are based on the belief in the existence of a particular god or gods, or in the teachings of a spiritual leader

examples.en: the Jewish religion
examples.zh: 犹太教

examples.en: Christianity, Islam and other world religions
examples.zh: 基督教、伊斯兰教和其他世界性宗教

examples.en: The law states that everyone has the right to practise their own religion.
examples.zh: 法律规定每个人都有信仰宗教的权利。

senses.def: a particular interest or influence that is very important in your life
senses.zh: 特别的兴趣；重大的影响

examples.en: For him, football is an absolute religion.
examples.zh: 对于他来说，足球就是他至高无上的追求。

examples.en: Football has become an alternative religion for many people.
examples.zh: 足球已经成为很多人的另类信仰。

senses.def: to suddenly start believing in a religion
senses.zh: 突然有了信仰；突然开始信教

examples.en: We're waiting for the company to get religion on recycling.
examples.zh: 我们在等待该公司转变态度，认真对待废物的循环利用问题。

senses.def: to suddenly start believing in a religion
senses.zh: 突然有了信仰；突然开始信教

examples.en: We're waiting for the company to get religion on recycling.
examples.zh: 我们在等待该公司转变态度，认真对待废物的循环利用问题。

senses.def: the state of being religious or too religious
senses.zh: 笃信宗教；过度的宗教热忱

senses.def: connected with religion or with a particular religion

examples.en: religious beliefs/convictions/faith
examples.zh: 宗教信仰

examples.en: religious freedom/liberty
examples.zh: 宗教自由

examples.en: religious traditions/practices/ceremonies
examples.zh: 宗教传统／习俗／仪式

examples.en: religious institutions/organizations
examples.zh: 宗教机构/组织

examples.en: religious education (= education about religion)
examples.zh: 宗教教育

examples.en: religious instruction (= instruction in a particular religion)
examples.zh: 教义讲授

examples.en: a religious order (= group of people living in a religious community)
examples.zh: 宗教教派

examples.en: a religious minority/community
examples.zh: 宗教少数群体/社区

examples.en: The situation for many ethnic and religious minorities remains dangerous.
examples.zh: 许多民族和宗教少数群体的处境仍然危险。

examples.en: religious groups/leaders
examples.zh: 宗教团体／领袖

examples.en: religious conservatives
examples.zh: 宗教保守派

examples.en: In 2000, the Greek government eliminated religious affiliation from citizens' identity cards.
examples.zh: 2000年，希腊政府取消了公民身份证上的宗教信仰。

examples.en: objects which have a religious significance
examples.zh: 圣物

examples.en: a religious house (= a monastery or convent)
examples.zh: 宗教会所

senses.def: believing strongly in a particular religion and obeying its laws and practices

examples.en: His wife is very religious.
examples.zh: 他的妻子非常虔诚。

examples.en: a deeply religious man
examples.zh: 笃信宗教的人

examples.en: Although I'm not particularly religious, I whispered a few words of prayer.
examples.zh: 虽然我不是特别虔诚，但我还是低声祈祷了几句。

examples.en: His mother noticed that he had become more religious.
examples.zh: 他的母亲注意到他变得更加虔诚。

senses.def: a school supported by a synagogue
senses.zh: 宗教团体资助学校；教会学校

examples.en: She has religious school on Sunday mornings.
examples.zh: 她每周日上午去宗教学校上课。

senses.def: a school especially for children of a particular religion
senses.zh: 信众学校（尤为信仰某种宗教的儿童而设）

examples.en: The children attend religious schools outside their catchment area.
examples.zh: 孩子们在其学区外的宗教学校上学。

senses.def: very carefully or regularly
senses.zh: 十分认真地；审慎地；很有规律地

examples.en: She followed the instructions religiously.
examples.zh: 她非常认真地按照说明操作。

examples.en: They go to Greece religiously every year.
examples.zh: 他们每年都会虔诚地前往希腊。

senses.def: in a way that is connected with religion

examples.en: Were you brought up religiously?
examples.zh: 你是在宗教的氛围中长大的吗？

senses.def: the quality of believing strongly in a particular religion and obeying its laws and practices
to stop having something, especially when this happens unwillingly

examples.en: He was forced to relinquish control of the company.
examples.zh: 他被迫放弃对公司的控制权。

examples.en: They had relinquished all hope that she was alive.
examples.zh: 他们已经完全不指望她还活着了。

examples.en: I relinquished her hand (= stopped holding it) and stood up.
examples.zh: 我松开她的手（=不再握住）并站了起来。

examples.en: She relinquished possession of the house to her sister.
examples.zh: 她将房子让给了她的妹妹。

senses.def: a container in which a relic
senses.zh: 圣髑盒；盛放圣人遗物的容器

senses.def: to get great pleasure from something; to want very much to do or have something
senses.zh: 享受；从…获得乐趣；渴望；喜欢

examples.en: to relish a challenge
examples.zh: 喜欢挑战

examples.en: to relish the chance/opportunity to do something
examples.zh: 渴望做某事的机会

examples.en: to relish the idea/thought of something
examples.zh: 欣赏某种观点／想法

examples.en: I don't relish the prospect of getting up early tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我可不愿意明天早上早起。

examples.en: Nobody relishes cleaning the oven.
examples.zh: 没有人喜欢清理烤炉。

senses.def: great pleasure

examples.en: She savoured the moment with obvious relish.
examples.zh: 她显然津津有味地回味着那一刻。

senses.def: a cold, thick, spicy sauce made from fruit and vegetables that have been boiled, that is served with meat, cheese, etc.
senses.zh: 风味佐料（用水果和蔬菜煮后制成的冷稠酱汁）

senses.def: to experience something again, especially in your imagination
senses.zh: （尤指在想象中）再次体验，重温；回味

examples.en: He relives the horror of the crash every night in his dreams.
examples.zh: 每天晚上他都会梦见那次撞车的可怕情景。

senses.def: a relative

examples.en: All the rellies will be at the party.
examples.zh: 所有亲戚都会来参加聚会。

senses.def: to put more bullets into a gun, more film into a camera, etc.
senses.zh: 给…再装填（子弹或胶卷等）

senses.def: to put data or a program into the memory of a computer again
senses.zh: 给（计算机）重新装入（数据或程序）

senses.def: to fill a container, vehicle, machine, etc. again
senses.zh: 再装满（容器、车辆、机器等）

senses.def: to move or to move somebody/something to a new place to work or operate

examples.en: The firm may be forced to relocate from New York to Stanford.
examples.zh: 公司也许会被迫从纽约迁移到斯坦福。

examples.en: Some were unwilling to relocate.
examples.zh: 有些人不愿意搬迁。

examples.en: The company relocated its head office to Stanford.
examples.zh: 公司将总部迁到了斯坦福。

examples.en: Our offices are to be relocated to Newcastle.
examples.zh: 我们的办公室将搬迁至纽卡斯尔。

senses.def: the act of moving, or of moving somebody/something, to a new place to work or operate
senses.zh: 搬迁的行为，或将某物搬到一个新的地方工作或操作。

examples.en: relocation costs
examples.zh: 搬迁费用

senses.def: the feeling of being unwilling to do something and hesitating before you do it, because you do not want to do it or because you are not sure that it is the right thing to do

examples.en: There is still some reluctance on the part of employers to become involved in this project.
examples.zh: 雇主们仍然不太愿意参与这个项目。

examples.en: It was with great reluctance that she took early retirement.
examples.zh: 她非常不情愿地提前退休。

examples.en: They finally agreed to our terms with a certain reluctance.
examples.zh: 他们最终有点勉强地同意了我们的条件。

senses.def: hesitating before doing something because you do not want to do it or because you are not sure that it is the right thing to do

examples.en: He finally gave a reluctant smile.
examples.zh: 他最后露出了一丝无可奈何的微笑。

examples.en: They nodded in reluctant agreement.
examples.zh: 他们不太情愿地点头同意了。

examples.en: She was reluctant to admit she was wrong.
examples.zh: 她不愿承认自己有错。

examples.en: a reluctant hero (= a person who does not want to be called a hero)
examples.zh: 不情愿做英雄的英雄

senses.def: in a way that involves hesitating before doing something because you do not want to do it or because you are not sure that it is the right thing to do

examples.en: We reluctantly agreed to go with her.
examples.zh: 我们勉强答应跟她一起去。

examples.en: Reluctantly, he started the engine and drove off.
examples.zh: 无奈之下，他启动了引擎，开走了。

senses.def: to need or depend on somebody/something

examples.en: The charity relies solely on donations from the public.
examples.zh: 这家慈善机构完全依赖公众捐款。

examples.en: They had to rely entirely on volunteer workers.
examples.zh: 他们必须完全依靠志愿者。

examples.en: The charity relies heavily on public support and donations.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构很大程度上依赖公众的支持和捐赠。

examples.en: As babies, we rely entirely on others for food.
examples.zh: 在婴儿时期，我们完全依赖别人喂食。

examples.en: These days we rely heavily on computers to organize our work.
examples.zh: 现在，我们在很大程度上依赖电脑来安排我们的工作。

examples.en: The industry relies on the price of raw materials remaining low.
examples.zh: 这一产业靠的是原料便宜，不涨价。

senses.def: to trust or have faith in somebody/something

examples.en: You should rely on your own judgement.
examples.zh: 你应该相信你自己的判断。

examples.en: He's a great athlete who must learn to rely more on his natural instincts.
examples.zh: 他是一位伟大的运动员，必须学会更多地依靠自己的本能。

examples.en: We have to rely on the only available evidence.
examples.zh: 我们必须依赖唯一可用的证据。

examples.en: You can rely on me to keep your secret.
examples.zh: 你可以相信我一定会为你保守秘密。

examples.en: He can't be relied on to tell the truth.
examples.zh: 不能指望他说真话。

examples.en: I couldn't rely on John for information.
examples.zh: 我不相信约翰提供的信息。

senses.def: rapid eye movement
senses.zh: 快速眼动（夜间做梦时眼睛快速而细微的移动）

examples.en: REM sleep is an essential part of brain function.
examples.zh: 快速眼动睡眠是大脑功能的重要组成部分。

senses.def: a US pop group established in 1980. Their albums have included Green
senses.zh: 成立于1980年的美国流行乐队。他们的专辑包括Green（1988），Out of Time（1991）和Automatic for the People（1992）。

senses.def: to continue to be something; to be still in the same state or condition

examples.en: to remain silent
examples.zh: 保持沉默

examples.en: to remain standing/seated/motionless
examples.zh: 保持站立/坐着/不动

examples.en: to remain calm/confident
examples.zh: 保持冷静/自信

examples.en: Train fares are likely to remain unchanged.
examples.zh: 火车票价很可能会保持不变。

examples.en: It remains unclear whether Russia will in fact agree to the meeting.
examples.zh: 尚不清楚俄罗斯是否会真的同意此次会晤。

examples.en: The museum will remain open to the public throughout the building work.
examples.zh: 博物馆在施工期内将保持对公众开放。

examples.en: Energy prices might remain high.
examples.zh: 能源价格可能仍居高不下。

examples.en: His reputation remains intact.
examples.zh: 他的声誉仍然完好无损。

examples.en: Production levels have remained constant.
examples.zh: 生产水平保持不变。

examples.en: He is confident that demand will remain strong.
examples.zh: 他相信需求将保持强劲。

examples.en: The rumour was confirmed by a member of the Cabinet,who wished to remain anonymous.
examples.zh: 一位不愿透露姓名的内阁成员证实了这一传闻。

examples.en: It remains true that sport is about competing well, not winning.
examples.zh: 体育重在勇于竞争而非获胜，一向如此。

examples.en: Despite threats of strike action, the management remain hopeful that an agreement can be reached.
examples.zh: 尽管威胁要采取罢工行动，但管理层仍对达成协议抱有希望。

examples.en: Her identity remains a mystery.
examples.zh: 她的身份仍然是个谜。

examples.en: to remain an issue/a problem
examples.zh: 仍然是一个问题

examples.en: In spite of their quarrel, they remain the best of friends.
examples.zh: 尽管有过争吵，他们仍是最好的朋友。

examples.en: Scotland voted to remain part of the United Kingdom
examples.zh: 苏格兰公投决定继续留在英国

examples.en: He remains a member of the Labour Party.
examples.zh: 他仍然是工党成员。

examples.en: He will remain as manager of the club until the end of his contract.
examples.zh: 他将继续担任俱乐部经理，直至合同期满。

examples.en: As a result, sanctions remained in place.
examples.zh: 因此，制裁仍未解除。

examples.en: This law remained in force until 1917.
examples.zh: 该法律一直有效到 1917 年。

examples.en: Power remained in the hands of the former Communist leaders.
examples.zh: 权力仍然掌握在前共产党领导人手中。

examples.en: They were able to remain in power by forming a coalition government.
examples.zh: 他们通过组建联合政府得以继续掌权。

examples.en: She remains in office until July.
examples.zh: 她将留任至七月。

examples.en: Interest rates will remain at current levels well into next year.
examples.zh: 明年利率将维持在当前水平。

senses.def: to still be present after the other parts have been removed, used, etc.; to continue to exist

examples.en: Very little of the house remained after the fire.
examples.zh: 火灾之后，这座房子所剩无几。

examples.en: Only about half of the original workforce remains.
examples.zh: 原来的劳动力只剩下大约一半。

examples.en: There were only ten minutes remaining.
examples.zh: 只剩下十分钟了。

senses.def: to stay in the same place; to not leave

examples.en: They remained in Mexico until June.
examples.zh: 他们在墨西哥一直住到了六月。

examples.en: The plane remained on the ground.
examples.zh: 飞机仍未起飞。

examples.en: She left, but I remained behind.
examples.zh: 她走了，而我留了下来。

examples.en: He remains in police custody until his next court date.
examples.zh: 在下次开庭之前，他仍被警方拘留。

examples.en: His application to remain in this country failed.
examples.zh: 他留在这个国家的申请失败了。

senses.def: to still need to be done, said or dealt with

examples.en: It remains to be seen (= it will only be known later) whether you are right.
examples.zh: 你对不对还有待证实。

examples.en: Much remains to be done.
examples.zh: 还有很多事要去做。

examples.en: There remained one significant problem.
examples.zh: 还有一个非常重要的问题。

examples.en: Of course, problems remain.
examples.zh: 当然，问题依然存在。

examples.en: Questions remain about the president's honesty.
examples.zh: 总统是否诚实，还有许多疑问。

examples.en: I feel sorry for her, but the fact remains (that) she lied to us.
examples.zh: 我为她感到难过，可事实是她对我们撒了谎。

examples.en: The puzzle remains of what happened to the ship.
examples.zh: 那艘船发生了什么事还是个谜。

senses.def: to not become involved in something; to show no interest in people
senses.zh: 不参与；远离；无动于衷；漠不关心

examples.en: The Emperor kept himself aloof from the people.
examples.zh: 这个皇帝对人民漠不关心。

senses.def: to not become involved in something; to show no interest in people
senses.zh: 不参与；远离；无动于衷；漠不关心

examples.en: He has remained somewhat aloof from the business of politics.
examples.zh: 他一直对政治事务不太关心。

senses.def: to not become involved in something; to show no interest in people
senses.zh: 不参与；远离；无动于衷；漠不关心

examples.en: The Emperor kept himself aloof from the people.
examples.zh: 这个皇帝对人民漠不关心。

senses.def: to not become involved in something; to show no interest in people
senses.zh: 不参与；远离；无动于衷；漠不关心

examples.en: He has remained somewhat aloof from the business of politics.
examples.zh: 他一直对政治事务不太关心。

remain in the closet: @@@LINK=(be, remain, stay, etc.) in the closet

senses.def: to not become involved in something; to show no interest in people
senses.zh: 不参与；远离；无动于衷；漠不关心

examples.en: He has remained somewhat aloof from the business of politics.
examples.zh: 他一直对政治事务不太关心。

senses.def: the people, things or time that remain
senses.zh: 其他人员；剩余物；剩余时间

examples.en: I kept some of his books and gave away the remainder.
examples.zh: 我保留了一些他的书，其他的都送人了。

senses.def: the numbers left after one number has been subtracted

examples.en: Divide 2 into 7, and the answer is 3, remainder 1.
examples.zh: 7 除以 2，商 3 余 1。

senses.def: a book that has been remaindered
senses.zh: 廉价出售的图书；滞销图书

senses.def: to reduce the price of a book that did not get sold at its original price
senses.zh: 降价销售，低价处理（滞销书）

senses.def: a person who believes that the UK should have remained in the European Union and does not support Brexit
senses.zh: 留欧派（不主张英国脱离欧盟的人）

examples.en: The Remainers warned of the risks of leaving the EU.
examples.zh: 留欧派警告离开欧盟的风险。

examples.en: He was a Remainer and called for a second referendum on the terms of any EU exit.
examples.zh: 他是留欧派，并呼吁就任何退出欧盟的条款进行第二次公投。

senses.def: a new or different version of an old film or song
senses.zh: （旧影片的）翻拍版；（老歌的）翻唱版

examples.en: He plays the lead in a remake of the 1920s comedy classic.
examples.zh: 他在一部20世纪20年代经典喜剧的改编版中担任主演。

senses.def: to make a new or different version of something such as an old film or song; to make something again
senses.zh: 重新制作，改编（电影或歌曲等）；重做

examples.en: ‘The Seven Samurai’ was remade in Hollywood as ‘The Magnificent Seven’.
examples.zh: 《七武士》在好莱坞被重新制作成《豪勇七蛟龙》。

senses.def: to send somebody away from a court to wait for their trial which will take place at a later date

examples.en: The two men were charged with burglary and remanded in custody (= sent to prison until their trial).
examples.zh: 两名男子被控入室偷窃而被还押候审。

examples.en: She was remanded on bail (= allowed to go free until the trial after leaving a sum of money with the court).
examples.zh: 她获准取保候审。

examples.en: After his arrest, he was remanded to Brixton prison.
examples.zh: 被捕后，他被还押到布里克斯顿监狱。

senses.def: the process of keeping somebody in prison while they are waiting for their trial

examples.en: He is currently being held on remand.
examples.zh: 他正被还押候审。

examples.en: I was in prison on remand for three weeks.
examples.zh: 我被押候审 3 个星期。

examples.en: a remand prisoner
examples.zh: 还押罪犯

senses.def: a place where people are sent when they are accused of a crime and are waiting for their trial
to make a key on a keyboard have a different function
senses.zh: 给（键盘）重新映射（重新设定按键的功能）

senses.def: something that you say or write which expresses an opinion, a thought, etc. about somebody/something

examples.en: to make a remark
examples.zh: 发表评论

examples.en: The controversy intensified following remarks by the President of the European Commission.
examples.zh: 欧盟委员会主席发表讲话后，争议加剧。

examples.en: What exactly did you mean by that last remark?
examples.zh: 你最后那句话究竟是什么意思？

examples.en: He made a number of rude remarks about the food.
examples.zh: 关于这里的食物他说了许多无礼的评论。

examples.en: He made his opening remarks to the assembled press.
examples.zh: 他向聚集的媒体发表了开场白。

examples.en: I'm ready to apologize for my immature remarks.
examples.zh: 我准备好为我不成熟的言论道歉。

senses.def: the quality of being important or interesting enough to be noticed

examples.en: The exhibition contains nothing that is worthy of remark.
examples.zh: 这次展览没有任何值得看的东西。

senses.def: to say or write a comment about something/somebody

examples.en: Sport, George Orwell once remarked, is like war.
examples.zh: 乔治·奥威尔曾经说过，体育就像战争。

examples.en: The judges remarked on the high standard of entries for the competition.
examples.zh: 众评委说参赛作品水准很高。

examples.en: She remarked how tired I was looking.
examples.zh: 她说我看上去显得特别累。

examples.en: ‘It's much colder than yesterday,’ he remarked casually.
examples.zh: “今天比昨天冷多了。”他漫不经心地说。

examples.en: 'That's an excellent idea,' she remarked to her companion.
examples.zh: “这是个好主意，”她对她的同伴说。

examples.en: Critics remarked that the play was not original.
examples.zh: 评论家们指出这部戏剧缺乏创意。

examples.en: He was heard to remark to his wife that the behaviour of some of the guests was appalling.
examples.zh: 有人听到他对妻子说，一些客人的行为令人震惊。

examples.en: The similarities between the two have often been remarked on.
examples.zh: 人们经常谈到两者的相似之处。

intro.en: These are all words for something that you say or write, especially something that gives information or an opinion.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指口头或书面的说明、宣布。

items.def: something that you say or write that gives information or an opinion, often in a formal way:
items.zh: 通常指正式的说明、声明、陈述、报告

examples.en: A government spokesperson made a statement to the press.
examples.zh: 政府发言人向新闻界发表了一份声明。

items.def: something that you say or write that gives an opinion on something or is a response to a question about a particular situation:
items.zh: 指议论、评论、意见

examples.en: She made helpful comments on my work.
examples.zh: 她对我的工作提出了有益的意见。

items.def: a spoken or written statement that informs people about something:
items.zh: 指公告、布告、通告

examples.en: the announcement of a peace agreement
examples.zh: 和平协议公告

items.def: something that you say or write that gives an opinion or thought about somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指谈论、言论、评述

examples.en: He made a number of rude remarks about the food.
examples.zh: 关于这里的食物他说了许多无礼的评论。

items.def: (rather formal) an official or formal statement, especially one that states an intention, belief or feeling, or that gives information:
items.zh: 指官方或正式的公告、宣告、宣言、声明

examples.en: the declaration of war
examples.zh: 宣战

items.def: (rather formal) a comment, especially one based on something you have seen, heard or read:
items.zh: 尤指根据所见、所闻、所读而作的评论

examples.en: He began by making a few general observations about the report.
examples.zh: 开头他先对这个报告作了几点概括性的评论。

intro.en: These words all mean to say or write a fact or opinion.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指口头或书面说明事实或发表意见。

items.def: to express an opinion or give facts about something:
items.zh: 指发表意见或说明事实

examples.en: He refused to comment until after the trial.
examples.zh: 他拒绝在审判前作任何评论。

items.def: (rather formal) to mention something because it is important or interesting:
items.zh: 指特别提到或指出

examples.en: He noted in passing that the company’s record on safety issues was not good.
examples.zh: 他顺便提到该公司在安全方面的记录不好。

items.def: to say or write what you have noticed about a situation:
items.zh: 指说起、谈论、评论

examples.en: Critics remarked that the play was not original.
examples.zh: 评论家们指出这部戏剧缺乏创意。

items.def: (formal) to say or write what you have noticed about a situation:
items.zh: 指说起、谈论、评论

examples.en: She observed that it was getting late.
examples.zh: 她说天色晚了。

senses.def: unusual or surprising in a way that causes people to take notice
senses.zh: 非凡的；奇异的；显著的；引人注目的

examples.en: a remarkable achievement/career/talent
examples.zh: 非凡的成就／事业／才能

examples.en: She was a truly remarkable woman.
examples.zh: 她是一位真正非同凡响的女人。

examples.en: What is even more remarkable about the whole thing is…
examples.zh: 整件事情更引人注目的是⋯

examples.en: The area is remarkable for its scenery.
examples.zh: 这一地区以其优美的景色而引人注目。

examples.en: It is remarkable that nobody noticed sooner.
examples.zh: 竟然没有人早点发现，真有意思。

senses.def: in a way that is unusual or surprising and causes people to take notice
senses.zh: 非凡地；奇异地；显著地；引人注目地

examples.en: The car is in remarkably good condition for its age.
examples.zh: 就车龄而论，这辆车的状况好极了。

examples.en: Remarkably, nobody was killed.
examples.zh: 出奇的是竟然无人丧生。

examples.en: The two reports are remarkably similar.
examples.zh: 两份报告非常相似。

senses.def: the act of marrying again after being divorced or after your husband or wife has died

examples.en: the rising rate of divorce and remarriage
examples.zh: 离婚率和再婚率上升

senses.def: to marry again after being divorced or after your husband or wife has died

examples.en: After his wife died, he swore he would never remarry.
examples.zh: 他妻子死后，他发誓绝不再婚。

senses.def: to make a new master

examples.en: All the tracks have been digitally remastered from the original tapes.
examples.zh: 所有的曲子都已经从原始录音带转录到了数码母带上。

senses.def: a match or game played again between the same people or teams, especially because neither side won the first match or game
senses.zh: （尤指因首轮未决出胜负）重赛，复赛

senses.def: that can be solved or cured

examples.en: remediable problems/diseases
examples.zh: 可以解决的问题；可治愈的疾病

senses.def: aimed at solving a problem, especially when this involves correcting or improving something that has been done wrong
senses.zh: 旨在解决问题的；补救的；纠正的

examples.en: remedial treatment (= for a medical problem)
examples.zh: 治疗

examples.en: Remedial action must be taken now.
examples.zh: 现在必须进行补救。

examples.en: The building needs urgent remedial work to make it safe.
examples.zh: 该建筑需要紧急修复工作以确保其安全。

senses.def: connected with school students who are slower at learning than others

examples.en: remedial education
examples.zh: 补习教育

examples.en: a remedial class
examples.zh: 补习班

examples.en: She teaches remedial English.
examples.zh: 她教英语补习。

senses.def: to improve something or correct something that is wrong, especially to change or stop damage to the environment
senses.zh: 补救；纠正；（尤指对环境破坏的）整改，制止

examples.en: The problems need to be detected and remediated quickly.
examples.zh: 这些问题得迅速查明并加以纠正。

examples.en: Plants can remediate contaminated soil.
examples.zh: 植物可以修复受污染的土壤。

examples.en: a course designed to remediate English and math skills
examples.zh: 旨在补习英语和数学技能的课程

senses.def: the process of improving something or correcting something that is wrong, especially changing or stopping damage to the environment
senses.zh: 补救；纠正；（尤指对环境破坏的）整改，制止

examples.en: remediation of contaminated soil
examples.zh: 受污染土壤的改善

senses.def: a way of dealing with or improving an unpleasant or difficult situation
senses.zh: 处理方法；改进措施；补偿

examples.en: When the reservoir becomes blocked, the only remedy lies in cleaning the entire system.
examples.zh: 水库堵塞，唯一的解决办法就是疏浚整个系统。

examples.en: There is no simple remedy for unemployment.
examples.zh: 失业问题没有简单的解决办法。

examples.en: There are a number of possible remedies to this problem.
examples.zh: 这个问题有许多可能采取的解决办法。

senses.def: a treatment or medicine to cure a disease or reduce pain that is not very serious

examples.en: He took a herbal remedy for his hay fever.
examples.zh: 他服用草药治疗花粉热。

examples.en: an excellent home remedy for sore throats
examples.zh: 治疗咽喉疼痛的极佳的家庭疗法

senses.def: a way of dealing with a problem, using the processes of the law
senses.zh: （通过法律程序的）解决方法，救济

examples.en: Holding copyright provides the only legal remedy against unauthorized copying.
examples.zh: 持有版权是制止盗版的唯一法律手段。

examples.en: What’s my remedy in law in this case?
examples.zh: 在这种情况下，我可以采取什么法律补救措施？

senses.def: to correct or improve something

examples.en: to remedy a problem
examples.zh: 解决问题

examples.en: This situation is easily remedied.
examples.zh: 这种情形易于补救。

senses.def: to have or keep an image in your memory of an event, a person, a place, etc. from the past

examples.en: This is Carla. Do you remember her?
examples.zh: 这位是卡拉。你记得她吗？

examples.en: I don't remember my first day at school.
examples.zh: 我已经忘了第一天上学的情景。

examples.en: I'll always remember this holiday.
examples.zh: 我将永远记住这个假期。

examples.en: She doesn't remember a thing about it.
examples.zh: 她对此一无所知。

examples.en: She fondly remembered her early years in India.
examples.zh: 她对早年在印度度过的日子充满愉快的回忆。

examples.en: He still remembered her as the lively teenager he'd known years before.
examples.zh: 他记忆中的她依然是他多年以前认识的那个活泼的少女。

examples.en: I remember her from university .
examples.zh: 我从大学起就记得她。

examples.en: He will be remembered with affection by all who knew him.
examples.zh: 所有认识他的人都会深情地怀念他。

examples.en: As far as I can remember, this is the third time we've met.
examples.zh: 我记得这是我们第三次会面了。

examples.en: I remember seeing pictures of him when I was a child.
examples.zh: 我记得我小时候看到过他的照片。

examples.en: Do you remember switching the lights off before we came out?
examples.zh: 你记得我们出来之前关灯了吗？

examples.en: I remember thinking what a brilliant idea that was.
examples.zh: 我记得我当时想这是一个多么绝妙的主意。

examples.en: I remember reading something in the paper about that.
examples.zh: 我记得在报纸上读过一些有关此事的内容。

examples.en: I remember watching the film on television.
examples.zh: 我记得在电视上看过这部电影。

examples.en: I can still vividly remember my grandfather teaching me to play cards.
examples.zh: 爷爷教我打纸牌的情景我记忆犹新。

examples.en: I seem to remember the film being genuinely scary.
examples.zh: 我似乎记得这部电影真的很恐怖。

examples.en: I can't remember his taking a single day off work.
examples.zh: 我不记得他请过哪怕一天假。

examples.en: I remember (that) we used to go and see them most weekends.
examples.zh: 我记得我们过去经常在周末去看望他们。

senses.group: somebody/something from the past 过去的人／事物

senses.def: to bring back to your mind a fact, piece of information, etc. that you knew

examples.en: You were going to help me with this. Remember?
examples.zh: 你说要帮着我做的。记得吗？

examples.en: If I remember correctly, you were supposed to collect the keys on your way here.
examples.zh: 如果我没记错的话，你应该在来这里的路上去取钥匙。

examples.en: I'm sorry—I can't remember your name.
examples.zh: 对不起，我想不起你的名字了。

examples.en: I can't remember a time when I didn't feel this way.
examples.zh: 我不记得什么时候我没有这种感觉。

examples.en: He couldn't remember the words to any of the songs.
examples.zh: 他不记得任何一首歌的歌词。

examples.en: Can you remember how much money we spent?
examples.zh: 你能回忆起我们花了多少钱吗？

examples.en: He was trying to remember where he had parked his car the night before.
examples.zh: 他努力回忆前一天晚上他把车停在哪里。

examples.en: Remember that we're going out tonight.
examples.zh: 别忘了我们今天晚上要出去。

senses.def: to keep an important fact in your mind

examples.en: Remember (that) you may feel sleepy after taking the pills.
examples.zh: 记住，吃了这些药片之后，你可能会犯困。

examples.en: It is important to remember that exercise and a balanced diet are the foundation of any successful fitness plan.
examples.zh: 重要的是要记住，运动和均衡饮食是任何成功的健身计划的基础。

examples.en: The thing to remember is that all of this will take time.
examples.zh: 要记住的是，所有这一切都需要时间。

examples.en: You have to remember that he is still recovering from injury.
examples.zh: 你必须记住，他仍在从伤病中恢复。

examples.en: You need to remember that the court has a very wide discretion in such cases.
examples.zh: 您需要记住，法院在此类案件中拥有非常广泛的自由裁量权。

examples.en: It should be remembered that the majority of accidents happen in the home.
examples.zh: 不要忘记大多数事故都是在家里发生的。

senses.def: to not forget to do something; to actually do what you have to do
senses.zh: 记着，不忘（去做）；动手做（必须做的事）

examples.en: Remember to call me when you arrive!
examples.zh: 你到了之后别忘了给我打电话！

examples.en: Remember to keep your doors and windows locked—even if you're in the back garden.
examples.zh: 即使您在后花园，也要记得锁好门窗。

examples.en: Please remember to include a contact telephone number.
examples.zh: 请记住附上联系电话号码。

examples.en: I must remember to check which day they are due to start.
examples.zh: 我必须记得检查他们预计哪一天开始。

examples.en: Just remember to take your mosquito repellent.
examples.zh: 请记住带上驱蚊剂。

examples.en: Did you remember your homework (= to bring it)?
examples.zh: 你记得带家庭作业了吗？

senses.group: something you have to do 必做之事

senses.def: to think about somebody with respect, especially when saying a prayer

examples.en: a church service to remember the war dead
examples.zh: 纪念战争死难者的教堂礼拜仪式

senses.def: to give money, a present, etc. to somebody/something

examples.en: My aunt always remembers my birthday (= by sending a card or present).
examples.zh: 我姨妈在我的生日总要送我礼物。

examples.en: His grandfather remembered him (= left him money) in his will.
examples.zh: 他爷爷在遗嘱中给他留下了一笔钱。

senses.def: to be famous or known for a particular thing that you have done in the past
senses.zh: 因某事而成名（或名留青史）

examples.en: He is best remembered as the man who brought jazz to England.
examples.zh: 他因为将爵士音乐传到英国而为人们所熟知。

examples.en: She is best remembered for her first book, ‘In the Ditch’.
examples.zh: 她因第一部作品《在沟里 》为人们所熟知。

items.idm: be (best) remembered for something | be (best) remembered as something

senses.def: to be famous or known for a particular thing that you have done in the past
senses.zh: 因某事而成名（或名留青史）

examples.en: He is best remembered as the man who brought jazz to England.
examples.zh: 他因为将爵士音乐传到英国而为人们所熟知。

examples.en: She is best remembered for her first book, ‘In the Ditch’.
examples.zh: 她因第一部作品《在沟里 》为人们所熟知。

senses.def: used to ask somebody to give your good wishes to somebody else

examples.en: Remember me to your parents.
examples.zh: 代我向你的父母问好。

senses.def: the act or process of remembering an event in the past or a person who is dead

examples.en: A service was held in remembrance of local soldiers killed in the war.
examples.zh: 为当地阵亡的战士举行了纪念仪式。

examples.en: a remembrance service
examples.zh: 纪念仪式

examples.en: He smiled at the remembrance of their first kiss.
examples.zh: 他想起了他们的初吻，露出了微笑。

examples.en: a chapel/garden of remembrance (= in memory of people who have died)
examples.zh: 纪念死者的教堂／庭园

senses.def: an object that causes you to remember somebody/something; a memory of somebody/something
senses.zh: 纪念品；纪念物；一段记忆

examples.en: The cenotaph stands as a remembrance of those killed during the war.
examples.zh: 矗立着的纪念碑是对战争中死难者的纪念。

examples.en: The group shared their remembrances of life at school.
examples.zh: 小组成员分享了他们在学校生活的回忆。

senses.def: the Sunday nearest to the 11 November on which those killed in war, especially the wars of 1914–18 and 1939–45, are remembered in ceremonies and church services in the UK and some other countries
senses.zh: 阵亡将士纪念日（最接近 11 月 11 日的星期天。英国和其他一些国家为战争中的死难者，尤为两次世界大战中的阵亡者举行纪念仪式和教堂礼拜仪式）

senses.def: to help somebody remember something, especially something important that they must do

examples.en: I'm sorry, I've forgotten your name. Can you remind me?
examples.zh: 对不起，我忘了你的名字。提醒我一下好吗？

examples.en: That (= what you have just said, done, etc.) reminds me, I must get some cash.
examples.zh: 那倒提醒了我，我得带上一些现金。

examples.en: ‘You need to finish that essay.’ ‘Don't remind me (= I don't want to think about it).’
examples.zh: “你要完成那篇论文。”“别提啦！”

examples.en: ‘Don't forget the camera.’ ‘Remind me about it nearer the time.’
examples.zh: “别忘了带相机。”“到时候再提醒我一下。”

examples.en: I loved her and wanted to remind her of that.
examples.zh: 我爱她并想提醒她这一点。

examples.en: Your advertisements should remind people of your great location.
examples.zh: 您的广告应该提醒人们您的优越地理位置。

examples.en: Remind me to phone Alan before I go out.
examples.zh: 提醒我在出去之前给艾伦打电话。

examples.en: Passengers are reminded that smoking is not allowed on this train.
examples.zh: 乘客们请注意，本次列车禁止吸烟。

examples.en: The paper reminded its readers that 4,500 soldiers were killed on the first day of the Normandy landings.
examples.zh: 该报提醒读者，诺曼底登陆第一天就有 4,500 名士兵阵亡。

examples.en: Members are reminded that the club's annual general meeting will take place on Thursday.
examples.zh: 请会员注意，俱乐部年度股东大会将于周四举行。

examples.en: The bathroom mirror constantly reminds me that I am getting old.
examples.zh: 浴室的镜子不断提醒我，我正在变老。

examples.en: He likes to remind everyone that he is a US senator.
examples.zh: 他喜欢提醒大家，他是美国参议员。

examples.en: I have to keep reminding myself that things could be much worse.
examples.zh: 我必须不断提醒自己，事情可能会更糟。

examples.en: Can someone remind me what I should do next?
examples.zh: 谁能告诉我下一步该做什么？

examples.en: ‘You had an accident,’ he reminded her.
examples.zh: 他提醒她道：“你出过一次事故了。”

senses.def: if somebody/something reminds
senses.zh: 使想起（类似的人、地方、事物等）

examples.en: You remind me of your father when you say that.
examples.zh: 你说那样的话，使我想起了你的父亲。

examples.en: That smell reminds me of France.
examples.zh: 那股气味使我想起了法国。

examples.en: to remind somebody a little/a bit/a lot/very much of somebody/something
examples.zh: 提醒某人一点/一点/很多/非常想起某人/某事

senses.def: something that makes you think about or remember somebody/something, that you have forgotten or would like to forget
senses.zh: 引起回忆的事物；提醒人的事物

examples.en: The sheer size of the cathedral is a constant reminder of the power of religion.
examples.zh: 大教堂的宏大规模使人时时感受到宗教的威严。

examples.en: The incident served as a timely reminder of just how dangerous mountaineering can be.
examples.zh: 这次事故及时地提醒了人们登山运动有时会有多危险。

examples.en: The article concludes with a chilling reminder that the disease can strike anyone at any time.
examples.zh: 文章最后令人不寒而栗地提醒人们，这种疾病可以随时袭击任何人。

senses.def: a letter or note informing somebody that they have not done something
senses.zh: （告知该做某事的）通知单，提示信

examples.en: If an invoice is not paid within seven days, we automatically send out a reminder.
examples.zh: 如果账单在七天内未支付，我们将自动发出提醒信息。

senses.def: to think, talk or write about a happy time in your past
senses.zh: 回忆，追忆，缅怀（昔日的快乐时光）

examples.en: We spent a happy evening reminiscing about the past.
examples.zh: 我们一晚上回忆往事，感到很愉快。

senses.def: a spoken or written description of something that somebody remembers about their past life

examples.en: The book is a collection of his reminiscences about the actress.
examples.zh: 这本书辑录了他对那位女演员的回忆。

examples.en: reminiscences of a wartime childhood
examples.zh: 战时童年生活的回忆录

senses.def: the act of remembering things that happened in the past

examples.en: The role of reminiscence in family history research should never be underestimated.
examples.zh: 回忆录在家族史研究中所起的作用绝不应被低估。

senses.def: something that reminds you of something similar
senses.zh: 使人想起类似事物的东西；引起联想的相似事物

examples.en: Her music is full of reminiscences of African rhythms.
examples.zh: 她的音乐总是使人联想到非洲音乐的节奏。

senses.def: reminding you of somebody/something

examples.en: The way he laughed was strongly reminiscent of his father.
examples.zh: 他笑的样子让人很容易想起他的父亲。

examples.en: She writes in a style reminiscent of both Proust and Faulkner.
examples.zh: 她的写作风格让人想起普鲁斯特和福克纳。

senses.def: showing that you are thinking about the past, especially in a way that causes you pleasure
senses.zh: 回忆过去的；怀旧的；缅怀往事的

examples.en: a reminiscent smile
examples.zh: 追忆往事时露出的微笑

senses.def: not giving something enough care and attention

examples.en: It was remiss of them not to inform us of these changes sooner.
examples.zh: 他们粗心大意，没有早一些通知我们这些变化。

examples.en: She had clearly been remiss in her duty.
examples.zh: 她在工作中显然马马虎虎。

senses.def: a period during which a serious illness improves for a time and the patient seems to get better

examples.en: The patient has been in remission for the past six months.
examples.zh: 在过去的六个月中，病人的病情已经有所缓解。

examples.en: The symptoms reappeared after only a short remission.
examples.zh: 短暂的康复之后，症状再次出现。

examples.en: a period of remission
examples.zh: 缓解期

senses.def: a reduction in the amount of time somebody spends in prison, especially because they have behaved well

examples.en: With remission for good behaviour, he could be out by the end of the year.
examples.zh: 由于表现良好，病情得到缓解，他可能会在今年年底出院。

examples.en: She has been granted a remission of sentence.
examples.zh: 她已获得减刑。

examples.en: He lost two months’ remission after he attacked another prisoner.
examples.zh: 在袭击另一名囚犯后，他失去了两个月的缓解期。

senses.def: an act of reducing or cancelling the amount of money that somebody has to pay

examples.en: New businesses may qualify for tax remission.
examples.zh: 新的企业有资格享受税收减免。

examples.en: There is a partial remission of fees for overseas students.
examples.zh: 对留学生可以减免部分费用。

senses.def: the area of activity over which a particular person or group has authority, control or influence
senses.zh: 职权范围；控制范围；影响范围

examples.en: Such decisions are outside the remit of this committee.

to send or bring somebody back to their own country

examples.en: The refugees were forcibly repatriated.
examples.zh: 难民被强制遣送回国。

examples.en: The insurance will cover the costs of repatriating you and your family in the case of an accident.
examples.zh: 该保险将承担发生事故时将您和您的家人遣返的费用。

examples.en: Tourists who are injured or fall sick are repatriated.
examples.zh: 受伤或染病的旅游者会遣送回国。

senses.def: to send money or profits back to your own country
senses.zh: 寄（钱）回国；将（利润）调回本国

examples.en: An agreement between the countries enables companies to repatriate their profits freely.
examples.zh: 两国之间的协议使公司能够自由汇回利润。

senses.def: the act of sending or bringing somebody back to their own country

examples.en: the repatriation of refugees
examples.zh: 难民遣返

examples.en: a voluntary repatriation programme for foreign nationals
examples.zh: 外国人自愿遣返计划

examples.en: If someone dies abroad, insurance may not cover the repatriation of their body.
examples.zh: 如在国外去世，保险可能不包括遗体遣返费用。

senses.def: the act of sending money or profits back to your own country

examples.en: the repatriation of profits
examples.zh: 利润调拨回国

senses.def: to pay back the money that you have borrowed from somebody

examples.en: to repay a debt/loan/mortgage
examples.zh: 偿还债务／贷款／按揭贷款

examples.en: I'll repay the money I owe them next week.
examples.zh: 我将在下个星期偿还欠他们的钱。

examples.en: The advance must be repaid to the publisher if the work is not completed on time.
examples.zh: 如果作品没有按时完成，预付款必须返还给出版商。

examples.en: When are you going to repay them?
examples.zh: 你什么时候把钱还给他们？

examples.en: I fully intend to repay them the money that they lent me.
examples.zh: 我非常想把他们借给我的钱还给他们。

examples.en: I'll repay you for the ticket next week.
examples.zh: 我会在下周还你票钱。

senses.def: to give something to somebody or do something for them in return for something that they have done for you

examples.en: How can I ever repay you for your generosity?
examples.zh: 你对我这样慷慨，我怎么才能报答你呢？

examples.en: Their trust was repaid with fierce loyalty.
examples.zh: 他们的信任获得的回报是忠心耿耿。

senses.def: if something repays

examples.en: The report repays careful reading.
examples.zh: 这份报告值得仔细阅读。

examples.en: The charter can be seen in the town museum, which more than repays a visit.
examples.zh: 该宪章可以在镇博物馆看到，而这个博物馆确实值得去参观一下。

senses.def: that can or must be paid back
senses.zh: 可偿还的；必须偿还的；应回报的

examples.en: The loan is repayable in monthly instalments.
examples.zh: 这笔借款能以按月摊付的方式偿还。

examples.en: The sum is wholly repayable within five years.
examples.zh: 该款项须于五年内全部偿还。

senses.def: the act of paying back money that you have borrowed from a bank, etc.

examples.en: The loan is due for repayment by the end of the year.
examples.zh: 这笔借款要在年底还清。

examples.en: debt repayment
examples.zh: 小规模生产

examples.en: We offer flexible repayment terms.
examples.zh: 我们提供灵活的还款条件。

examples.en: The normal repayment period is five years.
examples.zh: 正常的偿还期是五年。

senses.def: a sum of money that you pay regularly to a bank, etc. until you have returned all the money that you owe
senses.zh: 按期偿还的款项；分期偿还额

examples.en: We were unable to meet (= pay) the repayments on the loan.
examples.zh: 我们无法支付贷款的分期偿还额。

examples.en: The monthly mortgage repayments are quite high.
examples.zh: 每个月的抵押贷款还款额相当高。

examples.en: monthly/weekly repayments
examples.zh: 每月/每周还款

synonyms.words: premium ▪ contribution ▪ subscription ▪ repayment ▪ deposit ▪ instalment

intro.en: These are all words for an amount of money that you pay or are expected to pay, or for the act of paying.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指款额、款项、付款。

items.def: an amount of money that you pay or are expected to pay; the act of paying:
items.zh: 指款额、款项、付款

examples.en: ten monthly payments of $50
examples.zh: 每月付款 50 美元，十次付清

items.def: an amount of money that you pay once or regularly for an insurance policy; an extra payment added to the basic rate; a higher amount of money than usual:
items.zh: 指保险费、额外费用、附加费、溢价

examples.en: an insurance premium
examples.zh: 保险费

items.def: a sum of money that you pay regularly to your employer or the government in order to pay for benefits such as health insurance, a pension, etc:
items.zh: 指（给雇主或政府用作医疗保险、养老金等福利的）定期缴款

examples.en: You can increase your monthly contributions to the pension plan.
examples.zh: 你可以增加你的养老金计划每月供款。

items.def: an amount of money you pay in advance to receive a service:
items.zh: 指（服务的）订阅费、用户费

examples.en: a subscription to Netflix
examples.zh: 网飞的订阅费

items.def: (British English英式英语) an amount of money that you pay regularly to a bank, etc. until you have returned all the money that you owe; the act of paying this money:
items.zh: 指按期偿还的款项、分期偿还额、偿还债务、归还借款

examples.en: the repayments on the loan
examples.zh: 贷款的分期偿还额

items.def: an amount of money that you pay as the first part of a larger payment:
items.zh: 指订金

examples.en: We've put down a 5 per cent deposit on the house.
examples.zh: 我们已支付了房款的 5% 作为订金。

items.def: one of a number of payments that you make regularly over a period of time until you have paid for something:
items.zh: 指分期付款的一期付款

examples.en: We paid for the car by/​in instalments.
examples.zh: 我们以分期付款买了这辆车。

senses.def: a type of mortgage
the act of repealing

examples.en: the repeal of the Corn Laws in 1846
examples.zh: 1846 年废除《谷物法》

senses.def: if a government or other group or person with authority repeals

examples.en: The committee does not have the power to repeal the ban.
examples.zh: 委员会无权取消禁令。

senses.def: to say or write something again or more than once

examples.en: to repeat a question/a claim/an assertion/a warning
examples.zh: 再次提问／声明／断言／警告

examples.en: to repeat a phrase/mantra
examples.zh: 重复一个短语/口头禅

examples.en: She repeated the word several times.
examples.zh: 她把这个词重复了好几次。

examples.en: I'm sorry—could you repeat that?
examples.zh: 对不起，你可以再说一遍吗？

examples.en: She kept repeating his name softly over and over again.
examples.zh: 她轻声地一遍又一遍地重复着他的名字。

examples.en: The opposition have been repeating their calls for the president's resignation.
examples.zh: 反对派一再要求总统辞职。

examples.en: Are you prepared to repeat these allegations in court?
examples.zh: 您准备好在法庭上重复这些指控了吗？

examples.en: I mentioned it before, but it bears (= is worth) repeating.
examples.zh: 我之前提到过，但值得（=值得）重复。

examples.en: Do say if I'm repeating myself (= if I have already said this).
examples.zh: 如果我在重复自己说过的话，请直言。

examples.en: He's fond of repeating that the company's success is all down to him.
examples.zh: 他老爱说公司的成功全都归功于他。

examples.en: ‘Are you really sure?’ she repeated.
examples.zh: “你真的很肯定吗？”她再次问道。

senses.def: used to emphasize something that you have already said

examples.en: The claims are, I repeat, totally unfounded.
examples.zh: 我再说一遍，这些说法是毫无根据的。

examples.en: Nor, to repeat, can these changes be avoided.
examples.zh: 再说一遍，这些变化也是无法避免的。

examples.en: I am not, repeat not, travelling in the same car as him!
examples.zh: 我不会，再说一遍，不会和他坐同一辆车的！

senses.def: to say something that somebody else has said, especially in order to learn it

examples.en: The teacher's statement is then repeated by the students.
examples.zh: 然后学生重复老师的话。

examples.en: Listen and repeat each sentence after me.
examples.zh: 先听再跟着我朗读每个句子。

examples.en: Can you repeat what I've just said word for word?
examples.zh: 你能一字不差地复述我刚才说过的话吗？

examples.en: ‘We were both asleep and didn’t hear anything,’ she repeated.
examples.zh: “我们都睡着了，什么也没听到，”她重复道。

senses.group: what somebody else said 他人的话

senses.def: to tell somebody something that you have heard or been told by somebody else

examples.en: I don't want you to repeat a word of this to anyone.
examples.zh: 这些话你一个字也不要告诉别人。

examples.en: The rumour has been widely repeated in the press.
examples.zh: 报界广泛转载了这一传闻。

senses.group: what somebody else said 他人的话

senses.def: to do or produce something again or more than once

examples.en: to repeat a mistake/process
examples.zh: 重复错误／过程

examples.en: to repeat an experiment/exercise
examples.zh: 重复实验／练习

examples.en: Organizers are hoping to repeat the success of last year's event.
examples.zh: 组织者希望复制去年活动的成功。
