examples.en: He won his first Monaco Grand Prix in 1994 and repeated the feat in 1995, 1997 and 1999.
examples.zh: 他于 1994 年首次赢得摩纳哥大奖赛冠军，并于 1995 年、1997 年和 1999 年再次实现这一壮举。

examples.en: The treatment should be repeated every two to three hours.
examples.zh: 这种治疗方法应该每隔两到三小时重复一次。

examples.en: They are hoping to repeat last year's victory.
examples.zh: 他们希望重复去年的胜利。

examples.en: These offers are unlikely to be repeated.
examples.zh: 这样的出价不大可能再有了。

examples.en: The programmes will be repeated next year.
examples.zh: 明年将继续开设这些课程。

examples.en: to repeat a class/year/grade (= in a school, to take a class/year/grade again)
examples.zh: 重读班级/年级/年级（= 在学校，再次参加班级/年级/年级）

examples.en: Lift and lower the right leg 20 times. Repeat with the left leg.
examples.zh: 将右腿提放 20 次，换左腿重复同样的动作。

senses.def: to happen more than once in the same way

examples.en: History has a strange way of repeating itself.
examples.zh: 历史会奇怪地重演。

examples.en: This phrase is repeated at intervals throughout the song.
examples.zh: 这句话在整首歌中不时重复。

examples.en: a repeating pattern/design
examples.zh: 重复出现的图案／设计

examples.en: A single note repeated over and over again, throbbing in my head.
examples.zh: 一个音符反复出现在我的脑海中。

senses.def: if food repeats

examples.en: Do you find that onions repeat on you?
examples.zh: 你是不是觉得吃了洋葱嘴里老有一股味儿？

senses.def: an event that is very similar to something that happened before
senses.zh: 重演的事物；重复的事件

examples.en: She didn't want a repeat performance of what had happened the night before.
examples.zh: 她不想让前一天晚上的事重演。

examples.en: A repeat of the 1906 earthquake could kill up to 11 000 people.
examples.zh: 如果再次发生 1906 年的地震，可能会有多达 11 000 人死亡。

examples.en: a repeat order (= for a further supply of the same goods)
examples.zh: 续订货单

examples.en: a repeat prescription (= for more of the same medicine)
examples.zh: 重复处方

examples.en: a repeat offender (= somebody who commits a crime again)
examples.zh: 惯犯

examples.en: revenues generated from repeat business
examples.zh: 重复业务产生的收入

examples.en: Something needs to be done urgently to prevent a repeat of this incident.
examples.zh: 需要紧急采取一些措施来防止此类事件再次发生。

senses.def: a television or radio programme that has been broadcast before
senses.zh: 重播的电视（或广播）节目

examples.en: ‘Is it a new series?’ ‘No, a repeat.’
examples.zh: “这是新播出的连续剧吗？”“不，是重播的。”

senses.def: a passage that is repeated
polite and not offensive

examples.en: His reply was not repeatable.
examples.zh: 他的回答不便重复。

senses.def: that can be repeated

examples.en: Are the results repeatable?
examples.zh: 结果可重复吗？

senses.def: many times

examples.en: He has repeatedly denied the claims.
examples.zh: 他一再否认这些说法。

senses.def: a gun that you can fire several times without having to load it again
a decimal
a second chance for competitors who were not successful in an earlier round to qualify for the next round of the competition

examples.en: The Italian team came through the repêchage to take bronze in the final.
examples.zh: 意大利队闯过复活赛，在决赛中夺得铜牌。

senses.def: to successfully fight somebody who is attacking you, your country, etc. and drive them away

examples.en: to repel an attack/invasion/invader
examples.zh: 击退进攻／入侵；驱逐入侵者

examples.en: Troops repelled an attempt to infiltrate the south of the island.
examples.zh: 部队挫败了对该岛南部的渗透企图。

examples.en: The reptile's prickly skin repels nearly all of its predators.
examples.zh: 这种爬行动物浑身是刺，几乎所有的捕食者都退避三舍。

senses.def: to drive, push or keep something away

examples.en: a cream that repels insects
examples.zh: 驱除昆虫的乳剂

examples.en: The fabric has been treated to repel water.
examples.zh: 这种织物进行过防水处理。

senses.def: to make somebody feel horror or disgust

examples.en: I was repelled by the smell.
examples.zh: 这种气味让我恶心。

senses.def: if one thing repels

examples.en: Like poles repel each other.
examples.zh: 同极相斥。

senses.def: very unpleasant; causing strong dislike
senses.zh: 使人反感的；令人厌恶的

examples.en: I found the pictures repellent.
examples.zh: 我发现这些照片令人厌恶。

examples.en: Their political ideas are repellent to most people.
examples.zh: 他们的政治观点令大多数人反感。

senses.def: not letting a particular substance, especially water, pass through it

examples.en: water-repellent cloth
examples.zh: 防水布

examples.en: mutually repellent substances such as oil and water
examples.zh: 如油和水这类不融合的物质

senses.def: a substance that is used for keeping insects away from you

examples.en: (an) insect repellent
examples.zh: 驱虫剂

examples.en: mosquito repellent
examples.zh: 驱蚊剂

senses.def: a substance that is used on cloth, stone, etc. to prevent water from passing through it

examples.en: (a) water repellent
examples.zh: 防水剂

senses.def: to feel and show that you are sorry for something bad or wrong that you have done

examples.en: God welcomes the sinner who repents.
examples.zh: 上帝欢迎悔过的罪人。

examples.en: She had repented of what she had done.
examples.zh: 她对自己所做的事深感懊悔。

examples.en: He came to repent his hasty decision (= wished he had not taken it).
examples.zh: 他开始后悔自己的草率决定。

examples.en: I will spend the rest of my life trying to repent for my actions.
examples.zh: 我将在对自己所作所为的忏悔中度过余生。

senses.def: the fact of showing that you are sorry for something wrong that you have done

examples.en: He shows no sign of repentance.
examples.zh: 他毫无悔意。

examples.en: The book speaks of the need for repentance and atonement.
examples.zh: 这本书谈到了悔改和赎罪的需要。

examples.en: They were released on parole for showing signs of repentance.
examples.zh: 由于有悔改的表示，他们获得假释。

examples.en: Sins are wiped out by sincere repentance.
examples.zh: 罪恶通过真诚的忏悔消除了。

senses.def: feeling or showing that you are sorry for something wrong that you have done
senses.zh: 后悔的；悔过的；表示悔改的

examples.en: She was not in the least repentant.
examples.zh: 她没有丝毫悔改的意思。

examples.en: His words left us all feeling suitably repentant.
examples.zh: 他的话让我们都感到适当的悔改。

examples.en: She wanted to show how deeply repentant she was.
examples.zh: 她想表明她有多么深刻的悔改。

senses.def: an indirect and usually bad result of an action or event that may happen some time afterwards

examples.en: The collapse of the company will have repercussions for the whole industry.
examples.zh: 这家公司的垮台将会给整个行业造成间接的负面影响。

intro.en: These are all words for a thing that is caused because of something else.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示后果、结果。

items.def: a thing that is caused or produced by something else:
items.zh: 指后果、结果

examples.en: She died as a result of her injuries.
examples.zh: 她因伤死亡。

items.def: (rather formal) a result of something that has happened, especially a bad result:
items.zh: 尤指不好的结果、后果

examples.en: This decision could have serious consequences for the industry.
examples.zh: 这项决定可能对该行业造成严重后果。

items.def: the result of an action or process:
items.zh: 指行动或过程的结果、效果

examples.en: We are waiting to hear the final outcome of the negotiations.
examples.zh: 我们在等待谈判的最终结果。

items.def: (rather formal) an indirect and usually bad result of an action or event that may happen some time afterwards.
items.zh: 指一段时间后出现的间接的影响，通常指不良反响、恶果

senses.def: all the plays, songs, pieces of music, etc. that a performer knows and can perform

examples.en: to add to/extend your repertoire
examples.zh: 增加/扩展你的曲目

examples.en: a pianist with a wide repertoire
examples.zh: 能演奏很多曲子的钢琴师

senses.def: all the things that a person is able to do

examples.en: a young child’s growing verbal repertoire
examples.zh: 小孩不断增长的语言表达能力

senses.def: the type of work of a theatre company in which different plays are performed for short periods of time

examples.en: an actor in repertory
examples.zh: 参加轮演剧目的演员

examples.en: a repertory company
examples.zh: 轮演剧目剧团

senses.def: repertoire
the fact of doing or saying the same thing many times

examples.en: learning by repetition
examples.zh: 通过重复来学习

examples.en: In her work we find the constant repetition of the same themes.
examples.zh: 在她的作品中，我们发现相同主题的不断重复。

senses.def: a thing that has been done or said before

examples.en: We do not want to see a repetition of last year's tragic events.
examples.zh: 我们不想看到去年的悲剧重演。

examples.en: If you can, perform multiple repetitions of this exercise on each hand.
examples.zh: 如果可能，每只手都反复进行这一练习。

senses.def: involving something that is often repeated, in a way that becomes boring
senses.zh: 重复的；一再的；重复乏味的

examples.en: a long and repetitious speech
examples.zh: 冗长重复的讲话

senses.def: repeatedly, in a way that becomes boring
senses.zh: 重复的；一再的；重复乏味的

senses.def: the fact of happening repeatedly, in a way that becomes boring
senses.zh: 重复的；一再的；重复乏味的

examples.en: Many people found its repetitiousness boring.
examples.zh: 很多人觉得它的重复很无聊。

senses.def: saying or doing the same thing many times, so that it becomes boring

examples.en: a repetitive task
examples.zh: 重复乏味的工作

senses.def: repeated many times

examples.en: a repetitive pattern of behaviour
examples.zh: 重复的行为模式

examples.en: Travel sickness is caused by the effect of repetitive movements.
examples.zh: 晕车是由重复运动的影响引起的。

senses.def: repeatedly, especially in a way that becomes boring
senses.zh: （尤指以乏味的方式）重复乏味地，反复地

examples.en: He listened with kind patience as I talked endlessly and repetitively about Joe.
examples.zh: 当我没完没了地重复谈论乔时，他耐心地听着。

senses.def: again and again, every time in the same way

examples.en: By doing these exercises repetitively, the brain learns to function better.
examples.zh: 通过重复进行这些练习，大脑可以更好地发挥作用。

senses.def: the fact of happening repeatedly, especially in a way that becomes boring

examples.en: The repetitiveness of the work really got me down after a while.
examples.zh: 工作的重复性确实让我沮丧了一段时间。

senses.def: to say or write something using different words in order to make the meaning clearer
senses.zh: 换个说法说，改变词句（以使意思更清楚）

examples.en: I suggest you rephrase that remark.
examples.zh: 我建议你换种说法。

examples.en: Let me rephrase my question.
examples.zh: 我换个方式问吧。

senses.def: to be used instead of somebody/something else; to do something instead of somebody/something else

examples.en: The new design will eventually replace all existing models.
examples.zh: 新的设计最终将会取代全部现有的型号。

examples.en: Teachers will never be replaced by computers in the classroom.
examples.zh: 课堂上电脑永远不会取代老师。

examples.en: These measures in no way replace the need for regular safety checks.
examples.zh: 这些措施绝不能取代定期安全检查的必要性。

examples.en: The weird feeling was gradually replaced by shock, and then anger.
examples.zh: 奇怪的感觉渐渐被震惊所取代，然后是愤怒。

examples.en: She replaced Dr Hales as head teacher.
examples.zh: 她接替黑尔斯博士担任校长。

examples.en: Green will replace the injured Walker in the starting line-up.
examples.zh: 格林将顶替受伤的沃克首发。

examples.en: He was selected last week to replace her on the council.
examples.zh: 上周他被选为理事会的接替者。

senses.def: to remove somebody/something and put another person or thing in their place

examples.en: He will be difficult to replace when he leaves.
examples.zh: 他离开后，他的位置很难有人接替。

examples.en: proposed changes to the constitution to replace the current system of government
examples.zh: 拟议修改宪法以取代现行政府体制

examples.en: He was replaced as party leader in 1967.
examples.zh: 1967年，他被取代为党的领导人。

examples.en: It is not a good idea to miss meals and replace them with snacks.
examples.zh: 不吃正餐，改吃点心，这不是什么好主意。

senses.def: to change something that is old, damaged, etc. for a similar thing that is newer or better

examples.en: We're thinking of replacing our phone system.
examples.zh: 我们正在考虑更新我们的电话系统。

examples.en: to replace a window/roof
examples.zh: 更换窗户／屋顶

examples.en: to replace a battery/light bulb
examples.zh: 更换电池/灯泡

examples.en: All the old carpets need replacing.
examples.zh: 所有的旧地毯都需要更换。

examples.en: an operation to replace both hips
examples.zh: 双髋置换手术

examples.en: You'll be expected to replace any broken glasses.
examples.zh: 玻璃杯如有损坏，要负责赔偿。

examples.en: The club does not have the finances resources to replace the damaged equipment.
examples.zh: 俱乐部没有财力来更换损坏的设备。

examples.en: We will replace a faulty part immediately.
examples.zh: 我们将立即更换有故障的部件。

senses.def: to put something back in the place where it was before

examples.en: I replaced the cup carefully in the saucer.
examples.zh: 我小心翼翼地将杯子放回茶碟。

examples.en: to replace the handset (= after using the phone).
examples.zh: 放回电话听筒

senses.def: that can be replaced

examples.en: a replaceable liner
examples.zh: 可更换的内衬

examples.en: Possessions are replaceable—your family isn’t.
examples.zh: 财产是可以更换的，但你的家人却不能。

senses.def: the act of replacing one thing with another, especially something that is newer or better

examples.en: the replacement of worn car parts
examples.zh: 汽车上损坏零件的更换

senses.def: a thing that replaces something, especially because the first thing is old, broken, etc.

examples.en: She had a hip replacement six years ago.
examples.zh: 她 6 年前做了髋关节置换手术。

examples.en: If your passport is stolen you should apply for a replacement immediately.
examples.zh: 如果护照被偷，应立即申请更换。

examples.en: replacement windows
examples.zh: 新换的窗子

senses.def: a person who replaces another person in an organization, especially in their job
senses.zh: （尤指工作中的）接替者，替代者

examples.en: We need to find a replacement for Sue.
examples.zh: 我们需要找一个替代休的人。

senses.def: a game that is played again because neither side won in the previous game
senses.zh: （由于未决出胜负而进行的）重赛

examples.en: United won the replay 3–1.
examples.zh: 重赛时曼联以 3-1 获胜。

examples.en: a replay against Real Madrid
examples.zh: 对阵皇家马德里队的重赛

senses.def: the playing again of a short section of a film, tape, etc. especially to look at or listen to something more carefully
senses.zh: （录像、录音等的）重放，重演，重播

examples.en: The replay showed that the ball was over the line.
examples.zh: 视频回放证明球过线了。

senses.def: something that is repeated or happens in exactly the same way as it did before
senses.zh: 重演的事物；重复出现的事物

examples.en: This election will not be a replay of the last one.
examples.zh: 这次选举将不会是上一次的重演。

senses.def: to play a sports game again because neither team won the first game

examples.en: The game will now have to be replayed on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 比赛现在必须在周二重赛。

senses.def: to play again a video, music recording or video game

examples.en: The police replayed footage of the accident over and over again.
examples.zh: 警察一遍又一遍地重放事故的片段。

examples.en: He replayed the scene in his mind.
examples.zh: 他不断回想起当时的情景。

examples.en: You can replay the game as a different character.
examples.zh: 您可以以不同的角色重玩游戏。

senses.def: the quality in a video game, music recording, etc. of being suitable for or worth playing more than once

examples.en: To add replay value, each level has two sets of collectibles and time challenges.
examples.zh: 为了增加重玩价值，每个级别都有两套收藏品和时间挑战。

examples.en: Even the lyrics are not enough to give this song replay value.
examples.zh: 就连歌词也不足以赋予这首歌重听的价值。

senses.def: the quality in a video game, music recording, etc. of being suitable for or worth playing more than once

examples.en: This game offers a lot of content and replayability for solo play or multiplayer.
examples.zh: 该游戏提供了大量的内容和可重玩性，适合单人游戏或多人游戏。

senses.def: suitable for or worth playing more than once
senses.zh: 可重播：适合或值得多次玩

examples.en: This is a quick and highly replayable fantasy game.
examples.zh: 这是一款快速且高度可重玩的奇幻游戏。

examples.en: It's an immensely replayable new single.
examples.zh: 这是一首非常值得重玩的新单曲。

senses.def: to make something full again by replacing what has been used

examples.en: to replenish food and water supplies
examples.zh: 补充食物和水

examples.en: Allow me to replenish your glass.
examples.zh: 让我再给您斟满。

senses.def: the act of making something full again by replacing what has been used

examples.en: Computerization has enabled the automatic replenishment of stock.
examples.zh: 计算机化实现了库存的自动补充。

senses.def: filled with something; with a full supply of something

examples.en: literature replete with drama and excitement
examples.zh: 充满紧张刺激情节的文学作品

senses.def: very full of food

examples.en: We all felt pleasantly replete.
examples.zh: 我们都感到愉快而充实。

senses.def: a very good or exact copy of something

examples.en: There is even a scaled-down replica of the Eiffel Tower there.
examples.zh: 那儿甚至有一个缩小比例的埃菲尔铁塔模型。

examples.en: The weapon used in the raid was a replica.
examples.zh: 抢劫案中使用的武器是一件仿制品。

examples.en: replica guns
examples.zh: 仿制的枪支

examples.en: Amy was a younger replica of her mother.
examples.zh: 艾米是她母亲的年轻翻版。

senses.def: that can be copied exactly

examples.en: The design is easily replicable.
examples.zh: 这个设计很容易复制。

senses.def: an artificial being that is created as an exact copy of a particular human being

examples.en: Ford played Rick Deckard, a retired police officer tasked with tracking down escaped replicants.
examples.zh: 福特饰演退休警察里克·戴克，奉命追捕逃跑的复制人。

senses.def: to copy something exactly

examples.en: Subsequent experiments failed to replicate these findings.
examples.zh: 后来的实验没有得出同样的结果。

examples.en: The format of the seminar day will be replicated in each Sports Council region.
examples.zh: 研讨会日的形式将在每个体育理事会地区进行复制。

senses.def: to produce exact copies of itself

examples.en: The drug prevents the virus from replicating itself.
examples.zh: 这种药能防止病毒复制。

senses.def: the act of copying something exactly; the copy that is made
senses.zh: 复制：精确复制某物的行为；复制的副本

examples.en: an exact replication of the original experiment
examples.zh: 原始实验的精确复制

examples.en: These houses are not replications of the paintings, but were inspired by them.
examples.zh: 这些房子并不是画作的复制品，而是受到了画作的启发。

senses.def: the process by which a biological

examples.en: Vitamin B is essential for proper cell replication and growth.
examples.zh: 维生素 B 对于细胞的正常复制和生长至关重要。

senses.def: a gene
to say or write something as an answer to somebody/something

examples.en: She didn't even bother to reply.
examples.zh: 她根本就懒得回答。

examples.en: He was quick to reply.
examples.zh: 他很快就回复了。

examples.en: to reply to a question/an email/a query
examples.zh: 回答问题；回复电子邮件；解答疑问

examples.en: He hasn't replied to any of my text messages.
examples.zh: 他还没有回复我的任何短信。

examples.en: She usually replies immediately to comments on her posts.
examples.zh: 她通常会立即回复对她帖子的评论。

examples.en: She simply replied with a smile.
examples.zh: 她只是报以微笑。

examples.en: He replied to her question with a scowl.
examples.zh: 他皱着眉头回答了她的问题。

examples.en: ‘I won't let you down,’ he replied confidently.
examples.zh: 他信心十足地答道：“我不会让你失望的。”

examples.en: The senator replied that he was not in a position to comment.
examples.zh: 参议员回答说他不宜发表评论。

senses.def: to do something as a reaction to something that somebody has said or done

examples.en: Italy took an early lead but Brazil replied with two goals in the last five minutes.
examples.zh: 意大利队早早取得领先，但巴西队在最后五分钟内连进两球予以反击。

examples.en: The terrorists replied to the government's statement with more violence.
examples.zh: 恐怖分子以更多的暴力事件来回应政府的声明。

senses.def: an act of replying to something/somebody in speech, writing or by some action

examples.en: I asked her what her name was but she made no reply.
examples.zh: 我问她叫什么名字，但她没有回答。

examples.en: I received a reply from the firm's managing director.
examples.zh: 我收到了公司总经理的答复

examples.en: I got some interesting replies to my post about online banking.
examples.zh: 我那篇关于网上银行的帖子收到了一些有趣的回复。

examples.en: I am writing in reply to your letter of 16 March.
examples.zh: 3 月 16 日来函收悉，现答复如下。

examples.en: a reply-paid envelope (= on which you do not have to put a stamp because it has already been paid for)
examples.zh: 邮资已付信封

examples.en: Morocco scored four goals without reply to win the game.
examples.zh: 摩洛哥队在一球未失的情况下连入四球，赢得了这场比赛。

senses.def: a person whose job is to repossess
senses.zh: （向拖欠货款者追回商品的）商品收回员

senses.def: a written or spoken account of an event, especially one that is published or broadcast

examples.en: Are these news reports true?
examples.zh: 这些新闻报道属实吗？

examples.en: media/press/newspaper reports
examples.zh: 媒体／报刊／报纸报道

examples.en: And now over to Jim Muir, for a report on the South African election.
examples.zh: 现在请吉姆·缪尔报道南非大选的情况。

examples.en: A local news station aired a special report on the controversy.
examples.zh: 当地一家新闻电台对这一争议进行了特别报道。

examples.en: According to this evening's weather report, there will be snow tomorrow.
examples.zh: 根据今晚的天气预报，明天有雪。

senses.def: a spoken or written description of something containing information that somebody needs to have

examples.en: a police report
examples.zh: 警方报告

examples.en: The company has just released its annual report.
examples.zh: 公司刚刚发布了年度报告。

examples.en: Can you give us a progress report?
examples.zh: 你可以给我们提供进度报告吗？

examples.en: You need to compile a report on your findings.
examples.zh: 你需要就你的发现写一份报告。

senses.def: an official document written by a group of people who have examined a particular situation or problem

examples.en: to release/issue a report
examples.zh: 发布报告

examples.en: The committee will publish its report on the health service next week.
examples.zh: 委员会将在下周发表他们对公共医疗服务的调查报告。

examples.en: According to the report, we are facing an obesity crisis.
examples.zh: 根据报告，我们正面临肥胖危机。

senses.def: a story or piece of information that may or may not be true

examples.en: There are unconfirmed reports of a shooting in the capital.
examples.zh: 有未经证实的传言说在首都发生了枪击事件。

examples.en: I don't believe these reports of UFO sightings.
examples.zh: 我不相信这些有关目击不明飞行物的传言。

examples.en: We are hearing reports that she has quit.
examples.zh: 我们不断听到她已经辞职的传闻。

examples.en: Despite reports claiming the market is heading for a crash, he predicts that prices will rise.
examples.zh: 尽管有报道称市场即将崩溃，但他预测价格将会上涨。

senses.def: a written statement about a student’s work at school, college, etc.

examples.en: a school report
examples.zh: 学生成绩报告单

examples.en: to get a good/bad report
examples.zh: 成绩优异／欠佳

examples.en: She got a better report card this time.
examples.zh: 她这次的成绩提高了一些。

senses.group: on student’s work 学生的学习

senses.def: an employee whose work is the responsibility of a particular manager

examples.en: a weekly meeting with my direct reports
examples.zh: 同我的直接下属一起开的周会

examples.en: He was finding one of his reports very difficult to manage.
examples.zh: 他发现他的一份报告非常难以管理。

senses.def: the sound of an explosion or of a gun being fired

examples.en: a loud report
examples.zh: 巨大的爆炸声

senses.def: talked about by people in a bad/good way
to give people information about something that you have heard, seen, done, etc.

examples.en: The crash happened seconds after the pilot reported engine trouble.
examples.zh: 飞行员报告发动机有故障后几秒钟飞机就坠毁了。

examples.en: The findings are similar to those reported in previous studies.
examples.zh: 研究结果与之前的研究报告相似。

examples.en: The company is expected to report record profits this year.
examples.zh: 这家公司今年有望获得创纪录的利润。

examples.en: Call me urgently if you have anything to report.
examples.zh: 如果有什么事要向我汇报，立即给我打电话。

examples.en: The committee will report on its research next month.
examples.zh: 委员会下个月将汇报他们的研究情况。

examples.en: He regularly reports on his activities to his family.
examples.zh: 他定期向家人报告他的活动。

examples.en: The neighbours reported seeing him leave the building around noon.
examples.zh: 邻居们反映说在中午时分看见他离开了大楼。

examples.en: Six months later, an inspector reported the problem recurring.
examples.zh: 六个月后，一名检查员报告问题再次出现。

examples.en: The doctor reported the patient fully recovered.
examples.zh: 医生说这位病人已经完全康复。

examples.en: The house was reported as being in excellent condition.
examples.zh: 报告说明这房子的状况极佳。

examples.en: The house was reported to be in excellent condition.
examples.zh: 报告说明这房子的状况极佳。

examples.en: She was reported by the hospital spokesman to be making excellent progress.
examples.zh: 医院发言人说她恢复得相当快

examples.en: Employers reported that graduates were deficient in writing and problem-solving skills.
examples.zh: 雇主反映毕业生缺乏写作和解决问题的技能。

examples.en: She failed to report what had occurred.
examples.zh: 她对发生的事情没有报告。

examples.en: ‘The cabin's empty,’ he reported.
examples.zh: “小屋是空的。”他汇报说。

senses.def: to present a written or spoken account of an event in a newspaper, on television, etc.

examples.en: The stabbing was widely reported in the press.
examples.zh: 这起持刀伤人事件被媒体广泛报道。

examples.en: Our job is to report the news, not to create it.
examples.zh: 我们的工作是报道新闻，而不是创造新闻。

examples.en: The TV news reported that several people had been arrested.
examples.zh: 据电视新闻报道，已有数人被捕。

examples.en: As previously reported, Norfolk police are investigating the case.
examples.zh: 正如之前报道的那样，诺福克警方正在调查此案。

examples.en: It was reported that several people had been arrested.
examples.zh: 据报道已有数人被捕。

examples.en: The media reported me as saying things I did not say.
examples.zh: 媒体报道我说了一些我没有说的话。

examples.en: She reports on royal stories for the BBC.
examples.zh: 她为英国广播公司做有关王室活动的报道。

examples.en: She has reported from many war zones.
examples.zh: 她曾在许多战区做过报道。

examples.en: This is Andrew Black reporting for Channel 4 News.
examples.zh: 我是安德鲁·布莱克为第四频道新闻报道。

senses.def: used to show that something has been stated, and you do not know if it is true or not
senses.zh: （不知传言是否确凿）据说，传闻

examples.en: She is reported to earn over $10 million a year.
examples.zh: 据传她一年挣 1 000 多万美元。

examples.en: The president is reported as saying that he needs a break.
examples.zh: 据传总统说他需要休息一下。

examples.en: Opinion has been reported as fact.
examples.zh: 意见已被报道为事实。

examples.en: It was reported that changes were being considered.
examples.zh: 有传言说改革措施正在酝酿之中。

senses.def: to tell a person in authority about a crime, an accident, an illness, etc. or about something bad that somebody has done

examples.en: Have you reported the incident to the police?
examples.zh: 这起事件你报警了吗？

examples.en: a decrease in the number of reported cases of AIDS
examples.zh: 艾滋病病例报告数量的减少

examples.en: He's already been reported twice for arriving late.
examples.zh: 他因为迟到已经两次被告发。

examples.en: She threatened to report him to the authorities for hunting without a licence.
examples.zh: 她威胁要向当局举报他无证狩猎。

examples.en: I’m going to report you if you do that again!
examples.zh: 如果你再这样做我就举报你！

examples.en: She has reported her daughter missing.
examples.zh: 女儿失踪，她已经向警方报案。

senses.group: crime/accident, etc. 犯罪或事故等

senses.def: to tell somebody that you have arrived, for example for work or for a meeting with somebody

examples.en: You should report for duty at 9.30 a.m.
examples.zh: 你应该在上午 9:30 报到上班。

examples.en: Private Smith reporting for duty, sir!
examples.zh: 二等兵史密斯报到，长官！

examples.en: All visitors must report to the reception desk on arrival.
examples.zh: 所有访客到达后务必在接待处报到。

examples.en: Volunteers have been instructed on where to report.
examples.zh: 志愿者已被告知去哪里报告。

senses.def: talked about by people in a bad/good way

intro.en: These are all words for a written or spoken account of events.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指对所发生事情的记述、讲述。

items.def: a written or spoken account of an event, especially one that is published or broadcast:
items.zh: 尤指刊登或广播的报道

examples.en: Are these newspaper reports true?
examples.zh: 报纸上这些报道属实吗？

items.def: an account, often spoken, of what happened to somebody or of how something happened; a report of events in a newspaper, magazine or news broadcast:
items.zh: 常指对所发生事情的口头叙述、描述、（新闻）报道

examples.en: It was many years before the full story was made public.
examples.zh: 许多年之后，事情的全貌才公之于众。

items.def: a written or spoken description of something that has happened:
items.zh: 指对所发生事情的书面或口头描述、叙述、报告

examples.en: She gave the police a full account of the incident.
examples.zh: 她向警方详尽地叙述了所发生的事情。

items.def: a description of an event from the point of view of a particular person or group of people:
items.zh: 指特定的人或群体对某事的描述、说法

examples.en: She gave us her version of what had happened that day.
examples.zh: 她从她的角度向我们描述了那天发生的事情。

senses.def: to return to a place, especially in order to work again
senses.zh: 回归；返回；（尤指）回到工作岗位

examples.en: Take an hour for lunch and report back at two.
examples.zh: 花一个小时吃午饭，两点钟返回。

senses.def: to give somebody information about something that they have asked you to find out about

examples.en: Find out as much as you can about him and report back to me.
examples.zh: 尽量查找有关他的资料，向我汇报。

examples.en: One person in the group should be prepared to report back to the class on your discussion.
examples.zh: 应由其中一名组员准备向全班汇报你们的讨论情况。

examples.en: They reported back that no laws had actually been broken.
examples.zh: 他们汇报说并没有真正发生违法的事。

examples.en: The reconnaissance party reported back that the town was heavily fortified.
examples.zh: 侦察队发回报告，说那个镇子设防严密。

senses.def: one of the stages that a bill
senses.zh: 报告阶段法案成为议会法令前必须经历的一个阶段。在委员会审议阶段之后，由下议院议员展开辩论。报告阶段通过后，法案进入三读。

senses.def: if you report to
the reporting of news or the typical style in which this is done in newspapers, or on TV and radio
senses.zh: 新闻报道；报道风格；报道文体

examples.en: We need accurate up-to-the-minute reportage of events.
examples.zh: 我们需要准确的最新事件报道。

examples.en: There is increasing awareness of how biased media reportage can govern our perceptions.
examples.zh: 人们越来越意识到有倾向性的媒体报道足以左右自己的看法。

senses.def: a question in reported speech
a report of what somebody has said that does not use their exact words

examples.en: In reported speech, ‘“I'll come later,” he said.’ becomes ‘He said he'd come later.’
examples.zh: 在间接引语中，‘I’ll come later,’ he said 变为 He said he’d come later。

examples.en: Certain grammatical rules must be followed when describing a conversation in reported speech.
examples.zh: 用转述引语描述对话时必须遵循一定的语法规则。

senses.def: according to what some people say

examples.en: The band have reportedly decided to split up.
examples.zh: 据说这个乐队已经决定解散。

examples.en: The move, reportedly the President’s idea, has come in for a lot of criticism.
examples.zh: 据报道，此举是总统的想法，但遭到了很多批评。

senses.def: a person who collects and reports news for newspapers, radio or television

examples.en: He leaked the story to a news reporter.
examples.zh: 他把这个故事泄露给了一名新闻记者。

examples.en: He began his career as a newspaper reporter in New York.
examples.zh: 他的职业生涯始于纽约的一名报社记者。

examples.en: She worked as an investigative reporter for a national newspaper.
examples.zh: 她曾担任一家全国性报纸的调查记者。

examples.en: a reporter from the ‘New York Times’
examples.zh: 《纽约时报》的记者

senses.def: a state of rest, sleep or feeling calm

examples.en: She went outside seeking a few moments of repose.
examples.zh: 她走到外面寻求片刻的休息。

examples.en: In repose, his face was sad.
examples.zh: 休息时，他的脸色悲伤。

examples.en: The first rays of morning sun disturbed their repose.
examples.zh: 清晨的第一缕阳光打破了他们的安宁。

senses.def: to be or be kept in a particular place

examples.en: She stared at the empty cabinet where once the vase had reposed.
examples.zh: 她盯着曾经放花瓶的空柜子。

senses.def: to lie or rest in a particular place

examples.en: We left her reposing on the sofa.
examples.zh: 我们让她躺在沙发上。

senses.def: a place where something is stored in large quantities
a person or book that is full of information
senses.zh: 学识渊博的人；智囊；知识宝典

examples.en: My father is a repository of family history.
examples.zh: 我的父亲对家族史无所不知。

examples.en: The foundation is the largest repository of the artist’s work.
examples.zh: 该基金会藏有最多这位艺术家的作品。

examples.en: The site is near an underground repository for radioactive waste.
examples.zh: 该地点靠近放射性废物地下储存库。

senses.def: to take back property or goods from somebody who has arranged to buy them but who still owes money for them and cannot pay
senses.zh: （因买者未如期付款而）收回（房地产、商品等）

examples.en: First I lost my job, then my house was repossessed.
examples.zh: 我先是失去了工作，后来房子又被收回。

senses.def: the act of repossessing

examples.en: families threatened with repossession
examples.zh: 受到房子将被收回威胁的家庭

examples.en: a repossession order
examples.zh: 物品收回令

senses.def: a house, car, etc. that has been repossessed
senses.zh: 被收回的房子（或汽车等）

examples.en: Auctions are the best place for buying repossessions.
examples.zh: 拍卖会是购买被收回商品的最佳地方。

senses.def: morally wrong and deserving criticism
senses.zh: （不道德而）应受指责的，应受谴责的

examples.en: His conduct was thoroughly reprehensible.
examples.zh: 他的行为应该受到彻底的谴责。

senses.def: to be a member of a group of people and act or speak for them at an event, a meeting, etc.

examples.en: The competition attracted over 500 contestants representing eight different countries.
examples.zh: 这次比赛吸引了代表 8 个不同国家的 500 多名参赛者。

examples.en: Local businesses are well represented on the committee (= there are a lot of people from them on the committee).
examples.zh: 委员会中有许多地方企业的代表。

examples.en: The opening speech was by Bob Alan representing Amnesty International.
examples.zh: 代表国际特赦组织的鲍勃·艾伦致开幕词。

examples.en: The President was represented at the ceremony by the Vice-President.
examples.zh: 副总统代表总统出席了这次庆典。

senses.group: act/speak for somebody 为某人做／说

senses.def: to act or speak officially for somebody and defend their interests
senses.zh: 作为…的代言人；维护…的利益

examples.en: The union represents over 200 000 teachers.
examples.zh: 工会代表着 20 余万名教师的利益。

examples.en: The association was formed to represent the interests of women artists.
examples.zh: 成立这个协会是为了维护女性艺术家的利益。

examples.en: Ms Dale is representing the defendant (= is his/her lawyer) in the case.
examples.zh: 在这个案件当中，戴尔女士为被告作辩护。

examples.en: As an MP, it is my duty to represent my constituents.
examples.zh: 作为一名国会议员，我有责任代表我的选民。

senses.group: act/speak for somebody 为某人做／说

senses.def: to take part in a sports event for a particular country, city, etc.

examples.en: He's been chosen to represent Scotland in next year's World Cup Finals.
examples.zh: 他被选中代表苏格兰参加明年的世界杯决赛。

senses.def: to be a symbol of something

examples.en: Each colour on the chart represents a different department.
examples.zh: 图表中的每一种颜色都代表一个不同的部门。

examples.en: Wind direction is represented by arrows.
examples.zh: 风向是用箭头表示的。

examples.en: The artist uses doves to represent peace.
examples.zh: 艺术家用鸽子代表和平。

examples.en: It is not clear what these symbols were intended to represent.
examples.zh: 这些符号代表什么还不清楚。

senses.def: to be something

examples.en: This contract represents 20% of the company's annual revenue.
examples.zh: 这份合约相当于公司 20% 的年收入。

examples.en: The final figure represents a 12% increase on the number of new jobs created the previous year.
examples.zh: 最终数字表明新增就业岗位数量比上一年增加了 12%。

examples.en: They're investing in low-carbon technologies that represent value for money.
examples.zh: 他们正在投资代表物有所值的低碳技术。

examples.en: He got rid of anyone who represented a threat to his authority.
examples.zh: 他除掉了所有威胁他权威的人。

examples.en: This role represents a unique opportunity to further your career in healthcare.
examples.zh: 这个角色代表了您在医疗保健领域进一步发展职业生涯的独特机会。

examples.en: The peace plan represents (= is the result of) weeks of negotiation.
examples.zh: 这个和平计划是数周谈判的成果。

senses.def: to be present in something to a particular degree

examples.en: Women and men were represented equally on the teams.
examples.zh: 小组中男女人数相当。

examples.en: Women are disproportionately represented among welfare recipients.
examples.zh: 接受福利救济的人中女性人数过少。

senses.def: to be an example or expression of something
senses.zh: 成为…实例；成为典型；体现

examples.en: The project represents all that is good in the community.
examples.zh: 这项工程充分体现了社区的美好。

examples.en: Those comments do not represent the views of us all.
examples.zh: 这些言论并不代表我们所有人的看法。

examples.en: The book purported to represent the lives of ordinary people.
examples.zh: 这本书声称旨在展现普通人的生活。

senses.group: be example of 成为例证

senses.def: to show somebody/something, especially in a picture

examples.en: The carvings represent a hunting scene.
examples.zh: 这些雕刻作品描绘了一幅狩猎的场面。

examples.en: The map represents Italy in the 12th century.
examples.zh: 该地图代表 12 世纪的意大利。

examples.en: The results are represented in fig. 3 below.
examples.zh: 结果如下面的图 3 所示。

examples.en: The Egyptian goddess is represented as a woman with cow's horns.
examples.zh: 埃及女神被描绘成一个长着牛角的女人。

senses.def: to present or describe somebody/something in a particular way, especially when this may not be fair
senses.zh: （尤指不公平地）展现，描述，表现

examples.en: The king is represented as a villain in the play.
examples.zh: 剧中国王的形象是一个恶棍。

examples.en: The risks were represented as negligible.
examples.zh: 他们把风险说得微不足道。

examples.en: The film represents us as helpless victims.
examples.zh: 这部电影将我们描绘成无助的受害者。

examples.en: The film accurately represents the atmosphere of the post-war period.
examples.zh: 影片准确地再现了战后时期的气氛。

senses.def: to make a formal statement to somebody in authority to make your opinions known or to protest

examples.en: They represented their concerns to the authorities.
examples.zh: 他们向当局陈述了他们关心的问题。

examples.en: He admitted falsely representing to police officers that the car had been stolen.
examples.zh: 他承认自己告诉警察汽车失窃不是事实。

senses.group: make formal statement 正式声明

senses.def: the act of presenting somebody/something in a particular way; something that shows or describes something
senses.zh: 表现；描述；描绘；表现形式

examples.en: the negative representation of single mothers in the media
examples.zh: 媒体对单身母亲的负面描述

examples.en: The snake swallowing its tail is a representation of infinity.
examples.zh: 蛇衔其尾表示无穷无尽。

senses.def: the fact of having representatives who will speak or vote for you or act in your place

examples.en: The green movement lacks effective representation in Parliament.
examples.zh: 环境保护运动在议会中缺乏有力的支持者。

examples.en: The accused was not allowed legal representation.
examples.zh: 没有允许被告请律师。

senses.def: formal statements made to somebody in authority, especially in order to make your opinions known or to protest

examples.en: We have made representations to the prime minister, but without success.
examples.zh: 我们同首相进行交涉，但没有效果。

senses.def: trying to show things as they really are

examples.en: It is on pottery that representational art first appeared in ancient Greece.
examples.zh: 具象艺术首先出现在古希腊的陶器上。

senses.def: involving the act of representing somebody/something

examples.en: local representational democracy
examples.zh: 地方代议民主政体

senses.def: a person who has been chosen to speak or vote for somebody else or for a group of people, or to take the place of somebody else

examples.en: Our elected representatives in government should be doing something about this.
examples.zh: 我们选出的政府代表应该对此采取一些行动。

examples.en: Management are obliged to consult with union representatives about changes to conditions.
examples.zh: 资方有义务就变更条件征求工会代表的意见 。

examples.en: The actor's legal representatives have strongly denied the allegations.
examples.zh: 该演员的法律代表强烈否认这些指控。

examples.en: He was the Queen's representative at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 他代表女王出席了庆典。

examples.en: a representative of the UN
examples.zh: 联合国代表

examples.en: The committee includes representatives from industry.
examples.zh: 这个委员会包括产业界的代表。

senses.def: a person who works for a company and travels around selling its products
senses.zh: 销售代表；销售代理；代销人

examples.en: a sales representative
examples.zh: 销售代表

examples.en: She's our representative in France.
examples.zh: 她是我们公司驻法国的销售代表。

senses.def: a person who is typical of a particular group

examples.en: The singer is regarded as a representative of the youth of her generation.
examples.zh: 这位歌手被看作是她那一代年轻人的典型代表。

senses.def: (in the US) a member of the House of Representatives, the Lower House of Congress; a member of the House of Representatives in the lower house of a state parliament
typical of a particular group of people; that is a typical example of something

examples.en: Is a questionnaire answered by 500 people truly representative of the population as a whole?
examples.zh: 由 500 人参加的问卷调查能真正代表所有民众吗？

examples.en: The paper-thin models in magazines are not representative of most women.
examples.zh: 杂志上纸片般瘦削的模特儿并不是大多数女人的样子。

examples.en: Some residents argued that the protesters were not representative of the community.
examples.zh: 一些居民认为抗议者不代表社区。

examples.en: The painting is not representative of his work of the period.
examples.zh: 这幅画不是他在那个时期画作的代表作。

senses.def: containing or including examples of all the different types of people or things in a large group

examples.en: We interviewed a representative sample of teachers.
examples.zh: 我们采访了一些教师代表。

examples.en: Exhibits include a widely representative collection of Greek vases.
examples.zh: 展品包括一批有普遍代表性的希腊花瓶收藏品。

senses.def: consisting of people who have been chosen to speak or vote for the rest of a group
senses.zh: 由代表组成的；代议制的

examples.en: a representative democracy
examples.zh: 代议制民主政体

examples.en: the advent of modern representative government
examples.zh: 现代代议制政府的出现

senses.def: to try not to have or show an emotion, a feeling, etc.

examples.en: to repress a smile
examples.zh: 忍住不笑

examples.en: He burst in, making no effort to repress his fury.
examples.zh: 他冲了进来，毫不掩饰自己的愤怒。

examples.en: For years he had successfully repressed the painful memories of childhood.
examples.zh: 多年来，他成功地压抑了童年的痛苦记忆。

senses.def: to use political and/or military force to control a group of people and limit their freedom

examples.en: The government was quick to repress any opposition.
examples.zh: 政府迅速镇压一切反对势力。

senses.def: the act of using force to control a group of people and limit their freedom

examples.en: Peasant farmers face poverty and severe government repression.
examples.zh: 农民面临贫困和政府的严厉镇压。

examples.en: They were fighting against repression and injustice in their country.
examples.zh: 他们正在与自己国家的镇压和不公正作斗争。

senses.def: the act of controlling strong emotions and desires and not allowing them to be expressed so that they no longer seem to exist

examples.en: sexual repression
examples.zh: 性压抑

senses.def: controlling people by force and limiting their freedom

examples.en: a repressive regime/measure/law
examples.zh: 实行高压政策的政权；镇压措施；严厉的法律

senses.def: controlling emotions and desires and not allowing them to be expressed
in a way that involves controlling people by force and limiting their freedom
the fact that a government or other authority controls people by force and limits their freedom
the fact of tending to control emotions and desires and not allow them to be expressed
to officially cancel or delay a punishment for a prisoner who is condemned
senses.zh: 撤销…的死刑；缓期执行…的死刑

examples.en: a reprieved murderer
examples.zh: 被判死刑缓期执行的杀人犯

senses.def: to officially cancel or delay plans to close something or end something

examples.en: 70 jobs have been reprieved until next April.
examples.zh: 有 70 个职位暂时保留到明年四月份。

senses.def: an official order stopping a punishment, especially for a prisoner who is condemned
senses.zh: 刑罚终止令；（尤指）死刑缓刑令

examples.en: He was saved from the gallows by a last-minute reprieve.
examples.zh: 最后一刻的缓刑令使他得以免受绞刑。

senses.def: a delay before something bad happens

examples.en: Campaigners have won a reprieve for the hospital threatened with closure.
examples.zh: 活动家们为这家受关闭威胁的医院赢得了喘息的机会。

senses.def: the act of telling somebody officially that you do not approve of them or their actions
senses.zh: 正式告诉某人你不赞成他们或他们的行为

examples.en: He received a severe reprimand for his behaviour.
examples.zh: 他因其行为受到了严厉的斥责。

senses.def: to tell somebody officially that you do not approve of them or their actions

examples.en: The officers were severely reprimanded for their unprofessional behaviour.
examples.zh: 军官们因违反职业操守而受到了严厉的斥责。

examples.en: The judge reprimanded him for using such language in court.
examples.zh: 法官斥责他在法庭上使用那样的语言。

examples.en: ‘Don't be so childish,’ she reprimanded.
examples.zh: “别这么幼稚，”她斥责道。

senses.def: to print more copies of a book, an article, etc. with few or no changes

examples.en: This popular guide has already been reprinted several times.
examples.zh: 这本广受欢迎的指南已经再版多次。

senses.def: an act of printing more copies of a book because all the others have been sold

examples.en: The book is into its fifth reprint.
examples.zh: 该书已第五次重印。

senses.def: a book that has been reprinted
a violent or aggressive act towards somebody because of something bad that they have done towards you

examples.en: They did not want to give evidence for fear of reprisals.
examples.zh: 他们因为害怕报复而不想作证。

examples.en: They shot ten hostages in reprisal for the assassination of their leader.
examples.zh: 他们的首领遭到暗杀。为了报复，他们枪杀了十名人质。

senses.def: to repeat a piece of music or performance

examples.en: Craig reprises his role as James Bond for the fifth time.
examples.zh: 克雷格第五次扮演詹姆斯·邦德。

senses.def: a repeated part of something, especially a piece of music
senses.zh: 重复部分；（尤指乐曲的）反复

senses.def: copied, especially from a style that was originally made in the past; that is a reproduction
senses.zh: （尤指按古典风格）复制的，仿制的

examples.en: Victorian repro furniture
examples.zh: 仿制的维多利亚式家具

senses.def: something that is copied from a style that was originally made in the past
the science and practice of copying documents and pictures for publishing, etc.
blame or criticism for something you have done

examples.en: His voice was full of reproach.
examples.zh: 他的话完全是一种责备的语气。

examples.en: The captain's behaviour is beyond reproach (= so good that you cannot criticize it).
examples.zh: 队长的行为无可非议。

senses.def: a word or remark expressing blame or criticism
senses.zh: 责备的话语；批评的言辞

examples.en: He listened to his wife's bitter reproaches.
examples.zh: 他听着妻子严厉的责备。

senses.def: a state of shame or loss of honour

examples.en: Her actions brought reproach upon herself.
examples.zh: 她的举动使她很丢面子。

senses.def: a person or thing that brings shame on somebody/something
senses.zh: （给…）带来羞辱的人（或事）；（使…）丢脸的人（或事）

examples.en: Such living conditions are a reproach to our society.
examples.zh: 这样的生活条件是我们这个社会的耻辱。

examples.en: Paul saw this as a reproach to himself.
examples.zh: 保罗把这看成是自己的耻辱。

senses.def: to blame or criticize somebody for something that they have done or not done, because you are disappointed in them

examples.en: Nobody has a right to reproach me.
examples.zh: 没有人有权利责备我。

examples.en: She was reproached by colleagues for leaking the story to the press.
examples.zh: 她因为将这件事透露给新闻媒体而受到同事的指责。

examples.en: She reproached him with his cruelty.
examples.zh: 她责备他的残忍。

examples.en: ‘You know that isn't true,’ he reproached her.
examples.zh: 他责怪她道, “你知道那不是真的。”

senses.def: to feel guilty about something that you think you should have done in a different way

examples.en: She had no reason to reproach herself.
examples.zh: 她没有理由责备自己。

examples.en: He reproached himself for not telling her the truth.
examples.zh: 他因为没有告诉她真相而自责。

examples.en: You have nothing to reproach yourself with.
examples.zh: 你没有什么可责备自己的。

senses.def: expressing blame or criticism

examples.en: a reproachful look
examples.zh: 责备的目光

examples.en: She was doing her best not to sound reproachful.
examples.zh: 她尽力不让自己听起来像是在责备。

senses.def: in a way that expresses blame or criticism

examples.en: ‘How could you?’ Jeremy said reproachfully.
examples.zh: “你怎么可以？”杰里米责备地说。

senses.def: not moral

examples.en: reprobate behaviour
examples.zh: 恶行行为

senses.def: a person who behaves in a way that society thinks is not moral
to treat waste material so that it can be used again

examples.en: All these countries reprocess nuclear fuel.
examples.zh: 这些国家均对核燃料进行再处理。

examples.en: The firm reprocesses recyclable materials.
examples.zh: 该公司对可回收材料进行再加工。

examples.en: Commercial reprocessing plants were built.
examples.zh: 商业后处理厂建成。

senses.def: to make a copy of a picture, piece of text, etc.

examples.en: It is illegal to reproduce these worksheets without permission from the publisher.
examples.zh: 未经出版者许可翻印这些习题是违法的。

examples.en: The photocopier reproduces colours very well.
examples.zh: 这台复印机复制的色彩效果很好。

examples.en: This material can be reproduced without payment.
examples.zh: 该材料可以免费复制。

examples.en: All illustrations are reproduced by kind permission of the Mercury Gallery.
examples.zh: 所有插图均承蒙水星画廊许可复制。

senses.def: to produce something very similar to something else in a different medium or context; to make something happen again in the same way

examples.en: The atmosphere of the novel is successfully reproduced in the movie.
examples.zh: 小说的氛围在电影中得到成功再现。

examples.en: Unfortunately, he was never able to reproduce this level of performance in a competition.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，他在比赛中从未能够再现这种竞技水平。

examples.en: I was able to reproduce the same results with subsequent tests.
examples.zh: 我在随后的试验中重现了同样的结果。

senses.def: if people, plants, animals, etc. reproduce

examples.en: Most reptiles reproduce by laying eggs on land.
examples.zh: 大多数爬行动物在陆地产卵进行繁殖。

examples.en: cells reproducing themselves (= making new ones)
examples.zh: 自我繁殖的细胞

senses.def: that can be produced or done again in the same way
senses.zh: 能再生的;能再制造的;能再现的

examples.en: an experiment capable of giving reproducible results
examples.zh: 能够给出可重复结果的实验

senses.def: the act or process of producing babies, young animals or plants

examples.en: sexual reproduction
examples.zh: 有性生殖

examples.en: They are studying reproduction in shellfish.
examples.zh: 他们正在研究贝类的繁殖。

senses.def: the act or process of producing copies of a document, book, picture, etc.

examples.en: Use a black pen on white paper to ensure good reproduction.
examples.zh: 用白纸黑笔，以确保复制清晰。

senses.def: the quality of recorded sound

examples.en: Digital recording gives excellent sound reproduction.
examples.zh: 数字录音的声音效果极佳。

senses.def: a thing that has been reproduced

examples.en: They have a catalogue with colour reproductions of the paintings for sale.
examples.zh: 他们有一个待售画作的彩色图样目录。

examples.en: reproduction furniture (= furniture made as a copy of an earlier style)
examples.zh: 仿制的旧式家具

senses.def: connected with reproducing

examples.en: reproductive organs
examples.zh: 生殖器官

senses.def: the science and practice of copying documents and pictures for publishing, etc.
blame or disapproval

examples.en: His words were a mixture of pity and reproof.
examples.zh: 他的话里既有同情也有责备。

examples.en: He clicked his tongue in mock reproof.
examples.zh: 他咂舌，假装责备。

senses.def: a remark that expresses blame or disapproval
senses.zh: 责备的话语；非难的言辞

examples.en: She received a mild reproof from the teacher.
examples.zh: 她受到了老师温和的责备。

senses.def: to tell somebody that you do not approve of something that they have done

examples.en: Helen reproved him sharply.
examples.zh: 海伦严厉地斥责了他。

examples.en: He reproved her for rushing away.
examples.zh: 他责备她不该匆匆离去。

examples.en: ‘Don't mock,’ she reproved him.
examples.zh: “别嘲笑，”她责备他。

senses.def: in a way that shows that you do not approve of something that somebody has done

examples.en: ‘You’re late,’ she said reprovingly.
examples.zh: “你迟到了。”她责备地说。

senses.def: any animal that has cold blood and skin covered in scales
connected with or typical of reptiles
senses.zh: 爬行动物的;爬行的;像爬行动物的

examples.en: our reptilian ancestors
examples.zh: 我们的爬行动物祖先

examples.en: He licked his lips in an unpleasantly reptilian way.
examples.zh: 他像爬虫般舔着嘴唇，令人生厌。

senses.def: a country that is governed by a president and politicians elected by the people and where there is no king or queen

examples.en: newly independent republics
examples.zh: 新独立的共和国

examples.en: Mary McAleese has been the President of the Republic of Ireland since 1997.
examples.zh: 玛丽·麦卡利斯自 1997 年起担任爱尔兰共和国总统。

senses.def: a person who supports a form of government with a president and politicians elected by the people and with no king or queen
senses.zh: 拥护共和政体的人；共和主义者

senses.def: a member or supporter of the Republican Party of the US
senses.zh: （美国）共和党党员，共和党的支持者

senses.def: a person from Northern Ireland who believes that Northern Ireland should be part of the Republic of Ireland and not part of the United Kingdom
senses.zh: 北爱尔兰共和主义者（认为北爱尔兰应脱离英国回归爱尔兰共和国）

senses.def: connected with or like a republic
senses.zh: 共和国的；共和政体的；拥护共和政体的

examples.en: a republican government/movement
examples.zh: 共和政体／运动

senses.def: connected with the Republican Party in the US
connected with or supporting the Republicans
senses.zh: 北爱尔兰共和主义者的；支持北爱尔兰共和主义者的

senses.def: belief in the principles of a republic

examples.en: a strong commitment to Republicanism
examples.zh: 对共和制的坚定信念

senses.def: to refuse to accept something

examples.en: to repudiate a suggestion
examples.zh: 拒绝一项建议

examples.en: Socialism had been repudiated at the polls.
examples.zh: 社会主义在民意调查中被否定。

examples.en: Borrowers have begun repudiating their debt obligations.
examples.zh: 借款人已开始拒绝履行债务义务。

examples.en: The buyer is entitled to repudiate the contract within a reasonable period of time.
examples.zh: 买方有权在合理期限内拒绝履行合同。

senses.def: to say officially and/or publicly that something is not true

examples.en: to repudiate a report
examples.zh: 驳斥一份报告

senses.def: to refuse to be connected with somebody any longer
senses.zh: 拒绝与…往来；断绝同…的关系

examples.en: His party repudiated him after the scandal.
examples.zh: 丑闻发生后，他的政党拒绝了他。

senses.def: the act of refusing to accept something

examples.en: the world-wide repudiation of slavery in the nineteenth century
examples.zh: 十九世纪世界范围内对奴隶制的否定

senses.def: the act of saying officially and/or publicly that something is not true

examples.en: the repudiation of a claim
examples.zh: 拒绝索赔

senses.def: the act of refusing to be connected with somebody any longer
senses.zh: 拒绝与…往来；断绝同…的关系

examples.en: his stunning repudiation of his party and its candidate
examples.zh: 他对他的政党及其候选人的令人震惊的否认

senses.def: relating to a situation in which somebody refuses to do something that they are legally required to do

examples.en: a repudiatory breach of contract
examples.zh: 毁约性违约

senses.def: a very strong feeling of dislike for something

examples.en: She was trying to overcome her physical repugnance for him.
examples.zh: 她努力克制对他非常强烈的反感。

senses.def: making you feel strong dislike
senses.zh: 使十分嫌恶；使反感；不得人心

examples.en: We found his suggestion absolutely repugnant.
examples.zh: 我们觉得他的建议绝对不得人心。

examples.en: The idea of eating meat was repugnant to her.
examples.zh: 一想到吃肉她就想吐。

senses.def: to make somebody feel strong dislike

examples.en: I was repulsed by the horrible smell.
examples.zh: 这种可怕的气味让我恶心。

senses.def: to fight somebody who is attacking you and drive them away

examples.en: to repulse an attack/invasion/offensive
examples.zh: 击退一次进攻／入侵／攻势

senses.def: to refuse to accept somebody’s help, attempts to be friendly, etc.

examples.en: Each time I tried to help I was repulsed.
examples.zh: 每次我想要帮忙都遭到了拒绝。

examples.en: She repulsed his advances.
examples.zh: 她拒绝了他的追求。

senses.def: a feeling of very strong dislike of something that you find extremely unpleasant
senses.zh: 嫌恶感；强烈的反感；憎恶

senses.def: the force by which objects tend to push each other away

examples.en: the forces of attraction and repulsion
examples.zh: 引力和斥力

senses.def: causing a feeling of strong dislike; very unpleasant
senses.zh: 令人厌恶的；令人反感的；十分讨厌的

examples.en: a repulsive sight/smell/habit
examples.zh: 令人厌恶的情景／气味／习惯

examples.en: What a repulsive man!
examples.zh: 这个人真讨厌！

senses.def: causing repulsion

examples.en: repulsive forces
examples.zh: 斥力

intro.en: These words all describe something, especially a smell, taste or habit, that is extremely unpleasant and often makes you feel slightly ill.
intro.zh: 以上各词形容某物（尤指气味、味道或习惯）令人很不舒服而且常令人恶心。

items.def: extremely unpleasant and making you feel slightly ill:
items.zh: 指令人不快的、使人厌恶的、令人恶心的、使人作呕的

examples.en: What a disgusting smell!
examples.zh: 这气味真难闻！

items.def: dirty, and tasting or smelling bad:
items.zh: 指肮脏恶臭的、难闻的、恶心的

examples.en: She could smell his foul breath.
examples.zh: 她闻得到他的口臭。

items.def: extremely unpleasant and making you feel slightly ill:
items.zh: 指令人不快的、使人厌恶的、令人恶心的、使人作呕的

examples.en: The stew looked revolting.
examples.zh: 这煨菜看上去令人作呕。

items.def: (rather formal) extremely unpleasant in a way that offends you or makes you feel slightly ill. Repulsive usually describes people, their behaviour or habits, which you may find offensive for physical or moral reasons.
items.zh: repulsive 通常指人或其行为习惯刺激感官或有违道德而令人厌恶。

items.def: (formal) (especially of smells) extremely unpleasant.
items.zh: 尤指气味令人不适的、令人恶心的、使人厌恶的

items.def: (informal) (of a smell, taste or personal habit) extremely unpleasant.
items.zh: 指气味、味道或个人习惯令人很不舒服的、令人恶心的、使人厌恶的

senses.def: in a way that is extremely unpleasant and causes strong dislike

examples.en: repulsively ugly
examples.zh: 丑陋不堪

senses.def: to change something slightly in order to make it suitable for a new purpose
senses.zh: （为适合新用途）对…稍加修改，略微改动

examples.en: Content repurposed from old media is legitimate internet content.
examples.zh: 把旧媒体的内容改编后就成为合法的互联网内容。

senses.def: that people consider to be honest; having a good reputation

examples.en: a reputable dealer/company/supplier
examples.zh: 可信赖的交易商／公司／供应商

senses.def: the opinion that people have about what somebody/something is like, based on what has happened in the past

examples.en: to have a good/bad reputation
examples.zh: 有好／坏名声

examples.en: to build/earn a reputation
examples.zh: 建立／获得声誉

examples.en: She soon established a reputation as a first-class cook.
examples.zh: 她不久就赢得了一流厨师的美誉。

examples.en: The company enjoys an international reputation for quality of design.
examples.zh: 该公司在设计质量方面享有国际声誉。

examples.en: a politician with a reputation for honesty
examples.zh: 以诚实着称的政治家

examples.en: I'm aware of Mark's reputation for being late.
examples.zh: 我知道马克迟到是出了名的。

examples.en: He has the reputation of being a hard worker.
examples.zh: 他颇有工作勤奋的名声。

examples.en: to damage/tarnish/ruin somebody’s reputation
examples.zh: 损害／玷污／毁坏某人的名声

examples.en: The weather in England is living up to its reputation (= is exactly as expected).
examples.zh: 英国的天气完全就如人们所说的那样。

examples.en: She is, by reputation, very difficult to please.
examples.zh: 众所周知，她很难取悦。

senses.def: the opinion that people have of somebody/something

examples.en: I know him only by repute.
examples.zh: 我仅闻到他的名声(未见其人)。

examples.en: She is a writer of international repute.
examples.zh: 她是一位享有国际声誉的作家。

examples.en: My parents were artists of (some) repute (= having a very good reputation).
examples.zh: 我的双亲是具有（一定）知名度的艺术家。

senses.def: generally thought to be something or to have done something, although this is not certain

examples.en: He is reputed to be the best heart surgeon in the country.
examples.zh: 他号称是这个国家最好的心脏外科医生。

examples.en: The house is wrongly reputed to have been the poet's birthplace.
examples.zh: 这所房子被误以为是诗人的出生地。

examples.en: She sold her share of the company for a reputed £7 million.
examples.zh: 她的公司股份据说卖了 700 万英镑。

senses.def: used to say that something is generally thought to be true, although this is not certain

examples.en: He was reputedly a millionaire.
examples.zh: 据说他是一位百万富翁。

examples.en: It is reputedly the best hotel in the country.
examples.zh: 据说这是该国最好的酒店。

senses.def: the action of asking for something formally and politely; a thing that you formally ask for
senses.zh: （正式或礼貌的）要求，请求；要求的东西

examples.en: a request for information
examples.zh: 索取资讯

examples.en: They made a request for further aid.
examples.zh: 他们要求再给一些援助。

examples.en: He submitted a request to adopt a flexible working routine.
examples.zh: 他提交了一份采用灵活工作程序的请示。

examples.en: to grant a request
examples.zh: 批准请求

examples.en: to refuse/decline/reject/deny a request
examples.zh: 拒绝请求

examples.en: She went to the wedding at her mother's request (= because her mother had asked her to go).
examples.zh: 她应母亲的要求去参加婚礼（=因为她母亲要求她去）。

examples.en: He was there at the request of his manager (= because his manager had asked him to go).
examples.zh: 他按照经理的要求到了那里。

examples.en: The writer's name was withheld by request (= because the writer asked for this to be done).
examples.zh: 按照作者的要求，姓名不予公布。

examples.en: Application forms are available on request.
examples.zh: 有申请表供索取。

examples.en: She left her address with a request that any mail should be sent on to her.
examples.zh: 她留下了自己的地址，并要求把所有邮件都转寄给她。

senses.def: an instruction to a computer to perform a task

examples.en: When the software has finished processing the request, a download window pops up.
examples.zh: 当软件处理完请求后，会弹出一个下载窗口。

senses.def: a song or tune that somebody asks to have played on a radio programme

examples.en: The next request is from a listener in Aberdeen.
examples.zh: 下一首歌曲是阿伯丁的一位听众点播的。

examples.en: a radio request programme
examples.zh: 电台点播节目

senses.def: to ask for something or ask somebody to do something in a polite or formal way

examples.en: She requested permission to film at the White House.
examples.zh: 她申请准予在白宫拍摄。

examples.en: You can request a free copy of the leaflet.
examples.zh: 你可以索要一份免费的宣传单。

examples.en: She requested anonymity because she wasn't authorized to speak to the press.
examples.zh: 她要求匿名，因为她无权向媒体发表讲话。

examples.en: The government has requested information from the companies involved in the scandal.
examples.zh: 政府要求卷入丑闻的公司提供信息。

examples.en: Visitors are requested not to touch the exhibits.
examples.zh: 参观者请勿触摸展品。

examples.en: We were requested to assemble in the lobby.
examples.zh: 我们被要求在大厅集合。

examples.en: She requested that no one be told of her decision until the next meeting.
examples.zh: 她要求下次开会前不要向任何人透露她的决定。

examples.en: She requested that no one should be told of her decision.
examples.zh: 她要求不要向任何人透露她的决定。

examples.en: ‘Please come with me,’ he requested.
examples.zh: “请跟我来。”他要求道。

senses.def: a bus stop
a Mass
a piece of music for this ceremony
to need something; to depend on somebody/something

examples.en: These pets require a lot of care and attention.
examples.zh: 这些宠物需要悉心照顾。

examples.en: Deciphering the code requires an expert.
examples.zh: 破译密码需要专家。

examples.en: This condition requires urgent treatment.
examples.zh: 这种情况得紧急处理。

examples.en: Do you require anything else? (= in a shop/store, for example)
examples.zh: 你还需要什么吗？

examples.en: These plants absolutely require shade.
examples.zh: 这些植物必须养在阴凉处。

examples.en: True marriage requires us to show trust and loyalty.
examples.zh: 真正的婚姻有赖于我们表现出信任与忠诚。

examples.en: The situation required that he be present.
examples.zh: 这种情形需要他在场。

examples.en: The situation required that he should be present.
examples.zh: 这种情形需要他在场。

examples.en: Lentils do not require soaking before cooking.
examples.zh: 小扁豆在烹饪前不必浸泡。

senses.def: to make somebody do or have something, especially because it is necessary according to a particular law or set of rules
senses.zh: 使做（某事）；使拥有（某物）；（尤指根据法规）规定

examples.en: I just require a signature on the form.
examples.zh: 我只需要在表格上签名。

examples.en: The wearing of seat belts is required by law.
examples.zh: 法律规定必须系安全带。

examples.en: ‘Hamlet’ is required reading (= must be read) for this course.
examples.zh: 《哈姆雷特》是这门课程的指定读物。

examples.en: Several students failed to reach the required standard.
examples.zh: 有几名学生没有达到规定的标准。

examples.en: What exactly is required of a receptionist (= what are they expected to do)?
examples.zh: 接待员的职责到底是什么？

examples.en: All candidates will be required to take a short test.
examples.zh: 所有候选者都要参加一次小测验。

examples.en: All adults are legally required to pay the tax.
examples.zh: 法律要求所有成年人缴纳税款。

examples.en: We require that you comply with the following rules:…
examples.zh: 我们要求你遵守以下规则：…

examples.en: The law requires that everyone wear a seat belt.
examples.zh: 法律要求每个人都必须系安全带。

intro.en: These words all mean to say that somebody should do or have something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含要求之义。

items.def: to make a very strong request for something; to say very definitely that somebody should have or do something:
items.zh: 指强烈要求、坚决要求

examples.en: She demanded an immediate explanation.
examples.zh: 她强烈要求立即作出解释。

items.def: [often passive] (rather formal) to make somebody do or have something, especially because it is necessary according to a law or set of rules or standards:
items.zh: 指要求做（某事）、达到（某水平），尤指根据法规或规定

examples.en: All candidates will be required to take a short test.
examples.zh: 所有候选者都要参加一次小测验。

items.def: to demand that somebody should do, have or be something, especially because it is their duty or responsibility:
items.zh: 指要求、认为应得、指望，尤因义务或责任

examples.en: I expect to be paid promptly for the work.
examples.zh: 我要求即时付工钱。

items.def: to demand that something happens or that somebody agrees to do something:
items.zh: 指坚决要求、坚持

examples.en: I didn’t want to go but he insisted.
examples.zh: 我并不想去，但他硬要我去。

items.def: to expect or demand something:
items.zh: 指期望、要求

examples.en: You’re asking too much of him.
examples.zh: 你对他要求过分了。

senses.def: something that you need or want

examples.en: the basic requirements of life
examples.zh: 基本生活所需

examples.en: a software solution to meet your requirements
examples.zh: 满足您需要的软件包

examples.en: All products can be customized to suit your specific requirements.
examples.zh: 所有产品均可定制以满足您的特定要求。

examples.en: Our immediate requirement is extra staff.
examples.zh: 我们亟须增加人手。

examples.en: These goods are surplus to requirements (= more than we need).
examples.zh: 这些货物超过了我们的需要。

senses.def: something that you must have in order to do something else

examples.en: to meet/fulfil/satisfy the requirements
examples.zh: 符合／具备／满足必备的条件

examples.en: What is the minimum entry requirement for this course?
examples.zh: 这门课程的基本入学条件是什么？

examples.en: Banks now face stricter regulatory requirements.
examples.zh: 银行现在面临更严格的监管要求。

senses.def: necessary for a particular purpose
senses.zh: 必需的；必备的；必不可少的

examples.en: She lacks the requisite experience for the job.
examples.zh: 她缺少做这份工作所必需的经验。

examples.en: They were not able to start the meeting until the requisite number of members were present.
examples.zh: 直到必要数量的成员出席后，他们才能开始会议。

senses.def: something that you need for a particular purpose

examples.en: toilet requisites (= soap, toothpaste, etc.)
examples.zh: 洗漱用品

examples.en: A university degree has become a requisite for entry into most professions.
examples.zh: 大学学位已经成为在大多数行业谋职的必要条件。

senses.def: a formal, official written request or demand for something

examples.en: the requisition of ships by the government
examples.zh: 政府对船只的征用

examples.en: a requisition form/order
examples.zh: 征用单；征用令

senses.def: to officially demand the use of a building, vehicle, etc., especially during a war or an emergency
senses.zh: （尤指战时或紧急状态时）征用

examples.en: The school was requisitioned as a military hospital.
examples.zh: 学校被征用作为军用医院。

examples.en: The government could not afford to pay for all the grain that it had requisitioned from farmers.
examples.zh: 政府无力支付从农民手中征用的所有粮食。

senses.def: to give something such as love, a favour, kind treatment, etc. in return for what somebody has given you

examples.en: requited love
examples.zh: 得到回报的爱

senses.def: to change the route that a road, vehicle, phone call, etc. normally follows
senses.zh: 改变…的路线；改变…的线路

examples.en: to reroute a road
examples.zh: 改变道路路线

examples.en: to reroute traffic
examples.zh: 改变交通路线

examples.en: The flight was rerouted through Singapore.
examples.zh: 该航班改道途经新加坡。

examples.en: A large proportion of the defence budget has been rerouted to education.
examples.zh: 国防预算的很大一部分已重新用于教育。

senses.def: a television programme that is shown again

examples.en: reruns of old TV shows
examples.zh: 老电视节目的重播

senses.def: an event, such as a race or competition, that is held again
senses.zh: 重新举行的事；重新赛跑；重赛

examples.en: Officials have ordered a rerun of the last race.
examples.zh: 官员们已下令重赛最后一场比赛。

senses.def: something that is done in the same way as something in the past

examples.en: We wanted to avoid a rerun of last year's disastrous trip.
examples.zh: 我们想避免去年那种糟糕的旅行再度出现。

senses.def: to show a film, television programme, etc. again
to do something again in a similar way
senses.zh: （以相同的方式）重做，再次进行

examples.en: to rerun an experiment
examples.zh: 重新做实验

senses.def: to run a race again
the sale to another person of something that you have bought

examples.en: the resale value of a car
examples.zh: 汽车的转卖价格

senses.def: to change the time at which something has been arranged to happen, especially so that it takes place later
senses.zh: 将…改期；修改…的时间表；重新安排

examples.en: The meeting has been rescheduled for next week.
examples.zh: 会议改期到下周举行。

examples.en: The show will now be rescheduled to a later date.
examples.zh: 该节目现在将重新安排到稍后的日期。

senses.def: to arrange for somebody to pay back money that they have borrowed at a later date than was originally agreed

examples.en: to reschedule a loan
examples.zh: 重新安排贷款

examples.en: Repayments on the loan have been rescheduled over 20 years.
examples.zh: 贷款已推迟了分 20 多年偿还。

senses.def: to officially state that a law, contract, decision, etc. no longer has any legal force

examples.en: The agreement was rescinded on 20 March 1993.
examples.zh: 该协议于1993年3月20日被废除。

senses.def: the act of cancelling or ending a law, an order, or an agreement
to save somebody/something from a dangerous or harmful situation

examples.en: The coastguard rescued six people from the sinking boat.
examples.zh: 海岸警卫队从沉船上救起来六个人。

examples.en: The woman was rescued from her burning home by firefighters.
examples.zh: 这名女子被消防队员从着火的家中救出。

examples.en: You rescued me from an embarrassing situation.
examples.zh: 我正感到尴尬，你为我解了围。

examples.en: The house was rescued from demolition.
examples.zh: 这所房子保住了，可以不拆。

examples.en: He rescued a child from drowning.
examples.zh: 他救起了一名落水儿童。

examples.en: The hostages were rescued and brought to safety.
examples.zh: 人质获救并转移到安全场所。

examples.en: The shelter rescues stray dogs.
examples.zh: 收容所救助流浪狗。

examples.en: She had despaired of ever being rescued alive.
examples.zh: 她那时对获救生还已经绝望了。

senses.def: the act of saving somebody/something from a dangerous or difficult situation; the fact of being saved

examples.en: We had given up hope of rescue.
examples.zh: 我们那时已经放弃了获救的希望。

examples.en: A wealthy benefactor came to their rescue with a generous donation.
examples.zh: 一位富有的赞助人慷慨解囊挽救了他们。

examples.en: a rescue operation/mission
examples.zh: 救援行动／任务

examples.en: a mountain rescue team
examples.zh: 登山救援队

examples.en: rescue helicopters/boats/workers
examples.zh: 救援直升机／船只／人员

examples.en: The United Nations is helping to coordinate rescue efforts.
examples.zh: 联合国正在帮助协调救援工作。

senses.def: an occasion when somebody/something is saved from a dangerous or difficult situation

examples.en: Ten fishermen were saved in a daring sea rescue.
examples.zh: 在一次惊心动魄的海上营救行动中，十名渔民获救。

examples.en: Her own boat capsized after she attempted a rescue.
examples.zh: 她在设法营救别人时自己的船也翻了。

intro.en: These words all mean to prevent somebody/​something from dying, losing something, being harmed or embarrassed.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含拯救、挽救、营救之义。

items.def: to prevent somebody/​something from dying, being harmed or destroyed or losing something:
items.zh: 指救、救助、挽救、拯救

examples.en: Doctors were unable to save him.
examples.zh: 医生未能把他救活。

items.def: to save somebody/​something from a dangerous or harmful situation:
items.zh: 指营救、援救、抢救

examples.en: They were rescued by a passing cruise ship.
examples.zh: 他们被一艘经过的游轮救起。

items.def: to rescue somebody/​something from a difficult situation, especially by providing money:
items.zh: 尤指资助某人脱离困境

examples.en: Don’t expect me to bail you out if it all goes wrong.
examples.zh: 如果一切都搞砸了，就别指望我来解救你。

items.def: (formal, religion) to save somebody from the power of evil:
items.zh: 指拯救、救赎

examples.en: He was a sinner, redeemed by the grace of God.
examples.zh: 他是一个罪人，承蒙上主的恩宠才获得救赎。

senses.def: a dog that has been rescued after being treated badly

examples.en: Anyone thinking of buying a dog should think about adopting a rescue dog.
examples.zh: 任何想买狗的人都应该考虑收养一只救援犬。

senses.def: a dog that is trained to take part in rescue operations

examples.en: Training a search and rescue dog can take as long as three years.
examples.zh: 训练搜救犬可能需要长达三年的时间。

senses.def: a person whose job is to try to save people from dangerous or difficult situations, especially after an accident or a disaster

examples.en: Rescue workers are working under very difficult conditions to find survivors from the blast.
examples.zh: 救援人员正在非常困难的条件下努力寻找爆炸的幸存者。

senses.def: a person who saves somebody/something from a dangerous or harmful situation

examples.en: Rescuers began to free the trapped miners.
examples.zh: 救援人员开始营救被困矿工。

senses.def: a careful study of a subject, especially in order to discover new facts or information about it

examples.en: scientific/medical/academic research
examples.zh: 科学／医学／学术研究

examples.en: They are raising money for cancer research.
examples.zh: 他们正在为癌症研究筹集资金。

examples.en: to do/conduct/undertake research
examples.zh: 做研究

examples.en: I've done some research to find out the cheapest way of travelling there.
examples.zh: 我查阅了一番，想找到去那里最省钱的方式。

examples.en: He has carried out extensive research into renewable energy sources.
examples.zh: 他对再生能源进行了广泛研究。

examples.en: Recent research on deaf children has produced some interesting findings about their speech.
examples.zh: 对失聪儿童的最新研究已经在言语能力方面取得了一些令人关注的结果。

examples.en: Research on animals has led to some important medical advances.
examples.zh: 对动物的研究带来了一些重要的医学进步。

examples.en: According to recent research, more people are going to the movies than ever before.
examples.zh: 根据最近的研究，看电影的人比以往任何时候都多。

examples.en: Their latest research project will be funded by the government.
examples.zh: 他们最新的研究项目将由政府资助。

examples.en: Are you hoping to get a research grant?
examples.zh: 您希望获得研究资助吗？

examples.en: a research fellow/assistant/scientist
examples.zh: 研究员/助理/科学家

examples.en: a research institute/centre/laboratory
examples.zh: 研究所/中心/实验室

examples.en: The research findings were published in the Journal of Environmental Quality.
examples.zh: 研究结果发表在《环境质量杂志》上。

senses.def: to study something carefully and try to discover new facts about it

examples.en: to research a topic/subject
examples.zh: 研究一个主题／课题

examples.en: She's in New York researching her new book (= finding facts and information to put in it).
examples.zh: 她在纽约为她的新书搜集材料。

examples.en: They began researching potential buyers for their product.
examples.zh: 他们开始研究其产品的潜在买家。

examples.en: The book has been meticulously/exhaustively/thoroughly researched.
examples.zh: 这本书经过了细致/详尽/彻底的研究。

examples.en: They spent days researching in the school library.
examples.zh: 他们花了几天时间在学校图书馆里做研究。

examples.en: We have to research how the product will actually be used.
examples.zh: 我们必须研究该产品的实际使用方法。

senses.def: (in industry, etc.) work that tries to find new products and processes or to improve existing ones

examples.en: They pour millions of dollars into research and development.
examples.zh: 他们投入数百万元进行研发。

examples.en: I do a lot of research and development work in my job.
examples.zh: 我的工作涉及大量研发工作。

senses.def: any of several government organizations in Britain that support and carry out scientific research, and also provide scientific advice and information to the public and to professional groups
senses.zh: 研究委员会（支持和开展科学研究的英国政府组织，也向公众和专业团体提供科学建议和信息）

examples.en: You could apply for a studentship from the Science and Engineering Research Council.
examples.zh: 你可以申请科学和工程研究委员会的研修生奖学金。

senses.def: a person who studies something carefully and tries to discover new facts about it

examples.en: European researchers say olive oil could help prevent cancer.
examples.zh: 欧洲研究人员说橄榄油有助于预防癌症。

examples.en: Researchers found there was no evidence of an increased risk of infection.
examples.zh: 研究人员发现没有证据表明感染风险增加。

examples.en: The study was carried out by researchers at Bristol University.
examples.zh: 这项研究是由布里斯托大学的研究人员进行的。

examples.en: a leading researcher in the field of artificial intelligence
examples.zh: 人工智能领域的权威研究员

examples.en: researchers in psychology
examples.zh: 心理学研究人员

senses.def: to cut out part of an organ or a piece of tissue
an operation to cut out part of an organ or a piece of tissue
to sell something that you have bought

examples.en: He resells the goods at a profit.
examples.zh: 他转卖货品赢利。

senses.def: the fact of being or looking similar to somebody/something

examples.en: a striking/close/strong resemblance
examples.zh: 明显的／不小的／显著的相似之处

examples.en: Yes, there are family resemblances.
examples.zh: 是的，有家族相似之处。

examples.en: She bears an uncanny resemblance to Dido.
examples.zh: 她长得酷似迪多。

examples.en: The movie bears little resemblance to the original novel.
examples.zh: 电影和原著相去甚远。

examples.en: The plot of the movie bears more than a passing resemblance to Jane Austen's ‘Emma’.
examples.zh: 这部影片的情节与简·奥斯汀的《爱玛》不只是一点点的相似。

examples.en: The resemblance between the two signatures was remarkable.
examples.zh: 两个签名的相似之处非常明显。

senses.def: to look like or be similar to another person or thing

examples.en: She closely resembles her sister.
examples.zh: 她和她姐姐很像。

examples.en: So many hotels resemble each other.
examples.zh: 许多酒店看上去都差不多。

examples.en: The plant resembles grass in appearance.
examples.zh: 这种植物的外形像草。

senses.def: to feel bitter or angry about something, especially because you feel it is unfair
senses.zh: 愤恨；感到气愤；愤愤不平

examples.en: I deeply resented her criticism.
examples.zh: 我对她的批评感到非常气愤。

examples.en: The children resented the new woman in their father’s life.
examples.zh: 孩子们怨恨父亲生活中的新女人。

examples.en: He bitterly resents being treated like a child.
examples.zh: 他十分厌恶被别人当孩子对待。

examples.en: She resented him making all the decisions.
examples.zh: 她讨厌什么事都要听他的。

examples.en: She resented his making all the decisions.
examples.zh: 她讨厌什么事都要听他的。

senses.def: feeling bitter or angry about something that you think is unfair
senses.zh: 感到气愤的；憎恨的；愤慨的

examples.en: a resentful look
examples.zh: 充满怨恨的眼神

examples.en: They seemed to be resentful of our presence there.
examples.zh: 他们好像对我们在那里露面很生气。

examples.en: She was resentful at having been left out of the team.
examples.zh: 她对被运动队淘汰感到气愤。

senses.def: in a way that shows that you feel bitter or angry about something that you think is unfair
senses.zh: 感到气愤的；憎恨的；愤慨的

senses.def: a feeling of anger or unhappiness about something that you think is unfair

examples.en: to feel/harbour/bear resentment towards/against somebody
examples.zh: 对某人感到／深怀／有怨恨

examples.en: She could not conceal the deep resentment she felt at the way she had been treated.
examples.zh: 受到那样的待遇，她无法掩藏内心强烈的愤恨。

senses.def: an arrangement for a seat on a plane or train, a room in a hotel, etc. to be kept for you

examples.en: I'll call the restaurant and make a reservation.
examples.zh: 我要给餐厅打个电话预订座位。

examples.en: We have a reservation in the name of Grant.
examples.zh: 我们是以格兰特的名字预订的。

examples.en: I had to cancel my hotel reservation.
examples.zh: 我不得不取消酒店预订。

senses.def: a feeling of doubt about a plan or an idea

examples.en: I have serious reservations about his ability to do the job.
examples.zh: 我非常怀疑他有没有能力胜任这项工作。

examples.en: They support the measures without reservation (= completely).
examples.zh: 他们毫无保留地支持这些措施。

senses.def: an area of land in the US that is kept separate for native North Americans to live in
senses.zh: （美国为美洲土著居民划出的）保留地，居留地

senses.def: (in India) the policy of keeping a fixed number of jobs or places in schools, colleges, etc. for people who are members of scheduled castes
senses.zh: 预留政策（印度为表列种族、表列部族或落后种姓成员保留一定数量的工作岗位或入学名额等）

senses.def: (in India) the policy of keeping a fixed number of jobs or places in schools, colleges, etc. for people who are members of Scheduled Castes
senses.zh: 预留政策（印度为表列种族、表列部族或落后种姓成员保留一定数量的工作岗位或入学名额等）

senses.def: a supply of something that is available to be used in the future or when it is needed

examples.en: cash/foreign currency reserves
examples.zh: 现金／外汇储备

examples.en: large oil and gas reserves
examples.zh: 大量的石油和天然气贮藏量

examples.en: reserve funds
examples.zh: 储备金

examples.en: He discovered unexpected reserves of strength.
examples.zh: 他出乎意料地发现还有体力。

examples.en: The country has the world's largest reserves of coal.
examples.zh: 该国拥有世界上最大的煤炭储量。

examples.en: The company has substantial reserves of capital.
examples.zh: 这家公司有大量的资本储备。

senses.def: a piece of land that is a protected area for animals, plants, etc.

examples.en: a wildlife/forest reserve
examples.zh: 野生生物／森林保护区

senses.def: an area of land in the US that is kept separate for native North Americans to live in
senses.zh: （美国为美洲土著居民划出的）保留地，居留地

senses.def: the quality that somebody has when they do not talk easily to other people about their ideas, feelings, etc.

examples.en: She found it difficult to make friends because of her natural reserve.
examples.zh: 她因天性矜持很难交到朋友。

examples.en: Jaime always talked to people without reserve.
examples.zh: 海梅总是毫无保留地与人交谈。

senses.def: a feeling that you do not want to accept or agree to something, etc. until you are quite sure that it is all right to do so

examples.en: Any contract should be treated with reserve until it has been checked.
examples.zh: 任何契约在经过核实之前都应谨慎对待。

examples.en: She trusted him without reserve (= completely).
