synonyms.words: come back ▪ go back ▪ get back ▪ turn back

intro.en: These words all mean to come or go back from one place to another.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含回来、回去、返回之义。

items.def: to come or go back from one place to another:
items.zh: 指回来、回去、返回

examples.en: I waited a long time for him to return.
examples.zh: 我等他回来等了很长时间。

items.def: to return. Come back is usually used from the point of view of the person or place that somebody returns to:
items.zh: come back 通常指回到说话人处或所在的地方

items.def: to return to the place you recently or originally came from or that you have been to before. Go back is usually used from the point of view of the person who is returning:
items.zh: go back 通常是从要返回者的角度来说

items.def: to arrive back somewhere, especially at your home or the place where you are staying:
items.zh: 指返回、回去，尤指回家

examples.en: What time did you get back last night?
examples.zh: 你昨晚什么时候回家的？

items.def: to return the way that you came, especially because something stops you from continuing:
items.zh: 指原路返回、往回走，尤指因某事阻止而不能继续前进

examples.en: The weather got so bad that we had to turn back.
examples.zh: 天气变得非常恶劣，我们不得不循原路折回。

senses.def: the address that a letter should be returned to if it cannot be delivered

examples.en: There was no return address on the back of the envelope.
examples.zh: 信封背面没有回信地址。

examples.en: Write your return address in the upper left-hand corner of the envelope.
examples.zh: 请把回寄地址写在信封的左上角。

senses.def: mail that is sent as a reply or response to something

examples.en: This is where the return mail is received and read.
examples.zh: 在这里可以查看回函。

examples.en: Please reply to this letter by return mail (= as soon as possible).
examples.zh: 请尽快回复这封信。

senses.def: a second match or game between the same two players or teams
senses.zh: （相同对手间的）第二回合比赛，再度交锋

senses.def: a ticket for a journey to a place and back again

examples.en: I lost my return ticket and was stranded in Thailand.
examples.zh: 我的回程票弄丢了，结果被困在了泰国。

senses.def: a trip to a place that you have been to once before, or a trip to see somebody who has already come to see you

examples.en: This hotel is worth a return visit.
examples.zh: 这家旅店值得再次光顾。

examples.en: The US president is making a return visit to Moscow.
examples.zh: 美国总统正在对莫斯科进行回访。

examples.en: They came here last week, and we'll pay them a return visit in the summer.
examples.zh: 他们上周来拜访，而我们将在夏天回访他们。

senses.def: that can or must be given back after a period of time
senses.zh: 可退还的；应归还的；必须交还的

examples.en: A returnable deposit is payable on arrival.
examples.zh: 抵达时应支付可退还押金。

examples.en: The application form is returnable not later than 7th June.
examples.zh: 申请表应不迟于 6 月 7 日交回。

senses.def: that can be taken back to a shop in order to be used again

examples.en: returnable bottles
examples.zh: 可退还的瓶子

senses.def: a person who returns to their own country, after living in another country
a person who goes back to work after not working for a long time
senses.zh: 重返工作岗位者；再就业者

examples.en: women returners
examples.zh: 重返工作岗位的妇女

examples.en: courses for adult returners
examples.zh: 再就业成人教育课程

senses.def: an official in a particular area who is responsible for arranging an election and announcing the result
if you retweet
a message written by another user on the social media
senses.zh: 在推特上转发的信息或帖子

senses.def: a first name for boys
a popular sandwich made with corned beef
senses.zh: 鲁本三明治：一种流行的三明治，用咸牛肉，瑞士奶酪和酸菜在黑麦面包上制成，然后烤制

senses.def: the act of joining together two or more regions or parts of a country so that they form a single political unit again

examples.en: the reunification of Germany
examples.zh: 德国的重新统一

senses.def: to join together two or more regions or parts of a country so that they form a single political unit again
a social occasion or party attended by a group of people who have not seen each other for a long time

examples.en: a family reunion
examples.zh: 家人团聚

examples.en: the school’s annual reunion
examples.zh: 一年一度的校友联欢会

examples.en: a reunion of the class of ’85
examples.zh: 85 届同学聚会

senses.def: the act of people coming together after they have been apart for some time

examples.en: an emotional reunion between mother and son
examples.zh: 母子团圆的激动场面

examples.en: Christmas is a time of reunion.
examples.zh: 圣诞节是团聚的日子。

senses.def: the action of becoming a single group or organization again

examples.en: the reunion of the Church of England with the Church of Rome
examples.zh: 英格兰圣公会和天主教的再度联合

senses.def: to bring two or more people together again after they have been separated for a long time; to come together again

examples.en: Last night she was reunited with her children.
examples.zh: 昨天晚上，她和她的子女团聚。

examples.en: The family was reunited after the war.
examples.zh: 战争过后，一家人又相聚了。

examples.en: There have been rumours that the band will reunite for a world tour.
examples.zh: 有传言说这个乐队将再度聚集，来一次环球巡演。

senses.def: to join together again separate areas or separate groups within an organization, a political party, etc.; to come together again

examples.en: As leader, his main aim is to reunite the party.
examples.zh: 作为领导，他的主要目标就是要使党内各派团结起来。

senses.def: that can be used again
senses.zh: 可重复使用的；可再次使用的

examples.en: reusable plastic bottles
examples.zh: 可重复使用的塑料瓶

senses.def: to use something again

examples.en: Please reuse your envelopes.
examples.zh: 信封请重复利用。

senses.def: the act of using something again

examples.en: The water is conserved and reheated for reuse.
examples.zh: 水被保存并重新加热以供再利用。

examples.en: a plan for the reduction, reuse and recycling of all waste
examples.zh: 减少、再利用和回收所有废物的计划

senses.def: a British company, now part of Thomson Reuters, which employs journalists all over the world and sells news to newspapers, television and radio. It also provides stock exchange
when you rev

examples.en: The taxi driver revved up his engine.
examples.zh: 出租车司机把发动机发动起来。

examples.en: I could hear the car revving outside.
examples.zh: 我可以听到外面汽车发动的声音。

senses.def: a complete turn of an engine, used when talking about an engine’s speed

examples.en: 4 000 revs per minute
examples.zh: 每分钟 4 000 转

examples.en: The needle on the rev counter soared.
examples.zh: 转速表的指针猛升。

examples.en: The engine is almost silent at low revs.
examples.zh: 发动机在低转速时几乎没有声音。

senses.def: (used before a name) reverend
senses.zh: （尊称神职人员）尊敬的，可敬的

examples.en: Rev. Jesse Jackson
examples.zh: 尊敬的杰西·杰克逊牧师

senses.def: Wilbert Awdry (1911-97) an English vicar
senses.zh: W Awdry牧师：Wilbert Awdry（1911-97）是英国牧师和儿童读物的作家。他以创造汤姆斯坦克引擎而闻名。

senses.def: an act of estimating the value of something again, especially giving it a higher value
senses.zh: 重新评价，重新评估（尤指给予更高评价）

senses.def: an increase in the value of the money of one country when it is exchanged for the money of another
senses.zh: 提高（货币的）兑换价；使（货币）升值

examples.en: the revaluation of the pound
examples.zh: 英镑的升值

senses.def: to estimate the value of something again, especially giving it a higher value
senses.zh: 重新评价，重新评估（尤指给予更高评价）

senses.def: to increase the value of the money of a country when it is exchanged for the money of another country
senses.zh: 提高（货币的）兑换价；使（货币）升值

examples.en: The yen is to be revalued.
examples.zh: 日元的兑换价将调高。

senses.def: to make changes to the form of something, usually to improve its appearance
senses.zh: 改变；修改；（通常指）改进外观，翻新

examples.en: The company is attempting to revamp its image.
examples.zh: 公司正试图重塑形象。

senses.def: a change to the form of something, usually to improve its appearance
senses.zh: 改变；修改；（通常指）改进外观，翻新

examples.en: Could your kitchen do with a revamp?
examples.zh: 你的厨房可以改造一下吗？

senses.def: a policy of attacking somebody who has attacked you, especially by a country in order to get back land
senses.zh: （尤指国家为收复失地的）复仇主义

senses.def: to make something known to somebody

examples.en: to reveal a secret
examples.zh: 泄露一条秘密

examples.en: Her expression revealed nothing.
examples.zh: 从她的表情什么也看不出来。

examples.en: A series of flashbacks reveal the details of the tragedy.
examples.zh: 一系列闪回展示了这一悲剧的细节。

examples.en: The identity of the buyer has not been revealed.
examples.zh: 买家的身份尚未透露。

examples.en: The survey reveals some worrying statistics.
examples.zh: 该调查揭示了一些令人担忧的统计数据。

examples.en: The doctors did not reveal the truth to him.
examples.zh: 医生没有向他透露真相。

examples.en: The report reveals that the company made a loss of £20 million last year.
examples.zh: 报告显示，公司去年亏损 2 000 万英镑。

examples.en: It was revealed that important evidence had been suppressed.
examples.zh: 据透露，重要的证据被隐瞒了。

examples.en: Officers could not reveal how he died.
examples.zh: 警察不能透露他的死因。

examples.en: Salted peanuts were recently revealed to be the nation's favourite snack.
examples.zh: 最近发现，咸味花生是该国最受人喜爱的小吃。

examples.en: He has been revealed as a traitor.
examples.zh: 他的叛徒身份被揭露出来。

senses.def: to show something that previously could not be seen

examples.en: He laughed, revealing a line of white teeth.
examples.zh: 他笑了起来，露出一排洁白的牙齿。

examples.en: The door opened to reveal a cosy little room.
examples.zh: 房门打开，一间温暖舒适的小屋展现在眼前。

examples.en: X-rays revealed a fracture.
examples.zh: X光照片显示有一处骨折。

examples.en: Excavations at these sites have revealed impressive stone structures.
examples.zh: 这些遗址的发掘揭示了令人印象深刻的石头结构。

examples.en: She crouched in the dark, too frightened to reveal herself.
examples.zh: 她蜷缩在黑暗中，吓得不敢露面。

senses.def: the moment when a previously secret piece of information is made known, such as the winner of a prize, or the solution to a mystery in a film or TV drama
senses.zh: 谜底揭晓的时刻；真相大白的时候

examples.en: The big reveal at the end of the movie answers all questions.
examples.zh: 电影结尾时真相大白，所有谜团都解开了。

senses.def: religion that is based on a belief that God has shown himself
senses.zh: 启示宗教，天启教（以神的启示为信仰基础）

senses.def: in a way that gives interesting information that you did not know before
senses.zh: 揭露真相的；发人深省的

examples.en: He spoke revealingly about his problems.
examples.zh: 他谈论了他的问题，揭露了他不为人知的一面。

senses.def: in a way that allows more of somebody's body to be seen than usual
senses.zh: 暴露的；使身体过分裸露的

senses.def: a tune that is played to wake soldiers in the morning; the time when it is played

examples.en: Reveille sounded at first light.
examples.zh: 天一亮，起床号就拉响了。

senses.def: to spend time enjoying yourself in a noisy, enthusiastic way
noisy celebrations

examples.en: Bright lights illuminated the revels and feasting.
examples.zh: 明亮的灯光照亮了狂欢和盛宴。

senses.def: to enjoy something very much

examples.en: She was clearly revelling in all the attention.
examples.zh: 显而易见，她对大家的关注感到十分高兴。

examples.en: He revelled in the freedom he was allowed.
examples.zh: 他尽情享受着他所能拥有的自由。

examples.en: Some people seem to revel in annoying others.
examples.zh: 有些人好像总是喜欢惹人烦。

examples.en: She revelled in defying the critics.
examples.zh: 她热衷于反抗批评者。

senses.def: a fact that people are made aware of, especially one that has been secret and is surprising
senses.zh: 被暴露的真相；被曝光的秘闻

examples.en: startling/sensational revelations about her private life
examples.zh: 对她的私生活令人吃惊的曝光

examples.en: He was dismissed after revelations that confidential files were missing.
examples.zh: 机密文件不翼而飞的消息披露后他被解雇了。

senses.def: the act of making people aware of something that has been secret

examples.en: The company's financial problems followed the revelation of a major fraud scandal.
examples.zh: 重大的欺诈丑闻被揭露之后，公司随之出现了财务问题。

senses.def: something that is considered to be a sign or message from God

examples.en: These events were seen as a divine revelation.
examples.zh: 这些事件被视为神圣的启示。

senses.def: to be a completely new or surprising experience; to be different from what was expected
senses.zh: 让人大开眼界；令人耳目一新；出乎意料

examples.en: His performance in the race today was a revelation to everyone.
examples.zh: 他今天在赛跑中的表现让所有人都大吃一惊。

examples.en: My trip to Texas was a revelation.
examples.zh: 这次得克萨斯之行使我大开眼界。

senses.def: to be a completely new or surprising experience; to be different from what was expected
senses.zh: 让人大开眼界；令人耳目一新；出乎意料

examples.en: His performance in the race today was a revelation to everyone.
examples.zh: 他今天在赛跑中的表现让所有人都大吃一惊。

examples.en: My trip to Texas was a revelation.
examples.zh: 这次得克萨斯之行使我大开眼界。

senses.def: making people aware of something that they did not know before

examples.en: a revelatory insight
examples.zh: 有启发作用的见解

senses.def: a person who is having fun in a noisy way, usually with a group of other people and often after drinking alcohol
noisy fun, usually involving a lot of eating and drinking

examples.en: We could hear sounds of revelry from next door.
examples.zh: 我们能够听到隔壁纵饮狂欢的声音。

examples.en: New Year revelries
examples.zh: 新年狂欢

senses.def: a person who has returned, especially one who is thought to have come back from the dead
senses.zh: 一个已经返回的人，尤其是一个被认为已经从死里复活的人

examples.en: The stories focus on unnatural death, revenants and vampires.
examples.zh: 这些故事的重点是非自然死亡、亡灵和吸血鬼。

senses.def: something that you do in order to make somebody suffer because they have made you suffer

examples.en: She is seeking revenge for the murder of her husband.
examples.zh: 丈夫遭到谋杀，她在寻找机会报仇。

examples.en: The bombing was an act of revenge for the shooting of two young boys.
examples.zh: 这次轰炸是针对枪杀两个小男孩而实施的报复行动。

examples.en: The bombing was in revenge for the assassination.
examples.zh: 爆炸事件是对暗杀行为的报复。

examples.en: He swore to take (his) revenge on his political enemies.
examples.zh: 他发誓要报复他的政敌。

examples.en: revenge attacks/killings
examples.zh: 报复性的进攻／杀戮

senses.def: the defeat of a person or team that defeated you in a previous game
senses.zh: （曾经失败一方的）雪耻，打败对手

examples.en: The team wanted to get revenge for their defeat earlier in the season.
examples.zh: 球队想要为这个赛季早些时候的失败雪耻。

examples.en: This was sweet revenge for our defeat earlier in the season.
examples.zh: 本赛季早些时候我们输给了对手，这次可算是个令人痛快的复仇。

senses.def: the act of sharing private, sexual photos or videos of somebody without their permission, on the internet or via phones, in order to make them feel embarrassed and upset
senses.zh: 报复性色情（为羞辱或恐吓他人而擅自传播其性私密照片或视频）

examples.en: Online abuse and revenge porn have become serious problems for many young people.
examples.zh: 网络凌辱和报复性色情已成为许多年轻人的严重问题。

senses.def: to punish or hurt somebody because they have made you suffer

examples.en: She vowed to be revenged on them all.
examples.zh: 她发誓一定要报复他们所有人。

examples.en: Macduff declares his intention to revenge himself on Macbeth.
examples.zh: 麦克德夫宣布他打算向麦克白报仇。

senses.def: the money that a government receives from taxes or that an organization, etc. receives from its business
senses.zh: 财政收入；税收收入；收益

examples.en: The government is currently facing a shortfall in tax revenue.
examples.zh: 政府目前有税收缺口。

examples.en: Advertising revenue finances the commercial television channels.
examples.zh: 广告收入给商业电视频道提供资金。

examples.en: a slump in oil revenues
examples.zh: 石油收入的下跌

examples.en: The company's annual revenues rose by 30%.
examples.zh: 公司的年收入增加了 30%。

senses.def: the government department in the UK that is responsible for collecting taxes
the money that a company or person earns from a particular activity; a means by which a company or person earns money

examples.en: Hiring the venue out for weddings will create an additional revenue stream.
examples.zh: 出租场地用于举办婚礼将创造额外的收入来源。

examples.en: The show has become a lucrative revenue stream for the TV company.
examples.zh: 该节目已成为电视公司利润丰厚的收入来源。

senses.def: a sound effect that can be changed by electronic means to give music more or less of an echo
to be repeated several times as it is reflected off different surfaces

examples.en: Her voice reverberated around the hall.
examples.zh: 她的声音在大厅里回荡。

examples.en: The crash reverberated through the house.
examples.zh: 撞击声在房子里回响。

senses.def: to seem to shake because of a loud noise

examples.en: The hall reverberated with the sound of music and dancing.
examples.zh: 音乐和舞蹈的声音使得整个大厅似乎都在震颤。

senses.def: to have a strong effect on people for a long time or over a large area
senses.zh: 有长久深刻的影响；产生广泛影响

examples.en: Repercussions of the case continue to reverberate through the financial world.
examples.zh: 这件事持续影响着整个金融界。

senses.def: a loud noise that continues for some time after it has been produced because of the surfaces around it

examples.en: The reverberations of the drum were still vibrating in the air.
examples.zh: 鼓声的余音仍在空气中震动。

examples.en: The house shook with the reverberation of the bomb.
examples.zh: 房子因炸弹的回响而摇晃。

senses.def: the effects of something that happens, especially unpleasant ones that spread among a large number of people
senses.zh: 影响；（尤指）广泛的消极影响

examples.en: the political reverberations of the scandal
examples.zh: 丑闻的政治影响

senses.def: to admire and respect somebody/something very much

examples.en: Her name is revered in Spain.
examples.zh: 她的名字在西班牙受到尊敬。

examples.en: He is now revered as a national hero.
examples.zh: 他现在被尊为民族英雄。

senses.def: a feeling of admiring and respecting somebody/something very much

examples.en: The poem conveys his deep reverence for nature.
examples.zh: 这首诗表达了他对大自然深深的崇敬之情。

senses.def: the title of a member of the clergy
senses.zh: （尊称神职人员）尊敬的，可敬的

examples.en: the Reverend Charles Dodgson
examples.zh: 尊敬的查尔斯·道奇森牧师

examples.en: Good morning, Reverend.
examples.zh: 早安，神父。

senses.def: a title of respect used when talking to or about a Mother Superior
senses.zh: （对女修道院院长的尊称）可敬的修女

examples.en: You have a visitor, Reverend Mother.
examples.zh: 您有客人来访，圣母。

examples.en: The Reverend Mother will see you now.
examples.zh: 圣母现在就要见你了。

senses.def: showing deep respect
senses.zh: 充满敬意的；深表崇敬的

examples.en: His voice was hushed, almost reverent.
examples.zh: 他的声音低沉，近乎虔诚。

senses.def: showing deep respect
senses.zh: 充满敬意的；深表崇敬的

examples.en: His name was always mentioned in almost reverential tones.
examples.zh: 人们每次提起他的名字，语调中几乎总是充满了敬意。

senses.def: in a way that shows deep respect
senses.zh: 充满敬意的；深表崇敬的

examples.en: She lowered her voice reverentially.
examples.zh: 她恭敬地压低了声音。

senses.def: in a way that shows deep respect
senses.zh: 充满敬意的；深表崇敬的

senses.def: a state of thinking about pleasant things, almost as though you are dreaming

examples.en: She was jolted out of her reverie as the door opened.
examples.zh: 门一开就把她从幻想中惊醒。

senses.def: the edge of a coat, jacket, etc. that is turned back so that you see the opposite side of it, especially at the lapel
a change of something so that it is the opposite of what it was
senses.zh: 颠倒；彻底转变；反转；倒置

examples.en: a complete/dramatic/sudden reversal of policy
examples.zh: 政策的全面／剧烈／突然转变

examples.en: the reversal of a decision
examples.zh: 决定的撤销

examples.en: The government suffered a total reversal of fortune(s) last week.
examples.zh: 上星期，政府的命运发生了逆转。

senses.def: a change from being successful to having problems or being defeated
senses.zh: 倒退；逆转；退步；转胜为败

examples.en: the team’s recent reversal
examples.zh: 球队最近的失败

examples.en: The company's financial problems were only a temporary reversal.
examples.zh: 公司的财务问题只是暂时的挫折。

examples.en: Industrial unrest and cheaper imports played their part in the company's reversal of fortunes.
examples.zh: 工业动荡和比较低廉的进口使公司形势恶化。

senses.def: an exchange of positions or functions between two or more people

examples.en: It’s a complete role reversal/reversal of roles (= for example when a child cares for a parent).
examples.zh: 这是彻底的角色转换。

senses.def: to change something completely so that it is the opposite of what it was before
senses.zh: 颠倒；彻底转变；使完全相反

examples.en: Falling birth rates may reverse the trend towards early retirement.
examples.zh: 出生率下降可能扭转提前退休的趋势。

examples.en: to reverse a procedure/process
examples.zh: 逆转程序/过程

examples.en: The government has failed to reverse the economic decline.
examples.zh: 政府未能扭转经济滑坡的趋势。

examples.en: It is sometimes possible to arrest or reverse the disease.
examples.zh: 有时可以阻止病情发展或使病情彻底好转。

senses.group: change to opposite 转化为对立面

senses.def: to change a previous decision, law, etc. to the opposite one

examples.en: The Court of Appeal reversed the decision.
examples.zh: 上诉法庭撤销了这项裁决。

examples.en: The policy is likely to be reversed if there is a change of government.
examples.zh: 如果政府改组，这项政策很可能被废除。

examples.en: to reverse a judgement
examples.zh: 推翻判决

senses.group: change to opposite 转化为对立面

senses.def: to turn something the opposite way around or change the order of something around

examples.en: Writing is reversed in a mirror.
examples.zh: 镜子里的字是反的。

examples.en: You should reverse the order of these pages.
examples.zh: 你该把这几页的顺序颠倒过来。

examples.en: To solve the puzzle, simply reverse the order of the numbers.
examples.zh: 要解开这个谜，只要颠倒数字的顺序即可。

senses.group: change to opposite 转化为对立面

senses.def: to exchange the positions or functions of two things

examples.en: It felt as if we had reversed our roles of parent and child.
examples.zh: 感觉我们就像家长和孩子交换了角色。

examples.en: She used to work for me, but our situations are now reversed.
examples.zh: 过去她为我工作，而现在我们的地位对调了。

senses.def: to admit you were wrong or to stop having a particular position in an argument

examples.en: He has reversed himself on a dozen issues.
examples.zh: 他已经不再坚持自己在一系列问题上的立场。

senses.def: when a vehicle or its driver reverses

examples.en: He reversed around the corner.
examples.zh: 他倒车转过拐角。

examples.en: She reversed into a parking space.
examples.zh: 她将车倒着开进停车位。

examples.en: Caution! This truck is reversing.
examples.zh: 小心！卡车在倒车。

examples.en: Now reverse the car.
examples.zh: 现在倒车。

senses.def: to make a phone call that will be paid for by the person you are calling, not by you

examples.en: I want to reverse the charges, please.
examples.zh: 劳驾，我想打一个由受话人付费的电话。

senses.def: the opposite of what has just been mentioned

examples.en: This problem is the reverse of the previous one.
examples.zh: 这个问题和上一个问题相反。

examples.en: Although I expected to enjoy living in the country, in fact the reverse is true.
examples.zh: 尽管我原以为会喜欢乡村生活，但实际情况正好相反。

examples.en: In the south, the reverse applies.
examples.zh: 在南方，情况相反。

examples.en: It wasn't easy to persuade her to come—quite the reverse.
examples.zh: 说服她过来不容易，实在太难了。

examples.en: If you tell children to do something, they will often do the exact reverse.
examples.zh: 告诉孩子要做什么事，他们往往会反着干。

senses.def: the back of a coin, piece of material, piece of paper, etc.

examples.en: The coin has a coat of arms stamped on the reverse.
examples.zh: 硬币的背面刻有徽章。

examples.en: The coin has a date on one side and the emperor's head on the reverse.
examples.zh: 硬币的一面是日期，另一面是君主的头像。

senses.def: the machine in a vehicle used to make it move backwards

examples.en: Put the car in/into reverse.
examples.zh: 给汽车挂上倒挡。

senses.def: a loss or defeat; a change from success to failure

examples.en: Property values have suffered another reverse.
examples.zh: 房地产价值再次遭受损失。

examples.en: a damaging political reverse
examples.zh: 具有破坏性的政治倒退

examples.en: Their forces have suffered serious reverses in recent months.
examples.zh: 他们的部队在最近几个月里严重受挫。

senses.def: to start to happen or to make something happen in the opposite way

examples.en: In 2008 economic growth went into reverse.
examples.zh: 2008 年，经济增长发生了逆转。

examples.en: Various problems have put the company’s expansion plans into reverse.
examples.zh: 各种问题使该公司的扩张计划陷入倒退。

senses.def: in the opposite order or way

examples.en: The secret number is my phone number in reverse.
examples.zh: 这个密码是我的电话号码的逆序排列。

examples.en: We did a similar trip to you, but in reverse.
examples.zh: 我们走了和你相似的旅程，但方向相反。

senses.def: opposite to what has been mentioned

examples.en: to travel in the reverse direction
examples.zh: 向相反方向行进

examples.en: The winners were announced in reverse order (= the person in the lowest place was announced first).
examples.zh: 获胜者是按逆序宣布的。

examples.en: The experiment had the reverse effect to what was intended.
examples.zh: 实验的结果与原来的意图相反。

examples.en: One year later she made the same journey in the reverse direction.
examples.zh: 一年以后她从相反的方向出发重游了那条路线。

senses.def: opposite to the front

examples.en: Iron the garment on the reverse side.
examples.zh: 这件衣服要从反面熨。

examples.en: On the reverse side of the medal is a coat of arms.
examples.zh: 奖牌的背面是盾徽。

senses.def: to start to happen or to make something happen in the opposite way

examples.en: In 2008 economic growth went into reverse.
examples.zh: 2008 年，经济增长发生了逆转。

examples.en: Various problems have put the company’s expansion plans into reverse.
examples.zh: 各种问题使该公司的扩张计划陷入倒退。

senses.def: in the opposite order or way

examples.en: The secret number is my phone number in reverse.
examples.zh: 这个密码是我的电话号码的逆序排列。

examples.en: We did a similar trip to you, but in reverse.
examples.zh: 我们走了和你相似的旅程，但方向相反。

senses.def: a reverse-charge
senses.zh: （电话）由受话方付费的，对方付费的

senses.def: by asking the person who receives a phone call to pay for it rather than the person who makes it
senses.zh: （电话）由受话方付费的，对方付费的

examples.en: I didn't have any money so I had to call reverse-charge.
examples.zh: 我没钱了，只好打对方付费电话。

senses.def: the practice or policy of making sure that jobs, advantages etc. are given to people from groups that are often treated unfairly because of their race, sex, etc.
senses.zh: 反向区别对待，反向歧视，逆向歧视（对因种族、性别等原因遭受歧视的群体在就业等方面给予特别照顾）

examples.en: They claim to be the victims of reverse discrimination.
examples.zh: 他们声称是逆向歧视的受害者。

examples.en: The court heard arguments that programs to reserve some public works contracts for minorities cause reverse discrimination.
examples.zh: 法院听审了有关将公共工程合同预留给少数族裔的方案会造成逆向区别对待的论据。

senses.def: the copying of another company’s product after examining it carefully to find out how it is made
senses.zh: 逆向工程，反求工程（研究另一家公司产品的制造后加以仿制）

senses.def: the fact that a piece of clothing, material, etc. can be turned inside out and worn or used with either side showing
senses.zh: 可翻转的；可两面穿的；正反两用的

senses.def: the fact that a process, an action or a disease can be changed so that something returns to its original state or situation
senses.zh: 可逆的；可恢复原状的；可医治的

examples.en: The proposals should consider the reversibility of environmental effects.
examples.zh: 提案应考虑环境影响的可逆性。

senses.def: that can be turned inside out and worn or used with either side showing
senses.zh: 可翻转的；可两面穿的；正反两用的

examples.en: a reversible jacket
examples.zh: 可两面穿的夹克

senses.def: that can be changed so that something returns to its original state or situation
senses.zh: 可逆的；可恢复原状的；可医治的

examples.en: Is the trend towards privatization reversible?
examples.zh: 私有化趋势可能逆转吗？

examples.en: reversible kidney failure
examples.zh: 可医治的肾衰竭

senses.def: a white light at the back of a vehicle that comes on when the vehicle moves backwards
the act or process of returning to a former state or condition

examples.en: a reversion to traditional farming methods
examples.zh: 传统耕作方法的回归

senses.def: the return of land or property to somebody
senses.zh: （土地或财产的）归还，归属原主

examples.en: the reversion of Hong Kong to China
examples.zh: 香港回归中国

senses.def: to reply

examples.en: Excellent openings—kindly revert with your updated CV.
examples.zh: 绝佳招聘职位，请回信寄来您的最新简历。

examples.en: We request you to kindly revert back if you have any further requirements.
examples.zh: 如果您有任何进一步的要求，请回复。

senses.def: to return to the original owner again
to return to a former state; to start doing something again that you used to do in the past

examples.en: After her divorce she reverted to her maiden name.
examples.zh: 离婚以后，她重新用起娘家的姓氏。

examples.en: His manner seems to have reverted to normal.
examples.zh: 他的举止好像已经恢复了正常。

examples.en: Try not to revert to your old eating habits.
examples.zh: 尽力不要恢复你过去的饮食习惯。

examples.en: For a while the children behaved well but they soon reverted to type (= returned to their usual ways).
examples.zh: 孩子们一度表现良好，但很快又恢复了他们原来的样子。

senses.def: to return to an earlier topic or subject
senses.zh: 重提，回到，恢复（先前的话题或主题）

examples.en: So, to revert to your earlier question…
examples.zh: 那么，回到你先前所提的问题…

examples.en: The conversation kept reverting to the events of March 6th.
examples.zh: 谈话一再回到 3 月 6 日所发生的事件上来。

senses.def: stones or other material used to make a wall stronger, hold back a bank of earth, etc.
a report in a newspaper or magazine, or on the internet, television or radio, in which somebody gives their opinion of a book, play, film, product, etc.; the act of writing this kind of report
senses.zh: （对书、戏剧、电影、产品等的）评介，评论

examples.en: a book review
examples.zh: 书评

examples.en: She gave the film a glowing review.
examples.zh: 她对这部电影褒扬有加。

examples.en: mixed/negative/bad reviews
examples.zh: 褒贬不一/负面/差评

examples.en: a positive/favourable review
examples.zh: 正面/有利的评论

examples.en: an online review of the restaurant
examples.zh: 餐厅的在线评论

examples.en: He submitted his latest novel for review.
examples.zh: 他提交了自己最新的小说供评论。

senses.def: an act of looking again at something you have studied or written, especially in order to prepare for an exam
senses.zh: （尤指为准备考试的）温习，复习

examples.en: We need to do the review for the test tomorrow.
examples.zh: 为了明天的考试，我们需要复习。

examples.en: I should have time for a quick review of my notes before the test.
examples.zh: 测验前我应该有时间把笔记过一遍。

examples.en: We'll have time at the end of class for review.
examples.zh: 下课前我们还有时间复习。

examples.en: There is a grammar review section at the end of each unit.
examples.zh: 每个单元末尾都有语法复习部分。

senses.def: an examination of something, with the intention of changing it if necessary
senses.zh: 评审，审查，检查，检讨（以进行必要的修改）

examples.en: The government has embarked on a systematic review of transport policy.
examples.zh: 政府已经开始对交通运输政策进行全面审查。

examples.en: MPS have called for an independent review.
examples.zh: MPS 呼吁进行独立审查。

examples.en: The proposals are available for review online.
examples.zh: 这些提案可在网上查阅。

examples.en: The terms of the contract are under review.
examples.zh: 合同条文正在审议。

examples.en: His parole application is up for review next week.
examples.zh: 他的假释申请下周审查。

examples.en: a review board/panel
examples.zh: 评审委员会／小组

examples.en: a pay/salary review
examples.zh: 薪酬审定

senses.def: an examination of all the relevant information on a subject or on a series of events

examples.en: to conduct/undertake a review of customer complaints
examples.zh: 对客户投诉进行调查

examples.en: to publish a review of recent cancer research
examples.zh: 发表有关最近癌症研究的报告

examples.en: a comprehensive review of current scientific knowledge on the subject
examples.zh: 对该学科当前科学知识的全面回顾

examples.en: a thorough review of relevant materials
examples.zh: 彻底审查相关材料

examples.en: The literature review suggests a number of areas for further study.
examples.zh: 文献综述提出了一些有待进一步研究的领域。

senses.def: a ceremony that involves an official inspection
to write a report of a book, play, film, product, etc. in which you give your opinion of it
senses.zh: 评论，评介（书、戏剧、电影、产品等）

examples.en: Please rate and review your purchase on our website.
examples.zh: 请在我们的网站上为您的购买体验打分并发表评论。

examples.en: The play was reviewed in the national newspapers.
examples.zh: 全国性报纸都对这部戏剧作了评论。

examples.en: The book was favourably reviewed by most critics.
examples.zh: 这本书受到大多数评论家的好评。

senses.def: to look again at something you have studied, especially in order to prepare for an exam
senses.zh: （尤指为准备考试而）温习，复习

examples.en: We will be reviewing all the topics covered this semester.
examples.zh: 我们将复习本学期学过的所有内容。

examples.en: Jonas helped me review for the test.
examples.zh: 乔纳斯帮我复习备考。

senses.def: to check a piece of work to see if there are any mistakes

examples.en: Review your work before you turn it in.
examples.zh: 在上交作业之前先检查一下您的作业。

senses.def: to carefully examine or consider something again, especially so that you can decide if it is necessary to make changes

examples.en: The government will review the situation later in the year.
examples.zh: 政府将在今年晚些时候对形势重新加以研究。

examples.en: The company is reviewing its business travel policy.
examples.zh: 该公司正在重新审查其公务差旅政策。

examples.en: After reviewing the evidence, the judge dismissed the case.
examples.zh: 法官审查了证据后，驳回了此案。

examples.en: This case should be reviewed in the light of new evidence.
examples.zh: 鉴于新证据出现，这个案子应该再作考虑。

examples.en: to review a decision/proposal
examples.zh: 审查决定/提案

examples.en: Staff performance is reviewed annually.
examples.zh: 员工的业绩每年进行一次评估。

senses.def: to read or study information about something, especially in order to reach an opinion about it

examples.en: to review records/documents/data
examples.zh: 审阅记录／文件／数据

examples.en: Let's start by reviewing the evidence.
examples.zh: 让我们从审核证据开始。

examples.en: This paper reviews the literature on the subject.
examples.zh: 本文评述了有关该主题的文献。

examples.en: The next section briefly reviews previous studies.
examples.zh: 下一节简要回顾了以前的研究。

examples.en: Students can review the material at their own pace.
examples.zh: 学生可以按照自己的进度复习材料。

examples.en: You should review the document carefully before signing.
examples.zh: 您应该在签署之前仔细查看该文件。

senses.def: to think about past events, for example to try to understand why they happened

examples.en: to review your failures and triumphs
examples.zh: 回顾自己的失败和成功

examples.en: She had been reviewing the previous week on her way home.
examples.zh: 她在回家的路上对前一个星期进行了回顾。

senses.def: to make an official inspection

examples.en: The Commander-in-Chief reviewed the troops.
examples.zh: 总司令检阅了部队。

intro.en: These words all mean to think about, study or describe somebody/​something carefully, especially in order to understand them, form an opinion of them or make a decision about them.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含思量、审查、调查、研究之义。

items.def: to think about, study or describe an idea, subject or piece of work very carefully:
items.zh: 指审查、调查、考查、考察

examples.en: These ideas will be examined in more detail in Chapter 10.
examples.zh: 这些观点将在第 10 章做更为详细的探讨。

items.def: to examine the nature or structure of something, especially by separating it into its parts, in order to understand or explain it:
items.zh: 指分析

examples.en: The job involves gathering and analysing data.
examples.zh: 这项工作需要搜集和分析资料。

items.def: to examine something again, especially so that you can decide if it is necessary to make changes:
items.zh: 指复查、检讨，以做必要的修改

examples.en: The government will review the situation later in the year.
examples.zh: 政府将在今年晚些时候对形势重新加以研究。

items.def: to examine somebody/​something in order to understand them or it:
items.zh: 指研究、调查

examples.en: We will study the report carefully before making a decision.
examples.zh: 我们将认真研究这份报告，然后再作决定。

items.def: to write or talk about something in detail, showing the different ideas and opinions about it:
items.zh: 指详述、论述

examples.en: This topic will be discussed at greater length in the next chapter.
examples.zh: 这个主题将在下一章里详细论述。

senses.def: a person who writes reviews of books, films or plays

examples.en: a book reviewer for ‘The Guardian’
examples.zh: 《卫报》的书评撰稿人

examples.en: The movie was enthusiastically received by the reviewers.
examples.zh: 这部电影受到评论家的热捧。

senses.def: a person who examines or considers something carefully, for example to see if any changes need to be made
to criticize somebody/something in a way that shows how much you dislike them
to change your opinions or plans, for example because of something you have learned

examples.en: I can see I will have to revise my opinions of his abilities now.
examples.zh: 我明白我现在不得不改变对他的能力的看法了。

examples.en: The government may need to revise its policy in the light of this report.
examples.zh: 政府可能需要根据这份报告改变其政策。

examples.en: I realised that I would have to revise my life plan.
examples.zh: 我意识到我必须修改我的人生计划。

senses.def: to change something, such as a book or an estimate, in order to correct or improve it

examples.en: a revised edition of a textbook
examples.zh: 课本的修订版

examples.en: I'll prepare a revised estimate for you.
examples.zh: 我将为你准备一份经过修正的评估报告。

examples.en: This revised version of his play has only two acts.
examples.zh: 他的剧本的修改版只有两幕。

examples.en: They should create a revised marketing plan.
examples.zh: 他们应该制定修订后的营销计划。

examples.en: We may have to revise this figure upwards.
examples.zh: 我们也许要将这个数字往上调一调。

examples.en: The growth forecast has been revised down.
examples.zh: 增长预测已下调。

examples.en: Of the original 200, that was revised to 100, only about 50 people showed up.
examples.zh: 原来的200人，修改为100人，只有大约50人到场。

senses.def: to prepare for an exam by looking again at work that you have done

examples.en: I can't come out tonight. I have to revise.
examples.zh: 我今晚不能出去。我得复习。

examples.en: I spent the weekend revising for my exam.
examples.zh: 我花了整个周末复习备考。

examples.en: I'm revising Geography today.
examples.zh: 我今天复习地理。

senses.def: a change or set of changes to something

examples.en: He made some minor revisions to the report before printing it out.
examples.zh: 把报告打印出来之前，他做了一些小的修改。

senses.def: the act of changing something, or of examining something with the intention of changing it

examples.en: The system is in need of revision.
examples.zh: 这一系统需要修正。

examples.en: a revision of trading standards
examples.zh: 贸易标准的修改

examples.en: Their educational policies are due for revision.
examples.zh: 他们的教育政策需要修改。

senses.def: the process of learning work for an exam

examples.en: Have you started your revision yet?
examples.zh: 你开始复习了吗？

examples.en: a revision class/course/timetable
examples.zh: 复习班/课程/时间表

senses.def: ideas that are different from, and want to change, the main ideas or practices of a political system, especially Marxism
wanting to change a political system, especially Marxism

examples.en: revisionist historians
examples.zh: 修正主义历史学家

senses.def: a person who wants to change a political system, especially Marxism

examples.en: bourgeois revisionists
examples.zh: 资产阶级修正主义者

senses.def: to visit a place again, especially after a long period of time
to return to an idea or a subject and discuss it again

examples.en: It's an idea that may be worth revisiting at a later date.
examples.zh: 这个观点也许值得以后进一步探讨。

senses.def: the process of making something stronger, more active or more healthy
senses.zh: 使更强壮；使恢复生机（或健康）

examples.en: the revitalization of the steel industry
examples.zh: 钢铁工业的振兴

senses.def: to make something stronger, more active or more healthy
senses.zh: 使更强壮；使恢复生机（或健康）

examples.en: measures to revitalize the inner cities
examples.zh: 让内城区重焕活力的措施

examples.en: The local economy has been revitalized.
examples.zh: 地方经济已恢复活力。

examples.en: Gentle massage will revitalize your skin.
examples.zh: 轻柔的按摩将使您的皮肤恢复活力。

senses.def: an improvement in the condition or strength of something
senses.zh: （状况或力量的）进步，振兴，复苏

examples.en: the revival of trade
examples.zh: 贸易振兴

examples.en: an economic revival
examples.zh: 经济复苏

examples.en: a revival of property values
examples.zh: 房地产价值的复苏

senses.def: the process of something becoming or being made popular or fashionable again

examples.en: a religious revival
examples.zh: 宗教的奋兴

examples.en: Jazz is enjoying a revival.
examples.zh: 爵士乐再度盛行。

examples.en: a revival of interest in folk music
examples.zh: 对民间音乐的兴趣的恢复

senses.def: a new production of a play that has not been performed for some time

examples.en: a revival of Peter Shaffer’s ‘Equus’
examples.zh: 彼得·谢弗的《马》的重演

senses.def: the process of creating interest in something again, especially religion

examples.en: Christian revivalism
examples.zh: 基督教复兴运动

senses.def: the practice of using ideas, designs, etc. from the past

examples.en: revivalism in architecture
examples.zh: 建筑的复古

senses.def: a person who tries to make something popular again
senses.zh: 推动复兴者；复兴运动倡导者

senses.def: that tries to make something popular again
senses.zh: 推动复兴者；复兴运动倡导者

examples.en: revivalist movements
examples.zh: 复兴运动

examples.en: a revivalist preacher
examples.zh: 宗教奋兴布道者

senses.def: to become, or to make somebody/something become, conscious or healthy and strong again

examples.en: The flowers soon revived in water.
examples.zh: 这些花见了水很快就活过来了。

examples.en: The economy is beginning to revive.
examples.zh: 经济开始复苏。

examples.en: The paramedics couldn't revive her.
examples.zh: 护理人员无法使她苏醒。

examples.en: This movie is intended to revive her flagging career.
examples.zh: 这部电影意在使她渐趋衰败的事业再现辉煌。

examples.en: Attempts to revive him failed.
examples.zh: 把他救活的努力失败了。

senses.def: to make something start being used or done again

examples.en: This quaint custom should be revived.
examples.zh: 应该恢复这一独特的风俗。

examples.en: She has been trying to revive the debate over equal pay.
examples.zh: 她一直在设法再次展开关于同工同酬的辩论。

examples.en: The poor trade figures have revived fears of higher interest rates.
examples.zh: 不良的贸易数字再次引起人们对加息的担忧。

senses.def: to produce again a play, etc. that has not been performed for some time

examples.en: This 1930s musical is being revived at the National Theatre.
examples.zh: 这部 20 世纪 30 年代的音乐剧正在国家剧院重新上演。

senses.def: to give new life or health to something
senses.zh: 使获得新生；使复活；使再生；使恢复健康

senses.def: the act of cancelling a law, etc.

examples.en: the revocation of planning permission
examples.zh: 建筑许可的撤销

senses.def: to officially cancel something so that it is no longer legally acceptable

examples.en: Your licence may be revoked at any time.
examples.zh: 你的执照随时可能被吊销。

senses.def: a protest against authority, especially that of a government, often involving violence; the action of protesting against authority
senses.zh: （尤指针对政府的）反抗，违抗；起义；叛乱

examples.en: The Peasants Revolt of 1381 was the first popular uprising in England.
examples.zh: 1381年的（瓦特·泰勒）农民起义是英国第一次人民起义。

examples.en: to lead a revolt
examples.zh: 领导起义

examples.en: The army quickly crushed the revolt.
examples.zh: 军队很快镇压了叛乱。

examples.en: The revolt was suppressed with total ruthlessness.
examples.zh: 这次起义被极端残忍地镇压了。

examples.en: the biggest back-bench revolt this government has ever seen
examples.zh: 本届政府所遭遇到的规模最大的一次下院普通议员的抗议

examples.en: Attempts to negotiate peace ended in armed revolt.
examples.zh: 和谈的努力最后以武装叛乱告终。

examples.en: The people rose in revolt.
examples.zh: 人民奋起反抗。

senses.def: to take violent action against the people in power

examples.en: The peasants threatened to revolt.
examples.zh: 农民威胁说要造反。

examples.en: Finally the people revolted against the military dictatorship.
examples.zh: 人民最终起来反抗军事独裁。

examples.en: The peasants revolted against high taxes and the losses of the war.
examples.zh: 农民起来反抗高税收和战争损失。

senses.def: to behave in a way that is the opposite of what somebody expects of you, especially in protest

examples.en: Teenagers often revolt against parental discipline.
examples.zh: 青少年常常不遵从父母的条条框框。

senses.def: to make you feel horror

examples.en: All the violence in the movie revolted me.
examples.zh: 电影里的各种暴力场面令我非常震惊。

examples.en: The way he ate his food revolted me.
examples.zh: 他吃饭的样子让我感到恶心。

examples.en: She was revolted by the smell of stale beer and vomit in the room.
examples.zh: 她对房间里陈旧啤酒和呕吐物的气味感到厌恶。

senses.def: in an extremely unpleasant way
senses.zh: 令人作呕的；极其讨厌的

examples.en: revoltingly ugly
examples.zh: 丑陋不堪

senses.def: an attempt, by a large number of people, to change the government of a country, especially by violent action

examples.en: a socialist revolution
examples.zh: 社会主义革命

examples.en: the outbreak of the French Revolution in 1789
examples.zh: 1789 年法国大革命的爆发

examples.en: The shooting and killing of thirty people started a revolution.
examples.zh: 三十人的枪杀引发了一场革命。

examples.en: The country appears to be on the brink of revolution.
examples.zh: 这个国家似乎快要爆发革命。

senses.def: a great change in conditions, ways of working, beliefs, etc. that affects large numbers of people

examples.en: a cultural/social/scientific, etc. revolution
examples.zh: 文化、社会、科学等的重大变革

examples.en: the sexual revolution of the 1960s
examples.zh: 20 世纪 60 年代的性革命

examples.en: the digital/technological revolution
examples.zh: 数字/技术革命

examples.en: They led the electronics revolution but have been left behind by the IT revolution.
examples.zh: 他们引领了电子革命，但被 IT 革命抛在了后面。

examples.en: A revolution in information technology is taking place.
examples.zh: 信息技术正在发生巨变。

senses.def: a complete circular

examples.en: The disk rotates at up to 500 revolutions per minute.
examples.zh: 磁盘以高达每分钟 500 转的速度旋转。

examples.en: The revolution of the earth around the sun takes one year.
examples.zh: 地球环绕太阳公转一周需要一年时间。

senses.def: connected with political revolution

examples.en: a revolutionary leader
examples.zh: 革命领袖

examples.en: revolutionary uprisings
examples.zh: 革命起义

senses.def: involving a great or complete change
senses.zh: 革命性的；大变革的；巨变的

examples.en: a revolutionary idea
examples.zh: 革命性的想法

examples.en: a time of rapid and revolutionary change
examples.zh: 迅速剧烈变革的时期

examples.en: revolutionary advances in medicine
examples.zh: 医学的革命性进步

examples.en: The effects of technological development are revolutionary.
examples.zh: 技术发展的影响是革命性的。

examples.en: At the time this idea was revolutionary.
examples.zh: 这个想法在当时创意非凡。

senses.def: a person who starts or supports a revolution, especially a political one
senses.zh: （支持）改革者；（尤指）革命者，革命支持者

examples.en: socialist revolutionaries
examples.zh: 社会主义革命者

examples.en: Like the French revolutionaries, his main concern was to unify the country.
examples.zh: 和法国革命者一样，他主要关心的是国家的统一。

examples.en: The revolutionaries tried to encourage soldiers to mutiny or desert.
examples.zh: 革命者试图劝说士兵暴动或当逃兵。

senses.def: to completely change the way that something is done

examples.en: Aerial photography has revolutionized the study of archaeology.
examples.zh: 航空摄影已经给考古学研究带来了一场革命。

senses.def: to go in a circle around a central point

examples.en: The fan revolved slowly.
examples.zh: 电扇缓慢地转动着。

examples.en: The earth revolves on its axis.
examples.zh: 地球环绕自身的轴心转动。

senses.def: to move around something in a circle

examples.en: The earth revolves around the sun.
examples.zh: 地球绕太阳公转。

senses.def: to have somebody/something as the main interest or subject
senses.zh: 围绕；以…为中心；将…作为主要兴趣（或主题）

examples.en: His whole life revolves around surfing.
examples.zh: 他一生都在做与冲浪相关的事。

examples.en: She thinks that the world revolves around her.
examples.zh: 她以为整个世界都以她为中心。

examples.en: The discussion revolved around the question of changing the club's name.
examples.zh: 讨论的中心问题是改变俱乐部的名称。

examples.en: The world doesn't revolve around you, you know.
examples.zh: 你要知道，这个世界不是以你为中心的。

senses.def: to move around something in a circle

examples.en: The earth revolves around the sun.
examples.zh: 地球绕太阳公转。

senses.def: to have somebody/something as the main interest or subject
senses.zh: 围绕；以…为中心；将…作为主要兴趣（或主题）

examples.en: His whole life revolves around surfing.
examples.zh: 他一生都在做与冲浪相关的事。

examples.en: She thinks that the world revolves around her.
examples.zh: 她以为整个世界都以她为中心。

examples.en: The discussion revolved around the question of changing the club's name.
examples.zh: 讨论的中心问题是改变俱乐部的名称。

examples.en: The world doesn't revolve around you, you know.
examples.zh: 你要知道，这个世界不是以你为中心的。

senses.def: a small gun that has a container for bullets that turns around so that shots can be fired quickly without having to stop to put more bullets in

examples.en: The man stood over him, aiming the revolver at his head.
examples.zh: 那个男人站在他上方，用左轮手枪指着他的头。

senses.def: a type of door in an entrance to a large building that turns around in a circle as people go through it

examples.en: She saw him heading towards the revolving door.
examples.zh: 她看见他朝那旋转门走过去。

senses.def: used to talk about a place or an organization that people enter and then leave again very quickly
senses.zh: 中转站（指人们进入后很快又离开的地方或机构）

examples.en: The company became a revolving-door workplace.
examples.zh: 这家公司成了工作的中转站。

senses.def: a show in a theatre, with songs, dances, jokes, short plays, etc., often about recent events
a strong feeling of horror

examples.en: Most people viewed the bombings with revulsion.
examples.zh: 大多数人对爆炸事件表现出惊恐不安。

examples.en: She felt a deep sense of revulsion at the violence.
examples.zh: 她对这一暴行深恶痛绝。

examples.en: I started to feel a revulsion against their decadent lifestyle.
examples.zh: 我对他们那腐朽的生活方式开始感到厌恶。

senses.def: a thing that you are given because you have done something good, worked hard, etc.

examples.en: a financial reward
examples.zh: 经济奖励

examples.en: a reward for good behaviour
examples.zh: 优秀行为奖

examples.en: You deserve a reward for being so helpful.
examples.zh: 你帮了这么大的忙，理应受到奖励。

examples.en: Winning the match was just reward for the effort the team had made.
examples.zh: 赢下比赛是全队付出努力应得的回报。

examples.en: They're playing the game more for the love of sport than for financial reward.
examples.zh: 他们玩这项运动更多的是出于对运动的热爱，而不是为了经济回报。

examples.en: The company is now reaping the rewards of their investments.
examples.zh: 公司正在收获他们的投资回报。

examples.en: Top corporate jobs are not without their rewards.
examples.zh: 顶级企业的工作并非没有回报。

examples.en: The appointment was widely seen as a reward for his loyalty.
examples.zh: 人们普遍认为这一任命是对他忠诚的奖励。

senses.def: an amount of money that is offered to somebody for helping the police to find a criminal or for finding something that is lost

examples.en: A £100 reward has been offered for the return of the necklace.
examples.zh: 已悬赏 100 英镑找寻项链。

examples.en: Anyone wanting to claim the reward should contact the city police.
examples.zh: 任何想要领取奖金的人都应该联系市警察。

senses.def: the reward for acting in a moral or correct way is the knowledge that you have done so, and you should not expect more than this, for example praise from other people or payment
senses.zh: 施恩无他图，有德便是报；美德本身就是报偿

senses.def: to give something to somebody because they have done something good, worked hard, etc.

examples.en: She was rewarded for her efforts with a cash bonus.
examples.zh: 她因自己所作的努力而得到一笔奖金。

examples.en: He rewarded us handsomely (= with a lot of money) for helping him.
examples.zh: 对于我们的帮助，他大加酬谢。

examples.en: In some states of India, doctors are richly rewarded for serving in the rural areas.
examples.zh: 在印度的一些邦，医生因在农村地区服务而获得丰厚的回报。

examples.en: She started singing to the baby and was rewarded with a smile.
examples.zh: 她开始给孩子唱歌，孩子则报以微笑。

examples.en: Our patience was finally rewarded.
examples.zh: 我们的耐心最终得到了回报。

examples.en: After a steep climb you will be rewarded by magnificent views from the summit.
examples.zh: 经过陡峭的攀登后，您将欣赏到山顶的壮丽景色。

senses.def: the reward for acting in a moral or correct way is the knowledge that you have done so, and you should not expect more than this, for example praise from other people or payment
senses.zh: 施恩无他图，有德便是报；美德本身就是报偿

senses.def: to watch a film, television programme, etc. again
senses.zh: 再次观看电影、电视节目等

examples.en: Each week we rewatch an episode and talk about our favourite moments.
examples.zh: 每周我们都会重看一集并谈论我们最喜欢的时刻。

senses.def: an act of watching a film, television programme, etc. again
senses.zh: 再次观看电影、电视节目等的行为

examples.en: It's a great movie — definitely worth a rewatch.
examples.zh: 这是一部很棒的电影——绝对值得再看一遍。

examples.en: I found the show even more rewarding on rewatch.
examples.zh: 我发现重看这部剧更有价值。

senses.def: the practice of helping large areas of land to return to their natural state
senses.zh: （大片土地的）野化，恢复原始样貌

examples.en: There is a proposal for the rewilding of the islands.
examples.zh: 有人建议恢复这些岛屿的自然样貌。

examples.en: Rewilding represents a desire to return to the state in which humans existed before the advent of civilization.
examples.zh: 回归原始代表着渴望回到人类在文明出现之前的存在状态。

senses.def: to make something such as a film or a recording go back to the beginning or to an earlier point
senses.zh: 使（影片、录音、视频等）倒回；倒带

senses.def: a button that you press to go back to an earlier part of a film, piece of music, etc.
senses.zh: 按下该按钮可返回到电影、音乐等的较早部分。

examples.en: Hit the rewind button and listen to the song again.
examples.zh: 按倒带键，再听一遍这首歌。

examples.en: There is no rewind button to visit the past.
examples.zh: 没有倒带按钮可以回顾过去。

senses.def: to put new electrical wires into a building or piece of equipment
senses.zh: 给（建筑物或设备）换新电线

examples.en: The house has been rewired.
examples.zh: 房子已经重新布线。

senses.def: to write or say something again using different words in order to make it clearer or more acceptable
to make changes to something in order to improve it or make it more suitable

examples.en: We’re constantly reworking our old songs.
examples.zh: 我们在不断修改我们的老歌。

examples.en: She kept reworking this area of the painting.
examples.zh: 她不断地修改这幅画的这个区域。

senses.def: able to be used again for different data

examples.en: a rewritable CD
examples.zh: 可重写光盘

senses.def: to write something again in a different way, usually in order to improve it or because there is some new information

examples.en: I intend to rewrite the story for younger children.
examples.zh: 我想为年纪更小的孩子改写这篇故事。

examples.en: This essay will have to be completely rewritten.
examples.zh: 这篇文章得全部重写。

examples.en: an attempt to rewrite history (= to present historical events in a way that shows or proves what you want them to)
examples.zh: 改写历史的企图

senses.def: an act of writing something again in a different way, usually in order to improve it or because there is some new information; something that has been written again in this way

examples.en: The film underwent many drafts and rewrites.
examples.zh: 这部电影经历了多次草稿和重写。

examples.en: He wants to see a major rewrite of the script.
examples.zh: 他希望看到剧本的重大重写。

senses.def: a word meaning ‘king’, used, for example, in the titles of legal cases brought by the state when there is a king in the UK
senses.zh: 国王（英国国王在位时用于政府诉讼案案目等）

examples.en: Rex v Jones
examples.zh: 国王诉琼斯案

senses.zh: 雷克斯·斯托特（Rex Stout）：（1896-1975）美国作家，撰写了70多个流行的神秘故事。其中大多数是关于胖侦探尼禄·沃尔夫（Nero Wolfe）及其助手阿奇·戈德温（Archie Godwin）的。其中包括《仙境中的恶意》（1940），皇家同花顺（1965）和三王牌（1971）。

senses.def: Royal Flying Corps
Robert F Kennedy
registered general nurse
expressing great enthusiasm or happiness
senses.zh: （言语或文字的）狂热表达，充满欣喜的表达

senses.def: to talk or write with great enthusiasm about something
a piece of music that is full of feeling and is not regular in form

examples.en: Liszt’s Hungarian Rhapsodies
examples.zh: 李斯特的《匈牙利狂想曲》

to get a lot of money, especially suddenly or unexpectedly

intro.zh: 以上各词均用以形容人富有或地方富饶。

items.def: (of a person) having a lot of money, property or valuable possessions; (of a country or city) producing a lot of wealth so that many of its people can live at a high standard
items.zh: 指（人）富有的、富裕的，（国家或城市）富庶的、富饶的

items.zh: 指繁荣的、成功的、兴旺的

examples.zh: 他家境不太宽裕。

items.zh: 指富裕、宽裕

examples.zh: 他们不是百万富翁，但也很富裕。

senses.def: a popular British make of round, thin, sweet biscuits with a light brown colour. They are made by McVitie's
senses.zh: 颇受欢迎的英国制造的圆形，薄而甜的饼干，呈浅棕色。它们是由McVitie生产的。

senses.def: a first name for boys
(1732-92) an English businessman who invented a machine using water power for spinning
senses.zh: 理查德·阿克赖特（Richard Arkwright）：（1732-92）一位英国商人，他发明了一种利用水力来纺棉的机器，直到那时，这种机器都是手工纺制的。他建立了自己的工厂，并成为工业革命的早期领导人之一。1786年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1923-2014) an English film actor, producer and director. He acted in many famous British films, including Brighton Rock
senses.zh: 理查德·阿滕伯勒（Richard Attenborough）：（1923-2014）英国电影演员，制片人和导演。他曾参演过许多英国著名电影，包括布莱顿·洛克（1947）。他最成功的导演和制片人是甘地（1982），曾获得八项奥斯卡奖。他在1976年被任命为骑士，在1993年被任命为终身陪伴。DavidAttenborough是他的兄弟。

senses.def: (1751-1816) a British writer of plays, born in Ireland. He wrote a series of popular comedies, including The Rivals
senses.zh: 理查德·布林斯利·谢里丹（Richard Brinsley Sheridan）：（1751-1816）英国戏剧作家，出生于爱尔兰。他撰写了一系列受欢迎的喜剧片，包括《竞争对手》和《丑闻学校》，并以其敏捷而聪明的幽默在伦敦闻名。他成为威尔士亲王和几位重要政治人物的朋友。1780年，他成为辉格党议员，并担任过多个重要的政府职务。尽管他在政治和戏剧领域拥有成功的职业生涯，但他背负着许多债务，并死于贫困。

senses.def: (1821-90) an English writer and explorer
senses.zh: 理查德·伯顿（Richard Burton）：（1821-90）英国作家和探险家。他前往印度，阿拉伯和一些非洲国家，学习了许多语言，以便可以与当地人交谈并撰写他们的文化和传统。他还以《阿拉伯之夜》的翻译而闻名。1886年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1925-84) a Welsh actor. He first became famous for his performances of Shakespearian roles in the theatre, and in the 1960s and 1970s he acted in many major British and US films. He was also well known for his relationship with Elizabeth Taylor. They were married and divorced twice, and acted in several successful films together, including Cleopatra
senses.zh: 理查德·伯顿（Richard Burton）：（1925-84）威尔士演员。他首先以表演莎士比亚戏剧而闻名，并于1960年代和1970年代在许多英国和美国的主要电影中饰演。他还因与伊丽莎白·泰勒（Elizabeth Taylor）的关系而闻名。他们两次结婚和离婚，并一起出演了几部成功的电影，包括克娄巴特拉和《谁怕弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫》？

senses.def: (1804-65) an English politician who, with John Bright, led the argument in the House of Commons
senses.zh: 理查德·科布登（Richard Cobden）：（1804-65）英国政治家，他与约翰·布赖特（John Bright）一起在下议院领导反对玉米法的主张，主张自由贸易。他还竞选州立教育和反对克里米亚战争。

senses.def: (1844-1901) the man who brought W S Gilbert
senses.zh: 理查德·奥伊卡特（Richard D'Oyly Carte）：（1844-1901）这位将WS吉尔伯特（Gilbert）和亚瑟·沙利文爵士（Sir Arthur Sullivan）一起创作非常成功的系列歌剧的人称为萨沃伊歌剧（Savoy Opera），因为它们是在1881年之后在德凯利（D'Oyly Carte）的新萨沃伊剧院（Savoy Theatre）演出的。伦敦。D'Oyly Carte还建造了Savoy酒店。

senses.def: (1912-2005) an English scientist whose research first found a definite link between smoking and lung cancer. He worked for the Medical Research Council
senses.zh: 理查德·多尔（Richard Doll）：（1912-2005）一位英国科学家进行的研究首先发现了吸烟与肺癌之间的明确联系。他曾在医学研究委员会工作，曾是牛津大学的教授。1971年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: Richard Evelyn Byrd (1888-1957) a US explorer
senses.zh: 理查德·E·伯德：理查德·伊夫林·伯德（1888-1957），美国探险家和海军飞行员。1926年，他和弗洛伊德·贝内特（Floyd Bennett）首次越过北极。伯德（Berrd）还在1929年飞越南极，并多次前往南极洲。

senses.def: (1918-88) a US physicist
senses.zh: 理查德·费曼（Richard Feynman）：（1918-88）美国物理学家，他对量子电动力学进行了首次研究。他在该领域的工作获得了1965年诺贝尔物理学奖。他的“费曼图”有助于解释物质和光的行为。第二次世界大战期间，费曼参与了曼哈顿计划。1986年，他成为调查挑战者号飞船爆炸事件的委员会成员。

senses.def: (1922-2011) an English artist who was one of the first people to introduce pop art
senses.zh: 理查德·汉密尔顿（Richard Hamilton）：（1922-2011）是一位英国画家，是最早将流行艺术引入英国的人之一。他的画作经常涉及现代社会中的社会和政治问题。

senses.def: (1157-99) the king of England from 1189 to 1199, following his father King Henry II
senses.zh: 理查一世（1157–1199）英格兰国王（1189–1199 在位）。其父亨利二世死后继位。因作战英勇而常被称为“狮心理查”。统治前期参加第三次十字军东征，最后于 1191 年与萨拉丁议和。归途中，理查被奥地利皇帝亨利六世俘虏，缴付巨额赎金后才获释。统治后期与法国人作战，1199 年战死，王位由弟弟约翰承继。

senses.def: (1367-1400) the king of England from 1377 to 1399, following his grandfather King Edward III
senses.zh: 理查二世（1367–1400）英格兰国王（1377–1399 在位），继承祖父爱德华三世王位。十岁登基，由叔父冈特的约翰摄政。成功镇压 1381 年农民起义。其后力图控制国内权贵，尤其是冈特的约翰之子亨利·博林布鲁克。1398 年将亨利流放国外，但次年亨利回国，夺取王位，称亨利四世。理查二世被囚，后死在狱中，可能是被谋杀。

senses.def: a play (1595) by William Shakespeare
senses.zh: 《理查二世》威廉·莎士比亚剧作（1595），讲述理查二世最后几年的故事。剧中理查被描述为一个无法控制权贵的羸弱之人。

senses.def: (1452-85) the king of England from 1483 to 1485, following his nephew
senses.zh: 理查三世（1452–1485）英格兰国王（1483–1485 在位）。在其侄爱德华五世之后继位。通常被认为是一个残酷暴虐的国王，很可能下令谋杀了囚禁在伦敦塔中的王子，但并非所有历史学家都接受这个观点。理查在博斯沃思原野战役中被亨利·都铎（即后来的亨利七世）杀死。

senses.def: an early play (c. 1592) by William Shakespeare
senses.zh: 《理查三世》威廉·莎士比亚的早期剧作（约 1592）。英格兰国王理查三世被描写成一个残忍暴虐之徒，为攫取王位而谋杀多人，最后在博斯沃思原野战役中被杀。理查被迫徒步作战，喊出著名的台词：“一匹马！一匹马！拿我的国土换一匹马！”该剧开场，他有一段著名独白，起始两行是：“现在这约克的太阳把我们的隐忍难堪的严冬变成了光荣体面的夏日了。”（梁实秋译）

senses.def: Richard Joseph Daley (1902-76) the mayor
senses.zh: 理查德·戴利（Richard J Daley）：理查德·约瑟夫·戴利（Richard Joseph Daley，1902-76年），1955年至1976年担任芝加哥市市长，以其强大的方法而闻名。1968年，他下令芝加哥警察袭击一群示威者，这使正在开会选择总统候选人的民主党感到尴尬。

senses.def: (1618-58) an English poet. He was one of the 'Cavalier
senses.zh: 理查德·洛夫莱斯（Richard Lovelace）：（1618-58）英国诗人。他是英国内战期间支持查理一世国王的“骑士诗人”之一。在战争期间，他被关进监狱，并在那里写了一些最出色的作品，包括监狱中的《致全天候》诗，其中包含著名的台词：

senses.def: (1913-94) the 37th US President (1969-74) and the only one to resign
senses.zh: 理查德·尼克松（Richard Nixon）：（1913-94）第37任美国总统（1969-74），也是唯一一位辞职。他于1946年当选为美国众议院议员，当时是众议院美国非裔美国人活动委员会成员，1950年当选为美国参议院议员。他曾是艾森豪威尔总统（1953-61）的副总统，但被击败约翰·肯尼迪（John F Kennedy）在1960年当选总统。作为总统，尼克松成功结束了越南战争，并在美中之间建立了更紧密的关系，但由于水门事件丑闻，尼克松不得不辞职才被人们广泛铭记。他被昵称为“特里克·迪克”，是因为他在与人打交道时常常不直接也不诚实。

senses.def: (1902-79) an American composer
senses.zh: 理查德·罗杰斯（Richard Rodgers）：（1902-79）美国作曲家，曾为许多百老汇音乐剧创作音乐。他和写这句话的洛伦兹·哈特（Lorenz Hart）制作了29部这样的节目，包括《武器中的宝贝》（Babes in Arms，1937年）和《帕尔·乔伊》（Pal Joey，1940年）。然后，他与奥斯卡·哈默斯坦（Oscar Hammerstein）一起创作了更多作品，包括《俄克拉荷马州！》，《旋转木马》（Carousel，1945年），《南太平洋》，《国王与我》（1951年）和《音乐之声》。这些节目很多都变成了电影。罗杰斯还为电视连续剧《海上胜利》创作音乐。

senses.def: (1936-2012) an English composer
senses.zh: 理查德·罗德尼·贝内特（Richard Rodney Bennett）：（1936-2012）英国作曲家，以他的歌剧《硫的矿山》（1965）和《胜利》（1970）以及数部电影的音乐而闻名。他在1998年被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1672-1729) an Irish writer of plays and essays. He moved to London as a young man, and wrote several comedy plays. They contained more social and moral comments than the popular Restoration comedies
senses.zh: 理查德·斯蒂尔（Richard Steele）（1672-1729）：爱尔兰戏剧和散文作家。他年轻时移居伦敦，并写了几部喜剧剧。与流行的《复原》喜剧相比，它们包含了更多的社会和道德评论，而且并不十分成功。创办两本杂志《 The Tatler》和《 The Spectator》时，他是最受人铭记的，为此他撰写了有关文学和道德问题的论文。

senses.def: (1771-1833) an English engineer who was the first man to develop steam
senses.zh: 理查德·特雷维西克（Richard Trevithick）：（1771-1833）是一位英语工程师，他是第一个将蒸汽机开发成运载乘客的车辆的人。其中的第一台用于道路，但在1804年，他制造了第一台在轨道上移动的蒸汽机。

senses.def: (1908-60) a US writer whose best-known books are the novel Native Son
senses.zh: 理查德·赖特（Richard Wright）（1908-60）是美国作家，其最著名的书籍是小说《原住民》和他自己的生平故事《黑男孩》（Black Boy，1945年）。他还写了一些故事集，《汤姆叔叔的孩子们》（1938年）。赖特曾担任共产党员多年。第二次世界大战后，他住在巴黎，死于巴黎。

senses.zh: （色彩）鲜艳富丽地；（口味）醇美地；（气味）浓郁芬芳地

senses.zh: （1890-1969）一位英国作家，写威廉书和成人小说

senses.def: a large public park in Richmond
senses.zh: 里士满大公园（Richmond Great Park）：伦敦西南部里士满的大型公园，于1637年为查尔斯一世国王创建，是狩猎鹿的地方。它是最大的皇家公园，仍然包含大量鹿。

examples.zh: 海洋生物的丰富多样

examples.en: This new colour will add warmth and richness to your natural hair shade.

examples.en: He was a nuisance and we're all well rid of him (= we'll be much better without him).

examples.zh: 问题是如何处理核废料。

examples.en: I can't get rid of this headache.
examples.zh: 我这头疼老是不好。

examples.en: We got rid of all the old furniture.
examples.zh: 我们扔掉了所有的旧家具。

senses.def: to want to be free of somebody/something that has been annoying you or that you do not want

examples.en: Are you trying to say you want rid of me?
examples.zh: 你是在说要甩掉我吗？

senses.def: to remove something that is causing a problem from a place, group, etc.

examples.en: Further measures will be taken to rid our streets of crime.
examples.zh: 将采取进一步的措施来防止街头犯罪。

examples.en: The prime minister's aim was to rid the country of socialism forever.
examples.zh: 总理的目标是让这个国家永远摆脱社会主义。

senses.def: to make yourself free from somebody/something that is annoying you or causing you a problem

examples.en: to rid yourself of guilt
examples.zh: 摆脱内疚

examples.en: He wanted to rid himself of the burden of the secret.
examples.zh: 他想把秘密说出来，让自己得到解脱。

senses.def: an unkind way of saying that you are pleased that somebody/something has gone

examples.zh: 他离去时，她气愤地冲着他说：“再见吧，早走早好！”

examples.zh: 别拐弯抹角了，有话直说。

examples.zh: 比尔博破解了打开通往大山之门的暗语。

senses.zh: 神秘事件；无法解释的情况

examples.en: the riddle of how the baby died
examples.zh: 婴儿死亡之谜

examples.en: The riddle of his identity was only solved when his brother saw him on TV.
examples.zh: 当他的哥哥在电视上看到他时，他的身份之谜才被解开。

senses.def: to make a lot of holes in somebody/something

examples.zh: 这辆车被子弹打得千疮百孔。

examples.zh: 布满弹坑的汽车

senses.def: to be full of something, especially something bad or unpleasant

examples.zh: 恶性肿瘤遍布他的全身。

examples.en: Her typing was slow and riddled with mistakes.
examples.zh: 她打字很慢而且错误百出。

examples.en: The woods are riddled with rabbit holes.
examples.zh: 树林里布满了兔子洞。

examples.zh: 他们骑马走在狭窄的乡村小路上。

examples.zh: 他骑在一匹高大的黑马上。

examples.zh: 他骑马走了五十英里。

examples.en: to ride a horse

examples.zh: 她以前从没骑过马。

examples.zh: 他今年到目前为止已六次在赛马中夺标。

senses.def: to spend time riding a horse for pleasure

examples.en: How often do you go riding?
examples.zh: 你多长时间骑一次马？

examples.zh: 男孩子们骑着自行车在街上兜风。

examples.zh: 他骑着一辆哈雷摩托车。

examples.zh: 这就像骑自行车：有一天你不能，第二天你就可以了。

examples.zh: 那里地面高低不平，无法骑车。

examples.zh: 别人都乘车，而我是走回来的。

examples.zh: 她每天乘公共汽车去上学。

examples.zh: 一只大鸟在它下面乘着气流。

examples.zh: 我们骑着马走在山里的小路上。
