a long loose outer piece of clothing, especially one worn as a sign of rank or office at a special ceremony
senses.zh: 袍服，礼袍（常于典礼中穿着以显示身份）

examples.en: coronation robes
examples.zh: 加冕礼袍

examples.en: cardinals in scarlet robes
examples.zh: 身披红袍的枢机主教

examples.en: a ghostly figure in flowing robes of white
examples.zh: 白袍飘飘的魅影

examples.en: an old man swathed in robes
examples.zh: 裹着长袍的老人

senses.def: a loose piece of clothing worn before and after taking a bath
a long loose piece of clothing, usually with a belt, worn indoors over night clothes, for example when you first get out of bed
senses.zh: 晨衣，晨袍（起床后套于睡衣外在室内穿的宽松长罩衫，通常有束带）

senses.def: to dress somebody/yourself in long loose clothes or in the way mentioned

examples.en: a robed choir
examples.zh: 身着礼袍的唱诗班

examples.en: The priests were robed in black.
examples.zh: 各司祭都穿上了黑袍。

senses.def: a first name for boys
(1728-92) a Scottish architect who, with his brother James (1730-94), started a new neoclassical
senses.zh: 罗伯特·亚当（Robert Adam）：（1728-92）是苏格兰建筑师，他与兄弟詹姆斯（1730-94）在英国建筑和家具设计中开始了新的新古典主义风格（受古希腊和罗马风格的影响）。他们设计了许多著名的房屋，包括建伍大厦和爱丁堡大学的主楼。

senses.def: (1920-2006) a US film director. His films usually gave a sad or funny picture of US life. They include M*A*S*H
senses.zh: 罗伯特·奥特曼：（1920-2006）美国电影导演。他的电影通常描绘出美国生活的悲哀或有趣的画面。其中包括M * A * S * H（1970），Nashville（1975），Short Cuts（1995）（根据Raymond Carver的故事改编）和Gosford Park（2001），该书位于英国的乡间别墅内。

senses.def: (1924-95) an English writer of plays and films. He first became famous with his play about Thomas More
senses.zh: 罗伯特·博尔特（1924-95）：英国戏剧和电影作家。他首先以关于托马斯·莫尔（Thomas More）的戏剧而闻名，他是《四季的男人》（1960）。他还为电影《阿拉伯的劳伦斯》（Lawrence of Arabia）（1962）编写了剧本。他的两个电影剧本获得了奥斯卡金像奖：日瓦戈博士（1965年）和《一个四季的男人》（1967年）。

senses.def: (1627-91) a British scientist whose experiments and the way he wrote about them were ahead of his time. Before chemical elements were discovered, he suggested a theory of atoms
senses.zh: 罗伯特·博伊尔（Robert Boyle）：（1627-91）是一位英国科学家，他的实验和他对实验的写作方式超出了他的时代。在发现化学元素之前，他提出了一种原子理论，称事物是由“微粒”构成的。博伊耳定律最能记住他，该定律解释了压力与气体体积之间的关系。

senses.def: (1844-1930) an English poet, best known for his short poems. He was more popular during his life than he is now and was made Poet Laureate
senses.zh: 罗伯特·布里奇斯（1844-1930）是一位英国诗人，以他的短诗而闻名。他一生中比现在更受人欢迎，并于1913年被任命为诗人桂冠。

senses.def: (1812-89) an English poet. His early work was written to be performed in the theatre, and most of his poetry is easy to read, but full of meaning. In 1846 he secretly married Elizabeth Barrett and they went to live in Italy. They were friends of many other important British writers, including Carlyle
senses.zh: 罗伯特·布朗宁（1812–1889）英国诗人。早期作品为舞台剧而作，诗作多通俗易懂却意蕴丰富。1846 年，与伊丽莎白·芭蕾特秘密结婚后同往意大利。夫妇俩是卡莱尔、丁尼生等众多英国重要作家的朋友。其最负盛名的作品是《哈默林的花衣吹笛人》（1842）和《海外乡愁》（1845）。

senses.def: (1759-96) a Scottish poet, often referred to as Robbie (or Rabbie) Burns. He wrote many poems and songs in English, and in the dialect
senses.zh: 罗伯特·彭斯（1759–1796）苏格兰诗人，常被称为罗比（或拉比）·彭斯。用英语和苏格兰低地方言创作了大量诗歌和歌曲，描绘爱情、乡村和劳动人民生活，表达对苏格兰的热爱。被公认为苏格兰民族诗人，《汤姆·奥桑特》、《友谊天长地久》等诗歌和歌曲作品广为人知。

senses.def: (1577-1640) an English academic at Oxford University
senses.zh: 罗伯特·伯顿（Robert Burton）：（1577-1640）是牛津大学的一名英语学者，以撰写《忧郁的解剖学》（1621年）而著称，该书研究了抑郁症，抑郁症的历史和影响

senses.def: (1563-1612) a British politician who became Queen Elizabeth I's
senses.zh: 罗伯特·塞西尔（Robert Cecil）：（1563-1612）英国政治人物，在其父亲伯格利勋爵去世后成为伊丽莎白女王一世最重要的部长。他在1591年被任命为骑士，在1596年被任命为国务卿。詹姆斯一世出任国王后，他仍然是一位重要的政治人物。

senses.def: (1725-74) an English soldier and administrator
senses.zh: 罗伯特·克莱夫（Robert Clive）：（1725-74）英国士兵兼行政人员。他也被称为“印度的活”，因为他在使印度成为大英帝国的一部分方面发挥了重要作用。在东印度公司（East India Company）工作期间，他与法国人作战，并中断了他们在印度的权力。然后在普拉西（P757sey）战役（1757年）中，克莱夫（Clive）击败了印度孟加拉邦的统治者，并用允许英国人通过他统治孟加拉的统治者代替了他。这是后来遍布印度大部分地区的系统的开始。

senses.def: Robert Edward Lee (1807-70) the leader of the armies of the Confederate States
senses.zh: 罗伯特·李（Robert E Lee）：罗伯特·爱德华·李（Robert Edward Lee，1807-70年），美国南北战争时期，同盟国的领导人。他因他的荣誉和友善而受到尊重。李将军在与较大的联合军的战斗中赢得了许多战役，其中包括第二轮公牛奔跑和Chancellorsville战役。然而，他在葛底斯堡（Gettysburg）败北，不久之后在阿波玛托克斯法院（Appomattox Court House）投降给格兰特将军。南北战争之前，李带领美军在哈珀斯渡轮（Harpers Ferry）逮捕了约翰·布朗（John Brown）。林肯总统要求他领导美国军队，但李忠实忠于他的弗吉尼亚州并加入了南方。战争结束后，他成为华盛顿学院院长，后更名为华盛顿和李学院。

senses.def: Robert Edwin Peary (1856-1920) a US Navy officer and explorer
senses.zh: 罗伯特·E·佩里（Robert E Peary）：罗伯特·埃德温·佩里（Robert Edwin Peary，1856-1920年），美国海军军官兼探险家。经过两次较早的尝试失败后，他于1909年4月6日成为第一个到达北极的人。

senses.def: (Robert Francis Kennedy 1925-68) a US Attorney General (1961-4) appointed
senses.zh: 罗伯特·肯尼迪（Robert F. Kennedy，1925-68年）：美国司法部长（1961-4），由他的哥哥约翰·肯尼迪总统任命。他也被非正式地称为Bobby Kennedy或RFK。他坚决支持民权运动和为穷人创造更好的条件。在他的兄弟被谋杀之后，肯尼迪在林登·B·约翰逊总统的领导下继续担任总检察长，直到1964年当选美国参议院议员为止。他想在1968年成为民主党总统候选人，但在赢得加利福尼亚初选的那天就被Sirhan Sirhan谋杀。

senses.def: (1874-1963) a US poet who won four Pulitzer Prizes
senses.zh: 罗伯特·弗罗斯特（Robert Frost）：（1874-1963）是一位美国诗人，曾获得四次普利策奖。他以关于乡村的诗而闻名。从1912年到1915年，弗罗斯特住在英国，在那里他写了《男孩的遗嘱》（A Boy's Will，1913年）。然后，他在美国新罕布什尔州定居，并撰写了有关新英格兰的文章。他的诗集有《见证树》（1942年）和《在清除中》（1962年）。他最著名的诗是《修墙》和《雪夜里的伍兹驻足》。弗罗斯特（Frost）享年87岁，在1962年约翰·肯尼迪（John F Kennedy）的就职典礼上宣读了他的诗《礼物彻底》（A Gift Outright）。

senses.def: (1895-1985) an English writer. He wrote many books of poetry, books about literature, and novels. He is now best known for his historical novels set in ancient Rome, I, Claudius
senses.zh: 罗伯特·格雷夫斯（Robert Graves）：（1895-1985）英国作家。他写了许多诗歌，文学书籍和小说。现在，他以在古罗马一世创作的历史小说而著称，克劳迪乌斯（1934）和上帝的克劳迪乌斯（1934），这些小说在1976年被英国广播公司电视连续剧《长周末》（1940）改编，这是一部社会历史小说。 1918年至1939年的英国，以及他关于第一次世界大战经历的自传《再见了一切》（1929年）。在第一次世界大战中战斗后，格雷夫斯离开英国，并在马略卡岛度过了他的大部分生活。

senses.def: (1591-1674) an English poet and priest. He wrote many short, cheerful poems, including Gather Ye Rosebuds While Ye May
senses.zh: 罗伯特·赫里克（Robert Herrick）：（1591-1674）英国诗人和牧师。他写了许多简短而欢快的诗，包括《叶Ye的玫瑰花蕾》和《樱桃成熟》。

senses.def: (1938-2012) an Australian art critic , writer and broadcaster
senses.zh: 罗伯特·休斯（Robert Hughes）：（1938-2012）澳大利亚艺术评论家（表示对艺术品的意见的人），作家和广播员。他为《时代》撰稿，并撰写了许多有关艺术的书籍，包括《美国视野：美国史诗般的艺术史》（1997年），这是基于他的电视连续剧。他因其电视节目《现代艺术的冲击》（1981年）和《新事物的冲击》（2004年）而在英国和美国闻名。他还为澳大利亚共和党运动发言。

senses.def: (1850-94) a Scottish writer of novels. He is best known for his famous children's adventure stories Treasure Island
senses.zh: 罗伯特·路易斯·史蒂文森（1850-94）：苏格兰小说作家。他以其著名的儿童冒险故事《金银岛和绑架》而闻名，但他也为儿童和著名的成人心理小说《杰基尔博士和海德先生的怪案》（1886）作诗。由于身体欠佳，史蒂文森在生命的最后几年去了太平洋的萨摩亚岛。

senses.def: (1917-77) a US poet who won Pulitzer Prizes
senses.zh: 罗伯特·洛威尔：（1917-77），美国诗人因两本诗集《韦里勋爵城堡》（1946年）和《海豚》（1973年）而获得普利策奖。他的其他收藏包括生命研究（1959年）、《为联邦死亡》（1964年）和"一天一天"（1977年）。洛威尔用"忏悔诗"来写他的问题和他不幸的婚姻。他还写剧本并翻译了欧洲诗人的作品。

senses.def: (1927-2001) a US author who wrote more than 20 novels which have been translated into 32 languages in 40 countries. The stories are about spies
senses.zh: 罗伯特·鲁德鲁姆（Robert Ludlum）：（1927-2001）美国作家，他写了20多部小说，这些小说被翻译成40个国家的32种语言。这些故事是关于间谍和国际犯罪的。他的一些小说被拍成电影，包括《伯恩身份》（1980），《伯恩至上主义》（1986）和《伯恩最后通（》（1990）。他的其他小说包括《马特洛克论文》（1973年），《伊卡洛斯议程》（1988年）和《马塔雷兹倒数》（1997年）。

senses.def: Robert Maynard Pirsig (1928-2017) a US writer best known for his philosophical
senses.zh: 罗伯特·皮尔西格（Robert M Pirsig）：罗伯特·梅纳德·皮尔西格（Robert Maynard Pirsig，1928-2017年），美国作家，他的哲学小说《禅宗》和《摩托车维修艺术》（1974）

senses.def: (1946-89) a US artist and photographer. Many people are offended by the sexual nature of his images, which often show the naked
senses.zh: 罗伯特·马普索普（Robert Mapplethorpe）：（1946-89）美国艺术家和摄影师。许多人被他的图像的性本质所冒犯，这些图像经常显示出男性裸体。

senses.def: (1923-91) a British businessman, publisher
senses.zh: 罗伯特·麦克斯韦（1923-91），英国商人，出版商和报纸所有者，出生于捷克斯洛伐克。他于1940年来到英国，并因在第二次世界大战中的军事成就而获得了军事十字勋章。他首先通过自己的出版公司Pergamon Press致富。但是，在1969年，对该公司进行的正式调查认为他不适合经营公司。当时他还担任过国会工党议员，从1964年到1970年担任该职位。麦克斯韦（Maxwell）建立了一个庞大的商业帝国，并成为报纸业中最有权势的人之一。1984年，他购买了《镜报》集团的报纸，因此成为英国所有流行报纸《每日镜报》，《星期日镜报》和《星期日人》的所有者。麦克斯韦（Maxwell）从船上摔死溺死。他去世后，发现他是非法从雇员的退休金中收取钱款的。他的儿子凯文（Kevin）和伊恩（Ian）因涉嫌与他的公司有关的金融犯罪而被起诉，但被判无罪。麦克斯韦的名声被摧毁了。

senses.def: (1916-2009) a US Secretary of Defense (1961-8) under President Kennedy
senses.zh: 罗伯特·麦克纳马拉（Robert McNamara）：（1916-2009）肯尼迪总统和约翰逊总统领导下的美国国防部长（1961-8）。麦克纳马拉（McNamara）离开了这份工作，因为他对越南战争存有疑虑，后来他公开表示这是错误的。政治生涯结束后，他成为世界银行行长（1968-81）。在一部关于他一生的纪录片《战争迷雾：罗伯特·麦克纳马拉的人生的十一个教训》（2003年）中，他讨论了自己在越南的失败。

senses.def: (1917-97) a US actor who often played tough characters. He was noted for his relaxed style and for not taking his work too seriously. He made more than 125 films but once said, ‘Movies bore me, especially my own.’ His films include The Story of GI Joe
senses.zh: 罗伯特·米切（Robert Mitchu ）男：（1917-97）经常扮演强硬角色的美国演员。他以轻松的风格和不认真对待工作而闻名。他拍了125部电影，但曾经说过：“电影让我感到厌烦，尤其是我的电影。” 他的电影包括《 GI乔的故事》（1945年），《猎人之夜》（1955年），《瑞安的女儿》（1971年）和《告别我的可爱》（1975年），其中扮演了菲利普·马洛。

senses.def: (1771-1858) a Welsh industrialist
senses.zh: 罗伯特·欧文（Robert Owen）：（1771-1858）是威尔士的实业家，他的社会改革思想（即改善社会的变革）影响了英国合作社运动和工会的发展。他在苏格兰购买了一些棉纺厂，并为他的工人创建了一个模范工业社区，为他们提供了良好的住房和教育。工厂赚取了丰厚的利润，他的想法甚至在上层阶级中也得到了赞赏，尽管当他主张工人应该分享工厂所有权时，他们的热情并不高。他创立了其他几个社区，包括美国的New Harmony，但这些社区的成功率较低。

senses.def: (1788-1850) one of the most important British politicians of the early 19th century and one of the people who started the modern Conservative Party
senses.zh: 罗伯特·皮尔（Robert Peel）：（1788-1850）是19世纪初期英国最重要的政治人物之一，也是发起现代保守党的人之一。作为内政大臣（1822-30），皮尔负责赋予罗马天主教徒从事公共生活的权利，并负责组织大都会警察。（英国警察有时仍被称为Bobbies，来自Robert的缩写Bobby。他们曾经也被称为削皮器。）他两次出任总理（1834-5和1841-6），他的政府通过了许多重大的新政法律，尤其是与英国贸易有关的法律。1830年，他被封为男爵。

senses.def: (1905-89) a US writer who was the country's first Poet Laureate
senses.zh: 罗伯特·佩恩·沃伦（Robert Penn Warren）：（1905-89）美国作家，是美国第一位诗人桂冠诗人，也是唯一获得小说和诗歌普利策奖的美国人。他主要写有关南方的文章。他的普利策奖是为小说《所有国王的人》（1946年）和他的诗歌集《承诺》（1957年）以及《当下》（1979年）而设立的。沃伦（Warren）还是著名的评论家

senses.def: (1925-2008) a US artist who was one of the leading figures of pop art
senses.zh: 罗伯特·劳森伯格（Robert Rauschenberg）：（1925-2008）美国艺术家，是波普艺术的主要人物之一。他在1950年代因其“混合”绘画而闻名，其中包括瓶，指甲和新闻照片等真实物体。

senses.def: (1927-2011) an English radio and television presenter
senses.zh: 罗伯特·罗宾逊（Robert Robinson）：（1927-2011）英国广播和电视节目主持人，尤其是测验节目的主持人。他的电视节目包括《问家庭》（1967-84年）和《叫我诈Bl》（1967-88年），以及广播电台《停止一周》（1974-92年）和《英国大脑》。

senses.def: a small US book containing rules for running formal meetings, based on the procedures used in the British Parliament. It was first published in 1876 and has appeared since then in several new versions. It has been used by the US Congress, businesses and even small clubs.
senses.zh: 罗伯特的《议事规则》：这本美国小书，其中包含根据英国国会使用的程序进行正式会议的规则。它于1876年首次发布，此后以多个新版本出现。它已被美国国会，企业甚至小型俱乐部使用。

senses.def: (1774-1843) an English poet who also wrote histories and biographies
senses.zh: 罗伯特·索瑟（Robert Southey）：（1774-1843）是一位英国诗人，他还撰写了历史和传记。他是Coleridge和Wordsworth的朋友，并且是诗人湖之一。1813年，他被任命为诗人桂冠。

senses.def: (1803-59) an English engineer, the son of George Stephenson
senses.zh: 罗伯特·史蒂芬森（1803-59）英国工程师，乔治·史蒂芬森的儿子。在成为伦敦和伯明翰铁路的工程师之前，他帮助父亲设计和建造了火箭队的利物浦和曼彻斯特铁路。他还设计了许多重要的桥梁，并在他生命的最后12年担任保守党。

senses.def: (1274-1329) the king of Scotland from 1306 until his death. He joined William Wallace
senses.zh: 罗伯特·布鲁斯（Robert Bruce）：（1274-1329）从1306年直到他去世的苏格兰国王。他与威廉·华莱士（William Wallace）一起试图从苏格兰的英国人手中夺取政权，但几次被爱德华一世国王的军队击败。他最终于1314年在班诺克本（Bannockburn）击败了英国人，并于1328年承认苏格兰为独立国家。罗伯特的儿子大卫二世（David II）于1329年至1371年统治苏格兰。有个通俗的故事是罗伯特·布鲁斯（Robert Bruce）躲在英国人的山洞里，他如何看着蜘蛛反复试图将其网附着在岩石上，直到终于成功了。这使他下定决心继续击败英国人。

senses.def: (1676-1745) a British Whig
senses.zh: 罗伯特·沃波尔（Robert Walpole）：（1676-1745）英国辉格党政客，是英国第一任首相（1715-17和1721-42）。他还担任任何首相，任职时间最长，并且是第一个住在唐宁街十号的人。他的执政时期是该国的和平与经济成功时期，尽管沃波尔本人也被指控在政府中有不诚实的举动。他于1742年成为伯爵。

senses.def: a small brown European bird with a red breast
a grey American bird with a red breast, larger than a European robin
senses.zh: 旅鸫，美洲知更鸟（毛灰色，胸部红色，比欧亚鸲大）

senses.def: a first name for boys (usually Robin
senses.zh: 罗宾（男子名常写作 Robin，女子名常写作 Robyn）

senses.def: (1946-2005) a British Labour politician. He became a Member of Parliament
senses.zh: 罗宾·库克（Robin Cook）：（1946-2005）英国劳工政治家。他于1983年成为国会议员，并在担任劳动大臣之前在劳工影子内阁中担任过多个职位（1997年至2001年）。他成为下议院领导人，但为抗议2003年入侵伊拉克而辞职。

senses.def: Puck
a person who takes or steals money from rich people and gives it to poor people

examples.en: He was seen as an educational Robin Hood with his proposal to take federal money out of the hands of schools and place it in the hands of students.
examples.zh: 他被视为教育界的罗宾汉，他提议将联邦资金从学校手中转移到学生手中。

senses.def: (1952-2014) a US actor known for his energy and wild humour. He began his career on the television comedy series Mork and Mindy
senses.zh: 罗宾·威廉姆斯（Robin Williams）：（1952-2014）是一位以精力充沛和幽默着称的美国演员。他的职业生涯始于电视喜剧系列《莫克和明迪》（1978-82年）。他曾因《善意狩猎》（1998年）获得奥斯卡奖，并因越南的《早安》而获得金球奖（1987年），《渔夫之王》（1991年）和《杜伯夫人》（1993年）。他的其他电影包括《死人诗社》（1989年），《鸟笼》（1996年），《浮躁者》（1997年）和《失眠》（2002年）。

senses.def: a character in a book of the same name by Daniel Defoe
senses.zh: 鲁滨逊·克鲁索（Robinson Crusoe）：丹尼尔·笛福（Daniel Defoe）同名书中的一个人物，于1719年出版。克鲁索（Crusoe）在船沉没后独自留在一个岛上，并用他的少量财物在那里生存。曼周五帮助了他，曼周五在克鲁索将他从死里救出来后成为了克鲁索的忠实仆人。这本书以真实的故事为基础，通常被认为是第一本英语小说。

senses.def: a phone call from a company that is trying to sell you something, using a computer-operated dialling
senses.zh: 机器人电话（自动拨号并播放录音信息的推销电话）

senses.def: a machine that can perform a complicated series of tasks by itself

examples.en: These cars are built by robots.
examples.zh: 这些汽车是由机器人制造的。

examples.en: On her first flight she was responsible for operating the shuttle's robot arm.
examples.zh: 在她的第一次飞行中，她负责操作航天飞机的机械臂。

senses.def: (especially in stories) a machine that is made to look like a human and that can do some things that a human can do

examples.en: a toy robot
examples.zh: 玩具机器人

examples.en: The action starts when an army of giant robots invades Manhattan.
examples.zh: 故事从一大群巨型机器人入侵曼哈顿开始。

senses.def: a traffic light

examples.en: Turn left at the first robot.
examples.zh: 在第一个交通信号灯处向左拐。

senses.def: connected with robots

examples.en: a robotic arm
examples.zh: 机械臂

senses.def: like a robot, making stiff movements, speaking without feeling or expression, etc.
senses.zh: 像机器人的；呆板机械的

examples.en: robotic movements
examples.zh: 呆板而机械的动作。

senses.def: the science of designing and operating robots
strong and healthy

examples.en: She was almost 90, but still very robust.
examples.zh: 她将近 90 岁了，但身体仍然十分强健。

examples.en: He seems to be in robust (good) health.
examples.zh: 他看起来身体健康。

senses.def: strong; able to survive being used a lot and not likely to break

examples.en: a robust piece of equipment
examples.zh: 经久耐用的设备

senses.def: strong and not likely to fail or become weak

examples.en: robust economic growth
examples.zh: 强劲的经济增长

senses.def: strong and determined; showing that you are sure about what you are doing or saying

examples.en: The company is taking a more robust approach to management.
examples.zh: 该公司正在采取更加严格的管理方法。

senses.def: in a strong and healthy way

examples.en: The plants grew robustly.
examples.zh: 植物生长茂盛。

senses.def: in a strong way that is not likely to break or fail

examples.en: The furniture was robustly constructed.
examples.zh: 家具做得非常结实。

senses.def: in a strong or determined way that shows you are sure about what you are doing or saying

examples.en: They defended their policies robustly.
examples.zh: 他们坚定地捍卫自己的政策。

senses.def: the state of being strong and healthy

examples.en: His mental robustness helped him to cope in the aftermath of the trial.
examples.zh: 他的精神坚强帮助他应对审判后的后果。

senses.def: the quality of being strong and unlikely to break or fail

examples.en: Materials were chosen for their robustness and ease of maintenance.
examples.zh: 选择材料是因为其坚固性和易于维护。

senses.def: the quality of being strong enough to be trusted or relied on

examples.en: They questioned the robustness of the evidence.
examples.zh: 他们质疑证据的可靠性。

senses.def: the quality of being strong and determined because you are sure about what you are doing or saying

examples.en: She confronted her critics with typical robustness.
examples.zh: 她以典型的强硬态度面对批评者。

senses.def: a city in north-western New York state, on Lake Ontario
senses.zh: 罗切斯特（纽约州西北部安大略湖沿岸城市）

senses.def: the hard solid material that forms part of the surface of the earth and some other planets

examples.en: They drilled through several layers of rock to reach the oil.
examples.zh: 他们钻透了几层岩石寻找石油。

examples.en: a cave with striking rock formations (= shapes made naturally from rock)
examples.zh: 有奇妙天然岩石造型的洞穴

examples.en: The tunnel was blasted out of solid rock.
examples.zh: 这条隧道是在坚固的岩石中炸出来的。

examples.en: volcanic/igneous/sedimentary rocks
examples.zh: 火山岩；火成岩；沉积岩

senses.def: a mass of rock

examples.en: the Rock of Gibraltar
examples.zh: 直布罗陀山

examples.en: The ship crashed into the infamous Sker Point rocks and broke into three pieces.
examples.zh: 这艘船撞上了恶名远扬的斯戈尔尖岬暗礁群，断为三截。

examples.en: The ship hit some rocks and sank.
examples.zh: 那船触到了一些暗礁沉没了。

examples.en: A great rock jutted out into the water.
examples.zh: 一块大岩石伸出水面。

senses.def: a large single piece of rock

examples.en: They clambered over the rocks at the foot of the cliff.
examples.zh: 他们吃力地爬过了绝壁脚下的巨石。

examples.en: The sign said ‘Danger: falling rocks’.
examples.zh: 警示牌上写着“危险：前有落石”。

examples.en: We made our way down into the river bed and stepped from rock to rock.
examples.zh: 我们沿着河床走下去，从一块岩石走到另一块岩石。

senses.def: a small stone

examples.en: Protesters pelted the soldiers with rocks.
examples.zh: 抗议者向士兵投掷石块。

senses.def: a type of loud popular music, developed in the 1960s, with a strong beat played on electric guitars and drums

examples.en: punk/indie/classic rock
examples.zh: 朋克／独立／经典摇滚乐

examples.en: a rock band/star/concert
examples.zh: 摇滚乐队／明星／音乐会

examples.en: a rock musician/song/album
examples.zh: 摇滚音乐家/歌曲/专辑

examples.en: I hate rap but I like rock.
examples.zh: 我讨厌说唱，但我喜欢摇滚。

senses.def: a type of hard sweet made in long sticks, often sold in places where people go on holiday by the sea

examples.en: a stick of Brighton rock
examples.zh: 一支布赖顿硬棍糖

senses.def: a precious stone
a person who is emotionally strong and who you can rely on

examples.en: He is my rock.
examples.zh: 他是我的主心骨。

senses.def: in a situation where you have to choose between two things, both of which are unpleasant
to have an orgasm
to do something that you really enjoy
senses.zh: 做自己真正喜欢的事；享受

examples.en: He gets his rocks off listening to rap.
examples.zh: 他听说唱时会发疯。

senses.def: a relationship or business that is on the rocks
senses.zh: （关系或生意）陷于困境，濒临崩溃

examples.en: Sue's marriage is on the rocks.
examples.zh: 休的婚姻触礁了。

senses.def: served with pieces of ice but no water

examples.en: Scotch on the rocks
examples.zh: 加冰块的苏格兰威士忌酒

senses.def: extremely steady and calm; that you can rely on
senses.zh: 十分可靠；稳如泰山；安如磐石

senses.def: to move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side; to make somebody/something move in this way

examples.en: The boat rocked from side to side in the waves.
examples.zh: 小船在波浪中摇荡。

examples.en: She was rocking backwards and forwards in her seat.
examples.zh: 她在座位上前摇后晃。

examples.en: He rocked the baby gently in his arms.
examples.zh: 他抱着孩子轻轻摇晃。

senses.def: to shock somebody/something very much or make them afraid

examples.en: The country was rocked by a series of political scandals.
examples.zh: 一连串的政治丑闻震惊全国。

examples.en: The news rocked the world.
examples.zh: 这则消息震惊了全世界。

senses.zh: 粗糙度：不温和或谨慎的治疗

examples.en: His guard alternated from roughness and threats to leaving him alone.
examples.zh: 他的戒心时而粗暴、时而威胁，时而不打扰他。

senses.def: the fact of having a lot of violence or crime
senses.zh: 犯罪盛行的；充斥暴力的；危险的

examples.en: the roughness of the streets
examples.zh: 街道的粗糙度

senses.def: the fact of having large and dangerous waves

examples.en: the roughness of the sea
examples.zh: 大海的粗糙度

senses.def: the fact of being difficult or unpleasant

examples.en: the roughness of life in those hard times
examples.zh: 那些艰难时期生活的坎坷

senses.def: to treat somebody badly and not worry about their feelings
senses.zh: （对某人）为所欲为，横行霸道；任意蹂躏

senses.def: a gambling

examples.en: the roulette wheel/table
examples.zh: 轮盘赌轮/桌子

examples.en: He lost most of his money at roulette.
examples.zh: 他在轮盘赌上输掉了大部分钱。

examples.en: He was at a casino, playing roulette.
examples.zh: 他当时在赌场玩轮盘赌。

senses.def: having a shape like a circle or a ball

examples.en: a round plate
examples.zh: 圆盘子

examples.en: These glasses suit people with round faces.
examples.zh: 这款眼镜适合圆脸的人。

examples.en: The fruit are small and round.
examples.zh: 这种水果小而圆。

examples.en: Rugby isn't played with a round ball.
examples.zh: 橄榄球比赛用的不是圆球。

examples.en: the discovery that the world is round
examples.zh: 地球是圆的这一发现

examples.en: The child was watching it all with big round eyes (= showing interest).
examples.zh: 这孩子睁着又大又圆的眼睛看着这一切。

examples.en: a T-shirt with a round neck
examples.zh: 圆领 T 恤衫

examples.en: a coin with a round hole in the centre
examples.zh: 中央有圆孔的硬币

examples.en: The tower was perfectly round.
examples.zh: 这座塔是完美的圆形。

examples.en: They sat at a large round table.
examples.zh: 他们坐在一张大圆桌旁。

senses.def: having a curved shape

examples.en: the round green hills of Donegal
examples.zh: 多尼戈尔那些圆圆的绿山冈

examples.en: Put both the surname and publication date in round brackets.
examples.zh: 将姓氏和出版日期置于圆括号里。

examples.en: She had a small mouth and round pink cheeks.
examples.zh: 她的嘴小小的，圆脸蛋粉粉的。

examples.en: Choose shoes with a flat sole and round toes.
examples.zh: 选择平底、圆头的鞋子。

senses.def: a round

examples.en: Make it a round figure—say forty dollars.
examples.zh: 凑个整数，就四十块钱吧。

examples.en: Two thousand is a nice round number—put that down.
examples.zh: 两千是个不错的整数，记下吧。

examples.en: Well, in round figures (= not giving the exact figures) we've spent twenty thousand so far.
examples.zh: 嗯，说个约数吧，我们至今花了有两万了。

examples.en: The total was a round $30 million in Australian dollars.
examples.zh: 总额约为 3000 万澳元。

senses.def: moving in a circle

examples.en: Everybody joins hands and dances round.
examples.zh: 大家手拉着手，围成一圈跳舞。

examples.en: How do you make the wheels go round?
examples.zh: 你是怎么让轮子转起来的？

examples.en: The children were spinning round and round.
examples.zh: 孩子们一个劲地转呀转。

examples.en: The thought kept going round and round in her head.
examples.zh: 这个想法一直萦绕在她的心头。

examples.en: Love makes the world go round.
examples.zh: 爱让世界运转。

senses.def: measuring or marking the edge or outside of something

examples.en: a young tree measuring only 18 inches round
examples.zh: 周长只有 18 英寸的小树

examples.en: They've built a high fence all round to keep intruders out.
examples.zh: 他们在周围竖起了高高的篱笆，以防外人进入。

senses.def: on all sides of somebody/something

examples.en: A large crowd had gathered round to watch.
examples.zh: 一大群人聚在周围观看。

senses.def: at various places in an area

examples.en: People stood round waiting for something to happen.
examples.zh: 人们在各处站着，等待着发生什么事情。

senses.def: in a circle or curve to face another way or the opposite way

examples.en: He turned the car round and drove back again.
examples.zh: 他调转车头，又开了回来。

examples.en: She looked round at the sound of his voice.
examples.zh: 听到他的声音，她扭头看了看。

examples.en: Harvey spun round to face him.
examples.zh: 哈维转身面对他。

senses.def: to the other side of something

examples.en: We walked round to the back of the house.
examples.zh: 我们绕到房子的后面。

examples.en: The road's blocked—you'll have to drive the long way round.
examples.zh: 这条路被堵了，你们得开车绕着走了。

senses.def: from one place, person, etc. to another

examples.en: They've moved all the furniture round.
examples.zh: 他们把所有的家具搬动了一遍。

examples.en: He went round interviewing people about local traditions.
examples.zh: 他到处找人访谈，了解当地的传统。

examples.en: Pass the biscuits round.
examples.zh: 把饼干传给大家。

examples.en: Have we enough cups to go round?
examples.zh: 我们的杯子够大家用吗？

examples.en: Rumours are going round that she's pregnant again.
examples.zh: 谣言四起，说她又怀孕了。

senses.def: to or at a particular place, especially where somebody lives
senses.zh: 到某地，在某地（尤指居住地）

examples.en: I'll be round in an hour.
examples.zh: 我过一个小时就到。

examples.en: We've invited the Frasers round this evening.
examples.zh: 我们已经邀请了弗雷泽一家今晚过来。

examples.en: Edward loved her cooking and regularly came round to supper.
examples.zh: 爱德华喜欢她做饭，经常过来吃晚饭。

senses.def: on the next, first, etc. occasion that the same thing happens
senses.zh: 同样的事情下次（或第一次等）发生时

examples.en: He repeated none of the errors he'd made first time round.
examples.zh: 他没有重复过首次所犯下的任何错误。

examples.en: This time round it was not so easy.
examples.zh: 这一次这事可就不那么容易了。

senses.def: approximately

examples.en: We're leaving round about ten.
examples.zh: 我们十点钟左右要离开。

examples.en: A new roof will cost round about £3 000.
examples.zh: 换新房顶大约要花 3 000 英镑。

senses.def: in the area near a place

examples.en: in Oxford and the villages round about
examples.zh: 在牛津及其附近的村庄

senses.def: in a circle

examples.en: the first woman to sail round the world
examples.zh: 第一位环球航行的女性

examples.en: The earth moves round the sun.
examples.zh: 地球绕着太阳转。

senses.def: on, to or from the other side of something

examples.en: Our house is round the next bend.
examples.zh: 前面一拐弯就是我们家。

examples.en: There she is, coming round the corner.
examples.zh: 她来了，绕过拐角过来了。

examples.en: There must be a way round (= a way of solving) the problem.
examples.zh: 这个问题一定有办法解决。

senses.def: on all sides of somebody/something; surrounding somebody/something

examples.en: She put her arms round him.
examples.zh: 她张开双臂搂住他。

examples.en: He had a scarf round his neck.
examples.zh: 他脖子上围着围巾。

examples.en: They were all sitting round the table.
examples.zh: 他们围着桌子坐着。

senses.def: in or to many parts of something

examples.en: She looked all round the room.
examples.zh: 她将房间四下打量了一下。

senses.def: to fit in with particular people, ideas, etc.

examples.en: He has to organize his life round the kids.
examples.zh: 他不得不以孩子们为中心来安排自己的生活。

senses.def: a difficult problem or responsibility that it seems impossible to solve or get rid of

examples.en: My debts are a millstone around my neck.
examples.zh: 债务成了我难以摆脱的负担。

examples.en: Unemployment was an economic millstone around the country’s neck.
examples.zh: 失业是压在这个国家脖子上的一块经济磨石。

senses.def: near where you are now or where you live

examples.en: There are no decent schools round here.
examples.zh: 附近没有什么像样的学校。

senses.def: a stage in a competition or sports event

examples.en: the qualifying rounds of the National Championships
examples.zh: 全国锦标赛的资格赛

examples.en: Anderson was knocked out of the tournament in the third round.
examples.zh: 安德森在锦标赛的第三轮被淘汰出局。

examples.en: He beat Fischer in the opening round.
examples.zh: 他在首轮比赛中击败了费舍尔。

examples.en: She made it through to the final round.
examples.zh: 她成功进入了最后一轮。

senses.def: a stage in a boxing

examples.en: The fight only lasted five rounds.
examples.zh: 比赛只持续了五个回合。

examples.en: Ali won the next round convincingly.
examples.zh: 阿里令人信服地赢了下一轮比赛。

senses.def: a complete game of golf; a complete way around the course in some other sports, such as showjumping
senses.zh: （高尔夫球、马术场地障碍赛等的）一轮比赛，一局，一场

examples.en: We played a round of golf.
examples.zh: 我们打了一场高尔夫球。

examples.en: I finished the practice round and went in to have lunch.
examples.zh: 我打完一场高尔夫球练习赛后，就进去吃午饭了。

examples.en: the first horse to jump a clear round
examples.zh: 干净利落地完成整套跳跃表演的第一匹马

senses.def: a set of events which form part of a longer process

examples.en: the next round of peace talks
examples.zh: 下一轮和谈

examples.en: a new round of pay bargaining
examples.zh: 新的一轮增加工资的谈判。

examples.en: the final round of voting in the election
examples.zh: 选举的最后一轮投票

examples.en: This latest round of redundancies follows the loss of 250 jobs in January.
examples.zh: 继 1 月份裁员 250 人之后，又进行了最新一轮裁员。

examples.en: There were two important rounds of negotiations.
examples.zh: 有两轮重要的谈判。

examples.en: He won the second round of the elections.
examples.zh: 他赢得了第二轮选举。

senses.def: a regular series of activities
senses.zh: 一系列常规活动；惯常的活动

examples.en: the daily round of school life
examples.zh: 学校的日常生活

examples.en: Her life is one long round of parties and fun.
examples.zh: 她的生活就是没完没了的聚会娱乐。

senses.group: regular activities/route 惯常的活动／路线

senses.def: a regular route that somebody takes when delivering or collecting something; a regular series of visits that somebody makes
senses.zh: （收发信函等的）固定路线；照例要出去做的事情

examples.en: Dr Green was on her daily ward rounds.
examples.zh: 格林医生在进行每日一次的巡查病房。

examples.en: a postman on his delivery round
examples.zh: 正在投递邮件的邮递员

examples.en: Four soldiers patrolled the area and an officer made his rounds at frequent intervals.
examples.zh: 四名士兵在该地区巡逻，一名军官不时巡视。

examples.en: The milkman does his round very early.
examples.zh: 送奶工一大早就送奶。

senses.group: regular activities/route 惯常的活动／路线

senses.def: a number of drinks bought by one person for all the others in a group
senses.zh: （由一人给大家买的）一巡饮料

examples.en: a round of drinks
examples.zh: 一巡饮料

examples.en: It's my round (= it is my turn to pay for the next set of drinks).
examples.zh: 这一巡轮到我了。

senses.def: a whole slice of bread; sandwiches made from two whole slices of bread
senses.zh: 一整片面包；（两整片面包做的）三明治

examples.en: Who's for another round of toast?
examples.zh: 谁还要烤面包片？

examples.en: two rounds of beef sandwiches
examples.zh: 两份牛肉三明治

senses.def: a round

examples.en: Cut the pastry into rounds.
examples.zh: 将油酥面团切成一个个圆块。

senses.def: a short period during which people show their approval of somebody/something by clapping

examples.en: There was a great round of applause when the dance ended.
examples.zh: 舞蹈结束的时候，爆发出了一阵热烈的掌声。

senses.def: a single shot from a gun; a bullet for one shot

examples.en: They fired several rounds at the crowd.
examples.zh: 他们朝人群开了几枪。

examples.en: We only have three rounds of ammunition left.
examples.zh: 我们只剩下三发子弹了。

senses.def: a song for two or more voices in which each sings the same tune but starts at a different time

senses.def: crazy

examples.en: I would go round the bend if I had your job.
examples.zh: 如果我有你的工作，我会拐弯抹角。

examples.en: The kids have been driving me round the bend today (= annoying me very much).
examples.zh: 孩子们今天快把我气疯了。

senses.def: either of a pair of marks, ( ), placed around extra information in a piece of writing or part of a problem in mathematics
a quiz
senses.zh: 英国巡回测验：第4电台的测验节目，来自该国不同地区的两个团队被问到一些困难的问题，以测试他们的知识。它于1947年首次播放。1997年，英国广播公司（BBC）决定终止该节目，但有很多人抗议该决定被更改。

senses.def: with eyes that are fully open because of surprise, fear, etc.
senses.zh: （因为吃惊、害怕等）两眼圆睁的

examples.en: The child watched, round-eyed, as the horses galloped past.
examples.zh: 孩子睁大眼睛看着马匹驰过。

senses.def: to finish an activity or complete something in a good or suitable way

examples.en: She rounded off the tour with a concert at Carnegie Hall.
examples.zh: 她在卡内基音乐厅举行一场音乐会，以此圆满结束了她的巡回演出。

examples.en: A coffee would round the meal off nicely.
examples.zh: 最后来杯咖啡，这顿饭就吃得心满意足了。

examples.en: We rounded off the day with a picnic.
examples.zh: 我们以野餐圆满结束了一天的活动。

senses.def: to take the sharp or rough edges off something
senses.zh: 去除…的棱角；使…的边缘光滑

examples.en: You can round off the corners with sandpaper.
examples.zh: 你可以用砂纸把棱角打磨光滑。

senses.def: to suddenly speak angrily to somebody and criticize or attack them

examples.en: He rounded on journalists, calling them ‘a pack of vultures’.
examples.zh: 他突然对记者大发雷霆，称他们是一帮乘人之危的家伙。

senses.def: a competition in which every player or team plays every other player or team
a letter intended to be read by many people that is copied and sent to each one

examples.en: I always send a round robin letter with all our news to friends at Christmas.
examples.zh: 圣诞节时我都会给朋友群发一封信，告诉大家我们的近况。

senses.def: a letter that has been signed by a large number of people who wish to express their opinions about something
something that is made, written, etc. by several people who each add a part one after another
senses.zh: 合作（或合写等）的东西；接龙创作

examples.en: a round robin story
examples.zh: 接龙故事

senses.def: with shoulders that are bent forward or sloping downwards
at which everyone is equal and has the same rights
senses.zh: 圆桌的；参与者权利均等的

examples.en: round-table talks
examples.zh: 圆桌会谈

senses.def: lasting or happening all day and night
senses.zh: 日夜不停的；持续一整天的

examples.en: round-the-clock nursing care
examples.zh: 全天的护理

senses.def: a journey to a place and back again

examples.en: a 30-mile round trip to work
examples.zh: 上班往返 30 英里的路程

examples.en: It's 30 miles round trip to work.
examples.zh: 上班要走往返 30 英里的路程。

examples.en: It took two days to make the round trip.
examples.zh: 往返行程花了 2 天。

examples.en: a 300-mile round trip from Denver to Laramie
examples.zh: 从丹佛到拉勒米的 300 英里往返旅程

senses.def: going to a place and back again; for or connected with such a journey

examples.en: a round-trip flight
examples.zh: 往返航班

examples.en: a round-trip ticket/fare
examples.zh: 往返机票/票价

senses.def: to find and gather together people, animals or things

examples.en: I rounded up a few friends for a party.
examples.zh: 我找了几个朋友聚了聚。

examples.en: The cattle are rounded up in the evenings.
examples.zh: 到了晚上，牛都要圈起来。

senses.def: if police or soldiers round up

examples.en: A number of suspects were rounded up and questioned.
examples.zh: 一些嫌疑人被围捕并接受讯问。

senses.def: a summary of the most important points of a particular subject, especially the news

examples.en: We'll be back after the break with a round-up of today's other stories.
examples.zh: 休息之后我们会摘要报道今天其他的新闻。

examples.en: a news round-up
examples.zh: 综合新闻报道

examples.en: This week’s issue includes a round-up of the latest record releases.
examples.zh: 本周的期刊包括最新唱片发行的综述。

senses.def: an act of bringing people or animals together in one place for a particular purpose

examples.en: the round-up of sheep for shearing
examples.zh: 围捕羊以剪毛

examples.en: The police carried out their usual round-up of Saturday night drunks.
examples.zh: 警方对周六晚上的醉酒者进行了例行围捕。

senses.def: the second of two openings covered by a membrane
senses.zh: 圆窗（位于中耳和内耳之间的薄膜覆盖的第二个开口）

senses.def: a place where two or more roads meet, forming a circle that all traffic must go around in the same direction

examples.en: At the roundabout, take the second exit.
examples.zh: 到环岛后，走第二个出口。

examples.en: When entering a roundabout, give way to any traffic already on it.
examples.zh: 进入环形交叉口时，给已经在环形交叉口上的所有车辆让路。

examples.en: Leave the roundabout at the second exit.

senses.def: (1795-1897) a British Post Office
senses.zh: 罗兰·希尔（Rowland Hill）：（1795-1897）一位英国邮局工作人员，发明了邮票，最初花费了1美分（便士·布莱克，1840年推出）。在此之前，邮费是由接收信件或包裹的人支付的。希尔在1860年被任命为骑士。

senses.def: a device fixed to the side of a boat for holding an oar
a former British business producing many well-known types of chocolate bars and sweets, including Kit Kat
senses.zh: 一家前英国企业，生产包括Kit Kit，Smarties和Black Magic在内的许多著名类型的巧克力和糖果。Rowntree于1862年在约克成立，并于1969年与另一家糖果生产商Mackintosh合并。自1988年以来，它一直由雀巢拥有，某些产品（如Rowntree的Fruit Pastilles）仍沿用Rowntree品牌。

senses.def: a first name for boys
(1920-2003) a British politician and author. He was Home Secretary
senses.zh: 罗伊·詹金斯（Roy Jenkins）：（1920-2003）英国政治家和作家。他曾是哈罗德·威尔逊（Harold Wilson）工党政府的内政大臣（1965-7和1974-6）和财政大臣（1967-70），后来帮助建立了社会民主党。从1977年到1981年，他担任欧洲委员会主席。他写了几本有关政治和政治家的书，并于1987年成为终身同辈。

senses.def: (1923-97) a US painter who helped to establish pop art
senses.zh: 罗伊·利希滕斯坦（Roy Lichtenstein）：（1923-97）是美国画家，他帮助建立了波普艺术。他的许多照片，例如《 Whaam！》（1963年），就像大型漫画一样，被视为对流行文化的评论。利希滕斯坦有时会以他自己的风格再次绘制其他艺术家的照片，例如他1992年发行的文森特·梵高的《阿尔勒的卧室》。他还制作了塑料和金属雕塑。

senses.def: (1936-88) a US singer and writer of pop songs who was very successful in the early 1960s. He was sometimes called the 'Big O'. His voice had a sad and emotional quality and he always wore dark glasses while performing. His best-known songs include Only the Lonely
senses.zh: 罗伊·奥比森（Roy Orbison）：（1936-88）是美国歌手和流行歌曲作家，他在1960年代初期非常成功。他有时被称为“大O”。他的声音具有悲伤和情感上的特质，表演时总是戴墨镜。他最著名的歌曲包括《孤独》（Only the Lonely，1960年），《哭泣》（Cryin'，1961年）和《漂亮女人》（Pretty Woman，1964年）。Orbison于1987年入选摇滚名人堂。

senses.def: (1912-98) a US singer and actor. He was the most popular Hollywood
senses.zh: 罗伊·罗杰斯（Roy Rogers）：（1912-98）是美国歌手和演员。他是1940年代最受欢迎的好莱坞牛仔明星，被称为“牛仔之王”。他和他著名的马触发器（Trigger）出演了约100部电影，包括《西部星空》（1938年），《得克萨斯州的黄玫瑰》（1944年）和《阿帕奇玫瑰》（1947年）。他的妻子演员戴尔·埃文斯（Dale Evans，1912-2001）经常和他一起表演。他创造了许多唱片，并于1988年入选乡村音乐名人堂。

senses.def: (1884-1976) a Canadian newspaper owner who created an international business empire
senses.zh: 罗伊·汤姆森（Roy Thomson）：（1884-1976）加拿大报纸的老板，他在英国建立了国际商业帝国。汤姆森组织（Thomson Organization）包括世界各地的出版，旅行，印刷，广播和电视公司。汤姆森（Thomson）曾经是两家英国国家报纸的所有者，分别是他于1959年购买的《星期日泰晤士报》和他于1966年购买的《泰晤士报》。他在1964年成为终身同龄人。

senses.def: a British horse racing event held over five days at Ascot
senses.zh: 皇家阿斯科特（Royal Ascot）：每年6月在阿斯科特（Ascot）举行的为期五天的英国赛马活动。王室成员参加了一些比赛，许多人是出于社会原因而不是运动而去那里。皇家阿斯科特（Royal Ascot）的第三天通常是女士节，为此，许多在场的妇女戴着大，印象深刻或不寻常的帽子。

senses.zh: 一家生产陶器和瓷器的英国公司。它由约翰·道尔顿（John Doulton）于19世纪初在伦敦开始，后来搬到特伦特河畔斯托克（Stoke-on-Trent）附近的波斯勒姆。

senses.zh: 皇家公园（伦敦最初属于君主的公园，现由政府管理，共九个，包括位于伦敦市中心的格林公园、摄政公园、圣詹姆斯公园、肯辛顿花园和海德公园，以及里士满大公园、汉普顿宫公园、布希公园和格林尼治公园）

senses.def: a ship that was used by members of the British royal family

examples.en: I was treated royally throughout my visit.

senses.def: to move your hand, a cloth, etc., backwards and forwards over a surface while pressing it

examples.en: He sat up on the hard bunk and rubbed his eyes.
examples.zh: 他从硬床板上坐起来，揉了揉眼睛。

examples.en: She rubbed her chin thoughtfully.
examples.zh: 她若有所思地抚摩着下巴。

examples.en: He rubbed a hand wearily over his eyes.
examples.zh: 他疲倦地用一只手擦了擦眼睛。

examples.en: Rub the surface with sandpaper before painting.
examples.zh: 用砂纸打磨表面，然后再上油漆。

examples.en: The cat rubbed itself against my legs.
examples.zh: 猫在我腿上蹭来蹭去。

examples.en: I rubbed at the stain on the cloth.
examples.zh: 我擦了擦布上的污渍。

examples.zh: 动物一直在这些树上蹭来蹭去。

examples.en: She rubbed her hair dry quickly with a towel.
examples.zh: 她迅速用毛巾擦干头发。

examples.en: I rubbed a clear patch on the window with my fingers.
examples.zh: 我用手指把窗户上的一小块儿擦干净了。

senses.def: to press two surfaces against each other and move them backwards and forwards; to be pressed together and move in this way

examples.en: She rubbed her hands in delight.
examples.zh: 她高兴得直搓手。

examples.en: In some cultures, people traditionally greet each other by rubbing noses.
examples.zh: 在某些文化中，人们传统上通过揉鼻子来打招呼。

examples.en: She rubbed her hands together in effort to warm them.
examples.zh: 她搓着手，努力让它们暖和起来。

examples.en: He made a fire by rubbing sticks together.
examples.zh: 他通过摩擦木棍生火。

examples.en: It sounded like two pieces of wood rubbing together.
examples.zh: 听起来就像是两块木头在一起摩擦。

senses.def: to move backwards and forwards many times against something while pressing it, especially causing pain or damage
senses.zh: 磨，摩擦（尤指引起疼痛或损害）

examples.en: The back of my shoe is rubbing.
examples.zh: 我的鞋后跟磨脚。

examples.en: The wheel is rubbing on the mudguard.
examples.zh: 车轮蹭着挡泥板了。

examples.en: Their perpetually wet clothes rubbed against their skin.
examples.zh: 他们永远湿漉漉的衣服摩擦着他们的皮肤。

examples.en: The horse's neck was rubbed raw (= until the skin came off) where the rope had been.
examples.zh: 马脖子上套过缰绳的地方皮都给磨掉了。

senses.def: to spread a liquid or other substance over a surface while pressing it

examples.en: She rubbed the lotion into her skin.
examples.zh: 她把润肤液揉搓进皮肤里。

examples.en: Rub salt over the fish before cooking.
examples.zh: 烹饪前在鱼上撒盐。

examples.en: Put a little cream onto each hand and rub it in well.
examples.zh: 在每只手上抹上一点儿乳膏，然后涂均匀。

senses.zh: 鲁道夫·瓦伦蒂诺（Rudolph Valentino）：（1895-1926）是无声电影中最成功的美国明星之一。他出生于意大利，并于1913年去美国。他扮演浪漫角色，在《酋长》（The Sheik，1921年）中最有名。他的其他电影包括《天启四骑士》（1921），《血与沙》（1922）和《酋长之子》（1926）。瓦伦蒂诺（Valentino）逝世时，超过10万人参加了他的葬礼。

senses.def: (1865-1936) an English writer. He was born in India, where many of his books are set (e.g. The Jungle Book
senses.zh: （1865-1936）英国作家。他出生于印度，那里有很多书籍（例如《丛林书》和《金正传》），并在1880年代在那里担任记者。他以多种形式写作，包括小说，短篇小说和成人和儿童的诗歌。他的许多诗仍然很受欢迎，包括If，Gunga Din和Mandalay（1892）。他作品中的角色通常是大英帝国部分地区的士兵，而且他被指控对大英帝国及其使用军事力量感到过分自豪。1907年，吉卜林成为第一位获得诺贝尔文学奖的英国作家。

examples.zh: 天气恶劣，破坏了我们的旅行。

examples.zh: 正是那个错误断送了他得到那份工作的机会。

examples.zh: 我的新鞋被泥浆给糟蹋了。

examples.zh: 如果败诉，她就完了。

examples.zh: 这个国家因战争而遭到严重破坏。

examples.en: Two bodies were found among the charred ruins of the house.
examples.zh: 在房子烧焦的废墟中发现了两具尸体。

examples.en: He was determined to build a new life out of the ruins of his career.
examples.zh: 他决心从事业失败中爬起来，重新开始新的生活。

senses.def: a statement of what may, must or must not be done in a particular situation or when playing a game

examples.zh: 她给房客定下了严格的规矩，包括即时支付租金。

examples.zh: 违反规则

examples.zh: 执行规则

examples.en: You can't just change the rules to suit yourself.
examples.zh: 不能为方便个人而改变规则。

examples.zh: 这违背了所有的规章制度。

examples.zh: 这些产品为国际法规所禁止。

examples.en: This explains the rules under which the library operates.
examples.zh: 这份材料说明了图书馆的运作方式。

examples.zh: 成人社会不成文的规则（=每个人都明白）

examples.zh: 程序/行为规则（=说明必须如何做某事）

examples.zh: 养老金新规定将于明年生效。

examples.en: Normal competition rules apply.
examples.zh: 适用正常的比赛规则。

examples.en: According to the rules of the game, you have to miss a turn.
examples.zh: 根据游戏规则，你必须错过一个回合。

senses.def: a statement of what is possible according to a particular system, for example the grammar of a language

examples.en: the basic rules of grammar
examples.zh: 基本语法规则

examples.en: What is the rule for forming plurals?
examples.zh: 构成复数的规则是什么？

senses.def: a statement of what you are advised to do in a particular situation

examples.en: The first rule is to make eye contact with your interviewer.
examples.zh: 首先是眼睛要直视面试官。

examples.en: Follow these few simple rules and you won't go far wrong.
examples.zh: 遵守这几个简单的规则，你就不会出什么大错。

examples.en: There are no hard and fast rules for planning healthy meals.
examples.zh: 在安排健康饮食方面，没有什么硬性规定。

senses.def: a habit; the normal state of things; what is true in most cases

examples.en: He makes it a rule never to borrow money.
examples.zh: 他的规矩是从不向人借钱。

examples.en: Cold winters here are the exception rather than the rule (= are rare).
examples.zh: 在这里，严寒的冬天并不多见。

senses.def: the government of a country or control of a group of people by a particular person, group or system

examples.en: military/civilian/democratic rule
examples.zh: 军事管制；民选政府；民主统治

examples.en: The 1972 Act imposed direct rule from Westminster.
examples.zh: 1972 年的法案强制实行了英国中央政府的直接统治。

examples.en: The country was still under colonial rule.
examples.zh: 这个国家仍处于殖民统治之下。

examples.en: majority rule (= government by the political party that most people have voted for)
examples.zh: 获选票多数的政党组成政府的原则

senses.def: a measuring instrument with a straight edge
usually but not always

examples.en: I go to bed early as a rule.
examples.zh: 我一贯睡得早。

examples.en: As a general rule, vegetable oils are better for you than animal fats.
examples.zh: 一般来说，植物油比动物脂肪对人较有好处。

senses.def: to change the rules to suit a particular person or situation
senses.zh: 根据具体情况改变规则；通融

examples.en: Couldn't they just bend the rules and let us in without a ticket?
examples.zh: 难道他们就不能通融一下，让我们没票也进去吗？

senses.def: people say that something is the exception that proves the rule
senses.zh: 反证规律的例外；足以证明普遍性的例外

examples.en: Most electronics companies have not done well this year, but ours is the exception that proves the rule.
examples.zh: 今年多数电子公司都不景气，而我们公司却是普遍中的例外。

senses.def: if somebody plays by their own rules

examples.en: If he wanted a loan he would have to play by the bank's rules.
examples.zh: 如果他想贷款的话，必须按银行的规定行事。

senses.def: to deal fairly and honestly with people
senses.zh: 按规则玩游戏；处事公正诚实；循规蹈矩

senses.def: the condition in which all members of society, including its political leaders, accept the authority of the law

examples.en: Democracy and the rule of law are yet to be firmly established in the country.
examples.zh: 该国的民主和法治尚未牢固建立。

senses.def: a practical method of doing or measuring something, usually based on past experience rather than on exact measurement
senses.zh: 实用的估算方法，经验工作法（通常依据经验而非准确测量）

examples.en: As a rule of thumb, you should cook a chicken for 20 minutes for each pound of weight.
examples.zh: 根据经验，每磅重量的鸡肉应煮 20 分钟。

senses.def: the standards of behaviour that most people accept or that actually operate in a particular area of life or business
senses.zh: 游戏规则；大家共同遵守的行为标准

senses.def: to follow the rules of your job in a very strict way in order to cause delay, as a form of protest against your employer or your working conditions
to control and have authority over a country, a group of people, etc.

examples.en: At that time, King John ruled England.
examples.zh: 当时是约翰王统治着英格兰。

examples.en: The city was ruled by rich and powerful nobles.
examples.zh: 这座城市由富有而强大的贵族统治。

examples.en: The film is set in an imagined future in which machines rule the world.
examples.zh: 这部电影的背景是假想的未来，那时机器统治着世界。

examples.en: Eighty million years ago, dinosaurs ruled the earth.
examples.zh: 八千万年前，地球是恐龙的天下。

examples.en: Charles I ruled for eleven years.
examples.zh: 查理一世统治了十一年。

examples.en: After the revolution, anarchy ruled.
examples.zh: 革命以后，无政府主义大行其道。

examples.en: She once ruled over a vast empire.
examples.zh: 她曾统治过一个幅员辽阔的帝国。

senses.def: to be the main thing that influences and controls somebody/something

examples.en: The pursuit of money ruled his life.
examples.zh: 对金钱的追求支配着他的生活。

examples.en: We live in a society where we are ruled by the clock.
examples.zh: 我们生活在一个人人都围着时间转的社会。

examples.en: Her whole life seemed to be ruled by fear.
examples.zh: 她的一生似乎都被恐惧所笼罩着。

senses.def: to give an official decision about something

examples.en: The court will rule on the legality of the action.
examples.zh: 法庭将裁定此举是否合法。

examples.en: The judge ruled against/in favour of the plaintiff.
examples.zh: 法官判原告败诉／胜诉。

examples.zh: 这笔交易可能会被判定为非法。

examples.en: The deal was ruled to be illegal.

examples.zh: 这条路和这条河是平行的。

examples.en: The railway line runs right past the house.
examples.zh: 铁路线就从房子旁边经过。

examples.en: The bookcase runs the length of the room.
examples.zh: 书柜与房间一样长。

examples.en: We ran a cable from the lights to the stage.
examples.zh: 我们从电灯那里拉了一条电缆通到舞台。

senses.def: to flow

examples.en: The tears ran down her cheeks.
examples.zh: 泪水顺着她的脸淌下来。

examples.en: Water was running all over the bathroom floor.
examples.zh: 浴室里水流满地。

senses.def: to make liquid flow

examples.en: She ran hot water into the bucket.
examples.zh: 她把热水注入桶里。

examples.en: to run the hot tap (= to turn it so that water flows from it)
examples.zh: 拧开热水龙头

examples.en: I'll run a bath for you.
examples.zh: 我去给你放洗澡水。

examples.en: I'll run you a bath.
examples.zh: 我去给你放洗澡水。

senses.def: to send out a liquid

examples.en: Who left the tap running?
examples.zh: 谁没关水龙头？

examples.en: Your nose is running (= mucus is flowing from it).
examples.zh: 你流鼻涕了。

examples.en: The smoke makes my eyes run.
examples.zh: 烟熏得我直流眼泪。

senses.def: to be covered with a liquid

examples.en: His face was running with sweat.
examples.zh: 他满脸是汗。

examples.en: The bathroom floor was running with water.
examples.zh: 浴室的地面上全是水。

senses.def: if the colour runs
senses.zh: （衣物等的颜色在下水后）褪，掉

examples.en: The colour ran and made all my underwear pink.
examples.zh: 掉色了，我所有的内衣都被染成粉红色了。

senses.def: to melt

examples.en: The wax began to run.
examples.zh: 蜡开始熔化了。

senses.def: to become different in a particular way, especially a bad way
senses.zh: 变成，成为，变得（尤指不利的变化）

examples.en: The river ran dry (= stopped flowing) during the drought.
examples.zh: 这条河在干旱期间断流了。

examples.en: Supplies are running low.
examples.zh: 物资供应渐趋不足。

examples.en: We understand that feelings are running high on this issue
examples.zh: 我们知道人们在这个问题上情绪高涨

examples.en: We've run short of milk.
examples.zh: 我们牛奶不够了。

examples.en: You've got your rivals running scared.
examples.zh: 你已经使对手感到恐惧了。

senses.def: to be at or near a particular level

examples.en: Inflation was running at 26 per cent.
examples.zh: 通货膨胀率达到了 26%。

senses.def: to continue for a particular period of time without stopping

examples.en: Her last musical ran for six months on Broadway.
examples.zh: 她上一部音乐剧在百老汇连续上演了六个月。

examples.en: The course runs from June 25th to August 27th.
examples.zh: 课程时间为6月25日至8月27日。

examples.en: This debate will run and run!
examples.zh: 这场辩论会没完没了地继续下去！

senses.def: to operate or be legally acceptable for a particular period of time

examples.en: The permit runs for three months.
examples.zh: 许可证的有效期为三个月。

examples.en: The lease on my house only has a year left to run.
examples.zh: 我房子的租期只剩下一年了。

senses.def: to happen or progress at the time or in the way mentioned
senses.zh: （在某时间或以某方式）发生，进行

examples.en: Programmes are running a few minutes behind schedule this evening.
examples.zh: 今晚播出的节目比预定的时间晚了几分钟。

examples.en: Everything is running according to plan.
examples.zh: 一切都在按计划进行。

examples.en: Her life had always run smoothly before.
examples.zh: 她以前的生活一直很稳定。

examples.en: The murderer was given three life sentences, to run concurrently.
examples.zh: 这个杀人犯被判处三项无期徒刑，合并执行。

senses.def: to be a candidate in an election for a political position, especially in the US

examples.en: Obama ran a second time in 2012.
examples.zh: 2012 年，奥巴马第二次参选。

examples.en: Hilary Clinton ran for president in 2016.
examples.zh: 希拉里·克林顿 (Hilary Clinton) 2016 年竞选总统。

examples.en: He ran unsuccessfully for the Senate in New York.
examples.zh: 他竞选纽约州参议员没有成功。

examples.en: She is planning to run in the parliamentary election.
examples.zh: 她计划参加议会选举。

senses.def: to bring or take something into a country illegally and secretly
senses.zh: 走私；非法携运；秘密携带

examples.en: He used to run guns across the border.
examples.zh: 他过去经常私运枪支过境。

examples.en: She made money by running drugs.
examples.zh: 她靠贩毒赚钱。

senses.group: guns, drugs, etc. 枪支、毒品等

senses.def: to have particular words, contents, etc.

examples.en: Their argument ran something like this…
examples.zh: 他们的论点大致是这样的…

examples.en: ‘Ten shot dead by gunmen,’ ran the newspaper headline.
examples.zh: 报纸的标题为“枪手射杀十人”。

senses.def: to print and publish an item or a story

examples.en: On advice from their lawyers they decided not to run the story.
examples.zh: 根据他们的律师的建议，他们决定不刊载这篇报道。

senses.def: to do a test, an experiment, etc.

examples.en: The doctors decided to run some more tests on the blood samples.
examples.zh: 医生决定对血样再进行一些化验。

examples.en: The two experiments are run in parallel.
examples.zh: 这两个实验是同时进行的。

examples.en: The company is running clinical trials of the new drug.
examples.zh: 该公司正在进行新药的临床试验。

senses.def: if tights
to be pleased to do what somebody wants
senses.zh: 赶紧做某人喜欢的事；急于应某人的要求

examples.en: She knew she had only to call and he would come running.
examples.zh: 她知道只要打个电话，他就会高高兴兴地照办。

senses.def: to run in order to escape from somebody/something
to treat somebody badly and not worry about their feelings
senses.zh: （对某人）为所欲为，横行霸道；任意蹂躏

senses.def: working fully and correctly

examples.en: It will be a lot easier when we have the database up and running.
examples.zh: 等我们把数据库弄好以后，就省事多了。

examples.en: We soon had the sound system up and running.
examples.zh: 我们不久就将音响系统启用了。

senses.def: an act of running; a period of time spent running or the distance that somebody runs
senses.zh: 跑；跑步；跑步的时间（或距离）

examples.en: I go for a run every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早晨都去跑步。

examples.en: a five-mile run
examples.zh: 跑上五英里

examples.en: The event comprised a 1500m swim, 40km bike ride and 10km run.
examples.zh: 比赛项目包括1500米游泳、40公里自行车和10公里跑步。

examples.en: Catching sight of her he broke into a run (= started running).
examples.zh: 他一看见她就跑了起来。

examples.en: I decided to make a run for it (= to escape by running).
examples.zh: 我决定逃跑。

examples.en: She took the stairs at a run.
examples.zh: 她跑着上了楼梯。

examples.en: The Ethiopian is aiming to produce his second record-breaking run of the week.
examples.zh: 这名埃塞俄比亚选手的目标是在本周第二次跑出破纪录的成绩。

examples.en: The race consists of an eight-mile cross-country run followed by an army assault course.
examples.zh: 比赛包括八英里的越野跑，然后是军队突击课程。

senses.def: a trip by car, plane, boat, etc., especially a short one or one that is made regularly
senses.zh: （尤指短程或定期，乘交通工具的）旅程，航程

examples.en: They took the car out for a run.
examples.zh: 他们开车出去旅行。

examples.en: We went for a run in his new car.
examples.zh: 我们开着他的新车去旅行。

examples.en: This ferry operates on the Dover-Calais run.
examples.zh: 该渡轮在多佛-加莱航线上运营。

senses.def: a period of something good or bad happening; a series of successes or failures
senses.zh: 一段（幸运或倒霉的）时光；一系列（成功或失败）

examples.en: a run of good/bad luck
examples.zh: 一连串好运／噩运

examples.en: Liverpool lost to Leeds, ending an unbeaten run of 18 games.
examples.zh: 利物浦队输给了利兹队，结束了连续 18 场不败的纪录。

examples.en: Manchester United have finally ended their run of victories.
examples.zh: 曼联队最终结束了连胜。

senses.def: a series of performances of a play or film

examples.en: The show had a record-breaking run in the London theatre.
examples.zh: 这出戏在伦敦剧院连续上演，打破了演出纪录。

senses.def: the amount of a product that a company decides to make at one time

examples.en: The first print run of 6 000 copies sold out.
examples.zh: 首印 6 000 册已全部售罄。

senses.def: a situation when many people sell dollars, etc. and the value of the money falls
a situation when many people suddenly want to take their money out of a bank
a situation when many people suddenly want to buy something

examples.en: There's been a run on barbecues with the hot weather.
examples.zh: 天气酷热，烤肉架生意火爆。

senses.def: the way things usually happen; the way things seem to be happening on a particular occasion

examples.en: In the normal run of things the only exercise he gets is climbing in and out of taxis.
examples.zh: 他平时的唯一运动就是上下出租车。

examples.en: Wise scored in the 15th minute against the run of play (= although the other team had seemed more likely to score).
examples.zh: 怀斯在比赛进行到第 15 分钟的时候出人意料地得分。

senses.def: a sloping track used in skiing and some other sports
senses.zh: （滑雪或其他运动中的）坡道，滑道

examples.en: a ski/toboggan run
examples.zh: 滑雪道；雪橇滑道

senses.def: a point scored in the game of cricket

examples.en: Our team won by four runs.
examples.zh: 我们队以四分的优势取胜。

senses.def: an act of trying to get elected to public office

examples.en: He made an unsuccessful run for governor in 2008.
examples.zh: 2008 年他竞选州长失败。

examples.en: Senator Blake's run for the presidency
examples.zh: 布莱克参议员竞选总统

senses.def: an area with a fence, walls, etc. in which animals or birds are kept as pets or on a farm

examples.en: a chicken run
examples.zh: 养鸡场

senses.def: a series of notes sung or played quickly up or down the scale
a series of cards held by one player
senses.group: in card games 纸牌游戏

senses.def: a long thin hole in tights
senses.zh: （紧身裤袜或长筒袜的）滑丝，抽丝

senses.def: diarrhoea
the average type of something

examples.en: He was very different from the general run of movie stars.
examples.zh: 他和一般的电影明星迥然不同。

senses.def: to make somebody try very hard, using all their skill and effort, in order to beat you in a game or competition
senses.zh: 不让…轻易取胜；与…进行激烈竞争

senses.def: to give somebody/get/have permission to make full use of something
senses.zh: 允许某人充分使用；获准充分使用

examples.en: Her dogs have the run of the house.
examples.zh: 她的狗可以在家里自由活动。

senses.def: relating to a longer period in the future

examples.en: This measure inevitably means higher taxes in the long run.
examples.zh: 从长远来看这项措施的结果免不了要多纳税。

senses.def: relating to the immediate future

examples.en: In the short run, unemployment may fall.
examples.zh: 从短期来看，失业率可能降低。

senses.def: trying to avoid being captured

examples.en: He's on the run from the police.
examples.zh: 他在躲避警方的追捕。

examples.en: The prisoners have now been on the run for three days.
examples.zh: 那些囚犯已在逃3 天了。

senses.def: continuously active and moving around

examples.en: I've been on the run all day and I'm exhausted.
examples.zh: 我忙了一整天，累极了。

examples.en: Here are some quick recipes for when you're eating on the run (= in a hurry).
examples.zh: 这是一些供匆忙用餐时用的快餐食谱。

examples.en: I usually eat breakfast on the run.
examples.zh: 我常常是边走边吃早饭。

note.en: Most idioms containing run are at the entries for the nouns and adjectives in the idioms, for example run riot is at riot.
note.zh: 大多数含 run 的习语，都可在该等习语中的名词及形容词相关词条找到，如 run riot 在词条 riot 下。

senses.def: to be pleased to do what somebody wants
senses.zh: 赶紧做某人喜欢的事；急于应某人的要求

examples.en: She knew she had only to call and he would come running.
examples.zh: 她知道只要打个电话，他就会高高兴兴地照办。

examples.zh: 我们不久就将音响系统启用了。

senses.def: to be or put yourself in a situation in which something bad could happen to you

examples.en: People who are overweight run a risk of a heart attack or stroke.
examples.zh: 超重的人有犯心脏病和中风的危险。

examples.en: We don't want to run the risk of losing their business.
examples.zh: 我们不想冒险失去他们的生意。

examples.en: Investment is all about running risks.
examples.zh: 投资就是要冒风险。

run a/the risk (of something/of doing so.word: run a/the risk (of something/of doing something) | run risks

senses.def: to do something that is not allowed by a law or rule, or to do something that people in authority think is bad
senses.zh: （与法律、规章、当权者等）相抵触，有冲突

examples.en: to run afoul of the law
examples.zh: 违犯法律

senses.def: to suddenly become very angry or excited and start behaving violently, especially in a public place
senses.zh: （尤指在公共场所）发狂，狂暴，疯狂

examples.en: The media called for an investigation into claims that the army had run amok.
examples.zh: 媒体呼吁对有关军队胡作非为的说法进行调查。

senses.def: to be very busy and active trying to do something, but not very organized, with the result that you do not succeed

run around like a headless chicken.word: run around like a headless chicken

senses.def: to do things that are difficult, without learning the basic skills first
senses.zh: 不会走就跑；没掌握基本功就做难事

senses.def: if a sports team tries to run down/out the clock
senses.zh: 消耗掉剩余的比赛时间（比赛接近结束时，球队不想进球而只设法控制住球，以阻止对方进球得分）

senses.def: to stop supplying water; to be all used so that none is left

examples.en: The wells in most villages in the region have run dry.
examples.zh: 这个地区多数村庄的水井都已干涸。

examples.en: Vaccine supplies started to run dry as the flu outbreak reached epidemic proportions.
examples.zh: 流感爆发并大肆流行，疫苗供应开始枯竭。

examples.en: Our resources of scientific talent and ingenuity have not run dry.
examples.zh: 我们的科学人才和独创性资源并未枯竭。

senses.def: to run in order to escape from somebody/something
to be allowed to go where it likes; not tied to anything or kept in a cage
senses.zh: 四处自由走动；未关起来；未受束缚

examples.en: Horses should be able to run free on large plots of land.
examples.zh: 马应该能够在大片土地上自由奔跑。

senses.def: to be strong and angry or excited

examples.en: Feelings ran high as the election approached.
examples.zh: 选举临近，大家情绪都很激动。

senses.def: to be a common feature in a particular family
senses.zh: 为一家人所共有；世代相传

examples.en: Heart disease runs in the family.
examples.zh: 这家人都有心脏病。

examples.en: a medical condition which runs in the family
examples.zh: 家族遗传的疾病

senses.def: to clear the way for the player with the ball by blocking players from the other team
senses.zh: 掩护阻挡（为己方持球队员让出道路）

senses.def: to help somebody by dealing with problems for them so that they do not need to deal with them

examples.en: You have plenty of friends that can always run interference for you.
examples.zh: 你有很多朋友可以随时为你进行干扰。

senses.def: to talk too much, in a way that is not sensible
senses.zh: 夸夸其谈；信口开河；喋喋不休

senses.def: to lose energy and enthusiasm and stop doing something, or do it less well
to be much better at doing something than somebody else
senses.zh: 做事远比某人好；遥遥领先

examples.en: I used to beat my son at chess but now he runs rings around me.
examples.zh: 我曾经在国际象棋中打败过我的儿子，但现在他围着我跑。

senses.def: to behave in a way that is violent and/or not under control

examples.en: They let their kids run riot.
examples.zh: 他们听任自己的孩子撒野。

examples.en: Local youths ran riot after the attack.
examples.zh: 攻击事件发生后，当地青年开始闹事。

senses.def: if your imagination, a feeling, etc. runs riot
senses.zh: （指想象、情感等）任意发挥，奔放

examples.en: An artist must learn to let his imagination run riot.
examples.zh: 艺术家必须学会让他的想象力尽情发挥。

examples.en: These prejudices have been allowed to run riot for too long.
examples.zh: 这些偏见已经被允许肆虐太久了。

senses.def: to grow and spread quickly

run risks: @@@LINK=run a/the risk (of something/of doing something) | run risks

senses.def: to treat somebody badly and not worry about their feelings
senses.zh: （对某人）为所欲为，横行霸道；任意蹂躏

senses.def: to be busy doing something without achieving anything important or making progress
to make somebody do a lot of work or make a big effort so that they become tired

examples.en: For 20 minutes the other team ran us ragged.
examples.zh: 20分钟内，对方队伍把我们弄得焦头烂额。

senses.def: to be nearly as good, fast, successful, etc. as somebody/something else

examples.en: Germany ran Argentina very close in the final.
examples.zh: 在决赛中，德国队发挥得几乎和阿根廷队一样出色。

senses.def: to make somebody work so hard that they are no longer able to work; to use something so much that it is broken
senses.zh: 使某人精疲力竭；耗尽某物；过度使用某物

senses.def: to find somebody/something after looking hard for a long time
to be criticized or attacked by a lot of people, especially a group of people that you have to walk through
senses.zh: 受严厉谴责；受夹道攻击

examples.en: Some of the witnesses had to run the gauntlet of television cameras and reporters.
examples.zh: 一些证人不得不穿过众多电视摄像机和记者的围堵。

examples.zh: 他很潇洒地朝皮帕点头致意。

senses.def: the action of raising your right hand to the side of your head as a sign of respect, especially between soldiers and officers
senses.zh: （尤指士兵和军官之间的）敬礼

examples.en: He returned the salute as he passed the line of guards.
examples.zh: 当他穿过警卫队时，他回敬了一个礼。

senses.def: a thing that you say or do to show that you respect and admire somebody/something or to welcome somebody

examples.en: He raised his hat as a friendly salute.
examples.zh: 他举帽亲切致意。

examples.en: His first words were a salute to the people of South Africa.
examples.zh: 他开口首先向南非人民致敬。

examples.en: The occasion was organized as a salute to a century of change.
examples.zh: 此次活动旨在向一个世纪的变革致敬。

examples.en: They all raised their glasses in salute.
examples.zh: 他们都举杯致意。

examples.en: The retiring editor received a special salute from the local newspaper.
examples.zh: 那位即将退休的编辑获得了这家地方报社的特别致敬。

senses.def: an official occasion when guns are fired into the air to show respect for an important person

examples.en: a 21-gun salute
examples.zh: 鸣炮 21 响的礼仪

senses.def: when an officer or important person takes the salute
senses.zh: （高级军官在阅兵时）接受敬礼，行答礼

examples.en: The Queen took the salute as the guardsmen marched past.
examples.zh: 卫兵队列经过时，女王接受了他们的敬礼。

senses.def: when an officer or important person takes the salute
senses.zh: （高级军官在阅兵时）接受敬礼，行答礼

examples.en: The Queen took the salute as the guardsmen marched past.
examples.zh: 卫兵队列经过时，女王接受了他们的敬礼。

senses.def: (a person) from El Salvador
senses.zh: 萨尔瓦多人；萨尔瓦多的；萨尔瓦多人的

senses.def: the act of saving things that have been, or are likely to be, damaged or lost, especially in a disaster or an accident

examples.en: the salvage of the wrecked tanker
examples.zh: 对失事油轮的打捞

examples.en: a salvage company/operation/team
examples.zh: 打捞公司；营救行动；抢救队

senses.def: the things that are saved from a disaster or an accident

examples.en: an exhibition of the salvage from the wreck
examples.zh: 沉船打捞物品展览

senses.def: to save a badly damaged ship, etc. from being lost completely; to save parts or property from a damaged ship or from a fire, etc.
senses.zh: 打捞，营救（失事船舶等）；抢救（失事船舶、火灾等中的财物）

examples.en: The wreck was salvaged by a team from the RAF.
examples.zh: 失事船只被英国皇家空军救援小组打捞起来了。

examples.en: The house was built using salvaged materials.
examples.zh: 这栋房子是用回收的废旧材料建成的。

examples.en: We only managed to salvage two paintings from the fire.
examples.zh: 我们只从火灾中抢救出两幅画。

senses.def: to manage to rescue something from a difficult situation; to stop a bad situation from being a complete failure

examples.en: What can I do to salvage my reputation? (= get a good reputation again)
examples.zh: 我怎样才能挽回我的名声呢？

examples.en: He wondered what he could do to salvage the situation.
examples.zh: 他不知道怎样才能挽救这个局面。

examples.en: United lost 5–2, salvaging a little pride with two late goals.
examples.zh: 联队以 2:5 失利，只靠后来两粒进球挽回了一点面子。

senses.def: a place where old machines, cars, etc. are broken up so that the metal can be sold or used again
senses.zh: （废旧机器、旧车等拆售的）废品回收场

examples.en: salvage yards with cars that are being sold for parts
examples.zh: 拆卸汽车出售零部件的废品场

senses.def: a way of protecting somebody from danger, disaster, loss, etc.
senses.zh: （危险、灾难、损失等的）避免方式，解救途径

examples.en: Group therapy classes have been his salvation.
examples.zh: 他一直靠参加集体治疗小组来调节心理。

senses.def: the state of being saved from the power of evil

examples.en: to pray for the salvation of the world
examples.zh: 为世人得救而祷告

examples.en: The medieval Church believed in salvation through faith and works.
examples.zh: 中世纪基督教会相信通过信德与善行争取灵魂得救。

examples.en: salvation from sin
examples.zh: 从罪恶中得到拯救

senses.def: a substance that you put on a wound or painful skin to help it to get better or to protect it
to do something that makes you feel less guilty
senses.zh: 使良心得到宽慰；减轻内疚感

examples.en: He took them presents to salve his conscience.
examples.zh: 他拿了他们的礼物来安慰自己的良心。

senses.def: a large plate, usually made of metal, on which drinks or food are served at a formal event
senses.zh: 金属托盘（正式场合用于上饮料或食物）

examples.en: a silver salver
examples.zh: 银托盘

examples.en: The winner will receive an engraved salver as a trophy.
examples.zh: 获胜者将获得一个雕刻托盘作为奖杯。

senses.def: the act of firing several guns or dropping several bombs, etc. at the same time; a sudden attack

examples.en: The first salvo exploded a short distance away.
examples.zh: 第一批投下的炸弹在不远处爆炸。

examples.en: The newspaper article was the opening salvo in what proved to be a long battle.
examples.zh: 报上那篇文章是一场长期论战的开篇第一炮。

senses.def: light loose trousers that are tight around the ankles, sometimes worn by South Asian women

examples.en: a salwar kameez (= a salwar worn with a kameez)
examples.zh: 宽松裤克米兹套装

senses.def: a first name for boys or girls, short for Samuel
senses.zh: 山姆（男子或女子名，Samuel 或 Samantha 缩写）

senses.def: (1851-78) a US outlaw
senses.zh: 萨姆·巴斯（Sam Bass）：（1851-78）被称为“德克萨斯州罗宾汉”的美国'徒。在成为不法分子之前，他是一个牛仔。1877年，他的团伙从内布拉斯加州的火车上偷走了6万美元，这是当时历史上最大的火车抢劫案。巴斯被枪击后第二年死亡。

senses.def: a type of leather belt with a strap
senses.zh: 萨姆·布朗（Sam Browne）：一种皮带，其皮带从左侧穿过右肩，由英国军官，某些警官等佩戴。

senses.def: (1935-64) a US singer and writer of soul
senses.zh: 萨姆·库克（Sam Cooke）：（1935-64）是美国歌手和灵魂音乐作家。他最著名的歌曲是《 You Send Me》（1957年）。库克被一名无辜的妇女杀害，因为她正在为自己辩护。

senses.def: (1793-1863) a US military and political leader. He helped Texas
senses.zh: 萨姆·休斯顿（1793-1863）：美国军事和政治领导人。他帮助德克萨斯州从墨西哥获得独立，在圣哈辛托战役中击败了墨西哥军队。休斯顿成为得克萨斯共和国的第一任总统，得克萨斯州成为州之后，他代表美国参议员（1846-59）。他还当选德克萨斯州州长，但由于不想让德克萨斯州加入同盟国而被迫离职。

senses.def: (1925-85) a US film director who was sometimes criticized for the amount of realistic violence shown in his films. These include Major Dundee
senses.zh: 萨姆·佩金帕（Sam Peckinpah）：（1925-85）美国电影导演，有时因其电影中表现出的现实暴力而受到批评。其中包括邓迪少校（1965年），狂野束，稻草狗（1971年），帕特·加勒特和小孩子比利（1973年）以及奥斯特曼周末（1983年）。

senses.def: (1943-2017) a US actor who also wrote and directed plays and films. His play Buried Child
senses.zh: 山姆·谢泼德（Sam Shepard）：（1943-2017）是一位美国演员，他还撰写和导演戏剧和电影。他的戏剧《埋葬的孩子》（1978年）获得了普利策奖，并撰写了诸如得克萨斯州的巴黎（1984年）和《寂静的舌头》（1994年）等电影。他的演员电影包括《正确的东西》（1983），《犯罪的心》（1986）和《鹈鹕简介》（1993）。

senses.def: (1912-2002) one of the most successful US golf players in the 1940s and 1950s, also known as 'Slammin' Sam' because he hit the ball so far. He won the PGA
senses.zh: 萨姆·斯内德（Sam Snead）：（1912-2002）是1940年代和1950年代美国最成功的高尔夫选手之一，也被称为“ Slammin” Sam。他三度（1942、1949和1951）夺得PGA冠军，三度（1949、1952和1954）夺得美国大师赛冠军。

senses.def: a character created in 1930 by the US writer Dashiell Hammett
senses.zh: 萨姆·斯佩德（Sam Spade）：1930年由美国作家达希尔·哈米特（Dashiell Hammett）在他的《马耳他猎鹰》一书中创作。黑桃是一个坚强但诚实的私人侦探。Hammett还为《 Black Mask》杂志撰写了Sam Spade的故事。

senses.def: (1919-93) a US actor who also directed films and plays. He settled in England in 1951 and worked for many years on a plan to build a copy of the Globe
senses.zh: 萨姆·瓦纳梅克（Sam Wanamaker）：（1919-93）美国演员，还导演电影和戏剧。他于1951年在英国定居，并为制定伦敦伦敦环球剧院的复制品计划工作了多年。他去世后就完成了。他的女儿是演员佐伊·瓦纳梅克（Zoe Wanamaker）。

senses.def: a special building made to hold the dead body of an important person or to remind people of that person
senses.zh: 三摩地（samadhi）：一种特殊的建筑物，用来容纳重要人物的尸体或使人们想起那个人物

senses.def: a first name for girls
a person who gives help and sympathy to people who need it
senses.zh: 善良的撒马利亚人；善人；乐善好施者

senses.def: a chemical element. Samarium
a fast dance originally from Brazil; a piece of music for this dance
senses.zh: 桑巴舞（源于巴西，节奏快）；桑巴舞曲

senses.def: a spicy sauce made with chillies
senses.zh: 咖喱饭调味品，桑巴尔酱

examples.en: Each table had a small pot of sambal on it.
examples.zh: 每张桌子上都有一小锅参巴酱。

examples.en: In Thai cuisine mint is used to counteract the heat of fiery sambals.
examples.zh: 在泰国菜中，薄荷被用来中和辣椒酱的热量。

senses.def: a spicy South Indian dish consisting of lentils
senses.zh: 水鹿：由扁豆和蔬菜组成的南印度辣菜

examples.en: Rice and sambar were cooked for the schoolchildren.
examples.zh: 为学童们准备了米饭和水鹿。

examples.en: The menu includes curries, sambar, dal, chutney and rice.
examples.zh: 菜单包括咖喱、水鹿、木豆、酸辣酱和米饭。

senses.def: exactly the one or ones referred to or mentioned; not different

examples.en: We have lived in the same house for twenty years.
examples.zh: 我们在同一座房子里住了二十年了。

examples.en: Our children go to the same school as theirs.
examples.zh: 我们的孩子和他们的孩子上同一所学校。

examples.en: She's still the same fun-loving person that I knew at college.
examples.zh: 她仍爱耍爱闹，还是上大学时的那副老样子。

examples.en: This one works in exactly the same way as the other.
examples.zh: 这个跟那个运转方法完全一样。

examples.en: They promise to meet again in the exact same place six months later.
examples.zh: 他们承诺六个月后在同一个地方再次见面。

examples.en: They both said much the same thing.
examples.zh: 他们两人的话大致一样。

examples.en: He used the very same (= exactly the same) words.
examples.zh: 他用了完全相同的字眼儿。

examples.en: I resigned last Friday and left that same day.
examples.zh: 我上星期五辞了职，当天就离开了。

examples.en: I was relieved and sad at the same time.
examples.zh: 我感到既宽慰又难过。

examples.en: Gary and I look more or less the same age.
examples.zh: 加里和我看起来年龄差不多。

examples.en: I recognized a lot of the same people.
examples.zh: 我认出了很多同样的人。

senses.def: exactly like the one or ones referred to or mentioned

examples.en: I bought the same car as yours (= another car of that type).
examples.zh: 我买了一辆车，和你那辆一模一样。

examples.en: She was wearing the same dress that I had on.
examples.zh: 她穿的连衣裙和我穿的一样。

examples.en: The same thing happened to me last week.
examples.zh: 上星期我也遇到了同样的事。

examples.en: Most parents tend to raise their children in much the same way they were raised
examples.zh: 大多数父母倾向于以与他们被抚养长大的方式大致相同的方式抚养他们的孩子

examples.en: Other countries don't suffer from the same kinds of health problems we do.
examples.zh: 其他国家没有遭受与我们相同的健康问题。

examples.en: Older adults may not get the same level of protection from the vaccine.
examples.zh: 老年人可能无法从疫苗中获得相同水平的保护。

senses.def: used to say that a situation has not changed at all

examples.en: ‘How's it going?’ ‘Oh, same old, same old.’
examples.zh: “情况怎么样？”“哦，还是老样子。”

senses.def: used to say that a situation or the excuses, products or entertainment being offered have not improved at all
senses.zh: 老样子；老一套；老生常谈

examples.en: It's the same old story —budget cuts and government neglect.
examples.zh: 还是那一套——预算削减和政府不作为。

examples.en: The band's new album includes the same old stuff they've been playing forever.
examples.zh: 乐队的新专辑包含了他们一直在演奏的老东西。

senses.def: the same thing or things

examples.en: I would do the same again.
examples.zh: 我愿再做同样的事。

examples.en: I think the same as you do about this.
examples.zh: 在这件事上，我的想法和你一样。

examples.en: Just do the same as me (= as I do).
examples.zh: 跟着我做就行了。

examples.en: His latest movie is just more of the same—exotic locations, car chases and a final shoot-out.
examples.zh: 他的最新影片只不过是老一套，异国的场景、追车场面，最后一场枪战把对手干掉。

examples.en: ‘I'll have coffee.’ ‘Same for me, please (= I will have one too).’
examples.zh: “我喝咖啡。”“我也来一杯。”

senses.def: having the same number, colour, size, quality, etc.
senses.zh: （数目、颜色、大小、质量等）相同，一样

examples.en: There are several brands and they're not all the same.
examples.zh: 有好几个品牌，不一样的。

examples.en: I'd like one the same as yours.
examples.zh: 我要一个和你一样的。

senses.def: the same person

examples.en: ‘Was that George on the phone?’ ‘The same (= yes, it was George).’
examples.zh: “是跟乔治通的电话吗？”“正是。”

senses.def: despite this

examples.en: He's not very reliable, but I like him just the same.
examples.zh: 他不太可靠，但我还是喜欢他。

examples.en: ‘Will you stay for lunch?’ ‘No, but thanks all the same.’
examples.zh: “留下来吃午饭，好吗？”“不了，多谢。”

examples.en: All the same, there's some truth in what she says.
examples.zh: 尽管如此，她说的还是有些道理的。

senses.def: to not be important to somebody
senses.zh: 对某人无关紧要（或无所谓）

examples.en: It's all the same to me whether we eat now or later.
examples.zh: 我们现在吃也行，过一会儿吃也行。我无所谓。

examples.en: I'd rather stay here, if it's all the same to you.
examples.zh: 我宁愿待在这里，如果你无所谓的话。

senses.def: the same person or thing

examples.en: It turns out that her aunt and my cousin are one and the same.
examples.zh: 原来她姑妈就是我表姐。

examples.en: In his work, form and meaning are one and the same.
examples.zh: 在他的作品中，形式和意义密不可分。

senses.def: used to ask somebody to serve you the same drink as before

examples.en: Same again, please!
examples.zh: 和刚才一样的，请再来一份！

senses.def: used to say that something is also true of you

examples.en: ‘I can't wait to see it.’ ‘Same here.’
examples.zh: “我巴不得马上看到它。”“我也一样。”

senses.def: used to answer a greeting
senses.zh: （回应问候、冒犯的话等）你也一样

examples.en: ‘Happy Christmas!’ ‘And the same to you!’
examples.zh: “圣诞快乐！”“也祝你圣诞快乐！”

examples.en: ‘Get lost!’ ‘Same to you!’

senses.def: in the same way

examples.en: We treat boys exactly the same as girls.
examples.zh: 男孩、女孩我们完全同等对待。

examples.en: He gave me five dollars, same as usual.
examples.zh: 和平时一样，他给了我五美元。

note.en: Most idioms containing same are at the entries for the nouns and verbs in the idioms, for example be in the same boat is at boat.
note.zh: 大多数含 same 的习语，都可在该等习语中的名词及动词相关词条找到，如 be in the same boat 在词条 boat 下。

senses.def: used to say that a situation has not changed at all

examples.zh: “情况怎么样？”“哦，还是老样子。”
