examples.en: a second-class education
examples.zh: 二流的教育

senses.def: connected with the less expensive way of travelling on a train, ship, etc.

examples.en: second-class carriages/compartments/passengers
examples.zh: 二等车厢／隔间／车厢乘客

senses.def: (in the UK) connected with letters, packages, etc. that you pay less to send and that are delivered less quickly
senses.zh: 第二类的（英国邮件等级，投递较第一类慢，邮资也较低）

examples.en: second-class letters/stamps
examples.zh: 第二类信件；第二类邮件所贴的邮票

senses.def: (in the US) connected with the system of sending newspapers and magazines by mail
senses.zh: 第二类的（美国邮件等级，用于投递报刊）

senses.def: used to describe a British university degree which is good but not of the highest class

examples.en: Applicants should have at least a second-class honours degree.
examples.zh: 申请者须有二等以上学位。

senses.def: a child of a cousin of your mother or father
senses.zh: 父母表兄弟（或姐妹）的孩子；父母堂兄弟（或姐妹）的孩子

senses.def: murder, etc. that is less serious than first-degree
senses.zh: 二级（谋杀、人身侵犯或入室盗窃等罪，严重程度低于一级）

senses.def: burns of the second most serious of three kinds, causing blisters
used to describe people who were born in the country they live in but whose parents came to live there from another country

examples.en: She was a second-generation Japanese-American.
examples.zh: 她是第二代日裔美国人。

senses.def: at a more advanced stage of development than an earlier form
senses.zh: 第二代的（更先进或改进了的）

examples.en: second-generation handheld computers
examples.zh: 第二代掌上电脑

senses.def: to guess what somebody will do before they do it; to guess how you will feel in the future

examples.en: It was impossible to second-guess the decision of the jury.
examples.zh: 陪审团的决定不可能预测。

examples.en: It's one of the toughest decisions you'll ever make and you may still be second-guessing yourself .
examples.zh: 这是您做过的最艰难的决定之一，您可能仍在事后怀疑自己。

senses.def: to criticize somebody after a decision has been made; to criticize something after it has happened
senses.zh: 事后批评（或品评）；耍事后聪明

senses.def: the hand on some watches and clocks that shows seconds
not new; owned by somebody else before

examples.en: a second-hand bookshop (= for selling second-hand books)
examples.zh: 旧书店

examples.zh: 二手车

senses.def: learned from other people, not from your own experience

examples.en: second-hand opinions
examples.zh: 来自他人的观点

examples.en: I bought the camera second-hand.
examples.zh: 我买的这架照相机是二手货。

senses.def: if you learn something second-hand

examples.en: I only heard about it second-hand.
examples.zh: 我只是听别人说的。

senses.def: smoke that is breathed in from other people smoking around you

examples.en: The smoking ban protects non-smokers from second-hand smoke.
examples.zh: 禁烟令可以保护非吸烟者免受二手烟的侵害。

senses.def: a house or flat that somebody owns as well as their main home and uses, for example, for holidays
a place where somebody now lives and which they know as well as, and like as much as, the place where they grew up

examples.en: I was born in New York but France is my second home.
examples.zh: 我出生在纽约，但法国是我的第二故乡。

senses.def: a person who has the second highest rank in a group and takes charge when the leader is not there

examples.en: For twenty years he served the business as second in command to his father.
examples.zh: 二十年来，他一直担任父亲的二把手，为公司服务。

examples.en: his second in command, Major Thursby
examples.zh: 他的副手瑟斯比少校

examples.en: She is second in command.
examples.zh: 她是二把手。

senses.def: a language that somebody learns to speak well and that they use for work or at school, but that is not the language they learned first

examples.en: ESL or English as a Second Language
examples.zh: ESL——作为第二语言的英语

senses.def: the learning of a second language
an officer of lower rank in the army or the US air force
senses.zh: 陆军少尉；（美国）空军少尉

senses.def: a virtual world
senses.zh: 第二人生（玩家可交流、玩游戏和假装过另一种生活的互联网虚拟世界）

senses.def: a family name or surname
a second personal name or middle name

examples.en: His second name is Willem, after his grandfather.
examples.zh: 他的中间名是威廉，取自他祖父的名字。

senses.def: something that you do very easily and naturally, because it is part of your character or you have done it so many times

examples.zh: 他发现教学是他的第二天性。

not very good or impressive

examples.en: a second-rate player
examples.zh: 平庸的运动员

senses.zh: 二读（向英国议会提交议案的第二阶段，下一阶段通常是辩论）

examples.zh: 该应用程序允许用户将他们的设备用作第二个屏幕，提供有关他们在电视上观看的电影的更多信息。

examples.en: a second-screen app

examples.en: a second-screen experience
examples.zh: 第二屏幕体验

senses.def: to use a mobile device while watching television, especially to access additional content or apps
senses.zh: 使用第二屏幕（在看电视时使用移动设备，尤指登入其他内容或应用程序）

examples.en: Many people are now second-screening on their mobile devices to find out more about what they're watching on TV.
examples.zh: 现在许多人用移动设备作为第二屏幕，更深入地了解电视上看到的内容。

senses.def: the ability that some people seem to have to know or see what will happen in the future or what is happening in a different place

examples.en: United's second string were in Reserve Cup action last night.
examples.zh: 联队的替补队员昨晚参加了后备队杯赛。

examples.en: Wilson was a second string for New Zealand in last week's match.
examples.zh: 在上周的比赛中，威尔逊是新西兰队的替补队员。

senses.def: only used occasionally where somebody/something else is not available

examples.en: a second-string quarterback
examples.zh: 替补四分卫

senses.def: new energy that makes you able to continue with something that had made you tired
senses.zh: 恢复的精力；重振的精神；缓过劲来的状况

senses.def: in a way that is less important than something else or happens as a result of something else
senses.zh: 其次：以一种不如其他事物重要或由于其他事物发生的方式

examples.en: Their clothing is primarily functional and only secondarily decorative.
examples.zh: 他们的衣服首重实用，其次才讲款式。

senses.def: connected with teaching children of 11–18 years

examples.en: secondary teachers
examples.zh: 中学教师

examples.en: the secondary curriculum
examples.zh: 中学课程

senses.def: less important than something else

examples.en: That is just a secondary consideration.
examples.zh: 那只不过是次要的考虑因素。

examples.en: Experience is what matters—age is of secondary importance.
examples.zh: 重要的是经验，年龄是次要的。

examples.en: Raising animals was only secondary to other forms of farming.
examples.zh: 与其他农业生产相对而言，饲养牲畜只是副业。

examples.en: After a while, his writing became secondary to his celebrity.
examples.zh: 过了一段时间，他的写作变得次要于他的名气。

examples.en: Forests are secondary in importance only to the oceans in their effects on the earth.
examples.zh: 就其对地球的影响而言，森林的重要性仅次于海洋。

examples.en: The characters and plot become secondary to the setting and atmosphere.
examples.zh: 人物和情节变得次要于背景和氛围。

senses.def: happening as a result of something else
senses.zh: 间接引发的；继发性的；次生的

examples.en: a secondary infection
examples.zh: 继发感染

examples.en: a secondary effect
examples.zh: 间接结果

examples.en: a secondary colour (= made from mixing two primary colours)
examples.zh: 次色

examples.en: a secondary outcome
examples.zh: 次要结果

senses.def: education for children between the ages of 11 and 18

examples.en: primary and secondary education
examples.zh: 小学和中学教育

senses.def: the section of industry that uses raw materials
senses.zh: 第二产业（用原材料生产商品的产业）

senses.zh: 现代中等学校（20 世纪 70 年代以前英国一种中学，招收未考入文法学校的 11 至 16 岁学生）

senses.def: the act of preventing workers who are not involved in a strike from supplying goods to the company where the strike is held
senses.zh: 二级纠察封锁（阻止未参加罢工的工人向公司供应货物）

a book or other source of information where the writer has taken the information from some other source and not collected it himself or herself
the second strongest stress that is put on a syllable in a word or a phrase when it is spoken
a person who seconds
used to introduce the second of a list of points you want to make in a speech or piece of writing

examples.en: Firstly, it's expensive, and secondly, it's too slow.
examples.zh: 首先是价格贵，其次，速度太慢。

examples.en: First of all, there's no time to do all this, and secondly, it's the wrong thing to be doing anyway.
examples.zh: 首先，没有时间做这一切，其次，无论如何，这样做都是错误的。

examples.en: Secondly, and importantly, cultural influences on behaviour are discussed.
examples.zh: 其次，也是重要的，讨论了文化对行为的影响。

senses.def: a short period of time when an employee is sent to another department, office, etc. in order to do a different job

examples.en: They met while she was on secondment from the Foreign Office.
examples.zh: 两人是在她从外交部调来短期任职时认识的。

senses.def: the fact of making sure that nothing is known about something; the state of being secret

examples.en: the need for absolute secrecy in this matter
examples.zh: 在这件事情上绝对保密的必要性

examples.en: Everyone involved was sworn to secrecy.
examples.zh: 所有相关人员均被要求宣誓保密。

examples.en: The whole affair is still shrouded in secrecy.
examples.zh: 整个事件依旧秘而不宣。

senses.def: known about by only a few people; kept hidden from others
senses.zh: 秘密的；保密的；外人不得而知的

examples.en: secret information/meetings/talks
examples.zh: 秘密信息／会议／会谈

examples.en: They belong to an age-old secret society.
examples.zh: 他们属于一个古老的秘密社团。

examples.en: He tried to keep it secret from his family.
examples.zh: 这件事他试图瞒着家里。

examples.en: Details of the proposals remain secret.
examples.zh: 提议的细节仍不得而知。

examples.en: a secret passage leading to the beach
examples.zh: 通往海滩的秘密通道

examples.en: The two candidates were chosen by a secret ballot (= in which nobody knows how you voted) of MPs.
examples.zh: 这两名候选人是通过议员无记名投票（=没有人知道你是如何投票的）选出的。

examples.en: He's a natural salesman, whose secret weapon is the sheer confidence and optimism that he exudes.
examples.zh: 他是一个天生的推销员，他的秘密武器就是他所流露出的纯粹的自信和乐观。

examples.en: The group is on a highly secret mission.
examples.zh: 该小组正在执行一项高度机密的任务。

examples.en: Secret police documents were leaked to the press.
examples.zh: 秘密警察的文件被泄露给媒体。

examples.en: The scandal was kept secret from the French public for 18 years.
examples.zh: 这起丑闻向法国公众隐瞒了 18 年。

examples.en: What could be so secret that it had to stay hidden?
examples.zh: 有什么秘密如此秘密以至于必须隐藏起来？

senses.zh: （指行为与习惯）暗中进行的，未公开的，隐秘的

examples.en: He's a secret drinker.
examples.zh: 他偷偷地喝酒。

examples.en: I didn't know you were a secret football fan.
examples.zh: 我不知道你私下里还是个足球迷。

examples.en: her secret fears
examples.zh: 她内心的担忧

examples.zh: 也许他心里暗暗希望她能回到他身边。

senses.def: liking to have secrets that other people do not know about; showing this

examples.en: They were so secret about everything.
examples.zh: 他们无论对什么都那样神秘兮兮的。

examples.en: Jessica caught a secret smile flitting between the two of them.
examples.zh: 杰西卡看见他们俩诡秘地相视一笑。

examples.zh: 你能保守秘密吗？

examples.en: She will not reveal his secret.
examples.zh: 她不会泄露他的秘密。

examples.en: The location of the ship is a closely guarded secret.
examples.zh: 那艘船的位置是高度机密。

examples.en: This bar is one of central London's best/worst kept secrets.
examples.zh: 这个酒吧是伦敦中心区最不为人知／广为人知的地方。

examples.en: Shall we let him in on (= tell him) the secret?
examples.zh: 我们要不要把秘密透露给他？

examples.en: He made no secret of his ambition (= he didn't try to hide it).
examples.zh: 他并没有掩饰自己的雄心壮志。

examples.zh: 他过去的黑暗秘密

examples.en: The dirty little secret of gaming is how much time you spend not having fun.
examples.zh: 游戏的肮脏小秘密是你花了多少时间没有乐趣。

examples.en: Let me tell you a secret.
examples.zh: 让我告诉你一个秘密。

senses.def: the best or only way to achieve something; the way a particular person achieves something

examples.en: She still looks so young. What's her secret?
examples.zh: 她看上去依旧那么年轻，她的保养秘诀是什么呢？

examples.en: Careful planning is the secret of success.
examples.zh: 仔细计划是成功的诀窍。

examples.en: These animals may hold the secret to combating the virus.
examples.zh: 从这些动物身上也许能找到对抗这种病毒的诀窍。

examples.en: The secret to happiness is love.
examples.zh: 幸福的秘诀是爱。

examples.en: What is the secret to their success?
examples.zh: 他们成功的秘诀是什么？

senses.def: a thing that is not yet fully understood or that is difficult to understand

examples.en: the secrets of the universe
examples.zh: 宇宙的奥秘

examples.en: He spent much of his childhood here, learning the secrets of the woods.
examples.zh: 他在这里度过了童年的大部分时间，学习森林的秘密。

senses.def: if something is an open secret
a secret that somebody feels ashamed about
without other people knowing about it

examples.en: The meeting was held in secret.
examples.zh: 会议是秘密召开的。

examples.en: She admired him, in secret of course.
examples.zh: 她当然暗地里钦佩他。

examples.en: The film stars were married in secret to avoid publicity.
examples.zh: 这对影星为了避开公众注意，秘密结了婚。

senses.def: if something is an open secret
a secret that somebody feels ashamed about
without other people knowing about it

examples.en: The meeting was held in secret.

examples.en: The film stars were married in secret to avoid publicity.
examples.zh: 这对影星为了避开公众注意，秘密结了婚。

senses.def: a person who works secretly to obtain information for a government or other organization
a police force that works secretly to make sure that citizens behave as their government wants
an arrangement in which each one of a group of friends or colleagues buys a small Christmas gift for one other person in the group. The person receiving the gift does not know who chose it.
senses.zh: 神秘圣诞老人（朋友或同事之间匿名互送圣诞礼物的活动）

examples.en: Each person can spend up to £10 in the office Secret Santa.
examples.zh: 每人最多可在“秘密圣诞老人”办公室消费 10 英镑。

examples.en: She got his name in the office Secret Santa and she knew nothing about the guy.
examples.zh: 她在秘密圣诞老人办公室里得知了他的名字，但她对这个人一无所知。

senses.def: a government department that is responsible for protecting its government’s military and political secrets and for finding out the secrets of other governments
a small desk
involving or connected with the work of a secretary

examples.en: secretarial work
examples.zh: 文秘工作

senses.def: the department of a large international or political organization which is responsible for running it, especially the office of a secretary general
senses.zh: （大型国际组织、政治组织的）秘书处，书记处

senses.def: a person who works in an office, working for another person, dealing with mail and phone calls, keeping records, arranging meetings with people, etc.

examples.en: a legal/medical secretary
examples.zh: 法律／医务秘书

examples.en: the mayor's press secretary
examples.zh: 市长新闻秘书

examples.en: Please contact my secretary to make an appointment.
examples.zh: 请和我的秘书联系，预约一个时间。

examples.en: He is secretary to the board of governors.
examples.zh: 他是董事会秘书。

senses.def: an official of a club, society, etc. who deals with mail, keeping records and making business arrangements

examples.en: the membership secretary
examples.zh: 组织干事

examples.en: She served as club secretary for 25 years.
examples.zh: 她任俱乐部文书25年。

examples.en: The union's branch secretary said he hoped a solution would be found.
examples.zh: 工会支部书记表示，希望能找到解决办法。

examples.en: secretary to the Jockey Club
examples.zh: 赛马俱乐部干事

senses.def: (in the UK) the head of an important government department
the head of a government department, chosen by the president

examples.en: Secretary of the Treasury
examples.zh: 财政部长

examples.en: She was deputy secretary of agriculture.
examples.zh: 她担任过农业部副秘书。

senses.def: an assistant of a government minister, an ambassador

examples.en: Ms Watson is a former parliamentary secretary to the Minister of Education.
examples.zh: 沃森女士是教育部长的前议会秘书。

senses.def: a thin African bird with long legs that eats snakes
senses.zh: 鹭鹰，蛇鹫（非洲猛禽，长腿，捕食蛇类）

senses.def: the person who is in charge of the department that deals with the running of a large international or political organization
senses.zh: （大型国际或政治组织的）秘书长，总干事，总书记

examples.en: a former secretary general of NATO
examples.zh: 北约前任秘书长

senses.def: (in the UK) the head of an important government department

examples.zh: 教育大臣

examples.en: the Education Secretary
examples.zh: 教育大臣

senses.def: (in the US) the head of the government department that deals with foreign affairs
to produce a liquid substance

examples.en: Insulin is secreted by the pancreas.
examples.zh: 胰岛素是胰腺分泌的。

examples.en: More saliva is secreted while chewing.
examples.zh: 咀嚼时会分泌更多唾液。

senses.def: to hide something, especially something small

examples.en: The drugs were secreted in the lining of his case.
examples.zh: 毒品藏在他的皮箱内衬中。

senses.def: the process by which liquid substances are produced by parts of the body or plants

examples.en: the secretion of bile by the liver
examples.zh: 肝脏分泌胆汁的过程

senses.def: a liquid substance produced by parts of the body or plants

examples.en: bodily secretions
examples.zh: 人体分泌物

senses.def: tending or liking to hide your thoughts, feelings, actions, etc. from other people
senses.zh: 惯于掩藏自己的；不外露的

examples.en: He's very secretive about his work.
examples.zh: 他对自己的工作讳莫如深。

examples.en: The child became secretive and withdrawn.
examples.zh: 那孩子变得内向孤僻。

examples.en: his highly secretive nature
examples.zh: 他讳莫如深的本性

senses.def: in a way that hides your thoughts, feelings, actions, etc. from other people, or that suggests you are doing this

examples.en: She smiled secretively.
examples.zh: 她偷偷地笑了笑。

senses.def: behaviour that hides your thoughts, feelings, actions, etc. from other people
senses.zh: 惯于掩藏自己的；不外露的

senses.def: in a way that is kept hidden from people

examples.en: The police had secretly filmed the conversations.
examples.zh: 警方秘密拍摄了对话过程。

examples.en: She was secretly pleased to see him.
examples.zh: 见到他，她心中窃喜。

senses.def: a small group of people who belong to a particular religion but who have some beliefs or practices which separate them from the rest of the group

examples.en: The Shakers are an American religious sect, founded in the 18th century.
examples.zh: 震颤派是美国的一个宗教派别，创立于18世纪。

senses.def: connected with the differences that exist between groups of people who have different religious views

examples.en: sectarian attacks/violence
examples.zh: 教派攻击／暴力活动

examples.en: attempts to break down the sectarian divide in Northern Ireland
examples.zh: 旨在消除北爱尔兰的宗教派系分歧的努力

senses.def: strong support for one particular religious or political group, especially when this leads to violence between different groups

examples.en: reports of a rise in religious and ethnic sectarianism
examples.zh: 关于宗教和种族派别暴力事件增加的报告

examples.en: victims of sectarianism
examples.zh: 宗派主义的受害者

senses.def: any of the parts into which something is divided

examples.en: That section of the road is still closed.
examples.zh: 那段公路依旧封闭。

examples.en: the tail section of the plane
examples.zh: 飞机的尾部

examples.en: The library has a large biology section.
examples.zh: 这个图书馆有大量的生物学藏书。

senses.def: a separate part of a structure from which the whole can be put together

examples.en: The shed comes in sections that you assemble yourself.
examples.zh: 棚屋以散件出售，需要自己组装。

senses.def: a separate part of a document, book, etc.

examples.en: These issues will be discussed more fully in the next section.
examples.zh: 这些问题将在下一节中有更充分的讨论。

examples.en: the sports section of the newspaper
examples.zh: 报纸的体育版

examples.en: The report has a section on accidents at work.
examples.zh: 报告中有一段谈到工作中的事故问题。

examples.en: The book is divided into four sections.
examples.zh: 本书分为四个部分。

examples.en: It is difficult to navigate from one section of the site to another.
examples.zh: 从网站的一个部分导航到另一部分很困难。

examples.en: Feel free to add your own ideas in the comments section.
examples.zh: 欢迎在评论部分添加您自己的想法。

examples.en: the previous/following/final section
examples.zh: 上一节/下一节/最后一节

examples.en: Section by section, this essay examines and explores the key terms.
examples.zh: 本文逐节检查和探讨关键术语。

senses.def: a separate group within a larger group of people

examples.en: an issue that will affect large sections of the population
examples.zh: 涉及人口中广大阶层的问题

examples.en: the brass section of an orchestra
examples.zh: 管弦乐队的铜管乐器组

examples.en: an area populated largely by the poorer sections of society
examples.zh: 居民以较贫困阶层为主的地区

examples.en: The way he's been treated by certain sections of the media is despicable.
examples.zh: 某些媒体对待他的方式是卑鄙的。

examples.en: We've had meetings with all sections of the community.
examples.zh: 我们与社区各个部门举行了会议。

senses.group: group of people 人的群体

senses.def: a department in an organization, institution, etc.

examples.en: He's the director of the finance section.
examples.zh: 他是财务处处长。

examples.en: the section of the company dealing with customer services
examples.zh: 负责客户服务的公司部门

senses.def: a district of a town, city or county

examples.en: the Dorchester section of Boston
examples.zh: 波士顿的多切斯特区

examples.en: one of the city’s most affluent sections
examples.zh: 该市最富裕的地区之一

senses.def: a measure of land, equal to one square mile
a drawing or diagram of something as it would look if it were cut from top to bottom or from one side to the other

examples.en: The illustration shows a section through a leaf.
examples.zh: 图中所示为叶的剖面。

examples.en: The architect drew the house in section.
examples.zh: 建筑师绘制了房子的剖面图。

examples.en: The surgeon performed a section (= made a cut) on the vein.
examples.zh: 外科医生施行了静脉切开手术。

examples.en: to examine a section from the kidney
examples.zh: 观察肾脏切片

senses.def: to divide body tissue
to cut animal or plant tissue
senses.zh: 做（动物或植物组织的）切片

senses.zh: （依法令精神病人）强制入院治疗

examples.zh: 他因自残而根据《精神健康法》被分院。

senses.group: send to hospital 送往医院

senses.zh: 美国陆军条例第八款（旧时据此开除被认为不适合当兵的军人的军籍）

senses.def: a soldier who has been dismissed from the US army because he is not mentally fit
senses.zh: （由于心理不适而）遭开除军籍的军人

senses.def: to separate an area from a larger one

examples.en: Parts of the town had been sectioned off.
examples.zh: 城市的部分地区被划了出去。

senses.def: connected with one particular group within a community or an organization
senses.zh: （社团或组织中）某群体的，某阶层的

examples.en: the sectional interests of managers and workers
examples.zh: 管理层和广大工人的不同利益

senses.def: made of separate sections

examples.en: a sectional building
examples.zh: 组合式建筑

senses.def: connected with a cross section

examples.en: a sectional drawing
examples.zh: 剖面图

senses.zh: （尤指一国经济的）部门，领域，行业

examples.en: the service/banking/manufacturing/financial sector
examples.zh: 服务业；银行业；制造业；金融业

examples.en: jobs in the agricultural sector
examples.zh: 农业部门的就业机会

examples.en: She works in the voluntary sector (= organizations that do not make a profit).
examples.zh: 她在非营利机构工作。

examples.en: We have seen rapid growth in the services sector.
examples.zh: 我们看到服务业的快速增长。

examples.en: the privileged sectors of society
examples.zh: 社会中受特别优待的行业

senses.def: a part of a particular area, especially an area under military control

examples.en: each sector of the war zone
examples.zh: 战区的每个军控地段

examples.en: The partition of the city meant that members of the same family were living in different sectors.
examples.zh: 城市的分割意味着同一家庭的成员居住在不同的区域。

senses.def: a part of a circle lying between two straight lines drawn from the centre to the edge

senses.zh: （尤指一国经济）部门的，领域的，行业的

examples.en: The party pursued sectoral interests rather than the interests of society as a whole.
examples.zh: 该党追求的是行业利益，而不是社会整体利益。

examples.en: The company continues to make a profit despite sectoral competitiveness.
examples.zh: 尽管存在行业竞争，该公司仍继续盈利。

examples.en: The government is seeking to address sectoral imbalances across the country.
examples.zh: 政府正在寻求解决全国范围内的部门失衡问题。

senses.zh: 现世的；世俗的；非宗教的

examples.en: secular music
examples.zh: 世俗音乐

examples.zh: 我们生活的社会多半是世俗的。

senses.def: living among ordinary people rather than in a religious community
the belief that religion should not be involved in the organization of society, education, etc.
senses.zh: 现世主义，世俗主义（认为社会结构和教育等应排除宗教的影响）

senses.def: holding or showing the belief that religion should not be involved in the organization of society, education, etc.
senses.zh: 现世主义，世俗主义（认为社会结构和教育等应排除宗教的影响）

examples.en: a secularist culture
examples.zh: 世俗主义文化

senses.def: a person who believes that religion should not be involved in the organization of society, education, etc.
senses.zh: 现世主义，世俗主义（认为社会结构和教育等应排除宗教的影响）

examples.en: Most secularists and humanists believe strongly in freedom of religion and belief as long as religion remains a private matter.
examples.zh: 大多数世俗主义者和人文主义者坚信宗教和信仰自由，只要宗教仍然是私人事务。

senses.def: the process of removing the influence or power that religion has over something

examples.en: the secularization of society/education
examples.zh: 社会/教育的世俗化

senses.def: to make something secular
senses.zh: 使现世化；使世俗化；使脱离宗教控制

examples.en: a secularized society
examples.zh: 世俗化社会

senses.def: to obtain or achieve something, especially when this means using a lot of effort
senses.zh: （尤指经过努力）获得，取得，实现

examples.en: to secure a contract/deal/funding
examples.zh: 订立合同；达成协议；获得资金

examples.en: The team managed to secure a place in the finals.
examples.zh: 球队拼得了决赛的一席之地。

examples.en: The team were unable to secure a victory.
examples.zh: 这个队未能获胜。

examples.en: She secured 2 000 votes.
examples.zh: 她获得 2 000 票。

examples.en: The delegation has secured the promise of a ceasefire.
examples.zh: 代表团已获得停火承诺。

examples.en: A production company secured the film rights to the biography.
examples.zh: 一家制作公司获得了该传记的电影版权。

examples.en: They are contract workers unable to secure a full-time position.
examples.zh: 他们是合同工，无法获得全职职位。

examples.en: Retailers will need to pay a higher price in order to secure supplies.
examples.zh: 零售商将需要支付更高的价格才能确保供应。

examples.en: He secured a place for himself at law school.
examples.zh: 他被法学院录取了。

examples.en: He secured himself a place at law school.
examples.zh: 他被法学院录取了。

senses.def: to attach or fasten something so that it does not move

examples.en: She secured the rope firmly to the back of the car.
examples.zh: 她把绳子牢牢地拴在车尾。

examples.en: He secured the boat with a rope.
examples.zh: 他用绳子把船固定住。

examples.en: The tables on board were secured firmly to the floor.
examples.zh: 船上的桌子牢牢地固定在地板上。

senses.def: to protect something so that it is safe and difficult to attack or damage

examples.en: to secure a property against intruders
examples.zh: 保护房产以免外人闯入

examples.en: Have you properly secured your computer from viral attack?
examples.zh: 你有没有妥善地保护电脑不受病毒攻击？

examples.en: a savings plan that will secure your child’s future
examples.zh: 为您孩子的未来提供保障的储蓄计划

examples.en: We must all do everything we can to secure our borders.
examples.zh: 我们都必须尽一切努力保护我们的边界。

examples.en: The windows were secured with locks and bars.
examples.zh: 窗户已经插上栓，上了锁，都关好了。

senses.group: protect from harm 使不受危害

senses.def: to legally agree to give somebody property or goods that are worth the same amount as the money that you have borrowed from them, if you are unable to pay the money back

examples.en: a loan secured on the house
examples.zh: 以房子作抵押的贷款

senses.def: likely to continue or be successful for a long time

examples.en: a secure job/income
examples.zh: 稳定的工作／收入

examples.en: It's not a very secure way to make a living.
examples.zh: 以此谋生终非长久之计。

examples.en: The future of the company looks secure.
examples.zh: 看来公司未来不会有问题。

senses.def: where somebody/something cannot be harmed; that cannot be affected or harmed by something

examples.en: It's important to keep your documents secure.
examples.zh: 保证你的文件安全很重要。

examples.en: Civilians are being evacuated to a secure location.
examples.zh: 平民正在被疏散到安全地点。

examples.en: Parents are primarily concerned with leaving their children in a safe, secure environment.
examples.zh: 家长们主要关心的是把孩子放在一个安全可靠的环境里。

examples.en: Information must be stored so that it is secure from accidental deletion.
examples.zh: 必须把资料保存起来，以免无意中删除。

senses.def: feeling happy and confident about yourself or a particular situation

examples.en: At last they were able to feel secure about the future.
examples.zh: 他们终于觉得不必为将来而担忧了。

examples.en: She finished the match, secure in the knowledge that she was through to the next round.
examples.zh: 她打完比赛，知道自己已进入下一轮，心里踏实了。

examples.en: She felt safe and secure in his arms.
examples.zh: 在他的臂弯里她感觉很安全。

examples.en: I would like to be financially secure by age 55.
examples.zh: 我希望在 55 岁时获得经济保障。

senses.def: guarded and/or made stronger so that it is difficult for people to enter or leave
senses.zh: 严密把守的；牢固的；坚固的

examples.en: Check that all windows and doors have been made as secure as possible.
examples.zh: 看看是不是所有的门窗都关紧了。

examples.en: a secure unit for child offenders
examples.zh: 少年犯拘留病房

examples.en: The building is secure against intruders.
examples.zh: 该建筑可以防止入侵者。

senses.def: not likely to move, fall down, etc.

examples.en: The aerial doesn't look very secure to me.
examples.zh: 我看这天线不太牢固。

examples.en: It was difficult to maintain a secure foothold on the ice.
examples.zh: 在冰上不容易站稳脚。

examples.en: Our relationship was now on a more secure footing.
examples.zh: 现在，我们的关系有一个更为稳固的基础了。

senses.group: not likely to move or fall 牢固

senses.zh: 安全培训中心：英国的一个针对17岁以下多次违反法律的儿童的中心。孩子们被关在中心内，并接受教育和培训。第一个中心于1998年开放。

senses.def: in a way that is safe or protected against harm, crime, etc.

examples.en: She locked the door securely behind her.
examples.zh: 她随手把门锁好。

examples.en: ways to pay securely over the internet
examples.zh: 通过互联网安全支付的方法

senses.def: in a way that is not likely to move, fall down, etc.

examples.en: Make sure the ropes are securely fastened.
examples.zh: 确保绳索已系牢。

senses.def: in a way that is likely to continue or be successful for a long time

examples.en: His power was securely established.
examples.zh: 他的权力已经稳固地确立了。

senses.def: a British company best known for guarding and transporting money or valuable objects, for example, from shops to banks and for taking prisoners to and from court. In 2004 it joined with another company to become Group 4 Securicor (G4S).
senses.zh: 一家英国公司，以保护和运输金钱或贵重物品而闻名，例如从商店到银行，以及将囚犯送上法庭或从法庭上带走。2004年，它与另一家公司合并成为Group 4 Securicor（G4S）。

senses.def: the activities involved in protecting a country, building or person against attack, danger, etc.

examples.en: national/homeland security (= the defence of a country)
examples.zh: 国家／国土安全

examples.en: airport security officers
examples.zh: 机场保安人员

examples.en: The bars are to provide security against break-ins.
examples.zh: 这些栏杆用于保证安全，以防有人闯入。

examples.en: They carried out security checks at the airport.
examples.zh: 他们在机场实行了安全检查。

examples.en: Passwords are a very important security measure.
examples.zh: 密码是一项非常重要的安全措施。

examples.en: The visit took place amidst tight security (= the use of many police officers).
examples.zh: 访问是在戒备森严的情况下进行的。

examples.en: the security forces/services (= the police, army, etc.)
examples.zh: 安全部队／机构

examples.en: a high/maximum security prison (= for dangerous criminals)
examples.zh: 高度／最高级戒备的监狱

examples.en: a security alert/threat/situation
examples.zh: 安全警报/威胁/情况

examples.en: a security adviser/expert
examples.zh: 安全顾问/专家

examples.en: The criminals were caught (= filmed) on a security video.
examples.zh: 罪犯被监控录像拍了下来。

examples.en: to tighten/improve/enhance security
examples.zh: 加强/改善/增强安全性

examples.en: The team abandoned its tour due to security concerns.
examples.zh: 出于安全考虑，该团队放弃了巡演。

examples.en: The two countries agreed to work together to strengthen border security.
examples.zh: 两国同意共同努力加强边境安全。

examples.en: We will protect our national security.
examples.zh: 我们将保护我们的国家安全。

examples.en: Before I can answer your question I have to take you through security (= ask some questions to check a person's identity).
examples.zh: 在我回答你的问题之前，我必须带你通过安检（=问一些问题来检查一个人的身份）。

senses.def: a place at an airport where you go after your passport has been checked so that officials can find out if you are carrying illegal drugs or weapons

examples.en: My bag was emptied and searched when I went through security.
examples.zh: 通过安检时我的包被清空搜查。

examples.en: It took ages to clear security and reach the departure lounge.
examples.zh: 花了好长时间才通过安检到达候机室。

examples.en: Airport security might decide you're unfit to fly.
examples.zh: 机场安检可能会判定您不适合飞行。

senses.def: the department of a large company or organization that deals with the protection of its buildings, equipment and staff

examples.en: Security was/were called to the incident.
examples.zh: 保安人员被叫到事发现场。

senses.def: protection against something bad that might happen in the future

examples.en: financial security
examples.zh: 财务担保

examples.en: Which type of investment offers the greatest security?
examples.zh: 哪一种投资的安全性最高？

examples.en: This system provides basic security for employees.
examples.zh: 该系统为员工提供基本的安全保障。

senses.def: the state of feeling happy and safe from danger or worry

examples.en: the security of a loving family life
examples.zh: 安享天伦之乐

examples.en: She'd allowed herself to be lulled into a false sense of security (= a feeling that she was safe when in fact she was in danger).
examples.zh: 她不自觉地陷入了一种虚假的安全感之中。

senses.group: feeling happy/safe 感觉愉快／安全

senses.def: a valuable item, such as a house, that you agree to give to somebody if you are unable to pay back the money that you have borrowed from them

examples.en: His home and business are being held as security for the loan.
examples.zh: 他是以房子和店铺为抵押得到这笔贷款的。

examples.en: She pledged her jewellery as security for a £50 000 loan.
examples.zh: 她用自己的珠宝作为抵押，贷款5 万英镑。

examples.en: His father agreed to stand security for his son's house-purchase loan.
examples.zh: 他父亲同意为儿子的购房贷款作担保。

examples.en: The bank will make a loan against the security of the lender's house.
examples.zh: 银行将会凭借款人的住房抵押提供贷款。

senses.def: documents proving that somebody is the owner of shares, etc. in a particular company

examples.en: government securities
examples.zh: 政府证券

senses.group: shares in company 公司股份

senses.def: a blanket
senses.zh: （儿童借以得到安全感的）安慰毯，安慰物

examples.en: He takes his security blanket with him everywhere.
examples.zh: 他走到哪里都带着自己的安乐毯。

examples.en: For her, money was like a security blanket.
examples.zh: 对她来说，钱就是心理保障。

senses.def: something that provides protection against attack, danger, etc.
senses.zh: 保护物；防护措施；安全保障

examples.en: A firewall provides an essential security blanket for your computer network.
examples.zh: 防火墙为计算机网络提供了基本安全保障。

senses.def: official orders or measures that prevent people from knowing about, seeing, etc. something

examples.en: The government has thrown a security blanket around the talks.
examples.zh: 政府明令禁止泄露谈判内容。

senses.def: a sum of money you pay when you rent a place to live and that is returned when you leave if you do not cause any damage

examples.en: The landlord requires a security deposit of one month's rent.
examples.zh: 房东要求付一个月租金作为保证金。

senses.def: soldiers and police who are responsible for maintaining security in a city, region, etc.

examples.en: a member of the security forces
examples.zh: 安全部队成员

examples.en: Local and national security forces failed to respond adequately to the crisis as it unfolded.
examples.zh: 地方和国家安全部队未能对危机的发展做出充分反应。

senses.def: a person whose job is to guard a building, money, etc.
a mistake in a piece of software that allows a user to gain access to a computer system or network without permission

examples.en: The hacker discovered a security hole that exposed over ten million users' passwords.
examples.zh: 黑客发现了一处安全漏洞，超过一千万用户的密码面临泄露风险。

senses.def: a person who cannot be given secret information because they are a danger to a particular country, organization, etc., especially because of their political beliefs
senses.zh: （尤指因政治信仰而对国家、机构等安全构成威胁的）危险分子

examples.en: They regarded her as a security risk.
examples.zh: 他们将她视为安全风险。

senses.def: a government organization that protects a country and its secrets from enemies
secretary
a car with four doors and a boot
a box containing a seat for one person, carried on poles
slow, calm and relaxed
senses.zh: 镇定的；泰然的；不慌不忙的

examples.en: We followed the youngsters at a more sedate pace.
examples.zh: 我们跟在年轻人后面，步子稍慢一点。

senses.def: quiet, especially in a way that lacks excitement

examples.en: a sedate country town
examples.zh: 宁静的乡间小镇

examples.en: a sedate family occasion
examples.zh: 一个安静的家庭场合

examples.en: a sedate, sober man
examples.zh: 一个严肃审慎的人

senses.def: to give somebody drugs in order to make them calm and/or to make them sleep

examples.en: Most of the patients are heavily sedated.
examples.zh: 多数病人服了大剂量镇静药。

examples.en: A vet was called to sedate the animal.
examples.zh: 兽医被叫来给这只动物注射镇静剂。

senses.def: in a slow, calm and relaxed way, without any excitement
senses.zh: 镇定的；泰然的；不慌不忙的

senses.def: the act of giving somebody drugs in order to make them calm or to make them sleep; the state that results from this

examples.en: The victim's wife was last night being kept under sedation in the local hospital.
examples.zh: 昨晚，受害人的妻子在当地医院用药后处于镇静状态。

senses.def: a drug that makes somebody go to sleep or makes them feel calm and relaxed

examples.en: The doctor gave him a mild sedative to help him sleep.
examples.zh: 医生给了他一种温和的镇静剂来帮助他入睡。

senses.def: having the effect of making somebody go to sleep or feel calm and relaxed

examples.en: the sedative effect of the drug
examples.zh: 该药物的镇静作用

senses.def: in which you spend a lot of time sitting down

examples.en: a sedentary job/occupation/lifestyle
examples.zh: 常久坐的工作／职业／生活方式

senses.def: spending a lot of time sitting down and not moving

examples.en: He became increasingly sedentary in later life.
examples.zh: 到晚年，他变得越来越不爱动了。

senses.def: that stay and live in the same place or area
senses.zh: 定居的；定栖的；不迁徙的

examples.en: Rhinos are largely sedentary animals.
examples.zh: 大致说来，犀牛是一种定栖动物。

examples.en: a sedentary population
examples.zh: 定居人口

senses.def: a Jewish ceremonial
senses.zh: 逾越节家宴（犹太教逾越节第一夜或第一第二两夜举行）

senses.def: a plant like grass that grows in wet ground or near water
the solid material that settles at the bottom of a liquid

examples.en: If milk is clean, there should be no sediment in the bottom of the bottle.
examples.zh: 如果牛奶是干净的，瓶底应该没有沉淀物。

senses.def: sand, stones, mud, etc. carried by water or wind and left, for example, on the bottom of a lake, river, etc.
connected with or formed from the sand, stones, mud, etc. that settle at the bottom of lakes, etc.

examples.en: sedimentary rocks
examples.zh: 沉积岩

senses.def: the process of a layer of sediment
the use of words or actions that are intended to encourage people to oppose a government
senses.zh: 煽动叛乱的言论（或行动）

examples.en: to be charged with sedition
examples.zh: 被控煽动罪

examples.en: sedition laws
examples.zh: 煽动法

examples.en: to commit sedition
examples.zh: 犯煽动叛乱罪

senses.def: intended to encourage people to oppose a government
senses.zh: 煽动叛乱的言论（或行动）

examples.en: seditious activity
examples.zh: 煽动叛乱的活动

examples.en: The letter was declared seditious.
examples.zh: 这封书信被宣布具有煽动性。

senses.def: to persuade somebody to have sex with you, especially somebody who is younger or who has less experience than you
to persuade somebody to do something that they would not usually agree to do by making it seem very attractive

examples.en: The promise of huge profits seduced him into parting with his money.
examples.zh: 高额利润的许诺诱使他把钱交了出来。

examples.en: advertisements that seduce us with promises
examples.zh: 用承诺引诱我们的广告

senses.def: a person who seduces
the act of persuading somebody to have sex with you

examples.en: Cleopatra’s seduction of Caesar
examples.zh: 克里奥帕特拉对凯撒的引诱

senses.def: the qualities or features of something that make it seem attractive

examples.en: Who could resist the seductions of the tropical island?
examples.zh: 谁能不为这个热带海岛的魅力而倾倒呢？

examples.en: the seduction of fame
examples.zh: 成名的诱惑

senses.def: sexually attractive

examples.en: a seductive woman
examples.zh: 富有魅力的女人

examples.en: She used her most seductive voice.
examples.zh: 她运用了自己最有魅力的嗓音。

examples.en: There was something seductive about the way he smiled at her.
examples.zh: 他对她微笑的方式有些诱人。

senses.def: attractive in a way that makes you want to have or do something
senses.zh: 有吸引力的；令人神往的

examples.en: The idea of retiring to the south of France is highly seductive.
examples.zh: 退休后到法国南方去，这个主意令人心驰神往。

examples.en: These opportunities seemed infinitely seductive.
examples.zh: 这些机会似乎具有无穷的诱惑力。

senses.def: in a sexually attractive way
senses.zh: 诱人的；迷人的；有魅力的；性感的

examples.en: She smiled seductively.
examples.zh: 她笑得很迷人。

senses.def: in an attractive way that makes you want to have or do something
senses.zh: 有吸引力的；令人神往的

examples.en: You make everything sound so seductively simple.
examples.zh: 你让一切听起来都那么简单诱人。

senses.def: the fact of being sexually attractive
senses.zh: 诱人的；迷人的；有魅力的；性感的

senses.def: the quality of being attractive in a way that makes you want to have or do something
senses.zh: 有吸引力的；令人神往的

senses.def: a woman who seduces
showing great care and effort in your work
senses.zh: 勤勉的；孜孜不倦的；勤奋的

examples.en: sedulous attention to detail
examples.zh: 注重细节

senses.def: in a way that shows great care and effort in your work
senses.zh: 勤勉的；孜孜不倦的；勤奋的

senses.def: to become aware of somebody/something by using your eyes

examples.en: She looked for him but couldn't see him in the crowd.
examples.zh: 她在人群里找来找去，但没看见他。

examples.en: I looked out of the window but saw nothing.
examples.zh: 我向窗外望去，什么也没看见。

examples.en: The opera was the place to see and be seen (= by other important or fashionable people).
examples.zh: 歌剧院是个名流和时尚人士竞显丰采的地方。

examples.en: I would like to see some proof of this statement.
examples.zh: 我想看看这个说法的一些证据。

examples.en: The divers reported seeing a lot of sharks.
examples.zh: 潜水员报告说看到了很多鲨鱼。

examples.en: He recalls seeing his father sitting at the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 他记得看到他的父亲坐在厨房的桌子旁。

examples.en: I've never seen anything like this!
examples.zh: 我从来没有见过这样的事情！

examples.en: He could see (that) she had been crying.
examples.zh: 他看得出她哭过。

examples.en: Did you see what happened?
examples.zh: 你看见出什么事了吗？

examples.en: If you watch carefully, you’ll see how it is done.
examples.zh: 如果你仔细观察，你就会看到它是如何完成的。

examples.en: I hate to see you unhappy.
examples.zh: 我不愿见你不高兴。

examples.en: She was seen running away from the scene of the crime.
examples.zh: 有人看见她从犯罪现场跑开。

examples.en: I saw you put the key in your pocket.
examples.zh: 我见你把钥匙放进了口袋里。

examples.en: He was seen to enter the building about the time the crime was committed.
examples.zh: 有人看见他在案发时间前后进入那栋建筑物。

examples.en: The government not only has to do something, it must be seen to be doing something (= people must be aware that it is doing something).
examples.zh: 政府不仅必须采取措施，而且必须让人们知道它在采取措施。

examples.en: The walls were too high to see over.
examples.zh: 墙太高了，看不到那一边。

senses.def: to have or use the power of sight

examples.en: She will never see again (= she has become blind).
examples.zh: 她再也看不见东西了。

examples.en: On a clear day you can see for miles from here.
examples.zh: 在晴天，你从这儿能看出去很远。

examples.en: It was getting dark and I couldn't see to read.
examples.zh: 天色黑下来，我看不成书了。

examples.en: I could hardly see because of the smoke.
examples.zh: 由于有烟，我几乎什么都看不见。

senses.def: to watch a game, television programme, performance, etc.
senses.zh: 观看（比赛、电视节目、演出等）

examples.en: Did you see that programme on Brazil last night?
examples.zh: 昨晚你有没有看那个介绍巴西的节目？

examples.en: In the evening we went to see a movie.
examples.zh: 晚上，我们去看了一场电影。

examples.en: Fifty thousand people saw the match.
examples.zh: 有五万人观看了那场比赛。

examples.en: I finally got to see them in concert.
examples.zh: 我终于有机会在音乐厅见到他们。

examples.en: I really want to see this film now.
examples.zh: 我现在真的很想看这部电影。

examples.en: This performance was very beautiful, like nothing I had ever seen before.
examples.zh: 这场表演非常精彩，是我以前从未见过的。

examples.en: I remember seeing that movie when I was a kid.
examples.zh: 我记得小时候看过那部电影。

examples.en: It's not the sort of thing you see on TV that often.
examples.zh: 这不是你经常在电视上看到的那种节目。

examples.en: This film really deserves to be seen on a big screen.
examples.zh: 这部电影确实值得在大银幕上观看。

senses.def: to look at something in order to find information; to go to somebody in order to ask for help or information

examples.en: See page 158.
examples.zh: 参见第 158 页。

examples.en: If you missed the session, see a member of staff for advice.
examples.zh: 如果你错过了这一场，可向工作人员咨询。

examples.en: See Table 2 for details.
examples.zh: 详情请参见表 2。

examples.en: See also paragraphs 6.5 to 6.9 above.
examples.zh: 另见上文第 6.5 至 6.9 段。

examples.en: See above/below for a breakdown of the costs.
examples.zh: 开支细目见上／见下。

examples.en: See over (= the next page) for details.
examples.zh: 详情请看下一页。

senses.group: look up/ask for information 查看；询问

senses.def: to be near and recognize somebody; to meet somebody by chance

examples.en: Guess who I saw at the party last night!
examples.zh: 猜猜昨天我在晚会上碰见谁了！

examples.en: Aren't you pleased to see me?
examples.zh: 见到我你不高兴吗？

examples.en: It's so good to see you!
examples.zh: 很高兴见到你！

senses.group: meet by chance 偶然遇见

senses.def: to visit somebody/something

examples.en: Come and see us again soon.
examples.zh: 早点再来看我们。

examples.en: Around 200 000 visitors each year come to see the summer palace.
examples.zh: 每年大约有20万游客来参观颐和园。

senses.def: to have a meeting with somebody

examples.en: You ought to see a doctor about that cough.
examples.zh: 你得找个大夫看看你的咳嗽。

examples.en: What is it you want to see me about?
examples.zh: 你找我有什么事？

examples.en: I can only see you for five minutes.
examples.zh: 我只能见你五分钟。

senses.def: to spend time with somebody

examples.en: Are you seeing anyone (= having a romantic relationship with anyone)?
examples.zh: 你是不是跟什么人好上了？

examples.en: They've been seeing a lot of each other (= spending a lot of time together) recently.
examples.zh: 他们近来老泡在一起。

examples.en: We haven't seen much of Liz lately.
examples.zh: 最近我们很少见到莉兹。

examples.en: He has changed since his family last saw him.
examples.zh: 自从家人上次见到他以来，他已经发生了变化。

senses.def: to understand something

examples.en: ‘It opens like this.’ ‘Oh, I see.’
examples.zh: “这样就打开了。”“哦，我明白了。”

examples.en: He didn't see the joke.
examples.zh: 他没听懂这则笑话。

examples.en: I don't think she saw the point of the story.
examples.zh: 我觉得她没有领会故事的中心意思。

examples.en: He changed the way we see the world around us.
examples.zh: 他改变了我们看待周围世界的方式。

examples.en: to see a/the need for something
examples.zh: 意识到对某事的需求

examples.en: I see no need to involve the law.
examples.zh: 我认为没有必要涉及法律。

examples.en: I can see both sides of the argument.
examples.zh: 争论双方的观点我都清楚。

examples.en: They saw nothing wrong with having three cars.
examples.zh: 他们认为拥有三辆车并没有什么问题。

examples.en: Make Lydia see reason (= be sensible), will you?
examples.zh: 你要让莉迪娅明白道理好不好？

examples.en: Can’t you see (that) he’s taking advantage of you?
examples.zh: 他在利用你，难道你看不出来？

examples.en: I don't see that it matters what Josh thinks.
examples.zh: 乔希怎么想有什么要紧，我不明白。

examples.en: ‘It's broken.’ ‘Oh yes, I see what you mean.’
examples.zh: “它破了。”“噢，我明白你的意思。”

examples.en: ‘Can we go swimming?’ ‘I don't see why not (= yes, you can).’
examples.zh: “我们可以去游泳吗？”“可以呀。”

examples.en: They will be able to see what really happened there.
examples.zh: 他们将能够看到那里到底发生了什么。

senses.def: to have an opinion of something

examples.en: I see things differently now.
examples.zh: 现在，我看问题的方式不一样了。

examples.en: Try to see things from her point of view.
examples.zh: 设法从她那个角度去看问题。

examples.en: The way I see it, you have three main problems.
examples.zh: 我认为你有三个主要问题。

examples.en: As far as I can see (= in my opinion), you've done nothing wrong.
examples.zh: 在我看来，你没做错。

examples.en: Lack of money is the main problem, as I see it (= in my opinion).
examples.zh: 依我看，主要问题是缺钱。

examples.en: She is in love with him but Darren sees their relationship in a different light (= has a different opinion).
examples.zh: 她爱上了他，但达伦以不同的眼光看待他们的关系（=有不同的看法）。

senses.def: to consider something as a future possibility; to imagine somebody/something as something

examples.en: I can't see her changing her mind.
examples.zh: 我无法想象她会改变主意。

examples.en: I can't really see myself working in a lab all day.
examples.zh: 我真的无法想象自己整天在实验室工作。

examples.en: His colleagues see him as a future director.
examples.zh: 他的同事认为他很可能是未来的负责人。

examples.en: She was quiet and withdrawn and never saw herself as a dancer.
examples.zh: 她安静而孤僻，从不认为自己是一名舞者。

senses.def: to find out something by looking, asking or waiting
senses.zh: （通过查看、打听、等待）弄清，了解

examples.en: ‘Has the mail come yet?’ ‘I'll just go and see.’
examples.zh: “邮件来了没有？”“我去看看。”

examples.en: ‘Is he going to get better?’ ‘I don't know, we'll just have to wait and see.’
examples.zh: “他会好起来吗？”“不清楚，我们只能等着瞧了。”

examples.en: We'll have a great time, you'll see.
examples.zh: 你瞧着吧，我们会很开心的。

examples.en: Go and see what the kids are doing, will you?
examples.zh: 你去看看孩子们在干什么好不好？

examples.en: We'll have to see how it goes.
examples.zh: 我们得看看情况怎么样。

examples.en: It will be interesting to see what happens.
examples.zh: 我很有兴趣看看会发生什么事。

examples.en: I see (that) interest rates are going up again.
examples.zh: 我知道利率又在提高了。

examples.en: It can be seen that certain groups are more at risk than others.
examples.zh: 看得出，有的组风险大，有的组风险小。

senses.def: to find out or decide something by thinking or considering

examples.en: ‘Will you be able to help us?’ ‘I don't know, I'll have to see.’
examples.zh: “你能帮助我们吗？”“不好说，我得考虑一下。”

examples.en: ‘Can I go to the party?’ ‘We'll see (= I'll decide later).’
examples.zh: “我能去参加聚会吗？”“待会儿再看吧。”

examples.en: I'll see what I can do to help.
examples.zh: 我考虑考虑，看我能帮上什么忙。

senses.def: to make sure that you do something or that something is done

examples.en: See that all the doors are locked before you leave.
examples.zh: 一定要把所有的门都锁好了再走。

examples.en: Could you see that the kids are in bed by 8 o'clock?
examples.zh: 你能确保孩子们在八点前上床吗？

senses.def: to experience or suffer something

examples.en: He has seen a great deal in his long life.
examples.zh: 他在漫长的一生中经历了许多事情。

examples.en: I hope I never live to see the day when computers finally replace books.
examples.zh: 我可不愿意活到那一天，看着计算机最终取代书籍。

examples.en: It didn't surprise her—she had seen it all before.
examples.zh: 她没有大惊小怪，她以前全都见识过。

senses.def: to be the time when an event happens

examples.en: Next year sees the centenary of Saint-Saëns' death.
examples.zh: 明年是圣桑逝世一百周年。

examples.en: The twentieth century saw dramatic changes in most areas of life.
examples.zh: 20 世纪见证了生活中大部分领域的巨变。

senses.def: to be the place where an event happens

examples.en: This stadium has seen many thrilling football games.
examples.zh: 在这座体育场里举办过许多激动人心的足球比赛。

senses.def: to go with somebody to help or protect them

examples.en: I saw the children across (= helped them cross) the road.
examples.zh: 我护送孩子们穿过马路。

examples.en: May I see you home (= go with you as far as your house)?
examples.zh: 我可不可以送你回家？

examples.en: My secretary will see you out (= show you the way out of the building).
examples.zh: 我的秘书会把你送出去。

senses.def: that can be seen
used when you are thinking or trying to remember something
senses.zh: 让我想一想；让我思考一下

examples.en: Now let me see—how old is she now?
examples.zh: 让我想一想，她现在多大了呢？

senses.def: to realize that there is going to be a problem before it happens
senses.zh: 料到会有问题；意识到会出麻烦

examples.en: We should have seen it coming. There was no way he could keep going under all that pressure.
examples.zh: 我们本该料到的。承受着那么大的压力，他不可能坚持下去。

senses.def: to realize that somebody/something is not as good, pleasant, etc. as they/it seem
senses.zh: 看清某人（或事物）的真实状况（不是表面那样美好）

senses.def: to find out or look at something yourself in order to be sure that what somebody is saying is true
senses.zh: 亲自看，亲自了解（以核实）

examples.en: If you don't believe me, go and see for yourself!
examples.zh: 要是不信我说的，你自己去看看！

senses.def: because of the fact that…

examples.en: Seeing that he's been off sick all week he's unlikely to come.
examples.zh: 他因病整整一周没有上班了，所以今天也不大可能来。

senses.def: goodbye

examples.en: I'd better be going now. See you!
examples.zh: 现在我可该走了。再见！

senses.def: used when you are explaining something
senses.zh: （作解释时说）你看，你知道，要知道

examples.en: You see, the thing is, we won't be finished before Friday.
examples.zh: 要知道，问题是星期五以前我们完不了事。

senses.def: the district or office of a bishop
senses.zh: 主教（或大主教）教区；主教（或大主教）权限；牧座

examples.en: the Holy See (= the office of the Pope)
examples.zh: （罗马）宗座

note.en: Most idioms containing see are at the entries for the nouns and adjectives in the idioms, for example not see the wood for the trees is at wood.
note.zh: 大多数含 see 的习语，都可在该等习语中的名词及形容词相关词条找到，如 not see the wood for the trees 在词条 wood 下。

senses.def: that can be seen
used when you are thinking or trying to remember something
senses.zh: 让我想一想；让我思考一下

examples.en: Now let me see—how old is she now?
examples.zh: 让我想一想，她现在多大了呢？

senses.def: to realize that there is going to be a problem before it happens
senses.zh: 料到会有问题；意识到会出麻烦

examples.en: We should have seen it coming. There was no way he could keep going under all that pressure.
examples.zh: 我们本该料到的。承受着那么大的压力，他不可能坚持下去。

examples.en: Seeing that he's been off sick all week he's unlikely to come.

senses.def: goodbye

intro.en: These words all mean to become aware of somebody/​something by using your eyes, especially suddenly or when it is not easy to see them/​it.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含看见、见到、看出之义，尤指突然发现或注意到。

items.def: to become aware of somebody/​something by using your eyes:
items.zh: 指看见、见到、看出

examples.en: She looked for him but couldn’t see him in the crowd.
examples.zh: 她在人群里找来找去，但没看见他。

items.def: to see or notice somebody/​something, especially suddenly or when they are not easy to see or notice:
items.zh: 指看见、看出，尤指突然发现或注意到

examples.en: I’ve just spotted a mistake on the front cover.
examples.zh: 我刚才在封面上发现了一处错误。

items.def: to see or notice something for a moment, but not clearly or completely:
items.zh: 指瞥见、察觉

examples.en: She caught sight of a car in the distance.
examples.zh: 她瞥见远处有一辆车。

items.def: (literary) to see somebody/​something for a moment, but not clearly or completely:
items.zh: 指瞥见、看一眼

examples.en: He’d glimpsed her through the window as he passed.
examples.zh: 他路过时透过窗户瞥见了她。

intro.en: These words all mean to turn your eyes in a particular direction.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含看、观看之义。

items.def: to turn your eyes in a particular direction:
items.zh: 指看、瞧

examples.en: If you look carefully you can just see our house from here.
examples.zh: 你要是仔细看，从这里就可以看见我们的房子。

items.def: to look at somebody/​something for a time, paying attention to what happens:
items.zh: 指看、注视、观看、观察

examples.en: to watch television
examples.zh: 看电视

items.def: to watch a game, television programme, performance, etc.:
items.zh: 指观看（比赛、电视节目、演出等）

examples.en: In the evening we went to see a movie.
examples.zh: 晚上，我们去看了一场电影。

items.def: (formal) to look at something, especially when you look carefully; to watch television, a film, etc.:
items.zh: 指看、观看（尤指仔细观察）；看（电视、电影等）

examples.en: People came from all over the world to view her work.
examples.zh: 观众从世界各地涌来欣赏她的作品。

items.def: (formal) to watch somebody/​something carefully, especially to learn more about them or it:
items.zh: 指观察、注视、监视

examples.en: The patients were observed over a period of several months.
examples.zh: 这些病人被观察了数月之久。

intro.en: These words all mean to know or realize something, for example why something happens, how something works or what something means.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含懂得、理解、认识到之义。

items.def: to know or realize the meaning of words, a language, what somebody says, etc.; to know or realize how or why something happens, how it works or why it is important:
items.zh: 了解；认识到；明了

examples.en: I don’t understand the instructions.
examples.zh: 我不懂这些指令的意思。

items.def: to understand what is happening, what somebody is saying, how something works or how important something is:
items.zh: 指理解、明白、领会（正在发生的事、某人的话、某事如何起作用或重要性如何）

examples.en: ‘It opens like this.’ ‘Oh, I see.’
examples.zh: “这样就打开了。”“哦，我明白了。”

items.def: (informal) to understand a joke, what somebody is trying to tell you, or a situation that they are trying to describe:
items.zh: 指理解、明白（笑话、某人试图告知的事或描述的情况）

examples.en: She didn’t get the joke.
examples.zh: 她听不懂那个笑话。

items.def: to understand an explanation, a story or the meaning of something:
items.zh: 指理解、明白（说明、故事、意思）

examples.en: Sorry—I don’t quite follow.
examples.zh: 对不起，我不太懂你的话。

items.def: to come to understand a fact, an idea or how to do something:
items.zh: 指理解、领会、领悟、明白（事实、想法或如何做某事）

examples.en: They failed to grasp the importance of his words.
examples.zh: 他们没有理解他的话的重要性。

items.def: (often used in negative statements) (formal) to understand a fact, idea or reason:
items.zh: （常用于否定句中）指理解、领悟、明白（事实、想法或原因）

examples.en: The concept of infinity is almost impossible for the human mind to comprehend.
examples.zh: 无穷的概念几乎是人类的大脑无法理解的。

intro.en: These words all mean to think about somebody/​something in a particular way.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含认为、视为、看待之义。

items.def: to think of somebody/​something in a particular way:
items.zh: 指认为、视为、看待

items.def: to say that somebody/​something has particular qualities or characteristics:
items.zh: 指认为…是、把…看作

items.def: to have a particular feeling or opinion about something:
items.zh: 指认为、感到

items.def: to think of somebody/​something in a particular way:
items.zh: 指认为、视为、看待

items.def: to have an opinion of something:
items.zh: 指认为、看待

items.def: to think of somebody/​something in a particular way:
items.zh: 指认为、视为、看待

intro.en: These words all mean to form an idea in your mind of what somebody/​something might be like.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含想象、设想之义。

items.def: to form an idea in your mind of what somebody/​something might be like:
items.zh: 指想象、设想

examples.en: The house was just as she had imagined it.
examples.zh: 这房子正如她所想象的。

items.def: to imagine something that might happen or might have happened:
items.zh: 指猜想、想象、试想

examples.en: We couldn’t think where you’d gone.
examples.zh: 我们猜想不出来你到哪里去了。

items.def: to consider something as a future possibility; to imagine somebody as something:
items.zh: 指设想、想象

examples.en: I can’t see her changing her mind.
examples.zh: 我无法想象她会改变主意。

items.def: (especially British English尤用于英式英语) to imagine what will happen in the future:
items.zh: 指想象、设想、展望

examples.en: I don’t envisage working with him again.
examples.zh: 我想象不出再与他一起工作的可能。

items.def: to imagine what a situation will be like in the future, especially a situation that you intend to work towards:
items.zh: 指展望、想象

examples.en: They envision an equal society, free from poverty and disease.
examples.zh: 他们向往一个没有贫穷和疾病的平等社会。

senses.def: to deal with something

examples.zh: 我得做午饭了。

examples.zh: 他说他不帮忙，是不是？好，我们这就去找他。

examples.zh: 我得找人把房顶修一修。

senses.def: to find somebody/something attractive or interesting

examples.zh: 我不知道她看上他哪儿了。

to force somebody to leave a place, for example by threatening them or running after them

examples.zh: 几条狗立刻把他们吓走了。

senses.def: to defeat somebody in a game, fight, etc.
senses.zh: （在游戏、战斗等活动中）打败，击败

examples.en: The home team saw off the challengers by 68 points to 47.
examples.zh: 主队以 68:47 击败前来挑战的客队。

senses.def: to last longer than the rest of somebody’s life
senses.zh: 寿命比某人长；看着某人故去

examples.en: I've had this coat for years, and I'm sure it will see me out.
examples.zh: 这件外衣我穿了好多年，我敢说它能穿一辈子。

senses.def: to reach the end or last until the end of something

examples.en: They had enough fuel to see the winter out.
examples.zh: 他们有足够的燃料过冬。

examples.en: He saw out his career in Italy.
examples.zh: 他在意大利一直工作到退休。

senses.def: to visit and look at a place carefully

examples.en: We need to see over the house before we can make you an offer.
examples.zh: 我们需要好好看了房子以后才能给你开个价。

senses.def: to keep changing from one situation, opinion, emotion, etc. to another and back again
senses.zh: （局势、意见、感情等）摇摆不定，不断反复，交替

examples.en: Her emotions see-sawed from anger to fear.
examples.zh: 她一会儿气，一会儿怕，情绪变来变去。

examples.en: Share prices see-sawed all day.
examples.zh: 整整一天，股票价格时涨时跌，不断变化。

senses.def: a piece of equipment for children to play on consisting of a long flat piece of wood that is supported in the middle. A child sits at each end and makes the see-saw

examples.en: Can we go on the see-saw?
examples.zh: 我们玩跷跷板吧？

senses.def: a situation in which things keep changing from one state to another and back again
senses.zh: 拉锯局面（指来回往复，起伏不断）

examples.en: The match was a see-saw battle between the two teams.
examples.zh: 比赛成了两队之间的拉锯战。

senses.def: to realize the truth about somebody/something

examples.en: We saw through him from the start.
examples.zh: 一开始我们就识破他了。

examples.en: I can see through your little game (= I am aware of the trick you are trying to play on me).
examples.zh: 我看透了你的小把戏。

senses.def: to not give up doing a task, project, etc. until it is finished
senses.zh: 把（任务、工程等）进行到底；坚持完成

examples.en: She's determined to see the job through.
examples.zh: 她决心完成这项工作。

senses.def: to give help or support to somebody for a particular period of time

examples.zh: 她靠着顽强的勇气和乐观的性格挺了过来。

examples.en: I only have $20 to see me through the week.
examples.zh: 我只有 20 美元来维持我这一周了。

senses.def: very thin so that you can see through it

examples.zh: 透明的女式衬衫

examples.en: This material goes see-through when it’s wet.
examples.zh: 这种布料湿的时候就透明了。

examples.zh: 你来负责安排下次会议，好吗？

examples.zh: 别担心，这事儿我来处理。

examples.en: We'll have to get that door seen to (= repaired).
examples.zh: 我们得找人把那扇门修一下。

senses.def: to make sure that…

examples.zh: 你能确保今天下午把电邮发出去吗？

senses.zh: 认为（做某事）恰当（或适合）；决定，愿意（做某事）

examples.en: You must do as you think fit (= but I don't agree with your decision).
examples.zh: 你认为怎么合适就怎么干（但我不同意你的决定）。

examples.en: The newspaper did not see fit to publish my letter (= and I criticize it for that).
examples.zh: 那份报纸认为我的信件不宜发表（而我批评这种看法）。

examples.zh: 反叛的起因

examples.zh: 这件事在我心中播下了怀疑的种子。

examples.zh: 他指出资本主义自身蕴藏着自我毁灭的种子。

examples.zh: 头号种子选手轻松获胜。

examples.zh: 生菜都结籽了。

examples.zh: 在杂草结籽前将其剪除会极大地减少将来的杂草问题。

examples.zh: 他因病整整一周没有上班了，所以今天也不大可能来。

examples.zh: 建议驾车者另寻其他路线。

examples.zh: 警方并未寻找与这起死亡事件有关的其他人。

examples.en: They sought in vain for somewhere to shelter.
examples.zh: 他们怎么也找不到一个藏身的地方。

examples.en: I think it's time we sought legal advice.
examples.zh: 我想我们现在该咨询一下律师了。

examples.en: They sought refuge in the mountain villages.
examples.zh: 他们在山村里寻求避难。

examples.en: She fled the country and is now seeking asylum in Sweden.
examples.zh: 她逃离了那个国家，目前正在瑞典寻求政治避难。

examples.en: The pilot sought permission to land.
examples.zh: 飞行员请求降落许可。

examples.en: EU citizens have the right to seek employment in any member state.
examples.zh: 欧盟公民有权在任何成员国寻找就业机会。

examples.en: He has not sought medical treatment for his condition.
examples.zh: 他没有就自己的病情寻求治疗。

examples.en: She was determined to seek revenge.
examples.zh: 她决心报仇。

examples.en: She managed to calm him down and seek help from a neighbour.
examples.zh: 她设法使他平静下来，然后向一位邻居求助。

examples.en: We need to seek approval from the local council.
examples.zh: 我们需要寻求当地议会的批准。

examples.en: They came seeking for the truth.
examples.zh: 他们来寻求真相。

senses.def: to try to do something

examples.en: He sought to establish himself as a writer.
examples.zh: 他试图成为一名作家。

examples.en: They quickly sought to distance themselves from the protesters.
examples.zh: 他们迅速设法远离抗议者。

senses.def: looking for or trying to get the thing mentioned; the activity of doing this
senses.zh: 寻求（或追求）…的；对…的寻求（或追求）

examples.en: attention-seeking behaviour
examples.zh: 为引起他人的注意而作出的行为

examples.en: Voluntary work can provide a framework for job-seeking.
examples.zh: 参与义务工作有助于奠定求职的基础。

examples.zh: 许多人移民到澳大利亚寻求财富。

examples.zh: 许多人移民到澳大利亚寻求财富。

examples.zh: 他佩服她淘便宜货的能力。

senses.def: the amount of time that a computer takes to find data
a person who is trying to find or get the thing mentioned
senses.zh: 寻找者；寻求者；追求者；谋求者

examples.en: an attention/a publicity seeker
examples.zh: 故意引人注意的人；追求出名的人

examples.en: seekers after the truth
examples.zh: 追求真理的人

examples.en: The new attraction is expected to draw pleasure seekers from across the region.
examples.zh: 新景点预计将吸引该地区的休闲游客。

senses.def: to give the impression of being or doing something

examples.en: You seem happy.
examples.zh: 你好像挺高兴。

examples.en: Do whatever seems best to you.
examples.zh: 你觉得什么最好，就做什么。

examples.en: This may seem obvious to you.
examples.zh: 这对你来说似乎是显而易见的。

examples.en: It seems clear that there has been a mistake.
examples.zh: 很明显，其中出现了错误。

examples.en: It seems likely that they will lose the election.
examples.zh: 看来他们很可能会输掉选举。

examples.en: Strange as it may seem, exactly the same thing happened to me.
examples.zh: 虽然看起来很奇怪，但同样的事情也发生在我身上。

examples.en: He seems a nice man.
examples.zh: 他看来是个好人。

examples.en: She seems to be a smart woman.
examples.zh: 她看上去是个聪明的女人。

examples.en: You seem to be nervous.
examples.zh: 你看起来很紧张。

examples.en: People aren’t always what they seem to be.
examples.zh: 人们并不总是他们看起来的样子。

examples.en: It seemed like a good idea at the time.
examples.zh: 当时这主意好像不错。

examples.en: It always seemed as though they would get married.
examples.zh: 他们一直仿佛是要结婚似的。

examples.en: ‘He'll be there, then?’ ‘So it seems (= people say so).’
examples.zh: “这么说，他要去那儿了？”“似乎是这样。”

examples.en: It seems to me that teachers have to work pretty hard.
examples.zh: 我觉得教师蛮辛苦的。

examples.en: It must have seemed to him that he was safe.
examples.zh: 他一定觉得自己很安全。

examples.en: It seems that they know what they're doing.
examples.zh: 看来，他们知道自己在干什么。

examples.en: They seem to know what they're doing.
examples.zh: 看来，他们知道自己在干什么。

senses.def: used to make what you say about your thoughts, feelings or actions less strong
senses.zh: （用以缓和语气）感到好像，觉得似乎

examples.en: I seem to have left my book at home.
examples.zh: 我大概是把书忘在家里了。

examples.en: I can't seem to (= I've tried, but I can't) get started today.
examples.zh: 我怕是没法在今天开始了。

senses.def: used to suggest that something is true when you are not certain or when you want to be polite
senses.zh: （表示不确切或客气）看来好像，似乎

examples.en: It would seem that we all agree.
examples.zh: 我们大家似乎都同意。

examples.en: This last point, it seems to me, is particularly important.
examples.zh: 在我看来，最后一点尤为重要。

examples.en: It seems only reasonable to ask students to buy a dictionary.
examples.zh: 要学生买一本词典似乎挺合情合理的。

senses.def: in a way that appears to be true but may in fact not be

examples.en: a seemingly stupid question
examples.zh: 看似愚蠢的问题

examples.en: a seemingly endless journey
examples.zh: 似乎永远走不完的旅程

examples.en: It was a seemingly impossible task.
examples.zh: 这似乎是一项不可能完成的任务。

senses.def: according to what you have read or heard

examples.en: Seemingly, he borrowed the money from the bank.
examples.zh: 据说，他从银行贷出了那笔钱。

examples.en: They were seemingly having an affair.
examples.zh: 他们似乎有外遇。

senses.def: appropriate for a particular social situation
senses.zh: 合适的；得体的；合乎礼仪的

examples.en: It was not considered seemly to talk in such a way in front of the children.
examples.zh: 在孩子们面前这样说话被认为不太合适。

examples.en: Blood was beginning to seep through the bandages.
examples.zh: 血开始从绷带渗出来。

examples.en: Water seeped from a crack in the pipe.
examples.zh: 水从管道的一个裂缝中渗出。

examples.en: Gradually the pain seeped away.
examples.zh: 疼痛渐渐消失了。

senses.def: the process by which a liquid flows slowly and in small quantities through something; the result of this process

examples.en: Water gradually escapes by seepage through the ground.
examples.zh: 水逐渐从地上渗走了。

examples.en: oil seepages
examples.zh: 油渗

examples.en: This new legislation represents a further seepage of power to Brussels.
examples.zh: 这项新立法代表着权力进一步向布鲁塞尔渗透。

examples.zh: 她在角落里默默地生闷气。

examples.en: He marched off, seething with frustration.
examples.zh: 他大为失望，气呼呼地走开了。

examples.en: Inwardly he was seething at this challenge to his authority.
examples.zh: 他因权威受到挑战而怒火中烧。

examples.en: She was seething at the insult.
examples.zh: 听到这些辱骂，她愤怒不已。

senses.zh: 充满，遍布，到处都是（人、动物）

examples.en: The resort is seething with tourists all year round.
examples.zh: 这处名胜一年四季游人如织。

examples.en: He became caught up in a seething mass of arms and legs.
examples.zh: 他被卷进了摩肩接踵的人群。

examples.en: The grey ocean seethed beneath them.
examples.zh: 灰蒙蒙的大海在他们下面翻滚。

senses.def: a part of something that is separate from the other parts or can be considered separately

examples.zh: 她擦干净了这幅画的一小部分。

examples.en: Lines divided the area into segments.
examples.zh: 这一地区用线条分成了若干部分。

examples.en: The changes will affect only a small segment of the population.
examples.zh: 这些变化只会影响一小部分人口。

examples.en: They divided the bone into equal segments.
examples.zh: 他们将骨头分成相等的部分。

a part of a circle separated from the rest by a single line
the smallest speech sound that a word can be divided into

examples.zh: 市场研究人员常常按年龄和社会阶层划分人口。

examples.en: The worm has a segmented body (= with different sections joined together).
examples.zh: 这条虫子的身体是分节的。

senses.zh: 分割；划分；分割成（或划分成）的部分

senses.zh: 隔离并区别对待（不同种族、宗教或性别的人）

examples.en: a culture in which women are segregated from men
examples.zh: 妇女受到隔离歧视的文化

examples.zh: 白人和黑人被隔离在城镇的不同区域。

examples.zh: 实行种族隔离的社会

examples.en: a segregated school (= one for students of one race or religion only)
examples.zh: 单一种族（或信仰）的学校

examples.zh: 铁栅栏把行人与来往车辆隔开。

senses.def: to take somebody/something in your hand suddenly and using force

examples.en: She tried to seize the gun from him.
examples.zh: 她试图夺他的枪。

examples.en: He seized her by the arm.
examples.zh: 他抓住她的胳膊。

examples.en: She seized hold of my hand.
examples.zh: 她抓住我的手。

senses.def: to take control of a place or situation, often suddenly and violently
senses.zh: （常指通过暴力突然）夺取，攻占，控制

examples.en: They seized the airport in a surprise attack.
examples.zh: 他们突袭攻占了机场。

examples.en: The army has seized control of the country.
examples.zh: 军队已经控制全国。

examples.en: He seized power in a military coup.
examples.zh: 他在军事政变中夺取了政权。

senses.def: to arrest or capture somebody

examples.en: The men were seized as they left the building.
examples.zh: 这些人在离开那栋房子时被抓获。

examples.en: Terrorists have seized five hostages.
examples.zh: 恐怖分子劫持了五名人质。

senses.def: to take illegal or stolen goods away from somebody

examples.en: A large quantity of drugs was seized during the raid.
examples.zh: 在这次突击行动中起获了大量毒品。

examples.en: We have the legal right to seize his property.
examples.zh: 我们有没收他财产的合法权力。

examples.en: She promptly seized the opportunity his absence gave her.
examples.zh: 她立即抓住了他不在场给她创造的机会。

senses.def: to affect somebody suddenly and deeply

examples.zh: 她突然惊慌失措。

examples.en: He was seized by curiosity.
examples.zh: 他好奇心顿起。

senses.def: if a part of your body seizes

examples.zh: 彼得突然对她最后的评论非常关注。

examples.zh: 法庭下令没收他的财产。

examples.zh: 该法案授予警察入室、搜查和扣押的权力。

examples.en: the army’s seizure of power
examples.zh: 军队对政权的夺取

examples.en: the seizure of Burma by Japan in 1942
examples.zh: 1942 年日军对缅甸的占领

examples.en: The invasion began with the seizure of the country's largest southern city.
examples.zh: 入侵的第一步是占领该国南部最大的城市。

senses.def: a sudden attack of an illness, especially one that affects the brain
senses.zh: （疾病，尤指脑病的）突然侵袭，发作

examples.en: to have/suffer an epileptic seizure
examples.zh: 癫痫发作

senses.def: not often

examples.en: He had seldom seen a child with so much talent.
examples.zh: 有如此天赋的孩子他以往没见过几个。

examples.en: She seldom, if ever, goes to the theatre.
examples.zh: 她难得上剧院看场戏——即便不能说从来不去。

examples.en: They seldom watch television these days.
examples.zh: 这些日子他们很少看电视。

examples.en: Seldom had he seen such beauty.
examples.zh: 他以前很少见过这样的美景。

senses.def: to choose somebody/something from a group of people or things, usually according to a system

examples.en: He hasn't been selected for the team.
examples.zh: 他未能入选该队。

examples.en: All our hotels have been carefully selected for the excellent value they provide.
examples.zh: 我们的所有旅馆都是精心挑选的，最为合算。

examples.en: She was selected as the parliamentary candidate for Bath.
examples.zh: 她被选为巴斯选区的议员候选人。

examples.en: a randomly selected sample of 23 schools
examples.zh: 随机抽选的 23 所样本学校

examples.en: selected poems of T.S. Eliot
examples.zh: T.S. 艾略特诗选

examples.en: This model is available at selected stores only.
examples.zh: 这种款式只在特定商店有售。

examples.en: She selected an apple from the fruit bowl.
examples.zh: 她从水果盘里挑选了一个苹果。

examples.en: It is important to select a software package that suits your requirements.
examples.zh: 选择适合您要求的软件包非常重要。

examples.en: Six theatre companies have been selected to take part in this year's festival.
examples.zh: 已选定六个剧团参加今年的戏剧节。

examples.en: Select what you want from the options available.
examples.zh: 从可选项中选择你想要的。

examples.en: They could select from a range of choices depending on their interests and skills.
examples.zh: 他们可根据兴趣和技能进行各种各样的选择。

senses.def: to mark something on a computer screen; to choose something, especially from a menu
senses.zh: （在电脑屏幕上）选定；（从菜单中）选择，选取

examples.en: Select the text you want to format by holding down the left button on your mouse.
examples.zh: 按住鼠标左键选取你想要安排版式的文本。

examples.en: Select ‘New Mail’ from the ‘Send’ menu.
examples.zh: 从“发送”菜单中选择“新邮件”。

senses.def: carefully chosen as the best out of a larger group of people or things
senses.zh: 精选的；作为…精华的；优等的

examples.en: a select wine list
examples.zh: 名优葡萄酒目录

examples.zh: 婚礼只邀请了几个至亲好友参加。

examples.en: It was a very fashionable event with a select audience.
examples.zh: 这是一个非常时尚的活动，有特定的观众。

intro.zh: 以上各词均含选择、挑选人或物之义。

items.def: to decide which thing or person you want out of the ones that are available:
items.zh: 指选择、选取人或物

examples.en: You choose—I can’t decide.
examples.zh: 你来选吧，我拿不定主意。

items.def: [often passive] to choose somebody/​something, usually carefully, from a group of people or things:
items.zh: 指仔细选择、挑选

examples.en: He was selected for the team.
examples.zh: 他已入选进队了。

items.def: (rather informal) to choose somebody/​something from a group of people or things:
items.zh: 指选择、挑选

examples.en: She picked the best cake for herself.
examples.zh: 她为自己挑了一块最好的蛋糕。

items.def: to choose between two or more possibilities:
items.zh: 指在两个或更多可能的情况中作出抉择、决定、选择

examples.en: We’re still trying to decide on a venue.
examples.zh: 我们仍在设法选定一个活动地点。

items.def: to choose to take or not to take a particular course of action:
items.zh: 指选择是否采取某种行动

examples.en: After graduating she opted for a career in music.
examples.zh: 毕业后她选择了从事音乐工作。

items.def: (rather informal) to choose something:
items.zh: 指选择某物

examples.en: I think I’ll go for the fruit salad.
examples.zh: 我想要水果色拉。

senses.def: a small group of politicians or experts that have been chosen to examine a particular subject or problem
senses.zh: 特别委员会（为研究某课题等而成立）

examples.en: the House of Commons Select Committee on medical ethics
examples.zh: 下议院医学伦理特别委员会

examples.en: The matter was investigated by a parliamentary select committee.
examples.zh: 议会特别委员会对此事进行了调查。

senses.def: a person who is chosen for something
a person who is chosen to do military service
the process of choosing somebody/something from a group of people or things, usually according to a system

examples.en: She took a long time to make her selection.
examples.zh: 她花了好长时间才作出选择。

examples.en: The final team selection will be made tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天将确定队伍的最后人选。

examples.en: the random selection of numbers
examples.zh: 号码的随机抽取

examples.en: selection criteria
examples.zh: 挑选标准

examples.en: the selection process
examples.zh: 选拔过程

examples.en: Artists are chosen by a selection committee.
examples.zh: 艺术家由评选委员会选出。

examples.en: Jury selection in the cases is due to begin next week.
examples.zh: 这些案件的陪审团遴选定于下周开始。

examples.en: her selection for the England squad
examples.zh: 她入选英格兰队

examples.en: his unexpected selection as party leader
examples.zh: 他出人意料地被选为党的领导人

senses.def: a number of people or things that have been chosen from a larger group
senses.zh: 被挑选的人（或物）；被选中者；入选者

examples.en: A selection of readers' comments is published below.
examples.zh: 下面选登了部分读者的评论。

examples.en: The orchestra played selections from Hollywood musicals.
examples.zh: 管弦乐队演奏了好莱坞音乐剧精选的曲目。

senses.def: a collection of things from which something can be chosen

examples.en: The showroom has a wide selection of kitchens.
examples.zh: 展厅里有多种式样的厨房可供选择。

examples.en: The wine selection isn't bad.
examples.zh: 这儿的葡萄酒不错。

intro.en: These are all words for a person or thing that is chosen, or that is liked more than others.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指选中或特别喜爱的人或事物。

items.def: a person or thing that is chosen:
items.zh: 指入选者、选中的东西

examples.en: She’s the obvious choice for the job.
examples.zh: 她是这个职位当然的人选。

items.def: a person or thing that you like more than the others of the same type:
items.zh: 指同类人或事物中最喜欢的一个

examples.en: Which one’s your favourite?
examples.zh: 你最喜欢哪一个？

items.def: a thing that is liked better or best:
items.zh: 指偏爱的或最喜爱的事物

examples.en: Tastes and preferences vary from individual to individual.
examples.zh: 人的爱好和选择各不相同。

items.def: a number of people or things that have been chosen from a larger group:
items.zh: 指从大群中选出来的一组人或物

examples.en: A selection of reader’s comments are published below.
examples.zh: 下面选登了部分读者评论。

items.def: (rather informal) a person or thing that is chosen:
items.zh: 指入选者、选中的东西

examples.en: She was his pick for best actress.
examples.zh: 她是他认为最好的女演员。

senses.def: a group of people who choose, for example, the members of a sports team
senses.zh: （运动队队员等的）选拔委员会；遴选委员会

senses.def: used to describe the process by which each word limits what kind of words can be used with it in normal language
senses.zh: （正规语言中单词对搭配词）选择的，限制的

examples.en: ‘Eat’ has the selectional restriction that it must be followed by a kind of food, so ‘I eat sky’ is not possible.
examples.zh: eat 一词之后限跟某种食物，所以不可能说 I eat sky。

senses.def: affecting or involving only a small number of people or things from a larger group

examples.en: the selective breeding of cattle
examples.zh: 牛的选择性培育

examples.en: selective strike action
examples.zh: 有选择的罢工行动

examples.en: the socially selective nature of population changes
examples.zh: 人口变化的社会选择性特点

senses.def: tending to be careful about what or who you choose
senses.zh: 认真挑选的；严格筛选的

examples.en: You will have to be selective about which information to include in the report.
examples.zh: 究竟要把哪些资料收入报告，你得仔细斟酌挑选。

examples.en: Their admissions policy is very selective.
examples.zh: 他们的录取政策非常严格。

examples.en: a selective school (= one that chooses which children to admit, especially according to ability)
examples.zh: 择优录取学生的学校

senses.def: a system in which people have to spend a period of time in the armed forces by law
in a way that affects or involves only a small number of people or things from a larger group

examples.en: The product will be selectively marketed in the US (= only in some areas).
examples.zh: 这种产品只会在美国某些被选中的地区上市。

examples.en: The cattle have not been selectively bred for beef or milk.
examples.zh: 这些牛没有经过选择性饲养以生产牛肉或牛奶。

senses.def: in a way that shows care being taken about what or who is chosen
senses.zh: 有选择地：以某种方式表现出对选择什么人或谁被选择的关心

examples.en: Academia must engage with the media selectively and on its own terms.
examples.zh: 学术界必须有选择地、按照自己的方式与媒体接触。

senses.def: the fact of being careful about what or who you choose
senses.zh: 认真挑选的；严格筛选的

examples.en: Schools are tending towards greater selectivity.
examples.zh: 学校的筛选标准正在变得越来越严格。

senses.def: the fact of affecting some things and not others
senses.zh: 选择性：影响某些事物而不影响其他事物

examples.en: The drugs have greater selectivity for tumour cells compared with healthy cells.
examples.zh: 与健康细胞相比，这些药物对肿瘤细胞具有更大的选择性。

senses.def: a person who chooses the members of a particular sports team

examples.en: The Welsh selectors have named the team for next week’s international.
examples.zh: 威尔士选拔者已经指定了参加下周国际比赛的球队。

senses.def: a device in an engine, a machine, etc. that allows you to choose a particular function

examples.en: a gear selector

examples.en: a selector switch
examples.zh: 选择器开关
