senses.def: the type of person you are, especially the way you normally behave, look or feel
senses.zh: （自己的）通常的行为方式，本来面目，惯常心态

examples.en: You'll soon be feeling your old self again (= feeling well or happy again).
examples.zh: 你很快就会恢复原样的。

examples.en: He's not his usual happy self this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上，他不像平素那样乐呵呵的。

examples.en: Only with a few people could she be her real self (= show what she was really like rather than what she pretended to be).
examples.zh: 只有和某几个人在一起时，她才能表现出真实的自我。

examples.en: his private/professional self (= how he behaves at home/work)
examples.zh: 他在家里／上班时的样子

senses.def: a person’s personality or character that makes them different from other people

examples.en: Many people living in institutions have lost their sense of self (= the feeling that they are individual people).
examples.zh: 许多生活在福利院里的人已经失去了个性意识。

examples.en: the inner self (= a person’s emotional and spiritual character)
examples.zh: 内心的思想感情

examples.en: a lack of confidence in the self
examples.zh: 缺乏自信

senses.def: your own advantage or pleasure rather than that of other people
senses.zh: 个人利益；一己的享乐；私心

examples.en: She didn't do it for any reason of self.
examples.zh: 她那样做绝不是出于私心。

examples.en: Self, self, self! That’s all you ever think about!
examples.zh: 自己，自己，自己！这就是你所想的一切！

senses.def: used to refer to a person

examples.en: You didn't hurt your little self, did you?
examples.zh: 小家伙，你没伤着自己吧？

examples.en: We look forward to seeing Mrs Brown and your good self this evening.
examples.zh: 我们期盼今晚能见到布朗夫人和您本人。

examples.en: I was very thirsty (note to self: bring water on walks!).
examples.zh: 我当时很渴（提醒自己：散步时带上水！）。

senses.def: to not have the strength, influence, etc. that you used to have
senses.zh: 失去昔日的力量（或影响等）；威风不再；不如当年

examples.en: When his career ended, he became a shadow of his former self.
examples.zh: 当他的职业生涯结束时，他变成了以前的自己的影子。

senses.def: of, to or by yourself or itself

examples.zh: 自我控制

examples.zh: 写明回邮地址的

examples.en: self-taught
examples.zh: 自学的

examples.zh: 女孩们闷闷不乐地坐着，自顾自地坐着。

examples.zh: 自主学习中心／图书馆

examples.zh: 她托人捎话说她要回家了。

senses.def: to tell somebody to go somewhere or to do something; to arrange for somebody to go somewhere

examples.en: Ed couldn't make it so they sent me instead.
examples.zh: 埃德去不了，所以他们就派我去了。

examples.en: She sent the kids to bed early.
examples.zh: 她早早打发孩子们上床睡觉。

examples.en: The judge sent her to prison for two years.
examples.zh: 法官判处她两年监禁。

examples.en: He was sent away to boarding school at the age of eight.
examples.zh: 八岁时，他被送去寄宿学校。

examples.en: The government has agreed to send 3 000 troops to the region.
examples.zh: 政府已同意向该地区派遣3000名士兵。

examples.en: We are being sent on a training course next month.
examples.zh: 我们下月将被派去参加一个培训课程。

examples.en: Children were sent home from school because it was just too hot.
examples.zh: 由于天气太热，孩子们被从学校送回家。

examples.en: I've sent Tom to buy some milk.
examples.zh: 我叫汤姆去买牛奶了。

senses.group: somebody somewhere 让某人前往某处

senses.def: to make something/somebody move quickly or suddenly

examples.en: Every step he took sent the pain shooting up his leg.
examples.zh: 他每走一步，疼痛就顺腿蹿上来。

examples.en: The punch sent him flying.
examples.zh: 那一拳打得他整个人飞了出去。

examples.en: The report sent share prices down a further 8p.
examples.zh: 这份报告一公布，股价又跌了 8 便士。

senses.group: make something move quickly 使某物快速移动

senses.def: to make somebody behave or react in a particular way
senses.zh: 使作出（某种反应）；使表现出（某种行为）

examples.en: Her music always sends me to sleep.
examples.zh: 她的音乐总使我进入梦乡。

examples.en: Her account of the visit sent us into fits of laughter.
examples.zh: 她讲述参观的经过，我们听得一阵阵大笑。

examples.en: All the publicity nearly sent him crazy.
examples.zh: 成天生活在公众的注意之下让他差一点发疯了。

senses.group: make somebody react 使某人作出反应

senses.def: to tell somebody clearly or rudely to go away
senses.zh: 叫某人卷铺盖走人；撵某人走

examples.en: She tried to interfere but I sent her packing.
examples.zh: 她想多管闲事，我把她赶走了！

senses.group: make somebody react 使某人作出反应

senses.def: used to say that you should accept an unpleasant situation or event because you cannot change it
senses.zh: （表示无法改变，应该接受）这些都是对我们的考验（或磨炼）
senses.group: make somebody react 使某人作出反应

senses.def: to tell somebody clearly or rudely to go away
senses.zh: 叫某人卷铺盖走人；撵某人走

examples.en: She tried to interfere but I sent her packing.
examples.zh: 她想多管闲事，我把她赶走了！

items.idm: these things are sent to try us

senses.def: used to say that you should accept an unpleasant situation or event because you cannot change it
senses.zh: （表示无法改变，应该接受）这些都是对我们的考验（或磨炼）

senses.def: to tell somebody clearly or rudely to go away
senses.zh: 叫某人卷铺盖走人；撵某人走

examples.en: She tried to interfere but I sent her packing.
examples.zh: 她想多管闲事，我把她赶走了！

senses.def: to refuse to speak to somebody, as a way of punishing them for something that they have done
senses.zh: 拒绝与某人交谈（作为惩罚）

senses.def: to write to somebody and ask them to send you something by post
to send somebody to prison
to order a student to leave a university because of bad behaviour
to ask or tell somebody to come to you, especially in order to help you

examples.en: Send for a doctor, quickly!
examples.zh: 请个大夫来，快！

senses.def: to ask somebody to bring or deliver something to you

examples.en: His son found him and sent for help.
examples.zh: 他儿子找到了他，然后向人求救。

examples.en: She sent for the latest sales figures.
examples.zh: 她要求把最新的销售统计数字给她送来。

senses.def: to send somebody away from you to another place
to produce a sound, signal, etc. so that other people can hear it, receive it, etc.

examples.en: He opened his mouth and sent forth a stream of noise.
examples.zh: 他张开嘴，发出一连串声音。

senses.def: to order somebody to go to a place to deal with a difficult situation
senses.zh: 派某人去（应付困难局面）

examples.en: Troops were sent in to restore order.
examples.zh: 部队被派去恢复秩序。

senses.def: to send something by post to a place where it will be dealt with

examples.en: Have you sent in your application yet?
examples.zh: 你把申请书寄去了没有？

senses.def: to write to somebody and ask them to send you something by post

examples.en: I've sent off for some books for my course.
examples.zh: 我已去函邮购一些上课用的书。

senses.def: to order somebody to leave the field because they have broken the rules of the game

examples.en: Bale was sent off for a foul in the second half.
examples.zh: 贝尔在下半场因犯规被罚下场。

senses.def: to send something to a place by post

examples.en: I'm sending the files off to my boss tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天我要把这些档案给老板寄去。

senses.def: an occasion when people come together to say goodbye to somebody who is leaving

examples.en: Her colleagues gave her a good send-off.
examples.zh: 她的同事们为她热烈送行。

senses.def: to send something to a place so that it arrives before you get there

examples.en: We sent our furniture on by ship.
examples.zh: 我们提前把家具水运过去了。

senses.def: to send a letter that has been sent to somebody’s old address to their new address

examples.en: They promised to send on our mail when we moved.
examples.zh: 他们答应在我们搬家后把信件转寄给我们。

senses.def: to send something from one place/person to another

examples.en: They arranged for the information to be sent on to us.
examples.zh: 他们托人把信息转告我们。

senses.def: to send something to a lot of different people or places

examples.en: Have the invitations been sent out yet?
examples.zh: 请柬分发出去了没有？

senses.def: to produce something, such as light, a signal, sound, etc.

examples.en: The sun sends out light and heat.
examples.zh: 太阳发出光和热。〈phr.〉

senses.def: to ask a restaurant or shop to deliver food to you at home or at work

examples.en: Let's send out for a pizza.
examples.zh: 我们订一份外送比萨吧。

senses.def: to make people laugh at somebody/something by copying them/it in a funny way
senses.zh: （通过滑稽模仿）取笑，讽刺，挖苦

examples.en: a TV programme that sends up politicians
examples.zh: 模仿取笑政治人物的电视节目

senses.def: to send somebody to prison
an act of making somebody/something look silly by copying them in a funny way

examples.en: Her book is a hilarious send-up of a conventional spy story.
examples.zh: 她写的书用的是取笑传统侦探小说的笔法，令人捧腹。

senses.def: a person who sends something

examples.en: If undelivered, please return to sender.
examples.zh: 若无法投递，请退还寄信人。

senses.def: a situation when a referee
a member of a native North American people, many of whom now live in the US states of New York and Ohio
senses.zh: 塞内卡人（美洲土著，很多现居于美国纽约州和俄亥俄州）

senses.def: a country in West Africa
(a person) from Senegal
senses.zh: 塞内加尔人；塞内加尔的；塞内加尔人的

senses.def: the process of becoming old and showing the effects of being old
old and showing the effects of being old
behaving in a confused or strange way, and unable to remember things, because you are old

examples.en: I think she's going senile.
examples.zh: 我想她是衰老了。

examples.en: Her senile grandfather lives with them.
examples.zh: 她年迈的祖父和他们住在一起。

senses.def: caused by old age

examples.en: senile cataracts
examples.zh: 老年性白内障

senses.def: a term used in the past to mean Alzheimer's
the condition of being senile

examples.en: an old man on the verge of senility
examples.zh: 渐显龙钟之态的老人

senses.def: high in rank or status; higher in rank or status than others

examples.en: a senior official/officer/manager/executive
examples.zh: 高级官员／军官／经理／主管

examples.en: a senior adviser/analyst/lecturer
examples.zh: 高级顾问／分析师／讲师

examples.en: a senior partner in a law firm
examples.zh: 律师事务所的高级合伙人

examples.en: She is senior vice president of marketing.
examples.zh: 她是主管营销的高级副总裁。

examples.en: senior figures in the Labour party
examples.zh: 工党高层人物

examples.en: senior members of staff
examples.zh: 高级职员

examples.en: a senior position
examples.zh: 高级职位

examples.en: a senior post/job
examples.zh: 高级职位/工作

examples.en: I have ten years' experience at senior management level.
examples.zh: 我有十年的高层管理经验。

examples.en: Junior nurses usually work alongside more senior nurses.
examples.zh: 初级护士通常和较高级的护士一起工作。

examples.en: He is a former senior civil servant who now runs a campaign website.
examples.zh: 他是一名前高级公务员，现在经营一个竞选网站。

examples.en: He is senior to me.
examples.zh: 他的职位比我高。

examples.en: The meeting should be chaired by the most senior person present.
examples.zh: 会议应由在座的职位最高的人主持。

senses.def: for adults or people at a more advanced level

examples.en: to take part in senior competitions
examples.zh: 参加成人比赛

examples.en: his first game of senior football
examples.zh: 他的第一场成年足球比赛

examples.en: He won the senior men's 400 metres.
examples.zh: 他获得男子甲组 400 米冠军。

senses.def: for senior citizens
senses.zh: （尤指已退休）年纪大的，老年的

examples.en: Get one third off rail fares with a senior railcard.
examples.zh: 持有老年火车通行优惠卡可减免三分之一车费。

examples.en: senior discounts/concessions
examples.zh: 老年折扣／优惠

senses.group: for older people 年长之人

senses.def: used after the name of a man who has the same name as his son, to make it clear who is being referred to
senses.zh: （父子同名时，加在父亲的名字后）老，大

senses.def: for children over the age of 11 or 13
senses.zh: 中等的，中学的（招收 11 或 13 岁以上学生）

senses.def: connected with the last year in high school

examples.en: the senior prom
examples.zh: 毕业年级舞会

senses.def: a person who is older than somebody else

examples.en: She was ten years his senior.
examples.zh: 她比他大十岁。

examples.en: My brother is my senior by two years.
examples.zh: 我哥哥比我大两岁。

senses.def: an older person, especially somebody who has retired from work

examples.en: His company helps seniors maintain their independence
examples.zh: 他的公司帮助老年人保持独立

senses.def: a person who is higher in rank or status
senses.zh: 级别（或地位）较高者；上级；上司

examples.en: She felt unappreciated both by her colleagues and her seniors.
examples.zh: 她觉得无论同事还是上司都不赏识她。

senses.def: adults or people who have reached an advanced level
senses.zh: 资深成人运动员；高水平运动员

examples.en: tennis coaching for juniors and seniors
examples.zh: 初、高级网球训练

senses.def: a child at a senior school; an older child in a school
(in the US and some other countries) a student in the last year at a high school
senses.zh: （美国等若干国家高中和大学的）毕业班学生

examples.en: high school seniors
examples.zh: 高中毕业班学生

senses.def: a male member of one of the lower ranks of the British air force
a female member of one of the lower ranks of the British air force
an officer of middle rank in the US navy
an older person, especially somebody who has retired from work

examples.en: discounts/travel concessions for senior citizens
examples.zh: 老年人折扣/旅行优惠

senses.def: a room used for social activities by teaching staff in a college or university
senses.zh: （大学的）教师联谊活动室，教师交谊厅

senses.def: a school for young people between the ages of 14 and 18
an officer of middle rank in the US air force
an occasion when somebody forgets something, or does not think clearly (thought to be typical of what happens when people get older)
senses.zh: 年长表现（幽默表达，指人失忆、忘事、糊涂的状况）

examples.en: It was an important meeting and a bad time to have a senior moment.
examples.zh: 那是个重要会议，可不能犯糊涂。

senses.def: a person in charge of a group of nurses in a hospital
the fact of being older or of a higher rank than others

examples.en: a position of seniority
examples.zh: 高级职位

senses.def: the rank that you have in a company because of the length of time you have worked there

examples.en: a lawyer with five years’ seniority
examples.zh: 有五年从业经验的律师

examples.en: Should promotion be based on merit or seniority?
examples.zh: 提拔一个人应当看业绩，还是看资历？

senses.def: a feeling that you get when something affects your body

examples.en: a tingling/burning sensation
examples.zh: 刺痛／烧灼的感觉

examples.en: I had a sensation of falling, as if in a dream.
examples.zh: 我有一种坠落的感觉，像在梦中似的。

senses.def: the ability to feel through your sense of touch

examples.en: She seemed to have lost all sensation in her arms.
examples.zh: 她的两条胳膊好像完全失去知觉了。

senses.def: a general feeling or impression that is difficult to explain; an experience or a memory
senses.zh: 直觉；莫名其妙的感觉；经历；回忆

examples.en: He had the eerie sensation of being watched.
examples.zh: 他不安地感到有人在监视他。

examples.en: When I arrived, I had the sensation that she had been expecting me.
examples.zh: 我到那儿后，感觉到她一直在等着我。

senses.def: very great surprise, excitement, or interest among a lot of people; the person or the thing that causes this surprise
senses.zh: 轰动；哗然；引起轰动的人（或事物）

examples.en: News of his arrest caused a sensation.
examples.zh: 他被捕的消息引起了轰动。

examples.en: The band became a sensation overnight.
examples.zh: 一夜之间，这支乐队名声大振。

senses.def: causing great surprise, excitement, or interest

examples.en: The result was a sensational 4–1 victory.
examples.zh: 比赛结果是轰动性的，以 4:1 狂胜对手。

examples.en: The affair was the most sensational political sex scandal of the century.
examples.zh: 这起事件是本世纪最轰动的政治性丑闻。

senses.def: trying to get your interest by presenting facts or events as worse or more shocking
senses.zh: 哗众取宠的；耸人听闻的

examples.en: sensational news stories
examples.zh: 引起轰动的新闻报道

senses.def: extremely good; wonderful

examples.en: You look sensational in that dress!
examples.zh: 你穿这件连衣裙漂亮极了！

senses.def: a way of getting people’s interest by using words that are intended to shock you or by presenting facts and events as worse or more shocking
senses.zh: （行文或报道）耸人听闻，哗众取宠

examples.en: the sensationalism of the popular press
examples.zh: 为大众服务的新闻界所使用的耸动视听的做法。

senses.def: getting people's interest by using words that are intended to shock or by presenting facts and events as worse or more shocking
senses.zh: （指行文或报道）耸人听闻，哗众取宠

examples.en: sensationalist headlines
examples.zh: 博人眼球的标题

senses.def: to make a story seem more exciting or shocking
senses.zh: 耸人听闻地夸张；大肆渲染

senses.def: in a way that causes great surprise, excitement or interest

examples.en: They won sensationally against the top team.
examples.zh: 他们战胜了那支头号强队，引起了轰动。

senses.def: in a way that tries to get your interest by presenting facts or events as worse or more shocking
senses.zh: 哗众取宠的；耸人听闻的

examples.en: The incident was sensationally reported in the press.
examples.zh: 报纸上对那一事件大肆渲染。

senses.def: in an extremely good or wonderful way

examples.en: He's sensationally good-looking!
examples.zh: 他帅呆了！

senses.def: an understanding about something; an ability to judge something

examples.en: One of the most important things in a partner is a sense of humour (= the ability to find things funny or make people laugh).
examples.zh: 作为一个生活伴侣，最重要的素质之一是幽默感。

examples.en: He has a very good sense of direction (= finds the way to a place easily).
examples.zh: 他的方向感很强。

examples.en: She has lost all sense of direction in her life (= the idea of what she should do in her life).
examples.zh: 她彻底失去了人生的方向感。

examples.en: Always try to keep a sense of proportion (= of the relative importance of different things).
examples.zh: 对事情随时都要把握好孰轻孰重。

examples.en: a sense of rhythm/timing
examples.zh: 节奏感；时机感

examples.en: a sense of fun/adventure
examples.zh: 一种乐趣/冒险的感觉

examples.en: Readers gain a real sense of what life was like in the camp.
examples.zh: 读者真切地感受到该营地的生活是什么样子的。

examples.en: Alex doesn't have any dress sense (= does not know which clothes look attractive).
examples.zh: 亚历克斯对服装毫无鉴赏力。

senses.def: good understanding and judgement; knowledge of what is sensible or practical behaviour
senses.zh: 见识；良好的判断；清醒的认识

examples.en: You should have the sense to take advice when it is offered.
examples.zh: 你要知道好歹，别人给你忠告，就该接受。

examples.en: There's no sense in (= it is not sensible) worrying about it now.
examples.zh: 现在大可不必为那件事忧虑。

examples.en: Can't you talk sense (= say something sensible)?
examples.zh: 你就不能说点正经的？

examples.en: There's a lot of sense in what Mary says.
examples.zh: 玛丽说得很在理。

senses.def: the meaning that a word or phrase has; a way of understanding something
senses.zh: 意义；含义；理解…的方式；看待…的角度

examples.en: That word has three senses.
examples.zh: 那个词有三个意思。

examples.en: The word ‘love’ is used in different senses by different people.
examples.zh: “爱”这个字不同的人用来表示不同的意思。

examples.en: Globalization in the broadest sense is nothing new.
examples.zh: 最广泛意义上的全球化并不是什么新鲜事。

examples.en: The word ‘perspective’ is being used here in a technical sense.
examples.zh: 这里使用的“视角”一词是技术意义上的。

examples.en: He was a true friend, in every sense of the word (= in every possible way).
examples.zh: 无论从哪个角度讲，他都是个真正的朋友。

examples.en: In a sense (= in one way) it doesn't matter any more.
examples.zh: 从某种意义上说，这事已无关紧要了。

examples.en: In some senses (= in one or more ways) the criticisms were justified.
examples.zh: 在一定意义上，那些批评意见是有道理的。

examples.en: In no sense can the issue be said to be resolved.
examples.zh: 无论如何这个问题都不能说已经解决了。

examples.en: I am using ‘cold’ in the sense of ‘unfriendly’.
examples.zh: 我这里用“冷”表示“不友好”。

examples.en: I don't mean that the press ought to be free in the sense that no one ought to pay for it.
examples.zh: 我并不是说媒体应该自由，因为没有人应该为此付费。

examples.en: There is a sense in which we are all to blame for the tragedy.
examples.zh: 在某种意义上，对这个悲剧我们大家都有责任。

senses.def: one of the five powers (sight, hearing, smell, taste and touch) that your body uses to get information about the world around you
senses.zh: 感觉官能（即视、听、嗅、味、触五觉）

examples.en: the five senses
examples.zh: 五种感觉官能

examples.en: Dogs have a keen sense (= strong sense) of smell.
examples.zh: 狗的嗅觉很灵敏。

examples.en: the sense organs (= eyes, ears, nose, etc.)
examples.zh: 感觉器官

examples.en: I could hardly believe the evidence of my own senses (= what I could see, hear, etc.).
examples.zh: 我简直不敢相信自己的感觉。

examples.en: The mixture of sights, smells and sounds around her made her senses reel.
examples.zh: 四周的景象、气味和声音纷至沓来，使她晕头转向。

senses.def: a feeling about something important

examples.en: His career was guided by a strong sense of duty.
examples.zh: 强烈的责任感引领着他的事业。

examples.en: There is now a sense of urgency to fix the problem.
examples.zh: 现在有一种解决问题的紧迫感。

examples.en: I have found a sense of purpose in the work I do here.
examples.zh: 我在这里的工作中找到了使命感。

examples.en: Most people in the country have a strong sense of national identity.
examples.zh: 该国大多数人都有强烈的民族认同感。

examples.en: My parents instilled a strong sense of responsibility in me.
examples.zh: 我的父母给我灌输了强烈的责任感。

examples.en: Clubs try to create a sense of community.
examples.zh: 俱乐部力求营造一种群体意识。

examples.en: Helmets can give cyclists a false sense of security.
examples.zh: 头盔能给骑车人一种虚假的安全感。

examples.en: He felt an overwhelming sense of loss.
examples.zh: 他感到非常失落。

examples.en: I had the sense that he was worried about something.
examples.zh: 我感觉他有心事。

examples.en: I got the sense that she wasn't very pleased to see us.
examples.zh: 我感觉她见到我们不是很高兴。

senses.def: a normal state of mind; the ability to think clearly
senses.zh: 健全的心智；清醒的思维能力；理智

examples.en: If she threatens to leave, it should bring him to his senses.
examples.zh: 假如她威胁着要走，说不定他会清醒过来。

examples.en: I waited for them to come to their senses and return.
examples.zh: 我等待着他们回过神来并回来。

examples.en: No one in their right senses would give him the job!
examples.zh: 任何有理智的人都不会给他这份工作！

examples.en: Are you out of your senses? You'll be killed!
examples.zh: 你疯了吗？你会丢了性命的！

senses.group: normal state of mind 正常的精神状态

the first novel (1811) by Jane Austen
senses.zh: 理智与情感：简·奥斯丁的第一本小说（1811年），其中一部巧妙的喜剧讲述了金钱和婚姻对英国上层中产阶级的重要性。这是达什伍德（Dashwood）一家的故事，特别是两个姐妹，埃莉诺（Elinor）非常懂事，玛丽安（Marianne）更加激动。他们爱上了两个男人，但随后发现他们俩已经订婚。当爱琳娜（Elinor）所爱的男人爱德华（Edward）既失去了财富，又失去了自己要娶的女人时，他很乐意嫁给他真正爱的女人埃莉诺（Elinor）。然而，玛丽安（Marianne）所爱的男人威洛比（Willoughby）却让她嫁给了一个有钱的女人。她有一段时间很难过，但最终嫁给了别人。

senses.zh: 9月11日：2001年9月11日，当天在纽约和美国其他地方发生了一系列重大恐怖袭击。恐怖分子使用从美国东海岸劫持的四架客机进行袭击。上午8.46，第一架飞机坠入纽约世界贸易中心TM的北塔。上午9.03，第二架飞机坠入南塔。不到90分钟后，两座塔楼都倒下了。第三架飞机撞上五角大楼，第四架撞到宾夕法尼亚州的一个野外。在这次袭击中有近3000人死亡，这一数字比第二次世界大战对珍珠港袭击中的死亡人数还要多。这些袭击被视为是由本萨登（Osama Bin Laden）领导的恐怖组织基地组织（Al Qaeda）的工作。它们导致许多国家通过了强有力的反恐法律，并导致了美国主导的阿富汗战争，而本拉登被认为藏匿在阿富汗。2011年，他在巴基斯坦被发现并被杀害。

examples.zh: 她一盘未失，完胜对手。

senses.def: a group of things regarded as a unit because they all have particular qualities in common

examples.en: the set of all square numbers less than 50
examples.zh: 50 以下的所有平方数集

senses.def: a series of songs or pieces of music that a musician or group performs at a concert

examples.en: a stunning solo set of ten songs
examples.zh: 令人惊叹的十首独奏歌曲

senses.def: a group of school students with a similar ability in a particular subject
senses.zh: （在某学科上能力相当的）一批学生

examples.en: She's in the top set for French.
examples.zh: 她的法语成绩名列前茅。

senses.def: the way in which somebody’s face or body is fixed in a particular expression, especially one showing a feeling of being determined

examples.en: She admired the firm set of his jaw.
examples.zh: 她喜欢他那副紧绷着下巴的刚毅神态。

senses.def: an act of arranging hair in a particular style while it is wet

examples.en: A shampoo and set costs £15.
examples.zh: 洗头并做发型共 15 英镑。

senses.def: the state of becoming solid or hard

examples.en: To be sure of a good set when making the jam, use preserving sugar with added pectin.
examples.zh: 为了确保制作果酱时效果良好，请使用添加果胶的保鲜糖。

senses.def: a hole in the ground where a badger
a young plant, shoot

examples.en: onion sets
examples.zh: 洋葱苗

senses.def: in a particular position

examples.en: a house set in 40 acres of parkland
examples.zh: 一所坐落在一片 40 英亩开阔绿地上的房子

examples.en: He had close-set eyes.
examples.zh: 他的两眼靠得很近。

senses.def: planned or fixed
senses.zh: 安排好的；确定的；固定的

examples.en: Each person was given set jobs to do.
examples.zh: 给每个人分配了预先定好的工作。

examples.en: The school funds a set number of free places.
examples.zh: 学校资助固定数目的免费生。

examples.en: Mornings in our house always follow a set pattern.
examples.zh: 在我们家，每天早上的生活总是遵循一种固定的模式。

examples.en: New vehicles must comply with set safety standards.
examples.zh: 新车必须符合现有的安全标准。

senses.def: not likely to change

examples.en: set ideas/opinions/views on how to teach
examples.zh: 不变的教学思想／主张／观点

examples.en: As people get older, they get set in their ways.
examples.zh: 随着年龄的增长，人就积习成性。

examples.en: He had very set ideas of what he wanted.
examples.zh: 他对于想要的东西非常固执。

senses.def: having a fixed price and a limited choice of dishes

examples.en: a set dinner/lunch/meal
examples.zh: 一份晚餐／午餐套餐；一份套餐

examples.en: Shall we have the set menu?
examples.zh: 我们吃套餐好吗？

senses.def: likely to do something; ready for something or to do something

examples.en: The team looks set for victory.
examples.zh: 看来这个队能赢。

examples.en: Interest rates look set to rise again.
examples.zh: 看样子利率又要提高了。

examples.en: Be set to leave by 10 o'clock.
examples.zh: 做好准备，最晚 10 点钟走。

examples.en: Get set… Go!
examples.zh: 预备 － 跑！

senses.def: fixed; not natural

examples.en: a set smile
examples.zh: 僵硬的笑容

examples.en: His face took on a set expression.
examples.zh: 他脸上现出凝滞的神态。

senses.def: to be strongly opposed to something

examples.en: Why are you so dead set against the idea?
examples.zh: 你为什么那样死命地反对这个主意呢？

examples.en: Her parents are dead set against the marriage.
examples.zh: 她的父母坚决反对这门婚事。

senses.def: to want to do or have something very much; to be determined to do something
senses.zh: 一心想做；决心做；十分想得到

examples.en: She’s set on a career in medicine.
examples.zh: 她立志从事医学事业。

examples.en: He’s set on getting a new car
examples.zh: 他准备买一辆新车

what you say to tell people to start a race

note.en: Idioms containing set are at the entries for the nouns and adjectives in the idioms, for example set the pace is at pace n.

having the necessary qualities or conditions to succeed
senses.zh: 有成功的素质；具备成功的条件

examples.en: She seems set fair to win the championship.
examples.zh: 她似乎具备夺冠的条件。

examples.en: Conditions were set fair for stable economic development.
examples.zh: 形势适合经济稳定发展。

senses.def: to enter or visit a place

examples.en: the first man to set foot on the moon
examples.zh: 第一个登上月球的人

examples.en: I vowed never to set foot in the place again.
examples.zh: 我发誓再不去那个地方了。

senses.def: to make something start burning

examples.en: A spark from the fire had set light to a rug.
examples.zh: 从火炉迸出的火星点燃了地毯。

senses.def: to begin a trip by sea

examples.en: a liner setting sail from New York
examples.zh: 自纽约起航的邮轮

examples.en: We set sail (for France) at high tide.
examples.zh: 我们在涨潮时起航（前往法国）。

senses.def: to make somebody/something independent or successful

examples.en: His business sense helped set the club on its feet again.
examples.zh: 他的经营意识使俱乐部又重振雄风。

senses.def: to make somebody feel physically uncomfortable

examples.en: Just the sound of her voice sets my teeth on edge.
examples.zh: 我一听到她的声音就浑身不舒服。

senses.def: to prepare or start something

examples.en: That telephone call set in train a whole series of events.
examples.zh: 那个电话把一整套事项安排好了。

senses.def: to set a standard of quality or performance

examples.en: The show really sets the bar for artistic invention.
examples.zh: 这场演出真正为艺术创新设立了标杆。

examples.en: Sofia sets the bar very high for what she expects of herself.
examples.zh: 索菲亚对自己的期望设定得非常高。

senses.def: to do something at a particular speed or to a particular standard so that other people are then forced to copy it if they want to be successful
senses.zh: 确定速度；确立标准；领先

examples.en: The company is no longer setting the pace in the home computer market.
examples.zh: 这家公司再也不能在国内计算机市场上独领风骚了。

senses.def: to run faster than the other people taking part, at a speed that they then try to copy

examples.en: Willis set the pace for the first mile.
examples.zh: 威利斯设定了第一英里的配速。

senses.def: to create a situation in which something can easily happen or develop
senses.zh: 为…做好准备（或铺平道路）

examples.en: His arrival set the scene for another argument.
examples.zh: 他这一来，又会引起一场争论。

senses.def: to give somebody the information and details they need in order to understand what comes next

examples.en: The first part of the programme was just setting the scene.
examples.zh: 节目的第一部分不过是介绍背景而已。

examples.en: The scene is set in the first paragraph with an account of Sally's childhood.
examples.zh: 第一段中通过对萨莉童年的描述设定了故事的背景。

senses.def: to make something definite or complete
senses.zh: 使某事万无一失；使某事圆满

examples.en: Her election to the premiership set the seal on a remarkable political career.
examples.zh: 当选总理使她的政治生涯灿烂辉煌。

senses.def: to make it possible for something to happen; to make something likely to happen
senses.zh: 使某事成为可能；为某事铺平道路

examples.en: Family problems in childhood can set the stage for stress in adult life.
examples.zh: 童年时期的家庭问题可能为成年生活带来压力。

examples.en: The thrilling semi-finals set the stage for what should be a great game.
examples.zh: 半决赛尚且激动人心，决赛将更扣人心弦了。

senses.def: to be very successful and admired by other people

examples.en: He's never going to set the world alight with his paintings.
examples.zh: 他永远不会用他的画作来点亮世界。

senses.def: to be very successful and admired by other people

examples.en: He's never going to set the world on fire with his paintings.
examples.zh: 他的绘画永远不会引起轰动。

senses.def: to cause people to start talking/people are talking about somebody’s private affairs
senses.zh: （惹得）满城风雨；（使）议论纷纷；招（或说）闲话

examples.en: His sudden resignation set tongues wagging.
examples.zh: 他的突然辞职引起了人们的议论。

examples.en: This is a small island and tongues are beginning to wag.
examples.zh: 这是一个小岛, 人们开始议论纷纷。

senses.def: to make a place your home

examples.en: They set up house together in a small flat in Brighton.
examples.zh: 他们一同在布赖顿的一个小公寓里建立了家庭。

examples.en: They want to set up house together.
examples.zh: 他们想共同建设住房。

senses.def: to start a business

examples.en: an area where many artists have set up shop
examples.zh: 有很多艺术从业者聚集的地区

examples.en: Some buskers had set up shop outside the station.
examples.zh: 一些街头艺人在车站外开设了商店。

senses.def: to be determined to oppose somebody/something

examples.en: It is a shame that the council has set its face against the scheme.
examples.zh: 令人遗憾的是，该委员会坚决反对该计划。

senses.def: to start doing something

examples.en: She set about the business of cleaning the house.
examples.zh: 她动手打扫起房子来。

examples.en: We need to set about finding a solution.
examples.zh: 我们得着手寻找一个解决办法。

senses.def: to make somebody oppose a friend, relative, etc.
senses.zh: 使某人反对（朋友、亲人等）

examples.en: My ex set all our friends against me.
examples.zh: 我的前任让我们所有的朋友都反对我。

senses.def: to judge something by comparing good or positive qualities with bad or negative ones

examples.en: Set against the benefits of the new technology, there is also a strong possibility that jobs will be lost.
examples.zh: 权衡利弊，新技术的确有种种好处，但也很可能使一些人失去工作。

senses.def: to record something as a business cost as a way of reducing the amount of tax you must pay
senses.zh: 把…按营业成本记账以降低（税额）

examples.en: to set capital costs off against tax
examples.zh: 把资金成本按营业成本记账以减税

senses.def: to make somebody/something different from or better than others
senses.zh: 使与众不同；使突出；使优于…

examples.en: Her elegant style sets her apart from other journalists.
examples.zh: 她的高雅风格使她与其他记者截然不同。

senses.def: to keep something for a special use or purpose

examples.en: Two rooms were set apart for use as libraries.
examples.zh: 留出两个房间作为图书室。

senses.def: to save or keep money, time, land, etc. for a particular purpose
senses.zh: 省出，留出（钱、时间、土地等）

examples.en: She tries to set aside some money every month.
examples.zh: 她每个月都尽量存点钱。

examples.en: The government has set aside thousands of acres of land as protected wilderness.
examples.zh: 政府留出几千英亩土地作为自然环境保护区。

senses.def: to not consider something, because other things are more important

examples.en: Let's set aside my personal feelings for now.
examples.zh: 目前咱们就不要顾及我的个人感情了。

senses.def: to officially state that a decision made by a court is not legally acceptable
senses.zh: 撤销（法院的判决）；宣布无效

examples.en: The verdict was set aside by the Appeal Court.
examples.zh: 上诉法庭驳回了那个裁决。

senses.def: a system in which the government pays farmers not to use some of their land for growing crops; the land that the farmers are paid not to use
senses.zh: 退耕补贴制度（由政府补贴，鼓励农民退耕部分耕地）；退耕地

examples.en: 750 acres of set-aside
examples.zh: 汤姆舒适地坐在桌子旁边。

examples.en: set-aside payments
examples.zh: 预留付款

senses.def: to delay the progress of something/somebody by a particular time

examples.en: The bad weather set back the building programme by several weeks.
examples.zh: 天气恶劣，建筑计划延误了几个星期。

senses.def: to cost somebody a particular amount of money

examples.en: The repairs could set you back over £200.
examples.zh: 这次修理大概得花你 200 多英镑。

senses.def: to place something, especially a building, at a distance from something
senses.zh: 使（建筑物等）与…拉开距离

examples.en: The house is set well back from the road.
examples.zh: 这座房子离公路挺远。

senses.def: a book that students must study for a particular exam
to stop and allow somebody to get off

examples.en: Passengers may be set down and picked up only at the official stops.
examples.zh: 乘客只有在正式车站方可上下车。

senses.def: to write something down on paper in order to record it
to give something as a rule, principle, etc.

examples.en: The standards were set down by the governing body.
examples.zh: 这些标准是由管理机构制定的。

senses.def: to start a journey
to present something or make it known

examples.en: The president set forth his views in a television broadcast.
examples.zh: 总统在电视讲话中阐述了自己的观点。

senses.def: to begin and seem likely to continue

examples.en: The rain seemed to have set in for the day.
examples.zh: 这雨好像要下一天了。

senses.def: to fasten something into a flat surface so that it does not stick out from it

examples.en: a plaque set into the wall
examples.zh: 嵌在墙上的牌匾

senses.def: to fasten something into a flat surface so that it does not stick out from it

examples.en: a plaque set into the wall
examples.zh: 嵌在墙上的牌匾

senses.def: to begin a journey

examples.en: We set off for London just after ten.
examples.zh: 刚过十点，我们就动身上伦敦去了。

senses.def: to make a bomb, etc. explode

examples.en: A gang of boys were setting off fireworks in the street.
examples.zh: 一帮男孩子正在街上放烟火。

senses.def: to make an alarm start ringing

examples.en: Opening this door will set off the alarm.
examples.zh: 一开这道门，警铃就会响。

senses.def: to start a process or series of events

examples.en: Panic on the stock market set off a wave of selling.
examples.zh: 股市恐慌引发了一轮抛售潮。

senses.def: to make something more attractive or easy to notice by being placed near it
senses.zh: 衬托；使显得更漂亮（或更突出）

examples.en: That blouse sets off the blue of her eyes.
examples.zh: 那件上衣衬托出了她的蓝眼睛。

senses.def: to make somebody start doing something such as laughing, crying or talking
senses.zh: 使某人笑（或哭、说等）起来

senses.def: to attack somebody suddenly

examples.en: I opened the gate, and was immediately set on by a large dog.
examples.zh: 我一开门，一条大狗就迎面扑来。

senses.def: to make a person or an animal attack somebody suddenly

examples.en: The farmer threatened to set his dogs on us.
examples.zh: 农场主威胁要放出狗来咬我们。

senses.def: to leave a place and begin a journey

examples.en: They set out on the last stage of their journey.
examples.zh: 他们动身踏上最后一段行程。

senses.def: to begin a job, task, etc. with a particular aim or goal
senses.zh: （怀着目标）开始工作，展开任务

examples.en: She set out to break the world record.
examples.zh: 她一心努力要打破世界纪录。

examples.en: They succeeded in what they set out to do.
examples.zh: 他们实现了既定的目标。

senses.def: to arrange or display things

examples.en: Her work is always very well set out.
examples.zh: 她总是把工作安排得很有条理。

senses.def: to present ideas, facts, etc. in an organized way, in speech or writing

examples.en: He set out his objections to the plan.
examples.zh: 他陈述了他对这个计划的反对意见。

examples.en: She set out the reasons for her resignation in a long letter.
examples.zh: 她写了一封长信说明自己辞职的原因。

senses.def: a phrase that is always used in the same form

examples.en: Don't worry about the grammar, just learn this as a set phrase.
examples.zh: 别管语法，只要把这个作为固定词组来学习即可。

senses.def: a part of a play, film, piece of music, etc. that has a well-known pattern or style, and is used to create a particular effect
senses.zh: （戏剧、电影、音乐等中的）固定模式

examples.en: The play contained all kinds of theatrical set pieces.
examples.zh: 该剧包含了各种戏剧场景。

senses.def: a move in a sports game that is well planned and practised

examples.en: to score from a set piece
examples.zh: 定位球得分

senses.def: a point that, if won by a player, will win them the set (7)
senses.zh: 盘点（再得一分即赢下该盘）

senses.def: a shot using both hands, made while standing still
an instrument for drawing straight lines and angles, made from a flat piece of plastic or metal in the shape of a triangle
a book that students must study for a particular exam
to begin doing something in a busy or determined way
senses.zh: 起劲地干起来；毅然开始做

senses.def: a small fight or an argument

examples.en: We had a bit of a set-to with the neighbours.
examples.zh: 我们和邻居发生了一些争执。

senses.def: a device that allows digital television from cable, satellite, the internet, etc. to be seen on a television set that does not have this feature built in (= as part of the television)
senses.zh: 机顶盒（数字电视机转接装置，把数字电视信号转换成普通电视信号）

senses.def: to provide somebody with the money that they need in order to do something

examples.en: A bank loan helped to set him up in business.
examples.zh: 他靠一笔银行贷款做起了生意。

senses.def: to make somebody healthier, stronger, more lively, etc.
senses.zh: 使更健康（或强壮、活泼等）

examples.en: The break from work really set me up for the new year.
examples.zh: 放下工作稍事休息，的确使我更有精力在新的一年大干一场了。

senses.def: to trick somebody, especially by making them appear guilty of something

examples.en: He denied the charges, saying the police had set him up.
examples.zh: 他否认那些指控，说警察冤枉他了。

senses.def: to create something or start it

examples.en: to set up a business
examples.zh: 开办公司

examples.en: A fund will be set up for the dead men's families.
examples.zh: 将为死者家属设立一项基金。

senses.def: to build something or put something somewhere

examples.en: The police set up roadblocks on routes out of the city.
examples.zh: 警察在城外的路上设置了路障。

senses.def: to make a piece of equipment or a machine ready for use
senses.zh: 安装好，装配好，调试好（设备或机器）

examples.en: She set up her guitar and amp in her bedroom.
examples.zh: 她把吉他和扩音器组装在了卧室里。

senses.def: to arrange for something to happen

examples.en: I've set up a meeting for Friday.
examples.zh: 我已安排好在星期五开会。

senses.def: to start a process or a series of events

examples.en: The slump on Wall Street set up a chain reaction in stock markets around the world.
examples.zh: 华尔街股价暴跌在全球股票市场上引起了连锁反应。

senses.def: to start running a business

examples.en: She took out a bank loan and set up on her own.
examples.zh: 她从银行贷了一笔款，自己干起来了。

examples.en: After leaving college, he set himself up as a freelance photographer.
examples.zh: 大学毕业后，他干起了自由摄影师。

senses.def: a way of organizing something; a system

examples.en: I've only been here a couple of weeks and I don't really know the set-up.
examples.zh: 我刚来几个星期，对这里的组织情况不大了解。

examples.en: What’s the set-up in your family—who does the cooking?
examples.zh: 你们家里是怎么安排的——谁负责烧饭？

senses.def: a situation in which somebody tricks you or makes it seem as if you have done something wrong

examples.en: He didn't steal the goods. It was a set-up.
examples.zh: 那些商品不是他偷的，这是栽赃。

senses.def: to attack somebody suddenly

examples.en: I opened the gate, and was immediately set on by a large dog.
examples.zh: 我一开门，一条大狗就迎面扑来。

senses.def: to consider something to be important

examples.en: She sets great store by her appearance.
examples.zh: 她十分看重自己的外貌。

examples.en: It is unwise to put too much store by these statistics.
examples.zh: 过分重视这些统计数字是不明智的。

senses.def: to start something moving

examples.en: They set the machinery in motion.
examples.zh: 他们将机器开动起来。

examples.en: The wheels of change have been set in motion.
examples.zh: 变革的车轮已经开始运转。

examples.en: He wound the key and set the toy in motion.
examples.zh: 他转动钥匙，让玩具动了起来。

senses.def: to talk about how the world could be changed to be a better place
senses.zh: 谈论如何使世界变得更好

examples.en: We stayed up all night, setting the world to rights.
examples.zh: 我们一夜没睡，谈论着如何拯救世界。

senses.def: a difficulty or problem that delays or prevents something, or makes a situation worse

examples.en: The team suffered a major setback when their best player was injured.
examples.zh: 最优秀的队员受了伤，使得这支队伍的实力大打折扣。

examples.en: The breakdown in talks represents a temporary setback in the peace process.
examples.zh: 谈判破裂意味着和平进程暂时受阻。

senses.def: a merchant
a rich man
a title added to a name to indicate high social status
senses.zh: 塞斯（表示社会地位高的头衔）

senses.def: a first name for boys
a hole in the ground where a badger
a long comfortable seat with a back and arms, for two or more people to sit on

examples.en: He slumped down exhausted on the settee.
examples.zh: 他筋疲力尽地跌坐在长椅上。

examples.en: She found her glasses lying on the settee.
examples.zh: 她发现自己的眼镜搁在长椅上。

senses.def: a large dog with long hair, sometimes used in hunting. There are several types of setter
senses.zh: 蹲伏猎狗，雪达犬（体大毛长，有几个品种）

examples.en: an Irish setter
examples.zh: 爱尔兰蹲伏猎狗

examples.en: a red setter
examples.zh: 红色蹲伏狗

senses.def: a person who sets something

examples.en: a quiz setter
examples.zh: 命题人

senses.def: to put an end to an argument or a disagreement
senses.zh: 结束（争论、争端等）；解决（分歧、纠纷等）

examples.en: to settle a dispute/a matter/an issue
examples.zh: 解决争端／事情／问题

examples.en: to settle a case/lawsuit/claim
examples.zh: 结案；结束诉讼／索赔

examples.en: to settle an argument/a disagreement
examples.zh: 解决争论/分歧

examples.en: It's time you settled your differences with your father.
examples.zh: 现在你该解决同你父亲之间的分歧了。

examples.en: I want this thing settled.
examples.zh: 我希望解决此事。

examples.en: There is pressure on the unions to settle.
examples.zh: 工会组织面临消除纷争的压力。

examples.en: The company has agreed to settle out of court (= come to an agreement without going to court).
examples.zh: 那家公司同意庭外和解。

examples.en: Many cases are settled through negotiation.
examples.zh: 很多案件都是通过协商解决的。

examples.en: The corporation later settled with the singer for $1.5 million.
examples.zh: 该公司后来与该歌手以 150 万美元和解。

senses.def: to decide or arrange something finally

examples.en: It's all settled—we're leaving on the nine o'clock plane.
examples.zh: 一切都定下来了，我们乘九点的航班走。

examples.en: Good, that's settled, then.
examples.zh: 好，那就这么定了。

examples.en: Bob will be there? That settles it. I'm not coming.
examples.zh: 鲍勃会去吗？那好，我就不去了。

examples.en: He had to settle his affairs (= arrange all his personal business) in Paris before he could return home.
examples.zh: 他得把他在巴黎的事情处理好才能回家。

examples.en: It's been settled that we leave on the nine o'clock plane.
examples.zh: 已经定好我们乘坐九点的航班离开。

examples.en: All the loose ends should be settled within 48 hours.
examples.zh: 所有未尽事宜应在 48 小时内解决。

senses.def: to make a place your permanent home

examples.en: She settled in Vienna after her father's death.
examples.zh: 父亲死后，她就在维也纳定居了。

examples.en: She is an American who settled here a couple of years ago.
examples.zh: 她是一名美国人，几年前定居在这里。

examples.en: The couple afterwards settled near Bournemouth.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇后来在伯恩茅斯附近定居。

examples.en: He has now settled permanently in London.
examples.zh: 他现已在伦敦永久定居。

examples.en: He married and settled in a seaside cottage.
examples.zh: 他结婚并定居在海边小屋。

examples.en: His parents eventually settled in Paris.
examples.zh: 他的父母最终定居在巴黎。

senses.group: choose permanent home 选择永久住地

senses.def: to make your permanent home in a country or an area as colonists
senses.zh: 殖民；作为移民在殖民地定居

examples.en: This region was settled by the Dutch in the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 荷兰人于 19 世纪来到这一地区定居。

examples.en: a fertile area that was densely settled in early times
examples.zh: 早期人口稠密的肥沃地区

examples.en: They settled on undeveloped land along the Mississippi.
examples.zh: 他们定居在密西西比河沿岸未开垦的土地上。

examples.en: It was the worst drought since the British settled in Australia in 1788.
examples.zh: 这是自 1788 年英国人定居澳大利亚以来最严重的干旱。

examples.en: Very few Maori were living in the area when the first Europeans settled there.
examples.zh: 当第一批欧洲人在那里定居时，很少有毛利人居住在该地区。

senses.group: choose permanent home 选择永久住地

senses.def: to make yourself or somebody else comfortable in a new position

examples.en: Ellie settled back in her seat.
examples.zh: 埃利舒适地靠着椅背坐下。

examples.en: They prepared to settle in for the night (= make themselves comfortable for an evening at home).
examples.zh: 他们准备安顿下来过夜。

examples.en: He settled himself comfortably in his usual chair.
examples.zh: 他在自己惯常坐的椅子上舒舒服服地坐下来。

examples.en: I settled her on the sofa and put a blanket over her.
examples.zh: 我把她放在沙发上安顿好，给她盖了一条毯子。

senses.group: into comfortable position/state 进入舒适的位置／状态

senses.def: to put something carefully in a position so that it does not move

examples.en: She settled the blanket around her knees.
examples.zh: 她用毯子裹住膝盖。

senses.group: into comfortable position/state 进入舒适的位置／状态

senses.def: to become or make somebody/something become calm or relaxed
senses.zh: （使）平静下来，安静下来，定下心来

examples.en: The baby wouldn't settle.
examples.zh: 婴儿安静不下来。

examples.en: I took a pill to help settle my nerves.
examples.zh: 我吃了一片药，好镇定一下神经。

examples.en: This should settle your stomach.
examples.zh: 这样你的胃应该就不难受了。

senses.group: into comfortable position/state 进入舒适的位置／状态

senses.def: to fall from above and come to rest on something; to stay for some time on something

examples.en: Dust had settled on everything.
examples.zh: 到处落满灰尘。

examples.en: Two birds settled on the fence.
examples.zh: 两只鸟落在篱笆上。

examples.en: I don't think the snow will settle (= remain on the ground without melting).
examples.zh: 我看这雪存不住。

examples.en: His gaze settled on her face.
examples.zh: 他的目光落在她脸上。

examples.en: Slowly dusk began to settle.
examples.zh: 慢慢地，黄昏开始降临。

senses.def: to sink slowly down; to make something do this

examples.en: The contents of the package may have settled in transit.
examples.zh: 包裹里的东西可能在运输途中摇密实了。

examples.en: Don't drink it yet. Let the grounds settle.
examples.zh: 还没喝呢。让理由安定下来。

senses.def: to pay the money that you owe

examples.en: Please settle your bill before leaving the hotel.
examples.zh: 请您先结账再离开旅馆。

examples.en: The insurance company is refusing to settle her claim.
examples.zh: 保险公司拒付她提出的索赔款项。

examples.en: They used the last of the money to settle their debts.
examples.zh: 他们用最后的钱来还债。

examples.en: Let me settle with you for the meal.
examples.zh: 我来把饭费付给你。

examples.en: I'll pay now—we can settle up later.
examples.zh: 现在我来付账，咱们以后再算。

senses.def: to wait for a situation to become clear or certain
senses.zh: 待尘埃落定；待形势明朗

examples.en: He waited for the dust to settle after the election before making any new decisions.
examples.zh: 他等待选举结束后尘埃落定，然后再做出任何新决定。

senses.def: to hurt or punish somebody who has harmed or cheated you in the past
senses.zh: （和某人）算账，清算旧账；报复（某人）

examples.en: ‘Who would do such a thing?’ ‘Maybe someone with an old score to settle.’
examples.zh: “谁做得出这样的事呢？”“也许是结有宿怨的人吧。”

examples.en: An embittered Charlotte is determined to settle accounts with Elizabeth.
examples.zh: 愤怒的夏洛特决心与伊丽莎白算账。

senses.def: an old-fashioned piece of furniture with a long wooden seat and a high back and arms, often also with a box for storing things under the seat
senses.zh: 高背长椅（老式木家具，有扶手，座下多带柜）

items.idm: let the dust settle | wait for the dust to settle

senses.def: to get into a comfortable position, either sitting or lying

examples.en: She settled down in an armchair to watch television.
examples.zh: 她坐在扶手椅上看电视。

examples.en: I settled down with a book.
examples.zh: 我舒舒服服地坐下看书。

senses.def: to start to have a quieter way of life, living in one place
senses.zh: （在某地）定居下来，过安定的生活

examples.en: When are you going to get married and settle down?
examples.zh: 你打算什么时候成家，安定下来？

examples.en: It's time I settled down.
examples.zh: 我是时候安定下来了。

examples.en: She felt she wasn't yet ready to settle down.
examples.zh: 她觉得自己还没有准备好安顿下来。

senses.def: to become or make somebody become calm, less excited, etc.

examples.en: It always takes the class a while to settle down at the start of the lesson.
examples.zh: 那个班一上课总得过一会儿才能安静下来。

examples.en: Now, come on, settle down!
examples.zh: 现在，来吧，安定下来！

examples.en: I’m sure things will settle down soon.
examples.zh: 我确信事情很快就会安定下来。

examples.en: The early goal settled the home side down.
examples.zh: 早早的进球让主队锁定胜局。

senses.def: to accept something that is not exactly what you want but is the best that is available

examples.en: In the end they had to settle for a draw.
examples.zh: 最后，他们只好接受平局的结果。

examples.en: I couldn't afford the house I really wanted, so I had to settle for second best.
examples.zh: 我真心想要的房子我买不起，所以只得退而求其次了。

examples.en: He didn’t see why he should settle for less.
examples.zh: 他不明白为什么他应该满足于更少。

senses.def: to start to feel comfortable in a new home, job, etc.
senses.zh: 安顿下来；习惯于（新居）；适应（新工作）

examples.en: How are the kids settling into their new school?
examples.zh: 孩子们在新学校习惯了吗？

examples.en: You'll soon settle into a routine.
examples.zh: 你很快就会养成习惯。

examples.en: It’s not always easy for a new player to settle in.
examples.zh: 对于新玩家来说，适应并不总是那么容易。

senses.def: to start to feel comfortable in a new home, job, etc.
senses.zh: 安顿下来；习惯于（新居）；适应（新工作）

examples.en: How are the kids settling into their new school?
examples.zh: 孩子们在新学校习惯了吗？

examples.en: You'll soon settle into a routine.
examples.zh: 你很快就会养成习惯。

examples.en: It’s not always easy for a new player to settle in.
examples.zh: 对于新玩家来说，适应并不总是那么容易。

senses.def: to choose or make a decision about something after thinking about it

examples.en: Have you settled on a name for the baby yet?
examples.zh: 你给孩子起好名字没有？

examples.en: After much deliberation, he finally settled on a beautiful patterned rug.
examples.zh: 经过深思熟虑，他最终选定了一张漂亮的有图案的地毯。

senses.def: to formally arrange to give money or property to somebody, especially in a will
senses.zh: 转让（钱财）；（尤指在遗嘱中）赠与

examples.en: He settled part of his estate on his son.
examples.zh: 他把部分财产转让给儿子了。

senses.def: to begin to give your attention to something
senses.zh: 开始认真对待；定下心来做

examples.en: They finally settled down to a discussion of the main issues.
examples.zh: 他们终于开始讨论一些主要问题了。

examples.en: He found it hard to settle to his work.
examples.zh: 他觉得定不下心来工作。

senses.def: an official agreement that ends an argument between two people or groups

examples.en: to negotiate a peace settlement
examples.zh: 就和平协议进行谈判

examples.en: The management and unions have reached a settlement over new working conditions.
examples.zh: 资方和工会已就新的工作条件达成协议。

examples.en: an out-of-court settlement (= money that is paid to somebody or an agreement that is made to stop somebody going to court)
examples.zh: 庭外和解

senses.def: the action of reaching an agreement

examples.en: the settlement of a dispute
examples.zh: 争端的解决

senses.def: the conditions, or a document stating the conditions, on which money or property is given to somebody

examples.en: a divorce/marriage/property settlement
examples.zh: 离婚／结婚／财产协议

senses.def: the action of paying back money that you owe

examples.en: the settlement of a debt
examples.zh: 债务的偿还

examples.en: Settlement is made monthly by direct debit.
examples.zh: 欠款每月从账户直接扣除。

examples.en: She had to pay over $5 000 in settlement of her debts.
examples.zh: 她必须支付 5 000 多美元来清偿债务。

senses.def: a place where people have come to live and make their homes, especially where few or no people lived before

examples.en: signs of an Iron Age settlement
examples.zh: 铁器时代村落遗址

examples.en: a mining settlement
examples.zh: 采矿定居点

senses.def: the process of people making their homes in a place

examples.en: the settlement of the American West
examples.zh: 美国西部的开拓过程

examples.en: early settlement patterns in South America
examples.zh: 南美早期居住地模式

senses.def: a public building in an area of a large city that has social problems, that provides social services such as advice and training to the people who live there
senses.zh: 社区福利服务之家，街坊文教馆（为邻里提供多方面服务）

examples.en: He volunteered to work at an inner-city settlement house.
examples.zh: 他自愿在市中心的安置所工作。

examples.en: the settlement houses in slum areas of London in the 1880s
examples.zh: 1880年代伦敦贫民区的定居点房屋

senses.def: a person who goes to live in a new country or region

examples.en: Most of the settlers came from England.
examples.zh: 多数移民来自英格兰。

senses.def: a male servant
a male social worker
senses.zh: 男社会福利工作者；男社工

examples.en: There are seven cookies left.
examples.zh: 还剩下七块饼干。

examples.en: seven of Sweden’s top financial experts
examples.zh: 七位瑞典顶级金融专家

examples.en: Ten people were invited but only seven turned up.
examples.zh: 邀请了十个人，但只有七个人到场。

examples.en: Can you lend me seven dollars?
examples.zh: 你能借我七美元吗？

examples.en: a seven-month contract
examples.zh: 为期七个月的合同

examples.en: Look at page seven.
examples.zh: 看第七页。

examples.en: Seven and two is nine.
examples.zh: 七加二等于九。

examples.en: Two sevens are fourteen.
examples.zh: 二七一十四

examples.en: I can't read your writing—is this meant to be a seven?
examples.zh: 我看不懂你的字——这是要写成七吗？

examples.en: The bulbs are planted in fives or sevens (= groups of five or seven).
examples.zh: 鳞茎以五个或七个一组的方式种植。

examples.en: We moved to America when I was seven (= seven years old).
examples.zh: 我七岁时我们搬到了美国。

examples.en: Shall we meet at seven (= at seven o'clock), then?
examples.zh: 那我们七点见面，好吗？

senses.def: in a confused state; not well organized

examples.en: I haven't had time to clear up, so I'm all at sixes and sevens.
examples.zh: 我还没来得及清理，所以我心乱如麻。

senses.def: the desire for new sexual experience that is thought to be felt after seven years of marriage
senses.zh: 七年之痒（婚后七年另觅新欢的欲望）

senses.def: in a confused state; not well organized

examples.en: I haven't had time to clear up, so I'm all at sixes and sevens.
examples.zh: 我还没来得及清理，所以我心乱如麻。

senses.def: the desire for new sexual experience that is thought to be felt after seven years of marriage
senses.zh: 七年之痒（婚后七年另觅新欢的欲望）

senses.def: a book (1926) by T E Lawrence
senses.zh: 智慧的七大支柱：TE劳伦斯著（1926年）。它描述了他在第一次世界大战期间在阿拉伯沙漠中的经历，当时他去帮助阿拉伯人对抗土耳其。

senses.def: 17th
each of 17 equal parts of something
7th

examples.en: Today is the seventh (of May).
examples.zh: 今天是五月七日。

examples.en: the seventh century BC
examples.zh: 公元前七世纪

examples.en: It's her seventh birthday.
examples.zh: 这是她7岁生日

examples.en: My office is on the seventh floor.
examples.zh: 我的办公室在七楼。

examples.en: It's the seventh time that I've been to America.
examples.zh: 这是我第七次去美国。

examples.en: The artist had just sold another painting, her seventh.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家刚刚售出另一幅画，这是她的第七幅画。

examples.en: the world’s seventh-largest oil exporter
examples.zh: 世界第七大石油出口国

examples.en: He finished seventh in the race.
