synonyms.words: yell ▪ cry ▪ scream ▪ cheer ▪ bellow ▪ raise your voice

intro.en: These words all mean to say something in a very loud voice.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指大声说出、叫嚷。

items.def: to say something in a loud voice; to speak loudly and often angrily to somebody:
items.zh: 指大声说、叫、嚷、斥责、怒骂

examples.en: Stop shouting and listen!
examples.zh: 别嚷了，听着！

items.def: to shout loudly, for example because you are angry, excited, frightened or in pain:
items.zh: 指（因气愤、激动、害怕或痛苦而）叫喊、大喊、吼叫

examples.en: She yelled at the boy to get down from the wall.
examples.zh: 她冲小孩大喊，让他从墙上下来。

items.def: (rather formal or literary) to shout loudly:
items.zh: 指喊叫、呼喊、呼叫

examples.en: She ran over to the window and cried for help.
examples.zh: 她跑到窗口呼喊救命。

items.def: to shout something in a loud high voice because you are afraid, angry or excited:
items.zh: 指（因害怕、气愤或激动而）尖叫、大叫

examples.en: He screamed at me to stop.
examples.zh: 他冲着我大叫，要我停下来。

items.def: (especially of a crowd of people) to shout loudly to show support or praise for somebody, or to encourage them:
items.zh: （尤指一群人）欢呼、喝彩、加油

examples.en: We all cheered as the team came onto the field.
examples.zh: 球队入场时我们都欢呼起来。

items.def: to shout in a loud deep voice, especially because you are angry:
items.zh: 指大声吼叫，尤指怒吼

examples.en: ‘Quiet!’ the teacher bellowed.
examples.zh: “安静！”老师大吼道。

items.def: to speak loudly to somebody, especially because you are angry:
items.zh: （尤指因气愤而）提高嗓门、大声说话

examples.en: She never once raised her voice to us.
examples.zh: 她从未对我们提高嗓门说话。

senses.def: to talk about something in a very public way

examples.en: He was in love and wanted to shout it from the rooftops.
examples.zh: 他要大声宣布，他恋爱了。

shout, etc. something from the rooftops.word: shout, etc. something from the rooftops

senses.def: to shout so that somebody who is speaking cannot be heard
senses.zh: 用喊叫声盖过某人的讲话

examples.en: The speaker was shouted down by a group of protesters.
examples.zh: 一群抗议者大叫大嚷，盖过了讲话人的声音。

senses.def: to say something in a loud voice so that it can be clearly heard

examples.en: Don't shout out all the answers.
examples.zh: 别把所有的答案都大声说出来。

examples.en: The crowd just shouted out her name.
examples.zh: 众人只是喊着她的名字。

examples.en: ‘I'm over here!’ I shouted out.
examples.zh: “我在这边！”我大声喊道。

senses.def: a public expression of thanks or welcome, especially on radio or television or during a live performance
senses.zh: （尤指广播、电视或现场演出中的）公开致谢，公开致意

examples.en: This is a shout-out to all our sponsors and advertisers.
examples.zh: 这是对我们所有赞助方和广告商的公开致谢。

examples.en: I have to give a huge shout-out to my boyfriend, Brian.
examples.zh: 我必须大力赞扬我的男朋友布莱恩。

senses.def: an argument when people shout loudly at each other

examples.en: The meeting turned into a shouting match between the tenants and the landlord.
examples.zh: 会议变成了房客和房东之间的一场争吵。

examples.en: He had got into a shouting match with a fan.
examples.zh: 他和一名球迷发生了争吵。

senses.def: doing or involving a lot of shouting
senses.zh: 大喊大叫的；吵吵嚷嚷的

examples.en: a shouty conversation on the stairs
examples.zh: 楼梯上的高声谈话

examples.en: shouty headlines
examples.zh: 喧闹的头条新闻

senses.def: to push somebody/something in a rough way

examples.en: The crowd was pushing and shoving to get a better view.
examples.zh: 人们挤来挤去，想看得清楚点儿。

examples.en: The door wouldn't open no matter how hard she shoved.
examples.zh: 她怎么使劲推，门都推不开。

examples.en: He shoved her down the stairs.
examples.zh: 他把她推下楼梯。

senses.def: to put something somewhere roughly or carelessly
senses.zh: 乱放；随便放；胡乱丢；随手扔

examples.en: She shoved the book into her bag and hurried off.
examples.zh: 她把书胡乱塞进包里就急急忙忙走了。

examples.en: He came over and shoved a piece of paper into my hand.
examples.zh: 他走过来往我手里塞了一张纸条。

examples.en: Shove your suitcase under the bed.
examples.zh: 把你的手提箱塞到床底下吧。

examples.en: Could he be lying? She shoved the thought to the back of her mind.
examples.zh: 他会不会在说谎？她把这个想法抛到了脑后。

senses.def: used to say rudely that you will not accept or do something
senses.zh: （粗鲁地表示不接受或不做某事）去他的，没门儿，去他妈的

examples.en: ‘The boss wants that report now.’ ‘Yeah? Tell him he can shove it.’
examples.zh: “老板现在要那份报告。”“是吗？你告诉他没门儿。”

senses.def: a strong push

examples.en: You have to give the door a shove or it won't close.
examples.zh: 这门你得猛推一下，否则关不上。

examples.en: Harry gave him a hefty shove and he fell over.
examples.zh: 哈里猛地推了他一下，他摔倒了。

senses.def: when there is no other choice; when everything else has failed
senses.zh: 别无选择时；须孤注一掷时

senses.def: used to say rudely that you will not accept or do something
senses.zh: （粗鲁地表示不接受或不做某事）去他的，没门儿，去他妈的

examples.en: ‘The boss wants that report now.’ ‘Yeah? Tell him he can shove it.’
examples.zh: “老板现在要那份报告。”“是吗？你告诉他没门儿。”

senses.def: when there is no other choice; when everything else has failed
senses.zh: 别无选择时；须孤注一掷时

senses.def: used to say rudely that you will not accept or do something
senses.zh: （粗鲁地表示不接受或不做某事）去他的，没门儿，去他妈的

examples.en: ‘The boss wants that report now.’ ‘Yeah? Tell him he can shove it.’
examples.zh: “老板现在要那份报告。”“是吗？你告诉他没门儿。”

senses.def: a game in which coins are pushed so they slide across a marked board on a table
senses.zh: 一种游戏，其中将硬币推入，使其在桌子上的标记板上滑动

senses.def: used to tell somebody rudely to go away

examples.en: Shove off and leave me alone!
examples.zh: 滚开，别烦我！

senses.def: to move in order to make a space for somebody to sit down next to you

examples.en: Shove up! Jan wants to sit down.
examples.zh: 挪一挪！简要坐下来。

senses.def: a tool like a spade

examples.en: workmen with picks and shovels
examples.zh: 手拿镐铲的工人

examples.en: The children took their pails and shovels to the beach.
examples.zh: 孩子们带着桶和铲子到海滩上去了。

senses.def: the part of a large machine or vehicle that digs or moves earth
senses.zh: （推土机、挖土机等的）铲，铲形部分

senses.def: to lift and move earth, stones, coal, etc. with a shovel

examples.en: A gang of workmen were shovelling rubble onto a truck.
examples.zh: 一帮工人正用铁锹往卡车上装碎石。

examples.en: They went out in freezing conditions to shovel snow.
examples.zh: 他们冒着严寒出去铲雪。

examples.en: to shovel the sidewalk/driveway (= to remove snow)
examples.zh: 铲除人行道／车行道上的积雪

examples.en: He sat at the table, shovelling food into his mouth.
examples.zh: 他坐在桌前，一个劲地往嘴里塞吃的。

senses.def: (of a construction project) at the stage where workers can be employed and building begun
senses.zh: （建筑工程）准备就绪的，可马上动工的

examples.en: The pipeline is a $7 billion, shovel-ready project.
examples.zh: 该管道是一个耗资 70 亿美元、已准备就绪的项目。

examples.en: This infrastructure project is shovel-ready.
examples.zh: 该基础设施项目已准备就绪。

senses.def: the amount that a shovel
to make something clear; to prove something

examples.en: The figures clearly show that her claims are false.
examples.zh: 这些数字清楚地表明，她的说法是错误的。

examples.en: The government's popularity is declining, as the polls show.
examples.zh: 民意调查表明，政府的受欢迎程度正在下降。

examples.en: Our research showed us that women were more interested in their health than men.
examples.zh: 我们的研究表明女性比男性更关心自身健康。

examples.en: The report showed an increase in sales.
examples.zh: 报告表明销量上升了。

examples.en: Studies show a link between cancer and processed meats.
examples.zh: 研究表明癌症与加工肉类之间存在联系。

examples.en: His new book shows him to be a first-rate storyteller.
examples.zh: 他的新著表明他讲故事的本领是一流的。

examples.en: Tax records show Shakespeare living near the Globe Theatre in 1599.
examples.zh: 税务记录表明莎士比亚 1599 年生活在环球剧院附近。

examples.en: This shows how people are influenced by TV advertisements.
examples.zh: 这表明电视广告对人们的影响有多大。

examples.en: History has shown us how dangerous nationalism can be.
examples.zh: 历史告诉我们，民族主义是多么危险。

senses.def: to let somebody see something

examples.en: You have to show your ticket as you go in.
examples.zh: 进场必须出示门票。

examples.en: If there's a letter from France please show it to me.
examples.zh: 如有法国来的信，请拿给我看看。

examples.en: Have you shown your work to anyone?
examples.zh: 你有没有把你做的活儿给谁看过？

examples.en: Have you shown anyone your work?
examples.zh: 你有没有给谁看过你做的活儿？

examples.en: We were shown a training video.
examples.zh: 我们观看了一段培训视频。

senses.group: let somebody see something 给人看

senses.def: to teach or demonstrate the way to do something, for example by letting somebody watch you do it or by explaining it

examples.en: She showed the technique to her students.
examples.zh: 她向学生演示了那个技巧。

examples.en: She showed her students the technique.
examples.zh: 她向学生演示了那个技巧。

examples.en: In my book I showed a method which is very quick and easy.
examples.zh: 在我的书中，我展示了一种非常快速且简单的方法。

examples.en: Glue the sticks to the paper as shown in Figure 37.
examples.zh: 将木棍粘到纸上，如图 37 所示。

examples.en: Can you show me how to do it?
examples.zh: 你能教我怎么做吗？

examples.en: The diagram shows how to assemble the shelves.
examples.zh: 该图显示了如何组装架子。

senses.def: to point to something so that somebody can see where or what it is

examples.en: He showed me our location on the map.
examples.zh: 他在地图上给我指出我们所处的位置。

examples.en: Show me which picture you drew.
examples.zh: 指给我看哪张画是你画的。

senses.def: to lead or guide somebody to a place

examples.en: The attendant showed us to our seats.
examples.zh: 服务员把我们带到我们的座位。

examples.en: The candidates were shown in.
examples.zh: 候选人被领了进来。

examples.en: I'll go first and show you the way.
examples.zh: 我先走，给你带路。

senses.def: to make it clear that you have a particular quality

examples.en: to show great courage
examples.zh: 表现出极大的勇气

examples.en: He has shown his commitment to his art.
examples.zh: 他表现出了对艺术的承诺。

examples.en: She wants to show the world her ability.
examples.zh: 她想向世人展示她的能力。

examples.en: She had shown herself unable to deal with money.
examples.zh: 她所做的事已表明她不善理财。

examples.en: You have shown yourself a master tactician.
examples.zh: 你已经证明自己是一位战术大师。

examples.en: He has shown himself to be ready to make compromises.
examples.zh: 他表现出自己愿意妥协。

examples.en: He has shown that he is ready to make compromises.
examples.zh: 他表现出愿意妥协。

senses.def: to behave in a particular way towards somebody

examples.en: I wanted to be there to show support.
examples.zh: 我想到场，以示支持。

examples.en: They showed no respect for their parents.
examples.zh: 他们毫不尊敬自己的父母。

examples.en: They showed their parents no respect.
examples.zh: 他们毫不尊敬自己的父母。

examples.en: They have shown us nothing but kindness.
examples.zh: 他们没有向我们展示什么，除了仁慈。

senses.def: if a feeling or quality shows

examples.en: Fear showed in his eyes.
examples.zh: 他的眼神流露出恐惧。

examples.en: She tried not to let her disappointment show.
examples.zh: 她极力掩饰自己的失望情绪。

examples.en: They loved working together, and it shows (= it can be seen in their work).
examples.zh: 他们喜欢一起工作，这能看得出来。

examples.en: She showed no interest in my work.
examples.zh: 她对我的工作没显示丝毫兴趣。

examples.en: Her expression showed her disappointment.
examples.zh: 从她的表情可以看出她很失望。

examples.en: The market shows no sign of slowing down.
examples.zh: 市场没有显示衰退的迹象。

examples.en: Her second attempt showed a marked improvement.
examples.zh: 她的第二次尝试进步明显。

examples.en: The new strategy shows promise.
examples.zh: 新战略显示出希望。

examples.en: She tried not to show how disappointed she was.
examples.zh: 她极力掩饰她是多么失望。

senses.def: if something shows

examples.en: She had a warm woollen hat and scarf on that left only her eyes and nose showing.
examples.zh: 她戴着保暖呢帽和围巾，只露出了眼睛和鼻子。

examples.en: Nothing showed on the X-ray.
examples.zh: X光片上没有显示任何东西。

examples.en: Their new white carpet showed every mark.
examples.zh: 他们新铺的白地毯有一点脏都看得出。

examples.en: He grinned, and his teeth showed white in the darkness.
examples.zh: 他咧嘴一笑，牙齿在黑暗中显得洁白。

senses.group: be able to be seen 可见

senses.def: to give particular information, or a time or measurement
senses.zh: 标示，表明（信息、时间、计量）

examples.en: The map shows the principal towns and rivers.
examples.zh: 这张地图标出了主要城镇和河流。

examples.en: The clock showed midnight.
examples.zh: 时钟显示已是午夜。

examples.en: The end-of-year accounts show a loss.
examples.zh: 年终账面显示出现了亏损。

examples.en: The flow chart shows how resources are allocated.
examples.zh: 流程图显示出资源的分配情况。

senses.def: to be of somebody/something; to represent somebody/something

examples.en: The photographs clearly show a broken window.
examples.zh: 照片清楚地显示了一扇破碎的窗户。

examples.en: She had objected to a photo showing her in a bikini.
examples.zh: 她曾反对给自己拍穿比基尼泳装的照片。

examples.en: This picture shows my mother as a young woman.
examples.zh: 这张照片显示的是我母亲年轻时的样子。

examples.en: The painting shows St George slaying the dragon.
examples.zh: 这张油画上画的是圣乔治屠龙的场面。

senses.def: to be or make something available for the public to see

examples.en: The movie is now showing at all major movie theaters.
examples.zh: 这部影片目前正在各大影院上映。

examples.en: The documentary will be shown on Sunday night.
examples.zh: 纪录片将在周日晚播出。

examples.en: She plans to show her paintings early next year.
examples.zh: 她计划明年初展出自己的绘画作品。

senses.group: for public to see 让公众看

senses.def: to prove that you can do something or are something

examples.en: They think I can't do it, but I'll show them!
examples.zh: 他们以为我做不了，我却要做给他们看看！

examples.en: He has shown himself to be a caring father.
examples.zh: 他已经证明了自己是个有爱心的父亲。

examples.en: I'm giving him a chance to show what he can do.
examples.zh: 我是在给他机会证明自己的能力。

senses.def: to arrive where you have arranged to meet somebody or do something

examples.en: I waited an hour but he didn't show.
examples.zh: 我等了一个小时，可他一直没露面。

senses.def: to enter an animal in a competition
to show your support for your country, an organization or an idea to encourage or persuade others to do the same
senses.zh: 表示并号召拥护自己的国家（或某组织、某思想）

senses.def: to perform a particular activity in order to show other people what you are capable of doing

examples.en: We watched the horses going through their paces.
examples.zh: 我们观察马匹的步伐。

examples.en: The British team showed its paces during a training session in the hotel pool.
examples.zh: 英国队在酒店泳池的训练中展示了自己的步伐。

senses.def: used to say that something proves something

examples.en: It just goes to show what you can do when you really try.
examples.zh: 这就表明，当你真下功夫时能做成什么事。

senses.def: to ask somebody to leave, because they are no longer welcome
to appear among your friends or in public

examples.en: She stayed at home, afraid to show her face.
examples.zh: 她待在家里，不敢露面。

senses.def: to make your plans or intentions known
senses.zh: 摊牌；让对方摸着底细；公开自己的意图

senses.def: to show somebody/know/learn how a particular job should be done
senses.zh: 向某人演示／知道／学会如何做某事

senses.def: to do something first so that other people can follow
to make it clear to somebody that you have more power and authority than they have
to show that you are ready to help, work hard, etc. if necessary

examples.zh: 知识问答节目

examples.en: a reality show (= one that is based on real people, not actors)
examples.zh: 真人真事节目。

examples.zh: 去看／观看演出

examples.zh: 上演／演出节目

examples.zh: 这本书已被改编为舞台剧。

examples.zh: 这是威尔士最大的农业展会之一。

examples.zh: 民主党人在中央公园组织了一次群众集会来显示实力。

examples.zh: 4000名士兵的武力展示导致协议很快达成。

examples.zh: 她有点发脾气了，他却无动于衷。

examples.zh: 她担心过于露骨的感激之情可能会被误解。

examples.zh: 该公司正在寻求为该项目争取大力支持。

examples.zh: 她做出一副对歌剧感兴趣的样子，但这不过是装门面而已。

senses.def: an event, a business or a situation where something is being done or organized

examples.zh: 整个这一摊儿都由她管。

examples.en: I won't interfere—it's your show.
examples.zh: 我不会插手，这归你管。

examples.zh: 这支队伍在比赛中有上佳表现。

examples.en: It's a poor show if he forgets your birthday.
examples.zh: 要是他忘了你的生日，那可太差劲了。

examples.zh: 英国乐队在今年的颁奖典礼上大出风头。

intro.zh: 以上各词均含带去、引领之义。

examples.zh: 步行路太远，我开车送你去。

examples.zh: 消防队员把幸存者带到了安全的地方。

examples.zh: 总统在十二名保镖的护送下到达。

examples.zh: 我母亲开车把我们送到了机场。

examples.zh: 服务员把我们带到我们的座位。

examples.en: He always walked her home.
examples.zh: 他经常护送她走回家。

examples.en: She guided us through the busy streets.
examples.zh: 她带领我们穿过了繁忙的街道。

senses.zh: 表演船：杰罗姆·科恩和奥斯卡·哈默斯坦的著名百老汇音乐剧（1927年）。它是根据埃德娜·费伯（Edna Ferber）的一部小说（1926年）写的，小说讲述的是密西西比河上的游船“棉花开花”上的人。它包括歌曲《 Ol'Man River》和《 Only Make Believe》。电影共有三种版本（1929、1936和1951）。

examples.zh: 演艺界人士／明星

examples.en: That's showbiz!
examples.zh: 这就是娱乐界！

examples.zh: 他不过是在表现自己，因为他喜欢的那个姑娘在场。

examples.zh: 我们热衷于炫耀我们的新车。

examples.en: He likes to show off how well he speaks French.
examples.zh: 他喜欢向人展示他法语讲得有多好。

examples.zh: 写在纸背面的字透了过来。

examples.zh: 他说话时流露出内心的辛酸。

examples.zh: 她苍白的皮肤下一条条血管清晰可见。

examples.zh: X 光照片上显示出的一根断骨

examples.zh: 在耀眼的光线下，她脸上的皱纹清晰可见。

examples.zh: 他在音乐会上呼呼大睡，真给我丢脸。

senses.zh: （因做得比别人好而）使人难堪，使人尴尬，使人丢脸

examples.zh: 我马上就把这个写完并寄出去。

examples.zh: 他在淋浴间冲澡。

examples.zh: 我刚洗完澡。

examples.zh: 与卧室配套的淋浴间

examples.zh: 淋浴间；浴帘

examples.zh: 电淋浴器

examples.zh: 热水／冷水淋浴

examples.zh: 洗淋浴

examples.zh: 四月的阵雨

examples.zh: 我们遇上一阵大雨。

examples.zh: 今天下午可能有阵雨。

senses.zh: （坚果或牡蛎、蛤等的）壳；（植物的）荚，外皮

senses.def: to remove the shell or covering of nuts, shellfish
to shake because you are cold or frightened, or because of a strong feeling
senses.zh: （因寒冷、害怕或激动而）发抖，打颤，战栗

examples.en: Just thinking about the accident makes me shudder.
examples.zh: 只要一想起那场事故，我就发抖。

examples.en: Alone in the car, she shuddered with fear.
examples.zh: 她一个人待在车里，害怕得直哆嗦。

examples.en: I shuddered at the thought of all the trouble I'd caused.
examples.zh: 一想到我闯的祸，就不寒而栗。

examples.en: I shudder to think how much this is all going to cost (= I don't want to think about it because it is too unpleasant).
examples.zh: 想想这一切得花多少钱，我就发怵。

senses.def: to shake very hard

examples.en: The bus shuddered to a halt.
examples.zh: 公共汽车剧烈地晃动着停了下来。

examples.en: The floor was shuddering beneath us.
examples.zh: 我们脚下的地板在颤抖。

senses.def: a shaking movement you make because you are cold or have a feeling of fear or horror
senses.zh: （因寒冷、害怕或惊恐等引起的）发抖，打颤，战栗

examples.en: a shudder of fear
examples.zh: 害怕的颤抖

examples.en: She gave an involuntary shudder.
examples.zh: 她不由自主地抖了一下。

examples.en: A cold shudder ran through him.
examples.zh: 他浑身打了个寒战。

senses.def: a strong shaking movement
senses.zh: 强烈的震动；剧烈的抖动

examples.en: The elevator rose with a shudder.
examples.zh: 电梯猛震一下，升上去了。

senses.def: to walk slowly without lifting your feet completely off the ground

examples.en: He shuffled across the room to the window.
examples.zh: 他拖着脚走到房间那头的窗户跟前。

examples.en: The line shuffled forward a little.
examples.zh: 队列往前挪了挪。

senses.def: to move from one foot to another, especially because you are bored, nervous or embarrassed
senses.zh: （尤指无聊、紧张或尴尬地）把脚动来动去；坐立不安

examples.en: Jenny shuffled her feet and blushed with shame.
examples.zh: 珍妮来回倒换着脚，羞愧得脸红了。

examples.en: The boys shuffled around uncomfortably.
examples.zh: 男孩们不安地动来动去。

senses.def: to mix cards up in a pack

examples.en: Shuffle the cards and deal out seven to each player.
examples.zh: 洗洗牌，然后给每人发七张。

examples.en: I shuffled the deck, then pulled a card out from the middle.
examples.zh: 我洗了牌，然后从中间抽出了一张牌。

examples.en: Whose turn is it to shuffle?
examples.zh: 该轮到谁洗牌?

senses.def: to move paper or things into different positions or a different order
senses.zh: 把（纸张等）变换位置，打乱次序

examples.en: I shuffled the documents on my desk.
examples.zh: 我胡乱翻动桌上的文件。

examples.en: Don't worry, I should be able to shuffle some of the classes around.
examples.zh: 别担心，我应该能够调整一些课程的顺序。

senses.def: a slow walk in which you take small steps and do not lift your feet completely off the ground

examples.en: He walked with a shuffle.
examples.zh: 他拖着脚步走着。

examples.en: There was a shuffle of feet as the room emptied.
examples.zh: 房间里空荡荡的时候，传来脚步声。

senses.def: the act of mixing cards before a card game

examples.en: Give the cards a good shuffle.
examples.zh: 把牌好好洗一洗。

senses.def: a type of dancing in which you take small steps and do not lift your feet completely off the ground
a change in the jobs that a group of people do, for example in a government
to not notice somebody/something or pay attention to somebody/something because of a confusing situation
senses.zh: 在混乱中没有注意到；忽略；遗失

examples.en: Middle children tend to get lost in the shuffle.
examples.zh: 排行居中的子女往往得不到充分的关注。

senses.def: not in any special order

examples.en: I use my phone's music app on shuffle.
examples.zh: 我用手机的音乐应用随机播放。

examples.en: The song came up on shuffle.
examples.zh: 这首歌是随机播放的。

examples.en: You can put your whole music collection on shuffle.
examples.zh: 您可以随机播放整个音乐收藏。

senses.def: to not notice somebody/something or pay attention to somebody/something because of a confusing situation
senses.zh: 在混乱中没有注意到；忽略；遗失

examples.en: Middle children tend to get lost in the shuffle.
examples.zh: 排行居中的子女往往得不到充分的关注。

senses.def: not in any special order

examples.en: I use my phone's music app on shuffle.
examples.zh: 我用手机的音乐应用随机播放。

examples.en: The song came up on shuffle.
examples.zh: 这首歌是随机播放的。

examples.en: You can put your whole music collection on shuffle.
examples.zh: 您可以随机播放整个音乐收藏。

senses.def: a game in which players use long sticks to push discs towards spaces with numbers on a board
senses.zh: 推移板游戏（用推杆将圆盘推至推移板上的不同得分区）

senses.def: to have a quick look at something
a blanket
senses.zh: 舒卡毯，舒卡布（马赛人披戴，常为方格红布）

examples.en: The men were all dressed in traditional shukas.
examples.zh: 男人们都穿着传统的舒卡服。

senses.def: to avoid somebody/something

examples.en: They were both shunned by their families when they remarried.
examples.zh: 他们再婚后都被家人疏远了。

examples.en: an actor who shuns publicity
examples.zh: 一个避免引起公众注意的演员

examples.en: The company has long been shunned by ethical investors.
examples.zh: 该公司长期以来一直受到有道德的投资者的回避。

senses.def: to move a train or a coach of a train from one track to another
senses.zh: 使（火车或火车车厢）转轨

senses.def: to move somebody/something to a different place, especially a less important one

examples.en: John was shunted sideways to a job in sales.
examples.zh: 约翰被平级调动到销售部门的一个岗位上。

senses.def: a road accident in which one vehicle crashes into the back of another
a small tube put in your body in a medical operation to allow the blood or other fluid

examples.en: If the artery is too narrow, a small 4mm shunt is inserted to widen it.
examples.zh: 如果动脉太窄，可插入 4 毫米的小分流器以使其变宽。

senses.def: used to tell somebody to be quiet

examples.en: Shush! Do you want to wake everyone?
examples.zh: “嘘！你想吵醒每一个人吗？”

senses.def: to tell somebody to be quiet, especially by saying ‘
senses.zh: （尤指通过“嘘”声或把手指竖在嘴唇上）要某人安静，嘘

examples.en: Lyn shushed the children.
examples.zh: 林恩“嘘”了一声，让孩子们安静下来。

senses.def: to close something; to become closed

examples.en: The window won't shut.
examples.zh: 这窗子关不上。

examples.en: The doors open and shut automatically.
examples.zh: 这些门都是自动开关的。

examples.en: The door shuts and locks behind her.
examples.zh: 门在她身后关上并锁上。

examples.en: Philip went into his room and shut the door behind him.
examples.zh: 菲利普进了自己的房间，随手把门关上。

examples.en: I can't shut my suitcase—it's too full.
examples.zh: 我的手提箱合不上，装得太满了。

examples.en: She shut her eyes and fell asleep immediately.
examples.zh: 她闭上眼，立刻就睡着了。

examples.en: He shut his book and looked up.
examples.zh: 他合上书，抬起头来。

senses.def: when a shop, restaurant, etc. shuts

examples.en: The bank shuts at 4.
examples.zh: 那家银行 4 点钟关门。

examples.en: What time do the shops shut on Saturday?
examples.zh: 星期六商店什么时候关门？

examples.en: We left the hotel only to discover that the whole city shuts at 10.30.
examples.zh: 离开酒店才发现10.30全城都关门了。

examples.en: The factory is going to shut next year.
examples.zh: 这家工厂将于明年关闭。

examples.en: We decided to shut the cafe early as there were no customers.
examples.zh: 我们决定咖啡馆提前打烊，因为没有顾客了。

examples.en: They're going to shut two plants in Texas and fire 2 240 workers.
examples.zh: 他们将关闭德克萨斯州的两家工厂并解雇 2 240 名工人。

senses.def: to make it unlikely that something will happen
senses.zh: 使不可能；拒…于门外；把…的门堵死

examples.en: She was careful not to close the door on the possibility of further talks.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼不让进一步谈判的大门关上。

senses.def: to not talk about something to somebody because it is a secret or because it will upset or annoy them

examples.en: I've warned them to keep their mouths shut about this.
examples.zh: 我警告过他们对此事要守口如瓶。

examples.en: Now she's upset—why couldn't you keep your mouth shut?
examples.zh: 瞧她现在心烦意乱的样子，你就不能闭上嘴？

examples.en: The athletes were warned to keep their mouths shut about politics.
examples.zh: 运动员们被警告不要谈论政治。

senses.def: to shut a door hard when somebody is trying to come in
senses.zh: 将某人拒之门外；让某人吃闭门羹

senses.def: to refuse to talk to somebody or meet them, in a rude way
senses.zh: 拒绝同某人谈话；拒绝见某人

examples.en: She decided to shut her ears to all the rumours.
examples.zh: 她拿定主意对所有的谣言置之不理。

senses.zh: （对…）视而不见，熟视无睹，置若罔闻

examples.zh: 你不能对他的暴力行为视而不见。

examples.en: They seem intent on shutting their eyes to the problems of pollution.
examples.zh: 他们似乎一心要对污染问题视而不见。

senses.zh: （粗暴地要某人停止说话）住口，闭嘴

senses.zh: 闭着眼都能做；轻而易举

examples.en: I've made this trip so often, I could do it with my eyes shut.
examples.zh: 我经常走这条路，闭着眼睛都能找到。

senses.def: not open

examples.en: The door was shut.
examples.zh: 门关着。

examples.en: She slammed the door shut.
examples.zh: 她咣的一声把门关上了。

examples.en: Keep your eyes shut.
examples.zh: 别睁开眼睛。

examples.en: His eyes remained tightly shut.
examples.zh: 他的眼睛仍然紧闭着。

examples.en: I hope you can keep your mouth shut (= not tell anyone) about what you saw.
examples.zh: 我希望你能对你所看到的事情闭嘴（=不要告诉任何人）。

senses.def: not open for business

examples.zh: 不凑巧，银行现在不营业。

examples.en: The swimming pool has been shut for a decade.
examples.zh: 那游泳池已经关门歇业十年了。

examples.zh: 他做志愿工作，为卧病在家的人送热饭菜。

examples.zh: 遇到紧急情况发动机便自动停止工作。

senses.zh: 关闭机器（或工具等）；使机器（或工具等）停止运转

examples.zh: 我希望有人能关掉汽车警报器。

senses.zh: 切断煤气（或水等）的供应；停止供应煤气（或水等）

examples.zh: 当盖子合上时，立刻会有一个阀门切断煤气。

examples.zh: 波斯尼亚和亚得里亚海之间有群山相隔。

senses.def: to prevent somebody/something from entering a place

examples.en: Mum, Ben keeps shutting me out of the bedroom!
examples.zh: 妈，本老不让我进卧室！

examples.en: sunglasses that shut out 99 per cent of the sun’s harmful rays
examples.zh: 能遮挡 99% 的太阳有害射线的太阳镜

senses.def: to not allow a person to share or be part of your thoughts; to stop yourself from having particular feelings
senses.zh: 把某人排除在…外；不把…告诉某人；克制某种感情

examples.en: I wanted to shut John out of my life for ever.
examples.zh: 我想永远不让约翰走进我的生活。

examples.en: She learned to shut out her angry feelings.
examples.zh: 她学会了克制自己的愤怒。

examples.en: If you shut me out, how can I help you?
examples.zh: 如果你什么也不告诉我，我怎么帮你呢？

senses.def: to stop talking (often used as an order as a rude way of telling somebody to stop talking)
senses.zh: （常用来粗暴地让某人停止说话）住口，闭嘴

examples.en: Just shut up and listen!
examples.zh: 住口，听着！

examples.en: Will you tell Mike to shut up?
examples.zh: 你让迈克闭嘴好不好？

examples.en: When they'd finally shut up, I started again.
examples.zh: 等他们最终住了嘴，我又重新开始讲。

senses.def: to make somebody stop talking
senses.zh: 使某人住口；让某人闭嘴

examples.en: She kicked Anne under the table to shut her up.
examples.zh: 她在桌子底下踢了安妮一脚，让她住嘴。

senses.def: to close a room, house, etc.

examples.en: The summer house was shut up for another year and we went back to the city.
examples.zh: 避暑别墅又关闭了一年，我们又回到了城里。

senses.def: to keep somebody/something in a place and prevent them from going anywhere
senses.zh: 把…关（或藏）起来；把…关（或藏）在

examples.en: They shut him up in jail.
examples.zh: 他们把他关进了监狱。

examples.en: The children were shut up in their rooms.
examples.zh: 孩子们被关在自己的房间里。

senses.def: to go somewhere where you will be completely alone

examples.en: Mary always shuts herself away in her room while she’s working.
examples.zh: 玛丽工作时总是把自己关在房间里。

examples.zh: 马丁不与外界接触，专心写他的书。

examples.en: factory shutdowns
examples.zh: 工厂的倒闭

examples.en: the nuclear reactor’s emergency shutdown procedures
examples.zh: 核反应堆的紧急关闭程序

senses.zh: 完胜（比赛中不让对手得分）

examples.zh: 他们探索了一番，打开了每个大房间的百叶窗。

examples.zh: 去年，有 7 万多家商店被迫关了门。

examples.zh: 他关掉了垂死女孩形象的百叶窗。

examples.en: I could feel the shutters coming down in her mind.
examples.zh: 我能感觉到她心里的那扇门在慢慢关闭。

intro.en: These are all words for the state of being physically or mentally ill.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指身体或精神上的不适、疾病。

items.def: the state of being physically or mentally ill
items.zh: （身体或精神上的）疾病，病

items.def: illness; bad health:
items.zh: 指疾病、不健康

examples.en: I recommend you get insurance against sickness and unemployment.
examples.zh: 我建议你办个疾病和失业保险。

items.def: (rather formal) the state of being physically ill or having lots of health problems:
items.zh: 指健康状况不佳

examples.en: She resigned because of ill health.
examples.zh: 她因健康状况不佳而辞职。

items.def: illness or pain:
items.zh: 指疾病、疼痛

examples.en: heart trouble.
examples.zh: 心脏病

senses.def: money paid by the government to people who are away from work because of illness
senses.zh: 疾病补助金（由政府发放给因病不能上班的职工）

senses.def: a person who gets pleasure from doing strange and cruel things
senses.zh: 从病态行为取乐的人；（精神）变态者

examples.en: child molesters and other sickos
examples.zh: 对儿童进行性骚扰者及其他变态狂

senses.def: a strike in which all the workers at a company say they are sick and stay at home
a room in which a person who is ill is lying in bed
a first name for boys or sometimes for girls, short for Sidney
senses.zh: 锡德（男子名，有时为女子名，Sidney 缩写）

senses.def: (1922-2014) a very popular comedian
senses.zh: 席德·凯撒（Sid Caesar）：（1922-2014）是美国早期电视台上非常受欢迎的喜剧演员。他的节目是与Imogene Coca合作的“表演节目（1950-55）”，凯撒获得了两项艾美奖。该节目的作家包括伍迪·艾伦，尼尔·西蒙和梅尔·布鲁克斯。

senses.def: either of the two halves of a surface, an object or an area that is divided by an imaginary central line
senses.zh: （由想象的中线分出的）一边，一侧

examples.en: the right side of the brain
examples.zh: 脑的右半部

examples.en: satellite links to the other side of the world
examples.zh: 与世界的另一边卫星连线

examples.en: They drive on the left-hand side of the road in Japan.
examples.zh: 在日本驾车靠左行。

examples.en: She was on the far side of the room.
examples.zh: 她在房间的那一边。

examples.en: They crossed from one side of London to the other.
examples.zh: 他们从伦敦的这一头到了另一头。

examples.en: Keep on your side of the bed!
examples.zh: 你还是睡你那边吧！

examples.en: a factory on the west side of town
examples.zh: 城西的一间工厂

senses.def: a position or an area to the left or right of something
senses.zh: （事物左方或右方的）一旁，一边，一侧

examples.en: He crossed the bridge to the other side of the river.
examples.zh: 他过桥到了河对岸。

examples.en: The opposite side of the street was still in shadow.
examples.zh: 街道对面仍然处于阴影之中。

examples.en: There is a large window on either side of the front door.
examples.zh: 前门两侧各有一个大窗户。

examples.en: people on both sides of the Atlantic
examples.zh: 大西洋两岸的人

examples.en: a town on this side of the border
examples.zh: 边境这边的一个小镇

examples.en: She saw James standing on the other side of the fence.
examples.zh: 她看到詹姆斯站在栅栏的另一边。

examples.en: She tilted her head to one side.
examples.zh: 她把头歪到一边。

senses.def: one of the flat surfaces of something that is not the top or bottom, front or back

examples.en: A notice was stuck to the side of the filing cabinet.
examples.zh: 文件柜的一侧贴着一张通知。

examples.en: Write your name on the side of the box.
examples.zh: 把你的姓名写在盒子的侧面。

examples.en: There's a scratch on the side of my car.
examples.zh: 我的汽车侧面有一道划痕。

examples.en: Now lay the jar on its side.
examples.zh: 现在把广口瓶侧着放倒。

examples.en: The ship was damaged on her starboard side.
examples.zh: 船的右舷受损。

examples.en: The kitchen door is at the side of the house.
examples.zh: 厨房门开在房子的侧面。

examples.en: a side door/window/panel
examples.zh: 侧门；侧窗；侧板

examples.en: a side wall/entrance
examples.zh: 侧墙/入口

senses.group: not top or bottom 侧面

senses.def: the vertical

examples.en: A path went up the side of the hill.
examples.zh: 沿着山坡往上有一条小路。

examples.en: Brush the sides of the tin with butter.
examples.zh: 在烤模的四周刷上黄油。

examples.en: We could see sheep grazing on the side of the mountain.
examples.zh: 我们可以看到羊在山坡上吃草。

senses.group: not top or bottom 侧面

senses.def: a part near the edge of something; an area just beyond the edge of something

examples.en: The stream flows into the south side of the lake.
examples.zh: 那小溪汇入湖的南侧。

examples.en: A path leads down one side of the garden.
examples.zh: 一条小道向花园的一侧延伸。

examples.en: We planted tulips along the side of the lawn.
examples.zh: 我们沿草坪的边缘种上了郁金香。

examples.en: She sat on the side of the bed.
examples.zh: 她坐在床边。

examples.en: The player received treatment on the side of the pitch.
examples.zh: 该球员在球场一侧接受治疗。

examples.en: A van was parked at the side of the road.
examples.zh: 路边停着一辆面包车。

senses.def: either the right or left part of a person’s body, from the armpit

examples.en: I've got a stitch in my side (= a sudden pain from running or laughing).
examples.zh: 我胁下岔气了。

examples.en: She has a pain down her right side.
examples.zh: 她身子右边疼。

examples.en: He was lying on his side.
examples.zh: 他侧卧着。

senses.def: either of two surfaces of something flat and thin, such as paper or cloth

examples.en: The upper side of the leaf was a much darker green.
examples.zh: 叶子的正面是更深的暗绿色。

examples.en: The reverse side of the coin has a picture of a flower.
examples.zh: 硬币的背面是一朵花。

examples.en: Write on one side of the paper only.
examples.zh: 只在纸的一面写。

examples.en: Fry the steaks for two minutes on each side.
examples.zh: 牛排两面各煎两分钟。

senses.group: of something flat and thin 平而薄的东西

senses.def: the amount of writing needed to fill one side of a sheet of paper

examples.en: He told us not to write more than three sides.
examples.zh: 他告诉我们写字不要超过三面纸。

senses.def: any of the flat surfaces of a solid object

examples.en: A cube has six sides.
examples.zh: 立方体有六面。

examples.en: Each side of the pyramid is greater than five acres in area.
examples.zh: 金字塔每面的面积都大于五英亩。

senses.def: any of the lines that form a flat shape such as a square or triangle

examples.en: a shape with five sides
examples.zh: 五边形

examples.en: The farm buildings form three sides of a square.
examples.zh: 这几栋农舍构成一个正方形的三个边。

senses.def: used in adjectives to state the number or type of sides

examples.en: a six-sided object
examples.zh: 六面体

examples.en: a glass-sided container
examples.zh: 玻璃面的容器

senses.def: a place or position very near to somebody/something

examples.en: Her husband stood at her side.
examples.zh: 她丈夫站在她身边。

examples.en: She was glad to have him by her side.
examples.zh: 她很高兴有他在身边。

examples.en: Keep close to my side.
examples.zh: 紧挨着我，别走开。

examples.en: Her friends never seem to leave her side.
examples.zh: 她的朋友们似乎从未离开过她身边。

examples.en: He rushed to be at her side.
examples.zh: 他急忙跑到她身边。

senses.group: near to somebody/something 某人／某物的近旁

senses.def: one of the two or more people or groups taking part in an argument, war, etc.

examples.en: Both sides agreed to restore diplomatic relations.
examples.zh: 双方同意恢复外交关系。

examples.en: At some point during the war he seems to have changed sides.
examples.zh: 战争期间，他好像在某个时候曾经转投对方营垒。

examples.en: Each side is capable of destroying the other in a nuclear war.
examples.zh: 双方都有能力在核战争中摧毁对方。

examples.en: We have finally reached an agreement acceptable to all sides.
examples.zh: 我们最终达成一项各方都能接受的协议。

examples.en: The two sides announced a deal yesterday.
examples.zh: 双方昨天宣布达成协议。

examples.en: to be on the winning/losing side
examples.zh: 在获胜／失败一方

examples.en: There are faults on both sides.
examples.zh: 双方都有错。

examples.en: There is anger on both sides of the political divide.
examples.zh: 政治分歧的双方都感到愤怒。

senses.def: one of the opinions, attitudes, or positions held by somebody in an argument, a business arrangement, etc.
senses.zh: 一方的意见（或态度、立场）

examples.en: We heard both sides of the argument.
examples.zh: 我们听过了辩论双方的意见。

examples.en: I just want you to hear my side of the story first.
examples.zh: 我只想要你先听听我的说法。

examples.en: One side of the debate is articulated best by France and Germany.
examples.zh: 辩论一方的意见由法国和德国很好地进行了表达。

examples.en: The defendant has had no opportunity to put his side of the case.
examples.zh: 被告没有机会表达自己的观点。

examples.en: Will you keep your side of the bargain?
examples.zh: 你那一方能不能遵守协议？

examples.en: On the plus side, the film is beautifully shot and edited.
examples.zh: 从好的方面来说，这部电影的拍摄和剪辑都很精美。

senses.def: a particular aspect of something, especially a situation or a person’s character

examples.en: These poems reveal her gentle side.
examples.zh: 这些诗显示出她温柔的一面。

examples.en: It's interesting to see another side of a story that is so well known.
examples.zh: 看到众所周知的事情的另一面是很有意思的。

examples.en: It's good you can see the funny side of the situation.
examples.zh: 你能看到情况可笑的一面，这很好。

examples.en: I'll take care of that side of things.
examples.zh: 那方面的事情由我来处理。

examples.en: This is a side of Alan that I never knew existed.
examples.zh: 我以前从来不知道艾伦还有这样的一面。

examples.en: the darker side of human nature
examples.zh: 人性的阴暗面

examples.en: a behind-the-scenes documentary which promises to show a side of him rarely seen in public
examples.zh: 一部幕后纪录片，承诺展示他很少在公共场合露面的一面

senses.def: a feeling that you are better than other people

examples.en: There was no side to him at all.
examples.zh: 他一点架子也没有。

senses.group: feeling that you are better 优越感

senses.def: a sports team

examples.en: As captain, Pryce is confident of leading his side to victory.
examples.zh: 作为队长，普赖斯自信能率领队伍取胜。

examples.en: The French have a very strong side.
examples.zh: 法国队非常强大。

examples.en: We were on the winning/losing side.
examples.zh: 我们支持获胜／失利的一方。

examples.en: As the home side, they were expected to play an attacking game.
examples.zh: 他们是主队，预计会采用进攻的打法。

senses.def: the part of your family that people belong to who are related either to your mother or to your father

examples.en: a cousin on my father’s side (= a child of my father’s brother or sister)
examples.zh: 我父亲那边的表亲

senses.def: a side dish
senses.zh: 与自己所处情况不同的一面；事物的另一面

examples.en: Your dinner comes with a choice of two sides.
examples.zh: 您的正餐有两道配菜可供选择。

senses.def: one of the two halves of an animal that has been killed for meat
a television channel

examples.en: What's on the other side?
examples.zh: 另一个频道上演什么？

senses.def: to support and agree with somebody
senses.zh: 站在某人一边；和某人观点一致

examples.en: I'm definitely on your side in this.
examples.zh: 在这个问题上，我毫不含糊地站在你这一边。

examples.en: Whose side are you on anyway?
examples.zh: 你到底赞成谁的观点呢？

senses.def: the boyfriend or girlfriend of somebody who is already married or in a steady sexual relationship with somebody else

examples.en: Is he your bit on the side?
examples.zh: 他是你的旁观者吗？

senses.def: to choose between two possible choices
senses.zh: 二者择其一；支持两方中的一方

senses.def: to show too much of a good quality in order to avoid showing too little
senses.zh: 在某方面做过头；偏向于（好的特质）

examples.en: I thought it was better to err on the side of caution (= to be too careful rather than take a risk).
examples.zh: 我认为宁可过于谨慎也不要冒风险。

senses.def: moving to the left and then to the right and then back again

examples.en: He shook his head slowly from side to side.
examples.zh: 他慢慢地摇了摇头。

examples.en: The ship rolled from side to side.
examples.zh: 船左右摇晃。

examples.en: The cat sat with its tail twitching from side to side.
examples.zh: 猫蹲坐着，尾巴左右摆动。

senses.def: from or living in a poor area or part of town
senses.zh: 来自（城里的）贫民区；住在贫穷的地区（或城区）

senses.def: to make somebody pleased with you/annoyed with you
senses.zh: 讨得某人的欢心；惹得某人恼怒

senses.def: to be in a bad mood for the whole day for no particular reason
senses.zh: （无缘由地）一起床就整天情绪不好

senses.def: said about people who never seem happy with what they have and always think they could be happier in a different place or situation
senses.zh: 草是那边绿；这山望着那山高

senses.def: to have something as an advantage that will make it more likely that you will achieve something

examples.en: She may not win this year, but she does have youth on her side.
examples.zh: 她也许今年赢不了，可是她的确有年轻的优势。

senses.def: to know where you can get an advantage for yourself
to be forced to change from feeling pleased or satisfied to feeling disappointed or annoyed
senses.zh: 转喜为忧；得意变成失意；笑脸变为苦脸

examples.en: He’ll be laughing on the other side of his face when he reads my letter.
examples.zh: 当他读到我的信时，他会在另一边笑。

senses.def: to fail to give your friends, family, etc. the help and support they expect, or to behave in a way that makes them disappointed
senses.zh: 使自己人失望；未能帮助（或支持）自己的一方

examples.en: You can always rely on Maggie—she’d never let the side down.
examples.zh: 你永远可以信赖玛吉——她永远不会让对方失望。

examples.en: I felt I was letting the side down by not going to the wedding.
examples.zh: 我没有去参加婚礼，感觉让自己人失望了。

senses.def: to be cheerful or positive about a bad situation, for example by thinking only of the advantages and not the disadvantages
senses.zh: （对坏情况）持乐观态度，看到光明的一面

examples.en: Look on the bright side. You managed to do more than I did.
examples.zh: 看好的一面吧，你比我当初做的多多了。

senses.def: to stay with somebody, especially in order to take care of them
senses.zh: （尤指为了照顾）不离某人左右

senses.def: in or from all directions; everywhere

examples.en: We realized we were surrounded on all sides.
examples.zh: 我们意识到我们被包围了。

examples.en: Disaster threatens on every side.
examples.zh: 灾祸四伏。

examples.en: She was bombarded with questions from all sides.
examples.zh: 她受到来自各方的质询。

senses.def: slightly too big, small, high, etc.

examples.en: These shoes are a little on the tight side.
examples.zh: 这双鞋略有点紧。

examples.en: Don’t you think you’re a bit on the short side to play basketball?
examples.zh: 你不觉得你打篮球有点矮吗？

senses.def: used to introduce the good points about somebody/something, especially after the bad points have been mentioned
senses.zh: （尤用于提及缺点之后）就优点方面而言

examples.en: On the credit side, she’s always willing to work very late.
examples.zh: 从好的方面来说，她总是愿意工作到很晚。

senses.def: on the woman’s side of the family
out of your way
senses.zh: 在（或到）一边；在（或到）一旁

examples.en: I left my bags on one side.
examples.zh: 我把几个包丢在一边。

senses.def: to be dealt with later

examples.en: I put his complaint to one side until I had more time.
examples.zh: 我把他的投诉放到一边，等时间充裕些再处理。

examples.en: Leaving that to one side for a moment, are there any other questions?
examples.zh: 把这个先放一放，还有没有别的问题？

senses.def: younger or older than 40, 50, etc. years of age
senses.zh: 不到／已过 40 岁（或 50 岁等）

senses.def: being especially careful; taking no risks

examples.en: I took some extra cash just to be on the safe side.
examples.zh: 我多带了一些现金，以防万一。

senses.def: in addition to your main job
senses.zh: 作为副业；兼职；在正事之外

examples.en: a mechanic who buys and sells cars on the side
examples.zh: 兼做汽车买卖的机修工

senses.def: secretly or illegally
senses.zh: 秘密地；偷偷摸摸地；非法地

examples.en: He's married but he has a girlfriend on the side.
examples.zh: 他有妻室，但暗地里还有一个女友。

senses.def: served at the same time as the main part of the meal, but on a separate plate
in trouble with the police
the aspect of a situation that is the opposite of or contrasts with the one you have been talking about
with the top part turned to the top; in the correct, normal position
senses.zh: 正面朝上；位置正确；在正常位置

examples.en: I dropped my toast, but luckily it fell right side up.
examples.zh: 我把烤面包掉在地上，但幸好它正面朝上。

senses.def: close together and facing in the same direction

examples.en: There were two children ahead, walking side by side.
examples.zh: 前面有两个孩子肩并肩走着。

examples.en: The two sat side by side on the bench.
examples.zh: 两人并排坐在凳子上。

senses.def: together, without any difficulties

examples.en: We have been using both systems, side by side, for two years.
examples.zh: 两年来，两套系统我们一直同时使用，互不影响。

examples.en: The two communities exist happily side by side.
examples.zh: 两个群体和睦共处，相安无事。

senses.def: used to refer to either of two opposite opinions on an issue

examples.en: The two countries are often on opposite sides of the fence when it comes to climate change.
examples.zh: 这两个国家在气候变化问题上经常对立。

examples.en: There are arguments on both sides of the aisle.
examples.zh: 辩论双方都有论据。

senses.def: to laugh a lot at somebody/something
to express support for somebody in an argument
senses.zh: 表示支持一方；表明立场

examples.en: She didn't think it was wise to take sides in their argument.
examples.zh: 对于他们的辩论，她觉得向着谁都不明智。

senses.def: to speak to somebody in private, especially in order to warn or tell them about something
senses.zh: 把某人拉到一边（悄悄说话）

senses.def: before a particular time, event, age, etc.

examples.en: They aren't likely to arrive this side of midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜之前他们不大可能赶到。

senses.def: a person or thing that repeatedly annoys somebody or stops them from doing something
senses.zh: 不断让人烦心的人（或事）；肉中刺；眼中钉

senses.def: used to say that somebody can wait for something to happen or can wait before doing something
senses.zh: 有的是时间（等待某事发生或做某事）

senses.def: used to talk about two ways of looking at the same situation
to support and agree with somebody
senses.zh: 站在某人一边；和某人观点一致

examples.en: I'm definitely on your side in this.
examples.zh: 在这个问题上，我毫不含糊地站在你这一边。

examples.en: Whose side are you on anyway?
examples.zh: 你到底赞成谁的观点呢？

senses.def: the boyfriend or girlfriend of somebody who is already married or in a steady sexual relationship with somebody else

examples.en: Is he your bit on the side?
examples.zh: 他是你的旁观者吗？

items.idm: come down on one side of the fence or the other

senses.zh: 二者择其一；支持两方中的一方

items.idm: err on the side of something

senses.def: to show too much of a good quality in order to avoid showing too little
senses.zh: 在某方面做过头；偏向于（好的特质）

examples.en: I thought it was better to err on the side of caution (= to be too careful rather than take a risk).
examples.zh: 我认为宁可过于谨慎也不要冒风险。

senses.def: moving to the left and then to the right and then back again

examples.en: He shook his head slowly from side to side.
examples.zh: 他慢慢地摇了摇头。

examples.en: The ship rolled from side to side.
examples.zh: 船左右摇晃。

examples.en: The cat sat with its tail twitching from side to side.
examples.zh: 猫蹲坐着，尾巴左右摆动。

items.idm: from/on the wrong side of the tracks

senses.def: from or living in a poor area or part of town
senses.zh: 来自（城里的）贫民区；住在贫穷的地区（或城区）

items.idm: get on the right/wrong side of somebody

senses.def: to make somebody pleased with you/annoyed with you
senses.zh: 讨得某人的欢心；惹得某人恼怒

items.idm: get out of bed on the wrong side

senses.def: to be in a bad mood for the whole day for no particular reason
senses.zh: （无缘由地）一起床就整天情绪不好

items.idm: the grass is (always) greener on the other side (of the fence)

senses.def: said about people who never seem happy with what they have and always think they could be happier in a different place or situation
senses.zh: 草是那边绿；这山望着那山高

senses.def: to have something as an advantage that will make it more likely that you will achieve something

examples.zh: 战争就快结束时，布拉格再次处于包围之中。

senses.def: being criticized all the time or put under pressure by problems, questions, etc.
senses.zh: 一再遭到批评的；受…困扰的

examples.en: The government is already under siege for its economic policy.
examples.zh: 政府已经因其经济政策而受到围攻。

examples.en: Under military and economic siege, entire economic sectors have collapsed.
examples.zh: 在军事和经济封锁下，整个经济已经崩溃。

senses.def: to begin a siege
senses.zh: 围困，围攻（城镇、建筑物等）

examples.en: The crusaders laid siege to Lisbon.
examples.zh: 十字军围攻里斯本。

examples.en: The English forces laid siege to the city of Tournai.
examples.zh: 英国军队包围了图尔奈城。

senses.def: to surround a building, especially in order to speak to or question the person or people living or working there
senses.zh: 包围（某建筑物，旨在和里面的人对话或质询）

examples.en: Crowds of journalists laid siege to the star’s apartment.
examples.zh: 成群结队的记者包围了这位明星的公寓。

senses.def: surrounded by an army or the police in a siege

examples.en: The city was under siege for six months.
examples.zh: 该城被围困了六个月。

examples.en: At the very end of the war, Prague again came under siege.
examples.zh: 战争就快结束时，布拉格再次处于包围之中。

senses.def: being criticized all the time or put under pressure by problems, questions, etc.
senses.zh: 一再遭到批评的；受…困扰的

examples.en: The government is already under siege for its economic policy.
examples.zh: 政府已经因其经济政策而受到围攻。

examples.en: Under military and economic siege, entire economic sectors have collapsed.
examples.zh: 在军事和经济封锁下，整个经济已经崩溃。

senses.def: a feeling that you are surrounded by enemies and must protect yourself
senses.zh: 受围心态（感觉周围都是敌人因而必须自卫）

senses.def: (1886-1967) an English poet and author. He served as a soldier in the First World War
senses.zh: 齐格弗里德·沙宣（Siegfried Sassoon）：（1886-1967）英国诗人和作家。他曾在第一次世界大战中当过士兵，并以关于战争恐怖的诗歌而闻名。他因在战斗中的勇气而被授予军事十字勋章，但后来由于反对战争而被拒绝。他的诗集包括《反击》（1918年），并写了一系列有关他一生的书，包括《猎狐人回忆录》（1928年）。

senses.def: the standard unit for measuring how well an object conducts
a type of dark yellow or red clay
senses.zh: （富铁）黄土，褐土（用作颜料）；黄褐色；赭色

examples.en: Burnt sienna, with its rich luminous red, makes an ideal colour for adding warmth to natural brick.
examples.zh: 烧赭石具有浓郁的发光红色，是为天然砖增添温暖的理想颜色。

senses.def: a first name for girls
a long range of steep mountains with sharp points, especially in Spain and America
senses.zh: （尤指西班牙和美洲的）锯齿状山脉

examples.en: the Sierra Nevada
examples.zh: 内华达山脉

senses.def: a country in West Africa which is a member of the Commonwealth. The capital city, Freetown, was established in 1787 by British people who were against the slave trade, as a place where former slaves could start new lives. There have been several conflicts between the descendants
(a person) from Sierra Leone
senses.zh: 塞拉利昂人；塞拉利昂的；塞拉利昂人的

senses.def: a rest or sleep taken in the early afternoon, especially in hot countries
senses.zh: （尤指在气候炎热的国家的）午睡，午休

examples.en: to have/take a siesta
examples.zh: 睡午觉

examples.en: I went upstairs for my afternoon siesta.
examples.zh: 我上楼去睡午觉。

examples.en: Lots of people were taking a short siesta in the shade.
examples.zh: 很多人在阴凉处小睡。

senses.def: a tool for separating solids from liquids or larger solids from smaller solids, made of a wire or plastic net attached to a ring. The liquid or small pieces pass through the net but the larger pieces do not.

examples.en: Press the apricot jam through a sieve and stir in one tablespoon of cold water.
examples.zh: 将杏酱压过筛子，加入一汤匙冷水搅拌。

examples.en: Wash the rice in a sieve under cold running water.
examples.zh: 把米放在筛子里，用流动的冷水冲洗。

senses.def: to have a very bad memory; to forget things easily
to put something through a sieve

examples.en: Liquidize or sieve half the soup and return it to the pot.
examples.zh: 把一半的汤打成浓汁或者滤一下，再倒回锅里。

examples.en: The compost is heavy and has been sieved to eliminate stones and twigs.
examples.zh: 堆肥很重，已经过筛以除去石头和树枝。

items.idm: have a memory/mind like a sieve

senses.def: to have a very bad memory; to forget things easily
a unit for measuring the effect of radiation
senses.zh: 希沃特（辐射效果单位，简称希）

senses.def: to put flour or some other fine substance through a sieve
senses.zh: 筛（面粉或颗粒较细的物质）

examples.en: Sift the flour into a bowl.
examples.zh: 把面粉筛到碗里。

senses.def: to examine something very carefully in order to decide what is important or useful or to find something important

examples.en: We will sift every scrap of evidence.
examples.zh: 我们将细查每一点证据。

examples.en: Computers are being used to sift the information.
examples.zh: 计算机被用来筛选信息。

examples.en: Crash investigators have been sifting through the wreckage of the aircraft.
examples.zh: 调查坠机事件的专家一直在仔细检查飞机残骸。

senses.def: to separate something from a group of things

examples.en: He sifted the relevant data from the rest.
examples.zh: 他从其余的资料中筛选出相关的资料。

examples.en: She looked quickly through the papers, sifting out from the pile anything that looked interesting.
examples.zh: 她很快地翻了一下那摞文件，把所有看着有趣的东西都拣了出来。

senses.def: to remove something that you do not want from a substance by putting it through a sieve

examples.en: Put the flour through a sieve to sift out the lumps.
examples.zh: 把面粉过筛，除去面块。

senses.def: to separate something, usually something you do not want, from a group of things

examples.en: We need to sift out the applications that have no chance of succeeding.
examples.zh: 我们需要剔出那些成功无望的申请。

examples.en: They will try to sift out the winners and the losers.
examples.zh: 他们将努力选出胜方和败方。

senses.def: a small sieve
a container with a lot of small holes in the top, used for shaking flour or sugar onto things
senses.zh: 撒…瓶（盖上有许多小孔，用于撒面粉等粉状物或糖）

examples.en: a sugar sifter
examples.zh: 撒糖瓶

senses.def: to take and then let out a long deep breath that can be heard, to show that you are disappointed, sad, tired, etc.

examples.en: He sighed deeply at the thought.
examples.zh: 想到这里，他深深叹了口气。

examples.en: She sighed with relief that it was all over.
examples.zh: 事情总算全都过去了，她轻松地舒了一口气。

senses.def: to say something with a sigh

examples.en: ‘Oh well, better luck next time,’ she sighed.
examples.zh: “唉，就这样了，但愿下一次运气好些。”她叹息道。

senses.def: to make a long sound like a sigh

examples.en: the sighing of the wind through the trees
examples.zh: 风穿过树林的叹息

examples.en: branches sighing in the wind
examples.zh: 树枝在风中叹息

senses.def: an act or the sound of sighing

examples.en: to give/heave/let out a sigh
examples.zh: 发出叹息

examples.en: a deep sigh
examples.zh: 深深的叹息

examples.en: ‘I'll wait,’ he said with a sigh.
examples.zh: “我就等呗。”他叹口气说。

examples.en: We all breathed a sigh of relief when it was over.
examples.zh: 事情过去了，我们大家都松了一口气。

senses.def: the ability to see

examples.en: to lose your sight (= to become blind)
examples.zh: 失明

examples.en: She has very good sight.
examples.zh: 她的视力很好。

examples.en: The disease has affected her sight.
examples.zh: 这种病影响了她的视力。

examples.en: He has very little sight in his right eye.
examples.zh: 他右眼视力极弱。

examples.en: It's important that you have regular sight tests.
examples.zh: 定期进行视力检查很重要。

senses.def: the act of seeing somebody/something

examples.en: She kept sight of him in her mirror.
examples.zh: 她一直在镜子里看着他。

examples.en: She caught sight of a car in the distance.
examples.zh: 她看见远处有一辆车。

examples.en: After ten days at sea, we had our first sight of land.
examples.zh: 我们在海上航行十天之后，首次看见陆地。

examples.en: The mere sight of him makes me want to scream.
examples.zh: 光是看到他就让我想尖叫。

examples.en: The sight of him hobbling off so early in the match depressed everyone.
examples.zh: 看到他在比赛这么早就一瘸一拐地退场，每个人都感到沮丧。

examples.en: He laughed quietly to himself at the sight.
examples.zh: 看到这一幕，他暗自笑了起来。

examples.en: I have been known to faint at the sight of blood.
examples.zh: 大家都知道，我看到血就会昏倒。

examples.en: The soldiers were given orders to shoot on sight (= as soon as they saw somebody).
examples.zh: 士兵得到命令，见人就射击。

senses.def: the area or distance within which somebody can see or something can be seen

examples.en: There was no one in sight.
examples.zh: 一个人也看不见。

examples.en: They stole everything in sight.
examples.zh: 他们偷走了眼前的一切。

examples.en: The end is in sight (= will happen soon).
examples.zh: 结局已现端倪。

examples.en: The goats ate everything in sight.
examples.zh: 山羊吃掉了眼前的一切。

examples.en: At last we came in sight of a few houses.
examples.zh: 最后，我们看到了几座房屋。

examples.en: A bicycle came into sight on the main road.
examples.zh: 大路上出现了一辆自行车。

examples.en: They marched on and by the following afternoon the enemy was within sight.
examples.zh: 他们继续行军，第二天下午敌人进入了视线。

examples.en: He sprinted ahead as they came within sight of the finishing line.
examples.zh: 当他们看到终点线时他向前冲刺。

examples.en: Leave any valuables in your car out of sight.
examples.zh: 把贵重物品留在车里看不见的地方。

examples.en: Keep out of sight (= stay where you cannot be seen).
examples.zh: 不要露面。

examples.en: She never lets her daughter out of her sight (= always keeps her where she can see her).
examples.zh: 她从来不让女儿走出她的视线。

examples.en: Get out of my sight! (= Go away!)
examples.zh: 滚开！

examples.en: The boat disappeared from sight.
examples.zh: 那艘船从视野中消失了。

examples.en: The house was hidden from sight behind some trees.
examples.zh: 房子藏在树林后面。

examples.en: He won't let the children leave his sight.
examples.zh: 他不让孩子们离开他的视线。

examples.en: Her father was nowhere in sight.
examples.zh: 她的父亲没了踪影。

examples.en: The cricket ground was situated within sight of both village pubs.
examples.zh: 在该村的两个酒吧都能看到那个板球场。

examples.en: They waited until the enemy was in plain sight.
examples.zh: 他们一直等到敌人清晰地出现在视野里。

examples.en: He strode by, in full sight of the guards.
examples.zh: 他在卫兵的眼皮底下大步走过。

examples.en: He didn't shoot until he had a clear sight of the goal.
examples.zh: 他看清目标后才射击。

senses.group: how far you can see 视野

senses.def: a thing that you see or can see
senses.zh: 看见（或看得见）的事物；景象；情景

examples.en: Roadside stalls are a common sight in the city.
examples.zh: 路边摊在这个城市很常见。

examples.en: It's a spectacular sight as the flamingos lift into the air.
examples.zh: 一群红鹳飞向空中，景象十分壮观。

examples.en: The museum attempts to recreate the sights and sounds of wartime Britain.
examples.zh: 博物馆试图再现战时英国的情景。

examples.en: He was a sorry sight, soaked to the skin and shivering.
examples.zh: 他浑身湿透，打着寒战，一副凄惨的样子。

examples.en: The bird is now a rare sight in this country.
examples.zh: 如今在这个国家，这种鸟已罕见了。

examples.en: He became a familiar sight on the streets of Oxford.
examples.zh: 他成了牛津大街上一道熟悉的风景。

examples.en: The gardens were a beautiful sight to behold in the twilight.
examples.zh: 暮色中的花园景色十分美丽。

senses.group: what you can see 看见的事物

senses.def: the interesting places, especially in a town or city, that are often visited by tourists

examples.en: We're going to Paris for the weekend to see the sights.
examples.zh: 我们打算去巴黎过周末，参观那里的名胜。

examples.en: The next day I did the sights of the city.
examples.zh: 第二天我游览了这座城市的景点。

examples.en: It's best if you can get someone local to show you the sights.
examples.zh: 最好找当地人带你参观景点。

senses.def: a person or thing that looks silly, untidy, unpleasant, etc.
senses.zh: 可笑（或邋遢、脏乱、讨厌）的人（或物）

examples.en: She looks a sight in that hat!
examples.zh: 她戴着那顶帽子，样子够滑稽的！

senses.group: silly/untidy person 可笑／邋遢的人

senses.def: a device that you look through to aim a gun, etc. or to look at something through a telescope

examples.en: He had the deer in his sights now.
examples.zh: 他现在瞄准了那头鹿。

examples.en: to align the sights on the target
examples.zh: 将瞄准器对准目标

examples.en: Even as a young actress, she always had Hollywood firmly in her sights (= as her final goal).
examples.zh: 她还是年轻演员的时候，就瞄准了好莱坞。

senses.def: when you first begin to consider something

examples.en: At first sight, it may look like a generous offer, but always read the small print.
examples.zh: 乍一看，对方给出的条件好像很优厚，但任何时候都不要小看那些小号字印刷的附加条款。

senses.def: when you see somebody/something for the first time

examples.en: It was love at first sight (= we fell in love the first time we saw each other).
examples.zh: 我们一见钟情。

examples.en: We fell in love with the house at first sight.
examples.zh: 我们第一眼看到这所房子就爱上了它。

examples.en: He looked at first sight like a tourist.
examples.zh: 乍一看他像是个游客。

senses.def: to hate, etc. somebody/something very much

examples.en: I can't stand the sight of him!
examples.zh: 我看见他就烦！

examples.en: We've shared an office for too long and we're sick of the sight of each other.
examples.zh: 我们在一个办公室里工作时间太长了，彼此一见面就感到厌烦。

senses.def: to appear, especially when moving gradually closer from a long way off

examples.en: A ship hove into sight.
examples.zh: 远处出现了一条船。

examples.en: Like a galleon in full sail, Cara hove into view.
examples.zh: 卡拉就像一艘扬帆起航的大帆船，驶入了我们的视野。

senses.def: in somebody’s opinion
senses.zh: 从某人的观点来看；在某人看来

examples.en: We are all equal in the sight of God.
examples.zh: 在上帝眼里我们都是平等的。

senses.def: to recognize somebody without knowing them well
to become no longer able to see somebody/something

examples.en: They finally lost sight of land.
examples.zh: 他们终于看不见陆地了。

senses.def: to stop considering something; to forget something

examples.en: We must not lose sight of our original aim.
examples.zh: 我们决不能忘记我们最初的目标。

senses.def: not pleasant to look at

examples.en: You should have seen him in his swimming trunks—not a pretty sight!
examples.zh: 你应该见识见识他穿游泳裤的样子，真是一景呢！

senses.def: impossible for anyone to find or see

examples.en: I wanted to talk to him but he was nowhere to be found.
examples.zh: 我想和他谈谈，但哪儿也找不到他。

examples.en: The children were nowhere to be seen.
examples.zh: 根本看不到孩子们在哪儿。

examples.en: A peace settlement is nowhere in sight (= is not likely in the near future).
examples.zh: 近期内无望和平解决。

senses.def: used to say somebody will quickly be forgotten when they are no longer with you
to expect more/less from a situation
senses.zh: 提高／降低要求；眼光变高／变低

examples.en: If they can’t afford such a big house, they’ll just have to lower their sights a little.
examples.zh: 如果买不起这么大的房子，他们就只能把目光放低一点了。

examples.en: After failing to get into university, he lowered his sights and got a job in a shop.
examples.zh: 未能上成大学后他降低了目标，在一家商店里 找了份工作。

senses.def: to decide that you want something and to try very hard to get it
senses.zh: 以…为奋斗目标；决心做到

examples.en: She's set her sights on getting into Harvard.
examples.zh: 她决心要上哈佛大学。

examples.en: I had set my sights on a career in journalism.
examples.zh: 我立志从事新闻事业。

examples.en: He says he wants to win the trophy, but I think he's setting his sights too high.
examples.zh: 他说他想赢得奖杯，但我认为他目标定得太高了。

examples.en: She has her sights set on becoming a writer.
examples.zh: 她的目标是成为作家。

senses.def: very much better; much too good, etc.

examples.en: She's done a darn sight better than I have.
examples.zh: 她干得比我强多了。

examples.en: It's worth a damn sight more than I thought.
examples.zh: 它的价值比我原先想的高多了。

senses.def: a person or thing that you are pleased to see; something that is very pleasant to look at
if you buy something sight unseen
senses.zh: 在未见过的情况下；事先未经检查

examples.en: I bought it, sight unseen.
examples.zh: 我没见到东西就把它买下了。

senses.def: to suddenly see something, especially something you have been looking for

examples.en: After twelve days at sea, they sighted land.
examples.zh: 在海上航行十二天后他们看到了陆地。

note.en: Hove is usually used for the past tense and past participle in this idiom.
note.zh: 这一习语中 heave 的过去式及过去分词通常用 hove。

senses.def: when you first begin to consider something

examples.en: At first sight, it may look like a generous offer, but always read the small print.
examples.zh: 乍一看，对方给出的条件好像很优厚，但任何时候都不要小看那些小号字印刷的附加条款。

senses.def: when you see somebody/something for the first time

examples.en: It was love at first sight (= we fell in love the first time we saw each other).
examples.zh: 我们一见钟情。

examples.en: We fell in love with the house at first sight.
examples.zh: 我们第一眼看到这所房子就爱上了它。

examples.en: He looked at first sight like a tourist.
examples.zh: 乍一看他像是个游客。

items.idm: hate, be sick of, etc. the sight of somebody/something

senses.def: to hate, etc. somebody/something very much

examples.en: I can't stand the sight of him!
examples.zh: 我看见他就烦！

examples.en: We've shared an office for too long and we're sick of the sight of each other.
examples.zh: 我们在一个办公室里工作时间太长了，彼此一见面就感到厌烦。

senses.def: to appear, especially when moving gradually closer from a long way off

examples.en: A ship hove into sight.
examples.zh: 远处出现了一条船。

examples.en: Like a galleon in full sail, Cara hove into view.
examples.zh: 卡拉就像一艘扬帆起航的大帆船，驶入了我们的视野。

items.idm: in the sight of somebody/in somebody’s sight

senses.def: in somebody’s opinion
senses.zh: 从某人的观点来看；在某人看来

examples.en: We are all equal in the sight of God.
examples.zh: 在上帝眼里我们都是平等的。

senses.def: to recognize somebody without knowing them well
to become no longer able to see somebody/something

examples.en: They finally lost sight of land.
examples.zh: 他们终于看不见陆地了。

senses.def: to stop considering something; to forget something

examples.en: We must not lose sight of our original aim.
examples.zh: 我们决不能忘记我们最初的目标。

senses.def: not pleasant to look at

examples.en: You should have seen him in his swimming trunks—not a pretty sight!
examples.zh: 你应该见识见识他穿游泳裤的样子，真是一景呢！

items.idm: nowhere to be found/seen | nowhere in sight

senses.def: impossible for anyone to find or see

examples.en: I wanted to talk to him but he was nowhere to be found.
examples.zh: 我想和他谈谈，但哪儿也找不到他。

examples.en: The children were nowhere to be seen.
examples.zh: 根本看不到孩子们在哪儿。

examples.en: A peace settlement is nowhere in sight (= is not likely in the near future).
examples.zh: 近期内无望和平解决。

items.idm: out of sight, out of mind

senses.def: used to say somebody will quickly be forgotten when they are no longer with you
to expect more/less from a situation
senses.zh: 提高／降低要求；眼光变高／变低

examples.en: If they can’t afford such a big house, they’ll just have to lower their sights a little.
examples.zh: 如果买不起这么大的房子，他们就只能把目光放低一点了。

examples.en: After failing to get into university, he lowered his sights and got a job in a shop.
examples.zh: 未能上成大学后他降低了目标，在一家商店里 找了份工作。

items.idm: set your sights on something/on doing something

senses.def: to decide that you want something and to try very hard to get it
senses.zh: 以…为奋斗目标；决心做到

examples.en: She's set her sights on getting into Harvard.
examples.zh: 她决心要上哈佛大学。

examples.en: I had set my sights on a career in journalism.
examples.zh: 我立志从事新闻事业。

examples.en: He says he wants to win the trophy, but I think he's setting his sights too high.
examples.zh: 他说他想赢得奖杯，但我认为他目标定得太高了。

examples.en: She has her sights set on becoming a writer.
examples.zh: 她的目标是成为作家。

items.idm: a (damn, etc.) sight better, etc. | a (damn, etc.) sight too good, etc.

senses.def: very much better; much too good, etc.

examples.en: She's done a darn sight better than I have.
examples.zh: 她干得比我强多了。

examples.en: It's worth a damn sight more than I thought.
examples.zh: 它的价值比我原先想的高多了。

senses.def: a person or thing that you are pleased to see; something that is very pleasant to look at
if you buy something sight unseen
senses.zh: 在未见过的情况下；事先未经检查

examples.en: I bought it, sight unseen.
examples.zh: 我没见到东西就把它买下了。

intro.en: These are all words for the area or distance that you can see from a particular position.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指视力范围、视野。

items.def: the area or distance that you can see from a particular position:
items.zh: 指视力范围、视野

examples.en: He looked up the street, but there was no one in sight.
examples.zh: 他朝街上望去，一个人也没看见。

items.def: (rather formal) the area or distance that you can see from a particular position:
items.zh: 指视力范围、视野

examples.en: The lake soon came into view.
examples.zh: 那湖很快便映入眼帘。

items.def: the area that you can see from a particular position:
items.zh: 指视野

examples.en: The couple moved outside her field of vision (= total area you can see from a particular position).
examples.zh: 这对夫妇离开了她的视野。

intro.en: These are all words for a thing that you can see, especially from a particular place.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指景色，尤指从某处看到的风景。

items.def: what you can see from a particular place or position, especially beautiful natural scenery:
items.zh: 指从某处看到的景色、风景，尤指自然美景

examples.en: The cottage had a delightful sea view.
examples.zh: 这小屋可以看到宜人的海景。

items.def: a thing that you see or can see, especially something that is impressive or unusual:
items.zh: 指看见或看得见的事物、景象，尤指壮观、奇特的景象

examples.en: It’s a spectacular sight as the flamingos lift into the air.
examples.zh: 一群红鹳飞向空中，景象十分壮观。

items.def: a view that you see, especially one with people and/​or animals moving about and doing things:
items.zh: 指景象、景色，尤指有人和／或动物活动的风光

examples.en: It was a delightful rural scene.
examples.zh: 那是赏心悦目的乡村风光。

items.def: a view of a wide area of land:
items.zh: 指全景

examples.en: The tower offers a breathtaking panorama of Prague.
examples.zh: 从塔上可看到壮丽的布拉格全景。

senses.def: if you buy something sight unseen
senses.zh: 在未见过的情况下；事先未经检查

examples.en: I bought it, sight unseen.
examples.zh: 我没见到东西就把它买下了。

senses.def: an imaginary line that goes from somebody’s eye to something that they are looking at
to play or sing written music when you see it for the first time, without practising it first
senses.zh: 视奏，视唱（事先没有练习，直接看着乐谱演奏或演唱）

senses.def: a person who can play or sing written music when they see it for the first time, without practising it first
senses.zh: 视奏，视唱（事先没有练习，直接看着乐谱演奏或演唱）

examples.en: He’s an excellent sight-reader.
examples.zh: 他是一位出色的视奏者。

senses.def: unable to see

examples.en: The statue stared down at them with sightless eyes.
examples.zh: 雕像用一双盲眼俯视着他们。

senses.def: to visit interesting buildings and places as a tourist

examples.en: That day I was sightseeing in Rome.
examples.zh: 那天我正在罗马观光。

senses.def: a person who is visiting interesting buildings and places as a tourist

examples.en: Oxford attracts large numbers of sightseers.
examples.zh: 牛津吸引着大量观光客。

senses.def: the 18th letter of the Greek alphabet (Σ, σ)
senses.zh: 希腊字母表的第 18 个字母

senses.def: (1887-1951) a US composer
senses.zh: 西格蒙德·隆伯格（Sigmund Romberg）：（1887-1951）是美国作曲家，出生于匈牙利，曾写过70多部百老汇音乐剧和轻歌剧。其中包括Maytime（1917），The Student Prince（1924）和The Desert Song（1926）。他的几部戏被拍成电影。

senses.def: an event, an action, a fact, etc. that shows that something exists, is happening or may happen in the future

examples.en: Looking back, I should have seen the signs.
examples.zh: 回想起来，我应该看到了迹象。

examples.en: a clear/visible sign
examples.zh: 清晰的迹象；显而易见的征兆

examples.en: an encouraging sign
examples.zh: 鼓舞人心的迹象

examples.en: a positive sign
examples.zh: 正号

examples.en: The fact that he didn't say ‘no’ immediately is a good sign.
examples.zh: 他没有马上拒绝，这是好兆头。

examples.en: If I had noticed the warning signs, none of this would have happened.
examples.zh: 要是我当时注意到了那些危险苗头，这种事就一桩也不会发生。

examples.en: Early signs point to business improving.
examples.zh: 早期迹象预示业务有所好转。

examples.en: This move will be seen as a sign of weakness.
examples.zh: 这一举动会被看成是示弱。

examples.en: Bankers say they can definitely detect signs of a recovery.
examples.zh: 银行家们说他们明显觉察到复苏的迹象。

examples.en: Headaches may be a sign of stress.
examples.zh: 头痛可能是紧张的迹象。

examples.en: There is no sign of John anywhere.
examples.zh: 哪儿都没有约翰的影子。

examples.en: Soldiers swarmed the city looking for any sign of her.
examples.zh: 士兵们涌入城市寻找她的踪迹。

examples.en: There was no sign of life in the house (= there seemed to be nobody there).
examples.zh: 那座房子没有一点住人的迹象。

examples.en: Her work is showing some signs of improvement.
examples.zh: 她的工作出现了一些改进的迹象。

examples.en: I hope this incident isn't a sign of things to come.
examples.zh: 我希望这件事不意味着将有大事发生。

examples.en: Get this test if you have signs and symptoms of diabetes.
examples.zh: 如果有糖尿病的症状，就做这个检查。

examples.en: He is reading the signs all wrong.
examples.zh: 他对标志的解读全错了。

examples.en: Call the police at the first sign of trouble.
examples.zh: 一有闹事的苗头就叫警察。

examples.en: The gloomy weather shows no sign of improving.
examples.zh: 阴沉的天气没有丝毫转晴的迹象。

examples.en: There is little sign of this happening in the immediate future.
examples.zh: 几乎没有迹象表明这种情况会在不久的将来发生。

examples.en: If an interview is too easy, it's a sure sign that you haven't got the job.
examples.zh: 如果面试太简单，那必定表示你没得到那份工作。

examples.en: There were no outward signs that anything was wrong.
examples.zh: 没有任何外在迹象表明有什么问题。

senses.def: a piece of paper, wood or metal that has writing or a picture on it that gives you information, instructions, a warning, etc.

examples.en: to put up/post a sign
examples.zh: 竖起指示牌

examples.en: to carry/hold a sign
examples.zh: 携带/持有标志

examples.en: a street/stop sign
examples.zh: 路标；停车标志

examples.en: a shop/pub sign
examples.zh: 商店╱酒吧招牌

examples.en: a traffic sign
examples.zh: 交通标志

examples.en: The sign read ‘No Fishing’.
examples.zh: 标牌上写着“禁止垂钓”。

examples.en: The sign on the wall said ‘Now wash your hands’.
examples.zh: 墙上的牌子上写着“请洗手”。

examples.en: There was a 'Closed' sign in the window.
examples.zh: 窗户上挂着“已关闭”的牌子。

examples.en: Follow the signs for the city centre.
examples.zh: 照标牌的指示到市中心。

senses.group: for information/warning 提供信息；用以提醒

senses.def: a movement or sound that you make to tell somebody something
senses.zh: 示意的动作（或声音）；手势

examples.en: He gave a thumbs-up sign (= to show approval/agreement).
examples.zh: 他竖起大拇指表示赞同。

examples.en: She was waiting for some kind of sign from him.
examples.zh: 她在等待他的某种信号。

examples.en: At a sign from her, the band would start to play.
examples.zh: 只要她一示意，乐队就会开始演奏。

examples.en: He gave a slight bow as a sign of respect.
examples.zh: 他欠了欠身以示尊重。

examples.en: She shook her head in a desperate sign to tell the child to remain silent.
examples.zh: 她绝望地摇摇头，示意孩子保持沉默。

examples.en: She nodded as a sign for us to sit down.
examples.zh: 她点头示意我们坐下。

examples.en: Three blasts on the whistle was the sign for visitors to leave.
examples.zh: 哨声三声，是游客离开的标志。

examples.en: to make the sign of the cross (= an act of moving one hand in the shape of a cross, done by Christians to show respect for God or by a priest to bless somebody/something)
examples.zh: （在胸口上）画十字圣号

senses.def: a mark used to represent something, especially in mathematics

examples.en: a plus/minus sign (= +/−)
examples.zh: 加号；减号

examples.en: a dollar/pound sign (= $/£)
examples.zh: 美元／英镑的符号

examples.en: the sign for ‘square root’
examples.zh: “平方根”的符号

senses.def: a star sign

examples.en: What sign are you?
examples.zh: 你是什么星座？

senses.def: something that you feel shows what things are like now, especially how bad they are

examples.en: The increasing number of people owning guns is an alarming sign of the times.
examples.zh: 拥有枪支的人数不断增加是这个时代的一个令人震惊的迹象。

senses.def: to write your name on a document, letter, etc. to show that you have written it, that you agree with what it says, or that it is real

examples.en: Sign here, please.
examples.zh: 请在这里签名。

examples.en: to sign an agreement/a deal/a contract
examples.zh: 签署协议／协定／合同

examples.en: to sign a document/statement/declaration/form
examples.zh: 签署文件／声明／公告／表格

examples.en: to sign a petition/a bill/ an order
examples.zh: 签署请愿书/法案/命令

examples.en: to sign a cheque
examples.zh: 在支票上签字

examples.en: Sign your name here, please.
examples.zh: 请在这里签名。

examples.en: You haven't signed the letter.
examples.zh: 这封信您还没有署名。

examples.en: The treaty was signed on 24 March.
examples.zh: 条约是 3 月 24 日签订的。

examples.en: The player was signing autographs for a group of fans.
examples.zh: 这名队员正在为一群球迷签名。

examples.en: I'm going to his office now to sign the papers.
examples.zh: 我现在要去他的办公室签署文件。

examples.en: The bill was signed into law by the president yesterday.
examples.zh: 该法案昨天由总统签署成为法律。

examples.en: He signed himself ‘Jimmy’.
examples.zh: 他署名“吉米”。

senses.def: to arrange for somebody, for example a sports player or musician, to sign a contract agreeing to work for your company; to sign a contract agreeing to work for a company

examples.en: United have just signed a new goalie.
examples.zh: 联队最近和一名新守门员签约。

examples.en: to sign a player
examples.zh: 和一名球员签约

examples.en: He signed for United yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天他和联队签了约。

examples.en: The band signed with Virgin Records.
examples.zh: 乐队同维京唱片公司签了约。

examples.en: She was the first musician signed to the new record label.
examples.zh: 她是第一个跟这家新唱片公司签约的音乐家。

senses.def: to make a request or tell somebody to do something by using a sign, especially a hand movement

examples.en: The hotel manager signed to the porter to pick up my case.
examples.zh: 旅馆经理示意行李员替我拿箱子。

examples.en: The police officer signed for us to stop.
examples.zh: 警察示意我们停下来。

examples.en: The police officer signed that we were to stop.
examples.zh: 警察示意我们停下来。

examples.en: He signed his troops to move out.
examples.zh: 他签署了部队撤离令。

senses.group: make movement/sound 做出动作；发出声音

senses.def: to use sign language to communicate with somebody

examples.en: She learnt to sign to help her deaf child.
examples.zh: 为帮助她耳聋的孩子，她学会了手语。

examples.en: An increasing number of plays are now being signed.
examples.zh: 现在越来越多的戏剧配上了手语。

senses.def: definite, because all the legal documents have been signed
senses.zh: 签名盖章完毕的；铁定的；成定局的

senses.def: to sign a document to show that you have agreed to buy something or do something
senses.zh: 在签字处签上姓名（表示同意）；签名同意

examples.en: Just sign on the dotted line and the car is yours.
examples.zh: 只要在虚线上签名，这车就归你了。

senses.def: to make a promise never to drink alcohol
something that you feel shows what things are like now, especially how bad they are

examples.en: The increasing number of people owning guns is an alarming sign of the times.
examples.zh: 拥有枪支的人数不断增加是这个时代的一个令人震惊的迹象。

items.idm: signed and sealed | signed, sealed and delivered

senses.def: definite, because all the legal documents have been signed
senses.zh: 签名盖章完毕的；铁定的；成定局的

senses.def: to sign a document to show that you have agreed to buy something or do something
senses.zh: 在签字处签上姓名（表示同意）；签名同意
