examples.zh: 这个中产阶级的孩子，其父亲认识公司董事，据说有更多的社会资本。

examples.en: Corporations transform social capital into economic capital.
examples.zh: 公司将社会资本转化为经济资本。

senses.def: a person who tries to improve their position in society by becoming friendly with people who belong to a higher social class
senses.zh: 攀附权贵借以挤入上流社会的人；趋炎附势向上爬的人

senses.def: the state of being aware of the problems that affect a lot of people in society, such as being poor or having no home, and wanting to do something to help these people

senses.zh: 社会契约，民约（以公益约束行为）

examples.zh: 社会达尔文主义在过去曾被用来证明种族主义政策的合理性。

senses.zh: 社会民主主义；社会民主主义国家

senses.def: a person who believes in or supports social democracy
senses.zh: 社会主义者；社会党党员

senses.zh: 社会民主主义；社会民主主义国家

senses.zh: 社交距离（人与人之间保持安全距离，以防止疾病传播）

examples.en: She rubbed his back soothingly.
examples.zh: 她安抚地抚摸着他的背。

senses.def: a person who is believed to be able to tell what will happen in the future
covered with soot
of the colour of soot
senses.zh: 煤烟子一样黑的；炭黑色的

senses.def: a small, not very important, thing that is offered to somebody who is angry or disappointed in order to make them feel better
senses.zh: （为缓和某人愤怒或失望情绪而赠与的）小东西

examples.en: The move was seen as another sop to the moderates in the party.
examples.zh: 这个举措被视为对党内温和派另一小小的安抚。

senses.def: a set of instructions on how to perform a routine business activity (the abbreviation for standard operating procedure

examples.en: The company has been accused of flouting the SOPs and guidelines formulated to combat the disease.
examples.zh: 该公司被指控无视为对抗这种疾病而制定的标准操作程序和指南。

senses.def: a first name for girls
a first name for girls
a teacher of philosophy in ancient Greece, especially one with an attitude of doubting that statements are true
senses.zh: （古希腊的）哲学教师；（尤指持质疑态度的）哲人，智者

senses.def: a person who uses clever but wrong arguments
a sophisticated
senses.zh: 老于世故的人；见多识广的人

examples.en: She wasn’t the sophisticate that Jack had imagined her to be.
examples.zh: 她并不像杰克想象的那样世故。

senses.def: clever and complicated in the way that it works or is presented
senses.zh: 复杂巧妙的；先进的；精密的

examples.en: highly sophisticated computer systems
examples.zh: 十分先进的计算机系统

examples.en: Medical techniques are becoming more sophisticated all the time.
examples.zh: 医疗技术日益复杂精妙。

senses.def: having a lot of experience of the world and knowing about fashion, culture and other things that people think are socially important
senses.zh: 见多识广的；老练的；见过世面的

examples.en: the sophisticated pleasures of city life
examples.zh: 城市生活中五花八门的享乐

examples.en: Mark is a smart and sophisticated young man.
examples.zh: 马克是一个聪明老成的年轻人。

senses.def: able to understand difficult or complicated ideas

examples.en: a sophisticated audience
examples.zh: 有鉴赏力的观众

senses.def: experience of the world and knowledge of fashion, culture and other things that people think are socially important
senses.zh: 见多识广的；老练的；见过世面的

examples.en: Despite her scruffy clothes, there was an air of sophistication about her.
examples.zh: 尽管她衣衫褴褛，但神态老练世故。

examples.en: He felt people were contemptuous of his lack of sophistication.
examples.zh: 他觉得人们看不起他不懂人情世故。

examples.en: She adopted an upper-class accent to give herself a veneer of sophistication.
examples.zh: 她操着上层社会的口音，装出一副很老练的样子。

senses.def: the quality in a machine or system of being clever and complicated in the way that it works or is presented

examples.en: the increasing power and sophistication of computers
examples.zh: 计算机的日趋强大与先进

examples.en: Financial markets have grown in sophistication as well as size.
examples.zh: 金融市场的规模不断扩大，复杂程度也越来越高。

senses.def: the ability to understand difficult or complicated ideas

examples.en: He writes with increasing sophistication on the subject.
examples.zh: 他写这个题目越来越得心应手。

senses.def: the use of clever arguments to persuade people that something is true when it is really false

examples.en: Convincing myself that I had gained in some way from my loss was just pure sophistry.
examples.zh: 让自己相信我在某种程度上从我的损失中得到了纯粹的诡辩。

senses.def: a reason or an explanation that tries to show that something is true when it is really false

examples.en: He was hostile to their hypocritical sophistries.
examples.zh: 他对他们虚伪的诡辩充满敌意。

senses.def: a student in the second year of a course of study at a college or university
a high school
showing a lack of maturity

examples.en: sophomoric jokes
examples.zh: 幼稚的笑话

senses.def: making you want to go to sleep

examples.en: the soporific effect of the sun
examples.zh: 太阳让人昏昏欲睡的作用

senses.def: very wet

examples.en: Your clothes are sopping wet!
examples.zh: 你的衣服都湿透了！

senses.def: silly and sentimental
senses.zh: 一味情意缠绵的；感情过于丰富的；多愁善感的

examples.en: soppy love songs
examples.zh: 缠绵的情歌

examples.en: She is soppy about cats.
examples.zh: 她对猫很敏感。

senses.def: a small musical instrument, especially a recorder
senses.zh: 一种比高音乐器演奏更高的小型乐器，尤其是录音机或萨克斯风

senses.def: a singing voice with the highest range for a woman or boy; a singer with a soprano
senses.zh: 女高音声部；女高音歌手

examples.en: She has sung soprano in many major operas.
examples.zh: 她在很多大型歌剧中唱过女高音。

senses.def: a musical part written for a soprano
with the highest range of notes in its group

examples.en: a soprano saxophone
examples.zh: 高音萨克斯管

senses.def: the most common size of recorder
a sweet frozen food made from sugar, water and fruit juice, often eaten as a dessert
(in stories) a man with magic powers, who is helped by evil spirits

examples.en: He was suspected of misusing his magical powers as a sorcerer.
examples.zh: 人们怀疑他滥用魔法。

senses.def: (in stories) a woman with magic powers, who is helped by evil spirits

examples.en: She was given poison by an evil sorceress.
examples.zh: 邪恶的女巫给她下了毒药。

senses.def: magic that uses evil spirits

examples.en: sorcery and witchcraft
examples.zh: 巫术和妖术

examples.en: She was said to have caused the king’s illness by sorcery.
examples.zh: 据说她施巫术使国王得病。

senses.def: not moral or honest

examples.en: It was a shock to discover the truth about his sordid past.
examples.zh: 他以往的丑行被发现时，人们感到震惊。

examples.en: I didn't want to hear the sordid details of their relationship.
examples.zh: 我不想听他们之间的那些龌龊细节。

examples.en: I don’t care about you and your sordid little affairs!
examples.zh: 我不关心你和你那些肮脏的小事！

senses.def: very dirty and unpleasant

examples.en: people living in sordid conditions
examples.zh: 生活环境肮脏不堪的人

examples.en: These were the urban poor, living in the sordid back streets and alleys of prosperous Victorian cities.
examples.zh: 这是些城市贫民，生活在维多利亚时代繁荣的城市中肮脏的后街和小巷里。

senses.def: if a part of your body is sore

examples.en: to have a sore throat
examples.zh: 嗓子疼

examples.en: His feet were sore after the walk.
examples.zh: 他走路把脚都走疼了。

examples.en: My stomach is still sore (= painful) after the operation.
examples.zh: 手术后，我的胃还在疼。

examples.en: When I woke up my head was sore and throbbing.
examples.zh: 当我醒来时，我的头又痛又抽痛。

senses.def: upset and angry, especially because you have been treated unfairly

examples.en: He was still sore at me for telling him he couldn't sing.
examples.zh: 他还气恼我说他不会唱歌。

senses.def: in a bad mood; in an angry way

examples.en: I should keep out of his way. He’s like a bear with a sore head this morning.
examples.zh: 我应该远离他。今天早上他就像一头头疼的熊。

senses.def: a person or thing that you are pleased to see; something that is very pleasant to look at
a subject that makes you feel angry or upset when it is mentioned

examples.en: It's a sore point with Sue's parents that the children have not been baptized yet.
examples.zh: 孩子们至今未受洗礼，这是休的父母的一块心病。

senses.def: to be very easy to notice in an unpleasant way

examples.en: The blue building stood out like a sore thumb among the whitewashed villas.
examples.zh: 蓝色的建筑在粉刷成白色的别墅中显得格外显眼。

examples.en: If you wear a suit to the party, you’ll stand out like a sore thumb.
examples.zh: 如果你穿西装去参加聚会，你会很引人注目。

senses.def: a painful, often red, place on your body where there is a wound or an infection

examples.en: The illness left them with open sores all over their backs.
examples.zh: 这种病让他们的背上全是开放性溃疡。

examples.en: open sores
examples.zh: 开放性溃疡

synonyms.words: sore ▪ raw ▪ inflamed ▪ excruciating ▪ burning ▪ itchy

intro.en: These words all describe something that causes you physical pain.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指使人肉体上疼痛的。

items.def: causing you physical pain. Painful can describe a part of the body, illness, injury, treatment or death:
items.zh: painful 可用于描述身体部位、疾病、受伤、治疗或死亡等

items.def: (of a part of the body) painful and often red, especially because of infection or because a muscle has been used too much:
items.zh: 指（身体部位）发炎疼痛的、肌肉酸痛的

examples.en: a sore throat
examples.zh: 咽喉疼

items.def: (of a part of the body) red and painful, for example because of an infection or because the skin has been damaged:
items.zh: 指（身体部位）红肿疼痛的、破损的、擦伤的

examples.en: The skin on her feet had been rubbed raw.
examples.zh: 她脚上的皮磨破了。

items.def: (of a part of the body) painful, red and hot because of an infection or injury:
items.zh: 指（身体部位）发炎的、红肿的

examples.en: The wound had become inflamed.
examples.zh: 伤口发炎了。

items.def: extremely painful. Excruciating can describe feelings, treatments or death but not parts of the body:
items.zh: excruciating 可用于描述情感、治疗或死亡，而非身体部位

items.def: painful and giving a feeling of being very hot:
items.zh: 指火辣辣地痛的

examples.en: She felt a burning sensation in her throat.
examples.zh: 她感到咽喉火辣辣的疼。

items.def: giving an uncomfortable feeling on your skin that makes you want to scratch; having this feeling:
items.zh: 指发痒的

examples.en: an itchy rash
examples.zh: 发痒的皮疹

senses.def: a pain in the throat, usually caused by a cold or another virus

examples.en: I took the day off work, as I had a bad cold and a sore throat.
examples.zh: 我请了一天假，因为我得了重感冒并且喉咙痛。

senses.def: seriously; very much

examples.en: I was sorely tempted to complain, but I didn't.
examples.zh: 我极想发牢骚，但还是没开口。

examples.en: If you don't come to the reunion you'll be sorely missed.
examples.zh: 你要是不来参加团聚，大家会非常想念你的。

examples.en: Their patience was sorely tested as yet another delay to the scheduled service was announced.
examples.zh: 由于宣布航班再次延迟，他们的耐心受到了严峻的考验。

senses.def: pain and redness

examples.en: an ointment to reduce soreness and swelling
examples.zh: 止痛消肿软膏

senses.def: the feeling of being upset and angry, especially because you have been treated unfairly

examples.en: Their soreness at not being included was apparent.
examples.zh: 他们因不被包括在内而感到的痛苦是显而易见的。

senses.def: very small grain grown as food in tropical countries; the plant that produces this grain
a member of an international organization of clubs for business and professional women
senses.zh: 国际商业和职业女性俱乐部组织的成员

senses.def: a club for a group of women students at an American college or university
a plant with leaves that taste bitter and are used in salads or in making soup or sauces
senses.zh: 酸模，酸叶草（叶子味苦，可用于做色拉、汤或酱汁）

senses.def: a feeling of being very sad because something very bad has happened

examples.en: He expressed his sorrow at the news of her death.
examples.zh: 听到她的死讯，他表示哀伤。

examples.en: They said that the decision was made more in sorrow than in anger.
examples.zh: 他们说作出这个决定，与其说是出于气愤，不如说是出于悲伤。

senses.def: a very sad event or situation

examples.en: the joys and sorrows of childhood
examples.zh: 童年的欢乐和悲伤

examples.en: His death was a great sorrow to everyone who knew him.
examples.zh: 他的死对每一个认识他的人来说都是很悲痛的事。

senses.def: to have or express very sad feelings

examples.en: the sorrowing relatives
examples.zh: 悲伤的亲属

examples.en: They had sorrowed over his death.
examples.zh: 他们对他的去世感到悲痛。

senses.def: very sad

examples.en: her sorrowful eyes
examples.zh: 她悲伤的双眼

senses.def: in a very sad way
feeling sad and ashamed about something that has been done

examples.en: We're very sorry about the damage to your car.
examples.zh: 损坏了你的车，我们真是过意不去。

examples.en: I'm sorry about the mess—I haven't had a chance to tidy up yet.
examples.zh: 对于这里的混乱，我感到很抱歉——我还没来得及收拾。

examples.en: She is obviously deeply sorry for what she has done.
examples.zh: 很明显，她对自己的所作所为深感愧疚。

examples.en: We are sorry for the delay and hope the train will be moving again shortly.
examples.zh: 对于延误我们深表歉意，希望火车很快就能再次运行。

examples.en: He says he's really sorry for taking the car without asking.
examples.zh: 他没打招呼就用了车，他说他为此感到非常抱歉。

examples.en: She was sorry that she'd lost her temper.
examples.zh: 她为自己发了脾气而感到愧疚。

examples.en: I am so sorry that this happened.
examples.zh: 我对发生这样的事感到非常抱歉。

examples.en: If you say you're sorry we'll forgive you.
examples.zh: 你要是道歉，我们就原谅你。

senses.def: feeling sad and showing sympathy

examples.en: I'm sorry that your husband lost his job.
examples.zh: 你丈夫把工作丢了，我很惋惜。

examples.en: We're sorry to hear that your father's in hospital again.
examples.zh: 听说你父亲又住院了，我们心里都不好受。

examples.en: I was sorry to see him go.
examples.zh: 看到他走我很遗憾。

examples.en: No one is sorrier than I am about what happened.
examples.zh: 发生了这样的事，我比谁都难过。

examples.en: I am sorry about the way Dad treated you.
examples.zh: 我对爸爸对待你的方式感到抱歉。

examples.en: I'm sorry about your mother. I do hope she'll soon be feeling better.
examples.zh: 你母亲的事我感到很遗憾，真希望她能快点儿好。

examples.en: I'm very sorry for your loss (= expressing sympathy when somebody has died).
examples.zh: 我对你的损失感到非常抱歉（=对某人去世表示同情）。

senses.def: feeling disappointed about something and wishing you had done something different or had not done something

examples.en: She was sorry that she'd lost contact with Mary.
examples.zh: 她懊悔跟玛丽失去了联系。

examples.en: I'll make you sorry you were ever born!
examples.zh: 我会让你后悔来到了这个世上！

examples.en: You'll be sorry if I catch you!
examples.zh: 要是让我抓着，你会后悔的！

examples.en: I was genuinely sorry to be leaving college.
examples.zh: 大学毕业时，我打心底里舍不得离去。

examples.en: She was almost sorry to stop work.
examples.zh: 她对不再工作有点儿后悔了。

senses.def: very sad or bad, especially making you feel pity

examples.en: The business is in a sorry state.
examples.zh: 公司境况真是糟糕。

examples.en: They were a sorry sight when they eventually got off the boat.
examples.zh: 他们最终从船上下来，一副惨兮兮的样子。

senses.def: to be sad or feel sympathy for somebody

examples.en: He decided to help Jan as he felt sorry for her.
examples.zh: 他同情简的遭遇，决定帮助她。

senses.def: used to say that it is wiser to be too careful than to act too quickly and do something you may later wish you had not
senses.zh: 宁可事先谨慎有余，不要事后追悔莫及

examples.en: She decided to avoid travelling at night. Better safe than sorry.
examples.zh: 她决定避免夜间出行。安全总比后悔好。

senses.def: to feel unhappy; to be sad about yourself because you are suffering

examples.en: Stop feeling sorry for yourself and think about other people for a change.
examples.zh: 别老觉得自己委屈了，也替别人想一想吧。

examples.en: Mitch felt slightly sorry for himself.
examples.zh: 米奇有些为自己感到遗憾。

senses.def: used when you are apologizing for something

examples.en: I'm sorry, I forgot.
examples.zh: 对不起，我忘了。

examples.en: Oh, I'm sorry. Have I taken the one you wanted?
examples.zh: 哟，对不起。我是不是拿了你想要的那个？

examples.en: I'm sorry. I can't make it tomorrow.
examples.zh: 很抱歉。我明天不行。

examples.en: I'm sorry to interrupt but there's an urgent call for you.
examples.zh: 很抱歉打扰您，但有紧急电话要找您。

senses.def: used for disagreeing with somebody or politely saying ‘no’
senses.zh: （表示不同意或委婉地拒绝）对不起

examples.en: I'm sorry, I don't agree.
examples.zh: 对不起，我不同意。

examples.en: I'm sorry, I'd rather you didn't go.
examples.zh: 恕我直言，我看你还是不去为好。

senses.def: used for introducing bad news

examples.en: I'm sorry to have to tell you you've failed.
examples.zh: 我只能遗憾地告诉你，你不及格。

senses.def: used for saying that something is disappointing
senses.zh: （表示某事令人失望）我遗憾地说

examples.en: He didn't accept the job, I'm sorry to say.
examples.zh: 我很遗憾，他不接受那项工作。

senses.def: used when you are apologizing

examples.en: Sorry I'm late!
examples.zh: 对不起，我来晚了！

examples.en: Did I stand on your foot? Sorry!
examples.zh: 我是不是踩你脚了？抱歉！

examples.en: Sorry to bother you, but could I speak to you for a moment?
examples.zh: 不好意思打搅你，我能不能跟你说几句话？

examples.en: Sorry, we don't allow dogs in the house.
examples.zh: 对不起，我们是不让狗进屋的。

examples.en: He didn't even say sorry.
examples.zh: 他连句道歉的话也没有说。

senses.def: used for asking somebody to repeat something that you have not heard clearly
senses.zh: （请某人重复你没听清楚的话）你说什么，请再说一遍

examples.en: Sorry? Could you repeat the question?
examples.zh: 你说什么？能不能把问题再说一遍？

senses.def: used for correcting yourself when you have said something wrong
senses.zh: （纠正自己说错的话）不对，应该是

examples.en: Take the first turning, sorry, the third turning on the right.
examples.zh: 到第一个，不，到第三个路口往右拐。

examples.zh: 他同情简的遭遇，决定帮助她。

examples.zh: 我很遗憾，他不接受那项工作。

senses.def: a group or type of people or things that are similar in a particular way

examples.en: ‘What sort of music do you like?’ ‘Oh, all sorts.’
examples.zh: “你喜欢哪一类音乐？”“噢，哪一类都喜欢。”

examples.en: This sort of problem is quite common./These sorts of problems are quite common.
examples.zh: 这类问题相当普遍。／这几类问题相当普遍。

examples.en: He's the sort of person who only cares about money.
examples.zh: 他这种人一心只想着钱。

examples.en: The sort/sorts of people who are having large families in the US and Ireland are very similar.
examples.zh: 在美国和爱尔兰，多子女的那些人非常类似。

examples.en: For dessert there's a fruit pie of some sort (= you are not sure what kind).
examples.zh: 甜点是一种水果派。

examples.en: Most people went on training courses of one sort or another (= of various types) last year.
examples.zh: 多数人去年都上过这样那样的培训班。

examples.en: There were snacks—peanuts, olives, that sort of thing.
examples.zh: 有各种小吃，花生米、橄榄什么的。

examples.zh: 在营地有为孩子们组织的各种各样的活动。

examples.zh: 像这样的言论并不是你所期望的澳大利亚最有权势的女性之一会说出来的。

examples.en: Tracey has been causing her mother all sorts of problems (= many different ones).
examples.zh: 特蕾西给她母亲带来了各种各样的问题（=许多不同的问题）。

senses.def: a particular type of person

examples.zh: 我哥哥不是那种会在这种事上撒谎的人。

examples.en: ‘They spent their honeymoon mountain climbing.’ ‘Oh well, it takes all sorts!’
examples.zh: “他们度蜜月时都是爬山。”“哦，好吧，这需要各种各样的努力！”

senses.def: used to emphasize that the situation is very different from what has been said
senses.zh: （强调情况与所说的大不相同）绝不是那么回事，一点也不，才不哩；没有的事

examples.zh: “我太糟糕了！”“你根本不是那种人。”

senses.def: used when you are saying that something is not a good example of a particular type of thing
senses.zh: （表示某事物不够好）勉强算的，凑合的

examples.en: He offered us an apology of sorts.
examples.zh: 他给我们勉强道了个歉。

senses.def: ill or upset

examples.en: She was tired and out of sorts by the time she arrived home.
examples.zh: 她回到家里，又累又烦。

examples.en: Are you feeling all right? You look a bit out of sorts.
examples.zh: 请问你还好吗？你看上去有点不太对劲。

senses.def: to some extent but in a way that you cannot easily describe

examples.en: She sort of pretends that she doesn't really care.
examples.zh: 她摆出一副并不真正在乎的样子。

examples.en: ‘Do you understand?’ ‘Sort of.’
examples.zh: “你懂了吗？”“有点懂了。”

senses.def: used for describing something in a not very exact way
senses.zh: （表示不十分准确）近似于某物，有点像是某物

examples.en: I had a sort of feeling that he wouldn't come.
examples.zh: 我隐约觉得他不会来。

examples.en: She was jumping around like some sort of kangaroo.
examples.zh: 她像个袋鼠似的跳来跳去。

examples.en: They're a sort of greenish-blue colour.
examples.zh: 它们的颜色近乎带点绿的蓝色。

examples.en: I was glad about it afterwards, in a funny sort of way.
examples.zh: 后来我对此感到很高兴，以一种有趣的方式。

examples.en: I started at the bottom, answering phones and sorting the mail.
examples.zh: 我从底层做起，接听电话及整理邮件。

examples.zh: 计算机按字母顺序排列这些单词。

examples.zh: 垃圾很容易分开，可归入塑料、玻璃和纸三类。

examples.zh: 妇女和孩子把矿石从岩石中分拣出来。

examples.en: Events are sorted by date and category.
examples.zh: 事件按日期和种类分别整理。

examples.en: I'm really busy—can you sort it?
examples.zh: 我真的很忙，你能处理一下吗？

examples.en: Everything's now been sorted.
examples.zh: 一切都处理妥当了。

examples.en: The problem with my broadband still hasn't been sorted.
examples.zh: 我的宽带问题还没有解决。

examples.zh: 柜橱该整理一下了。

examples.zh: 我把衣服分成两摞。

examples.zh: 你要去汽车站的话，能不能把明天的车票买好？

examples.zh: 要是你能等一会儿，我就可以把什么都给你弄好。

examples.zh: 你装车，我把孩子们安顿好。

examples.zh: 她翻遍行李箱找件衣服穿。

examples.zh: 他们对敌军进行了多次出击。

examples.en: He led his platoon in a sortie against the enemy.
examples.zh: 他率领他的排向敌人出击。

senses.def: a short trip away from your home or the place where you are

examples.zh: 我和妈妈一起去购物。

examples.zh: 他认为他不死的灵魂有堕入地狱的危险。

examples.en: The howling wind sounded like the wailing of lost souls (= the spirits of dead people who are not in heaven).

examples.zh: 眼睛是心灵的窗户。

examples.en: There was a feeling of restlessness deep in her soul.
examples.zh: 她内心深处感到焦躁不安。

senses.def: the country at the southern tip of Africa. Its capital city is Pretoria but Cape Town and Bloemfontein also function as capitals. In the 17th and 18th centuries different areas of the country were settled by the Dutch and the British, who fought each other in the Boer Wars
senses.zh: 南非：位于非洲最南端的国家。它的首都是比勒陀利亚，但开普敦和布隆方丹也起首都的作用。在17和18世纪，荷兰人和英国人在布尔战争中相互交战，在该国的不同地区定居。南非在18世纪后期成为大英帝国的一部分。1909年，它成为英联邦的独立成员，但在建立了种族隔离政策（试图将国家的种族分开，白人控制下）后于1961年离开。大多数其他国家不同意这项政策，许多国家拒绝与南非进行贸易或与南非参加体育赛事。经过多年的国际压力，1994年，南非政府允许所有人享有相同的投票权，纳尔逊·曼德拉（Nelson Mandela）成为该国第一位黑人总统。南非是非洲最富有的国家，并且是世界上最大的钻石，黄金和其他贵重金属生产国之一。由于构成人口的多种不同群体和文化及其11种正式语言，南非被称为彩虹之国。

examples.zh: 如果你把自己的电邮地址贴在网上，那就要给垃圾邮件机器人白捡了。

senses.def: a person who sends advertising material by email to a large number of people who have not asked for it
connected with or full of internet spam

examples.en: spammy websites/blogs/links
examples.zh: 滥发电邮的网站／博客／链接

examples.en: All these links are coming from very spammy sites.
examples.zh: 所有这些链接都来自非常垃圾的网站。

senses.def: to last all through a period of time or to cover the whole of it

examples.en: His acting career spanned 55 years.
examples.zh: 他的演艺生涯长达 55 年。

examples.en: Family photos spanning five generations were stolen.
examples.zh: 一家五代人的照片失窃了。

senses.def: to include a large area or a lot of things
senses.zh: 包括（广大地区）；涵盖（多项内容）

examples.en: The operation, which spanned nine countries, resulted in 200 arrests.
examples.zh: 这次行动涉及九个国家，逮捕了 200 人。

examples.en: His experience spanned not merely politics, but also business and journalism.
examples.zh: 他的经历不仅涉及政治，还涉及商业和新闻业。

senses.def: to stretch right across something, from one side to the other

examples.en: a series of bridges spanning the river
examples.zh: 架在河上的一系列桥梁

examples.en: The roof was spanned by curved ribs of steel.
examples.zh: 屋顶上架着钢制肋拱。

senses.def: the length of time that something lasts or is able to continue

examples.en: I worked with him over a span of six years.
examples.zh: 我和他共事达六年之久。

examples.en: The project must be completed within a specific time span.
examples.zh: 这项工程必须在规定期限内完成。

examples.en: a study of the entire span of Arab history
examples.zh: 对整个阿拉伯历史的研究

senses.def: a range or variety of something

examples.en: Managers have a wide span of control.
examples.zh: 经理的职权范围很大。

examples.en: These forests cover a broad span of latitudes.
examples.zh: 这些森林绵延在多个纬度上。

senses.def: the part of a bridge or an arch

examples.en: The bridge crosses the river in a single span.
examples.zh: 河上的桥为单跨桥。

senses.def: the measurement of something from one side to the other

examples.en: The kite has a span of 1.5 metres.
examples.zh: 风筝宽 1.5 米。

senses.def: neat and clean

examples.en: Their house is always spick and span.
examples.zh: 他们家总是收拾得清清爽爽。

senses.def: neat and clean

examples.en: Their house is always spick and span.
examples.zh: 他们家总是收拾得清清爽爽。

senses.def: an artificial material that stretches, used for making clothes that fit close to the body
senses.zh: 莱卡（有弹性的人造材料，用于制作紧身衣）

senses.def: to cover or to decorate something with small pieces of something shiny
a small piece of shiny metal or plastic used to decorate clothes
senses.zh: （装饰服装的）闪光金属片，闪光塑料片

examples.en: a dress covered with red spangles
examples.zh: 一件布满红色亮片的连衣裙

senses.def: language which is a mixture of Spanish and English, especially a type of Spanish that includes many English words
senses.zh: 西英混合语（尤指包含很多英语词的西班牙语）

senses.def: a person from Spain
a dog with large soft ears that hang down. There are several types of spaniel
senses.zh: 西班牙猎犬（大耳下垂，品种甚多）

examples.en: a cocker spaniel
examples.zh: 西班牙猎鸡狗。

examples.en: a springer spaniel
examples.zh: 惊飞獚

senses.def: from or connected with Spain
the language of Spain, Mexico and most countries in Central and South America
a large tree with spreading branches that produces smooth brown nuts that you can eat, inside cases with sharp points on them
a name for a type of flu that caused a global pandemic
senses.zh: 西班牙流感（1918年流感大流行）

examples.en: Spanish flu is estimated to have infected a third of the world's population.
examples.zh: 据估计，西班牙流感已感染了世界三分之一的人口。

senses.def: a bright green insect that has a strong smell and produces a harmful substance
a poisonous mixture made from the dried bodies of these insects, that is said to give people a strong desire to have sex
senses.zh: 西班牙绿芫菁混合剂（有毒性，据信可催情）

senses.def: a tropical American plant that has long, thin grey leaves and that grows over trees
a large onion with a mild taste
senses.zh: 西班牙洋葱：口味适中的大洋葱

senses.def: a hit given several times on the bottom as a punishment, especially to a child
to hit somebody, especially a child, several times on their bottom as a punishment

examples.en: I used to get beaten and spanked a lot when I was a kid.
examples.zh: 我小时候经常挨打、打屁股。

examples.en: She says she’s never spanked her children.
examples.zh: 她说她从没打过孩子。

senses.def: a metal tool with an end with a special shape for holding and turning nuts

examples.en: I’ll need a spanner to change the back wheel.
examples.zh: 我需要一把扳手来换后轮。

senses.def: (to cause) a delay or problem with something that somebody is planning or doing
(to cause) a delay or problem with something that somebody is planning or doing
to make the movements used in boxing
to argue with somebody, usually in a friendly way
senses.zh: （多指在友好气氛中）辩论，争论

examples.en: political sparring
examples.zh: 政治斗争

examples.en: verbal sparring
examples.zh: 言语争吵

examples.en: He liked to spar with colleagues during weekly meetings.
examples.zh: 他喜欢在每周的会议上与同事争论。

senses.def: a strong pole
a structure that supports the wing of an aircraft
available to do what you want with rather than work

examples.en: He's studying music in his spare time.
examples.zh: 他在空闲时间学音乐。

examples.en: I haven't had a spare moment this morning.
examples.zh: 我一上午一会儿也没闲着。

senses.def: that is not being used or is not needed at the present time

examples.en: We've got a spare bedroom, if you'd like to stay.
examples.zh: 要是愿意你就住下，我们空着一间卧室。

examples.en: I'm afraid I haven't got any spare cash.
examples.zh: 恐怕我手头没有多余的现金。

examples.en: Are there any tickets going spare (= are there any available, not being used by somebody else)?
examples.zh: 有多余的票吗？

senses.def: kept in case you need to replace the one you usually use; extra

examples.en: a spare key/tyre
examples.zh: 备用钥匙／轮胎

examples.en: Take some spare clothes in case you get wet.
examples.zh: 多带几件衣服，以备身上弄湿了好穿。

senses.def: thin, and usually quite tall
to become very angry or upset

examples.en: Your mum would go spare if she knew!
examples.zh: 如果你妈妈知道了，她一定会饶命的！

examples.en: I’ll go spare if I don’t get out of the house soon!
examples.zh: 如果我不尽快走出家门，我就去闲逛了！

senses.def: to make something such as time or money available to somebody or for something, especially when it requires an effort for you to do this

examples.en: I'd love to have a break, but I can't spare the time just now.
examples.zh: 我是想休息一下，可眼下找不出时间。

examples.en: Could you spare one of your staff to help us out?
examples.zh: 你能不能从你手下抽一个人过来帮帮我们？

examples.en: We can only spare one room for you.
examples.zh: 我们只能给你腾出一个房间。

examples.en: You should spare a thought for (= think about) the person who cleans up after you.
examples.zh: 你应该为随后打扫的人着想啊。

examples.en: He was late, but he spared a glance for the pretty girl at the desk.
examples.zh: 他迟到了，但他还是瞥了一眼办公桌上那个漂亮的女孩。

examples.en: Surely you can spare me a few minutes?
examples.zh: 你应该能为我空出几分钟时间吧？

senses.group: time/money/room/thought, etc. 时间、钱、房间、心思等

senses.def: to save somebody/yourself from having to go through an unpleasant experience

examples.en: He wanted to spare his mother any anxiety.
examples.zh: 他不想让母亲有丝毫的担忧。

examples.en: Please spare me (= do not tell me) the gruesome details.
examples.zh: 那些让人毛骨悚然的细节就请你不要讲了。

examples.en: You could have spared yourself an unnecessary trip by phoning in advance.
examples.zh: 你要是先打个电话就用不着跑这一趟了。

examples.en: She was spared from the ordeal of appearing in court.
examples.zh: 她无须出庭受折磨了。

senses.group: save somebody pain/trouble 免得痛苦／麻烦

senses.def: to allow somebody/something to escape harm, damage or death, especially when others do not escape it

examples.en: They killed the men but spared the children.
examples.zh: 他们杀死了大人，但放过了孩子。

examples.en: She begged them to spare her life.
examples.zh: 她恳求他们饶命。

examples.en: During the bombing only one house was spared (= was not hit by a bomb).
examples.zh: 在轰炸中，只有一座房子幸免。

examples.en: The storm largely spared Houston and surrounding districts.
examples.zh: 暴风雨基本未危害到休斯敦及其周边地区。

examples.en: The children were spared from the virus.
examples.zh: 孩子们没被病毒感染。

examples.en: Hong Kong was spared a direct hit, but the storm still brought heavy rains and powerful winds.
examples.zh: 香港虽然未遭正面吹袭，但风暴还是带来了大雨和强风。

senses.group: not harm/damage 不伤害；不损坏

senses.def: to do everything possible to achieve something or to do something well without trying to limit the time or money involved

examples.en: He spared no effort to make her happy again.
examples.zh: 为使她重新快乐起来，他想尽了办法。

examples.en: No expense was spared in furnishing the new office.
examples.zh: 装潢新办公室不惜工本。

senses.group: no effort/expense, etc. 尽力、破费等

senses.def: to work as hard as possible
to save somebody from an embarrassing situation
senses.zh: 不让某人难堪；免得某人丢面子

examples.en: A last minute goal spared their blushes.
examples.zh: 最后一刻的进球让他们没有脸红。

senses.def: to be careful not to do or say anything that might upset somebody
senses.zh: 不惹某人难受；避免触及某人的痛处

examples.en: I kept off the subject of divorce so as to spare her feelings.
examples.zh: 我避开离婚这个话题，以免触及她的感情。

senses.def: if you have time, money, etc. to spare

examples.en: I've got absolutely no money to spare this month.
examples.zh: 我这个月一点儿富余钱都没有。

examples.en: We arrived at the airport with five minutes to spare.
examples.zh: 我们赶到机场时还剩五分钟。

senses.def: an extra thing that you keep in case you need to replace the one you usually use (used especially about a tyre of a car)

examples.en: to get the spare out of the boot/trunk
examples.zh: 从汽车行李箱中取出备用轮胎

examples.en: I've lost my key and I haven't got a spare.
examples.zh: 我把钥匙丢了，还没有备用的。

senses.def: spare parts

examples.en: It can be difficult to get spares for some older makes of car.
examples.zh: 有些旧型号汽车可能不好买配件。

examples.zh: 如果你妈妈知道了，她一定会饶命的！

examples.en: I’ll go spare if I don’t get out of the house soon!
examples.zh: 如果我不尽快走出家门，我就去闲逛了！

senses.def: to save somebody from an embarrassing situation
senses.zh: 不让某人难堪；免得某人丢面子

senses.zh: 不惹某人难受；避免触及某人的痛处

examples.en: I kept off the subject of divorce so as to spare her feelings.
examples.zh: 我避开离婚这个话题，以免触及她的感情。

senses.def: a new part that you buy to replace an old or broken part of a car, machine, etc.

examples.en: We have to get our spare parts from abroad.
examples.zh: 我们必须从国外获得备件。

senses.def: a rib

examples.en: barbecued spare ribs
examples.zh: 烤排骨

senses.def: an extra wheel for a car
an area of loose fat around the middle part of somebody’s body

examples.en: Vigorous exercise will help to get rid of your spare tyre.
examples.zh: 剧烈运动有助于消除你的腹部赘肉。

senses.def: in a way that is careful to use or give only a little of something

examples.en: Use the cream very sparingly.
examples.zh: 这种乳霜要尽可能少用。

senses.def: to cause something to start or develop, especially suddenly

examples.en: The proposal would spark a storm of protest around the country.
examples.zh: 这一提案将引发全国性的抗议浪潮。

examples.en: Winds brought down power lines, sparking a fire.
examples.zh: 大风刮断电线，引起了火灾。

examples.en: The organizers are hoping to spark some interest in young people.
examples.zh: 组织者希望激发年轻人的兴趣。

examples.en: The riots were sparked off by the arrest of a local leader.
examples.zh: 骚乱是因逮捕一名当地领导人而触发的。

senses.def: to produce small flashes of fire or electricity
senses.zh: 冒火花；飞火星；产生电火花

examples.en: a sparking, crackling fire
examples.zh: 噼啪直响、火星飞迸的火

examples.en: The game suddenly sparked to life.
examples.zh: 比赛突然变得激烈起来。

senses.def: a very small burning piece of material that is produced by something that is burning or by hitting two hard substances together

examples.en: A shower of sparks flew up the chimney.
examples.zh: 烟囱里飞出无数火星。

examples.en: A spark from the machinery had set fire to some material.
examples.zh: 机器发出的火花点燃了一些材料。

senses.def: a small flash of light produced by an electric current

examples.en: sparks from a faulty light switch
examples.zh: 漏电的电灯开关发出的火花

examples.en: A spark ignites the fuel in a car engine.
examples.zh: 汽车发动机中的燃料由火花点燃。

senses.def: a small amount of a particular quality or feeling
senses.zh: （指品质或感情）一星，丝毫，一丁点

examples.en: a spark of hope
examples.zh: 一线希望

examples.en: The woman’s eyes still had a spark of life in them.
examples.zh: 女子的眼眸中，依然闪烁着生命的光芒。

senses.def: a special quality of energy, intelligence or enthusiasm that makes somebody very clever, funny, etc.

examples.en: As a writer he seemed to lack creative spark.
examples.zh: 作为作家，他似乎缺少创作激情。

examples.en: She was a real star. She had a certain spark—that something extra.
examples.zh: 她是一位真正的明星。她有一种独特的火花——一种额外的东西。

senses.def: an action or event that causes something important to develop, especially trouble or violence

examples.en: These were the sparks of revolution.
examples.zh: 这些都是革命的火花。

senses.def: feelings of anger or excitement between people
senses.zh: 愤怒的情感；激烈的情绪

examples.en: Sparks flew at the meeting (= there was a lot of argument).
examples.zh: 会上争论激烈，火星四溅。

examples.en: She was suddenly aware of the romantic spark between them.
examples.zh: 她突然意识到他们之间擦出了浪漫的火花。

senses.def: a lively and intelligent person, especially somebody young
senses.zh: 活泼机灵的人（尤指年轻人）

examples.en: Some bright spark (= stupid person) left the tap running all night.
examples.zh: 不知是哪个聪明人让自来水流了一夜。

senses.def: a lively and intelligent person, especially somebody young
senses.zh: 活泼机灵的人（尤指年轻人）

examples.en: Some bright spark (= stupid person) left the tap running all night.
examples.zh: 不知是哪个聪明人让自来水流了一夜。

senses.def: a part in a car engine that produces a spark
to begin a conversation, an argument, a friendship, etc., often suddenly
senses.zh: 激起，突然引发（交谈、争论、友谊等）

examples.en: I tried to spark up a conversation with her.
examples.zh: 我设法跟她攀谈起来。

senses.def: to shine brightly with small flashes of light

examples.en: sparkling eyes
examples.zh: 炯炯有神的眼睛

examples.en: Her jewellery sparkled in the candlelight.
examples.zh: 烛光下，她的首饰光彩熠熠。

examples.en: The sky sparkled with brilliant stars.
examples.zh: 天空闪烁着灿烂的星星。

senses.def: to be full of life, enthusiasm or humour
senses.zh: 生气勃勃；热情奔放；神采飞扬

examples.en: He always sparkles at parties.
examples.zh: 在各种聚会上，他总是光芒四射。

examples.en: She sparkled with cheerfulness and good humour.
examples.zh: 她充满了快乐和幽默。

senses.def: a series of flashes of light produced by light hitting a shiny surface

examples.en: the sparkle of glass
examples.zh: 玻璃闪耀的亮光

examples.en: the sparkles of light on water
examples.zh: 水面上的闪光

examples.en: The sky went dark and the sea lost its sparkle.
examples.zh: 天色暗了下来，大海也失去了光芒。

examples.en: There was a sparkle of excitement in her eyes.
examples.zh: 她眼里闪耀着激动的光芒。

senses.def: the quality of being lively and original

examples.en: The performance lacked sparkle.
examples.zh: 这场演出缺少亮点。

examples.en: Do something to add a sparkle to your life!
examples.zh: 做一些事情，为你的生活增添光彩！

synonyms.words: gleam ▪ glow ▪ sparkle ▪ glisten ▪ shimmer ▪ glitter ▪ twinkle ▪ glint

intro.en: These words all mean to produce or reflect light.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含发光、反光之义。

items.def: to produce or reflect light, especially brightly:
items.zh: 指发光、反光、照耀

examples.en: The sun was shining and the sky was blue.
examples.zh: 阳光灿烂，天空一片蓝。

items.def: to shine with a clear bright or pale light, especially a reflected light:
items.zh: 指闪烁、隐约闪光、微光反射

examples.en: Moonlight gleamed on the water.
examples.zh: 月光照在水面上泛起粼粼波光。

items.def: (often of something hot or warm) to produce a steady light that is not very bright:
items.zh: 常指热的物体发出稳定而微弱的光

examples.en: The end of his cigarette glowed red.
examples.zh: 他的烟头发着微弱的红光。

items.def: to shine brightly with small flashes of light:
items.zh: 指闪烁、闪耀

examples.en: The diamonds sparkled in the light.
examples.zh: 钻石在灯光下闪闪发亮。

items.def: (of something wet) to shine:
items.zh: 指湿物闪光、闪亮

examples.en: The road glistened wet after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨后的道路润泽闪亮。

items.def: to shine with a soft light that seems to shake slightly:
items.zh: 指发出微弱的闪光、闪烁

examples.en: Everything seemed to shimmer in the heat.
examples.zh: 在高温下所有的东西都好像在闪光。

items.def: to shine brightly with small flashes of reflected light:
items.zh: 指闪亮、闪耀

examples.en: The ceiling of the cathedral glittered with gold.
examples.zh: 大教堂的天花板金光闪闪。

items.def: to shine with a light that changes rapidly from bright to faint to bright again:
items.zh: 指一明一暗地闪耀、闪烁

examples.en: Stars twinkled in the sky.
examples.zh: 星星在天空中闪烁。

items.def: to give small bright flashes of reflected light:
items.zh: 指微微闪光、闪亮、反光

examples.en: The blade of the knife glinted in the darkness.
examples.zh: 刀刃在黑暗中亮了亮。

senses.def: a type of small firework
full of life; interesting and funny
senses.zh: 生气勃勃的；充满活力的；有意思的

examples.en: a sparky personality
examples.zh: 活泼的性格

senses.def: a person that you regularly have friendly arguments or discussions with

examples.en: He was an old political sparring partner of mine.
examples.zh: 他是我的一位政治老搭档。

senses.def: a person that a boxer
a small brown and grey bird, common in many parts of the world
a small bird of prey
only present in small amounts or numbers and often spread over a large area

examples.en: the sparse population of the islands
examples.zh: 那些岛上零星的人口

examples.en: Vegetation becomes sparse higher up the mountains.
examples.zh: 山上越高的地方植物越稀少。

examples.en: The information available on the subject is sparse.
examples.zh: 这个题目资料匮乏。

senses.def: with only small amounts or numbers of something, often spread over a large area

examples.en: a sparsely populated area
examples.zh: 人口稀少的地区

examples.en: a sparsely furnished room
examples.zh: 陈设寥寥的房间

senses.def: the fact of only being present in small amounts or numbers and often spread over a large area
simple or severe; without anything that makes life easier or more pleasant
senses.zh: 斯巴达式的；简朴的；清苦的

examples.en: the spartan life of the training camp
examples.zh: 训练营的斯巴达生活

examples.en: The hotel room was somewhat spartan.
examples.zh: 酒店房间有点简朴。

senses.def: a sudden and often painful contracting of a muscle, which you cannot control

examples.en: Cholera reduces heartbeat and causes muscle spasms.
examples.zh: 霍乱会使心跳变慢并引起肌肉痉挛。

examples.en: The injection sent his leg into spasm.
examples.zh: 一针打下去，他的腿就痉挛了。

senses.def: a sudden strong feeling or reaction that lasts for a short time
senses.zh: （感情或反应）一阵阵发作，阵发

examples.en: a spasm of anxiety/anger/coughing/pain, etc.
examples.zh: 突然一阵焦虑、愤怒、咳嗽、疼痛等

senses.def: happening suddenly for short periods of time; not regular or continuous
senses.zh: 一阵阵的；阵发性的；断断续续的

examples.en: a spasmodic interest in politics
examples.zh: 对政治的间歇性兴趣

examples.en: There was spasmodic fighting in the area yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天，那一地区发生过零星的战斗。

examples.en: The training given was spasmodic and followed no organized pattern.
examples.zh: 所进行的训练是间歇性的，没有遵循有组织的模式。

senses.def: caused by your muscles becoming tight in a way that you cannot control

examples.en: spasmodic movements
examples.zh: 痉挛性动作

senses.def: suddenly for short periods of time; not regularly or continuously
senses.zh: 一阵阵的；阵发性的；断断续续的

examples.en: Her involvement with the organization continued spasmodically for fifteen years.
examples.zh: 她对该组织的参与持续了十五年。

senses.def: in a way that is caused by your muscles becoming tight in a way that you cannot control

examples.en: His hand jerked spasmodically.
examples.zh: 他的手痉挛地抽搐着。

senses.def: a word for a person who is affected by cerebral palsy
an offensive word used by children to mean ‘a stupid person’
relating to or caused by a muscle spasm
senses.zh: 患痉挛性瘫痪的;痉挛性的

examples.en: spastic movements
examples.zh: 痉挛运动

senses.def: a word to describe somebody who is affected by cerebral palsy
an offensive word used by children to mean ‘stupid’
senses.zh: （有时儿童用以骂人愚蠢）笨拙的，无能的

senses.def: a chicken or other bird that is cut open and cooked under a strong heat
senses.zh: 扒手：在强热下切开并煮熟的鸡或其他鸟

senses.def: a large number of things, which are usually unpleasant, that happen suddenly within a short period of time
senses.zh: 一连串，接二连三（通常指不愉快的事物）

examples.en: The bombing was the latest in a spate of terrorist attacks.
examples.zh: 这次炸弹爆炸事件是一连串恐怖主义袭击中最近的一起。

examples.en: a recent spate of killings/thefts
examples.zh: 最近发生的一系列杀人/盗窃事件

senses.def: containing more water and flowing more strongly than usual

examples.en: After heavy rain, the river was in spate.
examples.zh: 大雨过后，河水暴涨。

examples.en: Celia was in full spate (= completely involved in talking and not likely to stop or able to be interrupted).
examples.zh: 西莉亚口若悬河，滔滔不绝。

senses.def: containing more water and flowing more strongly than usual

examples.en: After heavy rain, the river was in spate.
examples.zh: 大雨过后，河水暴涨。

examples.en: Celia was in full spate (= completely involved in talking and not likely to stop or able to be interrupted).
examples.zh: 西莉亚口若悬河，滔滔不绝。

senses.def: relating to space and the position, size, shape, etc. of things in it

examples.en: changes taking place in the spatial distribution of the population
examples.zh: 人口的地域分布所发生的变化

examples.en: the development of a child’s spatial awareness (= the ability to judge the positions and sizes of objects)
examples.zh: 孩子空间意识的形成

senses.def: in a way that relates to space and the position, size, shape, etc. of things in it

examples.en: Pictures are spatially separated from the written text.
examples.zh: 图片与文字在空间上是分离的。

senses.def: to cover somebody/something with drops of liquid, dirt, etc., especially by accident

examples.en: blood-spattered walls
examples.zh: 血染的墙壁

examples.en: As the bus passed, it spattered us with mud.
examples.zh: 公共汽车开过时溅了我们一身泥。

examples.en: Oil was spattered on the floor.
examples.zh: 地板上落满了油点。

senses.def: to fall on a surface in drops, often noisily

examples.en: We heard the rain spattering on the roof.
examples.zh: 我们听见雨点噼里啪啦地打在房顶上。

senses.def: a number of drops of a liquid or small amounts of something that hit a surface; the noise this makes

examples.en: a spatter of rain against the window
examples.zh: 雨点打在窗户上的噼啪声

examples.en: a spattering of blood
examples.zh: 点点血迹

examples.en: a spatter of applause
examples.zh: 稀稀落落的掌声

senses.def: a tool with a broad flat part that is not sharp, used for mixing and spreading things, especially in cooking and painting
senses.zh: （烹饪、油漆等活动中用以调拌或涂敷的）铲，刮勺，抹刀，刮刀

senses.def: a kitchen utensil
senses.zh: 锅铲，煎鱼铲（铲面有细长孔）

senses.def: a thin flat instrument that doctors use for pressing the tongue down when they are examining somebody’s throat
senses.zh: 压舌板，压舌器（医生诊症用）

senses.def: to lay eggs
to cause something to develop or be produced

examples.en: The band's album spawned a string of hit singles.
examples.zh: 这支乐队的专辑带出一连串走红的单曲。

senses.def: to appear or be created

examples.en: Attackers were spawning from all kinds of unexpected places.
examples.zh: 攻击者从各种意想不到的地方涌现。

examples.en: I upgraded the city to spawn a giant.
examples.zh: 我升级了城市以产生一个巨人。

senses.def: a soft substance containing the eggs of fish, frogs etc.
to remove the ovaries
senses.zh: 切除雌兽的卵巢；劁（雌兽）

examples.en: Have you had your cat spayed?
examples.zh: 你的母猫劁了没有？

senses.def: a small shop that somebody operates from their home, selling food, drinks, cigarettes, etc. to local people, especially in a township
senses.zh: （尤指黑人城镇的）家庭杂货店，街头小店

senses.def: Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals
senses.zh: 防止虐待动物协会（全写为 Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals）

examples.en: If a dog gets lost and has a chip, the SPCA can determine who the owner is.
examples.zh: 如果狗迷路了并且有芯片，SPCA 可以确定主人是谁。

senses.def: to talk to somebody about something; to have a conversation with somebody

examples.en: The President refused to speak to reporters.
examples.zh: 总统拒绝同记者讲话。

examples.en: We never spoke about her illness.
examples.zh: 我们从未谈论过她的病。

examples.en: The confidential setting allowed us to speak freely about our concerns.
examples.zh: 保密的环境使我们能够自由地谈论我们的担忧。

examples.en: I've spoken to the manager about it.
examples.zh: 那件事我已经和经理谈过了。

examples.en: Can I speak with you for a minute?
examples.zh: 我能跟你谈一会儿吗？

examples.en: ‘Do you know him?’ ‘Not to speak to.’ (= I recognize him but do not really know him)
examples.zh: “你认识他吗？”“见过但没说过话。”

examples.en: ‘Can I speak to Susan?’ ‘Speaking.’ (= at the beginning of a phone conversation)
examples.zh: “请让苏珊接电话好吗？”“我就是。”

examples.en: I saw her in the street but we didn't speak.
examples.zh: 我在街上看见她了，但我们没有谈话。

senses.def: to use your voice to say something

examples.en: The illness left him unable to speak.
examples.zh: 生病后他不能说话了。

examples.en: Please speak more slowly.
examples.zh: 请讲慢点。

examples.en: Without speaking, she stood up and went out.
examples.zh: 她没有说话，站起身来走了出去。

examples.en: He speaks with a Scottish accent.
examples.zh: 他说话带苏格兰口音。

examples.en: She speaks in a husky voice.
examples.zh: 她用沙哑的声音说话。

examples.en: She has a beautiful speaking voice.
examples.zh: 她说话的音色很美。

senses.def: to be able to use a particular language

examples.en: to speak several languages
examples.zh: 会讲几种语言

examples.en: to speak a little Urdu
examples.zh: 会说一点乌尔都语

examples.en: Do you speak English?
examples.zh: 你会说英语吗？

senses.def: to use a particular language to express yourself

examples.en: What language is it they're speaking?
examples.zh: 他们讲的是什么语？

examples.en: Would you prefer it if we spoke in German?
examples.zh: 我们用德语讲好吗？

examples.en: What language are they speaking in?
examples.zh: 他们说的是哪种语言？

senses.def: speaking the language mentioned

examples.en: French-speaking Canada
examples.zh: 加拿大法语区

examples.en: non-English-speaking students
examples.zh: 不会讲英语的学生

senses.def: to mention or describe something/somebody

examples.en: She still speaks about him with great affection.
examples.zh: 说起他来她依旧一往情深。

examples.en: He was speaking publicly for the first time about the incident.
examples.zh: 他首次公开谈论这一事件。

examples.en: Witnesses spoke of a great ball of flame.
examples.zh: 目击者都谈到有个大火球。

examples.en: Her students speak very highly of her (= they say very good things about her).
examples.zh: 她的学生对她评价很高（=他们说她很好）。

examples.en: Speaking of travelling, (= referring back to a subject just mentioned) are you going anywhere exciting this year?
examples.zh: 说到旅游，你今年要去什么好玩的地方吗？

examples.en: The brochure speaks of beautiful secluded grounds.
examples.zh: 这本小册子谈到了美丽而僻静的地方。

senses.def: to make a speech to an audience

examples.en: Hundreds of people came to hear her speak.
examples.zh: 数百人前来听她演讲。

examples.en: I hate speaking in public.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢当众讲话。

examples.en: He was invited to speak at a conference.
examples.zh: 他被邀请在大会发言。

examples.en: to speak on the radio
examples.zh: 在电台上讲话

examples.en: Professor Todd spoke to the group about her research.
examples.zh: 托德教授对这群人宣讲她的研究。

examples.en: She spoke in favour of the new tax.
examples.zh: 她发表演说，支持新税。

examples.en: He has a number of speaking engagements this week.
examples.zh: 他这个星期安排了几次演讲。

senses.def: to say or state something

examples.en: She was clearly speaking the truth.
examples.zh: 她讲的显然是实情。

examples.en: He spoke the final words of the play.
examples.zh: 剧中最后的台词是他说的。

examples.en: They had the courage to speak the truth.
examples.zh: 他们勇敢地说出了事实真相。

senses.def: what a person actually does means more than what they say they will do
to be willing to be polite or friendly towards somebody, especially after an argument

examples.en: She's not been on speaking terms with her uncle for years.
examples.zh: 多年来她跟她叔叔一直不说话。

examples.en: Are they speaking to each other again yet?
examples.zh: 他们俩和好了没有？

senses.def: it is not necessary to give any further explanation about something because the information that is available already proves that it is true
used to show that what you are saying is true in a general, etc. way
senses.zh: 总的、一般、粗略、相对等说来

examples.en: Generally speaking, the more you pay, the more you get.
examples.zh: 一般来说，花钱多，买的东西就多。

examples.en: There are, broadly speaking, two ways of doing this.
examples.zh: 大致说来，做这件事有两种方法。

examples.en: Personally speaking, I've always preferred Italian food.
examples.zh: 就我个人来讲，我总是偏爱意大利菜。

senses.def: if you think about it in a particular way; true in some but not all ways
senses.zh: 可以说；不妨说；从某种意义上说

examples.en: All these points of view are related, in a manner of speaking.
examples.zh: 所有这些观点都在某方面相互关联。

senses.def: such a small amount that it is not worth mentioning

examples.en: They've got no friends to speak of.
examples.zh: 他们没一个像样的朋友。

examples.en: She's saved a little money but nothing to speak of.
examples.zh: 她攒了一点钱，不过数目不值一提。

senses.def: used to emphasize that you are expressing something in an unusual or humorous way

examples.en: They were all very similar. All cut from the same cloth, so to speak.
examples.zh: 他们都十分相像。可以说就跟一块布上剪下来似的。

senses.def: to be so easy to see and understand that you do not need to say anything else about it/them

examples.en: Her success speaks for itself.
examples.zh: 她的成功有目共睹。

examples.en: Recent events speak for themselves.
examples.zh: 最近发生的事件不言而喻。

senses.def: to express what you think or want yourself, rather than somebody else doing it for you
senses.zh: 自己说（而非让别人替自己说）

examples.en: I'm quite capable of speaking for myself, thank you!
examples.zh: 我自己会说，谢谢了！

senses.def: used to tell somebody that a general statement they have just made is not true of you
senses.zh: （告诉某人不要以为自己的概括性意见适用于大家）只说你自己，那是你

examples.en: ‘We didn't play very well.’ ‘Speak for yourself!’ (= I think that I played well.)
examples.zh: “我们打得不太好。”“是说你自己吧！”

senses.def: to say or think bad things about somebody

examples.en: Don't speak ill of the dead.
examples.zh: 勿议已故者之短。

senses.def: used to say that you are the type of person mentioned and are expressing your opinion from that point of view
senses.zh: （表示从某种角度看问题）作为…来说

examples.en: Speaking as a parent, I'm very concerned about standards in education.
examples.zh: 作为家长，我十分关注教育的水准。

senses.def: to say exactly what you think, in a very direct way
senses.zh: 说心里话；说实在的；坦率地说

examples.en: She’s never hesitated about speaking her mind.
examples.zh: 她从不犹豫说出自己的想法。

examples.en: Everyone should have the right to speak their mind.
examples.zh: 每个人都有权说出自己的想法。

senses.def: people say speak/talk of the devil

examples.en: Well, speak of the devil—here's Alice now!
examples.zh: 嗬，说谁谁到——瞧，艾丽斯这就来啦！

senses.def: to say something when you should not, for example because it is not the right time or you are not the right person to say it
senses.zh: 说话不合时宜（或不合身份）

senses.def: to say something that you should not because it is the wrong situation or because it offends somebody
senses.zh: 说话出格（或冒失、鲁莽、不合时宜）

senses.def: to be able to communicate easily with another person because you share similar opinions and experience
senses.zh: （因意见和经历相似）能容易地沟通，说得来，有共同语言

senses.def: to tell you a lot about something/somebody, without the need for words

examples.en: His achievement speaks volumes for his determination.
examples.zh: 他的成就充分说明了他的决心。

examples.en: What you wear speaks volumes about you.
examples.zh: 你的衣着会清楚地说明你是一个什么样的人。

senses.def: to say good or bad things about somebody
senses.zh: 称赞（或贬损）某人；说某人的好话（或坏话）

examples.en: She never speaks ill of anyone.
examples.zh: 她从不说任何人的坏话。

senses.def: if you are using words or rules in their exact or correct sense

examples.en: Strictly speaking, the book is not a novel, but a short story.
examples.zh: 严格说来，这部小说不能算长篇，而是短篇。

examples.en: Using the word in that context is not, strictly speaking, correct.
examples.zh: 严格来说，在这种情况下使用这个词是不正确的。

senses.def: the language used by a particular group of people, especially when it is difficult for other people to understand or they find it annoying
senses.zh: （尤指令他人费解或厌烦的）圈中行话，用语

examples.en: Visitors to websites don't want to read marketing-speak.
examples.zh: 网页浏览者不想看推销语言。

examples.en: His email was a nonsensical paragraph of management-speak.
examples.zh: 他的电子邮件是一段无意义的管理言论。

examples.en: Unlike his colleagues, he avoids White House speak.
examples.zh: 与他的同事不同，他避免在白宫发表讲话。

examples.en: The ‘finished goods inventory’—that’s Wall Street speak for unsold goods.
examples.zh: “成品库存”——这是华尔街对未售出商品的说法。

senses.def: what a person actually does means more than what they say they will do

intro.en: These words all mean to share news, information, ideas or feelings with another person or other people, especially by talking with them.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含交流、交谈之义。

items.def: to speak in order to give information, express feelings or share ideas:
items.zh: 指说话、讲话、谈话

examples.en: We talked on the phone for over an hour.
examples.zh: 我们在电话里谈了一个多小时。

items.def: (rather formal) to talk and share ideas on a subject or problem with other people, especially in order to decide something:
items.zh: 指谈论、讨论、商量

examples.en: Have you discussed the problem with anyone?
examples.zh: 你与谁商量过这个问题吗？

items.def: to talk to somebody about something; to have a conversation with somebody:
items.zh: 指谈话、交谈

examples.en: I’ve spoken to the manager about it.
examples.zh: 那件事我已经和经理谈过了。

items.def: (rather formal) to exchange information or ideas with somebody:
items.zh: 指与某人交流信息或意见

examples.en: We only communicate by email.
examples.zh: 我们只通过电子邮件进行交流。

items.def: to discuss something, especially formally, before making a decision or finding a solution:
items.zh: （尤指正式）讨论、辩论

examples.en: Politicians will be debating the bill later this week.
examples.zh: 政界将在本周晚些时候讨论这项议案。

items.def: (rather formal) to discuss something with somebody in order to get their permission for something, or to help you make a decision:
items.zh: 指（与某人）商议、商量（以得到许可或帮助决策）

examples.en: You shouldn’t have done it without consulting me.
examples.zh: 你不该不和我商量就做。

synonyms.words: refer to somebody/​something ▪ speak ▪ cite ▪ quote

intro.en: These words all mean to write or speak about somebody/​something, often in order to give an example or prove something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含写到、说到、谈及或举例说明之义。

items.def: to write or speak about something/​somebody, especially without giving much information:
items.zh: 指提到、写到、说到，尤指未给出详细信息

examples.en: Nobody mentioned anything to me about it.
examples.zh: 没人跟我提过这事儿。

items.def: (rather formal) to mention or speak about somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指提到、谈及、说起

examples.en: I promised not to refer to the matter again.
examples.zh: 我答应过再不提这事了。

items.def: to mention or describe somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指提起、讲述

examples.en: Witnesses spoke of a great ball of flame.
examples.zh: 目击者都谈到有个大火球。

items.def: (formal) to mention something as a reason or an example, or in order to support what you are saying:
items.zh: 指提及（原因）、举出（示例）证明

examples.en: He cited his heavy workload as the reason for his breakdown.
examples.zh: 他提到繁重的工作负荷是导致他累垮的原因。

items.def: to mention an example of something to support what you are saying:
items.zh: 指举例说明

examples.en: Can you quote me an instance of when this happened?
examples.zh: 你能否给我举例说明一下发生这事的情况？

senses.def: to be so easy to see and understand that you do not need to say anything else about it/them

examples.en: Her success speaks for itself.
examples.zh: 她的成功有目共睹。

examples.en: Recent events speak for themselves.
examples.zh: 最近发生的事件不言而喻。

senses.def: to express what you think or want yourself, rather than somebody else doing it for you
senses.zh: 自己说（而非让别人替自己说）

examples.en: I'm quite capable of speaking for myself, thank you!
examples.zh: 我自己会说，谢谢了！

senses.def: used to tell somebody that a general statement they have just made is not true of you
senses.zh: （告诉某人不要以为自己的概括性意见适用于大家）只说你自己，那是你

examples.en: ‘We didn't play very well.’ ‘Speak for yourself!’ (= I think that I played well.)
examples.zh: “我们打得不太好。”“是说你自己吧！”

senses.def: to say something when you should not, for example because it is not the right time or you are not the right person to say it
senses.zh: 说话不合时宜（或不合身份）

senses.def: to tell you a lot about something/somebody, without the need for words

examples.en: His achievement speaks volumes for his determination.
examples.zh: 他的成就充分说明了他的决心。

examples.en: What you wear speaks volumes about you.
examples.zh: 你的衣着会清楚地说明你是一个什么样的人。

senses.def: to say good or bad things about somebody
senses.zh: 称赞（或贬损）某人；说某人的好话（或坏话）

examples.en: She never speaks ill of anyone.
examples.zh: 她从不说任何人的坏话。

senses.def: to say exactly what you think, in a very direct way
senses.zh: 说心里话；说实在的；坦率地说

examples.en: She’s never hesitated about speaking her mind.
examples.zh: 她从不犹豫说出自己的想法。

examples.en: Everyone should have the right to speak their mind.
examples.zh: 每个人都有权说出自己的想法。

senses.def: to state the views or wishes of a person or a group; to act as a representative for somebody

examples.en: Our party speaks for the poor and unemployed.
examples.zh: 我们党为穷人和失业者代言。

examples.en: I can’t speak for the others, but I’d love to come myself.
examples.zh: 我不能代表其他人发言，但我很愿意自己来。

examples.en: I speak for all my colleagues.
examples.zh: 我代表所有同行讲话。

senses.def: to be evidence that something exists or is present

examples.en: Everything here speaks of perfect good taste.
examples.zh: 这里的一切都体现出极为高雅的情趣。

senses.def: to state your opinions publicly, especially in opposition to something and in a way that takes courage
senses.zh: 挺身（反对某事物）；公开站出来（反对）

examples.en: He was the only one to speak out against the decision.
examples.zh: 他是唯一公开反对这一决定的人。

examples.en: I will continue to speak out on matters of public concern.
examples.zh: 我将继续就公众关心的问题发声。

examples.en: He spoke out against mismanagement.
examples.zh: 他公开站出来反对管理不善。

senses.def: to talk to somebody in a serious way about something wrong they have done, to try to stop them doing it again

examples.en: This is the third time I’ve had to speak to him about being late.
examples.zh: 这是我第三次不得不跟他谈论迟到的事情。

examples.en: I've spoken to Ed about it and he's promised not to let it happen again.
examples.zh: 我已经同埃德谈过了，他答应不让这种事情再次发生。

senses.def: to attract or interest somebody/something

examples.en: The story spoke to him directly.
examples.zh: 这个故事立刻吸引了他。

examples.en: It's a design that speaks to the senses.
examples.zh: 这是一个诉诸感官的设计。

senses.def: to discuss or comment on a topic, problem or situation

examples.en: The show wants to speak to real issues affecting young people.
examples.zh: 这档节目想要讨论深切影响年轻人的问题。

senses.def: to be evidence that something exists or is true

examples.en: The number of cleaning firms speaks to the fact that cleaning is considered an important service.
examples.zh: 保洁被视为一项重要的服务，保洁公司的数量证明了这个事实。

senses.def: usually used in orders to tell somebody to speak more loudly

examples.en: Please speak up—we can't hear you at the back.
examples.zh: 请大声点讲，我们在后面听不见。

senses.def: to say what you think clearly and freely, especially in order to support or defend somebody/something
senses.zh: 明确表态；（尤指为…）说好话，辩护

senses.def: people say speak/talk of the devil

examples.en: Well, speak of the devil—here's Alice now!
examples.zh: 嗬，说谁谁到——瞧，艾丽斯这就来啦！

senses.def: to say something that you should not because it is the wrong situation or because it offends somebody
senses.zh: 说话出格（或冒失、鲁莽、不合时宜）

senses.def: to be able to communicate easily with another person because you share similar opinions and experience
senses.zh: （因意见和经历相似）能容易地沟通，说得来，有共同语言

senses.def: to say or think bad things about somebody

examples.en: Don't speak ill of the dead.
examples.zh: 勿议已故者之短。

senses.def: a place in the US where people could buy alcohol illegally, at the time in the 1920s and 1930s when it was illegal to make or sell alcohol
senses.zh: （美国 20 世纪 20、30 年代禁酒期间）非法经营的酒店

senses.def: a person who gives a talk or makes a speech

examples.en: He was a guest speaker at the conference.
examples.zh: 他是会议的特邀演讲人。

examples.en: a keynote speaker at the Republican convention
examples.zh: 共和党大会的一位主要发言人

examples.en: She was a brilliant public speaker.
examples.zh: 她很擅长在公开场合演讲。

examples.en: The Society has an interesting talk by a visiting speaker every month.
examples.zh: 该协会每月都会有一位来访演讲者进行有趣的演讲。

examples.en: Previous speakers include two former US Secretaries of State.
examples.zh: 之前的发言者包括两位美国前国务卿。

examples.en: He was much in demand as a visiting speaker.
examples.zh: 作为客座演讲者，他很受欢迎。

examples.en: The conference featured a number of distinguished speakers from the world of business and industry.
examples.zh: 会议邀请了多位来自商界和工业界的杰出演讲者。

examples.en: She is a frequent speaker on human and civil rights.
examples.zh: 她经常就人权和公民权利发表演讲。

senses.def: a person who speaks a particular language

examples.en: English speakers
examples.zh: 讲英语的人

examples.en: Spanish/Arabic/Chinese speakers
examples.zh: 西班牙语/阿拉伯语/中文使用者

examples.en: a fluent speaker of German
examples.zh: 讲一口流利德语的人

senses.def: a person who is or was speaking

examples.en: I looked around to see who the speaker was.
examples.zh: 我四下环顾看说话的是谁。

examples.en: A speaker conveys information through tone and body language.
examples.zh: 演讲者通过语气和肢体语言传达信息。

examples.en: Communication is an active process that involves both the speaker and the listener.
examples.zh: 沟通是一个主动的过程，涉及说话者和听者。

senses.def: the part of a radio, computer or piece of musical equipment that the sound comes out of

examples.en: The car had a powerful sound system with four speakers.
examples.zh: 这辆车配有四喇叭大功率音响系统。

senses.def: the title of the person whose job is to control the discussions in a parliament

examples.en: the Speaker of the House of Commons/Representatives
examples.zh: 英国下议院／美国众议院议长

intro.en: These are all words for a person who talks or who is talking, especially in a particular way.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指说话者，尤指以某种方式说话的人。

items.def: a person who is or was speaking; a person who speaks a particular language:
items.zh: 指发言者、讲某种语言的人

examples.en: I looked around to see who the speaker was.
examples.zh: 我四下环顾看说话的是谁。

items.def: (rather formal) a person who is able to describe their ideas and feelings clearly to others:
items.zh: 指交际者、交流者

examples.en: The ideal candidate will be an effective communicator.
examples.zh: 理想的候选人定要是善于沟通的人。

items.def: (disapproving) a person who enjoys talking about other people’s private lives:
items.zh: 指喜欢传播流言蜚语的人、爱说长道短（或说三道四）的人

examples.en: Don't tell anyone, because some people are terrible gossips.
examples.zh: 不要告诉任何人，因为有些人很八卦。

items.def: a person who talks in a particular way or who talks a lot:
items.zh: 指以某种方式说话的人、爱说话的人

examples.en: He’s a very persuasive talker.
examples.zh: 他是一个说话很有说服力的人。

senses.def: a phone that can be used without being held, because it contains a microphone
senses.zh: 扬声电话（内置麦克风和扬声器，使用时无须拿起听筒）

senses.def: the north-east corner of Hyde Park
senses.zh: 演讲者角：伦敦海德公园（Hyde Park）的东北角。自19世纪以来，人们被允许在当地向公众发表关于他们选择的任何主题的演讲。在周末，通常会有几个人站在箱子上，发表有关政治，宗教或其他主题的演讲。有时，公众会与他们争论。

senses.def: used to say that you are the type of person mentioned and are expressing your opinion from that point of view
senses.zh: （表示从某种角度看问题）作为…来说

examples.en: Speaking as a parent, I'm very concerned about standards in education.
examples.zh: 作为家长，我十分关注教育的水准。

senses.def: a weapon with a long wooden handle and a sharp metal point used for fighting, hunting and fishing in the past

examples.en: She had a fish impaled on the point of her spear.
examples.zh: 她矛尖上叉住了一条鱼。

examples.en: The tribesmen were armed with spears and shields.
examples.zh: 部落男子都手持矛和盾。

examples.en: a 5 000-year-old stone spear point
examples.zh: 有 5,000 年历史的石制矛尖

senses.def: the long pointed stem
to throw or push a spear

examples.en: They were standing in the river spearing fish.
examples.zh: 他们站在河里叉鱼。

examples.en: She speared an olive with her fork.
examples.zh: 她用叉子扎起一个橄榄。

senses.def: a gun which shoots spears
a person or group that begins an activity or leads an attack against somebody/something
to begin an activity or lead an attack against somebody/something
senses.zh: 做…的先锋；带头做；领先突击

examples.en: He is spearheading a campaign for a new stadium in the town.
examples.zh: 他正发起一项运动，呼吁在城里新建一座体育场。

senses.def: a type of mint

examples.en: spearmint chewing gum
examples.zh: 留兰香口香糖

senses.def: a detailed description of something, especially the design and materials needed to produce something

examples.en: We want the machine manufactured to our own spec.
examples.zh: 我们要求这台机器按我们自己的规格来制造。

senses.def: when you do something on spec

examples.en: A lot of young people apply for jobs on spec (= not in reply to an advertisement, but hoping that a job might be available).
examples.zh: 许多年轻人根据具体要求申请工作（=不是为了回复广告，而是希望有工作机会）。

senses.def: to design and make something to a particular standard
senses.zh: 按特定标准设计并制造

examples.en: The camera is well specced for the price.
examples.zh: 就价钱来说，这台照相机的配置很不错。

senses.def: when you do something on spec

examples.en: A lot of young people apply for jobs on spec (= not in reply to an advertisement, but hoping that a job might be available).
examples.zh: 许多年轻人根据具体要求申请工作（=不是为了回复广告，而是希望有工作机会）。

senses.def: an offensive word to describe somebody who wears glasses
not ordinary or usual; different from what is normal
senses.zh: 特殊的；特别的；不寻常的；不一般的

examples.en: The school will only allow this in special circumstances.
examples.zh: 学校只有在特殊情况下才会同意这种事。

examples.en: An application has been filed for special leave to appeal in the High Court.
examples.zh: 已提交向高等法院提出上诉的特许申请。

examples.en: Some of the officials have special privileges.
examples.zh: 有些官员享受特权。

examples.en: There is something special about this place.
examples.zh: 这个地方有几分特别。

examples.en: This type of wood needs special treatment.
examples.zh: 这种类型的木材需要特殊处理。

senses.def: more important than others; deserving or getting more attention than usual
senses.zh: 重要的；格外看重的；特别关照的

examples.en: What are your special interests?
examples.zh: 你有哪些主要的爱好？

examples.en: Our special guest on next week’s show will be…
examples.zh: 我们下周节目的特邀嘉宾是…

examples.en: a special occasion
examples.zh: 重要场合

examples.en: a special 20th anniversary edition of the movie
examples.zh: 电影 20 周年纪念特别版

examples.en: It's a film that holds a special place in my heart.
examples.zh: 这是一部在我心中占有特殊位置的电影。

examples.en: What makes him special as a director is his obvious intelligence.
examples.zh: 让他成为与众不同的导演的，是他显而易见的才智。

examples.en: She makes me feel special.
examples.zh: 她让我感觉很特别。

examples.en: She's a very special friend.
examples.zh: 她是我特别要好的朋友。

examples.en: Don't lose it—it's special.
examples.zh: 别丢了，这可不是一般东西。

senses.def: organized or intended for a particular purpose
senses.zh: 特设的；有专门目的的；起专门作用的

examples.en: British special forces were employed on stealth operations.
examples.zh: 英国特种部队受雇参加了秘密行动。

examples.en: a special event/report/team
examples.zh: 特设活动；特别报告／团队

examples.en: There are almost no special features on this DVD.
examples.zh: 这张DVD几乎没有什么特别之处。

examples.en: These teachers need special training.
examples.zh: 这些教师需要专门的培训。

examples.en: Dr Pearce is the special adviser on environmental issues.
examples.zh: 皮尔斯博士是环境问题特别顾问。

examples.en: a United Nations special envoy
examples.zh: 联合国特使

examples.en: The merger was approved at a special meeting of shareholders.
examples.zh: 此次合并已在特别股东大会上获得批准。

senses.def: used by or intended for one particular person or group of people
senses.zh: 专用的；专门针对…的；特有的

examples.en: She has a special way of smiling.
examples.zh: 她微笑的样子有些特别。

examples.en: He enlivens his lectures with his own special brand of humour.
examples.zh: 他特有的招牌式幽默使讲课生动活泼。

examples.en: He sent a special message to the men.
examples.zh: 他给那些人专门去了一封信。

senses.def: better or more than usual

examples.en: As an only child she got special attention.
examples.zh: 她是个独生女，所以备受关爱。

examples.en: Special thanks are due to the many volunteers who helped organize fundraising events.
examples.zh: 要特别感谢众多志愿者帮助组织了募捐活动。

examples.en: People who grow things have a special relationship with the land.
examples.zh: 种植作物的人们与土地有着特殊的关系。

examples.en: Please take special care of it.
examples.zh: 请对它多加关照。

examples.en: Police advised residents to take special precautions because of the increase in burglaries.
examples.zh: 由于入室盗窃案有所增加，警方建议居民采取特别预防措施。

senses.def: something that is not usually available but is provided for a particular purpose or on one occasion
senses.zh: 特别活动（或节目等）；特制产品

examples.en: an election-night special on television
examples.zh: 选举之夜电视特别节目

examples.en: The menu changes regularly and there are daily specials to choose from.
examples.zh: 菜谱定期更换，而且每天都有特色菜供选择。

senses.def: a price for a particular product in a shop or restaurant that is lower than usual

examples.en: There's a special on coffee this week.
examples.zh: 本周咖啡特价。

senses.def: on sale at a lower price for a short period of time

examples.en: The chocolates were on special at my local store.
examples.zh: 我家附近商店的巧克力在做特价。

examples.en: You can often find them on special.
examples.zh: 你经常可以在特别节目中找到它们。

senses.def: on sale at a lower price for a short period of time

examples.en: The chocolates were on special at my local store.
examples.zh: 我家附近商店的巧克力在做特价。

examples.en: You can often find them on special.
examples.zh: 你经常可以在特别节目中找到它们。

senses.def: a detective who works for the national government in the US, for example for the FBI
the department of the British police force that deals with the defence of the country against political crimes and terrorism
senses.zh: （英国警察部门的）政治保安处

examples.en: Special Branch was/were heading the investigation.
examples.zh: 特别部门正在领导调查。

senses.def: a symbol that is not a letter of the alphabet or a number

examples.en: Your password must contain at least eight characters, including one capital letter, one number and one special character.
examples.zh: 你的密码必须含有至少八个字符，包括一个大写字母、一个数字和一个特殊字符。

senses.def: (in the UK) a person who is not a professional police officer but who is trained to help the police force, especially during an emergency
senses.zh: 临时警察，纠察（英国在非常时期协助警察维持治安）

senses.def: a service that delivers a letter, etc. faster than normal

examples.en: I’ll send the contract to you by special delivery.
examples.zh: 我将通过特快专递将合同寄给您。

senses.def: a version of a product that has extra material or features that do not appear in the standard version

examples.en: She will release a special edition of the album featuring ten unreleased demos.
examples.zh: 她将发行该专辑的特别版，其中包含十个未发行的演示。

examples.en: They love to have an excuse to make special edition sneakers.
examples.zh: 他们喜欢有借口制作特别版运动鞋。

examples.en: They will release two special edition models to commemorate their 100-year anniversary.
examples.zh: 他们将发布两款特别版车型以纪念其成立 100 周年。

senses.def: the education of children who have physical or learning problems
senses.zh: 特殊教育（为有身体障碍或学习障碍的儿童而设）

senses.def: unusual or exciting pieces of action in films or television programmes, that are created by computers or clever photography to show things that do not normally exist or happen
senses.zh: （电影或电视节目的）特技效果

senses.def: a group of people who work together to achieve something that they are particularly interested in, especially by putting pressure on the government, etc.
senses.zh: （尤指对政府施压的）特别利益集团

examples.en: The president has pledged to stand up to powerful special interest groups such as the gun lobby and the tobacco industry.
examples.zh: 总统承诺对抗枪支游说团和烟草业等强大的特殊利益集团。

senses.def: a licence allowing two people to get married at a time or place that is not usually allowed
senses.zh: 结婚特别许可（批准在通常不允许的时间或地点结婚）

senses.def: particular educational needs that a child has because of a learning problem or disability
senses.zh: 智力或身体障碍者的）特殊需求

examples.en: She teaches children with special needs.
examples.zh: 她教的是有特殊需求的儿童。

senses.def: a product that is sold at less than its usual price, especially in order to persuade people to buy it; the act of offering goods in this way

examples.en: Shop around for special offers.
examples.zh: 去四处转转，看有没有特价商品。

examples.en: a special offer on perfume
examples.zh: 香水特价销售

examples.en: Fresh pasta is on special offer this week.
examples.zh: 本周新鲜意大利面有特价优惠。

senses.def: a military mission that uses specially trained soldiers or special equipment, especially one that is done in secret or uses unusual tactics

examples.en: Government forces bombed the militants while conducting special operations to take out their commanders.
examples.zh: 政府军轰炸了武装分子，同时开展特别行动以消灭他们的指挥官。

examples.en: Special operations forces are integral in the defence of the area.
examples.zh: 特种作战部队是该地区防御不可或缺的一部分。

senses.def: trying to persuade somebody about something by mentioning only the arguments that support your opinion and ignoring the arguments that do not support it
senses.zh: （只谈有利于自己观点的论据的）诡辩

senses.def: a special official who can be appointed

examples.zh: 你低估了人类克服困难的精神力量。

examples.zh: 瑜伽旨在将身体、思想和精神结合起来。

senses.def: a person’s feelings or state of mind

examples.en: They were all in good spirits as they set out.
examples.zh: 他们出发时人人心情都很好。

examples.en: You must try and keep your spirits up (= stay cheerful).

examples.zh: 一首总能使我高兴起来的歌

examples.en: kindred spirits (= people who like the same things as you)

senses.def: courage, energy or determination

examples.zh: 彼得打出了一场精彩的比赛，展现了他真正的精神。

examples.zh: 晚会很成功，因为每个人都很投入。

examples.zh: 我正在努力融入假期的气氛。

examples.zh: 要依照法律的精神实质，而不是字面意思。

senses.zh: 一瞬间作出的；做得非常精确的

examples.en: She had to make a split-second decision.
examples.zh: 她必须在瞬间作出决定。

examples.en: The success of the raid depended on split-second timing.
examples.zh: 袭击的成功取决于分秒不差的时间安排。

senses.def: two separate periods of time that you spend working in a single day, with several hours between them
senses.zh: 间隔班（工作时间分成间隔几小时的两段轮班）

examples.en: I work split shifts in a busy restaurant.
examples.zh: 我在一家繁忙的餐馆上间隔班。

senses.def: (in elections in the US) a vote in which somebody votes for candidates from two different parties
senses.zh: （在美国的各级选举中）投两党候选人的选票

senses.def: including votes for candidates from two different parties in a single vote
senses.zh: （在美国的各级选举中）投两党候选人的选票

examples.en: a split-ticket vote
examples.zh: 投两党候选人的选票

senses.def: to stop having a relationship with somebody

examples.en: My parents split up last year.
examples.zh: 我父母去年离婚了。

examples.en: She's split up with her boyfriend.
examples.zh: 她和男朋友分手了。

examples.en: The rock group split up last year.
examples.zh: 这个摇滚乐队去年解散了。

senses.def: to make two people stop having a relationship with each other

examples.en: My friend is doing her best to split us up.
examples.zh: 我的朋友竭力想拆散我们。

senses.def: to divide a group of people into smaller parts; to become divided up in this way

examples.en: We were split up into groups to discuss the question.
examples.zh: 我们分组讨论了那个问题。

examples.en: Let's split up now and meet again at lunchtime.
examples.zh: 我们现在先分开，午饭时再集合。

senses.def: to divide something into smaller parts

examples.en: The day was split up into 6 one-hour sessions.
examples.zh: 一天的活动分作 6 个时段，每个时段一小时。

senses.def: to divide something into two equal parts; to divide into two equal parts

examples.en: The country was split down the middle over the strike (= half supported it, half did not).
examples.zh: 国内支持和反对罢工的人势均力敌。

examples.en: Divide the cake down the middle.
examples.zh: 将蛋糕从中间分开。

examples.en: It would seem the community has divided down the middle, with some favouring expansion and some dead set against it.
examples.zh: 社区似乎分成了两派，一些人支持扩张，一些人坚决反对。

senses.def: the end of a relationship

examples.en: Within three months of the honeymoon, it was splitsville for Ron and Mimi.
examples.zh: 罗恩和米米蜜月之后不到三个月就散伙了。

senses.def: a large mark or spot of ink
senses.zh: 一块污渍；一片污迹；色块；光斑

examples.en: He had a splodge of oil on his cheek.
examples.zh: 他脸颊上有一块油渍。

senses.def: to move through water, making soft sounds
senses.zh: （在水里）啪嗒啪嗒地移动，溅泼着前行

examples.en: Children were sploshing about in the pool.
examples.zh: 孩子们在游泳池里哗哗地游来游去。

senses.def: the soft sound of something moving through or falling into water

examples.en: His watch fell into the pond with a quiet splosh.
examples.zh: 他的手表掉进池塘里，发出轻轻的水花声。

senses.def: a small amount of liquid that moves through the air

examples.en: a splosh of milk in my tea
examples.zh: 我的茶里溅了一点牛奶

senses.def: an act of spending a lot of money on something that you do not really need
to spend a lot of money on something that you do not really need

examples.en: He splurged his whole week’s wages on a champagne dinner.
examples.zh: 整整一周的工资，他一顿香槟晚餐就挥霍得一干二净。

examples.en: She splurged out more than she could afford on loads of new clothes.
examples.zh: 她花了超出自己承受能力的钱买了很多新衣服。

senses.def: to speak quickly and with difficulty, making soft spitting
senses.zh: 气急败坏地说；慌张地说

examples.en: ‘But, but…you can’t!’ she spluttered.
examples.zh: “可是，可是…你不能啊！”她急促而慌乱地说。

examples.en: Her father spluttered with indignation.
examples.zh: 她父亲气得说话都语无伦次了。

senses.def: to make a series of short explosive

examples.en: The firework spluttered and went out.
examples.zh: 花炮噼里啪啦地喷完后灭了。

examples.en: She fled from the blaze, coughing and spluttering.
examples.zh: 她从大火中逃出来，一边咳嗽，一边噗噗地吐气。

senses.def: a short explosive

examples.en: The car started with a loud splutter.
examples.zh: 汽车突的一声发动了。

senses.def: pottery
senses.zh: 在英格兰特伦特河畔斯托克的Spode工厂生产的陶器和瓷器（通过烘烤一种细粘土制成的坚硬的白色发光材料）。该工厂由Josiah Spode（1733-97）于1770年建立，并很快因其产品质量（包括柳木花纹板）而闻名。自2009年以来，该公司由Portmeirion Group拥有，但其产品仍使用Spode这个名称。

senses.def: to change something good into something bad, unpleasant, etc.

examples.en: Our camping trip was spoilt by bad weather.
examples.zh: 天气不好，破坏了我们的露营旅行。

examples.en: Don't let him spoil your evening.
examples.zh: 别让他搞得你一晚上不开心。

examples.en: The tall buildings have spoiled the view.
examples.zh: 那些高楼大厦破坏了这一带的景致。

examples.en: Don't eat too many nuts—you'll spoil your appetite (= will no longer be hungry at the proper time to eat).
examples.zh: 别吃太多坚果，会影响你的食欲。

examples.en: I won’t tell you what happens in the last chapter—I don’t want to spoil it for you.
examples.zh: 我不会告诉你最后一章发生了什么－我不想破坏你的兴致。

senses.def: to give a child everything that they ask for and not enough discipline in a way that has a bad effect on their character and behaviour

examples.en: She spoils those kids of hers.
examples.zh: 那几个孩子被她宠坏了。

examples.en: My grandparents used to spoil me rotten.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母过去极宠我。

senses.def: to make somebody/yourself happy by doing something special

examples.en: Why not spoil yourself with a weekend in a top hotel?
examples.zh: 为什么不到顶级饭店度个周末，让自己享受享受呢？

examples.en: He really spoiled me on my birthday.
examples.zh: 我生日那天他真让我受宠若惊。

senses.def: to become bad so that it can no longer be eaten
to mark a ballot paper
senses.zh: 错填（选票），使作废（尤指作为抗议）

examples.en: The group called on its supporters to spoil their ballot papers.
examples.zh: 该组织呼吁其支持者毁掉他们的选票。

to cause something good to fail because you did not spend a small but necessary amount of money or time on a small but essential part of it
if too many people are involved in doing something, it will not be done well

examples.en: the spoils of war

examples.zh: 强盗们瓜分了赃物。

examples.en: the spoils of high office
examples.zh: 身居高位的连带利益

examples.en: The two teams shared the spoils with a 1–1 result.
examples.zh: 两队以1-1的比分平分秋色。

senses.zh: （为竞争而迅速发表的）抵消影响的报道（或书籍等）

examples.zh: 该报剧透了。

examples.en: In the final episode (spoiler alert) he gets shot.
examples.zh: 在最后一集（剧透警告）他中枪了。

senses.def: actions which are intended to stop somebody from doing what they plan to do
senses.zh: 破坏策略：旨在阻止某人做他们打算做的事情的动作

senses.def: already claimed or being kept for somebody
