a person who studies astrology
the study of astronomy
senses.zh: 观星：天文学或占星学的研究

senses.def: unpleasant; real, and impossible to avoid
senses.zh: 严酷的；赤裸裸的；真实而无法回避的

examples.en: The author paints a stark picture of life in a prison camp.
examples.zh: 作者描绘出一幅冷酷而真实的战俘营生活画面。

examples.en: The government faced a stark choice between civil war and martial law.
examples.zh: 政府面临残酷的选择，内战还是戒严。

examples.en: The remains of the building stand as a stark reminder of the fire.
examples.zh: 房子的断壁残垣是那场大火无情的见证。

examples.en: He now faces the stark reality of life in prison.
examples.zh: 他现在要面对狱中生活的严酷现实了。

examples.en: The stark truth is that there is not enough money left.
examples.zh: 明摆着的事实是剩下的钱已经不够了。

examples.en: The stark fact is that even with more time, we still couldn’t raise enough money.
examples.zh: 严峻的事实是，即使有更多时间，我们仍然无法筹集到足够的资金。

senses.def: very different from something in a way that is easy to see

examples.en: stark differences
examples.zh: 鲜明的区别

examples.en: Social divisions in the city are stark.
examples.zh: 城市里各社会阶层有明确的分野。

examples.en: The good weather was in stark contrast to the storms of previous weeks.
examples.zh: 这时的好天气和前几个星期的暴风雨形成鲜明的对比。

senses.def: looking severe and without any colour or decoration
senses.zh: 毫无修饰的；荒凉的；粗陋的

examples.en: I think white would be too stark for the bedroom.
examples.zh: 我觉得卧室里用白色未免太素了。

examples.en: The hills stood stark against the winter sky.
examples.zh: 在冬日的天空下，小山了无生气。

senses.def: complete and total

examples.en: The children watched in stark terror.
examples.zh: 孩子们极端恐惧地看着。

senses.def: wearing no clothes
completely crazy
completely crazy

intro.en: These words all describe statements, often about something unpleasant, that are very clear, not trying to hide anything, and not using more words than necessary.
intro.zh: 以上各词常形容令人不快的陈述清楚明白、直截了当、简单明了。

items.def: used for talking about a fact that other people may not like to hear; honest and direct in a way that other people may not like:
items.zh: 用于他人可能不乐意听的事实，或指直率、直接得让人不喜欢

examples.en: The plain fact is that nobody really knows.
examples.zh: 事实很明显，没有人真正了解。

items.def: [only before noun] used for talking about a fact that other people may not like to hear; very obvious and not complicated by anything else:
items.zh: 用于他人可能不乐意听的事实，或指事物简单明了

examples.en: The simple truth is that we just can’t afford it.
examples.zh: 事实很简单，我们就是付不起。

items.def: (rather formal) used for describing an unpleasant fact or difference that is very obvious:
items.zh: 用于描述令人不快的事实或区别十分明显、鲜明

examples.en: The stark truth is that there is not enough money left.
examples.zh: 明摆着的事实是剩下的钱已经不够了。

items.def: [only before noun] the most basic or simple, with nothing extra:
items.zh: 指最基本的、最简单的

examples.en: She gave me only the bare facts of the case.
examples.zh: 她只给我介绍了这个案件的一些基本情况。

items.def: (formal) expressing your opinion or intention very clearly and firmly:
items.zh: 指表达明确的、毫不含糊的、斩钉截铁的

examples.en: The reply was an unequivocal ‘no’.
examples.zh: 回答是个干脆利落的“不”字。

senses.def: not wearing any clothes
in a way that is unpleasant, real and impossible to avoid; completely
senses.zh: 严酷的；赤裸裸的；真实而无法回避的

examples.en: We are starkly aware of the risks.
examples.zh: 我们完全清楚所面临的种种风险。

examples.en: These theories contrast starkly with the reality of everyday life.
examples.zh: 这些理论和日常生活现实形成鲜明对照。

senses.def: in a way that is easy to see because it is very different
senses.zh: 鲜明：以一种易于看到的方式，因为它是明显不同的

examples.en: The lighthouse stood out starkly against the dark sky.
examples.zh: 灯塔在漆黑的天空的映衬下十分显眼。

senses.def: in a way that looks severe because it has no colour or decoration
senses.zh: 毫无修饰的；荒凉的；粗陋的

examples.en: The interior is starkly simple.
examples.zh: 内部装饰简单粗陋。

senses.def: a severe appearance without colour or decoration
senses.zh: 毫无修饰的；荒凉的；粗陋的

examples.en: the starkness of modernist architecture
examples.zh: 现代主义建筑的质朴

senses.def: the fact of being unpleasant, real and impossible to avoid
senses.zh: 严酷的；赤裸裸的；真实而无法回避的

examples.en: the starkness of loss and grief
examples.zh: 赤裸裸的失落和悲伤

senses.def: with no stars in the sky

examples.en: a starless night
examples.zh: 没有星星的夜晚

senses.def: a young woman actor hoping to become famous
senses.zh: 渴望成名的年轻女演员

examples.en: Hollywood starlets of the 1940s
examples.zh: 20 世纪 40 年代好莱坞那些渴望成名的年轻女演员

senses.def: light from the stars

examples.en: We walked home by starlight.
examples.zh: 我们借着星光走回家。

senses.def: a common bird with dark shiny feathers and a noisy call

examples.en: a flock of starlings
examples.zh: 一群八哥

senses.def: with light from the stars

examples.en: a starlit night
examples.zh: 星光照耀的夜晚

senses.def: full of stars

examples.en: a beautiful starry night
examples.zh: 繁星满天的美丽夜晚

senses.def: looking like a star

examples.en: starry flowers
examples.zh: 像星星似的花朵

senses.def: shining like stars
full of emotion, hopes or dreams about somebody/something in a way that is not realistic

examples.en: a starry-eyed plan
examples.zh: 不切实际的计划

examples.en: I remember when you were all starry-eyed about Rob.
examples.zh: 我记得当时你们对罗布抱有不切实际的幻想。

senses.def: if somebody has stars in their eyes
senses.zh: 成名的梦想；（尤指成为演员、歌手等的）明星梦

senses.def: a large spacecraft
Star Trek
senses.zh: 星际飞船企业：星际迷航

senses.def: to begin doing or using something
senses.zh: 开始，着手，动手（做或使用）

examples.en: I start work at nine.
examples.zh: 我每天九点开始工作。

examples.en: He's just started a new job.
examples.zh: 他刚刚着手一项新工作。

examples.en: The kids start school next week.
examples.zh: 孩子们下星期开学。

examples.en: I only started (= began to read) this book yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天才开始看这本书。

examples.en: We need to start (= begin using) a new jar of coffee.
examples.zh: 我们得新开一罐咖啡了。

examples.en: It's a long story. Where shall I start?
examples.zh: 说来话长。我该从哪儿说起呢？

examples.en: Can you start (= a new job) on Monday?
examples.zh: 你可以星期一就来上班吗？

examples.en: It started to rain.
examples.zh: 下起雨来了。

examples.en: I was starting to feel tired.
examples.zh: 我有点累了。

examples.en: Mistakes were starting to creep in.
examples.zh: 不知不觉间，开始出错了。

examples.en: She started laughing.
examples.zh: 她笑了起来。

examples.en: Suddenly things started happening.
examples.zh: 突然事情开始发生。

examples.en: It's time you started on your homework.
examples.zh: 你该做功课了。

examples.en: Let's start by reviewing what we did last week.
examples.zh: 我们开始先来复习一下上星期学的内容。

examples.en: If you want to find out more, this website is a good place to start.
examples.zh: 如果您想了解更多信息，这个网站是一个很好的起点。

senses.def: to begin happening; to make something begin happening

examples.en: Work is due to start this weekend.
examples.zh: 本周末开始工作。

examples.en: What time does the show start?
examples.zh: 展会什么时候开始？

examples.en: Have you any idea where the rumour started?
examples.zh: 你知不知道谣言是从哪儿传出来的？

examples.en: Who started the fire?
examples.zh: 谁放的火？

examples.en: I'm ready to start the process of writing.
examples.zh: 我已经准备好开始写作过程了。

examples.en: Do you start the day with a good breakfast?
examples.zh: 你早晨起来会先好好吃一顿早饭吗？

examples.en: You're always trying to start an argument.
examples.zh: 你总是想挑起争论。

examples.en: The news started me thinking.
examples.zh: 那条消息让我思考起来。

senses.def: when you start

examples.en: Start the engines!
examples.zh: 发动引擎！

examples.en: He started the recording.
examples.zh: 他开始录音。

examples.en: I can't get the car started.
examples.zh: 这辆车我发动不起来。

examples.en: The car won't start.
examples.zh: 这辆车发动不起来。

senses.def: to begin to exist; to make something begin to exist

examples.en: The company started in 1894 in Pennsylvania.
examples.zh: 该公司于 1894 年在宾夕法尼亚州成立。

examples.en: There are a lot of small businesses starting up in that area.
examples.zh: 小型企业在那一地区大量涌现。

examples.en: She started a business while she was still at school.
examples.zh: 她上学时就办了个公司。

examples.en: I decided to start a fashion blog.
examples.zh: 我决定开设一个时尚博客。

examples.en: They want to start a family (= to have children).
examples.zh: 他们准备要孩子了。

examples.en: He decided to start up his own film festival.
examples.zh: 他决定举办自己的电影节。

senses.def: to begin from a particular place, amount or situation; to begin in a particular way

examples.en: The trail starts just outside the town.
examples.zh: 小径从刚出城的地方开始。

examples.en: Hotel prices start at €80 for a double room.
examples.zh: 旅馆的双人房间每晚起价 80 欧元。

examples.en: A sentence always starts with a capital letter.
examples.zh: 句子第一个字母都大写。

examples.en: The evening started badly when the speaker failed to turn up.
examples.zh: 那天晚上的活动开局不利，因为演讲者没有来。

examples.en: The best professional musicians start young.
examples.zh: 卓有成就的音乐家很早就接触音乐。

senses.group: from place/level/in particular way 起点；下限；方式

senses.def: to begin, or to begin something such as a career, in a particular way that changed later

examples.en: She started as a secretary but ended up running the department.
examples.zh: 她起初只是一个秘书，但最后掌管起了整个部门。

examples.en: It started as a hobby and grew from there.
examples.zh: 开始时只是出于兴趣，后来便一发而不可收。

examples.en: The company started out with 30 employees.
examples.zh: 公司创立之初只有 30 名员工。

examples.en: I started off as a dishwasher making 25 cents an hour.
examples.zh: 我一开始是一名洗碗机，每小时挣 25 美分。

examples.en: He started life as a teacher before turning to journalism.
examples.zh: 他开始当过教师，后来改行搞起了新闻。

examples.en: She started her career working for the BBC.
examples.zh: 她的职业生涯始于为 BBC 工作。

senses.group: from place/level/in particular way 起点；下限；方式

senses.def: to begin a journey; to leave

examples.en: What time are we starting tomorrow?
examples.zh: 我们明天什么时候出发？

senses.def: to begin to move in a particular direction

examples.en: I started after her (= began to follow her) to tell her the news.
examples.zh: 我起身朝她追去，好把消息告诉她。

examples.en: He started for the door, but I blocked his way.
examples.zh: 他向门口走去，但我挡住了他的去路。

senses.def: to move suddenly and quickly because you are surprised or afraid

examples.en: The sudden noise made her start.
examples.zh: 突如其来的声音吓了她一跳。

senses.def: used to tell somebody not to complain or be critical
senses.zh: （制止某人抱怨或挑剔）别抱怨，别挑剔

examples.en: Don't start! I told you I'd be late.
examples.zh: 别抱怨啦！我跟你说过我要迟到的。

examples.en: Don't you start! It's hard enough managing the kids, without you complaining too.
examples.zh: 别抱怨啦！管理孩子们已经够难的了，不要再抱怨了。

senses.def: to make something start happening; to make sure that something continues to happen
to start a relationship well/badly

examples.en: I seem to have got off on the wrong foot with the new boss.
examples.zh: 看来我和新老板的关系一开头就不好。

senses.def: to begin doing something

examples.en: It's nearly ten o'clock. Let's get started.
examples.zh: 快十点了，咱们开始吧。

examples.en: It's already late, so I think we should get started.
examples.zh: 已经很晚了，我觉得咱们该开始了。

senses.def: to start a relationship well/badly

examples.en: I seem to have started off on the wrong foot with the new boss.
examples.zh: 我似乎和新老板一开始就走错了路。

senses.def: to cause trouble
used when you are giving the first and most important reason for something

examples.en: To start with, it’s much too expensive…
examples.zh: 首先是太贵⋯

senses.def: at the beginning

examples.en: The club had only six members to start with.
examples.zh: 这家俱乐部起初仅有六名会员。

examples.en: I'll have melon to start with.
examples.zh: 我要先吃甜瓜。

examples.en: She wasn't keen on the idea to start with.
examples.zh: 她一开始并不喜欢这个主意。

senses.def: used to blame somebody for beginning a fight or an argument
senses.zh: （指责某人）是你（或他、她等）挑起来的

examples.en: ‘Stop fighting, you two!’ ‘He started it!’
examples.zh: “你们俩，别打了！”“是他先动手的！”

senses.def: the point at which something begins

examples.en: If we don't hurry, we'll miss the start.
examples.zh: 如果我们不快点的话，我们就会错过开始的机会。

examples.en: They haven't won since the start of the season.
examples.zh: 赛季开始后他们还没赢过。

examples.en: Things didn't look too hopeful at the start of the year.
examples.zh: 在年初，情况显得并不十分乐观。

examples.en: We've had problems right from the start.
examples.zh: 我们从一开始就遇到了困难。

examples.en: We've had problems from the very start.
examples.zh: 我们从一开始就遇到了问题。

examples.en: The trip was a disaster from start to finish.
examples.zh: 那次旅行从头到尾糟糕透顶。

examples.en: a perfect start to the day
examples.zh: 那一天的美好开端

examples.en: After a slow start to his career, things improved.
examples.zh: 在经历了职业生涯的缓慢起步之后，情况有所改善。

examples.en: The campaign is off to a promising start.
examples.zh: 这场运动有了一个好的开始。

examples.en: a shaky/rocky start
examples.zh: 摇摇欲坠的开始

examples.en: This could be the start of something big.
examples.zh: 这或许是要有大事的苗头。

senses.def: the act or process of beginning something

examples.en: We need to get an early start in the morning.
examples.zh: 我们早上得早点儿出发。

examples.en: I'll paint the ceiling if you make a start on the walls.
examples.zh: 你要是动手刷墙，我就刷天花板吧。

examples.en: She's moving abroad to make a fresh start (= to begin a new life).
examples.zh: 她要移居国外，开始新的生活。

examples.en: I think it's time we made a start.
examples.zh: 我想咱们该开始了。

examples.en: It's not much, but it's a start (= something useful has been done, although there is a lot more still to do).
examples.zh: 这算不上什么，但总是个开始。

senses.def: the opportunity that you are given to begin something in a successful way
senses.zh: 起始优势；良好的基础条件

examples.en: Many critics got their start writing for this magazine.
examples.zh: 很多批评家都是从为这家杂志撰稿起步的。

examples.en: Moving to a different school gave Sally a fresh start.
examples.zh: 转学到另一所学校给了莎莉一个新的开始。

examples.en: They worked hard to give their children a good start in life.
examples.zh: 他们力争为孩子们的人生奠定一个良好的基础。

examples.en: The job gave him his start in journalism.
examples.zh: 那份工作是他进入新闻界的开始。

senses.def: the place where a race begins

examples.en: The runners lined up at the start.
examples.zh: 赛跑运动员在起跑线上一字排开。

examples.en: The runners walked up to the start line.
examples.zh: 参赛选手走向起跑线。

senses.def: an amount of time or distance that somebody has as an advantage over other people at the beginning of a race

examples.en: I gave the younger children a start.
examples.zh: 我让年幼的孩子提前起跑。

examples.en: She went into the second round with a five-minute start on the rest of the cyclists.
examples.zh: 她进入第二轮，并取得比其他自行车选手提前五分钟出发的优势。

senses.def: an occasion when somebody/something competes in a race or competition, or when somebody is a member of a team that starts a game

examples.en: She has been beaten only once in six starts.
examples.zh: 她参加了六次比赛，只败过一次。

examples.en: He has scored three goals in his last three starts.
examples.zh: 他在最近的三场比赛中进了三个球。

senses.def: an act of moving your body quickly and suddenly because you are surprised, afraid, etc.

examples.en: You gave me quite a start!
examples.zh: 你吓了我一大跳！

examples.en: She woke from the dream with a start.
examples.zh: 她猛地一惊，从梦中醒来。

senses.def: frequently starting and stopping again; not continuously

examples.en: Because of other commitments I can only write my book in fits and starts.
examples.zh: 由于还承担着其他任务，我只能断断续续地写书。

senses.def: used to emphasize the first of a list of reasons, opinions, etc.
senses.zh: （强调一系列理由、意见等的第一条）首先

examples.en: I'm not working there—for a start, it's too far to travel.
examples.zh: 我不去那边干活儿。首先，路太远，去不了。

senses.def: from an initial position in which none of the necessary elements are in place

examples.en: The space project went from a standing start to the moon in ten years.
examples.zh: 航天工程 10 年前从零起步，10 年后登上了月球。

senses.def: to make a very good start; to begin something well
senses.zh: 有很好的开端；有良好的起步；开门红

examples.en: She’s got off to a flying start in her new career.
examples.zh: 她的新职业生涯有了个良好的开端。

senses.def: to begin happening; to begin doing something

examples.zh: 讨论颇为温和地开展起来。

examples.zh: 我们先来做点强度低的运动。

examples.zh: 我们一开始先自我介绍。

examples.zh: 树叶起先是绿色，到后来会变红。

examples.zh: 我一开始非常勤奋，但没有坚持下去。

examples.zh: 我们从讨论“软件体系结构”的定义开始吧。

examples.zh: 我们要如何开始一切呢？

examples.zh: 她怎么会有那样古怪的念头呢？

examples.zh: 什么也别跟她说，不然你又要惹她生气了。

examples.zh: 凯文把我们大家都逗笑了。

examples.zh: 三岁时我母亲就让我开始练钢琴了。

examples.zh: 他父亲指点他做农活儿。

examples.zh: 你不要埋怨他没工作。

examples.zh: 她对我们干的活儿不满意，要我们返工。

intro.en: These words all mean to make somebody feel surprised.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含使惊奇、使诧异之义。

items.def: to give somebody the feeling that you get when something happens that you do not expect or do not understand, or something that you do expect does not happen; to make somebody feel surprised:

examples.zh: 这一结果完全在我的意料之中。

items.zh: 指惊吓、使吓一跳、使大吃一惊

examples.en: Sorry, I didn’t mean to startle you.
examples.zh: 对不起，我不是存心要吓唬你。

examples.en: Just the huge size of the place amazed her.
examples.zh: 仅仅地方之大就使她十分惊奇。

items.def: to surprise somebody very much:

examples.zh: 这消息使大家十分惊讶。

examples.zh: 她敌视的反应使我们大吃一惊。

items.def: to surprise or shock somebody very much:

examples.en: His arrogance astounded her.
examples.zh: 他的傲慢使她震惊。

examples.zh: 她美得惊人。

examples.en: to die of/from starvation
examples.zh: 饿死

examples.zh: 由于发生旱灾，明年将有数百万人面临饥饿的威胁。

examples.zh: 不足果腹的食物

examples.zh: 飞行员因为缺氧已经失去了知觉。

examples.zh: 他们挣的工资不够维持基本生活。

examples.zh: 工人的生活条件很差，所得工资难以维持生计。

examples.zh: 展示饥饿儿童的图片

examples.zh: 新工作的工资没有过去多，不过我们不至于挨饿！

examples.zh: 她试图通过节食来减肥。

examples.zh: 封锁的目的是让该国挨饿，迫使其屈服。

examples.zh: 让我感到痛苦的是无法与有识之士交谈。

examples.zh: 这个部门一直缺少资源。

examples.zh: 那婴儿的大脑缺氧了。

senses.zh: 以断绝食物来源迫使某人出来

examples.zh: 如果他们不出来，我们就饿死他们！

examples.zh: 她有一大笔钱存在几个不同的银行账户下。

examples.zh: 思绪纷乱

examples.zh: 液态水

examples.zh: 当他回到家时，他的情况非常糟糕。

examples.zh: 她震惊不已。

examples.zh: 那座房子年久失修。

examples.zh: 他一直处于消沉状态。

senses.def: a situation

examples.en: This state of affairs can no longer be ignored.
examples.zh: 再不能无视这种情况了。

senses.def: the stage that has been reached in a process, etc. which has not yet been completed

examples.en: What is the current state of play in the peace talks?
examples.zh: 和平谈判目前进展得怎么样？

senses.def: the score in a sports match, especially in cricket
provided or controlled by the government of a country

examples.en: state officials/agencies
examples.zh: 国家官员／机构

examples.en: state education
examples.zh: 公办教育

examples.en: families dependent on state benefits (= in Britain, money given by the government to people who are poor)
examples.zh: 靠政府救济金生活的家庭

examples.en: state secrets (= information that could be harmful to a country if it were discovered by an enemy)
examples.zh: 国家机密

senses.def: provided or controlled by a particular state of a country, especially in the US

examples.en: the state government/legislature
examples.zh: 州政府；州立法机构

examples.en: California state law
examples.zh: 加州法律

examples.en: a state prison/hospital/university
examples.zh: 州监狱；州立医院／大学

examples.en: state police/troopers
examples.zh: 州警察

examples.en: a state tax
examples.zh: 州税

examples.en: federal and state government policies
examples.zh: 联邦和州政府政策

senses.group: part of country 国家的一部分

senses.def: connected with the leader of a country attending an official ceremony

examples.en: The queen is on a state visit to Berlin.
examples.zh: 女王正在柏林进行国事访问。

examples.en: the state opening of Parliament
examples.zh: 隆重的议会开幕式

examples.en: the state apartments (= used for official ceremonies)
examples.zh: 国事活动厅

senses.def: to formally write or say something, especially in a careful and clear way

examples.en: He has already stated his intention to run for election.
examples.zh: 他已声明打算参加竞选。

examples.en: The facts are clearly stated in the report.
examples.zh: 报道对事实真相作了清楚的说明。

examples.en: There is no need to state the obvious (= to say something that everyone already knows).
examples.zh: 显而易见的事实就不必陈述了。

examples.en: State clearly how many tickets you require.
examples.zh: 说清楚你需要多少张票。

examples.en: The children were asked in turn to state what they wanted from the situation.
examples.zh: 孩子们被要求依次陈述他们想从这种情况中得到什么。

examples.en: He stated categorically that he knew nothing about the deal.
examples.zh: 他明确表示对那笔交易一无所知。

examples.en: It was stated that standards at the hospital were dropping.
examples.zh: 据称，那家医院的医疗水准在不断下降。

examples.en: All the photographs in this book, unless otherwise stated, date from the 1950s.
examples.zh: 本书所有照片，除非另有说明，均摄于 20 世纪 50 年代。

examples.en: The contract was stated to be invalid.
examples.zh: 那份合同宣布作废。

examples.en: The driver is stated to have three previous convictions.
examples.zh: 据称，这名司机此前曾有过三项犯罪记录。

senses.def: to fix or announce the details of something, especially on a written document

examples.en: This is not one of their stated aims.
examples.zh: 在他们宣布的目标里没有这一条。

examples.en: You must arrive at the time stated.
examples.zh: 你必须在规定时间到达。

examples.en: Do not exceed the stated dose (= of medicine).
examples.zh: 不要超过规定的剂量。

senses.def: to be/become excited or anxious

examples.en: She was in a real state about her exams.
examples.zh: 她对考试感到很紧张。

examples.en: He made a mistake and got into a terrible state about it.
examples.zh: 他犯了一个错误，并为此陷入了可怕的境地。

examples.en: Jane was in a terrible state after losing her job.
examples.zh: 失业以后，简情况很糟。

senses.def: to be dirty or untidy

examples.en: What a state this place is in!
examples.zh: 这地方真够乱的！

examples.en: How did the carpet get into that state?
examples.zh: 地毯是如何进入这种状态的？

senses.def: (in the Roman Catholic Church) having been forgiven by God for the wrong or evil things you have done
senses.zh: （天主教指灵魂上没有大罪的状态）受天主眷爱，蒙受恩宠

examples.en: He died in a state of grace.
examples.zh: 他死的时候灵魂得到了宽恕。

senses.def: a situation

examples.en: This state of affairs can no longer be ignored.
examples.zh: 再不能无视这种情况了。

senses.def: the stage that has been reached in a process, etc. which has not yet been completed

examples.en: What is the current state of play in the peace talks?
examples.zh: 和平谈判目前进展得怎么样？

senses.def: the score in a sports match, especially in cricket

synonyms.words: circumstances ▪ position ▪ conditions ▪ things ▪ the case ▪ state of affairs

intro.en: These are all words for the conditions and facts that are connected with and affect the way things are.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指情况、状况。

items.def: all the things that are happening at a particular time and in a particular place:
items.zh: 指情况、状况、形势、局面

examples.en: the present economic situation
examples.zh: 目前的经济形势

items.def: the facts that are connected with and affect a situation, an event or an action; the conditions of a person’s life, especially the money they have:
items.zh: 指条件、环境、状况、境况，（尤指）经济状况

examples.en: The ship sank in mysterious circumstances.
examples.zh: 那艘船神秘地沉没了。

items.def: the situation that somebody is in, especially when it affects what they can and cannot do:
items.zh: 指处境、地位、状况

examples.en: She felt she was in a position of power.
examples.zh: 她觉得她自己有权力。

items.def: the circumstances in which people live, work or do things; the physical situation that affects how something happens:
items.zh: 指居住、工作或做事情的环境、境况、条件，影响某事发生的物质环境、状态、条件

examples.en: We were forced to work outside in freezing conditions.
examples.zh: 我们被迫在户外天寒地冻的环境下工作。

items.def: (rather informal) the general situation, as it affects somebody:
items.zh: 指形势、局面、情况、事态

examples.en: Hi, Jane! How are things?
examples.zh: 喂，简，近来怎么样？

items.def: the true situation:
items.zh: 指实情、事实

examples.en: If that is the case (= if the situation described is true), we need more staff.
examples.zh: 如果真是那样，我们就需要更多的员工了。

items.def: a situation:
items.zh: 指事态、情况、形势

examples.en: How did this unhappy state of affairs come about?
examples.zh: 这种不幸的情况是怎么发生的呢？

intro.en: These words all mean to say something, usually clearly and definitely and often in public.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含表明、宣称、宣布之义。

items.def: (rather formal) to say something officially or publicly; to state something clearly and definitely:
items.zh: 指公布、宣布、表明、宣称

examples.en: to declare war
examples.zh: 宣战

items.def: (rather formal) to formally write or say something, especially in a careful and clear way:
items.zh: 指陈述、说明、声明

examples.en: He has already stated his intention to run for election.
examples.zh: 他已声明打算参加竞选。

items.def: (rather formal) to state something, sometimes in a way that is slightly indirect:
items.zh: 指表明、暗示

examples.en: During our meeting, he indicated his willingness to cooperate.
examples.zh: 在我们会晤期间，他提及了合作的意愿。

items.def: to tell people officially about a decision or plans; to give information about something in a public place, especially through a loudspeaker; to say something in a loud and/​or serious way:
items.zh: 指宣布、宣告、（通过广播）通知

examples.en: They haven’t formally announced their engagement yet.
examples.zh: 他们还没有正式宣布订婚。

senses.def: the fact of somebody using their personal or professional status in order to influence political decisions to their advantage
senses.zh: 政府俘获（指利用个人身份或职业地位影响政治决定，从而令自己获益）

examples.en: There is a direct relationship between state capture and corruption.
examples.zh: 国家夺取与腐败之间存在直接关系。

senses.def: education in schools, colleges and universities provided by the government

examples.en: the state education system
examples.zh: 国家教育体制

examples.en: There needs to be more money going into state education.
examples.zh: 需要有更多的资金投入公立教育。

senses.def: (in the US) a building in which a state legislature
the border between two states in the US

examples.en: the Nevada-California state line
examples.zh: 内华达和加利福尼亚两州州界

examples.en: His family lived across the state line in West Virginia.
examples.zh: 他的家人住在州界线那边的西弗吉尼亚州境内。

senses.def: a situation in which the government limits people’s freedom to enter or leave a city, town or building

examples.en: Armed police placed the city centre under a virtual state of siege while the trial continued.
examples.zh: 在审判继续进行期间，武装警察对市中心实施了虚拟的包围状态。

senses.def: using the most modern or advanced techniques or methods; as good as it can be at the present time
senses.zh: 应用最先进技术（或方法）的；最先进的

examples.en: The system was state of the art.
examples.zh: 这一系统是当时最先进的。

examples.en: a state-of-the-art system
examples.zh: 目前最先进的系统

examples.en: The Physics Department has state of the art facilities.
examples.zh: 物理系拥有最先进的设施。

senses.def: a lawyer who represents a state in a court
if a criminal turns state’s evidence
senses.zh: （刑事被告向法庭提供的）对同案犯不利的证据

senses.def: a school that is paid for by the government and provides free education

examples.en: Do you go to a state school or a private school?
examples.zh: 你上公立学校还是私立学校？

examples.en: Do students from state schools get the same opportunities as children who are privately educated?
examples.zh: 公立学校的学生是否能获得与私立学校的孩子相同的机会？

senses.def: a university that is managed by a state of the US
(in the US) a member of a State police force

examples.en: Scores of police and state troopers tried to clear the streets.
examples.zh: 大批当地警察和州警察试图疏散街上的人群。

senses.def: a university that is managed by a state of the US
skill in managing state and political affairs

examples.en: He had little real experience of statecraft.
examples.zh: 他几乎没有真正的治国经验。

senses.def: the fact of being an independent country and of having the rights and powers of a country

examples.en: Slovakia’s path to independent statehood
examples.zh: 斯洛伐克的独立建国之路

senses.def: the condition of being one of the states within a country such as the US or Australia

examples.en: West Virginia was granted statehood in 1863.
examples.zh: 西弗吉尼亚于 1863 年获准成为一个州。

senses.def: not officially a citizen of any country

examples.en: The children of illegal immigrants will in many cases be born stateless.
examples.zh: 在许多情况下，非法移民的孩子一出生就没有国籍。

senses.def: the condition of not officially being a citizen of any country
a small state (= country)
senses.zh: （尤指大国分裂后形成的）小国

senses.def: impressive size, appearance or manner
senses.zh: 宏大的；壮观的；气宇不凡的；仪态高贵的

examples.en: the stateliness of this immense city
examples.zh: 这座巨大城市的庄严

senses.def: a slow and formal quality
senses.zh: 庄重：缓慢而正式的品质

examples.en: a seventeenth-century world of stateliness and gentle formality
examples.zh: 一个庄严而温和的十七世纪世界

senses.def: impressive in size, appearance or manner
senses.zh: 宏大的；壮观的；气宇不凡的；仪态高贵的

examples.en: an avenue of stately chestnut trees
examples.zh: 两边有雄伟高大栗树的林荫道

examples.en: a tall, stately woman
examples.zh: 仪态高贵的高个子女人

senses.def: slow and formal
senses.zh: 缓慢庄严的；优雅从容的

examples.en: a stately dance
examples.zh: 缓慢优雅的舞蹈

examples.en: The procession made its stately progress through the streets of the city.
examples.zh: 游行队伍缓慢而庄严地穿过城市的街道。

senses.def: a large, impressive house of historical interest, especially one that the public may visit
senses.zh: （具历史价值，尤指可供人参观的）豪华大宅

examples.en: Priceless antique furniture was destroyed in the fire at the stately home.
examples.zh: 那座富丽堂皇的宅子里价值连城的古董家具在大火中付之一炬了。

senses.def: something that you say or write that gives information or an opinion

examples.en: Are the following statements true or false?
examples.zh: 下面的说法对不对？

examples.en: The article contained several false statements.
examples.zh: 该文章包含多项虚假陈述。

examples.en: He made a rather misleading statement.
examples.zh: 他发表了一个颇具误导性的言论。

examples.en: Is that a statement or a question?
examples.zh: 这是在表态呢，还是提出问题呢？

examples.en: I didn't agree with her statement about education.
examples.zh: 我不同意她关于教育的说法。

senses.def: a formal or official account of facts or opinions

examples.en: a joint/a written/an official statement
examples.zh: 联合／书面／官方声明

examples.en: A government spokesperson made a statement to the press.
examples.zh: 政府发言人向新闻界发表了一份声明。

examples.en: The court heard witness statements from several people.
examples.zh: 法庭听取了多名证人的证词。

examples.en: The prosecution delivered a brilliant opening statement.
examples.zh: 检方发表了精彩的开庭陈词。

examples.en: The government will issue a statement on the policy change today.
examples.zh: 政府将在今天就政策的改变发表声明。

examples.en: In a statement released yesterday, the company denied the allegations.
examples.zh: 在昨天发布的一份声明中，该公司否认了这些指控。

examples.en: He gave a statement (= a written account of facts about a crime, used in court if legal action follows) in which he said he saw two men.
examples.zh: 他提供了一份供述，说他看见了两名男子。

examples.en: According to a White House press statement, negotiators are still striving to reach an agreement.
examples.zh: 据白宫新闻声明称，谈判代表仍在努力达成协议。

senses.def: a printed record of money paid, received, etc.

examples.en: The directors are responsible for preparing the company's financial statements.
examples.zh: 几位总监负责填写公司的财务报表。

examples.en: My bank sends me monthly statements.
examples.zh: 银行按月给我寄来结算单。

senses.def: a clear expression of an opinion or attitude that you make through your actions or appearance

examples.en: They decided to make a political statement by refusing to vote.
examples.zh: 他们决定把拒绝投票作为一种政治声明。

examples.en: The play makes a strong political statement.
examples.zh: 这出戏表明一种鲜明的政治立场。

examples.en: The way you dress makes a statement about you.
examples.zh: 你的衣着表明了你的性格。

examples.en: The cleaning staff extended their strike mainly to make a statement about how determined they were.
examples.zh: 清洁工人延长了罢工时间，主要目的是表明他们的决心。

examples.en: The clothes you wear are a statement about yourself.
examples.zh: 衣着是对自我的一种诠释。

senses.def: (in England and Wales) an official report on a child’s special needs made by a local education authority
senses.zh: （英格兰和威尔士地方教育部门针对儿童的特殊需求提供的）评估报告

examples.en: a statement of special educational needs
examples.zh: 特殊教育需求评估报告

senses.def: the act of stating or expressing something in words

examples.en: When writing instructions, clarity of statement is the most important thing.
examples.zh: 编写操作说明时，表述清晰明白至为重要。

senses.def: (in England and Wales) to officially decide and report that a child has special needs for his or her education
senses.zh: （英格兰和威尔士）对（儿童）做特殊教育需求评估

examples.en: statemented children
examples.zh: 评估认定须接受特殊教育的学童

intro.en: These are all words for something that you say or write, especially something that gives information or an opinion.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指口头或书面的说明、宣布。

items.def: something that you say or write that gives information or an opinion, often in a formal way:
items.zh: 通常指正式的说明、声明、陈述、报告

examples.en: A government spokesperson made a statement to the press.
examples.zh: 政府发言人向新闻界发表了一份声明。

items.def: something that you say or write that gives an opinion on something or is a response to a question about a particular situation:
items.zh: 指议论、评论、意见

examples.en: She made helpful comments on my work.
examples.zh: 她对我的工作提出了有益的意见。

items.def: a spoken or written statement that informs people about something:
items.zh: 指公告、布告、通告

examples.en: the announcement of a peace agreement
examples.zh: 和平协议公告

items.def: something that you say or write that gives an opinion or thought about somebody/​something:
items.zh: 指谈论、言论、评述

examples.en: He made a number of rude remarks about the food.
examples.zh: 他对这食物作了许多无礼的评论。

items.def: (rather formal) an official or formal statement, especially one that states an intention, belief or feeling, or that gives information:
items.zh: 指官方或正式的公告、宣告、宣言、声明

examples.en: the declaration of war
examples.zh: 宣战

items.def: (rather formal) a comment, especially one based on something you have seen, heard or read:
items.zh: 尤指根据所见、所闻、所读而作的评论

examples.en: He began by making a few general observations about the report.
examples.zh: 开头他先对这个报告作了几点概括性的评论。

senses.def: an island which is one of the boroughs
senses.zh: 史泰登岛：是纽约市行政区之一的岛屿。它的前名是里士满。它通过Verrazano-Narrows桥与布鲁克林相连。史泰登岛渡轮前往曼哈顿的炮台公园，可欣赏城市美景。

senses.def: a private room on a large ship
a room used by important government members, members of a royal family, etc. on formal occasions
senses.zh: （政府要员或王室成员等使用的）会客厅，议事厅，国事活动厅

senses.def: (in the US) the rights of each state in relation to the national government, such as the right to make some laws and to have its own police force
senses.zh: （美国的）州权（相对于国家政府的权力，如制定某些法律和拥有自己的警察）

senses.def: connected with the US; in or towards the US (used when the person speaking is not in the US)
senses.zh: （用以在境外指美国）美国的（地），在美国的（地），去美国的（地）

examples.en: When are you next planning a trip stateside?
examples.zh: 你计划下一次什么时候去美国？

senses.def: a man who is a wise, experienced and respected political leader

examples.en: the party’s elder statesman
examples.zh: 该党元老

senses.def: having or showing the qualities and abilities of a statesman
senses.zh: 具有政治家风范的；像政治家的

examples.en: He was commended for his statesmanlike handling of the crisis.
examples.zh: 他处理那场危机时，因表现出政治家的才干而受到称赞。

senses.def: skill in managing state affairs
a wise, experienced and respected political leader
a woman who is a wise, experienced and respected political leader

examples.en: the party's elder stateswoman
examples.zh: 该党的元老女政治家

senses.def: happening or existing in all parts of a state of the US
senses.zh: （美国）全州性的（地），在全州范围内的（地）

examples.en: a statewide election
examples.zh: 州选举

examples.en: She won 10 per cent of the vote statewide.
examples.zh: 她赢得全州 10% 的选票。

senses.def: not moving, changing or developing

examples.en: The balance sheet provides a static picture of the financial position at a point in time.
examples.zh: 资产负债表提供了某个时间点财务状况的静态图景。

examples.en: Prices on the stock market, which have been static, are now rising again.
examples.zh: 股市价格一直停滞不动，现在又在上涨了。

examples.en: a static population level
examples.zh: 稳定的人口水平

senses.def: acting as a weight but not producing movement

examples.en: static pressure
examples.zh: 静压

senses.def: noise or other effects that interrupt radio or television signals and are caused by particular conditions in the atmosphere
electricity that gathers on or in an object that is not a conductor

examples.en: My hair gets full of static when I brush it.
examples.zh: 我梳头时头发就有好多静电。

senses.def: the science that deals with the forces that balance each other to keep objects in a state of rest
angry or critical comments or behaviour
electricity that gathers on or in an object that is not a conductor

examples.en: a brief spark of static electricity
examples.zh: 短暂的静电火花

senses.def: a drug that people take to lower the level of cholesterol
senses.zh: 胆固醇合成酶抑制剂；他汀

examples.en: Statins are prescribed for patients at risk of heart disease and stroke.
examples.zh: 他汀类药物用于有心脏病和中风风险的患者。

senses.def: a place where trains stop so that passengers can get on and off; the buildings connected with this

examples.en: the main station
examples.zh: 中心车站

examples.en: Euston Station
examples.zh: 尤斯顿车站

examples.en: a train station
examples.zh: 火车站

examples.en: a railway station
examples.zh: 火车站

examples.en: a tube/an underground station
examples.zh: 地铁站

examples.en: a subway station
examples.zh: 地铁站

examples.en: I get off at the next station.
examples.zh: 我在下一站下车。

senses.group: for trains/buses 火车；公共汽车

senses.def: a place where buses stop; the buildings connected with this
senses.zh: 公共汽车站；长途汽车站

examples.en: We waited for him at the bus station.
examples.zh: 我们在公交车站等他。

examples.en: a coach station
examples.zh: 长途汽车站

examples.en: Victoria Coach Station
examples.zh: 维多利亚长途汽车站

senses.group: for trains/buses 火车；公共汽车

senses.def: a place or building where a service is organized and provided or a special type of work is done

examples.en: Report the theft at the nearest police station.
examples.zh: 向最近的警察局报告盗窃案。

examples.en: a petrol station
examples.zh: 加油站

examples.en: a gas station
examples.zh: 加油站

examples.en: a pollution monitoring station
examples.zh: 污染监测站

examples.en: an agricultural research station

examples.zh: 这种新药是治疗这一疾病的重大进展。

examples.en: Closing the factory would be a retrograde step.
examples.zh: 关闭工厂将是一种倒退。

senses.def: one of a series of things that somebody does or that happen, which forms part of a process

examples.en: Having completed the first stage, you can move on to step 2.
examples.zh: 第一阶段完成后，你就可以接着进行第二步了。

examples.en: If you follow all the steps, nothing will go wrong.
examples.zh: 如果你遵循所有的步骤，就不会出什么差错。

examples.en: I'd like to take this idea a step further.
examples.zh: 我想把这一思想深化一步。

examples.en: This was a big step up (= to a better position) in his career.
examples.zh: 这是他在事业上向前迈出的一大步。

examples.en: I'll explain it to you step by step.
examples.zh: 我来一步一步地给你解释。

examples.en: a step-by-step guide to building your own home
examples.zh: 自建房舍的分步骤指导手册

senses.def: the act of lifting your foot and putting it down in order to walk or move somewhere; the sound this makes

examples.en: a baby’s first steps
examples.zh: 婴儿学步

examples.en: He took a step towards the door.
examples.zh: 他朝门口迈了一步。

examples.en: We heard steps outside.
examples.zh: 我们听见外面有脚步声。

senses.def: the distance that you cover when you take a step

examples.en: It's only a few steps further.
examples.zh: 再走几步就到了。

examples.en: He turned around and retraced his steps (= went back the way he had come).
examples.zh: 他转身原路往回走。

examples.en: She moved a step closer to me.
examples.zh: 她朝我靠近一步。

examples.en: The hotel is only a short step (= a short distance) from the beach.
examples.zh: 旅馆离海滩只有几步路。

examples.zh: 她正坐在最下面一级楼梯上。

examples.en: We walked down some stone steps to the beach.
examples.zh: 我们走下几级石阶，来到海滩上。

examples.en: A short flight of steps led up to the door.
examples.zh: 上几磴台阶就到了门口。

senses.def: a series of movements that you make with your feet and which form a dance

examples.zh: 你知道这个舞蹈的舞步吗？

senses.def: the way that somebody walks

examples.zh: 他迈着轻快的步子走着。

examples.en: There was a smile on her face and a spring in her step.
examples.zh: 她脸上挂着笑容，脚步轻快。

senses.def: a type of exercise that you do by stepping on and off a raised piece of equipment

examples.en: a step class
examples.zh: 踏板操训练班

senses.def: a stepladder

examples.zh: 一架折梯

examples.zh: 我们得踩着梯子才能爬到阁楼上去。

senses.def: the interval
to change the way you are walking so that you do not walk in the same rhythm as the people you are walking or marching

examples.en: The soldiers turned without once breaking step.
examples.zh: 士兵们转过身来，没有停下脚步。

senses.def: to change the way you are walking so that you start walking in the same rhythm as the person you are walking with
senses.zh: （和某人）合上步伐，步调一致起来

examples.en: He caught her up and fell into step beside her.
examples.zh: 他赶上她，跟着她的步子往前走。

senses.def: putting your feet on the ground in the right/wrong way, according to the rhythm of the music or the people you are moving with
senses.zh: （和某人）步伐一致（或不一致）；（和音乐）合拍（或不合拍）

examples.en: He was out of step with the music.
examples.zh: 他跟不上音乐的节奏。

examples.en: She had trouble keeping in step with the others.
examples.zh: 她跟不上其他人的舞步。

senses.def: having ideas that are the same as or different from other people’s

examples.en: She was out of step with her colleagues.
examples.zh: 她和同事们想法不一样。

senses.def: to walk carefully
to behave in a careful and sensible way

examples.en: You’d better watch your step with him if you don’t want trouble.
examples.zh: 如果你不想惹麻烦的话，你最好和他在一起时小心点。

examples.en: She's always one step ahead of the competition.
examples.zh: 她总是在竞争中领先一步。

senses.def: when you do something one step at a time
senses.zh: 一步一步；逐步；按部就班

examples.zh: 上／下公共汽车

examples.zh: 我听见叫我名字时向前迈了一步。

examples.en: She stepped aside to let them pass.
examples.zh: 她闪到一边让他们过去。

examples.en: We stepped carefully over the broken glass.
examples.zh: 我们小心翼翼地从碎玻璃上走了过去。

examples.en: I turned around quickly and stepped on his toes.
examples.zh: 我一个急转身，踩到了他的脚上。

examples.en: She opened the door and stepped out into the sunshine.
examples.zh: 她打开门，走进阳光下。

examples.en: Going into the hotel is like stepping back in time.
examples.zh: 走进这家旅馆就像是回到了过去。

senses.def: to do somebody’s job or work when they are suddenly or unexpectedly unable to do it
senses.zh: 临时顶替某人工作；临时顶缺

examples.en: She stepped into the breach caused by Stella's illness.
examples.zh: 她填补了斯特拉患病造成的缺口。

senses.def: to continue a job or the work that somebody else has started

examples.en: She stepped into her father’s shoes when he retired.
examples.zh: 当她父亲退休时，她接替了他的职位。

senses.def: used especially in orders to tell somebody to drive faster
senses.zh: （尤用以要求加速驾驶）开快点儿，赶快

senses.def: to offend or annoy somebody, especially by getting involved in something that is their responsibility
senses.zh: 激怒，得罪，冒犯（尤指因插手他人职责）

examples.en: I don’t want to step on anybody’s toes so I’ll keep quiet.
examples.zh: 我不想踩到任何人的脚趾，所以我会保持安静。

senses.def: to behave badly or break the rules
senses.zh: 表现不好；不守规矩；越轨；出格

examples.en: His boss warned him that if he stepped out of line once more he would be fired.
examples.zh: 他的老板警告他，如果他再次越界，他将被解雇。

examples.zh: 雇主们已站出来帮助弥合教育与就业之间的鸿沟。

examples.zh: 教学工会正在加强罢工行动以支持他们的工资要求。

a first name for boys
(c. 1097-1154) the king of England from 1135 to 1154. He was the grandson
senses.zh: 史蒂芬：（大约1097-1154年）1135年至1154年的英格兰国王。他是征服者威廉的孙子，即使他同意表弟玛蒂尔达（Matilda）拥有王位的权利也成为国王。他在国王的大部分时间里都在抵抗她成为女王的企图，最后同意她的儿子亨利二世去世后将成为国王。

senses.def: (1871-1900) a US journalist who wrote poems and realistic novels. His most famous novel is The Red Badge of Courage
senses.zh: 斯蒂芬·克兰（Stephen Crane）：（1871-1900）美国记者，他写诗和写实小说。他最著名的小说是《勇气的红色徽章》（The Red Badge of Courage，1895年），讲述了一位受惊的士兵在美国内战中的勇气。克莱恩于1897年去英格兰居住，但三年后去世，享年28岁。

senses.def: (1813-61) a US politician who defeated Abraham Lincoln
senses.zh: 斯蒂芬·道格拉斯（(1813-61) 美国政治家，1858年击败亚伯拉罕·林肯竞选美国参议员，但在1860 年美国总统选举中输给了林肯。林肯与道格拉斯的辩论在美国历史上是著名的。道格拉斯的堪萨斯-内布拉斯加州法案允许新州选择是否保留人们作为奴隶。他有一个俗称“小巨人”。）

senses.def: (1826-1864) a US writer of almost 200 popular songs, most of them about the US South. They are sometimes called folk songs
senses.zh: 斯蒂芬·福斯特（Stephen Foster）：（1826-1864）是美国作家，创作了近200首流行歌曲，其中大部分是关于美国南部的。它们有时很简单，因此有时被称为民歌。大部分是由白人演艺人员表演的音乐表演，用代表当时非裔美国人讲话的词来表达。他们包括哦！苏珊娜（Susanna），家里的老人们，坎普顿种族（Camptown Races），我的肯塔基老家，美丽的梦想家和老黑人乔（Black Black Joe）。福斯特本人只去过一次南方。

senses.def: (1942-2018) a British scientist working in theoretical
senses.zh: 斯蒂芬·霍金（(1942-2018) 一位从事理论物理学工作的英国科学家，对人们对宇宙起源的看法产生了重大影响。他关于这一主题的著作《时间简史》(1988) 和《果壳中的宇宙》(2001) 已售出数百万册。他患有运动神经元疾病，这限制了他的移动和说话能力，因此他通过一台为他“说话”的特殊计算机进行交流。“我在书中加入的方程式将使销售额减半。”史蒂芬·霍金关于《时间简史》）

senses.def: (1941-2002) a US palaeontologist
senses.zh: 史蒂芬·杰伊·古尔德（Stephen Jay Gould）：（ 1941-2002年）美国古生物学家。他以“标点均衡”理论而闻名，该理论解释了进化发生在快速变化的短期内，而长期间没有变化。他写了许多关于地球生命史的流行书籍和文章。

senses.def: (1974-1993) a black British teenager who was murdered in South London in 1993 by a group of white teenagers. senses.def: the quality in a website of being so interesting that people continue visiting it or watching it
