examples.zh: 加上这笔新贷款，负债总额达到 10 万美元。

examples.en: I'd like to take my argument a stage further.
examples.zh: 我想把我的论点进行进一步的发挥。

examples.en: He believes he has the skills to take the club forward.
examples.zh: 他相信他有能力使俱乐部继续发展。

examples.en: We'll take the matter forward at our next meeting (= discuss it further).
examples.zh: 我们将在下一次会议上进一步讨论这个问题。

senses.def: to need or require a particular amount of time

examples.en: The process took about a year.
examples.zh: 这个过程花了约一年时间。

examples.en: The journey to the airport takes about half an hour.
examples.zh: 到机场大约需要半小时。

examples.en: It takes about half an hour to get to the airport.
examples.zh: 到机场大概需要半小时。

examples.en: That cut is taking a long time to heal.
examples.zh: 那伤口需要很长时间才能愈合。

examples.en: The official seemed to take hours to examine my passport.
examples.zh: 这位官员似乎花了几个小时来检查我的护照。

examples.en: That should only take you ten minutes.
examples.zh: 那事只需花你十分钟。

examples.en: It took her three hours to repair her bike.
examples.zh: 她花了三个小时修理自行车。

examples.en: It'll take her time to recover from the illness.
examples.zh: 她康复需要时间。

examples.en: It'll take time (= take a long time) for her to recover from the illness.
examples.zh: 她的病需要很长时间才能痊愈。

examples.en: I need a shower—I won't take long.
examples.zh: 我要冲个澡，用不了多长时间。

senses.def: to photograph somebody/something

examples.en: to take a picture/photo/shot of somebody/something
examples.zh: 给（某人／某物）拍照／照相／拍快照

examples.en: to have your picture/photo taken
examples.zh: 让人给你拍照

senses.def: to use a form of transport, a road, a path, etc. to go to a place
senses.zh: 乘坐，搭乘（交通工具）；取（道）；走（路线）

examples.en: to take the bus/train
examples.zh: 乘公共汽车／火车

examples.en: to take a cab/plane
examples.zh: 乘坐出租车/飞机

examples.en: Take the second road on the right.
examples.zh: 第二个路口向右拐。

examples.en: It's more interesting to take the coast road.
examples.zh: 走海滨公路更有意思。

senses.def: to put your hands or arms around somebody/something and hold them/it; to reach for somebody/something and hold them/it

examples.en: I passed him the rope and he took it.
examples.zh: 我把绳子递给他，他接了过去。

examples.en: Free newspapers: please take one.
examples.zh: 报纸免费，请取一份。

examples.en: Can you take (= hold) the baby for a moment?
examples.zh: 你能先抱一下孩子吗？

examples.en: He took her hand/took her by the hand (= held her hand, for example to lead her somewhere).
examples.zh: 他拉着她的手。

examples.en: She took the child in her arms and kissed him.
examples.zh: 她把孩子搂在怀里亲吻他。

senses.def: to remove something/somebody from a place or a person

examples.en: Will you take your books off the table?
examples.zh: 把你的书从桌子上拿走好吗？

examples.en: The sign must be taken down.
examples.zh: 这个指示牌一定要摘下来。

examples.en: He took some keys out of his pocket.
examples.zh: 他从口袋里取出几把钥匙。

examples.en: My name had been taken off the list.
examples.zh: 我的名字从名单上画掉了。

examples.en: She was playing with a knife, so I took it away from her.
examples.zh: 她在玩一把刀子，于是我把刀子从她手里夺了过来。

examples.en: She was playing with a knife, so I took it off her.
examples.zh: 她在玩一把刀子，于是我把刀子从她手里夺了过来。

examples.en: The new sports centre will take the pressure off the old one.
examples.zh: 新的体育中心将减轻老体育中心的压力。

senses.def: to remove something without permission or by mistake

examples.en: Someone has taken my scarf.
examples.zh: 有人把我的围巾拿走了。

examples.en: Did the burglars take anything valuable?
examples.zh: 入室窃贼偷走了贵重的东西没有？

examples.en: All she had taken was her passport and driving licence.
examples.zh: 她只带了护照和驾照。

examples.en: The storms took the lives of 50 people.
examples.zh: 这场暴风雨夺走了 50 人的生命。

senses.def: to get something from a particular source

examples.en: The scientists are taking water samples from the river.
examples.zh: 科学家正从河中采水样。

examples.en: The machine takes its name from its inventor.
examples.zh: 这机器是用发明者的姓名命名的。

examples.en: Part of her article is taken straight (= copied) out of my book.
examples.zh: 她的文章有一部分是从我的书中抄来的。

senses.def: to sit down in or use a chair, etc.

examples.en: Are these seats taken?
examples.zh: 这些座位有人吗？

examples.en: Come in; take a seat.
examples.zh: 进来，坐下。

senses.def: to eat, drink, etc. something

examples.en: Do you take sugar in your coffee?
examples.zh: 你的咖啡里要放糖吗？

examples.en: The doctor has given me some medicine to take for my cough.
examples.zh: 医生已给我开了治咳嗽的药吃。

examples.en: He started taking drugs (= illegal drugs) at college.
examples.zh: 他上大学时开始吸毒。

senses.def: to find out and record something; to write something down

examples.en: The police officer took my name and address.
examples.zh: 警察记下了我的姓名和地址。

examples.en: Did you take notes in the class?
examples.zh: 你在课堂上做了笔记吗？

senses.def: to do an exam or a test

examples.en: When did you take your driving test?
examples.zh: 你什么时候参加的驾驶执照考试？

senses.def: to study a subject at school, college, etc.

examples.en: She is planning to take a course in web design.
examples.zh: 她打算修一门网络设计课。

examples.en: Last year I started taking yoga classes.
examples.zh: 去年我开始参加瑜伽课程。

examples.en: How many subjects are you taking this year?
examples.zh: 你今年修多少门课？

senses.def: to use a particular course of action in order to deal with or achieve something

examples.en: We need to take a different approach to the problem.
examples.zh: 我们应该采用另一种方法来解决这一问题。

examples.en: The government is taking action to combat drug abuse.
examples.zh: 政府正在采取措施，打击滥用毒品。

senses.def: used with nouns to say that somebody is doing something, performing an action, etc.
senses.zh: （与名词连用，表示举动、动作等）

examples.en: to take a look
examples.zh: 看一看

examples.en: to take a break
examples.zh: 暂歇一下

examples.en: to take a shot at somebody/something
examples.zh: 朝某人／某物开枪

examples.en: to take a step/walk/stroll
examples.zh: 迈步；散步；溜达

examples.en: to take a bath/shower/wash
examples.zh: 洗澡；淋浴；洗一洗

examples.en: to take a bite/drink/sip
examples.zh: 咬／喝／呷一口

examples.en: to take a deep breath
examples.zh: 深吸一口气

examples.en: We will take a decision on the matter next week.
examples.zh: 我们下星期将对这一问题作出决定。

examples.en: She's taken a nasty fall and has her leg in plaster.
examples.zh: 她重重摔了一跤，腿上打了石膏。

examples.en: Experts have urged ministers to take the necessary steps to resolve the issue.
examples.zh: 专家敦促各部部长采取必要措施解决这一问题。

senses.def: to test or measure something

examples.en: to take somebody’s temperature
examples.zh: 给某人量体温

examples.en: I need to have my blood pressure taken.
examples.zh: 我需要量一下血压。

senses.def: to capture a place or person; to get control of something

examples.en: The rebels succeeded in taking the town.
examples.zh: 反叛者攻占了那个城镇。

examples.en: The state has taken control of the company.
examples.zh: 政府已经接管了这家公司。

examples.en: The militants took the city from government forces.
examples.zh: 激进分子从政府军手中夺取了这座城市。

examples.en: The rebels took him prisoner.
examples.zh: 反叛者把他俘虏了。

examples.en: He was taken prisoner by the rebels.
examples.zh: 他被反叛者俘虏了。

examples.en: The bank robbers took several employees hostage.
examples.zh: 银行劫匪抓了几个职员作人质。

senses.def: to choose, buy or rent something

examples.en: I'll take the grey jacket.
examples.zh: 我要那件灰色夹克衫。

examples.en: We took a room at the hotel for two nights.
examples.zh: 我们在旅馆开了个房间，住了两夜。

senses.def: to buy a newspaper or magazine regularly
senses.zh: 经常购买（某报纸或期刊）

examples.en: We take the ‘Express’.
examples.zh: 我们订阅的是《快报》。

senses.def: to accept or receive something

examples.en: If they offer me the job, I'll take it.
examples.zh: 如果他们给我这份工作，我就接受。

examples.en: She was accused of taking bribes.
examples.zh: 她被控受贿。

examples.en: I'll take the call in my office.
examples.zh: 我要在办公室里接这个电话。

examples.en: I take full responsibility for my actions.
examples.zh: 我对我的行为负全责。

examples.en: Why should I take the blame for somebody else's mistakes?
examples.zh: 我为什么要代人受过呢？

examples.en: If you choose deceit, then you must take the consequences of your actions.
examples.zh: 如果你选择欺骗，那么你就必须承担你行为的后果。

examples.en: If you take my advice you'll have nothing more to do with him.
examples.zh: 你要是听我的劝告，就不要再和他有什么瓜葛。

examples.en: Will you take $10 for the book (= will you sell it for $10)?
examples.zh: 这本书 10 美元你卖吗？

examples.en: The store took (= sold goods worth) $100 000 last week.
examples.zh: 这家商店上星期的营业额为 10 万美元。

senses.def: to act in response to an opportunity

examples.en: When the bus stopped for fuel, we took the opportunity to get something to eat.
examples.zh: 公共汽车停下加油，我们趁机找了点儿吃的。

examples.en: England failed to take their chances and had to settle for a draw.
examples.zh: 英格兰没有抓住机会，只好接受平局。

examples.en: He isn't afraid to take risks.
examples.zh: 他不怕冒险。

examples.en: Take the initiative and fill your life with exciting experiences.
examples.zh: 要有积极主动的心态，让自己有精彩的人生。

senses.def: to accept somebody as a customer, patient, etc.

examples.en: The school doesn't take boys (= only has girls).
examples.zh: 这所学校不收男生。

examples.en: The dentist can't take any new patients.
examples.zh: 这位牙科医生接待不了新患者了。

senses.def: to experience or be affected by something

examples.en: The school took the full force of the explosion.
examples.zh: 这所学校在爆炸中毁坏最严重。

examples.en: Can the ropes take the strain (= not break)?
examples.zh: 这些绳子能承受住这一张力吗？

examples.en: The team took a terrible beating.
examples.zh: 这个队遭到惨败。

examples.en: I'm afraid your husband has taken a turn for the worse.
examples.zh: 恐怕你丈夫的病情已经恶化了。

senses.def: to be able to bear something

examples.en: She can't take criticism.
examples.zh: 她受不了批评。

examples.en: I don't think I can take much more of this heat.
examples.zh: 我觉得再也忍受不了这种高温了。

examples.en: I find his attitude a little hard to take.
examples.zh: 我觉得他的态度有点儿令人难以接受。

examples.en: It was clear that she wasn't going to take any nonsense.
examples.zh: 很明显，她不会接受任何废话。

senses.def: to react to something/somebody in a particular way

examples.en: He took the criticism surprisingly well.
examples.zh: 他对待这一批评的态度竟意外地好。

examples.en: These threats are not to be taken lightly.
examples.zh: 这些威胁可不能等闲视之。

examples.en: I wish you'd take me seriously.
examples.zh: 我希望你认真对待我的话。

examples.en: I was being sarcastic but you took my comment literally.
examples.zh: 我是在讽刺，但你从字面上理解了我的评论。

examples.en: She took it in the spirit in which it was intended.
examples.zh: 她根据其精神实质来认识此事。

senses.def: to understand or consider something in a particular way

examples.en: How am I supposed to take that remark?
examples.zh: 我应该怎么理解那话的意思？

examples.en: Taken overall, the project was a success.
examples.zh: 总的看来，这个项目是成功的。

examples.en: She took what he said as a compliment.
examples.zh: 她把他说的看作是称誉。

examples.en: What did you take his comments to mean?
examples.zh: 你认为他的意见是什么意思？

senses.def: to consider somebody/something to be somebody/something, especially when you are wrong
senses.zh: （尤指错误地）以为，把…看作；误认为

examples.en: Even the experts took the painting for a genuine Van Gogh.
examples.zh: 连行家都误以为这幅画是凡高的真迹。

examples.en: Of course I didn't do it! What do you take me for (= what sort of person do you think I am)?
examples.zh: 那当然不是我干的！你把我当成什么人啦？

examples.en: I took the man with him to be his father.
examples.zh: 我误以为和他在一起的那个男人是他父亲。

senses.def: to have a particular feeling, opinion or attitude
senses.zh: 产生（感觉）；持有（看法）；采取（态度）

examples.en: My parents always took an interest in my hobbies.
examples.zh: 我父母总是关心重视我的爱好。

examples.en: Don't take offence (= be offended) at what I said.
examples.zh: 我讲的话你别见怪。

examples.en: I took a dislike to him.
examples.zh: 我对他产生了反感。

examples.en: He takes the view that children are responsible for their own actions.
examples.zh: 他的观点是孩子应对自己的行为负责。

senses.def: to reduce one number by the value of another

examples.en: Take 5 from 12 and you're left with 7.
80 take away 5 is 75.
examples.zh: 80 减去 5 等于 75。

senses.def: used to introduce somebody/something as an example

examples.en: Lots of couples have problems in the first year of marriage. Take Ann and Paul.
examples.zh: 在婚后头一年里，许多夫妇都出现一些问题。安和保罗就是个例子。

senses.def: to have or start to have a particular form, position or state
senses.zh: 采用（形式）；就任（职位）；出现（状况）

examples.en: Our next class will take the form of a debate.
examples.zh: 我们下一堂课将采用辩论的形式。

examples.en: The new president takes office in January.
examples.zh: 新总统将于一月份就职。

examples.en: The home side had a chance to take the lead.
examples.zh: 主队曾有机会领先。

senses.def: to need or require something in order to happen or be done

examples.en: It only takes one careless driver to cause an accident.
examples.zh: 只要有一个粗心大意的驾驶者便会发生车祸。

examples.en: It doesn't take much to make her angry.
examples.zh: 她动不动就发脾气。

examples.en: He didn't take much persuading (= he was easily persuaded).
examples.zh: 不用费多少口舌就说服了他。

senses.def: to use something in order to work

examples.en: The buses have been adapted to take biofuel.
examples.zh: 公共汽车被改装为使用生物燃料。

senses.def: to wear a particular size in shoes or clothes

examples.en: What size shoes do you take?
examples.zh: 你穿多大号的鞋？

senses.group: size of shoes/clothes 鞋／衣服的尺码

senses.def: to have enough space for something/somebody; to be able to hold or contain a particular quantity

examples.en: The bus can take 60 passengers.
examples.zh: 这辆公共汽车可载 60 名乘客。

examples.en: The tank takes 50 litres.
examples.zh: 这罐能容 50 升。

senses.def: to be the teacher or leader in a class or a religious service

examples.en: The head teacher usually takes us for French.
examples.zh: 校长通常给我们上法语课。

examples.en: Mr Perkins took the morning service.
examples.zh: 珀金斯先生参加了早间礼拜。

senses.def: to go over or around something

examples.en: The horse took the first fence well.
examples.zh: 那匹马轻快地跃过了第一道栅栏。

examples.en: He takes bends much too fast.
examples.zh: 他拐弯时车开得太快。

senses.def: to kick or throw the ball from a fixed or agreed position

examples.en: to take a penalty/free kick/corner
examples.zh: 主罚点球／任意球；开角球

senses.def: to use a particular method to find out people’s opinions
senses.zh: 付诸（表决）；举行（投票）；进行（调查）

examples.en: to take a vote/poll/survey
examples.zh: 付诸表决；进行民意测验／调查

senses.def: to be successful; to work

examples.en: The skin graft failed to take.
examples.zh: 皮肤移植未能成功。

senses.def: to have or require something when used in a sentence or other structure
senses.zh: （用于句子或其他结构中时）有，需要

examples.en: The verb ‘rely’ takes the preposition ‘on’.
examples.zh: 动词 rely 需要和介词 on 连用。

senses.def: used to say that you do not care if somebody accepts or rejects your offer
senses.zh: 要就要，不要就拉倒；取舍请便

senses.def: used to say that somebody does not have a strong opinion about something
senses.zh: 可有可无；无所谓；无偏好

examples.en: Dancing? I can take it or leave it.
examples.zh: 跳舞？我跳不跳都行。

senses.def: to have the qualities, ability, etc. needed to be successful
senses.zh: 具备（成功）所需要的一切条件（或素质、能力等）

senses.def: used to say that you cannot trust somebody to behave well in public
senses.zh: （用以表示不相信某人会在公共场合行为得体）到哪儿都拿不出去

examples.en: You haven’t spilled your coffee again! I can’t take you anywhere!
examples.zh: 你没有再把咖啡洒了！我不能带你去任何地方！

senses.def: to accept something/somebody without wishing it/them to be different or without thinking about it/them very much in advance

examples.en: She takes life as it comes.
examples.zh: 她对待生活的态度是顺其自然。

senses.def: to suppose; to assume

examples.en: I take it you won't be coming to the party?
examples.zh: 我想你不会来参加聚会吧？

senses.def: used to emphasize that what you are going to say is the truth
senses.zh: 我敢担保；我说的肯定没错

examples.en: Take it from me—he'll be a millionaire before he's 30.
examples.zh: 不信你等着瞧，他到不了 30 岁就会成为百万富翁。

senses.def: to make somebody physically or mentally tired
senses.zh: 使精疲力竭；使心力交瘁

examples.en: Looking after small children really takes it out of you.
examples.zh: 照看小孩确实会使你精疲力竭。

senses.def: to decide to do something without asking permission or advice
to need a lot of effort or time; to be very difficult to do
used as an exclamation when you are hitting somebody or attacking them in some other way
a scene or part of a film that is filmed at one time without stopping the camera
senses.zh: （不停机一次连续拍摄的）场景，镜头

examples.en: We managed to get it right in just two takes.
examples.zh: 我们仅拍摄了两个镜头就把这部分戏拍好了。

senses.def: an amount of money that somebody receives, especially the money that is earned by a business during a particular period of time

examples.en: How much is my share of the take?
examples.zh: 我的那一份收入是多少？

examples.en: The auction was predicted to make $20 million, but the actual take turned out to be half that figure.
examples.zh: 预计拍卖会赚得 2000 万美元，但实际成交额只有这个数字的一​​半。

senses.def: the particular opinion or idea that somebody has about something

examples.en: What's his take on the plan?
examples.zh: 他对这项计划有什么意见？

examples.en: a new take on the Romeo and Juliet story (= a way of presenting it)
examples.zh: 对《罗密欧与朱丽叶》故事的重新演绎

senses.def: to accept money from somebody for helping them in a dishonest or illegal way

note.en: Most idioms containing take are at the entries for the nouns and adjectives in the idioms, for example take the biscuit is at biscuit.
note.zh: 大多数含 take 的习语，都可在该等习语中的名词及形容词相关词条找到，如 take the biscuit 在词条 biscuit 下。

items.idm: somebody can take it or leave it

senses.zh: 可有可无；无所谓；无偏好

examples.en: Dancing? I can take it or leave it.
examples.zh: 跳舞？我跳不跳都行。

senses.def: to have the qualities, ability, etc. needed to be successful

items.idm: I, you, etc. can’t take somebody anywhere

examples.en: She takes life as it comes.

senses.def: to suppose; to assume

senses.def: used to emphasize that what you are going to say is the truth

items.idm: take it/a lot out of somebody

senses.def: to make somebody physically or mentally tired
senses.zh: 使精疲力竭；使心力交瘁

examples.en: Looking after small children really takes it out of you.
examples.zh: 照看小孩确实会使你精疲力竭。

items.idm: take it on/upon yourself to do something

senses.def: to decide to do something without asking permission or advice
to need a lot of effort or time; to be very difficult to do
used as an exclamation when you are hitting somebody or attacking them in some other way
to accept money from somebody for helping them in a dishonest or illegal way

synonyms.words: lead ▪ escort ▪ drive ▪ show ▪ walk ▪ guide ▪ usher ▪ direct

intro.en: These words all mean to go with somebody from one place to another.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含带去、引领之义。

items.def: to go with somebody from one place to another, for example in order to show them something or to show them the way to a place:
items.zh: 指带去、带路、引领

examples.en: It’s too far to walk—I’ll take you by car.
examples.zh: 步行路太远，我开车送你去。

items.def: to go with or go in front of somebody in order to show them the way or to make them go in the right direction:
items.zh: 指带路、领路、引领

examples.en: Firefighters led the survivors to safety.
examples.zh: 消防队员把幸存者带到了安全的地方。

items.def: to go with somebody in order to protect or guard them or to show them the way:
items.zh: 指护卫、护送

examples.en: The President arrived, escorted by twelve bodyguards.
examples.zh: 总统在十二名保镖的护送下到达。

items.def: to take somebody somewhere in a car, taxi, etc:
items.zh: 指驾车送（人）

examples.en: My mother drove us to the airport.
examples.zh: 我母亲开车把我们送到了机场。

items.def: to take somebody to a particular place, in the right direction, or along the correct route:
items.zh: 指引领、带领

examples.en: The attendant showed us to our seats.
examples.zh: 服务员把我们带到我们的座位。

items.def: to go somewhere with somebody on foot, especially in order to make sure that they get there safely; to take an animal, especially a dog, for a walk or make an animal walk somewhere:
items.zh: 指陪伴或护送（人）走、牵着或赶着（动物）走、遛（狗）

examples.en: He always walked her home.
examples.zh: 他经常护送她走回家。

items.def: to show somebody the way to a place, often by going with them; to show somebody a place that you know well:
items.zh: 指给某人领路（或导游）、指引

examples.en: She guided us through the busy streets.
examples.zh: 她带领我们穿过了繁忙的街道。

items.def: (rather formal) to politely take or show somebody where they should go, especially within a building:
items.zh: 指礼貌地引往、引导、引领，尤指在建筑物内

examples.en: She ushered her guests to their seats.
examples.zh: 她把客人引领到座位上。

items.def: (rather formal) to tell or show somebody how to get somewhere or where to go:
items.zh: 指给某人指路、为某人领路

examples.en: A young woman directed them to the station.
examples.zh: 一名年轻女子给他们指了去车站的路。

synonyms.words: sit down ▪ be seated ▪ take a seat ▪ perch

intro.en: These words all mean to rest your weight on your bottom with your back straight, for example on a chair.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含坐下之义。

items.def: to rest your weight on your bottom with your back straight, for example on a chair:
items.zh: 指坐

examples.en: May I sit here?
examples.zh: 我可以坐在这儿吗？

items.def: to move from a standing position to a sitting position:
items.zh: 指坐下、就座

examples.en: Please sit down.
examples.zh: 请坐。

items.def: (formal) to be sitting:
items.zh: 指坐着

examples.en: She was seated at the head of the table.
examples.zh: 她坐在桌子的上座。

items.def: to sit down Take a seat is used especially as a polite way of inviting somebody to sit down:
items.zh: take a seat 尤作请人就座的礼貌用语

items.def: (rather informal) to sit on something, especially on the edge of something:
items.zh: 指坐在…上，尤指坐在…边沿

examples.en: She perched herself on the edge of the bed.
examples.zh: 她坐在床沿上。

senses.def: to begin to have complete control over somebody/something; to become very strong
senses.zh: 开始完全控制；变得十分强大

examples.en: Panic took hold of him and he couldn't move.
examples.zh: 他突然惊慌得动弹不得。

examples.en: They got out of the house just before the flames took hold.
examples.zh: 他们就在大火吞噬房子之前逃了出来。

examples.en: It is best to treat the disease early before it takes a hold.
examples.zh: 最好还是病向浅中医。

senses.def: to put a lot of effort into doing something
senses.zh: 兢兢业业地做某事；费力地做某事

examples.en: The couple went to great pains to keep their plans secret.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇煞费苦心，对计划守口如瓶。

take (great) pains (to do something) | g.word: take (great) pains (to do something) | go to great pains (to do something)

senses.def: to do something very carefully

examples.en: He always takes great pains with his lectures.
examples.zh: 他总是仔细用心地准备讲稿。

senses.def: to take charge of an organization, project, etc.

examples.en: Lucenti took over the helm when the previous director retired.
examples.zh: 前任董事退休后，卢森蒂接任掌舵人。

senses.def: to begin controlling the direction in which a boat or ship moves
to start dancing on a dance floor

examples.en: Couples took the floor for the last dance of the evening.
examples.zh: 双双对对开始跳晚会的最后一支舞。

senses.def: to say goodbye

examples.en: With a nod and a smile, she took leave of her friends.
examples.zh: 她点头微笑着向朋友告辞。

senses.def: to allow somebody else to play a more active and important role in a particular situation than you do
senses.zh: 允许他人领先；甘愿居于人下；退居幕后

examples.en: Many managers take a back seat and leave recruitment to specialists.
examples.zh: 许多经理退居二线，将招聘工作留给了专家。

senses.def: to lose money on a business agreement
to decide to do something, knowing that it might be the wrong choice

examples.en: We took a chance on the weather and planned to have the party outside.
examples.zh: 我们怀着天气可能会好的侥幸心理筹划到户外聚会。

senses.def: to think somebody/something is bad; to not have a good opinion of somebody/something
senses.zh: 对…持不好的看法；对…没有好感

examples.en: She took a dim view of my suggestion.
examples.zh: 她对我的建议持否定态度。

take a dim view of somebody/something.word: take a dim view of somebody/something

senses.def: to suddenly get worse

examples.en: Profits really took a dive last year.
examples.zh: 去年利润确实跌得很厉害。

examples.en: The market is volatile and profits could take a dive.
examples.zh: 市场起伏不定，利润可能会大幅下降。

senses.def: to start liking somebody/something, often without an obvious reason
senses.zh: 喜欢上，爱上（常指没有明显原因）

examples.en: He’s taken quite a fancy to his next-door neighbour.
examples.zh: 他很喜欢他的隔壁邻居。

senses.def: to make your beliefs known and to try to make others follow them

examples.en: We need to take a firm line on data privacy.
examples.zh: 对于数据隐私问题，我们必须立场坚定。

examples.en: They took a firm stand against drugs in the school.
examples.zh: 他们坚决反对校园吸毒现象。

take a heavy toll: @@@LINK=take a heavy toll (on somebody/something) | take its toll (on somebody/something)

senses.def: to have a bad effect on somebody/something; to cause a lot of damage, deaths, pain, etc.
senses.zh: 产生恶果；造成重大损失（或伤亡、痛苦等）

examples.en: Illness had taken a heavy toll on her.
examples.zh: 疾病对她的身体造成极大的损害。

examples.en: The recession is taking its toll on the housing markets.
examples.zh: 经济衰退使住房市场遭受着重大损失。

examples.en: The pressure of fame can take a terrible toll.
examples.zh: 名声的压力能造成可怕的伤害。

senses.def: a rude way of telling somebody to go away
to be damaged or badly affected by something
senses.zh: 遭到破坏；受到严重影响

examples.en: The airline industry took a hit last year.
examples.zh: 去年航空业受到了严重冲击。

take a hold of sth: @@@LINK=catch, get, grab, take, etc. (a) hold of somebody/something

senses.def: to be able to laugh at a joke against yourself
senses.zh: 经得起玩笑话；开得起玩笑

examples.en: The trouble with her is she can't take a joke.
examples.zh: 她的问题在于开不起玩笑。

take a leaf from of book: @@@LINK=take a leaf from/out of somebody’s book
take a leaf from of sb's book: @@@LINK=take a leaf from/out of somebody’s book
take a leaf from of somebody's book: @@@LINK=take a leaf from/out of somebody’s book
take a leaf from/out of sb’s book: @@@LINK=take a leaf from/out of somebody’s book
take a leaf from/out of somebody's book: @@@LINK=take a leaf from/out of somebody’s book

senses.def: to copy somebody’s behaviour and do things in the same way that they do, because they are successful
senses.zh: 效仿，模仿（成功之人的举止和行为）

take a leaf from/out of somebody’s book.word: take a leaf from/out of somebody’s book

take a leaf out of book: @@@LINK=take a leaf from/out of somebody’s book
take a leaf out of sb's book: @@@LINK=take a leaf from/out of somebody’s book
take a leaf out of somebody's book: @@@LINK=take a leaf from/out of somebody’s book

senses.def: to consider a problem or possibility very carefully and without hurrying
senses.zh: 极其慎重地考虑（问题或可能性）

examples.en: We need to take a long, hard look at all the options.
examples.zh: 我们需要十分谨慎地考虑所有的可选方案。

take a long (cool/hard) look at somethin.word: take a long (cool/hard) look at something

take a middle course: @@@LINK=(steer, take, etc.) a middle course | (find, etc.) a/the middle way

senses.def: used to tell somebody to sit down

examples.en: Come in and take a pew. Can I get you a cup of tea?
examples.zh: 请进来坐。我给你倒杯茶好吗？

senses.def: to make an unkind remark about somebody/something; to laugh at somebody/something
to leave suddenly; to run away
to refuse an offer or invitation but say that you might accept it later

examples.en: ‘Are you coming out with us?’ ‘Can I take a rain check?—I must get this finished tonight.’
examples.zh: “你要和我们一起出去吗？”“我可以临时检查一下吗？——我今晚必须把这件事完成。”

senses.def: to do something even though you know that something bad could happen as a result

examples.en: That's a risk I'm not prepared to take.
examples.zh: 我不愿意去冒这个险。

examples.en: You have no right to take risks with other people's lives.
examples.zh: 你没有权利拿别人的生命去冒险。

senses.def: to begin to like somebody very much as soon as you see or meet them

examples.en: He seems to have taken a shine to you.
examples.zh: 他似乎对你产生了好感。

senses.def: to understand what somebody wants you to do even though they tell you in an indirect way

examples.en: I thought they'd never go—some people just can't take a hint.
examples.zh: 我以为他们永远也不会走的，有些人就是不会看眼色。

examples.en: Sarah hoped he'd take the hint and leave her alone.
examples.zh: 萨拉希望他能明白她的意思，不来打扰她。

examples.en: Can't you take a hint and leave me alone?
examples.zh: 你难道就听不懂我的暗示？让我一个人清静会儿吧。

senses.def: to kneel
senses.zh: 单膝下跪（以抗议歧视黑人）

examples.en: Officers at the rally were seen taking a knee in solidarity with the demonstrators.
examples.zh: 集会上出现警察单膝跪地以声援示威者的一幕。

senses.def: to bow

examples.en: She came back on stage to take another bow.
examples.zh: 她回到舞台再次鞠躬。

examples.en: The song ended and Albert took a bow.
examples.zh: 一曲结束，艾伯特鞠躬谢幕。

examples.en: The boss takes his final bow today.
examples.zh: 老板今天退休。

examples.en: The team's chairman takes his final bow at this match.
examples.zh: 球队主席在这场比赛中最后一次鞠躬。

take account of: @@@LINK=take account of something | take something into account
take account of something: @@@LINK=take account of something | take something into account

senses.def: to consider particular facts, circumstances, etc. when making a decision about something

examples.en: The company takes account of environmental issues wherever possible.
examples.zh: 这家公司总是尽量考虑到各方面的环境问题。

examples.en: Coursework is taken into account as well as exam results.
examples.zh: 除考试结果外，课程作业也要计入成绩。

take account of something | take somethi.word: take account of something | take something into account

take account of sth: @@@LINK=take account of something | take something into account

senses.def: to make use of something well; to make use of an opportunity

examples.en: She took advantage of the children's absence to tidy their rooms.
examples.zh: 她趁孩子们不在时收拾了他们的房间。

examples.en: We took full advantage of the hotel facilities.
examples.zh: 我们充分享用了旅馆设施。

examples.en: I took complete advantage of the situation.
examples.zh: 我充分利用了当时的形势。

senses.def: to make use of somebody/something in a way that is unfair or dishonest

examples.en: He took advantage of my generosity (= for example, by taking more than I had intended to give).
examples.zh: 他利用我的慷慨占了便宜。

senses.def: to direct your criticism at somebody/something
senses.zh: 把目标对准某人（或某事物）；把批评的矛头指向某人（或某事物）

take as it comes: @@@LINK=take something as it comes | take somebody as they come
take as they come: @@@LINK=take something as it comes | take somebody as they come

senses.def: to check who is present and who is not present at a place and to mark this information on a list of names

examples.en: Mrs Sakamoto had finished taking attendance.
examples.zh: 阪本夫人已经点完名了。

senses.def: used when saying goodbye

examples.en: Bye! Take care!
examples.zh: 再见！多保重！

senses.def: to be careful

examples.en: Take care (that) you don't spill any of it!
examples.zh: 小心不要洒出任何东西！

examples.en: Care should be taken to close the lid securely.
examples.zh: 盖子应小心扣紧。

senses.def: to care for somebody/something/yourself; to be careful about something

examples.en: Who's taking care of the children while you're away?
examples.zh: 你外出时谁来照料孩子？

examples.en: She takes great care of her clothes.
examples.zh: 她非常爱惜自己的衣服。

examples.en: He's old enough to take care of himself.
examples.zh: 他已经不小了，能照顾自己了。

examples.en: You should take better care of yourself.
examples.zh: 你应该更加保重自己。

senses.def: to be responsible for or to deal with a situation or task

examples.en: Don't worry about the travel arrangements. They're all being taken care of.
examples.zh: 别担心旅行安排，一切都会有人照管的。

examples.en: Celia takes care of the marketing side of things.
examples.zh: 西莉亚负责产品营销方面的事宜。

senses.def: to understand or consider something; to take notice of something
senses.zh: 获知；察知；考虑到；注意到

examples.en: In the light of the new evidence that the court can now take cognizance of, the case is dropped.
examples.zh: 鉴于法院现已掌握的新证据，此案被撤销。

senses.def: to begin to feel happier and more confident because of something
to start to produce the results that are intended

examples.en: The aspirins soon take effect.
examples.zh: 阿司匹林很快见效。

examples.en: The medicine started to take effect after a few minutes.
examples.zh: 几分钟后药物开始见效。

senses.def: to come into use; to begin to apply

examples.en: The new law takes effect from tomorrow.
examples.zh: 新法律明日起生效。

senses.def: to act in order to avoid danger or an unpleasant situation
senses.zh: 采取回避行动（以避免危险或不愉快的处境）

examples.en: The pilot had to take evasive action to avoid a mid-air collision.
examples.zh: 飞行员不得不采取规避行动以避免空中相撞。

senses.def: to object strongly to something; to be angry about something

examples.en: I take great exception to the fact that you told my wife before you told me.
examples.zh: 你还没告诉我就先对我妻子讲了，为此我非常生气。

examples.en: No one could possibly take exception to his comments.
examples.zh: 任何人都不可能对他的意见提出异议。

senses.def: to run away

examples.en: The gang took flight when they heard the police car.
examples.zh: 这伙歹徒听见警车声就逃走了。

examples.en: As soon as they detected the cheetah it took flight.
examples.zh: 他们一发现猎豹，它就逃走了。

senses.def: to gradually form into a particular shape; to gradually develop

examples.en: In her body a new life was taking form.
examples.zh: 一个新的生命在她的体内逐渐形成。

senses.def: to leave work without asking permission first
to be frightened by something

examples.en: The birds took fright and flew off.
examples.zh: 鸟受惊飞走了。

examples.en: Investors took fright at the falling market.
examples.zh: 投资者看到股市下跌，纷纷出逃。

take great pains to do sth: @@@LINK=take (great) pains (to do something) | go to great pains (to do something)

senses.def: to feel more positive about something, especially when you thought that you had no chance of achieving something
senses.zh: （由于某事）增强信心；重新振作起来

examples.en: The government can take heart from the latest opinion polls.
examples.zh: 政府可以从最近的民意测验中找回信心。

senses.def: to start disagreeing or arguing with somebody about something
senses.zh: 向某人提出异议；开始与某人争论

examples.en: I must take issue with you on that point.
examples.zh: 我必须就那一点向你提出异议。

senses.def: to suppose; to assume

examples.en: I take it you won't be coming to the party?
examples.zh: 我想你不会来参加聚会吧？

senses.def: used to tell somebody not to be worried or angry

examples.en: Take it easy! Don't panic.
examples.zh: 沉住气！不要惊慌。

senses.def: to believe something is true without first making sure that it is

examples.en: I just took it for granted that he'd always be around.
examples.zh: 我还想当然地以为他总能随叫随到呢。

examples.en: She seemed to take it for granted that I would go with her to New York.
examples.zh: 她似乎理所当然地认为我会和她一起去纽约。

senses.def: used to emphasize that what you are going to say is the truth
senses.zh: 我敢担保；我说的肯定没错

examples.en: Take it from me—he'll be a millionaire before he's 30.
examples.zh: 不信你等着瞧，他到不了 30 岁就会成为百万富翁。

senses.def: to suddenly start thinking something, especially something that other people think is stupid
senses.zh: 突发奇想；突然开始想某事

take it upon yourself to do something: @@@LINK=take it on/upon yourself to do something

senses.def: to make somebody physically or mentally tired
senses.zh: 使精疲力竭；使心力交瘁

examples.en: Looking after small children really takes it out of you.
examples.zh: 照看小孩确实会使你精疲力竭。

take it/a lot out of somebody.word: take it/a lot out of somebody

senses.def: to accept something without discussing it
senses.zh: 直接认定为；不经讨论即认可

examples.en: Can we take it as read that you want the job?
examples.zh: 我们能不能认为你想要这份工作？

senses.def: to relax and avoid working too hard or doing too much

examples.en: The doctor told me to take it easy for a few weeks.
examples.zh: 医生叫我休息几周。

examples.en: I like to take things easy when I’m on holiday.
examples.zh: 我在假日愿意轻松一些。

senses.def: to not think about what will happen in the future
senses.zh: 得过且过；做一天和尚撞一天钟；过一天算一天

examples.en: The webmaster will decide whether to take down the web page or make the required changes.
examples.zh: 网站管理员将决定是拿掉网页还是按要求改动。

senses.def: the amount of money that you earn after you have paid tax, etc.
senses.zh: （扣除税项等之后的）实得工资

senses.def: to allow somebody to stay in your home

examples.en: to take in lodgers
examples.zh: 收房客

examples.en: He was homeless, so we took him in.
examples.zh: 他无家可归，我们便收留了他。

senses.def: to take somebody to a police station in order to ask them questions

examples.en: Police have taken a man in for questioning following the attacks.
examples.zh: 袭击发生后警察抓了一个男人到警局盘问。

senses.def: to make somebody believe something that is not true

examples.en: She took me in completely with her story.
examples.zh: 她用谎话把我完全蒙蔽了。

examples.en: Don't be taken in by his charm—he's ruthless.
examples.zh: 不要被他那迷人的风度所蒙蔽，其实他冷酷无情。

senses.def: to absorb

examples.en: Fish take in oxygen through their gills.
examples.zh: 鱼用鳃吸取氧气。

senses.def: to make a piece of clothing narrower or tighter

examples.en: This dress needs to be taken in at the waist.
examples.zh: 这件连衣裙的腰身需要改瘦。

senses.def: to include or cover something

examples.en: The tour takes in six European capitals.
examples.zh: 这次旅游包括六个欧洲国家的首都。

examples.en: Her lecture took in all the recent developments in the subject.
examples.zh: 她的讲座将该学科的新发展全部包罗在内。

senses.def: to go to see or visit something such as a film

examples.en: I generally take in a show when I'm in New York.
examples.zh: 我每次去纽约通常总会看一场演出。

senses.def: to take notice of something with your eyes

examples.en: He took in every detail of her appearance.
examples.zh: 他仔仔细细打量了她一番。

examples.en: She took in the scene at a glance.
examples.zh: 她看了一眼就完全明白了这个场景。

senses.def: to understand or remember something that you hear or read

examples.en: Halfway through the chapter I realized I hadn't taken anything in.
examples.zh: 这一章我读到一半才意识到我根本没有看懂。

senses.def: to behave in an unpleasant way towards somebody because you feel angry, disappointed, etc., although it is not their fault

examples.en: OK, so you had a bad day. Don't take it out on me.
examples.zh: 好，这么说你今天遇上了很多倒霉事。可也别拿我当出气筒。

examples.en: She tended to take her frustrations out on her family.
examples.zh: 她心里不痛快总是在家里人身上发泄。

senses.def: to leave the ground and begin to fly

examples.en: The plane took off an hour late.
examples.zh: 飞机起飞晚了一个小时。

senses.def: to leave a place, especially in a hurry

examples.en: When he saw me coming he took off in the opposite direction.
examples.zh: 他见我走过来便赶快转身走了。

senses.def: to become successful or popular very quickly or suddenly
senses.zh: 突然大受欢迎；迅速流行

examples.en: The new magazine has really taken off.
examples.zh: 这份新杂志真是大受欢迎。

examples.en: Her singing career took off after her TV appearance.
examples.zh: 在她上了电视节目后，歌唱事业一飞冲天。

senses.def: to copy somebody’s voice, actions or manner in a humorous way
senses.zh: （以诙谐的方式）模仿，学某人的样子

senses.def: to make somebody stop playing, acting, etc. and leave the field or the stage

examples.en: He was taken off after twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 二十分钟后，他被替换下场。

senses.def: to remove something, especially a piece of clothing from your/somebody’s body

examples.en: to take off your coat
examples.zh: 脱掉大衣

examples.en: He took off my wet boots and made me sit by the fire.
examples.zh: 他脱掉我湿漉漉的靴子，让我在火炉旁坐下。

senses.def: to have a period of time as a break from work

examples.en: I've decided to take a few days off next week.
examples.zh: 我已决定下星期休息几天。

senses.def: to stop a public service, television programme, performances of a show, etc.

examples.en: The show was taken off because of poor audience figures.
examples.zh: 该剧目因不卖座而停演了。

senses.def: to remove some of somebody’s hair, part of somebody’s body, etc.
senses.zh: 剪掉（头发）；截去，切除（人体部位）

examples.en: The hairdresser asked me how much she should take off.
examples.zh: 理发师问我头发剪多少。

examples.en: The explosion nearly took his arm off.
examples.zh: 他的胳膊差点儿被炸掉。

senses.def: to leave a place; to make somebody leave a place
to remove somebody from something such as a job, position, piece of equipment, etc.
senses.zh: 调离，解除（工作、职务等）；撤掉，拆除（器械）

examples.en: The officer leading the investigation has been taken off the case.
examples.zh: 主持调查此案的警员已被撤下。

examples.en: After three days she was taken off the ventilator.
examples.zh: 三天之后给她摘掉了呼吸器。

senses.def: to remove an amount of money or a number of marks, points, etc. in order to reduce the total

examples.en: The manager took $10 off the bill.
examples.zh: 经理把账单上的金额减了 10 美元。

examples.en: That experience took ten years off my life (= made me feel ten years older).
examples.zh: 那段经历使我老了十岁。

senses.def: the moment at which an aircraft leaves the ground and starts to fly

examples.en: The plane is ready for take-off.
examples.zh: 飞机准备随时起飞。

examples.en: take-off speed
examples.zh: 起飞速度

examples.en: Owing to the fog, there were no take-offs from the airport yesterday.
examples.zh: 由于大雾，昨天机场没有航班起飞。

examples.en: The local economy is poised for take-off.
examples.zh: 当地的经济蓄势待发。

senses.def: the moment when your feet leave the ground when you jump
if you do a take-off
to begin to have a particular quality, appearance, etc.

examples.en: The chameleon can take on the colours of its background.
examples.zh: 变色龙可以变成周围环境的颜色。

examples.en: His voice took on a more serious tone.
examples.zh: 他说话的语气变得严肃起来。

senses.def: to employ somebody

examples.en: to take on new staff
examples.zh: 雇用新员工

examples.en: She was taken on as a trainee.
examples.zh: 她受聘当实习生。

senses.def: to play against somebody in a game or contest; to fight against somebody
senses.zh: （运动或比赛）同某人较量；反抗；与某人战斗

examples.en: to take somebody on at tennis
examples.zh: 与某人比赛打网球

examples.en: The rebels took on the entire Roman army.
examples.zh: 反叛者与整个罗马军队战斗。

senses.def: to decide to do something; to agree to be responsible for something/somebody
senses.zh: 决定做；同意负责；承担（责任）

examples.en: I can't take on any extra work.
examples.zh: 我不能承担任何额外工作。

examples.en: We're not taking on any new clients at present.
examples.zh: 目前我们不接收新客户。

senses.def: to allow somebody/something to enter

examples.en: The bus stopped to take on more passengers.
examples.zh: 公共汽车停下让其他乘客上车。

examples.en: The ship took on more fuel at Freetown.
examples.zh: 轮船在弗里敦停靠加燃料。

senses.def: to go to a restaurant, theatre, club, etc. with somebody you have invited
senses.zh: 带某人出去（到餐馆、剧院、俱乐部等）

senses.def: to kill somebody or destroy something

examples.en: They took out two enemy bombers.
examples.zh: 他们摧毁了敌人的两架轰炸机。

senses.def: to remove something from inside somebody’s body, especially a part of it
senses.zh: 切除，摘除（尤指人体内的一部分）

examples.en: How many teeth did the dentist take out?
examples.zh: 牙科医生拔了几颗牙？

senses.def: to obtain an official document or service
senses.zh: 获得，领到（正式文件或服务）

examples.en: to take out an insurance policy/a mortgage/a loan
examples.zh: 买了一份保险；得到按揭贷款；获得贷款

examples.en: to take out an ad in a newspaper
examples.zh: 在报纸上刊登广告

senses.def: to buy cooked food at a restaurant and carry it away to eat, for example at home
senses.zh: （从餐馆买饭菜等）带回食用；买外卖食物

senses.def: to start legal action against somebody by means of an official document

examples.en: The police have taken out a summons against the driver of the car.
examples.zh: 警方已向这辆汽车的驾驶人发出传票。

senses.def: to obtain money by removing it from your bank account
to remove an amount of money from a larger amount, especially as a payment

examples.en: The fine will be taken out of your wages.
examples.zh: 罚款将从你的工资中扣除。

senses.def: to make somebody forget their worries and become less concerned with their own thoughts and situation
senses.zh: 使摆脱苦恼；为某人消愁

senses.def: to become bigger or more important than something else; to replace something

examples.en: Try not to let negative thoughts take over.
examples.zh: 尽量别受消极的想法左右。

examples.en: It has been suggested that mammals took over from dinosaurs 65 million years ago.
examples.zh: 有人提出哺乳动物是在 6 500 万年前取代恐龙的。

examples.en: In your teens, peer-group friendships may take over from parents as the major influence on you.
examples.zh: 在你十几岁的时候，同龄人的友谊可能会取代父母成为对你的主要影响。

senses.def: to begin to have control of or responsibility for something, especially in place of somebody else

examples.en: Paul's daughter took over the job in 2017.
examples.zh: 保罗的女儿于 2017 年接手这一工作。

examples.en: Gerald Ford took over the presidency after Nixon resigned.
examples.zh: 尼克松辞职后，杰拉尔德·福特接任总统职务。

senses.def: to gain control of a political party, a country, etc.

examples.en: The army is threatening to take over if civil unrest continues.
examples.zh: 军方扬言如果内乱继续就实行军管。

senses.def: to gain control of a business, a company, etc., especially by buying shares
senses.zh: 接收，接管（企业、公司等，尤指通过购买股份）

examples.en: CBS Records was taken over by Sony.
examples.zh: 哥伦比亚广播公司的唱片公司已被索尼公司收购。

senses.def: Fifth Amendment
to help somebody learn or become familiar with something, for example by talking about each part in turn
senses.zh: 帮助某人深入了解；给某人解说

examples.en: The director took us through the play scene by scene.
examples.zh: 导演一幕一幕地给我们说戏。

examples.en: I still don’t understand the contract. Can you take me through it again?
examples.zh: 我还是没看懂合同。你能带我再经历一遍吗？

senses.def: to go away to a place, especially to escape from danger

examples.en: The rebels took to the hills.
examples.zh: 反叛者躲进山里。

senses.def: to begin to do something as a habit

examples.en: I've taken to waking up very early.
examples.zh: 我已形成习惯，醒得很早。

senses.def: to develop an ability for something

examples.en: She took to tennis as if she'd been playing all her life.
examples.zh: 她网球打得很好，好像一生都在从事这项运动似的。

senses.def: to start liking somebody/something

examples.en: I took to my new boss immediately.
examples.zh: 我立刻对新老板产生了好感。

examples.en: He hasn't taken to his new school.
examples.zh: 他对新学校还没有产生兴趣。

senses.def: to continue, especially starting after somebody/something else has finished

examples.en: The band's new album takes up where their last one left off.
examples.zh: 这个乐队的新唱片集是接上一集的乐曲录制的。

senses.def: to fill or use an amount of space or time

examples.en: The table takes up too much room.
examples.zh: 这张桌子太占地方。

examples.en: I won't take up any more of your time.
examples.zh: 我不再占用你的时间了。

examples.en: Her time is fully taken up with writing.
examples.zh: 她的时间都被写作占据了。

senses.def: to learn or start to do something, especially for pleasure

examples.en: They've taken up golf.
examples.zh: 他们学起打高尔夫球来了。

examples.en: She has taken up (= started to learn to play) the oboe.
examples.zh: 她学起吹双簧管来了。

senses.def: to start or begin something such as a job

examples.en: He takes up his duties next week.
examples.zh: 他下周就要开始履行职责。

senses.def: to join in singing or saying something

examples.en: to take up the chorus
examples.zh: 加入合唱

examples.en: Their protests were later taken up by other groups.
examples.zh: 其他团体后来也加入了他们抗议的行列。

senses.def: to continue something that somebody else has not finished, or that has not been mentioned for some time
senses.zh: 继续（他人未完成的事）；接着讲（以前提过的事）

examples.en: She took up the story where Tim had left off.
examples.zh: 她接着讲蒂姆未讲完的故事。

examples.en: I'd like to take up the point you raised earlier.
examples.zh: 我想继续谈一谈你早些时候提出的问题。

senses.def: to move into a particular position

examples.en: I took up my position by the door.
examples.zh: 我把住了门口。

senses.def: to accept something that is offered or available
senses.zh: 接受（建议或能得到的东西）

examples.en: to take up a challenge
examples.zh: 接受挑战

examples.en: She took up his offer of a drink.
examples.zh: 他请她喝一杯，她接受了。

senses.def: to make something such as a piece of clothing shorter

examples.en: This skirt needs taking up.
examples.zh: 这条裙子需要改短。

senses.def: the rate at which people accept something that is offered or made available to them

examples.en: a low take-up of government benefits
examples.zh: 政府救济金的低领取率

examples.en: The take-up of foreign language courses has been disappointing.
examples.zh: 外语课程的使用情况令人失望。

examples.en: The take-up rate rose to 80%.
examples.zh: 吸纳率上升至80%。

senses.def: to question somebody about something, because you do not agree with them

examples.en: I must take you up on that point.
examples.zh: 那个问题我一定要找你问个明白。

examples.en: I’d like to take you up on what you said earlier.
examples.zh: 我想谈谈你之前所说的。

senses.def: to accept an offer, a bet, etc. from somebody

examples.en: Thanks for the invitation—we'll take you up on it some time.
examples.zh: 谢谢你的盛情邀请，改日我们一定奉陪。

senses.def: to begin to be friendly with somebody, especially somebody with a bad reputation
senses.zh: 开始结交（尤指名声不好的人）

senses.def: to speak or write to somebody about something that they may be able to deal with or help you with

examples.en: They decided to take the matter up with their MP.
examples.zh: 他们决定向本地区的下院议员反映这一问题。

take/blow the lid off something: @@@LINK=lift the lid on something | take/blow the lid off something

senses.def: to speak to somebody in private, especially in order to warn or tell them about something
senses.zh: 把某人拉到一边（悄悄说话）

senses.def: to choose something that involves some risk

examples.en: Our first impressions aren't great, but I'm willing to take a punt on it.
examples.zh: 我们的第一印象不太好，但我愿意赌一把。

examples.en: Adventurous new investors might want to have a punt.
examples.zh: 有冒险精神的新投资者可能会想冒险一试。

senses.def: to try to do something

examples.en: He took a punt at explaining why he'd done it.
examples.zh: 他试图解释他这么做的原因。

senses.def: to make use of the right to refuse to answer questions in court about a crime, because you may give information which will make it seem that you are guilty
senses.zh: （在法庭上）拒绝回答，避而不答

senses.def: a restaurant that cooks and sells food that you take away and eat somewhere else

examples.en: We can get something to eat from the Chinese takeaway.
examples.zh: 我们可以从中国外卖店买点东西吃。

senses.def: a meal that you buy at this type of restaurant

examples.en: Let's have a takeaway tonight.
examples.zh: 咱们今晚吃一顿外卖的饭菜吧。

senses.def: an important fact, point or idea to be remembered from a talk, meeting or event
senses.zh: （从会议或讨论中得到的）想法收获，心得体会

examples.en: The key takeaways from the presentation are: 1. …
examples.zh: 演讲的主要要点是： 1. ...

senses.def: a move in which a wrestler
an act of strongly criticizing somebody/something

examples.en: The lyrics of the song are a rare takedown of an A-list celebrity.
examples.zh: 这首歌的歌词罕见地批评了一名一线名人。

examples.en: Did you read her scathing takedown of modern dating culture?
examples.zh: 你读了她对现代约会文化的严厉抨击吗？

senses.def: the act of removing a website, web page or file from the internet, usually in response to a formal request
senses.zh: （通常应正式要求）关闭网站，删除网页，下架文件

examples.en: The social media giant receives around two million takedown notices daily.
examples.zh: 该社交媒体巨头每天收到大约两百万条删除通知。

examples.en: The artist's estate is assiduous in submitting takedown requests for copyright violations.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家的遗产管理方不遗余力地就侵犯版权行为提交删除要求。

senses.def: an arrest or unexpected visit by the police
a restaurant that cooks and sells food that you take away and eat somewhere else
a meal that you buy at this type of restaurant

examples.en: Let's have a takeout tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚我们吃外卖吧。

senses.def: an act of taking control of a company by buying most of its shares

examples.en: a takeover bid for the company
examples.zh: 收购这家公司的出价

senses.def: an act of taking control of a country, an area or a political organization by force
senses.zh: （对国家、地区、政治组织等的）强行接管，控制

examples.en: attempts to prevent the takeover of the Republic by the military
examples.zh: 试图阻止军队接管共和国

senses.def: a person who is willing to accept something that is being offered

examples.en: They won't find many takers for the house at that price.
examples.zh: 以这样的要价，他们不会为房子找到多少承让人的。

examples.en: Are there any takers for my home-made ice cream?
examples.zh: 有人要吃我自制的冰淇淋吗？

senses.def: a person who takes something

examples.en: drug takers
examples.zh: 吸毒者

examples.en: It is better to be a giver than a taker.
examples.zh: 施比受有福。

senses.def: the amount of money that a shop, theatre, etc. receives from selling goods or tickets over a particular period of time

examples.en: The box office takings are up on last week.
examples.zh: 票房收入较上星期有所增长。

senses.def: a shoe with a rubber sole
a tyre on a car, etc.
a lake
a traditional pattern of rhythm in classical Indian music
senses.zh: 塔拉（古印度音乐的传统节拍组合）

senses.def: a fine soft powder, usually with a pleasant smell, that you put on your skin to make it feel smooth and dry
a story created using the imagination, especially one that is full of action and adventure
senses.zh: （尤指充满惊险的）故事；历险记

examples.en: a coming-of-age/morality tale
examples.zh: 成长/道德故事

examples.en: The story is a classic tale of love and betrayal.
examples.zh: 这是一则爱与背叛的经典故事。

examples.en: Dickens’ ‘A Tale of Two Cities’
examples.zh: 狄更斯的《双城记》

examples.en: His latest book is a delightful children’s tale about talking animals.
examples.zh: 他的最新书是一个关于会说话的动物的令人愉快的儿童故事。

senses.def: an exciting spoken description of an event, which may not be completely true
senses.zh: （精彩但不一定完全真实的）讲述，叙述

examples.en: I love listening to his tales of life at sea.
examples.zh: 我喜欢听他讲述他的海上生活。

examples.en: I've heard tales of people seeing ghosts in that house.
examples.zh: 我听说有人在那栋房子里见到过鬼。

examples.en: She regaled us with tales of her wild youth.
examples.zh: 她讲述她青年时的荒唐事，逗我们开心。

examples.en: The team's tale of woe continued on Saturday (= they lost another match).
examples.zh: 上星期六这支队又遭败绩。

examples.en: Her experiences provide a cautionary tale (= a warning) for us all.
examples.zh: 她的经历成了我们大家的前车之鉴。

senses.def: to survive a difficult or dangerous experience so that you can tell others what really happened
senses.zh: 幸免于难之后向人讲述真实经历

senses.def: an old idea or belief that people now know is not correct
senses.zh: 无稽之谈；不科学的陈腐观念

senses.def: to give some information that is different from what you expect or have been told
senses.zh: 说的情况迥然不同；讲出来的是另一回事

examples.en: These drugs are widely believed to be effective medications. The data, however, tell a different story.
examples.zh: 这些药物被广泛认为是有效的药物。然而，数据却讲述了一个不同的故事。

senses.def: to explain itself, without needing any further explanation or comment
senses.zh: 不言而喻；不释自明；无须解释

examples.en: Her face told its own story.
examples.zh: 看她的面部表情，就什么都明白了。

senses.def: to tell somebody about something that another person has done wrong

items.idm: live, etc. to tell the tale

senses.def: to survive a difficult or dangerous experience so that you can tell others what really happened
senses.zh: 幸免于难之后向人讲述真实经历

senses.def: an old idea or belief that people now know is not correct
senses.zh: 无稽之谈；不科学的陈腐观念

senses.def: to give some information that is different from what you expect or have been told
senses.zh: 说的情况迥然不同；讲出来的是另一回事

examples.en: These drugs are widely believed to be effective medications. The data, however, tell a different story.
examples.zh: 这些药物被广泛认为是有效的药物。然而，数据却讲述了一个不同的故事。

senses.def: to explain itself, without needing any further explanation or comment
senses.zh: 不言而喻；不释自明；无须解释

examples.en: Her face told its own story.
examples.zh: 看她的面部表情，就什么都明白了。

senses.def: to tell somebody about something that another person has done wrong
a natural ability to do something well

examples.en: The festival showcases the talent of young musicians.
examples.zh: 会演展示了年轻音乐家们的才华。

examples.en: to possess/have exceptional musical talent
examples.zh: 有杰出的音乐天赋

examples.en: The team is known for nurturing raw talent.
examples.zh: 该团队以培养人才而闻名。

examples.en: a man of many talents
examples.zh: 多才多艺的男子

examples.en: She displayed her talent for comedy at the event.
examples.zh: 她在活动中展现了自己的喜剧才华。

examples.en: She showed considerable talent for getting what she wanted.
examples.zh: 她很有天资，能够达成自己的目标。

examples.en: a talent contest/competition (= in which people perform, to show how well they can sing, dance, etc.)
examples.zh: 才艺选拔赛

senses.def: people or a person with a natural ability to do something well

examples.en: to nurture/develop young talent
examples.zh: 培养青年人才

examples.en: We are losing our top talent to other countries who pay more.
examples.zh: 我们的顶尖人才正在流失，去往报酬更丰厚的国家。

examples.en: He is a great talent.
examples.zh: 他是个了不起的人才。

senses.def: people who are sexually attractive

examples.en: He likes to spend his time chatting up the local talent.
examples.zh: 他喜欢把时间花在和当地的妞儿搭讪上。

senses.def: a person whose job is to find people who are good at singing, acting, sport, etc. in order to give them work
senses.zh: （歌唱、戏剧、体育运动等的）人才发掘者，新秀发现者，星探

senses.def: a show or event, for example on television or in a school, in which people compete to show how well they can sing, dance, play a musical instrument, entertain by telling funny jokes or stories, etc.
senses.zh: 才艺表演；达人秀；选秀节目

examples.en: She became a child star after winning a TV talent show for six weeks in a row.
examples.zh: 她在连续六周赢得电视选秀节目后成为一名童星。

senses.def: having a natural ability to do something well
senses.zh: 有才能的；天才的；有才干的

examples.en: a talented player/musician/artist
examples.zh: 天才运动员／音乐家／艺术家

examples.en: Some of these young musicians are incredibly talented.
examples.zh: 其中一些年轻音乐家非常有才华。

senses.def: an object that is thought to have magic powers and to bring good luck
to say things; to speak in order to give information or to express ideas or feelings

examples.en: Stop talking and listen!
examples.zh: 别说话，注意听！

examples.en: We talked on the phone for over an hour.
examples.zh: 我们在电话里谈了一个多小时。

examples.en: Who were you talking to just now?
examples.zh: 你刚才在跟谁说话？

examples.en: Ann and Joe aren't talking to each other right now (= they refuse to speak to each other because they have argued).
examples.zh: 安和乔两人现在互不理睬。

examples.en: Watch the scene where Don talks to himself in the mirror while shaving.
examples.zh: 观看唐刮胡子时对着镜子自言自语的场景。

examples.en: We looked around the school and talked with the principal.
examples.zh: 我们参观了那所学校，并跟校长进行了交谈。

examples.en: They talk a lot about the inspiration for their music.
examples.zh: 他们大谈他们音乐的灵感。

examples.en: When they get together, all they talk about is football.
examples.zh: 他们在一起时，谈论的都是足球。

examples.en: What are you talking about? (= used when you are surprised, annoyed and/or worried by something that somebody has just said)
examples.zh: 你在胡说什么？（对他人所言感到惊奇、不悦或担忧时用）

examples.en: I don't know what you're talking about (= used to say that you did not do something that somebody has accused you of).
examples.zh: 我不知道你在说什么（表示自己没有做对方指责的事）。

examples.en: to talk openly/freely/publicly about something
examples.zh: 公开/自由/公开谈论某事

examples.en: She started talking loudly to her friends about the film they'd just seen.
examples.zh: 她大声对朋友们谈起他们刚看的电影。

examples.en: Mary is talking of looking for another job.
examples.zh: 玛丽说起要另找一份工作。

examples.en: We often talked of the war.
examples.zh: 我们经常谈论这场战争。

examples.en: We talked ourselves hoarse, catching up on all the news.
examples.zh: 我们互诉近况，把嗓子都说哑了。

senses.group: speak to somebody 与人说话

senses.def: to discuss something, usually something serious or important
senses.zh: 讨论，谈论，商谈，洽谈（通常指重大的事）

examples.en: This situation can't go on. We need to talk.
examples.zh: 这种情况不能再继续下去了。我们需要谈一谈。

examples.en: The two sides in the dispute are finally willing to talk.
examples.zh: 争执双方最终愿意商谈。

examples.en: Talk with your doctor before radically changing your diet.
examples.zh: 彻底改变饮食之前先跟你的医生谈谈。

examples.en: Is there anything you'd like to talk about?
examples.zh: 您有什么想谈的吗？

examples.en: We want to talk to people about this issue.
examples.zh: 我们想就这一问题跟人们谈一谈。

examples.en: to talk politics
examples.zh: 谈论政治

senses.def: to say words in a language

examples.en: The baby is just starting to talk.
examples.zh: 这婴儿刚开始咿呀学语。

examples.en: Alex can't talk yet—he's only just one year old.
examples.zh: 亚历克斯还不会说话－他才一岁大。

examples.en: We couldn't understand them because they were talking in Chinese.
examples.zh: 我们听不懂他们在讲些什么，因为他们说的是中国话。

examples.en: Are they talking Swedish or Danish?
examples.zh: 他们说的是瑞典语还是丹麦语？

senses.def: to say things that are/are not sensible

examples.en: She talks a lot of sense.
examples.zh: 她讲得很在理。

examples.en: You're talking rubbish!
examples.zh: 你胡说八道！

examples.en: See if you can talk some sense into him (= persuade him to be sensible).
examples.zh: 看你能否给他讲通道理。

senses.def: used to emphasize an amount of money, how serious something is, etc.
senses.zh: （用以强调款额、情况严重程度等）讲的是，指的是

examples.en: We're talking £500 for three hours' work.
examples.zh: 咱们讲的可是工作三个小时酬金 500 英镑。

examples.en: Do you know what this will cost? We’re talking megabucks here.
examples.zh: 你知道这会花费多少钱吗？我们在这里谈论的是巨额资金。

senses.def: to talk about a person’s private life
senses.zh: 说闲话；讲人坏话；嚼舌头

examples.en: Don't phone me at work—people will talk.
examples.zh: 别在上班时给我打电话，人家会说闲话的。

senses.def: to give information to somebody, especially unwillingly

examples.en: The police questioned him but he refused to talk.
examples.zh: 警察审问他，但他拒不招供。

senses.def: to try and persuade somebody to stop behaving in a stupid way, sometimes using rough or violent methods
senses.zh: 开导某人别干傻事；强使某人理智行事

examples.en: Try and talk some sense into her before she makes the wrong decision.
examples.zh: 尽力说服她，别让她作出错误的决策。

examples.en: Where would I be without you to knock some sense into my head?
examples.zh: 如果没有你给我灌输一些理智，我会在哪里？

senses.def: to have knowledge about something from your own experience
senses.zh: 亲身经历过；作经验之谈

examples.en: I worked there for 20 years, so I know what I'm talking about.
examples.zh: 我在那里工作了 20 年，所以我知道我在说什么。

senses.def: used to tell somebody that they should not criticize somebody else for something because they do the same things too
senses.zh: （用以表示自己同样不对时不要批评别人）还有脸说别人

examples.en: ‘George is so careless with money.’ ‘Look who's talking!’
examples.zh: “乔治真是乱花钱。”“亏你还有脸说别人！”

senses.def: people who have a lot of money have more power and influence than others
senses.zh: 财大气就粗；有钱就有势

senses.def: used when you like what somebody has suggested very much
senses.zh: （表示赞同对方的话）你这算说对了，你所言正合我意

senses.def: people say speak/talk of the devil

examples.en: Well, speak of the devil—here's Alice now!
examples.zh: 嗬，说谁谁到——瞧，艾丽斯这就来啦！

senses.def: to say something that you should not because it is the wrong situation or because it offends somebody
senses.zh: 说话出格（或冒失、鲁莽、不合时宜）

senses.def: to be able to communicate easily with another person because you share similar opinions and experience
senses.zh: （因意见和经历相似）能容易地沟通，说得来，有共同语言

senses.def: used to emphasize something
senses.zh: （用以强调）这才叫，真是…不得了

examples.en: Talk about mean! She didn't even buy me a card.
examples.zh: 这才叫吝啬呢！她连张贺卡都没给我买。

senses.def: to talk to somebody about sex in order to make them sexually excited
to talk in a way that sounds convincing, but may not be sincere
senses.zh: 说得好听；说得天花乱坠

examples.en: The senior managers talk a good game about customer relations, but really they don't care about the customer.
examples.zh: 高级管理人员说起客户关系头头是道，但实际上他们不在乎客户。

senses.def: to talk too much, especially about things that are boring or not important
senses.zh: 唠叨个没完没了；喋喋不休

senses.def: used when you are going to say more about a subject that has already been mentioned
senses.zh: （继续谈论时用）提起，说起，谈及，至于

examples.en: Talking of Sue, I met her new boyfriend last week.
examples.zh: 谈到休，上星期我遇到了她的新男友。

senses.def: people say talk/speak of the devil

examples.en: Well, talk of the devil—here's Alice now!
examples.zh: 好吧，谈谈魔鬼——现在爱丽丝来了！

senses.def: to talk about your work with the people you work with, especially when you are also with other people who are not connected with or interested in it
senses.zh: 说行话；三句话不离本行（尤指当着外行的面）

examples.en: Whenever we meet up with Clive and Sue they always end up talking shop.
examples.zh: 每当我们见到克莱夫和苏时，他们总是会聊一些正经事。

senses.def: to be able to talk in a confident way that makes people think you are good at what you do

examples.en: You can talk the talk, but can you walk the walk? (= can you act in a way that matches your words?)
examples.zh: 你说得头头是道，可你能做到吗？

senses.def: to say silly things while you are talking about a subject you do not understand
to tell people very strongly what you want
to talk about something seriously
senses.zh: 郑重其事地谈；严肃认真地谈

senses.def: to make excuses and give reasons for not doing something; to manage to get yourself out of a difficult situation
senses.zh: 靠能言善辩开脱；以话解围

examples.en: I managed to talk my way out of having to give a speech.
examples.zh: 我好说歹说总算逃脱了发言的差事。

senses.def: used to tell somebody that they should not criticize somebody else for something because they do the same things too
senses.zh: （用以表示自己同样不对时不要批评别人）还有脸说别人

senses.def: used to tell somebody that they should not criticize somebody else for something because they do the same things too
senses.zh: （用以表示自己同样不对时不要批评别人）还有脸说别人

senses.def: a speech or lecture on a particular subject

examples.en: I went to several interesting talks at the conference.
examples.zh: 会议期间我听了几场有意思的演讲。

examples.en: She gave a talk on her visit to China.
examples.zh: 她作了一次访华报告。

examples.en: I heard a talk about the history of printing.
examples.zh: 我听到有人谈论印刷术的历史。

senses.def: a conversation or discussion

examples.en: She looked worried so we had a talk.
examples.zh: 她看上去很忧虑，所以我们谈了一下。

examples.en: We need to have a serious talk about money matters.
examples.zh: 我们需要认真讨论金钱问题。

examples.en: I had to have a heart-to-heart talk with her.
examples.zh: 我得推心置腹地和她谈一谈。

examples.en: I will have to have a little talk with that young lady (= talk to her about something she has done wrong).
examples.zh: 我得和那位年轻女士谈谈了。

examples.en: I had a long talk with my boss about my career prospects.
examples.zh: 我和老板就我的事业前景进行了一次长谈。

senses.def: formal discussions between governments or organizations
senses.zh: （政府或组织之间正式的）洽谈，会谈，谈判

examples.en: peace/trade talks
examples.zh: 和谈；贸易谈判

examples.en: to hold talks
examples.zh: 举行会谈

examples.en: to engage in/enter into talks
examples.zh: 参与/进入会谈

examples.en: to pull out of talks
examples.zh: 退出谈判

examples.en: The delegation arrived for talks with their government.
examples.zh: 代表团前来与他们的政府谈判。

examples.en: He is currently in talks with two football clubs.
examples.zh: 他目前在跟两家足球俱乐部谈。

examples.en: Talks between management and workers broke down over the issue of holiday pay.
examples.zh: 劳资双方就假日工资的谈判破裂了。

examples.en: Leaders will resume talks on the trade deal next month.
examples.zh: 各国领导人将在下个月重启关于贸易协定的谈判。

examples.en: Talks continue over the political future of the province.
examples.zh: 关于该省政治未来的谈判仍在继续。

examples.en: A further round of talks will be needed if the dispute is to be resolved.
examples.zh: 要解决纠纷，还需再举行一轮谈判。

examples.en: Union representatives walked out of emergency talks aimed at reaching a pay settlement.
examples.zh: 工会代表退出旨在达成薪资解决方案的紧急谈判。

senses.def: words that are spoken, but without the necessary facts or actions to support them

examples.en: It's just talk. He'd never carry out his threats.
examples.zh: 这只不过是说说而已。他绝不会把他的恫吓付诸行动。

examples.en: Don't pay any attention to her—she's all talk.
examples.zh: 别听她的，她光说空话。

senses.def: stories that suggest a particular thing might be true or might happen in the future
senses.zh: 传言；谣言；流言蜚语；揣测

examples.en: She dismissed the stories of her resignation as newspaper talk.
examples.zh: 她不理会有关她辞职的报道，认为那不过是报纸的谣言。

examples.en: There was talk in Washington of sending in troops.
examples.zh: 华盛顿有派兵的传言。

examples.en: There’s talk that he’s a difficult actor to work with.
examples.zh: 有人说他是一个很难合作的演员。

senses.def: a topic of conversation or a way of speaking

examples.en: business talk
examples.zh: 业务洽谈

examples.en: She said it was just girl talk that a man wouldn't understand.
examples.zh: 她说这是女生话题，男人是听不懂的。

examples.en: The book teaches you how to understand Spanish street talk (= slang).
examples.zh: 这本书教你如何理解西班牙俚语。

examples.en: It was tough talk, coming from a man who had begun the year in a hospital bed.
examples.zh: 这话出自年初住进医院的一位男子之口，语气很强硬。

senses.group: topic/way of speaking 话题；说话方式

senses.def: comments or remarks that show that you are ready to fight very hard for something

examples.en: What we want from the management is fighting talk.
examples.zh: 我们希望管理层发出战斗宣言。

senses.group: topic/way of speaking 话题；说话方式

senses.def: the person or thing that everyone is talking about in a particular place
senses.zh: （某地人人谈论的）话题，谈论中心

examples.en: Overnight, she became the talk of the town (= very famous).
examples.zh: 一夜之间，她成了街头巷尾谈论的话题。

senses.group: topic/way of speaking 话题；说话方式

intro.en: These words all mean to share news, information, ideas or feelings with another person or other people, especially by talking with them.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含交流、交谈之义。

items.def: to speak in order to give information, express feelings or share ideas:
items.zh: 指说话、讲话、谈话

examples.en: We talked on the phone for over an hour.
examples.zh: 我们在电话里谈了一个多小时。

items.def: (rather formal) to talk and share ideas on a subject or problem with other people, especially in order to decide something:
items.zh: 指谈论、讨论、商量

examples.en: Have you discussed the problem with anyone?
examples.zh: 你与谁商量过这个问题吗？

items.def: to talk to somebody about something; to have a conversation with somebody:
items.zh: 指谈话、交谈

examples.en: I’ve spoken to the manager about it.
examples.zh: 那件事我已经和经理谈过了。

items.def: (rather formal) to exchange information or ideas with somebody:
items.zh: 指与某人交流信息或意见

examples.en: We only communicate by email.
examples.zh: 我们只通过电子邮件进行交流。

items.def: to discuss something, especially formally, before making a decision or finding a solution:
items.zh: （尤指正式）讨论、辩论

examples.en: Politicians will be debating the bill later this week.
examples.zh: 政界将在本周晚些时候讨论这项议案。

items.def: (rather formal) to discuss something with somebody in order to get their permission for something, or to help you make a decision:
items.zh: 指（与某人）商议、商量（以得到许可或帮助决策）

examples.en: You shouldn’t have done it without consulting me.
examples.zh: 你不该不和我商量就做。

intro.en: These are all words for a talk given to an audience.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指讲话、发言。

items.def: a formal talk given to an audience:
items.zh: 指演说、讲话、发言

examples.en: Several people made speeches at the wedding.
examples.zh: 有几个人在婚礼上讲了话。

items.def: a talk given to a group of people to tell them about a particular subject, often as part of a university or college course:
items.zh: 通常指大学里的讲座、讲课、演讲

examples.en: a lecture on the Roman army
examples.zh: 关于罗马军队的讲座

items.def: a formal speech given to an audience:
items.zh: 指演说、演讲

examples.en: a televised presidential address
examples.zh: 总统的电视演讲

items.def: a fairly informal session in which somebody tells a group of people about a subject:
items.zh: 指相当不正式的报告、演讲

examples.en: She gave an interesting talk on her visit to China.
examples.zh: 她做了个关于她在中国访问的有趣报告。

items.def: a talk on a moral or religious subject, usually given by a religious leader during a service:
items.zh: 指布道、讲道

examples.en: to preach a sermon
examples.zh: 布道

synonyms.words: conversation ▪ dialogue ▪ talk ▪ debate ▪ consultation ▪ chat ▪ gossip

intro.en: These are all words for an occasion when people talk about something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示交谈、谈论。

items.def: a detailed conversation about something that is considered to be important:
items.zh: 指重要事情的讨论、谈论、商讨

examples.en: Discussions are still taking place between the two leaders.
examples.zh: 两位领导人仍在进行讨论。

items.def: a talk, usually a private or informal one, involving two people or a small group; the activity of talking in this way:
items.zh: 通常指私下的或非正式的交谈、谈话

examples.en: a telephone conversation
examples.zh: 电话交谈

items.def: conversations in a book, play or film:
items.zh: 指书、戏剧或电影中的对话、对白

examples.en: The novel has long descriptions and not much dialogue.
examples.zh: 这部小说描述多，对话少。

examples.en: The President told waiting reporters there had been a constructive dialogue.
examples.zh: 总统告诉等候的记者，刚才进行了一次富有建设性的对话。

items.def: a conversation or discussion, often one about a problem or something important for the people involved:
items.zh: 常指对有关人员就某个问题或重要的事情进行的交谈、谈话、讨论、商讨

examples.en: I had a long talk with my boss about my career prospects.
examples.zh: 我和老板就我的事业前景进行了一次长谈。

items.def: a formal discussion of an issue at a public meeting or in a parliament. In a debate two or more speakers express opposing views and then there is often a vote on the issue:
items.zh: 指公共集会上或议会里就某问题进行的、常以表决结束的辩论

examples.en: a debate on prison reform
examples.zh: 关于监狱制度改革的辩论

items.def: a formal discussion between groups of people before a decision is made about something:
items.zh: 指团体间在决策前进行的咨询、商讨、磋商

examples.en: There have been extensive consultations between the two countries.
examples.zh: 两国之间进行了广泛磋商。

items.def: a friendly informal conversation; informal talking. The countable use of chat is especially British English:
items.zh: chat 作可数名词尤用于英式英语

items.def: a conversation about other people and their private lives:
items.zh: 指关于他人及其私生活的闲谈、闲聊、说长道短

examples.en: We had a good gossip about the boss.
examples.zh: 我们讲了好一会儿老板的闲话。

senses.def: to talk in a way that sounds convincing, but may not be sincere
senses.zh: 说得好听；说得天花乱坠

examples.en: The senior managers talk a good game about customer relations, but really they don't care about the customer.
examples.zh: 高级管理人员说起客户关系头头是道，但实际上他们不在乎客户。

senses.def: used to emphasize something
senses.zh: （用以强调）这才叫，真是…不得了

examples.en: Talk about mean! She didn't even buy me a card.
examples.zh: 这才叫吝啬呢！她连张贺卡都没给我买。

senses.def: to talk to somebody about sex in order to make them sexually excited
to talk about your work with the people you work with, especially when you are also with other people who are not connected with or interested in it
senses.zh: 说行话；三句话不离本行（尤指当着外行的面）

examples.en: Whenever we meet up with Clive and Sue they always end up talking shop.
examples.zh: 每当我们见到克莱夫和苏时，他们总是会聊一些正经事。

senses.def: to talk too much, especially about things that are boring or not important
senses.zh: 唠叨个没完没了；喋喋不休

talk the hind legs off a donkey.word: talk the hind legs off a donkey

senses.def: to be able to talk in a confident way that makes people think you are good at what you do

examples.en: You can talk the talk, but can you walk the walk? (= can you act in a way that matches your words?)
examples.zh: 你说得头头是道，可你能做到吗？

senses.def: to say silly things while you are talking about a subject you do not understand
to tell people very strongly what you want
to talk about something seriously
senses.zh: 郑重其事地谈；严肃认真地谈

senses.def: to make excuses and give reasons for not doing something; to manage to get yourself out of a difficult situation
senses.zh: 靠能言善辩开脱；以话解围

examples.en: I managed to talk my way out of having to give a speech.
examples.zh: 我好说歹说总算逃脱了发言的差事。

talk your way out of sth doing sth: @@@LINK=talk your way out of something/of doing something
