senses.def: to talk, etc. without stopping

examples.en: She was chatting away, nineteen to the dozen.
examples.zh: 她没完没了地聊着。

talk, etc. nineteen to the dozen.word: talk, etc. nineteen to the dozen

senses.def: to talk about something in a general way without dealing with the most important parts of it
senses.zh: 拐弯抹角地说；不着边际地说

examples.en: We spent a whole hour talking around the problem before looking at ways of solving it.
examples.zh: 在寻找解决方法之前，我们花了整整一个小时讨论这个问题。

senses.def: to speak to somebody without listening to what they say in reply
senses.zh: （不理会对方反应）对某人大发议论，滔滔不绝地对某人说

examples.en: You can’t have a real conversation with him—he just talks at you all the time.
examples.zh: 你无法与他进行真正的对话——他只是一直对你说话。

senses.def: to answer somebody rudely, especially somebody in authority
to help a pilot of a plane to land by giving instructions from the ground
to make something seem less important or successful than it really is

examples.en: You shouldn't talk down your own achievements.
examples.zh: 你不该贬低自己的成绩。

senses.def: to speak to somebody as if they were less important or intelligent than you
senses.zh: 以高人一等的口气说话

senses.def: to persuade somebody/yourself to do/not to do something
senses.zh: 说服某人（或自己）做／不做某事

examples.en: I didn't want to move abroad but Bill talked me into it.
examples.zh: 我本不想移居国外，但是比尔把我给说服了。

examples.en: She tried to talk him out of leaving.
examples.zh: 她极力劝他不要走。

senses.def: to discuss something carefully and completely in order to make a decision, solve a problem, etc.
senses.zh: 把…谈透；协商作出（决定）；协商解决（问题）

examples.en: We need to talk out the issue with the others before making a decision.
examples.zh: 在做出决定之前，我们需要与其他人讨论这个问题。

senses.def: to persuade somebody/yourself to do/not to do something
senses.zh: 说服某人（或自己）做／不做某事

examples.en: I didn't want to move abroad but Bill talked me into it.
examples.zh: 我本不想移居国外，但是比尔把我给说服了。

examples.en: She tried to talk him out of leaving.
examples.zh: 她极力劝他不要走。

senses.def: to discuss something carefully and completely, especially in order to reach an agreement or make a decision
senses.zh: 详细讨论，详谈（以达成协议或作出决定）

examples.en: You'll find it helpful to talk things over with a friend.
examples.zh: 把情况和朋友详细聊一聊，你会觉得大有帮助。

examples.en: They talked over the proposal and decided to give it their approval.
examples.zh: 他们讨论了该提议并决定批准。

senses.def: radio programmes in which somebody discusses a particular subject with people who phone the radio station to give their opinions
to talk about something in a general way without dealing with the most important parts of it
senses.zh: 拐弯抹角地说；不着边际地说

examples.en: We spent a whole hour talking around the problem before looking at ways of solving it.
examples.zh: 在寻找解决方法之前，我们花了整整一个小时讨论这个问题。

senses.def: to persuade somebody to accept something or agree to something

examples.en: We finally managed to talk them round to our way of thinking.
examples.zh: 我们最后总算说服他们接受我们的想法。

senses.def: a television or radio programme in which famous people are asked questions and talk in an informal way about their work and opinions on various topics

examples.en: a talk-show host
examples.zh: 访谈节目主持人

senses.def: a television or radio programme in which a presenter
senses.zh: （电视或电台的）观众讨论节目，听众讨论节目

senses.def: to explain to somebody how something works so that they can do it or understand it

examples.en: Can you talk me through the various investment options?
examples.zh: 你能给我详述可以选择的各种投资方法吗？

senses.def: to discuss something carefully and completely until you are sure you understand it

examples.en: It sounds like a good idea but we’ll need to talk it through.
examples.zh: 这听起来是个好主意，但我们需要仔细讨论。

senses.def: the amount of time that a mobile phone can be used for calls without needing more power or more payments
senses.zh: （手机的）通话时间，基本通话时间

senses.def: to describe somebody/something/yourself in a way that makes them/it/you sound better than they really are

examples.en: They talked up the tourist attractions to encourage more visitors.
examples.zh: 他们对这些旅游胜地大肆炒作以吸引更多游客。

senses.def: people say talk/speak of the devil

examples.en: Well, talk of the devil—here's Alice now!
examples.zh: 好吧，谈谈魔鬼——现在爱丽丝来了！

senses.def: liking to talk a lot
senses.zh: 爱说话的；饶舌的；健谈的

examples.en: He's not very talkative, is he?
examples.zh: 他的话不多，是吧？

examples.en: She was in a talkative mood.
examples.zh: 她滔滔不绝，谈兴正浓。

senses.def: a system that allows people working in a recording or broadcasting studio to talk to each other without their voices being recorded or heard on the radio
senses.zh: （录音或播音室的）内部联络系统，内部对讲系统

senses.def: a person who talks in a particular way or who talks a lot

examples.en: a brilliant talker
examples.zh: 能言善辩的人

examples.en: She’s a (great) talker (= she talks a lot).
examples.zh: 她很健谈。

examples.en: He's more a talker than a doer (= he talks instead of doing things).
examples.zh: 他说得多做得少。

examples.en: He’s not much of a talker.
examples.zh: 他说话不多。

senses.def: a person who can talk very quickly and easily, but who cannot always be trusted
senses.zh: 快嘴快舌但不可信赖的人

examples.en: As a politician, she had the reputation for being a real fast talker.
examples.zh: 作为一名政治家，她以说话很快而闻名。

senses.def: a person who can talk very quickly and easily, but who cannot always be trusted
senses.zh: 快嘴快舌但不可信赖的人

examples.en: As a politician, she had the reputation for being a real fast talker.
examples.zh: 作为一名政治家，她以说话很快而闻名。

intro.en: These are all words for a person who talks or who is talking, especially in a particular way.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指说话者，尤指以某种方式说话的人。

items.def: a person who is or was speaking; a person who speaks a particular language:
items.zh: 指发言者、讲某种语言的人

examples.en: I looked around to see who the speaker was.
examples.zh: 我四下环顾看说话的是谁。

items.def: (rather formal) a person who is able to describe their ideas and feelings clearly to others:
items.zh: 指交际者、交流者

examples.en: The ideal candidate will be an effective communicator.
examples.zh: 理想的候选人定要是善于沟通的人。

items.def: (disapproving) a person who enjoys talking about other people’s private lives:
items.zh: 指喜欢传播流言蜚语的人、爱说长道短（或说三道四）的人

examples.en: Don't tell anyone, because some people are terrible gossips.
examples.zh: 不要告诉任何人，因为有些人很八卦。

items.def: a person who talks in a particular way or who talks a lot:
items.zh: 指以某种方式说话的人、爱说话的人

examples.en: He’s a very persuasive talker.
examples.zh: 他是一个说话很有说服力的人。

senses.def: a film that has sounds and not just pictures
used when you are going to say more about a subject that has already been mentioned
senses.zh: （继续谈论时用）提起，说起，谈及，至于

examples.en: Talking of Sue, I met her new boyfriend last week.
examples.zh: 谈到休，上星期我遇到了她的新男友。

senses.def: a type of drum from West Africa whose sound can be changed in order to communicate different messages
senses.zh: 话鼓（西非的一种可通过声音变化传递不同信息的鼓）

senses.def: a person on television who talks straight to the camera and is seen close up

examples.en: The election broadcast consisted largely of talking heads.
examples.zh: 有关选举的电视广播主要播放发言者的特写镜头。

senses.def: a US pop group formed in 1975 and known for the unusual words of their songs. David Byrne was the group's singer. Their albums included Fear of Music
senses.zh: 会说话的人：成立于1975年的美国流行乐团，以其歌曲中不寻常的单词而闻名。大卫·伯恩（David Byrne）是该乐队的歌手。他们的专辑包括Fear of Music（1979），Remain in Light（1980）和Naked（1988）。

senses.def: a subject that is talked about or discussed by many people

examples.en: The judge's decision became a legal talking point.
examples.zh: 法官的判决成了法律界谈论的中心。

senses.def: an item that somebody will speak about at a meeting, often one that supports a particular argument

examples.en: Senate Democrats issued these talking points.
examples.zh: 参议院民主党发表了这些议题。

senses.def: a place where there is a lot of discussion and argument but no action is taken
senses.zh: （只讨论而无行动的）清谈俱乐部

senses.def: an act of talking seriously to somebody to tell them they have done something wrong

examples.en: to give somebody a good talking-to
examples.zh: 狠狠训斥某人一顿

senses.def: containing a lot of talk or conversation
senses.zh: 讲话场景多的；有很多对话的

examples.en: The film is brilliantly animated, but it’s overly talky and suffers from painfully slow pacing.
examples.zh: 这部电影的动画做得很棒，但对话太多，导致节奏慢得要命。

senses.def: liking to talk a lot
senses.zh: 爱说话的；多嘴的；饶舌的；健谈的

examples.en: The smartest, talkiest students often need to be discouraged from dominating the class.
examples.zh: 最聪明、最健谈的学生常常需要阻止他们在课堂上占据主导地位。

senses.def: having a greater than average height

examples.en: She's tall and thin.
examples.zh: 她身材高瘦。

examples.en: the tallest building in the world
examples.zh: 世界上最高的建筑物

examples.en: tall trees/chimneys
examples.zh: 高大的树木/烟囱

examples.en: a tall glass of iced tea
examples.zh: 一大杯冰茶

examples.en: He's grown taller since I last saw him.
examples.zh: 他比我上次见到时长高了。

senses.def: used to describe or ask about the height of somebody/something
senses.zh: （用以表示或询问高度）有…高，身高

examples.en: How tall are you?
examples.zh: 你身高多少？

examples.en: He's six feet tall and weighs 200 pounds.
examples.zh: 他身高六英尺，体重 200 磅。

senses.def: to be very difficult to do
something large and successful often begins in a very small way
senses.zh: 参天橡树长自小小橡实；合抱之树，生于毫末

senses.def: to show that you are proud and able to deal with anything

examples.en: Suddenly he seemed to stand taller.
examples.zh: 忽然间他显得更高了。

senses.def: to feel proud and confident
to be very difficult to do

items.idm: great/tall oaks from little acorns grow

senses.def: something large and successful often begins in a very small way
senses.zh: 参天橡树长自小小橡实；合抱之树，生于毫末

senses.def: to show that you are proud and able to deal with anything

examples.en: Suddenly he seemed to stand taller.
examples.zh: 忽然间他显得更高了。

senses.def: to feel proud and confident
the fact of criticizing people who are richer or more successful than others
senses.zh: 高罂粟综合征（批评富有或成功的人）；仇富症；红眼病

senses.def: a large sailing ship with high masts

examples.en: A number of tall ships were docked in the harbour as part of the maritime festival.
examples.zh: 一些高桅帆船作为海洋节的一部分，泊在港口里。

senses.def: a story that is difficult to believe because what it describes seems exaggerated
senses.zh: 无稽之谈；荒诞不经的故事

examples.en: No one would believe such a tall story.
examples.zh: 如此荒诞不经的故事没有人会相信。

examples.en: Sounds like another one of his tall stories to me.
examples.zh: 听起来他又在对我说些无稽之谈了。

senses.def: the capital city of the US state of Florida
senses.zh: 塔拉哈西（美国佛罗里达州首府）

senses.def: a tall piece of furniture with drawers
the fact of being tall
animal fat used for making candles
senses.zh: （用以制造蜡烛、肥皂等的）动物油脂

senses.def: a record of the number or amount of something, especially one that you can keep adding to

examples.en: He hopes to improve on his tally of three goals in the past nine games.
examples.zh: 他希望提高在过去九场比赛中打进三球的纪录。

examples.en: Keep a tally of how much you spend while you're away.
examples.zh: 在外出期间，把你的花费都记录下来。

examples.en: With 85% of the vote counted, unofficial tallies showed Ramos leading his closest rivals.
examples.zh: 随着85%的选票清点完毕，非官方计票结果显示拉莫斯领先于最接近的对手。

examples.en: She scored four more points, taking her tally to 15.
examples.zh: 她又得了四分，总计15分。

senses.def: to be the same as or to match another person’s account of something, another set of figures, etc.
senses.zh: （说法、数字等）与…符合（或一致）；吻合

examples.en: Her report of what happened tallied exactly with the story of another witness.
examples.zh: 她对于事情的叙述和另一个证人的说法完全吻合。

examples.en: The two accounts tally precisely/closely/fairly well.
examples.zh: 这两份帐目完全吻合/相近/相当吻合。

senses.def: to calculate the total number, cost, etc. of something
senses.zh: 计算（总的数目、成本等）；合计

examples.en: When we tallied up the cost of moving, we decided against it.
examples.zh: 计算了搬迁的成本之后，我们决定不这样做。

senses.def: used in hunting for telling the dogs that a fox
senses.zh: 呔嗬（狩猎时的吆喝声，示意猎狗发现了狐狸）

senses.def: connected with the Talmud; in the Talmud
senses.zh: 塔尔木迪奇：与塔木德相连；在Talmud牛津搭配字典中

senses.def: a long, sharp, curved nail on the feet of some birds, especially birds of prey
(in some countries in South Asia) a smaller division of a district that governs itself
a weapon with a handle and a long, usually curved, metal blade
senses.zh: 一种带有手柄和长且通常弯曲的金属刀片的武器

senses.def: television audience measurement
senses.zh: 电视收视率测量（用于估算观看了特定电视节目的人数的研究）

senses.def: a poem (1790) by Robert Burns
senses.zh: 罗伯特·伯恩斯（Robert Burns）的诗（1790）。苏格兰农民塔姆·香特尔（Tam o'Shanter）一天晚上喝醉了，当他骑车回家时，他看到三个女巫（即拥有邪恶魔力的女人）开始追随他。他尽可能快地骑行，并在女巫无法穿越的河上越过一座桥而逃脱。一个女巫在马匹穿过桥之前把马的尾巴拔掉。Tam在这首诗的许多插图中所戴的帽子，一种传统的苏格兰圆形羊毛帽，现在被称为tam o'shanter。

senses.def: a round hat made of wool with a small ball made of wool in the centre, originally worn in Scotland
senses.zh: 苏格兰宽顶羊毛圆帽（中央缀绒球）

senses.def: a Mexican dish of meat or beans and cornmeal
senses.zh: 塔马利，墨西哥粽子（将肉或豆和玉米面团包在玉米皮中蒸熟）

examples.en: She makes and sells tortillas and tamales from home.

senses.def: to show that you are very angry or anxious about something
senses.zh: （因发怒、焦急而）撕扯自己的头发

examples.en: She's keeping very calm—anyone else would be tearing their hair out.
examples.zh: 她依旧泰然自若，换作别人早急坏了。

examples.en: I felt like tearing my hair out in frustration.
examples.zh: 我沮丧得想把头发扯下来。

senses.def: to destroy the most important part or aspect of something

examples.en: Closing the factory tore the heart out of the community.
examples.zh: 工厂的关闭让社区的心都碎了。

senses.def: (to be) in a very great hurry
to attack somebody very violently
to speak angrily to somebody who has done something wrong
used to say that something has happened to cause your plans to fail
a hole that has been made in something by tearing

examples.en: This sheet has a tear in it.
examples.zh: 这条床单上有个破洞。

senses.def: to be enjoying great success

examples.en: Business confidence has soared and the economy is on a tear.
examples.zh: 商业信心飙升，经济蓬勃发展。

examples.en: The team has been on a tear since defeating the Red Sox in May.
examples.zh: 自从五月份击败红袜队以来，球队一直在泪流满面。

senses.def: the damage to objects, furniture, property, etc. that is the result of normal use
senses.zh: （正常使用造成的）磨损，损耗，损坏

examples.en: The insurance policy does not cover damage caused by normal wear and tear.
examples.zh: 保险单不保正常使用所造成的坏损。

examples.en: The living-room carpet has to stand up to the combined wear and tear of two dogs and three children.
examples.zh: 客厅的地毯必须经受住两只狗和三个孩子共同的磨损。

senses.def: a drop of liquid that comes out of your eye when you cry

examples.en: A tear rolled down his face.
examples.zh: 一滴眼泪沿他的面颊流下来。

examples.en: I shed a tear (= cried a little) during the final episode of the show.
examples.zh: 演出的最后一幕我流泪了。

examples.en: She left the room in tears (= crying).
examples.zh: 她哭着离开了房间。

examples.en: He suddenly burst into tears (= began to cry).
examples.zh: 他突然放声大哭起来。

examples.en: He was crying tears of joy.
examples.zh: 他高兴得大哭。

examples.en: The memory brought a tear to her eye (= made her cry).
examples.zh: 她想起这事便热泪盈眶。

examples.en: As he listened to the music, his eyes filled with tears.
examples.zh: 他听着音乐，眼睛里噙着泪水。

examples.en: Their story will move you to tears (= make you cry).
examples.zh: 他们的故事会使你感动得落泪。

examples.en: They reduced her to tears (= made her cry, especially by being cruel or unkind).
examples.zh: 他们弄得她哭起来了。

examples.en: Most of the audience was on the verge of tears (= very close to crying).
examples.zh: 大多数观众都快流泪了。

examples.en: I was close to tears as I told them the news.
examples.zh: 我告诉他们这一消息时都快要哭了出来。

examples.en: Desperately she fought back the tears (= tried not to cry).
examples.zh: 她竭力忍住没让眼泪流出来。

examples.en: The tears welled up (= appeared and started to flow) in his eyes.
examples.zh: 他热泪盈眶。

examples.en: We were in floods of tears (= crying a lot) at the end of the film.
examples.zh: 电影结束时我们都泪如泉涌。

senses.def: very hard work; a lot of effort

examples.en: The only way to succeed is through old-fashioned blood, sweat and tears.
examples.zh: 成功的唯一途径还是老办法：艰苦奋斗。

senses.def: extremely bored
senses.zh: 厌烦透了的；极其厌倦的

examples.en: I remember being bored stiff during my entire time at school.
examples.zh: 我记得整个学校生活使人厌烦得要命。

examples.en: She enjoys it. Everyone else is bored silly.
examples.zh: 她很享受。其他人都无聊傻了。

examples.en: He walked along, bored out of his mind.
examples.zh: 他一路走着，心烦意乱。

examples.en: She was alone all day and bored to death.
examples.zh: 她整天自己一个人待着，无聊得要死。

senses.def: if somebody sheds

examples.en: Let’s have no more politicians shedding crocodile tears for the unemployed.
examples.zh: 让我们不再有政客为失业者流鳄鱼的眼泪。

senses.def: if you say that something will end in tears
senses.zh: （告诫时说）以痛苦而告终，结局悲惨

examples.en: After all that excitement the day was bound to end in tears.
examples.zh: 在所有的兴奋过后，这一天注定要以不快而结束。

examples.en: Needless to say, it ended in tears.
examples.zh: 不用说，它以泪水结束。

examples.en: He warned us it would all end in tears.
examples.zh: 他警告我们这一切都会以泪水结束。

senses.def: to be unable to decide or choose between two people, things or feelings
senses.zh: （在两者间）难以选择，左右为难

examples.en: I was torn between my parents and my friend.
examples.zh: 我在父母和朋友之间左右为难。

senses.def: to criticize somebody, or their work or ideas, very severely
senses.zh: 严厉斥责；痛斥；批评得体无完肤

items.idm: tear somebody/something apart, to shreds, to bits, etc.

senses.def: to destroy or defeat somebody/something completely or criticize them or it severely
senses.zh: 彻底毁灭；彻底打败；严厉批评

examples.en: We tore the other team apart in the second half.
examples.zh: 我们在下半场把对方球队打得落花流水。

examples.en: The critics tore his last movie to shreds.
examples.zh: 影评家把他最近的一部影片说得一无是处。

senses.def: to make somebody feel very unhappy or worried

examples.en: It tears me apart to think I might have hurt her feelings.
examples.zh: 一想到我可能伤害了她的感情，我就感到痛心。

examples.en: His distress tore me up inside.
examples.zh: 他的痛苦让我心如刀绞。

senses.def: to destroy something violently, especially by pulling it to pieces

examples.en: The dogs tore the fox apart.
examples.zh: 几条狗把那只狐狸撕成了碎片。

senses.def: to make people in a country, an organization or other place fight or argue with each other
senses.zh: 使四分五裂；使分崩离析

examples.en: Divisive politics is tearing our country apart.
examples.zh: 分裂的政治正在分裂我们的国家。

senses.def: to search a place, making it look untidy and causing damage

examples.en: They tore the room apart, looking for money.
examples.zh: 他们为了找钱，把房间翻得乱七八糟。

senses.def: to pull or cut something violently so that it tears

examples.en: He tore at the meat with his bare hands.
examples.zh: 他徒手撕肉。

senses.def: to leave somewhere even though you would prefer to stay there; to take something away from somewhere
senses.zh: 依依不舍地离开；忍痛离去；把…拿走

examples.en: Dinner's ready, if you can tear yourself away from the TV.
examples.zh: 开饭了，别舍不得离开电视了。

examples.en: She was unable to tear her eyes away from him (= could not stop looking at him).
examples.zh: 她恋恋不舍地望着他。

senses.def: to pull or knock down a building, wall, etc.

examples.en: They’re tearing down these old houses to build a new office block.
examples.zh: 他们正拆除这些旧房子以修建新的办公大楼。

senses.def: a tube through which tears pass from the tear glands
a gas that makes your eyes sting

examples.en: The police fired tear gas at the protesters.
examples.zh: 警方向抗议者发射了催泪瓦斯。

senses.def: to attack somebody/something physically or with words

examples.en: The wind tore into him.
examples.zh: 狂风猛烈地吹打着他。

examples.en: She tore into him with claims of failure and lies.
examples.zh: 她痛斥他，说他失败并说谎。

senses.def: to start doing something with a lot of energy

examples.en: They tore into their food as if they were starving.
examples.zh: 他们狼吞虎咽地吃起饭来，好像饿坏了似的。

examples.en: The band tore into their opening number.
examples.zh: 乐队激情澎湃地演奏了他们的开场曲。

senses.def: a film, story, etc. that is designed to make people feel sad
senses.zh: 催人泪下的电影（或故事等）；“催泪弹”

senses.def: relating to something that can be removed by being torn off, especially part of a sheet of paper

examples.en: a tear-off slip
examples.zh: 可撕下的纸条

senses.def: wet with tears
senses.zh: 布满泪痕的；泪水涟涟的

examples.en: a little girl with tear-stained cheeks
examples.zh: 满脸泪痕的小女孩

senses.def: to make somebody feel very unhappy or worried

senses.def: to destroy or defeat somebody/something completely or criticize them or it severely

senses.def: to destroy a document, etc. by tearing it into pieces

examples.en: She tore up all the letters he had sent her.
examples.zh: 她把他寄给她的信都撕了。

examples.en: He accused the leader of tearing up the party's manifesto (= of ignoring it).
examples.zh: 他谴责领导人无视党的宣言。

senses.def: if you or your eyes tear up

examples.en: My eyes started to tear up.
examples.zh: 我的眼睛开始流泪。

examples.en: One minute she's making you tear up, the next she's making you laugh.
examples.zh: 她一会儿让你感动得流泪，一会儿又让你开怀大笑。

senses.def: to leave somewhere even though you would prefer to stay there; to take something away from somewhere
senses.zh: 依依不舍地离开；忍痛离去；把…拿走

examples.en: Dinner's ready, if you can tear yourself away from the TV.

examples.en: She was unable to tear her eyes away from him (= could not stop looking at him).

senses.def: a young person who is difficult to control and often does stupid, dangerous and/or illegal things
a single tear that comes from your eye
crying, or about to cry

examples.en: She suddenly became very tearful.
examples.zh: 她突然痛哭流涕。

examples.en: He answered in a tearful voice.
examples.zh: 他含泪回答道。

senses.def: at which people feel emotional and cry
senses.zh: 令人伤心的；催人泪下的

examples.en: a tearful farewell
examples.zh: 挥泪送别

examples.en: She made a tearful phone call to her family.
examples.zh: 她含泪给家人打了个电话。

senses.def: in an emotional way, looking or sounding as if you are crying, or about to cry

examples.en: ‘Why are you doing this?’ she asked tearfully.
examples.zh: “你为什么要这样做？”她泪流满面地问。

senses.def: the fact of being emotional, and looking or sounding as if you are crying, or about to cry
full of or involving tears
senses.zh: 眼泪汪汪地，含泪的；流泪的

examples.en: teary eyes
examples.zh: 泪眼

examples.en: a teary smile/goodbye
examples.zh: 含泪的微笑；挥泪告别

senses.def: to laugh at somebody and make jokes about them, either in a friendly way or in order to annoy them or make them embarrassed

examples.en: Don't get upset—I was only teasing.
examples.zh: 别不高兴，我只是在逗你玩。

examples.en: I used to get teased about my name.
examples.zh: 过去别人总拿我的名字开玩笑。

examples.en: ‘You're not scared, are you?’ she teased him.
examples.zh: “你没害怕，对吧？”她揶揄道。

senses.def: to annoy an animal, especially by touching it, pulling its tail, etc.
to make somebody sexually excited, especially when you do not intend to have sex with them

examples.en: She teased the men with an expression that was both innocent and knowing.
examples.zh: 她带着一种既天真又世故的表情挑逗那些男人。

senses.def: to make somebody want something or become excited about something by showing or offering them just a small part of it; to make somebody want more of something
senses.zh: （用一小部分）逗惹，刺激；使想要更多

examples.en: Spring is here and we have already been teased with a glimpse of summer.
examples.zh: 春天来了，我们已经迫不及待地想要一睹夏日的风采。

examples.en: There are tempting menus to tease the taste buds.
examples.zh: 有挑逗味蕾的诱人的菜单。

examples.en: He teased an appearance on tonight's show with a message on social media.
examples.zh: 他在社交媒体上发布了一条消息，调侃今晚将出席节目。

senses.def: to pull something gently apart into separate pieces

examples.en: to tease wool into strands
examples.zh: 把羊毛梳成缕

senses.def: to comb
a person who likes to play tricks and jokes on other people, especially by telling them something that is not true or by not telling them something that they want to know
senses.zh: 爱戏弄人的人；逗弄者；取笑者

senses.def: an act that is intended as a trick or joke

examples.en: Ignore everything he said—it was all just a tease.
examples.zh: 忽略他所说的一切——这只是一个玩笑。

senses.def: a person who pretends to be attracted to somebody, makes them sexually excited and then refuses to have sex with them
senses.zh: 卖弄风骚的人；勾引人者

senses.def: to remove knots
to spend time trying to find out information or the meaning of something, especially when this is complicated or difficult
senses.zh: 探讨；深入研究；梳理清楚

examples.en: The teacher helped them tease out the meaning of the poem.
examples.zh: 老师帮助他们弄清楚那首诗的含义。

senses.def: a plant that has large flowers with spikes
a difficult problem or question
an advertisement for a product that does not mention the name of the product or say much about it but is intended to make people interested and likely to pay attention to later advertisements
senses.zh: 前导广告，悬念式广告（含蓄而引人好奇）

examples.en: For the first week we ran a teaser featuring a black cat.
examples.zh: 第一周我们播放了一个以黑猫为主角的预告片。

senses.def: in a way that is intended to make somebody feel embarrassed, annoyed, etc.

examples.en: ‘Maybe, you’re just too old,’ she said teasingly.
examples.zh: “也许，你太老了，”她戏弄地说。

senses.def: in a way that suggests something and makes somebody want to know more

examples.en: ‘I have no intention of selling my story…not yet, anyway,’ he said teasingly.
examples.zh: “我无意出售我的故事……无论如何，还没有，”他戏谑地说。

senses.def: in a way that is intended to make somebody sexually excited

examples.en: She ran her hands teasingly over his shoulders.
examples.zh: 她用双手戏弄地抚过他的肩膀。

senses.def: a small spoon for putting sugar into tea and other drinks
the amount a teaspoon

examples.en: Add two teaspoons of salt.
examples.zh: 加两小匙盐。

examples.en: a teaspoonful of sugar
examples.zh: 一茶匙糖

senses.def: the rubber part at the end of a baby’s bottle that the baby sucks
one of the parts of a female animal’s body that the young animals drink milk from
the time during the afternoon or early evening when people have the meal called tea
a plant that has large flowers with spikes
a unit of computer memory or data, equal to 240
senses.zh: 太比特（二进制计算机内存或数据单位，等于 1 099 511 627 776 比特）

senses.def: a unit of computer memory or data, equal to 240
senses.zh: 太字节（二进制计算机内存或数据的单位，等于 1 099 511 627 776 字节）

senses.def: scientific knowledge used in practical ways in industry, for example in designing new machines
machines or equipment designed using technology

examples.en: tech companies
examples.zh: 科技公司

examples.en: This gadget is a great new piece of tech.
examples.zh: 这个小工具是一项伟大的新技术。

senses.def: technical college

examples.en: He teaches at the local tech.
examples.zh: 他在当地科技公司任教。

senses.def: a technician

examples.en: She's a lab tech at the university.
examples.zh: 她是大学的实验室技术人员。

senses.def: having a good knowledge and understanding of modern technology, especially computers
senses.zh: 精通现代技术的；（尤指）精通电脑的

examples.en: the tech-savvy younger generation
examples.zh: 精通技术的年轻一代

examples.en: The bank needs to meet the demands of today's tech-savvy consumers.
examples.zh: 该银行需要满足当今精通技术的消费者的需求。

senses.def: technical help that a company gives to customers using their computers or other products
senses.zh: （公司为用户提供的）技术支持，技术支援

senses.def: a department in a company that provides technical help to its workers or customers
senses.zh: （公司的）技术支持部，技术支援部

examples.en: I called tech support and they fixed it.
examples.zh: 我给技术支持部打了电话，他们修好了。

examples.en: She works in tech support.
examples.zh: 她从事技术支持工作。

examples.en: I told him straight (= in a direct way) that I wasn't voting for him.
examples.zh: 我直接告诉他我不会投票给他。

examples.en: He later told the court that he had returned the money.
examples.zh: 他后来告诉法庭，他已经退还了钱。

examples.en: I kept telling myself (that) everything was OK.
examples.zh: 我不断告诉自己一切都没问题。

examples.en: Are you telling me you didn't have any help with this? (= I don't believe what you have said)
examples.zh: 你是说在这件事情上你没有得到过任何帮助吗？

examples.en: Tell me where you live.
examples.zh: 告诉我你住哪儿。

examples.en: ‘I'm ready to go now,’ he told her.
examples.zh: “我现在可以走了。”他对她说。

examples.en: 'We hope that there will be some progress,' he told reporters.
examples.zh: 他对记者说: “我们希望会有一些进展。”

senses.def: to give information about something

examples.en: The advertisement told us very little about the product.
examples.zh: 这则广告提供的产品情况很少。

examples.en: This gauge tells you how much fuel you have left.
examples.zh: 这油表显示还剩有多少燃料。

examples.en: The sound of his breathing told her (that) he was asleep.
examples.zh: 她从他呼吸的声音中听出来他睡着了。

senses.def: to express something in words

examples.en: to tell stories/jokes/lies
examples.zh: 讲故事；说笑话；撒谎

examples.en: Are you sure you're telling the truth?
examples.zh: 你说的真是实话吗？

examples.en: I can't tell you how happy I am.
examples.zh: 我无法向你表达我多么高兴。

examples.en: We'd go fishing and she'd tell me stories.
examples.zh: 我们那时常去钓鱼，她常给我讲故事。

examples.en: All of them had an interesting story to tell.
examples.zh: 他们所有人都有一个有趣的故事要讲。

senses.group: express in words 用言语表达

senses.def: to let somebody know a secret

examples.en: Promise you won't tell.
examples.zh: 你要保证不往外讲。

examples.en: ‘Who are you going out with tonight?’ ‘That would be telling!’ (= it's a secret)
examples.zh: “你今晚要和谁约会？”“那可不能讲！”（是个秘密）

senses.def: to order or advise somebody to do something

examples.en: He was told to sit down and wait.
examples.zh: 有人吩咐他坐下等着。

examples.en: There was a sign telling motorists to slow down.
examples.zh: 有一个让汽车司机减速的指示牌。

examples.en: I kept telling myself to keep calm.
examples.zh: 我不断叮嘱自己要保持冷静。

examples.en: I specifically told you to be here on time.
examples.zh: 我特意嘱咐过你要准时到。

examples.en: Do what I tell you.
examples.zh: 你要照我的吩咐做。

examples.en: Children must do as they're told.
examples.zh: 孩子们必须听话。

examples.en: Don't tell me what to do!
examples.zh: 别跟我说该怎么办！

examples.en: The doctor told me (that) I should eat less fat.
examples.zh: 医生嘱咐我要少吃油腻。

senses.def: to know, see or judge something correctly

examples.en: I think he's happy. It's hard to tell.
examples.zh: 我想他是幸福的。这很难说。

examples.en: As far as I can tell, she's enjoying the course.
examples.zh: 据我判断，她喜欢这门课程。

examples.en: ‘That's not an original.’ ‘How can you tell?’
examples.zh: “那不是正本。”“你怎么知道的？”

examples.en: I could tell (that) he was angry from his expression.
examples.zh: 从他的表情我看得出他生气了。

examples.en: The only way to tell if you like something is by trying it.
examples.zh: 要判定是否喜欢一件东西，唯一的办法是试一试。

examples.en: It's too early to tell how popular this service will be.
examples.zh: 现在判断这项服务有多受欢迎还为时过早。

examples.en: It's impossible to tell exactly where the problem is.
examples.zh: 不可能准确说出问题出在哪里。

senses.def: to recognize the difference between one thing or person and another

examples.en: It was hard to tell the difference between the two versions.
examples.zh: 很难分辨出这两个版本有什么区别。

examples.en: Can you tell Tom from his twin brother?
examples.zh: 你能分得出汤姆和他的孪生弟弟吗？

examples.en: Can you tell this copy from the original?
examples.zh: 你能区分这个副本和原件吗？

examples.en: It's difficult to tell them apart.
examples.zh: 很难把他们区分开来。

examples.en: The kittens look exactly alike—how can you tell which is which?
examples.zh: 这些小猫看上去一模一样，你怎么能分辨出哪只是哪只呢？

examples.en: I couldn't tell who was meant to be the chairman.
examples.zh: 我无法判断谁应该担任主席。

senses.def: to have an effect on somebody/something, especially a bad one
senses.zh: 产生效果，发生影响（尤指负面影响）

examples.en: The strain was beginning to tell on the rescue team.
examples.zh: 过度的疲劳开始让救援队吃不消了。

senses.def: with all people, etc. counted and included

examples.en: There are 52 people coming, all told.
examples.zh: 总共有 52 人要来。

senses.def: used to say that you know or can guess what somebody is going to say, especially because it is typical of them
senses.zh: （用以表示知道或猜得出他人要说什么）不至于…吧，别又要说…了吧

examples.en: Don't tell me you were late again!
examples.zh: 你不至于又迟到了吧！

senses.def: to hear people talking about something

examples.en: I've often heard tell of such things.
examples.zh: 我常听到人谈起这种事。

senses.def: used to tell somebody the true facts about a situation, especially when these are not known by other people
senses.zh: （用于说出真相）说实话，说真的，老实说

examples.en: If the truth be known, I was afraid to tell anyone.
examples.zh: 如果要实话实说的话，是我不敢告诉任何人。

senses.def: used to say that something you have just said is not true or correct
senses.zh: （表示刚说的话不真实或不正确）我说错了，我说的不对

examples.en: We first met in 2006, no, I tell a lie, it was 2007.
examples.zh: 我们第一次见面是在 2006 年，不，我说错了，是 2007 年。

senses.def: used to emphasize what you are saying, especially when it is surprising or difficult to believe
senses.zh: 我可以肯定地说；我敢说；确实

examples.en: It isn't cheap, I can tell you!
examples.zh: 我敢说，这并不便宜！

examples.en: I'm telling you, that's exactly what she said.
examples.zh: 我可以肯定地说，那正是她的原话。

senses.def: used to introduce a suggestion

examples.en: I'll tell you what—let's stay in instead.
examples.zh: 听我说，咱们还是待在家里吧。

senses.def: used when something bad has happened, to remind somebody that you warned them about it and they did not listen to you
senses.zh: 我提醒过你要出事；不听好人言，吃亏在眼前

senses.def: a way of referring to somebody talking publicly, usually for money, about a past sexual relationship with somebody famous
senses.zh: （通常为了获利）泄露与名人的私情

senses.def: used to say that somebody told you something but you do not want to say who it was
senses.zh: （不想说出是谁告诉的）有人告诉我的，不告诉你我是怎么知道的

senses.def: to survive a difficult or dangerous experience so that you can tell others what really happened
senses.zh: 幸免于难之后向人讲述真实经历

senses.def: to give some information that is different from what you expect or have been told
senses.zh: 说的情况迥然不同；讲出来的是另一回事

examples.en: These drugs are widely believed to be effective medications. The data, however, tell a different story.
examples.zh: 这些药物被广泛认为是有效的药物。然而，数据却讲述了一个不同的故事。

senses.def: used to introduce a question
senses.zh: （用以引出问题）告诉我，跟我说实话

examples.en: Tell me, have you had lunch yet?
examples.zh: 跟我说实话，你吃过午餐没有？

senses.def: used to say that you understand what somebody is talking about and have had the same experience

examples.en: ‘I get so annoyed with Steve!’ ‘Tell me about it. He drives me crazy.’
examples.zh: “史蒂夫把我烦透了！”“你算说对了。他快把我逼疯了。”

senses.def: used to tell somebody that you do not believe what they have said
senses.zh: 不见得吧；我不相信；别瞎扯

senses.def: to explain itself, without needing any further explanation or comment
senses.zh: 不言而喻；不释自明；无须解释

examples.en: Her face told its own story.
examples.zh: 看她的面部表情，就什么都明白了。

senses.def: to tell somebody about something that another person has done wrong
to tell somebody/know some useful, interesting or surprising information about somebody/something
senses.zh: 了解／透露有用的（或有趣的、意外的）信息；有所了解／披露；见多识广

examples.en: After winning several Oscars, Nick Park can tell you a thing or two about making animated films.
examples.zh: 在赢得多项奥斯卡奖后，尼克·帕克可以告诉你一两件关于制作动画电影的事情。

senses.def: to read the time from a clock, etc.

examples.en: She's only five—she hasn't learnt to tell the time yet.
examples.zh: 她才五岁，还没有学会看钟表。

senses.def: to make it clear to somebody that you will no longer accept their bad behaviour
senses.zh: 警告某人的行为不可容忍；不吃某人的这一套

senses.def: to make it clear to somebody that you are angry and are rejecting what they are offering you
senses.zh: 别来这一套；让某人收起…的一套

senses.def: used to say that it is impossible to know what happened or will happen

examples.en: There's no telling how they'll react.
examples.zh: 说不准他们会有什么反应。

senses.def: used to say that you will have to wait for some time to find out the result of a situation

examples.en: Only time will tell if the treatment has been successful.
examples.zh: 只有时间才能证明这种疗法是否成功。

senses.def: used when admitting something

examples.en: To tell the truth, I fell asleep in the middle of her talk.
examples.zh: 说实话，我在她讲话过程中睡着了。

senses.def: you can never be sure, for example because things are not always what they appear to be
senses.zh: 谁也拿不准；谁也说不清；很难说

senses.def: I completely agree with you

examples.zh: 总共有 52 人要来。

examples.zh: 我们第一次见面是在 2006 年，不，我说错了，是 2007 年。

intro.en: These words all mean to use your position of authority to say to somebody that they must do something.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含命令、指挥、要求之义。

items.def: to use your position of authority to tell somebody to do something:
items.zh: 指命令、指挥、要求

examples.en: The company was ordered to pay compensation to its former employee.
examples.zh: 公司被勒令向以前的员工作出补偿。

items.def: to say to somebody that they must or should do something:
items.zh: 指命令、指示、吩咐

examples.en: He was told to sit down and wait.
examples.zh: 有人吩咐他坐下等着。

items.def: (rather formal) to tell somebody to do something, especially in a formal or official way:
items.zh: 尤指以正式或官方的方式指示、命令、吩咐

examples.en: The letter instructed him to report to headquarters immediately.
examples.zh: 那封信指示他立即向总部汇报。

items.def: (formal) to give an official order:
items.zh: 指正式发出指示、命令

examples.en: The judge directed the jury to return a verdict of not guilty.
examples.zh: 法官指示陪审团作出无罪裁决。

items.def: to use your position of authority to tell somebody to do something:

examples.en: He commanded his men to retreat.
examples.zh: 他命令手下撤退。

examples.zh: 写的东西不要超过 200 字。

items.zh: 指词语、术语、措辞

examples.en: technical/​legal/​scientific terms
examples.zh: 专门／法律／科学用语

items.def: a group of words that have a particular meaning when used together:
items.zh: 指短语、词组、惯用法

examples.en: Who coined the phrase ‘fake news’?
examples.zh: 谁创造了 fake news（假新闻）这个词语？

items.def: a word or phrase:
items.zh: 指词语、措辞、表达方式

examples.en: He tends to use a lot of slang expressions that I’ve never heard before.
examples.zh: 他往往用许多我以前从未听说过的俚语。

items.def: a group of words whose meaning is different from the meanings of the individual words:
items.zh: 指习语、成语、惯用语

examples.en: ‘Let the cat out of the bag’ is an idiom meaning to tell a secret by mistake.
examples.zh: let the cat out of the bag（让猫从袋子里跑出来）为成语，意为无意中泄露秘密。

senses.def: (in an American school or college) a long piece of written work that a student does on a subject that is part of a course of study
senses.zh: （美国学校或大学的）学期论文

examples.en: I have a term paper due Wednesday.
examples.zh: 我周三要交一份学期论文。

examples.en: I wrote a term paper on eating disorders.
examples.zh: 我写了一篇关于饮食失调的学期论文。

senses.def: the period of time when classes are held at a school, college, or university, as opposed to the holidays

examples.en: I never went out in the evenings during term time.
examples.zh: 学期期间我晚上从不外出。

senses.def: done, happening or used during the period of time when classes are held at a school, college, or university, as opposed to the holidays

examples.en: Please give your term-time address.
examples.zh: 请提供你上学期间的住址。

senses.def: an offensive word for a woman who is thought to be very strict or trying in an unpleasant way to tell people what to do
a building or set of buildings at an airport where passengers arrive and leave

examples.en: A second terminal was opened last year.
examples.zh: 第二个航空站是去年开始运营的。

examples.en: Your flight leaves from Terminal 3.
examples.zh: 您的航班从 3 号航站楼起飞。

senses.def: a place, building or set of buildings where journeys by train, bus or boat begin or end
senses.zh: （火车、公共汽车或船的）终点站

examples.en: a railway/bus/ferry terminal
examples.zh: 铁路／公共汽车终点站；渡船码头

senses.def: a piece of equipment, usually consisting of a keyboard and a screen that joins the user to a central computer system

examples.en: Internet terminals have been installed at most libraries.
examples.zh: 大多数图书馆已经安装了因特网终端。

senses.def: a point at which connections can be made in an electric circuit

examples.en: a positive/negative terminal
examples.zh: 正极／负极端子

senses.def: that cannot be cured and will lead to death, often slowly

examples.en: He has terminal lung cancer.
examples.zh: 他患有晚期肺癌。

examples.en: The illness is usually terminal.
examples.zh: 这种病通常为不治之症。

examples.en: She's suffering from terminal (= very great) boredom.
examples.zh: 她现在感到烦得要死。

senses.def: suffering from an illness that cannot be cured and will lead to death

examples.en: a terminal patient
examples.zh: 晚期病人

senses.def: certain to get worse and come to an end
senses.zh: 不可救药的；无可挽回的

examples.en: The industry is in terminal decline.
examples.zh: 这个行业每况愈下，一蹶不振。

senses.def: at the end of something

examples.en: a terminal branch of a tree
examples.zh: 树顶枝条

examples.en: terminal examinations (= at the end of a course, etc.)
examples.zh: 期终考试

senses.def: the maximum speed that something falling through air, water or a gas can reach before the effect of gravity
in a way that cannot be cured and will lead to death, often slowly

examples.en: a hospice for the terminally ill
examples.zh: 绝症患者临终关怀医院

examples.en: a terminally dull film
examples.zh: 乏味得要死的电影

senses.def: to end; to make something end

examples.en: Your contract of employment terminates in December.
examples.zh: 你的聘约十二月份到期。

examples.en: The agreement was terminated immediately.
examples.zh: 那项协议立即被终止了。

examples.en: to terminate a pregnancy (= to perform or have an abortion)
examples.zh: 终止妊娠（堕胎）

senses.def: to end a journey

examples.en: This train terminates at London Victoria.
examples.zh: 这趟列车的终点站是伦敦维多利亚火车站。

senses.def: the act of ending something; the end of something

examples.en: Failure to comply with these conditions will result in termination of the contract.
examples.zh: 违反这些条款将导致合同终止。

senses.def: a medical operation to end a pregnancy

examples.en: She chose to have an early termination.
examples.zh: 她选择了早期终止妊娠。

senses.def: connected with the meanings of words, especially the technical words and expressions used in a particular subject

examples.en: Some terminological confusion surrounds the use of these words.
examples.zh: 这些词的使用存在一些术语混淆。

senses.def: the set of technical words or expressions used in a particular subject

examples.en: The article avoids using too much medical terminology.
examples.zh: 这篇文章避免使用过多的医学术语。

examples.en: The disagreement arose over a different use of terminology.
examples.zh: 分歧的缘起在于专门用语使用的不同。

examples.en: Scientists are constantly developing new terminologies.
examples.zh: 科学家不断发展新的专门用语。

examples.en: The outer walls, in building terminology, are ‘double skin’.
examples.zh: 用建筑学的术语来说，外层的墙是double skin。

intro.en: These are all terms for the words and expressions people use when they speak or write, or for a particular style of speaking or writing.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指措辞、用词或某种类型的言语。

items.def: a particular style of speaking or writing:
items.zh: 指某种类型的言语或语言

examples.en: Give your instructions in everyday language.
examples.zh: 用通俗的语言发布指令。

items.def: all the words that a person knows or uses, or all the words in a particular language; the words that people use when they are talking about a particular subject:
items.zh: 指一个人掌握或使用的词汇、某种语言的词汇、某一学科的词汇

examples.en: to have a wide/​limited vocabulary
examples.zh: 词汇丰富／有限

items.def: a way of expressing yourself or of saying something:
items.zh: 指表达方式、措辞、说法

examples.en: I’ll try to explain in simple terms.
examples.zh: 我会尽量讲得通俗易懂。

items.def: [usually sing.] the words that are used in a piece of writing or speech, especially when they have been carefully chosen:
items.zh: 指措辞、用词

examples.en: It was the standard form of wording for a consent letter.
examples.zh: 这是同意书的标准用词。

items.def: (rather formal) the set of technical words or expressions used in a particular subject:
items.zh: 指某学科的术语、专门用语

examples.en: medical terminology
examples.zh: 医学术语

senses.def: the last station at the end of a railway line or the last stop on a bus route
senses.zh: （铁路或公共汽车路线的）终点站

examples.en: It's the terminus for trains from the north.
examples.zh: 这是从北方驶来的火车的终点站。

senses.def: an insect that lives in organized groups, mainly in hot countries. Termites

examples.en: a termite colony
examples.zh: 白蚁群

senses.def: happening each term in a school, college, etc.

examples.en: termly reports
examples.zh: 学期报告

examples.en: to pay fees in termly instalments
examples.zh: 分期付款

senses.def: rules that you must agree to when you make a contract or an official agreement
senses.zh: （协议、合同或活动的）条款及细则

examples.en: Read the terms and conditions carefully before signing the contract.
examples.zh: 签署合同前请仔细阅读条款和条件。

senses.def: the limits that are set on what an official committee or report has been asked to do
senses.zh: （委员会或报告的）受委托权限，受权调查范围

examples.en: The matter, they decided, lay outside the commission's terms of reference.
examples.zh: 他们认定这个问题不在委员会受托权限之内。

senses.def: a bird with long pointed wings and a tail with two points that lives near the sea
the structure of a piece of music in three sections, in which the third section is the same as the first
relating to dancing
safe dry land, as contrasted with water or air
senses.zh: 安全的陆地，坚实的大地（与水和空中相对而言）

examples.en: After two days at sea, it was good to be back on terra firma again.
examples.zh: 在海上度过两天之后，又回到使人觉得坚实的陆地，真是惬意。

senses.def: a continuous row of similar houses that are joined together in one block

examples.en: 12 Albert Terrace
examples.zh: 艾伯特排房 12 号

senses.def: a flat, hard area, especially outside a house or restaurant, where you can sit, eat and enjoy the sun
senses.zh: （尤指房屋或餐馆外的）露天平台，阳台

examples.en: Close to the villa is a big pool with a sun terrace around it.
examples.zh: 别墅旁边是个大游泳池，四周有晒台。

examples.en: The view from the roof terrace is spectacular.
examples.zh: 屋顶露台的景色非常壮观。

examples.en: All rooms have a balcony or terrace.
examples.zh: 所有的房间都有阳台或露台。

senses.def: the wide steps where people can stand to watch the game
one of a series of flat areas of ground that are cut into the side of a hill like steps so that crops can be grown there

examples.en: The villagers had dug terraces in the hillside.
examples.zh: 村民在山坡上开出了梯田。

senses.def: used to describe houses that form part of a terrace
senses.zh: 排房的；排屋的；排屋对着的街道的

examples.en: a terraced cottage
examples.zh: 排房式小屋

examples.en: terraced housing
examples.zh: 排屋式住房

examples.en: terraced streets
examples.zh: 排房对着的街道

senses.def: having a series of flat areas of ground like steps cut into it

examples.en: a terraced garden
examples.zh: 梯坛式的花园

examples.en: a terraced hillside
examples.zh: 阶梯状的山坡。

senses.def: a house that is one of a row of houses that are joined together on each side
an area with wide steps where people can stand to watch the game
a slope or the side of a hill that has had flat areas like steps cut into it
senses.zh: 阶梯状坡地；阶梯形山坡

senses.def: red-brown clay

examples.en: terracotta pots/tiles/roofs
examples.zh: 陶罐/瓷砖/屋顶

senses.def: a red-brown colour
to make a planet more like Earth, so that people can live on it
senses.zh: 将（行星）地球化（以适合人类居住）

senses.def: used to refer to an area of land when you are mentioning its natural features, for example, if it is rough, flat, etc.

examples.en: difficult/rough/mountainous terrain
examples.zh: 难以通过的地带；崎岖不平的地形；山地

examples.en: They walked for miles across steep and inhospitable terrain.
examples.zh: 他们在陡峭而荒凉的地形上走了数英里。

intro.en: These are all words for areas away from towns and cities, with fields, woods and farms.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指远离城镇，有田野、树林和农场的地区。

items.def: (often the country) an area that is away from towns and cities, especially one with particular natural features:
items.zh: （常作 the country）尤指具有自然特征的乡下、乡村

examples.en: She lives in the country.
examples.zh: 她住在乡下。

items.def: everything that you can see when you look across a large area of land, especially in the country:
items.zh: 尤指乡村的风景或景色

examples.en: This pattern of woods and fields is typical of the English landscape.
examples.zh: 这种林地与田野的格局是典型的英格兰乡村景色。

items.def: land outside towns and cities, with fields, woods and farms. Countryside is usually used when you are talking about the beauty or peacefulness of a country area:
items.zh: countryside 通常用于强调乡村地区的美丽或宁静

items.def: (formal) land. Terrain is used when you are describing the natural features of an area, for example if it is rough, flat, etc:
items.zh: terrain 用于描述某地区的地形或地势

items.def: (usually the land) the countryside; the way people live in the country as opposed to in towns and cities:
items.zh: （通常作 the land）指与城镇相对的农村、农村生活方式

examples.en: Many younger people are leaving the land to find work in the cities.
examples.zh: 许多较年轻的人陆续离开农村到城市去找工作。

items.def: the natural features of an area, such as mountains, valleys, rivers and forests, especially when these are attractive to look at:
items.zh: 指自然风景、景色、风光

examples.en: We stopped on the mountain pass to admire the scenery.
examples.zh: 我们在山口停下来欣赏风景。

senses.def: an outdoor area with special features designed for winter sports, especially snowboarding
senses.zh: 地形公园（为单板滑雪等冬季户外运动特别设计的场地）

examples.en: The terrain park now has bigger jumps and more excitement for skiers and snowboarders.
examples.zh: 地形公园现在为滑雪者和单板滑雪者提供了更大的跳跃和更多的刺激。

examples.en: The terrain park is closed for the summer.
examples.zh: 地形公园夏季关闭。

examples.en: a family-friendly terrain park
examples.zh: 适合家庭的地形公园

senses.def: a small turtle
senses.zh: 水龟（生活在北美温带江河湖泊中）

senses.def: a glass container for growing plants in or for keeping small animals such as snakes or insects in
living on the land or on the ground, rather than in water, in trees or in the air

examples.en: a terrestrial habitat
examples.zh: 陆上栖息地

senses.def: connected with the planet Earth

examples.en: terrestrial life
examples.zh: 地球上的生物

senses.def: operating by using equipment on the surface of the earth, rather than sending the signal via a satellite
senses.zh: 陆地上的，地面上的（与卫星相对而言）

senses.def: very unpleasant; making you feel very unhappy, upset or frightened
senses.zh: 非常讨厌的；令人极不快的；可怕的

examples.en: a terrible experience
examples.zh: 令人极不愉快的经历

examples.en: What terrible news!
examples.zh: 多么骇人听闻的消息！

examples.en: I've just had a terrible thought.
examples.zh: 我刚刚产生了一个可怕的念头。

examples.en: It was a terrible thing to happen to someone so young.
examples.zh: 这件事发生在这么年轻的人身上真是太可怕了。

examples.en: That’s a terrible thing to say!
examples.zh: 说这话太难听了！

examples.en: It smells terrible in here.
examples.zh: 这里的气味很难闻。

examples.en: It must have been terrible to witness the accident.
examples.zh: 亲眼目睹这起事故一定很可怕。

senses.def: causing great harm or injury; very serious
senses.zh: 危害极大的；造成极大伤害的；非常严重的

examples.en: a terrible accident
examples.zh: 重大事故

examples.en: He had suffered terrible injuries.
examples.zh: 他受了重伤。

examples.en: I'll have to stay with her—she's in a terrible state.
examples.zh: 我得陪着她－她的状态很不好。

examples.en: The storm was terrible and caused a lot of damage.
examples.zh: 暴风雨非常可怕，造成了很大的损失。

senses.def: unhappy or ill

examples.en: I feel terrible—I think I'll go to bed.
examples.zh: 我觉得难受，想去睡觉了。

examples.en: You look terrible, you'd better sit down.
examples.zh: 你看起来很糟糕，你最好坐下来。

senses.def: of very bad quality; very bad

examples.en: a terrible meal
examples.zh: 劣质餐食

examples.en: Your driving is terrible!
examples.zh: 你的驾驶技术真是糟糕透了！

examples.en: I have a terrible memory for names.
examples.zh: 我记名字很差劲。

examples.en: Cyclists claim that most city streets are in terrible condition.
examples.zh: 骑自行车的人声称大多数城市街道的状况都很糟糕。

senses.def: used to show the great extent or degree of something bad

examples.en: a terrible mistake
examples.zh: 严重的错误

examples.en: to be in terrible pain
examples.zh: 处于极度痛苦之中

examples.en: The room was in a terrible mess.
examples.zh: 房间里脏乱不堪。

examples.en: It was a terrible tragedy.
examples.zh: 这是一场可怕的悲剧。

examples.en: I had a terrible job (= it was very difficult) to persuade her to come.
examples.zh: 为劝她来，我费尽了口舌。

examples.en: You’ll be in terrible trouble if you’re late again.
examples.zh: 如果你再迟到，你的麻烦就大了。

examples.en: Sometimes the pain is so terrible I can't sleep.
examples.zh: 有时疼痛太厉害了，我无法入睡。

intro.en: These words all describe something that is very unpleasant.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指事物令人不快的。

items.def: very bad or unpleasant; making you feel unhappy, frightened, upset, ill, guilty or disapproving:
items.zh: 指糟透了的、非常讨厌的、令人极不快的、可怕的、骇人的

examples.en: What terrible news!
examples.zh: 多么骇人听闻的消息！

items.def: (rather informal) very bad or unpleasant; used to describe something that you do not like or that makes you feel depressed, ill, guilty or disapproving:
items.zh: 指很坏的、极讨厌的（用以形容令人沮丧、不舒服、内疚或不高兴的事物）

examples.en: That’s an awful colour.
examples.zh: 那颜色难看得很。

items.def: (rather informal) very unpleasant; used to describe something that you do not like:
items.zh: 指极坏的、十分讨厌的（用以形容令人不快的事物）

examples.en: The coffee tasted horrible.
examples.zh: 这咖啡难喝极了。

items.def: (especially British English尤用于英式英语, rather informal) very bad or unpleasant; used to describe something that you do not like or that you disapprove of:
items.zh: 指糟糕透顶的、讨厌的（用以形容令人不快或反对的事物）

examples.en: What dreadful weather!
examples.zh: 多么讨厌的天气！

items.def: (informal) extremely bad or unpleasant:
items.zh: 指糟糕透顶的、可恶的、极坏的

examples.en: There was a vile smell coming from the room.
examples.zh: 房间里传来令人恶心的气味。

items.def: (rather informal) extremely unpleasant and unacceptable:
items.zh: 指讨厌得难以容忍的

examples.en: The traffic around the city was horrendous.
examples.zh: 城里的交通糟透了。

senses.def: very

examples.en: I'm terribly sorry—did I hurt you?
examples.zh: 非常抱歉，我伤着您了吗？

examples.en: It's terribly important for parents to be consistent.
examples.zh: 父母要做到始终如一，这是极为重要的。

examples.en: I’m not terribly interested in politics.
examples.zh: 我对政治不太感兴趣。

senses.def: very much; very badly

examples.en: I miss him terribly.
examples.zh: 我非常思念他。

examples.en: They suffered terribly when their son was killed.
examples.zh: 儿子遇难之后，他们悲痛欲绝。

examples.en: The experiment went terribly wrong.
examples.zh: 这次实验出了大问题。

examples.en: Would you mind terribly if I didn’t come today?
examples.zh: 如果我今天不来，你会非常介意吗？

senses.def: a small active dog. There are many types of terrier
senses.zh: 梗犬（一种活泼的小型犬）

senses.def: excellent; wonderful
senses.zh: 极好的；绝妙的；了不起的

examples.en: I feel absolutely terrific today!
examples.zh: 我今天的感觉真是好极了！

examples.en: She's doing a terrific job.
examples.zh: 她活儿干得真棒。

examples.en: You look terrific in that dress.
examples.zh: 你穿那件衣服看起来棒极了。

examples.en: He was really terrific when I was in trouble.
examples.zh: 当我遇到困难时，他真的很棒。

examples.en: That’s terrific news!
examples.zh: 这真是个好消息！

examples.en: So nobody’s coming. Terrific!
examples.zh: 所以没人来。了不起！

senses.def: very large; very great
senses.zh: 很大的；巨大的；异乎寻常的

examples.en: I've got a terrific amount of work to do.
examples.zh: 我有大量的工作要做。

examples.en: We drove along at a terrific speed.
examples.zh: 我们以极快的速度驱车行驶。

synonyms.words: cool ▪ fantastic ▪ fabulous ▪ terrific ▪ brilliant ▪ awesome ▪ epic

intro.en: These are all informal words that describe somebody/​something that is very good, impressive, great fun, etc.
intro.zh: 以上各词均为非正式用语，表示美妙的、令人惊叹的、极好玩的等。

items.def: (informal非正式用语) very good; giving a lot of pleasure:
items.zh: 指美妙的、好极的、使人快乐的

examples.en: We had a great time in Madrid.
examples.zh: 我们在马德里玩得很开心。

items.def: (informal非正式用语) used to show that you admire or approve of something, often because it is fashionable, attractive or different:
items.zh: 指因时髦、漂亮或与众不同而令人钦佩的、绝妙的、顶呱呱的

examples.en: I think their new song’s really cool.
examples.zh: 我认为他们的新歌棒极了。

items.def: (informal非正式用语) extremely good; giving a lot of pleasure:
items.zh: 指极好的、了不起的、非常愉快的

examples.en: ‘How was your holiday?’ ‘Fantastic!’
examples.zh: “你假期过得好吗？”“棒极了！”

items.def: (informal非正式用语) extremely good:Jane’s a fabulous cook.简的烹饪技巧堪称一绝。 (Fabulous is slightly more old-fashioned than the other words in this set.)
items.zh: fabulous 较这组词中的其他词稍显过时。

examples.en: Jane’s a fabulous cook.
examples.zh: 简的烹饪技巧堪称一绝。

items.def: (informal非正式用语) extremely good; wonderful:
items.zh: 指极好的、绝妙的、了不起的

examples.en: She’s doing a terrific job.
examples.zh: 她活儿干得真棒。

items.def: (British English, informal英式英语，非正式用语) extremely good; wonderful:
items.zh: 指极好的、绝妙的、了不起的

examples.en: ‘How was the show?’ ‘Brilliant!’
examples.zh: “演出怎么样？”“棒极了！”

items.def: (informal, especially North American English非正式用语，尤用于美式英语) very good, impressive or great fun:
items.zh: 指极好的、令人惊叹的、极好玩的

examples.en: The show was just awesome.
examples.zh: 演出实在棒极了。

items.def: (informal非正式用语) very good, impressive or great fun:
items.zh: 指极好的、令人惊叹的、极好玩的

examples.en: The adventure and action are truly epic in scope.
examples.zh: 惊险刺激的动作场面的确壮观。

senses.def: extremely (usually used about positive qualities)
senses.zh: 极其，非常（通常用于正面性质）

examples.en: terrifically exciting
examples.zh: 极其令人兴奋

senses.def: to make somebody feel extremely frightened
senses.zh: 使恐惧；使十分害怕；使惊恐

examples.en: Flying terrifies her.
examples.zh: 她害怕坐飞机。

examples.en: Stop it! You’re terrifying the children!
examples.zh: 停下来！你吓坏了孩子们！

examples.en: He terrified employees at the bank into handing over cash.
examples.zh: 他恐吓银行职员交出现金。

intro.en: These words all mean to make somebody afraid.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含使害怕、使恐惧之义。

items.def: to make somebody feel afraid, often suddenly:
items.zh: 指（常突如其来地）使惊吓、使惊恐

examples.en: He brought out a gun and frightened them off.
examples.zh: 他掏出一把枪，把他们吓跑了。

items.def: to make somebody feel afraid:
items.zh: 指使害怕、使恐惧

examples.en: They managed to scare the bears away.
examples.zh: 他们设法把那些熊吓跑了。

items.def: to make somebody anxious or afraid:
items.zh: 指使惊恐、使害怕、使担心

examples.en: It alarms me that nobody takes this problem seriously.
examples.zh: 谁都不认真对待这个问题，我非常担心。

items.def: to make somebody feel extremely afraid:
items.zh: 指使恐惧、使十分害怕、使惊吓

examples.en: Flying terrified her.
examples.zh: 她害怕坐飞机。

senses.def: in a way that makes somebody feel extremely frightened
senses.zh: 使恐惧；使十分害怕；使惊吓

examples.en: The mountain roads are terrifyingly steep.
examples.zh: 山路陡峭得可怕。

senses.def: a soft mixture of meat or fish, etc. cut into small pieces, pressed into a container and served cold, especially in slices as the first course of a meal
connected with the land or sea that is owned by a particular country

examples.en: territorial disputes
examples.zh: 领土争端

examples.en: Both countries feel they have territorial claims to (= have a right to own) the islands.
examples.zh: 两个国家都认为自己对这些岛屿拥有主权。

senses.def: guarding and defending an area of land that they believe to be their own

examples.en: territorial instincts
examples.zh: 领域性本能

examples.en: Cats are very territorial.
examples.zh: 猫的领域性很强。

senses.def: (in the UK) a member of the Territorial Army
the parts of a sea or an ocean that are near a country’s coast and are legally under its control

examples.en: The dumping of industrial waste will be prohibited outside territorial waters.
examples.zh: 禁止向领海以外倾倒工业废物。

senses.def: the desire in animals, birds, etc, to guard and defend an area of land that they believe to be their own

examples.en: the instinctive territoriality of some animals
examples.zh: 某些动物本能的领地意识

senses.def: in a way that is connected with the land or sea that is owned by a particular country

examples.en: The country was trying to expand territorially.
examples.zh: 这个国家在设法扩张领土。

senses.def: in the way that animals, birds, etc. try to guard and defend an area of land that they believe to be their own

examples.en: Larger packs are more territorially aggressive than smaller packs.
examples.zh: 较大的狼群比较小的狼群更具领土攻击性。

senses.def: land that is under the control of a particular country or political leader

examples.en: enemy/disputed/foreign territory
examples.zh: 敌方／有争议的／外国领土

examples.en: occupied territories
examples.zh: 被占领的土地

examples.en: They have refused to allow UN troops to be stationed in their territory.
examples.zh: 他们拒不允许联合国部队驻扎在他们的国土上。

senses.def: an area that one person, group, animal, etc. considers as their own and defends against others who try to enter it
senses.zh: （个人、群体、动物等占据的）领域，管区，地盘

examples.en: Blackbirds will defend their territory against intruders.
examples.zh: 乌鸫会保护自己的地盘，不允许外来者侵入。

examples.en: She seems to regard that end of the office as her territory.
examples.zh: 她似乎把办公室的那一头看成是她的领地了。

examples.en: Each of these gangs has its own territory.
examples.zh: 每个帮派都有自己的地盘。

senses.def: an area of activity, especially one that is familiar/unfamiliar or somebody's particular responsibility
senses.zh: 活动范围，领域（尤指所熟悉或不熟悉的，或某人的职责）

examples.en: This type of work is uncharted territory for us.
examples.zh: 我们从未涉足过这类工作。

examples.en: Legal problems are Andy's territory (= he deals with them).
examples.zh: 法律问题由安迪负责处理。

senses.def: an area of a town, country, etc. that somebody has responsibility for in their work or another activity

examples.en: Our representatives cover a very large territory.
examples.zh: 我们的代理人负责的地区很广。

senses.def: a particular type of land

examples.en: unexplored territory
examples.zh: 未勘察地区

senses.def: a country or an area that is part of the US, Australia, Canada or India but is not a state or province
senses.zh: （美国）领地；（澳大利亚）地区；（加拿大）地区

examples.en: Guam and American Samoa are US territories.
examples.zh: 关岛和美属萨摩亚是美国的领地。

senses.def: to be a normal and accepted part of a particular job, situation, etc.
senses.zh: 成为必然的部分（或结果）

examples.en: She has to work late most days, but in her kind of job that goes with the territory.
examples.zh: 她在大部分日子里都得加班，但根据她的工作性质，这是不可避免的。

senses.def: in a place that has no connection with either of the people or sides who are meeting and so does not give an advantage to either of them
senses.zh: 在中立地区；在第三方地区

examples.en: We decided to meet on neutral territory.
examples.zh: 我们决定在中立地区会面。

senses.def: to be a normal and accepted part of a particular job, situation, etc.
senses.zh: 成为必然的部分（或结果）

examples.en: She has to work late most days, but in her kind of job that goes with the territory.
examples.zh: 她在大部分日子里都得加班，但根据她的工作性质，这是不可避免的。

senses.def: in a place that has no connection with either of the people or sides who are meeting and so does not give an advantage to either of them
senses.zh: 在中立地区；在第三方地区

examples.en: We decided to meet on neutral territory.
examples.zh: 我们决定在中立地区会面。

senses.def: a feeling of extreme fear

examples.en: a feeling of sheer/pure terror
examples.zh: 胆战心惊

examples.en: Her eyes were wild with terror.
examples.zh: 她的眼睛里充满了恐惧。

examples.en: People fled from the explosion in terror.
examples.zh: 人们惊恐地逃离爆炸现场。

examples.en: He lives in terror of (= is constantly afraid of) losing his job.
examples.zh: 他一直胆战心惊地害怕丢了工作。

examples.en: Some women have a terror of losing control in the birth process.
examples.zh: 有些妇女惧怕在分娩过程中失去控制。

examples.en: The very name of the enemy struck terror into their hearts.
examples.zh: 他们一听到敌人的名字就心惊胆战。

senses.def: a person, situation or thing that makes you very afraid
senses.zh: 可怕的人；恐怖的事；可怕的情况

examples.en: These street gangs have become the terror of the neighbourhood.
examples.zh: 这些街头少年团伙使得周围邻里谈之色变。

examples.en: The terrors of the night were past.
examples.zh: 夜间那些恐怖的事情都已经成为过去。

examples.en: Death holds no terrors for (= does not frighten or worry) me.
examples.zh: 死神是吓不倒我的。

senses.def: violent action or the threat of violent action that is intended to cause fear, usually for political purposes
senses.zh: （通常出于政治目的）恐怖行动，恐怖

examples.en: a campaign of terror
examples.zh: 恐怖运动

examples.en: terror tactics/groups
examples.zh: 恐怖手段／组织

examples.en: The president declared a war on terror (= a campaign against the use of terror).
examples.zh: 总统宣布反恐战争（=反对使用恐怖的运动）。

senses.def: a person (usually a child) or an animal that causes you trouble or is difficult to control

examples.en: Their kids are real little terrors.
examples.zh: 他们的小孩都是十足的讨厌鬼。

intro.en: These are all words for the bad feeling you have when you are afraid.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示害怕时的恐慌情绪。

items.def: the bad feeling that you have when you are in danger or when a particular thing frightens you:
items.zh: 害怕；惧怕

examples.en: (a) fear of flying
examples.zh: 害怕坐飞机

items.def: a feeling of extreme fear:
items.zh: 指惊恐、恐惧、惊骇

examples.en: Her eyes were wild with terror.
examples.zh: 她的眼睛里充满了恐惧。

items.def: a sudden feeling of great fear that cannot be controlled and prevents you from thinking clearly:
items.zh: 指惊恐、恐慌

examples.en: I had a sudden moment of panic.
examples.zh: 我突然一阵惊慌。

items.def: fear or worry that somebody feels when something dangerous or unpleasant might happen:
items.zh: 指惊恐、惊慌、恐慌

examples.en: The doctor said there was no cause for alarm.
examples.zh: 医生说不必惊慌。

items.def: a feeling of fear, usually sudden:
items.zh: 通常指突如其来的惊吓、恐怖

examples.en: She cried out in fright.
examples.zh: 她吓得大声叫喊。

senses.def: extremely frightened
senses.zh: 胆战心惊的；惊恐万状的

senses.def: the use of violent action in order to achieve political aims or to force a government to act

examples.en: an act of terrorism
examples.zh: 恐怖主义行动

examples.en: the fight against terrorism
examples.zh: 反对恐怖主义的斗争

examples.en: The government has sworn to do everything in its power to combat terrorism.
examples.zh: 政府已发誓将竭尽全力打击恐怖主义。

senses.def: a person who takes part in terrorism

examples.en: The terrorists are threatening to blow up the plane.
examples.zh: 恐怖分子扬言要炸毁飞机。

examples.en: a terrorist attack/bomb/group
examples.zh: 恐怖分子的袭击／炸弹／团体

senses.def: to frighten and threaten people so that they will not oppose something or will do as they are told

examples.en: drug dealers terrorizing the neighbourhood
examples.zh: 使附近地区人心惶惶的毒品贩子

examples.en: People were terrorized into leaving their homes.
examples.zh: 人们在恫吓之下离开家园。

senses.def: a type of soft cotton cloth that has a surface covered with raised loops
senses.zh: 毛圈棉织物（多用以做毛巾）

senses.def: a first name for boys or girls, short for Terence
senses.zh: 特里（男子或女子名，Terence 或 Teresa缩写）

senses.def: (1948-2015) an English author. His best-known books are humorous novels about Discworld, a strange, flat planet where imaginary beings such as witches
senses.zh: 特里·普拉切特（Terry Pratchett）：（ 1948-2015年）英语作家。他最著名的书是关于碟形世界的幽默小说，碟形世界是一个奇怪而扁平的星球，生活着想象中的生物，例如女巫和巨龙。其中包括《魔术的色彩》（The Color of Magic，1983），《小众神》（Small Gods，1992）和鼻烟壶（Snuff）（2011）。

senses.def: (1938-2016) an Irish radio and television presenter
senses.zh: 特里·沃根（Terry Wogan）：（1938-2016）爱尔兰广播和电视节目主持人。他是1967年第一台广播电台的第一位唱片骑师，后来在BBC电视台（1984-92年）进行了自己的聊天节目。他在英国广播公司第二台电台（WBC）上进行了早间节目（Wake Up to Wogan，1993-2009年），并在欧洲电视歌唱大赛（1971-2008年）的英国电视节目中担任主持人，并在节目中轻轻地取笑了整个活动。他在2005年被任命为骑士。

senses.def: using few words and often not seeming polite or friendly

examples.en: a terse style
examples.zh: 生硬冷漠的风格

examples.en: The president issued a terse statement denying the charges.
examples.zh: 总统发表了一份简短的声明，否认那些指控。

examples.en: Although he was terse, he didn’t rage at me.
examples.zh: 虽然他很简短，但他并没有对我发脾气。

senses.def: in a way that uses few words and often does not seem polite or friendly

examples.en: ‘I won’t,’ he replied tersely.
examples.zh: “我不会，”他简洁地回答。

senses.def: the fact of using few words and often not seeming polite or friendly
third in order, rank or importance
senses.zh: 第三的；第三位的；第三级的

examples.en: the tertiary sector (= the area of industry that deals with services)
examples.zh: 第三产业部门

senses.def: a college that provides education for people aged 16 and older, but that is not a university
senses.zh: 职业专科学校（为 16 岁以上的人提供教育的学院，但并非大学）

senses.def: education for people above school age, including college, university and training courses for particular jobs
senses.zh: 第三级教育，中学后教育（包括学院、大学和职业培训）

examples.en: The policy improves access to tertiary education.
examples.zh: 该政策改善了接受高等教育的机会。

senses.def: the part of a country’s economy that provides services
a light strong artificial material, used for making clothes, etc.
a British newspaper published each week, originally by the company that owned The Times
senses.zh: 每周发行的英国报纸，最初由拥有《泰晤士报》的公司发行。它适用于教师和其他参与教育的人员，其中包含有关教育问题的文章和用于教师职业的广告。它于1910年首次发布。TES网站提供工作广告，教学资源和论坛，教师可以在其中讨论实践并互相提供建议和支持。

senses.def: one of Britain's largest chains of supermarkets. It was started by Jack Cohen (1898-1979), a Jewish immigrant who started selling tea in a market in the East End
senses.zh: 乐购英国大型连锁超市。由犹太移民杰克•科恩(1898-1979)创办。第一次世界大战刚结束，科恩便开始在伦敦东区的一个市场卖茶叶。Tesco这个名称最早于1924年用于他出售的一个茶叶品牌。该名称由茶叶公司合伙人T•E•Stockwell的姓名首字母和科恩(Cohen)自己名字的前两个字母所组成。1929年，科恩在伦敦开了一家食品店。到第二次世界大战开始时，在伦敦市内和周边地区已有多家乐购商店。20世纪70年代，乐购超市开始出现，现在有数千家超市分布在英国大多数城镇的市内或近郊。最大规模的乐购超市不仅出售食品，还卖衣服和家居用品，并提供其他服务。1997年，乐购创办了自己的银行。2003年，乐购开始提供手机通信服务。世界上许多国家都有乐购的门店。

examples.en: I buy most of my food at Tesco.
examples.zh: 我大部分食品都在乐购买。

examples.en: There's a new Tesco's opening near us.
examples.zh: 我们家附近新开了一家乐购超市。

senses.def: teaching English as a second language
senses.zh: 作为第二语言的英语教学

senses.def: teaching English to speakers of other languages
senses.zh: 对母语为非英语人士的英语教学

senses.def: teachers of English to speakers of other languages (an organization of teachers)
a first name for girls, short for Teresa
a novel (1891) by Thomas Hardy
senses.zh: 德伯家的苔丝：托马斯·哈迪（Thomas Hardy）的小说（1891）。它讲述了一个年轻女子苔丝的悲惨故事，以及她与两个男人的关系遇到的麻烦。她与一个人结婚而杀死另一人，为此被绞死。该书首次出版时结局不佳，令许多读者感到震惊。

senses.def: a first name for girls, sometimes short for Teresa
senses.zh: 特莎（女子名，有时是 Terasa 缩写）

senses.def: (1947-2018) a British Labour politician. She became a Member of Parliament
senses.zh: 泰莎·乔威尔（Tessa Jowell）：（ 1947-2018年）英国工党政治家。她于1992年成为国会议员。从2001年至2007年，她担任文化，媒体和体育事务大臣，负责改革赌博和许可法律，并决定将来如何支付BBC费用。2007年，她成为奥运会大臣，伦敦大臣和Paymaster General，2009年成为内阁办公室大臣。她在2015年成为终身同龄人。

senses.def: made from small flat pieces arranged in a pattern
senses.zh: 镶嵌铺面小块的；镶嵌花样的

examples.en: a tessellated pavement
examples.zh: 嵌花地面

senses.def: an arrangement of shapes fitted closely together with no spaces in between, especially in a repeated pattern; the act of arranging something in this way

examples.en: a tessellation of eleven different geometric shapes
examples.zh: 十一种不同几何形状的镶嵌

examples.en: When did your interest in tessellation and optical illusions begin?
examples.zh: 您什么时候开始对镶嵌和视错觉产生兴趣的？

senses.def: the range of notes that are used in a singing part
senses.zh: 唱歌声部中使用的音符范围

senses.def: an examination of somebody’s knowledge or ability, consisting of questions for them to answer or activities for them to perform

examples.en: an IQ test
examples.zh: 智商测试

examples.en: a test on irregular verbs
examples.zh: 不规则动词测验

examples.en: Students take standardized tests in English and maths.
examples.zh: 学生们参加英语和数学标准化测试。

examples.en: to do a test
examples.zh: 参加测验

examples.en: to pass/fail a test
examples.zh: 通过／没有通过测验

examples.en: a good mark in the test
examples.zh: 测验中取得的高分

examples.en: a good score on the test
examples.zh: 优良的测验成绩

senses.def: a medical examination to discover what is wrong with you or to check the condition of your health

examples.en: The hospital is doing some tests.
examples.zh: 医院正在做一些检查。

examples.en: We'll need to perform a series of tests.
examples.zh: 我们需要执行一系列测试。

examples.en: screening tests for cancer
examples.zh: 癌症筛查

examples.en: Three athletes were sent home after failing drugs tests.
examples.zh: 三名运动员因药检不过关被送回国。

examples.en: The pregnancy test was positive.
examples.zh: 妊娠试验呈阳性。

examples.en: negative/positive test results
examples.zh: 阴性／阳性检测结果

senses.def: an experiment to discover whether or how well something works, or to find out more information about it

examples.en: the results of laboratory tests
examples.zh: 实验室测试结果

examples.en: to conduct a nuclear test
examples.zh: 进行核试验

examples.en: Tests have shown high levels of pollutants in the water.
examples.zh: 测试显示水中污染物质的含量很高。

examples.en: I'll run a diagnostic test to determine why the server keeps crashing.
examples.zh: 我要做诊断测试，弄清为什么服务器总是不断地发生故障。

senses.group: of machine/product, etc. 机器、产品等

senses.def: a situation or an event that shows how good, strong, etc. somebody/something is

examples.en: The local elections will be a good test of the government's popularity.
examples.zh: 地方选举将是检验政府是否得人心的一个很好的试金石。

examples.en: He saw their separation as a test of the strength of their love.
examples.zh: 他认为他们的分离是对他们爱情强度的考验。

senses.def: a cricket
senses.zh: （板球或橄榄球的）各国家队间的决赛阶段比赛

examples.en: They played well in the first Test against South Africa.
examples.zh: 他们在对南非的第一场国际锦标赛中打得不错。

examples.en: He will be first choice for the opening test against the All Blacks.
examples.zh: 他将成为对阵全黑队的首场测试的首选。

senses.def: to put somebody/something in a situation that will show what their or its true qualities are

examples.en: His theories have never really been put to the test.
examples.zh: 他的理论从未真正经受过检验。

examples.en: The latest pay dispute has really put her management skills to the test.
examples.zh: 最近的薪酬纠纷确实让她的管理才能受到了考验。

senses.def: to prove to be good, popular, etc. over a long period of time

examples.en: Whether this new technology will stand the test of time remains to be seen.
examples.zh: 这种新技术能否经得起时间的考验仍需拭目以待。

senses.def: to teach students only what is necessary in order to pass a particular test, rather than help them develop a range of skills
senses.zh: 应试教育；为考试而教学

senses.def: to find out how much somebody knows, or what they can do by asking them questions or giving them activities to perform

examples.en: Students will be tested at the end of each module.
examples.zh: 学生将在每个模块结束时接受测试。

examples.en: Children are tested on core subjects at age 11.
examples.zh: 儿童在 11 岁时要接受核心课程的测验。

examples.en: We test all students in English and maths.
examples.zh: 我们测验所有学生的英语和数学。

examples.en: Applicants' skills, ability and knowledge are tested before job offers are made.
examples.zh: 工作聘书发出前要对申请者的技术、能力、知识进行考查。

examples.en: We test your English before deciding which class to put you in.
examples.zh: 我们测验过你的英语后再决定把你分在哪一班。

senses.def: to perform well/badly in a test of knowledge or ability
senses.zh: 在知识或能力测试中表现不错／糟糕

examples.en: students who tested well in reading
examples.zh: 阅读测试考得好的学生

senses.zh: 至高无上的法案：1534年的国会法案，使亨利八世国王成为英格兰教会的负责人。这使教皇在英格兰失去了权力。

senses.def: either of two Acts of Parliament
senses.zh: 联盟法案：两项议会法案之一。1707年的第一部《联合法案》正式加入了英格兰和苏格兰，成为英国的一个王国，由伦敦议会统治。1800年的第二部《联合法案》将爱尔兰加入了这组国家，然后被称为大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国。

senses.def: a school in New York for professional actors. It was begun in 1947 by Elia Kazan
senses.zh: 演员工作室：位于纽约的专业演员学校。它由Elia Kazan，Robert Lewis和Cheryl Crawford于1947年开始。在艺术总监李·斯特拉斯堡（Lee Strasberg）的领导下，它成为方法的中心，其许多著名的学生包括马龙·白兰度（Marlon Brando）和罗德·斯蒂格（Rod Steiger）。

senses.def: a British organization formed in 1977 to give economic advice to the British government, foreign governments and other groups. It was named after the 18th-century economist
senses.zh: 亚当·斯密研究所（Adam Smith Institute）：成立于1977年的英国组织，旨在为英国政府，外国政府和其他团体提供经济建议。它以18世纪经济学家亚当·史密斯（Adam Smith）的名字命名，并分享了他的许多想法（例如，关于减少国家参与社会和商业事务的重要性的重要性）。它尤其与1980年代和1990年代英国的保守党政府有关。

senses.def: a family of strange but funny cartoon characters who live in a large dark house and behave in an unusual way that suggests evil and death. They were created in 1935 in the New Yorker
senses.zh: 亚当斯一家（Addams Family）：一个奇怪但有趣的卡通人物家族，他们生活在一个大黑屋里，并且举止异常，暗示着邪恶和死亡。它们由Charles Addams于1935年在《纽约客》杂志上创建。这些角色被用于电视连续剧和三部电影（1991年，1993年和1998年）。

senses.def: a mountain range in the US state of New York, where the Hudson River
senses.zh: 阿迪朗达克山脉（Adirondack Mountains）：位于美国纽约州的哈德逊河（Hudson River）开始的山脉。游客被吸引到它的湖泊和森林，包括阿迪朗达克森林保护区。

senses.def: (in the UK in the past) the government department controlling the navy

examples.en: The Admiralty was/were determined to resolve the issue.
examples.zh: 海事部决心解决这个问题。

senses.def: an independent organization, founded in 1962, which checks that advertisements do not lie or make false claims about a product. Anyone can ask the Advertising Standards Authority
senses.zh: 广告标准局（Advertising Standards Authority）：成立于1962年的独立组织，负责检查广告是否包含谎言或对产品进行虚假声明。任何人都可以要求广告标准管理局调查广告。如果有问题，则管理局可以告诉公司进行更改或删除。

senses.def: a movement that developed in England in the late 1880s. It was based on the belief that art should exist as an independent idea, and not in order to support religion, the state, etc. This principle is most clearly expressed in the phrase ‘art for art's sake
senses.zh: 审美运动：1880年代后期在英格兰发展的运动。它基于这样的信念：艺术应该作为独立的思想存在，而不是为了支持宗教，国家等。这一原则在“为艺术而艺术”一词中得到了最清晰的表达。该运动受到拉斐尔前派和约翰·拉斯金的影响。它的支持者包括威廉·莫里斯，奥斯卡·王尔德和奥布里·比兹利。

senses.def: a period in Europe in the 18th century when many writers and thinkers
senses.zh: 启蒙时代；理性时代欧洲18世纪的一个时期。这个时期许多作家和思想家开始对国王或教会的权威等既定信仰提出质疑，主张理性和科学求证。人人平等并享有平等权利的观念开始形成。

senses.def: a phrase sometimes used to refer to the 18th and 19th centuries in Britain, when different types of steam engine were being invented and developed by people such as James Watt
senses.zh: 蒸汽时代：这个短语有时用来指代英国的18和19世纪，当时詹姆斯·沃特和乔治·史蒂芬森等人发明和开发了不同类型的蒸汽机。蒸汽机被用作工厂，轮船和火车的动力。英国的一些人为蒸汽时代的终结而感到遗憾，因为他们认为那时的生活会更加愉快和轻松。

senses.def: a British company that carries out research in agriculture
senses.zh: 农业发展和咨询服务：一家英国公司，为政府和其他客户进行农业研究，并就政策向政府提供建议

the-agricultural-development-and-advisor.word: the Agricultural Development and Advisory Service

senses.def: the fort
senses.zh: 阿拉莫堡：要塞（现在位于德克萨斯州圣安东尼奥），在那里约有4000名墨西哥士兵大军在1836年杀死了保卫它的所有187名德州人。戴维·克罗基特和詹姆斯·鲍伊在那里去世。“记住阿拉莫！” 成为得克萨斯州脱离墨西哥独立的著名呐喊。约翰·韦恩（John Wayne）执导并拍摄了一部关于这场战斗的影片，《阿拉莫》（1960年）。

senses.def: part of the old port of Liverpool
senses.zh: 阿尔伯特码头（Albert Dock）：英格兰利物浦旧港口的一部分，许多早期的维多利亚式建筑已被改建成餐厅和博物馆，包括泰特利物浦

senses.def: a large round concert hall in west London, which holds 8 000 people. It was built in 1868-71 in memory of Prince Albert
senses.zh: 阿尔伯特音乐厅：位于伦敦西部的大型圆形音乐厅，可容纳8000人。它建于1868-71年，以纪念阿尔伯特亲王。其中发生了各种音乐和体育赛事，但最著名的是举行舞会的音乐厅。

senses.def: a monument
senses.zh: 阿尔伯特纪念碑：位于伦敦阿尔伯特音乐厅对面的纪念碑，建于1860年代，以纪念阿尔伯特亲王

senses.def: a comedy play (1610) by Ben Jonson
senses.zh: 炼金术士：本·琼森（Ben Jonson）的一部喜剧剧（1610），讲述一个假装自己是炼金术士的人，目的是骗取人们的钱财。许多人认为这是琼森最伟大的作品。

senses.def: a music festival that takes place every summer in Aldeburgh, a small town in Suffolk
senses.zh: Aldeburgh音乐节：每年夏天在英格兰萨福克的一个小镇Aldeburgh举行的音乐节。这个节日是由居住在这里的本杰明·布里顿（Benjamin Britten）创立的。

senses.def: a theatre in the West End
senses.zh: 奥德维奇剧院（Aldwych Theatre）：伦敦西区的一家剧院，以奥德维奇（Aldwych）闹剧而著名，本·特拉弗斯（Ben Travers）的喜剧戏剧在1920年代和1930年代在那里演出。1960年至1982年，这里是皇家莎士比亚剧团的伦敦总部。

senses.def: about 150 islands spread over 1 200 miles/1 920 kilometres from the Alaskan Peninsula to Russia. About 8 000 people, mostly fishermen
senses.zh: 阿留申群岛由约150个岛组成，从阿拉斯加半岛绵延1 200余英里（约1 920公里）至俄罗斯。岛上约有8 000居民，大多为渔民。

senses.def: a series of four novels by Lawrence Durrell
senses.zh: 亚历山大四重奏：劳伦斯·杜雷尔（Lawrence Durrell）撰写的四本小说系列，讲述了1930年代埃及亚历山大亚历山大（Alexandria）一群朋友的复杂爱情事务。这四本书分别是Justine（1957），Balthazar（1958），Mountolive（1958）和Clea（1960）。该系列构成了杜勒尔最著名的作品。

senses.def: the informal name for a group of Americans known for their humour. They met regularly in the 1920s and 1930s at the Algonquin Hotel in New York, and the group included the writers Dorothy Parker
senses.zh: 阿冈昆圆桌会议：一群以幽默闻名的美国人的非正式名字。他们在1920年代和1930年代在纽约的Algonquin酒店定期聚会，小组成员包括作家Dorothy Parker和Robert Benchley。1994年，制作了关于该团体的电影，帕克太太和恶性循环。

senses.def: the Rugby Union
senses.zh: 全黑队（指新西兰国家橄榄球队）

senses.def: the tennis club in Wimbledon
senses.zh: 全英俱乐部：位于伦敦温布尔登的网球俱乐部，每年都会举行著名的网球比赛。它始于1868年的一个槌球俱乐部。

senses.def: a range of mountains that runs from south-west Virginia
senses.zh: 阿勒格尼山脉：从弗吉尼亚西南部到宾夕法尼亚州中部的山脉。它们是阿巴拉契亚中央山脉的一部分。

senses.def: a former British bank that had branches in many towns and cities. It was originally a building society
senses.zh: 一家前英国银行，在许多城镇设有分支机构。它最初是一个建筑协会，并于1997年成为一家银行。1990年，它接管了Girobank，2008年本身被桑坦德银行接管。2010年，Alliance＆Leicester分支机构更名为桑坦德银行。

senses.def: a political party formed in Northern Ireland in 1970 by people who disagreed with the extreme views of both Catholics and Protestants. The party's original aim was to end the Troubles
senses.zh: 同盟党：1970年在北爱尔兰成立的一个政党，他们不同意天主教徒和新教徒的极端观点。该党的最初目的是通过召集双方温和派人士结束这场麻烦。现在，它的主要目标之一是支持北爱尔兰的多样性（包括更广泛的人群）。

senses.def: American Medical Association
an organization that supports amateur
senses.zh: 业余田径协会：一个支持英国业余田径的组织。它始于1880年，当时仅针对男性，但1991年与女子业余田径协会合并。

senses.def: a non-profit
senses.zh: 业余运动联盟：支持业余运动的美国非营利组织。它成立于1888年。

senses.def: an international sailing contest, first held in 1851 and happening every three or four years. A US crew has won it almost every time, although there have also been wins for Australia, New Zealand and Switzerland.
senses.zh: 美洲杯：国际帆船比赛，始于1851年，每三，四年举行一次。尽管几乎在澳大利亚，新西兰和瑞士也获得了胜利，但美国机组人员几乎每次都赢得了胜利。

senses.def: a school for actors in New York City and, since 1974, in Los Angeles, California. It began in 1884 and is the oldest dramatic school in America.
senses.zh: 美国戏剧艺术学院：这是一所纽约市演员学校，自1974年以来，这所学校位于加利福尼亚的洛杉矶。它始于1884年，是美国最古老的戏剧学校。

the-american-academy-of-dramatic-arts.word: the American Academy of Dramatic Arts

senses.def: AARP

the-american-association-of-retired-pers.word: the American Association of Retired Persons

senses.def: a professional organization for US lawyers. It began in 1878 and has its main office in Chicago
senses.zh: 美国律师协会：美国律师的专业组织。它始于1878年，总部设在芝加哥。ABA鼓励法律标准，法律研究以及美国司法体系的改善。

senses.def: a US organization, founded in 1920, that defends the rights of people under the US Constitution. It was involved in the legal case in 1954 that ended the system of separate schools for African Americans. The ACLU
senses.zh: 美国公民自由联盟：成立于1920年的美国组织，根据美国宪法捍卫人民的权利。它参与了1954年的法律诉讼，该诉讼终止了针对非洲裔美国人的单独学校制。有时，美国公民自由联盟（ACLU）曾因捍卫所有人的自由而受到批评，例如1978年，它支持美国纳粹党的进军权利。最近，它反对在公立学校中进行祈祷，并且自9月11日以来，一直反对在国家紧急状态下减少公民权利。
