the-united-kingdom-atomic-energy-authori.word: the United Kingdom Atomic Energy Authority

senses.def: a former small British political party from 1995 to 2008. It was supported mainly by Protestants in Northern Ireland who wanted Northern Ireland to remain a part of the United Kingdom.
senses.zh: 英国联合党：1995年至2008年曾是英国小型政党。它主要得到北爱尔兰的新教徒的支持，他们希望北爱尔兰继续成为英国的一部分。

senses.def: an association of many countries that aims to improve economic and social conditions and to solve political problems in the world in a peaceful way

examples.en: The United Nations is/are asking for more aid.
examples.zh: 联合国正在寻求更多援助。

senses.def: the part of the United Nations that tries to keep peace and order in the world, consisting of representatives of fifteen countries
a US charity, established in 1944, which raises money to support private colleges and universities with mostly African American students. It also helps individual students.
senses.zh: 黑人大学联合基金会（United Negro College Fund）：美国慈善机构，成立于1944年，旨在为私立大学和大学提供资金，其中大多数是非裔美国学生。它还可以帮助个别学生。

senses.def: a Christian Church formed in Britain in 1972 when the Presbyterian
senses.zh: 联合改革教会：1972年在英国成立的基督教教会，当时英国的长老会与英格兰和威尔士的公理会合为一体。此后，又有另外两个教会团体加入该团体：1981年改组后的基督教堂和2000年的苏格兰公理会。

senses.def: USAID

the-united-states-agency-for-internation.word: the United States Agency for International Development
the-united-states-agency-for-internation.uk: /ðə juˌnaɪtɪd steɪts ˌeɪdʒənsi fər ɪntəˌnæʃnəl dɪˈveləpmənt/
the-united-states-agency-for-internation.us: /ðə juˌnaɪtɪd steɪts ˌeɪdʒənsi fər ɪntərˌnæʃnəl dɪˈveləpmənt/

senses.def: the university that trains officers for the US Air Force. It was established in 1954 in Colorado Springs
senses.zh: 美国空军学院：为美国空军训练人员的大学。它成立于1954年，位于科罗拉多州的科罗拉多斯普林斯，是美国最新的军事院校。

the-united-states-air-force-academy.word: the United States Air Force Academy

senses.def: the US military service that was controlled by the US Department of Transportation
senses.zh: 美国海岸警卫队：一直由美国运输部控制的美国兵役，直到2003年，现在是美国国土安全部的一部分。它最早成立于1790年，并于1915年获得现名。海岸警卫队制止了涉嫌运载毒品和其他非法物品的船只，并可以进行逮捕。它还随时注意遵守其他海洋法律，并救助处于危险中的人员和船只。

senses.def: USDA Forest Service
senses.zh: 美国森林服务局：USDA森林服务局

senses.def: a US government organization that was responsible for providing information about the US to other countries of the world, e.g. through libraries and cultural programmes. It also ran the Fulbright scholarship
senses.zh: 美国信息署：美国政府组织，负责通过例如图书馆和文化节目向世界其他国家提供有关美国的信息。它还运行富布赖特奖学金计划，并就其他国家对美国政策的看法向国家安全委员会提供建议。USIA成立于1948年，并于1999年成为国务院的一部分。

senses.def: a US armed service that is part of the Department of the Navy. It was established by Congress in 1798, and is now trained to fight at sea, on land and in the air. The Marines
senses.zh: 美国海军陆战队：隶属于海军部的美国武装部队。它由国会于1798年建立，现在经过了海上，陆地和空中战斗的训练。第二次世界大战期间，海军陆战队成功攻打了日军占领的太平洋岛屿，因此广为人知。他们还积极参加了朝鲜战争，越南战争，海湾战争以及伊拉克和阿富汗的战争。

senses.def: USMCA
senses.zh: 美国-墨西哥-加拿大协议：USMCA

senses.def: the military school that trains officers for the US Army. It is at West Point, New York, and was established by Congress
senses.zh: 美国军事学院；西点军校美军陆军培养军官的军校，位于纽约州的西点，1802年由国会创建。该校学生被称为士官生。曾在那里受训的美国著名将军包括罗伯特•E•李、尤利塞斯•S•格兰特、约翰•潘兴、德怀特•D•艾森豪威尔、乔治•巴顿、道格拉斯•麦克阿瑟和诺曼•施瓦茨科夫。

senses.def: the military school that trains officers for the US Navy and the US Marine Corps
senses.zh: 美国海军学院：训练美国海军和美国海军陆战队军官的军事学校。它于1845年在马里兰州的安纳波利斯成立。学生被称为中学生。

senses.def: a large country in North America consisting of 50 states and the District of Columbia
the upper house of the US Congress. There are 100 Senators
senses.zh: 美国参议院：美国国会上议院。有100名参议员（每个州两名参议员），当选为期六年。参议院和参议院都必须通过法律，但参议院在与外交政策有关的事务上负有特殊责任，并且也有权对总统的任命进行“咨询和同意”。

senses.def: the organization that deals with students wanting to apply to study at British universities and colleges. Students must complete a special form online, and may apply to a maximum of five institutions. Each institution then considers the requests and may offer students places. The website provides a search tool which lists all the courses available at British universities and colleges, and gives information about them. The only university that does not take part in the UCAS
senses.zh: 大学招生服务：该组织与希望申请在英国大学学习的学生打交道。学生必须在线填写特殊表格，并且最多可以申请五个机构。然后，每个机构都会考虑请求，并可以为学生提供名额。该网站提供了一个搜索工具，列出了英国大学和学院提供的所有课程，并提供了有关这些课程的信息。唯一不参与UCAS服务的大学是开放大学。

the-universities-and-colleges-admissions.word: the Universities and Colleges Admissions Service

senses.def: UCLA

the-university-of-california-los-angeles.word: the University of California, Los Angeles

senses.def: a university in London, started in 1836. It consists of a large number of colleges in different parts of the city, including the London School of Economics
senses.zh: 伦敦大学：伦敦的一所大学，始于1836年。它由伦敦不同地区的许多学院组成，其中包括伦敦经济学院和伦敦大学学院。这些学院和机构具有很大的独立性。伦敦是1878年英国第一所招收女性学位课程的大学。作为国际计划的一部分，伦敦大学的学生在世界各地学习和考试。

senses.def: a university in Manchester, north-west England. In 2004 it was established as the largest university of its kind in Britain when two universities, the Victoria University of Manchester and the University of Manchester Institute of Science and Technology (UMIST) combined.
senses.zh: 曼彻斯特大学：位于英格兰西北部曼彻斯特的一所大学。2004年，曼彻斯特维多利亚大学和曼彻斯特大学科学技术学院（UMIST）两所大学合并成立，成为英国最大的同类大学。

senses.def: the most famous Catholic university in the US. It is in South Bend, Indiana
senses.zh: 圣母大学：美国最著名的天主教大学。它成立于1842年，位于印第安纳州的南本德。巴黎圣母院拥有美国最著名的大学橄榄球队，有时也被称为“爱尔兰斗士”。

senses.def: a soldier who has been killed in a war, whose body has not been identified, and who is buried in special ceremony. The Unknown Soldier
senses.zh: 无名战士（在特别葬礼上埋葬的阵亡无名军人，象征某场或所有战争中的阵亡将士）

examples.en: the tomb of the Unknown Soldier
examples.zh: 无名战士墓

senses.def: a thing that is impossible to imagine or accept
senses.zh: 不可思议的事情：无法想象或接受的事物

examples.en: Suddenly the unthinkable happened and he drew out a gun.
examples.zh: 突然，难以置信的事情发生了，他掏出了一把枪。

examples.en: The time has come to think the unthinkable (= consider possibilities that used to be unacceptable).
examples.zh: 现在该开始考虑以前觉得难以想象的事情了。

senses.def: the popular name for the team of US Justice Department officers led by Eliot Ness
senses.zh: 由Eliot Ness领导的美国司法部官员团队的通俗名称。之所以给他们起这个名字，是因为人们认为他们太诚实了，无法接受非法付款。

senses.def: the groups of people that are considered to have the highest social status and that have more money and/or power than other people in society

examples.en: a member of the upper class/upper classes
examples.zh: 上流社会人士

examples.en: The upper classes have no automatic right to rule.
examples.zh: 上层阶级没有自动的统治权。

senses.def: the people who belong to the highest social class
senses.zh: 上流社会的人；上层人士；达官显贵

examples.en: The upper crust is/are willing and able to spend a huge amount on their children's education.
examples.zh: 上流社会愿意并且能够在孩子的教育上花费大量资金。

senses.def: the class of people in British society between the middle class
senses.zh: 中上层阶级：英国社会中上层阶级与上层阶级之间的阶级。它的成员包括公司董事，教授或大律师等具有较高社会地位并可能赚很多钱的人。但是，在现代英国，以这种方式识别人员的情况较不普遍。

examples.en: Even the upper middle class was/were feeling the effects of price rises.
examples.zh: 甚至上层中产阶级也感受到了物价上涨的影响。

senses.def: the final result of a series of events

examples.en: The upshot of it all was that he left college and got a job.
examples.zh: 这一切的最终结果是他离开大学并找了份工作。

senses.def: the National Urban League
senses.zh: 城市联盟：全国城市联盟

senses.def: Masters Tournament
senses.zh: （美国）（职业高尔夫）名人赛，大师赛

senses.def: a major US golf competition held each year at different places. It was first held in 1895.
senses.zh: 美国高尔夫球公开赛（美国重要的高尔夫球赛事，每年在不同地点举行，始于1895年）

senses.def: a US tennis competition held each year which is one of the sport's grand slam
senses.zh: 美国网球公开赛（美国年度网球比赛，大满贯赛事之一。首届公开比赛于1968年在纽约的森林小丘举行，1978年移至纽约的法拉盛草坪举行）

senses.def: a US law that was passed in 2001 following the September 11
senses.zh: 美国爱国者法案：9月11日袭击事件发生后于2001年通过的美国法律。全称是通过提供拦截和阻止恐怖主义法所需的适当工具来团结和加强美国。它增加了美国政府在打击恐怖主义方面的权力，包括允许美国政府在总检察长认为非美国公民对国家安全构成威胁的情况下，将其无限制地无限期监禁，而无需进行审判。公民自由组织曾强烈批评它。

senses.def: the organization controlled by the US Department of Agriculture
senses.zh: USDA森林服务局：由美国农业部控制的组织，负责保护和管理美国的森林和草原。它成立于1905年。它从事研究并为各个州和私人森林所有者提供教育计划和建议。森林服务处致力于预防和扑灭森林大火。

the-usda-forest-service.uk: /ðə ˌjuː es ˌdiː eɪ ˈfɒrɪst sɜːvɪs/
the-usda-forest-service.us: /ðə ˌjuː es ˌdiː eɪ ˈfɔːrɪst sɜːrvɪs/

senses.def: an organization that provides support for people serving in the US armed forces, and their families. It was started in 1941 and most of the people who work for it are volunteers. As well as social clubs and family support, the USO
senses.zh: 为在美国武装部队中服役的人员及其家人提供支持的组织。它始于1941年，为它工作的大多数人都是志愿者。除社交俱乐部和家庭支持外，USO还为在国外服务的士兵提供娱乐。鲍勃·霍普（Bob Hope）经常出现在USO节目中。

senses.def: a famous US Navy ship. Its popular name is 'Old Ironsides' because bullets could not pierce
senses.zh: USS宪法：美国著名的海军舰船。它的流行名称是“ Old Ironsides”，因为子弹无法刺穿其坚硬的橡木面。它于1797年在波士顿完成，并在1812年的战争中使用。当这艘船很旧时，有计划销毁它，但奥利弗·温德尔·福尔摩斯（Oliver Wendell Holmes）的诗《老铁杆》（Old Ironsides，1828年）引起了公众强烈反对该决定的感觉，因此得以保存。自1934年以来，《宪法》就在波士顿向公众开放。1997年，《宪法》航行了116年来第一次，以庆祝其200岁生日。

senses.def: Victoria and Albert Museum
senses.zh: 维多利亚和阿尔伯特博物馆

senses.def: people who have been completely defeated in a competition, war, etc.
senses.zh: 战败者；被完全征服的人；败阵者

senses.def: an international charity, now officially called Variety the Children's Charity, that helps children. Its members are famous actors and entertainers
senses.zh: 综艺俱乐部：一家国际慈善机构，现在正式称为儿童慈善组织，该组织致力于帮助儿童。它的成员是著名的演员和演艺人员，他们通过组织表演和音乐会来收钱。第一家综艺俱乐部于1927年在美国成立，该慈善机构现已在包括英国在内的世界许多国家设有分支机构。树枝被称为帐篷，支撑构件被称为树皮。英国是帐篷36。

senses.def: the group of buildings in Rome where the Pope
senses.zh: 梵蒂冈（罗马教宗居住和办公的地方）

senses.def: the centre of government of the Roman Catholic Church

examples.en: The Vatican has/have issued a further statement this morning.
examples.zh: 梵蒂冈今天上午发表了进一步声明。

senses.def: a small country in western Europe
senses.zh: 梵蒂冈（西欧小国）；梵蒂冈的

senses.def: a US rock group that had no big commercial hits but influenced many later groups and singers, including David Bowie. Their albums included The Velvet Underground and Nico
senses.zh: 地下丝绒乐队（Velvet Underground）：这是一家美国摇滚乐队，在商业上没有大的成功，但影响了许多后来的乐队和歌手，包括大卫·鲍伊（David Bowie）。他们的专辑包括The Velvet Underground和Nico（1967），White Light / White Heat（1967），The Velvet Underground（1969）和Loaded（1970）。该组织于1971年瓦解，并在1990年代短暂成立。

senses.def: a long bridge in New York City connecting Staten Island
senses.zh: 韦拉札诺海峡大桥（位于美国纽约州纽约市的桥梁，以双层结构的悬索桥横跨纳罗斯水道来连接纽约市的史泰登岛与布鲁克林。此桥是以意大利探险家乔凡尼·达·韦拉札诺来命名的，韦拉札诺是有纪录以来第一个进入纽约港以及哈德逊河的欧洲探险家。其最长跨距为1,290米，在1964年完工之初为全世界最长的悬索桥。直到1981年，现今其跨距排名全世界第十，但是仍然还是美国境内最大的悬索桥。）

senses.def: a title used before the name of certain senior priests, especially a dean
senses.zh: （牧师）：在某些高级牧师的名字之前使用的头衔，尤其是英格兰教会的教务长或教务长，或苏格兰教会的前任主持人

examples.en: the Very Reverend William Wallis
examples.zh: 威廉·沃利斯牧师

senses.def: a large organization for former members of the US armed forces who fought in wars abroad. It helps those in need, has campaigns to influence the government on military matters, and does community service. It was established in 1899.
senses.zh: 外国战争退伍军人：一个大型组织，专门为在国外作战的美军前成员组成。它帮助有需要的人，开展运动以在军事问题上影响政府，并提供社区服务。它成立于1899年。

senses.def: a vicar
senses.zh: Bray牧师：传统英语歌曲中的牧师。他根据执政的国王或王后的信仰改变了自己的宗教和政治信仰，并且只关心继续工作。“布雷的牧师”这个名字有时用来形容准备改变信仰以获取优势的人。

senses.def: a British BBC
senses.zh: Dibley的牧师：英国BBC电视台情景喜剧（1994-2007年），黎明法国人在一个小村庄里扮演爱好娱乐的牧师（英格兰教会牧师）

senses.def: a novel (1766) by Oliver Goldsmith
senses.zh: 韦克菲尔德牧师：奥利弗·戈德史密斯（Oliver Goldsmith）的小说（1766）。这是关于一个牧师的，他虽然善良而诚实，但一生中经历过几次灾难，例如房屋烧毁和儿子入狱。经过许多复杂的冒险后，这本书愉快地结束了。

senses.def: Britain's national museum of art and design, in South Kensington
senses.zh: 维多利亚和阿尔伯特博物馆

senses.def: a large sculpture in front of Buckingham Palace
senses.zh: 维多利亚纪念馆（Victoria Memorial）：伦敦白金汉宫前的大型雕塑。它是为纪念维多利亚女王而于1911年制作的，展示了她与其他几个人物坐在一个代表胜利的金色雕像下的情景。

senses.def: Lord Nelson's
senses.zh: 胜利：特拉法加战役中纳尔逊勋爵的飞船。现在在英格兰南部朴茨茅斯的皇家造船厂展出。

senses.def: a long wall built in memory of Americans who were killed or lost in the Vietnam War
a long war in Vietnam in which the US army fought against Communist forces
the old name for the French Quarter
senses.zh: 美国新奥尔良市法国区的旧名称。在法语中意为“旧广场”。

senses.def: a short name for Greenwich Village
senses.zh: 格林尼治村（在美国纽约市曼哈顿区西南侧，传统上与作家、艺术家、音乐家相联系）

senses.def: a popular poem by the US poet Henry Wadsworth Longfellow
senses.zh: 乡村铁匠：美国诗人亨利·沃兹沃思·朗费洛（Henry Wadsworth Longfellow）的一首通俗诗，讲述的是乡村铁匠的简单，健康的生活。美国儿童经常必须在学校学习它。

senses.def: a US newspaper that was published each week in New York, originally in Greenwich Village
senses.zh: 《乡村之声》：美国报纸，每周在纽约出版，最初在格林威治村出版。它以娱乐和艺术方面的文章而著称。它最初于1955年作为嬉皮士和其他具有“替代”文化的人的报纸出现，但后来逐渐变得更加传统。它在纽约市免费分发。上一版印刷版于2017年出版。该论文可在线使用直至2018年公司关闭。

senses.def: a group of over 90 islands in the Caribbean. The western ones have been governed by the US since 1917 and the eastern ones by Britain since 1666. Christopher Columbus
senses.zh: 维尔京群岛：加勒比地区90多个岛屿的集合。西方国家自1917年以来一直由美国统治，东方国家自1666年以来一直由英国统治。克里斯托弗·哥伦布（Christopher Columbus）于1493年成为第一个来此访问的欧洲人，长期以来一直是游客的天堂。美属维尔京群岛占地133平方英里/ 344平方公里。首都是夏洛特阿马利亚。英属维尔京群岛占地59平方英里/ 153平方公里。首都是路镇。

senses.def: a name given to the British queen Elizabeth I
senses.zh: 维尔京女王：给英国女王伊丽莎白一世的名字，因为她没有结婚并且可能从未发生过性关系

senses.def: a US television western
senses.zh: 弗吉尼亚人：每周在美国全国广播公司（1962-71）上播出的美国电视西部连续剧。弗吉尼亚人是一个没有名字的神秘男子，他于1880年代访问了怀俄明州梅德弓的希洛牧场。该系列改编自1902年欧文·怀斯特（Owen Wister）的同名小说，这是美国文学中的第一部西方小说，并且在1929年（与加里·库珀（Gary Cooper））和1946年都有电影版本。

senses.def: an official US government service that broadcasts news and other programmes in English and many other languages around the world
the name usually used to refer to the United States National Prohibition Act passed by the US Congress in 1919 to introduce the laws relating to Prohibition
senses.zh: 《沃尔斯特德法案》：通常用来指代美国国会在1919年通过的《美国国家禁止法案》，以介绍与禁止有关的法律。它以明尼苏达州美国国会议员安德鲁·沃尔斯特德（Andrew Volstead）的名字命名。该法和禁令于1933年终止。

senses.def: the parts of the British armed forces for people who are volunteers and train in their free time so they can be used in a national emergency

a major international round-the-world race for sailing boats, which first took place in 1973. The boats start in Europe and race in stages to different ports around the world. The race takes place every three years and used to be called the Whitbread Round the World Race.
senses.zh: 沃尔沃环球帆船赛（Volvo Ocean Race）：大型国际环球帆船比赛，始于1973年。该船始于欧洲，分阶段比赛至世界各地的不同港口。这项竞赛每三年举行一次，以前称为“惠特布雷德环球竞赛”。

senses.def: a US law passed during the civil rights movement
senses.zh: 1965年的《投票权法》：在民权运动期间通过的美国法律，由林登·B·约翰逊总统签署。它使许多限制非法使用，这些限制主要在南部使用，以阻止非洲裔美国人投票。这些限制包括测试人们的读写能力。

the-voting-rights-act-of-1965.uk: /ðə ˌvəʊtɪŋ raɪts ækt əv ˌnaɪntiːn ˌsɪksti ˈfaɪv/
the-voting-rights-act-of-1965.us: /ðə ˌvəʊtɪŋ raɪts ækt əv ˌnaɪntiːn ˌsɪksti ˈfaɪv/

senses.def: the main Latin version of the Bible prepared in the late 4th century
senses.zh: 《圣经》通俗拉丁文本（完成于 4 世纪后期）

senses.def: a famous and fashionable New York hotel on Park Avenue
senses.zh: 位于公园大道的纽约著名时尚酒店。19世纪后期，富裕的阿斯特家族的不同成员分别开设了帝国大厦现在所在的华尔道夫酒店和阿斯特酒店。他们于1931年合并为目前装饰艺术风格的建筑。

senses.def: a British government department responsible for representing Welsh interests within the British government, and representing the British government in Wales. It deals with matters outside the control of the Welsh Assembly
senses.zh: 威尔士办事处：英国政府部门，负责代表英国政府内部的威尔士利益，并代表威尔士的英国政府。它处理威尔士议会无法控制的事项。它由威尔士国务卿领导，其正式名称为威尔士国务卿办公室。

senses.def: an art museum in Liverpool, north-west England. It was opened in 1877 and contains one of Britain's largest collections of European painting.
senses.zh: 沃克美术馆：位于英格兰西北部利物浦的美术馆。它于1877年开放，收藏了英国最大的欧洲绘画作品之一。

senses.def: a golf competition for men who are not professional players, held every two years between a US team and a mixed British and Irish team. It was first held in 1922 and named after George Herbert Walker (1875-1953), President of the US Golf Association.
senses.zh: 沃克杯（Walker Cup）：这是一场针对非职业球员的高尔夫比赛，每两年由美国队与英国和爱尔兰混合队进行。它于1922年首次举办，并以美国高尔夫协会主席乔治·赫伯特·沃克（George Herbert Walker，1875-1953）的名字命名。

senses.def: people who have been injured in a battle or an accident but who are still able to walk
senses.zh: （战争或事故中）尚能走路的伤员

examples.en: The walking wounded were treated at the scene of the crash.
examples.zh: 行走的伤员在事故现场接受治疗。

senses.def: the leading financial newspaper in the US. It was first published in 1889 by Charles H Dow (1851-1902) and Edward D Jones (1856-1920) and is still owned by Dow Jones & Company, which also publishes the Dow-Jones Index
senses.zh: 《华尔街日报》：美国领先的财经报纸。它最初由Charles H Dow（1851-1902）和Edward D Jones（1856-1920）于1889年出版，但仍归Dow Jones＆Company所有，后者还出版了道琼斯指数。《日刊》虽然强调商业和经济新闻，但也有有关政治和一般新闻的文章。它每周六天以印刷形式和在线出版。该公司还制作欧洲和亚洲版本，以及一本名为《华尔街日报》的奢华生活方式杂志。

senses.def: a museum of art in London. It was opened in 1900 and contains a large collection of 18th-century French paintings and furniture, as well as other paintings, sculpture, decorative
senses.zh: 华莱士收藏馆：伦敦的艺术博物馆。它于1900年开放，收藏了大量18世纪的法国绘画和家具，以及来自欧洲和世界各地的其他绘画，雕塑，装饰物和武器。

senses.def: a famous nonsense
senses.zh: 海象和木匠：刘易斯·卡罗尔（Lewis Carroll）的儿童读物《透过窥镜》中的一首废话。它描述了海象和木匠如何说服一些牡蛎，然后将它们吃掉。这首诗最著名的台词是：

senses.def: a large US company started in 1923 by Walt Disney
senses.zh: 华特迪士尼公司1923年由华特•迪士尼创立的一家美国大公司，最知名的是它摄制的儿童动画电影。如今拥有包括华特迪士尼影片和试金石影片在内的多家电影制作公司，还生产玩具和儿童图书，并在美国和其他国家经营迪士尼主题乐园，还拥有包括美国广播公司在内的若干美国电视网。

senses.def: a US television series (1972-81) about a large family in the Blue Ridge Mountains of Virginia
senses.zh: 沃尔顿一家：美国电视连续剧（1972-81），讲述大萧条期间弗吉尼亚蓝岭山脉的一个大家庭。它很受欢迎，但有些人开玩笑讲诚实，爱和家庭价值观的简单故事。

senses.def: an organization, started in 1917, that cares for the graves
senses.zh: 战争坟墓委员会：成立于1917年的组织，该组织照顾在两次世界大战中均丧生的英军和英联邦武装部队成员的坟墓。它负责管理全球超过一百万的坟墓和其他古迹。它的全名是英联邦战争坟墓委员会。

senses.def: a war (1812-15) fought between Britain and the US. One of the main causes was the British action of forcing American sailors to serve on British ships. During the war, US soldiers attacked Canada, but without success. The British captured Washington, DC, in 1814 and burned the Capitol
senses.zh: 1812年战争：英美之间爆发战争（1812-15）。主要原因之一是英国迫使美国水手服役于英国船只的行动。战争期间，美军袭击了加拿大，但没有成功。英国于1814年占领华盛顿特区，并烧毁了国会大厦和白宫。然而，美国的成功促成了《根特条约》（1814年）的签订，从而结束了战争。不了解条约的安德鲁·杰克逊将军在三周后的新奥尔良战役（1815年）中击败了英国。战争使美国人更加团结，不愿参与欧洲事务。

senses.def: the usual British name for the American Revolution
senses.zh: 美国独立战争（英国人对这场战争的通常叫法）

senses.def: a war (1701-14) between Britain, Austria, the Netherlands, Portugal and Denmark on one side, and France and Spain on the other side. It started when the king of Spain died leaving no children, and Philip, the grandson
senses.zh: 西班牙继承战争：一方面是英国，奥地利，荷兰，葡萄牙和丹麦之间的战争（1701-14），另一方面是法国和西班牙之间的战争。它始于西班牙国王去世，无子生子，法国国王的孙子菲利普成为西班牙的下一任国王。奥地利人认为，奥地利人有权当西班牙的国王，而英国人则支持他们，因为他们不希望法国变得过于强大。该目的主要达到。战争结束时，尽管英国承认菲利普为西班牙国王，但它从法国获得了加拿大的大部分地区，从西班牙获得了直布罗陀和梅诺卡岛。

the-war-of-the-spanish-succession.word: the War of the Spanish Succession

senses.def: the former name of the British government department in charge of the Army, established during the Crimean War
senses.zh: 战争办公室：克里米亚战争期间建立的英国政府负责陆军的部门的前身。1964年，它成为国防部的陆军部。

senses.def: the name given by the media since the 1970s to various US government programmes that try to stop the use of illegal drugs. They include public information campaigns and attempts to stop the trade of drugs into the US from other countries. The idea has been criticized by people who think that it would be more effective to treat the causes of drug addiction
senses.zh: 毒品战争：自1970年代以来媒体对美国政府旨在阻止使用非法毒品的各种计划的称呼。其中包括开展宣传运动，并试图阻止其他国家从美国贩运毒品。有人认为这种想法会更有效地治疗成瘾的根源。

senses.def: a US law passed in 1973 which allows Congress to limit the President's use of military forces. It states that the President must tell Congress within 48 hours when sending armed forces anywhere, and Congress must give approval for forces to stay there for more than 90 days. The Act was passed despite a veto
senses.zh: 《战争权力决议》（1973年通过的一项美国法律，允许国会限制总统使用军队的权力。法律规定，总统在派遣武装部队到任何地方时必须在48小时内告知国会，国会必须批准部队在那里停留超过90天。尽管遭到理查德·尼克松总统的否决，该法案还是通过了。）

senses.def: the name now used for the period of fighting (1455-85) in England between the supporters of the two most powerful families in the country at the time, the House of Lancaster
senses.zh: 玫瑰战争：当时在英格兰两个最强大家族的支持者兰开斯特宫（House of Lancaster）的支持者之间的战斗时期（1455-85），这个名字的名称是一朵红玫瑰，还有约克宫，其象征是一朵白玫瑰。双方的目的都是使他们的家庭成为英格兰国王。双方在不同时期都取得了成功，战争只有在亨利·都铎（兰开斯特宫）击败理查德三世（约克宫）并成为亨利七世国王后才结束。他与约克的伊丽莎白的婚姻使双方团结起来，并结束了战斗。

senses.def: a large, shallow bay
senses.zh: 华盛顿河（Wash）：英格兰东海岸的一个大而浅的海湾，北海将南部的诺福克郡和北部的林肯郡分开。许多英国人都知道一个故事，约翰·金在1216年在一次军事战役中试图越过水浅的华盛顿特区时，丢了行李和一些士兵。

senses.def: a tall, thin monument
senses.zh: 华盛顿纪念碑（Washington Monument）：华盛顿特区购物中心（The Mall）上的一座又高又薄的纪念碑，旨在纪念乔治·华盛顿（George Washington）。它高555英尺/ 169米，由白色大理石制成。游客可以爬898步到达山顶，从那里可以欣赏到城市的美景。纪念碑耗时40年建造，并于1888年完工。

senses.def: a leading US national newspaper, published every day in Washington, DC
senses.zh: 《华盛顿邮报》：美国领先的全国性报纸，每天在华盛顿特区发行。通常认为它是表达自由的意见。这是第一份调查整个水门事件的报纸，并因此获得了普利策奖（1973年）。它于1877年首次出版。

senses.def: a poem (1922) by T S Eliot
senses.zh: 荒原：TS艾略特（TS Eliot）的一首诗（1922年），被视为第一次世界大战后情绪低落和精神错乱的一种表达。它的许多行引用了其他文学作品和文化问题，这些在诗末的注释中进行了解释。这首诗的风格包括起初似乎没有紧密联系的短小段，对现代诗歌产生了很大的影响。

senses.def: the magazine produced by the religious group the Jehovah's Witnesses
senses.zh: 瞭望塔：由宗教团体耶和华见证会制作的杂志。成员们试图通过挨家挨户地与杂志讨论其中的事项来引起人们的兴趣和信仰。

senses.def: a children's book (1863) by Charles Kingsley
senses.zh: 婴儿戏水：查尔斯·金斯利（Charles Kingsley）的儿童读物（1863年）。这是关于一个正在打扫烟囱的小男孩，逃离了他残酷的雇主，跌入溪流，在那里他遇到了住在那儿的小动物，水生婴儿。这是一个关于善与恶的道德故事。许多人特别记得其中两个角色的名字：凶猛的Bedonebyasyoudid太太和非常友善的Doasyouwouldbedoneby太太。

senses.def: the 11th sign of the zodiac
senses.zh: 黄道第十一宫；宝瓶宫；宝瓶（星）座；水瓶（星）座

senses.def: a person born when the sun is in this sign, that is between 21 January and 19 February
senses.zh: 水瓶座的人（约出生于 1 月 21 日至 2 月 19 日）

senses.def: the 11th sign of the zodiac
senses.zh: 黄道第十一宫；宝瓶宫；宝瓶（星）座；水瓶（星）座

senses.def: a person born when the sun is in this sign, that is between 21 January and 19 February
senses.zh: 水瓶座的人（约出生于 1 月 21 日至 2 月 19 日）

senses.def: the processes by which water passes between the earth's atmosphere, land and oceans, involving water falling from clouds as rain and snow, flowing in streams and rivers to the sea, and then returning to the atmosphere through evaporation
senses.zh: 水循环（指水在地球大气层、大地、海洋之间的循环过程）

examples.en: Rainfall is a key link in the global water cycle and a measure for changing climate.
examples.zh: 降雨是全球水循环的关键环节，也是气候变化的衡量标准。

senses.def: the level that the water reaches along the side of a ship

examples.en: The ship was struck below the waterline by a single torpedo.
examples.zh: 该船在水线以下被一枚鱼雷击中。

examples.en: If the vote goes against her, the prime minister may well be holed below the waterline.
examples.zh: 如果投票结果对她不利，首相很可能会陷入水线以下。

senses.def: the name given to the novels of Sir Walter Scott
senses.zh: 韦弗利小说：沃尔特·斯科特爵士的小说之所以被冠以名字，是因为他在小说开始时就说这些小说是“韦弗利的作者”写的，但没有给出名字。其中第一本（本身称为Waverley）于1814年出版，直到1827年Scott才公开宣布他实际上是小说的作者。

senses.def: a group of members of the US House of Representatives that makes suggestions about laws concerning tax and trade in order to provide money for the US government
senses.zh: 美国众议院筹款委员会（就税收和贸易法规提出建议以便为政府提供资金）

senses.def: a television quiz
senses.zh: 最弱的一环：电视问答节目，从2000年至2012年在英国BBC上露面，现在在世界各地的国家都有播出。一个由9名参赛者组成的团队按链条回答常识性问题，从而为每个正确答案积累一定的资金。当有人打破锁链时，由于回答错误，所有的钱都将丢失。在每个回合结束时，参赛者将投票给最弱的一环，对团队最不有用的参赛者将投票离开该团队。这一直持续到只剩下一个人（获胜者）为止。获胜者将获得所有赢得的钱。该节目的英，美版本由安妮·罗宾逊（Anne Robinson）呈现，他表现出非常刻苦的形象，经常批评参赛者。

senses.def: an area of attractive countryside in south-east England which includes parts of the counties of Kent
senses.zh: 韦尔德（Weald）：英格兰东南部迷人的乡村地区，包括肯特郡，萨里郡和萨塞克斯郡的部分县。特别是这里有许多水果和蔬菜种植的地区。韦尔德（Weald）是一个老式的词，意为野生，即未耕种，以前曾被树林覆盖。

senses.def: an important work of economic and social theory by Adam Smith
senses.zh: 《国富论》亚当•斯密所著关于经济和社会理论的重要著作，1776年出版，全名是《国民财富的性质和原因的研究》。他在书中分析了劳动力生产与国家财富的产生之间的关系。他的结论是，要达致最佳的经济状况必须鼓励自由企业制度（即在贸易领域允许公开竞争并且政府不干预的经济制度）。这一观点对此后的经济理论产生了巨大影响，并成为20世纪80年代英国保守党政府制定经济政策的基本原则。

senses.def: the threads
a British charity that provides money for medical research projects. It was originally funded with money left by US chemist
senses.zh: 惠康信托基金会（Wellcome Trust）：一家为医学研究项目提供资金的英国慈善机构。它最初是由美国化学家亨利·威尔康（Henry Wellcome，1852-1936年）逝世时留下的钱资助的。他从一家在英国成立的生产毒品和其他药物的公司赚钱。

senses.def: the group of people who are elected as a government for Wales, which is to some extent independent of the UK parliament and has the power to make some laws
a red dragon
senses.zh: 威尔士龙：一条红色的龙，是威尔士的官方标志

senses.def: a regiment
senses.zh: 威尔士卫队：英国陆军的一个团。它成立于1915年，使威尔士参加了后卫军团。

senses.def: a former organization started by the Welsh Assembly
senses.zh: 威尔士语言委员会：由威尔士议会成立的前组织，旨在鼓励在威尔士使用威尔士语。2012年，其权力移交给了威尔士政府和威尔士语言专员。

senses.def: the industrial region of south Wales, for example the Rhondda Valley
senses.zh: 威尔士山谷：威尔士南部的工业区，例如Rhondda山谷。那里的主要工业是煤炭和钢铁，煤矿始建于19世纪初期。多年来，这些行业雇用了该地区大多数人，但煤炭行业现已消失，钢铁行业变得越来越小。

senses.def: the states on the west coast of the US, especially California
senses.zh: 美国西海岸（尤指加利福尼亚州）

senses.def: the name often used to refer to the south-west of Britain, particularly the counties of Cornwall
senses.zh: 西方国家：通常用来指英国西南部的名称，尤其是康沃尔郡，德文郡，萨默塞特郡和多塞特郡

senses.def: the western area of central London where there are many theatres, shops and hotels
senses.zh: 西伦敦，伦敦西区（即伦敦市中心西部的戏院、商店和旅馆聚集区）

senses.def: several groups of islands between the Caribbean and the Atlantic, that include the Antilles and the Bahamas
senses.zh: 西印度群岛（位于加勒比海和大西洋之间，包括安的列斯群岛和巴哈马群岛）

senses.def: a question originally asked by Labour Member of Parliament
senses.zh: 西洛锡安问题：最初由工党议员塔姆·戴利尔（Tam Dalyell）提出的问题，他在苏格兰的选区过去被称为西洛锡安。在下放权力之前，他询问伦敦英国议会的苏格兰议员能够对影响英国选区的事项进行表决，但是同一议员不能对影响他或她自己选区的事项进行投票是正确的。苏格兰议会的责任。如今，大多数人认为问题在于伦敦的苏格兰国会议员仍然可以就英语事务进行投票，而英格兰的国会议员却失去了影响苏格兰事务的权力。许多政客继续不同意这个问题的答案，

senses.def: a metropolitan county
senses.zh: 西米德兰兹郡：英格兰中部的一个大都市县，创建于1974年，由七个地区组成，这些地区以前是沃里克郡，伍斯特郡和斯塔福德郡的一部分，包括伯明翰和考文垂等城市

senses.def: the western part of Manhattan in New York City, which includes Broadway and Central Park
senses.zh: 曼哈顿西区（在美国纽约市，包括百老汇和中央公园）

senses.def: a popular US television drama series on NBC
senses.zh: 西翼：美国国家广播公司（NBC）上颇受欢迎的电视连续剧，从1999年到2006年放映了马丁·辛（Martin Sheen）及其幕僚所扮演的美国总统。它经常处理当前的政治问题，并赢得了许多艾美奖。

senses.def: a council area
senses.zh: Western Isles（西岛）：苏格兰西北部的一个议会区域，通常用盖尔语官方名称Eilean Siar来称呼。它由外赫布里底群岛组成：刘易斯和哈里斯，北尤伊特，南尤伊特和巴拉。它的行政中心是斯托诺韦。西部岛屿一词有时也用于表示赫布里底群岛中的所有岛屿。

senses.def: the oldest and most important dog show in the US. It began in 1877 and is now held every February in Madison Square Garden
senses.zh: 威斯敏斯特犬舍俱乐部狗展：美国最古老，最重要的狗展。它始于1877年，现在每年2月在麦迪逊广场花园举行，有2800只狗参加比赛。

the-westminster-kennel-club-dog-show.word: the Westminster Kennel Club Dog Show

senses.def: the western central region of the US including the Great Plains where wheat
senses.zh: 小麦带（包括大平原在内的美国中西部小麦产区）

senses.def: the money, things or skill that you need in order to be able to do something
senses.zh: （做某事的）所需资金，必要的设备，所需技术

examples.en: They lacked the wherewithal to pay for the repairs.
examples.zh: 他们缺少维修费。

senses.def: the famous gallery (= a raised platform along the inner wall of a building)
senses.zh: 耳语画廊：著名的画廊，一直绕着伦敦圣保罗大教堂的圆顶内部。众所周知，声音传递的方式是：如果一个人在画廊一侧的墙壁附近窃窃私语，那么靠近画廊另一侧墙壁的另一个人会听到它们的声音。 ，距离107英尺/ 32米。

senses.def: the tall chalk cliffs on the south-eastern coast of England, around the port of Dover
senses.zh: 多佛白崖：英格兰东南沿海多佛港附近的高大白垩崖。从海上几英里处就可以看到它们，因此它们是人们乘船接近多佛时所见的英格兰的第一部分。对于其他国家的许多英国人来说，他们代表着回家的念头。维拉·林恩（Vera Lynn）演唱的第二次世界大战最受欢迎的歌曲之一，开头是：

senses.def: the official home of the President of the US in Washington, DC
senses.zh: 白宫（美国总统官邸，位于首都华盛顿）

senses.def: the US President and his or her officials
senses.zh: 白宫（指美国总统或美国政府）

examples.en: The White House has issued a statement.
examples.zh: 白宫已经发表了一项声明。

examples.en: White House aides
examples.zh: 总统助手

senses.def: a phrase that was used mainly in the 19th century to express the idea, now considered offensive, that European countries had a duty to control countries and organizations in parts of the world with less money, education or technology than Europe. The phrase was first used in a poem by Rudyard Kipling
senses.zh: 《白人的负担》（最初出现在英国诗人鲁德亚德·吉卜林的一首诗中。主要在19世纪使用，用来表达如今被认为具有冒犯性的观念，即欧洲国家有责任控制那些在金钱、教育或技术方面不如欧洲的世界其他地区的国家和组织。最初出现在鲁德亚德·吉卜林的一首诗中。）

senses.def: a phone book (on white paper), or a section of a book, that lists the names, addresses and phone numbers of people living in a particular area
a character in Lewis Carroll's
senses.zh: 《白兔》：刘易斯·卡罗尔的《爱丽丝梦游仙境》中的角色。故事开始时，他就是爱丽丝（Alice）钻一个洞的白兔子。他担心自己迟到了，并一直看着他的手表。

senses.def: the oldest part of the Tower of London
senses.zh: 白塔（White Tower）：伦敦塔最古老的部分。它是一幢大型诺曼教堂，位于建筑物群的中心，由白色石头制成。在17世纪，在这里发现了两个孩子的骨头，许多人认为它们是塔中王子的骨头。

senses.def: a building in Whitechapel
senses.zh: 位于伦敦Whitechapel的一栋建筑物，并在此举行艺术展览。它于1901年开幕。伦敦公开赛是每三年一次在伦敦展出的艺术家作品的展览。

senses.def: a theatre on Whitehall
senses.zh: 白厅剧院：装饰风格的伦敦白厅剧院。它因在那里表演的闹剧（根据可笑的情节而制作的喜剧而闻名）而闻名，被称为白厅闹剧。

senses.def: the name used by the press, etc. to refer to the illegal sale of property in Arkansas by the Whitewater Development Corporation, a company that had connections with US President Bill Clinton and his wife Hillary. Investigations into the affair, which were begun in 1994 by Congress and the Independent Counsel Kenneth Starr led to a trial of Clinton by the US Senate in 1999 in which he was acquitted
senses.zh: 白水事件（Whitewater affair）：新闻界等使用的名称，是指白水发展公司（Whitewater Development Corporation）在阿肯色州非法出售财产的公司，该公司与美国总统比尔·克林顿（Bill Clinton）和他的妻子希拉里（Hillary）有联系。这项事件的调查始于1994年，由国会和独立法律顾问肯尼斯·斯塔尔（Kenneth Starr）发起，导致美国参议院于1999年对克林顿进行审判，他被宣告无罪。克林顿卸任后，调查终于在2001年结束。

senses.def: a museum in New York which contains art from the beginning of the 20th century. The original museum was opened by the American artist and art collector
senses.zh: 惠特尼美国艺术博物馆：位于纽约的博物馆，其中收藏了20世纪初的艺术品。最初的博物馆于1931年由美国艺术家和艺术品收藏家格特鲁德·范德比尔特·惠特尼（Gertrude Vanderbilt Whitney，1875-1942年）开馆。1966年，博物馆迁至现在的麦迪逊大街。

the-whitney-museum-of-american-art.word: the Whitney Museum of American Art

senses.def: a British pop group. It began as a mod
senses.zh: 谁：英国流行乐团。它始于1960年代的Mod乐队，到1970年代初是世界上最受欢迎的摇滚乐队之一。该小组的成员以行为举止疯狂，有时在表演时会破坏其设备。谁最著名的唱片包括《我的世代》（1965年）和两个摇滚歌剧（通过一系列摇滚音乐讲述的故事），汤米（1969年）和夸德罗菲亚（1973年）。

senses.def: one of the best-known characters in Chaucer's
senses.zh: 巴斯的妻子：乔瑟的坎特伯雷故事中最著名的人物之一。她是一个活泼的女人，已经结婚五次，对性发表了许多幽默的评论。她讲的故事，巴斯的故事的妻子，是关于亚瑟王的骑士之一。他必须找到"女人最爱什么？一个丑陋的老妇人说，她会告诉他答案，但前提是他娶了她。他同意，她变成了一个美丽的年轻女子。

senses.def: a women's tennis competition between British and US players which took place every year from 1923 to 1989. It was then stopped because the British players were not good enough to compete with the US players, who almost always won easily.
senses.zh: 怀特曼杯（Wightman Cup）：从1923年到1989年，每年都举行英，美女子网球比赛。后来由于英超选手无法与几乎总是轻松获胜的美国选手竞争而被中止。

senses.def: a hall for concerts in the West End
senses.zh: 威格莫厅（Wigmore Hall）：伦敦西区的音乐会厅。它主要用于古典歌曲和室内音乐的演奏。

senses.def: a violent western
senses.zh: 狂野群：由萨姆·佩金帕（Sam Peckinpah）执导的一部暴力西方电影（1969年），讲述了一群参与墨西哥革命的Revolution徒。有人认为它是有史以来最好的西方菜之一。

senses.def: Hole-in-the-Wall Gang
the western states of the US during the years when the first Europeans were settling there, used especially when you are referring to the fact that there was not much respect for the law there
senses.zh: 荒野西部，西大荒（开拓时期，尤指尚无法制的美国西部）

senses.def: a British organization, set up in 1946 by Peter Scott
senses.zh: 野禽和湿地信托基金：英国组织，由彼得·斯科特（Peter Scott）于1946年成立，旨在研究和保护野禽

senses.def: if something gives you the willies

a very tall building in the US that was from 1973 to 1996 the tallest in the world, and is now the second-tallest in the US, after One World Trade Center in New York. The Willis Tower was called the Sears Tower
senses.zh: 威利斯大厦（Willis Tower）：美国最高的建筑，从1973年到1996年是世界上最高的建筑，现在是仅次于纽约世界贸易中心的美国第二高的建筑。直到2009年，威利斯大厦一直被称为西尔斯大厦，现在仍然经常被称为。它在芝加哥，由Sears，Roebuck和Company建造。建筑物高1450英尺/ 443米，有110层。

senses.def: a children's novel (1908) by Kenneth Grahame
senses.zh: 柳树上的风：肯尼思·格雷厄姆（Kenneth Grahame）创作的儿童小说（1908年）。它描述了一群生活在河边的小动物的冒险和关系，其中包括relationships鼠，老鼠，蟾蜍和a。它是20世纪最受欢迎的英国儿童读物之一。AA Milne于1929年编写的该舞台的一个版本称为Toad of Toad Hall，仍然经常使用。

senses.def: the West Indian cricket
a former small theatre in the West End
senses.zh: 风车剧院：伦敦西区（1931-1964）的一家小剧院。它以裸露或几乎裸露的女人跳舞而闻名。喜剧演员曾经在舞蹈表演之间讲笑话，许多著名的表演者（包括托尼·汉考克和彼得·塞勒斯）都从那里开始了自己的职业生涯。第二次世界大战期间，炸弹被扔到伦敦时，这是唯一一家开放的剧院。

senses.def: a name for the US city of Chicago
senses.zh: 风城（美国芝加哥市的别称）

senses.def: an international winter sports

examples.en: Tickets are now on sale for next year's Winter Games.
examples.zh: 明年冬季奥运会的门票现已有售。

senses.def: an international winter sports

examples.en: The 2022 Winter Olympics took place in Beijing.
examples.zh: 2022 年冬季奥运会在北京举行。

senses.def: a play (c. 1610) by William Shakespeare
senses.zh: 冬季故事：威廉·莎士比亚（William Shakespeare）的戏剧（c。1610）。它开始可悲，愉快地结束。西西里国王列昂特（Leontes）认为他的妻子不忠实。他将她送入监狱，并命令将他的小女儿留在“沙漠之滨”。他认为他们俩都死了，对他所做的一切感到非常抱歉。但是，他的女儿是由牧羊人（一个照看羊的人）找到的，长大后自己成了牧羊人。当她爱上王子时，他们一起逃到了西西里。在那里，莱昂特斯认出了他的女儿，并发现他的妻子还活着。年轻的恋人结婚了，国王和王后又重新团结了起来。

senses.def: the large area of land between the River Mersey
senses.zh: 维尔勒（Wirrall）：英格兰西北部利物浦以南的默西河和迪河之间的大片土地

senses.def: the time, late at night, when it is thought that magic things can happen
senses.zh: 半夜三更；魔幻之事发生的时刻

senses.def: a very popular US film (1939) based on the children's book The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
senses.zh: 《奥兹巫师》：一部非常受欢迎的美国电影（1939年），根据弗兰克·鲍姆（1856-1919）的儿童读物《奥兹奇才》（1900年）改编的。在影片中，朱迪·加兰饰演的一个叫多萝西的小女孩，被一阵风吹到堪萨斯州的陌生之地奥兹。为了回家，她必须打败西方邪恶的女巫，她借助稻草人、锡伍德曼、懦弱的狮子和奥兹巫师本人。这部电影最著名的歌曲包括《彩虹之上》，我们去看巫师，走黄砖路。

senses.def: an informal name for the members of the US trade union IWW
senses.zh: 美国工会IWW成员的非正式名字

senses.def: a British government report, completed in 1957, on homosexuality
senses.zh: 《沃尔芬登报告》：1957年完成的英国政府报告，内容涉及同性恋（即同性之间的性关系）。它负责同意成年人在英国合法化之间的同性恋行为。在那之前，所有同性恋行为都是非法的。

senses.def: a former women's division of the US Army. It stopped operating in 1978.
senses.zh: 妇女军团：美国陆军的前女师。它于1978年停止运营。

senses.def: a British prize given every year for the best novel published in the UK that is written in English by a woman from any part of the world. The money for this large prize is provided by a group of sponsors. The prize was first given in 1996. Until 2012 it was sponsored by the former mobile phone company Orange
senses.zh: 妇女小说奖：每年由在世界范围内的女性用英语撰写的，在英国出版的最佳小说获得的英国大奖。这项巨额奖金的资金由一组赞助商提供。该奖项于1996年首次颁发。直到2012年，该奖项均由前手机公司Orange赞助，被称为Orange小说奖。

senses.def: the women's section of the British Army for most of the 20th century. In 1992 it combined with the rest of the army.
senses.zh: 妇女皇家陆军军团：20世纪大部分时间的英国陆军妇女部。在1992年，它与其他军队合并。

senses.def: the Royal Voluntary Service
senses.zh: 妇女的皇家志愿服务：皇家志愿服务

senses.def: the seat on which the Lord Speaker
senses.zh: 伍尔萨克（Woolsack）：议长在英国国会上议院的所在地。这是一个非常大的正方形垫子，里面填充有羊毛，上面覆盖着红布。

senses.def: a New York building which was the tallest in the world when it was completed in 1913. It is on Broadway
senses.zh: 伍尔沃斯大厦（Woolworth Building）：这是纽约建筑物，于1913年竣工，是世界上最高的建筑物。它位于百老汇，高792英尺/ 242米。它耗资1,350万美元，由FW Woolworth为他的公司建造。1930年，克莱斯勒大厦取代它成为世界上最高的建筑物。

senses.def: a British organization, known as The Industrial Society until 2002, which aims to improve the quality of people's working lives by carrying out research and providing advice to businesses about issues such as the work-life balance
senses.zh: 工作基金会：英国的一个组织，直到2002年之前被称为工业协会，其宗旨是通过开展研究并向企业提供有关工作与生活平衡等问题的建议，从而提高人们的工作质量。一个人投入工作的时间和精力以及他们一生所花费的时间）

examples.en: The working class has/have rejected them in the elections.
examples.zh: 工人阶级在选举中没有投他们的票。

examples.en: If you were working class, going to university wasn’t even an option.

examples.zh: 工人阶级中的群体

examples.en: The working poor have little choice but to take more than one job at a time.
examples.zh: 低薪穷人不得不同时打不止一份工。

senses.def: a US government programme (1935-43) established by President Franklin D Roosevelt
senses.zh: 作品进度管理部门：美国总统富兰克林·罗斯福（Franklin D Roosevelt）制定的美国政府计划（1935-43），这是他的新政的一部分。其名称后来更改为Works Projects Administration。大萧条期间，它为失业者创造了数百万个就业机会，主要是建筑和艺术领域。

senses.def: the oldest US almanac
senses.zh: 《世界年历》：美国最古老的年历（许多主题的事实书）仍在出版。它的全称是《世界年鉴》和《事实手册》。纽约世界报纸始于1868年。现在由世界年鉴书定期出版，该书还出版了《儿童世界年鉴》。

senses.def: a well-known British national radio news programme, broadcast on Radio 4
senses.zh: “世界一处”：一个著名的英国国家广播新闻节目，从星期一到星期五每天下午1点在第四电台广播，其中包含有关当天重要新闻事件的报道和评论。它于1965年首次播出。

senses.def: an international organization that lends money to countries who are members at times when they are in difficulty and need more money
senses.zh: 世界银行（向处于困境需要资助的成员国贷款的国际机构）

senses.def: a competition between national teams from all over the world, usually held every few years
senses.zh: 世界杯比赛（通常为几年一度）

examples.en: The next Rugby World Cup will take place in three years' time.
examples.zh: 下一届橄榄球世界杯赛将于三年后举行。

senses.def: a series of baseball games played every year between the winners of the American League and the National League
senses.zh: 世界系列赛（美国棒球联盟和全国棒球联盟优胜者之间的年度比赛）

senses.def: a system for finding information on the internet, in which documents are connected to other documents using hypertext

examples.en: to browse a site on the World Wide Web
examples.zh: 在万维网上浏览一个网站

senses.def: a poem by the US poet Henry Wadsworth Longfellow
senses.zh: 《西斯佩鲁斯的残骸》：美国诗人亨利·沃兹沃思·朗费罗的诗。这是在他的收藏《民谣和其他诗歌》（1841年）中，其中也包括《乡村铁匠》。它讲述了一个父亲和他的小女儿在暴风雨中撞船撞死的故事。像《 Hesperus的残骸》这样的短语可能被用来表示“非常不整洁”或“处于毁灭状态”。这首诗包括以下几行：

senses.def: Wilbur Wright (1867-1912) and Orville Wright (1871-1948), US engineers who built the first successful aircraft that used an engine and was heavier than air. They first flew their aircraft, called Flyer, on four successful flights on 17 December 1903 near Kitty Hawk, North Carolina
senses.zh: 莱特兄弟：威尔伯·赖特（Wilbur Wright，1867-1912年）和奥维尔·赖特（Orville Wright，1871-1948年），美国工程师，他们成功制造出第一架使用发动机并且比空气重的飞机。他们首先于1903年12月17日在北卡罗来纳州的基蒂·霍克附近成功进行了四次成功的飞行，名为飞行器。他们最长的飞行是852英尺/ 260米，持续了59秒。

senses.def: the female section of the British Royal Navy
senses.zh: 英国皇家海军女性部。它成立于1917年，直到1990年其成员都无法在船上服役。1993年，WRNS正式成为皇家海军的一部分，并不再作为一个单独的部门存在。

senses.def: a river that flows from Powys
senses.zh: 怀伊河：一条河流，流经威尔士中部的Powys，流经英格兰的赫里福德市，并在一部分形成威尔士和英格兰之间的边界。它长130英里/ 210公里，在布里斯托尔海峡流入大海。

senses.def: a popular US television series that began in 1993 and is widely shown in other countries. It is about two members of the FBI, Agent Mulder (David Duchovny) and Agent Scully (Gillian Anderson), who investigate mysterious events suggesting other forms of life in space. There has also been a film, The X-Files
senses.zh: X档案：1993年开始的美国受欢迎的电视连续剧，并在其他国家广泛播放。它是联邦调查局的两名成员，特工穆尔德（David Duchovny）和特工史卡利（Gillian Anderson），他们调查神秘事件，这些事件暗示了太空中其他形式的生命。还有一部电影《 X档案》（1998）。

senses.def: a New York professional baseball team. Its official name is the New York Yankees. Famous Yankee players have included ‘Babe’ Ruth
senses.zh: 洋基队：纽约职业棒球队。它的正式名称是纽约洋基。著名的洋基队球员包括'Babe'Ruth，Lou Gehrig和Joe DiMaggio。球队在布朗克斯著名的洋基体育场打主场比赛。

senses.def: an informal name for Scotland Yard
senses.zh: 围场：苏格兰围场或新苏格兰围场的非正式名称，既指首都警察局也指伦敦市中心的总部

senses.def: a course of action that a person takes believing that it will lead to good things. It comes from the Yellow Brick Road in The Wizard of Oz
senses.zh: 黄砖路（指正确的行动方向，沿着它走，就一定会有好的结果。这个名词出自《绿野仙踪》，多乐茜和她的朋友们沿着黄砖铺成的路走，最后到达翡翠城）

senses.def: a military unit that traditionally guards the British king or queen at certain ceremonies. It was created in 1485 for the ceremony in which Henry VII
senses.zh: 守卫也门：传统上在某些仪式上守卫英国国王或王后的军事部队。它创建于1485年，用于亨利七世成为国王的仪式。它的成员仍然穿着当时的Tudor风格的红色制服，类似于Yeoman Warders所穿的制服，尽管这两个群体是完全分开的。

senses.def: one of the operas
senses.zh: 守卫也门：吉尔伯特和沙利文的歌剧之一。这是关于一个男人即将在伦敦塔被处决之前结婚，然后被告知他已经被宽恕并且将永远不会被处决的故事。

senses.def: an area of countryside, valleys and villages in the north of England. They are mainly in the county of North Yorkshire
senses.zh: 约克郡山谷：英格兰北部的乡村，山谷和村庄。他们主要在北约克郡，但也有一部分在坎布里亚郡。该地区于1954年成为国家公园。它被视为英格兰最美丽的地区之一，在步行度假或乘车游览附近的英国人中尤其受欢迎。

senses.def: areas of high, open land with few trees in North Yorkshire
senses.zh: 约克郡高沼：英格兰北约克郡高空旷地的地区，树木稀少。其中包括称为北约克郡的地区，该地区自1952年以来一直是国家公园。

senses.def: the name given by the press to Peter Sutcliffe, an Englishman who murdered thirteen women and tried to kill several more in the north of England in the 1970s, before he was caught in 1981. The name was meant to suggest that his crimes were similar to those of Jack the Ripper
senses.zh: 约克郡开膛手（Yorkshire Ripper）：新闻界给彼得·萨特克利夫（Peter Sutcliffe）的名字，他杀死了13名妇女，并在1970年代谋杀了英格兰北部的几名妇女，直到1981年被捕。这个名字的意思是暗示他犯罪与开膛手杰克的犯罪相似。

senses.def: a very popular US television soap opera
senses.zh: 年轻人和躁动不安：CBS上一部非常受欢迎的美国电视肥皂剧。它始于1973年，赢得了许多艾美奖，其中包括5项“最佳日间戏剧系列”。

senses.def: a nickname
senses.zh: 年轻的假扮者：查尔斯·爱德华·斯图尔特（1720-88）的昵称，也被称为邦妮·普林斯·查理。伪装者是主张某项权利的人，通常是成为国王或王后的权利，尽管并非所有人都认为主张是公正的。

senses.def: four US outlaws
senses.zh: 弟弟：狂野西部的四名美国US徒。四兄弟中最著名的是科尔·杨格（Cole Younger（1844-1916））和吉姆·杨格（Jim Younger（1848-1902））。他们是杰西（Jesse）和弗兰克·詹姆斯（Frank James）的表亲，该团体有时被称为詹姆斯·杨格（James-Younger Gang）。1876年，三名兄弟在试图抢劫明尼苏达州诺斯菲尔德的一家银行后被抓获并送进监狱。其中有几部关于他们的电影，包括《长骑手》（The Long Riders，1980）和《美国Out徒》（American Outlaws，2001）。

senses.def: an organization that provides cheap accommodation (called youth hostels
senses.zh: 青年旅馆协会（Youth Hostels Association）：该组织为通常在度假期间到处旅行的人们提供廉价住宿（称为青年旅馆）。它于1930年在英国成立，是国际青年旅舍（Hostelling International）的一部分，该旅舍在全球约90个国家/地区运营。尽管有这个名字，任何年龄的人都可以住在青年旅馆。

senses.def: a territory
senses.zh: 育空地区（加拿大西北部地区，与美国阿拉斯加州接界，首府怀特霍斯）

senses.def: a war in South Africa (1879) between the Zulu people and British armed forces. After several battles the Zulus were finally defeated at Ulundi.
senses.zh: 祖鲁战争（发生于1879年，是大英帝国与祖鲁王国之间的战争。经过几次战斗，祖鲁人最终在乌伦迪被击败。）

senses.def: something that has some good parts and some bad ones
senses.zh: 好坏兼有之物；瑕瑜互见之物

examples.en: Their investment plan shows the familiar curate's egg pattern of some bits doing well and others doing badly.
examples.zh: 他们的投资计划显示了人们所熟悉的管理者的鸡蛋模式，即一些部分表现良好，另一些部分表现不佳。

senses.def: a person who leaves home and wastes their money and time on a life of pleasure, but who later is sorry about this and returns home
senses.zh: 回头的浪子；改邪归正的人

senses.def: a course of action that is difficult to stop once it has begun, and can lead to serious problems or disaster
senses.zh: 使人滑向深渊的斜坡；危险的境地

examples.en: She realized he was on the slippery slope towards a life of crime.
examples.zh: 她意识到他正走上犯罪之路。

senses.def: the way things seem to be organized; the way somebody wants everything to be organized

examples.en: My personal problems are not really important in the overall scheme of things.
examples.zh: 从全局来看，我个人的问题并非十分重要。

examples.en: This small annoyance isn't much in the grand scheme of things.
examples.zh: 这点儿烦心事无关大局。

examples.en: I don't think marriage figures in his scheme of things.
examples.zh: 我想，婚姻在他的心目中是无足轻重的。

senses.def: used to tell somebody what is the best action for them to take to get the result they want

examples.en: If you want to get around London fast, the Underground is your best bet.
examples.zh: 如果你想在伦敦四处转转而又不费时间，最好是乘地铁。

senses.def: a first name for girls, sometimes short for Althea
senses.zh: 西娅（女子名，有时为 Althea 或 Anthea 缩写）

senses.def: a theatre company formed in 2003 which performs plays in the Welsh language at theatres around Wales and at the National Eisteddfod
senses.zh: 一家剧院公司，成立于2003年，在威尔士各地的剧院和威尔士国家艾斯特菲德剧院表演威尔士语戏剧

senses.def: a building or an outdoor area where plays and similar types of entertainment are performed

examples.en: Broadway theatres
examples.zh: 百老汇的剧院

examples.en: an open-air theatre
examples.zh: 露天剧场

examples.en: How often do you go to the theatre?
examples.zh: 你多久看一次戏？

examples.en: She left the theatre a few minutes after the curtain fell.
examples.zh: 落幕后几分钟她就离开了剧场。

senses.def: a building in which films are shown

examples.en: They arrived at the movie theater a few minutes later.
examples.zh: 他们几分钟后到了电影院。

examples.en: I urge you to go see this film when it comes to a theater near you.
examples.zh: 当谈到这部电影时，我强烈建议您去附近的剧院观看。

senses.def: plays considered as entertainment

examples.en: an evening of live music and theatre
examples.zh: 现场演奏音乐戏剧晚会

examples.en: I like music, theatre and cinema.
examples.zh: 我喜欢音乐、戏剧和电影。

examples.en: current ideas about what makes good theatre (= what makes good entertainment when performed)
examples.zh: 对何谓好戏剧的普遍看法

examples.en: We're huge fans of musical theatre.
examples.zh: 我们是音乐剧的狂热爱好者。

examples.en: live/street/youth theatre
examples.zh: 现场/街头/青年剧场

examples.en: a theatre critic
examples.zh: 戏剧评论家

senses.def: the work of writing, producing and acting in plays
senses.zh: 戏剧工作；剧作；演出；上演

examples.en: I want to work in theatre.
examples.zh: 我想从事戏剧工作。

examples.en: a theatre troupe/company
examples.zh: 剧团

examples.en: He had never done musical theatre when he landed the lead role as the Phantom.
examples.zh: 当他担任《幽灵》主角时，他从未演过音乐剧。

examples.en: He was essentially a man of the theatre.
examples.zh: 他本质上是个戏剧人。

examples.en: He wants to go into the theatre when he finishes university.
examples.zh: 他想读完大学后进入戏剧界。

senses.def: a room in a hospital used for medical operations

examples.en: a theatre sister (= a nurse who helps during operations)
examples.zh: 手术室护士

examples.en: He's still in theatre.
examples.zh: 他仍在接受手术。

examples.en: He's already been taken to theatre for the operation.
examples.zh: 他已经被送进手术室接受手术了。

senses.def: the place in which a war or fighting takes place

examples.en: an intelligence officer in the Pacific theatre
examples.zh: 太平洋战区的一名情报官员

examples.en: Russia replied by opening up a new theatre of war in the Balkans.
examples.zh: 俄罗斯的回应是在巴尔干地区开辟新战区。

senses.def: going regularly to the theatre
senses.zh: 定期去剧院的；经常看戏的

examples.en: the theatregoing public
examples.zh: 经常看戏的公众

senses.def: a way of performing plays on a stage which is surrounded by the audience
a nurse with special training, who helps during operations
a person who goes regularly to the theatre
senses.zh: 经常去戏院看戏的人；爱看戏的人

senses.def: connected with the theatre

examples.en: a theatrical agent
examples.zh: 演员经纪人

senses.def: deliberately attracting attention or creating a particular effect in a way that seems false
senses.zh: 演戏似的；夸张的；做作的

examples.en: a theatrical gesture
examples.zh: 夸张的姿势

senses.def: the exaggerated

examples.en: The speech reflected his love of theatricality and rhetoric.
examples.zh: 演讲反映了他对戏剧性和修辞的热爱。

examples.en: I was fascinated by the theatricality of the event.
examples.zh: 我对这次活动的戏剧性着迷。

senses.def: in a way that is connected with the theatre

examples.en: Theatrically speaking, he was a genius.
examples.zh: 从戏剧角度来说，他是一个天才。

senses.def: in a way that is exaggerated
senses.zh: 演戏似的；夸张的；做作的

examples.en: ‘What now?’ she sighed theatrically.
examples.zh: “现在怎么办？”她戏剧性地叹了口气。

senses.def: performances of plays

examples.en: amateur theatricals
examples.zh: 业余戏剧演出

senses.def: behaviour that is exaggerated

examples.en: I’ve had enough of her theatricals for one day!
examples.zh: 我一天已经受够了她的戏剧！

senses.def: a word meaning ‘you’, used when talking to only one person who is the object of the verb

examples.en: We beseech thee, O Lord.
examples.zh: 主啊，我们恳求您。

senses.def: the crime of stealing something from a person or place

examples.en: car theft
examples.zh: 偷盗汽车

examples.en: Police are investigating the theft of computers from the company's offices.
examples.zh: 警方正在调查这家公司办公室里的计算机失窃案。

examples.en: A number of thefts have been reported recently.
examples.zh: 近来有些偷窃案的报道。

senses.def: of or belonging to people, animals or things that have already been mentioned or are easily identified

examples.en: Their parties are always fun.
examples.zh: 他们的聚会总是乐趣横生。

examples.en: Which is their house?
examples.zh: 哪座房子是他们的？

senses.def: used instead of his
senses.zh: （在提及性别不详的人时，用以代替 his 或 her）

examples.en: If anyone calls, ask for their number so I can call them back.
examples.zh: 如有人打电话来，问问他们的电话号码，这样我可以回电话。

senses.def: of or belonging to them
senses.zh: 他们的，她们的，它们的（所有物）

examples.en: Theirs are the children with very fair hair.
examples.zh: 他们的孩子是那些长着满头金发的。

examples.en: It's a favourite game of theirs.
examples.zh: 这是他们最喜爱的游戏。

senses.def: belief in the existence of God or gods
a person whose job is to provide the workers or materials needed to do a piece of work
senses.zh: （提供劳动力或物资的）工程承办人；承包商

senses.def: a first name for girls
(1917-82) a US jazz musician who played the piano and wrote music. He led a big band in the 1960s and helped to develop modern jazz. His albums include Alone in San Francisco
senses.zh: （1917-82年）美国爵士音乐家，他弹钢琴和写音乐。他在1960年代领导一支大型乐队，并帮助发展了现代爵士乐。他的专辑包括1959年在旧金山的《独自一人》和1962年的《和尚的梦》。1963年，他入选爵士名人堂。

senses.def: used when referring to people, animals or things as the object of a verb or preposition, or after the verb be

examples.en: Tell them the news.
examples.zh: 把这消息告诉他们。

examples.en: What are you doing with those matches? Give them to me.
examples.zh: 你拿那些火柴做什么？把它们交给我。

examples.en: Did you eat all of them?
examples.zh: 你把它们都吃光了吗？

examples.en: It's them.
examples.zh: 是他们。

senses.def: used instead of him
senses.zh: （指性别不详的人时，用以代替 him 或 her）

examples.en: If anyone comes in before I get back, ask them to wait.
examples.zh: 如果在我回来之前有人来，就请他等一等。

senses.def: connected with the theme or themes of something

examples.en: the thematic structure of a text
examples.zh: 文本的主题结构

senses.def: the function that a noun phrase has in relation to a verb, for example agent
senses.zh: 解元角色，主题角色（指与动词相关的名词短语的功能，如施动者或受动者）

senses.def: in a way that is connected with the theme or themes of something

examples.en: The books have been grouped thematically.
examples.zh: 这些书已经按照主题分类。

senses.def: the subject or main idea in a talk, piece of writing or work of art
senses.zh: （演讲、文章或艺术作品的）题目，主题，主题思想

examples.en: the central/main/key/major theme
examples.zh: 中心主题；主要思想；关键／重要主题

examples.en: Births are a recurring theme in Leigh's work.
examples.zh: 出生是利的作品中重复出现的主题。

examples.en: Hot temperatures were a common theme over the past couple of weeks.
examples.zh: 高温是过去一两周老生常谈的话题。

examples.en: The stories are all variations on the theme of unhappy marriage.
examples.zh: 这些故事讲来讲去无非是这样那样的不幸婚姻。

examples.en: North American literature is the main theme of this year's festival.
examples.zh: 北美文学是今年艺术节的主题。

examples.en: The President stressed a favourite campaign theme—greater emphasis on education.
examples.zh: 总统强调了最受人欢迎的竞选主题 － 更加重视教育。

examples.en: The naked male figure was always the central theme of Greek art.
examples.zh: 男性裸体雕像总是希腊艺术的中心主题。

examples.en: Through sculptures Chen explored themes of illness, exile and cultural difference.
examples.zh: 陈通过雕塑探讨了疾病、流亡和文化差异等主题。

senses.def: a short tune that is repeated or developed in a piece of music

examples.en: The trumpets' theme is then taken up by the rest of orchestra.
examples.zh: 接着由乐队其他人员演奏小号主旋律。

senses.def: music that is played at the beginning and end and/or is often repeated in a film, television programme, etc.

examples.en: the theme from ‘The Godfather’
examples.zh: 《教父》的主题音乐

examples.en: The film's haunting musical theme stayed in my head for days.
examples.zh: 那部电影挥之不去的主题旋律多日来萦绕于我的脑际。

examples.en: He wrote and sang the theme to the hit TV series, ‘Minder’.
examples.zh: 他创作并演唱风靡一时的电视系列剧《保镖》的主题歌。

examples.en: His theme is played each time he appears on screen.
examples.zh: 每次他出现在屏幕上时都会播放他的主题曲。

senses.def: a short piece of writing on a particular subject, done for school
the part of a sentence or clause that contains information that is not new to the reader or audience
a pub, bar, etc. that is designed to reflect a particular subject or period of history
senses.zh: （反映某主题或历史时期的）主题酒馆（或酒吧、餐馆等）

examples.en: He wasn't doing anything, just standing there.

senses.def: an event or action that is the beginning of something more serious and/or unpleasant
senses.zh: （不好的事物的）端倪，冰山一角

examples.en: The introduction of a tax on workplace parking is seen by many as the thin end of the wedge.
examples.zh: 许多人认为，对工作场所停车征税只是楔子的薄弱环节。

senses.def: with little or no hair on the head

examples.en: He's starting to get a little thin on top (= he's losing his hair).
examples.zh: 他开始有点谢顶了。

examples.en: He's going bald on top.
examples.zh: 他谢顶了。

senses.def: the lack of ability to accept criticism, offensive remarks, etc. without becoming upset

examples.en: You shouldn’t be in politics if you have such a thin skin.
examples.zh: 如果你脸皮这么薄，就不应该从政。

senses.def: even when there are problems or difficulties
senses.zh: 不顾艰难险阻；赴汤蹈火；同甘共苦

examples.en: He's supported the team for over ten years through thick and thin.
examples.zh: 十多年来，在任何情况下他都支持这个队。

examples.en: In marriage, you have to stick together through thick and thin.
examples.zh: 在婚姻中，你们必须同甘共苦。

senses.def: to be in a difficult or dangerous situation where you could easily make a mistake
senses.zh: 处于困境（或险境）；如履薄冰；走钢丝

examples.en: He was walking a fine line between being funny and being rude.
examples.zh: 他想滑稽而不粗鲁，难以把握分寸。

examples.en: She often seems to tread a thin line between success and failure.
examples.zh: 她似乎经常在成功与失败之间徘徊。

senses.def: to begin to become weaker or less acceptable
senses.zh: 开始变弱；变得不受欢迎；变得兴趣索然

examples.en: These excuses are wearing a little thin (= because we've heard them so many times before).
examples.zh: 这些托辞让人听得有点儿腻烦。

examples.en: My patience is beginning to wear very thin.
examples.zh: 我有些不耐烦了。

senses.def: in a way that produces a thin piece or layer of something

examples.en: Don't spread it too thin.
examples.zh: 不要涂得太薄。

examples.en: I like my bread sliced thin.
examples.zh: 我喜欢吃切成薄片的面包。

senses.def: to make a liquid less thick or strong by adding water or another substance

examples.en: Thin the paint with water.
examples.zh: 用水把颜料调稀。

examples.en: If the soup is too thick, thin it down with a little milk.
examples.zh: 如果汤太浓，可以加一点牛奶稀释。

senses.def: to become less thick

examples.en: a middle-aged man with thinning hair
examples.zh: 头发逐渐稀少的中年男子

examples.en: His hair was long at the sides but thinning on top.
examples.zh: 他的头发两侧很长，但顶部稀疏。

senses.def: to become less thick or fewer in number; to make something less thick or fewer, for example by removing some things or people

examples.en: The clouds thinned and the moon shone through.
examples.zh: 云层渐稀，透出了月光。

examples.en: The crowd had thinned out and only a few people were left.
examples.zh: 人群渐渐散去，只剩下几个人。

examples.en: The traffic was beginning to thin out.
examples.zh: 车流开始稀疏。

examples.en: Thin out the seedlings to about 10cm apart.
examples.zh: 把秧苗间成相隔 10 厘米。

senses.def: to be taking a risk

items.idm: disappear, vanish, etc. into thin air

senses.def: to disappear suddenly in a mysterious way
senses.zh: 消失得无影无踪；不翼而飞；悄然而逝

examples.en: She can’t just have vanished into thin air.
examples.zh: 她不可能凭空消失。

examples.en: At a stroke she could make things vanish into thin air.
examples.zh: 她用手碰到什么就能让它消失不见。

senses.def: to have many problems or difficulties to deal with; to not be successful
senses.zh: 遇到许多麻烦；过得不顺

examples.en: He’s had a thin time of it since losing his job.
examples.zh: 自从失业后，他的日子就过得很艰难。

senses.def: from nowhere or nothing, as if by magic

examples.en: Unfortunately, I can’t just conjure up the money out of thin air!
examples.zh: 不幸的是，我不能凭空变出钱来！

senses.def: to try to do so many different things at the same time that you do not do any of them well
senses.zh: 样样都抓，哪样都抓不好

examples.en: With four markets to manage, there's a danger that's she's spreading herself too thin.
examples.zh: 她要管理四个市场，恐怕会分身乏术。

senses.def: if people or things are thick/thin on the ground
senses.zh: 为数众多（或不多）；数目巨大（或微小）；众多（或稀少）

examples.en: Customers are thin on the ground at this time of year.
examples.zh: 一年里这个时节顾客很少。

examples.en: Security officers were thick on the ground during the King’s visit.
examples.zh: 国王访问期间，安保人员密密麻麻。

items.idm: the thin end of the wedge

senses.def: an event or action that is the beginning of something more serious and/or unpleasant
senses.zh: （不好的事物的）端倪，冰山一角

examples.en: The introduction of a tax on workplace parking is seen by many as the thin end of the wedge.
examples.zh: 许多人认为，对工作场所停车征税只是楔子的薄弱环节。

senses.def: with little or no hair on the head

examples.en: He's starting to get a little thin on top (= he's losing his hair).
examples.zh: 他开始有点谢顶了。

examples.en: He's going bald on top.
examples.zh: 他谢顶了。

senses.def: the lack of ability to accept criticism, offensive remarks, etc. without becoming upset

examples.en: You shouldn’t be in politics if you have such a thin skin.
examples.zh: 如果你脸皮这么薄，就不应该从政。

senses.def: even when there are problems or difficulties
senses.zh: 不顾艰难险阻；赴汤蹈火；同甘共苦

examples.en: He's supported the team for over ten years through thick and thin.
examples.zh: 十多年来，在任何情况下他都支持这个队。

examples.en: In marriage, you have to stick together through thick and thin.
examples.zh: 在婚姻中，你们必须同甘共苦。

items.idm: walk/tread a fine/thin line (between A and B)

senses.def: to be in a difficult or dangerous situation where you could easily make a mistake
senses.zh: 处于困境（或险境）；如履薄冰；走钢丝

examples.en: He was walking a fine line between being funny and being rude.
examples.zh: 他想滑稽而不粗鲁，难以把握分寸。

examples.en: She often seems to tread a thin line between success and failure.
examples.zh: 她似乎经常在成功与失败之间徘徊。

senses.def: to begin to become weaker or less acceptable
senses.zh: 开始变弱；变得不受欢迎；变得兴趣索然

examples.en: These excuses are wearing a little thin (= because we've heard them so many times before).
examples.zh: 这些托辞让人听得有点儿腻烦。

examples.en: My patience is beginning to wear very thin.
examples.zh: 我有些不耐烦了。

senses.def: easily upset by criticism or offensive remarks
senses.zh: 脸皮薄的；（对批评或冒犯的语言）易生气的

senses.def: having a thin skin
with little or no hair on the head

examples.en: He's starting to get a little thin on top (= he's losing his hair).
examples.zh: 他开始有点谢顶了。

examples.en: He's going bald on top.
examples.zh: 他谢顶了。

senses.def: a word meaning ‘yours’, used when talking to only one person
senses.zh: （第二人称单数的物主代词）你的（所有物）

senses.def: the form of thy
senses.zh: （第二人称单数所有格 thy 的另一种形式，用于元音或 h 前）你的

senses.def: an object whose name you do not use because you do not need to or want to, or because you do not know it

examples.en: Can you pass me that thing over there?
examples.zh: 把那边那个东西递给我好吗？

examples.en: She's very fond of sweet things (= sweet foods).
examples.zh: 她非常喜欢吃甜食。

examples.en: He's just bought one of those exercise things.
examples.zh: 他刚买了一副健身器械。

examples.en: Turn that thing off while I'm talking to you!
examples.zh: 我在跟你说话，把那个玩意儿关掉！

senses.def: an object that is not alive in the way that people and plants are

examples.en: Don't treat her like that—she's a person, not a thing!
examples.zh: 别那样对待她，她是人，不是物件！

examples.en: He's good at making things with his hands.
examples.zh: 他善于手工制作物品。

examples.en: She took no interest in the people and things around her.
examples.zh: 她对周围的人和事毫无兴趣。

examples.en: Books may one day become a thing of the past (= something that no longer exists).
examples.zh: 书籍有一天会成为过去。

examples.en: I need to buy a few basic things like bread and milk.
examples.zh: 我需要买一些面包、牛奶之类的必需品。

senses.def: objects, clothing or tools that belong to somebody or are used for a particular purpose

examples.en: Shall I help you pack your things?
examples.zh: 我帮你打点行装好吗？

examples.en: Bring your swimming things with you.
examples.zh: 随身带上游泳用品。

examples.en: I'll just clear away the breakfast things.
examples.zh: 我这就收拾早餐餐具。

examples.en: Put your things (= coat, etc.) on and let's go.
examples.zh: 把你的衣服穿上，咱们就走。

senses.def: a fact, an event, a situation or an action; what somebody says or thinks
senses.zh: 事实；事件；情况；行为；话语；想法

examples.en: They talked about many things, like books, music and films.
examples.zh: 他们谈了许多事，诸如书、音乐和电影。

examples.en: There are a lot of things she doesn't know about me.
examples.zh: 我有很多情况她都不了解。

examples.en: There's another thing I need to tell you.
examples.zh: 我还有一件事要告诉你。

examples.en: Bad things happen to good people.
examples.zh: 好人会摊上坏事。

examples.en: I've got lots of things to do today.
examples.zh: 今天我有许多事要做。

examples.en: He has things on his mind.
examples.zh: 他心里有事儿。

examples.en: The most important thing in life is to have fun!
examples.zh: 生活中最重要的事儿是快乐。

examples.en: She said the first thing that came into her head.
examples.zh: 她想到了什么就说什么。

examples.en: Forgetting her was the only thing in the world I found I couldn't do.
examples.zh: 忘记她是世界上我唯一做不到的事情。

examples.en: He found the whole thing (= the situation) very boring.
examples.zh: 他觉得整件事情非常无聊。

examples.en: Let's forget the whole thing (= everything).
examples.zh: 咱们把所有事情都忘掉吧。

examples.en: Among other things, I have to deal with mail and keep the accounts.
examples.zh: 除了其他事情，我还要处理邮件和记账。

examples.en: I like camping, climbing and that sort of thing.
examples.zh: 我喜欢露营、爬山之类的活动。

examples.en: ‘Why did you tell her our secret?’ ‘I did no such thing!’
examples.zh: “你为什么把我们的秘密告诉她？”“我没干过这种事！”

examples.en: There's no such thing as a typical day in this job.
examples.zh: 这种工作就没有正常工作日这样的事情。

examples.en: One thing is for sure—it will be a memorable evening!
examples.zh: 有一点是肯定的——这将是一个难忘的夜晚。

examples.en: The main thing to remember is to switch off the burglar alarm.
examples.zh: 最要紧的是记住关掉防盗报警器的开关。

senses.group: fact/event/situation/action 事实；事件；情况；行为

senses.def: the general situation, as it affects somebody

examples.en: Things haven't gone entirely to plan.
examples.zh: 事态没有完全按照计划发展。

examples.en: I wish things could have been different.
examples.zh: 我希望事情能有所不同。

examples.en: Hi, Jane! How are things?
examples.zh: 喂，简，近来怎么样？

examples.en: As things stand at present, he seems certain to win.
examples.zh: 据目前情况看，他似乎胜券在握。

examples.en: All things considered (= considering all the difficulties or problems), she's done very well.
examples.zh: 通盘考虑起来，她干得很好。

examples.en: They're trying to change things for the better.
examples.zh: 他们正在努力改进现状。

examples.en: Things have changed over the last few years.
examples.zh: 过去几年里情况发生了变化。

examples.en: He's happy with the way things have worked out.
examples.zh: 他对事情的进展感到满意。

examples.en: Why do you make things so difficult for yourself?
examples.zh: 你为什么这样跟自己过不去？

senses.group: fact/event/situation/action 事实；事件；情况；行为

senses.def: a quality or a concept

examples.en: Reality and truth are not the same thing.
examples.zh: 现实和实情不是同一个概念。

examples.en: The two of them have one thing in common—they never give up.
examples.zh: 他们两人有一个共同特点——他们从不放弃。

examples.en: The good thing about this job is all the travelling.
examples.zh: 这份工作的好处是到处旅行。

senses.def: what is needed or socially acceptable
senses.zh: 需要的东西；适当的东西；合适的东西

examples.en: You need something to cheer you up—I know just the thing!
examples.zh: 你需要点什么使你高兴起来，我知道什么正合你的需要！

examples.en: to say the right/wrong thing
examples.zh: 说得体的／不得体的话

examples.en: The best thing to do is to apologize.
examples.zh: 道歉方是上策。

senses.group: what is needed/right 需要的／合适的事物

senses.def: used to say that something is important or real
senses.zh: 重要的事情；真实的事情

examples.en: I don't understand why these corny films are still a thing in 2020.
examples.zh: 我不明白为什么这些老掉牙的电影在 2020 年还受欢迎。

examples.en: I'm not sure that ‘modular techno music’ is really a thing.
examples.zh: 我不确定是不是真有“模块泰克诺音乐”这回事。

senses.def: used with negatives to mean ‘anything’ in order to emphasize what you are saying
senses.zh: 任何东西（用于否定句，加强语气）

examples.en: I haven't got a thing to wear!
examples.zh: 我没有一件可穿的衣服！

examples.en: She hasn't had a thing to eat all day.
examples.zh: 她一整天都没有吃东西。

examples.en: There wasn't a thing we could do to help.
examples.zh: 没有什么我们能帮得上忙的。

examples.en: Ignore what he said—it doesn't mean a thing.
examples.zh: 别理睬他说的话，他那都是瞎说。

senses.def: all that can be described in a particular way
senses.zh: 所有…的事物；凡是…的东西

examples.en: She loves all things Japanese.
examples.zh: 凡是日本的东西她都喜欢。

senses.group: things of particular type 某种类型的事物

senses.def: a living creature

examples.en: All living things are composed of cells.
examples.zh: 所有的生物都由细胞组成。

senses.def: used to talk to or about a person or an animal, to show how you feel about them
senses.zh: （指人或动物，带感情色彩）人，家伙，东西

examples.en: You silly thing!
examples.zh: 你这个蠢货！

examples.en: You must be starving, you poor things.
examples.zh: 你们一定是饿坏了，你们这些可怜的家伙。

examples.en: The cat's very ill, poor old thing.
examples.zh: 这猫病得很厉害，真可怜。

examples.en: The baby's a pretty little thing.
examples.zh: 小宝宝是个漂亮的小东西。

senses.def: if the conditions stay the same; if other conditions are the same
senses.zh: 如果所有条件保持不变；如果其他情况一样

examples.en: All things being equal, we should finish the job tomorrow.
examples.zh: 一切照常的话，我们明天应该完成这项工作。

examples.en: All other things being equal, the bigger fighter should win.
examples.zh: 同等条件下，大块头的拳手应该会赢。

senses.def: used when you do not want to complete a list

examples.en: She likes nice clothes and things like that.
examples.zh: 她喜欢漂亮衣服之类的东西。

examples.en: I've been busy shopping and things.
examples.zh: 我一直忙于购物之类的事情。

senses.def: as was shown or proved by later events
senses.zh: 正如后来表明的；果然如此；果不其然

examples.en: I didn't need my umbrella, as it turned out (= because it didn't rain).
examples.zh: 我果然没用上我的伞。

senses.def: as was shown or proved by later events
senses.zh: 正如后来表明的；果然如此；果不其然

examples.en: As things turned out, the weather—and the whole weekend—were perfect.
examples.zh: 事实证明，天气——以及整个周末——都很完美。

senses.def: to please everyone by changing your attitudes or opinions to suit different people
to be understood or used in different ways by different people
to be socially acceptable behaviour
senses.zh: 是合乎礼仪的行为；是得体的行为

senses.def: to be lucky that…

examples.en: It's a good thing we got here early.
examples.zh: 幸亏我们早到了这儿。

examples.en: It's a good thing you remembered to turn off the gas!
examples.zh: 你没忘关煤气，很好！

senses.def: used to say that although something seems to be bad, it could have good results
senses.zh: 并不是坏事；或许是好事

examples.en: We didn't want the press to get hold of the story, but it might be no bad thing.
examples.zh: 我们本不想让新闻界知道这事，但是知道了也许并非是坏事。

examples.en: It's no bad thing to express your anger.
examples.zh: 表达愤怒不是坏事。

senses.def: to have found a job, situation or style of life that is pleasant or easy
senses.zh: 找到称心的工作；过上舒心的日子；混得不错

senses.def: to imagine that you can see or hear something that is in fact not there
people say chance would be a fine thing
a situation in which somebody only just wins or loses, for example in a competition or an election
senses.zh: （比赛或选举等中的）险胜，差距很小的败北

examples.en: Mr Taylor’s election defeat was a close-run thing.
examples.zh: 泰勒先生的选举失败是一场势均力敌的事情。

examples.en: The invasion never happened but it was a close-run thing.
examples.zh: 侵略始终没有发生，但是差一点就发生了。

senses.def: a situation in which success or failure is equally possible

examples.en: We got him out in the end, but it was a close thing.
examples.zh: 我们最后总算把他救了出来，可那是真险啊。

senses.def: to have the same result or meaning
to do what you want to do or what interests you, without thinking about other people; to be independent
senses.zh: 做自己想做的事；照自己的意愿行事；独立自主；自行其是

senses.def: to have a powerful emotional effect on somebody
senses.zh: 使某人十分激动；震撼某人

examples.en: That song just does things to me.
examples.zh: 一听到那首歌我就激动不已。

senses.def: early in the morning/late in the evening
senses.zh: 一早／晚上最后（要做的事）

examples.en: I need the report on my desk first thing Monday morning.
examples.zh: 星期一一早这个报告就得放在我的办公桌上。

examples.en: I took the dog for a walk last thing before going to bed.
examples.zh: 晚上就寝前我去遛狗了。

senses.def: the most important matters must be dealt with first
senses.zh: 最重要的事最早办；要事先办

examples.en: We have a lot to discuss, but, first things first, let's have a cup of coffee!
examples.zh: 我们有许多事要讨论，不过急事先办，咱们先喝杯咖啡吧！

senses.def: used to introduce one of two or more possible reasons for doing something
senses.zh: （用以引出两个或更多的理由之一）一来，一方面

examples.en: ‘Why don't you get a car?’ ‘Well, for one thing, I can't drive!’
examples.zh: “你为什么不买辆汽车呢？”“啊，首先，我不会开车！”

senses.def: to have something arranged in the way that you want, even though other people want it to be arranged differently

examples.en: The German team weren't going to let the English have everything their own way.
examples.zh: 德国队不会让英格兰队按自己的方式行事。

senses.def: to have a strong like or dislike of somebody/something in a way that seems strange or unreasonable
senses.zh: （莫名其妙地）对…有好感，对…有偏见

examples.en: She has a thing about men with beards.
examples.zh: 她对留胡子的男人有强烈的感觉。

senses.def: to be sexually attracted to somebody; to like something very much

examples.en: Liz has always had a thing for guys in bands.
examples.zh: 莉兹总是对乐队里的小伙子春心萌动。

examples.en: He has a thing for the new girl in the office.
examples.zh: 他对办公室里的新来的女孩很感兴趣。

examples.en: Jamie has a thing for fast cars.
examples.zh: 杰米喜欢开快车。

senses.def: in the way that things usually happen

examples.en: In the nature of things, young people often rebel against their parents.
examples.zh: 年轻人常常会反抗他们的父母，这很自然。

senses.def: B is very different from A, for example it is more difficult, serious or important
senses.zh: …是一回事，…是另一回事；…和…截然不同

examples.en: Romance is one thing; marriage is quite another.
examples.zh: 爱情是一回事，婚姻却是另一回事。

examples.en: It's one thing to tease your sister, but it's another to hit her.
examples.zh: 逗你妹妹玩是一回事，但打她那就另当别论了。

senses.def: it isn’t something that you really enjoy or are interested in
senses.zh: 这不是我（或他等）真正喜欢的东西；并非…所好

senses.def: it is something that only a particular group understands
senses.zh: 这是…的事（只有某群体才理解的）

examples.en: You wouldn't know what it means—it's a girl thing.
examples.zh: 你不会知道那是什么意思，那是女孩子家的事。

senses.def: to know/tell somebody some useful, interesting or surprising information about somebody/something
senses.zh: 了解／透露有用的（或有趣的、意外的）信息；有所了解／披露；见多识广

examples.en: She's been married five times, so she knows a thing or two about men!
examples.zh: 她结过五次婚，所以对男人有所了解。

senses.def: to make something seem more important than it really is
senses.zh: 小题大做；大惊小怪；故弄玄虚

senses.def: a situation in which you are successful, but which could also have ended badly
