examples.en: Shall I help you pack your things?
examples.zh: 我帮你打点行装好吗？

items.def: [U] (informal) used to refer to a group of objects when you do not know their names, when the names are not important or when it is obvious what you are talking about:
items.zh: 指名称不详、名称无关紧要或所指明确的东西、物品、玩意儿

examples.en: Where’s all my stuff?
examples.zh: 我那些东西都哪儿去了？

items.def: [U] (rather formal) a thing or things that are owned by somebody:
items.zh: 指所有物、财产、财物

examples.en: This building is government property.
examples.zh: 这座大楼是政府的财产。

items.def: things that you own, especially something that can be moved:
items.zh: 指个人财产、私人物品（尤指动产）

examples.en: Prisoners were allowed no personal possessions except letters and photographs.
examples.zh: 囚犯除信件和照片外不允许有任何私人物品。

items.def: [U] things that are considered useless or of little value:
items.zh: 指无用的东西、无价值的东西

examples.en: I’ve cleared out all that old junk from the attic.
examples.zh: 我把阁楼里所有的废旧杂物都清除干净了。

items.def: possessions that can be moved, especially ones that you have with you at a particular time:
items.zh: 指动产，尤指随身物品

examples.en: Please make sure you have all your belongings with you when leaving the plane.
examples.zh: 请确保在下飞机前带好所有的随身物品。

items.def: (specialist or rather formal) possessions that can be moved:
items.zh: 指动产、（可搬运的）私人财产

examples.en: He was found guilty of handling stolen goods.
examples.zh: 他被判犯销赃罪。

items.def: things that are worth a lot of money, especially small personal things such as jewellery or cameras:
items.zh: 尤指私人的贵重物品（如首饰、相机等）

examples.en: Never leave cash or other valuables lying around.
examples.zh: 现金或其他贵重物品请勿乱放。

synonyms.words: circumstances ▪ position ▪ conditions ▪ things ▪ the case ▪ state of affairs

intro.en: These are all words for the conditions and facts that are connected with and affect the way things are.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指情况、状况。

items.def: all the things that are happening at a particular time and in a particular place:
items.zh: 指情况、状况、形势、局面

examples.en: the present economic situation
examples.zh: 目前的经济形势

items.def: the facts that are connected with and affect a situation, an event or an action; the conditions of a person’s life, especially the money they have:
items.zh: 指条件、环境、状况、境况，（尤指）经济状况

examples.en: The ship sank in mysterious circumstances.
examples.zh: 那艘船神秘地沉没了。

items.def: the situation that somebody is in, especially when it affects what they can and cannot do:
items.zh: 指处境、地位、状况

examples.en: She felt she was in a position of power.
examples.zh: 她觉得她自己有权力。

items.def: the circumstances in which people live, work or do things; the physical situation that affects how something happens:
items.zh: 指居住、工作或做事情的环境、境况、条件，影响某事发生的物质环境、状态、条件

examples.en: We were forced to work outside in freezing conditions.
examples.zh: 我们被迫在户外天寒地冻的环境下工作。

items.def: (rather informal) the general situation, as it affects somebody:
items.zh: 指形势、局面、情况、事态

examples.en: Hi, Jane! How are things?
examples.zh: 喂，简，近来怎么样？

items.def: the true situation:
items.zh: 指实情、事实

examples.en: If that is the case (= if the situation described is true), we need more staff.
examples.zh: 如果真是那样，我们就需要更多的员工了。

items.def: a situation:
items.zh: 指事态、情况、形势

examples.en: How did this unhappy state of affairs come about?
examples.zh: 这种不幸的情况是怎么发生的呢？

senses.def: used to refer to a thing whose name you do not know or have forgotten, or which you do not want to mention
senses.zh: （指不知、或忘记、或不想提及其名）某某，那东西

examples.en: It's one of those thingamajigs for keeping papers together.
examples.zh: 就是那种可以把文件归放在一起的那个东西。

senses.def: used to refer to ghosts and other supernatural
senses.zh: 夜里奇异可怕的响声；鬼魂；超自然现象

examples.en: There are mysterious lights in the sky and things that go bump in the night.
examples.zh: 天空中有神秘的灯光，夜晚有东西碰撞。

things that go bump in the night.word: things that go bump in the night

senses.def: used to refer to a person or thing whose name you do not know or have forgotten, or that you do not want to mention
senses.zh: （指不知、忘记或不想提及其名）某某，那个人，那东西

examples.en: It's one of those thingummies for keeping papers together.
examples.zh: 就是能收纳文件的那么一种东西。

examples.en: Is thingummy going to be there? You know, that woman from the Sales Department?
examples.zh: 某某人会去那儿吗？你知道，就是销售部的那个女的。

senses.def: used to refer to a person or thing whose name you do not know or have forgotten, or which you do not want to mention
senses.zh: （指不知、或忘记、或不想提及其名）某某，那个人，那东西

examples.en: Look at that woman over there—the one with the straw hat with the pink thingy around it.
examples.zh: 看看那边那个女人——那个戴着草帽、帽子周围有粉色东西的女人。

examples.en: This new multimedia thingy means you can research things a lot more easily.
examples.zh: 这个新的多媒体玩意儿意味着做研究可以容易多了。

senses.def: to have a particular idea or opinion about something/somebody; to believe something

examples.en: Do you really think (that) he'll win?
examples.zh: 你真认为他会赢吗？

examples.en: I thought I heard a scream.
examples.zh: 我好像听到了一声尖叫。

examples.en: I didn't think people were allowed to park here.
examples.zh: 我原以为这里不让停车。

examples.en: Am I right in thinking that you used to live here?
examples.zh: 我想你过去在这里住过，对吗？

examples.en: I think this is their house, but I'm not sure.
examples.zh: 我想这是他们的家，但不敢肯定。

examples.en: He ought to resign, I think.
examples.zh: 我看他应该辞职。

examples.en: That's my opinion, but you might think otherwise (= have a different opinion).
examples.zh: 那是我的看法，你可以不同意。

examples.en: We'll need about 20 chairs, I should think.
examples.zh: 我看我们需要大约 20 把椅子。

examples.en: I can't help thinking (that) things could have been different.
examples.zh: 我禁不住想事情本可以是另外一副样子。

examples.en: It was once thought that the sun travelled around the earth.
examples.zh: 人们曾经认为太阳绕着地球转。

examples.en: Well, I like it. What do you think?
examples.zh: 嗯，我喜欢这个。你认为怎么样？

examples.en: What did you think about the idea?
examples.zh: 你原先认为这个想法怎么样？

examples.en: What did you think of the film?
examples.zh: 你觉得这部电影怎么样？

examples.en: ‘Is he any good?’ ‘I don't think so.’
examples.zh: “他怎么样？”“我认为一般。”

examples.en: ‘Will we make it in time?’ ‘I think so.’
examples.zh: “我们会及时完成吗？”“我想会的。”

examples.en: I think it highly unlikely that I'll get the job.
examples.zh: 我认为我得到这份工作的可能性极小。

examples.en: She thought him kind and generous.
examples.zh: 她认为他宽厚仁慈。

examples.en: It was better than I thought possible.
examples.zh: 这比我想象的要好。

examples.en: I thought it a good idea to go with him.
examples.zh: 我认为和他一起去是个好主意。

examples.en: He's thought to be one of the richest men in Europe.
examples.zh: 他被认为是欧洲最富有的人之一。

examples.en: I think of this place as my home.
examples.zh: 我把这个地方当成了家。

examples.en: She is thought of as a possible director.
examples.zh: 人们认为她有可能成为董事。

senses.def: to use your mind to consider something, to form connected ideas, to try to solve problems, etc.

examples.en: Are animals able to think?
examples.zh: 动物会思考吗？

examples.en: Let me think (= give me time before I answer).
examples.zh: 让我想一想。

examples.en: Stop and think for a moment before making any decisions.
examples.zh: 在做出任何决定之前先停下来思考一下。

examples.en: I'm sorry, I wasn't thinking (= said when you have upset or offended somebody accidentally).
examples.zh: 对不起，我太冒昧了。

examples.en: I can't tell you now—I'll have to think about it.
examples.zh: 我现在无法告诉你，我得考虑一下。

examples.en: The government needs to think carefully about the issues raised.
examples.zh: 政府需要认真考虑所提出的问题。

examples.en: All he ever thinks about is money.
examples.zh: 他满脑子想的只是钱。

examples.en: He was trying to think what to do.
examples.zh: 他在努力想办法。

senses.def: to have ideas, words or images in your mind

examples.en: You're very quiet. What are you thinking?
examples.zh: 你一声不吭，在想什么？

examples.en: I was just thinking what a long way it is.
examples.zh: 我刚才在琢磨路途太远了。

examples.en: ‘I must be crazy,’ she thought.
examples.zh: “我准是疯了。”她想。

examples.en: ‘What can I do now?’ he thought frantically.
examples.zh: “我现在能做什么？”他焦躁不安地想。

senses.def: to form an idea of something; to imagine something

examples.en: We couldn't think where you'd gone.
examples.zh: 我们猜不出来你到哪里去了。

examples.en: Just think how nice it would be to see them again.
examples.zh: 试想一下要是能再见到他们该有多好。

examples.en: I hate to think what would have happened if we hadn't arrived.
examples.zh: 我不敢想象当时要是我们没有赶到会出现什么情况。

examples.en: I like to think (that) he would help if I needed it.
examples.zh: 我希望当我有需要时他会帮忙。

examples.en: I can’t think (that) he would be so stupid.
examples.zh: 我不能想象他会这么蠢。

examples.en: If I'm home late, my mother always thinks the worst.
examples.zh: 如果我回家晚了，我母亲总是往最坏处想。

examples.en: Just think—we'll be lying on the beach this time tomorrow.
examples.zh: 想想看，明天这个时候我们就躺在海滩上了。

examples.en: Try to think yourself into the role.
examples.zh: 尽量发挥想象力，使自己进入角色。

senses.def: to expect something

examples.en: I never thought (that) I’d see her again.
examples.zh: 我从未料想到还会见到她。

examples.en: The job took longer than we thought.
examples.zh: 这项工作用的时间比我们预想的多。

examples.en: You'd think she'd have been grateful for my help (= but she wasn't).
examples.zh: 你还期望她会对我的帮助感恩戴德呢。

examples.en: I never thought you would carry out your threat.
examples.zh: 我从未想过你会把威胁付诸行动。

examples.en: Who would have thought to find you here?
examples.zh: 谁会料到你在这儿呢？

senses.def: to think in a particular way or on a particular subject

examples.en: Let's think positive.
examples.zh: 咱们往好的方面想吧。

examples.en: You need to think big (= aim to achieve a lot).
examples.zh: 你要敢想。

examples.en: If you want to make money, you've got to think money.
examples.zh: 你要想赚钱，就得一门心思琢磨钱。

senses.group: in a particular way 以某种方式

senses.def: used in questions to show that you are angry or surprised

examples.en: What do you think you're doing?
examples.zh: 你以为你在干什么？

senses.group: showing anger/surprise 表示生气／吃惊

senses.def: used to make something you say sound less definite or more polite
senses.zh: （用于使话语不太肯定或较为婉转）

examples.en: I thought we could go out tonight.
examples.zh: 我本想我们今晚可以出去。

examples.en: Twenty guests are enough, I would have thought.
examples.zh: 我觉得二十位客人就够了。

examples.en: Do you think you could open the window?
examples.zh: 请打开窗子好吗？

examples.en: ‘You've made a mistake.’ ‘I don't think so.’
examples.zh: “你出错了。”“我想不会吧。”

senses.group: being less definite/more polite 不太肯定；较为婉转

senses.def: to intend something; to have a plan about something

examples.en: I think I'll go for a swim.
examples.zh: 我想去游泳。

examples.en: I'm thinking in terms of about 70 guests at the wedding.
examples.zh: 我打算邀请 70 位嘉宾参加婚礼。

senses.def: to remember something; to have something come into your mind

examples.en: I didn't think (= it did not occur to me) to tell her.
examples.zh: 我没有想到要告诉她。

examples.en: I can't think where I put the keys.
examples.zh: 我想不起把钥匙放在哪儿了。

senses.def: to behave in a very confident way that annoys other people, for example by telling them what to do

examples.en: She was acting as if she owned the place.
examples.zh: 她的一举一动好像在说这是她的地盘似的。

senses.def: used when you suddenly remember something or realize that it might be important
senses.zh: （用于突然想起某事或认识到其重要性）想起来了，的确

examples.en: Come to think of it, he did mention seeing you.
examples.zh: 想起来了，他确实提到看见过你。

senses.def: used to say that you and another person must both be very clever because you have had the same idea or agree about something
used to say very strongly that you do not agree with something, or that something is not possible
senses.zh: 我想并非如此；我不这样认为；根本不可能

examples.en: Me? Fail? I don't think so.
examples.zh: 我？失败？我可不这样认为。

senses.def: used to draw attention to a fact that is not obvious or has not previously been mentioned
senses.zh: （用以引起对不明显或未曾提到过的事情的注意）你想想看

examples.en: It was a difficult situation, when you think about it.
examples.zh: 仔细想来，当时处境是很困难的。

senses.def: used to say that you hope or believe that something is true
senses.zh: （表示希望或相信某事属实）我倒想…

examples.en: I like to think I'm broad-minded.
examples.zh: 我倒想心胸开阔。

examples.en: I’d like to think that you were helping me because you wanted to, not because you felt you had to.
examples.zh: 我想你帮助我是因为你愿意，而不是因为你觉得你必须这样做。

senses.def: that is what I expected or suspected
senses.zh: 我早料到了；果然不出我所料

examples.en: ‘He said he'd forgotten.’ ‘I thought as much.’
examples.zh: “他说他忘了。”“果然不出我所料。”

senses.def: used when you are thinking or trying to remember something
senses.zh: 让我想一想；让我思考一下

examples.en: Now let me see—where did he say he lived?
examples.zh: 嗯，让我想想，他说他住在哪里呢？

senses.def: to consider it right or acceptable to do something; to decide or choose to do something
senses.zh: 认为（做某事）恰当（或适合）；决定，愿意（做某事）

examples.en: You must do as you think fit (= but I don't agree with your decision).
examples.zh: 你认为怎么合适就怎么干（但我不同意你的决定）。

examples.en: The newspaper did not see fit to publish my letter (= and I criticize it for that).
examples.zh: 那份报纸认为我的信件不宜发表（而我批评这种看法）。

senses.def: to say or think bad things about somebody

examples.en: Don't speak ill of the dead.
examples.zh: 勿议已故者之短。

senses.def: to consider a situation again and perhaps change your idea or intention
senses.zh: 重新考虑后另作打算（常指最终改变主意）

examples.en: You really should think again about that.
examples.zh: 对那件事你真的应该三思。

senses.def: to say what your thoughts are as you have them
senses.zh: 自言自语；边想边说；进行有声思考

senses.def: to have a higher opinion of somebody

examples.en: She has behaved appallingly—I must say I thought better of her.
examples.zh: 她的行为太恶劣了，看来我过去是高看了她。

senses.def: to decide not to do something after thinking further about it
senses.zh: 深思熟虑后决定不做；一想又改变主意

examples.en: Rosie was about to protest but thought better of it.
examples.zh: 罗西刚要抗议，但又一想决定作罢。

senses.def: to form your own opinions and make decisions without depending on others
to say or think bad things about somebody

examples.en: I wouldn't want them to think ill of me.
examples.zh: 我不想让他们对我有不好的看法。

senses.def: to consider an activity to be normal and not particularly unusual or difficult
senses.zh: 不把…当一回事；对…等闲视之；觉得…无所谓

examples.en: She thinks nothing of walking thirty miles a day.
examples.zh: 她认为一天步行三十英里不足为奇。

senses.def: used as a polite response when somebody has said sorry to you or thanked you
to be able to think and react to things very quickly and effectively without any preparation
to think about something, or how to do something, in a way that is new, different or shows imagination
senses.zh: 跳出框框想问题；另辟蹊径

senses.def: to think in a clear or logical way

examples.en: The drugs were affecting her and she couldn't think straight.
examples.zh: 药物作用下，她无法清晰思考。

senses.def: to think carefully before deciding to do something
senses.zh: 三思而行；慎重考虑后再决定

examples.en: You should think twice about employing someone you've never met.
examples.zh: 雇用素不相识的人应三思而行。

senses.def: to have a very good, poor, etc. opinion of somebody/something

examples.en: He thinks the world of his daughter.
examples.zh: 他非常器重女儿。

examples.en: I don't think much of her idea.
examples.zh: 我认为她的主意不怎么样。

senses.def: used to show that you are surprised or shocked by something
senses.zh: （表示惊奇或震惊）真想不到，竟然

examples.en: To think that my mother wrote all those books and I never knew!
examples.zh: 我母亲写了那么多的书，我竟然一无所知！

senses.def: to think carefully about something in order to make a decision about it
senses.zh: 想一想，琢磨一下（以便作决定）

examples.en: I'll have a think and let you know tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我要好好想一想，明天告诉你。

senses.def: used to tell somebody that they are wrong about something and must change their plans or opinions
senses.zh: 你还得想一想；你得改变计划（或主意）

examples.en: If you think I’m going to pay all your bills you’ve got another think coming.
examples.zh: 你要是以为我会替你付清帐单，你还是再琢磨琢磨去吧。

senses.def: a popular British television programme, broadcast from 1955 to 2003. Each programme tells the story of the life of a famous person or one who has helped others. They do not know about it in advance, and the presenter
senses.zh: 这就是你的生活：这是英国颇受欢迎的电视节目，从1955年到2003年播放。每个节目都讲述一个名人或帮助他人的人的生活故事。他们事先不知道，主持人在节目开始时感到惊讶。然后，他们被带到电视演播室，在那里他们的朋友，家人和其他在生活中起着重要作用的人作为客人出现并讲述他们的故事。他们生活中的所有细节都收集在一本大红皮书中，该红皮书将在计划结束时分发给他们。该节目由Eamonn Andrews和Michael Aspel于1993年至2003年一直提供到1987年。1952年至1961年在美国电视上播放了具有相同标题的类似节目。

(1795-1842) headmaster
senses.zh: 托马斯·阿诺德（Thomas Arnold）：（1795-1842）橄榄球学校（1828-42）的校长。他介绍了许多影响英国公立学校教育发展的变化。马修·阿诺德（Matthew Arnold）是他的儿子。

senses.def: (1879-1961) an English conductor
senses.zh: 托马斯·比坎（Thomas Beecham）：（1879-1961）是一位英国指挥，他创立了伦敦两个伟大的管弦乐队，伦敦爱乐乐团和皇家爱乐乐团，并帮助使他那个时代的英国音乐，尤其是他的朋友Delius的音乐更受欢迎。他还因发表聪明，有趣甚至有时无礼的言论而闻名。1916年，他被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1753-1828) an English artist who worked mainly in book illustration. He brought a new realistic style to the art of engraving
senses.zh: 托马斯·贝威克（Thomas Bewick）：（1753-1828）是一位主要从事书籍插图创作的英国艺术家。他为雕刻艺术带来了新的写实风格（即在金属上切割设计，然后从中进行印刷）。他以动物和鸟类的照片而闻名。他最著名的作品有《四足动物史》（1790年）和《英国鸟类史》两卷（1797-1804年）。

senses.def: (1795-1881) a Scottish writer of books and essays about history and philosophy, who attacked the social injustice
senses.zh: 托马斯·卡莱尔（Thomas Carlyle）：（1795-1881）是苏格兰一位有关历史和哲学的书籍和散文作家，他抨击了工业革命导致的社会不公。他最著名的作品是《法国大革命》（1837年）。他还以公开演讲而闻名。

senses.def: (1752-70) an English poet. He wrote poetry in an old-fashioned style, and pretended it was the work of a 15th-century priest called Thomas Rowley, who never existed. In 1770 he came to London to produce an opera
senses.zh: 托马斯·查特顿：（1752-70）英国诗人。他以过时的风格写诗，并假装这是一位15世纪牧师托马斯·罗利（Thomas Rowley）的作品，他从未存在过。1770年，他来到伦敦，制作了他写的歌剧。他不是很成功，并在17岁时自杀。他的诗歌和去世影响了浪漫主义诗人以及拉斐尔前派和查特顿，这是彼得·阿克罗伊德（Peter Ackroyd）于1987年出版的同名小说的主题。

senses.def: (1718-79) an English designer of strong but elegant
senses.zh: 托马斯·奇彭代尔（Thomas Chippendale）：（1718-79）英国设计师，设计坚固但典雅的家具，通常带有线条流畅和雕花装饰。奇彭代尔（Chippendale）的工作影响了许多其他人，包括乔治·赫普怀特怀特（George Hepplewhite）和托马斯·喜来登（Thomas Sheraton）。他的儿子，也叫托马斯（Thomas），继续他的生意直到1813年。

senses.def: (1808-92) an English travel agent
senses.zh: 托马斯·库克（Thomas Cook）：（1808-92）是一位英国旅行社，他在租用火车带人们去参加节制运动后，进行了世界上第一个套票旅行。 。托马斯·库克（Thomas Cook）成为全球最大的旅游公司之一，但该公司倒闭并于2019年停止交易。

senses.def: (1489-1556) the first Anglican Archbishop of Canterbury
senses.zh: 托马斯·克兰默：（1489-1556）坎特伯雷的第一位英国国教大主教。他受到马丁·路德（Martin Luther）思想的影响，并在亨利八世与阿拉贡的凯瑟琳（Catherine of Aragon）的婚姻结束并建立英格兰教会时为其提供了支持。他负责《共同祈祷书》，对宗教改革产生了深远的影响。罗马天主教玛丽一世成为女王后，他被焚烧致死。

senses.def: (c. 1485-1540) the chief minister to King Henry VIII
senses.zh: 托马斯·克伦威尔（Thomas Cromwell）：（约1485-1540年）1530年代担任亨利八世国王的首席部长。托马斯·沃尔西（Thomas Wolsey）倒台后，克伦威尔（Cromwell）安排了国王与阿拉贡凯瑟琳（Aatherine）的离婚，随后组织了修道院的解散。1540年，克伦威尔被任命为埃塞克斯伯爵，但四个月后，国王指责他叛国，并砍下了他的头。克伦威尔在执行死刑时说，他死于天主教徒。

senses.def: (1785-1859) an English writer who regularly took the drug opium
senses.zh: 托马斯·德·昆西（Thomas De Quincey）：（1785-1859）是一位英国作家，他经常服用鸦片，并在他最着名的著作《英国鸦片吃者自白》（1821）中描述了鸦片对他的影响。他是诗人华兹华斯和科尔里奇的朋友。

senses.def: (1847-1931) a famous US inventor
senses.zh: 托马斯·爱迪生（1847-1931）：美国著名发明家。他的发明包括用于再现声音的机器，电灯泡和“电影摄影机”，后来用于电影院。他于1912年制作了第一部有声电影。

senses.def: (1612-71) an English soldier, the most important general
senses.zh: 托马斯·费尔法克斯（Thomas Fairfax）：（1612-71）是一名英国士兵，是英国内战中议会方面最重要的将军。他负责组建新模型军，并且是其第一任领导人。他在1640年被任命为骑士，在1648年被任命为男爵。

senses.def: (1727-88) an English artist. He was influenced by Dutch artists such as Rubens and Van Dyck, and became famous for his landscapes (= pictures of the countryside)
senses.zh: 托马斯·盖恩斯伯勒（Thomas Gainsborough）：（1727-88）英国艺术家。他受到鲁本斯（Rubens）和凡戴克（Van Dyck）等荷兰艺术家的影响，并以其风景和肖像而闻名，通常是贵族成员。他经常将这两种技能结合在一起，并用室外的乡村背景画肖像，表现出光线对人们的衣服或树木的影响。他最著名的画作可能是《蓝男孩》和《安德鲁斯夫妇》。

senses.def: (1716-1771) an English poet, best known for his Elegy Written in a Country Church Yard
senses.zh: 托马斯·格雷（Thomas Gray）：（1716-1771）是一位英国诗人，以在乡村教堂院子里创作的悲歌而闻名。他是霍勒斯·沃波尔（Horace Walpole）的朋友。他写的几首诗对浪漫主义运动的发展产生了深远的影响。

senses.def: (1840-1928) an English writer of novels and poems. He was born in Dorset
senses.zh: 托马斯·哈代（1840–1928）英国小说家、诗人。生于多塞特郡，大部分小说都以此地为背景，小说中称其为“威塞克斯”，首府“卡斯特桥”。该地区仍常被称为哈代乡。他的许多小说表现人生受偶然操控，结局往往非常残酷。作品常以悲剧结尾。代表作有《远离尘嚣》（1874）、《德伯家的苔丝》（1891）和《无名的裘德》（1895年）。作品初版时并不为维多利亚时代的英国人喜爱，因此哈代不再写小说，后半生以写诗为主。

senses.def: (1588-1679) an English philosopher
senses.zh: 托马斯·霍布斯（Thomas Hobbes）：（1588-1679）是一位英国哲学家，他提出了一系列有关自然，人类行为和社会的理论。他不相信上帝，并认为使社会团结在一起的唯一方法是拥有强大的社会制度和强大的统治者。他的著作《利维坦》（Leviathan，1651年）阐述了这些观点。

senses.def: (1743-1826) the third US President (1801-9) and one of the nation's Founding Fathers
senses.zh: 托马斯·杰斐逊（1743–1826）美国第三任总统（1801–1809），制宪元勋之一。起草了《独立宣言》的大部分内容，但反对建立强大的中央政府。总统任内，支持购买路易斯安那和刘易斯、克拉克的西部探险。协助设计华盛顿特区，是第一位在那里举行就职日典礼的总统。曾任弗吉尼亚州州长（1779–1781）和国务卿（1789–1793）。创建弗吉尼亚大学（1819）并设计校园建筑。和约翰·亚当斯一样，在《独立宣言》发表 50 周年的纪念日去世。

senses.def: (1785-1866) an English writer of novels and poetry. He used satire
senses.zh: 托马斯·洛夫·孔雀（Thomas Love Peacock）：（1785-1866）英国小说和诗歌作家。他用讽刺来抨击那个时代的知名人士的态度。例如，在《噩梦修道院》（Nightmare Abbey，1818年）中，他取笑了科尔里奇，雪莱和拜伦等人。

senses.def: (1800-59) an English writer and politician. His best-known works are his unfinished
senses.zh: 托马斯·麦考利（Thomas Macaulay）：（1800-59）英国作家和政治家。他最著名的作品是他的未完成的《英国历史》，这对后来的历史作家和《古罗马时期》都产生了重大影响。他曾是国会议员和战争部长（1839-41），并于1857年被任命为男爵。

senses.def: an English author who wrote Le Morte d'Arthur
senses.zh: 托马斯·马洛里（Thomas Malory）：一位英国作家，他写了《亚瑟王的故事》（Le Morte d'Arthur），这是关于亚瑟王及其圆桌骑士故事的集合。他的身份不确定，但他可能是Warwickshireknight的Thomas Malory爵士，他于1471年在监狱中去世。

senses.def: (1766-1834) an English economist
senses.zh: 托马斯·马尔萨斯（Thomas Malthus）：（1766-1834）英国经济学家兼牧师。他在《人口原理》随笔（1798年）中提出，人口的增长快于粮食的供应，除非人为地控制人口增长，否则将导致贫困和死亡率上升。他的想法对查尔斯·达尔文产生了重要影响。

senses.def: (1478-1535) an English politician, author and scholar
senses.zh: 托马斯·莫尔（1478–1535）英国政治家、作家和学者。亨利八世的朋友。最初被亨利八世任命为驻外代表。1518 年进入枢密院，1521 年被封为爵士，1529 年接替枢机主教沃尔西，担任大法官。亨利八世决定取代教皇成为英格兰教会之首，莫尔拒绝接受，因此入狱，后被处死。1935 年，被教皇庇护十一世封为圣徒。托马斯·莫尔还著有《乌托邦》（1516），描绘心目中的完美社会。该书在整个欧洲大获成功。

senses.def: (1737-1809) an English writer and politician who wrote and spoke in favour of freedom and democracy
senses.zh: 托马斯·潘恩（Thomas Paine）（1737-1809）是一位英语作家和政治家，为自由和民主而写作和讲话。1774年，他移居美国，并撰写了《常识》（Common Sense，1776年），这本简短的书提议美国脱离英国独立。回到英国后，他撰写了《人的权利》以支持法国大革命，并且不得不逃到法国以避免因叛国罪而被捕（叛国罪）。在法国，他成为革命政府的一员，但因为反对杀害国王而被判入狱。在那里，他写了他的最后一本著名的著作《理性时代》（The Age of Reason，1794-5），该著作抨击了许多基督教信仰和实践。

senses.def: (1756-1827) an English artist. He is famous for his caricatures
senses.zh: 托马斯·罗兰森（Thomas Rowlandson）：（1756-1827）英国艺术家。他以讽刺漫画而闻名，展现了当时的社会和政治，例如系列“死亡的英国舞”（1814-16）。他还为托比亚斯·斯莫列特（Tobias Smollett）和劳伦斯·斯特恩（Laurence Sterne）绘制肖像并绘制书籍插图。

senses.def: (1751-1806) an English furniture designer. His book The Cabinet-Maker and Upholsterer's Drawing Book
senses.zh: 托马斯·喜来登（Thomas Sheraton）：（1751-1806）是一位英国家具设计师。他的书《橱柜制造商和室内装潢工人的绘画书》（1791-4）对新古典家具的发展产生了重要影响，他的设计通常精致而优美。

examples.en: a beautiful Sheraton chair/table
examples.zh: 漂亮的喜来登椅子/桌子

senses.def: (c. 1505-85) an English composer
senses.zh: 托马斯·塔利斯（Thomas Tallis）：（约1505-85年）英国作曲家。他主要写宗教音乐，是皇室的官方音乐家和作曲家之一。现在，他最著名的音乐是托马斯·塔利斯（Thomas Tallis，1910年）改编的拉尔夫·沃恩·威廉姆斯的《音乐幻想曲》。

senses.def: (1757-1834) a Scottish engineer who designed many bridges, canals
senses.zh: 托马斯·特尔福德（Thomas Telford）：（1757-1834）是一位苏格兰工程师，曾在英国设计过许多桥梁，运河和道路。他最著名的成就包括苏格兰北部的加里东运河和威尔士北部的梅奈海峡大桥。他的许多桥梁仍在使用中。

senses.def: the best-known character in a popular series of British children's stories about railways (1945-72) written by the Rev Wilbert Awdry
senses.zh: 托马斯坦克引擎（Thomas the Tank Engine）：威尔伯特·艾德利牧师（Rev Wilbert Awdry）后来由他的儿子克里斯托弗（Christopher）撰写的一系列英国儿童故事中最著名的人物（1945-72）。托马斯（Thomas）和书中的其他火车具有面孔和人文特征，并且会说话。这些书已被制成儿童电视节目。

senses.def: (1900-38) a US writer whose four long and powerful novels are set in the South
senses.zh: 托马斯·沃尔夫（Thomas Wolfe）：（1900-38）是美国作家，他的四本长而有力的小说以南方为背景，并立足于自己的生活。他们是《看家天使》（1929年），《时光与河》（1935年）和两本在他去世后出版的《网络与摇滚》（1939年）和《你不能再回家》（1940年）。沃尔夫还写了一些短篇小说。

senses.def: to feel a series of regular painful movements

examples.en: His head throbbed painfully.
examples.zh: 他的头一抽一跳地痛。

examples.en: My feet were throbbing after the long walk home.
examples.zh: 我走了很长的路回到家后，双脚阵阵作痛。

senses.def: to beat or sound with a strong, regular rhythm
senses.zh: （强烈有节奏地）跳动，搏动，震响

examples.en: The ship's engines throbbed quietly.
examples.zh: 船上的发动机有节奏地轻轻震动。

examples.zh: 咚咚的击鼓声

examples.zh: 血液在我的血管里有节律地涌动着。

examples.en: A pulse throbbed painfully in his temples.
examples.zh: 他太阳穴里的脉搏剧烈地跳动着。

examples.en: The club was throbbing to the beat of the music.
examples.zh: 俱乐部随着音乐的节拍而颤动。

examples.en: His voice was throbbing with emotion.
examples.zh: 他的声音激动得颤抖。

senses.def: a feeling of pain that you experience as a series of strong beats

examples.en: My headache faded to a dull throb.
examples.zh: 我的头痛逐渐减轻，后来变得微微抽痛。

senses.def: a strong, regular beat

examples.zh: 这首歌开头部份的低音颤动

synonyms.words: ache ▪ burn ▪ sting ▪ tingle ▪ itch ▪ throb

intro.en: These are all words that can be used when part of your body feels painful.
intro.zh: 以上各词均可指身体部位感到疼痛。

items.def: (of part of your body) to feel painful; (of an action) to cause pain:
items.zh: 指（身体部位）感到疼痛、（某一动作）引起疼痛

examples.en: My feet hurt.
examples.zh: 我脚疼。

items.def: to feel a continuous pain that is not severe:
items.zh: 指（持续地）疼痛、隐痛

examples.en: I’m aching all over.
examples.zh: 我周身疼痛。

items.def: (of part of your body) to feel very hot and painful:
items.zh: 指（身体部位）火辣辣地痛、发烫

examples.en: Our eyes were burning from the chemicals in the air.
examples.zh: 空气中弥漫的化学物质熏得我们的眼睛火辣辣地痛。

items.def: to make somebody feel a sharp burning pain or uncomfortable feeling in part of their body; (of part of your body) to feel this pain:
items.zh: 指（使）身体部位感觉刺痛、灼痛

examples.en: My eyes were stinging from the smoke.
examples.zh: 烟熏得我眼睛痛。

items.def: (of part of your body) to feel as if a lot of small sharp points are pushing into the skin there:
items.zh: 指（身体部位）感到刺痛

examples.en: The cold air made her face tingle.
examples.zh: 冷空气冻得她的脸发痛。

items.def: to have an uncomfortable feeling on your skin that makes you want to scratch; to make your skin feel like this:
items.zh: （使）发痒

examples.en: I itch all over.
examples.zh: 我浑身痒。

items.def: (of part of your body) to feel pain as a series of regular beats:
items.zh: 指（身体部位）有规律地抽动、抽痛

examples.zh: 他的头一抽一跳地痛。

senses.def: violent pains, especially at the moment of death

examples.en: The creature went into its death throes.
examples.zh: 这个生命到了临终疼痛阶段。

senses.def: in the middle of an activity, especially a difficult or complicated one
senses.zh: 正在做，正忙于（尤指困难或复杂的活动）

examples.en: The country was in the throes of revolutionary change.
examples.zh: 国家正处于革命动荡中。

examples.en: We’re in the throes of moving to a new office, so the place is in chaos at the moment.
examples.zh: 我们正忙着搬到新办公室，所以现在这个地方很混乱。

a special chair used by a king or queen to sit on at ceremonies

examples.en: He sat very upright in his chair, as if he were a king on his throne.
examples.zh: 他端坐在椅子上，像个坐在宝座上的国王。

senses.def: the position of being a king or queen

examples.en: Queen Elizabeth came/succeeded to the throne in 1952.
examples.zh: 伊丽莎白女王于 1952 年即位／登基。

examples.en: when Henry VIII was on the throne (= was king)
examples.zh: 亨利八世在位时

examples.en: Prince Charles is next in line to the British throne.
examples.zh: 查尔斯王子是英国王位的第二顺位继承人。

senses.def: the person who really controls an organization, a country, etc. in contrast to the person who is legally in charge

examples.zh: 他的助手被认为是王位背后的真正权力者。

senses.def: the person who really controls an organization, a country, etc. in contrast to the person who is legally in charge

examples.en: His assistant was thought to be the real power behind the throne.
examples.zh: 他的助手被认为是王位背后的真正权力者。

senses.def: a crowd of people

examples.en: We pushed our way through the throng.
examples.zh: 我们挤过人群。

examples.en: He was met by a throng of journalists and photographers.
examples.zh: 他遇上了一群记者和摄影师。

senses.def: to go somewhere or be present somewhere in large numbers

examples.en: The children thronged into the hall.
examples.zh: 孩子们拥进了大厅。

examples.en: People are thronging to see his new play.
examples.zh: 人们成群结队地去看他的新戏。

examples.en: Crowds thronged the stores.
examples.zh: 各商店都挤满了人。

senses.def: to be full of people, cars, etc.

examples.en: The cafes were thronging with students.
examples.zh: 各个小餐馆里都挤满了学生。

examples.en: The streets were thronged with people.
examples.zh: 条条大街都挤满了人。

senses.def: to attack or kill somebody by pressing their throat in order to stop them from breathing

examples.en: He throttled the guard with his bare hands.
examples.zh: 他徒手掐死了卫兵。

examples.en: I like her, although I could cheerfully throttle her at times (= because she is annoying).
examples.zh: 我喜欢她，虽然她有时烦得我想把她掐死。

examples.en: The city is being throttled by traffic.
examples.zh: 这座城市的交通拥挤不堪。

senses.def: a device that controls the amount of fuel that goes into the engine of a vehicle, for example the accelerator
senses.zh: 节流阀；节流杆；风门；风门杆

senses.def: as fast as possible; with as much power or energy as possible
senses.zh: 全速；开足马力；全力以赴

examples.en: He drove along at full throttle.
examples.zh: 他全速驾车行驶。

examples.en: The campaign is continuing to run at full throttle.
examples.zh: 这场运动继续全力进行。

senses.def: as fast as possible; with as much power or energy as possible
senses.zh: 全速；开足马力；全力以赴

examples.zh: 他全速驾车行驶。

examples.en: The campaign is continuing to run at full throttle.
examples.zh: 这场运动继续全力进行。

senses.def: to control the supply of fuel or power to an engine in order to reduce/increase the speed of a vehicle

examples.en: I throttled back as we approached the runway.
examples.zh: 我们靠近跑道时，我减速了。

senses.def: to control the supply of fuel or power to an engine in order to reduce/increase the speed of a vehicle

examples.en: I throttled back as we approached the runway.
examples.zh: 我们靠近跑道时，我减速了。

senses.def: from one end or side of something/somebody to the other
senses.zh: 从…一端至另一端；穿过；贯穿

examples.en: The burglar got in through the window.
examples.zh: 盗贼是从窗户进来的。

examples.en: The bullet went straight through him.
examples.zh: 子弹从他身上穿了过去。

examples.en: Her knees had gone through (= made holes in) her jeans.
examples.zh: 她的膝盖把牛仔裤磨破了。

examples.en: The sand ran through (= between) my fingers.
examples.zh: 沙子从我的手指缝间漏了下去。

examples.en: The path led through the trees to the river.
examples.zh: 这条小路穿过树林通向河边。

examples.en: The doctor pushed his way through the crowd.
examples.zh: 医生挤过人群。

examples.en: The Charles River flows through Boston.
examples.zh: 查尔斯河流经波士顿。

examples.en: The flood was too deep to drive through.
examples.zh: 洪水太深，汽车开不过去。

senses.def: to see, hear, etc. something from the other side of an object or a substance

examples.en: I couldn't hear their conversation through the wall.
examples.zh: 我隔墙听不到他们的交谈。

examples.en: He could just make out three people through the mist.
examples.zh: 透过薄雾他勉强能看出有三个人。

senses.def: from the beginning to the end of an activity, a situation or a period of time

examples.en: The children are too young to sit through a concert.
examples.zh: 这些孩子年纪太小，音乐会没完就坐不住了。

examples.en: He will not live through the night.
examples.zh: 他活不过今天晚上了。

examples.en: I'm halfway through (= reading) her second novel.
examples.zh: 她的第二部小说我看了一半了。

senses.def: past a barrier, stage or test
senses.zh: 通过（障碍、阶段或测试）；穿过

examples.en: Go through this gate, and you'll see the house on your left.
examples.zh: 你穿过这道大门，就看到左面的房子了。

examples.en: He drove through a red light (= passed it when he should have stopped).
examples.zh: 他开车闯了红灯。

examples.en: First I have to get through the exams.
examples.zh: 首先我必须通过这些考试。

examples.en: The bill had a difficult passage through Parliament.
examples.zh: 这项提案费了一番周折才在议会上通过。

examples.en: I'd never have got through it all (= a difficult situation) without you.
examples.zh: 假如没有您，我是绝对渡不过这个难关的。

senses.def: until, and including
senses.zh: 直至，一直到（所指时间包括在内）

examples.en: We'll be in New York Tuesday through Friday.
examples.zh: 我们从星期二到星期五将一直待在纽约。

senses.def: by means of; because of

examples.en: You can only achieve success through hard work.
examples.zh: 你得孜孜不倦方能成功。

examples.en: It was through him (= as a result of his help) that I got the job.
examples.zh: 我全靠他的帮助才找到这份工作。

examples.en: The accident happened through no fault of mine.
examples.zh: 发生事故并不是我的过错。

senses.def: from one end or side of something to the other

examples.en: Put the coffee in the filter and let the water run through.
examples.zh: 把咖啡放入过滤器里让水流过。

examples.en: The tyre's flat—the nail has gone right through.
examples.zh: 轮胎瘪了，让钉子扎穿了。

examples.en: The onlookers stood aside to let the paramedics through.
examples.zh: 围观的人闪开一条路，让医务辅助人员通过。

senses.def: from the beginning to the end of a thing or period of time

examples.en: Don't tell me how it ends—I haven't read it all the way through yet.
examples.zh: 先别告诉我结尾，我还没有读完呢。

examples.en: I expect I'll struggle through until payday.
examples.zh: 我想我会挨到发薪日的。

senses.def: past a barrier, stage or test
senses.zh: 通过（障碍、阶段或测试）；穿过

examples.en: The lights were red but he drove straight through.
examples.zh: 红灯亮着，但他开车闯了过去。

examples.en: Our team is through to (= has reached) the semi-finals.
examples.zh: 我们队打进了半决赛。

senses.def: travelling through a place without stopping or without people having to get off one train and onto another

examples.en: ‘Did you stop in Oxford on the way?’ ‘No, we drove straight through.’
examples.zh: “你路经牛津时停车了吗？”“没有，我一直开过来的。”

examples.en: This train goes straight through to York.
examples.zh: 这列火车直达约克。

senses.def: connected by phone

examples.en: Ask to be put through to me personally.
examples.zh: 请接线员把电话直接接给我本人。

examples.en: I tried to call you but I couldn't get through.
examples.zh: 我给你打电话了，可是怎么也打不通。

senses.def: used after an adjective to mean ‘completely’

examples.en: We got wet through.
examples.zh: 我们浑身上下都湿透了。

senses.def: completely; in every way
senses.zh: 完全；彻底；地地道道；彻头彻尾

examples.en: He's British through and through.
examples.zh: 他是地地道道的英国人。

senses.def: through
senses.zh: （交通旅行）直达的，直通的，全程的

senses.def: a through
a through

examples.en: The village lies on a busy through road.
examples.zh: 那村庄坐落在一条繁忙的直达公路上。

examples.en: No through road (= the road is closed at one end).
examples.zh: 此路不通。

senses.def: used to show that you have finished using something or have ended a relationship with somebody
senses.zh: （使用）完成，结束；（关系）了结，断绝

examples.en: Are you through with that newspaper?
examples.zh: 你看完那份报纸了吗？

examples.en: Todd and I are through.
examples.zh: 托德和我吹了。

senses.def: completely; in every way
senses.zh: 完全；彻底；地地道道；彻头彻尾

examples.en: He's British through and through.
examples.zh: 他是地地道道的英国人。

senses.def: completely; in every way
senses.zh: 完全；彻底；地地道道；彻头彻尾

examples.en: He's British through and through.
examples.zh: 他是地地道道的英国人。

senses.def: with somebody’s help
senses.zh: 经某人斡旋；承某人协助

senses.def: as a result of the action of somebody/something

examples.en: He obtained his position through the agency of an old friend.
examples.zh: 他通过一位老朋友的介绍获得了这个职位。

senses.def: even when there are problems or difficulties
senses.zh: 不顾艰难险阻；赴汤蹈火；同甘共苦

examples.en: He's supported the team for over ten years through thick and thin.
examples.zh: 十多年来，在任何情况下他都支持这个队。

examples.en: In marriage, you have to stick together through thick and thin.
examples.zh: 在婚姻中，你们必须同甘共苦。

senses.def: a well-known children's book by Lewis Carroll
senses.zh: 透过镜面玻璃：刘易斯·卡洛尔（Lewis Carroll）着名的儿童读物，该书于1872年首次出版，并附有约翰·特尼尔（John Tenniel）的插图。这是关于一个小女孩爱丽丝（Alice）的陌生世界中的冒险经历，她也是卡洛尔（Carroll）较早出版的《爱丽丝梦游仙境》（Alice in Wonderland）的主题。爱丽丝梦见自己穿过窥镜，在另一侧遇到红色和白色的皇后，栩栩如生的国际象棋棋子，特威德勒姆和特威德莱迪，矮胖子，狮子和独角兽。

senses.def: in or into every part of something

examples.en: They export their products to markets throughout the world.
examples.zh: 他们把产品出口到世界各地的市场。

examples.en: The house was painted white throughout.
examples.zh: 这所房子全都粉刷成了白色。

senses.def: during the whole period of time of something
senses.zh: 自始至终；贯穿整个时期

examples.en: The museum is open daily throughout the year.
examples.zh: 这个博物馆一年到头每天都开放。

examples.en: The ceremony lasted two hours and we had to stand throughout.
examples.zh: 仪式进行了两个小时，我们自始至终都得站着。

senses.def: the amount of work that is done, or the number of people that are dealt with, in a particular period of time
senses.zh: （某一时期内的）生产量，接待人数

examples.en: high/low throughput
examples.zh: 高/低吞吐量

examples.en: The centre has a weekly throughput of 200 000 shoppers.
examples.zh: 该中心每周的吞吐量为 20 万购物者。

senses.def: used in the names of some freeways
senses.zh: （用于某些跨州或州际高速公路的名称中）过境道路，直达道路

senses.def: to send something from your hand through the air by moving your hand or arm quickly

examples.en: Practise throwing and catching.
examples.zh: 练习抛和接。

examples.en: They had a competition to see who could throw the furthest.
examples.zh: 他们举行了一场比赛，看谁投得最远。

examples.en: Who threw that rock?
examples.zh: 谁扔的石头？

examples.en: Stop throwing stones at the window!
examples.zh: 别朝窗户扔石头了！

examples.en: She threw the ball up and caught it again.
examples.zh: 她把球抛起来又接住。

examples.en: He threw the ball into the bushes and the dog ran to fetch it.
examples.zh: 他把球扔进灌木丛里，狗跑去捡球。

examples.en: Three grenades were thrown into the corridor.
examples.zh: 三枚手榴弹被扔进走廊。

examples.en: Two petrol bombs had been thrown through the front window.
examples.zh: 两枚汽油弹从前窗扔了出去。

examples.en: Don't throw it to him; give it to him!
examples.zh: 别扔给他，递给他！

examples.en: Can you throw me that towel?
examples.zh: 请把那条毛巾扔给我好吗？

senses.def: to put something in a particular place quickly and carelessly

examples.en: Just throw your bag down over there.
examples.zh: 把你的袋子就扔到那边吧。

examples.en: He threw the keys casually down on the table.
examples.zh: 他随手把钥匙扔在桌子上。

examples.en: A blanket was thrown over the bed.
examples.zh: 床上铺着一条毯子。

examples.en: I took some folders and started throwing stuff in them.
examples.zh: 我拿了一些文件夹，开始往里面扔东西。

senses.group: put carelessly 漫不经心地放置

senses.def: to move something/somebody suddenly and with force

examples.en: The boat was thrown onto the rocks.
examples.zh: 那条船触礁了。

examples.en: The sea throws up all sorts of debris on the beach.
examples.zh: 大海把各种残骸碎片都冲上海滩。

examples.en: They were thrown to the floor by the impact.
examples.zh: 他们被冲击力击倒在地。

examples.en: He was arrested and thrown in jail (= sent to prison).
examples.zh: 他被捕入狱。

examples.en: He threatened to throw her in the river if she screamed.
examples.zh: 他威胁她敢叫就把她扔到河里。

examples.en: I threw open the windows to let the smoke out.
examples.zh: 我猛力推开窗子，让烟散出去。

examples.en: He threw the double doors open in a dramatic gesture.
examples.zh: 他动作夸张地推开了双扇门。

examples.en: Miraculously he was thrown clear (= out of the vehicle when it crashed) and suffered nothing more than severe bruising.
examples.zh: 不可思议的是，他被甩了出去，只受了严重的擦伤。

senses.group: move with force 用力移动

senses.def: to move your body or part of it quickly or suddenly
senses.zh: 猛动（头、臂、腿）；挺起（胸）；仰起（头）；挥动（拳头、手臂）

examples.en: He threw back his head and roared with laughter.
examples.zh: 他猛地仰起头哈哈大笑起来。

examples.en: I ran up and threw my arms around him.
examples.zh: 我跑上前去，张开双臂搂住他。

examples.en: Jenny threw herself onto the bed.
examples.zh: 珍妮一头倒在床上。

examples.en: I just wanted to throw myself into his arms and cry.
examples.zh: 我真想扑到他怀里大哭一场。

senses.group: part of body 身体部位

senses.def: to make somebody fall quickly or violently to the ground

examples.en: Two riders were thrown (= off their horses) in the second race.
examples.zh: 有两名骑手在第二场赛马中从马上摔了下来。

senses.group: make somebody fall 使人摔倒

senses.def: to make somebody/something be in a particular state
senses.zh: 使处于，使陷入（某种状态）

examples.en: Hundreds were thrown out of work.
examples.zh: 数以百计的人遭到解雇。

examples.en: The future of the project has been thrown into doubt.
examples.zh: 这一项目的未来悬了。

examples.en: Everything was thrown into chaos.
examples.zh: 一切都陷入了混乱。

examples.en: We were thrown into confusion by the news.
examples.zh: 我们被那消息弄得惊慌失措。

examples.en: The problem was suddenly thrown into sharp focus.
examples.zh: 这个问题突然引起人们的密切关注了。

senses.group: into particular state 处于某种状态

senses.def: to direct something at somebody/something

examples.en: to throw doubt on the verdict
examples.zh: 对裁断产生怀疑

examples.en: to throw the blame on someone
examples.zh: 委过于人

examples.en: to throw accusations at someone
examples.zh: 对某人大加指责

examples.en: He threw the question back at me (= expected me to answer it myself).
examples.zh: 他反过来问我这个问题。

senses.group: direct something at somebody/something 指向某人／事物

senses.def: to make somebody feel upset, confused, or surprised
senses.zh: 使心烦意乱；使困惑；使惊奇

examples.en: The news of her death really threw me.
examples.zh: 她的噩耗确实令我震惊。

examples.en: The speaker was completely thrown by the interruption.
examples.zh: 演讲的人因受到干扰而心烦意乱。

senses.def: to roll a dice
senses.zh: 掷（色子）；掷出（色子的点数）

examples.en: Throw the dice!
examples.zh: 掷色子！

examples.en: He threw three sixes in a row.
examples.zh: 他一连掷出三个六点。

senses.def: to make a clay

examples.en: a hand-thrown vase
examples.zh: 手工拉制的陶瓶

senses.def: to send light or shade onto something

examples.en: The trees threw long shadows across the lawn.
examples.zh: 树木在草坪上投下长长的影子。

senses.def: to make your voice sound as if it is coming from another person or place
senses.zh: 使变音；使嗓音听起来像来自他人（或别处）

senses.def: to hit somebody with your fist
to move a switch to operate something
to have a sudden period of angry behaviour, violent emotion, etc.

examples.en: She'll throw a fit if she finds out.
examples.zh: 她要是发现了，一定会大发雷霆。

examples.en: Children often throw tantrums at this age.
examples.zh: 儿童在这个年龄经常犯脾气。

senses.def: to give a party

examples.en: They threw a party for him on his birthday.
examples.zh: 他们在他生日那天为他办了一个生日会。

examples.en: He always throws a big bash on Oscar night.
examples.zh: 他总是在奥斯卡之夜举办盛大的聚会。

senses.def: to deliberately lose a game or contest that you should have won
senses.zh: 故意输掉（本应获胜的比赛或竞赛）

examples.en: He was accused of having thrown the game.
examples.zh: 他被指责故意放水，输掉了这场比赛。

senses.group: in sports/competitions 体育运动；比赛

senses.def: the act of throwing something, especially a ball or dice

examples.en: a well-aimed throw
examples.zh: 准确的投掷

examples.en: It's your throw (= it's your turn to throw the dice).
examples.zh: 轮到你掷（色子）了。

examples.en: He threw me to the ground with a judo throw.
examples.zh: 他用柔道摔法把我摔倒在地。

examples.en: a throw of the dice
examples.zh: 骰子的一掷

senses.group: in sports/competitions 体育运动；比赛

senses.def: the distance that something is thrown

examples.en: a javelin throw of 57 metres
examples.zh: 57 米远的标枪投掷

senses.group: in sports/competitions 体育运动；比赛

senses.def: a loose cloth cover that can be placed over a sofa
senses.group: in sports/competitions 体育运动；比赛

senses.def: used to say how much items cost each

examples.en: The tickets for the dinner were £50 a throw.
examples.zh: 餐券每张 50 英镑。

senses.group: in sports/competitions 体育运动；比赛

senses.def: a very short distance away

examples.en: We live just a stone's throw from here.
examples.zh: 我们就住在附近。

examples.en: The hotel is within a stone's throw of the beach.
examples.zh: 旅馆离海滩很近。

senses.group: in sports/competitions 体育运动；比赛

note.en: Idioms containing throw are at the entries for the nouns and adjectives in the idioms, for example throw your hat into the ring is at hat.
note.zh: 含 throw 的习语，都可在该等习语中的名词及形容词相关词条找到，如 throw your hat into the ring 在词条 hat 下。

senses.def: used to say how much items cost each

examples.en: The tickets for the dinner were £50 a throw.
examples.zh: 餐券每张 50 英镑。

senses.def: a very short distance away

examples.en: We live just a stone's throw from here.
examples.zh: 我们就住在附近。

examples.en: The hotel is within a stone's throw of the beach.
examples.zh: 旅馆离海滩很近。

synonyms.words: toss ▪ hurl ▪ fling ▪ chuck ▪ lob ▪ bowl ▪ pitch

intro.en: These words all mean to send something from your hand through the air.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含扔、投、掷、抛之义。

items.def: to send something from your hand or hands through the air:
items.zh: 指投、掷、抛、扔

examples.en: Some kids were throwing stones at the window.
examples.zh: 有些孩子在朝窗户扔石头。

items.def: to throw something lightly or carelessly:
items.zh: 指轻轻或漫不经心地扔、抛、掷

examples.en: She tossed her jacket onto the bed.
examples.zh: 她把她的短上衣丢到床上。

items.def: to throw something violently in a particular direction:
items.zh: 指猛扔、猛投、猛摔

examples.en: Rioters hurled a brick through the car’s windscreen.
examples.zh: 暴徒把一块砖猛地扔向汽车，砸破了挡风玻璃。

items.def: to throw somebody/​something somewhere with a lot of force, especially because you are angry or in a hurry:
items.zh: 尤指生气地或急匆匆地用力扔、掷、抛、丢

examples.en: She flung the letter down onto the table.
examples.zh: 她把信摔在桌子上。

items.def: (especially British English尤用于英式英语, informal) to throw something carelessly:
items.zh: 指随便扔、抛

examples.en: I chucked him the keys.
examples.zh: 我把钥匙扔给了他。

items.def: (informal) to throw something so that it goes high through the air:
items.zh: 指往空中高扔、高抛、高掷

examples.en: They were lobbing stones over the wall.
examples.zh: 他们在朝墙那边扔石头。

items.def: (in cricket) to throw the ball to the batter
items.zh: （棒球）指把球投给击球员

items.def: (in baseball) to throw the ball to the batter
items.zh: （棒球）指把球投给击球员

senses.def: to suddenly become very angry or upset

examples.en: My parents threw a wobbly when I told them.
examples.zh: 当我告诉我的父母时，他们感到很不安。

senses.def: to invite somebody to fight or compete with you

examples.en: She has thrown down the gauntlet to the newspaper by accusing it of libel.
examples.zh: 她向那家报社发出挑战，控告他们诽谤。

senses.def: to spend more money on something, when you have wasted a lot on it already
to admit that you have been defeated and stop trying
senses.zh: 认输；承认失败；放弃努力

examples.en: We're not going to throw in the towel just because we lost one game.
examples.zh: 我们不会因为输了一场比赛就认输。

senses.def: to throw a towel into the ring as a sign that you admit that you have been defeated
senses.zh: （拳击手或其助手将毛巾、海绵扔进拳击场内以示）认输

examples.en: His corner threw in the towel near the end of the tenth round.
examples.zh: 在第十回合快要结束时，他的助手认输了。

senses.def: to decide to join somebody and share their successes and problems

examples.en: He threw in his lot with the pirates.
examples.zh: 他决心与那些海盗共命运。

throw in your lot with somebody.word: throw in your lot with somebody

senses.def: to try to deal with a problem or improve a situation by spending money on it, when it would be better to deal with it in other ways

examples.en: It is inappropriate simply to throw money at these problems.
examples.zh: 只是用钱去处理这些问题是不适当的。

examples.en: They tend to throw money at problems without trying to work out the best solution.
examples.zh: 他们往往遇到困难就大把花钱，而不是尽力去找出最好的解决办法。

senses.def: to dance

examples.en: She spent the whole evening throwing shapes on the dance floor.
examples.zh: 她整晚都在舞池里跳舞。

senses.def: to behave in a way that makes you seem to threaten somebody, especially by standing as though you are ready to fight, without actually becoming violent
senses.zh: 作势要打架；摆出气势汹汹的样子

examples.en: I was worried he might get violent but he was just throwing shapes.
examples.zh: 我担心他会动手，但他只是虚张声势。

examples.en: The two main investors threw some shapes during the debate.
examples.zh: 两名主要投资人在辩论时剑拔弩张，火药味十足。

senses.def: to give somebody a small part of what they want as a way of showing that you want to help them, without offering them the main thing they want
senses.zh: 施以小惠（以示助人，却不满足主要的要求）；丢给某人一块骨头

examples.en: She feels this new energy bill is just throwing a bone to the environmentalists.
examples.zh: 她认为这项新的能源法案只是在向环保主义者扔一根骨头。

senses.def: to allow somebody to suffer or be punished in an unfair way, as if they have no value

examples.en: Her boss collects a big retirement cheque while she is thrown to the dogs.
examples.zh: 她的老板领着丰厚的退休金，而她却被抛弃不顾。

senses.def: to leave somebody to be roughly treated or criticized without trying to help or defend them
senses.zh: 弃…于险境而不顾；见死不救

senses.def: to make somebody else suffer in order to save yourself or gain an advantage for yourself
senses.zh: （为了自救或私利而）使别人受苦，拿某人当牺牲品

examples.en: Plenty of my co-workers are satisfied to throw everyone else under the bus as long as they keep their wages.
examples.zh: 我的许多同事只要能保住自己的工资，不惜牺牲其他所有人的利益。

senses.def: to get rid of somebody/something that you think is not useful

examples.en: He threw all his old friends overboard once he was promoted.
examples.zh: 升职后，他把所有的老朋友都抛弃了。

senses.def: to lose something that you want at the same time as you are trying to get rid of something that you do not want
senses.zh: 把婴儿和洗澡水一起倒掉（丢弃不想要的东西的同时失去宝贵的东西）

throw the baby out with the bathwater.word: throw the baby out with the bathwater

senses.def: to punish somebody who has committed an offence as severely as possible

examples.en: ‘Get this man down to the station and throw the book at him!’ yelled Curtis.
examples.zh: “让这个人到车站去，把书扔给他！”柯蒂斯喊道。

senses.def: to raise both hands in the air to show that you are feeling annoyed or upset about something
senses.zh: 举起双手表示不满（或生气）

examples.en: We threw up our hands in despair at the scale of the problem.
examples.zh: 我们对问题的严重性感到绝望。

senses.def: to stop doing something or taking part in something, especially because you are not successful
to announce officially that you are going to compete in an election, a competition, etc.
senses.zh: 正式宣布参加竞选（或比赛等）

throw your hat into the ring.word: throw your hat into the ring

senses.def: to spend money in a careless and obvious way
senses.zh: 花钱大手大脚；挥霍金钱

examples.en: He thinks he can make friends by throwing his money around.
examples.zh: 他认为只要肯花钱就能交到朋友。

senses.def: to use your position of authority or power in an aggressive way in order to achieve what you want

examples.en: She was a good manager, who didn’t find it necessary to throw her weight around.
examples.zh: 她是一位优秀的经理，她认为没有必要到处施展自己的影响力。

senses.def: to put yourself in a situation where you must rely on somebody to be kind to you and not harm or punish you
senses.zh: 指望某人能够善待（或宽恕）自己

senses.def: to add something that has an effect on a situation
senses.zh: 增加有影响的人（或事物）

examples.en: When you throw into the mix the passion and energy of a young artist, you have a recipe for success.
examples.zh: 把年轻艺术家的激情和活力加入其中，就是成功的诀窍。

throw, etc. something in/into the mix.word: throw, etc. something in/into the mix

senses.def: to reject something such as an attitude, a way of life, etc.
senses.zh: 拒绝接受（某种看法、生活方式等）

examples.en: Russell had thrown aside his pride and accepted the situation.
examples.zh: 拉塞尔已经抛开了自尊，接受了现状。

senses.def: to get rid of something that you no longer want

examples.en: I don't need that—you can throw it away.
examples.zh: 我不需要那东西，你可以把它扔了。

examples.en: That old chair should be thrown away.
examples.zh: 那把旧椅子应该扔掉了。

senses.def: to fail to make use of something; to waste something

examples.en: to throw away an opportunity
examples.zh: 失去机会

examples.en: You must take the exam—you can't throw away all that work!
examples.zh: 你必须参加考试 ── 不能让你所有的努力都白费了！

senses.def: to remind somebody of something they have said or done in the past, especially to upset or annoy them
senses.zh: （尤指为使人烦恼）使想起，提醒，重提

examples.en: His unwise remark was frequently thrown back at him by his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他的同事经常重提他的蠢话。

senses.def: to force somebody to rely on something because nothing else is available

examples.en: There was no TV so we were thrown back on our own resources (= had to entertain ourselves).
examples.zh: 没有电视机，所以我们只好自娱自乐了。

senses.def: to include something with what you are selling or offering, without increasing the price

examples.en: You can have the piano for $200, and I'll throw in the stool as well.
examples.zh: 你花 200 美元就可以买走这架钢琴，另外奉送这张琴凳。

senses.def: to add a remark to a conversation

examples.en: Jack threw in the odd encouraging comment.
examples.zh: 杰克难得加了一句鼓励的话。

senses.def: the act of throwing the ball back onto the playing field after it has gone outside the area
to begin to do something with energy and enthusiasm
senses.zh: 投身于；热衷于；积极从事

senses.def: to manage to get rid of something/somebody that is making you suffer, annoying you, etc.

examples.en: to throw off a cold/your worries/your pursuers
examples.zh: 治好伤风；消除忧虑；甩掉追踪者

senses.def: to take off a piece of clothing quickly and carelessly
senses.zh: 匆匆脱掉，拽下，扯掉（衣服）

examples.en: She entered the room and threw off her wet coat.
examples.zh: 她一进屋就脱掉了湿漉漉的大衣。

senses.def: to put on a piece of clothing quickly and carelessly

examples.en: She just threw on the first skirt she found.
examples.zh: 她找到一条裙子就匆忙穿上。

senses.def: to allow people to enter or visit a place where they could not go before
to allow people to discuss something, take part in a competition, etc.
senses.zh: 允许…公开（讨论）；允许…参加（竞赛）

examples.en: The debate will be thrown open to the audience.
examples.zh: 这次辩论将允许观众参加。

examples.en: The organizers are throwing the contest open to under 21s for the first time.
examples.zh: 组织者首次向 21 岁以下的青少年开放比赛。

senses.def: to force somebody to leave a place

examples.en: You'll be thrown out if you don't pay the rent.
examples.zh: 你不付房租就会被撵出去。

senses.def: to say something in a way that suggests you have not given it a lot of thought

examples.en: to throw out a suggestion
examples.zh: 随口提出建议

senses.def: to decide not to accept a proposal, an idea, etc.
senses.zh: 拒不接受，否决（建议、想法等）

senses.def: to get rid of something that you no longer want
to produce smoke, light, heat, etc.

examples.en: a small fire that threw out a lot of heat
examples.zh: 散发出大量热量的小火炉

senses.def: to confuse something or make it wrong
senses.zh: 使混淆不清；打乱；使出错

examples.en: Our calculations of the cost of our trip were thrown out by changes in the exchange rate.
examples.zh: 我们旅行费用的计算因为汇率变动而完全打乱了。

senses.def: to stop being friends with somebody or having a romantic relationship with them
a small cushion
to bring people into contact with each other, often unexpectedly
senses.zh: 使不期而遇；使意外聚在一起

examples.en: Fate had thrown them together.
examples.zh: 命运使他们聚在一起。

senses.def: to make or produce something in a hurry

examples.en: I threw together a quick meal.
examples.zh: 我匆匆做了一顿便饭。

senses.def: to vomit

examples.en: The smell made me want to throw up.
examples.zh: 这味道使得我想呕吐。

senses.def: to vomit

examples.en: The baby's thrown up her dinner.
examples.zh: 女婴把吃的东西吐了出来。

senses.def: to make people notice something

examples.en: Her research has thrown up some interesting facts.
examples.zh: 她的研究有些很有意思的发现。

senses.def: to build something suddenly or in a hurry

examples.en: They're throwing up new housing estates all over the place.
examples.zh: 他们在这一带突然建起了新的居住区。

senses.def: to leave your job

examples.en: to throw up your career
examples.zh: 放弃事业

senses.def: to rush violently at something/somebody
senses.zh: 冲向（人或物）；向…猛扑过去

senses.def: to be too enthusiastic in trying to attract a sexual partner
to stop caring about how dangerous something might be; to start taking risks
senses.zh: 不顾危险；鲁莽行事；冒险

examples.en: He threw caution to the wind and dived into the water after the child.
examples.zh: 他不顾一切地跳入水中追赶孩子。

senses.def: to use all your influence and power to support something

examples.en: The government has thrown its weight behind the anti-pollution campaign.
examples.zh: 政府大力支持反污染运动。

senses.def: something you say quickly without careful thought, sometimes in order to be funny
senses.zh: 脱口而出的；顺嘴说出的；开玩笑的

examples.en: She was very upset at what to him was just a throwaway remark.
examples.zh: 对他来说这只是随口说说而已，而她听了却很不高兴。

senses.def: produced cheaply and intended to be thrown away after use
senses.zh: 用后丢弃的；一次性使用的

examples.en: throwaway products
examples.zh: 一次性使用的产品

examples.en: We live in a throwaway society (= a society in which things are not made to last a long time).
examples.zh: 我们生活在一次性物品充斥的社会。

senses.def: a person or thing that is similar to somebody/something that existed in the past
senses.zh: 返祖者；返祖；返祖型的东西

examples.en: The car's design is a throwback to the 1960s.
examples.zh: 这种汽车的设计回到了 20 世纪 60 年代。

senses.def: a person who throws something

examples.en: a discus thrower
examples.zh: 铁饼运动员

thrown in at the deep end: @@@LINK=jump/be thrown in at the deep end

senses.def: through (= until, and including)
senses.zh: （交通旅行）直达的，直通的，全程的

examples.en: We'll be in New York Tuesday thru Friday.
examples.zh: 我们将于周二至周五在纽约。

senses.def: a bird with a brown back and brown spots on its chest
senses.zh: 鸫（一种背部为褐色、胸部有褐色斑点的鸟）

examples.en: a song thrush
examples.zh: 歌鸫

senses.def: a disease that affects the mouth and throat
a disease that affects the vagina
to push something/somebody suddenly or violently in a particular direction; to move quickly and suddenly in a particular direction

examples.en: He thrust the baby into my arms and ran off.
examples.zh: 他把婴儿往我怀里一塞就跑了。

examples.en: She thrust her hands deep into her pockets.

senses.zh: 直到世界末日；很长时间；永远

examples.en: This job's going to take me till doomsday.
examples.zh: 这项工作要花去我一生一世的心血。

senses.def: for a very long time; forever

examples.en: You can talk till the cows come home—you’ll never make me change my mind.
examples.zh: 你就是说出大天来，也休想改变我的主意。

senses.def: a popular BBC
senses.zh: 直到死亡让我们参与：BBC受欢迎的电视喜剧系列（1965-75年）。主角阿尔夫·加内特（Alf Garnett）受过良好的教育，对右翼人士有极端的看法，尤其是关于居住在英国的黑人和外国人。他一直与他的妻子，女儿和丈夫争吵，他们都取笑他。1970年代和1980年代，在美国哥伦比亚广播公司（CBS）上播放了一部以《直到死亡而做》为基础的美国电视连续剧，该剧名为《家庭中的一切》。

senses.def: forever

examples.en: He’ll talk till kingdom come if you let him.
examples.zh: 如果你允许的话，他会一直说话，直到天国来临。

to move, or make something move, into a position with one side or end higher than the other

examples.en: Suddenly the boat tilted to one side.
examples.zh: 小船突然倾向一侧。

examples.en: The seat tilts forward, when you press this lever.
examples.zh: 按这个控制柄，座位就向前倾斜。

examples.en: His hat was tilted slightly at an angle.
examples.zh: 他的帽子有点歪。

examples.en: She tilted her head back and looked up at me with a smile.
examples.zh: 她仰起头含笑看着我。

senses.def: to make something/somebody change slightly so that one particular opinion, person, etc. is preferred or more likely to succeed than another; to change in this way
senses.zh: 使倾向于；使向…倾斜；偏向

examples.en: The conditions may tilt the balance in favour of the Kenyan runners.
examples.zh: 这些条件可能对肯尼亚赛跑运动员有利。

examples.en: Popular opinion has tilted in favour of the socialists.
examples.zh: 公众舆论已倒向社会党人一边。

a position in which one end or side of something is higher than the other; an act of tilting

examples.en: The table is at a slight tilt.

examples.en: He answered with a tilt of his head.
examples.zh: 他歪着头回答。

examples.en: a tilt to the left
examples.zh: 歪向左边

examples.en: vertical tilt
examples.zh: 垂直倾斜

examples.en: The slope of the horizon is a consequence of spacecraft tilt.
examples.zh: 地平线的倾斜是航天器倾斜的结果。

senses.def: an attempt to win something or defeat somebody

examples.zh: 林木业

examples.zh: 实木门

senses.zh: （建造房屋用的）大木料，栋木；（造船用的）肋材

examples.en: roof timbers
examples.zh: 房檩

examples.en: The house has exposed oak timbers.
examples.zh: 房子的橡木料露在外面。

a place where wood for building, etc. is stored and sold
built of timbers

examples.en: a timbered cottage
