senses.def: a place that is very far away
what is measured in minutes, hours, days, etc.
senses.zh: （以分钟、小时、天等计量的）时间

examples.en: The world exists in time and space.
examples.zh: 世界存在于时间与空间之中。

examples.en: The changing seasons mark the passage of time.
examples.zh: 季节的更替标志着时间的流逝。

examples.en: A visit to the museum will take you back in time to the 1930s.
examples.zh: 参观这家博物馆会使你回到 20 世纪 30 年代。

examples.en: At this point in time, it seems unlikely that he will write any more books.
examples.zh: 到这个时候他似乎不太可能再写书了。

examples.en: Perceptions change over time (= as time passes).
examples.zh: 观念随着时间的流逝而变化。

examples.en: As time goes on I love this city more and more.
examples.zh: 时间长了我越来越喜欢这座城市了。

examples.en: As time went by we saw less and less of each other.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，我们见面越来越少。

examples.en: The main character is able to travel through time.
examples.zh: 主角能够穿越时空。

senses.group: minutes/hours/years, etc. 分钟、小时、年等

senses.def: the time shown on a clock in minutes and hours
senses.zh: （钟表所显示的）时间，钟点，时刻

examples.en: What time is it/What’s the time?
examples.zh: 几点了？

examples.en: Do you have the time?
examples.zh: 你知道现在几点了吗？

examples.en: What time do you make it?
examples.zh: 你说现在几点了？

examples.en: What time do you have?
examples.zh: 你知道现在几点了吗？

examples.en: Let me just check the time.
examples.zh: 让我查看一下时间。

examples.en: The time is now half past ten.
examples.zh: 现在是十点半。

examples.en: Can she tell the time yet (= say what time it is by looking at a clock)?
examples.zh: 她会看钟表了吗？

examples.en: Can she tell time yet?
examples.zh: 她会看钟表了吗？

examples.en: My watch keeps perfect time (= always shows the correct time).
examples.zh: 我的表走得很准。

examples.en: Look at the time! We'll be late.
examples.zh: 看几点了！我们要迟到了。

examples.en: This time tomorrow I'll be in Canada.
examples.zh: 明天这个时候我就在加拿大了。

senses.group: minutes/hours/years, etc. 分钟、小时、年等

senses.def: the time measured in a particular part of the world
senses.zh: （世界某一地区所计量的）时，时间

examples.en: 6 o’clock local time
examples.zh: 当地时间 6 点钟

examples.en: We're two hours behind Central European Time.
examples.zh: 我们比欧洲中部时间晚两个小时。

senses.group: minutes/hours/years, etc. 分钟、小时、年等

senses.def: the time when something happens or when something should happen
senses.zh: （某事发生或应该发生的）时间，时候

examples.en: What time do you finish work?
examples.zh: 你什么时候下班？

examples.en: The baby loves bath time.
examples.zh: 这婴儿喜欢洗澡的时候。

examples.en: A computer screen shows arrival and departure times.
examples.zh: 电脑屏幕显示出到达和离开的时间。

examples.en: I think it's time to go to bed.
examples.zh: 我想该睡觉了。

examples.en: This is hardly the time to discuss politics.
examples.zh: 现在不是讨论政治的时候。

examples.en: It's time for lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐时间到了。

examples.en: It's time the kids were in bed.
examples.zh: 孩子们该睡觉了。

examples.en: It's time that farmers listened to consumers.
examples.zh: 现在是农民倾听消费者意见的时候了。

examples.en: By the time you get there the meeting will be over.
examples.zh: 等你到了那里的时候，会议就该结束了。

examples.en: Have I called at a bad time? Shall I call back later?
examples.zh: 我现在打电话是不是不是时候？我晚会儿再打？

examples.en: We stock six different beers at any one time.
examples.zh: 我们随时库存六种不同的啤酒。

examples.en: I didn't realize it at the time, but that was the best day of my life.
examples.zh: 当时我没有意识到，但那是我生命中最美好的一天。

examples.en: The promotion came at just the right time for me.
examples.zh: 于我而言，升职来得正是时候。

examples.en: The new product will launch when the time is right.
examples.zh: 新产品将在适当的时候推出。

examples.en: You'll feel differently about it when the time comes (= when it happens).
examples.zh: 到时候你就会有不同的感受了。

examples.en: Several articles were published around the time of his death in 2018.
examples.zh: 2018 年他去世前后发表了几篇文章。

senses.group: minutes/hours/years, etc. 分钟、小时、年等

senses.def: an amount of time; the amount of time available to work, rest, etc.
senses.zh: 一段时间；（可用于工作、休息等的）一段时间

examples.en: I can't go with you—I don't have time.
examples.zh: 我不能跟你走——我没时间。

examples.en: He spends a lot of his time working.
examples.zh: 他把大量时间都花在工作上。

examples.en: Do you have time for a chat?
examples.zh: 有空聊聊吗？

examples.en: Allow plenty of time to get to the airport.
examples.zh: 预留足够的时间到达机场。

examples.en: I can probably make the time to see them.
examples.zh: 我大概能腾出时间见他们。

examples.en: It takes time to make changes in the law.
examples.zh: 修改法律还有待时日。

examples.en: We have no time to lose (= we must hurry).
examples.zh: 我们不能耽误时间了！

examples.en: We got to the airport with time to spare.
examples.zh: 我们到了机场，时间还算充裕。

examples.en: She plans to study overseas for an extended period of time.
examples.zh: 她计划长期出国学习。

examples.en: What do you like to do in your free time?
examples.zh: 你闲暇时喜欢干什么？

examples.en: She doesn’t have much spare time.
examples.zh: 她没有太多空闲时间。

examples.en: Sorry, I can’t spare the time.
examples.zh: 对不起，我抽不出时间。

examples.en: Don't waste any more time!
examples.zh: 别再浪费时间了！

examples.en: What a waste of time!
examples.zh: 太浪费时间了！

examples.en: Time's running out for them to complete the project.
examples.zh: 他们完成这项工程的时间不多了。

examples.en: I didn't finish the test—I ran out of time.
examples.zh: 我没答完试卷，我的时间不够了。

examples.en: Time's up—have you worked out the answer yet?
examples.zh: 时间到了，你得出答案了没有？

examples.en: He never takes any time off (= time spent not working).
examples.zh: 他从不休假。

examples.en: Jane's worked here for some time (= for a fairly long period of time).
examples.zh: 简在这儿工作已经有好长时间了。

examples.en: Do it now please—not in three hours' time (= three hours from now).
examples.zh: 请现在就干，而不是三个小时之后。

examples.en: The journey time is two hours.
examples.zh: 旅程时间为两个小时。

examples.en: I don’t want to take up too much of your precious time.
examples.zh: 我不想占用你太多宝贵的时间。

examples.en: What’s the hurry? We have all the time in the world.
examples.zh: 急什么？我们拥有世界上所有的时间。

senses.def: a period of time, either long or short, during which you do something or something happens

examples.en: His injuries will take a long time to heal.
examples.zh: 他的伤需要很长一段时间才能好。

examples.en: It took them a long time to get home.
examples.zh: 他们花了很长时间才回到家。

examples.en: Did you have to wait a long time to see the doctor?
examples.zh: 您是否需要等待很长时间才能看医生？

examples.en: I lived in Egypt for a time.
examples.zh: 我在埃及住过一阵子。

examples.en: I was only there for a short time.
examples.zh: 我只在那里待了很短的时间。

examples.en: The early morning is the best time of day.
examples.zh: 清晨是一天最好的时光。

examples.en: Her parents died a long time ago.
examples.zh: 她的父母很早以前就去世了。

examples.en: At one time (= at a period of time in the past) Emily was my best friend.
examples.zh: 埃米莉一度是我最好的朋友。

examples.en: Mr Curtis was the manager in my time (= when I was working there).
examples.zh: 我在那里工作时，柯蒂斯先生是经理。

senses.def: a period of history connected with particular events or experiences in people’s lives

examples.en: The movie is set at the time of the Russian Revolution.
examples.zh: 这部电影以俄国革命时期为背景。

examples.en: the politician who promised ‘peace in our time’
examples.zh: 承诺“我们这个时代的和平”的那位政客

examples.en: in ancient times
examples.zh: 在古代

examples.en: The Industrial Revolution took place in Victorian times.
examples.zh: 工业革命发生在维多利亚时代。

examples.en: the violent times we live in (= the present period of history)
examples.zh: 我们生逢的乱世

examples.en: in times of trouble
examples.zh: 在困难时期

examples.en: The business was successful, even during difficult times.
examples.zh: 生意很兴旺，即使在困难时期。

examples.en: Times are hard for the unemployed.
examples.zh: 对失业者来说，时世艰难。

examples.en: Times have changed since Grandma was young.
examples.zh: 世易时移，现在已不是祖母年轻时那会儿了。

senses.def: an occasion when you do something or when something happens

examples.en: Every time I hear that song I feel happy.
examples.zh: 我每次听到那首歌都感到很愉快。

examples.en: It doesn't matter if you don't win every time (= every time you play).
examples.zh: 如果您不是每次都赢（=每次玩）也没关系。

examples.en: Next time you're here let's have lunch together.
examples.zh: 下次你到这里来，咱们一起吃午饭。

examples.en: He failed his driving test three times.
examples.zh: 他考了三次驾驶执照都没通过。

examples.en: He's determined to pass this time.
examples.zh: 这一回他决心要考及格。

examples.en: When was the last time you saw her?
examples.zh: 你上次是什么时候见到她的？

examples.en: I see her two or three times a week.
examples.zh: 我每周见她两到三次。

examples.en: How many times (= how often) do I have to tell you not to do that?
examples.zh: 我得要跟你说多少回不要做那种事？

examples.en: I remember one time (= once) we had to abandon our car in the snow.
examples.zh: 我记得有一次我们迫于无奈把汽车丢弃在雪地里。

examples.en: At no time did I give my consent to the plan.
examples.zh: 我从未同意过这项计划。

senses.def: an event or occasion that you experience in a particular way
senses.zh: （以某种方式经历的）事件，时刻

examples.en: Did you have a good time in Spain?
examples.zh: 你在西班牙过得愉快吗？

examples.en: They're having a hard time dealing with her illness.
examples.zh: 他们正费力地为她治病。

examples.en: I had an awful time in the hospital.
examples.zh: 我住院的日子可真难熬。

examples.en: Mike and I shared some really good times.
examples.zh: 迈克和我曾共同度过一段很美好的时光。

senses.def: how long somebody takes to run a race or complete an event
senses.zh: （完成赛跑或竞赛项目的）所用时间

examples.en: The winner's time was 11.6 seconds.
examples.zh: 获胜者的时间是 11.6 秒。

examples.en: She completed the 500 metres in record time (= faster than any previous runner).
examples.zh: 她以破纪录的时间跑完了 500 米。

examples.en: one of the fastest times ever
examples.zh: 历来最快的成绩之一

senses.def: the number of beats

examples.en: This piece is in four-four time.
examples.zh: 这首乐曲为四四拍。

examples.en: a slow waltz time
examples.zh: 缓慢的华尔兹节拍

examples.en: The conductor beat time with a baton.
examples.zh: 指挥用指挥棒打拍子。

senses.def: the correct speed and rhythm of a piece of music

examples.en: Try and dance in time to the music (= with the same speed and rhythm).
examples.zh: 要跟上音乐的节奏跳舞。

examples.en: Clap your hands to keep time (= sing or move with the correct speed and rhythm).
examples.zh: 拍手以保持节奏。

examples.en: to play in/out of time (= follow/not follow the correct speed and rhythm)
examples.zh: 演奏得合／不合节奏

examples.en: He always plays in perfect time.
examples.zh: 他演奏的节奏总是准确无误。

senses.def: used to say that something should have happened before now
if you do something against time

examples.en: They're working against time to try and get people out of the rubble alive.
examples.zh: 他们正在争分夺秒，设法把人们从瓦砾中活着救出来。

senses.def: earlier/later than was expected

examples.en: We finished 15 minutes ahead of time.
examples.zh: 我们提前 15 分钟完成。

examples.en: The plane took off an hour behind time.
examples.zh: 飞机晚点一个小时才起飞。

senses.def: having advanced or new ideas that other people use or copy later
senses.zh: 超越时代的；有超前意识的；具有前瞻性的

senses.def: during the whole of a particular period of time

examples.en: The letter was in my pocket all the time (= while I was looking for it).
examples.zh: 这信一直就在我的口袋里。

senses.def: very often; repeatedly

examples.en: She leaves the lights on all the time.
examples.zh: 她总是让灯亮着。

senses.def: always

examples.en: Our representatives are ready to help you at all times.
examples.zh: 我们的代表随时准备帮助你。

examples.en: Hot water is available at all times.
examples.zh: 随时都有热水。

senses.def: even when the circumstances are very good

examples.en: He's never very happy at the best of times—he'll be much worse now!
examples.zh: 他即使在处境最好的时候也从未很高兴过，现在就更糟了！

senses.def: at one time; together

examples.en: She was laughing and crying at the same time.
examples.zh: 她又哭又笑。

senses.def: used to introduce a fact that is different and must be considered
senses.zh: （用以引出必须予以考虑的不同情况）同时，也，然而，不过

examples.en: You have to be firm, but at the same time you should try and be sympathetic.
examples.zh: 你必须要严格，不过也应尽量怀有同情心。

senses.def: separately or in groups of two, three, etc. on each occasion

examples.en: We had to go and see the principal one at a time.
examples.zh: 我们得逐一去见校长。

examples.en: She ran up the stairs two at a time.
examples.zh: 她一步两阶地跑上楼梯。

examples.en: He surfs the internet for hours at a time.
examples.zh: 他一次在网上待好几个小时。

senses.def: at the age you are (especially when you are not young)
senses.zh: 在…这样的年纪（尤指不年轻时）

examples.en: Eyesight doesn't get any better at my time of life.
examples.zh: 到我这把年纪，视力绝不会变好的。

senses.def: sometimes

examples.en: He can be really bad-tempered at times.
examples.zh: 他有的时候脾气可真坏。

examples.en: The rain will become heavy at times in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午雨有时会变大。

examples.en: He can be rather moody at times.
examples.zh: 他有时候相当情绪化。

senses.def: to mark or follow the rhythm of music, by waving a stick, tapping

examples.en: She beat time with her fingers.
examples.zh: 她用手指打拍子。

senses.def: happening before you were born or can remember or before you lived, worked, etc. somewhere
senses.zh: 在…出生（或记事、在世、工作等）之前

examples.en: ‘Were you taught by Professor Pascal?’ ‘No, he was before my time.’
examples.zh: “帕斯卡尔教授教过你吗？”“没有，他教书时我还没有入校呢。”

senses.def: before the usual time in somebody’s life when something happens

examples.en: She got old before her time.
examples.zh: 她过早地衰老了。

senses.def: old-fashioned in your ideas, methods, etc.
to be able to take advantage of opportunities when they come

examples.en: His success was down to being in the right place at the right time.
examples.zh: 他的成功是因为把握住了时机。

senses.def: to still be alive after the time when you were expected to die

examples.en: He’s been living on borrowed time ever since his last heart attack.
examples.zh: 自从上次心脏病发作以来，他一直过着借来的时光。

senses.def: to be doing something that other people are likely to soon stop you from doing
senses.zh: 做很快就会遭到制止的事；好景不长

examples.en: According to the latest opinion polls, the government is living on borrowed time.
examples.zh: 根据最新的民意调查，政府的生存时间是借来的。

senses.def: used to encourage somebody who has not been successful at something
senses.zh: （鼓励未成功的人）祝下次好运

examples.en: Never mind— better luck next time.
examples.zh: 没关系，祝你下次好运。

examples.en: If you didn't win a prize, better luck next time.
examples.zh: 如果没获奖，愿你下次好运。

senses.def: to wait for the right time to do something

examples.en: He decided to bide his time until he got an opportunity to talk to her alone.
examples.zh: 他决定等待时机，直到有机会单独与她交谈。

senses.def: to do something in order to delay an event, a decision, etc.

examples.en: The negotiators kept the gunman talking to buy time for the hostages.
examples.zh: 谈判者不断让持枪歹徒说话，以便为人质争取时间。

senses.def: to say or decide that it is time for something to finish
a very difficult or unpleasant job or time
senses.zh: 费力（或令人讨厌）的事；难熬（或令人不快）的日子

examples.en: I've had a devil of a job finding you.
examples.zh: 我费了九牛二虎之力才找到你。

senses.def: to spend time in prison
whenever there is a choice

examples.en: I don't really like cities—give me the countryside every time.
examples.zh: 我真不太喜欢城市，一有机会就让我去乡村吧。

senses.def: if you do something for old times’ sake
senses.zh: 看在旧日的情分上；念及老交情

senses.def: for a short period of time but not permanently

examples.en: You can leave your suitcase here for the time being.
examples.zh: 你可以暂时把衣箱留在这儿。

senses.def: beginning on that day; from that time

examples.en: From that time forth she gave me endless friendship and encouragement.
examples.zh: 从那时起，她给了我无尽的友谊和鼓励。

senses.def: occasionally but not regularly

examples.en: She has to work at weekends from time to time.
examples.zh: 她偶尔周末还得工作。

senses.def: to delay something so that you can have more time to make a decision, deal with a problem, etc.
to deliberately make a situation difficult and unpleasant for somebody
senses.zh: 给某人找茬儿；使某人不好过

examples.en: They really gave me a hard time at the interview.
examples.zh: 面试时他们确实是在难为我。

senses.def: used to say that you prefer a particular thing or person to the one that has just been mentioned
senses.zh: 我宁愿；我更喜欢；我宁可选择

examples.en: We don't go out much. Give me a quiet night in front of the TV any day!
examples.zh: 我们不常出去。我宁愿坐在电视机前安安静静地过一夜！

senses.def: to have no difficulties or problems
senses.zh: 日子好过；过得舒适；毫无困难

examples.en: He’s had an easy time of it since he married Lucy.
examples.zh: 自从与露西结婚以来，他过得很轻松。

senses.def: to enjoy yourself very much
to like and be interested in somebody/something
senses.zh: 喜欢；对…感兴趣；愿意为…花时间

examples.en: I've always had a lot of time for Mary.
examples.zh: 我总是有很多时间陪伴玛丽。

senses.def: to dislike somebody/something
senses.zh: 不喜欢；讨厌；不愿为…花时间

examples.en: I have no time for lazy people like Steve.
examples.zh: 我讨厌像史蒂夫这样的懒汉。

senses.def: to have many problems or difficulties to deal with; to not be successful
senses.zh: 遇到许多麻烦；过得不顺

examples.en: He’s had a thin time of it since losing his job.
examples.zh: 自从失业后，他的日子就过得很艰难。

senses.def: to enjoy yourself very much
to have nothing to do or not be busy
senses.zh: 无所事事；没事可干；闲着

senses.def: to enjoy yourself very much; to have a very good time
senses.zh: 玩得很痛快；过得非常快活

examples.en: The kids had a whale of a time at the theme park.
examples.zh: 孩子们在主题公园度过了一段愉快的时光。

senses.def: when enough time has passed

examples.en: It is possible that in the course of time a cure for cancer will be found.
examples.zh: 治疗癌症的方法终有一天能找到。

examples.en: In the course of time, I began to understand.
examples.zh: 终于我开始明白了。

senses.def: when the time is appropriate, usually after a long period
senses.zh: 在适当时候，时机成熟时（尤指久待之后）

examples.en: I have no doubt that she’ll tell us in the fullness of time.
examples.zh: 我毫不怀疑她会及时告诉我们。

senses.def: early; with enough time so that you are not in a hurry

examples.en: Get to the airport in good time.
examples.zh: 早早到机场。

senses.def: used to say that something will be done or will happen at the appropriate time and not before
senses.zh: 会按时做（或出现）；不消多久

examples.en: Be patient, Emily! All in good time.
examples.zh: 别急，埃米莉！快好了。

senses.def: at the very last moment; just before something bad happens, so that you manage to avoid it, but only just
senses.zh: 在最后一刻；在紧要关头；恰是时候

examples.en: They escaped from the smoke-filled house just in the nick of time.
examples.zh: 他们及时逃离了烟雾缭绕的房子。

senses.def: so soon or so quickly that it is surprising
senses.zh: 短暂（或快）得令人吃惊；立刻；马上；一会儿

examples.en: The kids will be leaving home in no time.
examples.zh: 孩子们很快就要离开家了。

senses.def: a long time ago in the past

examples.en: In olden times people would gather in town squares to gossip and exchange stories.
examples.zh: 在过去，人们会聚集在城镇广场上闲聊和交换故事。

senses.def: how and when you want to, even though this might annoy other people

examples.en: He always does the work, but in his own sweet time.
examples.zh: 工作他总是在做，但只在自己高兴的时候做。

examples.en: She just ignores all the criticism and continues in her own sweet way.
examples.zh: 她只是无视所有的批评，继续以她自己的甜蜜方式。

senses.def: when you are ready and not sooner

examples.en: Don't hassle him! He'll do it in his own good time.
examples.zh: 别唠唠叨叨地烦他了！他准备好时就会做的。

senses.def: in your free time and not when you usually work or study
after a period of time when a situation has changed
senses.zh: 经过一段时间之后；迟早；最后；终于

examples.en: They learned to accept their stepmother in time.
examples.zh: 过了一段时间之后他们学着接受他们的继母。

examples.en: You'll get used to the work in time.
examples.zh: 你迟早会适应这份工作的。

senses.def: not late; with enough time to be able to do something

examples.en: Will we be in time for the six o'clock train?
examples.zh: 我们来得及赶上六点钟的那趟火车吗？

examples.en: The ambulance got there just in time (= to save somebody's life).
examples.zh: 救护车及时赶到那里。

senses.def: used to say that you think somebody should do something soon
senses.zh: 差不多／现在是…的时候了

examples.en: It's about time you cleaned your room!
examples.zh: 你该打扫自己的房间了！

senses.def: used to say that something will definitely happen, although you are not sure when
senses.zh: 早晚的事；只是时间问题

examples.en: It's only a matter of time before they bring out their own version of the software.
examples.zh: 他们推出自己的软件只是个时间问题。

senses.def: to change and develop your ideas, way of working, etc. so that you do what is modern and what is expected

examples.en: Many complained that the Royal Family had failed to move with the times.
examples.zh: 许多人抱怨王室未能与时俱进。

senses.def: to spend time doing something that is not important while you are waiting for something else to happen

examples.en: We killed time playing cards.
examples.zh: 我们打纸牌消磨时间。

senses.def: used to say hello to somebody you have not seen for a long time
to complete a journey quickly

examples.en: We made excellent time and arrived in Spain in two days.
examples.zh: 我们一路很顺当，两天后就到了西班牙。

senses.def: to do something quickly or very often because you wish you had started doing it sooner
senses.zh: （加快或加紧做某事以）弥补失去的时间

examples.en: I’ll have to work hard now to make up for lost time.
examples.zh: 我现在必须努力工作，以弥补失去的时间。

senses.def: many times; frequently
to pass the time while you wait for something more interesting

examples.en: I'm just marking time in this job—I'm hoping to get into journalism.
examples.zh: 我干这件工作只是在等待时机，我希望能从事新闻工作。

senses.def: to make marching
on the next, first, etc. occasion that the same thing happens
senses.zh: 同样的事情下次（或第一次等）发生时

examples.en: He repeated none of the errors he'd made first time round.
examples.zh: 他没有重复过首次所犯下的任何错误。

examples.en: This time round it was not so easy.
examples.zh: 这一次这事可就不那么容易了。

senses.def: used to say that something is usually true or almost always happens

examples.en: Nine times out of ten she gives the right answer.
examples.zh: 她的答案十有八九是对的。

senses.def: almost always
senses.zh: 几乎没有例外；几乎总是

senses.def: used to say that something should have happened before now
to refuse to speak to somebody because you do not like or respect them

examples.en: Since the success of her novel, people shake her hand who once wouldn't have given her the time of day.
examples.zh: 自从她的小说获得成功之后，曾经懒得答理她的人也跟她握起手来。

senses.def: now is the best time to do something, not in the future
senses.zh: 现在是做…的最佳时机；现在不做更待何时

senses.def: that has ever existed
senses.zh: 自古以来；有史以来；从未有过

examples.en: Many rated him the best singer of all time.
examples.zh: 许多人认为他是有史以来最优秀的歌手。

senses.def: used, especially at the beginning of stories, to mean ‘a long time ago in the past’
senses.zh: （用于故事的开头）从前，很久以前

examples.en: Once upon a time there was a beautiful princess.
examples.zh: 从前，有一位美丽的公主。

senses.def: at the arranged or correct time; not late

examples.en: The train arrived right on time.
examples.zh: 火车准时到达。

senses.def: to say hello to somebody and have a short conversation with them
senses.zh: （与某人）寒暄，打招呼，闲谈一会儿

senses.def: to find or create reasons why something has to be delayed, often so you have longer to prepare for it

examples.en: His legal team, clearly playing for time, sought to have the case heard a month later.
examples.zh: 他的律师团队明显是在拖延时间，请求一个月后对案子听证。

senses.def: a situation in which you have to do something or finish something very fast before it is too late
senses.zh: 和时间赛跑；抢时间；争分夺秒

examples.en: Getting food to the starving refugees is now a race against time.
examples.zh: 为饥饿的难民提供食物现在是一场与时间的赛跑。

senses.def: something that you feel shows what things are like now, especially how bad they are

examples.en: The increasing number of people owning guns is an alarming sign of the times.
examples.zh: 拥有枪支的人数不断增加是这个时代的一个令人震惊的迹象。

senses.def: it is better to deal with something immediately because if you wait it may become worse or more difficult and cause extra work
senses.zh: 及时缝一针能省九针；小洞及时补，免遭大洞苦

senses.def: to not think about what will happen in the future
senses.zh: 得过且过；做一天和尚撞一天钟；过一天算一天

examples.en: I don't know if he'll get better. We're just taking it one day at a time.
examples.zh: 我不知道他还能不能好转，我们只有过一天算一天。

senses.def: to use as much time as you need without hurrying

examples.en: There's no rush—take your time.
examples.zh: 别着急，慢慢来。

senses.def: used to say you think somebody is late or is too slow in doing something
senses.zh: 迟到；慢慢腾腾；磨磨蹭蹭

examples.en: You certainly took your time getting here!
examples.zh: 你真是姗姗来迟啊！

senses.def: to spend some time away from your usual work or activity in order to rest or do something else instead
senses.zh: 抽出时间（暂停工作或活动）；忙里偷闲

examples.en: She is taking time out from her music career for a year.
examples.zh: 她将抽出一年的时间，暂不从事音乐事业。

senses.def: the fact that something has not happened before does not mean that it will never happen
senses.zh: 没有发生的事情并不意味着永远不会发生；什么事情都有第一次

senses.def: used when you have failed to do something twice and hope that you will succeed the third time
senses.zh: （但愿）第三次交好运；过一过二不过三

senses.def: often; on many or all occasions
senses.zh: 一次又一次；一再；屡屡；总是

examples.en: You will get a perfect result time after time if you follow these instructions.
examples.zh: 如果你遵循这些用法说明，每次都会得到最佳的效果。

examples.en: Time and again, the girls have shown how strong and determined they can be.
examples.zh: 女孩们一次又一次地展示了她们的坚强和决心。

senses.def: one and a half times the usual rate of pay

examples.en: We get time and a half on Sundays.
examples.zh: 周日我们有一个半时间。

senses.def: time seems to pass very quickly
senses.zh: 时间过得真快；光阴似箭；时光飞逝

examples.en: How time flies! I've got to go now.
examples.zh: 时间过得真快！现在我得走了。

examples.en: Time has flown since the holiday began.
examples.zh: 假日一开始，时间就过得飞快。

senses.def: time is valuable, and should not be wasted
senses.zh: 时间就是金钱；一寸光阴一寸金

senses.def: used to say that somebody can wait for something to happen or can wait before doing something
senses.zh: 有的是时间（等待某事发生或做某事）

senses.def: used to say that something used to happen in the past
senses.zh: 曾经有那么个时候…；那年头…

examples.en: Time was when you could go for a walk in the country and not see another person for miles.
examples.zh: 过去你可以在乡间散步走上好几英里也看不到一个人。

examples.en: Time was when we never needed to lock our house at night.
examples.zh: 以前我们晚上从来不需要锁门。

senses.def: used to say that you will have to wait for some time to find out the result of a situation

examples.en: Only time will tell if the treatment has been successful.
examples.zh: 只有时间才能证明这种疗法是否成功。

senses.def: during the whole of a particular period of time

examples.en: My keys were in my pocket the whole time (= while I was looking for them).
examples.zh: 我的钥匙一直在我的口袋里（=当我寻找它们时）。

senses.def: very often; repeatedly

examples.en: He drums his fingers on the table the whole time—it's very annoying.
examples.zh: 他一直用手指敲击桌子——这很烦人。

senses.def: to measure how long it takes for something to happen or for somebody to do something

examples.en: ‘How long does it take to get to Leeds from here?’ ‘I don’t know, I’ve never timed it.’
examples.zh: “从这里到利兹需要多长时间？”“我不知道，我从来没有计时过。”

examples.en: The winner was timed at 20.4 seconds.
examples.zh: 获胜者用的时间为 20.4 秒。

examples.en: Time how long it takes you to run ten laps.
examples.zh: 记一下自己跑十圈所需的时间。

examples.en: Time how long it takes you to answer the questions.
examples.zh: 记一下自己回答这些问题所需的时间。

senses.def: to arrange to do something or arrange for something to happen at a particular time
senses.zh: 为…安排时间；选择…的时机

examples.en: She timed her arrival for shortly after 3.
examples.zh: 她定在 3 点钟刚过到达。

examples.en: Their visit was perfectly timed.
examples.zh: 他们的访问时机拿捏得恰到好处。

examples.en: The runners set off at precisely timed intervals.
examples.zh: 赛跑者按照精确的时间间隔出发。

examples.en: Their request was poorly timed (= it was made at the wrong time).
examples.zh: 他们的请求不合时宜（=在错误的时间提出）。

examples.en: If we time it right, we should miss the traffic.
examples.zh: 如果时间安排的好，我们可以避开交通拥堵。

examples.en: ‘I hope we're not too early.’ ‘You couldn't have timed it better!’
examples.zh: “我希望我们没有到得太早。”“你们来的时间再合适不过了。”

examples.en: The announcement of her new role was timed to coincide with the launch of her latest book.
examples.zh: 她的新角色通告与她的新书发布安排在同一时间。

senses.def: to hit or kick a ball at a particular moment in a sports game
senses.zh: 在某一时刻击球（或踢球）

examples.en: She timed the pass perfectly.
examples.zh: 她传球的时机掌握得恰到好处。

examples.en: a beautifully timed shot
examples.zh: 时机把握得绝妙的一击

senses.def: a popular US news magazine, published every week. It was started in 1923 by Henry Luce (1898-1967), the husband of Clare Booth Luce
senses.zh: 时间：每周出版一本受欢迎的美国新闻杂志。它由Clare Booth Luce的丈夫Henry Luce（1898-1967）和Briton Hadden（1898-1929）的丈夫于1923年创立。它为世界各地的新闻工作者设立了办事处，并发展了一种特殊的写作风格，这种风格有时被称为Timese。该杂志现在有几种不同的国际版本。人们认为将照片印在杂志的封面上是一种极大的荣幸，并且每年作为特色节目，它都会选择当年的男人或女人。

senses.def: used to say that something should have happened before now
if you do something against time

examples.en: They're working against time to try and get people out of the rubble alive.
examples.zh: 他们正在争分夺秒，设法把人们从瓦砾中活着救出来。

senses.def: earlier/later than was expected

examples.en: We finished 15 minutes ahead of time.
examples.zh: 我们提前 15 分钟完成。

examples.en: The plane took off an hour behind time.
examples.zh: 飞机晚点一个小时才起飞。

senses.def: having advanced or new ideas that other people use or copy later
senses.zh: 超越时代的；有超前意识的；具有前瞻性的

items.idm: all the time | the whole time

senses.def: during the whole of a particular period of time

examples.en: The letter was in my pocket all the time (= while I was looking for it).
examples.zh: 这信一直就在我的口袋里。

senses.def: very often; repeatedly

examples.en: She leaves the lights on all the time.
examples.zh: 她总是让灯亮着。

senses.def: always

examples.en: Our representatives are ready to help you at all times.
examples.zh: 我们的代表随时准备帮助你。

examples.en: Hot water is available at all times.
examples.zh: 随时都有热水。

senses.def: even when the circumstances are very good

examples.en: He's never very happy at the best of times—he'll be much worse now!
examples.zh: 他即使在处境最好的时候也从未很高兴过，现在就更糟了！

senses.def: at one time; together

examples.en: She was laughing and crying at the same time.
examples.zh: 她又哭又笑。

senses.def: used to introduce a fact that is different and must be considered
senses.zh: （用以引出必须予以考虑的不同情况）同时，也，然而，不过

examples.en: You have to be firm, but at the same time you should try and be sympathetic.
examples.zh: 你必须要严格，不过也应尽量怀有同情心。

senses.def: separately or in groups of two, three, etc. on each occasion

examples.en: We had to go and see the principal one at a time.
examples.zh: 我们得逐一去见校长。

examples.en: She ran up the stairs two at a time.
examples.zh: 她一步两阶地跑上楼梯。

examples.en: He surfs the internet for hours at a time.
examples.zh: 他一次在网上待好几个小时。

items.idm: at my, your, his, etc. time of life

senses.def: at the age you are (especially when you are not young)
senses.zh: 在…这样的年纪（尤指不年轻时）

examples.en: Eyesight doesn't get any better at my time of life.
examples.zh: 到我这把年纪，视力绝不会变好的。

senses.def: sometimes

examples.en: He can be really bad-tempered at times.
examples.zh: 他有的时候脾气可真坏。

examples.en: The rain will become heavy at times in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午雨有时会变大。

examples.en: He can be rather moody at times.
examples.zh: 他有时候相当情绪化。

senses.def: to mark or follow the rhythm of music, by waving a stick, tapping

examples.en: She beat time with her fingers.
examples.zh: 她用手指打拍子。

items.idm: before my, your, his, etc. time

senses.def: happening before you were born or can remember or before you lived, worked, etc. somewhere
senses.zh: 在…出生（或记事、在世、工作等）之前

examples.en: ‘Were you taught by Professor Pascal?’ ‘No, he was before my time.’
examples.zh: “帕斯卡尔教授教过你吗？”“没有，他教书时我还没有入校呢。”

senses.def: before the usual time in somebody’s life when something happens

examples.en: She got old before her time.
examples.zh: 她过早地衰老了。

senses.def: old-fashioned in your ideas, methods, etc.

items.idm: be in the right place at the right time

senses.def: to be able to take advantage of opportunities when they come

examples.en: His success was down to being in the right place at the right time.
examples.zh: 他的成功是因为把握住了时机。

senses.def: to still be alive after the time when you were expected to die

examples.en: He’s been living on borrowed time ever since his last heart attack.
examples.zh: 自从上次心脏病发作以来，他一直过着借来的时光。

senses.def: to be doing something that other people are likely to soon stop you from doing
senses.zh: 做很快就会遭到制止的事；好景不长

examples.en: According to the latest opinion polls, the government is living on borrowed time.
examples.zh: 根据最新的民意调查，政府的生存时间是借来的。

senses.def: used to encourage somebody who has not been successful at something
senses.zh: （鼓励未成功的人）祝下次好运

examples.en: Never mind— better luck next time.
examples.zh: 没关系，祝你下次好运。

examples.en: If you didn't win a prize, better luck next time.
examples.zh: 如果没获奖，愿你下次好运。

senses.def: to wait for the right time to do something

examples.en: He decided to bide his time until he got an opportunity to talk to her alone.
examples.zh: 他决定等待时机，直到有机会单独与她交谈。

senses.def: to do something in order to delay an event, a decision, etc.

examples.en: The negotiators kept the gunman talking to buy time for the hostages.
examples.zh: 谈判者不断让持枪歹徒说话，以便为人质争取时间。

senses.def: to say or decide that it is time for something to finish

items.idm: a devil of a job/time

senses.def: a very difficult or unpleasant job or time
senses.zh: 费力（或令人讨厌）的事；难熬（或令人不快）的日子

examples.en: I've had a devil of a job finding you.
examples.zh: 我费了九牛二虎之力才找到你。

senses.def: to spend time in prison
whenever there is a choice

examples.en: I don't really like cities—give me the countryside every time.
examples.zh: 我真不太喜欢城市，一有机会就让我去乡村吧。

senses.def: if you do something for old times’ sake
senses.zh: 看在旧日的情分上；念及老交情

senses.def: for a short period of time but not permanently

examples.en: You can leave your suitcase here for the time being.
examples.zh: 你可以暂时把衣箱留在这儿。

senses.def: beginning on that day; from that time

examples.en: From that time forth she gave me endless friendship and encouragement.
examples.zh: 从那时起，她给了我无尽的友谊和鼓励。

senses.def: occasionally but not regularly

examples.en: She has to work at weekends from time to time.
examples.zh: 她偶尔周末还得工作。

senses.def: to delay something so that you can have more time to make a decision, deal with a problem, etc.
to deliberately make a situation difficult and unpleasant for somebody
senses.zh: 给某人找茬儿；使某人不好过

examples.en: They really gave me a hard time at the interview.
examples.zh: 面试时他们确实是在难为我。

senses.def: used to say that you prefer a particular thing or person to the one that has just been mentioned
senses.zh: 我宁愿；我更喜欢；我宁可选择

examples.en: We don't go out much. Give me a quiet night in front of the TV any day!
examples.zh: 我们不常出去。我宁愿坐在电视机前安安静静地过一夜！

senses.def: to have no difficulties or problems
senses.zh: 日子好过；过得舒适；毫无困难

examples.en: He’s had an easy time of it since he married Lucy.
examples.zh: 自从与露西结婚以来，他过得很轻松。

senses.def: to enjoy yourself very much

items.idm: have a lot of time for somebody/something

senses.def: to like and be interested in somebody/something
senses.zh: 喜欢；对…感兴趣；愿意为…花时间

examples.en: I've always had a lot of time for Mary.
examples.zh: 我总是有很多时间陪伴玛丽。

items.idm: have no time for somebody/something | not have much time for somebody/something

senses.def: to dislike somebody/something
senses.zh: 不喜欢；讨厌；不愿为…花时间

examples.en: I have no time for lazy people like Steve.
examples.zh: 我讨厌像史蒂夫这样的懒汉。

senses.def: to have many problems or difficulties to deal with; to not be successful
senses.zh: 遇到许多麻烦；过得不顺

examples.en: He’s had a thin time of it since losing his job.
examples.zh: 自从失业后，他的日子就过得很艰难。

items.idm: have the time of your life

senses.def: to enjoy yourself very much

items.idm: have time on your hands | have time to kill

senses.def: to have nothing to do or not be busy
senses.zh: 无所事事；没事可干；闲着

items.idm: have a whale of a time

senses.def: to enjoy yourself very much; to have a very good time
senses.zh: 玩得很痛快；过得非常快活

examples.en: The kids had a whale of a time at the theme park.
examples.zh: 孩子们在主题公园度过了一段愉快的时光。

senses.def: when enough time has passed

examples.en: It is possible that in the course of time a cure for cancer will be found.
examples.zh: 治疗癌症的方法终有一天能找到。

examples.en: In the course of time, I began to understand.
examples.zh: 终于我开始明白了。

senses.def: when the time is appropriate, usually after a long period
senses.zh: 在适当时候，时机成熟时（尤指久待之后）

examples.en: I have no doubt that she’ll tell us in the fullness of time.
examples.zh: 我毫不怀疑她会及时告诉我们。

senses.def: early; with enough time so that you are not in a hurry

examples.en: Get to the airport in good time.
examples.zh: 早早到机场。

senses.def: used to say that something will be done or will happen at the appropriate time and not before
senses.zh: 会按时做（或出现）；不消多久

examples.en: Be patient, Emily! All in good time.
examples.zh: 别急，埃米莉！快好了。

senses.def: at the very last moment; just before something bad happens, so that you manage to avoid it, but only just
senses.zh: 在最后一刻；在紧要关头；恰是时候

examples.en: They escaped from the smoke-filled house just in the nick of time.
examples.zh: 他们及时逃离了烟雾缭绕的房子。

senses.def: so soon or so quickly that it is surprising
senses.zh: 短暂（或快）得令人吃惊；立刻；马上；一会儿

examples.en: The kids will be leaving home in no time.
examples.zh: 孩子们很快就要离开家了。

senses.def: a long time ago in the past

examples.en: In olden times people would gather in town squares to gossip and exchange stories.
examples.zh: 在过去，人们会聚集在城镇广场上闲聊和交换故事。

senses.def: how and when you want to, even though this might annoy other people

examples.en: He always does the work, but in his own sweet time.
examples.zh: 工作他总是在做，但只在自己高兴的时候做。

examples.en: She just ignores all the criticism and continues in her own sweet way.
examples.zh: 她只是无视所有的批评，继续以她自己的甜蜜方式。

senses.def: when you are ready and not sooner

examples.en: Don't hassle him! He'll do it in his own good time.
examples.zh: 别唠唠叨叨地烦他了！他准备好时就会做的。

senses.def: in your free time and not when you usually work or study
after a period of time when a situation has changed
senses.zh: 经过一段时间之后；迟早；最后；终于

examples.en: They learned to accept their stepmother in time.
examples.zh: 过了一段时间之后他们学着接受他们的继母。

examples.en: You'll get used to the work in time.
examples.zh: 你迟早会适应这份工作的。

senses.def: not late; with enough time to be able to do something

examples.en: Will we be in time for the six o'clock train?
examples.zh: 我们来得及赶上六点钟的那趟火车吗？

examples.en: The ambulance got there just in time (= to save somebody's life).
examples.zh: 救护车及时赶到那里。

senses.def: used to say that you think somebody should do something soon
senses.zh: 差不多／现在是…的时候了

examples.en: It's about time you cleaned your room!
examples.zh: 你该打扫自己的房间了！

items.idm: it’s just/only a matter of time (before…)

senses.def: used to say that something will definitely happen, although you are not sure when
senses.zh: 早晚的事；只是时间问题

examples.en: It's only a matter of time before they bring out their own version of the software.
examples.zh: 他们推出自己的软件只是个时间问题。

senses.def: to change and develop your ideas, way of working, etc. so that you do what is modern and what is expected

examples.en: Many complained that the Royal Family had failed to move with the times.
examples.zh: 许多人抱怨王室未能与时俱进。

items.idm: kill time | kill an hour, a couple of hours, etc.

senses.def: to spend time doing something that is not important while you are waiting for something else to happen

examples.en: We killed time playing cards.
examples.zh: 我们打纸牌消磨时间。

senses.def: used to say hello to somebody you have not seen for a long time
to complete a journey quickly

examples.en: We made excellent time and arrived in Spain in two days.
examples.zh: 我们一路很顺当，两天后就到了西班牙。

senses.def: to do something quickly or very often because you wish you had started doing it sooner
senses.zh: （加快或加紧做某事以）弥补失去的时间

examples.en: I’ll have to work hard now to make up for lost time.
examples.zh: 我现在必须努力工作，以弥补失去的时间。

items.idm: many a time | many’s the time (that)…

senses.def: many times; frequently
to pass the time while you wait for something more interesting

examples.en: I'm just marking time in this job—I'm hoping to get into journalism.
examples.zh: 我干这件工作只是在等待时机，我希望能从事新闻工作。

senses.def: to make marching

items.idm: (the) next, first, second, etc. time round

senses.def: on the next, first, etc. occasion that the same thing happens
senses.zh: 同样的事情下次（或第一次等）发生时

examples.en: He repeated none of the errors he'd made first time round.
examples.zh: 他没有重复过首次所犯下的任何错误。

examples.en: This time round it was not so easy.
examples.zh: 这一次这事可就不那么容易了。

items.idm: nine times out of ten | ninety-nine times out of a hundred

senses.def: used to say that something is usually true or almost always happens

examples.en: Nine times out of ten she gives the right answer.
examples.zh: 她的答案十有八九是对的。

items.idm: ninety-nine times out of a hundred

senses.def: almost always
senses.zh: 几乎没有例外；几乎总是

senses.def: used to say that something should have happened before now

items.idm: not give somebody the time of day

senses.def: to refuse to speak to somebody because you do not like or respect them

examples.en: Since the success of her novel, people shake her hand who once wouldn't have given her the time of day.
examples.zh: 自从她的小说获得成功之后，曾经懒得答理她的人也跟她握起手来。

items.idm: (there is) no time like the present

senses.def: now is the best time to do something, not in the future
senses.zh: 现在是做…的最佳时机；现在不做更待何时

senses.def: that has ever existed
senses.zh: 自古以来；有史以来；从未有过

examples.en: Many rated him the best singer of all time.
examples.zh: 许多人认为他是有史以来最优秀的歌手。

senses.def: used, especially at the beginning of stories, to mean ‘a long time ago in the past’
senses.zh: （用于故事的开头）从前，很久以前

examples.en: Once upon a time there was a beautiful princess.
examples.zh: 从前，有一位美丽的公主。

senses.def: at the arranged or correct time; not late

examples.en: The train arrived right on time.
examples.zh: 火车准时到达。

items.idm: pass the time of day (with somebody)

senses.def: to say hello to somebody and have a short conversation with them
senses.zh: （与某人）寒暄，打招呼，闲谈一会儿

senses.def: to find or create reasons why something has to be delayed, often so you have longer to prepare for it

examples.en: His legal team, clearly playing for time, sought to have the case heard a month later.
examples.zh: 他的律师团队明显是在拖延时间，请求一个月后对案子听证。

senses.def: a situation in which you have to do something or finish something very fast before it is too late
senses.zh: 和时间赛跑；抢时间；争分夺秒

examples.en: Getting food to the starving refugees is now a race against time.
examples.zh: 为饥饿的难民提供食物现在是一场与时间的赛跑。

senses.def: something that you feel shows what things are like now, especially how bad they are

examples.en: The increasing number of people owning guns is an alarming sign of the times.
examples.zh: 拥有枪支的人数不断增加是这个时代的一个令人震惊的迹象。

senses.def: it is better to deal with something immediately because if you wait it may become worse or more difficult and cause extra work
senses.zh: 及时缝一针能省九针；小洞及时补，免遭大洞苦

items.idm: take it/things one day at a time

senses.def: to not think about what will happen in the future
senses.zh: 得过且过；做一天和尚撞一天钟；过一天算一天

examples.en: I don't know if he'll get better. We're just taking it one day at a time.
examples.zh: 我不知道他还能不能好转，我们只有过一天算一天。

items.idm: take your time (over something) | take your time to do something/doing something

senses.def: to use as much time as you need without hurrying

examples.en: There's no rush—take your time.
examples.zh: 别着急，慢慢来。

senses.def: used to say you think somebody is late or is too slow in doing something
senses.zh: 迟到；慢慢腾腾；磨磨蹭蹭

examples.en: You certainly took your time getting here!
examples.zh: 你真是姗姗来迟啊！

senses.def: to spend some time away from your usual work or activity in order to rest or do something else instead
senses.zh: 抽出时间（暂停工作或活动）；忙里偷闲

examples.en: She is taking time out from her music career for a year.
examples.zh: 她将抽出一年的时间，暂不从事音乐事业。

items.idm: there’s a first time for everything

senses.def: the fact that something has not happened before does not mean that it will never happen
senses.zh: 没有发生的事情并不意味着永远不会发生；什么事情都有第一次

senses.def: used when you have failed to do something twice and hope that you will succeed the third time
senses.zh: （但愿）第三次交好运；过一过二不过三

items.idm: time after time | time and (time) again

senses.def: often; on many or all occasions
senses.zh: 一次又一次；一再；屡屡；总是

examples.en: You will get a perfect result time after time if you follow these instructions.
examples.zh: 如果你遵循这些用法说明，每次都会得到最佳的效果。

examples.en: Time and again, the girls have shown how strong and determined they can be.
examples.zh: 女孩们一次又一次地展示了她们的坚强和决心。

senses.def: one and a half times the usual rate of pay

examples.en: We get time and a half on Sundays.
examples.zh: 周日我们有一个半时间。

senses.def: time seems to pass very quickly
senses.zh: 时间过得真快；光阴似箭；时光飞逝

examples.en: How time flies! I've got to go now.
examples.zh: 时间过得真快！现在我得走了。

examples.en: Time has flown since the holiday began.
examples.zh: 假日一开始，时间就过得飞快。

senses.def: time is valuable, and should not be wasted
senses.zh: 时间就是金钱；一寸光阴一寸金

senses.def: used to say that somebody can wait for something to happen or can wait before doing something
senses.zh: 有的是时间（等待某事发生或做某事）

senses.def: used to say that something used to happen in the past
senses.zh: 曾经有那么个时候…；那年头…

examples.en: Time was when you could go for a walk in the country and not see another person for miles.
examples.zh: 过去你可以在乡间散步走上好几英里也看不到一个人。

examples.en: Time was when we never needed to lock our house at night.
examples.zh: 以前我们晚上从来不需要锁门。

items.idm: time (alone) will tell | only time will tell

senses.def: used to say that you will have to wait for some time to find out the result of a situation

examples.en: Only time will tell if the treatment has been successful.
examples.zh: 只有时间才能证明这种疗法是否成功。

items.idm: the whole time | all the time

senses.def: during the whole of a particular period of time

examples.en: My keys were in my pocket the whole time (= while I was looking for them).
examples.zh: 我的钥匙一直在我的口袋里（=当我寻找它们时）。

senses.def: very often; repeatedly

examples.en: He drums his fingers on the table the whole time—it's very annoying.
examples.zh: 他一直用手指敲击桌子——这很烦人。

synonyms.words: break ▪ respite ▪ time out ▪ breathing space

intro.en: These are all words for a short period of time spent relaxing.
intro.zh: 以上各词均表示短暂的休息。

items.def: a period of relaxing, sleeping or doing nothing after a period of activity:
items.zh: 指休息、睡眠

examples.en: We stopped for a well-earned rest.
examples.zh: 我们停下来做个应有的休息。

items.def: a short period of time when you stop what you are doing and rest or eat:
items.zh: 指间歇、休息

examples.en: Let’s take a break.
examples.zh: 咱们休息一会儿吧。

items.def: a short break from something difficult or unpleasant:
items.zh: 指从困境或不愉快、不舒适的状态中得到暂缓、暂停

examples.en: The drug brought a brief respite from the pain.
examples.zh: 药物暂时缓解了疼痛。

items.def: (especially North American English尤用于美式英语, informal) time for resting or relaxing away from your usual work or studies:
items.zh: 指暂停工作或学习的时间

examples.en: Take time out to relax by the pool.
examples.zh: 去游泳池边歇一歇吧。

items.def: a short rest in the middle of a period of mental or physical effort:
items.zh: 指脑力或体力活动期间的短暂休息、喘息时间

examples.en: This delay gives the party a breathing space in which to sort out its policies.
examples.zh: 这一延误使该党有了喘息之机来厘定其政策。

senses.def: used to say that you will have to wait for some time to find out the result of a situation

examples.en: Only time will tell if the treatment has been successful.
examples.zh: 只有时间才能证明这种疗法是否成功。

time (alone) will tell | only time will.word: time (alone) will tell | only time will tell

senses.def: often; on many or all occasions
senses.zh: 一次又一次；一再；屡屡；总是

examples.en: You will get a perfect result time after time if you follow these instructions.
examples.zh: 如果你遵循这些用法说明，每次都会得到最佳的效果。

examples.en: Time and again, the girls have shown how strong and determined they can be.
examples.zh: 女孩们一次又一次地展示了她们的坚强和决心。

examples.en: Time was when we never needed to lock our house at night.
examples.zh: 以前我们晚上从来不需要锁门。

time will tell: @@@LINK=time (alone) will tell | only time will tell

senses.def: a study to find out how efficient a company’s working methods are
senses.zh: 时间与动作研究（为评估生产或工作效率）

senses.def: a bomb that can be set to explode at a particular time
a situation that is likely to cause serious problems in the future

examples.en: Rising unemployment is a political time bomb for the government.
examples.zh: 日益严重的失业问题对政府来说是一枚政治上的定时炸弹。

examples.en: He described global warming as ‘an environmental time bomb ticking away’.
examples.zh: 他把全球变暖描绘成“正在滴答作响的定时炸弹”。

senses.def: a container that is filled with objects that people think are typical of the time they are living in. It is buried so that it can be discovered by people in the future.
senses.zh: 时代文物贮藏器（收藏具有时代特征的物品）

senses.def: a piece of card on which the number of hours that somebody has worked are recorded, usually by a machine
senses.zh: 考勤卡；工作时间记录卡

senses.def: a special clock that records the exact time that somebody starts and finishes work
taking or needing a lot of time

examples.en: a difficult and time-consuming process
examples.zh: 困难而又费时的过程

examples.en: It’s quite time-consuming having to check all the labels individually.
examples.zh: 单独检查所有标签非常耗时。

senses.def: a method for taking photographs in which light is allowed to reach the film for longer than normal
the length of time that is used or available for something

examples.en: We expect to complete the project within a fairly short time frame.
examples.zh: 我们希望能在相当短的时间内完成这项目。

senses.def: respected because it has been used or done for a long time
senses.zh: 古老而受到尊重的；历史悠久的；由来已久的

examples.en: They showed their approval in the time-honoured way (= by clapping, for example).

examples.zh: 带有几分不满的惊奇神情

examples.zh: 他的声音里充满了悲伤。

senses.def: a small amount of a colour, feeling or quality

examples.zh: 感到几分妒忌

examples.en: There was a faint pink tinge to the sky.
examples.zh: 天空略带一点淡淡的粉红色。

senses.def: to feel an emotion strongly

examples.zh: 当她在火边暖手时，她感到手指有些刺痛。

examples.zh: 感到一阵激动

examples.zh: 当飞机沿着跑道飞驰时，他们感到一阵期待。

synonyms.words: ache ▪ burn ▪ sting ▪ tingle ▪ itch ▪ throb

intro.en: These are all words that can be used when part of your body feels painful.
intro.zh: 以上各词均可指身体部位感到疼痛。

items.def: (of part of your body) to feel painful; (of an action) to cause pain:
items.zh: 指（身体部位）感到疼痛、（某一动作）引起疼痛

examples.en: My feet hurt.
examples.zh: 我脚疼。

items.def: to feel a continuous pain that is not severe:
items.zh: 指（持续地）疼痛、隐痛

examples.en: I’m aching all over.
examples.zh: 我周身疼痛。

items.def: (of part of your body) to feel very hot and painful:
items.zh: 指（身体部位）火辣辣地痛、发烫

examples.en: Our eyes were burning from the chemicals in the air.
examples.zh: 空气中弥漫的化学物质熏得我们的眼睛火辣辣地痛。

items.def: to make somebody feel a sharp burning pain or uncomfortable feeling in part of their body; (of part of your body) to feel this pain:

examples.zh: 烟熏得我眼睛痛。

examples.zh: 冷空气冻得她的脸发痛。

items.def: to have an uncomfortable feeling on your skin that makes you want to scratch; to make your skin feel like this:
items.zh: （使）发痒

examples.en: I itch all over.
examples.zh: 我浑身痒。

items.def: (of part of your body) to feel pain as a series of regular beats:

examples.en: His head throbbed painfully.

senses.zh: （尤指可能不起作用地）小修补，小修理

examples.en: He’s in the garage tinkering with his bike.
examples.zh: 他在车库里摆弄他的自行车。

examples.en: The password will prevent others from tinkering with your data.
examples.zh: 密码将防止其他人修改您的数据。

examples.en: The government is merely tinkering at the edges of a much wider problem.
examples.zh: 政府只是在解决一个更广泛问题的边缘。

senses.zh: 古老童谣的第一句话。这通常是在数东西的时候说的，比如数刚吃完的水果里的石头，以便看看孩子长大后会是什么样子。完整版本是：“锅匠、裁缝、士兵、水手、富人、穷人、乞丐、小偷。”

senses.def: a US make of children's toy which consists of a set of small wooden wheels and coloured wooden sticks which fit together to build models. Tinkertoys
senses.zh: 美国制造的儿童玩具，由一组小的木制轮子和彩色的木棍组成，可以一起组装以制作模型。小叮当玩具最早于1914年制造。

examples.en: Water tinkled in the fountains.

examples.zh: 银铃般的笑声

examples.zh: 他晃动玻璃杯，让冰块叮当作响，然后抿了一口。

examples.en: She complained of a permanent tinny taste in her mouth.
examples.zh: 她抱怨嘴里永远有一股腥味。

senses.def: a can of beer
a metal material made from iron and steel and covered with a layer of tin

senses.zh: 无足轻重的；不起作用的

examples.zh: 令人担忧的是，很快任何一个无能的独裁者都将能够获得核武器。

senses.def: a ringing sound
very small in size or amount

examples.en: a tiny baby
examples.zh: 纤弱的婴儿

examples.en: We come from a tiny little town in upstate New York.
examples.zh: 我们来自纽约州北部的一个微不足道的小镇子。

examples.en: Brenda felt a tiny bit bored.
examples.zh: 布伦达感到有点无聊。

examples.en: Only a tiny minority hold such extreme views.
examples.zh: 只有极少数人持这样极端的观点。

examples.en: Most of the land is owned by a tiny fraction of the population.
examples.zh: 大部分土地归一小部分人所有。

examples.en: Even a tiny amount of food may trigger an allergic reaction.
examples.zh: 即使少量的食物也可能引发过敏反应。

examples.en: a tiny village/town/island
examples.zh: 一个小村庄/城镇/岛屿

senses.def: a way of referring to children when somebody wants, or is going to have, a baby
senses.zh: （用于想要或即将有孩子时）小宝宝的脚步声

examples.en: We can't wait to hear the patter of tiny feet.
examples.zh: 我们恨不得早点儿有个小宝宝。

senses.def: a way of referring to children when somebody wants, or is going to have, a baby

examples.en: We can't wait to hear the patter of tiny feet.
examples.zh: 我们恨不得早点儿有个小宝宝。

senses.def: a character in the story A Christmas Carol
senses.zh: 小提姆（Tiny Tim）：查尔斯·狄更斯（Charles Dickens）的故事《圣诞节颂歌》中的角色。他是一个残疾的小男孩，是为Scrooge工作的Bob Cratchit的儿子。蒂姆·提姆（Tiny Tim）在故事的结尾处说出了著名的遗言：“上帝保佑我们，每个人。”

senses.def: a small piece of advice about something practical

examples.en: handy tips for buying a computer
examples.zh: 购买电脑几点有用的提示

examples.en: useful tips on how to save money
examples.zh: 几个省钱的窍门儿

examples.en: Here are my top tips for interview success.
examples.zh: 以下是我面试成功的重要秘诀。

examples.en: The blog offered various beauty tips.
examples.zh: 该博客提供了各种美容秘诀。

examples.en: His money tips and tricks could save a typical family up to £6 000 a year.
examples.zh: 他的理财秘诀和窍门可以为一个普通家庭每年节省高达 6 万英镑。

senses.def: a secret or expert piece of advice about what the result of a competition, etc. is likely to be, especially about which horse is likely to win a race
senses.zh: （尤指有关赛马的）内幕消息，指点

examples.en: a hot tip for the big race
examples.zh: 赛马大赛的最新内幕消息

senses.def: secret information that somebody gives, for example to the police, to warn them about an illegal activity that is going to happen or has happened

examples.en: The man was arrested after an anonymous tip.
examples.zh: 有人匿名举报后，那个人被抓了起来。

senses.def: a small amount of extra money that you give to somebody, for example somebody who serves you in a restaurant

examples.en: to leave a tip
examples.zh: 留小费

examples.en: He gave the waiter a generous tip.
examples.zh: 他给了服务员很多小费。

examples.en: Someone put a dollar in the tip jar.
examples.zh: 有人在小费罐里放了一美元。

senses.def: the thin, pointed end of something

examples.en: the tips of your fingers
examples.zh: 手指尖

examples.en: the tip of your nose
examples.zh: 你的鼻尖

examples.en: the northern tip of the island
examples.zh: 岛的北端

senses.def: a small part that fits on or over the end of something

examples.en: a walking stick with a rubber tip
examples.zh: 带橡皮头的手杖

an untidy place

examples.en: Their flat is a tip!
examples.zh: 他们的寓所简直是个猪窝！

senses.def: if a word or name is on the tip of your tongue
senses.zh: 话在嘴边上（却一时想不起来）

senses.def: only a small part of a much larger problem

examples.zh: 这个数字仅代表冰山一角，因为多达 90% 的病例没有报告。

senses.def: to give somebody an extra amount of money to thank them for something they have done for you as part of their job

examples.en: Americans were always welcome because they tended to tip heavily.
examples.zh: 美国人总是受欢迎，因为他们往往给很多小费。

examples.en: Did you remember to tip the waiter?
examples.zh: 你记得给服务员小费了吗？

examples.en: She tipped the porter a dollar.
examples.zh: 她给了行李工一美元的小费。

senses.group: give extra money 额外付款

examples.en: The boat tipped to one side.
examples.zh: 船向一边倾斜。

examples.en: The seat tips forward to allow passengers into the back.
examples.zh: 座位向前放倒，好让乘客进入车的后部。

examples.en: She tipped her head back and laughed loudly.
examples.zh: 她把头一仰，哈哈大笑起来。

examples.en: He tipped the wheelbarrow on its side.
examples.zh: 他把手推车向一侧倾斜放置。

senses.group: lean/pour/push at an angle 倾斜地倚／倒／推

senses.def: to make something/somebody come out of a container or its/their position by holding or lifting it/them at an angle

examples.en: She tipped the dirty water down the drain.
examples.zh: 她把脏水倒入了下水道。

examples.en: The bus stopped abruptly, nearly tipping me out of my seat.
examples.zh: 公共汽车突然刹车，差点儿把我从座位上甩出去。

senses.group: lean/pour/push at an angle 倾斜地倚／倒／推

examples.en: The goalkeeper just managed to tip the ball over the crossbar.
examples.zh: 守门员刚好把球捅出球门的横梁。

examples.zh: “此处禁止倒垃圾。”

senses.zh: 预言…获胜；事先说…会成功

examples.zh: 人们说这支乐队将位居榜首。

examples.en: The film is being hotly tipped for Oscar success.
examples.zh: 这部电影有望获得奥斯卡奖。

examples.en: The senator has been tipped by many as a future president.
examples.zh: 许多人猜测这位参议员将会继任总统。

examples.en: She has been widely tipped as a future CEO.
examples.zh: 人们普遍认为她将成为未来的首席执行官。

examples.en: The actor is tipped to win an Oscar for his performance.
examples.zh: 这位演员因表演出色而被认为有望获得奥斯卡奖。

senses.zh: （用颜色、物质等）覆盖…的末端，遮盖…的边

examples.en: The wings are tipped with yellow.
examples.zh: 翅膀的尖端呈黄色。

senses.zh: 使天平倾斜；使结果倾向某方；起决定性作用

examples.zh: 在面试中，机敏的表现是一种有利的条件。

examples.zh: 新的证据打破了检方的立场。

examples.zh: 他称得体重刚过 80 公斤。

senses.def: a novel (1857) by the English author Thomas Hughes (1822-96) about a young boy growing up at Rugby School
senses.zh: 汤姆·布朗（Tom Brown）的《学校时代：英国作家托马斯·休斯（1822-96）创作的一部小说（1857），讲述一个小男孩在橄榄球学校长大，休斯本人在那里读书。真正的橄榄球校长托马斯·阿诺德（Thomas Arnold）博士在书中扮演角色，对汤姆有很大的影响，但汤姆的许多经历令人不快，他常常受到一个叫Flashman的残酷大男孩的恶劣对待。

senses.def: (1947-2013) a popular US writer of novels about spies
senses.zh: 汤姆·克兰西（Tom Clancy）：（ 1947-2013年），美国著名小说家，其作品涉及间谍和美国政府的军事行动。许多人以中央情报局的杰克·瑞安（Jack Ryan）为主要角色。克兰西的书籍以其技术细节而著称。其中包括《红色十月的狩猎》（1984年），《爱国者游戏》（1987年），《清除和现在的危险》（1989年），《行政命令》（1996年）和《战备就绪》（2004年）。有几部被拍成电影了。

senses.def: a drink made with gin

senses.def: (1922-2014) a British footballer

senses.def: a well-known novel (1749) by Henry Fielding
senses.zh: 汤姆·琼斯（Tom Jones）：亨利·菲尔丁（Henry Fielding）着名的小说（1749）。它描述了一个叫汤姆·琼斯的年轻人的复杂冒险。汤姆（Tom）被发现是婴儿，由富裕的土地所有者Squire Allworthy抚养长大。他爱上了另一个地主的女儿索菲·西方（Sophie Western），但被不公平地强迫离家出走。汤姆然后在英格兰旅行，经常遇到麻烦，特别是因为他与许多妇女有关系。汤姆天性不错，但在行动上常常不小心。汤姆（Tom）嫁给索菲（Sophie）时，小说中有许多喜剧场面和幸福的结局。这本书已被制作成电影（1963年），阿尔伯特·芬尼（Tom）和汤姆（BBC）电视连续剧（1997年）。

senses.def: (1880-1940) a US actor in more than 400 silent westerns
senses.zh: 汤姆·米克（Tom Mix）：（1880-1940）是美国演员，在400多个无声的西方人中担任演员。他是第一个“牛仔之王”，并且是1920年代好莱坞最富有的演员之一。他穿着白色的衣服和白色的帽子，是一个出色的骑手。他的电影包括《紫色圣人的骑士》（1925年）和《最后的足迹》（1927年）。米克斯（Mix）在1930年代以自己的马戏团游览了该国。他死于车祸。

senses.def: the main character in The Adventures of Tom Sawyer
senses.zh: 汤姆·索耶（Tom Sawyer）：马克·吐温（Mark Twain）的小说《汤姆·索亚历险记》（1876）中的主要角色，该小说特别受儿童欢迎。汤姆是一个活泼聪明的男孩，与密苏里州圣彼得堡的波莉姨妈住在一起。他与朋友哈克贝利·芬恩（Huckleberry Finn）和贝基·撒切尔（Becky Thatcher）在密西西比河上过着令人兴奋的生活和许多冒险活动。

senses.def: (1928-2013) a British writer whose books often used satire
senses.zh: 汤姆·夏普（Tom Sharpe）：（1928-2013）是一位英国作家，他的书中经常使用讽刺。他最著名的书籍包括《 Porterhouse Blue》（1974年）和威尔特（1976年），《 Porterhouse Blue》也被制成了受欢迎的电视连续剧。

senses.def: a tiny boy (no bigger than a thumb

senses.zh: 专注于，全力投入（有一定难度的事）

examples.en: Choose an essay topic that you can really get your teeth into.
examples.zh: 选择一个你可以真正悉心钻研的论文题目。

senses.def: used when you are saying that you want something very much

examples.en: I'd give my eye teeth to own a car like that.
examples.zh: 我巴不得有一辆那样的汽车。

senses.def: to press or hit your teeth together because you feel angry; to feel very angry and upset about something, especially because you cannot get what you want
senses.zh: （尤因不获所求而气得）咬牙切齿

examples.en: He'll be gnashing his teeth when he hears that we lost the contract.
examples.zh: 他要是听说我们丢了这份合同，准会气得咬牙切齿。

examples.en: The news caused great wailing and gnashing of teeth.
examples.zh: 消息一出，引起一片哀嚎，咬牙切齿。

senses.def: to bite your teeth tightly together

examples.en: She gritted her teeth against the pain.
examples.zh: 她咬牙忍痛。

examples.en: ‘Stop it!’ he said through gritted teeth.
examples.zh: “住手！”他咬牙切齿地说。

senses.def: to be determined to continue to do something in a difficult or unpleasant situation

examples.en: It started to rain harder, but we gritted our teeth and carried on.
examples.zh: 雨开始大起来，可我们鼓起勇气继续进行。

senses.def: to like food that contains a lot of sugar
to be powerful and effective
senses.zh: 具有强大威力；有杀伤力

senses.def: used to express anger or surprise

examples.en: Hell’s teeth, I promised I’d be back by two.
examples.zh: 天哪，我答应过两点钟就回来。

senses.def: despite problems, opposition, etc.
senses.zh: 不管，不顾，尽管遇到（困难、反对等）

examples.en: The new policy was adopted in the teeth of fierce criticism.
examples.zh: 新政策尽管受到强烈的批评，但还是被采用了。

senses.def: in the direction that a strong wind is coming from

examples.en: They crossed the bay in the teeth of a howling gale.
examples.zh: 他们顶着呼啸的狂风渡过了海湾。

senses.def: to treat somebody badly or fail to give them help when they need it
senses.zh: 粗暴对待某人；使极度失望

senses.def: something that hurts somebody/something emotionally; a great disappointment
senses.zh: 沉重的打击；重大挫折；极度失望

examples.en: The job losses are a kick in the teeth for the union.
examples.zh: 失业对工会来说是一个沉重打击。

senses.def: to say something that is not true at all
senses.zh: 满口谎言；撒弥天大谎；睁着眼说瞎话

examples.en: The witness was clearly lying through his teeth.
examples.zh: 那证人分明是在睁着眼睛说瞎话。

senses.def: used to say that it is very difficult to make somebody do something

examples.en: It's like pulling teeth trying to get him to talk.
examples.zh: 让他开口说话太难了。

senses.def: old or too old
involving opposition or competition that is violent and without sympathy
senses.zh: 残酷无情；血淋淋；决不宽容

examples.en: nature, red in tooth and claw
examples.zh: 残酷无情的大自然

senses.def: to make somebody feel physically uncomfortable

examples.en: Just the sound of her voice sets my teeth on edge.
examples.zh: 我一听到她的声音就浑身不舒服。

senses.def: having many weapons
to show your teeth in an aggressive and threatening

examples.en: The dog bared its teeth and growled.
examples.zh: 那条狗龇牙咧嘴地低吼。

items.idm: by the skin of your teeth

senses.def: if you do something by the skin of your teeth

examples.en: He escaped defeat by the skin of his teeth.
examples.zh: 他勉强逃脱了失败。

senses.def: to do something that gives you your first experience of a particular type of work
senses.zh: 从…中获得初步经验；初次涉足

examples.en: She cut her teeth on local radio.
examples.zh: 她在当地广播电台崭露头角。

senses.def: to grow a new tooth

items.idm: an eye for an eye (and a tooth for a tooth)

senses.def: used to say that you should punish somebody by doing to them what they have done to you or to somebody else

examples.en: They advocate a justice system that works on the principle of an eye for an eye.
examples.zh: 他们主张建立一个以眼还眼原则运作的司法系统。

senses.def: to fight in a very determined way for what you want
senses.zh: 坚决斗争；全力以赴地斗争

examples.en: The residents are fighting tooth and nail to stop the new development.
examples.zh: 居民为制止新的房地产开发计划正在全力以赴进行斗争。

examples.en: She fought tooth and nail to keep custody of the children.
examples.zh: 她竭尽全力争取孩子的监护权。

examples.zh: 我一听到她的声音就浑身不舒服。

senses.def: a pain in your teeth or in one tooth

examples.en: I've got toothache.
examples.zh: 我牙疼。

examples.en: I've got a toothache.
examples.zh: 我牙疼。

senses.def: a small brush for cleaning your teeth
a short moustache
having teeth

examples.en: a toothed whale
examples.zh: 齿鲸

examples.en: The motor was driven by a toothed belt.
examples.zh: 电机由齿形带驱动。

senses.def: having the type of teeth mentioned

examples.en: a gap-toothed smile
examples.zh: 露出稀疏牙齿的微笑

senses.def: having no teeth

examples.en: a toothless old man
examples.zh: 没牙的老头儿

examples.en: She gave us a toothless grin.
examples.zh: 她张开没牙的嘴巴对我们笑了笑。

senses.def: having no power or authority
senses.zh: 人微言轻的；没有权威的；不起作用的

examples.en: The local council has often been criticized for being a toothless institution.
examples.zh: 地方议会经常被批评为一个没有权力的机构。

senses.def: a substance that you put on a brush and use to clean your teeth

examples.en: a tube of toothpaste
examples.zh: 一管牙膏

examples.en: fluoride toothpastes
examples.zh: 含氟牙膏

senses.def: a short pointed piece of wood or plastic used for removing bits of food from between the teeth
tasting good
a toothy
to walk, drive, etc. somewhere without hurrying
senses.zh: 信步；闲逛；溜达；不慌不忙地开车

senses.def: to produce a series of notes by blowing into a musical instrument
senses.zh: 连续吹（乐器）；发出一连串的嘟嘟声

senses.def: a US sweet bar that tastes of chocolate and is very chewy
senses.zh: 一种美国甜酒吧，尝起来有巧克力的味道，非常有嚼劲。它是由定居纽约的奥地利人Leo Hirshfield于1896年创建的，并以他的女儿的名字命名。第二次世界大战期间，Tootsie Rolls被包括在美国士兵的食品盒中。

senses.def: toes or feet
the highest part or point of something

examples.en: She was standing at the top of the stairs.
examples.zh: 她站在楼梯的顶端。

examples.en: The title is right at the top of the page.
examples.zh: 标题就在页面的顶端。

examples.en: Write your name at the top.
examples.zh: 把你的姓名写在上端。

examples.en: He filled my glass to the top.
examples.zh: 他把我的杯子斟得满满的。

examples.en: We climbed to the very top of the hill.
examples.zh: 我们爬到了山的最高点。

examples.en: Snow was falling on the mountain tops.
examples.zh: 山顶上正在下雪。

examples.en: He was completely bald on the top of his head.
examples.zh: 他的头顶完全秃了。

examples.en: I was out of breath when I reached the top.
examples.zh: 我到山顶时上气不接下气。

examples.en: the top of the milk (= the cream that rises to the top of a bottle of milk)
examples.zh: 牛奶表面的奶皮

examples.en: The wind was blowing in the tops of the trees.
examples.zh: 风儿吹拂着树梢。

senses.def: the upper flat surface of something

examples.en: Can you polish the top of the table?
examples.zh: 请把桌面擦亮好吗？

senses.def: a piece of clothing worn on the upper part of the body

examples.en: I need a top to go with this skirt.
examples.zh: 我需要一件上衣来配这条裙子。

examples.en: a tracksuit/bikini/pyjama top
examples.zh: 运动服上衣；比基尼泳装／睡衣的上部

examples.en: He was wearing a blue hooded top.
examples.zh: 他穿着一件蓝色连帽上衣。

examples.en: She wore a pink skirt with a matching top.
examples.zh: 她身穿一条粉色裙子和一件与之相配的上衣。

senses.def: a thing that you put on the end of something to close it

examples.en: Where's the top of this pen?
examples.zh: 这支笔的笔帽在哪儿？

examples.en: a bottle with a screw top
examples.zh: 带螺旋盖儿的瓶子

senses.def: the highest or most important rank or position
senses.zh: 最高的级别；最重要的职位

examples.en: They finished the season at the top of the league.
examples.zh: 他们打完这个赛季之后积分高居联赛的榜首。

examples.en: He's at the top of his profession.
examples.zh: 他正处于事业的巅峰。

examples.en: We have a lot of things to do, but packing is at the top of the list.
examples.zh: 我们有许多事情要做，但首先是打点行装。

examples.en: The company needs to make a change at the top.
examples.zh: 公司需要对高层进行调整。

examples.en: She is determined to make it to the top (= achieve fame or success).
examples.zh: 她决心要出人头地。

examples.en: He worked his way to the top in just a few short years.
examples.zh: 他在短短几年内就登上了顶峰。

examples.en: The album shot straight to the top of the charts.
examples.zh: 这张专辑直接登上了排行榜的榜首。

examples.en: The issue has recently risen to the top of the agenda.
examples.zh: 这个问题最近已经上升到议程的首位。

examples.en: I would not have gone into boxing if I didn't think I could reach the top.
examples.zh: 要不是想着拿冠军，我当初就不练拳击了。

examples.en: This decision came from the top.
examples.zh: 这个决定是由最高领导作出的。

senses.def: the end of a street, table, etc. that is furthest away from you or from where you usually come to it

examples.en: I'll meet you at the top of Thorpe Street.
examples.zh: 我会和你在索普大街的尽头碰面。

senses.def: the leaves of a plant that is grown mainly for its root

examples.en: Remove the green tops from the carrots.
examples.zh: 去掉胡萝卜的绿叶。

senses.group: leaves of plant 植物的叶子

senses.def: used after an amount of money, time, etc. to show that it is the highest, longest, etc. possible
senses.zh: （用于款额等后）最高，至多；（用于时间等后）最长，最久

examples.en: It couldn't have cost more than £50, tops.
examples.zh: 这东西的价格最高不会超过 50 英镑。

examples.en: It'll take a couple of hours, tops.
examples.zh: 最多不超过几个小时。

senses.group: amount of money/time 金钱；时间

senses.def: a person or thing of the best quality
senses.zh: 最优秀的人；最好的东西；精华

examples.en: Among sports superstars she’s (the) tops.
examples.zh: 她在超级体育明星中独占鳌头。

examples.en: In the survey the Brits come out tops for humour.
examples.zh: 这项调查显示，英国人的幽默是首屈一指的。

senses.def: a child’s toy that turns round on a point when it is moved very quickly by hand or by a string

examples.en: She was so confused—her mind was spinning like a top.
examples.zh: 她如坠五里雾中，被搞得晕头转向。

senses.def: high up/low down in the structure of an organization or a society
senses.zh: 在（机构或社会的）顶层／底层

examples.en: These workers are at the bottom of the economic heap.
examples.zh: 这些工人处在经济结构的底层。

senses.def: in the highest position or rank in a profession or career
senses.zh: （在行业、事业中）高居首位，处于顶峰

senses.def: as loudly as possible
senses.zh: 高声地；放声地；扯着喉咙地

examples.en: She was screaming at the top of her voice.
examples.zh: 她在声嘶力竭地尖叫。

examples.en: I was shouting at the top of my voice but she couldn't hear me.
examples.zh: 我喊的声音已经是最大了，可她还是听不见。

senses.def: to get very angry
in the least/most important position in a group of people or things
senses.zh: 处于无足轻重的／举足轻重的地位

examples.en: It’s been 20 years since a British player was top of the pile.
examples.zh: 自从英国球员成为顶尖球员以来，已有 20 年了。

examples.en: The government is doing little to help those at the bottom of the social pile.
examples.zh: 政府几乎没有采取任何措施来帮助那些处于社会底层的人。

senses.def: to win a contest or an argument
senses.zh: （在比赛或辩论中）名列前茅，先拔头筹

examples.en: In most boardroom disputes he tends to come out on top.
examples.zh: 在大多数董事会议的辩论中，他往往占据上风。

senses.def: going to every part of a place in a very careful way

examples.en: We cleaned the house from top to bottom.
examples.zh: 我们把房子彻底打扫了一遍。

senses.def: completely; all over
senses.zh: 从头到脚；浑身上下；全部

examples.en: She was dressed in green from top to toe.
examples.zh: 她从头到脚穿了一身绿。

senses.def: to be too much for somebody to manage or deal with

examples.en: All this extra work is getting on top of him.
examples.zh: 这么多的额外工作快使他吃不消了。

senses.def: to manage to control or deal with something

examples.en: How will I ever get on top of all this work?
examples.zh: 我究竟怎样才处理得了这么多的工作？

senses.def: just guessing or using your memory, without taking time to think carefully or check the facts
senses.zh: 单凭猜测（或记忆）；信口地；不假思索地

examples.en: I can't remember the name off the top of my head, but I can look it up for you.
examples.zh: 我一时想不起这个名字，不过我可以给你查一查。

senses.def: on the highest point or surface

examples.en: a cake with cream on top
examples.zh: 上面浇有奶油的蛋糕

examples.en: Stand on top and look down.
examples.zh: 站在顶上俯视。

senses.def: in a leading position or in control
senses.zh: 处于领先地位；控制局面

examples.en: She remained on top for the rest of the match.
examples.zh: 在比赛的余下部分她一直领先。

senses.def: in addition

examples.en: Look, here's 30 dollars, and I'll buy you lunch on top.
examples.zh: 你看，这是给你的 30 美元，另外我还会给你买午餐。

senses.def: on, over or covering something/somebody

examples.en: Books were piled on top of one another.
examples.zh: 书一本一本地摞在一起。

examples.en: There was a vase on top of the bookcase.
examples.zh: 书架顶上有个花瓶。

examples.en: Many people were crushed when the building collapsed on top of them.
examples.zh: 那座楼房倒塌时砸伤了下面许多人。

senses.def: in addition to something

examples.en: He gets commission on top of his salary.
examples.zh: 他除了薪金之外还拿佣金。

examples.en: On top of everything else, my car's been stolen.
examples.zh: 我所有的东西都被盗，连汽车也给偷走了。

senses.def: very close to something/somebody

examples.en: We were all living on top of each other in that tiny apartment.
examples.zh: 我们都挤着住在那套小小的公寓里。

senses.def: in control of a situation

examples.en: Do you think he's really on top of his job?
examples.zh: 你认为他真的能做好他的工作吗？

examples.en: Work tends to pile up if I don’t keep on top of it.
examples.zh: 如果我不坚持下去，工作就会堆积如山。

senses.def: very happy or proud
senses.zh: 欢天喜地；心满意足；非常自豪

senses.def: done with too much acting, emotion or effort

examples.en: His performance is completely over the top.
examples.zh: 他的表演完全过火了。

examples.en: an over-the-top reaction
examples.zh: 过头的反应

senses.def: to go back to the beginning of a song, piece of music, etc. and repeat it

examples.en: OK, everybody, let's take it from the top.
examples.zh: 好，咱们大家从头再唱一遍。

senses.def: with little or no hair on the head

examples.en: He's starting to get a little thin on top (= he's losing his hair).
examples.zh: 他开始有点谢顶了。

examples.en: He's going bald on top.
examples.zh: 他谢顶了。

senses.def: used to talk about a person’s intelligence

examples.en: He hasn't got much up top (= he isn't very intelligent).
examples.zh: 他没有多少脑子。

examples.en: It’s what’s up top (= how intelligent you are) that matters.
examples.zh: 重要的是你有多聪明。

senses.def: highest in position

examples.en: He lives on the top floor.
examples.zh: 他住在顶层。

examples.en: She kept her passport in the top drawer.
examples.zh: 她把护照存放在最上层抽屉里。

examples.en: The score is in the top left-hand corner of the screen.
examples.zh: 分数位于屏幕的左上角。

senses.def: highest in rank, degree or importance

examples.en: He's one of the top players in the country.
examples.zh: 他是国内最优秀的运动员之一。

examples.en: She got the top job.
examples.zh: 她得到了那个最高职位。

examples.en: top officials/executives/aides
examples.zh: 高层官员／主管／助手

examples.en: He finished top in the exam.
examples.zh: 他考试得了第一名。

examples.en: She was top in English.
examples.zh: 她的英语拔尖。

examples.en: He was top of the class in geography.
examples.zh: 他的地理成绩在班上名列前茅。

examples.en: She got top marks for her essay.
examples.zh: 她的论文得了最高分。

examples.en: They're top of the league.
examples.zh: 他们是联赛的领头羊。

examples.en: The club can claim top spot in the league with a victory.
examples.zh: 该俱乐部赢一场就能得到联赛冠军。

examples.en: The athletes are all on top form (= performing their best).
examples.zh: 运动员都处于最佳竞技状态。

examples.en: He was City's top scorer last season.
examples.zh: 他是上赛季城队的头号射手。

examples.en: Welfare reform is a top priority for the government.
