examples.zh: 他们买了一块40英亩的土地用于开发。

senses.def: a short piece of writing, especially on a religious, moral or political subject, that is intended to influence people’s ideas
senses.zh: （尤指宣扬宗教、伦理或政治的）短文，传单，小册子

examples.en: feminist tracts
examples.zh: 女权主义小册子

senses.def: a modern house built on an area of land where a lot of other similar houses have also been built
the quality of being easy to deal with or control
easy to deal with or control

examples.en: This approach helps to make the issues more tractable.
examples.zh: 这种方法有助于使问题更容易处理。

senses.def: the action of pulling something along a surface; the power that is used for doing this
a way of treating a broken bone in your body that involves using special equipment to pull the bone gradually back into its correct place
senses.zh: 牵引（使体内断骨复位的疗法）

examples.en: He spent six weeks in traction after he broke his leg.
examples.zh: 他腿部骨折后做了六个星期的牵引治疗。

senses.def: the force that stops something, for example the wheels of a vehicle, from sliding on the ground
senses.zh: （车轮等对地面的）附着摩擦力

senses.def: the extent to which an idea, a product, etc. becomes popular or gains support
senses.zh: 受欢迎（或得到支持）的程度

examples.en: The president's message is gaining traction among undecided voters.
examples.zh: 总统的观点在犹豫不决的选民中越来越受欢迎。

senses.def: a vehicle, driven by steam
senses.zh: （旧时用以拖重物的）牵引机车，牵引车

senses.def: a powerful vehicle with two large and two smaller wheels, used especially for pulling farm machines

examples.en: a farmer on his tractor
examples.zh: 拖拉机上的农夫

examples.en: the sound of a tractor ploughing in the field nearby
examples.zh: 附近田里拖拉机作业的声音

senses.def: the front part of a tractor-trailer
senses.zh: （牵引式挂车的）牵引车，拖车头

senses.def: a large truck with two sections, one in front where the driver sits and one behind for carrying goods. The sections are connected by a flexible joint
senses.zh: 牵引式挂车；铰接式卡车；载重拖车

senses.def: a first name for boys or girls
senses.zh: 特雷西，崔西（男子或女子名）

senses.def: traditional jazz in the style of the 1920s, with free playing (= improvisation
senses.zh: 传统爵士乐（有 20 世纪 20 年代的风格、固定的节奏及和声，可即兴发挥）

senses.def: traditional jazz in the style of the 1920s, with free playing (= improvisation
senses.zh: 传统爵士乐（有 20 世纪 20 年代的风格、固定的节奏及和声，可即兴发挥）

senses.def: that you can easily buy and sell or exchange for money or goods

examples.en: tradable assets
examples.zh: 可交易资产

examples.en: tradable goods
examples.zh: 可贸易商品

senses.def: the activity of buying and selling or of exchanging goods or services between people or countries

examples.en: international/foreign/global/world trade
examples.zh: 国际／对外／全球／世界贸易

examples.en: the international trade in oil
examples.zh: 国际石油贸易

examples.en: the illegal trade in wildlife
examples.zh: 野生动物非法贸易

examples.en: the arms/drugs trade
examples.zh: 军火／毒品交易

examples.en: The Senate has approved a trade agreement with Latin American nations.
examples.zh: 参议院批准了一项与拉美国家的贸易协议。

examples.en: Trade between the two countries has increased.
examples.zh: 两国之间的贸易增长了。

examples.en: an international trade barrier to GM food
examples.zh: 转基因食品的国际贸易壁垒

examples.en: Market prices and trade liberalization have increased prices.
examples.zh: 市场价格和贸易自由化提高了价格。

examples.en: trade negotiations/talks
examples.zh: 贸易谈判/会谈

examples.en: Public support for the current trade policy is declining.
examples.zh: 公众对当前贸易政策的支持正在下降。

examples.en: a bilateral trade deal
examples.zh: 双边贸易协议

senses.def: a particular type of business

examples.en: the building/food/tourist trade
examples.zh: 建筑／食品／旅游业

examples.en: He works in the retail trade (= selling goods in shops/stores).
examples.zh: 他做零售工作。

examples.en: the fur/book trade
examples.zh: 毛皮/书籍贸易

senses.def: a particular area of business and the people or companies that are connected with it

examples.en: They offer discounts to the trade (= to people who are working in the same business).
examples.zh: 他们对同行业的人给予折扣。

examples.en: a trade magazine/journal
examples.zh: 行业杂志／期刊

examples.en: Their company is respected and well known in the trade.
examples.zh: 他们的公司在业内受到尊重并享有盛誉。

examples.en: It's a trade association that represents all segments of the dairy industry.
examples.zh: 这是一个代表乳制品行业所有部门的贸易协会。

examples.en: The trade has/have called for fairer regulation.
examples.zh: 该行业已经呼吁进行更公平的监管。

senses.def: the amount of goods or services that you sell

examples.en: Trade was very good last month.
examples.zh: 上月的交易量很大。

examples.en: All around the pyramids, salespeople were doing a roaring trade in souvenirs.
examples.zh: 在金字塔周围，商贩们红红火火地做着纪念品生意。

senses.def: a job, especially one that involves working with your hands and that requires special training and skills

examples.en: He was a carpenter by trade.
examples.zh: 他以木工为业。

examples.en: When she leaves school, she wants to learn a trade.
examples.zh: 她毕业后想学一门手艺。

examples.en: She was surrounded by the tools of her trade (= everything she needs to do her job).
examples.zh: 她周围都是她干活用的工具。

senses.def: to sell a lot of something very quickly
senses.zh: 生意兴隆；售出大量（某物）

examples.en: The ice-cream vendors were doing a roaring trade.
examples.zh: 冰淇淋摊贩的生意非常红火。

senses.def: a person who can do many different types of work, but who perhaps does not do them very well
to look for customers, passengers, etc. in order to do business

examples.en: taxis plying for trade outside the theatre
examples.zh: 出租车在剧院外进行交易

senses.def: to do your work or business

examples.en: This is the restaurant where he plied his trade as a cook.
examples.zh: 这是他做厨师的那家餐厅。

examples.en: Drug dealers openly plied their trade in front of children.
examples.zh: 毒贩在儿童面前公开进行交易。

senses.def: the clever ways of doing things, known and used by people who do a particular job or activity
senses.zh: （某一行业或活动的）绝招，绝活，门道，生意经

senses.def: to buy and sell things
senses.zh: 做买卖；做生意；从事贸易

examples.en: The firm openly traded in arms.
examples.zh: 这家公司公开买卖军火。

examples.en: Early explorers traded directly with the Indians.
examples.zh: 早期的探险者与印第安人直接进行交易。

examples.en: Her family traded in textiles with the Far East.
examples.zh: 她的家人与远东进行纺织品贸易。

examples.en: trading partners (= countries that you trade with)
examples.zh: 贸易伙伴

examples.en: Our products are now traded worldwide.
examples.zh: 我们的产品现在销往世界各地。

examples.en: In 1900, more than 60% of cotton goods traded internationally were made in Lancashire.
examples.zh: 1900 年，国际贸易中超过 60% 的棉制品是在兰开夏郡生产的。

examples.en: The turnover of agricultural goods traded with the US amounted to $45 million last year.
examples.zh: 去年与美国的农产品贸易额达4500万美元。

senses.def: to exist and operate as a business or company

examples.en: The firm has now ceased trading.
examples.zh: 这家商行现已停业。

examples.en: They traded as ‘Walker and Son’.
examples.zh: 他们以“沃克父子公司”之名营业。

senses.def: to be bought and sold, or to buy and sell something, on a stock exchange

examples.en: Shares were trading at under half their usual value.
examples.zh: 那些股票以低于通常价值的一半买卖。

examples.en: Shares in the company haven't been publicly traded since 1998.
examples.zh: 该公司的股票自 1998 年以来就没有公开交易过。

senses.def: to exchange something that you have for something that somebody else has

examples.en: to trade secrets/insults/jokes
examples.zh: 互换秘密；对骂；互说笑话

examples.en: Cabinet colleagues traded insults over the future of the pound.
examples.zh: 内阁同僚为英镑的未来互相谩骂。

examples.en: She traded her posters for his CD.
examples.zh: 她以海报换取他的光盘。

examples.en: I wouldn't mind trading places with her for a day.
examples.zh: 我不介意和她掉换一天位置。

senses.def: to sell a lot of something very quickly
senses.zh: 生意兴隆；售出大量（某物）

examples.en: The ice-cream vendors were doing a roaring trade.
examples.zh: 冰淇淋摊贩的生意非常红火。

senses.def: a person who can do many different types of work, but who perhaps does not do them very well
to look for customers, passengers, etc. in order to do business

examples.en: taxis plying for trade outside the theatre
examples.zh: 出租车在剧院外进行交易

senses.def: to do your work or business

examples.en: This is the restaurant where he plied his trade as a cook.
examples.zh: 这是他做厨师的那家餐厅。

examples.en: Drug dealers openly plied their trade in front of children.
examples.zh: 毒贩在儿童面前公开进行交易。

senses.def: the clever ways of doing things, known and used by people who do a particular job or activity
senses.zh: （某一行业或活动的）绝招，绝活，门道，生意经

intro.en: These are all words for the jobs that somebody does in return for payment, especially over a long period of time.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指有报酬的工作，尤指长期从事的职业。

items.def: the job that somebody does, especially in order to earn money:
items.zh: 指工作、职业

examples.en: It’s very difficult to find work at the moment.
examples.zh: 目前很难找到工作。

items.def: (rather formal) work, especially when it is done to earn money; the state of being employed or the situation in which people have work:
items.zh: 指工作、职业、受雇、就业

examples.en: Only half the people here are in paid employment.
examples.zh: 这儿只有一半的人有拿工资的工作。

items.def: the job or series of jobs that somebody has in a particular area of work, usually involving more responsibility as time passes:
items.zh: 指生涯、职业

examples.en: He had a very distinguished career in the Foreign Office.
examples.zh: 他在外交部有过一段光辉的事业。

items.def: a type of job that needs special training or skill, especially one that needs a high level of education:
items.zh: 指需要专门技能（尤其是较高教育水平）的职业、专业

examples.en: He hopes to enter the medical profession.
examples.zh: 他希望能从事医务工作。

items.def: (rather formal) a job or profession:
items.zh: 指工作、职业

examples.en: Please state your name, age, and occupation.
examples.zh: 请写明姓名、年龄和职业。

items.def: a job, especially one that involves working with your hands and requires special training and skills:
items.zh: 指行业，尤指手工职业、手艺、行当

examples.en: Carpentry is a highly skilled trade.
examples.zh: 木工是需要纯熟技巧的职业。

senses.def: to buy goods or shop at a particular store
the difference in value between imports and exports
a situation in which the value of a country’s imports is greater than the value of its exports
to spend less money on things than you used to

examples.en: Shoppers are trading down and looking for bargains.
examples.zh: 到商店买东西的人都降低消费，寻找减价货。

senses.def: an event at which many different companies show and sell their products
senses.zh: 商品展销会；商品交易会

senses.def: to give something used as part of the payment for something new
senses.zh: 以旧物折价换新物；折价贴换

examples.en: He traded in his old car for a new Mercedes.
examples.zh: 他把旧汽车折价添钱买了辆新奔驰。

senses.def: a method of buying something by giving a used item as part of the payment for a new one; the used item itself
senses.zh: 折旧贴换交易；以旧折价换新；折价旧物

examples.en: the trade-in value of a car
examples.zh: 一辆汽车的以旧换新抵价

examples.en: Do you have a trade-in?
examples.zh: 你有折价的旧物品吗？

senses.def: the name given to a product by the company that produces it
a name that is taken and used by a company for business purposes

examples.en: The company uses the trade name Marubeni in the US.
examples.zh: 公司在美国使用“丸红”商号。

senses.def: to balance two things or situations that are opposed to each other

examples.en: They were attempting to trade off inflation against unemployment.
examples.zh: 他们正力求在通货膨胀和失业之间进行协调。

senses.def: the act of balancing two things that are opposed to each other
senses.zh: （在相互对立的两者间的）权衡，协调

examples.en: a trade-off between increased production and a reduction in quality
examples.zh: 对产量增加和质量下降的权衡

examples.en: There is a trade-off between the benefits of the drug and the risk of side effects.
examples.zh: 在这种药的疗效和副作用之间有个权衡利弊的问题。

senses.def: to use something to your own advantage, especially in an unfair way

examples.en: They trade on people's insecurity to sell them insurance.
examples.zh: 他们利用人们的不安全感向他们推销保险。

senses.def: (in the past) the route that people buying and selling goods used to take across land or sea
a school where students go to learn a trade
a secret piece of information that is known only by the people at a particular company

examples.en: to give away trade secrets
examples.zh: 泄露商业秘密

examples.en: The recipe for their drink is a closely guarded trade secret.
examples.zh: 他们饮料的配方是严格保守的商业秘密。

examples.en: She was dismissed for revealing trade secrets.
examples.zh: 她因泄露商业机密被解雇。

senses.def: an event at which many different companies show and sell their products
senses.zh: 商品展销会；商品交易会

examples.en: Opening on June 11, the trade show will feature a wide range of goods.
examples.zh: 这次交易会于6月11日开幕，展出的商品种类繁多。

senses.def: a situation in which the value of a country’s exports is greater than the value of its imports
an organization of workers, usually in a particular industry, that exists to protect their interests, improve conditions of work, etc.
the principles and practices of trade unions

examples.en: the history of trade unionism
examples.zh: 工会主义的历史

senses.def: a member of a trade union
to sell something in order to buy something more expensive
senses.zh: 卖次买好；（卖掉原有的以便）买更贵的东西

examples.en: We're going to trade up to a larger house.
examples.zh: 我们打算卖掉房子，再买一座大点的。

senses.def: to give something you have used as part of the payment for something more expensive
senses.zh: 以旧物折价添钱买较贵的东西；折价贴换

senses.def: a sale of an object in order to buy something similar but better and more expensive
senses.zh: 卖次买好；以次换好的买卖

senses.def: strong winds that blow all the time towards the equator
senses.zh: 信风，贸易风（稳定吹向赤道再向西）

examples.en: The trade winds originate in the South Pacific.
examples.zh: 信风源自南太平洋。

senses.def: a name, symbol or design that a company uses for its products and that cannot be used by anyone else

examples.en: ‘Big Mac’ is McDonald's best-known trademark.
examples.zh: “巨无霸”是麦当劳最著名的商标。

senses.def: a special way of behaving or dressing that is typical of somebody and that makes them easily recognized
senses.zh: （人的行为或衣着的）特征，标记

examples.en: Attention to detail is Anthea’s trademark.
examples.zh: 注重细节是安西娅的特点。

examples.en: The artist uses her trademark swirls of paint to good effect in her latest exhibition.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家在她最新的展览中使用了她标志性的漩涡颜料，取得了良好的效果。

senses.def: to register something as a trademark

examples.en: They have trademarked the name in the US and the UK.
examples.zh: 他们已在美国和英国将这个名称注册为商标。

senses.def: a person who buys and sells things as a job

examples.en: small/independent/local traders
examples.zh: 小的／独立的／当地的商人

examples.en: bond/currency traders
examples.zh: 债券／货币交易人

examples.en: Being a sole trader (= a person who runs a business on their own) is a risky venture.
examples.zh: 当独资经营者是有风险的。

senses.def: any of over 200 shops in the US that sell good quality and unusual food, much of which is imported from other countries. The first shop opened in Los Angeles
senses.zh: 乔商贸（Trader Joe's）：美国200多家商店中的任何一家出售优质食品和不寻常食品，其中大部分是从其他国家/地区进口的。1967年在洛杉矶开设了第一家商店。

senses.def: a person whose job involves going to houses to sell or deliver goods

examples.en: All deliveries should be made to the tradesmen's entrance.
examples.zh: 送货都必须到送货员专用入口。

examples.en: The Market Hall attracted tradesmen and stall holders from the surrounding district.
examples.zh: 市场大厅吸引了周边地区的商人和摊主。

senses.def: a person who sells goods, especially in a shop
senses.zh: （尤指在商店里售货的）商人；店主

senses.def: a person who works with their hands in a job that involves training and special skills, for example a carpenter

examples.en: This is a job for a skilled tradesman.
examples.zh: 这是娴熟的工匠才能干的活。

senses.def: people whose job involves selling goods or services, especially people who own a shop
people whose job involves training and special skills, for example carpenters
a woman who sells goods, especially in a shop
senses.zh: （尤指在商店里售货的）女商人；女店主

senses.def: a woman who works with her hands in a job that involves training and special skills, for example a carpenter

examples.en: Many women feel safer with a tradeswoman working in their homes.
examples.zh: 许多女性觉得有女商人在家工作更安全。

senses.def: a woman whose job involves going to houses to sell or deliver goods
senses.zh: 女上门推销商；女送货员

senses.def: one of a set of cards, often showing sports players or other famous people on them, that children collect and exchange with one another
senses.zh: 集换式卡牌（儿童收集并相互交换的运动员或明星等卡牌）

senses.def: an area of land, often on the edge of a city or town, where there are a number of businesses and small factories
an area in a stock exchange
senses.zh: （证券交易所或银行的）交易大厅

senses.def: a small place in an area that is a long way from any town, used as a centre for buying and selling goods (especially in North America in the past)
senses.zh: （尤指北美旧时偏远地区的）贸易站

senses.def: a belief, custom or way of doing something that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people; a set of these beliefs or customs
senses.zh: 传统；传统的信仰（或风俗）

examples.en: religious/cultural/ancient traditions
examples.zh: 宗教／文化／古老传统

examples.en: This region is steeped in tradition.
examples.zh: 这个地区有着深厚的传统。

examples.en: The company has a long tradition of fine design.
examples.zh: 这家公司的优秀设计历史悠久。

examples.en: The company has continued its tradition of innovation.
examples.zh: 公司延续了创新的传统。

examples.en: The British are said to love tradition (= to want to do things in the way they have always been done).
examples.zh: 据说英国人热爱传统。

examples.en: They broke with tradition (= did things differently) and got married quietly.
examples.zh: 他们打破传统，毫不声张地结了婚。

examples.en: By tradition, children play tricks on 1 April.
examples.zh: 按照传统风俗，儿童在 4 月 1 日捣乱戏弄别人。

examples.en: According to tradition, a tree grew on this spot.
examples.zh: 传说这里以前长着一棵树。

examples.en: There's a tradition in our family that we have a party on New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 我们家有个传统，新年除夕要办家庭聚会。

examples.en: He's a politician in the tradition of (= similar in style to) Kennedy.
examples.zh: 他是位具有肯尼迪风格的从政者。

examples.en: a native culture expressed almost wholly through an oral tradition (= that is only spoken and not written down)
examples.zh: 几乎完全通过口头传统表达的本土文化（=仅口头而非书面记录）

examples.en: He is motivated by a family tradition of charity and good works.
examples.zh: 他受到慈善和行善的家庭传统的激励。

examples.en: his country's rich folk traditions
examples.zh: 他的国家丰富的民间传统

examples.en: His work has earned him a central place in the African American literary tradition.
examples.zh: 他的作品为他赢得了非裔美国文学传统的中心地位。

senses.def: being part of the beliefs, customs or way of life of a particular group of people, that have not changed for a long time

examples.en: traditional dress/music/art/culture/dance
examples.zh: 传统服装／音乐／艺术／文化／舞蹈

examples.en: It's traditional in America to eat turkey on Thanksgiving Day.
examples.zh: 感恩节时吃火鸡是美国的传统。

examples.en: traditional values/practices/beliefs
examples.zh: 传统价值观/实践/信仰

examples.en: Acupuncture has long been a part of traditional Chinese medicine.
examples.zh: 针法长期以来一直是传统中医的一部分。

examples.en: Janet makes cheese by traditional methods.
examples.zh: 珍妮特用传统方法制作奶酪。

examples.en: Cinema poses a threat to traditional art forms.
examples.zh: 电影对传统艺术形式构成了威胁。

senses.def: following older methods and ideas rather than modern or different ones

examples.en: a traditional method/way of doing something
examples.zh: 传统的做事方法／方式

examples.en: traditional methods of teaching
examples.zh: 传统的教学方法

examples.en: a traditional approach/view
examples.zh: 传统的方法/观点

examples.en: Their marriage is very traditional.
examples.zh: 他们的婚姻十分守旧。

examples.en: the traditional female role of homemaker
examples.zh: 家庭主妇的传统女性角色

examples.en: He was raised in a traditional patriarchal family.
examples.zh: 他在一个传统的父权家庭中长大。

senses.def: medical treatment that is based on the ancient beliefs and practices from a particular culture

examples.en: a key ingredient in traditional medicine
examples.zh: 传统医学的关键成分

examples.en: Turmeric has been used as a traditional medicine in much of Asia for thousands of years.
examples.zh: 姜黄在亚洲大部分地区被用作传统药物已有数千年的历史。

senses.def: the belief that customs and traditions are more important for a society than modern ideas
senses.zh: 传统主义（认为传统习俗比现代思想对社会更重要）

senses.def: a person who prefers tradition to modern ideas or ways of doing things

examples.en: He was known for his traditionalist views.
examples.zh: 他以其传统主义观点而闻名。

senses.def: preferring tradition to modern ideas or ways of doing things

examples.en: traditionalist Catholics/Protestants
examples.zh: 传统主义天主教徒/新教徒

examples.en: traditionalist views/approaches
examples.zh: 传统主义观点/方法

senses.def: according to the beliefs, customs or way of life of a particular group of people, that have not changed for a long time

examples.en: The festival is traditionally held in May.
examples.zh: 这一节庆活动传统上在五月举行。

examples.en: Housework has traditionally been regarded as women's work.
examples.zh: 家务传统上被视为妇女的事。

examples.en: Garlands of flowers have always been traditionally associated with May festivities.
examples.zh: 传统上，花环一直与五月的庆祝活动联系在一起。

examples.en: Traditionally, markets are held in the open air.
examples.zh: 按照传统，集市设在露天。

senses.def: by following older or accepted methods and ideas rather than modern or different ones

examples.en: The study compared the results of mature and traditionally qualified students.
examples.zh: 该研究比较了成熟学生和传统合格学生的结果。

senses.def: to say things about somebody that are unpleasant or not true
a large square in central London. It was created in 1830-41 and named in honour of Lord Nelson's
senses.zh: 特拉法尔加广场英国伦敦市中心的大广场，建于1830年至1841年间，为纪念纳尔逊勋爵在特拉法尔加战役中的胜利而命名。广场的中央耸立着纳尔逊纪念柱，广场的一侧是国家美术馆。该广场是伦敦最热门的旅游景点之一，也是经常举行政治抗议和其他游行示威的地方。每年都有大批人聚集在这里欢庆新年。

senses.def: the vehicles that are on a road at a particular time

examples.en: There's always a lot of traffic at this time of day.
examples.zh: 每天这个时候总是有很多来往车辆。

examples.en: There are currently delays of 40 minutes due to heavy traffic.
examples.zh: 目前由于交通拥堵，延误了 40 分钟。

examples.en: She left home early to avoid the rush-hour traffic.
examples.zh: 她很早就离开家，以避免高峰时段的交通。

examples.en: The road will be closed to through traffic for eight weeks.
examples.zh: 该道路将禁止通行车辆八周。

examples.en: The car veered across the road into the path of oncoming traffic.
examples.zh: 汽车转向穿过马路，进入迎面驶来的车辆的道路。

examples.en: They were stuck in traffic and missed their flight.
examples.zh: 他们遇到了堵车，没赶上班机。

examples.en: a plan to reduce traffic congestion
examples.zh: 减少交通拥堵的计划

examples.en: traffic police (= who control traffic on a road or stop drivers who are breaking the law)
examples.zh: 交通警察

examples.en: She was badly injured in a road traffic accident.
examples.zh: 她在一场车祸中严重受伤。

examples.en: The delay is due simply to the volume of traffic.
examples.zh: 延误完全是因为交通拥挤。

examples.en: We got used to the constant noise of the traffic.
examples.zh: 我们已经习惯了交通的持续噪音。

senses.def: the movement of ships, trains, aircraft, etc. along a particular route
senses.zh: （沿固定路线的）航行，行驶，飞行

examples.en: transatlantic traffic
examples.zh: 横渡大西洋的航行

examples.en: The line is used by both passenger and freight traffic.
examples.zh: 该线路用于客运和货运。

senses.def: the movement of people or goods from one place to another

examples.en: commuter/freight/passenger traffic
examples.zh: 市郊间上下班运输；货运；客运

examples.en: the traffic of goods between one country and another
examples.zh: 一国与另一国间的货物运输

senses.def: the movement of messages and signals through an electronic communication system

examples.en: the computer servers that manage global internet traffic
examples.zh: 管理全球互联网通信的计算机服务器

examples.en: web/network traffic
examples.zh: 网络信息流量

examples.en: Telecom operators have upgraded their networks to improve their capacity as data traffic increases.
examples.zh: 随着数据流量的增加，电信运营商升级了网络以提高容量。

senses.def: illegal trade in something

examples.en: the traffic in firearms
examples.zh: 非法军火交易

senses.def: to move people illegally, especially in order to make them work in bad conditions without proper payment
senses.zh: 非法贩卖人口（尤指迫使他们充当廉价劳工）

examples.en: The women had been trafficked and forced into sex work.
examples.zh: 这些妇女被贩卖并被迫从事性工作。

examples.en: Organized criminal gangs are trafficking in migrants.
examples.zh: 有组织的犯罪团伙正在贩运移民。

examples.en: Many people were trafficked across the border.
examples.zh: 许多人被拐卖过边境。

examples.en: trafficked children
examples.zh: 被贩卖的儿童

senses.def: to buy and sell something illegally

examples.en: Smugglers were trafficking arms across the border to the rebels.
examples.zh: 走私分子越境将武器贩卖给叛乱者。

examples.en: to traffic in drugs
examples.zh: 买卖毒品

senses.def: to spread or try to encourage a harmful idea or type of behaviour
senses.zh: 传播或试图鼓励有害的想法或行为类型

examples.en: We have no time for people who traffic in bigotry.
examples.zh: 我们没有时间理会那些怀有偏执的人。

examples.en: They trafficked all kinds of baseless conspiracy theories.
examples.zh: 他们贩卖各种毫无根据的阴谋论。

senses.def: ways of making roads safer, especially for people who are walking or riding bicycles, by building raised areas, etc. to make cars go more slowly
senses.zh: 道路安全措施，减缓机动车车速措施（如在马路设置凸面使车辆减速，保障行人及骑自行车者的安全）

senses.def: a place where two or more roads meet, forming a circle that all traffic must go around in the same direction
a plastic object like a cone
senses.zh: （通常因维修而暂时封闭某片道路用的）交通锥，锥形交通路标

senses.def: an area in the middle of a road where you can stand and wait for cars to go past until it is safe for you to cross
senses.zh: 交通岛（供行人避让车辆）

senses.def: a long line of vehicles on a road that cannot move or that can only move very slowly

examples.en: We were stuck in a traffic jam.
examples.zh: 我们遇上了交通阻塞。

senses.def: a set of lights that controls the traffic on a road. The red, orange and green lights show when you must stop and when you can go.

examples.en: Turn left at the traffic lights.
examples.zh: 在交通信号灯处向左拐。

examples.en: There are temporary traffic lights because of the roadworks.
examples.zh: 因道路施工设置了临时的交通灯。

senses.def: a person whose job is to check that people do not park their cars in the wrong place or for longer than is allowed, and to place tickets on vehicles that are parked illegally to make the owners pay a fine
senses.zh: （处理违章停车的）交通管理员

senses.def: a person who buys and sells something illegally

examples.en: a drugs trafficker
examples.zh: 毒贩

senses.def: a person who writes tragedies
an actor in tragedies
a female actor in tragedies
a very sad event or situation, especially one that involves death
senses.zh: 悲惨的事；不幸；灾难；惨案

examples.en: It's a tragedy that she died so young.
examples.zh: 她英年早逝是一大悲哀。

examples.en: Tragedy struck the family when their son was hit by a car and killed.
examples.zh: 这个家庭惨遭不幸，他们的儿子被汽车撞死了。

examples.en: The whole affair ended in tragedy.
examples.zh: 整个事件以悲剧而告终。

examples.en: Investigators are searching the wreckage of the plane to try to find the cause of the tragedy.
examples.zh: 调查人员正在搜寻飞机残骸，试图找出悲剧的原因。

senses.def: a serious play with a sad ending, especially one in which the main character dies; plays of this type

examples.en: Shakespeare’s tragedies
examples.zh: 莎士比亚的悲剧

examples.en: Greek tragedy
examples.zh: 希腊悲剧

examples.en: Revenge tragedies were very popular in Elizabethan England.
examples.zh: 复仇悲剧在伊丽莎白一世时代的英格兰非常受欢迎。

senses.def: making you feel very sad, usually because somebody has died or suffered a lot

examples.en: He was killed in a tragic accident at the age of 24.
examples.zh: 他 24 岁时在一次悲惨的事故中丧命。

examples.en: Cuts in the health service could have tragic consequences for patients.
examples.zh: 减少公共医疗卫生服务可能对病人造成悲惨的后果。

examples.en: It would be tragic if her talent remained unrecognized.
examples.zh: 若她一直怀才不遇，那就可悲了。

examples.en: a rather tragic story
examples.zh: 相当悲惨的故事

senses.def: connected with tragedy

examples.en: a tragic actor/hero
examples.zh: 悲剧演员／男主角

senses.def: a technique in literature in which a character’s actions or thoughts are known to the reader or audience but not to the other characters in the story
senses.zh: 悲剧性讽示（故事中某个人物的行为或想法为读者或观众所知却不为故事中其他人物所知的表现手法）

senses.def: in a way that makes you feel very sad, usually because somebody has died or suffered a lot

examples.en: Tragically, his wife was killed in a car accident.
examples.zh: 他的妻子在车祸中不幸身亡。

examples.en: He died tragically young.
examples.zh: 他英年早逝。

senses.def: a play that is both funny and sad; plays of this type
an event or a situation that is both funny and sad
senses.zh: 悲喜交加的事情（或局面）

senses.def: connected with plays that are both funny and sad

examples.en: The play is a tragicomic masterpiece.
examples.zh: 该剧是一部悲喜剧的杰作。

senses.def: both funny and sad

examples.en: the tragicomic failure of his dreams
examples.zh: 他的梦想悲喜剧般的失败

senses.def: a long line or series of marks that is left by somebody/something

examples.en: a trail of blood
examples.zh: 一连串血迹

examples.en: tourists who leave a trail of litter everywhere they go
examples.zh: 一路乱丢垃圾的游客

examples.en: The hurricane left a trail of destruction behind it.
examples.zh: 飓风过后满目疮痍。

senses.def: a track, sign or smell that is left behind and that can be followed, especially in hunting
senses.zh: （尤指打猎时跟踪的）踪迹，足迹，臭迹

examples.en: The hounds were following the fox's trail.
examples.zh: 猎犬追踪着狐狸的气味。

examples.en: The police are still on the trail of the escaped prisoner.
examples.zh: 警方仍在追捕逃犯。

examples.en: Fortunately the trail was still warm (= clear and easy to follow).
examples.zh: 庆幸的是痕迹仍然清晰可循。

examples.en: The trail had gone cold.
examples.zh: 臭迹已经消失了。

senses.def: a path through the countryside

examples.en: a trail through the forest
examples.zh: 穿过森林的小路

senses.def: a route that is followed for a particular purpose

examples.en: a tourist trail (= of famous buildings)
examples.zh: 游览路线

examples.en: politicians on the campaign trail (= travelling around to attract support)
examples.zh: 进行巡回宣传的政治人物

senses.def: to be the first to do or to discover something that others follow

examples.en: The department is blazing a trail in the field of laser surgery.
examples.zh: 这个部门正在为激光外科学领域开辟一条新路。

senses.def: to start a journey

examples.en: The following spring I hit the road.
examples.zh: 第二年春天我就上路了。

senses.def: close to catching or finding the person or thing that you have been running after or searching for
senses.zh: 快要抓到，即将找到（追查对象）

senses.def: to pull something behind somebody/something, usually along the ground; to be pulled along in this way

examples.en: A jeep trailing a cloud of dust was speeding in my direction.
examples.zh: 一辆吉普车拖着一股扬尘，朝我疾驰而来。

examples.en: I trailed my hand in the water as the boat moved along.
examples.zh: 我把手放在水里，让小船拖着往前划行。

examples.en: The bride's dress trailed behind her.
examples.zh: 新娘的结婚礼服拖在身后。

senses.def: to walk slowly because you are tired or bored, especially behind somebody else; to go from one place to another without enthusiasm
senses.zh: （尤指跟在他人后面）疲惫地走，没精打采地慢走，磨蹭；拖着步子（去某处）

examples.en: The kids trailed around after us while we shopped for clothes.
examples.zh: 我们在商店买衣服时，孩子们无精打采地跟在后面。

senses.def: to be losing a game or other contest
senses.zh: （在比赛或其他竞赛中）落后，暂落下风

examples.en: United were trailing 2–0 at half-time.
examples.zh: 联队在上半场结束时以 0:2 落后。

examples.en: We were trailing by five points.
examples.zh: 我们落后五分。

examples.en: This country is still trailing badly in scientific research.
examples.zh: 这个国家在科研方面仍然大大滞后。

examples.en: The Conservatives are trailing Labour in the opinion polls.
examples.zh: 在民意测验中保守党的支持率落后于工党。

senses.def: to follow somebody/something by looking for signs that show you where they have been

examples.en: The police trailed Dale for days.
examples.zh: 警方跟踪了戴尔多日。

examples.en: They spent three hours trailing a deer through the woods.
examples.zh: 他们花了三个小时在树林里追踪一只鹿。

examples.en: Sharks were trailing the ship.
examples.zh: 鲨鱼正在追踪那艘船。

senses.def: to grow or hang downwards over something or along the ground; to move downwards over something

examples.en: trailing plants
examples.zh: 蔓生植物

examples.en: He had tears trailing down his cheeks.
examples.zh: 他的眼泪顺着双颊流了下来。

senses.def: to advertise a film, TV programme, etc. in advance
senses.zh: 预告，前期宣传（电影、电视节目等）

examples.en: It was trailed heavily as the Big Film of the New Year.
examples.zh: 大量的宣传造势称之为新年大片。

senses.def: to be the first to do or to discover something that others follow

examples.en: The department is blazing a trail in the field of laser surgery.
examples.zh: 这个部门正在为激光外科学领域开辟一条新路。

senses.def: to start a journey

examples.en: The following spring I hit the road.
examples.zh: 第二年春天我就上路了。

senses.def: close to catching or finding the person or thing that you have been running after or searching for
senses.zh: 快要抓到，即将找到（追查对象）

senses.def: to become gradually quieter and then stop
senses.zh: 声音逐渐减弱到停止；逐渐消失

examples.en: His voice trailed away to nothing.
examples.zh: 他的声音越来越小，最后消失了。

examples.en: ‘I only hope…’, she trailed off.
examples.zh: “我只希望…”她的声音越来越小，最后听不到了。

senses.def: a bicycle or light motorcycle that can be used on rough ground
senses.zh: 越野自行车；越野摩托车

senses.def: a mixture of dried fruit and nuts, eaten as a snack

examples.en: It's a good idea to take snacks like trail mix, peanuts or chocolate when you go hiking.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行时最好带上什锦干果、花生或巧克力等零食。

senses.def: to become gradually quieter and then stop
senses.zh: 声音逐渐减弱到停止；逐渐消失

examples.en: His voice trailed away to nothing.
examples.zh: 他的声音越来越小，最后消失了。

examples.en: ‘I only hope…’, she trailed off.
examples.zh: “我只希望…”她的声音越来越小，最后听不到了。

senses.def: a person who is the first to do or discover something and so makes it possible for others to follow
senses.zh: 创始人；先驱；拓荒者；开路先锋

examples.en: a trailblazer in the field of genetic engineering
examples.zh: 基因工程领域的开拓者

senses.def: done or tried for the first time, making it possible for others to follow

examples.en: trailblazing scientific research
examples.zh: 开拓性的科学研究

senses.def: a truck, or a container with wheels, that is pulled by another vehicle

examples.en: a car towing a trailer with a boat on it
examples.zh: 拖着一辆载有小船的拖车的小汽车

senses.def: a vehicle without an engine, that can be pulled by a car or truck or used as a home or an office when it is parked
senses.zh: （拖车式）活动房屋，活动工作室

examples.en: a trailer park (= an area where trailers are parked and used as homes)
examples.zh: 拖车式活动房屋停车场

senses.def: a small building for people to live in that is made in a factory and moved to a permanent place
a series of short scenes from a film or television programme, shown in advance to advertise it

examples.en: He featured in the trailer for the movie.
examples.zh: 他主演了这部电影的预告片。

examples.en: The review said that if you've seen the trailer, you needn't bother watching this film.
examples.zh: 影评说看过预告片之后就没有必要看那部影片了。

intro.en: These are all words for a notice, picture or film telling people about a product, job or service.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指广告、启事。

items.def: a notice, picture or film telling people about a product, job or service; an example of something that shows its good qualities; the act of advertising something and making it public:
items.zh: 指广告、宣传的实例、广告活动或广告宣传

examples.en: They ran advertisements on TV and on social media.
examples.zh: 他们在电视和社交媒体上推出了广告。

items.def: [U] the business of attracting the attention of the public to somebody/​something such as a company, book, film, film star or product; the things that are done to attract attention:
items.zh: 指宣传业、广告宣传工作或传播工作

examples.en: She works in publicity.
examples.zh: 她从事宣传工作。

items.def: (informal) a notice, picture or film telling people about a product, job or service:
items.zh: 广告；启事

examples.en: We put an ad on that website.
examples.zh: 我们在那个网站刊登了一则广告。

items.def: an advertisement on television or on the radio.
items.zh: 指电视或电台播放的广告

items.def: a set of advertisements for a particular product or service; activities done in order to increase the sales of a product or service:
items.zh: 指广告宣传、促销活动

examples.en: a special promotion of local products
examples.zh: 当地产品的特别促销活动

items.def: (especially British English尤用于英式英语) a series of short scenes from a film or television programme, shown in advance to advertise it.
items.zh: 指电影或电视节目的预告片

senses.def: an offensive way of referring to poor white people with little education
senses.zh: 住活动房屋的废物（侮辱性的说法，指地位低下的贫困白人，他们很多住在拖车式活动房屋停靠场里）

senses.def: a large truck with two sections, one in front where the driver sits and one behind for carrying goods. The sections are connected by a flexible joint
the back edge of something moving, especially an aircraft wing
one of the two biggest US bus companies which joined with the Greyhound bus
senses.zh: 美国最大的两家巴士公司之一，于1990年代初与灰狗巴士公司合并。它的公共汽车去了全国各地。Continental Trailways Blues（1983）是乡村音乐歌手Steve Earle的热门歌曲。

senses.def: a number of connected coaches or trucks, pulled by an engine or powered by a motor in each one, taking people and goods from one place to another

examples.en: to get on/off a train
examples.zh: 上／下火车

examples.en: I like travelling by train.
examples.zh: 我喜欢乘火车旅行。

examples.en: a passenger/commuter train
examples.zh: 客运／市郊通勤列车

examples.en: an express/a steam/a bullet train
examples.zh: 特快/蒸汽/子弹头列车

examples.en: to catch/take/get the train to London
examples.zh: 赶上／乘坐／搭乘开往伦敦的火车

examples.en: He boarded the train in Kansas City.
examples.zh: 他在堪萨斯城上了火车。

examples.en: a train journey/driver/operator
examples.zh: 火车旅程／司机／公司

examples.en: Basel's main train station
examples.zh: 巴塞尔的主要火车站

examples.en: He boarded the train in Kansas City.
examples.zh: 他在堪萨斯城上了火车。

examples.en: You have to change trains at Reading.
examples.zh: 你得在雷丁换乘火车。

examples.en: There are regular train services to Edinburgh and Glasgow.
examples.zh: 有定期火车服务前往爱丁堡和格拉斯哥。

examples.en: The train is running late/on time.
examples.zh: 火车晚点／准点。

examples.en: I was on a platform waiting for a train.
examples.zh: 我当时正在站台上等火车。

senses.def: a number of people or animals moving in a line
senses.zh: 列队行进的人（或动物）；队列；行列

examples.en: a camel train
examples.zh: 骆驼队

senses.def: a series of events or actions that are connected
senses.zh: 一系列相关的事情（或行动）

examples.en: His death set in motion a train of events that led to the outbreak of war.
examples.zh: 他的死引发了一系列的事件，从而导致了战争的爆发。

senses.def: the part of a long formal dress that spreads out on the floor behind the person wearing it
senses.zh: 拖裾，裙裾（长礼服的曳地部分）

senses.def: to have something as a result

examples.en: Unemployment brings great difficulties in its train.
examples.zh: 失业带来了重重困难。

senses.def: following behind somebody

examples.en: In the train of the rich and famous came the journalists.
examples.zh: 记者蜂拥在豪绅名流之后。

senses.def: to prepare or start something

examples.en: That telephone call set in train a whole series of events.
examples.zh: 那个电话把一整套事项安排好了。

examples.en: The system only allows air to go one way, preventing air from transferring from one tire to another.
examples.zh: 该系统只允许空气单向流动，防止空气从一个轮胎转移到另一个轮胎。

examples.en: How can I transfer money from my bank account to his?
examples.zh: 怎么才能把我账户上的钱转到他的账户上呢？

examples.en: The patient was transferred to another hospital.
examples.zh: 患者转送到了另一家医院。

examples.en: I couldn't transfer all my credits from junior college.
examples.zh: 我无法把我在专科学校的所有学分都转过来。

examples.en: Assets can be transferred overseas.
examples.zh: 资产可以转移到海外。

examples.en: She transferred the sauce into a china jug.
examples.zh: 她把调味汁倒进瓷罐。

examples.en: The honeybee transfers pollen between flowers.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂在花中间传粉。

examples.en: Customers still can't easily transfer money between accounts.
examples.zh: 客户仍然无法轻松地在帐户之间转账。

senses.group: to new place 到新地方

senses.def: to move from one job, school, situation, etc. to another; to arrange for somebody to move

examples.en: Children usually transfer to secondary school at 11 or 12.
examples.zh: 儿童通常在 11 或 12 岁时升读中学。

examples.en: This is her first season in the Ohio State team after transferring from Tennessee.
examples.zh: 这是她从田纳西州转学后在俄亥俄州立大学队的第一个赛季。

examples.en: Students can transfer from a community college to a university.
examples.zh: 学生可以从社区学院转学到大学。

examples.en: He transferred to UCLA after his freshman year.
examples.zh: 他读完大学一年级后，转学到加利福尼亚大学洛杉矶分校。

examples.en: Ten employees are being transferred from the sales department.
examples.zh: 十名雇员已调离销售部。

examples.en: His superiors transferred him to easier assignments.
examples.zh: 他的上级把他调到更轻松的任务。

examples.en: She was promoted and transferred from the department of law to the Institute of Legal Studies.
examples.zh: 她从法律系晋升调入法学研究所。

examples.en: 98 percent of our patients are admitted, transferred, or discharged within four hours.
examples.zh: 我们 98% 的患者在四小时内入院、转院或出院。

senses.group: to new job/school/situation 到新的工作／学校／环境

senses.def: to change to a different vehicle during a journey; to arrange for somebody to change to a different vehicle during a journey

examples.en: It was a relief, after transferring from ship to ship, to just sit and relax.
examples.zh: 不断地换乘轮船之后能坐下来休息会儿真舒服。

examples.en: I transferred at Bahrain for a flight to Singapore.
examples.zh: 我在巴林转乘飞往新加坡的班机。

examples.en: Passengers are transferred from the airport to the hotel by taxi.
examples.zh: 旅客自机场改乘出租汽车到旅馆。

senses.group: to new vehicle 换乘交通工具

senses.def: to copy information, music, an idea, etc. from one method of recording or presenting it to another; to be recorded or presented in a different way
senses.zh: 转存，转录（资料、音乐等）；改编

examples.en: You can transfer data to a memory stick in a few seconds.
examples.zh: 你可以在几秒钟内将数据转存到 U 盘。

examples.en: Data is easily transferred electronically.
examples.zh: 利用电子手段传输数据很容易。

examples.en: You can transfer songs from your computer to a phone.
examples.zh: 您可以将歌曲从计算机传输到手机。

examples.en: The novel does not transfer well to the movies.
examples.zh: 这部小说不太适宜改编成电影。

examples.en: An audio file should transfer in a matter of minutes.
examples.zh: 音频文件应在几分钟内传输。

senses.def: if you transfer
senses.zh: 转移（感情）；传染（疾病）；让与，转让（权力等）

examples.en: Joe had already transferred his affections from Lisa to Cleo.
examples.zh: 乔已移情别恋，把爱意从莉萨转移到了克利奥身上。

examples.en: I decided to transfer my loyalty to my local team.
examples.zh: 我决定将我的忠诚度转移到我当地的团队。

examples.en: This disease is sometimes transferred from mother to baby (= so that the baby has it as well as the mother).
examples.zh: 这种疾病有时会母婴传播。

senses.def: to officially arrange for something to belong to somebody else or for somebody else to control something

examples.en: He transferred the property to his son.
examples.zh: 他把财产转让给了儿子。

examples.en: Sovereignty was formally transferred on December 27.
examples.zh: 主权在 12 月 27 日正式移交。

senses.def: to move, or to move somebody, to a different sports team, especially a professional football (soccer) team
senses.zh: 转会，使转会（尤指职业足球队）

examples.en: He transferred to Everton for £60 million.
examples.zh: 他以 6 000 万英镑的转会费转到埃弗顿队。

examples.en: He was transferred from Spurs to Arsenal for a huge fee.
examples.zh: 他以巨额转会费从热刺队转到阿森纳队。

senses.def: to send a phone call that you have received to another phone number

examples.en: I'll just transfer you to customer service.
examples.zh: 我这就给你转接客户服务部。

examples.en: Customers are able to transfer calls from their landline to their mobile.
examples.zh: 客户可以将电话从固定电话转接至手机。

senses.def: the act of moving somebody/something from one place, group or job to another; an occasion when this happens

examples.en: electronic data transfer
examples.zh: 电子数据传输

examples.en: After the election there was a swift transfer of power.
examples.zh: 大选之后权力迅速交接。

examples.en: He has asked for a transfer to the company's Paris branch.
examples.zh: 他要求调到公司的巴黎分部。

examples.en: the transfer of currency from one country to another
examples.zh: 货币从一国到另一国的汇划

examples.en: I asked for a transfer from my company to one of their California offices.
examples.zh: 我要求从我的公司调到他们在加州的一个办事处。

examples.en: I did a file transfer from one PC to another.
examples.zh: 我把一个文件从一台个人电脑转到另一台上。

examples.en: the transfer of property between private buyers
examples.zh: 私人买家之间的财产交接

senses.group: change of place/job/situation 地点／工作／环境的改变

senses.def: an act of changing to a different place, vehicle or route when you are travelling
senses.zh: （旅途中的）中转，换乘，改变路线

examples.en: The transfer from the airport to the hotel is included in the price.
examples.zh: 票价包括从机场转车到旅馆的费用。

examples.en: The hotel can arrange airport transfers.
examples.zh: 酒店可以安排机场接送服务。

senses.def: a ticket that allows a passenger to continue their journey on another bus or train
senses.group: train/bus ticket 火车／公共汽车票

senses.def: the act of moving a sports player from one club or team to another

examples.en: It was the first goal he had scored since his transfer from Chelsea.
examples.zh: 这是他从切尔西队转会过来之后的第一粒进球。

examples.en: His club have given him a free transfer.
examples.zh: 他的俱乐部同意他自由转会。

examples.en: a transfer fee
examples.zh: 转会费

examples.en: to be on the transfer list (= available to join another club)
examples.zh: 在转会名单上

examples.en: the January transfer window (= a period in the year when transfers can take place)
examples.zh: 一月转会窗口（=一年中可以进行转会的时期）

senses.def: a picture or design that can be removed from a piece of paper and stuck onto a surface, for example by being pressed or heated
senses.zh: 转印图画，转印图案（利用挤压或加热，可从纸上转印到物体的表面）

senses.def: the process of using behaviour that has already been learnt in one situation in a new situation
senses.zh: 迁移（将已习得的行为在新的情况下应用）

senses.def: a student at a college or university who has completed classes at another college or university after leaving high school

examples.en: admission criteria for transfer students
examples.zh: 转学生录取标准

examples.en: problems experienced by older transfer students
examples.zh: 年长转学生遇到的问题

senses.def: the fact that something can be moved from one person, place or use to another
senses.zh: 可转移的；可调动的；可转让的；可转录的；可中转的

senses.def: that can be moved from one place, person or use to another
senses.zh: 可转移的；可调动的；可转让的；可转录的；可中转的

examples.en: This ticket is not transferable (= it may only be used by the person who has bought it).
examples.zh: 此票不得转让。

examples.en: We aim to provide our students with transferable skills (= that can be used in different jobs).
examples.zh: 我们的目的是让学生掌握可用于不同工作的技术。

senses.def: the process of moving something from one place, person or use to another

examples.en: the transference of heat from the liquid to the container
examples.zh: 热量从液体到容器的传导

senses.def: the action of transferring something or somebody
a complete change of form or appearance into something more beautiful or spiritual

examples.en: the transfiguration of the human soul
examples.zh: 人类灵魂的变形

examples.en: In this light the junk undergoes a transfiguration; it shines.
examples.zh: 在这种光线下, 这破烂东西变美了; 它发光了。

senses.def: to change the appearance of a person or thing so that they look more beautiful

examples.en: Ann’s whole face was transfigured by the early morning light.
examples.zh: 安的整张脸都被清晨的阳光美化了。

senses.def: to make somebody unable to move because they are afraid, surprised, etc.
senses.zh: 使（因恐惧、惊愕等而）动弹不得；使惊呆

examples.en: Luisa stood transfixed with shock.
examples.zh: 路易莎大吃一惊，站在那里呆若木鸡。

senses.def: to change the form of something; to change in form

examples.en: The photochemical reactions transform the light into electrical impulses.
examples.zh: 光化学反应使光变为电脉冲。

examples.en: Materials are transformed from their original state into other forms.
examples.zh: 材料从其原始状态转变为其他形式。

examples.en: I am convinced that the electric power industry is transforming.
examples.zh: 我相信电力工业正在转型。

examples.en: The way we work, play and communicate every day has completely transformed from a decade ago.
examples.zh: 我们每天工作、娱乐和交流的方式与十年前相比已经完全改变。

senses.def: to completely change the appearance or character of something/somebody, especially so that it is better; to completely change in appearance or character

examples.en: A new colour scheme will transform your bedroom.
examples.zh: 新的色彩调配将使你的卧室焕然一新。

examples.en: It was an event that would transform my life.
examples.zh: 那是能够彻底改变我一生的一件事。

examples.en: During the performance the artist transforms herself with the aid of make-up and a wig.
examples.zh: 在表演过程中，艺术家借助化妆品和假发来改变自己。

examples.en: London's Docklands have been radically transformed over the last 20 years.
examples.zh: 过去 20 年来，伦敦港区发生了翻天覆地的变化。

examples.en: He seems to have been miraculously transformed into a first-class player.
examples.zh: 他似乎奇迹般地变成了一名一流球员。

examples.en: The place was transformed from a quiet farming village into a busy port.
examples.zh: 这个地方由安静的农村变为繁忙的港口。

examples.en: The surface of the lake has completely transformed from bright green to blood red.
examples.zh: 湖面由翠绿色完全变成血红色。

senses.def: a complete change in somebody/something

examples.en: The way in which we work has undergone a complete transformation in the past decade.
examples.zh: 在过去的十年里，我们的工作方式经历了彻底的变革。

examples.en: What a transformation! You look great.
examples.zh: 真是判若两人！你看上去真神气。

examples.en: the country’s transformation from dictatorship to democracy
examples.zh: 这个国家由独裁到民主的转变

senses.def: the process of making institutions and organizations more democratic

examples.en: a lack of transformation in the private sector
examples.zh: 在私营部门缺乏民主改革

senses.def: connected with a complete change in somebody/something, especially a positive change

examples.en: a transformational moment in the country's history
examples.zh: 该国历史上的变革时刻

examples.en: Transformational leadership is about inspiring others to achieve greater things themselves.
examples.zh: 变革型领导力就是激励他人自己取得更大的成就。

senses.def: a type of grammar that describes a language as a system that has a deep structure which changes in particular ways when real sentences are produced
senses.zh: 转换语法（将语言描述为有深层结构的系统，在产出真实句子时按特定方式转换）

senses.def: a device for reducing or increasing the voltage
to put new blood into the body of a person or an animal

examples.en: to transfuse blood into a patient
examples.zh: 给病人输血

senses.def: the process of putting new blood into the body of a person or an animal
the act of investing extra money in a place or an activity that needs it

examples.en: The project badly needs a transfusion of cash.
examples.zh: 这个项目急需追加现金投资。

senses.def: describing or relating to people whose gender identity

examples.en: Sam identifies as a transgender man.
examples.zh: 山姆自认是一名变性人。

examples.en: transgender issues
examples.zh: 关于跨性别者的有争议的问题

examples.en: gays, lesbians, bisexuals and transgender people
examples.zh: 男同性恋、女同性恋、双性恋和跨性别者

senses.def: describing or relating to people whose gender identity
having genetic

examples.en: transgenic crops
examples.zh: 转基因作物

senses.def: the study or practice of creating transgenic
a transgenic
by introducing genetic
to go beyond the limit of what is morally or legally acceptable
senses.zh: 越轨；违背（道德）；违犯（法律）

examples.en: They had transgressed the bounds of decency.
examples.zh: 他们已经超越了正派的界限。

examples.en: to transgress against God/your neighbour/natural law
examples.zh: 违背上帝/你的邻居/自然法

examples.en: We will punish any who transgress.
examples.zh: 我们将惩罚任何违规者。

senses.def: an act that goes beyond the limits of what is morally or legally acceptable
senses.zh: 越轨；违背（道德）；违犯（法律）

examples.en: She was unable to forgive his latest transgression.
examples.zh: 她无法原谅他最近的违规行为。

examples.en: their transgression of social and cultural boundaries
examples.zh: 他们超越社会和文化界限

examples.en: They are guilty of transgression against the natural order.
examples.zh: 他们犯有违反自然秩序的罪。

senses.def: going beyond the limit of what is morally or socially acceptable
senses.zh: 越轨的；违背（道德）的；违犯（法律）的

examples.en: In the 1970s such behaviour was widely regarded as transgressive.
examples.zh: 在 20 世纪 70 年代，这种行为被广泛认为是违法行为。

examples.en: The artist was a bold and transgressive figure.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家是一个大胆而越轨的人物。

senses.def: a person who goes beyond the limit of what is morally or legally acceptable
senses.zh: 越轨；违背（道德）；违犯（法律）

senses.def: the practice of moving animals to different fields in different seasons, for example to higher fields in summer and lower fields in winter
the fact that something continues for only a short time
senses.zh: 短暂的；转瞬即逝的；倏忽的

examples.en: the transience of human life
examples.zh: 人生的短暂

senses.def: continuing for only a short time
senses.zh: 暂时的；片刻的；转瞬即逝的

examples.en: the transient nature of speech
examples.zh: 言语的即逝性

senses.def: staying or working in a place for only a short time, before moving on

examples.en: a city with a large transient population (= of students, temporary workers, etc.)
examples.zh: 有大量流动人口的城市

senses.def: a person who stays or works in a place for only a short time, before moving on
senses.zh: 暂住某地的人；过往旅客；临时工

examples.en: Most of the farm workers are transients.
examples.zh: 大多数农场工人都是流动人口。

senses.def: a small electronic device used in computers, radios, televisions, etc. for controlling an electric current as it passes along a circuit
a small radio with transistors
the process of being moved or carried from one place to another

examples.en: The cost includes transit.
examples.zh: 成本中包括运费。

examples.en: goods damaged in transit
examples.zh: 在运输中损坏的货物

examples.en: transit times
examples.zh: 运送时间

senses.def: the act of going through a place on the way to somewhere else
senses.zh: 通过；经过；通行；过境；中转

examples.en: the transit lounge at Vienna airport
examples.zh: 维也纳机场中转候机室

examples.en: a transit visa (= one that allows a person to pass through a country but not to stay there)
examples.zh: 过境签证

senses.def: the system of buses, trains, etc. that people use to travel from one place to another

examples.en: the city’s mass/public transit system
examples.zh: 城市的公共交通运输系统

senses.def: a type of large van that is used for delivering goods, carrying equipment, etc.

examples.en: Transit vans used by gas engineers
examples.zh: 天然气工程师使用的运输车

examples.en: all types of transit vans available for rental
examples.zh: 可供出租的所有类型的运输车

senses.def: to pass across or through an area

examples.en: The ship is currently transiting the Gulf of Mexico.
examples.zh: 这艘船现在正穿越墨西哥湾。

examples.en: 29 000 vessels transit in and out of the harbour every year.
examples.zh: 每年有29000艘船舶进出港口。

senses.def: a camp that provides temporary accommodation for refugees
the process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another

examples.en: the transition from school to full-time work
examples.zh: 从学校到全职工作的过渡阶段

examples.en: He will remain head of state during the period of transition to democracy.
examples.zh: 在向民主政体过渡时期，他仍将是国家首脑。

examples.en: Only after he stepped down could a genuine transition from dictatorship begin.
examples.zh: 只有在他下台后，真正的独裁过渡才能开始。

examples.en: a three-year transition period
examples.zh: 三年过渡期

examples.en: He has not met with the transition team members.
examples.zh: 他尚未会见过渡团队成员。

examples.en: The company was slow to make the transition from paper to computer.
examples.zh: 这家公司从纸本到电脑的转变缓慢。

examples.en: We need to ensure a smooth transition between the old system and the new one.
examples.zh: 我们需要确保新旧制度的平稳过渡。

examples.en: This course is useful for students who are in transition from one training programme to another.
examples.zh: 对转换培训项目的学生来说，这一课程很有用。

senses.def: the process of starting to live your life as a person of a different sex, to match your gender identity

examples.en: She wrote to co-workers announcing her transition and asking them to refer to her with female pronouns.
examples.zh: 她写信给同事宣布她的转变，并要求他们用女性代词来称呼她。

senses.def: to change or to make something change from one state or condition to another

examples.en: They transitioned from print journalism to the digital world.
examples.zh: 他们由纸媒过渡到了数字世界。

examples.en: Almost every country in the world has made the decision to transition away from fossil fuels.
examples.zh: 世界上几乎每个国家都做出了摆脱化石燃料的决定。

examples.en: They decided to transition the farm to organic.
examples.zh: 他们决定将农场转型为有机农场。

senses.def: to start living your life as a person of a different sex, to match your gender identity

examples.en: The singer told fans about his decision to transition.
examples.zh: 这位歌手向歌迷讲述了他转型的决定。

senses.def: one of the group of metals in the centre of the periodic table
senses.zh: 过渡金属（位于元素周期表中心的一组金属元素，可形成有色化合物，常作为催化剂）

senses.def: connected with the process of changing from one state or condition to another

examples.en: a transitional period
examples.zh: 过渡期

examples.en: a transitional government
examples.zh: 过渡政府

senses.def: used with a direct object

examples.en: In ‘She wrote a letter’, the verb ‘wrote’ is transitive and the word ‘letter’ is the direct object.
examples.zh: 在 She wrote a letter 一句中，动词 wrote 是及物动词，letter 一词是直接宾语。

senses.def: with a direct object

examples.en: The verb is being used transitively.
examples.zh: 这个动词在这里用作及物动词。

senses.def: the fact of a particular verb being either transitive

examples.en: These codes indicate the transitivity of the verb.
examples.zh: 这些代码表示动词的及物性。

senses.def: continuing for only a short time
senses.zh: 暂时的；片刻的；转瞬即逝的

examples.en: the transitory nature of his happiness
examples.zh: 他昙花一现的幸福

examples.en: These feelings of resentment tend to be transitory.
examples.zh: 这些怨恨的感觉往往是短暂的。

senses.def: to express the meaning of speech or writing in a different language

examples.en: He translated the letter into English.
examples.zh: 他把这封信译成了英文。

examples.en: Her books have been translated into 24 languages.
examples.zh: 她的书被译成了 24 种语言。

examples.en: Can you help me translate this legal jargon into plain English?
examples.zh: 你能帮助我用浅显易懂的英语来说明这一法律术语吗？

examples.en: This chapter was translated from the French by Oliver Breen.
examples.zh: 这一章由奥利弗·布林译自法语。

examples.en: His works have been translated from French into countless languages.
examples.zh: 他的作品已从法语翻译成无数语言。

examples.en: ‘Suisse’ had been wrongly translated as ‘Sweden’.
examples.zh: Suisse 被错译成 Sweden（瑞典）。

examples.en: The novel has been widely translated.
examples.zh: 这本小说已翻译成多种文字。

examples.en: I don't speak Greek so Dina offered to translate for me.
examples.zh: 我不懂希腊语，于是迪娜主动给我翻译。

examples.en: My work involves translating from German.
examples.zh: 我的工作包括德语翻译。

examples.en: My father dictated in Polish while I translated into English.
examples.zh: 我父亲用波兰语口述，而我则翻译成英语。

examples.en: I spoke to him through my friend who translated from Arabic into English.
examples.zh: 我通过我的朋友与他交谈，他将阿拉伯语翻译成英语。

senses.def: to be changed from one language to another

examples.en: Most poetry does not translate well.
examples.zh: 诗歌大多翻译不好。

senses.group: in dangerous/bad situation 处境危险／恶劣

senses.def: to keep somebody in a bad situation that they want to get out of but cannot

examples.en: He was trapped in an unhappy marriage.
examples.zh: 他陷入不幸的婚姻之中。

examples.en: I feel trapped in my job.
examples.zh: 我觉得被工作缠住了。

senses.group: in dangerous/bad situation 处境危险／恶劣

senses.def: to have part of your body, your clothing, etc. held in a place so tightly that you cannot remove it and it may be injured or damaged

examples.en: I trapped my coat in the car door.
examples.zh: 我的外衣被汽车门夹住了。

examples.en: The pain was caused by a trapped nerve.
examples.zh: 这疼痛是由于神经受压迫引起的。

senses.group: part of body/clothing 身体／衣服部位

senses.def: to force somebody/something into a place or situation that they cannot escape from, especially in order to catch them
senses.zh: 把…逼进，迫使…进入（不能逃脱的地方）

examples.en: The escaped prisoners were eventually trapped in an underground garage and recaptured.
examples.zh: 越狱逃犯终于给追逼到地下车库，再次被捕。

examples.en: Police believe the fingerprints could help trap the killer.
examples.zh: 警方相信这些指纹可以帮助抓获凶手。

senses.def: to catch an animal in a trap
senses.zh: 设陷阱捕捉，用捕捉器捕捉（动物）

examples.en: Raccoons used to be trapped for their fur.
examples.zh: 人们过去经常设陷阱猎取浣熊，以获得其毛皮。

senses.def: to catch or keep something in a place and prevent it from escaping, especially so that you can use it

examples.en: Solar panels trap energy from the sun.
examples.zh: 太阳能电池板吸收太阳能。

senses.def: to trick somebody into something
senses.zh: 使陷入圈套；使中计；使上当

examples.en: He felt he had been trapped into accepting the terms of the contract.
examples.zh: 他觉得自己是中了圈套才接受这个合同条款的。

examples.en: The police managed to trap him into revealing his true identity.
examples.zh: 警方设法诱骗他说出了自己的真实身份。

senses.def: to make a trap
to try to trick somebody into doing or saying something; to succeed in this

items.idm: to fall into/avoid the trap of doing something

senses.def: to do/avoid doing something that is a mistake but that seems at first to be a good idea

examples.en: Parents often fall into the trap of trying to do everything for their children.
examples.zh: 家长经常陷入极力为子女操办一切的误区。

examples.en: The movie avoids the trap of spending too much time explaining things.
examples.zh: 这部电影避免了花太多时间解释事物的陷阱。

senses.def: a small door in a floor or ceiling
senses.zh: 地板门；（天花板上的）活板门，通风门，活动天窗

senses.def: a wooden or metal bar hanging from two pieces of rope high above the ground, used especially by circus
senses.zh: （尤指马戏团演员使用的）高空秋千，吊架

examples.en: a trapeze artist
examples.zh: 高空秋千表演者

senses.def: a flat shape with four straight sides, one pair of opposite sides being parallel
a flat shape with four straight sides, none of which are parallel
a flat shape with four straight sides, none of which are parallel
a flat shape with four straight sides, one pair of opposite sides being parallel
a person who traps
senses.zh: 捕杀动物者（尤指为获取毛皮）

senses.def: the possessions, clothes, etc. that are connected with a particular situation, job or social position
senses.zh: （与某一处境、职业或社会地位有关的）身外之物，标志，服装

examples.en: They enjoyed all the trappings of wealth.
examples.zh: 他们享有所有象征财富的东西。

examples.en: the trappings of fame/power/success
examples.zh: 名声／权力／成功的标志

senses.def: a member of a group of monks
senses.zh: 特拉普派的（有严格教规，包括缄口苦修的修道士组织）

senses.def: belonging to a group of monks
senses.zh: 特拉普派的（有严格教规，包括缄口苦修的修道士组织）

senses.def: things that you throw away because you no longer want or need them

examples.en: Don't forget to take out the trash.
examples.zh: 别忘了把垃圾带走。

senses.def: objects, writing, ideas, etc. that you think are of poor quality
senses.zh: 劣质品；拙劣的作品；糟粕；谬论

examples.en: What's this trash you're watching?
examples.zh: 你看的这个乌七八糟的节目是什么？

examples.en: He's talking trash (= nonsense).
examples.zh: 他在胡说八道。

senses.def: an offensive word used to describe people that you do not respect
senses.zh: 窝囊废；废物；没出息的人

senses.def: to damage or destroy something

examples.en: The band was famous for trashing hotel rooms.
examples.zh: 这帮人以破坏旅馆房间出名。

senses.def: to criticize something/somebody very strongly

examples.en: Several journalists attempted to trash his reputation.
examples.zh: 几位记者试图抨击他名声不佳。

senses.def: to throw away something that you do not want

examples.en: I'm leaving my old toys here—if you don't want them, just trash them.
examples.zh: 我把我的旧玩具留在这里，你不要就扔掉好了。

senses.def: a container for people to put rubbish in, in the street or in a public building
senses.zh: （街道上或公共建筑物里的）垃圾箱，废物箱

senses.def: a large container with a lid
senses.zh: （常置于室外的）垃圾桶，垃圾箱

senses.def: a way of talking that is intended to make somebody, especially an opponent, feel less confident
senses.zh: 垃圾话，口水战（为令对手等丧失自信心）

senses.def: of poor quality; with no value

examples.en: trashy TV shows
examples.zh: 无聊的电视节目

senses.def: an Italian restaurant serving simple food
a mental condition caused by severe shock, stress or fear, especially when the harmful effects last for a long time

examples.en: the effects of trauma and stress on the body
examples.zh: 创伤和压力对身体的影响

examples.en: The children showed no signs of trauma after their ordeal.
examples.zh: 经历磨难后，孩子们没有表现出任何外伤迹象。

examples.en: patients who have histories of childhood trauma
examples.zh: 有童年创伤史的病人

senses.def: a very frightening or upsetting experience

examples.en: She felt exhausted after the traumas of recent weeks.
examples.zh: 她经受了最近几个星期的痛苦之后感到精疲力竭。

senses.def: an injury

examples.en: The patient suffered severe brain trauma.
examples.zh: 患者的大脑受到严重损伤。

senses.def: extremely unpleasant and causing you to feel upset and/or anxious

examples.en: a traumatic experience
examples.zh: 不幸的经历

examples.en: Divorce can be traumatic for everyone involved.
examples.zh: 离婚对所有相关的人都会造成痛苦。

examples.en: a traumatic childhood
examples.zh: 不幸的童年

senses.def: connected with or caused by trauma

examples.en: traumatic amnesia
examples.zh: 创伤性遗忘

senses.def: in an extremely unpleasant way that makes you feel upset and/or anxious
to shock and upset somebody very much, often making them unable to think normally or continue with their normal life

examples.en: He was so traumatized by the attack that he could not work for a year.
examples.zh: 这次袭击给他造成了严重的创伤，导致他一年无法工作。

examples.en: We were traumatized by what we saw.
examples.zh: 我们所看到的景象令我们精神受创。

senses.def: an unpleasant experience or situation that involves a lot of hard work, difficulties and/or pain
senses.zh: 艰苦劳动；煎熬；艰辛；痛苦

examples.en: the travails of life in post-war Britain
examples.zh: 战后英国生活的艰辛

senses.def: to go from one place to another, especially over a long distance

examples.en: I go to bed early if I'm travelling the next day.
examples.zh: 如果第二天要去旅行我就早睡。

examples.en: to travel around the world
examples.zh: 周游世界

examples.en: I love travelling by train.
examples.zh: 我喜欢乘火车旅行。

examples.en: We always travel first class.
examples.zh: 我们总坐头等舱旅行。

examples.en: I travel abroad a lot.
examples.zh: 我经常出国旅行。

examples.en: They travelled on the bus to and from work together.
examples.zh: 他们一起乘公共汽车上下班。

examples.en: We travelled to California for the wedding.
examples.zh: 我们到加利福尼亚去参加婚礼。

examples.en: They enjoy travelling to other European countries.
examples.zh: 他们喜欢去其他欧洲国家旅行。

examples.en: My client travels extensively on business.
examples.zh: 我的客户经常出差。

examples.en: When I finished college I went travelling for six months (= spent time visiting different places).
examples.zh: 我大学毕业后在外旅行了六个月。

examples.en: As a journalist, she has travelled the world.
examples.zh: 作为记者，她跑遍了全世界。

examples.en: He travelled the length of the Nile in a canoe.
examples.zh: 他乘独木舟游完尼罗河的全程。

examples.en: I travel 40 miles to work every day.
examples.zh: 我每天奔波 40 英里去上班。

examples.en: They travelled huge distances in search of food.
examples.zh: 他们长途跋涉寻找食物。

examples.en: Many residents must travel long distances to a grocery store.
examples.zh: 许多居民必须长途跋涉去杂货店。

senses.def: to go or move at a particular speed, in a particular direction, or a particular distance
senses.zh: （以某速度、朝某方向或在某距离内）行进，转送，传播

examples.en: to travel at 50 miles an hour
examples.zh: 以每小时 50 英里的速度行进

examples.en: Messages travel along the spine from the nerve endings to the brain.
examples.zh: 信息从神经末梢沿脊柱传送到大脑。

examples.en: News travels fast these days.
examples.zh: 如今消息传播得很快。

examples.en: He never travelled far from the home he shared with his mother.
examples.zh: 他从未离开过与母亲共同居住的家。

examples.en: The wide streets allow cars to travel at high speeds.
examples.zh: 宽阔的街道允许汽车高速行驶。

senses.def: to be still in good condition after a long journey
senses.zh: 经长途运输仍不变质；经得住长途运输

examples.en: Some wines do not travel well.
examples.zh: 有些葡萄酒经不住长途运输。

senses.def: to be equally successful in another place and not just where it began

examples.en: These recipes travel well and don't require unusual ingredients or equipment.
examples.zh: 这些食谱很容易传播，不需要不寻常的原料或设备。

examples.en: Some writing travels badly (= is not successful) in translation.
examples.zh: 有些作品经翻译后流传不广。

senses.def: to go fast

examples.en: Their car can really travel!
examples.zh: 他们的车开得可真快！

senses.def: to take more than three steps while you are holding the ball, without bouncing
to take very little with you when you go on a trip

examples.en: She travels light, choosing to use as little equipment as possible.
examples.zh: 她轻装旅行，尽量少带行装。

senses.def: the act or activity of travelling

examples.en: air/rail/space travel
examples.zh: 乘飞机／火车／航天器

examples.en: travel expenses
examples.zh: 旅费

examples.en: The job involves a considerable amount of foreign travel.
examples.zh: 这个工作要经常出差去国外。

examples.en: the travel industry
examples.zh: 旅游业

examples.en: travel sickness
examples.zh: 晕车

examples.en: a travel bag/clock (= for use when travelling)
examples.zh: 旅行包；旅行钟

examples.en: a travel guide (= a book of useful information for travellers)
examples.zh: 旅行指南

examples.en: If you're going abroad, get some travel insurance.
examples.zh: 如果您要出国，请购买一些旅行保险。

examples.en: your passport and other travel documents
examples.zh: 您的护照和其他旅行证件

examples.en: The pass allows unlimited travel on all public transport in the city.
examples.zh: 该乘车证可乘坐市内所有的公共交通工具，次数不限。

examples.en: I used my compass to confirm my direction of travel.
examples.zh: 我用指南针确认了我的行进方向。

examples.en: What are your favourite time travel stories?
examples.zh: 你最喜欢的时间旅行故事是什么？

examples.en: Most experts advise against air travel for at least three weeks after a heart attack.
examples.zh: 大多数专家建议心脏病发作后至少三周内不要乘坐飞机。

senses.def: time spent travelling, especially in foreign countries and for pleasure

examples.en: The novel is based on his travels in India.
examples.zh: 这部长篇小说是根据他的印度之行写成的。

examples.en: Her work is influenced by her travels around the globe.
examples.zh: 她的作品受到她环球旅行的影响。

examples.en: When are you off on your travels (= going travelling)?
examples.zh: 你们什么时候动身外出旅行？

senses.def: to take very little with you when you go on a trip

examples.en: She travels light, choosing to use as little equipment as possible.
examples.zh: 她轻装旅行，尽量少带行装。

senses.def: to take very little with you when you go on a trip

examples.en: She travels light, choosing to use as little equipment as possible.
examples.zh: 她轻装旅行，尽量少带行装。

senses.def: a company that arranges travel and/or accommodation for people going on a holiday or journey

examples.en: You can book at your local travel agency.
examples.zh: 你可以在当地的旅行社预订。

senses.def: a person or business whose job is to make arrangements for people wanting to travel, for example buying tickets or arranging hotel rooms
senses.zh: 旅行代办人；旅行代理商

senses.def: a shop where you can go to arrange a holiday, etc.

examples.en: He works in a travel agent's.
examples.zh: 他在一家旅行社工作。

senses.def: feeling sick because you are travelling in a vehicle
the unpleasant feeling that you are going to vomit
a moving path, especially at an airport
a special ticket that allows passengers to travel on underground trains, ordinary trains and buses in Greater London
senses.zh: 旅游卡（有效期为一天至一年不等的打折车票，乘客凭此票可在大伦敦范围内乘坐地铁、普通列车和公共汽车。在有效期内乘车次数不限）

senses.def: a person who is travelling or who often travels
senses.zh: 旅行者；旅游者；旅客；游客

examples.en: She is a frequent traveller to Belgium.
examples.zh: 她经常到比利时去旅行。

examples.en: leisure/business travellers
examples.zh: 休闲／商务旅客

examples.en: These hotels are becoming popular with the discerning traveller.
examples.zh: 这些酒店越来越受到挑剔的旅行者的欢迎。

senses.def: a person who does not live in one place but travels around, especially as part of a group; a member of the travelling community

examples.en: New Age travellers
examples.zh: 经常迁移的新时代人

senses.def: a cheque
a group of people who have no fixed home and move from place to place, for example Irish Travellers
senses.zh: 一群没有固定住所并从一个地方搬到另一个地方的人，例如爱尔兰旅行者或罗姆人

examples.en: He grew up in the travelling community.
examples.zh: 他在旅游社区长大。

examples.en: She was the first student from the Travelling community at the university.
examples.zh: 她是大学里第一个来自旅行社区的学生。

examples.en: She protested that the bill was an attack on travelling communities.
examples.zh: 她抗议说该法案是对旅游社区的攻击。

senses.def: a sales rep
a film, broadcast or piece of writing about travel
senses.zh: 旅行纪录片；旅游广播节目；游记

senses.def: to cross an area of land or water

examples.en: skiers traversing the slopes
examples.zh: 穿越斜坡的滑雪者

examples.en: The region is traversed by several roads.
examples.zh: 该地区有多条道路穿过。

senses.def: an act of moving sideways
senses.zh: （在陡坡上的）侧向移动，横过，横越；可横越的地方

examples.en: We began a traverse across the rock face.
examples.zh: 我们开始穿越岩壁。

senses.def: something that does not have the qualities or values that it should have, and as a result is often considered wrong or offensive

examples.en: The trial was a travesty of justice.
examples.zh: 这一审判是对正义的嘲弄。

examples.en: His claim is a travesty of the facts.
examples.zh: 他的说法是对事实的嘲弄。

examples.en: a travesty of a marriage
examples.zh: 对婚姻的嘲弄

senses.def: a moving path, especially at an airport
to search through a large amount of information or a large number of people, places, etc. looking for a particular thing or person
senses.zh: 查阅（资料）；搜集，搜罗，网罗（人或物）

examples.en: She trawled the shops for bargains.
examples.zh: 她到各商店搜罗便宜货。

examples.en: Major companies trawl the universities for potential graduate trainees.
examples.zh: 大公司在大学里寻找潜在的研究生实习生。

examples.en: The police are trawling through their files for similar cases.
examples.zh: 警方正在档案中查阅类似案件。

senses.def: to fish for something by pulling a large net with a wide opening through the water
a search through a large amount of information, documents, etc.

examples.en: A quick trawl through the newspapers yielded five suitable job adverts.
examples.zh: 快速翻阅一下报纸便找到五则适合的招聘广告。

senses.def: a large net with a wide opening, that is dragged along the bottom of the sea by a boat in order to catch fish
a fishing boat that uses large nets that it drags through the sea behind it
a flat piece of wood, metal or plastic with raised edges, used for carrying or holding things, especially food

examples.en: He brought her breakfast in bed on a tray.
examples.zh: 他把早餐用托盘给她送到床上。

examples.en: She came in with a tray of drinks.
examples.zh: 她端着一托盘饮料走进来。

examples.en: a tea tray
examples.zh: 茶盘

senses.def: a shallow plastic box, used for various purposes

examples.en: a seed tray (= for planting seeds in)
examples.zh: 育苗盘

examples.en: a cat’s litter tray
examples.zh: 猫砂盆

examples.en: an ice tray (= for making ice cubes)
examples.zh: 制冰盒

senses.def: Truth and Reconciliation Commission
senses.zh: 真相与调解委员会（南非组织，调查以往的不公平待遇事件）

senses.def: that cannot be trusted; intending to harm you
senses.zh: 不可信任的；背叛的；奸诈的

examples.en: He was weak, cowardly and treacherous.
examples.zh: 他软弱、胆怯、奸诈。

examples.en: lying, treacherous words
examples.zh: 阴险的谎话

senses.def: dangerous, especially when seeming safe

examples.en: The ice on the roads made driving conditions treacherous.
examples.zh: 路上的冰对驾车构成了隐患。

examples.en: the mountain’s notoriously treacherous rocky crest
examples.zh: 出名地暗藏危险的岩石山顶

senses.def: in a way that involves hurting somebody who trusts you

examples.en: The king had been treacherously murdered by his brother.
examples.zh: 国王被他的兄弟奸诈地谋杀了。

senses.def: in a dangerous way, especially when something seems safer than it is

examples.en: treacherously icy conditions on the roads
examples.zh: 道路上结冰的情况很危险

senses.def: behaviour that involves hurting somebody who trusts you, for example by telling their secrets to other people; an example of this

examples.en: an act of treachery
examples.zh: 背叛行为

examples.en: He was punished for his treacheries.
examples.zh: 他因背叛而受到惩罚。

examples.en: Rumours of treachery and conspiracy began to circulate in the Queen’s court.
examples.zh: 关于背叛和阴谋的谣言开始在女王宫廷中流传。

senses.def: a thick black, sweet, sticky liquid produced when sugar is refined
a very sweet thick yellow liquid made from sugar

examples.en: a treacle tart
examples.zh: 糖蜜馅饼

senses.def: like treacle

examples.en: a treacly brown liquid
examples.zh: 糖浆状的棕色液体

senses.def: expressing feelings of love in a way that seems false or exaggerated
senses.zh: 虚情假意的；过分多情的

examples.en: treacly music
examples.zh: 甜腻腻的音乐

senses.def: to put your foot down while you are stepping or walking

examples.en: Ouch! You trod on my toe!
examples.zh: 唉哟！你踩着我的脚指头了！

examples.en: Careful you don't tread in that puddle.
examples.zh: 小心，别踩着那水坑。

senses.def: to move, push or press something with your feet

examples.en: Don't tread ash into the carpet!
examples.zh: 别把烟灰踩进地毯里！

examples.en: The wine is still made by treading grapes in the traditional way.
examples.zh: 这种葡萄酒仍然是以传统的方法踩碎葡萄酿制的。

examples.en: She planted the seeds and trod the earth down.
examples.zh: 她埋下种子，把土踩实。

senses.def: to walk somewhere

examples.en: Few people had trod this path before.
examples.zh: 以前没有多少人走过这条小路。

examples.en: He was treading quietly and cautiously.
examples.zh: 他蹑手蹑脚地走着。

senses.def: people with little experience try to do the difficult or dangerous things that more experienced people would not consider doing
to be very careful about what you do or say
senses.zh: 小心谨慎地说；小心翼翼地做

examples.en: The government will have to tread very carefully in handling this issue.
examples.zh: 政府在处理这个问题时须慎之又慎。

examples.en: We must tread warily —we don't want to offend anyone.
examples.zh: 我们必须谨慎行事——我们不想冒犯任何人。

senses.def: to choose and follow a particular way of life, way of doing something, etc.
senses.zh: 走一条困难、危险、孤独等的人生道路（指选择特定的生活方式或处事方法）

examples.en: A restaurant has to tread the tricky path between maintaining quality and keeping prices down.
examples.zh: 餐馆必须在保证质量和价格低廉之间走出一条困难的折中之路。

senses.def: to follow somebody closely
senses.zh: 紧随某人之后；步人后尘

senses.def: to offend or annoy somebody, especially by getting involved in something that is their responsibility
senses.zh: 激怒，得罪，冒犯（尤指因插手他人职责）

examples.en: I don’t want to tread on anybody’s toes so I’ll keep quiet.
examples.zh: 我不想踩到任何人的脚趾，所以我会保持安静。

senses.def: to be in a difficult situation in which you do not have much freedom of action and need to be extremely careful about what you do

examples.en: The government is walking a difficult tightrope in wanting to reduce interest rates without pushing up inflation.
examples.zh: 政府想要在不推高通胀的情况下降低利率，就像在走钢丝一样艰难。

senses.def: to keep yourself in the same place in deep water by moving your arms and legs

examples.zh: 我听到他在楼梯上的沉重脚步声。

examples.zh: 这些轮胎磨损得已低于胎面 1.6 毫米的法定厚度。

examples.zh: 脚踏传动缝纫机

senses.def: work or a way of life that is boring or makes you tired because it involves always doing the same things
senses.zh: 枯燥无味的工作（或生活方式）

examples.en: I'd like to escape the office treadmill.
examples.zh: 我想摆脱办公室的枯燥工作。
