senses.zh: （由人或牲畜踩动踏板使之转动的）踏车

senses.def: an exercise machine that has a moving surface that you can walk or run on while remaining in the same place

examples.en: I try to do half an hour’s exercise on the treadmill every morning.
examples.zh: 我尝试每天早上在跑步机上锻炼半小时。

senses.def: the crime of doing something that could cause danger to your country, such as helping its enemies during a war
senses.zh: 危害国家罪，叛国罪（如战时通敌）

examples.en: an act of high treason against the English crown
examples.zh: 对英国的叛国行为

examples.en: They were charged with treason and sentenced to death.
examples.zh: 他们被指控犯有叛国罪，判了死刑。

senses.def: that can be punished as treason

examples.en: a treasonable act
examples.zh: 叛国行为

senses.def: a collection of valuable things such as gold, silver and jewellery

examples.en: buried treasure
examples.zh: 埋藏的财宝

examples.en: a pirate’s treasure chest
examples.zh: 海盗的财宝箱

senses.def: a highly valued object
senses.zh: 极贵重的物品；珍宝；宝物；珍品

examples.en: the priceless art treasures of the Uffizi Gallery
examples.zh: 乌菲齐美术馆收藏的无价艺术瑰宝

senses.def: a person who is much loved or valued
senses.zh: 备受宠爱（或器重）的人；心肝宝贝儿

examples.en: Liz is an absolute treasure—I couldn’t do without her.
examples.zh: 莉兹绝对是一个宝藏——我离不开她。

senses.def: to have or keep something that you love and that is extremely valuable to you

examples.en: I treasure his friendship.
examples.zh: 我珍重他的友谊。

examples.en: This ring is my most treasured possession.
examples.zh: 这枚戒指是我最珍爱的财产。

examples.en: I shall always treasure the memory of our time together.
examples.zh: 我将永远珍藏我们在一起的那段回忆。

examples.en: Thank you for the watch. I will really treasure it.
examples.zh: 谢谢你的手表。我真的会好好珍惜的。

examples.en: memories that I will treasure for the rest of my days
examples.zh: 我将在余生中珍藏的回忆

senses.def: a place that contains many valuable or interesting things

examples.en: The area is a treasure house of archaeological relics.
examples.zh: 这个地区是古文物遗迹的宝库。

examples.en: The palace is a treasure house of fine antiques.
examples.zh: 这座宫殿是精美古董的宝库。

senses.def: a game in which players try to find a hidden prize by answering a series of questions that have been left in different places
senses.zh: 寻宝游戏（回答问题以获得匿藏的奖品）

senses.def: an adventure story by Robert Louis Stevenson
a US film (1948) that won three Oscars
valuable things that are found hidden and whose owner is unknown
a place, book, etc. containing many useful or beautiful things
senses.zh: 宝藏，宝库（贮藏珍宝、知识等）

senses.def: a person who is responsible for the money and accounts of a club or an organization
senses.zh: （俱乐部或组织的）司库，会计，出纳，财务主管

examples.en: the treasurer of the rugby club
examples.zh: 橄榄球俱乐部的财务主管

senses.def: (in the UK, the US and some other countries) the government department that controls public money
senses.zh: （英国、美国和其他一些国家的）财政部

examples.en: The Treasury is/are refusing to rule out tax rises.
examples.zh: 财政部拒绝排除加税的可能性。

senses.def: a place in a castle, etc. where valuable things are stored
senses.zh: （城堡等中的）金银财宝库，宝库

examples.en: Semi-precious stones were found in the treasury of the old monastery.
examples.zh: 在古老修道院的宝库中发现了半宝石。

examples.en: This must be one of the richest cathedral treasuries in Europe.
examples.zh: 这一定是欧洲最富有的大教堂宝藏之一。

senses.def: a type of investment sold by the US government in which a fixed amount of money is paid back on a certain date
to behave in a particular way towards somebody/something
senses.zh: 以…态度对待；以…方式对待

examples.en: to treat people with respect
examples.zh: 尊重他人

examples.en: to treat people with caution/suspicion/dignity
examples.zh: 谨慎/怀疑/有尊严地对待别人

examples.en: Treat your keyboard with care and it should last for years.
examples.zh: 爱惜你的键盘，这样就可以使用很多年。

examples.en: All candidates will be treated equally, regardless of age.
examples.zh: 所有候选人无论年龄大小，都将受到平等对待。

examples.en: They treat their animals quite badly.
examples.zh: 他们对自己养的动物很不好。

examples.en: She felt unfairly treated.
examples.zh: 她感觉自己受到了不公平的对待。

examples.en: My parents still treat me like a child.
examples.zh: 我父母仍然把我当成孩子。

examples.en: He was treated as a hero on his release from prison.
examples.zh: 他获释出狱时被当成英雄看待。

examples.en: They treat him as if he weren't even there.
examples.zh: 他们对待他就好像他根本不存在一样。

senses.def: to consider something in a particular way

examples.en: I decided to treat his remark as a joke.
examples.zh: 我决定把他的话当作戏言。

senses.def: to deal with or discuss something in a particular way

examples.en: The question is treated in more detail in the next chapter.
examples.zh: 下一章中对这一问题有更详尽的阐述。

examples.en: These allegations are being treated very seriously indeed.
examples.zh: 这些指控确实正受到认真的对待。

examples.en: All cases involving children are treated as urgent.
examples.zh: 所有涉及孩子的案件都做急案处理。

senses.def: to give medical care or attention to a person, an illness, an injury, etc.

examples.en: She was treated for sunstroke.
examples.zh: 她因中暑而接受治疗。

examples.en: The students involved were treated for head injuries.
examples.zh: 涉事学生头部受伤接受治疗。

examples.en: The clinic has treated several thousand patients free of charge .
examples.zh: 该诊所已免费治疗了数千名患者。

examples.en: She was treated in hospital.
examples.zh: 她在医院接受治疗。

examples.en: He was treated for depression with medication prescribed by his doctor.
examples.zh: 他接受了医生开出的药物治疗抑郁症。

examples.en: to treat a disease/a condition/cancer
examples.zh: 治病；治疗癌症

examples.en: The hospital treated forty cases of malaria last year.
examples.zh: 该医院去年治疗了四十例疟疾病例。

examples.en: Antibiotics are used to treat bacterial infections.
examples.zh: 抗生素用于治疗细菌感染。

examples.en: The condition is usually treated with drugs and a strict diet.
examples.zh: 这种病通常用药物和严格控制饮食进行治疗。

senses.def: to use a chemical substance or process to clean, protect, preserve, etc. something
senses.zh: （利用化学物质或反应）处理，保护，保存

examples.en: to treat crops with insecticide
examples.zh: 给庄稼喷洒杀虫剂

examples.en: wood treated with preservative
examples.zh: 经过防腐处理的木材

senses.def: to pay for something that somebody/you will enjoy and that you do not usually have or do
senses.zh: 招待；款待；请（客）；买（可享受的东西）

examples.en: She treated him to lunch.
examples.zh: 她请他吃午饭。

examples.en: Don't worry about the cost—I'll treat you.
examples.zh: 别担心费用，我来替你付。

examples.en: I'm going to treat myself to a new pair of shoes.
examples.zh: 我打算给自己买双新鞋。

senses.group: pay for something pleasant 花钱享受

senses.def: to treat somebody with no respect at all
senses.zh: 视某人如粪土；把…视为草芥；蔑视

examples.en: They treat their workers like dirt.
examples.zh: 他们把工人看得粪土不如。

senses.group: pay for something pleasant 花钱享受

senses.def: something very pleasant that somebody can enjoy, especially something that you give somebody or do for them

examples.en: When I was young chocolate was a treat.
examples.zh: 我年轻的时候，吃巧克力是一种难得的享受。

examples.en: We took the kids to the zoo as a special treat.
examples.zh: 我们特地带孩子们到动物园去，让他们开心一下。

examples.en: You've never been to this area before? Then you're in for a real treat.
examples.zh: 你以前从来没有到过这一地区？那么你一定会喜之不尽。

examples.en: Let's go out for lunch—my treat (= I will pay).
examples.zh: 咱们到外面去吃午餐，我请客。

senses.group: pay for something pleasant 花钱享受

examples.en: His idea worked a treat (= was successful).
examples.zh: 他的主意棒极了。

examples.en: I don’t know whether she can act but she looks a treat.
examples.zh: 我不知道她是否能演, 但她看上去挺行。

senses.group: pay for something pleasant 花钱享受

intro.en: These are all words for things that make you happy or that you enjoy.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指令人愉快、高兴的事。

items.def: a thing that makes you happy or satisfied:
items.zh: 乐事；快事

examples.en: the pleasures and pains of everyday life
examples.zh: 日常生活的苦与乐

items.def: a thing or person that brings you great pleasure:
items.zh: 指令人高兴的事或人、乐事、乐趣

examples.en: the delights of living in the country
examples.zh: 生活在乡村的乐趣

items.def: a thing or person that brings you great pleasure or happiness:
items.zh: 指令人高兴的事或人、乐事、乐趣

examples.en: the joys and sorrows of childhood
examples.zh: 童年的欢乐与悲伤

items.def: (rather formal) something that you are proud and lucky to have the opportunity to do:
items.zh: 指荣幸、荣耀、光荣

examples.en: It was a great privilege to hear her sing.
examples.zh: 听她唱歌是莫大的荣幸。

items.def: (informal) a thing that somebody enjoyed or is likely to enjoy very much:
items.zh: 指乐事、乐趣

examples.en: You’ve never been to this area before? Then you’re in for a real treat.
examples.zh: 你以前从来没有到过这一地区？那么你一定会喜之不尽。

items.def: (formal) something that you are very pleased or proud to do because people are showing you great respect:
items.zh: 指荣幸、光荣

examples.en: It was a great honour to be invited here today.
examples.zh: 今天承蒙邀请到此，深感荣幸。

senses.def: to treat somebody with no respect at all
senses.zh: 视某人如粪土；把…视为草芥；蔑视

examples.en: They treat their workers like dirt.
examples.zh: 他们把工人看得粪土不如。

senses.def: to entertain somebody with something special

examples.en: The crowd were treated to a superb display of tennis.
examples.zh: 观众看了一场非常精彩的网球赛，大饱眼福。

senses.def: that can be made better with medical care

examples.en: a treatable infection
examples.zh: 可治疗的感染

senses.def: a long and serious piece of writing on a particular subject

examples.en: ‘A Treatise on Probability’ by John Maynard Keynes
examples.zh: 约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯的《概率论》

examples.en: Any of these questions would deserve a lengthy treatise, perhaps even a small book.
examples.zh: 这些问题中的任何一个都值得写一篇长论文，甚至是一本小书来探讨。

senses.def: something that is done to cure an illness or injury, or to make somebody look and feel good

examples.en: The drug is used in the treatment of depression.
examples.zh: 该药用于治疗抑郁症。

examples.en: He is receiving treatment for shock.
examples.zh: 他正在接受休克治疗。

examples.en: She has been undergoing cancer treatment.
examples.zh: 她一直在接受癌症治疗。

examples.en: He may have to seek treatment abroad.
examples.zh: 他可能需要到国外寻求治疗。

examples.en: These bites rarely require treatment.
examples.zh: 这些叮咬很少需要治疗。

examples.en: Two motorists needed hospital treatment following the accident.
examples.zh: 事故发生后，两名驾车者需要住院治疗。

examples.en: The centre provides treatment to young drug addicts.
examples.zh: 该中心为年轻吸毒者提供治疗。

examples.en: She is responding well to treatment.
examples.zh: 她经过治疗大有起色。

examples.en: to require hospital/medical treatment
examples.zh: 需要住院／药物治疗

examples.en: No effective treatment exists for this highly infectious disease.
examples.zh: 对于这种高度传染性疾病，尚无有效的治疗方法。

examples.en: There are various treatments available for this condition.
examples.zh: 对这种病有各种疗法。

examples.en: Guests at the health spa receive a range of beauty treatments.
examples.zh: 客人在休闲健身中心可接受各种美容服务。

senses.def: a way of behaving towards or dealing with a person or thing

examples.en: the brutal treatment of political prisoners
examples.zh: 对政治犯的残酷虐待

examples.en: Certain city areas have been singled out for special treatment.
examples.zh: 某些城区已划出要进行特别治理。

examples.en: Why does she always get preferential treatment (= treatment that is better than other people get)?
examples.zh: 为什么她总是得到优待（=比其他人得到的待遇更好）？

senses.def: a way of dealing with or discussing a subject, work of art, etc.

examples.en: Shakespeare’s treatment of madness in ‘King Lear’
examples.zh: 莎士比亚在《李尔王》中对疯癫的处理手法

senses.def: a process by which something is cleaned, or protected against something

examples.en: a sewage treatment plant
examples.zh: 污水处理厂

examples.en: an effective treatment for dry rot
examples.zh: 防治干腐病的有效方法

senses.def: a formal agreement between two or more countries

examples.en: the Treaty of Rome
examples.zh: 《罗马条约》

examples.en: a peace treaty
examples.zh: 和平协定

examples.en: to draw up/sign/ratify a treaty
examples.zh: 起草／签署／正式批准条约

examples.en: Under the terms of the treaty, La Rochelle was ceded to the English.
examples.zh: 根据这个条约的条款，拉罗谢尔割让给了英国人。

senses.def: an agreement which was signed in 1997 by EU
the high tones or part in music or a sound system

senses.def: angry or slightly aggressive behaviour that may cause an argument
senses.zh: 顽强：可能引起争执的愤怒或稍有攻击性的行为

senses.def: tending to argue or become angry; slightly aggressive
senses.zh: 爱争吵的；粗暴的；好斗的；寻衅的

examples.en: ‘What do you want?’ he asked, sounding slightly truculent.
examples.zh: “你想要什么？”他问道，听起来有些好斗。

senses.def: in an angry or slightly aggressive way that may cause an argument
senses.zh: 顽强地：以愤怒或稍有攻击性的方式可能引起争论

senses.def: to walk slowly or with heavy steps, because you are tired or carrying something heavy
senses.zh: （因疲劳或负重而）步履沉重地走，缓慢地走，费力地走

examples.en: He trudged the last two miles to the town.
examples.zh: 他步履艰难地走完最后两英里到了城里。

examples.en: The men trudged up the hill, laden with supplies.
examples.zh: 这些人背着补给品疲惫地往山上爬。

examples.en: We spent the morning trudging around the mall looking for a suitable gift.
examples.zh: 我们花了一上午的时间在商场里跋涉寻找合适的礼物。

senses.def: a long walk that makes you tired
senses.zh: 长途跋涉；疲惫的长途步行

senses.def: a first name for girls, sometimes short for Gertrude
senses.zh: 特鲁迪（过去常用女子名，有时为 Gertrude 缩写）

senses.def: connected with facts rather than things that have been invented or guessed
senses.zh: 符合事实的；确实的；如实的

examples.en: Indicate whether the following statements are true or false.
examples.zh: 标出下列说法是对还是错。

examples.en: Can you prove that what you say is true?
examples.zh: 你能证明你说的是真的吗？

examples.en: All the rumours turned out to be true.
examples.zh: 所有的传闻结果都确有其事。

examples.en: Is it true she's leaving?
examples.zh: 她要走是真的吗？

examples.en: It is certainly true that money can't buy you happiness.
examples.zh: 金钱确实买不到幸福，这确实是事实。

examples.en: I think it would be true to say that the show was a success.
examples.zh: 我认为可以说这个节目是成功的。

examples.en: That's not strictly (= completely) true.
examples.zh: 那不完全正确。

examples.en: The novel is based on a true story.
examples.zh: 这部小说是根据真人真事写成的。

examples.en: Unfortunately, these findings do not hold true (= are not valid) for women and children.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，这些调查结果不适用于妇女和儿童。

examples.en: Exercise can help in the development of social skills, and this is especially true for kids playing team sports.
examples.zh: 锻炼有助于发展社交技能，对于参加团队运动的孩子尤其如此。

examples.en: The music is dull and uninspiring, and the same is true of the acting.
examples.zh: 音乐沉闷枯燥毫不动人，表演也是。

examples.en: You never spoke a truer word (= used to emphasize that you agree with what somebody has just said).
examples.zh: 你说的一点不假。

senses.def: real or exact, especially when this is different from how something seems
senses.zh: 实质的，真正的（而非表面上的）

examples.en: the true face of war (= what it is really like rather than what people think it is like)
examples.zh: 战争的真实面目

examples.en: This project demonstrates the true value of teamwork.
examples.zh: 项目展示了团队合作的真正价值。

examples.en: The true cost of these experiments to the environment will not be known for years to come.
examples.zh: 这些实验对环境造成的确切代价在未来数年内是看不见的。

examples.en: He reveals his true character to very few people.
examples.zh: 他没有向什么人显露过他的真实性格。

examples.en: I did not realize the true nature of their relationship.
examples.zh: 我当时没意识到他们关系的真正性质。

examples.en: She was unable to hide her true feelings for him.
examples.zh: 她无法掩饰自己对他的真实感情。

senses.def: having the qualities or characteristics of the thing mentioned

examples.en: It was true love between them.
examples.zh: 他们是真心相爱。

examples.en: He's a true gentleman.
examples.zh: 他是个正人君子。

examples.en: The painting is a masterpiece in the truest sense of the word.
examples.zh: 这幅画是名副其实的杰作。

examples.en: He is credited with inventing the first true helicopter.
examples.zh: 他被认为是发明第一架真正的直升机的人。

senses.def: used to admit that a particular fact or statement is correct, although you think that something else is more important
senses.zh: （承认事实或说法正确，但有更重要的考虑）确实，的确

examples.en: It's true that he could do the job, but would he fit in with the rest of the team?
examples.zh: 他确实能做这项工作，但他是否能和团队其他人配合得好呢？

examples.en: It's perfectly true that I didn't help much, but I was busy.
examples.zh: 我的确没有帮什么忙，我太忙了。

examples.en: ‘We could get it cheaper.’ ‘True, but would it be as good?’
examples.zh: “我们可以买得再便宜一点儿。”“话是这么说，但是质量是不是一样好呢？”

examples.en: True enough, but that doesn't tell the whole story.
examples.zh: 确实如此，但这并不能说明全部故事。

senses.def: showing respect and support for a particular person or belief in a way that does not change, even in different situations
senses.zh: 忠诚的；忠心耿耿的；忠实的

examples.en: a true friend
examples.zh: 忠实的朋友

examples.en: She has always been true to herself (= done what she thought was good, right, etc.).
examples.zh: 她一贯坚持按自己的信念办事。

examples.en: He was true to his word (= did what he promised to do).
examples.zh: 他信守诺言。

examples.en: Many were executed for remaining true to their principles.
examples.zh: 许多人因忠于自己的原则而被处死。

examples.en: Knights swore to be true to their lord.
examples.zh: 骑士们发誓忠于他们的领主。

senses.def: being an accurate version or copy of something
senses.zh: 精确的；与正本无异的；逼真的

examples.en: The movie is not true to the book.
examples.zh: 这部电影并非忠于原著。

examples.en: The painting is a true likeness of her.
examples.zh: 这幅画是她的真实写照。

senses.def: straight and accurate

examples.en: His aim was true (= he hit the target).
examples.zh: 他瞄得很准。

senses.def: to become reality

examples.en: Winning the medal was like a dream come true.
examples.zh: 获得这枚奖牌好比梦想成真。

examples.en: All her wishes came true.
examples.zh: 她所有的愿望都实现了。

senses.def: to give the impression of being sincere/true or not sincere/true
senses.zh: 给人以真实（或空洞、虚假）的印象

examples.en: It may seem a strange story but it rings true to me.
examples.zh: 这个故事也许显得离奇，但我却觉得很真实。

examples.en: His expressions of support rang rather hollow.
examples.zh: 他表达的支持听起来相当空洞。

examples.en: His promise rang hollow.
examples.zh: 他的承诺听起来很空洞。

senses.def: used to say that you cannot believe that something is as good as it seems

examples.en: ‘I'm afraid you were quoted the wrong price.’ ‘I thought it was too good to be true.’
examples.zh: “很抱歉，给你报错价了。”“我也觉得价格低得令人难以置信。”

senses.def: that you have used or relied on in the past successfully
senses.zh: 经过考验的；可靠的；可信赖的

examples.en: a tried and true method for solving the problem
examples.zh: 解决问题的可靠方法

senses.def: your real character, rather than the one that you usually allow other people to see

examples.en: It was only after they got married that he showed himself in his true colours.
examples.zh: 结婚之后他才露出了真面目。

senses.def: used to say that somebody is behaving in the way that you expect them to behave, especially when this is annoying
senses.zh: 跟往常一样；一如既往；合乎本性

examples.en: True to form, she managed to upset everyone before leaving.
examples.zh: 一如既往，她在离开前设法让每个人都感到不安。

senses.def: seeming real rather than invented
senses.zh: 真实的；逼真的；惟妙惟肖；活灵活现

examples.en: I don’t think the characters are very true to life.
examples.zh: 我觉得这些人物不是很真实。

senses.def: in a direct line

examples.en: The arrow flew straight and true to the target.
examples.zh: 箭不偏不斜地朝靶子飞去。

examples.en: He shot true.
examples.zh: 他开枪是真的。

senses.def: to tell the truth

examples.en: He had spoken truer than he knew.
examples.zh: 他说得比他知道的还确切。

examples.zh: 忠于保守党的投票人

senses.zh: （对人、团体、原则等）忠贞不渝的，坚定不移的；典型的；有代表性的

examples.en: a true-blue Californian
examples.zh: 典型的加利福尼亚人

senses.def: a US magazine that contains articles which are supposed to be true stories written by ordinary people about their love and marriage problems. They are written in a very romantic and emotional way. The magazine is now only available online.
senses.zh: 真实的自白：美国杂志，其中载有被认为是由普通人撰写的有关他们的爱情和婚姻问题的真实故事的文章。他们以非常浪漫和情感的方式写作。该杂志现在仅可在线获得。

senses.def: a genre of book, film, etc. that examines or tells the story of a real crime
senses.zh: 真实罪案（书、电影等的一种类型，分析或讲述真实犯罪案例）

examples.en: It's a true crime story in which truth is stranger than fiction.
examples.zh: 这是一个真实的犯罪故事，真相比小说更离奇。

examples.en: He presented a series of true crime documentaries highlighting unique or elaborate crimes.
examples.zh: 他制作了一系列真实的犯罪纪录片，突出了独特或精心策划的犯罪行为。

senses.def: a true-life
senses.zh: 真人真事的；确有其事的；写实的

senses.def: north according to the earth’s axis
senses.zh: 真北（以地轴北极为正北）

senses.def: a technology that uses Bluetooth™
senses.zh: 真无线（利用蓝牙技术连接电子设备和耳机，不用任何线材）

examples.en: I'm looking for some affordable true wireless stereo earphones.
examples.zh: 我正在找价格适中的真无线立体声耳机。

senses.def: an expensive type of fungus
senses.zh: 块菌（生长于地下，可食用，价格昂贵）

senses.def: a soft round sweet made of chocolate
a shallow basket
a statement that is clearly true and does not therefore add anything interesting or important to a discussion
senses.zh: 不言而喻的道理；自明之理；老生常谈

examples.en: It has become a truism that every woman wants to choose how she delivers her baby.
examples.zh: 每个女人都想选择自己的分娩方式，这已成为不言而喻的事实。

senses.def: used to emphasize that a particular statement, feeling, etc. is sincere or real
senses.zh: （用于说法、感觉等）真诚地，诚恳地，衷心地

examples.en: She truly believes that none of this is her fault.
examples.zh: 她真的认为这一切都不是她的错。

examples.en: I'm truly sorry that things had to end like this.
examples.zh: 事情落到这样的结局，我从内心里感到歉疚。

examples.en: I felt truly at home.
examples.zh: 我感到真正宾至如归。

examples.en: I do care. Truly, I do!
examples.zh: 我真的在乎。真的，我愿意！

examples.en: Does she truly love him?
examples.zh: 她真的爱他吗？

examples.en: He could never truly forgive her.
examples.zh: 他永远无法真正原谅她。

examples.en: He truly wants to improve the town.
examples.zh: 他真心实意地想改善这个小镇。

senses.def: used to emphasize a particular quality

examples.en: The results are truly amazing.
examples.zh: 结果真是太惊人了。

examples.en: It's a truly remarkable movie.
examples.zh: 这是一部真正了不起的电影。

examples.en: a truly great work of art
examples.zh: 真正伟大的艺术作品

examples.en: a truly memorable occasion
examples.zh: 的确值得纪念的盛事

examples.en: a truly magnificent performance
examples.zh: 真正精彩的表演

senses.def: used to emphasize that a particular description is accurate or correct

examples.en: a truly democratic system of government
examples.zh: 真正的民主政体

examples.en: Well, really and truly, things were better than expected.
examples.zh: 啊，情况的的确确比预计的要好。

examples.en: He started the first truly international ballet company.
examples.zh: 他创办了第一个真正的国际芭蕾舞团。

examples.en: They truly understand what we're going through.
examples.zh: 他们真正理解我们正在经历的事情。

examples.en: a brand that is truly global
examples.zh: 一个真正的全球品牌

senses.def: completely

examples.en: By that time we were well and truly lost.
examples.zh: 那时候我们已经完全迷路了。

senses.def: used at the end of a formal letter before you sign your name
I/me

examples.en: Steve came first, Robin second, and yours truly came last.
examples.zh: 史蒂夫最先，罗宾第二，鄙人最后。

senses.zh: 杜鲁门·卡波特（Truman Capote）：（1924-84）美国作家。他最著名的作品是《蒂凡尼的早餐》（1958年）和“非小说类小说”《冷血》（1966年）。电影版本都是由这两本书组成。卡波特（Capote）在纽约社会成员中很受欢迎，但后来因写了一些不愉快的事情而被拒绝。

senses.def: (in some card games) a card that belongs to the suit
senses.zh: （某些纸牌游戏的一张）王牌，主牌，将牌

examples.en: I played a trump and won the trick.
examples.zh: 我打出一张主牌，赢了那一墩。

senses.def: (in some card games) the suit
senses.zh: （某些纸牌游戏的）王牌花色，主牌花色

examples.en: What's trumps?
examples.zh: 王牌是什么？

examples.en: Clubs are trumps.
examples.zh: 梅花是主牌。

examples.en: Trumps is/are the suit with the highest value.
examples.zh: 王牌是价值最高的套装。

senses.def: to do what is necessary to make a particular situation successful, especially when this is sudden or unexpected
senses.zh: 打出王牌；做有助于获得（意外）成功的事

examples.en: I didn't honestly think he'd pass the exam but he came up trumps on the day.
examples.zh: 说实话我以为他考试及不了格，但是那天他发挥出色，考得不错。

examples.en: Just when we thought there was no hope, my parents turned up trumps with a large loan.
examples.zh: 就在我们以为已经没有希望的时候，我的父母突然拿出了一大笔贷款。

senses.def: to play a trump card
senses.zh: 出王牌赢（牌）；出王牌压掉（他人的牌）

examples.en: They were trumped by another firm that made a lower bid.
examples.zh: 他们被另一家出价较低的公司击败。

examples.zh: 他不需要打出王牌，就能得到他想要的东西。

examples.zh: 许多私立学校将小班授课作为营销活动的王牌。

examples.zh: 他指控其对手为了政治原因诬陷他。

examples.zh: 她以莫须有的罪名被捕。

senses.zh: 喇叭形物；（尤指）绽开的水仙花

examples.zh: 他们的联姻被宣扬成年度婚礼。

examples.zh: 4 月 19 日，《泰晤士报》大肆宣扬，“首相将在选举中取得压倒性胜利”。

examples.zh: 我的文章以节录的形式发表了。

examples.zh: 【数】 斜截棱锥.

examples.zh: 因上了茶水, 深入讨论缩短了。

senses.zh: 截短，缩短，删节（尤指掐头或去尾）

examples.en: The restaurant's name is a truncation of the words ‘France Origine’.
examples.zh: 餐厅的名字是“France Origine”一词的缩写。

senses.def: a short thick stick that police officers carry as a weapon

examples.en: Some of the prisoners were beaten about the head with rubber truncheons.
examples.zh: 一些囚犯头部遭到橡皮警棍的击打。

senses.def: to move or roll somewhere slowly and noisily; to move something with wheels slowly and noisily, especially something heavy

examples.en: A train trundled across the bridge.
examples.zh: 一列火车隆隆驶过大桥。

senses.def: to walk slowly with heavy steps
a low bed that can be stored under a higher bed
senses.zh: （可推入另一张床下面的）带轮矮床

examples.en: A trundle bed is a great solution for occasional guests.
examples.zh: 对于偶尔来访的客人来说，小轮床是一个很好的解决方案。

senses.def: to mention or do something that you have often mentioned or done before

examples.en: A long list of reasons was trundled out to justify their demands.
examples.zh: 他们重复一大串理由，说明他们的要求正当。

senses.def: the thick main stem

examples.en: an instrument made from a hollowed-out tree trunk
examples.zh: 用挖空的树干制成的工具

senses.def: the space at the back of a car that you put bags, cases, etc. in

examples.en: He slammed the trunk shut.
examples.zh: 他砰地关上了行李箱。

examples.en: She popped the trunk and we tossed the stuff inside.
examples.zh: 她打开行李箱，我们就把东西扔了进去。

senses.def: the long nose of an elephant
a piece of clothing covering the lower part of the body and sometimes the top part of the legs, worn by men and boys for swimming
a large, strong box with a lid

examples.en: I found the documents at the bottom of an old tin trunk in the attic.
examples.zh: 我在阁楼上一个旧铁皮箱子的底部找到了那些文件。

examples.en: She was packing her school trunk.
examples.zh: 她正在收拾学校的行李箱。

senses.def: the main part of the human body apart from the head, arms and legs
a phone call to a place that is a long distance away but in the same country
an important main road

examples.en: Over a 1 000 miles of new trunk roads and motorways have been built.
examples.zh: 已建成超过 1000 英里的新主干道路和高速公路。

examples.en: The M40 motorway and the A34 trunk road make the town easily accessible.
examples.zh: M40高速公路和A34主干道使该镇交通便利。

senses.def: the administrative
senses.zh: 特鲁罗（英格兰西南部康沃尔郡城市）

senses.def: a special belt with a thick piece of material, worn by somebody who has a hernia
a frame made of pieces of wood or metal used to support a roof, bridge, etc.
senses.zh: （支撑屋顶、桥梁等的）桁架，构架

senses.def: to tie up somebody’s arms and legs so that they cannot move
senses.zh: 把（人的双臂和双腿）捆紧，缚牢

examples.en: The guard had been gagged and trussed up.
examples.zh: 警卫的嘴被堵住并被捆起来。

senses.def: to tie the legs and wings of a chicken, etc. before it is cooked
senses.zh: （在烹煮鸡等前）把腿和翅膀束紧

senses.def: the belief that somebody/something is good, sincere, honest, etc. and will not try to harm or trick you

examples.en: Our partnership is based on trust.
examples.zh: 我们的伙伴关系建立在互相信任的基础上。

examples.en: This is a relationship built on mutual trust.
examples.zh: 这是一种建立在相互信任基础上的关系。

examples.en: It has taken years to earn their trust.
examples.zh: 花了好多年才赢得他们的信任。

examples.en: We worked hard to gain the trust of local people.
examples.zh: 我们努力赢得当地人民的信任。

examples.en: Talking openly with your team helps to build trust.
examples.zh: 与您的团队开诚布公地交谈有助于建立信任。

examples.en: Her trust in him was unfounded.
examples.zh: 她对他的信任毫无道理。

examples.en: If you put your trust in me, I will not let you down.
examples.zh: 你要是信赖我，我就不会让你失望。

examples.en: I want to thank all those people who have placed their trust in me.
examples.zh: 我要感谢所有信任我的人。

examples.en: She will not betray your trust (= do something that you have asked her not to do).
examples.zh: 她不会辜负你对她的信任。

examples.en: He was appointed to a position of trust (= a job involving a lot of responsibility, because people trust him).
examples.zh: 他被委以重任。

examples.en: This is a serious breach of trust.
examples.zh: 这是严重的背信行为。

examples.en: The company has to earn the trust and confidence of consumers again.
examples.zh: 公司必须再次赢得消费者的信任和信心。

examples.en: There is a lack of trust between the two countries.
examples.zh: 两国之间缺乏信任。

senses.def: the belief that something is true or correct or that you can rely on it

examples.en: We place so much trust in computers that it gets a little scary.
examples.zh: 我们对计算机如此信赖，真让人有点害怕。

examples.en: Voters need to have trust in the voting system.
examples.zh: 选民需要对投票系统有信任。

examples.en: Public trust in science is harmed by inaccurate journalism.
examples.zh: 不准确的新闻报道破坏了公众对科学的信任。

examples.en: If I were you, I would not place too much trust in their findings.
examples.zh: 如果我是你，我不会太相信他们的发现。

senses.def: an arrangement by which an organization or a group of people has legal control of money or property that has been given to somebody, usually until that person reaches a particular age; an amount of money or property that is controlled in this way

examples.en: He set up a trust for his children.
examples.zh: 他为子女安排好了信托财产。

examples.en: The money will be held in trust until she is 18.
examples.zh: 这笔钱将由人代管到她 18 岁为止。

examples.en: Our fees depend on the value of the trust.
examples.zh: 我们的费用视信托金额而定。

senses.def: an organization or a group of people that invests money that is given or lent to it and uses the profits to help a charity
senses.zh: 受托基金机构；受托团体

examples.en: a charitable trust
examples.zh: 慈善基金机构

senses.def: a group of companies that work together illegally to reduce competition, control prices, etc.
senses.zh: 托拉斯（为减少竞争、操纵价格等而非法联合的企业组织）

examples.en: anti-trust laws
examples.zh: 反托拉斯法

senses.def: being taken care of by somebody

examples.en: The family pet was left in the trust of a neighbour.
examples.zh: 这家的宠物委托邻居代管。

senses.def: to believe what somebody says even though you do not have any proof or evidence to show that it is true
to have confidence in somebody; to believe that somebody is good, sincere, honest, etc.
senses.zh: 信任；信赖；相信（某人的善良、真诚等）

examples.en: She trusts Alan implicitly.
examples.zh: 她绝对信任艾伦。

examples.en: He has shown that he can't be trusted.
examples.zh: 他已经表现出自己不可信。

examples.en: Never trust a man who will not look you in the eye.
examples.zh: 永远不要相信一个不看你眼睛的男人。

examples.en: a trusted adviser/friend
examples.zh: 可依赖的顾问／朋友

examples.en: You can trust me not to tell anyone.
examples.zh: 你可以相信我不会跟任何人讲。

examples.en: She nodded, not trusting herself to speak.
examples.zh: 她点点头，不相信自己能开口说话。

examples.en: Which party do you trust to run the economy?
examples.zh: 您信任哪个政党来管理经济？

senses.def: to believe that something is true or correct or that you can rely on it

examples.en: He trusted her judgement.
examples.zh: 他相信她的判断力。

examples.en: Always trust your instincts.
examples.zh: 永远相信你的直觉。

examples.en: a trusted source
examples.zh: 值得信赖的来源

examples.en: Don't trust what the newspapers say!
examples.zh: 别相信报纸上的话！

senses.def: to hope and expect that something is true

examples.en: I trust (that) you have no objections to our proposals?
examples.zh: 我想你不反对我们的建议吧？

senses.def: to not trust somebody at all

examples.en: He says he just wants to help you but I wouldn’t trust him an inch if I were you.
examples.zh: 他说他只是想帮帮你，可我要是你的话，绝对不会相信他。

senses.def: that you have used or relied on in the past successfully
senses.zh: 经过考验的；可靠的；可信赖的

examples.en: a tried and trusted method for solving the problem
examples.zh: 一种经过验证且值得信赖的解决问题的方法

examples.en: Some teachers prefer the tried and trusted methods of language learning.
examples.zh: 一些教师更喜欢经过考验且值得信赖的语言学习方法。

senses.def: used when somebody does or says something that you think is typical of them
senses.zh: （认为某人言行一贯如此时说）管保，保证

examples.en: Trust John to forget Sue's birthday!
examples.zh: 管保约翰会把休的生日忘了！

items.idm: in somebody’s trust | in the trust of somebody

senses.def: being taken care of by somebody

examples.en: The family pet was left in the trust of a neighbour.
examples.zh: 这家的宠物委托邻居代管。

senses.def: to believe what somebody says even though you do not have any proof or evidence to show that it is true
to not trust somebody at all

examples.en: He says he just wants to help you but I wouldn’t trust him an inch if I were you.

senses.def: that you have used or relied on in the past successfully
senses.zh: 经过考验的；可靠的；可信赖的

examples.en: a tried and trusted method for solving the problem
examples.zh: 一种经过验证且值得信赖的解决问题的方法

examples.en: Some teachers prefer the tried and trusted methods of language learning.
examples.zh: 一些教师更喜欢经过考验且值得信赖的语言学习方法。

examples.zh: 管保约翰会把休的生日忘了！

synonyms.words: depend on somebody/​something ▪ rely on somebody/​something ▪ count on somebody/​something ▪ believe in somebody

intro.en: These words all mean to believe that somebody/​something will do what you hope or expect of them or that what they tell you is correct or true.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含相信、信任、信赖之义。

items.def: to believe that somebody is good, honest, sincere, etc. and that they will do what you expect of them or do the right thing; to believe that something is true or correct:
items.zh: 指相信、信任、信赖

examples.en: You can trust me not to tell anyone.
examples.zh: 你可以相信我不会跟任何人讲。

items.def: (often used with can/​cannot/​could/​could not) to trust somebody/​something to do what you expect or want, to do the right thing, or to be true or correct:
items.zh: （常与 can/cannot/could/could not 连用）指相信、信赖、指望

examples.en: He was the sort of person you could depend on.
examples.zh: 他是你可以信赖的人。

items.def: (used especially with can/​cannot/​could/​could not and should/​should not) to trust somebody/​something to do what you expect or want, or to be honest, correct or good enough:
items.zh: （尤与 can/cannot/could/could not 和 should/should not 连用）指信任、信赖

examples.en: Can I rely on you to keep this secret?
examples.zh: 我能相信你会保守这个秘密吗？

items.def: (often used with can/​cannot/​could/​could not) to be sure that somebody will do what you need them to do, or that something will happen as you want it to happen:
items.zh: （常与 can/cannot/could/could not 连用）指可信赖、依靠、指望（某人做某事）、确信（某事会发生）

examples.en: I’m counting on you to help me.
examples.zh: 我就靠你帮我啦。

items.def: to feel that you can trust somebody and/​or that they will be successful:
items.zh: 指信赖、信任、相信某人会成功

examples.en: They need a leader they can believe in.
examples.zh: 他们需要一个可以信赖的领导。

senses.def: money that is controlled for somebody by an organization or a group of people

examples.en: She set up a trust fund for her children.
examples.zh: 她为她的孩子设立了一个信托基金。

senses.def: to have confidence in somebody/something; to believe that somebody/something is good and can be relied on

examples.en: She needs to trust more in her own abilities.
examples.zh: 她需要更加相信自己的能力。

examples.en: You have to trust in the competence of others.
examples.zh: 你必须信任别人的能力。

senses.def: a region governed by the United Nations Organization or by another country that has been chosen by the United Nations Organization
senses.zh: （联合国或其委托国家的）托管领地

senses.def: to put your confidence in something such as luck, chance, etc. because there is nothing else to help you

examples.en: I stumbled along in the dark, trusting to luck to find the right door.
examples.zh: 我摸黑跌跌撞撞地往前走，希望凭运气能找对门。

senses.def: to give something/somebody to a person to take care of because you believe they would be very careful with it/them
senses.zh: 托付；托交；把…委托给某人照管

examples.en: I'd trust her with my life.
examples.zh: 她是我可以性命相托的人。

examples.en: He is not to be trusted with other people's money.
examples.zh: 不可把别人的钱托给他保管。

senses.def: a young person from a rich family who does not need to work, but likes to pretend to reject the way that rich people live
senses.zh: 来自富裕家庭的年轻人，他不需要工作，但喜欢假装拒绝富人的生活方式

examples.en: He’s a trustafarian with society connections and a hippie lifestyle.
examples.zh: 他是一个有社会关系和嬉皮生活方式的信任主义者。

examples.en: The place was full of trustafarian posers.
examples.zh: 这个地方到处都是托拉斯的装腔作势者。

senses.def: a person or an organization that has control of money or property that has been put into a trust

examples.en: The bank will act as trustees for the estate until the child is 18.
examples.zh: 银行将充当财产的信托机构，直到孩子 18 岁。

senses.def: a member of a group of people that controls the financial affairs and decides the policy of a charity or other organization
senses.zh: （慈善事业或其他机构的）受托人

examples.en: the board of trustees
examples.zh: 信托理事会

examples.en: a trustee of the hospice
examples.zh: 临终关怀中心的受托人

examples.en: the trustees of the National Gallery
examples.zh: 国家美术馆的受托人

examples.en: a trustee of the museum
examples.zh: 博物馆的受托管理人

senses.def: the job of being a trustee
the responsibility for governing a particular region, given to a country by the United Nations Organization; a region that is governed by another country in this way
senses.zh: 托管（联合国委托某一国家管理某一地区）；托管地区

examples.en: a period of trusteeship
examples.zh: 托管期间

examples.en: Burundi was formerly a Belgian trusteeship.
examples.zh: 布隆迪以前是比利时托管地。

senses.def: in a way that shows you are willing to believe that other people are good, honest, etc.
senses.zh: 轻信的；轻易信赖别人的

senses.def: the quality of always being good, honest, sincere, etc. so that people can rely on you

examples.en: It was a chance to prove his trustworthiness to them.
examples.zh: 这是一个向他们证明他的可信度的机会。

senses.def: that you can rely on to be good, honest, sincere, etc.
senses.zh: 值得信任的；可信赖的；可靠的

examples.en: Mitchell was a solid and trustworthy man.
examples.zh: 米切尔是一个坚定而值得信赖的人。

examples.en: Women were seen as more trustworthy and harder working.
examples.zh: 女性被认为更可信赖，工作更努力。

senses.def: that you have had a long time and have always been able to rely on
senses.zh: （长期以来）可信任的，可信赖的；忠实的

examples.en: a trusty friend
examples.zh: 忠实的朋友

examples.en: She spent years touring Europe with her trusty old camera.
examples.zh: 她带着她那架忠心耿耿的照相机在欧洲周游多年。

senses.def: a prisoner who is given special advantages because of good behaviour
senses.zh: 模范囚犯（由于表现好而受到优待）

senses.def: the true facts about something, rather than the things that have been invented or guessed
senses.zh: 真相；实情；事实；真实情况

examples.en: Do you think she's telling the truth?
examples.zh: 你认为她在讲实话吗？

examples.en: We are determined to get at (= discover) the truth.
examples.zh: 我们决心查出真相。

examples.en: She had only spoken the truth.
examples.zh: 她只是说了实话。

examples.en: So now you know the truth.
examples.zh: 那么现在你知道实情了。

examples.en: I knew the truth would come out in the end.
examples.zh: 我知道真相最终会水落石出。

examples.en: The truth is that there are no easy answers.
examples.zh: 真实情况是没有显而易见的答案。

examples.en: The truth of the matter is we can’t afford to keep all the staff on.
examples.zh: 实际情况是我们无力继续聘用所有的职员。

examples.en: The sad truth is that, at 72, he is past his prime.
examples.zh: 令人遗憾的是他已72岁了，盛年不再。

examples.en: The simple truth is that new roads just encourage more traffic.
examples.zh: 简单的事实是，新道路只会鼓励更多的交通。

examples.en: I don't think you are telling me the whole truth about what happened.
examples.zh: 我认为你没有把事情的全部真相都告诉我。

examples.en: These documents reveal the truth about his past.
examples.zh: 这些文件揭示了他过去的真相。

examples.en: The awful truth about his disappearance finally dawned on her.
examples.zh: 她终于明白了他失踪的可怕真相。

examples.en: Only recently has the truth behind the killings emerged.
examples.zh: 直到最近，杀戮背后的真相才浮出水面。

examples.en: It’s the gospel truth! (= completely true)
examples.zh: 这是福音真理！ （=完全正确）

examples.en: I honestly don't know, and that's the truth.
examples.zh: 老实说我不知道​​，但这就是事实。

senses.def: the quality or state of being based on fact

examples.en: There is no truth in the rumours.
examples.zh: 这些谣言毫无根据。

examples.en: There is not a grain of truth in what she says.
examples.zh: 她说的没有一句真话。

examples.en: His version of events does contain an element of truth.
examples.zh: 他对事件的描述确实包含一些事实成分。

examples.en: You must be prepared to prove the truth of these allegations.
examples.zh: 您必须准备好证明这些指控的真实性。

senses.def: a fact that is believed by most people to be true

examples.en: universal truths
examples.zh: 普遍真理

examples.en: She was forced to face up to a few unwelcome truths about her family.
examples.zh: 她不得不正视有关她家的几桩尴尬事。

senses.def: if you say that somebody has been economical with the truth
senses.zh: 没把实话全讲出来（婉指某人隐瞒了一些重要事实）

senses.def: to say something that is not completely true

examples.en: I wasn’t exactly lying when I said I hadn’t seen her—I was just bending the truth a little.
examples.zh: 当我说我没有看到她时，我并不是在撒谎——我只是稍微歪曲了事实。

senses.def: used to tell somebody the true facts about a situation, especially when these are not known by other people
senses.zh: （用于说出真相）说实话，说真的，老实说

examples.en: If the truth be known, I was afraid to tell anyone.
examples.zh: 如果要实话实说的话，是我不敢告诉任何人。

senses.def: used to emphasize the true facts about a situation

examples.en: She laughed and chatted but was, in truth, not having much fun.
examples.zh: 她虽然又是笑又是侃，但实际上玩得并不开心。

senses.def: a time when somebody/something is tested, or when important decisions are made
senses.zh: 考验的时刻；（决策的）关键时刻

examples.en: The moment of truth is when the trainee pilots take over the controls of the plane.
examples.zh: 关键时刻是实习飞行员接管飞机控制权的时刻。

senses.def: used to say that a fact or comment is completely false
senses.zh: 大错特错；假到极点；荒谬绝伦

examples.en: She thinks I don’t like her but nothing could be further from the truth.
examples.zh: 她认为我不喜欢她，但事实并非如此。

examples.en: I know you think she's mean, but nothing could be further from the truth.
examples.zh: 我知道你认为她小气，但事实完全不是这样。

senses.def: used when admitting something

examples.en: To tell you the truth, I'll be glad to get home.
examples.zh: 说实话，能回家我会很高兴。

examples.en: I got a bit big-headed, to tell the truth.
examples.zh: 说实话，我有点自大了。

examples.en: To tell you the truth, I'm rather dreading his return.
examples.zh: 跟你说实话吧，我非常害怕他回来。

senses.def: used to say that things that actually happen are often more surprising than stories that are invented
senses.zh: 现实比虚构更不可思议

senses.def: used to say that people will find out the true facts about a situation even if you try to keep them secret
senses.zh: 真相终将大白于天下；纸包不住火；终会水落石出

senses.def: if you say that somebody has been economical with the truth
senses.zh: 没把实话全讲出来（婉指某人隐瞒了一些重要事实）

senses.def: to say something that is not completely true

examples.en: I wasn’t exactly lying when I said I hadn’t seen her—I was just bending the truth a little.

intro.en: These words all mean to move something in a particular direction, especially towards or behind you.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含拖、拉、拽之意。

items.def: to hold something and move it in a particular direction; to hold or be attached to a vehicle and move it along behind you:

examples.zh: 把椅子再往桌子这边拉近些。

items.def: to pull somebody/​something in a particular direction or behind you, usually along the ground, and especially with effort:

examples.zh: 这麻袋太重了，提不起来。你得拖着走。

examples.zh: 我把椅子向火旁拉近了点。

senses.def: to aim or point something in a particular direction

examples.zh: 警察把高压水枪对准了闹事者。

examples.en: He turned the gun on himself.
examples.zh: 他把枪口对准了自己。

examples.en: She looked at him then turned her attention back to me.
examples.zh: 她看了看他，然后又把注意力转回到我的身上。

examples.en: His thoughts turned to his dead wife.
examples.zh: 他想起了自己已故的妻子。

senses.def: to start to come in or go out

examples.en: The tide is turning—we'd better get back.
examples.zh: 涨潮了，我们最好回去吧。

senses.group: of tide in sea 海潮

senses.def: to make or let somebody/something go into a particular place or state

examples.en: They turned the horse into the field.
examples.zh: 他们把马松开放到牧场里。

examples.en: to turn the dogs loose
examples.zh: 把狗放开

senses.def: to fold something in a particular way

examples.en: She turned down the blankets and climbed into bed.
examples.zh: 她掀开毯子爬上床去。

examples.en: He turned up the collar of his coat and hurried out into the rain.
examples.zh: 他竖起大衣领子，冒雨匆匆走了。

senses.def: to perform a movement by moving your body in a circle

examples.en: to turn cartwheels/somersaults
examples.zh: 做侧手翻；翻筋斗

senses.def: if a game turns
to reach or pass a particular age or time
senses.zh: 到达，超过（某一年龄或时间）

examples.en: She turns 21 in June.
examples.zh: 她到六月份就满 21 岁了。

examples.en: It's turned midnight.
examples.zh: 已过了午夜。

senses.def: when your stomach turns
to shape something on a lathe

examples.en: to turn a chair leg
examples.zh: 在车床上车椅子腿

examples.en: turned boxes and bowls
examples.zh: 车削成的盒和碗

senses.def: as was shown or proved by later events
senses.zh: 正如后来表明的；果然如此；果不其然

examples.en: I didn't need my umbrella, as it turned out (= because it didn't rain).
examples.zh: 我果然没用上我的伞。

senses.def: to be well, badly, etc. dressed
senses.zh: 穿着打扮得好（或不好等）

senses.def: likely to be very shocked or angry

examples.en: My father would turn in his grave if he knew.
examples.zh: 我父亲知道的话在九泉之下也会不得安宁的。

senses.def: used to report what somebody says or does, when this is surprising or annoying
senses.zh: （用以报告令人吃惊或不快的言行）竟会

examples.en: How could she turn round and say that, after all I've done for her?
examples.zh: 我为她做了这么多，她怎么竟会说出那种话来？

senses.def: the time when somebody in a group of people should or is allowed to do something

examples.en: When it's your turn, take another card.
examples.zh: 轮到你时，再抓一张牌。

examples.en: Please wait your turn.
examples.zh: 请等着轮到你。

examples.en: Whose turn is it to cook?
examples.zh: 轮到谁做饭了？

examples.en: Steve took a turn driving while I slept.
examples.zh: 我睡觉时，史蒂夫接着开车。

examples.en: If you can't put any cards down you have to miss a turn.
examples.zh: 你如果不能出牌就要错过一轮。

senses.def: a change in direction in a vehicle

examples.en: Make a left/right turn into West Street.
examples.zh: 向左／右拐入西大街。

examples.en: He made a sudden turn to the right.
examples.zh: 他突然向右转。

senses.def: a place where a road leads away from the one you are travelling on

examples.en: Take the next turn on the right.
examples.zh: 下一个路口右拐。

examples.en: He took a wrong turn and ended up on the coast road.
examples.zh: 他拐错了，结果到了海滨路。

senses.def: a bend or corner in a road

examples.en: a lane full of twists and turns
examples.zh: 弯弯曲曲的小巷

senses.def: an act of turning somebody/something around

examples.en: Give the handle a few turns.
examples.zh: 转动几下把手。

examples.en: The engine started with the first turn of the key.
examples.zh: 第一次转动钥匙时，发动机就启动了。

senses.def: an unusual or unexpected change in what is happening
senses.zh: （异乎寻常或意外的）变化，转变

examples.en: a surprising turn of events
examples.zh: 意想不到的事态变化

examples.en: His health has taken a turn for the worse (= suddenly got worse).
examples.zh: 他的健康状况突然恶化。

examples.en: Events took a dramatic turn in the weeks that followed.
examples.zh: 在以后的几周里，事态急转直下。

examples.en: The book is, by turns, funny and very sad.
examples.zh: 这部书时而妙趣横生，时而悲悲戚戚。

senses.def: a short performance or piece of entertainment such as a song, etc.

examples.en: Everyone got up on stage to do a turn.
examples.zh: 每个人都登台表演了一个小节目。

senses.def: a short walk

examples.en: We took a turn around the park.
examples.zh: 我们在公园里转了一圈。

senses.def: a feeling of illness

examples.en: a funny turn (= a feeling that you may faint)
examples.zh: 感到一阵晕眩

examples.en: Grandma had one of her turns.
examples.zh: 奶奶也有一次轮到她。

senses.def: everywhere or every time you try and do something

examples.en: At every turn I met with disappointment.
examples.zh: 我事事都不顺心。

examples.en: Her ideas were blocked at every turn.
examples.zh: 她的想法处处受阻。

senses.def: cooked for exactly the right amount of time
to frighten or shock somebody
senses.zh: 使大吃一惊；吓某人一跳

examples.en: You gave me quite a turn, creeping up on me like that!
examples.zh: 你这样蹑手蹑脚地走过来，真是吓了我一跳！

senses.def: (to do) something that helps somebody
senses.zh: （为某人做）好事，善事；（做）有助于某人的事

examples.en: Well, that's my good turn for the day.
examples.zh: 好啦，这就是我今天做的好事。

senses.def: one after the other in a particular order

examples.en: The children called out their names in turn.
examples.zh: 孩子们逐一自报姓名。

senses.def: as a result of something in a series of events

examples.en: Increased production will, in turn, lead to increased profits.
examples.zh: 增加生产会继而增加利润。

senses.def: to do no work

examples.en: She hasn't done a hand's turn all week.
examples.zh: 她闲了整整一星期。

senses.def: you should help somebody who has helped you
senses.zh: 善须善报；要以德报德；好人应得好报

senses.def: going to change soon

examples.en: His luck is on the turn.
examples.zh: 他就要时来运转了。

senses.def: if you do something out of turn
senses.zh: 未遵守顺序；不按次序；加塞

examples.en: Batista had batted out of turn.
examples.zh: 巴蒂斯塔抢着击球。

examples.en: I'm writing to you out of turn because I have some very important news.
examples.zh: 我现在冒昧地给你写信是因为我有一些重要的消息。

senses.def: to be useful for a particular purpose or period of time
senses.zh: （在某方面或某期间）发挥作用，派上用场；足以满足…的需要

senses.def: to say something that you should not because it is the wrong situation or because it offends somebody
senses.zh: 说话出格（或冒失、鲁莽、不合时宜）

senses.def: if people take turns

examples.en: The male and female birds take turns in sitting on the eggs.
examples.zh: 雄鸟和雌鸟轮流伏窝。

examples.en: We take it in turns to do the housework.
examples.zh: 我们轮流做家务。

examples.en: The kids took turns on the swing.
examples.zh: 孩子们轮流荡秋千。

senses.def: the time when a new century/year starts
senses.zh: 世纪之交；新年伊始；辞旧迎新之际

examples.en: It was built at the turn of the century.
examples.zh: 这是在世纪之交修建的。

examples.en: The team are unbeaten since the turn of the year.
examples.zh: 球队自年初以来保持不败。

senses.def: a particular way of thinking about things
a particular way of describing something
senses.zh: 措辞；表达方式；描述方式

examples.en: He is meticulous in his choice of words and turns of phrase.
examples.zh: 他措辞谨慎，描述细致。

senses.def: an extra amount of pressure, cruelty
a sudden increase in your speed or rate of progress; the ability to suddenly increase your speed
senses.zh: 突然加速；加快进度；突然加快的能力

examples.en: He put on an impressive turn of speed in the last lap.
examples.zh: 他在最后一圈猛然加速。

examples.en: The kangaroo has a fast turn of speed.
examples.zh: 袋鼠转弯的速度很快。

examples.en: For a small car it has a good turn of speed.
examples.zh: 对小型轿车来说，这辆车的紧急加速性能挺不错。

note.en: Most idioms containing turn are at the entries for the nouns and adjectives in the idioms, for example not turn a hair is at hair.
note.zh: 大多数含 turn 的习语，都可在该等习语中的名词及形容词相关词条找到，如 not turn a hair 在词条 hair 下。

senses.def: to pretend not to notice something bad that is happening, so you do not have to do anything about it
senses.zh: （对某事）佯装不见，睁一只眼闭一只眼

examples.en: The authorities were either unaware of the problem or they turned a blind eye to it.
examples.zh: 当局要么不知道这个问题，要么对此视而不见。

senses.def: to ignore or refuse to listen to somebody/something

examples.en: He turned a deaf ear to the rumours.
examples.zh: 他对这些谣言置若罔闻。

senses.def: to have sex with somebody for money
likely to be very shocked or angry

examples.en: My father would turn in his grave if he knew.
examples.zh: 我父亲知道的话在九泉之下也会不得安宁的。

senses.def: to start crying, especially in order to get sympathy or attention
senses.zh: 开始哭鼻子（尤指为博得同情或引人关注）

senses.def: to change your way of life to become a better, more responsible person
used to report what somebody says or does, when this is surprising or annoying
senses.zh: （用以报告令人吃惊或不快的言行）竟会

examples.en: How could she turn round and say that, after all I've done for her?
examples.zh: 我为她做了这么多，她怎么竟会说出那种话来？

senses.def: to make a person feel too proud in a way that other people find annoying
to make a place very untidy when you are searching for something

examples.en: The burglars had turned the house inside out.
examples.zh: 窃贼把房子翻了个底朝天。

senses.def: to cause large changes

examples.en: The new manager turned the old systems inside out.
examples.zh: 新任经理对旧体制进行了彻底的改革。

senses.def: to use or change a bad situation so that it helps you
senses.zh: 使转为有利；变（不利）为有利；利用

examples.en: Every magician has a trick that goes wrong, but you can turn this to your advantage by pretending it was deliberate and making the audience laugh.
examples.zh: 每个魔术师都有一个会出错的魔术，但你可以通过假装这是故意的并让观众发笑来将其转化为你的优势。

senses.def: to make a place untidy when looking for something
senses.zh: 把…翻得乱七八糟；使凌乱不堪

examples.en: The police turned the whole house upside down looking for clues.
examples.zh: 警察为查找线索把整所房子翻得乱七八糟。

senses.def: to cause big changes in a person’s life that upset and confuse them
senses.zh: 给（某人生活）造成大的变化（或混乱）

examples.en: His sudden death turned her world upside down.
examples.zh: 他的遽然离世使她的生活完全乱套了。

senses.def: to stop fighting and return to peaceful activities
senses.zh: 铸剑为犁；化干戈为玉帛；偃武修文

senses.def: to stop fighting and return to peaceful activities
senses.zh: 铸剑为犁；化干戈为玉帛；偃武修文

senses.def: to run away from a fight or dangerous situation
senses.zh: （危急时刻）转身逃跑，逃逸，临阵脱逃

examples.en: When they heard the sirens, they turned tail and ran.
examples.zh: 当他们听到警报声时，他们转身就跑。

senses.def: to pass a very important point in an illness or a difficult situation and begin to improve
senses.zh: （患病时期）转危为安，脱离危险，好转；渡过难关；脱离困境

examples.en: The country's economy has finally turned the corner.
examples.zh: 该国的经济终于迎来了转机。

senses.def: to make a deliberate decision to remain calm and not to act in an aggressive way when somebody has hurt you or made you angry
senses.zh: （受到伤害或被激怒时）甘心容忍，不予回击

senses.def: to begin doing things in a different way and thinking in a more positive way after a period of difficulties
senses.zh: （经过困难后）翻开新的一页，开始新的生活

examples.en: It’s time to turn the page and make a fresh start.
examples.zh: 是时候翻开新的一页，重新开始了。

examples.en: He turned the page on that chapter in his life a long time ago.
examples.zh: 很久以前，他就翻过了人生的那一章。

senses.def: to change a situation so that you are now in a stronger position than the person who used to be in a stronger position than you
senses.zh: 扭转形势；转变局面；转弱为强

senses.def: to turn over completely while sailing
to appear when they are not welcome or not wanted, especially when this happens regularly
senses.zh: （不愿碰上的）却总出现；冤家路窄

turn up like a bad penny.word: turn up like a bad penny

senses.def: to turn so that you are facing in the opposite direction
to move so that you are standing or sitting with your back

examples.en: When on stage, try not to turn your back on the audience.
examples.zh: 在舞台上尽量不要背对观众。

senses.def: to reject somebody/something that you have previously been connected with

examples.en: She turned her back on them when they needed her.
examples.zh: 他们需要她的时候，她却背弃了他们。

examples.en: More and more people are turning their backs on meat and becoming vegetarians or vegans.
examples.zh: 越来越多的人放弃肉食，成为素食主义者或纯素食主义者。

examples.en: She decided to turn her back on Paris and return home.
examples.zh: 她决定离开巴黎回家去。

senses.def: to start doing something or be able to do something, especially when you do it well
senses.zh: （尤指成功、顺利地）着手做，能够做

examples.en: Jim can turn his hand to most jobs around the house.
examples.zh: 吉姆能担当起家里的大部分杂活。

turn your mind to: @@@LINK=put/set/turn your mind to something | set your mind on something
turn your mind to something: @@@LINK=put/set/turn your mind to something | set your mind on something
turn your mind to sth: @@@LINK=put/set/turn your mind to something | set your mind on something

senses.def: to refuse something, especially because you do not think that it is good enough for you

examples.en: The children turn up their noses at almost everything I cook.
examples.zh: 孩子们几乎瞧不上我烹制的任何东西。

turn your nose up at something.word: turn your nose up at something

senses.def: to make you feel upset, sick or full of horror
senses.zh: 让某人反感（或恶心、惊恐万分）

examples.en: Pictures of the burnt corpses turned my stomach.
examples.zh: 那些烧焦的尸体的照片让我直恶心。

examples.en: The smell of the dead dog turned his stomach.
examples.zh: 那条死狗的气味使他感到恶心。

senses.def: to stop or make somebody stop being friendly towards somebody

examples.en: She turned against her old friend.
examples.zh: 她与老朋友翻脸了。

examples.en: After the divorce he tried to turn the children against their mother.
examples.zh: 他离婚后企图教唆子女反对他们的母亲。

senses.def: to change position or direction so as to face the other way; to make somebody/something do this

examples.en: Turn around and let me look at your back.
examples.zh: 转过身去让我看看你的后背。

examples.en: I turned my chair around to face the fire.
examples.zh: 我把椅子转过来面向火炉。

senses.def: if a business, economy, etc. turns around
senses.zh: （使企业、经济等）好转，扭转，有起色

senses.def: to refuse to allow somebody to enter a place
senses.zh: 把某人拒之门外；不准某人进入

examples.en: Hundreds of people were turned away from the stadium (= because it was full).
examples.zh: 体育场满座，数百人被拒之门外。

examples.en: They had nowhere to stay so I couldn't turn them away.
examples.zh: 他们无处安身，所以我不能把他们打发走。

senses.def: to return the way you have come; to make somebody/something do this

examples.en: The weather became so bad that they had to turn back.
examples.zh: 天气变得非常恶劣，他们不得不循原路折回。

examples.en: We said we would do it—there can be no turning back.
examples.zh: 我们说过要干这事，不能反悔。

examples.en: Our car was turned back at the border.
examples.zh: 我们的汽车在边境被挡了回来。

senses.def: to reject or refuse to consider an offer, a proposal, etc. or the person who makes it
senses.zh: 拒绝，顶回（提议、建议或提议人）

examples.en: Why did she turn down your invitation?
examples.zh: 她为什么谢绝你的邀请？

examples.en: He has been turned down for ten jobs so far.
examples.zh: 他迄今申请了十份工作都遭到拒绝。

examples.en: He asked her to marry him but she turned him down.
examples.zh: 他请求她嫁给他，但是她回绝了。

senses.def: to reduce the noise, heat, etc. produced by a piece of equipment by moving its controls

examples.en: Please turn the volume down.
examples.zh: 请把音量调低些。

examples.en: He turned the lights down low.
examples.zh: 他把灯光调得暗了一些。

senses.def: to face the centre or move towards the centre in a curve

examples.en: Her feet turn in.
examples.zh: 她的两脚呈内八字。

senses.def: to go to bed

examples.en: It’s late—I think I’ll turn in.
examples.zh: 不早了，我该睡觉去了。

senses.def: to take somebody to the police or somebody in authority because they have committed a crime
senses.zh: 把…扭送（到警察局）；使自首

examples.en: She threatened to turn him in to the police.
examples.zh: 她扬言要把他交给警方。

examples.en: He decided to turn himself in.
examples.zh: 他决定到警察局去自首。

senses.def: to give back something that you no longer need
senses.zh: 交还，退还（不再需要的东西）

examples.en: You must turn in your pass when you leave the building.
examples.zh: 你离开大楼时必须交还通行证。

senses.def: to give something to somebody in authority

examples.en: They turned in a petition with 80 000 signatures.
examples.zh: 他们递交了一份有 8 万人签名的请愿书。

examples.en: I haven't even turned in Monday's work yet.
examples.zh: 我连星期一的作业还没交呢。

senses.def: to achieve a score, performance, profit, etc.
senses.zh: 取得（分数）；完成（表演）；获得（利润）

examples.en: The champion turned in a superb performance to retain her title.
examples.zh: 上届冠军表现十分出色，卫冕成功。

senses.def: to become too interested in your own problems and stop communicating with others
senses.zh: 忙于自己的事情而不与人交往；闭门谢客

senses.def: to become something

examples.en: Our dream holiday turned into a nightmare.
examples.zh: 我们梦想的假日变成了一场噩梦。

examples.en: In one year she turned from a problem child into a model student.
examples.zh: 一年内，她从问题儿童变成了模范学生。

senses.def: to make somebody/something become something

examples.en: Ten years of prison had turned him into an old man.
examples.zh: 十年大狱使他变成了一个老头。

examples.en: The prince was turned into a frog by the witch.
examples.zh: 王子被女巫变成了一只青蛙。

senses.def: to leave a road in order to travel on another

examples.en: Is this where we turn off?
examples.zh: 这儿是我们换道的地方吗？

examples.en: The jet began to turn off the main runway.
examples.zh: 那架喷气式飞机开始拐出主跑道。

senses.def: to stop listening to or thinking about somebody/something

examples.en: I couldn't understand the lecture so I just turned off.
examples.zh: 我听不懂讲课，所以也就不听了。

senses.def: to make somebody feel bored or not interested

examples.en: People had been turned off by both candidates in the election.
examples.zh: 大选中的两位候选人都让人觉得扫兴。

senses.def: to stop somebody feeling sexually attracted; to make somebody have a strong feeling of dislike
senses.zh: 使（异性）失去兴趣；使厌恶

senses.def: to stop the flow of electricity, gas, water, etc. by moving a switch, button, etc.
senses.zh: 关掉，截断（电流、煤气、水等）

examples.en: to turn off the light
examples.zh: 关上灯

examples.en: They've turned off the water while they repair a burst pipe.
examples.zh: 他们修理爆裂的水管时，关上了水阀。

examples.en: Please turn the television off before you go to bed.
examples.zh: 睡觉前请关上电视。

senses.def: a place where a road leads away from another larger or more important road

examples.en: We missed the turn-off for the airport.
examples.zh: 我们错过了通往机场的岔道。

examples.en: We were chatting and overshot our turn-off.
examples.zh: 我们光顾着聊天，错过了岔道。

senses.def: a person or thing that people find boring or not attractive
senses.zh: 扫兴的人（或事）；厌烦的人（或事）

examples.en: The city's crime rate is a serious turn-off to potential investors.
examples.zh: 这个城市的犯罪率使得潜在的投资者望而却步。

examples.en: I find beards a real turn-off.
examples.zh: 我觉得胡子确实令人厌恶。

senses.def: to attack somebody suddenly and unexpectedly

examples.en: The dogs suddenly turned on each other.
examples.zh: 那两条狗突然互相撕咬了起来。

examples.en: Why are you all turning on me (= criticizing or blaming me)?
examples.zh: 你们怎么突然都冲我来了？

senses.def: to depend on something

examples.en: Much turns on the outcome of the current peace talks.
examples.zh: 事情主要取决于当前和谈的结果。

senses.def: to have something as its main topic

examples.en: The discussion turned on the need to raise standards.
examples.zh: 这次讨论的主要议题是提高标准的必要性。

senses.def: to make somebody excited or interested, especially sexually

examples.en: Jazz has never really turned me on.
examples.zh: 我对爵士乐从未真正产生过兴趣。

examples.en: She gets turned on by men in uniform.
examples.zh: 她看到穿制服的男人就欲火攻心。

senses.def: to make somebody become interested in something or to use something for the first time
senses.zh: 使对…感兴趣；使首次使用

examples.en: He turned her on to jazz.
examples.zh: 他使她对爵士乐产生了兴趣。

senses.def: to start the flow of electricity, gas, water, etc. by moving a switch, button, etc.
senses.zh: 接通（电流、煤气、水等）；打开

examples.en: to turn on the heating
examples.zh: 打开供热系统

examples.en: I'll turn the television on.
examples.zh: 我来打开电视机。

examples.en: He really knows how to turn on the charm (= suddenly become pleasant and attractive).
examples.zh: 他确实懂得如何一展魅力。

senses.def: a person or thing that people find sexually exciting

examples.en: He finds leather a real turn-on.
examples.zh: 他发现皮革真正令人兴奋。

senses.def: to be discovered to be; to prove to be

examples.en: It turned out that she was a friend of my sister.
examples.zh: 她原来是我姐姐的朋友。

examples.en: The job turned out to be harder than we thought.
examples.zh: 这工作结果比我们想象的要难。

examples.en: The house they had offered us turned out to be a tiny apartment.
examples.zh: 他们向我们提供的房子原来是很小的公寓套间。

senses.def: to happen in a particular way; to develop or end in a particular way

examples.en: Despite our worries everything turned out well.
examples.zh: 尽管我们都很担心，结果一切都顺利。

examples.en: You never know how your children will turn out.
examples.zh: 很难说子女将来的发展怎样。

examples.en: If the day turns out wet, we may have to change our plans.
examples.zh: 如果那天下雨的话，我们可能得改变计划。

senses.def: to be present at an event

examples.en: A vast crowd turned out to watch the procession.
examples.zh: 有一大群人出来观看游行队伍。

senses.def: to point away from the centre

examples.en: Her toes turn out.
examples.zh: 她的脚趾向外撇。

senses.def: to produce somebody/something

examples.en: The factory turns out 900 cars a week.
examples.zh: 这家工厂每周生产 900 辆汽车。

examples.en: The school has turned out some first-rate students.
examples.zh: 这所学校已培养出一些一流的学生。

senses.def: to force somebody to leave a place
to switch a light or a source of heat off

examples.en: Remember to turn out the lights when you go to bed.
examples.zh: 临睡前别忘了关灯。

senses.def: to clean something carefully and completely by removing the contents and organizing them again

examples.en: to turn out the attic
examples.zh: 把阁楼腾空清扫

senses.def: to empty something, especially your pockets
to make something point away from the centre

examples.en: She turned her toes out.
examples.zh: 她把脚趾向外撇。

senses.def: to change position so that the other side is facing towards the outside or the top

examples.en: If you turn over you might find it easier to get to sleep.
examples.zh: 你若翻个身，也许入睡容易些。

examples.en: The car skidded and turned over.
examples.zh: 汽车打滑向一侧翻倒了。

examples.en: The smell made my stomach turn over (= made me feel sick).
examples.zh: 这气味让我反胃。

senses.def: to start or to continue to run
to change to another channel when you are watching television
to do business worth a particular amount of money in a particular period of time
senses.zh: 营业额为…；做金额为…的生意

examples.en: The company turns over £3.5 million a year.
examples.zh: 这家公司一年的营业额为 350 万英镑。

senses.def: to make something change position so that the other side is facing towards the outside or the top

examples.en: Brown the meat on one side, then turn it over and brown the other side.
examples.zh: 把肉的一面烤黄，然后翻转过来，再烤另一面。

senses.def: to think about something carefully

examples.en: She kept turning over the events of the day in her mind.
examples.zh: 她脑子里不断琢磨当天发生的事。

senses.def: to sell goods and replace them

examples.en: A supermarket will turn over its stock very rapidly.
examples.zh: 超市的货物周转得很快。

senses.def: to steal from a place

examples.en: Burglars had turned the house over.
examples.zh: 盗贼把这所房子盗窃一空。

senses.def: to make an engine start running
to deliver somebody to the control or care of somebody else, especially somebody in authority
senses.zh: 移交，送交（他人看管，尤指当局）

examples.en: Customs officials turned the man over to the police.
examples.zh: 海关官员把那个男子移交给警方看管。

senses.def: to give the control of something to somebody

examples.en: He turned the business over to his daughter.
examples.zh: 他把这个企业交给了女儿管理。

senses.def: to change the use or function of something

examples.en: The factory was turned over to the manufacture of aircraft parts.
examples.zh: 这家工厂转产飞机部件。

senses.def: to change position or direction so as to face the other way; to make somebody/something do this

examples.en: Turn around and let me look at your back.
examples.zh: 转过身去让我看看你的后背。

examples.en: I turned my chair around to face the fire.
examples.zh: 我把椅子转过来面向火炉。

senses.def: if a business, economy, etc. turns around
senses.zh: （使企业、经济等）好转，扭转，有起色

senses.def: a light on a vehicle that flashes to show that the vehicle is going to turn left or right
to go to somebody/something for help, advice, etc.

examples.en: She has nobody she can turn to.
examples.zh: 她求助无门。

senses.def: to be found, especially by chance, after being lost
senses.zh: （尤指失去后偶然）被发现，被找到

examples.en: Don't worry about the letter—I'm sure it'll turn up.
examples.zh: 别为那封信担心，我相信会找到的。

senses.def: to arrive

examples.en: We arranged to meet at 7.30, but she never turned up.
examples.zh: 我们约好 7:30 碰头，但她根本没露面。

senses.def: to happen, especially by chance

examples.en: He's still hoping something (= for example, a job or a piece of luck) will turn up.
examples.zh: 他仍然在希望会有机会出现。

senses.def: to increase the sound, heat, etc. of a piece of equipment

examples.en: Could you turn the TV up?
examples.zh: 你能把电视机的音量开大些吗？

examples.en: The music was turned up loud.
examples.zh: 音乐的音量开大了。

senses.def: to make a piece of clothing shorter by folding and sewing
senses.zh: 将（衣服的底边）折起缝好；改短

senses.def: to find something

examples.en: Our efforts to trace him turned up nothing.
examples.zh: 我们辛辛苦苦跟踪他，却无功而返。

senses.def: the bottom of the leg of a pair of trousers that has been folded over on the outside
something surprising or unexpected that happens
senses.zh: 奇异的事；意想不到的事

examples.en: He actually offered to help? That's a turn-up for the books!
examples.zh: 他居然提出要帮忙？这真是太阳从西边出来了！

senses.def: to turn around suddenly so that you are facing in the opposite direction

examples.en: He turned on his heel and marched away angrily.
examples.zh: 他猛地转过身，愤怒地大步离开了。

senses.def: to say or do something unkind deliberately; to make somebody who is unhappy feel even more unhappy
senses.zh: 恶意地说（或做）；落井下石；往伤口上撒盐

examples.en: Marcia laughed as she twisted the knife still deeper.
examples.zh: 玛西娅笑了，把刀子拧得更深。

examples.en: Just to twist the knife, the filmmakers have provided a surprise ending.
examples.zh: 为了更加悲情，电影制作者早已准备好了一个令人吃惊的结局。

senses.def: a sudden and complete change in somebody/something
senses.zh: 突变；一百八十度的大转弯；变卦

examples.en: a dramatic turnabout in overseas policy
examples.zh: 海外政策的戏剧性转变

senses.def: the amount of time it takes to unload a ship or plane at the end of one journey and load it again for the next one

examples.en: Budget airlines rely on very fast turnaround times.
examples.zh: 廉价航空公司靠的是快速的终点装卸。

senses.def: the amount of time it takes to do a piece of work that you have been given and return it
senses.zh: （接活到交活之间的）周转期，时限

examples.en: Customers want a quick turnaround between order and delivery.
examples.zh: 客户希望下单后能快速发货。

senses.def: a situation in which something changes from bad to good

examples.en: a turnaround in the economy
examples.zh: 经济好转

senses.def: a complete change in somebody’s opinion, behaviour, etc.

examples.en: They remain suspicious about the government’s turnaround on education policy.
examples.zh: 他们仍然对政府教育政策的转变持怀疑态度。

senses.def: a person who leaves one political party, religious group, etc. to join one that has very different views
the smallest circle that a vehicle can turn around in
senses.zh: （车辆掉头用的）最小转向圆，最小回转圆

senses.def: the time when an important change takes place, usually with the result that a situation improves

examples.en: The promotion marked a turning point in her career.
examples.zh: 这次提升标志着她事业上的转折点。

senses.def: a round white, or white and purple, root vegetable
a large round yellow root vegetable
complete and ready to use immediately
senses.zh: 交钥匙的；完整并可立即使用的

senses.def: the number of people who attend a particular event

examples.en: This year's festival attracted a record turnout.
examples.zh: 今年的节日吸引的参加者之多创了纪录。

senses.def: the number of people who vote in a particular election

examples.en: a high/low/poor turnout
examples.zh: 参加投票的人数很多／很少／寥寥无几

examples.en: a 60% turnout of voters
examples.zh: 60% 的投票率

senses.def: the total amount of goods or services sold by a company during a particular period of time
senses.zh: （一定时期内的）营业额，成交量

examples.en: an annual turnover of $75 million
examples.zh: 7 500 万美元的年营业额

examples.en: a fall in turnover
examples.zh: 营业额的下降

senses.def: the rate at which employees leave a company and are replaced by other people
senses.zh: 人事变更率；人员调整率

examples.en: a high turnover of staff
examples.zh: 很高的人员变更率

senses.def: the rate at which goods are sold in a shop and replaced by others
senses.zh: （商店的）货物周转率，销售比率

examples.en: a fast turnover of stock
examples.zh: 快速的存货周转

senses.def: a small pie
senses.zh: 三角馅饼，半圆馅饼（以水果或果酱作馅）

senses.def: a wide road, where traffic can travel fast for long distances and that drivers must pay a toll

examples.en: Southbound traffic was clogged on the New Jersey Turnpike for more than 30 miles.
examples.zh: 新泽西州收费公路南行交通堵塞了 30 多英里。

examples.en: Turnpike tolls are going up next month.
examples.zh: 公路通行费下个月加价。

senses.def: the amount of time it takes to unload a ship or plane at the end of one journey and load it again for the next one
the amount of time it takes to do a piece of work that you have been given and return it
senses.zh: （接活到交活之间的）周转期，时限

senses.def: a situation in which something changes from bad to good

examples.en: a turnround in the economy
examples.zh: 经济好转

senses.def: a complete change in somebody’s opinion, behaviour, etc.

examples.en: They remain suspicious about the government's turnround on education policy.
examples.zh: 他们仍然对政府教育政策的转变持怀疑态度。

senses.def: a gate at the entrance to a public building, stadium, etc. that turns in a circle when pushed, allowing one person to go through at a time
senses.zh: 旋转栅门（常设于公共建筑、体育场等入口处）

examples.en: Stewards were checking people's membership cards at the turnstiles.
examples.zh: 工作人员正在十字转门处检查人们的会员卡。

examples.en: The club need to attract more supporters through the turnstiles.
examples.zh: 俱乐部需要通过十字转门吸引更多的支持者。

senses.def: the round surface on a record player
a large, round surface that is able to move in a circle and onto which a railway engine is driven in order to turn it to go in the opposite direction
the art of changing and mixing recordings to make new sounds, by touching and moving the records on a turntable
senses.zh: 转盘式：通过触摸和移动转盘上的记录来更改和混合录音以产生新声音的艺术

examples.en: a turntablism competition
examples.zh: 转盘比赛

examples.en: a DJ who is taking turntablism to the next level
examples.zh: 一位将转盘主义提升到新水平的 DJ

senses.def: a person who changes and mixes recordings to make new sounds by touching and moving records on a turntable
senses.zh: 转盘列表：通过触摸和移动转盘上的记录来更改和混合录音以产生新声音的人

examples.en: the art of the turntablist
examples.zh: 转盘艺术家的艺术

examples.en: The indie band needs a turntablist to do some scratching on a song.
examples.zh: 独立乐队需要一名转盘师来对歌曲进行一些搓盘工作。

senses.def: a clear liquid with a strong smell, used especially for making paint thinner and for cleaning paint from brushes and clothes
very bad behaviour
a blue or blue-green semi-precious

examples.en: a turquoise brooch
examples.zh: 绿松石胸针

senses.def: a blue-green colour
blue-green in colour

examples.en: a turquoise dress
examples.zh: 青绿色的连衣裙

senses.def: a small tower on top of a wall or building, especially a castle
a small metal tower on a ship, plane or tank
senses.zh: （战舰、飞机或坦克的）炮塔，回转炮塔，活动射击装置

examples.en: a gun turret
examples.zh: 炮塔

senses.def: having one or more turrets

examples.en: a turreted castle
examples.zh: 带有塔楼的城堡

senses.def: a large reptile
any reptile
to turn over completely while sailing
to turn over completely while sailing
a wild dove
a US make of wax
senses.zh: 龟牌蜡（美国汽车蜡品牌。1983年，该公司也开始销售清洁皮鞋和家居物品的产品）

senses.def: a sweater with a high part fitting closely around the neck
a high, round collar
senses.zh: 高圆翻领；高圆翻领衣服

senses.def: the part of the body that you sit on

examples.en: I needed to get off my lazy tush and do some exercise.
examples.zh: 我不能老坐着，必须起来运动运动。

senses.def: either of the long, curved teeth that stick out of the mouth of elephants and some other animals
a university in Tuskegee, Alabama
senses.zh: 塔斯基吉大学：位于阿拉巴马州塔斯基吉的一所大学，是最早为非裔美国人提供教育的大学之一。它最早由布克·T·华盛顿（Booker T Washington）在1881年建立，目的是教育自由的奴隶。该大学拥有一个大型的非裔美国人历史书籍图书馆和一个博物馆。

senses.def: a short struggle, fight or argument especially in order to get something
senses.zh: 扭打，争斗，争执（尤指为了争得物品）

examples.en: He was injured during a tussle for the ball.
examples.zh: 他在争球时受了伤。

examples.en: There was a legal tussle over the closure of the hospital.
examples.zh: 关于关闭医院的问题存在法律纠纷。

examples.en: She had a brief tussle with her conscience before telling the whole story.
examples.zh: 在讲述整个故事之前，她与自己的良心进行了短暂的斗争。

senses.def: to fight or compete with somebody/something, especially in order to get something
senses.zh: 扭打，争斗（尤指为了争夺物品）

examples.en: The children were tussling with one another for the ball.
examples.zh: 孩子们在你抢我夺地争球。

senses.def: a small area of grass that is longer and thicker than the grass around it
with small areas where the grass is longer and thicker than the grass around them

examples.en: tussocky grass
examples.zh: 丛生草

senses.def: used as the written or spoken way of showing the sound that people make when they think something is bad
senses.zh: （作书面语或口语，表示不赞成的咂嘴声）啧啧

examples.en: Tut-tut, I expected better of you.
examples.zh: 啧啧，我没想到你会这样。

examples.en: tuts of disapproval
examples.zh: 不同意的啧啧声

senses.def: to make one or more short sounds that show that you think something is bad
senses.zh: 发出一声或多声短音，表明您认为某事不好

examples.en: He tut-tutted under his breath.
examples.zh: 他低声咂了咂嘴。

senses.def: a person who is taught or given advice by a tutor
the teaching and instruction that one person gives to another

examples.en: Under his tutelage, she started reading widely again.
examples.zh: 在他的指导下，她又开始广泛阅读。

senses.def: the state of being protected or controlled by another person, organization or country
senses.zh: （人、组织、国家等给予的）保护，监护，托管

examples.en: parental tutelage
examples.zh: 家长的监护

examples.en: A new regime was installed under French tutelage.
examples.zh: 在法国的监护下建立了一个新政权。

senses.def: a private teacher, especially one who teaches an individual student or a very small group

examples.en: He worked as a tutor to the family's three young children.
examples.zh: 他担任那家三个小孩的私人教师。

senses.def: a teacher whose job is to pay special attention to the studies or health, etc. of a student or a group of students

examples.en: his history tutor
examples.zh: 他的历史导师

examples.en: He was my personal tutor at university.
examples.zh: 他是我大学时的个人指导教师。

examples.en: She's in my tutor group at school.

examples.zh: 牛津和德国的波恩结成了友好城市。

examples.zh: 你总是歪曲我说的每一句话。
