examples.zh: 有太多的政府部门不对社会大众负责。

senses.def: in a way that is very difficult to explain; without any obvious reason
senses.zh: 难以解释地；莫名其妙地；无明显原因地

examples.en: He has been unaccountably delayed.
examples.zh: 他被莫名其妙地耽误了。

examples.en: She felt suddenly and unaccountably cheerful.
examples.zh: 她突然感到莫名的高兴。

senses.def: a person or thing that is unaccounted for

examples.en: At least 300 civilians are unaccounted for after the bombing raids.
examples.zh: 遭轰炸袭击之后，至少有 300 名平民下落不明。

senses.def: not explained

examples.en: In the story he gave the police, half an hour was left unaccounted for.
examples.zh: 他对警察的陈述中有半个小时的事情未交代清楚。

senses.def: not in the habit of doing something; not used to something

examples.en: He was unaccustomed to hard work.
examples.zh: 他不习惯艰苦工作。

examples.en: I am unaccustomed to being told what to do.
examples.zh: 我没有听人使唤的习惯。

senses.def: not usual, normal or familiar
senses.zh: 反常的；不一般的；不熟悉的

examples.en: The unaccustomed heat made him weary.
examples.zh: 反常的炎热令他虚弱无力。

examples.en: I was surprised by her unaccustomed silence.
examples.zh: 对于她异常的沉默我觉得很吃惊。

senses.def: that you cannot manage to reach or obtain
senses.zh: 难以达到的；无法获得的

examples.en: unachievable goals
examples.zh: 难以实现的目标

senses.def: not receiving the thanks or praise that is deserved
senses.zh: 未得到应有的感激（或赞赏）的

examples.en: Her contribution to the research went largely unacknowledged.
examples.zh: 她对这项研究的贡献大都被忽略了。

senses.def: that people do not admit as existing or true; that people are not aware of
senses.zh: 不被承认存在（或真实）的；未被意识到的

examples.en: unacknowledged feelings
examples.zh: 下意识的感情

senses.def: not publicly or officially recognized
senses.zh: 未得到公开（或正式）承认的；非正式的

examples.en: the unacknowledged leader of the group
examples.zh: 这个团体非正式任命的首领

senses.def: not familiar with something/somebody; having no experience of something

examples.en: visitors unacquainted with local customs
examples.zh: 不谙当地风俗的游客

senses.def: not changed according to particular facts or circumstances; not adjusted

examples.en: Unadjusted figures which do not take tourism into account showed that unemployment fell in July.
examples.zh: 不含旅游业的调整前数字表明七月份失业率下降。

senses.def: without any decoration

examples.en: The walls were plain and unadorned.
examples.zh: 墙壁朴素无华。

examples.en: The story is recounted in her usual unadorned style.
examples.zh: 这个故事以她一贯的朴素风格讲述。

senses.def: you use unadulterated
senses.zh: 完全的；十足的；不折不扣的

examples.en: For me, the holiday was sheer unadulterated pleasure.
examples.zh: 对我来说，这个假期是百分之百的赏心乐事。

senses.def: not mixed with other substances; not adulterated

examples.en: unadulterated foods
examples.zh: 未掺杂其他物质的食物

senses.def: not willing to take risks or try new and exciting things
senses.zh: 不愿冒险（或尝试新奇事物）的

senses.def: not changed or influenced by something; not affected by something
senses.zh: 未被改变的；未受影响的；无动于衷的

examples.en: People's rights are unaffected by the new law.
examples.zh: 新法规没有影响人民的权利。

examples.en: His attitudes have remained largely unaffected by changes in fashion.
examples.zh: 他的态度基本上没有受到时尚变化的影响。

examples.en: Some members of the family may remain unaffected by the disease.
examples.zh: 这家族有些人可能不会受到这种疾病的影响。

examples.en: She was seemingly unaffected by his presence.
examples.zh: 他的到来看来并没有对她产生什么影响。

senses.def: natural and sincere
senses.zh: 真诚自然的；真挚的；不做作的

examples.en: She had a warm smile and an unaffected manner.
examples.zh: 她笑容温暖，举止不做作。

examples.en: He greeted me with unaffected warmth.
examples.zh: 他以不做作的热情向我打招呼。

senses.def: not belonging to or connected with a political party or a large organization
senses.zh: 独立的；无党派（或组织）的

examples.en: unaffiliated voters
examples.zh: 无党派选民

examples.en: candidates unaffiliated with any political party
examples.zh: 不隶属于任何政党的候选人

senses.def: costing so much that people do not have enough money to pay for it

examples.en: Health insurance is now unaffordable for many people.
examples.zh: 如今很多人买不起健康保险。

examples.en: Critics said the government’s policy was unaffordable.
examples.zh: 批评者称政府的政策是难以承受的。

examples.en: Retirement is an unaffordable luxury for these workers.
examples.zh: 对于这些工人来说，退休是一种难以承受的奢侈。

senses.def: not afraid or nervous; not worried about what might happen
senses.zh: 不害怕；不畏惧；不紧张；无顾忌

examples.en: She was unafraid of conflict.
examples.zh: 她不怕发生冲突。

examples.en: He's unafraid to speak his mind.
examples.zh: 他勇于说出心里的话。

senses.def: without help from anyone or anything

examples.en: Did she produce this work unaided?
examples.zh: 她是在没有任何帮助的情况下完成这件作品的吗？

examples.en: He can now walk unaided.
examples.zh: 他现在能独自行走了。

examples.en: Photographs can show things invisible to the unaided eye.
examples.zh: 照片可以展现裸眼看不见的东西。

senses.def: that cannot be taken away from you
not mixed with anything else, such as negative feelings

examples.en: unalloyed joy
examples.zh: 纯粹的快乐

senses.def: that cannot be changed
senses.zh: 无法改变的；不可更改的

examples.en: the unalterable laws of the universe
examples.zh: 不可改变的宇宙法则

examples.en: an unalterable belief
examples.zh: 不可改变的信念

senses.def: that has not changed or been changed

examples.en: This practice has remained unaltered for centuries.
examples.zh: 这种习俗已数百年未变。

examples.en: The house survives in a largely unaltered state.
examples.zh: 这所房子基本上保持不变。

examples.en: He is virtually unaltered by the years.
examples.zh: 他几乎没有随着岁月的流逝而改变。

senses.def: clear in meaning; that can only be understood in one way
senses.zh: 意思清楚的；明确的；毫不含糊的；无歧义的

examples.en: an unambiguous statement
examples.zh: 明确的陈述

examples.en: The message was clear and unambiguous—‘Get out!’
examples.zh: 这其中的含义明确无疑——“滚开！”

senses.def: in a way that is clear in meaning and can only be understood in one way
senses.zh: 意思清楚的；明确的；毫不含糊的；无歧义的

examples.en: She answered all their questions clearly and unambiguously.
examples.zh: 她清楚、毫不含糊地回答了他们所有的问题。

senses.def: not interested in becoming successful, rich, powerful, etc.
not involving a lot of effort, time, money, etc. or anything new
senses.zh: 不费功夫（或时间、金钱等）的；不铺张的

examples.en: an unambitious plan
examples.zh: 平实的计划

senses.def: complete agreement about something among a group of people

examples.en: There is no unanimity of opinion among the medical profession on this subject.
examples.zh: 医学界对此问题尚未达成一致意见。

examples.en: We won’t all agree, but we need to achieve a degree of unanimity.
examples.zh: 不可能没有意见分歧，但我们需要取得一定程度的一致。

senses.def: if a decision or an opinion is unanimous
senses.zh: （决定或意见）一致的，一致同意的

examples.en: a unanimous vote
examples.zh: 全体一致的表决

examples.en: unanimous support
examples.zh: 一致的拥护

examples.en: The decision was not unanimous.
examples.zh: 这项决定没有得到一致通过。

examples.en: Unanimous agreement must be reached for this plan to go ahead.
examples.zh: 必须达成一致同意该计划才能继续进行。

examples.en: The jury reached a unanimous verdict of ‘not guilty’.
examples.zh: 陪审团一致裁定“无罪”。

examples.en: She was the unanimous choice of the selection committee.
examples.zh: 她是选拔委员会的一致选择。

senses.def: if a group of people are unanimous
senses.zh: （团体）意见一致的，一致同意某事的

examples.en: Local people are unanimous in their opposition to the proposed new road.
examples.zh: 当地居民一致反对拟建的新公路。

examples.en: The committee were unanimous in rejecting the proposal.
examples.zh: 委员会一致否决了该提议。

senses.def: by everyone in a particular group
senses.zh: 意见一致地;获全体支持地

examples.en: The motion was passed unanimously.
examples.zh: 动议获一致通过。

examples.en: The resolution was unanimously rejected.
examples.zh: 该决议被一致否决。

senses.def: happening without anyone being told or warned in advance
senses.zh: 未通知的；未预告的；未打招呼的

examples.en: She just turned up unannounced on my doorstep.
examples.zh: 她未打招呼就来到我家门口了。

examples.en: an unannounced increase in bus fares
examples.zh: 公共汽车票价未经公告的上涨

senses.def: an unanswerable
senses.zh: 无可争辩的；不容反对的

examples.en: They presented an unanswerable case for more investment.
examples.zh: 他们提出了一个无可争辩的理由，要求增加投资。

senses.def: an unanswerable
that has not been answered
senses.zh: 未回答的；未解答的；悬而未决的

examples.en: Many questions about the crime remain unanswered.
examples.zh: 这桩罪行涉及的许多问题仍然没有答案。

senses.def: that has not been replied to

examples.en: unanswered letters
examples.zh: 未答复的信件

senses.def: that you have not expected or predicted

examples.en: unanticipated costs
examples.zh: 预料之外的费用

senses.def: not saying that you are sorry about something, even in situations in which other people might expect you to
without saying or showing that you are sorry about something, even in situations in which other people might expect you to

examples.en: The movie was unapologetically romantic.
examples.zh: 这部电影毫无疑问是浪漫的。

examples.en: He unapologetically defended the accuracy of the poll results.
examples.zh: 他毫无歉意地捍卫了民意调查结果的准确性。

senses.def: not attractive or pleasant
senses.zh: 无吸引力的；不诱人的；令人不快的

examples.en: The room was painted in an unappealing shade of brown.
examples.zh: 这屋子漆成了难看的棕色。

examples.en: The prospect of studying for another five years was distinctly unappealing.
examples.zh: 未来还需要再学五年，真是让人厌烦。

examples.en: The idea of hiring a wedding dress is unappealing to many brides.
examples.zh: 租用婚纱的想法对许多新娘来说并不有吸引力。

senses.def: unpleasant to eat; looking as if it will be unpleasant to eat
senses.zh: 难吃的；倒胃口的；看似难吃的

examples.en: She brought me an unappetizing meal of cold fried eggs on toast.
examples.zh: 她给我端来一份冷的煎蛋吐司，看上去就倒胃口。

senses.def: not having your work or your qualities recognized and enjoyed by other people; not appreciated
senses.zh: 无人赏识；不被欣赏；无人感激

examples.en: He was in a job where he felt unappreciated and undervalued.
examples.zh: 他以前的工作未让他感到受赏识和重视。

senses.def: not friendly or easy to talk to
senses.zh: 不友好的；难接近的；不好说话的

examples.en: Neighbours described the man as being difficult and unapproachable.
examples.zh: 邻居们说这名男子不随和，难接近。

senses.def: that nobody can disagree with
senses.zh: 无可争辩的；不容置疑的

examples.en: unarguable proof
examples.zh: 不容置疑的证据

senses.def: in a way that nobody can disagree with
senses.zh: 无可争辩的；不容置疑的

examples.en: She is unarguably one of the country's finest athletes.
examples.zh: 她是公认的全国最优秀的运动员之一。

senses.def: not carrying a weapon

examples.en: unarmed civilians
examples.zh: 没有武装的平民

examples.en: He walked into the camp alone and unarmed.
examples.zh: 他手无寸铁，独自一人走进营地。

senses.def: not involving the use of weapons

examples.en: The soldiers were trained in unarmed combat.
examples.zh: 士兵接受徒手格斗训练。

senses.def: involving only one member of a set at a time
not feeling ashamed or embarrassed about something, especially when people might expect you to
senses.zh: 不害臊的；不感觉难为情的；恬不知耻的

examples.en: She talked openly about her unashamed love of money.
examples.zh: 她公开谈论了她对金钱的无耻热爱。

examples.en: She would have been quite unashamed if anyone had caught her.
examples.zh: 即使被逮住，她也丝毫不会觉得难为情的。

senses.def: without feeling or showing you are ashamed or embarrassed about something, especially when people might expect you to be
senses.zh: 不害臊的；不感觉难为情的；恬不知耻的

examples.en: She wept unashamedly.
examples.zh: 她不顾羞耻地哭了起来。

examples.en: an unashamedly sentimental song
examples.zh: 矫揉造作、故作伤感的歌

senses.def: an unasked
without being invited or asked
senses.zh: 未获邀请的；未经要求的

examples.en: He came to the party unasked.
examples.zh: 他未经邀请就来参加聚会了。

examples.en: She brought him, unasked, the relevant file.
examples.zh: 她主动把有关案卷带给了他。

senses.def: that has not been asked for or requested

examples.en: unasked-for advice
examples.zh: 主动提出的建议

senses.def: that cannot be destroyed, defeated or questioned
senses.zh: 无法摧毁的；不可战胜的；不容置疑的

examples.en: The party now has an unassailable lead.
examples.zh: 这个党的领先地位现在坚不可摧。

examples.en: Their ten-point lead puts the team in an almost unassailable position.
examples.zh: 他们以十分领先的优势使整个球队处于难以撼动的地位。

examples.en: She replied with what she thought was unassailable logic.
examples.zh: 她用她认为无懈可击的逻辑来回答。

senses.def: not given to or reserved for any particular person or purpose
not helped by anyone or anything
senses.zh: 无人帮助的；不靠外援的；独力的

examples.en: She could not move unassisted.
examples.zh: 她不能够独力活动。

senses.def: not wanting to draw attention to yourself or to your abilities or status
senses.zh: 不爱出风头的；不爱炫耀的；谦逊的

examples.en: He did some wonderful work in a quiet and unassuming way.
examples.zh: 他一声不响、不事张扬地干了一些漂亮活儿。

examples.en: He has won public affection for his unassuming style.
examples.zh: 他以其谦逊的风格赢得了公众的喜爱。

senses.def: not married or involved in a romantic relationship
senses.zh: 未婚的；单身的；未恋爱的

examples.en: He was still unattached at the age of 34.
examples.zh: 他 34 岁时还是单身。

senses.def: not connected with or belonging to a particular group or organization
senses.zh: 不属于团体或组织的；无所属的；无党派的；独立的

senses.def: impossible to achieve or reach
senses.zh: 无法得到的；难以达到的

examples.en: an unattainable goal
examples.zh: 难以达到的目标

examples.en: Setting unattainable goals will only lead to frustration.
examples.zh: 定下难以达到的目标只会导致受挫。

senses.def: without the owner present; not being watched or cared for
senses.zh: 主人不在场的；无人看管（或照料）的

examples.en: unattended vehicles
examples.zh: 无人看管的车辆

examples.en: Never leave young children unattended.
examples.zh: 小孩绝不能无人看管。

examples.en: He found the reception desk unattended.
examples.zh: 他发现接待处无人值守。

senses.def: not attractive or pleasant to look at
senses.zh: 不悦目的；不漂亮的；难看的

examples.en: an unattractive brown colour
examples.zh: 难看的棕色

senses.def: not good, interesting or pleasant
senses.zh: 不好的；无趣的；令人反感的

examples.en: one of the unattractive aspects of the free market economy
examples.zh: 自由市场经济糟糕的一个方面

senses.def: in a way that is not attractive or pleasant to look at
senses.zh: 不悦目的；不漂亮的；难看的

examples.en: She scrunched up her face unattractively.
examples.zh: 她把脸皱成一团，难看极了。

senses.def: to a degree that does not seem good, interesting or pleasant
senses.zh: 不好的；无趣的；令人反感的

examples.en: an unattractively high income tax rate
examples.zh: 所得税率高得不具吸引力

senses.def: without official permission

examples.en: No access for unauthorized personnel.
examples.zh: 未经允许不得入内。

examples.en: unauthorized use of public funds
examples.zh: 未经授权使用公共资金

examples.en: an unauthorized biography (= written without the subject’s permission or help)
examples.zh: 外传

senses.def: the fact that something cannot be obtained

examples.en: Many of the problems were caused by the unavailability of suitable equipment.
examples.zh: 许多问题是由于没有合适的设备造成的。

senses.def: the fact that somebody is not able or not willing to see, meet or talk to somebody
senses.zh: 不能（或不愿）见面；不能（或不愿）交谈

examples.en: The trial was adjourned due to the unavailability of a key witness.
examples.zh: 由于关键证人缺席，审判延期。

senses.def: that cannot be obtained

examples.en: Such luxuries are unavailable to ordinary people.
examples.zh: 此等奢侈品普通百姓是难以获得的。

senses.def: not able or not willing to see, meet or talk to somebody
senses.zh: 不能（或不愿）见面；不能（或不愿）交谈

examples.en: The minister was unavailable for comment.
examples.zh: 部长无法接受访问作出评论。

senses.def: without success

examples.en: Their efforts were unavailing.
examples.zh: 他们的努力都付诸东流。

senses.def: impossible to avoid or prevent
senses.zh: 无法避免的；难以预防的

examples.en: unavoidable delays
examples.zh: 不可避免的延误

examples.en: Recession at the time seemed unavoidable.
examples.zh: 当时的经济衰退似乎是不可避免的。

senses.def: in a way that is impossible to avoid or prevent
senses.zh: 无法避免的；难以预防的

examples.en: I was unavoidably delayed.
examples.zh: 我不可避免地被耽搁了。

senses.def: not knowing or realizing that something is happening or that something exists
senses.zh: 不知道；没意识到；未察觉

examples.en: He was completely unaware of the whole affair.
examples.zh: 他对整件事情一无所知。

examples.en: She was unaware that I could see her.
examples.zh: 她没想到我能看见她。

senses.def: the state of not knowing or realizing that something is happening or that something exists
senses.zh: 不知道；没意识到；未察觉

senses.def: when not expected
senses.zh: 猝然；出其不意地；冷不防

examples.en: The camera had caught her unawares.
examples.zh: 她毫无防备地被拍摄下来。

examples.en: The announcement took me unawares.
examples.zh: 这项声明令我感到意外。

examples.en: She came upon him unawares when he was searching her room.
examples.zh: 他在翻她屋子时，冷不防被她撞见了。

senses.def: without noticing or realizing
senses.zh: 不留神地；未注意到；不知不觉地

examples.en: He slipped unawares into sleep.
examples.zh: 他不知不觉地睡着了。

senses.def: to make something no longer balanced, for example by giving too much importance to one part of it
to make somebody/something unsteady so that they are likely to fall down
senses.zh: 使失去重心（或平衡）；使倾覆

senses.def: to make somebody so upset that they are unable to continue thinking or behaving as they normally do
senses.zh: 使心理不平衡；使精神失常

senses.def: to allow something that was banned before

examples.en: The main anti-apartheid parties were unbanned in 1990.
examples.zh: 主要的反种族隔离政党于 1990 年被解禁。

senses.def: too painful, annoying or unpleasant to deal with or accept
senses.zh: 难耐的；无法接受的；难以处理的

examples.en: The heat was becoming unbearable.
examples.zh: 炎热开始变得难以忍受。

examples.en: unbearable pain
examples.zh: 无法忍受的疼痛

examples.en: He's been unbearable since he won that prize.
examples.zh: 他得奖以后变得很难相与。

senses.def: to a degree that is too painful, annoying or unpleasant to deal with or accept
senses.zh: 难耐的；无法接受的；难以处理的

examples.en: unbearably hot
examples.zh: 酷热难当

examples.en: He was so unbearably smug about winning.
examples.zh: 他对胜利沾沾自喜，简直难以忍受。

senses.def: impossible to defeat

examples.en: This year the team has shown itself to be almost unbeatable.
examples.zh: 今年，这支球队已经证明了自己几乎是不可战胜的。

examples.en: The French team looks unbeatable.
examples.zh: 法国队看起来是打不垮的。

examples.en: United remain unbeatable at the top of the League.
examples.zh: 联队以不败战绩排在联赛第一位。

senses.def: impossible to improve
senses.zh: 已达极限的；难以竞争的

examples.en: unbeatable offers
examples.zh: 最优惠的报价

senses.def: not having been defeated

examples.en: The team are unbeaten in their last four games.
examples.zh: 这个队在最近的四场比赛中从未输过。

examples.en: They will be putting their unbeaten record to the test next Saturday.
examples.zh: 下周六他们的不败纪录将要受到考验。

senses.def: not suiting a particular person

examples.en: She was wearing an unbecoming shade of purple.
examples.zh: 她穿着一身深浅不相配的紫色衣服。

senses.def: not appropriate or acceptable
senses.zh: 不恰当；不得体；不可接受

examples.en: He was accused of conduct unbecoming to an officer.
examples.zh: 他被谴责行为有失官员身份。

senses.def: not suitable or good enough for somebody/something
senses.zh: 不合适的；不适宜的；不得体的

examples.en: His behaviour is unbefitting of a university professor.
examples.zh: 他的行为与大学教授的身份不相符。

examples.en: The amount of litter in the streets is unbefitting for a historic city.
examples.zh: 街道上垃圾之多与历史名城不协调。

senses.def: without the person mentioned knowing

examples.en: Unbeknown to her they had organized a surprise party.
examples.zh: 他们瞒着她筹备了一个惊喜聚会。

senses.def: lack of belief, or the state of not believing, especially in God, a religion, etc.
senses.zh: （对上帝的）不相信；无（宗教）信仰

senses.def: used to emphasize how good, bad or extreme something is
senses.zh: 非常好（或坏、极端）的；难以置信的；惊人的

examples.en: We had an unbelievable (= very good) time in Paris.
examples.zh: 我们在巴黎的日子快活极了。

examples.en: Conditions in the prison camp were unbelievable (= very bad).
examples.zh: 集中营的生活条件糟糕透了。

examples.en: We get through an unbelievable amount of food each week.
examples.zh: 我们每周都会吃掉大量的食物。

examples.en: The cold was unbelievable (= it was extremely cold).
examples.zh: 天气冷极了。

examples.en: It's unbelievable that (= very shocking) they have permitted this trial to go ahead.
examples.zh: 令人震惊的是他们竟允许进行这项审讯。

senses.def: very difficult to believe and unlikely to be true

examples.en: I found the whole story bizarre, not to say unbelievable.
examples.zh: 我觉得整个事件经过荒诞不经，更不用说不可信了。

senses.def: extremely

examples.en: unbelievably bad/good
examples.zh: 坏得／好得令人难以置信

senses.def: in a way that is very difficult to believe

examples.en: Unbelievably it actually works.
examples.zh: 虽然难以置信，但这确实行得通。

senses.def: a person who does not believe, especially in God, a religion, etc.
senses.zh: 无（宗教）信仰的人；（尤指）不信上帝的人

senses.def: feeling or showing that you do not believe somebody/something

examples.en: She stared at us with unbelieving eyes.
examples.zh: 她用疑惑的眼睛看着我们。

examples.en: He gazed at the letter, unbelieving.
examples.zh: 他两眼盯着信，满腹狐疑。

senses.def: to relax and become less strict or formal in your behaviour or attitude
senses.zh: （在行为或态度上）放松；变得无拘束；随和

examples.en: He could be fun if he’d unbend a little.
examples.zh: 如果他能稍微放松一点，他会很有趣。

senses.def: to make something that was bent become straight; to become straight
fair and not influenced by your own or somebody else’s opinions, desires, etc.
senses.zh: 公正的；不偏不倚的；无偏见的

examples.en: unbiased advice
examples.zh: 客观的忠告

examples.en: an unbiased judge
examples.zh: 公正的法官

senses.def: without being asked, invited or expected
senses.zh: 未经要求；未被邀请；擅自

examples.en: He walked into the room unbidden.
examples.zh: 他径自走进了屋子。

examples.en: The memories came back to her unbidden and unwanted.
examples.zh: 那些记忆不由自主地、不情愿地又回到了她的脑海中。

senses.def: not made whiter by the use of chemicals; not bleached

examples.en: unbleached flour
examples.zh: 未经漂白的面粉

senses.def: not spoiled
senses.zh: 完好的；无损的；无污点的

examples.en: He had an unblemished reputation.
examples.zh: 他的名声白璧无瑕。

examples.en: her pale unblemished skin
examples.zh: 她那白皙光洁的皮肤

examples.en: The team had a previously unblemished record (= they had not lost any games).
examples.zh: 该队此前拥有完美的记录（=他们没有输掉任何比赛）。

senses.def: if somebody has an unblinking stare
without blinking

examples.en: Tara stared unblinkingly back at her.
examples.zh: 塔拉一眨不眨地盯着她。

senses.def: to clean something, for example a pipe, by removing something that is blocking it
to make it possible to use a mobile phone again after it has been stopped from working as a security measure

examples.en: Does anyone know how I can get my phone unblocked?
examples.zh: 有谁知道如何才能解锁我的手机？

examples.en: You will need a code to unblock your phone.
examples.zh: 您将需要一个代码来解锁您的手机。

senses.def: not yet born

examples.en: her unborn baby
examples.zh: 她未出世的宝宝

senses.def: having, or seeming to have, no limits

examples.en: her unbounded energy
examples.zh: 她的无限精力

senses.def: not defeated or not ready to accept defeat
senses.zh: 不败的；不屈的；不服输的

examples.en: The losing team left the field bloody but unbowed.
examples.zh: 那支队伍一番苦战后离开赛场，虽败犹荣。

senses.def: to remove a new product from the material it is packed in
senses.zh: 对...进行开箱；把...从箱子里取出来

examples.en: Parents often make videos of their kids unboxing their presents.
examples.zh: 父母经常拍摄孩子拆礼物的视频。

senses.def: that does not have a brand name

examples.en: The website sells cheap, unbranded clothes and accessories.
examples.zh: 该网站售卖廉价的杂牌服装和配饰。

examples.en: The group campaigned strongly for unbranded cigarette packaging.
examples.zh: 该组织大力倡导无品牌香烟包装。

senses.def: impossible to break
senses.zh: 无法打破的；牢不可破的

examples.en: This new material is virtually unbreakable.
examples.zh: 这种新材料实际上是不碎的。

examples.en: the unbreakable bond between parent and child
examples.zh: 亲子之间牢不可破的联系

senses.def: an unbridgeable
senses.zh: （分歧、意见等）无法弥合的；无法沟通的

examples.en: Owing to seemingly unbridgeable political differences, there has been little dialogue between the two sides.
examples.zh: 由于看似无法弥合的政治分歧，双方之间几乎没有对话。

senses.def: lacking control and therefore extreme
senses.zh: 无节制的；奔放的；极端的

examples.en: unbridled passion
examples.zh: 奔放的激情

senses.def: not interrupted in any way

examples.en: a single unbroken line
examples.zh: 一条连续的线

examples.en: 30 years of virtually unbroken peace
examples.zh: 30 年几乎未间断的和平

examples.en: my first night of unbroken sleep since the baby was born
examples.zh: 自孩子出世以来我睡的头一个囫囵觉

examples.en: an unbroken chain of events
examples.zh: 不间断的事件链

examples.en: Silence reigned unbroken in the room.
examples.zh: 房间里一片寂静。

senses.def: that has not been improved on
senses.zh: 未改写的；未被打破的；未被超过的

examples.en: His long jump record remained unbroken for 25 years.
examples.zh: 他的跳远纪录 25 年没被打破。

senses.def: to open the buckle
to talk to somebody about your problems or something you have been worrying about, so that you feel less anxious

examples.en: She needed to unburden herself to somebody.
examples.zh: 她需要找个人诉诉心里的苦衷。

examples.en: She unburdened herself of her feelings of guilt.
examples.zh: 她倾吐了心中的内咎感。

senses.def: to take something that causes a lot of work or worry away from somebody/something
to open the buttons on a piece of clothing

examples.en: He unbuttoned his shirt.
examples.zh: 他解开衬衣扣子。

senses.def: not fair or appropriate
senses.zh: 不公允的；不适当的；不恰当的

examples.en: His comments were uncalled for.
examples.zh: 他的评论有失公允。

examples.en: uncalled-for comments
examples.zh: 不恰当的言论

senses.def: in a way that seems strange and is difficult to explain

examples.en: He looked uncannily like someone I knew.
examples.zh: 他酷似我认识的一个人。

senses.def: strange and difficult to explain

examples.en: I had an uncanny feeling I was being watched.
examples.zh: 我有种被人监视的奇怪感觉。

examples.en: It was uncanny really, almost as if she knew what I was thinking.
examples.zh: 真是不可思议，她好像知道我在想什么似的。

examples.en: He has an uncanny knack of being able to see immediately where the problem lies.
examples.zh: 他有一种不可思议的本领，能够立即发现问题所在。

examples.en: She bore a quite uncanny resemblance to my Auntie Elsie.
examples.zh: 她与我的埃尔西阿姨有着惊人的相似。

senses.def: not taken care of

examples.en: The garden looked uncared for.
examples.zh: 这花园似乎无人管理。

examples.en: an uncared-for garden
examples.zh: 一个无人照料的花园

senses.def: not showing sympathy about the problems or pain of other people

examples.en: He was selfish and uncaring.
examples.zh: 他很自私而且漠不关心。

examples.en: We live in an uncaring society.
examples.zh: 我们生活在一个冷漠的社会。

examples.en: She was totally uncaring of anyone's feelings.
examples.zh: 她完全不顾及任何人的感受。

senses.def: continuing all the time
senses.zh: 持续不断的；连绵不绝的

examples.en: unceasing efforts
examples.zh: 不懈的努力

examples.en: Planes passed overhead with unceasing regularity.
examples.zh: 每隔一段时间总有飞机从头顶飞过。

senses.def: without stopping

examples.en: Snow fell unceasingly.
examples.zh: 雪不停地下。

senses.def: not censored
senses.zh: 未作删剪的；未经审查的

examples.en: an uncensored newspaper article
examples.zh: 未经删剪的报纸文章

senses.def: done roughly and rudely

examples.en: He was bundled out of the room with unceremonious haste.
examples.zh: 他被粗暴地轰出屋外。

senses.def: in a rough or rude way, without caring about a person’s feelings

examples.en: They dumped his belongings unceremoniously on the floor.
examples.zh: 他们粗暴地把他的物品摔到地板上。

senses.def: feeling doubt about something; not sure

examples.en: They're both uncertain about what to do.
examples.zh: 他们两人都拿不定主意该怎么办。

examples.en: I'm still uncertain of my feelings for him.
examples.zh: 我仍不能肯定我对他的感情。

senses.def: likely to change, especially in a negative or unpleasant way

examples.en: Our future looks uncertain.
examples.zh: 我们似乎前途渺茫。

examples.en: a man of uncertain temper
examples.zh: 脾气令人捉摸不透的男人

senses.def: not definite or decided

examples.en: It is uncertain what his role in the company will be.
examples.zh: 他在公司担当什么职务尚未决定。

senses.def: not confident

examples.en: The baby took its first uncertain steps.
examples.zh: 宝宝迈出了最初的蹒跚脚步。

senses.def: clearly and strongly
senses.zh: 明确有力地；毫不含糊地

examples.en: I told him what I thought of him in no uncertain terms.
examples.zh: 我直言不讳地说出了我对他的看法。

senses.def: clearly and strongly
senses.zh: 明确有力地；毫不含糊地

examples.en: I told him what I thought of him in no uncertain terms.
examples.zh: 我直言不讳地说出了我对他的看法。

senses.def: without confidence

examples.en: They smiled uncertainly at one another.
examples.zh: 他们犹豫地相视而笑。

senses.def: the state of being uncertain

examples.en: There is considerable uncertainty about the company's future.
examples.zh: 这家公司的前景相当渺茫。

examples.en: He had an air of uncertainty about him.
examples.zh: 他显出将信将疑的神情。

senses.def: something that you cannot be sure about; a situation that makes you not be or feel certain
senses.zh: 拿不定的事；令人无把握的局面

examples.en: life’s uncertainties
examples.zh: 人生的不可知因素

examples.en: the uncertainties of war
examples.zh: 战争带来的不确定性

senses.def: that cannot be questioned or argued with; that cannot be challenged
senses.zh: 不可争辩的；不容置辩的；不可挑战的

examples.en: unchallengeable evidence
examples.zh: 无可置辩的证据

senses.def: not doubted; accepted without question; not challenged
senses.zh: 不被怀疑的；完全接受的；没有异议的

examples.en: She could not allow such a claim to go unchallenged.
examples.zh: 她不能对这样的要求听之任之。

examples.en: These ideas have remained largely unchallenged for 60 years.
examples.zh: 60 年来，这些想法基本上没有受到挑战。

senses.def: not opposed by anyone

examples.en: He is in a position of unchallenged authority.
examples.zh: 他拥有绝对的权威。

senses.def: without being stopped and asked to explain who you are, what you are doing, etc.

examples.en: I walked into the building unchallenged.
examples.zh: 我畅行无阻地走进大楼。

senses.def: that cannot be changed
senses.zh: 无法改变的；不可更改的

examples.en: unchangeable laws
examples.zh: 不变的定律

senses.def: that has stayed the same and not changed

examples.en: My opinion remains unchanged.
examples.zh: 我的看法一如既往。

examples.en: They will play an unchanged team in Saturday’s game.
examples.zh: 他们将在周六的比赛中对阵不变的球队。

examples.en: The school appeared essentially unchanged since my day.
examples.zh: 这所学校自从我那个时代以来好像就没有多大变化。

senses.def: that always stays the same and does not change

examples.en: unchanging truths
examples.zh: 永恒的真理

examples.en: The days went by, unchanging.
examples.zh: 时间一天天过去了，一切照旧。

examples.en: The party stood for certain unchanging principles.
examples.zh: 该党主张某些不变的原则。

senses.def: not typical of somebody; not the way somebody usually behaves
senses.zh: （指人的行为）非典型的；非通常的；表现奇怪的

examples.en: The remark was quite uncharacteristic of her.
examples.zh: 这话很不像是她说的。

senses.def: in a way that is not typical of somebody or the way they usually behave
senses.zh: （指人的行为）非典型的；非通常的；表现奇怪的

examples.en: The children had been uncharacteristically quiet.
examples.zh: 孩子们不同于往常，十分安静。

senses.def: unkind and unfair in the way that you judge people

examples.en: uncharitable thoughts
examples.zh: 刻薄的想法

examples.en: I don’t want to be uncharitable, but he isn’t very intelligent, is he?
examples.zh: 我不想表现得无情，但他不太聪明，不是吗？

senses.def: in a way that is unkind or unfair, especially when judging somebody
senses.zh: 刻薄地;不宽厚地;不公平地

senses.def: not marked on a map; that has not been visited or investigated before
senses.zh: 地图上未标示的；人迹罕至的；无人涉足的

examples.en: The ship hit an uncharted rock.
examples.zh: 船撞在海图上未标示的岩石上。

examples.en: They set off into the country's uncharted interior.
examples.zh: 他们出发前往这个国家人迹罕至的内陆。

examples.en: The party is sailing in uncharted waters (= a situation it has not been in before).
examples.zh: 这个党面临一种崭新的局势。

examples.en: I was moving into uncharted territory (= a completely new experience) with this relationship.
examples.zh: 这个关系让我开始有全新的体验。

senses.def: to remove a mark (✓) from a box on an electronic form to show that you do not want something
not showing the qualities that are generally expected of a Christian; not kind or thinking about other people’s feelings
senses.zh: 无基督教徒品质的；不慈善的；不为他人着想的

senses.def: not polite
not behaving in a way that is acceptable according to social or moral standards
senses.zh: 不合社会（或道德）规范的；无教养的

senses.def: not having developed a modern culture and way of life

examples.en: I have worked in the wildest and most uncivilized parts of the world.
examples.zh: 我曾在世界上最荒凉、最原始的地区工作过。

senses.def: that nobody has claimed as belonging to them or being owed to them
senses.zh: 无人认领的；无人领取的

examples.en: The prize has remained unclaimed.
examples.zh: 该奖品至今无人领取。

examples.en: Unclaimed property will be sold off after three months.
examples.zh: 无人认领的财产将在三个月后被出售。

senses.def: not officially secret; available to everyone
that has not been classified

examples.en: A high proportion of candidates get low or unclassified grades (= their work is not good enough to receive a grade).
examples.zh: 有很大部分的考生成绩很差或没有成绩。

senses.def: not large or important enough to be given a number
the brother of your mother or father; the husband of your aunt or uncle
senses.zh: 舅父；叔父；伯父；姑父；姨父

examples.en: Uncle Ian
examples.zh: 伊恩叔叔

examples.en: I'm going to visit my uncle.
examples.zh: 我要去看我舅舅。

examples.en: a maternal/paternal uncle (= related through the mother’s/father's side of the family)
examples.zh: 舅舅；叔叔（或伯父）

examples.en: I've just become an uncle (= because my brother/sister has had a baby).
examples.zh: 我刚当上叔叔（或舅舅）。

examples.en: Joey was like an uncle to us.
examples.zh: 乔伊对我们来说就像叔叔一样。

examples.en: He was the youngest son of Edward III and uncle to Richard II.
examples.zh: 他是爱德华三世最小的儿子，理查二世的叔叔。

examples.en: The celebrant of the Mass was Rev. Martin Doyle, uncle of the bride.
examples.zh: 弥撒的司仪是新娘的叔叔马丁·道尔牧师。

senses.def: used by children, with a first name, to address a man who is a close friend of their parents
senses.zh: （儿童用语，称呼父母的同辈男性朋友）叔叔，伯伯

senses.def: used as a polite way of addressing or referring to an older man
senses.zh: （对老年男性的尊称）大叔，老伯

examples.en: The uncle who lives opposite my parents is always so warm and friendly.
examples.zh: 住在我父母对面的叔叔总是那么热情友好。

senses.def: used to say how easy and quick it is to do a particular task

examples.en: Press here and Bob's your uncle! It's disappeared.
examples.zh: 按一下这里就成了！消失了。

senses.def: used to say how easy and quick it is to do a particular task

examples.en: Press here and Bob's your uncle! It's disappeared.
examples.zh: 按一下这里就成了！消失了。

senses.def: a US product name for rice that was originally produced by the Uncle Ben's Converted Brand Rice Company. The original Uncle Ben was a farmer in Texas.
senses.zh: 本叔叔™：美国大米的产品名称，最初由本叔叔的转换品牌大米公司生产。本叔叔是德克萨斯州的一位农民。

senses.def: the character who tells the traditional African American stories in several books by Joel Chandler Harris (1848-1908). Uncle Remus is a freed slave whose stories include Brer (Brother) Rabbit, Brer Fox and Brer Bear. Among the books are Uncle Remus, His Songs and His Sayings
senses.zh: 雷摩大叔（乔尔·钱德勒·哈里斯(1848-1908)的几本书中讲述传统非裔美国人故事的角色。乔叟雷姆斯是一位获得自由的奴隶，他的故事包括布雷尔兔、布雷尔狐和布雷尔熊。其中的书籍包括《乔叟雷姆斯，他的歌曲和他的话语》(1881)、《焦油娃娃》(1904) 和《乔叟雷姆斯和布雷尔兔》(1906)。他还是华特·迪士尼电影《南方之歌》(1946)中的主要角色。）

senses.def: a way of referring to the United States of America or the US government (sometimes shown as a tall man with a white beard
senses.zh: 山姆大叔（指美国或美国政府，有时被塑造成有白胡子、戴大礼帽的高个子男人）

examples.en: He owed $20 000 in tax to Uncle Sam.
examples.zh: 他欠美国政府 2 万美元税款。

senses.def: an offensive word used to refer to a black man who is thought to be too willing to serve or please white people
senses.zh: 汤姆大叔（旧时有时用以指想讨好或侍奉白人的黑人男子）

senses.def: a character from the traditional English song Widdicombe Fair
senses.zh: 汤姆·考布利叔叔（Uncle Tom Cobbleigh）：传统英语歌曲《 Widdicombe Fair》中的角色。这首歌包含了一长串参加博览会的人，最后一行是“老叔叔汤姆·科布利和所有人”。人们有时会用这个短语来表示某个地方有很多人，包括每个人可能期望或想象的人

examples.en: Everyone turned up at the party – Jack, Ella, Steve, Roger, old Uncle Tom Cobbleigh and all!
examples.zh: 每个人都出现在聚会上——杰克、艾拉、史蒂夫、罗杰、汤姆·科布莱老叔叔等等！

senses.def: a novel (1852) by the US writer Harriet Beecher Stowe
senses.zh: 《汤姆叔叔的小屋》（美国作家哈丽特·比彻·斯托 1852 年的小说。这是关于一个名叫汤姆的善良奴隶的故事，他受到西蒙·莱格里的虐待并最终被杀死。汤姆的女儿小伊娃也去世了，小说中另一个著名的角色是孩子托普西。 “汤姆叔叔”这个名字有时被用作侮辱，用来形容一位行为方式过于尊重白人的非裔美国人。）

senses.def: dirty and therefore likely to cause disease
senses.zh: 肮脏的，不洁净的（因而容易致病）

examples.en: unclean water
examples.zh: 不清洁的水

senses.def: considered to be bad, immoral
senses.zh: 邪恶的；不洁的；（宗教上所指）不洁净的

examples.en: unclean thoughts
examples.zh: 邪念

examples.en: unclean food
examples.zh: 不洁的食物

senses.def: not clear or definite; difficult to understand or be sure about
senses.zh: 不清楚的；不确定的；难以掌握的

examples.en: His motives are unclear.
examples.zh: 他的用意不明。

examples.en: Our plans are unclear at the moment.
examples.zh: 目前我们的计划还不确定。

examples.en: It is unclear whether there is any damage.
examples.zh: 有无损坏尚不清楚。

examples.en: Your diagrams are unclear.
examples.zh: 你的图表不清楚。

senses.def: not fully understanding something

examples.en: I'm unclear about what you want me to do.
examples.zh: 我不太明白你要我做什么。

senses.def: to clear something, for example a pipe, by removing something that is blocking it

examples.en: How do I unclog a sink pipe?
examples.zh: 我怎样才能疏通洗涤槽管道？

senses.def: not wearing any clothes
senses.zh: 赤裸的；裸体的；一丝不挂的

senses.def: not containing too many objects, details or unnecessary items

examples.en: an uncluttered room
examples.zh: 整洁的房间

senses.def: to become or make something straight after it has been wound or twisted
senses.zh: （使盘卷的东西）展开，打开；拉直

examples.en: The snake slowly uncoiled.
examples.zh: 蛇慢慢地展开了盘着的身体。

examples.en: The huge snake uncoiled itself.
examples.zh: 巨蛇舒展开来。

examples.en: to uncoil a rope
examples.zh: 打开盘卷的绳索

senses.def: with no colour; with no colour added

examples.en: plain, uncoloured glass
examples.zh: 普通、无色玻璃

senses.def: that has not been brushed or combed
not letting you feel physically comfortable; unpleasant to wear, sit on, etc.
senses.zh: 使人不舒服的；令人不舒适的

examples.en: uncomfortable shoes
examples.zh: 不舒适的鞋子

examples.en: The headphones can be uncomfortable to wear.
examples.zh: 这副耳机有时戴着不舒服。

examples.en: I couldn't sleep because the bed was so uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 这床太不舒服了，我睡不着觉。

examples.en: I find these chairs incredibly uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 我觉得这些椅子坐上去非常不舒服。

senses.def: not feeling physically relaxed, warm, etc.
senses.zh: 感到难受的；感觉不舒服（或不暖和等）的

examples.en: I was sitting in an extremely uncomfortable position.
examples.zh: 我坐着的姿势难受极了。

examples.en: It was uncomfortable to walk for long periods of time.
examples.zh: 长时间步行并不轻松。

examples.en: She still finds it uncomfortable to stand without support.
examples.zh: 她仍觉得没有支撑站着不太舒服。

examples.en: Sharp stones on the path made walking barefoot rather uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 小路上有尖石块，赤脚走路很不舒服。

senses.def: anxious, embarrassed or afraid and unable to relax; making you feel like this
senses.zh: （使）焦虑的；尴尬的；害怕的；不自在的

examples.en: He looked distinctly uncomfortable when the subject was mentioned.
examples.zh: 提到这个话题，他明显表现出不安。

examples.en: She felt uncomfortable with the way George looked at her.
examples.zh: 乔治看她的样子让她感到不自在。

examples.en: They are uncomfortable with the idea of a military assault.
examples.zh: 他们对军事攻击的想法感到不安。

examples.en: The thought made her even more uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 这个想法让她更加不舒服。

examples.en: There was an uncomfortable silence.
examples.zh: 有一种令人不安的寂静。

examples.en: She was always a little uncomfortable about being photographed.
examples.zh: 她照相时总有点儿不自然。

examples.en: They are uncomfortable about the compromises they have made.
examples.zh: 他们对自己所做的妥协感到不安。

examples.en: The film is often very uncomfortable to watch.
examples.zh: 这部电影通常看起来非常不舒服。

examples.en: It is very uncomfortable to have to admit that we might share some responsibility for the situation.
examples.zh: 不得不承认我们可能对这种情况负有一些责任，这是非常不舒服的。

senses.def: unpleasant or difficult to deal with
senses.zh: 棘手的；麻烦的；难处理的

examples.en: an uncomfortable fact
examples.zh: 令人头痛的事实

examples.en: I had the uncomfortable feeling that it was my fault.
examples.zh: 我内心惴惴不安，觉得那是我的过错。

examples.en: Her letter was an uncomfortable reminder of responsibilities I preferred to forget about.
examples.zh: 她的信让我不舒服地想起了我宁愿忘记的责任。

senses.def: in a way that makes you feel anxious or embarrassed; in a way that shows you are anxious or embarrassed
senses.zh: 令人不安（或尴尬）地；显得不安（或尴尬）地

examples.en: I became uncomfortably aware that no one else was laughing.
examples.zh: 我难堪地意识到别人都没有笑。

examples.en: Her comment was uncomfortably close to the truth.
examples.zh: 她的评论逼近真相，令人局促不安。

examples.en: He shifted uncomfortably in his seat when I mentioned money.
examples.zh: 我提到钱时，他便坐不住了。

senses.def: in a way that is not physically comfortable

examples.en: I was feeling uncomfortably hot.
examples.zh: 我觉得酷热难当。

examples.en: She perched uncomfortably on the edge of the table.
examples.zh: 她将就坐在桌边上，非常难受。

senses.def: not having given or promised support to a particular person, group, belief, action, etc.

examples.en: The party needs to canvass the uncommitted voters.
examples.zh: 这个党需要向未表明态度的选民游说拉票。

examples.en: Some workers remain uncommitted to the project.
examples.zh: 有些工人仍未对该计画做出承诺。

senses.def: not existing in large numbers or in many places
senses.zh: 不常有的；罕见的；稀罕的

examples.en: an uncommon occurrence
examples.zh: 不寻常的事情

examples.en: Side effects from the drug are uncommon.
examples.zh: 这药很少有副作用。

examples.en: It is not uncommon for college students to live at home.
examples.zh: 大学生住在家里并不少见。

examples.en: Red squirrels are uncommon in England.
examples.zh: 红松鼠在英格兰很少见。

senses.def: unusually large in degree or amount; great

examples.en: She showed uncommon pleasure at his arrival.
examples.zh: 他的到来令她异常欢喜。

senses.def: to an unusual degree; extremely

examples.en: an uncommonly gifted child
examples.zh: 一个天赋异禀的儿童

examples.en: He looks uncommonly like a younger version of his father.
examples.zh: 他看上去极其像他父亲年轻的时候。

senses.def: not often; not usually

examples.en: Not uncommonly, there is a great deal of rain in August.
examples.zh: 八月份降雨量大并非异常。

senses.def: not willing to talk to other people or give opinions
senses.zh: 不爱说话的；寡言少语的；缄默的

senses.def: not cheaper or better than others and therefore not able to compete equally
senses.zh: 无竞争力的；竞争力弱的

examples.en: an uncompetitive industry
examples.zh: 无竞争力的行业

examples.en: uncompetitive prices
examples.zh: 缺乏竞争力的价格

senses.def: not saying that you are unhappy about a difficult or unpleasant situation; not saying that you are in pain
without saying that you are unhappy about a difficult or unpleasant situation; without saying that you are in pain
that has not been finished
senses.zh: 未完成的；未竟的；未竣工的

examples.en: an uncompleted project
examples.zh: 未完成的项目

examples.en: She left the sentence uncompleted.
examples.zh: 她没有把这句话说完。

senses.def: simple; without any difficulty or worry
senses.zh: 简单的；率真的；容易的；无忧无虑的

examples.en: an easygoing, uncomplicated young man
examples.zh: 一个随和、率直的男青年

examples.en: Why can't I have an uncomplicated life?
examples.zh: 我为什么不能过一种简朴的生活？

senses.def: rude or showing a lack of respect
senses.zh: 无礼的；贬抑的；缺乏尊重的

examples.en: uncomplimentary remarks
examples.zh: 不客气的话

senses.def: not understanding a situation or what is happening
senses.zh: 不理解的；茫然的；不领会的

senses.def: without understanding a situation or what is happening
senses.zh: 不理解的；茫然的；不领会的

examples.en: She looked at him uncomprehendingly.
examples.zh: 她一脸茫然地看着他。

senses.def: unwilling to change your opinions or behaviour
senses.zh: 不让步的；不妥协的；强硬的

examples.en: an uncompromising attitude
examples.zh: 强硬的态度

examples.en: He has a reputation for being tough and uncompromising.
examples.zh: 他的严厉和强硬态度是出了名的。

examples.en: He was quite uncompromising about high standards in art.
examples.zh: 他对艺术的高标准毫不妥协。

examples.en: The government has remained uncompromising on this issue.
examples.zh: 政府在这个问题上始终不妥协。

senses.def: in a way that shows you are not willing to change your actions, opinions or behaviour
senses.zh: 不让步的；不妥协的；强硬的

examples.en: The house is uncompromisingly modern in its austere design.
examples.zh: 这座房子的朴素设计具有毫不妥协的现代感。

senses.def: that you do not try to hide
senses.zh: 不掩饰的；不隐藏的；明显的

examples.en: unconcealed curiosity
examples.zh: 表露无遗的好奇心

senses.def: a lack of care, interest or worry about something that other people would care about

examples.en: She received the news with apparent unconcern.
examples.zh: 她接到这消息时显然无动于衷。

senses.def: not worried or anxious about something because you feel it does not affect you or is not important
senses.zh: 冷淡的；漠视的；漫不经心的

examples.en: He drove on, apparently unconcerned about the noise the engine was making.
examples.zh: 他继续驾车前进，对发动机发出的噪声显然毫不在意。

senses.def: not interested in something

examples.en: Young people are often unconcerned with political issues.
examples.zh: 青年人对政治问题往往漠不关心。

senses.def: without being anxious about something because you feel it does not affect you or is not important
senses.zh: 冷淡的；漠视的；漫不经心的

senses.def: without any conditions or limits
senses.zh: 无条件的；无限制的；绝对的

examples.en: the unconditional surrender of military forces
examples.zh: 军队的无条件投降

examples.en: She gave her children unconditional love.
examples.zh: 她将爱毫无保留地给了她的孩子。

examples.en: They appealed for the immediate and unconditional release of all political prisoners.
examples.zh: 他们呼吁立即无条件释放所有政治犯。

examples.en: They demanded the unconditional withdrawal of military forces.
examples.zh: 他们要求无条件撤军。

senses.def: without any conditions or limits
senses.zh: 无条件的；无限制的；绝对的

examples.en: I support her unconditionally.
examples.zh: 我无条件支持她。

senses.def: not trained or influenced by experience; natural

examples.en: an unconditioned response
examples.zh: 无条件反应

senses.def: not limited in space, range or amount

examples.en: The animals have unconfined access to pasture.
examples.zh: 这些动物是散养的。

examples.en: When the news came through joy was unconfined.
examples.zh: 听到消息时无比喜悦。

senses.def: that has not yet been proved to be true or confirmed
senses.zh: 未经证实的；未被认可的；未确认的

examples.en: unconfirmed rumours
examples.zh: 未证实的传言

examples.en: Unconfirmed reports said that at least six people had been killed.
examples.zh: 未经证实的报道称至少有六人丧生。

senses.def: not friendly or pleasant to be with
senses.zh: 不友善的；性情不相投的

examples.en: uncongenial company
examples.zh: 脾气不相投的同伴

senses.def: not pleasant; not making you feel relaxed; not suitable for your personality
senses.zh: 不愉快的；令人紧张的；不适宜的

examples.en: an uncongenial atmosphere
examples.zh: 不和谐的气氛

senses.def: not suitable for something; not encouraging something

examples.en: The religious climate at the time was uncongenial to new ideas.
examples.zh: 当时的宗教气候容不得新思想。

senses.def: not related or connected in any way

examples.en: The two crimes are apparently unconnected.
examples.zh: 这两起犯罪显然没有关联。

examples.en: My resignation was totally unconnected with recent events.
examples.zh: 我的辞职与最近的事件毫不相干。

examples.en: The judge was unconnected with the company representatives.
examples.zh: 法官跟公司的各位代表没有任何关联。

examples.en: The question was unconnected to anything they had been discussing.
examples.zh: 这个问题与他们的讨论毫无联系。

senses.def: too strong to be defeated or changed
senses.zh: 不可战胜的；坚不可摧的；难以改变的

senses.def: so bad, immoral

examples.en: It would be unconscionable for her to keep the money.
examples.zh: 如果她保留这些钱，那就太不合情理了。

senses.def: too great, large, long, etc.
senses.zh: 过分的；过于大（或多、长等）的

examples.en: You take an unconscionable amount of time getting dressed!
examples.zh: 你穿衣服花了太多时间！

senses.def: in a state like sleep because of an injury or illness, and not able to use your senses
senses.zh: 无知觉的；昏迷的；不省人事的

examples.en: They found him lying unconscious on the floor.
examples.zh: 他们发现他晕倒在地板上。

examples.en: She was knocked unconscious.
examples.zh: 她被打昏了。

examples.en: She fell unconscious after breathing in the gas.
examples.zh: 吸入煤气之后她就不省人事了。

examples.en: It was a powerful sedative that would render them unconscious within minutes.
examples.zh: 这是一种强效镇静剂，几分钟内就能让他们失去知觉。

senses.def: existing or happening without you realizing or being aware; not deliberate
senses.zh: 无意识的；潜意识的；自然流露的

examples.en: unconscious desires
examples.zh: 自然流露的欲望

examples.en: Freud sought to unlock the workings of the unconscious mind.
examples.zh: 弗洛伊德试图解开无意识心理的运行机制。

examples.en: the danger of unconscious bias
examples.zh: 无意识偏见的危险

examples.en: The brochure is full of unconscious humour.
examples.zh: 这本小册子妙趣横生。

senses.def: not aware of somebody/something; not noticing something; not conscious
senses.zh: 未察觉；未意识到；未注意

examples.en: She is unconscious of the effect she has on people.
examples.zh: 她没有察觉自己对大众的影响。

examples.en: He was quite unconscious of the danger.
examples.zh: 他丝毫没有意识到危险。

examples.en: Parents are often quite unconscious of the ways in which they influence their children.
examples.zh: 父母很多时候都意识不到自己在哪些方面会影响孩子。

examples.en: He made his way down the street, unconscious of the people, cars and buildings around him.
examples.zh: 他沿着街道走，没有注意到周围的人、汽车和建筑物。

senses.def: the part of a person’s mind with thoughts, feelings, etc. that they are not aware of and cannot control but that can sometimes be understood by studying their behaviour or dreams
senses.zh: 无意识（不察觉的心理活动）

senses.def: an unfair belief about a group of people that you are not aware of and that affects your behaviour and decisions

examples.en: Removing unconscious bias in the recruitment process is an important way of improving workforce diversity.
examples.zh: 消除招聘过程中的无意识偏见是提升员工多元化的重要途径。

examples.en: They recognize the need for unconscious bias training as a starting point.
examples.zh: 他们认识到有必要针对无意识偏见做培训，并以此为起点。

senses.def: without being aware

examples.en: Perhaps, unconsciously, I've done something to offend her.
examples.zh: 我也许无意中做了什么得罪她的事。

senses.def: a state like sleep caused by injury or illness, when you are unable to use your senses

examples.en: He had lapsed into unconsciousness.
examples.zh: 他陷入了昏迷状态。

senses.def: not thought about, or not thought about with enough care
senses.zh: 未经（或欠）考虑的；未经深思熟虑的

examples.en: I came to regret my unconsidered remarks.
examples.zh: 我对我那些考虑不周的言辞开始感到后悔。

senses.def: very sad and unable to accept help or comfort
senses.zh: 悲痛欲绝的；无法慰藉的

senses.def: in a very sad way and without being able to accept help or comfort
senses.zh: 悲痛欲绝地；无法慰藉地

senses.def: not allowed by the constitution
senses.zh: 违背宪法的；违反宪章（或章程）的

examples.en: The judges declared the decision unconstitutional.
examples.zh: 法官宣布该决议违宪。

senses.def: in a way that is not allowed by the constitution
senses.zh: 违背宪法的；违反宪章（或章程）的

senses.def: not limited in amount, extent, etc.
senses.zh: 不受（数量、范围等）约束的；自由的

examples.en: unconstrained growth
examples.zh: 自然生长

senses.def: not harmed by something (for example, dangerous or dirty substances)
senses.zh: 未被损害的；未受污染的

examples.en: uncontaminated water
examples.zh: 未受污染的水

examples.en: The equipment is sterilized to ensure that the blood remains uncontaminated.
examples.zh: 设备经过消毒，以确保血液不受污染。

examples.en: The problems were made worse by the inadequate provision of medical help and uncontaminated milk.
examples.zh: 由于医疗帮助和未受污染的牛奶供应不足，问题变得更加严重。

senses.def: not likely to cause people to disagree
senses.zh: 没有（或不容易）引起争议的

examples.en: The proposal is relatively uncontentious.
examples.zh: 这个建议并没有什么重大的争议。

senses.def: without any opposition or argument

examples.en: These claims have not gone uncontested.
examples.zh: 这些说法并非无人提出异议。

examples.en: She was appointed to the post following an uncontested election (= in which there were no other candidates).
examples.zh: 她在一次无争议的选举后被任命为该职位（=没有其他候选人）。

examples.en: The uncontested divorce was finalized on March 17.
examples.zh: 无争议离婚于3月17日最终完成。

senses.def: that you cannot control or prevent
senses.zh: 无法控制的；难以防止的；禁不住的

examples.en: an uncontrollable temper
examples.zh: 控制不住的脾气

examples.en: uncontrollable bleeding
examples.zh: 止不住的流血

examples.en: I had an uncontrollable urge to laugh.
examples.zh: 我忍不住想笑。

examples.en: The ball was uncontrollable.
examples.zh: 球控制不住了。

examples.en: He's an uncontrollable child (= he behaves very badly and cannot be controlled).
examples.zh: 他是个难以管教的孩子。

examples.en: That child is uncontrollable.
examples.zh: 那孩子难以管束。

examples.en: They were all victims of her uncontrollable temper.
examples.zh: 他们都是她无法控制的脾气的受害者。

senses.def: in a way that you cannot control or prevent
senses.zh: 无法控制的；难以防止的；禁不住的

examples.en: She began shaking uncontrollably.
examples.zh: 她不由自主地哆嗦起来。

senses.def: that somebody cannot control or stop
senses.zh: 抑制不住的；无法制止的

examples.en: uncontrolled anger
examples.zh: 克制不住的愤怒

examples.en: The thoughts rushed into my mind uncontrolled.
examples.zh: 各种想法如潮水般涌上我的心头。

senses.def: that is not limited or managed by law or rules
senses.zh: 不受法律（或规则）制约的；无序的

examples.en: the uncontrolled growth of cities
examples.zh: 城市的无规划发展

examples.en: uncontrolled dumping of toxic waste
examples.zh: 有毒废弃物的胡乱弃置

senses.def: not causing, or not likely to cause, people to disagree
senses.zh: 没有争议的；不会引起争议的

examples.en: an uncontroversial opinion
examples.zh: 无争议的意见

examples.en: He chose an uncontroversial topic for his speech.
examples.zh: 他为自己的演讲选择了一个不会引起争议的话题。

senses.def: not following what is done or considered normal or acceptable by most people; different and interesting
senses.zh: 不因循守旧的；不因袭的；新奇的

examples.en: an unconventional approach to the problem
examples.zh: 解决这个问题的非常规方法

examples.en: unconventional views
examples.zh: 新奇的观点

examples.en: The magazine describes him as having unconventional good looks.
examples.zh: 该杂志形容他拥有非传统的英俊外表。

senses.def: the quality of not generally following what is done or considered normal or acceptable by most people, in a way that is different and interesting
senses.zh: 不因循守旧的；不因袭的；新奇的

senses.def: in a way that does not follow what is done or considered normal or acceptable by most people; in a different and interesting way
senses.zh: 不因循守旧的；不因袭的；新奇的

examples.en: He dresses unconventionally.
examples.zh: 他穿着非常规。

senses.def: not believing or not certain about something despite what you have been told

examples.en: I remain unconvinced of the need for change.
examples.zh: 我仍怀疑改革的必要性。

examples.en: She seemed unconvinced by their promises.
examples.zh: 她似乎不相信他们的许诺。

examples.en: The jury were unconvinced that he was innocent.
examples.zh: 陪审团不相信他是无辜的。

senses.def: not seeming true or real; not making you believe that something is true
senses.zh: 似乎不真实的；不令人信服的；难以相信的

examples.en: I find the characters in the book very unconvincing.
examples.zh: 我觉得书中的人物很不真实。

examples.en: His explanation was unconvincing.
examples.zh: 他的解释并不能令人信服。

examples.en: She managed a weak, unconvincing smile.
examples.zh: 她勉强挤出一丝笑意。

senses.def: in a way that does not seem true or real; in a way that does not make you believe that something is true
senses.zh: 似乎不真实的；不令人信服的；难以相信的

examples.en: He laughed unconvincingly.
examples.zh: 他干笑了几声。

senses.def: not cooked

examples.en: Eat plenty of uncooked fruit and vegetables.
examples.zh: 要多吃生的水果和蔬菜。

examples.en: The steak was uncooked in the middle.
examples.zh: 这牛排的中间部分是生的。

senses.def: not considered acceptable by fashionable young people
senses.zh: 不时髦的；不帅的；不潇洒的；不酷的

examples.en: My kids tell me my hairstyle is really uncool.
examples.zh: 我的孩子们告诉我我的发型真的很不酷。

senses.def: not willing to be helpful to other people or do what they ask
senses.zh: 不愿合作的；不愿配合的

examples.en: The witness was extremely uncooperative.
examples.zh: 目击者一点都不配合。

examples.en: She was an aggressive and uncooperative child.
examples.zh: 她这孩子非常好强，不愿与人合作。

senses.def: if a person is uncoordinated
senses.zh: 动作不协调的；不灵便的；手脚笨拙的

senses.def: having no control; not moving smoothly or together
not well organized; with no thought for how the different parts work together
senses.zh: 不缜密的；无通盘安排的；缺乏全面考虑的

examples.en: The budget process had been uncoordinated and inefficient.
examples.zh: 预算过程不协调且效率低下。

examples.en: The strikes were spontaneous and uncoordinated.
examples.zh: 罢工是自发且不协调的。

senses.def: to open a bottle by removing the cork
not supported by any other evidence; not having been corroborated
a policy or proposal that is uncosted

examples.en: Critics complained that the new policy was totally uncosted.
examples.zh: 批评人士抱怨，这项新政策完全未计成本。

senses.def: an uncountable noun
a noun that is uncountable
to remove the connection between two vehicles, two parts of a train, etc.
senses.zh: 使（车辆、车厢等）分离；分开（连在一起的两个）

examples.en: To uncouple the trailer from the car, press the ‘release’ button and lift.
examples.zh: 要将拖车与汽车分离，请按下“释放”按钮并抬起。

senses.def: rude or socially unacceptable
senses.zh: 粗鲁的；无礼的；无教养的

examples.en: uncouth laughter
examples.zh: 粗野的笑声

examples.en: an uncouth young man
examples.zh: 一个无教养的年轻人

senses.def: to remove something that is covering something

examples.en: Uncover the pan and let the soup simmer.
examples.zh: 揭开锅盖，让汤再慢火煨一下。

senses.def: to discover something that was previously hidden or secret

examples.en: Police have uncovered a plot to kidnap the President's son.
examples.zh: 警方发现了一个绑架总统之子的阴谋。

examples.en: It will be difficult to uncover the truth.
examples.zh: 揭露真相将会很困难。

examples.en: Archaeologists have uncovered an entire Roman city.
examples.zh: 考古学家发现了整个罗马城市。

senses.def: not willing to criticize somebody/something or to judge whether somebody/something is right or wrong
senses.zh: 不愿批评的；不置可否的；不得罪人的

examples.en: Her uncritical acceptance of everything I said began to irritate me.
examples.zh: 我说什么她都不论对错一概接受，这倒惹我不耐烦起来。

senses.def: without criticizing somebody/something or judging whether somebody/something is right or wrong
senses.zh: 不愿批评的；不置可否的；不得罪人的

examples.en: These official statistics should not be accepted uncritically.
examples.zh: 不应不加批判地接受这些官方统计数据。

senses.def: not full of people

examples.en: The beach was pleasantly uncrowded.
examples.zh: 海滩上人不多，很是惬意。

senses.def: not yet crowned
the person considered to be the best, most famous or successful in a particular place or area of activity
senses.zh: 无冕之王（某地区或领域中最杰出的人）

senses.def: the person considered to be the best, most famous or successful in a particular place or area of activity
senses.zh: 无冕之王（某地区或领域中最杰出的人）

senses.def: the act of pouring oil on somebody’s head or another part of their body as part of an important religious ceremony
behaviour or speech that is not sincere and that expresses too much praise of somebody
senses.zh: 虚情假意的行为（或讲话）；奉承；甜言蜜语

senses.def: friendly or giving praise in a way that is not sincere and that is therefore unpleasant
senses.zh: 谄媚的；油滑的；拍马奉迎的

examples.en: an unctuous host
examples.zh: 油腔滑调的主人

senses.def: in a way that is friendly or that gives praise which is not sincere and is therefore unpleasant
senses.zh: 谄媚的；油滑的；拍马奉迎的

senses.def: not used for growing crops
not well educated; not able to understand or enjoy art, literature, etc.
senses.zh: 缺乏教养的；不文雅的；粗俗的

senses.def: to become straight, or to make something become straight, after being in a curled

examples.en: The snake slowly uncurled.
examples.zh: 那条蛇慢慢地伸开了蜷缩的身子。

examples.en: The cat uncurled itself and jumped off the wall.
examples.zh: 那猫伸直了腰跳下墙头。

senses.def: left to grow; not cut short

examples.en: The uncut grass came up to her waist.
examples.zh: 未割的草齐了她的腰。

senses.def: left in its complete form; without any parts removed; not censored
senses.zh: 未删节的；未删剪的；未审查的

examples.en: the original uncut version
examples.zh: 未删节的原版

senses.def: not given a shape by cutting

examples.en: uncut diamonds
examples.zh: 未切割的钻石

senses.def: not cut into separate pieces

examples.en: an uncut loaf of bread
examples.zh: 一整条未切的面包

senses.def: not damaged, harmed or made less good

examples.en: There was a slight collision but my car was undamaged.
examples.zh: 虽有轻微碰撞，但我的汽车没有损坏。

examples.en: He emerged from the court case with his reputation undamaged.
examples.zh: 他挺过了官司，名声没有受损。

senses.def: without a date written or printed on it

examples.en: an undated letter
examples.zh: 一封没写日期的信

senses.def: of which the date is not known
senses.zh: 日期不明的；时间不详的

examples.en: undated archaeological remains
examples.zh: 时间未确定的考古遗迹

senses.def: still enthusiastic and determined, despite difficulties, danger, etc.
senses.zh: 顽强；百折不挠；坚强不屈

examples.en: He seemed undaunted by all the opposition to his idea.
examples.zh: 尽管他的思想屡遭非难，他似乎仍然百折不挠。

examples.en: Undaunted, she persevered.
examples.zh: 她不屈不挠，坚持了下来。

senses.def: dead, but still able to move, act and (in some cases) think and speak. Vampires
senses.zh: 不死的，亡灵的（肉体已死但仍能行动，甚至思考和说话）

examples.en: In this movie, Frankenstein is presented as a giant, undead monster, brought to life through the dark power of science.
examples.zh: 在这部电影中，弗兰肯斯坦被描绘成一个巨大的不死怪物，通过科学的黑暗力量而复活。

senses.def: creatures who are undead

examples.en: In this game, players have to battle a vast army of the undead.
examples.zh: 这款游戏中，玩家要迎战亡灵大军。

senses.def: not having made a decision about somebody/something

examples.en: I’m still undecided (about) who to vote for.
examples.zh: 我还拿不定主意投谁的票。

examples.en: He was undecided as to what to do next.
examples.zh: 他对下一步要做什么犹豫不决。

senses.def: not having been decided

examples.en: The venue for the World Cup remains undecided.
examples.zh: 世界杯的举办地点尚未确定。

examples.en: The question cannot be left undecided.
examples.zh: 这个问题不能悬而不决。

senses.def: not admitted to; not stated in an open way; not having been declared
senses.zh: 未承认的；未声明的；未申报的

examples.en: No income should remain undeclared.
examples.zh: 一切收入均应申报。

examples.en: Undeclared goods (= that the customs are not told about) may be confiscated.
examples.zh: 未报关的物品可能被没收。

senses.def: not having lost or been defeated

examples.en: They are undefeated in 13 games.
examples.zh: 他们 13 场比赛未被打败过。

examples.en: the undefeated world champion
examples.zh: 全胜的世界冠军

senses.def: not protected or guarded

examples.en: undefended borders
examples.zh: 不设防边界

senses.def: if a case in court is undefended
not made clear or definite

examples.en: The money was lent for an undefined period of time.
examples.zh: 这笔钱无限期借出。

senses.def: to cancel an action of deleting
senses.zh: 取消删除；恢复（已删除的文件等）

senses.def: not needing a lot of effort or thought
senses.zh: 不费力的；不费神的；轻松容易的

examples.en: an undemanding job
examples.zh: 轻松的工作

senses.def: not asking for a lot of attention or action from other people
senses.zh: 不强求的；不要求照顾的；随和的

senses.def: against or not acting according to the principles of democracy
senses.zh: 不民主的；专横的；霸道的

examples.en: undemocratic decisions
examples.zh: 专制的决定

examples.en: an undemocratic regime
examples.zh: 专制政权

examples.en: The system is fundamentally undemocratic.
examples.zh: 这一体制根本上是不民主的。

senses.def: in a way that is against or not according to the principles of democracy
senses.zh: 不民主的；专横的；霸道的

examples.en: an undemocratically elected government
examples.zh: 非民选政府

examples.en: He was accused of acting undemocratically.
examples.zh: 他被指作风专断。

senses.def: not showing feelings openly, especially feelings of love
senses.zh: 喜怒不形于色的；不流露感情的

senses.def: true or certain; that cannot be denied

examples.en: He had undeniable charm.
examples.zh: 他具有不可否认的魅力。

examples.en: It is an undeniable fact that crime is increasing.
examples.zh: 犯罪在增长是无可争辩的事实。

examples.en: The link between poverty and bad health is undeniable.
examples.zh: 贫困与健康状况不佳之间的联系是不可否认的。

senses.def: in a way that is true or certain and cannot be denied

examples.en: undeniably impressive
examples.zh: 确实令人赞叹

examples.en: He is, undeniably, an excellent player.
examples.zh: 不可否认，他是一名出色的球员。

senses.def: in, to or through a position that is below something

examples.en: Have you looked under the bed?
examples.zh: 你看了床底下没有？

examples.en: She placed the ladder under (= just lower than) the window.
examples.zh: 她把梯子立在窗户下面。

examples.en: The dog squeezed under the gate and ran into the road.
examples.zh: 狗从门底下钻出去，跑到大路上去了。

senses.def: below the surface of something; covered by something

examples.en: The boat lay under several feet of water.
examples.zh: 那条船沉在水下好几英尺处。

senses.def: less than; younger than

examples.en: an annual income of under £10 000
examples.zh: 不到 1 万英镑的年收入

examples.en: It took us under an hour.
examples.zh: 这事花了我们不到一小时。

examples.en: I'm actually in the film for just under two minutes.
examples.zh: 我其实在电影里出镜不到两分钟。

examples.en: Nobody under 18 is allowed to buy alcohol.
examples.zh: 未满 18 岁者不得买酒。

senses.def: affected by something

examples.en: The wall collapsed under the strain.
examples.zh: 墙壁因承受不了重压而坍塌了。

examples.en: I've been feeling under stress lately.
examples.zh: 我最近感到压力很大。

examples.en: I'm under no illusions about what hard work this will be.
examples.zh: 对于这项工作的辛苦，我从不存错误的幻想。

examples.en: You'll be under anaesthetic, so you won't feel a thing.
examples.zh: 你将被麻醉，所以什么也感觉不到。

senses.def: used to say who or what controls, governs or manages somebody/something

examples.en: The country is now under martial law.
examples.zh: 这个国家目前在戒严中。

examples.en: The coinage was reformed under Elizabeth I (= when she was queen).
examples.zh: 英国币制在伊丽莎白一世时代作了改革。

examples.en: She has a staff of 19 working under her.
examples.zh: 她手下有 19 个职员工作。

examples.en: Under its new conductor, the orchestra has established an international reputation.
examples.zh: 在新指挥的领导下，这个乐团建立了国际声誉。

senses.def: according to an agreement, a law or a system
senses.zh: 根据，按照（协议、法律或制度）

examples.en: A man was detained under the Mental Health Act.
examples.zh: 根据《精神卫生法》，一名男子被拘留。

examples.en: Under the terms of the lease you had no right to sublet the property.
examples.zh: 按租约条款的规定，你无权转租这房产。

examples.en: Is the television still under guarantee?
examples.zh: 这台电视机还在保修期内吗？

senses.def: experiencing a particular process

examples.en: The hotel is still under construction.
examples.zh: 旅馆还在兴建中。

examples.en: The matter is under investigation.
examples.zh: 此事正在调查中。

senses.def: using a particular name

examples.en: She also wrote under the pseudonym of Barbara Vine.
examples.zh: 她还用芭芭拉·瓦因的化名从事写作。

senses.def: found in a particular part of a book, list, etc.
senses.zh: 在…项下；在（书等中的）某部分

examples.en: If it's not under ‘sports’, try looking under ‘games’.
examples.zh: 如果在“体育运动”项下查不到，就试试“游戏”项吧。

senses.def: below something

examples.en: He pulled up the covers and crawled under.
examples.zh: 他掀开被子钻到里面。

senses.def: below the surface of water

examples.en: She took a deep breath and stayed under for more than a minute.
examples.zh: 她深吸了一口气，然后潜水一分多钟。

examples.en: The boat was going under fast.
examples.zh: 小船正迅速下沉。

senses.def: less; younger

examples.en: prices of ten dollars and under
examples.zh: 不高于十美元的价格

examples.en: children aged 12 and under
examples.zh: 12 岁及以下的儿童

senses.def: in or into an unconscious state
senses.zh: 在昏迷中；陷入昏迷状态

examples.en: He felt himself going under.
examples.zh: 他觉得自己将要昏厥。

senses.def: below

examples.en: undergrowth
examples.zh: 下木层

examples.en: undercoat
examples.zh: 底涂层

senses.def: lower in age or rank

examples.en: the under-fives
examples.zh: 五岁以下的儿童

examples.en: an undergraduate
examples.zh: 大学生

senses.def: not enough

examples.en: underripe
examples.zh: 未成熟的

examples.en: undercooked
examples.zh: 未煮熟的

senses.def: lower

examples.en: the under layer
examples.zh: 下面的一层

examples.en: the under surface of a leaf
examples.zh: 叶子的背面

senses.def: hidden or protected by something

examples.en: Later, under cover of darkness, they crept into the house.
examples.zh: 后来他们在夜幕的掩护下溜进了房子。

examples.en: We attacked at night, under cover of darkness.
examples.zh: 夜里我们在夜幕的掩护下发动进攻。

senses.def: if somebody is under a cloud

examples.en: She left the company under a cloud.
examples.zh: 她在一片质疑中离开了公司。

senses.def: not legally old enough to do a particular thing

examples.en: It is illegal to sell vapes to children who are under age.
examples.zh: 向未成年儿童出售电子烟是违法的。

senses.def: in a tent

examples.en: They spent the night under canvas.
examples.zh: 他们在帆布下过夜。

senses.def: pretending to be somebody else in order to do something secretly
senses.zh: （为秘密活动）伪装着，装扮着，冒名顶替

examples.en: a police officer working under cover
examples.zh: 做隐蔽工作的警察

senses.def: under a structure that gives protection from the weather

examples.en: Start growing the plants indoors or under cover.
examples.zh: 开始在室内或遮盖下种植植物。

examples.en: All the seats are under cover.
examples.zh: 所有的席位都盖了起来。

senses.def: made with the permission of a company or an organization

examples.en: They are Italian trains, but they will be built in Britain under licence.
examples.zh: 这些是意大利的火车，但获得许可将在英国制造。

examples.en: The vaccine is manufactured under licence locally.
examples.zh: 该疫苗是在当地获得许可生产的。

senses.def: made with the permission of a company or an organization

examples.en: They are Italian trains, but they will be built in Britain under license.
examples.zh: 它们是意大利火车，但将在英国获得许可制造。

examples.en: The vaccine is manufactured under license locally.
examples.zh: 该疫苗是在当地获得许可生产的。

under lock and key: @@@LINK=(keep something/put something/be) under lock and key

senses.def: if a house or other building is under offer
senses.zh: （房屋或其他建筑物）已有买主出价，在洽售中

examples.en: The property is currently under offer to a client.
examples.zh: 这处房产目前已有一位客户出价打算购买。

under one roof: @@@LINK=under one roof | under the same roof

senses.def: in the same building or house
senses.zh: 在同一座建筑中；同在一个屋檐下

examples.en: There are various stores and restaurants all under one roof.
examples.zh: 在同一栋大楼里有各种商店和餐馆。

examples.en: I don't think I can live under the same roof as you any longer.
examples.zh: 我觉得我再也不能和你生活在同一个屋檐下了。

examples.en: We're good friends but we could never live under the same roof.
examples.zh: 我们是好朋友，但是我们永远无法生活在同一屋檐下。

under one roof | under the same roof.word: under one roof | under the same roof

senses.def: if a liquid or a gas is kept under pressure

examples.en: Draught beer is pumped out of the barrel under pressure.
examples.zh: 生啤酒在压力下从桶中泵出。

senses.def: being forced to do something

examples.en: The director is under increasing pressure to resign.
examples.zh: 要求总监辞职的呼声越来越高。

examples.en: Hospital staff are coming under pressure to work longer hours.
examples.zh: 医院员工正被迫延长工作时间。

senses.def: made to feel anxious about something you have to do
senses.zh: 承受着（急于完成某事的）压力

examples.en: The team performs well under pressure.
examples.zh: 这个队在压力下表现良好。

examples.en: He's felt under pressure since his wife had the operation.
examples.zh: 妻子做手术以来，他一直觉得压力很大。

senses.def: unwillingly and after expressing disagreement
senses.zh: 无奈地；不服气地；不甘心地

examples.en: She wrote a letter of apology but only under protest.
examples.zh: 她无奈之下写了一封致歉信。

examples.en: The strikers returned to work, but under protest.
examples.zh: 罢工人员不情愿地返回了工作岗位。

senses.def: in a sealed
in a separate envelope

examples.en: The information you requested is being forwarded to you under separate cover.
examples.zh: 现另函寄上所要资料。

senses.def: surrounded by an army or the police in a siege

examples.en: The city was under siege for six months.
examples.zh: 该城被围困了六个月。

examples.en: At the very end of the war, Prague again came under siege.
examples.zh: 战争就快结束时，布拉格再次处于包围之中。

senses.def: being criticized all the time or put under pressure by problems, questions, etc.
senses.zh: 一再遭到批评的；受…困扰的

examples.en: The government is already under siege for its economic policy.
examples.zh: 政府已经因其经济政策而受到围攻。

examples.en: Under military and economic siege, entire economic sectors have collapsed.
examples.zh: 在军事和经济封锁下，整个经济已经崩溃。

senses.def: if something is under somebody’s nose
senses.zh: 就在某人面前（却看不见）

examples.en: I searched everywhere for the letter and it was under my nose all the time!
examples.zh: 我到处找这封信，可它一直就在我面前。

senses.def: if something happens under somebody’s nose
senses.zh: 当着某人的面，就在某人眼皮底下（却没有被察觉）

examples.en: The police didn't know the drugs ring was operating right under their noses.
examples.zh: 警方不知道贩毒集团就在他们的眼皮底下运作。

senses.def: completely controlled by somebody
senses.zh: 完全受某人控制；受制于人

examples.en: She’s got him under her thumb.
examples.zh: 她把他管住了。

senses.def: waiting for a signal to start a race
suspected of doing something wrong, illegal or dishonest

examples.en: The whole family is currently under suspicion of her murder.
examples.zh: 目前这一家人都涉嫌谋杀她。

examples.en: A number of doctors came under suspicion of unethical behaviour.
examples.zh: 一些医生涉嫌有不道德行为。

examples.en: He fell under suspicion of tax evasion.
examples.zh: 他有逃税嫌疑。

senses.def: being watched carefully by somebody
senses.zh: 在某人的密切注视下；在某人的监视下

examples.en: The children played under the watchful eye of their father.
examples.zh: 孩子们在父亲悉心看护下玩耍。

examples.en: I want you under my eye.
examples.zh: 我要你待在我能看到的地方。

senses.def: with the protection or support of a particular organization or person

examples.en: Medical supplies are being sent under the aegis of the Red Cross.
examples.zh: 医疗用品正在红十字会的支持下运送。

senses.def: with the help, support or protection of somebody/something

examples.en: The community centre was set up under the auspices of a government initiative.
examples.zh: 在政府的大力支持下，社区中心建成了。

examples.en: a peacekeeping force under United Nations auspices
examples.zh: 联合国主持下的维和部队

senses.def: claiming to support a particular set of ideas

examples.en: They fought the election under the banner of ‘No new taxes’.
examples.zh: 他们打着“免征新税”的旗号参加竞选。

senses.def: as part of a particular group or organization
senses.zh: 作为某个组织的一部分

examples.en: Troops are in the country under the banner of the United Nations.
examples.zh: 军队以联合国的名义在该国驻扎。

senses.def: receiving medical care from somebody

examples.en: He's under the care of Dr Parks.
examples.zh: 他在接受帕克斯医生的治疗。

examples.en: refugees under the care of the relief agencies
examples.zh: 受救济机构照顾的难民

senses.def: experiencing a lot of pressure

examples.en: Our side was under the cosh for most of the second half.
examples.zh: 我方在下半场的大部分时间里承受着很大的压力。

senses.def: goods that are bought or sold under the counter

examples.zh: 严重营养不良的儿童

senses.def: the condition of being in bad health because of a lack of food or a lack of the right type of food

senses.def: a piece of men’s underwear worn under their trousers

examples.en: He came to the door dressed only in his underpants.
examples.zh: 他来开门时只穿了条内裤。

examples.en: He sat on the examination table in his underpants.
examples.zh: 他穿着内裤坐在诊查桌上。

senses.def: a piece of underwear worn by men or women under trousers, a skirt, etc.

senses.zh: 下穿式立交桥；地下通道

senses.def: to pay somebody too little money, especially for their work
the fact of paying somebody too little money, especially for their work; the amount by which somebody is paid too little
senses.zh: 支付低薪；报酬过低；支付的过低金额

senses.def: to not be as successful as was expected
to support or form the basis of an argument, a claim, etc.
senses.zh: 加强，巩固，构成（…的基础等）

examples.zh: 这份报告以广泛的研究为基础。

senses.def: to support a wall and make it stronger by putting metal, concrete

senses.zh: 低调处理；降低…的重要性

examples.zh: 我觉得她在淡化报告的重要性。

senses.def: not having done enough preparation for something you have to do
senses.zh: 准备不充分的；准备不足的

senses.def: something that is underpriced
senses.zh: 定价过低的；售价过低的

senses.def: having less money and fewer opportunities than most people in society
senses.zh: 在社会中处于弱势的；贫苦的；机遇少的；底层的

examples.en: underprivileged sections of the community
examples.zh: 社区的弱势阶层

examples.en: educationally/socially underprivileged groups
examples.zh: 教育上／社会上处于弱势地位的群体

examples.en: No one from these educationally underprivileged groups has a chance of getting to university.
examples.zh: 这些受教育程度较低的群体没有人有机会上大学。

examples.en: The party aims to represent the interests of the underprivileged sections of society.
examples.zh: 该党旨在代表社会中弱势群体的利益。

senses.def: people who are underprivileged
to not recognize how good, important, etc. somebody/something really is

examples.en: He's seriously underrated as a writer.
examples.zh: 他是被严重低估的一位作家。

examples.en: an underrated movie
examples.zh: 一部未得到应有评价的电影

examples.en: Don’t underrate yourself.
examples.zh: 不要低估自己。

senses.def: to draw a line under a word, sentence, etc.
senses.zh: 在（词语等下）画线；画底线标出

examples.en: The word ‘not’ was heavily underscored.
examples.zh: “不”这个词被重重地强调了。

senses.def: to emphasize or show that something is important or true

examples.en: His speech underscored the need for a clear policy.
examples.zh: 他的演讲强调了明确政策的必要性。

examples.en: Her question underscored how little she understood him.
examples.zh: 她的问题突显了她对他的了解是多么的少。

examples.en: The report underscored that the project enjoyed considerable support in both countries.
examples.zh: 报告强调，该项目在两国都得到了大力支持。

examples.en: It should be underscored that these are only preliminary findings.
examples.zh: 应该强调的是，这些只是初步发现。

senses.def: the symbol (_ ) that is used to draw a line between letters or words, especially in computer commands and internet addresses
senses.zh: 下划线（用于字母或单词之间，尤见于计算机命令和网址）

senses.def: found, used or happening below the surface of the sea

examples.en: undersea cables/earthquakes
examples.zh: 海底电缆／地震

senses.def: (in the UK) a senior civil servant
(in the UK) a junior minister who works for the minister in charge of a government department
(in the US) an official of high rank in a government department, directly below a member of a cabinet

senses.zh: 以低于（竞争对手）的价格出售；竞价销售

examples.en: Our goods are never undersold (= our prices are the lowest).
examples.zh: 我们的商品永远不会卖得不足（=我们的价格是最低的）。

senses.def: to sell something at a price lower than its real value
to make people think that somebody/something is/you are not as good or as interesting as they/you really are
senses.zh: 降低人们对…的印象；贬损

examples.en: Don't undersell yourself at the interview.
examples.zh: 面试时不可过分自谦。

senses.def: not getting enough help, products or services
senses.zh: 未得到足够帮助（或产品、服务）的

examples.en: improving access to healthcare in underserved areas
examples.zh: 改善缺医少药地区的医疗卫生服务

senses.def: a piece of underwear worn under a shirt, etc. next to the skin
senses.zh: （衬衣等里面贴身穿的）背心，汗衫

examples.en: He was standing there in his undershirt and shorts.
examples.zh: 他穿着背心和短裤站在那儿。

senses.def: to fail to reach the intended level, target, etc.
to land before reaching the runway
a situation in which something does not reach the intended level, target, etc.

examples.en: the public spending undershoot
examples.zh: 公共支出低于预期

senses.def: a situation in which an aircraft lands before reaching the runway
underpants
the bottom or lower side or surface of something
not as big as is expected or needed

examples.en: She held an undersized baby in her arms.
examples.zh: 她怀里抱着一个身材矮小的婴儿。

examples.en: He is relatively undersized for an American football player.
examples.zh: 对于美国橄榄球运动员来说，他的身材相对偏小。

examples.en: He attempts to catch the beast with a comically undersized net.
examples.zh: 他试图用一张尺寸小得可笑的网来捕捉野兽。

senses.def: a skirt that is worn under another skirt as underwear
