examples.zh: 那片湖很快映入眼帘。

examples.en: The sun disappeared from view.
examples.zh: 太阳看不见了。

examples.en: Tensions within the band remained hidden from public view.
examples.zh: 乐队成员之间的紧张关系仍然不为公众所知。

examples.en: There was nobody in view.
examples.zh: 一个人也看不见。

examples.en: I hid in the hallway out of view.
examples.zh: 我躲在走廊里看不见的地方。

examples.en: Sit down—you're blocking my view.
examples.zh: 坐下，你挡住我的视线了。

examples.en: I didn't have a good view of the stage.
examples.zh: 我看不清舞台。

senses.group: what you can see 可看到的东西

senses.def: a personal opinion about something; an attitude towards something

examples.en: to have strong political views
examples.zh: 持强硬的政治观点

examples.en: She and I hold opposing views on the matter.
examples.zh: 关于这件事她和我观点相反。

examples.en: His views on the subject were well known.
examples.zh: 他对这个问题的看法众所周知。

examples.zh: 这次会议将使人们有机会表达对这个问题的看法。

examples.zh: 我们所持的态度是：干涉是错误的。

examples.en: This evidence supports the view that there is too much violence on television.
examples.zh: 这一证据证实了人们认为电视节目中有太多暴力的看法。

examples.en: I, on the other hand, take a different view.
examples.zh: 另一方面，我持不同的观点。

examples.en: I am afraid I do not share this view.
examples.zh: 恐怕我不同意这个观点。

examples.en: My own/personal view is that…
examples.zh: 我个人的看法是…

examples.en: In my view it was a waste of time.
examples.zh: 依我看，这是浪费时间。

examples.en: There was a frank exchange of views (= an angry argument) between Dr Wilson and the other members of the committee.
examples.zh: 威尔逊博士和委员会的其他成员言辞激烈地交换了意见。

examples.zh: 他乐观地看待人生。

examples.en: the Christian view of the world
examples.zh: 基督教的世界观

examples.en: The book gives readers an inside view of political life.
examples.zh: 这本书为读者提供了政治生活的内部视角。

examples.en: The traditional view was that marriage was meant to last.
examples.zh: 传统的观念是结成夫妻就要白头到老。

senses.group: way of understanding 理解方式

examples.zh: 他一边游览城镇和周围乡村，一边写生。

senses.def: to have a particular aim, plan, etc. in your mind

examples.zh: 他想挣钱，心中抱定这个目标就出国了。

senses.group: chance to see something 观看的机会

senses.def: to appear, especially when moving gradually closer from a long way off

examples.en: A ship hove into sight.
examples.zh: 远处出现了一条船。

examples.en: Like a galleon in full sail, Cara hove into view.
examples.zh: 卡拉就像一艘扬帆起航的大帆船，驶入了我们的视野。

senses.group: chance to see something 观看的机会

senses.def: that can be seen completely, directly in front of somebody/something
senses.zh: 完全看得见；在眼皮底下

examples.zh: 他在众目睽睽之下被人枪杀了。

examples.zh: 由于天气的缘故，这项赛事将在室内进行。

senses.group: chance to see something 观看的机会

senses.def: being shown in a public place so that people can look at it

examples.en: The new discoveries will be on view in London in the spring.
examples.zh: 新发现将于春季在伦敦展出。

examples.en: The carriage was put on view for the public to see.
examples.zh: 那辆四轮马车被陈列出来让公众参观。

senses.group: chance to see something 观看的机会

senses.def: to think somebody/something is bad; to not have a good opinion of somebody/something
senses.zh: 对…持不好的看法；对…没有好感

examples.en: She took a dim view of my suggestion.
examples.zh: 她对我的建议持否定态度。

senses.group: chance to see something 观看的机会

senses.def: to consider what is likely to happen or be important over a long period of time rather than only considering the present situation

examples.en: As pension funds are investing for members’ retirements, they can take the long view.
examples.zh: 由于养老基金正在为会员的退休生活进行投资，因此它们可以放眼长远。

examples.zh: 普遍认为他可能当领导。

examples.zh: 这种车刚造出时，其设计被认为是独具匠心。

examples.zh: 她对他心存怀疑。

examples.en: You should view their offer with a great deal of caution.
examples.zh: 你应当非常谨慎地看待他们的提议。

examples.zh: 人们从世界各地涌来欣赏她的作品。

examples.zh: 日食须透过一种特殊镜片方可观看。

examples.en: These paintings were meant to be viewed from a distance.
examples.zh: 这些画作是为了从远处观看的。

intro.zh: 以上各词均指景色，尤指从某处看到的风景。

items.def: what you can see from a particular place or position, especially beautiful natural scenery:
items.zh: 指从某处看到的景色、风景，尤指自然美景

examples.en: The cottage had a delightful sea view.
examples.zh: 这小屋可以看到宜人的海景。

items.def: a thing that you see or can see, especially something that is impressive or unusual:
items.zh: 指看见或看得见的事物、景象，尤指壮观、奇特的景象

examples.en: It’s a spectacular sight as the flamingos lift into the air.
examples.zh: 一群红鹳飞向空中，景象十分壮观。

examples.zh: 那是赏心悦目的乡村风光。

senses.def: that can be looked at

examples.zh: 她对这个问题会有她自己的看法。

senses.def: a direction or place from which you look at something

a window in a spacecraft
a period of time when people do not sleep, especially at night, in order to watch a sick person, say prayers, protest, etc.

examples.zh: 她强调必须时常保持警惕。

senses.zh: 文斯·伦巴第（Vince Lombardi）：（1913-70）是美国职业美式足球教练，以其艰辛的方法而闻名。从1959年到1967年，他训练了威斯康星州的绿湾包装工队，在那期间他们赢得了141场比赛，仅输了39场。他的球队五次获得了国家橄榄球联赛冠军（1961-2和1965-8）以及前两个超级碗。 （1967-8）。为纪念赢得超级碗的球队而颁发的文斯·隆巴迪奖杯就是为了纪念他。

senses.zh: 技艺精湛的；技巧超群的

examples.en: Kane treated us to a virtuoso performance against Chelsea this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午对阵切尔西的比赛中，凯恩为我们带来了一场精彩的表演。

examples.en: a virtuoso pianist/player
examples.zh: 钢琴大师；技艺精湛的演奏者

examples.en: They gave a virtuoso display of Spanish dancing.
examples.zh: 他们的西班牙舞表演展示了超群的技艺。

senses.def: behaving in a very good and moral way; showing high moral standards
senses.zh: 品行端正的；道德高尚的

examples.en: a wise and virtuous man
examples.zh: 博学多识的君子

examples.en: She lived an entirely virtuous life.
examples.zh: 她一生品行端正。

examples.en: They believe strongly that work is virtuous.
examples.zh: 他们坚信工作是有美德的。

senses.def: claiming to behave better or have higher moral standards than other people
senses.zh: 自命不凡的；自命清高的

examples.en: He was feeling virtuous because he had finished and they hadn't.
examples.zh: 因为他完成了而他们没有，他自以为了不起。

senses.def: a series of events in which each one seems to increase the good effects of the previous one
in a very good or moral way
senses.zh: 品行端正的；品德高的；有道德的

examples.en: Most religions ask us to live virtuously.
examples.zh: 大多数宗教要求我们过有道德的生活。

senses.def: in a way that involves claiming or feeling that you behave better or have higher moral standards than other people
senses.zh: 自命不凡的；自命清高的

examples.en: I virtuously refused a piece of cake.
examples.zh: 我善意地拒绝了一块蛋糕。

senses.def: the degree to which a disease or poison is dangerous or harmful and quick to have an effect

examples.en: the virulence of the virus strain
examples.zh: 病毒株的毒力

senses.def: the fact of showing strong negative and bitter feelings

examples.en: the virulence of the attacks on her in the press
examples.zh: 媒体对她的猛烈攻击

senses.def: extremely dangerous or harmful and quick to have an effect

examples.en: a virulent form of influenza
examples.zh: 一种致命的流感

examples.en: a particularly virulent flu germ
examples.zh: 一种毒性特别强的流感病毒

senses.def: showing strong negative and bitter feelings
senses.zh: 狠毒的；恶毒的；不共戴天的

examples.en: virulent criticism
examples.zh: 恶意的批评

examples.en: virulent nationalism
examples.zh: 不共戴天的民族主义

senses.def: in a way that shows strong negative and bitter feelings
senses.zh: 狠毒的；恶毒的；不共戴天的

examples.en: They remain virulently opposed to any kind of compromise deal.
examples.zh: 他们仍然强烈反对任何形式的妥协协议。

senses.def: a disease or poison that acts virulently

examples.en: There were fears that smallpox could re-emerge even more virulently.
examples.zh: 人们担心天花可能会再次出现，毒性更强。

senses.def: a living thing, too small to be seen without a microscope

examples.en: the flu/influenza virus
examples.zh: 流感病毒

examples.en: patients known to have been infected with the virus
examples.zh: 已知感染了这一病毒的患者

examples.en: the human immunodeficiency virus or HIV
examples.zh: 人类免疫缺陷病毒或艾滋病毒

examples.en: the hepatitis C virus
examples.zh: 丙型肝炎病毒

examples.en: a highly infectious disease caused by a virus
examples.zh: 由病毒引起的高度传染性疾病

examples.en: a virus infection
examples.zh: 病毒感染

examples.en: The vaccination offers good protection against the virus.
examples.zh: 疫苗接种可以很好地预防病毒。

examples.en: It is not clear how she contracted the virus.
examples.zh: 目前尚不清楚她是如何感染病毒的。

senses.def: a disease caused by a virus

examples.en: There's a virus going around the office.
examples.zh: 办公室里流行着一种病毒性疾病。

examples.en: I must have caught a virus on holiday.
examples.zh: 我一定是在度假时感染了病毒。

senses.def: instructions that are hidden within a computer program and are designed to cause faults or destroy data

examples.en: a computer virus
examples.zh: 计算机病毒

examples.en: I think I've got a virus on my laptop.
examples.zh: 我认为我的笔记本电脑中了病毒。

examples.en: The virus in the software was programmed to corrupt the hard disk.
examples.zh: 软件中的病毒被编程来破坏硬盘。

examples.en: software errors that can be exploited by virus writers
examples.zh: 可以被病毒编写者利用的软件错误

senses.def: in relation to

examples.en: Britain’s role vis-à-vis the United States
examples.zh: 英国对美国的作用

senses.def: in comparison with

examples.en: It was felt that the company had an unfair advantage vis-à-vis smaller companies elsewhere.
examples.zh: 人们感到这家公司与其他地方的小公司相比占有不公平的优势。

senses.def: a stamp or mark put in your passport by officials of a foreign country that gives you permission to enter, pass through or leave their country

examples.en: to apply for a visa
examples.zh: 申请签证

examples.en: an entry/tourist/transit/exit visa
examples.zh: 入境／旅游／过境／出境签证

senses.def: a person’s face
an important Buddhist festival that celebrates the birth, enlightenment
senses.zh: 卫舍迦节（佛教最重要节日，时间为太阳位于黄道汉宫第二宫月圆日，纪念佛陀诞辰、开悟与去世）

senses.def: the large organs inside the body, especially the intestines
resulting from strong feelings rather than careful thought
senses.zh: （未经过认真思考而）出自内心的，发自肺腑的

examples.en: visceral fear
examples.zh: 发自内心的恐惧

examples.en: She had a visceral dislike of all things foreign.
examples.zh: 凡是外国的东西，她都打心眼儿里讨厌。

senses.def: relating to the viscera
sticky and slimy

examples.en: the viscid lining of the intestine
examples.zh: 肠黏膜

senses.def: a chemical made from cellulose
the quality in a liquid of being thick and sticky; the quality of not flowing freely
(in the UK) a nobleman
senses.zh: 子爵（英国贵族，低于伯爵而高于男爵）

senses.def: the rank or position of a viscount
a woman who has the rank of a viscount
the wife of a viscount
thick and sticky; not flowing freely
a tool with two metal blocks that can be moved together by turning a screw

examples.en: He held my arm in a vise-like (= very firm) grip.
examples.zh: 他的手像虎钳一样紧紧抓住了我的手臂。

senses.def: how far or well you can see, especially as affected by the light or the weather
senses.zh: 可见度；能见度；能见距离

examples.en: good/poor/bad/zero visibility
examples.zh: 能见度高／低／差／为零

examples.en: Visibility was down to about 100 metres in the fog.
examples.zh: 雾中的能见距离降到了大约 100 米。

examples.en: The car has excellent all-round visibility (= you can see what is around you very easily from it).
examples.zh: 这辆车四周的视野极好。

senses.def: the fact of attracting attention or being easy to see
senses.zh: 可见性；明显性；引人注目

examples.en: The advertisements were intended to increase the company's visibility in the marketplace (= to make people more aware of its products and services).
examples.zh: 那些广告旨在使这家公司在市场中更加引人注目。

examples.en: We aim to raise the visibility of ethnic minorities in our organization.
examples.zh: 我们力求使组织里的少数民族更受关注。

senses.def: that can be seen

examples.en: The house is clearly visible from the beach.
examples.zh: 从海滩可以清楚地看到那所房子。

examples.en: Most stars are not visible to the naked eye.
examples.zh: 大多数星星肉眼看不见。

examples.en: The moon was just visible between the clouds.
examples.zh: 月亮在云层之间隐约可见。

senses.def: that is obvious enough to be noticed

examples.en: We have not noticed any visible benefits from the new system.
examples.zh: 我们没有注意到新系统有任何明显的好处。

examples.en: A more visible police presence in communities is essential to combat crime.
examples.zh: 社区中更明显的警察存在对于打击犯罪至关重要。

examples.en: He showed no visible sign of emotion.
examples.zh: 他丝毫不露声色。

examples.en: She made a visible effort to control her anger.
examples.zh: 看得出她竭力控制自己不发火。

examples.en: After using the cream for a month, I could see no visible difference.
examples.zh: 使用这款面霜一个月后，我没有看到明显的差异。

senses.def: a group whose members can be seen not to belong to the majority group in society, usually because they are not white
senses.zh: 显性少数民族（与占社会主体的民族明显不同）

examples.en: According to the census, South Asians are the largest visible minority in Ontario.
examples.zh: 根据人口普查，南亚人是安大略省最大的明显少数民族。

senses.def: in a way that is easy to see

examples.en: He was visibly shocked.
examples.zh: 看得出他大为震惊。

examples.en: She paled visibly at the news.
examples.zh: 她听到这个消息时脸色明显变得苍白。

senses.def: the ability to see; the area that you can see from a particular position

examples.en: to have good/perfect/poor/blurred/normal vision
examples.zh: 视力好／极好／差／模糊／正常

examples.en: Cats have good night vision.
examples.zh: 猫的夜视能力强。

examples.en: Her vision was still blurry.
examples.zh: 她依然视力模糊。

examples.en: The disease causes a gradual loss of peripheral vision.
examples.zh: 这种病让人慢慢失去周边视觉。

examples.en: He glimpsed something on the edge of his vision.
examples.zh: 他斜眼瞥见了点什么。

senses.def: an idea or a picture in your imagination

examples.en: Our job is to guide a client and develop a strategic vision.
examples.zh: 我们的工作是指导客户并制定战略愿景。

examples.en: He had a vision of a world in which there would be no wars.
examples.zh: 他幻想有一个没有战争的世界。

examples.en: The word conjures up visions of home and family.
examples.zh: 这个词让人想起家和家人的愿景。

examples.en: The film's vision of the future is bleak.
examples.zh: 这部电影对未来的愿景是暗淡的。

examples.en: He harboured visions of becoming party leader some day.
examples.zh: 他怀有有一天成为党的领导人的愿景。

examples.en: I had visions of us getting hopelessly lost.
examples.zh: 我想象我们完全迷失了方向。

examples.en: These two men share a similar vision for the country.
examples.zh: 这两人对于国家有共同的愿景。

examples.en: He had a very specific vision for the future.
examples.zh: 他对未来有一个非常具体的愿景。

senses.def: a dream or similar experience, especially of a religious kind

examples.en: The idea came to her in a vision.
examples.zh: 她在神示中想到了这个主意。

examples.en: He had visions regularly.
examples.zh: 他经常出现异象。

examples.en: She claimed she saw a vision of the Virgin Mary.
examples.zh: 她声称她看到了圣母玛利亚的异象。

senses.def: the ability to think about or plan the future with great imagination and intelligence

examples.en: She had vision and determination.
examples.zh: 她有远见和决心。

examples.en: a leader of vision
examples.zh: 有远见的领袖

examples.en: He's a competent politician, but he lacks vision.
examples.zh: 他是个合格的从政者，但缺乏远见。

senses.def: a person of great beauty or who shows the quality mentioned
senses.zh: 容貌极美的人；有…气质的人

examples.en: She was a vision in white lace.
examples.zh: 她穿着白色蕾丝的衣服美极了。

examples.en: a vision of loveliness
examples.zh: 可爱的人

senses.def: the picture on a television or cinema screen
senses.zh: （电视或影院屏幕的）影像，画面

examples.en: We apologize for the loss of vision.
examples.zh: 很抱歉没法显示画面。

intro.en: These are all words for the area or distance that you can see from a particular position.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指视力范围、视野。

items.def: the area or distance that you can see from a particular position:
items.zh: 指视力范围、视野

examples.en: He looked up the street, but there was no one in sight.
examples.zh: 他朝街上望去，一个人也没看见。

items.def: (rather formal) the area or distance that you can see from a particular position:
items.zh: 指视力范围、视野

examples.en: The lake soon came into view.
examples.zh: 那湖很快便映入眼帘。

items.def: the area that you can see from a particular position:
items.zh: 指视野

examples.en: The couple moved outside her field of vision (= total area you can see from a particular position).
examples.zh: 这对夫妇离开了她的视野。

senses.def: a person whose job is to choose and process images for television
senses.zh: 视觉混合器：负责为电视选择和处理图像的人

senses.def: original and showing the ability to think about or plan the future with great imagination and intelligence
senses.zh: 有眼力的；有创见的；有远见卓识的

examples.en: a visionary leader
examples.zh: 有远见卓识的领袖

senses.def: relating to dreams or strange experiences, especially of a religious kind
senses.zh: 梦幻的；（尤指）宗教异象的；神示的

examples.en: visionary experiences
examples.zh: 异象体验

senses.def: a person who has the ability to think about or plan the future in a way that is intelligent and shows imagination
senses.zh: 有眼力的人；有远见卓识的人

examples.en: She was a true visionary.
examples.zh: 她是一位真正的有远见的人。

examples.en: The company needs visionaries to see opportunities.
examples.zh: 公司需要一些独具慧眼的人去发现机遇。

senses.def: to go to see a person or a place for a period of time

examples.en: My parents are coming to visit me next week.
examples.zh: 我父母下周要来看我。

examples.en: to visit friends/family
examples.zh: 看望朋友／家人

examples.en: It looks like a lovely place to visit.
examples.zh: 这看上去是个好去处。

examples.en: to visit a country/city/town
examples.zh: 访问一个国家/城市/城镇

examples.en: to visit a museum/shrine
examples.zh: 参观博物馆/神社

examples.en: to visit a hospital/an office
examples.zh: 去医院/办公室

examples.en: to visit a home/house
examples.zh: 拜访一个家/房子

examples.en: She went to visit relatives in Wales.
examples.zh: 她去威尔士看望亲戚了。

examples.en: The Prime Minister is visiting Japan at the moment.
examples.zh: 首相目前正在访问日本。

examples.en: You should visit your dentist at least twice a year.
examples.zh: 你应该每年至少去看两次牙科医生。

examples.en: This is an area rarely visited by Europeans.
examples.zh: 这是欧洲人很少去的地方。

examples.en: I first visited New York in 1991.
examples.zh: 我第一次访问纽约是在1991年。

examples.en: He is planning to visit China later this month.
examples.zh: 他计划本月晚些时候访问中国。

examples.en: The best time to visit is during the winter dry season.
examples.zh: 最佳游览时间是冬季旱季。

senses.def: to go to a website on the internet

examples.en: For more information, visit our website.
examples.zh: 欲知详情，请访问我们的网站。

examples.en: to visit a site/page
examples.zh: 访问网站/网页

senses.def: to stay somewhere for a short time

examples.en: We don't live here. We're just visiting.
examples.zh: 我们不住在这里，只是短期停留。

examples.en: Ships visit the island occasionally.
examples.zh: 这个岛偶尔有船只停靠。

examples.en: The lake is also visited by seals in the summer.
examples.zh: 夏天也有海豹游到这湖里来。

senses.def: to make an official visit to somebody, for example to perform checks or give advice

examples.en: Government inspectors are visiting schools in the area.
examples.zh: 政府督学正在巡视这一地区的学校。

examples.en: Council officers will be visiting premises to inspect safety arrangements.
examples.zh: 市议会官员将前往场所检查安全安排。

senses.def: an occasion or a period of time when somebody goes to see a place or person and spends time there

examples.en: a two-day/three-day visit
examples.zh: 两日／三日的游览

examples.en: the prime minister's surprise visit to the troops
examples.zh: 首相突然视察军队

examples.en: an official/state visit
examples.zh: 官方／国事访问

examples.en: It's my first visit to New York.
examples.zh: 这是我第一次去纽约。

examples.en: If you have time, pay a visit to the local museum.
examples.zh: 你若有空，参观一下当地的博物馆。

examples.en: The family made a visit to England in the summer of 1923.
examples.zh: 这家人于 1923 年夏天去了趟英格兰。

examples.en: a visit to the doctor
examples.zh: 看医生

examples.en: His visits home were limited to Christmas.
examples.zh: 他只在圣诞节期间回家。

examples.en: We had a visit from the police last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚警察来我们家了。

examples.en: Arranegments are being made for a visit by a member of the royal family.
examples.zh: 正在安排王室成员的访问。

examples.en: a brief/recent visit
examples.zh: 短暂/最近的访问

examples.en: The team reported on deficiencies found during the site visit.
examples.zh: 团队报告了现场访问期间发现的缺陷。

examples.en: Regular visits to the dentist are important.
examples.zh: 定期去看牙医很重要。

examples.en: Is this a social visit, or is it business?
examples.zh: 这是社交性的拜访，还是业务性的？

examples.en: They're on an exchange visit to France.
examples.zh: 他们到法国进行互访。

examples.en: Following this initial visit, she will return to Montserrat in June.
examples.zh: 初次访问后，她将于六月返回蒙特塞拉特。

senses.def: an occasion when somebody looks at a website on the internet

examples.en: Visits to our website have doubled in a year.
examples.zh: 我们网站的访问人次一年内翻了一番。

examples.en: The site now gets about 600,000 visits a day.
examples.zh: 该网站现在每天的访问量约为 600,000 次。

senses.def: an occasion when two or more people meet to talk in an informal way

examples.en: He thought back to his visit with the doctor.
examples.zh: 他回想起他当时与医生拉家常的情形。

senses.def: to punish somebody/something

examples.en: The sins of the fathers are visited upon the children (= children are blamed or suffer for what their parents have done).
examples.zh: 父辈造的孽报应到子女头上。

senses.def: to punish somebody/something

examples.en: The sins of the fathers are visited upon the children (= children are blamed or suffer for what their parents have done).
examples.zh: 父辈造的孽报应到子女头上。

senses.def: to spend time with somebody, especially talking socially
senses.zh: 与某人聊天；与某人闲谈

examples.en: Come and visit with me some time.
examples.zh: 找个时间来跟我聊聊吧。

senses.def: the right of a parent who is divorced or separated from his or her partner to visit a child who is living with the partner

examples.en: She is seeking more liberal visitation with her daughter.
examples.zh: 她正在争取对女儿有更自由的探视权。

examples.en: visitation rights
examples.zh: 探视子女的权利

senses.def: an official visit, especially to check that rules are being obeyed and everything is as it should be
an unexpected appearance of something, for example a ghost
a disaster that is believed to be a punishment from God
senses.zh: （视为上帝惩罚的）天灾，灾难，灾祸

examples.en: a visitation of plague
examples.zh: 天降瘟疫

senses.def: a government organization that works to encourage people from abroad to visit the UK and to encourage British people to visit tourist attractions in England. Separate organizations promote Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland within the UK. Among other things, they give different symbols to hotels, etc. to show what standard of accommodation they offer.
senses.zh: 一个政府组织，致力于鼓励国外人访问英国，并鼓励英国人访问英格兰的旅游景点。独立的组织在英国境内推广威尔士，苏格兰和北爱尔兰。除其他事项外，它们给酒店等使用不同的符号，以显示其提供的住宿标准。

senses.def: (especially in the past) a small card with your name on it that you leave with somebody after, or instead of, a formal visit
senses.zh: （访客留下或其他人用以表示到访的）名片，拜帖

senses.def: a nurse who visits and treats patients in their homes
senses.zh: 上门服务护士；家庭探访护士

senses.def: a person who visits a person or place
senses.zh: 来访者；访问者；参观者；游客

examples.en: We've got visitors coming this weekend.
examples.zh: 本周末我们有客人来访。

examples.en: Do you get many visitors?
examples.zh: 来探望你的人多吗？

examples.en: The theme park attracts 2.5 million visitors a year.
examples.zh: 这个主题乐园每年吸引 250 万游客。

examples.en: She's a frequent visitor to the US.
examples.zh: 她经常去美国。

examples.en: We have been regular visitors to the island for 20 years.
examples.zh: 20 年来，我们一直是岛上的常客。

examples.en: The festival draws visitors from all over the world.
examples.zh: 该节日吸引了来自世界各地的游客。

examples.en: a visitor centre/attraction
examples.zh: 游客中心；旅游胜地

senses.def: a person who looks at a website on the internet

examples.en: How can we attract more visitors to our website?
examples.zh: 我们如何才能吸引更多人访问我们的网站呢？

senses.def: a book in which visitors write their names, addresses and sometimes comments, for example, at a hotel or place of public interest
senses.zh: 来客登记簿；来宾留言簿；游客意见簿

senses.def: a part of a helmet
a curved piece of plastic, etc. worn on the head above the eyes to protect them from the sun
a small piece of plastic, etc. inside the front window of a car that can be pulled down to protect the driver’s eyes from the sun
senses.zh: （汽车内挡风玻璃上方的）遮阳板

senses.def: the stiff front part of a cap that sticks out above your eyes
a beautiful view, for example, of the countryside, a city, etc.

examples.en: She turned her gaze towards the soothing vista of river and fields.
examples.zh: 她把目光转向河流和田野的舒缓景色。

senses.def: a range of things that might happen in the future

senses.def: telling people your opinions or protesting about something loudly and with confidence
senses.zh: 大声表达的；直言不讳的

examples.en: He has been very vocal in his criticism of the government's policy.
examples.zh: 他对政府政策的批评一直是直言不讳。

examples.en: The protesters are a small but vocal minority.
examples.zh: 抗议者人数不多但敢于直言。

senses.def: the part of a piece of music that is sung, rather than played on a musical instrument
senses.zh: （乐曲中的）歌唱部分，声乐部分

examples.en: backing vocals
examples.zh: 伴唱

examples.en: In this recording Armstrong himself is on vocals.
examples.zh: 在这个录音中阿姆斯特朗亲自领唱。

intro.en: These words all describe producing language using the voice, rather than writing.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指口头的、口语的。

items.zh: 指口语的、口头的

examples.zh: 英语口语考试

items.def: [usually before noun] spoken rather than written:
items.zh: 指口头的、口述的

examples.zh: 将有一次法语口试和笔试。

items.zh: 指嗓音的、发音的

examples.zh: 声乐

senses.def: the thin pieces of tissue
a way of speaking in which air moves slowly through the vocal cords
senses.zh: 气泡音（声带微颤而发出的弱声）

examples.en: Vocal fry could be something that is done subconsciously, but it is also a way for women to fit in with one another.
examples.zh: 发声可能是下意识的行为，但这也是女性相互融入的一种方式。

examples.en: Pop singers slip vocal fry into their music as a way to reach low notes and add style.
examples.zh: 流行歌手将声音混入他们的音乐中，作为达到低音和增添风格的一种方式。

senses.def: relating to or consisting of a vowel or vowels
an exercise for practising singing in which syllables or vowel sounds are repeated
a piece of music to be sung without words
a singer, especially in a pop, rock or jazz band
senses.zh: （尤指流行音乐、摇滚乐或爵士乐乐队的）歌手，歌唱者

examples.en: a lead/guest/backing vocalist
examples.zh: 领唱／特邀／伴唱歌手

senses.def: a word or sound that is produced by the voice

examples.en: the vocalizations of animals
examples.zh: 动物发出的声音

senses.def: the process of producing a word or sound with the voice
to use words to express something

examples.en: Showing children pictures sometimes helps them to vocalize their ideas.
examples.zh: 让儿童看图画有时有助于他们用言语表达思想。

senses.def: to say or sing sounds or words

examples.en: Your baby will begin to vocalize long before she can talk.
examples.zh: 你的宝宝在她会说话前很早就要开始咿呀发声了。

senses.def: in a way that uses the voice

examples.en: to communicate vocally
examples.zh: 口头交流

senses.def: by speaking in a loud and confident way

examples.en: They protested vocally.
examples.zh: 他们直言不讳地提出了抗议。

senses.def: a type of work or way of life that you believe is especially suitable for you
senses.zh: （认为特别适合自己的）工作，职业，生活方式

examples.en: Nursing is not just a job—it's a vocation.
examples.zh: 护理不仅仅是一项工作，而且还是一种职业。

examples.en: She believes that she has found her true vocation in life.
examples.zh: 她相信自己找到了真正适合自己的生活方式。

examples.en: You missed your vocation—you should have been an actor.
examples.zh: 你干错行了，你本该当演员。

senses.def: a belief that a particular type of work or way of life is especially suitable for you
senses.zh: （认为某种工作或生活方式特别适合自己的）信心，使命感

examples.en: He has a vocation for teaching.
examples.zh: 他是教书的材料。

examples.en: She is a doctor with a strong sense of vocation.
examples.zh: 她是一位具有强烈使命感的医生。

senses.def: a belief that you have been chosen by God to be a priest or nun

examples.en: He spoke about his vocation to the priesthood.
examples.zh: 他谈到了自己蒙圣召成为司铎。

examples.en: They are set on living out their vocation as priests.
examples.zh: 他们决心要实践身为牧师的使命。

senses.def: connected with the skills, knowledge, etc. that you need to have in order to do a particular job
senses.zh: 职业的；职业技术的；业务知识的

examples.en: vocational education/qualifications/training
examples.zh: 职业教育／资格／培训

senses.def: (in the US) a school that teaches skills that are necessary for particular jobs
using or connected with the form of a noun, pronoun or an adjective used for talking to a person or thing

examples.en: the vocative case
examples.zh: 呼格

senses.def: the form of a noun, a pronoun or an adjective used when talking to a person or thing
expressing your opinions or feelings in a loud and confident way
senses.zh: 大声疾呼的；喧嚣的；大叫大嚷的

examples.en: vociferous protests
examples.zh: 高声的抗议

examples.en: a vociferous critic of the president’s stance
examples.zh: 猛烈批评总统所持态度的人

examples.en: Opposition from senior party members became increasingly vociferous.
examples.zh: 党内高层的反对声音越来越大。

senses.def: in a loud and confident way

examples.en: to complain vociferously
examples.zh: 大声地抱怨

senses.def: a large international mobile phone company that started in Britain in 1985
senses.zh: 一家大型国际手机公司，于1985年在英国成立

senses.def: a podcast

examples.en: She plans to create a vodcast tour of her studio for the Art at Work month.
examples.zh: 她计划为 “工作中的艺术” 月活动制作一个介绍她的工作室的视频播客。

senses.def: the activity of making vodcasts

examples.en: Many newspapers are choosing to use podcasting and vodcasting to reach a wider audience.
examples.zh: 多家报纸开始选择利用有声和视频播客以扩大读者群。

senses.def: a strong, clear alcoholic drink, made from grain, originally from Russia
senses.zh: 伏特加（一种原产于俄国的烈性酒）

senses.def: a glass of vodka

examples.en: I'll have a vodka and lime.
examples.zh: 我要喝一杯来檬伏特加。

senses.def: without guarantee; at the risk of the buyer
senses.zh: 无保证地（的）；由买方承担风险地（的）

examples.en: All contracts contain a voetstoots clause, which means the property is bought ‘as is’.
examples.zh: 所有合同都包含 voetstoots 条款，这意味着房产是“按原样”购买的。

examples.en: Dishonest sellers will not be protected by the voetstoots clause.
examples.zh: 不诚实的卖家将不受 voetstoots 条款的保护。

examples.en: They bid 3m rand voetstoots or 5m rand if the property was renovated.
examples.zh: 若房产按现状出售，他们出价 300 万兰特；若对房产进行翻修，他们出价 500 万兰特。

senses.def: a fashion for something

examples.en: the vogue for child-centred education
examples.zh: 以孩子为中心的教育潮流

examples.en: Black is in vogue again.
examples.zh: 黑色又成了流行色。

examples.en: Sixties music has come back into vogue.
examples.zh: 六十年代的音乐又重新流行起来。

examples.en: This novel had a great vogue ten years ago.
examples.zh: 这本小说十年前曾风靡一时。

senses.def: a magazine aimed at women published every month in many countries including Britain and the US, which contains articles about fashion, beauty, the arts and other subjects. It has a lot of influence in the fashion world. It first appeared in the US in 1892 and in Britain in 1916.
senses.zh: 《时尚》杂志（面向女性的杂志，每月在包括英国和美国在内的许多国家出版，其中包含有关时尚、美容、艺术和其他主题的文章。它在时尚界有很大的影响力。它最早于 1892 年在美国出现，在 1916 年在英国出现。）

senses.def: the sound or sounds produced through the mouth by a person speaking or singing

examples.en: I could hear voices in the next room.
examples.zh: 我能听到隔壁说话的声音。

examples.en: He recognized Sarah's voice.
examples.zh: 他听出了萨拉的声音。

examples.en: to speak in a deep/soft/loud voice
examples.zh: 低沉／轻柔／大声地说

examples.en: ‘I promise,’ she said in a small voice (= a quiet, shy voice).
examples.zh: “我保证。”她小声说。

examples.en: There was a note of concern in his voice.
examples.zh: 他的声音里带着一丝关心。

examples.en: He never raised his voice (= spoke loudly in an angry way) to the children.
examples.zh: 他从不对孩子们提高声音（=以愤怒的方式大声说话）。

examples.en: to lower your voice (= to speak more quietly)
examples.zh: 小声点

examples.en: Keep your voice down (= speak quietly).
examples.zh: 说话轻一些。

examples.en: Don't take that tone of voice with me!
examples.zh: 别用那种腔调和我说话。

examples.en: The men turned around at the sound of my voice.
examples.zh: 听到我的声音，男人们转过头来。

examples.en: Her voice shook with emotion.
examples.zh: 她激动得声音颤抖。

examples.en: ‘There you are,’ said a voice behind me.
examples.zh: “你来啦。”我身后一个声音说道。

examples.en: When did his voice break (= become deep like a man's)?
examples.zh: 他是什么时候变声的？

examples.en: Her voice sounded familiar.
examples.zh: 她的声音听起来很熟悉。

examples.en: He was suffering from flu and had lost his voice (= could not speak).
examples.zh: 他患了流感，嗓子哑了。

examples.en: She has a good singing voice.
examples.zh: 她有一副很好的歌喉。

examples.en: She was in good voice (= singing well) at the concert tonight.
examples.zh: 她在今晚的音乐会上唱得不错。

senses.group: sound from mouth 口中发出的声音

senses.def: having a voice of the type mentioned

examples.en: low-voiced
examples.zh: 嗓门低的

examples.en: squeaky-voiced
examples.zh: 嗓音尖细的

senses.def: the right to express your opinion and influence decisions
senses.zh: 发言权；发表意见的权利；影响

examples.en: Employees should have a voice in the decision-making process.
examples.zh: 雇员在决策的过程中应该有发言权。

examples.en: Refugees have been unable to find a voice in politics.
examples.zh: 难民一直没能享有政治发言权。

senses.def: a particular attitude, opinion or feeling that is expressed; a feeling or an opinion that you become aware of inside yourself

examples.en: He pledged that his party would listen to the voice of the people.
examples.zh: 他保证他的政党愿意倾听人民的呼声。

examples.en: Very few dissenting voices were heard on the right of the party.
examples.zh: 在党的右翼听不到什么不同的政见。

examples.en: the voice of reason/sanity/conscience
examples.zh: 理性的／理智的／良心的声音

examples.en: ‘Coward!’ a tiny inner voice insisted.
examples.zh: “胆小鬼！”内心一个小声音坚持说。

senses.def: an organization that expresses the opinion of a particular section of society

examples.en: The Royal Society is the voice of the British science establishment.
examples.zh: 皇家学会是英国科学界的喉舌。

senses.def: the form of a verb that shows whether the subject of a sentence performs the action (the active voice)

examples.en: Can you turn this sentence into the passive voice?
examples.zh: 你能把这句话变成被动语态吗？

senses.def: sound produced by movement of the vocal cords
senses.zh: 浊音（声带振动发出的元音和某些辅音）

senses.def: as loudly as possible
senses.zh: 高声地；放声地；扯着喉咙地

examples.en: She was screaming at the top of her voice.
examples.zh: 她在声嘶力竭地尖叫。

examples.en: I was shouting at the top of my voice but she couldn't hear me.
examples.zh: 我喊的声音已经是最大了，可她还是听不见。

senses.def: to be able to speak or express your opinion
senses.zh: 能说出自己的看法；能表达自己的意见

senses.def: to express your feelings, worries, etc.

examples.en: Many workers at the meeting gave voice to their fears about job security.
examples.zh: 会议上的许多工人表达了他们对工作保障的担忧。

senses.def: to like talking a lot or too much, usually without wanting to listen to other people

examples.en: She’s much too fond of the sound of her own voice.
examples.zh: 我在赛跑中得了三等奖。

senses.def: to express your feelings, opinions, etc. in a way that makes people notice and consider them
senses.zh: （为引起他人注意）发表意见，表达感情

examples.en: The programme gives ordinary viewers a chance to make their voices heard.
examples.zh: 该节目为普通观众提供了表达自己声音的机会。

examples.en: a society in which individuals are able to make their voices heard
examples.zh: 一个人人都能够发表意见的社会

senses.def: the voice of God or your conscience
senses.zh: 上帝的教示；良心的呼唤

senses.def: as a group; with everyone agreeing

examples.en: The various opposition parties speak with one voice on this issue.
examples.zh: 在这个问题上各反对党派众口一词。

examples.en: The teachers speak with one voice when they demand an end to the cuts.
examples.zh: 教师一致要求停止削减开支。

senses.def: to tell people your feelings or opinions about something
senses.zh: 表示，表达，吐露（感情或意见）

examples.en: to voice complaints/criticisms/doubts/objections, etc.
examples.zh: 表示不满、批评、怀疑、异议等

examples.en: A number of parents have voiced concern about their children's safety.
examples.zh: 一些家长对他们子女的安全表示了担心。

senses.def: to produce a sound with a movement of your vocal cords

senses.zh: 高声地；放声地；扯着喉咙地

senses.zh: （为引起他人注意）发表意见，表达感情

examples.zh: 该节目为普通观众提供了表达自己声音的机会。

examples.en: a society in which individuals are able to make their voices heard
examples.zh: 一个人人都能够发表意见的社会

senses.zh: 上帝的教示；良心的呼唤

senses.def: as a group; with everyone agreeing

examples.zh: 在这个问题上各反对党派众口一词。

examples.en: The teachers speak with one voice when they demand an end to the cuts.
examples.zh: 教师一致要求停止削减开支。

senses.def: that you can control by spoken commands

examples.en: voice-activated computers/controls
examples.zh: 声控计算机／操纵装置

examples.en: The phone's features include voice-activated dialling and speakerphone for hands-free calls.
examples.zh: 该电话的功能包括声控拨号和免提通话扬声器。

senses.def: a person who provides voices for films, television shows, video games, etc.

examples.en: The brilliant voice actors bring this animated series to life.
examples.zh: 出色的配音演员将这部动画系列带入了生活。

senses.def: a computer program that can hold a conversation with somebody and complete particular tasks by responding to instructions or to information that it gathers from that person's digital device
senses.zh: 语音助手（计算机程序，可与人对话，并根据指令或用户数字设备信息完成特定任务）

examples.en: This digital voice assistant will learn that you like to work out in the morning and what type of music you listen to.
examples.zh: 这种数字语音助手会了解到你喜欢晨练以及你听哪一类音乐。

senses.def: the area at the top of the throat that contains the vocal cords
a recording of a spoken message

examples.en: I left a voice message on his phone.
examples.zh: 我往他的手机留了一条语音信息。

senses.def: information or comments in a film, television programme, etc. that are given by a person who is not seen on the screen
senses.zh: （电影或电视节目的）解说，画外音

examples.en: She earns a lot of money doing voice-overs for TV commercials.
examples.zh: 她为电视广告配音收入很高。

senses.def: technology that allows a computer to identify a voice

examples.en: the computer's voice recognition capability
examples.zh: 计算机的语音识别能力

senses.def: technology that allows a computer to understand spoken words
produced without moving your vocal cords
an electronic system that can store phone messages, so that somebody can listen to them later
a printed record of a person’s speech, showing the different frequencies and lengths of sounds as a series of waves
senses.zh: 声纹（显示个人说话声音频率和长度的打印记录）

senses.def: a large empty space

examples.en: Below him was nothing but a black void.
examples.zh: 他下面只是一片漆黑。

examples.en: She sat staring into the void, emptying her mind of all thoughts.
examples.zh: 她坐在那儿，凝视着虚空，清空了所有的思绪。

senses.def: a feeling of being empty, caused by the loss of somebody/something
senses.zh: （因失去某人或某事物而产生的）空虚感，寂寞感，缺失感

examples.en: The void left by his mother's death was never filled.
examples.zh: 他母亲死后留下的空虚感永远没能填补上。

examples.en: It seemed that nothing could fill the aching black void left by Rachel’s death.
examples.zh: 雷切尔去世留下来的痛苦空虚似乎什么也无法填补。

senses.def: completely without something

examples.en: The sky was void of stars.
examples.zh: 天空没有一颗星星。

senses.def: not correct or legally valid

examples.en: The agreement was declared void.
examples.zh: 该协议已宣布无效。

examples.en: an impediment which rendered the marriage void
examples.zh: 一个令婚姻无效的障碍

senses.def: empty

examples.en: void spaces
examples.zh: 空位

senses.def: William Butler Yeats (1865-1939) a leading Irish writer of poetry, plays and stories. His best-known works of poetry include The Wild Swans at Coole
senses.zh: WB叶芝：威廉·巴特勒·叶芝（1865-1939）是爱尔兰诗歌，戏剧和故事的著名作家。他最著名的诗歌作品包括《库尔的野天鹅》（1917年），《上楼梯》（1933年）和《诗集》（1933年）。他的作品包括《心灵的土地》（1894年）和《绿色头盔》（1910年），其中几部被写成在都柏林的修道院剧院演出，他帮助建立了这座剧院。他的故事书《凯尔特人的暮光之城》引起了人们对爱尔兰传统故事的极大兴趣。叶芝（Yeats）作为民族主义者也参与政治活动，并成为爱尔兰议会（1922-8）的参议员。他于1923年获得诺贝尔文学奖。

senses.def: William Claude Fields (1879-1946) a US comic actor well known for his humorous remarks. He had a large nose and the characters he played often drank a lot of alcohol and hated children and dogs. He was in the Ziegfeld Follies on Broadway

senses.def: William Christopher Handy (1873-58) a US musician who is often called 'the father of the blues'. He wrote St Louis Blues
senses.zh: WC·汉迪（WC Handy）：威廉·克里斯托弗·汉迪（William Christopher Handy，1873-58年），美国音乐家，通常被称为“布鲁斯之父”。他写了《圣路易斯布鲁斯》（St Louis Blues，1914年），但未能出售，所以他开始收集和发行传统的布鲁斯音乐。他的其他歌曲包括孟菲斯布鲁斯（1912）和比尔街布鲁斯（1917）。他还领导了一支乐队（1903-21）。

senses.def: William Edward Burghardt Du Bois (1868-1963) a US writer who helped to establish the NAACP
senses.zh: 威廉·爱德华·伯格哈特·杜波依斯（1868-1963）是美国作家，曾帮助建立NAACP。他的著作包括《黑人的灵魂》（1903年），他还是NAACP杂志《危机》（1910-34年）的编辑。他是第一位获得哈佛大学博士学位的非裔美国人，并在亚特兰大大学教授经济学和历史（1897-1910和1932-44）。1961年，杜布瓦（Du Bois）成为共产党员，搬到加纳（Ghana）逝世。

senses.def: William Gilbert Grace (1848-1915) an English cricketer
senses.zh: WG格雷斯（WG Grace）：威廉·吉尔伯特·格雷斯（William Gilbert Grace，1848年至1915年），是一名英国板球运动员，他在1860年代至20世纪初曾在格洛斯特郡和英格兰效力，在击球手和投球手方面同样成功。他是有史以来最伟大的板球运动员之一。

senses.def: Wystan Hugh Auden (1907-73) an English poet who wrote poems of many different types, often using traditional forms of verse
senses.zh: Wystan Hugh Auden（1907-73）是一位英国诗人，他写了许多不同类型的诗歌，通常使用传统的诗歌形式但使用现代语言。他还为歌剧写词，并为邮局写著名的宣传片。在1930年代，他写了一些最好的诗时，他是一群左翼作家的领导成员。他的许多最著名的诗歌都收录在《另一次》（Other Time，1940年）中。1946年，他成为美国公民，后来的诗歌变得更加虔诚。他的作品对20世纪后期的诗歌产生了深远的影响。

senses.def: used to describe a situation in which the most important aspect is being influenced and controlled by somebody/something that is not as important
senses.zh: （用以描述次要部分影响和支配主要部分）主次颠倒，喧宾夺主

senses.def: a regular amount of money that you earn, usually every week or every month, for work or services
senses.zh: （通常按周或月领的）工资，工钱

examples.en: wages of £300 a week
examples.zh: 周薪 300 英镑

examples.en: a weekly wage of £300
examples.zh: 周薪 300 英镑

examples.en: an hourly/a daily/a monthly wage
examples.zh: 时薪；日薪；月薪

examples.en: Workers in these stores earn a good wage.
examples.zh: 这些店的职工挣钱不少。

examples.en: We all hope we can find a job that pays a decent wage.
examples.zh: 我们都希望找到一份有像样工资的工作。

examples.en: Wages were paid on Fridays.
examples.zh: 每星期五发工资。

examples.en: They are prepared to work for wages well below the legal minimum.
examples.zh: 他们准备以远低于法定最低工资的工资工作。

examples.en: The average wage for unskilled workers is very low.
examples.zh: 非技术工人的平均工资非常低。

examples.en: There are extra benefits for people on low wages.
examples.zh: 低薪者有额外补助。

examples.en: Workers have been on strike for higher wages since October.
examples.zh: 自10月以来，工人们一直在举行罢工，要求提高工资。

examples.en: Tax and insurance are deducted from your wages.
examples.zh: 所得税和保险费从工资扣除。

examples.en: low/minimum wage earners
examples.zh: 拿低／最低工资的人

examples.en: wage cuts
examples.zh: 减薪

examples.en: a wage increase of 3%
examples.zh: 3% 的加薪

examples.en: a wage rise of 3%
examples.zh: 3% 的加薪

examples.en: wage demands/claims/settlements
examples.zh: 工资要求；工资和解协议

examples.en: The staff have agreed to a voluntary wage freeze (= a situation in which wages are not increased for a time).
examples.zh: 全体员工已经同意自愿冻结工资。

senses.def: to begin and continue a war, a battle, etc.
senses.zh: 开始，发动，进行，继续（战争、战斗等）

examples.en: The rebels have waged a guerrilla war since 2007.
examples.zh: 叛乱分子自 2007 年以来一直在进行游击战。

examples.en: He made the decision to wage war.
examples.zh: 他做出了发动战争的决定。

examples.en: He alleged that a press campaign was being waged against him.
examples.zh: 他声称有人正在对他发起新闻攻势。

intro.en: These are all words for money that a person earns or receives for their work.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指收入、工资、薪水。

items.def: money that a person receives for their work, or from investments or business:
items.zh: 指收入、收益、所得

examples.en: people on low incomes
examples.zh: 低收入的人

items.def: money that employees get for doing their job, usually paid every week or every month:
items.zh: 通常指按周或按月领取的工资、工钱

examples.en: a weekly wage of £400
examples.zh: 周薪 400 英镑

items.def: money that employees earn for doing their job:
items.zh: 指工资、薪水

examples.en: The job offers good rates of pay.
examples.zh: 这工作报酬高。

items.def: money that employees earn for doing their job, usually paid every month.
items.zh: 通常指按月发放的薪水、薪金

items.def: money that a person earns from their work:
items.zh: 指薪水、工资、收入

examples.en: a rise in average earnings for factory workers
examples.zh: 工厂工人平均收入的增加

senses.def: a person who earns money, especially a person who works for wages

examples.en: We have two wage earners in the family.
examples.zh: 我们家有两个人挣钱。

senses.def: the difference between the amount that two different groups of people are paid

examples.en: efforts to close the gender wage gap
examples.zh: 努力缩小性别工资差距

senses.def: an envelope

examples.en: He got his first wage packet at fourteen years old.
examples.zh: 他在 14 岁时领到了他的第一份工钱。

senses.def: a person who depends entirely on the money they receive for the job that they do. This term is usually used about people whose jobs are not seen as skilled
senses.zh: 工资奴隶，雇佣劳动者（其工作通常被认为无需专门技能或乏味）

examples.en: After a few years as a wage slave for a large corporation she decided to quit and set up her own business.
examples.zh: 在一家大公司做了几年工资奴隶后，她决定辞职，自己开公司。

examples.en: Millions of people went to the cities, where they became paupers, beggars and wage slaves.
examples.zh: 无数人迁入城市，沦为贫民、乞丐和工资奴隶。

senses.def: an arrangement to risk money on the result of a particular event
to bet money

examples.en: She always wagered on an outsider.
examples.zh: 她总是把赌注押在不大可能获胜的马上。

examples.en: to wager £50 on a horse
examples.zh: 在一匹马上押 50 英镑的赌注

examples.en: I had wagered a great deal of money that I would beat him.
examples.zh: 我下了大赌注打赌我会赢他。

senses.def: used to say that you are so confident that something is true or will happen that you would be willing to bet money on it

examples.en: I'll wager that she knows more about it than she's saying.
examples.zh: 我敢打赌，她知道的比她说的要多。

senses.def: funny, clever and not serious

examples.en: waggish remarks
examples.zh: 俏皮话

senses.def: a short movement from side to side or up and down

examples.en: a waggle of his eyebrow
examples.zh: 他的眉毛一动

senses.def: to make something move with short movements from side to side or up and down; to move in this way

examples.en: Can you waggle your ears?
examples.zh: 你能让耳朵来回动吗？

senses.def: related to the music of the German composer
senses.zh: 瓦格纳乐曲的，瓦格纳作品风格的（指德国作曲家里夏德·瓦格纳）

senses.def: very big or great, or in a style that is too serious or exaggerated
senses.zh: 巨大的；极大的；过于严肃（或夸张）的

examples.en: a hangover of Wagnerian proportions
examples.zh: 强烈的宿醉反应

senses.def: a railway truck for carrying goods

examples.en: He tried to hide in a container wagon.
examples.zh: 他试图藏到集装箱运输车里。

examples.en: The statue was transported on a railway wagon.
examples.zh: 雕像是用火车车厢运输的。

senses.def: a vehicle with four wheels, pulled by horses or oxen

examples.en: covered wagons rolling across the prairies
examples.zh: 驶过大草原的有篷大马车

examples.en: A hay wagon was winding slowly along the lane.
examples.zh: 一辆干草车沿着小巷缓慢地蜿蜒行驶。

senses.def: a small table on very small wheels, used for carrying or serving food or drink
senses.zh: （运或送食品、饮料的）小推车，台车

senses.def: to not drink alcohol, either for a short time or permanently
senses.zh: （短期或永久地）不喝酒，戒酒，滴酒不沾

senses.def: to not drink alcohol, either for a short time or permanently
senses.zh: （短期或永久地）不喝酒，戒酒，滴酒不沾

senses.def: a long line of wagons
senses.zh: （19 世纪美国人向西部迁移的）马拉篷车队

senses.def: an amount of goods carried on a wagon
senses.zh: 货车车厢载荷；马车载荷

senses.def: a small bird with a long tail that moves up and down when the bird is walking
senses.zh: 鹡鸰（走动时长尾上下摆动）

senses.def: a type of beef that comes from particular breeds
senses.zh: 日本和牛（肉质细嫩的一种日本牛肉）

examples.en: premium products like Japanese Wagyu beef
examples.zh: 日本和牛等优质产品

senses.def: used to show that you like or admire somebody/something, or are surprised by it
senses.zh: 用于表示您喜欢或钦佩某人/某事，或者对此感到惊讶

examples.en: Wah, you look so handsome!
examples.zh: 哇，你看起来真帅！

senses.def: a special effect made on electric musical instruments, especially the guitar, which varies the quality of the sound
senses.zh: （尤指吉他等电子乐器发出的）哇音；“哇哇”音响效果

senses.def: a small, thin person, usually a child, who looks as if they do not have enough to eat
senses.zh: 瘦小的人；（通常指）面黄肌瘦的小孩

examples.en: the waifs and strays of our society (= people with no home)
examples.zh: 我们社会的弃儿

senses.def: small and thin, like a child who does not get enough to eat
senses.zh: 像浪似的：小而瘦，就像一个没有吃饱的孩子

examples.en: waif-like young girls
examples.zh: 面黄肌瘦的女孩

senses.def: a holiday beach and area of Honolulu
senses.zh: 怀基基海滩（夏威夷海滩度假区，位于夏威夷瓦胡岛檀香山郊区）

senses.def: to make a long, loud, high noise because you are sad or in pain

examples.en: The little girl was wailing miserably.
examples.zh: 那小女孩难过得号啕大哭。

senses.def: to cry or complain about something in a loud high voice
senses.zh: 大声呼叫；哀号；高声抱怨

examples.en: The cat was wailing to be let out.
examples.zh: 那只猫号叫着想要出去。

examples.en: ‘It's broken,’ she wailed.
examples.zh: “打碎了。”她大声叫道。

examples.en: There's no point wailing about something that happened so long ago.
examples.zh: 事情早已发生，痛哭流涕也于事无补。

senses.def: to make a long, loud, high sound

examples.en: Ambulances raced by with sirens wailing.
examples.zh: 救护车高声鸣笛疾驰而过。

senses.def: a long, loud, high cry expressing pain or very sad feelings; a sound similar to this
senses.zh: （疼痛或悲伤时发出的）号啕，哀号

examples.en: a wail of despair
examples.zh: 绝望的哀号

examples.en: the distant wail of sirens
examples.zh: 远处警报器的鸣响

examples.en: The child let out a high-pitched wail.
examples.zh: 孩子发出一声高亢的哭声。

senses.def: a wooden covering on the lower part of the walls in a room
wood that is attached along the lower part of the walls in a house
the area around the middle of the body between the ribs

examples.en: He put his arm around her waist.
examples.zh: 他搂住了她的腰。

examples.en: She was paralysed from the waist down (= in the area below her waist).
examples.zh: 她腰部以下都瘫痪了。

examples.en: The workmen were stripped to the waist (= wearing no clothes on the top half of their bodies).
examples.zh: 工人光着上身。

senses.def: the part of a piece of clothing that covers the waist

examples.en: a skirt with an elasticated waist
examples.zh: 腰部有松紧带的裙子

examples.en: These jeans have a 32-inch waist.
examples.zh: 这些牛仔裤的腰围是 32 英寸。

senses.def: having the type of waist

examples.en: a high-waisted dress
examples.zh: 高腰连衣裙

senses.def: up to the middle part of the body

examples.en: The water was waist-deep.
examples.zh: 水齐腰深。

examples.en: We waded waist-deep into the muddy water.
examples.zh: 我们蹚进齐腰深的泥水里。

examples.en: Where we were standing, the lake was waist-deep.
examples.zh: 我们站立的地方，湖水齐腰深。

senses.def: high enough to reach the middle part of the body

examples.en: waist-high grass
examples.zh: 齐腰高的草

examples.en: The grass had grown waist-high.
examples.zh: 草长得齐腰高了。

senses.def: the piece of cloth that forms the waist
senses.zh: 衣服腰；腰头；（尤指）裙腰，裤腰

examples.en: an elasticated waistband
examples.zh: 松紧腰身

senses.def: a short piece of clothing with buttons down the front but no arms, usually worn over a shirt and under a jacket, often forming part of a formal suit

examples.en: He always wore a brightly-coloured waistcoat under his dark grey suit.
examples.zh: 他总是在深灰色西装里面穿上颜色鲜艳的马甲。

examples.en: He took a gold watch out of his waistcoat pocket.
examples.zh: 他从背心口袋里掏出一块金表。

senses.def: the amount that a person measures around the middle part of their body, used to talk about how fat or thin they are

examples.en: an expanding waistline
examples.zh: 逐渐增大的腰围

examples.en: All this butter and cream won’t do much for my waistline.
examples.zh: 所有这些黄油和奶油对我的腰围没有多大作用。

senses.def: the part of a piece of clothing where your waist
to stay where you are or delay doing something until somebody/something comes or something happens

examples.en: She rang the bell and waited.
examples.zh: 她按铃后等候着。

examples.en: The President agreed to speak to the waiting journalists.
examples.zh: 总统同意与等待的记者交谈。

examples.en: They waited patiently while I got ready.
examples.zh: 当我准备好时，他们耐心地等待着。

examples.en: I waited and waited, but the bus didn't come.
examples.zh: 我等呀等，公共汽车就是不来。

examples.en: Have you been waiting long?
examples.zh: 你等了很久了吗？

examples.en: to wait (for) hours/days/weeks/months/years
examples.zh: 等待数小时／天／周／月／年

examples.en: I’ve been waiting (for) twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 我等了二十分钟。

examples.en: I'll wait outside until the meeting's over.
examples.zh: 我会在外面等到会议结束。

examples.en: I had to wait in line at the bank.
examples.zh: 我不得不在银行排队等候。

examples.en: Wait for me!
examples.zh: 等等我！

examples.en: to wait for a bus
examples.zh: 等公共汽车

examples.en: I'm still waiting for the results of my blood test.
examples.zh: 我还在等待验血结果。

examples.en: He smiled, waiting for an answer to his question.
examples.zh: 他微笑着，等待着他的问题的答案。

examples.en: We're waiting for the rain to stop before we go out.
examples.zh: 我们要等到雨停了再出去。

examples.en: Hurry up! We're waiting to go.
examples.zh: 快点儿，我们等着走呢。

examples.en: We'll have to wait until it stops raining.
examples.zh: 我们不得不等到雨停。

examples.en: You'll just have to wait your turn (= wait until your turn comes).
examples.zh: 你得等着轮到你才行。

senses.def: to hope or watch for something to happen, especially for a long time

examples.en: Leeds United had waited for success for eighteen years.
examples.zh: 利兹联队企盼夺冠已经十八年了。

examples.en: This is just the opportunity I've been waiting for.
examples.zh: 这正是我一直在期待的机会。

examples.en: They are waiting for the right moment to make their move.
examples.zh: 他们正在等待合适的时机采取行动。

examples.en: He's waiting for me to make a mistake.
examples.zh: 他正盼着我出错呢。

examples.en: I've been waiting a long time to say that to her.
examples.zh: 我已经等了很久，就想对她说那话。

examples.en: I waited my chance and slipped out when no one was looking.
examples.zh: 我等待时机，趁没人注意时溜了出去。

examples.en: We simply cannot afford to wait any longer.
examples.zh: 我们再也等不起了。

examples.en: I waited with bated breath for what would happen next.
examples.zh: 我屏息以待接下来要发生的事情。

senses.def: to be ready for somebody to have or use
senses.zh: 准备妥；在手边；可得到；可使用

examples.en: Your car is waiting, sir.
examples.zh: 先生，您的车已经在等您了。

examples.en: When we arrived on the platform, there was a train waiting.
examples.zh: 当我们到达站台时，有一列火车正在等候。

examples.en: There's a letter waiting for you at home.
examples.zh: 家里有你一封信。

examples.en: There was a nice surprise waiting for me when I got back.
examples.zh: 当我回来时，有一个惊喜在等着我。

examples.en: The hotel had a taxi waiting to collect us.
examples.zh: 旅馆召了辆出租车等着接我们。

senses.def: to be left to be dealt with at a later time because immediate action is not needed

examples.en: I've got some calls to make but they can wait until tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我有几个电话要打，不过可以等到明天再说。

examples.en: I'm afraid this can't wait. It's very important.
examples.zh: 这事非常重要，恐怕不能耽搁。

examples.en: We've just spent a fortune on a new roof, so the new car is going to have to wait.
examples.zh: 我们刚刚花了一大笔钱买了一个新屋顶，所以新车必须等待。

senses.def: a thing or person that is very likely to cause danger or a problem in the future because of the condition it is in or the way they behave

examples.en: Any one of these nuclear plants may be a disaster waiting to happen.
examples.zh: 这些核电厂中的任何一个都可能会成为灾难隐患。

senses.def: ready to take over a particular job or be used in a particular situation when needed
senses.zh: 准备接替某工作；准备就绪

examples.en: She was aware of a whole host of ambitious young managers waiting in the wings.
examples.zh: 她知道有一大批雄心勃勃的年轻经理正在伺机而动。

examples.en: There's a wealth of talent waiting in the wings of British theatre.
examples.zh: 英国戏剧界蕴藏着大量的人才。

senses.def: used when you are emphasizing that somebody is very excited about something or keen to do it

examples.en: The children can't wait for Christmas to come.
examples.zh: 孩子们等圣诞节都等不及了。

examples.en: I can hardly wait to see him again.
examples.zh: 我迫不及待地想再次见到他。

senses.def: to make somebody have to wait or be delayed, especially because you arrive late
senses.zh: （尤指因迟到）让人等候，使人耽搁

examples.en: I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.
examples.zh: 对不起，让你久等了。

senses.def: to wait for a situation to become clear or certain
senses.zh: 待尘埃落定；待形势明朗

examples.en: He waited for the dust to settle after the election before making any new decisions.
examples.zh: 他等待选举结束后尘埃落定，然后再做出任何新决定。

senses.def: used to tell somebody that they must be patient and wait to find out about something later

examples.en: We'll just have to wait and see—there's nothing we can do at the moment.
examples.zh: 我们只得等等看，眼下没有法子。

examples.en: a wait-and-see policy
examples.zh: 等待观望的政策

examples.en: ‘Where are we going?’ ‘Wait and see!’
examples.zh: “我们到哪里去？”“等着瞧吧！”

senses.def: to serve food to people, for example at a formal meal
senses.zh: 伺候进餐；（往饭桌上）端饭上菜

senses.def: used to say that you are about to tell somebody something that is surprising
senses.zh: （要说出令人吃惊的事情）听着，听好了

examples.en: They're off on a trip, to—wait for it—the Maldives!
examples.zh: 他们出去旅行了，去的地方是，听好了，马尔代夫！

senses.def: used to tell somebody not to start doing something yet, but to wait until you tell them
senses.zh: （让人在得到通知前别做某事）等候通知

senses.def: to wait for a short time

examples.en: Can you wait a second while I make a call?
examples.zh: 你能等一会儿让我打个电话吗？

examples.en: Hey! Wait a minute! I'll come with you!
examples.zh: 喂，等一下！我和你一起去！

senses.def: used when you have just noticed or remembered something, or had a sudden idea
senses.zh: （刚注意到、想起某事或突然想出了主意）且慢，等一等

examples.en: Wait a minute—this isn't the right key.
examples.zh: 等一等，不是这把钥匙。

senses.def: to take care of somebody’s needs so well that they do not have to do anything for themselves
senses.zh: 过分照顾；让…饭来张口，衣来伸手

examples.en: He seems to expect me to wait on him hand and foot.
examples.zh: 他似乎希望我全心全意地伺候他。

senses.def: to work serving food to people in a restaurant
used to show that you are very excited about telling or showing something to somebody
senses.zh: （兴奋地表示或展示某事物）等到…吧

examples.en: Wait till you see what I've found!
examples.zh: 你等着看我发现了什么吧！

senses.def: used to threaten to punish somebody or do something bad to them
senses.zh: 等到…再说（表示威胁要惩罚或加害某人）

examples.en: Wait till I get my hands on him!
examples.zh: 等我抓住他再说！

senses.def: used to suggest that you should all start doing what you have been discussing
senses.zh: （建议都应开始去做商议中的事）我们还在等什么呢

senses.def: used to tell somebody to do something now rather than later
senses.zh: （让人马上就干而不要往后拖）你还等什么呢

examples.en: If the car needs cleaning, what are you waiting for?
examples.zh: 如果这辆汽车需要清洗，你还在等什么呢？

senses.def: used to emphasize a threat, warning or promise
senses.zh: （用以加强威胁、警告或允诺的语气）你就等着吧，你就等着瞧

examples.en: I'll be famous one day, just you wait!
examples.zh: 我有朝一日会出名的，你就等着瞧吧！

senses.def: an act of waiting; an amount of time waited

examples.en: The wait seemed interminable.
examples.zh: 等待似乎无休无止。

examples.en: It took six months for the house to be finished, but it was worth the wait.
examples.zh: 房子花了六个月才完工，但这等待是值得的。

examples.en: We had a long wait for the bus.
examples.zh: 我们等公共汽车等了很长时间。

examples.en: He now faces an agonizing two-month wait for the test results.
examples.zh: 他现在要苦苦等待两个月才能拿到测验结果。

examples.en: We had a half-hour wait to see the doctor.
examples.zh: 我们等了半个小时才去看医生。

examples.en: There could be a wait of four months or more.
examples.zh: 可能要等待四个月或更长时间。

senses.def: to hide, waiting to surprise, attack or catch somebody
senses.zh: 隐蔽待机以出其不意；伏击；埋伏以待

examples.en: He was surrounded by reporters who had been lying in wait for him.
examples.zh: 他被暗中守候他的记者团团围住。

items.idm: an accident/a disaster waiting to happen

examples.zh: 我走进门，环顾四周。

examples.en: He walked out the door, got in his car, and drove off.
examples.zh: 他出了门，上了车，开走了。

examples.en: He greeted her as she walked through the door.
examples.zh: 当她走进门时，他向她打招呼。

examples.en: I was walking down the street when I suddenly felt ill.
examples.zh: 我正走在街上，突然感到不舒服。

examples.en: The school is within easy walking distance of the train station.
examples.zh: 学校离火车站不远，不费劲就走到了。

examples.en: They walked the dark streets of Los Angeles.
examples.zh: 他们在洛杉矶黑暗的街道上行走。

examples.en: Children here walk several miles to school.
examples.zh: 这里的孩子去上学要步行好几英里。

examples.en: She walked the short distance to her flat.
examples.zh: 她走了一小段路就到了她的公寓。

senses.def: to spend time walking for pleasure

examples.en: I like an active holiday, so I walk.
examples.zh: 我喜欢活跃的假期，所以我步行。

examples.en: She's started to go walking.
examples.zh: 她开始去散步。

examples.en: We're going walking in the mountains this summer.
examples.zh: 今年夏天我们打算到山里去徒步旅行。

examples.en: I walked across Scotland with a friend.
examples.zh: 我和一个朋友徒步穿越了苏格兰。

examples.en: They love walking the moors.
examples.zh: 他们喜欢到沼泽地散步。

senses.def: to go somewhere with somebody on foot, especially in order to make sure they get there safely

examples.en: He always walked her home.
examples.zh: 他经常护送她走回家。

examples.en: I walked him to the corner of the street.
examples.zh: 我陪他走到街角。

senses.def: to take an animal for a walk; to make an animal walk somewhere

examples.en: They walk their dogs every day.
examples.zh: 他们每天遛狗。

examples.en: She walked the horse around the ring.
examples.zh: 她牵着马绕着圆环走一圈。

senses.def: to disappear; to be taken away

examples.en: Lock up any valuables. Things tend to walk here (= be stolen).
examples.zh: 把贵重物品锁起来。这里的东西常会不翼而飞。

senses.def: to appear
when a batter
senses.zh: 当击球手上垒时，他们不等裁判宣布出局就离开球场

examples.en: He knew he was out, so he walked.
examples.zh: 他知道自己出局了，所以他主动离场。

senses.def: to reach first base
senses.zh: （因投手投出四坏球）自由上一垒；使（击球手）自由上一垒

examples.en: He walked 60 times in 57 games.
examples.zh: 他在 57 场比赛中获得了 60 次自由上一垒。

examples.en: Despite walking one batter, Jackson showed solid control of the pitch.
examples.zh: 尽管投出了四坏球让一名击球手自由上垒，杰克逊还是表现出了对球场的稳固把控。

senses.def: to be taking a risk
to feel very happy

examples.en: Most couples feel they are walking on air on their wedding day.
examples.zh: 大多数新人在婚礼那天都感到乐不可支。

senses.def: to get married
to do things that are difficult, without learning the basic skills first
senses.zh: 不会走就跑；没掌握基本功就做难事

senses.def: to be in a difficult situation in which you do not have much freedom of action and need to be extremely careful about what you do

examples.en: The government is walking a difficult tightrope in wanting to reduce interest rates without pushing up inflation.
examples.zh: 政府想要在不推高通胀的情况下降低利率，就像在走钢丝一样艰难。

senses.def: to walk around the area that they are responsible for

examples.en: We have two officers walking the beat after midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜以后我们派有两名警察巡逻。

senses.def: to be in a difficult or dangerous situation where you could easily make a mistake
senses.zh: 处于困境（或险境）；如履薄冰；走钢丝

examples.en: He was walking a fine line between being funny and being rude.
examples.zh: 他想滑稽而不粗鲁，难以把握分寸。

examples.en: She often seems to tread a thin line between success and failure.
examples.zh: 她似乎经常在成功与失败之间徘徊。

senses.def: to be allowed to leave court, etc., without receiving any punishment

examples.en: She was acquitted and walked free from court.
examples.zh: 她被无罪释放，自由离开法庭。

senses.def: to go somewhere on foot instead of in a vehicle

examples.en: It’s not very far. We can easily walk it.
examples.zh: 不是很远。我们可以轻松地走过去。

senses.def: to easily achieve something that you want

examples.en: It's not a difficult exam. You'll walk it!
examples.zh: 这次考试不难。你会轻松通过的！

senses.def: to make somebody walk so far or so fast that they are very tired

examples.en: I hope I haven’t walked you off your feet.
examples.zh: 希望我没有让你累坏了。

senses.def: to stop working in order to go on strike
(in the past) to walk along a board placed over the side of a ship and fall into the sea, as a punishment
senses.zh: 走跳板（旧时强迫受害人在置于船舷外的跳板上行走而致落水）

senses.def: to walk around the streets of a town or city
senses.zh: （在城镇里）穿街走巷；在大街上闲逛

examples.en: Is it safe to walk the streets alone at night?
examples.zh: 夜间独自一人在大街上行走安全吗？

senses.def: to feel proud and confident
to act in a way that shows people you are really good at what you do, and not just good at talking about it

examples.en: You can talk the talk but can you walk the walk?
examples.zh: 你说得头头是道，可是你做得到吗？

senses.def: a journey on foot, usually for pleasure or exercise
senses.zh: 行走；步行；徒步旅行；散步

examples.en: Let's go for a walk.
examples.zh: 咱们去散散步吧。

examples.en: I like to have a walk in the evenings.
examples.zh: 我喜欢晚上散步。

examples.en: I decided to take a walk to clear my head
examples.zh: 我决定出去散步醒醒脑子。

examples.en: She's taken the dog for a walk.
examples.zh: 她带着狗去散步了。

examples.en: He set out on the long walk home.
examples.zh: 他动身走很长的路回家了。

examples.en: a ten-minute walk
examples.zh: 步行十分钟的路程

examples.en: The office is ten minutes' walk from here.
examples.zh: 从这里去办公室要步行十分钟。

examples.en: He's out for a walk with a friend.
examples.zh: 他跟朋友出去散步了。

examples.en: He met her on one of his Sunday afternoon walks.
examples.zh: 他在星期天的一次午后散步中遇到了她。

examples.en: a short/long walk
examples.zh: 短途/长途步行

examples.en: It's only a short walk to the beach.
examples.zh: 步行到海滩没多远。

examples.en: a walk along the shore
examples.zh: 沿岸散步

examples.en: a walk around town
examples.zh: 绕城散步

examples.en: a walk through the woods
examples.zh: 穿过树林

examples.en: I think the walk from the station did me some good.
examples.zh: 我认为从车站步行对我有好处。

examples.en: a walk in the country
examples.zh: 乡间散步

senses.def: a path or route for walking, usually for pleasure; an organized event when people walk for pleasure
senses.zh: 散步的小路；步行的路径；（为游玩而组织的）徒步旅行

examples.en: I'm going on a sponsored walk to raise money for cancer research.
examples.zh: 我要去参加一场有赞助的慈善徒步活动，为癌症研究募捐。

examples.en: a guided walk around the farm
examples.zh: 由向导引路绕农场走一圈

examples.en: We wanted to do a walk for charity.
examples.zh: 我们当时想去参加慈善步行活动。

examples.en: There are some interesting walks in the area.
examples.zh: 这一带有几条有趣的小径。

examples.en: a circular walk
examples.zh: 环形步行路径

senses.def: a way or style of walking; the act or speed of walking rather than running

examples.en: I recognized him by his walk.
examples.zh: 我根据他走路的样子认出了他。

examples.en: The horse slowed to a walk.
examples.zh: 那匹马慢下来缓步而行。

senses.def: a sidewalk
a sports event in which people compete to walk a long distance as fast as possible without running

examples.en: the 20k walk
examples.zh: 20 公里竞走

senses.def: time that you spend thinking about and remembering the past or going to a place again in order to remind yourself of past experiences

examples.en: Visiting my old school was a real trip down memory lane.
examples.zh: 参观我的母校是一次真正的回忆之旅。

examples.en: The role isn't exactly a walk in the park.
examples.zh: 这个角色的难度不容小觑。

examples.en: The next game will be a walk in the park.
examples.zh: 下一场比赛将是在公园散步。

senses.def: a person’s job or position in society

examples.en: She has friends from all walks of life.
examples.zh: 她在社会各界中都有朋友。

synonyms.words: lead ▪ escort ▪ drive ▪ show ▪ walk ▪ guide ▪ usher ▪ direct

intro.en: These words all mean to go with somebody from one place to another.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含带去、引领之义。

items.def: to go with somebody from one place to another, for example in order to show them something or to show them the way to a place:
items.zh: 指带去、带路、引领

examples.en: It’s too far to walk—I’ll take you by car.
examples.zh: 步行路太远，我开车送你去。

items.def: to go with or go in front of somebody in order to show them the way or to make them go in the right direction:
items.zh: 指带路、领路、引领

examples.en: Firefighters led the survivors to safety.
examples.zh: 消防队员把幸存者带到了安全的地方。

items.def: to go with somebody in order to protect or guard them or to show them the way:
items.zh: 指护卫、护送

examples.en: The President arrived, escorted by twelve bodyguards.
examples.zh: 总统在十二名保镖的护送下到达。

items.def: to take somebody somewhere in a car, taxi, etc:
items.zh: 指驾车送（人）

examples.en: My mother drove us to the airport.
examples.zh: 我母亲开车把我们送到了机场。

items.def: to take somebody to a particular place, in the right direction, or along the correct route:
items.zh: 指引领、带领

examples.en: The attendant showed us to our seats.
examples.zh: 服务员把我们带到我们的座位。

items.def: to go somewhere with somebody on foot, especially in order to make sure that they get there safely; to take an animal, especially a dog, for a walk or make an animal walk somewhere:
items.zh: 指陪伴或护送（人）走、牵着或赶着（动物）走、遛（狗）

examples.en: He always walked her home.
examples.zh: 他经常护送她走回家。

items.def: to show somebody the way to a place, often by going with them; to show somebody a place that you know well:
items.zh: 指给某人领路（或导游）、指引

examples.en: She guided us through the busy streets.
examples.zh: 她带领我们穿过了繁忙的街道。

items.def: (rather formal) to politely take or show somebody where they should go, especially within a building:
items.zh: 指礼貌地引往、引导、引领，尤指在建筑物内

examples.en: She ushered her guests to their seats.
examples.zh: 她把客人引领到座位上。

items.def: (rather formal) to tell or show somebody how to get somewhere or where to go:
items.zh: 指给某人指路、为某人领路

examples.en: A young woman directed them to the station.
examples.zh: 一名年轻女子给他们指了去车站的路。

senses.zh: （从困难的处境或关系中）脱身，一走了之

examples.en: He was tempted to walk away from the problem.
examples.zh: 他很想摆脱这个问题。

senses.def: to win or obtain something easily

examples.en: She walked away with the gold medal.
examples.zh: 她轻松地摘走了金牌。

senses.def: large enough to walk into

examples.en: a walk-in closet
examples.zh: 步入式衣帽间

senses.def: not arranged in advance; where you do not need to arrange a time in advance
senses.zh: 未经预约的；无须事先约定的

examples.en: a walk-in interview
examples.zh: 未经预约的访谈

examples.en: a walk-in clinic
examples.zh: 无须预约的诊所

senses.def: to enter a room when somebody in there is doing something private and does not expect you

examples.en: I walked in on the two of them with their heads together.
examples.zh: 我走进去，看到他们两个头靠在一起。

senses.def: to become involved in an unpleasant situation, especially because you were not sensible enough to avoid it
senses.zh: 不意落入，不明智地陷入（不愉快的境地）

examples.en: I realized I'd walked into a trap.
examples.zh: 我意识到自己稀里糊涂落入了陷阱。

senses.def: to succeed in getting a job very easily

examples.en: She walked straight into a job at the bank as soon as she graduated.
examples.zh: 毕业后，她直接进入银行工作。

senses.def: to crash into something/somebody while you are walking, for example because you do not see them

examples.en: I was in a hurry and almost walked into the glass door.
examples.zh: 我手忙脚乱，差点就撞到了玻璃门上。

senses.def: to leave a person or place suddenly because you are angry or upset

examples.en: She said, ‘You just don't care, do you?’ and walked off in a huff.
examples.zh: 她说：“你根本不在乎，是吗？”然后气呼呼地走开了。

senses.def: to go for a walk after a meal so that you feel less full

examples.en: We walked off a heavy Sunday lunch.
examples.zh: 我们星期日午餐吃得特别多，散散步帮助消化。

senses.def: to win something easily

examples.en: Marion walked off with the top prize.
examples.zh: 马里昂带着最高奖项离开。

senses.def: to take something that is not yours; to steal something

examples.en: Someone's walked off with my phone!
examples.zh: 有人拿走了我的手机！

senses.def: used to describe a very small part in a play or film, without any words to say
senses.zh: （指戏剧或电影中无台词的）小角色，龙套角色

senses.def: to stop working in order to go on strike

examples.en: Workers at the plant are threatening to walk out over pay.
examples.zh: 该工厂的工人因工资问题威胁要罢工。

senses.def: to leave a meeting, performance, etc. suddenly, especially in order to show that you do not like or approve of it
senses.zh: 突然离去，退场，退席（尤为表示异议）

examples.en: They hinted that they would walk out of the peace talks.
examples.zh: 他们暗示将退出和谈。

senses.def: to suddenly leave somebody that you are having a relationship with and that you have a responsibility for
senses.zh: 遗弃，抛弃，舍弃，离开（某人）

examples.en: How could she walk out on her kids?
examples.zh: 她怎么能遗弃自己的孩子呢？

senses.def: to stop doing something that you have agreed to do before it is completed

examples.en: I never walk out on a job half done.
examples.zh: 我做工作从不半途而废。

senses.def: to treat somebody badly, without considering them or their needs

examples.en: She'll always let him walk all over her.
examples.zh: 她对他总是逆来顺受。

senses.def: to defeat somebody easily

examples.en: They walked all over their opponents in the crucial match.
examples.zh: 他们在关键的比赛中踩遍了对手。

senses.def: to help somebody learn or become familiar with something, by showing them each stage of the process in turn

examples.en: She walked me through a demonstration of the software.
examples.zh: 她一步步地给我演示软件。

senses.def: an occasion when you practise a performance, etc. without an audience being present
a careful explanation of the details of a process
to walk towards somebody/something, especially in a confident way

examples.en: She just walked up to the desk and asked to see the manager.
examples.zh: 她只是走到办公桌前，要求见经理。

senses.def: a tall building with stairs but no elevator
senses.zh: 无电梯的大楼；无电梯大楼中的办公室（或公寓套房）

senses.zh: 沃尔玛超市美国大型连锁超市，在美国和其他国家有多家门店，以便宜的价格销售种类繁多的商品。1962年山姆•沃尔顿(1918-92)在阿肯色州开设了第一家沃尔玛店，他后来成为美国最富有的人之一。

the tree on which walnuts

examples.zh: 胡桃木写字台

senses.zh: 海象胡子（浓密且两端下垂的唇上长胡须）

senses.def: (1901-66) a US producer of films, especially cartoons. He created Mickey Mouse
senses.zh: 沃尔特·迪斯尼（Walt Disney）：（1901-66）美国电影制片人，尤其是动画片。他创作了米老鼠和唐老鸭，并制作了第一部长片动画片，其中包括《白雪公主和七个小矮人》（1937），《幻想曲》（1940）和《小鹿斑比》（1942）。他还制作了许多成功的自然电影，其中第一部是《生存沙漠》（1953年），以及与现场演员一起拍摄的电影，例如金银岛（1950年）和玛丽·波平斯（Mary Poppins）（1964年）。迪士尼因他的作品而获得了26项奥斯卡奖，人们还记得他是家庭娱乐方面最伟大的制作人之一。他还拥有电视节目并创建了迪士尼乐园。

senses.def: (1819-92) a major US poet who wrote about individual freedom, equal rights and sexual love, as well as about his love for America. Though many readers thought his poems were immoral
senses.zh: 沃尔特·惠特曼（Walt Whitman）：（1819-92）是一位美国主要诗人，他写了关于个人自由，平等权利和性爱以及对美国的爱。尽管许多读者认为他的诗是不道德的，但他对后来的美国诗人，尤其是节拍一代产生了深远的影响。他使用了新形式的“自由诗歌”，其中线条不押韵。他最著名的作品有《草叶》，《鼓水龙头》（1865年）和一系列著作《民主远景》（1871年）。

senses.def: a first name for boys
(1826-77) an English economist
senses.zh: 沃尔特·贝格霍特（Walter Bagehot）：（1826-77）是一位英国经济学家和新闻工作者，因其著作《英国宪法》（1867）而广为人知。

senses.def: (1845-1915) an English artist and member of the Arts and Crafts Movement
senses.zh: 沃尔特·克兰（Walter Crane）：（1845-1915）是一位英国艺术家，也是手工艺运动的成员。他的彩色图书插图对儿童图书的发展产生了深远的影响。

senses.def: (1916-2009) a US television journalist who presented the national CBS Evening News programme from 1962 to 1981. He ended each programme by saying, 'And that's the way it is.’ Cronkite was known for his honesty
senses.zh: 沃尔特·克朗凯特（Walter Cronkite）：（1916-2009）美国电视新闻记者，从1962年至1981年介绍了美国国家广播公司（CBS）晚间新闻节目。克朗凯特（Cronkite）以其诚实而闻名，并于1973年被选为“美国最值得信赖的人”。

senses.def: (1873-1956) an English writer of poems, novels and short stories for adults and children. His best-known works are the poems Songs of Childhood
senses.zh: 瓦尔特·德拉马雷（Walter de la Mare）：（ 1873-1956年），是英国成人和儿童诗歌，小说和短篇小说的作家。他最著名的作品是诗歌《童年之歌》（1902年），《听众》（1912年），《孔雀派》（1913年）和小说《侏儒回忆录》（1921年）。

senses.def: (1889-1974) a US journalist. He wrote a regular political column called Today and Tomorrow
senses.zh: 沃尔特·利普曼（Walter Lippmann）：（1889-1974）美国记者。他撰写了定期的政治专栏，名为《今日与明天》，该专栏出现在世界各地的报纸上。他为《纽约先驱论坛报》（1931-62）和《华盛顿邮报》（1962-7）撰稿，两次获得普利策奖。利普曼还于1914年帮助创办了《新共和国》杂志。

senses.def: a person who imagines that their life is full of excitement and adventures when it is in fact just ordinary

examples.en: My client is very much a Walter Mitty character.
examples.zh: 我的当事人是一个沃尔特·米蒂式的人物。

examples.en: I was living in a sort of Walter Mitty world.
examples.zh: 我生活在沃尔特·米蒂的世界里。

senses.def: (c. 1552-1618) an English explorer
senses.zh: 沃尔特·罗利（Walter Raleigh）：（c。1552-1618）是一位英国探险家，政治家和士兵。他的职业生涯是与西班牙人和爱尔兰人作战，并于1584年由伊丽莎白女王一世任命为骑士。在她的支持下，他多次前往北美（1584-9）和南美（1595），将烟草和马铃薯，但未能在那里建立永久基地。伊丽莎白去世后，他因叛国罪（叛国罪）被判入狱13年，其间他撰写了《世界历史》（1614年）。1616年，他被国王詹姆斯一世（James I）释放，去南美寻找黄金。他在这方面并不成功，当他回来时，他因砍断头而受到惩罚。

senses.def: a large hospital and medical centre near Washington, DC
senses.zh: 沃尔特·里德国家军事医学中心：位于华盛顿特区附近的大型医院和医疗中心，为美国武装部队及其家人提供医疗服务。美国总统经常去那里进行身体检查。该中心还进行研究，于1909年在军队医院开业，并以美国陆军少校沃尔特·里德（1851-1902）的名字命名，后者发现蚊子携带热带病黄热病。

walter-reed-national-military-medical-ce.word: Walter Reed National Military Medical Center

senses.def: (1771-1832) a Scottish author and poet. Most of his poetry and his historical novels are based on the traditions and history of Scotland, especially the border region. His most famous poems include The Lay of the Last Minstrel
senses.zh: 沃尔特·斯科特（Walter Scott）：（1771-1832）是苏格兰作家和诗人。他的大部分诗歌和历史小说都基于苏格兰的传统和历史，尤其是边境地区。他最著名的诗有《最后的吟游诗人的躺椅》和《湖中的夫人》，他最著名的小说包括韦弗利，罗伯·罗伊和艾芬豪。所有这些在他的一生中都非常受欢迎，并在英国和欧洲影响了作家。斯科特（Scott）在1820年成为男爵。

senses.def: (1860-1942) an English artist. He was the most important painter of the Camden Town Group
senses.zh: （1860-1942）英国艺术家。他是卡姆登镇集团最重要的画家，并受到法国印象派画家和惠斯勒的影响。他以在剧院里的生活画以及后来的枯燥房间的画而闻名，这些房间通常都是裸体模特。

senses.def: (1897-1972) a popular US radio and newspaper journalist in the 1930s and 1940s. He began his radio broadcasts with the phrase ‘Good evening, Mr and Mrs America and all the ships at sea’. His style of reading the news was very dramatic and he was one of the first journalists to add his own comments to news stories. From 1929 to 1969 he wrote a regular column about politicians and entertainers for The Mirror
senses.zh: 沃尔特·温切尔（Walter Winchell）：（1897-1972）是1930年代和1940年代美国最受欢迎的广播和报纸记者。他以“晚安，美国先生和太太以及海上所有船只”一词开始广播。他的新闻阅读风格极富戏剧性，是最早对新闻报道发表评论的新闻记者之一。从1929年到1969年，他定期为《纽约镜报》撰写有关政治人物和演艺人员的专栏文章。

senses.def: a dance in which two people dance together to a regular rhythm; a piece of music for this dance
senses.zh: 华尔兹舞；华尔兹舞曲；圆舞曲

examples.en: to dance a/the waltz
examples.zh: 跳华尔兹舞

examples.en: a Strauss waltz
examples.zh: 施特劳斯圆舞曲

senses.def: to dance a waltz

examples.en: I watched them waltzing across the floor.
examples.zh: 我望着他们跳着华尔兹在舞池中旋转。

examples.en: He waltzed her around the room.
examples.zh: 他带着她满屋跳华尔兹舞。

senses.def: to walk or go somewhere in a very confident way

examples.en: I don't like him waltzing into the house as if he owned it.

examples.zh: 新招收的成员轻松顺利地完成了训练。

senses.def: to leave a place or person in a way that is very annoying, often taking something that is not yours

examples.en: He just waltzed off with my car!
examples.zh: 他顺手牵羊开走了我的汽车！

senses.def: looking pale and weak
senses.zh: 苍白无力的；无血色的；憔悴的

examples.en: his grey, wan face
examples.zh: 他那苍白憔悴的面孔

examples.en: She gave me a wan smile (= showing no energy or enthusiasm).

examples.en: the wan sunlight of a winter’s morning

examples.en: The fairy waved her wand and the table disappeared.

examples.en: You can't expect me to just wave a (magic) wand and make everything all right.

senses.def: to walk slowly around or to a place, often without any particular sense of purpose or direction

examples.en: She wandered aimlessly around the streets.
examples.zh: 她在大街上漫无目的地到处游荡。

examples.en: We wandered back towards the car.
examples.zh: 我们溜达着回到汽车那里。

examples.en: The child was found wandering the streets alone.
examples.zh: 那孩子被发现独自在大街上瞎转。

senses.def: to move away from the place where you ought to be or the people you are with

examples.en: The child wandered off and got lost.
examples.zh: 那孩子走散后迷路了。

examples.en: How could you let him wander off like that?
examples.zh: 你怎么能让他这样走散了？

examples.en: They had wandered from the path into the woods.
examples.zh: 他们离开小路消失在树林里。

senses.def: to stop being directed on something and to move without much control to other ideas, subjects, etc.
senses.zh: 走神；神志恍惚；（思想）开小差

examples.en: It's easy to be distracted and let your attention wander.
examples.zh: 很容易走神分散注意力。

examples.en: Try not to let your mind wander.
examples.zh: 尽量别让你的思想开小差。

examples.en: Her thoughts wandered back to her youth.
examples.zh: 她浮想联翩，思绪回到了青春岁月。

examples.en: Don’t wander off the subject—keep to the point.
examples.zh: 不要偏离主题——切入主题。

senses.def: to move slowly from looking at one thing to looking at another thing or in other directions

examples.en: She let her gaze wander.
examples.zh: 她东瞅瞅西望望。

examples.en: His eyes wandered towards the photographs on the wall.
examples.zh: 他的目光慢慢地移向墙上的照片。

senses.def: to go in a curve instead of following a straight course

examples.en: The road wanders along through the hills.
examples.zh: 这条路蜿蜒曲折地穿过山丘。

senses.def: a short walk in or around a place, usually with no special purpose

examples.en: I went to the park and had a wander around.
examples.zh: 我去公园转了一圈。

senses.def: a person who keeps travelling from place to place with no permanent home

examples.en: ‘So, I see the wanderer has returned!’ he sneered.
examples.zh: “所以，我看到流浪者回来了！”他冷笑道。

examples.en: I felt like a homeless wanderer on the face of the earth.
examples.zh: 我感觉自己就像地球表面上一个无家可归的流浪者。

senses.def: journeys from place to place, usually with no special purpose

examples.en: His wanderings took him first to India.
examples.zh: 他的漂泊首先来到了印度。

senses.def: a strong desire to travel
to become gradually weaker or less important

examples.en: Her enthusiasm for the whole idea was waning rapidly.
examples.zh: 她对整个想法的热情迅速冷淡了下来。

examples.en: Their popularity waned during that period.
examples.zh: 在那段时期，他们的受欢迎程度有所下降。

examples.en: Demand for the product shows no signs of waning.
examples.zh: 该产品的需求没有显示出减弱的迹象。

senses.def: to appear slightly smaller each day after being round and full
