senses.zh: （力量、重要性等）兴衰枯荣，盛衰；阴晴圆缺

examples.en: Public interest in the issue has waxed and waned over the years.
examples.zh: 这些年来公众对这个话题的兴趣时冷时热。

senses.def: becoming smaller, less important or less common

examples.en: Her popularity has been on the wane for some time.
examples.zh: 她的人气一段时间以来不断下降。

examples.en: Violent crime appears to be on the wane in the capital.
examples.zh: 首都的暴力犯罪似乎正在减少。

senses.def: to increase then decrease in strength, importance, etc. over a period of time
senses.zh: （力量、重要性等）兴衰枯荣，盛衰；阴晴圆缺

examples.en: Public interest in the issue has waxed and waned over the years.
examples.zh: 这些年来公众对这个话题的兴趣时冷时热。

senses.def: becoming smaller, less important or less common

examples.en: Her popularity has been on the wane for some time.
examples.zh: 她的人气一段时间以来不断下降。

examples.en: Violent crime appears to be on the wane in the capital.
examples.zh: 首都的暴力犯罪似乎正在减少。

senses.def: to get something that you or another person wants, but do not really have a right to have, by persuading somebody or by a clever plan
senses.zh: 把…弄到手；设法获得；搞到

examples.en: She had wangled an invitation to the opening night.
examples.zh: 她弄到了一张首映之夜的请柬。

examples.en: We should be able to wangle it so that you can start tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我们应该能设法安排你明天启程。

examples.en: He managed to wangle his way onto the course.
examples.zh: 他终于设法修读了这一科目。

examples.en: I'll try to wangle some money out of my parents.
examples.zh: 我要设法从父母那里哄出些钱来。

examples.en: He had wangled her a seat on the plane.
examples.zh: 他为她弄到了一个飞机上的座位。

senses.def: to masturbate
an act of masturbation
an offensive word used to refer to a man that you dislike or are angry with
senses.zh: 孬种，下流坯（用以侮辱男性）

examples.en: a bunch of wankers
examples.zh: 一群下流坯

senses.def: in a weak or pale way
senses.zh: 虚弱地，无精打采地 ；微弱地

examples.en: He smiled wanly.
examples.zh: 他惨然一笑。

examples.en: a wanly glowing bulb
examples.zh: 一个暗淡的发光灯泡

senses.def: a way of saying or writing ‘want to’ or ‘want a’ in informal speech
senses.zh: 要，想要个（非正式口头或书写形式，用以表示 want to 或 want a）

examples.en: I wanna go.
examples.zh: 我想走。

examples.en: Wanna drink? (= Do you want…)
examples.zh: 要杯饮料吗？

senses.def: a person who behaves, dresses, etc. like somebody famous because they want to be like them

examples.en: a rock star wannabe
examples.zh: 模仿摇滚歌星的人

senses.def: to have a desire or a wish for something/somebody

examples.en: Do you want some more tea?
examples.zh: 你再要点儿茶吗？

examples.en: to want children/kids
examples.zh: 想要孩子

examples.en: to want peace/war/change
examples.zh: 想要和平/战争/变革

examples.en: Voters want answers to these questions,
examples.zh: 选民想要这些问题的答案，

examples.en: If you want more information, visit the website.
examples.zh: 如果您想了解更多信息，请访问该网站。

examples.en: The US wants access to Chinese markets.
examples.zh: 美国希望进入中国市场。

examples.en: The voters seem to want a reason to vote for him.
examples.zh: 选民们似乎想要一个投票给他的理由。

examples.en: She's always wanted a large family.
examples.zh: 她一直希望生一大群孩子。

examples.en: If you want some help, just ask.
examples.zh: 如果您需要帮助，尽管询问。

examples.en: I want a new job.
examples.zh: 我想要一份新工作。

examples.en: All I want is the truth.
examples.zh: 我只想知道实情。

examples.en: Thanks for the present—it's just what I wanted.
examples.zh: 感谢赠我这份礼物，这正是我想要的。

examples.en: I can do whatever I want.
examples.zh: 我想干什么就可以干什么。

examples.en: The last thing I wanted was to upset you.
examples.zh: 我最不希望做的事就是惹你不高兴。

examples.en: What do you want for Christmas?
examples.zh: 圣诞节你想要什么？

examples.en: I wanted bacon and eggs for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐想要培根和鸡蛋。

examples.en: The party wants her as leader.
examples.zh: 这个政党希望由她做领袖。

examples.en: What do you want to do tomorrow?
examples.zh: 明天你想做什么？

examples.en: What I really want to know is why you would even think that?
examples.zh: 我很想知道的是你为什么竟然会那么想？

examples.en: ‘It's time you did your homework.’ ‘I don't want to!’
examples.zh: “你该做作业了。”“我就是不想做！”

examples.en: I just wanted to know if everything was all right.
examples.zh: 我只是想知道是否一切都好。

examples.en: You can come too, if you want.
examples.zh: 如果你想来也可以来。

examples.en: We could see a movie later if you want to.
examples.zh: 如果你愿意的话，我们可以稍后看电影。

examples.en: There are two points which I wanted to make.
examples.zh: 我想要指出的有两点。

examples.en: I wanted to go home.
examples.zh: 我想回家。

examples.en: I simply wanted to be left in peace.
examples.zh: 我只是想安静地待着。

examples.en: She desperately wanted to believe him.
examples.zh: 她非常想相信他。

examples.en: These are books that children actually want to read.
examples.zh: 这些都是孩子们真正想读的书。

examples.en: Do you want me to help?
examples.zh: 你要我帮忙吗？

examples.en: I want people to know what I've done.
examples.zh: 我想让大家知道我干了什么。

examples.en: We didn't want this to happen.
examples.zh: 我们并不希望发生这样的事情。

examples.en: I want it (to be) done as quickly as possible.
examples.zh: 我希望这件事尽快完成。

examples.en: I don't want you coming home so late.
examples.zh: 我不希望你这么晚回家。

examples.en: Do you want your coffee black or white?
examples.zh: 你的咖啡里加不加奶？

examples.en: It was clear that somebody wanted him dead.
examples.zh: 很明显有人想要他死。

examples.en: They want him arrested.
examples.zh: 他们希望他被捕。

examples.en: What do you want from me?
examples.zh: 你要从我这里得到什么？

examples.en: I had to discover what I really wanted out of life.
examples.zh: 我得弄清楚我到底要从生活中得到什么。

senses.def: to need something

examples.en: We'll want more furniture for the new office.
examples.zh: 我们的新办公室需要添些家具。

examples.en: What this house wants is a good clean.
examples.zh: 这房子需要好好打扫一下。

examples.en: It wants a special sort of person for that job.
examples.zh: 它需要一个特殊的人来做这项工作。

examples.en: The plants want watering daily.
examples.zh: 这些植物需要天天浇水。

examples.en: The cake mixture wants to be smooth and light.
examples.zh: 蛋糕糊要光滑松软。

examples.en: The plants want to be watered daily.
examples.zh: 这些植物需要天天浇水。

senses.def: to need somebody to be present in the place or for the purpose mentioned

examples.en: She's wanted immediately in the director's office.
examples.zh: 她得马上到主任办公室去。

examples.en: Excuse me, you're wanted on the phone.
examples.zh: 对不起，有你的电话。

senses.def: used to give advice to somebody, meaning ‘should’ or ‘ought to’

examples.en: warm weather/temperatures/air
examples.zh: 温暖的天气／温度／空气

examples.en: Wash the blouse in warm soapy water.
examples.zh: 这件女衬衫要用温的肥皂水洗。

examples.en: Tomorrow will be warm and sunny.
examples.zh: 明天将会温暖晴朗。

examples.en: a warm and dry spell
examples.zh: 一段温暖干燥的日子

examples.en: Are you warm enough?
examples.zh: 你够暖和吗？

examples.en: The children jumped up and down to keep warm.
examples.zh: 孩子们上下跳动保持身体暖和。

examples.en: I can’t seem to get warm.
examples.zh: 我似乎无法取暖。

examples.en: Wait for the warmer weather before putting the plants in the garden.
examples.zh: 等待天气变暖后再将植物放入花园中。

examples.en: a warm climate
examples.zh: 温暖的气候

examples.en: It's nice and warm in here.
examples.zh: 这里暖烘烘的。

examples.en: Heat the bread until it is warm to the touch.
examples.zh: 加热面包直至摸起来温热。

examples.en: The sun felt warm on his skin.
examples.zh: 阳光照在他的皮肤上，感觉很温暖。

senses.group: at pleasant temperature 温度宜人

senses.def: keeping you warm

examples.en: warm clothing/clothes
examples.zh: 暖和的衣服

examples.en: a warm pair of socks
examples.zh: 一双暖和的袜子

examples.en: This sleeping bag is very warm.
examples.zh: 这条睡袋很暖和。

examples.en: I wish I had a warm house to go back to.
examples.zh: 我希望我能回到一个温暖的家。

senses.def: showing enthusiasm, friendship or love

examples.en: Her smile was warm and friendly.
examples.zh: 她的微笑热情而友好。

examples.en: The star received a warm welcome from fans.
examples.zh: 这位明星受到了粉丝的热烈欢迎。

examples.en: The speaker was given a warm reception.
examples.zh: 演讲者受到热烈欢迎。

examples.en: He felt a warm glow at the memory.
examples.zh: 他一想到这个就感到温暖。

examples.en: a warm smile/greeting
examples.zh: 温暖的微笑/问候

examples.en: She threw her arms around me in a warm embrace.
examples.zh: 她张开双臂拥抱我，给予我一个温暖的拥抱。

examples.en: Most people get a warm feeling when they see puppies playing together.
examples.zh: 大多数人看到小狗在一起玩耍时都会有一种温暖的感觉。

examples.en: Please send her my warmest congratulations.
examples.zh: 请代我向她致以最热烈的祝贺。

examples.en: Her comments were greeted with warm applause.
examples.zh: 她的评论赢得了热烈的掌声。

examples.en: an extremely warm and friendly person
examples.zh: 一个极为热情友好的人

senses.def: containing red, orange or yellow, which creates a pleasant, comfortable and relaxed feeling or atmosphere

examples.en: The room was decorated in warm shades of red and orange.
examples.zh: 这房间是用红和橙这些暖色调装饰的。

examples.en: Reds and yellows are warm colours that attract attention.
examples.zh: 红色和黄色是引人注目的暖色。

senses.def: used to say that somebody has almost guessed the answer to something or that they have almost found somebody/something that has been hidden
senses.zh: 即将猜中；接近答案；即将找到

examples.en: Keep guessing—you're getting warmer.
examples.zh: 接着猜，你离答案越来越近了。

senses.def: feelings of love, comfort and support; things that give you these feelings
senses.zh: 温暖：爱，安慰和支持的感觉；给你这些感觉的东西

examples.en: The memories fill me with warm fuzzies.
examples.zh: 那些记忆让我倍感美好温暖。

examples.en: Being generous may evoke some warm fuzzy feelings for you.
examples.zh: 慷慨可能会给你带来一些温暖而模糊的感觉。

examples.en: We had a nice short exchange and were both left with a good warm fuzzy.
examples.zh: 我们进行了一次愉快的简短交流，双方都留下了温暖的绒毛。

senses.def: to make something/somebody warm or warmer; to become warm or warmer

examples.en: Come in and warm yourself by the fire.
examples.zh: 进来烤火暖和暖和吧。

examples.en: The alcohol warmed and relaxed him.
examples.zh: 这酒使他浑身发暖轻松起来。

examples.en: I'll warm up some milk.
examples.zh: 我来热些牛奶。

examples.en: There is little doubt that the planet is warming.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，地球在变暖。

examples.en: As the climate warms up, the ice caps will melt.
examples.zh: 随着气候变暖，冰盖将融化。

examples.en: We soon warmed up in front of the fire.
examples.zh: 我们在炉火前面马上暖和起来了。

examples.en: Return the bowl to the heat to warm through.
examples.zh: 把碗放回加热器把它热透。

examples.en: Poach until the fish is warmed through.
examples.zh: 煮至鱼变热。

examples.zh: 他的语气突然变得友善起来。

examples.en: The story warmed our hearts.
examples.zh: 这个故事让我们心里暖洋洋的。

examples.zh: 他在游泳池里游了五个来回作为热身。

senses.zh: 暖场表演（正式表演开始前上演的短小音乐、喜剧等节目）

examples.zh: 重新热过的的鸡肉米饭

senses.zh: （想法或产品）老一套的，陈腐的

examples.en: There's not much drama in the warmed-over plot.
examples.zh: 这个老套的故事情节里没有多少令人兴奋的东西。

senses.zh: （旧时的）长柄炭炉，长柄暖床器

senses.zh: （某地区）气温上升的趋势，变暖趋势

examples.en: There has been a strong warming trend over the past 30 years.
examples.zh: 过去30年来，全球变暖趋势明显。

senses.def: in a way that keeps you warm

examples.en: They were warmly dressed in coats and scarves.
examples.zh: 他们穿着大衣，戴着围巾，十分暖和。

senses.def: in a way that shows enthusiasm, friendship or love

examples.en: The play was warmly received by the critics.
examples.zh: 剧评人对这部戏赞誉有加。

examples.en: She greeted me very warmly.
examples.zh: 她非常热情地跟我打招呼。

wanting to start a war or encouraging people to start a war

the state or quality of being warm, rather than hot or cold

examples.en: She felt the warmth of his arms around her.
examples.zh: 她感到了他双臂搂着她的温暖。

examples.en: The animals huddled together for warmth.
examples.zh: 那些动物依偎在一起取暖。

examples.en: He led the child into the warmth and safety of the house.
examples.zh: 他把这孩子领到家里享受温暖和安全。

senses.def: the state or quality of being enthusiastic and/or friendly

examples.en: They were touched by the warmth of the welcome.
examples.zh: 他们受到了热情欢迎，很感动。

examples.en: His expression lacked warmth or encouragement.
examples.zh: 他的表情缺乏温暖或鼓励。

examples.en: The area is famous for the warmth and hospitality of its people.
examples.zh: 该地区以其人民的热情好客而闻名。

senses.def: to tell somebody about something, especially something dangerous or unpleasant that is likely to happen, so that they can avoid it
senses.zh: 提醒注意（可能发生的事）；使警惕

examples.en: I tried to warn him, but he wouldn't listen.
examples.zh: 我设法提醒过他，可他就是不听。

examples.en: If you're thinking of getting a dog, be warned—they take a lot of time and money.
examples.zh: 如果你想养条狗，有话说在前头，那可既费时间又费钱。

examples.en: Security experts warned about the problems months ago.
examples.zh: 安全专家几个月前就提醒注意这些问题了。

examples.en: He warned us against pickpockets.
examples.zh: 他提醒我们要提防小偷。

examples.en: Officials warned the pilot of an anonymous threat.
examples.zh: 官员们提醒飞行员注意一个匿名威胁。

examples.en: He has been warned of the danger he is in.
examples.zh: 他已被警告他所面临的危险。

examples.en: Police have warned of possible delays.
examples.zh: 警方已经通知交通可能受阻。

examples.en: He is warning youngsters about the dangers of fireworks.
examples.zh: 他警告年轻人注意烟花的危险。

examples.en: Aid agencies have repeatedly warned that a humanitarian catastrophe is imminent.
examples.zh: 救援机构多次提醒说一场人道灾难迫在眉睫。

examples.en: She was warned that if she did it again she would lose her job.
examples.zh: 她被警告说如果她再这样做就会丢掉工作。

examples.en: I had been warned what to expect.
examples.zh: 有人事先告诉过我要出什么事。

examples.en: ‘Beware of pickpockets,’ she warned (him).
examples.zh: “当心扒手。”她提醒（他）道。

senses.def: to strongly advise somebody to do or not to do something in order to avoid danger or punishment
senses.zh: 劝告（使有所防备）；警告；告诫

examples.en: The guidebook warns against walking alone at night.
examples.zh: 这本指南告诫夜间不要单独行走。

examples.en: He hit the other child, despite being warned about the consequences of such behaviour.
examples.zh: 尽管被警告这种行为的后果，他还是打了另一个孩子。

examples.en: He warned Billy to keep away from his daughter.
examples.zh: 他警告比利离他女儿远点。

examples.en: ‘I’m warning you!’ said James, losing his patience.
examples.zh: “我警告你！”詹姆斯不耐烦地说道。

examples.en: They were warned not to climb the mountain in such bad weather.
examples.zh: 已经劝过他们天气这么坏不要攀登那座山。

senses.def: to give somebody an official warning after they have broken a rule

examples.en: The referee warned him for dangerous play.
examples.zh: 裁判警告他有危险动作。

senses.def: to tell somebody to leave or stay away from a place or person, especially in a threatening
senses.zh: （尤指以威胁的方式）叫…离开，告诫…不要靠近

examples.en: The farmer warned us off his land when we tried to camp there.
examples.zh: 我们想在那里露营，可是农场主警告我们不得靠近他的土地。

senses.def: to advise somebody not to do something or to stop doing something

examples.en: She wanted to ask him about it but the look in his eyes warned her off.
examples.zh: 她想要问他这件事，可他的眼神阻止了她。

examples.en: We were warned off buying the house.
examples.zh: 有人劝我们不要购买这所房子。

senses.def: a major film company established in 1923 by four brothers, Harry Warner (1881-1958), Albert Warner (1884-1967), Sam Warner (1888-1927) and Jack Warner (1892-1978). It produced the first sound film, The Jazz Singer
senses.zh: 华纳兄弟公司著名电影公司，由兄弟四人在1923年创建，他们是哈里•华纳(1881-1958)、阿尔伯特•华纳(1884-1967)、山姆•华纳(1888-1927)和杰克•华纳(1892-1978)。1927年，该公司制作了有史以来第一部有声电影《爵士歌手》。华纳兄弟的其他电影有《北非谍影》、《胜利之歌》、《窈窕淑女》、《驱魔人》（1973年）、《超人》、《为戴西小姐开车》（1989年）、《蝙蝠侠》、《不可饶恕》（1992年）、《亡命天涯》、《夺命感应》（1998年）和《哈利波特》系列，另外还制作了《急诊室的故事》和《老友记》等电视剧。华纳兄弟唱片公司为杰森•德鲁罗和杜阿•利帕等歌手制作过唱片。1989年，华纳兄弟公司与时代公司合并，组成时代华纳公司。

senses.def: a very large US media and entertainment company selling magazines, films, television programmes and internet services all over the world. It was formed as Time Warner in 1989 when the magazine company Time Inc joined with the film company Warner Brothers
senses.zh: 华纳媒体美国大型媒体和娱乐公司，在全世界范围销售杂志、电影、电视节目和互联网服务。公司成立于1989年，由杂志公司时代集团和电影公司华纳兄弟合并而成，名为“时代华纳”。1996年，又收购了拥有美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 的特纳广播公司。旗下的杂志包括《时代》和《体育画报》。2000年与美国在线合并，成为世界上最大的媒体公司。2018年改名为“华纳媒体”。

examples.zh: 他当时不知道自己正被当局监视。

senses.def: to be careful about what you say in order not to upset or offend somebody

examples.en: Watch your language, young man!
examples.zh: 年轻人，注意你的措辞！

examples.en: The referee told the players to mind their language.
examples.zh: 裁判让队员注意言辞。

senses.def: to walk carefully
to behave in a careful and sensible way

examples.en: You’d better watch your step with him if you don’t want trouble.
examples.zh: 如果你不想惹麻烦的话，你最好和他在一起时小心点。

senses.def: to protect yourself against danger

examples.en: She'd better watch her back if she wants to hold onto the top job.
examples.zh: 如果她想保住一把手的位置，最好小心提防。

senses.def: to be careful not to work longer than the required time; to think more about when your work will finish than about the work itself
senses.zh: 盯着钟表（算计着不超过规定的工作时间，或只盼望下班而无心工作）

examples.en: employees who are always watching the clock
examples.zh: 总是在不停地看表等着下班的员工

senses.def: used to say that when you are impatient for something to happen, time seems to pass very slowly
senses.zh: 心急水不开（越心急，时间过得越慢）

senses.def: used as a warning to somebody to be careful
to be careful what you say in order not to offend somebody or make them angry
senses.zh: 说话当心；嘴上留个把门的

senses.def: used in orders, to tell somebody to wait for more news about something to be announced
senses.zh: （用于命令）等待下面发表的消息

examples.en: I can't tell you any more right now, but watch this space.
examples.zh: 目前我不能跟你多说，等着听下面发表的消息吧。

senses.def: to be sure that you know what the time is, so that you finish something at the correct time, or are not late for something
senses.zh: 注意时间（以便按时完成或到达）

examples.en: I'll have to watch the time. I need to leave early today.
examples.zh: 我得看着点时间。今天我要早走。

senses.def: to relax and watch people in a public place
senses.zh: 闲看人来人往；静观众生百态

examples.en: We sat outside a cafe, watching the world go by.
examples.zh: 我们坐在一家小餐馆外面，望着眼前来来往往的人们。

examples.en: I love just watching the world go by.
examples.zh: 我喜欢静观周围发生的事情。

senses.def: a type of small clock that you wear on your wrist

examples.en: She kept looking anxiously at her watch.
examples.zh: 她焦急不安地一个劲儿看表。

examples.en: He paced nervously, checking his watch.
examples.zh: 他一边紧张地踱着步，一边检查手表。

examples.en: My watch is fast/slow.
examples.zh: 我的表快／慢了。

examples.en: Sorry I'm late—my watch has stopped.
examples.zh: 对不起，我来晚了，我的手表停了。

senses.def: the act of watching somebody/something carefully in case of possible danger or problems

examples.en: The police have mounted a watch outside the hotel.
examples.zh: 警方已在旅馆外面布置人监视。

examples.en: I'll keep watch while you go through his papers (= watch and warn you if somebody is coming).
examples.zh: 你查阅他的文件，我来放哨。

examples.en: The government is keeping a close watch on how the situation develops.
examples.zh: 政府正在密切注视着形势的发展。

senses.def: a fixed period of time, usually while other people are asleep, during which somebody watches for any danger so that they can warn others, for example on a ship; the person or people who do this

examples.en: I go on watch in an hour.
examples.zh: 我一个小时后值班。

examples.en: I'm on first watch.
examples.zh: 我值第一班。

senses.def: a notice or an announcement that warns the public that there may be severe weather conditions very soon

examples.en: We have tornado watches in effect for a lot of Florida.
examples.zh: 佛罗里达州很多地方的龙卷风警报尚未解除。

examples.en: They're in charge of issuing the tornado watches.
examples.zh: 他们负责发布龙卷风警报。

senses.def: to be looking carefully for somebody/something that you expect to see, especially in order to avoid possible danger

examples.en: Be on the watch for thieves.
examples.zh: 要提防小偷。

senses.def: to watch somebody/something carefully

examples.en: Over the next few months we will keep a close watch on sales.
examples.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，我们将密切关注销售情况。

intro.en: These words all mean to turn your eyes in a particular direction.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含看、观看之义。

items.def: to turn your eyes in a particular direction:
items.zh: 指看、瞧

examples.en: If you look carefully you can just see our house from here.
examples.zh: 你要是仔细看，从这里就可以看见我们的房子。

items.def: to look at somebody/​something for a time, paying attention to what happens:
items.zh: 指看、注视、观看、观察

examples.en: to watch television
examples.zh: 看电视

items.def: to watch a game, television programme, performance, etc.:
items.zh: 指观看（比赛、电视节目、演出等）

examples.en: In the evening we went to see a movie.
examples.zh: 晚上我们去看了一场电影。

items.def: (formal) to look at something, especially when you look carefully; to watch television, a film, etc.:
items.zh: 指看、观看（尤指仔细观察）；看（电视、电影等）

examples.en: People came from all over the world to view her work.
examples.zh: 观众从世界各地涌来欣赏她的作品。

items.def: (formal) to watch somebody/​something carefully, especially to learn more about them or it:
items.zh: 指观察、注视、监视

examples.en: The patients were observed over a period of several months.
examples.zh: 这些病人被观察了数月之久。

senses.zh: 说话当心；嘴上留个把门的

senses.def: to look and wait for somebody/something to appear or for something to happen
senses.zh: 观察等待（某人出现或发生某事）

examples.en: The cat was on the wall, watching for birds.
examples.zh: 那只猫在墙上伺机捕捉鸟儿。

senses.def: a list of people or groups that need to be watched closely because they might be dangerous
senses.zh: 监控名单（含需严密监控的危险人物或团体）

examples.en: The FBI already has the organization on its watch list.
examples.zh: 联邦调查局已将该组织列入监控名单。

examples.en: He had been on a terror watch list since 2016.
examples.zh: 他从 2016 年起就在恐怖分子监控名单上了。

senses.def: a list of things that you are watching closely because they might offer you a good opportunity

examples.en: One area that is high on my investment watch list is cryptocurrency.
examples.zh: 我特别关注的一个投资领域是加密货币。

senses.def: used to warn somebody about something dangerous

examples.en: Watch out! There's a car coming!
examples.zh: 小心！汽车来了！

senses.def: to make an effort to be aware of what is happening, so that you will notice if anything bad or unusual happens

examples.en: The cashiers were asked to watch out for forged banknotes.
examples.zh: 要求出纳员注意伪钞。

senses.def: to be careful of something

examples.en: Watch out for the stairs—they're steep.
examples.zh: 小心楼梯，这些台阶很陡。

senses.def: to take care of somebody/something; to guard and protect somebody/something

examples.en: Maria asked Amelia to watch over her daughter.
examples.zh: 玛丽亚请阿梅莉亚照看她的女儿。

senses.def: a thin piece of leather, etc. for fastening your watch around your wrist
interesting, fun or pleasant to watch
a thin piece of leather, etc. for fastening your watch around your wrist
a person or group of people whose job is to check that companies are not doing anything illegal or ignoring people’s rights
senses.zh: （监督公司活动及监护人们权利的）监察人，监察团体

examples.en: She is a member of the consumer watchdog for transport in London and Southern England.
examples.zh: 她是消费者监察团体的成员，监督伦敦和英格兰南部运输业。

examples.en: ‘Ofwat’ is the water industry watchdog in Britain.
examples.zh: “Ofwat” 是英国水务行业的监管机构。

senses.def: a dog that is kept to guard a building
a person who watches and studies somebody/something regularly

examples.en: an industry/a market watcher
examples.zh: 行业／市场观察员

senses.def: paying attention to what is happening in case of danger, accidents, etc.

examples.en: Her expression was watchful and alert.
examples.zh: 她露出一副察言观色、处处提防的表情。

examples.en: His mother kept a watchful eye on him.
examples.zh: 他的母亲特别留心他。

examples.en: The children played under the watchful eye of their teacher.
examples.zh: 孩子们在老师的看护下玩耍。

examples.en: She seemed watchful and slightly worried.
examples.zh: 她看上去很警惕，还有些担心。

senses.def: in a way that pays careful attention to what is happening in case of danger, accidents, etc.
the fact of paying careful attention to what is happening in case of danger, accidents, etc.
the task of watching a group or situation to report on what is happening but without getting directly involved
senses.zh: 观察报告，跟踪报告（对某团体或形势进行观察并报告最新情况）

examples.en: to have/keep/hold a watching brief on somebody
examples.zh: 对某人进行/保持/持有简短的观察

senses.def: a person who makes and repairs watches and clocks as a job
senses.zh: 钟表匠；钟表制造人；修表匠

senses.def: a man whose job is to guard a building, for example a bank, an office building or a factory, especially at night
a tall tower from which soldiers, etc. watch when they are guarding a place
a word or phrase that expresses somebody’s beliefs or attitudes, or that explains what somebody should do in a particular situation

examples.en: Quality is our watchword.
examples.zh: 品质至上是我们的口号。

senses.def: a liquid without colour, smell or taste that falls as rain, is in lakes, rivers and seas, and is used for drinking, washing, etc.

examples.en: a glass of water
examples.zh: 一杯水

examples.en: drinking water
examples.zh: 饮用水

examples.en: There is hot and cold running water (= water supplied by pipes) in all the bedrooms.
examples.zh: 所有的卧室里都有冷热自来水。

examples.en: The refugees are desperate for food, clean water and medical supplies.
examples.zh: 难民急需食物、清洁水和医疗用品。

examples.en: All chickens need a continuous supply of fresh water to drink.
examples.zh: 所有鸡都需要持续供应淡水来饮用。

examples.en: water pollution
examples.zh: 水污染

examples.en: water shortages
examples.zh: 缺水

examples.en: concerns about water quality
examples.zh: 对水质的担忧

examples.en: The water (= the supply of water) was turned off for several hours each day during the drought.
examples.zh: 干旱期间，每天都要停几个小时的水。

senses.def: an area of water
senses.zh: 大片的水；水域；（尤指）江，河，湖，海

examples.en: We walked down to the water's edge.
examples.zh: 我们步行到水边去。

examples.en: shallow/deep water
examples.zh: 浅／深水域

examples.en: It was lovely and cool in the water.
examples.zh: 水中凉爽宜人。

examples.en: She fell into the water.
examples.zh: 她失足落水。

examples.en: In the lagoon the water was calm.
examples.zh: 环礁湖里风平浪静。

senses.def: the surface of a mass of water

examples.en: The leaves floated on the water.
examples.zh: 叶片漂浮在水面上。

examples.en: I could see my reflection in the water.
examples.zh: 我能看到水中自己的倒影。

examples.en: She dived under the water.
examples.zh: 她潜入水下。

examples.en: He disappeared under the water.
examples.zh: 他在水下消失了。

senses.def: the water in a particular lake, river, sea or ocean

examples.en: the grey waters of the River Clyde
examples.zh: 克莱德河灰蒙蒙的河水

examples.en: This species is found in coastal waters around the Indian Ocean.
examples.zh: 在环印度洋沿岸的海域有这一物种。

senses.def: an area of sea or ocean belonging to a particular country

examples.en: We were still in British waters.
examples.zh: 我们仍在英国的领海上。

examples.en: fishing in international waters
examples.zh: 在国际海域捕鱼

examples.en: The submarine had strayed into Russian waters.
examples.zh: 潜艇误闯进了俄罗斯海域。

senses.def: used to describe a situation, usually one that is difficult, dangerous or not familiar
senses.zh: 不明朗（或未知、困难、危险等）的局面

examples.en: The conversation got into the murky waters of jealousy and relationships.
examples.zh: 交谈进入到爱妒交织的复杂话题。

examples.en: The government has warned of stormy waters ahead.
examples.zh: 政府已告诫说，以后的局势将很严峻。

examples.en: I was going into uncharted waters.
examples.zh: 我要进入未知的领域。

senses.def: to be in or get into trouble
family relationships are stronger than any others
senses.zh: 血浓于水；亲属关系最牢靠

senses.def: to destroy somebody/something completely
to show that somebody/something is not good by being very much better than it/them
senses.zh: （以更加优异者）表明…不好，显得…差得多

examples.en: I like my old phone, but this new model blows it out of the water.
examples.zh: 我喜欢我的旧手机，但这个新款比它强多了。

senses.def: using a boat or ship

examples.en: They reached Naples by water.
examples.zh: 他们乘水路到达那不勒斯。

examples.en: Goods were often transported by water in the 19th century.
examples.zh: 19 世纪货物经常通过水路运输。

senses.def: a complete difference or division between two people or groups

examples.en: Voters want to see clear blue water between the main parties.
examples.zh: 选民希望看到主要政党之间有清澈的蓝水。

examples.en: They failed to put clear blue water between themselves and their competitors.
examples.zh: 他们没能让自己和竞争对手形成明显区别。

senses.def: a person or plan that is dead in the water

examples.en: His leadership campaign is dead in the water.
examples.zh: 他参加领导层竞选无望成功。

senses.def: to start doing something very carefully to see if it will be successful or not

examples.en: We decided to dip a toe in the computer games market.
examples.zh: 我们决定涉足电脑游戏市场。

senses.def: a person who feels uncomfortable because they are in an environment that is not familiar
senses.zh: 离水之鱼（因环境不熟悉而感到不舒服，不自在的人）

senses.def: despite any difficulties

examples.en: I was determined to go, come hell or high water.
examples.zh: 我决心要去，不管有什么困难。

senses.def: in trouble or difficulty
used to say that something happened in the past and is now forgotten or no longer important
to deal with a difficult situation, especially one in which you have financial problems, and just manage to survive
senses.zh: 勉强逃脱困境；设法不举债；挣扎求存

examples.en: I’m not sure how much longer we’ll be able to keep our heads above water.
examples.zh: 我不确定我们还能坚持多久。

senses.def: (to become used to something) very easily, without any problems or fears
senses.zh: 像鸭子入水般容易，轻而易举，毫不困难，毫无畏惧（习惯于某事）

examples.en: She has taken to teaching like a duck to water.
examples.zh: 她教起书来驾轻就熟。

senses.def: in large quantities

examples.en: He spends money like water.
examples.zh: 他挥霍无度。

senses.def: if an argument, an excuse, a theory, etc. does not hold water
senses.zh: （论点、借口、理论等）站不住脚，不合情理

senses.def: to urinate
to give reasons for not being in favour of something; to criticize something

examples.en: She immediately poured cold water on his plans to expand the business.
examples.zh: 她立刻给他拓展业务的计划泼了冷水。

senses.def: to try to settle an argument
a person who seems to be quiet or shy may surprise you by knowing a lot or having deep feelings
senses.zh: 静水流深；木讷寡言者也许胸藏丘壑

senses.def: to find out what the situation is before doing something or making a decision
to keep yourself in the same place in deep water by moving your arms and legs
senses.zh: 踩水（摆动四肢使身体在深水中保持直立）

senses.def: to make no progress while you are waiting for something to happen

examples.en: I decided to tread water until a better job came along.
examples.zh: 我决定原地踏步，直到找到更好的工作。

senses.def: used to say that something, especially criticism, has no effect on somebody/something

examples.en: I can't tell my son what to do; it's water off a duck's back with him.
examples.zh: 我无法告诉我儿子该做什么，他根本听不进去。

senses.def: when a pregnant woman’s waters break
you can give somebody the opportunity to do something, but you cannot force them to do it if they do not want to
senses.zh: 牵马近水易，逼马饮水难；机会可以给，做不做由人；老牛不饮水，不能强按头

senses.def: to pour water on plants, etc.

examples.en: to water the plants/garden
examples.zh: 给花草／花园浇水

senses.def: to become full of tears

examples.en: The smoke made my eyes water.
examples.zh: 烟熏得我直流眼泪。

senses.def: to produce saliva

examples.en: The smells from the kitchen made our mouths water.
examples.zh: 厨房里的香味馋得我们直流口水。

examples.en: The smell of the meat made her mouth water.
examples.zh: 肉的香味让她垂涎欲滴。

senses.def: to give water to an animal to drink

examples.en: to water the horses
examples.zh: 饮马

examples.en: After a tour of the grounds, the guests were fed and watered.
examples.zh: 客人们游览场地之后，给招待得酒足饭饱。

senses.def: to provide an area of land with water

examples.en: The valley is watered by a stream.
examples.zh: 这山谷有一条小溪流过。

senses.def: to add water to an alcoholic drink

examples.en: watered wine
examples.zh: 掺了水的葡萄酒

senses.def: to be in or get into trouble
family relationships are stronger than any others
senses.zh: 血浓于水；亲属关系最牢靠

items.idm: blow somebody/something out of the water

senses.def: to destroy somebody/something completely
to show that somebody/something is not good by being very much better than it/them
senses.zh: （以更加优异者）表明…不好，显得…差得多

examples.en: I like my old phone, but this new model blows it out of the water.

examples.zh: 我爱他，我想他也有同样的感觉。
