examples.zh: 你大老远地跑来看我们？

examples.en: The area's wine industry still has a way to go to full maturity.
examples.zh: 这个地区的酿酒业还远远没有完全成熟。

examples.en: We still have a ways to go.
examples.zh: 我们还有很大的差距。

senses.def: an area, a part of a country, etc.

examples.en: I think he lives somewhere over Greenwich way.
examples.zh: 我想他住在格林尼治那一带。

examples.en: I'll stop by and see you next time I'm down your way.
examples.zh: 下次我去你那一带时会顺道去看你的。

senses.def: a particular aspect of something

examples.en: I have changed in every way.
examples.zh: 我已经完完全全变了。

examples.en: It's been quite a day, one way and another (= for several reasons).
examples.zh: 从几方面看，这是不寻常的一天。

senses.def: a particular condition or state

examples.en: The economy's in a bad way.
examples.zh: 经济状况很糟。

examples.en: I don't know how we're going to manage, the way things are.
examples.zh: 按目前这样的情况，我不知道我们要如何应付。

senses.def: on the other side of the street, etc.

examples.en: Music blared from the open window of the house across the way.
examples.zh: 从街对面那栋房子开着的窗户里传出嘈杂的音乐声。

senses.def: during the whole journey/period of time

examples.en: She didn't speak a word to me all the way back home.
examples.zh: 回家的一路上，她没对我说过一句话。

examples.en: the whole way to Arizona
examples.zh: 去亚利桑那州的一路上

examples.en: This bus doesn't go all the way so you'll have to change.
examples.zh: 这趟公交车是区间车，所以你必须换乘。

examples.en: I watched the movie the whole way through.
examples.zh: 我从头至尾看了这部电影。

senses.def: completely; as much as it takes to achieve what you want

examples.en: I'm fighting him all the way.
examples.zh: 我在全力和他对抗。

examples.en: You can feel that the audience is with her all the way.
examples.zh: 你可以感觉到听众完全支持她。

senses.def: as you make progress with something
senses.zh: 随着进展；某事进行的同时

examples.en: You'll learn something along the way.
examples.zh: 一路下来你会学到东西的。

senses.def: used to say that things often happen in a particular way, especially when it is not convenient
senses.zh: （表示经常如此，尤指不方便）总是这样，老是

senses.def: however you choose to look at a situation
to behave or do things in a particular manner because it is part of your character

examples.en: It's not his fault he's so pompous—he was born that way.
examples.zh: 他如此自命不凡并不是他的错，他天生就是这种性格。

senses.def: to be easy compared with what came before

examples.en: It's all downhill from here. We'll soon be finished.
examples.zh: 从这以后就容易了。我们很快就会结束。

senses.def: to become worse or less successful
senses.zh: 每况愈下；走下坡路；不断恶化

examples.en: It's been all downhill for his career since then, with four defeats in five games.
examples.zh: 从那时起他的战绩便江河日下，五场比赛输掉了四场。

examples.en: I started work as a journalist and it was downhill all the way for my health.
examples.zh: 我开始当记者后，身体每况愈下。

senses.def: to be easy compared with what came before

examples.en: It's downhill all the way from here. We'll soon be finished.
examples.zh: 从这里开始一路都是下坡路。我们很快就会完成。

senses.def: to become worse or less successful
senses.zh: 每况愈下；走下坡路；不断恶化

examples.en: I started work as a journalist and it was downhill all the way for my health.
examples.zh: 我开始当记者后，身体每况愈下。

examples.en: It's been all downhill for his career since then, with four defeats in five games.
examples.zh: 从那时起他的战绩便江河日下，五场比赛输掉了四场。

senses.def: to have habits or opinions that you have had for a long time and that you do not want to change
senses.zh: 积习难改；禀性难移；执拗

examples.en: Grandma is so set in her ways.
examples.zh: 奶奶的行事方式就是这样一成不变。

senses.def: to have nearly achieved something and be going to achieve it soon

examples.en: She is well on the way to recovery.
examples.zh: 她就要康复了。

examples.en: He is well on the way to establishing himself among the top ten players in the world.
examples.zh: 他很快就会成为排名世界前十位的选手。

senses.def: by a great amount

examples.en: He was the best by a long way.
examples.zh: 很长一段时间以来他都是最好的。

senses.def: used to introduce a comment or question that is not directly related to what you have been talking about
senses.zh: 顺便提一下；捎带说一声；附带问一句

examples.en: By the way, I found that book you were looking for.
examples.zh: 顺便提一下，我找到了你在寻找的那本书。

examples.en: What's the time, by the way?
examples.zh: 顺便问一句，几点钟了？

examples.en: Oh by the way, if you see Jackie, tell her I'll call her this evening.
examples.zh: 啊，对了，你要是看到杰基，告诉她我今晚给她打电话。

senses.def: by a route that includes the place mentioned

examples.en: The artist recently arrived in Paris from Bulgaria by way of Vienna.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家最近从保加利亚途经维也纳到了巴黎。

examples.en: She came to TV by way of drama school.
examples.zh: 她是念过戏剧学校后到电视台的。

senses.def: as a form of something; for something; as a means of something
senses.zh: 作为…的形式；为了；作为…的手段

examples.en: He received £600 by way of compensation from the company.
examples.zh: 他得到那家公司 600 英镑的赔偿。

examples.en: She rolled her eyes by way of an answer and left.
examples.zh: 她转动了一下眼睛作为回答就走了。

senses.def: to start to live or behave in a different way from before
senses.zh: 开始过另一种生活；换个活法

examples.en: He was in trouble with the police as a teenager but now he’s completely changed his ways.
examples.zh: 青少年时期他曾与警察发生过麻烦，但现在他完全改变了自己的生活方式。

examples.en: Your father is unlikely to change his ways now.
examples.zh: 你父亲现在不大可能改变生活方式了。

senses.def: to gradually achieve something or move somewhere by being determined and using a lot of effort
senses.zh: 努力逐步获得；艰难地移动

examples.en: She clawed her way to the top of her profession.
examples.zh: 她努力不懈，终于爬到了职业的顶峰。

examples.en: Slowly, he clawed his way out from under the collapsed building.
examples.zh: 他艰难地从倒塌的大楼废墟底下慢慢爬了出来。

senses.def: to remove things that are stopping the progress or movement of something

examples.en: The ruling could clear the way for extradition proceedings.
examples.zh: 这项裁决也许能为引渡程序铺平道路。

senses.def: to happen to you by chance, or when you were not expecting it
senses.zh: 意外落在…头上；偶尔发生在…身上

examples.en: He took the first job that came his way.
examples.zh: 他选择了他遇到的第一份工作。

examples.en: Have any interesting articles come your way recently?
examples.zh: 你最近读到什么有意思的文章了吗？

senses.def: to have two opposite effects or results
senses.zh: 两面都行得通（或说得通）；有利也有弊

senses.def: used to say that it does not matter which one of two possibilities happens, is chosen or is true

examples.en: Was it his fault or not? Either way, an explanation is due.
examples.zh: 是他的错或不是？无论是不是，都得有个解释。

examples.en: We could meet today or tomorrow—I don't mind one way or the other.
examples.zh: 我们可以在今天或明天见面，哪一天对我都行。

senses.def: in all directions

examples.en: Her hair tumbled every which way.
examples.zh: 她的头发乱得像鸡窝。

senses.def: to move along carefully, for example when it is dark, by touching walls, objects, etc.
to be careful about how you do things, usually because you are in a situation that you are not familiar with

examples.en: She was new in the job, still feeling her way.
examples.zh: 她对这项工作不熟悉，还在摸索着干。

senses.def: to discover the right route (to a place)

examples.en: I hope you can find your way home.
examples.zh: 希望你能找到回家的路。

senses.def: to come to a place or a situation by chance or without intending to

examples.en: He eventually found his way into acting.
examples.zh: 他弄到最后竟干起了演艺这一行。

senses.def: to become used to doing something/to lose the habit of doing something

examples.en: The women had got into the way of going up on the deck every evening.
examples.zh: 这些女人养成了每天晚上到平台去的习惯。

senses.def: to prevent somebody from doing something; to prevent something from happening

examples.en: He wouldn't allow emotions to get in the way of him doing his job.
examples.zh: 他不会让感情妨碍自己的工作。

senses.def: to get or do what you want, especially when somebody has tried to stop you

examples.en: She always gets her own way in the end.
examples.zh: 到最后总是她说了算。

senses.def: to break or fall down

examples.en: The pillars gave way and a section of the roof collapsed.
examples.zh: 这些立柱坍塌了，一部分屋顶坠落下来。

examples.en: Her numb leg gave way beneath her and she stumbled clumsily.
examples.zh: 她那麻木了的腿一软，她便重重地摔了一跤。

senses.def: to stop resisting somebody/something; to agree to do something that you do not want to do

examples.en: He refused to give way on any of the points.
examples.zh: 他拒绝在任何一点上让步。

senses.def: to allow somebody/something to be or go first

examples.en: Give way to traffic already on the roundabout.
examples.zh: 让已上环状交叉路的车辆先行。

senses.def: to allow yourself to be very strongly affected by something, especially an emotion
senses.zh: 让自己陷于（某种情绪等）

examples.en: Flinging herself on the bed, she gave way to helpless misery.
examples.zh: 她一头扑倒在床上，痛苦不堪。

senses.def: to be replaced by something

examples.en: The storm gave way to bright sunshine.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后阳光灿烂。

examples.en: As he drew nearer, his anxiety gave way to relief.
examples.zh: 当他走近时，他的焦虑逐渐缓解。

senses.def: to have full sexual intercourse
to have known each other for a long time

examples.en: We go back a long way, he and I.
examples.zh: 我跟他，我们俩相识很久了。

senses.def: to last a long time

examples.en: She seems to make her money go a long way.
examples.zh: 看起来她用钱细水长流。

examples.en: A small amount of this paint goes a long way (= covers a large area).
examples.zh: 这种涂料用一点就可涂一大片。

examples.en: I find that a little of Jerry's company can go a long way (= I quickly get tired of being with him).
examples.zh: 我发觉跟杰里待上一会儿就受不了啦。

senses.def: to help very much/a little in achieving something
senses.zh: （对做某事）帮助很大／不大，作用很大／不大

examples.en: The new law goes a long way towards solving the problem.
examples.zh: 新的法律十分有助于解决这一问题。

senses.def: to make a special effort to do something

examples.en: He would always go out of his way to be friendly towards her.
examples.zh: 他总是特意向她表示友好。

examples.en: She went out of her way to help them.
examples.zh: 她不辞劳苦地帮助他们。

senses.def: to do as you choose, especially when somebody has advised you against it

examples.en: It's best to let her go her own way if you don't want a fight.
examples.zh: 你要不想吵架的话，最好是随她去好了。

examples.en: He's always gone his own way when it comes to design.
examples.zh: 在设计方面，他总是走他自己的路。

senses.def: to end a relationship with somebody

examples.en: When the business was sold they went their separate ways.
examples.zh: 公司被卖掉后，他们就分道扬镳了。

examples.en: They decided to go their separate ways after being together for five years.
examples.zh: 在一起 5 年之后，他们决定分手。

examples.en: When we finished school, we all went our separate ways.
examples.zh: 毕业之后，我们就都各奔东西。

senses.def: to go in a different direction from somebody you have been travelling with
to travel in the same direction as somebody

examples.en: I'm going your way—I'll walk with you.
examples.zh: 咱们同路，我和你一起走。

senses.def: to go well for you; to be in your favour

examples.en: By the third round he knew the fight was going his way.
examples.zh: 拳击打到第三回合，他知道形势对自己很有利。

senses.def: to die
by having an unpleasant experience or by making mistakes
senses.zh: 通过痛苦的经历；通过出错

examples.en: She won't listen to my advice so she'll just have to learn the hard way.
examples.zh: 她不肯听我的忠告，所以只好吃了苦头才知道厉害。

examples.en: He learned about the dangers of drugs the hard way.
examples.zh: 他吃了一番苦头后才懂得了毒品的危险。

senses.def: to have made a lot of progress
senses.zh: 取得大的进步；大有长进

examples.en: We've come a long way since the early days of the project.
examples.zh: 这项目开始以来我们已取得很大进展。

examples.en: The study of genes has come a long way in recent years.
examples.zh: 最近几年的基因研究取得了很大进展。

senses.def: to be a sensible person
to have or want to have the advantages of two different situations or ways of behaving that are impossible to combine

examples.en: You can't have it both ways. If you can afford to go out all the time, you can afford to pay off some of your debts.
examples.zh: 你不可能做到两全其美。如果你有钱整天外出玩乐，就能还掉一部分债。

senses.def: used to say in an angry way that although you are not happy about something that somebody has said, you are not going to argue

examples.en: Oh OK, then. Have it your own way!
examples.zh: 啊，那好吧。想要怎么样随便你！

senses.def: to have something arranged in the way that you want, even though other people want it to be arranged differently

examples.en: The German team weren't going to let the English have everything their own way.
examples.zh: 德国队不会让英格兰队按自己的方式行事。

senses.def: to need to make a lot of progress before you can achieve something
senses.zh: 还有很长的路要走；还有很大差距

examples.en: She still has a long way to go before she's fully fit.
examples.zh: 她还需要很长时间才能完全恢复健康。

senses.def: used to say that something often happens in a particular way, especially when it is out of your control
senses.zh: …是常有的事（尤指无法控制的事）

examples.en: First love affairs have a way of not working out.
examples.zh: 第一次恋爱常常不成功。

examples.en: Fate has a way of changing the best of plans.
examples.zh: 命运可以改变最完美的计划。

senses.def: to be good at dealing with somebody/something
senses.zh: 善于应付；善于处理；有办法对付

examples.en: He has a way with small children.
examples.zh: 他很会逗小孩。

examples.en: She has a way with words (= is very good at expressing herself).
examples.zh: 她善于辞令。

senses.def: to persuade somebody to have sex with you
used to explain what you would do if you had total control over something
senses.zh: 如果我说了算；如果我来掌控

examples.en: If I had my way, smoking would be banned completely.
examples.zh: 如果我说了算，就要完全禁烟。

senses.def: of any type

examples.en: I don't approve of violence in any shape or form.
examples.zh: 我不赞成任何形式的暴力行为。

examples.en: I can't stand insects in any shape or form.
examples.zh: 无论什么样的昆虫我都很害怕。

examples.en: I do not condone bullying in any way, shape or form.
examples.zh: 我不容忍任何方式、形式或形式的欺凌行为。

senses.def: on a large/small scale

examples.en: The new delivery service has taken off in a big way.
examples.zh: 新的递送服务迅速走红。

examples.en: Many people are investing in a small way in the stock market.
examples.zh: 许多人都在小量地向证券市场投资。

examples.en: He then started spending money in a big way.
examples.zh: 他那时开始大把地花钱。

senses.def: (to be/become) pregnant
used to show that a statement has more than one meaning
senses.zh: （所说的话）不止一个意思；在很多方面

examples.en: With the first goal he used his head in more ways than one.
examples.zh: 他进第一个球时从多方面动了脑筋。

senses.def: used to say what normally happens in a particular situation

examples.en: In the ordinary way, she's not a nervous person.
examples.zh: 一般而言，她不是个容易紧张的人。

senses.def: how and when you want to, even though this might annoy other people

examples.en: He always does the work, but in his own sweet time.
examples.zh: 工作他总是在做，但只在自己高兴的时候做。

examples.en: She just ignores all the criticism and continues in her own sweet way.
examples.zh: 她只是无视所有的批评，继续以她自己的甜蜜方式。

senses.def: to some extent; not completely
senses.zh: 在某种程度上；不完全地

examples.en: In a way it was one of our biggest mistakes.
examples.zh: 从某种意义上来说，这是我们所犯的最大错误之一。

senses.def: in a manner that is appropriate to or typical of a person or thing but that may seem unusual to other people

examples.en: I expect she does love you in her own way.
examples.zh: 我想她的确是以她特有的方式爱你。

examples.en: The building is very attractive in its own way.
examples.zh: 这座建筑以其自己的方式非常有吸引力。

examples.en: He was attractive in his own way.
examples.zh: 他有他的迷人之处。

senses.def: stopping somebody from moving or doing something

examples.en: You'll have to move—you're in my way.
examples.zh: 你得挪一挪，你挡了我的路。

examples.en: I left them alone, as I felt I was in the way.
examples.zh: 我留下他们单独在一起，因为我觉得我碍他们的事。

examples.en: There were several rocks in the way.
examples.zh: 有几块岩石挡住了路。

senses.def: used in questions and negative sentences to talk about the types of something that are available
senses.zh: （用于问句或否定句）关于，就…而言

examples.en: There isn't much in the way of entertainment in this place.
examples.zh: 这个地方没有多少娱乐活动。

senses.def: to avoid somebody

examples.en: Let's keep out of her way while she's in such a bad mood.
examples.zh: 她心情不好，我们不要打扰她。

senses.def: to be familiar with a place, subject, etc.
senses.zh: 熟悉周围情况（或话题等）

senses.def: to make a lot of money easily and feel very pleased about it
to get yourself into or out of a situation by lying
senses.zh: 由于撒谎而处于某种境地（或摆脱某种处境）

senses.def: to deliberately avoid seeing somebody/something

examples.en: Prison officers know what's going on, but look the other way.
examples.zh: 狱警知道出了什么事，但扭过头去装作没看见。

senses.def: to become lost

examples.en: We lost our way in the dark.
examples.zh: 我们在黑暗中迷了路。

examples.en: She lost her way in the fog.
examples.zh: 她在大雾中迷了路。

senses.def: to forget or move away from the purpose or reason for something

examples.en: I feel that the project has lost its way.
examples.zh: 我觉得这个项目已经背离了原来的意图。

examples.en: This project seems to have lost its way.
examples.zh: 这个项目似乎背离了原来的意图。

senses.def: to allow somebody/something to pass; to allow somebody/something to take the place of somebody/something
senses.zh: 让…通过；给…让路；让出位置

examples.en: Make way for the Lord Mayor!
examples.zh: 给市长大人让路！

examples.en: Tropical forest is felled to make way for grassland.
examples.zh: 热带森林被砍伐，腾出地方做草地。

senses.def: to move or get somewhere; to make progress

examples.en: Will you be able to make your own way to the airport (= get there without help, a ride, etc.)?
examples.zh: 你能自己去机场吗？

examples.en: Is this your plan for making your way in the world?
examples.zh: 这就是你要出人头地的计划吗？

senses.def: to stop behaving badly
(to take/find) an acceptable course of action that avoids two extreme positions
senses.zh: （走）中间道路；（取）中庸之道；（采取）折中办法

senses.def: used to show that you are certain about something

examples.en: It was the wrong decision—there are no two ways about it.
examples.zh: 这是错误的决定，毫无疑问。

senses.def: used to say that there is no possibility that you will do something or that something will happen
senses.zh: 不可能；决不；不行；没门儿

examples.en: ‘Do you want to help?’ ‘No way!’
examples.zh: “你想帮忙吗？”“没门儿！”

examples.en: No way am I going to drive them there.
examples.zh: 我无论如何都不会开车把他们送到那里去。

examples.en: There's no way we could afford that sort of money.
examples.zh: 我们无论如何都花不起那种钱。

senses.def: during the journey

examples.en: He stopped for breakfast on the way.
examples.zh: 他中途停下吃早点。

examples.en: She grabbed her camera and bag on her way out.
examples.zh: 她出门时一把抓起照相机和提包。

senses.def: going or coming
senses.zh: 即将去（或来）；就要去（或来）

examples.en: I'd better be on my way (= I must leave) soon.
examples.zh: 我最好还是快点儿走。

examples.en: The letter should be on its way to you.
examples.zh: 那封信该快到你那里了。

examples.en: Then he went off on his merry way.
examples.zh: 然后他执意离开了。

senses.def: not yet born

examples.en: They've got three kids and one on the way.
examples.zh: 他们有三个孩子，还有一个尚未出生。

senses.def: to make it possible for somebody to do something or for something to happen

examples.en: The agreement could open the way for the country to pay off its debts.
examples.zh: 这一协定使得该国有望还清债务。

senses.def: in the opposite position, direction or order

examples.en: I think it should go on the other way round.
examples.zh: 我想这应该以相反的方式继续下去。

senses.def: the opposite situation

examples.en: I didn't leave you. It was the other way round (= you left me).
examples.zh: 我没有离开你。是你离开了我。

senses.def: in a safe place where somebody/something cannot be hurt or injured or do any damage to somebody/something

examples.en: She put the knife in a drawer, out of harm’s way.
examples.zh: 为安全起见，她把刀放在抽屉里。

examples.en: I prefer the children to play in the garden where they’re out of harm’s way.
examples.zh: 我比较喜欢让孩子在花园里玩耍，因为那里安全。

senses.def: no longer stopping somebody from moving or doing something

examples.en: I moved my legs out of the way so that she could get past.
examples.zh: 我挪开腿让她过去。

examples.en: I didn't say anything until Dad was out of the way.
examples.zh: 我直到爸爸不再打扰之后才说话。

senses.def: finished; dealt with

examples.en: Our region is poised for growth once the election is out of the way.
examples.zh: 大选一结束，我们地区就准备大展拳脚。

senses.def: used in negative sentences to mean ‘unusual’
senses.zh: （用于否定句）奇特的，不寻常的，罕见的

examples.en: She had obviously noticed nothing out of the way.
examples.zh: 她显然没发现异常情况。

senses.def: not on the route that you planned to take

examples.en: I'd love a ride home—if it's not out of your way.
examples.zh: 我很想搭你的车回家，如果这不叫你绕路的话。

senses.def: a point at which two people or groups of people decide to separate
senses.zh: 岔路口；分道扬镳处；分手处

examples.en: These events led to a final parting of the ways.
examples.zh: 这些事件导致了最终的分道扬镳。

senses.def: to create a situation in which somebody will be able to do something or something can happen

examples.en: This decision paved the way for changes in employment rights for women.
examples.zh: 这项决议为修改妇女就业权利创造了条件。

senses.def: to make enough money to pay what it costs to keep it going
senses.zh: 赢利运作；不负债；收支平衡

examples.en: The bridge is still not paying its way.
examples.zh: 这座桥现在还入不敷出。

senses.def: to pay for everything yourself without having to rely on anyone else’s money
senses.zh: 独立偿付一切；自食其力

senses.def: to walk carefully, choosing the safest, driest, etc. place to put your feet
senses.zh: 择路而行；小心看着路行走

examples.en: She picked her way delicately over the rough ground.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼地在高低不平的地面上行走。

examples.en: We picked our way carefully over the jagged rocks.
examples.zh: 我们在犬牙交错的岩石中小心翼翼地前行。

senses.def: to make somebody annoyed or angry, often without intending to, by doing or saying something that offends them

examples.en: She tends to rub people up the wrong way.
examples.zh: 她常常以错误的方式惹恼别人。

senses.def: to realize or admit that you have done something wrong and decide to change your behaviour
senses.zh: 知过即改；承认自己的做法不对并决心改正

examples.en: Will they realize the error of their ways before it is too late?
examples.zh: 他们能及时意识到自己在方式方法上的错误吗？

senses.def: to find that it is possible or convenient to do something
senses.zh: 觉得有可能做某事；认为便于做某事

examples.en: Small builders cannot see their way clear to take on many trainees.
examples.zh: 小建筑商认为不可能招收很多见习生。

senses.def: to get an idea of what is likely to happen before deciding what to do
to do something first so that other people can follow
to make it easier for somebody/something to develop or make progress

examples.en: These negotiations are intended to smooth the path to a peace treaty.
examples.zh: 这些谈判目的在于为签订和平条约铺平道路。

examples.en: We’re trying to smooth the way for women who want to resume their careers.
examples.zh: 我们正在努力为想要恢复职业生涯的女性铺平道路。

senses.def: to (not) prevent somebody from doing something

examples.en: If you believe you can make her happy, I won't stand in your way.
examples.zh: 如果你相信你能使她幸福，我不会妨碍你的。

examples.en: He wanted to go to college and would let nothing stand in his way.
examples.zh: 他想上大学，不会让任何事情阻碍他的。

senses.def: to be bisexual
senses.zh: 双性恋；既喜欢异性也喜欢同性

senses.def: to end a difficult situation by choosing the simplest solution even if it is not the best one
senses.zh: 以最简单的方法解决难题；快刀斩乱麻

examples.en: He took the easy way out and didn’t go to the meeting.
examples.zh: 他想走捷径，没有去参加会议。

examples.en: She took the easy way out and paid someone to write the article for her.
examples.zh: 她采取了简单的方法，花钱请人为她写这篇文章。

senses.def: to be offended by a remark that was not intended to be offensive

examples.en: Don't take this the wrong way, but maybe you're trying a bit too hard.
examples.zh: 不要误解这一点，但也许你有点太努力了。

senses.def: to make excuses and give reasons for not doing something; to manage to get yourself out of a difficult situation
senses.zh: 靠能言善辩开脱；以话解围

examples.en: I managed to talk my way out of having to give a speech.
examples.zh: 我好说歹说总算逃脱了发言的差事。

senses.def: that is the situation and we cannot change it, so we must accept it
senses.zh: 情况就是这样；没有别的办法

senses.def: there are many different ways to achieve something
senses.zh: （要做成某事）方法不止一个，有的是办法

senses.def: in my opinion
senses.zh: 我认为；依我看；依我之见

senses.def: having started

examples.en: Preparations are well under way for a week of special events in May.
examples.zh: 五月份特别活动周的准备工作已经顺利开展。

senses.def: a plan of action that is likely to be successful
senses.zh: 成功的途径；正确的方案

examples.en: Personal electronic health records are the way forward for effective healthcare in the future.
examples.zh: 个人电子病历是未来有效医疗服务的发展途径。

senses.def: something that allows you to join a group of people, an industry, etc. that it is difficult to join, or to understand something that it is difficult to understand
senses.zh: （加入难以进入的群体、行业等的）敲门砖；（弄懂难以理解的事物的）窍门，诀窍

senses.def: the typical pattern of behaviour of a person or group
senses.zh: （个人或群体的）特有的行为模式，典型生活方式

examples.en: the American way of life
examples.zh: 美国人的生活方式

examples.en: She loved the Spanish way of life and immediately felt at home there.
examples.zh: 她喜欢西班牙的生活，一到那里就觉得舒适自在。

examples.en: the beliefs and practices of the Hindu way of life
examples.zh: 印度教生活方式的信仰与实践

senses.def: the way that most people behave; the way that things happen, which you cannot change
senses.zh: 大多数人的行为模式；世道；事情发生的规律

examples.en: The rich and powerful make the decisions—that's the way of the world.
examples.zh: 有钱有势者说了算，这就是世道。

senses.def: used to say that somebody else has either to agree with your opinion or to leave
the methods and materials available for doing something
senses.zh: （做某事现有的）方法和资源，手段和财力

examples.en: ways and means of raising money
examples.zh: 筹资办法

examples.en: Newspapers have ways and means of getting hold of secret information.
examples.zh: 报纸总有办法搞到秘密消息。

senses.def: used to tell somebody that you are pleased about something they have done

examples.en: Good work, guys! Way to go!
examples.zh: 伙计们，活儿不错！干得好！

examples.en: Way to go! I wish I could do that!
examples.zh: 太棒了！真希望我也能做到！

senses.def: the way to make somebody like or love you
senses.zh: 赢得某人喜爱的办法；攻心策

examples.en: The way to a man's heart is through his stomach (= by giving him good food).
examples.zh: 取得男人欢心的方法就是让他吃好。

senses.def: if you really want to do something then you will find a way of doing it
a series of victories or successes
senses.zh: 一系列胜利（或成功）；连胜；连赢

examples.en: He'll look to continue his winning ways with a victory in Mexico on 16 February.
examples.zh: 他希望 2 月 16 日在墨西哥获胜，延续他的连胜脚步。

senses.def: to do something from beginning to end, especially when it takes a lot of time or effort
senses.zh: 自始至终做（尤指耗费时间或力量的事）

examples.en: She worked her way through the pile of documents.
examples.zh: 她从头至尾处理了那一堆文件。

senses.def: to have a job or series of jobs while studying, travelling, etc. in order to pay for your education, etc.
senses.zh: 勤工俭学；半工半读；边挣钱边周游世界

senses.def: to move regularly to a more senior position in a company
senses.zh: 逐步升职；按部就班晋升

examples.en: He worked his way up from messenger boy to account executive.
examples.zh: 他从送信员一步一步晋升为客户经理。

senses.def: very far; by a large amount

examples.en: She finished the race way ahead of the other runners.
examples.zh: 她遥遥领先于其他选手跑到终点。

examples.en: children who are way behind in reading skills
examples.zh: 在阅读技巧方面远远落后的孩子们

examples.en: I must be going home; it's way past my bedtime.
examples.zh: 我得回家了，早过了我的就寝时间了。

examples.en: The price is way above what we can afford.
examples.zh: 这价格大大超过了我们的支付能力。

examples.en: They live way out in the suburbs.
examples.zh: 他们住在很偏远的郊区。

examples.en: I guessed that there would be a hundred people there, but I was way out (= wrong by a large amount).
examples.zh: 我估计那里会有一百人，但是我大错特错了。

examples.en: This skirt is way too short.
examples.zh: 这条裙子太短了。

examples.en: The project is going way beyond our expectations.
examples.zh: 该项目的进展远远超出了我们的预期。

senses.def: very

examples.en: Things just got way difficult.
examples.zh: 事情变得太困难了。

examples.en: I'm way glad to hear that.
examples.zh: 听到这个消息，我太高兴了。

senses.def: a long time ago

examples.en: I first met him way back in the 80s.
examples.zh: 我和他初次见面早在 80 年代。

examples.en: Way back, when he was a boy, he had lived on a farm in Wales.
examples.zh: 很久以前，当他还是个孩子的时候，他住在威尔士的一个农场里。

senses.def: on the other side of the street, etc.

examples.en: Music blared from the open window of the house across the way.
examples.zh: 从街对面那栋房子开着的窗户里传出嘈杂的音乐声。

senses.def: during the whole journey/period of time

examples.en: She didn't speak a word to me all the way back home.
examples.zh: 回家的一路上，她没对我说过一句话。

examples.en: the whole way to Arizona
examples.zh: 去亚利桑那州的一路上

examples.en: This bus doesn't go all the way so you'll have to change.
examples.zh: 这趟公交车是区间车，所以你必须换乘。

examples.en: I watched the movie the whole way through.
examples.zh: 我从头至尾看了这部电影。

senses.def: completely; as much as it takes to achieve what you want

examples.en: I'm fighting him all the way.
examples.zh: 我在全力和他对抗。

examples.en: You can feel that the audience is with her all the way.
examples.zh: 你可以感觉到听众完全支持她。

senses.def: as you make progress with something
senses.zh: 随着进展；某事进行的同时

examples.en: You'll learn something along the way.
examples.zh: 一路下来你会学到东西的。

senses.def: used to say that things often happen in a particular way, especially when it is not convenient
senses.zh: （表示经常如此，尤指不方便）总是这样，老是

senses.def: however you choose to look at a situation
to behave or do things in a particular manner because it is part of your character

examples.en: It's not his fault he's so pompous—he was born that way.
examples.zh: 他如此自命不凡并不是他的错，他天生就是这种性格。

items.idm: be (all) downhill | be downhill all the way

senses.def: to be easy compared with what came before

examples.en: It's all downhill from here. We'll soon be finished.
examples.zh: 从这以后就容易了。我们很快就会结束。

senses.def: to become worse or less successful
senses.zh: 每况愈下；走下坡路；不断恶化

examples.en: It's been all downhill for his career since then, with four defeats in five games.
examples.zh: 从那时起他的战绩便江河日下，五场比赛输掉了四场。

examples.en: I started work as a journalist and it was downhill all the way for my health.
examples.zh: 我开始当记者后，身体每况愈下。

items.idm: be downhill all the way | be (all) downhill

senses.def: to be easy compared with what came before

examples.en: It's downhill all the way from here. We'll soon be finished.
examples.zh: 从这里开始一路都是下坡路。我们很快就会完成。

senses.def: to become worse or less successful
senses.zh: 每况愈下；走下坡路；不断恶化

examples.en: I started work as a journalist and it was downhill all the way for my health.
examples.zh: 我开始当记者后，身体每况愈下。

examples.en: It's been all downhill for his career since then, with four defeats in five games.
examples.zh: 从那时起他的战绩便江河日下，五场比赛输掉了四场。

senses.def: to have habits or opinions that you have had for a long time and that you do not want to change
senses.zh: 积习难改；禀性难移；执拗

examples.en: Grandma is so set in her ways.
examples.zh: 奶奶的行事方式就是这样一成不变。

items.idm: be well on the way to something/doing something

senses.def: to have nearly achieved something and be going to achieve it soon

examples.en: She is well on the way to recovery.
examples.zh: 她就要康复了。

examples.en: He is well on the way to establishing himself among the top ten players in the world.
examples.zh: 他很快就会成为排名世界前十位的选手。

senses.def: by a great amount

examples.en: He was the best by a long way.
examples.zh: 很长一段时间以来他都是最好的。

senses.def: used to introduce a comment or question that is not directly related to what you have been talking about
senses.zh: 顺便提一下；捎带说一声；附带问一句

examples.en: By the way, I found that book you were looking for.
examples.zh: 顺便提一下，我找到了你在寻找的那本书。

examples.en: What's the time, by the way?
examples.zh: 顺便问一句，几点钟了？

examples.en: Oh by the way, if you see Jackie, tell her I'll call her this evening.
examples.zh: 啊，对了，你要是看到杰基，告诉她我今晚给她打电话。

senses.def: by a route that includes the place mentioned

examples.en: The artist recently arrived in Paris from Bulgaria by way of Vienna.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家最近从保加利亚途经维也纳到了巴黎。

examples.en: She came to TV by way of drama school.
examples.zh: 她是念过戏剧学校后到电视台的。

items.idm: by way of/in the way of something

senses.def: as a form of something; for something; as a means of something
senses.zh: 作为…的形式；为了；作为…的手段

examples.en: He received £600 by way of compensation from the company.
examples.zh: 他得到那家公司 600 英镑的赔偿。

examples.en: She rolled her eyes by way of an answer and left.
examples.zh: 她转动了一下眼睛作为回答就走了。

senses.def: to start to live or behave in a different way from before
senses.zh: 开始过另一种生活；换个活法

examples.en: He was in trouble with the police as a teenager but now he’s completely changed his ways.
examples.zh: 青少年时期他曾与警察发生过麻烦，但现在他完全改变了自己的生活方式。

examples.en: Your father is unlikely to change his ways now.
examples.zh: 你父亲现在不大可能改变生活方式了。

items.idm: claw your way back, into something, out of something, to something, etc.

senses.def: to gradually achieve something or move somewhere by being determined and using a lot of effort
senses.zh: 努力逐步获得；艰难地移动

examples.en: She clawed her way to the top of her profession.
examples.zh: 她努力不懈，终于爬到了职业的顶峰。

examples.en: Slowly, he clawed his way out from under the collapsed building.
examples.zh: 他艰难地从倒塌的大楼废墟底下慢慢爬了出来。

items.idm: clear the way (for something/for something to happen)

senses.def: to remove things that are stopping the progress or movement of something

examples.en: The ruling could clear the way for extradition proceedings.
examples.zh: 这项裁决也许能为引渡程序铺平道路。

senses.def: to happen to you by chance, or when you were not expecting it
senses.zh: 意外落在…头上；偶尔发生在…身上

examples.en: He took the first job that came his way.
examples.zh: 他选择了他遇到的第一份工作。

examples.en: Have any interesting articles come your way recently?
examples.zh: 你最近读到什么有意思的文章了吗？

senses.def: to have two opposite effects or results
senses.zh: 两面都行得通（或说得通）；有利也有弊

items.idm: either way | one way or the other

senses.def: used to say that it does not matter which one of two possibilities happens, is chosen or is true

examples.en: Was it his fault or not? Either way, an explanation is due.
examples.zh: 是他的错或不是？无论是不是，都得有个解释。

examples.en: We could meet today or tomorrow—I don't mind one way or the other.
examples.zh: 我们可以在今天或明天见面，哪一天对我都行。

senses.def: in all directions

examples.en: Her hair tumbled every which way.
examples.zh: 她的头发乱得像鸡窝。

senses.def: to move along carefully, for example when it is dark, by touching walls, objects, etc.
to be careful about how you do things, usually because you are in a situation that you are not familiar with

examples.en: She was new in the job, still feeling her way.
examples.zh: 她对这项工作不熟悉，还在摸索着干。

senses.def: to discover the right route (to a place)

examples.en: I hope you can find your way home.
examples.zh: 希望你能找到回家的路。

senses.def: to come to a place or a situation by chance or without intending to

examples.en: He eventually found his way into acting.
examples.zh: 他弄到最后竟干起了演艺这一行。

items.idm: get into/out of the way of (doing) something

senses.def: to become used to doing something/to lose the habit of doing something

examples.en: The women had got into the way of going up on the deck every evening.
examples.zh: 这些女人养成了每天晚上到平台去的习惯。

senses.def: to prevent somebody from doing something; to prevent something from happening

examples.en: He wouldn't allow emotions to get in the way of him doing his job.
examples.zh: 他不会让感情妨碍自己的工作。

senses.def: to get or do what you want, especially when somebody has tried to stop you

examples.en: She always gets her own way in the end.
examples.zh: 到最后总是她说了算。

senses.def: to break or fall down

examples.en: The pillars gave way and a section of the roof collapsed.
examples.zh: 这些立柱坍塌了，一部分屋顶坠落下来。

examples.en: Her numb leg gave way beneath her and she stumbled clumsily.
examples.zh: 她那麻木了的腿一软，她便重重地摔了一跤。

senses.def: to stop resisting somebody/something; to agree to do something that you do not want to do

examples.en: He refused to give way on any of the points.
examples.zh: 他拒绝在任何一点上让步。

senses.def: to allow somebody/something to be or go first

examples.en: Give way to traffic already on the roundabout.
examples.zh: 让已上环状交叉路的车辆先行。

senses.def: to allow yourself to be very strongly affected by something, especially an emotion
senses.zh: 让自己陷于（某种情绪等）

examples.en: Flinging herself on the bed, she gave way to helpless misery.
examples.zh: 她一头扑倒在床上，痛苦不堪。

senses.def: to be replaced by something

examples.en: The storm gave way to bright sunshine.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后阳光灿烂。

examples.en: As he drew nearer, his anxiety gave way to relief.
examples.zh: 当他走近时，他的焦虑逐渐缓解。

senses.def: to have full sexual intercourse
to have known each other for a long time

examples.en: We go back a long way, he and I.
examples.zh: 我跟他，我们俩相识很久了。

senses.def: to last a long time

examples.en: She seems to make her money go a long way.
examples.zh: 看起来她用钱细水长流。

examples.en: A small amount of this paint goes a long way (= covers a large area).
examples.zh: 这种涂料用一点就可涂一大片。

examples.en: I find that a little of Jerry's company can go a long way (= I quickly get tired of being with him).
examples.zh: 我发觉跟杰里待上一会儿就受不了啦。

items.idm: go a long/some way towards doing something

senses.def: to help very much/a little in achieving something
senses.zh: （对做某事）帮助很大／不大，作用很大／不大

examples.en: The new law goes a long way towards solving the problem.
examples.zh: 新的法律十分有助于解决这一问题。

items.idm: go out of your way (to do something)

senses.def: to make a special effort to do something

examples.en: He would always go out of his way to be friendly towards her.
examples.zh: 他总是特意向她表示友好。

examples.en: She went out of her way to help them.
examples.zh: 她不辞劳苦地帮助他们。

senses.def: to do as you choose, especially when somebody has advised you against it

examples.en: It's best to let her go her own way if you don't want a fight.
examples.zh: 你要不想吵架的话，最好是随她去好了。

examples.en: He's always gone his own way when it comes to design.
examples.zh: 在设计方面，他总是走他自己的路。

senses.def: to end a relationship with somebody

examples.en: When the business was sold they went their separate ways.
examples.zh: 公司被卖掉后，他们就分道扬镳了。

examples.en: They decided to go their separate ways after being together for five years.
examples.zh: 在一起 5 年之后，他们决定分手。

examples.en: When we finished school, we all went our separate ways.
examples.zh: 毕业之后，我们就都各奔东西。

senses.def: to go in a different direction from somebody you have been travelling with
to travel in the same direction as somebody

examples.en: I'm going your way—I'll walk with you.
examples.zh: 咱们同路，我和你一起走。

senses.def: to go well for you; to be in your favour

examples.en: By the third round he knew the fight was going his way.
examples.zh: 拳击打到第三回合，他知道形势对自己很有利。

items.idm: go the way of all flesh

senses.def: to die
by having an unpleasant experience or by making mistakes
senses.zh: 通过痛苦的经历；通过出错

examples.en: She won't listen to my advice so she'll just have to learn the hard way.
examples.zh: 她不肯听我的忠告，所以只好吃了苦头才知道厉害。

examples.en: He learned about the dangers of drugs the hard way.
examples.zh: 他吃了一番苦头后才懂得了毒品的危险。

senses.def: to have made a lot of progress
senses.zh: 取得大的进步；大有长进

examples.en: We've come a long way since the early days of the project.
examples.zh: 这项目开始以来我们已取得很大进展。

examples.en: The study of genes has come a long way in recent years.
examples.zh: 最近几年的基因研究取得了很大进展。

items.idm: have your head screwed on (the right way)

senses.def: to be a sensible person
to have or want to have the advantages of two different situations or ways of behaving that are impossible to combine

examples.en: You can't have it both ways. If you can afford to go out all the time, you can afford to pay off some of your debts.
examples.zh: 你不可能做到两全其美。如果你有钱整天外出玩乐，就能还掉一部分债。

senses.def: used to say in an angry way that although you are not happy about something that somebody has said, you are not going to argue

examples.en: Oh OK, then. Have it your own way!
examples.zh: 啊，那好吧。想要怎么样随便你！

senses.def: to have something arranged in the way that you want, even though other people want it to be arranged differently

examples.en: The German team weren't going to let the English have everything their own way.
examples.zh: 德国队不会让英格兰队按自己的方式行事。

items.idm: have a long way to go

senses.def: to need to make a lot of progress before you can achieve something
senses.zh: 还有很长的路要走；还有很大差距

examples.en: She still has a long way to go before she's fully fit.
examples.zh: 她还需要很长时间才能完全恢复健康。

items.idm: have a way of doing something

senses.def: used to say that something often happens in a particular way, especially when it is out of your control
senses.zh: …是常有的事（尤指无法控制的事）

examples.en: First love affairs have a way of not working out.
examples.zh: 第一次恋爱常常不成功。

examples.en: Fate has a way of changing the best of plans.
examples.zh: 命运可以改变最完美的计划。

senses.def: to be good at dealing with somebody/something
senses.zh: 善于应付；善于处理；有办法对付

examples.en: He has a way with small children.
examples.zh: 他很会逗小孩。

examples.en: She has a way with words (= is very good at expressing herself).
examples.zh: 她善于辞令。

senses.def: to persuade somebody to have sex with you
used to explain what you would do if you had total control over something
senses.zh: 如果我说了算；如果我来掌控

examples.en: If I had my way, smoking would be banned completely.
examples.zh: 如果我说了算，就要完全禁烟。

items.idm: in any (way,) shape or form

senses.def: of any type

examples.en: I don't approve of violence in any shape or form.
examples.zh: 我不赞成任何形式的暴力行为。

examples.en: I can't stand insects in any shape or form.
examples.zh: 无论什么样的昆虫我都很害怕。

examples.en: I do not condone bullying in any way, shape or form.
examples.zh: 我不容忍任何方式、形式或形式的欺凌行为。

senses.def: on a large/small scale

examples.en: The new delivery service has taken off in a big way.
examples.zh: 新的递送服务迅速走红。

examples.en: Many people are investing in a small way in the stock market.
examples.zh: 许多人都在小量地向证券市场投资。

examples.en: He then started spending money in a big way.
examples.zh: 他那时开始大把地花钱。

senses.def: (to be/become) pregnant
used to show that a statement has more than one meaning
senses.zh: （所说的话）不止一个意思；在很多方面

examples.en: With the first goal he used his head in more ways than one.
examples.zh: 他进第一个球时从多方面动了脑筋。

senses.def: used to say what normally happens in a particular situation

examples.en: In the ordinary way, she's not a nervous person.
examples.zh: 一般而言，她不是个容易紧张的人。

items.idm: in your own sweet time/way

senses.def: how and when you want to, even though this might annoy other people

examples.en: He always does the work, but in his own sweet time.
examples.zh: 工作他总是在做，但只在自己高兴的时候做。

examples.en: She just ignores all the criticism and continues in her own sweet way.
examples.zh: 她只是无视所有的批评，继续以她自己的甜蜜方式。

items.idm: in a way | in one way | in some ways

senses.def: to some extent; not completely
senses.zh: 在某种程度上；不完全地

examples.en: In a way it was one of our biggest mistakes.
examples.zh: 从某种意义上来说，这是我们所犯的最大错误之一。

items.idm: in her, his, its, etc. (own) way

senses.def: in a manner that is appropriate to or typical of a person or thing but that may seem unusual to other people

examples.en: I expect she does love you in her own way.
examples.zh: 我想她的确是以她特有的方式爱你。

examples.en: The building is very attractive in its own way.
examples.zh: 这座建筑以其自己的方式非常有吸引力。

examples.en: He was attractive in his own way.
examples.zh: 他有他的迷人之处。

senses.def: stopping somebody from moving or doing something

examples.en: You'll have to move—you're in my way.
examples.zh: 你得挪一挪，你挡了我的路。

examples.en: I left them alone, as I felt I was in the way.
examples.zh: 我留下他们单独在一起，因为我觉得我碍他们的事。

examples.en: There were several rocks in the way.
examples.zh: 有几块岩石挡住了路。

senses.def: used in questions and negative sentences to talk about the types of something that are available
senses.zh: （用于问句或否定句）关于，就…而言

examples.en: There isn't much in the way of entertainment in this place.
examples.zh: 这个地方没有多少娱乐活动。

senses.def: to avoid somebody

examples.en: Let's keep out of her way while she's in such a bad mood.
examples.zh: 她心情不好，我们不要打扰她。

senses.def: to be familiar with a place, subject, etc.
senses.zh: 熟悉周围情况（或话题等）

items.idm: laugh all the way to the bank

senses.def: to make a lot of money easily and feel very pleased about it

items.idm: lie your way into/out of something

senses.def: to get yourself into or out of a situation by lying
senses.zh: 由于撒谎而处于某种境地（或摆脱某种处境）

senses.def: to deliberately avoid seeing somebody/something

examples.en: Prison officers know what's going on, but look the other way.
examples.zh: 狱警知道出了什么事，但扭过头去装作没看见。

senses.def: to become lost

examples.en: We lost our way in the dark.
examples.zh: 我们在黑暗中迷了路。

examples.en: She lost her way in the fog.
examples.zh: 她在大雾中迷了路。

senses.def: to forget or move away from the purpose or reason for something

examples.en: I feel that the project has lost its way.
examples.zh: 我觉得这个项目已经背离了原来的意图。

examples.en: This project seems to have lost its way.
examples.zh: 这个项目似乎背离了原来的意图。

senses.def: to allow somebody/something to pass; to allow somebody/something to take the place of somebody/something
senses.zh: 让…通过；给…让路；让出位置

examples.en: Make way for the Lord Mayor!
examples.zh: 给市长大人让路！

examples.en: Tropical forest is felled to make way for grassland.
examples.zh: 热带森林被砍伐，腾出地方做草地。

senses.def: to move or get somewhere; to make progress

examples.en: Will you be able to make your own way to the airport (= get there without help, a ride, etc.)?
examples.zh: 你能自己去机场吗？

examples.en: Is this your plan for making your way in the world?
examples.zh: 这就是你要出人头地的计划吗？

senses.def: to stop behaving badly

items.idm: (steer, take, etc.) a middle course | (find, etc.) a/the middle way

senses.def: (to take/find) an acceptable course of action that avoids two extreme positions
senses.zh: （走）中间道路；（取）中庸之道；（采取）折中办法

items.idm: (there are) no two ways about it

senses.def: used to show that you are certain about something

examples.en: It was the wrong decision—there are no two ways about it.
examples.zh: 这是错误的决定，毫无疑问。

senses.def: used to say that there is no possibility that you will do something or that something will happen
senses.zh: 不可能；决不；不行；没门儿

examples.en: ‘Do you want to help?’ ‘No way!’
examples.zh: “你想帮忙吗？”“没门儿！”

examples.en: No way am I going to drive them there.
examples.zh: 我无论如何都不会开车把他们送到那里去。

examples.en: There's no way we could afford that sort of money.
examples.zh: 我们无论如何都花不起那种钱。

senses.def: during the journey

examples.en: He stopped for breakfast on the way.
examples.zh: 他中途停下吃早点。

examples.en: She grabbed her camera and bag on her way out.
examples.zh: 她出门时一把抓起照相机和提包。

senses.def: going or coming
senses.zh: 即将去（或来）；就要去（或来）

examples.en: I'd better be on my way (= I must leave) soon.
examples.zh: 我最好还是快点儿走。

examples.en: The letter should be on its way to you.
examples.zh: 那封信该快到你那里了。

examples.en: Then he went off on his merry way.
examples.zh: 然后他执意离开了。

senses.def: not yet born

examples.en: They've got three kids and one on the way.
examples.zh: 他们有三个孩子，还有一个尚未出生。

items.idm: open the way for somebody/something (to do something)

senses.def: to make it possible for somebody to do something or for something to happen

examples.en: The agreement could open the way for the country to pay off its debts.
examples.zh: 这一协定使得该国有望还清债务。

senses.def: in the opposite position, direction or order

examples.en: I think it should go on the other way round.
examples.zh: 我想这应该以相反的方式继续下去。

senses.def: the opposite situation

examples.en: I didn't leave you. It was the other way round (= you left me).
examples.zh: 我没有离开你。是你离开了我。

senses.def: in a safe place where somebody/something cannot be hurt or injured or do any damage to somebody/something

examples.en: She put the knife in a drawer, out of harm’s way.
examples.zh: 为安全起见，她把刀放在抽屉里。

examples.en: I prefer the children to play in the garden where they’re out of harm’s way.
examples.zh: 我比较喜欢让孩子在花园里玩耍，因为那里安全。

senses.def: no longer stopping somebody from moving or doing something

examples.en: I moved my legs out of the way so that she could get past.
examples.zh: 我挪开腿让她过去。

examples.en: I didn't say anything until Dad was out of the way.
examples.zh: 我直到爸爸不再打扰之后才说话。

senses.def: finished; dealt with

examples.en: Our region is poised for growth once the election is out of the way.
examples.zh: 大选一结束，我们地区就准备大展拳脚。

senses.def: used in negative sentences to mean ‘unusual’
senses.zh: （用于否定句）奇特的，不寻常的，罕见的

examples.en: She had obviously noticed nothing out of the way.
examples.zh: 她显然没发现异常情况。

senses.def: not on the route that you planned to take

examples.en: I'd love a ride home—if it's not out of your way.
examples.zh: 我很想搭你的车回家，如果这不叫你绕路的话。

senses.def: a point at which two people or groups of people decide to separate
senses.zh: 岔路口；分道扬镳处；分手处

examples.en: These events led to a final parting of the ways.
examples.zh: 这些事件导致了最终的分道扬镳。

senses.def: to create a situation in which somebody will be able to do something or something can happen

examples.en: This decision paved the way for changes in employment rights for women.
examples.zh: 这项决议为修改妇女就业权利创造了条件。

senses.def: to make enough money to pay what it costs to keep it going
senses.zh: 赢利运作；不负债；收支平衡

examples.en: The bridge is still not paying its way.
examples.zh: 这座桥现在还入不敷出。

senses.def: to pay for everything yourself without having to rely on anyone else’s money
senses.zh: 独立偿付一切；自食其力

items.idm: pick your way (across, along, among, over, through something)

senses.def: to walk carefully, choosing the safest, driest, etc. place to put your feet
senses.zh: 择路而行；小心看着路行走

examples.en: She picked her way delicately over the rough ground.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼地在高低不平的地面上行走。

examples.en: We picked our way carefully over the jagged rocks.
examples.zh: 我们在犬牙交错的岩石中小心翼翼地前行。

items.idm: rub somebody up the wrong way

senses.def: to make somebody annoyed or angry, often without intending to, by doing or saying something that offends them

examples.en: She tends to rub people up the wrong way.
examples.zh: 她常常以错误的方式惹恼别人。

items.idm: see, realize, etc. the error of your ways

senses.def: to realize or admit that you have done something wrong and decide to change your behaviour
senses.zh: 知过即改；承认自己的做法不对并决心改正

examples.en: Will they realize the error of their ways before it is too late?
examples.zh: 他们能及时意识到自己在方式方法上的错误吗？

items.idm: see your way (clear) to doing something/to do something

senses.def: to find that it is possible or convenient to do something
senses.zh: 觉得有可能做某事；认为便于做某事

examples.en: Small builders cannot see their way clear to take on many trainees.
examples.zh: 小建筑商认为不可能招收很多见习生。

items.idm: see which way the wind is blowing

senses.def: to get an idea of what is likely to happen before deciding what to do
to do something first so that other people can follow
to make it easier for somebody/something to develop or make progress

examples.en: These negotiations are intended to smooth the path to a peace treaty.
examples.zh: 这些谈判目的在于为签订和平条约铺平道路。

examples.en: We’re trying to smooth the way for women who want to resume their careers.
examples.zh: 我们正在努力为想要恢复职业生涯的女性铺平道路。

senses.def: to (not) prevent somebody from doing something

examples.en: If you believe you can make her happy, I won't stand in your way.
examples.zh: 如果你相信你能使她幸福，我不会妨碍你的。

examples.en: He wanted to go to college and would let nothing stand in his way.
examples.zh: 他想上大学，不会让任何事情阻碍他的。

senses.def: to be bisexual
senses.zh: 双性恋；既喜欢异性也喜欢同性

senses.def: to end a difficult situation by choosing the simplest solution even if it is not the best one
senses.zh: 以最简单的方法解决难题；快刀斩乱麻

examples.en: He took the easy way out and didn’t go to the meeting.
examples.zh: 他想走捷径，没有去参加会议。

examples.en: She took the easy way out and paid someone to write the article for her.
examples.zh: 她采取了简单的方法，花钱请人为她写这篇文章。

senses.def: to be offended by a remark that was not intended to be offensive

examples.en: Don't take this the wrong way, but maybe you're trying a bit too hard.
examples.zh: 不要误解这一点，但也许你有点太努力了。

items.idm: talk your way out of something/of doing something

senses.def: to make excuses and give reasons for not doing something; to manage to get yourself out of a difficult situation
senses.zh: 靠能言善辩开脱；以话解围

examples.en: I managed to talk my way out of having to give a speech.
examples.zh: 我好说歹说总算逃脱了发言的差事。

items.idm: that’s the way the cookie crumbles

senses.def: that is the situation and we cannot change it, so we must accept it
senses.zh: 情况就是这样；没有别的办法

items.idm: there’s more than one way to skin a cat

senses.def: there are many different ways to achieve something
senses.zh: （要做成某事）方法不止一个，有的是办法

senses.def: in my opinion
senses.zh: 我认为；依我看；依我之见

senses.def: having started

examples.en: Preparations are well under way for a week of special events in May.
examples.zh: 五月份特别活动周的准备工作已经顺利开展。

senses.def: a plan of action that is likely to be successful
senses.zh: 成功的途径；正确的方案

examples.en: Personal electronic health records are the way forward for effective healthcare in the future.
examples.zh: 个人电子病历是未来有效医疗服务的发展途径。

senses.def: something that allows you to join a group of people, an industry, etc. that it is difficult to join, or to understand something that it is difficult to understand
senses.zh: （加入难以进入的群体、行业等的）敲门砖；（弄懂难以理解的事物的）窍门，诀窍

senses.def: the typical pattern of behaviour of a person or group
senses.zh: （个人或群体的）特有的行为模式，典型生活方式

examples.en: the American way of life
examples.zh: 美国人的生活方式

examples.en: She loved the Spanish way of life and immediately felt at home there.
examples.zh: 她喜欢西班牙的生活，一到那里就觉得舒适自在。

examples.en: the beliefs and practices of the Hindu way of life
examples.zh: 印度教生活方式的信仰与实践

senses.def: the way that most people behave; the way that things happen, which you cannot change
senses.zh: 大多数人的行为模式；世道；事情发生的规律

examples.en: The rich and powerful make the decisions—that's the way of the world.
examples.zh: 有钱有势者说了算，这就是世道。

senses.def: used to say that somebody else has either to agree with your opinion or to leave
the methods and materials available for doing something
senses.zh: （做某事现有的）方法和资源，手段和财力

examples.en: ways and means of raising money
examples.zh: 筹资办法

examples.en: Newspapers have ways and means of getting hold of secret information.
examples.zh: 报纸总有办法搞到秘密消息。

senses.def: used to tell somebody that you are pleased about something they have done

examples.en: Good work, guys! Way to go!
examples.zh: 伙计们，活儿不错！干得好！

examples.en: Way to go! I wish I could do that!
examples.zh: 太棒了！真希望我也能做到！

senses.def: the way to make somebody like or love you
senses.zh: 赢得某人喜爱的办法；攻心策

examples.en: The way to a man's heart is through his stomach (= by giving him good food).
examples.zh: 取得男人欢心的方法就是让他吃好。

items.idm: where there’s a will there’s a way

senses.def: if you really want to do something then you will find a way of doing it
a series of victories or successes
senses.zh: 一系列胜利（或成功）；连胜；连赢

examples.en: He'll look to continue his winning ways with a victory in Mexico on 16 February.
examples.zh: 他希望 2 月 16 日在墨西哥获胜，延续他的连胜脚步。

senses.def: to do something from beginning to end, especially when it takes a lot of time or effort
senses.zh: 自始至终做（尤指耗费时间或力量的事）

examples.en: She worked her way through the pile of documents.
examples.zh: 她从头至尾处理了那一堆文件。

items.idm: work your way through college, round the world, etc.

senses.def: to have a job or series of jobs while studying, travelling, etc. in order to pay for your education, etc.
senses.zh: 勤工俭学；半工半读；边挣钱边周游世界

senses.def: to move regularly to a more senior position in a company
senses.zh: 逐步升职；按部就班晋升

examples.en: He worked his way up from messenger boy to account executive.
examples.zh: 他从送信员一步一步晋升为客户经理。

senses.def: a long time ago

examples.en: I first met him way back in the 80s.
examples.zh: 我和他初次见面早在 80 年代。

examples.en: Way back, when he was a boy, he had lived on a farm in Wales.
examples.zh: 很久以前，当他还是个孩子的时候，他住在威尔士的一个农场里。

senses.def: a long time ago

examples.en: I first met him way back in the 80s.
examples.zh: 我和他初次见面早在 80 年代。

examples.en: Way back, when he was a boy, he had lived on a farm in Wales.
examples.zh: 很久以前，当他还是个孩子的时候，他住在威尔士的一个农场里。

senses.def: used to tell somebody that you are pleased about something they have done

examples.en: Good work, guys! Way to go!
examples.zh: 伙计们，活儿不错！干得好！

examples.en: Way to go! I wish I could do that!
examples.zh: 太棒了！真希望我也能做到！

senses.def: a door used for leaving a building
a way of escaping from a difficult situation

examples.en: She was in a mess and could see no way out.
examples.zh: 她陷入困境，找不到出路。

examples.en: She had taken the easy way out by returning the keys without a message.
examples.zh: 她采取了简单的办法：归还钥匙但不留言。

senses.def: as you are leaving
going out of fashion
unusual or strange
senses.zh: 稀奇的；非传统的；前卫的

examples.en: way-out ideas
examples.zh: 离奇的想法

senses.def: as you are leaving
going out of fashion
a place where people stop to eat or rest during a long journey

examples.en: After China and Japan, the job in the UK was a way station to retirement.
examples.zh: 继中国和日本之后，英国的工作成为退休的中转站。

senses.def: a person who travels from one place to another, usually on foot

examples.en: Then the wayfarer hastens home.
examples.zh: 然后，行人匆匆回家。

senses.def: to stop somebody who is going somewhere, especially in order to talk to them or attack them
senses.zh: 拦截（尤其是为了谈话或袭击）；拦路

examples.en: I got waylaid on my way here.
examples.zh: 我在来这里的路上遭到了拦路抢劫。

senses.def: a mark or sign on a route in the countryside to show the way to people who are walking, etc.

examples.en: Turn right where you see a waymark arrow.
examples.zh: 看到箭头路标就向右转。

senses.def: with marks or signs to show the way to people who are walking

examples.en: waymarked routes
examples.zh: 有路标的路线

examples.en: Do I have to wear a tie?
examples.zh: 我得系领带吗？

examples.en: Was she wearing a seat belt?
examples.zh: 她系着安全带吗？

examples.en: She never wears make-up.
examples.zh: 她从不化妆。

examples.en: All delegates must wear a badge.
examples.zh: 所有代表都要佩戴徽章。

examples.en: She always wears black (= black clothes).
examples.zh: 她总是穿黑色衣服。

examples.en: I've got nothing to wear.
examples.zh: 我没有衣服穿。

examples.en: One woman decided to wear flowers in her hair.
examples.zh: 一位女士决定在头上戴上鲜花。

senses.def: to have your hair in a particular style; to have a beard

examples.en: She wears her hair long.
examples.zh: 她梳着长发。

examples.en: Hannah preferred to wear her hair short.
examples.zh: 汉娜更喜欢留短发。

examples.en: to wear a beard
examples.zh: 留胡须

senses.def: to have a particular expression on your face
senses.zh: 流露，面带，呈现（某种神态）

examples.en: He wore a puzzled look on his face.
examples.zh: 他脸上流露出迷惑不解的神情。

examples.en: His face wore a puzzled look.
examples.zh: 他脸上流露出迷惑不解的神情。

examples.en: Both men wore confident smiles.
examples.zh: 两个人都带着自信的微笑。

examples.en: She turned to us, wearing a blank expression.
examples.zh: 她转向我们，表情茫然。

senses.group: expression on face 面部表情

senses.def: to become, or make something become thinner, smoother or weaker through continuous use or rubbing

examples.en: The carpets are starting to wear.
examples.zh: 地毯渐渐磨坏了。

examples.en: A racing car's rear end gets very loose as the tyres wear.
examples.zh: 随着轮胎的磨损，赛车的后端会变得非常松动。

examples.en: The sheets have worn thin.
examples.zh: 床单已经磨薄了。

examples.en: The stones have been worn smooth by the constant flow of water.
examples.zh: 不停的流水把这些石头冲刷得很光滑。

senses.def: to make a hole, path, etc. in something by continuous use or rubbing
senses.zh: 穿破；磨出（洞）；踩出（路）；冲出（沟）

examples.en: I've worn holes in all my socks.
examples.zh: 我把我所有的袜子都穿破了。

examples.en: The water had worn a channel in the rock.
examples.zh: 水把岩石冲出了一条沟。

senses.def: to stay in good condition after being used for a long time

examples.en: That carpet is wearing well, isn't it?
examples.zh: 这地毯很耐用，是不是？

examples.en: You're wearing well—only a few grey hairs!
examples.zh: 你一点儿都不显老，只有几根灰白头发！

examples.en: Those curtains have worn very well.
examples.zh: 那些窗帘非常耐用。

senses.group: stay in good condition 保持良好状况

senses.def: to accept or allow something, especially something that you do not approve of
senses.zh: 接受，容许（尤指不赞成的事物）

examples.en: It's an interesting proposal, but the rich countries are never going to wear it.
examples.zh: 这是一个有趣的提议，但富裕国家永远不会接受它。

senses.def: if you feel that a remark applies to you, you should accept it and take it as a warning or criticism
to allow your feelings to be seen by other people
senses.zh: 让感情外露；把心事挂在脸上

examples.en: He’s not one to wear his heart on his sleeve.
examples.zh: 他不会轻易表达自己的情感。

senses.def: to begin to become weaker or less acceptable
senses.zh: 开始变弱；变得不受欢迎；变得兴趣索然

examples.en: These excuses are wearing a little thin (= because we've heard them so many times before).
examples.zh: 这些托辞让人听得有点儿腻烦。

examples.en: My patience is beginning to wear very thin.
examples.zh: 我有些不耐烦了。

senses.def: to be the person in a marriage or other relationship who makes most of the decisions
senses.zh: （在婚姻等关系中）处于支配的位置，起指挥的作用

examples.en: It’s obvious who wears the trousers in that family!
examples.zh: 那家谁当家显而易见！

senses.def: used especially in shops to describe clothes for a particular purpose or occasion

examples.en: casual/evening wear
examples.zh: 便装；晚礼服

examples.en: children’s/ladies’ wear
examples.zh: 童装；女装

senses.def: the fact of wearing something

examples.en: casual clothes for everyday wear
examples.zh: 平时穿的休闲服

examples.en: These woollen suits are not designed for wear in hot climates.
examples.zh: 这些毛料西服不是为炎热气候下穿着设计的。

senses.def: the amount or type of use that something has over a period of time
senses.zh: 使用量（或形式）；耐用性；经久性

examples.en: You should get years of wear out of that carpet.
examples.zh: 那条地毯你可使用很多年。

senses.def: the damage or loss of quality that is caused when something has been used a lot

examples.en: His shoes were beginning to show signs of wear.
examples.zh: 他那双鞋看样子快穿坏了。

examples.en: The machines have to be checked regularly for wear.
examples.zh: 必须定期检查机器的磨损情况。

senses.def: the damage to objects, furniture, property, etc. that is the result of normal use
senses.zh: （正常使用造成的）磨损，损耗，损坏

examples.en: The insurance policy does not cover damage caused by normal wear and tear.
examples.zh: 保险单不保正常使用所造成的坏损。

examples.en: The living-room carpet has to stand up to the combined wear and tear of two dogs and three children.
examples.zh: 客厅的地毯必须经受住两只狗和三个孩子共同的磨损。

senses.def: to become, or make something become, gradually thinner or smoother through continuous use or rubbing
senses.zh: （因重复使用或磨擦而）变薄，变光滑；使变薄；使变光滑

examples.en: The inscription on the coin had worn away.
examples.zh: 铸在这枚硬币上的文字已磨平了。

examples.en: The steps had been worn away by the feet of thousands of pilgrims.
examples.zh: 成千上万的朝圣者把台阶踏得磨损了。

senses.def: to become, or make something become, gradually smaller or smoother through continuous use or rubbing
senses.zh: （因重复使用或磨擦而）变小，变光滑；使变小；使变光滑

examples.en: Notice how the tread on this tyre has worn down.
examples.zh: 注意这个轮胎的花纹磨损的程度。

senses.def: to make somebody/something weaker or less determined, especially by continuously attacking or putting pressure on them or it over a period of time
senses.zh: （尤指通过不断攻击或施加压力）使衰弱，使意志薄弱

examples.en: Her persistence paid off and she eventually wore me down.
examples.zh: 她不屈不挠，最终把我拖垮了。

examples.en: This relentless pressure began to wear down their resistance.
examples.zh: 这种无情的压力开始瓦解他们的抵抗。

senses.def: to gradually disappear or stop
senses.zh: 逐渐消失；消逝；逐渐停止

examples.en: The effects of the drug will soon wear off.
examples.zh: 这麻醉药品的作用将很快消失。

examples.en: The novelty of married life was beginning to wear off.
examples.zh: 婚姻生活的新鲜感开始消失。

senses.def: to pass, especially in a way that seems slow

examples.en: As the evening wore on, she became more and more nervous.
examples.zh: 随着夜色渐深，她越来越紧张。

senses.def: to become, or make something become, thin or no longer able to be used, usually because it has been used too much

examples.en: He wore out two pairs of shoes last year.
examples.zh: 去年他穿坏了两双鞋。

senses.def: to make yourself/somebody feel very tired
senses.zh: 使疲乏；使筋疲力尽；使厌烦

examples.en: The kids have totally worn me out.
examples.zh: 孩子们简直把我烦透了。

examples.en: You'll wear yourself out if you carry on working so hard.
examples.zh: 你要是继续这样拼命工作，身体会吃不消的。

senses.def: pleasant and comfortable to wear; suitable to be worn
senses.zh: 穿戴舒适的；可穿戴的；适于穿戴的

examples.en: The new styles are very smart and very wearable.
examples.zh: 新款式非常智能且非常耐磨。

senses.def: a small computing
senses.zh: 可穿戴设备（小型计算机设备，佩戴于手腕等处）

examples.en: Phones, tablets, wearables and other devices are all part of the mix for our digital lives.
examples.zh: 手机、平板电脑、可穿戴设备和其他设备都是我们数字生活的一部分。

senses.def: any item that you can wear

examples.en: She uses wool, silk and mohair to make knitted wearables.
examples.zh: 她使用羊毛、丝绸和马海毛制作针织可穿戴设备。

senses.def: the person who is wearing something; a person who usually wears the thing mentioned
senses.zh: 穿戴者；佩戴人；常穿戴…的人

examples.en: The straps can be adjusted to suit the wearer.
examples.zh: 这些背带可进行调整以适合使用者。

examples.en: contact lens wearers
examples.zh: 戴隐形眼镜的人

senses.def: in a way that shows somebody is very tired

examples.en: He closed his eyes wearily.
examples.zh: 他疲惫地闭上了眼睛。

senses.def: in a way that shows somebody is annoyed and bored because they have had to do something, hear something, explain something, etc. many times

examples.en: ‘Yes, yes, I know,’ she said wearily.
examples.zh: “是的，是的，我知道，”她疲倦地说。

senses.def: the feeling of being very tired

examples.en: Weariness overcame her and she went to bed.
examples.zh: 她感到疲倦，就上床睡觉了。

senses.def: the failure to interest people or make them enthusiastic because something has been done, heard, seen, etc. many times before

examples.en: There is a sense of weariness about these arguments.
examples.zh: 这些争论让人感到厌倦。

senses.def: that makes you feel very bored and tired
senses.zh: 乏味的；令人疲劳的；使人厌倦的

examples.en: a repetitive and wearisome task
examples.zh: 重复且令人厌烦的任务

examples.en: I was beginning to find her endless chatter very wearisome.
examples.zh: 我开始觉得她没完没了的喋喋不休非常令人厌烦。

senses.def: very tired, especially after you have been working hard or doing something for a long time
senses.zh: （尤指努力工作或长时间做某事后）疲劳的，疲倦的，疲惫的

examples.en: Any chance of a drink? This weary traveller is about to collapse from thirst.
examples.zh: 有机会喝一杯吗？这位疲惫的旅行者快要渴倒了。

examples.en: She suddenly felt old and weary.
examples.zh: 她突然感到了衰老和疲倦。

examples.en: He gave a long, weary sigh.
examples.zh: 他疲倦地长叹一声。

senses.def: making you feel tired or bored
senses.zh: 使人疲劳的；使人厌烦的

examples.en: a weary journey
examples.zh: 使人疲乏的旅程

examples.en: weary hours spent in negotiation
examples.zh: 在谈判中度过了疲惫的时间

senses.def: no longer interested in or enthusiastic about something
senses.zh: （对…）不再感兴趣，不再热心，感到不耐烦

examples.en: Students soon grow weary of listening to a parade of historical facts.
examples.zh: 学生们很快便对听连串史实厌烦起来。

senses.def: to make somebody feel tired
to lose your interest in or enthusiasm for something

examples.en: She soon wearied of his stories.
examples.zh: 她很快就厌烦了他的故事。

senses.def: a small wild animal with red-brown fur, a long thin body, and short legs. Weasels
to avoid doing something that you ought to do or have promised to do
senses.zh: 逃避，推诿（责任或已作出的承诺）

examples.en: He's now trying to weasel out of our agreement.
examples.zh: 他现在正设法逃避在我们协议中应承担的义务。

senses.def: a word that has little meaning, or more than one meaning, that you use when you want to avoid saying something in a clear or direct way
senses.zh: 滑头话；含糊其词的话；推诿词

senses.def: the condition of the atmosphere at a particular place and time, such as the temperature, and if there is wind, rain, sun, etc.

examples.en: cold/hot/warm/wet/dry weather
examples.zh: 寒冷／炎热／温暖／潮湿／干燥的天气

examples.en: severe/extreme weather
examples.zh: 灾害性／极端天气

examples.en: good/bad weather
examples.zh: 好／坏天气

examples.en: Flights have been delayed because of the inclement weather.
examples.zh: 航班因天气恶劣延误。

examples.en: Weather conditions are set to improve by Thursday.
examples.zh: 天气状况到周四大概会好转。

examples.en: concerns about changing weather patterns
examples.zh: 对不断变化的气象模式的担忧

examples.en: We'll have the party outside, weather permitting (= if it doesn't rain).
examples.zh: 天气允许的话，我们就在室外举行这次聚会。

examples.en: I'm not going out in this weather!
examples.zh: 这种天气我不会出门的！

examples.en: Did you have good weather on your trip?
examples.zh: 你旅途中天气好吗？

examples.en: The winter weather kept us from going out for a walk.
examples.zh: 冬季的天气使我们没法出去散步。

examples.en: His flight was cancelled due to bad weather.
examples.zh: 由于天气恶劣，他的航班被取消。

examples.en: What sort of weather did you have?
examples.zh: 你当时的天气怎么样？

examples.en: poor/fine weather
examples.zh: 恶劣／晴朗的天气

examples.en: What's the weather like?
examples.zh: 天气怎么样？

examples.en: I've been enjoying this beautiful weather.
examples.zh: 我一直在享受这种好天气。

examples.en: There's going to be a change in the weather.
examples.zh: 天气将有变化。

examples.en: if the weather holds/breaks (= if the good weather continues/changes)
examples.zh: 如果天气还是这么好／变坏

examples.en: The weather is very changeable at the moment.
examples.zh: 现时天气变化无常。

examples.en: ‘Are you going to the beach tomorrow?’ ‘It depends on the weather.’
examples.zh: “你明天打算去海滩吗？”“那要看天气而定。”

examples.en: a weather report
examples.zh: 气象报告

examples.en: a weather map/chart
examples.zh: 气象图

examples.en: The tent protected us from the worst of the weather.
examples.zh: 帐篷保护我们免受最坏天气的影响。

senses.def: a report of what the weather will be like, on the radio or television, in the newspapers or online

examples.en: to listen to/watch the weather
examples.zh: 收听／收看天气预报

examples.en: And now for the weather.
examples.zh: 现在来说说天气。

examples.en: I checked the weather this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早晨我查看了一下天气情况。

senses.def: if you say that it is brass monkeys
in all kinds of weather, good and bad
senses.zh: 不论天气好坏；风雨无阻

examples.en: She goes out jogging in all weathers.
examples.zh: 无论天气好坏，她都出去慢跑锻炼。

examples.en: The lifeboat crews go out in all weather(s).
examples.zh: 救生船人员在任何天气情况下都出动救援。

senses.def: to watch somebody/something carefully in case you need to take action
senses.zh: 对…随时留意；对…小心提防

examples.en: Keep a weather eye on your competitors.
examples.zh: 密切关注竞争对手的天气情况。

senses.def: to seem to find something more difficult or complicated than it needs to be

examples.en: People in this country make such heavy weather of learning languages.
examples.zh: 这个国家的人们学习语言的天气如此艰难。

senses.def: if you are or feel under the weather
to change, or make something change, colour or shape because of the effect of the sun, rain or wind
senses.zh: （因受日晒、雨淋或风吹使）褪色，变色，变形

examples.en: This brick weathers to a warm pinkish-brown colour.
examples.zh: 这块砖经日晒雨淋褪成了带粉红的暖褐色。

examples.en: Some of the stone has weathered badly.
examples.zh: 这块石头的某些部份已经严重风化了。

examples.en: Her face was weathered by the sun.
examples.zh: 她的脸晒黑了。

senses.def: to come safely through a difficult period or experience
senses.zh: 经受住；平安地度过（困难时期）

examples.en: The company just managed to weather the recession.
examples.zh: 这家公司勉强度过了衰退期。

examples.en: She refuses to resign, intending to weather the storm (= wait until the situation improves again).
examples.zh: 她拒绝辞职，想要经受住这次风暴的考验。

senses.def: if you say that it is brass monkeys

senses.zh: 不论天气好坏；风雨无阻

examples.en: She goes out jogging in all weathers.
examples.zh: 无论天气好坏，她都出去慢跑锻炼。

senses.def: to have an influence on somebody’s opinion or the result of something
senses.zh: （对看法或结果）有影响；有分量

examples.en: His past record weighs heavily against him.
examples.zh: 他过去的记录对他很不利。

examples.en: The evidence weighs in her favour.
examples.zh: 证据对她有利。

senses.def: to lift an anchor
to choose your words carefully so that you say exactly what you mean

examples.en: He spoke slowly, weighing his words.
examples.zh: 他缓慢地说着，斟酌着措辞。

examples.zh: 他缓慢地说着，斟酌着措辞。

examples.en: He spoke slowly, weighing his words.
examples.zh: 他缓慢地说着，斟酌着措辞。

senses.def: to make somebody feel worried or anxious
senses.zh: 使烦恼；使焦虑；使忧心忡忡

examples.en: The responsibilities of the job are weighing her down.
examples.zh: 这项工作的责任压得她喘不过气来。

examples.en: He is weighed down with guilt.
examples.zh: 他由于内疚而心神不定。

senses.def: to make somebody/something heavier so that they are not able to move easily

examples.en: I was weighed down with baggage.
examples.zh: 我被行李压得走不动路。

examples.en: She tried to swim to the surface, but her clothes and shoes weighed her down.
examples.zh: 她试图游到水面，但她的衣服和鞋子压垮了她。

senses.def: to have your weight measured, especially before a contest, race, etc.

examples.en: Both boxers weighed in at several pounds below the limit.
examples.zh: 两个拳击手赛前量的体重都比规定限度少几磅。

examples.en: Her baby daughter weighed in at 6lb 4oz.
examples.zh: 她的小女儿重 6 磅 4 盎司。

senses.def: to join in a discussion, an argument, an activity, etc. by saying something important, persuading somebody, or doing something to help
senses.zh: （在讨论、辩论、活动等中）发表有分量的意见，发挥作用

examples.en: We all weighed in with our suggestions.
examples.zh: 我们都提出了有分量的建议。

examples.en: Finally the government weighed in with financial aid.
examples.zh: 最后政府提供了财政支援。

senses.def: the occasion when the weight of a boxer
senses.zh: （对拳击手、骑师等正式的）称体重

senses.def: to make somebody worried and unhappy
senses.zh: 加重…的思想负担；使焦虑不安；使忧虑

examples.en: The responsibilities weigh heavily on him.
examples.zh: 他肩负重任，寝食不安。

examples.en: Something was weighing on her mind.
examples.zh: 她心事重重。

senses.def: to measure an amount of something by weight

examples.en: She weighed out a kilo of flour.
examples.zh: 她称出一千克面粉。

examples.en: Weigh out all the ingredients before you start.
examples.zh: 开始之前先称量一下所有成分。

senses.def: to form an opinion of somebody by watching or talking to them
senses.zh: （通过观察或谈话）形成对…的看法，品评

examples.en: It was obvious that she was cautiously weighing me up.
examples.zh: 看得出来，她是在小心翼翼地掂量着我。

senses.def: a machine for weighing vehicles and their loads, usually with a platform onto which the vehicle is driven
senses.zh: 桥秤，地秤，地磅，称量台（用以称车等及其装载量）

senses.def: a machine for weighing large objects or for weighing people in a public place
how heavy somebody/something is, which can be measured in, for example, kilograms

examples.en: It is about 76 kilos in weight.
examples.zh: 这东西重约 76 千克。

examples.en: Bananas are sold by weight.
examples.zh: 香蕉按重量出售。

examples.en: In the wild, this fish can reach a weight of 5lbs.
examples.zh: 这种鱼在自然生存环境中可以长到 5 磅重。

examples.en: She is trying to lose weight (= become less heavy and less fat).
examples.zh: 她正在设法减肥。

examples.en: He’s put on/gained weight (= become heavier and fatter) since he gave up smoking.
examples.zh: 他戒烟后体重增加了。

examples.en: No more for me. I have to watch my weight.
examples.zh: 我不再吃了。我得控制体重。

examples.en: He has now shed the extra weight.
examples.zh: 他现在已经减掉了多余的体重。

examples.en: Body fat increases rapidly as body weight increases.
examples.zh: 体脂随体重增长而迅速增加。

examples.en: The point is to achieve permanent weight loss.
examples.zh: 重点是要达到持久减重。

examples.en: Stress can cause weight gain.
examples.zh: 精神压力会导致体重增加。

examples.en: Sam has a weight problem (= is too fat).
examples.zh: 萨姆太胖了。

senses.def: the fact of being heavy

examples.en: The pillars have to support the weight of the roof.
examples.zh: 这些立柱必须支撑起屋顶的重量。

examples.en: I just hoped the branch would take my weight.
examples.zh: 我真希望树枝经得住我的体重。

examples.en: He staggered a little under the weight of his backpack.
examples.zh: 他身上的背包压得他有点步履蹒跚。

examples.en: The table collapsed under their weight.
examples.zh: 桌子在他们的重量下倒塌了。

examples.en: Don't put any weight on that ankle for at least a week.
examples.zh: 至少要一个星期别让那个脚踝承重。

senses.def: an object that is heavy

examples.en: The doctor said he should not lift heavy weights.
examples.zh: 医生建议他别拿重物。

examples.en: Heavy weights should be lifted with a straight back.
examples.zh: 提重物时背要挺直。

examples.en: Consider adding weight training and aerobic exercises to your routine.
examples.zh: 考虑在您的日常活动中添加重量训练和有氧运动。

senses.def: an object used to keep something in position or as part of a machine
senses.zh: （用于固定某物或用作机器部件的）重体，重物

examples.en: weights on a fishing line
examples.zh: 钓线上的坠

senses.def: a great responsibility or worry

examples.en: The full weight of responsibility falls on her.
examples.zh: 全部的重任都落在了她的肩上。

examples.en: The news was certainly a weight off my mind (= I did not have to worry about it any more).
examples.zh: 这个消息真是去掉了我心头的重担。

examples.en: Finally telling the truth was a great weight off my shoulders.
examples.zh: 最后讲了实话使我如释重负。

examples.en: He was buckling under the weight of his responsibilities.
examples.zh: 多重责任的重担正逐渐将他压跨。

senses.def: importance, influence or strength

examples.en: The many letters of support added weight to the campaign.
examples.zh: 许多声援信增加了这场运动的影响力。

examples.en: The President has now offered to lend his weight to the project.
examples.zh: 总统现已主动表示支持这个项目。

examples.en: Your opinion carries weight with the boss.
examples.zh: 你的意见对老板有影响。

examples.en: How can you ignore the sheer weight of medical opinion?
examples.zh: 你怎么能忽视医生意见的绝对重要性呢？

examples.en: The weight of evidence against her is overwhelming.
examples.zh: 对她不利的证据确凿，无法抵赖。

senses.def: a unit or system of units by which weight is measured

examples.en: tables of weights and measures
examples.zh: 度量衡表

examples.en: imperial/metric weight
examples.zh: 英制／公制重量

senses.def: a piece of metal that is known to weigh a particular amount and is used to measure the weight of something, or lifted by people to improve their strength and as a sport
senses.zh: 砝码；秤砣；秤锤；杠铃片；哑铃

examples.en: a set of weights
examples.zh: 一组砝码

examples.en: a light/heavy weight
examples.zh: 轻的／重的砝码

examples.en: She lifts weights as part of her training.
examples.zh: 举杠铃是她锻炼的一部分。

examples.en: He does a lot of weight training.
examples.zh: 他进行大量的举重训练。

senses.def: to have influence with somebody

examples.en: My views don't carry much weight with the boss.
examples.zh: 我的意见在老板那里没有多少分量。

senses.def: used to say that there is too much of something
senses.zh: 在某物的折磨（或重压）下呻吟；被某物压得喘不过气来（或无法忍受）

examples.en: The table groaned under the weight of the biggest buffet they had ever seen.
examples.zh: 桌子在他们见过的最大的自助餐的重压下发出呻吟声。

senses.def: to work as hard as everyone else in a job, an activity, etc.
to be or try to be more successful than others in doing something that normally requires more skill, experience, money, etc. than you have
senses.zh: 超常发挥取胜；以小搏大

examples.en: This player seems to be able to constantly punch above her weight.
examples.zh: 这位选手似乎能够不断地出拳超过她的体重。

examples.en: He punched above his weight as the party’s foreign affairs spokesman.
examples.zh: 作为党的外交事务发言人，他的表现超出了自己的能力。

senses.def: to sit down and rest, especially when you are tired
senses.zh: （尤指疲乏时）坐下歇歇脚，坐下喘口气

examples.en: Come and sit down and take the weight off your feet for a while.
examples.zh: 来坐下歇一会儿吧。

senses.def: to use your position of authority or power in an aggressive way in order to achieve what you want

examples.en: She was a good manager, who didn’t find it necessary to throw her weight around.
examples.zh: 她是一位优秀的经理，她认为没有必要到处施展自己的影响力。

senses.def: to use all your influence and power to support something

examples.en: The government has thrown its weight behind the anti-pollution campaign.
examples.zh: 政府大力支持反污染运动。

senses.def: the combined power, strength or influence of a group
senses.zh: 人多势众；团队力量（或影响）

examples.en: They won the argument by sheer weight of numbers.
examples.zh: 他们纯粹靠人多势众在争论中获胜。

senses.def: very useful or valuable

examples.en: A good mechanic is worth his weight in gold.
examples.zh: 优秀的技工是不可多得的。

senses.def: to attach a weight to something in order to keep it in the right position or make it heavier
senses.zh: 在…上加重量；使负重；（用重物）固定

examples.en: The fishing nets are weighted with lead.
examples.zh: 这些渔网是靠铅坠下沉的。

examples.en: The body had been weighted down with stones.
examples.zh: 尸体上压着石头。

senses.group: attach heavy object 附上重物

senses.def: to give different values to things to show how important you think each of them is compared with the others

examples.en: The results of the survey were weighted to allow for variations in the sample.
examples.zh: 这次调查的结果进行了加权处理，以包容样本中的偏差。

examples.en: Each of these factors should be weighted according to their relative importance.
examples.zh: 应根据这些因素的相对重要性对它们进行加权处理。

examples.en: a weighted vote (= one that is worth more than a single vote)
examples.zh: 加权选票

examples.en: a weighted grade (= given at school for a course that is more advanced or harder and so has a higher value)
examples.zh: 加权分数

senses.def: an organization in both Britain and the US that holds special classes to help people who want to lose weight. It advises customers on what foods to eat and promotes healthy habits such as regular exercise. It also produces a range of its own foods. In 2018 it changed its name to WW with the slogan
senses.zh: 慧Watch轻体™：这是一个在英国和美国都设有特殊课程的组织，旨在帮助想要减肥的人。它为顾客提供饮食建议，并促进健康的习惯，例如定期运动。它还生产一系列自己的食物。在2018年，它以``健康的身体''为口号将其更名为WW。

senses.def: in an important and serious way
