examples.zh: 任何政府行动都会受到认真考虑。

senses.def: heavily

examples.en: It fell weightily into the mud.
examples.zh: 它重重地掉进了泥里。

examples.zh: 事情的严重性

senses.zh: 无重量的；似无重量的；失重的

examples.zh: 宇航员在失重的条件下工作。

the sport or activity of lifting heavy weights

examples.en: weighty matters
examples.zh: 重大事情

senses.def: heavy

examples.en: a weighty volume/tome
examples.zh: 大部头书

senses.def: a low wall or barrier built across a river in order to control the flow of water or change its direction

examples.en: Flood water was pouring over the weir in a thundering torrent.
examples.zh: 洪水如雷鸣般从堰上倾泻而下。

senses.def: very strange or unusual and difficult to explain
senses.zh: 奇异的；不寻常的；怪诞的

examples.en: I had a really weird dream last night.
examples.zh: 我昨晚做了个很离奇的梦。

examples.en: She's a really weird girl.
examples.zh: 她真是个古怪的女孩。

examples.en: He's got some weird ideas.
examples.zh: 他有些怪念头。

examples.en: It's really weird seeing yourself on television.
examples.zh: 看到自己上了电视感觉怪怪的。

examples.en: the weird and wonderful creatures that live beneath the sea
examples.zh: 奇异美丽的海底生物

senses.def: strange in a mysterious and frightening way

examples.en: She began to make weird inhuman sounds.
examples.zh: 她开始发出可怕的非人的声音。

senses.def: used to show that ‘funny’ is being used with the meaning of ‘strange’
used to show that ‘funny’ is being used with the meaning of ‘strange’
to seem strange to somebody and make them feel worried or uncomfortable
senses.zh: 使感到奇怪；使感到烦恼；使感到不舒服

examples.en: The whole concept really weirds me out.
examples.zh: 这整个想法让我觉得十分怪异。

examples.en: I have nothing to do and it weirds me out.
examples.zh: 我无事可做，这让我很奇怪。

examples.en: Driving on the left still weirds me out.
examples.zh: 靠左行驶仍然让我感到奇怪。

senses.def: in a way that is very strange or unusual and difficult to explain
senses.zh: 奇异的；不寻常的；怪诞的

examples.en: The town was weirdly familiar.
examples.zh: 这个小镇莫名其妙地熟悉。

senses.def: the fact of being very strange or unusual and difficult to explain
senses.zh: 奇异的；不寻常的；怪诞的

examples.en: I was enthralled by the sheer weirdness of the images.
examples.zh: 我被这些图像的纯粹怪异所迷住了。

senses.def: a person who looks strange and/or behaves in a strange way

examples.en: It’s dangerous to be out on your own—there are too many weirdos around.
examples.zh: 独自一人出去很危险——周围有太多怪人。

senses.def: to not do something that you have promised to do, for example to not pay money that you owe
senses.zh: 说话不算数；赖账；耍赖皮

senses.def: used as a greeting

examples.en: Welcome home!
examples.zh: 欢迎归来！

examples.en: Welcome to Oxford!
examples.zh: 欢迎您来到牛津！

examples.en: Good evening everybody. Welcome to the show!
examples.zh: 诸位，晚上好。欢迎观看本次演出！

senses.def: to say hello to somebody in a friendly way when they arrive somewhere

examples.en: They were at the door to welcome us.
examples.zh: 他们在门口迎接我们。

examples.en: to welcome a visitor/guest
examples.zh: 欢迎来访者／客人

examples.en: It is a pleasure to welcome you to our home.
examples.zh: 很高兴欢迎您光临舍下。

examples.en: The whole family turned out to welcome him back.
examples.zh: 全家人都出来迎接他归来。

senses.def: to be pleased that somebody has come or has joined an organization, activity, etc.

examples.en: They welcomed the new volunteers with open arms (= with enthusiasm).
examples.zh: 他们热烈欢迎这些新的志愿者。

examples.en: We are always pleased to welcome new members.
examples.zh: 我们总是很高兴欢迎新成员。

examples.en: We are delighted to welcome you to our company.
examples.zh: 非常欢迎你到我们公司来。

examples.en: The new immigrants have been welcomed into the community.
examples.zh: 新移民受到社区的欢迎。

senses.def: to be pleased to receive or accept something

examples.en: to welcome a decision/move
examples.zh: 欣然接受一项决定／动议

examples.en: Women's rights campaigners welcomed the news.
examples.zh: 妇女权力活动家们欢迎这一消息。

examples.en: I warmly welcome this announcement.
examples.zh: 我热烈欢迎这一宣告。

examples.en: We welcome the opportunity to work with the government to develop better services locally.
examples.zh: 我们欢迎有机会与政府合作，在当地开发更好的服务。

examples.en: I'd welcome any suggestions.
examples.zh: 任何建议我都会愉快地听取。

examples.en: In general, the changes they had made were to be welcomed.
examples.zh: 总的来说，他们所作的这些变动都会被欣然接受。

examples.en: We welcome input from our readers.
examples.zh: 我们欢迎读者提出意见。

senses.def: accepted or wanted somewhere

examples.en: I'll go, then. I know when I'm not welcome.
examples.zh: 那我就去吧我知道什么时候我不受欢迎。

examples.en: They were anxious to make us feel welcome in their home.
examples.zh: 他们热切希望让我们感到在他们家里受到欢迎。

examples.en: Children are always welcome at the hotel.
examples.zh: 儿童在旅馆里总是受到款待。

examples.en: Our neighbours made us welcome as soon as we arrived.
examples.zh: 我们一到就受到了邻居们的欢迎。

examples.en: I had the feeling we were not welcome at the meeting.
examples.zh: 我有种感觉，人家并不欢迎我们参加这个会议。

examples.en: Children are always welcome at the hotel.
examples.zh: 儿童在旅馆里总是受到款待。

examples.en: New members are welcome to the club.
examples.zh: 欢迎新成员加入俱乐部。

examples.en: Poetry Reading. Tonight at 8 p.m. Admission free. All are welcome.
examples.zh: 诗歌朗诵。今晚 8 点。免费入场。欢迎大家。

examples.en: a welcome guest/visitor
examples.zh: 受欢迎的客人 [来访者]

senses.def: that you are pleased to have, receive, etc.

examples.en: Her book is a welcome addition to the literature on late Victorian Britain.
examples.zh: 她的书是又一部受欢迎的有关维多利亚晚期英国的文学作品。

examples.en: It was a welcome return to form for the current world champion.
examples.zh: 对于现任世界冠军而言，这是令人欣喜的状态恢复。

examples.en: Your letter was very welcome.
examples.zh: 很高兴收到你的信。

examples.en: a welcome sight
examples.zh: 赏心悦目的景象

examples.en: welcome news
examples.zh: 好消息

examples.en: The fine weather made a welcome change.
examples.zh: 天气转晴，令人心旷神怡。

senses.def: used to say that you are happy for somebody to do something if they want to
senses.zh: （表示乐于让某人做某事）可随意

examples.en: Everyone is welcome to attend, but places are limited.
examples.zh: 每个人都可以参加，但名额有限。

examples.en: You're welcome to join us for dinner tomorrow.
examples.zh: 欢迎您明天来和我们一起吃晚饭。

examples.en: You're more than welcome to come with us.
examples.zh: 非常欢迎您和我们一起来。

examples.en: They're welcome to stay here as long as they like.
examples.zh: 他们在这里愿意住多久就住多久。

examples.en: You're welcome to use the pool.
examples.zh: 欢迎您使用游泳池。

senses.def: used to say that you are very happy for somebody to have something because you definitely do not want it
senses.zh: （表示十分乐于让他人取去自己不想要的事物）尽管…好了

examples.en: It's an awful job. If you want it, you're welcome to it!
examples.zh: 这事真难办。你要是想做就交给你做好了！

senses.def: used as a polite reply when somebody thanks you for something

examples.en: ‘Thanks for your help.’ ‘You're welcome.’
examples.zh: “多谢你的帮助。”“别客气。”

senses.def: something that you do or say to somebody when they arrive, especially something that makes them feel you are happy to see them

examples.en: to get/receive a welcome
examples.zh: 受到欢迎

examples.en: Thank you for your warm welcome.
examples.zh: 感谢你们的热情接待。

examples.en: The winners were given an enthusiastic welcome when they arrived home.
examples.zh: 获胜者奏凯而归时受到了热烈欢迎。

examples.en: He returned to a hero’s welcome.
examples.zh: 他回来时受到英雄般的欢迎。

examples.en: a speech/smile of welcome
examples.zh: 欢迎词；欢迎的微笑

examples.en: She was asked to say a few words of welcome.
examples.zh: 她被要求说几句欢迎的话。

examples.en: I wish to extend a very warm welcome to the team.
examples.zh: 我谨向团队表示热烈欢迎。

examples.en: It was a nice welcome to a strange new city.
examples.zh: 那是来到一座陌生的新城市时受到的热情欢迎。

senses.def: the way that people react to something, which shows their opinion of it
senses.zh: （表明看法的）反应方式，对待，接受

examples.en: This new comedy deserves a warm welcome.
examples.zh: 这出新喜剧值得受到热烈欢迎。

examples.en: The proposals were given a cautious welcome by the trade unions.
examples.zh: 这些建议得到了工会审慎的接受。

senses.def: to stay somewhere as a guest longer than you are wanted
senses.zh: 做客太久而不再受欢迎

examples.en: Sensing that he had outstayed his welcome, he quickly said his goodbyes and left.
examples.zh: 他感觉到自己逗留的时间太长已经不再受欢迎，赶快说声再见就离开了。

senses.def: used as a polite reply when somebody thanks you for something

examples.en: ‘Thanks for your help.’ ‘You're welcome.’
examples.zh: “多谢你的帮助。”“别客气。”

senses.def: to stay somewhere as a guest longer than you are wanted
senses.zh: 做客太久而不再受欢迎

examples.en: Sensing that he had outstayed his welcome, he quickly said his goodbyes and left.
examples.zh: 他感觉到自己逗留的时间太长已经不再受欢迎，赶快说声再见就离开了。

items.idm: lay, put, roll, etc. out the welcome mat (for somebody)

senses.def: to make somebody feel welcome; to try to attract visitors, etc.
senses.zh: 使感到受欢迎；设法吸引（客人等）

examples.en: The county has put out the welcome mat for international investors.
examples.zh: 该县已经为国际投资者铺上了欢迎垫。

senses.def: a formal welcome to the traditional land of an Aboriginal people by one or more members of the local Aboriginal community
senses.zh: （澳大利亚由当地土著主持的）土著家园欢迎仪式

examples.en: A welcome to country was conducted, followed by a traditional smoking ceremony.
examples.zh: 欢迎来到这个国家，随后举行了传统的吸烟仪式。

examples.en: The event began with a Welcome to Country by Kaurna elder Auntie Josie Agius.
examples.zh: 活动以考纳长老乔西·阿吉乌斯阿姨的欢迎来到乡村开始。

senses.def: to join pieces of metal together by heating their edges and pressing them together

examples.en: to weld a broken axle
examples.zh: 焊接一条断裂的轴

examples.en: The car has had a new wing welded on.
examples.zh: 这辆汽车焊上了一块新挡泥板。

examples.en: All the parts of the sculpture have to be welded together.
examples.zh: 这件雕塑所有的部件都必须焊接在一起。

senses.def: to make people or things join together into a strong and effective group
senses.zh: 使紧密结合；使连成整体

examples.en: They had welded a bunch of untrained recruits into an efficient fighting force.
examples.zh: 他们把一群未经训练的新兵打造成了一支有战斗力的部队。

examples.en: The crisis helped to weld the party together.
examples.zh: 这场危机促使整个党紧密地团结在一起。

senses.def: a joint
a person whose job is welding
the general health, happiness and safety of a person, an animal or a group
senses.zh: （个体或群体的）幸福，福祉，安康

examples.en: We are concerned about the child's welfare.
examples.zh: 我们关注那个孩子的福祉。

senses.def: practical or financial help that is provided, often by the government, for people or animals that need it

examples.en: The state is still the main provider of welfare.
examples.zh: 政府仍然是福利的主要提供者。

examples.en: child welfare
examples.zh: 儿童福利

examples.en: a social welfare programme
examples.zh: 社会福利计划

examples.en: welfare provision/services/work
examples.zh: 福利供给／机构／工作

examples.en: There must be adequate welfare provision for people who are unable to work.
examples.zh: 必须为无法工作的人提供足够的福利。

senses.def: money that the government pays regularly to people who are poor, unemployed, sick, etc.
senses.zh: 社会保障金（政府定期向穷人、失业者、病人等发放）

examples.en: They would rather work than live on welfare.
examples.zh: 他们更愿工作而不愿靠社会保障金过活。

senses.def: a system by which the government provides a range of services to people who need them, for example medical care, money for people without work, care for old people, etc.
senses.zh: 福利制度（由政府向有需要的人提供各种免费服务，如医疗、失业救济金、对老人的照顾等）

examples.en: the provision of services such as health through the welfare state
examples.zh: 福利制度下提供的医疗之类的服务

senses.def: a country that has such a system

a phrase used in Britain for government programmes that are aimed at reducing the number of people who are unemployed and receiving money from the State, by creating jobs for them or training them for work
senses.zh: 福利工作：在英国用于政府计划的短语，旨在通过为失业者创造就业机会或培训他们以减少失业人数并从国家获得金钱

senses.def: the sky or heaven
to make a very loud noise
to make a very loud noise
in a good, right or acceptable way

examples.en: They played well in the tournament.
examples.zh: 他们在锦标赛中打得很好。

examples.en: The team work well together.
examples.zh: 这支团队在一起配合良好。

examples.en: The kids all behaved well.
examples.zh: 孩子们都很有礼貌。

examples.en: The conference was very well organized.
examples.zh: 这次会议组织得很好。

examples.en: Well done! (= expressing admiration for what somebody has done)
examples.zh: 干得好！

examples.en: His campaign was not going well.
examples.zh: 他的竞选活动进展得不顺利。

examples.en: These animals make very good pets if treated well (= with kindness).
examples.zh: 这些动物若得到善待会成为很好的宠物。

examples.en: People spoke well of (= spoke with approval of) him.
examples.zh: 人们对他的评价很高。

examples.en: She took it very well (= did not react too badly), all things considered.
examples.zh: 总的说来，她的反应还挺不错。

examples.en: They lived well (= in comfort and spending a lot of money) and were generous with their money.
examples.zh: 他们生活优裕，花钱大方。

examples.en: She was determined to marry well (= marry somebody rich and/or with a high social position).
examples.zh: 她决意嫁给有钱有势的人。

senses.def: completely and properly

examples.en: Add the lemon juice and mix well.
examples.zh: 加进柠檬汁并搅拌均匀。

examples.en: The surface must be well prepared before you start to paint.
examples.zh: 一定要把表面打磨好再开始油漆。

examples.en: How well do you know Carla?
examples.zh: 你对卡拉有多了解？

examples.en: He's well able to take care of himself.
examples.zh: 他完全能够自理。

examples.en: a well trained dog
examples.zh: 训练有素的狗

senses.def: to a great extent or degree

examples.en: He was driving at well over the speed limit.
examples.zh: 他当时开车的速度远远超过了限制。

examples.en: She is well aware of the dangers.
examples.zh: 她很清楚这些危险。

examples.en: They are very well suited to each other.
examples.zh: 他们非常般配。

examples.en: a well-loved tale
examples.zh: 深受喜爱的故事

examples.en: The castle is well worth a visit.
examples.zh: 这座城堡很值得参观。

examples.en: He liked her well enough (= to a reasonable degree) but he wasn't going to make a close friend of her.
examples.zh: 他够喜欢她的，但并不打算和她结为密友。

examples.en: I was well annoyed, I can tell you.
examples.zh: 我跟你说吧，我那时气坏了。

senses.def: easily

examples.en: She could well afford to pay for it herself.
examples.zh: 她自己完全买得起。

senses.def: probably

examples.en: You may well be right.
examples.zh: 你很可能是对的。

examples.en: It may well be that the train is delayed.
examples.zh: 火车很可能晚点了。

senses.def: with good reason

examples.en: I can't very well leave now.
examples.zh: 我现在离开不太合适。

examples.en: I couldn't very well refuse to help them, could I?
examples.zh: 我没有理由拒绝帮助他们，是不是？

examples.en: ‘What are we doing here?’ ‘You may well ask (= I don't really know either).’
examples.zh: “我们在这儿干什么呢？”“你算问对了（我也不知道）。”

senses.def: in addition to somebody/something; too

examples.en: Are they coming as well?
examples.zh: 他们也来吗？

examples.en: They sell books as well as newspapers.
examples.zh: 他们既卖报也卖书。

examples.en: She is a talented musician as well as being a photographer.
examples.zh: 她不但是个摄影师而且还是个天才的音乐家。

senses.def: to be getting healthier after an illness; to be in good health after a birth
senses.zh: （病后）康复，恢复良好；（产后）平安，健康

examples.en: Mother and baby are doing well.
examples.zh: 母婴平安。

senses.def: to have nearly achieved something and be going to achieve it soon

examples.en: She is well on the way to recovery.
examples.zh: 她就要康复了。

examples.en: He is well on the way to establishing himself among the top ten players in the world.
examples.zh: 他很快就会成为排名世界前十位的选手。

senses.def: to be lucky that you are not involved in something unpleasant or difficult to deal with
senses.zh: 幸运地与（不愉快或困难之事）无关；幸亏没有卷入

examples.en: I don’t know exactly what’s been going on. I only know that you’re well out of it.
examples.zh: 我不知道到底发生了什么事。我只知道你已经摆脱了困境。

senses.def: to know a lot about something

examples.en: He's well up in all the latest developments.
examples.zh: 他对所有的最新发展情况都了如指掌。

senses.def: used to emphasize an angry statement or an order

examples.en: You can bloody well keep your job—I don't want it!
examples.zh: 你就继续干你那份臭工作吧，我才不稀罕呢！

examples.en: ‘I’m not coming.’ ‘Yes, you bloody well are!’
examples.zh: “我不会来的。”“对，你当然不会来。”

senses.def: used to emphasize an angry statement or an order

examples.en: You can bloody well keep your job—I don't want it!
examples.zh: 你就继续干你那份臭工作吧，我才不稀罕呢！

examples.en: ‘I’m not coming.’ ‘Yes, you bloody well are!’
examples.zh: “我不会来的。”“对，你当然不会来。”

senses.def: to be successful

examples.en: Jack is doing very well at school.
examples.zh: 杰克在学校里学习成绩斐然。

senses.def: to treat somebody generously
to become successful or rich
to make a profit or get money from somebody/something
to be sensible or wise to do something

examples.en: He would do well to concentrate more on his work.
examples.zh: 他最好还是更加集中精力在工作上。

examples.en: You did well to sell when the price was high.
examples.zh: 你在价钱高的时候出售，真明智。

senses.def: used to emphasize an angry statement or an order

examples.en: You're fucking well coming whether you want to or not.
examples.zh: 不管你想不想来，你他妈的也要给我过来。

senses.def: used to emphasize a statement when you are annoyed about something
senses.zh: （生气时用以加强语气）当然，无疑，必然

examples.en: If you don't come now, you can jolly well walk home!
examples.zh: 你要是还不来，那就步行回家吧！

senses.def: used to criticize somebody by saying that they should realize or understand something
senses.zh: （用以批评）其实完全明白，哪会不知道，知道得很清楚

examples.en: You know as well as I do that you're being unreasonable.
examples.zh: 其实你完全明白你是在故意胡搅蛮缠。

senses.def: to be very aware of a fact and unable to deny or ignore it
senses.zh: 非常清楚；不可否认；不可忽视

examples.en: He knew full well what she thought of it.
examples.zh: 他非常清楚她对此事的看法。

senses.def: to not get involved in something that you have no connection with

examples.en: When it comes to other people's arguments, it's better to leave well alone.
examples.zh: 遇到别人争论时，最好别插嘴。

senses.def: if you are going to be punished for doing something wrong, whether it is a big or small thing, you may as well do the big thing
senses.zh: 与其偷羊羔被绞死，不如偷只羊；一不做，二不休

senses.def: used to say that something seems the best thing to do in the situation that you are in, although you may not really want to do it
senses.zh: 做…倒也无妨；只好做（某事）

examples.en: If no one else wants it, we might as well give it to him.
examples.zh: 如果没人要这个，我们不妨给他吧。

senses.def: used to say that there is no real difference between two things that you might do

examples.en: If you are going to have sugar, you may as well have a bar of chocolate.
examples.zh: 如果你要吃糖，也可以来一块巧克力。

senses.def: to have good intentions, although their effect may not be good
almost; almost completely

examples.en: One dog looks pretty much like another to me.
examples.zh: 在我看来，狗长得都差不多。

examples.en: He goes out pretty well every night.
examples.zh: 他几乎每晚都外出。

examples.en: The first stage is pretty near finished.
examples.zh: 第一阶段已经接近完成。

senses.def: completely

examples.en: By that time we were well and truly lost.
examples.zh: 那时候我们已经完全迷路了。

senses.def: having made good progress

examples.en: If we got Terry to do that, we'd be well away.
examples.zh: 假若我们让特里干这事，我们就会有很大成绩。

senses.def: drunk or in a deep sleep
to be good friends with somebody, especially somebody important
senses.zh: 是某人（尤指要人）的好友

examples.en: She seems to be well in with all the right people.
examples.zh: 她似乎和所有大人物都关系很好。

senses.def: in good health

examples.en: I don't feel very well.
examples.zh: 我觉得身体不太好。

examples.en: Is she well enough to travel?
examples.zh: 她身体怎么样，能够旅行吗？

examples.en: Get well soon! (= for example, on a card)
examples.zh: 愿早日康复！

examples.en: I'm better now, thank you.
examples.zh: 我现在好些了，谢谢您。

examples.en: He's not a well man.
examples.zh: 他身体不太好。

senses.def: in a good state or position

examples.en: It seems that all is not well at home.
examples.zh: 看来家中并非事事如意。

examples.en: All's well that ends well (= used when something has ended happily, even though you thought it might not).
examples.zh: 结果好就算一切都好。

senses.def: sensible; a good idea

examples.en: It would be just as well to call and say we might be late.
examples.zh: 还是打个电话说一声我们可能到得晚些比较好。

examples.en: It would be well to start early.
examples.zh: 最好还是早点动身。

senses.def: still living and not injured or harmed

examples.en: The missing student was found alive and well in Newcastle.
examples.zh: 失踪学生在纽卡斯尔被找到，安然无恙。

senses.def: still popular or successful

examples.en: Singapore's literary scene is alive and well.
examples.zh: 新加坡的文学界充满活力。

examples.en: Contrary to popular belief, the tourism industry is alive and well in this part of the world.
examples.zh: 与普遍的看法相反，旅游业在这个地方很兴旺。

senses.def: used to criticize or reject a remark that somebody has made, especially when they were trying to make you feel happier about something
senses.zh: （尤用于批评或反驳对方的安慰言语）某人尽可做某事

examples.en: It's all very well for you to say it doesn't matter, but I've put a lot of work into this and I want it to be a success.
examples.zh: 你说这无所谓当然容易，可是我却已经花费很大力气而且想要取得成功。

senses.def: quite good but not exactly what is wanted
senses.zh: 好倒是好（但并不完全合乎心意）

examples.en: That's all well and good, but why didn't he call her to say so?
examples.zh: 那好倒是好，可是他为什么不给她打电话这样说呢？

senses.def: used to express surprise, anger or relief
senses.zh: （表示惊奇、愤怒或宽慰）哎呀，哟，啊，好啦

examples.en: Well, well—I would never have guessed it!
examples.zh: 哟，哟，我怎么也不会猜到那儿去！

examples.en: Well, really! What a thing to say!
examples.zh: 啊，真是的！这么说太不像话了！

examples.en: Well, thank goodness that's over!
examples.zh: 好啦，谢天谢地，这件事总算过去了！

senses.def: used to show that you accept that something cannot be changed

examples.en: Well, it can't be helped.
examples.zh: 唉，这没有办法。

examples.en: ‘We lost.’ ‘Oh, well. Better luck next time.’
examples.zh: “我们输了。”“啊，算了。愿下次交好运。”

senses.def: used to agree to something, rather unwillingly

examples.en: Well, I suppose I could fit you in at 3.45.
examples.zh: 好吧，我想可以在 3:45 见你。

examples.en: Oh, very well, then, if you insist.
examples.zh: 啊，那好吧，如果你坚持的话。

senses.def: used when continuing a conversation after a break

examples.en: Well, as I was saying…
examples.zh: 噢，我刚才是说…

senses.def: used to say that something is uncertain

examples.en: ‘Do you want to come?’ ‘Well, I'm not sure.’
examples.zh: “你想来吗？”“哦，我还说不准。”

senses.def: used to show that you are waiting for somebody to say something

examples.en: Well? Are you going to tell us or not?
examples.zh: 嗯？你想不想告诉我们？

senses.def: used to mark the end of a conversation

examples.en: Well, I'd better be going now.
examples.zh: 就这样，我现在该走了。

senses.def: used when you are stopping to consider your next words

examples.en: I think it happened, well, towards the end of last summer.
examples.zh: 我想事情发生在…呃…快到上个夏末的时候。

senses.def: used when you want to correct or change something that you have just said
senses.zh: （纠正或改变刚说过的话时用）

examples.en: There were thousands of people there—well, hundreds, anyway.
examples.zh: 那里有数以千计的人，噢，至少几百人。

senses.def: used to express surprise
senses.zh: （表示惊奇）哟，我可从未做过（或听说过）这样的事

senses.def: I agree completely

examples.en: ‘We must stand up for ourselves.’ ‘Well said, John.’
examples.zh: “我们必须自己起来保护自己。”“说得好，约翰。”

senses.def: a deep hole in the ground from which people obtain water. The sides of wells

examples.en: to dig/sink a well
examples.zh: 挖井/打井

examples.en: The dog fell down a well.
examples.zh: 狗落入了井中。

senses.def: a hole made in the ground to obtain oil
a narrow space in a building that drops down from a high to a low level, giving room for stairs or a lift, or to allow light into the building
senses.zh: 楼梯井；电梯井道；采光井

examples.en: Two generous light wells in the main floor bring light down to the basement.
examples.zh: 主层有两个宽敞的采光井，将光线引入地下室。

senses.def: the space in front of the judge in a court, where the lawyers sit
in addition to somebody/something; too

examples.en: Are they coming as well?
examples.zh: 他们也来吗？

examples.en: They sell books as well as newspapers.
examples.zh: 他们既卖报也卖书。

examples.en: She is a talented musician as well as being a photographer.
examples.zh: 她不但是个摄影师而且还是个天才的音乐家。

senses.def: to be getting healthier after an illness; to be in good health after a birth
senses.zh: （病后）康复，恢复良好；（产后）平安，健康

examples.en: Mother and baby are doing well.
examples.zh: 母婴平安。

items.idm: be well on the way to something/doing something

senses.def: to have nearly achieved something and be going to achieve it soon

examples.en: She is well on the way to recovery.
examples.zh: 她就要康复了。

examples.en: He is well on the way to establishing himself among the top ten players in the world.
examples.zh: 他很快就会成为排名世界前十位的选手。

senses.def: to be lucky that you are not involved in something unpleasant or difficult to deal with
senses.zh: 幸运地与（不愉快或困难之事）无关；幸亏没有卷入

examples.en: I don’t know exactly what’s been going on. I only know that you’re well out of it.
examples.zh: 我不知道到底发生了什么事。我只知道你已经摆脱了困境。

senses.def: to know a lot about something

examples.en: He's well up in all the latest developments.
examples.zh: 他对所有的最新发展情况都了如指掌。

senses.def: used to emphasize an angry statement or an order

examples.en: You can bloody well keep your job—I don't want it!
examples.zh: 你就继续干你那份臭工作吧，我才不稀罕呢！

examples.en: ‘I’m not coming.’ ‘Yes, you bloody well are!’
examples.zh: “我不会来的。”“对，你当然不会来。”

senses.def: used to emphasize an angry statement or an order

examples.zh: 倘若我们再次见面，我希望他还记得我为他做的事。

examples.zh: 一涉及做事，他便不中用了。

examples.zh: 我们必须在气球升起之前离开这里！

examples.zh: 当危急关头时，他总能鼓起勇气继续前行。

senses.zh: 当条件变得艰苦时，当进展变得困难时（隐含有志者更勇往直前之意）

when the going gets tough the tough get: @@@LINK=when the going gets tough (the tough get going)

when you've seen them all: @@@LINK=when you’ve seen, heard, etc. one, you’ve seen, heard, etc. them all

examples.zh: 我不太喜欢科幻小说。读过一本，就知道其他的内容了。

senses.def: from where

examples.en: They returned whence they had come.
examples.zh: 他们从哪里来又回到哪里去了。

senses.def: at any time that; on any occasion that
senses.zh: 在任何…的时候；无论何时；在任何…的情况下

examples.en: You can ask for help whenever you need it.
examples.zh: 你如果需要帮助随时可以提出来。

senses.def: every time that

examples.en: Whenever she comes, she brings a friend.
examples.zh: 她每次来都带着个朋友。

examples.en: The roof leaks whenever it rains.
examples.zh: 屋顶每逢下雨就漏。

examples.en: We try to help whenever possible.
examples.zh: 只要有可能我们都尽量帮忙。

senses.def: used when the time when something happens is not important
senses.zh: 别的什么时候（也可以）；任何时间（都行）

examples.en: ‘When do you need it by?’ ‘Saturday or Sunday. Whenever.’
examples.zh: “你什么时候需要这个东西？”“星期六或星期日。哪一天都行。”

examples.en: It's not urgent—we can do it next week or whenever.
examples.zh: 这不着急，我们可以在下星期或别的什么时候做。

senses.def: used in questions to mean ‘when’, expressing surprise
senses.zh: （用于问句，表示惊奇）究竟什么时候

examples.en: Whenever did you find time to do all that cooking?
examples.zh: 你怎么有时间做了这么多菜？

senses.def: in or to what place or situation
senses.zh: 在哪里；到哪里；处于哪种情形

examples.en: Where do you live?
examples.zh: 你住在哪儿？

examples.en: I wonder where they will take us to.
examples.zh: 我不知道他们要把我们带到哪里去。

examples.en: Where (= at what point) did I go wrong in my calculations?
examples.zh: 我计算中什么地方出了差错？

examples.en: Where (= in what book, newspaper, etc.) did you read that?
examples.zh: 你在哪儿读到这个的？

examples.en: Just where (= to what situation or final argument) is all this leading us?
examples.zh: 这一切到底是要将我们引向何处？

senses.zh: （用于表示地点或情况的词语后）在那（地方），到那（地方）

examples.en: It's one of the few countries where people drive on the left.
examples.zh: 这是为数不多的几个靠左行驶的国家之一。

senses.def: the place or situation in which
senses.zh: 在那里；在该处；在该情况下

examples.en: We then moved to Paris, where we lived for six years.
examples.zh: 我们随后移居巴黎，在那里住了六年。

senses.def: (in) the place or situation in which

examples.en: This is where I live.
examples.zh: 这是我住的地方。

examples.en: Sit where I can see you.
examples.zh: 坐在我能看到你的地方。

examples.en: Where people were concerned, his threshold of boredom was low.
examples.zh: 涉及人的事情，他便极易感到厌烦。

examples.en: That's where (= the point in the argument at which) you're wrong.
examples.zh: 这就是你的错误所在。

senses.def: used to ask what action somebody should take, especially in order to improve the difficult situation that they are in
senses.zh: （尤指为了改变困境而询问）下一步该怎么办，往下怎么做呢

senses.zh: 盛大活动（场合）；流行活动（地方）

examples.zh: 从等待入场的人群来看，这好像是个盛大活动。

where on earth: @@@LINK=how, why, where, who, etc. on earth

senses.zh: （决定某人言论的）某人的全部背景

examples.zh: 检验成败的时刻到了：消费者真的会购买这种产品吗？

examples.en: Whereabouts did you find it?
examples.zh: 你在哪儿找到它的？

senses.zh: （用以比较或对比两个事实）然而，但是，尽管

examples.zh: 有一些研究结果令人满意，然而其他的则不然。

examples.en: We thought she was arrogant, whereas in fact she was just very shy.
examples.zh: 我们以为她很傲慢，但实际上她只是很害羞。

senses.def: used at the beginning of a sentence in an official document to mean ‘because of the fact that…’
senses.zh: （用于正式文件中句子的开头）鉴于

senses.def: by which; because of which

examples.en: They have introduced a new system whereby all employees must undergo regular training.
examples.zh: 他们采用了新的制度，所有的雇员都必须定期培训。

senses.def: the reasons for something

examples.en: I had no intention of going into the whys and the wherefores of the situation.
examples.zh: 我无意深入调查这一情况的来龙去脉。

senses.zh: 其中；在那里；在那种情况下；以什么方式

examples.zh: 他对她说她在说谎，她便愤然而去。

examples.zh: 她所到之处都有成群的人等着见她。

examples.zh: 只要有可能就用全谷物早餐食品。

senses.def: used in questions to mean ‘where’, expressing surprise
senses.zh: （用于问句，表示惊讶）究竟在哪里，究竟到哪儿

senses.def: or any other place

examples.en: tourists from Spain, France or wherever

senses.zh: 刺激…的欲望；增强…的兴趣

examples.zh: 你看了这本书就会更想多读她的著作。

senses.zh: （表示迟疑或两个可能性之间的选择）是否

examples.zh: 他似乎还没有决定去留。

examples.zh: 这一想法能否付诸实践还有待于观察。

examples.zh: 我问过他这都是他自己做的还是有人帮他做的。

examples.en: I'll see whether she's at home (= or not at home).
examples.zh: 我来看看她在不在家。

examples.en: It's doubtful whether there'll be any seats left.
examples.zh: 看来未必还有座位。

senses.zh: （表示两种情况都真实）是…（还是），或者…（或者），不管…（还是）

examples.zh: 无论你接不接受我们的保险提议，你都可以免费得到一份礼物。

examples.zh: 不管你愿意不愿意，我都要走了。

examples.en: Whether or not we're successful, we can be sure that we did our best.
examples.zh: 不管成功与否，我们确已尽了最大努力。

a sound that people make to show that they are surprised or relieved

examples.en: Whew—and I thought it was serious!
examples.zh: 嚯，我原以为它有多么严重呢！

examples.en: Ten grand? Whew!
examples.zh: 一万英镑？哟！

examples.en: Which is better exercise—swimming or tennis?
examples.zh: 游泳和网球，哪种运动比较好？

examples.en: Which way is the wind blowing?

senses.def: used to be exact about the thing or things that you mean
senses.zh: （明确所指的事物）…的那个，…的那些

examples.zh: 俯瞰湖泊的房子要价高些。

examples.en: It was a crisis for which she was totally unprepared.
examples.zh: 这是一场她完全没有防备的危机。

senses.def: used to give more information about something
senses.zh: （进一步提供有关某事物的信息）那个，那些

examples.en: His best movie, which won several awards, was about the life of Gandhi.
examples.zh: 他最优秀的电影，就是荣获几项大奖的那一部，是关于甘地生平的。

examples.zh: 你的索赔应当能成功，假如这样的话，损害赔偿金将会相当可观。

senses.zh: （区分人或事物）谁是谁，哪个是哪个

examples.zh: 这一对双胞胎长得一模一样，我分不清谁是谁。

senses.zh: 哪个？：一家测试产品质量并每月在其杂志中发布结果的英国组织？并在其网站上。这有助于人们选择最好的产品，并赋予组织影响力，以保护购买商品或使用服务的人们的利益。该组织由消费者协会于1957年成立。

senses.def: used to talk about recognizing the difference between one person or thing and another

examples.en: The twins are so alike I can't tell which is which.
examples.zh: 这一对双胞胎长得一模一样，我分不清谁是谁。

senses.def: used to talk about recognizing the difference between one person or thing and another
senses.zh: （区分人或事物）谁是谁，哪个是哪个

examples.en: The twins are so alike I can't tell which is which.
examples.zh: 这一对双胞胎长得一模一样，我分不清谁是谁。

senses.zh: （表示什么特征或品质在作决定时重要）…的那个，…的那些

examples.en: Choose whichever brand you prefer.
examples.zh: 挑选你喜欢的那个品牌。

examples.en: Pensions should be increased annually in line with earnings or prices, whichever is the higher.
examples.zh: 养老金每年应该按照收入或物价中升幅较高的那一项增长。

examples.en: Whichever of you gets here first will get the prize.
examples.zh: 你们谁第一个到达这里谁就获奖。

senses.def: used to say that it does not matter which, as the result will be the same

examples.en: It takes three hours, whichever route you take.
examples.zh: 无论你走哪一条路都需要三个小时。

examples.en: The situation is an awkward one, whichever way you look at it.
examples.zh: 无论从哪一方面看，这个局面都很尴尬。

examples.en: Whichever they choose, we must accept their decision.
examples.zh: 无论他们如何选择，我们都必须接受他们的决定。

senses.def: a smell, especially one that you only smell for a short time

examples.en: a whiff of cigar smoke
examples.zh: 一股雪茄烟味

examples.en: He caught a whiff of perfume as he leaned towards her.
examples.zh: 他探身靠近她时闻到一股香水味。

senses.def: a slight sign or feeling of something
senses.zh: 轻微的迹象（或感觉）；一点点；些许

examples.en: a whiff of danger
examples.zh: 一点点危险

senses.def: an unsuccessful attempt to hit the ball
to smell bad
to try without success to hit the ball
smelling bad
in Britain in the past, a member of a party that supported progress and change and that later became the Liberal Party
senses.zh: 辉格党党员（属于英国旧时的激进党派，自由党的前身）

senses.def: during the time that something is happening; at the same time as something else is happening
senses.zh: 在…期间；当…的时候；与…同时

examples.en: We must have been burgled while we were asleep.
examples.zh: 我们肯定是在睡着时遭遇了入室盗窃。

examples.en: Her parents died while she was still at school.
examples.zh: 她还在读书时父母就去世了。

examples.en: While I was waiting at the bus stop, three buses went by in the opposite direction.
examples.zh: 我在公共汽车站等车时，路对面驶过了三辆公共汽车。

examples.en: You can go swimming while I'm having lunch.
examples.zh: 我吃午饭时你可以去游泳。

examples.en: Shoes mended while you wait (= on a shop sign)
examples.zh: 在你等候的时候修好的鞋

examples.en: While Tom's very good at science, his brother is absolutely hopeless.
examples.zh: 汤姆很擅长理科，而他的弟弟绝对是不可救药。

examples.en: Some people work better to music while others do not.
examples.zh: 有些人在音乐的陪伴下工作得更好，而另一些人则不然。

senses.def: although; despite the fact that…

examples.en: While I am willing to help, I do not have much time available.
examples.zh: 尽管我愿意帮忙，但是没有多少时间。

senses.def: used to suggest that somebody could do something while they are doing something else
senses.zh: 趁做某事的时候；顺便；顺带

examples.en: ‘I'm just going to buy some postcards.’ ‘Can you get me some stamps while you're at it?’
examples.zh: “我正想去买明信片。”“你能顺便给我买些邮票吗？”

senses.def: a period of time

examples.en: I only stayed for a short while.
examples.zh: 我只待了一小会儿。

examples.en: They chatted for a while.
examples.zh: 他们聊了一会儿。

examples.en: I haven't seen him for quite a while (= a fairly long time).
examples.zh: 我有好一阵子没有见到他了。

examples.en: He is fitter now than he has been for a long while.
examples.zh: 他现在比很长一段时间以来都更健康。

examples.en: After a while John started to relax a bit.
examples.zh: 过了一会儿约翰开始放松了一些。

examples.en: I'll be back in a little while (= a short time).

examples.zh: 我们一时冲动买了这所房子。

examples.en: My duties seem to change daily at the whim of the boss.
examples.zh: 我的职责似乎随着老板的兴致每天改变。

examples.zh: 那孩子迷了路，抽抽搭搭地哭起来。

examples.zh: “别丢下我不管。”他呜咽着说。

senses.def: a low, weak sound that a person or an animal makes when they are hurt, frightened or sad

examples.zh: 小狗害怕地小声呜咽。

examples.zh: 她疼得哭出了声。

examples.en: The animal gave a pathetic little whimper.
examples.zh: 这只动物低声呜咽，令人怜悯。

examples.en: The whole affair ended less with a bang than with a whimper (= in a way that was not impressive).

senses.def: unusual and not serious in a way that is either funny or annoying

senses.def: to complain in an annoying, crying voice

intro.zh: 以上各词均含对人或事物感到恼怒、不高兴或不满之义。

examples.zh: 我要就这件事向经理投诉。

examples.zh: 学生走上街头抗议这项决定。

items.def: to say that you disagree with something or think it is bad; to give something as a reason for objecting:
items.zh: 指不同意、不赞成、反对或抗辩

examples.en: If nobody objects, we’ll postpone the meeting till next week.
examples.zh: 如果没有人反对，我们就把会议推迟到下周。

items.def: (rather informal, disapproving) to complain about somebody/​something, especially something that is not really very serious:
items.zh: 尤指为不太严重的事情发牢骚、咕哝、嘟囔

examples.en: They kept grumbling that they were cold.
examples.zh: 他们不停地嘟囔着说冷。

examples.zh: 我们在办公室兜兜转转，给她买了一份临别礼物。

examples.zh: 关于维生素的好消息和坏消息让公众左右为难。

examples.zh: 落叶在风中旋转。

examples.zh: 她猛地转过身子面对着他。

examples.zh: 他们低头躲避直升机旋转的桨叶。

examples.zh: 她脑子里乱糟糟的。

examples.zh: 她的生活就是接连不断的聚会。

examples.zh: 很容易被纷繁的社交活动缠得脱不开身。

examples.zh: 她对他简直是太疯狂了。

examples.en: I'm not wild about the idea.
examples.zh: 我对这个想法不太感兴趣。

senses.def: affected by storms and strong winds

examples.zh: 暴风雨之夜

examples.en: The sea was wild.
examples.zh: 大海波涛汹涌。

examples.zh: 我连做梦都没想到会再见他。

senses.def: (1837-76) a famous frontiersman
senses.zh: “狂野的比尔”希科克（1837-76）：美国狂野西部著名的边裁。他的真名是James Butler Hickok。在加入布法罗·比尔（Buffalo Bill）的《狂野西部表演》（Wild West Show，1872-4年）之前，他曾在堪萨斯州的几个城镇担任法务官。然后，他搬到了南达科他州戴德伍德，在那里他被枪杀并在打牌时被杀。

senses.def: a wild pig
a card that has no value of its own and takes the value of any card that the player chooses
senses.zh: （由持牌人自由决定牌值的）百搭牌，变牌

senses.def: an opportunity for somebody to play in a competition when they have not qualified in the usual way; a player who enters a competition in this way
senses.zh: “外卡”参赛，“外卡”选手（指没有正常参赛资格而参赛）

examples.en: He was given a wild card for the tournament.
examples.zh: 他获得了参加锦标赛的外卡参赛机会。

examples.en: She was beaten in the semi-finals by wild card Louise Smith.
examples.zh: 她在半决赛中被外卡选手路易斯·史密斯击败。

senses.def: a symbol that can represent any letter or number

examples.en: An asterisk is commonly used as a wild card.
examples.zh: 星号常常被用作通配符。

examples.en: a wild-card search
examples.zh: 通配符搜索

senses.def: a person or thing whose behaviour or effect is difficult to predict
senses.zh: 难以预测的人（或事物）；未知因素；未知数

examples.en: The Nationalist party is the wild card in the election.
examples.zh: 国民党是此次选举的未知因素。

senses.def: with eyes that express strong and uncontrolled
senses.zh: （人，动物因惊恐或绝望而）两眼圆睁的；两眼发直的

examples.en: a wild-eyed gunman
examples.zh: 眼露凶光的枪手

examples.en: wild-eyed look of desperation
examples.zh: 绝望的眼神

senses.def: too extreme; not sensible or realistic
senses.zh: 过于极端的；不明智的；不现实的

examples.en: a wild-eyed fanatic
examples.zh: 狂热的狂热分子

examples.en: It was dismissed as just another wild-eyed conspiracy theory.
examples.zh: 它被斥为又一个疯狂的阴谋论。

senses.def: a search for something that is impossible for you to find or that does not exist, that makes you waste a lot of time
senses.zh: 徒劳的寻找；白费力气的追逐

examples.en: The police had been sent on a wild goose chase.
examples.zh: 警察被派去进行徒劳的追捕。

senses.def: a grain that is produced by a type of North American grass and is used as food; the plant that produces this grain
a type of rough silk
a show in which performers create the atmosphere and characters of the Wild West
senses.zh: 狂野西部表演：表演者与牛仔和美洲原住民一起营造狂野西部的氛围和人物的表演。他们骑马，射击对象并展示其他西方技巧。这类表演在19世纪末期特别受欢迎，当时它们经常在大帐篷中进行。最著名的是布法罗·比尔（Buffalo Bill）的“狂野西部秀”，他参加了美国许多城市和欧洲。

senses.def: a wildcat strike
senses.zh: （罢工）未经工会同意的，突然自发进行的

examples.en: Agreement was reached after several days of wildcat strikes.
examples.zh: 经过几天的自发罢工后达成协议。

examples.en: The aim of the law is to prevent wildcat stoppages.
examples.zh: 该法律的目的是防止随意停工。

senses.def: that has not been carefully planned and that will probably not be successful; that does not follow normal standards and methods
senses.zh: （计划不周密而）不稳妥的；不按正常标准的

senses.def: to look for oil in a place where nobody has found any yet
a type of small wild cat that lives in mountains and forests
senses.zh: 野猫（生活在山区或森林里）

senses.def: a person who looks for oil in a place where nobody has found any yet
a large antelope

examples.en: a herd of wildebeest
examples.zh: 一群牛羚

senses.def: a large area of land that has never been developed or used for growing crops because it is difficult to live there
senses.zh: 未开发的地区；荒无人烟的地区；荒野

examples.en: The Antarctic is the world's last great wilderness.
examples.zh: 南极洲是世界上最后一个大荒原。

examples.en: a wilderness area (= one where it is not permitted to build houses or roads)
examples.zh: （政府划定的）保留自然环境面貌地区

examples.en: the barren wilderness of modern life
examples.zh: 现代生活贫瘠的荒漠

senses.def: a place that people do not take care of or control
senses.zh: 荒芜的地方；杂草丛生处

examples.en: Their garden is a wilderness of grass and weeds.
examples.zh: 他们的花园杂草丛生。

examples.en: That part of the city is a wilderness of run-down houses and derelict factories.
examples.zh: 该市的那一区域很荒僻，到处是破败的住房和废弃的工厂。

examples.en: They transformed the wilderness into a garden.
examples.zh: 他们把荒地变成了花园。

senses.def: a position that is no longer important, especially in politics

examples.en: the man who brought the party back from the political wilderness
examples.zh: 使该党重获执政地位的人

examples.en: After three years in the wilderness she was given a government post.
examples.zh: 担任闲职三年后她得到了一个政府职位。

examples.en: His wilderness years (= when he was out of politics and the public eye) in the 1990s were spent in Canada.
examples.zh: 20 世纪 90 年代他在加拿大度过了坐冷板凳的日子。

senses.def: a very big fire that spreads quickly and burns natural areas like woods, forests and grassland

examples.en: Firefighters are battling devastating wildfires in northern California.
examples.zh: 消防队员正在与加州北部毁灭性的野火作斗争。

senses.def: to become known by more and more people very quickly
senses.zh: 像野火般蔓延；迅速传开

examples.en: Rumours of his death spread like wildfire.
examples.zh: 有关他去世的谣言像野火般迅速传开。

examples.en: The news spread like wildfire.
examples.zh: 消息不胫而走。

senses.def: a flower growing in natural conditions, not planted by somebody
birds that people hunt for sport or food, especially birds that live near water such as ducks
senses.zh: （尤指生活在水边被人猎食的）野禽，野鸭，野鹅

senses.def: animals, birds, insects, etc. that are wild and live in a natural environment

examples.en: policies designed to protect wildlife
examples.zh: 为保护野生动物制定的政策

examples.en: Development of the area would endanger wildlife.
examples.zh: 开发这一地区将会危及野生动物。

examples.en: a wildlife habitat
examples.zh: 野生动物栖息地

examples.en: a wildlife refuge/sanctuary
examples.zh: 野生动物保护区

senses.def: a long narrow piece of land that is left in a natural state, in order to connect populations of wildlife that are otherwise separated by land that is farmed, roads, etc.
senses.zh: 生态廊道（保持自然状态的狭长地带，以连接被耕地、公路等分隔的野生动物活动区域）

examples.en: It is important to protect wildlife corridors in order to ensure diversity in animal populations.
examples.zh: 保护生态廊道以确保动物种群的多样性，是非常重要的。

senses.def: in a way that is not controlled

examples.en: She looked wildly around for an escape.
examples.zh: 她环顾四周，拼命寻找逃路。

examples.en: His heart was beating wildly.
examples.zh: 他的心脏剧烈地跳着。

examples.en: Interest rates have been fluctuating wildly.
examples.zh: 利率一直剧烈波动。

senses.def: extremely; very

examples.en: The story had been wildly exaggerated.
examples.zh: 这件事被过分地夸大了。

examples.en: It is not a wildly funny play.
examples.zh: 这并不是一出太滑稽的戏剧。

senses.def: the quality in scenery

examples.en: the wildness and beauty of the Scottish hills
examples.zh: 苏格兰山丘的野性和美丽

senses.def: the quality in an animal of behaving in a natural way that has not been controlled or changed by people

examples.en: the dog's initial wildness
examples.zh: 狗最初的野性

senses.def: behaviour that shows a lack of discipline or control
senses.zh: 缺乏管教的；无法无天的；放荡的

examples.en: He gained a reputation for drinking and wildness.
examples.zh: 他因酗酒和狂野而闻名。

senses.def: the quality in feelings of being very strong and hard to control
senses.zh: 野性：非常强烈且难以控制的感觉品质

examples.en: the wildness of his passion
examples.zh: 他的热情狂野

senses.def: the quality of being exciting because it is surprising, new or not known
senses.zh: 野性：令人惊讶，新奇或未知的令人兴奋的品质

examples.en: In fashion, a little bit of wildness is attractive.
examples.zh: 在时尚界，一点点野性是有吸引力的。

senses.def: weather conditions in which there are strong winds or storms

examples.en: All around us there was the wildness of the wind.
examples.zh: 我们周围都是狂野的风。

senses.def: clever tricks that somebody uses in order to get what they want or to make somebody behave in a particular way

examples.en: She used all her feminine wiles on Sam in order to get her way.
examples.zh: 为了达到自己的目的，她对山姆使用了所有的女性诡计。

senses.def: (1899-1935) a US pilot of early aircraft. He was the first person to fly around the world alone, in 1933. He died with his passenger, Will Rogers
senses.zh: 威利邮政：（1899-1935）美国早期飞机的飞行员。1933年，他是独自一个人环游世界的第一人。当飞机失事在阿拉斯加的巴罗角附近时，他与乘客威尔·罗杰斯一起去世。

senses.def: (1893-1918) an English poet who fought in the First World War
senses.zh: 威尔弗雷德·欧文（Wilfred Owen）：（1893-1918）是一位英国诗人，曾在第一次世界大战中作战，其诗作涉及战争的恐怖及其造成的生命浪费。战争结束前一周他被杀，两年后，他的朋友齐格弗里德·沙宣（Siegfried Sassoon）发表了他的诗。欧文的六首诗以本杰明·布里顿（Benjamin Britten）的《战争安魂曲》（War Requiem）（1962年）中的音乐为背景。

senses.def: done deliberately, although the person doing it knows that it is wrong

examples.en: wilful damage
examples.zh: 蓄意破坏

examples.en: The report concluded that her death was a result of wilful neglect.
examples.zh: 报告的结论是，她的死亡是故意疏忽造成的。

senses.def: determined to do what you want; not caring about what other people want

examples.en: a wilful child
examples.zh: 任性的孩子

senses.def: deliberately, although you know that what you are doing is wrong
senses.zh: 故意：故意，尽管您知道自己在做什么是错误的

examples.en: They were charged with wilfully neglecting their children.
examples.zh: 他们被指控故意对孩子疏于照管。

senses.def: the determined desire to do what you want without caring what other people want or feel

examples.en: the wilfulness and arrogance of human nature
examples.zh: 人性的任性和傲慢

senses.def: (1824-89) an English writer of novels. His most famous novels are The Woman in White
senses.zh: 威尔基·柯林斯（Wilkie Collins）：（1824-89）英国小说作家。他最著名的小说是《白衣女人》（1860）和《月光石》（1868），被认为是第一部真正的英语侦探小说。

senses.def: to want or like

examples.en: Call it what you will, it's still a problem.
examples.zh: 不管怎么说，这仍然是个问题。

senses.def: to use the power of your mind to do something or to make something happen

examples.en: As a child he had thought he could fly, if he willed it enough.
examples.zh: 他小时候曾经以为，只要有足够的决心，想要飞就能飞起来。

examples.en: She willed her eyes to stay open.
examples.zh: 她使劲睁着眼睛。

examples.en: He willed himself not to panic.
examples.zh: 他竭力让自己不要恐慌。

senses.def: to intend or want something to happen

examples.en: They thought they had been victorious in battle because God had willed it.
examples.zh: 他们以为自己打了胜仗是上帝的旨意。

senses.def: to formally give your property or possessions to somebody after you have died, by means of a will
senses.zh: 立遗嘱将（财产等）赠与（某人）；立遗嘱赠与

examples.en: Joe had willed them everything he possessed.
examples.zh: 乔把自己拥有的一切都遗赠给了他们。

examples.en: Joe had willed everything he possessed to them.
examples.zh: 乔把自己拥有的一切都遗赠给了他们。

senses.def: used for talking about or predicting the future

examples.en: You'll be in time if you hurry.
examples.zh: 你要是抓紧一点儿就会来得及。

examples.en: How long will you be staying in Paris?
examples.zh: 你将在巴黎待多久？

examples.en: Fred said he'd be leaving soon.
examples.zh: 弗雷德说他很快就要走了。

examples.en: By next year all the money will have been spent.
examples.zh: 到明年所有的钱都将花光了。

senses.def: used for asking somebody to do something

examples.en: Will you send this letter for me, please?
examples.zh: 请你替我把这封信寄出去行吗？

examples.en: You'll water the plants while I'm away, won't you?
examples.zh: 我外出的时候请你给花草浇浇水，行不行？

examples.en: I asked him if he wouldn't mind calling later.
examples.zh: 我问他能否过会儿再来电话。

senses.def: used for inviting somebody to do something

examples.en: Will you join us for lunch?
examples.zh: 和我们一起吃午饭好吗？

senses.def: used for showing that somebody is willing to do something

examples.en: I'll check this letter for you, if you want.
examples.zh: 你要是愿意，我会给你查查这封信的。

examples.en: They won't lend us any more money.
examples.zh: 他们不愿再借给我们钱了。

examples.en: He wouldn't come—he said he was too busy.
examples.zh: 他不愿来，他说他太忙。

examples.en: We said we would keep them.
examples.zh: 我们说过要保存它们的。

senses.def: used for ordering somebody to do something

examples.en: You'll do it this minute!
examples.zh: 你现在就要做这事！

examples.en: Will you be quiet!
examples.zh: 安静点儿！

senses.def: used for stating what you think is probably true

examples.en: That'll be the doctor now.
examples.zh: 这会儿准是医生来了。

examples.en: You'll have had dinner already, I suppose.
examples.zh: 我想，到时候你大概已经吃过饭了。

senses.def: used for stating what is generally true

examples.en: If it's made of wood it will float.
examples.zh: 这要是木材做的就能浮在水面上。

examples.en: Engines won't run without lubricants.
examples.zh: 没有润滑油发动机就不能运转。

senses.def: used for stating what is true or possible in a particular case
senses.zh: （叙述在某种情况下是真实或可能的事）

examples.en: This jar will hold a kilo.
examples.zh: 这个罐子能盛一千克。

examples.en: The door won't open!
examples.zh: 那扇门就是打不开！

senses.def: used for talking about habits

examples.en: She'll listen to music, alone in her room, for hours.
examples.zh: 她总是独自一个人在屋里听音乐，一听就是几个小时。

examples.en: He would spend hours on the telephone.
examples.zh: 他一打电话往往就是几个小时。

senses.def: used in questions with I
senses.zh: （用于带有 I 的问题中，表示主动提议或建议）

examples.en: Will I call back later?
examples.zh: 我回头再打电话好吗？

senses.def: the ability to control your thoughts and actions in order to achieve what you want to do; a strong and determined desire to do something that you want to do

examples.en: to have a strong will
examples.zh: 有坚强的意志

examples.en: to have an iron will/a will of iron
examples.zh: 有钢铁般的意志

examples.en: Her decision to continue shows great strength of will.
examples.zh: 她决心坚持下去，显示出了很强的意志力。

examples.en: The matter became a battle of wills between the king and the barons.
examples.zh: 这件事成了国王和男爵们之间的意志较量。

examples.en: The meeting turned out to be a clash of wills.
examples.zh: 这次会议结果成了一次意志的角力。

examples.en: The government lacked the political will to reform the tax system.
examples.zh: 政府缺乏改革税收制度的政治决心。

examples.en: In spite of what happened, he never lost the will to live.
examples.zh: 尽管有如此遭遇，他从未丧失活下去的意志。

senses.def: what somebody wants to happen in a particular situation

examples.en: They governed according to the will of the people.
examples.zh: 他们顺应民意执政。

examples.en: He thought he was doing the will of God.
examples.zh: 他认为他正在遵行上帝的旨意。

examples.en: I was forced to sign the agreement against my will.
examples.zh: 我被迫违心地签了这份协议。

examples.en: I don't want to go against your will.
examples.zh: 我不想违背您的意愿。

examples.en: Much against my will, I let him go.
examples.zh: 我很不情愿地让他走了。

examples.en: She always wants to impose her will on other people (= to get what she wants).
examples.zh: 她总是想把自己的意志强加于人。

examples.en: It is God's will.
examples.zh: 这是上帝的旨意。

examples.en: She came of her own will (= because she wanted to), not forced by Antony.
examples.zh: 她是自愿来的，而不是安东尼强迫的。

senses.def: a legal document that says what is to happen to somebody’s money and property after they die

examples.en: I ought to make a will.
examples.zh: 我应该立份遗嘱。

examples.en: My father left me the house in his will.
examples.zh: 我父亲在遗嘱中把这所房子遗赠给了我。

examples.en: She did not leave a will.
examples.zh: 她没有留下遗嘱。

examples.en: On March 25, 1616 William Shakespeare revised his last will and testament.
examples.zh: 1616 年 3 月 25 日，威廉·莎士比亚修改了他的遗嘱。

examples.en: Some things cannot be given away by will (= in a will).
examples.zh: 有些东西无法通过遗嘱赠予。

senses.def: having the type of will

examples.en: a strong-willed young woman
examples.zh: 意志坚强的年轻女子

examples.en: weak-willed greedy people
examples.zh: 意志薄弱而贪婪的人

senses.def: whenever or wherever you like

examples.en: They were able to come and go at will.
examples.zh: 他们能够来去自由。

examples.en: She believes employers should have the right to hire and fire at will.
examples.zh: 她认为雇主有权随意雇用和开除员工。

senses.def: if you really want to do something then you will find a way of doing it
used to say that you cannot do something, even though you really want to
senses.zh: 尽管已尽心竭力；尽管真心愿意

examples.en: With the best will in the world I could not describe him as a good father.
examples.zh: 尽管我心里极想美言几句，却怎么也不能说他是位好父亲。

senses.def: in a willing and enthusiastic way

examples.en: They set to work with a will.
examples.zh: 他们劲头十足地开始工作。

senses.def: a first name for boys, short for William

examples.zh: 他们能够来去自由。

examples.en: She believes employers should have the right to hire and fire at will.
examples.zh: 她认为雇主有权随意雇用和开除员工。

examples.zh: 尽管我心里极想美言几句，却怎么也不能说他是位好父亲。

senses.def: a popular US television comedy series, which started in 1998, about Grace and her male best friend, Will, who is gay
senses.zh: 威尔与格蕾丝（Will and Grace）：美国受欢迎的电视喜剧系列节目，始于1998年，讲述了格蕾丝（Grace）和她最好的男性朋友威尔（同性恋）的故事。

senses.def: a service by which items, especially tickets, can be paid for and then collected later
senses.zh: 预售寄存服务（为顾客保存已付款商品，待以后领取）

examples.en: Up to the day of the event, will-call is located at the main Ticket Office.
examples.zh: 到活动当天为止，在主售票处提供预订票领取服务。

examples.en: He was standing in the will-call line to collect two tickets.
examples.zh: 他在预售票队列排队领取两张票。

senses.def: a thing that is impossible to obtain; a person that you cannot depend on
senses.zh: 难以捉摸的人（或事物）；镜花水月；虚无之物

senses.def: a blue light that is sometimes seen at night on soft, wet ground and is caused by natural gases burning
(1879-1935) a US entertainer, sometimes called the ‘ cowboy
senses.zh: 威尔·罗杰斯（Will Rogers）：（1879-1935）是美国的艺人，有时也被称为“牛仔哲学家”。他以对政客和新闻事件的敏锐而幽默的评论而闻名。他于1916年在齐格菲歌舞团（Ziegfeld Follies）综艺节目中广为人知，后来拍了许多电影，包括州博览会（1933）和汽船圆弯（1935）。他还写了一篇幽默的专栏文章，刊登在许多报纸上。

senses.def: (1876-1947) a US writer of novels, short stories and poetry. She began as a teacher and journalist. Her stories were often about the US West. She won the Pulitzer Prize
senses.zh: 威拉·凯瑟（Willa Cather）：（1876-1947）美国小说，短篇小说和诗歌作家。她开始担任老师和新闻记者。她的故事经常是关于美国西部的。她因《我们的一个》（1922年）和《大主教的死亡来》（1927年）而获得普利策奖。

senses.def: (1904-97) a US artist, born in the Netherlands. He went to the US in 1926 and soon became a leader in the abstract expressionism
senses.zh: 威廉·德·库宁（Willem de Kooning）：（1904-97）美国艺术家，出生于荷兰。他于1926年前往美国，并很快成为抽象表现主义运动的领导者。他用鲜艳的色彩和巨大的能量画出了大画。他还对绘画人的形式感兴趣，如他的系列《女人IV》（1952-3）。

senses.def: done deliberately, although the person doing it knows that it is wrong

examples.en: willful damage
examples.zh: 故意损坏

senses.def: determined to do what you want; not caring about what other people want

examples.en: a willful child
examples.zh: 任性的孩子

senses.def: a first name for boys
the main character in a series of stories by Richmal Crompton
senses.zh: 威廉（William）：Richmal Crompton的一系列故事中的主角。他是一名中产阶级的英语小学生，并且是Outlaws的领袖，Outlaws是一群经历有趣的冒险并经常遇到麻烦的孩子。

senses.def: a style of furniture that was popular in Britain at the end of the 17th century, during the reign
senses.zh: 威廉和玛丽（William and Mary）：一种家具风格，在17世纪末威廉姆三世（King William III）和玛丽皇后（Queen Mary）统治时期（即国王时期）在英国流行。优雅的桌子，椅子和橱柜上刻有木头的图案是典型的风格。

senses.def: (1757-1827) an English artist and poet who from childhood claimed to have visions
senses.zh: 威廉·布雷克（William Blake）：（1757-1827）是一位英国艺术家和诗人，从小就声称自己有远见并与天上的生物对话。他很有个人风格，充满宗教符号。他制作了自己的作品的“有启发性的书”，其中包含他的诗歌和绘画以手工完成。其中最著名的是《纯真与经验之歌》（1794）。他最著名的诗是《耶路撒冷》（1804）和《泰格》。他一生非常贫穷，被埋葬在伦敦一个普通的坟墓里。他的画作收藏最多的是泰特美术馆。

senses.def: (1914-97) a US writer of the beat generation
senses.zh: 威廉·伯劳斯（William Burroughs）：（1914-97）美国一代跳动作家。他的经历经常反映在他的同性恋和吸毒者的经历中。他最著名的小说是《裸午餐》（The Naked Lunch，1959年）。

senses.def: (1543-1623) an English composer
senses.zh: 威廉·伯德（William Byrd）：（1543-1623）英国作曲家，以宗教音乐闻名。他是托马斯·塔利斯（Thomas Tallis）的学生，也是都铎时期最伟大的音乐家之一。尽管他是罗马天主教徒，但他还为英格兰教会创作了许多音乐。

senses.def: (c. 1422-91) the man who set up the first printing firm in Britain. He printed his first book in 1474. By printing books in English, Caxton had a strong influence on the spelling and development of the language. Many of the books he published were French stories which he translated himself.
senses.zh: 威廉·卡克斯顿（约 1422–1491）英国首家印刷所的创办者。1474 年印刷了第一本书。因印制英语书籍而对英语拼写及发展产生深远影响。出版的书多为他本人翻译的法语故事。

senses.def: (1763-1835) an English political journalist who became a leader of the movement towards modern democracy
senses.zh: 威廉·科贝特（William Cobbett）：（1763-1835）一位英国政治记者，成为英国现代民主运动的领导者。他将大部分工作发表在自己的杂志《政治名册》上，其中还包含了议会辩论的摘要，后来发展成为现代的《议事录》。他对权威的频繁攻击经常使他陷入麻烦，包括两年监禁。他是一个农民的儿子，今天以他的著作《乡村骑术》（Rural Rides，1830年）着称，该书描述了1832年《改革法案》之前英国乡村的生活和贫穷的农场工人的状况。

senses.def: Buffalo Bill
(1670-1729) an English writer of plays, which are fine examples of Restoration comedy
senses.zh: 威廉·康格雷夫（William Congreve）：（1670-1729）英国戏剧作家，是恢复喜剧的典范。他最著名的戏剧是《世界之道》（1700年）。

senses.def: (1731-1800) an English poet whose work is simpler and more natural than most 18th-century English poetry. He was very unhappy for most of his life, and much of his work is sad. His best-known works are hymns
senses.zh: 威廉·考珀（William Cowper）：（1731-1800）英国诗人，其作品比大多数18世纪英国诗歌更简单，更自然。在他的一生中，他非常不高兴，他的大部分工作都很悲伤。他最著名的作品是赞美诗，例如《神秘地走动的上帝》。

senses.def: (1897-1962) one of the most important US writers of novels and short stories in the 20th century. He won the Nobel Prize
senses.zh: 威廉·福克纳（1897–1962）20 世纪美国最重要的长篇和短篇小说作家之一。1949 年获诺贝尔文学奖。作品多设定在虚构的密西西比州约克纳帕塔法县，描写没落的富贵家庭。文字精彩但艰深难懂。作品有《喧哗与骚动》（1929）、《寓言》（1954）和《掠夺者》（1962），后两部作品获普利策奖。

senses.def: (1809-98) an English liberal
senses.zh: 威廉·格拉德斯通（William Gladstone）：（1809-98）一位英国自由派政治家，曾四次出任总理（1868-74、1880-85、1886和1892-4）。他最初是议会的保守党议员，但后来离开了自由党，在1867年成为自由党的领导人。他和他的竞争对手Disraeli是30多年来英国政治的主要人物。格拉德斯通负责改善英国的生活：他秘密地进行了投票，将投票权赋予了大多数男人（而不是女性），并赋予了所有儿童受教育的权利。他还认为，大英帝国的国家应该统治自己，爱尔兰应该拥有自治权，但是他在实现这些目标之前就死了。

senses.def: (1911-93) an English writer of novels. He is best known for his first novel, Lord of the Flies
senses.zh: 威廉·戈尔丁（(1911-93) 英国小说作家。他最著名的是他的第一部小说《蝇王》(1954)。像他的许多其他作品一样，它关注人类的残酷行为。他凭借小说《人生仪式》(1980)获得布克奖，并于1983年获得诺贝尔文学奖。1988年被封为爵士。）

senses.def: William Hubbs Rehnquist (1924-2005) the Chief Justice of the US Supreme Court
senses.zh: 威廉·H·伦奎斯特（William H Rehnquist）：威廉·哈布斯·伦奎斯特（William Hubbs Rehnquist，1924-2005年）美国最高法院首席大法官（1986-2005年）。在此之前，他是美国司法部的首席法律顾问（1969-71）和最高法院的法官（1971-86）。他被罗纳德·里根（Ronald Reagan）任命为首席大法官，在他的领导下，法院变得更加保守（反对很多政治和社会变革）。约翰·罗伯茨（John Roberts）被任命接替他。

senses.def: William Henry Seward (1801-72) the US Secretary of State
senses.zh: 威廉·H·苏厄德（William H Seward）：美国国务卿威廉·亨利·苏厄德（William Henry Seward，1801-72年）说服政府于1867年以720万美元的价格从俄罗斯购买了阿拉斯加。它之所以被称为苏厄德的愚蠢，是因为许多人认为为如此空旷，冰冷的地区付出如此高昂的代价是愚蠢的。苏厄德（Seward）在亚伯拉罕·林肯（Abraham Lincoln，1861-5年）任国务卿期间，在林肯遇害时幸免于谋杀。然后他在安德鲁·杰克逊（Andrew Jackson）（1865-9）的领导下成为国务卿。阿拉斯加的一个小镇以他的名字命名。

senses.def: (1882-1959) a US admiral
senses.zh: 威廉·哈尔西（William Halsey）：（1882-1959）美国海军上将（高级海军军官），他在第二次世界大战期间赢得了南太平洋的胜利。他从密苏里号战舰上指挥了盟军（1942-4）和美国第三舰队（1944-5）。Halsey的流行名称是“牛”。

senses.def: (1578-1657) an English doctor who first discovered how blood flows around the body
senses.zh: 威廉·哈维（William Harvey）：（1578-1657）一位英国医生，他首先发现血液如何在身体周围流动

senses.def: (1778-1830) an English writer and critic, best known for his essays and lectures. He expressed strong, often harsh
senses.zh: 威廉·哈兹利特（William Hazlitt）：（1778-1830）是一位英国作家和评论家，以他的论文和演讲而闻名。他表达了强烈的，常常是苛刻的观点，尤其是对其他作家的观点。他最著名的作品包括莎士比亚戏剧的角色（1817-18），餐桌谈话（1821）和时代精神（1825）。

senses.def: (1738-1822) a British astronomer
senses.zh: 威廉·赫歇尔（William Herschel）：（1738-1822）英国天文学家，出生于德国。他最初是一名音乐家，但后来通过用自己制造的望远镜研究天空而成为一名天文学家。他发现了天王星，这是自古以来第一个被确认的新行星，并证明了双星的存在。成为乔治三世国王的正式天文学家后，他于1816年被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1744-1797) an English artist who travelled with Captain Cook
senses.zh: 威廉·霍奇斯（William Hodges）：（1744-1797）是一位英国艺术家，他与库克船长一起乘船前往太平洋（1772-75），为风景，冰山和人们绘制和绘画照片他看见

senses.def: (1697-1764) an English painter and engraver
senses.zh: 威廉·霍加斯（William Hogarth）：（1697-1764）英国画家和雕刻师，以讲道德故事的绘画作品而闻名，例如《耙子的进步》（1733） -5）和婚姻模式（1743-5）。他在伦敦奇斯威克（Chiswick）的房子现在是博物馆。

senses.def: (1827-1910) an English Pre-Raphaelite
senses.zh: 威廉·霍尔曼·亨特（William Holman Hunt）：（1827-1910）英国拉斐尔前派画家。他的照片大多是乡村风景或圣经的风景，其中许多包含道德信息。其中最著名的两个是《世界之光》（1854年）和《替罪羊》（1855年）。

senses.def: (1857-1930) the 27th US President (1909-13). He was a Republican
senses.zh: 威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱（William Howard Taft）：（1857-1930）第27任美国总统（1909-13）。他是共和党人，此前曾担任美国战争大臣（1904年）。作为总统，他创建了劳工部，并继续执行西奥多·罗斯福总统的外交政策。他后来担任最高法院首席大法官（1921-30），并且是唯一担任过美国政府两个不同部门的负责人的人。

senses.def: (c. 1027-87) the king of England from 1066 to 1087. He was the Duke of Normandy, in northern France, when the English king Edward the Confessor
senses.zh: 威廉一世（约 1027–1087）法国诺曼底公爵，英格兰国王（1066–1087 在位）。英王忏悔者爱德华死后，威廉声称爱德华曾承诺由他继位。1066 年，攻入英格兰，在黑斯廷斯战役中击败已即位的英王哈罗德二世，并在同年晚些时候登基。威廉将英格兰的权力和土地分封给诺曼人，并大量修建城堡来控制英格兰人民。

senses.def: (c.1056-1100) the king of England from 1087 to 1100. He became king when his father William I
senses.zh: 威廉二世：（1056-1100年）1087年至1100年的英格兰国王。他的父亲威廉一世去世后，他成为国王。他是一个熟练的领导者，但是他试图从男爵和教会那里取钱使他不受欢迎。他在狩猎时死于一场事故，但许多人认为他被谋杀了，以便他的兄弟亨利一世成为国王。由于头发的颜色，他被称为Rufus，意为红色。

senses.def: (1650-1702) the king of Great Britain and Ireland from 1688 to 1702. He was a Dutch prince, married to Mary, the daughter of James II
senses.zh: 威廉三世（William III）（1650-1702）从1688年至1702年是英国和爱尔兰国王。他是荷兰王子，嫁给了詹姆斯二世的女儿玛丽。他们被英国新教徒邀请担任英国国王和王后，以防止罗马天主教詹姆斯二世成为国王。威廉在不流血的革命中成为国王，并在博因战役中击败了詹姆斯二世在爱尔兰的部队。他被北爱尔兰的一群新教徒铭记，他们反对爱尔兰成为一个共和国，并自称为橘人。

senses.def: (1765-1837) the king of Great Britain and Ireland from 1830 to 1837. He was the son of George III
senses.zh: 威廉四世（William IV）（1765-1837）从1830年至1837年是英国和爱尔兰国王。他是乔治三世的儿子，在皇家海军度过了多年。人们还记得他曾与一位女演员生过十个私生子（即婚外生的孩子）。他最重要的行动是创建50个辉格党新成员，投票反对反对该法案的议会保守党。

senses.def: William Joseph Brennan (1906-97) a US Supreme Court
senses.zh: 威廉·J·布伦南（William J Brennan）初中：威廉·约瑟夫·布伦南（1906-97）是美国最高法院法官（1956-90），他以自由主义的见解以及对个人自由和少数群体权利的大力支持而闻名。在1990年，他负责一项法院判决，该判决称政府不能制止侮辱或毁坏美国国旗的人，因为那会限制他们的自由。

senses.def: (1860-1925) a US politician known for his great skill as a public speaker. His famous 'Cross of Gold' speech in 1896 supported the idea that US coins should be made of silver. Bryan was very religious and at the Scopes trial
senses.zh: 威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩（William Jennings Bryan）：（1860-1925）以出色的演讲能力而闻名的美国政治家。他在1896年著名的“黄金十字勋章”演讲中支持美国硬币应由银制成的观点。Bryan非常虔诚，在Scopes审判中，他反对进化论。从1913年到1915年，他曾担任美国国务卿。

senses.def: (c. 1685-1748) an English painter and architect who also designed gardens and the insides of houses. He studied in Rome and helped to introduce Palladianism
senses.zh: 威廉·肯特（William Kent）：（约1685-1748年）是一位英国画家和建筑师，他还设计了花园和房屋内部。他在罗马学习，并帮助向英国介绍了Palladianism（一种意大利建筑风格）。伦敦设计了许多公共建筑，包括财政部建筑。现在，他以他设计的花园而闻名。在其中，他介绍了一种更为自然和非正式的风格，并被誉为现代园艺之父。他的室内设计可以在伯灵顿故居和诺里奇附近的霍克汉姆厅看到。

senses.def: (c. 1330-c. 1386) an English poet whose only known work is Piers Plowman
senses.zh: 威廉·兰兰德（William Langland）：（c。1330-c。1386）英国诗人，其唯一出名的作品是Piers Plowman，这首诗描述了一个人寻求真理的精神之旅。

senses.def: (1811-63) an English writer best known for his long historical novel Vanity Fair
senses.zh: 威廉·马克·和平·沙克雷（William Makepeace Thackeray）：（1811-63）一位英国作家，以其悠久的历史小说《名利场》而闻名。他还是一名记者，经常以许多不同的名字为《 Punch》和其他杂志撰稿。他的其他成功小说包括《彭登尼斯史》（1848-50）和《弗吉尼亚人》（1858-9）。

senses.def: (1823-78) a New York City political leader, known as 'Boss' Tweed, who became a symbol for dishonest behaviour in city politics. In the 1860s he was the leader of Tammany Hall
senses.zh: 威廉·马西·特威德（William Marcy Tweed）：（1823-78）纽约市政治领导人，被称为“老板”特威德，他成为城市政治中不诚实行为的象征。在1860年代，他曾是Tammany Hall的负责人，并经营着“ Tweed Ring”，该圈从想要与市政府开展业务的公司中非法接收了数百万美元。他终于被免职，死于监狱。

senses.def: (1830-1902) a Scottish poet whose Poetic Gems
senses.zh: 威廉·麦格教授（William McGonagall）：（1830-1902）是一位苏格兰诗人，其诗歌诗集于1890年出版。他的诗没有技巧或对诗歌的理解，但因此很受欢迎且很有趣。一个例子是他给乔治吉拉芬牧师的致辞：

senses.def: (1843-1901) the 25th US President (1897-1901). He was a US officer during the Civil War
senses.zh: 威廉·麦金莱：（1843-1901）第25任美国总统（1897-1901）。他在内战期间是美国军官，是共和党人，曾两次在美国众议院任职（1877-83年和1885-91年），并担任俄亥俄州州长（1892-6年）。在他担任总统期间，美国的权力大大提高。他支持西班牙裔美国人与中国的战争和贸易，并创造了美国历史上最高的关税。他被无政府主义者谋杀。

senses.def: (1834-96) an English designer, artist, poet, businessman and socialist
senses.zh: 威廉·莫里斯（William Morris）：（1834-96）英国设计师，艺术家，诗人，商人和社会主义者。作为一名艺术家和诗人，他受到拉斐尔前派的影响，但他最著名的是家具和房屋装饰设计师。他不喜欢那个时代的大规模生产方法，并希望传统工匠的作用继续下去。他建立了自己的公司，该公司使用传统方法生产手工家具和室内装饰。这些设计中的许多，特别是用于墙纸和织物的设计，至今仍在使用。他对传统方法的信念使莫里斯（Morris）参与了手工艺运动。他还创办了Kelmscott出版社，以继续传统的印刷方法。作为英国早期的社会主义者之一，莫里斯是社会变革的支持者，并于1884年成立了自己的社会主义同盟。

senses.def: (1324-1404) the bishop
senses.zh: Wykeham的William：（1324-1404）从1367年到1404年的温彻斯特主教。他以建立温彻斯特学院而闻名，他的学生仍被称为Wykehamists。

senses.def: (1644-1718) an English Quaker
senses.zh: 威廉·佩恩（William Penn）：（1644-1718）英国贵格会成员，在查理二世国王赐予他的土地上建立了宾夕法尼亚州的美国殖民地。他为奎克派（Quakers）和所有其他宗教团体提供了一个安全的地方，并将其称为“神圣的实验”。他还帮助创建了费城。

senses.def: (1759-1806) the youngest man ever to become Prime Minister of Britain (at the age of 24). He was Prime Minister from 1783 to 1801 and again from 1804 to 1806. His achievements included removing much of the corruption
senses.zh: 威廉·皮特（William Pitt）：（1759-1806）成为英国首相（24岁）的最年轻的男人。他在1783年至1801年担任总理，并在1804年至1806年再次担任总理。他的成就包括从英国政治中消除了许多腐败现象，并改善了该国的财务状况。他还开征所得税，并负责《联合法案》（1800年），爱尔兰通过该法案成为英国的一部分。他经常被称为“小皮特”，而他的父亲查塔姆伯爵被称为“老皮特”。

senses.def: (1863-1951) a very rich American who owned newspapers, magazines, radio stations and two film companies. He used yellow journalism
senses.zh: 威廉·兰道夫·赫斯特（William Randolph Hearst）：（1863-1951）是一位非常富有的美国人，拥有报纸，杂志，广播电台和两家电影公司。他在报纸上使用黄色新闻来增加销量。他的《纽约日报》在1890年代与约瑟夫·普利策（Joseph Pulitzer）拥有的《纽约世界》（New York World）展开了激烈竞争，并且都鼓励了美西战争以帮助销售。赫斯特在加利福尼亚建造了圣西蒙城堡，作为他的家。奥森·威尔斯（Orson Welles）根据赫斯特的生平改编了他的电影《公民凯恩》。

senses.def: (1908-81) a US author of novels, plays and more than 400 short stories. He wrote about ordinary people and refused the Pulitzer Prize
senses.zh: 威廉·萨罗扬（William Saroyan）：（1908-81）是美国小说，戏剧和400多个短篇小说的作者。他撰写关于平民百姓的文章，并因其剧本《生命的时光》（1939年）而获得普利策奖，因为他不希望有钱人支持艺术。Saroyan最著名的小说是The Human Comedy（1943）。

senses.def: (1564-1616) the English poet and playwright
senses.zh: 威廉·莎士比亚（1564–1616）英国诗人和剧作家，常被称为最伟大的英语作家。出生于埃文河畔斯特拉特福，一个富有的手套工匠和商人的儿子。1582 年与安妮·哈瑟维结婚，育有三个孩子。1588 年移居伦敦，加入著名的宫廷大臣剧团。很快成为著名剧作家，并在环球剧院出演自己的戏剧。莎士比亚为伦敦舞台创作了 36 个剧本，包括《仲夏夜之梦》、《皆大欢喜》等喜剧，《哈姆雷特》、《奥赛罗》、《麦克白》、《罗密欧与朱丽叶》等悲剧，《理查二世》、《亨利四世》等历史剧以及两部传奇剧《冬天的故事》和《暴风雨》。这些剧作主要为诗体，因其诗意的语言、戏剧技巧和文学风格而备受推崇。他还写诗，其中最有名的是《十四行诗集》，以语言优美、情感热烈著称。莎士比亚于 1611 年前后回到埃文河畔斯特拉特福，1616 年去世。今天，他的戏剧仍经常在世界各地上演。在英国，莎剧常由皇家莎士比亚剧团在伦敦环球剧院以及埃文河畔斯特拉特福和全国各地演出。每年，斯特拉特福都会在最接近莎士比亚诞辰日 4 月 23 日的周末举办庆祝活动，来自世界各地的人们会向莎士比亚墓献花。

senses.def: (1844-1930) an English clergyman
senses.zh: 威廉·斯普纳（William Spooner）：（1844-1930）英国牧师（英格兰教会的牧师）和牛津大学老师。他以习惯于在讲话时不停改变两个或两个以上单词的发音而闻名，因此他可能会说“错误的肝脏”而不是“漫长的河水”。这种短语通常很幽默，被称为“傻瓜主义”。

senses.def: (1907-2003) a US cartoonist
senses.zh: 威廉·史蒂格（William Steig）：（1907-2003）是美国漫画家和儿童读物作家，他的漫画在《纽约客》杂志上广为人知，其中包括117种封面。他的孩子们的书包括史瑞克（1990），该书在2001年成功制作成动画电影。

senses.def: (1925-2006) a US writer of powerful novels. He received the Pulitzer Prize
senses.zh: 威廉·斯泰伦（(1925-2006) 美国著名小说家。他因《纳特·特纳的自白》(1967) 获得普利策奖，一些人批评该书基于非裔美国奴隶纳特·特纳领导的叛乱而讲述的暴力故事。斯泰伦的其他小说包括《在黑暗中躺下》(1951)和《苏菲的选择》(1979)，后者成为一部成功的电影(1982)。）

senses.def: (1820-91) a US military leader during the Civil War
senses.zh: 威廉·特库姆舍·谢尔曼（William Tecumseh Sherman）：（1820-91）南北战争期间的美国军事领导人。谢尔曼将军指挥美国西部军队（1864-5）。最令人记忆深刻的是，他与6万名士兵一起穿越佐治亚州，摧毁了可能对南方战争有用的任何东西，包括军事装备，工厂，铁路，房屋和农场动物。战后，1879年，他发表了著名的声明：“战争就是地狱”

senses.def: William I
(1824-1907) a British physicist
senses.zh: 威廉·汤姆森（William Thomson）：（1824-1907）英国物理学家和发明家。他在热力学定律方面做了很多工作，并于1848年制造了一个温度标尺，后来被称为开尔文标尺。他还在磁性和电力领域做过重要工作。他发明了许多科学仪器，特别是在海上使用，并参与了在大西洋下铺设第一条电缆的工作。他于1866年被任命为骑士，并于1892年被任命为男爵。

senses.def: (c. 1494-1536) an English writer who translated the Bible. His work as a translator
senses.zh: 威廉·廷代（William Tyndale）：（约1494-1536年）是一位翻译圣经的英国作家。他的翻译工作在英国遭到反对，他被迫住在德国，在那里他于1525年至1531年间制作了第一本英语版本的圣经。后来成为1611年詹姆士国王版的基础。他被活活烧死在比利时作为异端。

senses.def: (c. 1270-1305) a Scottish soldier. He led an army against the English forces of King Edward I
senses.zh: 威廉·华莱士（William Wallace）：（约1270-1305年）苏格兰士兵。他领导一支军队抵抗占领苏格兰的爱德华一世国王的英军，并于1297年在斯特林桥击败了他们。第二年，华莱士在爱尔华克（Falkirk）被爱德华击败，后来被俘虏并被绞死。电影《勇敢的心》（1995）讲述了他的一生。

senses.def: (1902-83) an English composer
senses.zh: 威廉·沃尔顿：（1902-83）英国作曲家。他最著名的作品包括Façade（1923）和oratorio（代表大型声音和管弦乐队的音乐）Belshazzar的Feast（1931），这两个词均由Sitwell家族的成员撰写。沃尔顿（Walton）还写歌剧，管弦乐队的作品和电影音乐，包括亨利五世（1944）和哈姆雷特（1948）。他在1951年被任命为骑士。

senses.def: (1759-1833) an English politician, best known for his successful campaigns to stop the slave trade and to make slavery
senses.zh: 威廉·威尔伯福斯（William Wilberforce）：（1759-1833）英国政治家，以成功制止奴隶贸易和在大英帝国将奴隶制定为非法而闻名。

senses.def: (1770-1850) one of the most popular of all English poets who, together with Samuel Taylor Coleridge
senses.zh: 威廉·华兹华斯（William Wordsworth）：（1770-1850）是所有英国诗人中最受欢迎的诗人之一，他与塞缪尔·泰勒·科尔里奇（Samuel Taylor Coleridge）一起发起了英国诗歌的浪漫运动。他的诗主要是关于自然之美及其与全人类的关系。其中许多人描述了英格兰西北部湖区的乡村，他出生并度过了大部分时间。他最著名的作品包括《抒情歌谣》（1798年），这是他本人和科尔里奇的诗集；《诗歌》（1807年），其中包括《水仙花和死亡率的寓言》，以及《前奏曲》，这是一首关于他的早期生活和强烈情感的长诗。然后是自然经验，在他去世后于1850年出版。他一生的大部分时间都与妹妹多萝西（1771-1855）一起住在湖区，他对他产生了很大的影响，并在一起记录了他们的生活日记。当他住在格拉斯米尔的鸽子小屋时，他写下了许多他最著名的诗。这所房子现在是博物馆和受欢迎的旅游胜地。

senses.def: (1640-1716) an English writer of Restoration comedy
senses.zh: 威廉·威彻利（William Wycherley）：（1640-1716）英国恢复喜剧剧作家。他最著名的戏剧是《乡村妻子》（The Country Wife，1675年），该剧至今仍在播放，其主题是当时那个时代社会的不道德行为。

senses.def: (1902-81) a US film director, born in Germany and known for his great attention to detail. He won Oscars
senses.zh: 威廉·威勒（William Wyler）：（1902-81）美国电影导演，出生于德国，以对细节的关注着称。他因导演米妮弗夫人（1942），《我们生命中的最佳岁月》（1946）和本·胡尔（1959）而获得奥斯卡奖。他的其他电影包括《呼啸山庄》（1939年），《罗马假日》（1953年），《大乡村》（1958年）和《滑稽女郎》（1968年）。

senses.def: the common name for Williams F1 (Williams Formula One), a British company that makes racing cars and organizes teams of drivers, mechanics
senses.zh: 威廉姆斯（Williams）：威廉姆斯F1（威廉姆斯一级方程式）的总称，这是一家英国公司，生产赛车并组织驾驶员，机械师等团队参加比赛。它由弗兰克·威廉姆斯（Frank Williams）和帕特里克·海德（Patrick Head）于1977年成立，一直是赛车界最成功的车队之一。它的全名是Williams Grand Prix Engineering Limited。

senses.def: a historic US town in south-eastern Virginia
senses.zh: 威廉斯堡（Williamsburg）：位于弗吉尼亚州东南部的美国历史名镇。它于1633年定居为中间种植园，但很快以英国国王威廉三世的名字命名。1699年至1779年，这里是殖民地的首府。威廉和玛丽学院于1693年在那建立。这个18世纪的小镇在1930年代重新建造为威廉斯堡殖民地，如今受到游客的欢迎。

senses.def: a word for a penis
(1931-2003) the most successful US professional jockey
senses.zh: 威利鞋匠（Willie Shoemaker）：（1931-2003年）有史以来最成功的美国职业骑师。他的俗名是“鞋”。1949年至1990年之间，他在40 351场比赛中赢得了8 833场比赛，其中包括在肯塔基州德比四场比赛中的胜利。

senses.def: in a way that shows you are happy or pleased to do something or that you do not object to doing something
senses.zh: 愿意：以某种方式表明您对某件事感到高兴或高兴，或者您不反对做某事

examples.en: People would willingly pay more for better services.
examples.zh: 有好一些的服务，人们是愿意多花钱的。

examples.en: I would never willingly upset you.
examples.zh: 我绝不会心甘情愿地让你难过。

senses.def: used to say that you are happy or pleased to do something
senses.zh: 乐于：曾经说过您对某事感到高兴或高兴

examples.en: ‘Will you help me?’ ‘Willingly.’
examples.zh: “你愿意帮我个忙吗？”“当然愿意。”

senses.def: the quality of being happy and ready to do something

examples.en: Success in studying depends on a willingness to learn.
examples.zh: 乐于学习才能学业有成。

senses.def: a tree with long, thin branches and long, thin leaves, that often grows near water
the wood of the willow
senses.zh: 柳木（常用以制作板球拍）

senses.def: a first name for girls
a design that is often seen on English pottery

senses.zh: 温斯洛·荷马（Winslow Homer）：（1836-1910）是一位以水彩闻名的美国画家。他们表达了强烈的美国精神，并在19世纪末影响了其他美国画家。他绘制了美国生活，海洋景观和海洋景象，尤其是在新英格兰和佛罗里达州，例如Cannon Rock（1895）和Gulf Stream（1899）。在他职业生涯的早期，他为《哈珀周刊》（Harper's Weekly）画了内战场景。

senses.def: (1874-1965) a politician who is remembered as one of Britain's greatest statesmen
senses.zh: 温斯顿·丘吉尔（Winston Churchill）（1874-1965）是一位政治家，被公认为是英国最伟大的政治家之一。他是保守派政治家兰道夫·丘吉尔勋爵和他的美国妻子珍妮的儿子。他年轻时曾在印度和埃及当过兵，并在南非当过新闻记者。从1900年到1965年，他是五个不同选区的国会议员。他起初是一个保守派，1904年改为自由党，1925年回到保守党。1906年至1929年间，他在政府中担任许多重要职务，但与当时的一般感觉背道而驰，反对希特勒提高德国政权的举动。武器供应。当内维尔·张伯伦（Neville Chamberlain）在1940年被迫辞职时，丘吉尔成为总理和国防部长。他在第二次世界大战期间的广播讲话使英国人民有坚强的决心赢得这场战争，特别是在严重危机时期。由丘吉尔领导的保守党在1945年大选中失败，但他于1951年至1955年再次退休，享年80岁。他于1953年被授予骑士勋章，同年他获得诺贝尔奖。文献。丘吉尔也是一位熟练的画家。他以抽大雪茄和为“胜利”制作V形手势而闻名。他经常被简单地称为“温妮”，在英国和美国都被深深地怀念。1963年，国会授予他名誉美国公民。但他在1951年至1955年退休时再次出任总理，享年80岁。他于1953年获封为骑士，同年获得诺贝尔文学奖。丘吉尔也是一位熟练的画家。他以抽大雪茄和为“胜利”制作V形手势而闻名。他经常被简单地称为“温妮”，在英国和美国都被深深地怀念。1963年，国会授予他名誉美国公民。但他在1951年至1955年退休时再次出任总理，享年80岁。他于1953年获封为骑士，同年获得诺贝尔文学奖。丘吉尔也是一位熟练的画家。他以抽大雪茄和为“胜利”制作V形手势而闻名。他经常被简单地称为“温妮”，在英国和美国都被深深地怀念。1963年，国会授予他名誉美国公民。
