examples.en: He was forced to withdraw from the competition because of injury.
examples.zh: 他因伤被迫退出比赛。

examples.en: The horse had been withdrawn from the race.
examples.zh: 那匹马被停赛了。

senses.def: to stop giving or offering something to somebody

examples.en: Workers have threatened to withdraw their labour (= go on strike).
examples.zh: 工人扬言要罢工。

examples.en: He withdrew his support for our campaign.
examples.zh: 他停止了对我们运动的支持。

examples.en: Unless you return the form within seven days, the offer will be withdrawn.
examples.zh: 除非您在 7 天内退回表格，否则优惠将被撤回。

examples.en: The drug was withdrawn from sale after a number of people suffered serious side effects.
examples.zh: 这药因许多人服后产生严重副作用而被停止销售。

senses.def: to say that you no longer believe that something you previously said is true
senses.zh: 收回，撤回，撤销（说过的话）

examples.en: The newspaper withdrew the allegations the next day.
examples.zh: 这家报纸第二天收回了这些说法。

examples.en: Last night he unconditionally withdrew his comments.
examples.zh: 昨天晚上，他无条件地收回了自己的评论。

senses.def: to become quieter and spend less time with other people

examples.en: She's beginning to withdraw into herself.
examples.zh: 她开始变得不爱与人交往了。

examples.en: She withdrew into her own world.
examples.zh: 她把自己封闭在个人的天地里。

senses.def: the act of taking an amount of money out of your bank account

examples.en: You can make withdrawals of up to $250 a day.
examples.zh: 你一天最多可以从银行账户中提取 250 美元。

examples.en: She made a withdrawal of £250 from her bank account.
examples.zh: 她从银行账户上提取了 250 英镑。

senses.def: the act of moving or taking something away or back

examples.en: the withdrawal of support
examples.zh: 不再支持

examples.en: the withdrawal of the UN troops from the region
examples.zh: 联合国部队从该地区的撤离

examples.en: the withdrawal of a product from the market
examples.zh: 从市场上召回一种产品

senses.def: the act of no longer taking part in something or being a member of an organization

examples.en: his withdrawal from the election
examples.zh: 他从选举中退出

examples.en: Britain’s withdrawal from the EU
examples.zh: 英国退出欧盟

senses.def: the period of time when somebody is getting used to not taking a drug that they have become addicted

examples.en: I got withdrawal symptoms after giving up smoking.
examples.zh: 我戒烟之后出现了脱瘾症状。

examples.en: She was still suffering withdrawal from nicotine.
examples.zh: 她仍然在忍受戒烟之苦。

senses.def: the act of saying that you no longer believe that something you have previously said is true

examples.en: The newspaper published a withdrawal the next day.
examples.zh: 报纸第二天发表了撤销声明。

senses.def: the behaviour of somebody who wants to be alone and does not want to communicate with other people

examples.en: She is showing signs of withdrawal and depression.
examples.zh: 她表现出孤僻与消沉的现象.

senses.def: if a plant withers

examples.en: The grass had withered in the warm sun.
examples.zh: 这些草在温暖的阳光下枯死了。

examples.en: The grass withered under a scorching sun.
examples.zh: 草在灼热的阳光照射下枯萎了。

senses.def: to become less or weaker, especially before disappearing completely
senses.zh: 萎缩；（尤指渐渐）破灭，消失

examples.en: All our hopes just withered away.
examples.zh: 我们所有的希望都渐渐破灭了。

senses.def: in a way that is intended to make somebody feel silly or ashamed
senses.zh: 尖刻的；使人难堪的；令人无地自容的

senses.def: to refuse to give something to somebody

examples.en: She was accused of withholding information from the police.
examples.zh: 她被指控对警方知情不报。

examples.en: Payment was withheld until the work was completed.
examples.zh: 直到工作完成后才付款。

examples.en: The government was threatening to withhold future financial aid.
examples.zh: 政府在威胁停止未来的财政援助。

senses.def: (in the US) an amount of money that is taken out of somebody’s income as tax and paid directly to the government
senses.zh: 预扣税（由雇主代扣并直接交给政府）

senses.def: before a particular period of time has passed; during a particular period of time
senses.zh: 不出（某段时间）；在（某段时间）之内

examples.en: You should receive a reply within seven days.
examples.zh: 你会在七天之内收到答复。

examples.en: The ambulance arrived within minutes of the call being made.
examples.zh: 打电话后几分钟内救护车就到了。

examples.en: Two elections were held within the space of a year.
examples.zh: 在一年的时间之内举行了两次选举。

senses.def: not further than a particular distance from something
senses.zh: 不出（某段距离）；在（某段距离）之间

examples.en: a house within a mile of the station
examples.zh: 离车站不到一英里的一所房子

examples.en: Is it within walking distance?
examples.zh: 那里步行走得到吗？

senses.def: inside the range or limits of something
senses.zh: 不出（某范围或限度）；在（某范围）之内

examples.en: That question is not within the scope of this talk.
examples.zh: 那个问题不在本次会谈范围之内。

examples.en: We are now within range of enemy fire.
examples.zh: 我们现在处于敌人的火力射程以内。

examples.en: He finds it hard to live within his income (= without spending more than he earns).
examples.zh: 他觉得靠自己的收入生活难以为继。

senses.def: inside something/somebody

examples.en: The noise seems to be coming from within the building.
examples.zh: 吵闹声像是从楼房里传出来的。

examples.en: There is discontent within the farming industry.
examples.zh: 农业界内部存在不满。

examples.en: Despite her grief, she found a hidden strength within herself.
examples.zh: 尽管悲伤，她还是发现了自己内心隐藏的力量。

senses.def: inside

examples.en: Cleaner required. Apply within. (= on a sign)
examples.zh: 招聘清洁工。应聘者请进。

senses.def: close to something

examples.en: The house is within easy reach of schools and sports facilities.
examples.zh: 这房子距离学校和体育设施都很近。

examples.en: Verona and Padua are both within easy reach for day trips.
examples.zh: 维罗纳和帕多瓦都可以轻松前往一日游。

examples.en: a holiday town within reach of Marseilles
examples.zh: 离马赛很近的一个度假小镇

senses.def: near enough to be able to hear something

examples.en: a house within sound of the sea
examples.zh: 听得见海浪声的房子

within an ace of doing: @@@LINK=within an ace of something/of doing something
within an ace of doing something: @@@LINK=within an ace of something/of doing something
within an ace of doing sth: @@@LINK=within an ace of something/of doing something
within an ace of something doing: @@@LINK=within an ace of something/of doing something
within an ace of something doing somethi: @@@LINK=within an ace of something/of doing something
within an ace of something doing sth: @@@LINK=within an ace of something/of doing something

senses.def: very close to something

examples.en: We came within an ace of victory.
examples.zh: 我们差点儿赢了。

within an ace of something/of doing some.word: within an ace of something/of doing something

within an ace of sth doing something: @@@LINK=within an ace of something/of doing something
within an ace of sth doing sth: @@@LINK=within an ace of something/of doing something
within an ace of sth/of doing sth: @@@LINK=within an ace of something/of doing something

senses.def: not far (from)

examples.en: There's loads of cheap accommodation within cooee of the airport.
examples.zh: 机场附近有很多便宜住处。

senses.def: near enough to hear somebody/something or to be heard

examples.en: As she came within earshot of the group, she heard her name mentioned.
examples.zh: 她刚走近到能听见这群人说话声时便听到有人提她的名字。

examples.en: He said nothing, for the policeman was still within earshot.
examples.zh: 他什么也没说，因为警察仍在听得见的范围内。

senses.def: to some extent
senses.zh: 在一定限度内；在一定程度上

examples.en: I'm willing to help, within limits.
examples.zh: 我愿意帮忙，可有一定的限度。

examples.en: The children can do what they like, within limits.
examples.zh: 孩子们可以在规定范围内做自己喜欢的事。

senses.def: very close

examples.en: We live within shouting distance of the bus station.
examples.zh: 我们住的地方离公交车站很近。

examples.en: We came within shouting distance of winning the cup.
examples.zh: 我们离赢得奖杯已经很近了。

senses.def: very close

examples.en: We live within spitting distance of the bus station.
examples.zh: 我们住的地方离公交车站很近。

examples.en: We came within touching distance of winning the cup.
examples.zh: 我们离赢得奖杯已经很近了。

senses.def: near enough to be reached or attacked easily; near enough to reach or attack something easily
senses.zh: 近在咫尺；在攻击距离之内

examples.en: The beach is within striking distance.
examples.zh: 海滩近在咫尺。

examples.en: The cat was now within striking distance of the duck.
examples.zh: 此时，猫就在可攻击鸭子的距离内。

senses.def: very close

examples.en: We came within touching distance of winning the cup.
examples.zh: 我们离赢得奖杯已经很近了。

examples.en: We live within spitting distance of the bus station.
examples.zh: 我们住的地方离公交车站很近。

senses.def: possible/not possible

examples.en: A successful outcome is not beyond the realms of possibility.
examples.zh: 最后并非没有可能成功。

examples.en: It is not beyond the bounds of possibility that we'll all meet again one day.
examples.zh: 我们大家将来有一天再度聚在一起，并非绝不可能。

senses.def: at a time, or during the time, that is remembered by people still alive
senses.zh: 在仍活着的人们的记忆中；记忆犹新

examples.en: the coldest winter in living memory
examples.zh: 人们记忆中最寒冷的冬天

senses.def: within/outside the limits of what a person, an organization, etc. is responsible for; dealt/ not dealt with by a document, law, etc.
senses.zh: 在（个人或组织等的）权限之内／之外；在（文件、法律等的）范围内／外

examples.en: Local disputes are outside the purview of this legislation.
examples.zh: 地方纠纷不属于该立法的管辖范围。

examples.en: The matter falls within the purview of the Select Committee.
examples.zh: 此事属于特别委员会的职权范围。

senses.def: a British comedy film (1986) about two young actors in the 1960s. They have no work, and spend most of their money on drink and drugs. When they leave London to spend some time in a small house in the Lake District
senses.zh: 一部英国喜剧电影（1986年），讲述1960年代两个年轻演员的故事。他们没有工作，大部分钱花在喝酒和吸毒上。当他们离开伦敦在湖区的一间小房子里待一会时，很多幽默来自于他们的态度和行为与他们在乡下遇到的人们的态度和行为之间的差异。

senses.def: not having, experiencing or showing something

examples.en: They had gone two days without food.
examples.zh: 他们两天没吃东西了。

examples.en: He found the place without difficulty.
examples.zh: 他毫不费力地找到了那地方。

examples.en: She spoke without much enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 她说话冷冰冰的。

senses.def: not in the company of somebody

examples.en: Don't go without me.
examples.zh: 别甩下我就走。

senses.def: not using or taking something

examples.en: Can you see without your glasses?
examples.zh: 你不戴眼镜能看见吗？

examples.en: Don't go out without your coat.
examples.zh: 别不穿大衣就出去。

senses.def: not doing the action mentioned

examples.en: He left without saying goodbye.
examples.zh: 他不辞而别。

examples.en: You can't make an omelette without breaking eggs.
examples.zh: 你不可能不打破鸡蛋就做成煎蛋卷。

examples.en: Without wanting to criticize, I think you could have done better. (= used before you make a critical comment)
examples.zh: 我不是想要批评谁，只是认为你本可以做得更好一些。

examples.en: The party was organized without her knowing anything about it.
examples.zh: 聚会已操办妥当，她却一无所知。

senses.def: not having or showing something

examples.en: Do you want a room with a bath or one without?
examples.zh: 你要不要带洗澡间的房间？

examples.en: If there's none left we'll have to do without.
examples.zh: 如果没有剩余的我们就只得将就了。

examples.en: I'm sure we'll manage without.
examples.zh: 我相信我们能凑合的。

without a by your leave: @@@LINK=without a by your leave; without so much as a by your leave

senses.def: without asking permission; rudely
senses.zh: 擅自；未经许可；粗鲁地；无礼地

examples.en: He walked straight in, without so much as a by your leave.
examples.zh: 他径直走了进来，甚至没有得到你的允许。

without a by your leave; without so much.word: without a by your leave; without so much as a by your leave

senses.def: immediately; without stopping to think about something further

examples.en: He dived in after her without a second thought.
examples.zh: 他不假思索地随她跳入水中。

examples.en: I accepted the offer without a second thought.
examples.zh: 我没有细想就接受了报价。

senses.def: without stopping what you are doing

examples.en: Marta scored from 20 metres without breaking stride.
examples.zh: 玛尔塔从20米远的地方不慌不忙地射门得分。

senses.def: in a very rough or informal way
senses.zh: 粗鲁无礼；不拘礼节；随便

examples.en: He found himself pushed without ceremony out of the house and the door slammed in his face.
examples.zh: 他被毫不客气地推出屋子，门砰的一声当着他的面关上了。

senses.def: without objecting or hesitating

examples.en: They accepted without demur.
examples.zh: 他们接受了，没有提出异议。

senses.def: not resulting in harm or damage to somebody/something

examples.en: This tax cannot be introduced without detriment to people’s living standards.
examples.zh: 这项税收政策一旦实施，将对人们的生活水平造成不利影响。

senses.def: used to emphasize that the statement you are making is always true and everyone or everything is included

examples.en: All students without exception must take the English examination.
examples.zh: 所有学生都必须参加英语考试，无一例外。

examples.en: Without exception, all employees must carry their identity card with them at all times.
examples.zh: 所有雇员无一例外地任何时候都要带着身分证。

senses.def: when you tell somebody to do something without fail

examples.en: I want you here by two o'clock without fail.
examples.zh: 我要你两点钟务必来到这里。

senses.def: always

examples.en: He hands in his assignment every week without fail.
examples.zh: 他每周都一定会交作业。

senses.def: in a fair way

examples.en: They undertook to make their judgement without fear or favour.
examples.zh: 他们承诺公正无私地做出判断。

senses.def: without delaying; immediately

examples.en: We set to work without further ado.
examples.zh: 我们立即开始工作。

senses.def: without being prevented from doing something; freely
senses.zh: 毫无阻碍；顺畅地；自由地

examples.en: New regulations will allow residents to travel between member states without let or hindrance.
examples.zh: 新规将允许居民自由地在成员国之间旅行。

examples.en: He should be able to view all records without let or hindrance.
examples.zh: 他应该能够毫无阻碍地查看所有记录。

senses.def: without a point at which something has to stop

examples.en: The debt is rising without limit.
examples.zh: 债务正在无限制地增加。

examples.en: She's a free spirit and lives her life without limits.
examples.zh: 她是个自由的人，过着无拘无束的生活。

senses.def: without affecting any other legal matter
senses.zh: 不损害其他权益；无损于合法权利

examples.en: They agreed to pay compensation without prejudice (= without admitting guilt).
examples.zh: 他们同意赔偿，但不承认有罪。

without rhyme or reason: @@@LINK=there’s no rhyme or reason to/for something | without rhyme or reason
without so much as a by your leave: @@@LINK=without a by your leave; without so much as a by your leave

senses.def: used when you are giving your opinion and emphasizing the point that you are making

examples.en: This meeting has been, without doubt, one of the most useful we have had so far.
examples.zh: 这无疑是我们迄今为止最有用的一次会议。

examples.en: Without the slightest doubt this is a remarkable exhibition.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，这是一次成功的展览会。

examples.en: She is without a doubt the best player I know.
examples.zh: 她无疑是我所知道的最佳运动员。

senses.def: to be strong enough not to be hurt or damaged by extreme conditions, the use of force, etc.

examples.en: The materials used have to be able to withstand high temperatures.
examples.zh: 所使用的材料必须能够耐高温。

examples.en: They had withstood siege, hunger and deprivation.
examples.zh: 他们经受了围困、饥饿和贫穷。

senses.def: silly or stupid; not sensible
to be extremely frightened or bored
senses.zh: 被吓破了胆；乏味得要命

senses.def: to be extremely frightened or bored
senses.zh: 被吓破了胆；乏味得要命

senses.def: a person who sees something happen and is able to describe it to other people

examples.en: He failed to interview a key witness.
examples.zh: 他没能采访关键的目击证人。

examples.en: Police have appealed for witnesses to the accident.
examples.zh: 警方呼吁这起事故的目击者出来作证。

examples.en: We have a witness to the killing.
examples.zh: 我们有凶杀案的目击者。

examples.en: According to witnesses, the man jumped out of his vehicle and attacked the other driver.
examples.zh: 据目击者称，该男子跳下车并袭击了另一名司机。

examples.en: She gave a witness statement to the police.
examples.zh: 她向警方作了证人陈述。

examples.en: Mark had to go into the witness protection programme to escape the violence.
examples.zh: 马克不得不加入证人保护计划以逃避暴力。

senses.group: person who sees something 目睹者

senses.def: a person who gives evidence in court

examples.en: a defence/prosecution witness
examples.zh: 被告的／控方的证人

examples.en: He was hired to be an expert witness in the trial.
examples.zh: 他被聘为审判的专家证人。

examples.en: to appear as (a) witness for the defence/prosecution
examples.zh: 出庭为被告／控方作证

examples.en: The defence called their first witness.
examples.zh: 被告传唤他们的第一个证人。

examples.en: Several witnesses testified that there had been two gunmen.
examples.zh: 几个目击者证实有两名持枪歹徒。

senses.def: a person who is present when an official document is signed and who also signs it to prove that they saw this happen

examples.en: He was one of the witnesses at our wedding.
examples.zh: 他是我们婚礼的证婚人之一。

examples.en: The will was signed in the presence of two witnesses.
examples.zh: 遗嘱是在两名见证人在场的情况下签署的。

examples.en: There was no witness to her signature.
examples.zh: 她的签名没有证人。

senses.def: evidence of a person’s strong religious beliefs, that they show by what they say and do in public
senses.group: of religious beliefs 宗教信仰

senses.def: to provide evidence of the truth of something

examples.en: The crowd of mourners at his funeral bore witness to the great affection in which he was held.
examples.zh: 葬礼上默哀的人群见证了他生前受到的爱戴。

examples.en: The ancient temples bear silent witness to the passing dynasties.
examples.zh: 这些古剎默默见证了历代的兴亡。

senses.group: of religious beliefs 宗教信仰

senses.def: to see something take place

examples.en: He has been witness to a terrible murder.
examples.zh: 他目击了一起残忍的凶杀事件。

examples.en: a witness to murder
examples.zh: 谋杀案目击者

senses.group: of religious beliefs 宗教信仰

senses.def: to show that something is true; to provide evidence for something

examples.en: His good health is a witness to the success of the treatment.
examples.zh: 他身体健康证明这种疗法是成功的。

senses.group: of religious beliefs 宗教信仰

senses.def: to see something happen (typically a crime or an accident)
senses.zh: 当场看到，目击（尤指罪行或事故）

examples.en: to witness an accident/a murder/an attack
examples.zh: 目击一场事故／谋杀／袭击

examples.en: Police have appealed for anyone who witnessed the incident to contact them.
examples.zh: 警方呼吁所有目击这一事件的人与他们联系。

examples.en: We are now witnessing an unprecedented increase in violent crime.
examples.zh: 我们现在亲眼看到暴力犯罪空前增多。

examples.en: She was shocked by the violent scenes she had witnessed.
examples.zh: 她被亲眼目睹的暴虐场面惊呆了。

examples.en: The novel is based on an event that he himself had witnessed.
examples.zh: 这部小说是根据他亲眼所见的事件改编的。

examples.en: I couldn’t bear to witness their suffering.
examples.zh: 我不忍心目睹他们的痛苦。

examples.en: We had witnessed one of the most outstanding theatrical performances of the decade.
examples.zh: 我们目睹了十年来最出色的戏剧表演之一。

examples.en: It's one of the strongest pieces of dance theatre I've ever witnessed.
examples.zh: 这是我见过的最强大的舞蹈剧之一。

senses.def: to be the place, period, organization, etc. in which particular events take place
senses.zh: 是发生…的地点（或时间、组织等）；见证

examples.en: Recent years have witnessed a growing social mobility.
examples.zh: 近年来人们的社会流动性越来越大。

examples.en: The retail trade is witnessing a sharp fall in sales.
examples.zh: 零售业的销售额在急剧下降。

examples.en: The last century witnessed an unprecedented increase in violent crime.
examples.zh: 暴力犯罪在上个世纪空前增多。

senses.def: to be present when an official document is signed and sign it yourself to prove that you saw this happen
senses.zh: （为正式文件的签署）作证，联署

examples.en: to witness a signature
examples.zh: 联署作证

examples.en: The document was witnessed by a lawyer.
examples.zh: 这份文件有律师作见证。

senses.def: to be a sign or proof of something

examples.en: The huge attendance figures for the exhibition witness to a healthy interest in modern art.
examples.zh: 从展览会参观人数之多可以看出，人们对现代艺术具有浓厚兴趣。

examples.en: There has been increasing interest in her life and work, as witnessed by the publication of two new biographies.
examples.zh: 从两部新传记的出版可以看出，人们对她的生活和工作越来越感兴趣。

senses.def: used when giving an example that proves something you have just said

examples.en: Authentic Italian cooking is very healthy—witness the low incidence of heart disease in Italy.

senses.def: a British women's magazine. It has been published once a month since 1926 and contains articles on subjects such as fashion, homes, cooking and travel
senses.zh: 女人与家：英国女性杂志。自1926年以来，该杂志每月出版一次，其中包含有关时装，住宅，烹饪和旅行等主题的文章

senses.def: a woman who is not white

examples.en: The organization works to advance women of color in politics.
examples.zh: 该组织致力于推动有色人种女性参政。

senses.def: a British radio programme on BBC Radio 4
senses.zh: 女人的时光：英国广播公司（BBC）第四台的英国广播节目，包括有关妇女的各种报道，谈话和小说。自1946年以来，该节目每天从星期一到星期五播出。在周末，本周节目中的某些节目在“周末妇女时间”中播出。

senses.def: a popular British women's magazine. It has been published once a week since 1932 and contains articles on subjects such as fashion, health, beauty and cooking, as well as news about famous people. It also contains short stories, mainly about love.
senses.zh: 女人的自己：英国一本流行的女性杂志。自1932年以来，该杂志每周出版一次，其中包含有关时尚，健康，美容和烹饪等主题的文章，以及有关名人的新闻。它还包含一些短篇小说，主要是关于爱情的。

senses.def: a popular British women's magazine. It has been published once a week since 1911 and consists of a mixture of true stories about people's lives, fictional
senses.zh: 《妇女周刊》：英国一本流行的女性杂志。自1911年以来，该杂志每周出版一次，内容包括有关人们生活的真实故事，虚构的爱情故事，有关名人的文章（例如电影明星）以及有关实用主题的文章（例如装修房屋，缝纫和编织）以及烹饪。它主要是由老年妇女阅读的。

senses.def: the state of being a woman, rather than a girl

examples.zh: 他看着自己的女儿们都长大成人了。

senses.def: women in general

senses.def: a man who has sexual relationships with many different women

examples.zh: 他以玩弄女性出名。

women in general

senses.def: the organ in women and female animals in which babies or young animals develop before they are born

examples.en: A scan determines the position of the baby in the womb.
examples.zh: 扫描检查可以确定胎儿在子宫中的位置。

examples.en: The baby's head was starting to emerge from the womb.
examples.zh: 婴儿的头开始从母亲的子宫中露出来。

senses.def: an Australian animal like a small bear, that carries its young in a pouch
senses.zh: 毛鼻袋熊（体形像熊的澳大利亚有袋动物）

senses.def: any of a group of imaginary animals with long fur and long noses. They live underground in a large London park and at night they come out to collect the rubbish that people have left behind. They were invented by the children's writer Elizabeth Beresford in her book The Wombles
senses.zh: 虚构的动物中的任何一个，具有长的毛皮和长的鼻子。他们住在伦敦一个大型公园的地下，到了晚上，他们出来收集人们留下的垃圾。它们是由儿童作家伊丽莎白·贝雷斯福德（Elizabeth Beresford）在她的《 The Wombles（1968）》中发明的，并在1970年代播放了儿童电视连续剧《 The Wombles》时大受欢迎。

senses.def: any of the local branches of the National Federation of Women's Institutes (itself sometimes referred to as the Women's Institute
senses.zh: 妇女协会：全国妇女协会联合会的任何地方分支机构（有时也称为妇女协会）。该组织始于1915年，旨在改善和发展生活在乡村地区的妇女的生活。每个分支机构都组织社交，文化和慈善活动，并举行会议，成员可以在其中学习与家庭有关的技能，例如烹饪。大多数小城镇和乡村地区都有妇女研究所。人们通常将组织与年龄较大的中产阶级妇女联系起来。电影《日历女孩》（2003年）是根据有关约克郡妇女协会成员的真实故事改编的。

senses.def: a person who supports Women's Liberation
senses.zh: 妇解分子；支持妇女解放运动的人

senses.def: the freedom of women to have the same legal, social and economic rights as men

senses.def: all the women in a community or family, especially one that is led by men
senses.zh: （一个集体或家庭的，尤指由男人领导的）女人们，妇女们

examples.zh: 男猎手们带回食物让他们的女人烹调。

to think about something and try to decide what is true, what will happen, what you should do, etc.

examples.en: ‘Why do you want to know?’ ‘No particular reason. I was just wondering.’
examples.zh: “你为什么想要知道？”“没有特殊原因。我就是想搞清楚。”

examples.en: I wonder who she is.
examples.zh: 我在想她到底是谁。

examples.en: I was just beginning to wonder where you were.
examples.zh: 我刚才正琢磨你上哪儿了呢。

examples.en: You have to wonder just what he sees in her.
examples.zh: 让人纳闷的是他到底看上她什么了。

examples.en: I can't help wondering whether I'm missing something here.
examples.zh: 我禁不住想我是不是错过什么了。

examples.en: Have you ever wondered what your cat really thinks of you?
examples.zh: 你有没有想过你的猫对你的真实想法是什么？

examples.en: I always wondered why you never got married.
examples.zh: 我一直想知道你为什么没结婚。

examples.en: I'm still wondering how that could have happened.
examples.zh: 我仍然想知道这是怎么发生的。

examples.en: I sometimes wonder where all this is going to end.
examples.zh: 有时我想知道这一切将在哪里结束。

examples.en: I often wonder what became of him.
examples.zh: 我常常想知道他后来怎么样了。

examples.en: We were wondering about next April for the wedding.
examples.zh: 我们寻思着下个四月举行婚礼可好。

examples.en: ‘Where's Natasha?’ he wondered aloud.
examples.zh: “娜塔莎在哪儿？”他大声问。

examples.en: I wonder if you can help me.

examples.en: I was wondering whether you'd like to come to a party.
examples.zh: 不知您能否来参加聚会。

senses.def: to be very surprised by something

examples.en: She wondered at her own stupidity.
examples.zh: 她没想到自己竟会这样愚蠢。

examples.en: He's gone and left us to do all the work, I shouldn't wonder (= I wouldn't be surprised if he had).
examples.zh: 他走了，把所有的活儿都留给我们干。我对此并不感到奇怪。

examples.en: I wonder (that) he didn’t hurt himself jumping over that wall.
examples.zh: 我纳闷他怎么从那墙上跳过去竟没摔伤自己。

examples.en: I don't wonder you're tired. You've had a busy day.
examples.zh: 你累了，这我一点儿不奇怪。你已经忙了一整天。

senses.def: a feeling of surprise and pleasure that you have when you see or experience something beautiful, unusual or unexpected

examples.zh: 他仍然有一种孩子般的好奇感。

examples.en: She gazed down in wonder at the city spread below her.
examples.zh: 她俯视展现在眼前的城市，惊叹不已。

examples.en: His eyes were filled with wonder at the sights before him.
examples.zh: 看着眼前的景象，他的眼中充满了惊叹。

examples.zh: 这座庙建于 1403 年，是建筑史上的奇迹。

examples.en: The Grand Canyon is one of the natural wonders of the world.

examples.en: the wonders of modern technology

examples.en: That's the wonder of poetry—you're always discovering something new.

examples.en: technological wonders

examples.en: Dita, you're a wonder! I would never have thought of doing that.
examples.zh: 蒂塔，你真神了！我从来想不到那样做。

examples.en: Have you seen the boy wonder play yet?

examples.en: a new wonder drug

senses.def: a young, upper-class person who is considered weak and stupid
senses.zh: 上流脓包；上流青年懦夫

examples.en: He is working on a new novel.
examples.zh: 他正在写一部新小说。

examples.en: She's outside, working on the car.
examples.zh: 她在外面修理汽车。

examples.en: I've been working at my assignment all day.
examples.zh: 我整天都在做作业。

examples.en: Work with a partner to solve the problem.
examples.zh: 跟搭档一起解决这个问题。

examples.en: We work closely with clients to develop specific solutions.
examples.zh: 我们同客户密切合作以制订具体的解决方案。

examples.en: Doctors often work very long hours.
examples.zh: 医生经常长时间工作。

examples.en: He works shifts at a metal plant.
examples.zh: 他在一家金属厂轮班工作。

senses.group: do job/task 做工；执行任务

senses.def: to have a job

examples.en: Both my parents work.
examples.zh: 我父母都工作。

examples.en: to work in an office/a factory
examples.zh: 在办公室/工厂工作

examples.en: She works for an engineering company.
examples.zh: 她在一家工程公司工作。

examples.en: My father wants me to work for him when I leave school.
examples.zh: 我父亲希望我离开学校后为他工作。

examples.en: I've always worked in education.
examples.zh: 我一直从事教育工作。

examples.en: He worked in the oil industry for twenty years.
examples.zh: 他在石油行业工作了二十年。

examples.en: Do you enjoy working with children?
examples.zh: 你喜欢做儿童工作吗？

examples.en: My son is working as a teacher.
examples.zh: 我的儿子是当老师的。

senses.group: do job/task 做工；执行任务

senses.def: to make efforts to achieve something

examples.en: She dedicated her life to working for peace.
examples.zh: 她为争取和平奉献了自己的一生。

examples.en: The committee is working to get the prisoners freed.
examples.zh: 委员会正在设法营救那些被监禁的人出狱。

examples.en: We have proved that different groups can work harmoniously together.
examples.zh: 我们已经证明，不同群体能够和谐共事。

examples.en: The police and the public need to work together to combat crime.
examples.zh: 警方和公众需要联手打击犯罪。

senses.def: to make yourself/somebody work, especially very hard
senses.zh: 使工作；（尤指）使卖力干活

examples.en: She works herself too hard.
examples.zh: 她工作起来太不辞劳苦了。

examples.en: He says they're working him hard.
examples.zh: 他说他们逼他拼命干活。

senses.def: to function; to operate

examples.en: The printer isn't working.
examples.zh: 这部打印机坏了。

examples.en: How does the device actually work?
examples.zh: 这台设备到底怎么运行？

examples.en: Are they any closer to understanding how the brain works?
examples.zh: 他们对大脑功能的了解有进展吗？

examples.en: It works by electricity.
examples.zh: 这是电动的。

examples.en: The filtration process works by physically removing the contaminants from the water.
examples.zh: 过滤过程通过物理方式去除水中的污染物。

senses.def: to make a machine, device, etc. operate
senses.zh: 开动，操作（机器、装置等）；使运作

examples.en: Do you know how to work the coffee machine?
examples.zh: 你会使用咖啡机吗？

examples.en: The machine is worked by wind power.
examples.zh: 这台机器是以风力推动的。

senses.def: to have the result or effect that you want
senses.zh: 奏效；产生预期的结果（或作用）

examples.en: The pills the doctor gave me aren't working.
examples.zh: 医生给我的药片不管事。

examples.en: My plan worked, and I got them to agree.
examples.zh: 我的计划奏效了，我让他们同意了。

examples.en: The system seemed to work well.
examples.zh: 这个系统似乎效果不错。

examples.en: Everything worked very smoothly.
examples.zh: 一切都进展非常顺利。

examples.en: His charm doesn't work on me (= does not affect or impress me).
examples.zh: 我不为他的魅力所动。

senses.def: to have a particular effect

examples.en: Your age can work against you in this job.
examples.zh: 你的年纪会妨碍你干这个工作。

examples.en: Speaking Italian should work in his favour.
examples.zh: 会说意大利语应对他有好处。

senses.def: to manage or operate something to gain benefit from it

examples.en: to work the land (= grow crops on it, etc.)
examples.zh: 耕种土地

examples.en: Boys who didn't go to school worked the land with their fathers.
examples.zh: 不上学的男孩跟父亲一起种田。

examples.en: He works a large area (= selling a company's goods, etc.).
examples.zh: 他负责一个大地区的工作。

examples.en: You have to learn how to work the system if you want to succeed.
examples.zh: 你如果想成功，就必须学会让制度为你所用。

examples.en: She was a skilful speaker who knew how to work a crowd (= to excite them or make them feel something strongly).
examples.zh: 她是个很有技巧的演讲者，善于感召听众。

senses.def: to make a material into a particular shape or form by pressing, stretching, hitting it, etc.
senses.zh: （通过压挤、拉长、锤击等）使成形，使定形

examples.en: to work clay
examples.zh: 制陶

examples.en: to work gold
examples.zh: 打制金器

examples.en: to work the mixture into a paste
examples.zh: 把混合物调成糊状

senses.def: to use a particular material to produce a picture or other item
senses.zh: 用某种材料作画（或编制、编织等）

examples.en: an artist working in oils
examples.zh: 油画画家

examples.en: a craftsman working with wool
examples.zh: 毛织手工艺人

senses.def: to move violently

examples.en: He stared at me in horror, his mouth working.
examples.zh: 他恐惧地盯着我，嘴在抽搐着。

senses.group: of part of face/body 脸／身体部位

senses.def: to move or pass to a particular place or state, usually gradually
senses.zh: （逐渐地）移动（到某位置）；（逐步）变成（某状态）

examples.en: It will take a while for the drug to work out of your system.
examples.zh: 这药需要一段时间才能从你体内排出。

examples.en: He worked his way to the top of his profession.
examples.zh: 他一步一步努力，终于成为行业内的翘楚。

examples.en: I was tied up, but managed to work myself free.
examples.zh: 我被捆绑起来，但设法挣脱了绳索。

examples.en: The screw had worked loose.
examples.zh: 这螺丝钉松动了。

senses.def: to arrange something in a particular way, especially by being clever

examples.en: Can you work it so that we get free tickets?
examples.zh: 你能不能为我们搞到些免费票？

senses.def: the job that a person does especially in order to earn money

examples.en: He started work as a security guard.
examples.zh: 他开始工作时做保安员。

examples.en: I'm still looking for work.
examples.zh: 我仍在找工作。

examples.en: It is difficult to find work in the present economic climate.
examples.zh: 在目前这种经济大气候下很难找到工作。

examples.en: She's planning to return to work once the children start school.
examples.zh: 她正计划孩子一入学就恢复上班。

examples.en: full-time/part-time/unpaid/voluntary work
examples.zh: 全职／兼职／无报酬的／志愿工作

examples.en: She had been out of work (= without a job) for a year.
examples.zh: 她已经失业一年了。

examples.en: They are in work (= have a job).
examples.zh: 他们有工作。

examples.en: What line of work are you in (= what type of work do you do)?
examples.zh: 你干哪种工作？

examples.en: She's been off work (= not going to work) with a bad back since July.
examples.zh: 她从七月份开始因为背部问题一直没上班。

senses.def: the place where you do your job; the time that you spend there

examples.en: I go to work at 8 o'clock.
examples.zh: 我 8 点钟去上班。

examples.en: I was late for work again.
examples.zh: 我又上班迟到了。

examples.en: I have to leave work early today.
examples.zh: 我今天得早点儿下班。

examples.en: Her friends from work came to see her in the hospital.
examples.zh: 她工作单位的朋友来医院看望她。

examples.en: I get on well with my work colleagues.
examples.zh: 我和同事相处得很好。

examples.en: a pleasant work environment
examples.zh: 愉快的工作环境

examples.en: The new legislation concerns health and safety at work.
examples.zh: 这项新法规涉及工作场所的健康与安全。

examples.en: I like to go for a run after work.
examples.zh: 我喜欢下班后去跑跑步。

senses.def: the duties that you have and the activities that you do as part of your job

examples.en: Police work is mainly routine.
examples.zh: 警察的工作主要都是按常规的。

examples.en: The accountant described his work to the sales staff.
examples.zh: 会计师向销售部的职员介绍了自己的职责。

senses.def: tasks that need to be done

examples.en: Taking care of a baby is hard work.
examples.zh: 照看婴儿是件苦差。

examples.en: Whenever am I going to do all this work?
examples.zh: 这么多活儿我什么时候才能干完？

examples.en: There is plenty of work to be done in the garden.
examples.zh: 花园里有很多活儿要干。

examples.en: Stop talking and get on with your work.
examples.zh: 别说话了，继续干你们的活儿吧。

examples.en: He completed the work shortly before his death.
examples.zh: 他在去世前不久完成了这项工作。

examples.en: important work being undertaken by volunteers
examples.zh: 志愿者正在进行的重要工作

examples.en: Big football matches make a lot of work for the police.
examples.zh: 大型足球赛事给警察带来大量的工作。

senses.def: materials needed or used for doing work
senses.zh: 工作所需的材料（或档案等）

examples.en: She often brings work (= for example, files and documents) home with her from the office.
examples.zh: 她经常把办公室里的工作带回家。

examples.en: His work was spread all over the floor.
examples.zh: 他工作的材料摊了一地。

senses.def: the use of physical strength or mental power in order to do or make something

examples.en: She earned her grades through sheer hard work.
examples.zh: 她的学习成绩完全是靠刻苦用功得来的。

examples.en: We began work on the project last year.
examples.zh: 我们去年开始做这个项目。

examples.en: They performed pioneering work on the treatment of cancer.
examples.zh: 他们在癌症治疗方面做出了开创性的工作。

examples.en: Work continues on renovating the hotel.
examples.zh: 修整这家旅馆的工作在继续。

examples.en: The work of building the bridge took six months.
examples.zh: 修建这座桥的工作用了六个月的时间。

examples.en: The art collection was his life's work.
examples.zh: 收集艺术品是他一生的工作。

examples.en: She set them to work painting the fence.
examples.zh: 她让他们粉刷围墙。

senses.def: a thing or things that are produced as a result of work

examples.en: She's an artist whose work I really admire.
examples.zh: 她这位艺术家的作品令我赞赏不已。

examples.en: outstanding work in this area/field
examples.zh: 这一领域的杰出工作

examples.en: Is this all your own work (= did you do it without help from others)?
examples.zh: 这件作品是你独立完成的吗？

examples.en: The book is a detailed and thorough piece of work covering all aspects of the subject.
examples.zh: 这本书包括了这一学科的方方面面，是一部缜密翔实的大作。

examples.en: He left a substantial body of work—drawings and watercolours as well as oils.
examples.zh: 他留下了大量作品——素描、水彩画以及油画。

senses.group: product of work 工作成果

senses.def: a book, piece of music, painting, etc.

examples.en: the collected/complete works of Tolstoy
examples.zh: 托尔斯泰选集／全集

examples.en: works of fiction/literature
examples.zh: 小说／文学作品

examples.en: Chopin’s piano works
examples.zh: 肖邦的钢琴曲

examples.en: Beethoven composed his greatest works in the latter part of his life.
examples.zh: 贝多芬在晚年创作了他最杰出的作品。

examples.en: He recognized the sketch as an early work by Degas.
examples.zh: 他认出这幅草图是德加的早期作品。

senses.def: the result of an action; what is done by somebody

examples.en: The damage is clearly the work of vandals.
examples.zh: 这毁损显然是些恣意破坏公物的人所为。

senses.group: result of action 行动结果

senses.def: activities involving building or repairing something

examples.en: roadworks
examples.zh: 道路施工

examples.en: They expanded the shipyards and started engineering works.
examples.zh: 他们扩建造船厂，开始了工程施工。

examples.en: A contract can ensure that landlords carry out the works for which they are legally responsible.
examples.zh: 合同可以确保房东开展他们负有法律责任的工程​​。

senses.def: a place where things are made or industrial processes take place

examples.en: an engineering works
examples.zh: 机器制造厂

examples.en: a brickworks
examples.zh: 砖厂

examples.en: Raw materials were carried to the works by barge.
examples.zh: 原材料由驳船运到工厂。

senses.def: the moving parts of a machine, etc.
senses.group: parts of machine 机器部件

senses.def: everything

examples.en: We went to the chip shop and had the works: fish, chips, gherkins, mushy peas.
examples.zh: 我们去薯条店吃了套餐：炸鱼、炸薯条、小黄瓜、豆泥。

senses.def: the use of force to produce movement
part of your normal working life and not unusual
senses.zh: 日常工作的一部分；习以为常；不足为奇

examples.en: Swimming with sharks or training a tiger cub—it's all in a day's work for animal wrangler Chris Bolton.
examples.zh: 与鲨鱼一起游泳或训练小老虎——这一切都是动物管理员克里斯·博尔顿 (Chris Bolton) 一天的工作。

senses.def: it is not healthy to spend all your time working; you need to relax too
senses.zh: 只工作不玩耍，聪明的孩子也变傻

senses.def: having an effect on something

examples.en: She suspected that secret influences were at work.
examples.zh: 她怀疑有些秘密势力在作祟。

senses.def: busy doing something

examples.en: He is still at work on the painting.
examples.zh: 他仍在忙着画那幅画。

examples.en: Danger—men at work.
examples.zh: 危险——施工进行中。

senses.def: people who do not have enough to do often start to do wrong

examples.en: She blamed the crimes on the local jobless teenagers. ‘The devil makes work for idle hands,’ she would say.
examples.zh: 她认为那些违法活动是当地的无业青少年所为，总是说：“人一闲，惹麻烦。”

senses.def: (to do) the unpleasant or dishonest jobs that somebody else does not want to do
senses.zh: （干）没人愿干的事，卑鄙的勾当

examples.en: Next time you can get somebody else to do your dirty work for you!
examples.zh: 下次你可以让别人帮你做肮脏的工作！

examples.en: He always gets someone else to do the dirty work for him.
examples.zh: 他总是让别人替他做卑鄙的勾当。

examples.en: The drugs gang used children to do their dirty work for them.
examples.zh: 贩毒团伙利用儿童为他们做违法的事。

senses.def: to begin; to make a start

examples.en: We set to work on the outside of the house (= for example, painting it).
examples.zh: 我们从屋子的外部开始干了起来。

examples.en: Let's get to work.
examples.zh: 我们干起来吧。〈phr.〉

senses.def: to give or tell somebody everything
to do/start to do your work
senses.zh: 做（或着手做）自己的工作

examples.en: She went cheerfully about her work.
examples.zh: 她高高兴兴地做自己的工作。

senses.def: kind acts to help others
to be likely to have difficulty doing something

examples.en: You'll have your work cut out to get there by nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 你九点钟前赶到那里可不容易。

senses.def: something that is in the works
senses.zh: 在讨论（或计划、筹备等）中；在酝酿中

senses.def: work that you are paid to do or that must be done
senses.zh: 分内的事；必须干的工作

examples.en: There was a job of work waiting for him that he was not looking forward to.
examples.zh: 有一件他不想干但又必须完成的工作在等待着他。

senses.def: to use more time or energy on a task than is necessary
senses.zh: 在某事上耗费过多时间（或精力）；费冤枉力

senses.def: to do something quickly and with little effort
to defeat, deal with something/somebody quickly
senses.zh: 干净利落地打败（或处理）；三下五除二就打垮（或解决）

examples.en: Liverpool made short work of the opposition (= in a football match).
examples.zh: 利物浦队干净利落地击败了对手。

examples.en: He made short work of his lunch (= ate it quickly).
examples.zh: 他三口两口吃完午饭。

examples.en: Mike made short work of fixing the engine.
examples.zh: 迈克很快修好了发动机。

senses.def: used to say that a job is made easier if a lot of people help
senses.zh: 人多好办事；众人拾柴火焰高

senses.def: a person who is unpleasant, unkind or dishonest
senses.zh: 恶棍；令人讨厌的人；靠不住的人

examples.en: Don’t trust him; he’s a nasty piece of work.
examples.zh: 不要相信他；他是一个令人讨厌的作品。

examples.en: He's a thoroughly nasty piece of work.
examples.zh: 他是一个极为阴险的家伙。

senses.def: used to show you are pleased when somebody has done something well

examples.en: You did a good job today. Nice work, James!
examples.zh: 你今天干得不错。好样的，詹姆斯！

senses.def: used when you wish that you had somebody’s success or good luck and think they have achieved it with little effort
senses.zh: （认为对方耕耘少，收获多）能有这样的好事儿就好了

examples.en: He was paid £200 for a ten-minute speech? Nice work if you can get it.
examples.zh: 他十分钟的演讲就得到了 200 英镑的报酬？如果你能得到它，那就太好了。

senses.def: (to cause) a delay or problem with something that somebody is planning or doing
needing too much effort

examples.en: I can't be bothered making a hot meal—it's too much like hard work.
examples.zh: 我懒得做热饭热菜，太麻烦了。

senses.def: a thing that takes a very short time to do

examples.en: It was the work of a few minutes to hide the damage.
examples.zh: 花了几分钟的时间才掩盖了损坏。

note.en: Most idioms containing work are at the entries for the nouns and adjectives in the idioms, for example work your fingers to the bone is at finger.
note.zh: 大多数含 work 的习语，都可在该等习语中的名词及形容词相关词条找到，如 work your fingers to the bone 在词条 finger 下。

senses.def: to arrange something in a particular way, especially by being clever

examples.en: Can you work it so that we get free tickets?
examples.zh: 你能不能为我们搞到些免费票？

senses.def: part of your normal working life and not unusual
senses.zh: 日常工作的一部分；习以为常；不足为奇

examples.en: Swimming with sharks or training a tiger cub—it's all in a day's work for animal wrangler Chris Bolton.
examples.zh: 与鲨鱼一起游泳或训练小老虎——这一切都是动物管理员克里斯·博尔顿 (Chris Bolton) 一天的工作。

examples.zh: 他三口两口吃完午饭。

examples.en: Mike made short work of fixing the engine.
examples.zh: 迈克很快修好了发动机。

senses.def: used to say that a job is made easier if a lot of people help
senses.zh: 人多好办事；众人拾柴火焰高

senses.def: a person who is unpleasant, unkind or dishonest
senses.zh: 恶棍；令人讨厌的人；靠不住的人

examples.zh: 不要相信他；他是一个令人讨厌的作品。

examples.en: He's a thoroughly nasty piece of work.
examples.zh: 他是一个极为阴险的家伙。

senses.def: used to show you are pleased when somebody has done something well

examples.en: You did a good job today. Nice work, James!
examples.zh: 你今天干得不错。好样的，詹姆斯！

items.idm: nice work if you can get it

senses.def: used when you wish that you had somebody’s success or good luck and think they have achieved it with little effort
senses.zh: （认为对方耕耘少，收获多）能有这样的好事儿就好了

examples.en: He was paid £200 for a ten-minute speech? Nice work if you can get it.
examples.zh: 他十分钟的演讲就得到了 200 英镑的报酬？如果你能得到它，那就太好了。

needing too much effort

examples.en: I can't be bothered making a hot meal—it's too much like hard work.
examples.zh: 我懒得做热饭热菜，太麻烦了。

senses.def: a thing that takes a very short time to do

examples.en: It was the work of a few minutes to hide the damage.
examples.zh: 花了几分钟的时间才掩盖了损坏。

intro.en: These are all words for the jobs that somebody does in return for payment, especially over a long period of time.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指有报酬的工作，尤指长期从事的职业。

items.def: the job that somebody does, especially in order to earn money:
items.zh: 指工作、职业

examples.en: It’s very difficult to find work at the moment.
examples.zh: 目前很难找到工作。

items.def: (rather formal) work, especially when it is done to earn money; the state of being employed or the situation in which people have work:
items.zh: 指工作、职业、受雇、就业

examples.en: Only half the people here are in paid employment.
examples.zh: 这儿只有一半的人有拿工资的工作。

items.def: the job or series of jobs that somebody has in a particular area of work, usually involving more responsibility as time passes:
items.zh: 指生涯、职业

examples.en: He had a very distinguished career in the Foreign Office.
examples.zh: 他在外交部有过一段光辉的事业。

items.def: a type of job that needs special training or skill, especially one that needs a high level of education:
items.zh: 指需要专门技能（尤其是较高教育水平）的职业、专业

examples.en: He hopes to enter the medical profession.
examples.zh: 他希望能从事医务工作。

items.def: (rather formal) a job or profession:

examples.zh: 请写明姓名、年龄和职业。

items.def: a job, especially one that involves working with your hands and requires special training and skills:
items.zh: 指行业，尤指手工职业、手艺、行当

examples.en: Carpentry is a highly skilled trade.
examples.zh: 木工是需要纯熟技巧的职业。

intro.zh: 以上各词均指工厂、车间、工场、制造厂。

examples.zh: 巧克力厂；香烟厂；制衣厂

examples.zh: 棉纺厂；造纸厂；纺织厂；毛纺厂

items.def: (often in compounds) a place where things are made or an industrial process takes place:
items.zh: （常构成复合词）指工厂、制造厂

examples.en: a brickworks
examples.zh: 砖厂

items.def: (usually in compounds) an area of land used for building something:
items.zh: （通常构成复合词）指建造某物的区域、场地

examples.en: a shipyard
examples.zh: 船坞

items.def: a room or building in which things are made or repaired using hand tools or machinery (usually individual items or small numbers of items):

examples.zh: 汽车修理厂

senses.def: to arrange something in a particular way, especially by being clever

examples.zh: 你能不能为我们搞到些免费票？

senses.def: to be immediately and completely successful

examples.zh: 你给我的那些新药丸真是药到病除。

senses.def: to follow the rules of your job in a very strict way in order to cause delay, as a form of protest against your employer or your working conditions

senses.def: to do something from beginning to end, especially when it takes a lot of time or effort
senses.zh: 自始至终做（尤指耗费时间或力量的事）

examples.en: She worked her way through the pile of documents.
examples.zh: 她从头至尾处理了那一堆文件。

senses.def: to move regularly to a more senior position in a company
senses.zh: 逐步升职；按部就班晋升

examples.en: He worked his way up from messenger boy to account executive.
examples.zh: 他从送信员一步一步晋升为客户经理。

senses.def: to find a way of working that avoids a particular problem without actually solving the problem

examples.en: The lack of test data is a problem, but we've found a way to work around that.
examples.zh: 缺少试验数据是个问题，但我们想办法绕了过去。

senses.def: to gradually turn a conversation towards a particular topic, subject, etc.

examples.en: It was some time before he worked around to what he really wanted to say.
examples.zh: 他东拉西扯了一会儿才绕到真正要说的事情上来。

senses.def: to make great efforts to achieve something or do something well

examples.en: He's working at losing weight.
examples.zh: 他正在努力减肥。

examples.en: Learning to play the piano isn't easy. You have to work at it.
examples.zh: 学弹钢琴不容易，你非得下功夫不可。

senses.def: a container for the things you need for sewing
a person's attitude to work, especially the idea that hard work is a good habit and should be rewarded

examples.en: They have a very strong work ethic.
examples.zh: 他们有很强的职业道德。

examples.en: She has a poor work ethic (= does not work hard).
examples.zh: 她的职业道德很差。

senses.def: the work or jobs that you have done in your life so far

examples.en: The opportunities available will depend on your previous work experience and qualifications.
examples.zh: 能否有机会要看你的工作经历和学历。

examples.en: What kind of work experience do you have?
examples.zh: 您有什么样的工作经验？

senses.def: a period of time that a young person, especially a student, spends working in a company as a form of training

examples.zh: 学生在当地公司获得工作经验。

examples.en: He's doing a month's unpaid work experience with an engineering company.
examples.zh: 他正为一家工程公司无偿工作一个月以获得工作经验。

examples.en: Can't you work a few more jokes into your speech?
examples.zh: 难道你就不能在讲话中再增加几句笑话吗？

examples.zh: 逐渐掺进黄油。

senses.def: a project that is not yet finished and is still being added to or developed
senses.zh: 进行中的项目；尚未完工的活儿

examples.en: My essay is still a work in progress.
examples.zh: 我的文章还在写作中。

examples.en: Public events where students present their work in progress are an important part of the programme.
examples.zh: 学生展示他们正在进行的工作的公共活动是该计划的重要组成部分。

senses.def: the total value of the materials and labour for projects that are not yet finished
senses.zh: 进行中的工作：尚未完成的项目的材料和人工的总价值

examples.en: The board had estimated the value of its work in progress as £6 145.
examples.zh: 董事会估计其正在进行的工作价值为 6 145 英镑。

senses.def: to try to include something

examples.en: Can't you work a few more jokes into your speech?
examples.zh: 难道你就不能在讲话中再增加几句笑话吗？

senses.def: to add one substance to another and mix them together

examples.en: Gradually work in the butter.
examples.zh: 逐渐掺进黄油。

senses.def: the number of hours per week you spend working, compared with the number of hours you spend with your family, relaxing, etc.
senses.zh: 工作与生活的平衡；劳逸结合

examples.en: Part-time working is often the best way to improve your work-life balance.
examples.zh: 兼职工作往往是更好地平衡工作与生活的最佳方式。

senses.def: a painting, statue, etc.
senses.zh: 艺术品；（绘画、雕塑等）艺术作品

examples.en: A number of priceless works of art were stolen from the gallery.
examples.zh: 美术馆中许多价值连城的艺术品被盗。

senses.def: something that is attractive and made with skill
senses.zh: 令人赏心悦目的东西；精致的物品

examples.en: The bride's dress was a work of art.
examples.zh: 新娘的礼服十分精美。

examples.en: The building is hated by some and considered a work of art by others.
examples.zh: 一些人厌恶这座建筑，而其他人则认为它是一件艺术品。

senses.def: to get rid of something, especially a strong feeling, by using physical effort

examples.en: She worked off her anger by going for a walk.
examples.zh: 她散散步气就消了。

senses.def: to earn money in order to be able to pay a debt

examples.en: They had a large bank loan to work off.
examples.zh: 他们有一大笔银行贷款需要偿还。

senses.def: to try to persuade somebody to agree to something or to do something
senses.zh: 努力说服（使某人答应或做某事）

examples.en: He hasn't said he'll do it yet, but I'm working on him.
examples.zh: 他还没说他会做这事，不过我正在设法说服他。

senses.def: to try hard to improve or achieve something

examples.en: You need to work on your pronunciation a bit more.
examples.zh: 你需要再加把劲改进发音。

examples.en: ‘Have you sorted out a babysitter yet?’ ‘No, but I'm working on it.’
examples.zh: “你找到临时看孩子的保姆了吗？”“还没有，我正在找呢。”

examples.en: We are working on plans for a new swimming pool.
examples.zh: 我们正在进行新游泳池的规划工作。

senses.def: to train the body by physical exercise

examples.en: I work out regularly to keep fit.
examples.zh: 我经常做运动以保持健康。

senses.def: to develop in a successful way

examples.en: My first job didn't work out.
examples.zh: 我的第一份工作干得不好。

examples.en: Things have worked out quite well for us.
examples.zh: 事情的结果对我们很不错。

senses.def: if something works out

examples.en: The restaurant bill worked out at £23 each.
examples.zh: 餐厅的账单算下来每人 23 英镑。

examples.en: This all works out to around $11 000.
examples.zh: 这一切加起来共约 11,000 美元。

examples.en: It'll work out cheaper to travel by bus.
examples.zh: 算来还是乘公共汽车便宜些。

senses.def: to understand somebody’s character

examples.en: I've never been able to work her out.
examples.zh: 我从未能看透她。

senses.def: to calculate something

examples.en: to work out the answer
examples.zh: 计算出答案

senses.def: to find the answer to something

examples.en: to work out a problem
examples.zh: 解决问题

examples.en: Can you work out what these squiggles mean?
examples.zh: 你能辨认出这些潦草的字迹是什么意思吗？

examples.en: I couldn't work out where the music was coming from.
examples.zh: 我弄不清这音乐是从哪里传来的。

senses.def: to plan or think of something

examples.en: I've worked out a new way of doing it.
examples.zh: 我想出了做这事的一个新方法。

senses.def: to remove all the coal, minerals, etc. from a mine over a period of time

examples.en: a worked-out silver mine
examples.zh: 开采光了的银矿

an official document that somebody needs in order to work in a particular foreign country

examples.en: All non-EU citizens need a work permit in order to get a job.
examples.zh: 所有非欧盟公民都需要工作许可证才能找到工作。

senses.def: a job, often as part of a course of study, where you get some experience of a particular kind of work

examples.en: She’s been on a work placement with a firm of accountants.
examples.zh: 她曾在一家会计师事务所实习。

senses.def: a system that allows prisoners to leave prison during the day to go to work
senses.zh: 监外就业（允许囚犯日间离开监狱外出工作的制度）

senses.def: to gradually turn a conversation towards a particular topic, subject, etc.

examples.en: It was some time before he worked around to what he really wanted to say.
examples.zh: 他东拉西扯了一会儿才绕到真正要说的事情上来。

senses.def: unwilling to work
senses.zh: 不愿工作的；怕干活的；懒惰的

senses.def: a flat surface in a kitchen for preparing food on

examples.en: Work surfaces should be left clear and clean.
examples.zh: 工作枱应该保持干净整洁。

senses.def: to follow a plan, schedule, etc.
senses.zh: 按照（计划、时间表等）；根据…行事

examples.en: to work to a budget
examples.zh: 按照预算办事

examples.en: We're working to a very tight deadline (= we have little time in which to do the work).
examples.zh: 我们的工期很紧。

senses.def: a situation in which workers refuse to do any work that is not in their contracts, in order to protest about something
senses.zh: 按章工作（为表示抗议而拒绝做超出合同规定的工作）

senses.def: to try to reach or achieve a goal
senses.zh: 努力达到，设法完成（目标）

examples.en: They are all working towards/toward a common goal.
examples.zh: 他们都在为共同的目标而奋斗。

senses.def: to develop or improve something with some effort

examples.en: I can't work up any enthusiasm for his idea.
examples.zh: 我对他的想法怎么也热心不起来。

examples.en: She went for a long walk to work up an appetite.
examples.zh: 她为了增加食欲散步了很长时间。

senses.def: to make somebody/yourself reach a state of great excitement, anger, etc.

examples.en: Don't work yourself up into a state about it. It isn't worth it.
examples.zh: 别为此大动肝火。这不值得。

senses.def: to bring something to a more complete or more acceptable state

examples.en: I'm working my notes up into a dissertation.
examples.zh: 我正在把我的笔记整理成一篇论文。

senses.def: to develop or move gradually towards something, usually something more exciting or extreme
senses.zh: 逐步发展到，逐渐达到（更高或更深的程度）

examples.en: The music worked up to a rousing finale.
examples.zh: 乐曲渐变到激动人心的末乐章。

examples.en: I began by jogging in the park and worked up to running five miles a day.
examples.zh: 我开始在公园里慢跑，后来逐渐增加到一天跑五英里。

senses.def: to achieve very good results

examples.en: Her exercise programme has worked miracles for her.
examples.zh: 她的健身计划对她很有效。

examples.en: You can work miracles with very little money if you follow our home decoration tips.
examples.zh: 你要是按照我们的家居装饰建议行事，可以用很少的钱就产生奇妙的效果。

examples.en: He performed miracles to get everything ready in time.
examples.zh: 他及时把一切都准备妥当，创造了奇迹。

senses.def: that can be used successfully and effectively

examples.en: a workable plan
examples.zh: 切实可行的计划

examples.en: I’m sure we can come to some workable arrangement.
examples.zh: 我肯定我们能做一个切实可行的安排。

examples.en: a workable framework/programme/proposal/solution/system
examples.zh: 可行的框架/方案/提案/解决方案/系统

senses.def: that you can shape, spread, dig, etc.
senses.zh: 可成形（或延长、挖掘等）的

examples.en: Add more water until the dough is workable.
examples.zh: 往面团里再加点儿水，直到能揉成形为止。

examples.en: Plant the shrubs when the soil is soft and workable.
examples.zh: 当土壤柔软且适合耕作时种植灌木。

senses.def: that can still be used and will make a profit
ordinary; not very interesting
senses.zh: 普通的；平凡的；平淡无奇的

examples.en: This was a far cry from her normal workaday world.
examples.zh: 这与她通常的平淡无奇的世界大不相同。

examples.en: She changed back into her workaday clothes.
examples.zh: 她又换回上班时的衣服。

senses.def: a person who works very hard and finds it difficult to stop working and do other things
senses.zh: 工作狂；工作迷；醉心于工作的人

senses.def: a way of working, especially with a piece of software, that avoids a particular problem but does not actually solve the problem
senses.zh: （尤指处理软件问题的）绕过操作（不能解决问题，但能避开其不良影响）

a book with exercises in it, often with spaces for students to write answers in, to help them practise what they have learnt
a box used for keeping tools or sewing
the part of a day during which you work

examples.en: an 8-hour workday
examples.zh: 8 小时工作日

senses.def: a day on which you usually work or on which most people usually work

examples.en: workday traffic
examples.zh: 平日的交通

senses.def: very excited or upset about something

examples.en: There's no point in getting worked up about it.
examples.zh: 为此大发脾气也无济于事。

examples.en: What are you so worked up about?
examples.zh: 什么事使得你这么激动？

senses.def: a person who works, especially one who does a particular kind of work

examples.en: farm/factory/office workers
examples.zh: 农场／工厂工人；职员

examples.en: construction/health/care workers
examples.zh: 建筑工人；医疗／护理人员

examples.en: manual/skilled/unskilled workers
examples.zh: 体力劳动者；熟练／非熟练工人

examples.en: temporary/part-time/casual workers
examples.zh: 临时工；兼职工；零工

examples.en: seasonal migrant workers picking blueberries
examples.zh: 采摘蓝梅的季节性流动工人

examples.en: Aid workers quickly arrived at the scene of the disaster.
examples.zh: 救援人员迅速到达灾难现场。

senses.def: a person who is employed in a company or industry, especially somebody who does physical work rather than organizing things or managing people

examples.en: Conflict between employers and workers intensified and the number of strikes rose.
examples.zh: 劳资矛盾加剧，罢工次数增多。

examples.en: Talks between workers and management have ended today.
examples.zh: 劳资谈判今天结束了。

senses.def: a person who works in a particular way

examples.en: a hard/fast/quick/slow worker
examples.zh: 做事努力／快／麻利／慢的人

examples.en: He's a worker (= he works very hard).
examples.zh: 他工作很努力。

senses.def: a female bee that helps do the work of the group of bees but does not produce young
a person who knows how to get what they want quickly, especially when beginning a sexual relationship with somebody
senses.zh: 善于迅速达到目的的人；（尤指恋爱方面）善于一下子获得青睐的人

senses.def: a person who knows how to get what they want quickly, especially when beginning a sexual relationship with somebody
senses.zh: 善于迅速达到目的的人；（尤指恋爱方面）善于一下子获得青睐的人

senses.def: a type of insurance that provides payments to employees who get injured or sick as a direct result of their job
senses.zh: 工伤赔偿金；劳工赔偿保险

examples.en: He filed a claim for workers' compensation.
examples.zh: 他提出了索要工伤赔偿金的要求。

senses.def: a system in which unemployed people have to work in order to get money for food, rent, etc. from the government
senses.zh: 工作福利制（领取福利金的失业者须要参与公益工作等）

senses.def: the series of stages that a particular piece or type of work passes through from the beginning until it is finished; the rate at which it passes through these stages

examples.en: He was responsible for managing the workflows of a department of 400.
examples.zh: 他负责管理 400 人的部门的工作流程。

examples.en: There is a growing need for workflow management software which helps businesses track documents that are incoming and outgoing.
examples.zh: 对帮助企业跟踪传入和传出文档的工作流程管理软件的需求不断增长。

examples.en: One of the best ways to improve productivity in your business and cut costs is to streamline your workflow.
examples.zh: 提高企业生产力和削减成本的最佳方法之一是简化工作流程。

senses.def: all the people who work for a particular company, organization, etc.

examples.en: The factory has a 1 000-strong workforce.
examples.zh: 这家工厂的职工多达千人。

examples.en: Two thirds of the workforce is/are women.
examples.zh: 职工中的三分之二是妇女。

senses.def: all the people in a country or an area who are available for work
senses.zh: （国家或行业等的）劳动力，劳动大军，劳动人口

examples.en: A quarter of the local workforce is/are unemployed.
examples.zh: 本地四分之一的劳动力都失业了。

examples.en: an educated workforce
examples.zh: 受过教育的劳动力

senses.def: a person or machine that you can rely on to do hard and/or boring work
senses.zh: 埋头苦干的人；老黄牛（指吃苦耐劳的人）；耐用的机器

senses.def: (in England and Wales in the past) a building where very poor people were sent to live and given work to do
senses.zh: （英国旧时的）济贫院，劳动救济所

senses.def: the money that is needed to run a business rather than the money that is used to buy buildings and equipment when starting the business
senses.zh: 流动资本；运营资本；周转资金

senses.def: from or connected with the social class whose members do not have much money or power and are usually employed to do manual

examples.en: a working-class background
examples.zh: 工人阶级出身

senses.def: the part of a day during which you work

examples.en: I spend most of my working day sitting at a desk.
examples.zh: 我一天之中大部分工作时间都坐在办公桌旁。

examples.en: Their working day can last anything up to 15 hours.
examples.zh: 他们的工作日最长可达 15 小时。

senses.def: a day on which you usually work or on which most people usually work

examples.en: Sunday is a normal working day for me.
examples.zh: 星期日是我的正常工作日。

examples.en: Thousands of working days were lost through strikes last year.
examples.zh: 去年因罢工损失了数以千计的工作日。

examples.en: Allow two working days (= not Saturday or Sunday) for delivery.
examples.zh: 发货需两个工作日。

senses.def: a woman who works as a prostitute
a woman who has a paid job
senses.zh: 劳动女子；女工；职业妇女

senses.def: a club where people go after work to meet each other, drink in the bar, play games such as darts
senses.zh: 工人俱乐部：下班后去见面，在酒吧喝酒，玩飞镖，卡片和宾果游戏以及观看娱乐节目（包括唱歌，跳舞和喜剧）的俱乐部。自1960年代以来，许多著名的英国艺人开始了在这些俱乐部表演的职业生涯。它们由教堂在1850年代建立，并在1862年建立了一个中央组织工人工人俱乐部和协会联盟（WMCIU）之后，数量有所增加。

senses.def: a report written by a group of people chosen to study an aspect of law, education, health, etc.
(in the US) an official document that enables somebody under 16 years old or born outside the US to have a job
senses.zh: （美国 16 岁以下或侨居者的）工作证，雇佣证书

senses.def: a group of people chosen to study a particular problem or situation in order to suggest ways of dealing with it

examples.en: The government has set up a working party on prison overcrowding.
examples.zh: 政府成立了一个解决监狱人满为患问题的工作组。

examples.en: The working party is/are expected to present its/their report next month.
examples.zh: 预计工作组将在下个月提交报告。

senses.def: an ordinary person whose job is not very interesting
senses.zh: 普通上班族；工作无趣但又靠此维生的人

senses.def: a temporary name that is used during the production of a book, film, etc. before the actual name is chosen
senses.zh: 暂定名称；暂定书名（或片名等）

examples.en: The working title for the film is ‘The Suffering’.
examples.zh: 这部电影的暂定名称是“苦难”。

senses.def: the total amount of time that you spend at work during the week
senses.zh: 一周的工作时间；工作周

examples.en: a 40-hour working week
examples.zh: 40 个小时的工作周

senses.def: using all your energy to do something; working as well as possible
senses.zh: 竭尽全力；尽力干好；开足马力

senses.def: the amount of work that has to be done by a particular person or organization

examples.en: a heavy workload
examples.zh: 沉重的工作负担

examples.en: We have taken on extra staff to cope with the increased workload.
examples.zh: 我们已经额外雇用员工来应付增加了的工作量。

examples.en: Management is looking at ways of spreading the workload between departments.
examples.zh: 管理层正在寻找在部门之间分散工作量的方法。

senses.def: a man who is employed to do physical work

examples.en: A gang of workmen were shovelling rubble into a truck.
examples.zh: 一群工人正往卡车上铲碎石子。

examples.en: A gang of council workmen has been digging a hole in the road.
examples.zh: 一伙市政工人一直在路上挖洞。

senses.def: a person who works in the way mentioned

examples.en: a good/bad workman
examples.zh: 工作好的／差的人

examples.en: He was soon found to be a good workman.
examples.zh: 很快他就被发现是一名好工人。

senses.def: done, made, etc. in a way that is careful and complete and shows skill but is not usually very original or exciting

examples.en: They’ve done a workmanlike job.
examples.zh: 他们活儿做得很精细。

examples.en: It was a workmanlike performance from the local team.
examples.zh: 这是当地团队精湛的表演。

examples.en: The writing is workmanlike, if sometimes too casual.
examples.zh: 写作很有技巧，虽然有时过于随意。

senses.def: the skill with which somebody makes something, especially when this affects the way it looks or works

examples.en: Our buyers insist on high standards of workmanship and materials.
examples.zh: 我们的买主对工艺和材料坚持要高标准。

examples.en: The sword is a fine example of Celtic workmanship.
examples.zh: 这把剑是凯尔特工艺的典范。

examples.en: I was admiring the exquisite workmanship in the mosaic.
examples.zh: 我当时正在欣赏镶嵌画的精致做工。

senses.def: a person that you work with, often doing the same job, in an office, a factory, etc.
senses.zh: 一起工作的人；同事；工友

examples.en: Her workmates organized a leaving party for her last day in the office.
examples.zh: 同事为她举办了欢送会，纪念她在办公室工作的最后一天。

senses.def: a period of physical exercise that you do to keep fit

examples.en: She does a 20-minute workout every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早晨做运动 20 分钟。

examples.en: The team had a hard workout this morning.
examples.zh: 该队今天早晨进行了大强度训练。

examples.en: When I do a good workout, I feel fine.
examples.zh: 进行适当的锻炼后我感到很舒服。

senses.def: an item that is being worked on with a tool or a machine
senses.zh: 工件（指使用工具或机器加工或生产的物件）

examples.en: Clamp smaller workpieces to a bench.
examples.zh: 将较小的工件夹紧到工作台上。

senses.def: the office, factory, etc. where people work

examples.en: the introduction of new technology into the workplace
examples.zh: 把新技术引进工厂

examples.en: These safety standards apply to all workplaces.
examples.zh: 这些安全标准适用于所有工作场所。

examples.en: workplace safety
examples.zh: 工作场所的安全

senses.def: a room in which work is done, especially work that involves making things

examples.en: The jeweller has a workroom at the back of his shop.
examples.zh: 珠宝商在他的店铺后面有一间作坊。

senses.def: a group of employees who represent all the employees at a factory, etc. in discussions with their employers over conditions of work
senses.zh: 职工委员会（负责和雇主协商工作条件等）

senses.def: a piece of paper or an electronic document on which there is a series of questions and exercises to be done by a student
senses.zh: （学生做的）活页练习题，电子作业文档

senses.def: a piece of paper or an electronic document on which work that has been done or has to be done is recorded
senses.zh: 工作记录（或进度）表；电子工作记录（或进度）表

senses.def: a period of discussion and practical work on a particular subject, in which a group of people share their knowledge and experience

examples.en: There will be the opportunity for practical theatre work in drama workshops.
examples.zh: 戏剧研习班将提供实际戏剧工作的机会。

examples.en: She was invited to participate in a poetry workshop on campus.
examples.zh: 她受邀参加校园诗歌研讨会。

senses.def: a room or building in which things are made or repaired using tools or machines

examples.en: The craftsmen worked in a freezing cold workshop.
examples.zh: 工匠在极度寒冷的作坊里干活儿。

examples.en: a car repair workshop
examples.zh: 汽车修理厂

synonyms.words: plant ▪ mill ▪ works ▪ yard ▪ workshop ▪ foundry

intro.en: These are all words for buildings or places where things are made or where industrial processes take place.
intro.zh: 以上各词均指工厂、车间、工场、制造厂。

items.def: a building or group of buildings where goods are made, mainly by machine:
items.zh: 工厂；制造厂

examples.en: a chocolate/​cigarette/​clothing factory
examples.zh: 巧克力厂；香烟厂；制衣厂

items.def: a factory or place where power is produced or an industrial process takes place:
items.zh: 指发电厂、工厂

examples.en: a nuclear power plant
examples.zh: 核电厂

items.def: a factory that produces a particular type of material:
items.zh: 指（生产特定材料的）工厂、制造厂

examples.en: a cotton/​paper/​textile/​woollen mill
examples.zh: 棉纺厂；造纸厂；纺织厂；毛纺厂

items.def: (often in compounds) a place where things are made or an industrial process takes place:
items.zh: （常构成复合词）指工厂、制造厂

examples.en: a brickworks
examples.zh: 砖厂

items.def: (usually in compounds) an area of land used for building something:
items.zh: （通常构成复合词）指建造某物的区域、场地

examples.en: a shipyard
examples.zh: 船坞

items.def: a room or building in which things are made or repaired using hand tools or machinery (usually individual items or small numbers of items):
items.zh: 指车间、工场、作坊

examples.en: a car repair workshop
examples.zh: 汽车修理厂

items.def: a factory where metal or glass is melted and made into different shapes or objects:
items.zh: 指铸造厂、玻璃厂

examples.en: an iron foundry
examples.zh: 铸铁厂

senses.def: a space in which to work, especially in an office
a place where information that is being used by one person on a computer network is stored
the desk and computer at which a person works; one computer that is part of a computer network
senses.zh: 个人工作区；（计算机）工作站

senses.def: a flat surface in a kitchen for preparing food on

examples.en: The kitchen has granite worktops.
examples.zh: 厨房配有花岗岩台面。

senses.def: a medical examination of a patient in order to say exactly what an illness or the cause of a problem is
senses.zh: （为诊断而做的）全面身体检查；诊断检查

examples.en: The patient underwent a diagnostic workup.
examples.zh: 病人做了全面身体检查。

senses.def: the total amount of time that you spend at work during the week
senses.zh: 一周的工作时间；工作周

senses.def: the earth, with all its countries, peoples and natural features

examples.en: a map of the world
examples.zh: 世界地图

examples.en: French is spoken in many parts of the world.
examples.zh: 世界上许多地方都说法语。

examples.en: Which is the largest city in the world?
examples.zh: 世界上最大的城市是哪个？

examples.en: to sail around the world
examples.zh: 环球航行

examples.en: She has been all over the world.
examples.zh: 她周游了全世界。

examples.en: Their products are sold throughout the world.
examples.zh: 他们的产品销售到了世界各地。

examples.en: They travelled the world for pleasure.
examples.zh: 他们到世界各地旅游。

examples.en: He's the world's highest paid entertainer.
examples.zh: 他是世界上薪酬最高的演艺人。

examples.en: a meeting of world leaders
examples.zh: 世界各国领导人大会

examples.en: campaigning for world peace
examples.zh: 发起世界和平运动

examples.en: the world economy
examples.zh: 世界经济

examples.en: world markets/trade
examples.zh: 世界市场/贸易

examples.en: the world premiere of the movie
examples.zh: 电影全球首映

senses.group: the earth/its people 地球；地球人

senses.def: used before another noun to describe one of the most important people or things of their type in the world
senses.zh: （用于名词前，描述世界上同类中最重要的人或事物）

examples.en: the world champion/championship/record/title
examples.zh: 世界冠军／锦标赛／纪录／冠军

examples.en: As of October, her world ranking was No.1.
examples.zh: 自十月份起，她的世界排名为第一。

examples.en: the major world religions
examples.zh: 主要世界宗教

senses.group: the earth/its people 地球；地球人

senses.def: a particular part of the earth; a particular group of countries or people; a particular period of history and the people of that period
senses.zh: 某地域（或民族、历史时期等）的人类社会；世界

examples.en: the Arab world
examples.zh: 阿拉伯世界

examples.en: In the Western world, there is a different attitude to marriage.
examples.zh: 西方世界对待婚姻的态度有所不同。

examples.en: farmers in the developing world
examples.zh: 发展中世界的农民

examples.en: The book has sold 12 million copies in the English-speaking world and has been translated into six languages.
examples.zh: 该书在英语世界已售出 1200 万册，并被翻译成六种语言。

examples.en: in the modern/ancient world
examples.zh: 在现代／古代社会

senses.group: the earth/its people 地球；地球人

senses.def: the people or things belonging to a particular group or connected with a particular interest, job, etc.
senses.zh: 按性质（或职业等）划分的类别；界；界别

examples.en: the animal/plant/insect world
examples.zh: 动物界；植物界；昆虫界

examples.en: the business/corporate world
examples.zh: 企业界

examples.en: She is a popular figure in the art world.
examples.zh: 她在艺术界是很受欢迎的人物。

examples.en: the world of politics/business/sport
examples.zh: 政界；商界；体育界

examples.en: the world of music/art/fashion
examples.zh: 音乐/艺术/时尚世界

examples.en: stars from the sporting and artistic worlds
examples.zh: 体育和艺术界的众明星

senses.def: everything that exists of a particular kind; a particular kind of life or existence
senses.zh: 某领域的一切事物；自然界

examples.en: the natural world (= animals, plants, minerals, etc.)
examples.zh: 自然界

examples.en: the physical/material world
examples.zh: 物质世界

examples.en: They are a couple in the real world as well as in the movie.
examples.zh: 他们在电影和现实生活中都是一对夫妇。

examples.en: The island is a world of brilliant colours and dramatic sunsets.
examples.zh: 这个岛是个绚丽多彩、晚霞娇艳的世界。

examples.en: They had little contact with the outside world (= people and places that were not part of their normal life).
examples.zh: 他们与外界没有什么联系。

senses.def: our society and the way people live and behave; the people in the world

examples.en: We live in a rapidly changing world.
examples.zh: 我们生活在瞬息万变的社会里。

examples.en: Young people always think they are going to change the world.
examples.zh: 年轻人总想着要去改变社会。

examples.en: It's not your job to save the world.
examples.zh: 拯救世界不是你的工作。

examples.en: He's too young to understand the ways of the world (= how the world works).
examples.zh: 他还太年轻，不懂得处世之道。

examples.en: The whole world was waiting for news of the astronauts.
examples.zh: 全世界的人都在等待宇航员的消息。

examples.en: She felt that the world was against her.
examples.zh: 她觉得整个世界都在与她作对。

examples.en: The eyes of the world are on the President (= many people around the world are waiting to see what the President will do).
examples.zh: 全世界的目光都落在总统身上。

examples.en: News of the incident was slow to reach the wider world.
examples.zh: 该事件的消息传播到更广泛的世界的速度很慢。

senses.def: a way of life where possessions and physical pleasures are important, rather than spiritual values

examples.en: monks and nuns renouncing the world
examples.zh: 弃绝俗世享乐的修士和修女

senses.def: a person’s environment, experiences, friends and family, etc.
senses.zh: 生活环境；阅历；生活圈子

examples.en: Parents are the most important people in a child's world.
examples.zh: 父母在儿童的天地里是最重要的人。

examples.en: When his wife died, his entire world was turned upside down.
examples.zh: 他妻子死后，他的整个生活变得一塌糊涂。

senses.def: an environment that is imagined or constructed, for example in a computer game
senses.zh: （电脑游戏等中的）幻想世界，虚拟世界

examples.en: Computer games create whole virtual worlds.
examples.zh: 电脑游戏创造出完整的虚拟世界。

examples.en: The game comprises four separate worlds, each split into six levels.
examples.zh: 这款游戏由四个独立世界构成，每个世界分六层。

examples.en: You're living in a fantasy world!
examples.zh: 你生活在幻想世界中！

senses.def: a planet like the earth

examples.en: There may be other worlds out there.
examples.zh: 那里可能有其他星球。

senses.def: the state of human existence

examples.en: this world and the next (= life on earth and existence after death)
examples.zh: 今世和来世

senses.def: to be loved by and very important to somebody
senses.zh: 是…的最喜爱的人（或事物）；对…非常重要；是…的一切

senses.def: to be giving all your attention to something so that you do not notice what is happening around you
senses.zh: （全神贯注于某事而）不注意周围的事情

examples.en: When he’s listening to music he’s lost to the world.
examples.zh: 当他听音乐时，他迷失了世界。

senses.def: the benefits of two or more completely different situations that you can enjoy at the same time
senses.zh: 两种（或多种）不同情况的优点；两全其美

examples.en: If you enjoy the coast and the country, you'll get the best of both worlds on this walk.
examples.zh: 你要是喜欢海滨和乡村，那么这次散步你会一举两得。

examples.en: Maybe in the best of all possible worlds things would be different.
examples.zh: 也许在最好的情况下，事情会有所不同。

senses.def: to be completely different in attitudes, opinions, etc.
senses.zh: （在态度、看法等方面）有天壤之别，截然不同

examples.en: Although they are twins, they are worlds apart in their attitude to life.
examples.zh: 尽管他们是双胞胎，他们的人生观却完全不同。

senses.def: a situation or society that changes in a way that is meant to improve people’s lives but is often a source of extra problems
senses.zh: 美好的新世界（本欲改善人们的生活，实则带来预料不到的问题）

examples.en: the brave new world of technology
examples.zh: 科技进步的美好新世界

examples.en: the architects' vision of a brave new world of pristine concrete
examples.zh: 建筑师想象中的由崭新混凝土建筑构成的美好新世界

senses.def: to become less/more important or successful in society
senses.zh: 落泊；衰落；倒运；飞黄腾达；发迹；兴盛

senses.def: to be born
in a deep sleep
to make somebody feel much better; to improve something
senses.zh: 使…感到好得多；对…大有好处；改善

examples.en: A change of job would do you the world of good.
examples.zh: 换一下工作会对你大有好处。

senses.def: exactly as if…; exactly like somebody/something

examples.en: She behaved for all the world as if nothing unusual had happened.
examples.zh: 看她的表现就像根本没有发生过什么大事似的。

examples.en: He looked for all the world like a schoolboy caught stealing apples.
examples.zh: 他那个样子简直就像偷苹果时被当场抓住的小学生。

senses.def: to be very successful and admired
used to emphasize something and to show that you are surprised or annoyed
senses.zh: （用于强调，表示惊讶或不悦）到底，究竟

examples.en: What in the world did they think they were doing?
examples.zh: 他们到底认为自己在做什么？

senses.def: used to say that something is what you would like to happen or what should happen, but you know it cannot

examples.en: In an ideal world we would be recycling and reusing everything.
examples.zh: 我们要是能回收并再利用所有的东西就再理想不过了。

senses.def: used to emphasize what you are saying
senses.zh: （加强语气）世界上，天下，根本，到底

examples.en: There's nothing in the world I'd like more than to visit New York.
examples.zh: 访问纽约是我最想做的事。

examples.en: Don't rush—we've got all the time in the world.
examples.zh: 别急急忙忙的，我们有的是时间。

examples.en: You look as if you haven't got a care in the world!
examples.zh: 你看上去好像一丝牵挂都没有！

senses.def: if you are in a world of your own

examples.en: I tapped on the window to get her attention but she was in a world of her own.
examples.zh: 我敲窗户以引起她的注意，但是她却沉浸在自己的世界里。

senses.def: used to express your surprise when you meet somebody you know in an unexpected place, or when you are talking to somebody and find out that you both know the same person
senses.zh: （意外遇见某人或发现对方也认识某人时表示惊讶）世界真小

senses.def: a person with a lot of experience of life, who is not easily surprised or shocked
senses.zh: 生活阅历丰富的人；老成持重的人

senses.def: not the worst thing that could happen to somebody
senses.zh: 天不会塌下来；不是灭顶之灾

examples.en: Failing one exam is not the end of the world.
examples.zh: 一次考试不及格并非世界末日。

examples.en: It won't be the end of the world if you don't get the job.
examples.zh: 如果你得不到这份工作也不会是世界末日。

senses.def: used to say that you would never do something

examples.zh: 他忧心忡忡地瞥了他父亲一眼。

senses.def: to keep thinking about unpleasant things that might happen or about problems that you have

examples.en: Don't worry. We have plenty of time.
examples.zh: 不必担心。我们有很多时间。

examples.en: Stop worrying, Dad—it'll be fine.
examples.zh: 别担心，爸爸，会没事儿的。

examples.en: Don't worry about me. I'll be all right.
examples.zh: 别为我担忧。我会没事的。

examples.en: He's always worrying about his weight.
examples.zh: 他总是为自己的体重发愁。

examples.en: Never mind—it's nothing to worry about.
examples.zh: 没关系，不必担心。

examples.en: That's not something you need to worry about.
examples.zh: 那不是你需要担心的事情。

examples.zh: 你今晚可以住在这里，这样你就不用发愁摸黑走回家了。

examples.zh: 她是我妹妹，我担心她的安全。

examples.zh: 她开始为她的朋友担心。

examples.zh: 我担心自己进不了大学。

examples.zh: 使我发愁的是如何再找到工作。

examples.en: That prospect worried investors.
examples.zh: 这一前景令投资者感到担忧。

examples.zh: 别担心，我会处理的。

examples.en: He's worried himself sick (= become extremely anxious) about his daughter.
examples.zh: 他的女儿可把他愁坏了。

examples.zh: 你去哪了？整个晚上我都担心得要命。

examples.en: It worries me that he hasn't come home yet.
examples.zh: 他还没有回家，这叫我放心不下。

examples.en: It worried me to think what might happen.
examples.zh: 想到可能会发生的事情我就发愁了。

senses.def: to annoy or upset somebody

examples.en: The noise never seems to worry her.
examples.zh: 她好像从不受噪音干扰。

examples.en: Don't keep worrying him with a lot of silly questions.
examples.zh: 别老用许多愚蠢的问题打扰他。

examples.en: I didn't want to worry you with all the details.
examples.zh: 我不想让你担心所有的细节。

examples.en: Don't worry the driver with unnecessary requests.
examples.zh: 不要提些没必要的要求打扰驾驶员。

examples.zh: 别着急，我很快就能把它修理好。

examples.en: Not to worry—no harm done.
examples.zh: 别担心，没伤着。

senses.def: the state of worrying about something

examples.en: The threat of losing their jobs is a constant source of worry to them.
examples.zh: 丢掉工作的威胁时常使他们忧心忡忡。

examples.en: A heart attack can be brought on by stress and worry.
examples.zh: 压力和担忧会导致心脏病发作。

examples.en: Levels of worry about crime had fallen by a third.
examples.zh: 对犯罪的担心程度下降了三分之一。

examples.en: to be frantic with worry

examples.en: She couldn't sleep with worry.
examples.zh: 她担心得睡不着觉。

senses.def: something that worries you

examples.en: You need have no worries—everything's been taken care of.
examples.zh: 你不必担心，一切都搞定了。

examples.en: worries about the future
examples.zh: 对未来的担忧

examples.en: She expressed some worries about working with him.
examples.zh: 她对和他一起工作表达了一些担忧。

examples.en: Mugging is a real worry for many old people.
examples.zh: 行凶抢劫确实是许多老人担心的事。

examples.en: There was the nagging worry that he wouldn't be able to match his past successes.
examples.zh: 人们一直担心他无法再取得像过去一样的成功。

examples.en: My only worry is that…
examples.zh: 唯一令我担忧的是…

examples.en: The biggest worry is that further stock market falls might dent consumer confidence.
examples.zh: 最大的担心是股市继续下跌会使消费者信心受挫。

examples.en: money/financial worries
examples.zh: 金钱／财务担忧

examples.en: The news of his release from prison added further to her worries.
examples.zh: 他出狱的消息进一步加剧了她的担忧。

examples.en: Students should discuss any problems or worries they have with their course tutors.
examples.zh: 学生应与课程导师讨论任何问题或担忧。

senses.def: it’s not a problem; it’s all right (often used as a reply when somebody thanks you for something)
senses.zh: 没什么，不客气，没关系（常用以回答别人的道谢）

examples.en: No worries—there's plenty of time.
examples.zh: 不要担心 － 时间足够了。

senses.def: it is not important; it does not matter

examples.zh: 他开始解绳子上的结。

examples.zh: 令人担忧的强辐射

examples.zh: 令人担忧的是，计划中有关如何削减开支的细节很少。
