examples.zh: 我参加不了这次聚会了，真倒霉！

senses.def: to become or make something worse than it was before

examples.en: The political situation is steadily worsening.
examples.zh: 政治局势在持续恶化。

examples.en: Her health has worsened considerably since we last saw her.
examples.zh: 自从我们上次见到她以来，她的身体差多了。

examples.en: Staff shortages were worsened by the flu epidemic.
examples.zh: 由于流感，职员短缺的情况更加严重了。

senses.zh: （对上帝或神的）崇拜，敬仰，礼拜

examples.en: an act/a place of worship
examples.zh: 礼拜；礼拜场所

examples.en: morning/evening worship (= a church service in the morning/evening)
examples.zh: 早晨／晚上的礼拜

examples.en: The tradition of ancestor worship stretches back thousands of years.
examples.zh: 祭祖的传统可以追溯到几千年前。

senses.def: a strong feeling of love and respect for somebody/something

examples.zh: 她对他的感觉近似于爱慕。

senses.zh: （对治安官或市长的尊称）阁下

examples.zh: 玛雅人在丛林里建起了金字塔来膜拜他们的神。

examples.zh: 我们在圣马利教堂做礼拜。

examples.en: He worshipped at the local mosque.
examples.zh: 他在当地的清真寺做礼拜。

senses.def: to love and admire somebody very much, especially so much that you cannot see their faults
senses.zh: 热爱；爱慕，崇拜（尤指达到看不到缺点的地步）

examples.zh: 她极度疼爱自己的儿女。

examples.en: He worshipped her from afar (= he loved her but did not tell her his feelings).
examples.zh: 他暗恋着她。

examples.en: She worships the ground he walks on.
examples.zh: 她对他的爱达到痴迷的程度。

senses.zh: 尊敬的（英国用于某些市长和工匠团体的称号中）

examples.en: the Worshipful Company of Goldsmiths

senses.def: a person who worships

examples.zh: 经常到圣安德烈教堂做礼拜的人

senses.def: involving the worst situation that could happen

examples.zh: 在最坏的情况下，有一万多人可能会受到影响。

senses.def: having a value in money, etc.

examples.zh: 我们的房子大约值 10 万英镑。

examples.en: How much is this painting worth?
examples.zh: 这幅画值多少钱？

examples.en: to be worth a bomb/packet/fortune (= a lot of money)
examples.zh: 值一大笔钱

examples.en: It isn't worth much.
examples.zh: 这不值多少钱。

examples.zh: 答对了这道题可以得五分。

examples.en: This order is potentially worth millions of pounds to the company.
examples.zh: 对公司来说，这份订单有可能价值数百万英镑。

examples.zh: 这家博物馆的确值得参观。

examples.zh: 这个想法很值得考虑。

examples.zh: 去之前预约一下是值得的。

examples.zh: 为次日送达额外支付 3 英镑总是值得的。

examples.en: Was it worth the effort?
examples.zh: 这值得花费力气吗？

examples.en: The new house really wasn't worth all the expense involved.
examples.zh: 这座新房子确实不值这么多的花费。

examples.en: The job involves a lot of hard work but it's worth it.
examples.zh: 这工作需要花费很大力气，但是值得。

examples.en: The trip was expensive but it was worth every penny.
examples.zh: 这次旅行花费很大，但是花的每一分钱都不冤枉。

examples.en: The film is definitely worth seeing.
examples.zh: 这部电影绝对值得一看。

senses.def: having money and possessions of a particular value

examples.en: He's worth £10 million.
examples.zh: 他拥有 1 000 万英镑的财产。

senses.def: it is better to keep something that you already have than to risk losing it by trying to get much more
senses.zh: 一鸟在手胜过双鸟在林（满足于现有的总比因过分追求而失去一切好）

senses.def: in a very determined way, with great energy and effort
senses.zh: 竭尽全力；拼命；十分坚定

examples.en: He was rowing for all he was worth.
examples.zh: 他在拼命地划船。

senses.def: in order to get as much as you can from somebody/something

examples.en: She is milking her success for all it's worth.
examples.zh: 她在利用自己的成功拼命捞好处。

senses.zh: （所说的只是个人意见）无论管不管用，不论好坏

examples.en: I prefer this colour, for what it's worth.
examples.zh: 无论好坏，我喜欢这个颜色。

senses.def: not worth doing because it is against the rules or because it might cause you to lose your job
senses.zh: 工作所不允许的事；违反原则的事；可能丢饭碗的事

examples.en: It's more than my job's worth to let you in without a ticket.
examples.zh: 没有票就让你进去，我可能会丢饭碗的。

senses.def: the advantages to be gained from doing something are not great enough, considering the effort or cost involved

examples.en: If the price goes up again, he may decide that the game’s not worth the candle.
examples.zh: 如果价格再次上涨，他可能会认为这款游戏得不偿失。

senses.def: having no value, especially legally, or because one of the people involved has no intention of doing what they said they would

examples.zh: 凡称职的教师都知道这一点。

examples.zh: 优秀的技工是不可多得的。

senses.def: interesting or useful for somebody to do

examples.zh: 你来参加会议对你会大有好处。

examples.zh: 你要是给他的报酬丰厚，他会做这份工作的。

senses.def: an amount of something that has the value mentioned
senses.zh: 价值（十美元、40 英镑等）的东西

examples.zh: 获胜者将得到价值五十英镑的书。

examples.zh: 洪水造成了价值数千万英镑的损失。

examples.en: a dollar’s worth of change
examples.zh: 一美元的零钱

examples.zh: 他们的贡献具有伟大的意义。

examples.zh: 这些活动有助于儿童培养自身的价值感。

examples.zh: 好的面试可以让求职者证明他们的价值。

examples.zh: 让我们在那里度过一整天，真正物有所值。

examples.zh: 她脸上的笑容使得这一切都非常值得。

examples.zh: 我们都觉得我们为当地社区做了一些有价值的事情。

examples.zh: 把真正高质量的插图包括进去是值得的。

examples.zh: 他的想法中很少有值得进一步关注的。

examples.zh: 这份报告里有些调查结果值得注意。

examples.zh: 作曲家直到写出一部歌剧来才被认为是名副其实。

examples.en: a worthy champion (= one who deserved to win)

examples.zh: 你好，戴夫，谢谢光临。

examples.zh: 她宁愿死也不愿意演讲。

examples.zh: 就我个人而言，我宁愿看到资金和资源投入教育。

examples.zh: 我宁愿要一个真正好用的简单产品，而不是一个华而不实的东西。

examples.en: Two passengers are still trapped in the wreck.
examples.zh: 有两名乘客仍被困在失事的车辆里。

examples.en: She was pulled from the burning wreck by firefighters.
examples.zh: 她被消防员从燃烧的残骸中拉了出来。

senses.def: a person who is in a bad physical or mental condition
senses.zh: （身体或精神上）受到严重损伤的人

examples.en: Physically, I was a total wreck.
examples.zh: 从身体上说，我完全是一个废人。

examples.en: The experience left her an emotional wreck.
examples.zh: 这次经历给她留下了情感上的创伤。

examples.en: The interview reduced him to a nervous wreck.
examples.zh: 这次面试使得他的精神高度紧张。

senses.def: a vehicle, building, etc. that is in very bad condition
senses.zh: 状况非常糟糕的车辆（或建筑物等）

examples.en: The house was a wreck when we bought it.
examples.zh: 我们买下这座房子时，它破烂不堪。

examples.en: They still hoped to salvage something from the wreck of their marriage.
examples.zh: 他们仍然希望从他们破碎的婚姻中挽回点什么。

senses.def: an accident in which a vehicle hits something, for example another vehicle, usually causing damage and often injuring or killing the passengers

examples.en: a car/train wreck
examples.zh: 汽车／火车失事

senses.def: to damage or destroy something

examples.en: A bomb completely wrecked the building.
examples.zh: 一颗炸弹把这座建筑完全炸毁了。

examples.en: The building had been wrecked by the explosion.
examples.zh: 那座楼房被炸毁了。

examples.en: The road was littered with wrecked cars.
examples.zh: 公路上到处都是被撞坏的汽车。

examples.en: youths who steal and wreck fast cars
examples.zh: 偷窃和毁坏跑车的年轻人

senses.def: to cause something to fail completely

examples.en: The weather wrecked all our plans.
examples.zh: 天气把我们的计划全都毁了。

examples.en: A serious injury nearly wrecked his career.
examples.zh: 一次重伤差点儿葬送了他的前程。

senses.def: to damage a ship so much that it sinks or can no longer sail
senses.zh: 使（船舶）失事；使遇难；使下沉

examples.en: The ship was wrecked off the coast of France.
examples.zh: 那艘船在法国的沿岸失事。

intro.en: These are all words that can be used when something, especially a vehicle, hits something else very hard and is damaged or destroyed.
intro.zh: 以上各词均含碰撞、撞击之义，尤指撞车。

items.def: to hit an object or another vehicle, causing damage; to make a vehicle do this:
items.zh: 指（使）物体或交通工具碰撞或撞击

examples.en: I was terrified that the plane would crash.
examples.zh: 飞机可能会失事，我吓坏了。

items.def: to crash into something with a lot of force; to make something do this:
items.zh: 指（使）重重地撞上

examples.en: The car skidded and slammed into a tree.
examples.zh: 汽车打滑，砰的一声撞到树上。

items.def: (rather formal) (of two vehicles or people) to crash into each other; (of a vehicle or person) to crash into somebody/​something else:
items.zh: 指交通工具或人碰撞、相撞或撞上

examples.en: The car and the van collided head-on in thick fog.
examples.zh: 那辆小轿车和货车在浓雾中迎面相撞。

items.def: (rather informal) to crash into something with a lot of force; to make something do this; to crash a car:
items.zh: 指（使）猛烈撞击、猛烈碰撞或撞车

examples.en: Ram-raiders smashed a stolen car through the shop window.
examples.zh: 飙车抢劫者驾着偷来的汽车撞破商店橱窗。

items.def: to crash a vehicle and damage it so badly that it is not worth repairing
items.zh: 指使交通工具彻底毁坏

senses.def: the parts of a vehicle, building, etc. that remain after it has been badly damaged or destroyed
senses.zh: （车辆等的）残骸；（建筑物等的）废墟

examples.en: A few survivors were pulled from the wreckage.
examples.zh: 从废墟中扒出了几个幸存者。

examples.en: Pieces of wreckage were found ten miles away from the scene of the explosion.
examples.zh: 在离爆炸现场十英里的地方发现了残骸碎片。

examples.en: Could nothing be rescued from the wreckage of her dreams?
examples.zh: 难道从她那破灭的梦想中就找不出一丝希望了吗？

senses.def: a person who destroys another person’s plans, relationship, etc.
senses.zh: （对他人计划、关系等的）破坏者

examples.en: She saw him as the wrecker of all her dreams.
examples.zh: 她把他视为她所有梦想的破坏者。

senses.def: a vehicle used for moving other vehicles that have been damaged in an accident

examples.en: the wrecker’s yard
examples.zh: 拆车场，汽车报废场

senses.def: a heavy metal ball that hangs from a crane
senses.zh: （悬挂于吊车供拆除建筑物用的）破碎球，落锤

senses.def: a very small brown bird
to pull or twist

examples.en: The bag was wrenched from her grasp.
examples.zh: 那个包从她紧握的手里被夺了出来。

examples.en: He grabbed Ben, wrenching him away from his mother.
examples.zh: 他抓住本，把他从他母亲那里一把抢走了。

examples.en: Guy wrenched his mind back to the present.
examples.zh: 盖伊的思绪猛地回到现在。

examples.en: They wrenched the door open.
examples.zh: 他们猛地把门拉开了。

examples.en: She managed to wrench herself free.
examples.zh: 她终于设法挣脱出来。

senses.def: to twist

examples.en: She wrenched her knee when she fell.
examples.zh: 她跌倒时把膝盖扭伤了。

examples.en: I slipped and wrenched my ankle quite badly.
examples.zh: 我滑倒了，脚踝严重扭伤。

senses.def: to make somebody feel great pain or unhappiness, especially so that they make a sound or cry
senses.zh: 使痛苦，使十分难过（尤指以致哭喊出声）

examples.en: His words wrenched a sob from her.
examples.zh: 他的话使得她难过得抽泣起来。

examples.en: a wrenching experience
examples.zh: 苦难的经历

examples.en: Her words wrenched at my heart.
examples.zh: 她的话使得我心如刀绞。

senses.def: a metal tool with a special shape at the end for holding and turning things, including one that can be changed to fit objects of different sizes, also called a monkey wrench
pain or unhappiness that you feel when you have to leave a person or place that you love

examples.en: Leaving home was a terrible wrench for me.
examples.zh: 对我来说离开家是件十分痛苦的事。

senses.def: a sudden and violent twist

examples.en: She stumbled and gave her ankle a painful wrench.
examples.zh: 她绊了一跤，把脚踝崴得很痛。

senses.def: (to cause) a delay or problem with something that somebody is planning or doing
(to cause) a delay or problem with something that somebody is planning or doing
to take something such as power or control from somebody/something with great effort

examples.en: They attempted to wrest control of the town from government forces.
examples.zh: 他们企图从政府军手中夺取对这个城镇的控制权。

senses.def: to take something from somebody that they do not want to give, suddenly or violently

examples.en: He wrested the gun from my grasp.
examples.zh: 他把枪从我手里抢走了。

senses.def: to fight somebody by holding them and trying to throw or force them to the ground, sometimes as a sport

examples.en: As a boy he had boxed and wrestled.
examples.zh: 他小时候练过拳击和摔跤。

examples.en: Armed guards wrestled with the intruder.
examples.zh: 武装警卫和闯入者扭打起来。

examples.en: She tried to wrestle with her attacker.
examples.zh: 她试图与袭击者摔跤。

examples.en: Shoppers wrestled the raider to the ground.
examples.zh: 购物的人把抢劫者摔倒在地上。

senses.def: to struggle physically to move or manage something
senses.zh: 努力移动（或操纵）；用力对付

examples.en: He wrestled with the controls as the plane plunged.
examples.zh: 飞机向下冲时，他竭力控制住操纵装置。

examples.en: She wrestled the keys out of the ignition.
examples.zh: 她使劲把插在点火装置上的钥匙拔下来。

senses.def: to struggle to deal with something that is difficult
senses.zh: 奋力对付；努力处理；全力解决

examples.en: She had spent the whole weekend wrestling with the problem.
examples.zh: 她整个周末都在绞尽脑汁处理这个问题。

examples.en: We wrestled for hours with the problem of which job to do first.
examples.zh: 我们为先做哪项工作的问题争论了好几个小时。

examples.en: She has been wrestling to raise the money all year.
examples.zh: 她一年来一直在想方设法筹集这笔资金。

senses.def: a person who takes part in the sport of wrestling
a person that you feel sympathy for or are sad about

examples.en: a poor wretch
examples.zh: 可怜的人

examples.en: The poor wretch has lost his mother.
examples.zh: 这个可怜的人失去了他的母亲。

senses.def: an evil, unpleasant or annoying person
senses.zh: 恶棍；坏蛋；无赖；无耻之徒

examples.en: The little wretches have splashed water all over the bathroom.
examples.zh: 这群小家伙把浴室里的水溅得到处都是。

senses.def: feeling ill or unhappy
senses.zh: 感到不适的；难受的；不愉快的

examples.en: You look wretched—what's wrong?
examples.zh: 你看起来愁眉苦脸的，怎么啦？

examples.en: I felt wretched about the way things had turned out.
examples.zh: 事情落了这么个结局，我感到很难受。

examples.en: She looked thoroughly wretched.
examples.zh: 她看上去非常沮丧。

senses.def: extremely bad or unpleasant

examples.en: She had a wretched time of it at school.
examples.zh: 她上学时的日子十分难熬。

examples.en: The animals are kept in the most wretched conditions.
examples.zh: 这些动物的饲养条件极其恶劣。

senses.def: making you feel sympathy or making you sad

examples.en: She finally agreed to have the wretched animal put down.
examples.zh: 她最后同意用药结束这个可怜的动物的生命。

senses.def: used to show that you think that somebody/something is extremely annoying
senses.zh: （表示憎恶）该死的，无法容忍的

examples.en: Is it that wretched woman again?
examples.zh: 这又是那个该死的女人吗？

senses.def: in a way that shows you feel very ill or unhappy
senses.zh: 感到不适地；难受地；不愉快地

examples.en: ‘I’m so sorry,’ she said wretchedly.
examples.zh: “我很抱歉，”她可怜兮兮地说。

senses.def: very badly; to a very bad degree

examples.en: They were wretchedly under-equipped for such a journey.
examples.zh: 他们对于这样的旅程装备严重不足。

senses.def: a feeling of being very ill or unhappy
senses.zh: 感到不适的；难受的；不愉快的

examples.en: I have had periods of wretchedness in my life that I have kept hidden from the outside world.
examples.zh: 我一生中也曾经历过一些不幸的时期，但我一直向外界隐瞒这些不幸的时期。

senses.def: extremely bad or unpleasant conditions

examples.en: The wretchedness and poverty they encountered made a deep impression.
examples.zh: 他们所遭遇的不幸和贫穷给他们留下了深刻的印象。

senses.def: to twist

examples.en: The baby was wriggling around on my lap.
examples.zh: 婴儿在我大腿上扭来扭去。

examples.en: She wriggled her toes.
examples.zh: 她扭动着脚趾。

senses.def: to move somewhere by twisting
senses.zh: 蠕动；甩动而行；蜿蜒行进

examples.en: The fish wriggled out of my fingers.
examples.zh: 那条鱼从我指缝中一甩身溜走了。

examples.en: She managed to wriggle free.
examples.zh: 她设法扭动着挣脱了。

examples.en: They wriggled their way through the tunnel.
examples.zh: 他们在地道中蜿蜒行进。

examples.en: He wriggled himself into a comfortable position.
examples.zh: 他扭动着身子，摆出一个舒服的姿势。

senses.def: an act of wriggling
to avoid doing something that you should do, especially by thinking of clever excuses
senses.zh: 耍滑不做，逃避（应做的事）

examples.en: He tried desperately to wriggle out of giving a clear answer.
examples.zh: 他竭力支支吾吾不给予明确的回答。

examples.zh: 当交易签订合同时，买方仍有一些回旋余地。

examples.en: The amendment leaves no wriggle room for lawmakers.
examples.zh: 该修正案没有给立法者留下任何回旋余地。

examples.zh: 她眼角上出现了鱼尾纹。

senses.def: a small fold that you do not want in a piece of cloth or paper

examples.en: I tried to iron out the wrinkles in my shirt.
examples.zh: 我设法将衬衫上的褶皱熨平。

examples.en: I went through my presentation to iron out any wrinkles (= to correct any parts that were not quite right).
examples.zh: 我将报告从头至尾检查了一遍，看看还有没有什么问题。

examples.zh: 她厌恶地皱起鼻子。

examples.zh: 他全神贯注地锁紧眉头。

examples.zh: 他咧嘴一笑满脸都是皱纹。

examples.zh: 他大力腕射，球越过守门员，使他们获得领先。

examples.zh: 他戴着一条反种族歧视的腕带。

examples.zh: 出售这些腕带是为了提高人们对“让贫困成为历史”活动的认识。

examples.zh: 她的腕表发出哔哔声。

examples.zh: 这家公司因违约已接到法院令状。

examples.zh: 我们一心想传讯这家报纸。

examples.zh: 有些国家的儿童到了六岁才开始学习读书写字。

examples.en: Please write in pen on both sides of the paper.
examples.zh: 请用钢笔在纸的正反两面书写。

examples.zh: 我没有笔可以写字。

examples.zh: 请把名字写在纸的顶端。

examples.zh: 老师把答案写在黑板上。

examples.zh: b 错写成 d 了。

examples.zh: 写小说；写歌；编写计算机程序

examples.en: to write an article/essay
examples.zh: 写一篇文章

examples.zh: 《愤怒的葡萄》是谁写的？

examples.zh: 他希望有一天写一部关于自己经历的书。

examples.zh: 文稿写得非常好。

examples.en: The play was originally written for British television.
examples.zh: 该剧最初是为英国电视台编写的。

examples.zh: 我本想去旅行，然后把见闻写下来。

examples.en: He writes for the ‘New Yorker’ (= works as a writer).
examples.zh: 他为《纽约客》撰稿。

examples.en: No decision has been made at the time of writing.

examples.zh: 她为他写了几首诗。

examples.zh: 再见！别忘了写信。

examples.zh: 特此致函询问有关语言课程事宜。

examples.en: She wrote to him in France.
examples.zh: 她给他往法国写信。

examples.en: I wrote a letter to the Publicity Department.
examples.zh: 我给宣传部写了一封信。

examples.en: I wrote the Publicity Department a letter.
examples.zh: 我给宣传部写了一封信。

examples.en: She wrote that they were all fine.
examples.zh: 她信上说他们一切安好。

examples.en: Write me while you're away.
examples.zh: 你外出期间给我写信。

examples.en: He wrote me that he would be arriving Monday.
examples.zh: 他给我写信说他将于星期一到达。

examples.en: They wrote thanking us for the present.
examples.zh: 他们写信来感谢我们赠送的礼物。

senses.def: to state the information or the words mentioned

examples.en: The author writes that this theory has now been disproved.
examples.zh: 作者写道，这一理论现已被证明不成立。

examples.en: Ancient historians wrote of a lost continent beneath the ocean.
examples.zh: 古代史学家写过一片沉没海底的大陆。

examples.en: She wrote of her life in Africa.
examples.zh: 她写了她在非洲的生活。

examples.en: ‘Of all my books,’ wrote Dickens, ‘I like this the best.’
examples.zh: 狄更斯写道：“在我所有的书中，我最喜欢这本。”

senses.group: state in writing 书面陈述

senses.def: to put information in the appropriate places on a form

examples.en: to write (out) a cheque
examples.zh: 开一张支票

examples.en: The doctor wrote her a prescription for more antibiotics.
examples.zh: 医生又给她开了些抗生素。

examples.en: I'll write you out a receipt.
examples.zh: 我来给你开一张收据。

senses.def: to record data in the memory of a computer

examples.en: An error was reported when he tried to write data to the file for the first time.
examples.zh: 当他第一次尝试把数据写入文档时，报告说有错。

senses.def: to work correctly or in the way mentioned

examples.en: This pen won't write.
examples.zh: 这支钢笔不好使。

senses.def: to be very obvious to other people from the expression on somebody’s face
senses.zh: 形之于色；表现得十分明显

examples.en: Guilt was written all over his face.
examples.zh: 他满脸愧疚。

senses.def: to show clearly the quality mentioned or the influence of the person mentioned
senses.zh: 明显有（某性质）；显然受到（某人影响）

examples.en: It was a performance with star quality written all over it.
examples.zh: 这次演出显然明星气派十足。

examples.en: This essay has got Mike written all over it.
examples.zh: 这篇散文俨然是迈克的手笔。

senses.def: not especially good; ordinary

examples.en: The team’s performance was nothing to write home about.
examples.zh: 这支球队的表现不值得一提。

senses.def: having no value, especially legally, or because one of the people involved has no intention of doing what they said they would
used when you are stating that there is nothing more that can be said about something or that something is completely finished
senses.zh: （表示没有其他要说或某事已彻底结束）就这么多，到此结束

examples.en: We were doing well but we ran out of money and that’s all she wrote.
examples.zh: 我们做得很好，但我们没钱了，这就是她写的。

items.idm: be written all over somebody’s face

senses.def: to be very obvious to other people from the expression on somebody’s face
senses.zh: 形之于色；表现得十分明显

examples.en: Guilt was written all over his face.
examples.zh: 他满脸愧疚。

items.idm: have something/somebody written all over it/somebody

senses.def: to show clearly the quality mentioned or the influence of the person mentioned
senses.zh: 明显有（某性质）；显然受到（某人影响）

examples.en: It was a performance with star quality written all over it.
examples.zh: 这次演出显然明星气派十足。

examples.en: This essay has got Mike written all over it.
examples.zh: 这篇散文俨然是迈克的手笔。

senses.def: not especially good; ordinary

examples.en: The team’s performance was nothing to write home about.
examples.zh: 这支球队的表现不值得一提。

items.idm: not worth the paper it’s written/printed on

senses.def: having no value, especially legally, or because one of the people involved has no intention of doing what they said they would
used when you are stating that there is nothing more that can be said about something or that something is completely finished
senses.zh: （表示没有其他要说或某事已彻底结束）就这么多，到此结束

examples.en: We were doing well but we ran out of money and that’s all she wrote.
examples.zh: 我们做得很好，但我们没钱了，这就是她写的。

senses.def: to write somebody a letter or an email replying to their letter or email
senses.zh: （给某人）写回信，回复电子邮件

examples.en: I'm afraid I never wrote back.
examples.zh: 我恐怕从未写过回信。

examples.en: She wrote back saying that she couldn't come.
examples.zh: 她回信说她来不了。

examples.en: She wrote back to him the next day.
examples.zh: 她第二天就给他回信了。

senses.def: a situation where an asset
senses.zh: （对呆账的）拨回；拨回资产的账面值

senses.def: to write something on paper, especially in order to remember or record it

examples.en: Write down the address before you forget it.
examples.zh: 把地址记下来，免得忘了。

examples.en: I'd better write this down, otherwise I'll forget it.
examples.zh: 我最好把它写下来，否则就忘了。

senses.def: to reduce the value of assets
senses.zh: 减记，划减（资产的账面价值）

examples.en: All stock over six months old was written down to 50%.
examples.zh: 所有超过六个月的存货价格都减记50%。

examples.en: the written-down value of the stock
examples.zh: 股票的减记价值

senses.def: a reduction in the value of assets
senses.zh: （资产等账面价值的）减记，划减

examples.en: a £100 000 write-down in the value of the property
examples.zh: 财产价值减记10万英镑

senses.def: to write to an organization or a company, for example to ask about something or to express an opinion
senses.zh: 致函（某机构）（表达意见等）

examples.en: I'll write in for more information.
examples.zh: 我要写信索取更详细的材料。

examples.en: She wrote in to the BBC to complain.
examples.zh: 她写信给BBC抱怨。

senses.def: to add an extra name to your voting paper in an election in order to be able to vote for them
senses.zh: （在选票上）写上非候选人姓名

senses.def: a vote for somebody who is not an official candidate in an election, in which you write their name on your ballot paper

a candidate in an election for public office whose name is not printed on the official list of candidates, usually because they have not been selected by a political party. People voting for such a candidate must therefore write the candidate's name on the voting paper. Some use this write-in vote
senses.zh: 非推荐候选人公职选举中未被列为正式候选人，通常因其未被政党选中。若要投票给此类候选人，须将其姓名写在选票上。有些人会写下荒唐的名字，以示抗议。

senses.def: to include a rule or condition in a contract or an agreement when it is made

examples.en: A penalty clause was written into the contract.
examples.zh: 在合同中写入了一项罚款条款。

examples.en: He had an extra clause written into his contract.
examples.zh: 他在合同中写入了一个附加条款。

senses.def: to write to an organization or a company, usually in order to ask them to send you something
senses.zh: 致函（某机构）（索取资料等）

examples.en: I've written off for the catalogue.
examples.zh: 我已去函索取商品目录。

examples.en: He decided to write off for the brochure.
examples.zh: 他决定写信索取小册子。

senses.def: to cancel a debt; to recognize that something is a failure, has no value, etc.

examples.en: to write off a debt/an investment
examples.zh: 注销一笔债务／一项投资

senses.def: to damage something, especially a vehicle, so badly that it cannot be repaired or would cost more to repair than to replace

examples.en: He’s written off two cars this year.
examples.zh: 他今年撞毁了两辆车。

senses.def: to decide that somebody/something is a failure or not worth paying any attention to
senses.zh: 认定…失败（或没有价值、不可救药等）

examples.en: Don't write me off as a failure just because of that one time when things didn't go right.
examples.zh: 不要因为有一次事情进展不顺利就认为我是个失败者。

senses.def: a vehicle that has been so badly damaged in an accident that cannot be repaired or would cost more to repair than to replace

examples.en: She survived the crash with minor injuries, but the car was a write-off.
examples.zh: 她在碰撞中幸存，受了点儿轻伤，但汽车报废了。

senses.def: a period of time during which you do not achieve anything

examples.en: With meetings and phone calls, yesterday was a complete write-off.
examples.zh: 昨天都在开会和打电话，瞎忙了一天。

senses.def: an act of cancelling a debt and accepting that it will never be paid
to write something on paper, including all the details, especially a piece of work or an account of something
to remove a character from a regular series on television or radio
senses.zh: 去掉（系列电视剧或广播剧中的角色）

examples.en: She was written out after 20 years in the role.
examples.zh: 她在扮演这个角色20年后就被淘汰了。

senses.def: to protect the information on a computer disk from being changed or deleted
to record something in writing in a full and complete form, often using notes that you made earlier

examples.en: to write up your notes/the minutes of a meeting
examples.zh: 把笔记／会议记录整理成文

examples.en: They had to do a survey of the island and write up their findings.
examples.zh: 他们必须对该岛进行调查并写下调查结果。

senses.def: an article in a newspaper or magazine in which somebody writes what they think about a new book, play, product, etc.

examples.en: The performance got a good write-up in the local press.
examples.zh: 当地报纸刊登了赞扬这次演出的评论文章。

senses.def: a person whose job is writing books, stories, articles, etc.

examples.en: Who's your favourite writer?
examples.zh: 你最喜欢的作家是谁？

examples.en: a travel/cookery/science fiction writer
examples.zh: 游记作家；写菜谱的人；科幻作家

examples.en: a freelance feature writer for ‘Time’ magazine
examples.zh: 《时代》周刊的自由专题撰搞人

examples.en: writers of poetry/fiction
examples.zh: 诗歌/小说作家

examples.en: the first Russian writer to win the Nobel Prize for Literature
examples.zh: 首位获得诺贝尔文学奖的俄罗斯作家

examples.en: She left her job to become a full-time writer.
examples.zh: 她辞去了工作，成为一名全职作家。

senses.def: a person who has written a particular thing

examples.en: the writer of this letter
examples.zh: 写这封信的人

examples.en: I used to be a prolific letter writer.
examples.zh: 我曾经是一位多产的写信人。

senses.def: a person who forms letters in a particular way when they are writing

examples.en: a messy writer
examples.zh: 书写潦草的人

senses.def: a problem that writers sometimes have when they cannot think of what to write and have no new ideas
senses.zh: （写作人的）灵感障碍，神思枯竭，写作笔障

examples.en: He's just published a new novel after two years of writer's block.
examples.zh: 在经历了两年的写作障碍后，他刚刚出版了一本新小说。

senses.def: a pain or stiff feeling in the hand caused by writing for a long time
senses.zh: 书写痉挛（长时间写字造成的手部疼痛或僵硬感）

senses.def: to twist
senses.zh: （常指因剧痛不停地）扭动，翻滚

examples.en: She was writhing around on the floor in agony.
examples.zh: 她痛得在地板上直打滚。

examples.en: The snake writhed and hissed.
examples.zh: 那蛇蠕动着，发出嘶嘶的声音。

examples.en: He was writhing (= suffering a lot) with embarrassment.
examples.zh: 他难堪得无地自容。

writing is on the wall | see the writing: @@@LINK=the writing is on the wall | see the writing on the wall

senses.def: a piece of furniture with a surface for writing on and often separate sections for pens and paper
paper for writing letters on
not right or correct
senses.zh: 错误的；不对的；不正确的

examples.en: I got all the answers wrong.
examples.zh: 我的答案全都错了。

examples.en: He was driving on the wrong side of the road.
examples.zh: 他开车行驶在道路逆行的一侧。

examples.en: Sorry, I must have dialled the wrong number.
examples.zh: 对不起，我一定是拨错电话号码了。

examples.en: You're holding the camera the wrong way up!
examples.zh: 你把照相机拿颠倒了！

examples.en: That picture is the wrong way round.
examples.zh: 那幅画挂反了。

examples.en: I soon realised I'd taken a wrong turn.
examples.zh: 我很快就意识到拐错弯了。

examples.en: He got all his calculations wrong.
examples.zh: 他全都算错了。

examples.en: The information is just plain wrong.
examples.zh: 这些信息完全是错误的。

senses.def: not right about something/somebody

examples.en: I think she lives at number 44, but I could be wrong.
examples.zh: 我想她是住在 44 号，不过我可能记错了。

examples.en: You were wrong about Tom; he's not married after all.
examples.zh: 你把汤姆的情况搞错了，他根本没结婚。

examples.en: We were wrong to assume that she'd agree.
examples.zh: 我们错误地以为她会同意。

examples.en: She would prove him wrong (= prove that he was wrong) whatever happened.
examples.zh: 不论发生的是什么事，她都会证明他是错的。

examples.en: Correct me if I'm wrong (= I may be wrong) but didn't you say you two knew each other?
examples.zh: 我若说错了请你纠正，你不是说过你们彼此认识吗？

examples.en: If you think I'm happy, you're dead wrong.
examples.zh: 如果你以为我心情很好，就大错特错了。

examples.en: You think you've beaten me but that's where you're wrong.
examples.zh: 你以为已经赢了我了，可你错就错在这里。

examples.en: ‘I thought this might interest you because I know you like boxing.’ ‘You're not wrong (= you are absolutely right). I love boxing.’
examples.zh: “我认为这可能会让你感兴趣，因为知道你喜欢拳击。”“完全正确。我喜欢拳击。

senses.def: causing problems or difficulties; not as it should be
senses.zh: 引起问题（或麻烦）；有毛病；不正常

examples.en: Is anything wrong? You look worried.
examples.zh: 出了什么事？看你愁眉苦脸的样子。

examples.en: ‘What's wrong?’ ‘Oh, nothing.’
examples.zh: “哪儿不舒服？”“噢，没事。”

examples.en: There's something wrong with the printer.
examples.zh: 打印机出了故障。

examples.en: I have something wrong with my foot.
examples.zh: 我的脚有点儿不对劲。

examples.en: The doctor could find nothing wrong with him.
examples.zh: 医生查不出他有什么病。

senses.def: not suitable, right or what you need
senses.zh: 不合适的；不适当的；不合意的

examples.en: He's the wrong person for the job.
examples.zh: 他不适合做这项工作。

examples.en: She's simply wrong for this job.
examples.zh: 她根本不适合这份工作。

examples.en: I realized that it was the wrong thing to say.
examples.zh: 我意识到说这话不恰当。

examples.en: Most people think that the country is heading in the wrong direction.
examples.zh: 大部分人认为国家走错了方向。

examples.en: It was his bad luck to be in the wrong place at the wrong time (= so that he got involved in trouble without intending to).
examples.zh: 算他倒霉，在错误的时间出现在错误的地方。

examples.en: We don't want this document falling into the wrong hands.
examples.zh: 我们不想让这份文件落入不对路的人手里。

examples.en: She's all wrong for you.
examples.zh: 她完全不适合你。

senses.def: not morally right or honest

examples.en: This man has done nothing wrong.
examples.zh: 这位男子没有做过不正当的事。

examples.en: It is wrong to tell lies.
examples.zh: 说谎是不道德的。

examples.en: It's morally wrong to kill somebody.
examples.zh: 杀人在道德上是错误的。

examples.en: It was wrong of me to get so angry.
examples.zh: 我不该发这么大脾气。

examples.en: What's wrong with eating meat?
examples.zh: 吃肉有什么不对？

examples.en: There's nothing inherently wrong with this type of nostalgia.
examples.zh: 这种怀旧本身没什么不当之处。

examples.en: It is wrong that he should not be punished for what he did.
examples.zh: 他的所作所为竟可不受惩罚，这太不公平了。

senses.def: to support somebody/something that is not successful
senses.zh: 下错赌注（支持了失败的一方或事情）

senses.def: to have the wrong idea about how to get or achieve something
senses.zh: 把方法搞错（或想偏）；走错路线

examples.en: You're barking up the wrong tree if you're expecting us to lend you any money.
examples.zh: 你要是指望我们借钱给你，你是走错庙门了。

senses.def: from or living in a poor area or part of town
senses.zh: 来自（城里的）贫民区；住在贫穷的地区（或城区）

senses.def: to start a relationship well/badly

examples.en: I seem to have got off on the wrong foot with the new boss.
examples.zh: 看来我和新老板的关系一开头就不好。

senses.def: to make somebody pleased with you/annoyed with you
senses.zh: 讨得某人的欢心；惹得某人恼怒

senses.def: to be in a bad mood for the whole day for no particular reason
senses.zh: （无缘由地）一起床就整天情绪不好

senses.def: to understand something in the wrong way
to do, say or write something that is suitable/not suitable for a particular occasion
senses.zh: 做（或说、写）得得体／不得体

examples.en: It is a bizarre tale and the author hits just the right note of horror and disbelief.
examples.zh: 这是一个离奇的故事，作者恰到好处地表达了恐惧和难以置信。

examples.en: Unfortunately, the president struck the wrong note in his speech, ignoring the public mood.
examples.zh: 不幸的是，总统在讲话中语调错误，无视公众情绪。

senses.def: almost correct

examples.en: Your guess wasn't far out at all.
examples.zh: 你猜得几乎一点不错。

examples.en: They weren't far out with their estimate of 100 000.
examples.zh: 他们的估计数字为 100 000，并不算太远。

examples.en: You're not far wrong when you say he's the richest guy in town.
examples.zh: 当你说他是镇上最富有的人时，你并没有大错。

senses.def: younger or older than 40, 50, etc. years of age
senses.zh: 不到／已过 40 岁（或 50 岁等）

senses.def: thinking or behaving in the right/wrong way
senses.zh: 思路对头／不对头；做法对路／不对路

examples.en: We haven’t found a cure yet—but we are on the right track.
examples.zh: 我们还没有找到治疗方法，但我们正走在正确的道路上。

examples.en: The new manager successfully got the team back onto the right track.
examples.zh: 新教练成功地将球队又带上正轨。

examples.en: The police were on the wrong track when they treated the case as a revenge killing.
examples.zh: 警方将案件当作仇杀案来办理是搞错了方向。

senses.def: in trouble with the police
to make somebody annoyed or angry, often without intending to, by doing or saying something that offends them

examples.en: She tends to rub people up the wrong way.
examples.zh: 她常常以错误的方式惹恼别人。

senses.def: to be offended by a remark that was not intended to be offensive

examples.en: Don't take this the wrong way, but maybe you're trying a bit too hard.
examples.zh: 不要误解这一点，但也许你有点太努力了。

senses.def: in a way that produces a result that is not correct or that you do not want

examples.en: My name is spelt wrong.
examples.zh: 我的名字给拼错了。

examples.en: The program won't load. What am I doing wrong?
examples.zh: 这程序载入不了。我哪里出错了？

examples.en: I was trying to apologize but it came out wrong (= what I said sounded wrong).
examples.zh: 我是想要道歉，可是话一出口却变了味儿。

examples.en: ‘I thought you were going out.’ ‘Well you must have thought wrong, then!’
examples.zh: “我原以为你要出去呢。”“啊，那你一定是想错了！”

senses.def: to not understand correctly what somebody means or what they are
senses.zh: 误会，误解，曲解（某人的意思或为人）

examples.en: Don’t get me wrong (= do not be offended by what I am going to say), I think he’s doing a good job, but…
examples.zh: 别误解我，我认为他活儿干得不错，不过…

senses.def: to not understand a situation correctly

examples.en: No, you've got it all wrong. She's his wife.
examples.zh: 不，你完全误会了。她是他的妻子。

examples.en: You've got it all wrong. I never meant to imply that you were responsible.
examples.zh: 你完全误解了，我从来都没想暗示你负有责任。

senses.def: to make a mistake with something

examples.en: I must have got the figures wrong.
examples.zh: 我一定是把数字给搞错了。

examples.en: It looks like they got their predictions wrong again.
examples.zh: 看来他们的预测又错了。

senses.def: to make a mistake
senses.zh: 犯错误；做错事；搞错；弄错

examples.en: If you do what she tells you, you won't go far wrong.
examples.zh: 你要是按照她说的做，就不会出大差错。

examples.en: Where did we go wrong with those kids (= what mistakes did we make for them to behave so badly)?
examples.zh: 我们在什么地方把这些孩子惯坏了？

senses.def: to stop working correctly

examples.en: My watch keeps going wrong.
examples.zh: 我的表不断地出毛病。

senses.def: to experience problems or difficulties

examples.en: The relationship started to go wrong when they moved abroad.
examples.zh: 移居国外后，他们的关系开始出现问题了。

examples.en: What else can go wrong (= what other problems are we going to have)?
examples.zh: 还会出现什么问题？

examples.en: What went wrong? You were doing really well.
examples.zh: 什么地方出了错？你做得非常好。

examples.en: Something has gone badly wrong.
examples.zh: 出了严重的问题。

examples.en: to go terribly/seriously wrong
examples.zh: 出大问题

senses.def: to make a mistake
senses.zh: 犯错误；做错事；搞错；弄错

examples.en: In the last two games he has hardly put a foot wrong.
examples.zh: 他在上两局比赛中几乎一点错都没有出。

senses.def: used to say that something will always be acceptable in a particular situation
senses.zh: 绝对不会出错；绝不会有问题

examples.en: For a quick lunch you can't go wrong with pasta.

senses.def: (1916-1999) one of the greatest violinists
senses.zh: （1916-1999）是20世纪最伟大的小提琴家之一。他出生于美国，但在1940年代永久定居英国。他最初以儿童小提琴家而闻名，七岁时在旧金山进行了首次公开表演。后来，包括威廉·沃尔顿（William Walton）等著名作曲家为他专门创作了许多作品。1963年，梅纽因开办了一家有特殊音乐能力的儿童学校。他还是指挥和指挥音乐节，以及人道主义主题的写作和广播。他于1987年被任命为骑士，并于1993年被任命为终身陪伴。
